thought the food here was very good, but my gripe was with the service.  when my entree came out, i ordered a beer to go with it.  unfortunately, i didn't get that beer until i had finished eating.  i ordered the prime rib which was great, but the wedge salad was my favorite part of the meal.  i'd give this place 3.5 stars if i could because of the service, but i'll round up because of the food.  i'm hoping the service is fixed and am giving them the benefit of the doubt because they just opened.

I wish I could pack this place up and take it home with me. Great drinks, great food, and great staff. Atmosphere is kick-ass too! The food is basically modern interpretations of southern comfort food (and vegetarian friendly for my fellow veggies out there). Though it's a secret I kind of want to keep to myself, I can't give this place enough love.

Just moved to Nashville from Chicago 2 years ago. Wanted so much to love the pizza here but have several bad experience.  Some with the staff and some with the food.  The last order was the biggest disappointment.  Ordered the deep dish with spinach and the spinach on the pizza was burnt.  When I open the box the spinach looked black and sure enough when I tried it, all I could taste was burnt spinach.  Another experience was a thin crust with sausage and mushroom.  Pizza had no mushroom and very little sausage.  This was after they messed up my order to begin with and I had to wait an additional 35 minutes.  The combo sandwich my husband ordered did not have italian sausage on it but polish sausage.  Trust me he would know the difference.  The pizza isn't cheap so at this point I would rather pay less for bad pizza.

everything was ON POINT. I had the sonora dog which I absolutely loved. The mango marguerita was amazing and hit the spot perfectly. I also had the carne asada caramelos were a hit. Too bad I live in LA because I would go back for their food any day. 

I would have docked them a star just for their dumb hostess with her dumb attitude, but the food more than made up for it. The server we had was great though.

I guess if you like natural flavorless smoothies this is the place to go. The smoothies didn't taste bad but they just didn't taste good. I ended up throwing mine away because I couldn't get by the after taste of every sip, which to me tasted like...tree or grass.

Howl is so much fun! I've been to the location in Boston and this is the perfect addition to the Philly night scene. It took over Bucca de Beppo's lot so it's pretty spacious. Depending on your arrival time you may have to wait in line, but it moves quickly. There's a $5 cover but during their opening month they have a coupon on their Facebook page for free admission. The performers were awesome, but as the first review said they're more like a cover band than dueling pianos. Regardless, very entertaining and a ton of fun to dance and sing along. The area in front of the stage is really loud and gets pretty hot, but the rest of the bar is fine. The drinks were expensive and not strong, which was disappointing. The speciality drink there is the huge bucket of booze, meant to serve 4 people. Tasty, but again, not strong enough. 

If you're looking to sing and dance the night away, come to Howl!

One of the worst experiences of my entire life.  I was stranded in a dark parking lot, by myself, and I am a woman over 50. This is a very, very scary thing to be stranded alone in a dark parking lot.  I called Progressive Roadside Assistance, and they dispatched Big Dave's Towing.  Short story long, things went terribly wrong. A tow truck drove by and did not stop. I contacted Progressive, got patched through to Big Dave's.  Keep in mind I'm scared to death at the time.  Instead of being helpful, they screamed obscenities at me, and then the PURPOSEFULLY endangered my life by telling me that they decided to cancel the call because I was so frightened and scared and they did not want to deal with a frightened woman.

Fortunately, their driver decided to come anyway.  His truck was bigger, and a different color, than the one that had driven by earlier.  He was helpful, professional, and very pleasant to work with.  I wish I could say that the story had a happy ending, but it does not.

While I was waiting I called up a friend and she stayed on the line with me until the first tow truck drove by. After I got home I called her back.  She immediately called Big Dave's Towing and was told, "We don't care if she had gotten raped or not.  She would have deserved it."

What kind of monsters are the people who run Big Dave's Towing?  TO WISH THAT I HAD BEEN RAPED, BEATEN, OR EVEN KILLED BECAUSE I WAS STRANDED IN A DARK PARKING LOT, AT NIGHT, AND SCARED TO DEATH, IS BEYOND LOW.  IT IS PURE EVIL!

I went Marakkesh with my friend. I am really amazed with the atmosphere and delicious Moroccan food. 
I live in NY butI never tasted such a good food. 

The folks and personnel are really good and they love their work,

When I ate the Chicken and lamb with my friend, the degree of happiness was at the highest.

GO THERE WITH A FRIEND AND SHARE HAPPINESS BY ENJOYING THE FOOD

I am gluten and yeast intolerant, so I was in heaven when I found this place. Not only did they have all my normal foods, but I found flax seed pizza dough and vegan cupcakes that were divine. Everything was laid out easy to find. I am now a regular!

This place always has what I need. I've been to Whole Foods, but they don't provide a lot of options for gluten free diners. I have been to Rollin Oats at least once a week to get items for my kitchen. 

I can get Quinoa pasta which is the best gluten free pasta out there in my book, and they have sales occasionally so you can stock up. They also have vegan cheese since I'm lactose intolerant. This is also relatively well priced. 

Overall I find this store to be the only one in the vicinity that truly suits my needs.

I keep coming back here, and it keeps being impeccable. I'll admit, I was a skeptic, mostly because of that fact that Han Dynasty has become a chain throughout Philly, and deserved or not, operations which open up multiple locations can have a reputation for slacking on standards. If they have at Han Dynasty's University City locations, I think my mind might explode.

The interior is really pleasant, and has a very hip vibe. It's a great place to drop in for lunch, and I've never had to wait long for a table. I would go on about the menu, but I've yet to see anything which I would tell people to avoid. You'll notice at the table that there isn't any sauces or salt and pepper, and that's because everything I've gotten has been properly seasoned before it has arrived. The place is great for groups, as the dishes have been designed for sharing. Do it, do it, do it!

i stayed here for five nights including new years eve and I had a great time. It's a Great place to stay, the staff were friendly. They have a social hour on select nights with FREE wines, beers and a nice hot meal. It's one of the best deals in town plus the location is perfect for tourists.

Hotel was pretty clean, rooms were decent size, sheets were not clean. Had a problem with Internet, was told that Internet was per room after paying we were then told it was per device. We had to argue for quite sometime but after talking to manager problem was resolved. Parking is really expensive and garage is "under construction" very unsafe.

Kelp sushi delivered some tasty sushi rolls. I ate the spicy tuna and California rolls. Both were tasty with large pieces of fresh fish within each roll. Ordered takeout over the phone and used a coupon code for $10 off. The order was packed neatly with the rolls tightly wrapped in waxed paper rather than plastic containers. The decor inside was hip and trendy. I would go back with a group and try out more dishes!

On a scale from good to Indian, this place scored a good.  It has a nice ambiance and the buffet has a good selection.  The food was heavy and the flavors are good for arizona, but not really good for Indian food in it's original form.  If you need a fix the buffet will get you in and out fast. Good for AZ.
Their massaman beef and coconut rice are great, flavourful dishes. The beef is tender. Service is fast and friendly.

I agree with the fast friendly service. Just stopped by for a quick carry-out and was pleasantly surprised. I was in and out in record time. 
Once I got home and unwrapped my treasures, I saw the portion size... yay... jackpot for someone like me who likes to pig out...
I had the grilled beef bahn mi and it was excellent. I may order that without the jalapenos since they are quite  strong and fiery. Otherwise the taste is just wonderful. 
Also ordered the vermicelli with beef, which was quite big and equally tasty. 
Yes, I will be back to discover more items on their menu.
Came here for their lunch buffet. Only $8? Yes, please! Staff is friendly. Food is good. Eat here.

Extensive menu and they were pretty busy for a weeknight.  They have a nice private roomFor use and lots of sports decor as expected,  this new location still has some work to do, pretty average sports bar.  House wine was fine but the wings came out much hotter than they were supposed to, even the second time around.  Their bbque sauce is spicy. Service was pretty good.  Nothing terribly special going on here.

We did a dinner cruise. Unfortunately, we picked the one day of our trip with 2 waves of thunderstorms during our cruise!  the jazz band, and passengers, were literally blown off the decks.  Also, we were expecting cajun buffet, but that was not what was served.  We met a lovely couple from Scotland as we huddled on deck.  We would actually give this another try, but would probably opt for the cruise only and would skip dinner.  The short time we got to enjoy the jazz band on deck before the storm blew in was Fantastic!!

So, outside of Mark in NYC, these were the best sliders I've ever had. Add in amazing donuts and it's frankly a bit surprising that I ever left. I'm not typically a fan of the burger/donut combo, but the Croque Monsieur was pretty awesome. Also, the guys serving us were extremely friendly, which was a nice change from your typical hipsteresque spot.

So slow... Waited at the bar to be seated. 30 minutes later we sat down. We waited another 15 minutes to actually stop another waiter to ask for a waiter. She helped us an directed us to another person which we basically had to stop to take our order. The service is unbelievable for what I'm paying. I haven't even gotten the food an I'm so unhappy... So somewhere else!!!

This is the worst tanning salon ever.  Beware!  They tell you everything is included in the membership, but when you want to use a service you have to pay extra.  Then if there is an issue, nobody will return calls and they will do anything to keep charging you.  They try to upsell you everytime you walk in the door!  I'm so happy I cancelled my membership.

Amazing! Delicious! I love Bailey's Range! First tried it a few months ago after moving downtown and I was very impressed. I love that all of their meats are grass-fed and all of their beer is supplied by local breweries. I have been back multiple times and have never been disappointed. The only thing I would change would be to make the burgers bigger. They're a little on the small side. I definitely recommend this restaurant!

If you're after a unique experience, best look elsewhere. If, however, all that you require is a pleasant, clean place to sit and have a reasonably priced meal you should be fine. 

The drip coffee was surprisingly good. Menu selection is reasonable. This is essentially a fairly well-done (if generic, inoffensive) chain restaurant with just the smallest bit of flair when it comes to decor and menu. 

Keep expectations in check and if you're looking for exotic (and expensive) I recommend milktooth (it's amazing).

I made a reservation online 2 or 3 days prior, then the day of I called to confirm.  No problem.  It was a business dinner with clients, I wanted to show them a bit of history of Reno, and according to Yelp; good reviews.

I would give a zero for the service, in particular the 20 something girl at the front.  She is useless, and if that is the first face you see coming in - forget it.  I will never setup another business dinner or lunch there because of this young lady.  She argued, said there was no reservation, rolled her eyes, looked bored, wasn't helpful, and then when all was said and done the reservation WAS there, but she didn't "see" it.  Meanwhile the people are piling up at the door!  

Now are they SO busy on a week night that they can afford to turn a party of 8 away?  Are there really no tables available?  Really?  Or, is the hostess lazy and didn't want to do her JOB?!!  

Never going back, never going to recommend.

Affordable Plumbing is Ultra Professional! 
They call back right away, the times I have used them they arrived earlier then they advertised. Their prices work with your budget, they work fast, they don't need to guess about what the problem is and avoid the wrong fix. When they have serviced our apartment building, we have not needed to call them back for the same problem.

AAAA++++ Highly Recommend!
Best sushi I've had in a VERY long time. Service was awesome and they offer bottomless rolls!
Best Indian food in Boise, bar none. Interesting atmosphere, fresh ingredients, lunch buffet every day. Varied menu. Large selection of beer.

I thought this place was a little stuffy and loaded with tourists. They even made me take off my hat in the dining room(a fedora) but let in 2 jackasses in shorts and flip flops. 
Service was good but it was all too much for my liking. They do make a mean sauzerac. 
We did the prie fixe. Started with Redfish cake(great) and soup of the day(meh). The pork chop was huge and delicious. Seafood stew was alright. Bread pudding was great as was the butterscotch pudding.
Wine pours a bit skimpy for my taste and wasn't a fan of their by the glass offerings.
This was pretty good. I was looking for some Mexican food and found it. Large portions and it came out relatively quick.

Fun breakfast choices (including vegetarian and low carb friendly) with flair, friendly service. Great people watching on the Monon trail if you choose outdoor seating. What's not to love?

New to me(Apr 2014)! - Fresh fried donut holes, generously sized. Share an order as a 'breakfast appetizer'!
Food is ok. They had good Italian sandwiches. Takes a long time to get your food. The place is old looking and could use a remodel. Overall I would come back but its not on the top of my list.

Love this place, love the al pastor tacos, taco Tuesday was so good! $1.50 each taco..awesome deal! My friend got the quesadilla with mushroom and rajas, spicy but really good. The tortillas are amazing, I love this place

Definitely a little divey and could probably use a really good deep cleaning, but I liked the Pines Tavern. Our server was friendly and accommodating and there when we needed her.  My Tavern burger special was tasty, but the burger itself was smaller than expected for $9. Overall, a good first experience. Will try again.

Great service - fixed an amp I thought wasn't worth bothering with for next to nothing - in a couple of hours to boot!
I didn't have a look at much of the merchandise but it looked like cool used stuff and plenty of new accessories  (sticks, heads, strings, cables, etc). My guess is this is the best mom and pop store in Nola.

This is my favorite place for a greasy burger, and I mean that in a good way. Big, juicy, and cooked to perfection, this is where I come when I don't want fast food or something that tastes like it came from a chain restaurant. I've also tried the barbecue and it was excellent. Service isn't fast, and that's ok as that's not why I eat there. Staff is always friendly and attentive. One thing to keep in mind is they only take cash or check, no credit cards (that's how it's been when I go, I'm sure that will change at some point).

Finally got around to this place, after a busy Saturday. Came in and we were seated within 10 minutes , which came to a surprise because the place was packed. Sat down and looked over the menu and decided that I could not possibly pass up the Queso and Guac dip. This was definitely a good choice since the guac was super fresh and the queso was cheesetacular. My only regret was getting the riesling instead of a beer for this meal. My main dish was hard to choose because they had so much to pick from, though  was finally able to decide on the short rib grilled cheese. The sandwich itself was okay, though once I found out they have given what seemed to be a horseradish aioli the dish went from a mediocre sandwich to a richly complex flavored dish that I could not stop eating. In the end the meal was a solid one and my only pique would be that even though we were seated fairly quickly the service was a bit slow. It was a very crowded Saturday so I cannot complain overly much. To sum up as one other reviewer said, this place is like the cheesecake factory without the wait and that is far from a bad thing.

As a member of the Southern Arizona Concierge Network, I was dining at this El Charro location this past week. The decor and ambiance was fabulous, the servers were so very attentive, and the food was delicious! Their Sangria is to die for!! I have been at their other locations several times and this store did not disappoint!
Don't buy if you need delivery and don't have weeks to wait.  Horrible, they give no guarantee and don't care once they get there money.  Don't buy here.

I admit our expectations were high (best children's museum in the world), but we've been to many children's museums and found this one to be good but not great.  Every children's museum needs a large play city (see Tampa, Cleveland, and Dayton museums) and that was lacking here.  Although the museum and exhibits were large, they didn't really seem to spark the imagination as well as COSI in Columbus.  Also, no reciprocal memberships from other children's museums are accepted.  For those to the East, I'd recommend the Boonshoft museum in Dayton.

Uncommonly cool food. Extremely forward thinking and trendy, this relatively new Irish Channel hot spot brings flavor and nuance to an hip community with no pretensions. The artwork and seating arrangements is very inviting. With a great environment to match the laid back lifestyle of the neighborhood, its the perfect place to drop in at random and find no disappointment. 

The donuts are an exceptional presentation of colors and variety, redefining the old conception of the coffee-soaker, deep fried breakfast replacement. Not unlike high end French pastries, the variety of flavors and concoctions is experimental and innovative. Try the maple sriracha. Time and time again, it blows my mind away as one of the most original pastry ideas I've ever come across. 

Their sliders are a hunger cure. Try three different ones every time you come, and you'll probably never have the same combination more than once. Going with the regular selection is a great idea, but don't miss out on selections like beef belly or bulgogi with Kim-chi. 

The staff is extremely gracious and they keep the place very clean, always servicing the huge espresso machine. On that note, they will weigh your espresso before and after brewing to provide the best acidity, all grains coming form Atlanta's 1000 Faces. 

Grab some beer next door at steins and walk over and enjoy. Or grab some donuts and go over to steins for beer. Whatever way you do it, this is a happening weekend spot. 

I look forward to coming here for a long time.

Had the Creole House Shrimp Po Boy, Fried Alligator, and the Caramel Waffle Apple Sunday.  All of it was phenomenal.  Our server was great.  If I'm ever in New Orleans again, I would absolutely come back.  Very cool place.

The restaurant is located in the corner of a strip mall. I ordered fajitas steak and what I was served was the cheapest meat they could pass as steak, by no means was it close to skirt steak. One thing I didn't like for the price was the cheese selection. Mexican Restaurant should serve Mexican cheese, such as fresco or cotija. Instead they serve fajitas with kraft shredded cheddar mix ( I wouldn't even say kraft... best value brand). This food was not authentic and at best mediocre. I wouldn't recommend, but if you end up there it's not torture. I think they need to pay attention to the value of ingredients!

Excellent! They have the best hamburgers in all of New Orleans. However, after saying that be prepared. It's nearly impossible to bite into the burger due to how large it is, but it's well worth it and the price is reasonable ($10.81-total without cheese and it comes with your choice of fries or onion rings). The burger consists of delicious large, thick and juicy burger meat inside a large sesame seed bun which also includes two thick-cut slices of tomato, a thick slice of onion and lots of lettuce and pickles and your choice of condiments. The fries are large, but I usually get their tasty onion rings. Their drive-thru is fast and I live about three blocks from a Metarie location so I like to stop by from time-to-time on the way home from work and eat the meal at home. It's funny, but everytime I order one of their burgers I can't help but think of what an insult it is to the hamburger that places like Burger King or McDonalds and other fast food places offer (dog food on a bun). The shrimp basket is another story... Delicious, but a bit pricey if you get the onion rings to go along with it. Whatever you order I'm sure you won't regret it!

You like a delicious breakfast? THIS is your place! I had a great brunch with 5 friends and we definitely were happy campers! There are do many choices, we all ordered different dishes and shared. We left happy, full, and with some food for the road. We'd definitely return here if we find out way to Nashville again

My friends and I just call this "Fancy Schnucks." The grocery store itself is gorgeous, and its selection cannot be beat. 

But really, this review is for the brunch. Have you been to the brunch?? It's on the mezzanine, and both times I've been it's been nearly deserted. This is a mystery to me. At $19.95 it's a little pricey, but it's a huge buffet with included adult beverage and fresh hot beignets plus waffles made to order. Housemade sausages, local produce, fresh baked goods- I can't say enough good things about this brunch.

Two of us sat at the bar at 8:00 on a Tuesday night, not very busy... and the service was super slow. Waited a few minutes for a bartender to return to the bar. We were finally given drink menus then waited another 10 minutes, (then watched the 2nd/3rd round drinks go out for others at the bar), before we were able to give our 1st round orders. We then asked for food menus. Weren't ready at the first attempt to take our orders and the second attempt was a pretty good while after that. Food, (5 hot n spicy wings @ 50 cents a piece, and a cheddar veggie burger with fries), took over a half an hour. Positives that made this a 3-star rating instead of less: 

1) Food was still hot and enjoyable. It was tasty upper level bar food; though nothing that I'd rave about.

2) Our bartender and other staff we interacted with (hostess and other bartender) were very nice; bartender was talkative but not too attached. She gave great suggestions when I asked about two different app options. She also remembered the lemon for my water (somehow always a big deal to me...it's the little things)! Then when it took a long time for her to bring our check she acknowledged it and apologized for the wait. 

And...

3) Great mixed drinks that were worth the wait!

Overall a great, "happy hour with co-workers" spot.

My brother took me to Philadelphia Archery and Gun Club for my first gun shooting experience.  He's a member here and has tried many of the shooting ranges around and in the city.  He brought along a 9mm and a rifle, an sks? or something.  I don't know I think it was of the Russian assault variety.  He gave me a lot of information in a short period of time and I mostly retained the stuff I needed to know immediately.  

We arrived and were greeted by some lackluster staff that had me show ID and fill out a form before directing us upstairs.  To be fair it was after 7:30 and they close up around 8:30 or 9.  The upstairs gentleman, Mike, was really nice.  He liked my name and said it reminded him of something from Sherlock Holmes or Hopalong Cassidy and then proceeded to show me his dvd case for Hopalong Cassidy.  It was weird but I liked it.   I don't know what would happen if I had gone here without a member or someone skilled with guns so I can't say much about the staff on that level but nice is nice.  It was $5 for me to shoot since I was with a member, apparently Wednesday is ladies night and ladies shoot free so keep that in mind if you were blessed with girly parts. 

The range is smallish, with about eight or so lanes.  Each is equipped with a target holder and controls for moving your target.  My brother brought zombie targets but the range has targets (for sale I think) if you need them.  According to my brother the ammunition is a little pricey but I don't know much about that.  I don't know that I'd go back and shoot again but it was a cool experience and I can scratch it off of my list.
This place was cool, on our first trip out too philly we stopped by this whole little area and it's pretty amazing to see all the history

We stopped in for lunch. We started with the Crawfish Beignet, which is really not so much a Beignet, but excellent none the less. I had a Cajun Cuban with red beans and rice. The Cuban was OK, but far from the best I have had, and the red beans and rice were pretty good also, but not great. My wife had the Drum Crab Stacker which was really quite good. It was drum fish (which was very good), stacked with fried green tomato and a crawfish sauce. Service was great, and lots of great sounding items on the menu in a cozy atmosphere. Really liked it and will be back when in NOLA.

The selection of calzones are very impressive. Went with a group and we shared each other's calzones. They were all excellent. Saw huge salads being served to other tables that looked amazing. The only thing that would have made it 5 stars was the soda selection. No Coke or Pepsi products on the fountain. All the selections were gross. This place needs to nut-up and get a Coke Freestyle machine. Save the goofy sodas for bottles only. Stop doing the hipster fad.

Gross permutations of ramen. I would just go traditional with the ramen joint in China town. This is coming from someone who has been to ramen places in Tokyo and Fukuoka. I don't understand the hype about this place. 

Whatever you do, do not order the cold ramen. I tried it and it was absolutely awful.
Very disappointed.

This place came highly recommended by friends. After a morning of driving, I was ready to devour some amazing food. The boozy milkshake stole the show. My husband had a milkshake without alcohol, which was also stupid good. The fries and the homemade sauces were also delicious. I wish the fries were a bit warmer, but hey, fries are fries! We both got burgers. When looking at the menu, we thought the amount of ingredients would = a ton of flavor, but that wasn't the case. Both burgers, cooked medium, were just okay. Not a ton of flavor, nothing special. They were both beef, so if we went back Id try one of the other meats. All in all, the milkshakes alone are a reason to check this place out!

This is a casual pizza joint.  I needed a little something heartier than a slice of pizza, so I ordered the Veggie Roll.  I'm not sure what makes it a roll rather than a calzone other than it's shape, but it was delicious.  Their marinara is delicious, so I bet their pizza is awesome.  The veggies in the Veggie Roll were all fresh, not frozen or canned, and I always appreciate that.  The staff was friendly enough and my food was cooked really fast.  There weren't a lot of people in there, though, so I don't know how the wait is when it's packed.  I'll definitely be back to try the pie!

It's and ok burger is good but it's one of those things after you eat you feel disgusting like why did I eat that. I've have some good tasty burgers they didn't make me feel so bad afterwards. Three stars because they provide and excellent milkshake. I wouldn't recommend going if you don't plan on getting a shake. All of them have turned out good. My husband enjoyed the tater tots.

This McDonald's don't taste like the others
And i haven't ate a McDonalds in almost a year...
Until now.....thank u

Went here for a concert this last weekend and let me just say that Plush is not plush at all.  It was one of the worst experiences of my life.  I paid $25 for a ticket so I could stand in a very dark, hot room crowded by a bunch of people. There is very limited seating and most of that is on the upper level. Not sure if you pay extra or have to get there early.  There was no air circulation and the acoustics were horrendous.

It is basically a warehouse with a concrete floor.  If you come here, bring earplugs and comfortable shoes otherwise you will leave early like we did hot, sweaty and half deaf. 

Also you will pay about $10 for parking on a lot since street parking is at a premium in this area of midtown.

We did not eat here. They do have cider on tap which was a bonus for my friend who doesn't drink beer.

The four stars I am giving Maynards are for the cocktail I had, a delectable libation combining crushed blackberries and whiskey. 

Potent, sexy and pretty to look at, it melded beautifully with the chic surroundings of Maynard's on a Friday night. Add to this a wild monsoon and you have a cinematic start to a night out.

The passing plates looked divine but I can't attest to their delish factor because all we did was drink. Next time Maynard, next time.
This place is walking distance to my office and the lunch prices are pocket friendly! But the food it's really not so great. Bland and unappealing. I would recommend Thai Kitchen in Maryland Heights!
Great addition to 54th street! This cute little shop is full of unique gifts and home decor. They have everything from candles to furniture, at a variety of price points.

Very cool atmosphere in Philly! We came here on a weekend and the wait was going to be over an hour. We came back during the week and there was still a wait for a table but the bar was open. Honestly we probably had more fun sitting at the bar than if we had a table. I got the veggie burger and my BF got a regular bacon cheese burger. He enjoyed his burger and ranked it in his top 5. I enjoyed the veggie burger and it was quite large, but I quite honestly was wishing for more sauciness or some moisture. I would not say that this was the best veggie burger I have had and for the price I was slightly disappointed. I did, however, immensely enjoy the tater tots! They were crispy on the outside and like mashed potatoes on the inside! Whatever sauce they give you to go with it was delicious as well! All-in-all, I enjoyed my dinner at the bar at Village Whiskey. It is a bit pricey, but if you can swing it I don't think you'll be disappointed!

Have been here 3 times and each time has been spot on. The spring rolls are HUGE. I like the rice paper they use and the shrimp ones are delicious along with the sauce they are served with. The egg rolls were okay, deep fried and standard, so I say go with the spring rolls- shrimp or beef to choose from. My friend always gets the #10 pho, but I branch out and have enjoyed my options each time. I say go for the sandwiches!! They are on the smaller size but they are cheap and tasty. Very fresh veggies and ingredients. The music is tranquil and the lady is super friendly.

This bakery makes magnificent cakes! They are moist, rich, and delicious! I have purchased the almond cake, the gingerbread cake, and a butterscotch cake. Each one was delightful! I highly recommend the gingerbread cake for any holiday gathering! It is a masterpiece!

This is, hands down, my favorite place for breakfast, ever.  There food is truly incredible and very well thought out and executed.  Their hollandaise sauce can not be topped by any other restaurant, and it's different every time you go in there.  

Great for families, kids under six "pay what they weigh", so a #30 kid gets to eat for 30 cents.  We honestly end up paying less to eat hear than McDonalds, and there is no comparison when it comes to the food.

The service is the best.  The hostess knows to put us with Bob before we even open the door, but all the people there are great.  

I have been coming here for over 6 years and have never been disappointed.

my friend and I had reservations and were seated in the last seat on a busy Wednesday night. There was a great 5 piece band playing and it didn't overwhelm the acoustics. The main problem was service...we sat there for 15 minutes as server after server passed us by with no eye contact, and when the server finally came to us our closely seated neighbor bogarted him and out in a drink order and some more food before we could even order a cocktail. You would think that he would have turned and taken our order but it want another ten minutes until he returned and I had given up and gone for cocktails already...which I was happy I did because the bartender out on quite a show of talent in preparing the drinks! The tapas were good, especially the noodles. Eclectic menu, excellent drinks-just don't forget to pack your patience:)
We had 4 different items from the menu and they were all delicious.  Michael our server was excellent.

The server was very nice. The patio was clean (although there were alot of bug bites).  Really not a nice place to enjoy a view.  The food was very bland. Too bad. This could be a nice place but the food is not worth a return trip. I suggest going elsewhere for Italian food.

Best friendliest employees that know the menu. Fantastic antipasatas! I love this place... the vibe, the food, service, patio, and the bar. One tiny complaint is the kitchen is a tad heavy handed with salt and i love salt but sometimes you gotta dial back in riva... still 5 stars. Seriously great service.

I'm visiting my old hometown Philadelphia from NYC for a conference and decided to stop by here for dinner after the next door Olive Garden had me and everyone else in the bar area waiting for any sign of staff for over 5 minutes..but this was a blessing in disguise because I walked back to honeygrow and all I can say is wow this place is amazing! Super easy and fun to order exactly to your liking, and the end result is the most delicious and healthy stir fry you ever had (beats even stir fry sit down and order restaurants like stir crazy in quality, and I love stir crazy)!! And on top of that, the refreshing kale'ata is a nice deal and really hits the spot, and I can only imagine their trademark honeybar is even more nice and will be trying one when I come back tomorrow. Service/staff excellent as well. Only bad thing about honeygrow is now I'm totally disappointed that NYC doesn't have a place like this, nor have I found any of of the free multi-phone charging boxes at this place anywhere (perhaps just too deep a fear of loitering/Philly hospitality in NY?)

I admit, I have walked past this place about 20 times thinking it was a hipster/pretentious hang out. Finally the lady friend, convinced me to give it a chance (despite the sidewalk dj trying way too hard). The first thing I noticed was that every table inside had a reserved sign on it when we walked in at 9, yet no one was seated at these tables (when we left at 1030, two of those tables were occupied).

The bartender(s) were very friendly. We happened to be nerds on an old-fashioned cocktail pub crawl so ordered one here. Our bartender made us some hybrid between a bourbon based old-fashioned and mojito, and I will say this was one of the best drinks I have had. We had to continue our crawl to The Canopy so I couldn't have a second (as the crowd seemed to arrive), but I probably would come back here.

My only complaint (I can't comment on food) is that the dj, while live, wasn't very good. We later walked on over to The Canopy and enjoyed the music much more. That being said, I realize everyone has a different appreciation/taste in music. I love anything on Beach Dr and being close to the bay, and everyone working here seemed nice enough, so I plan on visiting again eventually.

i came here a few times, but this time i got their breakfast croissant panini. wasn't sure to try something different, but this was a great breakfast source. it came with organic eggs, niman ranch bacon, and gruyere cheese on a house baked croissant.

Just had dinner here for the first time. It's so nice to find a small intimate restaurant in Media that cares about quality and friendly . Tori was a great server! So pleasant and helpful! The food was really good! You must try the monkey brains! Don't miss this out of the way find!

We drove way out of our way to get here and to be honest the drive wasn't worth it. No one explained the menu to us, the service was only okay and the food was also only okay...
I would not go out of my way to eat here and I definitely will not go back.
Fresh food, I love it. If you want a Fancy dinner this is a good option also prices are good, service is ok. The crab cake appetizer its really good

I love this place, I always do my nails and I have not found a place I liked this much since my girl Kim in "VIP Nails" in Downtown Chicago.

I have tried a few places in CT but could not find a place where they would do a decent job anywhere.

I highly recommend this salon. Very professional and elegant job. To think I almost past them right by because they are hidden in the far end of a shopping plaza. Next to a bank.

Go see them. You will be very, very happy :o)  

I lost my login for my other acct. This is my review from previous profile.

Excellent meal with exceptional service. Our waiter Kevin was spot on with his suggestions. The Filet Carmine was perfectly cooked and delicious. The Chilean Sea Bass on special was like butter. A great visit from the time we entered. Very friendly staff.

I have been coming to this place for about a year now. I really enjoyed the sushi rolls and appetizers. However, the service has not been the best. It really depends who you get. We were in there today and I was extremely disappointed.  I had an hour and a half for lunch and they were just taking forever. My colleague and I ordered our dessert and 20 mins later it had still not arrived. When I asked them about it and told them we had to get back to work, they were extremely rude and said they had no control over the kitchen. Are you kidding me!!!!!! All it was was ice cream. I can't believe it.

This was a last minute decision and I'm so glad my 9 year old chose it!  I'm not a waffle eater at all, but couldn't resist the bacon and cheese waffle! It was delicious and not too massive.  The kids had m&m's and the marshmallow waffles, two more great choices.  Service was friendly and quick! I would definitely recommend this place for any meal! We came for lunch!  Full diner menu available as well.

One of my favorite places to get Chinese food. I have no clue what these other idiots who gave this place low ratings are talking about but this place is worth checking out for sure. Their fried rices, chicken lo mein and General tso's are awesome. The quality of the chicken and pork they use is of way better quality than most normal Chinese restaurants.
This was the best food we had our entire time on Treasure Island. The service was great, the prices super reasonable, and the food delicious.

We went for Thanksgiving dinner this year, family style. We were sat outside and when booking online through opentable there is no way to state the preference in seating or knowing where we sat. They called a week before and required a credit card on file for reservations which I didn't even know they would do, lucky I answered the phone that night!

We were seated outside, they had plenty of heaters but it was COLD for Tucson and there were leaves on the table and very spread out. I did see empty tables inside however even though we had reservations they would not seat us inside. The server Kenneth was outstanding which really saved my rating on the stars! My family and I were not impressed with the family style main course, it was all on one plate: mashed potatoes, gravy, cranberries, turkey, lamb, and stuffing which didn't make any sense and was really weird! We did get extra of the mashed potatoes and stuffing after asking Kenneth and him seeing my mom's face when we were served via 1 plate for 3 people?! The portions were definitely small but the food was good. Quality great! The leaves definitely fell into our drinks and food which was not a great experience and the train going by every 15 minutes or so was not the perfect quiet family meal I had been hoping.The total bill was $200 for 3 people which may or may not have been worth it? Not sure if we will be going back next year but the experience of the service was outstanding!
My step-son had a super fun time and it was a great bonding experience for us.

My Toad-In-Hole hit the spot with challah French toast and truffle oil- and a perfectly done toad!* I thought the prices were really reasonable, especially considering the fresh seasonal produce (my dish came with salad) and tasty homemade details. I got a side of coleslaw for the heck of it and it was fresh, crisp and nicely spiced.

Staff were fast and friendly but kept it cool, so I didn't feel rushed despite being a solo diner. I'd definitely come back to try their homemade desserts.

*No toads were harmed in the making of my egg.

This place is a adorable small little cafe shop which you will end up sitting with others at a table cause of the space. The waiters and host were very polite and nice. I enjoyed the different variety of breakfast choices they have and also perfect for veggie lovers too. They had really good grits which I loved and i had me some eggs and sausage which was good, they kept serving and filling up our coffee which is always needed on a Sunday morning after a great party weekend. The wait is long I must say and there's nowhere to really stand unless your outside but its worth it for the nice home style southern breakfast and the fresh OJ! which I couldn't stop getting more of. I enjoyed Philly in general but I would def. go back here for some breakfast, its nothing fancy but they add there own little tricks and ingredients to add some more flavor and taste to it.

Excellent... No reservations so short wait... Goat cheese appetizer was fantastic, BLT was incredible (avacado), burger is excellent quality beef. Fries are perfect. You have to have the bread pudding dessert, add french vanilla ice cream. It tastes like a warm fresh donut. Unreal!

We were seated in an oddly lit small room w a party  7 girls at adjacent table that were approx 19-25 yes old and had zero consideration for those around them. Kudos parents way to NOT reach your children respect. We asked the waiter to be moved outside. It was a tad chilly , not terrible though as we had the entire patio to ourselves. The lasagne was very tasty and my wife's shrimp linguine was delicious also. Service was good prices fair. Our experience became 100% more enjoyable after we eliminated the inconsiderate group of loud 20 something's from it. Not the restaurant's fault but worth noting in hopes that one of the girls reads this review and realizes that they aren't the only ones in the room.

I was so excited for this place to open. The first time I ate here it wasn't bad, but I have been back since and was disappointed. Margaritas are ok. Just not fabulous for Mexican food. If they change the quality, it could be better.

The staff here is amazing. I stayed here for two weeks with a big group for work, and management, front desk, servers, and drivers were friendly and accommodating. There is a clean and decently equipped gym with tvs; the laundry room was equipped with 4-5 washers and dryers and a TV; and breakfast offered excellent choices. The stand out is definitely the customer service here. Everyone always had a smile, and they even gave free bottles of cold water, which is a nice touch considering the 90+ degree weather in the summer. The only reason I did not give this place 5 stars is the bedding. This may be more of a preference, but I prefer fluffier blankets (like down) and pillows that do not sink all the way down. It would have also been nice to have some rotating options for breakfast over the course of two weeks. To end on a positive, this hotel has $2-3 happy hour drinks and is located next to a metro stop and chic restaurants.

Came in for lunch and on their menu they have around 15 or so lunch specials from $5.99 to $6.99. Nice. Their staff is so cheerfully friendly. The chips are great, I enjoyed the salsas, one mild and one hot. And I enjoyed the freshly made guac for $2.00 well spent. 4 stars.

My wife had the fish tacos, probably made of Tilapia. We're not huge fans of Tilapia as it is a tad fishy tasting. The tacos weren't bad, just not great, because of the Tilapia. It was small flanks of fish on a small street taco tortilla. She had a grilled and two breaded ones to try. 3 stars.

I had the tacos (?) can't remember the name, but the shells were crispy pan fried. It comes with three so I tried all options: a shredded beef, a hamburger, and a chicken. All were OK. Not great, OK. I actually didn't enjoy the shredded beef that much because since it was twice cooked, it was a bit fibrous and chewy. I just don't like shredded beef, I guess. Your mileage will vary. The hamburger one was OK and so was the chicken. It comes with lettuce, tomato, onion, cheese, and pico, but there is no way you can put it in the taco without breaking the shell into smithereens. So that was kind of a fail. I took a bite and forked some of the lettuce, tomato, onion, cheese, pico into my mouth. I also tried putting it on top of the taco shell sideways and eating it, but that wasn't successful, either. 3 stars.

The specials came with beans and rice. The rice was average. The beans were mixed with red enchilada sauce. I didn't like the resulting flavor. I just wanted some good, lard-laden refried frijoles. Didn't get it. 2 stars.

Got some good ratings here on Yelp. Maybe I'll go back one day and try something else. Otherwise, my 3 star rating is about right for me.

It's been 6 days, and almost all of my gel nail polish has chipped (and it never does on me). It is very thin on the ends, almost as if the lady didn't really paint the ends with color and that's why. I had them painted last Friday night and they were a mess by last Sunday- I tried to go back and get them retouched then but they are closed Sundays. At this point, I can see that doing that wouldn't have helped anyways. Don't waste your time on this place. As soon as other people came in she immediately began rushing, too, which I would not have complained about if the nails had actually lasted.

My husband and I each went here once. We had been going to art plus science since moving to Philadelphia but wanted to try another place just to change things up. My cut was nothing to write home about and in fact I didn't even have that "fresh cut" feeling you usually get. My hair was not styled well and overall my reaction was "meh". My husband got his haircut and when he came home I asked him if he liked it and he said "it's just okay". Apparently the girl did not do any texturizing to his hair that he is used to from art plus science as well as our old salon back home. The stylist also never let him see the back of his head when she was finished. When he came home I noted that it was obvious she didn't do any texturizing or gradation of his hair in the back. His side burns were also uneven. He told the stylist that his hair grows very fast and based on that we were both surprised that she didn't cut it shorter. He will probably need another haircut in 2 weeks. So we were overall unimpressed and will be going back to art plus science. Prices are average to what we spend.

New Orleans isn't a great Mexican food town but I do come here because their queso is awesome and they have a great happy hour. ($2 simple tacos/$4 margs/$5 sangria) I love that they don't use commercial mixes for their margs - they actually make the syrups and mixes themselves.

Watch out for their seasonal specials - when they have watermelon salsa, you must get whatever they are pairing with it. And if you have a sweet tooth, the hazelnut avocado mousse is fantastic.

Pro-tips: the back patio is awesome for al fresco dining. If you need to charge your phone, the bartender will totally hook you up!
Great place to go anytime of the year, but especially in the warmer weather. Great food, service and fun live music.

I think this place is a lil better than Panera Bread. They have a lot of good sandwich, soup and salad options. The strawberry with poppy seed dressing and chicken I had was refreshingly delicious! The steak panini was delish. Their chocolate chip cookie was good and they have a fresh brewed sweet tea!!! Yum!!!

Excellent buffet.  Great variety of excellent food.  I eat at the buffet twice a week (comps). The only reason I didn't give them four stars is they run out of coconut cream pie every day we are there!

I can't believe I've never written a review for Andre Richard Salon!  Andre has been doing my hair for a few years now, and he's the shizzle.  I live out in the 'burbs, but drive 45 minutes into the city every month to visit Andre because I won't let anyone else touch my head now.

My hair is a pain in the a** -- fine and curly, which means the wrong cut either leaves it weighed down and curl-less or looking like a frizzy mushroom.  I have had some cuts ove the years that have left me wanting to shave my head in frustration, so I am super picky.  Andre and his staff have had curly-hair mentoring with the DevaCurl folks, so they GET how to deal with curls.  My hair looks fantastic now, and I don't need to mess with it beyond washing it and throwing in some product.  No exaggeration, people stop me all the time and ask who does my hair.

Besides cuts and color, Andre and his staff are fantastic with dressier 'dos and makeup as well.  Andre has a performance background, and so he loves having fun with makeup and "evening" hair.  They provide styling services for a number of local fashion shows every year; I've been in the salon when it's been full of models getting made up before a show, and their work is superb.  Even with a short cut like mine, Andre has shown me little hints and tricks to funk it up a bit when I want a change.

If you're looking for a salon where people know their stuff, are fun to work with, and make sure you leave there looking awesome, you owe it to yourself to visit Andre Richard.
Awesome food! It was a great atmosphere and the people were so friendly. It wasn't too crowded (I went in the AM) and the healthy options were great. I will be back:)
Nice and clean, friendly staff, but food just wasn't all that good. I'd give them another chance though.

So we went to this place for breakfast after looking for good restaurants with good breakfast and after reading the reviews we decided to give it a try. Well let me start by saying that the moment that you step inside you will experience a warm welcoming, the place is very clean, nice and cozy. Our server was Dora and she was excellent! Very attentive! Now comes the food and I can tell you that the waffle was so delicious, crispy and to top it off, warm syrup. We definitely are coming back to enjoy a great breakfast again!
Fantabulous ! Got the brown vermicil noodles and everything was seasoned perfectly - watch out pho Tao bay!

Oh my God, why did I think doing a food crawl of Philly over 4th of July weekend was a good idea? Because it is--I just can't control the weather (....yet) and couldn't escape the 98-degree heat!

Luckily, Johns Water Ice appeared like a hazy oasis in the concrete desert heat. The boyfriend and I stepped up (i.e. collapsed) at the counter, caught our breaths, and ordered some good ol' Philly water ice.

I got chocolate. It was good. Cool and refreshing and not overwhelmingly sweet for my poor, dry, parched mouth. I liked the wateriness. The boy got banana. It was made with honest-to-goodness real bananas! You could taste the realness! You could even see the little black dots that are in the center of bananas. Plus, it wasn't fake shiny yellow! He got half a cup of bananas, half a cup of chocolate and swirled them together to make some good banana chocolate. It was very delish. Yes, I said "delish".

I went here because I wanted a good bike to ride around town. I loved the service I received - I never felt like they were trying to "oversell" me. They took their time to show me a few different models, explained the differences, and answered all my questions. I also never felt pressured! I love that I can now bring my bike there for parts and service. Overall, a great experience.

I heart this store so hard. The only thing I dislike are the locations ... as a downtowner, I have to stop at the Castleton store after work, which is kind of a pain. But it's worth it to score my Three Buck Chuck pinot grigio!

As a frequent guest at the Chase I often enjoy a low key dinner on the patio. The food is fine. Nothing special. It gets truly unbearable on Sundays by the pool and Thursday nights when it becomes an inadvertent homage to Night at the Roxbury. Loud terrible music, a crowd that makes Jersey look respectable and hotel guests calling to complain. It has a serious identity crisis. Is this a fancy hotel or a shitty nightclub? The sad truth is the latter. 2 stars.
What seemed like a tourist trap actually turned out to be one of the highlights of our trip. Sam and Bruce were exceptional ambassadors and the entire staff made the voyage memorable.
This Chilis never fails to please   Friendly and helpful wait staff. Food is hot when brought to the table.

This has got to be one of the best vegetarian restaurants that I have been to. I have been coming here for years and every time the food comes out amazing! They also have good portion sizes, I would highly recommend this place to vegetarians and non vegetarians.
Little slow service at first but the food quality was good. They give you plenty for the price. Food did taste good and I'm happy with my visit.

I went here for dinner tonight. I soon as one of the servers saw us he opened the door for us. The inside of the restaurant has a nice modern look to it. There were also beautiful paintings on the wall. For dinner I ordered their chicken Parmesan. It is not on the menu, but they were happy to make it. It was delicious. The chicken had great flavor, and it was nice and moist. The fettuccine that came with it also tasted great with the chicken. I also ordered an Arnold Palmer to go, and they gave me a huge cup of it. I can tell that they care a lot about their customers. If you live in or are visiting Tucson. I would not hesitate to recommend this restaurant.

We arrived over an hour before the posted closing time, and were greeted with "I'm closing early."  So much for IHOP, we went to Dave's Dogs across the freeway and had a good meal -- and they stayed open.  If I had pulled something like that when I was in food service I would have been fired!

Good Tex-Mex cuisine and drinks (the sangria was particularly tasty). On the whole, everything was rather simple and straightforward (save for a few culinary twists, like the "guacamole trio") but done well. One of those "you can't go wrong here" restaurants.

Always a great experience at Texas Roadhouse house. Nice casual atmosphere and they are always very busy especially on the weekends. We usually do the call ahead sitting so we don't have to wait long to be seated. Service has always been great and we've always had good servers. Their cocktails are really good and we always get a margarita and never been disappointed. Definitely can't go wrong with their warm rolls with honey cinnamon butter. My go to is usually a steak smothered with onions and mushrooms, my last visit I had the ribs and steak combo with loaded baked potatoes and a side salad. My steak was perfectly grilled just the way I requested (medium) and ribs were decent.  As always our meal was enjoyable. They are obviously not on the same level as a high end steak house but for a regular meal when you're not looking to spend much they are one of my favorite chained restaurant for steaks and cocktails.

My goodness, if I could give the Jasmine Thai in Brandon more than 5 stars, I would. They are the best Thai restaurant I have ever been to, including the other Jasmine Thai locations. The decor here is grand! You feel transported and the uniform the staff wears is beautiful and adds to the elegance. The food is always delicious and fresh. You can make any dish as spicy or as mild as you wish. My favorite appetizers are the steamed dumplings and the chicken satay. My favorite dish is the clear noodles with whatever meat you choose! Its super yummy and really low in calories! I seriously eat it almost every day! Do yourself a favor and try everything on the menu!

This was one of my favorite places to eat pre Katrina. Now it's terrible. The staff is very slow, the portions are much smaller, and the prices are higher. I had to wait nearly 10 minutes for a refill and 20 minutes for my waitress to get my card to pay. 17% gratuity is mandatory no matter the party size or the service. The food is still pretty good, but the staff makes it not worth it.

Great huge new space!  They were only open 12 weeks before my arrival.  I like the pint jar glass ware.  The bathroom needs sprucing up but I'm sure they will get there, they are brand new and there beer is already sold in something like 80 establishments~!

This is a wonderful spot for lunch! The service is great, and the portions are just right. Our server checked in with everyone, and seemed glad to be there. The hot chicken sandwich was divine!!! I loved the people-watching, too, on that busy corner.

Love wine tasting!  Really friendly staff with several unique tasting options.  Great prices too; a 6 taste flight for 5 dollars! We also ordered a cheese and cracker plate to have with our wine.  Gruyere cheese with prosciutto and honey, it was super tasty and went perfect with our drinks.  If you want to take some home you buy a bottle and pay each time to get it refilled.  My favorite was the strawberry and rhubarb.  The semi dry one was good too!  They also sold homemade soaps and honey.  Just wish this place was a little bit bigger for busier days.  Not a lot of seating, but plenty of room around the bar area.
Get the Lettuce wraps!  The Mongolian beef is great as well.  I get mine with broccoli.

I had an appointment to replace a tire sensor, a 10 minute job. After a two hour wait I asked the representative what the problem  was and was told they were working on it. At the three hour mark I walked into the garage and was quickly stopped and told I couldn't be in there. I looked in and my car was not even in the garage! I went back to the representative and was told it was in a different area behind the one I had looked at. At this point I walked around the building and they had just started working on on the car. The mechanic apologized and said that he would get to it right away but he was working on three vehicles. 10 minutes later the car was pulled around in front. I walked The vehicle was pulled in front of the shop. I walked back to the representative to check out. I waited while she busied herself with no one, and it took 20 minutes before she checked me out.  I walked out to my car after 4 hours! This experience was unnecessary, unprofessional, and not acceptable!!!!

First time hade great reviews in yelp and we'll derserved. Best service and friendly staff and happy mood from everybody. Hade busicuts, and gravy was great and so was the fruit cup very fresh. Can't wait to go back and try something else with friends and family.

Awesome views of the city. Very expensive and the food is good. A bit overpriced. It has a nice lounge with great views also. We had our anniversary here and they surprised us with a nice desert plate. Everyone was very friendly.

I usually come here once every 2 years only to find that yes, the food is still pretty bland...well, at least they are consistent. I've tried breakfast and I've tried dinner and the food is always less than spectacular. I usually see this spot out my car window on my way to Amy's up the road which is so much better.

This is a chain, but the quality is pretty good, the flavors were fresh.  My husband's flat bread was good and I enjoyed my chicken picatta.  Our waiter was friendly and attentive.  The reason I'm only giving three stars is the dessert.  We ordered a chocolate mousse cake that came to us frozen.  It's pretty hard to appreciate the delicate texture of mousse when it's frozen, and for the price of the dessert that is unacceptable in my book.

A true farm to table concept restaurant. And accordingly, the vegetables that we had were elegantly prepared and excellent. The meat entrées were a bit heavy-handed--too much sauce accompanied my pork chop, for example. But since this is only their second week, I anticipate some refinement with the proteins and their presentation. 

The space is still fantastic-some minor changes from how it was set up with Salt. In the end, definitely worth a try.

If there was a zero star rating that's how I would rate this location. 
It is the worst ice cream ever. Not sure how the ice cream is mixed but it is NOT creamy. The ice cream is like eating air. Ewwww.

I picked this place based on yelp and was left very disappointed. Asking if they had any cooked options for my pregnant wife, they made us a custom all cooked "special roll" that was only imitation crab in the middle and shrimp on the top - for $16....ouch!  Service was really slow - ordered 4 hand rolls - two came out after 15 min and then the next two another 20 min later.  Skip the blue crab roll, it doesn't taste like blue crab...eel, salmon and yellowtail were decent.
This neighborhood bar is amazing. The bar staff especially Sam is amazing. You always feel welcomed and at home. Great prices and great pours.

Got to say was very disappointed with the service. Waitress was rude and food took forever even though it wasn't that crowded. When it arrived it wasn't that good. Don't recommend with all the other seafood places around that neighborhood

We've been here 2x
 Both times we were impressed with the wait staff, atmosphere and most importantly,  the scrumptious food!!
The salmon with exotic mushrooms was phenomenal. Our new favorite restaurant.

I had spent just about three hours driving between rush hour hell and personal appointments, so food was necessary right at that very moment....period.

Taco Bell is my guilty pleasure fast food joint, and this one happened to be right on my way home. Pulled on in, placed my order with a friendly team member, and then picked it up promptly thereafter. Parked in their lot and stuffed my face rapid-fire.

Successful trip all-around. I also like this spot because it's one of the newer locations. It just looked very clean from what I saw. (I believe this existed with the old facade when I was a kid, also, but I was a kid so I don't fully remember.)

Head's up: No left turn out of their lot.

This is a good stop if you're near Route 42 or heading through Clementon. It's also close to the Pike.
This place is packed floor to floor with vinyl. I always walk out with a few records if not a stack when I leave. The owner is a friendly guy always helping out if you need music suggestions.
Legit authentic Mexican food.  It's run by a family and they never disappoint.  Give it a try and you'll leave satisfied and full.

I just received my food and had to immediately come on here to write a review! I ordered the Turkey Meatballs & Zoodles and the Autumn Fest juice off UberEATS. Not only did the food come super quick (from Mid City to Metairie) but it was delicious and warm! I was worried the turkey meatballs would be bland, but they were filled with just the right amount of herbs and spices. It was also my first time trying zoodles, and I am now a huge fan! I can't wait to try more, the entire menu looks awesome. Thank you, Swegs, for serving convenient, tasty, healthy food at a great price! (I would have taken a photo, but I ate my food so fast! #yum)

Best of the best.  It will knock the socks off any Home Depot.  As a matter of fact, it is in a different class altogether.  Apparently this locally-owned store cares about their employees so they keep their staff.  You can get to know the staff here and listen to their tips and product recommendations and develop a sense of trust in your home repair needs.

One thing - if you're following a GPS, most of the GPS directions lead you about a half a mile away from where the store really is.  I made a manual change to mine.

The upstairs is devoted to gardening, light electrical, cleaning, etc.  The downstairs, which has its own separate entrance, is the heavy duty construction and gardening area.

No need to run to box stores when you have a gem like this in the area.

If I could give 0 stars I would. This place is TRASH. First of all they kept telling me the wrong total price so I had to keep adding more food to meet the delivery charge until I realized when I got the receipt, they added the tax after the delivery charge so it was at least $10 over the real total!!!! All this so I can satisfy my craving of sweet potato fries and what do I get. BURNT SWEET POTATO FRIES. Why even deliver them to me? Who would eat this? Disgusting. No class, all about the money.
Stopped by the Burg for the second time. Great food, great place great server.  Sharisse was our server again and she was super. If you haven't tried this place , you should!

I went in with high hopes. A place that specializes in burgers and offers a $30 burger on the menu should blow me away. I left unimpressed and let down.  My burger was over cooked and dry. The size of burger not worth the price. I honestly would of preferred a double cheeseburger from Wendy's.  

There is nothing special about this place. Not worth the money.

Karaoke dive bar in the Elliston Place/Vanderbilt area of Nashville.

This has been a staple I in Nashville for as long as I can remember....think Cheers in a College town. Regulars, bar tenders who know you by name, bar 
Games, food oh, and did I mention karokee and wonderful people-watching opportunities...

They have reasonable prices, adaquate seating...and did I mention Vandy students singing karaoke...

Excellent food. Excellent service. Came in 2 minutes before the grill closed, and I was invited to stay and enjoy my Bi Bim Bap. It was excellent. Fresh-tasting and well-balanced. I'll be back next time I'm in Nashville.

Loved this place. Came for a brunch of sorts - three donuts, coffee and a half chicken for two. The donuts we had were all hot - strawberry lavender, vanilla spice and the honey glazed that came with the chicken. All were fantastic - soooooo good. They are about as big as an Entemans donut and they are indeed light tasting although I'm sure not light in calories. The chicken was also very good - got the dry rub Za'atar which was excellent. Za'atar is dried thyme, oregano, marjoram, or some combination thereof, mixed with toasted sesame seeds, salt and sumac. Great stuff. A couple of the pieces were drier than I'd like and would have been great if there was a dipping sauce. None the less - really liked it although for those who have had Bon Chon this is similar - although I liked the crust on this chicken a lot. Hopefully next time we will get a fancy donut however they were all sold out when we got there at 330. Oh great service and solid music too.
Had take out for lunch today.  Have always loved their Pho, but just had the Best Grilled Pork vermicelli I've ever had!!  Delish.  Highly recommend.
When I order takeout, it's from Superwok and Superwok only. Never had a negative experience both dining it our eating out. Any time I want Chinese takeout, I head to Johnson Highway!

Came here to try the beers and to get some dinner. The food here is amazing!  I would come here even if I didn't like beer!  We got the fish tacos and the burger. The fish tacos were very good and slightly sweet. Very similar to other ones I have had previously but definitely worth getting. The burger is fabulous. The meat was cooked perfectly - very juicy and messy!  I'm glad they didn't ask us how we wanted it cooked because we might have ruined it by getting it done too 'well.'   We got a flight of beer and the Vintage cider. The Vintage cider tastes a lot like apple juice so great if you have a non-beer drinker in your group. Wish I lived nearby so I could come here on a regular basis.
I wish you could give zero stars or negative stars as a review. Completely unprofessional, horrible service, and a waste of money.
Best Thai food I have had so far. I ordered the crab rangoons followed by the Red Thai Curry with shrimp. It was amazing. My new favorite Thai restaurant.

it was a bad dining experience i ever had...
first of all, it was 80 degree, they turn off the AC after abound half hrs we sat down.  The cold dish: spicy chicken we use to order everytime taste awful, then we ask about it, the server told us the main chef quit.  After we finish the meal, walk out the door, our server chased after us said we did not pay tips, we were shock and embarrassed, cos we did pay more than 15%, so we went in again to have them do the calculation, but the cashier girl had bad attitude, she only respond me one word: "i forgot" i was so upset... last.. 4 out of 7 of us got stomachache after eating over there,  one of my friend even need to stop by the gas station for this emergency.  So, never again....

A friend introduced me to Trim-Rite several years ago (thanks Sherman) I have been using them ever since , and they have NEVER let me down.  The service is great these guys know what they are talking about.  The quality of meat is fantastic.  Whenever I have friends over to grill, celebrate or just want to treat the family I make the trip to Trim-Rite.  I use Trim Rite for my beef and Haines Pork shop in Mickelton for pork you can't go wrong.  Old school quality and service  NEVER goes out of style.

This is a difficult review. I'm from Florida and love love love sushi! I'd been craving it and through the Yelp reviews decided to come here. Upon first glance I was extremely disappointed. A tiny unimpressive venue with tables so close you may bump your neighbor with an elbow. We had to wait nearly an hour for a table on top of that. However it was 7:30 on a Saturday night. We had drinks at Picasso while we waited. Looking at the menu I noticed this sushi was, in my opinion, quite overpriced for the atmosphere and location. I believe $19 for most rolls of interest. Yet, I did have a very enjoyable time! I enjoyed that it's a BYOB, our waitress was extremely pleasant and the food was decent! I adored the salmon on fire appetizer!!!

I love it here, the waiters/waitresses were so nice! The sushi was delicious! I don't like sushi when it's warm. This sushi on the other hand was good quality, and fresh. I personally would recommend it if you are in the mood for sushi. I really liked the tuna fish dumplings. For my birthday each year, I enjoy having sushi for dinner. I would definitely eat here for my birthday!
We've been here twice. The food was great and the staff is very friendly. I would definitely recommend!

No smiles, running out of food but not communicating to teammates loud enough what is needed, arguing amongst each other, giving me a non- existent portion instead of waiting for your refills to come. I love chipotle but this was the most depressing visit ever. I'll stick to your other locations.

I wanted to like this place as the food was good but they crammed our party of 11 into a single booth which ruined the night. On top of that, the portions were not sized right for our group so most left hungry and the service was poor. The oddest thing of the night was they kept locking the door to the restaurant despite it being middle of service (7pm). Would not recommend.

Over-rated. We brought out of town guests here because it was on their touristy wish list. We expected to wait in line, typical for Nashville, about 45 minutes, so no big deal. 

Once seated we basically were at the mercy of the slowest waitress alive. We had a big day planned but our group of four spent nearly 2 hours of it sitting in a booth waiting on food, drink refills that never came and, after asking other servers to find our no show waitress, the check. No wonder there is a line to get when the table turnover is ridiculously slow!!

As for the food. Just "meh". After the hype and the wait I expected large, flavorful portions. The portions were on the small side and no one was impressed with the taste. I think my dish was the most well liked, Santa Fe Cornmeal Pancakes. They were hearty and unusual so they were a good pick. 

All of us ordered a side of hashbrowns, and lucky we did or we would have been very hungry later on. But I did have to blot a good amount of oil off the potatoes and the bottom of the dish. I know that hashbrowns aren't a health food, so no biggie, just excessive. 

Overall, an eclectic tourist stop. I can't understand why locals would go. There are better, cheaper, faster and more delicious options all over town. Go if you have time to kill and a lot of patience.

To be fair, I haven't gone to a major league baseball game since I was in kindergarden.  Still, I had a great time for the price paid!  I really felt as though I was taken care of here and the food, although super expensive, was alright.  

I was really impressed at how nice this place is.
DO NOT EAT HERE. Slowww, Horrible service, staff was extremely rude and the pizza is over priced. Go eat somewhere else.

My review is based strictly on the food . It was very good for a fast food Mexican joint . I had the shrimp nachos , healthy portion of shrimp through out the entire dish . My problem was with the service, the staff seemed clueless and disengaged . The place was also a bit dirty based on how many employees were standing around not doing much . As for as the food goes , I'm sure you won't be disappointed!

I decided to stop into a jeweler that i use to do business with a long time ago looking for a pair of earrings for a friend.  The gentleman behind the counter (owners son) hasn't got a clue about basic terms for example J hoop.  He had a very unpleasant attitude once i pointed that out.  

Also tried to tell me that his silver earrings were coated in platinum then he said palladium.  And then he tried to convince me that platinum, palladium and rhodium were the same thing and that his silver earrings were coated in palladium.  

Either this guy doesn't have a clue or he uses deceptive practices to sell his merchandise.  They don't plate with palladium or platinum.  It's always rhodium and they are not the same

I think a name change should occur...Royal trinkets....

Just had the most horrible experience with the server CASEY last night. He was unbelievably rude. I was with a party of 10 and I swear he had something against me. I asked if he could open me and my friends wine bottles and out of no where a cork screw lands on the table right in front of  me. He literally threw a cork screw at me for me to open my own wine bottle. He then proceeds to write my order and I saw him write it down with his pen on his pad. Food comes out and I don't get my meal, everyone is eating and he said he didn't write it down wanted to know what I got and he'll put in the order now.  He then places soup in front of me and says "here this will keep you preoccupied while you wait".... Oh thanks! Everyone in my party is finished eating so I tell him to please just cancel it if the chef didn't start making it and he goes.. "ok" and walks away...not are you sure? it'll be a minute... So he brings out the food anyway and I said I'm sorry I don't want it anymore thanks though, because I'm beyond annoyed at this point and he goes well "the chef didn't even want to make it... It's on the house." WHAT THE HELL did that even mean?! I don't know how the food is because I didn't eat, but service is terrible. Especially Casey.

This animal hospital is the best place they have all the bells and whistles for your pet! They also have an amazing team of Drs and nurses to care for your pet! Our dr/surgeon who was the neurologist was absolutely amazing he saved my dogs life my puppy is a 9 pd yorkie who got hit by a pick up truck and received a massive skull fracture the animal hospital by me wanted him to be put to sleep I transferred my puppy the following day to U Penn Ryan's Vet and am so thankful I did they immediately did surgery and saved him that was a Monday in Saturday he was driving back home with us I couldn't be more grateful to our surgeon and the staff that cared for him he is going to live a full happy life because of there CARE and SKILLS!!! And as far as the bill which I see Aton of in the other reviews not one part of my bill was shocking and it was extremely less than what I expected and I couldn't be happier with everything they have done there amazing people and if you want the best for your pet than you go to the BEST which they are every single department was absolutely amazing!!! Thank you all so much for everything!
This Frozen yogurt place is a nice addition on south street.

Huge shout out to ANDREA for setting the trajectory for our entire weekend!  Most amazing service ever, in the history of ever.  Plus husband and I felt like her amazingness rubbed off a bit on us.

And the food, AS ALWAYS, is ridonkulous good. Fried pickles, a wood stock, a woodstock with bison and Peroni on draft = best reason to get a babysitter and have a date.

I'm fan girling now....gush gush love love burger up. Really. Place is perfect. Worth it. Every single time.

Let me first say that West Coast Tacos isn't for the faint of heart. These tacos are SPICY. If you like that sort of thing you'll LOVE them, if you don't, you'll be screaming for a glass of water. Since we've gotten that out of the way, I will say that these tacos, despite their small-ish size go a very long way. I've only had the chicken, but those i know who have had the pork and beef have raved about them. The tacos that come out of this truck are so good that we have stalked the truck on each side of town just to get our "fix".. yes, they're THAT good.

I was so glad to find this joint resurfaced in Brentwood. Taco Tuesday killed me. All u can eat tacos (brisket, smoked chicken, or catfish) 2 sides and a drink for $9.50.  Brisket coma. Love the atmosphere and attitude.
