Jenny made our wedding cake and was absolutely my favorite vendor. She was incredibly kind (especially to my mother, which I appreciated!), was open to all our special requests, and delivered a beautiful and delicious cake. She also definitely quoted us the best price!

Now we stop in for cake and cookies all the time. There are lots of great bakeries in the area, but the Frosted Fox is our favorite!

Ok, ok.  I bumped you guys up a star because you've got super friendly servers.  Went here late last night for a quick salute to the Irish ala the Saint of Pattie and they were so kind as to serve us an Irish Car Bomb at our table upstairs!
I know of many bars who won't even give you an Irish Car Bomb at the bar, let along bring it to your table.  Super cool.

Last weekend I had an incredible weekend in New Orleans with my family. The amenities are great, but even with the Expedia package deal on flight/hotel, I gasped at the price for the room we had. After considering the hotel's location in the French Quarter, it makes a lot of sense though, and turned to be worth it. It's walking distance from The Court of Two Sisters, Cafe du Monde, and many local shops I enjoyed browsing, including a wonderful knitting shop called the Quarter Stitch. Harrah's is a couple of blocks away and if you're not up for walking, there is a cab stand on the corner.

Since this hotel encompasses an entire city block, it is home to a gift shop, a couple of restaurants including the lovely Begue's, as well as multiple bars. At the Mystick Den we saw an amazing jazz show featuring vocalist Betty Shirley. If she's playing, do not miss her.

Dear families, I've heard that if you stay on a room that faces out to Bourbon Street on the weekends, it can be quite loud. We were lucky to get an inside room facing the courtyard and pool. There's no reason not to go to New Orleans these days. Bring the commerce back!

The store has a great atmosphere, with an upstairs seating area, vaulted ceilings, exposed wood beams, and sky lights. The store was updated and very clean. 

The slices are enormous - basically the size of two pieces of what you would normally expect. The pizza itself was delicious. The crust is a great thickness in both the crust and the center, with a delicious flavor. The sauce on the pepperoni pizza was a little sweeter IMO than most places, which I really like. The white pizza with spinach, tomato, and Ricotta was also delicious. I will be frequenting this place.

Giving Noboru 2 stars is my way of being generous. 

I went for dinner over the weekend with some friends, and we were very disappointed. Considering the price for dinner, we all had expected a lot more.

At first glance, it appears as though there is a lot of sushi. However, after a closer look, we realized there actually was about 5 different types of sushi all with slight variations. For example, there was a shrimp roll, shrimp tempura, spicy shrimp tempura, shrimp tempura "sandwich", and shrimp tempura with a special sauce. I'm sorry, but that is not a good selection!

After we ate some sushi we decided to try some of their other dishes as well. The sesame chicken was pretty good if it was fresh, if it sat out for more than 15 minutes it would dry out and become hard to chew. Also, the fried rice was really bland and had a awkward texture. 

I know people go to Noboru for the dinner, but not the dessert, but since they had dessert we had to try it. On Noboru's website and Facebook page they advertise chocolate covered strawberries and even crepes! We saw nothing of the sort. There were miniature cookies which gave one of my friends and I a laugh because they were advertised as "homemade", when they clearly came from the nearest Acme. They also offered 3 small pieces of jello in a bowl, some fruit, mini cakes, mini brownies, vanilla soft serve ice cream and tart frozen yogurt (which, as a major fro yo fan, I was very disappointed in).  The only dessert item that my table semi-enjoyed were the brownies. 

Finally, I do have to say their cold veggies were delicious! I read some reviews prior to going, and one reviewer mentioned how great the asparagus was. I'm so glad I read their review and made sure to try the asparagus, because it was by far my favorite item there! My only suggestion would be that, while good cold, it should be served warm. I had one piece that was under a heat lamp and was so warm and delicious!

Overall I would say, avoid Noboru unless you really like shrimp and overpaying for food. It may have been the cleanest buffet I have ever been to, but no matter how clean a place is, if the food is not good then it is not worth it!

Fun place. Good food. 

I had the eggs Benedict which is not on their menu board but they do make it. It's excellent. 

The hash with salmon is also good. 

They also have sandwiches and burgers.

Still feeling hungry after a wedding we turned to our trusty Yelp app and found this little place. Walking up to it we felt like it was our kind of place, we love small plates, good cocktails and a relaxed atmosphere. For a saturday night it was surprisingly really quiet. We were seated and served quickly. My fiance and I both had drinks, the mojito and caipirinha. They were very good, though very heavy on the ice, this is a little disappointing given the price. We weren't hungry so we ordered just a few plates:
Higo Y Queso De Cabra- like another reviewer said, a little heavy on the bacon, still quite good.
Tocino Cina Pina- Didn't taste much else beside the crispy pork.
Albondigas Caseras- our favorite dish, these meatballs had so much flavor packed into them. I could've ate a plate of them!
Along with the bread and olive tapenade they serve, we were full. However, I will say that the portions seem really small. Most places put more garnishes on the dishes, here all the dishes were simple and little. We've been to enough of restaurants like this to know what to expect so I think it was a bit much that we spent nearly $90. 
All in all, we liked everything we had and if we are around the area we would go back.

Good food.  Clam chowder was marginal, but did have a lot of nice clam pieces.  Coconut shrimp was the best I've ever had.   Broiled fish and scallop combo was generous and nicely cooked.  Lobster Alfredo was a little disappointing - good lobster but weak Alfredo.  
Excellent service from our waitress despite big and tight crowds.  Like so many other restaurants in the area, it wants to be cool and distinct, so it's cluttered and chaotic, so be prepared.

Amazing dining experience!!! The cocktails, the charcuterie, the cheese, antipasti, pasta...everything was well thought out and worked great together. The ambience and decor is very welcoming and modern. The service was superb, Carl, was a very professional and attentive bartender, she was always smiling too. The manager, Dawn, stopped by to make sure everything was great, and it was. You should not miss this dining experience if you are in the area. Make reservations if you can, if not, eat at the bar!

OK SUPER CHEAP!!!
I am willing to bet the cheapest in town. BUt when you get prices like this you also get the full on families in their with their 6 kids to go shopping with MOM by her self. 
Honestly its bad enough to have to go shopping by your self but to add all 6 kids. UGGHHH talk about ruining everyones shopping experience. stay away from this store around the 1st week of any month.. Or you will see what I am talking about .

they have BULK items and did I mention its cheap!?!?!
Really enjoyed the food and atmosphere on my recent visit to Indiana.

The student named above as The Gourmet Pizza Company is being assessed in the following subjects.

AMBIANCE:     B
The student was quiet during a Thursday lunch. (S)He could benefit from a more sociable personality as there was nobody other than Mr. Mark A and his trusted colleague to provide company to this poor student. Otherwise, the student is neatly dressed despite hiding in the shadows of low lighting.

SERVICE:     C
The student's mother was respectful at the register. Not overtly friendly but neither rude nor abrasive either. She gave Mr. Mark A and colleague time to review the menu of what the student had to offer. She took the order and brought out the pizza in a timely fashion. 

FOOD:     B
Fortunately for the student, Mr. Mark A is not terribly picky with his pizza. The Thai Chicken Pizza served up by the student had nice flavor with the peanut sauce drizzled over it. There was a nice proportion of meat and veggies. Mr. Mark A did notice that a gluten-free pizza was an option to be served by the student, however, Mr. Mark A and colleague opted not to go hipster healthy this time around.

Mr. Mark A recommends The Gourmet Pizza Company for promotion to Middle School.

My Vintage Addiction is a one-of-a-kind shop.  If you are a child of the 70s, you'll feel very nostalgic as you browse their ever-changing selection of hand-picked items.  They also sell handmade items from local artists, which is a huge plus!

My husband and I drive from Arnold, MO to visit - definitely worth the drive. 

Plus Courtney (owner) is super-sweet!
Yeah the coffee's great, and it is really good, but food and pastries keep me coming back.  The breakfast burrito is nothing short of excellence!

If your interested in spending money on awful,bland and tasteless food this is the place to go. Service is mediocre at best. Furthermore, this place looks like it was designed by a fourth grade boy with a love for fishing. Definitely two thumbs way dow
Really good burgers and my fiancee really enjoyed the buffalo chicken sandwich, the Buffalo Buddy. French fries nice and crisp. A little pricey, but great atmosphere! Will be back

Got my first ink here and it was a great experience. Giving a four due to initial artists time management.  I had to be switched to different artist- no biggie-I liked him better.  I had a simple  tattoo that was very meaningful to me.  Kirk was awesome and very thorough on how to take care of tattoo.  I have a feeling this is just the first of many!

I thought this was a really fun experience.  The buffet dinner was good.  We had green beans, finger potatoes, creamed spinach, 2 types of pasta, roast beef, gumbo and roast pork loin.  The jazz band was good and touring the boat was fun.

I wish I could say something really nice about this place, but after the experience i had its hard too. I was brought to this restaurant by my daughter for a Birthday dinner. We sat outside, and it started out really nice, but when the watress brought out our appetizer, she accident spill my water all over me, knowing that it was a accident, I wasnt mad , but soak though and though.then the manager told us we had move inside cause it was going to rain, but did not provide us with a table or seating! tired of standing, holding our meals. we ask to finish our meals outside, it was only spitting rain a little. then it started to get really dark outside so we decide to just box up our meal, and leave. when asking after all that for our check, you think that restaurant would have offered something off the billed. NO !!! I then told my daughter to ask. and they took  10 dollars off. really ???? Been in customer service 40 years and never wrote a review in anything, but could not believe this.
Food is good as it looks! It a diamond hidden, it's perfect to dine with a sweet heart or group night outing just a lovely restaurant.

There are not enough stars for this place. Great food, beer selection, and service. The bartender (Cory) was very cool and knew his stuff. I like a IPA selection and they definitely had one. If I wasnt at work at this monent I would be there for lunch.  I will recommend the pub to everyone. I had a rare beer MY ANTONIA which was $18 and worth every penny. I look forward to going back soon.

Lanna Thai Cafe has got a good thing going, but there are a few things that prevent this restaurant from really shining.

Before we get into that, though, let's talk about the food.

We ordered six dishes at Lanna, and all were very good.

*Ginger Salmon:  This was the star of the meal.  Perfect salmon, perfect Thai veggies.  Would definitely order again.
*Tom Kha Gai:  Standard, but on the better side, with a definite "kick" to it thanks to diced Thai chilies in the soup.  Includes tomatoes and onions.
*Chicken Larb:  Good, tastes like larb should.
*Red Curry:  More "authentic" than most local restaurants, but not terribly spicy.  It's notable for not being excessively sweet like the curries found in most Thai places.  If you like your curries sweet, you may not like this, but we enjoyed it.
*Beef basil:  The beef was tender and the vegetables were good, but this, like the following dish, was not particularly notable.  Definitely felt like it needed more basil, however.
*Pepper beef:  Good, notable peppery flavour (as it should have), but otherwise standard Thai fare.

The restaurant itself is in a converted house.  This gives it a charming café feel, but also means there's not a lot of seating.  I definitely recommend making reservations; we came on a Thursday evening and the restaurant was full the entire time we were there.

Service was poor, but this is likely because there was only one waiter/cashier in the entire restaurant while we were there--the guy was clearly overworked.  Unfortunately, this means we had to wave him down anytime we wanted anything (and he never once refilled our glasses, though we didn't bother asking).  This is the primary reason I docked a star from the review.  No restaurant with poor service gets 5 stars from me.

Prices are reasonable, if slightly high for Thai food.  Most items on the menu are $10-12 (with most seafood being $13 and up)  However, even though we ordered 4 entrées (plus larb and a soup), we were only given one bowl of rice, and we were charged $6 for additional rice.  Not cool.

So, service was poor and charging so much for extra rice seems a little underhanded to me, but it's probably the best Thai food I've had in Reno and prices aren't terrible, so we're likely to return.

If you haven't been here you're obviously living under a rock. They have great food and coffee during the day and a great atmosphere for drinking at night. The cafe has unique sandwiches and some come with a delicious side salad. The grilled cheese with pear is great, the blt is great and just tried the peanut butter banana bacon sandwich which was definitely worth trying. The staff are really awesome creative people and you can tell they like working there. At night you can be sure to get a good recommendation for a drink from a knowledgable bartender.

The ONLY thing that saves this review from a 1 star is the entertainment. The food was atrocious. How do you mess up potato skins, FRENCH FRIES, and chicken wings? Fries were almost undercooked as if they half cooked them and left them there to sit in their own oil. The chicken wings were barely cooked and the sauce just poured on them (barely, out of 12 wings, sauce was on maybe 4). Lastly, the potato skins were literally skins. Almost no cheese and forget about bacon like it says in the menu. Overall opinion was that the drinks had next to NO alcohol and the service was absolutely terrible. Last time I come here ever. I never leave bad reviews or review much, but this experience had to be reviewed. Had it been good, I would have given it a good review because I like piano bars.

Looking to purchase new flooring? Look no further than GCO Carpet Outlet. We needed new carpet in our newly purchased home this summer.  Stacy was excellent to work with. She helped us find the perfect carpet with a tremendous selection to choose from.  Also, she handled the transaction and coordination of the order very efficiently.  Rob, the installer did a fabulous job--what a craftsman!  Thank you GCO for a great retail experience!

I am so glad I found this place on Yelp. We were in New Orleans to celebrate our wedding anniversary & I wanted to do something different mixed in with the typical things we usually do when we come to town, so I surprised my husband with a picnic at the Fly. We came with our blanket, chairs, snacks and of course plenty of cocktails and really enjoyed the laid back relaxing vibe. Laying there under the trees, feeling the breeze (October has perfect weather) and watching the Ships roll in on the Mississippi River was so nice and romantic. We really enjoyed this hidden gem near Audubon park. A nice little getaway from the busy city aspects of New Orleans.

I had read mixed reviews about this place so had to try it myself.
We started with a dozen raw oysters which were just the right size and extremely fresh.
I had the fish and chips for dinner which was light and crispy and the dipping sauce was great.
My husband had the blackened mahi platter with rice and broccoli. The fish was fresh and perfectly  seasoned.
We will eat here again for certain.
Our server Robert was very attentive and friendly.

Found this place back in January.  Had a "piece" of cake" and fell in love.  Great place for cake/cupcakes.  The piece is big enough for 4 people, fresh, great quality.  Came back to Florida from South Jersey for two week's and same back twice.  Can't wait for our next visit.  Strawberry shortcake and cookie dough cake were out of this world!  Blackout cake was the bomb for my boyfriend.  Thanks to the owners for making such quality products!

The excellence in food and service that was there when they opened has been completely maintained. With the high quality of the ingredients, I never feel weighed down after I eat here. Milkshake is my favorite in the city.

It's a shoe warehouse...what's NOT to love? Great brands at good prices. Plenty of items for men and women, including complementary accessories - socks, belts, handbags, scarves, jewelry, etc.

I always start in the clearance area, and usually find something there that I can't seem to live without.

Wasn't impressed, yes it was a Sat night, yes the NHL playoffs were across the street so I expected a wait.  Only waited about 15 min for a table....then came the real wait and I couldn't say it was the waitress' fault she was attentive and sweet but she had nothing to give us, drinks weren't coming out fast enough food was ready.  Disappointed in the prices too, 2 dinners and app $68 no sodas no liquors....just another chain

I was expecting the burgers to be delicious but they weren't. They're extremely greasy. As I was eating mine, a pool of grease formed on my plate. Pretty gross. Also, the waitress was slow so our bottomless fries took a long time. :/

This is an amazingly cool museum.  We drove all the way from Ann Arbor to go here.  It puts our local hands on museum to shame.  This and the children's museum in Nashville are epic!  It has a carousel, people, a freakin' indoor carousel!  Oh, yeah and REAL train in the basement.  What more can one need in a kids museum?  Nothing, I dare say, nothing!

Amazing facility and exhibits.  The museum has acquired so many artifacts and collectibles of the life and times of so many historical people.  The 9 and 11 year olds loved the museum and all of its interactive exhibits.  We look forward to many returns to a wonderful representation of the old west.

Delicious but (obviously) unhealthy.

Good beer choices, efficient & friendly service and good food.

Try the bacon grease popcorn and the cheese fries with gravy. Don't bother with the pulled pork sandwich. The po'boys are excellent.

I was so excited for a mac & cheese only store and ended up disappointed. The mac is only ok and they have a weird policy that doesn't all you to order a basic mac & cheese plain. You must order the more expensive "classic creations" from the menu. The portion is a good size but I wouldn't recommend it over all.

The staff is great. They are friendly, genuine and caring. But how on earth are we supposed to relax or sleep in a room that feels like 86+ degrees. 

It was 100 degrees outside and we needed to cool off and relax after driving up from Maryland. There was no relief in our room even though the thermostat said 60. They brought up two box fans when we asked so that helped a tad but when we're staying in a $400 rm hotel, I expect a comfortable room. Even room service noticed it was extremely hot and we should keep fighting. It was cooler in the hallway.

PROs:
- 1/2 mile from Liberty Bell and attractions 
- cool hotel, different from Marriott that's right across the street 
- cool bar, food served till midnight 
- 24 Hr room service 
- pay as you drink bar in the room
- the manager was nice enough to comp us all fees outside of the room charge (parking, meals, etc)
- valet gave us cold bottled waters after asking how our stay went
- Starbucks across front door 

CONs:
- older hotel with a ton of floors 
- not the Marriott with all of its newer features like A/C
- tough to pump the A/C up to the 17th floor especially when it's a million degrees outside 
- they were willing to move us rooms but the only one available was a double bed and the air wasn't much cooler, not worth the move
- they said engineers were working it but they never came to our room 
- foyer and elevators smell old and musty
- valet-only parking is on 12th St: $48/night with in/out privileges 
- no fridge except for bar fridge, we shoved our leftover cheesesteak sandwich in there
- we woke up in the heat and couldn't wait to get out of there
- I'll never stay again

We went to wine country looking to learn the basics about great wine and the wine making process and found Wine Edventures through yelp. All the reviews were right on.. Great guide who were very knowledgeable. The wineries all had a great selection of wines to taste and each place had very friendly staff. Overall My girlfriend and I found exactly what we were looking for.

my husband and i were recently in NOLA for four days, which included three mornings.  which, of course, meant three breakfasts.

we ate breakfast at cafe fleur de lis twice.  

in fact, the only reason we didn't eat there all three mornings is because we ate at another restaurant the first morning.  had we eaten here first, cafe fleur de lis would've been three for three.  we saw a waiter leave a couple of times with trays of covered food and walk across the street to the hotel.  it appears as though this place delivers room service to the guests there.  we'll be staying there next time :)

the pancakes were in-credible.  i have no idea what my husband ate, i can't remember.  i was far too involved with my strawberry covered, powdered sugar dusted, impossibly fluffy pancakes to really even notice.  i'm pretty sure they brought me a plate of 3 pancakes, but it could just as easily have been 12.  there was no way i was finishing them all and i was just a little sad about it...is it weird to miss pancakes?

anyway, super friendly staff, reasonably priced (for b'fast in the quarter) and, of course, ridiculously good pancakes.  eat here!!!!

I came here about a month ago and I really like the atmosphere here and the friendly staff as well. They addressed my back issue that I have going on and they made me feel right at home. I really like it here and will be coming back very very aoon.

Ekta proved to b a successful date night spot!  Quiet place with a handful of customers on an average Wednesday.  It was a BYOB but we didn't partake.  I ordered a soda and was disappointed when I paid 2 bucks for a can of soda, I could see the soda fountain behind the hostess desk, feels like a bait and switch but now I know for next time.  We ordered garlic naan, chicken kabob and veggie samosas for an appetizer before our food came out.  Samosas were hot and fresh without being overly greasy.  The kabob was a flavor bomb, perfectly cooked with just the right amount of char on the marinated chicken - will be ordering that again!  I ordered the chicken vindaloo (my go-to Indian dish) and the wife ordered Lamb tikka masala.  Both dishes came out steaming along with a plate of rice to share.  I always get the vindaloo extra spicy and it did not disappoint!  Great level of heat made me sweat a bit but did not compromise flavor.  At one point I coughed and the hostess giggled because she was worried they made it too hot for me but I assured it everything was great.  Garlic naan was soft and pillowy and perfect for wiping up the last bits of the red sauce on my plate.  Portions were good but I could have used a bit more jasmine rice.  Will be returning!

Chatham Tap is my favorite place to grab a bite to eat on Mass Ave. The service is typically great (unless the guy with the mohawk is your server) and their selection of beer is fantastic. Try the nachos or the pear & Gorgonzola melt!
CLOSED.  Because it's not clear from this Yelp page, I just wanted to point out that the Centennial Cafe is permanently closed.

They rep the California-style donut hard here. If you're into that sort of thing, and who isn't, I'd recommend these dudes (or DK's much improved Meridian outpost) over Nampa's similar Daylight Donuts.

The maple bacon bar hogs all the hype, and it's totally justified, but DK's greatest achievement in donut engineering is actually their old-fashioned crueller. All their cake donuts delight me, but that crueller represents everything that makes California donuts great. Not only is it submerged in hot grease long enough for a perfectly crisped exterior to form, it's also smothered with enough saucy, butter-loaded glaze that the top few layers of the pastry get thoroughly soaked. It's special. Like a donut should be.

Very nice hotel! The staff was very friendly and helpful. Check in time is listed as 4pm, but they allowed me to check in at 10am when my flight got in, which is awesome. It's located just a block away from Bourban, so it's right next to all the festivities. My Mardi Gras was stress free thanks to the Wyndham. 

I'll definitely be returning next year for carnival season!
The drive thru wait time is the worst in the nation. Minimum 15 mins with no cars in line. I once waited 28 mins! They are definitely #1 in poor drive thru Service...

Yet another place Nearby me. La.va Cafe has been in this location for ten years. It is a cafe with a swift of Israeli feel. A cafe that what it should be not a Starbucks or dunkin donuts.  They are reasonable and an average latte is near five dollars. Food is tasty and not overly priced in anyway possible. I recommend  this place to anyone.

Old World's pop-up shops are better than most local shops. 

Fantastic, quality drinks made by folks that are passionate about their product.

Excited for them to open their shop later this year, I don't think I'll be able to go anywhere else for my coffee!

Rude rude rude!!!! I've dealt with the service center twice now.  Originally I work with Joe and he was great (didn't work with him the seconds visit)but I had to take my car back a week later and from booking the appointment to dropping my car off everyone was extremely rude. I ended up telling them I'd be going to a different dealer and will never be returning. 
I ended up go to a different Hyundai dealer and it took the mechanic 5 mins to figure the problem out and order me a new radio.

Overall a nice size venue and in a good spot, but, drinks are expensive and the security staff (a bunch of black guys and one chick) are something I won't write on here. I comped because it was an EDM event hosted by DJ/promotion groups that I work for.  It would of been $15/20, though.

 To start, the girl made me pour a whole drink out when I clearly just walked out another entrance with it to find somebody. My hand was stamped and I wasn't even wearing a jacket in 30 degree weather. Where else did I get it? Secondly, they threw friends out for no reason other than objecting the claims they did anything and even proceeded to beat the one up, going as far as biting him just because he shoved back for putting their hands on him.

Never coming back. Shame because it's a great place to dance and socialize.

I came here with a large group of people. I don't feel as if this is a good place for large groups...the seating just really doesn't accommodate so half our party left. Those of us that remained (6 of us) ordered food and drinks. I really enjoyed the guac and the drinks. The tacos were just ok. The steak was probably the best, followed by the pastor....I didn't even finish the shrimp and bacon one even though the waitress recommend it. Difference in taste buds I guess because I didn't like it at all. This place Is also EXTREMELY loud but I guess that just goes with the territory around here. I did like that the waitress broke up our bill into individual checks without even asking!
Above average pub grub, live music, low key neighborhood bar.  Clean, nice architectural features, nice staff.

Great little Indonesian restaurant near Cacias bakery on corner of Ritner & 16th. There is a sign inside warning not to park in front of Cacias. Mostly Indonesian clientele. Food was really good and came out fast. Menu is divided into noodle(w/ broth or stir-fried), rice dishes, a few starters and sides.Good service, though we had to ask for a pot of tea.

The chicken in the satay was well seasoned and grilled in a nicely flavored peanut sauce studded w/ cucumbers. The fried tempeh was light and crispy; the accompanying dipping sauce- spicy & fishy..My  Nasi Lemak Ayam Goreng was good. The coconut rice was great and made a nice combo mixed with the crispy  fried things and the two sambals.  The hard boiled egg  had a fiery, but flavorful sambal  on top which made for a nice surprise.Pickled veg was very nice. Chicken was a bit disappointing. You get a choice of breast or thigh. My breast was tiny/ w wing attached. Kinda crispy, but a bit dry and not much meat and a bit of a strange flavor.Shouda got the Beef rendang which my friend got and liked a lot.

Definitely worth checking out. Much more varied menu and  more upscale than Hardena. Definitely looking forward to returning soon.

Food was great. Atmosphere is awesome. The reason I'm giving it a bad review is because of the servers! Our server didn't write down our order, and of course it was messed up. She didn't come back to check on us AT ALL the rest of the time we were there. We had to ask other girls for drink refills and the check, and tipped the girl who helped us the most--not our original server. When our food came out, the order was messed up, and when we asked about it, the server snapped at us saying she didn't know anything about that because she wasn't our server. Really? I've been a server, and so I'm ALWAYS polite and respectful. There's no reason to bite my head off at a simple question. Just awful service.
Haven't been here in a while, the quality has not changed a bit!  Still delicious food with great friendly service!  Love this place!  Wish there was one in St. Charles County!

The Peppermill is the closest place in Reno that we have to a Vegas style Hotel and Casino. It's like a magical getaway and every time they set foot inside the establishment, I feel like I have left Reno for a whole new world. The restaurants, the bars, the entertainment, even the night club - it's all Grand and there's something to do for everyone. Highly recommended for anything and any needs that anyone may have. The Tuscany events Ballroom is where we went to go see a country music concert. The entire place just feels like luxury.
Awesome food. Great surroundings.  A must go to apt. Enjoyed a romantic dinner. The Caesar had a divine garlic flavor. Can't wait to come again.

You have to try this place. One of the few places that live up to the hype.

Family owned and run, staff is genuinely friendly and the food is inexpensive and very tasty.  I wouldn't say we are regulars but we do frequent here quite a bit.

These guys are the best!  I was limited to one particular day for my move, and even though G&G was already booked for that day, they told me they would make time for me.  And they did - they even showed up over an hour early after calling to make sure that would be okay!  Once there, they got right to work and worked quicker than any other moving company I've used.  They were incredibly careful with everything I owned and there were no damages or breakages.  They even put moving blankets down on the floors to keep them clean, and moved them around as they needed to use different entryways.  

They price by the job instead of by the hour, and the actual price at the end of the job was exactly as they quoted, no surprises.  I found and used a great Living Social deal for them, but even without that savings their price came in way lower than a lot of the larger companies that I got quotes from.  And since they're local, they knew their way around and I didn't have to worry about planning out the best truck route to the new place.

Overall, a super friendly and professional local, family-owned business that I couldn't recommend more!  Look out for more Living Social deals over the next year.

Great selection of wine and very knowledgeable staff especially Charlie who used to be at Bottlestop down the road. The prices are about average for big liquor stores but you will find some gems here that you won't find anywhere else. Strong varietals are Zinfindels, Shiraz and Syrahs and Cabernet blends. Of course these are some of my favorites and other varietals are equally represented. Also has a tasting area which is pretty cool

I gave The Local Taco a try for the first time today.  It's cute, and has a nice patio, and I really wanted to like it.  I went during the late afternoon, so there were only a few other customers in the place when we walked in.  I was warned ahead of time by the person I dined with that it's "a little bit expensive" and it takes him a full order of chips & salsa & 3 tacos to fill up.  I am not opposed to spending the money, but I was really disappointed with my food.  I will say this, I did enjoy the tomatillo verde salsa very much.  When I ordered my 2 tacos, I was offered a lunch combo that comes with a side.  The refried beans that I got were pretty dry, and seemed like they had maybe been sitting out a while.  It was late afternoon, so it wouldn't be surprising...  I got the Southern Fried Chicken taco and the Smoked Brisket taco.  The chicken came with almost no toppings, so I covered it in the salsa.  The Brisket taco just had a flavor that I didn't care for.  It's a personal preference, so others may think it's fantastic.  It just wasn't for me.  

The person I was with got the Tequila Lime Chicken tacos.  It seemed to be the closest thing to a traditional taco they offered, and it's probably what I should have gotten, as well.  After my late lunch I realized that I was expecting more options along the lines of traditional tacos, when in fact this place offers just the opposite.

Wow, I thought this Chuck E Cheese was actually ok however this place has really went down hill...

Now the line hangs out the door and you must wait to be seated so I opted to not be seated and stand up which means this was going to be a short visit.

Besides the adults who are hogging the games and bullying kids and the adults who arguing over the ticket feeder and about to fight.

This place is really bad now..

I love the Chicken Salads at this place. They come in a tortilla shell and have a lot of beens, rice lettuce with really good grilled chicken. I used to go to the Pollo Feliz on Tucson and Valencia. That is now a ChickeNuevo and the food is still just as good. It is nice to have one in the neighborhood. This location is in an old Long John Silvers right next to Miss Saigon (which is the old Perkins) There has been a lot of repurposing in this area and ultimately both of these are moves in the right direction. You get a lot of food for you money at this place and I have yet to have something I didn't enjoy.

I purchased a brand new Hyundai Accent from this dealership 2 years ago. Since then the clock in the car has never worked correctly, the windshield wiper fluid system doesn't work, and then this morning I blow a tire on my way to work and find out I have no spare in the trunk. I realize I purchased it two years ago but normally when a sales associate says there is a full size spare there should be a full size spare. I shouldn't have to check to verify. I trusted this dealership on their word and it left me stranded on the side of the road for an hour and a half and could possibly cost me my job for being over two hours late.  I called the dealership to find out where the mix up happened and they transferred me three times and was treated like a criminal for asking why I didn't have all the items they said I was supposed to have. I'm very disappointed and will never be buying a huyandai vehicle again.
Quick service, but very disappointed by the bagels. Nothing great at all, can probably get better quality bagels in a grocery store. Certainly not "Bagelicious"...

I know know I'm a pretty tough critic but I ate here today at approximately 3:30 and will not go back.  Had the pastrami w fries on the side.  Fries were just ok. Not very hot.  Very salty.  Sandwich had twice as much slaw as meat. Meat and slaw were bland. Asked for it to be toasted and was very very lightly toasted.  Not heated enough to change color of the bread and make it crispy.  And here's the pic of the tomato slice (with stem).  Whoever put this on a sandwich has NO IDEA what good food is period. Sorry but that's the truth. It's a hot day and the ac was not keeping up. Sticky and stagnant atmosphere.  Floor was dirty and very slippery either from not being cleaned properly or from condensation. Either situation is not good. We sat in a back area which is fine but there were three big TVs all had an advertisement running over and over for the restaurant (you have to advertise when I'm already in the place?).  I asked the waitress if she could put the cubs game on. She halfheartedly said yes and then did nothing. So we got to watch a advertisement on three different TVs.  One part of the advertisement has a person taking a huge bite out a sandwich and the insides of the sandwich squeezing out all over. Disgusting if you ask me especially over and over.  I could see in the kitchen and it was in shambles. Food everywhere and flat top not scraped of melted cheese, etc.  I understand things get crazy back there but with everything else i experienced this was a major turnoff.  Def not going back.

I just bought a dress from David's bridal today and my sales associate Donna was very helpful! I'm not a dress shopping person per se I got asked to be a bridesmaid so David's bridal is where I went. I walked in Donna greeted me I knew what size I needed the bride is already picked out the color I tried it on I was out of there in 10 minutes after buying the dress. Very happy with my experience at David bridal.
Let's celebrate pride weekend with friends and beer, this place is awesome for wings ( Wednesday) food it's  and prices are ok too, music really chill you will have a good time here

Great addition to the Oldsmar restaurant scene the quality of the ingredients and the cuts of meat are far superior to any other Mexican restaurants. You can tell everything is made from scratch and not from a can All the critics out there need to give them a chance Must try in my book will be back

Not the classiest place. But if you want a good (not great meal) on the cheap and you want to stay away from chains, go here. Coffee is really poor and the dining area doesn't have many windows (expect near the front). Grits are lacking. But pancakes are the way to go. Esp banana!

Amazing! The chicken & dumplings were the best thing I've ever eaten. It was obviously made with care. Like out of your Mom's kitchen. The atmosphere was beautiful and staff was very knowledgeable. We will be back.
My wife and I have come for years--20. Good vegetarian options. Simple setting. The real deal.

The Red Habanero is a good Mexican experience but slightly pricey for this restaurant category and atmosphere. The noise level inside was louder than expected given the lack of a major sports game being on. The menu offered the usual fair and delivered to expectations.  A solid three star experience but far from a four star selection.

like most high end steak places you most likely will get a  good and pricey meal. personally i prefer morton's just b/c i think ruth goes a bit crazy with the butter on their steak and an inferior key lime pie but everything else is pretty comparable. they run a 3 course for 2 special for 89- it might be 99 now?- a couple times a year,  well worth it for that price.
Much needed in zephyrtucky!!! Good dogs , great shakes! I remember this place when it was the old country kitchen. Happy to seen it's taken over and cleaned up!

Did the Voodoo Bone Lady Tour tonight with Brian as our guide and it was excellent! Brian was informative and fun and exciting. He kept our interest piqued the whole time. If you want to know city history, visit this tour.

I'm a little late to the party and have been meaning to stop by Yelo'd since it opened, but didn't have the chance until this past weekend! It certainly did not disappoint. I stopped in after work and it was a little bit of a rainy day, so there wasn't a line. 

I tried the Halo Halo and had the Ube / Keso flavour swirl, but you can also just choose a single flavour. Ube is one of my favourite flavours, so I never pass up on that when given the chance. The flavour wasn't overly subtle and just perfect, and the leche flan that was also included as part of the toppings was a really nice addition!

While I was there, I also stopped into pick up 4 pints as part of the crowd funding I had supported months prior. One of the owners came out to help us select the 4 pints. He gave us samples of each of the flavours on tap to help us make our decision when we told him this was our first time in Yelo'd! He was super friendly and genuinely cared about providing a great experience and one of the reasons why I love supporting local businesses! 

There are usually 4 flavours on tap and are rotated every so often. If you're looking to purchase a pint; However, they may have additional flavours tucked away in their fridge, so definitely worth asking about if you're looking for a flavour they previously had that may no longer be on tap! We ended up picking up Buko, Ube, Pandan, & Keso. Super excited to try out these flavours at home :)

The shop is super colorful, cute, and really cozy. There are a few benches outside for you to enjoy your soft serve ice cream! And the menu is displayed on the wall, which is great, so you can easily ponder your options while waiting in line and don't have to play the squinting game.

They also had some cookies, pies, pandesal buns, and a few other items, which I will have to go back and try at a later date. I really liked how everything in the shop, the soft serve and baked treats had filipino/asian flavours. Definitely, something a bit different and unique! If you haven't stopped in yet, they are definitely worth a visit and you won't be disappointed!

A typical refined oyster bar with friendly staff & well portioned dishes. The service however regarding pacing of dishes is off & needs refinement as main courses were brought while we we still working on our appetizers & then we were expected to make room. Overall though a good place to perhaps meet friends.

I just moved to Penllyn and this place is really close to us so we gave it a try -- and we loved it! We haven't tried delivery yet (and I'm not sure we ever will) so I can't comment on that, but both times we've ordered pizzas from here have been great.

I used GrubHub to order both times and we were able to pick it up in 20 minutes or less (we had four pizzas the second time and it was the same length of time). The staff is pleasant and the pizza is really good. I definitely recommend the Ashley's Texan Taco Pizza if you're looking for something a little different but not crazy -- it was a hit both times we got it.

I'm only giving 4 stars for now because we haven't tried anything else on the menu yet, but I know we'll be ordering from here again.
pricey food and sub-par service. the half of any sandwich or melt looks like a crust. only three people and they took forever to make the food. understaffed on that sunday

My daughter recommended we go here and after sitting there for a few minutes I figured out why.  There are 3 gyms in the area including a rock climbing gym.  Let's just say, she was busy and distracted.  But hey, at least she wasn't on her phone.

One of my biggest pet peeves is not being able to park.  There is a nice big parking lot across the street that is free for the first 75 minutes.

You must order at a counter, which isn't bad, I suppose, but the prices reflect someone to serve you. They let you pick out your own emoji table marker so they know where to bring the food.  I thought that was kind of fun, a new way to express yourself at a breakfast joint.

I totally missed the build your own hash, not sure how, it is front and center. I think it is trying to choose something reading off a big sign as you approach the counter. I was only looking under the board entitled breakfast. Not good under pressure maybe???  

I ordered a very simple breakfast called The Patrol Combo; 2 eggs, bacon, garlic roasted potatoes.  They only had one type of bread, sour dough, which I thought was strange.  It wasn't even 10 am on a Thursday.
I read on another review they were out of bread, so common theme? 

All in all, it was very standard.  One thing I noted is the bacon looked way too crispy, over cooked, but it really wasn't.  It was really good.  Another, is the attention to detail, like adding the chives for decoration on the eggs.  I thought that was a nice touch.

My daughter had the eggs Benedict which she finished before I really even saw it.  She said it was good.

I would like to go back and try the build your own hash.  I think that is where the 5 stars lie. I would also recommend going on a weekday so you don't have to wait in a long line.

Love love love everything they make. There always so busy and still are able to give awesome service. When I'm Nola I always have to stop by the burgers are k. The pizza are great but my favorite is crawfish beignet @ brunch with the bottomless sangrias.

Had reservations and company from out of town try out what used to be one of our favorite spots. Ordered nearly everything off the menu and was then asked to leave because there was another reservation.  Never saw anyone even sit at the table while we were waiting for our Uber. Long and short of it, even if you have reservations and spend plenty of money here they don't care. Fast food restaurants will appreciate your business more than these folks.
First time here, very clean and opened. All machines look brand new. 8 miles vs 3 miles from home but worth a drive. Will definite return for my next workout.

The food here has become sporadically good at best, sad, they "used" to be good!

I brought a friend there for dinner tonight as she had liked it and I was unable to talk her into Carmelita's in Dunedin instead.

The tortilla chips served with the salsa were stale, not just a little, but really stale. We laughed, how hard is it to serve crisp corn chips?? Apparently its difficult at Poblanos!

I ordered the chimichangas, one steak and one chicken and I asked about the sides. The waitress Anna explained it comes with mexican rice and a guac salad, I said great as I don't like refried beans.
It came out and I didn't know what it was!
There were 2 Fajitas with cheese sauce on a plate with a guac salad and refried beans. 
I asked about the beans instead of the rice and the waitress took my plate back to the kitchen where they put my food on another plate with rice. 
As I started eating it the waitresss asked how it was and I questioned if it was the chimichangas which are fried and I had 2 soft tortillas with cheese sauce, like 2 fajitas with cheese sauce, exactly like that!
She took my plate again and went back to the kitchen. 
When she finally brought it back my date had finished her meal and I was thoroughly disgusted. 
How hard is it to fry 2 chimichangas and serve them?
Did the cook know what a chimichanga was?

They placed my tortillas on a grill and crispened them and brought them back. 
Again, I was asked what I thought and I said I was disappointed. 

No manager or owner came over, nothing. I ate one. 

The waitress came back and asked if I wanted to take it home, I said yes.
She handed me a box and walked away.

This is a deplorable experience, simply pathetic! What is she being tipped for???

It came out wrong at least twice and nothing was said or done, NOTHING!

Folks dont waste your time or money here, the food stinks, the waitress Anna is pathetic and management obviously doesn't give a damn either.

Carmelita's in Dunedin is 1000% better!
Reminds me of my mother and grandmothers cooking! Home away from home! Highly recommend the Dolsot Bibimbop and the Ramyum if you wanna clear your sinuses!

My wife and I visited this restaurant for lunch. Spicy Crab Bisque was as good as advertised. We also ordered the fish tacos and Crab/Spinach/Artichoke dip. I have to say I loved pretty much everything. We sat right next to the Aquarium and admired the beautiful fish while we dined. Our server Erin was awesome... Very attentive to our needs. Restaurant little pricey but it is what you expect.

First I must say the food was excellent.  The gorganzola filet with wine sauce was truly outstanding.  My primary complaint was with the service.  I was staying the week at the hotel next door and had dinner at Carmine's 3 times.  I finally came to the conclusion that management has trained the waiters to rush the service in order to turn the tables as frequently as possible.   Each night I dined with work  associates and throughout the meals the waiters kept trying to take away plates too soon.  It became difficult to have a relaxing dinner and constantly felt rushed.   On the 3rd night we spoke to the owner and it was clear that he did not want to take our complaint seriously and issued a very insincere apology.   In the end, he paid for our meals .  All of us at the table would have preferred that he would have acted more humble and treat us with more respect.  We were not looking for a free meal.  It was a company expense anyway.  We can only hope that he might think about what we told him.   We were most sincere and not trying to be difficult.  In his mind we were wrong and he was right.    All of the waiters I saw looked and acted somewhat inexperienced.  I suspect that mature professional waiters would not get along with the owner very well.   He seemed like a hot head and is probably difficult to work for.

This is a decent Target. I'm not a fan of the parking lot at all, but the store itself serves its purpose. Additionally, the employees here aren't very friendly. I've been here a number of times, and it really seems like everyone who works here hates their job. It's hard even to get a hello from anyone there. It's pretty bothersome, and if there was another store in the area, I'd probably go there instead of this one. I think they take advantage of their prime location, hence the poor customer service. Too bad.

My family and I took a 5 day vacation to New Orleans and we just happen to walk by this place and decided to eat there for lunch. Wow were we blowen away the food was amazing and the service was top notch. We ended our stay by eating here for dinner and we would highly suggest this resturant!

I really enjoyed the night out we had here for a birthday. The comics were funny, though the opening acts were better than the headliner, and the MC was better than all of them! The service for food and drink were excellent- our waitress was attentive but not obtrusive or distracting. 

The only real downside was that there was a group there from a Christmas party that were beyond drunk. A drunk man near us was talked to by staff after one outburst. These people talked the entire time, shouted the entire night, and did a very poor job of heckling, if you could call it that. It wasn't the comic strip's fault that Jen and the rest of the lubricant company decided to show up, but they could have addressed the behaviour like they did with others.

Overall, we will be back, though maybe not in company Christmas party season.

This is not my first experience at BIG AL`S. Usually it is a pleasant experience that I want to tell people about. Today one of the cashiers actually snapped a customer who made a mistake with product signage. I will say the girl in the fish area did`t explain that sign was not for plants

Awful awful awful. The chef got in a fight with a patron and we waited 45 min and still didn't get food. The chef literally threw a tomato at a patron that he was in an argument with over his bulls hat. The bathroom had urine on the floor. This place isn't even sanitary and should be closed! Wish I could give it 0 stars
Excellent customer service!!!  Service was  great and the food was very good!  The sushi was good
Staff is great. The hot roast beef wasn't hot it was barely luke warm, the bread was warmer than the meat. Took a few bites the flavors are nice, but I didn't finish it was cold.

The atmosphere was very cute, but had over a 90 minute wait.  Not even any space to stand in the bar area, so very uncomfortable.  They should use the NoWait app or accept reservations for parties of 5. I will try to return, hopefully they will figure out a waiting area or how to accept reservations

I saw this location a few weeks ago when I was at the AT&T Store next door and decided to stop in once they opened. Well I was in the area today and saw the "Now Open" sign and decided today would be the day. When I walked in I was immediately greeted by a young lady. She asked if I had been there before and I told her I hadn't. She explained the menu and handed me the order forms to make my own sushi roll or sushi bowl. She also showed me the menu with sushi and the sushi bowls with the combinations they already had. This was the hardest decision of my day! 

I decided on the Korean BBQ Beef bowl on the menu with white rice. The food was fresh and tasted good. Now I do have the confess I don't like carrots so I threw them all out so my sushi bowl was more like BBQ Beef bowl. 

The restaurant its self was nice and clean. There were some tables to dine in and there was seating in the window on stools. I ended up visiting the restrooms and they were clean and smelled good.  

I'll definitely be back soon to try more bowls and rolls!

SHARESE IS WONDERFUL! Very pleasant and patient! Excellent customer service.

She took so much time with my fiancée making sure she found the pair if glasses that tickled her perfect, she triple checked for deals and insurance coverage and gave multiple quotes for different glasses an lenses to help us make the most informed decisions.

The patented accu-fit really impressed me. The selection could probably be bigger at they locations, being in the mall limits their space, but they still have an immaculate selections.

When you make an appointment they send you email confirmation. My fiancée thought she was going to the International Mall location and upon receiving her confirmation she called and cancelled and made a new appointment at the International Mall location. They messed up her reservation and she did not get an email confirmation. She called and was not in their system. She then called back Westshore and made her appointment at the original location. We were very very happy!

The doctor was also awesome!!!

I don't even know why I'm bothering to write a review when there are so many. 
This was my first time visiting this location I normally go to the location in South Philly. Well I was just as pleased at the reading terminal location. They had a great selection and the staff was so super friendly and helpful! I only ordered cannolis (I would have bought much more if I wasn't a broke college kid) but they were so incredible and so fresh! I'm so happy this location is much closer to me now and I will proudly continue to make the trip to reading terminal market just for these cannolis. Ps- I got the original with chocolate chips- that's the only way to get them right ?!

This pool store will cost you money. I dropped off my pool cleaner a few months ago to be fixed. I called to check the status every few weeks and never got a straight answer. After going down to the store I realized the other manager got fired and never filled out the other half of my repair ticket. They said they have no record of me dropping off the cleaner. 

All in all I'm out a 500 dollar pool cleaner. Oh and the store employees admitted that the other manger was out thousands of dollars of inventory. Save yourself the headache and try out another pool supply store.
I love the atmosphere and set up, it is very modern and calming. I also thought the omelet was good value, large quantity and good quality.

Nice salad bar as a different option when you're feeling like you can't eat another meat centric meal in Nashville. Could have been more choices but I'm spoiled by having many options like this at home. Was definitely pleased to find this option.

We had to take our male cat to UPenn when he blocked on a Sunday, and our regular vet was closed.  The staff was very professional and explained everything to us.  They also were very clear in explaining costs, and the options that were available to us to control the costs (They quoted a flat rate that would provide what was necessary to unblock him until the next day, with an option to then transfer him to his regular vet).  Even though this flat fee was still expensive (you pay for the emergency) we did appreciate their honesty and attempts at mitigation.  They also worked with us on a payment plan.  Unfortunately, the emergency vet is a pretty tough experience, due to the nature of the extreme injuries and illnesses of the animals brought in.  It's an extremely stressful and intense environment, so the staff's thorough explanation of what to expect was definitely appreciated.

I went here for my 22nd birthday expecting a great time and I was shocked at how terrible my experience was. First off, there are absolutely no seats in the place, which isn't always a bad thing to stand and have a good time; however, you weren't even given the option. Second, the staff excluding the bartender were all rude. Third, I was unfamiliar with the bar considering it was my first time and I asked a staff member if they play live music all night and he informed me that they play club and dance music after 10 p.m. Which was a lie. Fourth, the drinks were the biggest disappointment for me. The website and menu states how the biggest buckets can be shared among several people, I drank one of those and felt absolutely nothing! It tasted like juice and it was $40! Finally, as I stated I was not drunk in any way nor was I acting drunk, and after going next door to the club Down I decided to go back to Howl at the Moon where the door men rudely yelled at me that I wasn't allowed back in because I was "too intoxicated" absolutely ridiculous!! Like I said I am not one to act all crazy and I was not even slightly buzzed. I went to Xfinity after I got "kicked out" and had a much better time! I will NEVER  go here again, it really put a damper on my birthday!!

I shop at the Fresh Market frequently and have always been pleased with my purchases. I have shopped there for many years. The prices for meat and produce are in line with local grocery stores and local meat markets. Organic milk, breads and bakery items are also similarly priced. They often have specials that are well worth the visit. I prefer the hometown feel of this market to that of larger markets. They always have the fresh produce, meats, and bakery items I am looking for.

What can I say...Erzulie's is absolutely top notch. The store is beautiful and the staff is the best and very helpful. I may not live in New Orleans anymore, but I truly look forward to my next visit to see Anna and this remarkable store.

Love this restaurant!! Great food... Gyros are awesome... Salads are great!!! Owner is always working and greets you with a smile. Menu is varied and everything we have tried is really good.  They have great coupons and they have generous servings...I always feel we are getting a great deal.  One of our local favorites!!!
Good food and great service. Can't ask for much more than that. Although I asked for mashed potatoes and was given tater tots, they did fix it by bringing me my mashys on the side. Thanks lady's.

I have been looking for excellent sushi in Tampa. I finally found it after a year. I have not even been to the restaurant yet. I found Kelp Sushi on Uber Eats. Home delivery food is never as good as what you get at the a actual restaurant. The quality of the Kelp Sushi, the presentation, the flavor, the portions were all absolutely perfect. On both occasions, the rolls were not made with too much rice. Most sushi places make the sushi look big by using way too much rice. I always use a lot of wasabi and soy. I tried part of three different rolls without either soy or wasabi, and it was still amazing! I cannot wait to sit inside and enjoy this incredible sushi. I will not go anywhere else in Tampa for sushi from now on. This is the one!

Went in here on a Friday night recently to get a quick clean up cut before a networking party that night... the only guy in there, whose name I can't remember, cut my hair. I was in a rush and paid after the cut TRUSTING that if it looked bad, something would be said. Stopped at home to changed and style my hair then noticed the botched cut he gave me. He literally went half way up on the sides with clippers then blended nothing in. It just stuck out like he barely touched it. I spent over 30$ on this cut only to have to go to another barber to get it fixed. 
I will never give business to Regis or any other big chain again. I knew I shouldn't have went in the first place but come on, the notch cut was very noticeable and nothing was said. What a joke.

Love me some Olive Garden. Yeah I've heard all the "it isn't true Italian food". Blah! Blah! Blah! I don't care. It is good.

The bread sticks plus salad were so tasty. Service was good, but a tad on the slow side. It really didn't bother me though. Just gave me some more time to fill up on that salad and breadsticks. I gave 4 stars instead of 5 stars for the simple fact that my youngest daughter order pizza and grapes. She received her pizza but never did receive her grapes. Of course, she didn't tell me about it until we left nor did I notice the grapes. 

There was hardly any wait, but it was still a pretty packed house which explained the slower service.

If you get the app, you WILL have a good time if you order in advance. Just walk in the dang store, connect to the WiFi, scan your digital receipt at the register, and BOOM you'll hear "online order for (your name)!" You just skipped an entire line of 25 people during the lunch rush, and dammit, you should be proud of yourself. Wawa is pure and wholesome and it's amazing quality for the price and it's hot if you want it to be and cold if you want it to be and it's fundamentally Philly why isn't there a 6-star option?!

Great food (avocado burger & Cobb salad are  AMAZING). Nice restaurant, great outdoor pool (can get drinks by the pool), clean rooms and everyone who works there is very nice. Probably most important is that you can't hear the airplanes!!! Soundproof glass. Will definitely come back!

Oh Hell to the yes. Ma Moons Bulgogi Fice Bowl, with duck egg ! Korean food in New Orleans !!!!!!!!
Tempura Shrimp. And Butternut Squash Ravioli. All flippin' amazing. Good music.
Lickety split service, ate at the bar, surpassed the 1 1/2 hr wait for a table .
I freaking love this place
Pretty looking on the outside. Still amateur on the inside. This owner has an inflated ego.. don't pump your money into inferior product. Go to La Bonne Boucher. It's the real thing.

The first time we went, we didn't actually get into the main restaurant because we had not made reservations and didn't want to pay our babysitter to wait so we went to the bar area. It was still good and we were glad we went, but I was craving that VIP experience by the huge fish tank. 
It was worth the wait! For our anniversary, we made reservations. We were seated right by the tank. We were not rushed and were able to take in the atmosphere. There were many wow moments including the lighted menus. That was my first time seeing that invention. It is a great solution to keeping the dining room romantically dimly lit. 
Our server, Jennifer, was personable and knowledgeable and efficient. She talked to us and I overheard her talking with other chatty customers. She did not mind and was engaged with the older couple and was relaxed the whole time even though she got double sat. (We were early for our reservation and they sat us right away. It was a good thing.) She was not afraid to let us know that her two other tables were also celebrating anniversaries. I liked her confidence. The other support staff were engaging as well but were quick with the compliments and comments and did not disturb our dinner but we had big smiles on our faces after he brought us our food. I didn't catch his name. 
The tank is amazing. We saw the huge green eel swim by us, saw the shark after dinner when we went in the tunnel in the hallway, and the fish were so big, I could have reached out to touch them. 
Now for the food. It came out so nice and hot and fresh. I loved that. My husband and I almost both ordered the grouper piccata but I decided to have the Mahi instead. I tried both and they were both delicious. The Mahi reminded me a bit of Thanksgiving with the walnut pesto and sweet cranberry touch. The flavors were separate but so good together. The butternut squash portion underneath did not taste too much like squash if you know what I mean, it was hot and creamy and so good. It had pasta in it, I don't remember exactly what it was called, but it was good. That butternut squash was my hesitation with ordering it since I do like healthy things, but sometimes veggies taste too much like health foods or can be too strong, but I was surprisingly happy with my decision. Before we got there, we had planned on going somewhere else on the beach for dessert, but that would have been childish. I mean really, why go order ice cream or snow balls when the best dessert ever is right there?! We split Jennifer's recommendation of the new pastry chef's invention, the lemon meringue cheesecake. SO GOOD! So rich. So fun to eat. My husband kept saying it has been years since he had had a dessert so good. Go and order it yourself to see! 
I need to find another occasion to go back. I want to take friends so they can get the VIP experience with the beautiful Tanked fish tank and all of the deliciousness.

My husband called ahead to find out what time the happy hour ended because his pregnant wife was craving a particular menu item. He was told 7:30 by a restaurant worker. We got there at 7:10 and informed happy hour ended at 7. I spoke with a manger and explained a restaurant employee misinformed us and asked she honor the happy hour price. She was rude, condescending and told us there was nothing she could do.  She smiled  and then walked away. I will not be a patron here EVER again.

So today (12/18/15) I decided to go back out and give this place a second try. We got there at 6:30pm to find out they now changed the happy hour, hour to now end at 6pm. Smh. I WILL NEVER GO BACK.
Was here for my 30th birthday and the Mac and cheese hamburger was very good! Great service and patio was clean and enjoyable!

Love love love this place. Was disappointed we couldn't get in due to a private party last night but we always enjoy our time there. This place is a good old fashioned bar, with pool, karaoke, and darts. The fried pickles are always my go for food. Love it.

Solid farm to table type offerings with some tasty flavors, but nothing it's namesake (who I presume to be Ernest Hemingway) would write home about...

Based on a recommendation, we joined some friends at Hemingway's for dinner.  We began our meal by sharing the Duck Poutine, which will be described below, and the Crispy Brussel Sprouts with our friends.  The brussel sprouts were phenomenal.  The combination of the heavy char on the brussel sprouts, the spicy cranberry glaze, peanuts, onion, and parmesan were delicious!

For dinner, my wife and I opted to share some of Hemingway's small plates.  We had the Duck Poutine, the Risotto, and the Kale Salad.  Interestingly, the star of our selections was the kale salad.  It offered a very fresh and clean complement to the more savory risotto and poutine selections.  The risotto was composed of butternut squash, apple, walnuts, and goat cheese, which was tasty, but just satisfactory.  The Duck Poutine was also tasty, but it needed more cheese curds and more duck.

All in all, we were satisfied with Hemingway's and we believe it to be a restaurant worth trying, but it is not a star of the Nashville dining scene.

Initially satisfied. Attempted to secure some other work. Cancelled 3 appointments. Then the invoice for annual plan shows up in mail. With 2 months late fees attached. Never signed up. The kid who answered advised me to ignore them. That's what happens when you try to be nice. Horrible. Horrible. Negative stars if possible

We have been to Side Splitters several times now and it is a great small comedy club! Buying tickets for an event is super easy using their online access. We have seen Jim Norton, Jim Florentine and Robert Kelly, to name a few, and it's always been a great time. The food and drink is reasonably priced and the staff there are very attentive during the show. If you want to see talented comics, check out Side Splitters!

I have taken this bus many many times and the service is very inconsistent. Sometimes they are very late ( over 30 minutes) sometimes they have seats, sometimes they don't.. you never know what you are going to get. The drivers are nice, but the service is awful, I don't know how they get away with it. If you have a choice, take the train or Bolt Bus... at least you know you will get a seat. If you must go greyhound, arrive early and stake your place in line and pray you will get a seat and the bus will be on time.
We come to NOLA quite often but stumbled upon Flanagan's and have been back twice in as many days. Both times I have decided that the deep fried Oreos was a perfectly acceptable dinner choice. Yum.
Great rooms, great fun. They have private rooms. Lots of great songs to choose from. I don't think there is any other place in Edmonton that has private rooms I hope they never close this place down.

Wow, what a meal.  The mixed green salad was beautifully balanced, table side iced tea was a classy touch and the wagyu burger was one of the most amazing burgers I have ever had the pleasure of eating.  Definitely a do over.

I have gone to EWC for about half a year now. Overall, they are worth going to. The blue wax they use is unbelievably merciful for Brazillians, let alone anywhere else on your body. The person you get is a bit of a hit or miss. If you find the person you like, make sure you request them from then on. The second girl I worked with did my eyebrow and upper lip. If the wax had not been so forgiving, I'm sure I would have left with skin removed. She waxed the same spot on each side of my lip 4x each. That is an absolute no-no. I would know. My mother is a cosmetologist and that's against protocol. Fortunately my first visit there for my Brazillian was swift and efficient. This was the case from then on when I made sure she was the only person I had appointments with.

The last note is that the girls at the front desk are somewhat unfriendly on the phone. They have a bit of attitude when you inquire about available time slots. A single fluke isn't a big deal, but speaking to them more than once on the phone resulted with a bit of a verbal backlash on my end. 

Good enough thanks to the wax. Keep tabs on the person you trust with wax and it should be fine.

If you are looking for a fun and different kind of bar experience, this is your place. It has a club atmosphere with dueling pianos. The live band is so talented and entertaining. They play requests, which is always fun. Lots of dancing and literal jello shots. Best bar in philly!

Found this place bc of the high rating on Yelp but sad to say I was disappointed .  They told us the wait would be about 20 min but waited closer to 45 - bonus points bc you can check to see where you stand in the wait list.

We got the hash which had little flavor but what seemed like a spicy mayo (not the delicious kind at w sushi) and was supposed to have other mixins but was primarily just potatoes.  

We also tried the avocado toast but it was just mediocre (I promise I'm not a picky eater!) I will say the biscuits were fantastic and I basically ate just that alone.

The staff was super friendly and the ambiance was cool but I think I could go without visiting again

Everything was good but not great. The decor is nice and for a second you feel like you are in a cozy hipster chicken shack in the south. The winner was the chicken sandwich.  I found it irritating that for what they were charging the sides that came with the whole and half chicken were individual sized and not a shareable size.  Also they give you too much butter with the breadbasket. I would go back for the sandwich.
Very good food that is truly unique in a cozy setting.  Wait staff was attentive and it was a enjoyable experience.
This place has really good food and the service here is amazing! Everyone is super nice and quick to accommodate! I would definitely recommend for others coming to the area!
I had an AMAZING experience here.  Tina gave us wonderful service.  So friendly and kind.  Food was delicious.  Not in reno often but this is a must for me from now on.

I have been getting my hair cut from Justin for the past 3-4 years and every time I leave the shop I am nothing less than satisfied. I do, and always will, recommend him to anyone for any kind of hair cut. His willingness to get better is unmatched and his love for barbering is shown through his work. These traits are consistent throughout every barber at The Men's Club and there is truly no where more genuine to go get a fresh cut in the Philadelphia area.

Everyone loves Bulk Barn and so do I!   So many aisles of awesome stuff, I definitely wasn't expecting what I saw when I went in.. I was expecting just standard bulk bins and then just big club pack bags.. not ALL bins. Once I walked through the candy aisles I got so frustrated because there were so many options I seriously ended up getting none haha. My chief complaint about this place was..well..  I was a "baddie" and sampled some of the candy and I didn't find them to be too tasty. I mean this in the sense of, you're used to buying Maynard's fuzzy peaches but now you're buying dollar store furry tangerines.  Also with some of the bagged candy I ended up buying anyways some of it tasted a bit older like it has been sitting on the shelf for a bit. Either way I was really impressed with the selection they had here. Peanut butter seriously??!?!!

This place is PHENOMENAL!! My friend and I were in town and were so surprised at the night we ended up having.  For the next month we were still hearing songs and saying to each other in excitement "OMG and they played this song too!!" It was such a blast.  This was months ago now and we are still talking about it. Love it!!
Awesome service, friendly. Cutest little cafe. Delicious food. Totally recommend this to anyone!

On a Sat morning... 

Pros:

- The seafood gumbo was the best I had during my stay. You must order it. 
- Yummy grits with the option of having egg whites.
- Great service. Our waitress was friendly and food was served nice and hot.
- it's a local spot and the decor wasn't too bad.

Cons:

- A bit out of the way from the French Quarter but it's definitely worth the $8 cab ride to the cafe.
- The grits & eggs was a bit too buttery for my day to day diet. But hey, it's The South lol. You only live once.
- The owner reprimanded his staff quite loudly that the patrons can hear. Awkward much...
Great spot. After the two rivers dog park. Bring your dog for  a nice bowl of ice water. The service is great, friendly atmosphere & staff. Thanks Emily .
Had a live roach scurry past me and the manager replied they had just finished dinner service ....

This place has the worst service. I only have this place 2 stars because they have a waiter there named Crystal. Only ask for Crystal if you want to have good service. The rest are dumb bimbos. Last time I ate we wanted some fries, never even got a refill. And the only reason we had fries in the first place was Crystal. She gave us some before we even ordered and wasn't even our waiter.

Management sucks. We complained and said well why didn't you say anything to her before. Yeah so she could spit on our food...

This was probably the worst service I've ever received. I came in tonight for a drink with friends. Our server was Elizabeth. She did not greet me as I came to the table, and she did not take my drink order, a different server who I caught just in time took my order. After I asked for another round, she actually told us she was "heading out" and made us close our tab. Very poor service and attitude. I will probably not be coming back.

Terrible service, our order got screwed up, and once we actually started eating there was a hair in one of our meals.
Another thing that I found odd was that they didn't have any ketchup dispensers, they only had packets of ketchup. I personally like a lot of ketchup and I had never been to a McDonalds before that didn't offer ketchup in a pump style dispenser. 
Strange expereince to say the least. I won't be returning to this location.

i was looking to score a ps3...didn't find one, but they did have ps3 & 360 games.  they had a bunch of small leatherman knives, which was cool.  they had a black ds for $99 and a new dual shock controller which was good.  lots of jewelry and a cool painting for a naked lady.

Went to eat here on a recent business trip to New Orleans.  Went on a Wednesday night and came back on Thursday.  Great restaurant, great staff and fantastic atmosphere.   Chris, my waiter, recommend the seafood gumbo and bacon wrapped shrimp and grits.  It was out of this world.  Told me to come back the next night to try the fried pork belly, fried oyster, and shrimp appetizer.  Was worth coming back.  The pork chip was delicious.  Would recommend this restaurant to anyone and ask for Chris.  Good man with a great handle of his menu.

This place is a great place.  I have yet to have a bad meal.  I love $5 burger Mondays.  This small place is very kid friendly which is a plus.  There are a TVs all around which is nice.  The ribs fall off the bone, the salmon has an excellent flavor and the blue cheese wedge.. well fantastic and does not cost $6+ like other places.  Try the fried Oreo sundae.  To die for!.

Anyway this place is a local restaurant and one of my favorites in S. Tampa.
