This is a great hotel. I stayed here for a conference and was in one of the updated atrium rooms. The hotel is everything that you would expect of a Gaylord property. There were plenty of restaurants, the grounds were perfectly maintained, and everything was beautiful. The resort fee was a bit annoying, but I've seen it at other hotels before. I will absolutely stay here again.

A parched dining experience....

I used to live near Citrus Park years ago and always enjoyed the classic pub style food and casual Key West style ambiance. I was in the vicinity recently and decided to check Ballyhoo out again. I was really looking forward to the fish tacos that used to be one of my fav menu items in the past.. 

From reading previous reviews it seems that the management had changed hands, any my beloved fish tacos were a huge disappointment! I order the grilled fish version and although the portion was huge, I rather have quality over quantity. 

The fish was horribly overcooked,and the tacos were dry. They did not serve any type of pico de gallo or salsa with it, nor was there any shredded cheese, a taco staple. Just bunch of lettuce, sparse tomatoes and dry, unseasoned rubbery fish.I asked for some salsa and lime and the server brought back one tiny little plastic cup of pico de gallo, and some dried up limes.. 

I like to smother my tacos with salsa. The server was friendly but very good at her disappearing act so unless I got up to find her, that was about all the salsa I was going to get! The tacos were accompanied by black beans and rice which were just dull, no seasoning.

My friend ordered a salad which looked like nothing special either. 

I did enjoy my cosmo martini though so a little buzz was nice to get through the mediocre meal. 

I'm rating Ballyhoo two stars because of the martini and because I didn't sample any other menu items and perhaps they do better at wings and burgers. But I certainly wouldn't go out of my way to dine here again...

I've been eating Pina's food for many years. In fact, since they opened.  The pizza I would rate a 2. It's doughy and greasy and lack flavor. 
The strombolis on the other hand are delicious. 
If you are wanting a good pizza try Alex's  in Roxborough or Tonellis in Lafayette Hill.

We just came into town and this was the closest place to our hotel with decent ratings. This place was a big disappointment for dinner. I have three little ones and ordered cheeseburgers from the kids menu. They were basically sliders charged at $5 a piece. Left my 8 year old starving. And my Ruben  sandwich was good. 

The waiter was our biggest complaint. Not really rude but gave us that kind of service that lets you know your not welcome. She did not tell us about the specials nor was she attentive. Came back at the end of our meal to ask if we needed anything. 

Overall food was good but service left much to be desired. Will not be returning this vacation.

Really a big place to have fun! Nice staff and life guards.
The attractions are great and interesting. We had a lot of fun there.
Will definitely go again!

True Mexican taqueria. True authentic Mexican Food. Muy buenos tacos, sopes y gorditas.

My family and I were at UCSB for a Softball camp and stopped at this restaurant on our way back home to San Diego. I must say, it was well worth our stop. 

As a Tijuana native, hime of street tacos, I approve this taqueria.

Great looking place. Lots of beer obviously. A beer lovers haven. Other than that, not much to differentiate this place from another bar except they have more beer choices. Not that a bar is a problem. Just looking for better food with the beer to enhance this place.  Hope they try to step up their game in that area. Kudos to our server Dave.  He was awesome. Great service, beard and stache!

So I generally am not particularly critical of restaurants but today this place needs to get this review. My husband and I arrived and were placed on the wait list. No big deal. Some nice person gave us a sample of the deep dish pizza and we quickly changed our minds on what we were going to order. The pizza was no better than Pizza Hut. We were seated and ordered the artichoke dip and a flatbread pizza. The artichoke dip came out. Most of the chips were small pieces. Hardly suitable for dipping. The waitress did not bring us flatware or napkins. She seemed to disappear so we had to flag someone down to get those. The flat bread pizza was something kids could make. On grocery store flatbread and pre fab low cost ingredients.  To me the biggest disappointment was the level of food served for the price. Expected higher quality for the price. The appetizer was sub par at 9 bucks with bits of chips and the grocery store flatbread at 15 bucks was unimpressive. Probably won't go back because there are local non-chain restaurants that are far better.

"The weather is perfect" she said.

"Yes", I agreed, "it is".

"Why did you bring me here?" she asked. "You know I don't like to try anything new".

"Maynard's Market and Kitchen got very good ratings on Yelp and I wanted to try it".

"I researched Maynard's for 4 hours last night so I already know what I'm getting" she said.

"What are you getting?" I asked.

"I am getting the Steak and Frites" she said. " It is an 8oz Certified Angus Beef skirt steak, maitre d' hotel butter, house-made French fries"

"Wow, you really did your homework" I said.

"Do you know what you want?" she asked.

I think I will try the Cuban Pork" I said.
"It is a sandwich with Ham, Gruyere, pickles, jalapenos, caramelized onions, lime juice, cilantro" I said "It's awesome, though I could do without the cilantro"

... Later on...

"Hey, I think the train is coming" I said. 

"Where do you think it is coming from? She asked.

"It could be coming from anywhere" I said. "How is your steak?"

"It is perfect" she said. "I love this place and I love you for taking me here. You're the greatest"

...and later yet...

"Hey, did you see that guy?" she asked.

"No I didn't, who was it?" I replied.

"It looked like someone famous. He looked like he was in one of those hair bands in the 80's" she said.

"Cool" I said.

"Do the mountains look like white elephants?" I asked

"You are an idiot" she said.
Kellys is AMAZING. Probably the best money can buy in Florida. Its reasonable and has great service and amazing-ly, well executed food. Been here once and it will NOT be my last time here.

The fish tacos! The shrimp tacos! Amazing. But the carnitas--how do you mess up fried pork?! The carnitas taco was possibly the worst I've had, but it was easy to overlook once I chomped into a fried shrimp taco. It's awesome that they have Mexican coke, though it's a shame it's $3 a bottle. Makes me think: coke or another taco? Taco it is! For seafood tacos, this place is the best.

Delicious food in a fun setting.  Great helpful and friendly service.  Two levels of seating near the bar.  We had awesome buffalo cauliflower, egg rolls with philly cheese steak and amazing kale salad.  highly recommend the Tavern.

Loved it! We made a reservation and everything was ready when we arrived 5 minutes before our scheduled time. The food & service was amazing! 
Our waiter kris knew his stuff, he recommended good red wine and good food. we had the crab cake & the salmon with pecan sweet potatoes. This is what I was waiting for when I visited New Orleans, for my mind to go omg that was delicious, my fiancé is a chef and he said that the food was amazing that he would def come back. The dessert was blackberry something Alaska, it was okay. Side note: we saw them pick up a table & they actually change the table cloth instead of just putting new plates and utensils. Great restaurant! We couldn't go upstairs because there was an event but def doing back tomorrow!

I reviewed the Tria in Rittenhouse and gave 4 stars. This Tria, hello! 5 stars!  The food is always worth 5 stars, in both locations. But this location in Washington square west is much more spacious and way less crowded. There's plenty of outdoor seating also!  In love with Tria. Always amazing food, unique small plates that blow away your tastebuds, rare craft beers, large selection of cheeses, and oh yeah, it's a wine bar!?  I go for the beer though :-)   And I can seriously eat every item on the menu they are all as equally delicious.  

Thanks Tria for rocking my world. Can't wait for the new beer bar to open this fall!!

Just ok food.  Paying $5.95 for chips and salsa is a bit much. Most restaurants you get them for free or a lot less. Food portions were large and service was good. I like they had vegetarian and vegan options. Both times we have gone the place has been empty. 
***If they are $3.75 then we were overbilled. Going to have to downgrade to one star.
Good fast breakfast. The restaurant was clean and tidy. The food was fast and hot. The manager was putting the orders together so  food was coming out fast and fresh.

I came in a few months ago and was very impressed with the customer service. I wasn't ready to buy, but wanted to check out some mattresses. Bruce showed me a bunch of different mattresses and gave me a price range. I never felt pressured and felt like I got the same service I would have if I was ready to buy. I went in a couple weeks later and Bruce wasn't there, but Ryan helped me and gave me the same service as Bruce did! I was a little nervous because I wasn't sure if the experience would be the same as the first time, but it was! I ended up buying my mattress that day and I'm loving it! I was very impresses with the entire situation!

This place is always packed! I expected the best.  When I stepped out of my car it smelled soooo goood!!  My tummy was ready for some boiled shrimp, corn and potatoes but sadly.... the shrimp was incredibly spongy. Over cooked maybe? Old? The waitress was nice enough to get me new basket but it was the same. The shell was stuck to the shrimp and to top it all there was no flavor. My co-workers orderer po-boys and they complaint about the bread which was hard. They ate the inside of the po-boy and said the taste was average. I was so disappointed. The service was great but ... whats going on in the kitchen?

I was excited when I learned that Marti's, a once outstanding restaurant, was reopening under the direction of capable restaurant folks. My wife and I thought our anniversary would be the perfect occasion to give it a try. When I made the reservation I noted that it was a special occasion and requested a good table. The person who took the reservation assured that he would make the special occasion known to the staff, which sounded great. We got the good table, but little else to make the night memorable. 

The restaurant is beautifully redone and creates an understated elegant atmosphere, but that dissipated rapidly when our server approached, after several minutes. She made no introduction, gave no welcome, but presented two wine lists and a "small plates" menu, took a drink order and left. Now, while I am familiar with the concept of small plates, I have never been given such a menu independent of the dinner menu, without explanation, except maybe in a bar. Were we getting a "sneak peak" at the appetizers? Were these suggested accompaniments to our drinks? Were they snacks because dinner would be slow in coming? The server simply did not favor us with any helpful thoughts on the subject. Then the drink order came and the drinks were wrong. That started the tone for the meal.

To say the service was less than attentive is an understatement. It seemed the server would rather not be bothered. 

Without belaboring in detail, the seared foie gras was so undercooked it was stringy. The blue crab bisque was lukewarm, the pommes frites we ordered to come with the entrees came somewhere between appetizers and entrees, the entrees came on hot plates, but the food was barely warm. We didn't send anything back, but in the spirit of helping a new restaurant improve we mentioned these shortcomings to our server who expressed perfunctory concern. By the way, the food was good but not great. The seared scallop dish is way over-priced for the portion size.

The final straw was that the very specific request that our coffee not be served until the desserts were served was openly ignored. The server immediately poured coffee and commented that the dessert usually come out pretty quickly, as if to say I know you don't want this now, but it is more convenient for me. The desserts didn't arrive for another 10 minutes. I could go on, but enough said.
 
Marti's has been open long enough that these should not be growing pains. They were busy, but not slammed when we were there. And while some of these things may seem small, when you are paying $90 a person with the tip (I did tip, but only 15% rather than usual 20-25%) you should have at least a good, if not great experience. I hope they correct their problems and become a successful restaurant, but the have a way to go.

Very rustic, but very tasty. Set in a small strip mall near the Zoo, the food is deliciously authentic. The value is tremendous; kebabs, rice, bread, salad and soup for $10. Highly recommended middle eastern "hole in the wall".

Cancellation at this hotel sucks. I booked the hotel through booking.com and had to cancel because my mom had cancer and  I was the only one who could take her to appointments. I made the reservation in October of last year and cancelled in November. My stay wasn't until March. I cancelled with booking and checked multiple times to make sure it was indeed cancelled. I then revived a text stating that they were looking forward to my stay in March. I then called and explained that I had cancelled my reservation and they said they had no record of it and I would be charged the full amount. I have been fighting this with my bank for almost four months now. They refuse to settle this and now I'm going to be out 300.00 because I was more worried about my mother's health then I was about following up and now embassy and booking has screwed me. I will never stay at another Hilton property nor will I ever use another third part site.

If I could give this establishment zero stars, I would. The manager/owner (I'm not sure what position he holds) is extremely rude to every customer that walks in the door. He's an older man with glasses and a constant look on his face as if he hates his life and job. If you see him, be prepared for a world of rude and abrasive responses. On one occasion, we went in and were told it would be a 45 minute wait even though there were multiple tables (both hibachi and regular) open. While I have worked in food service as a manager much of my adult life, I understand there are circumstances that are often out of the managers' control in terms of who is working and how many tables a server may have. However, there is an appropriate and POLITE way to address the situation. Today I called the restaurant repeatedly to see what time they served lunch till. The phone rang and went to an answering machine each time. When we arrived at the restaurant, the man, who seemed more preoccupied with his laptop and sitting on his butt, was extremely rude to the guests in front of me as well as to myself and my family. He snapped as us and said they are closed at 2:30 - it was 2:15 when we walked in. If the restaurant closes prior to the posted time, they should probably lock the door or put a sign outside to avoid any customer interacting with this so-called manager. I will never recommend this restaurant to anyone and will never be back to be treated so poorly for over-priced, sub standard food. It is pity because we live so close and would probably be frequent guests at such an establishment. Between our group and the group in front of us, the restaurant lost out on hundreds of dollars of business. This has been a consistent experience and it is absolutely ridiculous. Do not come here, go anywhere else that deserves your hard earned money. The experience and cost are not worth the time and frustration. This place should be shut down or hire new managers to run it. Ridiculous.

Two terrific experiences have persuaded me that these guys are honest.

I bought new tires here, which needed to be special ordered.  I never asked about price.  Yet when the bill came, the price, with installation, matched the lowest price I found online for the tires alone.

Months later, my brakes were squeaking slightly, so I took my car in for an inspection.  I would have easily believed they needed to be changed, but the service manager called me to tell me that I had plenty of useful life left on the pads. I offered to pay them for the inspection, but they declined.

In both instances, the mechanic could have taken advantage of me to make a buck.  But they didn't.

When something does go wrong with my car, I'm bringing it here.  Terrific, honest service.

Two years later and I still recommend GVDR for all your inert materials needs. Timely, professional and easy to work with. 
Just got a delivery today and the driver was friendly and professional and he didn't even run over my plants on the way out like some of those dudes do. 
Rock on w Green Valley.
Nothing spectacular about this hotel but it is in a great location, everyone's friendly and the rooms are comfortable. I would return.
Love this place! Food never disappoints, spicy and tasty and delicious! Service is excellent, ambiance is understated elegance. Will definitely go back!

There isn't a bad seat anywhere in the beauty. I have amazing memories in this stadium and I hope it stands for decades to come! 

I would really like to see some more events here, though. With such a beautiful open-air stadium, it would be awesome to see more events and concerts!

This is the perfect spot to grab a bite to eat and a margarita before a Lightning hockey game. (Go Bolts!) I have done that multiple times now, and I have enjoyed it each time. I can't speak for the service inside the restaurant, but I love sitting at the outside bar, and service has been spot on.

If you get there by 6 pm, there are a few happy hour specials; after 6 pm it's about $8 for a frozen strawberry margarita. We always order chips and salsa, and it comes out of the kitchen in minutes. Chips are fresh, and the salsa is decent, if uninspired.

My favorite item on the menu is the grilled avocado halves topped with ahi tuna.  So surprising that a dish of this caliber is on the regular menu - but it is, and it is delicious. Served with a side of boring rice, this is still the item to eat when you go here.

That being said, I tried the Southern Tacos last night: chicken strips, slaw, corn salsa, and avocado ranch with a bbq drizzle, served in two tortillas - and they were awesome!  So, now I am torn as to what to get next visit, but it's a good problem to have.  Shout out to the bartender for recommending the Mexican corn bread as my side item-it was outstanding, and heads and tails better than the rice.

Hablo Taco has surprised me by being way better than I expected, and I look forward to trying other items on their menu.
My wife and I found his place on our last day in New Orleans on the other side bourbon street (Frenchmen area). The service was excellent and the food tasted good.

Came here with my friends for lunch and was really surprised. I felt a tad under dressed for how nice and elegant it was inside. We were seated and given plenty of time to look at the menu. The waiter was spot on, and generous. He kept on refilling our water and recommended certain things. 

I got the miso soup and scallion pancake and miso soup. The miso soup was very smooth and the tofu in it was tasty. It's been awhile since I had miso soup that good. Then I got sushi which consisted of: tamago, shrimp, crab, octopus, and salmon. It was very delicous and each bite was flavorful. The octopus seemed a tad tough but it was still delicous. Everything came in good portions. Well worth the $11.95. 

Then I had banana tempur for dessert. So many bananas. It was so yummy! The bananas didn't feel oily or heavy, they were delicous. Will definitely get them again, and it was big enough to share. 

$55 in total for everyone. It is certainly an experience. If I was more comfortable with money I would totally go here every week. This place seems like it'd be successful in New York. Reminded me of all the nice restaurants up there. Good job!

Good all in one place that combined deli, grocery, cheese, and wine.  It is however, very crowder. If you are getting food from deli, to order online for to go ahead of time is a good tip to avoid long waiting time

Very friendly staff, beautiful fresh flowers, great customer service and just nice people.  I like to support local companies and Hope Blooms makes it so easy with great flowers at awesome prices.  Once you go to Hope Blooms you'll never buy flowers anywhere else.

Legit the best hot Dog I've ever had!!! I'm not a total hot dog person but I'm Obsessed with Dave's dogs... they are totally unique and different / I tried the Mac and cheese one, flaming hot cheetos (so good) and tried my bf's which he had the SB style and another one can't remember the name/ but wow wow wow/ sooo good- I can't wait to go again- I'm so excited for them to open up there store front off turnpike!!! Oh can't forget about the elote- so damn good!

I have eaten at this place twice, and at the other restaurant once.

Neither of these restaurants are very good. These restaurants would get 1 or 2 stars west of the state of Louisiana. However, since so many people in Tampa Bay have never actually had great Mexican or Tex-Mex food, they think this is the best Mexican food they've ever had. And that's because it is, because they haven't eaten Tex-Mex in San Antonio, TX, for example. Where they make tortillas that melt in your mouth

But back to Red Mesa. I think I have found an accurate way to describe Red Mesa:

The food that you get here tastes no better than the (Tex-Mex) food you would get at a Mex chain like Chili's, but Red Mesa fancies up the menu descriptions and jacks up the prices and adds a little hip restaurant decor in order to make you think the food is better than it really is. 

It's just bland, mediocre Tex-Mex style food that can be had at Chili's for much less money.

Advice: If you are going to eat here, stay away from the appetizers and side dishes and the tacos which are outrageously priced. (In Texas they would laugh you off the street if you told someone you paid 5 dollars for a taco, like Red Mesa charges.) Try to order a "combination" platter that has 1, 2 or 3 items for one price. Stay away from the guacamole, which is NOT WORTH 7 dollars. Just try to fill yourself up with the chips and get a combo dish. Desserts are also mediocre.

We visited here for my husband's birthday breakfast. It was recommended by a friend. The service was amazing! Every staff member was so polite to us and overly eager to serve us. Even with our daughter spilling her milk all over the floor. They assured us not to cry over spilled milk. The prices are really low, it reminded me of what a diner should be. We had great food and a wonderful experience. Even with the old school of paying by cash, we didn't mind in the least! We recommend this place to everyone truly looking for great service, a blast from the past, and good quality home cooked meal!

Being Jamaican and growing up in a Jamaican Restaurant I have been searching for good Jamaican food in Philadelphia. I have tried several Jamaican / Caribbean places in Philadelphia and this is by far the best place yet. I even took my parents to the Jerk Hut when they came to visit and they were impressed as well. 

The Jerk Hut experience is all about the food (I haven't had the pleasure of hanging outside on the Jerk Hut Lawn/Patio and listening to Reggae Vibes but I am looking forward to it in the Spring and Summer. 

Compared to other Jamaican food places the Jerk Hut is pricey but is more than reasonable when compared to other food sorts.  In my opinion it is worth it. 

Service: Remember you are getting a Jamaican experience, they are on Island Time! 

The Jerk Hut is good if you want to relax and enjoy some quality Jamaican food. It appears that once the outside patio/lawn opens the Jerk Hut would be a great place to accommodate a group of friends to casually get together BYOB, listen to reggae vibes and play dominoes.

Pretty cool spot to check out in Franklin! I like how open it was, place was packed, but didn't feel like it at all. 
Went there on a Sunday for lunch. Breakfast is served til 1pm. I wish it was served all day, because they had some good items. 
We got fried green tomatoes for an appetizer and I got catfish sandwich, my friend got Tennessee steak sandwich with brisket. 
To drink we got peach tea cocktails , I think it was made with bourbon. Tasted so good, I would recommend it! 
First time trying both fried tomatoes and catfish . I have nothing to compare it with, but I loved it! 
Cool atmosphere, service was great as well. Would love to come back there for brunch!

Had the most delicious meal here last night! We reserved a room and it was so fun! We ordered Sushi, Hibachi, and Pad Thai. Every single thing we ate was delicious! The jalapeño yellowtale  was my personal favorite and the Filet Mignon Hibachi was to die for!

First time at Naked Peach, my waxer was super sweet and friendly. However, it wasn't as neat as i'm used to. I'll update my review. But the reason for 3 stars is for the service desk. Not the friendliest greeters. Didn't smile at all. Front desk people, are the face of the company. It also took hours for someone to schedule my appointment. This location doesn't seem to answer the phone and when they do you're on hold for some time. Despite that, I signed up for the their reward program because it's affordable, and I really like the wax specialist personality.
One of the best places in Williamson County. The sweetest most kind hearted people  been going since I was a little girl & now almost 19!!! 11/10 would recommend

I have been a customer of GZM now for a few years. I first heard of GZM through a yahoo suggestion looking for a new place to get my hair cut. On a whim, I decided to trust what one girl said, and go see the stylist named Michelle. I was with her until she moved salons and now works at GZ South. If you live near there, go check her out, she was amazing.

Due to her leaving, I wanted to stay at GZM, so I asked who I should switch to. I now see Tammy, and she is just as excellent. I always sit in her chair and say "work your magic" and I always walk away with an excellent cut. She knows what styles work with what face shapes. I am in the process of letting my hair grow out, and I completely trust her in how to go about doing that. 

For anyone looking for a new salon, GZ is the way to go. Their prices are definitely reasonable, as well.

A 90 minute wait to get in..... then got seated at 1:07  got our food at 1:59. Can you say I was a little irritated. Someone ( I think it was a manager) came to our table to say sorry about the wait but that was it. No compensation or incentive to come back. People who sat down after us next to our table received their order in 20 min. Not to rate the food might be difficult but I will try to be fair. 
      The sourdough French toast. Not a fan. More like buttery cinnamon bread. Didn't get the sense of an egg bread combo at all. Would give it a 1/5 at best. The fried chicken biscuit was good with the honey hot sauce. My wife had the hot mess it was tasty. It was good but not worth the wait

Maybe my expectations were too high with chef Joe Baldino being just named a semifinalist for a James Beard Award - Best Chef Mid-Atlantic. As others have stated the place is small, fine. But it's LOUD and that's coming from someone from an Irish family of loud talkers!

Based on other reviews, I tried the Tagliatelli al Limone which was overwhelmed by the lemon. It approached Lemon Pledge territory. My friend had the gnocchi which I tried and were amazing. This gave me food envy. 

While offering desert the server knocked our bottle of red wine down my sleeve spilling 1/3 of it. Fine, it will come out of my black sweater, but it was a goooood bottle of wine! I expected the server to say let me bring coffee or a desert as an apology, but we got nada.

Unfortunately, a disappointing experience.

We had a great time at Scream a Geddon. The walk in the woods was really fun and the line moved along at a fairly quick pace.  The houses were great, great actors,sound  effects, etc. I would have given this event  5 stars but the lines for the hayride, the houses were way too long and VERY slow moving. The people with fast passes got in pretty quick which I  get,they paid extra  to avoid the lines. The issue is that they were letting very few people  in at a time,very few.  When you have hundreds of people lined up it doesn't make sense to only let a few in at a time. I  get why they did it, to make the experience even more frightening but it doesn't  make sense on a very busy Saturday  night when the place  is loaded with people.

This place is just horrible,,,,, I have tried this place twice and i will never go back.
the poatatoes might be the worst ive had borderline unedible,,, and the wait is suprising because of how bad the food is , they all must be there for the first time, i cant understand how they get any returning business. I have been in the food industry for over 20 years , I live in Glenside and would love to have this my go to place but it is just too poor a product.. as soon as you order they drop your toast ,,, why?   when your food finally does come out your toast is cold ,,, just failing grades acrosss the board

This school is the best kept secret in the Tampa area. I am extremely happy with the experience my son has had there these last two years and I can't wait for my younger son to start there soon. The school creates a warm and nurturing environment and experience for the children that nurtures a love of learning and develops them as whole people. My son's teachers are highly trained, have many years of teaching experience and are extremely committed to the children - they really get to know them and work to give each of them what they need individually. I love the feeling of being at the school - the grounds are designed as a 'food forest' (fruit trees! herbs! tons of edible plants!) and they have a big tree-lined 'meadow' where the children get to run and play.  I also really enjoy the other parents and the broader school community. Love this place and so happy that my kids get to go here.

We started to go into McSheas, but decided to try Coco for the first time. I would call the food average Thai. It was acceptable, but nothing we had was deserving of more than 3 stars. 

The service was a little discombobulated...we had 3 different servers. One time we got the wrong dish, and afterwards we got the wrong check (higher than it should have been). They were very apologetic.

The prices are reasonable, but not really - because the portions were smaller than they should have been. We felt like we were still a little hungry.

We would go back in a pinch, but it's not likely to become one of our regulars. I get the feeling they are just going through the motions to put ouu good, average Thai food - but with a little more effort and creativity in the kitchen, they could be serving food worthy of more stars.

Excellent place for a quick lunch. Inside or outside either is an excellent choice. Views of the Gulf are a great compliment to the food. Appetizers of string onions or fried green tomatoes, FGT, is a great start for anything on the menu.
Beautiful establishment, great service, lovely food! I took my mom for her birthday and she ABSOLUTELY loved it. It was a cool experience for her and I.

Fun place to go for a pub dinner / lunch and beers.   They have a ton on tap and placement of the taps makes for a rather interesting stretching pose for the young ladies in low cut tops behind the bar.  

Everyone even other patrons were very friendly and I came back a few times while in town on Business.

I was excited to see an Indian restaurant open near our house, and we decided to give it a whirl. I am even more excited to say that India Cafe had absolutely delicious food! We tried an app of fried fish- it came with pickled onions and tamarind chutney, was a large portion easily shareable. Our entrees- the vegetarian kofta and the eggplant/tomato stew- were pleasantly spicy and hot as we had requested, but not so hot that the flavors were masked. Basmati rice came garnished with crispy fried onions. The garlic naan was warm and buttery. We will return soon- I have eaten in many different Indian restaurants and I have cooked Indian meals from scratch, so I know what well-prepared food from this region tastes like. This is the real deal.

Matcha cappuccino was incentive enough to drive 25 minutes, but once getting there I just had to try The Notorious f.i.g.  and I am not complaining.   The pistachio cream specialty coffee drink was equally amazing.  The best find of all though was the blackberry corn scone - my new favorite thing.   I will definitely be back for lunch, the menu is nothing but bold, unique flavors.

Great bakery. The hazelnut cake is fantastic! I also recommend the "cro-cremes" (cro-nut equivalents).

The staff and the owner were extremely helpful. I ordered several cakes for an event, and the owner was very accommodating to my needs.

I would definitely recommend this bakery.
This is the 3rd time I've been here and they are out of plain bagels.  How can you be out of plain bagels and it's not even 10:30 am?!

In 2014 you wouldn't catch me dead in this place. However the past 2 years Pop's has made some major improvements. I personally now go there all the time to pick up my take out beer. I have also gotten wings at this place and they are tremendous. Great local spot for a quick bite to eat, or take out beer to go. Great work Pop's your whole team should be proud of the turnaround in such a short time.

I have to agree with most of the previous reviewers.  It's unremarkable - literally.  There isn't much to say about it.  There isn't anything to commend nor anything to chastise.  

It's on my walk home so I go in when I'm craving some Chinese.  I've tried others in the area but this is probably the best.  Sadly, the Chinese food scene in University City is kind of lame.

Philly's only Takoyaki source is great. So as long as you don't mind eating Japanese food cooked by a Japanese man because his wife is American like Jane, then you will love Maru. It's cheap and BYOB. Definitely try their dessert  balls

After being prodded to join a fellow Yelper one fine Thursday evening, I entered this Benton Park favorite and was pleasantly surprised by the parade of regulars that piled in "standing room only" to eat and listen to the Soulard blues Band. 

I was struck by the characters that lined the walls in this small, old time deli. Service was friendly and approachable and the band seemed relaxed and at ease at this low key gig. The owner is very sweet. He circulates and is sure to become your friend before you leave. 

 I've never been able to enjoy blues music in St. Louis without the billow of heavy smoke in my face, and I have to say it was a pleasant departure from the usual Blues experience.. 

I had a juicy pulled pork sandwich that was smothered in it's own juices. It was delish and hallelujah, no heavy sauce!! I'm not a big beer drinker, but I luvs me sum Fat Tire and at $2 ea,, HELLO, may I have another? 

They are only open late on Thursdays for live music. Otherwise, Blues City Deli is a busy lunch spot.  I'll be back.

Very pleasant atmosphere, and great menu for the perfect price. I ordered a chicken gyro sandwich with everything on it with my friends and received a free smoothie extra because my friend ordered a large that had excess leftover, so that was awesome. 
The food arrived in almost no time! The portion size was also very filling.
The flavors are very reminiscent of what i love about mediterranean food! Overall the owners are kind and have a great personality serving tasty food. I would highly recommend this cafe to anyone who wants to stop by for a quick, delicious meal or enjoy their time with a nice ethic dish. It's even better that they deliver on GrubHub so this will definitely be one of my favorite place to order from.

The food and drinks are very good but for the second time in a row our meals were cold. After the first incidence, I called the restaurant and spoke to the manager.  He told me he had other complaints and the main reason was the removal of their plate warmers. I asked the manager to bring my concerns to the owner - which he said he would.  We tried another dinner and again our plates and meals were cold.  There is no excuse for a restaurant to serve cold food!

I went 4 times in one week while visiting family across the canal. Take out twice, solo dine in and 8 person family lunch. All rocked it. 

There is a great humor and care from the staff. Employee would be to harsh a word, they are working, but it comes from a place deeper than just having a job. 

They
 cared about what we ate, they cared that we came back, and they cared about each other.

All that being said, they had to have great food to spend money here 4x. Crab lump meat Spinach Salad, start there and you'll know. They try more.
Thanks Zydeco's it was worth checking you out.

The drink menu is nothing special, but the filet mignon sliders with fries are delicious. Service is frequent and warm. The atmosphere wasn't my thing, but it was (loudly) buzzing with conversation the whole time, so at least there's a crowd.

I'd probably go here again for a late night snack, but otherwise I'll stay away. There's a $15 minimum to use a card.

This is hands down the BEST BBQ in Indianapolis that I have tried.  Large portions that actually taste as amazing as they look.

I have tried the wings, slaw, half chicken, pulled pork, ribs, and mac and cheese and everything was FANTASTIC .

Outside seating and very friendly staff.

It's narrow and dangerous-feeling, but it's free.  

I think the construction project should do away with some of the decrepitude, but it certainly won't make it as nice as the CCC.

We researched phones beforehand. I went to this Verizon store to see if they had any of the models were were interested on.  I was greeted warmly by sales staff.  The Moto we wanted was tethered to the counter, so I asked about buying 2 and setting up a plan.  The salesperson instead suggested the Samsung J7 or J3.  I again asked about buying the Moto G5, and he said they did not sell it.  I walked over to the one tethered to the counter and said I was confused.  He said "We don't sell those anymore."   I asked what phones they DID have that were no more than 5.5 inches long.  Other than an iPhone, none. He also said they sold no unlocked phones.   I asked if I could buy an unlocked phone elsewhere and bring it in to buy a prepaid service plan.  He said he would go and ask.  He then went behind the counter, entered a code into a door lock, slipped into a back room for several minutes, and then came out and said no dice.   I was tempted to ask if I had to bring the broom of the Wicked Witch of the West to get an audience with the wizard, but held my tongue.  We bought phones and a plan elsewhere.

If you want to figure out how to get into this place I am here to tell you....Monday for lunch. I walked in with a friend at 12:15, could have sat at a table and there were zero patrons at the bar. We sat at the bar. Burger was awesome. I ordered mine with cheese, friend onions and a fried egg minus the lettuce and tomato. Absolutely loved it. Fries were only decent. I agree with some other posters...the duck fat does not translate. Cheese sauce was decent but not legendary. If I were to do it again, I would get the same burger and try other sides. Skip the fries.
My therapist did a great job listening to my concerns and making me feel comfortable. The massage was great! I can't wait to go back for my next one.

We are new to the area, so we didn't know this place under old management. We came in for a late lunch/early dinner and really enjoyed the sushi and appetizer that we had. One of our favorite rolls was the Aloha roll, which was cucumber wrapped salmon, seaweed, mango & tuna. Very light and creative. Since it was so early, we had great service & the waiter had good suggestions. We will certainly be back!

Best gluten free meal I have ever tasted. Dedicated gluten free menu. I had the pork chops and they we're out of this world. Great server and even a patient bartender who worked with me to get a gluten free drink before my meal.

The best southern food  all you can eat buffet in Treme! I always come here for breakfast which gets very busy, or late lunch.  The food is fresh, home made, like your mama's. You can see pictures of all the famous people who have eaten here including President Obama. I highly recommend this place!

This earls has done a really good job changing the atmosphere from what it used to be, to what it is today. 
I went to earls for a chamber if commerce mixer where the food is free and the drinks are a la carte. They served pulled pork coleslaw spoons which were amazing. I had a sous chef that kept coming my way with the served trays because he could see it in my eyes how much I liked them.  The other item was some sort of sushi roll, which always blows my mind that a place that's not a sushi restaurant can execute a sushi roll so well when a lot of real sushi restaurants are not good at all. Thank you earls for having legit red seal chefs.
The only reason this isn't 5 stars is that they crammed 60+ people into an area designed for no more than 30. At least I got to know people a little better, which was the whole point of the mixer!

Went into the store in Thursday morning. Immediately greeted by Gerry, the man that was working there that day. Very pleasant experience. Explained I had a budget of 1k and he worked to get my exact mattress that I wanted (was $1,800) for the outlet price of $800. The mattress was delivered the next day. Old mattress/boxspring out -- new ones in. All in less than 10 minutes. The delivery men wore shoe protectors in the house which is perfect. Received a courtesy call the day before delivery for time window and again that day of delivery and about 20 minutes before delivery. Overall great experience.

We ate here on our last night in New Orleans. The dining room was very clean and our waitress was great--really friendly and attentive! We ordered the crab and artichoke dip as an appetizer, and I had the fried shrimp platter. The portions were very generous and the food was good good good--much better than we expected from a small diner-type establishment. It's also open quite a bit later than most of the other dine-in restaurants in the area. Very glad that we checked it out!

Haven't been in awhile. Decided to stop In for lunch. Just a few patrons in the bar. The beer selection is extensive. Many local beers, which I like. 
Selected to Irish sandwich, which is basically Rueben with a twist, and the house made chips. Sandwich great. Chips were stale. I asked bartender if they were made order. She said yes yet they were cold and soggy. Clearly leftovers. 
Never was checked on after I started on the sandwich. Bartender never engaged with guests. Just flat and took orders. Didn't offer the specials. 
After about four visits of basically the same lackluster service, I think I'm moving on. Too bad because I like the beer selection and supporting local businesses.

Jim Closson with Sit Means Sit of Boise, ID was able to show us how to teach our dog all of the commands we had been struggling with in just two private sessions. We went from not being able to get our dog to come when called to walking with her off leash in one week. What a fantastic training program! I uploaded a video of my dogs progress to my blog at the address that follows. 

http://www.tumblr.com/blog/sitmeanssitmethod

I was in search of a great nail salon in St. Louis for months and finally found it! Kathy always does a fantastic job with my nails. I had never tried the gel powder before coming to Bello and now I will never go back to regular gel. The gel powder is a bit more expensive but well worth it because it lasts for 3-4 weeks without chips or wearing down my nails. The atmosphere is great too, very relaxing, I am always offered wine. I love this place!
Best sushi in the Brandon area. Awesome rolls. Friendly staff. Fresh sashimi. Favorite rolls are the black angel, spivey girl, and Snow White.

If you go to Ghini's, get the Eggs Provencale. It is their signature dish and hands down, it is the best item on the menu.  Complete with tomatoes and thyme, it is a fresh alternative to scrambled eggs and bacon.

With outdoor seating and an attached bakery, Ghini's is a nice, relaxing place for brunch on the weekends to meet up with friends and family. It can crowded, so expect a short wait. It is worth it!
Nice casino. A little dark.  But at least it did not seem so smokey. Friendly staff.
Best cannoli ever!!! Very nice girl working there. I would definitely recommend  this place if you are in Philly!
So much hype with ehh delivery. The biscuits and gravy were SO hard and lacking flavor.

I'm only giving this place 4 stars and not 5 because I got my slices to go. There was a great selection of a packed veggie slice, tomato, meat-lover, etc., and I enjoyed my pizza slices, but ultimately I'm dying to go back and order myself a pie made to order. Once I got the slices home they weren't as crispy and magnificent as they would have been if I got them made to order or even just ate them immediately at the restaurant. So I'll be changing this review next time I go back in and bring my own wine and enjoy the garlic bread, my own pie, and some cannoli.  

I can't wait to return. Good job, Giorgio!
Next time I'll skip the Monte cristo and the madam....they were delicious, but the others were to die for. I should have bought more doughnuts. Next time, I'll buy so e to bring home.

After living in South Jersey for 5 years, originally from Chicago.  Finding good Mexican Cuisine was like finding a needle in hay stack here in South Jersey.  Chicago has an abundance of Spanish Cuisine.  
Great job, On the Border!  You've exceeded our taste bud expectations as well as our service satisfaction 
Fresh food and everything made onsite definitely goes a long way along with great recipes.  
Awesome job Lynn!!  We'll be back!

Came in to Whetstone to watch game and grab some dinner.  As always, I want to use a burger with bacon/cheese/fried egg as my yardstick.  They only have one burger on the menu, and it comes with cheese, slaw, pickles and onion.  Bartender seemed more interested in dancing around than waiting on customers, and took a bit of flagging to get her attention.  I ordered the burger, told the bartender to hold slaw/pickles/onion and asked if they could add bacon or fried egg.  The bartender told me that those are "brunch things" and "dont belong on a burger".  I still cant understand how restaurants refuse to figure out a way to overcharge me for an egg, but no bacon??  There should be a law against that.

Anyway, I just ordered the burger with "just the meat and cheese".  As expected, it came out with the slaw/onion/pickles, so I sent it back.  Bartender came back with the correct order a bit later, and it was really underwhelming.  Burger was small, served on a thin squished bun, and just looked pathetic.  It was cooked properly and tasted ok, but in a city with thousands of pubs, it was weak.

Stars off for bad service, no bacon, no egg, and underwhelming meal.  Wont be back.
Just as good as what I've had back in the south. I'll definitely be coming back here on a regular basis

Eh, nothing is super special about Sushi Teri.  The rolls are alright, the food is okay, the service is meh.  I actually prefer the sushi at Whole Foods to here, but I still like to stop in sometimes with friends.

Not really sure why, but the tables are ALWAYS wet with water.  Whenever the water glasses are put down the table automatically has water all over it.  Kind of strange.

These 5 stars belong to this Home Depot's outstanding group of employees. They are consistently friendly, helpful, and fully on board for their customers.  They concentrate on making and keeping customers. I use the garden shop from spring to fall each year. We bought our snow blower, outdoor grill, and we buy all of our painting supplies and our house hold necessities at this Home Dept. It's fully stocked, always there when I need something in a hurry. Needless to add, the help I'm given to load my car up at times is so important. This service is always delivered with a smile.

I was apprehensive about taking my vehicle to a business other than going to the dealership.  I took a chance, and was very pleased.  I had called with some questions and then decided to take my vehicle in.  Jacobe, whom I had spoken with on the phone, was amazing!  He was very kind, answered all of my questions, and was very personable.  I received an oil change, tire rotation, new battery installation, front wipers, and they even told me what needed to be repaired.  I have been experiencing a strange "rattle" for a few weeks.  The service guys did a great job on my vehicle and it is running great.  I am making an appointment to get the needed repair they found for me because the service was outstanding and saved me almost half by not going to the dealership.  Larry also was really nice as he rang up my services and explained the repair and how much time it will take to fix.  I am relieved that I could trust them with my services and I will be returning!

Parking in Clearwater is a nightmare.  This establishment had no parking at all and had to pay to park just to eat here.  The food here for the price is very mediocre.  Not impressed with the food went with a party of 30 and only 5 out of the 30 people were impressed with the food. The atmosphere is great with the open air concept just wish the food was better.

I'm happy to say that all the favorable reviews I've read about Yah Mon are all true!  I went there on a Saturday night with my husband and our 2 college-age children and we all enjoyed our food tremendously.  My children and I all ordered the Taste of the Islands.  The jerk chicken was very well seasoned and had the appropriate amount of heat to it.  The curry goat was also very well prepared as so was the oxtail (so tender and fall off the bone).  The serving sizes were very generous and we ended bringing a lot of leftovers home.  My husband ordered the salmon dish, and his only complaint was that the fish was not big enough.  We were served by the owner who also happens to be the husband of the chef. Sorry i can't remember his name - but he gave us a 5-star service quality!  I highly recommend this restaurant and would definitely go back there again - and I would even take friends from out of town to dine here.  Truly a Tampa gem!
It's not the greatest jack in the box I have been to but I feel like all fast food in the city is gross and not fast at all! Try something local instead so many great spots.

It's a beautifully planned out space, and you can really escape the chaos of an otherwise hectic day here. With any service, you can use the fitness center, and the co-ed whirlpool. There's a separate steam and sauna in the locker room. Also, a cafe is available for light, healthy eating. 

I love the fact the services begin here at eight am! Now, I may not get a Brazilian done at that hour of the morn, but to get a brow wax or a pedi out of the way, that's great. Locals get an extra treat if you have a service done Sunday - Thursday!

My brow wax wasn't as extensive as I like, and it's my fault for not specifying what I do like. However, I do pay to trust the esthetician, and the 10,000 watt bulb to see all the stay hairs in view. But, I'll be back for more services, and will happily report.

Atmosphere was homey and comfortable. The cook's greet you as you come in along with the host. We made a reservation a couple hours before coming in on a Saturday night and our table was ready with bread and waters all around when we arrived. Food was incredible; fresh and came out quickly. We had several shared entres which were all delicious. Service was phenomenal. Great place for a date or small group.

My mom was in town visiting for the long weekend and so I thought it would be a good idea to take her out for nice dinner and a few laughs at a comedy club. I called the Comic Strip to order the tickets over the phone and was told about their deal where if you order an entrée before 7:00pm they will give you complimentary door tickets to another show. I thought this was a pretty good deal so I got everyone together and went there for dinner and the show. 

We all ordered something different. A fish and chips dish, a pizza, a ribeye steak, and a rib plate. None of us were very impressed with our orders. The ribeye steak was not a ribeye and it was simply laughable that they would try to pass off that piece of meat as a ribeye to a group of Albertans who know their beef! The pizza I ordered was fairly good but loaded down with so much tomato sauce it wasn't funny! 

All of us agreed that the food was more standard pub food that was meant more to cater to the drunken masses than anyone else. The prices certainly did not make up for the meal either as the ribeye steak was $23. Just what you would expect to pay for a ribeye steak except it wasn't a ribeye steak! We were happy to get the complimentary tickets but won't be going back for the dinner next time. 

The ambience of the club was great and just what you would expect for a comedy club. Well lit, good sound system, and great view from almost every seat. It's a great idea to get there early so you can have your choice of seat and not get too close to the stage!

The comics we saw were great!  I didn't care much for a local girl that was on stage but I did laugh with some of her jokes. Not really complaining I just found her a little too vulgar and her humor wasn't really my style. The headliner was hilarious and we were all splitting our guts laughing so hard. 

All-in-all a great place to go for a funny evening out with friends and family alike!

Awesome place to hangout with friends.
Great Pizza with Great ingredients.
Excellent staff and service.

I will just highlight the pepperoni pizza.
The cheese was gooey. The pepperoni crispy. The Dough cook through and firm Great crust that had the great golden brown of bread. Sometimes burnt, but meh.
Great selection! Ordered the happy herd which was more than enough for 5 people. Food was a bit cold but overall great taste! Will definitely be coming back.

I'm not sure it gets much better than Mr. B's. This is one of the best restaurants in the FQ. Bar none. It is far less in price than many of the old standards (Galatoire's, Antoine's, Brennan's, etc), and has a better variety, honestly. It also feels far less touristy. The menu also has much lighter/healthier items than many of those spots. I don't feel like I walk out of there sick to my stomach from super heavy food. 

The menu is not enormous yet has a perfect array of options. The decor is classy and modern enough and doesn't feel old and outdated like many of the "standards" in the FQ. We had excellent food and service while there. The bread served before the meal is delicious. While my fish was quite good, the orzo served with it was AMAZING!! They let me get it instead of potatoes and didn't charge. I would go back there literally to get a plate of orzo- it was THAT delicious! Everything was tasty!!

If you are a tourist or if you are a local I suggest Mr. B's. This was one of my favorite spots to hit when I used to live there, and one of the 1st places on my list to go when I  am in town.

The food deserved a higher rating, but it is in a strip mall next to a bar and grill
on Ulmerton Road. Not a place you would expect to spend $125-150 for two people without wine.

Atmosphere              85   A dime a dozen in NY, but A+ for Florida
Service                       85   Rearity in Florida- heads up professional service
Food                           75   On the low end of up scale creative cuisine
Value                          70    Expensive for where and what you get
  
It is a "miles away from Florida" venue. If you don't mind spending the money to experience a big city restaurant, it is great.. Unfortunately it is underappreciated from someone who comes from a big city like myself. Terrific change of pace venue.
Under all conditions, I would recommend it.

Amber Indian is worth the drive to suburban hell--it's by far the best Indian in the metro area! The weekend buffet was beautiful--spicy chaat, pickles, onion pakoras, nav rattan korma et al. Everything was intricately and uniquely spiced; I usually find saag paneer and channa masala somewhat pedestrian, but both dishes made my tongue dance at Amber Indian. It looked like there were a ton of options for meatitarians as well. This buffet rivals my faves on Devon Avenue in Chicago. It's a must-go for anyone who enjoys Indian. 

The only downside was they had two TeeVees playing some really inane-looking Tim Allen movie. Blech.

This place is like a fancy Subway.  The staff was very friendly and attentive.  The clam chowder was a 3 out of 5.  I also had the turkey bacon avocado sandwich.  It was a 2.  Very bland and I think the tomatoes were old.  I did like the chocolate strawberry.  It was a nice surprise..

Luke is always a great experience. 

My favorites:
-50 cent raw oyster happy hour. 
-Paneed pork chop with red beans. Thick, smoky red beans the way they should be. 
-Oyster salad. Not your average disappointing oyster salad with 3 oysters. Almost a dozen of the best fried oysters you can eat. 

I return to New Orleans often, and even when I resist, I always end up back at Luke, and always am pleased.

I think the workers here are stoned and bone eyed. I ordered delivery, after almost 2 hours I called and asked about my order. At first they said it was on the way. The second time I called they said they had no record of my order and could not "find" it in the system. I stupidly ordered again and they never showed up. 420 weed is tight! I wish I could give a rating lower than zero, these guys would get a negative 5.

Amazing food and service. We walked in on Sunday afternoon and was greeted by the fantastic bartender, Steve, who helped us pick out our meal. I was excited about all the fresh seafood, unfortunately the stone crab claws were on display, but not available. We did get delicious oysters, watch out the horseradish is spicy. Had the blue crab soup also delicious and because Steve told the chef we wanted to see what the restaurant offered, he sent a complimentary gumbo that was fabulous. For our main entree we got something that was not on the menu, but Steve told us was a great dish to show off the restaurant, a pork shank with onions and potatoes and sauage and then a little hidden secret pork belly. All of it was wonderful. The skin on the pork was crispy and fatty and the meat fell off the bone and eating with the hidden pork belly made it more delicious. We will be back!

I've always liked this On The Border... it's like Chi Chi's on Don Pablo's, with one major difference - the food is really delicious!  It's like every other Mexican chain restaurant in terms of menu choices, decor, and presentation, but something about the way everything tastes just makes them a cut above the rest.  

We've also always had really great service every time, so kudos to whoever does the hiring in there.

Now on to the reason they're only getting 3 stars... up until recently, they gave you the option to build your own burrito.  Every table was equipped with a pad of paper with all types of burrito choices on it for you to fill out however you want, and you would then hand it to your waiter and be presented with your perfect burrito shortly thereafter, no ifs ands or buts.  In my opinion, probably the best thing they had going for them was this build your own burrito note pad.  Boyfriend and I went there Monday night and were devastated to learn that in addition to the menu changes mentioned by the previous yelper, the build your own burrito option is now no more.  

Bad move, OTB.  Bad move.

I got enchiladas instead, and they were delicious.  But something about filling out check boxes and having full control over what's being put on my plate will be very sorely missed.

The food is usually good. Unfortunately if you order delivery you have to wait more than two hours to get your food, with a chance of not getting it at all. 

Placed a order via grub-hub last night at 10:59 PM with estimated delivery being between 12:15 AM and 12:25 AM. At 1:30 AM I called them to see if the food would be delivered soon. The man on the phone so they were really backed up with orders and it should be there in a couple minutes. At 2:30 AM I decided just cancel the order with GrubHub. 

I completely understand being busy but waiting three hours for food is unacceptable.

If I ever order from Oregon steaks again I will be sure to drive there and pick up my food. Food is good service is awful but I guess that's what you get when you order from a place that's  open 24 hours and you place the order after 9 PM on a Tuesday.

On a date with my wife we stopped here for dinner after a movie ,I had the prime rib baked potato and broccoli she had the pulled pork ,I also had the mushroom artichoke soup.the soup was so good I wanted to lick the bowl,the prime rib was to die for and the pulled pork was down home good.the only down side was the broccoli it was tasteless and the corn bread was dry but that really didn't impact the experience .the wait staff was great and everyone tried very hard to make us feel welcome

I went with some friends a few weeks ago to enjoy live music upstairs; they had 3 different bands. The atmosphere was very welcoming, the bartender was charming and so attentive, and the music was delightful. I will be back soon!
This location was terrible; low stock and the staff was not helpful at all. Went to a different store down the street and was helped right when I walked in the door.

Way past the age of caring about margaritas or decor (never cared anyway), I go to restaurants for the FOOD!  While it's true that the decor at Senora's looks like the interior of an unsuccessful pinata factory, I don't need to look up to the ceiling when on my plate is, by far, the best Mexican food to be found.  Mexicans and Texans might disagree, but who the hell cares?  I begin each meal with a chicken tamale.  You'll find none better. Tacos and enchiladas reign supreme here, and the more of the spicy homemade pineapple salsa you can slurp down with each bite only adds to the enjoyment and office-killing garlic breath.  Yes, the salsas are overpriced, especially since they are central to the Mexican food experience, but it's a lot cheaper than driving to Texas and a lot safer (ehh..West Chester), than visiting Mexico.  And, at least for your first time there, try the flan.  Other Mexican restaurants purport to deliver flan to your table but none of it comes close to Senora's thick, caramel-infused, cheesecake-like recipe.  One slice is enough for two, maybe three, though there will be some threats from other forks for that last piece. 

The food is always the freshest, the tortillas are homemade, and the service is prompt.  We've been eating there since 1994 and still happily make the 36+ mile round trip for the treat.

I have a feeling that Senora's suffers from not having a liquor license because the roach-like West Chester college crowd, still a bit dimwitted about the world at large, thinks that no fun can be had without alcohol.  Go to a bar for your drinks.  Go to Senora's for food.  Freshman cannot live by Margaritas alone.

One of our favorite things when trying out a new place is to sit at the bar (when we don't have our kids), order a nice cocktail and pick a couple of appetizers to nibble on.

We were in town for a few days and stopped into Charro Steak to check it out.  We sat at the bar.  I ordered an "El Maestro" off their cocktail menu.  The bartender said they ran out of peppers (jalapenos?) and to choose something else.  I did.  The other drink was okay but I really wanted that spicy marg.  My wife liked her drink (with the upside-down Pacifico).

On their lunch menu, they have "Mixtas!" - which seemed exactly what we wanted:  tapas-style plates we could share.  I ordered three (for $7) and added steak.  The bartender wanted to charge a split-plate fee.  I have always been confused by this concept.  If a couple are sharing food and want to eat off the same plate, that should be okay.

So I ordered more mixtas so she put the order in on two plates.  All together we had the Chilaquilas, Esquites con Crema, Chile Verde Mac & Cheese and Spinach & Nopalitos en Crema.

The steak was good....but the rest of the food sounded way better on paper than it tasted.

So far my first experience here was "meh" but I would definitely like to come back and have a real dinner based on the other reviews and photos I have seen.

Oh one more thing:  the Charro Steak website has some issues (all browsers).  The upper menu has white text over a white background, so finding the menu (which also appears outdated) was a real treat :P

Olin Library is the main branch of the Washington University Library System and is open to the public as well. The students of WashU really have something to boast about with over four levels of media and books available at their disposal as well as full-time staff committed to helping with research.

In all the papers I've written, I've never had difficultly getting the materials I needed. Even if, for some random reason, Olin doesn't have the book I need, they subscribe to MOBIUS (a organization of libraries in Missouri), which can get me what I need in a matter of days.

The library is always at a comfortable 65 degrees at all times, so if you get cold easily, I'd bring something to put on. There is almost always a place to sit, but be prepared to fight for a seat the week before and during finals.

Uh oh! They serve (bad) prepackaged spinach artichoke dip here. There's almost nothing worse than knowing your meal was assembled from packaged food by someone no more talented than yourself for any money. Don't waste time on breakfast or dinner here. I don't know that it will last serving food like that.

Literally spit the burger out!   

The good:  Milkshake was solid - not exceptional, but certainly acceptable.  

The bad:  fried Oreos were a mixed bag. The first two were pretty good - but the remainder were hard and I gave up.  

The ugly:   WORST.  BURGER.  EVER.  So, the bun and toppings seemed like they would be ok - even good - if not for being paired with the most tasteless piece of meat ever. It's a shame a place calling itself "Burger Lane" falls short on the burger.  Frankly it ruined the whole thing.  

I don't see this place having much business if they don't improve quality.

We love this place and they never disappoint. I tried the drunken noodles for the first time and they were to die for, as well as the papaya salad, which we always order. I am glad they are located in our neighborhood.

I'll be real with you guys: there's no point in buying things at Sony Style. Since it's Sony's official store, you're never going to get a deal on ANYTHING. All the products are priced at the official MSRP no matter what. 

Yeah, okay, this place is cool because you get to see all the cool, shiny, Sony things in one place. That's great, but when it comes to buying the products you're better off going to Futureshop, Best Buy, or the Internet, where they'll cut you at least some kind of deal. 

Trust me.

I freaking love this food. I didn't get a hot dog but all the reviews about caramelos made me need one. I also got a cabeza taco on a whim and OH MY GOSH, new favorite. Hello face meat, I love you! It's inexpensive and tastes GREAT. I just wish they were more clear on how/where to pay. We asked and were told one thing but ended up having to do something else. It won't keep me from coming back at all, but it was annoying.
Good coffee, lovely space, friendly employees and open at 7 am on a Sunday!  Couldn't have asked for more.

The menu is enormous... plenty to choose from.
We've ordered delivery (3) times.
The food has been delivered very quickly.
The quality was great.
It was reasonably priced... not any higher than any other sushi downtown.

Overall great experience!

This is one of my favorite places to get coffee so I finally decided to come for breakfast after hearing great reviews and I was not impressed. I got the open egg sandwich with avocado and after a long wait it finally came out barely warm. The avocado, which I paid extra for, was unripe and completely inedible. The breakfast potatoes were good, but overall it was definitely not worth what I paid for it and I definitely would not get it again.

Whats up with all the good reviews!  Vacationing near weekie wachee and wanted some good thai food and saw all the good reviews so though lets try it. 1st off came here mon cuz yelp said they were opened and they were closed so came the next day.  The thai lady with glasses sat our party of 8, they was only 3 tables in the whole place and her lack of enthusiasm to service us just set the tone for the whole meal.  Seemed like she was rushing us  the whole time,  quick to seat us,  basically  threw our food at us,  quick to take our plates and quick to give us the check.  Now i don't know if these other yelpers being from a small town knew what real thai food should taste like but this ain't it.  I got the panang curry and my bowl of curry had tons of over cooked veg small amount meat and hardly any curry. My wife got pad  thai. Now being from atlanta we had our fair share of pad thai and this was horrible the pad thai was wet, watery, too sweet  and the sauce tasted like grocery store bought generic pad thai sauce. The appetizers were nothing special and not plated well. If your desperate  for thai then do it, but if you are expecting authentic great Thai food aviod.
Food ... 3
Decor .... 7
Service .... 2
Atmosphere  ... 5
Would i eat here again .... nope, even if i was desperate

I appreciate very much the generosity of this establishment, they provide 1 ounce tasters (free of cost) so that when you order your beer you know what it will taste like.  They also provide a tasting menu where you can order a round of several different varieties of beers for a 'minimal' cost.  I think that this kind of service is world class.

Great food especially for the price.  I don't eat sandwiches much, so I haven't eaten any, but others tell me they're good.  I can speak for the food though and I must say I love the authentic Latin dishes.  Some entrees are only served on particular days of the week, so give it a try on different days.
 
The GOOD - most of the dishes.  I like the tilapia, the grilled chicked breast (Wednesdays only), fish in salsa (Fridays only), chicharones, empanadas, moro rice, and more.  Oh, and the portion size.  I usually make a regular meal (under $7) into two meals.

The SO-SO - the yellow rice (even thought it seems like they have a new recipe so I should give it a try), pernil, baked chicken (quarters), and picadillo

The BAD -  the thought that if I eat this much every day, that I will gain some serious weight.  Eat some and put the rest away for another meal!
Had breakfast here.  Great service and the Creme Brulee French toast was amazing. The portions were large.  When in Nashville definitely stop by for breakfast.

I love Honeygrow! Everyone is so friendly and ready to help.  I love having their stir fry every time I go there.  My favorite is the garlic chicken option. What's even better is that you can customize your order, so naturally I loaded my order with vegetables! I can't eat a whole order so I always get it to go. The drinks are great too!

This place has the worst dining experience. Dining in has been the worst experience ive had. My husband and I came in, was seated immediately but waited nearly 30 minutes to be greeted by our waitress, which was after we flagged down a hostess for one. Once she came, we decided to order drinks, apps and dinner all at once due to the long wait time just for introductions. Well an hour later, we still hadnt received drinks or any of our food. Once our drinks arrived (FINALLY), so did our dinner (minus the appetizer ). The waitress said that our apps were given to another table and they had already started eating it. I honestly received better service at the bar while waiting for my table. I completely urge you to come here after you've eaten someplace else. Games are fun. Wish the gaming area was bigger but no complaints there. But def dont dine here. Take my word. U WILL be disappointed.

My husband and I were invited here by a friend.  He raved over it, we were not disappointed.  By far the best steak i have ever eaten.  The price is very reasonable too.  Your sides which are scrumptious by the way are included in the price.  You will be delighted if you choose to eat here.  The place is small, but worth the wait if there is one!  We moved away from Tampa to Upstate NY, but when i return it will be my go to!

This restaurant was a pleasant  surprise.  I can't say anything bad about drury inn. From the great customer at front desk from Reynaldo and Jaime to the hot breakfast and staff -Patrick and other stafff.... customer service was phenomenal. Rooms was great, hot water, comfy beds, cold air, great views - natural light.   Thank you for getting me reacquainted with my southern hospitality roots!!!

I came here with a few friends for my birthday celebration and boy was I impressed. We arrived just before closing which we didn't intend to, and the staff didn't seem a tad bit bothered. They attended to us, were generous, and the food was absolutely delightful. I have lived in North County all my life and am excited to have found you all. I will be returning. Thank you for the amazing service!

Good lunch special. One spring, soup and an entree for $8. Nothing spectacular, it was good. Small place off Nolensville. I recommend it for lunch. Smiling Elephant and Siam are better in my opinion but this place is fine. Nice waitstaff, good service. We got our order quickly.

I really thought these guys were honest and good people but they are like every other corporate business. They over price and give you the run around. I had a tune up there cost me nearly $600 didn't change 1 coil!!! Months after I had them replace my water pump which cost me just under $500 they failed to adjust my timing belt and since I knew nothing about cars they allowed me to leave their shop with a crazy tapping noise as if I owned a diesel truck and I made sure to bring it to their attention that's not a sound I ever heard prior to bringing it in. They insisted that I take it to who did my oil change. Days go by I'm on my way home from work and boom! Long story short I ended up having to get a used engine because they failed to pay attention to detail. Cost me $3,000.00!!!!! Only mom and pop auto shops for me.
Dan the man! Best driver ever. He was super knowledgeable, engaged with us at all the breweries and he's DJ skills were also quite impressive. Impossible not to have a great time!

Muriel's had excellant service (thanks to Rebecca) and very good and tasty food. The first time that we ate there during our stay was a Thursday night and we didn't think that it would be crowded so we didn't make reservations. We were accommodated quickly (which isn't easy for a party of 5) and seated. I would recommend making reservations as it would make it easy for everyone.

I started with the turtle soup and it was thick with a lot of flavor. The sherry swirl adds to the taste.  One person at the table had gumbo and said that it was lukewarm (but she ate it anyway and didn't send it back.)  Someone else tried the appetizer crepes and liked them also. 

I had the seafood au gratin and found it to be very tasty also. The portion looks on the small side, but it is very filling with the thick cheese sauce.  It was a bit much for me.

GREAT Bread pudding.  I actually ordered the brownie desert. I liked the gelato, but the brownie was a little dry for my taste.  I tasted someone's bread pudding and it was awesome.
Excellent restaurant for authentic Chinese food.  Nothing to look at but excellent food. Love this place!

Walked in unsure of what to expect and walked out amazed. It was one of the best boba drinks I have ever had and to find that in Edmonton of all places was quite surprising! I had the grapefruit green tea and it was so refreshing. The boba was great and the drinks are 5 star because they are made with fresh fruit. They didn't skimp on the boba and it wasn't overly sweet. Everyone I went with loved the drinks they ordered.

I can not say enough good things about this salon!!! Tara and Timmy are beyond awesome! I just moved to the area and needed new salon.  I had taught nail school for years so I'm very picky when it comes to my nails and toes. The salon is so clean and comfortable. The service these two provide is from the heart. Both of them truly care about you as a person and not just a "client". They communicate with you the entire time. This is very important.  

Ann gives the very best pedicures I have EVER had!!!  She has the kindest soul. She is fun and keeps conversation the entire time. I look forward to many more wonderful feetsy feels good! 

Washing is great as well! 

Do your self a favor and come to Tara's it will be the best decision you make.  

Thank you all so very much!!!!  Love everything about your beautiful Salon.

Dr. Rylie & Kenzi

We recently moved from the Mecca of resale shops, pollution and obnoxious people, New Jersey, and was pleasantly surprised when we walked into the NCJW on a recent trip to St. Louis! The quality of the merchandise was top rate - I got a bunch of Tommy Bahama shirts and sweaters for about $15 each and they were in excellent condition. Can't wait to got back again and drop some more money for a great cause!

My husband and I came in on a Sunday afternoon for a beverage and app before going to the Aquarium.  We had the great fortune of meeting TJ, the very talented bartender.  He made us the best "on the rocks" margaritas we've ever had, and I've sampled more than a few in my life.  Besides being a great mixologist, TJ is a wonderful conversationalist.  We had the 3 Amigos sampler of salsa, guac, and queso with fresh, crispy thin tortilla chips.  We will come back to try more!

Donuts are great! Flavors you normally see on a cooking show and good too!
Two guys trying to create their own American dream! 
Didn't want to take the usual suspect donuts to a customer today, so I Yelped donuts & glad I did. I travel all over and these guys stand out and make you want to return!
One of my favorite restaurants in Reno. I love the scallion pancakes and the popcorn chicken. I also come in at least once a week to get a boba smoothie.
