Chinks is the only 5 star steak place

5 star and triple monkey!

Took alot longer to get seated, but it's usually worth the wait.  Have been here quite alot, but not recently....I had the new pork loin with garlic mash, an veggies. The picture looked amazing...what I got was 3 huge chunks of dried out pork, on top of cold mash potatoes. I asked about the veggies an she brought out a cup of heated up raw veggies dripping in oil.  Very surprised an disappointed.  Also ordered the delicious red sangria, however, this time not so delicious, no fruit at all in the pitcher an the wine tasted like it had been sitting out, or was old wine...not sure if will return any time soon....

This hospital is the best,when my son was a teenager he got sick with severe headaches,weakness,fever.Rushed to east Jefferson e.r.spinal tap but ignorant male nurse administered iv antibiotic by mistake before spinal tap,my pediatrician advised we rush to Children's hospital,we were there for a week.Excellent care by doctors,nurses,entire staff.every year I donate to Children's hospital.Always will.

This place is adorable! I'm so happy the IMA decided to keep it open all summer. Everything on my first visit was picture perfect: the board game options, the classical guitarist playing in the background, the wine, the friendly staff, and the pleasant company of other happy and relaxed people around me. There is definitely a pull to be a member since you'd pay big bucks to access it otherwise, so time to join! Great atmosphere, super chill concept, and I am very excited to go again soon!

I'd imagine that if most people were asked in what part of town they enjoy the cuisine the most, it would be downtown. But for me, my favorite area for food is on Orchard between Emerald and Franklin. Time to score another one for the area. Like Orient Market, Deli Baguette is just barely off of Orchard (on Franklin), but close enough to merit inclusion for what I consider my favorite area for food.

The food in itself is not eyebrow-raising spectacular, but the basis for the recommendation comes in creating baguette sandwiches that are both solid and unique to the area. These are not your normal submarine sandwiches, offering options like daikon, pate, and cilantro on freshly-made baguettes (via the Orient Market) that create a somewhat different and French-inspired taste to the palate. I had the house special for my first sandwich (when it was being served over at the Orient Market), and I was hooked on my first try. As has been noted already, these sandwiches are butt cheap. $3.25 for the house special.

Don't bother with the combo to get a soda and chips. You're not at Subway, and you can get that option everywhere else. I liked the pork and shrimp spring rolls (which for some reason are not on the big menu behind the counter) and the pork-filled pastries, but be prepared to wait longer if none are premade. And Hallelujah-- another place here sells boba tea now! The selection is nowhere near as varied as Yokozuna Teriyaki, but you do get better value for what is offered.

When I've visited, the place has been at best moderately busy. As a result, things have gone quite slow. As it's still relatively new, it's hard to say if it's because of them still figuring things out or being understaffed and overwhelmed. Also somewhat odd is that you aren't asked if the food is to be eaten there or not. Seems like a bit of a waste if I'm sitting at a table and am handed my food in a plastic bag when I don't need one. Tell them you're eating there if you aren't asked. And they should invest in some trays-- it'll keep the tables cleaner too.

They started offering pho, but I didn't like it.

Congrats to the owners for bringing something different to the area and not just opening up some other standard Vietnamese joint.

This was such a disappointment. Have been here in the past but not recently. This used to be a forerunner in Mexican cuisine but with the proliferation of Latinos in our culture tacquiras are sprouting up in food trucks and on tiny streets in tinier towns. And the offerings are excellent. Cafe America is doing gringo versions of a significant cuisine. The chips in the guacamole app are greasy greasy greasy. The Chicken Tamale had barely three strips of dried out chicken which matched the overcooked rice and dried up beans. The Steak Chimichurri salad arrived without the steak. Montgomery Mall has a fabulous Mexican and Southampton has a good one. Pipersville has an authentic place. Why bother with this one?  Because its precious little Doylestown ?

We LOVE Preservation Hall and enthusiastically recommend it to everyone! We had the good fortune to go twice during a long weekend but should have gone every night. The musicians are amazingly talented and create a once in a life time experience for attendees. Each show is different...or at least were when we attended. It's amazing to me that we sat within inches (literally inches) of the musicians!

It's an intimate place. So do yourself a favor and arrive 45 minutes or so early with a beverage in hand and then enjoy chatting with others standing in line until they open the doors. We thoroughly enjoyed sitting on the mats in the front row.

Very happy with the service and food here. Our waitress was super patient and helpful with helping us sample some wines. She was knowledgeable about the items on the menu. The vibe of the restaurant was a smooth, jazzy feel. I would definitely  be returning.

This was our first time to Scullys and I know it's a tourist trap which is what I usually avoid, but in this case we had some out of town friends visiting who wanted to go. Besides the overpriced food which was good not exceptional but good. The service we received was poor. So poor we had to constantly get up and ask another person for things like refills, the check, to go boxes. Forget the salad because that never came at all so we had to wait an extra few minutes to have it removed from the check. All I can say is PLEASE don't make go back!
I was amazed by every dish and so was my entire party. This is real home town momma in the kitchen cookin up some dem some vittles Great!!

Went this morning for brunch and had a great time!  Everything was great from the service to the coffee to the eggs benedict.   Tried some of the caramelized banana french toast too and it was amazing!

I love Freedom Smoke!  I have been tobacco free for over a year and a half.  I went to vaping and cut my nicotine way down.  Super friendly staff makes this place an extremely pleasurable experience every time I visit.  Nice selection of juices.  I can not say enough good things about them.
Awesome store. Either strolling or actually looking, this is a great shape. Knowledgeable and energetic staff.
Food is always good and service is excellent. They are always very friendly and smiling. We eat there at least twice a month and if they were closer to me I would eat there more often.

Stay away from the salads.   Really liked this place during two previous visits.  First time at new location today looking for a light lunch.  They forgot about us on porch - other parties seated at same time leaving before we got our food.   When we got our salads (Barcelona w/ salmon and the Salmon salad) we were underwhelmed.    Portion was not good for $16-20 and they don't know how to cook salmon here.  Both of our filets were WAY overdone.   On top of that, they forgot the applesauce with our kids meal.  The kids meal dish "butternoodles" was nothing to write home about.  Should've ordered grilled cheese.
Excellent steaks, fries, everything. Shane was our waiter. Very knowledgeable and great recommendations! Our first time to Tucson. We will definitely return here!

I came here for brunch and now cannot wait to come back for dinner.  The space is huge and very well appointed and beautifully decorated.  We split a pastry and shared an appetizer of the classic hummus to start.  The hummus was the best I have ever had-smooth, creamy, and perfect flavor.  The waitress quickly offered us more pita which is a nice touch.  We both had a Lebanese flatbread, the Cheese, tomato, long hot, parsley and the  lamb bi-ajeen with egg.  Both were flavorful and perfect.  Cannot wait to come back now that the garden space is open.  BONUS: If you don'd feel like dining in, there is a small market cafe in the front.  We both got items to go!

Awful doctor's office. Wait times are insane and when you finally get into to see the doctor they just rush you in and out. Plus it's been a week and I have no medicine yet because they still haven't sent over the right documents to the pharmacy. Save your self a lot of time and headaches and don't go to this place.

This place is AWESOME!!!!! I'm not even being partial because it is within walking distance of my house. It is seriously one of the best happy hours I have ever encountered. The staff is friendly and attentive and seem to truly care for their patrons. The food is tasty and drinks delicious! Love the bar tenders! I hope this place lasts a long time here because it has found a great spot in my food loving, drink tasting heart.

First timers in the area and went on yelp and say the 10 for 5 coupon and decided to give it a try. I went with the Godfather and was not disappointed. Everyone was happy with their sandwiches and the staff was very friendly. Highly recommend and woth the stop
This was the second time that I have done he tour. It is really fun and informative. In the end you wonder where did the two hours go. Walking is nice specially if the weather helps

Great coffee! First time at La Colombe and got the draft latte. Never had a better latte before in my life! They also provide a counter with cream, sugar, syrup, etc... It's convenient, they have a bathroom, and people come to either chat or work on their laptops. Would love to stop by again!

I would give the the atmosphere 4.5 stars - excellent serving. The live music was fun and very good. We were there on a Saturday night. The food however left something to be desired, nothing to get excited about, especially Because it wasn't cheap.

I walked in to this "new to me" dreamland and was instantly overwhelmed by the numerous tasty and gorgeous options. Amber came to my rescue and not only described each treat of a cupcake in great detail but she could also tell how torn I was in deciding and suggested getting two, cutting them in half and eating half of each - Franken-cupcakes!!! She was lovely, funny and helpful as was her co-worker. She made my cupcake dreams come true!
Went here to shoot my new colt .45! The staff was exquisite and gave useful advice when I wanted it. Over all it was a great experience with no disappointments
Wandering through Kirkwood hungry, gave it a shot. JACKPOT!!! Fantastic!! Best burger I have ever had ~ mushrooms!! Enjoy!!

I've frequented this restaurant plenty of times in the last decade,  business and pleasure (including a delightful birthday dinner once) but recently I was so turned off by the service that I decided it was worth this post and further that they don't deserve my patronage. 

I came with a friend,  physically a little rough around the edges, but great.  Upon arrival we were guided to a table where the contacts from there forward were limited to the initial order and the bill.  My straw never came, there was no beverage refills and my order was very incorrect (how do you confuse fish with shrimp). Directly across from us were 4 white middle aged women dining and they of course had full attention of our young server. It was very disturbing and upon exiting I planned to tell the host but he didn't bother sticking his head out of the diner. Unacceptable.
Great atmosphere. Service was so so. Food was not good. Rubbery calamari. Bread and oil on table was plain. Red sauce was bland.

Huge fan of this place. Its very popular-as it should be-so make a reservation! We came on a Saturday night around 9 and were seated in about 30 min.

The margaritas are fabulous, and there's an outside bar with heaters above the bar--absolutely heaven in January/February. My friend had the cucumber margarita which was so creative! And delicious! I had the cadillac margarita which is a more traditional yet top shelf margarita and it was great. 

This place was pretty loud, it was almost like eating in a night club. Our waitress was very competent though and got everything right for us.  Delicious food, and I love corn tortilla tacos.

This is just a great place--I highly recommend it.

This is by far my favorite park in the Philly area.  Loved running on the trail.  My nephews loved skipping rocks in the creek.  The bridges were stunning.  The trail was great as many people were running and biking here. An absolute gem.  If you get the chance, go see it for yourself.

Yes. I am at it again. A day does not go by that I don't have my coffee from Starbucks. I come here so much be it through drive through or going in at the batista  knows exactly what I want and how I want it.  I couldn't ask for a better way to start my morning. 

Although they are extremely busy in the morning the drive thru moves very fast and my coffee is always piping hot. To top it off the customer service is always good.

Thank you for the invention of coffee. Thank you for the invention of Starbucks!

I've been to Trattoria Carina twice now, once when it was first trying out a small menu, and again now that it uses its full menu. Both times the food was excellent. The first time I was there, I sat outside and enjoyed a nice evening and long conversation with a friend. Tonight, however, I sat inside with a friend and after having been there for 1 hour and 15 minutes and ordering two appetizers and two entrees we were promptly asked by our server to leave to free up the table. I thought this was quite rude. The restaurant does not take reservations because it wants to have a relaxed neighborhood feel, but it does not feel very neighborly or relaxed to kick your customer out after an hour and fifteen minutes. Perhaps it would be better to take reservations and not rush their guests.

Not only was he pizza great, the service was excellent! We walked in a little before closing and we were welcomed with open arms and even got a free appetizer. If I'm ever back in the area I'll be sure to go back.

Stopped by at 6:45am on a Friday morning. Super cozy, hip, and friendly coffee shop with very high quality pours. I thought the pour-over was quite inexpensive and one of the best I've had. Bustling in the morning, this would be a great spot to congregate with friends or just relax and read a book with a great brew. So glad I live close by!

SUPER super friendly baristas :) The best peppermint mocha's in town and the drive thru is very fast, even in the busiest part of the morning! Definitely drive a bit out of my way to go to this particular store when I need a S'bucks!

I'll start off by saying that the moment I walked in the door, someone rushed to greet me! Thank you!!! That's so important to me, especially if I decide to make a purchase. 

 Walking through the store they have on display, beautiful bedroom, living room, and various accent pieces. If you're in the market... check it out! Unfortunately though, that's not what I was looking for. I came into the store looking for an office desk. My take, their desk display should  probably be removed from the floor, or they should have the pieces replaced. There were a couple of desks that I really liked, but the moment I saw the nicks, fingerprints, and dents on the furniture, I knew this would not to the store to buy from. After all, if I know it looks like that once I wear it down, I might as well purchase a higher quality piece that will be more difficult to damage. Welp! My search will continue...

My boyfriend and I tried this spot for the first time and it exceeded our expectations.

The service was great and the food was delicious. For their price point you get a good amount of food. The ambiance compared to the pricing was a little confusing for both of us. Although it was very nice, it didn't match their menu pricing. We came very casual and felt a little underdressed. 

For an appetizer we ordered the freshly baked meat pie. My boyfriend loved it but for me the pastry was a little too thick. 

We both shared the small jerk and curry chicken. Both dishes were great and plentiful. 

This place is a hidden gem tucked away in Hyde park. If you are looking for Caribbean food this place is for you. Overall we had great service and food. We definitely will be coming back

Wow... a diamond in the rough! The meal we ate here was delicious and I can't wait to go back for more.

This cafeteria style southern cookery boasts a slightly different menu every day (although they offer their deliciously moist, tender, crispy and flavorful fried chicken almost every day). Everything we ordered seemed fresh and NOT from a box!

As sides for my fried chicken, I opted for the loaded mashed potatoes (blended with cheese and bacon) and corn. both were delicious and well seasoned. My husband got the mac and cheese which was oh so cheesy and velvety smooth!! The rolls were light and fluffy, and the cornbread was a little dense but had great flavor.

We also grabbed some dessert. The snickers chocolate cake was moist light and incredibly rich... great frosting too! My husband got the chocolate pie which was thick, with a strong chocolatey flavor, nice crust,  and a layer of airy meringue.

I can't wait to try the rest they have to offer: all you can eat ribs on Thursday's and Saturday's, prime rib on Saturdays, chicken and dressing on Tuesday's... let's keep this place in business!

Went for the puddin' so my review is narrowly-focused, this time around...

Prior reviewer mentioned Magnolia's in The Village (as in NYC). I have to agree, at least banana puddingwise, yes comparable. Magnolia's makes ice box cake, which we didn't see at Sweet Life, and I LOVE ice box cake... but I am also a Phulph'n, and Magnolia's ain't worth 2 hours on the Chinatown bus for pudding, when I can get some BETTER options here on South Street.

Unlike Magnolia's, Sweet Life has a variety of pudding flavors: peaches-n-cream, banana, banana caramel, salted caramel, no-nana, "magic" (like a Snickers bar), etc. And Sweet Life adds cake at the bottom, which I do not remember being in Magnolia's cups (just wafers). Bakery cake, all saturated with the pudding to make it thicker, was a really nice twist to America's idea of Jello snack cups.

Also got the potato pie, which was sweet, and spicey, and savory too. Very good!

Can't wait to try more next time!

Went to pub and kitchen to eat some food and witness Doc Halladay make history. The bar was great, with a good amount of Phils fans and good draft beer specials. They also had dollar oysters which is enough to get me almost anywhere.

I had the flying fish octoberfest? whatever it was good. I had the fish and chips which were excellent. And the truffle dijonaisse was very very good. Be prepared for a very intense truffle flavor.

The reviews that i read prior to entering this place really bashed the service. I thought the service was great, our waitress was really friendly and attentive, filling our beers and water, and not rushing us at all.

Definitely reccommend this place for a casual drink and some good food to go along with it.

Also a sweet logo.

My first time @ O'Charley's.  Was skeptical but very pleasantly surprised by: friendliness, prompt service from sweet Lila, great check-in w/us by manager Jeff AND really tasty dinner.
Jeff stopped by to see how our dinner is going and shared some little July 4th experiences.  Very personable.  We had 1/2 rack of ribs which were meaty, yummy and fall-off-the-bone great.  Sides:  HUGE 'side salad', smashed potatoes and 'loaded potato' were great.  My mother said the broccoli was the 'best'.  (FYI - we love to cook and are 'picky').  The broccoli was cooked perfectly and had terrific flavors.  Last but not least...Mom enjoyed her peach pie.  I had part of a HUGE bowl of a decadent brownie w/vanilla ice cream, chocolate & caramel sauces.  Insanely huge and wonderful; enough for 3 people.  Oh, and the pre-dinner rolls w/butter were good (we were starving).  We'll be back, definitely.  Tasty food and great, friendly service.

We love Ru Sans!! It is such a casual hole in the wall which makes the experience that much better.  The sushi is not always the best in town, however, that small detail can be overlooked.  The quantity is much greater than  Virago and the price is much cheaper.  

We tend to get hot saki, tempora, sashimi,the spicy edamame (which is AMAZING) and roll number 15.  

The only complaint is that they lost our reservation for valentines day and we had to sit at the bar.  Not very romantic for valentines day but we went with it.

Well, what can I say? We are officially addicted to HipCityVeg. It's convenient and delicious and vegan. Vegan. Take out. West of Broad. Whodahthunkit?
The space is small but bright and the staff is very helpful. For a busy small space, they keep things running very smoothly. 
We have worked our way through a great deal of the menu so far and the big winners are hip city ranch, udon noodle salad, the buffalo bello and the spinach salad. The fries are pretty good as well. We also love the groothie and the green lemonade. Ooh, and the canned soda is a nice healthier soft drink choice. 
Really, if you want something quick and tasty that's not going to make you feel awful after eating it, this is the spot.

My partner and I had an excellent gourmet meal tonight at Stella Sera in Chestnut Hill.  The Portabella Mushroom with shrimp and lump crabmeat was a great starter.  My entree was pan blackened Mako Shark steak.  Seasoned perfectly, very tender and a large portion size.  

The Chef/owner even came out to my table after the meal to ensure we had a great experience here.

Table service was very prompt and professional.

It is  nice to know that places like this exist where the chef cares that his patrons have an excellent dining experience.

It is without reservation that I recommend you give this chef an opportunity  to show you his gourmet italian flare.

Great service! Our chef Augustus was funny and entertaining. He was super engaging and even showed us his dance moves! I feel like once you've been to one hibachi grill, then you've been to them all, but they're still yummy nonetheless. Good experience overall!

Came here after the auto show and were pretty shocked to see that it wasn't busy at all. Especially for lunch time on Super Bowl Sunday. We came in with our kids and thankfully they placed us away from everyone. The food was great, the kids enjoyed it and our waitress was very good. I would go back again in a heart beat. Also, one serving of fries fed our family of 4. We took home our pizza and fries, since we couldn't finish it all.

The Blue Sage was a treat.  We went for a networking lunch, myself and another woman.  We really enjoyed it!  

It is very cramped in there, but luckily, we went at 2pm and it was clearing out quite a bit.  The server was very plucky and fun.  She was also on top of her job which is refreshing.  

My companion had the Asian citrus salad and she thought it was really fresh and very tasty. I had the sliders, which were delish!  I also had the blue corn tacos, again not disappointed!!! 

I totally recommend stopping by this little hidden gem.

Ordered carryout this evening.  Place looked hopping between Xmas and New Years.  Love their bar-b-q- sauce.  This time I just wanted my own order of nachos with pork BBQ.  They use home made potato chips.  Really good!

I went with my wife to check out the free comedy show. We had a great time. The show was very entertaining and we especially liked the host, Red Bean. Nice guy. Funny, too. We would definitely consider returning, whenever we go back to New Orleans.

Last night I got the Extravaganza with everything on it my wife got the ultimate pepperoni with black olives and extra cheese. This was the best Domino's I have ever ate ever even better than it was two weeks ago when that was the best pizza that we have ever ate. Pizza Hut stopped delivering in my neighborhood which I don't understand because it's a subdivision, so Domino's gets out of our business and you are making it right and we appreciate it!

I feel bad having to do this, but I have to downgrade my review again.

I was there Saturday. It is still a deal for $8 and I still like the food overall. However, the quality of some of the food is slipping. Here are some of the foods that I think they need to improve:

Corn on the cob: Bland taste, butter and salt didn't help
Sweet and Sour chicken: Breading burnt 
Pizza: Horrible
Fries: Burnt
Pot stickers: Bland
Hibachi beef: Do much hard pieces of fat
Sushi: Getting worse, bland, too much rice
Deserts: Just horrible, don't know how else to explain it.
Fruit: Must be old, no taste

In addition, they seem to stop serving my favorite desert, the eggcups. I have been there several times in the last month for takeout and dining for lunch and dinner and they have not been around.

In addition, my biggest complaint is the service. The service has gone way downhill. Usually, they bring you some fortune cookies and a tip tray. After not seeing the server for 15 minutes after we finished eating, I left my smallest tip ever ($2, I usually leave $4 or $5) and walked out.

In addition, I don't believe the staff should eat in the main dining area. My family was in the restaurant business ( I spent several years as a busboy, waiter, cook, etc),  so I don't think I am 'better' than they are. However, when my server is eating lunch two tables over and giggling with friends, should I have to have dirty dishes build up on my table? Should the hostess have to run across the restaurant from the dining area because people are coming in? When you work in a restaurant, you should eat where people can't see you.  A customer should not have to feel that they are imposing on the staff to serve them. That's the way that business works.

I am afraid this place is starting to go downhill as the other Chinese buffets have gone in the area. My wife and I usually go there three or four times a month, and do take out every couple of weeks. We decided to take a long break from this place, and try some other places. I still like the place, so I am hoping they read these reviews. I don't want to have to come back and give a two star review.

Nashville for the weekend--Brunch on Saturday! (July 14, 2012)

First off I LOVE that they have a Saturday brunch.  Avoiding the crowds of Sunday and having yummy brunch food is awesome.  I don't know why we can't have brunch everyday and brunch for dinner menus should exist---but I digress.

DRINKS:
We ordered cocktails (2 for 1!!!!!!): cucumber bloody mary, sangria, and champaign drink.  The sangria was great and I loved the bloody mary---champaign drink was tasty but paled by comparison.  Also--our incredibly awesome server gave the helpful tip that the sangria is the most booze for the buck.  Not really my most important thing to know when ordering a cocktail, but I appreciate that she willingly shared the info.

FOOD: 
Chorizo gravy and cheese biscuits =yummy but very rich!
Singapore stir fry thing =FANTASTIC--watch out for the spice but totally worth the burn
Benedict w/tabasco =don't remember the name.  I am not one for benedicts but my friends both said it was quite good.
Sweet Potato chips with blue cheese dip =super awesome, need to figure out how to make that dip.
White Trash Hash =very yummy

Service was great and we were seated right away.  If I lived in Nashville this place would be in heavy rotation.
The ziggy burger was the best thing I've ever had. I'm from Richmond and we are getting so big on vegetarian options, but nothing we have compares to the ziggy burger.

Great service by Lety and atmosphere Glad to know they have Gluten Free bread! Loved the Beach Bowl with Hoison sauce.  Couple of suggestions: keep the salt/seasoning off fries and add grass feed beef to the menu; I'm sure customers such as myself would pay more for that option.
Awesome pastor tacos and tamales !! I just wasn't a fan of all that raw onion they put on top of the tacos !

This restaurant has a lot of potential, but it feels like it's having an identity crisis.  The menu is a mix of Italian, Spanish, and American dishes.  They seem to do everything well, though, but I wouldn't go here thinking that you can stick with one type of cuisine.

The cod fritters were great - nice and crispy on the outside with a bit of creaminess in the middle.  But the presentation was weird - they served it on a bed of french fries.  If the cod fritters had been presented on a small plate sans french fries, it would have dressed it up a bit.

The bolognese and lasagna were both solid.  Not over the top, but like good home cooking.  The portion sizes were very generous for both.

They have an excellent beer selection - tons of Belgian beers and plenty of domestic craft beer.  I love Belgian beers, but the beer list doesn't match the food.

I would definitely eat here again, but it would be nice if the restaurant would pick a personality and stick with it.

Mo recently left Aspara, so I am following her to her new salon, Mockingbird Salon on S. 13th Street.  Mo is a phenomenal stylist, and even though it has been more than 3 months since my last cut, it still looks good. 

I found this salon on Yelp a year ago when I really needed a new stylist.  The first time I went Mo sat down with me to find out what kind of cut I wanted, and she gave me a cut that was perfect.  Since then she has done a really good job, but I really wish I had taken a photo of that cut, because she hasn't been able to do it again.

This is a great salon - everyone greets you when you go in, like they saw you just yesterday and were waiting for you to come back.  

I had an experience when I was late for my appointment and asked if they could squeeze me in. They told me no because of the timing - doing the  cuts between coloring, between perms, between drying and styling.  They didn't take me late because it would have screwed up the timing.  That explanation was fine with me, because I would want them to do the same when I'm there.

We love Cafe Verdi!  This is the first place we stop when we drive up from Atlanta, Georgia.  The dishes are classic Italian, freshly made for each individual order.  Their signature chopped antipasto is our favorite with oil and vinegar dressing in just the right proportion.  I've never had a bad dinner there.  You get generous portions for very reasonable prices.  When there is a special, dinner for two gets us antipasto, entree, dessert and non-alcoholic beverages for under $40. Verdi also serves fresh Italian bread and butter which we love.
Carlo is always smiling and treats us like family. He makes sure everyone is satisfied.  Pizza is terrific here, too.  
The restaurant was recently remodeled and the seating now has banquettes upstairs with that section being accessed from the inside of the shopping center, which is easier than walking up the stairs if you come in the front entrance.  
Cafe Verdi is a local favorite and would be more well known if it were located somewhere other than in between a small drug store, nail salon and various small businesses.

Hands down THE WORST service I have ever witnessed. Waited an HOUR to even get a drink order. An hour in between drink orders and it took an hour and a half to get our food. The only reason we stayed was to watch the Cardinals game. I don't know about you, but service is key for repeat business. Would Not recommend this location to even the homeless. The one in Arnold is like the Ritz Carlton compared to this $&@# hole.

I purchased a gift card for $25 in December 2013 as a Christmas gift for my father in-law.  He was unable to eat there until August 2014, at that time the manager informed him that the gift card, that was payed with $25 on a credit card, had expired and he could not use this.  According to the FTC: "Money on a gift card cannot expire for at least five years from the date the card was purchased, or from the last date any additional money was loaded onto the card. If the expiration date listed on the card is earlier than these dates, the money can be transferred to a replacement card at no cost."  When we requested they honor the gift card the manager refused to do so. This is an illegal practice and I DO NOT recommend anyone ever purchase a gift card. I have submitted a claim to the BBB and hope that El Maguey decides to abide by the law and honor the money that we have already given them.

Let me start this review by saying I only gave this hotel one star because zero stars is not an option on YELP.  We arrived to our room and immediately had to run out because we were meeting friends for dinner.  I thought I would use the restroom quickly before we left.  That did not happen.  Why, you may ask?  Because there was poop in the toilet and dried, crusted pee on the seat.  Let me say that again, juuuuust in case you missed it.  FECES IN THE TOILET AND DRIED, CRUSTED URINE ON THE TOILET SEAT.  I called the front desk on our way to dinner so the situation could be corrected.  The front dest assured us that the room would be clean before we got back.  Upon returning to the room, the toilet was still disgusting, though we could tell that someone had half-a**ed cleaning some of it.  I called again and was told that housekeeping had cleaned it (the aforementioned pee and poo told me otherwise) but they would send some one again.  Eventually someone did come and clean it.  

I'm sorry, at the absolute very least, a hotel room should have a clean bathroom.  This was beyond disgusting.  On top of all that, the hallways smelled like stale cigarettes and body odor.  

Just no.  Stay somewhere else.  There is a Drury Inn just across the road (that I wish we had stayed at instead), just stay there.

ugh.
My second time in NOLA in 2 months and Luke is the favorite so far. Excellent service, food, drinks, environment. Seems like a healthy combination of locals and tourists.

Yes. Just Y. E. S. I really don't feel like anything more needs to be said, but for those who like a little detail...

Waiting in line was no big deal. It moved so quickly. If you drive by and want to keep driving because of the line, don't. It isn't really as long as you think. There were some sweetie students from Belmont outside with guitars and it was some of the best music I heard during my whole trip. Chances are that will happen when you visit.

The free coffee is a nice touch. Except for that the coffee is TERRIBLE. Seriously. For reals. No joking. Not being picky. It isn't good. That is the only reason Pancake Pantry get 4 stars from me instead of 5. Breakfast joint? You better serve good coffee.

Had a build your own omelette that was so great. Came with pancakes and chose to try the sweet potato. Come on, I've read the reviews...how could I not? They lived up to the hype. The syrup that comes with them? Heaven. Cinnamon creme something. Just so good.

So again - yes. Y. E. S. 

Try it.

I lived in New Orleans for several years and have eaten at many of the city's finest restaurants, and Bacchanal stands out as one of, if not my absolute favorite of them all.  

On my visit the "restaurant" was not yet open.  A food truck happened to be serving the food that evening.  The food truck had no name, just 2 dudes making some wicked fare.  By the time I had made my way to the food truck they had 86'd almost their entire menu, except of a Sweet Potato Gnocchi dish that is by far the best pasta concoction I've had in my entire life.  3+ years later I can still recall exactly what I had; it's not very often that happens for me.

I highly recommend this place if you're after something out of the ordinary.  I've traveled all over the U.S. and nothing compares to Bacchanal.

Place is similar to Applebee's ... the food is alright and my stomach was bugging me for a while. I came back here for the second time to see if I'd feel the same and I was unfortunately let down with the food. For the price, I expect some better quality.

My favorite place to pick up oysters. Choose carefully because there is a lot of variety and you get to try a shuck for free. ;)

I've also had the fish and chips - greasy, flakey, crispy fish and chips. Mmmm...
Food is ok..view is amazing..service is attentive. Go for happy hour.

Before leaving NO, I had to get beignets & coffee.  This particular location was outside of the NO city limits but it was quiet, cute and we didn't have to wait a ridiculously long time.

The beignets were delish!  We ordered just one order (which has 3 beignets) but I kinda wish I had my own personal order...oh well.  The Cafe Du Monde beignet mix I have at home just doesn't measure to the real thing.

i want more.

Super awesome perfect place to stay while  in NawLins, free safe parking! Take the trolly to town and party your ass off the head back just before 4am so you don't miss the last trolly! Free breakfast!
Great live music, friendly staff, good food (love the taco salad) best sweet tea around!
Lattes here are always amazing including the food! Staff is also always so friendly, making you feel welcomed!
Great service and food as usual at these restaurants! We came in at high noon, place was packed and they still provided excellent service. We had two of their three salads- lite fresh and taste!

I can't even tell you how incredible this company is!! We are in California and have been using them for 2 years for our tri-fold 8.5x11 brochures that we print at 2000 per batch.  This place is great!! The customer service is fantastic. You can always get a human on the phone.  They also have immediate follow up via email.   Not only that, but they send emails at every step of the process. 

The reason why we chose such a far away company for our brochures is the insanely affordable pricing!  The brochures are about 2/3 the price of other printers and sometimes even cheaper when they have promotion codes!!  

The quality of the finished work is excellent. The only thing I hate is that I have to give CMYK files instead of RGB, but almost all printers require that.  Still, the finished brochures look so good.  

I really like this company!  A+++

Saw some great reviews for Butcher & Bee, so my friend and I decided to make the trip over to East Nashville. Our experience was PHENOMENAL. We started with the sweet potato dish and the bacon wrapped dates, both of which blew us away. They were a smaller size, which was great as we wanted to make sure we were still able to enjoy our dinner. We then asked for opinions from both the server and chef, Chris. Both highly recommended the dry-aged tartare as a second course, followed by the seared wild mushroom entree. Although we were a little skeptical about the mushroom dish, I've never been more impressed. With the combination of great service and fantastic food, this place is a MUST. A special thanks again to Chris!

Ten Fifty-five is a great microbrewery. They make great beer and have a wonderful little taproom. I believe the only place to get their beer is at a local restaurant/bar or at the taproom. They don't bottle beer, but they do fill growlers. You can also order kegs of beer. 

At the taproom you can try small samples of their beers for free, or you can order a sampler, sit down, and try the beers at your own pace. They also serve pints, and have cool jar shaped pint glasses. 

It is important to note, the taproom is just a place to hangout and drink a good beer. They don't serve any food. They don't have anything except beer to drink, and there aren't any TVs to watch. I like it this way and if you are a craft beer fan you will probably like it too. I usually order a pint to drink while they fill my growler; after one beer and a fill I move on. 

We bought a small glass growler at the brewery, $12. The fills seem to cost around $8 each, different types of beer cost slightly different prices. Our growler holds about two pints of beer, perfect for one or two people. My only complaint about the brewery is the price of the growler fills. $4 to $5 per pint of beer to drink at home seems expensive. However, the beer cost the same price in the taproom and I don't mind paying $4 to $5 in the taproom. I just wish taking Ten fifty-five beer home was a better deal. I don't have any complaints about the beer itself. 

The taproom is a little hard to find, it is in an industrial office area. There are a few tables and a very cool shuffleboard game. I like the casual atmosphere. It is not a bar atmosphere, rather, just hanging out at the brewery. The taproom has limited hours so please look them up or call to confirm they are open before making the trip. Right now they are open Thursday-Saturday. 

I go out of my way to visit Ten fifty-five. It is one of my favorite spots in Tucson. I recommend going to the taproom and ordering a pint.
Food was awful!!!!! Tarter sauce tasted old, gumbo tasted like air freshener, and even the salad was horrible, payed way too much for food that was uneatable, very bad experience

LOVED this restaurant.  I saw this cute little patio area randomly while I was grabbing bagels next door one morning and made a mental note to stop there the next time I went out.  My date and I went there tonight and were extremely pleased.  The wait staff was wonderful.  They were sweet and polite and very responsive to our needs.  My date had eggplant park and said it was delicious.  I had a grilled chicken Caesar Insalata and it was also great.  The chicken was grilled perfectly.  The desserts were AWESOME!  Since it was our first time at this place, were were given the Dolce Patricia for free and let me tell you, it was incredible!! I highly suggest it.  We also tried the Tiramisu and it was excellent.

Attractive atmosphere, great wait staff and good food..I will return to this restaurant again!

great food potential and perhaps execution for some customers, unfortunately not us  tonight. it was a very busy Friday night. we arrived at about 5:40, did not get the burgers before 6:40 and were still waiting for the check at 7:15. the second order of beer took at least 30 minutes. the place is loud. interesting ambiance, kind of eclectic. Bday parties , families, not a romantic place. a place  you don't want to hang out in for more than an hour or you will leave smelling like fried oil.

wish the time was the only consideration in the 3 star rating. the service was slow and inattentive since all three -- the burgers and the fires came out lukewarm to almost cold. we ordered medium cooked burgers and the bison was well done, hard and lacked any of the described toppings except for a few mushrooms. so it was texture and lack of flavor. the aged burger was good. it was not quite juicy since it was not served warm but it tasted  good enough for a lukewarm burger, I guess. my husband liked it a lot more than me. the fries are fine and the best part were the pickles. 

the beer list is packed with local beer options for half and full pours which is kind of fun since one could try a few different beers at very affordable prices. the wine is considerably pricier and the list very limited, almost discouraging. 
I tried the red blend and it was underwhelming to say the least -- too thin and too sweet.

we noticed other tables were served food before us even though we were seated a good 15-20 minutes before them. 

after speaking with management we ended up paying only for the beer. the management staff was very understanding and willing to help. The stars go for the food concept/ potential and the way management responded.

Do yourself a favor and forget about the chain restaurants for fried chicken. I stopped going to those places once I found this place. Their fried chicken is very yummy! Mashed potatoes not so much - they are very bland and so is the gravy but the fried chicken is very tasty and not as greasy as the other places!

Definitely one of the best bars on Bourbon! Of course if you don't like country you won't agree but what do you expect. Came here as part of a Bachelorette party and our Bachelorette got to ride the bull for free! Awesome atmosphere, good mix of new and old country, great service, all around good time! Definitely worth the stop in, will definitely be coming back next time I'm on bourbon!

The only thing good about this place is the food. It's amazing. That is, when you can actually get it, which is unfortunate because this place could have incredible potential if the staff was competent. 

Flashback to a month or two ago. The weather was about to get bad, so the g/f and I decided to order some food to go before the storm came in. We placed an online order through their website. We arrived at the time the site said the food would be ready, only to be met with puzzled stares from the staff. They had received no online order. We showed the cashier the order confirmation and they informed us the online ordering system was having some issues. Ok, fine.

Fast forward to today, about an hour ago, the g/f and her friend wanted to meet up for brunch, so we decided on coming here. Their menu clearly states that brunch is "All Day Sunday, 9am - 4 pm". We get in line and begin to order brunch, when the cashier girl tells us they're, "Not doing brunch today." I told her that was the whole reason we came. She replied that they were having some, "Complications" - whatever that means. Strike one.

I order a sugar-free vanilla latte. My g/f, who was standing next to me, told me they didn't have any. Before I showed up, she ordered a sugar-free vanilla coffee and was told by the girl cashier that they didn't have any sugar-free vanilla syrup. When I asked if they did (I had ordered this on my first visit), the cashier girl asked and magically they had a full bottle of sugar-free vanilla syrup. Strike two.

We then place our food orders. I ordered a sandwich with a "V" in the name. It's not on their online menu, but it is on the menu in the store. It has turkey, bacon, cheese and avocado. I pay and then find my seat. Shortly after ordering, the same guy who took my order comes out to our table to tell us they don't have any avocado! STRIKE. THREE.

If you like to be forced into ordering something you didn't want because what you do want is not being offered that day, go here. 

I've been here twice and both times have been complete failures. Absolutely abysmal service. 

The three of us decided we won't be coming back.

After careful thought I have to give this place 2 stars. I've gone here on 4 separate occasions and on each trip got at least 2 desserts. Sadly, each and every dessert was very dry. Flavor was okay. But I've had better cake from a box mix. And you can make 10 box cakes for what you pay for one piece from here. I would reccomend a lot of places for dessert and cake over here. So I do not reccomend cake bake shop, mainly due to dry overpriced cake.

I give 2 stars instead of one because the service was great and the staff is very friendly.
Pretty decent boba here, but it usually takes a long time for them to make it even when they're not busy. I like to sit at this locations lounge area when its not full and just chat with friends.

I always come here when I need a mani pedi fix after work. It's right next to Suburban so very convenient location. The nail technicians do a good job and their tools are clean. I always come back here and each time I have a pleasant experience.

Service was horrible. Lukewarm food and flat beer. It's too bad because the food was good but sat forever while our waiter disappeared so was served lukewarm. The beer was flat so impossible to judge flavor.  It was apparent the wait staff was much more interested in hanging out in the back then doing their job. When we asked about milk in the dessert we were told the owner wasn't present. Maybe that was problem.

La Creperie Cafe was very cute with tasty food. We had a really sweet waitress who was attentive even though she was the only person working the dining room. The menu had a variety of salads, crepes, quiches, and paella so you can be sure everyone will find something to eat. Be sure to leave some room for dessert! The dessert crepes are definitely big enough to split between two people. Try the Napoleon. You'll thank me.

Remember: This is a BYOB so don't get caught without a good bouteille de vin!

Overall very solid experience.  We had a wonderful crab and avocado appetizer which was outstanding, fresh and light.  My wife had the crab cakes and liked them a lot.  I had a red snapper special which was outstanding.  I only have two complaints.  1.  The water there tastes like dish water.  I requested some lemons just so I could down it.  Looking around at all the mostly filled water glasses on other tables, I could tell I wasn't alone.  They need to get a water filter or use bottled or something.  2.  The bread put out on the table didn't come with any butter.  There was just a bottle of olive oil.  Would have liked to see butter or some dried garlic/herb to mix in with the olive oil for a nice bread accompaniment.  That said, we will certainly return.

We had eaten hear before and loved it.  This trip was totally different.  Although the restaurant had only one table filled when we arrived, hostess seated the three of us at a very small table for two, then seated someone right next to us.  She then complained that we were oozing over our table space onto the other people.  Hostess was VERY rude.  Beverages were good, but service was very slow - also odd considering most of the restaurant was empty.  Food was sub-par with tater tots and shrimp being so overcooked that they were inedible.  Pulled BBQ sandwich had so much fat in it it was impossible to eat.  This was such a disappointment since we are big Garces fans and eat often at his other restaurants.  Maybe this was just a bad day for them.

Excellent area if you want a little privacy while you are visiting the New Orleans downtown area(Bourbon st, Canal st). I drove from Atlanta & parking is $40/day if you stay downtown. So I was able to park for free at the hotel, and hopped in a Uber to downtown when I was ready to enjoy Bourbon st, & Canal st. Also the room was very clean!!!

Ordered and after an hour and a half called to see why the food had not arrived. They said the driver was on his way. After another half hour I called again and they said "they didn't get my order". Then proceeded to repeat my order and say it will be out in "a minute". Inconsistent service for mediocre Chinese food.

Had dinner here with friends while in town for the ASHE 2013 conference.  The service was outstanding and food was phenomenal!  Portions were large (all but one took left-overs back to hotel). Too stuffed for dessert but the neighboring table had the snickers pie and it looked good!)

True family style Dominican cooking. Perfectly cooked beans, rice, and chicharron! Also, there is free parking in a lot right behind the building. Adorable outdoor seating... The owner was very involved and came over to ask how everything was. I would definitely come again. You should go, too!

Just plain delicious food! Chinese chicken salad and gluten free Thai pizza was the best ever. Fresh and tasty. A bit spendy for a 12" GF pizza (24$), however worth it because of cravings for normal food! I would recommend this eatery to anyone. Friendly, effecient servers. We will definitely go again.
Expensive, overcrowded, hard to find a spot for parking, friendly but slow service, order the quiche, it had a flan texture that I didn't like, carrot cake was just ok

I am not impressed. I ordered an Italian sausage sandwich. I expected an actual Italian sausage sandwich. What I got was a roll with several small *slices* of Italian sausage with tons of tomato-based sauce and tomatoes. If I had any idea what they were going to bring me, I never would have ordered this. I felt ripped off and like the description on the menu was very misleading. My husband ordered the turkey panini. He said it didn't taste that great, and he had an upset stomach for most of the rest of the day. I would AVOID this place if I were you.

There are various ways Twistee treat could be improved. The employees' cone making skills are subpar causing the ice cream to be messy and spill. Ordering was awkward because employees were not that friendly or happy looking. There are no napkins on the benches (which are dirty) which is inconvenient. But the ice cream was tasty. 6.5/10

staff at the counter and at the returns were friendly enough.  the bad side is that they only have chevy's so you can't pick what car you want to drive unless you want a chevy.  conveniently located next to the baggage claim.

Love this store! My best friend and I frequently meet here for browse for neat finds. Home goods is owned by tj max and Marshall's but it's only the home items. I can always find the perfect gifts here for the best price. The kitchen section has awesome sets of dishes but you usually can't find a full set of everything. They have all the cooking things you could possibly need- even those strange items like egg pans or perfect pancake. The sheets and comforters are always at unbelievable prices. Bathroom items, picture frames, candles, decor, furniture, rugs...literally everything for your home at low prices. Inventory changes frequently so each visit is hit or miss but that's half the fun! I love this store! I will be back over and over again!

Had a fabulous breakfast. Amazing staff loved the bottles of water on the
Tables. Woke up early and arrived at 7.30am. Perfect time. No wait and place only half full. My only disappointment.,,,the use of thick airy doughy white bread in dishes.  Really gagging. French toast dense flavorless after two bites. Amazing roasted tomato and goat cheese omelette  coffee strong and with fresh cream. If there was no thick doughy white bread on the menu would be five stars

8 of us dined here recently, and after reading the reviews below, I was a bit hesitant and wasn't expecting much, but I was really pleased. the food was delicious, atmosphere nice and all of us were pleased. I would like to have had a bit more attentive service, but overall I would highly recommend if you are in the Metairie area.

I've been here twice in 8 days. This place is so creative. Everything I've had has been delicious. They put a new twist on food I've had before plus there are things I've never had before. Best tamales I've ever had, green corn and beef, and prices are very reasonable. Cocktails are also very creative. Love the old building it's in. I can't wait to take other people there.

Most from my previous review still applies, but it's grown on me. Since I've written my review they've expanded on their toppings (guacamole, dressings, etc.). But unless you're not hungry you should get at least 2 patties.

With my recent trip to NOLA and the non stop quest to see live music for 6 nights in a row, Chickie Wah Wah was a welcome sweet spot for a laid back evening. The cover was $8, the crowd was little older, but we were lucky to experience a piano professor who stepped in and played an insane piano number. Kudos for a great bar selection, a fabulous bartender who was super nice to share his thoughts about the sake, yes, they have sake!, the cleanest bathroom I have seen for ages and wonderfully delicious tacos, plus add in no smoke and that tingly feeling you get knowing that they have been featured on Treme, well, maybe that was the sake. Definitely a must and will be back next time around.

I live less than a mile from here and just never got around to trying the brunch. It's just a really good, solid choice for the buffet. Some of the offerings were excellent. The homemade casseroles were as were the omelettes. The fried chicken and the pot roast were very good. I tend to judge places on their biscuits and gravy and those were a bit lacking or they would have gotten 5 stars. The Cherry cobbler, cakes and banana pudding looked good too but I'm avoiding sugar. This is certainly worth a try for a breakfast or brunch.

We stumbled onto this restaurant after seeing the very long line at Hattie B's. The atmosphere seemed really nice and the wait for a table much more manageable-only 10 minutes. The menu choices were appealing and we put in an order for two burgers, fries, a fish sandwich and trail salad.  Then we waited, and waited and waited some more.  Fifty minutes later our food still did not arrive with no real explanation (or apology) from our server.  The manager was pleasant and after she was alerted our food did arrive. The burgers were tasty as were the Belgian fries. The trail mix salad had too many dried cranberries for my liking making it much too sweet.  I think with a different server the experience may have been more positive, but with so many great restaurants in Nashville I won't be going back to find out.

I made an appointment over the phone for my husband and his friend to get massages (birthday gift) I made this appointment a week in advance. The lady over the phone took the names of the clients and a contact number. When they arrived for the appointment, they were told that they didn't have one. I spoke to the person at the front desk and was told that she would fit them in however she didn't. I asked what could have happened? How are you managing clients appointments? I was told that they write the appointments down on sticky notes and transfer them. This is bad business. When I asked for a discount if I booked for another day, I was told no. This place seems to not care anything about customer service. I will not return there nor would I recommend them to anyone. Stay away!

I'm a frequent gulliftys diner, both before and after the renovation.  I loved it before but it really is an awesome gem now.  The new menu items like the duck and fig flatbread are soooooo good!  

Great beer selection and great dunks overall!

I LOOOOOOOVVVEEEEE Ooka.

 Yes, I had to type in caps because I love it that much. 

I'm a big fan of hibachi (there's something about food that's hot and fresh and presented in a fun manner that gets me going). This place is the best hibachi I've ever had. My favorite dish is the steak with an extra side of noodles. 

The restaurant is divided in two, with 4 hibachi tables on one side and a regular dining room on the other. You can order sushi rolls when you're at the hibachi side so no need to worry. It's important to note that it's a BYOB. Sometimes we forget and regret it when we get there. Make reservations if you're planning on going on a Friday or Saturday night as it fills up fast. I've never had a bad meal here. Enjoy!
Great service by the lady who came see had we been.waited on. My burger wasnt cooked adequately however it's good place to visit. I stop once we arrived on town heard it was great burger joint

This place is awesome! My kids, ages 10 and 6, loved it. We were there for 3 hours but could have easily stayed all day. So many hands on activities for all ages and beautiful views on top deck. Kinda disappointed with the museum store. I was looking for more souvenir type stuff but all they had were limited sizes of t-shirts. They should really add more custom Moxie stuff! Other than that, this place is great. We'll be back!
Worst McDonalds in the Country. One of their employees asked "what you want whitebread "
Authentic Thai. Tofu pan fried noodles were excellent, so was fresh spring roll. Duck red curry was really good too. Understaffed and we had to wait but it was worth it.

Awesome authentic Indian buffet in Carmel.  The lamb and marsala are particularly tasty.  Pricing is amazing - $$ indeed.  I have been searching for a decent Indian buffet since moving from California, this place is it.

Everything here is yummy! I love their coffee of course and their donuts (the pink ones!) or panini when I need a snack ;) Only thing that keeps me from coming super regularly is it's not the most welcoming atmosphere and a bit pricey for me. But overall a quality shop for sure. Ps. Lavender Latte-so good!

Anna, the owner, was friendly and listened to my concerns. She provided suggestions that fit my budget and ended up delivering beautiful hand bouquets and centerpieces for our wedding. The flowers were fresh and vibrant.

This is a tardy review, but is still probably accurate.  Last November, I was in Reno working on a presidential campaign.  I had a bunch iof stuff I needed to print, and so I uploaded the pdf files to FedEx Kinko's at the time (Now it's called FedEx Office...wooo!!!!) and was told it would take over 15 hours to print!  I only needed about 200 pages printed!!!

So then I took the file down there on my flash drive.  I had to rent a computer, which was a piece of crap, and then their software....Adobe Reader, for crying out loud...was not installed properly so I had to fix it for them.  And they charged me for it because I was using time on their clock!

Anyway, it was a ridiculous experience.  Other customers there were complaining also, and the employees were as dumb and as unconcerned as they could be.

I wish I could give it a negative star rating!  A Black Hole rating!!

What reminded me to rate this crappy place was reading another person's review of FedEx Office on the Daily Beast.  Apparently, the stores in New Jersey are as bad as the stores in Nevada!

My husband and I live nearby and this is our "go to" restaurant.  We dine here 1 or 2 days per week.  I am mostly vegetarian and I love the selection!  Every week there are several specials, and they always include a few vegetarian and vegan selections.  The specials are always creative and different every week.  I have had vegan dishes as diverse as tamales or stuffed peppers.
1.  The atmosphere:  Friendly! Relaxed. It is heaven on summer days to sit (or stand!) outside, enjoy a drink and everybody knows your name. Inside the bar is great on winter days, especially in the pub snug with the fireplace. The delightful owner is often at the bar. Though I have never been to a real English pub, this feels authentic.
2.  The food: It is always delicious.  I love the vegetarian staples such as the garden tacos and the vegan sloppy joe.  Everyone loves the fish and chips.  There is delicious pizza and creative dishes with touches of thai, mexican and middle eastern flavors.  Meat eaters have many choices ranging from scotch eggs to sirloin steak.  The weekly specials are creative and always inspired! The price is reasonable. 
3. The service: The servers are attentive and relaxed.  We love Dani, Kristy, Jessie, Dan, Nina and all the rest!
4. Beer:  I am not the best judge of beer and will usually order a red wine like cab. sav. or malbec, but most of my friends are ferocious beer drinkers and go crazy for the home-brewed beer here.
This is as good as it gets for a neighborhood pub with all of the right ingredients. If I could change one thing about the restaurant it would be to put in a new floor in the bar, as the current one has had at least one too many beers spilled on it...  We love ya BR Brewpub!

The ACE was a Dream! We staycationed here for Christmas this year and it was just what we hoped it would be. The staff was excellent, the room was cozy and everything from the food (Josephine Estelle and Seaworthy) to the pool was top notch. Chris at the bar really made our evenings. I've always loved staying at the Portland ACE and this was even better! We will be back!

I found this salon through yelp when I was in desperate need of a last minute mani. I was so happy they could fit me in (seems like walk-ins are easily accommodated ) The staff is so pleasant and they have impeccable attention to detail. 

Very happy to see their extensive color selection.

I got a shellac mani (which lasted over two weeks) and a pedi which was so relaxing. 

They even treat you with some chocolate! Highly recommend
Came back to try the kimbap, it was full of flavour and packed full. Also a great value, you get a lot for the price. Friendly staff as well.
Try the tacos al pastor ($15). A bit expensive, but it's 4 tacos with pico de Gallo, green salsa and beans... very tasty!
Delicious. Very reasonable prices. Good portion sizes. Friendly service. Three of us went to dinner and paid $30!  The only complaint I have is that I wish there were more vegetarian options.

Beds are super firm..hard to get comfortable at night. It's a good thing the pillows are soft. Rooms are nice and clean but hot as BLAZES. They don't even air condition the hallways even in August...our air conditioning unit was broken in our room and they let us struggle with having to fix it for 5 days before they finally switched our rooms to one with a fully functioning AC. Breakfast is okay...don't get the scrambled eggs. Idk what those were but they definitely weren't eggs. Just stick to bagels. I really do like the location of this hotel though, very close to a wide variety of shopping and dining options, from casual to very nice. Update- went to stay at a nearby motel 6 and had further annoyances about this place considering the price difference... First off, motel 6 manages to have food and drink vending machines and a microwave...Hampton Inn has a solitary drink vending machine and no microwave. Get it together, Hampton inn, these things are important.
Recently visiting from out of town and unfortunately got injured in a auto accident. Dr. Philips and staff are total pros and helped me with my neck and back injuries. I can't thank you guys enough!

Excellent thin crust pizza.  Not much seating inside and that is why I am rating it 4 stars instead of 5.  Pricing was very affordable and their is a good selection of items on the menu.  Highly recommended and will be back.

I ate there on Food Truck Friday in Tower Grove Park on 9-9-13. Lines were long which is a good sign to me. Plus I love a good gyro. So I ordered the standard gyro. 

I also bought extra sauce for $1.00. The lady told me that the sauce comes on it already however having eaten gyro's all over and loving the sauce I got it anyway.

I did not eat it right away and stashed it in the car to eat it at home. I already was a bit full from cake from Sarah's and 2 taco's from Seoul Taco.

The smell of deliciousness was wafting through the car. 

I had planned on "saving it" for later but by the time I got home I had to dig in. Very good. The meat was cut THICK but not too thick. It was perfect. The sauce was heaven and I did not need the extra sauce I ordered. The feta cheese was a bit heavy handed for my taste. 

I cannot believe I have to say that since I love feta cheese. However, I wanted to taste more of the meat and sauce and if you are a cheese person you know how much it can overpower a salad or sandwich. Might get the cheese on the side next time because the sauce and meat were so good!

If you like a good gyro, seek them out!
This is definitely some of the best BBQ I've had in a while. I would highly recommend their sandwhiches, but that's because I'm a BBQ sandwhich kind of guy.

First time trying this place. I was expecting a awesome burger, alas it was not to be. It was tasty but it was like a Steak-n-Shake burger. Not what I expected. The side order was not as plentiful as believed it should have been. Not much seating on the inside, I had to sit outdoors. Willing to give it another chance, I just think it was overrated.
Wings were small and burnt. Not very tasty at all! Too many people and very young crowd.

I hadn't been there recently but finally visited last week and want to reiterate how great this Fitness Center at this location still is.  I stopped off when I arrived in Tucson, asked for a visitor's pass and they accommodated me in a flash.  They have the same clean locker rooms, the same competent staff, and the same equipment.  They even had the same gentleman who goes there to socialize but not exercise.  My only complaints are the hours are too short on weekends.  I would have gone there on Saturday and Sunday evening if they were open.  The best time to go seems to be between 0700 and 0900 when it's not very crowded and a lot of equipment is available.

You earned three stars for the following reasons.....food was decent, building was cute, and your hostess is awesome. I received a text from my wine sipping friend and  her bff heading back from Sonoita asking me to meet them at Penca downtown around 7. True to a a ladies sense of timing they didn't arrive until 830. Which sounds bad, but it couldn't have worked out better. I called Penca to try to get a table on hold...they were booked solid...it was there last day of business for a month(could someone convince my place of business to do the same!) so that on top of second Saturday downtown happening....it was loony. I arrived before 7 to get my name on the "please God find me a table" list. The Hostess was a doll and highly entertaining and found me a seat at the bar where I could drink beer and pass time. I ended up getting a quesadilla while waiting. It was very very good. Served with beans and fresh veggies between the tortillas...i did enjoy it. My favorite Hostess in the world found a table for us eventually. Table was designed for 2 comfortably, but beggars cant be blah blah blah. My companions ordered drinks, I had another beer. I ordered the tacos, pappas and carnitas...both were very good along with the rice and black beans. The building was not air conditioned well and the humidity made everyone a bit uncomfortable I think. The service was average, they were busy. I would like to go back under better circumstances,

I don't gamble, so this review is for the pool area, which I visited recently with friends who were staying in the hotel.

WOWZA!  When can I come back?  The pool area consists of three pools, all of which are perfectly warmed, and two jacuzzis.  These are surrounded by the cushiest, most comfortable lounge chairs I have ever relaxed on.  Add to that the excellent poolside cocktail service and I was in heaven!  I think I'd rather spend the money on a room for the day than go to Wild Island!

My only complaint is that the entrance to the pool is awkward, forcing a guest to walk from the elevators all the way around through the fancy dining, bar area of the hotel in their bathing suits.

This is a nice quaint place.  I had the turkey chili that was okay.  It could have used a little more heat and flavor.  The chicken and broccolli rabe sandwich was good but there was more bread than meat and rabe.
We went to this place with my mom. I had the black bean burger. It was great. Big portions. my mom had the Reuben. She liked it. My husband had a classic sandwich and ate every bite. Will be back!
This place is good, very good price for a dinner buffet, right around $10 and the food is great!

Fave shoe store in Philly, along with Boyds and Headstart. Great casual as well as special occasion choices. Many British imports, leather as well as non-leather styles. Lots of color and fashion. Love!
Bomb everything....well I haven't tried everything per say but what I have is amazing. If you are in the area, go! They are very busy at times so I would suggest not during lunch time rush.
Love the food! But the customer service is HORRIBLE!! They almost never answer the phone, but they answered it tonight and told me I had to be there by 9:30, but they close at 10!

This is a gorgeous and very clean hotel.  We had a room in the West Wing.  At first it was a chore to get to the room but if you look for different features of the hotel (they also have posted signs) you will easily find your way around.  Self parking was excellent and the walk to Check In was confusing at first but you'll figure it out quickly.  Check In was quick.  The walk to the room was enjoyable as the floors were shiny and clean.  The room was in almost immaculate shape.  Well decorated and very, very clean.  Loved the carpet and the dark lacquered furniture and accents.  Absolutely gorgeous.  Bed was super comfortable and pillow just right.  Towels were thick and soft.  Water pressure in sink was less than satisfactory and shower pressure too.  Bottom left hand drawer almost fell out when I opened it.  This may be nit picking but it was mark down because of water pressure and broken drawer.  Another sink would have been nice.  Yes, I would stay here again.

So pleased I randomly picked this place to eat after my flight got in. Everyone was extremely affable and accommodating. The food I got was delicious and definitely a decent portion. I hung out there for a bit after I was done eating and didn't feel rushed or anything. This is my first time in Nashville and it's already started off well!

This is a hidden gem for all kids that love toy trains.  They have just about every imaginable wooden train set and accessory i available for purchase.  Even better than that though, there is a LARGE, custom built wooden train layout that your kids can play with for no cost so that they can try before you buy.  the owners are super nice and always have a smile to share with you.  They frequently have special events for little or no cost.   I know our family really enjoys this unique kids adventure.

I'd never heard of Zoup before, but apparently it's an east coast chain restaurant.  Don't let that scare you away, though.  The soups are...well...souper! :)  There were about a dozen different soup selections and they freely provided as many samples as you wished.  Oh, and they do have salads and sandwiches as well.

I ordered the half sandwich/half soup deal - Lobster Bisque with Roast Beef and Pepper Melt.  The sandwich was good, but I'll probably try a different sandwich next time.  The soup, however, was a winner.  Love me some Lobster Bisque!  I also tried samples of the Chicken Pot Pie soup and the Macaroni and Cheese soup (yes, mac and cheese soup!).  All excellent options for my future visits.

And...they have vegetable chips.  I tried some of the samples out on the counter.  Highly recommend!

I'm sure their business will boom throughout the winter ahead.  Hooray for new options in the West County Mall food court!

This is my favorite home cooked food in town, I love Boston market and always have been a loyal customer. Sadly, I got an individual meal and found a hair in my mashed potatoes. I will have to find a new location but I'm pretty upset by this. Although Erica is a great worker and really helped accommodate to my lengthy order!

Last month was our second time to buy a new bed from Mattress Firm in this location.  Yep, they've been here more than ten years.

Whatever else you select anywhere else, get a written price and these guys beat it.  Period.  
And then, five years same as cash.  
And... delivery that very same stinkin' night.  A little surprised they delivered at 9:30 PM, but hey, no issue here.

What more can you ask for, people?
this place is awesome they have good food in restaurants and good gambling. prices are fair on everything and good service.
My favorite meal in Tucson.  The sonoran hot dog was outstanding.  I was unhappy with the food in Tucson until I are here.  You must try it, yum!
The food here is fresh and delicious. The home made salsa gives Taqueria Azteca a unique flavor. They have many options for meat combinations. I need to come back and try the linqua.

that the place was cold (no heat) and empty should have been a warning sign: don't eat here.
very expensive, almost no food served, very unsatisfying
the mint tea is watered down
the portions are almost non-existant
no plates, no opportunity to wash hands but you gave to eat with your fingers
terrible place, avoid!

The falafel was out of this world! Great coffee, great brunch. 

I would love to come back for dinner. I hear their seafood is the best thing on the menu!

i am loving the staff at this place so far.  they are certainly very helpful with recommendations and very knowledgeable of the menu.  not to mention, they are all very friendly and approachable.

i briefly scanned through the other reviews and would just like to add... this location purposely make the food LESS SPICY than the original (as told by the staff).  i don't have a problem with it since i can only take so much of the spice pain... if you like it as spicy as the olde city one, you should let your waiter know.

the dan dan noodles are fabulous as always.  the lamb was a little disappointing since it had no characteristic of lamb (taste.. texture.. nada)

will def return! but keep in mind this place isn't cheap.  we got an appetizer, dan dan noodles and one entree to share = $40 (including tip), that was one pricey lunch for 2! o-o

Decided to try them on Grubhub since we were in the mood for cheap Chinese. Order came on time. 

While not bad, the food felt overwhelmed by veggies. My fiance's chow mein was literally a mound of  onions with bits of shredded pork here and there. 

When we called back to exchange it, they couldn't find our order and hung up on me when I went to search for the  receipt or at least look it up. They questioned me like I was in the wrong,too. At that point we just sucked it up. The rest of the food (rice, egg roll, good but only mild beef in garlic sauce) was fine by Americanized Chinese standards and I could pick out broccoli. We were hungry.

They also skimped on sauce and didn't even give fortune cookies. It was only $15 with tip,but, still.. poor customer service.

In passing, perhaps.  But ,I'll stick to other places for now.

PROS: great service and the staff is very friendly
The decorations in the place is very modern and charming.
The food tastes good.

Cons: appetizer sizes are far too small and really expensive.
The ramen has a normal portion size, but it still expensive to pay 14 dollars for soup.

I may be from Philly, but I'm not sure I can discern between good and bad water ice. Is there even really a difference? Regardless, Johns is tasty, its close to where I live, and its a cool scene (really seems like the whole neighborhood is there some nights). They don't have many flavors, but the no-frill atmosphere is part of the appeal. If you're in the hood on a hot day, worth a stop fo sho.
Nice spot for quick lunch.  Buffet generally has quite few choices.  I've never been for dinner but the lunch service is prompt and efficient.  A good value.

The owner is very bad in service. She was not only rude but just didn't have any manners to run the business.

The food in general was just OK but I will never come again because of the service and rudeness.

By far the best Italian in Philly! Authentic and delicious food in a great atmosphere. I had the rigatoni vodka and my husband the fusilli with seafood. AMAZING! And the oil/balsamic dip for your bread? Insaneeeee.

Went there with the kids, had been looking forward to trying it based on other reviews.  We walked in and the inside had a funky, unpleasant smell.  I do like the picnic table seating, and the video games for the kids are great.  

Pizza was ok, crust was pretty thin and seemed overcooked, bottom tasted like a cracker.  Sauce is tasty, but overall I found the pizza to be average, I have found better in Reno.
