The owner is so amazing - I had a party of 7 for brunch, and we called a day or 2 before, and he opened 30 minutes early for us so my out of town friend could experience the awesomeness before she had to hit the road. Love this place!

I went back here to try the dishes again after the owner responded to my review about it being too bland the first time I was there when they just opened.  He said they made some adjustments to the recipes and they certainly did!  AND they added a stone bowl upgrade! 3 dollars was a bit much to pay for the upgrade but Bimbimbop is not the same without it, so I had to have it! It was outstanding!  The flavor was just right..I did not even have to add any red sauce it was so good, my 6 year old keeps asking to go back!  We also ordered the chicken wings which were superb this time and the potstickers were great as well.  All around we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves and will be back!  It would be great for them to expand the menu to include a few more choices...like maybe the seafood soft tofu bowl..mmm.

Every time I call I'm on hold anywhere from 1-5 minutes and there is no "thank you for holding".  I was able to schedule a new patient appointment to be seen pretty quick (hence the one star).  However I was not told to bring my glasses as they were going to dilate my eyes and I was not told to bring my contacts so the dr. could see my prior prescription.  

Then I was told 3 days for my trial contacts to arrive that came in 6 days and then I called on July 3rd and advised them that the trials were not going for work and I was told I would get a cal back the beginning of the next week, and I still, 14 days later, have yet to hear anything.

If I could give negative stars I would, this place sucks.

The food is a bit better than average, however the staff are wonderful.  You feel like more than just a customer, as if you are joining family breakfast.  Socks not knocked off by the food, but that was ok.
Decent food but gave me indigestion from another planet i swear.  Do yourself a favor and just microwave a frozen acme pizza

Love this place!  Only place to sit is the Bar where you are over the chatter of dining patrons and you get to watch the performers and artisans at the Bar.  They use fresh juices daily and create amazing concoctions.  Am trying the lambs sliders based on other reviews.

"Burger Up" Burgers...are?? Ok.
     Maybe the over extended rants and hype about the burgers at "Burger Up" escalated my expectations. The burger I had was "ok" good. It wasn't "soooooo gooood" that I could say its in the top 3 of BNA. I gotta stick by my standards. Burger up has some things I think rock but they don't really transpire over into everyday awesome food for a good price. 
   
The location alone exudes a "Wannabe Snooty" type of a burger place. I've always believed, that burgers are better made.. "un-gourmeted". You grill some exotic meats, so what, its still the meat that makes them taste great. (Say that in a Christopher Walken Tone) 
   
   I couldn't tell if the fries were really done in truffle oil.The parmesan cheese flakes worked. I really think its a gimmick for the "Richy Riches "in the area to make themselves feel better about eating a burger. The selection of locally raised beef was a plus. The homemade ketchup was refreshing. The atmosphere is respective and I will say the service was excellent. The menu offers a comfortable selection of entrees to both carnivores and herbivores. The highlight here is fancy schmancy burgers made from beef.

  My Synopsis: Its for "Sheeple" who wanna buy a burger and not feel bad about eating one cause its "Organic or something??"

They have the best sandwiches ever . They are fast and every hoagie I have gotten from there is just delicious. Counter person was very helpful . My favorite is the : Caprastami and Italian .   Recommend totally
We had the 4x4 pizza, and I must say it was excellent definitely will come back, husband enjoyed the beer selection, the wood-fire gives the pizza such a great taste.

Looks could be deceiving! We stopped  by complete accident for a late lunch. It reminded  us of an old diner. But boy were we shocked  how amazing  the food was and the service was perfect!  We both had burgers.  They were seasoned and cooked perfectly.  We couldn't  stop talking how amazing  they were. They came w thick cut homemade  fries  that needed nothing on them because they were seasoned perfectly.  Definitely put this place on your  list.

I found this place through an Instagram photo, then I saw the place on yelp; I had to check it out since it had such great reviews. I went there around 2:30 yesterday, there wasn't a long line, thank God! I order so many things from their menu, for example, the Thai short rib tacos, satay chicken tacos, cap n crunch tilapia burrito, and the chicken katsu platter with egg and a Thai tea; everything was absolutely delicious!!! My most favorite one was the cap n crunch burrito, it's so tasty and crunchy; it had a lot of flavor. You can tell they use high quality ingredients, and the guy working behind the truck was super friendly! Great customer service, I would definitely come back and get more!

Lost my business over customer service. Use to go here regularly and order the same thing every time. Ordered #8 sandwich but upon going home realized they gave me the wrong sandwich. Normally not a big deal but thought I'd take it back to exchange for the correct sandwich. Upon going back the lady at the counter refused to correct the mistake.  In her mind I ordered the #10 because on the ticket that is what she wrote down. Her attitude was horrible and completely smug the whole time to actually make this a big deal. To not fix a sandwich order over a 2 dollar upcharge is absolutely ridiculous especially when I made the effort to drive all the way back. Then to add her lack of empathy is what really pissed me off enough to write my first review. Excellent business plan, lose customer over a 2 dollar mistake.

Love this place! Been here twice, once during the week & again on Saturday around 11:30am. Saturday was busy but we got seated right away. You MUST get the house made potato chips; they are amazing!  They serve breakfast & lunch all day on the weekend, so we had 2 scrumptious menus to choose from...but wait there's more. They were also celebrating pancake day & had a 3rd special menu of just pancakes. I was in a lunch mood & got the French onion dip with short rib & balsamic drizzle pizza. Yum! Different & tasty. The hubs got the "chicken in a pancake" which were 3 gigantic pancakes with a generous amount of bacon crumbles throughout & a runny egg baked into the center of each pancake. Wow! Definitely eat here if you are anywhere around Mullica Hill!

I will say this: it's a bit of a turnoff when a waitress starts out service with a warning of food that they currently don't have on the menu -- and then goes on to rattle off more dishes than I can keep track of.  Came here recently at around 7pm on a Sunday night, and I suppose they were running out of supplies at the end of the week. 

THAT ASIDE, this meal was delish. My favorite from the evening was the Sweet Potato Hash with bacon, sausage and  the de rigueur fried egg. Also had some sort of brussel sprouts dish with crispy shallots and pecorino romano (also really tasty). 

I've had brunch here before, but this was my first time in for dinner. Looking forward to coming back and having more of the menu!

Our second time here was as great as the first! Drinks are cheap AND good even on the weekends. Our food always comes out super quick and is the best Mexican food I've had in St. Louis, and I have lived here all my life. The service is fantastic and it's great quality food for the price.
Amazing. Burgers and Mac and cheese were everything. Ambiance was laid back and relaxing as well.
These guys are the best!  Love this restaurant, and I think it's the best chinese food in Reno.  Do not discount it for it's location!  A MUST!

This is such a wonderful place! I was worried sick about my precious boy's neutering, and ALL of the staff were positively wonderful! My boy's incision had some issues and the doc had me come in twice for a look. He was positive it would heal perfectly yet I was still very concerned. He took the time to explain everything and was so caring! Thank you so much for what you do here to all of the staff!!!
Ron's always tastes good and uses many natural ingredients! There's good reason for its frequently being packed.

They Have authentic Chinese and sea food, and karaoke rooms upstairs.
This meal consisted of Two lobsters for $19.95. 
Walnut shrimp, and salt baked scallops and squid.

Wish we had a Blaze in Miami, Florida! After searching on Yelp for gluten free restaurants in the area, I stumbled upon Blaze. The concept of this pizza joint is similar to Chipotle. You start off by selecting your dough and YES they have gluten free dough. There is a huge variety of toppings to chose from all very fresh and delicious. The oven they make you pizza is is quick and gives it amazing taste. I am from New York and though I had tried the best pizza in the world, well now I have. Staff was friendly and the pizza was done in no time. I love it so much I would even consider buying a franchise and take it to Miami!! You will not regret going to Blaze

I love the Brewpub. It's a great place for hanging out with friends in the evenings you don't want to deal with the craziness of the Broad Ripple strip. It just has a really nice, cozy, laid-back feel. The beers are excellent - I highly recommend getting a sampler. The food is also really just really good pub food and lots of options on the menu. I remember the shepherd's pie I got reminded me of food I ate in the United Kingdom - very authentic!

We were anxious to try this local spot again after it had been completely remodeled. We always enjoyed the food, but the flow of it and the decor had always fallen short. We were not dissapointed, the ambiance is comfortable, trendy, but, sophisticated enough for an occasion. Our old favorites were still on the menu and lots of cool new things. Love the crab soup. Had the scallops and my husband had the pork chop which was amazing. Dessert was excellent. Really liked all the barn board and the lighting was really unique and eye catching. We will def go back!

Ligne Roset is a very old, 1860,  furniture making company with headquarters and factories in France.  The store in Manayunk is one of 200 worldwide.  Their furniture is ultra clean modern in design and of the highest quality.  You will hear fans of Ligne Roset telling you that their prices are great.  Gauged against design and craftsmanship this is true, but it is anything but cheap.  If you are a fan of Italian, modern French and Scandinavian design, scanning their web site, and store, is a must.  And they have a child's line, Les Minis, if you want to spoil the kid from the jump.
Nice salad at a good price, but make sure you have a lot of time on your hands as service is slow and disorganized.

I'm usually more of a fan of Macy's stores. This stems from my past career needs, and my reluctance to shop for myself. I could usually find what I was looking for in apparel and even housewares. Most of the time enjoying good prices and or coupon savings.

I think the issue with this store is its location in what may be the saddest mall in the area. On this visit to VTC I estimated about 4 more closed businesses than just a month or so ago. I would guess at the occupancy being 33%, and that is probably being generous. The store seems understaffed, and somewhat under stocked. My better half felt there were bargains to be had in women's, I can't deny or confirm. 

When the time came to checkout we did have to wait longer than normal, so long that we decided to try and find another open register. There were several clearance sections throughout the store, if you have time and like a bargain they might be worth a look. Maybe if this mall revives, this Macy's will step up their game. I'd probably visit a different location if I was shopping for myself.

Buffalo Wings generally have pretty consistent service and food quality -- I mean, how hard is it to serve reheated chicken and beer?  Well--evidently, pretty hard.  We arrived at 5:45 -- pretty early for dinner -- and were told a 20-30 minute wait, which turned into a 45 minute wait.  That should have been our first sign something was amiss.  After waiting 45 minutes, we already knew what we wanted to order, so ordered immediately after being seated at 6:30.  We ordered a chicken salad, a burger, a wrap, boneless wings, and a kids mini corn dogs.  60 minutes later we finally got our food.  Our waitress was great, and came by every 10 minutes to ask if we needed anything (other than our food), but all she could say is it should be coming, it should be coming.  We asked if the order was lost, and she said she saw it up on the screen in the kitchen, and said she had confirmed the kitchen had seen it, and that the screen shows them how long a order has gone unfilled, so they should know it had been an hour.  She had even talked with the manger.  Despite this, it took a full 60 minutes to bring out 6 items which literally have 5 minute prep time.  The chicken on the salad, wrap, and wings had all been precooked and heated under a heat lamp -- they were all dry.  They also put dressing on the salad despite asking for it on the side.  The waitress insisted on the manager coming over to us.  She asked him several times.  He finally came over as we were trying to leave, and said "what is the problem" curtly as if the waitress hadn't already told him 10 times, before, during, and after our meal was delayed an hour.  When my 74 year old mother politely told him (remember, the waitress asked him to come over, not us), he replied "did everything come out ok?" as if the only thing that mattered was did we receive edible food or not after waiting 1 hour and 45 minutes.  The guy acted exasperated, like the whole thing was out of his control.  Dude, I hate to break it to you, but your the manager.  This place is bleeding money -- if you can't get food out in under an hour, you can't turn tables.  The faster you turn tables, the more customers you can serve, and the more money you make.  Also, the less the wait time, so less customers get frustrated and leave and are less likely to come back.  With an hour wait for food, less customers are going to come back again, including us.  Sayonara Buffalo Wings -- it was nice knowing you for 20 years, but after 86th/Ditch service/kitchen went downhill, we were only willing to give you one last chance, and despite having a brand new restaurant with a brand new general manager, you managed to disappoint us even further.  We simply have too many casual dining and bar and grill options to waste our time and money with you.
Awesome recipes from experienced brewers! Something hazy this way comes and the house ipa are definitely top of the list for me! Knowledgeable, friendly service, in a great atmosphere!

I love patty melts and the ones here make me happy. yeah the place is kinda greazy and has a reputation, but I have to go once in a while ;)

OK, to be honest we thought there was a cracker barrel on this exit but we couldn't find it, so we got stuck eating here. But it wasn't *totally* shitty!

I broke down late on a friday night and was able to get an appointment with a technician for early saturday morning. I towed my car to the dealership and came back on saturday. They emailed me with updates about my car and even picked me up from school the day it was ready.
An absolute must every time I get back to Tampa -- the spoon-thick shakes (which come in dozens of flavors) are on the short list of the greatest desserts in the world.

Great, local beer complimented by an excellent menu that changes based on products sourced locally. This is as good as a microbrewery gets, and the food can be described as "gourmet" bar food. Love it!!

My family and I eat here often and I have never been disappointed. The Salsa is so fresh and amazing. The Brunch is delicious and the Mimosas are only $1.  The last time I ate here I had the crab cake with creole tomato and crawfish sauce with an egg on top (don't recall the name of the item) it was SO AMAZING! My husband had the seared tuna fish salad and he said it was fresh and really tasty. Our son and nephew both had Quesadillas. My nephew told me they were the best he ever had, even better than Taco Bell (Hey he's 5). Great place for families and pets.

New owner owns a few restaurants, and upscaled the menu, but still reasonably priced. I got the bacon wrapped filet, it was cooked perfectly, and was top 3 I've ever had, and I've had prob close to 50 different steakhouse offerings before.
Also offer cheaper sandwiches that looked amazing too.
Bar offerings could be expanded a bit, but I'm sure they are working on it.

I was searching for a good hoagie place rather than doing Primo or Wawa for an evening bowling event at Devon Playdrome.  I found this deli did trays so I ordered a tray and a few other different hoagies to accomdate the group.  The woman who took my order was very helpful in trying to figure out how many sandwiches were needed to feed our total amount of people. The food was very tasty and a definite reason to stop there for a sandwich at any time.  We'll be having more bowling events and will be sure to stop back again the next time or sooner.

It's hard to say that there is a five star buffet in Reno, but I come here every summer for breakfast which is the best for the buck. This is a buffet that has great selection of food that is a bit above the average buffet. Lines can be long, but that's because everyone knows to come here. The price is average . Attentive staff. It's clean. It's roomy . What more do you want? You want more , go spend more money at a non - buffet restaurant.

This is by far my worst experience dining in NOLA. Ordered French Onion Soup, veal chop, veggie and bordelaise sauce. My chop was to be medium rare plus ... closer to medium. 

No soup showed up. Wrong sauce. And the chop was rare and an end cut. How do you serve an end-cut rare ... and is always reserved for medium well to well orders. 

Terribly disappointed and all I wanted was a casual good NOLA meal.

Second chance failed miserably! Medium rare to rare in some sections of the cut. The quality was horrific, vainy and tough. Over charred on the outside a under cooked, cold center in the middle. 

The best thing I can say is the bread was fine and the butter wasn't frozen. 

They lost a customer and a "former" advocate. Given the prices, you expect more and I'm left with a bad experience and hungry.

I have been meaning to write a review for months for this great little Tucson restaurant. My husband and I have come to love it. So few interesting restaurants in the north half of Tucson. This is a little gem to be enjoyed. They have great music. A lovely little patio. A quaint little interior. I'm on a limited sugar diet and they helped me invent a lovely muddled mint ad cucumber vodka, club sofa and lime cocktail. Incredible service. But better than that is the absolute consistency we have experienced with the Seabass and rice dish. Perfectly prepared fish at that fine point where it flakes but not one bit over done. Hard to find in Tucson. We have had many of their appetizers all which were delicious. Great place to experience in Tucson.

I loved the idea of yoga in a museum. The security at the Cabildo and the instructor were all very nice. They know most people are travelers so she had everything - mats, blocks, and straps. We did more of a yin class with a few balance poses and twists. She also teaches a Saturday class that is more of vinyasa flow. The instructor was humorous. Class is meant more for a beginner-intermediate, but it's what you make of it.

Another great meal at Tokai.  Chef David made some amazing creations. 
Loved everything.

After the hailstorm in 2011, they did fantastic work on paintless body repair on my 1 series bmw. I was so impressed that i had them install aftermarket downpipes. 
Huge mistake. They installed the pipes and charged $300 which is upper level of normal pricing and they left a non-bmw BOLT in the drivers side resonator. 
The rattle it caused never bothered me, but trying to sell the car now I wanted whatever the foreign object was to be removed. 
I took the car back to WC body repair and the man there told me it's impossible that there's anything they did causing the rattle, it has to be a 'pipe problem' Uhm hello physics...how can a solid pipe cause a rattle like that..for example..put the car on ramps and took a small hammer to resonator and could hear a clinking sound.
Long story short, took the car to Bradley Motorwork to remove the pipe ..what do you know? a non-bmw bolt falls out-- probably accidentally swept into my pipes on WC auto body's floor by their mechanic. 

Very upset that the ?owner? tried to blame a solid metal pipe on a clinking sound. Not very professional. Should have some labor warranty.

Best part..."it'll cost you $300 for us to look and just as much for us to put the pipes back on', and 'you better have gaskets ready"...cool.

We have always enjoyed this restaurant and the entire dinning experience. Last night was an example of how one individual can ruin the evening. When we had an issue with the To-Go order the manager basically told me to pound sand. We dinned in and at the time of seating ordered an entree to take home with the expectation it would be ready when we were finished. Unfortunately that was not the case and I was told when I received my bill that it would be an additional fifteen minutes before my take home order was ready because the kitchen was backed up. When I expressed my disappointment to the waiter, she sent Nanu, the manager over to speak with me. Nanu was not apologetic, did not offer concern and was certainly not  making my satisfaction his priority. I asked him to at least offer the entree to me for half price. He brought back my bill, said he charged me half for my take home order and quickly walked off. When I was leaving he was standing at the front, I told him that his actions were not acceptable and He was obviously not focused on customer service. His response was "call corporate". Wow, don't think I will be visiting this restaurant again. Management certainly does not care about the customer experience.

This is a quaint little bar just down from Bourbon Street. Just far enough from the ruckus. Let me start by saying they, by far, had the coldest beer I've ever tasted. $3 Blue Moons.....say what?! Yes, please!  

My crew ordered the backspace burger minus the fixins but RAVED about how great the burger tasted.  I had the adult grilled cheese. Equally great.  I would given them 5 stars but the kitchen was a one-man-band so our food took forever.  Granted it was the day of the Alabama/Ohio State game, but  the place isn't that large. It was well worth the wait. So much so we came back on the January 2nd for our farewell meal. This time I ordered the Backspace burger with the works. OMG! Definitely a must visit.

Epiphany Design Studios offers antiques, renovation, and interior design.  Most of this high-end furniture is pretty modern looking.  As I looked around,  I noted the pop music playing on the stereo, and the woman working there informed me that everything was 20% off.  Still a little too expensive for me.  The attractive oak dining room table was priced at $1750, and the least expensive item in the store, some sweet-smelling incense candles, cost between $17 and $32.  

Epiphany seems to be going for a chic but still mainstream style, with a mid-size collection of carefully presented tables, chairs, lamps, and china.

My second stay here. All I did was inform Kenny at the desk during check in that my fiancée and I were about to get married and we were in town for the weekend to celebrate her birthday. What followed was a commotion of niceties from the choc flavored strawberries and champagne brought up to our 32nd floor suite with wondrous view to the complimentary breakfast for our entire stay to unfettered access to the lounge. It was a very upscale and totally enjoyable weekend. I rarely give 5 stars but I will give this time because customer service was great and every employee seemed happy with their work and excited to help us. I would have fussed about parking but I got a very affordable $6 parking at the 'public' parking garage opposite the hotel. 
Thanks Kenny!!

I went there because i heard they have good ribs. Well i walked in and the lady said "We are not open, Probably another hour". Mind you its going on 4pm. This place serves breakfast, lunch and dinner so i dont know why they would not be open. I left and came back the next day. Me and my cousin ordered two chicken wing platters. The chicken had absolutely no flavor or season. The greens i have had way better, The mac and cheese was ok but i have had better as well. Cabbage was horrid and the yams was really good. Lemon and strawberry cake was really good as well. Icing is very sweet though. I would only go back to get a slice of cake if i ever went back

Maybe we were there on a bad day because the service was very slow, short staffed it seemed. We were waiting forever just to get waited on which was frustrating when you're hungry. By the time we got our food (almost 30+ mins) we just wanted to eat and leave. I suggested this to my family because of the reviews here on Yelp and my brother has been here before to add to the positive comments but for me, my first impressions of it (service-wise) weren't too good. 

The food, on the other hand, was good and I would probably give it another go because of  it. I got the chicken pad Thai. My parents also ordered from the big bowl menu and my brother got the chicken Katsu which was yummy. The prices were very reasonable, about $44 for all of us. 

I'm open to change my review on a next visit if the service is better. Service definitely affects your whole dine-in experience.

After loving on the west coast for over 20 years, I admit I'm a sushi snob. From the quality of the fish to the rice to the wasabi, it all counts and Tuna Bar hits on all cylinders (the wasabi is freshly grated). I'm looking forward to trying the other dishes as well but I'm sure they will deliver as well.

Food is good, service is TERRIBLE. We were there for 30 minutes before WE flagged down a waiter. They never asked how everything was. Never got refills on drinks until we asked. Be prepared to spend almost 2 hours cause they are so slow.

Went to johns pass to watch dolphins and the sunset to enjoy our last night in Florida. Was hoping to go to waltzs but they were closed, so we went to sculleys. We came at around 9:15 and they close at 10 so we cut it close, but our waiter showed no signs of frustration and was very nice and attentive all night. I ordered a cup of the clam chowder which was delicious, and the kale and quinoa salad with mahi mahi. Fish was very fresh, and the salad was excellent. My girlfriend ordered pasta with mussels and she enjoyed hers as well. To top it off we sat next to the water and got to see dolphins jumping out of the water. It was a great way to end our vacation and I look forward to coming back next time I get the opportunity

Love going to this bookstore. It's always nice and well kept and the staff is friendly. Cashiers regularly talk to me about my purchases and the staff has asked me numerous times if I need help finding books I'm looking for. It's also a pretty large store so they have a lot of books to choose from and it seems like they always have deals. They do have a cafe inside if you'd like to get something  to drink while reading. I'm sure it's not too much different from other B&N's but I really enjoy this one, and the people who work there!

This is the place to get your clothes fitted/fixed in the northside of Indianapolis. Yong is very knowledgeable and friendly. I really appreciate her turnaround in fixing clothes on time and the work is great. The prices are fair and the location is great-right next to Trader Joes! 

It is attached to a wedding dress store so their specialty is wedding dresses. However, you can get clothes other than wedding dresses fixed here so don't feel uncomfortable in bringing any mens/women's clothing item. Personally I get my pants, skirts, and coats hemmed here. Sometimes I even buy a slightly larger size so that I can get clothes custom fitted for me. Yong is great at providing suggestions or advice on how to get the perfect fit. 

Thank you again for your help!

This is definitely the place to be in the Tampa area! The drink specials are great and they always have incredible acts. Some of the acts are local or lesser known comedians and then others are big names in the comedy world. The food is good too, especially the loaded nachos. My friends and I come here all the time and have never once been disappointed. Great staff all around too they definitely make you feel appreciated. It's a little far from the downtown Tampa/channel side areas but most certainly worth the drive up there.

Having my hair done at the same place in NJ for 8 years, I was super nervous to switch hair colorists when I moved to the area. Kadi, however, exceeded all my expectations and did an amazing job on my color. I am so happy I bit the bullet and tried someplace new!
Every time I come home I always need to get Taste of India. Always impeccable and delicious and you're getting so much food for your money which is great cause I always have leftovers!

I recently just got married at Shephards on May 30th of this year. Let me tell you that the only saving grace for them is Sharyn the wedding coordinator. She was amazing!! She was very thorough and everything associated with our wedding was perfect, we couldn't have asked for a better person to help us set everything up since we live in Kentucky. Now that was the only thing that went smoothly. Whenever we checked into the hotel on the 28th on a Thursday we were inquiring about all the rooms that we had booked for the wedding party. The girl at the front desk was wearing a name tag that said Valerie but come to find out whenever she answered the phone her actual name was Heather. Hmm mm. Oh well. We were checking on 3 other reservations with "Valerie" and she said that she didn't see any in the system. Do we had to pull up all the reservations from our email and read them off to her. We had reserved two additional bay side rooms and 1 island view rooms. Well come to find out they booked us for  was 2 island view rooms and 1 bay room. We had told her that this wasn't correct and we had made the reservations directly with Greg. She then said well that sounds about right, implying that Greg does this numerous times a week. Finally we got everything straightened out and were told that we needed a 50$ deposit for incidentals. No worries on that. Let's fast forward through all the other boring details and get right down to the heart of the problem. My wife's mother was paying for our room and my brother in laws room also. Whenever we both checked our credit card statements my wife had 3 deposits for 50$ held on her card and also 2 charges for 210 and some change each. So our 50 deposit turned into over 470 dollars rather quickly. We let my brother in law know about what happened and told him to check his card also. Come to find out that they charged his card over 900$. When we checked out at the front desk what we thought would be a quick fix turned into a nightmare. A quick 5-10 minute check out turned into almost an hour. Not one person at the front desk could give us an explanation on how or why these charges were on our credit cards. The amounts didn't even match up to our room totals at all is the thing. No one at the front desk even cared to explain the situation and why the charged were ut on the cards. Eventually after the hour was up everything was finally worked out, everything except for my mother in law getting charged a 50$ incidental fee in addition to all the room costs. It is now the 10th of June and still have not seen that refund back on her card and it has been 11 days. I will not stay or use this resort ever again. Sharyn was the saving grace at this resort by far and she should be commended on how professional that she was. Also I would like to think whenever you book a 200+ dollar a night king suite that you are not kept up till 2-3am in the morning because the tiki bar outside lets the locals in to party all night. Stay away from this place at all costs.

Attended a Sockeye Brewery Tastings And food pairings. Six brews and five courses masterfully prepared by chef Shipley with excellent service. The restaurant is acoustically lively; at times it was difficult to maintain a conversation with our table mates. Within walking distance of the Capitol building, the usual menu and table names plays on the legislative process and famous legislators. Tonight's special event was a real treat and we plan to return in the future.

This place has gone from an iconic Tucson institution to a sad modern day faux Mexican restaurant. Couple the average food with terrible service and you have a customer will will not be coming back. We had a group of 10 that sat for about 6 mins before anyone ever approached our table. From there everything was painstakingly slow at every turn. I had a salad and tacos. The chopped salad was straight out of a bag with minimal Mexican cheese, canned mandarin orange slices, and soaked in dressing. I could have picked up the tacos at a hole in the wall for half the price and had a more authentic Mexican dinner. Save you time and don't go.

My girlfriend used to go to college in the area and when I was visiting this was the spot to go. They serve all types if meals but this review is really for the cheesesteak. It was damn good. In fact whenever I go to Philly I feel the need to get one from here (double cheese with green peppers). It's a good look.

My boyfriend and I went here back in April for my birthday breakfast and we loved every little bit of it.  The building is quaint and cute, the service was great and even the patrons were laid back.  I got a mimosa and he got a tequila sunrise, both were well made, no 80% OJ 20% champagne stuff going on at Horn's.  For food, I got the Crabby Wife and he got the Jewish Coonass.  Both dishes were absolutely delicious and neither of us would have changed a thing, talk about filling and comforting. I'm not usually a biscuit fan, but event the biscuits at Horn's were good!  If we're in NOLA again, we'll definitely be back.

Love this place. How is this place still in business with the huge portions you get! The food is very authentic and old family style italian. BYOB which is always awesome. It's also located right at the edge of girard estates area of philly which is the nicest and safest area in the city. I hope this places stays a south philly secret.

Ok. Yesterday was the third time I've been here in two weeks. May go again today. Definitely not a dieters delight. Though they do have veggie burgers. Tried the hot dogs but my favorite is the bacon cheeseburger. Fast, extremely friendly staff, large burger (if you have a small appetite, try the little burger), all condiments are free add ons. Such as mushrooms, lettuce, tomato, pickles and more.
Staff sings to the music.

Could've been an off night, but as yelp puts it, "meh. I've experienced better." The grungy crowd stared me down when I walked in wearing business attire and sat down to wait for a friend. Once she arrived, our frazzled waitress poured glasses of water before flitting off to wait on ten other tables (four of which were outside), returning very intermittently. The front and porch doors were left open breezing 50 degree weather past us for the entirety of our meal. It was not a comfortable place to eat.

The restaurant welcomed vegetarian menu in an otherwise carnivorous town. The hummus was a little dry and my Volatoo Indian rice bowl too liquid and bland (note: I like my food spicier than your average American, but it still was below standards after asking for extra spice). My friend commented her Thai peanut sauce was also blander than she had expected. I would not re-order these three dishes.

The crowd grew as the evening continued, leading me to think live music began after dinnertime, but I was in no mood to stay after eating.
Two visits on my trip. Excellent food and service! Had the oyster Benedict and the seafood Benedict.  Awesome grits as well!
Lots of slots, you have to pay to park, the cocktail waitresses aren't cute, drinks take forever, and everyone smokes in there..... I'd still go back though

First off. This rating is for service and not the food. I have to stress that first. That being said I can't begin to say how disappointed I am in the service (or lack there of) I received tonight. I actually frequent this restaurant and have for years. Tonight I attempted to bring 7 of my friends along to enjoy dinner here for a birthday celebration. When we arrived we asked what the wait time would be. The hostess who was very nice told us 20-25 minutes for indoor or we could be seated immediately outdoor. The 8 of us were talking and another woman arrived at the hostess station and told her it would not be 25 min but 45 to an hour. So we asked to be seated outside. The hostess explained that if we chose to eat outside if it rained there would be no guarantee we could be moved indoors. We agreed and that was fine. The hostess then mentioned to the other young lady (who I would later find out was named laney) that we chose outside and she was worried about the rain. Laney told her "well that isn't our problem". During the time that I was speaking to the hostess the other young woman kept repeating what the hostess was telling me. I'm an adult and I can hear plenty well so I knew what she was saying the first time and didn't need a third party repeating it. 

While the hostess sat the rest of my party I stuck around to ask the young lady if there was a problem or if we had done something to annoy or offend her. She simply stated she wasn't referring to us she was talking about something else. Ok. 

After the hostess sat us, no one ever arrived to take our order. No one even brought us water or asked if we wanted a drink. Nothing. To be so worried about us possibly eating in the rain, yet no one cared to try to get our order in a timely manner.  

After waiting with no sign of service what so ever, I picked all of our menus up and returned them to the hostess. I have never been so disappointed in the service I've received here. It's one of my favorite places to eat but tonight it left a bad taste in my mouth.

lovely location, whip off the Interstate 74 & the keep turning right (you won't see the sign at first, believe it or not)t & head back, this WAS the Perfect store, until they changed the layout
walmarts are great for late in the middle of the night shopping

Omg!!!! I was very surprised that the tacos I had was so delicious. My daughter suggested that we stopped and grab a bite to eat and I'm so glad we did. I had the triple threat tacos and let's just say I will be back. The restaurant was very clean and the employees were very nice and patient because I didn't have a clue what to order.

Very underwhelming. If you don't mind bland tacos sans sauce and dry chewy meats, then this place is for you. Also, the food came out ice-cold.

I never send food back to the kitchen but actually had to send two tacos back here. The jerk chicken tacos were like naked, dry chicken breasts in search of some flavor and slaw. After choking down the first bite I decided to request toppings be added. 

I'm giving two stars instead of one because I like their patio. Unless it's for drinks, I don't plan to return.

Be very careful before you spend hundreds of dollars to get here for a weekends racing - security implements random policies (which they blame on some mystery direction they were given the day before) that deny entry without publicizing policy until a sign at the gate.

Professional photography was redefined as any camera with a removable lens at the most recent race I attended (after no such rule at two previous events this year)

The Chicago style pizza was delicious. Great sauce. TONS of cheese wow. The deep dish crust is unbelievable. Our server was very friendly and on point. The pizza was fresh just for us, so we waited while it cooked. Good stuff.

Voodoo Bone lady is QUEEN. Her tour was so good other people on other mundane tours were trying to listen to hers. She is funny and so so knowledgeable. If you get her as a tour guide then god has opened up the heavens and shined the light down below because she is the best. We walked around leisurely she knew the most information of any tour host and she was the nicest. 

If youre going to do a tour (you have to for cemeteries) choose the Voodoo Bone Lady, anyone who says otherwise, yall are our demons.

Smoked fish is a hit, obviously. The place is impeccably clean. Food comes out fast. 

The down side: servers are testy and it's pricey. Two simple lunches (no sides) with 2 draft beers will set you back $40, easy. Also, it's cash-only policy in 2015 is a bit inconvenient. But when business isn't hurting, I guess you can make the rules.

Summary based on one multi-day stay, not during peak period:
--better than average rooms for a Hampton
--ok price
--free parking, enter around corner.  Don't use first cardkey, but 2nd, under hotel. 
--free, typical Hampton breakfast; afternoon snacks
--free Internet with ok speed
--friendly, helpful staff
--St Charles streetcar stop 1/2 block away
--close to good restaurants
--quiet rooms, including aircon
--elevator slow
Steak tacos and huevo Valenzuela for brunch are good. Nice ambiance. I get why they call it Paradise Cafe. So chill.

Great pizza, great salad and most of all excellent service. This is a family owned and run restaurant and they are so friendly they
make you feel like family.  The thin crust on the pizza was baked perfectly...not soggy anywhere; perfect amount of cheese, perfect amount of toppings.  The salad was great - no dressing needed.

Let's start with the good news.  The service was attentive and very good.  The truffle fries were delicious.  Okay, end of the good news.  The bad news is that I was very disappointed in my burger.  I ordered the Ramsey and, after cutting it in half, took a bite.  After a second bite, there was no more meat on that half.  Literally, two bites and done.  The second half made it through three bites.  This patty must have been the size of a breakfast sausage patty.  The bun was VERY deceiving in that it was 2-3 times larger than the "burger".  This was more like a slider than a full-sized burger.  I was quite disappointed.  It's a shame too because the bar looked like it had some great choices.  I won't be going back

Although I had a wonderful day, TAMPA NEEDS A NEW BASEBALL STADIUM.  If I am not cheering for the Royals, then I am a Rays fan.  Parking was easy (and I was told that if you have four or more people in your car, then you don't have to pay the $20 parking fee).  We had amazing seats due to scalpers who were desperate to get rid of tickets at the last minute.   I suppose it was nice being in a covered stadium because the sun can be brutal and you never know when I will rainstorm may appear, The dome is white on the inside and the ball gets lost against the white background and it's hard to see.  The Rays are having another decent year and it's amazing that  they aren't sold out and there are empty seats in the stands.  I think it's because of the location of the stadium and because it's not the greatest stadium to watch a game in.  Again, it was a good time and I will definitely be back.

We chose the hotel for our room block for our wedding on May 11, 2014, as we have stayed here several times over the years, and we thought that it would be a special experience for our guests. We were EXTREMELY disappointed. We arrived and checked in and were given the smallest room I have ever seen. It barely fit my husband and I, never mind a bride who planned to get ready in the room with hair/makeup artists, photographer, videographer. I was shocked that they would put a bride and groom in such a terrible room, and was bummed to see that my family members also had the same tiny rooms. I begged everyone in the staff I could contact for an upgrade, but was told the hotel was booked with other wedding parties. We had this room block in place for 8 months at this point, and I would think a bride who is bringing the hotel 25 room bookings would get preferred accommodations. I wasted a ridiculous amount of time over the next few days talking to the front desk and group sales to try to get another room. We were finally moved into a room that was a little more spacious on Saturday, May 10th, but it was still far from adequate to accommodate a bridal party. We were uncomfortably crammed into a very small room the day of the wedding and I was beyond disappointed. 
I had also arranged for our second-line after our wedding to end back at the hotel, and months before the wedding I had left repeated messages and emails for the person in charge to discuss this. He never called me back, and I was finally connected to him by group sales who had arranged the room block. I was told that we would have a designated area for our guests when we arrived after the wedding. I brought 70 people to the bar, and there was no place designated for our group. We were all scattered around the bar, as if I had never put the effort in to arrange anything beforehand.  
Lastly, upon checking in my sister (and MOH) waited at the carosel bat for her room to be ready and checked her luggage in the luggage room. When the it was finally ready, a bellcap brought up her bags. Her garment bag, which contained thousands of dollars worth of clothing (including her MOH dress) was not brought up with the rest of her bags. When she realized this later that evening, she immediately contacted the front desk and the baggage room, and her garment bag was not there. We spent the entire weekend hunting for the lost bag, with little help from management. We were sent from person to person, with no apologies, and were never able to view the security tapes which may have helped us track it down. Clearly, it was either given to the wrong hotel guest or stolen. The hotel claimed zero liability and was NO help in retrieving her belongings. Rather than enjoying time with our wedding guests that had flown in in from all over the country, we spent the day before the wedding running around the French Quarter to find (and spend more money) on a new Maid of Honor dress. There was no assistance from the staff, no compensation for the missing bag, or even sympathy. The entire situation was unacceptable. After spending thousands of dollars and bringing so much business to your hotel, we left feeling like our stay here ruined our wedding weekend. I have contacted management to discuss our stay several times over a span of months and my calls/email were not retured. If I had to do it all over again I would never have brought my guests to a place with such a lack of customer service or concern.
Delicious and authentic! I highly recommend! The beef ravioli/dumplings were amazing!

At first glance, this place looks awesome....Actually eating here, is a whole different story. The first thing, they really need too decide if they want to be a full service restaurant, or an upscale wanna-be Bread Co. When the best thing you have is their ice tea. I had the Salmon Tartine....which would have been called salmon sprinkled cream cheese. The cream cheese was at least an inch and a half thick. The roasted potatoes were ice cold, when we mentioned it, they took them back, microwaved them, came back out, half were raw. Not just mine, but my friend's also. For just ordering from the counter, they sure have a lot of staff walking around filling drinks....we were probably asked 5 different times in the course of 10 minutes is everything okay? Well, yes it was OK. They really need to figure out if they want to be a full service table restaurant or order at the counter, it became very confusing. They have actual menus printed out, not to-go menus as well as monitors with the menu. I highly wouldn't recommend this place, and will not be back. Clayton is definitely not the place for this eatery. Also, need to hire cooks that can actually cook!

Friendly, reasonably priced, and no bullshit!

I went to Hillsboro Village Auto Service mainly because it's within walking distance of my office, but was very happy with the service I received.  I went in to get a flat tire fixed & an oil change expecting hefty fees.  To my surprise, the whole thing was only $90 with synthetic oil.  Not too shabby with oil prices as they are, plus getting a tire fixed.

The mechanic also mentioned my tires needed to be replaced.  While you might take this with a grain of salt, know that I've built 3 kit cars, so I know my way around cars.  Upon inspecting the treads, I agreed.  It was nice that they went the extra mile and never felt like they were just trying to extract more dollars from me.

If you're looking for a good honest mechanic, this is the place to go.

My favorite place to enjoy a St. Louis summer night outside with pizza and cold drink.

First off, I'm totally impressed that they even have vegan cheese pizza!  Seriously, Pi is blowing away the West and East Coast.  It's vegan heaven!  You mean I can have my melty cheese pizza and not contribute to mammal suffering - wow, what can be better than that? 

The salads are fresh and the hummus is served with garlic pizza crust 'breadsticks'.  The chocolate chip cookie dessert is actually vegan moon pie - its was unexpected awesome.  Seriously, everything here is pretty on point even the dranks.

Only the thin crust is vegan, but hey, that's ok.  I can't even believe this place exists.
The worst service ever!  They lose the scripts and never have my refills ready.  In the last year only one refill was ready without me having to go back at least twice. :(

I was recommended to Dr Barlow by an Emergency Room MD, who was his patient and had a similar complaint.  Dr. Barlow's gentle touch and manner not only relieved the stress of pain but of worry as well.  I will be forever grateful to that ER Doctor for being honest enough by acknowledging his own Allopathic limitations when it comes to back pain by only being able to offer me pain meds.  I have a condition that does not allow me to take pain meds.  At the Westside Chiropractic I was given drug free relief!

In addition, his staff reflects his caring nature.  They are there for you.
Good tour of the facilities, it doesn't compare to the St. Louis Brewery, but definitely worth the trip if you live around the area. Decent selection of free samples after tour.

Mixed review. Wife enjoyed the wings but my hot ranch burger had no flavor. Word of advice "seasoning" Unremarkable bar food. Grease aplenty. Slow service. Nice atmosphere. Go an extra block west and go to Scotty's. Better food and service

Went here for lunch today with my mom and grandma to celebrate my grandmas birthday. Had a really good time. Service was great and food was really good! Had a difficult time picking off the menu since everything looked great. I will have to go back soon.

The scene: From the neon OPEN sign in the window, to an owner sitting in the front not doing anything but twiddling her thumbs, the Olive Garden-ish feel to the decor and the Kenny G elevator music, we were not at all impressed. We also noticed right away they were over staffed, but it still took 5 minutes for our server to even greet us. She was very nice but you could tell she didn't have "formal" dining experience (which I'm guessing is what they are going for given the menu prices).

The meal: We got Calamari to start which was terrible. The breading had no flavor, the squid was chewy and the dipping sauces were mediocre at best. My husband got the Crispy Skin Salmon.... the skin was, uh, NOT crispy.... more rubbery and soft. I got the Tilapia special which was just caked with breading and had an awful fatty caper sauce. The wine was good, though.....

This place will not survive. Which is unfortunate because you can tell the owners really have tried... they just missed the mark on every level. Far too expensive for the poor quality of food and the strange atmosphere. We will not be returning and will advise our friends to go elsewhere.

Went for Sunday brunch . The service was great for us as there was only one other table being served. The gumbo was so salty with burnt roux.  It was not edible .  The Bar B que  shrimp and grits had twice as many shrimp heads as shrimp. Don't think air condition works . The inside of the restaurant is very nice . It's just such a shame they can't serve good food . I won't be back.

As soon as I got past the nice atmosphere and friendly service and tasty food, I realized that it's slightly overpriced and have had better quality hibachi in other cities.

You can only have hibachi once for the first time.
It brings joy to many people, why is it so good?  the show.  And lots of great food.

I'm going to plant this seed, don't get your expectations up, and you won't feel disappointed.  But it's worth a try for some delightful asian cuisine.  They have sushi, and ok atmosphere.  You can even hang out at the bar and just grab a drink.  why not?  what else are you going to do in Smyrna.. LOL

Chandeliers are everywhere in this gorgeous boutique that epitomises the French Quarter.  I came in here to find some jewelry but, sadly, left empty handed.  

I do wish that there was more merchandise in the store.  Coming from Chicago, I think that back home the merchant would have stuffed the store with at least twice as many baubles yet it would have the same feeling.

The store is filled with jewelry at all different price points.  And the chandeliers are for sale as well!

Just swung in there after having issues with my car starting. Bobby and Julio helped me out and they were fantastic. Found it was a super simple fix and then pointed out a few other things I might want to look into down the road (I had recently purchased the car used and hadn't had it checked out yet). They weren't pushy at all and really helpful. Definitely feel they went above and beyond and will be bringing my cars their way in the future.

It only took me 3 months to discover this most perfect dive bar around the corner from my house. Super chill, good beer selection, music was good and not too loud. I expect that I'm about to become a regular here. Like I might go again tomorrow night. 

If you're looking for a place that isn't "sceney" and full of douchebags, where you can just sit & drink some beers & BS with your friends, look no further.

First of all I would like to say that the waitresses and bartenders are top notch workers. However, the one manager that wore glasses had a little power trip over the outside windows being open. It was a beautiful 70 degree Sunday, so we decided to go to this location knowing it had a beautiful outside patio. We were very upset when we sat outside and the windows were closed during our dining experience, we asked for the windows to be re opened and he refused. He also refused us other seating to where the Windows were open for our dining experience. After walking ourselves through the patio to the dinning room we found multiple tables that would of accommodated our party. All in all our experience was unsatisfactory due to the lack of professional management.

When we walked in it took awhile for anyone to come over to greet and seat us and there was hardly anyone In the restaurant. The server was attentive and brought us coffee right away which helped. The huevos rancheros were delicious but the French toast was disappointing. It tasted like it had been sitting awhile and had not been freshly made.

Great location, great hotel, until you have to deal with staff. 
When you have been traveling in a car for so many hours and you check into your next hotel, a nice welcoming smile can really make a difference in your stay. 
The free breakfast is very popular, get there early. 
If you stay with a pet that needs to go outside, there are not any grass patches but there is a nice park a couple blocks away. 
There is Parking available BUT it's $30.00 A DAY. I think that is expensive

I love companion! this really is similar to the bread Co Panera outfits of the world. However, it is just a little bit better. The experience at companion is one that makes you feel like you are in a little French bistro, the ingredients are all top notch and the fresh bread is to die for. 

I highly recommend the fa la la la la sandwich, and any of the delicious soups or salads. Also if you love cornbread like I do, make sure you try a piece of theirs!

Went here today for the first time. I was curious how could they possibly make a sandwich that would be anything but ordinary. I found out after ordering the Cuban sandwich today. This sandwich was incredible all because of the bread. It wasn't thick and doughy, nor was it rip and tear material. It was more like the best thin crust pizza, both hot and crisp. It almost resembled a wrap, but it was definitely bread. Crisp thin bread! By far the best bread I've ever had on a sandwich. The cheese complimented it very well too. They also cut it diagonally so to begin eating one half you would have a pointed shape that was very appealing to start biting into. It was also very neat and held together very well. My only change I would make the next visit is to try the veggie sandwich on this awesome bread. For most meat lovers, the meat on this sandwich was generous. But for me with bread this good, I seemed to desire a little less meat, keep the cheese the same, and add more jalapeños, mushrooms, pickles, and mustard. The Cuban did have mustard and pickles, but just for me, not everybody, a bit too much meat. I still ate it all and left full. Next trip, I'm trying the veggie sandwich, because to me the bread is the most important reason for me to return. So I'm wanting what I believe will be the best compliment to the bread added inside that won't overstuff me. 

I also tried and loved the coffee here. A free shot came with the sandwich already sweetened of espresso. I also ordered a deluxe coffee drink cappuccino. It was made with a lot of love. I'll close by saying I very much loved the people serving me today. I'm a little partial to the mom and pop places and what a treat to be served by an authentic international eatery without having to go to any further than Broad Ripple.

I've now visited this location twice, once during a relatively sleepy midweek evening on the patio area, and once on a crowded Friday night. I felt like the Lakehouse was more relaxed and less sports bar the first time I visited, but the second time I got the exact same vibe as other Scotty's locations. Not to say that's bad, but it's not really a very different experience between locations as far as ambiance seems to go. The Lakehouse is situated near Geist. You know you're getting close when the houses begin to quadruple in size. The service was excellent. We only waited about a half hour on a Friday night for a table for two, which was more than acceptable to me. The Lakehouse's menu is different than any other Scotty's location, their main focus being different gourmet-ish burgers. All that I've tried have been pretty good. I had the #7 most recently, an Asian inspired burger, and it was one of the better burgers I've had, but it didn't slap me in the face with greatness. I think my favorite part are the fries that come to your table with three great dipping sauces including Sun King mustard. We got regular sized local beers, but another table got a table tap, which is a huge tube of beer with a tap that you can drink at your table, and that inspired me to return and drink more.

I have a sprained ankle and am unable to get a pedicure until it's healed so I went by to get a polish change. I know people are there to make money, but it should be about customer service and future business as well. I asked her to cut the nails and she did it so fast it was almost painful. Nails are crooked and toes stained with removal of old polish. I could've done a better job myself. Disappointed.

Great happy hour with live music that makes the place have some class. The appetizers are fantastic but the food is expensive and I am not sold on it's overall quality.  High priced, but not top notch.  There are equal if not better places to eat throughout Tampa.

The first restaurant I've ever been to with a sink in the dining room.  Apparently to wash your hands after a messy crab meal.  The bartenders are old-school Philadelphia.  Lots of characters and of course crab-fries.  One of the better sports bars in Philly.  I'm sure I'll be back.

Food was ok, overpriced for breakfast food. Coffee is ridiculous @ $2.99! Service was good and fast, but they need to add more options for breakfast and lower their prices. 

Patachou prices for greasy dinner food.

I've always hated the Phillies, and went down last Thursday to root for the Giants. Had such a good time. Very nice stadium and the staff there is tremendous. Very friendly, with good humor, and the Philly fans did not live up to their reputation of being horrible - they were actually a lot of fun! I had a really good time, and like the Phillies just a little more now! And the Giants won!! Let's see if I feel the same brotherly love when I go down to root for the Yankees! =D

Mother's Day brunch. Made reservations so all good.  Friendly greeting and they showed us right to our table.  Steak and eggs, pancakes, omelet.  All very very good.  The food here really is excellent.  Weekend Bloody Mary bar, smaller than others but still. Nice for the price and they have different mixes of spiciness.  Outstanding coffee , as always. 

The problem is the service.  Our server was Lauren who is absolutely in the wrong job for her skills. It I think this may be the height of her capabilities.  No silverware on the table.  She didn't notice and I had to get up and ask for it.  She had no intuitive abilities as to what should normally accompany food items.  Her demeanor and personality were also very flat. Almost a forced cordiality because she was being forced to serve us.  What would otherwise be a fantastic five star meal was made uncomfortable by her incompetence as a server.  I really wish Blondie's would pay attention to the job their servers are doing.  So much about this place I like.  But the service is literally there worst on Wash Ave. we may give them another try, just so many other options that we can walk to.

Eaten here a few times and came strictly for drinks yesterday. Bailey's and all their restaurants are great and so is the Range. 3.5 stars would be a truthful number. Mainly, I round down because of their service. My reasoning for the almighty stars would be as follows: 

4 - amazing food. quality ingredients with chefs who know how to experiment with flavors that go together better than you and your girlfriend (boyfriend). I have not heard anyone saying they do not like their burgers. They are small (errrr. Gourmet) in portion but big in flavor. Sauces are hit and miss, french fries are good to great, and everything I've eaten or tried off another plate was a big hit, except for the patty melt which is a bust. My stove does better than theirs for this regard. 

3.5 - price point again is the Achilles heel for all Bailey's places to me. I am from Chicago. When I want to pay Chicago prices I usually end up going to all the best places in Chicago. St. Louis has been rated one of the most cost effective cities to live in recently - NOT because of the Range, Chocolate Bar, Rooster, etc. 

3 - The service is average, at best. The staff is friendly? (not rude), slow, and I find it hard to remember a time when they have gone out of their way. It is as if they are not working for tips. 

Sure, the Bailey's restaurants are sleek, sexy, cool, and important to the city evolving...I love that. But please hire some people who are also sleek, sexy, cool, and important to the city evolving.
You need to come here.  Seriously.  The food is so unique. We had the Poke (tuna) and the vegetable nachos which were both excellent.

This place is always at the top of my list for taking out-of-town friends and its good for bigger groups, or just for two. It mixes all the charm of a neighborhood cave-esque hole-in-the-wall with an amazing and ever-changing beer list and delicious BBQ (with vegan BBQ options too!!). What more could you ask for?!?

I would recommend the pulled pork, and it's awesome on their nachos as well (but I am a total nacho lover already). Be careful with the little goblet beers because some of them have upwards of 10% ABV and the tipsy comes quickly! My only regret is that I have now dined here six times and haven't gotten the bacon grease popcorn yet... 

The service is also always fantastic. Last night, they messed up our order a bit, but then we just ended up getting to try another kind of BBQ in addition, so I don't have a single complaint. Other restaurants should take note (*cough* Prohibition *cough*) and just give patrons the extra food when they accidentally confuse orders... it makes for a much happier experience overall :)

I came here for my first meal in St. Louis and I was pleasantly surprised. A nice mix of indoor/outdoor seating with a healthy and large tapas menu that compares well to my favorite old places in SF. 

The drinks selection is great as well. Service was a bit slow, but I'll pass them for it being a Monday. Ambiance is nice, but more for friends or longer term couples than a first date.

Food: OUT OF THIS WORLD GOOD, Staff: PRETENTIOUS AND INATTENTIVE
I don't think my wife and I fit the demographic this place is going for. We are not thirty something hipsters who learned about the place from their thirty something hipster friends. And were certainly weren't one of the small crowd sitting at the bar being entertained by the staff. We were scorned when we asked about reserving a table, yet they thought they could work us in, and once we showed up for dinner we had a choice of 4 empty tables. The restaurant was never more than half full the two hours were were there. Once we were seated we were practically ignored and usually had to go to the bar or grab someone as they went by to get service. 

OK, the food. We ordered a salad and a pickled plate, both were great. Since it was the day before my wife's birthday and our last night visiting New Orleans, we went for the Wagyu beef tenderloin. I would have never imagined paying $67 for a 5 oz. piece of meat, but we did and shared it. We're from Iowa so we've had good beef. We never knew something this good existed. It was cooked perfectly and came with a choice of dipping sauces, we chose the horseradish sauce. It was truly unbelievable. Our dessert was good but not memorable. 

For an establishment where you can walk out the door with a $135 bill, the service should be good if not excellent. The waitress seemed remorseful and embarrassed when we shared our experience. Maybe this will spur her to strive for mediocrity which would be an improvement. We're going to look for other restaurants that serve Wagyu.

All stars for their ambiance and Samosa chaat. Very very good ambiance and decor and I am very proud of it. I was looking forward to great food as well but I was completely disappointed with their lunch buffet. The food was not at all upto the mark and the buffet containers were not being filled on time. I loved their samosa chaat though! I would give it a second chance and go there for ala carte one day.

I went in at 9:15 am for breakfast, didn't get my food until 10. and there were numerous employees but no one at the register. They have it set up so you order at the sandwich counter and then get back in line at a different counter to pay. Just seemed dumb.

Our local pizza parlor, was definitely good as usual! I guess we usually don't have late night dinners it was good to order from this place, we ordered and it arrived within half hour.  We ordered the meat lovers (assorted types of meats) delicious.  We ordered a thin crust and a regular crust, both were great.  Love that we have a great local pizza place!

Drinks were great . Service was not rushed but still good. New place they clearly are working hard to get things right. The food was very good . I had the pig( carved table side) it was excellent. Good value for a very upscale restaurant . I would recommend and I will return to try more of there drinks and food.

I went here with some friends and I would recommend this place for some great drinks. They have some unique cocktails and cordials. But I was disappointed in the food.  It was just bland and nothing exciting.  The service was pleasant but it didn't make the food any better. Come here if you're looking for a variety of booze but don't come hungry.

Loved the service at Creole House, and the food was tasty too! Great portion sizes for your money, and the coffee refills kept the Bloody Mary's booziness at bay  Couldn't help but love the Gouda grits and Cajun sauce on top of my omelette, but was disappointed that the minced garlic was heaped inside without much class. I did find what appeared to be the plastic film top to a squeeze bottle on my plate, which both the manager and waiter apologized profusely for... and deducted from my final bill. Wouldn't say the bathroom was the cleanest I'd ever been in -- tough to keep up with during Mardi Gras, I suppose. Overall I still enjoyed my visit, but will probably go elsewhere when I'm back in town next!

My favorite local nail salon.  Love the walk-in availability.  Quiet, relaxing, spa-like atmosphere.  You can talk to your technician or just close your eyes and chill out.  The pedicures can't be beat, with the leg massage, etc.. Also love the paraffin hand treatment.  Have always been happy with their services when leaving.  Have never found the staff rude, they have always been friendly and helpful to me.  I find their prices right on par with other salons.  They have discounts I think in the beginning of the week.  Again, the availability of being able to walk in without an appointment and get a mani or pedi is so terrific.

My boyfriend and I went in last night, on Memorial day. We didn't make a reservation, nor did we think we needed too, since it was a Monday night. We were excited , expecting to  have a nice meal. The hostess was very nice and offered us seating at the bar. 
The bartender however was not interested it us at all. He threw the menus at us, and mumbled the things he was " OUT" of. 
With that, the server behind us at another table was rattling off the specials in which the bartender said there weren't any. 
I ended up ordering the lobster beignets, and my BF had the Shrimp and cheddar grits. 
The bartender continued to be rude, the shrimp was cold, and by no means was the food worth 60 bucks. 
We won't be back. The bartender needs to get an attitude adjustment. Not worth the money or the lip service.  Another couple at the bar ordered a hamburger and fries, this is more the speed of the place , nothing fancy.
Potato skins are amazing. Service was great! Our waitress was efficient, and friendly. Definitely love how you can bowl! Will go back again!

I love this clinic!  They are friendly when you call in for appointments and I never have to wait a long time.  Dr. Haskell is wonderful. She's thorough and intuitive with my dog who has valley fever, and a very sensitive stomach.  When he first started having symptoms of refusing to eat/ GI upset Dr. Haskell helped keep the cost down while trying to determine what was going on.They are also great with simply maintaining his health with yearly blood draws, shots and gland expression appointments with the techs. There are Saturday appointments too, and I always get appointments when I need them.  So nice to have a caring, thinking Vet for my high-needs animal!

You are pleasantly surprised by this restaurant.  It looks like your average pub but it is so much more.  The menu is diverse with normal pub food like wings and burgers.  But they also have osso bucco and potato encrusted grouper.  I had the grouper and it was delicious.  Seared on the outside and moist and succulent on the inside.  My husband had the fish tacos.  They served 3 tacos with huge chunks of grilled mahi mahi.  He loved it. They have outdoor seating if you don't want to be part of the bar scene which is loud and noisy with lots of TVs going.  The outside overlooks a pond with a fountain.  Almost every night they have a $3.95 special.  That night it was meatloaf with mashed potatoes and gravy and a veggie.  My mom ordered it and she said it was killer delicious.  The only caveat is you have to order a drink with the special.  She had a decaf coffee so she was a cheap date that night.  But the prices on the menu are very reasonable and the amount of food is plentiful.  Last time we were there I had the house pasta with chicken.  It is done in a light cream sauce and is enough for at least two meals.  So good.

Tried the chicken and waffle and found it to be excellent.  First time in CPC.  Nice place, nice ambience, diverse group of people.  What is not to like?  Will visit again.  Better come early or expect the place to be packed to the rafters.

Great coffee shop, first of all.  Great neighborhood.. good vibes in there.. and they're dog friendly (at least on the patio) which is a plus for me.

Drip coffee is pretty good.
My favorite thing there is their hot tea -- they have a huge selection of loose leaf tea.. and you might as well get the tea pot if you're going to be there for any longer than 30 minutes. and it's only a couple of bucks! 

Try their cookies.. amazing. My fav of course being their peanut butter. and I keep eyeing their other pastries.. one of these days I'll get around to trying them.  They've also got vegan food if you're into that..

cash only. atm in the back. clean bathrooms. overall dope place to study!
As a Newyorker I'd have to say some of the best pizza I ever have- Deffintly top 5. Be prepared to wait, as it's made fresh.

This location of HMV at West Edmonton Mall is a megastore of music and video. Two floors are filled solid with CDs and DVDs - by far the best selection of any of the major chains in the city. The prices are also fantastic. In many cases you can mix and match two or three CDs or DVDs for a set price, like $20, $25, or $30. I come here mostly because the sections for folk, World Music, and Francophone are far larger than anywhere else I have been. There are placeholders for artists that you cant find anywhere else, save for maybe a specialty store. Whenever I come here, I really have to exercise self-control.

Okay so pizza is def in my top 3 fav foods so as you can imagine I've tried my share of pizza places. This is place is amazing pizza. As a newly former vegetarian I opted for Alfredo's special and Wow was it good. So good. I highly recommend this place. Great prices also. I'm new to the area so I'm so happy to have found such a gem.

Came here in the middle of the week just to have a drink at the bar - we ended up staying way longer and for dinner as well. Everything was excellent! Our Server, Roger was so attentive and incredibly sweet. We weren't there to celebrate any birthdays but since I had a recent one, we turned the night into a birthday dinner and Roger made everything feel so special! The hostesses were lovely too - i wish i could recall the one girls name. When we wanted to move tables everyone was eager to help and not at all bothered. It really was a great experience - the food and cocktails were also amazing. Great Tuna Tartar and filet!

For the price, which is like 5 bucks, you get a lot to eat and it's decent. It seems to be coming out fresh pretty often and there are some good selections at the buffet. The atmosphere is a little creepy. Go for lunch if you want to pig out and pay almost nothing.

Great place. Clean and well taken care of. So many washers and dryers. Used the large washer @$4.50 a wash but loaded it with a lot. Dryers are .25/10min. Not bad considering most of mine was hung to dry. Great stop on our road trip. Chairs, tables and outlets to charge cell while you wait. Vending machines as well. Have to purchase a prepaided card for $1 which sucks because we are leaving town but easier to reload than using quarters.

Not going to lie, I was a Frugal McDougal girl before I found Midtown but not I must profess my true love for Midtown! The store is clean, everyone is extremely helpful, they carry mini bottles and fifths which rocks because somedays you only need a little not a lot!

My family and I considered going deep sea fishing as we had in the past on vacation at myrtle beach, but the cost was $15 more per person here and $7 more to rent rod and reel which was included on our myrtle beach trip. This was not stated in the brochure. So instead we decided to go on a dolphin cruise which we enjoyed and did get several close up pictures with dolphins.

Severs and bartender running around like crazy and can't get caught up. One bartender making all the drinks for the restaurant and has the entire bar section to wait on. Everyone at the bar told the manager she needs to have more help because it's not fair to the staff or the clients. For an area of town that is trying to recover and rebrand I suggest the restaurant get in step or get out.

The food was very food, but the service was paaaainfully slow. We sat there for what must've been 20 minutes before ordering our drinks. The drinks were delivered by someone other than our server. We didn't place our dinner order until I was almost done with my glass of wine. Food came out promptly and was delivered by someone other than our server. This was at 6:30 on a Tuesday and not during Mardi Gras or anything like that. 

My husband and I both had filet mignon with spinach and potatoes. The spinach was surprisingly delicious. Potatoes could've used a little something. Steaks were cooked perfectly. You could cut it with a butter knife. So yum. 

Good experience overall, but I'm glad I wasn't super hungry when we got there!

This place has really gone downhill in recent years.   I have great memories...but alas, that's all I have left, it seems.  The last few times I noticed it was pretty gnarly looking in the kitchen and the bathroom, but this last time was such a gruesome experience that I felt called to action. My cobb sallad was nasty and the silverware was caked with grime. And the service was slow.  I don't like chain restaurants and try to avoid them, but I must say I really prefer Bertuccis to this place.

We went a little later (8:15) on a Saturday night and the place was very busy but we were seated right away.   The waiter was attentive and the atmosphere was very nice.  The food was excellent and surprisingly inexpensive compared to a few other places around.   They have a bakery next door and the variety and quality of desserts was superb.
