My brother got a Philly chicken cheese steak and a side of fire grilled vegetables, both of which he's had before and no complaints there. My Dad ordered an American meal- Chicken breast with a side of mashed potatoes and broccoli and also a caesar side salad. He liked his meal. My mom and I both ordered the eggplant parmasean dish with a side of spaghetti.. the noodles were slightly overcooked and the marinara sauce was very bland. I tried doctoring it up by adding grated table cheese, it helped a little.. but no basil or any other spices or flavoring.. disappointed in that. The actual eggplant.. where was it? It was heavily breaded and the eggplant was so thin I practically had to get a magnifying glass out to see it. Also it was fried, and covered it cheese- the cheese was probably the best part. It was so heavy from being fried and breaded. One thing I did enjoy though was I got the butternut, nutmeg, pumpkin soup for an extra $2. The soup was hearty, filling and sweet.

If you've never visited Ron's, i'd recommend sticking to the Ovals- pizza, which is what they're known for. I enjoyed the soup too, so check that out. Prices range from $8-17 for lunch and dinners. They also have a bar which stays pretty packed. We went tonight for dinner around 6 and the bar was already full by then and the dining rooms were filling up fast.

First, let me say this place is a 3 1/2. 

Second, this place is a step up from the bars I've been to. They make their own potato chips, which are a bit too peppery, but great nonetheless. Their burgers are really good, and they aren't stacked so high you have to unhinge your jaw to eat them.

Their beer selection is very nice, and their bartender is pretty good. When you ask what he has on tap, he asks what you like and can then give you a couple selections that fit that profile.

The first few times I went, there was only one guy who was waiting tables in the entire place and tending bar, but still managed to do things fairly well. Usually when you're doing a lot of stuff like that, something suffers, and not just your frayed nerves. The last time I went, last week, there were a waitress and the bartender, and while the waitress seemed new, was very friendly and sweet, so she made up for the extra wait.

When the battery on my wife's car died, and I was out of town on business, I had to scramble to help her get back on the road.  I reasoned that it was better to try local than to pay to tow it to the dealership.  I reached out to the closest place I could find.  Ed Ebert's Automotive is a half mile from our home.

Mike was kind enough to stop by, get the car started, and take the car back to his shop to replace the battery.   When my wife and daughter walked down to pick it up an hour later, my wife reported how polite and helpful Mike and Arlene were and my four year old got a lollipop.

We are appreciative for their service, and relieved to have a trustworthy auto mechanic located so close to home.  

Thank you,
Colin

Went in to get my effed up haircut fixed. I sat down in Jen's chair,she was very nice and personable.  She already knew what she had to do, but she asked me anyway.  She fixed my fade and cleaned up my neck with a straight razor.  How much was the bill you ask? $2.00!!! That's right, no jive.  Tipped $8.00 just for the service.  Excellent, will return.

I am new to St. Louis and with my daughter, made our maiden voyage into The Fountain tonight - Amazing atmosphere, where we were welcomed right away, and over indulged in a dessert appropriately named "Dark and Sinister". I have eaten all over the world and I am ecstatic that this establishment is so close to my new home.  - I can't wait to enjoy all that The Fountain menu has to offer. Can't wait to go back. - I am going to need a better workout routine.

Great beverages. I'm a new fan of the mamacita caliente cocktail, medium spice. So delicious. The space is clean and modern. Haven't had a chance to visit during the mead & knead event or yoga yet, but I love the idea. The staff is friendly and able to answer questions and make recommendations. I also tried the breakfast magpie - cider & coffee? Interesting!

Where to start??!!
Everything about this restaurant is Wonderful!! From the intimate seating to the AMAZING food and staff!! The only thing anyone could possibly complain about is the noise level but if your family is Italian that shouldn't bother you at all. Hahaha

The owner in the restaurant is also the chef and makes sure that the quality of the good, the atmosphere in the restaurant and the service are all perfect.
He personally came, shook our hands and thanked us for coming back a second night in a row and offered us a special dessert.
We live over an hour away (on a good day) and we've made it a point to travel to Collingswood JUST for THIS restaurant again and again.
If you're like us and want GREAT food in an relaxing atmosphere where the staff treat you like friends then this is the perfect place to go!

Oh and try the Gnocchi alla argentiera and the Biancomangiare they're amazing!!!

We sat on the patio on a Saturday night, and despite the noise of the train passing by, it was a fairly quiet atmosphere. Cocktails were good but everything took a little while to arrive.

I ordered a pork chop that was awesome-- I highly recommend it! Huge portion and really delicious. 

Overall, Maynard's was good, but not super memorable. It would be a great pick for a more traditional crowd where there's something for everyone.

I had a friend tell me to check out this out while on a trip to New Orleans. It did not disappoint! The line is long and the space is intimate so get there early. If you are want to get a flavor of the city's musical history then Preservation Hall is the place to go!

Recently, over the Christmas vacation, I spent 6 nights at the Peppermill Hotel and Casino. The place was recommended to me by a good friend who stays here often, and I was really looking forward to my visit. Some things about this hotel were really great, while other things were not so great. My daughter commented that the place reminded her more of Las Vegas than Reno because of the fancy decor and ambiance.  

We loved the room. It was spacious and clean. A bell boy helped me up to the room, and he was super friendly and helpful. The only refrigerator provided was full of snacks and drinks offered by the hotel for a steep price, so the young man offered to arrange a small empty refrigerator for me. Unfortunately, it never showed up, but I understand that the hotel was very full due to the holidays. Maids are on duty into the late afternoon, and ours spoke good English and was very nice and accommodating. 

Room service arrived quickly. I won't say that all the food was wonderful. For breakfast, don't order the scrambled eggs; they were tasteless. I am not sure they were really eggs. The fried potatoes were not seasoned, and the toast was barely toasted. Bacon was wonderful. The buffalo chicken wing platter was good as well. Portions are huge. A side dinner salad could have served at least 3 people. 

We tried several  Peppermill restaurants. Bimini's Steakhouse has great food and very nice service. Perhaps my appetite is not what is normal for most people. We ate here twice: Christmas Eve supper and a birthday dinner later in the week. Both times, we left with several boxes. I will post additional comments about my experience at Bimini's under the restaurant's page. Biscotti's was more informal and equally good. I wish it had not closed so early, because we were hungry after seeing a show downtown. The deli in the sports book area serves a great pastrami sandwich that is large enough to share. The only bad dining experience we had was at the 24 hour Cafe Milano where none of the food we ordered was good. My order of fried chicken consisted of a leg and a back, and the gravy on the potatoes had lots of bacon bits in it which made it taste odd. The biscuit was too sweet and slightly stale. My daughter's chicken cashew stir fry was also not tasty. The Chai at the coffee stands has a very strange flavor. Pastries there are huge, over seasoned and over filled. Cocktails are not especially well mixed in any bar, so I suggest sticking to beer or wine. I tried a bloody Mary and a lemon drop martini with kind of bad results, especially considering the price. 

My girlfriend came up to Reno the day after Christmas to celebrate her birthday, and she shared my room with me for the last half of my stay. She enjoyed the heated pools, hot tub and steam room very much and reported no issues or problems with her experience. 

Wifi is free and efficient throughout the hotel, but bring your own iPhone, laptop or tablet. It was impossible to access the free computers provided in the very out of the way "internet cafe." 

Our stay was pleasant except for 3 problems. On the first night, my adult daughter took a shower, and she slipped and fell down in the tub. She was not injured, but the tubs are so slippery. Be careful! We were subsequently able to obtain a rubber mat from the housekeeping, and we had no further problems. On our second day, we each got stuck in the same elevator on separate trips. It would rise to our 17th floor, but it would not open; then it would rapidly drop to some other floor, scaring us senseless. After my complaint, the hotel gave me a $25 credit on my room service bill. By the last day of our stay, this elevator was still not fixed. Finally, on our last night, a Saturday, a large party raged outside our room from about 1 AM until about 4 AM when my friend poked her head out the door and screamed at the participants. Security was at that party but was unable to control the noise. It is because of these problems that this hotel gets only 3 stars from me. The stay was, as I mentioned previously, a very mixed experience.

This is a pre-review review based solely on the reviews I have read.  I am very impressed whenever a restaurant takes the time to respond to reviews.  It shows me they are dedicated to service.  No restaurant is perfect all the time, and not every employee is diligent.  But, the Governor's management's responses are direct and to the point.  I will certainly be stopping here my next trip to NOLA (in 5 looooooong weeks).

Fantastic snowballs with custom flavors that you'll be comparing to any snowball you get anywhere else! The only reason they're missing a star is because the hours have changed. Hours are Wednesday-Sunday from 2:00 to 8:00pm. These hours were not decided upon with the customer in mind, but hey, who's getting a snowball before 12 anyway?
This hotel is decent for a business trip or short stay in Philly, but I wouldn't stay here for a vacation. The hotel is also fairly close to the subway.

After nearly a year of walking by this place, but never quite being hungry enough to eat here, I finally gave it a try last night.

My parents are from Chicago originally, and often complain about the lack of "Chicago-style" food here in Tampa. To those who aren't familiar with Chicago-style food, it basically consists of hearty servings of  (usually) boiled meat piled on top of bread. And lots of fried stuff. Basically, it's heaven.

The restaurant is endearing and reminds me a lot of the small hot dog stands that can be found in my parents hometown. You order at the window, take a seat on the patio, and your order is brought out to you. At each table there are rolls of paper towels, and you will soon realize why it's necessary to have endless napkins at your disposal.

We split a basket combo, and I realize you might be wondering "Why did you SPLIT a combo? What are you, an old married couple on a budget??". But consider this: We ordered a foot-long Chicago Dog (which is boiled, topped with onions, relish, pickles, peppers, and cucumbers) a soda, and a HUGE basket of either fries or tater tots. The hot dog was AWESOME. It's been years since I've had a legit Chicago dog and this did not disappoint. The mustard was dripping down my fingers and chin, the hot dog was flavorful, and the peppers on it were awesome. The plentiful tater tots were both hot and crispy, and by the time we were done, I was pleasantly full.

The menu here holds a bunch of undiscovered treasures and I can't wait to be back to try the Italian Beefs. 

They're open till midnight on Thursdays, and 3am on both Friday and Saturday, which is something I'm happy to have discovered. Finally, an alternative to late-night pizza!

Delicious!!! Well priced. Friendly staff. My husband got the buffet and I got the chicken kabobs and garlic Naan. Naan was the best I've ever had. My husband tried goat meat on the buffet. Great curry.

We got there, the place was nice, nice environment, but had a little bit of a diner feel to it (because of the layout).. but then the sign that signals good food... Local Police. Once we saw local police were eating there, it was a sign that this was a good establishment.

Foot was cooked perfectly. Everything was delicious and it was reasonably priced, especially considering we were in the city center. 

Great selection for everyone.

If you like "fast" food you'll love this place... 

The food and drinks (we did the pairing menu) were great, with the exception of the pork which was extremely salty. I would have offered four stars for that. Instead I'm giving Sbraga a grudging 2 stars, because the the overall service was so rushed it basically ruined the meal.

Plates and wines were delivered and snatched away within moments of one another, and we spent the meal with one of the servers watching us eat, and checking her watch. No joke. At one point a server asked mid bite how I was doing and peered over to see if my plate could be removed.  If they could have dispatched us in 30 minutes they would have. Instead we held on for a bitter hour.

By dessert we had become so uncomfortable being "timed" that we simply offered up to our server that we could move so they could seat a larger group (obviously part of their goal in shooing us along).  Why one of the clock-watching staff could not have taken the initiative and politely suggested this, perhaps seating us at the counter with a complimentary drink for the hassle, I'm not sure. We are reasonable people and understand that Friday is an important night for the restaurant business, if someone had politely asked we would have been more than understanding. Instead we left feeling like we'd had our pockets picked.

Overall a very disappointing experience which truly could have been avoided while still accomplishing the restaurants goal.

Worst place ever. Too expensive. Save your money and go down the road. When terminating our lease, I told the leasing agent why We hated it here and her exact words were."you didnt have to live here" 
What the hell? I do like being by the water. But that's pretty much it. Walls are super thin and you literally hear EVERYTHING!
You pay 35$ for trash removal and they have missed my trash several times. They mow the lawn around 8am on certain days instead of later in the day. So if you have a late schedule, good luck getting any sleep. People have sex in the pool and dump trash and dog shit wherever they please. I hate it here and I'm glad I'm leaving. If you do decide that my review isn't enough and you still want to give shitty Camden Bay a try, then stay in building 10 apartment 102. You will be wishing you took my advice. All I have to say is paper thin walls!!!! 
The pool and work out area is nice.

Arrived early on a Saturday morning, about 20 minutes before they open and there was already a line of about 10 people ahead of me.  I recently moved from out of state and needed to change to a PA license.  I was one of the first people called and was in and out painlessly within 30 - 45 minutes.  They do not take credit cards, though! Thank goodness I had my checkbook.

I recently had a tattoo completed at Crimson Empire.  

Right from the start, it was a great experience.  Booking my consultation online was a breeze & I was able to send through photos of my (then) current tattoo and inspirational photos of what I was looking for.  Communication was concise, quick and friendly.

Jess Doyle completed my tattoo and she was absolutely lovely!  Everything was excellent, right from the initial consultation to my first (lining) appointment and then my second (shading) appointment. I couldn't be happier with the unique piece she created for me and I've already received so many compliments... and it's still healing!

All aspects of this project was easy.  Everything was explained to me from booking to my final payment.  I felt comfortable the whole way through and I would absolutely go back to Crimson. 

The building was modern, fun and clean!  As other reviewers have mentioned, it is located at the far end of a strip mall on 119 St, almost an immediate right into a parking lot after turning off south on 118 Ave.  Also, if I recall correctly, accepted payment methods are cash or credit (no debit).
Love this place - so cozy, food is FRESH, and the owners are so sweet. Great local spot!

I really enjoyed my 3-day stay at this hotel. Parking is in a garage (not the open air lot) across the street from the front door, and it is a special of $12 per 24 hours, just have your ticket validated at the hotel desk.  Our room was clean, and we received complimentary bottled water every day. The bathroom was nicely updated, though we did not receive towels one day, which was not a big deal to ask the front desk for on the way up. The room was "cozy", but you had everything you needed, including a refrigerator/freezer, microwave and safe (*NOTE* they will charge you $2 a day for the safe, but won't tell you the code unless you ask for it...you agree to pay this "tax" when you sign the paperwork at check in). The other reviewers are correct, and there is no individual thermostat in the room. We did get too warm the first two nights, but the windows open, so that did help. Despite these things, I am giving four stars because of the LOCATION, which is fantastic. We walked everywhere, and it was a real treat to not have to drive back to the hotel at the end of the day or worry about where to park each morning. For the price we paid, this was a great deal, and I will stay here again if I am in the area.

11 different protein options. Each are 3oz. Unlike other places that squash their patties flat and removes most of the juices, these are thicker and juicer with more flavor, they are just smaller in diameter. These are truly mini burgers with many fresh toppings. Sliders are typically 1oz or less. The sweet potato fries are awsome.

If this was more of a restaurant I would give it four stars but it's really more of a cafeteria.  You get food by the weight and they really only have a couple things to choose from.  Food wasn't bad at all but I think they really could've done more with it and have a better selection of different Indian cuisine.  On the plus side it's really cheap I think my food was like four or five dollars for the plate so its worth it to check it out if in the neighborhood.

This was a great meal! So worth the money!! Had the Hey Lucy omelette and it was just so good! Plenty to fill you up for a long day on the beach. My daughter wanted a salad that came with salmon on it and she's a vegetarian so she asked it without and they did it and then adjusted the price which was really awesome!! Fun drinks and great services! I would recommend this place to all.

What really sold me to get a membership here was their unlimited personal training. In most gyms, personal training is a separate price & can be very costly at times, but at Planet Fitness, it's already included in your membership! Though, the gym may be slightly small, it has everything you need to start your fitness journey. The staff are very friendly and welcoming whenever I walk in the door. All the machines and restrooms are super clean, it doesn't smell like sweat or feet when you walk in. Lol. 
Jake, their personal trainer, is awesome! He definitely pushes you to your true potential & believes in you every step of the way. Though, some workouts are challenging & will probably leave you sore the next day, he gets you through it.

If you hop into a cab and get Jerome as your driver, get the hell out!

He's a slowpoke, doesn't turn on the air, and claims not to have any change.

Yeah, I called Harris, but what are they going to do?  Nothing.

And of course, on the return portion of our trip, we had a great driver.  But it doesn't make up for getting scammed by non-St. Jerome.

PLENTY of seating, dinner on a Thursday night was quite interesting. Very awkward music (club/house/electro) for a sports bar. Aside from that the "ultimate tailgate" (crab cake on burger) was alright. I was thoroughly impressed by the crab-fries, specifically the dipping sauce that came with it (def made the meal) 

Very formidable beer selection, I was not disappointed. All in all, it was ok food at an ok venue. The food seems trumped by the over-the-top atmosphere.

DO NOT BUY THEIR GROUPON, LIVING SOCIAL, ETC DEALS!! I bought the Groupon for their gel manicure & pedicure back in January 2013. They say you have to use their online booking system to make an appointment. Well I've checked there system almost every week or two since then and have never been able to get an appointment. A handful of times there would be only 1 available and it would be in the middle of a work day so I wasn't able to book it. There was never anything after 5 or on the weekends. Initially I called to talk to someone about it. Of course no one answered so I left a message, which was never returned. Then I tried email. I did get a response, but it was pretty rude telling me they couldn't do anything about it and I needed to just keep trying the online system. After months of still no luck with that I tried emailing again (since in the email they said they are just too busy to answer calls). This time they did not even bother to respond back. I contacted Groupon and had my money refunded because this place is obviously a big mess- if they were really as busy as they claim, why would they need to offer Groupon and other similar deals? They have no customer service skills. I wish I could rate their service but unfortunately I was never given the opportunity to experience that.

Excellent lunch special and cheap bloody marys! Staff was very friendly and professional. I wish we could've sat on the balcony but it was a no go (maybe they don't do it at lunch time?). I highly recommend the 3 course prix fixe for lunch, potato leek soup was a real stand-out!
Greatest bagel I've had since last year when I went to NY! Lots of locals, very busy plan on standing in line especially on the weekends but totally worth it!

It's ugly, it seems dirty,  it's freezing  , it's unfriendly -- as if can't wait for you just pay and get out. The food is poor to middling.. and it's not a bargain ... so it's not as if you are saving   by having to pay cash.  I had to eat in my coat.

I am obsessed with Mediterranean food so I'm a bit of a snob when it comes to Mediterranean restaurants. This place was AMAZING! The pesto sauce and tzatziki sauce that covers their gyro plate (I got the lamb) is phenomenal. And the hummus was DELICIOUS! I only wish I lived closer (live in Huntsville, AL) so I could eat here all of the time. We shared a gyro plate and were able to get half potatoes and half rice. I really cannot say enough about this place. I will be eating here upon every visit to Nashville.

Not one thing on this menu could get a bad review.  The atmosphere is great inside an old car dealership.  The murals are beautiful and the woodwork in the bar is beautiful.  This is a good daytime family atmosphere and adult evening atmosphere.  They have a selection for all foodies around-meat, vegans, organic, gluten free, etc... But of course, everyone comes for the homemade icecream and adult martinis.  We always bring our friends to Fountains when they want something fun, but not a bar atmosphere.  Everyone enjoys, we've loved everything we've had here and the prices are on point for the food.  We will continue to return!

Went last night before his company Christmas jamboree and the food and service were wonderful!

This place was moderately busy on a Friday night, we were way overdressed because we had to do his party afterwards. The hostess was quick to greet us and super friendly.

We were led to a booth and our server was Katie, who was on the ball and incredibly charming. I ordered the scallops, subbed out mashed potatoes for the rice and my food was perfect. The scallops were perfectly cooked and succulent. The mash was tasty and even the vegetables were fantastic. The two drinks I had were really tasty and strong too, the bartender is on it! 

My date had the steak which comes with a killer marinade and was perfectly cooked and juicy. I was delighted with my scallops but the steak was so good! I wish they would do a surf and turf! 

Finished with cheesecake that was dense and creamy and it ended the night perfectly. 

Bathrooms were cute and clean with kitschy beach signs in the stalls. The crowd was upbeat and the staff were all smiles and laughter. 

Wonderful. We can't wait to go again!

I have recently had to spend more time in Tucson so I have had the chance to eat at a lot of places in town...with that being said, Charro is easily the best restaurant I've had in Tucson. 

We started with the chips and salsa which were great, both the red and green sauces were delicious. The chips were warm. We then had the table-side guac which was fantastic and a must order. 

I ordered the carne asada which was the best I've had. Perfectly cooked and came with sautéed veggies and melted cheese on top. We ordered the creamed corn (amazing), fries, cheesy potatoes (can't remember what they called it), and had some charro beans for our sides. All were wonderful but the creamed corn shined and is a must have!

The dessert was okay, but I'm not a big dessert person so that was fine with me. We ordered all four offered and the best was the flan!

TRY THIS PLACE! I will be back soon!

Got this in Terminal E- best airport food out there.  Not even a hint of food poisoning!  I asked, and it wa a possible to substitute salmon for kani.  Wonderful rolls with wonderful service.  Not world class.  Definitely airport world class!
One of the best middle eastern fast food chains I've been to. Love their Pita, falafel, fries and all the sides.

Although the breakfast food was decent and our server,Angela, was upbeat and attentive, our experience at the Aston Diner was merely subpar. As soon as we walked in, the atmosphere was noticeably cheery and welcoming. However as we sat at our booth waiting for food, the noise level became offputting. We had to practically yell across the table to have a conversation. Price wise it was too expensive considering the price to portion ratio. I got the number 6 breakfast special and was disappointed by the lack of food. I finished my plate in less than ten minutes and was  still hungry. I don't know if we will come back again, I think we can find a cheaper place to eat with greater food portions. Also, space was definitely an issue; there was barely enough room for the waitress to carry her serving tray. Overall the establishment was clean, organized, friendly, and well run.

I stayed here for a trade show at the convention center across the street. 

Great hotel for a business trip. In room internet was plenty fast, the hallways quiet at night. Fast and tasty room service. FedEx store on the second floor. Terrific views in either direction. They have low floor and high floor express elevators so you don't have to wait long for an elevator. There's a bar right by the elevator so you can grab a drink to take to your room after a long day on the show floor. 

You can use the skywalk to get to the convention center so no jacket required in the winter. If you know your way you can get all the way over to the mall from the JW  without going outside. 

All in all a very nice place to stay, one of the nicest hotels I've stayed in while in Indianapolis over the last 17 years.
Ordered the veggie pho for takeout... The amount of veggies is nice and a lot more than you get with veggie pho from other places, but the broth is very fishy smelling and tasting.

The service is fine and the place is clean enough, but none of that matters because the two most important factors are missing: good price and good taste!

I'm used to Wetzels Pretzels which I already thought was expensive at $3.49 +tax  a pretzel. However Wetzle's tastes amazing so I give it a pass. 

But this place takes the cake in terrible costing and tasting pretzels! I think I HAVE paid less for a pretzel at Disneyland! And probably have had dog food that was richer in taste. (Why am I eating dog food? None of your business! Maybe I just like to know what it tastes like so I can write accurate reviews about poor taste, ok?) 

Ok so I bought this pretzel anyway because I had a BOGO coupon, but it so wasn't worth it. Even if the pretzel had been $1 I wouldn't return! This pretzel was stale, stiff and overly chewy like a steak that was a crappy piece of meat to begin with and then got over-cooked. It tastes like they made it no sooner than yesterday and it was thin, yet not that crispy. 

Absolutely hated this pretzel and I can't believe I was suckered into such a travesty by a stupid coupon from Tmobile! That's right Tmobile, I'm bringing you into this too- please don't ever pair up with this place again!

We were in the mood for some Malaysian food and stumbled upon Penang! We ordered the beef rendang and mango chicken. They were meh. Just ok. Nothing special. The beef rendang was so chewy and dry and the mango chicken  looks pretty on plate but it was way too saucy and oily! We couldn't finish it for that reason because we didn't want to end up reaching for bottles of water afterwards. Also  there were def more mango slices than chicken. Was totally not worth the $$ and def suggest to not order this!

I'd give it 0 stars if I could. PetSmart is the worst. FLEAS! An employee told a customer that her dog had fleas and then proceeded to play with the dog. The dog spent a very long time in the store & was not asked to leave. I finally left to escape the fleas. Second, PetSmart sells defective products... And then won't take them back. Avoid Petsmart and this location.

Amazing fried chicken. Call ahead when possible, and take it with you. Sides are delicious, biscuits are good, and the desserts are great as well. I do a Walt's lunch for my homeroom every year to celebrate the end of the year and it is a huge fave for the students - they LOVE it. Great staff as well. You can't get better fried chicken then this in Delaware or PA, that's for sure.

First time visiting! I loved everything. The food is amazing and the service is genuine. The owner/chef Liem is so personable, checked on our table to make sure everything was awesome. Mist try the Long Island Thai tea and the spicy lemongrass Pho. The best fixer up on soup weather day!

I'm by no means a self proclaimed gyro expert, but this absolutely blew me away.  I had the Chicken Kabob Gyro Pita and wow, it was amazing.

Admittedly I would have written a pretty good review either way because, like just about every other review on here, the experience of being inside the shop was an enjoyment in and of itself.  I had read the reviews and had expected great, friendly customer service but I definitely wasn't prepared for just how nice and friendly.  And not in one of those fake- let me ask you a million times if you need anything- kind of ways.  Just genuinely happy and kind.  Even gave me a free sample of a smoothie! 

But the gyro itself is what made me write a great review and not just "pretty good". The chicken was so tender and flavorful and all the toppings joined together in the perfect compliment to the meat.  I am a huge believer of ordering something "the way it was intended" at least the first time I get something.  This came with tzatziki sauce, hummus, red onion, pickle, tomato and romaine.  Typically I may balk a little at the red onion but it had none of the bitter bite I usually find.  The romaine was unbelievably green, crisp and fresh.  The pickle was the perfect companion to the hummus and tzatziki, just the right amount of tang. 

As a warning, they haven't gotten in their credit card machine yet (but they say it should be in any day)... I of course had no cash but they were extremely accommodating with that as well.   I rarely give 5 stars, but Smiley's definitely earned it! Will be going back a lot, so glad I live in the neighborhood!
Great service and the entries are AMAZING. The honey lamb and spicy chicken make me feel like a small child on Christmas
When the kitchen is on, out comes perfect grilled octopus on a bed of the freshest arugula salad and tender medallions of  veal almost like filet mignon. Too bad the service can be sooooo slow.
Huge sandwiches very filling and taste pretty darn good definitely a hole in the wall but great food only downer for me was way too much lettuce not enough meats or cheese.

What can I say about Cake Bake? It never fails to please! With a friendly and accommodating staff,  exquisite decorations in the dining areas and most importantly cakes and other sweet treats made fresh daily with the finest ingredients imported from around the world,  your senses will be ignited with what can only be described as a euphoric experience. 
 From the time you walk up the stamped concrete sidewalk and hear the almost fairytale like music as you open the white French doors, you feel as if you have transcended to an ethereal French bakery. 
I could write a book about Cake Bake and everything great about it, but in the interested of both your and my time I will leave you with this: if you want to momentarily escape the humdrum of everyday life, if you love to experience beauty, if you ever have craved a sweet thing in your life, the Cake Bake Shop needs to be on your list of places to visit.

Great fast service Asian food in Oldsmar, just a quick trip from most of West Tampa, Westchase, etc.  I would relate it fairly close to a Pei Wei type restaurant as the closest comparison.

Highlights - the Tim Drum Curry is amazing.  It has been hard to order anything else since I tried this one (check out the picture I added to Yelp as well).  Basically tempera chicken, spinach and roasted peanut sauce over rice.  Another great thing is the Thai tea with unlimited refills.  I love Thai tea and I have never seen unlimited Thai tea anywhere.

They have a frequent member card which tracks from your phone number so it is super easy compared to other places where you can lose or forget your loyalty cards.

The food is delicious. The steak was cooked perfectly and seasoned just right. My wife and I came here for breakfast in our 1 year anniversary and couldn't have enjoyed ourselves more. we arrived around 1020 and waited about 45 minute, but I promise the wait was well worth it. The service was very kind and courteous. Everything about our experience was top notch. Get here early and often!

I would highly recommend, especially for trickier alterations. I had two skirts that needed to be taken out because they were too small. I first tried a more barebones alterations shop, who claimed there was no possible way to do this because there was not enough extra fabric. Luckily I then took them to Stitch-It where they assured me it was possible, identified a solution, & now having picked up the altered versions, the results look & fit great and you can't tell they were altered unless you knew to look for it. Turnaround was quick as well. Not super cheap, but worth it for the quality.

My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our visit and both of us decided that this was the best total restaurant experience we have had (and we are not spring chickens)- service and food were superb! Sterling was a fabulous waiter and the staff worked together smoothly. The food was perfectly cooked - the eggplant was outstanding and I don't usually care for eggplant. The whiskey cake was the perfect finish. We will definitely be back!

This is a favorite in terms of bars. I've gone several mondays for monday night football. They have some of the best wings in town. Always a good selection of beers. I love the tenderloin sandwich ($10) and very filling, definitely one of the best in town. The prices are good. Bartender and servers are very friendly.

Open late as well.

This place was a great place to take the family to eat! Not only was the food excellent the atmosphere and outside dining was spectacular!!! This is a must! Pizza is true Italian thin crust! Oh I love this pizza!!!!!!!! Thanks again for the excellent food and service!
My experience was a good one!!! My server was very attentive, the food was great and on time. I would definately come back and recommend a friend or two to visit as well!!!

The speed of a fast food restaurant, and you'll pay half the price for a meal worth twice as much, you can really taste the quality and craftsmanship of this cultural cuisine! Also the food was served to us while we sat on their outdoor patio. Here on vacation from Maryland, wish we had one!

Stayed at The Peppermill this weekend for a wedding. Typical casino cheesy so know that going in. The rooms were very nice and clean. Rooms were pretty expensive but it was worth it for us to stay in the same venue as the wedding. The Peppermill has a fantastic gym with real gym equipment, weights, etc. I was able to get in a few good workouts which was very nice. Pools were nice as well and not super busy during the day. Didn't eat at any of the venues so I can't speak to the food choices. Lots of bars that are easily accessible. Parking is free in structure which is standard for casinos in Nevada. Smoking is allowed which is also standard and gross. I wish they would ban it statewide but alas, not the case.

This is a great place to host a children's party! The staff and owner are friendly and they take the stress out of hosting a party. I was free to enjoy my childs party while the staff set up, distributed pizza, cut the cake, handed out the cake, and cleaned up. The facility is clean and well maintained. We will host another party at this great facility.

I really don't know where to start. You will be greeted in a warm Hawaiian way! Suffice to say, it can be very tasty and fun to eat healthy! Breakfast choices include Oatmeal Pancakes, (try the Organic Macadamia Nut Sauce as a change from Maple Syrup), the Loco Moco (a bowl with your choice of Basmati brown rice or Jasmine white rice with a lean free range buffalo patty, an organic egg over easy,  grilled onions and smothered with brown gluten free gravy!), the turkey omelette is great, and the Haole breakfast will satisfy any guest who is not in the mood to be adventurous. But I suggest you explore. The menu is healthy comfort food with smoothies to match. I go every Sunday as it is only 5 minutes from where I live. I know, it's rough. Did I mention Hula and Drum shows on the weekends? BUT, if you are in the area, you must try Ohana!  Teresa is such a gracious owner/host and "Mom" is so delightful that you will keep wanting to come back for the warm fuzzies! A-LO-ha!

For a new place, you can tell the staff are learning, bit very courteous and friendly. The food, of which I had the Cuban, and shared the Mofungo [very interesting taste]. The atmosphere genuinely feels Caribbean/Spanish influence. Definitely will be back to try not menu items.

If you are looking for floral arrangements that truly are works of art for a more than reasonable price come to Zenplicity. The customer service is nothing short of fantastic. My girlfriend was stunned at the freshness and the vibrant colors of the bouquet. I have bought many floral arrangements for her through the years and she said that these were the most beautiful ever. 
Do yourself a favor, stop searching for florists and just go here. You will be glad you did.
This spot is amazing. Definitely great for brunch. The wait is a bit long, but if you've got the time to spare it's worth the wait!

Had a delicious caramel iced latte, terrific friendly, fast service and I really enjoyed the unique, cozy atmosphere. This is a great place to relax with friends and not so much for work because instead of tables there is a bar and sofas. Will be sure to stop by again.

This has got to be the worst experience we've had in a very long time. First of all, they don't deliver to our home. But we were in the mood for stuffed crust, so we ordered online for pickup. We got our email confirmation for order complete time at 5:30, and I noticed one of our  pizzas was wrong so I called right away. The girl I spoke to on the phone confirmed she has changed it. So when my husband gets there at 5:35. the pizzas aren't even ready. And surprise, surprise the order is WRONG. There were only 2 people working, and he didn't want to wait. He gets home, and the pizzas are borderline cold, like they've been sitting there. It was just a horrible experience and will never order/eat at a Pizza Hut again. Bye, Felicia!

I was in town and this location was recommended. I came here with a few friends. I heard it was good and the reviews looked decent. The service was quick and efficient but not the best explained. I got what i thought was a shrimp broil that would have all the fixings just to get it and find out it was all alacarte. Odd? Anywhoo the shrimp was a bit over done. It was just okay to me.

Love! Love! Love!

So happy St. Pete has Casita Taqueria. 

Amazing guys who run this place.  Super friendly and always make you feel warm and fuzzy!

Their sangria and beer selection are incredible - 

But the food - YUM!  Inexpensive and delish!  Their flautas are off the chain, their pork and braised beef are incredible and perfectly spiced. 

Their blackened fish bowl is by far my FAVE! I can't not order it now.  I add on some of their homemade pineapple salsa and a side of their crema and it's like a bowl of crack.  

Visit them on a great weather day and sit in the back patio.  Very Southern Cali back there.  They are also on the 727FoodNow delivery which we take advantage of OFTEN!  This is definitely our go-to place.

Friend won a happy hour party by just entering her contact details online. The live-music is really amazing and spans a lot of top 40, but you gotta be pretty hammered because it's really really loud in here. I can never hear myself talk inside lol. The happy hour party gets you your first drink for a dollar if I remember correctly. Buffet in the back reminds me of a strip club... it's a whole bunch of bread, spaghetti and meatballs, and some salad. I'm pretty sure that they hand out the happy hour parties on a pretty lax basis because it wasn't too special.

*11/21/15 Update: Owner reached out to me and sent me a $25 gift card and free admission ticket. Very solid customer service, definitely was not expecting that. Much appreciated!

Hotel Monaco is diagonally across the street from Independence Hall which makes it great for tourists but anyone will appreciate the amenities, hospitality, and cleanliness of this fine hotel. The classically elegant yet boutique quirkiness of the decor is Wes Anderson-esque. Some of the thoughtful amenities include an evening wine hour, umbrella and yoga mat in the closet, and C.O. Bigelow soaps. They offer valet parking and there is a garage around the block. It met and exceeded my expectations for a four or five star hotel. I can't think of anything bad to say about it.

It pays to have friends who are chefs. Even better is marrying a chef who has chef friends, which I managed to do in March. Lucky us, one thoughtful chef friend gave us a gift card as a wedding gift to any of John Besh's restaurants, 3 of which are in New Orleans, where we honeymooned.

We chose to go to Lüke, because it seemed the most "us". The restaurant is lovely inside, and feels intimate because there are several rooms, even though the space is quite large when you combine all the spaces. We were led back to the room near the kitchen, which might annoy some people, but for us, being able to look through a large plate glass window at the goings-on was added entertainment.

I'll give you the rundown of what we ordered.

Charcuterie plate
A symphony of pork, rabbit and other delicious things. Paté, head cheese, fois gras terrine, house-pickled watermelon rind and other pickles, stone ground mustard and plenty of toasts.

Crabmeat salad
Mostly crab, served on greens, very lightly dressed. Sweetest crab I've ever eaten. Seriously.

Fried Oyster and bacon salad with buttermilk dressing
Yes, there's lettuce, but the giant chunks of bacon and the most succulent fried oysters I've ever eaten sit atop this lettuce, and they don't skimp.

Mussels and frietes 
I think this was like, 2 pounds of mussels in the best broth I've ever had. The fries were good but I enjoyed dunking the crusty bread that came with the salad and the waitress happily brought more. I think the kitchen staff was sort of amazed watching me eat ALL of this, and I am still not quite sure how I did it either. But I really like mussels.

The Lüke Burger
This thing was huge, the bacon on it was amazing, and husband enjoyed finishing it back at the townhouse as a latenight snack.

The service here was amazing. Our waitress was so friendly, patient and answered all our questions thoroughly. We could see the amazing efficiency and care in the kitchen, and the sommelier visited with tables and made suggestions clearly loves his job. It was a very lovely meal, and even without the gift card, would have been worth every penny -- though honestly I think this is a very affordable and accessible dining experience even for those who don't think they like fine dining. I think it's no accident Lüke is located in the financial district. I am sure they get lots of business people in there for lunch and dinner.

This will definitely remain one of the most memorable meals of our honeymoon in New Orleans, and I hope to go back someday!

The decor is certainly historic but the decorations are sparse and dull. The food is routine and the vegetables are boring. Price is strong but that's the only prominent feature. The Inn is not worth the effort to get there. It needs a transfusion!!

We were on a mission to find tacos al pastor after a great Vegas trip. This is where we ended up. The tacos were delicious (albeit not nearly as amazing as Tacos el Gordo). Service was super fast, tacos and salsas were tasty. No complaints!
This is a really great hotel.  First class service and most of all the best location on Bourbon street.  Parking is very expensive, be forewarned.

Its a casino, people. .....the chances of winning are not in your favor, but its still worth the trip. This place is not just gambling.  There are quality restaurants and music memorabilia. Live music, several bars with reasonable prices make this a great meeting place. There are cool hotel rooms for overnight stays. The staff is friendly.  Go out and enjoy yourselves.  Have a good time and people watch.

This pizza is awesome!  Definitely the best I've had since I was in Italy. Very flavorful cheese--I think they must use the whole fat cheese because it just was to die for. Our group ordered 2 pizza pies. Demolished one and ordered another.   The staff was super friendly and professional.  Cleaned up our old plates, tissues before the 2nd pizza arrived.  Highly recommended!
Went in to order. I was the only customer. Received my food quickly and the employees were very polite. I'm surprised to see the low rating on Yelp.
Went to Delicia tonight with 10 women.  Every one of us said that the food was great.  Nice atmosphere and our server Rachael was excellent!  Will definitely be going back soon.

I've ordered from here a few times and eaten here once. Really don't get the hype. I'd rather have better quality sushi not served in a martini glass. The pad Thai was possibly the worst I've ever had. It had a weird spicy sauce that just wasn't good. I don't know... It wasn't like, foul, but I didn't leave the meal feeling happy. 

I will say delivery was quick and my food arrived very hot. I feel like I would maybe give them another chance... but not unless I really had to.

This place is tiny, and can be filed with confused/wasted tourists, but I love it so. The restaurant is family owned and operated, and the main owner is a lovely and funny man to converse with while waiting for food. As other reviewers have noted, the place is filled with boxing memorabilia from the owner's former career. Definitely check out the cold sore on President Clinton! 

Their menu is filled with traditional Mediterranean "quick foods", such as falafel, hummus, gyros, and baba ghanouj. I cannot vouch for the gyros, but I can definitely vouch for the falafel. It is some of the best falafel I have ever had, and I have eaten a lot of falafel. They make it for you on the spot, and it's perfectly spiced. The portions are pretty damn good for 6 bucks!

Step offa Bourbon street for a second (PUT DOWN THE NASTY PIZZA!), and check this place out. It has a nice ambiance and the whole block has some cool bars on it.

If this place just cleaned up around the edges a little bit, it'd be a solid four-star experience. I haven't experienced consistency with meat here; it's always at least decent, but some times are certainly more overcooked than others. The sauce is a little underwhelming; a lot of BBQ places focus on either serving really good meat or really good sauce; while I certainly agree that the meat is the one to pick if you could truly only pick one, but why not both?? My take on the sides is mixed: the mac-n-cheese is killer and the cornbread is cool, but the cole slaw and veggie sides...ehh. Actually, the cole slaw is just bizarre; I think they were trying to be outside-the-box with the flavors, but something made it really watery. Furthemore, as many folks have pointed out, the portions are stingy. 

My take: you're only 1.2 miles away from Bacon and Caviar, make that your stop instead! Garlic cheese grits await you...

I cannot rave about this place enough. We tried it because it was really close to our hotel and they recommended it . I'm sure they get a kick back or something but who cares. It was so good we ate there two more times during our trip. We didn't even want to try other places it was so good. We aren't from the south so we asked a lot of questions. The server was very patient and kind. The cost was a little pricey but so worth it. Great atmosphere, food and staff. Can't wait to go back!

Went for the lunch buffet.  The owner was friendly and helped us through our first visit there.  The buffet had many options but we visited during a time where several dishes and entrees were out.  They made the missing entrees fresh and everything was downright delicious!  One of my favorite dishes was the one with cauliflower (not sure of the name).  Also, their Naan bread was the best I've ever had!  

Overall, this was a pleasant experience with friendly staff and outstanding cuisine!

Walked by Nadine Blake the first night of my New Orleans vacation, and was delighted with what I saw in the window. I made a mental and verbal note to go back there. I found Nadine herself to be so friendly and welcoming, and the shop itself so refreshing, in that it had items that I did not see anywhere else on my trip, and they were, as Edina from Absolutely Fabulous once said, "Gorgeous, tasteful, little stylish little gorgeous things",  It was the only place in New Orleans that I purchased anything to take back home with me. Being the holidays, I found some very special artisan Hanukkah cards, a special horse themed "winter" ornament for a hard to shop for, Christmas loathing best friend, fleur de lis mercury glass ornaments that I surprisingly did not see anywhere else in New Orleans, and that I called and ordered after I got home. She also had a great little carved skull for my Physician husband. It was a surprise find. I liked that... If you're in New Orleans, and making the shopping rounds on Royal Street, take a peek inside!

Free drink refills and friendly service and allows Sundays off for all their employees? Awesome place to eat. All this an an airport location where customer expectations are low?!  

Good sandwiches and waffle fries are delicious. Good value.

Everyone should stay at a Gaylord resort at least once in their life.  You truly won't be disappointed.

Our agenda this last trip to Nashville was strictly going to see a show at the Opry.  Luck would have it, I was able to snag a room on a Saturday night when the town was hopping with concerts galore all over the city.  I have seen parts of this resort in my other trips there but realized pretty quick that there's more to see!

Once on the grounds, parking is a bit tricky.  Finally found a human who directed us to self parking - they offer valet but it was closed this particular day.  There are not a lot of open spots in self parking so you may want to valet.  I'm not sure of the cost of valet but self was $29 with in and out privileges.  Once in the lobby we were directed to the correct check in line as this place was packed!

The hotel is broken up into 3 main categories - Cascades, Delta & Magnolia.  Each one is its one little world and all are connected as well.  We were in Magnolia, found our way to our room via map and got settled in.  Room was typical, there is outside access from each room with a patio which is nice.

The Opry and the Opry Mills mall are all easily accessible from the resort by resort shuttle, which is included in your daily resort fee.  The run shuttles for both literally all day and night, which is super nice.  The drivers are awesome and very engaging with the guests.  Your resort fee also includes other fun perks but we were not there long enough to enjoy them.

I'm giving 4 stars because of check-out, which is really my only issue.  One of the staff members told us, and another couple, that if we gave them our room key, they would be checked out and our bill would be emailed to us.  So we did that...and I never got the final bill.  I tried contacting and never heard back.  No biggie in reality but if you're going to tell your guests that, please do it.

If not in Nashville for downtown, check out Gaylord.  It was pretty amazing!

My new favorite breakfast joint. Last item I got was the waffle with acorn squash butter, and my life hasn't been the same since. Don't bother trying to eat the salads or to be "healthy," as you will wish you splurged. Super busy, so go when it opens if you can.

Great atmosphere, friendly staff and ownership.

Incredibly fast, very reasonable prices, FANTASTIC pizza!

Create your own pizza with up to 6 toppings for $7? Can't beat that. Quality and flavor is through the roof. Exact same concept as Blaze Pizza, but higher quality ingredients found at Slimms!

Quality dipping sauces, great variety to select from. Awesome place, highly recommend.

**Also, got in during the first hour of opening today and got free breadsticks!**

Good food.  Ribs, turkey ribs, greens.  Prefer their hot BBQ sauce.  

Will have to get a 2nd order of turkey ribs next time, as my 6 year old devoured them.

After dining here multiple times I honestly have no idea why I haven't yet offered a review of what is IMO one of Edmonton's greater eating establishments. Those guys over at Tres Carnales really knew what they were doing when putting together Rostizado, a much larger, classier, and perhaps even romantic version of Mexican dining, yet they still manage to retain a little piece of that lively air of Tres Carnales. 

I'll admit I balked at the prices when I first looked at the early menu offerings online, "Cmon!...its just a chicken how could it possibly cost that much?" Then I actually ate the food and was beyond impressed. Its not just chicken, its not just pork, its not just cauliflower etc etc etc. 
Before I'd even had my first bite I ventured back to the open kitchen and saw those gigantic chickens slowly cooking to perfection and took in some of those lovely smells and perhaps it was at that moment I understood what was happening here. The entrees, the sides, the salads, the desserts, oh man! Every last bite of every last dish was bliss. Any further words from me couldn't possibly express my adoration of their fine culinary work. Very well done; its little wonder why Rostizado continues to be such a success.   

Go, go taste for yourself. Oh yeah, lost in my reminiscing I almost forgot about the wonderful service!

Go on....git.

Food is very hit or miss.  Servers are not very attentive.   Several years ago went for dinner and my husbands shrimp was bad!   We were told chef and manager changed, so we decided to give Bull on 19th another try.   Visited the restaurant twice in the last two months and both visits the French fries were cold and the soup was warm, at best.  Chicken sandwich was very good our first visit, hard and cold (like it had been sitting around) the last meal.  Portion sizes are good, but they should focus more on quality and a warm meal.

Horrible service at this location. Doesn't matter that you are Executive. You will wait. Not a one time issue its constant for those of us who travel there frequently. 

Expect to possibly stand on their shuttles which smell and are dirty!

They only care about taking your $$$

A friend and I went for lunch, I was craving wings. The server was very attentive, so much so that I was kind of getting annoyed. lol however I would rather have too much attention then none. My wings were regular flavor. I'm a wimp when it comes to spice and the spice in the regular sauce was not too overwhelming. If I weren't on lunch I would have enjoyed a brew. They have great happy hour specials for $6, $7, and $8.00. I do miss the wings and fries being on the happy hour special menu though. I will go back.

We have made khyper one of our must go when we are in town. We often go several times during our time in Philly just because it has such a cool vibe. I would give this place a 5 but we had a really weird experience with 2 of their bar backs on New Years. They were pretty rude to a couple of Mummers in costume. Probably upset bc they where throwing confetti- but come on, its new years and its Philly for goodness sake....

Any way- nice, really nice selection of beers. They make a lovely Pimm's cup my most fave drink right now. I don't care how cold it is outside, this drink makes me think of happy times... Tried their wings recently and they were a repeat. 

If you are in the area, make sure to stop by. I need to make sure to try their brunch next time we are in town- seems like it is very popular. 

Go enjoy. You won't regret it.

Best brunch in Nashville. Amazing lunch. During brunch drinks are 2 for 1 and they are delicious. The wicked Bloody Mary and blood orange mimosa are my favorites. Red velvet waffle, white trash hash, cheddar biscuits and gravy, eggs benedicts, and Singapore stir fry are all so excellent it makes it hard to decide what to order each time. The burger and fries are amazing for lunch, as are the Philly cheesesteak egg rolls, and fried chicken skins with honey Sriracha sauce as apps. They also have a midtown quickie on the menu that changes every day. Tavern never gets old and never disappoints.

Called in an order for a large group with a variety of requests; was not dissappointed. Everything was correct, the price is great, and the food is fantastic. 

Crab Benedict caught my eye initially. Served on a croissant with Cajun hollindaise sauce it was everything I hoped and dreamed. Crab cake with real crab and minimal breading like it should be, egg was perfectly poached with a great texture and runny yolk, sauce was perfect. 2 eggs on 2 halves of the croissant, picked it up like a sandwich. Chose grits for my side and was not disappointed, though I did look longingly at the fruit side which was cut up banana and strawberry(not the normal melon crap)

Everybody really enjoyed their food, even the chick who got a veggie sandwich. I definitely plan on ordering from here again.

Note to self: try the turkey fig

Edit: came back again the next day and did the Thai shrimp poboy and it was excellent. Plenty of shrimp, Great flavor on the Cole slaw and chili sauce to give it some kick. Bread was good too. 

Also did a blue chick smoothie. Nice that it had real fruit instead of a mix. More of a slushee though since there didn't seem to be any cream in it. It was okay, but overpriced.

So disappointed! This is probably the worst food I've had in a very long time.  I'd give it no stars, but it won't post without one. I ordered the house potatoes and they were so hard I could not eat them.  The eggs were tasteless and the portions were small. The plate I ordered was suppose to have avocado and I finally did find "some" a tiny sliver on the side.  I came with a group of 4 people none of who liked their food.  We had 4 normal meals with coffee & 2 sides the bill came up to $74!!!  We've ordered similar meals at other restaurants and not paid that much.  The customer service was ok. But we all agreed we are NEVER  going back again.  On the bright side a small portions was a plus because less food was wasted- yuck!

This is a great urgent care clinic with caring staff and built to last. I need to keep writing this review it's the thing I have to do. Why go anywhere else? Expect the best and leave a thing on Yelp.

Solid place for good beer selection , decent bar type food and to catch some sports or unwind after work.

You want a beefy burger and a mug of suds? Stop in Sam's.

If you are a wanna be "foodie" and critique the shit out of every thing? Best move along. This place is an average Joe's spot.

I love this Salon. I have been going here since 2006 and have had several different stylists. For the past year, I've been going to Cordy and I absolutely love her. I have been going to school in Chicago for the past 4 years and I usually wait until I visit Tucson to get a cut here because it's always exactly what I want.

I have extremely thick hair and every single stylist I've gone to there knows what they're doing. 

Hands down, best place in Tucson. Now just please bring a T&G to Chicago!!

EXCELENT FOOD, ok service. Would give it 5 stars if service was better we came around 2pm and there were only about 4 tables with customers. Had to tell the waitress to fill our drinks and bring ketchup, twice. 
Food was outstanding! Had the almond catfish. Best catfish I have ever had. Light breading, fluffy, fresh and very tasty. Wife got the shrimp and oysters. Shrimp were huge and fresh. 
My 6 yr old son never compliments the food, but couldn't stop talking about how tasty the chicken fingers were. 
Would definitely recommend and come back again.
Who doesn't love Ted Drewes on a hot summers day.

Great service, and good pizza. Dough is semi frozen/slightly pre-baked, and the sauce is a good mix of tangy and tomato-y. There are set made up pizza combinations you can order, or you can custom order your toppings, but my friend and I stuck to the pre designed topping orders, subbing out some of the ingredients to ones that we like better. 

The meat lovers (sub out some of the meats for mushrooms and veggies) with their regular crust was awesome, and the crust came out perfectly with the bake directions included.

The gluten-free crust that we got came out pretty differently to what we are used to, as it was our first time trying gluten-free bread and pizza. It was not as light and crunchy as a white crust but still a good alternative for a day you are trying to be healthy or if your diet is gluten free. I think it is great that there is an alternative for these people to enjoy pizza as well.

On my way out, I received a $1 token for my next purchase, so I'll be back! CASH/CHECK ONLY

I haven't been back to the area in years, so I wanted to try KK as it is really an authentic local place.

You can really judge a place by the way customers are treated, especially when things don't go smoothly. Everyone seemed happy to be there, 

I sat at the bar and was greeted by many of the servers with a smile.  I decided to try the eggs Benedict, even if this can sometimes be a challenge.

There was evidently some issue, as the order took a while...and when it arrived the poor poached eggs had passed into the land of semi-hard boiled.   But the hollandaise was tasty.

When asked, I gently told of my eggy issues and they immediately  and pleasantly re-made the whole plate with absolutely no attitude etc..

This time it was perfect and well worth the wait !  They even offered not to charge me .  

Cudos to KK, you guys are the real deal 

I will be back !

We were in town for vacation and we were interested in Biscuit Love Gulch and the line was out the door. We decided to try Milk and Honey instead. We had a 30 minute wait but it went by fast since they have things you can look at and purchase to pass time. Once we got seated I ordered the dirty Benny and it was outstanding. The service was great and the orange juice is second to none. The food was brought out in a timely manner. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone. Thank you for the great experience.

THEY HAVE UBE. They just opened and it's an aesthetically pleasing place for you Instagram peeps. They have a few different flavors like matcha or UBE. When I walked in the owner was really REALLY nice and helped me out with my order. I got one of their curated flavors, UBE Baby Baby, which by now you should know Ube is my favorite flavor. Ube Baby Baby came with Ube soft serve, vanilla cake, and condensed milk. It was delicious.  I would totally come back and bring other people with me. It seems like a really chill place to hang out with friends or a place to grab dessert.

love. this. place. grab a quick bowl of tasty pho and grab a bahn-mi to go. not the most authentic flavors, but close enough for the price. my only complaint is that bok choy was the only veggie in the veggie pho. c'mon now, can i get a carrot or piece of broccoli please?

My new sushi joint. These guys made us feel special and at home. Very very friendly.
Would recommend to anyone.

If I could give this zero stars I would. I contacted the Electric Run to see when the rescheduled 2014 run would take place since they kept posting on their website "July 2014 - coming soon!". We were promised last year of registration would be deferred to 2014. I got an email back basically telling me I'm sh*t out of luck since they won't be doing an Electric Run in Philly in 2014 or ever again and if I wanted to do the run, I had to go to Baltimore which is the next closest city. They totally scammed me along with thousands of other people. The organizers never sent an email out telling last years registrants that they were not coming back to Philly in 2014. I demanded my money back (I couldn't dispute the charges on my credit card since it was past the 90 day window to dispute charges) and they flat out told me they would not be refunding my money. Again, a bunch of scam artists. They led us to believe they would have another race. They need to do the right thing and refund. They did not fulfill their end of the deal. Shame on Electric Run and all of their organizers. They are completely unprofessional and have shown they are amateurs at hosting events of this nature.

Normally I'm not a bar person but I heard the food from this Pub was legit and on Mondays the burgers that are normally 10 bucks for only 5 bucks. 
I always like a deal. My wife got the cheesesteak she wasn't feeling burgers.

First we decided to split the order of parmesan garlic wings. Outstanding, 
they were cooked nice and crispy  and were meaty. 
 
My wife really enjoyed her steak and she let me try a bite and it was very good
meat was very flavorful and roll was super pillowy. 
 
Since the burgers were only $5 (Mondays only) I decided to get two of them because what
accompanies a burger better than another burger. I gluttonously ate both of them. 
The meat was very flavorful and perfectly cooked medium. The bun was perfect and the accoutrements were fresh. Still very shocking of how good their burgers are and I did not expect to be so wowed. All the food here was excellent will definitely be back for more.

I love this place! A very cozy and fun neighborhood bar. The best bartenders and awesome Quizzo on Wednesdays. Plus they have Rock-N-Roll Bing on Thursday nights. Always a good time in a friendly atmosphere.

If you're looking to be treated like royalty, this isn't the dynasty for you.  We were rushed out of the restaurant after our meal as we were the last ones there and it was a full 15 minutes after their posted closing time (gasp!). Food was ok, but not heavenly enough to put up with rushed service.
We went here even after reading the bad reviews thinking it couldn't be that bad.  Well, it is that bad. Horrible service and the food was garbage.

Wow what a workout. I had Maria but it was her last class, so I can't speak for the rest of the instructors, but she was great. It was my first free intro class, and it did not disappoint. I also loved the bikes since they show RPM and you can really push yourself versus the standard bikes. The place is a little hard to find and is on a second floor of a row home. It's quite pricey, so I don't think I would get a full membership since I like having variety of classes to pick from, but for any spinning enthusiasts this is a great gym!
Awesome space and delicious, fresh food! I was loving the bottled beer selection too.

My Ford Explorer was serviced at Pep Boys on 06/12/14 and there was a discrepancy on what I was quoted for my service and the actual bill. The customer service displayed by Jack at the service counter turned a situation that would have been me paying my bill and never returning, into a great Pep Boys experience. Jack made my bill right which made me a very pleased customer and revealed the care that I am sure Pep Boys wants to extend to all their customers. I will definitely make this Pep Boys my number one retailer for my automotive needs. Thank you Jack. Thank you Pep Boys.
William Shipman

I hired the Cow and the Curd to come to a bbq party I had in NJ. First off, the owner Rob was extremely friendly, very responsive, and was very professional. Their truck was on site for about 3 hours and my guests (about 85) had choices of the fried cheese curd menu that we preselected. Everyone got a small plate full of curds with choices of dipping sauces. it was a huge hit and everyone loved it. Definitely something unique for a backyard bbq, and I felt there was really good value (food to price). I 100% recommend Rob and his staff (and of course the curds, which are delicious!)

Excellent brunch place...could be in LA or San Francisco or any major metropolis. I had the Monte Cristo with sweet potatoes instead of regular potatoes. It was so good. I sat outside but it was too cold...and so I requested going closer to a heat lamp. The servers were very receptive. The service was great, and the recommendations were spot on. I'll definitely be back.

Good, laid back brunch spot, more casual than Garces' more famous spots (Amada, Tinto) but still with nice, unique touches (menus on wooden slabs, artsy plates, creative cocktails).  The neighborhood is quiet on the weekends during the day, so it's never terribly busy for brunch and there's cheap parking in a lot right next to the building, which also houses Garces' corporate headquarters.  I always get a kick of the large painting in the lobby, done in a traditional Spanish style, of a cat sitting atop a horse.  As far as the food, can't go wrong with any of the waffle plates (this most recent time my wife had the fresh berries, and I had the fried chicken).  The waffles are cooked perfectly and not too dense / heavy.  Great syrup and home made butter.  Service is very friendly.  

There s a huge bar, too, so I imagine this would be a great spot to grab a drink or fancy pizza after work during the week.
The sushi was AMAZING!  We got great service and the food was out very fast.  Definitely coming back!

I'm a long time fan of Tangelo's. The food is delicious and the atmosphere is relaxing. Excellent place to hang out with friends. I would highly recommend the Chicken Mojo sandwich - it's my favorite!

We ate here during Restaurant Week and it was just OK. In fact, there was only one thing I remember about the evening. It was their eggplant rollantini. I love eggplant and it was perfectly cooked.  It was a delicious hot appetizer.

It was the type of restaurant that I would go back to if someone else suggested it, but not one that I would want to go back to by ourselves.

And that's all I have to say about La Scala
better than coco's key.  it gets very crowded though.  they really fill up to maximum capacity, and then some.  otherwise, the indoor lazy river is pretty cool.

To put it as nicely as I can, everything about this meal and experience was sub par. I once stopped here for a drink on the Pedal Tavern and remember seeing a sign that boasted "best burger in Nashville!" After ordering the cheeseburger, I realized that statement was about as true as the stuff you read on Wikipedia. It was a bland burger, nothing more and nothing less. The fries were good, though. 

The service, to also put it nicely, was pretty bad. When my brother and I walked in, we didn't know if we were supposed to seat ourselves or order at the bar. So, for about 5 minutes we waited at the bar, where there were only 3 or 4 other customers, and finally the bartender came over to take our order. My brother and I, we're pretty friendly, non-pushy people. But the bartender seemed put out by every request we made. I don't think she cracked a smile the entire time we were there.

One last complaint and I swear I'll be done...I asked for a cup of water and then the bartender brought me a bottled water and charged me $2. I asked her if I could get a cup of tap water but she said they only had bottled water. Since when do restaurants literally FORCE you to pay for water?

To sum it up, save your money and appetite for somewhere with better service and better food.

Was having a pretty epic day until the mc decided to say oh look we have a new black in the house. He looks around and immediately comes up to me and is like our last black left here's the new one. I kinda froze up in anger before I could even say anything and my friend dragged me out of there. Way to be classy and introduce "southern hospitality" to my northern friend. Never ever patronizing this place again. I'm from the south and never experienced this in NOLA nor am I one to leave reviews but this was by far one of my worst experiences in my adult life. The worst part about it was the patrons who were actually laughing like this was the funniest thing in life. Guess this place don't like brown. After we get out the the same idiot guy runs after us and asks us why we left. My friend tells him that was not ok...his reply...yes it was. Save your money go to a bar where you will be respected.
A really beautiful interior and the staff was so friendly and attentive!  I really enoyed my food, as did my friends with me. It would get 5 stars if it weren't so pricy.

If hubby and I have a date anywhere in the vicinity of lunch, we go here. The food is awesome and you can have as much as you want of it. 

I will give it four stars because I agree with other reviewers that the staff could be nicer. However at this point I just expect it. There was a Mexican restaurant we loved where we would always be given the stink eye, assuming because we weren't Mexican. It always made the place a little more endearing because we were hated so. Is it the way a business should run? Of course not! But it does make me feel like I am in a different culture and life does not revolve around me as the customer.

Pizza is great, but the staff is awful and the delivery is the WORST. We have been devoted customers and truly LOVE the pizza so we try so hard to stay loyal and keep our business with Fox's... but when every single time you order, and your told delivery is going to take X amount of time, then it's delivered 30 mins PAST (and that's being generous) that time.. it gets old. I'm sorry, but in order to keep your customers you need to have competent staff and honest delivery times. 

Zionsville Pizzeria here we come!

The food was good (definitely on the pricier side), but the service was terrible. Probably the most hipster restaurant I've been to in Reno, but I would not recommend this place if you're trying to have an intimate date night. The music in the restaurant is super loud. 

Service: After my boyfriend and I were seated, it took the waiter at least 15 minutes to get us water. The food took a long time to come out and our main dishes came out at different times. After finishing dinner, we asked for the check and I think the waiters completely forgot about us because we had to wait another 10-15 minutes. I would expect restaurants to want to turn tables over quickly, but for some reason service was super slow. For the poor customer service and overall dining experience, three stars.

Food: Tried the crab croquet. Pretty tasty, but I don't think it warrants the high price tag. Three crab croquets for $13 is a little steep.

Also had the spicy miso ramen ($16) and the wicked fried rice with duck cracklings ($14). I'd say the ramen here is probably better than other places I've been to in Reno, but nearly double the price. The broth wasn't super rich, but presentation and little vegetables were nice. The wicked fried rice was pretty good. The cracklings definitely add texture and the duck on top was cooked well.

Very disappointed. The service was very slow.  We ordered two burgers cooked medium & they were well done.  The fish was not fresh and overall the food was just not good. If your looking to hang out & have drinks this may be a nice location but not ideal for dining
Stopped in after a day at Adventure Island. The food was good, and they had fast friendly service. Counter service. No kids meals.

everyone said to go to pancake pantry but that the line wasn't worth it.  so of course that means to me i just have to go at a time no one else would be there! we decided to save this for our last meal, right before we have to go to the airport. we went on a sunday morning at 7 am and were seated right away. 

I had done my research and looked up the menu. there were so many options i wanted to try. obviously the sweet potato pancakes were listed as award winning but I like super sweet things so I was skeptical. I asked our sweet southern waitress what she recommended and she said the sweet potato pancakes were hands down best thing. so  I decided I would try those and the banana bread pancakes. both good but the sweet potato pancakes were AMAZING. that cinnamon cream syrup on top really put them over the edge. they were so moist. 

highly recommend getting those pancakes!! 

other people with my got the french toast and also tried and sugar and spice pancakes. everything was delicious.
