Location was the only real downside to me. It's more of an airport hotel than a city hotel. If I was coming to Tampa again I would like to see more of the central city. If I need to stay near the airport though I would not hesitate to come back here!

This place is really good. Lots of variety, they had 3 different types of veggie burgers and a lot of topping options. I had Guadalupe (I think) and it was amazing as is, but even better with pickled jalapeño. Everything had lots of flavor! Be careful with the build your own burgers though, all the toppings and options can add up and get pricey. Your better off ordering one of the ones already on the menu. Overall really really good meal.
Love the 8 pc nugget. So happy to have a new location. Drive through is almost always busy, but inside is usually empty.
They close at 3am on Fridays & Saturdays.  After 2am, they stop serving liquor, but admission is free.

I came to visit my brother at UCSB but knowing that he will be in class, I decided to go body boarding. Me and my girlfriend came to stearns wharf to see if we can find a place that has waves. There wasn't alot of people there it was more of boats around the area. So we went further down stearns wharf and found a new parking spot. You could park at the street but it was full instead we parked in the parking lot which was next to the beach and the restaurant. 

After body boarding we went to this place and it had a nice view with the view of the ocean in front of it. I ordered their chips and salsa and guac that cost about 6 dollars. The chips have a very nice texture. They fry the chips and then serve them. The guac and then salsa tastes very organic. I would recommend this place if you you want to relax and watch the sunset.
This place is amazing. Not much to add that hasn't already been said...if you haven't been yet,  go,  but if you decide to make it a Saturday visit,  be prepared for massive I crowds.
Loved my eyelashes and spray tan! Place was clean, staff was friendly and really helpful. Great prices and specials too.

I really wish they wouldn't put BBQ in their name. I hail from Memphis, so I am a bbq snob. This is NOT bbq! I like their brisket, cornbread, and Mac and cheese, but if you want real BBQ, go somewhere else.

This place is the best if you are trying to find anything!  Great service, excellent prices, wide selection and always in stock.

I tried some strawberry beer (Fruli) from a Yelp! event last year and I headed right to this place and sure enough they sell it!   I heard about flavoured vodka and checked out their section, they carry so many different brands and flavours.

Lots of staff working no matter what time of day you are shopping.  If you can't find something, someone will direct you and will even look in their computer to see how many bottles they have.

Many choices, in fact too many and there is always sampling as well.  The sampling staff are super friendly and knowledgable.  Looks like a fun place to work too.  Too bad there aren't more locations as this one is tucked away in Windermere and the other location is in Sherwood Park.

The ambiance!!!! Love love love the atmosphere. It's so cute. Also the margaritas- well they're big and they're strong. Well worth the money's. 

We started with the chips and salsa trio. Delicious! Came out quick and offered lots of variety of spices. 

I ordered fish tacos for my entree and was in love. The flavors were perfect. It paired well with black refried beans (delish!)  and cilantro rice. 

Parking can be a pain - but there is a small lot in back often forgotten about.

I cannot say enough positive things about Jaclyn and her team!  My wedding was May 18, 2013 and she did an incredible job with all of our make-up..airbrush is amazing...I promise you will not be disappointed!  Kate did my hair and I had so many comments on it :)  The salon is beyond cute and absolutely perfect for a girls day.  Jaclyn even had muffins and mimosas to treat us.  One of my bridesmaids has already booked STLooks for her wedding in April 2014 because she was so good.  Jaclyn responded to every single email within 24 hours, sent reminder messages, and we were ahead of schedule on the wedding day...customer service is unmatchable!  Thank you again Jaclyn for such a wonderful experience, you really added to the success of my wedding day!

This place is not affiliated with Tony Luke's. That is in South Philly, and it's 100% better.

Tony Jr.'s has okay hoagies, mediocre cheesesteaks, and very good onion rings. The "Philly" on their awning bothers me because of the quotation marks. Just call it a Philly Cheesesteak. Sadly, the poor punctuation does add Philly hoagie/steak shop authenticity.
What we later found out was that they packed the radiator with sealant. Screwed our car up. Sorry for my bad review for Sunshine Auto. These guys screwed up.

They acknowledged me pretty fast, as they had a nice lady on the front of the store. I had questions about switching to a new plan. It was pretty informative and got the salesman's card, but after trying to contact him, I get no reply. There was no point on giving me the card if you are not going to answer my calls or emails. The wait was about 15 minutes, which is way to much to get some basic questions answered.

Great store!! Mountain bikes, road bikes and more. Had a bent rim while riding balm boyette trail. Walked in store by recommendation to be surprised at the grand selection and friendly knowledgeable staff. My rim was unfixable. They respoked a new rim for me in less then an hour.

Monday night have the ribs with grilled shrimp.  There is a medium sauce and hot sauce. Waitress said that the hot sauce was not that hot. That's about relative because it was pretty hot. Delicious the baby back ribs are the best. I didn't see any bikers but this is also winter in Pennsylvania. Workers looks great. The baked beans are very good

Came in Sunday for lunch and some games with the kids. So stoked about the pizza and wing buffet. Until we discovered the cold pasta, pizza that tasted like it was from last Thursday. Then my wife ordered a margarita and there was not one, but 2 hairs in her drink. And my sons hot dog took 35 minutes to be brought out. 2 big fat thumbs down. We won't be back.

Got to for happy hour. Three stars bc they changed the flatbread- it's now rolled?
Note to chef...flatbread is supposed to be flat.  Please bring back the original presentation, flatbread is flat! Barring this, I enjoy each visit and I look forward to ordering the flatbread, it's my absolute favorite.

It absolutely pains me to write a poor review of Mr. B's Bistro.  I have been a loyal patron for more than 20 years.  I proposed to my wife there, and it holds a special place in my heart.
I have always gone there for the service even more so than the food.  I used to find their service better than practically anywhere else.  Not anymore.
We had a 9pm reservation for five, arrived early and sat/stood in the bar area.  It took 20 minutes to finally get a drink (in a plastic cup).  We were seated about 9:20 and given water and menus, then ignored until 9:40.  Our waiter (who reeked of cigarettes)  took our order 1 appetizer, 1 cocktail, 1 glass of wine.
The martini was not what I requested, and the pork belly was one of the worst I've had...ever.
40 minutes had passed before we received our order. Empty, unfilled water glasses, appetizer plate not picked up.  We wanted wine, but our waiter was nowhere to be found. When our food arrived, my scallops were room temp, my wife's steak was medium (not medium rare) with dry flavorless potatoes.  I mean, they were awful. The Gumbo Ya Ya was tasty, but not very warm. They brought the wrong order to my daughter who ordered salmon, with ZERO apologies.
We proceeded to finish our meal completely before they brought the salmon to her.  So we sat and watched her eat, again with nothing to drink and no waiter.
I tasted her over cooked salmon which lacked much flavor.  I asked for the bill, expecting to see an adjustment or at least some remorse from our waiter...but neither happened.  It took quite some time to receive it (from another person).
It was supposed to be a special night (renewing vows), but will be tarnished by bad service and subpar food.  For $250, and one of my favorite places...I was more than let down.
There are far too many other great restaurants to choose from in NOLA to put up with an experience like that.

I had the Tennessee burger because the menu said Zagats 50 burgers in 50 states. It did not disappoint the burger was very flavorful. I ordered the chips and they were good, however my wife ordered the truffle tots and next time I would order them they had a great flavor that is tough to beat!
Food was delicious. Enjoyed breakfast outside. They even bought my puppy a bowl of water.

I just wanted to thank you for making two elderly women very happy today. My husband and I are Aruba Marriott Timeshare owners and long time platinum members. We have been to your hotel multiple times. However, my 83 year old mother never was. When she mentioned her and her 84 year old girl friend were going to drive to Nashville from
Cincinnati for a visit, I strongly recommended they stay here. They love to drink wine and see things and this would enable them to park the car, have everything they needed, and "walk" home after a few drinks. It wasn't in their budget as they both live on limited fixed incomes, but after much convincing, they agreed since it would probably be their first and last visit since they are getting older. When they arrived today, your gracious front desk staff upgraded them to a
balcony room since the holiday travelers have all gone home. I can't thank you enough for making a great trip better for them. As soon as they got to their room, I received a text with the news. We are forever Marriott fans!!
If you are looking for a big sports bar that serves great food this is it great fast service excellent food and you have to try the crab fries

This is my favourite  place to bowl in Edmonton; not because it's the best service/atmosphere/quality wise, but because I personally am a weakling who struggles with big balls. I also think that the location is really convenient, in that Bonnie Doon is quite central in my scope of the city.  

It's basically genius that a bowling alley was built under a mall - malls should always have some entertainment element to them to balance out all the shopping and eating. Plus, a bowling alley, something that doesn't require windows, and just sprawls above ground.... so, despite my typical aversion spending much time underground, I actually find this practical aspect of the alley charming, and makes up for it's less than glam decor.  

I appreciate the amount of bench seating there is, and the convenient granny coat hangers, though I think more functional table/counter surfaces could be provided. And this is on par with Wal-Mart for places you'd want to take a bathroom selfie in.

Because I'm not hauling around massive and heavy balls that my puny little arms can't fully handle, I end up having all the fun that my romanticized perception of bowling had promised. 

I have not tried any foods here, but the bottled coolers seemed pricey to me - so maybe head out for happy hour somewhere else (maybe someplace with a great bathroom for your selfies too) before you game.

When I signed in to their guest WiFi, to check in on Yelp, I was somehow coerced into signing up for their promo texts. I've gotten a few so far, and can't say I really mind; I like teh dealz

I really wasn't sure what to expect, but I was absolutely wowed by this experience. Bishop, our guide, was very informative and hilarious... he has us cracking up the whole time. I would recommend this tour to anyone.
I had to take a star away because the star bartender, Mark, isn't there. It's just not the same without you, Mark! Our best to you.
Tried to eat here once and the hostess was so rude & unapologetic about the lack of tables that we just left.  Didn't mean to bother her.  Moving on.

Service：so，so. I already finished my meat, without rice. 
Food : the fired pork is overheated, so dry

Best bar food and place to hang out. 

You can hang out on the patio or stay inside. You can shoot pool or have a meal. You can have a few drinks as well. This place has beer from local breweries. Yum. Try a Tucson Blonde, if you haven't or have a Chicken Finger Basket or curly fries.

And the prices. Wow! I paid $13 for a meal and two beers.

Yum. Yum.

I've eaten here a few times and I usually get the "COCHON DE LAIT".  It's awesome.  It's directly across the street from my office making it very convenient.  I've always been seated right away, but the entree can take awhile during lunch.  We waited almost an hour one time.

SO DELICIOUS!! We started of with the spinach and artichoke dip. Then my sister and I both ordered crawfish poboys, definitely one of the best we have had. The service was quick and our server was great! Very kind and prompt. We will definitely be returning!
Great place for a quick breakfast. If you're staying on Canal do yourself a favor and walk down to this place. The staff is friendly and the serving sizes are hangover friendly.

I didn't manage to get a picture because we inhaled our pittas too quickly. I just returned from Israel and was craving some shawarma but didn't want to leave the couch. I found smileys on Yelp and then on grubhub for delivery. 

The BF and I ordered the chicken and beef shawarma at 6:30. By 6:45 the food was already here. 

I'm not proud of how quickly I ate it lol but it was delicious. The shawarma was great (not Israeli quality) but we'll spiced (not too spicy) and the tahini was very good. 

Bellies are full and we are very pleased to have found our go-to Mediterranean food.

My husband got pretty bad food poisoning here. I was playing phone tag with the manager for weeks to discuss our bad recent experience here and after a while I just gave up. So disappointed because we truly loved this place the 1st time. I wonder if they changed management or something

The people here get an A+ in my book. Friendly staff, HUGE areas to work out and all the cool kids go here (In my book again).

I am very pleased with my decision to join south RAC and I will continue to suggest it to all my friends :) 

GET FIT or GO HOME!!!

I had a hard time with this one. Most of the options were a little pricey and not a huge variety to choose from (I mean, $17 for a burger). I ended up getting the Cajun catfish in a tomato-y sauce with rice on the side. It was alright but lacked some flavoring. Several at our table got the shrimp po'boy and looked like that would've been a much better option

We've been coming for 8 years, and have always loved it.  The memories we share at the Peppermill are not only special but bountiful.   This place has always taken care of, so much, that we bring our Big Fat Greek Family time after time for many of life's greatest moments.  

Like any place, stuff happens, but give them a chance as they strive to be Reno's best and continued excellence.   People like Dave Fuller are the faces that represent how enormous establishments like this can maintain those diamond ratings!! Thank you, thank you for helping us make lasting memories - the ones you share with everyone you know.   
Food is delicious and plenty to please all.  Italian, steak, Chi the Chinese...milk at Biscottis heated for infants, crepes, quick sandwich, the list goes on. 
The Casino air quality has greatly improved and unfortunately/fortunately its easy to play longer.  
The cabanas and pool are excellent day time entertainment. Don't leave without trying Spa Toscana, it's paradise. 

In all, a great place for families of all numbers to enjoy.  We hosted a 93 person Big Fat Greek Baptism and the women in catering were amazing and went above & beyond to ensure my baby girl was a princess.  

See you the 4th of July Peppermill & Dave! Happy Fathers Day!
Rude, rude, rude! Hung up on me on the phone twice when I was asking about wait time. Food can't be their redeeming quality if you never get that far.

Joey is related to the Wildwood Macks and uses the original Macks recipe from the 50's & 60's.  Joey runs the shop and makes the pizzas and it's as good as or better than Macks Wildwood pizza...there, I said it!  I give the Wildwood Macks the edge because there's nothing better than having a slice on the boardwalk with the ocean at your back...but Romanticism aside, Joey Mack's is bona-fide 5 star pizza and worth the trek for!

It is a great location for families with young children.  Less amazing for people without young children although it is still a lovely location.  The food is okay but pedestrian.  Quite fine for young palates of any age.

One word....DISAPPOINTED.. I was very surprised at the lack of quality of the food for the price. Taco bell produces the same for a much lower price.  For the price of a casual lunch, I expected much more.  While we dined, there were 10 dirty tables waiting to be cleaned. Bathrooms were very dirty, girlfriend had to hover.  We would have loved to sit in a booth but NONE WERE AVAILABLE AND CLEAN!! FILTHY, ROTTEN, JUST A VERY DISAPPOINTING EXPERIENCE. Staff consisted of two overworked, hurried young girls who did their best. DISAPPOINTING!!!

The pancake plates are definitely a good value (under $10 for the peach and the banana bread pancakes). However, we did not feel that the pancakes were special or worth the wait (the line wrapped around the restaurant even at noon on a Wednesday). I wish the pancakes were fluffier and that the banana ones had actual slices of bananas with the plate. We thought the quality was on par with IHOP. The sausage links were clearly not made in house (frozen). Service was friendly though, and the price was right for a diner breakfast.

Ok. SO the pancakes were great. (Sweet potato). However the waitress was soo uninterested in us, never asked to refill our coffee, an had no personality. Maybe she had a bad day and was tired??? Idk. I am glad to have had the sweet potato pancake experience! Oh, and don't forget your sweater as it was cold in here!
Very impressed by this nail salon. I got a gel manicure and an eyebrow wax. The staff are super friendly, attentive, and detail oriented. Complimentary green tea and massage!

Best roast beef sandwich in the philly area? I definitely think so. Like the south philly location, the Springfield place offers a nice juicy sandwich with fresh cooked meat on the classic kaiser roll. If you're in the mood for a side try the gravy fries - French fries topped with roast beef chunks smothered in gravy will make your day. It was busy around lunch time and our waitress seemed a little overwhelmed but she didn't forget about us. The bar is a bit dark on the inside but you usually expect that from a dive bar. Overall great tasting sandwiches in a friendly environment.
Food all great! Fresh & Hot.  Service excellent for a buffet.  I'll go back you bet..

This Petsmart seems slightly smaller than some of the others I have been in but it was stocked well, clean, and organized.  I checked in on the cats that were waiting for adoption and to their credit the two that were there were clean and looked content.

I ordered their lunch special - Spring roll, lemongrass soup, and penang curry chicken w/ vegetables for take out. It was just as good as some of the Thai I've had in the city. Very tasty and vegetables were fresh. I will be going back! The owners were very friendly and accommodating. A nice addition to the neighborhood.

This was the second time being here. The first time the Po' Boy was really good. So this time I was there I was OK Po' Boy time it wasn't that great at all lacking seasoning big time. Not sure if they just had a off day. I might check it out one last time but not sure. Now the Gumbo was really good. So I might stop there for the Gumbo again.

For under $5 you can get a hot cafe au lait or coffee with 3 beignets. Service is speedy and sweet. Their drive thru is a great concept because you roll in and go.  Though I prefer to order my drinks in the walk up as it is somewhat faster.  They put Starbucks to shame with their lightweight coffee drinks. Make mines strong.  Beware: the beignets can become addictive if you are not careful.

This place is perfect for college students just getting into wine or new wine drinkers. Yvonne provides a wonderful selection each night and you get to try six wines for only $10! My favorite part is how she provides a short description of what to expect when tasting and I believe that helps immensely when developing your palate. I always have a great time when I come with friends. Be sure to say hi to her dog and cat; they are the sweetest. Ps. if you purchase anything to-go the port wine cheese is amazing
Dirty tables (not 1 clean one), terrible manager who stands around and watches then barks at the employees in front of customers, 1 person on the line and slow

We were in NO on vacay.  This was the best meal we had!  Scallops, shrimp po boy, chicken parm and meatballs were all outstanding.  Everyone from host to bartenders to the security guy could not have been more friendly and helpful. Awesome job chefs. If we lived here we'd be back all the time.

My experience at MDG has been excellent so far. I purchased a Groupon for their Blowdry Lounge and have had Erin as my stylist both visits. She does an excellent job and is very friendly! I recommend her to anyone. Great downtown location. Pros: they offer groupon deals, staff is friendly, it's a very clean and trendy salon. Cons: sort of pricey, sometimes takes a while to schedule, parking is sometimes difficult.
Been a member here for quiet some time. Love coming to get a massage or facial monthly and the discounts are nice for purchasing people gift cards and what not.

If you feel like paying twice as much and loading your own material, rent a 20 yard dumpster from waste mgmt. If you want someone else to load your junk and haul it away call Toby's junk hauling you won't be disappointed. I've used them twice and they have not let me down. Everything you could want from their service.......fair pricing, punctual and FAST. I'm not a huge yelper....trust me they are legit

Maybe the pizza is good here... but I can really only speak on the soup and salad. It could be the case that I'm the idiot who decides to get italian wedding soup at a pizza joint, but it was rancid :( I tried to get through eating it, but I just couldn't do it. I was too worried I would be sick afterwards. The salad was pretty overwhelming, too. I just wouldn't go back.

Came for lunch and sat outside. Scenery was awesome and service was good. Ordered the grouper platter and the fish was dry and tasteless. Asked for home fries but got french fries. My wife ordered a cheeseburger and it was also dry and bland. My assumption is the breakfast food is much better.

We had signed up for a lunch-time jazz cruise, minus the lunch.  It was relaxing being on the boat, and we bought a couple drinks.  The tour guide pointed out some interesting things but my biggest problem was that there was no jazz music.  The tour guide even announced that it was about to start, but nothing happened - no music, no explanation ... it was pretty disappointing.

Delicious breakfast. Don't miss the biscuits. The day we came they had crawfish omelette a with lots of big delicious crawfish. Coffee is excellent which is always a plus for me for breakfast. I wish I could come for lunch because the fried chicken and pork chip with oyster dressing sounds amazing. A great spot in Treme.

Dr. Reichman is an amazing doctor. I wish I could say the same for the staff upfront. I switched insurance and at the time of making the appointment I gave all my new information to reception. Less than 24 hours of my appointment while on an airplane they call me to tell me my new insurance isn't accepted. I asked to pay out of pocket because of the cost of the airfare to go home all the receptionist could do was blame me. When I asked why they wouldn't call before the day before she blamed me and said it's my responsibility to make sure my insurance is accepted. Im was stunned at how rude and dismissive. Unfortunately being at the airport on my layover I could express how I really felt!!!! Such an amazing doctor should really consider who she has representing her at the front door. What a waste even if my insurance changed I'll never go back because of the staff up front on the phones!!!!
The best food the best customer service and an outstanding manager they are all so helpful and the food is great

Fantastic!

As with many of my reviews, I've only been here once, but without a doubt I'll be back.  I'm so excited that, even though I'm stranded in the 'burbs (read: the east side) and bit of a drive away from Tucson's more "stand-out" spots that are closer to downtown and the University, this little gem is quite literally a 5 minute drive from my house.

We had an appetizer special, which was a pita with roasted red peppers, feta and some sort of seasoning.  It was the perfect appetizer size (as in, not such a giant smattering of food that you're unsure as to how you're supposed to eat your dinner), and it was just wonderful.  The feta wasn't harsh or dry--everything blended perfectly.

I had the chicken pilaf dinner, which was shawarma chicken with a huge portion of lentil pilaf topped with beautifully caramelized onions, as well as a salad, pita, garlic yogurt sauce and a little cup of hummus.  $10 and I took half of it home.  The chicken was well-seasoned and not dry and that pilaf might be the best thing that's ever happened to me.  Husband had a special which included a lamb kebab sandwich, fries and a drink for $9.50.  The lamb kebab sandwich was everything it should have been, but those "fries" were definitely the highlight (and not because the lamb was substandard by any means).  They're not french fries so much as they are fried potatoes but damn, baby, they're awesome--thinly sliced "half-moon" potatoes, seasoned and garlicky and a little lemony.  

Not much by the way of atmosphere, as it's in a strip mall and squashed between a dry-cleaner's and something else, and it's not all that well-labeled, but that doesn't seem to stop people from finding the place.  We "ate in" and there was a steady stream of take-out orders in the time we were there, and also a party of 4 was dining-in just as we were leaving.   Be warned--the dining area is SMALL.  There are some nice tables outside but we got here after the sun went down so we ate inside.  There are 4 2-top tables and 3 4-top tables (which look like they might be able to seat 5 or 6 if no one wiggles too much, but I don't know if they'll let you move chairs or not).  

No booze, but it's BYOBeer or Wine, and the party that was sitting as we were leaving brought a bottle of wine in with them, so I'm assuming it happens rather regularly (and there's a Safeway in the same plaza as the restaurant so it's also rather convenient).

I'll be honest: the only reason this isn't 5 stars is because I was a little less-than-impressed with the pita I was served with my dinner--it was sort of hard. Nonetheless, it was freakin' awesome and I'm sure these guys will be seeing a lot of me.

Smile and nod, smile and nod.
That's all I can do to confirm to the bartender that everything is awesome.
Yes the sardine sandwich is delicious, came quick to my spot at the bar and is in par with the weird yet unforgettable liverwurst sandwich at the Tap Room downtown. Just a bit oily, spicy, the picked red onions are just great. Some sardine fell out but it's classic pub food so how could I complain? Thank goodness for the cloth napkins. Oh and I was bold enough to switch out the potato salad for some Billy Goat chips and ask and receive some extra pickled red onions as well! (It's not sooo busy tonight, but I always appreciate it when a special request can be accommodated so effortlessly.)
Paired with an American IPA I can say I am quite happy here.
With a bike rack out front and a beer in hand while it's 107 degrees outside and 5 pm, life in the a/c seems particularly good right now. I would definitely recommend this spot or the Tap Room to anyone, absolutely.
While it's obviously not a fussy fine dining experience the food is great, the bartenders and severs friendly and helpful, and quick. 
Plus there are today 14 beers made by Schlafly on tap. The A-IPA is nice and hoppy.
Plus on Wednesdays here there is an all local farmers market and then also at other times film screenings and bands, etc... it goes on. I have no trouble supporting this local business.
Like the shirts say, Beer is not just for breakfast anymore.

Cute place and the Dragon Tea I got with sea salt foam was pretty good! Not too sweet and I was afraid the sea salt foam would be too salty but was just fine. Very thick foam and is a little too much, but very tasty with crispy jelly added. This place is on the higher end of prices imo for just a Boba milk tea but the ambience is super aesthetic and cute. Only 4 stars because they didn't have half of their menu available lol but I'm excited to go back and try their uji matcha items when it's in stock
-
Update
-
Still no matcha... but tried their waffle puff cone this time around and it's super tasty! Perfectly made cone that's super crispy on the outside and soft in the center. Not too sweet so the cone with the ice cream aren't sickening like other places. I also appreciate that the cone is cooled a little bit before the ice cream is placed in so it's not all melts right away :)

Sassy owner though, not sure i wanna come back now :|

I sure did love eating here. The turtle soup was tasty. It's nice sitting near the windows right on the edge of the nature reserve. Gators regularly cruise by, sometimes making it up the bank to bask in the sun.

IU health urgent care on broad ripple (62nd) where able to see me right away. Helen Weber-McReynolds,  PA IS an absolute guardian angel. I was having Severe shoulder spasms PA McReynolds was able to patch me up right away. I highly recommend to Everyone

I came here for lunch with a few friends. The place was packed, but we were able to push together a few tables. The staff was quick and friendly. Did not have any trouble.

Everything I had was good, but nothing special. I ordered the Frenchie sandwich. It was good, but not enough sprouts on the sandwich. The bread was good, but I should have gotten it toasted. There was a total of 10 in my group and we all received our food quickly. If I went back, I would probably do the soup & sandwich combo. 

For dessert, I got the gooey butter cake. It was really good and a good sized portion. It was so large that I ended up sharing it with everyone in my group.

Overall, I would recommend this to others and go back there myself.
Great food, but I would recommend ordering from the window and sitting outside: better view, quicker service and of mostly more space

So just traveling through and stopped for to-go order. No verbal greeting from the lady with dreadlocks. Seemed annoyed that I was even there. Fixed my bowl and chips and queso.   Couldn't figure out cash register. Told me my total was $24. I told her no. She fixed it. Total was $13. I paid and she offered no, "Thank you."  Just walked away. I thought I was in the South?  Much more friendly at my hometown Qdoba out West. Wouldn't recommend.

Great place! Came here based on the reviews and was definitely not disappointed. If you're confused on what to order, look through the pictures that people have posted- they helped me to decide. The food came out quickly and was just as delicious as it looked. I'd suggest coming here with a couple of friends and splitting a few plates family style so you can experience a lot of what they have to offer.

My boyfriend and I checked out Smokey Pint for the first time last night. We have been dying to find a place close to our house that we can occasionally drink and hang out at but all the bars in our neighborhood (Port Richmond) are not really our scene. If you haven't been here yet, expect the following: super nice service from the staff members, ridiculously cheap bottle and can beer prices, delicious BBQ and if you're lucky - a hilarious conversation with David, a chatty local with more spunk and character than half the people I know. I am so happy that we won't have to make the trek to Fishtown or Nolibs for a spot like this.  If you live close, take your bike so you can stay for a few - you won't regret it!

A ways from the Funk Zone, but probably more worth a visit than anything there! It's insanely hip, with high ceilings, a huge patio, and long, spacious bar. It'd be a really fun spot for a large group, even more so than Fig Mountain or Topa Topa. Skip the Funk Zone; come here.

Really extensive beer menu (plus free pretzels and mustard, so...). There's a cool winery next door, too, with a semi-shared patio area, so there's something for everyone. Bring all your friends and get over to this place ASAP!

Brunch was fantastic. I had the breakfast ya ya. Highly recommend! Everyone else really enjoyed they're meals too. Atmosphere & service were awesome as well. I'll be back!

Update... I did go back... dinner was less fantastic than brunch, i hope it's just a fluke, ill give it another try next time im in town...  :)

Great view and atmosphere when you sit outside but I wouldn't recommend going for breakfast. The food isn't great. Instead I'd go again for coffee and a pastry. It's a cool place but spend money on breakfast elsewhere.

Absolutely love this place. The food is excellent! Service is also excellent. Looking forward to our next visit. Get the fried pickles to start the evening out right. Pizza and sandwiches are all great.

TL;DR This place knocked it out of the park, both with the food and the wonderful small details of the experience. We went for the first time last night and I already think it's my favorite restaurant. What follows is the TL part. 

The first thing I noticed when we walked in was that on each table was a single fresh cut rose blossom floating in the bottom of a wine glass. Their decor was colorful and pretty. They dress the tables as if they way you prepare your house when you know guests are coming. It felt extremely homey and as if they REALLY cared. I rarely get that feeling in restaurants anymore, especially in Nashville. 

We ordered satay kai, and po pia sod to start, along with Thai iced coffee. Before they brought out our appetizers (both of which were delicious), they brought out something called Shrimp Chips which were in pastel colors and in coral-like shapes. And one that looked an over-easy egg. They were something we'd never had before. Unique and delightful. They also brought out our iced coffees, which displayed the paper straw wrapping twisted into the shape of a rose. 

For entrees we ordered chicken Pad Thai, orange chicken, and Kang Karee. I have never experienced equal satisfaction in my dish while also feeling jealousy of everyone else at my table's dish until going to Bangkokville. All three dishes were equally beautiful and delicious. Their serving ware was even impressive.  It looked like the kind of serving ware your grandmother would use for a holiday meal. 

Our server was extremely polite and even brought us each a small hard candy when she brought us our check.

We took a menu with us. Will 100% return.

Y'know how you have that impossible person on your gift list and you really have no idea what to buy them. BUT lucky for you, they are obsessed with their pet.  This is the place to buy them a gift.  Yes, it is mostly doggie stuff but I have found items for the cat lovers in my life.  

Plus you can bathe your own dog here in their self-service bathtub which is up on a platform which really could save your back.

Came here for a family event. It was a nice venue and the food was good. In addition, I thought we revived a good value for the price we paid per person. I thought some of the drinks at the bar were pricey for the portion of alcohol and glass size, but overall good venue. Also, I liked that the parking lot wasn't far from the banquet venue so I didn't have to walk far in my heels.

I love this hotel! My experience here was fantastic, Solomon the bellmen is the sweetest person i ever met all the staff are very sweet and helpful
The rooms are beautiful and spotless, the bed and pillows are very comfortable, the vintage look of this hotel makes it very unique and elegant
There's a complementary breakfast, they serve fresh fruit, great coffee and much more
I highly recommend it!

First visit to Nashville we stumbled on this restaurant. Looked fancier than we were looking for but menu sounded great so we went in. Can wear jeans no problem!!  Excellent food and terrific price. Their meal is Soup or salad, entree and spumoni. Many options for entree. We were a party of three who all got the salad and one got chicken parmesan and 2 got chicken and broccoli alfredo. All the food was fresh, hot and very tasty. We each got a glass of wine and cost was $25 each including tax and tip!

What an amazing experience. The food was stellar but the experience incredible. The owner, Veronika, is incredibly vibrant and makes for an amazing evening. I highly recommend this place but be prepared to be patient and have a great time.

Ledo's crust is different, but an interesting different. Like Nuprin. Remember Nuprin? Well, if it was a pizza crust, it would be Ledo's pizza crust. Thin. Flaky. Different. Ledo's.
The pepperoni is really good. It's sliced thick and has a nice spicy kick to it. I wish I'd taken a picture, because each little square slice of the pie had a single slice of pepperoni on it. I found it amusing. 
They have decent garlic bread too.

Bottom line: If you're looking for New York style pizza, look elsewhere. If you're looking for a crispy, almost Chicago style thin crust, that has at least once (and probably only once) been compared to a pain reliever that doesn't exist anymore, Ledo's is your place.

Freddy is awesome. I was referred to this location because of a business associate and I joined a monthly fee program and it has been great. I've been to the other locations and I drive past another just because of Freddy. He always takes great care of every car that comes into the shop. He remembers my name and asks about the family everytime I go there. The best part is he treats my Chevy like its a lambo and I couldn't be happier with the guys at Mister.

I had a great experience while inquiring about a new vehicle. I first came just browsing some cars not really set on which make or model I wanted to settle on. I was greeted by Shane who was super kind and showed me the CX5 Touring model, which I wanted a little more information on. I appreciated that buying a car on the spot wasn't pushed down my throat rather than asking questions about my preferences in a vehicle. Dre followed up with me the next day asking if I wanted to test drive the vehicle and anything else he or his team could help out with. I agreed and Ciso took care of me from start to finish. My experience was an A+ and I would recommend purchasing through any of the Dolan locations.

Best raw oysters and happy hour in town!!

Pros
Raw oysters
Happy hour
Service
Cocktails

Cons
Need reservations or you won't get in.
I have been coming to this salon for years. Every stylist is super qualified and fun to talk with. Rodney the owner is always around and remembers all clients names

The Best:
The waitress. I wish I had her name. Tall slender and woth long brown hair. She was charming and helpful and prompt. Best part of my meal.

The Good:
The Kei tuna was so so good. I normally don't like tuna but wow that was so good. I ordered quite a few! The inside is super beautiful and the colors are vibrant. And it had flavors that played well together. 

The Bad:
Bland was a reoccurring theme. Some of the rolls were ok but most where just absolutely flavorless (mango tango or whatever was just foam. Mango had no flavor) And I mean lemon n spice are flavors but you can't run a restraunt on 2 flavors. 

Overall I want to give them another chance and I hope I will get some more flavor if not I'll take a bunch of kei tunas.

Headline: Gastropub knocks my socks off.
House burger was one of the best I've had in Pinellas. Nice char, perfectly juicy & that brioche bun was quite pillowy;)
My husband's Asian fusion ribs had a great caramelization & were fall of the bone tender.
The only think that was so so was the poutine. I prefer my fries crispier and the sauce/gravy on them seemed to come up short on salt. Still minor flaw. 
Looking forward to trying the roasted potatoes in a sack with chorizo butter next time. 
Even dessert an aerated cheesecake with blueberries, blood orange sauce & almond crumble was legit.
It's actually more of a 4.5 for its unexpected creativity, skills & service.

Visiting from Orlando, we had a hotel nearby in Redington Shores and wanted to see some dolphins. Our hotel had a brochure for Hubbard's with a coupon for $2 off. Most of the reviews online didn't comment about the dolphin watching tour, but we figured we would give it a shot (as most of the dolphin tours were about 20 miles away in Clearwater). Our captain, Sean, was personable and made sure everyone from both sides of the boat got ample opportunity to see dolphins. We saw approximately six pods of dolphins, including one with six dolphins present! The watch lasted about an hour and a half and was well worth the money. We will be coming back for other tours on future trips.
Mostly rice, very little meet. Dol sot pot was not hot enough to crisp the rice.

Wish I was inside as opposed to OUTSIDE! CLOSED ON MONDAYS!!! Someone please update the information. I come to the area once a year for business. Great, flavorful Indian food! Friendly staff and clean place. Small dining area inside, I would consider it takeout if I lived nearby, but they do have a few small tables inside - no beer, wine or liquor.
Egg & cheese on onion bagel and hot tea. This is one of the better Einstein's locations and the bagels are better than Bread Co.

We stayed at the Hotel Monaco in November 2012, not long after it opened, I understand. Our visit to Philadelphia was a sort of last-minute 4 day affair, packed with complete lack of planning, and total spontaneity! We had such an amazing time that we added on another 2 nights, and were QUITE happy that this hotel could accommodate us on short notice!

We had only stayed once before at a Kimpton hotel, the Hotel Madeira in DC. Because of our experience there, we definitely wanted to try another Kimpton destination - their hotels are much more relaxing than the typical chain hotels, although often a little pricier, due to their "boutique" nature. 

Our stay in Philadelphia was nothing short of wonderful - clean rooms, friendly staff, and a great location right by the Liberty Bell. We walked each evening to several different restaurants and bars, and were impressed with how convenient everything was. There are a multitude of great places to eat and relax nearby - we liked Amada, Chifa, and Zento. Morimoto-san's place is nearby, but it would have been tough with our little one this time... We shall gladly return when she's a little older - my wife made me promise!

The art museums are a little farther away, but a $10 cab ride or subway ride isn't terribly inconvenient, and you are right up in the historical part of town to enjoy the Liberty Bell (which was right outside our window...) and the rest of Independence Park is right there.

Tip: sign up for their frequent traveler club - it's free, and gives you FREE Wi-Fi during your stay!

Moved over here not too long ago and was worried about the lack of decent pizza places, and wasn't expecting much from Fox's Den after reading the reviews. Ordered a deluxe though and was really surprised at how good it was! It's not going to blow your mind or anything, but this is definitely a better Pizza than you can get from the likes of Dominos or Pizza Hut. Had them a couple of times now and the pizzas were both well made and tasty. Definitely recommend this place for anyone in the area.

I think the food was a little too fancy for its own good. The waiter was really rushing us and we could not figure out why. He wanted us to make our dinner order before we even got our wine order figured out. He really did not know how to serve wine. We ordered a bottle and after he poured the three glasses he took the bottle off the table which is completely inappropriate . We ended up only ordering guacamole and chips and ate dinner elsewhere. It's too bad that this menu was so fussy and overpriced because the decor was really cute and really nice. I loved the dim lighting and the upstairs seating but I just did not want to stay there. We went to Puckett's boathouse instead which was much more low key and had way better wine

The best everything! Purchased the German chocolate cake, fresh pasta, Alfredo sauce, and shrimp. Wish the store the wasn't so crowded but it's that good you tolerate the closeness of your fellow shoppers.

Ordered from here twice. Poor customer service and unimpressive fish. 

The sushi was very meh the first time, but my roommate and I decided to give them one more try based on reviews. I think a lot of people leaving the good reviews have never had good sushi because Makiman is definitely sub par. 

Anyway, the second time I ordered some kind of fancy/special shrimp tempura roll and a salmon avocado roll. I don't know how hot the tempura roll was when they packaged it, but it made the salmon roll really warm. Not the rice, but the whole thing. Warm raw fish is not good and it grossed me out to where I couldn't eat it. I could have let this slide, but they also gave me a regular shrimp tempura roll instead of the one I ordered and paid for that cost double. I gave them a call about the roll and mentioned the warm salmon. The guy was super rude and told me that he's "been packaging sushi for 10 years and no one ever complained about this." Ok, jerk. I've been eating sushi for 10 years and never complained about this because it's never happened. 

He told me he would credit the extra $7 for the shrimp tempura from my next order. Told him there would be no next order after the conversation we just had and he said OK and hung up.

I wish i had pictures to show how great this place was but i don't. The decorations and the service were amazing. The food came out quick and was amazing. I ordered the Lüke burger. That burger was the most tender i have ever ate. It melts in your mouth and is really juicy. The fries were also very good. This is the place in New Orleans i recommend it is the best place there. ~Critic Kid

I want to love this place, but I have tried it twice and just can't give higher stars.  I have tried the Crab omlette, Caribean Sandwich, and the poached eggs......nothing special.  Don't get me wrong, it is good but I feel like the chef is still trying to find their voice.  

PRO:  The only thing on the menu worth writing about is the butternut squash soup.  Nice consistency and I appreciate the spices that were used.  This is not a bland soup at all so if you do not like spicy you will not like this.

CON:  Really......$5 for a small glass of OJ!  I realize that it is fresh squeezed, but come-on!

Maple Street is not on my usual weekend path, but I've stopped by this bakery the last few times I've been over that way.  Delicious apple turnover, almond croissants, and cheese danish/turnover/thingy.  I even bought my Mom a Thanksgiving cupcake with plastic turkey on top - old school.  

My only criticism is I wish they had a true vegetarian sandwich on their lunch menu.

I rescued a mixed breed, stray pup about 4 months ago. She has super soft hair which, I now know, is easy to maintain until it gets to a certain length, then bam- mat city. I was looking forward to having her groomed at Hair of the Dog & wanted to like their funky vibe and super low prices. When I brought her in, there was more of an odor than I expected and the woman greeted me with an air of malaise. I explained that I was still figuring out my pup's grooming regimen and feared she had gotten too long at this point because I was having a hard time keeping the mats out. After she felt through my pup's shaggy coat, she was incredibly rude and hostile, blatantly scoffed at me, and said "Wow, lady...I am not gonna try to comb through that, I'll shave her down & she'll be pink." I told the woman "I appreciate your opinion, but I don't appreciate your unprofessional tone," and she launched into a rant which included a promise that "any groomer in the city will tell you the same thing" and "this is dog abuse." Her co-worker, who had come in late, chimed in and the hostility only continued until I left. The same day, I brought my pup to another local groomer who said my pup was "about 2 weeks overdue for a groom to avoid being so mat-prone" and warned me that she'd need to go short, but made no mention of shaving. She was able to fit me in the next day & gave my pup a short, poodle-style summer cut with no pink to be seen. This groomer was also much more helpful, talked with me about my pup's hair type, what brushes would work best, and how we could grow her out to a still shaggy but matless length- basically working with me as a new dog owner instead of being judgmental and abrasive. I'm very glad I did not give my business to Hair of the Dog after such a terrible consultation experience. The employees there certainly will never have another opportunity to throw sharp, hurtful, and unwarranted comments at me. Yelp doesn't allow me to select zero stars, or I would have.

If you've followed my reviews for a while - and let's be honest, who hasn't - then you would know that it's hard for me to write a bad review, and even harder for me to do that for restaurants that don't typically get a lot of reviews.

But hey. When the food fits.

When it comes to Ethiopian food, I am easy to please. When it comes to service, I am easy to please. When it comes to repeating myself, I am easy to please.

We walked in and no one said anything and then eventually after a lot of awkwardness we were pointed to a table. I looked at the menu. The Miser Wot was the most expensive I have ever seen. Not too big a deal since usually it's big portions but I asked if it was enough for two people, and the waitress looked at me like I was dumb and said no. So we ordered two. 

Even with two orders of the same food, it was super small. It was also not at all tasty, and it came with no lettuce, no small side, no nothing. Just a small gob of a not very tasty goo on a plate for the most I've ever paid for this type of food.

I was definitely disappointed, but then again this place has a monopoly on the food as it is the only Ethiopian restaurant in Reno, so maybe they can get away with it since there is no competition. Too bad.

30th St station is probably worth a look if you're into architecture. The building is gorgeous and it never seems super crowded or uncomfortably busy. It makes for a good stop if I need a quick lunch as there are a lot of options to choose from.

I haven't taken any Amtrak trains yet, but I've taken some SEPTA trains in and out of the city. The building is clean and there seems to be a lot of security/police around as well.
Fantastic dinner and great setting. Oysters were the best I've ever had. Nice to sit by the window and watch people outside. Excellent service from Terrance and the other staff.
This is hands down the best Greek restaurant that I have ever eaten the flaming cheese appetizer was incredible and the baklava cheesecake was the best dessert I have ever eaten 10/10
Never been disappointed. Always a delicious mix of flavors. Friendly staff and quick service. Perfect cajun comfort food!

Ever since I moved to Florissant I've been wanting to try this place because I drove by it every day. After finding a groupon for the Rice House I knew it was time to try it. 

My favorite to order at any Chinese restaurant is General Tso's.  Their General Tso was probably the worst I've ever had. I also tried their Jambalaya Rice which was just ok. We probably won't go back to this place. It didn't satisfy our Chinese food craving at all.

This has to be one of the worst Walmarts I have ever been to. There is no organization of product. The store is unattractive with regard to cleanliness. There are always kids running around unattended, screaming and shrieking and playing with shopping carts. The employees are always more concerned with their personal conversations than helping customers, and the managers are not much better. 

On one occasion, there were not enough registers open and after standing in line for over ten minutes, another customer standing behind me asked two managers walking by if they could open some more registers only to be told, "No, but you can go over to the Jewelry counter and they will check you out there. Now, the jewelry counter had no way of processing the produce items she had in her arm. They did not apologize for the wait or even say have a nice day as they proceeded away from us as if we had said nothing to them at all. 

It is almost impossible to find working displays in this store. I went in shopping for an android tablet and while there were 6 on display, NONE of them worked and I was told they could not show me one that DID work. This went on for roughly three months before I gave up. 

If you use their check cashing service and the service declines to cash the check, you get no explanation, only an 888 number to call where you are placed on hold for as much as 30 minutes only to be told that the decision was based on criteria obtained from the computer. 

Gift cards? LORD, never take an eGift card in there and expect to get out quickly. The undertrained cashiers have no idea what to do with these and the managers/front end supervisors act as if you interrupted the second coming of Christ when they are asked for assistance. 

HONESTLY, were it not for the fact that the store is less than 2 miles from my home and the prices, I would never set foor in this Walmart again!!!!

When I walked in here I did so with every intention of reviewing it. And in my mind I said, "I've been here a few times and I'm pretty certain a 2-star is the best they'll ever get out of me."

Obviously this visit dissuaded me and gained themselves an extra star.

That said, while the employees are extremely (almost overly) friendly, the store still looks...cheap. Compared to Border's or Barnes and Noble I feel like this is the equivalent of having a taco from Taco Bell rather than Taco Bus (if you don't know what the means, go Yelp! for Taco Bus). 

My point is this: It's good/okay/satisfies-the-"craving", but when it comes down to it there are other, better, places that are just around the corner.

Went with friends from out of state that had not been at a Greek restaurant. Food and service was good. Food came out fast. Bakery right there too was awesome and we purchased some things to take home. Gyros were huge and other dishes had large portions. No lunch menu so felt the portions were a bit large for lunch. I have had better Gyros and sauce in flavor but none that big. The pita bread was very good.

I'm a native to the New Orleans area and I sometimes get upset at the restaurants in the French Quarter area because of all the restaurants here, they will most likely carry the torch and set the example and standard that tourists are impressed with. Muriel's is worthy of carrying that torch! The ambiance is second to none in the area. You can sit at ground zero of the French Quarter and eat great food at the window while watching the horse carriages trot by. The food is great. I usually order the steak tornados medium rare and I'm never disappointed. The service is very good too. I've never waited too long and they never fail to check up on us.

I've been vegan for 11 years now and have been a loyal customer since these establishments opened. I love their food so much my fiancé gave me a 40$ gift card to this location. I normally frequent the one on 40th and walnut (so often that they know my name and order) and the people have always went above and beyond at that location. However, today I went to the Rittenhouse location and after ignoring me for five minutes, the lady wound up taking my order. I ordered 3 items off the menu and I tried to use my gift card. At first it got declined and then a manager came over. She checked my balance and it said 0.00$!!! I was devastated. Since my fiancé doesn't really lie to me (why would he in this situation?) I am left to believe that when he bought the gift card, the worker pocketed the cash and never loaded the gift card. I'm very upset because I love the food so much, but this is unacceptable. They have lost a loyal customer and I will also warn others about the dishonest workers at this location.

I wanted to write a quick update for The Habit for vegetarians. The Habit has an awesome veggie burger, and even though it is more expensive than the standard beef burger it is all dressed up. It comes with sprouts, tomato, onions, lettuce and some kind of sweet sauce with orange slices on the side. You also get the choice of regular bun, wheat bun or french bread--the french bread makes the sandwich quite a bit bigger. 

Avocado and cheese are both extra, but the avocado really makes the sandwich. Pair it with some fries and you have a delicious vegetarian meal. Thanks, The Habit, for offering a veggie burger (not to mention salads) for vegetarians.

I loved Ted Drewes! I am in love with frozen custard now. My awesome traveling partner and I tried a concrete (a new concept to me, the only thing close to it that I have encountered is a blizzard, but that's with ice cream) and a sundae. And WOW. I wish we had frozen custard at home in Cincinnati. I can't wait to stop in St. Louis again to try some different flavors!! I LOVED the texture - the density, the creaminess. No wonder St. Louis natives hype this - I probably will too now!

I'm still a big fan of Il Posto (and the currrent duchess, thank you very much), but thought I would update my review based on my observations last night.

Tuesday & Wednesday nights from 5-8 and around 7 last night (a Tuesday) a small herd of cute 20-something gals all came strolling in. They weren't one big group either. So as my public service to single men of the appropriate age, go check it out.

Great place for wing and pizza!! My uncle live around here so I come and pick up food for parties or just when we hang out. The people here are really nice and read back the order. We ordered a plain pizza, pepperoni and a mushroom pizza. It was really good. The wings are also pretty good here they are crispy and juicy. We did not wait long for our order either. This place also has dine in eating and people around seem to enjoy their meal as well.

Def coming here every time I visit my cousins. Next I want to try there Stromboli's they looked really good. This place also sells beer and the place is clean. They take cash or credit. Did not take picture the first time but I will tale pictures next time.

I'm convinced that the people that work here just make whatever they think you should drink rather than what you actually order. I especially love when one certain condescending employee informs me that "skim milk beverages do not come with whip" after requesting no whip. Oh but it does...every.single.time. The other day, I ordered 3 items and every single item was either made incorrectly or completely the wrong thing.  Also, the drive thru....so slow. Glacial, even.

Great bar!  Their hot wings are among the best in the area!  I would go there just for the wings.  The only problem is that you can still smoke in there but that is a good point for some people.  Beer selection is decent and their service is really good.  I tend to rate bars like this based on comfort level.  Bucket feels like home!

AMAZING MENU. I've been there several times, picking different items each time. Wow. Really amazing stuff to pick at. It seems like a true tapas place even though they aren't really that at all. Definitely check it out.

We LOVE Alpha K9 U! The staff at Alpha K9 truly cares about dogs and their owners. Our two rescue dogs have never been more behaved. 

After a few years we finally decided to get help training them and address some anxiety and aggression issues so we turned to Alpha K9 U. Without hesitation they met with us and whipped us all into shape! We enrolled them into obedience classes and even though we were in a group setting we still felt we were getting individual attention and help. They are also very good at explaining why dogs behave as they do and what it means which was important to us. We worked alot with Kelli and I swear she is like the dog whisperer! 

Everyone here is so friendly and they make you feel so welcome. We cannot thank them enough for all of their help! Even though we now live 15 miles away we will still drive to Alpha K9 U for all of our training, daycare, and boarding needs.

This is my go-to nail salon. I have never gotten any "nail issues" from this place, FYI. Great service, free WIFI, free drinks, clean, decent prices. Need I say more?

PS: I agree that some techs are better than others, but I am not organized enough to jot down names of the good ones.
Surprisingly tasty!  Great pho and grilled meat dishes.  I'm definitely coming back.

Hot dog and fries only review, we didn't sample the ice cream. Firstly, don't go in here expecting some fancy diner. This is a strip mall store with a counter, grill, refrigerator, and an ice cream cooler. There are places for you to sit, but this isn't a Portillo's. 

Prices were good, topping selections were great. The dogs were delicious. I loved the fries, but the ones we got were super soggy and not crisp at all, which happens to be how I like it. 

Service was a little weak, but that's ok. Had to be asked a few things again after the order was taken, and wasn't able to give a topping suggestion when prompted unless we pushed for one.

We went here on a family vacation.  We had reservations and when we turned up,  they said it would be a while because "we just seated a lot of tables, and need to give the servers a rest".  What???  So we looked around in the shop and behind the aquarium.  Our waitress was nice, but really flaky.  Didn't tell us about the specials.  The gluten frees are marked (thank you), and the menus are these cool light up ones, like iPads.   The scallop appetizer was delish, but it only had three scallops and four sprouts for $16.   My fish was good, mahi-mahi, but it was lukewarm and flavors didn't blend well.  Kids meals are $10!   The waitress took our kid to see the aquarium, but never brought refills.  

-1 for service, -1 for cold food, -1 for the poorly explained wait.

The main attraction is the aquarium, not the food.

On Thursday, February 20, 2015 my daughter submitted a request to First American Warranty for service for her garbage disposal.  She was assigned Resnick Plumbing as the contractor to do the work. She called them the next day (February 21). They were unable to schedule an appointment until Wednesday, February 25, 2015 between the hours of 2:00 and 6:00 PM.  They never showed! She called them the next day to reschedule. They said they would be out that day (Thursday, February 26) between 2:00 and 6:00 PM again.  They showed up at 7:30 PM in a $20.00  Uhaul rental van. They were not aware of what needed to be repaired. They even asked to borrow a plunger and then stated they could not complete the work.  They informed her that the office would call the following day to schedule yet another date for the job. It is now Friday, March 6, 2015 and she has yet to hear from the office.   (Since she didn't expect any better from them, she called a plumber she found online that Friday and he came out the same day and fixed the problem).  I would never ever recommend Resnick Plumbing!

Had lunch here today. I live just a few blocks away, but had never come in. I thought from the look of the outside that it was going to be a PF Changs kind of deal, which is a big NOPE for me. If that's your bag, cool, but I prefer more authentic when I can get it. However, at the voice of a friend, I decided to give it a try. 

I got the pork belly double-cooked style, and the taiwanese sausage. The sausage is pretty much exactly what you'd expect, the sweet sausage that you find at Asian groceries, but paired with freshly sliced garlic which took it to another level.

The pork belly was a little drier than I expected. It didn't have exactly the melt in my mouth texture that I tend to associate with pork belly. The sauce, though a little oily, was flavorful and complex. They rated the spice at a four, but honestly I found it pretty mild. I would've put it more at a one or a two.

Despite those few minor nitpicks, this is definitely a place I intend to bring my husband back to to try more things. Maybe next time I'll try the rabbit.

Tried this place for the first time today. Got the 5 alarm pizza for us, a personal cheese for our picky daughter and a free side of superstix for checking in on yelp. Sat down at a table and realized that happy hour was going on and we could have gotten a smaller cheese pizza for a cheaper price. 
Food was pretty great. Our pizza was loaded with toppings. Staff would check up on us periodically to see if we needed anything and how the food was. 
My only real complaint I have ( and I have with all restaurants really) is that the child seats felt and looked gross.

Nice atmosphere and good food. What more could you want? 

Went in for a late Friday dinner. Server was nice and gave us plenty of time to order. Food came out quickly and was very good. 

I will definitely go back and suggest to others.

I love this place. It's a wonderfully authentic south philly establishment. Texas Wieners has been around since before we all started giggling at the word "wiener".

wiener. Yep, still funny.

Wiener jokes aside these guys make great burgers and dogs fast and cheap. I love bringing my kids in for a lunch on a saturday afternoon. Two texas tommies and an order of fries - yes doctor, that's just what I need.

Our hotel called White Fleet for a ride to the airport and scheduled it for 3:30 PM.  He asked if we were paying by credit card so he could notify the cab company.  We were picked up by a nice driver but he did not help us put our bags into the back of his large SUV.  When we arrived at the airport and I showed him American Express he asked if we had cash.  We said no we had to pay with the card and he asked if we had another type of card.  I gave him a Visa.  He said American Express charges $10.  He said if they had told him we were paying with a card he would not have picked us up.  I pointed out that it's a shame then that the city requires him to accept credit cards, the sarcasm was lost on him.  When the machine went to the main menu I had to figure out how to get back to payment because he said he could not touch it.

Worst cab ride ever!

I took my mother here as a gift and it was both our first times here. The inside of the building is very calming and relaxing with a friendly staff. We got a duet massage, I got a Swedish massage and my mother got the deep tissue massage. 

The lockers, robes, slippers, and showers were very nice. The robes were thick and very good quality. It's nice to have that to change into so when you come you don't have to worry about wearing something comfortable enough to get massaged in or having just a towel to cover yourself with. 

The quiet room was very nice and the hot tea was great. I forgot our masseuses names but I had a man and my mother had a woman. I've never had a professional massage before and only had Houston's Chinese Reflexology massages to compare it to. The Swedish massage was relaxing but I wouldn't say it really massaged too many muscles. I literally felt like I was getting a nice rub all over my body. My mother said her massage was good but it became painful when her masseuse used her elbow to massage her shoulder blade. Now that we know, the next time we come back we'll request the deep tissue massage but medium pressure. 

Thanks to their promotion on yelp, we were able to save 10% on our services. I was able to check in but my mother wasn't able to see the 10% discount for checking in. We even tried multiple devices but the kind receptionist eventually gave us the discount anyways. 

Note: The discount is per person so we both had to check in to get a complete 10% off our bill since we paid together. 

We will definitely be back for future services.

This may be the only place that I miss in Nashville it's moving to Denver. All of their dishes are fresh, unamericanized, and have complex flavor profiles. The phad Thai is not just the best in town, but the best ever, short of a flight to bangkok. Always packed, and the owners are awesome, but I've found the takeout waitresses to be pretty rude on the phone. Maybe it tastes better when they're mean.
This coffee shop is one of my favorites. Joe is super welcoming and the coffee is robust and tasty!!! Love love love them!
My favorite breakfast spot in the city & the owner is so nice! Btw try the grits & French toast!

I can only say amazing things about this place! My boyfriend and I are on vacation in Arizona and needed a place to eat. Not knowing anything about this area we decided to resort to yelp and find something that people loved. All the reviews on here are perfect. This place is absolutely amazing! The food was great. Didn't think we'd find this place in the middle of nowhere. Tacos were delicious and drinks are on point. I tried the sangria rosa and that definitely something I couldn't get enough of. The perfect flavors blended together.  We have one more day left here and we're already talking about making this a stop before we leave.

The food was on point, as always, but due to how busy this place was, (Still here.Just paid our check) Cam was superb! He was attentive, informative, never flinched when we had questions. 
Far too often, people only post the negatives. This was a major positive. We'll be back soon and we'll be asking for Cam!

No no no no no no no no no no no no no 
We waited two hours just for our drink orders to be taken then after 3 and a half hours of eating we finely got our food and it was not that good

First off, I loved that there was a free parking lot behind the restaurant, which is rare for restaurants in Nashville anymore.  The restaurant wasn't busy (Monday) but we had great service and really enjoyed our visit.  We ordered six different dishes, and all were excellent and full of flavor.

Overall, the spicy tuna guacamole is the dish that would bring me back.  It's like sushi meets guac.  I wish the potatoes had been crispier, but we ate until we were stuffed anyways.  It was really a delicious meal, and now I understand why the reviews on Yelp are so good!  Oh, and the caipirinha I had was delish too.

I'd come back to Americano to drink and munch on tapas with friends.   Probably wouldn't pick it for a 1-on-1 date night, but definitely for a group who wants to share plates and not get too full on a single dish.

I love this place, great local spot especially for holiday brunch. The food is consistently good, service is always friendly despite how busy they always are and portions are fare for the price. Favorite is the open faced turkey and brunch selections.

My mother and I decided to check out The Prime Rib after seeing reviews online. First off, it is in a great location (Rittenhouse Square). It was very conscience that to hop on an elevator, walk a few feet, and end up here. Second of all, the restaurant seems to get some traffic for the bar as well (a plus, because you know it's a popular spot). We both ended up ordering the house salad, which was delicious for a salad (I'm not really a salad person). The fact that I enjoyed it says a lot. I ended up ordering the split cut prime rib (medium rare). My mom ordered the prix fixe prime rib got two sides along with it (corn and mashed potatoes). The prime rib was delicious and perfectly cooked. Additionally, our waiter George was phenomenal. We ended our meal with desserts. We left stuffed, and with leftovers! Would recommend to anyone in the area. Will come back again.

Love Panda, this location has serious management issues. 2 stars is a stretch, but when you do get the food it is good.

Every time I go, they never have adequate staffing and the staff always complain that they've been short-staffed all day.

One time I went in they had 2 options for entrees (orange chicken and something else) and everything else had a wait, and the line was to the door with about 15 people in line, which is what another reviewer mentioned as well as the posted pictures. And this has happened on multiple occasions. They seem to have 2 people cooking, 1 person washing dishes, and 1 person serving food (maybe 2).

One time there was a line to the door and only 1 poor girl to serve food while there was 1 girl and 1 cook sitting down at the table in clear sight. I understand they legally have to take their lunch, but don't do it in front of a line of customers who are watching you.

I asked for one of the "premium" items one time that costs $1 more and they said its frozen and has to be "prepared" and would take at least 20 minutes...if I wanted to wait that long, I would have went to a sit-down restaurant.

Please review this place if you experience similar as they hopefully will make some changes.

Love the ambience here as well as the menu. I've been stopping by for iced coffees or the mango avocado smoothie (awesome with soy milk) and a bagel with tofutti, and love all of these. Today I tried their vegan chicken salad with the potato salad on the side and it was INCREDIBLE. Loved the flavor and the texture of each, will definitely be adding this to the list of regular items.

The waiter was super nice and so was the owner. So, that part is great and lots of beers to choose from. However, the restaurant is very tired, needs painting redone and in serious need of good cleaning, window sills, bathrooms,... The food is at best mediocre and for the price, definitely not worth it. They are very nice people working there though. So their heart is in it, just need to make some changes.

We found the place on yelp and thought to try it with my family.   There were 6 of us that arrived at about 530pm on a Monday and it was not busy.  We ordered several dishes like the egg plant, snow pea, scallion pancakes, chicken nuggets and more.  The food was authentic like home made which was tasty indeed.   Yes I would recommend to friends.

Went to Revivals for Easter Brunch Buffet total disappointment!   Over cook eggs, lunch meat ham,  lasagna with no sauce, bizarre sausage,  limp bacon, and horrendously over price at $15.99 for such low low quality food.   I don't have a problem paying for food if it's good but this was not.    Contacted the restaurant via email they quickly emailed me back to tell me no one else complained but the other Yelp reviews back what I'm saying here.

This is a great place to study or read the paper, but especially on weekends you have to get there by 9 or 10 AM at the latest if you want to actually get a spot. There are large tables to spread your things out on, plenty of outlets, and good wireless. They're also open until 10, which is very, very late for a neighborhood coffee shop and much appreciated.  It's NOT a great place to have a casual conversation because most of its patrons seem to think it's a public library and will shoot you dirty looks.  The coffee and food are decent--not great--and reasonably priced, and the staff is friendly.

Went back couple weeks ago, OK OK..one -star up..see inklings of improvements. Our nice Waiter who recognized us -asked if we were ordering our favorite Aussie drink, it was a bit Cold..but thought that was nice little personable touch..

Our food came out nice, no mishaps, nothing burnt.I do see that now, the check comes with actual prices on them, instead of before  when you were rung up, nothing on receipt, cashier would just ring it up based codes . I was always skeptical about that.. I like it much better. So signs of improvement I must say..keep at it!!! Who knows, & now they have a Dinner menu..WOW!!! extended hours..Hmmmm.might have to check that out.

Whenever I'm in a jam for a meal in Haddonfield, Animo is my go-to for a fresh, quick meal. The store recently moved just a block to two away, a couple doors down from Starbucks.  The new location seems a little more cozy if you are going to sit down and eat in.  

I've had various incarnations of some of the burritos, bowls, and salads and everything is always fresh and tasty.  The burritos are pretty big and stuffed, very filling, so lately I've been opting more for bowls.  The Nutty Honey B makes a delicious post-run breakfast, and I can't get enough of the Frozen Banana Custard (formally called the Chilly Gorilla) with any of its various toppings.  

When I was in there last time, I noticed that they had changed their menu.  Their burrito/bowl menu is much simpler, with more emphasis on building your own meal, with only a few specialty burrito suggestions.  I was quite pleased to see that they finally added some oatmeal to their breakfast menu, with various toppings to add on.  

I actually haven't tried any of their juices or smoothies, but I am keeping it in mind for the next time I'm in town and need an afternoon pick-me-up.  Having a sweet tooth, the only think I wish they'd offer were some vegan options along with their other delicious-looking baked goods.  If I lived or worked in Haddonfield, there'd be a problem because I'd be there way too much, and it's not a cheap place!  

Love Animo!  Check it out!

Best dentist my family had been too. Personable and take great care of our teeth. Sadly our insurance changed and we had to start going to an in-network dentist, but as soon as we have different insurance we are going back here.
KiKi is AWESOME...She really pays attention to detail and my nails always look great.  I Love this place and have had nothing but a Great Experience.

Do not ! I repeat Do Not get your haircut from here. The worst haircut I have ever gotten in my life. I asked for layers and to get bangs. The gentleman (White frosted hair) who cut my hair, messed it all up. My bangs are very short and not even. They don't even shape around my head and one side is shorter than the other side. This is the first time I have every been in this Supercuts, but I can tell you I will never go back. I will take my unhappy butt across the street to Hair Cutter, where I know they will do what I asked for.

What can I say about Pancake Pantry other then to say they are amazing!? The service was excellent and I was lucky to get there at a time when I could literally walk right in without a wait.  The pancakes were smaller then I expected so I ended up ordering a bit more food (it was late in the day and I hadn't eaten a thing). Everything was delicious!
