Wonderful little hotel in Santa Barbara. Greg and Jennifer are amazing hosts who go above and beyond to make sure each guest is comfortable and well taken care of. The beach is a 5 minute walk from the hotel and the pier is just a short drive away. The rooms are newly renovated, clean, bright, and spacious. Jennifer makes breakfast every morning which is such a nice touch and her biscuits are amazing!
Had a wonderful lunch here, cant believe the ambience, local traditional jazz playing in the background, what more could you ask? excellent brandy milk punches too!

This is one of my favorite spots. We have never had anything that we did not like. We love the cheese curds, bar bacon, and all the burgers we have tried. But even better then the food is the staff. We love our waitress Sheena, we will wait to sit in her area. She remembers all our favorites and treats us like family. The manager Andreya is so sweet she always makes time to visit the table and literally gave the shirt off her own back for someone. My daughter was cold and Andreya gave her the sweater she was wearing so she was warm.

Have been here a few times now. ;)
My dog was the oddball out, a little aggressive being the newbie. EVERYONE helped work him into the mix and allowed him the time to blend in. Now he is one of the pack and belongs. The Park is extremely well taken care of by the people that go there. It is nice my Spot looks forward to his visits.  ;)

I had my very first float on Sunday, 1/19/14. This is something I have wanted to try for many years. Nashville Float & Massage is the first and only one in Tennessee. 

I was extremely anxious prior to going - 90 minutes of total isolation seemed a little unnerving. That said, I did cheat and left my tank door open which Mark said was fine. The lights in the room were on a motion sensor so once I was in the tank they went out. The only perceivable light was the equivalent of a couple candles. 

The water came to mid-shin and was approximately body temperature. I laid back and floated like a cork, never once touching the bottom of the tank despite the water being only about 10 inches deep. It was a surreal experience as I tried to get acclimated to being weightless. The water temperature is such that you feel one with the water. I couldn't perceive which parts of my body were in the water and which were floating above the water.  I found that if I clasped my hands behind my head it allowed me to relax my neck and shoulders which was hard at first (they supply a neck pillow if needed), but I found this position very relaxing like reclining on a beach chair in the Caribbean. 

Being conscious & lying perfectly still was very odd for me so I stretched my body several times in different directions, cracked my knuckles (that's loud under water) and then started a gentle side-to-side swaying motion - fancying myself a bit of a MERMAID... but it was VERY relaxing.

After what seemed like 40-45 minutes, I wondered if I could go for another 45 minutes then I faintly heard music playing under the water. That was the sign that my 90 minutes was up. REALLY? It has been 90 minutes???

I told Amy, "I can see why this could become addictive". She suggested I try different times of the day/week to see which is best for me. I'm even considering a late night float (2-1/2  hours). I did feel really relaxed even though I was conscious/awake the entire time - or, at least I think I was... I slept like a baby Sunday night. 

"Get Tanked"!! This is a once in a lifetime experience. But for me, it won't be ONCE. I am plotting my return to Nashville Float and Massage - probably in the next two weeks. Next time I will close the door and plan to follow up with a massage after. I can see myself becoming a regular fixture at this place and highly recommend it to everyone. I haven't shut up about it all day, even gave my supervisor a brochure.

Mark & Amy (the owners) are amazing!! Thank you for working so hard to make this a reality in Nashville. See you soon.

Went in for dinner last night with my son and friend. We waited for quite some time before we received anything to drink. They were pretty busy, yet another reason why we thought it was a great choice for dinner. 

I ordered a burger medium, it came out MOOOing. I took the first bite and almost got sick. I told my waitress, she attempted to fix it. She was very polite, and understood. After that raw bite, I was nauseous and no longer had an appetite. I didn't want a replacement.  THEN a BAR MAID, I think her name was ALLY, felt it necessary to invite herself into our ordering fiasco and made matters 100 times worse. She insisted I took the burger, asked me 3-4 times if I wanted the new burger, bringing it to my table obsessively. (sounds like good customer service, but was quite the opposite)

The problem was, my waitress gave me the wrong burger, my burger came up right after that one. When this BAR MAID brought the correct burger out 2 minutes after I sent my burger back, there was absolutely no way I was going to eat that burger, having no idea that the "live cow" I bit a chunk out of was someone else's burger.  I could hear the BAR MAID at the food counter rambling on and on about the burger, my table, my son and was not only rude, but not fit for the service industry. My son left the restaurant and waited in the car for me and my friend to finish.  This employee had no idea of the situation, but inserted herself in our dining experience. If I could give a -3 stars I would. 

Note to RESTAURANT OWNERS: I know good people are hard to find, but if you sacrifice customer service, you let money walk out of the door. 
Your horrible service will propel people like me to share the experience on YELP for others to see.
This place is great to hang out and just have beer with friends and the owner if he's around very friendly service and the food is always delicious!
Excellent food & service. The guacamole was fantastic and the staff is very welcoming and offered excellent suggestions.

I have to say we would not of usually ate here but my husband had so many comped buffets we figured why not? Umm why not, because the food was AWFUL! and I mean everything was bland and awful!
You see a big variety however until you taste it is just yucky! I don't reccomend!

Smiley's is a hidden jewel in manayunk. The restaurant is a cute cafe with a very nice owner who cooks everything himself and makes the sauces fresh. He is super nice and the food is good and affordable. I like the beef or chicken platter. Smoothies are also very yummy!

Ordered an adjustable bed frame and mattress on April 8th. Mattress was out of stock so I told them to deliver one month later since I was going on vacation. On May 1st bed frame was delivered with no mattress. Delivery people banged up my stairway wall as well. Will never shop this store again.

I had a great purchasing experience with the pre-owned center.  My concern was with the service department. They tried to upsell me something that I didn't need.  They said my power steering fluid needed flushing because it had metal shavings in it and it was 'old'. I had purchased it Certified Pre-Owned 6 months earlier and it clearly states that the fluids are changed. I asked the service consultant what was wrong with my power steering system that would cause metal shavings to enter a closed loop ps system.  She just shrugged and said I would have to ask the technician who was busy.  I declined the $200 ps flush.  I have never been back.  How can I trust a service department that just makes stuff up?  The oil changes are way overpriced to begin with, but to have to brace yourself for the barrage of made up service issues each time you bring it in?  No thanks. I have a mechanic I can TRUST.  That being said, I will buy another CPO Lexus from there in a second.

Having the most wonderful week at a hotel in the French quarter la plaza De armed during jazz fest someone books me here and I get totally humiliated by Chris front desk clerk because I dripped A bit of alcohol on the tile..i love nola but not the dreary inn...i have never been treated so bad
feeling like constantly watched and rushed is nooooot good. I went in yesterday and they were on me about things. if I need help I'll definitely come up to you and ask.
Another average Chinese Buffet! Pretty clean because it is a newer building, but starting to show a little wear, and the typical Chinese buffet owner not doing anything to maintain the property.

Great location, very nice venue, ample parking, good selection of beers, great bartender (Reagan), good eats. Spendy, but I'd rather eat here than at McGrath's or Red Lobster. Outside seating when the weather is nice is the best way to experience Joe's.

I eat at this place a couple of times a month. It's a pretty big place with easy parking, fair to low prices, and offers quick, reliable and friendly service by staff who seem to be loyal to the place and stick around quite a while. This offers primarily the sort of home-style cooking you'd see in northern small town family restaurants. Some of the specials they have are out of this world delicious (lamb shanks, I'm thinking of you)! The menu has a good variety of red meat (mostly steaks and burgers) and seafood options, as well as some tasty omelets. The salad bar (a key feature for me in restaurants that offer them) is quite good though small, and offers enough fresh topping options to satisfy my salad craving ways, and fresh, though small. It always included 2 soups. Some that I've tried are split pea, tomato barley, chicken noodle and clam chowder. The clams in the chowder are always tender and plentiful, though this is not your traditional Boston chowder - this one has more of a thickened chicken base. 

The ambiance at Kally K's leaves much to be desired. It is quite outdated (imagine 80s country living room style) and the carpeted floor needs to be replaced. The clientele is mostly senior citizens (couples and sometimes large groups), so it's refreshing to see families and younger couples enjoying time at Kally K's. With a makeover, some fresh marketing, and a few modern menu items, this place could really become a hit with younger generations as well.

I've been here many times and each time had been with great service. All the ladies are so sweet and kind. My nails are done well and if I mess then up before I leave, they're always there to do a quick fix. I've also had eye brow waxed done and it's been great each time. They listen and keep my brows fuller. 
The wine is also a nice touch. 

Pic of a regular manicure 3 days later.

The decor is old and in desperate need of an update but the food is always consistent   The chicken tenders are the best in the business and what else needs to be said about the taters?  Just yummy!!  Not good for you but OMG are they delicious  the prices are a little higher than they need to be but it's a nice change

My daughter got good news and we decided to celebrate by trying out this new restaurant which we had heard great things about. We ordered online for take-out. 

My daughter ordered the veggie kabob with Greek salad and grilled potatoes as a side. I had the Mediterranean grilled chicken with  Greek salad and for my side, I had fresh fruit. Pita bread was included with both meals. 

Everything was phenomenal. My chicken was perfectly seasoned and cooked just right. The Greek salad was amazing: very fresh greens, feta cheese, cucumbers and Kalamata olives. The veggie kabob had grilled zucchini, portobello mushrooms, peppers and onions, all arranged on two wooden skewers. The grilled potatoes were out of this world. I am going to try to find a recipe so I can make them at home. They had a slightly lemony taste and the potatoes were cooked just right-- not too crispy but not mushy either. Wow. 

The only negative was that the meals were supposed to come with braised white beans and these were missing from both our dinners. If we had been dining in the restaurant, I am sure we could have had this matter taken care of. Since we got our order to eat at home, we couldn't fix it. So 4 stars for overlooking a part of the menu but 5 stars overall. We will definitely return to Zoe's.

Stopped in here for a drink and an appetizer while staying at the hotel ... ending up staying for more than one drink ... Great local beer list. My husband enjoyed trying different beers and our server was super knowledgeable. The cocktails were intimidating (and a lot feature bourbon or whiskey ... I'm not a fan) so I stuck to some cider from New Day. 

When we sat down, we were served delicious popcorn (it had truffle oil on it, if I remember right). One small quibble -- other tables were served multiple bags but we were only offered one. Waaaah. We also ordered a charcuterie plate, which was delicious. They can prepare appetizer type food at the bar but also have heartier meals you can order from the restaurant downstairs. 

The cocktails that I saw looked interesting -- I spied one with a spherical ice cube. 

We sat and watched the sun set while we drank. Nice setting. The crowd was mixed. We were dressed pretty casually, as were others, while some people were clearly starting their night out. The lighting is stunning -- this would be a great place to impress a date or out-of-town guests.
Really great pizzas. All the toppings are good, and the salads are fresh. Nice charred crust, tangy sauce, and the whole wheat option is awesome. It's nice to have such good pizza so close to home.

I enjoy walking around this mall cuz of the great stores it has for my east coast taste. It's as 'upscale' as Reno can be (I say that in the most minimal sense). I like how it's easily accessible from the freeway. A  handful of restaurants and a movie theater round out this 'mall'.. The only thing I majorly dislike is the poor layout of The Summit, but can't fix that at this point.

Been here 3 times in 3 weeks.
This place is competitively the best indian place around.
Food tastes good. Service is pleasant. Everything is fresh!

Their south indian seems a bit  lacking. But it is equally difficult to prepare.

Three words:

NOM
NOM
NOM

What a completely sublime experience that did not, I repeat, did not break the bank. I fed myself and three other people for under $40.  And they were fed with some of the best food I have had in the city.  The brisket drew oohs and ahhs from all party members at the table while we were treated to some ginormous texas toast and delicious taco salad.  

The service was top notch with water, chips and food being delivered very professionally and succinctly.  Well done!  

This will seriously go into the rotation of great places for us to eat nearby.

Horrible and terrifying experience last year. Don Staten completely disturbed me. He complimented me constantly & proceeded to COME OUT TO MY CAR after the appointment and knock on my window to "let me know if there was anything else I needed" and gave me his phone number. Disgusting. If you're a young women don't go here alone!!!

Where do I begin about the fabulousness that is called Sylvia's?? I was in Tampa for the weekend and wanted a great brunch spot to eat at on Sunday morning before heading back to Jax and Sylvia's came highly recommended. We were seated immediately and given the choice of ordering off the menu or eating the buffet. We chose the buffet and boy oh boy am I glad we did. cooked to order omelets and waffles, fried chicken, baked chicken, baked fish, collard greens, bacon, biscuits, oh my goodness! And let's not talk about the most delectable macaroni and cheese I have ever eaten...EVER!  All this yumminess at $13.99 per person!! 

There was nothing I tried that I did not love and had no choice but to stop eating after 2 full plates! I didn't have room to try the peach cobbler which is my favorite dessert. It was all washed down with a yummy mimosa, not bottomless but still reasonably priced at $4.00. 

I loved this place so much that I would drive to St. Pete's just to have brunch there! Anybody down to come hang with me? Sylvia's Sunday Gospel Brunch is a must eat, I'll be back for sure!

Amazing, amazing. Exactly what we were looking for. Amazing food, great atmosphere. Where have we been. Met friends, made plans to come back next week. Staff and waiters right on point! And my drink was perfect.

Not very impressive for a slow night. Service was OK but everything took a good amount of time. Drinks....20 minutes. Apps....another 20. Fries....45. Food was just ok. The spiciest wings were barely palatable, the pickle fries were mushy by the kids mess we're relish!  We've been sitting 30 minutes since they cleared our plates to get a check.

I dined here for the first time and I was impressed with the food.  You can tell they really do have something special and unique going on. The beef is from good stock.  Usually when I eat beef I feel heavy and bloated because of the red meat.  The quality of the meat and freshness of the ingredients enhanced my dining experience.  I had the mushroom & Swiss burger and paid the extra $1 to upgrade to truffle fries.   That was a no brainier and it was sooooo worth it!!  Fried pickles were also a tasty treat before the meal arrived.  I will definitely return and you get "5 Burgers Up" in my opinion:)

I've been to this location probably 50+ times since they opened a few years ago. This is not fine dining but when you have kids and you want something fast, this is an option you can feel moderately better about. Historically the service and food has been decent. Over the last 4-5 months there has been a significant decline in food, service and facility. It's so significant I can only assume this is a change in ownership. The food is consistently undercooked or overcooked, sloppily assembled, and often wrong. The facility, once clean and well maintained is now beat up and often dirty (and not just when they're busy). Tonight they had burned something, the air was thick and hazy. We asked them if they could open the door to ventilate the place because it was irritating our eyes. The "manager" said, "sure, you can open the door if you want". I replied that I wasn't sure how to prop the door open and it might be better if he did it. He went over, he'd it open for 20 seconds, closed it and walked away. We were one of two tables in the entire restaurant. So speaking of the staff, who were always friendly, they are no longer overly nice. However, the straw that broke the camel's back for me was watching one girl, watch me, watch her pick her nose. Then the other girl reached inside her shirt to adjust her undergarments. 

So good times! I can't wait for the new Whole Foods sit down section to open so I have a better local option. We can only eat at b.Good so often.

A very tasty blend of funnel cake and donut.  Made onsite and served warm with a pile of powdered sugar on top.  They are big too.  Much larger than expected.  I ordered an egg sandwich along with it, but cannot describe its flavor because I was too full to eat.  Also enjoyed a sweet tea that was refreshing.  It was not too sweet and really cold.  Enjoying this breakfast with jazz playing in the courtyard along Bourbon.  It feels like the right way to enjoy a simple New Orleans longtime favorite.

Our group of six diners had a very uneven experience. The restaurant air conditioning was not working. The service was very slow, with the whole experience taking over three hours. It took an hour and a half until the appetizers arrived, and then an additional forty five until the entrees appeared. The kitchen was slammed and never recovered. The kitchen may have suffered from the presence of George Perrier, as he visited the kitchen. The french press coffee was was my only highlight of the evening.

The woman behind the counter was very helpful and friendly. I was looking for a saw and she showed me their bargain bin saw as well as a sturdier if pricer option. They have all the basic DIY stuff for home and garden. I will definitely shop here before I head to one of the big box stores!

The burger and fries were amazing! I had the 'turbo' with the spicy fries and would recommend it to others as well. The service was decent enough and didn't have to wait long whatsoever. I've noticed that others have had problems with the service looking at the reviews, but the guys who helped us got our orders correct and were helpful.

They suck their staff are super roud and they don't respect customers. They know their service only comes from college kids so they know they have to keep up with basic standards which is pretty bad even for college kids (I'm a student myself). Honestly horrible establishment.
Stay here 1-2 times a year. Room prices are good, many restaurants to choose from, relaxing day spa, descent fitness facility, and large pool area. Downfall some of the rooms need updated.

I took my dog in for urinary problems.  She had been on antibiotics to see if it was an infection but the problem kept recurring.  They did a sonogram and found a mass in her bladder.  Most likely cancerous.  They put her on anti-inflammatory medication which helped immensely with her frequent urination problems.  Sadly, her case is terminal but the staff was very compassionate and helpful.  We do not know how long we will have her with us but we are grateful for the doctors and staff here for helping us through this last journey with our sweet pup. Thank you.

They say that there is no bad place to eat in N.O.  Wrong! I found it. I payed $15.95 for a shrimp poboy and what I got was a sloppy French roll with a few shrimp(about the size of a nickle) and some lettuce. So disappointing. This was the most expensive poboy I've had all week and it was pathetic. Buy spices from this place, but do yourself a favor; walk a few spaces down and get a real poboy!

I'm definitely a fan of this place, but I agree with commentary on the other yelp reviews.

Came in for happy hour, had two abita beers, shared mac & cheese and the pork empanadas. Really great stuff and the total only came out to about $12 each for my friend and I.

I did honestly feel like the bartenders were all in a sour mood. Just asking a question here or there or ordering something from the menu, I felt like I was inconveniencing them. I was also disappointed because so many reviews said they have great popcorn and I was there from 5:15-6:30 and no popcorn was served. We asked about it and they said they would bring it out, and they never did - so womp womp.

I would come back for happy hour, just be prepared to not expect a warm welcome from the people that work here. No idea why the bartenders don't like the patrons!

High end casino for Reno. Even with all of the very nice improvements they've made over the last decade or so, it would still be considered average or slightly below in Vegas. The rooms in the Tuscany tower are pretty nice.  I've stayed and played here many times, and have always been treated well. The players club is pretty generous with the promotional chips or free slot play. Nice poker room and sportsbook. A few little shops to entertain the ladies, but nothing like the enormous shopping malls attached to some the Vegas casinos. Pretty decent restaurant options. Fast, convenient valet parking, nice pool.
Not a fan, but I am rather picky. I enjoyed the catfish and the cheese grits are amazing. Interesting atmosphere but extremely noisy.

Best sushi restaurant! Sakana has the yummiest rolls and press boxes. My favorites are the light and healthy, mozzarella red wine eel and the habanero yt melt. For an appetizer you have to get the misozuke or poke salad. Their chirashi entree and salmon belly are also bomb. Besides the food, the staff, sushi chefs and owners are the best ever! The restaurant is small so be patient and don't be afraid to sit at the bar, which I prefer over the tables.
Pretty good and cheap. My fave place to get boba here.  if only they sold snacks...

What can you say about a bagel shop?  Surprisingly: tons.  All you really need to know is that the bagels are made daily, the cream cheese is homemade, and the bagels have toppings ON BOTH SIDES.  That is generally my biggest gripe about bagel shops.  You order an everything bagel, and you get 1/2 an everything and 1/2 a plain.  Not here!  TOPPINGS ON BOTH SIDES! YAY!  The ladies behind the counter are always polite and prompt.  The coffee is great (and purchasable by the pound either whole bean or ground).  And the previously mentioned homemade cream cheese?  Incredible.  Tons of flavors: Veggie (my favorite), honey, strawberry, chocolate chip, smoked salmon, etc...  Pick any of them, you can't go wrong.  I love picking up a baker's dozen on a Saturday morning and making bagel sandwiches at home all weekend.  Pro-tip: If ordering a dozen, have them slice only half.  That way you can freeze the other half and save them for later.  The only downside to the fresh bagels, is they do tend to go stale after a couple of days if you order them sliced.

I could not be more excited about this place opening up.  To me, the area has always lacked a quality bagel store.  The bagels are light and delicious - filling but don't feel like a brick in your stomach.  I wish they had olive cream cheese, I was pretty disappointed that they do not offer it.  However, I know I am in the small minority of people who like it, so not too surprising.

My husband brought bagels home, so I haven't been to the shop yet.  However, he said the donut selection was impressive and they looked amazing.  Unfortunately for me, I don't like donuts.  However, I am sure he will be back at some point to try them out.

So happy to have this place in town. Will absolutely be back.

We were told that this is THE place to eat for Mexican/Tex-Mex food in O'fallon. Wrong. The food wasn't gross, which saves this business from a 1-star, but it was far from flavor or interesting. 

The buffet we heard rave reviews about was pretty lame and didn't offer much choice. Perhaps I'm skewed by being told how awesome it was, but this was definitely one of the poorer experiences I've had at any restaurant, especially a themed one.
Loved it! We order 6 tacos and guac and it was all delicious! Cute place and wonderful staff! We will be back and have decided to pick up tacos on our way to our next concert!

Went back two out of three nights in Nashville. Every flavor we tasted was amazing! Never thought I would find something that could give Tillamook Chocolate Peanut Butter a run for its money but this was up there!

Samosa chaat is excellent. I got it wild (extra spicy) and it didn't disappoint. 

Staff is friendly and courteous. Highly recommend if you're in West Philly or visiting.

A great meal every time we come; they use fresh, local ingredients, bake their own breads and have delicious desserts! It is cozy and welcoming...... Sort of like going to your grandma's house (if your grandma is a gourmet chef). Comfort food but with healthy choices.... Can't beat that.

I routinely wait for the bus on Idaho St., and have thought of stopping here for a bite, but never have had the time.  After what I witnessed today, I never will.  I was told it was the owner who did this, but who knows.  Whoever it was should be fired.  If it was the owner, he should be put out of business.  As I was waiting for the bus "The Owner" came out of the restaurant and started verbally abusing and harassing a man waiting for the bus.  He kept insulting the man by telling him that he would be taking the bus for the rest of his life, and would never amount to anything.  I take offense to this, as should any of us who need to take Valley Ride to get to our destinations.  Mr. Moon's Kitchen, you will never serve me.  I hope all of Boise sees this, and you never serve any of them again either.  You are completely unprofessional and undeserving of the business from the good people of Boise.

Finally a poke eatery. My husband and I traveled from St. Pete area for lunch today and were glad we did. Yelp reviews were on point. Very fresh ingredients. The owner was helpful in making my final sauce decision. The octopus was delectable. We will be back!
Indeed I've had better. The only thing that keeps having me come back is their "Heart Attack" appetizer. Hooray for heart burn! **sarcasm**
This Brewery is awesome for a good quick bite, but also for their amazing beer! It's a great young professional and also college age vibe in the restaurant itself.

Cute selection of upscale shoes (and even in my baby feet size!) and handbags. The sales person was helpful without being pushy and actually seemed occupied by store tasks rather than her cellphone!  

The costume jewelry and other accessories were fun too.  Also, this one of the locations where you can check out Dominque Giordano's creations in person since her shop across the street is shut down.
Since my first review, we have been back several times, and it seems they are limiting items more and more.  They are "out" of favorites on the menu, like Unagi and limit desserts to just "one".  :(

Went to Cheu Noodle Bar for first time yesterday.  Was a decent place. I got the Crispy Sweet Potatoe Rangoon which was excellent! Also had the Miso Ramen which was decent.  The area is pretty small and there is no where to stand while you are waiting to be seated.

I didn't really like my haircut and the prices aren't any more substantially comparable to other places in Santa Barbara... my haircut was a bit uneven, choppy, and too short on one side compared to the other... waiting for it to grow out to go to my usual person-- but went here to give it a shot.

The lady who cut my hair is very nice and sociable... she seems to do good haircuts on other people but I think mine just didn't turn out the way I wanted to... oh well!

Service: friendly, prompt, courteous, outstanding.
Outdoor seating: sunny and breezy.  Very comfortable. 
Kitchenware: nothing plastic. All real stemware, flatware and dishes. YAY!  Lends to tastier fare and friendlier to the environment.  
Cold beer in a real glass: bonus!

Downside: the server recommended Crabby Bills "hearty portions" of grouper in the meals and sandwiches.  I was hooked then later disappointed to find this meager fillet dwarfed by a mega bun.  Big expectation, diminished value.  

Flavor: fair for both meals.  Grouper sandwich (noted above) Philly chicken (OK bun, lightly seasoned smothered in cheese)

Walked in on a Tuesday around 11:45 and was seated for lunch looking out on Jackson Square.  I had the seafood gumbo and a stuffed mirliton
made with shrimp and andouille stuffing with a roasted Creole tomato sauce.  Washed it all down with a couple of martinis made with a raspberry vodka and champagne.  Everything was delicious and the service was excellent.  Next time I'm in NOLA this will be a dinner choice.

My complaint revolves around 1 thing. No red cream soda. I can only assume the owner is trying to cut a corner and pay less for cheaper strawberry Fanta, which has been immediately offered to me every time I ask for red cream soda. I've been a few times now and it's clear that even though they have Barq's red cream soda on their sign, they don't get it for their customers anymore. This has literally been a staple item for me when I do decide to go to White Castle. I've made the decision this is my last time going to this White Castle or any other, unless they have Barq's cream soda.

There was no soy sauce in my order. Barely any ponzu sauce and the tuna and salmon were sliced in correctly. I'm VERY disappointed. How can you slice fish into LARGE cubes? Never ordering from here again. The tuna is brown, the jalapeños are not fresh. I would like a full on refund.

This is a great service company.  They cleaned my air conditioning ducts which were really, really dirty.  We bought the house about 7 months ago and I don't think that the ducts had ever been cleaned -- 10 years of lint and dust in the ductwork.  Dean's showed up on time and took about three hours cleaning my air conditioning ducts and dryer vent.  I cannot believe the difference in the system's efficiency now.  My guess is that my air conditioning system is at least 15% more efficient now.  This was a very messy job and David, the tech, was very clean and courteous.  I would definitely use them again and I would recommend them to others.

Downgrading here based on the service during our most recent visit. I brought in a party of 6 this time. I was looking forward to taking my parents and friends here after a fabulous visit last year. The problem was not the food we ingested, but the food that was cleared and spilled onto our laps and the floor. My friends purse was almost slopped on, my dads shorts were dripped on, and I was constantly fearing for my face every time a server reached across to fill water or clear a plate. I've never seen plates scraped off at the table...come on really?
It's a shame because the food is great but we will not be back. Well, Maybe if they start to offer dry cleaning with purchase of an entree.

Great place if you like poor quality sushi...these ratings are ridiculous and false...I gave this place a 2nd chance after 5 years and yup...still disgusting...honestly if u want sushi...go down the street to Kiku...

SO GREAT!

From the drinks, to the bread, to the main course everything was great and seasoned perfectly.  I really enjoyed the filet mignon and parmesan risotto. The only thing I didn't care for was the garlic mash.. they seemed dry and the presentation was bad.. literally looked like it came out of an ice cream scoop.  But honestly this was super minor compared to how great everything else was.  I will definitely be back!

Came here on a Sunday on way to Philadelphia Outlets and what a lovely surprise. Tucked away amid beautiful scenery, the restaurant offers fast and friendly service plus fresh delicious sushi rolls. Highly recommend the veggie roll and geisha roll. Our server also brought us delicious tempura fried bananas for a complimentary dessert. A great place to stop if shopping in Skippack. A+

Delicious and beautiful!  Creative baked goods presented in a lovely boutique style shoppe.  Got the 6 pack special of macaroons for their happy hour special.  50% off so they were $1 each for s pack of six, total $6.  Also picked up a flaky and tasty Apple galette.

Excellent food and even better service. Real authentic mexican food. They bring your chips out hot and crispy! Salsa is very good and they'll make it as hot or mild as you wish. It has an attached grocery store where you can buy meats already seasoned. The carne asada meat sold by the pound comes with chips, salsa, tortillas and everything you need to make them at home. Very affordable. At last an authentic Taqueria we frequent often. Just good folks cooking good food!

First off, don't let the fact that this restaurant is inside a hotel affect your decision to go here. We were staying at the best western across the street and checked yelp for places within walking distance (took us 5.5 hours in lovely rush hour Atlanta traffic to get to Nashville so the last place we wanted to be was in a car). We met Lewis when we sat down (very nice guy) and ordered the edamame based on his feedback that it "wasn't hot at all" - Lewis, I am not sure if someone overdid it with the spices on ours but DANG it was spicy! Good....but definitely had a large kick. So just be warned! :)

Great local beers on tap. Good service and nice atmosphere.

Pamela and I stayed here for the duration of our New Orleans vacation and loved it.

Even though some major construction is taking place, you would never know it, at least not in the Royal Salon Suite we had. No noise, vibration, dust, etc.

AC was perfect...  I like it 70 degrees constantly, and it was just that.

Water pressure was awesome with well regulated water temp in the shower. Jacuzzi was huge...

Check in was fast. Parking valet was fast.

It poured heavily one evening and the young dude out front braved winds and sideways rain to hail us a cab...  His umbrella was the only victim to the storm. Poor guy was soaked, but kept smiling.

Rooms were spacious, and housekeeping did a great job of keeping ours looking perfect.

The Carousel Bar is unique... You need to visit it at least once.  Yes, you rotate around the bar, the room is not spinning.

Visit the roof pool at sunset.

It is just a couple minutes walk from the Bourbon St. madness, but it did not spill over to the hotel at all.

The Monteleone will be our hotel next time we are in NOLA!!!!

John & Pamela Hoyt - SC

This place was so not with the price. Chips were staleish. I asked waitress if I could get shrimp in tacos some other way than fried and she said no, they are pre battered.  So we ordered fish tacos and fish was fried. Husband got mole salmon which had no flavor so he had to ask for hot sauce. Bill was 100 for 2 small tacos, salmon and a few drinks. This place will not last long.

Ok so this is my favorite place to have a great beer and excellent food! Ben at the bar is quite a trip and makes the experience fun! The PBB&J burger  is incredible!! The hangover is also AMAZING! Honestly, I can't think of a single thing that is wrong with this place other than it needs to be bigger so we don't have to wait next time. Also, if they had some outdoor seating I would get it six stars! Best bar in Carmel IMO

Really nice Cuban sandwich! We ordered it the "traditional" way, so mayo, lettuce and tomato were left out; just pure goodness of roasted pork/ham, salami, dill pickle and yellow mustard in layers between slices of expertedly toasted Cuban bread. After all, Ybor City Tampa is supposed to be the birth place of Cuban sandwich, at least in US, and this place does it right. 

Cafe Cubano is not on the menu (Surprise!), but Cafe con Leche is and they make a nice one. 

Simple decor, open kitchen, and really nice staff makes this a pleasant place to eat; you feel like eating in a friend's home.

We are part of their ongoing maintenance program, and are very pleased with it! They send us reminders and keep our heater and air conditioner working with no issues. Their staff is pleasant and helpful. Definitely recommend Sierra Air!

Books books books books and more books.  This is the first used book store i have ever been to.  If you like reading its a definite must go.  Read on my friends, it makes your brain smarter at a fraction of the cost of college

We went to SP for the first time last night.  The soup we both had was Tom Yum or some such like name.  Was very tasty, hot, just the right amount of spice and heat. Next came the main entree - duck chuu chee. Briefly stated, was about half a duck - not cut up pieces, crispy skin, no fat and the sauce was truly delish. Long story short, I really like the food a lot, ambiance is simple but nice, service was decent.  I'll be back no doubt,  Things other people got also looked tasty.
I haven't stayed there yet. My first day is the 30 of Oct. for my birthday.  I always new that the Crown Plaza was very nice and peaceful. That's why I pick it for my special day. I can't wait.

My wife and I ate here recently, and while the food here is certainly good, I feel that it is overpriced.  Both of us got the prix fixed menu, which included a salad, entree, and a dessert.  One thing that definitely rubbed me the wrong way was the fact that they charge $4 for iced tea, which is brought to you in this little glass teapot-like contraption.  And, they do not offer free refills for this!  I was a little stunned when the waitress told us this.  I was trying to think if there were any other places I had been in St.Louis that didn't offer free refills, and I couldn't think of any.  Very strange.

The caesar salad that my wife and I got was fine, and the filet I ordered was good as well, although small.  The dessert was a small portion as well, which I guess is to be expected on the prix fixed menu.  With all that said, if I'm going to spend this much at a steak and seafood restaurant, I'm going to Morton's, Fleming's, or Ruth's Chris over this place every time.

Great atmosphere, friendly staff and most importantly, amazing food. The layout is pretty much exactly like a Chipoltle or Moe's but obviously with different ingredients.

I tried the Tuna Burrito (Tuna, crab mix, masago, cucumber, scallions and cilantro in seaweed wrapper) with the Spicy Mayo flavor and my girlfriend got The Original (tuna, crab mix, shrimp tempura, cucumber and asparagus in a soy paper wrapper) with spicy mayo as well. Both were outstanding and ended up being two meals for the both of us. 

Also, I wouldn't just call this a tuna roll that hasn't been cut into portions. For the burrito's, at least, there was DEFINITELY more food than a basic roll.

Service was fast and to-the-point with friendly staff. The prices are relatively steep, but that should be expected for the quality of ingredients, which seem to be top notch.

There seemed to be a troll reviewer here that had nothing good to say about this place, and that review should be ignored. This place is GREAT. Everything was very fresh.

Check this place out when you're around there, you won't be disappointed.

Even better than the rave reviews :-) real folded croissant dough generously filled and expertly baked to perfection. Kudos to the chef & high quality staff for a top notch French breakfast. Eggs were light & fluffy. Could not have been better!

UPDATE:

We've had the vehicle less than a week and found an issue.  We called CarMax and they tried telling us our vehicle wasn't even equipped with the feature we were having the issue with.  After contacting the manufacturer and giving them our VIN, the manufacturer confirmed that the car is indeed equipped with the feature.  The repair lady at CarMax, Dede, told me I was lying. SERIOUSLY?!?!

We will NEVER buy a car from them again!  They do NOT know what they are talking about!
_______________________________________________

We traded in my 2008 vehicle last night for a 2013.  I had read too many reviews saying CarMax low-balls you on trade-in value, so my husband and I were skeptical last night on what they would offer us, but they actually offered us higher than the KBB value.  The process was very smooth and considering all of the paperwork that had to be printed and signed, decently quick.  

My only suggestion if you're looking to purchase a car from CarMax - have your own financing pre-arranged.  The best they could offer us (with an excellent credit score) was 5.45% where we were able to secure on our own through our credit union 3.9%.  Big difference when it comes to monthly payment amounts.

This place is at the very end of Stearns Wharf ..... its not very big and it takes awhile to get a table ....however the guys that work there are very efficient and take good care once you're seated..... clam chowder---pretty good ....lobster roll --- again pretty good ....Dungeness Crab also good ......overall its a good seafood restaurant with nice Pacific Ocean views ....
Vice is a great hangout spot. There are a lot of fun events to attend, the interior is super cute, and the staff is ultra friendly! The coffee is good and there is a handy phone charging station.
Slow service. Under par food. Overpriced Asian goods. Cashier seems more busy organizing deliveries than serving customers IN the store. Not impressed at all.

I am not a Best Buy fan.  I find the entire model to be a mess.  The employees are consistently rude, misinformed and lazy.  This is place I go to when I want to see stuff in person after doing extensive online research.  I feel forced to shop here because there are no other electronic/appliance stores to compete with this place.  I cannot tell you the thousands of times I have left here frustrated wishing I would've punched someone in the balls before leaving empty handed.  If you're self-sufficient and just need to complete a transaction, e.g., buy a phone charger, it's not too annoying, but expect a line when it's time to check out.  This place sucks.

My favorite bar/grill in town. There's a great selection on the menu, the food is wonderful, and the environment is fantastic. It can get crowded around happy hour, which I think is a great testament to how many people enjoy the place. Lots of regulars go here. A great place for dinner after work!

HORRIBLE!!!! The food is great but the servers (just a few) are the most arrogant people I have ever seen in my life!! They were extremely horrible and rude to a man who has served his country for 25 years! Will never eat there until they fire unpleasant Wendy and the black girl that only wanted to fight me after standing up for the Vet!! The absolute most horrible experience! You took our names and phone numbers and promised action but I have yet to hear from management. Until I get results, I am on a mission posting reviews everywhere about how horrible the service is and how you treated a veteran!!

I ordered here through grubhub and after waiting almost an hour and a half I finally call the restaurant to see where my food is. Turns out they forgot the order. They refused to comp my food and tried to deliver it 2 hours after I placed the original order. I'll never order from here again.

The food was great, however despite having a reservation we had to wait for quite a while to get a table and be served. We barely had enough time to get to our concert. The place was quite noisy too and i think it may have been louder than the concert! I would go again on a less busy night.
Love this place!  Food is always good and such a good deal for the money.  It's nice to be able to try different sushi rolls.

I am a pizza lover down to the very depth of my bones. Tonight was our first trip here and I'm happy to say it lived up to all of the hype!

We got the Greek salad, which was more unique tasting then traditional Greek salads, but still every bit as yummy. We got 1 giant pizza and I loved that we could do half and half pizzas (even with different sauce combos!) because we love trying new concoctions and mixing and matching flavors. Both halves that we got had the white sauce, I wish we would have substituted and tried red, but it was still good considering. The ingredients all tasted super fresh, which was a bonus to me as I'm not a fan of over processed ingredients.

The restaurant was very clean, and the service was great. Our cups stayed full throughout the entire meal and our waitress was very knowledgeable and helpful with recommendations. While it's more than I like spending on pizza, it was still reasonably priced.

Dewey's --- we will be back!
Best pho and Vietnamese sandwiches in town, hands down. The place may not look welcoming at first glance, but give the place a try, you will not be disappointed.

Yum.  I  just love Thai food and I think Thai Basil Cafe does a decent job of it.  Service is friendly, with a small language barrier.  Water is never empty.  The ambiance is so-so.  They made a fair attempt to decorate, but the workmanship is shotty and the ugly white counter and an uglier refrigerator in the main room dampers whatever ambiance they attempted to create.

The Thai sweet tea is delish and only $1.50.  They have lots of Pad stir fries, curries, and of course , my fav Tom Kha soup.  Tom Kha soup (a spicy coconut cream soup with chicken, lemon grass, galanga, Thai peppers, mushrooms, Thai basil, etc.) is one of those things I must have at least once every six weeks and I have resorted to making it myself because so many of the local restaurants charge so much for it!  You can get a small bowl here for $4.50, which is reasonable.

Still, the menu prices are slightly high (I'm spoiled by the prices at Thai House and Thips Thai - both in Illinois).  Overall, it was a nice experience.  I had a great meal and was very satisfied.
One of my favorite spot, the pork chop is delicious ! Mac and cheese as well, and the cocktails are great as well. The chef is super nice too, love this place !

Friendly staff, accommodating for vegetarians! Great dish...orange tofu.  Large portion.  Wish I would have ordered it spicy, no spice whatsoever, but that's my fault.  The egg rolls were actually vegetable spring rolls, and were cooked perfectly.  Looking forward to trying something else on my next visit.

Wow, amazing: Doughsants, omelette, everything was incredible, the jelly must be homemade. Service is really good now that they have been open for a while, bright open space. Herbal tea in personal French press as well as fancy cocktails. Next time I plan to sample the other baked goods:)
Chris and José both treat my Chawni like he is one of their own.  They take great care of the animals and even groom my difficult...matted haired dog.  I would be lost without them!

I spent two weeks in St. Petersburg and ate here three times! I really don't understand the negative comments because I can't say enough wonderful things about this place. The people behind the counter are friendly and accommodating. The food is amazing and even if the dining room is small, there is plenty of places outdoors to eat. It's Florida people!! It is going to be hot!! Anyway...Thanks for offering very good food and service. We will be back again upon our next visit! You guys (and gals) do it right!

Had lunch here on Monday and the entire experience was great. The staff was very attentive and willing to answer all questions, even those regarding the movie posters on the walls. Had the traditional El Charro tacos and they were great. This is not your typical Mexican food. Think healthy and really fresh. The tortilla soup is fantastic.

This is my fourth year going to Pennhurst and by far the most disappointing. Parking is an issue if you don't want to take the buses from the parking lot near wawa. We tried to park on site which is what we've done in years past but we were told the shuttle parking lot needed to fill first. It would be helpful if that was posted someplace. Anyway, we went on a Friday night at 7pm, only waited in line for about 5 minutes but when we were done it looked like it had gotten pretty packed. They did not do a good job of spacing groups out, essentially we just walked through all 3 attractions in a big long line. It seemed like they were rather short staffed as well, maybe because it was early on a Friday but there were many missed opportunities. I don't think we will be returning next year, if you live close by go for it but not worth a 2 hour drive.

Would definitely recommend calling before trying to shop here to make sure they're open. Drove all the way out here Sunday- after verifying their hours on Sundays online- and the place was closed. Even the business hours on the door indicated they'd be open well in advance of the time I arrived. Was excited to see the place after hearing such great reviews, however, won't ever be shopping here now. 2 other customers in the parking lot were also confused. Plenty of smoke shops in the area- don't waste your time driving to this one for no reason!

Jackson's is near and dear to my heart for several reasons.

Most importantly, they are in a wonderful location with a great atmosphere. Secondly, the guy who owns this place used to own rumba before it shut down (which evidently only shut down because it was too corporate on west end - probably with rent prices!) and the barros lucos was transported here magically! That is one great sandwich. That, coupled with their buffalo feathers and a cheese panini on the side? Done.
Even better if you're there for half priced bottle of wine Sundays - super deal! Definitely my favorite day to go to wind down from the weekend. Sometimes it gets overly crowded/stuffed with obnoxious undergrads with popped collars and plaid shorts but generally speaking the atmosphere is awesome on a sunny day.

FAR superior taste to Cafe Du Monde. The service sucks and sometimes you can't even get in the door but the beignets and hot chocolate are worth it. It was a great stop after dances as well as many nights hitting the bars in Fat City. Now it's a sweet family outing and it's always nice to stop in to the newspaper stand next door.
Their drive-thru is so slow it hurts. I recommend bringing food from the Wendy's next door because by the time you get your food you'll be hungry again.
Stayed nearby. The kids and some of the adults made frequent trips to Paradise Sweets. Great ice cream and quick service.  A fun stop on the beach
Support you local mom & pop pizza places they are much better.

My wife was excited that she "won" $3,000 which is what she thought from the HUGE flyer she got In the mail. I called the place. Actually she has to come in and first be pestered about buying a car, then she would be allowed to find out if she won. The odds are 1 in 50,000 to win! A salesman said that someone in Delaware won once. Why would a car dealership want bad will instead of good will?

Gluten free menu!!!! Staff is kind and knowledgable. Food is DELICIOUS. Selection of wine is large, but not overwhelming. From the start to finish the Tavern was enjoyable. Tricia behind the bar was wonderful and a huge shout out to the server that's gluten free (I didn't catch her name!) and helped me with my food- you're the best! So so happy I came here. You made my night.

One of the more upscale places in French Quarter.  Had the red fish with crab cake, beef medallion. Food is fabulous, bananas fosters was real good. Patio is awesome. Service was top notch. Nothing I can say wrong about this place.

I'll tell you what...I read up about Bailys' Range before giving it a try and I was still blown away about how cool it was. Nobody really talks much about the enormous amount of flavored bottled sodas you can try (we tried a Green River lime soda and a Reed's spiced apple soda - fantastic). Lots of mention about the shakes, but not much was said about the homemade ice cream desserts that they have. I was expecting the typical burger bar and got so much more!

The atmosphere is super cool. Two stories, with the longest communal table you ever will see and a bar. Upstairs has traditional seating that overlooks downstairs and also has bar-type seating around the perimeter of the windows. The kitchen is exposed on the first level, separated from the dining room with various gigantic window panes.

We started with the smoked onion rings - some of the best I've ever had - with Rooster sauce (awesome mix of stone grain mustard and mayo). For dinner, I went with one of the "burger war" beef burgers - espresso rubbed, topped with blue cheese, caramelized onions, bacon, and apple slivers. It was awesome! The flavors totally worked and it was obvious the ingredients were all high quality. We split fries with their cheese sauce - fries were great and the cheese sauce was good, but not your typical - it was very light in color and had hints of white wine. Pretty good, but not as good as the Rooster sauce. For dessert, we split scoops of pistachio and salted caramel ice cream. We made it a sundae (chocolate, whipped cream, and nuts) for $2 more - the premium mixed nuts on top made the up charge more than worth it.

Service was top-notch. Very helpful, answered every question knowledgeably, was around enough but not too much.

The only complaint and the only thing from keeping this a 5-star review is the fact that they serve the burgers on cold buns. It got to the point where I started eating my burger with a fork to work around the bun. It looks like they bake them on site, so I'm not sure why they wouldn't take the extra step to toast them before they serve you. They do have an option of a pretzel roll for $1 more, so maybe I'll try that next time...because I'll definitely be back!

10th and Walnut is the newest addition to the Marathon Family, and unlike its sister store on Chestnut, it does not look like bad 90's design. In fact, this new bi-level location is super swanky in comparison. With exposed brick, and bridges the restaurant decor might fool you into thinking you're in a Starr restaurant. 

The menu is the same as all of the other Marathon Grills. In my opinion, for the price the food is good. In fact, the food is just good. I rarely have a problem with anything I order. The standard fare is made up of salads, sandwiches, breakfast all day, and smoothies. 

Now, my biggest problem with this location is that the service was SLOW. But that might be a result of just opening.

I have been a customer here for a year and a half. Unfortunately, I will not be returning. I went in for a repair. After 4 days my gel was peeling. When I went in the man who  was tasked with removing the gel began peeling it back with his nails. No soaking, no tools. I was so grossed out I asked him to stop. When I asked about soaking he picked up the Dremel. You gotta be fooling me if you think I am gonna let the dude who was picking off my polish near me with a Dremel tool. Now I am starting my week with one nail bare and only one half of another in tact. #fwp

So they appreciate my candid feedback. Just so you know, as of today, July 30, 2018, this truck is still on their lot and is now marked at $25,900, more than $2,000 less than what I had offered to pay for it, and a full $4,000 less than their original price of $29,900 that they weasled me around on. Car dealerships and salesman ARE all the same, and they will screw you the first chance they get. If Crown Honda weren't so GREEDY, they would have made a sale at $27,986 and be more than $2,000 better off than they are now.

Called a few days before our rental since our flight was coming in at 12:40am & the Boise, Idaho Hertz rental counter technically closed at 12:30am. My husband spoke to Aaron (I think that's his name) who assured us that they generally wait until the last plane comes in before closing & that he would be there most likely when we arrived. 

Got to the counter that day probably close to 1am, and Aaron was there having just helped a family check out their rental. He was so very polite and kind, even though it was so late. He didn't seem like he was tired or aggravated that he was there late because of our flight. Super helpful, nice guy who deserves high praise! We even got an upgrade to a mid-sized vehicle because they were out of economy- free of charge! 

The car smelled brand new and everything was clean. They even noted some scuff marks near the trunk so we didn't have to worry about reporting it ourself. Checkin out and back in the day we left was super easy and we had the car from Friday night until Monday afternoon for a total of only $47! Couldn't believe the great rate Autoslash hooked us up with. Once again, we were well taken care of. Will ALWAYS use this service whenever we rent a car!

Great beer selection and hands down the best vegetarian cheesesteak I've had so far! Mushrooms were cooked perfectly with a gooey cheese sauce and a crunchy on-the-outside with sweet and chewy inside roll. 
Stopped here on impulse after a show at Underground Arts and will definitely be back after the next show we see. Glad to see a quality place that keeps the kitchen open a little later. The vibe inside was really comfy also. Plus I always get excited when I see a cask ale on tap.

There should be a Then Comes Baby in every neighborhood! Parenting -- and getting out of the house with a young infant! -- would be so much easier if there were more safe, friendly, supportive spaces for parents to connect with each other, get new information, and decompress. I first discovered Then Comes Baby through its donation-based, drop-in breastfeeding support clinic. Up until that point, my outings with my then four-week-old had been largely dominated by the quest to find a decent place to change his diaper and nurse him. Walkiing into Then Comes Baby was a dream: comfy couches, plenty of floor space for older babies to crawl and play, a changing table stocked with wipes and diapers, healthy snacks, and even a scale to weigh him. I especially appreciated having access to a scale, since in those early days it can be tough to know if your baby is getting enough milk. 

Sabrina, the warm and knowledgeable founder of Then Comes Baby and the facilitator of the breastfeeding clinic, is quick to make everyone feel at home, helping them settle in with their babies as they arrive and then making sure they have ample time to speak and get feedback. She manages to fit in several in-depth conversations on the topics parents bring up while still allowing time for everyone to share their challenges. As a Lactation Consultant with a public health background, she knows what's she talking about! When you're struggling with clogged ducts, milk supply, latching, or the myriad of other issues breastfeeding mamas sometimes face, it's a relief to have her level of expert advice. She's also a lot of fun :) 

Since the breastfeeding clinics, I've visited Then Comes Baby for classes on everything from Tum E Time, to yoga, to introducing solid foods. The list of classes I'd like to take there is much longer still. If my schedule allowed, I'd be there several times a week! I'm so glad this place exists!

This place really put their heart into buying a rundown building and making it so beautiful! A real gem in the community. They over fresh roasted beans and pour overs and well as flavored lattes and great space for hanging out. And it is attached to a cidery! Super cool!

Horrible customer service. I dont think it should be an excuse that u can provide terrible disrespectful customer service just because ur a bar on bourbon st with great live music and u know the people will jeep coming. I would like to boycott this place and I think everyone else should too. Stand outside and drink ur beer and you'll have just as much fun and you wont have to deal wig bull shit. But I guess when it drunk all places r the same. Management is shit and so r some not all of the bartenders and the so called security is a joke, fat slow bullshit motherfuckers that I can take out myself. SAD! !!!!! The shot girl Sharon was the only cool friendly customer service employee there.

I've been frequenting this place since they opened over 10 years ago.
They are a small shop in the food mall.  You won't find a wide range of options and the sushi isn't cheap.  However, its not overpriced and the chef gives generous sized slices.  What they do have is very good.  A great place to stop and grab quick bite or take-home.  I used to get the sea world combo a lot.  I always asked to substitute the teka-maki with spicy tuna.  Now that's how they sell it!

The most delicious home made chocolate chip cookies! Fair priced foods that taste a lot better than the cheap prices you pay. How can something so good be this cheap? I sure appreciate it. The owner as well as the workers cared enough to ask us about our foods and knew it was our first time there so they gave us one of their infamous chocolate chip cookies for free. God Bless

They are not joking by friendly. This has been the best car buying experience I ever had. Not pushy at all and they make it happen. Joe DiMaggio and Anthony Diaz were outstanding today. I will never go anywhere else. Thank you guys :) by the way this is Kristen... I do not know why my user name says Christina M. Ha

Horrible service. Rude, uncaring management. Used to be a great place but the new owner couldn't care less about guest satisfaction. Oh, and if you order something that is not to your liking or satisfaction, you will still have to pay for it. I was treated horribly by the owner when I tried to talk to him about my food. He wasn't the least bit concerned nor did he apologize or compensate for everything that went wrong. All the other reviews talking about the service and management are correct. And the pricing for the quality is too high. Save your money. There are way better Japanese places in the area now.

I'll start by saying that over the years my friend and I have randomly taken off from North Jersey to Philly in search of a good authentic cheesesteak....and for many years we remained unsuccessful.....until Chink's.

Chinks is a small hole in the wall type place, but as many know these places can be the best cheat eats around.  The cheesesteaks, at a mere 6$ are GREAT.  The perfect greasy, cheesey and tasty fast cheap eat.  I have had many cheese steaks before but this is by far one of the better ones :)   Also, this place boasts an old time soda fountain that ranges from hand mixed flavored sodas to thick shakes and even really good egg creams, and all at good prices. Many places in my area and NYC also boast this sort of option however they make a big deal of it being "vintage" and specialty and they overprice but chinks is not like that...its not some trendy new soda fountain...its more of an oldskool authentic soda fountain experience, that combined with the cheese steak is well worth a trip back just to go to Chinks.   This place is now a must try on my small but growing personal lists of Philly venues. I can see why the locals view it as a classic Philly institution.  Thumbs up for chinks!

I ordered a chirashi here. The ambiance is great especially with the outdoor seating area but the food is very average and everything is over-priced. There are several other great sushi restaurants not too far from Tokyo Japanese Restaurant and they do significantly a better job with the quality of their dish compared to tokyo japanese. Overall it was slightly disappointing.

With all of the great restaurants in NOLA, there is no need to stop at this one.  The "crab cake napoleon" was one small crab cake with a slice of eggplant on the top and bottom, the crab cake sandwich was covered in a thin sauce that had the pre-cut Picksweet onion/green pepper in it...not good.  That was a $15 entrée....no side, no nothing.

Pass on by this one!

I have the same review as the others. This is a great place. Brought two cars for maintenance today, and having my second meal of the day here!. Both were fresh and overall great! Tons of choices and specials. The gent running the cafe is also unbelievable friendly. He has always been that way. Customer service is a lost art!

First let me start by saying I love The Waffle House.  I eat at different locations all around the country.  In fact this location is two miles from my home and I didn't know it was there!  As soon as I found it I made plans to go there the following Saturday for breakfast. Saturday came and I showed up there at about 8:00AM.  It wasn't packed with people waiting to be seated so I sat down in a booth and ordered an ice tea while I looked at the menu.  And then I waited, and waited, and waited some more.  I didn't even get a smile out of my waitress, some young girl who couldn't be over 20 years old.  She was all smiles and friendly to everyone else but I was simply and obviously ignored.  Have no idea why, I was friendly and certainly not "that" customer.  Over the course of 30 minutes I watched her smile and greet everyone that sat at the surrounding booths, but not me.  Finally I said to hell with it and put three dollars on the table and left.  I went down Shadeland avenue to a carniceria/restaurant that always has fast and friendly service.  I'll update my review in another month and see how things go.  This time I'll sit at the counter.

I was looking for a quick lunch near my hotel and decided to try out Pizza Guys. When I walked in, I was courteously greeted and felt like a valued customer. I ordered a small pepperoni pizza for the $4.99 lunch special. It was done in about 6-7 min., much quicker than their estimated 10-15 min. The food was really good, the dough is made fresh everyday and had a nice fluffy crust. The sauce was sweet and tasty and all around a great pizza.

Pizzeria Vetri is hidden off of busy Benjamin Franklin Parkway in an oasis of restaurants on Callowhill Street. The inside of the restaurant is pretty hip - high ceilings, pizza oven visible in all its glory, and playing sick tracks. I can totally see this being a place for people to stop in for a pizza snack. We ordered the crudo pizza for two. This was definitely the perfect size for an in-between meal for two or someone that isn't super hungry at dinner. The pizza was delicious. There was no shortage of prosciutto and the mozzarella was a perfect balance to it. I'm normally not a big fan of crust but this was also great.

The egg casserole for breakfast. The chocolate mint tea. The yoga studio in the backyard. Walking distance from Conner Prairie. Historical decor and feel of the property. All of it. 

From the minute I made my reservation with Prairie Guest House they made the experience so warm and meaningful. This new addition to Fishers boasts a historical and rural flair that makes you feel a world away from the city. The rooms range from two twins to queens with en suite bathrooms. Each of the rooms has a unique flare that stays in line with the history of the home. In the communal spaces of the house you'll find a hefty book collection, stationary and Kuerig coffee cups. 

Yoga classes are offered throughout the week but you can also schedule private classes. The full breakfast is offered on the weekends and kicks off at 9am with juice, coffee, tea, jams, eggs, bacon and potatoes. Their egg casseroles are filled with veggies like asparagus and zucchini. 

Note: they're aiming to convert the barn into a venue in 2016 for events (perfect setup for intimate weddings).

I'm not a local, I live in San Francisco but Frost is the best gelato I've had outside of Italy. Whenever I'm in Tucson I insist that we go to Frost several times each trip. 

Not only is it delicious and perfectly creamy but they have a great selection of flavors with rotating seasonal flavors like Chai. Last week, they had a root bear flavor that I had never seen before and it blew me away. My go-to flavors are White Chocolate Macadamia Nut and Coconut. 

Not only is the gelato great but they will let you sample any flavors (and as many as) you want. Sometimes I feel rushed due to the constant stream of customers behind me but the staff is always nice and patient.  If I could give Frost 10 stars, I would.

This is hotel is an oasis! It should be 5 star rated! All rooms are luxurious! The pool is worth the drive from Cali.... We had a pool server that went above and beyond. She brought our drinks to us in the pool! The casino is never ending! So large and every machine you could want! The machines pay! I won on Blue 7s, China shores, caveman keno and Willy Wonka....

Bland, sweet, salty, far removed from anything authentic.   The food served here is on par with mall Chinese food.  The spring roll was improperly fried, so it was full of oil (this happens when fryer oil is not hot enough.) 

The Coconut soup was extremely sweet and had zero spice or flavor (Thai coconut soups have lime, chile and lemongrass dimensions.). This was chicken broth, coconut milk and sugar with a trace of red chili paste.)

The Won Ton soup was extremely salty and the won tons were poorly made.   They were not a nice soft noodle, they were gummy and pasty.

The fried rice had no flavor.  

So I have to agree with Rina's review:  For what is offered here, one would be just as well to order carry out from a corner generic Chinese-in-a-box purveyor.

There is a star given for cleanliness and a star for pleasant service.

No reason we would return.

Good food--easily passed up if you don't know to look for it inside Frenchman's outdoor area.  

We had raw and grilled oysters, along with a fried oyster dish atop some sort of spinach cream concoction.  We liked the grilled oysters the best.  The price is right and the service is friendly--walk up bar for food, they deliver to your table in the common area.  There's a bar with daiquiris next in the booth next door so you'll be set with a minimum of fuss.

Came back to the Hacienda on Sunday, Sep. 1st with my girlfriend. Ashley was our server in the bar area and she was very accommodating. The chimi was delicious as was my Pacifico with lime. Girlfriend got a vodka tonic and a combination plate that she ended up taking home. Another great visit!

They have EVERYTHING you're looking for.  Fried okra. Wings of every kind.  Cajun fries....just anything and everything.  Whatever you get you'll have to get the Ghetto Punch.  It's great! Love this place!!

What I like:

Large selection of craft beers (5 IPAs alone) about 20-30 total on tap.

Nice trendy aesthetic.  (Fainting couches line one wall).  

Full bar.  

Youthful bar staff.

What I don't like:

So loud that I would not go there to eat.  It is for drinking even though there is a menu.

Their specials are very expensive (compared to regular menu items).  Ask for the prices as it is a surprise since their specials are not written down and the wait staff does not tell you unless asked (this is a trend game that I dislike about American restaurants).   

Their regular menu is not as expensive but imagine seeing an item labelled "Seared Scallop" for around $15?  Seems pricey for a scallop.  

Specials are read to you by the waiter or waitress with no price information given.  Since it is so loud you miss every other word so difficult to determine what is being offered.

Beer selection was wide, but beer temperature was quite warm (This is Florida, not London, England).

Wait staff, while youthful and attractive, seemed novice and perhaps a little full of themselves.

Recommended for:  Friday happy hours, girls' nights out and those who are not concerned about dining value.    Avoid if having a date night and you want to have a conversation.  Perfect to take a boring person to as there is no way they can speak loud enough to bore you.

Thank you so much for a wonderful anniversary dinner for me and the wife! My 5 star is based on the fast and friendly service, the excellent view of the Gulch and the food. I highly recommend the banana upside down cake for dessert!

We went to Judge Bean's in hope of getting some good Texas style BBQ in an area known for its southern Memphis style fare.  We were pleasantly surprised all around.  The place is similar to most of the good Texas BBQ joints I've been to in the Lone Star State.  It has a really nice atmosphere, that is dive-y in all the right ways.  We each had the smokehouse combo which got us Brisket, sausage, & ribs w/ 2 sides.  Brisket & sausage was spot on as was the bbq sauce.  nice and vinegary with a kick.  Its actually as good as most I had in my 4 years in Texas.  The ribs were a nice surprise as Texas BBQ isn't known for that, but they were fall off the bone tender and seasoned perfectly.  The sides were great as well.  Cowboy beans had a perfect kick & consistency.  Sweet potato fries were an unexpected surprise that were delectable as well.  I can say that we will definitely go back as the service, food, & atmosphere were all well done especially for the price and amount of food we got.

They started with a new menu yesterday so I tried something different.  The Italian Salami salad was awesome - artichokes, walnuts, salami, parmesan, and tomato salad.  So good.  Had some garlic knots as an app which was a really good combination.  I like how cozy that location is.  The server was super sweet.  Will definitely go back.

We came here for the first time tonight and were very pleased with food, romantic atmosphere and great service. Our friends from Franklin recommended this restaurant for steak and seafood. I ordered French onion soup for appetizer, signature filet with two types of mash potatoes on the side, it was delicious! My husband ordered meatloaf and said it tasted incredible. We love red wines and we usually order cabs, ordered Jordan 2011, what a great bottle of Cabernet Sauvignon! Service was outstanding, our waiter kept coming back and refilling water all the time, even after we paid our bill and were finished with dinner. 
Loved burning candle on the table, it felt romantic and peaceful.
My fav local NOLA grocery. Always have a great wine selection and great  wine sales. Cashiers always nice and love the bakery! I feel home when I am shopping here!

Bittersweet Confections is my 5-yr-old son's "favorite coffee shop" (his words- which probably says something about how often I drag him to coffee shops, cafes, etc.)- It's fairly high on my own list of places to acquire caffeine as well. 
The pastry and chocolate selection here is good- the cupcakes are quite yummy and there's a wide selection of flavors. They've recently added a small gelato selection- mostly unusual flavors, not the basics.
Bittersweet also makes cakes for any occasion and they often have a slideshow on a screen in the cafe of lots of the different cake designs they've made (some of which are pretty creative)- so if you're looking for a cake in a specific shape, they can probably do it (Millennium Falcon cake, anyone? They can handle that.)

There's seating inside if you want to hang out and enjoy your treat and coffee. There's also free Wifi, so you can check in or peruse the Web while you sit. 
The staff is always friendly and willing to answer questions about the stuff in the dessert cases.

Although the service itself has not changed and it is still pretty great, I absolutely have to update my old review.

I have been coming here regularly for months, and lately, as often as once a week. 
Today, AFTER PAYING FOR MY SERVICES, I found out I would have had enough points to get them for free. They didn't want to refund my money and asked if I could simply get it free next time. 

I wish they had been clearer about the points needed, since I had no clue i was even remotely close to getting a free service. It definitely left a bad taste in my mouth and after getting my free pedicure next week, I'm not sure I'll be back as often. What a bummer.
Amazing food and drinks, good coffee. BUT there's flies everywhere. I eat here pretty often and that's always a problem.

I don't know if its because people here don't like chains or if people are just generally stupid but this place has some of the finest steaks in the suburbs Period.   This is a very high end steak house that only serves prime beef.   The filet is amazing and i've been here many times.   One thing to look for is to see if they have two dine for 99 special.   With this or some variation you can get two salads, two apps, two steaks, two sides and two dessets for 99 is quite  a good deal when you consider the filets alone are 40 each...

To the people who gave this place any less then 4 stars, please remove yourself from yelp as you have no idea about anything food and should most likely be looking to eat at diners as good food/service and quality service are not your strongest suite.   This place gets it right consistently and does steak well period.   If your looking for a steak you can't do much better then here.

We love this place! The food is awesome and the service is excellent - the staff is very friendly and helpful even on busy Friday nights. It can be a bit crowded with above average noise then, but that has never bothered us. So maybe don't go with a large crowd or on a first date on the weekend. 

Among the things we have tried and *loved*: the $1(!) endless nachos, guacamole, grilled Mexican corn (great blend of flavors), cactus & sweet potato burritos (wow!), chicken fried seitan (love the sweet, tangy bbq sauce), brisket sandwich and the "big ass" burger." I was iffy about the veggie hot wings (too sour for me), but my husband really liked them. So give this place a try.
