I'm pretty sure all Walmart's have a policy where they can't open more than two tills at a time. It doesn't matter if the lines to the back of store or if Queen Elizabeth herself needed some groceries. She'd be waiting a solid 30 mins for check out just like everyone else. 

Why even have 27 potential check outs? Knock them out and add a bigger section for dog food or something.

A-MAZING!
should be an absolute mandatory stop for any trip to St. Louis!
One of them has been salty to much, the other dish had a hair on the plate, the manager in the restaurant didn't know what to do, so the bottom line we had a bad experience.
Amazing. Great decor, friendly staff, delicious food and outstanding beer! We will definitely be back!

Love, Love, love and love.

I felt like i was at a punk rock-irish pub. Yeah i said it, its cheap and has that regular irish pub feel. But the people there are laid back and cool. The music is amazing, i felt like i was listening to my ipod (which is some great music right there), 90's rock blasting through those speakers. Oh and like i said, prices are cheap! Its hidden so make sure not to walk past it!

So i called before Friday night rush to order for delivery since i live 5 minutes from them and they sent me a flier.  I place my order. After i place my order and she runs my card she says i will be an hour.  I said wxcise me?  She said well  i can try and cancel it but it is to late now.   Then she tries to argue that it is friday and that is why it will take so long.  I pointed out their flier offers free fast delivery and why didn't o go to pizza hut.  She said they are better quality.  Well we will see.

I have NOTHING but good things to say about Glanzmann's service department. My '96 Legacy wagon with 235,000 always needs everything, but they know I'm not made of money and after making their recommendations, if I say no then that's it. No pressure, no hassle, nice waiting room, nice people ... and what's more, they actually FIX things! I can think of two occasions in the past where the average dealership would probably have just ordered new parts, but the techs at Glanzmann took the time and REPAIRED the problem!

If I had the money to buy a new Subaru (which I would love to do), I would buy it here. When I am finally forced to replace the '96, I will be shopping here first - and wherever I buy the next one, it will be serviced here.

I actually look forward to my annual inspection appointment in January. That's how good they are.

We've eaten here a few times and had to stop and thank the Chefs every time. Try the Benny Roll (lightly fired and topped with Bonito flakes) and the Scallop small plate (served atop a slice of mozzarella and sauteed mushrooms). Excellent service in a nice setting too. Will definitely be continuing to eat here. Wish they were open later!

Absolutely incredible.  Best Thai food in town.  The peanutty Masseman, the papaya salad, the spicy sole and the scallops pha pha are great.
If you feel like grabbing some Thai dont waste your time with any of the others in town.  I have lived here for 30 years and have tried all.  Zen Yai has consistently had quality and taste...

July 4th must have had the B team in the kitchen. With just a few tables seated for lunch it took an hour to get our food. The chicken alfredo lacked alfredo, the sausage and pepper sandwich was nothing more than a dry sausage with some green pepper on it. I needed to dip it in the rice laden soup to moisten it. The grilled chicken salad was missing the fried onions on top and the well made crab cakes were burnt on the bottom.the spaghetti and meatballs was abundant and well prepared. The scam with the wine sizes was a new one...a glass...and a little more...for a bunch more money
Service was very caring.
My sister said it usually was decent...not today.

I've had hundreds of massages over the years and IMC is one of the best. April is amazing. She listens and is able to give pain relief to sore muscles while relaxing you in a short span of time.

I've also had my eyebrows waxed here a couple of times. I feel like I'm getting a massage instead. At other salons I'm usually tense and it's uncomfortable to get a wax. Not at IMC, it was basically relaxing. 

I wouldn't go anywhere else. The price is right and the experience is amazing.

I don't know where to begin...we had a fabulous experience here last night. We arrived at ten pm when they were closing, and they sat us enthusiastically. The hostess was very nice, and our waitress went above and beyond!  We both ordered the petite filet, and it was cooked to perfection with a great smoky flavor. The  pesto dipping sauce for the bread was fantastically fresh and flavorful. They never made us feel rushed, and it was a great meal. In addition, you can't beat the setting in the historic Union Station Hotel.

Amazing amazing amazing. Definitely put preservation hall on your to do list. The band is incredibly gifted, it was a moving performance. As most reviewers have mentioned, purchase tickets in advance - there was a line out the door and with reserved seating you do not have to worry about the line. The performance was at 10:15pm, they opened the doors at 10pm. We arrived around 9:50, checked in and went to bourbon street, which is next door, grabbed some drinks and headed right in before they started. I hope to see this band in the future again!

Perfect place for breakfast. Don't let the small size worry you. The food is delicious, and service is terrific. Great for families, clean and friendly. I have family in Holiday, so now this gem is our "go to" for breakfast  any time we are in town from Chicago. Homemade hash is fantastic!

Pathetic service. We ordered the food and waited for 20 mins, the pager didn't ring for another 10 mins. After waiting 25 mins, went and checked for the order. I was told the pager died for some reason. The food was cold and the front desk didn't even offered to say sorry. Sorry Panera, curlew Rd Centre.. you guys need some training. The two star is for the cold food that I have paid.

We are on our honeymoon and stayed just a block away! We were looking for quality food without breaking the bank. The food here surpassed our expectations and the waiting staff was always chipper and lovely! Thanks so much for your hospitality and wonderful food,  we recommend the grits, seafood pasta, and crystal chicken sandwich!

We have made long distance moves many times over the past 20 years.
Never have I experienced anything like the one with Mayflower.
It is no exaggeration to say that their customer service pretty much ended once the contract was signed.
We were told that it may be as much as a 10 day wait  for our furniture to arrive.
We did live in a motel and board our pet for the full 10 days, not to mention eating out 2 or 3 times per day once we reached our destination.
On the 10 th day, the truck arrived and the driver told us that our furniture had been packed in that truck and sat 10 miles from our old home for all of that time! 
Needless to say, their poor planning cost us an additional $1500.00 at least.
Despite the check list of our packed items, several pieces were missing and it is now 
over 3 months with no explanation from the company
We fed the workers and tipped them well.
Recently we had occasion to disassemble 2 of our beds and found that they had been put together with one bolt at each corner, partially screwed in and no washers.
Amazing experience.

Chill place to stop and grab a bite after being on the motorcycles in the canyons all morning.  Great outdoor seating.  Everyone seemed to LOVE the sweet potato fries!  I wouldn't go out of my way to come here for lunch but the staff was friendly and the food was decent.  The salad was just average.  Next time I think I would try the BBQ place next door!  Parking sucks on a Sunny Sunday afternoon!

There is a sandbox for all the kiddies... perhaps why I knocked them down a star... 

Great view!

In the search for good food after a long road trip, we found ourselves in Ybor City, the historic part of Tampa.  We turned into Al's BBQ, which was no more that an old historic house with gravel parking and loose hens and chicks running amuck.  In the middle of the day, it almost appeared abandoned, but there it was, a smokehouse with its billowing plumes of sweetness stopping you at attention as they danced with your senses.  We walked inside and were immediately greeted and sat down at the bar.  I ordered the pulled pork dinner platter with black-eyed peas, veggies and bread.  The first test of good BBQ is to sample the meat simply and without sauce.  It was perfectly smoked with rich and robust flavors and burnt bits.  It passed with flying colors.  The second test of good BBQ is to slather the meat with sauce.  The mild tangy mustard sauce of a Carolina variety was an excellent compliment to the pork.  The last test, the irresistible desire to lick your fingers, which could not be controlled.  This delicacy accompanied by some sweet tea made it a true southern tribute.  The meal was culminated with some homemade banana pudding.  The BBQ is one of the best I've ever had.

Additionally, in my opinion, the sign of a great restaurant is often marked by the cleanliness of its bathrooms and at least the women's bathroom was spotless.

I would definitely come again in search of great southern BBQ.
I really love this place. It's like home and you parents cook for you. I would like to recommend biscuit. It's very nice.
Perfect local restaurant and bar.  A good beer and drink selection, and the food was very good.  Be sure to try the Veal Melanese.
Bit of a wait but very good. Siracha chicken was great!!! Staff is very helpful and nice to be sure you get what you will like. Tiramisu is good too.

This pho restaurant is a great find in Brandon. My wife and I have eaten here quite a few times, and I have yet to be disappointed. We judge most pho places by their pho tai and cha gio, and they excel at both. 

Their broth is tasty and filling, and they have plenty of dishes to choose from. I did try a few chicken dishes in the past, honey chicken was yummy. I am always impressed by the quality of the meat and noodles in their pho, having been to other restaurants that use poor meat.

Decor is typical of pho spots, but service is above average. The location is a couple blocks off highway 60, so you won't find it unless you're looking for it, but it is definitely worth checking out. It has become my favorite spot for pho.

best place to see a baseball game in the entire world.  

best food, best fans, best sightlines, and you can hear the crack of the bat hitting the ball from CF bleachers.  

and, a horse can eat off the grass, to quote Dick Allen.

The worst company ever beware, had a Ac/heat unit put in I paid for everything then turned on my microwave and the Ac was on and it blew fuses.Here they didn't upgrade electric I was told just don't use both (Asshole) fought with them and had to pay half.the came back at least 10 to 15 times to fix unit that had many issues.And after the warranty expired they told me I bought a cheap unit!They suck owner is a jerk and there best employee left and he was there only saving grace. I warn you do not use this bum.If I could give a negative star!

Not one of the better Worldmark properties. There were just so many things wrong with our unit and we had to call maintenance in several times. Plus, we had to re-wash the linens and towels .. ick. Another drawback is that this property is about 15 miles (or more) of light city driving from almost everything you would want to see.

Went for the Sunday jazz brunch. Love the atmosphere and the service was great! The french toast and the eggs, bacon and potatoes were delicious! My boyfriend doesn't usually eat potatoes/home fries with his breakfast but he loved them. The french toast was one really thick piece of brioche and topped with homemade strawberry compote and whipped cream. Delicious! We split a slice of cheesecake which was decent, but don't expect a slice of NY style cheesecake (my personal favorite). This is much lighter and not very sweet and topped with a dusting of cinnamon. The drinks are good too. They give one complimentary glass of champagne during brunch and then we ordered cocktails. My champagne cocktail was good but my boyfriend's Easy Like Sunday Morning gin cocktail was awesome! A great blend of flavors. I'm curious now to try dinner since that's the ultimate test, but as of right now they get 5 stars for an excellent brunch.

Trendy but not snobbish, for people who know what they want.  I really love the touches from the tables, to the bathrooms, ability to fit everyone in to such a small space.  It's really cozy place to get drinks and food.

Woodstock burger is good.  Sweet potato fries were soft, and not crispy the way I like them.  Peanut butter dessert was good, but not life changing.  Just really liked the ambiance

Super busy at 4 PM, so.. you'll likely be waiting in line during peak hours.

Last time I was here I had the turtle soup (amazing!) and gator burger (not too amazing).

This review however is for the raw Oysters.  I was craving some but Acme Oysters line was too long (as usual).  I decided to give Desire a try.  The oysters here were good but not cleaned as well.  I had a lot more pieces of sand in my mouth and it detracted from the experience.  The oysters also had a different less saltier flavor.  But faster service make this place the next best place for oysters!
Very cheap food. Stay away please. Dont buy sick. If you go here that  may be your first and last...visit.

This place was great!! I got a basic pedicure. They had the best massage chairs I've ever been in (most are just annoying, these actually felt nice). They also have like 15-20 chairs, so it would probably be great for a group. The staff was super nice and everything looked very clean! I'll definitely be going back!

I shop for all of my meat here. I eat lots of salmon and their pre cut salmon is always fresh. I occasionally will buy steak when it's on sale. My favorite is when the Primo Taglio meat goes on sale for five dollars on Fridays. They also are the only place that carries sprouts out of the three grocery stores in my area. The only complaint I have is that their prices are a little high and I do the majority of my shopping at other stores to save money.

Such a great experience!  Hot Cider with Grand Marnier.  Live local music.  Everybody near and far with a cool motocycle to show off was there.  Nice people and got to try the real Santa Maria Tri-tip Sandwich- BBQ on the big outdoor grill with french roll and salsa and horseradish.  Delish!  Fun being out in nature with the Spring wildflowers all popping up! - and feeling part of history visiting such a special place.

Our party of 4 had dinner here tonight for the first time and look forward to our next time! Great food, service and ambiance. The owners were onsite and took the time to ask us about our meal, which was wonderful. Highly recommend!

I had takeout from here yesterday for the 2nd time. The first time, a few weeks ago, I had an egg roll and veggie lo mein. I really enjoyed it. So I got takeout again and. I was so disappointed. My husband ordered ribs so I tried one and it was really good and tasty. Then I had wonton egg drop soup. The wontons were really good. The broth was so tasteless and bland, yet it still had a peppery taste to it. Not spicy, just an unwelcome element. I added 3 or 4 soy sauce packets to it and it was still tasteless. I got a small chicken in black bean sauce. Really not good. I left most of it. The chicken had a weird,super soft texture. Not like any kind of meat I've had. And the dish overall was not enjoyable. 
I had real hope for new China Moon....
Great Local Bar!  Good food, friendly staff.  Great place to go before a game or hang out.  Love the patio.

I don't waste my time and rate places unless I'm absolutely serious... definitely one of my top-5 ice cream / custard experiences ever. They've mastered their craft. 

S'mores Concrete. Do it. That is all. 

To anyone complaining about long lines...yeah, it sucks, but if you want zero line for something mediocre, you can go to the local Baskin Robbins.

To anyone overwhelmed by the selection; if everyone could agree on one thing, we'd live in world without war. But we can't...so narrow it down to 2 and flip a coin.

Walked up the pier and there was a long line, which meant that I was at the right place. Food was excellent along with friendly service. I had the crab sandwich which was fresh tasting. My friend had the lobster tacos and nearly fell out of the chair because they were so good. Bottom line: Expect to wait for a seat but keep in mind that there is a reason for this. Take your better half at sunset for a romantic evening.

This was my groups second spot we hit on our "wine crawl" which I really liked caused we were tipsy from the first spot and the weather was amazing. So if felt great walking to this spot. 

This place had beer tasting $5 which was awesome because I'm a huge beer drinker. I liked the beers available here, kinda to citrusy for my liking but I still enjoyed them. I had a great time here the vive was very hip and the crowd was nicely drunk without being douchie.

It was so long ago that i was here for brunch, but i remember it being delicious. Especially the cheese grits.
yum.

Love this place! Everytime a get a chance I stop by and leave with more than I intended to purchase. They have the freshest pastries, bread, and hot food. But the best item they sell is coffee. I have to say that I'm a coffee addict and they have me hooked...I would even say that they are better than Starbucks. Can't get enough of this place.

My wife and I drive all the way from Germantown here. It's our favorite coffee spot in the city.  Coffee is good and the food is always great. (Honeybee is my favorite).  The staff is also welcoming and efficient.

I came here to get finger printing done and was surprised to see that not only do they sell guns and do finger printing. They sell airsoft, knives, tazers, and pepper spray. The only one small thing that I would say could be improved on would be the lack of information on their website but besides that their store is fantastic. And I'm planning to purchase a firearm very soon. This is the place I'll be buying it at.

I believe I read the comment, "fat mans heroin!" Took the words right out of my arm...I mean mouth! Fabulous, quick and cheap! Plus...it's new, so kudos for manning up against the godfathers of fast-food. I have nothing but nice things to say about their food and the establishment!

I still agree that the doc is fantastic and so is his staff.  I will continue to come here but damn...like some of the other reviewers said you wait for quite a while to see the doc.  I waited for over 30 minutes today.  Thankfully i had the day off but with a irritated kid in tow it makes it a little tough.

More like oh no no. 
I went in my first time expecting a good turn out considering the reviews. I was sadly mistaken. I left with nails the shape I didn't like, one of my nails completely crooked and the lengths don't match at all. I tried to have them fixed by telling her I didn't like the way they looked and they were crooked but I got tired of telling her everything to fix.
Highly disappointed considering I spent $45.
Won't be going back.

This places seems to fly under the radar screen. It's a solid value across the board:  food, prices, atmosphere, wine selection, live music and location in heart of Head House Square.  The food is good, service friendly. The best aspect is the lack of crowds, which can kill the whole brunch concept at many of its competitors.

I stopped in here for lunch, even though the reviews were less than stellar. I mainly came in because I had been craving fried seafood and this place had what I needed.

It was later in the day, so the restaurant was pretty empty and I was seated immediately I decided to start with a bowl of the corn and crab bisque. The bisque wasn't anything overly special, but it was pretty good and I enjoyed it. I also got the Des Allemands catfish, which was one of the lunch specials of the day. This was great! A generous serving of tender catfish that was lightly battered and very tasty was presented with diced potatoes and green beans. The fish wasn't over cooked at all and the potatoes and green beans were a good addition to the meal.

Service was good and the food came out quickly, probably because there weren't a lot of people here. I would say this is a good place for lunch, but the atmosphere feels a little "cold" for dinner.

Joe is a phenomenal realtor!  He is very trustworthy, knowledgeable, and prompt.  As a first time homebuyer, I had no idea what I was doing.  Joe was very patient and walked me through every step of the process.  He was excellent at finding properties that were a great fit for me.  Joe made the process very enjoyable and educational.  I hope to work with him again in the future and will recommend him to everyone I know.

Guy called Bryan Gilmore is Head Chef at The Creole Creamery who I think is a genius wizard. He has apparently made over 400 flavors of ice cream up to date. Ever tried Sweet Potato Sassafras Praline flavored ice cream? The Creole Creamery is the only place in New Orleans that has unique flavors like this. 
Don't be discouraged by the exterior of this place. At first glance, Creole Creamery seems like a reminiscent of an old-school parlor with a hot-pink interior. There is an old local bakery's neon sign mounted over its doorway. But once you step in you will stumble upon one of the most amazingly awesome creamery that you will find in North America.
What makes The Creole Creamery's Sundaes and Ice Cream unique is the different and unique ingredients they use like corn, avocados, sweet potatoes and beets. They often step outside the box with ice-cream flavors like a surprisingly tasty avocado (surprising because I don't care much for avocados), sweet Lavender Honey and a refreshing, fruity peach Riesling. But my all-time favorite here is their signature old-fashioned, Creole cream cheese. This ice cream uses an old-style farmhouse cheese - think sweet, more spreadable cream cheese - and which is whipped into the ice cream. The result is velvety smooth, refreshing ice cream that's results in a fabulously rich dessert that's very, very hard to stop eating. Think of Creole cream cheese flavored ice cream as a summer version of cream cheese frosting.
Nom Nom!! I'll have another scoop of this thick and luscious ice cream.

Did not share a lot of other posters' experiences. Service was fast and friendly. The food was hot and flavorful. The grits and casserole were awesome sides and the biscuits were some of the best we've had in the south so far. Give this place a shot and you will be well-satisfied!

The staff is friendly, the bank is clean, and they always have suckers (win!) but I do have a few problems with this location...first, they never seem to have enough people working (always a long wait), second, they cannot notarize wills (weird!), and third, they cannot let another staff member serve as a witness for a notary (Wells Fargo does!). So, yeah. Friendly and abundant suckers as pluses; limited staff and limited options as negatives.

I bought a deal chicken coupon because I loved the Kirkwood location and my intention was going THERE.....until I went to make a reservation and found out it was closed! What a terrible disappointment! To my surprise, the restaurant on Clayton, though a bit farther to drive to, is a bit on the dressier side. We were asked wether we wanted to be seated in the dining room or the courtyard. My friend and I were dressed "business casual", so we chose the courtyard, making us feel less out of place and much more comfortable. The menu on the website still has my ABsolute favorite appetizer listed, the smoked trout with garlic lemon aioli...and it is NOT on the menu there. Again, I was disappointed. (HINT TO RESTAURANT: Please update your website!!!)
But, fear not fans of the Kirkwood location! The food and service is still up to the best standards, and the rest of the meal was NOT a disappointment.
My friend and I shared the Carpaccio appetizer, which was very good. We both had excellent entrees, and were much too full for dessert. I would definitely pay full price for a meal here on a special occasion, and the staff were excellent and deserved the good tip that we left.

My daughter took me here on a rainy cold night and we arrived just as Tony was about to close. He welcomed us in warmly and proceeded o make one of the BEST pizzas I ever had. Delicious and with tremendous care. Tony and his kindness only make it better!

This place is my refuge. I get my nails done about once a week whether they need it or not. Within two visits they knew me by name. The woman who runs the place is clairvoyant, I swear. She always seems to know exactly what I need. 

But objectively. Services I've had: 

Gel nails: always gorgeous, ballpark guess, around a hundred color options. Their designs are always on point and they're enthusiastic about trying out ideas. 

Pedicures: I've fallen asleep while in the chair. Twice. They're that comfortable and relaxing. This is coming from someone who can barely stand to have their feet touched. Toe polish is, again, always on point. 

Wax: possibly the best brow shaping I've ever had done. Ever. I suspect wizardry. So comfortable, I went ahead and had her do my "problem spots" on my face as well. 

Deep tissue massage: the room is private and comfortable, just a teensy bit small. I was truly shocked by how much force this teensy woman was able to apply. Because it was deep tissue, I was a tiny bit sore after, as though I'd done a particularly trying workout. 

On top of all that, the women are very warm and welcoming. I always breath a sigh of relief the moment I walk through the door. 

They're not cheap, but they're also not ridiculously expensive, and they're worth every penny.
I ordered a cheese steak when this place first opened. Very greasy.  Grease soaked through the roll and the bag.  The french fries were good though.

My husband and I love this place! I think they had just opened when we got stationed here, and this was the first restaurant we went to, on our first night here before we had the kitchen unpacked. We love it! Their selection of sushi is expansive without being overwheming, and they have a good selection of Japanese dishes for those not fond of sushi. The first night we went I had the udon soup which was as delicious as it was massive, I took half of it home for the next day's lunch! My husband had the beef teriyaki bento box, and it was very good, as was the clear soup and salad it came with. I can't remember everything else we had, as that was a few months ago, but we sampled quite a bit of the various sushi offerings and they were all delicious! I love flying fish roe, and theirs was extremely fresh and fabulous! We also had a raw tuna salad that was absolutely amazing! Our waitress was very sweet and brought out a fork and training chopsticks for our 3 year old. 

We went again last night for my birthday dinner and, again, everything was fabulous! We started out with the gyoza, which was perfectly crisp on the bottom and tender throughout, and the dipping sauce was wonderful, I made sure to save it for my sashimi. I had the Chirasi bento box meal, with two to three pieces each of 7 different sashimi pieces, including octopus (This was a first for me, I love it!), salmon, tuna, and crab stick with seasoned rice topped with roe. I am not honestly certain what the other two were, they were white fleshed fish, I think one may have been swordfish. I'm not good at guessing unless they have a distinct appearance. The presentation was gorgeous with some of the fish rolled into rose shapes. Lovely. The dippind sauce from the goyoza was fab on the white fish, too! We also ordered the shrimp and avocado rolls, which were delish, and my husband had the beef teriyaki again, which was just as great as before! We both had the miso soup this time and it was very good! I wanted to get some red bean ice cream, as that is a favorite of mine, but our son was getting antsy, so we headed home. 

I must also add that they offer a military discount, which is always appreciated! We would definitely be here more often if we ate out of the house more (I just love to cook!), and will definitely keep coming back! My only complaint is that they don't carry Orion beer, which is one my husband drank a lot of while stationed in Japan, and he says is also very popular there. I also wish I didn't have to ask for a fork, as I am slightly chop stick handicapped, and it's a rather embarassing thing to have to ask for, so I wish they would be offered at the table along with the chopsticks. However, that is quickly remedied by asking for a fork for my son, hiding it, pretending it fell on the ground, and asking for another! ;)

Maybe I'm biased because I've been coming here for going on twelve years now, but Uncle Andy's is absolutely one of the best ice cream shops on St. Pete Beach. We used to walk across the old drawbridge and treat ourselves to ice cream on lazy afternoons on our visits. Traveling across the bridge to the big pink fairy castle to get the best ice cream around is still worth it. 

It's definitely got an old-timey feel still, with old arcade games and vintage prints of the Don hanging on the walls. The coffee corner still stands for people who (for whatever forsaken reason) don't want ice cream. The coffee smell just adds to the charm. 

The ice cream itself definitely has that homemade taste. It's not super-smooth like superstore brand ice cream would be, but you can feel the texture of it. The flavors aren't extremely plentiful, but what they have are classics and perfect. Their malts and sundaes are supposed to be pretty good, but I've never strayed from my chocolate scoops!! 

The only real complaint is wow, super pricey. It should come expected, though, given that it is there as part of the Don Ce Sar Resort. It was about $14 for two separate cones, and then a ridiculous $7 for two bottles of water (what!?). 

The memories I have with this place may make me lean towards five stars, but I think it deserves it either way.

Delivery

Ordered crab rangun, steamed dumplings, sesame chicken, sweet and sour chicken, and pork fried rice.

We live in the West Norriton/Norristown line - ordered the food at 5pm on a Friday and the knock at the door was at roughly 545.

Younger Asian man with glasses was very polite and thanked us for the order.

Everything was hot when opened and even though we never asked for any drinks they included a can of Grape Soda and Ginger Ale with the order. We don't drink soda but the addition was unexpected and a nice surprise.

Steamed dumplings were good - the dough was a bit thicker than expected but still tasty.  Sesame chicken had a good taste and wasn't over/under cooked though the sauce it was in tasted much sweeter than anticipated. Sweet and sour chicken was done well and had a great taste - the sauce was on point too! Pork fried was seemed a bit overcooked but not bad.  Girlfriend says the Crab Rangun was good.

All things considered the food was good, friendly service, and on par delivery. We will order from them again in the future.
Reasonable prices, excellent customer service and clothes are always clean and fresh after,  perfect clothing alteration.

I love this place! The fried chicken is the BEST. The crunchy skin isn't greasy at all. Amazing. The greens and mashed potatoes are great too. The cornbread that come with the meal is sweet and buttery. Like a dessert. Yum.

The cheapest option is to get just veggies. It makes a great meal and is really inexpensive!  My kids love to eat here as well.

They have a meeting room that is perfect for business events. I attend the Mt. Juliet Chamber meetings there and always look forward to eating that delicious food. 

Just wanted to give a shot-out to one of my favorite restaurants!

Sarah Jane Nelson
owner - LIFE IS ROSEY: Jewelry & Gifts

This gym is pretty decent.  It's small so just know that going into it.  I was used to PSC where there was a ton of different types of equipment so it took a week or so for me to adjust to a smaller gym.  The staff is very pleasant and is probably the best gym staff I have ever seen in my 15 years of being a gym rat.  The personal trainers actually look the part!  This isn't always the case at other gyms which has always been confusing to me.
 
My only complaint about the gym would be the use of the space on the upper floor.  It looks like they could fit more equipment (weight machines or free weights) on this floor.  Additionally, one room has a really nice set of circuit equipment in it and suspension training equipment in it but it is always occupied by the "We Fit" class.  It's a great class and I am sure the members who take it regularly love it but the class is given at 5:30 pm and 6:30 pm eliminating that entire room and all of its equipment during the busiest hours of the gym.  It doesn't make much sense to me to dedicate that room during those busy hours to a very small percentage of members working out.  The equipment in that room would relieve the wait times and overflow in the free weight room and the only other weight circuit.
 
Overall the gym does the trick and I can get a good workout in.  Like I said, the staff is great which is sometimes hard to find in a gym.  I was told there would be a juice bar but there have been no signs of it yet.
Super young crowd. I guess you get what you pay for but the $10 all you can drink includes only the crappiest liquor.

I love chipotle, but this location is just terrible. I've gone a few times hoping maybe it was just a fluke.  Overall the food at this location is poor quality and doesn't taste as good as others

Staff is very friendly, however.

I love freedom massage, everyone is so friendly and helpful. I've been regularly going to Sarah, she is always professional and friendly. She's always responsive to feedback and helpful in relieving my issues as well as explaining things with my body and how I can do certain stretches at home to minimize my issues. 
I've actually tried almost every masseuse at freedom and I have no complaints, they're all really good and I always leave feeling amazing. Thank you freedom massage for relieving so much tension and stress from my body over the past couple years, I feel like a new woman!

Went to brunch at this charming restaurant this past weekend. The service was a bit slow but still attentive and the food was delicious. I had the smoked salmon on toast with a side of roasted potatoes. 

The coffee was fresh and the restroom was clean, which is always a nice touch. Be certain to check out the photos on the walls as they're a taste of old Hollywood glamour! My friends mentioned that many of the celebrities who live in Montecito love to eat here as well.

We live less than five blocks away.  After the second time in a row the pie was delivered cold I  called to complain and the response, verbatim, was, "What can I tell you?"  I told him he didn't have to tell me anything, I would go elsewhere.  Over the years I have never returned and never will.  I will not spend my money where I am disrespected.
Greasy horrible breakfast food.   Low quality. Food.  Downhill since what it use to be  just cheap breakfast food.

The food was bland. we ordered the burrito bowls but they didn't have it with steak so we asked them to replace the chicken bowl with steak instead. We were charged for the full Chicken burrito bowl and then charged extra for steak but we didn't get chicken and steak, only steak. What a rippoff, overated. 
Chipotle's just opened up about a few feet away.....Goodbye Moe's.
The pizza was good and as a delivery was right on time. The wings where a little bland but it might have been the way I ordered them. Overall a good experience.
Great sushi, friendly staff, and a cool environment for lunch downtown or heading out for the night on Wash St. I'll definitely be back.
Friendly staff, arcade cabinets, big screen TV for the epic matches, and a damn good Chicken Club.

I took my mom, sister, and niece here for dinner and we all enjoyed ourselves. The waiter chatted with us, gave menu recommendations, and was funny. I liked the atmosphere and local art they hung on the walls. I'd go back

Their prices for dry cleaning are WAY too high - I will use them for dress shirts, but not dry cleaning again. $10 for a sweater is ridiculous, as is almost $8 for dress pants. It may be "santa barbara" prices, but at these prices i will drive to Goleta or Carp before getting these bills.  Very disappointing
This is my Go to nail place. They just updated and the new chairs are great. Kim is the best and the price point is spot on. Highly recommend.

Bland food, bad service. We had a group of 14...group of people just looking for some music, cocktails and snacks. Told we couldn't sit outside because the wait staff couldn't accommodate, so they sat us inside. Within five minutes the entire outside cleared, barely a soul in sight. Then three parties the same size were sat outside. Immature, inexperienced, and rookie staff makes for a terrible experience. Note: the on-duty manager (4/24/16) was apart of the problem, a big part of it. Secondly, had the grouper sandwich after everyone raved about the grouper in this area...worst fish sandwich I've ever had.

It was our second time here.  Great food. Fantastic, fast service.  I ordered the jambalaya a half hour before closing, but they were out.  The cook came out to our table and asked me if he could still make it for me since he had the ingredients on hand, and it was excellent! Though I must say, the pulled pork sandwich with coleslaw was the winner of our two meals!  Potato chumpies were a good starter.  The white BBQ sauce was tasty as well as the blueberry habanero.  We'll certainly return again and again.
Our go to in the neighborhood! Delicious food, great drinks, kid friendly environment. Awesome staff.

This was my first visit to Tarpon Springs. If you're expecting a ton of Greek restaurants, touristy shops full of sponges of all shapes, sizes and qualities and every variation of gator and Florida tchotchke, Tarpon Springs is a perfect stop for all of that. Between the incessant heat (if you're going in the summer) and dock boat tour stands is a lovely little restaurant called Hellas. 

You'll find all the traditional Greek dishes here including the gyro, souvlaki, pita, and all the other heart burn inducing and totally worth it temptations. 

Our waiter seemed a little on the tired side-or maybe the disgusting heat zapped all the Opa! out of him; totally understandable. 

I picked the chicken souvlaki with a side of fries. It was yummy and the chicken was white meat cooked to perfection-cooked well but not too hard and still juicy. My mom got the B.L.T and didn't realized it came in a pita bread, I think she just wanted a traditional BLT not a BLTP, lol. The sis got the regular gyro and really enjoyed it. The hubs got the pastitsio or what he called a "Greek lasagna"-he liked it.

For appetizers we got the flamed cheese dish, saganaki. The guy bought it out, lit it on fire, said "Opa!" and then we ate the heck of it. It was a pretty small cut of cheese, I was definitely hoping for something bigger...I mean they said Opa, that deserves a big wedge of cheese for us to destroy. We also got the feta cheese spread with sides of pita. I ended up dipping most of my fries in the feta cheese spreads-that was yummy.

After this we were too stuffed for dessert but if you're a savage glutton you can get a ton of great things here or go, take a walk so you can come back and stuff yourself again at their bakery next door. 10/10 would stuff our faces again. Also there are Pokemon Go stops just outside, so there's that.

So my wife and I have eaten here in the past and have enjoyed it. We were heading to the Flyers game and decided to stop back in. We arrived around 5:40 with no reservation, we were greeted and sat immediately. This is South Philly so don't expect a parking spot to come easy.

Mark was our server and he was nice as usual. At times he seems to be stressed being the only actual server for all those tables. We started with the calamari Sicilian style. It was the highlight of my meal! The spice was just right, the calamari was cooked perfect. I was a bit let down that it was only rings and there wasn't much calamari only 6 or so pieces for $13.00. I ordered the chicken piccata. It was good! The chicken was very flavorful but again it was a very small amount of chicken for $21.00. The side of pasta was good but it was drowning in red sauce. My wife ordered the prawn and scallop special. It was over a white bean salad. The prawns were a bit of work and the scallops were a bit salty. But overall it was a good entree with a $29.00 price tag. Service was good not great. Like I said there is 1 server and 1 runner for 10+ tables at the time. The biggest plus is we got out 15 minutes before the game, around 6:45. Mark only stopped by once to see how the entrees were. Now, my biggest issue is refills. I was charged for 3 unsweetened ice teas. First off they are small glasses and I just wish I would have know refills aren't free. I hate that!! 


While this is good Italian food, not great but good, it is a nice place to go. At the same time it is a bit overpriced for the amount of food etc. We love the fact that it's a byob. We may be back, just not sure when. Solid 4 stars.

This restaurant has made me try very different foods. I've tried frog legs, beef intestine, duck tongue, rabbit, and so on. They were all delicious. I don't like spicy food but there is plenty to find here that is not too spicy. You can also tell them to make dishes mild. They have the best singapore mei fun I've eaten in New Jersey so far as well.

This is the first place I go everytime I come to Indy, they don't have them in Cali.  I have been going to this specific one since I was in middle school.  We used to go every Friday after the football games.  I have always gotten my usually ( frisco melt). Service and management is great still my favorite.

Visited on a Saturday night. The place was packed, mostly families with kids and a few large groups. The ambiance is non-existent, just your average run-of-the-mill pizza place. When we arrived, we were instructed to sit wherever we wanted. 

First of all, the service was terrible. Only saw our waitress to give our order, get our food and beg for boxes/check when we finally did see her again. No one ever asked if we wanted drink refills, etc. The table wasn't even clean when we sat down. 

The food itself was "meh.". I had the cannelloni which wasn't worth it. As someone else mentioned, the sauce is bland. Instead of having real mozzarella melted on top, it just had some processed shredded mozzarella. Plus I prefer cannelloni baked in a dish and this was just two noodles thrown on a plate. We also had a pizza, which wasn't terrible, but again as someone else mentioned, they clearly use canned mushrooms. I did see someone eating the pasta con broccoli and true to other reviews, it looked terrible. I couldn't even see sauce on it. 

I can see how this place is affordable and convenient for people with kids who aren't expecting a gourmet meal. As the pizza was not horrible and there are limited options in Fenton, I might return for carryout. But the service alone would keep me from dining in again. 

My suggestion would be to cut the number of entree and pasta options on the menu in half until they master those. The menu has too many options if they are all going to come out that poorly.

We had taken our family here last night. I had been on a business trip and promised my toddler we would go.
We arrived at 7:45pm
Ordered a large wings platter to snack on.
Wings arrived at our table at 8:20pm and were ordered at 7:52pm
Purchased 80 tokens for $20.
The place was in good working order.
My 2 year olds birthday is this week , so although I was hoping for Chuck E Cheese, I knew there might be a chance that we didn't get to see him.
At 8:25pm they announced that Chuck E would be out in 5 minutes. 
I was thrilled.  Kids gathered around the place where he dances waiting for him.
He never came. 
The place had quite a few kids who would have really enjoyed the Chuck E dance.
Not sure why they wouldn't bring him out as scheduled.

You would not expect this place to be as romantic as it is on the inside!!! When I pulled up I was pretty confused (and a little bit concerned), but was pleasantly surprised when I walked in. Everything was perfectly priced and the woman serving my friends and I was very funny. I got the green curry with scallops and was super excited that I was able to choose my level of spice because I like to go crazy with it!! There are not many places that do authentic Thai spice and this one really did it for me. Super tasty as well. I'm so glad that I live just down the street from this place, as I am definitely going to be frequenting.

Will not go back. I had high hopes. A friend recommended it and husband had had lunch here a few times but this was not a great experience. Our waitress was flakey, Drinks mixed up and delivered to the wrong Table. Got Guacamole and no chips. Son's chicken fingers had and odd taste (like fried in old oil and too much flour). Other son ordered Mixtos (steak, pork and chorizo) skillet tacos and  now had an upset stomach. I had the shrimp and crab bake and it tastes like fake crab... and too much cheese. Overall disappointed and underwhelmed. But my jalapeño margarita was good.

quick stop before we head back to Nashville, Tennessee ... Very good and authentic! So pleased that we found this spot before our trip back home. Very accommodating, great selection. Great service, food was delievered in a timely manner. Last but not least, delicious!

* great for families.
My dad came here he said they give nice cuts for only 5 dollars but when he comes home he has a bowl cut not a fade but with a nice line up

Had never been to Dewey's before but decided to go with a friend who was a big fan of their location in Cincinnati! I ordered a caesar salad, which was a really good basic salad. We decided to order a pizza and do half and half with the bbq chicken and the seasonal pizza at the time (don't remember what is was) but it was delicious!

Overall, great food, prompt and friendly service! I will definitely go back!

First time at this place and it didn't disappointed.
My kids brought me here for Father's Day as we wanted to try a different Authentic Mexican Restaurant.
Glad they did as all food we ordered was delicious and tasty. I loved the home made corn tortillas, made fresh from scratch. Salsa and chips were also very good.
I definitely recommend this place. 
I now have this restaurant in the top of my best Authentic Mexican Restaurants in Tucson and Phoenix!

What can I say that hasn't already been said? The music is fantastic, and was 100% worth the wait, the $20 cash, and the standing room only. I am planning to download some of their albums on iTunes now. It's made my husband a jazz convert!

Ordered the "I Love You" gift tin on 10/6 and requested it to be delivered by 10/9, and it was delivered promptly on that date. Did not have to request expedited shipping or anything, just selected standard shipping. I am personally not a huge fan of normal fortune cookies, but I thought these tasted way better! Can't wait to try new flavors with my next order :)

Dunks has the best coffee hands down. However, this location has service issues at times. Today I went through the drive-thru after a fiasco at Fox's Donut Den. All I wanted was coffee! I waited... And waited..... Finally I park and go inside. I asked why I got no response from the drive-thru and was told it's broken. The man behind the counter was nice and even gave me the coffee for free. I'll continue to go there only because there are few other DD's in west Nashville. Just be prepared, though the coffee is outstanding, the service is hit or miss.
This has to be the best Chinese food in the area.  Always clean with a very pleasant staff.  Had the pleasure of being served by Grace.

The quality of the food is great, but the service is horrible. In addition, I had an unpleasant experience on my last visit a couple of months ago and vowed not to go back. Picked up a carry out order after waiting well beyond when they said it would be ready. While at a stop light on my way home, I decided to vent the sesame chicken container to keep it from getting soggy. There was no sesame chicken in the bag. I drove back and they admitted they had given me the wrong order. There was a person sitting there and it was determined it was her food. They tried to get her to accept the food that I had taken from the restaurant and had been in my car! I would never want food that someone else had had in their possession and neither did she. She finally got them to agree to make her new food. Can't believe she even had to ask! Then, because they had charged me for the wrong order, they made me pay them the difference of $4.32 before giving me my food!! I'm sorry, but wasn't I the one inconvenienced by having to drive back? I was shocked they tried to collect. They lost a regular patron because of poor customer service. If it hadn't been so late and had there not been a household of starving people waiting to eat, I would have told them to keep their food and would have asked for a refund.

Got greek salad and spicy chicken wrap. Was able to change tortilla style but wish they did half wraps so I could get half salad half wrap. Fairly nice and quick service. Will try three stooges wrap next time. A little more than I wanted to pay for food but that's to be expected with limited serving hours. Food seems as fresh as a chipotle or piada. They did have smoothies and an array of salad dressings. Dessert selection minimal-only had 2 of 6 desserts at noon.
We hired Bella Vista Designs for our New Years festival and they did an outstanding job. The stage, sound, lighting and ambiance were perfect! The crew was top-notch. I highly recommend BVD!
Very poor experience, the waiter was very rude. The AC doesn't work well and can't cool the place. Food is poor, if you have to go just have a salad.

First of all I am super excited to try this new restaurant. I believe this is the first Shanghainese based cuisine in NOLA. I can taste some of my favorite childhood dishes tonight. Chef Hao did a wonderful job bringing his experiences from Japanese cuisine into this cool new restaurant as well. Chef was able to preserve the traditional Shanghainese cuisine taste while adding elements of fusion dishes of Japanese, Sichuan cuisines. This was a delightful and the most welcoming dinning experience. I have to bring my friends and family back again.

They are pure professionals. They cover all of their bases to make me feel comfortable having them in my home while I'm not there. And my dog seems to love them! They give me feed back about how the walk went, what they did together, and how my dog reacted. I love them!

With all the night-club like venues popping up all over Congress Street this non-pretentious downtown pub is a blessing. It is a favorite among some of Tucson's finest musicians and it is not unusual to walk in to find a local celebrity playing the keys on the well tuned piano nestled in the corner of the bar. The setting is intimate and the lighting is dark (as it should be in a good pub) but not too dark to see the extensive food menu (food provided by neighboring La Cocina which is my go-to spot when I have out-of-town guests). The pub has an impressive beer menu as well as cocktails and wine. The bartenders are attentive and knowledgeable. This is not a "hook-up" bar. It is a place you would feel comfortable bringing your cousin, your-co-worker, your parents or even your hip Seattle/Portland beer snob friends.

Awesome tacos! I got the shrimp and mahi mahi tacos (grilled) and they were great. I also split the guac with my boyfriend. AS a girl I suggest getting 2 and something small or 3 will fill you. Everything was fresh and the staff were awesome! The only thing is that the guac is a little over priced for what it is and I could have used a little more shrimp in my taco. I will be returning!

When I went in this new(ish) venue on Whyte was very clean, had some tasteful house tunes at a time appropriate volume, and the staff were friendly and helpful. I would recommend it to others! 

I had a plate of delicious fusion style burgers, but will definitely be back to try the sushi and Korean BBQ.

Pros: 

A great area just outside the French Quarter with so much good food within walking distance: Pêche, Balise, Willa Jean. They also have a beautiful Stumptown Coffee downstairs and nice Portland-esque clothing shops on their block. The bar in the lobby is a warm mix of French art-deco and winter lodge style, and our room came with a nice little Martin & Co. guitar. The concierge and valet were also very nice and helpful. 

Cons: 

The industrial, blacked-out aesthetic of the rooms does little to recall the vibrant energy of New Orleans. The one note of color was a cabinet painted with a beach-scene, but even this was off to the side and out of plain sight for the most part. The event space downstairs does a nice job showcasing local acts and music, and one wishes the designers would have nodded more towards the city's history than the brand's in the rooms as well. Cork flooring also retains dirt and walking barefoot in the room is not recommended. One other big con: the valet here is $45 a night, whereas the average in the city is around $25-$30 a night in similar hotels. I recommend parking in a neighborhood and walking over when possible to avoid this fee.
Worst Cheesecake Factory ever! Service was super slow and rude. Go to the Green Hills location. It has much better service. I'm astounded at how awful this was.
Old World Coffee Catering came to my office yesterday. I was seriously impressed with their coffee. I wish they could be here everyday!

I was being treated for neck and hip issues by an orthopedic. I had several complaints regarding balance and range of motion, due to these ailments. He recommended restorative yoga and stretch yoga at this Wellness studio. After several sessions I have regained both. The Instructers here are knowledgeable and caring. They are aware of each individual needs I continued these sessions today and have forgotten the pain, I have also included the Tai Chi class in my repertoire. This center offers more i.e. meditation, acupuncture and cold laser therapy and many other natural solutions under the guidance of Dr. Marie 
Perkins. If you are interested in non-pharmaceutical pain relief, I highly recommend East West Healing Solutions.      Joyce F.

I've been a longtime fan of John Besh (via his PBS series), so when the opportunity came up to visit New Orleans, I jumped at the chance to try one of his restaurants.  

It was definitely a mixed bag.  The rabbit/chicken pate and gumbo were well done, but once we moved on to the entrees the blue crab cavatelli and louisiana shrimp were served lukewarm, so it was hard to warm up (so to speak) to these two dishes.  We didn't mention this to our server until the end of the meal, at which point the manager came over and had those two entrees removed from our bill.

Service overall was not up to my expectations  Our server only checked on us once during the course of the meal, and a folding tray twice crashed to the floor near us, this should have been fixed after the first occurrence.

Overall, the food rated 3 stars, minus another star for the service, plus a star for adjusting our bill.  Given the number of "star" restaurants in New Orleans, it's doubtful if the Besh offerings will be a priority for me in future visits.
Food was ice cold and not great and we could NOT get a server to save our lives. 5 pm on a Friday and there's 3 tables filled with a line out the door bc there's no staff helping anyone.

I was much less impressed than I expected :/ 
The whole concept here is great! Fresh, healthy (depending on what you yourself choose as well), and fun! The wait staff was extremely friendly and even brought out four sauces for my friend and I to try before choosing our meals. They joked around with us as well which is always appreciated  however, overall I found the meal very lackluster. The sauce was delicious when I tried it, but not strong in the actual meal. I suppose more would have helped, or less noodles. I was also craving more veggies in my bowl. The honey bar idea is also very cute (unless you assume it comes with yogurt so you don't actually get it as a "topping" and end up with a bowl of toppings... Obviously my fault there). And I found the place fairly pricey as well. I would try it out again but maybe go a different route is all.

After seeing this place packed night after night we decided to give it a try. We got hand breaded chicken strip with homemade chips and potato salad. Everything was tasty but the service left a lot to be desired. Our food was thrown on the table as our waitress did a drive by and that was the last we saw of her until our bill showed up. I had asked for honey mustard but was given BBQ sauce. After waiting about 10 minutes for our waitress I finally got someone else's attention and by now we needed drink refills too. The other girl got my honey mustard and our drinks. Even then our waitress can be seen on the other side of the restaurant or behind the bar but not near our table.  Finally after I stacked all the dirty dishes up she did another drive by to drop the bill.  

Only in the area another week. Probably won't be back. Would have been fine with a better waitress.
Place was nice, people were friendly, drink prices were Ok.  But if you are seeing a band the sound guy doesn't know what he is doing.
Serious crafted coffee without taking themselves too seriously. Great space to work or study, it's not cramped and dark like some other places ;) My favorite in Reno!

This is more of a drinking place than dinner. I didn't enjoy dining here at all, the service was slow and the acoustics of the place made It impossible to have a conversation. The veggie cubano was pretty good and the drinks were strong though.

After the first time going I will never go to another movie theater. It is even more comfortable than the Cinna bistro, the reclining chairs are awesome . The place is clean and most of the food is very good.

Not only have I worked with Bella Vista Designs on multiple occasions, I have also had the pleasure of being a guest at many events where Bella Vista has created amazing lighting and decorations!

Every year I look forward to the Opening Night Party at The Santa Barbara International Film Festival and every year I am given a treat for the eyes. Bella Vista's lighting and designs make the party feel like an A-List Hollywood Gala.

At weddings and events, Bella Vista's lighting can turn a drab venue into a dream location. I have watched their crews set up many times and I can attest to how hard they work. The amount of detail that goes into setting up one of their designs is astounding.

Trevor is a pleasure to work with and is always right in the thick of things. If you use Bella Vista, you will remember it forever!

We've gone here 3 times snow and it's an okay place for a night out.  The food is generally chain quality and not exceptionally flavorful. I feel the same about their beers as well. Service was good each time, and meals were brought out in a reasonable amount of time. It's one of those places you end up at once or twice a year when you don't feel like driving any distance.  With the amount of high quality gastropubs just across the bridge, it's hard to accept the blandness delivered here.

I frequently travel between Mt Laurel and NYC so I use this bus service every other weekend. I never had any real issues here. I used to catch the bus in Philadelphia but it makes it easier for me to come here because I can park my car in the lot while I am away for the weekend and don't have to worry about someone dropping me off and picking me up due to no parking lots. I've never had anything stolen from my car or had any scratches so it is safe in my opinion. I usually take the 6:30 pm bus to New York and it is on time 95% of the time. The longest wait was about 15 minutes past the time the bus was supposed to arrive so no big deal. The only complaint I have is that when it gets crowded people try to cut in line. Usually they will have a line forming for the bus but people tend to stand around at the front to get in front of everyone that was already in line. The terminal itself is small but it does have some seating, if you can find a seat that is. It gets a little uncomfortable standing outside in the blazing heat or the freezing cold waiting for a bus. This terminal is also not open 24 hours so if you catch a bus later than 9 pm, you have no choice but to sit outside on the benches while the terminal is closed, and I think that's a little unsafe. Overall I have a good experience with this terminal and will continue to use it frequently.
Only gave the 2 stars because they were sooo nice. Not the best Paint job I've  had. I think my chipped nails looked better!   The selection of colors etc. was WACK! Glad I'm an LA girl now!

Siam Cafe is my favorite Thai place in Nashville because it features the lesser known Namsod salad - a blend of minced pork, ginger, peanuts, purple onions, and magic thai flavors (read: fish sauce). Besides that, Siam does all your thai favorites - pad thai, pad see ew, tom yum and tom kha extremely well. It's worth the trip to that little corner of Nolensville road.
The service was solid , not exceptional . I had the ribs , large portions , decent price . I would visit again.

This is a tale of two cities.  Amy gave probably the best massage I've ever had and deserves 6 stars. Ask for her and you will be pleased. 
Facilities were a 3 which changed the actual rating. It was clean, people were nice but it did not hit the Ritz standard. In Dallas the massage table was 4 way adjustable with memory foam-- this was up and down only with a nice bed but not the same. I wear a 44 coat and the thin stretchy robe had to be pulled to go around. Taking a shower and the knob fell off. 
Also the hot tub is downstairs and you have to walk through the entry and exercise room--a word of caution, hottub and pool are coed so being a swimsuit.  Steam and sauna were in the locker area and worked very well
I would return but had higher expectations based on visits to other properties
Bad, bad service, and if you expect the shrimp and crab dip to taste like shrimp and crab, forget about it.

I was pleasantly surprised by this place.  It would have been my last of the three restaurant choices in the Hyatt where I was staying for a work conference, but John Besh's restaurant didn't interest my coworker at all and the other bar/restaurant was closed, but it worked out for the best because I think this was probably the most satisfying choice.

I was not at all expecting sushi, but I got the Cherry Blossom roll and it was fantastic!  Service was good, not great, but not bad.  Had kind of a swanky atmosphere that put us off at first, but I'm glad we ended up here.  Would have given 5 stars, but there was nothing truly spectacular or special about this place, but it is perfectly satisfying.

We were really looking forward to the menu and were disappointed. The restaurant is very loud. Our server was forgetful. We waited 45 minutes between courses and our food was cold. The wrong desserts came out but then our server gave them to us complimentary in addition to ours choices. The dessert was good but everything else was forgettable.

Absolutely amazing!! We made reservations but it wasn't overly crowded on a Sunday, it was a perfect chill spot. The decor is awesome and a very stylish but warm vibe. The food was phenomenal and service was great. We got the dumplings, lobster fried rice, Rick shrimp, Sindy roll, and fishtown roll. The Sindy Roll and dumplings were our favorite. Highly recommend !!!
Amazing products! The owners are exceptionally nice people and carry a variety of great Indiana artisan edible gifts.

Husband and Daughter and I came here for Saturday brunch. It was pretty empty when we first got there around 10am, so we were seated right away. Husband and I ordered our endless mimosas and Daughter got her juice. Daughter ordered the fresh toast, husband ordered the huevos benitos, and I ordered the bagel and lox. I LOVED the bagel and lox. The salmon was really good. And we definitely got our moneys worth of mimosas. Our server was great. A to of people have complained about the service but our server was lovely, I forgot her name though. I plan to keep coming back!

Went in over the weekend. Absolutely loved it. Best fried chicken I've had in a while. It's unreal how you can making something so moist and crispy, and have it ready in a matter of minutes. I see a return trip in my future next time I am in PA. Can't wait for the breakfast options.
Very good donuts just loaded with lots of sugar ... But still tasty...customer service was good ... Also seems like a place to study and relax

I can't get enough Lama in my life. Pete really is amazing. The crew is awesome, the selection is impeccable. The prices are fair and the food at the Nook, which is attached under a separate tab, is some of the city's best! Cheers to the Best Tap Room in SB!
Great sour beers and beer options. Fun vinyl dj nights. Food is good overall- when I went they had a grilled cheese of the week or night which was fun. Knowledgeable friendly bar staff.

This is an amazing place for lunch.  I think this is probably the best crab cake i have had since my last trip to Maryland.  
The brownie and the pies are delicious.
Service was quick.  Waiter was responsive. Good price,  and Def one of the better chimichangas I've had.
Really nice people, I order to go and they give you enough food for at least two meals. If you like spicy, do yourself a favor and ask for the "spicy broth" in your pho.

Awesome!!!! These folks completely rock!!  Great sushi, great servers that have always remembered us and what we prefer to drink, as well as our favorite seats (we like the sushi bar, so we can watch em make the sushi). Tonight they honored us with special chopsticks for us to use when we're there.  If you can't tell, I love the people here. It's not just a great dinner, it's a friendly hang as well.

The 10th street location used to be a staple for taking guests out to lunch while at Jefferson. It's a shame it is gone but hopefully Square Peg can pick up where Marathon left off. 

Luckily there is still this location serving about the same menu. One of my teams  had a gift card that was long overdue to take advantage of so we set out here for lunch. Unfortunately they do not take reservations for groups at lunch so the 9 of us had to roll the dice. It was packed so the best they could do was two back to back booths after a 15 minute wait. This wasn't so bad except in the back left hand corner there is a ton of noise coming from behind a faux wall (that gets hot also) with dish washing in full effect. 

Nonetheless our service was great as we spent about 1.5 hours here. I had a 16 hour brisket sandwich special of the day that was delicious as the fries are nice and crispy. A solid plate for $10 but in general the menu does not have anything to get too excited about. Most of the other people got salads on this hot day which all looked tasty and fresh too. 

I would recommend this place for someone looking for a solid sit down lunch in Center City, but probably not for a true foodie.

My husband and I stopped here durinh happy hour last friday and tried the Chefs special entree.  Our Cchef was Brian and omg the food was greeeeeeeaaaat! We ate til we couldnt eat anymore.  We will def be coming back.  Wow!

Terrible "convenience" store. The only good thing about this gas station is where it is located. Even so, I will definitely NOT be returning to this place. Every time I've gone in there the employees are nothing but rude and not at all helpful. I went in there twice in one day and both of the interactions I had with the two different cashiers just left me appalled. The first time I went up and asked for ONE thing behind the counter and the cashier said "what?" So I asked nicely again and she still said "what?" And after asking her for the second time she then pulls out A headphone from her ear so I can ask a THIRD time. Then I had another encounter later that evening where the male cashier told me "not to get smart with him" when I simply asked a valid question about purchasing some ranch. There are just not any nice, personable people working in there. So if you stop here, I'd just get gas outside so you don't have to go in and talk to any of their shitty employees.

I've been coming to Coffeebar since it came to Reno and I love it! This is my go to coffee shop in town to study, get free wifi, and have a cup of coffee with friends. Prices are great, and the staff is friendly! The place does get a little packed so plan on waiting around for a good table, but it's expected since it has become increasingly popular among college students, business people, and coffee lovers. It's definitely worth a visit!

The instant smell of sweetness gives you no choice but to buy something.  The pralines are pretty good.  I'm a fan moreso of the white chocolate and chocolate peanut butter cups.  If you're looking for cute souveniors for kids, they have cute chocoloate alligators and crawfish.  Cute store, great location.  The people there are always cordial also which helps alot.

I created a yelp account just to review this place!! DELISH. The interior's nothing special and I didn't have high hopes but everything I ate was great and the service was quick and friendly.  Unlike many Thai restaurants the food tasted freshly made.  I had the tofu eggplant, which had a tasty sauce and the eggplant was freshly grilled.   For a starter, I had the Tom Ka Gai soup which was SO tasty, the lemongrass was wonderful and the bay leaves and other flavorings were great too!  Overall, I'm definitely coming here again!!

The 2nd best Peruvian chicken I've ever had in the US - only other one was in Richmond.  Seriously, run, don't walk, to this place and have some!  Just as good as I've had in Lima.  The fries were great, same with the rice & the dessert (Milhojas) were pretty good too!  Definitely a re-do for us!

Cover charge for shows during dinner service seems unnecessary.

I enjoy Puckett's, and their food is consistently good for the price. Basically a classy pick three with ok service and decent drinks. Most recently came on Friday night and would have much preferred to spend the $48 dollars we were charged for cover on tips for the band. It is a favorite with the locals and will get packed on the weekends so make reservations early.
Got the RIzzo and it was awesome. Cooked perfectly! Also got the drunken fries (a must) Staff was super friendly and was having a great time. 10/10 would SPOT burger again.

Wow, I can't believe after 4 years at school I'm finally eating here. I got a chicken club sandwich and it was amazing! Bread was super good, lightly toasted and but still super soft and fresh.  Prices were pretty good too and the sandwich was pretty big. Definitely check it out

DO NOT MOVE IN HERE - THEY ARE SCAM ARTISTS!! If I could give this apartment a negative rating, I would. My husband found this apartment in September of 2014 when they were doing renovations; he was promised a one bedroom apartment in a renovated building. The day before he was set to move in a woman from the leasing office called him and told him that his apartment wouldn't be ready for another 2 weeks and that all they had was a two bedroom available for $200 more/month in rent and would give him his $500 deposit back. With no place else to go he took the two bedroom apartment. We moved in and the building was at the bottom of a hill (which we weren't even aware of existed...) and was completely unrenovated; the exterior was falling apart, the interior hallway looked like something out of a horror film with flickering lights, mold and water stains all over the ceiling from water leaks, and mushrooms - LITERAL FUNGI growing on the floor! I called several times to complain and nothing was ever done! On top of the ridiculous bait and switch with our apartment they charged an outrageous amount for water and sewage. Our bill was regularly $150/month for two people. In our home, with 4 people, our water and sewage is never more than $80 a month. The maintenance crew is a joke and the front office staff could not be any more condescending and rude.

We moved out before our lease was up (we moved out in March 2015) and paid one months rent as the fee for moving out early. That should've been the end of it. Now, a year after we've moved out, the company has sent my husband to collections for $800 for 'last months rent and water utilities for May'. We never received anything in the mail from them or even a phone call, but even if we had, we moved out two months before the month that we supposedly owe rent and utilities for. 

THIS PLACE IS A SCAM! DO NOT MOVE IN HERE!!!

Great place for a quick fix when I'm craving pho. Not the best I've ever had but it still hits the spot. Large portions with a low price. Service is very nice and timely. Convenient location in the Fred Meyer complex is perfect for quick dinner and shopping nights on my way home.  Haven't tried the sandwiches yet but I plan on it and will update then.

Small cozy place for a phenomenal breakfast. Beautiful presentation with fresh fruit and mint sprigs, and of course delicious! Take a look at the bakery case full of cakes and I dare you not to swoon!
The most authentic Mexican restaurant that I have been to in New Orleans. Excellent food and good service. The highlight for me was the green salsa which is the best I have ever had.
This place is really good. We had a breakfast bagel ham egg and cheese. All of it was fresh
Julia Ramirez the Center Manager is amazing. She went above & beyond to help our company. I can't thank her enough, & she really inspired me to make each individual experience one of a kind!!

My family has been coming here for years and always loved it, but we had such a bad experience yesterday I doubt we will be back in awhile.  We had to sit on the patio because it was so busy, there was a festival going on, but it was cool, the fans were on and it's covered so we didn't mind.  Our waiter was very good and food was good.  Service a little slow.  However, toward the end of the meal, a lady right outside the patio decided to stop, stand there, and smoke a cigarette for a good 10 minutes, blowing her smoke all over my entire family, including my 10 year old son (it was his birthday), my older son, who has an autoimmune condition, myself, who has severe allergies and asthma, and other patrons including another young child.  When I asked the waiter if she could be made to leave (Florida Clean Air Act), his reply was, "No, the ashtray is there."  So either Hellas provides a SMOKING AREA right next to their DINING AREA (disgusting and unhealthy) or the City of Tarpon Springs does and they do nothing to have it moved.  I was sneezing all night and diagnosed with a sinus infection today!  I left without visiting the bakery, and doubt I will be back for a long time.  Beyond disappointed!!
I bought 2 mango trees.  A Carrie and a Cogshall.  Both were delivered as promised.  Jene is nice try to catch her before 3pm at the nursery.
Fun little Irish bar. Good drinks, good food. Tuesday (tonight) was trivia night. Well done, and a fun time. I would come back  and enjoy.

$14.95 All you can eat for lunch. Wow! I'm so stuffed. $20.95 for dinner. Still a great deal! The fish is good! The pieces and rolls are smaller which are bite size. Delish!!!! I am coming here more often!!!!!!

Best bagel I've had in the area. I had a toasted blueberry bagel with egg white and turkey. The bagel was great! Crunchy on the outside and super soft and fluffy on the inside.

The staff is incredibly friendly at Olivia's. the woman behind the counter was patient when I couldn't figure out what I wanted, an accommodating when I started mixing and matching things on the menu (I know, I'm a pain in the ass). I was the only person in the place that she did not know by first name. 

A really great place to stop by for breakfast or lunch.

Oh... And they have sriracha, which is awesome.

Cute little eatery. The staff was nice. We ordered the rosemary hand cut steak sandwich. Eating half took quite a while as the chunks of steak were so dry and tough. It was hard to get through eating this. If we stop in again would order the pizza as all of the pizzas looked good.

Great place to buy used children's books to donate to a cause!!! $1.00 each!!!! 
Love the location and atmosphere... and my kids can pick from the books themselves!!
Don't even bother calling. They will automatically put you on hold and then forget about you. Not a place to call in orders ahead of time.
I got the best microdermabrasion at this med spa and their products were great too. I liked how the facialist gave me samples. I plan on being a regular here.

I had my wedding gown altered here and was thoroughly impressed with the seamstress, DeNeal.  It was a pretty difficult job since I purchased  sample dresss that need to be reduced from a size 10 to size 2!  DeNeal performed a small miracle on making this dress look like it was crafted just for me.  She was patient in answering my questions and made it an enjoyable experience.  I give 5 stars to DeNeal, but took one star off from Oakwood since it was a pretty expensive ticket.  I guess it is all worth it for a perfect wedding dress!

Federal Donuts is a total success and with their early sellouts they've kinda developed a cult rep. I've been there a few times so I guess you can def put me down as a fan too.  However, I can't give it quite 5 stars despite the hype and my repeat appearances.  The chicken is great quality but I think the seasonings need to be a little stronger.  Harissa is a spice I'm into but the harissa chicken seems too weak on this flavoring. And in a way I feel the same about the donuts.  Again great quality but today I got the vanilla lavendar hot donut and couldn't really taste much of any flavoring.  If I didn't know what is was, I couldn't have told you for a million dollars if it had any flavoring or not or what the flavoring was.  I'm pretty sure for both the chicken and the donuts the flavor/spices  is the last thing added after they're deep fried.  Up the flavoring a bit guys and I'll give you that 5th star.

Went here for the first time for an acai bowl and it wont be my last. Had the tropicale and will be back to try more. Friendly people laid back atmosphere and I am sure a whole lot more that I haven't explored
