Sunday brunch: the service was good, although our waitress seemed a bit nervous and uncertain. The food was good and really interesting - this is not your typical Anglo brunch menu. This was the most interesting meal I've had in a long time. I'd love to try them for dinner, but right now dinner prices are out of my range - so I'd recommend them for a very reasonable and interesting brunch experience.

In my previous reviews I have given Beach Hut Deli 5 stars each time.

I have noted before that one should check their sandwich if getting it to go, as their really seems to be no quality control and if you customize your sandwich at all (ie: no mayo, etc) there is a high chance for it to not come as ordered.

This has finally come to a head.  I'll give them kudos for having the order correct the last couple of times, that led me in to a false sense of security.

Today I ordered a Hot Santa Cruz and a Cold Surfin' Cow.  The first was supposed to have no onions, the other sprouts instead of lettuce, no mayo, and light mustard.

The Santa Cruz ended up loaded with onions and I had to pick through it to remove them all, but there's just no getting rid of that smell and taste once it's been on your sandwich during a 15-minute ride back to Stead.

The Surfin' Cow had no lettuce ... and no sprouts, either.  Thankfully it was light on the mustard and had no mayo, but it was lacking a key ingredient.  It had NO bacon.  WTF?  How can you forget bacon, that's a standard ingredient for these popular sandwiches!

Very disappointed.  

While these sandos have great, high-end ingredients (and lots of them), the entire sandwich falls apart if it's out-right missing them altogether and the girls can't handle something as easy as subbing in sprouts for lettuce and ending up with neither.

Again, great food here, but at the price they charge, they should do a little quality control, especially with the owner standing right there taking the orders.  No reason for an order to be this wrong when it's not busy in there and it takes 15 minutes to make.

I hope that in the future I don't have to downgrade my review to 3 stars.

i got the shrimp & corn soup special and the cobb salad. the soup was really good, especially when you dump a ton of Crystal sauce in it. 

the cob salad was huge and very good. the grilled chicken was just right and tasted like the grill, which i dig. i actually felt full after this salad and i can throw down at lunch. 

i would like to make it here for breakfast/brunch but i'm never downtown during the day so we'll have to wait on that. 

i would come back. they are proud of their food but prices are high everywhere downtown, at least where you would want to eat.

Such a sorry shame of a once nice place. Wings are smaller,  greasy, slimy and lacking sauce or flavor. Kind of repulsive actually. We threw out last two orders which were pickup orders. Got a 5 dollar credit. Good for one beer, not the food. Food was great 6 years ago, but NOT NOW.  Never again, three strikes and OUT! Sorry! !!!!! Michelle
Nothing beats a butter pecan, black walnut ice cream on a waffle cone.  The staff is professional and courteous.  They do offer a sample if you are not sure which one that you want to try.

I just recently moved to Nashville and got my hair colored for the first time here with Rose at Studio Nooshin. I could not have asked for a better first time getting my hair colored. I asked for a blonde balayage - Rose was so personable and took the time to hear what I wanted. Throughout the whole process she took her time to get to know me and really made me feel welcome!! It turned out just the way I wanted and very similar to the picture I showed her. Highly recommend to anyone getting color or cut.

This September we will be getting married in my Father's backyard in Santa Barbara, and we are thrilled that the sweet and talented Kiel Rucker will be with us on the most important day of our lives. Back when I was in college, I had the pleasure of working with Kiel at a local SB coffee shop. He was always incredibly friendly, kind, thoughtful, and funny. I was so happy that he was available for our big day as I couldn't imagine anyone else being our photographer. 

Yesterday Kiel took us on a little road trip through Los Olivos and up Figueroa Mountain to find the perfect places for our engagement pictures. Needless to say we found more than enough beauty in the hills, and spent several hours together making magical memories and taking gorgeous pictures. Every moment we spent with Kiel was fun, enjoyable, and quite frankly perfect. He is so easy to be around, made us comfortable, made us laugh, and reminded us of how exciting this whole wedding thing really is :) The time flew by, and we were left with pictures that exceeded all our expectations. Now we are even more excited about the wedding later this year and what incredible images Kiel will be capturing. 

Inspired, enthusiastic, professional, creative, committed, fun, passionate, talented...these are only a few of the words that best describe Kiel. He has been the easiest decision we've made thus far, and absolutely the best.

THANK YOU KIEL!!!!

This has rapidly become our new favorite breakfast spot. The food is fantastic and the service is always friendly and cheerful. Everything we have had here is phenomenal. All homemade and delicious. The chilaquiles were a new find today and wow!  Amazing flavors with a slight spicy kick. Brophy's definitely hit it out of the park with this place!

If there's one thing I love in life, it's a good martini. If there's two things I love in life, it's a good martini for $5.

Enter The Red Pony.

Every Wednesday they offer their artfully crafted martinis for $5. If you like St. Germain, white cranberry and the early 90s movie, The Sandlot, you MUST order the Killin' Me, Smalls. (Actually, go ahead and order two. I won't judge. Because that's what I did.)

As if the drinks aren't enough reason to visit The Red Pony, the food is phenomenal. Boyfriend ordered the Hickory Fired Cowboy Ribeye with Tempura Lobster. I went out on a limb and ordered the Braised Rabbit... but not before casually leaning over to my chef friend. "What does rabbit taste like?" I inquired. "Well, it can be a bit dry..." she trailed off.

On the contrary! TRP's rabbit was almost like a roast. Tender, falling off the bone. And nestled in between bourbon glazed carrots and what appeared to be a new take on dirty rice with barley and andouille. Absolutely delicious. My compliments to the chef!

After all those pros, I know you're sitting there thinking "what's the catch?!" Well, the price isn't something I can shell out on a weekly basis... but if you're buying, I'm so there.
Stopped in this morning for a glass of water and breakfast turned into 4 hours and a 17 Morgan diets great stop Trish is the best

Great service here. My husband and I always get pedi's. Very nice and great prices. I highly recommend this place on getting a mani or a pedi. I am big on customer service and never had any problems. I will always use this nail spa

Silver Bear Swim School is the only place where I would bring my children to learn how to swim.  My experience has been nothing short of wonderful.  My kids can swim and they wouldn't even step in the water before starting at Silver Bear!  The curriculum and philosophy of Silver Bear are perfectly suited to any child - a strong swimmer, a timid toddler, and everything in between.  Kids not only learn how to swim but learn self-confidence and safety skills.

The instructors offer personalized instruction in a group environment, encouraging students to push each other and to learn from each other.  I appreciate that children can have FUN at the same time that they learn important swimming and safety skills.  The kids can't wait for their swim lessons (one recently asked if he could have swim lessons every single day) and I don't doubt that has to do with the positive environment at Silver Bear.  I have never had a problem with any of the instructors and always look forward to their instructive feed-back and tips.

The white plastic structures in the pool are incredibly helpful for children who are not yet capable of swimming the length of the pool, but want to experience the deep end.  The structures create perfect intermediate goals for little swimmers.

Not only that, but the pool deck is always pristinely clean - as are the changing rooms.  A huge plus in any mom's book.  There is a large viewing area for parents and room for my kids who aren't in lessons to play while I watch.  I love that Silver Bear has someone on the deck of the pool who is watching all the lessons - for extra safety.  

My kids love the fact that the pool is ALWAYS warm.  I have never heard  a single complaint from the little ones about being too cold to swim - a big problem at all of our previous swim lessons.  The pool temperature at Silver Bear is perfect.

I have nothing but glowing things about Silver Bear Swim School and its staff.  Absolutely 5 stars.  Thank you for creating the perfect swim school in Reno.

LC,

Oh how I have loved you for almost 10 years now. I have never had a bad cup of coffee, espresso, late or double cap. You are perfection in every sense of the word. I don't even mind when you raise your price just please begin to offer larger to go cups though.  You are the best coffee shop in the country.  Looking forward to seeing you tomorrow morning.
I'm sure this place has good food.  Leaving a review to let ppl know there is no bubble tea here, but shows up on yelp when you search.

This is killer. Get any curry +garlic naan, which is free, and be prepared to go home full and happy. They have tons of vegetarian options, naan options, and a section for Chinindian (Indianese?) cuisine. Added bonus: cute waiters.

Went to a pre-wedding out of town guest dinner at Bistro St. Tropez, and it was delightful.  The food was excellent - even more so given the 100 or so guests served dinner.  The bar and wait staff were friendly and knowledgeable.  And the view of the river and that part of Philly was a treat.  What a great place for such an event!

So I finally made it over for there infamous Burger! When I ordered and They didn't 
ask me how I wanted it cooked.. I was
concerned, But I was pleasantly surprised, the 2patties were very tasty. The Lettuce tasted Like juicy coleslaw!! There was definitely a Distinct Flavor to this burger! The Bunn was a Bit too dense, & the fries were frustrating. They kept braking off in to my Ketchup, Because they were so skinny. 25min wait was rough, but I Left satisfied
Worst pizza ever!!! My children and I physically got sick from this pizza.  It is NOTHING like Mack's or Mack n Manco down the shore.  DISGUSTING

The food was amazing. I got myself the 7oz Steak Burger and my girlfriend got the Cheesesteak and they were both great. Granted I will agree with a lot of comments saying the food did take a little bit of a wait but our server was very kind and friendly so we didn't mind the wait. We had a seat outside so I'm not sure what the interior was like but the atmosphere was great. All in all it was a really good time, as long as waits aren't a huge issue for you.
My Mother in/laws bf brought my husband, daughter, and I here. Awesome service, great atmosphere, delicious food!!! Highly recommend if you are looking for a classy Mexican experience.

City Center Park has fun things to do for all ages and abilities. What I most love are the swings: there are FOUR different kinds of swings. There are the regular swings, baby swings, tandem swings where an adult can sit facing a child and they can swing together, and chair swings. That's a lotta swings.

There is also an awesome-looking splash pad. We visited the park during the off season, so the water was turned off. (I believe the splash pad is open from Memorial Day through Labor Day.)

For young children (ages 2 to 5), there is playground equipment with little slides, balancing beam and steering wheel. You can get on and off this jungle gym either via the ramp or stairs. 

For older kids (5 to 12), there is an even larger jungle gym with a really tall slide, monkey bars, a bumpy bridge and more. 

There's a Little Free Library here, but when we peeked inside, it was pretty sparse. 

What else? There's a huge restroom here, as well as shaded picnic benches, tennis court and walking trail. There is also a rain garden with local plants and flowers, which is beautiful to see.

Good sports bars are hard to come by in the French Quarter. Decent food and lots of TVs with good sight lines. There's really no reason to come unless your watching a game but if you want to watch a game this is the best place around.

The food is good...one of the better Chinese restaurants in the area (but not THE best). Their menu contains both the standard Chinese food plus some innovative specials and platters that I haven't seen before so you get a good variety of choice. The service is friendly and the food comes out super fast...but almost too fast. There were times where I felt rushed. They have reasonable prices so overall if I'm in the area again, I'd go back but wouldn't go out of my way.

I've stopped in a few times.  They do carry some products that you can't find in a regular supermarket.  But for the most part, you can get your typical Spanish staples at a Wal Mart!  It's nice if you don't want to fight the crowds at a regular market!
New to Nashville.  Good beer selection.  Had the cheese plate - it was excellent.  Overall a very good time.

Amazing!!!!

A huge variety of pancakes. Tried 3 different ones and all delicious. Special cinnamon syrup for pancakes you can just drink

Eggs and omelettes made to perfection with delicious crispy bacon

A must if you are in Nashville

Great, large portions of food with live music.  Margaritaville is a fun, beachy place with food ranging from fish tacos ($17) to burgers ($16.)  The music is good if  a bit loud.  Service was excellent.  You can people watch from the window tables and they angle to let in a nice breeze.  Lunch is a bit high, but that may be the area pricing as well.  Live music pours from all of the establishments along Broadway.  Nice lunch place!

Batch cupcakery has vegan and gluten free cupcakes as well as a huge selection of regular cupcakes and cookies! Stopped in earlier and picked up two vegan chai cupcakes to go and they were delicious! The frosting is the best part of these cupcakes as it is not overly sweet and perfectly compliments the cupcake! We had stopped coming into batch because sometimes the cupcakes were a bit on the older side, but today we hit the jack pot and got super fresh, super yummy vegan chai cupcakes! So good!

The Indiana Convention Center is a great place to just wander around in the winter and see what's going on!  The staff is friendly, the lighting is great and the food is standard convention center eats.  I love all the signage and the digital boards keep you moving.

The shakes are addicting! I love Ben & Jerry's. Their ice creams, sundaes and shakes are the best. I love love love their cookies and cream shake. *SO* delicious. 

However, the location is not the best for a proper sit down. The floor is sticky and the tables are not very clean. This is why I took the one star away. But the service is good. The staff is friendly and very nice. The location is good for a takeaway. Definitely check it out :)

Stayed here for Whiskey Fest this week and had a great time. We got the corner king room with the spa bathtub which was heavenly! Had the best view of Independence Hall from our wall of windows in our room and in the bathroom. Such a great view to look at while showering in the morning. The room was big and the bed was so comfortable. It was my birthday recently so I was greeted with a piece of delicious chocolate cake and a bottle of champagne that was also very yummy. The only disappointing thing was the shower. The pressure was not that great and it seemed to be the only fixture that was not updated. The other disappointing thing was only being able to stay one night! :( Philly is such a great city and this hotel is the perfect one to stay in to experience it right!
Great place! Sabrina was so helpful with her recommendations and very attentive. I will be back!
A really good place! The best Mexican food in town in my opinion! The Super Fries they have here are the best in town! Overall, a really good place which everyone should check out!

One of my favorite places to go and get my comfort food on ...  the only problem with my review will be that I only have an opinion on a couple menu items because I get the same thing every time !!!

Chicken Fingers, Chicken Fingers, Chicken Fingers -- and Fries .... and get their delicious Ranch dressing with both ... or just bring me a big vat and I'll bathe in it !!

And who doesn't love $1.75 beer in a can ?!?!?!?!

The service is always friendly if a teeny tiny bit slow but those darn chicken tenders will make you forget any delays !!

I can only speak for their shrimp and grits as that's all I tried but it was extremely delicious. The shrimp are plump and sweet and the grits are intensely packed with flavor to compliment their seafood partner.

We hired Swig to bartend our wedding in New Tripoli, PA and were thoroughly impressed from the start with their professionalism. They were reasonably priced and made sure to present our signature drink in a special pitcher and even managed the foursquare special we had set up for our wedding. Overall, great service and I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a professional bartender to serve at an event.

I'm not sure who could *not* love this garden center. I went there with my wild and crazy 3year old son, who I could barely keep from knocking everything over. Despite his exuberance, the staff was incredibly helpful, helped me out to the car (along with the pink flamingo yard art my son insisted on), and during all of this they were able to explain some gardening 101 to me.

Bad experience there. Hostess sat us quickly which was nice but went downhill from there. Service was so so the waiter seemed too busy. Our food was all served cold, the fish on my plate was hot but the sides were all lukewarm. Over salted also. The beer was interesting and the only reason worth coming. I wouldnt waste your money on food.

Who doesn't like Costco? I really need to plan or at least know what to get when I'm at Costco coz if not I will just be randomly getting anything because pretty much they have everything! I like their seafood & fruit aisle, we usually get our lobster, crab, shrimp here & most of our fruits. Also they have their own brand Kirkland, so with paper towel & toilet paper, it's my go to! And oh did I say rice? I think they have cheap rice compared to Asian store so we get ours here. They have monthly sales or a coupon book that I always check so I can buy some stuff that I don't normally get or just to stock up. Cheapest gas too!

We did the tram tour round trip with our toddler. It was a great way to see some beautiful scenery without enduring the hike. The only con I have is that parking was very hard to find. Ranger said she recommends people arrive before 8am or after 3pm to find a parking spot easily. Otherwise a great experience!
You get to wait 20 minutes even when first in line at the drive thru window. Now worth it - even of their fries are die-worthy!

Want to love this place, but they're challenging me. Checked into an upper floor room yesterday to discover that someone else's key card was laying in the room, along with some of their trash. Glasses in the bathroom were dirty, some of the mini-bar snacks were missing, and used soap and shampoo were in the shower.

Housekeeping responded promptly and made things right, but misses like this are tiresome and make you wonder how well anything is being cleaned.

OMG! Their food is to die for. We had the New Zealand Lamb Rack, Lobster Risotto, and Grilled Asparagus. Filet, George's Sea Bank Scallops, Wild Mushroom Risotto, and Grilled Asparagus. All finished with Vanilla Bean Creme Burele...heavenly! Definitely going back.

I had a blast here! I came here for a private HBCU event. The place has a classy, swanky vibe. You can choose to bowl or enjoy the happy hour in a lounge area. The staff was incredibly helpful with setting up lanes and clearing and refilling drinks. It's a great alternative to a club or traditional bar.

Terrible. Not sure how this place got 4 stars.  My coke was flat but instead of fixing it she just took it away.  My omelet was not cooked all the way.  The egg whites were runny -- not cooked at all.  The potatoes were dry and cold.  The only decent thing was the English muffin but how hard is it to toast bread?  I will not be back

After being at Three Muses twice, I can confidently say they're inconsistent.  First time was one of the best meals I've had in a while, but the second was the most disappointing meal I've had in New Orleans.  

To start, getting a table for 5 on a Saturday at 8:30PM was pretty miserable.  We were told to "check back every 10 minutes" for a starting 45 minute wait.  After 45 minutes, we were told to "check back every 5 minutes."  Really?  Fine, food was awesome, we'll play your game (the live music venue beside them is awesome).  

We finally were seated, and ordered food.  It wasn't all bad, but it was definitely inconsistent and average at best.  Smoked salmon ravioli was completely saturated with dill, to the point of being one-note.  The gnocchetti sounded great on paper, but they forgot to put the panchetta, rendering the plate completely flavorless due to the lack of salt.  The duck in the duck pasta was completely overcooked to the point of nearly duck jerky.  The devils on horseback were soggy and overdone.  

A few standouts though were the sliders and the deviled eggs, and the cocktails were delicious.  Maybe their chef was in the weeds or they had the B-squad in on a saturday night.  Either way, unfortunately I won't be going back after this one.  a 5* and a 2* experience don't lend me to trying for the "3rd time's a charm" experience.  sigh.

Went to this place a 2nd time, and with a different BF, lol. Having remembered the salmon to be so good, I decided to go with it again. When I ordered, the waitress asked me if I had tried their Tilapia or Mahi Mahi before. I said no, only the salmon. She asked if I had been happy with it and I said yes, but she said nothing further. This should have been my sign to go with something else. When my $15 salmon came, it was seriously the tiniest piece of salmon I've ever been served (maybe about the size of 1/3 of a napkin and very thin), and the greens under it were puny. I told her I didn't remember it being that small, and she said that was why she had asked me about it originally. Had she actually SAID it will be very small for the price, I wouldn't have ordered it. I looked at my BF's large plate full of chicken kabob and potatoes hungrily. I told her I wanted to order the kabob instead, and for some reason she said the manager had to come talk to me. Then when he got there, she clearly had not explained anything to him and had made it sound like I had asked for him. I told him the issue and he was more than happy to make me a new plate. My kabob was delicious, as were the potatoes that came with it, so I'll stick with the 3 stars. But seriously, don't get the salmon there unless you want to pay $15 for 5 bites. Or maybe the size will be better again later, who knows?

Been going to Williams Sub since the 60's and unlike so many other restaurants the great quality has never changed. The subs always taste so fresh and you can tell that the staff cares about what they do since they are so friendly. I love this place so much more than the chain sub shops but on the other hand I wish Williams was a chain sub shop if they could all be 100% duplicates of this original so that we could enjoy them wherever we roam.
One of the best gems in Philly! Love this place! Very small and quaint.

I love that you can get free samples here around the holiday times and the candy is freaking good.  I usually come here around Christmas time and they have plenty of the samples to go around.  The chocolate sucker is my favorite, but their actual chocolates are great too.  Pretty cool that they have a permanent store at the mall instead of the little kiosk.  Definitely a fan.

Mae's just opened, and I hope they do well in this difficult spot. The last restaurant here didn't last a whole year. After noticing they had finally opened, I stopped into Mae's for lunch, and I'm glad I did. It's a cozy restaurant with an unusual choice of decor, but it's friendly and the menu is basically exactly what you'd expect from a Chinese restaurant -- complete with a $7-$8 lunch menu.

I ordered the Kung Pao Chicken lunch, which came with soup, egg roll, and fried rice. The hot and sour soup was mild but tasty (it could have used a little more bite, but my tastebuds are damaged and it might be hotter than I thought). The egg roll was huge, compared to the standard "lunch-side egg roll".

My entree was pretty large, with big chunks of chicken and no shortage of water chestnuts, peanuts, and peppers. Like the soup, I thought it could have been spicier. But I'm also a spicy food junkie. I was really pleased with the size of the lunch portion, and could easily have taken some home for later (but I overate instead).

The sole issue is that service was slightly slow, and I think that's just a new-restaurant issue. I'm looking forward to coming back here, as it's now the closest Chinese food to home, and is much better than the place across the intersection. It's nice to have another good option for lunch on the East side.

50cents oyster and half price drinks at happy hour! 
And we got a private "VIP" room coz we had nine people. 
The servers were relay talkative and helpful.

Fantastic food and with Happy there it could not be better!!!

Awesome!!!

We will definitely be back!!

Thanks!!
Helpful employees made ordering easy. Nice selection of soups, sandwiches, salads and sides. We will enjoy returning.

An cajun restaurant with local flavors, warm decor, and friendly service by the Harrah's Hotel (on the edge of the French Quarter). We were here for lunch and were pleasantly surprised by their reasonable pricing and fresh ingredients. The oysters were great, as were the beignets. I didn't try the gamba but my friend loved it. 

I tried the crawfish, which was good but too salty. Everything was way too salty in my plate including the corn. Salt was allowed (sadly) to take over everything. The amount of salt attacked my palettes rather than enliven them. 

The whole dish was spicy which was fine. It was the saltiness that's a problem. 

Service was efficient and very friendly, which is a redeeming point. A beautiful restaurant with just the right noise level.

Great pastries!
Great coffee!
Great service!
Great ambiance! 
Had a lot of work done!

1055 is by far my most favorite brewery in Tucson.  Not only are their beers top notch but the owners are very down to earth people who make it a point to welcome and thank everyone who comes in.  You really cannot go wrong with any of their beers as they are all fantastic and vary in beer types.  They recently expanded their tasting room and have food trucks outside to help you fight your hunger and stay longer to drink more!  

All in all, if you want great beer coupled with a great staff then 1055 is the place to be.
If u like a Bohemian atmosphere you'll love this place.  I usually have the Ninja Bomb - a Turkey wrap w cranberry salsa and granola for texture.

I love this place for its cool atmosphere and Ny style decor. I grabbed a king cake donut slice and a glazed and I have to say I was not blown away. 

The glazed donuts are a bit more cake-like which isn't necessary bad but I think for the size there needs to be a bit more glaze on it.  Te king cake had an interesting flavor to it which I though was just cinnamon but I think it's a combo of other things that maybe I am just not used to. 

Good, will go back, but not 100% sold yet...

Honestly this place never disappoints. Great food and service for a drive thru Mexican spot. My boyfriend is in love with their breakfast burritos and I always pour myself a view extra sides of their spicy guac to take home with me (sorry Aldertos) I literally love that stuff.
That dough!!!  PHENOMENAL!!!!  Veal stromboli?  IN MY FACE!!!!!!!!!!  Curly fries with cheese sauce?  YES!  Fast delivery, good prices, awesome sauce (see what I did there?!)!

My dog gets absolutely fantastic care at Penn Vet.  

The appointments take a long time because the final year veterinary students spend time learning from each case.  However, I get several eyes looking at my dog's case and discussing the particulars.  I know there's nothing getting overlooked for the sake of time.  

I also find the veterinarians more accommodating to my financial situation than I expected.  I am on a budget, and I have never felt pressured to purchase any unnecessary products from them.  We discuss the different options for her care and I can choose the one that is best for us.

Went to this place obviously geared to out of town conventioneers because it was convenient to meeting co-workers all staying at various hotels around the convention center.  My low expectations were easily met.  As expected the food was incredibly bland, boring, and fairly bad. I felt like I was in an old-school chain restaurant, like a place out of the early 90s.  The adventureless palates were predictably satisfied and were at home with the uninspired menu and the server's schtick. If you care about food, there are far better options in this town.  I really want to give it only one star, but that feels a bit like piling on.
Fun atmosphere!  Friendly staff!  Good food!  The chips are wonderful--thin and perfectly seasoned.  The tacos were tasty and desserts were wonderful.  Will definitely return!
Delicious Buffalo Chicken Sliders!!! Yummmmmmm.......and an absolute must is the Espresso Stout (Purple Haze) !!!
The breakfast burrito was amazing! All the ingredients tasted fresh and my meal wA flavor packed. I got the apple, carrot, and orange juice as well and it was delish!

Fantastic cuts of meat!  My first time here, I got a couple ribeye steaks....BEST steaks I have ever had (plus I only prepared them on my george foreman grill).  I was pretty impressed.  I've gotten fresh soups from here too--also excellent.  Last time I bought a roast to make prime rib.  The cut was fantastic--it really turned out great!

Everyone is always very friendly here.  Plus they have better quality meat cuts than a supermarket.
CASH ONLY. Worth any wait you encounter at the door. Great shrimp and grits, gravy is amazing and the juices are fresh and delicious. Casual ambiance and great service!

We had their food catered at work and it was my first time trying Greek food in general. Thanks to this place I am now officially a fan and can't wait to eat their food again! I loved the chicken and potatoes!

Zoey at the cashier area is super rude. There was almost no one in there and I had my hands full of stuff and she told me, very rudely, that I could not set down my items at the cashier area for a moment. I had four water bottles, so it did take up that much space. There was a sign there that said not to place items there, but I didn't see it as I had dark sunglasses on. All I had to do was pick up my chicken salad at the other area, which was already ordered, and walk right back over. There were two other customers in there, that's it, and plenty of room on the counter. I had tried to place my stuff way out of the way too. Any other customer would have had the entire counter space, but for my little corner at the opposite end, blocked by some cheese crackers anyway. It's just that she was so rude about it. I was in there awhile ago too, and same woman (Zoey) and same rudeness, only the last time I was in there there was no sign and no other customers. She's an middle-aged/ older woman (50's) with blonde hair, average build, raspy voice. There was just no reason she can't be polite. I was super nice and asked if I could set my water there quickly. I just hasn't seen the sign, but still... why be so rude? I think they should find someone else. 

The food is good, however. But I will now find someplace else to go when I'm in the area.

I have never had such horrible service in my life.  I don't expect much from a chain but this is ridiculous. On multiple occasions I have called in a to go order, they give me a time it will be ready (normally about 30mins later) and I show up at that time, and am forced to wait and additional 10-15 minutes. It's Chinese fast food! How does it take 45 mins? This place needs new management ASAP or this location won't be around much longer.

How are there so few reviews for this place? It's awesome! Yes, it can take a while to get your pizza, but just call ahead! I've tried some of the other "gourmet" pizzas around here, but this place is the best. The dough is chewy and perfectly cooked (no burnt bottoms). Not too much tomato sauce, just lots and lots of delicious toppings with 100% real mozzarella! The two best are the French Country Pizza (so good with chewy escargots) and the Gorgonzola with Steak.

When I first came to see Lisa, years of sitting in front of a computer and typing/texting had caused my thoracic and cervical spine to become inflexible, which in turn led to pain in my neck and shoulders.  After a friend suggested I try Gyrotonic, I found Springtime Fitness.  Not only is the studio space both beautiful and inviting, Lisa's vast knowledge of and experience with both Pilates and Gyrotonic helped to bring back my flexibility, strength and joy of movement.  Thank you to both Lisa and Peter!

Great place to start your day!  Their Ham Hash is made in-house, and is amazing!  The skillets are hearty and delicious, with such generous portions that you'll have plenty to take home for later!  If you prefer a sweeter breakfast, the New Orleans French Toast is incredible!  Cute place with very friendly staff.

While I'm not a huge fan of their layered cakes (very dry, with meh buttercream that falls off your fork as you try to eat it), I MUST say that their cannoli are OMG-SO-AMAZING! Think creamy-smooth ricotta filling inside a perfect, crunchy shell. If you want to have great cannoli, Termini's is your place - do not waste your time or calorie intake anywhere else. 

This place is out of the way of my daily activities, but you can count on seeing me trek all the way there just to get cannoli when cravings do come up. 

(Sorry, I haven't managed to photograph any of the cannoli I got from here since they vanish long before I have time to think of doing anything other than eating them.)

Have been following American Social on social media and decided for the last day of 2017 to give it a try... and so glad we did!  Everything from the service, to the food, to the atmosphere is amazing!  The flatbread was to die for, the chicken was tender and juicy and the girls live the pancakes and sides (we live the bacon!).  Oh and I can't forget the cocktails.. my favorite is the Tijuana Social!

Although this place was a bit pricey for me, the food was delicious! I had recently been to Italy and this place was very close to the real thing!  I had the Mozzarella Caprese and Gnocci al Telefono both with were very good. The atmosphere was nice on the patio last spring and I enjoyed the experience.

The gyros are fabulous!  They were very tender.  The staff was very friendly.   We were looking for a place to eat and stumbled across this gem.  We travel a lot and we love to find places like this.   Also, the prices are very reasonable.
Great Museum!  One of the best collections anywhere!  Have to visit Oldfields (Lilly House) and the gardens!
Been back and had great service and drinks. Tacos aren't for me but cool place. I will deff be back I'm sure at some point with friends. I guess I'll try a burger.
Great presentation of food. Delicious! Definitely will the rotisserie chicken. My husband likes a very good Fettuccine and R&R is the best so far in Reno. We will definitely be back.

One of the best Malaysian cuisine in Philly...  The Roti-Canai is simply amazing and so is the chicken fried rice.. don't forget to ask for hot sauce (green chilly in soy sauce) with it... Just the Best...

Great menu, tasty cuisine, and amazing ambience. Been there times now. Sat at bar 4 times and table service twice. Table service always good. However, bar service lacks in warmth from Bartenders( very cold folks ), less than average attentiveness, and a " going through the motions " attitude. So, sit at table or If wait is too long and you end up at the Bar just tip accordingly.

The short rib tacos are to die for, my favorite by far! So many flavors, it's worth the wait at lunchtime but get there early enough since they sell out fast! There's not a ton of short rib in the taco but there's a ton of everything else to make up for it.

We dined at Paradise Cafe on 12/2/11, after having a bad experience at another restaurant (Seagrass).  We were seated right away, which was nice since they were very busy.  We ordered tea, ceasar salad, and the chili.  Everything was great.  The chili was wonderful, full of steak and we were glad to have happened upon this place.  Our waiter was attentive and very nice.

I have purchased three CRV's from Waltrip Honda.  The one in question is a 2014 model.  In October the car would not start.  Brought it in and was told the battery, alternator, etc. was all good.  The car continued to not start on other subsequent occasions.  Again on 12/31 the car would not start so I brought it in again and was told the battery was bad and it would be $150 to replace it.

Either you did a poor diagnosis the first time or ripped me off this last time.  Either was I have lost confidence in your service department.

This place is amazing.  A casual atmosphere that can be a bit loud and you may experience a bit of a wait, but it's worth it!!  They have a nice menu selection and all orders can be custom made, so if you want something a certain way- just ask , they'll do it!!  Great homemade food and nice waitstaff- (Gina is our favorite).  This place is local for us and it's sure to be a must eat here weekly kind of place!

Guava margaritas. That's all. It's a meal in one sitting or at least it is for me! I shy away from blended margaritas most of the time, but this one is a game changer. 

I would not order any of the seafood items here. Not even the fish tacos. I think my friend ordered the special Paella one night and it was appalling. It smelled like we were sitting across a fish farm pier and rotting socks. I cannot believe they even called that Paella, it was sitting in a pool of oil and had squash and uncleaned mussels and mushy rice. 

As for the fish tacos, super bland tilapia and watery salsa. No thank you! The rice and beans were a saving grace. 

It's a pretty large venue and I see it being great for large groups. They play super awesome music and have a great bartender and cocktails. 

Maybe the seafood was off and that was just poor decision making skills.

Oh my goodness. I am in love with this place. Delicious food; great oysters! Soft shell crab; jumbo crab. Amazing. The server we had Desmond is amazing. I can totally tell he is a foodie! 

Why oh why do I have to write more! This place is incredible!!!

I always leave this place so happy with my nails. Everyone here is really good but Lan is my favorite. I will be coming here as long as she is working here. They take their time and do a super great job. I couldn't be anymore happier that this place is walking distance from my house! It's really such a blessing

My family shared a cookie sundae: a large cookie with a large scoop of ice cream, with fudge and whipped cream. The I've cream was ok, the cookie wasn't very good and the fudge was awful! Not sure if it had burned or what but the taste was completely off.

We appreciate the homemade aspect of the business and like supporting smaller venue vs. chains but this was a fail! Not to mention that the person working there - the owner? - could use a dose of friendliness.

I could go broke trying everything offered in this place. It's set up like a modern day cafeteria. You can chose where you want to eat whether its a salad bar, Wine and dessert bar, sandwich counter, or glass case with numerous tasty options. I opted for the salad and it was great. You can choose from their menu or create your own. I also sat at the bar and ordered ginger tea.
The ambience of this place is good and makes you feel you are in a mainstream city. Definitely check it out!

I come here for the best burger in Philadelphia. I love their whiskey burger. Their french fries are delicious but you have to order them as a side (they do not come with the burger order).
It's by far the best burger in the city. 
Seats are limited in the winter. Summertime, they have outdoor seating.

A must-do if you're passing through St. Louis.

Catch the free shuttle from ballpark village or a $10 Uber should get you there from downtown.

There's an almost grand entrance when you walk through the sliding doors and you may be hit with sensory overload.  Tons of interesting history and information on the founding of the brewery and the chronology leading up to current day.

Insanely cold beers in their tap room and, even though I'm not a huge Bud fan, they've got their Inbev partner beers which give you some options.  About 20 beers on tap and frosty cold.

The free tour was great and you'll get to see a lot of the brewing process and even the iconic Clydesdales.

Try to avoid this on a hot summer day because you'll be outside for half of the tour and it's borderline miserable.

After reading some reviews I was going to skip lunch.  I passed by the Carrollton location and wondered what happened to this restaurant.  Then I read they moved to Kenner.  Mona's is concentrated in New Orleans, but a move of this place to Kenner was a wise move.  I got a gyro and a chicken sharwma sandwich because I only had 30 minutes for lunch.  It was about a 5 minute drive, and by the time I glanced through the Arabic newspaper hidden on a table my order was ready.  The vegetables were so fresh it would make a vegetarian out of Neanderthal man.  The cucumber sauce was excellent.  The lamb and chicken was incredible and in my opinion, hangs anyone else out to dry.  Overall, it was CLEAN, fresh, fast, convenient, cool & courteous.  What more could you ask for?
Pictures!  Well I didn't have my phone on my hip but I wouldn't mind bringing someone there to impress them..  There's always something gaffed up in a restaurant, but not here.  Calm, quiet, collective, & attractive.   It was disturbing to know that halfway around the world there must be a place as nice as this that is without power and under siege.  Like they say "it makes a difference when the owners are there". 

Maybe they weren't the owners because I did not take Farsi in college.  But my best friend "Don Churchman" graduated from the American school in Kuwait and spoke perfect Arabic.  His interpretations really made me like Arabic people more than Jewish.  Abbas just needs an American P.R. spokesman and they would win the tv war and better explain their purpose.  (I know I am going to catch yelp hell for this add-on, but it's true.)
Excellent selection of local and big name beers! Ordered seasonal craft beers - both sours - and appetizers. Service was great too - thank Jill!

Soo good. Hits the spot. Great sushi; great entrees. Lobster roll comes in a sweet huge red wine glass with tempura. Sumo roll on point. Scallops entree is fire. Lounge area quite chill. Ready to relax in this nice vibe.

I will admit that I had never seen a show here before I decided to take improv classes here. Two months in and 15+ shows later I can say that I'm never without a smile here. It is a community of its own and I recommend joining the fun!

I'm generally pleased with the Marriott Chain and often stay at the Residence Inn in Unshaken when I get weekend rates using Priceline. 

I've stayed at this Courtyard - which is hidden in a business park behind the Plymouth Meeting Mall. There's another corporate hotel next to it. 

While the rates are similar to the Residence Inn and they have a pool, they are missing one IMPORTANT amenity - a complimentary breakfast (even a continental one.). I forgot that I learned this last year and quickly found out. They have a breakfast buffet (similar to all the other chains complimentary ones but the adult price is $11.00! You can buy individual items but they are not even reasonable. Coffee in lobby is free though. But there is no close place to get breakfast without driving 5 minutes or more. 

Just alerting others when you compare this with other hotels in the area.

I used to corner up to the Espresso Bar every Friday in high school to watch my barista friends at Mazzaro's make their latte art. I don't drink coffee, but I definitely eat cookies from the counter directly next to the bar as my buddies fashioned dogs, the Eifel tower, and smiley faces from froth. My other favorite things to do at this café/market place are: look at the giant wheels of chesses, stare at the giant stuffed animal heads that move, eat meatball subs on the patio next to the bubbling fountain, sip on Italian soda, buy authentic Italian goods to fashion into gift baskets, buy meatloaf for dinner...and, of course, eat a lot of cookies.

I'm a big Top Chef fan so I'm always a fan of checking out their restaurants.  This place did not disappoint.  The restaurant is very small, so make sure you have reservations. Luckily, we did, and were seated right away.  The dishes are all small portion so they recommend ordering 3-4 plates per person. My friend and I wanted to try a little of everything so that worked very well.  We ordered the Ricotta Cheese & Hummus to start.  I loved the hummus. I'm not usually a huge fan of hummus, but this one was really tasty to me.  It comes with big thick slices of fresh bread.  I wasn't a big fan of the Ricotta cheese b/c it had a smokey/bacon type taste to it. I wasn't sure if that was supposed to be in there or not, but I couldn't get past it.  Yes, I'm the only one in the world that doesn't like bacon and Yes, I realize I was dining at a restaurant named "Fat Ham." 

Of course had to try the Hot Chicken.  It was HOT. Like really HOT.  Don't order this if you can't do spicy foods. I generally like spicy, but this was slightly past my range.  Luckily they give you a slice of bread and ranch dressing to help cool your mouth.  We also liked the Ham & Eggs. Obviously, i skipped the ham portion, but it was very tasty! I love runny eggs on my food. Everything was very flavorful.

Overall, the experience was very nice. Our service was good and it was overall something new to try!

Stop Your Search Right Now, This is THE BEST North Indian Restaurant!!!    Lunch buffet is amazing and they do not skimp on paneer or chicken.  Fresh thick naan brought to your table and on the buffet.  This is the best and I've tried all the other local vegetarian restaurants, also moving here from Edison NJ (little India) I can guarantee you this is quality.

The donuts.... the donuts.... the biscuits... the cinnamon roll. Yassssss! And I love yalls waffle fries! Come here for just a donut; not going to happen! Call up your friends and family and ask them if they would like one because the flavors are out of the world and what is better than a doughnut sampler..... 

Great place and great values. Love the ice coffee too

Wow, what a gem.

My dad and I have birthdays very close to each other's, so we all went out to celebrate yesterday. Our server Duncan was very attentive. I settled on two small plates: the bacon-wrapped apricots (so good!) and escargot (a little gritty...). For my medium course, I had the sweet corn gnocchi, and creme brulee for dessert. Who'd've thought there'd be such a lovely place so close to where I live?

I was asked to leave my purse behind the register just to try on items (?) I was lied to about the prices when the entire store is on sale! They doubled the price of a jacket and tripled the price of the shorts I wanted to buy. The next day my friends bought the same exact jacket for $28 when the girl was charging me $100!!! When all the signage is clearly printed with the sale prices above. What the hell scam are they trying to pull? This place is such a mess u have to literally dig items out of the huge mountains of crap. Everything is seriously over priced and not worth purchasing unless they are having a semi annual sale. 
Hard pressed to find an actual store manager. The girls just pass off the management title at their convenience.

Pretty decent food, friendly accommodating staff and dog friendly.

HOWEVER, website states heated dog patio and it is not heated, not at all.

Coffeebar opened with a limited menu, so this review is probably premature. But I liked what I saw when I stopped by today and I feel comfortable writing about what I saw.
It's a coffee house and I wasn't able to try the coffee. The only decaf they have is espresso and that would mean an Americano, which I hate. So I got a hot chocolate instead. I also got a ham and cheese croissant and a chocolate/peanut/marshmallow dessert bar. I liked everything.
The hot chocolate was chocolaty and they put a generous mound of whipped cream on top. The dessert bar - I've already forgotten the specific name - was decadently good.. Loaded with calories and flavor. It's worth a trip there for that. I liked the croissant and I would get it again. It seemed a little old, though. I'm not sure when they cooked it. And I would have liked a little more prosciutto.
Service was friendly.
The layout was different than the former Bibo location there. They have expanded to the back of the building along the outer wall and they've given up some of the former Bibo space. I guess the pizza place next door might expand into that.
The grand opening with the full menu I guess is about a week away. When I can sample their coffee I think I'll be able to do my best review. But I like what I see so far.

Oh wow. Yummiest!  Sweet potato chips with warm blue cheese sauce. Awesome. Two for one drink special til 10 pm. Perfect. Philly cheese steak egg rolls that were to die for. Great night out. Probably too cool of a place for this old gal.  I wish I was hungrier.

very American-ized sushi; rolls are massive and include ingredients like mayo, okra, corn, etc.  Sushi snobs stay away, although the quality of fish is high and I have to admit it is tasty in a cheap American way.  Fun atmosphere, techno music, trendy.
WOW is all I can say about Aldertos Fresh Mexican Food!  The food is amazing, the place is very clean, the staff is friendly and the salsa is the best in town!!!!
Yum!!! Love the food - green beans and chicken and jalapeños- yummy chicken soup!!! Love Annie

We recently attended a wedding event at The Barn at Hawks Point and the food was catered by this City Barbecue location. First and foremost we'd like to thank Kylee and Mary for their kindness, caring, excellent service and making this event meal most enjoyable! Thank you Kylee and Mary!
The setup was beautiful; especially with the food in kettles and not those cheap aluminum disposable pans
The food was just the right temperature and not dry or cold
The pulled pork was excellent and not full of fatty bits
Mac and cheese and green beans great flavors and super tasty 
Rolls fresh and melted like butter when stacked with pulled pork
Great excellence in presentation, tastes and service!
We are frequent patrons of City Barbecue in Centerville (Dayton area) Ohio and now realize that standards of excellence are maintained by this company regardless of whether it's Ohio or Indiana 
Thank you for adding to this great moment

It's easy to stumble into this bar & grill since it's in the heart of Reno downtown. I only stopped here for drinks to chill on a Friday night. Apparently this is a place that UNR Greek life people like to go--there was like 50 people waiting in the entrance area showing off their letters. The bartenders were nice and I was happy to come up $25 on the blackjack bar machine.

They had their own Silver Peak IPA brew so I had to go with that. I imagine I'll be back sometime to try their food out. I sorta doubt the food would be any better than a TGIFs/BJ's/Applebee's/etc. but can't say until I've tried it myself! For a good time at the bar, at least, check out Silver Peak!

Had the Spinach & crabmeat Bisque, 
Chicken Rosamarino and the
Linguini Al Fruitti di Mare Fradiavolo.  Everything was cooked perfectly and very delicious.  Waiter friendly and attentive.  Cute little place, must make reservation.

I love this place. The dough is made fresh daily and the ingredients are as well. I have never had pizza this good and I won't eat at any other pizza place because of that. Very chill and quaint atmosphere and they have a great beer selection. Blue Moon Pizza rules!
BBQ is some of the best in the city. Beer selection is ok. Ambiance is dark and divey. Service could be more friendly but I get it--they have a "too cool for school" vibe to uphold.

Completely unassuming yet smashing with awesomeness.

The staff is friendly & make excellent recommendations.  The food I've had is great and very reasonably priced.  Their Greek salad is the best in the city - fresh, nice mix of green, tomatoes, pepperocinis, lots of yummy feta, perfect dressing and a soft wheat roll. 

This is the 1st and only place I've tried Bubble tea - and they have me hooked!  A friend of mine that is a bubble tea aficionado says it's the best she's had. 

You MUST try a Blueberry tea on the rocks, with the boba AND fresh smashed blueberries.  AND a Coconut tea - w/ fresh coconut.  Amazing!

Had 3 tacos in flour tortillas. Went with Pastor, Carnitas, and Shredded Beef. It comes with cilantro and onion. I added sour cream and grilled jalepeno. The meat was delicious. Overall rally tasty. The whole place is like the chipotle model. I would gladly eat here again.
They feature new beers all the time!  Love this place.  Patio is pet friendly.   Food selection is good as well.

Excellent breakfast/brunch spot in Tucson. Menu consists of various pastries (croissants, Danishes, scones, etc.), pancakes, egg dishes, etc as well as an extensive drink list (specialty mimosas, teas, coffees). This morning I ordered the fruit granola parfait which consisted of a large serving of organic vanilla yogurt smothered in fruits (blackberries, apples, strawberries, raisins, cranberries) and nuts (pine nuts, almonds). I ordered a side of walnut bread which came with fresh whipped butter and fresh jam on the side. It was delicious. My sister ordered two eggs with homefries and toast which she enjoyed and finished the whole plate. Perhaps the best part of the meal was the freshly squeezed orange juice- the freshest and tastiest I have ever had. Coffees and waters were continually refreshed. They really aced it.

False advertising of prices. Sign states 3 pants $12.99. Charged $15.09. Questioned charge. Was told it because pants were lined. Asked to show me lining. No lining in pants just extra support in waist line. Instead of advertised shirt price. Was charged more for a Tommy Bahamas shirt.

Good for a casual family place. For children - pancakes were a big hit!!!  Mac and cheese was spicy and cheesy for their taste.  Alcoholic drinks were fine.  I loved the salmon sandwich with Caesar salad.  Salmon was moist and yummy.  Light, tangy dressing.  And not too heavy.  Chicken fingers were dry.  .  Kale salad and an oriental like salad were big hits.  

Friendly service.  Well attended.  Comfortable.

I've eaten here twice. Once in 2007 and the second time was last week. I only ordered the sliders the second time and they made me sick. The beef had gone bad and I got a stomach ache! Thank god I only ate one. In case you're wondering, the first time I had the chicken picatta and it tasted great. But that was in 2007. So I don't know what happened to this place.

4 stars, place was quaint and the music was relaxing. At night it's all Sinatra style jazz. During the day a live jazz band. To eat we had the beignets and a muffuletta. U can seat wherever u like and they bring ur food out. Very chill atmosphere.

According to management, the fire marshal will not allow you to park your stroller by your table (despite having ample room to get through).  They could see we had a sleeping child in the stroller, but made no effort to come up with any sort of accommodation.  There were many tables at the front of the restaurant where we could have kept the stroller right next to us.  We asked if we could sit there instead.  They hemmed and hawed and finally said ok, but by that time, we were fed up and left.

Plenty of parking in this large strip mall parking lot.

I come here often to drop off packages.   

I've picked up stamps here and paid for shipping.

They also have po boxes which I have not used.

The staff is really helpful and nice.


Will I be back ? Yes
Was here a few weeks ago. Now I wish there was one in Huntington Beach! Love the food, decor and atmosphere. Would definitely go back!

BEWARE OF AMY!!! I'm trying to have a great wknd but this lady at the nail shop just tried me. After being rude AF (snatching my hand, fucking up my nail shape and insisting that no one in the entire place can do ombré nails) she thought it was ok to say to me, you like bcuz I'm not changing it!  To which I replied, you're going to do what I'm paying you to do. And if I don't like it then you'll change it! This lady sat back in her chair huffing and puffing after her manager told her to do one nail to make sure it comes out the way I want. All I asked for was an ombré white ya'll. Paint the nail short two coats then long one coat. It's not rocket science. So I asked her, are you having a bad day? I needed to know before I flipped the fuck out. She looks at me like she doesn't understand. So I say, YOU , BAD DAY?! She stares but doesn't reply. At this point my nails are almost painted and I let it go. I hit my nail on the side of the dryer. The manager fixes it right next to Amy (that's what her name tag says). I watch as she smiles and nods at the request of another customer (one who doesn't look like me). I sit there a little longer waiting for a snatch of the hand, a press of the drill to a finger a bit to gruffly, a roll of an eye, a huff and a puff... Nothing! I wanted to say to the customer, be careful she's got an attitude. But it was clear her experience wasn't that of mine. So I return to the drying table, escorted by the manager and I tell him, this is my third time here. Today's experience was not a pleasant one. You should speak to Amy about her attitude and how she treats customers. To which he says, awwww it's ok, it's ok, and pats me on the back. The bottom line.... I've gotta find a new nail shop! I have never had an experience like this and it's unfortunate to have to have one such as this today. I'm sure my not tipping her was a topic of conversation as she was speaking in her native tongue to another technician as I was sitting in front of her. Bad service doesn't get rewarded and I'm just not that girl who thinks that giving you my money will help change your views about folk who look like me!

Have a great lunch Buffett and the employees were very nice. They were all engaging and seemed to know a lot of the customers there. They took their tome to talk to me since I was not a local. Great meal overall and great experience.
Some of the best food I've had in Florida. Scallops are perfect as is the grouper.  Great food, great drinks and great atmosphere on the water!

We did not start out wanting to go to Joe's, but finding ourselves in Fairview on Friday evening at 9:15 starving and every place else packed with a huge wait we decided to go to Joe's since we've never had to wait for a table there.

We get seated right away and look over the new things on the menu since the last time we've been.  We then find ourselves 10 minutes later waiting and waiting for a server to acknowledge us.  We notice there are several groups of servers standing and talking to each other, so it's not that there was a lack of servers.  I finally get fed up enough because I was dying of thirst and get up to ask the host who our server is.  She looks at me right when I get up there and walks away.  OK, great, she has an attitude.  Then a server quickly notices me and comes over and short conversation goes something like this:
server "Have you not been served yet?"
me: "No, we sure haven't"
server "We were just standing over there discussing whether or not someone had gotten your table yet.  We'll get someone over to you right away"
me  "Thank you, but maybe you could have come and asked us instead of standing over there discussing it"

Now, you would think that would prompt someone to come immediately.  Not the case.  We sat for a few more minutes, maybe 5 before our server finally comes to our table.  I had not seen the guy who ended up being our server before he came to our table, so maybe he was in the restroom or something, I'm not sure, so I don't hold it against this poor guy as he was not one of them standing around talking, and this guy had no idea we had been waiting for a while to get served.

I will say our server was very good.  He was very attentive and polite.  Shortly after we ordered the manager came to our table and apologized for our wait and said she would be taking half off of our bill.  We felt that was fair enough, we hadn't even asked for a manager and had no intentions on getting anything free, we just wanted a server. 

Onto the food.  It was just ok.  I love the crab balls (I forget the actual name) but it's crab chunks w/ pepper cheese or something in a deep fried ball.  Other than that, everything else they have just seems to be so so.  Nothing is bad, we've just had better elsewhere.  

All in all, I guess the fact that on a Friday in Fairview when every place else still has a good 30 minute wait and you can walk right in to Joe's, you should get the hint that something isn't right with the place.  I would say we will never go again, but I'm sure we will find ourselves stuck in fairview starving again and not wanting to wait elsewhere.  Maybe I'll just work on avoiding Fairview.

I will say after having a weekend full of mostly horrible chain experiences maybe I should go back to avoiding chains in general.

I love this store. I could have spent all day in there. Purchased a rug and some other decorations. Barbara was so helpful in making the  arrangements to have the rug delivered to our home in Orange County. I would highly recommend if you are in Santa Barbara go by the store. 
Carol

The food is incredibly salty to the point of tasting bitter- all of it from appetizer to the main course and french fries.   We were barely able to eat  half of our food. We just paid the bill and left. The waitress didn't seem to care much.

I thought I had found a quick and easy place to deal with, however, this was the second time I have taken my vehicle in to get something fixed to only have to come back a day or two later to have it repaired correctly. Very frustrating! 1st time said mass airflow sensor was dirty and needed cleaned, costed me $130 ($80 to run a code reader) days later same issues and now they need to replace sensor for another $130 (but they were kind enough to note that they didn't charge for another code read. Yeah) brought my car to them at the beginning of the week & they said a sensor in my transmission was loose that cost me $87. Today more problems so I take it to a new mechanic and they say THE SAME PART needs replaced now I have a hefty $400 to pay. JUST FIX THE DAMN PART TO BEGIN WITH! I would rather pay the fee once then have to pay it twice. Never going back.

While I was very sad to learn that the previous establishment at this location was gone, it is nice to have another Indian restaurant give the northwest side a try after a few others have moved on.   

I always stick to the basics when visiting a new Indian restaurant for the first time and so went with the palak paneer with mild-medium spice.   It was very good; the paneer was fresh and the spices nicely balanced.  The spice level was consistent with what I would call mild-medium, meaning, there was noticeable spice, but it wasn't hot (no sweating or runny nose).  I also tried some of my friend's dish which was an eggplant selection and it was delicious!  I'll definitely order that on a future visit.  We shared some garlic naan which was fresh and flavorful.   

Service was great, everyone was very friendly, and clearly took pride in making high-quality food.  They didn't seem to mind that we spent kind of a long time occupying a table visiting after we were done with our meal (there was no one waiting, and still some tables open, I promise!)  

I'm looking forward to my next visit!

I originally would have given Red Robin 3 stars, but my last experience three weeks ago was so terrible that I just can't do that anymore.  My server was one of the worst I've ever had.  I just can not bring myself to go back for fear of getting the same guy and having this experience all over again. 

    Here is the breakdown:  First, he took forever to come to our table and even take our drink order.  I was about to get up and leave.  It had been at least ten or fifteen minutes before he ever acknowledged us at the table and the place wasn't even crowded!  It was a weeknight.  I could understand if it was a busy weekend and the place was packed, but I've been there on a busy weekend as well, and have not been treated like that.  However, I have on a weekday by a different server, but that's another story, and I left happy because a nice other waitress remedied the situation.  Anyway, this guy finally takes our order and then takes another ten minutes to bring me my water and then starts to walk off again.  I tell him that I would like to order.  I tell him which burger I want and that I want it to be a turkey burger, and with no mayo.  He looks really confused and takes about 3 minutes to write that down.  Then he repeats the name of the burger.  I say, "Yes, with turkey and no mayo please."  He starts writing again for what seems like forever and then my boyfriend tries to order.  Then he starts to walk away and my boyfriend says, "I'd like it medium-well, please."  He looked confused and was like, "oh..."   Then he asked me, "How about you?  Medium well?"  I said, "Mine is turkey, so I would like that cooked properly please."  He said, "Well, they're going to ask me how you like it cooked."  I said, "165 degrees please, which is the temperature turkey should be cooked to in order to be cooked properly."  He tried to argue with me about it and then kind of laughed and walked away.  That is a health hazard under-cooking poultry!   What is wrong with this guy?  I don't think this guy knew anything about food or had ever waited tables in his life.

    Then, I finally get my food thirty minutes later and it is slathered in mayonnaise. I try to get his attention for a while, but he ignores me, and I am so hungry at this point and this want to leave this place because this guy is annoying me that I just rip the top half off, wipe it off with my napkin and try to eat part of it.  He comes back about 20 minutes later when I'm about done and was like oh was it good.  I told him about the mayo and he said, "Well, I didn't know that."  Then he just walked away!  Weird! He didn't say he was sorry and acted like it was my fault even though I'd repeated it twice when I ordered!  So rude too!  Finally, we couldn't get him to bring the check and had to flag him down again.  I thought I would never get out of that place!  It was the worst service I have received in a very long time.  Although I enjoy Red Robin's turkey burger, this service really turned me off to the place.  A lot of time will have to pass before I consider giving it a go again, if I ever do.

I loved Bailey's! I wasn't feeling well before I went, but once I got some food in me, I wanted to try everything.

I wasn't feeling a burger so I got a cup of chili and fries with regular ketchup.  I was so confused about the chili when I first got it because it looked like it was potato soup.  Turns out, they put beer cheese on top of it.  It was awesome.  There were a lot of beans in the chili.  I'm not normally a fan of beans, but they tasted fine in the chili.  The fries were really good too.  I tried the beer cheese sauce, homemade ketchup, and the truffle/garlic aioli.  The homemade ketchup was so interesting. I think there was cinnamon in it.  I loved all three of them.  

I tried the drinks and they were great, especially they strawberry basil and cherry limeade.

The best part about our meal had nothing to do with the restaurant.  We were here for my sister's bachelorette party.  There was a convention in town so a big group of them were at the restaurant.  They heard that my sister was getting married so they offered to pay our entire table's bill.  It was 8 people so it must have been close to $150.  They also bought us all shots and had the entire restaurant sing "happy wedding day" to my sister.  It was a really fun experience.  

Our server was super cool too.  She didn't write down anyone's order and got it all right.

The sweet cream ice cream is divine. Add chopped up butterfingers to a like it size and serve it in a waffle bowl (the chocolate dipped one makes it an extra special treat). It's worth a nearly 10 mile drive ... even without a coupon. The staff is always friendly and efficient. I'm hooked.

I swear I've reviewed this before...I thought it was in my collection of Amtrak Station reviews from DC Union Station to Boston South Station.

In any event, I like this station a lot.  The building is beautiful...opened in 1933 it's got some beautiful Art Deco details throughout the station.  The main waiting room is gorgeous.  

You can also connect to commuter rails and subway/trolley lines adjacent to the station.  There's a good mix of retail and plenty of places to eat.

This station is what a train station should be....efficient, beautiful and grand.  Makes NY Penn Station look like the rathole it is.

Deciding to come to the Vientiane Cafe, a Laotian/Thai restaurant, was a pretty easy choice after hearing a positive review about it from a friend. The only difficult part to getting out here would be convincing my other friends that it would be worth the short trek from Penn's campus. Always looking to explore affordable options outside of Penn's standard offerings, I finally got a small group to come out to try the place on a slow weekend.

The Vientiane has a small storefront located along a row of other randomly put-together offerings, including a record store and a Chinese take-out restaurant. Upon entering the restaurant, there was a sense of warmth and community as the waiters and kitchen hummed along and the diners happily focused on their food and conversation. Stepping in from the chilly walk and the proximity of the other tables certainly helped set the mood too.

Luckily for us, we came just in time to snag the last available table. Promptly after we arrived, a small line began to form outside. As a side note, it's probably better to come a bit earlier for dinner because the restaurant only has seating for about 20-25 people.

The prices for entrees, about $8-$12 for most items, were in-line with what I was expecting and were pretty well-sized. We tried to order more Laos-influenced and less commonplace Thai dishes. We ended up sharing 4 entrees--homemade sausage, laab, sweet basil with chicken, and a pineapple fried rice--and stick rice, figuratively the "glue" to this meal as it absorbed the delicious sauce. The sticky rice came in these cool, little Laotian rice baskets which were used for steaming the rice. I'm sure the rice baskets are commonplace, but I was really excited to see them (*note to self: must get out more).

After the meal, we were all quite satiated and satisfied with our meal, including the bill, which came to roughly $15 per person (all-inclusive).
For my first foray into Laotian cuisine, I was happy with the experience. Compared to other Asian cuisines, there was greater use of mint, cilantro and spices to bring out the flavor in the meat dishes. My favorite was the laab dish, a warm minced meat salad served with chilis and mint. It is allegedly  also the unofficial national dish of Laos (I'm always amused where Wikipedia sources their information when there are no footnotes).

I would definitely come back for a lunch or dinner with a small group of friends.

I go here for the iced coffee. Probably the best in town, great flavor and smooth!! Also their deli has some delicious food and oven fired pizza. Their deserts are also amazing. I wouldn't ever buy groceries here as they are EXTREMELY overpriced and owned by the same company as Albertsons and food city, so I'll go there. The staff is always friendly and they have great catering dishes.

Went to bartram's garden and came here afterward for lunch. The restaurant is located on Woodland avenue, which is the heart of the West African community in Philadelphia. This is a small establishment, so eating with more than a few people might be difficult and it may not be the place for you if you're in a rush. If you have the time though, the food is absolutely worth it. We got fried tilapia with plantains and yassa poulet, and both were phenomenal. The portions are enormous and everything is seasoned uniquely. The staff is also super friendly. Would definitely recommend.

We recently booked a wedding/reunion party for about 20 guests at Luke.  Coordination with their booking agent was very smooth and professional.  We were seated in a side room with view of the kitchen.  Because of our party size we had a reduced menu selection to choose from.  All of our guests were very satisfied with the food and service.  Most commented it was the best meal they had ever eaten.  The grilled oysters were quite good.  We also got the baked brussel sprouts appetizer. Even guests who swore they did not like brussel sprouts were observed eating them!  The crawfish bisque was tasty, but a bit too salty.   The roasted chicken, grilled gulf fish, and crawfish risotto were very well received.  Desserts were equally good.  An expensive restaurant but well worth the price if you want to treat yourself or others to an excellent meal and experience.

We stopped by the bar for Happy Hour one evening.  Drinks half price and oysters $0.75 each.  Great value and very fresh oysters.  Happy Hour was very crowded with no tables available for seating.  Seems to be very popular and I can see why!

Update:  Return visit 3/2016.  Still one of the best restaurants in New Orleans.  Great food.  Service was very spotty.  At times we seemed to have been forgotten.  Service was passed off to multiple waiters/waitresses.  Service needs some work here.

Fantastic service and good sushi at great prices (Half off rolls Mon-Thur and 2 for 1 sake). We sat up at the counter and the sushi chefs were friendly and very attentive even though we also had a regular server. My husband and I were taking a trip down memory lane--he had gone to college in Santa Barbara ten years ago and Something's Fishy was his favorite happy hour spot way back when. The fact that the food was up to par with his memory was a huge bonus. Ten years of consistently good food and pricing is a rare accomplishment!!

Only ordered there pizza but man is it salty and just plain. Lack of toppings doesn't help but the crust is cardboard. New to area I just want a good pizza but for anyone new to Port Richey area there's no such thing. 
Not good tasting and not good visually.

I've been going here for years when I'm in Plant City. They are owned by a wonderful family and they have a real old-fashioned soda fountain! Their sandwiches are fantastic, especially Marti's chicken salad, and come on fresh baked bread. I always have a Cherry Smash, one of the sodas from the soda fountain that they hand mix fresh. The decor is wonderful with lots of vintage wares and photos and exposed brick walls. It is housed in an old building that used to have a small hospital and medical office that my precious mother was born in. Always good to see Miss Marti and her wonderful family here when I'm in town. I love this place!

Okay so my friend and I went here for margaritas and dinner. I got cheese enchiladas which were actually good, but I am a vegetarian and they did not have vegetarian beans. Then I got a strawberry margarita which was HUGE, and the most expensive margarita I've ever had. My friends margarita was $12, mine was $16, but I did not ask for premium liquor, although I think the waiter charged me for it! Also I was in town from Chicago, my first time in NOLA, and after hearing this, the waiter told me not to mind the rats and cockroaches! At dinner! Come on.... you can do better...

Nannie Franco's is great for slices and I like their garlic knots.
That's all I have ever eaten there and it's been good. A slice for a dollar, sodas too. 
I gave it four stars because it's inexpensive, the slices are HUGE and it's pretty good quality for the price. It's nice to have a slice place so close to home with a nice outside eating area.
I see a lot of delivery reviews that are negative, but I have never had anyone be rude to me there. Mayeb if I try something else, I'll change my tune, but I am really happy with Nannie Francos.

This Midcity newcomer is really making an impact fast! It took me awhile to finally go in, but once I did, I have returned regularly. They advertise as Healthy Southern Comfort Food which is exactly what they are. From savory but healthy salads, sandwiches and soups to fresh takes on classic entrees, they deliver as advertised. A couple of my favorites are the black bean burger and the turkey meatball sliders. It's also a great place to get "grab and go" items if you're in a rush. They have a really good selection of premade items displayed from stuffed peppers to sandwiches and salads. Check it out! Great lunch spot. My only complaint is that sometimes healthy equals a bit dry, but what do you expect? Overall totally worth it!

Absolutely excellent buffet, if a little bit pricey.

$20.99 per person for Saturday dinner, but an excellent selection, good service, and great quality food, including crab legs, steak, prime rib, gelato, pizza, and a huge selection of other dishes.

The only downside is the wait, at around 7PM we had to wait around 15 minutes for a table, but it was worth it.

Very clean, everything was cooked perfectly, and tasted great, the vegetables, fruit, etc was all fresh, with 4 or 5 salad dressing options.

The best quality buffet we've been to, but also probably the most expensive.

Hot diggity always satisfies my hot dog and fries cravings. I try something new each time and am never disappointed. They even have a vegetarian hot dog which my girlfriend loves. I only wish they stayed open later.
