I like the pool side service and music makes it seem similar to Las Vegas in a much smaller capacity. My kids loved being able to swim in 3 different pools and then head up to the arcade later in the day. The restaurants also are worth checking out, though my favorite is the Island Buffet, so much food!!
Reno Casinos in my opinion are typically for older folks but this one is an exception and we will be back!
Great place for breakfast! The atmosphere is casual, the coffee is excellent (Chemex, pour over, etc), and the rotating menu will allow you to try some great new dishes.

Two of us took a friend for his birthday last night. The Lobster & Bacon Taco (special) was AMAZING! I also had a Southern Fried and a Fish Taco - both great. The 'ritas were good too.

One slight negative with the experience. We sat down about 8:30 to eat so not extremely late in my eyes. At about 9 while we were eating, a server came around collecting the candles from the tables..including ours and other tables people were seated at. Pretty inappropriate to grab away the candle from our table while we are still dining. Definitely a "ok, time for everyone to get out of here" signal.

I've been to plenty of Panera's, and I'm usually a fan.  Tasty sandwiches and decent coffee.  Usually...

I went for breakfast and ordered a sandwich and iced coffee.  The avocado, egg white, and spinach sandwich was fine.  Nothing to comment there.  Coffee was a different story.  First off, I was given a paper cup.  I did a double-take and thought maybe she heard me say 'hot coffee' instead.  I checked the receipt and it did indeed say 'iced coffee.'  That's fine, no biggie.  I got a little bit of ice and filled up with iced coffee.  I took and sip and thought I was drinking water mildly flavored with coffee.  I thought maybe I added too much ice, though in retrospect, not enough time had elapsed for much melting to occur.  I poured it out and filled up with just the iced coffee.  Same thing.  Okay, maybe that's why I was given a paper cup - because I was going to be forced to go with hot coffee instead.

Most Panera's I've been do have a nice spread of coffee.  This one had decaf, light roast, dark roast, and hazelnut.  Not a great selection, but it would do.  I went with hazelnut.  Nothing...  Fine, I went with the dark roast.  I found a worker to report the two issues - iced coffee that tasted like water and hazelnut coffee being out.  Five minutes later, on my way out, I noticed that there was a sign on the hazelnut coffee, which I imagine said it was out.  I just think for an establishment that sells coffee, you need to keep better track of how much coffee is left.  Especially during breakfast hours.

Had to check out after hearing so many great things about this place.  It is defiantly worth checking out. Place was very busy but service was exceptional. Has a nice decor.  I had mussels which were awesome and a pizza which was okay. Problem with pizza is that they don't slice it up which I found odd.  Had to use a knife. I would defiantly return. Pricing is reasonable

I ate at Cafe de Manila last night with a friend and had an absolutely delightful meal with very good friendly service.

For an appetizer, we had lumpia - six Filipino 
oversize egg rolls with three different sauces; an excellent item and lots of food. 

I can't remember the names of our main courses - which, in the Filipino fashion, we shared.  They were also large servings and came with double rice. 

One was a pork cube light stew with bits of potato-like taro and pineapples - delicious!  Another was a beef stew in a heavy dark gravy along with green beans, whole baby okra pods, a few jalapeño-looking peppers (but much smaller and milder), and a couple of other vegetables - it's mouth-watering to write about it!

Most Filipino food is great... But if you haven't tried an item and it sounds weird you may want to avoid it.

I understand Cafe de Manila has a reasonably-priced buffet on Sundays so we're going to try it out to sample some of the more unusual dishes.

Two PROBLEMS:

1). It was Karaoke night and the one singer did song after song missing ALL the high notes - this normally wouldn't have bothered me that much but the volume was enormously high on gigantic speakers... And I'm talking about "rock concert" loud! 

2). Our server didn't speak much English, making it hard to get explanations of the dishes.

RESOLUTIONS:

1). After repeated efforts to get the volume down - which changed it from eardrum-damaging to just being totally unable to hear each other - we explained that we were going to have to leave without ordering; at that point, they moved us into a private dining room (where we were the only ones) and we had a peaceful meal.

2). Fortunately, the menu does a good job of explaining the items even though our very nice server couldn't. As it turned out, we were quite pleased with our selections.

As mentioned, I'll definitely be going back - this Sunday, in fact. I would rate the food at FIVE stars... With the two problems dropping it to four.

New owner, things have changed. Drink menu has grown. Haven't tried many. I personally think the Thai Iced Tea is no longer the same. However, the Vietnamese Iced Coffee is pretty good. Sadly, last time I ordered boba it was too mushy. It was near closing time, I don't know if that had anything to do with it.

There's a menu insert with newer items, I would skip it. Maybe some of the items are worth a shot but I'm too scared to try now. One night I ordered the Chicken Pan Fried noodle to go and, to my despair, it was not what I expected. I don't know what happened, in my mind the dish looked different, even the picture on the menu was different. I even wondered if it was a mistake. Imagine crispy deep fried noodles like the ones you put on top of a Chinese chicken salad drenched in a sauce with barely any chicken. Not the most pleasant experience.

For now, I'm sticking to the egg rolls, Bánh Mi sandwiches, Rice dishes, Bún bowls, and Iced Coffee. I wish the broth was tastier... don't usually buy Pho here unless I'm craving a hot bowl of soup. I genuinely enjoy Vietnamese cuisine and crave it often, but some menu items here are a miss. I really like those places where the menu is small, but you know everything tastes amazing. This place has variety, but most dishes are mediocre. Alas!!!! I still come here. It's conveniently near campus and sometimes you need some egg rolls to get you through finals, right? ;-)
Amazing food reasonably priced and great service! The best place for breakfast and lunch in Nola. Definitely a must try!

Loved this place! I came here for a senior dinner. While the menu is pretty small, I love how it's so focused on Korean fusion food. I ordered the salmon bibimbap with my rice on the side. I thought the flavors balanced perfectly. Compared to other bibimbaps I've had in the past, the one I had at Southgate wasn't too heavy on the sauce. The ingredients were also seasoned just right, so that the main star of the dish was the actual salmon. While I don't drink, I was also extremely impressed by their drink specials. Would definitely reconsider this place if I'm in the mood for awesome food in a cozy environment.

The food is excellent but the margaritas leave something to be desired. I would absolutely come here again for lunch (or for a Dos Equis) but I would try someplace else for a stellar marg. We have the enchiladas verdes and pollo y chorizo con queso and they were some of the best in town. Prices were excellent too!
Good selection. Good service. It can get noisy. It's more of a bar atmosphere on Friday and Saturday. It isn't the place for me.

There is no way I can express how blessed we feel for having these folks in our area. The staff are the most caring, the most polite and the most helpful staff I've seen around (not saying other businesses around are mediocre or anything but these guys are exceptional and have set a new standard). Drika is so kind and so polite that she is definitely a motivation for me to step in the restaurant  (I always hope she is there and thankfully she has always been there with her sweet smile and welcoming words). Other guy who is extremely nice is Mourissio  (spelling? !) And then there is another black guy extremely nice polite and jolly :) thanks for the management for their hiring as this is a rather new business.

Simply the best, most authentic Italian style pizza in Tucson!! This pizza tastes the same as how pizza tastes in good restaurants and pizzerie, in Italy. Yummm x 1,000,000 
Scott rules!!

Best Asian Chicken Salad in Reno. Yum. The other salads are good too. The Gorgonzola dressing is made in house. It is to die for. You can buy some to take home and we have. Yes. It is that good. 

We like the creative pizzas with unique toppings. Don't come here expecting the same pizza you can get at a chain pizza joint. The food here is fresh, delicious and anything but boring. The service is consistently friendly and attentive.

The drawbacks are minor. I'm not a big fan of the TVs they have somewhat recently installed around the dining area. It detracts from the atmosphere and adds to the noise level. There is a Bully's in the same mall so if I wanted TV and noise I would go there. I wish they would bring back the whimsical murals and remove the big screens.

Over all though, we love this place.

Came here for the first time today, 12/4/2015, for a Brazilian wax after a few painful experiences at International Salon. My overall experience here was great with Valerie! 

I called in an hour prior to make my appointment, and I was pleased to learn that residents of the tri-state receive 50% off their first appointment. The receptionist did warn me that if I arrived more than 9 minutes late for my scheduled appointment, they would have to cancel, so leave yourself some travel and parking time! 

When I arrived for my appointment, I was welcomed and checked in by one of the receptionists. She wasn't sweet or offputting, but I wish she would have given me the salon info packet to read while I waited. I had to fetch one for myself. 

This is where I learned about their specials! There is a student special for brazilian waxes (buy 3 get 1 free for $141). Yes!!! 

I only waited for a couple of minutes until my tech, Valerie, came to welcome me for my appointment. She was very down to earth and sweet. She's been waxing for 6 years! Unlike some techs, she told me how much I needed to undress, so it saved me from that awkward guessing game! She also explained all of the products she used on me and we had a nice conversation. Their salon's purple hard wax was very also very smooth and GENTLE! The temperature was perfect and she was very clean. No double dipping! I was out in less than fifteen minutes. 

When I was done, Valerie instantly picked up one of their salon's products and put it at the checkout counter. I was a little off put as I was put on the spot, but I didn't mind because I was interested in the product anyways. The wax itself was $23 for the first time, but it's normally $47. Despite a few things, it was a great experience! I already booked my next appointment with Valerie!! Hope this helps you! =)

Short notice reservation for 25 people turned into nearly 35.  Wait staff handled everything very well and the kitchen had the meals out at a reasonable pace. T-bone special was excellent and at a great price.  Don't do what we did and put a restaurant crew through this kind of torture.  Thanks for the great service and putting up with all of us, Creekside/Bull on 19.
Just ate there and the meatloaf dinner. Absolutely f'n horrible. Diarrhea in 5 minutes. Worst dinner I've ever had. No stars.

I have never written a yelp review until now but I had to do it. ABSOLUTELY DISGUSTING ESTABLISHMENT! I was in last night with a friend. The two young men behind the counter look absolutely miserable to be there but it gets so much worse. They ask what I want. I say burrito. They grab the burrito lay it down, scoop their hand into the rice and put it one the burrito and pat it down with their hands. Scoop into the beans, once again hands (they have plastic gloves on but this is still clearly unacceptable) I get pork, my friend chicken, all the meanwhile using no utensils. Straight hands all the way down the bar, even the vegetables. Same gloves!!!!!! 
I actually paid for my order, walked out and threw the burrito out. Why I didn't say anything or even paid for it, I have no idea. I think I was more so in shock and couldn't get a word out. 

Long story short: DISGUSTING. NEVER EATING AGAIN. These kids better not have jobs once someone sees this because this is so unacceptable. Does this place have training? Do they monitor their employees? Clearly not.

After tiring of the crappy dry cleaners by my house, I used yelp to hunt out a new one by my office.  Thanks to all those who previously reviewed Julie's I decided to give it a try.  I got two dress pants hemmed and cleaned and a skirt cleaned.  She was sweet and did a great job with the alterations.  The prices are reasonable too!  Julie's is now my go-to dry cleaner!!!

Awesome vegetarian restaurant! The brunch is a pre-fixe menu with lots of great options. All the dishes were generously sized, so we left with full stomachs and some leftovers. Everyone enjoyed their meals a lot.

The restaurant is spacious and the service is good. Great spot for a nice dinner!

Let me start by saying our waiter was terrific. He was attentive, friendly, and very deserving of the generous tip he received. That being said, the food was not that great. The crab cake looked and had the taste of anything you would find frozen at the supermarket. The scallops were dry, over cooked, and bland. The blackened shrimp had a decent flavor, but was over cooked and tough. We would rather have gone somewhere else for the prices we paid and the food we received.

Went for lunch during a beach vacation. Two other tables of customers  in the restaurant. Took about 10 minutes for a server to come by. Once she got there service was fine. Food is typical fried seafood fair. Nothing special. Nothin horrible. Enjoyed eating my lunch until the bartender "Tony" thought it would be a good idea to blow up a medical glove into a balloon and bounce it on our table onto our food. No thanks after that. We were done eating at that point.

This place is AMAZING! The people who work here are so friendly and nice. And the food is absolutely delicious! I'm from California and am ecstatic I found an authentic korean restaurant. It's delicious! The bulgogi kimchi fried rice is my favorite. Must try!

Great food. Been here many times and it is always amazing, fresh and friendly service. Greek salad is delicious and fresh ingredients. Had the Greek chicken pita for the first time and it exceeded my expectations. Favorite quick place to eat at. Many healthy options.
Had the crab pretzel and it was awesome!! I would eat here everyday ! Service was awesome and it wasn't that crowded. There's plenty of seating for dine in or you can take out. Beautiful place to go

Absolutely happy with this place! The staff at the desk, room cleaning, pool side and at the bar were all amazing. The food was excellent, solid drinks, and beer selection. Easy to get to from Tampa airport and the parking is easy.  A lot around this hotel of you venture out for the day. It's a nice alternative to the big name chains. We would come back for sure. The pool was excellent and again, the staff was amazing!!!

Had my side and rear windows tinted with their top product. There was a big sign in the waiting room that said there is no perfect job. Well, as far as I can tell there is and I got it. They took the time to explain the options and let me see it on their own cars. It took less time than then stated which was a good thing. I was very cautious  not to roll down the windows for the first week and have had no issues. Highly recommended, very professional.
Pretty good selection of firearms, extremely helpful and knowledgeable staff that doesn't talk down to you, and a very clean and well lit range.

My boyfriend & friends and I eat here pretty frequently, everything I have ever gotten is delicious. The food comes out quick, and is consistent each time. The place itself is clean, and the service is prompt and friendly.
The service is good and the food is always fresh. One of my favorite local sushi places.
Been to them twice.  Fresh and tasting good, great friendly service.  Love the short ribs taco.  Get a deal and buy 3 at once.  Track them down!

My family chose Bluewater Grill to celebrate our parents' birthdays. My father and I love lighthouses and found ourselves gravitating to this restaurant despite its heavy tourist location. The food was delicious. We had the crab artichoke dip, mahi mahi tacos, grilled octopus with potatoes, crab Louie salad, and a lobster roll. Dani, our waitress was a doll! She was patient, clear and just lovely. I greatly appreciate her kindness and patience to my older parents. The crab artichoke dish was hot, bubbling and delicious. The seafood was fresh and perfectly cooked. Dani brought a birthday sundae for my parents to enjoy towards the end of the meal. Everyone who worked at Bluewater Grill was exceptionally polite, thoughtful and welcoming. I applaud all the great people working at Bluewater Grill and look forward to coming again!

This 5 star review is as to one item on the menu and one item only.  It is the only thing anyone should order upon arriving at this establishment.  The chicken fingers.  They have the best chicken fingers in the world.  period.  There, I said it.  I challenge you to name a better chicken finger.  

Aside from the chicken fingers its a standard pub/sports bars and would have been a 3 star review.

My experience here was good, but I wish the menu was a little (okay, a lot) more clear. I had no idea what the difference was between any of the bowls of pho were or how much they cost. I also had no way of knowing what all was on the sandwiches.   Previous reviewers have mentioned that the staff speaks some English, but this was not my experience with the lady who was working when I was there.

That said, I really liked the pork belly bahn mi.  It's the number 4 on the menu, I believe. I  thought the bread was amazing and the ingredients tasted very fresh.   The strawberry smoothie was good but I was not into the bubbles. No big though, next time I will just order without them.  I saw someone get the avocado smoothie and it looked to die for.  Definitely trying that next time.

I will be back when it's not 100 degrees out to try the pho, and I would like to try the bahn mi no.1 if I can ever find out what the hell is on it. I also have read talk of fresh spring rolls on here but didn't see them on the menu. Do I just have to inquire about them or what? Kinda hard to do with such a language barrier between us.

We had my bridal shower here and the event turned out great!! We had so many compliments from the food, dessert and the mimosa fountain!!

We ended up having a few no shows but the planner allowed us to take home the extra meals, so that we can enjoy them instead of just paying the fee.

I also came here for brunch and the spread had a large variety and was also very good.

Check in was easy everyone we encountered was friendly and very accommodating.  Very busy but they handled it well.  It was a little pricey for 73.00 per night , I guess we're paying for location.  Everything was very was clean and updated.  Quiet at night.  This campground comes highly recommended.  They also have a shuttle available for trips downtown.

Upon hearing that we were going to be in New Orleans, our kind Southern friends offered us a room in their beautiful Garden District home, and even provided us a key. But, somehow, we locked ourselves out anyway (at 2 in the morning). Deciding it inappropriate to wake them (and their 2-year-old) up with a middle-of-the-night phone call, I employed MacGyveresque skills to find us a place. Columns Hotel? $200-something at this hour? I don't think so.  Avenue Garden? What's that? $89 *and* on the streetcar line? Perfect!

We stayed in the last available and teensyest room in the house room, #23, and it was cozy, clean, and cute, with a little balcony and everything. Plus the staff is friendly college kid types. We liked it so much we're blocking rooms for our wedding guests in October.

So, we had two different experiences here based on the servers.  We sat at the bar both times. The first night we had a gal that was fun, easy-going, helpful.  The person I was with got two sliders and she really liked the beef slider.  I got the meat pies, which were just okay...they tasted like they came out of a frozen box, but like a nicer brand, as opposed to... for example, Hot Pockets. Ha! Nothing wonderful, nothing terrible.  The drink that the bartender made was solid though.  
The second time we went there was a different bartender.  We were there on work, so we needed to stay within a certain budget with our food.  I ordered a slider (they have them as a single option) and a side of the brussel sprouts.  I specifically had pointed to the single slider on the menu when ordering.  When the food came out, it was the two slider meal option, and when I pointed it out (because of the work budget), it was just really awkward.  The bartender came out with an extra plate and proceeded to clear off the second burger and fries and take them in back... The slider was a better choice than the meat pies.  The brussel sprouts were good, but not great, a little greasy.  The environment is chill, relaxed, easy.  This place is not far from the convention center, so it's an easy walk after a long day there.  Obviously, take advantage of the Yelp free drink, and hope you get the female bartender, she's way more fun.

While visiting carpenteria, we decided to eat at Tony's. The food was pretty good but the  service. I found a french fry in the middle of  my pasta. Also, a vegetarian in the group got meat sauce even though that wasn't what we ordered. Besides that it took a long for our food to come.
Without a doubt, the best BBQ in town!  It's got a great atmosphere too, with a patio, bar, and just a good ol' rustic look to it.
Average touristy place. When acclaimed chef goes mainstream commercial, it brings below average plates / experience.

I love this place for a few reasons: 1. BYOB 2. Inexpensive and 3. the BEST chicken kabobs that I have EVER and yes, I say EVER had (and being from the Middle East, I have had my fair share of meat on a stick).

Dont let the fact that its in a basement stop you. The place is charming, clean and warm.

This Walmart has appallingly bad reviews and a low rating. I'm giving them a pass. It's Walmart you guys. Are you expecting white glove service? I'm not. It serves its purpose. That doesn't mean you shouldn't wipe down your cart really well with those sanitizing wipes by the door and try not to touch anything you don't have to touch. You should!

YUM! Went here tonight for dinner and it was awesome. I had humus followed by Greek Scallops followed by the baklava cheesecake (yes you read that right) and everything was amazing, fresh and delicious.  The service was prompt and friendly and the location great.  I would gladly return if I lived here.

I'm now converted to Yats. This place is fun, quick, and bang for your buck. The first thing you notice when you walk in is the artsy interior and posters for local events. The second thing you notice is that the food is so cheap! Third thing is that this seems like an ideal place to hang out on the patio on a summer night, mooching off the jazz bands from Jazz Kitchen next door. 

You can't go wrong with the crawfish ettouffe, and I always order an extra piece of bread for 50 cents. I am not convinced that the ettouffe is authentic, but hey, it's tasty. I tried a couple of Yats' other dishes, but I just can't get that creamy, cheesy ettouffe off my mind. 

The only thing I didn't like was that Yats uses plastic forks and styrofoam cups - it would be great if the restaurant was more green and that I didn't have to feel environmentally guilty for eating there!

I really enjoy the BBQ at Bridgeport Ribs. I order the same thing each time - non-sweet iced tea, three pieces chicken, 1/2 rack spare ribs, Texas toast, coleslaw, and beans as my 2 sides.  $18.00

I like both the mild and the hot honey. The hot honey is spicy and I like spicy. Most places advertise spicy and it isn't. 

It is a bar, a biker bar, but there is nothing to worry about. The staff is nice and I have never had an issue with others eating or drinking there. I usually go Saturday or Sunday at noon. It is quite and I can get some great food and read. 

I have had them feed 50 people at my backyard Birthday party and it all was very good. 

Like live music? They have it in the evenings. Be forewarned, it gets packed and loud but if that is your thing, GO! You will have a blast. Like motorcycles? There will be a whole line of them out front. Check them out but don't touch.

This place is just plain too crowded every time I go. The food is pretty good. We've had some bad service issues twice where they brought all the food for everyone but skipped someone at the table. By the time they brought it, we were finished!
Great place with a friendly staff! They have the best hot chocolate ever! The Belgium one is to die for. Sometimes me and my husband drive 1 hour just to go there! 10 stars for them!

The food is delicious and offers so many options. Being a vegetation I loved that I could substitute any burger for a veggie burger. The service was excellent and our waiter was extremely polite and friendly. Loved the experience!

Best beignets ever!!
Traveling to LA, we had to stop and have their coffee and beignets! We weren't expecting much but their beignets were dogwood I had to post!! 
Loving funnel cakes and that world, I absolutely loved their beignets even better than funnel cakes! 
So good! Definitely recommend!
Great, moderately priced, and a 2-for-1 coupon made for an excellent meal. Service was excellent, chipper servers abound. Melon gazpacho and scallops impressed me greatly.

I dined there last night with a group of friends, and I was blown away!  The food was amazing and the staff were beyond amazing!  We ordered about 18 different items between the four of us (two of which are chef's) and none of us could decide on an exact favorite.  It's a unique dining experience, a fun way to try new foods and we absolutely loved it!  The power went out during dinner, and they didn't miss a beat.  I was completely impressed.  It is a little on the pricey side, but totally worth every penny, we will all be retuning.  Well done Farmhaus!

My favorite Italian restaurant in the entire Philadelphia area..with delicious warm home-baked bread and gratuitous appetizer, delicious red sauce for pasta dishes, excellent pricing on all entrees, and outstanding veal dishes (the Veal Sorrento is my perennial favorite!).
A surpising find disguised behind a pizza parlor!

Literally the worst service. No one came to our table to take drink orders until like 11 minutes into our stay. They gave us brunch menus and then once we finally decided what we want, they told us brunch is no longer an option and we would have to wait 10 minutes for the dinner menu to go online. Then we waited another 5 minutes for coffee and 20 minutes for our food. then they added 20 percent to our 4 person table for tip though we were not planning on adding that much. AND THEN they sprayed the tables next to us with very strong chemicals. And THEN we waiting 10 more minutes for the check.

Yum! 
The only down side?  It's a BYOB.  Did not know that :(
Owner was kind enough to server up a Sake on the house :)

Came in for morning breakfast. Place was empty but food + coffee was great! Had a two egg breakfast with home fries and bacon and everything tasted good. Our male server was very pleasant, attentive, and knowledgable on the menu. 

I forgot to check in for 20% off and take a picture for Yelp, so I guess I'll have to come back! I want to anyway to try those Dutch baby pancakes! As all previous Yelpers have said, it is tucked into a small strip mall you'd probably never come to on your own.
Beautiful atmosphere, delicious food, personable, friendly staff, and a eclectic store.

Our time at the Terrell House this weekend was beyond perfect.  This B&B is one of the most beautiful places I have seen.  Miss Linda and her staff went above and beyond to ensure our time with them was memorable.  The suite at the Corner Store was perfect for my husband, my self and our 16 year old daughter.  A little slice of heaven..... Southern hospitality at its finest.
We sat in the bar area which had a nice casual vibe .  Service was good and the ribs were delicious.

At age 53, this was my first trip ever to New Orleans.  WOW! I fell in love and it was quite overwhelming to know which stores to shop.  So much choice!  My strategy was to make the rounds and at the end go back to what I liked most.  HOWEVER, the New Orleans spirits had something else in mind for me!  Third store in on Royal Street was Vintage 329.  I tried on a cool vintage ring and said to "Jamie" the lovely young woman who was helping me: "Love it, but need to look at other stores first.  See you later maybe?"  Then a pair of earrings caught my eye.   She pulled them out.  We started talking about history and then I saw a necklace I just had to try on -  and from that point on I was HOOKED!  We had so much FUN "playing."  We chatted it up about the various histories of vintage jewelry in the store; I tried lots of things on (even a tiara); I walked around the store and admired myself in the mirror with various pieces; Jamie gave me awesome feedback and helped me decide which pieces suited me most.  It was an all around BLAST!!!  I loved reveling in the awesome vintage jewelry and imagining who made it and who wore it before me.  I delighted in the time spent with Jamie.  It was all so playful, uplifting. fun AND educational!  Can you believe I purchased SEVEN gorgeous, amazing, pieces (including the tiara) AND Jamie gave me a special magical gift to boot.  Oh, and Jamie also prepared historic write-ups for each piece including a vintage advertisement that a brooch I purchased was featured in.  Sooooo happy :)

I want to write a review for the location right off Magazine St but maybe this will suffice? This is one of my fav breakfast spots. The price is right, the place is clean, and the food is consistently great!

I loooove the ham and cheese croissant. Also enjoy the breakfast bagel, French toast, and other items I've tried. The lunch isn't too shabby either. One thing that annoys me a tad is eating something like pancakes or French toast out of the little plastic serving basket bc the paper it's served on tears but hey for the price- whatever!
Delish!! Customer service was outstanding!!  I had the seafood benefit and it was great! Almost made the just ale of putting hot sauce on them, but it was amazing without it!!
Nice place and the food was good. Ordered the crab cake Benedict. Service was a bit slow but not horrible. It would be worth another try.

This is my first time here and will be my last. The service is absolutely horrible and it seems like the staff is completely clueless. I hate saying negative things but working in this industry I expect a certain level of competence and unfortunately Pita Jungle does not deliver.

Just order from here, the delivery time was awesome but I got a Italian hoagie and my whole roll was soggy(not even exaggerating).My daughters fries were soggy, not even the slightest bit of a crunch. I also ordered mozzarella sticks same thing, no crunch, kinda soggy too. Very upset I spent $25 on this meal!

I haven't tried everything they offer because my family and I cannot get passed the Apple Pie with Caramel and Pecan topping. I am more of a cake girl and this dessert is something that makes me look away from the cakes time after time. The customer service is wonderful no matter how busy they get, samples are always available and they are dog friendly with free homemade treats!

The store looks super cute and has unique cards which is why I decided to check it out two separate times to look for unique wedding cards. Both times I was completely ignored by the man behind the counter. Both times I was the only one in the store. One time he was watching tv and another he was just staring at his phone. The killer is the second time he actually looked up at me and just looked back at his phone! I couldn't believe it. I did need help but I decided to leave instead because I didn't want to bother him.

I've only ordered take out or delivery from here. The food is always consistent. 
Awesome pizza and salads! 
The selection of beers is great too!

What a very comfortable place to have breakfast!  I had been wanting to check them out, but never had the opportunity. Walking in, there's a birds eye view of various pastries, goodies and this day... this Saturday... the bloody mary bar!  I settled on the breakfast burrito w/potatoes for my meal and it was soooo good!  There aren't many places who do a good job with their breakfast burritos in terms of flavor, but this place is tops.  I'd have to say, this place will be my go-to spot for a breakfast burrito.  Now, potatoes being my favorite food, I wasn't overly thrilled with them.  They could have used about another 2 minutes in the skillet grill.  My friend and I felt comfortable here and actually spent several hours hanging out and talking.  The servers were friendly and weren't bothered by the amount of time we were there.  Matter of fact, we were there so long that happy hour kicked in and I ended up having 2 glasses of $3 house white wine!   Love it, love it!

Guys, let's face the facts. Dorignacs can't get any better!! I have been going to this store since I was IN the womb! :)  The service is impeccable in each and every department. No matter what I'm looking for, they always have it on the shelf with a wide variety of options to choose from. The deli is like no other in the area. Dorignacs Italian roast beef would be on my list of options if I ever had to choose what I wanted as my last meal ever! Stuffed artichoke - to die for. The bakery is dangerous! I love the emphasis applied to the Italian options in particular. The meat department is so "old school." You get exactly what you ask for each and every time, with a smile to boot. What else can I say? No, I'm not related to the Dorignacs but I do feel like I am. It's the way my family and I have felt for years. They make you feel like family. I hope they never go away. Thank you Dorignacs for being the best for so long :) Stay local!

Illegal Tacos offered a great burrito (full of protein and authentic flavor) for around eight dollars.  Easily something you could wrap and take home to finish or finish on the spot.  The space itself is somewhat limited on seating, but the patron turnover seemed steady so waiting a few minutes for an open table doesn't feel impossible.  I enjoyed the food here and feel content with only needing to eat here once while in Philadelphia for a few days.

I CANNOT SAY ENOUGH about Nalinn!!! She is hands down the best!! She is super friendly and is such a perfectionist.  The moment you walk in she is usually the only one that speaks.  Not only is she friendly but she pays much attention to detail and she goes above and beyond to make sure her customers are satisfied! If Nalinn ever leaves I would be devastated and I will follow!!  Nalinn is certainly the best at VENUS NAIL SPA!! If you want fabulous nails ask for Nalinn!!!

Great BBQ. Big portions for reasonable prices. Had the 3 meat, 2 fixin' combo meal and was happy with everything (brisket, pulled pork, StL ribs, Mac n cheese, corn casserole). Good ambiance and friendly service. Received a free app for checking in on yelp.
Outstanding deli. Service girls were cute and fun and the gyro with hummus was perfect!!! Wish I lived closer I would eat here all the time
Great NY style pizza.

A pleasant train station.  Bigger than the ones I'm used to, but not quite as swanky as, say, Penn Station or Washington, DC's Union Station, the NOUPT is a comfortable place to wait for an upcoming train ride.

There's plenty of seating, a small lounge for sleeper car passengers, Subway subs, and pizza.  We bought an acceptably-priced deck of playing cards from an amusing gift shop that had all sorts of amusing hand-written notices from the management (e.g., "Nothing here is free.  Please don't ask.)

The folks at the ticket counter were friendly and helped us get up to speed with our first overnight train ride. This terminal made for a very pleasant start to our trip.

We ate here on a Friday evening. They were very busy and we had to wait about 10-15 minutes for a table. There is no waiting area inside the restaurant and with the amount of people standing and waiting for a table, we sat in the vestibule. It was very cold outside and with several people coming and going, we kept getting hit with doors and the cold air from outside. When they took us to our table, they were still cleaning it off. The menu itself was ragged and in need of replacement. They had a nice selection of items on the menu. I ordered the house salad with ginger dressing, which arrived very quickly. The ginger dressing seemed to be made in house (not from a bottle) - it was creamy and didn't have a strong ginger or sweet flavor. I did enjoy it and would recommend the house salad. I ordered the sesame chicken and my husband ordered the kung pao chicken. Our food was average. I prefer extra sauce and there was barely enough to cover my chicken. My husband said his dish was not spicy. The portions were a little small - about half of what you get when you order take out. Overall we were not impressed and probably will not return.

Excellent customer service! My husband and I drove about 40 minutes for our Saturdate and this place was phenomenal! I had the figgy piggy and my hubby had the duke, both were delicious and more than enough for multiple meals. Decor was unique and vibe was relaxed. Definitely returning! The Nutella banana calzone was beyond amazing!!

I ate here for lunch yesterday. I was hoping for a quick lunch, because I was on a lunch break from work. However, the young waitress we had took her sweet time even getting to our table to take our drink orders. After we were seated the waitress took approximately 10 minutes to come to our table. And she was pretty standoffish thru out the entire meal. None the less, the food was great! I had the Philly cheesesteak wrap. It came with soup ( chicken gumbo) fries & cole slaw. It was delish!!!! My co-workers also enjoyed their food! This diner also has a large menu selection. The decor was reto fifties ( very cool!). I would def go again just hope the service is better the next time.
Very tasty pizza, delivered quickly and hot on a rainy Saturday night.  Very generous with toppings!

A long wait but worth it. The clam chowder was the best I've had in years! My kids enjoyed watching them prep the crab, lobsters- I am surprised they still ate the crab seeing that it was crawling around just minutes beforehand! Will return just for the clam chowder!!!

The Merry-Go-Round is hands down my favorite sushi roll in Santa Barbara.  Great ambiance.  It's intimate so a great place for a date, but definitely not good place  for parties larger than 6.  Bar none the best plate presentation of any sushi bar in town.

They also have an amazing seaweed salad.

Good service.

No reservations.  Weekdays are not too bad of a wait.  If the wait is long I usually just give them my number and drive to Lucky's for a drink until the table is ready.

I'll give it a 3.5  but I rounded up because it wasn't a bad experience, service was good and fast.

The burger was good but not great, maybe a little bit too salty . I wish it was a little more pink for a medium-rare that I ordered. I liked the truffle fries, but it was nothing special. The hamburger bun is pretty good I thought. They have a pretty nice selection of fountain drinks... but that's really not that important ha. When compared to Five Guys.. I would say this is way better and less messy, but a little bit more expensive for how small the burger is. I would still take a burger from Village Whiskey any day and pay the extra premium.
Also, don't be fooled by some of the other reviews regarding cleanliness, this place is not clean and the towels smell.

Ann is a wonderful training.  She is very knowledgable about dogs, and uses positive techniques which my pup took too immediately.  I love the secure setting where she trains, and it's the first time I've ever trained in a setting where we could work with our dogs off leash.  The adults as well as the dogs have a great time at "Dog School".  Would highly recommend anyone looking for positive training for you dog to check our Ann Bechnel Companion Dogs!

Back again and stopped by twice this week.  Once again the food is excellent and the staff is very friendly.

Rotisserie Chicken is so easy to over cook and become dry but they bribe their chicken and it comes out moist EVERYTIME! I order this dish every time I come here.

I also just tried the blackened ribeye and it was excellent as well. 

This is why I eat here every trip I make to Reno!
Amazing tiki bar patio out back during the warmer months. If you are looking for your new summer hang out spot with good drinks, look no further!

This review is only for take-out.  We have tried Samurai twice and I would say it is decent sushi for a good price.  Both times the rolls we got with Tuna had an odd tinny taste.  The food was not quite ready  for the time they told us either.  I would still give Samurai another shot; maybe dining in would be a different experience.
Really good donuts and pastry. Best gourmet donuts, so give it a try.

Ordered through Grubhub.  I ordered the Italian Sub which the menu described as having turkey, bacon and ham.  The sandwich cane and had turkey and bacon bits.  I called to let them know they sent me a turkey sandwich with bacon bits and the guy started arguing with me.  He told me I could order extra meat.  I didn't want extra meat.  I wanted turkey, ham and bacon.  Guy made no attempt to rectify the situation.  Will never order from there again and would not recommend to a friend or enemy for that matter.

The ribs here are the best that I have had here and this is compared to excellent barbecue in Chicago and Boston (Red Bones, I'm looking at you) the meat just falls off the bone. The shrimp tacos are also amazing. They have good beer specials; a $2 Dixie beer happy hour? Yes please! 

They also have live music that we heard was great.
5 stars because they're all about the milk stouts. They have a delicious chocolate milk stout, and they also make a peanut butter chocolate milk stout!

The cake was really great!  We picked up the carrot and chocolate cake slices. We liked that they were not sickly sweet. For the how busy the place was and small the entry felt we won't go out of our way to pick up more slices. If we are close we might stop by. For being the first time there half of the cakes did not have descriptions. We asked the girl ringing people up and she had to go ask someone else. Kinda weird when you work there we thought. 
It is the perfect place for anyone who loves pink!!!! Pink and glitter everywhere!!!!  Personally glitter is not my favorite thing.

This was my first time experiencing this place and it was soooooo unique. Everyone was super friendly from the jump which made it even easier to enjoy. Pictured is the grilled cheese and the pecan sticky bun. 

The grilled cheese was very unique because it was savory and sweet! If you're not super super hungry, this might be a little too much for you.

The pluses: 
1.it was very easy to get a table, even though I only called 45 minutes before we wanted to dine.
2. The server was very friendly, although she did forget to bring the cream for my tea and she forgot to bring my husband's second drink, until reminded.
3. The Onion soup was very good. My husband loved it, I thought it was a tad too salty. 
4. The Cassoulet was delicious and was a very generous serving. 
5.  The mushroom side was also very good.

The minuses:
1. Parking is terrible! We managed to find a space in the tiny parking lot. They do have valet parking -- we just didn't notice it until we had already parked and there is a giant parking garage less then a block away.
2. Pricey but  not outrageous.
3. My husband had the fish which he felt was overwhelmed by the toppings, rather than enhanced by them.
4. The ambience was nice but it does get a bit loud as the restaurant fills up. By the end of the meal we could hardly hear each other.

Its definitely not my favorite starr restaurant, but it has a few good options for the price point. I go to Jones when I'm nearby, but I dont usually travel into the city to eat there. The food quality used to be much better years ago, but it has really fallen off lately.
I was visiting Tucson and this is the best meal, I highly recommend the dry noodle and the spicy beef noodle,it's really awesome!
Food is good and really cheap, but the super sticky floor makes me concerned about the cleanliness of the food preparation area that I can't see. Hence the 4 stars.
Amazing!!!! Famous shrimp cocktail is to die for~~WOW! The cocktail sauce is awesome! Service impeccable. Steaks were incredible.
I ate here and there was literally poop on the floor. Good food but could do without the doodie

If you want to pay for parking ($150/mo for two cars, first-come first serve) and then have your car towed consistently because the people running the company don't know how log resident vehicles with a license plate.... Then, yeah - great place to live.

Review written by my hubby:

My wife and I were very disappointed with this place. 2 medium pizzas cost us over $35, which wouldn't have been a complete loss if the pizza was spectacular, which it wasn't. The pizza (which we waited 30 minutes for, though we were the only customers in the place) was thin and limp crusted, with rather sparse and unflavorful toppings. The Greek (Grecian) pizza was particularly "blah" tasting, and for some might even be considered disgusting. Very strange. Their somewhat Hawaiian-like pizza was okay, but just not anything special, especially for the money. Eclipse's pizza crust is supposed to be something particularly special, but Black Rock Pizza's is far superior by comparison. After this dining experience, my wife and I wished we had just spent $10 for 2 large 1 topping Little Ceasar's pizzas. It would have been twice as good and filling at a third the price. Don't bother with this place. It is more hype than substance. Not worth it at all.

Pretty fly!

I've eaten a ton of afghan food throughout the US.  This is good, especially for boise.  I'm not going to wax on about how delicious the scrumtious sultry meat pieces tasted after they had been fully masticated.....and stuff.

It's good.  It's tasty.  They can cook lamb medium rare.  7 day a week buffet with many vegetarian options for $10.  Done/over.  Go and eat.
Nasty place that smells like a 100 year old trailer that's been smoked in..... I think that sums it up.....
Truly a great restaurant.  Fresh, fun ambiance.  Solid menu

Went here today with my son on a class trip. First things first the kids had a blast. Eveybody was nice and being a weekday and chilly today the crowds were in check. 

Issue is the chlorine here. It's out of control and I was alarmed. My son has asthma. After an hour he was breathing heavily and wheezing. Had to take a lot of brakes. If you or your child have asthma be ready. My sons isn't even serious and it was pretty bad. 

Here is my main concern. I own a pool and I know when you can smell chlorine to that extent it's not the chlorine you are smelling. It's something called "combined chlorine". Combined chlorine is free chrloine that has attached to things in the water. Sweat. Urine. Skin flakes. Organic matter. So when you smell that strong chlorine smell, it means the water is dirty and that concerned me and after that it was hard to have a good time along with the wheezing child. One child had on a blue shirt. It was bleached ligjht green within an hour. 

I see other reviews here saying the same. It's a shame becshee we didn't have any staff issues etc and it's a cute little place, but they need to get that water in check or we won't be back.

This is definitely the BEST juice and smoothie spot on the east side and in ALL of Nashville! Everything is lovingly handmade by the owner himself, the friendliest guy in the neighborhood! He doesn't skimp on any ingredients and uses only the very best. And everything tastes AH-MAZING. And the kale salad is KILLER. Stop reading and get your juice on!

I loved my Ahi Tuna Burger so darn much. The brioche buns were buttery enough, the seared tuna was so so juicy, thick and well seasoned. The fries were good. And my Fat Bottom Oatmeal Stout was a nice extra touch. I enjoy the portion, just enough. I only wish it was a bit less expensive.

Love this place. They have a wide selection of feed (both seeds and pellets) and toys for birds. Staff are friendly and very knowledgeable. 

If you get a bird here, it comes with a complimentary vet exam which was really nice. Their grooming service is for nail trim, beak trim, and wing clipping (you can get all 3 together or 1 or w/e).

We love looking at the baby birds they have in the separate room. Absolutely adorable.

Great spicy tuna, shrimp dumplings and service! 

Also kid-friendly - we went early and had the whole back room to ourselves.

Crab fries + mussels + crabs + ice cold Yuengling + 300 million TVs and projectors to watch any sports programming available = one of my versions of heaven. 

Get here early though, if it's a big game night it gets packed pretty quick and you'll be waiting an hour for a seat.

Ate a pork chop at the Porkapalooza at the Local Omnivore. Great couple of guys and definitely know their food. Little sauce with some cilantro and garlic and a pineapple salsa. Fantastic. I would have taken a picture but nom nom nom get in my belly.

I was in St. Louis for a conference at SLU, and a few locals recommended we check this place out.

The Fountain sports a funky-diner type decor with a bar in the middle. The servers were super rad and helpful (even when we request 9 separate checks - I know, we're jerks).

Now, I can only speak to their drink selection - which was amazing! Their menu has pages & pages of specialty cocktails, good craft brews, and decent wine selection. 

Did I mentioned Ice Cream Martinis?

I went with the Thin Mint Ice Cream Martini. Sweet delicious chocolately-mint booze, with a little tiny Oreo on the rim. Like, pinch me.

As a total NYC obsessed snob (awareness is the first step), The Fountain made me think twice about dissing the Midwest. This place could have easily been around the corner in Brooklyn, with it's funky vibe, tatted waitresses, and delightful drinks. Well done!

Always Long Lines at Check-Outs, rare to find an employee that is helpful or even happy for that matter.

When a business has to hires someone to stand at the door and say Welcome, it gives me the feeling that their employees are not happy enough to say hello, good morning or anything unless they are getting paid to say it. 

It's not really convenient and the prices aren't much cheaper if at all, not sure why I torture myself, is their marketing that good.

((( Perceived Value, not really a value )))

Honestly, I haven't been to Outback in a long time. Boy I forgot what I was missing. My friend decided to have his birthday dinner, at the original Tampa location, and it was delicious! I got the Outback Special and it was cooked to perfection. My friend and I shared 2 pitchers of Margaritas and my bill was only $23. Can't go wrong with that!

The food is delicious.  Slightly on the pricey side, but totally worth the treat.  We lost our server for a little while, and at one point ended up asking someone else if they could let her know we were ready.  She came right away, and later the chef sent us some amazing fried donuts on the house.  Overall good service.  They were extremely busy, but all the staff looked cheery (and we had a perfect view of the kitchen from our bar stools).  I would definitely go back--since their menu changes all the time, every visit is a new adventure!

The hotel is right across the street from the Arch. Very nice. Hotel was clean and room was always kept nice. Lobby was large and open with bellman always ready to help. I did have a king size room but no view of the arch. that was a little disappointing. Shower was great, plenty of pressure and with the giant head. Bathroom was big enough for one might have been a little cramped for two. Nice extras in the bathroom, brand name toothpaste, cotton balls and q-tips. Bed was very comfortable. All in all a nice room. there is self-parking and valet but i did not use those. 3 blocks from the Busch stadium and there are several restaurants nearby.

We had such a great time.  Our host was a great guy and we (12 of us) escaped from the "Speakeasy" with seconds to spare.

I would recommend trying this for sure.
Awesome. Fast, real friendly, delicious, and you can sample everything. Bring cash!
Amazing staff, great service, supports local businesses and community, wide variety of supplies, best art store ever!!!

My car warning system showed the tire pressure was low.  I drove to Discount Tire on Tanque Verde where I purchased the tires.  When I checked the tires, I found a nail in the drivers side front tire.  The person on duty at the air station told me to go inside and check in and they would fix the tire.  I went inside and was told that there was no way they could see me as they were too busy. This was about 12 noon.  I was told I could come back later in the day.  When I returned to the car, the person at the air station said I will just fill up the tire, and it should be good for at least 2 days.  I had my wife bring the car back at about 4 pm and again she was told they were too busy, and she would have to come back tomorrow.

It is now 9 pm and I am waiting for roadside assistance as the front tire is completely flat.  We had spent a great deal of money at this Discount Tire store over the years.  But you can be sure we are going elsewhere from now on.  They not only give you completely wrong information, but they have no customer service.

Im new to the area and I am so happy that we found Jersey Java & Tea. The coffee was great, the caprese grilled cheese with basil hit the spot and the couches make you feel like you're at home. Not to mention they have Wi-Fi and sell wine that you can drink in shop, they even provide the glasses. Great place, we will be regulars!

This was a great experience.  I came in from NY for a wedding and decided to get a facial.  My aesthetician Misha was super friendly and did a great job.  Great service from all the staff.  Would definitely go back again.

On the plus side, the meat here is marinated well and tastes amazing. The women working here are friendly and very attentive. They will cook the meat for you at the grill so be prepared for that. There's also a pretty decent beer selection provided by the bar located in front and there's karaoke in the basement area if you feel like belting out a song after a few drinks. As a result, this place is open pretty late, too.

On the downside, the banchan isn't as plentiful as other places and the price is a little high for what you get. The building also looks like it's closed down. The first time we went, we had a hard time finding a way in and almost left. It really has that feeling of being a secret spot.

Still, it's a great place to go if you don't feel like making the trek to Olney or have that late night itch for some BBQ.
Went  to the Bobby spa... they were excellent great relaxation massage and deep-tissue the ladies were superb and professional

I love shopping here. Can usually find good deals. It's also fun to go through the home good aisles to see cool stuff and buy things you don't really need but it's such a good deal! At least, that's my mentality sometimes when I'm picking things up. ;)

This location seemed kind of low on stock of different sizes, boys' department didn't really have anything to pick through either- but then again it is a pretty busy location so I can't complain too much. The bathroom was kind of yucky, smelled really funky in there.

As this is the closest location to me, I will be  back of course. It's nice also that it's in a great shopping center. You can walk around and pretty much get all of your shopping done in one place. There's a Target on the other end of the parking lot, shoe stores, a GameStop, restaurants. You could even catch a movie at the end of your shopping lol.

Absolutely the best Mexican place in town.

Do NOT get fooled by the Taco BUS hype.  TacoSun is where it's at!

Hubby loves their nachos & I love their chicken torta.  Those marinated red onions are top notch!  HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
Great late night cookies . Got cookies ? It's easy and fun . Parking tough but look around.!

I admit, I don't often give a 5-star review on my first visit, but I was blown away by Three Flags Tavern's service, food and atmosphere. Don't judge this place by its outside appearance. We had a lovely dinner here and I will definitely keep it in mind for special occasions.

Get the brisket burger. Just get it! This burger is top notch - literally dripping with awesome meat flavor. I also got to top it with a blue cheese from their featured cheese plate! I could not have been happier with this burger.

We also tried the NY Strip Steak Diane, which was an excellent value for what you receive. It was cooked perfectly and I loved the side we chose with it - cheesy grits topped with crispy swiss chard.

The service was fantastic and they had an excellent wine list. You gotta give this place a try!

$3 drafts on Tuesday with the best wings (ordered them blackened, crispy) anywhere! Great outdoor pool area for dining. Don't know that I'd want to hang out there on the weekend but perfect on a weeknight.

Two stars because it's a clean restaurant. As soon as my fiancé and I walked in, I was a little put off by the rude waitress who sat us at a table with just pointing and the seat and saying, "Sit". I could hear her running around the restaurant and talking really loudly with the staff, seemingly in a really bad mood. I had previously been so excited to try this place I've read everyone rave about !!! yeah right, Edmonton!!! Get it together!!

The fish is edible, as I had the standard salmon nigiri. Everything else I tried was quite terrible. I had the cucumber salad with bits of crab in it, which probably was pre made and refrigerated because the waitress brought it to me immediately after I ordered. I tried some of the rolls, and none of them stood out because they were mediocre except for one that was absolutely horrid: the golden Philadelphia roll. Huge and the beef was covered with rice that was sooo mushy inside the fried exterior. No thanks

Never again

I cannot pass up browsing a small, independent hardware store because you never know what you are going to find. Perhaps it is that one needed item to finish a project that was waylaid months ago. Perhaps it is something that you didn't know you needed. Either way, you often leave thinking, "my life is going to be better now."

My boyfriend and I were passing this store on our way to Honey's for breakfast when it occurred to me that he needed a wrench to fix his leaking cold water supply pipe.

In nothing flat we were pointed to the tools section and a perfect Stanley wrench. I pride myself on organization, but even I was amazed at the selection that was organized in clean, clear, and almost modular fashion. The salespeople obviously take pride in their workshop like store and are genial enough to point you in the right direction should you be lost. 

In a short time, I was highly impressed. I almost want to invent some project just to go back and feel that my life is about to be more complete.

I suppose if you want to pay for Tony's-quality food and don't feel like dressing up, this would be the place to go.  However, why would you want to pay $50+/person + alcohol and not get gussied up??  We went on a Saturday night with a group of friends to celebrate 3 joint birthdays but were quite disappointed in our choice.  Since it's 1 bartender that serviced the entire restuarant + bartending, the service was mediocre at best, and the guy just came off as snooty.  There's no other way to put it.  While it did bear some elegance, the space was very small and cramped, and the a/c did not do the place (nor us) justice.  AND, you cannot get zabaione from Tony's, so what's the point, right??  If you're going to splurge, might as well just go to Tony's.  If not, then don't bother.
Love this place. Great drink. Good food. And awesome service. Quesadillas are great . Add to that the Patron Silver Margarita. Perfection.

Food was very good and service was great. Was a bit pricey for a lunch menu though, but the food was quality for the price. Only real negative was the metal searing was a bit uncomfortable, but overall a good addition to the area.

Just went here for the first time and it was absolutely fantastic. Our server was very friendly and personable and helped us get started with a great drink selection as soon as we were seated. He knew a lot about the menu and had great suggestions for items that would suit our tastes.

I got the BLTE -- bacon, arugula, tomato, a fried egg, and chipotle mayo -- and it was soooo good. A delicious twist on one of my favorite staples. 

We also had the pleasure of meeting Harry, the owner, who stopped our table and asked us how everything was. He was a real pleasure to talk to and made for great conversation. 

I know that I will definitely be here again, and I can't wait to bring some more newbies with me the next time I go. I highly recommend this place!
Went there a few years ago for the first time.  Visited last week. Still a good as ever!

I cannot recommend ParadICE Shave Ice highly enough.  The only problem I have is deciding whether I think their customer service is better than their product or vice versa!  Both are PERFECTION.

I chaired a huge carnival and reached out to them about serving shave ice at our event.  From the moment I reached out, they bent over backwards to not only make it happen, but make it happen smoothly.  They were so easy to work with, even in the months leading up to the event.  And I absolutely loved the fact that when I told them we require all vendors to only serve with compostable and recyclable items, they said they already do!  And no corn syrup or artificial colors, and only natural fruits and real sugar in their product?  Yes, please! And now let's talk about the event itself.

The ParadICE booth was the most popular stand at our event, and for good reason.  As soon as they started setting up their area, I knew they were different in their attention to detail.  Everything was immaculately clean and fresh looking and professional.  Their booth just drew everyone in, for all five hours of our event! There was a huge line all day... and not because they were slow, but because everyone wanted to get their hands on this delicious treat.  

One more thing... I am NOT a "sno-cone" person.  At all.  And I've had shave ice before (even in Hawaii) and can honestly take it or leave it.  But not this.  I got a few bites of someone's toward the end of the event and I didn't want to stop.  Truly one of the most delicious and refreshing treats I've ever had.  This company makes me want to plan a Hawaiian themed party.  I cannot think of one negative thing to say, and cannot wait to book them for next year's huge event.  In fact, I already have!
This place was absolutely disgusting and sucks that we have to wait here for our bus. The bus was 20 mins late and we couldn't even sit because the whole place was disgusting.
Good stuff. Pretty expensive, pretty fattening, pretty dang good. I like to mix and match flavors.
The food is very good for your basic Mexican fare.  Pleasant atmosphere with friendly staff and good service.

Amazing! We made reservations through opentable.com and were seated promptly when we arrived. I had the turtle soup, baby drum and bread pudding. Each dish is highly recommended. I will definitely be coming back just for the bread pudding!
Great restaurant for dinner. Always get a show that everyone enjoys. Good variety of choices, including a sushi bar.

One of my goals is to visit all the great art museums of the USA, and I'd include this one in the list without hesitation. I spent a very full 3.5 hours here, and that was without wandering the grounds with their endless trails. It's an encyclopedic collection, covering everything from Pre-Columbian art works up to a fantastic modern design section that even impressed someone like me, who didn't expect to be impressed by modern design. Rather than go through all the genres and collections on display (something you can get from the website), I'll tell you my favorite things I saw here:

- the huge pieces in the atrium, both the Sol LeWitt semi-Orphic color splashes and the multi-level installation of fluorescent lights. I saw a lot of people just lounging out under the immense glow on one of those comfy couches, and I understand the appeal - it looks like you're in the future as depicted in a 1960s sci-fi film.

- the Netherlandish paintings in the Clowes Collection: an art museum goes from good to great in my book if they have Netherlandish works, and you'll find a bit of them here. I'm particularly a fan of Hieronymous Bosch, and here are a couple of works by Bosch followers including one with a "Garden Of Delights"-esque tint. Freaky stuff, daddy.

- the sound samples in the Asian section: I'd never seen this in a museum before, but one wall has a selection of court/dance music from Japan, China, Korea, and Tibet taken mostly from Folkways records. I'm a big listener of traditional music, and this was a nice surprise in a less-traveled part of the museum. There are no headphones - rather everyone in the vicinity gets to hear the music, which works since the Japanese noh recording is over 20 minutes long. Mesmerizing and a good way to illustrate the difference in music across the region.

- Monet's "Charing Cross" painting: I know, I know, you can't get much more Art Appreciation 101 than to name off old Claude, but what can I say? This piece of his is so abstract that you can really only imagine that the bridge is there. 

- the modern design section: This would've been one of those areas I probably wouldn't have bothered with had I been on a more limited schedule, as I'm not a "design" kinda guy. I'm glad time wasn't a factor, because this was pretty fun and interesting, and certainly appeals to the "time capsule" part of my brain (even if in the 21st Century most of us don't have kitchen knife-holders that look like human heads...or at least not yet). 

- And lastly, even though I don't remember the artist and I wouldn't have stirred much excitement for it prior, the huge painting of the late 19th-Century Indianapolis city scene. I really love how the city reflects a bit on itself in the museum, which gives a good sense of local color. And unlike your typical landscape of the era where you see some pristine bit of Barbizon-esque nature scene, this puts you right in the streetcar-rolling center of town. Timeless scenes are always nice, but sometimes the timestamp tells us a bit more.

If I lived in Indianapolis, I'd be proud to call this my local museum. But as I don't live in Indianapolis, I'm at least proud to say I've visited it.

Horrible experience today. It's was an hour and a half way for the hayride. That's on top of waiting just to buy the tickets. Went to Terhune in Princeton and it was awesome. Free hayride. Tons of apples. Just as crowded but much more organized. 

The worst was I posted on FB about it and Johnson's deleted my post.

Our typical chain Mexican restaurant experienced was bumped way up by our wonderful server!  My friend was unhappy with guacamole and it's overwhelming lime flavor. Our server was beyond accommodating and he had the kitchen make a fresh batch without lime and bring limes to her to add as much as she wanted. When my dinner (enchiladas) came out I felt really bad making my own complaint about the unexpected sour cream sauce, when I had expected regular red enchilada sauce. Once again our wonderful server fixed it right away. Everything we had was tasty; to be sure there are family owned authentic places that are better but solid and enjoyable and great service. I'd stop by again.

Had a bacon, egg and cheese on an everything bagel.  Bagel was a bit thin (which I like) and very soft. Great breakfast sandwich. Ordered ahead and it was ready when I arrived 10 minutes later. Didn't have a donut but they had loads of flavors and they all looked delicious.

Came in here looking for coffee this morning. I got this (it was delicious) in addition to super friendly service and free wifi. In fact, I came back later on the same day to try their apple salad and it was DELICIOUS. 

This whole experience was such a lovely surprise to cheer up this rainy day!!

Great food late at night.  We were out and wanted something but didn't want to go thought a drive thru.  IHOP is 24 hours which is perfect.  Seated immediately and the food was great.  I got french onion pot roast with gravy and corn.  If its late and you're hungry I recommend IHOP
Standard Chili's experience: Fast service and yummy food. I love that you can now order and pay from the tablets at the tables... very cool!
The best hot and sour soup in Philadelphia.  Period.  The salt baked squid is another specialty that is done perfect.

I rarely travel to this side of town (westsider) but my sister suggested it for our family bday sinner. Set inside a strip mall i couldn't tell if it was even open from the outside, but once inside it was very clean and welcoming! I ordered the cajun chicken pasta and they didn't skimp ok the cheese or spices! It was DELICIOUS! The toast was well seasoned as well. Our party of 7 loved all our meals! And the prices cant be beat! Thanks

I would like to thank all the staff for making our stay for the weekend a relaxing and comforting experience for majority of our family members who came all around the globe to wish our aunt farewell to rest in paradise. 

Big shout out to Stephanie for taking good care of us with what ever we needed. She did her absolute best to make sure our room was clean and supplied us with anything we needed as we prepared my aunts funeral.

Thank you so much Stephanie!!

The best in the area for cheesesteaks. They bake their own bread daily. 

The location is a little hidden, and it is set back inside a fenced area. However, it is also next to a beer distributor making it very, very convenient.  

I like the cheesesteak with mushrooms best but my boyfriend raves about the buffalo chicken cheesesteak. We frequently get cheesesteaks as takeout and rarely do delivery seeing as we only live a couple blocks away. Our orders are always ready promptly if not early. They also sell a variety of cakes by the slice which is great if you just want a little taste.

I continue to be impressed with this dental practice, from the front desk staff to dentists and hygienists, everyone is friendly, knowledgeable and they make it a great experience.  They take pride in their office as well - it is very nice.  Also, I find it important they let you know what a needed procedure is going to cost after insurance so you have all the information before making decisions.

My wife and I tried this place for lunch and we loved it! You walk in and immediately see all the delicious looking pastries on display. Then, when you remember you came here for a somewhat healthy lunch, you can grab a tray to proceed down the line (grab a menu first if you don't know what you want to order) the first station is the special salads where you get things like a Chicken Caesar salad, etc. (if you get a caesar salad as a side with your sandwich then no need to stop here). Then comes the hot sandwiches/soup station (and finally you order any other food items (like the chicken salade croissant at the register). You pay for your meal and they give you a number to have your food delivered to your table (drinks are not delivered you get your own fountain drink if you choose to pay for a drink). To the side of the fountain drinks there is a complimentary bread station with butter and jelly as well.

I decided to order the infamous the Chicken salade croissant (delicious) w/ a side of tomato basil soup and caesar salad, my wife had the Turkey & Brie sandwich with a side caesar salad... They were both fantastic! We even tried the potato galette and it was extremely tasty. We only wish we had saved room for dessert!

The ambience is very rustic and appealing to the senses. The atmosphere at lunch was very inviting... good flow of traffic and nothing overwhelming, both the customers and employee's had an excellent vibe. We made sure to leave a tip for the food server/bus person even though it was limited service. We will be back!!!

O.K, the last couple of years I've become a beer snob. All of our vacation trips always end up having  a visit to a brewery or two.
My wife and I have visited all the breweries that we could find with in a 50mi radius and so far our favorite is Stoneyhead.
The tasting room is small, which makes it easier to make new friends. The bar keep was friendly and entertaining. 
The beers are very tasty and full of flavor. The Sneak Attack Ipa, Irish Ale and the Porter are our favorites.
Tastings are free and offered eagerly.
The popcorn was freshly made and endless.
They were dog friendly, and even gave us water for our pups.
We are eagerly awaiting the day we get to try the Porter, aged in barrels, which will be amazing.

I strolled in here right before close and they were nice enough to make me a poke bowl! It was so good and full of good quality tuna and salmon. The worker recommended the sweet and spicy sauce so I did that. I'll be back!

What an amazing salon! As soon as I walked in, the atmosphere was welcoming and friendly. The guy behind the reception desk was super friendly and offered me a coffee, tea or water - I knew I was in the right place!
Erin cut my hair and she was phenomenal. Finally a hair dresser that I could converse with and come up with ideas for a new hairstyle. I totally appreciated that she had ideas of what NOT to do with my cut because of my face shape or hair type. The final product was perfect and I love it!
I can't wait to go back - totally 5-star service and quality.
The employees were very helpful in pointing me in the right direction for the items I was looking for.  Banana Republic isn't my favorite store, but I do like their Pima cotton t shirts.

Not a terrible place for a quick bite if you're in the CBD and craving Thai food, but definitely not the first place I'd go to for Thai.  The last time I went there I ordered the chicken salad.  What a disappointment.  It was a few measly pieces of chicken served on iceberg lettuce with slices of cucumber that looked and tasted like they were days old.  And the dressing was super sweet and not at all spicy.  The Tom Kar soup is decent, but again not wonderful and the use of canned mushrooms is pretty bad.  The portions are also small, and I usually leave hungry....

I still go there every now and again because some of the folks I work with love it, but I don't personally recommend it.

Yum, do I love a combination cold cuts banh mi sandwich.

Seasons Cafe is a cute little place in a minimall off Gandy.  It is clean, well-lit, and full of friendly and efficient staff.

I had the banh mi, and while it was more expensive than I'm used to ($3.99 vs $2.99 at my favorite place on Waters in Tampa), the roll was quite large, and I couldn't finish it, so I'd say it's a pretty good deal.  The veggies were fresh and crispy, and I loved the generous spread of pate.  I did not find the meat overly fatty.  Also, the fresh avocado boba was fantastic with lots of avocado, although not the best boba I've had.

Being right off Gandy Ave. in Pinellas Co, it's almost as convenient as the Waters area to south Tampa, so I very well might return.

This is a review of a dr's appt there. My bariatric surgeon and his PA moved over to Community. They have valet parking, which is kind of swank. However, my friend and I were a bit lost, and ended up in the wrong building. Due to my knee issues, they kind of forced me into a wheelchair, which sucked. But the volunteer who directed us was really nice. It's a huge facility and multiple people asked if we needed help finding where we were going. Valet pickup was pretty quick.

Since we lost our favorite Chinese restaurant, we have been in search of a new one. We tried CK on a whim to test our luck. I ordered the beef & broccoli much special and Tricia ordered the salt pepper flounder, one of our favorite dishes from 168. The beef & broccoli was fine and typical, the side of fried rice was not as good as I make at home but honestly, I haven't found a place that does make it as good as I do. Tricia's salt pepper fish was very good. the batter was light and crispy and the fish was flaky. The scallions were very tasty but the jalopenos could be en cooked a bit more. But it is a dish that we will go back for again and we did. I do look forward to trying some of our other favorite dishes that the offer on their menu. We will be back for other dishes and being fairly close, within 2 miles I am sure we are in their delivery range.

Waiter was great but prices were rather high $10 up.. for very tiny portions and kinda bland tasting. We're local and eat cheaper with authentic flavor and reasonable portions. Probably will never eat here again.
Amazing wine and the atmosphere is awesome! The staff is very knowledgeable and beyond helpful. Selection is huge. You won't leave disappointed.

Ok. BR was in route (kinda) to the airport, I was hungry, had time, and was Jonesing for a burger and shake. Quality stuff again. Ordered the 69 (garlic-horseradish aoili on the side) with sweet tots and BR got the job done again. Just enough blue-cheese taste in every bite. The tots were crispy and sweet. The Strawberry-White Chocolate shake didn't last long!
Great food, excellent service. Big variety of sushi and rolls. The place is very clean. Their prices are the lowest that we found in Tucson.

My favorite restaurant in the Tampa area.  Beautiful room, great service, amazing food. Excellent for celebrations, they make it extra special for you. I enjoyed a 6 course tasting menu with paired wine. Awesome!

I'm torn between 3-4 stars... 
Love the variety of pastries, decent menu too... Food isn't amazing. You look around and it's definitely more of an older crowd. I'd go again, if in the area but wouldn't go out of my way. 

Staff was really friendly and on top of helping.

You like badass beer? 
Badass Bartenders? 
Badass Food?
