As I've gotten a little bit older (snobbier, foodier then thou) and returned here, I know that there is better out there, but this spot will always have a place in my heart. Fuck it, I was gonna give em 3 stars, but I'm bumping it up to 4.

What to eat: Italian (my fav) or tuna hoagie, chicken or regular cheese steak, buffalo wings. Pretty simple. Ask for a side of the hot peppers.

I stopped in the past Sunday evening. There were a few other groups there so the noise was ok. The parents had there kids under control which is also a plus. I ordered the crab cake appetizer, shrimp bisque soup and shrimp ravioli. They did bring out the appetizer while I was still working on the soup, but no issues after that. 
The soup was pretty good, the crab cakes were so-so and the ravioli with 3 shrimp on the side were also good. The ravioli came with a sauce that was similar to the shrimp bisque. The total was around $30 including bread and a drink. Overall I had a good experience and would go back. They must be reading these reviews!

unfortunately, i have to give this place a negative review.  even armed with the reviews of the "hole-in-the-wall" place with "cheap" "good" food, I still found this restaurant disappointing.  we went on a weeknight with a bottle of wine thinking 'oh yeah, we'll just pop the cork and have a relaxing meal'..  well, the atmosphere really didn't lend itself to bringing wine - maybe beer would have been a better choice.  

the main dining room is 6-10 tables with only one server who did not seem to be very aware that they even had diners to tend.  we found the main dishes quite greasy, and in particular the chalaw glupy (califlower) had a very weak taste (the kadu at least had some spice).  that being said, the hummus appetizer was delicious, especially with the homemade bread.  overall, we were unimpressed with the restaurant and probably won't be returning.
My favorite new nail spots in Old city. Always, clean and one the best gel manicures I've have had.

Sweeney Todd was such a spectacular performance! It was my first time seeing this production company and first time being at Tower Grove Abbey. The venue was really neat and the actors played out some of the scenes off stage and within the aisles. It made me feel like I was part of the scenes; like I was a bystander in London watching these interactions play out. It was truly magical! I cannot wait to see more shows by SDT!!
I highly recommend checking out this very talented company!
(P.s. I suggest wearing layers. It started out cold in the venue but got hotter as the night progressed)

They have a great concept that is well executed. I always make my own pizza, and for about $8, you get a small pie with as many toppings as you want! The ingredients taste fresh, and the fountain drinks are organic (real sugar!)! One thing I noticed was the thin crust, but I'm a fan of that so take what you will. I've never seen it packed, so service has been quick the few times I've been there. It's pleasant that the staff is so friendly. I highly recommend you to give it a try if you're near the area.

Went here on a Wednesday night after spending some time out for Sips.  It was pretty crowded but that was probably  due to people getting the drunk munchies during Sips.  They said there was a 30-45 minute wait but we were able to find two seats at the bar right away.  I was surprised about how cramped it was inside but it does make for a cool intimate atmosphere even if it feels a bit crowded.  Ordered the deviled eggs which were eggcellent.  Ordered the classic burger which was delicious.  I know the burger here is famous for being one of the best in Philly and I felt it lived up to that reputation.

Love this place. Very clean and professional. Plus the prices are reasonable. Yes they hound you about the package deals, but if take a chance to listen to them the deals really are worth it if you wax on a regular basis. Move over international salon there's a much better place in town.

It's a pretty good go to spot.  Has a menu that offers a variety of foods.  The drinks are pretty good. Service is okay.  Pros: Big tvs, good crowd when a game is on. Cons: can get tight when crowded.

My sons & I were coming home from a hockey tournament in North Jersey and we were craving roast pork broccoli rabe and cheesesteaks. No problem, just jump off 95 and Tony Luke's right there! 

Oh, it happened to be Sunday, right after the Phillies game let out. Tony Luke's was mobbed, we did our drive by, not a chance. So, I get on the phone and call my buddy who lives around 9th St., he says Oregon Steaks!! Better sandwiches in the neighborhood!! 

Much to our surprise, these sandwiches were on par with the other tourist attractions. Clean and very friendly service. Tell you what, I won't be standing in line anymore.

My husband and I have been going to Tamarindos for 10+ years since it is very near to where we live and serves marvelous food. We love it. The FREE margaritas are terrific, the food is wonderful and we have come to know and Love the sweet staff (which to me is very important). We have just come from their new location in Flourtown and find it cozy and lovely and I know the owner will continue to tweak it as he did his former location.

The food was excellent, best Mexican food I ate in a long time. I have eaten in a few cities, Houston, Vegas, And San Diego, nothing as good as this spot. Beef was excellent. Sat at the bar, great service. Compliments to Jerry and Robert, i had to slow down on those great drinks. Overall, I would recommend this spot tok any one in Tuscon visiting. Great, great, spot, and I have been to quite a few Mex spots in NY.

Average food. I saw the reviews on Yelp and had high expectations from this place. However, the food was bland, americanized and simply not great. Tried their chicken hoagie. Chicken was too dry and they use the same chicken for their shawarmas and gyros too.

This place is phenomenal.  The food quality is unparalleled and for the most part the service is awesome.  The pastries - quite simply incomparable!  Kudos to Vin who is, I believe, the manager.  He takes the meaning of customer service and satisfaction to heart in everything he does.  I cannot recommend this establishment strongly enough.  There will be a wait on occasion but anything this good is sooooo worth waiting for.

Came here because of the excellent reviews. Ordered as soon as they opened and allowed 25 minutes for them to cook my German pancake as described on menu. It's now been 45 minutes and I'm still waiting here. I usually don't care about waiting, but I got a infant in the car with my wife who is angry, and this puts me behind on my schedule.

Absolutely Horrible and Dishonest! - On 8/27/11 I checked into The Casa Del Mar Inn located in Santa Barbara, CA.  After receiving my key and unlading my vehicle I went to my room (Room 32) where I put my belongings down.  I remained in the room for approximately 20 minutes.  During that time the phone at the front desk (located approximately 10-15 feet from the front door of my hotel room) rang several times.  Additionally, several guests came in and out o the lobby.  While in the room it was as if I was in the lobby.  The sound from the phone, front desk representative, and guests was extremely loud.  I asked the desk if there was another room.  There was, but it was two room suite and cost a considerable amount more.  I was offered the room at the increased price, but declined.  I asked to not be charged, or refunded if I already was.  The front desk representative named Andy told me he couldn't do that.  I asked to talk to a manager.  He stated the manager wasn't on site.  I asked if we could call the manager.  He said he did not have the manager's number and couldn't call.  He was extremely rude!  I continued to request to we call the manager or give me a number I could call.  I explained that if he wasn't empowered to resolve the issue that maybe his manager was and we could work things out.  He smirked at me and then I told him I wasn't interest in playing games and asked if I would need law enforcement or an attorney to resolve the matter.  He finally dialed the manager's number and spoke with he manager (Christian Mercier - 805-963-4418).  The manager refused to talk to me.  He also said he would not refund the cost of the room unless the room was resold.

Don't bother scheduling an appointment online. I made an appointment for 2:00 today. When I showed up, they looked at me like I had 5 heads when I gave my name and appointment time. The woman proceeded to tell me that they were behind and I would have to come back tomorrow. I ended up walking down the street to Wayne nails on South Wayne Ave and was taken immediately for a manicure with no wait.

A perfect definition of southern hospitality and hidden gem. Went to the neighboring swamp tour and they recommend you to this bar which is directly across the street. All of the workers were so kind and welcoming. They were offering to take tons of pictures of us and gave us beads.  They even treated my friend to a free shot for her birthday. We purchased the bucket of beers for the swamp tour and it was incredibly cheap! Definitely worth it! 
Would love to visit this place again!
I love these people. I love this place. Excellent fair trade coffee and iced yerba mint mate.
We ate here for dinner.  Nice menu of Asian dishes all of which were prepared fresh.  We enjoyed our meals.  Our meal was quiet but no children were present.

This place is amazing. Food is amazing. Decorations are amazing. Staff is very friendly.
I ordered the Americano omelet and Nutella crepe. Both were crazy good.

I started off my meal with the shrimp cocktail because you just have to have St. Elmo's sauce at least once in your life. Well, once was plenty for me! How do people do it?! It was WAY too horseradish-y for me (and most people in my group). I know, I'm probably offending people all over Indiana, but I just can't!

On a different note, the meal was amazing (fettuccine Alfredo) with kale, edamame, and  quinoa salad. The salad was delicious, but I did expect it to be warm. It was a cold salad, still delicious, just not what I expected.

Just an FYI this Starbucks sucks! 4 associates standing around gabbing at the mouth and they can't make a drink to order. My cup didn't have the order marked on it so nothing that was supposed to be in was applied to the cup. I ordered a specialty drink and got a load of crap. Probably the worst drink I've ever received at a Starbucks!

After trying to find a place to eat for 30 min since every thing was closed. Mind you we went on the Fourth, we decided to eat here. We were welcomed with friendly smiles. Our waiter came and quickly took our orders.the atmosphere was great, it was not busy at all. We order the taste of Buyou and crab and shrimp Alfredo. The food came out quick and was very tasty. The only thing that could of been better was the seasoning on the pasta and there could of been more meat in the gumbo. But overall the food was great. Will come back again

Right in the action of bourbon and canal streets so its busy for sure. On the outside it looks pretty nice. It's a bit funky. Elevators on and off again, TV was shitty and mostly didn't work. Channels with no sound, weak signal causing no picture or just static channels.  No fan in the tiny bathroom, broken shower rod, dirty carpet and a view directly into the Marriott I think .  I mean like you could see in the rooms across the way.  No breakfast or anything. Restaurant not open for breakfast either.  Expensive for what you get. Having gone into other hotels in the area with similar high prices this ones on the low end.  Pool was shaky, small and murky and can't see the bottom.  It was alright I guess I don't need much.  Did get to see the staff nicely help a drunk older dude and his wife out of their Uber. Guy passed out right at the entry and fell onto the railing which held him up.  They dropped him into a wheelchair still out and wheel him up to his room.

Great atmosphere. The breakfast is good. Just like at a diner. Prices are high. Service was fast. For the price I wanted something more than a diner experience although it was just breakfast. Short Hills is know for their lunches.
This place is huge lots of choices entertainment and food could do without the smoke!

This place is spectacular! And free! Wonderful for a weekend activity, great for a first date, or, for obvious reasons, great for people who love art. There are so many exhibits in the building and each one of them displays something new and exciting. Everything from African art, to old Asian art, to modern art--all of it was perfect to look at. The staff is friendly, but DO NOT touch the art, or they will show their not-so-nice side of the art management world. 

The building is gorgeous and sits on a huge amount of space. There are gardens, outside pieces, and a beautiful restaurant and gift shop. There is limited free parking, but the bigger parking area is only $5, which is well worth it if you can't sweep free spots. If you live in Indianapolis and haven't visited this museum yet, I would ASAP pick an open day and spend as much time as possible here.

Kyber is open for BRUNCH everyday... I love brunch I can't wait to try it out sometime soon. I went here for lunch with a coworker BC it was open before 12. I will definitely becoming back we had a great time. Good food and service

Dr. Staten is very good as is his staff (location by Old Town Mall). They are all very knowledgeable of what they have, what they can do, and what they cannot do. My husband has very bad eyes, he requires special glasses (high index) that are quite thick, Jackie the Office Manager let us know that they would be quite expensive there but we could save money online or elsewhere, which I appreciated her honesty and we were able to find glasses at Walmart for a fraction of the cost. My children also had a great time here getting their eyes checked for the first time-Dr. Staten was very nice to them and really made sure their eyes were thoroughly checked. The gal (don't remember her name, dark hair and glasses, been there forever) is really helpful at finding glasses with you, she has a good opinion of what looks good or not. I appreciate her, she's helped me over fifteen years find the right glasses for me. I just want to thank the staff for their kindness, friendliness, knowledge, and help. I appreciate all of you as does my family. I highly recommend them, double check your insurance first, make sure they are in your network.

I've given this salon several chances and they have not lived up to my expectations. I have gone to two different women there to get my hair styled for a wedding and for a cut. The updo was cute but they are so overpriced for the services that they offer. And during my cut the lady was talking to me about bad hairstyling techniques and she turned my chair around, and I saw exactly what she was talking about- she did a horrible cut and not at all what I had showed her and talked to her about. They just hear and let it go out the other ear. Thank God my hair grows back quickly. I will not be returning.
EXCELLENT FOOD, SERVICE, SERVERS, PRICES!  I had 100+ people at my event and everyone is still talking about how good the food was!  Look no further if you need a caterer!

AWESOME experience!  Way more helpful then AAA and my insurance company when I got in an accident.  Were quick, efficient, funny, informative, honest, and clearly very good at what they do.  I would highly recommend them for all your towing needs.

The Milkshake gets a 4.5 Star...... 

But wait the name of the place is Burger Republic. It looks like that put more energy in there milk shakes then the name of this place. 

So the Burger was good. BUT!!!!! But when you order a burger Medium and cook it medium. It was solid Grey through out. 

Now the reason for the 3 star. Waitress came buy after i cut my burger in half,  I had to see if it was Medium. I took one Bite. She ask how was every thing and I told her it was not medium. She ask how was it cooked and i picked it up and ask her does this look Medium!!! She said No. Then walk off. Did she offer to have a redo, NO. Did she send a manager over and appoligize, NO!! She ignored it. 

So reason for the 3star is the Service. If you like a well done burger and Milk Shake. Hey your going to love it..
Love this place! They are always friendly, their pizza comes out yummy and they are always on time with deliveries. So much better than pizza hut down the street! No contest.
Great music, excellent DJ and delicious food! Couldn't ask for a better bar in Channelside. Do yourself a favor and order the grouper cheeks and flatbread! Definitely will be returning.

Everyone should be familiar with Friendly's.  Good sandwiches, burgers, fries, and ice cream.  Great spot for kids!  This location has horrible service.  During my visit, there were 2 other tables in the whole restaurant with people at them.  There were 3 waitresses working.  It took 5 minutes before my waitress greeted me and then another minute until she took my order.  My food was delivered by a different employee.  My server never asked if I wanted a refill, never asked if i was ok.  Really poor service.

This place is a total hole in the wall bar. They have a bunch of tv's, sports decor, a pool table, reasonably priced beer and a wall of dart boards. The service is fast and friendly. 

It does get pretty smoky here though. I was only there long enough to finish a bucket of beer with my friends and left smelling like an ashtray. 

Also if you go to the bathroom be prepared to hear the conversation had at the table near the door. That's some funny stuff!
Haircut was good. Attitude of female stylist was disappointing and pretentious. I won't be coming back solely because of this.

Lovely neighborhood gem but worth a drive if you're not local. Nice decor. Clean. Comfortable. Excellent menu and food. Binty is best server ever!

Binty left. Hmmmmm. 10-2014
Remarkable service and food.  If you're a meat eater and with a friend get the Charbroil Platter... Trust me, it will blow your mind.
Great food and a fun place to hangout! Not a lot of seating outside on a weekend, but still a good atmosphere!

AMAZING icecream, horrible wait, and so so service.  I ordered sundaes and they gave me cups with lids that dont secure,  by the time I got home it was a soupy mess. Their line wait is always 20 mins the drive through is closer to 10. If their icecream wasn't so gosh darn amazing I would never go back.

Came here for Breakfast for my sister and I birthday! It was amazing!! So tasty, great service, what more could you ask for. Wait goes by fast!! I love it next time we came to New Orleans will be sure to come back!!!

Hamburger was over cooked and bland, the side salad was soggy and sweet. Both were overpriced. They were out of two of the craft beers they offered on a Monday evening. The menu is limited to  basically sandwiches,  salads, and chili. All in all, other than the al fresco seating and the wine, our experience was subpar this evening.

Good food. Not as busy as the other Japanese steakhouses. Worth stopping by. My first time there and had a nice lunch with my family. Ordered traditonal hybatchi grill food and a sushi roll. I've had better but not bad, not bad at all.  Next time we will try something a little more signature to this restaurant!

Great boba place that reminds me of Cali. Kind of ridiculous that regular boba isn't included in the price though. Once they screwed up my boba order and just dumped the drink into a new cup with the right boba... With me losing 15-20% of my drink. That sucked considering they're kinda expensive. Starbucks level pricing. They have a lot of tables and a few couches and board games. Nice place to hang out with ac and outlets.

I don't know how busy this place gets at nights or even on the weekend. I've only been here for lunch, their famous sandwich w/ fries in it. The sandwiches get messy so be prepared. I've had many of the sandwiches and they're all pretty good. I usually ask for the fries on the side per if you had the fries inside the sandwich, it get REAL MESSY. hahaha When you eat their sandwhiches you can feel your arteries clogging and you must expect to do nothing for the following few hours due to the food coma. However, the sandwiches are all pretty good. It's not to die for, but it might kill you if you eat too much of them. =P

I did notice some good happy hour specials, so maybe i'll go check it out. The happy hour menu is set daily; they have one special going on every night (I think it's Sun-Thurs).

I'm not really sure why this place has such a high rating or maybe I ordered the wrong items, but the items that I did order were a huge disappointment. C'mon yelp!


SERVICE:
-Was good.



LOCATION:
-Ocean view, of course!



FOOD:
-CLAM CHOWDER: by far one of the worst clam chowder I've had in a while. If you're on a pier and offer clam chowder, you better make it good!! To be fair, I was at Old Fisherman's wharf the weekend before and then I had Pike's Place Chowder up in Seattle within the last year. Did not like the thick chowder texture. It was thick in the wrong way, where it was separating into chunks after 10 mins of eating. The clam taste was not infused very well into the soup either, it was 2 independent flavors from each other. The soup was herb-y flavored, more so than clam flavored.

-CRAB CAKES: the worst crab cake I've ever had! I usually love crab cakes, but this one BARELY tasted like crab. Probably because of all the spice they put into it. If anything it almost had a slight curry taste. For a SEAFOOD restaurant ON a pier, I was expecting nice fresh chunks of sweet crab meat!! NONE of that, the crab was really fine (almost like canned?? texture) and there was absolutely NO sweet crab here, just spice flavoring. I was better off feeding $14 to a seagull.

-FRESH CLAMS IN BROTH: this was the saving grace of the entire meal. The clams were sooo fresh, super sweet and great texture! The broth had a little too much white wine & not enough garlic for my taste. It was also on the salty side, but the clams! OMG, the clams!!! One of the clams was bad though (dead taste) but the rest were fresh.

Wonderful. We are big Indian food fans and love this place. We went for dinner (so no buffet). Popadoms served while we decided. I ordered a chicken dish with spinach (sorry the names are a bit of a mystery to me) and my wife had a lamb dish with ginger. We had the onion naan bread. Everything was delicious! We can't wait to go again but with more of a crowd to try a larger variety. Next we might try lunch to check out the buffet.

The service was VERY slow to start with. Staff running from place to place because their either short-handed, inadequately staffed, or--- see the following....Why: because the car wash doesn't function properly and someone has to drive it through the system-- it's supposed to be an auto car wash!, the chains did not work to pull the car through (!!!); the brushes inside the car wash were worn thin and inadequate to clean; rinsing is inadequate- they use your windshield wipers to clean the windows.  At the end, the staff did not clean the interior glass properly nor was the black front bumper of my SUV cleaned at all! A perfect example of a business run by folks who have no idea how to run a business. Perhaps it's a Breaking Bad type of "car wash???"I expressed my concern to, apparently the wrong person, and the cashier said, "whatever." WOW! $25 for what? Don't waste your money by using this so-called "car wash."

Banh mi: ( #60) special banh mi
-Freshly toasted bun
-Thinnly sliced asian style pork BBQ and Viet style cold cut
-Light on pate

Pho: 
- well seasoned. Less salty than your average pho. Tastes more homemade.
- cuts of beef are thicker and more tender than your average pho

The coke and club sodas were fantastic. Service ok, food was terrible. While the server and manager both tried to make it right, my stomach was turned by then. I ordered the meatloaf, and it was spicy. It was not like any other meatloaf I have ever had. But they tried. He ordered the bison, or should I say dry-son burger. Even though he ate all of it, it was the driest burger he had ever had. 

Love the atmosphere and the cool little TV speakers at each table.

Love the taco Tuesday and their rainy day specials. As a resident of channelside its nice to support the area as I would love to bring back more businesses to the channelside bay plaza. 

Their tacos are delicious and are a really good deal on special. I need to go back and try the full menu and see how it holds up!

For now you I will just base it off of tacos and margaritas. What more could you ask for??

Horrible, still crying after having my hair cut and colored  a couple of days ago. Received an amateurish hack job and can't get it fixed as it's chopped too short now. I have a wedding coming up and will probably wear a hat.

My hair is not even from side to side and looks hacked at, not layered. scissors were dull as my ends look awful already! and way too blond (almost fried) compared to what it was, going to have horrible roots in a couple of weeks!

After reading all the reviews this was not what I expected! I expected some time to be taken especially on my cut, not just chopped and sent out the door with a bad cut.

Wouldn't recommend!!!
Finally, a pizza in University City that I will eat. Devour, in fact. Great service, decent prices, and delivery! As an added bonus, their chicken alfredo pasta is amazing.

The owner is very friendly, the service...so, so. The portions are small. Not quite Authentic Mexican Cuisine. Good music tonight. A single guy singing western music. Would try again and order something else. Had the Maui Maui fish tacos and hardly any fish in the tacos.

The pecan pie is great! The filling is not too thick, not too thin. there is a generous amount of pecans, and I love the crust. The pies with chocolate in them are really rich. There is a mild graininess from sugar, but I like it. This is a local product, and I am happy to support a well made pie! Looking at the two other reviews, I'm surprised at the negative reports. I'm thinking there are all kinds of ways to make pies, and to condemn one because it is not exactly the one way you like best, seems to be taking  a very narrow view of the everexpanding universe of pie! Well, I like it!
Excellent food, don't miss it. The meat is perfectly cook and the desserts are out of this world. Highly recommend it.

When naf naf first opened I couldn't get enough of it. It seems to have gone downhill since then. They no longer are serving fresh pitas, they're out of a bag. I believe they're making them ahead of time and bagging them up, just not the same as fresh. They used to cut the pita across the top and put everything in and it would stay together "nicely". Now it just falls apart and is a bit more difficult to eat. It tastes good but just isn't what it once was unfortunately.
Awesome workout with super friendly instructors. Barre3 is definitely my favorite Barre studio.

The food was the usual Steak N Shake.  I gave it 3 stars because of the service.  There were lots of dirty tables and several people waiting to be seated and they took their time. 

On the plus side, the Garlic double burger was amazing?  You probably wouldn't want to kiss me after eating one of them. ;)
Clean with tons of machines.   Big laundromat with space to use the facility.   Machines are older but in good working order, takes coins which is a plus.

I cannot begin to express the level of excellent service I got from Carmax when I went there to sell my car. I had no intention of buying a car from them when I went to go sell my vehicle, and they did not pressure me into doing so, as I had explained in the beginning that I was not in the market for a vehicle. 

The wait time was a little longer than I thought, but definitely worth the wait. The gentleman that assisted me, Carlos Olvera, was very nice and clearly explained the entire process to me. Within an hour, I had an offer for my car that far exceeded my expectations, and was even larger than I could have gotten in a private sale (I had it listed on Craigslist for a few days and had already relisted it at a lower price once). 

The buying process was quick and painless, and I walked out of there with a draft to take to the bank! I would definitely return if I ever needed to sell a vehicle, and I would also recommend it to anyone else trying to sell their car. When you go there once, you can make an appointment for the next time, so you can skip the initial wait.

Any time we're out of town we always look for a brewpub, as we usually end up with great beer and food. This time was a disappointment. The service was poor. We probably waited 5-10 minutes before we saw the waitress, another 5-10 minutes before we got a beer for my daughter and a taster for me, another 5-10 minutes before we got our water, and another 5-10 minutes before we got the beer based on the taster.  And, the biggest disappointment was that the beer was just blah. My daughter's IPA was just okay, and she's an IPA lover, my taster was blah, and the Hefeweizen-Style beer I got instead of the taster tasted a bit like Bud Lite. The food was okay, but the portions were small for the price. My daughter got the steak salad, which was bigger than a side salad, but surprisingly skimpy, even in terms of the lettuce. Her saiad had about 1/4 of a portobello mushroom, two grains of the ancient rice blend, almost no gorgonzola,  and only about 3-4 ounces of steak. My meatloaf was fair. The BBQ sauce was really good, but the meatloaf was really dense and not super flavorful. The mashed potatoes on top were great, but the portion was very small.  It came with quite a few onion curls, and the piece of bread had been placed underneath the meat and potatoes, which was kind of odd.  For $17.95 for the meatloaf, I was disappointed.

This was delicious! We had the quinoa salad and the ceviche. Both were fresh and very flavorful. The mocha and wine was great too! The service was quick and friendly. The manager, Bog, was very helpful, too! Looking forward to returning for breakfast.

Supervisor is a bitch but I still love the place! I try to avoid it when certain people are working to get away from the pretentious attitude (not sure where they get it- they're line cooks at fast food restaurant) but overall I like this place :-)

Ok scratch that- supervisor is a HUGE BITCH! Wow. I will not be coming here while she is working again.

Love this spot.  Very modest looking from the outside, but inside it's cozy,colorful, and most importantly the food is delicious.  We've been back four or five times and the quality is consistent. If you want a locals recommendation on an Indian spot, come here!

My favorites are the tandoori chicken and tikka masala.  Soooo yummy!!

We found Saki Endless Sushi on Yelp and with 158 reviews and a 4 star rating, even with some detractors, decided to give it a try. 
Our family of 5 arrived at 7 pm on a Friday night. There was a wait of 35 minutes but in the end - it was well worth the wait, and here's why:
Jason arrived to take our drinks order and we had lots of questions. We thought about ordering a la carte to avoid the chargeback if we didn't finish something, but after watching those around us DEVOUR what they were served we went ahead with the AYCE option.
Here's what we ordered:
Hot and Sour soup and Egg drop soup - excellent. Two kids ordered the clear soup - one said it was good - one said it was too salty and didn't finish it.
Salad with ginger dressing - not very good - the dressing was missing that ginger bite and freshness, and had a weird after taste.
Crab Rangoon: YUM! The best I've had in more than 10 years..  Don't know why this is so hard to get right - I've even been served "rangoon" with no crab (even imitation crab) in it..  Theirs is excellent! I'd come back just for that.
Mexican Roll: New to us - was EXCELLENT - we ordered another one.
Spicy tuna: Tuna was spicy - but overly mushy and there WAS too much rice on the roll (reflecting the experience of another reviewer).
Dynamite roll: as expected for contents - but didn't have the spicy (red - sriracha?) sauce on top we usually get.
Shrimp tempura roll and California roll - as expected.
Volcano roll: Excellent - however the description said there was baked crab on top so we expected that part to be hot - but it was cold/room temperature - and the roll would have been better with the crab hot.
Coconut shrimp: GONE in less than 7 minutes.
Shrimp hibachi dinner - Yummy! BTW - Shrimp sauce is called Yum-Yum Sauce here.
Their iced tea is Yummy - should have asked what flavor it is...  
They do not have any low sodium soy sauce - we have never had that problem. Hope they will make it available before we come again, and Saki Sushi WILL be our go-to spot for sushi in Tampa. So glad we found it.

I never got to the main menu because the young man waiter who waited on us couldn't make his mind up if he wanted to serve us the Happy Hour menu or the main menu. We finally settled with the Happy Hour menu because he was very non-communicative. When 1 salad arrived, I was given my friend's salad and wolfed it down before I realized it wasn't the one I ordered. I did think it was strange because I was clear I wanted bell peppers on it and would pay for it. The turkey soup was cold, so I had to send it back, and then it came back too hot. We also ordered corn tacos and the waiter never said if they're soft or hard shell tacos. I wanted hard shell and I forgot to ask him, because tacos are usually hard shell.  But, guess what?  They were soft, but tasty though, but could have had more meat.

What really bothered us (and we're not uptight by any means) was the loud south-of-the-border music that sounded like a big party was going on of 100 or 200 people, and there were only 3 people in the restaurant! 

Our waiter never really returned after the wrong salad given and another more professional woman came, but by then we were ready to leave. The ice tea was given in a glass that looked more like tall skinny shot glass, and of course he didn't think to bring us any sweetener, so we had to get up and get it. The salad could have definitely had more ingredients in it for anybody. The one that I originally ordered didn't look much better, except that it did have my bell peppers. The waiter never offered bread, so we ordered a tortilla, which was stale. I don't know how they can serve a stale tortilla, but they managed to do it. 

I've heard good things about this restaurant; that's why I went there. But maybe the management went on vacation or something. I don't think I'd take a chance on going back though.

Today was my first ride and I have to say I was a little nervous and intimidated to even go! But I had such a great experience! The front desk was super friendly and helpful along with the staff inside who helped me set up my bike. Alexis (the instructor) was so full of positivity, the music was great and the workout was amazing! Now I know why people shell out the money to go! Bonus: bottle of water and shoes are free your first time!

I can't wait to go back for another ride!
Quality baked goods and a huge selection. Russian Tea Cakes = YUMMY.

I came here with intentions of wanting a good ok' Southern breakfast. It was more of a lunch and dinner joint. They were more than accommodating and offered to make me some eggs, bacon and Texas toast with my coffee. Long story short, I went for the wet Tennessee ribs with garlic mashed potatoes and some amazing beans! The food was delicious, in happy I stayed and the service was good ok' Southern love! Hope you enjoy your meal and the pecan pie!

No matter how bad the hair cut, going in you know its a risk that you are taking by going to a student and you even sign the waiver saying you are acknowledging it too...so anything less than 3 stars really would not be fair.  Don't get me worng I have gotten my fair share of bad cuts from different students here in St. Pete, as well as, another location down in Ft. Lauderdale.  But I have also gotten really great cuts too!

We came by after shopping at Bass Pro. We were seated quickly and the restaurant was fairly empty. We tried the all you can eat fried shrimp with coleslaw and french fries. The coleslaw was very good, the fries were fair and the shrimp kept coming. I took most of the batter off the shrimp and they were fairly small. The taste of the shrimp was fair, they did not have any spice on them so they were a little bland. 

The restaurant was clean and the waitress was very attentive and friendly. Two people ate for less than 25$. We will try other entrees next time we come.

Just went here for a work party about 20 of us and the service was awesome! Tried the Maui wowee pizza and it was excellent. The ambience is very chill and relaxed , I would definitely recommend this place if you are in the Brandon area.

We wandered into Broken Beaker on a Friday night. Every other bar around it was full so I found it a little odd that there were only a few people inside what seemed like a really cool concept. I had a Jolly Rancher Test Tube shot and my husband had a Tiny Rick, which is heavy on Jalapeño infused alcohol. The bartender we had was nice, attentive and gave us a lot of good information about the menu. We were sitting at the end of the bar though and employees were discussing their day to day like they were in a break room. There were some games on but no music so I felt like I was in the middle of their conversation. The presentation of the drinks was really cool. It's nice that they offer distillery tours. I think with some small improvements, this place could be a lot more on target with what they are going for. The ambiance could be a lot cooler with the science theme. Some interactive projects or more of a lab feel. It feels like it hasn't quite committed to the theme. Some different choices in lighting, music and decor could do a lot for the place. We will go back, probably to show our friends who come to town, but the challenge is really getting past the show and creating a regular stream of customers, which will mean creating a physical environment that people want to stay in.
Good gelato but the coffee was just okay (I expected something better). The beans and milk can be better.
This place is just ok.  The service was good and so is the decor but was sort of disappointed with the NY Strip. The lamb osso buco was pretty good and so was the short rib appetizer.

Sound Exchange is exactly what you want in a used media store: Funky selection, wide inventory, and piles of stuff to dig thru.

Staff was helpful when I wanted them to be, and left me alone otherwise. Just as it should be.

I honestly don't buy nearly as much music as I used to (course, I have TONS already...) and yeah, I miss Vinyl Fever and Alternative Record.

Sound Exchange was never the 'cool kids' shop, but they're the last ones standing. That says something.

And: They have a section with cool older (60s/70s) amps and other high end stereo equipment. Hipster paradise. Oh, did I mention the actual record sections? Ditto.

I actually bought a CD today. Haven't done that in about a year.

Overall, a cool but classy place for drinks. The menu is beautiful - so many options, and definitely not just limited to whiskey, so there is something for everyone. The bartenders were decently attentive, and drinks were tasty (we tried everything from the Old Fashion and One Legged Man to some of the fruitier drinks). We didn't sample any of the food since we were all heading out to dinner afterwards, but everything going by us appeared to be good, and smelled delicious! Only complaints involve the crowded nature of the bar / seating layout, where we were constantly being bumped into by waiters trying to serve food. Overall, seating is somewhat limited but in true Garces fashion, the place is usually pretty full. There also didn't appear to be any sort of happy hour...if you expect prices to be high, there won't be any surprises. Will be back to sample more of the drink menu!
Great English breakfast cafe. The way lace was packed but they did their best to seat and feed me. The Eggs Benedict were worth the wait

Came in on a Sunday it was very chill inside . The problem was with the menu. I couldn't decide between wings or fingers. I asked the server  her favorite and she said well we don't have any wings . I said ok well I'll take the buffalo fingers. Once my food came out she gave me ranch I said no I'll take the blue cheese she says oh we're out of blue cheese. I would have never gotten it like what's the point. Then the check comes and gratuity is already added which usually I don't mind but out order was not even over 50$ which is stated in the menu. Thumbs to this dump!

Excellent oysters - both char grilled and raw are top notch. Char grilled oysters are fully cooked with bay seasoning and cheese and served with a side of garlic butter (great taste, but a tad gritty. Possibly due to the Bay seasoning). If you like raw oysters like myself, you will really enjoy the raw variety (I ordered a full dozen oysters to myself one rainy evening and did not feel awkward with everyone watching). They were a good size and taste creamy with an fresh ocean explosion in your mouth. The fish are fresh and taste as so. I had my first hush puppies here and I am a fan!

I'm a pretty laid back guy, but I am big on manners and etiquette. When I asked the manager "How's your day going?", his response was, "What can I get you?"  The young man also proceeded to call me "dude" multiple times, although this is a word I often use, it is definitely not appropriate for a customer you do not know. I still went back the next day to get some more work done, but found it impossible due to the overly loud, obnoxious conversation of the employees. I'm all for a fun work environment, but please respect your patrons. Nice enough people, they just need a course on social etiquette and treating customers with respect.

The best happy hour oyster place I have ever. 
2 dozen raw, oyster and crab plus Brussels sprouts. A meal we will remember for a long time. We will be back.

Nothing special but open late Sunday night and I like that they try to source everything from local farms.

With my blackened chicken sandwich (which was really good) I got fries, though I asked for a salad.  I overlooked this because the fries were also really good.

I had the worst experience here on Oct 16.I needed to take my cat to the emergency vet.we got there at 11:55, they promptly took my cat back.I didn't see him until 3am.I had no idea what was going on.they had us in a room for an hour, not one person even looked in the door or came to simply update us on anything.finally after we asked the front desk, the vet came in.we agreed to several tests.one of which was a urine culture.to make a very long story short, we spoke to another vet at red bank,& he said the culture wasn't back yet.so a few days later I checked again.a tech said no results yet can take 7-10 days..Ok..TEN days later now,I call again.this vet proceeded to tell me the culture was never ordered.WHAT??a$500 visit, no culture..my cat is 17& this was the important test I was waiting for.I'm so angry.I can not believe the other 2 people I spoke to didn't see that no culture was done?I call bs.someone screwed up big time.I've never been treated so bad at a vet office.not only was the actual experience there a nightmare, clearly they don't have their act together on pet care.so all this wasted time waiting for results that aren't there.shame on you red bank!!

This is a terrible place to live. Not only have I had two maintenance issues involving my washer machine that flooded my entire neighbors apartment, not once but twice (the second time being because they did not fix it the first time). They dried my floors and did not chip in to have my carpets cleaned not once but a second time, even after they should have fixed it the first time.

Secondly, I gave my 30 days notice after my lease was set to expire (apparently even though you sign a contract for it to end on a specific date- they continue it without any further signing of paperwork). However, I was told by staffing in the office that I could find a tenant to take over my lease for the extra month they added on. When I called to secure it, they are now telling me that isn't feasible, and they are sorry their own employee gave me misinformation. Now they are trying to say I don't have a lease and it is a month to month and now I can't find a tenant to offset the cost.
Unbelievable every staff member has no clue, no one is on the same page and now they are trying to screw me for 1250!
A fabulous place to grab an eclectic snack while strolling down Baltimore Ave . . the fresh-squeezed juices taste like they were spiked with happiness :)

A good place to walk off the Indian you just had at the Taj.  There is a really good book selection and a wide range of household goods and sofas, in reasonable shape.  Like any of the other thrifts, sift carefully and you will find a gem.
Hands down the best shrimp and grits of life. I wish I could visit New Orleans more often just to eat here. Small little place, good service, better sauce than most places for the entrees.

Table Rock is a staple of the Boise area. There are plenty of trails you can hike (or mountain bike if you're nuts) to the top. If you're not into fitness, you can easily drive to the top as well. Enjoy fantastic views of the valley and try to catch a sunset. If you plan on heading there in spring or fall months remember a jacket. You're almost a 1,000 feet higher so that wind can pick up while you're at the top.
The crew here was very friendly. Fun decor and the food was very good. Overall a wonderful experience with superb service!

We decided to eat here instead of at our hotel and it was a great decision. The food was fresh, and there was several different choices to choose from; from chinese, soul food, mexican food, and many pasta dishes. The night we happened to go, there were to hispanic guys with great voices singing christmas carols, and other requested songs in spanish. They were pretty well known by some of the customers, so I am assuming they perform there often. Great food, and customer service.

It wont blow u away but it's a decent lunch spot. U wont have anything undercooked. The sesame bread is pretty good. I recommend sticking with egg drop soup unless you are used to the flavors of the other two. Option between white and brown rice, i feel like they missed out on the opportunity to have fried rice as an option. Overall i enjoyed it.

I like going here because there is a nice seating area outside and the food is delicious. I'm not a huge fan of their standard beers but love their sours. I would give them a 5/5 if they had sours on tap.

3.5- I'm some what torn on this

Gluten Free- Yes, item specific, clearly marked on menu
Dairy Free- Yes, item specific,clearly marked on menu

First and for most, I love the concept, especially since paleo tends to lead towards more gluten free dining. It is important to note, that like all most all Indy restaurants, they CANNOT claim to be gluten free as they don't meet a host of requirement and do NOT have dedicated kitchen space. For this reason, they are Gluten "Friendly".

Tips/Highlights

+ The welcome shot of olive oil is a nice touch. If you're unsure about it, I would suggest taking small sips if you aren't adventurous enough to chug the whole thing.

+ The menu broken up into courses, as well specifically calls out vegan/gluten friendly options. Nook also breaks out the Paleo and Keto geared options with the macros broken out.

+ The food was ok. The food was filling, fresh, healthy, and filling. Other than that, there wasn't one dish that I had/ stole bites from other members in my party that makes me really want to go back ASAP.

- The dinner wasn't exactly a quick. It was more of a prolonged experience.

-/+ Initially they didn't have a reservation system setup when they first opened. They now use OpenTable which they list as offering limited reservations, thought your guess is as good as mine as to how many tables they keep open for non-reservations.

- Cocktail bar- They truly mean cocktail bar. No food service is provided

-/+ Parking- It's downtown so parking can be a crap shoot in availability and cost, especially when there are events going on at what it's currently Bankers Life Fieldhouse*(Name to be changed pending the highest bidder). 

Overall, it's nice to see a GFCF dinning option available in the downtown area.

Place milked my tits entirely dry. I don't think I've ever been milked this hard from a coffee establishment. Starbucks has absolutely nothing on Milktooth. All the treats look incredible especially the pecan sticky bun. The pictures in the bano are stellar, just a bunch of race car drivers gettin after it livng their best leche lives.
This Applebee's is the best one of its franchise! Great customer service, great food,great ambience! One of my favorites in Clearwater area!

The food is very good. The service is a little lacking. The atmosphere is definitely very homey as it is in an old house. I was not very happy paying $4.00 for three small glasses of ice tea. It is absurd to have to pay for refills on fountain drinks. I am sure they charge for seconds of rice as they only brought me about a cup of white rice with my entree. I feel that I should be told there there is going to be additional charges that are not specified on the menu.

Kim and Greg are great to work with.  This time Kim handled my service and like before, I was well taken care of.  I'm never disappointed when I come to this auto service center.  I will definitely be a repeat.  I was and continue to be treated like a valued customer, no matter how small or large the job and that means the world to me.  And your facility is kept in A-1, very nice condition along with the amenities of cozy highback TV chairs, big screen cable TV courtesy beverages (water, coffee, tea & soda).  I really appreciate that.  - Gina

We subscribed to the Times for fifty years now and today I cancelled. Great paper but had to call at least twice a week for non delivery. Seems like everyone on our block can get a paper but we get missed. Very hard to talk to a customer service person only recordings. Use the 800 number and you might get lucky to get the operator who will transfer you to a real person,then you are told a supervisor will call you in 24 to 48 hours never received a call back. Glad our aggravation is over we will start reading the paper online. They have very poor customer service.
We ate here twice on our recent trip. We enjoyed sitting outside. We had crawfish, crab and my favorite was the roast beef po boy.

I've been going here for a few months for Brazilian waxes. The wax they use def does hurt less. The girls at the front desk are friendly and helpful.  The girl I've been going to for awhile is nice but isn't overly chatty-which is fine by me.  Today I got waxed by someone new due to my schedule. This individual was very thorough but tried to sell me exfoliating products. I get that I have a few ingrown hairs but I hate trying to be sold additional stuff. I just bought a 400 wax package. I get that she was just trying to make a recommendation and prob gets a commission but ugh. Hate it! I also noticed a bunch of stray hairs when I got home....even one patch that went completely ignored. I will be back to use my package just wish a different waxer.

I have to say that this place was a little underrated to me. The staff was SUPER NICE. They changed the television to the basketball game I wanted, the calzone was boss. I mean it was cooked perfectly and the sauce was fantastic. It was just the right amount of spice. The meat sauce that came with it was to die for. Even my skinny brother in law ate all of it. I'm a big boy and this place satisfied all of my needs. The staff was VERY helpful and kept my family full on drinks and outstanding service. Definitely going back when I'm in town! :)

The service quality and the food quality has gone down.  I've been coming here for at least 10 years.  Ordered the usual short stack of French toast. The server wrote down short stack and gave me pancakes and I told her she was wrong I asked for the French toast.  She did apologize and offered to get French toast for me but I was hungry and had a headache and wanted to eat something.  The pancakes were horrible.  I don't know what they use for batter but they were horrible. I didn't eat them.  Took a few bites and stopped.  My husband had a grilled chicken breast on a Kaiser roll.  The piece of chicken breast was so small it was ridiculous.  He took two bites and the chick was gone.  It was more of a bread sandwich with a large piece of lettuce and a small piece of chicken.  I will not be returning.  I've already noticed that the service has gone downhill and the quality of food has gone down.  They have cut there hours of operation also. It was very muggy and uncomfortable in the diner. The server sweating. You can see it on her face.  I asked her to tell the manager to turn the air on to make it comfortable for the customers.  The problem I have with that situation is that after speaking with the server and watching her wipe the sweat from her brow, you think she would of washed her hands.???.

I've gotten dry aged steaks and fillet-both were excellent. The staff is very knowledgeable and friendly and they do a great job trimming the cuts. This is one of my favorite shops in philly- definitely a must for meat lovers that cook.

I am not ashamed to five star this place. I am from Brooklyn and really missed the quality of great take out. This place has never disappointed me. House Special Chow Mein, Egg Rolls, Egg Drop Soup and Hot and Sour Soup all consistently delicious and hot when it gets home. Plus the Cashier/Order Person has always been polite and says "Thank You"  Would I eat there? In an emergency. It is mainly for take out. Most of the tables are for people waiting for their orders. Call ahead....it''s easier.

DON'T STAY HERE!! 
My husband & I checked out within an hour of finally checking in. 
I say finally because we weren't given a room until 5p when the check in time is 3p. 
The hotel room was dirty and the hallway smelled musty and of urine. 
This place boasted being renovated, but you can not tell. I hate to see what it was before the 'renovation'.
The staff was not friendly, more like robots. They were on auto-pilot and obviously overworked/stressed out by the amount of dissatisfied customers in the lobby. 

This place was so bad that we shelled out an extra $600 to book another room for our stay in New Orleans. This place was that bad.

And everyone keeps mentioning that the location is great. 
Honestly it really is not. It is only a good spot if you are planning on going to the casino a lot.  If not, then there are many other hotels that are in better locations.

I heard about this place opening and finally got a chance to try it last night.  It's a lot bigger than I expected so at 7pm we were able to get seated right away.  The ambiance is cool.  They have a high top "bar" with a fire pit in the middle.  There are a couple couch seating areas and a lot of 4 tops.   

Started off with drinks.   I think the bar was slammed from a big party they had there so they took a wee bit to get them.  The rosemary honey cocktail and the pulpa margarita were sweet and tasty.

We wanted to try a good selection of authentic dishes so we went tapas style.  The dough god trio was wonderful especially the calabacitas.  Also had the Tostadas de Jaiba and that was the best thing I had.  Authentic crab in a killer cilantro aioli sauce.  If they made a bigger entree version of this it would be awesome.  Also tried the Potato nachos which were slices of potato fried covered with yummy cheese sauce.  Not the typical nachos and that was a pleasant surprise.

Had to try the fry bread dessert, I guess my expectation from street fairs etc was too much.  It was the only thing that was so so.  Otherwise I will for sure go back there and try other things on the menu.   Service was wonderful and attentive.

Nicely done guys.

Comfort food? Yes please!

Every server and staff member were in positive moods and had their own preferences. I saw online I should get the Chicken and Waffles. I asked a few others and they gave their other recommendations. Not just the expensive ones, but everything. A good omen.

I had the bottomless mimosa with three different juices and opted for the chicken and waffles. Perfect. My first experience with them and they were wonderful. The server we had was excellent and came to us from time to time. My only complaint is that the meal could have used just a little more chicken or a second waffle. But that's my gluttony talking. 

Will I come back? Hell yeah!
Ill give a 1 star because the beer was cold other than that NADA! Tweekers everywhere rude dealers horrible food and pit bosses that need a real attitude check! Won't return.
Do not go here. Was greeted last though I got there before 2 other people. Then waited 35 minutes for a chicken parmesan. Worst service ever.
Great coffee. It makes my trip to the mall more enjoyable. Me and my wife almost always stop here when we are at the mall. Better than Starbucks in my opinion.

Nice franchise restaurant that has a long tenure prior to arriving in Meridian.  Good choice on the franchisee part. The food and service was very good.  Diversified menu with quality ingredients.  
I know everyone in Boise always says they love local restaurants but they really vote with their feet and end up a chain restaurants because they are consistent.
I like joe momma but they argue with their customers.  Steve's cafe down the street boast of game meat but can't properly execute basic bacon and eggs.
This one will be a winner!

First of all, Jefferson's is straight up sports grille food (burgers, fries, wings etc.) which is fine by me as I like that kind of thing. My meal started with their fried pickles (recommend on the their menu) which were some of the best I have ever had, they have my highest compliments on their fried pickles. The burger, on the other hand, was not that great, but not that bad either. In other words, the burger was perfectly average. My one side, mac n" cheese was just average as well, I have had better out of a box. 

To sum up, the fried pickles are a must have in this restaurant as they are fantastic. The burger, on the other hand, is perfectly average. Nothing to special here, but nothing bad here either.

This is by far my most favorite sushi joint ever!! Stellar customer service and some amazing and tasty rolls!! Cute little niche close to Trader Joe's, perfect place to stop at and grab some fantastic sushi after some grocery shopping or meeting up with friends and family. They have a vast variety of rolls to meet everyone's taste and will create just about anything you would want in sushi. Reasonably priced and always fresh fish. You will not be disappointed at Sushi Minato :)

So much to do out doors here! You can see horses that are kept across the small street, play in the fun park, get wet in the new little water area, grill out, picnic, or sit by the Bay and look out over the water. There is also Fishing available to rent poles very cheap like $5 and they have bait! Plus there's a small local restaurant at the pier that has everything from seafood and cold drinks to yummy ice cream. This is a great place to walk with friends and family or exercise even. I love this small quiet place on the water.

Mm yea GC is SUCKING these days. How complicated is it to make lo mein properly if you've been cooking it all day every day for... decades? Lo mein here has become consistently greasy & has a lovely burnt flavor. It's so oily that I leave the last few mouthfuls so I don't have a heart attack on the spot. The food here overall is overpriced and crappy. The one thing I order [shrimp w/broccoli] is really hard to F up, but eating with other folks has shown me how hit or miss GC is. For some reason it always takes 10 light years to get the food when I order in store for sit-down service. That gives me homicidal thoughts that I can't shake for days.

This place isn't even trying anymore. They know they don't have to because an entire neighborhood that's flush with cash thinks GC is the only viable option for Chinese. See all the reviews post 2008? They ain't lyin. Forget MY first review & get your Chinese somewhere else!

We had an outstanding experience this week. Very professional, friendly, efficient and the best movers I have ever worked with. The came in exactly on estimate. Great care was given to all our belongings and I would use them again in a heartbeat.

I really really missed this cozy, eclectic cafe.  It's the prime place for studying or just catching up with friends on a weekend (or before a mixer/dance, if you're in HS...ahh, those good ole days).  My extra frothy cafe latte hit the spot and the baristas are still just as friendly as I remembered.  Make sure you grab a fresh-baked chocolate chip cookie with your espresso, even if it's to go.  Your mouth will thank you.

This is my first time at a Sprout Chain. This store reminds me of a blend of Trader Joe's and Fresh market. There's a great deli section (something TJ lacks) and ample veggies. Plus prices are far better than Fresh Market and Whole Check... I mean, Whole foods lol.

Avocados were 3/$1, strawberries were $1 and they had lots of organic options. I tried a few of the samples that were being given out and everything was really good. There are not a lot of cash registers so I do see long waits possibly being a problem in the future.

Not the best KFC.  I ordered a family dinner, but apparently it just comes with loads of wallpaper paste (mashed fake potatoes) as sides, and in the tiniest prunt on menu, shows that any other side is an upcharge. 
Ended up paying over $32 instead of $25 because we opted out of fake potatoes. Clerk was ignorant. Got home and many pieces of extra crispy chicken had breading cracked off. 
Not agreat value any more for dinner.
Love this place ... food is always excellent and its a great local place to meet friends.   Must try the wedge salad.

After a year this is still the best nail salon. Amy does the vest pedicure by far, tge foit massage is seriously the bedt and Mindy now does my uv gel nails and does a excellent job. Show her a pic of a design and she can replicate it.

I love this place. As a beginning music producer, I've bought 75% of my starting studio equipment from this shop. I got some stuff from guitar center, but I felt better getting everything else from Corner Music.

The people who work here are top notch. They know their stuff. Take a guy there named Ray. Is he there to help me buy something, get a sale for the store? Sure, I guess that's part of the business, but he's better than that. Classic guy, very kind, and he's answered all sorts of questions about my equipment, the best use of it, what my priorities in getting together a home studio should be. It's certainly paid off. I'm pleasantly surprised at the quality of work I am doing, and I have Ray to thank for that.

Yes, I research equipment online. I find options. But Corner Music has personality. I love that. Thanks for being more than just a music shop, but a business focused on being good people to other good people.

Like: I like their beignets better than Cafe du Monde. Their's is actually lighter & not over flowing with confectioner's sigar. Love this locations ambiance, free Jazz music in the middle of all the loud music from Bourbon St 

Dislike: Lady who made my hot chocolate did not seem to know what she was doing, my hot chocolate was warm, not hot!

I've had great experiences at Eats! and always look forward to returning.  I love the house-made potato chips with the delectable spicy ranch dipping sauce, which they bring you while you wait for your meal.  Even my picky husband eats them right up!  Eats! has basic American food done very well, and the prices are reasonable.  My favorite menu items are the Midwest BLT, Cheese Fries and the Philly Cheesesteak, which reminds me a lot of the Philly's we get up in PA.  There were some menu items that I wasn't as crazy about, such as the Beer Cheese Soup (too watery), but most of the meals I've had there have been great.  The servers are friendly and knowledgeable, and the service is always prompt.   I'll definitely be back!

Not impressed with Uber so far, signed up for the first time, had 2 different coupons and the app didn't give me a chance to use either, I'm like everyone else and always wanting to save money, I choose Uber over Lyft to use the coupon to save money, and didn't get to, also was given the driver name and then 2 mins later the driver name switched, not sure if this is normal or not.

This is a terrible place to get in and out of. The donuts taste like they been cooked in Used Oil. The employees  always seem as they are disgusted to be there and looks at you as if you are bothering them. The donuts are small and taste oily then they charge 2 dollars more per dozen than everyone else. Almost forgot to mention the cook in back coming out drenched in sweat holding your food ? How healthy is that

Superior coffee, fast and friendly service.

Could definitely use an expansion or a second location nearby. It can be very difficult to get seating during certain times.

Deborah Solo was my realtor when I bought my house 17 years ago and again when I sold it in 2017. I cannot say enough positive things about both experiences. I knew that when I decided to sell, there was no question that I would use Deborah again. Her knowledge of the buying and selling process, Philadelphia and architecture is second to none..
I adored my house and was sad to sell it. Deborah was patient and understanding of the emotional attachment I had with the house. I cant imagine I was an easy client as as buyer as well. It took well over a year to find the house. We saw a lot of houses, but Deborah quickly figured out my style and what I was specifically looking for. She was patient and positive when the right house did not come along right away. 
 Throughout both the selling and buying process Deborah and her staff were very thorough and accessible. Any questions I had were quickly answered. If the opportunity arises to buy another property in Philadelphia, Solo Real Estate will be my realtor again.

the food here was good has a nice entrance and plenty of parking. the place is pretty clean and most everyone was friendly big open area and way nice less ghetto than the other casino Desert Diamond near by. The bathrooms were super clean.

Breakfast wrap grilled on pannini press, uh yes, please! We came back today because we had one last week and it was so delicious. I subbed out tomatoes for spinach, added mushrooms, and had gorgonzola for my cheese...oh my! Do it you won't regret it (assuming you like those ingredients). 

We split a side of fresh fruit. It costs $3, but it beats a load of greasy home fries (nice change up) and it was SUPER FRESH!

Lady next to us got the bananas fosters French toast which looked really good. 

The place is so small, so seating is at a premium, but the food is prices well and very good. If you can grab a seat or have a short wait it will be worth all your breakfast desires.
Chicken tacos too bland but good beer.

There are a hundred pizza chains going, and of course what makes Papa Murphy's different is that you bake the pizza at home. But it is good pizza, a good value, and made quickly and fresh.

Plusses: They really load up on toppings, especially on the cheeses, but also the rest. The crust is a nice medium thick, just enough comfort food mouth feel. If you aren't getting a discount, you aren't trying. They put coupons on the insert you get with the pizza, they advertise in the Star & Val-Pac, and you can print them on your home computer. Not greasy unless you get two or more meats, but if you order that, you have to be expecting a greasy result.

Minuses: The sauce is a bit bland. They could stand to jazz it up with more herbs, more garlic and/or some red pepper.

Plusses far outweigh the minuses. I love to order a plain cheese pizza from them this time of year, when my tomatoes and basil are ready. Really perfect.

Marathon Music Works is hands down the best standing room only venue in Nashville. Marathon Village is such an interesting area of town, and MMW only adds to it. 

My girlfriend and I recently went to the sold out M83 show here. For being a sold out show you wouldn't know it. Not nearly as packed as sold out shows at other venues. There are a few bars scattered about, which makes getting a beverage extremely easy. The stage placement is also spot on. Front and center as it should be everywhere. Parking can be a little bit of a pain in the ass. Dont fall for the $5 parking lots, just find some free street parking and save yourself five bucks. 

I cant want to enjoy another show at Marathon Music Works!
Amazing work done by Yong! My wedding dress needed alterations in the corset and her team did a beautiful job on my dress.

I took a chance on this salon because it had a couple of good reviews.  The person I worked with was Jill, who is new.  At first, she was really good as far as haircuts.  However, she has a lot of "issues" that limit her availability and focus.  I was happy with her work up until the last haircut in April 2012.  So, I brought in a picture, let her know what I needed and she immediately got loud and argumentative and made a scene.  It actually was rather shocking to see her reaction, however, somehow it calmed down and she finally cut my hair.  Again, it wasn't what I asked for, so I contacted her the next day and asked for a refund.  She played a lot of games about that and when I contacted the owner Christie, her response was basically, "She'll refund you, don't come in our salon again."  So, if this sounds like the type of "service" you'd like, Ciao is the place for you.  For me, it's Ciao, Ciao!

I expected more. I'm writing this review after multiple visits. The most amazing thing I had was the fried fish. It was legendary. I was disappointed with the flavoring of the pasta that came along with the fish. It was surprisingly very bland and tasted like it was previously frozen. I wanted more flavor. Wings are very good. I tried the lettuce wraps and was surprised at the small sized meat portion for the price. You can't go wrong with any of the desserts. They all were good. Dishes seemed to be a little overpriced to me. I don't mind paying for a good meal and experience at all, but the food for the prices just don't add up to me. Drinks are also a little pricey.
The salad with olives. Baked brie. Beef tenderloin. Tzin's Kelsey and Glen. Get ready for the best night in town!

I LOVE this place!  It is one of the BEST places off the beaten path of the main beach strip in Santa Barbara.  You cannot beat this place as an outdoor lunch spot, I can't emphasize that enough.  Fresh, fantastic food.  Friendly staff, tons of menu options, something for everyone, check it out!

Review would be a 3 1/2 star review for the draft and bottle selection but food is a 2 for sure. Stopped in on a Friday night and got the brisket sliders (dry), 1/2 rack of ribs (meh), cole slaw
(tasted spoiled) and corn bread. The sliders had the cole slaw on them and between the spoiled taste and the dry brisket we did not finish. The ribs were a bit dry and fell off the bone in one bite. Not the way they should be according to the BBQ Association. Everything tasted as if it was sitting around all day. We live close by and love to support local business's so we were very disappointed overall.

I eat out (a lot) at many different restaurants in the  Philadelphia and surrounding areas, but Tako is and has always been my favorite place to eat for the past 10 years. Consistently great sushi and beautifully presented. The staff is very friendly and  Jay, you Take SO much pride in your art. You're the man. We  love you!!!!  ~~~~~Craig and Kim

Came in on a Wednesday for 2-for-1. Not a lot of variety of beer which is why I gave them 4 stars. 

They had a live band which was over by the time we arrived about and hour before closing.

Parking can be difficult if your coming on a busier night. Other than that i will definitely be coming again. Great beers!!!!

I've been to this Panera few times before and it's always fine but tonight I ordered food to go, got home, realized they didn't make my sandwich correctly, drove back got a new sandwich! When I  got home and took a bite out a sandwich I found a nice long piece of blonde hair...  I am never coming back here or to any other Panera again.

Really nice, friendly little spot with amazingly cheap, large breakfasts. And they deliver? Sign me up for more!

Great grits.

My fault for not inspecting the meal I bought (2 breast of chicken) worth 6.52 basically gave me 1 breast of chicken by cutting 1/4 of the breast and saying that it's 2 breast. By the time I was home I didn't want to drive back and explain myself. Also their phone is out of service. I'm not sure this place will last long, it's always empty and theirs better options. I'm from Miami and the Pollo Tropicals over there are 20 times better. 

Go somewhere else, this place is pitiful.

We went to Nashville Humane Association today. We adopted a sweet boy! Retriever mix. We so impressed with the staff,how clean it was and the condition of all the fur babies!  We really liked the fact that the paper on each kennel was so descriptive about each furbaby.It We would like to thank the staff and receptionists for being so friendly much better than a certain other place... Thank you for a wonderful place and such a wonderful furbaby!!! We adopted Li us.He fit right in no problem.

The kids who work at Roast are friendly.  They screw up things once in a blue moon, but that's to be expected.

The cookies offered there are good.  They're not the best that I've ever had, but they're good all the same.

The pain au chocolate is terrible.  It's some kind of thick, chewy abomination.  Avoid it at all costs.

The sandwiches are overpriced by about 40%.

The drinks are good enough, but they're not particularly memorable.
I'm new to the city. I broke a tooth. They took me in right away. I need to get the work done but they were informative and polite. .

Ordered a sandwich on one ticket my boyfriend ordered a sandwich on Another they gave us two of the sane sandwiches, which were very spicey which I cannot handle, just don't understand how this could be difficult.
At first we thought it might be a bit expensive however the quality exceeds the pricing

Quick Summary: GET THE DUCK WINGS.

Came here for a midday-midweek soccer game, thinking that there wouldn't be too much of a crowd... and was very very mistaken. Standing room only around the bar, and tables had been reserved well in advance. But despite the large crowd of people playing hookey, they were quite adequately staffed and I didn't ever feel underserved.

Not having been to any of their other locations, I really liked the lay out here. There's a pretty big central bar, with seats on the inside and the outside, a pretty expansive patio and deep interior with tables that can accommodate some pretty big groups. I'd say ~15-18 max at one table, though I'm sure they've done better.

There were plenty of screens all around, and on this particular day it was especially important to be able to watch two simultaneous games, and I'd say most people had a good vantage point of both games, myself included.

Now you know about how the place is laid out...what about the important stuff... food and drinks.

Food: GET THE DUCK WINGS. Yes I know I already said it... but they're that frigging good. If you've never had duck its a leaner and more flavorful meat. I say leaner cause you won't have huge chunks of meat, but there's still plenty and that which is there has a bit more gamey and robust flavor to it.  They make them awesome here, with a nice crispy skin and not over sauced.  They were so good, I think we ordered them 3 times.  I was kind of distracted by the wings so I didn't order anything else, but if everything else is half as good as the wings, it'll still be great.

Drinks: A very nice extensive menu of draft and bottled beers, and they even have a good variety of beer cocktails (something I haven't quite ventured into yet).  As with most of 'chain' brew pubs, they've got a good selection of the bigger craft breweries with larger distribution networks; but in the spirit of craft beers, I think they could do better by offering some of the smaller local beers (especially since the Tampa area has such a great budding craft brewing industry). 

Overall, a great place to go for some upscale foods and finer drinks. I'd come out here with friends that know their beers and appreciate having some variety on their palates. Oh and definitely great to go for a game.. or two... or three,. not that I did that... or anything.

Great barbershop. I was looking for a great barber in saint Louis and I found my new spot. Sam does amazing work. Sam knew exactly what I wanted and was able to create a great work of art on my head. Great fade and hard part. My advice, go see Sam.

I always hit Harbor Seafood prior to my departures out of MSY.  GREAT food and many locals.  I brought some friends in from Michigan for Final Four and stayed in the French Quarter and ate throughout FQ, and UpTown....they liked Harbor best for the food!!!  Always will return....as long as traffic on I-10 doesn't put me behind schedule!!!

happy hour!!!! 

this was probably my most frequented happy hour stop during my tour de tucson. and i don't drink beer. so this is pretty much just a food review. 

the wings (tequila cilantro? and regular) were good, but nothing mind blowing. the pretzels and other such happy hour eats were all decent, but again nothing earth-shattering.... my posse seemed to loooove the beer (the hef and blonde and raspberry? i dunno. i really don't know anything about beer except i don't like it. hah.)

but the best thing? the spartachoke dip! that was how i kept saying it, although really it's spinach-artichoke. it is really really good... and unlike any other s/a dip ever. it's got olives and for goodness sake, pay the extra $1 for the bread bowl! and eat the freakin' bread bowl! it's the best part. 

so basically, this review was about the spartachoke dip (~$6 during hh. with the bread bowl). which you should get.
Some of the best service! Thank you Brianna and Jon for being so welcoming. 5 stars for the service
Wonderful burger with a gluten-free bun!  Kids loved the macaroni and cheese bites. Told us we would have a 30-minute wait for a party of six but we were seated in 10 minutes. Friendly server.

What to say about my favorite watering hole?  I started coming here to avoid another place. What stroke of good luck.
