The waitress was sweet enough, but seemed to forget things.  
The dip and a medium pizza was more than enough to fill us up and provide lunch for me today!

My husband and I stayed for one night due to a graduation, I was greatly disappointed.  The valet was $35.00 so that was definitely not going to happen.  Then we get to the room to relax and our TV remote was not working properly.  At 1 am people were running down the hall, then at 3 am loud voices from the next room, then apparently proceeded to have intimate relations giving that the headboard was hitting our wall which was quite annoying.  But I will say that the staff are very friendly and professional.  But for the price that you pay I would have expecting better.  But I will if ever in St Louis again, I will pick some where else to stay.
I love this place I love this food very good the lemon chicken wings the whole chicken everything is excellent

Fantastic Tucson food truck!!...Pablo Diablo is one of the best sandwiches I've put in my mouth!..Patty melt on Texas toast grilled with America cheese, avocado, sautéed jalapeños & onion!..Add the hatch green chile sauce and this sandwich will blow your mind!!..Don't wait!..Find out where they are and go get some awesome food!!
This place was very hard to find!!!! Upon entering the campus, there are no signs directing you to the restaurant. Other than this place being hard to find, the food is good!!

Definitely the worst place I've had the pleasure of visiting. We literally waited an hour and a half for all of our food to reach the table and not all of us got our food. My burger that  was supposed to be prepared medium well should have been ordered rare because what I got was a rock instead of actual meat. Most of our orders were wrong and the waitress, bless her heart was trying to correct all the mistakes. The manager did speak to us and said it was a weird transition of shift change, which in all honesty is unacceptable. Personally, I returned my food, had it removed from the check and will be getting my dinner elsewhere. An hour and a half for food to come out and orders wrong makes for an extremely disappointing experience.
This is the best shrimp and grits I've ever tasted. The cornbread is unique and tasty. The service was amazing.  I will definitely be going back.

We just missed lunch so the only thing available to us was appetizers, salads, and soups. I ordered the spinach salad. It was pretty good. I mostly filled up on bread. The bread was soft and warm. I liked it.
The location is fantastic and the ambiance is nice. 
I would be willing to try this place again for either Sunday brunch or lunch.

The pork tenderloin sandwich was amazing! My fiancé got the country fried steak and that was amazing as well! The servers was super nice! We visited from St Louis MO and love trying places we don't have in our state, so this was awesome and definitely recommend it!

Dont go here to gamble! Dealers are not friendly or nice and you will never get a drink! They have one cocktail waitress for the whole casino seems like! Awful experience will wait for new casino to open or go to the nugget or downtown!

5 star !  One of the best banking experience I've had in a while. Brian Mahoney, and employee, was fantastic and answered all my questions. He was amazing. I am opening up a business nearby and he answered all of my questions and took very good care of me and my needs. I am glad I found a Bank and a representative as I am new in town. Fantastic bank I can't wait to tell everyone. Awesome Brian
Had steak and (crab) cake.  Ambiance and music was excellent.  Service was a little slow.  Pricing was reasonable.

First off.  Our server was great!  We didn't eat the Chinese food (I will come back and update my review for that because the menu looked good) we came for sushi.  The fish was fresh, miso a tad salty.  What got me was the lack of a selection for nigiri (i.e. no scallops?)  I was a little surprised because everyones been talking about this place.  I'm a bit of a sushi snob and if you are one too, you may be happier at places I frequent.  I don't go for the cooked rolls and most their rolls have something to likes of Crystal shrimp or crab in it.  I opted to special order my rolls (they had no problem doing). The place is nice enough.  I'm interested in eating the Chinese food next time for sure.  3 stars because of the Nigiri selection :)

I loved this place! I had the meat pie, warm stuffed grape leaves and the baklava.

The meat pie was delicious! I will return here and order this again. The meat filling is wrapped in flaky crust and drenched in a bechamel-type sauce. Try this if you come here. You will not regret it.

The stuffed grapes leaves were good but not the best thing I tried on my visit. These grape leaves weren't like any other I've tried, these are served warm and served in sauce.

The baklava is amazing! Definitely order a piece. The baklava alone is worth the drive here.

The restaurant itself is very casual and plain. You come here for great food and not for the ambience. The people working there are very nice and attentive. Oh! And the place is BYOB.

With pizza it seems to come down to the question of what is the most important feature of a pizza?  For me, I love the crust, for me it needs to be soft and fluffy.  If the crust is right then good quality cheese and good toppings will make a fantastic pizza.

Reginelli's gets this just right for me.  One of my favorite pizzas is the sun pie, a specialty pizza with plenty of veggies and a pesto base.  I have tried several of the specialty pizzas and I have enjoyed all of them.  

They also have several locations around the city and all of them are consistently delicious.

Great pizza. One last week and another this evening. Love the thin crisp crust. Good quality cheese and tomato sauce. Delivery was quick and arrived nice and warm. 

The order taker on the phone repeated my order back to me twice and the driver was courteous.
BBQ ribs were fall off the bone amazing, as was the potato salad.  Their $14.99 all you can eat rib special on Thursday nights, along with the live entertainment, is a must!

Great experience from beginning to end. This was our first time and we loved it! They have an amazing happy hour menu for food and drink. Their portions are ridiculous. Definitely enough for 2-3 meals. My date and I each got their happy hour hibachi and had a total of 3 margaritas. Our bill was just over $50.00. The staff was very attentive. The Chefs were interactive and funny. At the end of our meal the maitre d or manager came and asked us about our experience. We will definitely be back and have already spread the word to friends that this is a great place for date night or a large group of friends.

Probably the best restaurant experience that I have ever had. From the moment we walked in to the time we left the service was impeccable and the food was a pure Delight. The deviled egg appetizer was amazing and the coffee encrusted filet was indescribable. Our server Nick took amazing care of us and made the experience unforgettable. I highly recommend this restaurant for any occasion. Thank you to the staff for making my birthday dinner experience the best ever!

I cannot say enough about how incredible Kristen is. She photographed us on three separate occasions - engagement shoot, Veils and Tails shoot (me and my dog), and the wedding day - and every time she went above and beyond. Not only is she excellent at photographing our pup, her mastery of composition and lighting produce the most beautiful photos of my now husband and me.

She also goes beyond just photographing and did an amazing job with our magnetic save the dates. I can't wait to see what she does for our wedding album!

For all your photography needs, go with Kristen.

I don't really see what the big deal is. 

Pizza dough tasteless. Soup a bit oily. Cheese is pretty good. I ordered the lunch menu with wine. $10+7. Likely will not come back.

Absolutely delicious. I usually get a BBQ Bacon Char combo. The only downside is a lot of the time my burger is sloppy due to the overload of BBQ... BUT IT'S SO GOOD. Fries are very nice too and their 95c cone is perf. Unfortunately, the food is so good that you have to eat it immediately.. it is not so good for leftovers. So don't plan on "getting it for later".
I have had very good results here with laser hair removal. Much better results than other places I have been in the past and everyone there has been very friendly and knowledgable.

Am in on a quick business trip in New Orleans and checked out this place - mainly because of its proximity to my hotel, but also in part because of the excellent reviews here on Yelp. I ordered a bowl of gumbo and a sazerac, both of which were good but not transcendent. The gumbo, at $10 a bowl, was fairly priced but not what I expected in terms of quality. Probably not the house specialty and probably not what I should have ordred, but c'est la vie. 

Everything seemed a little dusty, as well. Just didn't feel all that clean or comfortable.

Would definitely come back, but with a bigger appetite and a wider focus on the menu.
Best Bagels in Brandon.

Since we share the same name, I thought I'd give this place a try. Wow! The crawfish bisque was fantastic. Could have eaten 3 more bowls. Their shrimp and grits were possibly the best I've ever had. The only issue would be the lack of andoullie. Only two pieces in my dish. Shrimp was cooked perfectly. Their ambrosia dessert was a great take on a grandma's classic. Loved it.  Great experience from a guy who cooks from scratch everyday at home.

This is a favorite of mine and my mother's but I was terribly disappointed today, we stood there waiting to be helped at the window and out of the three men standing behind the window not one of them said anything to us but when another man cut in front of us they were quick to help him. We left and ate at moby dick.

The service was ok, it took awhile to get mustard and ketchup for the burger. We sat on the porch... There were so many fans blowing on us we were pulling our hair out of our mouths every time we spoke. The fans also blew the smoke from the neighboring table's cigarettes over to us. Yuck. To top it off, the fans blew my fork on to my lap. 
The food was mediocre. The chicken on the spinach salad was bland and had bitter charcoal all over it... Same with the burger. There weren't many items for vegetarians, but it's a steak and seafood joint so we didn't expect there to be. The sweet tea tasted old and like the server threw a packet of sugar in a glass of unsweetened tea and called it a day. I asked to have the tea replaced with water, which our server promptly accommodated but didn't take it off the bill.We probably won't be back, it just wasn't worth the price they want you to pay for just "ok" food. 
$56 bought:
1. Sweet Tea
2. Coke
3. Water
4. Ballyhoo Burger with bacon and cheese with Asian coleslaw
5. Spinach salad with Chicken
6. Margherita flatbread
7. Firecracker shrimp
$8 tip
A pretty reasonable check if the food was GOOD.
Store is marked closed but it is still open. They still have alot to sell. Prices are pretty good. Good percentage off. I will miss this store at this location.

Waited 20 minutes at the bar just to get a drink and gave up and left. The place was a mad house and clearly don't have their stuff together.  Curious to see if this place makes it because they have serious management issues.

Marble Slab is a great concept in a unique location that could use a family friendly ice cream place, but go at your own risk. The teeny boppers that work there are so wrapped up in their own version of The Hills drama you and your family are FAR down the list of folks they care about.  Customers are about as welcome as your parents going with you on a date.  
The 'workers' (and I use that term liberally) are more than happy to tell you that certain ice creams are just 'SUCH a pain to scoop".  How very sad.
You know what else is a pain?  Paying $10 for people's crappy attitudes.  As for their 'tip jar'- seriously?  Here's a tip - act like someone who is paid to serve customers.
The real deal for philly water ice. Go for a chocolate water ice and peanut butter ice cream gelati.

Way overpriced and nothing spectacular as far as the menu goes. Ordered the ribeye mid rare and it came to the table rare. C'mon. There are definitely better priced and better tasting steakhouses all over the city.

We ended up at RH&B almost by accident.
For a restaurant attached to a hotel I did not expect much but was very pleasantly surprised. The atmosphere is low key and a bit weird at time but the food is really good... Unbelievable ribs, hush puppies, etc...
Definitely recommend the place.
The young people working here obviously take no pride in their work. We ordered 4 milkshakes. They were all flavorless runny soupy messes. Both Baskin-Robbins in Sparks are joke.

I moved to the area say approx one year ago.  My husband and I love smoked meat, and looked on Yelp.  We went here based on the reviews and I LOVE IT!  The food is great, the people are friendly and the place is packed.  This is the best bbq place ever.  There is plenty of parking at this restaurant.  There was chickens hanging around the property, which I LOVE!  I wanted to just pick one up and pet it, while I ordered my food.  I knew this would freak some people out.  Thanks for having a fantastic bbq joint, in a beautiful home, with a great staff and amazing food.  I hope your business keeps growing.  We have been a few times in the last two weeks and will see you in the near future.

Was here the other night and chose to eat outside. My friend and I were both craving burgers so we both got the London burger. Burger itself was cooked to satisfaction and was quite tasty but the English muffin was certainly a curious touch as a bun. No big deal, but as expected it didn't hold up to the burger so I would have preferred a regular bun. Server was semi pushy, in an off putting way, which kind of made this experience worse than it should have been. Overall it was incredibly mediocre.

I love Three Flags Tavern at any time of the day! Their brunch, lunch and dinner options never cease to amaze me.

Their Eggs Benedict layered over fresh crab is to die for and you can't rate Three Flags Tavern without mentioning their famous Briscuit Burger. I couldn't wait to try it when I heard all the hype and I can definitely say it is worth every bite! 

Make sure to ask your waiter about the history behind the name "Three Flags"! I love hearing it when I am in the restaurant!

Saji is wonderful & very reasonably priced. I bought this adorable romper from Sierra Belle, but the straps were a bit too big and kept sliding off. She was able to alter my romper perfectly & it fits comfortably! I highly recommend and plan to have her as my go to alter queen!

I used to go to a Stawberry Shortcake store in the spot where Cuenelli's Rotisserie Chicken now stands. Intrigued by it's appearance when my family took me there, I was excited to try their food and see what it had to offer.

They have some dishes that made my mouth water just at reading them such as Bisteck a lo Pobre, but since it was around lunch time and my appetite wasn't too large I decided instead to try ordering a burger with french fries instead.

It was delicious! The burger was nice a juicy, the bun they use on it tastes great, and they don't overload the burger with too many toppings. The size of the burger was pretty big too, though it's not as cheap as say McDonald's or Steak N Shake. You pay for quality though. The french fries were tasty as well, more like homemade fries than the kind found in fast food places, yet tastier than those made by places such as The Cheesecake Factory or Ruby Tuesdays. 

My parents ordered Papa a La Huancaina and devoured it upon receiving it, my Mom citing it's excellent taste, and she's has tons of experience with Peruvian food so I'll take her word for it. 

The waitress was friendly and quick to pick up drinks and get our orders in. The place is small, but exactly what you would expect an authentic startup restaurant to look like. I'll certainly be back to try the Bisteck a lo Pobre in the future. 

Also: They have Inca Kola! Yum.

This is just quite a great place for everyone. Me and my friends are regulars at the Q as we call it (haha). They have really good Mexican foods and a great environment. I recommend the grilled chicken burrito for any first timers lol! It's my favorite Mexican grill by far. Customer service is great, the don't get jalapeño business! (That was a pun like all up in yo business) and if you don't get it then it's nacho business to ask me. (Haha that was another one lol) but completely seriously it's grrrreat!!!
Love love love this place! Great food & good service! Best Greek in the area ! Fresh! Clean !

I spend a majority of my money here for good reason-it's delicious. They support local family businesses, the quality is outstanding and the staff is incredible. Got to have "Buffalo Cauliflower". The craft beer selection is always spot on. Can we talk about the service? Always spot on. They are like family...the good kind. The meat is the standout here. Bear Creek Farms, Hatcher Dairy...that's locals helping locals.

Food was OK but the serivce at the bar is horrible the girl took forever to take the order I'm staring her I'm the face like I'm ready and she act like she didn't see anyone...then when I was waiting on the bill she took forever I was ready to just walk out... the lady had the WORST attitude..like give me a smile at least she didn't teller her name like when go to a normal spot...first and last time

Aloof and unappreciative of this customer- we bought a custom cake (a bit over $300) and they wouldn't let us taste any flavors (they were all "unavailable" ) We got vanilla and chocolate because who is going to take a chance on lavender goat cheese when it isn't available to try?  They didn't give us any of those flavors to try either, but a chocolate cupcake was available for purchase (why thank you!) the vanilla we took a chance on (it's vanilla). They also kept telling me that most everything would be "over our budget". Idk a budget of $300 for a cake for about 25 people doesn't seem cheap ‍-  (granted we aren't Beyoncé's crew!) Also, our event was early December and the manager didn't return my correspondence promptly, and when she did get back to me, her excuse was that they were so busy with thanksgiving pies (I feel valued!) We decided to go here because of reviews, their cupcake wars win, and to support a new(ish) Philly bakery, and, by the time we figured out that it wasn't panning out to be a good experience it was too late to change bakeries. But, if I could do it all over again, I would find a place that appreciated us, our money, time and occasion; hope this helps you do the same- unless you're Beyoncé then you're all good ;)

if I could give this place zero stars, I would. Stay far far away!!

So, one lovely night a couple of weeks ago, I was on my way home from Trader Joe's when my alternator crapped out in the parking lot. Fortuitously Dobbs just happened in the same lot. Feeling pretty lucky about the situation, we pushed the car into a spot at Dobbs. Given a choice, I would have preferred to take the car to the dealer, but I had no opinion whatsoever about Dobbs and so convenience won out. 

A few days (and lots of money) later, I get the call that the alternator has been replaced and the car is ready. It's fixed. I'm happy. Then oddly the check engine light comes on later that day. I make a mental note to go back to Dobbs the next day. Since the car is working well and they told me it was all better, I kinda ignore the light and decide to go out that night. Big mistake. As I am on Forest Park Parkway my radio suddenly dies. Then the lights dim. Then the headlights go out entirely. I am driving on FFP at 10:30 pm with NO lights (interior or exterior). Scariest experience of my life.

Get the car towed back to Dobbs since they have a warranty. Dobbs takes about 2 hours to tell me they can't find anything wrong. Bullshit. The fact that car was towed there means something is definitely wrong. So, I finally say 'screw this' and have the car towed to the dealership, which I should have done in the first place. 

Turns out, Dobbs screwed up my alternator installation which melted my battery fuse box. The dealer had it towed back to Dobbs and they replaced the battery and the alternator (again.)

Ok, fine, maybe the one star could account for the fact that they did make it right without charging me extra. But still. Horrible experience.

I have been going to Audrey for years to get my hair cut (which she is fabulous at doing) until this year, when I finally worked up the courage to get highlights. All of the reviews about Audrey being an expert colorist are true. Not only did my hair turn out amazing she was able to fix it after being in the sun and turning a less than desirable color. Audrey is very knowledgeable and get this... she actually listens to what you want and makes it happen. I highly recommend Audrey.

Parking is easy right behind the place and pizza by the slice with drink $5, so there is nothing to complain about. The slice selection was small when I got there but service fast and helpful. Best place to get something fast, cheap, and good.

Best deal in town for ice cream!  Mocha almond fudge.  Blackberry shake, turtle cup, chocolate peanut butter.  
Mmmmm.   Mmmmm
Pizza sucks all grease not cook all the way told 2 hours to deliver wtf I well never order again! !!!!!!!!!!

There service is amazing. The food was over the top. Crawfish & Mac-n-Cheese was to write home about.  Oysters were outstanding.  Hopitoulas on draft, what else could a family need!  Great Job Grand Isle...  We'll be back for sure.

Service was excellent. Steak was done to perfection and was tender for sure. I found the salad to be tasty as usual. yelp loves to NOT show all these excellent reviews. We will see if it gets shown or not. YELP 's system of hiding great reviews- stinks. They are the ones that deserve a 3 star rating or less.

A touch of New Mexico in Arizona. Love their Green Chili Cheeseburger. Suggest making it a double meat. 

For those that have never been to a Lotaburger it's like a New Mexico spin/twist on a Whataburger. Burgers have lots of shredded lettuce and mustard. If that's not your thing ask for your hamburger the way you like it. Meat patties are seasoned and if you get the green chili it will add some heat to your burger.

Their seasoned fries are also good. Atmosphere is nice and staff are friendly. I'll definitely be back!

The friendliest and most welcoming staff I've ever encountered. Despite waiting an hour for our reservation, we enjoyed a delicious authentic Moroccan dinner, complimentary wine and belly dancing entertainment. 

Also loved the decor and Arabic music is a plus.... I cannot wait to come back!
Delicious pastries!  The carrot cake and limoncello are scrumptious. They had a lot of variety. Cupcakes are great too. Definitely worth the visit. Take the kids!

This place was honestly delicious. I went there because it's one of the only places in the city that has knafeh. They'd sold out but I was not disappointed. The fresh mint lemonade was amazing. I will definitely be going back to get some fresh knafeh though.
The owners are very nice. OMG they finally opened the restaurant. The food is amazing I will be back during the weekend for some birria

Had a company function here recently, and the folks at the Landmark did a really nice job making everyone feel welcome. They also provided excellent, prompt, friendly service, and kept the food & drink flowing.
The unique thing about the Landmark is that while you could look at it as a sports bar/pub kind of place, it's much nicer inside and much cleaner than your typical sports bar. So if you want to watch a game in real comfort and not deal with sticky floors, dirty bathrooms, and cranky servers, this is a top choice!
Special shout-out to "Kelsey" -- one of our two servers who very kindly checked with mgmt and provided me with delicious gluten free wings to dine on. All done with a smile! Thank you Kelsey :)
Great Brunch spot !!  I ordered The Liquid Gold Juice a great mixture of Pineapple, Mango, Orange and Ginger....Mmmmm!!

Went here on a whim thanks to another Yelp review, and LOVED the place. Everyone was super nice and helpful, great attitudes, and I got my car in right away for an inspection without even needing an appointment. 

Another great thing was they fixed a burnt out tail light bulb for me & didn't even charge me! It's a small place, very cozy but I will definitely be coming back. Plus, as previous yelper mention, they didn't try to up sell me on a bunch of random things since I was a female & there by myself. 

Great experience and I like to support small business when possible.

Side Note: They don't make appointments...make sure you come in early in the day, or at a time they aren't busy. Can be an awesome way to get in quick if you can go in at the right time instead of waiting a week like most places.

They take excellent care of my pets. A major suggestion is that you choose one vet here and stick with that one. There are so many vets here which makes appointments convenient. But too many vets helping your pet gets confusing and caused me a bit of trouble with one pet illness. However, all the doctors are helpful. Dr. Vagnetti (and tech Andrea) and Dr. Myers (and her techs, Antonio and Ana) are great and have gone above and beyond expectations to help my pets. And Dr. Rhoades was very caring when we had to unexpectedly let our dog go in the middle of the night on Thanksgiving. And she made sure we were as ok as possible during his passing. Marissa, Casey, Cathy, and the CSR team are always so helpful and friendly too.

I just spent the weekend with my 3 sisters at this hotel and can't say enough about it.  The hotel is in the old railway station and has a beautiful lobby with a vaulted mosaic ceiling and stained glass windows.  There was plenty of comfortable seating around a very friendly bar which is adjacent to the equally friendly grille.   The room was very comfortable and the bathroom was particularly nice.  What made the stay was the friendliness of the staff.  I'm from Chicago and used to being treated in a rather faceless manner, but the staff of this hotel couldn't do enough for us.  Everyone we met offered service without being asked and seemed genuinely interested in making sure that we enjoyed our stay.  Would not even think of staying anywhere else in St. Louis!

If you read any of my info, you'll notice i like to toy around in the kichen throwing dough is one of my favorite past times. but when i'm in a pinch and need a quick cheap pizza, papa murphy's runs a close second. My wife and I love the delight Herb Chicken Mediterranean deLITE®...wow! you know, now that i'm thinking about it, this is sometimes even better than the ones i make. the olive oil/garlic base with the feta and sun dried tomatoes with fresh spinach leaves create a crescendo of flavor. i could seriously eat 3 of these pizzas by myself. 

the service is what you would expect from a short order take home pizza place. mostly teenagers, but they have always been quick and nice so no complaints here. 

if you're in the mood for pizza and don't want to make one from scratch (or pay a buttload) check this place out, it is almost the same price as a frozen pie, but significantly better!!!!

nashville does venice, CA

hipster vibe with delicious morning - buy one get one - drinks.
6/14/2017 - The Campbell location is CLOSED for renovations. Wish I had know before we drove clear across town. Be nice if they put it on their website, but I guess I expect too much.

Summary: Their special for the night was the best part. Not a great location or space to have a fancy dinner or throw a big party. I would probably go with family or friends again just because it was the first family owned Italian restaurant of the united states, but besides that I do not really find it overall that special. Too pricey. 

Food: 
Appetizers: Escargots Au gratin ($8.50) The escargots were really large for its size, it was tasty but could be because it was literally all butter. I still enjoyed it, but it could be better if it was less buttery.

Entree: Chicken Parmigiana ($17.00) My opinion is it is a bit too pricey for such a common dish. However, it was a bit crunchier than other chicken parm that I have had.  Besides that I did not find it any special and definitely not worth its price. 

Black Lobsters Raviolis ($20.00) This dish was one of their specials for the night, not on their menus.  It was tasty, but a little too salty and buttery.  It comes with jumbo shrimps and capers.  The dish looks small, but very filling.

Place: 
Location: It is within a residential area, about two (or more) blocks away from South St (Main commercial area). I took a cab there and back (cost about $20). Not easy access. Residential area also means hard to find parking.

Environment: The place has tinted windows, so we cannot see from outside.  The moment you walk in you basically see the whole place, very small.  The tables are cramped on top of each other. I went there on a Tues night, and there was a lot of elders, probably not a young hip place. 

Price: I think the overall pricing is too high.  Two people: 1 appetizer, 2 entree and some fountain drinks came out to be around $60 (with tip).

Had no idea the talent was this good! Awesome atmosphere. Plenty of things to do for the kids. Santa even made an appearance tonight.  Tickets are reasonably priced. Beer is a little expensive but still always a good time.
If you like middle eastern food, this is somewhat similar. My favorite was the lamb dish, there baklava was great too! Support their business!

I like My Pie better. This seemed to chaotic and didn't have Pies home made giant meatballs. Didn't give any plates, and no place to throw away your mess. ( one trash by door but it said recycle)? I don't know if it was the red sauce but it was very salty

Ugh, Tom, why why why can't you have a spot in Miami?

Thanks to Yelp I connected with Tom via Facebook and e-mail incredibly quickly. As someone who works in social media and marketing for a restaurant it's always refreshing to meet a business owner who embraces it as a way to connect to new customers.

First off, the beers, wine, and cheeses that I saw all look amazing. I'm sure the shop itself is the adult version of a candy store. You can tell Tom gives a hoot about what he's selling and I loved the craft beer suggestions he made, some being things I never even heard of. 

His professionalism and expertise is a breath of fresh air. Our gift recipients were extremely happy with the lovely basket he put together and delivered. If we're ever in town I'll be sure to visit; in the mean time I'll just longingly stare at their Facebook page and sing praises to those of you lucky enough to check this place out.

Amazing selection of vinegars and oils. Love that they let you sample everything before purchasing. Sales person was very knowledgeable , very friendly. She even shared one of her own recipes for salad dressing. We are hooked and will be back ! Very unique items, also great for gift giving !

I would avoid Big Als at all costs.  You may of had a great experience with them when you ordered and received your product, but watch out if anything goes wrong... They sent me an open box product that was missing parts and instead of offering an exchange did everything they could to pass the blame, first on to me and then on to UPS.  They refused to take care of the situation, luckily the vendor of the product stepped up to the plate and took care of me.

They love taking your money, but don't love taking care of their customers if their is an issue.  They are in it for the quick buck.

I will be sticking with my local fish stores or PetMountain.com from here on out.

5 Stars for overall performance.
I visit Dooney's every week for lunch with my office team.
Food quality is really good, you can feel the quality chicken/meat.
 Servers are friendly, take extra measures to provide great service and are nice to talk to.
We always ask for our fav server and she makes sure that we have extra water, napkins and all minor things which many big restaurants ignore.
Great service, great food !

Only thing I dont like is the chips which come with sandwiches/burgers, although for extra $1 you can get fries. But chips are loaded with oil and are not good to eat. Everything else is great.

I would definitely come back.

It's such a cute place, very quaint.  Beds were comfy, room clean, and staff friendly.  Easy parking and free breakfast.  Missed the wine & cheese hour two nights in a row since we were out getting drunk elsewhere.  This is located right by State Street and by the Neighborhood Bar & Grill where shit got a little ugly...but that's a different story.

Casa Del Mar, my party & I enjoyed you and will recommend to all our friends.

I get a massage from Michele on a monthly basis because she is so wonderful! I've been to other expensive spas in the area and Michele is absolutely the best in her field. She has a soothing and nurturing technique that is very hard to find. I never feel rushed or unimportant. The facility is also very relaxing. The spa is separate from the salon so it's quiet and calming. Go see Michele Park and treat yourself to a fabulous massage!

TL;DR - cheap prices, best biscuit, no thrills

Usually my breakfast spot in the area is Nicki's Omelette and Grill. Big fan of everything they do, but looking into breakfast on yelp, we saw the Ranch House pop up and figured we'd give it a shot. I had driven past it countless times, but as it closes after 2 pm, had never had a chance to go.

As described by others, the decor is out of the 70s. Wood walls, faded leather booths. Feels more like something from a small southern town then Tampa. Crowd was mostly families and elderly.

The menu is large - a lot of staples like different omelettes, pancakes, biscuits and gravy, waffles. Also a lot of named combinations that include all of the above. A lot of options, and at a cheap price.

Girlfriend got a biscuit and gravy, with eggs and bacon. I went with the southern fried steak, biscuit, mashed potatoes and gravy and home fries. Mmm, carbs.

The food was ok. I definitely feel Nicki's food taste better (as well as having better coffee). But the price was hard to beat. You get your money's worth here. But if you're willing to spend a little more, head a bit east.

Also the biscuit was the best I've had in Tampa. Big and buttery, this would be worth coming for.

This was our first time eating here and we were excited because the tag line was "Fresh Mexican". The steak salad was big and very good, as was the quesadilla, the queso burrito was big and was grilled which really set it off. The service was very fast but the restaurant had very few guests.

The biggest downer was the chips were a little on the stale side and with "Fresh" in the name you would have thought they would have had home made chips fresh out of the fryer. They really dropped the ball serving stale chips.
Amazing papusas! Tacos are good to great. Highly recommend. Odd hours so call in advance to ensure their open. Go!!!
Took my pet here without an Appt & she was taken care of. I love the way Lexie was groomed. She's groomed just the way I asked! I can't wait until next time! Thanks

I'm not much of a beer connaisseur but I enjoyed 16 ounces of Guava King with my family. Upstairs there are free games, which entertained my nieces and nephews while the adults had a chance to chat. Great spot for an afternoon with family.

A welcome addition to the growing number of excellent dining options on the east side of the city. This small neighborhood restaurant, located on the southwest corner of Speedway and Camino Seco, offers a limited but carefully selected menu consisting of a selection of appetizers, Asian-style salads, main dishes, noodles, and a variety of sushi and sashimi options. A number of combination plates are available Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. until 5 p.m. I had the salmon teriyaki with the chef's seaweed salad (try it, you'll like it) for $8.95 and it was absolutely delicious. Everything is obviously freshly prepared and the prices are reasonable. Well worth a visit if you live nearby - or even if you have to drive a few miles. Note that you have to enter the small complex housing the restaurant from the south side of Speedway.

Grateful to find this place! Best place to go  for some fiber, veggies, fresh juices, etc. to scrub your insides after some heavy southern meals! I really had to search to find a juice bar in Nashville! And just be careful - there are 2 of these places, and one of them does NOT have fresh juice! Really nice staff.

As far as good service goes, we started at the bar and had good service with a friendly bartender. Shortly after we moved to a table and the experience went sour. We were forgotten and then after finding a manager we were left again to wait for another hour before receiving our food. At this point we were late for the baseball game and wanted to leave. After receiving our food we found the meats overcooked and hardly saw our waitress. If you are looking for a slow place to wait for your food and you have no where to go this would be it. If that is not the case there are plenty of other places with better service and food.

Phenomenal,  I went with my girl and had never really tried the cuisine. She told me to trust her and I'm glad I did. We now go all the time and I try something new each visit  and continue to be impressed. 5 stars all day long

We had a great time. Although most people were interested in gators we were most interested in the landscape and swamp environment. The tour guide was knowledgeable about the swamp ecosystem and told stories. He answered all questions and chatted up the boat passengers. The landscape was beautiful and well worth the trip! And yes, there were plenty of gators and they came right up to the boat.
I happen to like the atmosphere, but I have been three times and I've got to say that the food kinda sucks and the wait staff is weird. Really.

Very prompt service. We are new home owners of this house since mid 2011. We never realized that the system did not work properly until we lost the entire system. The system and fan are like a new system at a fraction of the cost of a new system.
Labor, parts, the drive back to the office, service call to come out added up, but happy we did not get the must replace the system that happened the first days here from a different company that was only called to check the systems for function and filter. Explaining further, first days here in 2011, we were wanting the system serviced and hopefully signing a service contract with a company. Unfortunately the other company wanted to replace everything. When we had complete failure of the air conditioner and heating component two days  ago,  I first looked to the yellow pages. I researched the company that had the biggest add. After googling I found family air had great review. Fantastic service and they provided a military discount. I recommend Family Air.

While staying at the Hotel Monaco for a wedding, we came to the Red Owl Tavern for drinks on both Friday and Saturday night, and brunch on Sunday. The place was packed all three times. It is definitely the after party spot for all the wedding guests staying in block rooms. Given the crowds and the bar otherwise being nothing special, I would avoid as a late night destination except for convenience if you're staying in the hotel. I also had some strange experiences with the servers and bartenders at night. They ran out of clean glasses   and we had to wait for our drinks. Not a problem, except when they finally brought them they did so without the water my friend requested. She asked again and they responded that there were no clean glasses...while making another alcoholic drink in one. They were clearly prioritizing the paid drinks but it was obvious and rude. They also said told us they couldn't communicate with the kitchen and serve food which also seemed odd. 

Brunch was decent. I had a chicken and waffles special that was nicely spiced. Reservations are highly recommended.

Extra yummy real bbq!  Apparently they just moved to a new location on Main St in Safety Harbor. 

I had the pulled pork dinner with a side of collards and a "try" of the cornbread pudding.  The collards were good, extra smoky, but in need of a little salt.  The corn bread pudding was amazing!  It was kinda like a sweeter version of thanksgiving dressing or... maybe exactly as it sounds: bread pudding made with cornbread!  Seriously good shit.

The pulled pork itself had a healthy amount of smoke flavor and a huge pink smoke-ring.  I dipped it into a mixture of their mango and spicy bbq sauces.  The sweet sauce was a little too molassesey for me.  The mango had a perfect sweet tang and the spicy had a bit of a back-of-the-throat burn and the combo was perfect for me.  

The sweet tea was amazing too!  I had about 3 glasses!  

Altogether a great bbq joint!

Food is absolutely amazing, probably the best burger I have had in a long time and the mac and cheese is a MUST.  It is a little bit dark inside but if you're looking for a quick sandwich or burger, this is a great spot.

Ernesto and Martin are the best people you can have handle your table. Ernesto never misses anything and handles everything with the utmost professionalism. Wine bistro would be nothing without him. The food is delicious also, the gluten free pizza is unlike anything else in SB. You would be missing out if you did not come to Montecito Wine Bistro, I promised

Wasn't wowed and a little less than disappoint. Even on a busy day our food wasn't warm. Food is extremely overpriced, a single taco for $5?? Maybe Reno is that starved to call something Mexican food, but I you can hold out (and you really should) then don't come here.

I came during the lavender and honey festival and the lavender mojitos and margaritas were delicious. Maybe the drinks are worth it!

Very spacious and the food appetizers were good. The waited mentioned they had 1/2 off at the time and I liked the fact she suggested that instead of something more expensive. Also had happy hour about the same time. The "monkey brain" was delicious and very generous portions

Close connection to Chipotle and Qdoba but they make the tortillas on the spot and they are delicious :) I had the quesadilla( basic) with veggies(very flavorful) and it was under $6 and husband had the bowl that was served with a yummy tortilla as well. Two hottest salsas were wonderful additions to the meal and we got their chips and queso- blue tortilla chips and the queso was creamy and ALOT compared to other companies. We will return

As my Bellevue sweet spot, Cece's beacons for me near the Bellevue Cinema. I pull slow on the self-serve handle remembering the spew of thick fro yo from last time I was at Sweet Cece's. Swirling the berry and chocolate yogurt into my cup was accomplished, then topped with three of the maraschino cherries and other fresh fruit. Like always I practiced my tongue skills on the stems until tied.

No joke: the best nachos and best wings I have ever had. I will go into detail: 
Atmosphere; super chill. I am from Florida and wanted to find a local spot, not something touristy and cheap. It was very chill. I love the show "Nashville" on abc and I thought I would see Gunner or Scarlet or Deacon walk through at any moment. Besides being ear the cute restored east Nashville homes, it felt casual, comfortable and like I was supposed to be there. 
The nachos were a delicious and ferocious gift to my soul. They were on homemade potato chips, not tortilla chips, and the brisket was melt-in-your-mouth good. The barbecue sauce and cheese and sour cream and everything were so delicious.  
The wings had a flavor that Florida doesn't even know about. They were unique and smoked and hot and welcomed to my appetite! Lastly, the Mac and cheese, it was good and flavorful, but absolutely overshadowed by the nachos and wings. I will be back, with my husband and a smile!

A WORM WAS ON MY PLATE MOVING AROUND. I lost my appetite and politely asked that the restaurant comp my meal and the waiter refused. He said that's typical of organic food to have worms on it. And I reassured him that I grew up on an organic farm and we didn't serve our meals with live worms on it. This was my first time here and I will never go back. I can't believe they made me pay 20 dollars for that dish.

Henry's is a home decor and furniture store on the west end of Jasper Ave. They seem to be carrying a lot of Asian themed hutches and armours right now. They also have a nice selection of higher end chairs, sofas and tables. They also carry home decor items such as mirrors, vases and candles. I like this store, but didn't find anything on this particular visit. The sales clerk told me to check back often as they are always getting new stock in. I did find a potential Christmas present for the moms in my life though. They carry Lampe Berger home perfumes which smell lovely when put in one of their diffusers. My mom used to have one when I was a kid and is always mentioning how hard they are to find, so I am glad to know of a place that carries this line!

Literally the most HORRENDOUS service I have ever experienced in my life. The food is what you pay for. At 9-15 dollars a plate, you aren't going to get anything out of this world. I went there with a few friends for a quick bite, and they screwed up 4 out of 5 orders. Not to mention having to ask for the complementary chips, silverware, and side dishes about 10 times. Also, they brought all of our food out at separate times. The first person got his dish 15 minutes before the second. It was just mind boggling that this place is owned by The Bayou, which is one of my favorite stops in Manayunk. Bottom line is, if your going to spend your money for someone else to make you food, spend it elsewhere.

Love everything about this place! The food is fantastic! The service is wonderful! Me and the family eat here before every home hockey game! If you want a restuarant with healthy integrity filled food! Pizza fusion is the place to go! All the pizzas are great! The Portabello  mushroom sandwhich is YUM! Did I mention! They are vegetarian friendly!

Great place with an eclectic menu that will accommodate various tastebuds . I had the mushroom burger (vegetarian) with tater tots and it was delicious and flavorful! Wait staff is helpful and attentive. Perfect for team lunches during the week.

First time at Sabrina's, I don't believe it was worth all the hype. The breakfast menu wasn't big enough for someone who was a picky eater. Wound up getting a bagel with cream cheese and some bacon, bacon was delicious. My date got the featured stiffen Challah French Toast. When it came out, I was jealous. But he was over it after a couple bites, too much stuffing. Over all experience was good, may be back, may not. Didn't really win me over. Presentation of the food was a 10/10.

Four of us finally were able to get to The Block in the CWE.  The waiter was excellent and did not overwhelm with "is everything alright". The food really was very good. The trout, Amish chicken, special strawberry salad and ice cream deserts were perfect. The wine we have to get the name of it was a pinot from CA not from Oregon I would recommend it. To top it off the bar was full of people and a singer that sang all the songs we love to hear, after that the owner, Mark, took us on a tour of the patio. This is a must see as is and he is still continue to some other improvements. What a place for a summer or fall dinner.
I would highly recommend, and did I mention the menu, it did take a while to decide.
We have been to the Webster location, it truly does not have the atmosphere in or outside nor is the location so central to everything that really goes on in the city. The CWE is the spot to go.

If you're in town I would stop by this place ! It's a cute place for a nice relaxing evening, or mornings . We try the pork rice and it was great, also the strawberry personal pie was amazing , it was fresh and delicious! Definitely will be going back to try it some other stuff !

I recently dined at the prime rib with a group of 16 to celebrate a birthday, during restaurant month. It was great. Although being split up in 2 tables everything was on point. Serine was good, food was great. $35 for prime rib, soup, mashed potatoes & green beans. Although the portions of the sides were small, when we asked they did bring out more. Dessert was great, I'm a big chocolate fan so I throughly enjoyed the chocolate mouse cake. While my fiancé went with the creme brûlée. Deff worth the trip, can't beat it for $35 all month long. Can't wait to go again in a few weeks.
Loved this place 10 years ago when I was in college and love it now that I'm back in town. Pizza and ranch are really good. They did renovations and it looks so much better inside and upstairs.

I called to ask for a quote and received a really aggressive response that they couldn't give me a quote. Even upon describing the services required, how big the place is, etc. he couldn't provide a quote. Then had the gall to ask me to name a price. Basically starting a negotiation, of which I had no idea what he was actually going to clean

The call was disrespectful and unprofessional, that left me little faith that this company could provide quality services. Save yourself some time and don't even bother asking for a quote.

Not happy with price, I've been going there for years an I went in yesterday an he charged me $75 for an oil change, which before service failed to tell me abt price adjustments supposably they have changed since new year..first, sheet w prices on desk are the same an it's already 3 months in, new year..Rip Off, an when ? He said u can save $5 if you book online, a joke!! I will not be going there .....

I come here every Monday for the great karaoke.  The hookah is fairly priced and the drinks are strong.  On non-karaoke nights, I don't have as much fun, but it is still a good place to relax and catch up with friends.  I don't know any other place where I can smoke hookah, drink inexpensively, and sing my heart out.

We had a 'layover' after a wedding b/f the Masso's reception and were hungry so my bf found this wonderful little restaurant via Yelp!   Thanks yet again Yelp!

He got a really good sushi appetizer that was presented very nicely.  It was very fresh and tasty.

I had shrimp pad Thai that was excellent.  Again, very fresh and there were five nice sized shrimp, which wasn't skimpy at all for lunch!

My BFF had shrimp w/ lobster sauce, which she enjoyed alot - this is her 'go to' at Chinese places and she fancied this version alot, even though they forgot to not include peas, which our server apologized twice for.

Vince got a gorgeous, and equally beautiful lunch Bento box.  He liked it alot.  I noticed right away how different his ginger dressing looked.  The best I'd ever seen or tasted (I'm no Japanese food 'pro' though).  I never saw it look that texture b/f.

We decided on green tea ice cream for dessert.  Great choice!  I'm not sure if the huge size was b/c we were new to the restaurant or what but the mug was FILLED to the brim!  Our server brought out three spoons for us to share.  It was really good, creamy and rich :)  

I'm not in this area often but would absolutely go back!!!

I was more than a little hesitant to try Teavana after reading reviews of pushy salespeople. But praise be to Yelp- they must've learned their lesson because I was here two days in a row with two completely different staff and while there was a lot of explaining/demoing there was no pressure. In fact today a wonderful salesperson dissuaded me from buying the overly expensive starter kit and rather get me a tea I liked,  a tin, & tumbler on sale! (Please note this starter setup was HALF the cost of the actual kit)

I was thoroughly impressed with the staff who were able to guess exactly which tea I wanted after I blankly starred at them and said "I dunno I think it's green tea based with fruit..." Even more impressive was the reassurance that you will know if you will like the tea simply by smell, I didn't believe it but totally true.

Cool note: Teavana was purchased by Starbucks last year so those Starbucks gift cards work here and if you have a registered card you can accrue stars here as well!
We had a great stay! This hotel is in the perfect location!!! The room was comfortable. Bring ear plugs; you are still in the city!!!! We will definitely stay here again!!!!

Planning to move from Charlotte to Philadelphia for a job required a lot of planning. I stumbled upon Urban Igloo after hours of trying to filter through apartments online on my own. Urban Igloo is a great service for people trying to navigate a new area on their own when having little knowledge prior to a move.

On the drive up to the Philadelphia area, I set up an appointment to meet Jason. He was extremely flexible with our tight schedule and managed to line up several appointments for next day viewing in various neighborhoods including Manayunk, Old City, Waterfront, and Conchohoken. Even though I had very definite ideas of the amenities and features I wanted, Jason was able to meet all of my requirements and then some. Jason met us punctually and with a great attitude. He was extremely patient and answered all of our questions with ease. 

I would highly recommend using Jason and the Urban Igloo service! Thanks for all of your help!

Superior Grill is one of those restaurants that you need to go to frequently or your bodies goes through margarita withdrawals... those margs are gooooood. Let me rephrase that, everything on their menu is good. To start, they always bring over a hefty serving of chips and salsa. I honestly can't even recommend a specific dish because they are all great, but my personal favorites are the enchiladas. Their queso blanco dip is also incredible and I can eat an entire bowl of it on my own. This place is great for big parties and birthday celebrations too!

My two friends and I went here to get pedicures--what a great experience! Everyone was very friendly and we ended up  doing the deluxe pedicure, which was $10 more and well worth it! We got a sea salt scrub, exfoliating lotion and a long massage! It was a very relaxing hour long pedicure! I have had trouble finding a nail salon in Fishers I like, but I now have my go to!

Easy location, decent rooms (though very warm), tasty breakfast, and the woman in charge of the breakfast was delightful. 

Where they really shone though was when my daughter left her stuffed owl behind. We called and they didn't have it, but said they'd look for it. The day later we got a call that someone had found it in the parking lot and they'd mail it to us. I was dreading the condition of the owl after four days of rain in a parking lot, but when the package arrived they'd obviously washed and dried it before mailing. So sweet.

Mmmm.... HASHBROWNS... (what else can I say?) The food here was really good, it's a tasty breakfast / lunch place. I was impressed with this little cafe, had pancakes that were so buttery and light, but those hashbrowns are killer (garlicy or something). We also ordered a spinach omlette that was really good.
The owners were really nice and even gave me a tasting of the Moscato which was really good. I went at 9 pm and was still able to purchase some wine although they close at 8 pm.

I loved this hotel but I think that was due to a combination of Alan at the front desk (above and beyond customer service!!) and knowing I was finally heading home to Detroit.

This hotel is conveniently located inside the Tampa airport.  I dropped off my rental car downstairs, entered the airport like I was heading to a flight then kept walking to the (not very well marked) hotel entrance.

Yes, the room was dated, but it was very clean.  The Marriott bed was amazing.  A bit of air traffic noise, but... uhm... you're at the airport.

Excellent rate at $109 too (when the Hyatt in Dallas' airport wanted $300 earlier in the week!).

I recently had Mobileye 560 forward collision warning systems installed in multiple vehicles by Finishline. Finishline is one of Mobileye's dealers. I hadn't done business with them before, but I figured I would give them a call first. I'm very glad that I did. Everyone I came into contact with was very friendly, helpful, and professional. I'm very happy with how accurately all the systems were setup. They function perfectly and the installs are all very clean and factory looking. The work was done carefully and it shows. I dealt with Steve (manager), Tony (wheels and tires/my primary phone contact), and Rob (installer). The vibe in the shop is friendly and welcoming.

Just moved to NJ from Oklahoma and our new place needed our carpets cleaned out. I looked on here and found a couple of places that had good reviews but Art actually took the time to explain how they clean our carpets and was able to fit us in before our movers brought in our furniture. The two gentlemen that came by were on time if not a bit early, which I like businesses that are earlier than later. They gave me an estimate time of an hour to finish the job but finished roughly around 40 minutes. The place smelled 10 times better than it did before! The men explained the deodorizer and how it will be strong at first but as it fades it will take any left over odors with it! Highly recommend them!!! Thanks for doing a great job!!
Been taking my Jack Russell here for a couple years. They are so sweet to her and they are more affordable than the big pet store groomers.
Great food...been back 3 times and never disappoints. The Bloody Mary is amazing & awesome atmosphere.

I am writing this from the table... The food was so amazing that I needed to rate it ASAP. If you're here for brunch you have to get the shrimp and grits. Next level. Great service, live Jazz and a Bloody Mary that I wish u had a gallon on. Nice job Murial!

Little late on reviewing this (ok super late, as in probably a year. My apologies. We don't get to Nashville much anymore). 
I love checking out JohnnyT.s reviews on here because he is normally spot on with his ratings. Here is no exception. It was super busy but the line does move quickly. When it was our turn I had one kiddo that wasn't sure still what to get and nobody tried to rush her even though there was all these people. That meant a lot to me. Hubby loves Red velvet so he was a very happy Viejo. We will return.

Place was a bit sketchy from the cheesy ambiance, but the sushi made me understand why people talk about this place.  The fish tasted fresh, and the sauces were flavorful and light. My kinda sushi. BYOB makes for a cheap, delish meal, AND the presentation was over and above! Like a sushi paradise on a plate. Literally.

My wife and I try to eat at the original pancake House at least once a week and I always order the big and wonderful Apple Pancake it's great .Rome the owner has become great friends and Lisa  and Diane and the Chefs who make these wonderful dishes  are the worlds best ! you have to get there early as they get packed early . They have a great reputation 
Steve and Vicki ( Apple Pancake )
They now have the best cherry crepes and then you get an order of sausages links oh to die for get a pitcher of there wonderful tea and your set !!!
Steven and Vicki napier

They rocked it!  Great pie great gelato! Great friendly service.   I like capofitto lots.  This is run like a family restaurant by people who care.  normally I'd doing them for not having gf options but they were so nice im going all 5.
Open early, has what you want. Friendly and knowledgeable staff. The repair shop messed around with a bad wheel I had for an hour and didn't charge me a cent when it couldn't be fixed.

The food here is terrible (old-tasting, not warm at times). Takeout is packaged in leaky styrafoam plates. The prices are average, and there are many places in Lansdale that are better (I prefer Golden Chopsticks) - atmosphere is average at best. Would not recommend.

In a word, disappointing. Comfort food concept well designed but execution did not live up to the hype. Had skirt steak. Small portion for the price and not very tender. Turkey pot pie seemed well received by one of our party but brisket was not a hit. Service was swift at least so we got out quick. Won't be back.

This tiny spot on 10th street is pretty cool and captures the noodle vibe well. Staff, ambience, music and everything else - great.

Black Garlic Wings w/ shishito peppers & herbs - this is how I fantasize wings to taste in my mind and lives up to all the raves. sharp asian spice profile with some lime tang, I have never tasted anything like it. A personal favorite, shishito peppers, are yummy to eat as well. I was a bit confused about if I should or should not eat it, but it tasted fabulous, so why not ?

Fish Ribs -w/ charred corn, tamarind & herbs - The corns were crunchy and fresh. Im a sucker for crispy fish skin however the fish aspect of this particular type of fish was entirely too overwhelming for me personally. So be prepared !

Thin egg noodles w/ egg, matzo balls & chile broth - The quality of the brisket is phenomenal and cooked to perfection. The broth is spicy and well seasoned w/ generous serving of noodles. Who knew a delicious matzo ball could compliment the whole dish so well. Also that matzo ball was no joke. Loved it. However, the spoon that comes with it is a tad awkward to eat out of. They need a different one thats more easier to eat with. 

Hand Torn noodle w/ lamb neck, pickled mustard greens & dates - This was my second favorite dish after the wings. The lamb melts in your mouth and its texture compliments the wide noodles perfectly. Lucious and a mouthfull that is bursting with complex flavors of spice, tang and sesame. The pickled mustard greens cuts the richness of the lamb perfectly. 

They also have a good list of beer and limited, but nice liquor list.

Read the fine print.  I recently got an email for $3 off a dream cake.  I drove 20 minutes during my lunch hour to get one.  This offer coincided with the start to school & for fun I thought we'd celebrate that evening.  I was bummed that when I got there the coupon wasn't valid because you have to print it out.  I felt like it was a gimmick to get you in, but who reads the fine print?  Showing them on the phone isn't an option even though the ad had no distinguishing numbers.  I won't be suck in again!

The Spring Hill area has almost not store that carry micro-brews. After leaving Cigar City Brewing, we noticed this Total Wine & More and stopped in with renewed hope of finding good beer for New Years.

Given the selection and fair prices, we were not disappointed. The prices here are even comparable if not cheaper for Cigar City Brewing 6-packs than the brewery itself! Think we ended up purchasing close to 100$ between microbrewed beer and South African (Pinotage) wine.

Highly recommended for microbrewed beer!

An absolute must try. Fresh, delicious, vegetarian cuisine. I'm not veg and neither is my boyfriend but we both thoroughly enjoy the food at blue sage. Creative, tasty and plentiful. You won't be disappointed.

We booked this place thinking we would be bringing our dog along with us (yes, they are dog friendly). However, we were able to have my in laws watch them which allowed for us to have some time to ourselves. We were able to book the room the night before for a room with a queen bed for $149 (not including taxes). This is a very cute space and I loved that it was super cute with the Spanish style decor. They have covered parking that is first come first serve, otherwise you have to look for street parking. The location is only a block from the beach and about 0.5 miles from downtown Santa Barbara which is great for walking! They also have a daily "social" hour from 5 to 7 pm where they have wine, cheese, grapes, and crackers. In the morning, they provide breakfast which includes cereal, croissants, bagels, yogurt, and fruit. The rooms are on the smaller side and the bathroom is tiny as well, but it does the trick for a place that you can stay in and lounge around in. They have a beautiful courtyard that can also be enjoyed if you so wish. Checking in/checking out was very simple. The room keys were actual keys. Overall, I liked the experience and we have already suggested this place to our friends and family and we are sure to be back and stay here whenever we are visiting.

We showed up for our reservation and were shoved off into a back corner somewhere. It was not crowded and yet the staff seemed to forget about us and weren't being attentive. I ordered the filet mignon and boyfriend had the prime rib. Steak was dry and over cooked. They rushed us out because they were getting ready to close but if you didn't ignore us for the first 20 minutes we were there, we would've ordered our food much sooner, allowing you to close up reasonably on time.

I like to come here sometimes since its very close to my work location. Their lunch combo is very good. You get a drink, a sandwich and side of potato salad/chips/apple. I always get the potato salad because it's so good. I am a vegetarian so I don't have a lot of options but I do like their "veg out" sandwich its very healthy and not too many calories. I always get it on a whole wheat bread. They also have a drive thru even tho its not the best drive thru in the world but it is convenient when you wanna grab something quick on your way.

Others have said what I experienced that morning with some friends so I'll keep this brief. We actually ran a half mile to the park on the other side of the freeway to use toilets there before the race. When we returned, the line for the port-potties had moved about 20 feet. 6 to 8 toilets at the start of a race is way short of what's was needed. As a previous post mentioned, because it was not made clear, when the whistle blew, ALL runners looked at the R.D. He blew it again and then yelled, "Go! Run!". Seems like the R.D. may be a nice guy, but in way over his head. Still no results or photos and the race was on the 20th of July. We are disappointed because it could really be a very nice race.

The service was great - everyone was friendly & welcoming! I was seated very quickly. I just flew in from NC, and since this was my first visit - wanted to try the local fare. The seafood omelet with grits OMG-I was FLOORED! I'll be back again!

It had been a while since I had been to the dentist. After visiting two dentists prior to Smile Culture, I was frustrated and feeling deceived. Although I wasn't doing my 6 month check ups, I take good care of my teeth. So to say it was a shock to see 4 digit dental bills would be an understatement. 

I am from the Washington DC area, and had a trip planned up to Philadelphia to visit one of my good friends from college. He is a dental student at UPenn, so naturally I confided in him about the troubles I was having. Without hesitation, he recommended that I visit Smile Culture the weekend I was to visit to get a third opinion. Still skeptical, I agreed to have another consultation. As the saying goes, the third time is the charm!

Dr. Harshil Boghara was extremely personable and professional. He took the time to explain some of the issues I was having, and gave his recommendation. It turns that the previous two dentists had over diagnosed me. Shocker! Without knowing that I'd ever be back in his office, he offered his long term treatment plan that would keep the most money in my pocket and avoid multiple painful surgeries. I was so pleased that I had finally found a dentist that seemed like they weren't trying to sell me the most expensive plan but really had my best interest at heart. 

Needless to say, I have found my new dentist! My friend plans to stay in the area after he graduates, so it gives me a good excuse to come up every 6 months. It's worth it when you get the type of service that I received! From the time I walked in the door the ladies at the front desk made me feel comfortable and the waiting room was nothing short of proper! I was so relieved to have finally found a dentist that makes it a point to never over treat their customers. Thank you Smile Culture! I will see you again soon!

About a week ago we went to Katie's for our second visit with some close friends. We had wanted to sit outside like we did on our first visit but it had rained and the patio was shut down. 

So we sat inside. The interior of the restaurant is well laid out and tastefully done. We were there relatively early (5:30), and the restaurant was about half full. Initially the noise level was fine, slightly loud but manageable. However, as the restaurant filled up it soon became impossible to have a conversation at a normal level. I'm sure they can make some modifications to the interior to help manage the ambient sound.

The food was very good. We tried the meatball pizza which didn't disappoint.

Hopefully Katie's will address the sound in the interior or we'll only come back in patio season.

Some local friends told us about this spot which is an alternative to the touristy cheesesteak spots around South St.  Found out they used to be called "Chink's" (can see why they had to change that.)  good food, good service, limited menu and like the fact that the interior didn't change too much.  Recommend if you happen to be in the area.

Hitting the Town? Start with something at Bridgestone Arena if an event is happening like hockey. This arena is actually really nice with a lot of great restaurants and drink choices inside at reasonable stadium prices. There is actually a bar called the Patron Platinum Club that is open to the public but, a lot of people don't realize it is accessible for everyone. What I really like about this arena is that it is literally next door to all the action on Broadway and is perfect for drunkenly stumbling starting your night on the town. Plus if you are going to a hockey game the Predators are actually pretty decent and puck bunnies are always hot.

I really want to give Taj India a break because I really appreciate them for being there. Northeast Philly is desperate for decent Indian food, and Taj is definitely decent Indian food. Decent. Sometimes great, sometimes kind of lacking, but almost always decent. However as far as Indian food goes I've had much better for the same or similar price within 20-30 minute driving distance. 

I never eat in the place, it's a little depressing looking and often with weird music playing...but it's clean...I just prefer home in this case.

Oh, they also have a wide array of Indian desserts but I think they  might be too authentic for most Americans' taste...not sure...I'm not into trying random sweets but that's what I've heard.

Stuff I love about Taj: they make dosas! but also do a good job at north Indian dishes like Channa Masala, fairly cheap, call in your order and pick it up! The food reheats fairly well in a warm oven or a quick dump into a pot on the stove. Viola! Like new! Oh and its all vegetarian! 

Stuff I don't love: I have to ask 5 times to get enough mint chutney, the sambhar is a little salty at times, some of the curries aren't that good (don't do the black dahl! go for channa masala. Also the naans are really good as are a lot of the appetizers, including the samosas. 

All in all, it's a great find for the area, but it's sometimes hit or miss on some of the dishes. However the naan, samosas, and channa masala have been consistantly good.

Got my hair cut by Stephanie tonight, I am SUPER picky when it comes to my hair and Steph NAILED it!!!!! I highly recommend her!!!!! She's a super star!!!! Also VERY reasonable prices and they do everything

Great bar and good happy hour.   Drinks are very generous...wine pours are 6 oz and prices are fair.   The food is good...not great.   For my tastes some of the dishes have too much sauce, but that can always be ordered on the side.  

 On Thursday they have a seafood buffet for $22.00 that is a bargain.   The seafood is very fresh and the place is busy.  

The Sunday brunch is good.   Plenty for the money...when you figure most chains get $10-11 for a few eggs with meat.   Luna Bella you get an omelette prepared the way you want it...smoked salmon, seafood, roast beef, desserts....and a couple extra pounds if your not careful.

What!? A Starbucks across from CC's?  And they are open till 9pm when CC's closes at 5? Interesting choice to make! The interior is beautiful and it seems there is an entrance from outside and also the lobby of the main building.  Great views of Poydras from the window and it looks like there is lots of seating.
Great place to go on a date or just hang out with friends. Loved their old booth with the soap opera radio player. Had my first root beer float here and recommend it if you haven't tried yet.
We had a group in for my Birthday. Service & Selection was amazing. For being a wood fired grill, they sure can't figure out a medium temp.

The Barbary is HANDS DOWN the best place to go for super cheap drinks, a well known "City-Wide" consisting of a PBR can & shot of whiskey for $5, and a fun night of sweaty dancing and meeting tons of cool "Hipstery" people.  Its just a bunch of kids into alternative fashion, books, movies, and art.  Do not be discouraged, strike up a conversation!  There is a different party happening every night.  Check the online calender and pick a night of your choice! 

Every time I am at this bar, whether alone or with friends, I leave a happy girl.  
I always leave big tips, you should too!

PS The upstairs bathroom is always less crowded.

HouseMaster Home Inspections is by far the most outstanding inspection company I have ever dealt with.  I knew I was in expert hands after taking to Michelle Craft on the phone.  Randall Watts was the inspector, and he was as good as it gets.  Professional, friendly, reliable, detail-oriented, and my list goes on.  My highest praise to HouseMaster Home Inspections, and anyone who knows me, knows I am a perfectionist!

Great breakfast! Reasonable priced. Latte was delish. French toast on brioche was superb. Great benedicts. Homemade biscuits served with almost everything.  Typical slow southern service. We had a group of 6, spent $85.

Amazing Discoveries ("Amazing Disco" to its friends) is a great game store. They've embraced the idea that a local store can't compete with Amazon and online retailers on price, but instead must become the center of a community. They have a large and generally comfortable play area (a few chairs are in bad condition, but that's to be expected with the volume of people they host) and they host events frequently for card games, miniatures games, and other games. The staff are friendly and approachable - they have different areas of expertise, so the person you find may not always be able to answer your question, but they'll definitely know who on the staff to ask. 

The big draw here is their events. They publish a reliable calendar of events on their website, so it's very easy to answer the question that always comes up with games - "how do I find someone to play with?" Also making events better are the wall murals, the display of prints by a local fantasy artist, and the availability of water, soft drinks, and snacks. Some of their infrastructure could use a little investment - those chairs again! - but it's almost always easy to find a place to play whatever you've come to play. 

Amazing Disco is a great example of the Friendly Local Game Store and I'm glad it's here.

As we walked up to the hotel we were greeted by friendly staff.   We are checked in quickly find more friendly staff. Up on checking into our room we found it to be quaint but to our liking. The price the service the ambience the courtyard the location all make this the prime spot  for a nice peaceful exciting and enjoyable weekend in new orleans.

Prices are higher than other locations  ps cash only Luv the freshness  and the rest of the staff is great but The attitude of one of the workers today was down right ugly i have been before i didn't catch  her name but she had blk short hair and a tattoo on the back of her neck but when i tell you with an attitude like that she needs to stay home

I'm so excited that I don't have to drive into Philly to eat at Sabrina's. The food and servers were great. I think they have gotten better than Green Eggs. The food is always consistent. They picked a great location along many other shopping areas.

I had really high hopes for this place, but it was incredibly disappointing.

The staff members were rude, unresponsive, and incredibly lacking in knowledge as to what was in any of the menu items. I asked "what makes this sushi not-vegan?" and the employee replied "The soy sauce." Guys, soy sauce is vegan.

I don't understand the concept of this place. Yes, all "vegetarian" is nice- but what, then, is the purpose of labeling a few, and only a few, items as vegetarian? Isn't that obvious? As a vegan, however, things were very confusing. Only a few items were labeled vegan, and of those that weren't, I couldn't see anything apparent in the ingredients that would make it non vegan, but yet they were either unlabeled or labeled as "vegetarian".

I literally asked why they bother to label ANYTHING as vegetarian and the employee said "the bread is vegetarian." Oh good, I can eat bread without worrying about getting bacon stuck in my teeth.

Never going back unless they clean up their act and get serious and legitimate with vegan options.

Really good food and friendly, helpful servers. The etouffee loaded fries were really great. I had the pot roast Po-boy and it was delicious! The only thing that wasn't great was the kid's burger. My son didn't really like it, but they are known for they're Po-boys so stick with those.
I've been going to Burns Auto for years. Great staff and very honest. You can get anything from oil changes to brakes and tires.

They put me in a pedicure chair and I sat there for 45 minutes in cold water while they kept starting in other customers. I finally got up and said forget it and they were like "oh you are next" but didn't seem to care I had already been sitting there for almost an hour.
Amazing birthday cakes!! Everything else we've ever tried is delicious too. Prices are VERY reasonable and the staff is great too!!

I was introduced to Dirty Franks just a couple days ago. I freaking love it!

It's a laid-back, tiny, unpretentious dive bar. The mid-western girl in me was absolutely delighted. I will be back for frequent visits, and I will bring all my unclassy, beer-chugging friends.

NOTE: this place is cash only. So make sure you bring those bills!

Oh, my Michelob and 2 shots of Jameson was $12. Yes, I'm in love.
