Good Karma also has an outdoor oasis in the back which it seems not many know about. Wouldn't say this is the place for coffee connoisseurs because I don't think they roast or brew their own coffee. However drinks are solidly delicious and unique. And ambiance is very chill.
The food was good but wow.....it took an hr to bring it out. Then they kept getting the orders wrong.

Right in the French Quarter,  only a few blocks away from Bourbon Street, Mr. B's is top notch!  We tried the BBQ shrimp here that everyone's raving about. 

The raving is well warranted. The shrimp was served with the heads on tails in tact, which doesn't bother me at all.  It comes out steaming hot, all sauced up and impressively arranged on the plate.  

The sauce is made with Cajun seasonings, butter, salt, butter, pepper, butter, and herbs, and butter.  The 6 rather impressive size shrimps are giant and bbq'ed perfectly. I find myself sucking on the shrimp before peeling it. Once it's peeled, I dip it into the sauce and savor every tasty morsel. 

This is on our regular rotation of food stops when visiting NOLA.  My husband and I shared this amazing dish not knowing what to expect, but now I know, he'll be getting his own next time.
Great food great pIzza. Ask for Jaimee She's the best.  This place is a must for pizza lovers

Hole-in-the wall lovers who prefer specialized foods, this is the place for you.  Mood Cafe only offers lassis and chaat, but are darn good at the two things they offer. I had never tried chaat before but loved the combination of flavors, colors, and items in my mysterious dish. The lassi sizes are generous, and not that sweet. The owner was also super friendly which was a nice cherry on top.

Chaats at $8 and Lassis at $4 are not cheap, but the place is definitely good at what they do. What a place to treat myself once in a while!
Best pizza in Florida hands down. Reminds me of New York pizza. So cheesy. So delicious! I always go back. Their sandwiches are amazing too!

I would consider myself a frozen yogurt connoisseur.  I travel around the country for work and usually love to treat myself to fro-yo on the road.  I'd say Tuiti Fruitti is up there!  (Although this location does not have as many flavors or toppings as some of the Georgia stores)  The owner is incredibly sweet and seems committed to having a great family business on Delmar.  She's always in the store--usually with her kids-- with a smile on her face.  They have the biggest variety of fro-yo flavors and toppings in town. Think: Nutella, white chocolate, cheesecake, soy taro, etc. etc.  They swap their flavors monthly so there is always something new to try! I follow them on Facebook and occasionally they will run specials or give you an online coupon.
Very enjoyable. The service was efficient. The sandwiches and salads and soup were very good. The desserts were awesome.

Great selection most of the time! 

Nothing is ever grouped by size, so you have to do a little digging usually. I've had some great luck finding things that still have their tags on them for less than $5. I can get lots of items on a single trip and easily fill up the shopper card so that I get 50% on my next purchase! 

Store has carts, baskets, and easy parking. Go during the weekdays, it will be less crowded inside the small store!
Love this place - kids had a blast. Mexican next door is AWSOME and walk to jump on trolley to pier

Well isn't this the cutest hole in the wall. I only say that because of the size of the place....nothing disappointed. I had made a reservation for this place after the escape room for my fiancé's birthday. Never been here before but knowing my fiancé's taste in decor and my appreciation for food I selected this place. His parents were from out of town, and they aren't "city folk". We were sat by a young lady, assuming the bartender and quickly greeted by our friendly and amazing(which we will get to later) server Nilda. My fiancé's mom orders soda, her husband a mich ultra (see told ya), myself an old fashioned with my favorite Angels Envy, which you don't see in any restaurant, and my fiancé (the birthday boy) some knob creek old fashioned with a Chambord float (of course he has to be difficult). We order appetizers so everybody can decide what they want, I saw octopus on the menu online so I needed no time with the menu. 
We start with fondue, fried meatballs, tuna tartare. Our drinks arrived quickly and everybody enjoyed their beverages, including my father in law to be's much ultra and my fiancé's obnoxious drink. Mine was superb. Appetizers arrived and we devoured everything. The in laws who don't do raw seafood loved the tartare! And the fondue was superb as well. 
For dinner I (as we already established) got octopus, my fiancé lobster Mac, his father the pasta special with spaghetti, Alfredo, and spicy sausage, and for the mother; the most beautiful chicken pot pie I have ever seen in my life! We each tried everything and nothing was a disappointment. Glad to see this place could do art and comfort food. 
It was dessert time and I couldn't decide which one I wanted. Mom ordered cookie dough. Wait let me go back. They bring the desserts out on a tray. Like I've been to places that do this and usually it's easy to decide. Uhm not this time! At all. No way. My fiancé opted for the chocolate banana cake, I was torn so a warm cookie with a brownie piece in middle, and a chocolate pot de creme. I just can't. I was dead. They brought my fiancé's out with a candle and a birthday wish on the plate! How sweet! We didn't ask for that or anything. Nice touch.
Both the bartender who has now changed to a male I believe to be frank not only helped run our food and desserts but he also bussed our table and he wasn't even our server, know second old fashioned was even better, according to our server said he drinks them all the time and I could tell cuz yeah killer. Who now we will get to Nilda.
Our experience was sealed by her. She was fantastic. Friendly. Precise. She even had my fiancé's dessert comped for his birthday. Another win for Nilda!  while my fiancé and I live about an hour away and his parents triple that him and I will have to make a trip here just for this place again. We both agreed that this is the spot we could sit and veg and chat for hours. 
Thank you for an amazing time!!
I too am in the restaurant business and I  must say I'm jealous I don't work here. If y'all hiring give me a holler! Otherwise see you again for more libations and good food!

So you have probably been at the clubs all night. Maybe you already puked in a trash can on the shitty kitty dance floor. This is where you go to get pizza afterwards to fill the void in your stomach and in your life. Best part, the staff is awesome!

I came here for their happy hour. I've always heard great things about Maynards, so its definitely a place I would love to try for dinner next time. I got a cocktail called the heritage. It was mixed perfectly. The bartender got some skills. He was a great server as well. Even though he had to walk all the way around the bar to help us, he did it as often as he need to make sure we were take care of. The bar burger was huge!....Unbelievably! You'd think for a bar burger it would be much smaller but I'm sure it was their regular size dinner burger. Chargrilled meat cooked perfectly, squeeze in between tomatoes lettuce and chargrilled bun... yum! The only surprising thing is there was bleu cheese that the boyfriend overread, we dont like bleu cheese so we just scraped it off. Otherwise it was good and we cant wait to try the pizettes and dinner.

I love it here. They have cool flavors I'm always tempted to try and a ton of toppings. I'm a fan of the grapefruit frozen yogurt, it's tart and refreshing on a warm day, plus it pairs well with both sweet and tart toppings. I also like that you can choose how much you want (I like getting one cup to share). I only wish they had more sitting space inside. Sometimes I abstain from going in because all the tables are taken.

My friend and I came here wanting to explore a new coffee shop. We were pleasantly surprised. The cafe was busy with almpat no seats available. We were able to snag a couple of seats while we waited for our Maple Lattes. The coffee was great. It wasn't too sweet and the granola was awesome! I will say that the parking is ok. It's defintely easier than Tampa, but can be hard to find on the weekend. There is also street parking that doesn't require you to parallel park .
Local who has visited this place 4 times and EVERYTIME it is absolutely amazing. From the service to the food, never been disappointed. Love it! Nothing on the menu disappoints.

There's a full house tonight, ever seat is taken and we still had our food out within 5-10 minutes. Our waitress was very funny and friendly. This is one of my favorite locations to go to. Food is always great here also.

I love stopping by Street Tacos before and after shows at the Fox Theater. The meats are too yummy, all of them. I like that you get your choice of corn or flour tortillas. It does get busy but that's because it's so good.

Very good brunch! The cinnamon pancakes were delish and huge. The lobster benny was slightly over cooked and under seasoned. However, I was pleased with my first experience at Nudys. I would def recommend if you are in the area and want some good brunch. The inside of th restaurant is pretty cool too, upscale diner vibes.
I had their lunch buffet...good food and nice ambience.

We have been to Reno a number of times and stayed in various hotels. The Peppermill is by far the best. Their customer service is outstanding. We had a "chirping" smoke detector and it was fixed within 5 minutes. Our food has been fantastic (Oceano & Biscotti's). Our waiters have been very polite and attentive to our every need (our complicated order was completely memorized and came back perfect). We spent the afternoon in the beautiful spa area...the robes were so luxurious and again the STAFF was superb. We found the nice non-smoking area for playing the machines. We even got adjoining rooms with the excellent chech-in attendant.

We were shocked to see the cheapest entree was 19 dollars because we looked at the menu beforehand and saw several options on the bar menu. We asked if we could order off that menu after sitting down and we were told it was "against the rules." The food was ok and the portions were very small. The bar was full and the tables had ample seating. As we were leaving the hostess with braids asked us sarcastically if "we had good food despite not being able to order a burger."  The whole experience rubbed me the wrong way. A bit too pretentious for a restaurant that has been open all of 1 month. If you get reservations and are craving a burger go ahead and cancel them and walk to the bar. Or go to any of the other exceptional options available in the area.
Yep 5 stars much smarter people have written way better reviews read those but it deserves 5 stars.  Adrienne rocks made the visit a 5 star one.

This review pertains only to Saigon market, I will save the Restaurant for another review.

This is probably my least favorite Asian Market in town and probably Asian for that matter.  But they have two benefits that earn a visit from me every now and then.  

Even though they have a very limited fresh meat selection but it is definitely the best out of all the Asian market.  You won't find rib eyes or filet mignon here, but more rustic cut such as pork belly, pork shoulder, beef shank, beef loin, and innards.  The second benefit is the one male worker, i think he's the butcher, stocking boy, and cleaner.  He's pretty fast when it comes to helping you with the meat.  If i needed him to cut the meat and bones a certain way, he'll be on it.  His English isn't very good but I think he can make out keyword and can help you find what you are looking for. 

Their vegetable selection is limited and caters to Asian cooking.  Out of all the Asian market on Lafayette Road, Saigon has the worst vegetables!   They always look like they are dead or near dead.   The herbs in the refrigerated section is not too bad though and usually pretty fresh.  If you are wanting to buy vegetables though, I say skip Saigon and go to Saraga or Oriental market. 

Saigon has a similar selection of dried goods and frozen items like Van's Fish Market.   Check expiration dates especially on canned goods and I would be careful of frozen items as well.  I always make sure I do a thorough examination.  

Saigon also sells freshly made bake goods and exotic fruits, and you can find them scatter up by the register.  The owner usually stands behind the register, she usually doesn't say anything to any of the shopper unless she knows them.  I wish she would be more cheery because it kinda ruins my shopping mood because I enjoy grocery shopping.  Overall, Saigon would be a MEH experience but the fresh meat selection earns this place another star.
Whenever I don't feel well, their chicken and rice soup is something I can eat.  It's even better on day 2 when the soup has become a chicken-soaked rice dish.  Yum!

A good second place when you are looking for a typical breakfast place downtown.  A little bit pricey, but the quality is good and sometimes great!  Today I had a Mexi Moon without cheese along with a gluten-free pancake (which tasted the same as buttermilk, so good unless I didn't get my gluten-free, can't be sure, it was delicious).  That omelet was so delicious I'll be back several more times to have it again.  Very mouthwatering savory goodness.

This is THE best Thai food in Nashville, hands down.  Clean as a pin, pleasant atmosphere and the people who work there, from chefs to wait staff, are top notch and understand the intricacies of real Thai food. The ingredients the chefs use are top of the line so you don't have that nasty, bogged down feeling you get when after eating Thai food of less quality.  The Smiling Elephant is a Nashville, 5 Star treasure.  Try it, you'll love it.

I had a great experience taking my car here. They were able to help me immediately and treated me with respect. I was strained for time and they were able to meet my needs. When they found the problem they recommended me to get it fixed for free under warranty and only charged a small diagnostics fee. I would take my vehicle back here again without a doubt.

Ate here on a Sunday afternoon. I love sushi, but arrived with traditional fried seafood in mind, so stuck with that part of the menu. Batter'd & Fried did not disappoint! Had the fried cod, coconut shrimp (which was served with a divine sweet sauce), fries, and coleslaw. The coleslaw was a little too creamy for my taste, but overall, everything was spot on. Oh, and my dining partner ordered the clam chowder - we both thought it was the best we've ever had in Nashville!

I heard about SoFresh from a few people to I decided to give it a try for lunch one day.  I ordered the SoFresh Signature Salad and added chicken.  It consisted of a spring mix with goat cheese, avocado, grape tomatoes, cucumbers, onions, shredded carrots, raisins, pistachios, fresh herb vinaigrette.  The chicken was freshly grilled and all of the flavors of the salad meshed very well together, I actually didn't even use the dressing. The portion was perfect and rather large, I was definitely full after eating the entire salad. I like how the menu offers salads, bowls and wraps that way there is something for everyone. The food came out quickly and the service was great! I will definitely be returning!

This is for the hairstylist Carla who has her own station here. She is a wonderful hairstylists and puts in my extensions for me once a month. She's a sweet woman and very good at her job. Personable and I've grown to love her very much! I dont really pay much attention to the people around her who work there because they have no affiliation with me or my hair.

I will say though, this one lady who used to work as a nail tech was pretty loud and fairly "opinionated" on the many topics of conversation. 

However, if you ever need your hair done in anyway, Carla is the one to go to here! She's so sweet!

I always land here at some point during my monthly visit to NOLA. It's the charm and intimacy that always draws me in, as well as, terrific local jazz talent. 

The downside, and there's always a downside, is the lack of seating but expected for such a small venue. My other beef is the complete lack of table service from the bar staff. They seem relegated to manning the bar from behind the bar.  Maybe that's their deal, I don't know but it can be annoying when you have to fight your way to the counter for every drink. I did that at college bars years ago and I'm past that. 

Otherwise, great locale.

It's cray cray why there are so many bad reviews on here.

Cappy's makes excellent pizza & salad.
Their deep dish rivals Lou Malnati's Pizza in Chicago.

Why Cappy's is Awesome...
~ The deep dish pizzas have excellent flavor. The crust is crispy & each layer has its own distinctive flavor. The regular pizza is delicious too.
~ The atmosphere is fun. The menus are on old record covers. There is a toy train that makes it rounds around the restaurant. They have Trivial Pursuit cards on every table to make you feel stupid while you wait for your pizza. The tables have various 1980s toys & memorabilia inside them. I love going there & sitting somewhere new each time.

Where Cappy's can Improve...
~ They do not accept credit cards. Going to Cappy's is like being sucked into a time warp to the 1980s. The decor & table are fun & make Cappy's great, but it is annoying to have to pull cash out of an ATM every time I go.

Don't listen to any haters on Yelp that give this place a bad review.
If we were in the 1980s classic The Karate Kid -- 
The haters on Yelp would be like Cobra Kai showing Cappy's No Mercy.

The Trivial Pursuit cards would be like Mr. Miyagi because they help you learn.

The pizza would be like Ralph Macchio because it will deliver a karate kick to your taste buds.

_______________________________________________________________

I recommend you get a group of friends together, watch an 80s movie (I suggest Howard the Duck, Adventures in Babysitting, or The Breakfast Club), head to Cappy's for a delicious dinner, & then finish your evening at The Independent (which is right next door) to enjoy an expertly crafted beer.

If you take my advice, I guarantee you will have an awesome evening.

So. Good. I had a salted caramel donut and a cinnamon roll donut. Told myself I'd only eat half of each one, and couldn't wait to eat the rest the same afternoon. I took the food and coffee to go, and they packed everything up to make it super easy to carry. Great location/ambience too. Next time we are in NOLA, we will make a point to go back.

This was my first time at an Indian restaurant and the food was delicious! Everything I tried, I loved. And the wait staff/management was *super* friendly and helpful with choosing the different foods I should try. We don't live in the area and I hate that we won't be able to come back often, because we totally would!!

This place was recommended to us by a friend and oh my gosh was it terrible. First off when you come to a BBQ place your hoping to have a variety of BBQ items to choose from, not here. And to add insult to injury are their sides! Horrible!!! It was kinda expensive for the nothing you get. I got a brisket sandwich that I couldn't finish. It tasted absolutely disgusting, even smothered in their sauce. The staff was really friendly on a positive note.

The customer service manager contacted me and we discussed the charges during the plumbers visit. After explaining that I showed the plumber where the leak was I got reimbursed for the leak search charges.
I give it one more star since the work was done professionally but also that they care about they customer and listen to their complains. Thanks to social media like Yelp you can make your voice heard.

The reason I kept coming back to place in the beginning was simply because it is so bright (my old place felt like a dungeon). Aside from the inviting atmosphere, I quickly learned the service here is superb.. I will never go anywhere else. Tracy and Ling are my go-to for nails. I cannot recommend this place enough, none of them have ever tried to up sell me either which is a huge plus for a nail salon!

My friends and I purchased VIP tickets for a performance at 9 pm.  With these tickets we didn't really have to wait in line as we had reserved seating up front (WAY up front).  Otherwise, seating is FCFS with pillows and a couple of rows of chairs.  Everyone else must stand, which isn't bad given that the room is quite small so it's easy to see what's going on.

This is a no frills set up to allow for enjoyment of the music where attention is focused on the musicians and their performances.  There is no food or drink served and no restrooms. The do have a small gift shop set up to allow purchase of their CD's.

I had seen the Preservation Hall Jazz Band during the SF Jazz festival years ago and was looking forward to taking in a performance here.  Their set that night consisted of some New Orleans favorites and allowed for each musician to showcase his/her talents.  The performance lasted around 45 minutes.  It  was hard to find one person not enjoying themselves!

Well worth the time to stop by and check out the music here.  Reservations are a must.

I used to belong to a Hand and Stone in Morristown. I ended up abruptly moving to NYC and needing a new phone number and assumed my membership cancelled when I never received an email from the spa. I called the Marlton location while in town on business and asked if those credits would transfer, to which they told me yes. I booked a facial and a massage a week in advance. I left both my phone number and email and when I received a confirmation email about the appointment I assumed all must have been well. I arrived early to my appointment to ensure that my credits were still okay to be used. The receptionist said she had to call Morristown, but did not stop me from going into either my facial OR massage. 

The esthetician, Karen, was incredibly friendly and had a gentle touch. I wish she had done more extractions and really gone to work on my face. I appreciate the gentle-ness, but there's always a painful time during facials that you just have to grin and bear for better results, and I was hoping for more of that. Otherwise, I thought Karen was lovely. I was dismayed that between my facial and my massage there weren't any robes to transfer between rooms, so I got dressed and waited for about ten minutes while Karen tried to find my massage therapist, and then while she turned the room over until he came to get me. 

My massage therapist asked about my concerns and then left  me to change. By the time we started the massage it was already about 2:15. He was good about asking me how the pressure was, but I felt like I've gotten better massages from an airport chair massage. He used a lot of forearm, and little else technique wise. The massage was not thorough in the slightest. No scalp massage, no middle back, parts of my arms and legs were barely covered. I've had enough fifty minute massages to know that this was lacking. The massage ended at 2:50, not even close to fifty minutes (nor sixty if you're counting the ten minute changing time). After I got dressed my massage therapist was outside with a bottle of water, but he did not walk me out the door. He said goodbye in the hallway and I was left wandering in circles (ended up in an employee break room!) before finding my way out front. 

When I went to check out I held my tongue on the massage because I figured I had paid for it a while ago, I would suck it up and chalk it up to a bad but free (minus tip) experience. I was then told by the receptionist that she had yet to get in touch with Morristown regarding my credits. I had a bad feeling about this. When she got ahold of them they told her the only way to access my credits was to have me sign up again. There is no hand and stone in or around New York City (where I live). I was NOT prepared to pay for two services, I would have never made the appointments, and I certainly would have cancelled them had I known the circumstances. I asked why this was not checked ahead of time,or even during my first appointment before I went into a SECOND appointment, and I didn't think it was fair what was happening. A manager was brought over who said she would take care of things and would give me a call before running my credit card (I wanted to leave my tip on it). I assumed she would call me to work out some sort of price. Which is when I would have addressed the poor massage situation. 

I checked my credit card today and they ran my credit card after the appointment without my permission. I am beyond furious and refuse to ever return to this location, and plan on telling everybody I know in the area to avoid it as well. This was an unacceptable situation and I hope that anybody reading this knows to make 100% sure their services are covered before going in.

Ordered 2 pizzas for pick up.  I repeated the order 3 times; one cheese pizza and one pizza half pepperoni and half sausage. The pizza was cold, soggy, salty and I got one cheese and one pizza that was 1/2 cheese and half pepperoni sausage mixed.  I called and was told if I paid by credit card the price would be reduced. I paid cash. I had 5 kids waiting for dinner, it was raining and said I couldn't get back. The person I was talking to said "ok" and hung up.I can't say I will return.

I had the huevos rancheros. The only thing they actually cooked on this dish were the eggs. They microwaved the tortilla which made it chewy and inedible. They took some flavorless black beans from a can, poured them in a bowl, topped them with cheese and microwaved that too, yuck. I only had a couple of bites and didn't finish my food.

This place is fantastic. I haven't had my nails done in over a year and was looking for a new place. I came here after checking yelp reviews and I was not disappointed. I love that they have pearl white tips and the precision was somewhat of an art form. I officially found my nail home and suggest to anyone to give this place a try.

YOU CAN GET BEER TO GO AND WALK AROUND OUTSIDE WITH IT.

I guess because I'm young and was by myself they didn't ask if I wanted to start a tab. They charged me per beer. No checks, just "Can I have (insert beer)?" (...) "5 bucks." I imagine if you have more people or look like you're going to get smashed they'll start a tab and give you a check. It worked for me. I only wanted to try a few.

They have some neat shirts and whatnot.

The best beer I had was Cloudy with a Chance of Charcuterie, and it really blows that they didn't have it in cans (and when I asked the main location in Perkasie, they said it's scheduled for canning this week and will be both here and the main location with very limited distro). I don't like growlers because they go bad very easily (making this not very accessible to me other than on tap). I guess I'll just have to come to Peddler's Village more often...

I really love that I can sample makeup and other cosmeticsc here, especially for products for which it's important to test the color before buying (like foundation, blush, etc). They have an excellent free rewards program and even better online-only deals (always some coupons for free deluxe samples w/ some min purchase like $25). There's also great descriptions on display of some of the products, and a lot of employees around to help out.

This location apparently hired Tucson's very own Cesar Millan, a trainer named Jeremy. He alone is worth the five stars: He's helped me over the past year to train my rescue and he went way beyond the $100 I paid for six weeks of dog training classes. When I am stumped, and little Sophie stumps me often, Jeremy always finds a solution. Beyond that, I appreciate the staff, the prices aren't bad, just a solid business.

Although the salesman was friendly enough, The rest of the buying experience was pretty awful.

I regret not walking out and going to another dealer. I was a cash buyer for a new suburban but wanted to take advantage of GM 0% financing and finance 100% of the car. Elco is my usual dealer but I figured I would deal with a place closer to my home... No problem there,, What struck me as low rent was the dealer add on painted pinstripe and door edge protector for about $400. Really? Dealers still do that? I said no way and they removed the charge.. Which actually meant I just did not get the truck  discounted as much as it could have been. I DOUBT they get those things done for free.. MAYBE $100 for both, their cost... I got a few discounts and got a reasonable trade in on my old truck.. The fact that the wholesaler who buys from them was all over it drooling, That tells  me it was probably worth more than I got.

I have excellent credit and easily qualified for the loan as requested. I went to sign the papers and was asked if I wanted an extended warranty, I said yes, ONLY if it was a GMEPP (Formerly GMPP ) plan that is a General Motors product that is essentially an extension of the warranty. I usually get 84 months 75000 miles as I tend to keep my trucks 15 or more years.
When I declined he seems a bit irritated i would not pay for an aftermarket warranty which, usually not worth the paper they are printed on.  I bought a GMEPP from a dealer in North Dakota who was highly recommended on the Corvette Forums, 0 deductible 84 months 75000 miles from General Motors.

I was kind of embarrassed for the sales job applicants that had to fill out applications at a table in the noisy show room and interview in the cubicle next to the one i was spending all day in.. I could hear every cringe worthy question like, " Tell me what your weaknesses are" ect. They did not have a freaking office they could use?

It took SIX HOURS to complete the transaction... The cleaning of the car took a couple of hours... And it was  a half-assed job,, Marks remained on the arm rest and I am still peeling protective plastic from the interior.   Not to mention a ding on drivers door that marked the " Door Edge Protection".

I usually deal with ELCO Cadillac and St Louis Porsche so, in all fairness, my expectations might be too high.  

I blame only myself.


Addendum.    I just found masking  tape marks and overspray on a brand new 69000 dollar vehicle.    Wow.

I've been to Prohibition a few times since my one star review, and I'm sad to say I've had nothing but disappointment here. 

We stopped for brunch one day and it took 45 minutes to get our food.  When it came out, it was cold. Not once did the server apologize, so when the check came I paid and asked to speak to a manager.  Turns out the server was the manager. She was nice enough to refund the money back to my card, and offer a free round of drinks on our next visit.  We haven't been back to cash in on those drinks, and this happened months and months ago.

My previous experiences were just as disappointing.

I wish I could like you, Prohibition, but I've given up.

Go here all the time! They've got all of my biking gear, water bottles, bike tune-ups, snacks, and get me ready to hit the trail!  Great knowledgeable staff, offer educational classes and any info about the Katy trail you need to know!

This place is so great for families... You actually get to eat with your significant other while your kids play in a sand pit... That is worth every penny spent! You might actually get to eat your food hot too!

The food was ok... Typical burger joint, nothing fantastic but nothing bad either.

But you really come here because its on the beach, kids can play and run around, you can sit and actually eat your food, and enjoy the view!

It will always be a stop for us when in the area!

If you've been to Sylvia's in Harlem NYC, and you're looking for a similar experience, you're going to need to look elsewhere. This place doesn't encompass the charm, hospitality, or flavor of anything Southern and comforting.

Here's a quick breakdown...

PROS:
1) Fried Chicken - Winner! No complaints here. The batter wasn't overdone and the chicken still moist and flavorful.
2) Collard Greens - Very good, but can you really ruin these?
3) Mac'n Cheese - Yes, this was excellent. My only complaint is that the portion was too small!

CONS:
1) Cornbread - The first basket was cold. The second was warm and tasted better, but both batches were fairly dry and the portions were small. It wasn't what I was expecting at all.
2) Ribs - Small, mostly fatty, drenched in bbq sauce. I understand that ribs are typically drowning in sauce, but these had a strong ketchup flavor and left everyone at our table unimpressed.
3) Price - You have to pay $1 extra for white meat. And for what you pay the portions are pretty small. That, or I'd expect the quality and flavor of the meat to be much better.
4) Service... wow. The service here is HORRIBLE. Let's see, no one ever refilled our drinks or waters. We asked for lemons and straws twice, only 2 straws were delivered for our table of 3. It was 30 minutes before closing time and the wait staff started clearing our table without even asking if anyone was done, reaching across without even saying 'excuse me' or even saying anything at all. Oh, and by the way, one of us was still eating when you took our side dish away!

Because of the service, we never tried any of the desserts. I really want to like this place, but it seems like the inconsistencies are creating so many mixed reviews. I'm debating giving it a second try, and if things improve, then I'll definitely write an update. Here's for hoping,

I am visiting Philadelphia with 13 friends to attend the Annual Philadelphia Flower Show. Our trip was perfect until tonight. Our reservation was for 6:15. We were seated immediately and marveled at the gorgeous sunset views. Sadly by the time we left FOUR hours later the view was a distant memory replaced with slow service and sub par food.  Restaurants make their money by their liquor sales, right? Well if that's the case they lost money on us. Several times I looked up at the dinner table and there was not a single drop of wine in one wineglass. In four hours I had two glasses of wine. I probably would not have noticed the slow service if my wineglass had been full or at the very least our waiter had asked me if I would like another glass. Go for a cocktail, watch the beautiful sunset, and then go to a restaurant that will feed you and offer you a glass of wine.

It was amazing!! It was so hot but once the music started I didn't care how hot it was anymore. You can tell that the members of the band loved what they do. It was so much fun and an amazing experience. I would go all of the time if I lived closer.
Today was training day, and the food was free! Service was great and the food delicious. Can't wait for this place to open full-time!

Very reasonably priced especially with coupons. My wife and I have eaten there a couple of dozen times and never walked away with (excuse the pun) a bad taste in our mouth. Looking forward to their new location. Highly recommend this place especially if you are looking for a simple but slightly different taste.
Mushroom soup was awesome and the chicken malinese was done perfectly. Service was top notch

I finally found great Chinese food in Tucson/Marana. I am extremely picky (that's what my husband says anyway) so it's pretty hard to please me. I got chicken and vegetables in a ginger garlic sauce. The vegetables were carrots, bok choy, broccoli, shitake mushrooms, yellow squash. The sticky rice was cooked perfectly. There was a lot of big chunks of white meat chicken in the dish. It lasted me about 3-4 meals.

This place was awesome!!!!!! My boyfriend & I just recently moved to the Tampa area, so we are traveling to all different places and trying them out. We went to Ybor city one night and came across this place!! The drinks are phenomenal!!! You have several different flavors of frozen drinks to choose from, have a bad case of indecisiveness???? They let you mix and match!!!! Great atmosphere, outside, good music, and saw a NY METS sign hanging up letting us know the owner is from the NY area and now come baseball season my bf has a local spot to watch his favorite hometown team! We will without a doubt be returning here

Horrible...bartenders repeatedly made eye contact with us as they stood there talking with the same 2 people. Ignored us for over 20 mins when there's only 10-15 people in the whole place so we just walked out. Good business plan, just ignore your customers, will never go back.

I like the mom-and-pop feel of this place. It's very casual and is not high volume at all. It's a great place to come and hang out with friends. There's a pool table right next to the bar top and a few video games nearby. The dining tables aren't too close to the games and bar top. The food is good and the service is good also.

Came here recently on a Saturday night with my husband. At first we felt a little judged for not being hipster enough, but we quickly moved past it. We started out with cocktails and I liked that the majority of the liquors are local. As others may have mentioned, the portions are on the small side, but it's like a create your own tasting menu. We shared a 1st course, got our own 2nd and 3rd, then shared 2 desserts. I think the portion sizes were on par with plenty of tasting menus that I have had at other similar level places. I certainly did not leave hungry. 

Ambiance: dark, minimal, industrial, music was the Smiths, Depeche Mode, etc.

We had a great meal and great bottle of wine for a resonable price.  The two of us got out of there for just under 100 bucks which included a bottle of wine and desert.  We had left overs which were perfect for a late night snack back at hotel.  

 Tables are fairly close together which is great for somebody like me who likes to talk to people.  
In case you were wondering, yup got the veal parm.   It was awesome.  Also got fettuccini Alfredo.  Not bad.  The home made noodles rocked.  
Let's talk desert..... I would NOT suggest the canoli. The filling was chalky.  It was like eating a tumms.  Do not waste your money on one of these things.  

I will go back next time in Philly.

Before choosing this theater to see the Hangover 2 (which I won't even waste my time reviewing...that statement is a review in itself, really), I read a bunch of the reviews here on yelp.  I'm truly amazed at how many people commented on the state of the bathrooms.  I was expecting to go there and see outhouses based on the reviews here.  Since I typically don't go to a movie theater with the lone reason of peeing, I didn't really care and bought my tickets on fandango.

In typical "me" fashion, the second I got there I had to pee.  After reading the reviews I was truly frightened.  I even wore closed toed shoes in anticipation of a literal crap hole.  Imagine my surprise when I walked in to find shiny, almost glowingly clean stalls.  The only smell was that of cleaning supplies.  I didn't even see a single square of toilet paper on the floor.  I went again after the movie - same thing.  Forget all the reviews that said otherwise - the bathrooms here are fine.  Perhaps management has read the reviews themselves and made a change.

The theater itself is pretty standard.  We saw it in Digital Projection - I couldn't tell a difference from Standard, but I only go to the movies 2 or 3 times a year so perhaps I'm not the best judge.  The quality and sound were great though.

The only thing that irked me about this place is how big it is.  I realize that is a selling point for some people but just like I don't go to a movie theater to pee, I also don't go to watch 24 movies - I go to watch one.  In my opinion, the size here is a negative because it only creates crowds and long lines.

Overall, pretty standard - I don't see any reason to not go back.
Seriously, that was crazy delicious. And I've really never been that big of a fan of Thai food. Now I know why, it's never been as good as THIS!
Great food!!! (We loved the sandwiches) but wish there was more to choose from. Loved the unique design and mellow atmosphere!

I love the look and feel about this cute place!

Workers were very helpful to guide me to which coffee would fit me. 

I got the lemon blueberry donut which really tangy but good! Too bad they ran out of the cinnamon roll brûlée. I'll be back for you!

I also got the cold brew with condense milk. I forgot what he called it but he recommended that one since I wanted an over iced sweet coffee. And it was just that! Perfectly sweet coffee! 

Totally recommended and definitely coming back to try the food

(note: this review is based on my review about 3 years ago. I copy my review from another website and put it here.)

I haven't used his service, HOWEVER, I met one of his unhappy customer when I was checking out the place.   

I need some body and paint work done on my car. I heard he is the cheapest.   

The problem I found at his place is he does not use a spray booth at all. I asked to see it and he doesn't have it. So he paint the car outside.   

When I was there, an unhappy customer drove up and complain about the paint job he did on back of his Jeep. I wasn't near by his Jeep. I was about half a car length away from his Jeep. Already I could see how BAD the paint job is from a DISTANCE! I didn't even have to take a close look at all.   

He told the unhappy customer that his work is not done and all it needs is some polishing. From what I have seen, there's no way he can fix it with polishing.   

Even he can, he should not have return the car to him looking like that! It was really bad.   

As for the other work he does, I really don't know. But don't use him for body and paint work.

GREAT german food, good pricing and nice staff make up for anything negative we experienced.

We were the only table in the restaurant, so the food came out fast.  However, the rest of the service was LANGSAM: that would mean "slow" in german.  I was able to learn german because that's how long it took for a refill of water.  My Coke was never refilled.

And we had to ask twice for the check.

However.  We love german food, and I have to say that the spaetzle was perfect (not soggy, runny or tasteless; truly yummy) and the schnitzel was deep-fried perfection.  Seriously, it's good food.

I gave an extra star because they actually have kartofelknudel (potato dumpling) which is hard to find at other german restaurants.  But I knocked off a star because they only offer the kartofelknudel with a mushroom gravy (we prefer a beef broth).  But maybe that's a Berlin thing to offer it with gravy?

Anyway, we'll be back and be better prepared for the time.  Everyone was very nice there, so all in all a really good experience.

Incredible whiskey selection as promised. Everything you could dream of. A few flight options. Food over delivered!  Burger is huge, thick and tasty. Duck fat fries were amazing!  Small place. Very comfy but seems like prime time could be hard to get in.

I literally can not recommend this place enough. I came in skeptical about their 13 dollar ramen. (I have a general rule about spending over $10 on lunch.) But good lord. I went in at 1:15 and the living room sized restaurant was packed. There was one seat left at the end of the bar which is the main feature of the restaurant and the best seat in the house. It is incredible to watch the cooks and servers work together, I have never seen a team more in sync. And then there's the wonder twins. One is a cook and one is a server and the girl next to me thought she was going crazy. I have Kyle (the server wonder twin) as my server. He was great, very knowledgeable and fast. 
  Now to the food. Hot damn. This ramen. I got the miso ramen and it was perfect. The noodles were perfectly done and the ingredients melded perfectly. The broth wasn't too salty and had an excellent flavor with the brisket, cabbage and seaweed. 
Just overall a great experience.
Love this market, reasonable fresh meats! and vegys as well as tropical fruits and fresh fish

Sushi good (4 star sushi) but wait staff very slow and distracted. Also bathroom disgusting and you have to walk down a dirty hallway to reach it. The trip to the bathroom skewed my appetite and distracted from my overall experience. Bottom line, food good and if wait staff is engaged and you pee before you go and can wash your hands at table you'll be happy.

Outstanding! Decided to stroll through Collingswood on this gorgeous day with my husband. Stopped in mid afternoon for a late lunch and were greeted by a very friendly and welcoming young man. Our server was Caroline/Carolyn she was amazing, friendly, great smile, and very helpful when we had questions about the menu.
The food was outstanding! I had the Island sandwich on gluten free sourdough with a side salad. Oh wow! So tasty, so fresh and a good sized sandwich too! My husband had the Caesar salad with seitan, he said it was the best he ever had. We both had delicious and refreshing green iced teas. From the moment we walked in to when we left it was a 5 star experience, we felt welcome... Food 5 stars and service was 5 stars! Caroline/Carolyn (sorry not sure of the spelling) was awesome!! We will be back soon.

Worst food, service, and employees known to mankind. 

During prime dinner time, they'll staff the shit outta drive thru, but they'll have one kid as a cashier inside at the counter. 

The shift  manager will look back every so often, but refuses to help out at the counter herself. Her attitude stinks. Not worth the drive.
One word..... Awesome! Great ambiance &  fantastic food. It's a hidden gem. Tucked away off the college circle,  romantic and sweet.

Price is a little high, but well worth it for the special occasion, or if you care enough about your hair. 100% quality and service, in all aspects. Best one blade shave in town, and A+ environment.  -- Weekends usually have a Bloody Mary bar, and if you're into cigars, try the man cave downstairs. -- Highly recommend for bachelor parties.

Wow. The beers are exquisite, balanced, and there are many varieties to choose from. The Centennial Red is the best red I have had and believe me, I have downed dozens of them. Almost but does not quite beat Schlafly's Amber. Gets a little loud but we live in a goddamned city so who cares? Go there often.

What a fantastic place to step in and watch people. Staff is soooo friendly the Chef Cory came out talked with us. Our server Deloris was amazing. Really was impresses. This is a must stop very underrated....but so fantastic we had the dozen oyster raw, jambalaya and firecracker oysters and 2 hurricanes. Very very good. We were lucky and had a groupon so our food bill wasnt took high.

Oh I adore this place even though it reminds me of Walmart for alcohol. There is an AMAZING selection and unbeatable prices at wine and beyond. Every wine imaginable, they have - I was pleasantly surprised to find out that they carried some of my Okanagan favourites! Absolutely lovely! 

I think one of the best features this place has to offer is the wine tastings and samples of beer they offer! You can also buy large jugs of beer from their taps that are significantly cheaper and refillable - way to save the environment and my wallet wine and beyond! 

In my few trips to this place I've also found some lovely house decor - including a very LARGE wine glass that I intend to fill with wine corks! 

I could wander this store aimlessly for hours - it's heaven!

I just don't want to write a bad review, but after talking with Stephanie this afternoon and getting no resolution I feel it's worth it. No need to name call, just the facts of what happened. I ordered 3 round cakes for a baby shower. All vanilla cakes with vanilla buttercream icing. One was a naked cake. It was supposed to be simple with slight scalloped edges on top. It was a disaster and looked so unprofessional everyone who has seen it couldn't believe that I paid money for it. We were going to stick the naked cake on top of another round, however all the round cakes came with a ring of buttercream roses on top. I was never told that there would be roses. Apparently this is their standard, but no one mentioned it to me, so how would I know it would be on there? Also when I stacked the cakes, the naked cake icing was a different color than the other two cakes. All the same icing, one super white and the other two were a yellow color. They tasted different and I know what the frosting should taste like since I had a sample of it before ordering. Obviously they messed up the icing on two of the cakes. Stephanie explained that they didn't know I would be stacking it so it didn't seem like it would matter. All the cakes were also supposed to be on cardboard that was cut to the size of the bottom of the cakes. Stephanie and I spoke about this on the phone and I emailed her a confirmation that this would be done. Naturally, they weren't cut so they stood out terribly on our cake base. Plus we had to take the naked cake off of its cardboard base so we could stack it, which was just annoying and unnecessary. Also the cakes were dry. It was just so disappointing all around. I really wanted to like this bakery, but for how many things they got wrong and then to not give me a refund considering the issues were their fault, I'm astounded.
Great dinner spot. Fantastic filet, ran about $35. Yum.

We've eaten/drank here about 3 times including the night of the soft opening.   Every time has been excellent.  The wings have a great smokey flavor with a spicy finish.  The domestic beers are also cheap at $3.   The chips they serve as sides with the sandwiches are also really good and cooked perfectly.

Everything we had was spot on. We started with the crispy dirty rice, tuna tartare, and the corn on the cob as appetizers. I've ever had better corn on the cob in my life. The other appetizers were out of this world as well. I had the curried goat as my entree, which was excellent. I will definitely return.

Our waiter was so awesome (I think his name is Gene? From CA but moved to NOLA a few years ago and has this crazy southern accent). 

I had the Gulf Fish Meuniere and it was really good - soft, flavorful and flaky fish. 

I'd love to come back to try different dishes.

I was in search for a great bar with great drinks and live music and near my hotel, so I was so happy to find this place. 

The first drink that I got on my first visit was the Frenchy made with strawberry vodka, sugar, lemon juice and champagne and what a great cocktail. My boyfriend got the Evangeline made with gin, blackberry liqueur, lemon juice, orange juice, vanilla and egg white... OMG this one was my favorite of the night.  Don't get me wrong they make really good drinks but this one was my favorite by far and we did have some other drinks that night too.  

I liked the place so much that I returned the next night again and this time the bartender offered to make me a drink after I said how much I liked the ones the night before.  She said she can make me a custom drink based on flavors I like.  My drink was delicious and it had gin and mint leaves and was so good. 

The drinks can be a bit costly but I don't mind spending a lot on cocktails if I know they are going to be delicious.  

The atmosphere is wonderful and far from the crazy scene along Bourbon Street. The place is classy and comfortable and the owner is super friendly and she there every night with her friendly smile.    And she has local jazz bands play every night and she takes pride in only having bands that are really talented.

The place is small and have nice red walls and cozy tables to watch the band.  If you want to sit in a more private area, they also have a small room with couches.   

This is definitely going to be a place I will miss once I return home to Florida;  Really wish we had a place like this back home.   If you're ever in this area and want to stay away from the crazy loud areas, then come and enjoy nice live music with amazing cocktails here at 21st Amendment.

My wife and I used Swig to assist with a Holiday party this year.  We were very happy with their service.  Our intention was to only hire a bartender for the event (small gathering in a private home).  After several conversations with the owner, we decided to also hire a server to assist with other items besides bar tending.  We were glad we did.

The two person team arrived on time (in fact they were 20 minutes early!) ready to start work.  The bartender and server jumped in to set up the bar and assist with last minute preparations. After a brief tour and an explanation of our expectations for the evening, they were able to provide some suggestions.  Throughout the evening, the server took it upon his own initiative to assist with passing appetizers and refilling guests drinks (our expectation was to have all the food on a dining table for the guests to get if they so desired).  In other words, he did not sit around when he had some down time and wait to be told what to do!  The contract called for an hour of cleanup after the party was over.  Due to the guests having a good time and not leaving, the bartender and server were able to clean up and continue to serve guests at the same time.

I would recommend Swig to anyone who wants to use their service in a similar situation.  We will definitely be calling should we have a situation to use them again!
, this is very nice place to show and enjoy and eat, relaxing time it's well worth the money .
Below mediocre food; they used cheap shredded cheese and the food tasted bland. Will not be back.

I'm in town for work and needed an alteration on a pair of my tuxedo slacks. I called Saji and she answered right away and I told her what I needed and asked if I could get done by Saturday, which was two days away, she said yes and gave me her address. I dropped my slacks off expecting to get them on Saturday and to my surprise, Saji called a couple of hours later and said my slacks were done and I could come get them. She was extremely nice and her work is that of a master seamstress. My tuxedo is custom made and her work fits right in with the quality of my original designer. Do yourself a favor. Call Saji and get your alterations work done right and at a fair price!!! Saji is awesome!

I've been to at least three locations in the Reno/Sparks area but this one is the most consistent (across three stylists so far). By checking in online the long wait times are a thing of the past. I had Albany for the first time not too long ago and she did great. Kaylin is usually my go-to. I can have difficult hair to fade for a lot of people, but Kaylin does an excellent job every time. She's very professional and always makes sure my cut is right. I'm glad she's moving on up!

YAY for the bubble machine! I love this quaint, neighborhood store in it's new location. Sure we have to walk an additonal block or two coming from our home on foot but it's well worth it. Less foot traffic to compete against at the new location. I've always love O'Doodles attention to kids' interests and parents' tastes as far as toys and learning tools go. Awesome place to find gifts for baby showers and birthday parties. I support O'Doodles mostly because of their role in Chestnut Hill local flavor plus we've always enjoyed the music and storytime hours *when we can catch it since it's usually only during weekdays*. We've never left here emptyhanded and my two year old LOVES the toy train display! They have everything a parent would want to purchase their little one to play with and honestly some of the inventory which includes books can be adult-friendly too! I eyeballed a copy of Madeline with matching doll a few times during our last visit. Prices are competitve to that of say a chain toy store since no frequent  coupons or sales but OD's is certainly the better choice because of it being a small business and its community focus.
Love this place. Great workout and a positive uplifting and friendly environment! I love the space too.

The Yelpers got it right once again. If you haven't been here you are missing out. I was a bit skeptical at first, but decided to finally try them out for date night to catch 12 years a slave, great flick btw... The quality of the food was better than anticipated. Ordered the following: cappuccino & mochaccino (fantastic. as good, if not better than the one at your local starbucks), Chicken Parm, margharita pizza, calamari as an appetizer, and Gorgonzola salad with honey mustard dressing. All was restaurant quality, very tasty. Our appetizer came out unusually late, not sure what went down. 
I would categorize Villagio on a scale of 1-10 as follows: 

The seats: 7.5, yes they are pretty comfortable, but compared to other cinemas with reclining seating, it's not the best of the best, they could use a bit more of a recline, also wish the seats were a bit longer for taller customers. 

The theater: 8.5, like most theaters, some auditoriums are bigger than others. nothing to brag about, comparable to other popular cinemas. 

The food: 9, so far everything I've ordered has been great, especially the pizza. Well priced. Reason enough to visit villagio on a Friday night. 

The service: 7.5, service is not bad, just not great, can be hit or miss. sometimes the workers seem out of sync. almost feels like opening day. Wish there was a way to have the waiter come by to pick up your plates after you finish. with all the lights out during the movie, i can see someone spilling food. it's an accident waiting to happen.

Overall: 8, been here more than once, found it a bit surprising they would show a highly anticipated flick on it's premiere in one of their smallest auditoriums on prime time. Also, the films don't stay out for long, some movies I've seen last maybe a month. Anyway, They add 17% gratuity on the spot, considering the high price of going to the movies these days it's still a good value. Villagio is a home run, but you can't help but feel, it could be a grand slam. All in all, despite the flaws. It's a fun experience, worth coming back.

Chose the place based on Yelp reviews, so thank you! Cute little off the beaten path location and a small, quaint, clean, and modern eating area inside. I inquired if I ordered at the counter first (you do) and the host could tell I was a first-timer and immediately stepped out from behind the counter to make a couple recommendations for me. I went with the popular bibimbap, a delicious mix of rice and veggies and marinated steak and a sweet/spicy sauce. I chose crispy rice per his exuberance about it and it came out in a sizzling skillet. It was beautiful presentation, even better taste. Very fresh food; perfectly seasoned. I appreciated that not only was the food outstanding but all the employees genuinely seemed to enjoy their jobs and had a passion for what they serve. Start to finish...great experience. Will be back.

I read about this restaurant from a blog by lindork and was very interested in trying this place.  We were meeting some friends and decided to try Workshop eatery.  We enjoyed our food very much.  It's Deep South.  Didn't know 91st extended that far south.  I would never expect a restaurant there because it's sort of at the end of the industrial area.  There are plenty of parking.  The building the restaurant is in looks massive and very modern.  You have to enter the building and the restaurant is on ur right or left if you are coming from the opposite door.  The restaurant was bright and quite big. 

We started off with the kimchi BBq pork lettuce wrap it had vegetables, vermicelli, peanuts and watercress yoghurt and you wrap it with butter lettuce.  I really like the butter lettuce instead of the green leaf lettuce where most places use.  It was a nice size too.  The kimchi bbq pork was crunchy with a bit of a kick.  Delicious.  The next item was belly and butternut.  It is a maple braised pork belly on top of butternut squash, with roasted corn kennels, candied pecans and ancho oil.  I personally don't like to eat pork belly so I skipped out on that.  But I really enjoyed the squash with the corn.  I couldn't stop picking at it but minus the belly.  We also go the duck carpaccio. This dish is very different.  I didn't like the duck carpaccio.  Tasted like duck jerky and I'm not a big fan on the blood orange vinaigrette.  It tasted like balsamic vinegar with a citrus after taste.  I didn't like that dish at all.  

For the main course I ordered the potato & ricotta stuffed perogies.  Oh my, this is very good! I would definitely come back for that. First, perogies are my favorite and the stuffing is delicious.  They had chive sour cream for you but I didn't even really have to use it because the perogies were tasty on its own. It is served with braised leek and sautéed mushrooms.  

Our friends ordered their feature - can't remember the name but it was something with risotto.  I had a bite.  It was very good and one of the servers did say we should always try their features.  My hubby and our other friend ordered the pomegranate braised lamb.  Normally i don't eat lamb. But this lamb was very juicy and slides off the bone.  It was highly recommended by the server and he also mentioned we should try the steak dish.  

To finish off the meal we ordered the honey and yoghurt Panna cotta with sour cherries and candied pecans.  Honestly, I just had a few spoonful of it.  I was getting too full.  But it was not bad. Although I've had better Panna cotta (must try yokosuna's) and we also ordered the warp apple crisp.  The apple crisp is good but we were just too full and couldn't finish it.  The cream cheese ice cream is different it didn't have much taste to it. I had cream cheese ice cream before and this one is not that cream cheese. 

Definitely would come back here again.  I would bring my girlfriend because it's a good place to eat and chat for a long time :)

You will be "Counting Stars" when you visit Burger Republic but this is no place for a boy band! A well adorned sports bar in a hip and trendy area of Nashville.  Saw several locals, although the tourists were out in force. Despit the lackluster greeting from hostess, everything improved from there! The food server was awesome and helpful. We split the tot fondue (large app) and we bought "the farm" burger. The burger was a blend of quality products, I would suggest putting the tomato and lettuce on the bottom. Cooked to a perfect temp with a side salad. Even the"fondue" for the tots was above par.

Visit the Republic, at least once!

While visiting Tucson, I found myself in the mood for noodles (a common phenomenon in my case). I was pleasantly surprised to find Kung Fu Noodles highly rated by Yelpers. With the "Kung Fu" name,  I was fairly skeptical, expecting a generic takeout Chinese restaurant.  Well,  don't let the name fool you! This place is legit! The often recommended beef noodle soup ("Kung fu beef noodle") is solid.  Fairly spicy. Noodles are good and supposedly handmade, which I believe.  Also had the water boiled fish,  one of my go to spicy dishes,  and the rendition here is decent.  I've had better at dedicated szechuan restaurants,  but this one isn't bad.  Ditto for the dry cooked string beans.

Previous reviews described the poor service here,  though I didn't find that to be true. I found the staff to be attentive and prompt, though I was also here at 5pm on a Friday with most of the restaurant being empty. So your experience may vary.  

Will plan to patronize again when back in Tucson!

Food quality is good but the portions are small. The shrimp kabob "entree" contains six shrimp. That will not fill up a normal sized person. That dish costs 12 bucks with tax. Chicken sandwich is slightly better, but still leaves you hungry, and that's for 10 bucks. It's clean, healthy food, but could you give a little more food for those prices please? That being said, it's a good resource in the area and the chicken quesadilla is a hit with kids.
Great place stayed open after 5:00 on a Saturday, to accommodate us! Will be coming back :)

I was in Tucson so I figured I'd find a place with more traditional mexican foods than the americanized places all over town. They had quite an extensive menu but I was feeling like some tacos. There were a lot of choices, so I selected one of each. I got 2 hard tacos, chicken and beef, and 2 soft tacos, shrimp and fish. The fish was pretty lackluster. It was plain grilled fish with absolutely no flavor at all. Beef and chicken were good though the beef was a little dry, the chicken the better of the two being tender and juicy. The shrimp in my opinion was the best. Not sure what they did with it but it was fresh, yummy, and awesome. If you like it spicy there are tons of hot sauce bottles on the table.

I have to agree with my husband on this but I more on the higher side of 3.5 stars. I am leaning more on the high end because I was pleasantly surprised by my meal. I tend to be leery of breakfast joints of that nature because the service is usually average as well as the food and then the price is ridiculous for the quality. So I didn't have high hopes unfortunately. 

BUT my meal was incredible. I ordered ordered the Huevos Rancheros and was very pleased, it was superb. Loved the pork green chili and the side potatoes. But the service was slow and inattentive. I prefer to base most of my reviews on food alone but I couldn't here, if they step the professionalism of the waitstaff I would be happy to try more menu item but otherwise it was just A-OK.

This place is a hidden gem! Wonderful pupusas, fresh natural juice, sweet plantain, chicken tamales, you name it. Everything in this place is so good! And the owners make you feel like home. Perfect spot when you are craving REAL Latin-American food.

Good Starbucks location and easy to get in and out of. This location has a larger front patio with plenty of outdoor seating  if you so choose.  The inside is also a good size. Friendly staff and I was in and out. Almost tempted to grab a glass of wine instead but stayed the course and went for s jolt.
Some great craft brews on tap here, and rather great burgers and burritos too. Table service can vary, but mostly, we've had good experiences

Brought my car in for an oil change as I had passed the date by two months to get that done. Came inside and was waiting for awhile when the gentleman working on my car came in to let me know that I had another 4000 miles to go and I shouldn't waste my time and money on an early oil change. It's the honest thing to do but not everyone is honest. It would have been very easy, and I would have thought nothing of it , had they charged me. I really appreciate this kind of honesty and service. Might be why I've been coming here for 16 years. Only 4 stars and not 5 because the car washes themselves aren't the finest but I would have given them a 3 before today's encounter. Thanks Uptown Carwash! Good for you for having great employees.

yummy food with a menu that changes to feature fresh food. We only went for dinner and had duck and a fish dish. The portions were small for what we thought the prices were. The ginger drinks were good, but not as gingery as we like (i.e. we enjoy really strong ginger drinks with a good kick). 

The decor is fun and cheeky, very much a representation of what the Bywater offers. The location is small so not good for larger groups. It is accessible as the entire spot is on one floor. We didn't use the restrooms so not sure if those are accessible.
Great fresh food.  The falafels are light and crispy and hummus creamy and tasty.  Chicken shawarma bowls are great.

I come for the food when I work nearby, everything I have tried has been really good!  
Definitely a place to try, they also have a great coffee, wine, large deli and other European grocery items.

Absolutely love this hotel!  My room is always spotless, feels like home and I appreciate that this hotel has charm unlike the generic feel of a new hotel. Located conveniently across from the shopping center and bus stop. I stay here for work 1-4 times each month. The staff are so helpful and friendly and the manager is excellent! Looking forward to future stays!

Hadn't been in here in years. And geez it's so nice.  The expanded eating area gives everyone more room. Food is just through the zoom room in quality. Do yourself a favor and drop by for breakfast or lunch. But leave room for there treats, there sure to delight anyone who try's one

I should know better than to try to eat a bagel in California. At 9am it wasn't empty, but not busy. We were the only ones waiting for food. It took them 15 minutes to toast a mediocre bagel and put it in a box with capers, cream cheese, and onions, pre-packaged separately based on the 5 days prior date scrawled in sharpie on the plastic cup (they forgot my tomatoes). Not very cute for the mom-and-pop vibe they have going.

Barista was fast at least. Good latte and cold brew. I should have just ordered a pastry though.
The sweet potato fries are incredible and the flights of beer are awesome.  They map out the whole thing for you.  I've never had a bad meal here.

My friends and I came here after taking one of them  to ER. We were all famished after spending the day in ER. We were seated immediately and it took awhile to look at the extensive menu. One of my friends was delighted she could order breakfast! My other friend and I ordered sandwiches. So, we all enjoyed our meals. 1. Scrambled Eggs and Challah French Toast - I tried some of french toast, it was great! 2) I had a cup which is HUGE of soup and a sandwich (also huge). The soup was Mushroom-Barley, very tasty and the sandwich I had was Greek Sandwich = feta cheese, spinach,tomoato and melted Mozzarella on a hoagie roll toasted. Very good. 3) Turkey Sandwich- had lots of yummy components : Smoked Turkey, Lettuce, TOmato and Honey Mustard on a hoagie roll. Wait staff very nice. We will come back. (Yes, I will visit South Jersey friends again). Next time,  I would like to try some of the kosher foods: Bagel with Lox, Matzo Ball Soup, potato pancakes.....

Been wanting Chick-fil-A (CFA) for a few years, today was my first experience, I arrived 10:15 am, ordered at 10:20 am, thinking I could get a sandwich, NOPE, not until 10:30 AM! I was going to try the spicy one for $4.25. 

Instead, I got the CFA breakfast platter ($4.75) with 1 biscuit, eggs, a small piece of chicken and a very small portion of gravy. 

I thought the biscuit was tasty, the gravy was a very sad portion, it was okay flavor, not bad, didn't wow. The small piece of chicken had a good flavor. Eggs are eggs, not great, not terrible. If I had a good portion of gravy, I might be tempted to give 5 stars, but I literally had about 3 small plastic spoon fulls! 

I might order again this platter again, but it wasn't a wow experience. For breakfast, it's nice to have a change up, and with the chicken piece, it gave breakfast a unique experience. It would have been nice to have a WAFFLE option too! 

I was able to order a large order of waffle iron fries ($1.99). I liked these and the fact they were cooked in peanut oil. It feels good not to be consuming a GMO oil, like are forced too, everywhere else, that uses Corn, Soy, or Cottonseed. 

Last, it wasn't crazy busy, I was happy with my wait time for to go. I will go back and try that spicy sandwich, and if I get gravy again, I will dine in to make sure I get the right amount next time, and or open the bag, and look at the lowly filled cup, and get it filled correctly!

This is an unassuming place in a small shopping center on Rt 29 in Collegeville. Not much to look at from the outside, but the inside is where the good food is served. They have daily lunch specials, and for less than $10.00 you could get three enchiladas, tacos, or burritos in chicken or beef, with a generous side of rice and beans. They're not skimpy on the cheese, either. Fresh salsa and chips has some heat but it's very good. Service is also friendly and fast. Downside is that they don't serve alcohol, but it's a BYOB.
Great Indian place in West Philly. The buffet is very good, but the special orders, fresh from the kitchen, are the bomb ! Fresh and great tasting ! Awesome value and BYOB !

A truly unique experience. You can tell that everybody in this place cares about putting out great food and drink. The coffee was fantastic. We got two donuts and two breakfast sandwiches. Everything was excellent. 

We got the Friday chicken breakfast sandwich and the pork belly breakfast taco. I really can't pick a favorite of the two. Both were very well designed breakfast items. If I went back I'd get both again just to show them off to whoever I'm traveling with. 

This place is the real deal. Perhaps my most memorable meal in New Orleans...ever.

I'm not crazy about cupcakes, but decided to stop in recently.  Although the space is small, the decor is very cute.  I thought the cupcakes were reasonably priced and very tasty.  I don't really care for marshmallows, yet I  think the smore cupcake was my favorite.
Just tried Wings Mania. Better than I expected. It was clean and the wings were better than BW3. Prices were good too.

Had to get my locks changed. Called up and was told they would be there in 45 minutes. I got a call and Garrett was already there. Since I was still on my way and stuck in traffic I felt bad and thought they would leave. Nope, he asked what I needed and did the work. Could have charged extra but was honest and told me I didn't need the dead bolt removed. By the time I got there everything was complete and I just needed to pay. 

Awesome service. Awesome prices. Would recommend them to anybody.

This is one of our "go to" places in the area.  Food is always good (have had most of the items on the menu with no disappointments yet) beer selection is always new!  The staff has been pleasant and knowledgeable and the prices are extremely reasonable.  Pretty much everything you need in a place to eat and drink!

It's OK. The parking lot smells has an alluring smell of urine and a lot of smoke inside the hallways of the hotel rooms. The only thing that was really nice about the stay was the food at BREAKFAST food at Cafe Bellini inside the hotel. The prices were very comfortable. I don't think I would come back here again. The noise level wasn't too bad but the sheets were a bit questionable.

Absolutely awful lunch buffet coordination. 11:45 and no pizza on the buffet. It's prime lunch time. One server for entire restaurant (plus she is the cashier and doing other things in the kitchen). When the pizza arrives, it's delicious. One of the pizza makers asked me if everything was okay now that the pizzas were on the buffet. I wanted to ask if he had twice as many ready because he had hungry people who were going to scarf up the pies in two minutes. This is not a isolated incident. It's like this all the time. This restaurant needs to learn how to manage a pizza buffet.

My go to Starbucks!!! Staff are friendly and know my cinnamon dolce latte obsession. Lol. I was annoyed when this place was closed for construction because there aren't any really near me other than this one besides the BHP one... and there's just too much traffic. Drive thru here can be slow but it's not usually a big deal since I stop after work. Can't wait for pumpkin spice to come back because I'm basic. Not sorry.

This was the worst stop of my entire trip. No room to sit, and please don't use the bathroom. Its a 2x2 sweat box from the kitchen and you couldn't move sideways in there if you wanted to. They false advertise for half of their menu. Example:
"Ham and cheese omelet with your choice of toast, bagel or grits, 2.99"
Wow "Ill take it you reply." You get your bill 10.00. Scratching your head you ask "how that could be?" The answer, the cheese cost a 1.00 the bread 3.00 and so on. Shoot I'm surprised they didn't charge for the egg too. To top it off the food tasted like s#$% ran over twice. I could cook a better breakfast if I was drunk on bourbon st. Honestly, service was crap, it took two hours for a Dennys breakfast and it was off a street I couldnt even find. LAME

I have used this service multiple times now and all of the lawn professionals are great. They have excellent customer service should you have have a concern or question and always do a wonderful job to my challenging yard. We have overgrown trees, weeds, bushes with thorns etc and they always remove what we need and trim what we want to keep. I would recommend any of the professionals to any type yard you may have.

The best cheesesteak i've had so far!!! Fantastic, fast and cheesy.  The staff were very friendly, we hit the area around 230pm on our way in from NY. We were staying in Philly and have heard a lot about this place.  Definitely recommend checking them out, the milkshakes are huge and filling.  Great value and service.

Second time I have been to Apple in six weeks & my new phone is not working. According to them it's both Verizon & Yahoo, but not the phone. Give me a break! My iPad works fine & I have both Verizon & Yahoo with my iPad.

This is my new favorite Vietnamese place in town. They get nods for their banh mi but I've ordered the banh coung-pork crepes, and a few other dishes and everything has been so good. Their products are extremely fresh and it's all scratch. It's worth the trip! Great family owned place that serves food that is extremely traditional!

I have my install done by Jeff...I looked for this man for 2 years, only to find him in the same spot I left him but under a different salon name.  I am so glad I took the time to look for and find him...He is my Weave Guru.  Anytime another stylist can compliment your hair, speaks volumes about the kind of work that he does.  Thanks Jeff for always making me feel beautiful when I leave your chair.
A beautiful space that sometimes offers unique experiences. I went to see a screening of Casablanca where the orchestra performed the soundtrack live! It was incredible.

I've been here a few times. It's always busy, and sometimes there might be a wait, but it's worth it! I've had breakfast mostly and with groups. Everyone has enjoyed their meals. Service is good, and they don't rush you out. Good coffee!
Great food, service left a bit to be desired.

Nice place nice food sums up this location.

I really like the Kung pao chicken and the lettuce wraps.

Just make sure you make a reservation in advance

My husband and I stayed here for a 3 day "mini-moon" following our Nashville wedding last month and could not have been more pleased. The hotel is perfectly situated in the quarter-- right in the middle of everything but a couple of blocks away from the noise. The hotel was beautiful and the service was excellent. Upon arrival we were upgraded to a a vieux carre king suite, which was a complete and wonderful surprise. The front desk staff, especially Crystal, were so warm, friendly and accommodating that we felt right at home. 

As my husband Jesse so eloquently put it "there may be nicer hotels in New Orleans, but we will never find out". 

Thanks and hope to see you for our anniversary :)
