The party went super smooth, and everyone who came had a great time! We may have been the oldest ones on the court, but we were definitely having the most fun. 

Note: if you're with an older crowd, book your party for later in the night, so there aren't as many kids. Also consider just doing the lowest package-- I didn't see the value in reserving a private court.

The only reason I went was because I got a coupon in the mail and the ad boasted lots of seafood. Even with that I should of stayed away. This may seem like a lot of food but I took a little bit of each. I didn't try any sushi because they only had about 6 different kinds and none of them looked appetizing. Shrimp dumplings were gross. The pork dumplings were undercooked. The chicken on a stick was bland. Pork ribs were bland as well. There was something called chicken fingers but in actuality they were chicken feet. I'm not joking, chicken friggin feet. Lo mein was gross. Blue crabs smelled like someone took a poo in it. Stuffed clams had no taste. Shrimp balls were odd. The spring roll was just ok, the pork egg roll was gross, I didn't even finish it. The sui mei was so horribly disgusting it tasted like someone farted in my mouth. The chicken wings were bad because they had some kind of weird batter on them. Even the snow crabs weren't good and even though I got some as soon as they came out, by the time I got back to my table they were cold. I don't even think there was shrimp in what was supposed to be fried shrimp, n no cocktail sauce to speak of. And even though they had stuff to make a salad, I couldn't find any salad dressing. The only good thing I had was the nilla wafer pudding, but I'm sure you can buy the same thing in a store. This was my first and last time here. Do yourself a favor and go somewhere else, or eat a can of dog food which I'm sure will be more enjoyable. If they served this garbage to inmates it would be considered cruel and unusual punishment. I should of just stuck with my usual place, Hibachi Grill and supreme buffet in Cinnaminson which is far far superior. That's the way a buffet should be handled.

Decided to give this place a try after I was craving a good cuban. My go-to Cuban spot is Big Stein's down the road, but wanted to try something new. They definitely have a lot of options and is a a very cute restaurant. I got the lunch special which was the Hot Honey Turkey wrap (pressed). I was kind of confused when my bill came out to $10 when the lunch special was $6.99, but I'm assuming that's because I got the soup as my side. The soup, by the way, was cold. It's just an assumption that my soup would be hot, because well it's soup so that was disappointing. I will give this place another try for breakfast - seemed like they had a lot of good options and its served all day. My wrap was good but didn't have enough turkey.

HORRIBLE! this place gives meaning to the word crap! This place is in a great spot next to the airport. I work next to the airport and mentioned I was going there to eat and everybody tried to talk me out of it but I went anyway. The food was dry and tasteless and the place needs a good cleaning. Stay away...far away from this place!

The ambience is nice and there are several small touches making the service nice.  I had the veggie quesadilla with zucchini and it was good,  not super flavorful,  but still good. The salsa is tasty!  
The beans delivered with the meal in one little bowl to a booth of 6 people is strange and no one even touched them.  Either deliver with the chips and salsa and more than one bowl for booth of 6 (easier logistics to share) or skip.

Not good at all ... Ate there 2 weeks ago on Sunday ... Ordered 2 pounds of Alaskan king crab .. $60 per pound and there were disgusting and freezer burned ... We also ordered a bunch or other seafood ... Blue crabs ... Snow crab... Bill was just as much as eating at Barclay prime ... And we had no drinks !!! I will never eat there again ... Even if it were free ... I would not go back ...

Good food but when they are busy they take forever and if u call and complain they say the food is on it's way. Took and additional hour after that! Food was cold and the customer service was horrible needless to say I stopped ordering from here.

I have been here twice, and both times I was really impressed with the food. I ordered the same meal both times, the grilled chicken grande burrito. It is amazing! Also, the rice is fresh and really good.

A Gaybourhood institution! used to be a lot more fun... now rather tired.  

The food is rather decent, though a pit pricey.  I do like that one can order a salad with a burger rather than fries.  The guacamole is an embarrassment, but as a whole everything is OK.

It's the server that will make or break the experience.  There is this one chap that has been there for ages and I reckon it's because he gives the guys who frequent the place something to salivate over.  I for one am more impressed with my server's work ethic than looks.  

One one occasion, I asked for more napkins... didn't get them, another time needed an extra fork... not happening either.  Never got a refill on Iced Tea.  I once had to even ask the other server for the check because apparently he didn't feel like getting that for us either.  

If you get any other server, you'll have a decent experience as none of the others have as much 'tude.   Still, there are better places out there.
Loved the food, drinks and ambiance. Very good service too. Tableside guacamole is outstanding.  Salsa different and delish. Sauces were wonderful as well. Will visit again!

This is my go-to nail salon as I live and work on the North side of Indianapolis. I have never had to wait more than 20 minutes. I've had several gel manicures, regular manicures and pedicures. Usually I'm very satisfied but this last time I went, my gel nail color has become discolored after 5 days. Very frustrating. However, my experiences are always so great that I'm confident they will be able to assist me with fixing this current issue. 

Update - just went again and had excellent service!

Came here for Collingswood Restaurant Week; I had been to another Sabrina's location years ago but hadn't had the chance to try this one.  I ordered the vegetable spring rolls-great crunch and flavor, the braised short rib over risotto-large portion and meat was cooked nicely but the risotto was slightly bland, and the mini churros-so delicious and perfect size to end a large meal.

This place has a huge menu and while we were there tons of other kinds of food kept coming from the kitchen. I definitely want to come back and try their breakfast options!

We have been coming here for the last 10 years, usually we are here for 10-14 days at a time, twice a year. We have come to kn ow the staff really well here and continue to come back because we are treated like family. The hotel has one of the best locations you can get in the city, it is quiet and extremely close to all the historical attractions. The rooms are recently remodeled and have stayed true to the older style decore that goes with being in old city, combined with modern finishes and lighting. The lobby is very nice and open with a lot of places to hang out and relax. The bar has the best bar tender you will ever find (Danny) He makes the best cocktails and is just great to hang out and have a drink with.

Had lunch here today, while working nearby!  Just a simple pulled pork sandwich and some potato salad... and I left HAPPY! Service was awesome... really friendly staff, and it smells like carnivore heaven in there! 

The pulled pork was good, lots of flavor and very tender. The potato salad? OMG! Some of the best I have had... creamy and tart, and sweet.... just yummy! 

I will be going back.. when I am not time constrained... because I want to eat at least one whole rack of their ribs all by myself! And try some of the other assorted goodies on that menu!

Wonderful stuff! But you don't want to go there... trust me. If you don't go... there will be more for me!   :)

highly recommended!

Top Tomato is right near where I work, so after trying the rest of the pizza places within the three block radius of my office, this is my main go-to spot for pizza because it's the best I've found! The slices are large and they have a lot of variety in their offerings.  I love their red top pizza (sauce on top, cheese on bottom) but I've also had the Mediterranean pizza (spinach, feta, chunky tomato sauce, mozzarella) the Jersey Tomato pizza (chunky tomato sauce, mozzarella) and the plain is great too! I haven't tried a lot of the menu items besides the pizza, but I have had their italian and also tuna hoagies and they are great.  Not on a traditional hoagie roll but it looks like they may bake their own rolls, which are delicious. 

Also, the staff is very friendly and I've been there so much they greet me and know what I order.  

I am not sure about the reviewer who thinks Top Tomato is more expensive than NYPD - I go to NYPD too and I'm pretty sure their slices are a tad more expensive - but not enough to really matter.  It's Philly and you'll generally pay $2.50 -  $3 for a plain slice and more for one with toppings wherever you go.

My go-to vintage and thrift spot. The prices are more affordable than others in the area and the staff is always so friendly and helpful. I love that they have actual furniture and not just decor.  If you're looking for something special just follow their Instagram and you'll get all the updates.

Stopped in here on the way back to DC, after reading the reviews on Yelp. I always look for great places to eat outside of chain food restaurants. I have to say, my tummy was very pleased!!! I'm a big French toast fan and I have to say, they nailed it!! The eggs were scrambled and cooked to perfection. I loved the home fries that were flavored just right. 

The service was excellent! Very friendly and food came out pretty quickly. Prices are very reasonable and the settings of the restaurant are nice as well. I would highly recommend to others looking for a great breakfast spot!

I normally don't write yelp reviews, this is actually the first, but the treatment I got was outstanding, let me explain. *Note: This review is strictly for the service department, the sales team actually treated me horribly because I was a kid, little did they know I had deep pockets... I ended up buying a better truck for cheaper in Vegas, but that is another story.

I had just bought a brand new '17 Chevy Colorado Z71 Midnight Edition, less than 2K miles on it when I noticed the front left wheel was squeaking. I knew it wasn't a simple fix, because it happened only at slow speeds (under 5mph) and had nothing to do with the brakes or steering pump. All that said, I called the service department to get an appointment, I don't remember her name, but it was a female and she was able to squeeze me in first thing in the morning, around 7:45 am. She did this to ensure I was the first vehicle on the lift, but when I got there that morning, things took a turn.

As I drove in to the bay, all the mechanics didn't seem happy to see me and kinda looked angry, except for one, one guy at the end with a beard was so happy to see me! It was kinda strange actually haha. I got to the end and was greeted by a guy named Frank, and man, was he the BEST! He asked me some basic questions, and then took the keys and had it taken back into the shop. We both then went into his office, sat down and that's when he realized I didn't have an appointment. So I showed him the confirmation email, and he squeezed my name in even though for some odd reason I wasn't in the que. After that was all said and done, I signed some papers and then we got to talking about our trucks and it was a great conversation! It was great to see a mechanic with such a interest and passion for vehicles, totally stood out among the others who weren't even happy to see me pull in. Anyhow, all said and done Frank had no time estimate, which was fine, especially since neither of us knew the exact cause of the problem.

So I went to the waiting room, they have a TV and WiFi, nothing special, I ended up waiting over 5hrs until they even got it on the lift and found out what the cause was. (Some broken seal near the transfer case or something) and once Frank knew the diagnosis, he then gave me an estimate and I decided to go home and pick it up at the end of the day.

Now, I may be more patient than others, but the whole reason I wrote this review and lengthy story was to fully explain how in the world someone can go in for a simple fix, wait over 5 hours until it even got on the lift, and still leave a 5 star review. And here's why:

It's simple, Frank was by far the best mechanic I have ever dealt with. He made a point to not forget about me and update me the second he knew the status of my truck every step of the way. This was hugely important. Waiting sucks, but blindly waiting is unbearable. Overall, I don't know what position Frank is in, but with this kind of service, he should be overseeing the whole department! Even with all the frustration that comes with repairing a vehicle, from the client and mechanic side, I left perfectly happy solely because of the interaction I had with Frank, great guy, great employee!

Can't say enough good things about Famous Dave's restaurant. Their menu has a wide selection, their atmosphere has a good vibe, their prices are very fair, and their staff is excellent. Our waitress came out and gave us a sauce sample (which had a very cute presentation) and since it was our first time there, we even left with a complimentary bottle of their barbecue sauce. Definitely take the time to stop by Famous Dave's!
Meh. I think maybe Tampa bay just doesn't have great indian food? Is that why there's such good reviews? I've been here for the lunch buffet a few times and am just not impressed. It's just ok.

Food was great. Service was poor. I went for my Dads birthday and we were rushed out the whole time. The server literally took the menu from my hands before asking if I was ready to order. Not expected from a fine dining restaurant.

There was a time I would have given Tryst 5 stars. Food was good, drinks reasonably priced and the house music best in town. During a recent visit July 7th the shift manager and wait staff had such the attitude - I found them to be pompus, arrogant and outright repugnant. The menu has erroded over the years from interesting to "safe". I guess the owner has lost his european flair and this now "just another place". Save your money and go the  champaign bar next door. Interesting food, great wine and champaign selection, attentive service and you can still enjoy the music from Tryst - its only 20 ft away.

If you are making a Mexican meal this is the best store for it. The meat is reasonable and there are so many things on sale here. Don't go by the ads on this place for sales. There are far more sales that they don't publish. I mean one month I got four stick of real butter for $1.49 a pack  This is my favorite place to shop. The only reason that I didn't give it five stars is because I think pulling their deli was BS.

I love Dierbergs, after moving to the city of St. Louis I was dissappointed there were no Dierbergs within the city limits this is the closest one (I think) to my place. I really like their Deli, they have the best cooked meals, meats, deli items etc. The store is always clean and staff is very helpful! Also love the little directories on the side of each isle!

Maybe it was just me - but nothing about my experience here was worth repeating.

From reading the other reviews, I guess it's better if you're ravenous!  But there are much better places that showcase St. Louis cuisine and are still within walking distance of all the downtown venues and Arch  

I'd head to Washington Ave. downtown, or head down to Soulard / Benton Park for better eats.

Everything here is what you need to give your kids a fun and exhausting day. Other reviewers talk about it being "filthy". No, it's actually quite clean to perform the duties required of a soft playground. In the 3 hours I was there, I saw employees wiping off slides and rides, and saw daycare employees religiously having children use hand sanitizer and blow noses. An employee and even other parents helped solve some kid drama after my daughter got hit somewhere in the labyrinth. I almost gave it 4 stars due to price...but keeping it clean and the snack bar is cheap enough...I gave it 5. Good place. Check it out!

2 stars because the taste is still amazing, if all you care about is how something tastes, this place is great. 
If you're like me and appreciate customer service, this place fails horribly! From not being greeted, having to break up the horseplay and conversations behind the counter just to ask for help, in the middle of ordering two more kids come in and the girl getting my order stops to go talk to her friends, another guy had to grab my cup and finish my order. When I asked what flavor something was, the girl tells me she can't see what I'm pointing at and I should read the label, problem was the label was missing. I asked for my receipt so I could reference my experience when I wrote them, which I did and still haven't heard back from Frost, the kid actually tells me they were out of paper and that the manager went to the store to get more. It's late at night and that was the excuse they gave me! 
We have gone here 2-3 times a month for about 3 years and this was by far the worst we've ever experienced. I doubt we'll be going back

I want to LOVE this place. Like full on just F'n LOVE it.
Here is what I do love about-
The pepperjack cheese sticks, The sriracha dipping sauce is just the right kind of spicy and damn good. The cheese sticks could stand alone but that dipping sauce makes it one of my favorite appetizers in all of Reno.
Their burgers are outstanding. Juicy, flavorful, cooked to order, one of Reno's best.
The fact that it used to be Carrow's actually makes it cooler to me. Maybe I'm just a nostalgic fool but I like that it's been remodeled and not just tore down.
The beer selection is really good, like that they focus on local brews.
The crazy hunky bartender that looks like he could be Jason Momoa's brother. He is funny, engaging and damn fun to gaze at. Hubba.
I want to LOVE IT, but I just can't.
The service is just too hit and miss. Some visits (I've made about a dozen) the service is outstanding, others have been horrible. Almost like there is no middle ground.
The chicken Caesar salad can be really good but sometimes the chicken is drier than the playa in August.
And as referenced in a few other reviews, the prices are a bit high for the type of food they serve. 
So, it's a solid well deserved 4 stars instead of the 5 I want to give but can't bring myself to.
But hey, now they have room to grow!

Wonderful service, kind people, and a clean and fresh place to go for spa services. I went for an eyebrow tint, being my first time for this service I was very nervous but the girl did a great job and was very patient. I had little to no redness after my waxing.  They obviously use quality product.

Don't bother stopping in here - I did you the favor of trying it out and am here to report our visit left a lot to be desired.

We tried the first two breakfast burritos. I'm pretty sure they are microwaved.

My bf commented the coffee tasted like a hotel coffee-really watery and bland. I ordered a cafe au lait and it was probably the worst one I've ever had. Taste and Calvin Fletcher Coffee Co make this drink the intended way, and it is a completely different beverage than what I was served here.

Two women walked in after my boyfriend and I had been seated for 5-10 minutes and their food was brought out before ours was.

This place might as well be a starbucks.  Very disappointing.

I love wine, so this is a favorite spot for me.  I have met a date many times here during happy hour for a glass of wine (or more), accompanied by some classy appetizers.  If you're a fan of wine and cheese, this is the spot for you.  I never have a full dinner here, but it's a great place to sip a glass of wine, have delicious fancy snacks, and chat with friends. The atmosphere is hip.  When you get a two person table, it also has a romantic and intimate vibe, which makes it good for a date.  Highly recommended!

I needed to fill some holes in my spice rack and was referred to TJ from a friend.   She assured me that Trader Joes had cheap spices and a good selection.

I'm not sure if all locations are the same , but the spice isle at this particular store was 2 feet wide and three shelves high.   They probably had 10-12 different spices in all and many were basic and useless .    Though the prices were rather low, I thought for a minute that I may have missed the ACTUAL spice isle and that this was perhaps a display shelf.

I traversed the entire market in search of some help to either aid me in locating the true spice isle or to assure me that their meager 10 jar shelf was the best they had to offer.    No luck.  I may have laid eyes on one or two employees but none were too concerned with making so much as eye contact w me let alone offer any help whatsoever.

Now I would be a whole lot more understanding if they store was super busy or it was the day before thanksgiving or something.   But this was just a lazy Saturday morning.....maybe 20 patrons in the entire place.  Just nothing to purchase and no one to convince me otherwise .   

So I dropped my basket on the floor and left.  Went to Albertsons where their spice isle was 20 - 30 feet long with hundreds of options from which to choose.  

I got every spice I was looking for in five minutes.   Many were 2 for $3.   

Not going to Trader Joes again any time soon....if ever.

Something about being drunk on bourbon screams eat fried chicken at the end of the night. The first time I had it my friend was force feeding it down my throat at 4:00 a.m after I had thrown up a daiquiri from this same establishment (don't be like my please). I knew it was good but the second time around and I ordered my own plate I realized how good it actually was. They have these sauces on the table and the orange looking one was sooooo good drunk me wanted to take the bottle back with me to Texas. The biscuits were so good my friend literally ordered a whole box. I honestly can't wait to get back to NOLA and get some more of this goodness.

If I could rate a business 6 stars, I would! This place is wonderful! Some of the best coffee I've had, with the largest selection of regular and sugar free syrups!  The owner is incredibly sweet and nice, and offered to make me another coffee if I wasn't 110% happy with my flavor choices!  And, this place is priced fairly as well! My fiancé and I will be flying home in 2 days, but we will definitely be back tomorrow to enjoy this wonderful place again!
The only reason I give this 3 stars is because of the ambience. The drinks were poorly made and muddled and the staff communicated poorly, making ordering drinks difficult and off-putting.

After reading the previous reviews I decided to try it out and was surprised by how disappointed I was. The staff was great, very welcoming and friendly, however the food was not. I ordered the Gabagool grinder with fries and a side salad. The salad was fine, but everything else was very dry/hard. The meat on the sandwich was very tender and tasty though, so I took it off the hard bread and tossed it in my salad. Unfortunately, I was not impressed, maybe it's because I got takeout? Regardless, I will not be returning.

Are you kidding me. That's how this review is starting out. "Fast and easy service for curbside" is a joke. I was out there parked in a curbside spot for 20+ minutes PAST my "order ready" time. I had to call them for them to notice my car parked out there to tell me "oh yeah it's ready!" HA. My food better not be cold. Once the girl brought my food out to me, all I got was an "we're really busy" and walked away. I'm sorry, but what? That's all you're going to offer? Not even a free drink or a "I'm sorry?" Absolutely DO NOT recommended coming here.
Perfect fried chicken. Yummy mustard greens and beans. Mac N Cheese was bland. Will definitely go back next time I am in New Orleans.

Yum. Everything we ate was so good. I highly recommend the shrimp and grits. So good. The oysters were amazingly fresh and a great deal during happy hour. The onion tart was a really interesting, different type of appetizer. Salads were fresh and high quality too.

Good atmosphere for friends, family, happy hour after the big game, or for date night.

Great place with good service. Highly recommend.

First time eating here. Food was great - sandwiches and sides. Tomato basil was super fresh and rich- delish. Very fresh, cheesy, customizable. Even a BYO-salad for healthier options. Staff was super helpful with options, menu, checking in on us at the table. Great experience. Will definitely be back!

Love this laundromat. I drive the extra miles to come here. The place is well lit, very clean and comfortable with tables to sit at while your machines run. I had to do a giant mass laundry day (20 bags of laundry including comforters and pillows.) and it was actually a pleasant experience thanks to the quality of the facility. Machines range from $3 for single load machines to $7 for 5 load washers. Dryers are $0.25 per 8 minutes for small machines and $0.25 for 5 minutes in the big machines. Use the big dryers. I put 3 comforters in one big dryer and they we're completely done in 30 minutes. Also nice was that the dyers would spin periodically if you couldn't get to them right away to keep the wrinkles from setting. With 10 large dryers going at once this was a really nice feature. The owner couldn't have been nicer or more accommodating. The best part, all the machines are either new or meticulously maintained because they were so shiny and efficient. And a third of all the washers and dryers took credit/debit cards. So low on cash, no problem. Especially cool for me since I ended up spending over $60 on laundry that day. Can you imagine how heavy all those quarters would have been. If you need a laundromat go here. They put all other fasciitis to shame!!

First time here.  Do NOT be discouraged by outside of building.  Place is CLEAN inside and the food is GREAT!  My husband had the tilapia, rice and peas, & plantains.  I had the jerked chicken, carrot rice and cabbage.  Both meals were wonderful and the service was exemplary.  Servings were plentiful, price is good and, again, the food was great.  We will be back again and again.  Excited to find this restaurant.

This review is based solely on food.  I'm Mormon, and Mormons don't drink (theoretically). But let me fill you in on a little secret-- not drinking means you indulge in food that much more because really, it's all you have to cling to. 

Village burger, duck fat frites WITH cheese sauce.  Pickled beets with ricotta and olive tapenade. Perfect in their simplicity, each and every item.

Service sucks but I liked the food so much I don't really care. It's the size of a tuna can in this place and it's a bar so I wasn't expecting super attentive service, but it was borderline obnoxious.  Perhaps when you aren't tossing back drinks and racking up your tab the server isn't too pleased you're taking up a table? I can understand.  I'm guessing on the weekends it's out of control, but on a weeknight it was tolerable and we didn't have to wait for a table.

Could do without the appetizers that were a bit greasy and nothing great but, fish first courses were both great- a shrimp one and one with hamachi. The lamb curry was good- but more of a gnocchi dish than meat focused dish. Pepper pot ok.  Every few minutes someone tried to take our dishes away. First the bread and our bread dishes- even when there was still bread on them- we had to stop them. Then, our drinks- which weren't finished and throughout the meal they kept asking if were were done and trying to grab our plates. Very weird. Still, enjoyed the food.

As a continuation of my reviews geared for students or "work-from-homers", here goes....

TABLES: Good assortment of small, medium and large tables.
CHAIRS: Comfortable but hard. Two couches, two soft plushes.
NOISE: Low noise.
ESPRESSO: n/a
TEA: Many refreshing tea choices!
FOOD: Biscuits, croissant, sandwiches
Wi-Fi: FREE
ATM: nope
HOURS: 8am-9pm (10pm Fri, Sat) CLOSED SUNDAYS!
ATMOSPHERE: Chill, quiet, large and rather sparsely populated.
LIGHT: Tons of natural light because you are surrounded by windows.
PERKS: Sit and surf for as long as you like.
DOWNSIDE: This place is pretty ideal for studying! What can I say?

great breakfast place. never been here for lunch or dinner but for breakfast it's very good. They have great bacon and the prices are reasonable. Always have the food out quickly too which I like. Its always busy for a reason and its spotlessly clean. 
My step father had the chicken fried steak that he said was the best he's ever had. The biscuits and gravy were excellent. 

You can't miss for breakfast!

This is one of the nicer and cleaner McDonalds I have been to!  They even had a couple of touch screens that allow you to order and skip the normal line.   The bathrooms and seating area is clean.  They also still have hazelnut iced coffee, which some locations have discontinued!  The only thing is that the cinnamelts we ordered for breakfast were kind of dry and not very warm. :(

I wrote a review last year and want to update it.  This is my second time getting a cake here and both times I have found that Evelhyinne was a pleasure to work with - she was kind, accomodating and willing to work within my budget.  The cake she made was amazing.  I was really so happy with how my order turned out, and it was very reasonably priced.  My son loved his cake and cupcakes.  This place is definitely a hidden gem.  Thank you!

Average sushi. Horrible service. Just ordered on Uber eats and the food took 30 minutes longer than estimated. Essentially took an hour and a half to get my dinner. When I called the restaurant to check on the order, they were not helpful at all.
Excellent pedicure! I am a salon owner and I know a good pedicure when I get one ! Keep up the good work !

Reasonably priced, laid back, easy. I prefer my tacos with corn tortillas, so really these are burritos with flour tortillas (if you wanna get technical).  Good sangria. Loved the buffalo chicken taco innards. Nice people.

Happy Retales is the retail shop for Happy Tales Humane, the no-kill animal shelter.  Most of the proceeds for everything they sell go right back to help the animals.  I buy all of my cat's supplies here just for that reason--he was once a stray too!  

You can find anything you need for your cat or dog here--from food and treats to clothes, collars, and cat litter.  It's a smaller store, but packed full with merchandise.  The sales folks are nice too, and can usually answer any question you throw at them!  

It's always nice knowing that when you buy something you need anyway, your money is going to help stray and unwanted animals as well.  Much better than shopping at a big-box retailer!  

YAY for Happy Tales!
Good food. Good service. Nice people. Fat guy portions. What more do you need? I had a salad and everyone else got sandwiches and burgers. Good stuff!

If you took away the Citizens Bank sponsorship, I'd give it a 5, but they are such a terrible bank, one star removed. This is a great modern stadium with a nod to the classic stadiums of the early 20th Century. There really are no bad seats, and though the price of a ticket has gone up, you can still find prices that match the old Vet on Stub Hub. There is also a huge variety of food and a good (if overpriced) beer selection, and it was voted the number one stadium for vegetarians in the country.

I recently stayed here for a family member's wedding.  The hotel exterior and lobby are somewhat dated but the rooms are reasonably modern.  There is free wifi but it is slow with spotty ability to connect.  Loud hallways made for early wake ups.  On day 2 of our 4 night stay a bad odor developed in our room and persisted after being cleaned by the maid service.  This wasn't acceptable given the cost of the room ($130 a night) and my wife and I elected to stay at the Hyatt at the Arch for the remainder of the trip (cheaper and cleaner).  Not impressed with this hotel.

I was visiting Philadelphia and had planned on walking around but it was sweltering hot outside. I happened by this place and ducked in, figuring a pedicure would give me a good hour of air conditioning. Turns out, it was a great pedicure (with foot and shoulder massage, as others have noted). The staff was so nice. The place was beautiful. If I lived nearby I'd make this my new go-to place for pedicures.

I could not be happier with how the flowers turned out for our wedding on 8-18-18. I never had a trial or anything so everything was done based off of pictures I sent Jen. She nailed it. The centerpieces, bouquets, corsages, boutonnieres, aisle runners, everything was gorgeous!  She was extremely responsive and professional. I'd highly recommend her!

I ordered from Chef's Market for a small corporate event. I had the whole process and menu confused, but they(Debbie) worked with me as much as she could to get something that was perfect for my event.  The sandwiches, chips, and salad were all great, and the gourmet cookies got rave reviews.  I couldn't be happier with the service, helpfulness, and quality of this organization and its products.  

*highly recommend"

The cakes are delicious but extremely over priced. I've had better cakes at better prices and I don't find this place to be worth the money unless you are going for specifically the environment. Coffee is also very overpriced. Gorgeous interior though. If there's one thing you do try, try the Caramel cake.

I went in as a fan of Chicago-style pizza, which 312 advertises itself as specializing in.  Maybe I'm not fully versed in the details of Chicago-style, but I was slightly disappointed in a few details.  First, however, the ambiance and service were great.  I arrived about 6pm on a Tuesday and found a place to park right on the street outside.  My waitress was charming and attentive, so no problems there.  I ordered a deep-dish 10" cheese & pepperoni, expecting to eat half there and take the other half home.  My waitress warned me they take a while to cook - app. 45 minutes.  Which it did. Good thing I wasn't starving.  When the pizza came, there was plenty, but the sauce...oh, the sauce!  Tomato sauce dripping from every conceivable spot on the pizza, overwhelming the taste of the cheese and even the pepperoni.  And the crust was surprisingly hard, as if overdone.  But it was definitely thick with cheese and definitely filling.  I still have yet to eat my leftovers so my opinion may change slightly, but I doubt I'll be coming back.

Oh, and the price - $20 for a 10" one-topping pizza.  I bit the bullet because it sounded so good, but my total bill was almost $30 and definitely not worth what I got.

UPDATE: Apologies for getting a couple of factual items incorrect.  I went back and re-looked at the online menu to get my facts straight.  It was indeed a 12" pizza, and the price was $17.  With an iced tea, tax, and tip my total bill came to right about $30.  Probably not out of line, but less than satisfied with final product as indicated above. I apologize for any mischaracterization of the value.

Love Makiman. I come here at least once a month and have never been disappointed with the food or service. It's not some posh or swanky sushi bar, but the sushi is some of the best in the city (I eat sushi 1-2 times per week). They've got a huge variety of really great fushion-rolls. Must try: NE Viking, Cap'n Crunch, Sixers, and Caterpillar. It's surprisingly affordable for the quality of the sushi, and it's a BYOB. What's not to love?!
Great food and owner is a nice personable young man.  Highly recommend this restaurant.
50's diner and sports bar, good breakfast for normal prices. This place is packed as hell on sundays so expect a short wait for a seat.

I don't know or care to know about the restaurant side of this place.

All I want is my bag of crawfish, (maybe some mushrooms, corn, and potatoes) and to scuttle back to my hotel room, where I will eat them all while watching "say yes to the dress".

I keep going here, I keep loving it, I keep wanting more. 

I know you locals say there is a season to crawfish, that some months they are better and other months you want to stay away. But I am from the frozen north, from the land of the ice and steel grey skies. I will eat any and all mudbugs that you feel are lacking.


That is all.
Unbelievable market with Italian wines, homemade pastas and a great grocery!
An ok place. Music is nice, calamari was not the best, but the piña colada was great...
Our family of four really enjoyed the atmosphere and food here.  Our waitress was friendly and efficient, and the baby back ribs and sides were delicious.  We will be back!

Love this place! The sushi is delicious, so fresh, so yummy! You can bring your non-sushi eating friends, their noodle bowls are delicious too. The service is great, and the stuff is friendly. I love that I don't have to drive into the city for great sushi.

Beautiful, modern facility with a ton of options other than bowling. Instead of a rehearsal dinner for our wedding, we did a game night with our families here. The event planner for the space gave us two lanes at a discounted rate with food options. Everyone had a great time enjoying the lanes, bar, chess table and foosball.

First time to try seafood crepe and it was delicious, loaded with shrimp  and crab meet , and dill on the top giving it a different experience, definitely recommend it for breakfast and lunch,y wife had the belt eggwich and she said it is full of flavors and delicious.

I was impressed the minute I walked in, and I left even happier.

Very clean and modern inside, not the usual drab interior of a local Chinese restaurant. The service was very attentive and nice, and we ordered quickly.

The Food? Very good quality, I was very happy with my dish and appetizer. Since I'm a fan of Chinese food, I always order hot tea, and it was also good.

This is one of my new favorite local restaurants!
This is really good food. I've had better in New York City but this is really tasty. I got the combo meat salad. Hard to beat five bucks for dinner.
Great local Mexican with real, real horchata. Had a really good carne asada gotta with great salsa, all 3 heat levels.

Chop Stix is like a mini PF Changs...similar food and quality, nice atmosphere, great servers, food comes out fast. The happy hour from 3-5pm is awesome, great appetizer prices and adult beverages. As of this review, local hotel guests receive a discount. The servers and cooks are very open about changing up the menu for your dish. The food is really good.

I leave very close to Mood and it is one of my favorite places in West Philly. The Salad Chaat is my fave and it's even better when you add chicken. The rice pudding they keep in the fridges opposite of the counter is killer.

We went to Farmhaus last weekend for probably the 10th-15th time.  As always, the food was amazing.  The mushroom salad was very tasty and the breakfast was as wonderful as always.  It is definitely one of my favorite meals there-or anywhere.  

In the past, I would have given Farmhaus five stars and moved on.  

However, after we sat, we were informed of the chef's tasting menu-a new addition since the last time we had been there.  All was good and the menu looked great.  Out of our party of four, we definitely had 1-2 people interested in this tasting menu, particularly because their morel mushroom pasts could only be ordered off this menu, not the regular menu.  
The problem is that Farmhaus insists that each person at the table order a tasting menu if one person does.  Well, not everyone wanted a tasting menu!  We had a person with us recovering from the flu and he inquired whether he could split a tasting menu as he had little appetite and just wanted a bite of food.  Nope, each person had to order their own.  So we had 2 people who wanted the tasting menu (at over 50 dollars) and two who did not.  Any flexibility?  No.  We even thought about splitting the table up and having the two who wanted the tasting menu go sit by themselves so they could order what they wanted.  I'm not sure that is something we should have had to consider.  
We finally ordered entrees and moved on but were still very disappointed in the way this was handled and the inflexibility of the menu.  After this, plus a bill that seemed higher than usual (Did they raise their prices recently?) we have decided not to return.  

I do want to say our server was amazing.  She was very nice and did apologize for the inflexibility of the menu nicely-but there was nothing she could do about it.  

I am disappointed as this was one of our favorite restaurants, but again-I do not think we will be returning after this.

Good Asian food in a nice and lively neighborhood. We ordered shrimp lo-mein and chicken in hot sauce(it was hot) so if u don't  like spicy food then please do not order this :) dinner portion is quite big two people can easily share if you have small appetite. One thing I noticed was that sea food items like fish and specially shrimp dishes are priced little too much compare with other proteins. But the place is a keeper and I will go back.
Great food. Awesome service. Make sure you order the table-side guacamole!!! The drinks are also very delicious. The atmosphere, especially on the patio, is very romantic at night. I love this place.

Absolutely amazing!!  Everything we put into our mouths was completely delish'. From the new white sangria to the shrimp and grits to the banana bread pudding. Great atmosphere, friendly, hip, knowledgable staff. Love everything about this eclectic place!

Always fresh, fast, and delicious. This is one of my regular stops. Either location is good for my gyro fix, and service is always fast and friendly. 
I usually get the deluxe. My husband experiments with different gyros... He likes the spicy one and the Z. My daughter has enjoyed the chicken bacon ranch as well. Don't hesitate to stop! They are awesome!
beautiful restaurant with amazing service. food was great too!

This place was walking distance from the Westin hotel where I was staying. It gets really packed for dinner (especially if there is a convention in town) so I would try and make a reservation. We sat a party of 16 in the bar area since the dining room was all booked out.

Random Fact: St Elmo and Harry & Izzy's are owned by the same person.

Shrimp Cocktail - it was definitely the highlight of the meal. Great fresh shrimp with a cocktail-horseradish sauce that was awesome. I can tell why it is famous!
Calamari - not bad, but nothing mind-blowing
Seared Tuna - was fresh and pretty good. I did not care for the seaweed salad. It tasted kind of old to me.
Toasted Ravioli - okay. It was not crispy and I would have liked more flavor inside other than just cheese. It was like a mozzarella stick in ravioli form.

Lamb Chops - bland, under-cooked, cold. This was just not good. The apps were okay but this entree really turned me off from this place. It just lacked everything I would like in meat.

The rest of my party agreed that the entrees were a real disappointment. Great service and good drinks, but it could not save the entrees. If we are paying top dollar, then we would like the food to be on par with that. If I just had the entree, it would be 1 star, but everything else in the restaurant brought it up another star. Sadly do not think I will be coming back for dinner.

After discovering that my previous hairdresser was too super religious to have a reasonable gay marriage rights discussion, I felt it was probably time to move on. Plus it's not a great idea to insight holy furor in someone hold sharp objects to your head...

Anyway, thanks to some Yelp reviews I decided to try this salon, and booked with Christopher. I prepared myself for the usual battles I enter when dealing with people who don't know what to do with curly hair, but right away realized I had no reason to fear. Christopher sat me down to discuss my follicle needs before shampooing and whatnot, good sign right off the bat. Then asked if he could do a dry cut on me, which I'd heard about but was super skeptical to try... But what the hell it's only hair. After washing, conditioning, sculpting my curls into cute ringlets and drying under one of those big helmet driers (I usually refuse to get blow dried), he proceeded to take each individual curl and cut. 

Well honey I'm converted! Not only did it make so much more sense than wet cutting (curly haired sisters you know what I mean), but I could actually see what the cut was going to look like as he was doing it. So when he finished and asked if I liked it I didn't have to say yes with the hopes that when I washed it at home it wouldn't look ridiculous. He even sent me home with a product sample to try out. 

On a random personal note: I was telling my mom about this new salon I tried, and knowing that her mom had grown up in that area we looked it up. Sure enough, my grandmother grew up at 1218 Locust St and her father had a tailor shop on the first floor! We're trying to find a photo we know she has of herself sitting on the steps as a little girl. Man I love Philly =)

Amazing dosas. Terrible everything else. I ordered a chicken curry and the chicken pieces in it were breaded (Were they originally chicken nuggets? Who knows!). Biriyani was bland and featured cheap cinnamon sticks instead of cinnamon bark and obviously frozen mixed veggies. I've heard they've cleaned the place up a little since my visit but the interior was horrendous and dirty.

The lunch buffet is now Friday only.

The nice thing about ordering off the menu is that the injera is now served warm.  However, if you order the wrong dish, you're stuck with food that you don't really like.  I tried the Tibs Wot when I think I meant to order the Queen's Beef Tibs.  Whoops.  My dish was a bit salty, and I wish that I had less of the beef and more of the side vegetables, which were much more tasty.

Went here a couple of weeks ago.  I had the Butchers Chili....freaking awesome!!!!  My husband had Onion Porter Soup...WINNER.  We shared Reek Donkey Fish Spread...Fantastic.  Wish this place was closer to Lakeland.  Loved it!!!!

What a great find. With staff eager to share their love of the beer it's hard to leave without one of everything. That's what I did, and I only wish I would have bought more. 

The Fruit Fetish Vivid Berry might be one of the best Lacto kettle fruir sours I've had. Fruit forward is an understatement with the Cloudy and Cumbersome, like drinking mango fruit leather. Finally Tickle Parts and an IPA Fan's must grab. 

So I cannot wait for my next visit and delicious malty brew.

A tea room, is NOT just a tea room! Along with a restaurant calling itself a tea room comes the expectations of being transported in time to a kinder, quieter and more relaxed time.
I have been to this tea room, several times. It is usually fairly quiet, the decor is okay, but not overly inviting or comfortable.  The staff is usually knowledgeable,  efficient and polite.
The food quality varieties, as do some of the food offering.
I love scones and their scones are biscuits. The Devonshire cream is absolutely delicious.  The tea varieties are generally good.
They have completely commercialized their business. Murder Mystery dinners at night and interactive dinners.
I am all for small businesses growing and flourishing,  but not at the expense of the product. If you are going to do something, then devote all your energy to it and do it great. I think they need to get off the fence, make some positive changes and stick to their concept and business plan.
Really disappointed in this new twist of event, I really like the owners.
What's a girl to do? Be true to your scones, they are not biscuts.

As a non-meat eater, the menu is not the most friendly in the world but I don't even care. Dining on a Friday meant the veggie lasagna was the special and it a perfect amount for two (we added a salad and it was PLENTY).

The cocktails...oh my...just incredible. 

Only one small thumbs-down: the pretzel cone - sounds delicious, right? Well, perhaps we had a bad batch, but ours was hard, verrry salty (and I love salt) and overall not delicious. 

A lovely date spot as well :)

Jumbo margs and cheap shots?  Yes, please!  I shy away from here when it's colder, but you can find me on that patio with friends once a week during the summer.  It's definately a great time and I've never had an issue with service (unless they are super duper busy).  

I have eaten here and it wasn't that great, I wouldn't reccomend coming here for dinner- but if you want to have fun and get loud, this is definately a place to check out.  

They also have a good deal on buckets/pitchers.

I rode the airbus for four years while attending UCSB and have minimal grips with the service. Flights out of SBA to home were few and far between (and 2-4  as expensive as those from LAX) so this is a cost-effective way travel between SB and LA. The air bus offered an $80 round trip on a clean, well-maintained bus. Their website is simple and clear, making booking a trip straightforward and fast.

The departure point for Santa Barbara is pretty out of the way though - the local MTD buses do not drop passengers off close to the station so there's quite a bit of walking and luggage-dragging to be done if you don't take a taxi there.

Regardless, it's a great service. Along with being clean, the buses offer water, soda, and snacks out of a cooler for about a dollar.
From the drinks to the food, this place is absolutely fabulous. Eat everything. Drink everything.

This place is not the typical restaurant! It actually looks like a brothel inside except all the private rooms are dining rooms, not that I've frequented a lot of brothels in my time. Awkward. lets move on. 

So you get a big group of people (not for a gang bang... this is not a brothel) and you make sure to make your reservation in advance because you won't be eating here other wise. once you're seated the rest takes care of itself. Its like a tasters menu where you get 10 courses of food that is plopped in front of you ready to be massacred by your hands (I really don't remember using tools to eat? Was I that Drunk?) Needless to say the food tastes amazing (not because I was drunk that day.. I've been here a few times) the service is incredible the belly dancer does her thing, but most importantly you come here for the company!!!

Was really nice to visit there. Everything was laid out and it was beautiful. However the snow tubing was a little bit of a letdown. Long lines and the tubing is not very long. Also they need to hire better traffic directors. One guy got frustrated at us and made a nasty comment. That we can hear through our open window as we ask for directions being our first time up there.

So this restaurant is in a colorful area of town full of lovely ethnic restaurants. First thing, love that they have their own parking lot. On a chilly day it is nice to park close. The  food is delicious. Tasty, fresh dumplings that can be boiled, steamed, or pan fried with a variety of fillings. They did not have the Lamb with Dill. So we ordered Chicken with Curry Dumplings, Lamb with Coriander, and Beef with Tomatoes as well as the fresh noodles splashed with chili oil. All were delicious, however the lamb with coriander were our favourite.  Huge portions, delicious, fresh and flavourful and a very kind server. However, it was slightly run down on the inside and both of us found it very cold inside. Two things that could use some improvement. But for the price, quality and quantity of food we will definitely be back to try other flavours. They also have a take out/pick up option  which would take care of the atmosphere. Try it! I don't think you will be disappointed.

Terrible service!!!  I usually never complain but 20 min to get drinks?  45 minutes to get pizza?  This is a pizza place and they should be cranking these things out.  We got one large cheese pizza and it took forever.  Worse part is the waiter didn't even check on us.  The manager did comp the bill, but I can tell this kind of problem happens all the time here.

3rd year to stay in this hotel! The renovations were complete this year & the rooms are clean, updated, & spacious.
We choose this property based on location & secure parking! Beds are super comfortable! 

I will say the staff at checkin is overworked & understaffed for the number of guest. They were extremely short (borderline rude) at check in & no one answered calls to the front desk the entire stay.

Totally delicious. So glad I went. I couldn't stop raving about the food as I was eating. We got the appetizer sampler, chicken shawarma, and shish kebab. The service was a little slow but I don't care because the food makes it 100% worthwhile.

Had an amazing time at Kinky Quizzo. Was sad it was the last one for the summer. $2 bud lites, drag queen trivia hosts, and a friendly crowd-this place was great. I hate to label this a "gay" bar since I've gone there several times and I'm a chick engaged to a dude, but yes, people of the LGBT community frequent this establishment. They have good food, my fiance ordered the cheesesteak and it was pretty awesome. My other friend ordered a burger and he really enjoyed it. They have drink specials throughout the week and the service was good,  a little slow, but the place was packed. The bartenders were extremely friendly and I can't wait to go back when trivia starts up again.

I was looking for a place in Cool Springs and decided to give them a try. I was treating my daughter so we got the basic mani/pedi. I was impressed by the cleanliness and professionalism. Since I am in healthcare I wash my hands all the time. The technician talked to me about the gel manicure, but it was not a hard sell which I appreciated. So far my fingernails haven't chipped, but that always has more to do with myself than the manicure. The pedicure was relaxing and looks great. We will be back even if we make the trip only for this salon.


Update: The attached picture six days after my manicure. I have moved furniture, packed boxes, washed my hands 1 million times, and did my normal daily activities and my manicure still looks great!

Oh my goodness!  This broth was amazing!  It was flavorful and a good amount of spice that I was looking for!  If loving this broth is wrong, I don't want to be right!  I like the atmosphere, as it is simple and I met the owner Deanna who very nice!  Our waitress was very nice!  The only thing was that my water glass was not big enough!  I got the spicy miso and it was still good spicy but enough that I need the water once I got too much of a good slurp.  I loved how simple the menu was and the nice waitress hadn't a problem or haughtiness about answering my questions!  After all I've had ramen but am no pro!  The presentation was beautiful and everything in the soup was yummy!  My favorite part was the tender perfectly cooked piece of pork floating around in my soup!  So good I only broke off pieces of it as I ate as not to miss the tastiness!  Yum, yum, yum!  When we got there at about 5 we were in line but being that I consulted Google about the business for Friday, we only stood in line for maybe five minutes, which was enough time to greet my pal I was meeting there!  Listen to Google!  Lol

When I'm in Castleton this is a cool place to visit and it reminds me a bit of when I lived in Virginia Beach. Joe's Crab Shack is the kind of locals hangout you would find on the Chesapeake Bay. In fact, the restaurant sits right on a small lake. Joe's is a fun place that has the staff come out and dance to a hit from the 80's every 45 minutes... they have King Crab, Snow Crab, Dungeness Crab, Lobster, Oysters, Clams, Mussels, Salmon, Shrimp, Tilapia and more.
bamm freaking love this place good is great staff is super friendly and what a grwat value. well worth the trip !!!!!!

We ordered the Mexican salad and cucumber ginger lime fresca. The salad was really good and the addition of goat cheese was so unique and enhanced the taste. The cucumber ginger lime fresca was okay maybe the ginger was too strong but it left a bitter taste which didn't make us a fan of it. Would've given it 4 stars if the fresca would've been better.

I am happy to say, Cassy the owner and executive chef at HWK has contacted me and was in shock that I had the experience that I did. She assured me that was not their policy and was going to use this situation as a teaching moment with her front of the house staff. 

I appreciated her outreach and will attempt to dine at HWK again. Once I do, hopefully you'll see another increase in stars.

Nice little coffee shop on the outskirts of the Vanderbilt campus.  Solid ambience, great coffee.  Larger place than meets the eye.  Counters, tables, free WiFi.  Will go back when I travel through Nashville again.

Thoroughly enjoyed it! Chicken biriyani had boneless meat which is always nice. Spice level was just above mild. Chicken tikka masala had a nice warm flavor. The garlic naan was just ok -- didn't taste fresh. But if you dunk it in sauce, it's just fine!

While the line was quite long, (about 45 minutes to an hour) we weren't disappointed once we finally got in and seated. The Pecan Pancakes were amazing!! Not overly sweet, and the chopped pecans in the syrup that was brought with the dish added a nice crunch. The hash browns were crispy and fresh, and the bacon was perfectly cooked. The Sweet Potato pancakes were equally delicious, complemented nicely with the cinnamon cream syrup, which the boyfriend delightfully ate by the spoonful all by itself. Overall, we were very impressed. Worth the wait when you have time!

I've tried many of the local sushi places and this place is by far my favorite.  The family who runs it is super nice and they remember us now when we come in!  

I usually get a few of the rolls.  I've tried most of them at this point and there aren't any that I wouldn't recommend.  I do love their crunchy spicy tuna and salmon rolls though.  My fiance gets one of the sushi dishes and the fish is always fresh.    

Don't let the unimpressive outside turn you off.  I would definitely classify this place as a hole in the wall, but it's clean and we always have a great experience with the food and the service!

Ordered a buffalo chicken cheesesteak. Extremely watery. Lack luster taste. Allegedly comes with blu cheese, but really doesn't. Ordered the meal with fries for an extra 2.50 and it legitimately came with a small child's handful of fries. Extremely disappointed in the cheapness. And lack of quality. Seek a good meal elsewhere because it's clear they're on a budget.

When we visit Reno, we like to stay at this Courtyard.  It is a bit off the beaten path from the main drag, but we enjoy ourselves there.  

Its quite, and easy to get around from.  We enjoy how clean it is, and their customer service has always been right on.  We wouldn't hesitate to recommend it to anyone

I enjoyed a nice meal here this evening first time I've been there with a friend of mine.
Marshall was our waiter he was very attentive and helpful the inside of the restaurant is very colorful and clean.
This located in the sticks area of Reno Midtown and there was parking out front which made it easy to enter the restaurant.
I had the fried pork chop which was pretty good and the macaroni and cheese which the waiter said was epic I didn't quite find it epic but it was good.
My friend enjoyed the baby back ribs and she let me sample one and it was very very good. We both chose salads as sides and they were tasty also.
We split the bread pudding for dessert but it was full of raisins and I'm not a fan of raisins but otherwise it was a nice dessert.
May try it again for lunch in the summer.
Yum yum yum!  The new menu is great. I really like the HUGE pretzel. I wish it had a cheesy sauce with the mustard but all in all it's a-ok!
We got a selection of asada, carnitas, shrimp, and al pastor tacos and they were pretty amazing. They also carry taramind jarritos which is hard to find. Love this little find right off the fwy

Stayed at the Sandpiper lodge this weekend. And the price was about $120 for Sat night. I thought it was a bit pricey for what we got, but I figured Santa Barbara is a pricey area. Nothing special about the lodge. I didn't use there small pool or eat there danishes. We pretty much just slept there at the end of the night and checked out first thing in the morning. the front desk people were really nice. It's not far from State St. So its conveniently located. The small refrigerator under the TV made a ton of noise at night so we had to pull back the unit and unplug it just to be able to sleep.

The small rainbow sticker drew us inside. Always glad to see GLBT friendly businesses. 

This place has a warm atmosphere that's very local-centric (and dog friendly) and welcoming to NOLA visitors.  The veggie wrap, breakfast sandwich and grits were all OUTSTANDING and hot. My wife can't have caffeine, so a truly superb decaf beverage is gold when done right. She said her decaf vanilla soy latte is the best one she's ever had anywhere. 

Also, this is New Orleans, the city that never stops drinking - without apology. Do yourself a favor and indulge in a double fireball mocha. A+++

The G. Anthony Walker Report: I found for my taste buds the Ruby's Diner (RD's) at the King Of Prussia PA, mall is not all that for the breakfast meal. I had a simple 2 fried eggs hard, Hash Browns and French Combo. Definitely nothing to write home about. Although the place is nicely themed in a 50's diner/Johnny Rockets (Red color theme), beautiful esthetics, that was the only thing going for it. The service was less than average in my humble opinion.
Recommendation: Try it once your experience maybe better on a different day different location. I have no plans on giving them a 2nd try any time soon.
great customer service very professional and Polite, wine bottle fell out of box and they cleaned it up and replaced it at no charge , very helpful when asking questions also

Best country fried steak I have ever had!  My family has been coming here for 7 years, sometimes we ride bikes here or take our golf cart.  Nancy always greets us by name and makes us feel right at home!  Their grits are slow cooked, creamy and absolutely perfect (and I am a northerner!!! I DON'T eat grits!! But now I do at Caposey's!)  The crab cake Benedict is awesome too!!

We used to love this place, but not so much after tonight. Everything was cold, the ribs were dry, the Portabella mushroom was tiny, and they didn't even bother to include a bun in our take out order. I'm not sure what has happened to this place, but we will not be going back.
Love the ladies here. Creative, fun, and you never know what you will see. They have some really unique items, vintage, and a few local products as well.

This was our second appointment with Aptive! Demitrus Williams was our tech.  He was very courteous and listened to my questions and concerns and then applied the treatments as requested. He went above what my expectations for the service would be during his appt. thanks Demitrus!

i had a big birthday party here because i heard from a friend you could bring your own beer. i thought that would be a great money saver. it was - but scheduling the party was a confusing hassle. i felt like i didnt have all the information up front, even though i stopped in to confirm the date. i kept getting new info about fees later on in the planning process. i didnt even know we were getting a band until the day of, but i was glad we got one. the day of the party was unseasonably cold, and the party space is not insulated, so i would suggest u have parties here only in nice weather. but my friends braved it and were rewarded with great food.

I like this place because the street it is on is like an alley. It seems that you must be in the know to know this place. The bar is small but really nice. They have a rotating tap list that makes this a regular stop for me. The food is good. It is pizza. The salads are very generous and big enough to share. This is a great late, late night spot.

Solid French bistro style brunch. Very tasty food. Great location, quick service, but limited menu. The crawdad omelet and French toast were excellent. No waiting for a table, unlike Stanley's across the square.  Nice open air seating with all doors to the street open, french cafe style, with views of the oldest Catholic church in the US.  We would eat here again.  Fast and tasty.  Bottomless coffee. Eat here and get on with sightseeing.

Came here on President's day and it was extremely crowed, just an hour to get in. No where to sit, lockers were very small, and long lines for everything. When the dude with the funky toes came over to the "kids" area to wash up and blow his snot onto the floor, I knew it was time to go. Should of listened to the other reviews.

It's okay, we went on a busy Saturday night and while the place was busy it wasn't packed solid.  The food was bland, and my dish was dry as a bone (not even a sauce to help things).  The only saving grace was the beer.  I would give it another try next year when we come back but only if we run out of other places to go.
Coffee was very weak.  Might try again but perhaps would not order their coffee.  Also, no customer experience or interaction.  Not even a hello.

We ended our mini vacation with this evening dinner cruise. It was a perfect ending to our NOLA trip. The sunset and scenery were beautiful. We had our anniversary dinner on the cruise, buffet had a great select and bread pudding dessert were fantastic too. In honor of our anniversary we received complimentary champagne as well. Our server was great and treated us like celebrities. 
The band playing throughout the cruise was great. They were very talented. I truly recommend that you add this lunch or dinner cruise as must do in New Orleans.

I was here for the first time in a couple years last night. The manager was very friendly and had as laughing. We ordered a lg sausage pizza and it only took like 8 mins to cook. They put so much sausage on the pizza it was amazing. The cannolis were also very good. Will def return soon.
Food is amazing, beers are good, prices are a big steep.  The atmosphere is incredible though.  Absolutely love the vibe of this place

Quite possibly the best restaurant in the city. The food is as fresh as it gets and the flavors explode in your mouth. It may take a little time to get your food, but it's worth the wait. They are chopping your vegetables to order after all! 

I've been exploring this menu slowly since I keep forgetting to eat here, but everything I've had has been delicious and exciting.

The service is friendly and warm. It's a family run business and they are cooking with love and you can taste it with every bite.

Grande Besito...Best Mexican..everything is served with love and made with love. We drive an hour to just put ourselves in a nacho guacamole queso coma. Please open one in Sarasota before We die..gracias.

This place is an old favorite of mine in Chinatown! 
We always used to go here after shows at the Trocodero near by.  
The decor inside is a neat industrial style type things, but I think they have remodeled a little since the last time I went.

Penang has a huge selection of Malaysian food, you can definitely find something for everyone. One of my favorite dishes to get there is the appetizer of naan and curry dipping sauce. Holy hell it's delicious.

Otherwise I also like the crispy seafood noodles and their curry dishes!

They also give you oranges at the end of your meal (at least they used to, haven't been in some time) !

Go if you're in Chinatown for sure.

I am SO MAD that I did not discover this place earlier in my trip! After a disastrous job done at a shop that shall not be named - I was referred to Buff. I got excellent, conscientious service from WHITNEY. I was sad to learn that she is moving away this summer - I was planning to make her my go to every time I visit New Orleans. She swears, however, that everyone in the salon is as good as she is and that we both are very picky about our nails.

The chorizo taco is the best. The fish taco is pretty boring. Chicken tinga I'd give 3 out of 5.

Ask for Cooter.

I love Leo's. My girlfriend and I will stop in when it's open in the summer, and neither of us have had a bad dish. Wonderful, freshly homemade ice cream, and the cashiers are sweethearts... The only thing I could ask them to improve, really, would be to take credit cards. It's a cash-only operation. (There is an ATM in Waller's Deli next door, but it does have a service fee.) Other than that, keep doing what you're doing, Leo's, and we'll keep coming back.

Every morning, we stand front of the mirror and start and beauty of the day. When I see almost empty bottles, the first thing that I think of is Sephora than online shopping. If I'm desperate to get a new product, I'll visit Sephora. Personally, I like to shop alone instead of help from associates, because I do lots of research about products that I'm looking for, that I would like to compare. Sephora is a great place to try the product and make a purchase. :)

This place will not disappoint!  the raw bar and cooked oysters were to die for.

Usually I do not get impressed with menus with as much as I eat out, but this place made me want to come back for more.  You scored with this place. 
I am definitely a John Besh fan, (big lover of Restaurant August) but I could go to this place for lunch and dinner on the same day.

so great! Thank you!

We have been 3 times and loved it every time. Service was great ask for David. He was very helpful and knew the menu. I had the Asian chicken salad and husband had the burger and we loved it all. Other 2 visits were for the Sunday brunch which is the best in town. Huge variety for $16.95 (drinks extra). Prime rib is awesome as well as the cheesy hash browns!! Other choices are salad, soup, fruit, eggs, bacon,sausage, smoked salmon, waffles, poached eggs, omelets, French toast, cinnamon rolls, biscuits, gravy and more. I recommend this place!

Stopped by the Sun diner for a lunch as suggested by a person from the area. Walking in you will know that this place has been here awhile.  Very well worn and lived in feel. Taking a chance I, for the first time ever, ordered the chicken and waffles with sausage gravy. I was surprised by the fact that the meal was not heavy and tasted very good. The waiter was very helpful with suggestions and friendly. 
Stop by Goo Goos across the street after lunch

I have never left a review before but my experience at Eric's was so good that I had to create an account and leave a review to let everyone know how wonderful this shop is.  The flower arrangement was amazing.  Customer service was even better!  I won't hesitate to return to this shop for all my flower needs!!! Not one bad thing I can say about them!

I can't say enough about A Garden Party! Mary, Dawn, and their team will make your dreams come true. Their empathy, creativity, and tasteful eyes will ensure a gorgeous floral experience for any occasion! Mary flowered my 30th birthday, my bridal shower, my housewarming party and my wedding. Our wedding day was flawlessly executed!! I knew I would be an emotional bride but had no idea the flower delivery would be my first happy tears of the day! They personalized the floral bracelets for MOG/MOB, and my bouquet. 

I love this women and their vision! I would recommend the brilliant professionals at A Garden Party for any and all floral needs!!!

Had a very negative experience.  It was 10am on a Thursday and they were training someone so it took a bit for someone to take my order.  I ordered 2 donuts and an iced vanilla chai latte.   Apparently it comes frozen not on ice.  This was not explained to me.  I would not have ordered it if I had known.  The person was rude and didn't understand my complaint just said there is crushed ice in it.  So frustrating. Was not good.   Wouldn't order any coffee drinks here.   I got to my car to take a drink and it leaked out all over my off white suit shirt.  I will not be going to this store ever again.  I have told all my friends this is not good.   It will be awhile before Dunkin Donuts gets my business.

I loved my server, she was very good. This place has a nice atmosphere, love the decorations and the bathroom is adorable. The meal was my least favorite part. My turkey sandwhich came with fresh avocade which was good but with light sourdough. What exactly is light sourdough bread? It takes like white bread. The side salad was iceburg lettuce, which has no nutrition but I did enjoy the dressing. Last a terrible cookie that tastes as though it was made with splenda. I would probably come back here for the pastries or breakfast, but not for lunch.
As usual, we had a wonderful time at the 2016 Pima County Fair this year. We  will be back in 2017!

Last summer I visited this restaurant with my kids on a road trip. I am allergic to many common herbs, the Executive Chef and the Sous Chef were very good at helping me find "safe" foods on the menu. The severs and service was great.
Great (not good) service! Very quick delivery (like 2 mattresses delivered on a Saturday within 90 minutes of buying them)!

Topa Topa is a cool bar located in an old converted car garage. The space is very spacious with tons of tables and plenty seating around the bar. Delicious beers on tap which you can purchase by the pint or growler. Staff is friendly and accommodating. Food is also available for order in the hallway to the right. Stop in for a refreshing brew!

This is a beautiful trail with ample space for bikes and runners or walkers. People are always friendly and helpful. I did two marathon trainings on this trail, rode bikes and walked. The only thing I would probably like on the trail a little bit more would be some water fountains there is only one right near Greenvalley inn and it would be nice like on Kelly drive to have those water fountains that they have there.

Our third or fourth time to Hella's in the last few years.  Never disappoints.  The service was great and the food was even better.  It's hard to go wrong on the menu, but this time I went for the Pork Gyro.  The Greek Salad is an absolute must.

We came in with four adults and five children.  They found us a spot near the back out of the way.  The kid's meals were reasonably priced $4.99 which included a drink.

I highly recommend Hella's if you're in or near Tarpon Springs.

BONUS:  they have thier own parking lot behind the restaurant - they will validate with your meal.  Makes life much easier when it is busy down by the sponge docks.

OMG...from the (real) garlic  knots the the freshest salad & homemade dressing to the chilled chianti & my chicken pavano (and my friends chicken spinach fuit), EVERYTHING was phenomenal!!  I have never been to any restaurant where everything was 100% perfect. You would be crazy not to try it at least once  it I guarantee you'll be back!!
AMAZING GORGEOUS VENUE.  Staff is phenomenal, well-trained, and really helpful.  I feel very comfortable there, and the crowd is diverse.  Amazing and NEEDED addition to the Gayborhood
Over priced small plates. Much lower quality than last visit. Overly oily scallops. And only 3 tiny scallops. Very corporate feel these fays
Omg, it is the best fried chicken in the USA! The fresh hot donuts are amazing! Lavender/strawberry, not to be missed!!! They even have their own parking lot! Cannot wait to go back soon!!!

A fine Japanese cuisine. First time when I went to there is just amazed me, but after about 4 or 5 times, I found the menu is just short of selection. The should give some variation to customs. But anyway, the sashimi is fresh, sushi is tasty.

Amazing. Interesting flavors. Cute Decor. Big servings. Great taste. You will never go to Baskin Robins ever again. Kids and adults love it. Cash only go prepared. Lots of flavors to choose from. I want to try them all!

Went for brunch on Saturday and was extremely pleased to discover 2-for-1 drinks! Our group tried pretty much one of each drink and were extremely happy with each, particularly the Wicked Bloody Mary. The atmosphere was great-- trendy but very relaxed. I had the Singapore Stir fry, which was so flavorful and a wonderful change from the usual breakfast fare. As I dont eat meat or cheese, breakfast can be a little boring and standard, but this was a delicious option that strayed from the ordinary. Others had two different omelet varieties and the eggs benedict uno, all of which made the table very happy and satisfied. Would definitely recommend for brunch.. My only wish would be that they had more vegetarian options. The bloody marys by far made up for that though!

Lively and Eclectic - The hotel is situated across from Independence Park, and while not Rittenhouse Square, it was still conveniently located. The staff was very helpful, the rooms were nicely appointed, and the on site facilities made enjoying ourselves easy. There is a daily free drinks hour, as well as a club on the 10th floor, The Stratus, for relaxing before dining. There were two annoyances. First, a barking dog, for which the staff contacted the patrons and they came back to quiet it, and the second, were drunken patrons roaming the hall Friday night. Our Saturday stay was much quieter, with no issues. The hotel runs events, so there were numerous, diverse-looking, people and groups. A recommendation, if you are planning on having dinner, go to Talula's Garden; it was a wonderful experience.
Rachel is the best. Highly recommend her talents for creative solutions. This is a great place to get a haircut in Philly.
Best place in Indy! Get Meatloaf and finish with bread pudding. You won't be disappointed!!

I love Han Dynasty. I've been to this location a bunch of times, and each time I am so happy! There is always at least two good beers on draught, and the food is consistently amazing. I went on a very, very cold winter's night, a Sunday, with my husband. We  got there around 6:45pm and got seats at the bar right away, despite the crowd. It was hopping! Not sure why, to be honest, but no problem for us. 

We had two good beers that were on draught, and ordered our favorites, Spicy Cucumber and Dan Dan Noodles. They were perfect, as always. We ordered extra spice - level 8 on both, which is good if you like REALLY SPICY food. Heck I think we could get more next time. 

Will I go back? YES FOR SURE.

Only my 2nd time ordering but food is exceptional. It's not your normal cheap quality Chinese. Everything tastes and looks fresh. Everything has been very tasty and delivery is crazy fast! Only complaint is I wish they gave you a menu when you order. I heard about the place from my neighbor. I found the menu here on yelp but having an actual menu sometimes is convenient.
