The most impressive music store I've ever been into. The staff is incredibly helpful and encourage you to play their instruments and try things out. A lot of music stores are sadly more like music museums and make you feel like shouldn't touch anything or they're too quite and make you feel as if you shouldn't really turn on and amplifier to see what it sounds like but NOT corner music. The first member of the staff that I met handed me a guitar pick and led me to the guitars I was looking for. He allowed me to play just the way I needed to so that I got a good idea of what I was playing. I would recommend this place for all ages and skill levels.

Great food! Simple and delightful atmosphere. Definitely going back. Didnt rnkoy the lamb as much as I hoped I would. Next time going with the kabobs. 7 courses all for $33 after tax and tip. Great deal. Don't eat lunch that day.

Our recent visit to this was our second time since our first visit was uneventful and not very good.  We decided to try it again and while the service has improved dramatically, I feel the menu is not very exciting.  Too much like all the other mediocre restaurants.  The Siena advertises a French chef and exciting food -- what is exciting about prime rib?  I would like to see more French versions of their food.  How about filet mignon Rossini style?  How about a genuine French onion soup?  What about potato gratin rather than French fries? What about some great French sauces -- beurre blanc, provencale, etc. I would love to see a menu that no one else can compete with in Reno.  That is not the case at Da Vinci's.  everything was okay but the only thing that was excellent was the service.

Came here for a bachelorette party this past weekend and scheduled a Tarot Card reading with Kay. I was initially super skeptical and I typically don't buy in to this kind of stuff, but once I arrived all of my criticism went out the door! Kay was so calming and kind, and her reading was spot on right from the very first card! They allow you to take an audio recording of your reading, and I continuously listen to my session over again to hear how correct she was about so many aspects of my life (and prepare for upcoming fortunes that were predicted). All of the girls in our group had similar experiences with Kay (either with a Tarot card reading, a Past life reading, or an Angel reading). I am looking forward to August, as that month kept coming up in the cards, but mostly I'm looking forward to coming back to New Orleans and booking another reading! Book an appointment with Kay-- You won't regret it!

New to Yelp to write this review. First time at this place. Pizza awesome, Mike the waiter gross! Using his hands to add food to his plate from the salad bar and drinking what appeared to be ice tea out of a beer pitcher in front of other customers. Food: five stars. Service: Zero

Grand indeed! It's Texas sized! Huge! 10 x's bigger than the Las Vegas Bellagio Atrium. This had 3 different huge, high ceiling atriums, a boat ride like Disney's Pirate's of the Caribbean, Twin Waterfalls, tropical lush garden paths that snaked around with mini waterfalls along the way and it had a skywalk to take it all in from above.  There is fine dining throughout the property.  This place is gorgeous, grand and gosh darn awesome to take out of town guests like me! Nashville is sweet like sweet tea! Love Gaylord Opryland Hotel

Friend picks me up and I say lets get a Philly Cheesesteak. My first ever.
One customer and two workers. 
Condiments with peppers, picks, onions, hot sauce, ketchup, etc.
I ordered a cheeaseteak wit cheese, friend ordered the chicken cheesesteak.
Meat was limited and nothing special about it. 
I unwrap it at the house and I could not see any meat until I opened it up.

We were so disappointed with this visit! Sevice was unbelievably slow. From waiting to, be seated with many empty tables. To a waitress that seemed to want to be any where but there. Food was ok but not worth the 30 min. Wait. Not sure after 15'yrs of going we will be back. Was that bad of a experence!

It really isn't anything to write home about but the hash browns were good. 

I think Nashville has much better options like Biscuit which is across the street. And there you have it folks. Short and sweet.

After reading great reviews about this place I finally tried it with a few friends. I ordered the veggie burger which had rave reviews. Almost all said that it was one of the best veggie burgers they had ever had. I didn't think it was. I also ordered duck fat fries, which I also wasn't a big fan of. 

Other than that the service was great. Our waiter was attentive. The ambiance of the place is very cozy too. I would go back but probably only for drinks.

I recently went back to Moto after a rough visit and was able to thoroughly enjoy a fantastic meal and exceptional service. We received a very warm welcome and were made to feel at home and comfortable. The manager and waiting staff ensured that we had an amazing experience with them, and really went above and beyond. To the point where our waiter helped us get a cab in the snow! I'm definitely looking forward to dining with them again!

Most amazing service and most amazing food.  My hubby and I stopped in for a late dinner and the staff was so attentive the entire time.  Even at 10 pm the place had plenty of patrons but their service was still a 10!  Our waitress was Samantha and she deserves recognition for her great service.  And hats off to the chef for the delicious food.  Definitely 5 star!  Everything was delish!!!!

Tough to fault this restaurant. If you're looking for great service (see Jimmy) and great food and drink you want to check out tryst. We had the cheeseboard ($30) and the fig chicken salad sandwich. Super

12/24. Had the fig salad and lettuce wraps. Another 5 star experience. Love this place.

Shopping at AJ's can feel like a trip to a beautiful museum.  And yes, you will pay for it.   
But what I did NOT expect and GOT was food poisoning from AJ's.   

We have now twice picked up food from AJ's fast food area--Pizza, salad, soup, to take home on the weekends.   
And both times we have been sick for days afterwards: stomach aches, diarrhea, gas, etc. 

We ate at the outside patio one day a month or so ago and I went to the ladies room in the back.   I noticed that an AJ's employee in the stall next to me put her APRON on the restroom floor while she was going.   That alarmed me, but I thought 'oh well'.  

Twice since then my husband and I have been sickened after grabbing a slice of pizza from AJ's.   

This Place is TOXIC: DO NOT EAT fresh food from there!   I will never eat their fast food again--how disgusting to be sick for days after eating at such a nice place!

Authentic, traditional beignets and cafe au lait. It doesn't get any better than this. I recommend ordering the donuts "flat." These are cooked a little longer and will be crispier and less fill of dough. The frozen cafe au lait is also excellent.

Wonderful place! Great music, great food and great drinks. Lamb sliders and feta fries were out of this world. Bar tender also knew how to make an Old Fashioned the right way... Definite must visit in NOLA.
First time in 16 years I've been to a barber shop!  Got a great entire head and face straight razor shave complete with warm towels, warm shaving cream, and head/face massage.

Someone should probably update this. 
Filthy's is shut down for good. Found out the hard way after heading there in minus 20 for 2 dollar tacos last night. Heard a bit about the back story so I'm not surprised.

DON'T BOTHER for obvious reasons, but Tavern next door to it is pretty decent. Adopted the bingo (including the announcer) and kind of feels like they adopted the music and crowd too. And the weird movies playing on the TVs lol.

Although this is a charming little market,  they have a very limited selection of items that are somewhat pricey and it is much less crowded than others.  However you might want to take advantage of the outdoor terrace at the Café on the site. Great atmosphere, food and coffee!

Got a groupon here and overall I would say the value was good. George our tour guide was great, and very knowledgeable.

The tour should consider cutting out the visit to Princess Miriam's home. She spoke far too long to the point where it was getting boring. She is also a very strange character and listening to her for nearly an hour creeped me out. 

Other than that, it was great!

I went there a few times the food was good. last time I went I was upset because. ... dishes and silverware were dirty food very greasy and undrained and  unappetizing. Left  me with a bad view of the restaurant and staff.

Pizza came out barely warm!  Asked the waitress to make another one.  Manager brought back the pizza that they tried to warm up!!!  He took the charge off our bill.  But now the pizza was just gross.  The pizza should have been made fresh!  Ruined my lunch hour!  Since all I ate was one small slice of pizza!  This manager is ill equipped to manage this restaurant!  If i could have left no stars I would have....the 1 star I gave was too much!!!
I was given a recommendation by a "local" friend and he was spot on!  Delish!! Great service, great food and great sangrias!

We came here for brunch after finding out that Sabrina's opened one up here in NJ. While driving to the restaurant, we checked in through the Nowait app. The app wasn't coordinating with the restaurant because it said that there were 6 people ahead of us when there weren't any. But, we were glad that we used it because there was a fair going on right outside the restaurant. Daughter ordered the Tofu Scramble and thought it was pretty good. Hubs ordered the Be Nice To Your Brother Egg White Special and thought it was okay and it was no big deal. I ordered the Stuffed Challah French Toast and thought it was good. My order was huge and I had to get a box to bring that home. The only complaint I had about the place was the waitress. She was never around and we had to wait a while to get our check. Glad we got to try here, though!

Clearly, there is some sort of disconnect here.  For those of you that have given Taqueria Pico de Gallo 5 stars, I must sincerely ask WHY?  Is there some sort of cult following that I am not privy to? 
My asada tacos tasted like they had been simmering for many hours in a vat of slightly putrid goat-head soup.  And the poor woman at the counter looked like she hadn't slept for the last 3 days.
The ONLY reason PdG gets more than 2 stars is because the tortillas were handmade and actually pretty excellent.
Usually when it comes to small businesses, I'm all about it -- but guys, seriously.
Stick with the taco trucks, because Tucson officially does not have good Mexican food in any other place that I have found.

Hands down best Indian food on the main line. As a vegetarian, I always go for the creamy paneer tikka masala, bhindi (okra) masala, and dal makhani (lentils).

Pluses: Great dine in student discounts, BYOB.

I tried Ethiopian food for the first time last night at Queen of Sheba. I went here because of a Groupon I bought and I'm glad I tried it. I liked it!  The cuisine reminded me of Indian food, which is one of my favorite ethnic delights. However with Ethiopian food, you eat with your hands by scooping up said piles of food with injera, which is like a thin and airy version of Indian na'an. Thin as it may be, using bread as an edible utensil left me feeling rather full at the end.

The Queens Platter is like a sampler platter of 8 different items. You can order all vegetarian but we chose a combo of meats and vegetables. I actually preferred the veggies (red lentils, a yellow pea mash, a cabbage mix) over the meats. The meats were little gamey for me. 

I enjoyed scooping up little bits of all the assorted dishes with the injera. The Groupon also came with an appetizer sampler. On that was a hummus-like dip, a lentil hummus-esque dip, a fried appetizer that was like a a cross between an Indian samosa or a Jamaican jerk patty, and a tomato salad. They are not afraid of spice here, so if you avoid spice (I do not) beware of the rogue fresh jalapeno in the salad. I did not enjoy the honey drink (way too sweet, basically honey water) but the Ethiopian coffee at the end of the meal was nice. I guess normally there is a coffee ceremony where the beans are roasted tableside, but we missed out on that because it was late and we were closing the place down.

Service was very friendly here and there's a nice cozy, dim-lit atmosphere. I was also kind of surprised that they had a pretty long wine list and wines from all over. I had a merlot from Argentina that was really good. I would probably go back, but without a Groupon, it would have been pretty darn pricey. Do NOT go here with a picky eater, this place is only for the adventurous at heart.

Thanks George M. for recommending this place!! and also the reviews of my Yelper friends! When we checked the pics of this place on yelp... we knew we had to make a stop here. Thank goodness we did! It was SO delicious. 

We decided to make reservations so we wouldn't have to wait long. We arrived a little early so we sat at the bar. I wanted to stick to a rum drink since that was what I had earlier that afternoon. So the bartender made me a special hurricane with fresh fruit. The bar area is really nice. The place is really nice and décor is very warm and classy. 

We were starving so right off the bat we ordered a salad with fried oyster, bacon, romaine & avocado salad. OMG I am not a fan of oysters but fried oysters are amazing! especially in a fresh delicious salad. I had a cup of crab & corn bisque and I wish I had ordered a bowl instead. It was so warm and the flavor of crab and corn are great together. By this time we were so excited to order our entrées. 

Since I LOVE mussels I had to order Moules ET frites- this was mussels steamed with garlic & thyme (AMAZING) with house-made fries. I was afraid I would not be full but they loaded me up with mussels. My fiancé ordered Jumbo Louisiana shrimp "en cocotte" roasted jalapeño cheese grits, andouille & green onion sausages and of course I had to steal a little. It was made to perfection. 

I think by far this was one of the best places we visited in N.O. They made my top list. If you are ever in the area make sure you stop by. I heard happy hour is great here. 

Our waiter was very attentive and super cool even though we accidently dropped a drink. We were a little embarrassed but he made us feel comfortable. The manager actually brought us our entrées and chatted with us a bit.

I was resistant to trying it because I thought the name was too cute. I was not expecting much, having been jaded by the ridiculousness of the cupcake fad, and had been under-impressed by cup cakeries and their course-crumbed,dry, flavorless overrated cake products. This place is different. The bundt cakes here are moist and yet light and flavorful. They were sampling red velvet that day and I don't generally care for red velvet cake, but this was really velvety and tasty. We picked up a couple of flavors of bundtlets and they were also quite good. I am a home baker and former professional cake decorator so I'm picky and rarely eat cake unless it's homemade. And face it, at most social events, the cake on offer is, more often than not, a Costco half-sheet sugar bomb not worth your calories budget .

I found the Nothing Bundt Cakes store to be cute, clean, and the service was prompt and friendly. I've gotten used to expecting surly clerks who act as though you've interrupted their socializing. How refreshing to feel as though our business was welcome rather than an interruption.

They have absolutely the best smoothies around.  Everything is fresh, [mostly] healthy, and delicious.  My only complaint was that some of the listings on the chalkboard menu were blocked by blenders.  The owners were aware of the problem (echoed by the person behind me) and were promising to correct the matter ASAP.  I will definitely be back!!

First the I ordered the doors and paid in full upfront and I was told doors should be ready in 4 weeks. Okay that's fine. So after 4 weeks I call and check on the doors, I was told that they would be delivered the next Monday. Okay, So then I didn't receive a call about setting up time, so I call again. "oh your doors aren't ready yet" Okay so when will they be? Should have them delivered by Friday. Okay. Friday no call/ so called them again. "Well there's a problem with our equipment they should be ready next week and your doors are next in line" Okay call the following Thursday " well your doors just arrived we need to finish them. Well they need to be here next week. they were. However, two of the doors had to have trim removed and cut down due to sales and manufacturing mistake and other door was too tall. Called but nothing would be done. Not sure I'll use again or recommend.

BETTER than Cafe du Monde!!!

Less crowded (at 8am my mom and I were the only ones enjoying the patio, but really, who is out on Bourbon at 8am besides the beer trucks and street washers?  Me and my mom!) better tasting.

The beignets here are made.to.order.  We went to Cafe du Monde once and it was obvious they had been sitting.  These came hot and fresh.

The cafe au lait is also made.to.order.  Again, hot and fresh.

A great alternative to Cafe du Monde.  Scratch, a great "instead of" Cafe du Monde!
The food was okay, but cold. I was extremely disappointed with the service. If the service is bad forget it. I will definitely not be going back

I really want to leave two reviews, one for the service and ambience and one for the food.  The service was fantastic. We were having a very small wedding shower at the restaurant and the server and manager couldn't have been nicer. They accommodated my request for dessert and were very attentive to our needs the who,e time we were there. Ralph's is a great place for things like this. They have rooms you can use for more privacy but with only 8 people the main restaurant was perfect. Our waiter was quite content letting us sit and open the few presents we had and we never once felt rushed to get up from our table. Very fun atmosphere and wonderful staff. Now the food.  The majority of the table had the crawfish Benedict. This dish is exactly as the name implies. This dish should have been outstanding. Tangy hollandaise and spicy crawfish on one of their delicious biscuits. Sadly it was not. First of all the food was barely warm, bordering on cold. The grilled veggies, which were the side, were cold. There was no seasoning whatsoever on the crawfish and the hollandaise had no taste at all. I was really disappointed. The corned beef hash was warm and the small bite I had was good. It's not your typical hash. The corned beef were cubes of corned beef not shredded like in a hash. That didn't make it any better or worse just different. Their biscuits were DELICIOUS. Warm and flaky and with just that hint of saltiness that makes for the best biscuits. They were light and fluffy and even though they looked as if they might be dense they were not. I wish I had just ordered a plate of biscuits for my brunch. The bottomless mimosas were well ladled with champagne and they were definitely not stingy with the refills. My glass was always full. If your a coffee drinkers, they serve a French press, not just a cup. I had decaf and was not impressed with it. It was very bitter and no amount of cream could help it. I would have preferred just a good old cup of New Orleans Java. No need to serve fancy French press when you already have some of the best coffee.

I bought the most stunning Terra Plana Boots here and I get compliments on them all the time!

Although it's a small space the owner is incredibly sweet and helpful and really knows her products.

Although I can't afford to buy here all the time I certainly try to!

Love this place, 100% vegan /veggie, and earth friendly recycled materials! And the food here is top notch.  It's cramped and small, so get take-out because there's only 3 small tables to dine-in.

I had the Ziggy burger ($8.5), pretty much like a loaded veggie burger with all the toppings and sauce.  I think it was the best veggie burger i ever had in my life.  It was huge and plump, and oozing with juice and sauces.  Delicious!   I've also tried the taco salad ($8?), the cilantro dressing was amazing, and the sweet potato fries ($4) were also amazing.  I have also tried the Curry Tofu Wrap, this was also delicious, loaded with juicy tofu in a sweet curry sauce, with avacado, lettuce, and sprouts.  The cucumber dipping sauce is also yummy, although not needed since the wrap is juicy enough by itself!

They have this green health smoothie shake for $5.  It tastes soooo good and is loaded with fruits & veggies.  Called the "Groothie".. Order it!  Yumm 

I would eat here every day if I could afford a $15 lunch every day!  But, for now. I will highly recommend this place, and I'll keep coming back (maybe once a month lol).  I wish they would give you discounted fries with purchase of a sanwhich, like a "combo" option, or have a frequent buyer's card, but I guess you can use Level Up for that.  Best vegetarian take-out in the city hands down.

My husband and I were treated to dinner here by dear family that spare no expenses. 

We received a glass of champagne upon being seated, not sure if this was complimentary or not. However, I am sure that it was a great start. 

The waiter came over, gave us water, bread, and explained how things work, asked for any food restrictions (which annoyingly we had plenty of; kosher style, pescatarian, no pork or shellfish, and the lucky one among us- my husband- who has none and gets to eat EVERYTHING). Like I said, annoying and slightly complicated but our waiter got it. 

The food started coming out slowly, steadily, and pretty generously. I have to say, I don't remember the exact combinations of our dishes, but I do remember that the homemade pasta was incredibly tasty and cooked to perfection, every vegetable we had was incredibly fresh, meat was incredibly tender, wine was delicious, and dessert was brought out double, because we got it like that. Not really, because I asked ever so nicely for more macaroons. 

The service was one of the best parts and the ambiance very nice and homey. Our waiter was hysterical and very personable, the chef came by our table too which is always a nice touch. This is more of a "we're here celebrating something" or "tonight is a special evening" restaurant. A real treat.

I signed up for Will's classes to help me get me back in shape before my wedding. Will is very motivating, knowledgeable and helpful inside the gym and out. Always available to give advice on nutrition, supplements and goes above and beyond to help you reach your goals. Will is great for anyone regardless of fitness level. He will figure out a plan and exercises that work for you.

Love tria.  Great food great service.  I come here almost every Sunday afternoon.  It can get very crowded sometimes.  I had all the food on the menu.  Yes I really did.  All good. Try everything.  I love Sunday school I get to try the feature cheese, feature wine and feature beer for half priced. (first order).   See you on Sunday.

This is a great late night spot for some drunk food! We got the fried dumplings, pan fried seafood noodles, salt&pepper squid, and clams with black bean sauce. All of the dishes were flavorful and I would order them again.
We come here every time we visit St Louis. Great selection, fresh, and delicious. And they open early.

This hotel was okay, but not great. It is overrated. My room was not cleaned even at 4PM in the afternoon. Knowing that I would stay for multiple nights, housekeeping should have cleaned my room around lunch time when guests are known to be out of the room. On the second day, I had to call housekeeping to clean the room. It was pretty bad. 

Stay clear of the continental breakfast in the mornings. You have a long line of people wanting to be seated. You are better off walking out of the hotel into the many restaurants and diners open for business in the morning. 

The hotel is centrally located to all the attractions. It is in the French Quarter, yet only a block off of Canal St. where you can easily walk to the many restaurants in the CBD and Warehouse District.
Best Thai food I have ever had. Great Panang Curry. The spring rolls were good as well.

First time there today. The thin crust pizza was really good!  Loved the sauce too.  The guys behind the counter were super nice. The place is old and desperately in need of updating though. It looks like it hasn't changed since 1984. Despite the design of the place I will be back for take out.

I would give it half or no stars if I could. First when we walked in the line was to the door. There was another shorter line but I soon found out that it was a line for complaints and corrections to orders. I soon was in that line. Avoid this place.

This is a classic New Orleans restaurant. The ambience is 1960's upscale steak restaurant, but the service is second to none. The steaks are expertly prepared and after a few reasonably price drinks, everything is heavenly.

The Tuscan Tower rooms have always been the best in town but it appears they are in need of some renovation.  On my last visit, the reading lamp in between the two beds was flat out missing, yep, just an empty pedestal (not a good look to the room).  Immediately notified the front desk.  Also, it appears they have removed many of the decorative pillows, etc. that make the room appear more luxurious, not sure why they aren't being replaced.  Overall, the room just looks tired. The casino looks dark and dated with terrible ventilation.  Plus, what's with the double security to use your comp dollars?  Please enter your PIN and show me your ID to get a latte? Then, stand in line at the passport club desk to show your ID yet again to get your free play?  Really??!!  Ridiculous.  Have a little class Peppermill, these are your customers. You get three stars for the Terrace Lounge and a nice swimming pool.
The Underground burger is the best burger in town!!  Cheese fries are fabulous.  Great service.  Place is a little small but totally worth it for the food and hospitality.

I have been to Tryst many times to have drinks and have always had an awesome time. Last night we had friends in town and decided to stop in for dinner. Unfortunately I was thoroughly disappointed. My girlfriend ordered the Chicken Milanese entree and was shocked when a flat piece of fried chicken came out with a little potato salad on top instead of the beautifully described entree on the menu. Not what you would expect for the $24 price tag! Our friends both ordered the Seafood Risotto and were also pretty disappointed. We were embarrassed that this was their first impression of dining in St. Pete.  It was a shame to spend $120 dollars for four ppl on just food and no alcohol and not be wow'd to say the least. We will certainly be back for drinks and partying but will stay away from dining there!

I came here last night for their monthly third friday event.  It's free and its fun!  Live music,  food truck, cocktails,  glass blowing demonstration,  and entertainment.  The Fire Technicians were there and did a wonderful job. I wish I  had gotten there earlier to take advantage of the glass blowing demonstration,  but I'll know better for next time. Great place to meet friends,  take your kids, or have a date.  The glass is beautiful.

Eh .. we came, we ate, we paid a lot for average fare.

Exceptional was the service; forgettable was the meal. Obviously a popular place as it was packed .. huge margarita selection. 

It would be fair to describe "forgettable" with regards to the meal: for example, I had the mixtos tacos. I found the mixtos to be bland, the cheese to be rubbery, the rice and beans to be bland as well. Honestly, the salsa was the most flavorful part of our meal.

My husband and I took my 89 year old mother to Siamese Princess tonight. We were there many years ago but my mom has never been there. She lives in the area and we thought we'd try something new. We ordered dumplings as an appetizer and they were very watery. While we were waiting for our main course my husband spotted a roach crawling on the wall next to me. I killed it with a napkin and then my husband presented it to the waiter/manager. He seemed unfazed. The food came out and we had all lost our appetites. When the check came they had taken 10% off the bill. The manager stated that they need to get a new exterminator. Ya think? That's it for Siamese Princess.

You know how when you go to a hardware store you can never find anyone to help you.  Well,  this Lowes location must be looking to do things a new way.   We were helped in a few different departments by some intelligent,  friendly employees that not only made good suggestions,  but also helped with some concept ideas that I needed to work out.   The staff that I interacted with were younger than expected and had a passion that I wasn't expecting. 

The ability to develop concepts for improving your home with professionals and the available technology makes things so much easier than doing it all yourself or having to contract the work out for the crazy prices people are charging these days. 

As long as they keep up with the trends and keep excelling with this new approach they seem to have with customer service,  we will keep coming back!

Couple things about this hotel -

- Everyone I interacted was crazy, super, genuinely friendly. Someones people who are crazy super friendly are creepy and ungenuine. All these people were legit. From housekeeping to front desk to restaurant people.

- The owner, a nice old man who looks like everyone's favorite grandpa in a suit, walks around the restaurant in the morning to greet people, say hello and give out his card. It's cute.

- The breakfast buffet is amazing for a free hotel breakfast. They have real eggs, an omelet station with VEGETABLES, and the buffet line also had VEGETABLES. VEGETABLES ON A FREE HOTEL BREAKFAST BUFFET OMG. I ate dinner at the restaurant one night as well and while it wasn't the most tasty or gourmet thing ever it was a good value and came with, you guessed it, a good amount of VEGETABLES.

- Negative - there was some sort of drip from the room above to my room, outside the window, and it drove me freaking nuts, so I kept the fan on the whole time I tried to sleep. Also one night the person next to me was watching TV kinda loud but that is not the hotel's fault. It was her fault.

I'd totally stay here again.

Underwhelmed.  My husband and I celebrated our anniversary at the Farmhaus last week.  The decor is bland, beige walls, uninteresting art, too bright, the room echos and is very loud, I couldn't hear the waiter and I was trying to read his lips.  The menu was unexciting.  We ordered the nachos app and it was just a pile of sweet potato chips with crumbled bleu cheese and bacon bits on top and drizzled with BBQ sauce, it wasn't a very a cohesive dish.  The conch fritters were good though.   My husband ordered the most expensive dish on the menu, the ribeye for $33.00  It was tough and not very tasty and for $33.00 he expected more than an ordinary ribeye on top of mashed potatoes.  I ordered the Pompano fish entreé, it was just okay but moderately priced.  The dessert was good, we split the lemon pudding cake, the wine was good.  We were never offered coffee.   After all the hype I heard about this place, I  really expected to have a great experience, but it was just eh, okay.  I don't think we'll put this place in our rotation for dinner.  I'm really sad about that too.
Waited for half an hour but so worth it! Very good quality and interesting mix of food that comes with large serving.

I love this place so so so much. I came here during one of my first visits to Philadelphia and I'm so happy I ended up living down the street! Great playlists, great food, and very warm and friendly people. The owner, Blew, and her daughter are so kind and welcoming. Every time I come here I stay longer than I mean to, in the good way. Very thankful to have such an inspiring local business around. 

Other awesome things about this place:
The seating
The little library in the back
The mission and the intent of the space

Everything feels right about this spot :)

The breakfast burrito was tasty, but not real impressed with the sticky bun they warmed in the microwave and they got hard. Not impressed.

Overall nah.....glorified Staryucks.

Yelpers, I'm telling you that you've got to check out this bar, for a couple of reasons. One, it's new and kind of hidden, so you'll be totally in-the-know about a pub that many people haven't heard of yet. Two, because it's so new and little-known, it's not super busy (yet). Three, it's great!

The first thing I really like in here is the decor. It's got a cool, very modern red vibe. It's got that welcoming kind of "anyone welcome" vibe and that kind of feel that it could host anything from a UFC night to a small jazz performance.

I haven't tried any food, but the drinks are cold and the staff are friendly!

Timpanos Italian Chophouse reminds of a place from an old school Hollywood film where producers would take their respective colleagues and artists out to lunch to talk business and that exactly what I did. 

An associate of mine decided on this spot after reading great reviews and figured it was a great place to meet, eat, drink and talk business. 

I ordered a French 75 cocktail (gin, lemon juice, simple syrup, topped with Champagne) to feel relaxed and ready to discuss business matters. 

The waitress came along and took our order. I asked her suggestion and she recommended fresh Seared Ahi Tuna served on top of pallets of roasted tomatoes, grilled onions and pan fried olives, with a drizzle of balsamic vinaigrette; ***SPOILER ALERT!!!!***it was PERFECT!!!  

I'll def be coming back here for dinner sometime soon; be forewarned: as of July 2016, the construction in Hyde Park is hideous and inconvenient!!!

This place is really great. My son and I go about once a week. It has a hipster vibe. The doughnuts, croque monsier and monte cristo are beyond amazing. They have delicious and strong coffee. They also have sliders and beer but I'm usually there in the morning. Parking is a little tough sometimes but worth it. Everything tastes fresh and it's a fun place. They have a small patio in back where you can sit outside.

We came here for the brunch deal ($50 a person for endless drinks and food for 2 hours) to celebrate a friend's birthday. A group of 24 ppl and the place was pretty accommodating. Food was good; monkey bread is amazing! Service was alright; with a large group we ordered lots and lots of drinks. We asked for a pitcher of mimosa (which would've made it easier on the server and we could've gotten drinks faster) but they wouldn't allow it. Didn't make a lot of sense to us. Overall, pretty good, except for the speed of receiving drinks.

Cris Dave and Carlos took great care of me 
I Leased a 2014 Toyota Camry SE. Everything in the deal went smooth a little bit of negotiation and we ended up with the perfect lease price And a great residual

I'd give the Black Sheep another try. But next time, I'd do it in a group of less than 25 people. We came on a Thursday night, expecting to immediately take over the downstairs section at around 5:30PM. But come to find out, it did not open up until at least 7PM, even later depending on when the bartender got in and got set up.

Our server was as kind as she could be with a whole mess of rowdy professionals on their third beer, wanting to escape her section for the freedom and convenience of the downstairs bar.

Aside from the crowded conditions, and the sometimes surly service, the Black Sheep has plenty to offer from great beers on tap to pub food abounding to entrees straight out of Ireland. I'd been here for dinner before and had a relatively good experience then, so I'm not denying that you can have a great night at the Black Sheep. Just don't show up with 25 of your closest friends at happy hour and expect to find seats. It ain't happening.

Decent food for Wendys.  The sweet tea was far, far, far too sweet even by southern standards.  I threw 80% of it away.

Also, the above reviewer is wrong.  There are tons of options around the area which are both tastier and healthier than Wendys around the Vanderbilt University Medical Center.  Most run in the $8 to $10 range.  In the potentially tastier category:

1) Sam and Zoes (this one is a hidden gem) and just across the street.  It gets amazing reviews
2) Calypso Cafe (this one gets great reviews too) and its just down the road.
3) Chains like Applebees and Logans

In between Murfreesboro and Gallatin Pike this little park in nestled in the 'burbs of East Nashville. It doesn't have anywhere for you to grill out so you have to bring your own, but there is a nice little section of benches and covered benched areas for a picnic, and lots of open grassy places for the same. 

That is if you beat the Frisbee players to it. That's what the majority of this park is: Frisbee players. I have seriously never seen so many. 

There's a baseball field that I can only assume little league games happen at, and perhaps the local schools use. There's lots of room for parking, but with it's primarily a big hill, so good luck with your sports on that thing. I love the nature trail, it reminds me of the ones where I went to college, trampled little dirt paths, signs, and all. I love this park.

I love supporting small local businesses in our neighborhood. Tried the California Turkey Sandwich & Vegetable Soup. The sandwich had plenty of turkey meat, fresh guacamole and fresh bread. Soup was hearty with lots of fresh veggies. AMAZING desserts! Gooie Butter Cookie melted in our mouths. Trail Mix Granola Bar was fresh and soft. Highly recommend this place.

Fantastic views, fantastic food, great service! Went here for brunch and it was truly decadent. Also, it was not very crowded, which was surprising, because the food was so reasonably priced (well, center city prices anyway). I'll definitely be back!
My burger was extremely greasy and my fries were very cold. The waitress was also not helpful to me and my fiancés friends. She seemed preoccupied talking to other waitresses and the hostess.

Excellent service and food. I had the pappardelle bolognese and my partner had the filet with mushroom ragout. Not a scrap of food left behind. Attentive and friendly service by Adrian. We will return!

Rooms are old but clean. Resort is huge and I'm glad we got to stay here and experience it. But will not go back. Restaurants are ok. Loooooong wait to get into the bars of you go on a Friday night and it's after 9:30 PM.

I have been seeing Dr. Halle for several years. This is not just a doctor this is a family. Dr. Halle has helped and my family so much. I love seeing Cindy and Julie his staff. You really feel like a family. If you have had any problems with your back this is the place to come to. They treat the person and the injury.

I had a hankering for fried food this afternoon and low-and-behold, there was Chubbies drive thru beckoning to me.  

I've been through a few times and it never fails to deliver large quantities of deep fried goodness.  The chicken is great.  The shrimp and fish is all you can hope for.  The fries completely suck - greasy, mushy, and just gross.  

They had a gumbo special today, which my three-year-old ordered and I ate, which was really good - very smoky flavor with chicken and sausage over rice.  

They tend to be slow as they make the food to order, but worth the wait as there's absolutely no other option in this part of town.

Food is good. Much better than the average americanized Thai. They got a different twist on the food which makes it original yet authentic. As opposed to other reviews I actually enjoyed the Tom-Yum. It's different than any Tom-Yum I ate in Thailand but still good. I also tried the the Red Curry and some other entrees. All were good. Some very good. Never mind-blowing though.

Now the reason I decided to give it 3 stars is because at the end of the day the food lacks in the bang-for-the-buck department. The portions always seem a little too small and more than a little expensive. For a soup and an entree you'll pay over $20 after taxes, and you're not very likely to have any leftovers. The rice container for the take-out was as small as I've ever seen in any other Asian restaurant I've ever gotten food from.

I live close-by so I'll be back, but not nearly as often as I would like to, unless one of the following happens: the food gets exceptional, the prices drop or the portions get bigger. The restaurant needs to work on giving a more generous air and not feel just a tiny bit stingy.

Stopped in here after deciding not to eat elsewhere and I'm so glad we did! Service was very friendly and the food was outstanding! Had the wings and fries that were on special for $7. My husband got the burger and home cut fries. The burger was a hand made patty cooked just perfectly, very flavorful. The sweet potato fries were very tasty as well. I would most definately eat here again when in town.

This place is an amazing spot downtown! Me and my guest walked in and found out if we didn't have a reservation that we couldn't be seated till 8pm which was four hours away! Luckily we were able to sit at the bar and be served! The service was incredible, an older male took our drink orders (I got a wowie which is delicious) and I also ordered the espanol burger! The food was DELICIOUS. they cooked my burger perfectly. When I asked for the desert menu (since my birthday was in a couple days and we were celebrating for the weekend) I decided not to order a milkshake since $6 seemed a bit too pricey, but our server insisted, and gave me one on the house! This place had incredible food, awesome server, and a great atmosphere. I definitely see myself returning!

Bevan's Cold Cuts is that local sandwich shop with hometown hospitality. The chicken cheesesteak with onions a lil mayo and a lil ketchup is AMAZING! If you package your sandwich in a meal you get your pick of a variety of sandwiches. Lunch time is a mad house, but worth the wait!

1. Food is yummy -- delicious small plates - big enough for two to share each dish
2. Service very nice and attentive
3. A little tight, you may be overhearing your neighbor's conversation but some may consider it cozy


Definitely worth a try. I will be back!

Decent food, but avoid this place during lunch hour at all costs. They can't seem to get their orders straight. Wasted an hour. As can be seen on lower rating for this particular branch, the service problem seems to be unique to this particular location.

I walked in to the red hot and blue ( real horrible and bad)  and was greeted by a lovely hostess name Kaliyah.She gave me a menu and sat me and said that viola would be over to take your order. After 8 mins,She never came! Then I believe the manager(Rebecca)came over to take my order and she seemed really annoyed and not friendly! I didn't even get a hi! I ordered some food to go and when it came out the manager dropped it in front of me and left! Just rude! Food I give a 6,service is. -9! Go at your own risk !!!!!

Really was expecting more.  I usually go to the Wilmot location but thought I'd check this one out.  Huge mistake.  Went with a party of 6.  The only thing that looked close to what I ate growing up in Japan was the Tokyo ramen.  The curry rice was a joke.   I mean....broccoli?  Sushi was meh.  The 20 minute drive to speedway and Wilmot is worth not having the regret you'll have from eating here.

The former St James has renovated and reopened as Parlor.  A set of walls that created a tunnel when you entered the old restaurant is now gone, opening up the space. It's much brighter and a big improvement.  The centerpiece of the place is a fancy, gleaming imported oven which creates the pizzas that are served at this Parlor.  Pasta and salads and other starters are also on the menu.  We decided to give the highlighted pizza a try and it was a winner: it came out hot, and had a crunchy crust, delicious and light.  The beet/greens salad with nuts and raisins was also excellent and I will definitely it order again.  
     The old bar is still there, though slightly reconfigured.  The St James drinking crowd will be pleased that that hasn't changed.  But, it's hard to say how they'll feel about the increased number of children this lower price point pizza/pasta place will bring in: two of the tables in the bar had youngsters and their voices carried.
     Regardless, we like the new version: the renovation is a success and Parlor is a much calmer alternative to newcomer NYAJ a few steps away.
The best daquiri place we visited in New Orleans. Very friendly staff and strong flavorful drinks.

I love these girls! I have three dogs who are all a bit crazy. Two are rescues and one of them is an extremely worried 7 pound chihuahua. Kelly and Brianna take great care of them and are really patient. Their prices are reasonable (which is important when you literally have a pack of dogs), they are quick, and easy to schedule with. And most importantly they come back looking beautiful and smelling great! I would recommend wags and riches to anyone and everyone!
Well worth a visit. The rotating exhibits tend to get crowded. Make sure to set aside plenty of time or plan on coming back again to see what you missed the first time.

My favs at this place are their peach margaritas and their chocolate peanut butter fried dough dessert. Sooo good.

Its a great happening place to watch a hockey game too. 

Only cons I have experienced is when the staff say the "blender is broken" and that you feel like you are sitting in the road with a bunch of fumes when on their patio. lol. I wish they could have a rooftop patio like O2s!

Well designed small campground.  Easy maneuvering even on back-in sites.  Good entertainment, clean small pool.  No campfires.  Close to Opry Mills and Grand Ole Opry.  Two rv parts stores within 500'.

Bubble tea is one of my (many) vices. It's delicious and I'll never turn down the opportunity for a honeydew bubble tea with tapioca and lychee pieces. So great. Anyways, a friend and I came here for our bubble tea fix and it was a pretty decent experience. I'd come back, but it wasn't anything extraordinary. 

It was busy in there- like every single table was full type busy. People playing games, eating food, drinking tea, the whole thing. That being said, it was also quite loud but that's what you expect when a place is this popular! I'd like to come back and sit and enjoy myself since I only stayed in there for about 10 minutes. 

I got a honeydew bubble tea and it was good! I also ordered the spring rolls and they were actually really good as well. The price is decent for what you pay for and they have special deals on different days of the week, so on Tuesdays you get cheap green onion cakes if you buy a bubble tea, on Wednesdays you get cheap spring rolls, etc etc. You get the idea. 

The menu is huge and there are tons of options for bubble tea- you can also get iced teas, shaved ice, hot tea. There is an endless amount of options, really. I was also surprised at the amount of food they had on the menu as well! Also, you can get a stamp card here, when you buy nine bubble tea you get the tenth for free which is great for addicts like myself! 

Lots of parking in the parking lot even though it may get quite busy, depending on the time you go. There are quite a few other shops in the complex, which probably contributes to the craziness. If you don't want to bother with the crazy parking lot there's an abundance of street parking close by. 

The service wasn't that great when I went, the girls at the till weren't that friendly but I wasn't super bothered by it since they were so incredibly busy. It took a while for my spring rolls and I went up to the counter to ask for them, and they were sitting behind the counter not being called out. The girl was kind of snippy about it but I didn't really care since I just wanted my food. 

Overall, not bad. Was worth the visit because the bubble tea was delicious, and I'll probably come back some other time, maybe to enjoy a bigger dish or a game. I take experiences like this as a grain of salt- hopefully I come next time and they're friendlier. If not, I know I can always leave with a delicious drink that I came for.

What a great restaurant! There are few things in life that I enjoy more than hot vegan soup and this place was spot on. They have a vegan pho soup, amazing spicy noodles with tofu and veggies, and super friendly service. The food was super cheap and filling and I would definitely go back.

I stumbled across this fantastic place while wandering down Magazine St. As Californian vegetarians, we were, to put it mildly, THRILLED! And then the food came and we were astounded. We opted for the tofu pesto sandwich - Delicious. Meat eaters are welcome here too though. I'd say its the perfect brunch spot. :-)

This is a historic hotel in the French quarter. My wife and I have stayed her multiple times and always enjoy it. The roof top pool
Is great and the carousel lounge in the lobby is amazing.  The cost is reasonable for a stay here and the staff is very attentive. If you don't stay here for some reason at least walk in and give it a look. Very classy hotel steeped in history.

Once you try the fajita wrap, you'll never get anything else at HipCityVeg. It's honestly one of the best things I've put in my mouth--and a lot goes in there. The sweet potato fries come with a great black bean/cilantro dip that's unlike most anything else. I. Love. Hipcityveg. It's quick, it's good food, it's all vegetarian.

I wouldn't know how this tour is because we were unable to go on it. The evening of our 5 in 1 tour it was raining so hard we couldn't see out our hotel window. I called to see if we could reschedule for the next evening before we left town and I was told no refunds or rescheduling. They were completely unaccomadating which leaves a bad taste in my mouth. They got $50 for a service they did not provide. I will tell everyone I know who visits not to use this company and warn all yelp users don't book with this company unless there is 100% sunshine forecasted. I am very disappointed they did nothing to accommodate us when we politely asked for any sort of change since the tour would have been miserable if we did go. The tours seem very interesting and would have loved to go on one. Next time we are in New Orleans we will book with a different company

We had a fun time because it was an unusual day we had the restaurant to ourselves.  It was XMas eve day and not many places were open in VC. This was one of our two finalists after scanning reviews of local restaurants so we ducked in to ask if they were serving lunch.

The waiter greeted us and said they were mainly focusing on catering for the day but he'd ask the chef if she could handle cooking for us.  The answer came back yes but that we'd be her only customer's for the day!  (They did indeed turn other customers away after we were seated.)

The two of them, later just the chef after our waiter excused himself to do a delivery, took good care of us.  We tried quite a few things, including salad, soup, and main courses.  The food was excellent (although we'd probably not order the calamari sandwich again - tasty, but the calamari was much better without the bread) and although I'm sure she was really busy in the kitchen the timing of everything served worked out just right.

We will eat here again if we're in VC.

I am not much of a doctor person, but I have recommended this place to all of my friends who are looking for doctors. When I was sick, the staff was patient, kind, and helpful.  I got an appointment the same day I needed it--within 2 hrs.  Since I was pretty sick and worried, I needed to follow up more than once and ended up seeing more than 1 doctor. Though, they both seemed more than competent and surprisingly easy to get along with.  They didn't throw pills at me to get me out of the door by just prescribing antibiotics and ordering labs, but they worked with me to get me better as quickly and safely as possible, teaching me a lot that I didn't figure out by internet research.  These guys are all great.  Highest compliments to Penn's Finest.

Dark, very cluttered, and filthy, it resembles a pack-rat's basement far more than it does a retail store. With so many similar venues in the area, it's difficult to understand what's keeping this one afloat, unless it's a front for cock fights, high-stakes poker games, or illegal drugs.

Nice location and restaurant but AWFUL SERVICE. This is a newly built Pizza Hut so the building is nice and new, wish I could say the same about the service. I've ate here before and have been ignored by my waitress, the second and last time I ate there my supposable hand tossed pizza turned out looking like a thin crust doughy awful tasting pizza. Not to mention meanwhile as we are eating you can hear the employees in some sort of an argument. AVOID and save yourself from the disappointment

We took a swamp tour with them about 4 years ago and then went back again this trip with family. I accidentally booked for the wrong day and when we showed up and were told this I was afraid we'd made the trip for nothing. They were able to get us on a tour and had a really good time. Captain Ron was entertaining and informative. Would definitely recommend.

I used to come to Biscuits awhile ago, when it was a few doors down from the where it is now. Apparently it has come under new ownership since then - and not for the better.

My friends and I had come in during the last week of June for the first time since the move/owner change. There was quite a bit of America decoration, but it didn't really phase us, as it was entirely seasonally appropriate. However, we knew there was something a little creepy going on when we came back at Christmas and it was all still there. The whole place screams "'MURRRICA!!!'" a little too loudly. Plus, they pepper the waiting area with Christian paraphernalia. I love that we have a free country where you can garishly display your religious preferences however you like,  but at the end of the day it can turn people off. 

That aside, it was a little overpriced for what you get, which is basic-ass breakfast food. Besides the Patriotism being shoved down your throat with every bite, the restaurant is housed in an old dance studio, so the atmosphere is a little off. The service is slow and forgettable. The owner's snotty replies to the criticism below honestly make me never want to go back.

2-stars for their awesome home fries and Elvis-themed bathroom, though!
This place is a resort. The BBQ place is ok. Cold beer on tap. We like to stay under the solar panels In the shade with a patio area.
The food was just not good enough to match the price.  Very expensive and the food did not particularly wow me.  It was overall OK.

My boyfriend and I stayed in the "Deluxe King + Whirlpool Tub" room last year in May. It was a great experience! The Eagle Inn is clean, pretty and so comfortable. I don't think the prices are too bad considering I love it so much...however, if any of you are questioning whether you should stay here because of the cost, say YES and book it! The little extra cost can actually save you money if you take advantage of the breakfast provided (and it's great)! I agree with other reviewers that the staff is great, helpful and friendly without being overly ecstatic ("annoying") like other popular chain hotels. I can see this place being good for everyone....families, couples and friends. I'll be back in about 10 days and I cannot wait to relax in the peaceful atmosphere of the Eagle Inn.

The food here is absolutely amaizing. Perhaps the best Indian in Saint Louis, or at least out of the six places we've tried. We had biryani, vegetable korma, paneer tikka masala and naan. It was the best naan by far. You can order to a custom spice level. We went with 4 out of 10. It was perfect for me, but a little too spicy for my wife. The host (I assume the owner) was very pleasent and attentive.

I would give 5 stars but the food was a little slow to come out, and there was a significant delay for the naan. It is very new so some service glitches may be expected. We will definitely be going back.
Wow. That was incredible. Best lunch I've had in a month. Try their tacos - fish and veggie

I had the opportunity to visit Philadelphia with my sister & brother and when looking for things to do a cop recommended this shooting range. John gave us a lesson and he was funny but informative.  John and Eddie then assisted us in going through the amo. It was one of the best times of our vacation. I highly recommend anyone who visits Philadelphia to stop by...

Excellent gelato and sorbet in a quaint setting! I stopped in with some friends on a hot day when in the Grand Central district doing some shopping. The price is more than fair for the quality of product. I would recommend the coconut sorbet (great if your a coconut lover like me!) or the mango sorbet. Both were delicious and refreshing for a hot summer afternoon. They also have smoothies and a variety of coffee based beverages.

Since the place is newly opened, they are still working on getting some things together. The owner told us that they will soon have a bar with wine and local beers, and do some wine and dessert pairings. Can't wait for that!

I order King Cakes from here every year. Shipped to me and to my clients all over the country. I always get rave reviews at how delicious they are, and of course, I personally prefer this king cake to any other. Everyone gets a kick out of putting the icing on and decorating with colored sugar. Also, their French bread and Doberge cakes are to die for. The Doberge doesn't ship very well though FYI.
This place has a great happy hour and amazing food! My favorites are the smoked salt escolar, truffle salmon, & luscious lemonfish.

Really impressed with my meal here. Came in around 8pm on a Saturday night and we were able to get seats at the bar in front of the kitchen.

Got the beef skewer and corn skewer, both were fantastic. Beef was tender and I liked how they had coarse sea salt crystals on the side. Corn was perfectly grilled and had good seasoning on it, also nice that it came with two pieces of corn instead of just one.

I ordered the shio ramen, the noodles were perfectly cooked, and there was a nice thick piece of tender pork belly. Broth was a little thicker than I'm used to, also wish they had a pork broth because it's a little weird eating pork with chicken broth. The skewers were probably better than the ramen but the ramen was still pretty good.

Service was fine and it was cool to see them preparing the food. I was actually surprised how good the food was because none of the chefs/cooks in the kitchen were Asian (except maybe one could've been part Asian).

Overall, I was really impressed with my meal and would definitely eat here again.

Enjoyed a great brunch here on a Saturday with a friend of mine. We arrived around 9:30 AM and the dining room was full. There was a decent overflow of people waiting and I anticipated a much longer wait time than what we experienced which was about 20 minutes. This gave us time to engage in some observation of the clientele as well as the delicious breakfast items being pushed out by the kitchen. 

I loved the decor, clean, modern and welcoming! 
The breakfast menu can satisfy from savory to sweet. My friend and I shared a cinnamon roll before our main dish arrived. She had the eggs Benedict and I had a wonderful has. The food was seasoned really well, came out hot, and was ample in size for our post yoga consumption, I had to take some of my hash home. 

Overall I am for sure a fan of this place and look forward to dining on the patio when the weather is a bit warmer! 

My only criticism is for a refill of coffee they charge you .75 cents.  I don't know enough about the quality of coffee they serve but I can't imagine it's so extraordinary that you'll need to charge customers extra for a refill. Was just a tad put off by this!

I've stayed in a hotel across the country every night for over a month and this is by far the worst. We called and asked to check in early and were told check in would be at 3pm but to come in and request an early check in. We came in at 1pm and were told check in was actually at 4pm but that they would have the room ready in an hour and give us a call. 4pm rolls around and still no call so we ho back to the hotel... and it still isn't ready. When we asked if the front desk could find out when it would be ready he just said "i dont know". We ended up sitting in the lobby for another 45 minutes until we could get in... the valet guy kept wandering off so it took forever for us to get keys to the car to grab our luggage. Finally we got upstairs... the phone doesn't work and the halls are so narrow we can't get the bell cart in the room. Later when my friend came back to the hotel, she found that you had to have a key to even get into the hotel itself and hers had stopped working. After knocking on the door for several minutes a lady finally answers and accuses my friend of lying about staying there. She was treated like a criminal, ridiculous. Also they apparently only issue 2 keys so if you lose yours or it stops working, you're shit out of luck. Please, for the love of god, don't stay here!

P.S. I also posted this review on TripAdvisor and just received a response from them... not apologizing, but basically saying I lied about what time I was actually checked in and that "their records indicate that everything was fine so my review is puzzling"... umm actually what's puzzling is that you would lie about what happened and then try to excuse it on a public forum.
Love this place! But....you need to figure out your staffing and floor coverage. Bar is fine but hard to find seats there. Hostess seems lost 1/2 the time and we see 3-4 tables walk out unserved.

I'm a small town girl and I've always heard the big city car salesmen are shady and will try to sell you an overvalued vehicle. McMahon Ford lived up to every negative stereotype and more. We've been checking out the prices of a certain vehicle online and elsewhere. We saw something we liked on McMahon's lot a few weeks back. We finally had a moment to go take it out for a test drive this week. The salesman did not seem interested in selling us the car at all, in fact he didn't even offer us a business card. When discussing price, he pointed to their online price and was not interested in offering us anything less eventhough it was no where close to the appropriate Fair Market Value. While the car was listed as "new", it had 5,000 miles on it because it was a demo car and it had some other issues as well. Just to give you an idea here--the vehicle itself had been sitting on the lot for 9 months, had been through a hail storm (and repaired) and when we opened the hood when inspecting, mice had gotten in there over the winter and had been trying to make a nest out of the underlining of the hood. I decided to call the sales manager and see if he would be interested in offering a fair price. I politely tried to point out reasons why I felt the vehicle should be offered at a lower price and even mentioned how it compared in price with Fair Market Value. The manager would not negotiate whatsoever and in fact told me, "Well then, I guess this isn't the car for you!" I thanked him for his time and he rudely slammed the phone down. I'm no longer interested in purchasing at all from this dealer and would not recommend this dealer to anyone.

I so wanted this store to be good. One really nice thing is that the store is spacious. Unlike the former Von's store, there are no cardboard stands of goods blocking the aisles. Two carts can fit side by side in the aisles!
Unfortunately, it is expensive. In addition, yesterday I went in again and several products had no prices (namely, the butter, which I had intended to buy). I realize the quick changeover must've been a nightmare, but it was frustrating to find missing prices. I did report it, and was assured that would be fixed soon. 
Also, last time I'd bought the Haggen brand of ice cream, only to discover later that the 4th ingredient on the list was corn syrup solids. The Haggen brand of cinnamon rolls had corn syrup and corn syrup solids. I know sweet rolls and ice cream are hardly health food but why add corn syrup? 
I ended up going to Albertsons to buy the exact same items I'd gone to Haggens for but for much less. Alas. It's a lovely grocery store but much more expensive and not necessarily higher quality. I'm hoping the manager will take notice and adjust pricing soon.

I visited Clayton Barber for the first time today, and will never be back. I'm glad that they are successful enough to run an appointment only barber, but rudely  turning away business with an empty shop is ridiculous.

A very small "Supercenter" that is in what used to be the areas smallest Kmart. They have nothing that one would come to expect from a Walmart Supercenter and what they do have is crammed into to small a space. This store only exists because the good folks at Walmart were not allowed to build their store 2/10 of a mile down the road next to the river. Oh well so now TS has a Frankenstein store that is not going to make anyone happy.

This place was "new" to us and we wanted to go try it out. Walking in, the place felt very homely. I liked how it smelled fragrant, but not as much as other restaurants. 

I ordered a yellow curry, my partner ordered the Thai basil, and we got Tom Yum Soup.
The curry was not bad, but the consistency of the curry was not good. It was very liquid-y and not enough curry. Okay likely added too much coconut milk. The Tom Yum Soup was great; amazing taste, but only for those who enjoy fragrant and heavy tasting soups. This soup is very strong in both sweet and sour. 

The Thai basil was a bit weird when we got it. It  was really watery; which most Thai basil do not have a large amount of liquid. It also tasted a bit off, the chicken did not taste great. Overall however, it was food: It tasted like amateur cook made the food.

TLDR; If you have not had Thai food before, this place might be okay for you. Normal Thai food tastes like this. However if you have eaten enough Thai food, you will understand that this place is a bit subpar.

This is a better Peruvian restaurant than others I had tried in Tampa. Good selections of seafood and meat dish here and the deserts supposed to be very good. Just too full for me to try the desert this time. The beef heart and octopus appetizers were excellent. The paella got  good sauce. The meat and shrimps inside was tender and mixed nicely with the rice. Even I reheated the leftover paella the next day. It still tasted good. It was a big plate, more than enough for 2 people. The service was very good. The interior was nice but a bit too dark for me.
Great prices for some creative donuts. Wish we could have also tried the fried chicken as it seems  to be famous around here. Loved the spicy PB and J donut.

I have really appreciate Skylar's great job on the color on my hair! He really is talented with color and will not take you out of your comfort level.  Very nice people and a place to go and relax with the best head massage by Skylar!

They really aren't kidding when they tell you that their seaweed salad is "different." It's different, and not in a positive way. It tastes as if it was soaking alongside fish. It tastes worse than seawater. It tastes like fishy water. If you like your seaweed, I assure you that you won't like this version. 
Other than that, the beef negimaki is tasty, but the sushi sashimi wasn't anything to brag about. I've had better sushi elsewhere.
delicious delicious definitely DELICIOUS!!! SO much so I am in middle of eating and felt inclined to rate on Yelp ...FYI, NOT USUALLY that Chic to go taking time on this.... But YUMMMMM

LOVE the atmosphere of this place! They have wonderful customer service, extremely friendly staff, good specials, and lots to do. There is an inside bar, and an upstairs area to escape to for some quiet time. There is also an outside bar with lots of games. Definitely recommend this place!

I just had the best Prime rib I have had in a long time. I cannot tell you how impressed I was with the food and the service! The prime rib was tender and juicy. It was smoked and some places over do it with the smoking process. However this prime rib was smoked to perfection. Not to mention our server was excellent. We live near by and we have definitely found our new favorite neighborhood restaurant. I highly recommend Pinnochio's bar and grille, you will not be disappointed!

Yipes...I don't think I will be back. I ordered a pulled pork sandwich. It was so tough and chewy I couldn't swallow it. It was inedible. I ordered turkey instead and the waitress said that if I had trouble chewing the pork the turkey wouldn't be any better because they use think bread. What! I told her again, that it was the pork, not the bread...she seemed disinterested. I ordered a fish sandwich instead. I think their quality control was off. There was a bone in the fish. I understand that might happen from time to time, but it shouldn't it.
I think there are much more consistent places around.

I love asahi! Their rolls are always fresh and delicious and i have never had one bad dish here.


I love their big man rolls and their westbank rolls the most. Dont even get me started on their special salads!! 

I've read some reviews on here and saw that some people had bad fish here but i never encounter that before and I eat here ever week. 

Over all the food was awesome and the service was good. Cant wait to come back !!!
Great thing to do while in New Orleans.  The food was good, the view was great, the narrator did a great job and the jazz band was very entertaining.  It was an all-around good experience.

Food tasted pretty good, atmosphere very good, but my bowl was half full and my friend's 3 tacos were tiny.  Four of us usually go there and will be there this weekend for an event at the Fox, and we are deciding on dinner options before, and none of them are Street Taco unfortunately.  Make sure you get filled up on beer, they will appreciate it because you won't get filled up on the food.
Dr. Griffin and Dr. White were great. I had been having pain between my shoulder blades for a while and they were able to get rid of it!!!!! Great people and great chiropractors as well!!

Superb bbq, catfish sandwich was great, and you must get the bbq nachos- the housemade potato chips underneath were soooo good. Super cute inside, friendly staff, great bar, awesome food priced just right. 5 stars across the board!

Food was ok. Wasabi potatoes had zero hint of wasabi and were quite bland. Oysters on the P.o. Boy was mostly breading. 

**Fries pickles were the best I've ever had! Crisp and fantastic!**

The waitress was prompt and very courteous. I would have like to tip more, but it was already included since we had a large party.

Excellent good, ordered the pecan crawfish and it was absolutely wonderful. I would highly recommend this place and will definitely come back.

Loved the live music there too.
Delectable açaí bowls/pita and wonderful staff. Ambience was quaint and clean; only downside was lengthy wait time for food.

Possibly my favorite lunch place in Brentwood.
Everything I've tried,has been delicious and fresh. You can see them cooking. The service is great and the staff is so friendly. Also love supporting this local small business!

Horrible waitress. Went around 2 pm on a Saturday and were seated quickly. Waited an exceedingly long time for our food to arrive; Lukewarm at best. Took my parents and the waitress was very short and snippy with my father who was having trouble deciding.  Have eaten at the Red Lobster in Marion IL and was vastly better. Will not be returning here again.

My husband and I save a 5 star review for something spectacular. So a 4 is pretty darn good. The food was great. We started with the hummus plate. It was very garlic heavy, but we enjoyed that. For main course, I had the shrimp scampi. The shrimp was large and not overly tough at all. It had a wonderful light reading on it. My husband had the strip steak. It was cooked deliciously with a nice seat on both sides. 

The issue we had was the service. We showed up even after the dinner rush, around 8 or 8:30 pm. Yet the response to our table was slow. When the waiter came over, we hadn't decided on a drink but we ordered the hummus, with no cheese on top (it comes with feta and my husband is allergic to cheese). And we waited for what seemed like a long time for a cold appetizer plate and not a dinner rush. 

Anyways, the hummus came out to the table and it was sprinkled all over with feta cheese. So we sent it back. The food runner was nice about it. We waited for a new plate, and then when that came back, our waiter finally came to take a drink order. We ordered our drinks and food at the same time, capitalizing on the presence at the table. Good news is after that, we were pleased. The food made up for the slow service and we left happy and full. 

We had a groupon, and we always determine if we'd be back without a groupon to pay full price. While the food is t cheap, it's not terribly expensive and we decided the food was great enough we'd be back!

Today we had lisa as our guide and Marcie as our driver. We had a great time and visited 4 wineries!!! Great value for the price and lisa had superb knowledge of the area and wines. We would highly recommend wine edventures.

Mmm teriyaki burger is the best! I have tried the other burgers and they are delicious as well. Highly recommend if you're a In n Out regular. Although both are very different you'll soon become a habit regular!
Great burgers, plus, the smiling service never dissapoints me!  I highly reccomend it!!!  :-)

My two sons and I decided to make reservations at the Red Pony. We have heard many wonderful things and we were not disappointed. The Waitress new everything about the cocktails and beer. My son described what type of beer he liked and told her surprise me. She picked out a delightful beer that he thoroughly enjoyed.  We had the Kung Puo Duck for an appetizer and it was delicious !  Everything was awesome and one of the best meals we have ever eaten. We will be back for sure!
Everything was on point. The food was delicious the servers were kind, generous and efficient. Definitely going to come back for a second time.

This hotel was good. I normally stay in a Courtyard, but the downtown Courtyard location was fully booked. Towne Place was clean and the staff was friendly. I personally prefer a traditional hotel room instead of the little suite with a kitchenette like Towne Place has. The room here was clean, the furnishings in good shape, and the breakfast was better than I expected. This ended up being a good backup place to stay. The rate seemed high but I think Boise hotels must have been busy and maybe more expensive than normal.

Excellent food in the cafe. Their pizza is almost as good as Tony's. Great thin crust, just the right amount of chew and no soggy spots. All the pizza needs is a little more zip in the tomato sauce. Good selection of top quality toppings.

This is a relaxing place to shop for speciality foods in a clean and friendly store. A little high price wise but so are all of these types of speciality places. At least here when you ask for Prosciutto you get the real thing.

Used the salon for my wedding and they did an amazing job on everyone!! We had Tessa, Jennifer, Heather and Michelle working on us. As the bride, Tessa and Jennifer did my hair and make up. I looked AMAZING. Jennifer is also amazing at waxing and makes you feel sooo comfortable. Love these girls!
Went here for a quick lunch. Food tasted great, and the service was fine. A bit pricier than other pho places, but the portions were very generous.

Buffalo chicken cheesesteak YES PLEASE! This place shreds the meat versus cubing and really cares about the quality of the meat. The people there are pretty friendly and there's nothing better than a great sandwich at a picnic table on a weekend afternoon. Great stop when I'm back in Philly.

Mr Sowell was quick, on time and most importantly fixed my tv where other repair men failed.  I now have my $4000 tv back and am incredibly happy. Also the price was reasonable.  I would highly recommend him. Trust me if he can't fix it, it can't be fixed.

Lily is great! She did an overlay on me today. I was 20 mins late to my appointment and she worked me into her busy schedule. Didn't have to wait more than 30 mins before she could fit me in. Offered me a coke or water while I waited. She knows her stuff, most nail techs nip you or claim that your nail bed is crooked on your finger, but she was very gentle and no nips on my cuticles! She didn't have to spend too much time drilling because she applied the acrylic with expertise.  So glad I stopped by today.

Beautiful, clean facilities. Full size baseball court. 25m pool. Racquetball and squash. Heck there are places to this gym that I'm still discovering.  If you don't mind the cost and enjoy all of the amenities, this place is definitely worth it!
This place didn't have anything German on the menu.  The burger was good but not $16 good.  Kind of overpriced for what they had.   It was okay but it is not worth the prices.

I saw a five star rating for this quaint place and I agree wholeheartedly!  They serve you with a carafe of coffee and a milk bottle full of chilled water while you decide from the vast array of breakfast choices. I highly recommend it and will return!

I've been to BJ's once before at cirrus park and it was excellent. This exp was the worst. We were all out of a family dinner and every single person didn't like their food except for one and she got deep dish rigatoni. We had the sante fe salad and it left a lot to be desired. The shrimp and quinoa dish was ok and that's being generous. The server was semi rude and seemed like she could care less we were there. I'm not sure what happened Bc I planned the dinner and was so excited to take the fam there but I certainly won't be back. The apps we got were mozz sticks and avocado rolls. Mozz sticks were cold. Cold!!! The avocado rolls were cold and all of the avocado was brown and mushy. I wouldn't waste my time or money here.

Good option when you're looking for something somewhat healthy and also quick. Get your food, eat and you're done...never a hassle, always fresh. Plus it has the best coffee, better than Starbucks or D&D :)
Food was good. Service wasn't great. Bad ventilation: I smell like I spent my lunch in a diner.

Awful experience with takeout last night. Arrived five minutes after my order was supposed to be ready and was told it was ready, but to take a seat and they'd bring it out. Fine, no worries, I sat down with the other two people waiting, both of whom seemed unhappy.
