There were only two tables dining in the restaurant itself on a Saturday night- should have been my first clue. Ten minutes later, my "ready" order appeared. I got the Tandoori Mixed Grill, which was supposed to be enough for two, an order of naan, and gulab jamun for dessert. The gulab jamun was AMAZING and the best I've ever had. Naan was decent. Unfortunately, my mixed grill was a HUGE disappointment. Some pieces were hot and some were ice cold. Seasoning was barely there. I ordered my spice level as "hot" but there was no spice to it at all. The shrimp were teeny tiny and tasted freezer burnt. The lamb was gross and I am a HUGE lamb fan. And thank goodness I wasn't sharing, because the portion was small and not enough for two people. And it didn't even come with rice, just $21 for a plate of meat! I will not be back and don't recommend it, especially for take out.

Came here for lunch with the bf this past weekend. We started with grape leaves and mussels. Loved the grape leaves, and the pita bread we got was delicious. We both liked but didn't love the mussels, would maybe skip them next time.
My bf got the gyro sandwich, and I got the charcoal chicken sandwich. The pita wrap it was in was delicious, and the whole sandwich was really yummy and flavorful! We were both really happy with the food here, and the waitress and waiters were very nice and friendly. We definitely plan to come back!

We had heard about this gem through a tour guide at the Belmont Mansion. Luckily, we listened to her advice! This was the best food we had on our trip to Nashville. The shrimp tacos were amazing! The bloody Mary's were spicy, but delicious!
They have the best chicken soup.  It had large chunks of shredded chicken with carrots, celery and penne pasta.  The penne was cooked al dente, not soggy.  It hit the spot after a long day.
1st time here, great food at very reasonable prices. Nice atmosphere, great service. In Reno once a month, will be back!

The people are nice but I made and appoinment for them to install a radio I bought in my 06 Pontiac vibe at 1 and they didn't get to it until 5:30 and I had to and they said it would only take half an hour to put it in and it's almost been an hour and they're still not done they tend to fall behind quite a lot I gave a 3 star not for their quickness but for their politeness

This was not the best, at least the salad.  The dressing just did not taste good and they were out of two of the toppings I wanted.  It was really dry and an overall disappointment.  Stir fries looked much better.

I normally hate leaving bad reviews before giving a restaurant a second and third chance but I don't think I'll ever go back here again.  
We had a party of 8 seated downstairs on a Friday night in the cushion room @ 730 pm.   5 of the party showed up early and ordered drinks.  We got them to preorder a dish for us as we were going to be 15 mins late.  Upon arriving the restaurant was mid packed.  We went downstairs and ordered drinks and food after a 30 min wait cause the server was busy.  Well fast forward 2 hours later, not even exaggerating...the time was 9:25 when we got our first dish we pre ordered in the car on the way to the restaurant.  The server was very apologetic.  We were very antsy at this point and upset.  
The platter was scarce but food was good, our prawns were stone cold.  Not worth the extra cost as the portions were tiny.  The server took off an appetizer from the bill and offered free dessert for the wait.  Well we were starving at this point so we walked to Old Spagetti Factory and enjoyed  a quick good meal.

To sum up...2 hrs wait for food, cold prawns, tiny portion size vs cost and starving.  Our meal still cost us $30 per person.

We won't be back and our group was so unimpressed they swore this place off too.  Very disappointed.

2nd best shrimp and grits I've had in my life! Chris bartender was great and made me feel so welcomed even though I was alone.  I spoke with some natives and they weren't familiar with this place but I followed my gut as long as the sun was up and took the walk to this restaurant and I'm happy I did.  I'll let them know tomorrow that they have to check this place out.  I'm not an oyster fan but seeing these guys "shuck??" the oysters gave me a new appreciation of them.

Stayed here a few times because of the price. Never had a problem except for the smell I always get upon entering the room. Staff is friendly and has shuttles that go to the mall. Not the worst hotel I've been to, but I don't come here expecting a 4star hotel.

Got an inspection today and had a brake light out and was told the tires needed to be rotated(at no charge), I had to pay for two bulbs (I kept the extra bulb from the package (because I have so many uses for it), and I ridiculous change to replace a bulb, then I see a 26 dollar charge for the free tire rotation! Wtf pep boys, no charge means free in my dictionary, and when I asked about it I recieved a free oil change( which I do myself for the ost of oil and a filter! Which is less thn 26 dollars!) I

I just had the worst experience with this Quiznos.  We decided to order lunch for delivery, since we are having a sort of lazy Saturday.  We spoke with someone, I ordered the Veggie Guacamole and the boyfriend got an Italian.  We also got one bag of chips and two sides of dressing. We were told it would half an hour.

Like that ever happened.  An hour later we are starting to ponder the fate of our sandwiches.  There was no delivery driver in sight.  Then, behold, he pulls up to our house.  Half an hour after they said they would.

We realize there are no chips or dressing in our delivery bag.  We alert the delivery driver who offers to run back to the store to get them for us.  We decline, since it seems silly to send him all the way back to the store for a bag of chips.

My veggie guacamole sandwich is sans guac.  How does this happen? It's in the freaking name of the damn sandwich!  We call management.

We speak to Evan, tell him what was missing from our order, and he immediately responds by offering us to run the sandwiches back out with a coupon for twenty percent off our (which is not likely at this point). While I appreciate the offer, I am not going to wait another hour for a five inch sandwich.

He acts very surprised by the fact that it took an hour, gives me an excuse about how he has been gone all day, just got in, and is making himself food.  

I told him I would rather be refunded for order, at which point he gets confrontational, stating that even though WAY more than half our order is messed up, we can still eat the other sandwich, so he takes off the veggie and the chips (gracious of him, considering I never got the chips) and we hang up.  

The boyfriend bites into his Italian to find veggies that he ordered missing, and at this point I don't even want to deal with them again.

So Quiznos, I was sort of excited to try you again.  I hadn't eaten there in years, and now I am sitting here wondering why I decided to give you another chance.

Best Deep Dish in Nashville. They have great  service, homemade crust and their sauce is amazing.
It is a must try! 
 Trust me.

One of the best philly tacos I had so far it was worth the wait . I had the short ribs tacos it was delicious. The favor was decent. Staffs  was very friendly and helpful, since it was my first time there and i didn't know what to get. 
Just thinking about it,  I want to grab some more maybe I'll try the crunchy tilapia tacos or burritos.

This review is a tad bit late...the SO and I came here with our newborn baby for their Easter Sunday brunch. 

The brunch was actually a buffet made up of mostly local ingredients or locally sourced items (e.g., breads and pastries and desserts from Bon Ton Bakery). The price was super reasonable in my opinion ($45/person).

There were a couple of hot stations as well such as a customized omelette and ham. 

I found most of the items to be well made and the variety to be plentiful. The two items I had a problem with were the desserts as I felt they had been sitting out too long and tasted "off" but I was assured by the kitchen via our server that the items were okay to be sitting out for that long.

Our server was super pleasant (I think it was her first day?!).

The restaurant itself is a bright and beautiful space (also located in the Mosaic Centre in the SE of the city)

The one qualm I have to discuss though (as mentioned in another review by Annie J.) is the lack of change tables for babies in both the ladies and men's washrooms. What gives?! Along with our baby, there was another newborn baby seated at the table behind us and another older baby ahead of us. So families DO come but alas nowhere safe to change babies here. I had to resort to changing my little man on the bench in the shower in the ladies washroom...ugh! But it was tricky since I didn't want him to accidentally roll off so I had to manuever my way through the process by tucking things under my arm and around my wrist.  Needless to say, likely won't be back as long as we have a baby in tow.

I've been taking my pets to Street Road Animal Hospital for years. I tried many different vet practices before going there and can't imagine going anywhere else now. I can get an appointment quickly whenever one of my fur babies isn't feeling well and all the staff there are wonderful. I feel very confident in Dr. Baeza's ability to provide the very best care to my animals and I don't even know where to start in singing Amanda's praises. I always learn so much from her about whatever medical issues bring us in there as well as the follow up care to provide at home. Brittany and Dyan are two more of the longtime caring, informative staff. Also, the office is consistently clean and well maintained.

We waited almost an hour for pancakes and scrambled eggs! When we asked the server how long it'll take, hie responded "the people in the back are working really hard!" Horrible customer service, just HORRIBLE!!
Great coffee spot. They have a large selection of coffee, teas, and coffee and alcohol drinks. I just got the iced latte and it satisfied my coffee craving.

Good Chinese. I order pick up from here a couple of times a month. I usually get the same thing and its always been good and consistent. The service is fast and friendly. So far the fortune cookie lottery numbers are not lucky...
Moderate Food, Good location, Good Service, might return again but probably not, would rather keep looking for a better spot
This a sports bar/restaurant.  The food is good and the portions are huge. The waitresses are friendly. Oh yeah...the booths are kinda tight.

You write your own name on a list and check where you would like to sit. We checked outside. We had 5 people sit ahead of us so I asked one of the waitress's how long it would be and she I don't know how long people are going to be sitting outside! Well that should have been out first indication of what service we were going to receive. Unfortunately our waitress was the same person who was rude at the door. Her name was Laura. Three different groups sat down after us and got their food way before us. When we finally received our food it was all cold. She did not come back ONE time to ask us if we wanted anything! We asked her for our check and she went back into the kitchen and started scraping plates and clearing other tables. Had to ask another waitress for our check who immediately got it for us. Very disappointed. This was our last day in Sand Key. We were looking forward to a nice breakfast to start the day. I gave them 2 stars because if the food would have been warm it would have been good. The breakfast casserole is recommended. Should have went with our first choice of the Wildflower Cafe.

We ordered mild wings and garlic parmesan wings and they were so soggy and not crispy at all. They sucked! The sauce didn't even taste like mild and it was so buttery. We also ordered curly fries and we got a small little thing of it. It was the worst food. I will never order from here again. I was hoping a wing shop would have some good decent wings but it left me very disappointed.

Ok so today is my husbands birthday so I wanted to surprise him so we came here early for the happy hour to wait on our group to show up so we sat in the bar area and looked over the menu before ordering some happy hour sangria...another part of our party shows up and the waitress asks if we wanna be more comfortable sitting together so not thinking we say sure...she moves us to this back area of the restaurant and after we order more drinks and apps she proceeds to tell us that we aren't in happy hour area so drinks would be full price! Ok when you are moving a party from an area of happy hour don't you mention that before charging them!?!? This was the first mess up of the evening...I decided to be kind because it's my husbands birthday so we went on to food!! I give 3 stars because the food was pretty good...however when it came to the birthday surprise that was a hot mess I wish I could post a video because the server even acknowledges she has no clue what she's doing and she basically just pours alcohol over the dessert and serves it!!! Overall we will not come back!!! Note to self if you have a party of 5 or more you have an automatic 18% gratuity and then no separate checks!!!

This place is not just the best bakery in Wilmington- they may be the best in the Mid-Atlantic area!  I looooove this place and always forget about them until I have a party and need a bulk order.  I ordered a few dozen of their white and wheat rolls and slices of the speciatly pies- tomato pie, ricotta & plum tomato, and roasted pepper for a party on Saturday night.  As always- everyone was asking where i got the bread from.  The focaccia was a huge hit and I now have wonderful breadcrumbs in my freezer from what we didn't finish.

If you visit Reno you need to attend this little gem in the heart of Downtown. It's located close the the River walk movie theater and is nestled on the perfect street for a nice quality lunch.

The soup was to die for and the food tasted so amazingly good I will definitely return. The owner was friendly and made time to greet people. The service was fast and friendly.

This place has become a part of my regular habits. My wife and I both work into the evening, so a kitchen that is open til 12 or 1am is nice to have available. 
The zingers (a kind if buffalo chicken fingers) are almost always delicious and come with a variety of sauce choices. I really enjoy their baby back ribs and my wife enjoys that Mahi is always available. 
This place has a fantastic selection of draft beers and many microbrews and crafts. I thought a chain sports bar would just have the big chain beers, but occasionally they have something I've never heard of. It's always changing with the season as well. 
They take requests with the TVs and even will let you reserve one for a game. 
The place looks like it's still brand new and the decor is sports bar standard. I wish they had some more regular tables as most of their tables are either booths or high tops.

The customer service was bad. The margaritas were worse. Mine was so sour that I asked for another shot. Not only did the waitress not ask if my margarita was okay, but she charged me an extra $7! that was the worst $17 dollar margarita I've ever had.

Back in my heyday I thought I was a karaoke star. I have since grown older, wiser, and perhaps more aware of what my own voice sounds like. It ain't pretty, folks. I'm trying to come up with a comparable image, but I'm stumped. Anyway, I have avoided participating in karaoke for quite some time. I have been to several NOLA venues that offer it but I have just stood back in the crowd watching. Then I went to Kajun's for the first time. I don't know if this was a good thing, but I am so comfortable here I don't give a shit what my voice sounds like. Note to self:  Africa by Toto is a much harder song than you think so no more of that Kilimanjaro bullshit. But if I want to sing Barbie Girl or something by Cake (when the voice is really hurting), then I'm going to rock that out. They have a great 2 for 1 drink check-in deal with Yelp, friendly bartenders and patrons. This is a great way to spend a night with your friends in the St. Claude and now that they also have the pop-up restaurant Borachho attached, you don't have to hit Rally's for food! Warning: It can get pretty smokey in here if you hate that kind of thing.

This is more like a 2.5 star review. My recent experience was pretty "meh"...

I used to love this place when I lived down the street. I hadn't been in for a long time, and stopped in for a quick bite and glass of wine around happy hour time. I ordered a glass of wine, which was like $10. Not having a happy hour wine is really annoying, although they do offer a $20 bottle. Adding some glasses of wine to the happy hour menu would be cool. 

I ordered the pretzel with cheese. The pretzel was hard as a rock. So hard, in fact, that I couldn't cut it with a steak knife. I only ate about half because I was starving (it was 5pm and I hadn't eaten all day). Strangely enough, I feel like more than one employee saw me struggling to cut the damn pretzel, and no one asked me if everything was OK. Strange. I could have broken a window with that pretzel! Or a tooth!

Either way, it was a disappointing visit to a place I once loved.

Food was way over priced I liked the food but I'll never in my life will pay that much for a taco again that was crazy. $50 was just too much for 4 tacos 2 drinks and I'm not an ass so I left a tip, hopefully they change their prices soon. Good food though.

I LOVE this place! I am from Chicago, and visit the area sometimes a few months out of the year. This is my go-to place for produce when I dont go to local farms. Everything here is usually locally grown and LUSCIOUS! Excellent quality of produce, and I am very picky! Not only do they have a beautiful selection of veggies and fruit, there are  also a few homemade goodies (breads, cookies, honey etc) that are pretty dang good too! All that greatness that doesnt bust the bank, what more could you ask for?

EDIT: I am very angry at YELP for not filtering the right reviews. This produce stand deserves a 5 start rating, it is just that good. Produce here isnt labeled as organic, but a lot of the stuff is local, and a lot of farmers around here use integrated pest management. no farm wants to pay for the silly label of 'organic' and i dont blame them.... the government should NOT be taking a cut when we are trying to live and eat as we were meant to. Also, the produce here is not all huge and mutant like a lot of GMO i see at the grocery store... i wouldnt worry too much about that.

If they work on your make and model then these are the guys to see. Only reason they don't get 5 stars is that we had some kind of communication breakdown and it turns out my car was fixed a day earlier and I didn't know.

I'll start by saying this is moreso a 3.5 star than a 3 star.

Atmosphere:
As far as parking goes I would recommend parking on 4th - assuming there is any. We went on a Tuesday afternoon / evening for an early dinner before the Sounds game. They frequently have specials for sounds games and others so be sure you ask your server.

As far as atmosphere goes it reminded me more-so of a sports bar than a typical pizzeria but it wasn't a bad thing. Who knows, maybe all of the Chicago Pizzeria's are like this? Why Chicago? Cause that's where they're from and you can see all of the Chicago influenced memorabilia on the walls.

I've seen several pictures of the place and I can tell you its even smaller than it looks. By the time we got our food the dinner crowd was piling in and it was crowded. Our seats next to the window resulted in the maze we had to take if we needed to make it to the restroom.

Food:
They have a variety of food selection on their menus but if you come to a place called 312 Pizza Company you kind've have to try the deep dish pizza. We ordered a pepperoni deep dish and as soon as we did our waitress let us know it would take anywhere from 30mins - 45mins for it to come out so we ordered an appetizer of wings.

The wings weren't special in the least bit. They weren't bad but they weren't amazing either.

As far as drinks go they have a few cocktails but we stuck to the beers. Of which they have an interesting selection of craft beers to choose from, local and non.

Our pie came out after about 30mins and we dug in. Word to the wise - let it cool. I usually hate it when people use forks to eat pizza unless of course its a deep dish. Which I would advise if you decided to go with it then definitely fork it up. As far as the crust goes it was probably one of the best crusts I have ever had on a deep dish. The tomato sauce was just the right amount on the pie - not so little that I was eating crust and not so much that I thought it was a lasagna. As far as the quality of the sauce goes - I've had better. Don't get me wrong it wasn't bad but I wasn't blown away by it. I was still enjoying how great the crust was and I'm not really a crust guy.

Service:
Our waitress was very attentive. I've seen a couple of reviews where the service was lacking but our hostess and waitress were both great. After I finished my first beer she was back like a hawk ready to see if I wanted another. I switched to a can and it felt like she was back every time I took a drink out of it to see if I needed another. It could've been that the dinner crowd didn't show up yet, she was bored, or I come off as a raging alcoholic but I didn't mind.

Overall:
I definitely see it as a great place for before / after the Sounds games. As far as pizza in Nashville goes its a definite must try. Would I go out of my way to come here? No not really. Would I come back? Absolutely.

Easy to find though parking can be difficult in this area at time. Was able to get in for a last minute appointment. Got a simple long layered cut by Mike. No complaints. My hair is pretty easy to cut though. Wish the prices were a bit lower though....

Beautiful restaurant.. Great food with friendly & fast service .reasonable prices 
Large place ideal for special occasions 
Dining area is for casual or upscale dining 
Awesome pizza . Maria's homemade desserts are to die for. The proprietor makes them herself tots yummy. Shout out to cashier lady very friendly and professional

Depot burger, is one of the best burgers I've ever had. 
Their sweet potato fries are better than the regular ones.
Very nice service
Cool vibe and atmosphere
Home made gin and beers, along with selected drafts.
Great quality and a great experience.

Pizza is good as always, but also took two hours to arrive as always. Every time I order from this location, it arrives way past the stated time. Last time, I told myself I wouldn't order again. Tonight I had a late meeting and at 5:30 thought "I'll just order ahead to be delivered at 6:45." Got home at 7:20, it still wasn't here. I order Jets mainly for delivery; I would never order it if I had to pick it up. This location is so poor at the convenience factor that I honestly won't order again.
Great food, great place to catch the game and great prices for quantity and quality. Also had a great bratwurst there that was pretty tasty.

This is my favorite restaurant in Brentwood. The seating area is pretty small, so I usually pick it up and take it home or I go in and eat when I know if won't be crowded. The owner is very gracious. The Bi Bim Bop is fantastic but my favorite is the steak taco. I find myself craving it!  I buy a jar of kimchi every now and then too- it's always been very good.

This place is amazing.
It's a typical cafeteria line for food with the desserts, sides, and entrees and Sundays are VERY popular. I mean literally line on the sidewalk popular.
But the line goes fast, and they have a take-out line on the other side.
My personal favorite is the chicken fingers and mashed potatoes, but everything is good. Honorable mention to the cheesecake and rolls.
Anyone who prefers home cooked meals would love this place.

Rose with Simply Perfection Cake did an awesome job on our wedding cake!  It was a beautiful and delicious three tier cake with Lemon with lemon mousse, Red Velvet with Chocolate Mousse, and Strawberry with White Chocolate mousse!  If you need any type of cake made, give Rose a chance because she did an AWESOME job!  Thanks for all of your hard work!!

I had a very good breakfast here. It was the deluxe scramble which comes with your choice of ingredients. It took a while for the food to come, but it was worth the wait. I am happy that they are using the building well. I will definitely be returning to try other menu items.

We stopped by last Sunday based on the quality reviews of my fellow yelpers, and we enjoyed our breakfast.  The apple empanadas were just coming out of the oven and the place tasted great.  My wife and I shared our meals and one of the empanadas, and so we left full but not stuffed, as I've been known to do in the past.

The one quick tip I'd leave you is that this is not a gussied up, fancified place.  It's a simple place with good food, a friendly attitude and nice service.

We'll be back.
I almost committed suicide at this McDonald's it was so bad, can't believe I am even writing a yelp review on a McDonald's.

I was just in St. Louis for a quick trip and found myself seeking a place to eat around some of the main attractions - around the st louis arch, downtown, and the st louis cardinal stadium - LOVED calicos - pretty much anything you want to eat there. Good food, quick, and a huge bar to enjoy your spirits especially on game day. Well done and thanks!

Great food great beer great prices. However my last experience was not so great. My girlfriend was in a wheelchair she had just had surgery and so we needed a table, the host that night told us to wait for a table, we waited for half an hour he kept letting people in ahead of us and when we went to ask him what was up he said they were about to have a live band and no tables were available and the kitchen was closing. had it not been for this last experience...5 stars.

My husband and I visited the 21st Amendment bar in New Orleans for a few drinks and jazz. We were there on a Wednesday at 5pm. The place is small but we were comfortable in the little lounge off to the side. The place was full of people enjoying a casual drink and some live tunes. The drinks were creative and good. I had a Frenchy and husband had Sazarac. We chatted with the manager, Angela, for a good while. Very friendly and welcoming. She told us about the history of the place. A New Orleans local, she clearly has a passion and love for the city. This classy place fits right in. Convenient location.

They put the D in Delicious! Their food is a culinary delight and very savory. The food is masterfully prepared and presented. I am not from the area but I will surely recommend this restaurant to anyone and revisit them the next trip to this area.

We love coming here! Friendly staff and great options! Sometimes the line is long, but it's expected when a new place is opening. We come here frequently. Even our four year old loves this place. Definitely going to be loyal customers.
My friend & neighbor got catering from here (all vegan) and it was amazing. Will definitely be going to the restaurant soon with my husband as I am certain he will enjoy it as well.

A solid establishment. Q pizza was yummy, loaded with bacon. They have roasted garlic on their condiment table.
Mac and cheese was great. It's good for your soul.

I've heard a lot of cool things about Misconduct, so I figured to try this place for myself. Unfortunately, I do NOT agree.

The menu looked good, but the food was mediocre at best. The avocado sticks had a great panko breading and was well cooked, but it was bland. The garlic aioli tasted like canned mayo with store-bought minced garlic. Instead, we put a lot of salt on them.

I had ordered the shrimp sliders...that was the WORST!!! There was NO indication that this slider had shrimp in it. When I bit into it, it tasted like I had a mouth full of grease and gristle. 

The server was very nice and accommodating. She asked if I wanted anything else. I ordered the salmon sliders...can't go wrong with salmon, right? Wrong. The salmon was good, (but here we go again!), it was bland. The sauce on it looked good, but that was bland too. After putting a bunch of salt and pepper on it, I took a bite and the bun was overcooked; it was toasted all the way though. At this point, I just asked for the check.

I'm glad they didn't charge me for those meals. However, it would've been nice if management showed some kind of respect AND a professional courtesy by coming to our table to address our concerns. As far as I'm concerned, "misconduct" is a perfect name for this place.

My favorite sushi place ever. The best lunch specials around, 2 rolls for as low as $7.99 with soup and salad. Can't beat it! My favorites are #5 Spicy Beach and #27 Crab Special. 

Lots of options to choose from and they have great drink specials! 2 for 1 everyday.

Mad Mex has been my favorite Mexican place for years, because they offer gluten free and dairy free options (you'd be surprised how hard it is to get places to omit queso or crema fresca).
Before, we'd have to drive up the turnpike to Willow Grove, or go to the crappy one in University City. So, naturally, I AM SO HAPPY.

Pros:
-It's bigger than most other Mad Mex locations
-The food has been consistently good, every time we've gone
-The wait staff are so nice! And the manager likes to walk around and check in to see how people are doing, too
-Margarita and drink specials, regularly
-TOFU SOUR CREAM

Cons:
-We like to go earlier, 5:00 or 5:30, because it can get busy with families and screaming kids around 6. 
-I think it's a big drinking spot, without supplies to back it up. We've ordered a beer and had them come back saying that the keg was kicked a few times.

Located in the SoBro area of Indianapolis, La Mulita is a fantastic, new dining option for customers looking for a cheaper and more casual version of Delicia. It is the perfect place to grab a bite to eat if you are in the mood for Latin American cusine with a slight Caribbean influence.  Come here for lunch rather than dinner because the lunch menu offers more options.  It's the perfect place to have lunch with coworkers, friends or family. 

After looking at their menu for a while, I was torn between a couple options. Luckily, the lunch menu offers a 'Pick Two' option so I selected the two cemitas that drew my attention. The first was the cochinita pibil cemita, featuring pulled pork roasted in achiote topped with pickled onions, black beans and a MEASLY slice of avocado. The sesame bun was toasted slightly but still maintained a softness that provided a great backdrop to the strong Latin flavors of the black beans and the achiote. My only complaint was the avocado slice was too small, slightly disappointing and not contributing to the flavor of the cemita as much as I had hoped. 

The second was the pork milanesa cemita which consisted of breaded pork under a thin layer of Oaxaca cheese, chorizo, fried egg, chipotle peppers and cilantro mayo. This was my favorite of the two. The breading on the pork served as an intermediate between the spice of the chipotle peppers and the chorizo. The cilantro mayo and the fried egg were two great additions to the texture of the cemita and combined well with the rest of the ingredients. 

Also photographed are the vegetarian cemita and the carne asada taco. The vegetarian cemita consisted of a lightly breaded eggplant patty adorned with roasted peppers, chihuahua cheese as caramelized onion. The cemita also featured the delicious cilantro mayo. 

The carne asada taco was filled with marinated skirt steak, onions, cilantro and radish. Ingredients were served in a corn tortilla. The only complaint was that the taco was very tiny and not very filling. My advice? Stick to the cemitas. 

Overall, a great new restaurant in a fabulous part of Indianapolis. A much better price than Delicia and it's casual, rustic vibe is inviting and hip. I can't wait to try a few other items on the menu whenever I'm back in town!
Good value dinner specials, great beef barley soup and tapioca pudding. Cool car-themed decor.

Virginia G said it - even though her review is almost 2 years old.

The place is clean, oddly painted inside, the owner does come around to check that things were okay and the wait staff is attentive.  

Everything is pork, pork, pork, with some veal and tons of butter.  We've been too full to try many of the desserts.

My favorite is the salad.  I could honestly and truly take home a bucketful and be happy forever.  It's dressed with a light dill creamy dressing and contains marinated red kidney beans and beets (which I learned to love thanks to this salad) and a few other things that are just delicious.  I will have to go back again, and re-review the place because it's been at least a year, but that salad is amazing.

Worthwhile, slightly pricy, heavy on the butter, but good.

I am a huge fan of New Day Meadery! My wife and I live in Muncie, but try to stop by any time we are in Indy. To sit down and try so many different Meads, at reasonable prices, can't be beat. The atmosphere alone, is hip and jazzy. Brett and Tia are some of the nicest people that we have ever met. Parking is a challenge, but no fault of NDM, and it is well worth a short walk to taste such delicious Meads!

It is a must try if you are near Fountain Square!
Had delishious drinks amazing muscles and a great server. Perfect location on the water with wires to keep the seagulls away!

Zero stars if I could! 

Don't waste your time or money on Remember Me.  The older lady who runs the place only runs clients away.  I had a bad experience the year before (the old lady was rude and breathing down my neck while looking for a costume), and dreaded to go into this place, but I lived right down the street and needed a costume quick.  I was on my cell while in a rush to grab and 80's outfit, talking to a friend who had been admitted to the hospital the night before.  There was only 1 other customer in the ENTIRE store other than myself.  

I wan't even allowed a chance to browse, she asked me exactly what I was looking for in a rude tone.  When I told her I was just going to browse, she loudly told me "NO".  She said No, I wasn't going to be in her store while I was on the phone, it was disturbing to all the other customers, that I would need to either get off the phone or leave if I wanted to talk on the phone.  I left immediately, extremely angry.

On my way to the mall to find an outfit (which I found something great at Forever 21 for VERY cheap), after getting off the phone with my friend I decided to call Miss Crabby pants from Remember Me to let her know her attitude wasn't necessary.  She didn't even allow me to finish what I was saying and hung up on me, twice!

This woman should not be allowed to run a business, especially a store that COULD be great.  There are some costumes that are really cute, but TRUST ME, it isn't worth it.

Found this place because I was starving during my late class in grad. school.  Not good..... not good at all. Mind you, I ordered SHRIMP FRIED RICE! How do you screw that up? Well, they found a way.  My rice was rock-hard and flavorless and there were about 5 shrimp in my pint.   I have never tasted BAD shrimp fried rice, most places know how to make AT LEAST that.... except Chinese Delight.

Meh.

After reading and hearing a ton of hype about the Village Whiskey burger and duck fat fries, my husband and I ventured out of South Philly to try it out. We were super lucky and excited to find two open bar seats without having to wait an hour. 

When I asked the bar tender if the burger came with fries, he laughed and said that other restaurants only do that as "filler food" and that we'd have to order them on the side, they're just that good. And that the burger is so amazing that you don't need fries. We thought "fair enough, must be good." 

We got our burger and the fries. At best, the burger was mediocre. It was juicy and on a nice bun, but otherwise a very expensive ordinary burger. The fries were also pretty standard. There were few and they were presented nicely in a little cup, but pretty standard. 

While we were full at the end of our meal and it wasn't terrible, it was just average at best. The bartender was a bit cocky about the food which also was a big turn-off. I'd rather head back to our hood at Royal Tavern for a delicious, juicy and flavorful burger + plate of fries for less than half the cost.

I'm still dreaming of the sangria that I ordered. Sooo good.

The cocktail selection is really impressive.  I was conflicted between the sangria and the caipirinha.. thankfully my mom ordered the caipirinha and I ordered the sangria, so I got the best of both worlds :) And both were mucho delicioso! 

We opted out of the appetizer and jumped headfirst into entrees.  I ordered the enchiladas de verduras and my mom ordered the empanadas.  I was a little worried that the portion sizes wouldn't be too big and that I'd still be hungry after eating, but no fears here. It's a nice restaurant with generous portion sizes. What more could you want?! 

I liked my enchiladas, but I LOVED the empanadas.  The way the pork was seasoned in the empanadas was amazing. Both entrees came with a green colored rice which was really delicious.  I liked the enchiladas, but didn't love them and wouldn't order them again.  I thought some of them were more filled than others, but the ones that had a lot of filling were really good. Just wish all of them would've been like that.

We didn't order a dessert, but I would love to try the churros next time I go back! 

I like the location of Delicia and I like the interior although it was really, really loud... a bit hard to hear.  I will definitely go back!

Watta great place to stop in Pass-a-grille!

For starters, they sell shave ice*. It's the real deal, even the machine was manufactured in Hawaii.

They pour decent coffee, espresso and have ice cream and baked goodies. The kids will love it.

As good a place as any to stop for a treat in that area.

Location, location, location.

4 stars, hooray!

*if you don't know, you betta axe somebody.
Good Food ... Great Service ... And some  awesome Paradise Pie for dessert!

We split a pizza and a salad. Lisa enjoyed picking the toppings! The atmosphere is upbeat and bright. Best Pizza experience in OV. Surprising Affordable for the taste and experience, usually we are stuck with the opposite.

The kind maitre d' greeted me at the door and found me a seat at one of the few tables in this small café.  It was so small that he had to use my table for pitchers of water and tubs of dishes as he cleared other tables.  But he was really nice about it.  I recommend the Fleur-de-lis omelet--green peppers, onion, provolone and bits of sausage, covered with a mildly spicy red sauce and crawfish.  This came with wholegrain toast and fried hash browns.  The bloody Marys with bacon-infused vodka and full strips of bacon swizzle sticks looked amazing--it was just too early for me to indulge.

I went here for dinner last week and got 3 tacos. The portion size was good. The chicken was just ok. The carne asada was better. They have a salsa and topping bar to add to your tacos. It's hard to tell what everything is though. They should label the toppings.

I HIGHLY recommend this moving company. They get ALL the stars!!! 
Benson, the owner, went out of his way to accommodate my request to do a site survey, because of my anxiety about "hidden fees" when it comes to moving companies and second floor apartments. 
Then comes moving day. The 3-man crew immediately eased my anxiety about the the move. They were right on time, they were polite, they handled all of my belongings with the utmost care, and most of all they were extremely professional!! Calvin, Nathaniel, and Ro (my crew)were a joy to work with. 
There were no hidden fees and the price is was quoted was exactly what I was charged and the time frame I was given was exact. 
Again, I would HIGHLY recommend this company to any and everyone who's looking to move to/from the NOLA metro area, no matter the distance!!!

Great local restaurant to take the space of my beloved Home Wine Kitchen in Maplewood. Several girls and I had brunch there with great food and service. My pancakes with granola and fresh berries were absolutely delicious with the perfect pairing of a Matcha green tea latte. Can't wait to return and try them for dinner!

Absolutely fabulous. Fried macaroni & cheese are a must have. Burgers were out if this world. Prosciutto burger & buffalo burgers were the Best ever!!! Next time we're in Franklin TN we will be dining here again.

Daniel did an awesome job troubleshooting our fireplace.  Several other fireplace companies were not willing to come out based on the brand of the fireplace.  He was very knowledgeable and happy to explain the issue.  Very happy to have Daniel as a resource.

Sid Booker's is much apart of Philly as Cheesesteaks and Soft Pretzels.  I just always remember them being there and the smell overtaking my senses as I approached the take-out window to place my order. 

The shrimp are always a consistent golden brown and the taste is delicious!  The only side available is fries - makes your choices simple!!
The food here is delicious and the beer selection has something for everyone. I have been to this taphouse/restaurant about 4 times now and tried something different every time, all of it is amazing!
Chicken was rubbery, fried rice has no vegetable or egg, it's just yellow rice that tastes stale. Will stick to pizza for delivery when staying at this hotel.

I was let down by the pizza I had delivered to my residence.

I ordered a plain cheese pizza with broccoli on half of the pizza.  The broccoli was a collection of HUGE chucks of broccoli stem.  I like broccoli stems, but not massive chunks all over.  Maybe 3 or 4 actual florets (soggy and not appetizing).  

Topped with way too much cheese, which was almost fully congealed by the time it came to my door.  Dough was just barely cooked.

What a great time our party of 7 (4 adults, 3 kids) had! Cap'n Mike was not only knowledgeable but was funny and entertaining as well. He taught us about much of the wildlife we encountered and knew where the best spots were for spotting gators. He truly made our experience great! He even took us to a secluded spot that another boat barely went into (meaning it's not necessarily included in every tour) and we were treated to two baby Russian boars who came out to say (grunt) hello. We took the daytime 5pm tour (there's also a nighttime 5pm tour during non summer hours.)

We took our own car to the site (Slidell, LA), which made the tour half price, and even found a $3 off coupon on the internet.  

As for mosquitoes, when speeding down the bayou, there's no worry of them, but when we went into the secluded spot, we did see some flying around.  A couple of my companions got bitten, but I was fine. 

It was one of the highlights of our trip to New Orleans!

My brother took me here the dinner during my visit to NOLA. The restaurant is adorable, beautiful decor with southern flair. The hostess sat us at our table immediately and the server brought us water as we got settled. 

The menu had a nice selection and can tell that they like to provide a southern twist to their dishes. We ordered the French fries with truffle mayo- which I was disappointed the fries looked pressed rather then freshly cut.  For an upscale restaurant I would think they can offer fresh cut potatoes. 

I ordered the beef "pot roast" which turned out to be a perfectly cooked filet with the yummiest sauce that had mushrooms, carrots, and peas. The steak was perfectly medium rare and sauce was nicely cooked. My only criticism that the dish was heated so the good got cold real quick!

This is an upscale restaurant so the service was up there but little details of food preparation does not match up with the price of the dish.

We loved this place! The staff was really friendly and the helicopters are a lot of fun.  The play area is small, but still kept my children occupied for a long time- I had to pull them away.  All in all a great local family outing.

This place is so yum! I came here while visiting Nashville and I really wish we had this place in Chicago.

I ordered a Build Your Own Salad with arugula, chicken, goat cheese, strawberries, and vanilla-poached pears. Super fresh and healthy. They do cram the salad into this jam-packed plastic container, and when you open the container, your salad contents will likely overflow out of the container. Why is it not socially acceptable to eat salad out of a huge basin-like serving bowl?? :)

They also had this amazing-looking section of desserts. I ordered the peach carrot cake, which unfortunately was just okay. The frosting was buttercream; it probably would have been better with cream cheese frosting. It's a definite pass, so only deducting one star due to the sub-par dessert. But I would definitely return!

Like Buena Onda, but less chain-y. Illegal Tacos serves up flavorful soft tacos at a reasonable price. The shrimp are nicely seasoned and grilled to order. The toppings are always fresh, right down to the fragrant cilantro leaves. Definitely try a few of the salsas. My favorites are the citrusy, spicy hot version and the smoky-sweet medium salsa, but they are all unique and add different flavor nuances when combined with the tacos and fillings.

Yummy food and a local spot that is centrally located with outdoor seating. Folks from all over come to Frady's. They have a menu that changes of hot food and will make you some fresh eggs and bacon as a morning meal if you like. 

A small local shop as well that sells sodas, bread, and other needs, not exactly a supermarket, but will get you that salt or coffee you need at the last minute. 

Super friendly staff and an overall nice spot to know about in the area when you get tired of the other spots in the area (which could happen fairly quickly if you eat at the same spots every day).

We just ordered two burritos, and they were able to meet our request of using crispy cod + adding fresh avocado + a side of salsa, which made dinner spot on perfect. The quality of the ingredients was way above anything that I expected, and the flavor was outstanding. Great job guys, I'll definitely be a returning customer. Welcome to town.

Can't believe I'd never been here before- I live right around the corner! Pho Cam Ly is everything I want my pho place to be- unassuming and delicious. This is the first pho place I've found on this side of the river that serves tendon in their pho! The broth was amazing and the price was right! I'll definitely be back

My husband and I have been to Cracker Barrel many many times. We enjoy the generous helpings and the low cost. The eggs are always cooked just right. Their pancakes taste homemade and the syrup of course is pure maple. The French toast is cooked just the way I like it, crisp on the outside. I like the sausage links but not the pattys. They are smoked and I don't care for the flavor. The grits are cooked just right and the hash browns are the best!  I like the biscuits and gravy. The gravy is very rich with a smokey flavor.  Bacon is cooked crisp but not burnt. The staff is always friendly and upbeat.  The price is always right. Would recommend.

MY. NEW. FAVE OH RITE! PLACE.  Checked it out during the week for lunch during burger week. Sampled the cream cheese pepper burger and Mac & cheese. YUM! And ladies, if you're single, and even if you're not, but looking... it's the place to be during lunch. Total sausagefest.   Brought the husband back on Saturday night because I knew HE'D LOVE IT. As usual, I was right.

We sampled both burger week choices- fantastic. Because I decided to take a late afternoon nap, we got there a littttle late, to be be pleasantly surprised that all appetizers are 1/2 off after 9pm! That beckoned us to try several things. Pretzel sticks & beer cheese. Winner.  Stuffed smoked jalapeños- double winner. Rib tips- yep, winner too! (Consider them the Helio to Paul's win) potato skins- solid. Enjoyed one or two ice cold dirty lemonades (who's counting?)

Enjoyed the grown up, local crowd. Not a hipster in sight. Families are welcome in the seating area, bar is adults only.  Highly recommend B&B. Great service, local independent. By the way, they're opening Tacos & Tequila down the street soon. Looking forward to it!

Just moved here from DC, found Trav online. Seemed like a nice small business here I could feel comfortable, and it was. Trav knows all the guys by name, he's like a friend who gives great cuts (for just $14). He was really quick, does the close knife shave on the neck I like, and the wife loved the cut. 

I forgot they were cash only and offered to go get cash, but he didn't want me to lose my place in line, so he told me I could pay him back after. I'll be back. 

(Call to double check his new hours)

Reginelli's is on one of the busiest streets in New Orleans and has limited outdoor seating, which I found to be disappointing, but my friends and I ended up outside and in the sun.  We started with a hummus appetizer, and it really was outstanding. It was a perfect sized app, with yummy triangles of pita bread. 

I had a salad, which was okay. It was the asparagus and avocado salad, but it wasn't loaded with anything other then lettuce.  The downtowner sandwich was awesome!  It was loaded with everything! From olive pesto to ham, and then toasted.  The calzones were absolutely humongous, and stuff to the maximum with mozzarella and tomato sauce. MM good.

The pizza's looked great, but no one at my table ordered a pizza. That was a little faulty, but we all ended up with a few good dishes.

I came here on a recent short trip to Saint Louis. When I read about the espresso rubbed burger, topped with Apples, diced onions, bacon and blue cheese on the menu I was really curious about this creation. What I received was an incredibly delicious burger that I can recommend to anyone coming to Bailey's!

In addition they also have a great selection of local beers which is especially interesting if you come from out of town!

I love Courtney!  She never disappoints.  She will spend the time talking with you about your cut to make sure everyone is on the same page, and she definitely delivers.  I always look forward to my appointments with her.  I'll definitely be back to see Courtney.

Down home soul-food-type BBQ establishment. Pleasant staff, clean dining area. Beef ribs as well as pork spare and baby back. Not drowning in sauce. On the side is an option. Everything I've had has been nicely done. Try it out.

So, here's the deal: the food is good and I'm disappointed to know that the brisket is a lunch only item. However, the other items are good and their spicy sauce has enough kick and the service that has been much maligned here actually isn't too bad. On Friday evening I came here with my friend and his wife for dinner after he had been there and described the service situation and how terrible it is.

The line was long and so as we were waiting I spied a booth open up and I staked my claim, while the happy couple perused the menu. You may have been the Vandy kids complaining passively behind me about people 'not knowing the system here.' Why don't you go occupy something? One of the food runners put up no fight when I squatted at the booth before I got a number so whose policy is it? 

That evening the special was the Sweet Melissa which was a bbq chicken sandwich, but WHAT a bbq chicken sandwich, with a great sweet, smokiness to it and a soft warm bun that made me just want to crawl inside of it and take a nap. I also got a side of their 'ghost' sauce which had enough heat for me but not one that I couldn't even eat it. The pecan pie was a little small but pretty good.

My buddy ordered the turkey plate but they had run out of it-a testament to the deliciousness of their food and asked if the chicken plate was okay instead. He was fine with it and he asked the manager/head food runner/bearer of bad news that he wanted the fried pickles as well but didn't order it and was going to hand him some money for it when he said it would be fine and then came back with free fried pickles and a chicken plate. 

I have no complaints about the service, or its layout-it's got a service station near where the food is run and it can be a bit of a bottleneck at times but other than that I like how they tried to accommodate their shortfalls, and they were pretty responsive to us.

As far as the seating thing goes, as long as their policy isn't enumerated somewhere, then it's the law of the jungle-first come, first served. Welcome to the Thunderdome, bitches!

Maybe we just ordered the wrong thing...? No, i dont think so, it was really just that bad. Besides the fact that it took almost an hour and a half to get our food (and in an empty restaurant, thats just lazy), everything was so over peppered we could barely eat it. Would not go back.

We ordered:
Half nachos (eh. Nothing memorable)

Pork meat plate with collard greens and potato salad. This tasted like airport food.

I was really craving BBQ and I have to say, this completely missed the mark. I actually have nothing positive to say about it. I don't know why this place is so popular, every time I have eaten something from here I have been sorely disappointed.

Nearly the worst service at any fast food chain I have ever been to. I have been to this particular Chipotle three times in 2015, and two times my order was messed up. The employee staffing the cash register appeared to be aloof and not interested in providing good customer service at all. Don't come to this Chipotle during the lunch rush hour unless you are willing to wait. Last week I placed a to go order on the website for my entire family. I paid for the order ahead of time. When I arrived to pick it up, I stood at the cash register for 3 minutes before being acknowledged, despite Chipotle's advertising about being able to show up and get your order right away. I was given my order bag without any thanks, and then drove the 50 minutes to home (this was to be a special treat for my wife, who likes Chipotle, although we do not have one near our home). Upon arriving home, I found that they left out both of my kids' drinks and both of my kids' sides with their meals. I called back three times before the phone was answered and the person who answered took down my name, saying she would make it right the next time I was there. How does she expect the staff to remember? Sorry, but I don't plan for there to be a next time that I visit this Chipotle, when there are several other choices on the North side for a good lunch or dinner. 2 stars rather than 1 star, because the quality of the food is great.

My review is based more as a seller than a buyer.  There isn't much rhyme nor reason as to what they decide to sell and what they reject.  You never really get an explanation. I have taken what the Lambertville store would not accept to other Green Street locations and they have taken the clothing and they sold in less than one week.  Also, the Lambertville store isn't great with their record keeping.  Their computer system gets screwed up pretty regularly.  And if you say you want returned what didn't sell and don't go get it the day it is available to be picked up, forget it. They will tell you it is store property now.  And what do they do with your merchandise?  They never tell you. That seems like a bit of a scam to me.  Why couldn't you email the person and say, if you don't pick up your merchandise by XX date, we will donate it to a local charity.  I just think they need a little more sophistication on the record keeping and consignee interface side.  Some of the sales staff is rather rude but it looks like they are trying to address that.

Every time I come here I always have a great experience. Regardless of what the other comments say, the people are always friendly to me and always ask if I need help. I honestly hate going to other department stores and getting hassled by their salespeople. I always have awkward experiences at Nordstrom because they are so pushy, and make me feel pressured to buy things. I like a calm shopping experience, and if I need help I will ask. I understand sales and I know that's part of their job, but I can't stand when they take it too far. I think their customer service is great, and I will continue to shop here :)

The coins is a divey diner in a not so hot neighborhood, no worries tho plenty of cops eat here. Good food, good prices with quick service. The staff gets to know u after awhile and knows ur orders b4 u do. Not a good idea for weekend breakfast it gets packed but every other time I go just grab any open table. Hanging out with friends at this place has helped me keep my sanity many a nite

It seems like every time I am there, there are always a bunch of cops inside. They must be in the know. This place is awesome. Imagine it's late at night, you may or may not be intoxicated. You want to have good food, but everything is closed and your options are limited. You want something that id decent and cheap, because let's be honest you spent more on drinks than you intended. Well what do you do? You go to three coins diner. The food is generous, the staff generous, and the bill is light on your wallet. The omelet is good enough that your stomach actually wants to keep it down and your taste buds rejoice. Your fun night out in the town, just got better.

Stopped in for lunch around noon on a Saturday. I expected it to be busy, but there was only one other couple there. We both got bibimbap, I got tofu, he got beef. He also tried shrimp pancakes and kimchi. Both of us enjoyed our stone bowls. My only complaint is that it was spicy, which some people may not love, but I enjoyed it. One thing that was noted is that the beef is scarce, but the portion overall was good. He also liked both other dishes, declaring the kimchi the best ever. In addition, we both got the ginger cinnamon tea that is made in house. While I liked that it was not sweet, he would have preferred a lift sweetness. This is a great spot with excellent service and good food.

Great place for fried chicken! Prices are good and the size of the chicken pieces are quite large.  My absolute favorite item on the menu? The biscuits. The biscuits are the best I've ever tasted. Soaked in honey and butter it literally melts in your mouth and it's got just the right amount of sweetness you need after enjoying salty fried chicken. A must try here in NOLA!

Sparkling clean, spacious, stylish rooms and quick, efficient services. I arrived at 11:30 PM after a 5 hour delayed flight and was thrilled to see a bar, still open, with a good Pinot Grigio.  Beds are extremely comfortable, and complementary breakfast delicious- a variety of fresh fruit, eggs, bacon and more.   

About double the rate of other "suite" hotels in its class, but very worth it -some can be just depressing; this Hyatt made me happy

Best al pastor tacos I've ever had! I also had asada and the vegetarian taco #1 (potato) and they were all very good. Can't go wrong with this place and prices are so reasonable. I'll definitely stop by here again.

This place wasn't at all what I was expecting.  I've been to the downtown cantina before, guess I expected more of that.  Pros: free valet...that's about it.  Cons: the food was mediocre, but really pricey.  I got the duck enchiladas which were perfectly average, nothing special.  My guy got the puntas de filet mignon.  Very spicy and severely lacking in flavor.  He loves everything spicy, but with nothing but spice, what's the point?  My main problem was the service.  I cannot stand when I feel like I'm not being paid attention to because of how young I am or the amount in our party (servers are notoriously bad at checking on a 2 top).  The crowd here was mostly 40's-50's..I'm 25.  Our waitress never checked on us, left us without drinks, and generally didn't seem to care.  But she seemed to love the 6 top next to us.

The service is fine, the food is okay. I don't understand the raves about the food. Chicken tortellini was fine (3/5) and lobster ravioli was not good (fishy.) The sauce for both pastas was overly thick. We will not be returning.
Excellent place to stop in and get Cajun food. Service is quick and efficient. You get large portions for a low price.  The food was excellent . Highly recommend.

4 of us went for lunch after visiting the Penns Landing area. We almost gave it a pass after reading yelp reviews - glad we gave it a try. Good choice of beers on tap, pleasant waitress, good food and reasonable prices made our visit a very pleasant experience. $55 bought us 2 pitchers and 4 sandwiches and we were even too late for the lunch special prices. While the guys are not known as fussy eaters, we all thoroughly enjoyed our lunch. We had roast beef and barbecue pork sandwiches along with a shepard's pie. All were excellent and the homemade chips were a hit! Our only complaint might be the time it took for the food to arrive - especially since there were only 2 other booths occupied. Since we were not in a hurry, that wasn't a problem for us.

I'm torn about this review because I actually had a really good time at Lex. We were there for Kaskade album release party and the vibe was awesome and the set up was cool. But they oversold tickets and some people paid $100+ and never even got in. Plus, if you wanted to sit down you had to prepay $2500+ for a table. For the select few that were able to get in, and get a seat, the party was one of the best. Quite an eclectic mix of people, sexy waitresses wearing not-much, plenty of ravers mixed with high rollers mixed with us commoners. Decent light show, lots of confetti and the like to add to the excitement. 
Ultimately, I think a club has a responsibility to ticket holders, and therefore I doubt I'll be back.

Our family of 5 throughly enjoyed our dinner! The good was delicious and the service was warm and attentive. My only reason for taking away 1 star was the very strong smell of a plug in air freshener. It was so strong that at times it messed with your sense of taste.  This would not stop us from returning though...

I have only ordered twice from here the first order was last week and I was very satisfied overall. First up on the order was the deal and you get a one topping large pizza, I paid for extra toppings and there was barely any toppings, in fact the small pie of the week (Dixie chicken) that was half off price looked and tasted better. The delivery driver was friendly and fast too which was nice. 
The second order was last night, I ordered the deal once again and my sprite tasted like Alkaseltzer  it was so nasty I dumped it out and thought what a waste. This time the one topping looked better than the pie of the week (spring pie)  was supposed to have cilantro and salsa, definitely was no cilantro and very little salsa. 
Why do ya skimp on the toppings when you charge nearly $2 per extra? If I get skimped on one more time I'm going back to Papa John's they always load it down with toppings. 
(I like pepperoncinis and hate tootsie rolls anyway lol go ahead make my day)

Let me start by saying the pizza is amazing and very close to new york authenticity. The pint and slice deal is da-shiz-night. Prices on alcohol and food are very affordable and the slice size is filling; in fact, one slice can be considered a meal. Caitlin was my server and was very sweet and accommodating. There are great specials every night. Highly recommend

Went to Milktooth for the first time over the weekend while visiting Indianapolis. We sat at the bar and ordered brunch, and everything was outstanding! Even the guys behind the bar made great conversation with us! 

A word of caution, when they tell you the wings are hot, they aren't kidding! We also ordered a Cuban sandwich that was fantastic. We will definitely be back next time we are in the area!

Thanks for a great experience!

Complete Fitness Results have been there for me since the beginning of my weight loss journey. They got me started AND keep me motivated. 

They provide expert knowledge in not only in my workouts, but in nutrition, lifestyle and help me maximize my performance within my workouts which lead to awesome results! 

They have a great facility and great employees that care. They offer bootcamps every morning and every evening Mon-Fri and alt times on the weekends.

They pay close attention to your form with each exercise so its similar like personal training session but in a group format!

They are like a second family to me with my weight loss journey and have cheered me on every milestone I have made!

The turkey burgers and the sweet potato fries are fabulous here! I love them and that is what I always get. However, I know others who get the regular burgers aren't as impressed - but I haven't tried the beef burgers.

I do like that there are lots of topping choices and bun choices - you can really customize your burger the way you want. Simple to gourmet even.

It is a bit pricey - but for me the turkey burger and sweet potato fries are worth it.

The owner is super friendly, encourages you to try different things without giving off any sales pressure, the food is delicious, the mint and honey lassi is delicious! I have already planned what I'm going to eat on my next 2 visits! Don't forget about dessert, either! He gave us a sample of the carrot halwa with rice pudding and it was to die for! We left very full and incredibly satisfied.

We just had our wedding rehearsal dinner here and everything was phenomenal! The food, drinks, and the service were all top notch! So if you are looking for a place to accommodate your entire wedding party this is the place! Highly recommended! I'll be craving that cochon beignet for a long time!!

This place is laughable. 25-30 minute wait ended up being an hour. We finally sat down and waited another 15 minutes before anyone would serve us. There were 5 open tables in the restaurant at the time. We flagged down a server to order drinks and food. I got the jambalaya and my husband got the fried chicken. The jambalaya was meh at best. The greens were okay and my husband got the Mac and cheese which came out  cold. I would say skip this place. Not worth the wait at all.

Had a problem with my garage door where it wouldn't close. I'm new to the area and wasn't sure who to call. I found Banko doors through Yelp and thought I'd give them a try, so glad I did. As soon as the repair saw he told me it was a minor problem and he was right. Honest and fast...thanks again.
When I comes to my garage doors I will be using them again.

I placed a to go order online and received an email saying I could pick up my order in 15 minutes.  When I arrived at Tin Drum the cashier told me that the online ordering wasn't working and I would have to wait for my order. No problem, right? WRONG!!!  45 minutes later I had still not received my order!!!  The cashier didn't send it to the kitchen!!  I won't be back!!

These are the daisies, my favorite flower, that my husband purchased for me on June 7.   Three weeks ago. 

Could they be more beautiful?
Thanks to Jim, and Asters, they are still absolutely fresh and gorgeous. As they always are in the years we have been buying our flowers from him. 
Always a treat to the eye. 

Jim and his staff are always gracious, as well as fun to visit. The shop is a treat to the eye and your day.
The worst smoke shop ever,over priced ,ignorant staff,dont back there products ar all..they admitted the aspire colis could have been sold bad but refused to exchange them..NEVER AGAIN stay away..
Modern laundry is Nice and clean employees are very helpful and there is huge flat screens.

Well...things have changed since our last visit. 
The food is still fantastic...so the back of the house is doing a great job! 

But wow the front of the house staff needs a kick in the back side.  Although very nice these folks are slow with everything.  Ordered water and a soda...at the same time we ordered the BLT Guacamole.   The guac showed up 5 minutes before the water.   At least 4 waiters for 5 tables but still no water.
We had also ordered a margarita and a beer.  They showed up after we had half finished the guac.   COME ON...great food but a front end staff completely asleep at the wheel.   This place won't be here long if they don't pull it together.   To many good food options available in the immediate area to have such lackluster inattentive service.  Please fix it quick. I love your food.

Good resturant that I frequent.  Chicken Kabobs and rice is always good.  Portions aren't huge, but I didn't order any pasta.  Pasta orders get large -and- they are also tasty.  They have a 20 oz steak but I haven't ordered it yet.  I think that there should be two of me to order a 20 oz steak.  Well, pretty soon now.

The balding guy may look crabby. But his service is prompt and on spot. As is the menu items. The place may look like a dive inside. And on a hot day it may be less than comfortable to eat inside. But it is all well worth it. 

My favorite is the Italian Sausage Sandwich. I always get the "Burn my ass" which is semi-hot for me. For vanilla folks it will burn. 

Also one can NEVER go wrong with the Pork Sandwich with Provolone. I even took a girl on our first date to this place for lunch. Yeah a bit low brow. But she still raves about the pork so all was well! 

Screw Geno's or Pat's for Pork. Take the walk to George's instead!

Where to begin with this terrible dining experience??? The premise of this place is great, but the execution fell very very very short.  The food was good, but definitely not memorable.  There was no depth of flavors, just a trendy menu.  They were NOT busy and yet the service was terrible from start to finish:
After being seated waited almost 10 minute for our waiter.
Drinks were slow to come.
The food eventually started to arrive at our tiny table was literally dropped off by their food runner who delivered us the wrong foods and no one ever came back to our table to check on food or drinks.
When we finally decide to leave I had to get up and ask the hostess for our check.  She sent a manager over to us who apologized and took off the cost of one appetizer.  Still didn't make it worth our time or money.

Don't waste your money, this place falls very short.

These guys were great. This is now the second time we used the. They were not on time, but early! They never complained. They were super nice and really funny. I love the attitude they kept the whole time, very cheerful, singing, joking, just great. They treated our stuff with a lot of respect, nothing was broken, even with little safety packing. The prices were fair too! In our second move from philly to nyc, with an apartment full of crap the total was about 1400, which was competitive compared to everyone else. On top of that, NYC can be such a pain in itself, and with the occupy stuff going on nearby, they handled all of the hassels and delays with class and ease. Highly recommend!

This is a fun store to explore. Lots to look at. This review is for two chairs I ordered a year ago. I finally decided to special order two of their swoop swivel velvet chairs. You don't have an option to pickup in the store. You have to pay extra for their white glove delivery.  It took a good two months for them to be made and delivered. The delivery guys cut the upholstery on one when they unpacked the chair.  They saw it but waited for me to notice it. I had to call the store manager (who was amazing) to get another one ordered. That took another two months. They look nice but are not holding up well at all. The swivel part is bending and the chairs list to one side. They are not in constant use so I'm assuming it's a manufacturing defect. When I called customer service I discovered they don't stand behind or warranty their furniture. I don't recommend buying their upholstered pieces.

This is a NEW OWNER review update. I was a "regular" when this restaurant first opened and dropped off when I learned of some unfair treatment, by the then-owner, of his staff. That Simon Legree is now gone and the new owner is working hard and in earnest to win customers and keep them. I came back a month or so ago... met this new owner and asked him two simple questions.

By way of preamble... Nirvana serves a mix of Indian (great), Thai (good) and oddly... Chinese (meh) cuisine. That is the original Pan-Asian model from when it first opened. I have strictly limited myself to Indian dishes which are consistently excellent (one exception... the spicy goodness of their Thai Tom Yam Kung soup).

But my two simple questions for the new owner and his answers:
Q - You are Nepalese, right?
A - Yes.
Q - Then why don't you offer anything on your menu that is Nepalese cuisine?
A - You are right. I intend to do so. Please give me a month or two. I will add Nepalese dishes to my menu. May I please have your name and telephone number? [Which I provided.]

Six weeks later the new owner called me and invited me to come in as his guest for the first-ever Nepalese meal served at Nirvana. I asked if I might bring another couple which he warmly welcomed. We enjoyed a superbly prepared traditional Nepalese Thali meal made from the freshest ingredients. Thali is made up of a selection of various dishes. It was served on a polished metal high-rim platter/tray. The idea behind a Thali is to offer all the 6 different flavors of sweet, salt, bitter, sour, astringent and spicy on one single plate in perfect balance. It included a chicken curry, influenced by Nepal's neighbor, India.... but with its own particular, delightful variant; the freshest rice, a spicy spinach; spicy roasted potatoes, black lentils, plain refreshing yogurt, fresh-from-the-oven wheat-roti and finally, a side of achar (Nepalese spicy pickled veggies). The meal ended with simple fruit and Nepalese tea. Delightful goodness in every bite and sip.

The new owner is adding some Nepalese dishes with a menu addendum but if you want to try the thali he recommends you call and ask 24 hours before the desired meal. Try it! You'll love it!

They use the adjective, "urban," a little differently than in the Midwest.  Where I come from it's a euphemism middle class White people who are trying to avoid sounding prejudiced use to describe African-Americans specifically, or non-White people in general.  As in, "a contemporary urban music radio station," which plays hip-hop.  This grocery store seems to specialize in what I would call, distinctly suburban tastes.  It's mostly gourmet, artisinal, gluten-free, craft and pretentious goods, but they also have Velveeta Shells.  The prices seem high but then I'm not sure what free range Bison steaks should cost in a downtown grocery.  There's really no competition, the only other place to get snacks is a CVS.  The workers are very nice, there's an interesting choice of wine and beer, and you can get bus passes here.

Had been wanting to try this tap room for a while as I really enjoy Bier Brewery's beer and it's also fairly close to my house. 

Staff were very knowledgeable and friendly, not at all annoyed that I asked a million questions and kept trying different beers. I opted for the classic PDG and it was very tasty.  Each table also had chocolate fortune cookies for us to snack on. Umm, yum. 

They also had food to purchase which was delicious. I got a veggie wrap and a bag of potato chips for $4. Definitely worth it for a little afternoon snack. 

The interior was pretty industrial, but there were lots of little couches, chairs and tables to sit at. Also, there was a friendly dog who was wandering around, greeting customers. 

Good to know that this place is in my neighborhood and that it offers such a nice experience. I'll definitely be back!

The shops at Liberty place is a bit of calm in the storm of honking cars and peddling people on the streets of Philadelphia. While they don't have many stores, the ones they have are diverse and well maintained. In fact, I would argue that if you aren't super picky you could do all of your holiday shopping under this one small roof. 

Additionally, there is a food court which is super diverse. Everything from Indian to Salads, and Sushi to Smoothies. During the main lunch hours it is PACKED as everyone from the corporate offices in the building empty out in the food court, but during the rest of the day it is ever so quiet.

Bacchanal is constantly evolving, starting as a sleepy wine store with weekend tastings and now, still a wine store, but with outside seating, a full menu, cocktails, wines by the glass, and of course, all the bottle offerings of the wine store that can also be enjoyed outside.  Further, Bacchanal boasts nightly live music.  Nothing too raucous, just nice background music, like the Courtyard Kings (I think they're every Thursday).

I went there recently and had the mussels and a side of the broccoli rabe, and both were delicious.  The flatiron steak is another wonderful choice.  The chocolate bark dessert is unusually good too, being drizzled with olive oil and salted.  Why that works, I've no idea, but it does.

When you first enter the wine store, you can purchase wine to go or for consumption there.  If you buy to go, the price on the bottle is actually $5 more than you'll pay.  The bottles are marked with the drink-it-here price.  It is only at the register inside and for wine, sodas, beer, and a few types of cigarettes (I think they sell American Spirits - not sure if I'm remembering correctly) that one can pay with a card.  There are buckets on the far side of the room to get ice if you buy a chilled bottle to drink there.  If you want to eat or drink a cocktail, you'll need cash.  There's an ATM, but if you're prepared, you'll avoid the ATM fee.  To get food, you order outside at a window.  Pay with cash.  Get a number, and place it on your table.  Sooner than you'd expect, a waiter will bring you your yummy food.

Anyway, walking out the side door from the store, you find a cocktail bar on the side patio.  Beyond, the spacious backyard and plenty of outside seating.  That's where you'll sit.  Outside.  There's no seating yet inside, but in its continuing evolution, I hear we can expect inside seating upstairs sometime in early 2013.  In the meantime, there's heat lamps for chilly nights, just no solution for rainy nights at the moment.  I suppose in fairness, this should merit a four or four and a half star review, but this place is so unusual in being willing to reinvent itself to suit its patrons that I can't fault them a star for the rain.  After all, we all know we don't live in So. Cal. or AZ.

 Last night, I stopped by just to get a bottle to go.  After stumbling into a pinot tasting and a great conversation with one of the musicians who'd play there later that evening, I left, two hours later and very, very happy.

I took a glass-blowing class with two other girls on a Saturday afternoon and had a really great time.
