I'd say 4.5 stars for the food, my girlfriend had the burger which was excellent even 2 days later when I took the other half she didn't eat out of the refrigerator.  I had the Rosemary chicken which was tender and juicy and very well prepared. Most dishes of this nature you can't taste the Rosemary and herbs but this was rich in flavor of herbs and spices. The bread pudding was also top notch, comes with what looked like a rum sauce but tasted like a whiskey sauce. Topped with ice cream and roasted pecans. I taste bread pudding at every restaurant that serves it and this was definitely one of the top tasting ones I've had.

Friendly staff, great owner (mike) who came out and made sure I was doing good and everything was to my liking, the whole place has a great atmosphere, amazing food and cold beer! Definitely a 5 star in my books

This is my favorite delivery place! The only Chinese food i will order from. I usually get a Jersey or tiger roll.. Yum! The mei fun and lo mein are delicious as well. I just hate that they are closed on Mondays! I'm also giving it only 4 stars because they never give you enough soy sauce no matter how many times we asked. 2 soy sauce packets is not enough for 5 people! Let alone one person... when i start getting more soy sauce ill give you 5 stars :)

Friendly staff, great with my dog every time. So comforting that they are right around the corner. It's the only vet I know of where my dog gets excited to go- no matter how she's feeling! Highly recommended.

Read about this place and wanted to try it. I wasn't disappointed. I had a crawfish omelette that was covered in a zesty crawfish creole sauce that made this dish unique and tasty. My niece had a banana pancake with pecans that was the size of a large pizza...it was delicious but was enough to feed three hungry people. A couple next to us ordered the shrimp and grits and said they were excellent. Quaint place with good food.

Tokyo Steak house is the cool place to go visit ,but food was so so .... Hibachi are .... oh well not so good ,why ? because teriyaki sauce on everything they cook ( It's to sweet for me ) sushi was ...hmmm...  bad unlike what I hear it from a lot of review. I'm a sushi eater and been eating sushi for a long time ( 10 over ) the fish they using fresh fish but It been sit and reuse it after put out from the sushi case for over a day plus you can tell from how it look ( same as Kroger sushi if you want me to say ) I would drive to Murfreesboro to get sushi or down town if I really want sushi, anyway back to Hibachi ... the chef are not really funny and unfriendly they might put joke on you but some joke they did just a little bit odd... over all it's okay place to hang around the bar but not place to have a good time and enjoy the food.

I initially came to this restaurant with a family and had a great dinner with a nice selection. Keep in mind, this is more leaning towards Southern Italian style, so slightly heavier but nonetheless delicious and great quality (most American Italian and also St Louis Italian is of this style). I very much enjoyed their lamb and they also had a great mussel dish. Our server made excellent recommendations and was obviously very familiar.

I recommend making reservations on weekends when they are busy!

The interior is dark and cave-like...all walls and ceiling are painted brown.  Maybe, so it is hard to tell if it needs cleaning...?

We, two of us, started with a chicken satay starter...tasteless, poorly done...we should have left then...

Our main dishes were both different, which, were absolutely the worst meal I have had in years!  Just horrid!  I tried my guest's meal as well, and it was just as bad.  Neither of us finished our food.

Service...Two adults took the orders but two kids...not more than 10-12 years old...served the food and cleared the tables.

Stay away and don't waste your money!!!

Best value for your money when you want to eat delicious and tasty Caribbean food!  Family owned business and Chef Janice cooked all the food and her decor are so chic and classy clean looking.  A bright white atmosphere that your jaw will drop when you enter this restaurant.  Check out pics I posted! Good place to bring a date.  Dressy couples inside and family grp also.

I give this Starbucks one star. Never has COLD BREW when I go in here! Today it was 8:56 am. Whoops! Sorry no Cold Brew. You're kidding. Girl at counter wasn't very receptive. Barely gave me my oatmeal with what I asked for and I told her light ice on iced coffee. Did not happen!

Had lunch there yesterday. The food is tasty, the spice tea very tasty. However, the portions are very small. We had the chicken dish it came with one chicken thigh & one boiled egg. It cost nearly $14. A bit pricy for a chicken thigh. Nice experience but probably won't go there a lot.

As night descended unto the sky and the moon's crescent shined on bay water, I sat anticipating the world ahead of me and wondered a question so bold and provoking, "am I a wine guy"? Within minutes of patronizing Cru Cellars, I entered a deep state of comfort. I recall being warm and relaxed while the atmosphere invited me to stay, the kind a novelist could drink and journal sentiments on the teak wood while couples dine in the dim light. The wine, delectable, the staff, a delight! Truly a wonder emporium of wine and honor. Long story short I'm a wine guy now. 5 out 5 stars would go again

Love this nail salon! As you would hope from a good nail salon, the basics are there: clean facility, knowledgable staff, good hygiene, etc. However, they secured my business forever with their friendliness. Everyone seems genuinely happy to be working there, always chatting and laughing with customers and each other. Their prices are reasonable and you'll leaving feeling very content and happy. 

Tip: Ask for Tracy (also the extremely competent manager) if you want a nail design-- she has the steadiest hands and best eye in St. Louis!

Stopped in and tried this place for the 1st time. Ordered coffee, tomato juice, ham & cheese omelette which came with small potatoes. First of all, tomato juice was bad, bad meaning Rancid, I sent it back and ordered an orange juice. Orange juice tasted acceptable but "warm", so I ask for ice cubes. Coffee was terrible, taste like it was sitting for hours. When I received my meal, first thing I noticed the toast was only one slice and very small, I ask for another slice, which I felt I shouldn't ask for.
Omelette and ham was pretty good and so was the potatoes. Service was good. 
Will I return?  No.

Went there for lunch today....Pablo Taco...No Bueno! The Queso Blanco was not Blanco...it was orange. I was charged $2 for chips and salsa and $3 for an iced tea. Had the "puffy" steak tacos and all I count taste was grease. The salsa was awful and tasted like a smoked Chiptole.  Don't waste your time

I go to Bliss every couple of weeks and I love it. You get real quality craftsmanship on acrylic nails, millions of colors to choose from, courteous service, a lovely atmosphere and the prices are great. They even take great care of you when you need a repair, which is awesome.

Yelp needs to install a special 10 star rating for places like this.  These guys ROCK, they are so incredibly nice that I just can't get over it!  There is parking in the back for customers, and just wait until you step inside.  TFA just doesn't look all that big from the outside, and really it isn't, and yet they pack in so much merchandise that it would take hours to see it all!  Not only that, everything.....and I do mean everything.....is so cool that I contemplated selling a kidney in order to purchase the lot of it.  I of course didn't, but I hope that gives you an inkling of how seriously great TFA is.  

They have all manner of doo-dads from the 50s, 60s and 70s to decorate your home and yourself with.  The hat collection, ooooooh the hat collection, makes me sob due to the beauty of it.  There are a ton of clothes as well, all of which are super snazzy!  Get ready for an addiction people!

I've eaten at Tortugas many times over the years, sometimes for dinner and sometimes for lunch. While it may not be the most authentic Mexican I've ever had the food is consistently good. I've tried many things from the menu and have yet to be disappointed. The complimentary chips and salsa they give is delicious and very fresh tasting. 

As others have mentioned the service can be a little slow at times but it's never been unbearable and it always seemed to me to coincide with them having a larger than average crowd and just being slightly understaffed - most times I've been here at lunch it has just been 1 waitress and 1 busboy doing the whole place. 

The only slight downer is I have noticed that the portion sizes appear to have shrunk the last few times I have been here, at least for lunch and that is mostly what I come here for as it's close to work. The burritos and other lunch platters definitely used to be a bit bigger and more packed. Maybe it's just a variable that changes depending on who is cooking? It's not a deal breaker but still, it's something you notice when you are used to being served a certain size.

Overall a good option to satisfy your craving for South of the border.

Very rude staff... with the bands permission, I took the bands tip jar around to collect tips for the band as homage to the very lovely jazz band. Michael White . I am a musician and for someone in the audience to pass around a tip jar is an honor. I was almost thrown out of this hotel because their "policy"... of that "our policy does not condone that". I was literally escorted out...unbelievable! Absurd.

We go to Imos Pizza quite often. The family loves the thin crust and flavor. My favorite is the double sausage pizza. We have always had friendly and quick service. BTW, the salad with house dressing and double cheese is exceptional.

I agree with the review a year ago- patient and such knowledge base.  He had chairs for us to rest in and the restroom was close too.  We also got i-phone pictures of what we saw to share later with family and friends.  He showed us great i-pad pics of the sky we missed this past year since we live in a more cloudy place. 

So if you live in Tucson and wonder what to do on all your starry nights or if visiting, make sure to go on the Tour.  All it takes is to cup your hand around the eye piece and take in the wonder!!!

Definitely would eat here again. We began with a white pizza as an appetizer. It had great flavor, good amount of cheese and tasty dough. I had the chicken Parmesan that comes with a side of pasta/red sauce. The chicken was a huge portion. Enough to take home for lunch today! Party #2 & 3 had a cheesesteak which was on a 12" roll and very good. Party #4 had a cheesesteak Stromboli. It wasn't bad. I have had better. Service was good, decor very nice!

Came for happy hour before strolling to Bourbon street! Had the fried oysters for 1.25 each. Sooooo good! We also got the shrimp and grits, equally tasty! 

Half off all alcohol beverages during happy hour, which starts at 3pm! And 1.25 oysters either fried or cold. They are huge! 

Service was awesome! And the waiter sent us an extra drink, because ya know, why not! The place is a lil upscale and adjacent to the hotel. We got there just before the crowd started strolling in. Will be back next time I'm in NoLa!

VERY fresh sushi! Prompt service and a nice atmosphere as well.  The only downside is the location of where the waitresses have to enter orders.  They really need to relocate that behind the brick wall as all we could hear is complaining about not getting a top from a customer and the management lady griping about one of the girls eating her lunch.

I literally watched the older manager grab the girls food from the booth she was in and throw her food away.  Could you not have sat it in the back, is there no break area other than the lobby? I felt bad for her, she had to pay for that food too.  Totally unprofessional to have acted in such a manor directly in front of us.

Anyway, they are still fairly fresh and getting it together.  Maybe they will see this and make some needed adjustments.  I wish I could remember the name of our waitress because she was wonderful!

We ordered the salmon dinner, mackerel dinner and The mahi-mahi lunch portion. 

The dinners are definitely large enough to split with two people. The German potato salad served as a side is very delicious as well. Launch size portions when available are definitely a one person serving size.  Ok, yes I also ordered the key lime pie slice. But it was to go.  It was delicious as well!
Stumbled on this place a few years ago, every time we come back to the golf side I try to go to this place because it's that good.  Would recommend this place to any smoked fish lover.

My mom had a Groupon, so we decided to drive over.  Its only the next exit off the Vets expressway from her.  I was concerned at first because it looked dead .... there were only two families..a couple and maybe a 2 people at the bar on a weekend.  We were seated by a friendly hostess, and then greeted by our waitress.  She suggest a light pasta dish for mom, and I ordered a strawberry salad and a seared ahi tuna app.  I was VERY impressed with the salad!  I even asked for a small side of strawberries in addition.. they were very firm, fresh and sweet, the spinach, and dressing was outstanding!  The seared ahi tuna was lightly pan seared and crusted in sesames!  I LOVED IT! It was perfect~ Mom loved her pasta seafood dish it had a baby lobster and huge shrimp with a light sauce (not cream based) so it was a healthier alternative to the alfredo sauce offered at most chain places.  Over all I was very pleased with our experience it was a nice relaxing late lunch.  I would go again the Groupon was a great value!  

PS..ask for Melissa to wait on you!  Very sweet, informative, and professional!  

Ohh...and the Manager even goes around and says little things to everyone you can tell he likes being there!

Simply amazing. Small, intimate and personal. Tried the 'Feed Me' option and it did not disappoint. Every plate was sublimely prepared and the service was top rate. A must when you desire a smart setting and sophisticated meal that is served by caring professionals who care about their craft.

NASTY NASTY NASTY!!!!!! Steer clear.  I've been told they've had trouble with the Board of Health on several separate occasions.  I live very near here and I won't even get a cup of coffee from here (I drive to the one on Elysian Flds & I-610).  

The last time I visited this restaurant was in 2006 and the staff were rude, incompetent, impatient & unprofessional.  I don't get anything from here.  I ignore this place and avoid it like the plague!

I was pleasantly surprised by this resort/casino.  It's located off the strip but  in retrospect, that's a good thing.  The property is family friendly despite being a casino.  The pool is clean and inviting.  The rooms are clean and above average size.  I was in a veranda suite located on the third floor overlooking the pool.  The only negative was the designated smoking area directly under our room left us smokey!  Overall, this exceeded my expectations.

Wow! The food here is EXCELLENT! My husband and I had the buffet today (22 items since it was New Year's Eve) and everything was delicious. My favorite was the goat curry. Loads of meat with very little bone in a luscious sauce. There were several different kinds of chicken all very good, vegetables, plain rice, chicken biryani, soup, appetizers, salad, chutneys, desserts, mango juice, and masala tea all for $10.99. Can't beat that price anywhere! Before you sit down you are asked what kind of naan you would like to have and then it is brought to you in a basket. Water is constantly replenished. The food is piping hot at the buffet. Service is quite attentive. It is a small place, but homey and quiet. A friend who is a chef highly recommended this place. We finally have a new Indian restaurant to go to and I cannot wait to return for another meal.

Simply amazing. I LOVED this place so much. I had the carne asada tacos with refried beans, yellow rice and a side of guac. I even had a churro for dessert. I did try the watermelon cucumber drink but I didn't really care for it too much. I thought it was a little too sweet BUT I'm not a juice drinker. I just wanted to try something new. But as for the food, everything was great. My boyfriend had some tacos and a quesadilla. The quesadilla was very good also. If I'm ever in Tucson again, I will be returning to this wonderful taco place.

This is our favorite place to brunch in north Tampa. The food is amazing, and they have a nice little patio area outside. Weather permitting, we always sit out there; the restaurant is a bit too loud inside. I highly recommend the eggs Benedict, they're perfect every time and the hollandaise is made from scratch.

The food at Honey's is good, but good enough to wait 60 minutes on a Sunday morning?  Not nearly.  I'd gladly eat here again if I saw a lack of a line, but there are way too many amazing, underpopulated brunch spots in the neighborhood to justify an hour of hunger.

Lots of AC on a hot day, God bless. The Darkness chocolate croissant was nicely balanced, not too sweet and not overwhelmingly salty, like some salt/chocolate combinations tend to be. Also got meringues, which were fine. Do they do almond croissants? I want an almond croissant.

I wish I had read these reviews before taking three pairs of shoes to this place to be re-heeled.  I will probably never see the shoes again, and I am amazed that Northside Shoe Repair is still in business.  Like other reviewers, I showed up on the appointed day to get my shoes, only to be told that they had meant that the shoes would be ready the following week, i.e. it was going to take 14 days to re-heel three pairs of shoes.  I came back a week later, and the charge was nearly $60. The shoes looked ok - not a great job, but how hard is re-heeling shoes - but their credit card machine was, I was told, not working.  I went off to get cash, and when I returned the door was locked.  When I came back yesterday to get the shoes, the credit card machine was still not working (I noticed dust on the sign saying this, so it is not exactly something they are in a rush to fix).  It didn't matter whether I had cash or credit cards, however, because they couldn't find my shoes!  The woman "helping" at the counter told me I must have left my shoes more than six months ago (not true) and she had probably given them away, but was still looking more than half an hour later.  One pair of Ralph Lauren pumps, one pair of Ferragamo heels and one cute pair of ankle boots, gone.  All I got in return was the feeling that I was an idiot for every walking through the door of this place.

If I could give this dealership NO stars, I would.  I found a vehicle at this dealership that was difficult to locate and I contacted them to see if we could work a deal. I was willing to travel several hours to purchase the vehicle.  Coming from the DC area, I was already talking with several local dealerships who were willing to honor the USAA pricing, so that was a non-negotiable for me.  After several conversations with the internet sales manager, it became obvious that they would honor the USAA pricing with every vehicle EXCEPT the one I was looking to purchase because it was "hard to find".  In fact, at this point they had increased the price by more than $3000 for this reason alone.  I was unable to speak personally to the sales manager because every time I called he was "busy". So I had my wife call and SURPRISE, SURPRISE...he was suddenly available.  After a long conversation, he continued to insist that this was not price gouging but was, in fact, fair and refused to continue the conversation. In fact, he hung up on me. This is perhaps, the most unprofessional dealership I have ever worked with and their unwillingness to support the military is absolutely ludicrous.  Not only do I not recommend them to others, I have already reported them to the consumer affairs for the US military which places them on a "do not associate" list for this behavior. I cannot believe in this day, where service members are constantly sacrificing for their country, that a dealership of American cars would deliberately cheat a soldier out of fair pricing for a car that already costs nearly 50 thousand dollars.  These people are not model Americans and this experience has disgusted me.

I lived in Windsor club for a year and loved it. The staff was friendly and the property was really clean. It had a fantastic pool and the place was gated which I really liked. The gym was great and I typically had a morning run around the property and along the lake. I would highly recommend Windsor Club at Legacy Park.

Their coffee, employees and ambiance are all fantastic!  I love to stop in while working remotely.   Only complaint: seating.  It would be nice to sit on something other than a stool.  Soft seating or some actual chairs with back support would be wonderful.
This is a great place to go after work but the drinks are high as Fuck. I ordered a top shelf long island ice tea that shit was $32. I thought it was a mistake.
Best BBQ and mac n cheese around! Ok service, pretty extensive beer menu. Best drunk munchie meal after a night of drinking in old city? oh yeahhhh

Bad Service, Regular Food.


We were seated a the table for about 10 minutes waiting for the server. Once our order of drinks and appetizers we wait for like 10-15 minutes just for the drinks. Food was not bad but the mofongo had some raw pieces of plantain and some pieces were like sweet plantain. The yuca frita was kind of raw and we had to ask the server twice for water, sauce, etc

Tremblay Financial Services helped my family member with a time-sensitive retirement account issue. They were thorough in explaining options and in reducing the number of steps he had to take to complete the transaction. We are happy to have them on our side.

This is a wonderful style steakhouse that also offers fantastic seafood my wife treated me to go here for my birthday I had a delicious prime rib and she really enjoyed her crab Imperial fantastic service very elegant atmosphere probably recommend
The food was okay. I went in winter, and the seats by the door were brutal with drafts. The service wasn't that great. Also, they really dislike splitting checks with multiple credit cards.
Probably the worst cioppino I have ever had in my life. So disappointing that I paid $16 for it

It's okay if all you're looking for is some comfort food. Service is slow and this restaurant definitely isn't the cleanest. But if you want something fried, unhealthy and reasonably priced stop on by.
Great brunch ,love the new space,clean,and open,will be back for dinner sometime soon.

Have gone here many times. The food is delicious! They have a wide range in terms of spiciness. I would highly recommend the kabobs (duh!) and getting a few of the apps to share. Service can be a little slow, so I wouldn't recommend it for a quick bite, but if you've got the time, I would definitely check it out!!

Awesome idea for a quick, cheap car wash. I've been here multiple times. I have gotten everything from the basic wash to the ultimate. The wash always misses the back of my car. I drive a normal four door sedan, so this should not be a problem. Not sure if others have the same problem. I feel like I have to come home and complete the wash myself every single time.

Worst service I've ever received from a starbucks. They had four employees "working" while most of them were standing around while there's was eight people waiting for there drinks. The manager on duty or supervisor didn't seem to have any sense of urgency on getting the drinks made  and neither did the employees. Terrible experience and even worse service
Love this place. Great food for a very low price. Staff members are friendly and helpful. I had the half chicken, and my friend had the ox tail. Everything was great.

Really a 4.5. We loved our mini suite on the third floor. View was of an abandoned building next door but the HM can't help that. Breakfast: fair. Why can't we get a good cup of coffee in any hotel in NOLA? Loved the location off Bourbon. Very quiet. Housekeeper very friendly. Beds comfy. Would definitely stay here again but hoping for a better quality breakfast.

Yet another fantastic restaurant in New Orleans...amazing food and atmosphere.  It was recommended to us by a local.  The only reason I did not offer this restaurant 5 stars is because of our waitress.  As we normally do, my fiance and I went with the prix fixe menu...one for the both of us.  We do not do this because of a lack of funds, but simply because portion sizes are outrageous and we do not want to waste food.  We asked if we could split the meal and the waitress said we could but they would not split it onto two plates for us...we would have to do that ourselves at the table.  It's not a huge deal, definitely not a show stopper, BUT I feel as though this shows a slight lack of customer service.  Really, how long does it take to put one meal on two plates?  

Once again, we added an extra appetizer...I had the shitake mushroom and spinach soup (Fantastic) and my fiance had the shrimp and goat cheese crepes (fiance enjoyed them, I do not like goat cheese).  We ordered the pork chops which came with pecan crusted sweet potatoes and greens.  Without a doubt the BIGGEST pork chop I have ever seen and it was AMAZING!  For dessert, a vanilla bean creme brulee.  

Wine/drink menu was a bit pricey for my taste, but all restaurants around here seem to charge up the wazoo for alcohol.  
 
Great location, great food, great atmosphere, almost great service.  Definitely check this place out!

I am so in love with my rug! I was a little intimidated  coming here because I didn't know what to expect. I had some time to look around by myself and my goodness they have such a beautiful selection! Aladdin asked me if I needed any help finding what I was looking for. I gave him a couple of ideas of what I had in mind and he brought out some of the most gorgeous rugs I have ever seen. It was even better than what I was imagining. I told him I would be back after I thought about it for a couple of days. I came back a few days later and was warmly greeted by another man. I asked if I could see just one more rug. He then suggested I take all of them home to try out! I feel like I was treated like family. This helped me tremendously. I found the perfect rug. It is so beautiful and has brought my house to life. They also have me a great deal! I highly recommend getting your rug here. These guys really know what they are doing and are so very helpful.
i love coming here......i am used to paying a bit less, but after the customer service i get here, i am a fan.... i love suzanne...she's so fun to talk to.

This place was gross. Stopped in for lunch last week. There was a swarm of black flies in the bathroom that I had to constantly blow away from my face. Then while we were waiting for our food, a mouse ran along the front of the bar. Needless to say we left as soon as we could.

I lived here for a year. I paid my rent early every month. I moved in my apartment smelled very bad ( they had an odor system connected to get rid of it) When I walked in with the leasing agent I noticed scratches on the hardwood floor, stains on the kitchen cooktop, walls had scratches, etc. I wrote all this down on the new tenant walk thru paper work, and it got signed by the leasing agent. 
 I had to submit a few work orders to get most of it done. I am pretty easy going person so I went ahead and did it. I was happy to be in my new apartment. I really never had any issues so I never required the office attention. I had a few  issues, like the light bolts dying on me, roaches, and they took care of it.
I am pretty easy going, but when I moved in, I went and clean my apartment, and left everything spotless (I had pictures to prove it as well).  A few days later I get an invoice. 
I am being charge for the cooktop and scratches on the hardwood floor (WHICH I NOTATED ON MY WALK THRU PAPER WORK) (WHICH I STILL HAD). 
Since I work a lot I sent my mother to talk to the property manager XHEVAIRE McCool.  My mother is the most educated person I met. She grew up in the Catholic church so she is very respectful and proper with everyone, even rude people such as the manager.  The manager barely paid any attention to her, when my mother asked for a copy of the walk thru paper the manager said she was missing page 1 (I know right). To our advantage, I always file all the important paper work, so I had a signed copy myself. She bought that with her. The manager said she will contact her corporate office so Chelsea (corporate agent who was very nice and professional fix it).  
The main reason I am writing this review is because the lack of professionalism.  How did they loose page 1 of the walk thru?  Don't they usually keep a file with all that information.  Also why will they try to charge me for something that was clearly marked on the walk thru paper work. 
Come on they knew that was there. On top of that I had proof that it was there when I moved in. 
When I spoke to Chelsea at the corporate office she indeed made it better, and fixed it to the best of her abilities and I am grateful for that, but I still cant recommend that place.   I don't appreciate the fact that the office people are so helpless specially the manager. 

If you are to move there please make sure you use a magnifier and check every area of the apartment, including the floor. Make sure you write down every scratch, every paint missing, or issue. I am very glad I did or I had to pay my $300 deposit and $592 on top of that for the scratches on the floor and cooktop damage that was already there when I got the apartment.

I do want to thank Chelsea at the corporate office for all her help. She was very knowledgeable of her job and she helped me out as much as she could. She understood why I was upset about the fact that the manager was trying to rip me off and charge me for damage I did not caused. I greatly appreciate that.  

Cheers,
Jackie

This place is so cute and so good! I love the hole-in-the-wall fell, and the decor is adorable.  The sandwiches are extremely delicious and you get huge portions for the prices. I love going here, and it is probably my favorite sandwich shop in Santa Barbara.

Stopped in after work to check it out, I wound up getting a gluten-free margherita pizza. They took every precaution to avoid cross-contamination, which is great. Best of all, it was definitely in my top 3 for best GF pizza I've ever had. As long as this attention to detail doesn't fade as time goes by, it's an easy 5/5.

So stoked to have a pho place in the neighborhood! We went for breakfast this morning and left feeling like this is a great addition to the neighborhood!

I had the #46 steak and flank pho, we shared spring rolls, he had some kind of spicy Thai influenced soup with a variety of meats and hollow noodles. 

Glows:
Clear, fairly flavorful broth.
Good texture noodles.
Tender meat.
Fresh sprouts, jalapeños, Thai basil.
Clean space and appealing decor.
Friendly service.
Reasonably priced.

Grows:
Spring rolls were just okay, and had an odd meat flavor. (Fake crab meat?) 
Pho Broth could have been more complex and flavorful.
His soup was lukewarm, not supposed to be. 
The awkward string curtain by the ladies bathroom clings to everyone and gets stuck in the doorway.

Overall, I am so happy to have a decent enough pho place closer than Washington Ave. Doesn't hold a candle to pho 75, but more authentic than trendy Stock, and better than any pho in Chinatown.

Had a reading with Kay and it was one of the most accurate readings I have ever experienced. This woman is so gifted. Heading back today for another visit!! Also have an impressive collections of stones and oils. Highly recommended.

I've eat here between 50-60 times. NEVER disappointed! I've tried almost every thing on the menu. Food's GREAT! Price is Very Affordable. Service is Always Perfect. If I eat out any where else I find myself comparing it to Cheddars.

Be sure to try the spin-dip! It's the best!

O.K. now I'm Hungry!
Steve is awesome! I'm in town for a race and needed major help...they had me in & out in no time at a great price!

Every time I crave Vietnamese food, this is my go to place!  I hate that they're closed on Sundays but I don't eat phó on Sundays anyway! Lily is amazing and always makes me feel at home even when the place is busy...and it's always busy.
Typical IHOP.  Clean and friendly service.  Came at an off time.  Quick service.  Enjoyed it.

Bartender Eric was kind and helpful in a very timely manner- he immediately greeted us and was happy to help. Very relaxed environment and strong drinks- what more can you ask for? Looking forward to stopping by again

I've made several comments over the several hours following my earlier meal and how good it was - if that says anything 
I had a Cuban bowl: Ropa Vieja (the meat is pulled) with black beans, sweet plantains, and yucca fries.
The entire meal was excellent! I would definitely go back, and I'd definitely order that again. (Though a friend's Pollo a la Plancha smelled amazing! So I might try that.)
The plantains were nothing special - not bad at all, good, in fact. The yucca fries.  So good. It was like a mix of a french fry and a mozzarella stick. It was probably my favorite piece of the meal.
I would definitely recommend friends to this place :)
Great atmosphere, even better food. I created a wild boar burger and you could taste the quality ingredients. Worth every penny!

This was the best restaurant we visited on our weekend trip to NOLA. The food here is unbelievable. We had 2 couples so we shared off each other's plates so everyone got a good variety of different dishes. The pork chop was very well cooked with a nice sweet flavor. Drum fish was good as well, and the shrimp and grits were amazing. They had a creaminess similar to mash potatoes, and the flavor was incredible. If that wasn't enough, the bread pudding was the best I've ever had. Save room.

Horrible dinner consisting of dry, tasteless meatloaf.  Was very disappointed because I have read several good reviews. We had actually planned on going for breakfast the next day but after dinner I have decided I will never go there again. It's the worst meal I have ever eaten out in a restaurant.

This place WAS pretty great... I love their snow cones and TroMo is the best place to go for one. However, they started jacking up the prices due to the high costs of Kirkwood's farmer's market rent. They unfortunately now have to pay for the booth PLUS the people that are in line. Oh yeah, the lines get pretty pathetic sometimes. After about 5 minutes if the line isn't moving I say a snow cone isn't worth a 20 minute wait. But then again, I could be suffering from snow cone withdrawal... lol

Super cool vibe. We came casual off a long drive. Excellent service! The food was super yummy! Must try the brussel sprouts! They are so sweet and delish. We also got the gnocchi and scallops. We would definitely recommend this place to visitors and locals!

Affortable Plumbing is the pits
Shawn (my plumber for the day) was rude, unprofessional and they left a hugh gaping hole at the curb with a comment" thats your job!" Had to get another cement person to fix the hole More$$$$$
If i could give no stars i would

DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY

We had a last-minute dinner here on New Year's Eve and overall enjoyed the experience.  The service was very good.  We had a reservation and were seated promptly.  Our server was pleasant and attentive.  The food came out quickly (we had a bottle of wine, an appetizer, and entrees) and the spacing between each item was acceptable.  The menu had a nice selection and the specials had prices listed -- yay for that, even though I didn't end up choosing one of those.

My downsides are that the food was just okay.  I had the grilled hanger steak with mushrooms, onions and peppers and while I had requested medium, I think it was a bit overdone and tough.  I don't know much about that particular cut of meat, so perhaps I should have gone more rare (or perhaps it would have been okay if they had cooked it per my order).  It was tasty as far as flavors go otherwise.  My friends and I were also a little peeved at the appetizer.  Honestly, I can't remember what it was and it was good as far as taste goes, but there were three.  And there were four of us.  I think the server should have suggested that we order two appetizers, or talked the kitchen into giving us a fourth serving.  Three is always awkward -- if it's a couple or two couples, someone always either gets the shaft or seems like the aggressive appetizer eater.  Restaurants -- give us even numbers of appetizers!  Three is not that cute!

I might go back if I were in the neighborhood but I wouldn't go out of my way to visit again.

Went to have a good time this weekend but was treated in a poor and unprofessional manner by their head of security and security guards.  Very disappointing experience especially since we spent tons of money eating and gambling and on hotel feels over the couple of days we were there. I will never give this place another dime and will never recommend it, unless they start complying with ADA standards as well as fair treatment for people of ALL races.  The Cafe Milano service was very slow and some of the workers looked like they were on drugs.  While we were on the slots in the middle of the night, countless people were asking us for cigarettes and whatever else we could spare..Didn't feel like a safe environment when you are gambling during night/early morning hours.  Save your money and  go to Grand Sierra, the overall service there is better as well as ambiance.

I'm gonna have to disagree with most people including my Yelp friends (yikes!) and say that I really didn't care for this place. I came here with my boyfriend and a couple friends for dinner one night recently, and sadly we weren't impressed. I'm a big fan of Asian noodle soups, so I was really excited to try this place, too! 

I got the coconut curry noodle soup which sounded promising. The curry broth flavor was initially pretty good, but it was soon overpowered by the huge glob of peanut sauce they put in the bowl. In general, I like peanut sauce but I found the flavor combo really weird, and the peanut sauce was thick and jelly-like in texture, which I found gross. I ate about half of the soup and then gave up. My boyfriend and another friend ordered the brisket soup. Neither of them liked the dish again due to the "off" flavor. My other friend who ordered the hand torn soup did enjoy her meal, though. 

On to the drinks...I'm not a big fan of canned beer to begin with, but I figured I'd give a new one a try. They have several options, but I didn't find any standouts on the list. I  decided to go with the Brewers Art brown ale which I found to be super bitter. I wasn't excited about any of the other beer options, so I decided to stop there. One of my friends didn't like the beer she chose either.

Also, the place is quite small and only has a couple tables up front, so the four of us had to sit side by side at the bar. It was hard to have a conversation with the whole group because it was pretty loud in there. 

Overall, I was just disappointed because I've heard so many good things about Cheu. Given my experience, I probably won't be back. I will just have to stick to the more traditional Asian noodle soup places that I love!

I visit Stefano's semi-regularly because it is around the corner from my house which makes it convenient. The owner is rude on a good day. They are pretty slow with service - always a good 25 minutes for your order (even for something simple). I have had a few bad experiences here but the chicken cheesesteaks keep me coming back. One time I ordered a single slice of white pizza. My boyfriend received his food but no one called out my food so I went up and asked how much longer my slice would be. Then I found out one of the employees ate my slice of pizza after I ordered it (which was the last one) and no one bothered to ask me if I wanted something else. The onion rings are good too. Pizza is okay.
Consistent product, tasty quesadilla. Salsa is a little odd and there is never enough queso but then again, when is there.

There was about a 45-minute wait, and the place was so crowded that you have to wait outside in the heat on some benches.  Once we got in, the waitress was awesome, the wait time for our food was not long considering the crowd, and everything I tried here was good.  A few issues with flies in the restaurant, but it was minor.
   I feel this business could use expanded and/or upgraded facilities to make it a 5-star for me, but it is very convenient to where I live, and I will continue to get food there.

I am craving Creole Creamery right now but don't want to leave my house!

It is so so so good, I have honestly never been disappointed.  All other restaurants should go into the ice cream business.  Creole Creamery is definitely on to something.

Olive garden you disappoint me.  It's been years since I have been here and I remember why.  Carpets were dirty (old & stained) table was greasy and food was just ok.  Took my mom here who recently gave up alcohol and server brought wine to the table (i forgot about this) overall not a good experience like I remember here.  This place needs a makeover ASAP.

I'm not sure what happened to this restaurant , they were awesome;  but the doors are closed and a sign in the window just says CLOSED so its too bad. You finally find a place with fresh food, and reasonable prices and they close, its hard to keep afloat with the bullshit prices these plazas charge for rent!!  They would rather lose months or a years worth of rent rather than lower their leases!!! Idiots

To In'n'out or To Habit. That is the question. Truthfully, while I love both In'n'Out and The Habit, they're entirely different animals in my humble opinion. In'n'Out is dirt cheap for consistently yummy burgers and fries. The Habit is a fresher tasting burger that tastes less like fast food and is delicious to boot. These are my go-to items on the Goleta Habit Menu:

1. Chili Cheese Burger: The ONLY Habit location that serves this. It's greasy and delicious especially with bacon and avocado. I like to mop up the extra chili with fries :)

2. Charburger with Cheese: A relatively clean tasting burger - you can taste the fresh ingredients. Grilled onions! Goes great with a few chili peppers from the self serve bin near the soda fountain. 

3. French Fries: Good when they're piping hot but they get cold and limp really fast - I like my fries crispy. On the upside, you can ask for a side of ranch and they go swimmingly well with ranch. Or, if you're lucky enough to have ordered a Chili Cheese Burger, dip these into the chili!

4. Onion Rings: Habit has some of the best onion rings - the onion stays promptly with the breaded section it belongs to. I hate it when you bite into an onion ring and the entire onion part comes out of the breading like a tube worm. This never happens with the Habit's Onion Rings. 

The Staff at the Goleta location is always friendly and helpful - always smiling! P.S. They let you order half and half for the fries and onion rings so you don't have to order both just to have a taste of each. By far my favorite Habit location!

There was nothing wrong with the room or location, but the customer service here was horrible. I went with three other friends, and we did eat in there once and preparty before going out on the town but we didn't leave that much of a mess at all. We went to leave our room 45 minutes before check out time and then were told that we had to pay a $35 cleaning fee for a pizza box left in there and one half empty bottle of vodka that could have been EASILY thrown away. We then told them we were not paying that and would go back up and clean it up to get a snarky response from the blonde Tennessean there. I've done way more damage in Vegas and the hotel staff there was amazingly nice. We also called down one of the nights and requested towels and they never brought them up so we had to go to the lobby to get them. We called for room service the first night as well and they NEVER delivered it. They tried to charge us for missing a card key, and that's just unheard of! We ended up getting our fee waived after much grief. I would not stay here if you want customer service! There was one really awesome guy who checked our bags, the valet is great, but that's about it. F- for the receptionists, they need to hire new ones if they want to keep their business.

Broadway House Grooming did a great job giving my kitty his first hair cut. Not only did they take the time to explain to me exactly what their process was ( as I had never taken my scared cat to the groomers and was nervous for him ) but they did a great job with his shaving as well. It was a great price and done in a timely manner. He is now sporting a handsome lion cut , cool for summer! Carolyn took great care of my baby!

Now in its second year this 3 day music festival held at the center city BBQ mostly within the a gravel pit of a parking lot as well as inside is an expensive way to spend an afternoon/evening in the days between week 1 and week 2 of jazz fest. What do you get for your $45/day $125/3day entrance fee? Not much. 1 beer coupon and 1 ticket for a large order of crawfish (which being vegetarian was lost on me). So beyond that you stand in a gravel parking lot listing to local music talent. They do serve up some quality music but with so much competition they really need to offer more or bring the prices way down before I would ever return. Not to mention if you ordered from the inside bartenders expect attitude and a long wait. Save your money and go to one of the numerous free music options like Wednesday at the square, Thursday at the park or givenoladay.
Delicious coffee, Amazing decor and Beautiful staff. Very homey feel and a great location.

Hostess staff was horrible.  Told us 45 to 1 hour wait for a party of 5. It's just BBQ I wasn't interested in waiting but my friend had wanted to try it, so we did. Several visible empty tables, and a closed patio on a beautiful Saturday night. I will say it did rain for 15 minutes earlier that day. As we waited in the hostess area, dodging employees rolling overflowing trash cans and food trolleys thru, we noticed a table right next to the hostess stand that could fit 6 to 7 people easily. It had a small gap between the 4 top and the 2 top. I told the hostess we could be flexible.  She didn't seem interested in seating us there. As we approached the 40 minute mark she told us she could seat us. I'll leave it to your imagination as to where she sat us. Yes the same table that had been vacant the entire time. Our server, Denise ? , was very punctual and efficient you could tell she was very busy.  The food arrived quickly. It was at best ok.  My ribs were dry and Luke warm and the sausage was cold but tasty. Here is the upside the atmosphere was great. The bartender that accommodated the little one with us with a very tasty Shirley Temple.  

I would go back, if nothing else to see if this was the norm. Won't be a place I recommend or say "hey we gotta go there".

Stayed in the Santa Barbara Casita. It's perfect. The only BAD THING is that we check out in 1 hour . 

We parked our car and haven't gotten back into it. Everything is walking distance. From state street to the peer and everything between. We had late lunch in downtown and walked to beach for sunset, although the sun sets behind the mountains, the changing colors in sky are beautiful. 
Breakfast was YUMMM  and everything was perfect. The Santa Barbara casita was clean, charming, spacious and the bed super comfy. Private entrances and we haven't seen another guest. Lil parking lot is full so we know there's others here. 

We will be back for sure. We stayed Thursday- Friday. Quick lil getaway but well worth it. 

Thank you Eagle Inn.

Came here for my eye exam, very professional and courteous. Dr. Duong was very patient and answered all my questions. The front staff was very nice and wait time was short. Highly recommend this place and would definitely come back next year for exam!

Pretty darn good happy hour specials going on here.  Had an LIT (which I hadn't had in years) 2 for 1 $5 and $3 appetizers.  We drank & ate like crazy and our bill was less than $20.  

I am not cheap but the apps were pretty good & drinks weren't weak.  

Went back a 2nd time for dinner . . . .Short Rib Mac n' Chez - OMG!!!! Delish!!!

I took my sister-in-law here as a birthday present. The 90 minute class (which ended up closer to the 2 hour mark) focused on teaching the basics: spring/summer rolls, California rolls, miso, and a Japanese dessert (we had white chocolate matcha fondue). I've made spring rolls and California rolls before but never through a class. Having completed the class, I'm very glad I did. Mori is a natural teacher and provided a lot of information that was accessible for those who don't know a lot about food and even those who do. She has a very practical approach to cooking - as an introductory class, she taught us about umami but was mostly interested in having us get good-looking food on the table without it being overwhelming. She was very encouraging, and I felt so empowered by what I had learned that I threw my own little sushi-making dinner party at home later that week. At several points during the class, she had a little photo op set up for us to take photos of our creations - which all 8 of us in the class took advantage of. What I liked best about the class was her advice on which food and cooking products were the best to buy (and where), and reasons for why certain products were better than others. As a white Midwestern girl, it made it possible for me to go to an international grocery store and know exactly what to get so that I could recreate good sushi at home. I cannot understate how valuable this aspect of the class was.

Mori teaches other classes, and I plan on taking all of them. She also is working on getting together a Korean cooking class that I am salivating just thinking about. Her cooking school is relatively new, but I see her being here for the long haul. We had a lot of fun making Japanese food in a positive environment. She is the only Japanese food teacher in the state, and we are lucky to have her.

Long story short: GO TAKE A CLASS HERE!

NEVER. AGAIN. ever. again. charged me for my nails that i have never been charged that much in my life. said she has the color that she wanted but wasn't the color in the slightest. seriously never again.

This is such a hip and trendy bar! I met my friend out for a drink and I'm so happy she suggested Loa Bar. This place is perfect if you're looking for a bar that does speciality cocktails and has a fun but intimate vibe. Honestly, it could be described more as a sexy ambiance with their dim lighting that strategically uses Edison bulbs and tons of candles throughout the bar. Definitely a great spot for a date but also works for meeting up with friends. 

I will say, though I love this bar, be prepared to wait and be patient. I came on a Saturday night and it was busy especially with some people trickling in after a wedding. But the wait is worth it! And honestly we only waited because we had a large order of their speciality cocktails which can be more complicated than your average well drink. The drinks I remembered trying were the honeycomb old fashioned, Atalanta and dandelion root cocktail and they were all wonderful! They do offer more than just their speciality cocktails, but why go here and not try out what they do best? 

And just an FYI, Loa bar is located within the International Hotel, so don't be fooled if you're following your GPS and it leads you to the hotel.

Love love. Super quick service, great eating in or on the go, and the price is so reasonable! I'm a big fan of the queso and the guacamole tacos. Always take my visiting friends and family here, and the indoor/outdoor seating is great in the any season, and the heated porch is especially great in the winter!

To be fair, this shop did not repair anything for me. But that's because the moment I walked in and asked if they could fix a leather bag (I know from past experience the heavy duty machines used to stitch shoe leather also work for other leather items), the woman behind the counter emphatically said, "NO." Not any kind of warmth, or I'm sorry. She seemed happy to turn someone away and be done with interacting, as if her mission was accomplished.

I found Luxury Studio on Yelp and I am so glad that I booked an appointment. Angelique is amazing, attentive and beyond cordial! I've had my lashes done before in other places but they've never been this good! I am definitely coming back. If you're looking around and you're still on the fence.... Stop thinking and come on in. I promise you won't regret it. Her work is amazing and not to mention very very affordable.

I'm visiting from out of town and Dr. Fabacher was absolutely amazing! He went thru several tests to rule out anything serious and was extremely comforting. Being from out of town the staff was so welcoming and really supportive. I really appreciate the care I had while at the urgent care center.

I'm a Latina from Texas, so I know Mexican food, my husband and I are here for the first time. Not much to choose from on the menu, I had the "Pollo Ranchero" -Grilled chicken breast covered with Estelas own spicy ranchero sauce(thin mole sauce) and alittle spicy cheese sauce,with corn tortillas a guacamole salad and my choice of side was refried beans... The dish was DELICIOUS! The only bad thing I have to say is the chips n dip Salsa tasted like tomato paste, I didn't like it.. But my husband did. I would definitely return if I'm back in town.

Once again St. Louis has spoiled me. The Whole Foods right outside of STL (Brentwood), had got me excited about Whole Foods once more. First with Graeters and secondly (and more often once Graeters appeared more places) with their outstanding to-go sandwiches and pastry selection.

This location, however, lacks an impressive (or even good) pastry section. Their pastry case is all of two or three feet long. The one in St. Louis? Probably four times that length. 

Where were the cream puffs? The non mini tarts? Or any fruit tarts besides mixed berry? Where were the french inspired pastries? Or the vegan ones? Where was any of this?

Instead there were pudding cups (I bought one - it was very pretty and did use very rich chocolate, but was still just a bit better than a normal pudding cup), creme brulee, two types of macaron flavors, and only a few cakes (albeit I am sure you can call in advance to order others as you can at most Whole Foods). There were mini tarts, but all the same mixed berry flavors... There was no layered deserts or tiramisu.

It was just a below average bakery selection and it left me sad (as I had driven there hungry and wanting pastries)

Maybe the other location in Indy will prove more fruitful? (Or pastry case full)

Had the chorizo/egg/potato burrito based on another yelp review. It was MONEY. The tortillas really made it. Killer salsa bar to go with it.

I'm moving to Marana in a month and planning on supporting this place! You should too. Not sayin, just sayin.
Great live music. Amazing food. Fun lively ambience  with a dance floor. Service was quick, attentive and we got free drinks from the owners :)

We had a very nice meal. The mussels were huge and juicy. The shrimp scampi had a cream sauce, so was not exactly what my daughter expected but she liked it just the same. Meatball is yummy. The gravy is excellent. Veal Rollatine was also quite good. Very large portions.

Something happened in the time that I wrote my initial review. Broadway changed their food menu, which is now pretty limited and not nearly as tasty, and they must have had a change in staff. The wait staff is now not nearly as attentive and almost seem disinterested in providing good service. Overall, very disappointing and strange.

I am amazed that this place has as many as 4.5 stars.

Sure, their food is good enough to eat, but it's nothing too unique.

I've never had a Greek salad without olives! 
Theirs has none, but the amazing dressing is the saving grace!

Traditional gyro meat should be made with Lamb! 
Theirs is not, but getting extra yummy Tzatziki makes it delish!

They can keep their farmed Tilapia (high in mercury) and frozen french fries. 
But I will scarf down a plate of Zeko's wings! It's all in the sauces with them.

Overall, it is a place with very friendly owners, who know how to dress up their food.
For this, I will return!

They should be aware of the bad-mouthing their employees do though.
I don't even know them and I've heard things more than once.

P.S. LOOK AT THE 'HOOD THIS PLACE IS IN, AND THEN COMPARE THAT TO THE REVIEWS YOU READ ;)

Came here for brunch with some friends and was underwhelmed. I got the egg white omelet and my friends got the cheddar and apple omelets. They were both pretty bland. The jam with the toast was the highlight of the meal. If you are getting a bloody go for the wrangler. The service was pretty slow and not super friendly. I usually love this place, but won't be coming back for brunch.

The Bridgestone Arena is where the Preds play, big name concerts are held and I'm sure the occasional Monster Truck rally. But the review is really about the fans rated number one by ESPN. While I am not sure of the formula the "mother ship" used, I'm pretty sure they got it right.
Everyone seems to be dressed in team colors, the anthem is often sung by some recording star, a veteran is recognized for their service all before the puck drops.
The fans taunt the opposing goalie with a verse that questions his ability. Loud music is played when the Preds need a lift. Live bands play between periods. It must all work as they often have the best home record in hockey.

Apparently, being featured on the hit Nashville series means you can be as pretentious as possible. From the moment my husband, mother-in-law, and I walked in the moment we left, we were treated like we were not important. They seemed to judge us on our appearance from the get-go. We were not clad in sports coats, dresses, and diamonds, but we were also not under dressed. We were asked to wait in the bar downstairs for 45 minutes for a reservation. They forgot about us. My husband went upstairs in the dining area to let the hostess know and she just awkwardly stared at him before hesitantly seating us. No apology either.

The interior decorating is modern and lovely with the art on the walls and the outside terrace seating upstairs provides a nice view of The Gulch, but it is not worth it when you are treated the entire time like you are not a valued patron.  They started cleaning up and closing down in front of us. This is definitely not professional or acceptable for a fine dining establishment. Apparently, ordering a bottle of wine, an appetizer, and two entrees is not enough to be treated like the other dressed to the nines patrons. The only thing redeeming about this restaurant was the delicious heirloom tomato gazpacho. 

We've been to many high-end Michelin starred and AAA Five Diamond restaurants and they treat everyone the same. Watermark is a stuffy restaurant that seems primarily concerned with seeing the numbers at the end of the receipt. I hate to give sour Yelp reviews, but unfortunately, this will be my first in a long time. Spend your money at Catbird Seat, a superior restaurant in Nashville that actually lives up to the hype and cares about delivering the BEST experience!

I had the penne pasta, mac and cheese side, and fried green tomatoes.

The penne pasta had a strong blue cheese taste. Didnt like it.

The mac and cheese was bland and the fried green tomatoes were okay.

The setting was like an old community bar/tavern. Low lighting.  Lots of tv screens.  A lot of country folk who seem to know each other.

Not my thing, but maybe its yours?
Friendly neighbor coffeehouse we will make it our breakfast spot while here. My mistake was splitting the Bagel and lox I will not do that tomorrow. The Cappaccino was spot on! Now to yelp lunch:)

I've been here 2 times now. The food is absolutely delicious! It is a very nice place, both good for casual dining and business dining. The brusetta appetizers are sooo good. Ive tried two of the pastas and they were both perfectly seasoned--rich and flavorful. I would highly recommend this place
Ordered Ginger Meat Tofu, spicy. The dish was well prepared, appropriately balanced with spices, fresh veggies and tofu. Amazing flavours, certainly recommend for others. Bit pricey but worth it.

Service was excellent, manager very nice. And food was excellent. Nachos were some of the best I've had.
Only down side is everytime we go, they are out of certain beers. Besides that everything is top notch

Great services, always friendly even though it's an upper class salon. Mikka cut my hair and she is really great! But she didn't give me what I asked, it was still fine, but didn't have that wow factor I had been going for. Be sure to ask for a senior stylist if that's what you want, otherwise you are put with whoever is available which is usually the newest team member. Amazing space, which they were more up to date on the new styles and trends considering how trendy they sell themselves as.

I'm giving Envie a four star for a lot of reasons, but most of all I think it's for the sentimental factor.  I'm pretty sure this is the first cafe that my husband and I visited after moving here and I was so excited about moving it makes me remember that time every time I'm in there.

Great things about Envie
1. it's on decatur where most of my favorite things are
2. it's always fun to people watch here
3. they are open fairly late compared to a lot of places (midnight)
4. their coffee is pretty good
5. they offer alcoholic coffee drinks (also pretty good)
6. the food is good, I really like the sandwiches

Not so great but okay
1. it can be really noisy since right on decatur
2. sometimes it's really crowded
3. sometimes it's hard to get the barista's attention

This place is pretty awesome try it out for lunch or try it for late night you'll have a good time.  :)

I gave Zaxby's a try.  It's located in front of the Super Target.  The building itself is new and nice.  Now...the food.  I got a Zax Snack Pack (three chicken tenders, crinkle cut fries, piece of Texas toast, one Zax's sauce, and a drink).  I went through the drive through around a prime lunch time.  

Below are some pros and cons.  Overall disappointing service and mediocre, bland food.  I won't be back, but will instead visit Chick-Fil-A or PDQ.

Pros:  
1.  I like the bag had handles, it made it easy to grab.
2.  Served with a mint and hand towel.
3.  Drink is in styrofoam cup.
4.  Texas Toast was good, probably my favorite of the three food items.
5.  Easy to arrive/leave from parking lot.

Cons:  
1.  Chicken lacked flavor (prefer Chick-Fil-A or PDQ), some tenders were very small, and  each tender had some "skin" on it.  See picture.  This was not the savory chicken skin like a rotisserie chicken, but fat or grizzle I couldn't bite into.
2.  Fries lacked flavor (again prefer Chick-Fil-A or PDQ).  A very small amount of fries had what appeared to be a reddish season salt on them and they were better, but still lacking flavor.
3.  Drink served overflowing with soda run off and a wet straw.  This is so annoying to me!
4.  Service is as poor as other reviews cite.  Woman yelled to another employee "Jesus (explicative) Christ, this isn't rocket science.  I need..." and proceeded to rattle off drive through tickets waiting.  
5.  You are charged for extra sauces
Excellent Indian-Pakistani food. It's in a nondescript strip mall, but don't be fooled. The owners are so kind and friendly, and make excellent food.

Bought some spray glue for a project.  Turns out it sat on the shelf for 8 years (date on can from 2008) - the glue never dried and the propellant didn't work right.  So, they don't check their perishable inventory.  Now I know to do it.  Heads up, folks.  

However, when I tried to return it for a refund, an employee advised me I had to enter the checkout line with everyone else.  Since it's Christmas  shopping season, the line was literally back to the entry door.  I ended up throwing the product away - wasn't worth the hassle.  Don't shop there much, will likely go there even less now. Not impressed by the lack of concern for seasonal shopping issues - most places have a dedicated customer return area.  This needs attention, Michaels.

If you don't mind wading through throngs of Edmonton hipsters to get to a great sandwich, then this is the place to go.  I dislike the curry tuna, but so far I've enjoyed every single other sandwich - especially the pulled pork.

I love Lucchese's, and inherited my brother's pair appr. 16 years ago. They are just about 27 years old now, and have always fit me like a glove. As soon as the leather started to crack (recently), I decided to retire 'em.

I was visiting Nashville recently, and walked into this store behind an older couple; there were two sales people, and they greeted the other customers and started chattin' them up. I wasn't in thre for more than 8 minutes before I walked out the door - with not even a peep outta the sales people. A simple greeting, or parting word would have been nice - esp from what could be perceived as high-end items.

I also know the price points and levels of quality that Lucchese offers, and will pay the price if I see exactly what I am looking for. Unfortunately, you will never get the whole product line in one store, so as was the case here, I walked out.

...but unfortunately, they will never know whether or not they could've had a sale, cuz they failed to reel me in.

JONES is one of my favorite dinner spots in the city because it offers something for everyone!
Always great service and yummy comfort food like mom makes. I really love the Turkey dinner especially when I am craving Thanksgiving meal in the middle of July.  I also recommend the Nachos if you are hungry or have a large party. Their specialty cocktails are unique, light, and refreshing so try one (or three)!
I've brought everyone here for dinner: my suburban family, my out of town guests, and my best friend! Like I said their menu has something for everyone and the decor is cool without being over the top trendy.
I almost forgot: ORDER DESSERT! They are fabulous!

I've had very good luck with this location. They are generally very nice. The location is small, but has what you need. Doctor was very careful and informative. They do the right types of tests here for a reasonable price. Sunglasses here are expensive, and the contacts are not cheap either, but they are a friendly office with good location and lots of parking.
This place is amazing! Everything is authentic and delicious! The fried tilapia is fantastic and so is the cafe con leche.

We discovered this gem of a neighborhood restaurant quite by accident. The service was friendly, welcoming and efficient. The fried oysters are tender and tasty--no grease. There is a great selection of po boys,  and the white chocolate bread pudding is more than ample.

Go Upstairs - Awesome bar, Awesome live music.  Like, REALLY awesome music. Rockabilly Honky Tonk Blues - Old Dudes that really rock out.  Try the 'Angel's Envy' bourbon.  Heard that food the downstairs is awful.

Went for brunch today. Nice atmosphere with jazz band playing which was really cool and the gentlemen playing were talented. Food was mediocre at best and for the price I'd say was a major letdown. We had the duck spring rolls which were okay but at 7 dollars per roll left much to be desired. The bbq shrimp were okay and again for nearly $25 again left much to be desired. The eggs and bacon were decent. Two bloody Mary's were watered down and bland. The one star review is reflected by the service. We had some of the most inattentive service in NOLA (in about 10 trips over the past 5 years) and that's saying a lot as things here move at a much slower pace in general. Forgot coffee order, forgot Bloody drink order, no coffee refill, no follow up whatsoever from our waitress on anything and had to ask for literally every single item needed including utensils. The closest thing to a modicum of service I had was from the water guys. Walked out with $100 check for brunch and a feeling that they could care less about us as a customer. Also I should have known going in when I saw the host berate a more junior team member to nearly tears for supposedly mishandling customer checkin. Unfortunately they can likely get away with it because the place was packed.......sorry Mr. B but we won't be returning or recommending you.

Service was a little slow to start but improved. Guacamole dip was very good. We had a large group. Everyone was very pleased with their meal. I had the El Jalisco Special.  It was very good and plenty of food for the next day. The passion fruit margarita was very good also. I would recommend this to anyone looking for a good Mexican restaurant

Steak was salty & over cooked to the max! I asked for Medium, they came out well well done. The experience was not a steak, it was chewing on beef jerky. The meat was tough to say the least. I gave some to my fiancé & when even he could not stomach it, took rest home for my dog.

I ordered a basic two eggs breakfast. It was not good. The bacon was overdone, the hash browns were flavorless, and they were out of biscuits. I was ok to substitute for an english muffin. It was swimming in butter. The waitress was very unfriendly and did the bare minimum. It was not crowded so I can't understand why they didn't get it right. I would be curious if I ordered something different if that would be better. But if you can't get two eggs any style right, then I don't have faith it will be better.
Dessert is underwhelming, the chocolate cake didn't even come with ice cream. The filet and risotto apps were good would recommend those.
Great place for fun and good food.  I love the surfer concept.  Mahi tacos were done well!   My only gripe is that they don't include wine in happy hour prices.

I think they must have several new people. A young girl dumped a coffee down the side of my white car with barely an apology.  And what the heck is going on with the drive through wait time?? I was trapped in the drive through for at least 30 minutes. Unbelievable.
Stopped in at lunch time, He was able to cut my Honda key and program the chip inside it in a few minutes .Prices were very affordable and also Military friendly!!

Ate at your restaurant at exit 19 on I-4 (Plant City) on Sat 4/19/14..

Couldn't have been more disappointed!

a 9 oz glass of house wine was prominently displayed on the menu at $4.00.  This is a Happy Hour 3-6 offering.  The actual available wine was $6.00 and 6 oz.
DECEPTIVE ADVERTISING.  BAIT AND SWITCH.  SHAME ON OUTBACK!

we ordered 6 oz filets which ended up costing $20.00 each.  NO VALUE. Mine had a little gristle - should be none.  My companions was seasoned so heavily she could not eat it and sent it back.  Her filet was 1/2" thick - not a filet!  Also, the Caesar salads had so much pepper my companion sent her's back - I ate mine.

In summary then, Outback operates on a BAIT AND SWITCH policy with POOR QUALITY and MINIMUM VALUE.

I am most disappointed and won't be returning...

Horrible coffee experience. The coffee is OK, I've had better. 

But what is REALLY annoying about this place is that when you walk in, you have no fucking idea where or how to order. You have to go searching around for a menu, a cashier station, etc. and figure out where and how to order. Trust me, having to figure all this out at 8 in the morning BEFORE YOU HAVE HAD YOUR COFFEE is NOT FUN.

Then they take FOREVER to give you your coffee. I don't know what the guy was doing back there: solving mathematical equations, developing a cure for cancer, masturbating? Because it took him at least 15 minutes to make 1 ounce of espresso. Are you freaking KIDDING me?

Nice lounge area, with cool music playing and the obligatory coffeehouse hipster chick manning the cash register.

But if you can't take my order and give me my coffee quickly, you lost me.

Bye-bye.

Stopped here for lunch while walking around Doylestown on Sunday. Sat outside and enjoyed the weather and food. Love that they had many vegetarian specialties and will definitely come back to try each one! 2 of us got the Southwest Black Bean Burger and 2 of us got the Vegetarian Burger. We shared cole slaw and mac n cheese. Everything was SO TASTY!!! Food was delicious and the different bbq sauces were even better!! Also, their homebrewed sweet peach tea, unsweetened iced tea and lemonades were perfect. Mike the owner super nice and funny! He came outside to see how everything was. Would recommend for sure!

Love this salon.  My hair is fine and thin and Dona French always pulls out all the stops to make it look wonderful.  If you're looking for a stylist who can really cut and color hair, your search is over.  She's the best!
My friend and I enjoyed our late lunch.  The food was good.  I'll be back soon for brunch.

the service here is outstanding, a true down home family hospitality from the time you come in to the time you leave. I've only been here twice, once for all you can eat fish fry (sun) and ribs (tues). on both occasions they made each dish a little different by adding a type of sauce or spices so I could try something new. it looks like a fun place for post work drinks, watching the game or social club meetings. I'll definitely come back

I worked down the street from the one in Westshore area so I was excited to see this one open up in Carrollwood! Tried the cranberry club with potato salad...it was delicious!! Staff could be a little more friendly, maybe they're just new and uncomfortable. Food was fresh and tasty, worth a stop in.
Extremely rude customer service and uncalled for.  What happened to the friendly people here?!?

Went on a Saturday  night at 5pm and place was half full by the time we left at 6pm there was a line so you may want to go early. Overall we loved this restaurant, as the food was very good and the open space of the dining room was pretty  cool. My daughter opted for breakfast( eggs Benedict) which is served all day. Wife and myself  went for sandwiches which were Mel's  chicken cutlet and cali turkey. Both were made with fresh ingredients and prepared to perfection. Definitely  a solid choice for any meal

Get the BBQ grilled cheese, and thank me later. Cheddar + American + BBQ short rib + bar bacon + cole slaw + onion strings on sourdough. The perfect hearty lunch on a chilly fall day. I saved half of my sandwich for dinner, it was so filling. 

The Pint Room has a great selection of burgers, salads and sandwiches. It can get a little loud in the restaurant, so keep that in mind. They do have a nice patio to enjoy in the warmer weather.

Spinach dip was lukewarm. Obviously sat out for 10+ minutes before served. Waitress couldn't understand that I wanted raw onions on the side. Burger came with fried onions. She got confused. I understand...too many kinds of onions. Waitress was not kind. Not enthusiastic. Didn't care that we were there. 

Burger was just not very good. Might as well have gone to 5 guys. Really nothing special about the meal. Not worth it. Won't go back.
What's with the bathrooms at train stations! You can have great shops and a nice staff but have such bad bathrooms.  Yep, my review went there but you always need a "p" break before the train!
Anytime locksmith was to my car within 20 minutes and very courteous and helpful. I would highly recommend.

Warm Springs Golf Club is such a convenient golf course from downtown. You don't have to fight through some of the cross town traffic. 

I have golfed here several times and this place is A-OK with me. The club house and the pro shoppe are simple but they work. Prices are affordable both for a game of golf, the driving range, and even their beers.

My friends and I enjoy to do  golfing happy hours where we grab a beer while we hit at the driving range. Best of all worlds! My one complaint with Warm Springs is I have never hit off of the grass at the driving range. Every time there are mats to hit from. Not sure if that ever changes?

When I play a round of golf, the greens aren't top in the world, of course, but they work for me!  They have some difficult holes and some fun par threes. I can't really complain for the price. We did a twilight game for $21.00. There are some great views of the evening sunsets from this course!

They don't have crazy strict rule and that is what I like! Golf is my game and if I want to wear a shirt without a collar, that is ALLLL RIGHT!!!

Way to go Warm Springs, I like what you do!

My husband's glasses broke - screw came loose and lens fell out.  He popped in to Acuity because of the good reviews on Yelp.  They offered him a drink while they repaired the glasses, including new nose guards, and cleaned them.  He didn't buy the glasses there but I'm sure he will buy the next pair from there.  Excellent customer service.

I had a great workout with Barbara.  Looking forward to checking the cardio and intense class options.  Seems like there are several class options every day, which is handy with my crazy work schedule.

Sorry. I have to downgrade my review.  While the food, drinks and service are still pretty good,I find there are SO many spots in this bar where a giant tap, lamp, or fire pit cover block your view of a tv.

Had my 2015 Lexus IS250 serviced with KEVIN in the Service Department recently . It was for a few warranty items that were quickly addressed and taken care of. They even provided a courtesy loaner vehicle (2017 Lexus with only 800 miles on it) to me at no charge while my Lexus was under repair. 
KEVIN kept in contact with me and updated on the progress of the repairs. The rest of the Service Department staff was friendly and prompt in getting my paperwork processed at both drop off and pick up. I recommend the Service Department and especially KEVIN if your Lexus needs service!

After reading all of the mixed reviews, I decided to book my birthday dinner at Jones anyway, since I love Stephen Starr restaurants to begin with.

The food was delicious. From appetizers to dessert, they know what they're doing. I loved the menu and had a hard time deciding what I wanted because everything looked so good! 

The ambiance was great. Loved the shag carpeting and lighting.

Let me tell you, the service was great. Our waitress, Brett, was so attentive to our needs and constantly refilled our water throughout the entire meal. She really made my birthday dinner stand out. Loved the ice cream and birthday cookies!

From start to finish, this place is very high on my list of favorite places. I would recommend Jones to anyone who is in Philly and wanting a great place to eat.
