And injera is like a spongy bread with a [slightly] sour taste that serves as a similar vessel as Indian naan - good for scooping up the stews/sauces.

Service:
I've visited four times and each time I felt like the service was good (even when using a Groupon), albeit slow/leisurely.

Look no further! Hands down this is the BEST casino I've ever stayed at. Stayed at the Tuscany tower and what a beautiful view! HUGE bathroom, double shower, king size beds and lets talk about watching TV while taking a bath! Great selection of restaurants. Definitely worth your visit you won't be disappointed. Thanks Peppermill!
Came for lunch. The service was great. AYCE for $13.95. Very fast. Very fresh. VERY GOOD! Can't wait to come back.

I would normally give the toscana spa at the peppermill five stars but it was to crowded and annoying to deal with loud obnoxious women. Ladies it's a spa I come here to get away from stress when you come in as a group keep it quiet this isn't animal house for god sakes! So it added to my irritation oh yeah the women's elevator was broken better luck next time. Don't go on a Saturday it's just to much.
The kids absolutely loved it! We went to the glow event they had. Super cheap for two hours of entertainment! They met new friends and had a blast! We will be going back!

To call this place a neighborhood gem is an understatement!!! This place is pretty much a go-to spot if you're looking for delectable eats, a notable late night bar menu, excellent crafted cocktails and hospitality that is up to par with Rittenhouse's finest!  I've been wanting to visit this place for a while now. My very good friend who knows how much of a foodie I am pushed for me to go and this place has consistently been featured in philadelphia magazine's top 50 restaurants. I finally made it a point to visit on Valentine's eve and this adorable and hip and LIVELY neighborhood gem is filled with energy, a fun crowd, dapper looking bartenders who have an appreciation for good grooming, your hipster servers and a notable menu! I scanned their menu even though I wasn't too hungry and one after the other, a series of gnoshes caught my eye! Their warm spiced nuts with sea salt was legitly warm and caramelized to perfection, deviled eggs were a perfect balance with the smooth creamy texture of the piped yolk topped with capers and potato crunch, their Brussels sprouts with balsamic glaze and lamb bacon (per the recommendation of our super star sever Beth was MINDBLOWING! I always appreciate a good server who knows his or her stuff) and we had a "secret" not on the menu whiskey bread. ZOMG, not only was this bread piping hot from the oven, but it had almost a croissant-y texture topped with an adorable dusted bunny stencil!! I feel like this menu was just a tease to what the entrees and dinner menu has to offer. Most definitely a MUST try spot! To top it all off, the well groomed bartender Dom stopped by our table to extend the Pub & Kitchen hospitality! This place speaks for itself and I only look forward to everything else this gem has to offer! Brava brava brava!!

The grounds are beautiful, the market is beautiful and the facilities are clean. We go once a year to do apple picking or pumpkin picking but because their goods are so pricey - we don't shop there at all.
Currently have been without Phones for 4 days.  Have voicemails and emails into Evolve but no one has called me back in 24 hours with a resolution or ETA.

Thursday evenings in the summer are my favorite because of this market!
It is a great place to go for dinner with all the amazing food trucks.
They have great venders with fruit, veggies, lots of tasty snacks and entertainment as well.
There are a lot of options for treats for people who have gluten or dairy allergies.
It's a fun evening especially when the weather is great.

This place is a hidden gem. I commonly order their antipasto salad and I just devoured it like I was in a competitive eating contest. Yes, I was starving but nevertheless their food is phenomenal. Don't even get me started on the cannoli's!

I'll start with the good...food was pretty good and a decent portion. The price for a sandwich and non alcoholic drink ran me around $13 which is to be expected in the airport. 

The bad...I had to wait 47 minutes for said sandwich. Don't choose this establishment if you are in a hurry. Lastly, the manager changed the channel with less than a minutes in an OT football game, because the LSU game came on. Everyone was screaming for him to change it back, but he said it was "company policy."

Great food but pricey and portions are too big. You order meat loaf and you get a whole meat loaf. The new 1/2 sandwich-cup of soup special is nice but excludes the reuben option. No prices shown. Everything a la carte. But the food is tasty and service is quick. Expect to pay 10-15 dollars for lunch though. But you won't leave hungry. (Baked goods very expensive too but quality is good.) Always ask what things cost before ordering.

Went for breakfast at 9:30. Got right in. Service was incredibly slow, had to keep asking for coffee refills. Waited a long time for our food to arrive. It did not all come out at once. Was disappointed by the experience. As we left around 11:00 there was quite a line waiting to be seated. So, others must have a better experience than we did. May try again, but am not sure.

It isn't super fancy or anything. But the Sunday dinner spaghetti is some of the best meat sauce spaghetti anywhere. This gives it a 5 star rating in my book. (Evidently spaghetti is a big part of my book)

We decided to make the Three Muses our destination for live music in New Orleans.  
Great food, amazing cocktails and killer music all in one place?  Don't mind if I do!

We got there early to pick out a good table, and then once the kitchen opened at five we set out to eat as many of their small plates as possible.  It was also quite fortuitous that the Three Muses served plenty of vegetarian fare, as my sis was getting a little sad at hearing, "yeah, I guess we could give you some rice and steam some veggies to go with it."  Poor girl - New Orleans is not the best place for a vegetarian!

So what did we try?  

- the butternut squash ravioli:  killer brown butter, three delish pillows of perfection
- the mac and cheese with brussel sprouts:  gotta be healthy if you have veggies, no?
- steak and cake:  yay bearnaise with a tender chunk of hangar steak!
- the duck confit and goat cheese flatbread:  mmm - and some balsamic to give it tang
- the fried pickles:  little vinegary slices of heaven dipped in ranch - start with these!
- the feta fries:  delish, garnished with fresh herbs

(and there were probably more, but I was having a few cocktails, too...)

Loved the Muse and the Pimm's cup...nothing went to waste!  And some people didn't like having to order at the bar, but it was pretty convenient until the place started filling up.
Breakfast omelets were good, but the beignets were great! Live jazz band was playing at 8am on Sunday morning and was enjoyable.
The technician was very friendly, knowledgable, and educated me on things I needed to know about, to ensure I get the best use out of my AC.

Thank you fellow Yelpers for helping me find this place!! This was exactly what I was looking for in a NOLA seafood restaurant.  

We made a point to come when the doors open for lunch so we had no problems with parking (very small) or getting a table.  The dining room was filled with wood panel walls & fish portraits with a long bar at the end of the restaurant.

The menu was very impressive; cooked / raw oysters, gumbo, etoufee, po boys, alligator, boiled crawfish/shp, variety of blacken or chargrilled fish, turtle soup (WHAT?!?!?) and so much more!!!  The price was very reasonable too.
http://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/b7V_5q22_eTeHlYzq1bpFw?select=WV6eUD88XoDjc6S0sCfdWQ

We order like there was no tomorrow (actually, tomorrow meant we would be in another state):

Boiled Special (5*) - 2lbs of boiled crawfish, 1/2 shp, 2 corn, mushroom for $15.95
http://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/b7V_5q22_eTeHlYzq1bpFw?select=geMUr3WHPtgq3iwqeKTJaA

2 dozen oysters (4*) - fresh & clean

Blackened Gator (5*) - better than chicken!!
http://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/b7V_5q22_eTeHlYzq1bpFw?select=3JMbxKxwg1iz28csGPR1Wg
Buffalo Frog Legs (3*) - fried soggy legs coated w/ buffalo sauce
http://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/b7V_5q22_eTeHlYzq1bpFw?select=j_CW7gGwLl77BB2Y4EmAgA

Seafood Gumbo (3*) - the brown color threw me off a bit, taste was alright too.  ....maybe too authentic for me???
http://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/b7V_5q22_eTeHlYzq1bpFw?select=pywXc1t88EIkuFzn8r21Mw

Blacken Redfish dinner (4*) 

Service (4.5*)

Good seafood with cheap beer, what more can you ask for?

Higher end (but not stuffy) breakfast/brunch place that is consistent with the quality that I'd expect from this new mixed-use development.  We came right at the Sunday brunch rush. Wait for a table of four was 20 minutes to get a table and then probably 30 more minutes for food. Everything came out hot and delicious. Kid's menu available with protein and carb breakfast and lunch type options. Slings and highchairs available. And Steven, our server, was friendly and took wonderful care of us. We will definitely be back!

This is the best place for fresh seafood at reasonable prices in Santa Barbara. The wait is long but it's worth it. Come around summer time so you can enjoy the pier while waiting to be seated. We got the rock crab, clam chowder and Caesar salad for $25. Oyster shoot for only $2.99. I'll come here again when I visit Santa Barbara.

Had a few of their beers before they got the permanent location and was impressed. I've been in here close to a half a dozen times and it's just opened. The atmosphere's great and the prices are very reasonable. 

8 beers on tap, and haven't found a bad one yet. Glad to have another solid spot in Brewerytown to hang.

Well,  after today's manicure I'll be coming here often. Every lady I saw getting either a pedi or mani had a smile in their face!  I came with a friend today,  mother's day.  Place was packed. There were 4 people waiting ahead of us. My  Wait time: less than 10 minutes! ! Got me in for my manicure, Cici was friendly fast and knew what she was doing.  I didn't get the mimosa but they had an array of goodies for the customers, VERY NICE!  the place is super clean,  tools are brand new, and the pedicures. ..man, they have this plastic cover that gets discarded after each customer is done.  HEALTH oriented,  Awesome.  Everybody is friendly,  treat you with a smile and it looks like every customer has a good relationship with their manicurist/pedicurist, which is A plus!! They are fluent and despite the place being packed for Mother's day, the flow was nice and I didn't see a long face at all. They have a good array of nail Polish ..great colors, OPI was a bit more pricey but ok..it's worthit. Price wise. ..yes you pay for what you get indeed; great environment,  great customer sevice, "food"... and CLEANLINESS.  Ladies. . Come over; IT IS SAFE and you'll be treated like a queen.

I really want to like this place.  This bike shop is the closest to my home and I've been there a handful of times with mixed results.

Prices seem to be set by whatever kind of mood the dude is in; sometimes I get a free headset tighten (see below), and sometimes its $30 for 10 min of work.

I'm taking a star off because they went after my nice vintage french headset with a pipe wrench, now its gouged forever :(

We had such a great tour with David! He was so much fun, welcoming, and had so much good information about New Orleans, the food, and the people. We are now "locals" and know that we need to ask for our burgers dressed! Food was good and David obviously has good relationships with all of the stops on the way.
Love Love Love this Place!!! . Excellent food that has always been consistent over the 10 years I've been going!! . What a treat to eat at Blue Sage!!!!

Tryst is a beautiful bar. Beach Drive needed something like it and especially a place that stays open until 3. I went on a Thursday night.  The place is beautifully appointed and very upscale. 

Amazing beer cooler with an incredible wide and varied selection.  Cocktails were well thought out when they created the menu. I had 2 very nice cocktails with muddled fruits and nice ingredients.  Steep cocktail price of $10 so it keeps you more in check than I prefer. 

We ordered 1 salad and 2 sharing tapas.  We had the Beef Carpaccio and the Eggplant Caprese.  Came in for dinner and at $15-17 per sharing tapa, I expected to be full. We walked out still hungry. With that said, food was very delicious and fresh. Nice wait staff from what we encountered.  

I will come back but not when I want a big dinner.  I think the place will be great for drinks when the weather starts turning for "fall" and we can sit outside.  Nice option to have that in St. Pete. 

Food wise tasty but more for a small (and expensive) bite. 

We did not encounter it being loud like Michael stated on a Thursday. 

2 drinks, 2 apps, 1 salad - $70.00 before tip 

Overall - could be a romantic place for a "tryst" or great for a girl's night to catch up.

A few years ago, there used to be a Bar Louie in Clay Terrace. I loved it! Especially the $5 burgers and drink specials. Came here this past Saturday night. 

- The band was quite good and started around 9:30pm
- The food was good. Bar pub food with Tots!
- The drinks were ok, I liked my Moscow Mule but the Browned lime was disappointing for a $9.50 drink 
- Parking is mostly street parking or you can park in the Church parking lot across the street. Cars go quickly at night down that corner. Be careful!
- Service was meh, it took a while for someone to get to us at bar. There was one bartender who was pretty on it. If I was able to get his attention, we were good. You kinda had to flag down otherwise. Or be ok with waiting 15 min for a drink. 

I will probably be back, but wouldn't go out of my way. I want to see how brunch is.

Nice staff, very clean salon and they took their timie on all 3 of us who went as walk ins for mani & pedis last Sat.
The only complaint is that they tried to first put me in a chair that didn't work for my spa pedi without telling me. I had to ask to be moved.  I mean seriously, we all know how great those chairs can be....and thank goodness I asked them to move me because their chairs are AMAZING!! I loved it. Maybe the best spa pedi chair I have been in and I get spa pedi at least 2 times per month just because I love the experience.
Not sure what type of top coat they use but my nails started to chip a little sooner than I am used to from my regular place in the Bay Area, so for that I am taking off 1 star.  Otherwise, I would def visit here again when in SB and in want or need of a mani and or pedi

When I go back to Nashville there are only a few places that I insist on going and this is one of them. 

The only thing Ive really ever had here is the tofu green curry and I am more than ok with this. I love this meal and this is one of those hidden gems in Nashville.

If your into trying any of the curry items, here is a tip that me and my girlfriend at the time use to do on togo orders: get just one order of curry  which comes with a large side of rice and then order another side rice for 99 cents (free if you dine-in) and its plenty of food. The servings are big and last night when I order some I tried to eat it all and though I nearly did, I couldn't. This meal that feed two nicely cost about right at 10 bucks. Its really hard to beat that.

parking has always sucked here but, I noticed last night they now are using the parking lot across the street which is a huge difference.

I cant speak for the buffet they have or nearly any other meal besides the other curry options but, I have eaten at numerous other Thai places in Nashville and I can say its the best curry in town and many people on and off of Yelp agree.

Going to Dr. Clarke is a pleasure. His friendly staff is there to assist in any way to make your appointment enjoyable. He has the top of the line equipment that makes his job much easier, quicker, with much less pain. He is a good communicator and very adept at doing root canals. I felt quite comfortable with Dr. Clarke. The pictures he takes of your tooth (teeth) are spectacular. I would not hesitate recommending him to my friends.

I got a free car wash here because I went to Oil Stop. I had a really bad experience at this car wash. From the second I pulled up the guy was trying to up-sell me. I told him I just wanted the free wash and he continued to try. 

Then they never explained how the whole process worked. I sat in my car and the guy was looking at me like I was stupid. The car wash was fine but I will never go back. I understand you want to sell me something but it was way more pushy than I wanted for a car wash!
Great food and great service. Get the French Toast.   Best I have had.   Just came here for breakfast twice.   Great both times.

I've been here several times for lunch and I always get the same thing; Scottish Salmon and the Nuevo Bread Salad.  My wife ordered the burger and it is the burger for which we measure all others. Service is good, ambiance and location are good.  It is so much better than its sister restaurant, Whiskey Kitchen.  I hear it is a trendy and crowded venue at night.

Rustic-Modern Italian sums it up very well. My recent dinner at Moto Cucina + Enoteca was incredible. Truly one of the best meals I've had in a while. Amazing wine selection and very knowledgeable server. The service was spot-on and very respectful of our decision to have a couple glasses of wine before we ordered anything else. My buddy had the Garganelli. It appeared beautifully and tasted exactly like you would expect a dish with chilies to taste. I had the Osso Bucco. Off the charts good. Originally, I questioned creamy polenta with cranberry. A crazy combination that works very, very well. Thankfully my friend couldn't eat all his pasta and let me take it home with my Osso Bucco. Both dishes made one heck of breakfast. Even cold they were excellent. 

As Nashville evolves into a metropolis its comforting to know we have an excellent place to escape the tourist and the traffic and enjoy a fantastic meal capable of making you feel like you are in Italy.

Good thing we had a reservation or else we would be waiting a good 1-2 hours. The food was great but the service was a bit slow but it was super busy. Theres a good range of side dishes that come with the bbq. 

The entrees were delicious. Got the seafood pancakes and japchae. definately worth it!

The service by waitress Jenea'was excellent . She was well versedof all menu items,happy to explain the typds of oyster dishes.The crab cakes were excellent,  Fried picles w Creole Ranch Dressing was Great.The Gumbo,Red Beans,Jambalaya were Delicious. The Desserts-- Bread pudding and slu e of Key lime Pie were just Awesome. The omly drawback was tge luke warm coffee was a disappointment.  Overall a Great Experience, i will be back.

Money ... money ... who doesn't love money?  While visiting Philly, I thought it'd be fun to see where the coins are made.  The mint is pretty small and you walk around on your own -- no guided tours.  You'll get to see the machines making coins and the entire production from A - Z.  The souvenir shop also has some cool items for sale.

Gave me exactly what I wanted!! I haven't been this happy with my hair in months. He will tell you what will work with your hair and what won't and is very honest about his opinion, doesn't sugarcoat the truth at all or try to sell you products. My hair is so beautiful right now I can't stop touching it!

Greek to its core. Nice atmosphere. Full and bustling. Service a little harried and inconsistent.

After great hummus I came to find that, as I was eating my appetizers and entrees, I just really don't like greek food that much. Not a knock on the restaurant, maybe more so my taste buds.

Flat face.

Rum Fish Grill gave me music for all of my senses. I made a reservation ahead of time. It's pretty handy that you can do it directly through yelp.com using the open table site. I wasn't quite sure what was to come because we planned outdoor activities before hand, and due to crazy rain we would be having, I had to have a plan a and b. I set up two reservations online. One at 5:00 and one at 5:45pm. The day of at 5 with the crazy storm upon us, we used our 5pm reservation and cancelled the other reservation online. Worked perfectly.  We had no wait. We had a perfect spot in front of the fish tank, and all was well.
Our waiter was helpful. He broke down the menu for us, said I asked tons of questions which I do, and he answered them very well. Hubby picked a N.Y. Strip and I picked the grilled jerk swordfish w papaya rum butter sauce. 
Guess what happens shortly after that?  Electricity went out! That's never happened to us at a restaurant. Ok. What's next? We just chilled a bit. We received table lamps, and the menus were lit.  Everyone had their calm professional demeanor with us. I'm sure they were really freaking out to death. Much of the surrounding businesses were out from the storm. Someone said someone hit a light pole. No idea. Florida is weird. It could be the case. Lights came on 15 minutes later, and food had not stopped coming out so I guess they were fine in the kitchen. Cool!
Management was so professional. Went to every single table, apologized for any inconvenience. I thought that was really nice that they did that.
While we were waiting, we were still able to see the fish swimming in the tank. There was light there. Weird feeling to have no electricity, but it worked out fine, and there were no mishaps.
Our food came out soon. my hubby's steak came with truffled mashed potatoes, & he changed the veggie option to coconut rice. It was perfect. Seriously, it was juicy and flavorable, and the right temperature and color.  My jerk swordfish was very good with the papaya rum butter sauce. I think it's more of a salsa to me w cubes of cut up papaya. I would ask for extra if I were you. It's that good. I was concerned that the jerk seasoning would be spicy, but w each bite of the sauce it was perfect. My waiter also said, if it ended up being spicy, he would make sure to make me a new one. He was really good and helpful. My dish came w coconut rice and red beans. It was a plate which I could not make at home so it proved to be an excellent choice. I washed it down with a "tanked"cocktail with tropical juices, mango rum, and bitters. Perfect.
We were celebrating my birthday weekend. Hubby let my waiter know about my birthday, and after we finished our entrees, my happy birthday dessert came with salted caramel ice cream and lava cake. Yes that was perfect too.
Afterwards... ahh, we had a great dinner and great service, we had to kill time at the restaurant. With the pouring rain, it was fine, we checked out the cave. You don't have to eat at the restaurant to see the fishes. Just go through the cave. There are so many picture opportunities. Everything is bright and pretty. The sting ray is smiling from the ceiling. I guess he likes the edges. The nurse shark is small.  It looks like it's like a stuffed animal because of its shape. Check out the irridescent colorful fish and the see through school of fish family. All the descriptions of the fish are there. You will not have to guess.
Before you leave, you can see if there's a band in the bar, or watch some sports on the flat screen tv. Lastly, shop for some Guy Harvey apparel, or make an appointment to swim in the tank.
This is a great place for a nice occasion, or just a night out. Children are welcome and will love the fish tank. You don't need to sit to close, with sitting a bit further you can better see the top of the tank. I am happy to have finally checked out Rum Fish Grill. Food is tasty, service was great, and fish tank, and Guy Harvey art was vibrant and fun.
Wonderful fresh flavors!  Best Brunch in Philly hands down - don't be afraid to try the specials - I have yet to try something here that I have not liked.

I was a little skeptical at first. There have been to a few bakeries in Indy over the last couple of years that had great decor but mediocre desserts. I am happy to say that The Cake Bake Shop is different. I tried the millionaire cake and a brownie and they were both delicious. Thank you for being an authentic bakery!
Really beautiful hotel. My husband and I celebrated our 1 year anniversary at this hotel. And to our delight we were upgraded into the pent house.... such a wonderful experience.

Poke Bowl is great. It's small and there's no normal seating...just bar stools and a small counter. But the poke is top quality and personally crafted like a Subway sandwich shop line. You can mix and match items in each of the categories and create your own perfect combination. The staff was nice and the place was super clean. Be careful about extra ingredients though. I asked if I could add a little of this and a little of that and my poke maker was happy to oblige but I later learned that I was upcharged for all of those extras without being told.

I had heard Iris can pour you up any number of specialty cocktails, so I was disappointed the bar did not have the ingredients for my drink of choice, the bourbon cobbler. The mixologist had a little something special up her sleeve though and poured a creative, yummy apricot bourbon substitute beverage. All in the group of seven were pleased with their cocktail selection, with the exception of the dry martini. The food, however, was a bit a let-down. 

As what I'm learning is an unfortunate theme in this town, it was a bit expensive for the quality of the meal. My eggplant lasagna was warm at best with very little flavor to it. Fortunately (or unforuntunately, depending on how you see it) I had gorged on the cheese plate(s) and was already too full to have more than a few bites. My fellow diners agreed their meals were okay but not would probably not come back and order again. 

Conclusion: I would come back for the charming ambience and creative cocktails, but not stay for dinner.
Just a great music venue. We hung out in the back with a beer and had a blast. Music all over New Orleans, but thanks to this venue we catch the band when the tour in New York.

Wonderful restaurant! My husband's pumpkin ravioli was perfect, not too sweet, the ravioli cooked exactly right. My lamb shank was falling off the bone delicious. Our waiter was informative and attentive, and easy to hear and understand in a small crowded restaurant. We enjoyed every bite! New to Philly, we appreciated the confirmation call when they reminded us that the restaurant was byob. If I'm ever in Philly again and would definitely go back to Kanellas.

Reeds American Table is to die for. I've been several times now since it's opened and had most items on the menu and everything has been wonderful. For the quality of food and price point, Reeds is probably one of the best restaurants in St. Louis. Try the beef and the pork belly (YUM!).

Check in was seamless, and the french butler, arrived promptly to take us to our cottage. As you enter the courtyard, you are met with many plants, flowers, and an awesome saltwater pool and the silence is amazing considering the location. You then go into your private courtyard and enter your cottage, which was spotless.  Breakfast had numerous offerings, so you will not leave hungry. Can not be beat.

Definitely a decent taco place. I got the fish taco plate for $8 which includes 3 fish/shrimp tacos (I substituted 1 chicken), a 16 oz drink which includes their horchata or fresh pineapple/mango smoothie, and rice and beans. The corn tortillas are definitely the best part of the meal. They're thick and soft and so yummy. The fish tacos are pretty good but the chicken was a little bland. Beans and rice..  eh. 

Overall, the tacos are pretty good, not sure if I'll be coming back with so many other choices. It's about $1.50/$1.60 a taco. 

There're more tables inside than it would seem and also some picnic tables outside but don't sit out there! Between loud noises of the tire shop and the mosquito that was biting me, I wish I had been inside with the a/c.

Food is great! I was impressed with the many healthy options,I had a hard time choosing what to pick!

Only thing, customer service was a little off, waiters did not seem very connected with customers, which was strange to me since they just opened. 

Bottom line, I recommend.
The service here was friendly and fast. The mini Cuban was delicious!!! I highly recommend trying this out for starters if you've never had Cuban before.

This CVS is conveniently located and pretty clean. There are times I'll have to go to another CVS since this one won't carry an item or has limited stock. The staff is helpful, but sometimes they go missing at the register and I have to hunt them down. Prices, even for a drug store, are usually on the high side

Very busy, popular and loud.  Place is a little dingy for the prices. Not much atmosphere. $5 beers, main dishes $ 16-26.  Food was just OK. We ordered 5-6 plates of food and there was nothing I had I would want again. $16.50 "Fried chicken" ended up being a bunch of thin chicken fingers hot spicy sauce. Not good especially for the prices.  Could have gone to Mickey D's for same.  Hate that they tack on the tip for you and put a spot for an additional tip.  Not impressed. Wouldn't be missing out if didn't come back. Much rather eat at Lee how fuk around corner. Have been to much better around Chinatown. Disappointing.

Excellent steaks! I had the ribeye with the gorgonzola crust. One of the best steaks I've had in years. Garlic mashed potatoes were delicious as well. Get there early - the placed packed out. Well worth it.
They only take CASH...NO debit cards. Bummer! Needless to sau, had to turn right around and leave. Next time I will have cash

Great workout great employees! Was here for work and dropped into a class they were extremely welcoming and explained the entire class to be prior as it was my first time participating in a Barry's class! Got a great sweat in and made sure to grab a delicious shake on my way out!

Love this location on 104th Street, their customer service is fantastic.  I purchased a rack from them back in June of 2015, which they help me install. Then when a part broke on the rack, last year, they quickly order it so I could have a working rack with little delay. Today, I called the store and Dustin was there to quickly help take care of another matter that came up with damage to my rack, from a theft of my bike. Thank you Racks For Cars!!! I shall be a loyal customer for a long time to come!

Unprofessional with no follow up.  I originally called EBS to fix a leak in my roof and the first visit was very professional and I paid for the service.  After the next rain the roof still leaked and they came again and the problem was still there.  They then missed the next appointment and had none of the measurements from the first appointment when I talked to them on the phone. The repairman called me from a friends cell phone because his was dead.  I have paid but still have a roof leak.

Bravo sits in a fun area of Wayne--right off Lancaster Ave, which can be pretty busy at the dinnertime hour, on a slightyl less busy street. Parking is still something to consider before 6:00 when you have to feed the meter, but all in all, it's still a good experience.

The pizza is good. It's a little on the greasy side, but overall, good cheese, good sauce, good toppings, good crust. Good stuff, not excellent. The restaurant itself is very well maintained.

Gavin DJed our wedding at the Riviera Mansion and I cannot express enough what a great job he did. He has a portion of his website where you can select songs and give him a good sense of the music you would like played. Gavin flawlessly chose music that fit the event throughout cocktail hour, dinner, and dancing. Our dance floor was packed the entire night and many of our guests commented on how great the music was. Gavin was also flexible to some last minute suggestions and changes. We could not recommend him highly enough. Thank you!

I know diddly about wine but the boyfriend and I decided to make a visit before flying back home since it was near our airbnb. We happened to come during happy hour and it was only $5 a glass! I will definitely return next time I'm in town on a Saturday night so I can experience the lights and music, the whole backyard party atmosphere.

Lots to do at the Hard Rock. Both the Lounge and Cafe are great. I enjoy stopping on the casino floor watching the action. Also there is a large variety of food available at the buffet, make sure you check it out for the weekly special.

Customer service was warm, chirpy & noticeably inauthentic. Be prepared for them to try to upsell you from every which way. I had purchased my insurance through Kayak and when I was going through the finalization one of the managers gave me the whole "our insurance is better because..." but when I declined to add an additional $15 a day for their insurance she kept pressing & making me feel more pressured to say yes. I eventually gave in for "peace of mind" but this drove my rental up from $170 to $276 when all was said and done. Also, definitely take pictures of your car from every angle before you pull it away! When I returned the car she tried to hit me with some unaligned fender that was already there (thanks to the proof of my photos). She also tried to get us to buy into their "discounted" gas and when we declined this, she did the whole pressing thing again & challenged us to find cheaper gas. (We did- across the bridge at Cherry Hill...) Great sales people for sure, but I felt really annoyed by the whole experience.

Amazing service! We used Allyson Krebs as our RE agent to sell our home in Nashville.  It was an investment property and we had moved to MT.   There's so much to do in getting a house ready for sale... and being remote owners, we were a little anxious about how we could coordinate all of the repairs, cleaning, etc. that was required just to be show-ready.

Allyson went above and beyond our expectations in handling the details and ensuring the property was ready to show with a compressed timeline.    House sold within days, well above asking price.  Couldn't have asked for a better experience!

I was visiting from out of town and excited to try Herbies. It was such a sad state of affairs. As a former St. Louisian, I am very interested in making sure businesses are thriving. This restaurant is doomed. The waiter was nice but everything took a ridiculously long time to receive. My friend ordered a French Onion Soup and it came in a coffee cup sized portion and apparently was bland. My other friend and I got salads that were unmentionably average. Then it took literally over 30 min to receive our entrees. My first friend ordered the veal chop and it was actually good. My other friend ordered the salmon and it was ok and appropriately prepared. I ordered the roasted chicken after bragging to the waiter that I am a roasted chicken connoisseur and he highly recommended their roasted chicken. I am not exaggerating when I tell you it was smaller than my fist (I am a petite woman). The drum stick portion was smaller than my pinky finger. It was actually very cute but ridiculous for $28. It was over cooked, dry and basically I got about 3 bites of actual chicken. We had to complain because I thought it was a joke. The waiter explained that these chickens are 28 days old when they are cooked. So they are basically baby chickens. If they gave two in a portion I could have understood the cost. When we complained, they offered another one to eat. It took at least 15 more minutes to receive this one and the waiter offered to wrap it up because it was obvious we were ready to get the heck out of there. We talked to the manager and he had no interest in our story. I'm mostly just sad that this restaurant was so bad and will likely not survive.

This is my favorite place to get sushi in Reno! It is reasonably priced especially considering the quality. Be warned that they love their hot sauce here so if you aren't really into spice, order without.

The staff is friendly and attentive to your needs, and the chefs are nice and always greet you. The Jalapeno appetizer is the best especially when they are not too spicy. This is the place that I bring people when I want to show them the best all you can eat.
Visiting for work and came to try the black spaghetti,  amazing,  order it,  trust me it was delicious.  I will be back next time in in town.

Taste of Havana is basically a food truck in a small store front in Broad Ripple. There are 2 tables for those lucky enough to get one. There's also a bar with a few stools, but I have a feeling that most folks grab their food and go. And that's a bad decision on their part. If you don't stick around and visit with the owner, Jorge, then you miss out on a big part of the Taste of Havana experience. He'll tell you that the best Cuban food is in Miami and Broad Ripple. And that there isn't a decent Cuban restaurant in New York City. He should know. He lived there for 3 years. If you stick around long enough, he'll also pour you a shot of Cuban coffee which he claims is far superior to Italian coffee because they always burn it. Anyways on to the food. I had a regular Cuban sandwich. Excellent bread, ham and cheese. The pork was good too but I think I would've preferred just a little more spice in it. The pickles and mustard round out a perfect sandwich experience. I would highly recommend Taste of Havana. Go for the food. Stay for the atmosphere.

Nice location. Good service. Okay food. Good deal for a nice place-- $28 for 3 small plates and a glass of wine. I appreciated the ability to try several things-- but the food could have been better. I felt like everything was a little too salty-- but it was imaginative and beautifully plated. No regrets. I had the brown butter spaetzle and broiled oysters. My favorite thing was the City Park salad with romaine and baby red oak leaves and little pieces of apple and bacon and stilton. The BBQ shrimp looked great. The husband had chicken livers, turtle soup and citrus lacquered pork belly. His fav small plate was the chicken livers. He said they were top notch.

Having purchased our home "used" and living here 3 years, we have encountered numerous problems (roof leaking, plumbing issues, water heater dying, etc) so we decided to do an inspection before other issues could arise.  Our search for an inspector began with suggestions from neighbors and many suggested Waypoint. After reviewing their background with the BBB, (which was an A+ rating) I contacted them for a basic 4 point inspection. Wilmer was the gentleman who came out and he was amazing (and very personable)!  Not only did he complete the inspection, but he offered very helpful hints that would be beneficial for lower insurance rates and help preserve the longevity of home.  We would highly recommend this company (and Wilmer) for either a basic inspection or if you are moving to a new home.

Recommended as a great local place to get Mexican food and a new startup that needed support.  We were not disappointed.  The tacos were excellent and reminded me of tacos I've eaten in Austin, TX (the highest praise possible for tacos!).  Very reasonably priced with high quality ingredients.  Obviously appreciated by locals, which is my favorite way to find places to eat.

Great customer service. Awesome fried pork chop, it's a must order item in the menu. Food is served quickly and has a mix menu from Indonesian to taiwanese to chinese. A must recommended restaurant to eat at.

Hands down, the best tri tip sandwich you will ever have!! i have been coming here for many years with some of the best camping in southern cali nearby.  the vibe is amazing especially over the weekends when people get together listening to a dude hitting a empty jack daniels box as a drum.  great day drive from LA !!

I took a friend to this Korean spot because she was curious about Korean food.  Bimbimbop was inedible, fried chicken with panko was not a real chicken filet, but akin to chicken McNuggets, or mystery meat.  The wings were just OK.  This was an awful meal, and I think my friend will likely skip the Korean food for a long time to come.
This pizza is great! Moved to the Main Line from Chicago and this has been my favorite pizza so far. Flavorful with a delicious crust, good service and friendly staff.

My sister and I have visited Tarpon Springs three times (once a year), and Hella's is always our destination for lunch.  The service is spot-on, and the food is great.

I have had their gyro, which is tender and succulent and full of good flavor.  I also have had their cod, and it was a pleasant surprise - I never knew that cod was that good.  My sister has also had many of their dishes and really liked them.

One hint, get there early - otherwise you will have to wait for a table.

Highly recommended.
Best Chinese in the area! Quality delicious food, speedy service and friendly people work the counter. I've been getting my Chinese from here for years and have never been disappointed!

This place is awesome!   I stopped by for the open house and loved the decor and employees...especially the owner karen.  The hot stone massage is amazing.  It's hard to find someone that can give a good hot stone massage!!!!  I rebooked for next month :-)

I have ordered different arrangements from this location of Edible Arrangements over the years, starting first with a delivery to a lawyer who stated it was the most beautiful thing he had ever seen get delivered. He was really impressed by the fruit bouquet. Have sent one to my mother, picked one up for my dad at Christmas time and NOW, I want somebody to order one for me! I will take an edible arrangement ANY DAY over a flower bouquet. Delicicious fruit, delicious choices- no better way to make somebody's day no matter what the occasion.

I had lunch at this small and very simple restaurant. Lunch specials are under $8 and include a small bowl of soup, an egg roll, rice and your dish. I had the curry beef that was just OK, the beef itself was spicy with curry flavor but the bell peppers were barely cooked. The portions are good and considering the price it's a great value.
The food wasn't hot, we ordered the "El Jefe" Nachos, both the shredded chicken and beef weren't hot, and the meat was dry....
Great flavors, wonderful taste and consistency.  Staff is terrific. You can't do better.

This place is a must for dessert everytime I am dining on Grand!

Literally, we start with dinner, walk up for gelato and an Espresso Cubano to set us up for the remainder of the evening, where we will no doubt be sipping naughty martinis at Absolutli Goosed!  

The staff is always very nice and give too much gelato :-)  Very comfortable seating and ambiance!

They have a very broad range of gelato flavors...my faves so far have been the London Fog, Chai, Blueberry and Pistachio.  Really can't go wrong, they do all of the flavors well!

The last three times I've gone herr my steak has been over cooked by two grades and the wait staff were mediocre at best.  We called ahead for seating and arrived 5 minutes early for our time, we then had to wait 25 extra minutes for them to put our party of 6 in at a 4 top with chairs on the end.  It was extremely uncomfortable.   I will not be returning.

The food here is great! I had the meatloaf, my hubby had the medium wings which were really hot so he would go mild next time which is not the norm, but the homemade blue cheese was so fantastic! My son had a French dip with fries which was good too. Service was great it's not busy and very casual. I love it here!

So glad Urban Village took our reservation for 10 people for Father's Day lunch! It was the perfect place for a big group with different tastes. Some of our favorites included the Wildey Wheat, black IPA, rye IPA, Kelly pizza, village salad, and shaved salad.

Special shout out to our wonderful server Erica, especially for carrying over countless 4 oz testers (we loved this option to be able to try several beers each). We'll definitely be back!

They're good enough but their prices sometimes make me cringe. They're good.... but not that good. They have one delivery guy who never fails to deliver pizzas that it looks like he plays Frisbee with them on his way from there to my house. It's definitely better than more than half the places in the area and we've never had anything that was less than delicious... Even if it came to us looking like it made it through a war on the way here.
I like eating there because it's cute but not fancy.
 Phone girls are nice too.

I've eaten here several times but today was pretty great. Corey my sever was exceptional, he was very attentive and quite knowledgeable in regards to the menu. I had the coffee cured filet with burgundy mushrooms and potatoes all was wonderful. I can't speak for the entire staff but my sever was the best.

The best sandwich in the Reno/Sparks area! I've been eating there for at least 15 years and it's always the same, KILLER! Michelle and the other staff are THE BOMBDIGITTY and you'll be hard pressed to find better, more friendly and relaxed staff. The pricess are a little higher than some other sandwich shops but they are worth every penny. My favorite sandwich is the yellow sub with sprouts, but I also love their wraps and soups. I can't imagine anyone not loving this place.
Great service.  Very friendly and they do a nice job with our clothes.  We've only had a couple of issues over several years and they have been very willing to compensate us.

I can customize my rolls?!? YAY! I'm pregnant and the waitress was so nice and patient with going over all of the cook rolls.  In addition to their available cooked rolls, I added whatever I wanted in them- mango, avocado, sauce, tamago egg... I called the shots.  

I love that their ceiling is really high and that their location is in a not so busy area. I will definitely be coming back for more after I give birth to try out their raw fish.

This is the biggest joke of a club of all time. I have been a member of Anytime Fitness for over 5 years and have visited almost every Anytime Fitness in central Indiana. I can say without a doubt, this is the worst club in central Indiana.

The owner/manager is one of the most backwards individuals when it comes to running and operating a gym I have ever experienced. Not only does he offer nothing when it comes to sales or promoting his club, but when it comes to running his club, he has no clue what he is doing. The first thing you should feel when entering a club to work out, whether it is your home gym or not, is a welcoming attitude. This man has none of that. No hello, no greeting of any kind of just stares at his computer or when he is out on the floor, looks for things to yell at people about. I am not necessarily expecting a hello when I enter the gym, but at least don't make people feel uncomfortable and just stare awkwardly at people when they are lifting. It creeps me out to no end.

And that isn't even my biggest concern when it comes to this man. I have been lifting for over 15 years and would consider myself knowledgeable about how a gym runs and gym etiquette. I was in this gym a couple of weeks ago and was deadlifting fairly heavy weight, so there was the usual setting down of the weights between reps that caused a little bit of noise. I totally get you cannot slam weights down, but I was being as controlled as I could be given the weight. The owner was sitting training someone at the leg press machine next to where I was deadlifting. Instead of coming over and asking me to be gentler or to try and control the weight better, he sat there and gave me dirty glances while shaking his head disapprovingly. I would have been totally fine with him asking me to watch my weight and control the weight better. But that is not what this coward did.

Instead, he called my home club in Plainfield, IN and complained to the manager at the Plainfield club about me. He told the Plainfield manager that he hated me and did not like how I was treating the weights when I deadlifted. He also proceeded to tell the Plainfield manager that he did not approve of my attire, which was a cut off shirt and shorts, what I have worn to every club I have ever been to with zero problem. He informed my home club's manager that my shirt quote "exposed my nipples and this was not appropriate". All the while, there were at least 3 other men in the gym who had the exact same attire as I did on that day.

Needless to say, my home club manager just laughed at these ridiculous claims. He knows how I lift, knows the way I respect the weights every time I am in the gym and also knows the way I dress, which is acceptable at any and every club but Carmel. I don't know what else to say besides this is the biggest farce ever that calls itself an Anytime Fitness. I am not even advocating not joining Anytime Fitness, as I think it is a wonderful gym to be a member at. I am just telling people not to become members at this location, or to even go there in general. I wish sending this complaint would do something about the issue, but it obviously won't affect much. I just want to let everyone know about the ridiculous nature of this manager/owner and to try to prevent people from joining this club. I would hate to see anyone get treated like I did, and I have been to this club multiple times without any issue. It has just been recently this guy has some kind of bone to pick with me or something. And he won't do it directly to me, so the next time I go into that club, I will be sure to let him know what I think about his comments and let him know I will never be frequenting his club again.

Cosi made a really DUMB move this week. I went in for my usual Orange-cranberry squagel bundled with a grande coffe. First I noticed that there were no orange cranberry ones and only 12 bagels in total (at 8AM!). So I chose a cinamon Raisin. Then I went to register and asked them to bundle with a coffee. I was tokd they were "cutting back bagels and promoting flatbread sandwiches) and they no longer bundle with coffee. SO I said I wasn't happy but to give me the coffee anyway. The price was 45% (!) more than last week! Then I looked at menu board and saw that the 1/2 salad and 1/2 sandwich combo (a healthy alternative) was not there. "We don't do that any more I was told". I WAS told that this new "menu" is only at 15th & Locust, 12th and Walnut and 4th & Chestnus (MY usual location) but I could walk to 9th and Chestnut or 18th and Walnut and get the "old menu". No staff person explained the reason and I saw lots of other customers who were surprised and not happy and said they wouldn't be back. REALLY dumb corporate decision, which I hope will change soon before they lose MANY more long time customers at these three locations.\\

This place is fantastic. I was apprehensive (as I often am walking into bike shops) when I walked in, but quickly realized that this place was different. There were some hard core road bikers in the back talking in their own language, a few weekend warriors getting their bikes worked on and getting gear, and me: an aspiring cyclist intimidated by the prices, lingo, and other details of taking up this pastime.  I normally cringe when I walk into bike stores and feel that if I don't drop 4 grand quickly on a carbon fiber bike or show them the yellow jersey I wore when leading three stages of the Tour de France, that I'll quickly be shown the exit (or a brusque cold shoulder).

At this place, a guy came up and asked what I was looking for and how he could help. I explained my situation: I have a road bike, I want to start using it as my primary means of transportation and for recreation, and I want to get the rest of the equipment that I need. He quickly explained what equipment is NEEDED versus what equipment is NICE TO HAVE. We went through helmets, floor pumps, bike shorts, bike shoes, flat kits, etc. I already have shoes and pedals as well as some tire repair kits. When I told him that, he quickly moved on - never pressuring me to upgrade or to change anything. We talked tire options (tube liners/extra-thick tires/tube sealant), tune up needs, maintenance suggestions, etc.

In the end, I only bought a helmet because I had all of the gear in the NEED category already. As I get going, I'll add the NICE TO HAVE stuff as I see fit. And I'll buy it from Reno Cycling & Fitness because they know how to treat customers. So it is amazing, for a fairly minor purchase, this guy invested nearly half an hour talking to me - never talking down to me. He understood my needs, listened when i talked and helped me immensely.

In a world of diminishing customer service, this place stands out. The depth of knowledge available will not be found in a big box store or at an online discounter. Keep honest, hardworking local companies in business and help yourself in the process.
I did not enjoy my food here. The fish was fried so hard I couldn't eat it. My rice taste like some boil n the bag rice. I was not impressed at all.

The pho is EXCELLENT and so is the service...but it's not the tidiest place in town.  The walls are pretty dirty, which is surprising for a newish place, and the floors are often not clean.  Regardless, it's still my go to pho spot.

Cafe deluxe was awesome. This used to be a laundromat back in the day, and now they've established a quirky little breakfast spot. We got some kind of breakfast scramble with meats and various other veggie ingredients. We ordered some flour tortillas on the side which were huge. 

The egg scrambles were huge portions, so after we got our fill, I made us two huge burritos to go. 

Cool place, nice people, and great coffee.

I recently stayed at The Saint with my sister for a few nights and loved it.  The minute we walked in we knew we'd loved it because of the amazing decor and the amazing hospitality. Right from the first time we walked in, we felt so welcome with the doorman and the front desk girls. SUPER!!! FRIENDLY!!! 

The hotel lobby and entrance all looked cool with great paintings and decor.  Just like their other locations, they have these oversized chairs that are great for taking fun pictures so before we even went up to see our room we already took a ton of cool pictures.  The chairs make you feel so miniature.

The hotel also has a really nice bar in the lobby.  It's decorated with lots of red chandeliers hanging over the bar and they serve some really great drinks.  If you're ever there, you need to make sure you go for there happy hours drinks (WAY cheaper).  At night the bar does get pretty busy and every night they have a live band so it was nice to sit and listen to them but it does get a little loud.

When we finally decided to go up to our room, we entered the elevator and we were so surprised and thought it was funny that they have a television that is always playing Classic Jazz (how cool is that?).  When the elevator doors open, the entire hallway was all dark with  blue lights; at first it reminded me of the movie The Shinning LOL

Our room was really roomy and nice.  At first I didn't like that our room was at the back of the building where you have no view (just looking at another building right there) but later i was happy to be in the back because when you get the rooms along Canal Street it is really loud with all the traffic and street action; the view wasn't worth it so we kept our back room.  But I will say I was so happy that the hotel was willing to change us if we wanted.

The location was so good; really close to everything we needed like best spot to get the trolleys, on the edge of the French Quarter, nearby so much more.
Nic at AAA was great working with us. He found the best deal for our trip.  Our last 3 trips was through AAA and never have they failed us.
The Habit has hands down my favorite Onion rings ever! they are cooked perfectly and they pair perfectly with the ranch sauce. My hamburger was good but i was fixated on my onion rings.

I come in to this store solely to (HYGIENICALLY) mess around with products, which I will then proceed to buy online via sephora.com. I honestly do not trust buying some products here- as many reviewers have said, the displays are filthy. I have personally witnessed the staff using dirty brushes to apply makeup on another customer's face. Any amateur makeup artist knows that this is a prime way to potentially spread germs and bacteria. Keeping costs low is an important factor of running a business, but that should not extend to such practices. Some of the staff are very friendly and lovely. Others will purposefully avoid your gaze and fumble with bottle caps rather than answer friendly questions about skincare.
Ugh. Just, ugh.

They are awesome! Great team of Physical therapists: professional, friendly, being going for  two months now due to the injuries caused by a car accident. I can't tell which therapist is better, because they are all simply AMAZING!

We ordered take out: Sesame Chicken, Lemon Chicken, and Chicken Chow Mein (yes, we love us some chicken!). I was definitely in the mood for some delightfully-bad-for-you-hole-in-the-wall food, and this far exceeded my expectations. 

First: the portions are ENORMOUS. Seriously. I've eaten Chinese take out in several different states, and this was striking. They packed in as many chow mein noodles as the little white box could handle. Complete with enough meat to last me 4 meals (and my boyfriend, 2 meals). 

Second: mouth watering glorious explosions in my mouth. The Sesame chicken was so crispy and sweet I was in Chinese food heaven. The Chow Mein noodles were thick and flavored well, and definitely left me wanting more. My boyfriend enjoyed his Lemon chicken, but I didn't actually try it myself. 

Third: amazing price for what you get. DO IT.

It was perfect for a take out movie night in. If I lived in Reno, this would be my go to.

The restaurant is in the casino which is understandable but some more signage outside would help. The place looks a bit gaudy and outdated but nice and clean. 

We had good service with drinks and appetizers. However, we got there at 7pm and it was 8:11pm and we still hadn't been served out entrees. Tables behind and in front of us were served and those people came after us. We asked for the manager and told him to charge us for our drinks and apps so we could leave. He then told us that or entrees were ready and he would only charge us half price. It was another 10 minutes and then a different server brought them out and we just told him to pack them up to go. The manager came back with the entrees packed in a bag and said they were on the house. He then informed us that because my husband ordered a bone-in chicken dish, it takes 26 minutes to make the meal. That is still the longest 26 minutes I have ever experienced. 

I don't believe the ambience or the food is worth the price.

One of my favorite spots for morning coffee. The device here is excellent. Such a cute place to sit back and relax. I've had several of their hot and cold beverages and my favorite is the white chocolate mocha on ice. Delicious!!!  This business will be seeing a lot of me.

My husband and I were visiting Philly from LA for a conference. We grabbed a chicken club and curry tofu wrap for the airplane ride. Even though we ate it a couple hours later, the flavors were still on point! I'd love to check out Hip City Veg again in a situation when I had more time.

Beautiful, classy and very old school Italiano decor.

Service is prompt, music is great (i.e. Sinatra, Dean Martin) and food was delicious!

As a bedrock of the Safety Harbor community it is terrible that this Cosby is tearing down more than 20 legacy "live oaks" in order to pave in a parking lot. Those trees are a vital part of the personality of Safety Harbor and since Choice Hotels purchased them they have proved they do not understand how important community support is for t
Fun little place. Great burgers and the basket of fries is enough for the whole family. They also have great deals during happy hour but haven't been in yet for that yet.

nice place for gatherings and hanging out. Friendly staff. 

Food was OK. Not bad, not good, it just sat somewhere in the middle.

Don't let the amount of reviews turn you away!  This place is a gem! Went there after looking for kitchen lighting at Ikea on a whem. I had the papusas (pork), horse steak (not horse meat) which came with tostones and rice and beans, and complimentary empanada (beef), the homemade nachos with a spicy dip that they serve to everyone, and complementary flan. The papusa was a warm tortilla like an arepa but flat and filed with your choice of fillings  (cheese, pork and I forgot the other) it was a good. Next the beef empanada had a soft outside (not like others I've had with a crispy outside) and wonderfully seasoned beef inside.  The entree came next I will tell you I was already full. The steak was nothing to scream about but it was good in its sauce with peppers and onions, rice (yellow rice, they do have white)and beans(black or red ) and the tostones. The tostones cane with this white sauce I've never had usually use to having them with a garlic and oil sauce,  this dip was excellent and even better in the steak.  The tostones cooked perfectly crispy edges and soft inside ( I ate all of them)! Then the smiling chef behind the counter said how about dessert? My response no way! He responds I have something special for you!  Our comes the vanilla flan! I kid you not this was the best flan I've had! Creamy, with just the right about of sweet caramel along the top and bottom. It was sinful! You want to give this spot a try! Great customer service! The smile on the head chef is amazing! They were all so personable. Clean,  great hot food made to order, everything came out piping HOT! Budget friendly and you'll have enough for lunch the next day!

Great tour! I would recommend doing the tour as soon as you get to the city. David was a great guide who also spoke a lot about the history of the city and it's food. We tasted food at 4 places and it filled us up pretty good. Glad we chose this tour!

I really like their vegetable korma.
Apparently, they offer delivery close by, but you need a 35 dollar minimum.

Im kind of glad that Im not the only one not singing Posto's praises.  While there wasnt anything horribly wrong with my lunch there, it really was a laclkluster experience for the pricetag. The service was minimal and I got the impression that I wasnt cool enough or European enough to be there. The salad and sandwich was tasty enough, but just not great. I was so excited reading the sammie descriptions, but then the actual product just kind of fell flat.  If you want a real sandwich served with a smile, go to st james!

I should have read the reviews here before wasting my time. After spending nearly a half hour on the phone with the sales representative (Yvette), I was told I would have my estimate later that same afternoon. Three days later when the estimate finally came through, it was incorrect and incomplete. I called her to check that she understood what I wanted in my order and to make sure we were on the same page. She assured me we were and that the updated estimate would be sent out in a few hours. 

Fast forward THREE WEEKS and I still have nothing. 

I reached out asking when I could expect to hear from her. Nothing. 

I reached out again asking that she prioritize my order and shift it to another representative if she is too busy to handle it. Nothing.

I called and asked for a supervisor, but one wasn't available. The representative who helped me  ended up acting as a mediator between Yvette and me, and she ultimately said that the estimate sent to me was for what I asked for, and that if there wasn't another estimate it was because I never ordered anything else. 

What a huge waste of time. Thank god I dodged the bullet of actually going through with an order and then finding out how unreliable and unprofessional these people are.

Have enjoyed this creamery for years!  Always amazed at the variety available and speed of receiving my order - which is aways perfect!  First visited in 1961 when I was a boarder at a high school in the county and the locals wanted to proudly show off their town.  Getting to Ted Drewes was never a chore because someone was alway looking for a weekend treat.   Now that we have grandchildren in the area and we gave recently moved back to St Louis, one of the first places we choose to take our visitors is Ted Drewes!  Thanks for continuing your legacy of excellent taste and service.

The public areas of the hotel are beautiful. The light shows in the lobby in the evenings (every hour on the hour starting at five) are really cool. Definitely worth taking time to see. We stayed in a Junior King Suite in the newer wing of the hotel. The rooms are nicely appointed, but nothing spectacular. One note about the King Junior Suite - the sleeping area and living area are separated by a wall, but not by a door. If you're thinking that you can put the kids on the sofa bed and have privacy in the bedroom, that is not happening. We used the valet and they were great every time, except for one where the guy forgot to call for our car. The pool was very cold when we were there in June, but does have floaters and pool toys, which is a nice touch for the kids.

Lilly's Café doesn't need my four star review because the place is always packed with happy and satisfied customers.  Best part of Lilly's Café is the always fresh ingredients used in the meal.  Great atmosphere and great quality food.  Nice change of pace from your typical Asian culinary fair.
In this Mexican food heaven on earth why would anyone eat here is beyond my comprehension.

This park is a hidden gem. Didnt even know that it exists because it is located behind the wall. This is where you can see a panoramic view of New Orleans CBD. It's amazing. I'm sure when the weather warms up a bit, it is going to be beautiful with flowers and all that!

We love this place! From the open air setup and outdoor seating to the deliciously unique rolls and friendly wait staff... this is my friends and I's South Philly go-to. Though they're busy we can always get a good table on a Friday night.

The special roll is always a hit and my personal favorite is the Remy roll. The vegetarian/ vegan sushi is also amazing! If that's your thing... ask them to make you an avocado and sweet potato roll with benito flakes. 

What's really special though is their seaweed salad. This is no average run of the mill seaweek, and nothing like the typical you get at sushi joints. Their seaweed is FRESH and served in mellow vinegar and lemon. Absolutely delicious! Even my apprehensive friend was Wowed and loved it. The only reason why we didn't give Izumi 5 stars is we figured there are even more insane sushi spots we have yet to try... but for now, this is our favorite =)

Loved this place and Bywater. interesting music, neat food and wine choices. Seating is a huge pain in the ass. Not enough room and it is that fighting over a seat thing I hate. No idea how they fix that, I guess you have to show up at 5pm and wait.

I've been having a hard time finding a good brunch spot, until I found Jones.  Unfortunately for me, Jones is a 3 hour drive.   So I will not be frequenting it - but one can dream.

We sat upstairs, which I recommend - a little quieter & you can watch everyone below you.  We were there around 11:30 on a rainy Saturday, and were sat immediately.  Service was fine, and fast.  Decor is super cute.

I had the French toast with tater tots.  Tater tots, you ask?  Yes, because where I'm from, they are not quite ubiquitous.  My Philly friend (aka tour guide) also had the French toast, and my husband had the avocado sandwich with fries.   The French toast was thick and tasty, and probably the biggest piece of French toast I've ever seen.   I enjoyed the tater tots.  My husband liked his sandwich and fries, but the fries went cold fast.  

Perhaps a second location in DC or Boston is needed?
I've been going to this Wawa pretty much every week since they opened for business. Service is good enough and gas prices are competitive with the area.

I made a few visits a while back and found them to be over priced for the quality, but in need of a haircut i recently scheduled an appointment a week out. I received an email the evening prior to my appointment asking if i could change my time. I replied that I could accommodate it.

The day of the appointment, they called me ten minutes before my originally scheduled time, saying they were no longer able to take me at the time THEY had requested the night before, and that "they would see me in ten minutes!" Obviously, i was not planning to be there in ten minutes since i'd already changed my work around to oblige their request. 

Honestly inconsiderate and unprofessional service. Would recommend to no one.

Oxymoronic name to begin with and I asked do you serve sparkling water with your Espresso and the lady said sometimes, clearly I didn't go in that sometimes! The cheap ass Quality Inn had free Breakfast that had more choices than this 'Breakfast' place :)

Espresso? Meh!

If you walk outside and look to the left you may find the breakfast place you are looking for :)

Kudos to the nice looking spot but it gives some sort of a fake vibe! Doesn't jive with a coffee shop, oh well.

Love their instructors and facilities, but I am writing this because of their horrible customer service. Not only was I charged for 5 (5!!!) months when I signed up for a 3 month membership, but I was _not_ told about the fact that my membership would automatically continue, that I would be charged for another month if I did not cancel by a certain date, that I had to come in personally to cancel, and that even though I canceled in person, I was still billed for a 5th month because of the timing. I have now called twice and emailed asking to speak with a manager about my account with no response.

Okay, so I tried this place because a co-worker gave me a coupon for buy 1 get 1 free for AYCE sushi from the valpak booklet.  Since I hadn't yet heard of Sushi Minato, I immediately Yelped it and saw nothing but great reviews.   I personally keep a 1-5 star sushi restaurant rating in my notes on my phone and I always love adding a place I've never been to - so why not ?  With a heck of a deal I had nothing to lose! 

First off, if they serve apps with AYCE sushi I always start with the seaweed salad.  They gave a good 5 to 6 bite bowl that was the perfect amount.  It wasn't too sweet and was lightly dressed.  Other places can tend to make theirs super sugary, so this actually tasted and felt healthy.  We did order the wontons (3 pc), they weren't anything to rave about - stay clear from ordering these as they were extremely greasy.   

We arrived at the restaurant about 5:15 straight after work to get a good spot at the counter on a Friday night.  My date immediately ordered the Mountain roll to start - it was made very promptly and it was delish,   The avocado was super green and ripe - never brown.  Everyone sitting at the counter asked the sushi chef which roll that was and they ended up ordering the Mountain as well.  The crab salad topping was so light with very little mayo which is a big plus in my book.  Since the Mountain roll was really good, I had to go with the house Minato roll because I love rolls with lemon slices and it's usually a good idea to order the signature roll.  There wasn't an overwhelming amount of rice on any of the rolls and the pieces were just the right size.  All of the fish was super fresh and was never mushy or bland.  I can't remember the names of all the rolls we ate, but a few of them incorporated fresh herbs such as basil, cilantro, and/or basil sauce.  The two herbs I'm completely obsessed with lately - especially cilantro.  I had the sushi chef make me the Cinco roll without cream cheese.  It had lovely chunks of tuna on top mixed with cilantro, it was so fresh but a heaping roll which filled me up quickly, so after that I stuck with mostly nigiri and Donald Ducks.    

All in all we had a good experience.  The sushi chef was very friendly and smiley and good at what he does.  I couldn't say "mmmmm" enough while I was eating and I was very excited to find a good new sushi place in Reno.  Everything was made right away and we never had to wait long.  

I will definitely be going back!

I was assigned to room 303. There was a roach crawling on the pillow on the bed. After complaining, I was even room 313. Room 313 had an unbearable smell in it. Smelled like someone died in there. Frustrated, I returned to the front desk to request a refund. I had given up on my stay at Motel 6. The two guys working at the front desk, refused to refund my money, and didn't even offer an apology for the inconvenience. This was my first and very last time unofficially staying at Motel 6; I ended up leaving to stay at an actual hotel that exceeded my expectation (somewhere Motel 6 could NEVER amount too). I wouldn't recommend this inhumane place to Satan himself. COMPLETELY DISSATISFIED!

Our friends had their tickets shipped from Dallas to Reno for burning man. They have yet to arrive and are 48 hours late after an overnight shipping. To say that we've had our vacation ruined my FedEx is an understatement
It s cheap drinking and average bar food at best. The service is hit or miss but its still a great place to go to watch a sporting event. I normally stop in when getting my car serviced next door.
Great food, one of bet places to eat in apollo beach.  Gyro is amazing and they have gluten-free pitas too!

Chase is marvelous. The romantic ambiance is great for an intimate dinner date, and the food is pretty good too. The lighting is a bit dark, making it hard to read the manus

But the food was lovely. I had a great chicken parm. and their bread is great.

My only complaint is that the wait staff was a bit slow. We had to wait for a long time before our food came and it was a while before we were brought the check and refills on drinks.

Putting Boise's Cupcake Specialty Shops To The Test

Thanks, in large part, to the steady popularity of food-themed media, Americans are quick to become infatuated with the food fad of the day.

As we allow these trends to be fed to us, many cities across the nation will inevitably experience a surge in businesses capitalizing on whatever these food crushes happen to be. Rarely, however, do many of those eateries survive in the long-term, because after all, our appetites become satisfied. Yet appetites are insatiable, and the talking heads of television are happy to let us know what we should be eating next.

The passing fancy of cupcakes notwithstanding.

Every once in a while, a good eatery goes the distance. In Boise's case, there are three specialty shops that still boast cupcakes as the main attraction.

The mission: to predict which of these businesses will continue to be prosperous and which of them (if any) are on the road to self-destruction. As an overview, what I found is that two of the three shops should, in the very least, be able to remain popular among die-hard cupcake fans. But one of them... well, I'll be surprised if they're still open in the next 12 months.

The contenders were graded based on the cupcakes (taste, presentation, and texture), counter service, and store atmosphere.

Here are the results for this business: Sugar Rush Cupcakery

The hardest thing to deal with is getting there. Strangely enough, as high-traffic as Fairview Avenue is, Sugar Rush is easy to miss. It's situated in a strip mall that sits back off of the road a bit. Crossing over the road onto the driveway and into the parking lot from the east-bound lanes can a white-knuckle experience when dealing with rush hour. Consequently, no matter what the current traffic volume, I highly recommend coming in from the west-bound side if you can.

Once you're in, the seating area is wide and spacious, almost too spread-out (if that's even possible).

If nobody is at the counter when you walk in, someone will appear within seconds. Counter service is pleasant and unobtrusive. The employees are patient and willing to answer questions.

Part of the reason/need for their patience is that you'll find that the display cases are filled with very creative, fun-to-eat flavors, which might make it difficult to choose.

They use real butter in their butter cream frosting. And they are very proud of that fact.

A true buttercream frosting firms up when chilled yet no hard shell forms on the outside, the creaminess and sweetness should have a nice balance. Fortunately, this is the case here.

Their cake holds together well, and it has an even, moist texture.

Although this cupcakery wasn't able to dethrone what I experienced to be the best cupcakes in the nation, if you're looking for the best cupcakes in Boise, Sugar Rush has the recipe.

We visited this location a total of four times in a two month period while we were staying in the area. The food was good each time but the service was vastly different each time. The last time we almost left. This is something the restaurant needs to work on with their servers. If our last experience was our only experience, I would have only given a two star rating.

We went to this place a couple of times already, then one day we had a $25 off gift thing from resturants.com

Boy was that a big mistake, one of the owners (jamaican guy) was so rude and blunt about how he did not approve of it and how it would cost him money if he used it. We left without ordering after getting his diss about it. He began telling us how the other owners wanted it but not him. (great for us)

We came back hoping the same man would not be there (he was) and then one of the servers said they were closed. It was 9:30pm and they closed at 10pm. We just wanted a slice.

We shall never return again. The pizza is just dough with toppings you can get anywhere, so get the "Walnut St" stick out your butt. We went to NYPD pizza around the corner to get our slice.
Best ox-tails in the area..! Great ropa viejo, picadillo, bollitos, etc. Cafeteria style makes it more fun...!

Ted Peters is darn good, famous mostly because it's been around longer than most Florida transplants. Yes, smoked mullet isn't bad, having said that though it IS about the only way they are edible. And if anyone who owns a smokehouse knows, it's not exactly something you say an hour before dinner - hmmm I think I'm going to smoke me some mullet!! I digress, me personally I do prefer the smoked Salmon, or even one of their burgers as they are friggin awesome too. The potato salad is not my style, having said that though it is not bad at all for the style that it is. (I'm more a NY Publix potato salad guy even though I don't care for NY - figure that out!) The only reason I did not give it 5 stars is the old real estate adage "location location location!!!"
