My fiancé and I ordered a pepperoni pizza from Reginellis last night and it was just perfect! We will definitely be coming back to explore their menu a bit more but I can definitely say  their pizza is freaking delicious and their prices are great too.

I had very high hopes, but was not at all impressed.  We went for an early dinner and I was so looking forward to the chicken spedini appetizer.  I ordered it right away and could not wait to try it!  The presentation was extremely plain, but if it's delicious I can get over a marginal presentation.  The taste was also very bland.  The chicken was dry and just not at all what I expected.  

For dinner, we split a St. Louis Style Pizza and it was good.  

The service was slow and the place was almost empty.  I cannot imagine why the service was so slow.  The server was polite, but very inattentive and we had to ask for more water, drinks, etc.        

I doubt that I will be back any time soon.
Had to comment because I was amazed at the furnishings and cleanliness of the bathroom.  Oh, and the food and service was spot on.

Walked in and the 3 employees at the door looked away to avoid seating us. Finally a young woman took us to our table and said she would bring us some water while we looked over the menu . She never came back .15 or so later our server came she was very nice and was apologetic . Food took long to come out . Tri tip torta was dry and hard to chew . Bland . Kids loved the Mac and cheese . I didn't like the overall experience and won't be coming back again .

Wow! What can I say. I know this place is under new ownership but it is absolutely worse than it was under previous owners. It took 30 minutes to get a drink and over an hour just to get the waiter to take our order. We had a party of 4. 3 ordered the burger special. One ordered shrimp and grits which after 30 minutes they informed us that they couldn't do shrimp and grits because they were out of polenta. When we finally got our order it was not correct and the waiter argued with us about what we ordered. I have given this place 4 chances but will not be back. This is one of the worst dining experiences I have ever had. Too bad I can't give 0 stars!
Mr. B's is fantastic...BBQ shrimp and gumbo are the best. Service was great...loved the atmosphere

I have liked Keva juice for years, but this Keva juice takes it to a whole new level. Every time I have visited the staff is friendly, tentative and full of helpful tips. I have visited on different days, at different times, and they are always fantastic. 

Everyone of the employees has helped me find substitute ingredients to whatever shake I am craving. Since I'm allergic to a large amounts of fruits, vegetable and other aspects of life, this is AMAZING! They took the time to do such things as washing the spoons, and making sure as little as possible cross contamination occurs. 

Beyond all of that though, the best part of this Keva Juice is that each employee truly wants you to have the best juice or smooth you could possibly have.
They have been closed more the last couple of week than they have been open. Very frustrating!
Don't go there. No heat, worst fries, turkey taste like it was dipped in pickle juice. Blahhhhhh

Came here with 2 foodie friends and we had an amazing feast. it was worth the visit

We ordered 8 items between us! For appetizers we had: 1) Pickled Pig's Heart (I was hoping it would be a the whole heart, but it was sliced like deli meat; nonetheless, it was very tasty, served with grilled broccoli on farm bread, all seated on a mildly spicy pepper jelly); 2) Sweet potato nachos (served with blue cheese, jalapenos and housemade catsup, very unique presentation and, very tasty); 3) Steamed pork buns (very tender pork belly, served on chinese buns (think "kong bah bao" buns) with a delicious XO sauce, also served with a housecured kimchi (for that "umami" factor). 

For entrees, we got: 1) Portochino (housemade pork and pancetta sausage, served on a bed of braised kale and roasted radishes in a red wine ham sauce, yummy!); 2) Gulf Fin Tuna (fresh whole tuna, perfectly done, honestly it wasn't particularly special, the only taste that stood out was the duck egg yolk that gave the fish a unique flavor); 3) Breakfast (I think my friend would have kissed the chef for the corn flour blinis, with whipped maple pig butter, it was very very good pancakes); 4) Bacon wrapped meatloaf; 5) Pork tenderloin (a bit on the salty side,but very tender!)
  
For dessert, we got: 1) homemade apple pie with zuchinni bread ice cream, 2) chocolate and peanut butter cup (chocolate mousse in a chocolate ring, on a peanut butter nougat disc), 3) trio of ice cream including the zuchinni bread, rhubarb sorbet and vanilla ice crean. 

To be honest, we regretted staying for dessert, it was a disappointing end to the meal. But it did not spoil our experience, I will still be back! (just skip dessert)

The lobby Bar is awesome.  The staff could not be more accommodating, fast and efficient and the food at the bar was great.  Beer selection is from local brew houses and single malts two notches above typical.   Really for a very busy hotel, the staff is always there and ready to help. The place to stay in Indianapolis.

Went into Giant on a busy Sunday to get a 12 pack of beer and 3 other items. Cashier at beer garden refused to ring out my other three items even though other cashiers have done it there before. When I asked if I am expected to go get in another line she said yes I guess so. Needless to say I cashed out my other three items and did not buy the beer from them. With grocery stores stealing business from bars and restaurants maybe they should try to be a little more accommodating.
Wow!! Amazing food, amazing atmosphere. The short rib grilled cheese and the chai latte are a must. Yummy smoothies and deserts too! 13/10 yum yum yum

I have an addiction to Press'd sandwiches Blazing Buffalo that borders on needing a twelve step program so naturally I was delighted to see they have a location in the University area last time I was out wandering that way.

I always make it a combo as I love the broccoli crunch salad that is one of their side options and the whole thing together with the drink rings up at around the 10-11 dollar mark which is more than reasonable for a healthy fast food lunch. My sandwich was delicious and I was happy they didn't hose it down with hot sauce like some of the other locations I have been to which meant none of it found it's way to my shirt which made me a happy Lyndsey. I think my only minor concern I had with my dining experience was the fact that my broccoli salad was a little light on cheese. Despite that though it was still very tasty and this location of Press'd more than met the high standards I have for my favorite sandwich company.

Our closest iHop, we really appreciate the consistency of the breakfast food. My husband loves the international passport breakfast with Swedish pancakes and compared to other iHops, we find the crepes to be the thinnest, lightest, and best! We prefer our bacon extra crispy and they do it every time perfectly as well as being able to poach eggs exactly as ordered. I find the nutritional info now on the menu to be informative and now have the veggie omlet with roasted tomato as a great bang for my calorie buck! Coffee could stand big improvement, as could canned o.j., but we find this to be the best of the big chain iHops. Some times are quite busy, so take it into consideration when planning your time there. Servers are friendly and accommodating. Still our go-to breakfast place.

I have used Priceline extensively for getting hotels in NOLA, and my wife and I have stayed at several different ones.  This has been my favorite.  The location across the street from Lucy's is awesome.  The restaurant downstairs is great for breakfast.  The rooms are nice.  Did I mention the location?  The art placed around the lobby makes this place unique.  I think this place would be worth it at normal price.

I was struggling to find the correct description when my husband nailed it - this is a safe dinner. No matter what you order, you are going to get an excellent meal with fantastic service. But it's a meal you could find anywhere. It didn't have the exciting New Orleans flare that makes this food scene one of the best in the world. The one dish we had with the "wow factor" was the bread pudding with a hot cup of decaf coffee.
Great Fried Catfish and fried catfish. Good service and friendly staff. Will return for sure
Food was ok.  Service was bearable.  The location & decor are sub-par.

Terry is the real MVP.  Me and a couple friends came in, searching for our friend (girl was a little drunk.) After failing to find her, Terry asked what she looked like and said he'd keep an eye out. After about 10 minutes of trying to call this chick, she answers her phone (or Terry does?) either way, point of the story is Terry brought us our drunk friend back to us safely. Something that is definitely not in his job description. Give this guy a gold star and a raise.

I was looking for a hotel that gave me the New Orleans feel, I was not dissapointed.  Beautiful courtyard, room decor, shutter doors....great 1st impression.
From there on....not great. There's coffee downstairs in the morning as they do not have coffee pots in the room. They dont have even pastries for the guests in the morning.....even if i paid! and $756.82, for 2 NIGHTS!!!!!! merits pastries, juice ...SOMETHING.
Room cleaning service was hideous...you touch the lamps and their are dusty and dirty. They came to clean on Sunday....left dirty glasses, half full cups of cofee, didnt pick up the crumbled paper in the bathroom from the bars of soap, which makes me think , they just dropped the towels and ran.
The front desk help was delightful on the afternoon of our arrival 11/7/15....but this morning  11/9 /15 when I asked for a late check out  the blonde man behind the desk was annoyed, indecisive. .and frankly a little rude.
Next time for that money I can stay at The Sheraton in Bourbon street.

Every time I visit Plant City I make it a point to get a little pampering done here. Everyone is so nice and super attentive. I almost hate to give them a good review because I don't want them to be too busy for me next time I'm in town.

By far one of my favorite Malaysian spots ! 
Roti Cani is on point the chicken is tender and the potato is soft, the curry isn't spicy just a slight kick. The bbq beef & chicken satay sticks with peanut sauce is amazing ! It's a much try and trust me you will not regret it ! I usually get the prawn mee when I come here it's my go to. The soup base is a little more spicer than other places i've been to but I love it ! They can add a little more veggies and meat into it. Service here has always been great never had a problem.

I am in love with their pastries!!! Had the chocolate bear claw & it was as good as croissants in France!  Scones are excellent also - fluffy & not too sweet.  Chef & staff were friendly, so will be back soon for lunch :)

Have attended many discussion groups and happy hours here. The speed of service is very impressive. Last night they had a full house, and my food was still served in only a few minutes. Menu is vegetarian friendly (be sure to specify if you're vegan). I have yet to try a food item I dislike, but the black bean burger and the beer bread are my favorites. The real winner of course is the assortment small-batch brews.

Look for seasonal varieties as well as regular favorites - order the sampler and try them all!

Showed up Saturday at 745 for dinner with friends.  Guy running the tiny dining room informs us that they stop seating at 730 on Saturday, but that we could order food to go, disclaiming that it takes about 20-30 min to prepare the food.  No problem.  So there we are, my friends, their 2 year old, and myself, waiting there outside on 6th street.  The front of the place opens to the street, so we're basically standing around trying not to ogle to hard at the people at the tables.  Odd thing is, the guy who took our orders intermittently chats us up, so he's aware that we are there waiting for something.  After 45 minutes, my friend asks about the status of our food and he acknowledges and trots off to the kitchen to see.  He emerges, sans food, approaches us matter of factly and informs that the food won't be ready for perhaps another hour!  No kidding.  Now I know about culture gaps, but this guy was born in Philly, he told us so.  Even so, there's never an excuse to treat customers like they or their own time doesn't matter.  100% non apologetic and indifferent to our inconvenience.  Food could be great. But I know I'll never be finding out.

They have seriously got some problem with Management and Employees working for them. It was my nightmare to get out of the apartments. They don't consider sub lease, straight away tells that they have people waiting in line so wouldn't cater sub lease and if i am on notice and GOD forbid something goes wrong, i have to go out of the apartment anyway. What??? I have lived in several parts of the country and rented apartment but they are the worst ones to handle.

Again after 2.5 years living there, they are charging me for paint and marks inside which were of the chairs near to the walls and resurfacing of the laminated kitchen countertops. Igot the house professionally cleaning but cleaning services and still have to pay them 400-450 dollors for the non sense things. Only the legible item was bath tub for which they charge 150$ and everything else was just crap.

I checked with other and everyone asked me why i got it cleaned when they are anyway going to impose the fines. That was my bad because i don't have such thing seen in past. But that's how you learn..anyway.

Maintenance wise they are the laziest team i have seen. To respond to any issue, their SLA is 48 hours and they will come for once and will say that they need to check with supervisor and wouldn't return ever. Once you check with Leasing office, the ticket is resolved already.

Anyway Past it Past but somewhere we are responsible for them to behave in this manner. If i am not happy and want to leave, 10 others are standing in the queue to have it because of Indian community preferring these apartments because of the connectivity and low prices. 

But you always get what you pay for. Entry is easy but exit is a nightmare.

I think most people can agree that no one "really" likes to go to the dentist but I can say that going here is always a great experience. The staff is friendly and Dr. Lawyer is very easy going. I came in today because I was experiencing some pain in my jaw from an old root canal and was not looking forward to having my teeth cleaned. Deanna was so nice and super gentle. I have to say that my appointment did not suck. Having tooth pain is the worst but it's always a relief when the people there to help are always so helpful. Hope that helps.

Ive used this place for years but Im done. Every single time I go in and ask for something, the guy who works there makes a big deal about the question. He doesnt know what the price is, he cant be bothered to open the box, he cant describe how long the papers are, and three times Ive gotten stuff I didnt want .Cant tell me how many items are in the box, cant tell me whats in it, and the selection is terrible compared to other shops. Its the attitude that I find irritating , as a woman, this place isnt very good. I recommend going somewhere else.

Came here to see Mike Epps perform. My only complaint is the seats are small and too close together. There is no room to stretch legs at all. U can forget about elbow space too. Oh and the $4 dollar pretzel sucked also.

This place is within walking distance. A few years ago an old coworker would bring these donuts into the office every Friday like clockwork. I left that company and hadn't had them in years. I finally ordered a dozen yesterday to take to a fantasy football draft party. They were a hit. 

Very tasty, reasonably priced and friendly service.

Tried to have breakfast at this restaurant because it was close to my fiancé's conference and it has really good reviews...emphasis on TRIED. 

When we arrived, we were next in line. When it was our turn, however, the server in charge of seating chose to place us in the awkward position of giving up a table to the family behind us and sit at the bar instead. How can we say no to that?! So we went with it. Well, the bar was a little high for my fiancé to reach the table, so we ask the bar area server to be re-seated at the next available table - no big deal as we only saw one other couple waiting after us.

Turns out, by the time a table opened up, the same server in charge of seating had again given up a table promised us to a family with a child. She claims they arrived before we placed our request, but that was totally false, as now there were at least FOUR other couples ahead of this family in line. So she had personally moved the family to the front of the line, bypassing ALL the couples. Worse yet, she got very defensive when we broached the subject, so we just walked out.

So unfortunately, we did not get to sample the food, due to very poor service from one server. This was too bad because all the other servers seemed very nice (although one threatened to unseat us from the bar if we wanted a table - because there were people who would sit at the bar, nevermind we were essentially guilted into taking the bar seats).

So if you go and one of them tries to pull this on you, stand your ground! Having a kid should not automatically jump someone else to the front of the line!

My husband and I got this hotel for one night. Thank goodness it was only one night. For $130 you'd expect something a little nicer. The room was big, but outdated. The bathroom tile was gross. It desperately needs to be updated. The free breakfast was gross! We ordered omelettes and we each took one bite and stopped. That bad! They had bacon, sausage, eggs, potatoes. All disgusting. My husband tried the waffles and french toast sticks. They were all rubbery. He got a banana and it had a black spot on it. Definitely not even worth free!! Save your money and go somewhere else. Trust me. Im not a very picky person, but this place is just not worth your money.
The server was rude and all the food had so much salt on it I could barely eat it. Even the salad was covered in salt.

We are attending a volleyball tournament in Tampa and decided to stay in and order food to avoid the Valentine restaurant rush. We ordered the fried ravioli. Caesar salad, fettuccine Alfredo with a house salad and pasta marinara with garlic knots. We used the yelp app to order delivery. It gave us a window of 70-90 minutes. It was closer to 2 hours but our hotels valet is jammed and there is a hockey game down the street. The salads were fresh and delicious. The Caesar and Greek dressing were probably the best I have ever had. The pasta was good. The garlic knots and ravioli were delicious. I would give them 5 stars except for the fact that they did not include silverware in the to go order to a hotel. I had to go to the restaurant in the hotel and ask for silverware. Not a big deal except it was already 9 pm and I was in my jammies. The hotel staff may be traumatized for life. I would however for sure dine in and order from them again and ask for silverware!

This is a great place to go for crab & lobster. As locals we've come many times over the years. First, the clam chowder is the best I've ever had and the bisque is also great. Stay away from the crab cakes unless you like a gluten type cake. Also as much as I love abalone, this is not the place to order it. Why they don't just pound it and fry it in pepper & salt flour is unknown. All the tacos are excellent. Cole slaw and onion rings are awesome. Plan on spending $100 plus for 2 if you have drinks and a shellfish dinner. Worth it!

Cute gelato place. One of our go-tos. The staffs are very attentive for people who want to try different flavors - thats part of the fun! I always just go for a chocolate with fruit combo. It never fails me either.

Hilarious waitress! She was half the fun! Despite being busy, service was fast & friendly. Delicious orange juice. Chicken & waffle - sooo good. The menu is limited but every one seemed to enjoy their grub!
Great food, beers and great service. Visiting from out of town and we enjoyed our stop at Barrel 55.

My husband and I like to at local restaurants so we walked to the Cornerstone Inn this past Friday evening.  We sat outside which I probably wouldn't do again as sitting on Ridge Avenue and trying to talk is difficult.  We both ordered the roast beef sandwiches and since it said that they came with chips we ordered a basket of fries to share instead.  When our sandwiches came, they came with fries as well.  Needless to say we had way too many fries.  The roast beef was not very good and the rolls fall apart when you try to pick up the sandwich.  We will probably go back, eat inside and try some other food other than the roast beef.  Hopefully something will be better and the staff should tell you that fries come with the sandwich that you are ordering especially when you order even more fries.

If you haven't been by Q & Bourbon stop by and see the amazing Noel & Tina! Lunch specials and dinner specials and right close to the track! You can hear the Indy cars from the patio! Margaritas are smooth and more bourbon than toucan taste I one trip. Not to mention the Q and sauce is remarkable! Service is top notch and good quality is above expectations! I had the loaded baked tater with pulled pork, and took rib tips to go for night shift food at work. I'll frequent more often! Come show love  to this local gem! Barbecue, Bourbon & Beautiful Speedway! You can't ask for better!
Excellent! It was a long wait but the bar is open seating and we got lucky. The espresso drinks are delicious and biscuit breakfast sandwiches were superb. Highly recommend!

Favorite burger joint in all of Nashville. 

Get the Woodstock--absolute favorite. Benton's bacon and cheddar accent the burger in the best possible way. Sweet potato fries are perfect--served in a stainless cup... the homemade ketchup is amazing as well. Black Bean Burger is great as well. 

Good drinks. Really fabulous atmosphere. The sprawling wall of windows allows for plenty of natural light in for a lunch date, and offers a great night view of 12 South over dinner as well. The community-style seating isn't always accommodating--especially if you're on a date. Parking on the street is usually not too difficult to navigate. Go early or late--there's usually a wait around the dinnertime hour.

Seriously love this place.

Ardmore and Havertown peeps: TRY THIS PLACE!  Went here twice for Sunday brunch. First time I had the breakfast tacos, which were delicious. Second time I had the meatball sliders. Also yummy. Their French fries are SO good. Went there for dinner tonight and had Caesar salad and rustics pizza. Very good but fewer mushrooms and more shortrib would have been better. Beer selection is really good.

Let me start off by saying I grew up eating here with my Grandmother every other Friday when it was in the "neighbourhood". One of my monthly dinner crews went just this pass Friday and for the price point I was not pleased! I spent $50 total and let's just say I left wanting a hot sausage sandwich from any corner store. I was born and raised in nola and consider myself somewhat of a foodie. While the food was kind of tasty the amount seemed to not be worth the price. Now I get they are located in the "quarters" but for my hard earned money I can think of a few more places to spend $50.

Decided to try the lunch buffet here after not having eaten at a Godfathers in about 12 years and was sadly disappointed, the pizza was fine but the salad was soggy and we felt rushed even though it was not busy. The busser came and stared at us halfway through our meal and when we got up to play the games our table was quickly cleared even though our belongings remained at the table as we were not quite finished.

Definitely a new favorite! I live just a few feet away so naturally had to make sure I checked this place out. I can say that my boyfriend and I were both pleasantly surprised by the portion sizes (huge) and quality of the food. Both of our meals were absolutely delicious. 

The bad - The staff was friendly but the service was pretty slow. I think the staff was a bit overwhelmed by the large crowds. Also there was no system in place for getting your names down while waiting for a table so that was a little weird as we weren't sure if we were forgotten about or still waiting. 

Overall, great food! Cute place. Awesome locations.

Could have been better. Dinner seemed a little rushed - it was a Thursday night so it was not extremely busy for them, I attribute it more to the server not being dialed in to his customer - which isn't great for a somewhat romantic setting. (I often wonder why the server hasn't noticed that we haven't even opened our menus yet.) 
The food was pretty good, pasta bolognaise and a salad to start. But my criticism is this, which I hope the owners read & heed: we were at an outside table and it was a lovely evening. The sun had set and there was plenty of light thanks to the street lights in the borough, but at some point they threw on the overhead spotlights which was an immediate rude awakening. The table of females behind us gasped collectively as well and actually screamed when the burst of light brought bugs to our tables and specifically a beetle into the hair of one of them. And what seemed worse was that when we all asked that they kill the offensive lighting, the answer twice was that they didn't want to "appear closed" to potential customers. Not only was this strange because clearly with people inside and out at tables eating it appeared quite open but it was annoying because the focus was more on the would-be customer rather than their actual customers (who were now unwitting participants in their marketing scheme).
I always get a quesadilla and its pretty reliable, it never wows me but its always satisfying.  The staff is nice and the service is quick.  They have darn good brownies too.

Where has this place been my entire life. I mean seriously. It was so incredible that I'm contemplating moving to St. Pete. I'd also end up like 400 pounds since I'd be on a strict pasta diet but whatever. 

We went at like 2pm on Saturday. Lucky for us, they close at 2:30 so we made it just in time. It looked like complete chaos- cars everywhere, a guy directing traffic, people entering and exiting in droves. My parents and I looked at each other like "should we run???" Alas, we didn't and I'm thankful we braved it. 

Mazzaros is divided into sections which worked out well because it was the most well oiled machine I've ever seen. You grab a number and go to your respective counter: fresh pastas, ready made dishes, bread/desserts, meats- it was impressive how well run the place was. 

I picked up fresh pastas (papardelle, cheese ravioli and spinach prociutto ravioli, vodka and marinara sauces, the best fresh sourdough I've EVER had, amazing cheeses, incredible Genoa salami and some olive oil straight from Italy. Everything was incredible. There's a whole area where you can order lunch and sit outside, coffee counters and a wine and cheese room. Come for lunch, come to pick up ingredients for an Italian feast, just come. You won't be disappointed. 

Ps- I probably gained 5 pounds after my visit. WORTH IT.
horrible housekeeping, concierge, restaurant service!! do not stay here if you value respect or customer service!

This place has been my go-to for Thai food for years now. I've tried other places but it's just never as good! I order the same thing every time, so I can't speak for the rest of the menu..but the red curry chicken does not disappoint

This store has amazing products and very knowledgeable staff to help you find the product best for you! I was especially helped by Kat, who showed me multiple options and samples for what I was looking for! I always leave this store with exactly what I need and more! I don't go anywhere else!!!!
This place serves up dreck.  I don't know what these other Yelp users see in it.  From flat, largely flavourless pho to hard uninspired spring rolls, the food at Pho Anh Sang is not good.

I ate here not very long ago for lunch. It wasn't bad at all. I'd give it more stars but I'm more of a fan of Eastern NC BBQ and this is not that. The meat was good and they smoke it right out front, I just don't like all that thick BBQ sauce...but hey that's just me. Like I said still very good and worth going by. You can also buy all types of meat here to take home and cook yourself.

We have been here several times. The atmosphere is always welcoming and the staff always eager to make you feel right at home. The greens and sausage were right in point.  Be sure to grab some of the sweet goodies in the side room for the road. We will definitely keep coming back.

Nice little cafe/restaurant on South. We sat in the front window ledge area, they have tables in back as well as a few seats outside in the back (too hot these days in the summer when it is 95+) and at least one table outside in the front typically.

Staff could not have been nicer, but at the same time not being in your business the whole time. My tea was just OK, but the wacky sounding hawaiian coffee with hazelnut was very good, better than it sounds.

We had the dill scrambled eggs with feta, which was OK but not great. Good quality, just not to our particular liking/taste. Also had the combo meal I think called the lot or something (scrambled eggs, bacon, french toast, etc.). Eggs were good but the bacon was incredible, probably the best I've had for breakfast in the city; not too crispy, the right amount of fat, etc.

Prices were pretty reasonable, the other patrons were pretty friendly, overall a nice time for breakfast without some crazy wait like you might get at some of the other brunch/breakfast places that have a rep in the city.

If you haven't been, give it a try, it is pretty good and the people are pretty nice all around.

What can I say about Wawa? Doesn't just about everyone love Wawa!? Whether it's for the flavorful coffee options or the delicious sandwiches, people flock to Wawa.

This location gets a super abundance of foot traffic because it's in a prime center city location. Before work, during lunch and after work this place is on and poppin'! Because they use an electronic order system, the process is easy & much faster than other stores where you have to wait in line to place the order. It is also a streamlined process because instead of paying "after" your food is ready, you pay "while" the food is being prepared. This my friends is the true genius of their awesomeness! 

That being said, this particular location can get real gritty real fast. The minimal seating area may have trash left on it from inconsiderate customers. And/or trash may be found on the floor. Many homeless people frequent this location as well, usually to do you the gracious service of holding the door so that you will oblige them with a meal as you leave the store.

I'm a city girl so these factors don't keep me from going to this location, in fact this is the one I go to the most! It's actually the one that gives the fastest service in the city, especially when you consider the volume of customers they serve.

The bull is the best entertainment, bartenders are good, the shot girls are persistent but all in Nola fun 

The music was all country and they kept it upbeat 

Good time had by all

Absolutely love this spot! Food and service is on point. I'm a picky eater, so when I order something it usually comes with a custom request which they always say "no problem" to.

Easy call ahead pickup and delivery except on Sunday. 

My go-to is the bacon egg and cheese and their cheesesteak is delicious!

Jackson's is one of the bars on 21st Ave that is popular with Vandy students and locals alike.  The bar is on a corner the 21st and the West side of Belcourt Ave so they utilize all that people watching real estate by having windows all facing towards the street, and a large patio along 21st Ave that butts up right against the sidewalk. The place is fun because they get a good crowd of young people.  I think that is the secret to success at any place in the world.  Everyone goes to Jackson's to have drinks and just talk, so it gets very busy and very noisy. 

They make nice mixed drinks here.  I had a pretty decent martini and even a Manhattan! So I think of this place as more of a drinks bar than a beer bar; they do serve beer, but you can get beer anywhere.  Order up a martini, sit on the patio, and people watch, it's good times.
This place is absolutely amazing! The owners are so welcoming and their treats and baked goods are absolutely to die for!! Next time on South street make sure to stop in!!

This review has been a long time coming (was on my to do list). Just wanted to say how accommodating, understanding, and prompt they were with communications. I would use their services the next time I am in the area. I would also recommend their services to anyone and everyone. If you haven't decided yet whether the price is worth it well let me tell you that their service is beyond. You will not regret it.

We have recently moved to the area from out of state and were super surprised by this place! The menu is huge, and all of it is available 24/7. EVERYTHING looks homemade, no freezer and microwave here. The donut selection looks amazing and the staff was really friendly. We can't wait to go back and take family as a treat when they come to visit as it's a local feature to the NOLA area.

On a scale of 1-5 I'd give the beer a 3.5, I had pizza and my wife Shepard's pie.   The pie had obviously been heated in a microwave as the outside was too hot to eat and center was cool.  I had a pizza in which the crust was over cooked and the toppings undercooked.  Positive note...the server was very attentive and personable...so for that bumping my rating up to a 4

So excited, that's all it takes, fresh baked things oh and donuts. I went next door to try the barber and had to stop in on my way out. So cool to see a couple follow their passion and open a bakery. I plan to bring the kids for super awesome treats from Brown's. Great place to stop if you are out on a bike ride on the weekends. Great coffee and pastries. I wish you all of the luck I hope things boom for you.

I live within walking distance and have gotten both take out and dine in quite a few times. The girls that work the counters always have smiles and the food is good quality as well.  The Chicken Parmesan grinder and the Grilled Chicken Salads have become my regular meals when I don't feel like looking at the menu.

The pizza crust probably is my least favorite part of Drexel Hill Pizzeria.  It's more of a softer, chewy crust.  I prefer Neapolitan dough which tends to be thin, crunchy, and airy.  That's just my personal preference - the toppings and calzones have always been great.
Came to Logans for a birthday party and the food was good and Stacy our waitress was awesome. For the group of people that we had she did an awesome job by herself.

We dined here on a Wednesday night (I believe) and sat at the bar. I didn't get the bartenders name but he was great! Very attentive and extremely knowledgeable about all the menu items and wine! We tried an array of appetizers--the bite size skewers are all amazing. I can't remember the name of them all, one was with artichokes and one was a simple meat and cheese one, those were my favorite!! There was also a ceviche style one that my boyfriend loved! We then split the fried lobster and cauliflower. The lobster was okay--not my favorite and the cauliflower was extremely salty. I wasn't too disappointed since the apps and service were on point. We will definitely be back to try other items! They also have a great happy hour!

This place is amazing.  In general, the vibe alone is 5 + stars.  The back courtyard can be crowded but I appreciate that they limit the people in the wine room.  So you're not knocking anything over or getting too irritated with the crowd.  You can buy cheese and meats and thene bring it to the counter with your wine.  They will make a platter for you and bring it to your table.  In addition, you can order some amazing food from the window in the back.  First come first serve on the tables but there are also standing tables and an upstairs cocktail bar.  The live music was incredible.  The place is just buzzing!  I loved it and I can't wait to come back and visit again!

Saw "Wonder of the World" last night.  It was a GREAT show. The acting and directing was incredible. If you have not been to Bruka it is time to catch one of their shows and this would be the perfect first time show.  Once you see one you will be hooked and will settle for nothing less than season tickets.

This was always a favorite place to go have a tasty Rapini pizza and glass ( or two !) of nice red wine. The staff has always been professional and fun! It was doubly great to go tonite as they recently re-opened after the awful fire up the block. The place has been totally cleaned and was its warm cozy self. The crew was cheerful, the food and wine great as usual  and salted caramel and bourbon butterscotch gelato was superb! Be sure to come back and support this special neighborhood business!!

nice little quiet place.  friendly staff, fast service.  broad menu too!  seafoid, soups,  all the regular stuff as well as few things you dont normally see.  shredded carne was delish.  and very reasonably priced.

Came here after church Wednesday night (btw if you don't have a church home, try Radiant off Dale Mabry) anyways came to Thai 5 after service for dinner and I was impressed! Service was great...Samantha took care of us. I had the Curry Panang with chicken! AMAZING!!!!!!!!! It was delicious, I ate every bite and so did my friends. It was sweet, spicy, and amazing! I would recommend this place to anyone. The Thai tea was awesome too. I can't wait to go back. I want to try the whole menu!

The staff of this H&M are some of the WORST retail employees I have ever encountered. 

Friday Sept 11 my friend and I came in to find a dress for my upcoming presentation. The young man running the dressing room was very sarcastic and rude to customers yelling "you're welcome" in an obviously exaggerated and disingenuous manner. When we finally found what we came for, the power went out. We were asked to drop our items and exit the store. We asked if there was any way we could hold our items. The staff member said she would put them on hold under our name. 

Saturday Sept 12 we returned right when the store opened, and the staff was very unhelpful and made very little effort to try to find our items we thought were on hold. We looked around on the racks for our desired items and they were nowhere to be found. We asked several employees for help and they could not be bothered to care other than to point us in the direction of where it "should be". When I was in the fitting room, my friend finished before me and returned her number to the employee. As she walked away, the fitting room staff who we had asked about our items proceeded to talk about how annoying she was and that helping us is "not their job". I get it, you are a retail employee and it's late Saturday morning, but we were not rude, we simply asked if you saw the dress, if you could possibly help us find what we are looking for. If you can't be bothered to help customers than you shouldn't be working in customer service. Talking crap about customers on the job (especially when they can hear you) is never acceptable. Good luck in the real world ladies, I hope your catty, "not my job" attitudes take you far!

Also, the fitting room floors are absolutely filthy. I had brand new pink socks on and by standing on their floor the bottoms became black from the dirt and dust.

Today was my first time visiting a Red Robin. I had heard many good things about them from friends and family and decided to take my Brother out for an early birthday lunch and a movie. The restaurant appeared very clean and service was friendly and professional with just one tiny lapse. The burgers were great and I was happy with the fact that the waitress didn't bat an eye when I ordered mine medium rare. I have had restaurants tell me they won't serve burgers below medium and that just tells me that they don't trust the quality of their meat or kitchen staff. The fries were a bit of a disappointment though. My brother had bragged about how good they were and since we were in shortly after opening at 11 AM, I expected them to be hot and fresh. While they weren't horrible, they weren't very warm and several of mine were very hard, like they had been left to either cook too long or sat under a heat lamp for far too long. Again, they weren't horrible, it just seemed strange for them not to be fresh so early in the day. All in all, I would happily go back again. 
My one issue is something that is common to a lot of restaurants. I am a big guy at 6'1" and around 315 lbs. Many restaurants, Red Robin included, have booths with their tables firmly mounted to the floor. As a hostess, if you have a larger customer coming in, it might behoove you to consider seating your diner somewhere where they can be comfortable. The restaurant was sparsely populated and there were regular tables and chairs, high top tables, and even bar seating that would have been far more comfortable for me rather than having me try and squeeze into a booth. Yes, I know that the simple answer is, "lose weight!", but that doesn't change the fact that you should always try and make your customer comfortable.

Total scam! The staff approaches you as being nice but in the end they lie to you about the membership fees and the conditions of being a member. 

They claim to be a gym with the lowest membership drops in the area, well thats because they never let you cancel your membership since managers never become available even if you call in ahead of time. 

Also forget about calling corporate on any of your concerns because they are always in meetings and never return your calls. 

If you want to be lied to, taken advantage of, or give your money away then this is the gym for you!

This is a modern beauty bar with old beauty parlor style. Very clean and elegant. Oh, and you can drink a mimosa while you get pampered!

My bridesmaid's and I came into Buff on my wedding day. They each got blow outs and styles and I got a mani/pedi. I seriously think it's the best manicure I've ever gotten and if only I were a local I would always request to go back. My nail shape is the prettiest it's ever looked and the color hasn't chipped at all in three days. Their hair came out great and one of them even bought her lipstick there. 

PS no, it's not a vibrating chair that you get your pedicure in, but the bath salts they use are ON POINT. Seriously, so soothing and relaxing. Exactly what a bride needs to stay calm on her big day.

These guys made a usually horrific experience a very pleasant one. They were right on time, flexible with payment methods, speedy and very friendly. Also, they were agreeable to negotiating the final charge because my freight elevator wasn't available until 45 minutes after they arrived. Highly recommend them for a move within Philly or long distance.

So after a few months of driving by this place on the way to Kroger, I decided to give it a try. We arrived mid Sunday morning and I'm guessing that's not the best time to show up: there was a line of people (some were outside). It looked like they had pieces of paper with typed numbers to prioritize hungry diners. I strongly recommend they upgrade to a text alert system. It's much more efficient. 

Anyways, since it was for a table of two, it was about a 10 minute wait before we were seated. It's a quaint spot with lots of food photos and paintings of Indiana sports teams. I really liked the atmosphere: chill and inviting. The host was very accommodating in making sure we got a table away from the door (it was a little chilly). Once seated, we made our orders: Mexican skillet, golden house frittata, and crêpe with fruit. I'm not sure if it was short on staff or too many diners, but it was worth the wait. I really enjoyed the crêpe. It's very rare when you have a crêpe with just the right amount of syrup. It wasn't too sugary or saucy and the fruit was fresh. The frittata, though slightly burnt around the edges, was also very tasty and the pancakes were very scrumptious. 

All in all, I really enjoyed the food and the service. I really wished I remembered the waitress' name for proper recognition. This is certainly my new greenwood breakfast spot. The location is perfect for a good meal followed by a grocery run. I'd certainly go again (probably before or after the apparent Sunday morning rush).
Great breakfast, awesome service, reasonable prices.  Nice place!
Great doctors office. Love the front desk
Best smoked meats ! The bar is cozy and there always seems to be friendly people to talk to. Great place, I recommend it.

Four visits with great food and beer! We had one problem with a tough tuna app and it was taken care of manager apologized and it was off our bill. Servers great, seating outside and in. Much needed restaurant of this type in this location. Love the onion soup, meat loaf and pizza's. We will be regulars!

Just attended a lovely wedding at the Wallingford Community Arts Center. I've been to quite a few weddings lately, and this place is much better than most. I love that the space is built onto the existing Dixon mansion, which was itself built in the Arts and Crafts style (?) Don't miss the coffered ceilings, the wrought iron detailing in the entrance windows, and the beautiful tilework and woodwork around the fireplaces.
We were in the large space with the high ceilings, with artwork on the walls. I loved that the artwork was all local - it really brought home the community aspect.
The event was very well managed, and the food was delicious. I felt like the pacing was particularly efficient, without rushing - no time wasted, here. The only drawback was (were?) the acoustics, despite the acoustic panels in the ceiling. The DJ was on the second level with two speakers, and it just didn't work. I'm not sure if that was the DJ's fault, the fault of the room, or both. Otherwise, an excellent space.
Did someone say COFFEEE!!!! This is the place to go!!! Oh and try there Poptarts sooo freaken AMAZING!!! Totally Recommend!!! Driving from LA to SB I will still go to this place!!

Wowee, really nice!

Visited from Birmingham, AL and caught the Neo-impressionist exhibit. Wow those colors! 

The museum itself was quite lovely with lots to see. We especially loved the contemporary/modern design exhibit with its kooky designs from the 50s up to the present. 

I would love to go back and spend a whole day exploring the 100 acres of land/gardens around the museum. Unfortunately we didn't get to see even a glimpse of that area. But the museum is definitely worth a trip!

This hidden gem in Sherwood Park has the potential to be one of the greats but the atmosphere is terrible. 

I debated given this place a 4 star rating but I can't because of the atmosphere. It doesn't suit the food. I'm not sure what they were trying to go for but the name of the restaurant doesn't match the decor. A fish tank in the middle? Huh? Silver furniture? Ok? 

Half of a restaurant experience relies on the atmosphere. At least for me. 

Now I want to talk about the food. Amazing! I had their chicken club sandwich for lunch and it delivered on taste and presentation. Serving a sandwich on a cutting board fits the restaurant name and the menu item. The bread was toasted well. The chicken was juicy and the condiments well balanced. 

If atmosphere isn't important to you, go here.  I really wished they would have done a complete remodel from the past 3 restaurants that occupied this space before they took over. Disappointing. I hope things turn around for them and they invest in a reno. It would be a shame to lose this restaurant.
One of my favorite Greek spots. Love the traditional Greek salad (good size) and you must try the spread and chips. It's a feta garlic dip with toasted pita slices. Awesome. I'm hooked on this place.

Guess I don't know what I could add to what's already been said.

Roti Kanai was yummy - could have used more than a tiny piece of chicken though (what do u expect for 3 bucks, right?)
The 2 other entrees we had (Mee Siam and Penang Kari Ayam) were good...especially the Mee Siam. The chicken dish (Kari Ayam) I though could have used more of the lemongrass it promised to make the flavors more multi-layered as opposed to the flat peanut flavor we got.

All in all - pretty good for the money but I won't be back. Guess I am not a big fan of ethnic food in a bare-bones setting with less than friendly service. But that's just the snob in me--- so feel free to disregard this review altogether :)
Found this place right next to Jacksons square and it is spectacular.  Everything was great and quality service.  $40 tasting menu was worth it for the quality seafood and delicious bread pudding.

A girl with ban did a horrible job on my ped and gel mani, she seem she doesnt speak English well, how can she get her license . My gel lift right next day. She did my pedi was super fast. Not coming back again

Big warehouse, nicely decorated, loud and crowded ambience. I ordered some grilled chicken with chipotle sauce, rice and beans. Chicken was over cooked, sauce was okay, rice was cold and imposible to ear, and beans....  oh God, poor beans. How someone could ruin black beans?
The food was cold, and over seasoned with cumin. My dish was a festival of cumin, nothing but cumin. I guess the chef believe me that Mexican food means cumin. 
Then the service, it was slow to the point that we needed to walk to the waitress station to get napkins and forks. Not to mention, appetizers dishes were not removed and entrees were squeezed in. 
It was my first and last visit to Don Pablo's.

Came upon this place by accident and I'm so glad I did! 

Mom and I had wanted to introduce my aunt to one of our favorite Indian restaurants, only to find it wasn't open for another hour... Lucky for us, Yelp directed us to Taj-India :)

Taj was neat and tidy and the server was very attentive. I had two delicious samosas to start and then came my vegetable curry with basmati rice. It was yummy, though I underestimated my ability to handle the spice! :P 

Though I can't remember what my mom and aunt ordered, they loved their dinner as well. They also fell in love with the Indian coffee and vowed to find it and make it at home.

Overall, definitely one of my new go-to spots when I'm in the Northeast. Doesn't hurt that the prices were modest for pretty sizable portions

Loved this place!  My husband and I both ordered the Rib Eye Steak and it was fabulous in it's simplicity.  Just a good piece of meat cooked perfectly with great side dishes.  I didn't have the ribs, but someone at our table ordered them and they looked wonderful!  As far as service goes, our waiter was a bit frazzled, but he was friendly and we all got what we ordered just fine.

The night we were there they had a lve Bluegrass band playing.  They were pretty good and added to the festive atmosphere. 

I would definitely come here again!!
The only nail salon I know of downtown.  They do good work but they only have 2 people that work there.  Always a long wait.

This is the third time I've been here and they have done it again!!!

Honey's does it just right! Started with a perfect cup of joe. Finished breakfast off with a bang....macaroni pancakes and a side of bacon! Delicious!!!

Food was good, more disappointed at the 20% gratuity added to my bill because I was not with the other couples. 

$50 for catfish, crawfish Mac n cheese and oysters is a lil much , but oh well you live and you learn .... 

Conclusion it was great to come try this classic food spot but I'll pass on the next invitation

The wait is generally much longer than when my appointments were scheduled and the receptionists were so rude I sometimes dreaded going in. The waiting area is cramped and depressing. I started with another clinic with a farther commute, where the entire staff is so nice and accommodating. I didn't realize how bad this place was until I started at this new clinic.

Had an amazing experience here today! Jessica did my palm reading and tarot cards. There were things she knew that were spot on and there's definitely no way she could've known anything about me beforehand. She had a very calming and soothing nature. Definitely recommend her!! The store itself was incredible as well. Various stones and gems of every shape, size, and color. This store is definitely worth a visit!!!
I visited here on 7-5-15, and had a great meal with awesome, friendly service as well! The pizza was hot and the ingredients were very fresh. I will definitely go back!!

Horrible experience. I ordered a Bloody Mary from the less than friendly bartender. My wife ACCIDENTALLY knocked it over. Resulting in it spilling all over her and I and on there floor. You would have thought we threw it on the ground by the rude reaction of the manger and the bartender. Then the bartender asks me if i wanted another which I replied yes please. Once she made the drink she put it down and says rudely " I hope you are more careful this time". Like we wanted to ruin our clothes. We got up and walked out but not before approaching the less than friendly manger who was useless. Will NEVER go back to this place. I'm sure the food is good but what's good food with horrible service

This place had pretty average reviews but I went there anyway. LIke previous reviewers have mentioned, the salsa is pretty spectacular. My friend actually drank the left over lime juice when we finished the fresh veggies. There were more chips left, so we ordered another one. The waitress brought it, but at no time did she tell us it was $1.50. We had assumed it was free refills, we found out that assumption was wrong when we got the bill. 

I ordered the choose 2 combo. Tamali with shredded beef and enchilada with chorizo. I was pretty full from the chips so I only ate the tamali. The shredded beef was spot on and the corn filling was great too. Nothing special about the enchilada, so I just packed it up to bring home. The accompanying rice wasn't too bad, the refried beans were dry and looked like paste. 

My friend ordered the Carribean Burrito with ground beef. They weren't given the option of shredded, just chicken or beef. He said everythign else was good, except the beef. It was dry and poorly seasoned.

Went for Sunday brunch and have to say the wait wasn't too bad. I had the shrimp and grits with sausage and cheese grits. The grits were perfectly creamy, and cheesy, the sausage made a great addition (it's a premium upgrade). I tried a rum milk punch for the first time and have to say the combination was refreshing, and the nutmeg added a great spice to this southerly charming drink. Sadiki was an amazing server, very prompt and had great suggestions regarding the menu. Can't wait to come back and try lunch and dinner .

Very ordinary looking eatery. The food ranges from okay to good, depending on what you order. They speak some English now, but if you don't know what you want, or ask for something not on the menu, you will have a difficult time. They are not cheap anymore, and a meal will cost you as much as a much fancier place. Make a quick dash to the washroom perhaps only to wash your hands on a good day, and avoid even that on a bad day and use chopsticks or cutlery exclusively.

Our family has been frequenting this restaurant for many years-  even before they moved to their current location. Although the owners/chefs/management have changed several times, we feel that they consistently have provided delicious fresh sushi /hibachi at a reasonable price.  Staff is friendly, lunch bento box is enough for 2 (if you are in the mood to share) and their monster roll is delish!

A drive-thru beer distributor. What a winning business opportunity! In the winter even the room temperature beer is already cold! Great selection and fast service what more do you need? All my friends from out of town are always impressed by this little place!

Good food, good service. As far as menu, it's usual bar food, but it's done well, quite delicious. 
Cold beer and tasty food, can't beat it.
TV's around the place offer variety of sport and occasionally some news.
I'll be back. Recommended!
Really good coffee and an awsome space! Well decorated beautiful cafe. It really nice to have a place to go in ybor for a good cup of coffee. Well done blind tiger.

Flexible atmosphere!

I love the comfortable atmosphere here.  You can sit at the bar and watch sports, or a romantic table for two, or a large comfortable table surrounded by friends.  The lighting and decor fit many different moods depending on your occasion.  

You may as well start with an appetizer because it will take you awhile to get through the large variety of menu choices.  I was on a date with my husband so it was a romantic evening.  I had the meatloaf with mashed potatoes and corn succotash.  It was delicious and the portion was huge.  I made myself stop halfway through so I could have room for cheesecake.  After all that is the most important course for a date night.  The second half of my food went into a to go box and we ordered cheesecake.  Godiva Chocolate Cheesecake was this visit's winner.  It was amazing.

The service was great.  We can't wait for our next visit!  After all there are so many dishes and cheesecakes to experience.
Great food but the prices are a little on the high side in the evening. Come for lunch but avoid for dinner.

Excellent food! Closest thing to indian food in India:) so glad we have an authentic, high quality restaurant that serves delicious North Indian food ! Try the chicken tikka masala and paneer butter masala -the best ive eaten in Tampa bay! The chicken was tender and juicy, the paneer was soft. Brilliant! Hope the food stays this way. Also, lovely ambience:) very glad that they've bothered to create an inspired colorful setting ( most other indian restaurants here are dull -quite unlike Indian restaurants in India )  happy to recommend and revisit.

Delicious espresso and iced coffee on tap. Good looking baristas and tasty things. Makes a nice morning

It's not the most obvious place to find, but definitely a good escape to relax at.

This place is awesome!  This is the best casino in Reno.   They have the best sportsbook in Reno.  They have great restaurants like Bimini's, Biscotti's, and Chi to just name a few.   They have the number one night club as well.   There are plenty of bars If that's your thing.   There is a bar in every section of the casino.  They do have a non smoking slot area for the non smokers.   

The Tuscany tower is all suits.  The rooms are off the hook !  They offer great views of the mountains or pool area.  The regular tower rooms aren't bad either.   The beds are comfortable and probably the nicest beds in Reno.  We always sleep good at the Peppermill.  

The pool area is nice and in the summer the top and bottom pools are open.   Otherwise the bottom pool and Jacuzzi are open.   There is a big arcade for the kids.  Big enough to keep them busy as long as you keep them supplied with game tokens.   If they had a movie theater here,  it would throw them over the top ! The Peppermill is our favorite casino in Reno !!!

I used this company 3 times over a two day visit to Boise. Two of those times I just called and asked for a cab, it was the middle of the day. They arrived promptly and got me where I was going quickly. One of the times I scheduled in advance for an early morning pick up and they arrived 20 minutes ahead of time, and waited until I was ready to go. I found them reliable, reasonable, and easy to deal with. I used a credit card and my receipts were emailed. They weren't the most professional group of drivers (one had a bit of a potty mouth when talking about traffic and such, one had very strong political opinions and wanted to tell me all about it, and the third was definitely more 'normal'). I would use them again without hesitation, they were also less expensive than the one other company I used from the airport to my hotel, I think Idaho Cab took a more direct route. The only reason I'm taking off a star is for the two less-than professional drivers.

Seriously, the level of professionalism and the ease of technology makes this service great.  I have worked with a driver in Atlanta for years and have just moved Tampa/St Pete and didn't have a contact and tried ExecuCar.  Best way I can describe it, is a professional version of Uber.  The technology allows a scheduled pick up and drop off.  The cars and drivers are what you'd expect in a nice limo.  And the communication via text allows you to know when you'll be picked up, where and by whom with the drivers cell phone if something comes up or you get turned around.  And they drive very well.  One of the best limo experiences I've had to date.

I never write reviews, but it just isn't right for Darring's to have an irrational person bring their average down. They do fantastic work, have clean facilities, and Rod is always doing something cool like contests for those on his Facebook page. I would highly recommend their work.

I miss going to this place ever since I left Missouri. The place is not very authentic but it's cheap and it fills you up. The pink lemonade is off the chart and we used to hang out here with my two younger brothers.

I work right next door to Cosi and it's perfect for my 20 minute lunch break. I usually get their tomato basil soup because it's absolutely delicious and I'm not a big soup fan. They serve it with your choice of either original bread or whole grain. It's thick yummy and so tasty and the best part is it's ready to go within just a couple of minutes. Also their salads are amazing too.

Ordered twice from this Sonic in the past week. 1st time got the Ultimate chix sandwich with onion rings and a shake. The shake was great, hard to mess that one up. Onion rings were okay, not cooked to order like advertised. Chicken sand was old and terrible. 2nd time I ordered and asked him to cook fresh fries. He said sure. Fries were luke warm. Doubles cheeseburger not fresh and I will not return.

This looks like any old commercial olive garden but the truth is ITS REALLLLY REALLY GOOD. My expertise in italian cuisine testing comes straight from nonna's kitchen and i must say this restaurant is the best of the best of the best of south jersey italian cuisine.

Best service ever. Rob arrived quickly. Tested battery and charging systems. Our old battery was past its expected life and having a door left open tipped it over. Rob had the appropriate battery at a moderate price, only $20 more than auto parts store (I checked before I called) and I didn't have to go get it or change it myself. Yes, sir! All good with me! Thank you, AAA, and than you, Rob!

One of my favorite bars in Nashville (biased as it's in my neighborhood). I do not recommend going Thursdays as their two-for-1 special unearths a fraternity/sorority orgy of sorts. Trust me. Tasty menu and a solid jukebox.  Patio has nice vibe too. Trust me on the jukebox.

Excelente,profesional services and good greek food.The place clean and very organized for the service.
Beautiful and good atmosphere.

Had plans to check out #Collingswood Mayfair and was happy to walk out the door to see this truck blocking my st off of Haddon Ave.  This was almost my first meal of the day, but since I heard all these greet things I decided to hold off. N glad I did cos after walking both ends of the fair it was hot and my first meal of the day was a sub par pulled pork sandwich from the Lumpys Bbq stand.  I've been outside for almost 2 hours and needed another meal before heading home and hit up this truck. I love cheese curds and this may b the best around.  One order was I think $9 but worth it for the 8/9 pieces I got with the srirachia mayo I think. Real good way to end the afternoon

Amazing food, fun vibe, and very friendly staff!! I have loved coming here for a long time, but recently I have been even more impressed by them. I have several food allergies, and I found this place to be very allergy friendly! I am not sure if they are accommodating to all allergies, but they have a list prepared explaining which options are safe or not safe with certain food allergies, which I thought was very thoughtful :)
I've eaten here ten times and never been disappointed.  Always busy but usually no wait to sit down.  Prices reasonable.  Food is fine, lots on the menu.  Service friendly and prompt.
Long wait times, poor service considering it's attached to a busy hotel. Garlic shrimp was so so. Came here to taste the local brews.

No line so far! Get your biscuits, french toast and bonuts here.

I tried the Lily french toast and the lemon mascarpone and light syrup were a really good combination (three biscuits). The bonuts were fresh and crisp like cream puff shells. My friend had the East Nasty, a fried chicken and gravy biscuit I'd eat over and over. Fast, friendly service - everyone knows their stuff!

Doctors and nurses usually seem pretty nice and knowledgeable. It's rather pricey and I don't think it's worth what ya pay for. Today though, I'm trying to pay for my overpriced treatment, credit card in hand and the cashier takes two people who walked up after me in front of me. It took me expressing frustration and them sending a new person to get checked out. Didn't even hear an apology from the lady who overlooked me only the one who went out of her way to help me. As with anywhere you have positive and negative experiences, in general, however, I don't feel like Banfield cares about their customers the way a veterinarian should.

Love the bar. Great Tequila selection, and better drinks. 

Food is great and creative. Seating upstairs is ok, downstairs is a different story. Get a seat at the bar if you're into the drinks, for there is no wait-service downstairs and the bar is smaller than my closet. So, unless you play Center for the Sixers, you're gonna wait to get a drink downstairs.

I recommend a 'flight' of Tequilas. Ask the bartender for advice if needed, they know what they're talking about here. 

Been here when its empty and bar is to ourselves, and on a busy Sat night..opt for the prior if you can. DJ sometimes (call ahead).
Waited over 20 minutes for our table even tough we had reservations.  Food wasn't all that.

Stayed for the weekend and after the first delicious experience, my wife and I decided to go back on the second day before heading back home. Fearful that it was just a one-time fluke and that we'd be served food that was over or under cooked, or with missing and/or exaggerated details, thankfully that wasn't the case. The only complaint we did have, though mild, was our server's extended conversations with the table next to us. While annoying, still not a deal breaker.

We found this place through Yelp-great reviews and extra 20% off helped get us here. Ami and chef were friendly and helpful with my "no spicy" request and gave us an extra shrimp appetizer and masago eggs and sauce when requested for the awesomely delicious Kani Salad. Fake crab and cucumber and masago and sweet sauce. The miso was good, lots of seaweed. My wife got the clam soup that had lots of clams that you take out of the shell yourself. Delicious broth. The crab Rangoon had a bit too many onions for my taste and came out so hot, she burned her mouth on first taste, beware and blow!  Ended with Shrimp shumai, she ate those so fast, I didn't get to taste it!  Mango Mochi for dessert-Yummy and some special sauces.

I'm so glad that Mt Juliet has an authentic Indian restaurant.  We try to eat here at least once every couple of weeks.  The prices aren't bad at all and the food is amazing and so flavorful.  We really enjoy the garlic naan and have enjoyed every dish we've tried, from the biryanis to the chicken tikka masala to curry and more.  

They take pride in making great, authentic Indian food and will make it as mild to as hot as you want it.  i have Indian coworkers that bring me food occasionally, and the taste is almost identical to their homemade dishes.

It was a Friday night and me and my partner were tired but wanted to try something different and good, didn't want to hassle about parking. So we decided to order something for pick up from Penang. 

We ordered their Indian pancake Roti Canai. Since it was to go so it probably got a little cold, so it was a little chewy and hard to tear off. None the less the curry sauce was fab. The two dishes we ordered were Bean curd Thai style and Beef Rendang. The vegetable Thai dish was great! It left a good aftertaste of spiciness in my mouth, portions were huge, the sauce was a little unhealthy - but what more can you expect when you eat out. I also really enjoyed their Beef Rendang very much, the beef was tender, a little heavy, but sauce was fantastic, again a little oily. 

We also ordered a small size of coconut rice, and that was enough for two. Had leftovers from both our dishes for the next day. 

One thing I do like about this restaurant was that it only took them 15 mins to have our food ready to be picked up on a Friday night. That's a plus! Food was great but leaned more on the expensive side.

Went here after visiting Longwood. We did not want to drive around at 9 looking for a place...and we saw this and figured we would give it a shot. Good clean place, our waitress was prompt and efficient. I had the Enchiladas Supreme- Supreme combo of four enchiladas, one chicken, one beef, one cheese and one shredded beef, topped with sour cream, salad and pico de gallo....all were very good and came out hot. My girlfriend had one of the combo plates and she too said it was very good...neither one of us had any left on the plate. Perhaps because we were famished from all the walking at Longwood...but the food was above average Mexican. We also ordered dessert. It was a Mexican corn pudding flan kinda thing...I am not 100% sure of the name. I loved it...it came with a dark chocolate and honey sauce and it was not overly sweet. My girlfriend did not like it though....yea more for me. But hey that is why we try stuff...who knows what we will like. Over all...if you are in the area this is a good safe choice for Mexican food. The price was right as well as it cost us about $42 for the two of us and I had a Negra Modelo draft (22oz) and she had a frozen Margarita.

This place seems to have worked out most of the kinks that plagued their opening, such as closing in the middle of lunch prime time because they ran out of meat.  Now, months later, I finally made another visit due to an extreme burger craving.  The burger definitely hit the spot, but the experience was almost ruined by the fries.  Not sure why I'm reading so many rave reviews for the truffle fries because mine were so greasy and salty that I needed my milkshake constantly.  I still ate the fries, mind you, but I feel I may regret it later.  I was trying to give them their due because of the rave about them and I'd never had truffle fries before, but the salt and oil made it too hard to distinguish any significant difference from regular fries.  I think the shake could've used a bit more strawberry also, because it often tasted plain with just hints of strawberry, although that may have been the result of the salty-ass fries.  Oh, and $12.50 plus tax for a cheddar cheeseburger, truffle fries and a shake?  I dunno... it's really just a step above typical fast food, maybe two steps actually, so the price is about right for the location.   While I'm not an aficionado, I do get the occasional craving and have had my share of good burgers.  I didn't expect it to be as pink as it was inside when I ordered medium but it was juicy and tasty.  I may go back to give them another chance to get the fries right, but the burger was on point.  The portions were just right too.  Just the right amount of fries, over a quarter pound of meat and a good size shake (maybe 16oz?).  If you don't get the combo, the burger alone might be a bit underwhelming at glance but I think American portions are too big anyways generally.  I'm 6 feet tall, 190lbs and I was full after the combo, without getting the "itis."
Bottom line:  a decent burger joint.

I absolutely love this place.  The food is always good, and the service is always fantastic.  And, if you didn't get enough, you can always buy more to take home from the attached store.  Honestly, by the time I finish my dinner, I am so full.  There is no lack of food on your plate, and the prices can't be beat.
We had the renowned fish because burgers are too greasy,  that was an expensive mistake,

Great staff and delicious pastries! This really is a professional bakery, with all sorts of French delicacies... you name it, they have it. The owner and staff are super friendly and helpful. Its a cool place to stop by any time of the day to meet up with friends, study, grab a quick snack or some good coffee. Try the quiche, highly recommended!

I play a lot of tennis and also enjoy the outdoors, so the quality of my vision is important to me. I also have a parent who suffered from cataracts and later macular degeneration which makes the monitoring of my eye health important to me. 
Dr. Cochrane has been my eye care professional for many years. He is very easy to communicate with and has always addressed my concerns and needs for great vision and eye health. He uses the latest equipment and his professional expertise is excellent plus his support staff are very nice and professional. 
Dr. Cochrane's office is conveniently located along West McCarran Blvd. just south of I-80 and the parking is easy, just steps from his door.

This is the absolute worst experience I have ever had filling a prescription. I have seriously considered paying out of pocket for my medicine or changing to a decent insurance company due to the inordinate amount of trouble I have been going through this past two weeks. 
I have been taking the exact same medication for years. All of a sudden I need "prior authorization" for it. No biggie right? Wrong. It has taken me TWO WEEKS of calling over and over back and forth with the pharmacy, doctors office and the insurance company to figure out how to get this approved. Express scripts keeps sending back my doctors paperwork and telling them I need to try something else first. No. This is why I pay insurance--so I can receive the medicine my doctor prescribes. Each time they reject my doctors paperwork, it takes a few days to restart the process. It is unfair for the nurses, doctors and pharmacy reps including myself to have to go through this. 
I loathe this company and once I get my refills I will make sure I do whatever I have to do to get away from them. You get what you pay for. I am calling BCBS and seeing what pharmacy programs they offer. This is the most frustrating and ridiculous experience I have ever had with an insurance company! DO NOT GO TO EXPRESS SCRIPTS!!! Pay the extra money and go somewhere else that will take care of your needs with no hassle.

I have been a member here for years and I love having a standing monthly massage.
I had a regular therapist that I went to for several yeas but she left so now I am with another great therapist. Not everyone is as good as my two favorites but no one does a bad job.

I have never had any problems with the front desk staff either as others have indicated. 

I can't say I love the new chairs they have in the waiting room but that's a minor thing.

I rode by this place almost everyday, I finally stopped in one day and I'm so glad I did! Best Club sandwich ever! Owner is super friendly and always walking around making sure everyone and everything is great!!
Can't wait to try their breakfast!

We really like this place- great pizza, love the gyros and the chef salad is delicious! Weren't crazy about the wings though. Super fast delivery and always friendly when we call. This is now our go-to delivery spot.

I love R2L, I've been there for dinner probably 4 times and absolutely loved it.  And, as everyone says, the view can't be beat.   I was there for this past New Years Eve, probably the most romantic place to be!  At midnight not only do you have a fantastic view of the fireworks on the river you also can see the fireworks going off in all the neighborhoods around the city, it was breathtaking.  As far as the food, seriously, I've never had anything I didn't like.  So far I've tried the Truffle Flatbread, a favorite I've loved since Rea. Lobster Mac, the best I've had.  A Seafood Risotto special, yum! Remembering it is making my mouth water.  Also, love the Truffle Risotto and Roasted Beets and Chestnuts. At the New Years Eve Party I couldn't stay away from the Chicken Cheese Steak with Kale and Broccoli Rabe, so decadent but I felt like I was getting my healthy greens too.   To top it all off, the Warm Vanilla Cake dessert is out of this world, a very rich and luscious adult version of a vanilla wafer.  R2L is not for those on a budget or wanting casual dining but It is the perfect restaurant for a special occasion.
Best in south philly , only bad thing is they open late and close early .  Staff is always great . Old man waters down the outside keeps it clean .  Great place

This is standard fare but decent buffet for price. The food options included ribs, chicken, meatloaf, plus plenty veggies and dessert items. The wait staff was good, plenty of trips for refills and plate pickups. The quality of good was better than most of shoney's.  This is another place when the places are better the further south you go.

Why aren't these everywhere? It is a free standing counter service through the window type of joint; like an old Dairy Queen or Tastee Freeze but much yummier. Very limited seating (one bench) but the custard was so good that I was too busy shoveling it into my mouth to notice or care. I guess it is better for my waistline that there are not more of these around. Next time I will get a concrete (custard mixed with one or more ingredients). I got a chocolate sundae but the chocolate tasted more like caramel. I thought about complaining but I couldn't stop eating.

Inconceivable: at a group presentation and they failed, even after a request to do so, turn off the loud of noxious music. Food was served late, 1.5 hour after ordering!!
Good: mediocre.

Atmosphere: 7/10 - It's retro-ish.  It isn't super clean, but it's comfortable and fun.
Noise: Pretty loud
Food: 8/10 - It's different, but the taste quality is great for such a casual place! Some foods are a bit too dry, but the great taste makes up for that. Great selection of unique food and drink choices.
