Update: I have tried the enchiladas with mole and again with the red chile sauce. Both were 9/10!  I also tried the BBQ taco - also 9/10. So good!  White queso: 10/10!
Drinks: I only tried the Tamarind soda, and it was great. The selection I saw was pretty good though. I see that they have $4 margaritas on Mondays. 
Originality: 7/10 - It's not super different, but there are many unique drink and food selections. It's like a really good food truck planted in a building.
Service: 9/10 - Very nice cashier and very fast service.
Cleanliness: 7/10 - Clean, but the floors could be better. 
Price-Quality Ratio: Fair-ish.  Maybe a tiny bit over-priced. Good thing it tastes so good!
Overall: 9/10

Enjoyed this restaurant so much the first night that it was a unanimous decision to come back the next night. Everyone ordered different meals each night and everything was great. Excellent food and service!

Hands down the BEST sushi in town. Mr. Choo makes you feel like a star and the sushi is out of this world real. Try the volcano, Iron Miss, or Yum Yum. I can't decide what is better. Give this hole in the wall a chance and you will NOT be disappointed. I will be back time and again.

Went to El Sol De Tala last with a small group of friends (including a few who've never been to the restaurant) and wow everyone thoroughly enjoyed the food and service. 

The restaurant is very big (looks are deceiving from the outside) and seems well laid out.  Apparently the building has been modified throughout the years as it has grown. 

They have recently modified the menu which included adding vegetarian items in the main menu instead of utilizing a separate menu (thanks).  Lots of vegetarian choices make the restaurant an ideal choice but I"m not sure if any vegan items are available. 

Chips and salsa are good but would like them to have a bit more salt on them chips (besides popcorn one of the only food items I actually want salted!)

Great service, good prices (I only had water so that helps!) and excellent food. Desserts looked good but I resisted the temptation and just watched as my friends enjoyed great looking desserts. 

Head down to East Washington Street for some excellent Mexican authentic food.

I called Audio Itch at 4:00 yesterday asking about installation costs for a Clarion detachable face single DIN - they said $70 which I thought was extremely reasonable given I had all the parts from Crutchfield.  They said I could come in right away at 4:30- I got there and they were ready to go and I was out at 5:20pm - Friendly guys knowledgeable and would recommend over Safe And Sound as I contacted them for a install quote and they never got back to me.

Wife and I were regulars at Splash since 2001 and were saddened by their closure in May. Had to try Aquafinz and it was excellent!   Wife had steak Oscar which was delicious.  I had the lobster, scallops, shrimp angel hair. It was outstanding.  Desert was creme brulee cheesecake with raspberry champagne sauce...yum!!!.  Service was excellent.  Great to see Chip back in business.  We will be regulars there I am sure!!
Great way to spend some time doing touristy things in New Orleans. From pick up to drop off it takes about 5 hours. The swamp your itself is a lot of fun and def worth checking out

BEST BRUNCH IVE EVER HAD in Florida. 
I loved the service, the food was so delicious, and the actual restaurant was so nice. They had indoor and a sort off outdoor area with fans, trees, and umbrellas  which is where I sat. They have a full bar, but I ordered a chocolate iced coffee, which isn't on the menu, but my waiter made himself, and it was the best thing ever!
The sangria is delicious and the shrimp empanadas are amazing! The staff is super friendly and welcoming I definitely recommend this place!

Remember my review on Sengyo??  I just rather go there or try other sushi places for sushi instead of Oh Yoko.  But before I get into that:

First off, I've ordered Pork Katsu as take-out twice here before - once for lunch (I think it was $11) and once crazily for dinner ($20-something?).  Don't get me wrong, it was delicious.  The pork wasn't oily and it had a nice little crunch to it.  The sauce that accompanied it was amazing (tasted almost like A-1 sauce, but better).  Wish they gave more!  For the lunch portion, there were a side of soup, salad, and fruit.  For dinner, just soup.  I don't know about you, but I can easily get this type of dish elsewhere for much cheaper.  But then again, I got it twice here only because the pork and sauce were super, super good.

So my boyfriend wanted to actually dine in here because of my previous take-outs and we finally did last night.  We were so excited, but knew it would be expensive considering how my take-out bills were already high up there.  We looked at the menu and there surprisingly wasn't any one thing that was particularly eye-catching.  As we sipped on our tea ($5), we ended up getting 'Tuna Flower' (not on the menu, $10ish) as an appetizer as we waited some more to decide on what to get.  The appetizer was pretty good - although it had a very strong wasabi taste to it (and I don't really like wasabi).  There were small tuna slices that were lined inside a martini glass and with wasabi + roe + tiny shreds of lettuce toppled in the middle.  The tuna seemed slightly fried on the edges and tasted sweet.  It was probably the best part of the dinner.  I give it a 4 out of 5 stars.

Then I ordered a Spicy Chirashi Don ($26) and boyfriend got Volcano roll ($13.95?) and Geisha roll (wrapped with pink soy paper, $13.95/14.95?).  I've never had a Chirashi Don, but have seen plenty at other sushi restaurants.  I thought perhaps it would have been similar, but to my surprise, a big plate (not really) came my way with small, small portions of diced tuna, salmon, white fish and a spoonful of salmon roe topped on some leafy greens and less than a bowl of rice.  Isn't Chirashi Don popular for the HUGE slices of sashimi??  The dish came with some spicy sauce, but it tasted like the sauce that comes with the popular Korean dish Bi Bim Bap (perhaps because the owner here is, indeed, Korean).  I'm not hating, but I thought Chirashi Don would be served with something like spicy mayo or spicy wasabi type sauce??  Minus points.

I took my chopsticks and put streaks of sauce onto the salad, like the server suggested, and it was okay.  'I can manage,' I thought.  Then I tried the Volcano roll.  Euh, how about there were only five TINY pieces??  Honestly, it tasted like a spicy tuna roll.  It didn't even have the usual baked salmon + spicy volcano sauce on top, but I guess every Japanese restaurant does it differently.  

At that point, I was disappointed, but still tried the Geisha roll.  Despite the prettiness, it was very plain.  Seriously??  We had to dip it into the leftover sauce we still had from the Tuna Flower to make it more edible (oh, and sauces, by the way, are $1 extra).  

After having ordered so much, we ordered two MORE rolls because of how small the other portions were - Tiger's Tail roll (with shrimp topped with spicy tuna, $13.95/14.95?) and Spicy Tuna roll ($7).  As you can see, sushi rolls here are pretty damn expensive.  The Spicy Tuna roll seemed to match the prices of normal sushi though.  Anyway, The Tiger's Tail roll was alright.  It had more pieces than the others, so that was good.  The Spicy Tuna roll was just five small pieces, but was also edible.  

Overall, dinner was disappointing and we're not even picky sushi eaters!!  The prices were too high for small portions of almost nothing - prices are comparable to a fine dining restaurant.  We wouldn't mind paying for good food, but this wasn't worth it.  If anything, if I'm really craving some Pork Katsu, I'll get to-go during lunch hours here, but that's probably it.  

P.S.  The reason for the extra star??  Because the chef is incredibly nice.  The server and chef checked in with us every now and then to make sure everything was okay.  Too bad the food wasn't up to par to us.

Great salon.  Quality cuts, color, and styling.... especially given the price!  I love Nei.  She is so sweet and did an awesome job on my hair last time I was there.  They also have great, organic hair products that are worth the investment.  I use one of the heat protectant sprays and have noticed my hair has been so much healthier even with all of the styling.

Logos is a wonderful Christian bookstore. They carefully select their stock. It is full of quality books (new and used).  They have a section for homeschooling materials. They also carry gift items ranging from stuffed animals to local artists' works. Ken, Cindy, and Ralph are very helpful.

They're pretty damn thorough on the actual pedicuring part and that's what I really get these for. I don't really care how long a polish lasts as much as i care that they take a lot of time getting my feet looking girly regardless of polish. Jiu-jitsu pretty much blasts thru any polish except for gel so i don't even bother holding my breath for that to last even one training session. 

Apparently the basic pedicure includes a scrub and massage. She took A LOT of time on the massage and wasn't all weak about it either. 

Another plus that she didn't make me have awkward chit chat! Sometimes all you wanna do is have a few minutes to yourself not thinking about too much or trying to socialize, right? ! 

$20 for all that? ? Sold. Coming back for sure.
The braised pork bowl came with a pretty pitiful amount of pork but it did taste pretty good. Had a taiwan beer for $3.50 which is pretty cool.
Sushi was great and prices are affordable. Very cute but chill environment, not too loud but a fun place to go with friends!

Issues at this location both times I've gone and now I'll never go back. First time they were so rough with the car it sucked off my magnetic car sticker (never ever had that happen in any other car wash). Went back to get it and they were gruff and kind of rude about returning it. Not to mention the whole car still wasn't clean after all that trouble. Went this past Fri night, had to uturn to get there and then the man saw me and put a cone in my way and waved me away!!!! After all that to get there! Others were going through car wash and vacuuming so I'm sure he just felt like closing early and now he's lost a customer for good!

Cornell and Nicole are great.  Funny and personable.  In terms of personal training it is very personal.  Exercises are goal directed and they go at your pace. Hours are really flexible. I work late so being able to go at 7 or 8 pm is great.  They also are very understanding of last minute changes and are happy to reschedule. They are open on weekends and will also do Skype or give me home regimens when I'm out of town or can't make it.  Gym is clean.  They vary the workouts so it never gets boring. And unlike big chains you don't feel cheated or taken advantaged of or some faceless customer.  I already convinced some of my family to also attend. They do couple or friend/group sessions too.  They have different packages for at little as 1 month to much longer if desired.

Excellent moving company. Would highly recommend! The men were professional, quick and on time. They went the extra mile and even fixed my bed! The individual who scheduled my move paid attention to detail and made sure they had all my inventory information prior to the move. The cost of the move was higher than expected, but they made my moving experience a less stressful one. Will be using this company again during a second move.

Great coffee and pastries. The pumpkin latte was better than the larger chain, and the cafe mocha was awesome.  

The owners are super nice and gave us a warm welcome. Great place to make your regular coffee hangout. Plus the drive thru is very convenient.

Absolutely delicious!! I bought 4 cupcakes on my way home from work.. two for me, two for my fiance. So far, I've had the Realli Vanilli and I was in heaven. My fiance had the Amoretti for Cherry (i think that's what it's called) and he loved it. 

Basically, I'm excited to try my second cupcake tomorrow! YUM!

Happy hour until 7 is the big headline here. 

The pizza is delicious, fresh, and fast. Had some potatoes in a bacon jam, also delicious, but a little on the light side. 

The atmosphere is nice, everybody is VERY friendly. They will certainly have my business again
C'mon it's ihop. Place is clean. Service was great(Kim) and all u can eat pancakes. What's not to love. Love the Ihop.

I wish I had read the recent Yelp reviews before going here for dinner the other night. This place is hurting bad for good service and well prepared food. After a long hard week of work all I wanted was a nice night out and to enjoy some good food with my fiance. That sure did not happen! 

1. Took about 5 minutes for a server come to our table one we were seated. (The restaurant was not very busy) 

2. She was not very friendly when she did greet us. We got the feeling we were a bother to her right off the bat. 

3. We ordered the Mediterranean platter as an appetizer and the pita seemed stale or overcooked. It was certainly not soft. 

4. I ordered a side of brown rice with my burger and was brought lentils instead. I pointed it out to the waitress who blamed the cooks and seemed very annoyed with me for pointing out the mistake. First off, maybe the cooks did mix up the order but is it not her responsibility to check the correctness of the order before it's brought to the table? Second, when she did bring me the rice it was hard and crunchy! Completely under-cooked!

5. My fiance ordered the garlic new potatoes to go with his burger and the potatoes were almost all burnt and inedible. The ones that weren't burnt didn't taste like garlic what so ever. He could have sent them back but after the attitude the waitress gave to me he didn't want to. 

6. We were not asked if we would like another round drinks or needed anything else after we had started in on our entrees. And how could we not want more drinks after such a disappointing dining experience? 

I have never had a bad experience here in the past. Food and service have always met my expectations. However, I am not sure I want to return here again anytime soon as it was absolutely not worth the $60+ we spent! 

My fiance made a comment that Taco Bell would have been a better choice for dinner and unfortunately I have to agree!

PF Changs is a pretty good place for a date, but the food is nowhere near authentic Chinese and the price is up there. I do enjoy the honey chicken, but for $15 your just paying for the atmosphere of the establishment. Service was fast and friendly

No craft in your product, for shame!

Walked in around 9pm on a Wednesday night to what can only be described as a completely generic lower state bar. 

Should have know by the lack of thought in the decor (including leftover wahoos fish tacos tables, nice touch) that this was not going to be a great culinary experience.

Garlic knots arrive with an obvious canned sauce. Pizza arrives later, doughy (turn that oven up!) with clearly sub par ingredients. Greasy. Expensive.

Staffing your restaurant with disinterested workers isn't a recipe for success.

First it seems like it's not going to be much of anything, but it's well worth your money. The portions are incredible for that amount spent, and the food is fantastic. Salads blow, but who's there for the salads. Recommend for casual dinner or takeout

I love me some Dave's dogs !! I want some rn ! I love Dave and his cooks and workers all so sweet and amAzing ! They on point and the food just is so ridiculously delicious! You will keep comming back for more ! I love them all try everything!! And keep trying them they all
So good and just different ' I didn't even like hot dogs till I went to Dave's dogs ' try combining dogs too my favorites are taco dog and Alfredo dog so dank !

After reading the reviews, we decided to go there. But the restaurant is not that impressive at all. The place is very small. Spaces between talbes are very tide. The food isn't that great either. We ordered edemame. But I can tell it is not freshly cooked but rather from left overs because I worked at Japanese restaurant before. So I can tell the edemame is dry. Then the california roll is dry too. The price of this restaurant is very expensive compare to other Japanese restaurant, but the food is not justified for the price. I will not recommend this restaurant to anyone and I will definitely not visit this place again.

Excellent donuts! Came here three times because the first two tries we missed the brûlée cinnamon roll. We finally got it and it did not disappoint. We also tried two sliders and they were tasty! Yummy chocolate chip cookie topped with salt just the way I like it! Great egg and bacon biscuit sandwich. Would be bad if we lived here. Friendly staff. Seems like a fun place to work.

I was planning on going to In N Out but something changed my mind and I came here instead. First let me tell you what made my experience 5 stars was not just the food but the service as well. Nick was very cheerful, enthusiastic and kind in both taking my order and delivering it to my table. The food, per usual, exceeded my expectations and the fries simply put all other fast food places to shame. When leaving my friend and I thanked Nick for wonderful service and he so humbly thanked us. Will be returning soon and frequently.
Best pizza in the nearby area for sure! We get their buffalo chicken pizza a lot, and it is simply to die for!!! You won't be disappointed! The cheesesteaks and subs are very good too!
Absolutely delicious! From the home made chips and salsa to the sangaria. Everything we ordered was delicious!! Loved the beans..... seriously love the beans! Great atmosphere, service and food!

We enjoy 101 Taiwanese Cuisine.  Seating is limited which can make it hard to get in on Friday and Saturday nights but worth the wait.  Prices are reasonable and portions are huge, always have leftovers.  They have TV screens that show various meals, really neat and helpful to see various dishes.

First visit for me to the DK House and the first time in 18 years for my wife.  First impression of the grounds - they badly need landscaping upgrades and improvements.  The building/porch roof badly needs attention.  Once inside, the dining areas are nicely appointed albeit needing a little TLC.  The main dining room has 7-8 tables and it can be very difficult to have a quiet dinner over the discussions of the other diners.  In hindsight, we should have asked to be seated in the smaller dining room with the fireplace.  Our appetizers were very good and fresh - shrimp cocktail for me and the shrimp/lobster bisque for my wife.  For dinner, I had the NY Strip and my wife had the Filet Mignon.  Both of our steaks were excellent.  Only complaint was from my wife as her mashed potatoes were ice cold in the middle.  Dessert was apple streusel and raspberry tort, both very good.  Service was excellent.  It was pricey ($180 including tip) but we'd go back.  I sincerely hope that the owners invest in the property as it is an iconic Chester County location.

Saw the good reviews and location was within walking distance. Put name in at VIP Lounge for Mexican food but did not want to wait the hour, so came here. No wait.

Outdoor seating was a smoking area so decided to eat inside. Singer inside performed oldies (the band America and others). Not great.

Waited a while for food and catfish came undercooked. Wife had to send back which is always a last resort but it was not edible. I had ribs which I would call cafeteria quality. Maybe came on a bad night but would not return.

Local beers on tap, stiff and delicious bloodies, and homemade deviled eggs (topped with crispy bacon and baked capers)...what's not to love? The bartender is a doll (and was here when we visited NOLA a year ago). This is a great stop to come in, cool off, and rehydrate with some tasty libations after strolling the French Market. Its right across the street. Cool spot in a cool town.

Very nice ballpark. I loved the large scoreboard and the Phillies little monument park by the bullpen area with plaques of all the past Phillies greats. I thought I may not see a game with the rain and chilly weather in the area. The game started fortunately for me so I can get the full game experience. Honestly anywhere in the stadium has good views. I loved the view of the skyline of downtown Philly even though it was cloudy on this day. The staff and ushers were very friendly and were not acting like bouncers like at my home ballpark (Globelife Park in Arlington). The staff treated me good. The food here was good and I tried some crab fries and it was very tasty. I certainly had a good time here and would highly recommend anyone else to take in a game if your visiting Philadelphia. I will be back here again in the future.

Marathon does not seem like a five-star restaurant on the surface, but when you dig deep and go there regularly, you realizw why.  The food is so delicious and so consistent there. Never a surprise. Their salads, sandwiches, and brunch items are some of my favorites in the city. Screw Stephen Starr and Jose Garces. A great home-cooked meal awaits you at Marathon!

Menu changed from what they had posted on their website that day, so we were disappointed when we got there but were willing to try other things.

Service was good and people were friendly.

Food however did not live up to the hype. Salad, trio appetizers, chicken, and trout were all average at best to bad. Perhaps other things on the menu are better, but based on these we will not ever return.

I called them for plumbing after I had a decent experience with ac...first price for academic was 800.00 for two condensers, but after I questioned it, they price was negotiated in half. Didn't argue with the house at 95 and outside temp was 110...so I called them for two leaky sinks...49.00 estimate service...tech came out, looking at refitting one pipe too short, and a leaky gasket assembly for a faucet, estimate almost 600.00..parts at Walmart couldn't have been more than 50.00...so total job couldn't be more than 200-250 tops. Called to complain about exuberant charged estimate, manager Jeff talked to me a said that you don't have to take the bid. When I mentioned a bait and switch he questioned my personality and character. When I told him that I would pay the 49 dollars and blast this on Facebook, he said he didn't want my 49 dollars. I hang up on him...told the tech he could keep his sunglasses, and I would put my plastic pipes back together. Now I have to wait for another plumber to come tomorrow to fix my issue...don't believe that the sunny plumber comes it is going to be a bright experience. Look in the distance for the monsoon that is not far behind that is going to drown you in astronomical costs for a simple job....they advertise on krq...don't take the sunglasses either, they could blind you from the solar flares their bill will cause you to experience

Tried the new Criss-Croissants with Spinach and roasted red pepper. It was great. My husband had the Denver Omelet Burger and it was tasty also. Service was good. Only thing I can say was that is was expensive for what you get.
 I will visit there again.

I will never visit again.   The restaurant"s valet took 60 minutes (a full hour) to bring my car.  Who wants to eat for 2 hours and then stand around outside for another hour waiting on car.  So frustrated.
Monday night (Wing nights 12 wings for $4 is worth it even though they only have BBQ, mild and hot).  Pretty terrible staff when it comes to attentiveness but I guess it's what you pay for.

It looks like a french dollhouse, my 5 year old daughter loves to watch them make cakes in the back. Great for very special occasions with immediate family. And the cakes are good but I'm not convinced it's $10-$14 a slice good. I actually prefer the taste of Illinois street food emporium cakes at around 1/3 the price. Still- awesome destination sweet shop to have in Indy.

Sandwich was quite good

We stopped in to grab some food, unsure what we wanted.  The order taker was patient as we scanned the menu board.  I finally settled on their Steak and White Cheddar Panini, and found it to be quite good.  I very much like that they list the calories for each item.

The place was clean and inviting and their offer to sell me a bakery item with my sandwich for only 99 cents tempting.

You order at one place and pick up your food at another.  They gave us a buzzer so we would know when it was ready, which only took a few minutes.

Food was ok. Our bartender was a sweetheart but I was a little taken back by the fact that the owner or MOD came down during our meal to reprimand her for changing the music that was playing. Extremely unprofessional and tacky to yell at employees in front of customers. Other than that, it's just a hole in the wall with mediocre, quick food. Not the worst place, just don't request to change the music.
Move in near by month ago and tried the Shrimp Salad .... awesome!! Will be going back soon.
Went to get a quick bite. Got there around 530ish. No wait. Food was great. Would def go back. Line was forming when we left at 630. So I would suggest getting there early

This my absolute favorite restaurant. We've been going there for years. Consistently delicious food and the service is always outstanding. You may need to wait a little after placing your order, but it's so worth it. Bring a bottle of wine and order the goat cheese nachos- they are the best. The soup is always great and the desserts are too... although I rarely have enough room left to order any. Play it safe and call ahead for reservations.

We loved the strawberry shortcake with whip cream and the strawberry pizza. It tasted so fresh and delicious. They didn't have much produce because they were closing down for the season. We really enjoyed the sweets! I would recommend it to anyone.

Family and I came here to try To-Kai because it was part of the UPromise Dining rewards Program.  Although pricey, we were hapy to find a new place to make it a regular in our list of restaurants.  The food for the family is below:
 
Japanese Mojito: 5 Stars.  Refreshing and not too stiff!  I probably could have had many of these, but stuck with one.

3 piece Dumpling Soup: 2 Stars.  Bland, dumplings I could find anywhere, did not finish.

Mango Soft Shell Crab Salad:  5 Stars.  The best food of the night.  The description is Mango, Crab Meat, Seaweed Salad, Lettuce, Avocado Salad and Masago on the Bottom, Whole Soft Shell Crab on Top.  This could have been a meal by itself.  Extremely tasty and just the right amount of sizzling crab on top with an amazing sauce.

Duck Rolls: 4 Stars.  Wonderful with no grease taste - Deep Fried Roasted Duck and Taro Finished with Sweet Soy and Honey Wasabi Sauce.  I expected duck meat pieces, but it was more of a hamburger meat texture.  Still, very tasty!

I Phone 4S Roll: 3 Stars.  Felt like it was warmer-than-room temperature which was a bit off putting.  Also, I had so much food that I probably did not enjoy it as much as I should have.  Crunchy Spicy Crab with Seared Sea Scallop on top.  

Teriyaki Bento Box Salmon:  3 Stars.  Comes with Salad, Soup, Rice, California Roll, Shrimp Tempura, Shumai, Fruit.  Wife said there was too much tempura in the box with the vegetables, and did not finish it.  However, the salmon was very tasty, and she did not like the California Roll.  Fruit was 1/2 an orange.  The tempura shrimp was really nice, though.

Overall, it came to $96 for 2 adults and 1 kid including tip, so for lunch this was expensive!  There are a lot of choices, so I'll be back to try others.  They have a hibachi on the one side which I'd like to try, too.  To-Kai also has 6 party tray specials from $34 to $80 for catering!

Service for our empty restaurant was ok.  Too long to take our orders; just right to get the food and drinks.

Got my car tuned up at this shop. They did a shody job that blew up 3 catalytic converters and cost me $3700 to get it fixed. The shop that repaired my car also told me that things like brake fluid change that I was charged for was not done. And I was also charge for a cabin air filter that does not even go in my car. THESE GUYS ARE A RIP OFF and incompetent at what they do

I cannot express the high level of customer service I received from this location. They were very busy and took the time to bring my suit jacket to my hotel. Exceptional! Thanks Rashon!! This is why I'm a loyal customer.
Great food, great staff. Beautiful venue. Better not be in a rush if you dine here. The staff want you to take the time to enjoy your visit and your food.

Once again, the reliable Yelp community led me to another great business while on my last trip to Arizona. I was craving something cool and dismissed the fact that it was about 60 degrees out (yes, 60 degrees is considered cold for Hawaii locals)!  Frost Gelato has a nice large corner location in Tucson on the long and semi-rundown strip of Tanque Verde Road and is in a newer building than ones of their neighbors. 

Frost Gelato is housed in a bright clean and spacious space that offers both indoor and outdoor seating. My timing was perfect as there were only two other customers and I found a prime parking stall right in front of the shop and didn't have to wait in line. I was immediately greeted by two friendly employees and they were patient with me while I tried to decide on what flavor gelato I wanted. Of course I wanted all 38 flavors that they offer but I had to be reasonable! What helped was that they offered free samples and I finally decided on cheesecake and salted caramel. I got it in a cup and although their gelato is a bit pricey, it was well worth it because the flavors were on point and the serving was pretty generous. They stuck a wafer roll in the gelato which gave it a nice touch. 

They also have waffle cones and sugar cones including their Spizzico cones which are their miniature sugar cones. The next time I'm in the Tucson area, I will find a way to make it back to Frost Gelato. Why wouldn't I? They have the whole package-great customer service, a nice clean and spacious location with ample parking, and the gelato's top notch! 2 down, 36 flavors to go...
Menu tries a bit too hard to be trendy, but this place is awesome for almost any occasion.  Casual, formal, rushed, or relaxed, the atmosphere and service will oblige.

First time in Nashville, our group stopped here for lunch. great experience! They are knowledgeable with what beers that have to offer & what you are looking for. The food was served hot & fresh! Hopefully we will return before our visit here is over.

I just moved to Tucson as a full-time resident about 2 months ago.  I first heard of The Screamery about 4 months ago in Kansas City, after researching the area and finding cool businesses I wanted to try when I got here.  I've probably been to the store now half a dozen times or more!  

I'm all about including 100% grass-fed dairy (and meats) in my diet whenever possible.  I heard the comments about how expensive it is ... But really you get what you pay for.  If I wanted cheaper frozen concoctions with 15-20 ingredients and (mostly) not cared for cows then the other guys would be the ticket.  

The ingredients here are few, simple and super delicious.     Today they had a new flavor (to me) Peanut Butter and Prickly Pear Jam (PB&J).  I got a pint of that and had to try their #1 seller the Sweet Cream Honeycomb ... fantastic!!   You can of course sample any of their flavors.  Every employee (including the owners) are great at customer service and making you feel welcome to be there.
The beer is mediocre. Every time I have come here the staff has been rude and inconsiderate. I wish the staff would just be a bit friendlier. That way I could appreciate the over priced ales.

I was having a lazy Sunday afternoon, so I decided to order delivery from this place after reading through all the raving reviews. I was going to order from where I always do, but they were closed so I decided to try out Erawan. I should have just chosen somewhere else, because I was pretty disappointed.

I ordered a pad thai (2 spice) and a tom yum soup with chicken (3 spice). I placed my order at 4pm, but it came at 6pm. Seriously, 2 hours for a quick stir fry and a soup? Not to mention that my delivery address was 3 minutes away by car.
I was extremely hungry by then so I was expecting a meal that was worth the ridiculous wait. The tom yum soup was pleasantly spicy, and had the right amount of sourness to it. The chicken, however, was stone-hard when I rescued it from the bottom of the soup container. It was WAY overdone, and had no flavor whatsoever. Next time the cook should season the meat before he/she dumps it into the soup.

I was much more disappointed by the pad thai. The noodles were just overcooked and soggy. It felt like I was eating senior food because it was so soft. The sauce was also terribly bland, and I had to grab some soy sauce and chili sauce from my cupboard to give it some flavor. Also, there was absolutely no spice whatsoever, despite my specifying for a 2-level spice. I don't know why people have been raving about their pad thai. And I know what real pad thai is like - I lived in Thailand for two years.

We had a very positive experience at the Taproom on a Friday night.  We were rolling in with a large group (approx. 12 people).  No reservations here and it was initially hard to find space.  There never ended up being enough table space available for more than maybe 4 people, but somehow we ended up etching out an area almost big enough at the bar.  The service was wonderful.  The bartenders got us all beers within minutes of us entering and remained friendly and attentive throughout the night.  The beer battered green beans ARE delicious.  (Thank you Yelpers for the recommendation.)  My friend and I split the pulled pork and the grilled cheese special, which on this evening was a brie and broccoli rabe combo.  Both were very tasty and everyone seemed quite pleased with their meals.  The fries and salad as a side are extremely tasty too.  The beer list is pretty good, though it by no means can compete with the heavy duty beer bars around the city.  There were a couple beers on special for $4 (Coronado wit?) but most beers were regularly listed at $5-$7.  This is OK, but I usually like there to be a cheaper option beer if possible after having a few $5.50 drafts or whatever...  Anyway, that's a fairly minor complaint in a generally positive experience.  This place deserves a very solid 4 stars.

What everyone else said about this laundromat is true: it is exceedingly clean, well kept, safe, priced right and the people who work here are friendly and helpful. What more can you want from a laundromat?

I came here to get my duvet washed. I could have washed it here myself, but as someone smarter than me recently said: "Ain't no one got time for that." So I dropped it off with the friendly launderette who was sitting at the counter. She took my info, told me when I could pick it up, and asked me what kind of detergent to use. (She listed off like five different kinds. I chose unscented Tide.) Three hours and $19 dollars later, I have a clean, fresh, nicely folded duvet ready to be put back on my bed. My clean duvet also came in a nice plastic bag with a handle. It's a dang miracle, I tell you.

If my washer and dryer ever conk out, this will be the place I visit to wash and dry my laundry. In the mean time, I like knowing that I have a place where I can drop off random things that are too big for my washer, and they will come back sparkling (and it won't cost me a fortune).

Our server was wonderful! she was attentive, sweet, knowledgeable of the food and its preparations. This place operates like clockwork.  The host was welcoming and the support staff was attentive and aware what was going on around them.  Staff gets a 5 star or (Starr)..lol
Now lets talk about the food. First off, our meals were not bad. They were average.  They did however, lack flavor.  It might sound strange to say this, but our food and the space lacked identity. I feel like all Starr restaurants are known to have an identity and the food reflects that identity. This was definitely a weak point. This place was "good" but not what I assumed a Starr restaurant would be about.  We did attend there brunch a few time and thought it was very good, our meals at dinner were uneventful and a little  disappointing.

I have been here many times and am never disappointed!  The service is great and the waitresses are always polite.  The last time I was there I had the Thursday special, the bison burger, and it was awesome!  Great flavor.  I also like how there is outside seating and some of the indoor seating includes couches at tables.

Had a good experience going to this place for the first time. They had lockers to put our things into while we changed into our robes and slippers. The deep tissue massage was wonderful and the ambience was on point. There was relaxing music and the massage table was warm so that was nice. The quiet room had tea and water, it would have been nice if we were offered other things. We used the spa wish gift card and checked into Yelp for an additional 10% off. Can't complain there! 
We left feeling sooo relaxed afterwards. Definitely is a treat you should give yourself at least once!

First time going in, and this will be my last. The service was subpar at best. Our server was barely at our table and took forever to get our food to us. We were there for lunch and it took 20 minutes to get a side salad out (and it ended up coming right before my entree). I ordered the salmon and I took 1 bite and noticed something was off with the taste. It was so noticeable that I had my sister try it and she noticed the taste too. I couldn't even finish my food.. At the end of it all our server brought boxes for us and the one on top had food in it already.. Needless to say we will not be returning.

Went there this week to make a purchase and I thought I knew exactly what I wanted....I looked around a bit and I started to change my mind (2 ppl offered assistance in a very friendly manner with a smile, I just refused because I was browsing) when I was ready an expert by the name of Justin H. Helped my wife and I out...VERY knowledgable and friendly he took a lot of time explaining a bunch of different aspects of certain pistol models we were choosing from, this was especially gainful for my wife who is BRAND NEW to the idea of shooting and owning a gun.  Justin sold me on an excellent pistol at a very competitive price....now I don't mean he pushed one model...he explained facts (not his preferences) about multiple and his knowledge and passion sold me on a particular model that was priced well.  Thanks for the assistance Justin H.
Always looking for a good pizza place so had high hopes. Unfortunately was disappointed as the pizza had little to no flavor.

I ate here a very long time ago. One of Philadelphia's oldest, original Italian restaurants. Food was delicious. I especially remember loving the meatballs and you can judge a good Italian place by two things:  meatballs and marinara!

Highly recommend if you are in town.

Two stars so far......
We finally got to go here last night after I talked them up to my friends.
We called ahead to make sure they were wheelchair accessible since one of my friends was in a chair (one of those 400lb motor car ones).

When I got there we were the 1st ones and we got some summer rolls (which were okay, but no where near as good as Pho Grand IMO).
I also got the Thai iced coffee and thought it was a little too sweet for me.

When my friends got there we noticed there was a step to get in and we asked for a ramp.  They had no clue what we were talking about.  We reminded them that we already called ahead and they said they were accessible but I don't think they even know what that means.

We had to leave and were given no apology whatsoever.
We ended up walking down the street in the rain to The King and I who did have a ramp.

What a mess of a night.

I had the southwestern chicken egg rolls as an appetizer and fish tacos as my entrée. The beers are absolutely great, the Java mocha stout is really smooth, any Guinness fan would love it. They also have beer samplers available; I'll be going back back before I leave Tucson

Perfect place to bring kiddos when the weather is yuck out!  I've never met a child that didn't know what Monkey Joe's is... Whether 2 years old or 6 years old - they ALL love it.

Staff is nice and the place is as clean as it can be with the amount of children running around and touching everything.

Best Indian food I have ever had. Recommend lamb korma but all their food is phenomenal.  Lunch buffet is also great as they mix it up every day so you can try things you may not be brave enough to order off the menu.  Wife and I eat here about once to twice a month.  Can't say enough good things about this place

Everyone seems to be complaining about prices but I kind of disagree. First off, their triple berry cake is the BEST. The fruits are fresh and the cake batter is not too sweet. The small goods I must say are a little bit pricey but if you look at the details and how nice it looks you get what you pay for. The ice cream is amazing, birthday cake would be my personal fave. Kitchen Sink is the big talk of the place but I haven't come around to trying. 

I come here from time to time for their breakfast if I'm tired of my regular Pho fix. lol. My boyfriend & I came in two weeks ago and decided to sit outside under the umbrella. With New Orleans bipolar weather, soon enough mister sun didn't shine and the July showers came down on us. The waiter was inside and didn't come outside to assure us if we wanted to move. So we closed our own umbrella and went inside hoping we bumped into the waiter to let him know. He refilled our drink and apologized for the inconvenience. I ordered the best banker croissant and my boyfriend had the 222. The best banker tasted better than I expected but my boyfriend's 222 was small proportioned. When our food arrived my waiter again was no where to be seen when I realized we didn't have our utensils so I actually got up and got it myself. Overall, food was good & worth the price. Better service next time please?

I'm surprised there is not more reviews on here for Michael.  He was amazing! The entire experience was very pampering.  He listens to exactly what you want.  The first time I went to the salon I got corrective color.  I can not say enough about how I unhappy I was with my look and when I left I felt amazing.  He really did a perfect job and my hair looked fabulous which I was very skeptical that it would.  I am a "hair snob" and loved the experience and studio.  He has done my cut perfect every time.  He is upfront with what will turn out and what may not so there is no surprises.  He really wants your hair to look fabulous and it has every time.  You can tell all of his experience throughout the cut and color process.   He is extremely professional and creates an wonderful ambiance.  The studio is in a great location and easy to find. I have already recommended him to my co workers and would to anyone else I know.  I couldn't imagine anyone being unhappy with him.

Saw employees eating as they served food (french fries), without gloves. The bathroom was in disarray with the trash can dumped all over the floor. A child had urinated in the play area, which was cleaned, after about 10 minutes of waiting and trying to keep children away. All the tables were dirty. They really need to step up their cleanliness and teach their employees not to put their foods or their mouths near the food while they're working.

I love this area (Frenchman street) of New Orleans. Great food and live music!! I was taken here by two NOLA locals. The food was modest and homey. It gave me a very local taste. I was slightly disappointed that the food was not spicey, but all in all a good meal. Wait staff is prompt and courteous with good ole southern charm.

Great food! The Chef uses true latin ingredients fusioned in an interesting and delicious way. The servers are attentive, polite and friendly, and the music is very good. Overall Delicia is one of my favorite restaurants in Indianapolis.

At 630pm the line was longer than I had ever seen it with people backed up to the door. Kudos to the staff for working so diligently to keep the line moving quickly and efficiently. It was well worth the wait once we sat down to eat.
Harry the bar tender and waiter was dead on with both drink and food recommendations flavors were well balanced and was well priced for the freshness. Will def be coming back

If you ever wanna dance, dance, dance while you're covered in sweat(yours and others'), this is the place to be. It can get ridiculously hot because 1. the dance floor is always packed, 2. the DJ usually spins tunes that are purely awesome, and 3. the loud music literally commands your body to move.

The crowd is fairly young or young-looking. Totally love all the cute hipster boys and girls. 

Oh, almost forgot. The upstair bar is open - not sure if it's just open for the summer but it's a chill place to hangz with friends even on a weekend night.

Very nice hotel in a safe location yet perfect location. 1 block from the street cars on Canal St and 2 blocks from the end of Bourbon st. Far enough away from the late night noise that it is relatively quiet.  Only 1/2 mile from Jackson square so you have the option to walk or take the street car. 
They must have recently renovated because everything in our room looked brand new and beautiful, even the fixtures in the bathroom. Granite counter tops! Very clean, even the grout in the bathrooms was sparkling white.  
Beautiful lobby and room service comes from the restaurant downstairs.  
Security was great at night, they make sure you are a guest before letting you up the elevators. 
My only complaint was parking was tight and there was not enough. our second night there I heard security say that 5 cars were stuck in the garage trying to turn around. Do not bring your giant suv.
Also...book directly from them they price match and have an option to choose a room that includes parking.

Yolklore challenges assumptions that a counter-service restaurant can't deliver thoughtful, elevated food. I was so impressed with my frittata and my husband raves about the Billy the Kid. All the ingredients were top notch and all dishes were plated beautifully. Delicious. Great kid options available. My son devoured his little dipper pancakes. The restaurant is a bit small, so you may struggle to find a table during busy weekend hours, but the staff is very welcoming and helpful.

After coming here a few times, I now feel confident giving this review:

The food here is pretty good, but it depends on what you get. They have very tasty seafood, pho, shrimp, salmon, green beans, and chicken. Now the hot and sour soup is okay, but usually comes without much in it. They have "baked steak" as an option but seriously, who eats baked steak? 

The service here is great, but I wish they would correct some of their practices. For example, they leave finished food trays right next to trays people are still taking food from. It doesn't come off as trying to be sanitary with the place. If you do the Hibachi grill and can't manage to sprint to the counter the moment its ready, expect the bell to be rung by the chef until you do pick it up. He either has a obsession ringing the bell or doesn't have a lot of patience. Either way, it gets a little annoying. Besides these two pet peeves, they do a good job greeting you and the servers do take care of you with a smile. Just watch out for the workers who stock the food; they act as if no one is around them.

I know there is much to stay about the name, "U Like". It has been the subject of many easy puns depending on if the person actually enjoyed the place or not. The name itself does its purpose of garnering attention, but can suffer the drawback if the person does not like the place. Of course, what do you do when you thought the place was okay. Do I just say it is the "Kinda Like Buffet?"

Overall, I give this place 3/5 stars. It can quite noisy at this place, and there is a general tendency (with a lot of buffet places) that kids have have a lot of freedom running around the food areas. I wish some parents would do a better job with their kids, but I'm not a parent yet so maybe this is meant to be their free time. I am a sucker for cooked seafood and vegetables, and this place I can have as much as I want. I do plan on continue eating here because I am the buffet type of guy. As long as the food is not artificial and has enough healthy options, I will be at the buffet, regardless if the food isn't 5 star quality.

When visiting my friend in Tucson, I needed to get my brunch on before exploring the city. She recommended Prep and Pastry as her favorite go-to spot, and girl, was she right! Being extra hungry, as one usually gets when on vacation, I ordered what I thought to be too much food, and basically ate it all 'cuz it was that good. You can get the chili French toast and you will be pleased with the salty sweetness combo, as other yelpers mention, you can try their take on the doughnut/croissant hybrid  the "dossant," which is pretty good, however, someone in your party HAS to order the grilled cheese - preferably YOU! Ordering this grilled cheese sandwich has been one of the best (top ten) decisions I've ever made! This buttery, crispy, and gooey asiago bread one-ups your childhood favorite with pesto smeared in between its slices and topped off with a warm little squishy tomato. The creaminess of the white cheddar mixed in with the smokiness of the tomato make this vegetarian sandwich taste as rich as if you're eating bacon! Dunk it in the tangy tomato bisque, and take a big bite of Prep's garlicky herby roasted potatoes, and just sit there taking all of the goodness in. Their website isn't kidding: "The Best Breakfast & Brunch in Tucson, AZ". Come hungry. Seriously.

love the laid back vibe and the patio that faces the monon. they have several good things. i like the drunken ravioli, pub ploughmans platter, and beer crock cheese. my kiddos love their chicken finger meals and everything is reasonably priced. wait staff is always great.
Food is amazing as always! Service was wonderful too with Alex! A bit cramped and very loud but all in all worth it for the food!!

This review is not for the actual rooms but for the top floor and terrace.  I was here for a reception and I wasn't quite sure where I was going.  The gentleman at the front desk seemed more than happy to help me and directed me where I needed to go.  Somehow he magically knew what I needed almost right away.  Anyway, top floor is gorgeous.  In a word, think MadMen.  The views are stunning especially as the sun sets and you get to see the city light up.  There staff was friendly and seemed eager to help everyone.  I didn't get to try some of the food because I didn't get around to it, but what I did have, some cooked vegetables, some pita and cheeses, were good.  I think the vegetables would have tasted better if they had kept them heated.  The drinks were good too!  As the reception was wrapping up, several attentive bartenders came up to us to make sure we had gotten any last drink orders in.  That impressed me because usually people just wanna close up shop and peace out, not ask for more work.  There were also a bunch of desserts.  My favorite was the fruit tart.  Just melt-in-your-mouth delicious!
I love my people at Diamond Nails...they are the best! They are always soo accommodating and go above and beyond to make sure you're  satisfied. Good prices for great services.

Great food and service at a reasonable price.  We had a terrible experience the night before at Sloppy Joes ... Bad food, mediocre service at a place that also good good reviews from Yelp.  So a bit leery of the ratings and stars given.  I'm pleased to say Captain Bills lived up to its ratings.  Started off with a cold beer an a dozen oysters.  Beer was cold, oysters plump and juicy.  I had the scallops, my wife had grouper.  Both well prepared and delicious.  The staff was friendly and outgoing adding to the experience.  The owner stopped by to introduce herself and make sure we were being well taken care of.  Also a long visit with the Host, who is a fellow NYer, for friendly conversation.  All in all a great experience.  I would highly recommend Captain Bills if your in the area.
The menu is outstanding -- some great ceviche, fish taco, and other seafood options you won't find at any other taqueria in town. Great balance of flavors and big portions. Servers are friendly, too.

Still loving this place, but feel like I need to bring an extra container for the excess cream chesse. Not complaining that they give you a lot of product, but I also dont want to die from a cream cheese heart attack!!
We've tried them all and this is our go to for pizza in the Montgomeryville/Chalfont area.

Came to dinner with a friend of mine to start the waitress we had didn't know anything about the cuts of steak or the wine. The food was actually really good had a filet with a baked potato however the lack of knowledge and lack of presence is what made me give it 2 stars. I got a glass of red wine with dinner and asked the waitress if it could be chilled which she followed do you want a glass of ice with and of course I declined and after eating and drinking about half the glass I noticed something interesting in the wine that shouldn't have been there. Asked 1 waitress what it could be and her response was "it's from the wine sitting to long" which was the dumbest thing I've ever heard I proceeded to ask our actual waitress what it could be from and she replied with " it's probably from the ice we used to chill it" however it looked like oil not water. The manager came over and could differentiate what it could have been.

If you're looking for a place with good steak and wine try mortons or del friscos. I will not be back at this restaurant more so because of the lack of knowledge

The drive into the restaurant was spectacular, and it is a super fun place to pull into and visit. The dining experience however was the opposite of spectacular. 
We dined with our daughter (who is very used to restaurants)- I would not recommend this restaurant for children going forward. It is a very quiet restaurant and her normal happy toddler chatter was very out of place- any level of music or normal conversation would have easily drowned her out. Another couple even commented to us that they felt uncomfortable to talk in the restaurant. 
My husbands peppercorn steak was literally all peppercorns. He ended up needing to scrape off the sauce to eat any part of the meal. My crab ravioli was a confusing combination of flavors that ended up only tasting of the vegetables surrounding the ravioli plate.  
Both my husband and I do not feel that the 4 star rating is accurately representative of the food quality- especially compared to the neighboring food choices.
Wonderful massage with Jessah.. my head was so relaxed it felt like It was floating! Thank you for the massage, I'll definitely be booking again!

Ate lunch there for the first time. We both had the pulled pork sandwich. Pork was very tender and juicy. One of the best we have had in Pinellas County! Prices were reasonable. Service was very good.

Stayed here a few times over the years. The front desk is very friendly. They even upgraded us to the ocean front at the same price. Rooms along the front are spacious and remodeled. Recommend the balcony. Parking is a bit tight  it it's in a good location to experience Santa Barbara. Not as expensive as the ones closer to Stearns Wharf.

Great restaurant!  Just ate here for breakfast this morning after having eaten here the other night for dinner (which was our first night in New Orleans).  For dinner the other night, the service was excellent.  For breakfast this morning, somehow it was even better.  I'll start with this morning's breakfast.

Our server, Jackson, was completely on top of his game.  I cannot say enough how much I appreciated not only the excellent service he provided us, but I could tell from observing him with other tables that he is an outstanding server, because I noticed other people trying to order items not really on the menu, and in each case he was extremely accommodating.  You don't always find that attitude and approach in restaurants these days.  But Jackson just offered to "make it happen," as he put it himself.  That's awesome in and of itself.  In our case, we did go just a bit outside the menu but nothing too outlandish - my wife ordered scrambled eggs, hash browns, plain and simple, and that combination just didn't happen to be on the menu but Jackson was happy to oblige.

For me, the fried chicken on a biscuit with tabasco honey was terrific!  Man, that tabasco honey was great!  And so was the fried chicken, moist, and tasty.  And the biscuit itself was great, too.  And those GRITS, they are also great. Do not touch them.  Don't add butter, pepper, or salt.  Just eat them as is because they have plenty of flavor.

An outstanding breakfast at Luke.  Nice ambiance too.  And I haven't even gotten to dinner.  I must say service was excellent for dinner, and I had shrimp and grits, which was very good, but for the star of the dinner show was the happy hour oysters and shrimp.  SO fresh and delicious and you can't beat the happy hour prices.  Plus those French 75s are delicious and also on the happy hour menu!  Like is a FINE restaurant!

Went there again today to purchase 2 used tires to replace 2 that were well worn.  Again, great customer service, great price.  I got there at 3pm and was back on the road by 3:25pm.  These guys do things the old-fashioned way--treat the customer right--and it shows.  Would not hesitate to recommend them!

This Walgreens location is horrible. I waited in line for over ten minutes to drop off prescriptions. When the tech finally got to me, he started playing with his computer and then walked away. He came back and walked away again. The tech next to him ignored me when I tried to talk to her and instead started helping another customer. As I was still waiting, I realized the problem was The Tim the tech forgot to charge the prior customer for what he had purchased so he was frantically trying find the man's phone number to call him and ask him to come back to pay. Tech 2, Melisa, finished with customer she took before me and asked if I needed something. I handed her the prescriptions and she flipped through them and asked "You're not going to wait for these, are you?" When I told her I was she rolled her eyes and snorted, "It'll be 30-40 minutes. You should really just go home." No, I waited, but I will go to a more customer friendly Walgreens next tune

This is just a shoutout to Devyn, a truly phenomenal hairstylist. I did a terrible job of explaining how I wanted my hair cut, and she still gave me by far the best hair cut I ever had. She is simply incredible!

I've been wanting to try this place since it opened and finally got a chance on my 5th wedding anniversary! While I take my baby son out to many restaurants, this isn't the kind of place I wanted to spend a bunch of money at and have to worry about him. So we came child-free. We made a reservation, which was a good idea. It was packed! We were seated upstairs, and as some others mention, it was LOUD. It didn't help that one party seated near us was quite obnoxious - to the tune of everyone turning around and staring. While it wasn't a romantic ambiance, it was still an enjoyable meal.

We started with the roasted cauliflower and the fries with ketchup and aioli. Both were delicious. The cauliflower came with golden raisins and gremolata. The fries were thin, salty, and had delicious dipping sauces. We cleaned our plates and washed them down with beer (him) and pineapple agua fresca (me). They have a huge list of wine and spirits here, and even a sommelier. I'm abstaining from alcohol currently but my husband enjoyed his pour. We continued our meal with the burger (him) and ratatouille (me). He enjoyed the burger with more fries, though said it was a little unimaginative. I LOVED the ratatouille. It had penne pasta, eggplant, zucchini and summer squash in a red pepper tomato sauce and lots of cheese. It came with a huge nest of arugula on time, which I removed (yuck, my least favorite green). I wanted to lick my plate. The flavors were intense. I'm not even a huge fan of eggplant unless it's very well prepared, like here. We finished with desserts, the pumpkin tart with maple ice cream and the oat financier cake with caramel apples and creme fraiche. Both were again, amazing. The oat cake was so flavorful and moist, perfectly complimented by the apples and creme. My husband almost didn't want us to order two to share because he was so full, but he couldn't stop eating them either. For two drinks, two apps, two entrees and two desserts, the bill was about $75 before tip. Not bad at all for this quality of meal. 

Service was on point all night. They have a lot of staff and seem to take somewhat of a team approach. I saw many people delivering food and helping out other than servers. We rarely had empty water glasses or dirty dishes on our table for more than a minute. 

Overall, a great experience and I will be back. They start serving brunch soon and I plan on trying it. Hopefully the crowds that we saw also enjoyed it and it stays around. Great addition to Maplewood!

Neat and trendy little ice cream shop on Whyte Ave and the other side of the tracks. Went there during Art Walk and there was a bit of a line. The lines moved pretty quickly though and soon we were at the front. They had four flavors. You could mix only certain combinations since they come out of a soft serve machine. We ended up getting yam and coconut flavor swirl. The cone cost 5.50 and the flavors were nice and not overly sweet which fit my personal preference. It is definitely a bit on the pricey side but I think worth a try. It's nice to see stores like this opening up along Whyte Ave.
I love this place. I go in frequently and I love that when I go in with my daughter, that Larry knows exactly what we want and he makes it perfect every time.

If you are a vegan, go here. Even if you're not a vegan, go here. This is a prime example of what vegan food should be. They nailed everything from the food to the decor.  No detail was missed. Excellent flavors and great service. Sat with a group of four and we all agreed it was a delicious meal worth the price of admission.

BY FAR THE BEST BBQ IN THE PLANET. I GET THE PULLED PORK. IT'S SO FILLING YOU COULD GET AWAY WITH JUST A HALF. He's only open Friday, Saturday and Sunday soooo make sure your up in the area on those days and pick one up! BEST by far!

This place was a random find on yelp. When we first pulled in we were unsure if we made a good choice. It was a fantastic find! Everything we ate was amazing. Nate was very friendly and you could tell that the crowd was full of 'regulars'. I strongly recommend.

So good!!!  Food, Service and drinks were amazing.  I was in town for a business trip and we went here for dinner one night.  Was just a great choice.  The waitress was so nice and had great recommendations for us - If I'm ever back in the area - I need to visit Jones again.

We stopped in here to get our fliers beignet and they were outstanding, also had a piece of carrot cake and not so good but I guess that's why it's called Cafe Beignet. We were lucky enough to sit really get down at the last available table and listen to a live band and enjoy a beignet and price was reasonable also.
Really good, lots of options for toppings, sauces, and even vegan cheese if you want. Good prices and tasty! I liked the wood fired taste.
I never thought I'd be back but after two company lunches I must say the food, service and overall experience was so much better.
Experience was not a delightful one. Usually you pay for what you get in this case that is very untrue. I will not return!
Went here for the first time for the dinner buffet. The service was excellent, there was a great variety of food, and it was all tasty. Would come back again!
I love, love, love this place and will pass this on to the next generation just as my grandmother has done to my mother, and my mother has done to me. I'm sure they'll still be open. LOL
Hands down our favorite Pizza place! We come here regularly and the service and food has always been consistent! Margaritas is delicious! We love TPC!!!

We just moved to the area and found the Blue Fig not far from our house.  The manager was very nice and made us feel right at home.

The food was really good and high quality.  I ordered the "Duo".  Both the Chicken and the Gyro meat were very good.  My wife got the Falafel plate and was happy with her choice as well. 

We went back two days later to give you an idea of how much we liked it.  New staple for us.
Great store!  Much larger than the old space and better layout. The food court selections are more varied and seating is much better

I definitely would return to the Brew Pub as there were many other choices on the menu that sounded delicious, plus their own brand of beer which we didn't sample. We went for lunch and my companion was thrilled with the vegetarian selection. My lunch was chosen from a large selection (not vegetarian) and was delicious. They serve local sodas from the fountain with refills and what I had was delicious. We ate outside on the patio which is on the street so there is some traffic noise. It would also be lovely to eat inside - it has a very pub like atmosphere.

UPDATE: They have a jumbo size now, thus eliminating the pettiness of my complaint at having no drink left by the time I arrive at my destination after purchasing a regular boba. 

I come here almost weekly, and am still trying to figure out the sugar quantities in these drinks, it's either too much or too little, and appears to differ greatly based on who is making your drink. I still thoroughly enjoy the Jasmine Green Milk Tea with regular boba, and am still struggling to find a new flavor due to my inability to order outside of this.

Usually this place runs smoothly but today seemed a bit confusing with no clarification. Had an appointment booked which was "time sensitive. " Line up was literally out the door. No one could figure out if there was two separate lines - one for walk in and one for appointments booked. I went to everyone in line and asked if anyone had booked appoint and everyone said no. Then I asked them if I could ask the question- no one else wanted to. So I asked - the receptionist was polite but could not clarify about line ups and scheduled visits- only to point to a screen to see your name. Once I asked however - they had put me in the system and then said "next time wait in line." I said I was more than willing to go back to the line and not jump cue but they moved me to the front. Made me feel really bad and prob pissed a few off. I said loudly that it's not clear for anyone else about the line up and appointments and until then - some other lab technician came and started diverting ppl in line and it shrunk in less than a minute. Ppl started following my cue. So hopefully they become more transparent on the process and indicate even online that when booking - you still have to wait in line at the lab regardless of booked time or not . They are fast and friendly however when it comes to actually taking the blood. This is the only one I go to so I have no comparison. But I'd suggest a less popular site (few people in cue)  if your blood work is time sensitive. Maybe worth that trek. Or be prepared to wait in a very crowded wait room. They have enough seats but even today- ppl were standing and waiting.

Great Place!!! Very modern!!! My wife enjoyed her Pho and I was especially looking forward to the sizzling hot plate w/ beef and eggs and French bread and pate and butter!!! And I was not disappointed!!!! I will definitely be back when I'm in the area again!! Thanks for the meal!!!

This was my second experience at Syberg's and much better than my first.  My first dinning experience was at the Syberg's on Dorsett where I ate the veggie pizza.  That was not the best pizza nor best experience.  Recently, my lunch on market was better.  I ordered the Syberg's Veggie Burger, which impressed me.  The thickness of the patty was similar to a juicy, thick burger.  Although it was not what anyone would categorize as juicy, but it definitely possessed the grilled flavor of a burger.  The bread, however, was nothing special and really not worth eating.  I would recommend sticking to the "Syberg's" labeled items and having a dish that includes the famous Syberg's sauce.
Their new white bean burger is absolutely positively incredible. I am a vegetarian and this is the best veggie burger I have ever had. My eyes rolled in the back of my head. Will be back tomorrow.

Love this place! The service is great and the food is delicious! I tried the mofongo con camarones and it was fantastic. Chef Carlos does a great job with the food he makes. Also tried their pastrami sandwich (just like they make it in Puerto Rico!) and their beef empanadas! And, they do local delivery on orders of $20 or more!?
The tuna tataki has my heart here...so amazing.  The James bond roll also were great......ordered a slew of stuff.  Was delicious .  Wish they opened up one closer to me in jersey :)
Had looked forward to going there for something yummy. Unfortunately, got the sticky bun which was very mediocre.  And at 2.99, overpriced (I guess anything is overpriced when it doesn't taste good).
Probably the best lobster place in the area we love to go for the summer lobsters in August. They couldn't be better.
The food here was fabulous, fresh and great tasting.  Can't wait to come here again.  The vegetables were crisp, but tender and the potion size was perfect.
Amazing breakfast / brunch spot. Our family ordered omelet, bngs, and doughnut ...so tasty! Great service, friendly people, absolutely will go back next time we are in town.

Really reasonably priced boutique hotel.  I stayed here over the memorial weekend and I was really impressed overall with my friends choice.  The location can't be beat.  You are far enough removed from the madness of certain steets while still being able to walk everywhere.  The prices are super reasonable.  I think I paid $169 / night over this holiday weekend.  That was the cost for a room with two double beds.  The room was especially small and the bathroom was made for a doll house, but who spends any time in the room.  They did have a mini-bar which was good and bad for obvious reasons.  The TV wasn't a flat screen, but so what that just helped me from ordering the overpriced movie options.  The staff was very nice and I especially liked Ms. Eva the concierge who I used for some reason every day.  As soon as I got there on Friday she was able to track me down within minutes a tailor that did one hour alterations and her other suggestions were good.  This place houses the carousel bar, which is a must visit.  I can't speak to the food since we didn't eat here, but I'm sure it would be decent.  The pool was okay, but didn't spend much time.  Don't really need to work on the tan.  They have a great spot for beignet right next door (cafe beignet).  The beignet are just as good as cafe du monde' without the wait.  The spa was a little below average.  Save your spa experience for some of the bigger luxury hotels.  Overall a great deal and a good experience.  I'll go again.

The wait staff at this store is terrible. After ordering online, arrived at the store on time, waiting for five minutes for someone to come out, I had to call the store twice for someone to finally come out. After arriving home, my order was wrong. Base on this experience and past unsatisfactory visit, I have decided that I will not dine at this store again. Nor will I recommend it to anyone.

Great service.
Great red curry. Would not change a single thing about the flavors.
Peaceful and well decorated. A good place to take a date.

DO NOT GO HERE UNLESS YOU MIGHT DIE OF STARVATION !!! I kid you not that my meal took 36 minutes in the drive thru at 9:44 pm on a Wednesday night. Only 3 cars ahead of me. I waited all that time and my order was not difficult double cheeseburger meal No onions, but of course it had onions. So if you want to wait forever for the wrong meal go there but I will never spend another dime there ever again.

We were originally going to Cafe du Monde on recommendations from friends, but the line there was a block long. The line here was just to the door, and with the tables pretty much all filled, everyone was getting orders to go, so the line moved fairly quickly. We were able to snag a couple of bar seats just as our order came up. My Iced Chicory and Coffee was wonderful, and matched the beauty that were the beignets we got. They came to us hot, sugary and ever so yummy!

Well they got rid of my fish sandwich only have fillets so I properly won't be back again. $17 for a fillet for lunch was much more then I expected. Completely disappointed!  Food good yes but not what I came for. This reason two stars. People get a fish sandwich back in the menu!!!!

Just had my third meal at Mt. Fuji and the family enjoys the high-quality, well prepared food and the friendly service. We are Mt. Juliet residents that very much enjoy ethnic foods.

There's this one irritating thing about Mt. Fuji. Actually, it applies to other ethnic restaurants too, but it was particularly irritating at Mt. Fuji because it was loud. It was the twangy country radio station. Our waitress was likewise irritated and gladly brought the manager over, who grinned about his inability to change things.

Ethnic restaurants are best when they offer an experience along with the food. It would be wonderful to have tranquil flute or beautiful Japanese music playing in the background. If not Mt. Fuji, then Fulin? Wasabi?

I love Tony Romas ribs, but I will never return to this location.

My last experience here was horrible for more than one reason. We sat down in a very packed Tony Romas on a Saturday afternoon and we waited and waited for a server to come by. The place was really busy so we sort of understood, but it got to the point where we almost got up and left.

Finally, a very angry server stomped up and asked what we wanted to drink. No hello, no sorry, no eye contact. It was super uncomfortable. She pretty much forced us to make a decision on the spot about what we wanted to eat and after we ordered, she avoided us like the plague.

She had one large table half filled with kids and one of them asked for another milkshake. She was holding a bunch of dirty dishes and as he asked for the refill, she stormed over to the drink area right behind our table and THREW the dishes into the sink. It was so loud and it startled me. I can't imagine how the kids felt. How embarrassing.

After a mediocre meal and continued empty glasses we asked for the cheque- and the manager. All of a sudden, she was nice and said she would be happy to grab the manager for us.

Another server came up to the table and said that the manager was just on a phone call and she was a senior server and could talk to us. I was not buying it. I had seen the two servers chatting at some point during our horrible meal and assumed they were friends and she was now covering her friends butt.

Nevertheless, I told the problem to her in detail and she apologized. That was about it. No discount, no "please come back", no accountability.

The worst part about it was when we were walking to our car, we saw the manager standing outside with a group of servers smoking. "On a phone call"?

Right.

This place definitely lost our business.

Been to Cosi a few thousand times and the Signature Salad is a favorite.   Went to this one and they tried to tell me a white dressing was the one that goes with that salad.   When I told them I didn't think that was right, they argued with me.   Seems odd that every other Cosi in the world uses a different dressing.   Maybe they were out and just didn't feel like making another batch?  It didn't taste good  and I didn't go back.

I love coming to this sushi spot! I believe that Arigato has better quality sushi however not by much, and Ichibans price point is much much better. The counter sunk tables are an awesome touch, and the guys behind the sushi bar really enjoy talking to you if you'll let them.

Brunchies is just what we needed in a Lutz! This is the perfect spot for breakfast or brunch. The guava stuffed pancakes are delicious and more than enough to share.  You can't go wrong with any of the omelettes.  Brunchies also offers a selection of mimosas.

We love the food here! We don't make it over this way often but when we do we love to stop in for a bite. The restaurant comes off as fancy, so we eat in the lounge and order our food from there, especially since we usually only eat the appetizers. The spinach dip is absolutely divine! We also get the chicken tenders tossed in buffalo and they are amazing. My husband also likes the calamari a lot, but I wouldn't know since I don't eat seafood. If you stay at the hotel or are in town, it's definitely worth eating at - even if just for appetizers.
By far the best Jamaican food I've ever had. Costs a little more than others in the area but worth every extra penny. I had oxtail, Mac and cheese, and rice and beans and everything was delicious!

Didnt think it was worth the huge line that formed outside the place while we ate.  Eggs ordinary, bacon actually very dry and crispy, blueberry pancakes not that extraordinary.  All in all, Id come back, but if there was the huge line outside, I'd recommend to find someplace else because even though the servers are prompt and efficient, the whole experience was very, sorry to say but in my humble opinion, not memorable.

I absolutely love thai food and have been here with friends before. Their food has been decent as far as I can remember. However, recently, my boyfriend and I went in with a groupon and they were absolutely horrendous. We ordered the duck avocado special and ordered a side of rice because it didn't come with rice. When we received our dish, the avocado was not ripe and tasted like cardboard. They took the dish back and said all their avocados were like that. So we ordered another dish that came with rice. Not only did they NOT apologize, but they refused to comp us for the side of rice we only ordered because of the duck avocado dish that we couldn't even eat. 

We'll never eat at this location again. The point of a groupon is to bring in service so we can go back again...they absolutely failed at that.

Worst brunch I have ever had!!! Waited one hour and ten minutes for our food. Our server said that they forgot to fix one of our orders so my food stayed in the window until they fixed the other plate. Everything on my plate was over cooked and cold.
