Ice cream is made right in front of you. You pick your toppings from fruits and sweets. This picture isn't very fancy (I didn't choose a lot of toppings this time). S'mores was my sons favorite. First time we made a visit we didn't feel very welcomed. Figured they didn't like tourists. But, we didn't care and went back.

Best ice cream on the beach by far! Went in and they had just ran out of the homemade waffle cones so I had my ice cream in a cup. While my family and I were eating our ice cream across the street by the beach, the man working at Paradise Sweets came over with a fresh waffle cone and another scoop of the ice cream that I was eating. Customer service like that should allow me to give this place an extra five stars. Will absolutely continue to return for ice cream here.

Came for dinner on a Tuesday with coworkers. It was not busy, I would say there were about 4 or 5 other tables dining there already. I'll say there were only two instances where I  was not-so-pleased: 

1. They have a rule where you cannot be seated until your entire party is there. I understand this policy when it comes to weekends or busy times or big groups but we were a group of 4 on a really slow day. I think it's okay to bend the rules once in a while. 

2. There was a round/circular booth that seated 5+ people. My manager asked if we could sit there but the hostess said that booth is reserved for parties of 5 or more. Again, I understand the need to leave larger tables open in case larger parties came in but there were plenty of open tables and no reservations for a party larger than 5 coming in. I think it's okay to bend the rules once in a while.

Besides that, the waitress was wonderful and attentive. She replaced our water/club sodas frequently and was helpful in helping us understand each item on the menu. The appetizers were good -- I highly recommend the calamari & chorizo. The salmon appetizer with the plaintains was good but I felt there were too many plaintains, not enough salmon. I got the short rib entree. I think the short rib was tender and the flavors were great. We tried the flan and the churros for the desserts and I thoroughly enjoyed both! They added popcorn to the flan which was an odd combo of textures but I ate those separately. 

Nothing blew me out of the water, so I would give this a 3.5 if I could.

When I first saw the construction taking place at this site I was excited cause I was told it was going to be a QT. It would be nice to have one near by, but am I glad it resulted in U GAS.

Super clean, fresh deli, awesome staff, plenty of pumps, and involved with the community

I stayed here for a weekend and they made my stay so pleasant. Located in a great spot on Bourbon street, you just get out of the hotel and they party is right outside. We got an upgrade to a bigger and more private room in the back of the hotel, so we could get good sleep while people were still partying at late hours. The upgrade came along with a nice wince happy hour and breakfast Buffett which made it totally worth paying for.
Stopped in for breakfast and so glad we did. Delicious food and great service. Got the hash. Definitely try the sage sausage.

Great place to eat.  Comepetative  value....... Good taste........employees are fast and curteous.......communication is always good.   What a great location.... Inside and out...quick and fast. You hardly wait at this place.
Awesome upscale restaurants definitely a good place to try if you are downtown. The drinks are on point and the view is amazing.

I had the Sunday 3 course meal and it was great. I started with the butternut squash custard, had the mushroom agnolotti entree, and olive oil cake for dessert (all vegetarian). I enjoyed the flavors of all of them, rich and interesting textures. My companion had a vegan 3 course with roasted beets, roasted sunchokes and crispy potatoes, and a dark chocolate pear dessert. There is a nice selection on the drink list, and the cocktail and wine we ordered were nice accompaniments. The service was great and accommodating and the ambiance was very nice.

Olio is a local gem for sure. My friend's live across the street and are regulars. The staff is always extremely friendly and full of wonderful recommendations. The atmosphere is quaint and cozy and when it's nice out their patio is phenomenal. I recommend trying their cocktails... I'm always pleasantly surprised.

Not the best Vietnamese I've ever had, but its good.  The real selling point of this place is the dirt cheap prices.  If I was local, I'd probably eat here all the time just for budget reasons.  Definitely give them a try!

Indianapolis is consistently ranked one of the best convention centers in the country, and the world-class Indiana Convention Center (ICC) is one of the many reasons why. 

For one, it's huge (and thus easy to get lost in, at times). For example: Indy hosts 60,000+ people for GenCon each summer here. I've never been inside the ICC during a convention, but I imagine when there is an event in town there is clear signage on where to go, as there can be many conferences happening at once under the same roof.

For hosting so many thousands of people, the ICC has yet to show signs of wear and tear (that I can see) - it's always clean.

Perhaps the biggest perk is the ICC is within walking distance of countless hotels and restaurants - some are even connected by skywalk! Lucas Oil Stadium and Bankers Life Fieldhouse are a stone's throw away, and you're near attractions like the Indianapolis Zoo and other museums. 

We are lucky to have such a fabulous venue in Indy!
FOOD WAS AMAZING!!! The wait staff was so nice and basically made seats for us so we could eat (it was very crowded). The price was affordable and the atmosphere was really nice
Excellent burgers (get the nashvegas) and great beer selection! The bushwackers are good too! Also, get the sweet Carolina fries--HEAVEN.

We had the charburger with cheese here and the fries with ranch and a house side salad. Everything was so delicious. The burger was amazing. I don't usually eat burgers but this one was too good. They also have outdoor seating and a great customer service. I definately recommend them if you're in the area. We had their burgers before a road trip and we were happy campers!

I've been on the hunt for an auto repair center and have finally found the one! I spoke with John and he was very polite and informative. He took the time to explain the work that needed to be done and was not trying to sell me on anything. This was probably  the first time I've enjoyed going to an auto shop.

This review is long overdue! We had been going to OV pediatrics since 2004 until we moved in 2012. We were referred to them when our 6 month old daughter had an inexplicable fever- out family doctor's stand in just told us to go home and not worry about it-babies sometimes have temperatures for no reason. Not accepting that answer we found out about them through a colleague whose children were under Dr. Roberts care at OV pediatrics. 

Turns out our baby daughter had a particularly nasty bladder infection that was discovered by OV pediatrics. Night and day experience! They listen to you and don't just blow anything off without thoroughly investigating before diagnosing. Our Primary doctor was Dr Villar and she is AWESOME!

Her bedside manner, knowledge and overall demeanor as a doctor is phenomenal and we have yet to find someone else even close to Dr. Villar in our new home area. :(

When we needed to be seen when she was  out of town all the other doctors were wonderful as well and any one is just as knowledgable and warm.  

Their new office is modern, clean and very easy to access. 

Both my children were patients at OV Pediatrics essentially their whole life.
Its an A++ practice and would not have ever considered taking my 2 children (ages 10 and 7) anywhere else if I could help it!
Still miss them... :(

F&F is a small eatery with a seasonal menu; they get much of their produce from small farms within Philadelphia. The quality of the food is top-notch; everything is fresh and bursting with flavor and most of the menu items are quite creative. The staff are very knowledgeable and willing to answer questions and discuss the menu at length, which we appreciated. The pace of the meal was unhurried, which we also appreciated as we enjoyed our bottle of wine (it's BYOB, which is common in Philadelphia due to medieval limits on liquor licenses). Portions and prices are moderate; I had three courses for about $40 and was comfortably full. The only odd bit was that as soon as we finished our food, they asked us to go outside to finish our wine because there were people waiting for our table (there were several empty tables). Aside from that, the experience was terrific, but it ended on a strange note.

Heard about this place so had to come try it. I love Indian food. This restaurant is awesome. I had the chicken 65 app, lamb korma and chicken vindaloo each was excellent . Restaurant is beautiful inside and out.

This is the best food truck on the planet! The curry chicken is amazing and Cap'N Crunch roll is out of this world. You have to get to the truck early during the week, otherwise the food sells out quickly since they make 1 large batch per day.

Thank goodness I only come here every so often for business because if not I would be in big trouble. I'd eat banana pudding everyday for breakfast lunch and dinner!  Everything here is soooo good. Gouda Mac n cheese are u kidding me? DELISH!  Anything you have is excellent. U can't go wrong but making the decision of what to eat is troubling because you will want it all. 

Charming place and supports locals with the soaps jewelry cloths etc  they sell which are set up in the front.  Rave rave rave over this place. Just YUMM

Ordered a Lexi with me and my buddy. Tasteless and overloaded with onions. Big waste of money. Called to see about possibly getting another in its place. Guy basically told us we were out of luck. I work hard for my money and this was supposed to be a treat. Pissed
Easily the best place ever to get a po' boy. Even better than in the Nola! That also give great service and are full of life like the people in the Nola.

Nice staff. In the warmer months they open up the main window. Gives it a great open feeling. They provide free WiFi and their concessions provide plenty: honey, syrup, cream. I give this place 4 stars because they don't provide pour over coffee and there are no prices displayed on their menu which can be deceiving. The decor of this place is modern and clean. I appreciate the cleanliness and the open spaces for people who want to get work done. They also display local art on the walls!

My Partner and I decided to give Tony Roma's a try for the first time today.  We were greeted by a hostess who immediately seated us,  I asked her for any specials or soup of the day, she deferred to the waitress, fair enough!  I ordered the all you can eat rib tips with mashed potato and coleslaw and my other half ordered the Southwestern Chicken . My ribs came they were tender, tasty and hot, the  BBQ sauce was very tasty!, My mashed potato was great as well, but thats where it ended as far as the food went. my coleslaw was half filled with fluid and moist and soggy.  My Partners Southwest chicken was decidedly pre frozen, as was the frozen bean medley that was served for the vegetables. The rice was dry and mixed with packaged frozen vegetables straight from the grocery store. Maybe im old fashioned but i expect a bit more for $22.00. Aside from the Ribs the whole meal was disappointing.  The one bright spot in the whole meal was the Server Lady with grey hair, fast efficient and very friendly :-)  I hope i see her at Montana's cause thats where im gonna go for ribs next time.

Friends had been recommending this place for months and I always forgot about it. One day we both had a craving for Asian food, and I REMEMBERED! Yeah!

Crab Bang Roll - awesome! So much crabmeat, I could die.  Red Curry - deliciously sweet, savory, spicy and he loved the Spring Rolls. I had the Pad Thai, of which I could eat a bucketful! So good!

The service was super fast and friendly too.

Think we finally found a 'Go-To' place for Sushi/ Japanese/ Thai food.

Very happy with my experience at Simply Perfection Cakes. Rose was very easy and nice to work with. My cake was delivered and flowers assembled before I got there and I was completely blown away. It was beautiful! Thanks again!

This place had great tako yaki. My friend recommended it and I had some.  It was really good. This place needs a little more polish with service and needs to be a little more unique. Its a little like Tampopo but it's not necessarily a bad thing. Once this improves and shapes up a little, it would be a little better

I have only experienced the delivery-side of this restaurant. The food arrived 1 hour and 45 minutes after placing the order. My hoagie was soggy, and my fries were ice-cold.

Do not order from here on saturday nights.

For the area acceptable.  Its the only game in town,  so special treatment isn't common.  Dealers by the majority are not friendly,  it strikes you as a "20% of the dealers make 80% of the tips" scenerio. I don't need a fan club,  but at least pretend you don't hate your job.  We've dined at every restaurant and can't say we've ever had a bad meal.

First time visitor on a Friday night. It was very busy, super cute and quaint with an expected (but not cheesy) Asian flare. One dollar domestic and two dollar imported beer (Only downfall being that they do not have a full bar-- only beer, wine, and sake) Started with a seaweed salad which was good, and ordered 2 specialty rolls and one Chicago roll. Rolls were all excellent and I'd say its the 2nd best in town. Unfortunately my 4 star (would give 3.5 if I could) comes from the incredibly SLOW, SLOW turtle-esq service. I'm generally never in a hurry to have dinner on Friday or Saturday night, but this was exceptionally slow from beginning to end. The rolls definitely made up for it, but do not ever go to this place if you're in a rush. Service was average and definitely a language barrier that is somewhat frustrating. Overall, I will definitely go back, as it's a convenient location in BR that always offers a good "scene" and great sushi.

Next to its other location in Brandon it's the Only place for Asian markets from Tampa to Orlando. Such a great live fish, meat and poultry market. The only place comes close to this is in GA. Good job guys!

Great Greek food and a Greek Bakery next door
makes Hellas a must stop in charming Tarpon Springs.
The history of sponge diving and how Greeks came to this area is something you will appreciate.
Try the large gyros and top it off at Hellas delicious Greek bakery deserts.

This past trip was not as outstanding as two years ago. My James Bond Roll had lots of crunchy almonds in it which overwhelmed the other flavors; the torching of the top of the roll was not even noticeable, compared to last time. It was just was not all that great. Also, they took foie gras off the menu, except on top of a piece of Seabass. My husband wanted to drive to Philadelphia to get and they didn't have it on the menu anymore. We ordered it on the Seabass, and picked off the tiny little piece on each serving and it was phenomenal. Would've been nice to of been just able to order it like the old days. The only tea was green and it was meh. On the positive side, the miso soup was the best I've ever had, and the crème brûlée dessert was fantastic. I also had the lunch sushi sashimi plate and none of it was really outstanding. Even the salmon had that flavor like it it was previously frozen. It wasn't battery and fresh tasting. Very disappointing.

I'm running errands at Walmart and Home Depot and as my tummy gurgles, I look out onto the horizon I see the qdoba sign, like a beacon of hope. I was greeted happily by the staff and they prepared my big yet affordable burrito. I even thanked Manager Marcus as I left. I appreciate it y'all. Keep it up!

Excellent event I think having it on Bridge last last year would have been better. I would give a 5 Star if it was non-Smoking! Having a Cigar tent there was bad idea everywhere you walked someone was smoking a stinky cigar. if you have smoking make it a designated area by that cigar tent so a person can at least move away from that area. Overall decent event. Lines were long at the most desirable places which is to be expected.

I'm right across the bridge in Jersey so this is the closest mall to me and coincidentally it is in tax free DE (yay!). Downside is alot of the shops don't appeal to me- Nordstrom (meh) and parking (particularly for restaurants) is a bleepin nightmare. Stores I brave the mall for are Sephora, Macys, Mac, Lush, and Teavana. I also love that Target is part of the mall along w/ some of my favorite restaurants (Brio, CF, and JB Dawsons).
Fave restaurant forever. Kale salad. Marathon burger. Bartenders who make the happy hour Paloma after happy hour. Dreams.

Just back - again - from Happy Hour / Dinner and it was better than ever.
The ambience is open, modern, and not loud or cramped - whether you choose the bar, bar booths, open tables in the dining room or banquettes.  It is fun to see the Operational Pizza oven at the back of the restaurant, but don't be misled - there are many other food options.

Their Happy Hour is extremely good - great inexpensive wines, tasty wings, sliders, Brussel sprouts, and a new offering - very lightly tempura battered cauliflower (delicious)! The pita bread is excellent - warm and fresh from the oven.  They also feature salads (try their Cici salad), as well as burgers, pasta etc. - all served in a prompt but unhurried manor.  The pizzas are very good - and they will accommodate your requests. (We like our pizza fairly crisp with a thin crust).

A special jewel is Melissa, the manager.  She is extremely personable and sets the tone to insure that all customers have a truly superior dining experience. Kudos to Melissa!! 

There is a diversity of people dining, depending on the time of day.  Business people, chic professionals meeting after work, families dining early with their young, sports lovers watching the bar TVs, and trendy couples just enjoying a great meal together.  
Now that the weather is warmer, we can't wait until the outside patio opens!! There is also a Sunday Brunch.
Breakfast was great. Good food, great vibe and the staff was very friendly and pleasant. Food was fresh and filling. Would def come back.

What can I say, I had a table full of toddlers, and Lyndel took really good care of us. She was attentive, quick and super sweet. I would give her 10 stars if I could. Our order was right and she was AWESOME and personable. SHE ROCKS!

I will be the first to admit that rating this place so highly is heavily influenced by my nostalgia for this place. That said, this place is still amazing, and you owe it to yourself to check it out. 

This is the place that first kindled my love of coffee, back in my college days. During grad school, I would come here just about every day to work on my papers, or to just decompress with a nice drink and a hot meal, while chatting with the wonderful, friendly staff. I can't recommend the southern pecan flavor enough, especially if you're visiting from out of town. 

The food is equally good, with sandwiches and burgers that are wonderful to eat (especially the Gouda burger). But, like everyone else ere, their true culinary crowning achievement is the breakfast in a go cup. Bacon, sausage, gravy, hash browns, and grits - all you need to add to it is some pepper and hot sauce and you e got yourself a great start to your day, whether that's bright and early or mid-afternoon. 

After a recent trip back home, I specifically made it a plan to visit here again, and I'm happy to say that they are still my favorite coffee shop in New Orleans. Possibly ever.

I've been here several times and will be back. I've had the Cuban sandwich, Georgia Pick (pork/cheese on naan bread) and Korean bbq tacos...all were top notch.  The pretzel stick appetizer was great as well.  This restaurant has a very unique menu for Main St and I would definitely recommend them for lunch or dinner.

Came here to buy the same dog food I do every week and I'm never coming here again because a very rude employee started yelling at me when I was trying to pick up the dog food I was going to buy. He told me to stop doing what I was doing (when I was picking up the bag) in a very rude and demeaning tone of voice. If I could give zero stars I would. I would rather drive all the way out to orange grove and thornydale to get my dog food than ever come here again.

I work at one of the office nearby and I feel like I see a lot of business people here. I have come for lunch and happy hour and when the weather warms up, am dying to have dinner on the patio. It is weirdly laidback and upscale at the same time. 

The menu is limited to some apps, salads, pizza, cheese/meats. To my surprise, one of favorite things on the menu is the verde salad with grilled salmon ($15). You get a very large salad filled with fava beans, avocado, cheese, lemon vinaigrette. So yummy. I NEVER get entrée salads, just at 24. I have had the Brussels Caesar which my husband loved. It was just okay to me. The pizzas are yummy as well as the polpette and burrata. Oh and their grilled calamari is delicious. Recently, the kitchen toasted it too much but fixed it quickly. 

I like that the happy hour has a mix of drinks and food. Bonus that they bring out a complimentary trio of small snacks (fried chickpeas, stuffed pepper, olives). Really cool spot.

I attended with a party of four on a Friday evening. The atmosphere is beautiful with elegant woodwork.  It was not even half full and the service was horrible.  it took forever for any request.  so lets break this out:
Design: 5, love the wood work, feels slightly elegant

Atmosphere: 3, would have liked to hear Italian music not 80-90s music over satelite

Service: 2, our waitress was hard to understand and obviously did not know enough about Italian food as some of our food requests they didn't list was basic, like pasta with garlic and oil.
Number one rule as a server, NEVER LET A DRINK GO DRY !!!!!. The server.....she made several major mistakes with drinks and general service.  Ladies should always be served first, wine should be first poured by the server and not plopped on the table with glasses. bringing condiments for your meal 10 minutes after we start eating is useless (pepper and cheese).   i watched a male server working away and he had his "A" game on. i watched a table come in well after us and leave before we got our meal.  The female we had was sleeping or was following snails to our table...WAKE UP !!!!

Food:  2, poorly timed dishes,  two plates came out so they sat as we waited for the other two. 4:30 minutes go by....wow finally the other two come...if the food inspector ever came by they would certainly fail the food temperature test, several dishes were luke warm at best.  the flavor of the dishes were blah, except the pasta with garlic.  one dish had veal and it was tough meat.  The other two dishes had chicken and they were dry and tough.

Price:3, the prices are way to high for what you get, i had a dish that was $25.95 that was worth maybe $19.95 at best, my friend had meatballs, that was priced at $14.95, that's reasonable and the portion was good sized. 

As a server you are the first and last person to represent the brand and a restaurant, if you fail as a server in your duties you are failing the business and the doors will close fast.

I hope the owners read this

I can't get enough of the Ziggy Burger, especially now that there is a University City location which means I can pick up an order after work and not have to worry about parking my car in the Rittenhouse neighborhood. If they add delivery - I'll be over the moon as it will mean a better take-out option when at work than Greek Lady. 

I heartily recommend the Ziggy Burger as the tempeh bacon and special sauce just really take the humble veggie burger to a whole new level of delicious. It will also keep you satisfied for hours. Splurge on some sweet potato fries as well for their slaty, tender goodness. I like the black bean cilantro dipping sauce which is a flavorful alternative to ketchup. 

If you're in the mood for something lighter, you can't go wrong with a green smoothie (groothie) or a banana whip. 

The service is ridiculously friendly and the orders are up quickly. I am always promptly greeted and the staff often provide great recommendations regarding menu items if you can't decide. If you're in a hurry, call ahead and your order is sure to be ready when you arrive. 

Compared to the Rittenhouse location this space is huge with seating for everyone! They still compost and recycle so after you satisfy your hunger you can satisfy your conscience as well.

I enjoy this place so much that I feel they should have a frequent buyer punch card for their burgers.

Kimpton hotels are usually fabulous and this is the best I have ever stayed in.  The service was top notch from the doorman to the front desk to the cleaning staff.  It is located right in the heart of the historical area and most places are a walk away.  If you do take cabs they are very inexpensive.  
The lobby is elegant, as are the rooms.
The Red Owl is located at the bottom of the hotel is wonderful for breakfast or to grab a quick lunch or casual dinner.  Stratus Lounge is on the 10th floor and is a must go-to.  Great décor and the staff is wonderful.
They have added all the small touches that mean a lot.  Coffee in the lobby in the a.m. chilled lemon or lime water all day and wine in the early evening.  Also checkout time is noon and it is a pet friendly hotel.  I didn't bring my furbabies but saw a few and never heard a bark or meow.
Would never stay anywhere else in Philly.

As others have said, Ruby's Diner isn't really a diner at all. Don't expect a huge plastic-coated menu with a swirly ring binder, or long-time waitresses that know your name. Don't expect a slew of regulars to be lurking in their booth or a menu of basically the same five dishes with many variations.

That being said, Ruby's food is pretty good. I opted for the kobe sliders. I had to pick off the celery-like peppers/onions? but the sliders with some swiss were DELICIOUS. The fries were good when they first came out, but soon became inedible. The service was friendly. Thinking back on it, our table was asked the perfect amount of times whether or not we wanted refills/if we needed anything. Plenty of attention without being overbearing-a mark of great service.

So I guess the food is good if you order the right thing, and the service is great too, but there's something about Ruby's that prevents me from going over 3 stars. Probably the chintzy "50's diner" booths and lighting, or that it's in the obnoxious King of Prussia mall. Anyways, if you're at the KOP-hell mall already, and need some diner-esque food, give Ruby's a try.

My husband and I stumbled upon Cafe Piazza for Sunday brunch. We ordered an omelette and Sicilian frittata. Service and food were delicious! Topped this off with doughnuts and Nutella. Also enjoyed Tim Elmore playing guitar and singing.

I work until midnight by the time I get to sahuarita McDonald's I take 10 mins out of my drive only to hear that the machine is down, they are only taking cash. I mean I hear this every time I go. Would be nice if they post on their 24 hr sign that for some reason they only take cash after midnight seems a little strange too me. I'm thinking the crew doesn't want to work @ 2 or 3 in the morning and make up the story of machine being down cash only rule. It's every time I got late at night how can the machine always be down?

We booked a tour of both Oak Valley Plantation and Laura Plantation. While I was happy that they provided transportation to and from the sites, the price was a little too high if you ask me.

Each site at the front gate asked for $20 per head for admission. Which means, I should have paid $40 in total. Cajun charged me $80. I understand there is some overhead to cover and all...but $40 is a bit high if you ask me just to transport me to and from the location. Especially since the bus was packed.

Plus, we were in a rush and I wasn't able to fully enjoy the picturesque view of Oak Valley to the fullest extent.

If you do have your own car or other means of transportation, then I recommend that you go there on your own. If not, then Cajun won't be that bad of a choice...

Most amazing food, service, and ambience! We had the Pork Pozole, Torta Mexicana, and the Flour Tortilla Bowl. Delicious, top quality food. Our server was so friendly and we enjoyed listening to music whole enjoying our brunch. When you're in Downtown Reno...this is the place to go!
Food use to be good here they got some new cooks and the quality of food really went down most of the food is way to greasy really disappointed it use to be one of my favorite places to eat lunch

I love this place beyond belief! It has the most flavorful food is the whole city!!! Which means the best food in the world in that Philadephia in my mind is this culinary capitol of the world!!! I was absolutely impressed. They were so attentive too it was my birthday. I had the most wonderful time. I would give this place 100 stars!!! Thank you! Thank you! Thank you! I can't wait to go back;)

I've learned authentic Chinese means kinda creepy and shabby outside.  Get anything spicy or dry rubbed. Don't get normal Chinese.  Menu is pretty much non English but that's what google is for. I don't like Chinese take out, I think it looses something on that ride home. Def worth a trip. Be adventurous!
Family favorite of the places we ate during their visit to NOLA.  Cute atmosphere, unique (and huge!) donuts.  This is also a favorite of mine and my friends, who live here in New Orleans.
Really relaxed vibe. A lot of food for the price and made to order. Nice spot for good fresh food.

Got to try the buffet today and was very pleased with the selections they offered.They brought  to the table for us hot fresh naan that you don't see offered elsewhere.They even made it garlic for me as a special request at no extra charge.The Naan is free with the buffet and made to order versus heaped on the buffet as Indian Garden does and I find sadly too often cold. Refills on the naan was offered but we wanted to save room for the fantastic array of well composed Indian dishes we had yet to sample.

 I also appreciated the nice fresh salad bar with vegetables,watermelon, chutneys and Indian pickles that we could help ourselves to. The Host and Chef Guru were so gracious and warmly greeted us and made us feel welcomed. The Chef even brought out complimentary vegetarian lollipops to try that reminded me of the flavors you find in a top notch egg roll. It was moist but crispy and covered in a sweet but spicy chili sauce. Very good! 

Lunch ended with a delicious carrot halwa pudding that has flavors that reminds me of sweet potato casserole you get at Thanksgiving and Hot Chai tea.Weekday lunch buffet is only $9.99!
What a great bargain especially for upscale Newtown PA.!

This place is absolutely unbelievable. We got a Painkiller and a King Thistle and they were both amazing. We also got the gummies, which were also delicious. Super friendly bartender, super cute decor - do yourself a favor and pay this place a visit.
expect to wait a while when coming here on the weekends. our breakfast was delicious  and the staff were super friendly.

My car is not a simple oil change, and Malcolm at this location (and his sidekick Evan) were incredibly knowledgeable, friendly and efficient.  I left with exactly what my car needed and a printout of future recommendations with prices and service times.  I highly recommend this location!

Caruso's isn't bad, and it's certainly better than chains like Olive Garden, but it's still only average.  They seem to try too hard to be stereotypically "Italian".  Their food is alright, but the food at Caffe Milano is better.  This restaurant is ok, but if you want good Italian food in this neighborhood, I recommend checking out Caffe Milano.  The quality is better there, and it isn't that much more expensive.

Great night again at Burger Up.  

Marshall was our awesome server with a great personality and very efficient.  We appreciated how he took care of us but also gave us space.  We were very lucky with him as a server!  

I got the mushroom and Swiss burger with truffle fries.  There were no truffle fries left on my plate.  I could have licked the sauce I just love it!  It was actually quite impressive how quickly I ate them.  My burger was just okay. I would not get it again.  Not enough mushrooms and no cooked onions.  The burger was too small for the bun and the cheese did not adhere to the toppings which made it quite a mess!  

The problems I had were:  we were sat in a seat with out backs to the bar and a few servers ran into me without apologizing .   I was as close as I could get to the table without sliding off my seat.  Also, the hostess let people hold the door open (since there was a line out the door) which created a cold jet of air directly towards my spot.  Lastly,  the hostess did not look up from her book when we were leaving to say good bye. I just really appreciate southern hospitality and Marshal has it, but the other servers lack it!

West Ave is a 2 minute walk from my office, so I've ordered take out several times for lunch. Today was my first time dining in (or out, as we sat outside). The staff is always friendly and I can say that I've enjoyed all of my meals. On prior visits, I've had the Salmon ALT. Good, but not great. There wasn't enough aioli, which made the sandwich a bit dry, and the Salmon kept sliding off of the bread. I've also had the Challah Grilled Cheese strips and Tomato Bisque. So good! It was a great warm and filling meal during the winter months. Their bisque is delicious. 

Today, my boss and I both got salads. I had the Asian Pear topped with the house marinated chicken and honey vinaigrette.  It was a simple salad, but everything was balanced nicely. Not too many pecans or blue cheese and lots of chicken. Some places can skimp on the protein. 

The only reason I can't give West Ave five stars is because I think it can get a bit pricey. A $12 salad with $4 extra for chicken.. eh. Prices aren't outlandish, but when you can find good food elsewhere for a little less, you tend to take the more inexpensive route. This isn't meant to take away from their food, which I think is good! Would surely recommend to others.

Best salad I've ever had in my life. Disclaimer: I don't even like salads and Mediterranean isn't my go to food. I added gyro meat to my salad. Sooooooo good. My friend got the buffalo pita and said it was amazing too.

Very elegant and the ambiance was intoxicating. The lighting was intimate and romantic. Live music was very appropriate and the serving staff was fast and efficient. Safe enviroment and decor was hip and modern. The them of the menue was tappas whicch was quite perfect for us. We had the bison sliders and they were fantastic. 2 Tender juicy tasty bison patties perfectly cookend & season. Served on a sweet soft brioche buns with a side of homeade pickles and pickled radish. Absolutely addicting! I will return for the burgers and to try more of the very sophisticated menu.

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED : I really can't say enough good things about this place. The pizza is thin cut and big slice style. I've had several different kinds of pizzas here and never have been disappointed. The wait staff is typically friendly, attentive, and helpful. 

Their hours are probably one of the biggest positives. Friday and Saturday when you come home from a game or need a late night food fix, they usually are open until 12-1. 

In terms of the beer garden.. I'm not much for going somewhere for simply beer so another review may she more light there.

In terms of how late they are open, the amount of options they have, and the quality of the food... HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!
Great food and staff! Always an event or special going on. The best neighborhood hangout. A must stop on the weekends.

We wanted some oysters while visiting the city.  Went by Acme and the line was ridiculous so we used Yelp on the iPhone to find Desire.  The Oysters Desire were excellent! We recommend Desire and will stop by there again next time we're in the neighborhood.

This place is pretty excellent- definitely a go-to for me and the BF.  Some notes:

-HAPPY HOUR and LATE NIGHT:  Happy Hour is 5-7 weekdays, and gets you half-price margaritas ($2.50 is hard to beat).  Late night is Sunday-Thursday 10pm-12am, and gives you half-price margaritas AND draft beers (usually they have a few decent craft beers).

*update- all specials have gone up :( bummer.  Alas! 


-$1 per person endless chips, smoked pico de gallo and salsa verde- DELICIOUS, and perfect happy hour/late night food

-Be wary: the margaritas can pack a punch.  It may be the cheap tequila, but inevitably these hit me after the fact in a weird and often headache and/or hangover-inducing manner that margaritas (even strong ones) don't usually give me.  Drink lots of water, that's for sure- and don't let this deter you.  

-Vegetarian Texas Cheesesteak?  AMAZING.

-Brunch includes a free drink for each adult over $21 (Bloody Mary or Mimosa).  VEGETARIANS BE WARNED- the Bloody Mary mix is NOT vegetarian, and not all of the waiters know that.  I asked, was told it was vegetarian, had my BF try it, asked again to have them double-check, and found out it wasn't.  I lucked out, but if you are allergic to seafood or vegetarian, stick with the Mimosa and make sure the waiters double-check anything that could mess with your dietary restrictions.
This is a beautiful station that felt very safe for a single female traveller.  All areas were clearly marked and well lit.  I would happily travel through this station again!

We just picked this restaurant because it was close to our hotel, but WE ARE SO GLAD WE DID!  The food was seriously delicious and reasonably priced!  The lemongrass tofu was flavorful and cooked perfectly (not rubbery!) and the chicken and broccoli was also yummy!  Highly recommend this gem!

really disappointed on a visit there this week.  the therapist was nice enough but wasn't very good giving massages.  Touch was too light.  I like deep tissue massages and while I pointed out exactly where a knot needed to be worked on, the massage was ineffectual and weak.  Even though the therapist kept saying she could feel the knot being reduced in size, i didn't feel any change at all and left after a 30 minute massage with the knot, same size and same pain.

On my way to a bowling tournament. This looked like a nice one to stop at. 

Drive through on a Sunday morning is pretty quick. Staff is very friendly here.

Had the late night hungries. This was the only place serving food around us. The beer was cold, the bartenders were drunk. One was in training so yeah, that's what he was teaching her. The hallway to the bathroom is creepy, FYI. After ordering,  a couple of our group members motioned to the floor. The bartender laughed and said, "Which one did you see? Since they are working on the streets, it's stirring them up and they are everywhere." I asked what they were talking about.  RATS!! And on cue our food arrived.  OH, HE'LL NO! Exist stage left. Gross AF.
Good tasting food that's a staple of the Reading Terminal Market.  Variety of deserts to choose from that are reasonably priced for a heavy tourist location.

I've really only used this service to check in. More often than not, it would have been faster to just go to the front desk, but it makes me feel more important to use the VIP services. Perhaps one day, I'll just camp out in there all day and watch football at the bar.
I like it here. So far have only gotten a hair cut, but will be back for highlights and a massage :)

Service and food was spectacular as always. I've been coming here for ten years. I'll be coming back for ten years to come. The decor is just my style. The food is always fresh and tasty (spicy). The staff is always extremely nice. It's small and quirky, but that's what makes this place so lovable. The Pumpkin curry.... Well any of their curries are a MUST try. If you order spicy, it WILL be SPICY.... So be prepared. If you're dining in, the two top by the window is the perfect people watching spot. Be prepared to see some weirdos. Also, if you're on a date, after your date, if you're feeling a little excited and adventurous from all the foreign spiciness there's a specialty shop just a few doors down that can help add some spice to your love life. This is the perfect location for a fun first date, ordering take out, or dining alone. The food never disappoints. I've loved everything I've ever eaten here.

I usually would never complain about this Texas Roadhouse but I had to wait over an hour for my food last time I was here, not to mention my waiter didn't ask if I wanted a refill or even come up to us for me to able to ask for a refill I had to ask a different waiter for a drink/straws/ etc.. Sucks because we came here for my brothers birthday, after waiting an hour for our food they came to tell us they dropped his steak and had to make. New one just for us to wait longer. Everyone at our table was already done eating by the time he got his food. Hopefully next time we will have better service.

Kampai is the new sushi restaurant replacing the old sushi restaurant,  Sansui, that was at this address for many years.  The inside looks really similar but it's been freshened up and looks cleaner.  

In my experience with St Louis sushi, Wasabi on Washington (only because I've never eaten at the Clayton local as I try to never eat west of Big Bend) is the standard against which all others should be judged.  Based upon this Wasabi standard, Kampai comes pretty close.  The sushi was fresh and the rolls were well made.  Miso soup and a small salad come with every meal and they were fine.  Finally, Kampai is priced well. When my sushi posse hit a place, we order a lot of food, and our bill at Kampi was less that it would normally be at Wasabi.  Their rolls are not as creative or interesting as Wasabi, but then they don't charge as much either.  

I would recommend Kampai to anyone.
Great stay for our daughter's graduation. Love the area and the rooms were very comfortable. Breakfast was great and Greg and Jennifer were excellent host the entire time. I will be back in a second.

Paid $14 for a 10 inch Margerita pizza that was cut into 6 pieces, 2 of which didn't have any cheese on them. None.  The sauce was good, but the pizza is absurdly overpriced. The size of the pizza would be the equivalent of 2 slices at a normal pizzaria. So it's like paying $14 for 2 slices of pizza.

Also got the $10 Caesar salad. Same issue. The only difference was that the salad was pedestrian, at best, and the pizza was actually pretty good.
I love the trail! It's beautiful and has just enough fun places to stop that a long ride doesn't get boring! Highly recommend the trail for getting so great outdoor activity in!

My review is only but a work in progress as, despite having been here twice, I still have not tried the food.  I love this place so I will be back to sample more.  I can't wait to test out the patatas bravas, tacos and other great things on their short but wonderful menu.

I'm in love with the Tiki bar in the rear of the restaurant.  Absolutely in love with it.  I heard that they plan to expand it, which makes me happy since the seating is very limited.  The drink menu at the back bar is a bit limited, but with the cute outdoor plants, cute cocktails, strings of lights, and bar, I could spend a whole afternoon and evening in the Tiki bar without any desire to leave.  Don't be nervous about trying to track the entrance to the Tiki bar down--it's worth asking for the directions to get back there.  

I won't stop going to this place when summer ends.  Atmosphere is one of the most important things about any place I go to and I love the care that the owners took in designing the interior of this place.  The beer list is also excellent at the front bar.  I look forward to trying the food as I have heard nothing but good things from those who have tried it!

We went to get crawfish for Father's Day. When I was peeling them they were like mush. Not all of them but about 20 of them. Also they had a distinct flavor like they were previously cooked and just reheated. I did order the eggplant with the crawfish sauce and it was pretty good. My husband had the stuffed Mirliton and I could not eat it. There was way too much seasoning in it. My son has gumbo and a shrimp pinky. He said it was good. The service was okay.

We've finally found a good Mexican restaurant in the Clearwater area since moving from Texas 2 years ago! Boyfriend had the durango combo plate ( taco, tamale, beef enchilada) and I had the steak fajitas. When they came out I could tell they would be great and they were. Boyfriend liked everything on his plate as well. The chips were great and they give you a hot and mild salsa which we mixed together to get the right spice.

Food is excellent with consistency!  Service is great with a family friendly environment. We go about once a week when possible. This is our Pasta House of choice!  All around great place to go for casual dining.

Ah... Yelp. You guys let me down this time. On my quest to try as many local restaurants in the area, my journey led me to Mei's world, a Taiwanese restaurant and pizza join all rolled into one. Crazy combination, right? I had to check it out. The first visit, service was very friendly albeit a little slow. I had a pork chop and rice dish. The price was inexpensive, but the flavor was a bit lacking. The second visit, I decided to try the trademark General Tso's pizza. When I asked about a question on the menu, the guy that answered seemed completely annoyed by inquiry. It was a huge departure from my first visit, but I wouldn't be so annoyed if the pizza was on point. Honestly... It was simply ok, but I wouldn't exactly go out of my way for mediocre pizza and hit or miss service. I guess service varies depending on who waits for you. There seems to be a bit of a language barrier, but eh. I'll stick to Yummy House on Waters or Golden Phoenix for my Chinese food fix.

Love this location. My favorite and just around the block from me. I really could have sworn I have left multiple reviews of this place but apparently I have been to busy eating to do so.

Best part of this location... FAST and great service, the prices are lower than all of the other locations (i can just be imagining that) and everything tastes way better

Con: they literally never have maque choux, which is my favorite dish there.


must do's : hot sauces, peanut butter pie, sour cream-onion-cheese combo - worth it

Mediocre at best.   No ambiance to the place whatsoever.   Felt like I was eating in a cafeteria.  

Food was a bit bland and greasy.   Asked waitress how big portions were and she said "not that big"...Portions ended up being big.  

My tomato soup was very salty.  

Very expensive for lunch.
Super disappointed. Ordered my food through caviar but it was not cooked well. You can tell it was rushed. It's a shame this place was one of my favorites. Clearly to go orders are not a priority.

This small house has been turned into a beautiful restaurant and bakery. If you find a parking spot you may be waiting hours in the cramped entryway for a seat but there are plenty of beautiful things to look at. Their cakes are beautiful but a bit on the dry side and expensive. Thankfully, the rest of their menu is delicious, especially the chicken salad sandwich on a croissant and the seasonal s'mores hot chocolate. Cake Bake is a great experience everyone should have at least once in their life time.

Came here for the Montesano Special sub. It was OK but lacked a balance in flavor profile.

I ordered the sub with everything on it, which includes capicola, salami, sharp provolone & prosciutto with lettuce, tomato, and onions. 

The bread was decent. It seemed fresh but was more robust and dominant than I prefer.

The meats were portioned generously. They were good in flavor, but not excellent. All the meats tasted similar and stuck to the tooth a but more than I'd desire (this is due to being cut slightly too thick.)

I found the sub too dry. The meats wholly dominated the flavors. The sub lacked an acid to balance and excite the palate between bites. There was little to savor in the sub other than the meat and bread. This made it uninteresting to me. 

The experience of this sub was OK. I'd love to come back and ask for more toppings or try something else. For this particular sub, as I ordered it, I give 3/5 stars. At $9 for a 9-in sub, I'd expect something more excellent.

Quiet little gem in heart of Doylestown. Colorful chair seating with open window views of the heart of Main St. BF and I shared a chunk of warm cornbread filled with kernels of delicious sweet corn. No need for butter as bread was slightly sweet with crusty outer edge. Yummmm I had the veggie burger w maple chipotle bbq sauce served w small bag of potato chips. Burger was thick served on brioche roll w lettuce tomato and jack cheese. BF had brisket sandwich w two sides- Mac and cheese and collards both were delicious. Brisket was thickly cut w minimal fat served on brioche roll w lettuce and red onion. Make sure to grab a homemade treat on the way out like turtle bars or like me graham crackers covered in toffee and chocolate ganche. Can't wait to revisit!

I was surprised today with some delicious treats from this little shop! We got a Tiramisu cake, magic bar, raspberry crumble bar, peanut butter cookie sandwich, and macaroons. Everything was very good and super rich! And the servings are very large! I was surprised how good everything was, there wasn't a single item that wasn't bad. The Magic Bar had a little more coconut on it than I like but it was still very good! The peanut butter cookie sandwich was so peanut buttery, the most peanut buttery thing I've ever had! It was absolutely tasty if you love peanut butter but man alive it was so rich! If you're in the mood for something sweet try this place out!

Stopped off at Dot's when I spotted it as I passed by from dropping Max off at the Ark Vet Clinic. Small diner, some might even call it a hole in the wall. But what they lack in tables, fancy napkins or stuffed shirt waiters, they make up for with a friendly staff who always seem to be in motion and you can watch your order being prepared on the flat top while chatting with the cook. Even the other patrons will chat with a total stranger! Had the meat lovers 3 egg omelet with a side of bacon, grits and toast. Also had OJ and coffee with free refills on the coffee. Definitely worth stopping in of you are in the area!

Soul Sista glad I didn't miss ya.

Been waiting for this place to open up, but I guess I must have missed the memo that it finally did, so as I was driving by and saw ppl inside I came to a screeching halt and popped in. First and foremost I was impressed by what they've done with this place, def a classy joint. Asked the waitress what she recommended and she immediately suggested the fried chicken (dumbest question of the year) so I went with the smothered fried chicken, mash and Mac and cheese. All was excellent, especially the mash. The waitress was attentive and polite, and the food came out quick without a hiccup. Really rooting for this place to do well in a part of town that desperately needs it. I'll be back to try some more, if everything is as good as what I initially had I may bump to 5 soon.
Our waitress was great. The issue was my veggie burger was not cooked. They did take it off the bill but I don't plan on going back.

Had car in there last week . Called to complain about noise I was getting in front tire service mgr told me it was the new brakes they just put on they had to wear in . That was not the case my tire was loose. Thank god it didn't fall off .

This restaurant is my korean favorite one. 
I usually order the beef BBQ and the soft tofu soup.

This is a diamond in the rough!!! Best Yelp search to date!! Cru Cellars is everything!! Wine flights! Samples! Sexy decor! Eclectic music! And charcuterie boards that are so classic and simple! Can't say enough great words about this gem! Can't wait to come back! I don't think I've used so many !!!!! in any post!!!!!!!!

This was by far the best button selection on fabric row, with really sweet and fun store owners. Unfortunately, they are now closed as of the end of November. I wish I had gotten in there one more time before they closed to stock up on buttons :( I was told they sold their buttons to a couple who sells the buttons online, but forget to get a site or store name. Check out Fleishman's, they have buttons if you are in need! We'll miss you, PA Fabric Outlet!

The food was good but I have had better in the city. The drinks I had were fine, nothing great. The service was awful. I have seen it written on other reviews that the service was not good and it's true. We had dirty dishes piled up on our table. We would have gotten more drinks if the server ever came back to inquire. When asking questions about the menu the server seemed annoyed.

If they get rid of this server I would have given Aldine 4 stars.
Brisket and Grits! The Crabby Wife, Sweet Poato pancake! It's a must for everybody to eat here! Everything was INCREDIBLE!
Great little place with excellent coffee and good food. Friendly staff, nice atmosphere and reasonable prices.  Sad to see the place go out of business.

PROS: super flavorful avocado asparagus salad, super flavorful Tom Kha soup, VERY friendly, never had a bad dish yet, kid friendly 

CONS: none

OVERALL: highly recommended!!! Best Thai restaurant near ventura

Great crowd, cheap beers and not douchey. Most of the staff has been around for years and you can always count on a consistent experience here. This is a great place for live music or game days. Personally this is hands down the best place for St. Patrick's Day. They feature Irish dancers, bagpipes (maybe not traditionally Irish but still cool) and Irish bands (plus green beer). You will never have to fight to get to the bar and there are plenty of areas to sit down and eat/drink.

This is one of my favorite shops. This place is packed, and there is always something interesting to find since the inventory constantly changes. My Elvis whiskey decanter is a fav. Lots of hats, purses, jewelry, and everything else in-between. Super friendly folks too. Check them out and discover some unique finds.

Recent transplant from SoCal and a devote burger lover. Been hopping from place to place, finding mediocre burgers around here -- not terrible, but nothing special. 

Came across Burger Up and expected to find the same. Luckily, it surpassed my expectations and has become one of my favorite burger joints in Nashville. 

They're burgers taste fresh, leafy greens, crunchy French fries, and delicious house ketchup. Additionally, staff is friendly and place is kept in good shape. Thumbs up, Burger Up!

Food good as always.  Love their shoestring like french frys and the chili 3 way. Shakes are the best around. But be prepared to wait. Here the third time in the last month and still pathetically slow. We arrive with only the quarter of the restaurant full and it still took 40 min for entree and another half an hour for shakes. Come on guys...

I have now gotten two tattoos done by Jon Ragoe here.  I moved down from Philly last summer and was a bit resistant to having to find a new artist down here.  After reading reviews I went to Black 13.  The studio is gorgeous.  Clean, new, just awesome.  Brittany is always very helpful.  I didn't know who exactly I wanted as I was just getting a short quote.  They set me up with Jon.  He was so nice and did an awesome job.  So I went back a couple months later for a larger piece from Jon.  Again, amazing.  I still can't get over how badass my trinacria turned out - even though my leg was twitching like mad, he handled it like a champ and gave me a beautiful tattoo.  I will be scheduling an appointment for my third tattoo from him soon.
I give this place more than 5 stars from my own personal experience.  However, I recently took my mom there to get a tattoo.  The artist she had (unfortunately not Jon) seemed to be very condescending and slightly rude.  I don't know if it was because she's older or that artist was tired or what, perhaps it was just an off day, but I was a bit put off by their attitude.
Overall though, awesome shop and would highly recommend, especially Jon!
Real bad attitude. Ignorant. I will not be back and will let others know.

Overpriced fast food joint.   Skip the pretension and just go to McDonald's down the street.  I was not impressed with the service, the selections or the food.   Only good point was the actual ice cream for dessert.   So skip the more and just get some ice cream to go.

I stopped by Bob's after work with intentions of buying a TV stand for my new apartment. I walked in and wasn't greeted, no big deal. However, I managed to make it to the back of the store and passed up not one, but at least 4 sales associates and not one acknowledged me. I probably spent a total of 10mins in the store, and eventually stopped looking for a TV stand. At that point, I had already made up my mind that I wasn't buying anything from this location because of the customer service.

This is the best Thai restaurant in the area(: the staff is kind, the service is fast and good. The place has 2 options to choose( indoor&outdoor) which both options are clean&great. It is a real authentic Thai food!!!!

This place rocks.

To start off, the Pad Thai is delicious. Not to oily or dry like some places I've been to. I recommend the Pork Pad Thai.
The Thai coffee is also amazing. If you have never had Thai coffee before it is very different from ice coffee. I think its the sweeten condensed milk they put in it to add extra flavor.
I haven't had anything else in the menu, but looking over at other people's dishes, while I was at the restaurant, I trust they are all very good.

The atmosphere is relaxed, although I did go later at night, so it may be more busy during the day time. Cost is average for Thai food. Average dish is $8 or $9. 

I'm sure to try some of their curries the next time I go.

This diner's name cracks me up. I was a little skeptical about eating here because of it, actually. Thank goodness I ignored my general hesitation and just went with it because it is great!

Inside is what I can only think to describe as a "divey diner" because it's very dated and not very aesthetically pleasing.  That really doesn't bother me as long as the food is good and the food here was great and the service is prompt and friendly.

I had a fried shrimp poboy once and a ham and cheese omelette with hash browns and toast on another visit. The poboy was really good and was piled high with shrimp. The omelette was wonderful and again piled high with the fillings. The chef is very generous.  Both were under $10.  Awesome!

Here's to you, Please U! You did, in fact, please me. :)

These people suck at their job...never again will I ever order from here again. This was the second chance and they got 3 strikes in the same night. Man, I waited 2 hours for my pizzas, the delivery driver wouldn't listen to directions on how to get to my apartment and to top it all off, the pizza for my children was completely wrong, yet again.

Love this place. Best food truck in Philly and the people working are great. I've only tried a few items but I was hooked with the captain crunch talapia burrito. Also the Taro Tea was delicious. I would recommend anyone that stops in philly and your buy the train station you have to stop by and try some of there food. It's fresh it's delicious and there is always a line and you know that means everyone around know they are the best.

Worst company ever.! They've been out 3 times so far this month. Detected that a part needed to be replaced but got unit working and did not replace it when it failed 2 more times. Finally yesterday they agreed to replace part for free after I had someone else come out & dispel their argument that it must be because we don't know how to work thermostat! Then this morning when an additional piece was detected as also needing to be replaced said I would have to pay $300  for labor on that part. Or $400 and they would upgrade original one they said would be free. Or I could use a different company but then I would be waiving warranty on other parts!  Despite calling me immediately to get my CC info repair man did not start job until 1 1/2 hr later. Incompetent, distrustful and unprofessional  is how I would describe them.

This place. So good! I love their chips (so thin and crispy!) and the Pasta Poblano is amazing! We eat Mexican food a lot, and this place offers a more elevated experience than your typical Mexican restaurant. Interesting, delicious dishes, great ambiance and attentive service make for a great experience every time!

We stayed here for a recent wedding and reception we attended.  It seemed like a good value for what we paid (group price).  Plus, we got the "Club Level" that included free breakfast and a place to hang at happy hour with free apps (alcohol not included).  Visited the pool and it wasn't too full of kids, a nice place to retreat for a few hours.  The staff seemed friendly and rooms were clean.  Reception food was very good, a higher quality than many other hotel receptions I've attended.  Much more updated inside than it looks outside.  I'd stay here again!

Whiskey is my drink of choice, and as you could guess Village Whiskey has them all.

Great atmosphere to go relax, sip a fine whiskey or scotch, and talk with the local crew.

The burgers get all the attention they deserve, and yes, they are on the pricey side, but you knew that before you walked in. It's Garces, you pay, he delivers.

-John Wiederman
Really Enjoyed my visit to Clear Vision.  Staff was fast and friendly.  Office is very updated with recent technology put my previous office to shame.  Glad I made the switch!!

Rescue Spa is a beautiful spot. I received a facial from Kelly Ann. I never suffered with breakouts of any kind until this past year, and unfortunately I have spots that have been breaking out and not going away. Kelly transformed those problem areas. She walked through everything with me during the facial. She is a true expert on skincare. With her suggestions for follow up care, using the P50 lotion & Masque Vivant, I am happy to say they have cleared up. My skin looks great thanks to her, and I will continue to receive facial services under her care.

Such an awesome spot in downtown Trenton. This place is small and cozy, but still comfortable and upbeat. We felt very welcomed as soon as we walked in the door right up until we left.  Chris, our waiter, was super attentive and took care of us without being too much.  The wings are some of the best wings I've ever had-- crispy skin and great flavor. I've tried the garlic parm and the honey sriracha.  My boyfriend and I each ordered a platter with 2 sides each, so in all we had ribs, brisket, baked beans, mac and cheese, collard greens and potato salad. There wasn't a single thing that wasn't absolutely delicious.  Our total bill was just over $40, and we each had leftovers to take home. If we had not both been so full we would have tried one of the desserts Chris recommended to us at the end of our meal.  
Definitely recommend stopping by, it's so worth the trip!

The last time I went here with a group, we got the most fantastic waiter any of us had ever had. John, the waiter, was attentive, friendly, fast, and knowledgeable. The food here has always been pretty good (that I've had) but it was the service that was really brought the place down. Not this time! So it seems they're hiring better waitstaff, hence the upgrade in rating. Always order a Big Ass Biscuit.

Welcome to Meridian, Panera! Love the Pick Two with Chicken Cobb Salad and Chicken Noodle Soup. Ever since Corner Bakery dropped the Santa Fe Salad I've been looking for a substitute - thanks Panera, I found it. Excellent flavors and good portions. Still working out the kinks of a new place-they forgot to include part of my meal and the iced tea ran dry in mid day. Those things should never happen, especially when you're trying to create a new fan base. Hopefully they will work those things out. The layout of the restaurant is not ideal. Order area is cramped and tucked awkwardly past a small pastry display. Chairs and tables are cramped and scattered making it difficult to walk to a table or the drink station. Hopefully they continue the good food choices and keep the place clean and stocked properly. I'll be back!

There are some restaurants where I just want 1 dish and I can never get enough of it.
This is one of them.

so my actual review is going to just be three  words

Dan Dan Noodles

Waited over an hour after ordering for our food to arrive. And when it did, was cold. Service was very slow and waitress did not once check with us to see if everything was OK (which it wasn't). After we finished and request our check, it took forever to arrive. Was very very loud, so much so that it made a bad dinner worse. Far too expensive for the quality of food and service provided. Avoid this place unless you like paying way too much for slow service and cold food, served at 110 decibles. Fish rank was the only redeeming part of this experience.

Heart food, but poor service. Try not to go in the afternoon during shift change. One server, one bartender, and night bartender and Barback leaned against the counter and talked instead of helping the slammed am staff. You would think they would help to push the process of clearing out so that they can make money... :/

Live musics, various choices of foods, large selections of wines
 I love it!

Great restaurant.  Great food. Super service.  We visit as often as possible.  When possible the kitchen will go out of there way to accommodate  special requests.  There foods are home made, not out of cans and frozen boxes of food.  Crab cakes are the best I've ever had, lump crab meat not lump BREAD like most restaurants.  I like the fact that you are given time between courses to relax and talk, not like most restaurants that you no soon finish one course then the next is plopped down in front of you - so refreshing not to be rushed through a meal so they can make room for the next group.  Keep up your great work Botto's.

Florence Solomon
This place is great! You can feel like you're traveling to Mexico for a bit and taste real typical Mexican food.
Mom-fia with Al Capone and Lucky Luciano. Strong drinks, friendly crowd, positive atmosphere and clean restrooms. A gentleman came by and gave us the history of this place. Amazing!

Very disappointed. Offer a sale on Sausage McMuffin with Egg and then they don't even make it the right way. Egg is not supposed to be folded like the biscuit sandwiches. I wonder if McDonalds corporate would be ok with them changing the recipes. Consistently get sub-par food from this location. Needs new owners/management. 


Strike 2....2 weeks later. Order a Mcrib. Get home and no sauce. Just a dry piece of meat on a bun. What a miserable excuse for a McDonalds. Wouldn't give them a star if I didn't have to.

absolutely delicious!! had some tapas to share and you could tell the ingredients are super fresh. Then had a lavosh grilled veggie wrap which was amazing and they even decorated the plate with sirarcha for me! 
Great place will surely come back soon for more healthy delicious food!

Nice location and atmosphere.  Stopped in for a late lunch.  Got chicken sandwich on a bun.  Chicken was fried (I should have paid attention) and too hot to eat.  Brioche bun was stale and had sesame seeds

Upon calling to ask about winter weather shoes, I was told they couldn't tell me if they had them or not. I even gave them a specific size, which their store is entirely sectioned by.  I was told they could not tell me. Either I'm crazy, or customer service should be high priority in the retail business. If they had taken the time to put me on hold, walk 30 feet, look and confirm, they would have made an easy sale. It's a snow day, so I doubt many people are there shopping. Way to put the customer first... NOT!

Exceptional service, great wine list and the pasta is outstanding. The best Italian in Indy.
Reviewed by an Italian.

This haunted attraction is associated with the Marlborough County corn maze.  The haunted events open at dusk.  They offer a Zombie Safari (paintball), a 3D Barn and Haunted Woods walk-through, and a haunted hayride.  I didn't do the Zombie Safari, but did go through the barn, woods, and hayride.  I highly recommend both the woods and the hayride - especially the woods.  It is scary in a primal sort of way to walk through dark, haunted woods, and they work well with that instinctive level of response throughout.  I don't want to post any spoilers, of course, but I will say that they really work well with sound effects, vision issues and that innate psychological response to create an artfully done, well-acted attraction that is genuinely scary, but very, very fun.

I just want to add that when you look around this Mexican restaurant there are Mexicans eating there. This is my rule for ethnic restaurants if there are no people of that ethnicity eating there, leave.  Here I'm the only gringo in the room so it's all good. (and I get to practice my Spanish)

After a quick Yelp search for breakfast/brunch, I found Two Chicks.  Upon entering the clean, bright, and modern ambiance, I was welcomed by the friendly, down-to-earth staff. Then comes the food: I got the Under the Sea Omelet, which included a delicious assortment of crab, shrimp, and brie, all all in good portions and cooked to perfection served with the best grits I have ever tasted. That's right: the best. I could go on, but if you are in New Orleans, do yourself a favor and give Two Chicks a visit.

What a deal!  For only $5 I got rice, grilled chicken, falafel, tahini, salad, and cheese cubes.  Then, the falafel guy put about 4 different sauces on it, and handed it to me.  No menus, and I didn't have to wait in line (I went around 1:30).  The food was delicious.  The falafel was crunchy and sweet, the chicken was blackened/grilled and tasted very good and charcoaly.  The sauces made everything taste great.  I plan on returning as many times as my waistline allows.

Got take out from Rearn Thai Monday night. I would give this place 3.5 stars. I have definitely had better Thai food. The Tom Yum soup was pretty good. But the Tofu Sog Kreg was awesome! Hence the 4 stars. The flavors were so unique, with scallions and black pepper and the tofu was super soft. Will probably ask for the "hot" spice level next time.

We live in Chicago and had preconceived notions about nashville's foodie scene.  We've been so pleasantly surprised on this trip with nashville's recent additions and Butcher and the Bee only helped this improved impression.

Loved the Asian influence in many of the dishes and, for a pescetarian in a meat-centric area, we were more than happy with the veggie options.  The Brussels were to die for, just like our server said, and I could eat the whipped feta spread on some pita bread every morning!

I'm sure running a sushi restaurant must be hard.  

But I think the most important thing would be to have fresh fish .

I ate here for lunch on a Saturday and this place had the oldest fish I can ever remember eating.  Very disappointing!!

At least the service was friendly .

Consistency seems to be a major issue here.  Sometimes, their food is awesome.  Other times, it tastes like it was cooked in a microwave.  One time, the chicken in my sandwich was still pink in the middle.  Service is sometimes fantastic, sometimes horrible.  I can't be bothered anymore to pay the prices they charge for food that is that damn unpredictable.
Super cute! Very friendly staff. Salted Carmel banana pudding was AMAZING! It was so clean and everything was fresh!

I love to get my morning or afternoon coffee here.  The hazelnut drip isn't too "nutty" Just the right amount.  The sandwiches are good.  I especially love the Primo Pesto Chicken.  Of course I love pesto on anything.  Some of the staff could use some friendliness lessons but most of the others make up for it.  Especially Merry!  She is always warm and welcoming as are several others.  For a quick and delicious "snack" under five bucks, go get a toasted sun dried tomato bagel with cream cheese and a coffee. Perfect!
Received as a gift. Was told the products were all natural. I looked at the label and they are filled with parabens and other chemicals. Very disappointing!

The hotel is still under construction and only 1 of the 2 elevators to our tower was working. We only stayed one night so this wasn't a big deal for us. Great location and staff seemed friendly. Rooms have mini-fridge and Keurig. Bed was firm but very comfortable and the hotel was very quiet when we went to bed. Nice bar downstairs. There is also a restaurant but we didn't eat there, was a bit too stuffy for us. Overall: clean, comfy, centrally located, and felt safe. Would stay here again.

Stopped in here for lunch on a whim on New Years Day and it was possibly the best meal that we had during our recent visit.  We had hoped to sit at the bar but it was full.  We ended up in the back, which was disappointing at first until we realized that that we could sit and watch through the glass enclosed kitchen.  Hubby had been craving raw oysters and his craving was definitely satisfied.  He enjoyed his bloody and I enjoyed by blueberry brunch cocktail.  We weren't terribly hungry so to go with our oysters we had the pied de cochon and the crabmeat maison.  The maison was amazing.  It was cool and refreshing.  It was also surprisingly light.  Then we had the pots de creme for dessert.  Our favorite was the vanilla with strawberries.  Perfect light end to the meal.  We would definitely go back here again.  Service was also really good.

I used to love coming to Bailey's Range when they first opened.  Their burgers were generous, never dry and good quality.  However, last time we went, they size of the burger drastically decreased and even though we ordered our burgers medium, they were very dry.  I also recall getting more of their homemade sauce, but think they may give you less now.  The ice cream is still as good as I remember it, but I don't think we will be going back any time soon.  Too many other burger joints that aren't nearly as expensive for what you get.
We went back and gave it another shot, loved it so much we are having our wedding reception there!!!

I will definitely be going back! The ice cream was creamy and smooth. I had the king cake flavor which had pieces of yummy king cake mixed in. The service was great, nice atmosphere. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars was because it's cash only. Luckily I had cash. I guess it was my lucky day!

I asked for a 1/2 inch trim and got the sides of my head shaved and Alfalfa strands up back that wont go away.
Costs $25
I bring my parents here every time they come in town because they love it so much. Sour beers are their fav and I love the salad. Definitely sheds some light on 4th street.

Service was so-so at first, no plates for the cornbread and biscuits. But it got better. The food was fast and excellent, like always! Had the apple chicken salad. It tasted as good as it looked, and it definitely filled me up. My fiancée had her chicken dumplings, the usual. And her mother had country fried steak. Check out was fast and friendly. Perfect meal!
Incredibly affordable and professional! They completed my whole transaction within minutes and dropped me off in a timely manner. My experience was quick and painless!

I love this store.  The selection is great.  The prepared foods are awesome.  The salad/food bar is decent to awesome depending on the day.

Bests: Veggies, meat/poultry, yogurt, beer, chocolate, bakery.

Yes, they are more expensive, but real food costs real money.  It's worth it, in my opinion.
Best chicken Caesar wrap I ever had!!! Really big menu. Restaurant was very clean. Will definitely come back many times

Will give it 4 stars. Food is good but a bit pricey for what it is. Service and employees are excellent and made our trip a pleasant experience. Make sure you download their app for 5.00 off and tell them it is your first visit for some free samples.
Great vegan selections. I loved the stuffed mushrooms and had the appetizer as my main dish. Flavorful and unique. I'll be back!

This hotel is very nice, but disappointing for a conference venue. All of the shops close early in the evening...and don't expect to have a late dinner or cocktails, the restaurants close early as well. We had a party of 20 and were asked to leave the Finley Irish Pub because they wanted to close @ 10:00pm.

It is crazy what is going on here. This places the size of a Costco but actually sells stuff you really want. I love the discounts right when you walk in, those are really valuable for an alcoholic like me who wants to booze up on the cheap. I couldn't fit anymore in the cart once i passed the super clearance section, (See above reason) but it's nice to know normal folks who have control of their drinking have a wide assortment of spirits to choose from when visiting St. Louis.

After reading all the over-the-top reviews, maybe my expectations were a little inflated, but I think this place though fine is way overrated.  The appetizers we had -- beef teriyaki and stuffed (with crab) mushrooms -- were excellent.  But the main show -- spider roll, mango roll and a "Louisiana" roll -- were not too out of the ordinary.  The latter had cream cheese in it -- which, though I have seen it done before, is to me an abomination.  But most disappointingly, brown rice was used in all the rolls, which gave them all a non-welcome flavor and lack of cohesiveness.

The presentations were very artistic, but the dollops of green, and orange, yellow, and red that went into them were "sauces," many of them spicy, that they take pride in.  But since when does sushi have "sauces" or anything with it besides soy sauce, wasabi, and ginger?  What up?

Anyways, not bad, but I wouldn't go back again; Arigato Sushi on State Street, though probably more expensive, is my choice in Santa Barbara.
Might be the best sushi I've had since moving to the city over a year ago.  The waiter was helpful and we loved the atmosphere.  Already have another reservation.
Great bibimbap! Fresh veggies, great flavor and very reasonable. The owners are very nice as well. This is our favorite bibimbap in the city! Truly a hidden gem.

Well, I attempted to eat here, but I arrived at 9:50 and ordered a taco and an enchilada.  They denied me service because they had "already cleaned the fryer."
