Very good. Just in town staying at a hotel for work and got some sushi to go. I'm kind of a sushi purist and stick with basic instead of all of the frilly new style sushi. I had a sashimi appetizer, several pieces of nigiri sushi, and the Dancing Tuna roll. The fish was very fresh an portions were great, with the exception of the sashimi appetizer. Little small but it was delicious. If you want sashimi, you may want to go with one of the sashimi platters instead. Bigger bang for your buck! But was very pleased with the fast friendly service and quality/freshness of the fish. Will be back!

My review is very much like Scott F. 

I was only here for Erin Express. From what I remember it's a lovely place.. not bad but I'm hardly ever near this bar so I don't imagine this being my go-to bar in University City.

However, probably best bar in the area.

Ok first off, Keith and the guys at musselman are the BEST dudes ever. My crew and I called ahead to see if these guys would stay open a bit late for us because we were only in town for one night and had to work during that day that prevented us from making it to musselman inside their business hours. Keith said it was no problem and waited for us to show up. 
Once we got there(we were running late) Keith greeted us with enthusiasm and a smile. We could tell this place was LEGIT. 
Keith let us run on the .4 mile course and it was FAST! He also wasn't a stickler for any unnecessary rules. He saw and understood that we were good drivers and in turn we respected Musselman's gear like it was our own. We spent $60 for three 20minute races. THAT was well worth the money!! For fast karts and plenty of friendly advice on the fastest line around the track this was one of the more pleasurable karting experiences I've had and I've karted in 12 countries on three continents. 
I will DEFINITELY be back next time I stop in Tucson! Thanks Musselman!

Heard really good things about this place and after cutting my own hair or going to the hair cuttery I decided to give it a try. Real easy to set up an appointment which you can do online or give a call and good conversation and good people. I'm new to the area and Josh gave me a lot of info on some good local places. Good cut, I'll be getting my cuts here from now on.
Their Avocado EggRolls are to die for!!!!! So yummy and their glazed wings are the best and so is the deep dish pizzas they offer!!!

A unique gem.  The outside design just attracts me.  It is on the corner of this huge building.  On the inside, it has two floors with lots of seating and a bar in the middle of the first floor.  They have a patio, too.  The only thing I do not like about it is the motion sensor light in the restroom.

I am glad I tried their food.  I ordered the blackened salmon sliders appetizer.  I enjoyed it because I asked to hold all the toppings except the spinach and to add pickles.  The salmon looks like about 2 oz. each for the 3 sliders.  I choose my side to be fries over tator tots.  Delicious, tasty, satisfying, healthy, just to name a few.

At 10 pm., it becomes an adult only late night restaurant.  The clientele is small but seems upscale and from Carmel.

They have lots of specials; join The Mob.

we were in town to go shopping and decided to get a balkan food fix.

food was awesome to say the least. i had the house salad and my wife had the cucumber salad. we both had the sour stuffed cabbage.

a regular american person might miss how good the food really is but, if even a modicum of eastern european blood is there, the food will rock you.

can't say anything about dessert because we were totally full with the meal.
I just moved to here from New York. First time try Thai food here. Food is great and price is cheaper than in New York. Like this place now. I will step by again. Nice service, too.

I'm not a sushi connoisseur, and admittedly my taste in the Japanese food craze is waning lately.  But, the food here is reasonably priced and tastes good.  Generally when my wife and I go here, we get a handful of rolls along with a full meal. 

Pro's:
1) Food: Good and reasonably priced.
2) Atmosphere: Very nice inside, but usually quite empty.
3) Wait staff: Friendly and no problems with order.
4) Parking: Easy.

Con's:
None really.

When I want to treat myself to some luxury (Will Ferrell voice).... I take myself over to Tria. It's my safe little haven of glorious wine. I haven't indulged in their selection of cheeses yet, but I certainly will soon. The staff is also really friendly, knowledgable and helpful. I'm actually going to Tria tonight...I can't wait!

I was very disappointed the Cuban coffee not so bueno..It would have been nice to have I good authentic Cuban Cafe con leche in this neck of the woods.  food was tasty. Very clean good service. friendly staff.

Night Market is a magical place.  A place where Philadelphia comes alive and wonderful food is available in abundance. Yes there are crowds. Yes there are lines. But there is no denying you're in a special place. The latest Night Market in Chinatown was the best yet. Come with friends and the right frame of mind and you'll have a great time as Philadelphia transforms itself into something else entirely.
The food was excellent.  The Shrimp and Calamari appetizer were delicious .  The Filet Oscar and Marmont Rib Eye were amazing dinner choices.  A hidden gem.
Big portions and lots of flavor! The wait was long but once your seated the service was great and the food came out fast. I will definitely be returning

This isn't a review of the food- this is a review of the people of Crescent City Steaks. It's my first night of my first trip ever to New Orleans. My mom and I tried walking back to the bead and breakfast we are staying at and got lost...so we ended up at Crescent City Steaks, and want to thank the staff so much for calling a cab for us... At least four or five times over the course of an hour, until one finally came, and being very warm and welcoming to us, especially on such a chilly night! Thank you! We hope to get to try your food soon too!

This a a fantastic bakery & restaurant along a strip of MANY Greek restaurants in Tarpon Springs.  The food here was fresh, tasty and just perfect after an afternoon on the ocean.

I enjoyed the spanikopita, tziki & pita, and saganaki (or better known as Flaming Cheese...whoopa!) =)

The pastries are yummy too!  The baklava!!  Wish I was there right now!

Was not impressed for such a long wait for food that was seasoned way off for breakfast food and for a bread place the muffins where dry. Might try again but not going out of my way. Some staff was rude and acted bothered to even fill the coffee, others where extremely nice and helpful.
Fabulous vet clinic. We love dr Miller and the entire staff. They are thorough and spend lots of time with your pet. It's a welcoming atmosphere as well. Very clean. My dog is also quite happy !

Enjoyed a great breakfast at Yolk! So thrilled Yolk made its way to Indiana from Chicago. The California Omelette was delish - fresh ingredients and lots of avocado. They were also willing to make a small order of the maple bacon pancakes. They were loaded with chocolate and bacon. One of the better breakfast spots in Indy! The smores pancakes were HUGE in size and filled with tiny marsh mellows, crushed graham cracker and chocolate sauce. They were a hit!
Unique, creative, and delectable cuisine prepared by chefs who are artists, and served by the friendliest staff!
Great food, great service and great people! The owner is of this place goes above and beyond to make sure your dining experience is not only authentic but enjoyable.

Had an amazing experience - just moved here and glad to find a great nail place so close to home. The ladies were incredibly efficient, and the manicure (French gel) was incredible. The leg and arm massages were the best I've had in a nail place and everyone was pleasant. Highly recommend!

The owners are assholes.  On multiple occasions I've ordered $200+ worth of pies to be delivered to compatriots, a mile from their establishment.  And multiple orders delivered to my residence, 5.3 driving miles, while tipping generously.  Then they arbitrarily decided that I was too far away to deliver.  No warning and no written policy on what distance was 'acceptable'.  I told the owner after a short discussion of the nebulous policy that he was an "asshole".  They deserve to go bankrupt.

Meh. 

The Greek salad was an extreme disappointment considering it was 6 + dollars. It was small but more importantly, really bad. It seemed to be a random assortment of pizza toppings thrown together. It was 80% spinach, 10% feta and the rest very small amounts of onion and literally 3 small pieces of warm iceberg lettuce. My advice, do not offer something on your menu if you're not going to do it right. The small Greek pizza was pretty good but the thin crust we ordered was actually quite doughy, which we both were surprised by. Honestly, I do not plan on going back.

Location just opened and this was our first time ever at a Red Robin. As packed as it was for lunch, the wait was only about 15 minutes for 2 of us. We were sat at a table barely a foot away from the table next to us,  so the lack of privacy was a little uncomfortable.

Being vegetarians, we were pleased that there were 2 different veggie burgers (Morningstar Veggie or Boca Vegan) that could be subbed on any burger! I tried the just the regular Veggie which had carmelized onions and zucchini on it....delicious!  Next time I will try subbing a veggie patty on one of the other burgers. Fries were also fresh and piping hot. Was a big portion, so I had leftovers for dinner.

Maria was our server and was terrific, especially given how busy it was. Overall,  we thought it was a little pricey - cost us almost $40 for 1 appetizer, 2 sodas, 2 burgers and tip. But we will be back since the food was good and it is difficult to find restaurants that have such great vegetarian options....which says a lot since this is a burger place. :)

This taco bell gets the job done! food is always correct, delish and hot. the boo and i are taco bell wh0res, at least once a week there is a craving. i never win anything and i do the damn survey all the time but overall, no issue fast food spot

The atmosphere in this place is pretty erratic and loud as far as the colors. In a good way. It does remind you of a tropical vacation Paradise. The bar is extremely large compared to most family restaurants. The bar stools are really comfy. The take out orders come from the bar. The tropical drinks have sunglass pins stuck in the fruits. They do beer buckets and have Sangria's and margaritas and normally about 14 beers on tap. The mozzarella cheese sticks were really really good. The All American, Black and Blue, and Good Egg burgers were all delish. The staff was friendly and even the hostess that set us initially came back during our dinner to check to see if everything was okay with us. Lots of photo apps especially when you first walk in they have the bright colored Lounge wooden chairs in the lobby. Parrots are everywhere and it gives you the feel of a tiki bar. The doors on the south side of the building are all garage door style and they open those during decent weather which creates a very nice breeze inside the restaurant. It just adds to the tropical atmosphere. The bathrooms were clean. The floor was kept clean. While we were there in the hour that we sat down for dinner we saw about 5 people come in for to-go orders, so if you're in one of the hotels that are close by this is a great option!

had no idea this place was here but I am SO happy that it is! I love Indian food and this place is absolutely awesome. It's the perfect little hole in the wall place. I came by myself, ate in, and felt right at home. great service and delicious food.I had the Chana masala. they offer what seems like an excellent lunch special that I will definitely be back for.
Came here for lunch. Fast Friendly service. The sushi came out quick. The presentation was amazing. Dry ice and a carved tower out of carrots. Would definitely go back.

My girlfriends and I decided to go up to Santa Barbara for the weekend and looked for  an affordable but nice place to stay. Affordable doesn't mean cheap and dirty with Castillo Inn. Our room was clean and decorated nicely. The beds were comfortable and our room even had two tv's. The only thing that bothered me a little was that the cleaning staff did not re-stock toilet paper and towels, which meant we had to re-use towels and at one point had to use tissue paper since we ran out of TP. We tried calling the front desk but it was late at night so there was no answer. Check out was the following day so we just let things be.They should have been more on top of things than this. Other than that, everything else was fine. 

Our room was on the 2nd floor. The booking, checking in, checking out process was easy. The location is perfect. 1/2 a block from the ocean and within walking distance to their trolley stop and the marina. You can take the water taxi from the marina to take you to the pier for restaurants, ocean, beaches, pier, night life, shopping, landmarks, etc etc. The trolleys are inexpensive and great way to get around. We had so much fun exploring Santa Barbara. It felt like time went by too quick but it was a memorable trip and we will definitely stay at the Castillo Inn if we come back to Santa Barbara.

I come here every time when I am in university city. Food is good specially the chicken tika. Some of there other dishes or a bit on the greasy side. But overall is a good restaurant to take your family to for a nice dinner.

Best food truck in philly, hands down.

So simple, a burrito truck, choose your filling, get some add ons if you want. And there you have it-- a full meal all in the compact wrap of wonderfulness that is a burrito from Mexi- Philly. I went to this place every day for lunch during my sophomore year, and now I rediscovered it after three years. The only difference is, back then I was a vegetarian. Although I usually go with the chicken burrito these days, the tofu one is still good, and there are plenty of other worthwhile fillings.  

Not particularly authentic, but the service is great, the price is VERY affordable (basic burrito with meat $4), and it will fill you up. Get a burrito here, you won't regret it.

I hate to give a good review, because then more people will start coming to what feels like a secret hideaway. Really it's all about two things, the staff and the gelato. The food and coffee are good, but the people and the impressive gelato selection are outstanding. Can't wait until it stops raining long enough to use the patio.

This was my first experience with hibachi and I definitely wasn't disappointed!  I got the hibachi shrimp and my fiancé got the hibachi chicken. The chef put on a really good 'show' for us, flipping his utensils around before he began cooking. The portions were plentiful and the food was very flavorful. Some of the shrimp might have gotten a little over cooked but that wasn't a big deal to me. The rice had a lot of flavor and the veggies were nice and crispy; everything was so good!  The staff was attentive and very polite. Definitely would recommend!
I had the steak bowl and it was delicious.  Since it's so new in our area the lines have been out the door so I recommend ordering on line which is very easy and you walk right up to get your food.

Not only a solid spot for well manicured cut, but a great place for the best customer service and easy conversation. This crew does it right and makes you feel relaxed and recharged in less than an hour. Nick and Isaac are the coolest guys I've met yet after living in Santa Barbara for over a year.

Just moved into the neighborhood and was looking for a good barbershop. I saw good recommendations for the Barbers Club so I stopped by. I was not disappointed. Really awesome staff, talented barbers and great environment. The boss was even walking around to introduce himself and socialize with customers. Great cut and shape-up, 100% recommend and I will definitely be back!

Pros: 

-the food here is REALLY GOOD (except the brisket sandwhich which is fatty meat)
-collard greens are awesome here as are the nachos
-Mary who takes orders is super nice and informative
-they have cool t-shirts
-parking is super easy
-great area with shops around

Cons:

-the servers do NOT smile here and are not friendly 
-my order was wrong and my server flatly told me she would check with the kitchen to see if it was my mistake or theirs. excuse me?
-same with my friend's order
-another friend had an expired ID and could not drink liquor. the bartender told her and my friend said ok. no problem. then the jerk of a bartender lady told my friend the same thing FOUR TIMES and then made fun of my friend to other customers at the bar
-the management did talk to us about the problems, but made no adjusments to our bill or anything 
-they were out of silverware in our area and instead of bringing us more our no smile server told us we could go to the other dining area and get them ourselves. 

I won't be back on future trips to Nashville.

We ate here on a Friday night and had a great time!

Our service was the best we've had anywhere in a long time. Christina was super nice and helpful as well as attentive to us. Great food and drinks as well. 

Located in a good spot on the strip next to a few hotels, you can't beat something this good within walking distance. They have a lot of seating which is always nice (and a good sign).

I had the shrimp tacos which were amazing. They were sweeter than I normally like, as I normally like spicy, but they were delicious. They had jicama coleslaw with pineapple in it. The sauce on top really perfected it.

My husband had the blackened grouper sandwich which was cooked perfectly. 

Definitely recommend!
I love this place, perfect location on the beach. The rooms were clean. The music was great live music and recorded and sound system was awesome. I just had a really perfect time for two days.
Ty came and switched out all of our locks. He was on time, friendly, and was even friendly to our dog. Locks work great and we feel much safer now. Highly recommend them!

Small froyo shop in the cute neighborhood off of Delmar and North & South. There were 2 vegan options: cinnamon and banana. I liked neither.  They had a watermelon flavor, but it contained dairy. WHY??!! The kids loved their flavors, which included salted caramel, chocolate, and cheesecake.  They offer 2 cup sizes here: large and larger. So no matter how little you put in even the smallest cup, it's gonna cost you $5. I'm not a fan of this money-grabbing practice.

I hear that they rotate the flavors often, so I wouldn't be against returning to see if they have more appealing vegan options next time.  However, in general, they are over-priced and would not be my first choice for dairy-free dessert. 

Also, if the cramped little parking area on the side of the building is full, there is more parking in the back, off of North & South.

8/16/2015
We were in NOLA for the Deftones + Incubus concert + wanted to cram as many memories as we could for an  overnight trip ( 5 kiddos @ home 5 -19). Wendy you were VERY warm + welcoming, as well as other staff! Thank you so much! 

Once I stepped into this hotel, the clock stopped.  Rustic, ghostly, with romantic novella vibes ambience. Our room was exactly what a couple wanting to rejuvenate, regroup, fall in love again needed.  Well air conditioned + ceiling fan. Actually had to turn the air off lol. Very clean. 

We love old buildings/homes  so this right up our ally.  My imagination got the better of me; had to have a lamp on for a couple hours. Just felt a presence.  
The complimentary breakfast was very lovely.  Enjoyed coffee+pastry on the balcony, in the 
company of my new found friend; baby gheko lol.

Parking was free depending WHERE you park. Wendy was kind enough to 411 us that as well.   My fella did walk just to check on things but everything was good.  We did park in front of someone's home tho. They were kind enough to allow it unless it's common practice.  There are lots 1 or 2 blocks where you pay to park as well.  Downtown was within walking distance.  It took 30 minutes in getting to the concert. That's a lovely hand in hand stroll.   
If you're not bothered by sweat, then keep strolling to the French Quarter! It rained our visit, but we didn't mind one bit! I could write more,but please see for yourselves! If you're uppity, naive about old buildings (you may see a few bugs; extreme heat, humidity + dampness, do the math),not into antiques or aged anything, this isn't for you.  

I didn't want to leave, and I guess NOLA didn't either because we had trouble starting our vehicle which has never happened even near empty.  We laughed it off, after 5 minutes it miraculously started.  Hmmm. ..Hoodoo Voodoo???

I had the caterpillar roll, which came with 10 ample pieces. It was definitely enough for a whole meal. I also had a miso soup, very generously priced at $1.50. The soup was hearty with miso, seaweed, mushrooms and tofu. The service was quick and efficient.

You can get just about everything here. Great variety on teas, seafood, produce etc... You can even pick up an electrical rice cooker, they have a great line of brands, better than other major department stores.

MD also sells cooked meals in the back of the store. Decent selection of Pork, Duck, among other dishes. Tried the duck, found it a bit greasy and a bit tough, very disappointing... this may have been the one downside to MD, but still a great market, great seafood and teas. Strongly recommend it.

If I could make one suggestion, it would for MD to offer samples on the regular. They have many items that look tempting and very appealing, I always feel undecided about buying because I've never tried it. Just a thought.

I used to eat Chipotle at least once a week. A few weeks ago, I had a complaint that I voiced with the manager. Basically, they skipped my App order with another web order that was placed after mine AND the person entered the restaurant as I was waiting for my order. I would've been fine if the manager apologized for the oversight and stated that he would go ahead and make it (by now, 3 more people had come in and my ticket was still in the wall), but he did not. He accused me of getting "feisty" with him. I asked for my money back and he apologized to the person behind me (who's order they bumped in front of mine) for the wait while he processed my return. I believe an issue of poor training and managerial skills. The customer is what drives a business and not apologizing for oversights and using derogatory terms is not conducive the brand. I emailed corporate and they offered me a coupon for a free meal. Not satisfied.

Taste of Music City was a great way to spend Saturday evening. Vendors had fresh food to sample. The lines moved relatively quickly. You knew which ones people were hyped to try by some especially long lines (this did not deter us from standing in them - no way! As the food was worth it.) Especially loved the fresh on site guacamole from Taco Mamacita! The BBQ Bean Roll from Puckets was delish! And, and the gin from  Corsair was smooth. So much more I could say about peach wine, locally brewed beer and Pina Colada Popcorn. Next time this happens - be there! Well worth it!

Side notes: 
Parking $5, and it was on a bridge, so you do have to walk up "hill" to get there, but at the end of the evening downhill and easy breezy.

Do not eat before you arrive. So much food, and your stomach will be more than satisfied.

If wanting to bring kids know this is a mostly adult event. Not a lot of seating + beverages are mostly alcoholic. So think twice before scrimping on a sitter. It might be well worth it to leave the kiddos at home and enjoy a night of adults.

I ordered the chicken strips and a couple hours later had the worst pain I've ever felt in my stomach. Didn't sleep much and the pain was so bad that I was close to going to the ER. Not sure if it was what I ate here, but it was the only thing I had eaten recently and the pain started immediately after! Not going to any Jack In the Box again. I don't trust that the food is sanitary.

(Maryland Farms Dentistry) MFD made the whole dentist visit experience more tolerable. I'm a big baby when it comes to going to the dentist. However, the friendly staff and Dr. Cochran took some of my woes away. 

The office is HIGH tech! Beautifully decorated, super sterile, t.v.'s at each station, stations are private, text reminders, and high tech dental gear! I visited MFD for over 7 years!! The only reason I stopped going was because I moved to TX.

And Dr. Cochran was even kind enough to personally refer me to three dentists in TX. I selected one from the referral list and am very pleased.
Swill is a great place to meet for business or conversation. There is plenty of space, wide tables, and good coffee.

McDonald's Fries are not vegetarian, are not free from Dairy or Wheat. 

They also contain hydrogenated oils. Blah. 

Its just odd that french fried potatoes contain wheat, dairy, and beef  "products"

I am an Chinese student in ucsb. For me, the food here cannot be called "Chinese food". Moreover, the service is horrible. I waited for 1 hour to have my meal ready. And the price is ridiculous in considering the quality of food and service.

so do NOT go there.

I come to 'feine at least twice or three times a week! All of their drinks are superb and I usually also pick up a half-priced pastry from the shelving on the side of the front room (regular's tip). The baristas are always friendly and the atmosphere is nice. The only bad experiences I have had here resulted from the occasional overly noisy customers or a barista's particular choice of music (one just played One Direction on repeat...shudder). 9/10 of my experiences here are very positive, and it's a great place to get work done. I only wish it was open until 9 or 10 at night.

I come here for Comfort. 
Comfort food that is. I know this is one of many chains, but one thing great about chains? Consistency. 
My all time favorite is the chicken and dumplings with a side of fried apples. Whenever I get that craving for luscious creamy dumplings and tart apples, there is only one taste you can find it. Not something to indulge in everyday, but when you get the itch for southern comfort food, this is the place to be.  If anyone knows how to make this meal (pictured above), I will negotiate giving you my first born for the recipe.
This is a great place to bring the family too! While you wait for your table, you can browse in their general store with all the fun nostalgic nic knacks. The staff was friendly and polite. It was a true treasure!

Cozy on up to the fireplace and you'll feel right at home. This place gives a rustic, hunting lodge feel that I just love. The lights are dimmed and when you step inside, it's like taking a small step back to a simpler time.

I've visited a couple of times in the past month. The bartenders and servers are very knowledgeable and friendly. Loved the wine and beer list. As for the food, I tried fish and chips and lamb sliders. The menu offers simple pub grub that doesn't disappoint.  Delish!  

If you live in the Maplewood, Richmond Heights, Clayton area, this is a great local hangout where you can meet up with friends and just relax.

We love Olio! It's such a fun place to go for drinks and small plates.  Located in a cool and quirky space in McRee town, the vibe is laid back and the menu is great! Most recently we ordered the corned beef sandwich, beet salad and zucchini carpaccio and they were all to die for!

Stumbled upon this place because we couldn't find another one and we were hungry!! I am so glad we did! IDelicious southern food- ordered the stuffed crab which was real crab deep fried that was so delicious - it came with mac & cheese and red beans and rice and homemade cornbread!! My mouth is still happy from this deliciousness. Couldn't stop eating it was so yummy!! Glad we came here and if ever back again, will make sure I go again!
Waited over 1 hour for pizza. And they called 20 numbers after us. Employees are rude! Would never recommend this place. Would give negative stars if possible.

I booked the Hyatt for one reason and one reason only,  They offered a free shuttle to and from the local college campus for a week long course I was taking.  The last day of the course I called for a shuttle pick-up and was told no.  The front desk person flat out refused to send the shuttle to pick me up. 

I can get not wanting (or being able) to offer shuttle service.  But if that's the case, don't advertise that you do.

Wish I could give this shop a better grade.......the staff were friendly, service was fine, ingredients inside the sandwich were fresh and good.....BUT - the bread was standard softy hoagie roll stuff, not the crusty, light baguette that makes good banh mi so delicious.  Typical banh mi are not the overstuffed "meat overload" sandwiches of Philly - so the doughy hoagie roll overshadows the rest of the ingredients here.

Absolutely fantastic experience! Our family of four, including 10 and 11 year old kids, like to find great places for breakfast. First Watch is great! We shared Belgian Waffles, egg tacos, an omelette, and avocado toast. It was delicious. We will be coming back. My daughter said we should give it 10 stars out of 5!

The staff was extremely nice, the service superb and fast!  Was visiting and got a bit sick of all the fried foods.  I'm Vietnamese so pho is always a staple and nice to have as an option when you're dehydrated from non stop adult beverages!  Went here with the husband and friend.  The pho was good and I also enjoyed the Vietnamese coffee. The atmosphere is super cute.

Standard beer and pub food fare. We tried four different beers: the mango IPA, the kolsch, the Brett Saison, and the Wit. We weren't impressed by any, but the Wit was our favorite out of the four. For food, we ordered corn fritters. The fritters were fine, but the sauce that came with them was a totally gross, fully congealed excuse for a queso. I held the tub of it upside down - nothing, it didn't drip. We were in the area and wanted to grab a beer, but I definitely wouldn't go out of my way to go back here!

Just overpowering.  Sushi is all about the fish, and everything here was about everything except the fish.  All the flavors were just so overpowering here, and when you tried to isolate the fish, it just wasn't the quality that I expect for sushi in comparison to some of the other local options.  

I do think if you're someone who is all into strong flavors and the texture of the fish itself is less important, you'll like this place, and I can see this being some people's favorite sushi restaurant based on how strong the sauces are, but for me, it's just too much sauce.  If you're about the sauce and smells and you don't really like sushi, this might be a good place to try to be introduced to sushi, but if you like subtle flavors and really care about the mouthfeel and flavor of the fish, I'd give this place a pass.

Amazing by the slice pizza but I saw one of the guys whip up a coney dog with a huge heaping of sauerkraut that looked amazing. The crust and sauce were spot on. Definitely coming back this is a must visit place.

I had high hopes for this place... been hearing about the view for as long as they have been open... too bad the food was whack.  i had the pork loin with beans and it was bland and the beans where not fully cooked.  highly disapointed as i had hoped that this place would have great food and a great view.  im being generous by giving them two stars. (one for the view and one for the effort) 

**also we made our reservations a month in advance so that we could get window seating in the main room... we ended up sitting in an area in the back of the resaurant which was like sitting in a hotel cafeteria.

I wish i would have known about this place sooner. Mexican food places in Tucson are a dime a dozen (especially on the Southside). So the fact that this place stands out says alot. I got 4 tacos...Birria, Cabeza, Barbacoa, and Pescado. The cabeza and barbacoa definitely stand out. Tip: when they ask you what type of tortilla to get...say corn. As a person who usually opts for flour i was very impressed by the thick homemade ground corn tortillas i got. Tip 2: When they ask you if you want salsa...ask for a bunch. This isnt that mild watery stuff you're gonna find at most places. Its got a heavy thick creamy consistancy with a nice kick. Very flavorful. Exactly what i want in a red sauce. Very filling at 1.60-1.80 a taco.

Defiantly a gem!  The food is absolute quality. I have been back three times and every time I fall even more in love with the food.  It truly shows that the chef cares about every dish.
Home made sausage with broccoli rabe, spinach gnocchi, and fish stew are some of my favorites.  Amazing experience every time!
The fries were really good; homecut can't be beat. I had the falafel sandwich. The falafel itself was flavorful.
Modern hotel in a very convenient location. We enjoyed our three nights here which was next-door to the Cracker Barrel.  The employees are very friendly The room was new, modern and, very comfortable

Dr. Bartley is the most thorough chiropractor I have ever been to. He is truly concerned with your well being and taking his time to properly adjust you. I was in a bad accident several years ago and have gone through a handful of chiropractors, and he is hands down the best one. If you're looking for a chiropractor, look no further. Im thankful to Sealand and Dr. Bartley for always being so accommodating. Also, you will enjoy the hydro massage chairs...HEAVEN!!!

Pleasantly surprised how much my wife and I liked this restaurant. The lunch buffet was delicious, and was a good way to sample different Indian dishes with just the right amount of spices. I recommend it highly.
Good food and boba especially the taro . service is straight to the point. It is a small place very much a deli

I love the feel of Cairdeas.  It's an adorable little coffee and deli shop in the heart of Dogtown on Tamm Ave.  The employees are nice, the food is good, and the coffee is, of course, fantastic- yay Kaldi's!  

Keep your coffee cup cozy and bring it back to get stamped each time.  When you get 5 stamps, you get a free drink.  

The spiked coffee they make for the St. Pat's Parade is amazing!  Even if you don't like coffee, you will love it made this way.

They are dog friendly and always have a bowl of water outside the door for your best bud to get a drink.

For this area, Red Mesa is the best Tex-Mex I've had, and I've tried a lot of them.  Very creative dishes, excellent flavor combinations.  I've never had a bad meal there, and have enjoyed every dish I've tried.
I'm so glad Bão is back!! My oil change today is $25 unlike $43 at Dons... beside the price Bao is a very nice guy!!!

I really liked this cute little spot. I ordered a berry waffle with berries on the side, an order of bacon and an order of potatoes. My waffle was delicious and the potatoes were perfectly seasoned, the bacon was good also. My husband ordered the beast sandwich and potatoes and he said it was very good and all the veggies on it tasted fresh. My friend ordered the meat burrito and he said it was flavorful and filling. It was slightly pricey for breakfast, but the ingredients are good quality so I suppose it's worth it. I was a little grossed out by the padding on the chairs that were full of gross stains. The owners should really look into replacing it with leather or something that can be wiped off. Also, when it was time to order they were out of a lot things already...we came on a Monday around 11am.

Three things to note:

1. Hand grenades are too sweet for my liking.
2. It's dirty, smelly, and loud in here (typical Bourbon).
3. Bartenders are rude.

This is a great place to go have some food and drinks with friends.  As brew pubs go it has all the essentials: a variety of beer; good burgers/sandwiches with a southwestern flair; and a great atmosphere.  Barrio Brew Co. is in a renovated warehouse just south of downtown which makes for a hip modern industrial feel and plenty of open space.  There are several large flat screen monitors and young attractive staff to satiate the needs of sports fans.  

The grub is definitely better than your average pub eats, and given the location and atmosphere there is not a better brew pub in Tucson.  However, if you're a real beer snob or hop head you might be a little disappointed in the beer selection.  While the beer is well crafted and balanced, you won't usually find any real complex or unusual brews.  That said, I will definitely go back, because Barrio is simply a great place to go have fun in a lively environment.

I felt four degrees cooler just walking into the place. 
This had nothing to do with the air conditioning.
Even with the tourists (not putting them down, I was one of them) flocking here, the Praline Connection is still able to keep the feel of a small funky soul food dinner. This is a place that is confident in what they are serving and that they are serving it right. Try the smothered pork chops and you want be disappointed.
This was an excellent find.  The pizza was amazing and the salads outstanding.  Fresh fresh fresh. Service great.  Wish we lived nearby would go all the time.

My boyfriend and I needed a place to eat before work and yelp let us here! It was a great experience and the food overall was great! I ordered the veggie Benedict and it was good! The sauce was little overpowering but it was still good in general. The staff was wonderful! Definitely have to come by again to try out other items on the menu!

We were a bit scared to order food here. The place had some stale smell. But, we decided to be brace & order food anyway since we were starving & felt lazy to find another place. Ceviche is awesome. Would go there again. Burrito & quesadilla were good too. Very reasonable too. Good food & portion!

The food was decent, but the portions could have been a lot better for the price. I had the duck gnocchi, and I have the feeling I should have gotten something more meat-centric. I'll probably go back, but my first experience wasn't great.

The food here leaves much to be desired. The Halibut was bland, the Tartar sauce did not go very well with the Chicken strips, and no butter for the baked potato! Decent steak bites and good Clam Chowder... I'll give them that.

They would have gotten 2-stars but for their kitchen being open past 11:30PM (on a Fri) when all the old farts in Santa Barbara have gone off to bed and the other establishments on State St have closed their doors...

They had some live music too... the dude wasn't great but heck he was out there playing. I respect that.

Seriously though... outside of K-town LA (and all the other cities in So Cal) suck when it comes to food after midnight... or even after 10 for that matter.

Came here for the first time while vacationing in clear water. Had to wait about 25 minutes, which wasn't a problem, but as soon as we got in the waitress brought our drinks and asked if we were ready to order. We obviously said no, as we had just sat down, and had never before seen their very large menu. She came back only about a minute and a half later and when we said we still weren't ready she stared and said "ooo-kay" as if she was irritated. She came back  a third time, only  a couple minutes later, and when one one of our party wasn't ready yet she walked off immediately. It was clear she was trying to rush us out, and the rest of the time she seemed to have a gripe with us and barely spoke or would make short tempered remarks. at one point, my girlfriend ordered a coffee, and she brought two. when we told her we only got one, she stared and said "oh, okay" and didn't begin to take it away. i just decided to say ill take it anyways. 

Besides the terrible service, the food was pretty damn good. I have had better though, but if this review was food alone it would get 4 stars. great food. bad service.

We had a nice time here. Great place for a group.

The restaurant handled a large group of 18 for us and I greatly appreciated the manager and our server,who was very attentive. There was one server at a busy place so it wasn't as fast as if we were a smaller, but more than acceptable given our group size. Also, the price point is very reasonable for NOLA.  We were upstairs and the room is spacious and a little loud with all of us talking.

For those who didn't like seafood, there was selection for them. I had a sampler and I found that I would have skipped and ordered the Etouffe as it is the best food in the sampler. My husband ordered the Creole House Po Boy which had a nice spicy (messy) sauce, but I missed the crunch of the fried shrimp.
Here in Philly on vacay from Miami... Decided to try it out and all I can say is AMAZING!!! The food was delicious! Highly recommend this spot!

I wanted to like the food here. We ordered fish and chips and lamb stew. Let's just say I won't be recommending it. Go there for a pint or two on the main floor but the second floor dining room was a bit of a mess and drafty too.

Barrio Brewing, and their University imprint Gentle Ben's, are like the 1993 Honda Civic of the Tucson beer scene. There is nothing particularly snazzy about them, but they are reliable, industrial, and get the job done. The barrio blonde and citrazona are perhaps their best known, but I also enjoy the copper pale and the rojo red ale. The latter are not sold in cans, but you can have growlers filled. Just make sure that your growler doesn't have any stickers or logos on it. They've also got a full bar. 

Where they really knock it out of the park is the food. Over the course of the dozen or so times I've been here, not one menu item has disappointed. Some favorites are the lizzy salad, buffalo chicken sandwich (ask for the gorgonzola cream on the side so that you don't get a moist sandwich), and the chips and guacamole. 

Again, I can't say I've ever thought "oh my god I really need a barrio beer right now!!!!" but the quality of the food, friendliness of the service, and enjoyable ambiance are what keep me coming back.

The atmosphere is nice, the service was really pretty good till the end when after clearing our table she must've gone on break or something. The place is laid out nicely, has a good feel to it and a good counter to pull up to if your eating alone(that what I do). I had the breakfast quesadilla and the wife had 3 scrambled egg whites cooked in olive oil. This was in up charged combo but very nice it was an option. Everything was fresh and the fruit bowl very sweet. My quesadilla was really good with real melted cheddar and chives that tasted fresh. Overall it was a good meal, very fairly priced in what looked like a newly remodeled, comfortable atmosphere.
We'll be back for sure to try more of the menu.
Fantastic Burgers of all variety! Huge list of Lagers and Ale and some really good dessert served in mason jars. Servers are very friendly and a very relaxed cool atmosphere.

We stayed here last week for a great rate ( reserved on booking.com ) the property in near one of the best restaurants in Tucson, and that's a huge plus in my book.  The property is older but well kept with beautiful landscaping and a clean pool.  We ordered margaritas and chips and salsa from the bar and enjoyed our down time poolside.  Friendly staff, and the rooms had unique touches like Mexican tiled bathrooms and tin headboards.  The only thing I didn't like was that the ground floor rooms have floor to ceiling windows on the sidewalk so if you wanted privacy, you couldn't have any natural light in the room. If you prefer natural light and not lamps, ask for a second floor room.

Loved the band Sunday afternoon. 2 dudes and fabulous. Stopped in for a beer and a quick bite. Back bar is laid back and groovy. Dining room folks thought band was too loud. Sat at a table 10' from band and could easily talk across the table. Manager harshed our mellow.  240 on a Sunday Funday. Get real.

Came here on a friend's recommendation when I was in town visiting my parents from San Francisco. Absolutely loved it!  Best, most interesting meal I've had in a long time. Super friendly attentive staff and lovely atmosphere, especially the outdoor patio. Cocktails were solid, good beer list. Highly recommend the hummus with lamb, the bruschetta,  the lamb pits, and the zucchini carpaccio.

We came in for rice bowls and love the simplicity of the menu and kind service. Food came quickly and the entire restaurant is immaculately clean. Nice seating options and calm decor. Food tastes great and was just enough for an early brunch meal.

I believe this is the first time I am giving a "restaurant" at an airport 5 stars!! Reason... huge smiles on everyone's face and great service which was great to see early in the morning. Definitely made me smile. Oh and the food was pretty good. I had the Reno quiche which hit the spot.
When all your employees have ear buds, listening to Spotify, it's not a good look.  Maybe that's why my order was late.

My friend and I were craving something new... we have Yelped across Tampa and St Pete, so now that we were about to go separate ways because our contract out here was ending and we have to go back to our main HQ of business operations, we wanted to try some local food fare that most likely wasn't available from our home cities.  He was craving chicken, and so here we are.  We pulled up and there was one car leaving.  They were closing in an hour so we skimmed through the compact menu.  What they lack in variations are found to be a key focus.  We both ordered the half chicken meal... and a ceviche appetizer to share.  *The ceviche will take 15 minutes to prepare.  
     So the rotisserie chicken come with 2 sides, and I chose the fries and cilantro rice.  Yeah I know, "double carbs"?!  I wanted fried if the rice sucked.  It didn't, the rice was good and even better with the house sauce.  There are 2 house sauces and let me tell you, they were both wonderful  I mean, I could have eaten the sauce by itself it was so good.  There was a jalepeno and cilantro one, OMG, this was the winner.  So when you see the sauces, there is a green one and a creme looking one (mustard based).  The chicken was sooooooooo good.  We both hardly spoke in the beginning and that's a sign of good food.  The chicken was moist and seasoned perfectly.  I don't know if I can remember a better rotisserie than this one.  I may even come here for lunch before I fly out.  WOW.  You know what?  I don't even want to finish this review, I can't say how awesome the chicken was with the cilantro rice and green sauce.  If there was a microphone to drop, it'd be on the floor, and no i wouldn't drop the chicken drumstick in its place, and if i did, i'd set in place the "5 second rule" which would be enforced in 1 second.  Go to Cuenelli's and have the half chicken combo!

The Avenue Clothing Co. is a great place to shop if you are looking for something office appropriate or conservative casual for women of any age.  I find this store is great for skirts and basic dress shirts as well as their jewellery, scarves and belts.  Things here are fairly affordable with most items under 150$, and there is usually a sale of some sort on as well.  The clothes here are not exactly trendy or overly exciting, but they are classic and great for basics.  I pop in here often as their merchandise changes often!

I was a member here many years ago (ok, five), and at the time I really enjoyed it. I was in shape and stayed in shape. Fast forward a few years (and many beers), and I have moved away and come back...both to Blue Bell and this gym. I have to re-climb the mountain, but in spite of my humbling I do enjoy this location quite a bit. Not the best gym of which I've ever been a member, but it is quite nice, rather cheap, and free of most sorts of BS. That is all I want.

They have plenty of Hammer Strength machines, and enough cardio stations during peak hours so you aren't standing around for minutes at a time not doing anything. Sure, the Devon Fitness Club beats this place for opulence (flat screen TV on every machine, anyone?), but this joint is far cheaper, so its a tradeoff. I have quite the beergut to remove but I don't feel out of place here, and that is all I wanted/needed. Just wish the music was better but I say that everywhere I go.

The lunch and dinner menu is pretty standard Mexican fare that you can find almost anywhere -- with a few oddballs thrown in, like a burger, club sandwich and Caesar and Cobb salads.  For breakfast, though, it really lives up to its name:  a weird combination of Mexican staples like huevos rancheros mixed with hybrids like breakfast burritos and then classic breakfast items like biscuits and gravy, French toast and Eggs Benedict.

The place does smell overwhlemingly of cleaning fluid/disinfectant.  I would not say it is particularly attractive inside, but it does have a certain diner-y appeal.  The counter seating is pretty neat looking, but they have so much stuff on the counter that only a handful of stools are available for eating at the counter.  The place was quite busy on a late Sunday morning.

The food is perfectly fine, if unexciting.  As others have said, it is the typical Mexican fare available at many restaurants in town and prepared very similarly.  The eggs were cooked perfectly to order.  The staff was very friendly and efficient.

Tucked away in an unassuming little strip mall, the Saltwater Grill does not look like much... but do not let that deter you.  Nice storefront, and the interior is very eclectic and bistro like.  It was raining the day I visited, so sitting outside was not an option.  

Anyway- to the food.  My dining partner and I split and order of the corn breaded catfish.  The catfish was tender, flaky and flavorful, and was ever so lightly yet crisply breaded.  I was impressed.  The bread they served was also good, and warm.  I ordered a cup of gumbo, and quickly wished I had ordered a bowl... it was that good.  

For my entree, I ordered the shrimp and grits.  OH. MY. GOD!  The shrimp was flavorful, I suspect it was grilled with bacon grease, and there were ample amounts encircling the plate.  The grits had cream in them, cheese and scallions on top, with a bit of bacon crumbles.  Until this point, I was not a fan of grits (having grown up south of the Mason Dixon line).  I loved these.  The right balance of savory, flavor, and a bit of spice in the shrimp.  I cannot recommend this dish highly enough.  If you decide to order, it is an excellent plate to share... or come hungry.  Really hungry.

Prices were what one would expect for the quality and quantity.  Service was efficient, friendly and accurate.

I plan on returning my next trip into New Orleans.

It was a hot day, looking for some refuge from the heat and find a good meal.
We came to the right place, hospitable greeting and nice bar service.
We had a great time and wish to visit again when in the area.
Honey Child! delicious ....
The food is good, but they forgot my sandwich order and I had to go up and ask in order to get it made.

What a spot! Ralph's is worth the trip for all of the pomp and circumstance said about it. The quality of food is top notch in an intimate, authentic old style restaurant. Will probably echo many of the other reviewers here, but stick with this simple statement: Bar none, one of the best dining experiences for Italian food in the Northeast, not just Philly.

Atmosphere - Ralph's is the oldest Italian restaurant still in existence in the United States. This is mentioned on the honorary plaque outside even before going in. The perfect balance of cozy and legendary, Ralph's decor and pictures show a timeless tradition of outstanding food and family pride. Tightly packed tables adorn the 1st of 3 floors, and the smells of the delicious cuisine permeate the air when you walk in.

Waitstaff - Our waitress was a traditional South Philly waitress, part attitude, part customer service, overall, exactly what you'd expect and want when dining here. Just added to the great food and wine, along with runners to bring out food, and crisp bread from the bakery just next door.

Food - Oh the glorious experience! Feasting on Italian since I was little, going out to try someone else's can really have a high bar to clear, and Ralph's set the new world record! From the delicious mussels in red gravy (get extra bread to dip in), to my heaping portion of lasagna, to the expertly packed meatballs, Ralph's had it all. Add on to that a slice of cannoli cake to split at the end of the meal and just made everything a home run in my book.

Intangibles - Restaurant has no lot, so valet is recommended on weekends. Closest garage parking is about 3 blocks up on South Street. Reservations should be made in all instances, as seating can be at a premium, saw a line out the door during our meals. Wine list is a little pricy, but well worth it for a party of 3 or more.

Overall - Ralph's is worth the high praise and affection, and is definitely a spot to check out on a foodie trip to Philly. The authenticity, quality, and old world style is very evident with everything here.

Everytime I have gone, the service has been slow. I guess it pays for the really always excellent veggie Italian wrap. They could lower some of the prices of the side items, $2.99 for Asian Slaw that is maybe a cup size. Probably meets serving requirements, but $ seems to me like it's marked up 250%.

Has a few of the common stores you'll see in the mall in one convenient location, but it would definitely be good to check online head of time so you know what stores to expect. It's in the city, so they make do with the space they have. I like to drop by for the Victoria's Secret (small selection though) and LOFT.

I have lived in Washington, California, and Idaho and this is my favorite Indian/Pakistani restaurant. This is the most authentic Indian food I have had in the states! The friendly service and atmosphere really make the Taj Mahal unique. If you are new to Indian food and are looking for something delicious to try I would suggest their tikka masala and an order of garlic naan  the best I have ever had!!!!!

Great tour. I went on the tour that covered Philly for 4.5 hours. Well informed guide... it met my expectation. Only issue is that it went over time due to a lunch break. My advice keep it under 4 hrs... inform the tourist they should bring snacks and water.

It limits the chances you will have tourist "dip out" on the tour and it operates efficiently.

Great snowballs.I really love this place and will always go back.
This is pure NOLA.

This place is a total tourist spot. It DOES NOT live up to the hype AT ALL!

Service is great. The food came out really fast and the staff is very friendly. 

We enjoyed the bonuts and our yummy Chai. 

Other than that, the biscuits were sooooooo dry and flavorless. Pretty much inedible. 

There are better brunch places in Nashville. Skip the hype and go somewhere yummy.

I had an amazing experience with Meredith who gave me a facial and Lina who have me a massage 
The atmosphere is peaceful. Everything is very clean

I guess this isn't my kinda place..
It's fun in there but it's really dark and loud - its a bar, so it has to be. 
But food is good.

Some friends and I stopped in here for dinner after hopping the bars down 4th street all day. The food was okay and the prices are pretty decent, but it wasn't something to rave about. The service was pretty slow as well. It's a nice little spot if you're feeling some quick cheap Italian food, but it's not the best I've had.

I'll start by saying that this place did not get a better rating because it's lack of staff. Hopewell valley vineyard is beautiful. They had two events on what turned out to be a gorgeous Saturday afternoon. They only had one person cooking, three people behind the bar. Clearly that's not enough. We weren't able to do the wine tasting because it would take too long. It took about 45 minutes to order a bottle of wine.  The staff was flustered and not in the best of moods. Most of the wines we tried were good. The prices are decent. I would visit again, just hope the experience is a little better.

Just ok. I had wings, potato salad, and a chocolate pretzel hand pie. My fav item was the potato salad. 

I think I would only eat here again if I was looking for late night eats after partying.

I wish I had found this place earlier and definitely plan on coming back! 

I had the French toast and fresh orange juice- while the French toast was pretty much like any other French toast, the lemon butter that comes with it was amazing and the fruit that came with it was quite fresh! The orange juice is pretty pricey at $5 but worth every penny- it's sweet, fresh, and pulp free!

Service was good, organized and timely! Everyone was kind and there was no confusion of where to order or how to get seated and stuff!

I like the overall laid back, friendly atmosphere and will recommend dawn patrol to anyone!

I love Samurai.  The food here is great, and the staff is super friendly.  I treat myself to dinner here at least one a week.  The waitstaff has even begun to treat me like Norm from Cheers.  They know where I like to sit, what I like to eat, etc., etc.  By far the best sushi place in the Wayne/Villanova/Bryn Mawr/Haverford/Ardmore area.

Let me start off by saying that this place is the Chipotle of sushi.  Came here when they first opened and the food was ok.  Recently came back and notice the quality of the food was not the same.  The fish and the toppings didn't look as fresh. Couldn't pin point which ingredients made each bit taste like "trash juice".   For the price they should not serve there food in plastic bowls the size of an ice cream cup.  I get it, this is not California or Hawaii but I don't think I will be back for a third time.

I have to disclaim before posting this lame review that I love the entire lineup from River Horse and especially Tripel Horse. I buy it all the time. That being said, we were very disappointed driving an hour from North Jersey on father's day weekend to see that Tripel Horse was not available. There were only 4 beers on tap. 3 were IPAs / pale ales and I forget the forth. 

The tour was your standard brewery tour but given their output I was expecting something more. I bought a large growler because again, I love their products and the ceramic cap chipped and broke the first time I used it... I may give it a shot again but there are more breweries to see.
Yummy and cheap oysters. That's all you really need to know.

Super Cool Vibe...Great Coffee.  Being a fan of their Truckee store I've been looking forward to this location opening for a while.  Since my kids ski race at Squaw and Coffeebar owner Greg used to Race for the University of Colorado...I've  developed a friendly customer relationship with Greg over the years. What a nice, friendly, fun guy...who just happens to know how to put out great coffee and food in the type of cool atmosphere Reno needs far more of...think Whole Foods but coffee. They're open late for hanging out.  Good music, the ever present soccer on TV, cool repurposed decor (the chandelier made from old chair legs is beautiful), back of the building garden seating, wi-fi, plentiful indoor seating, and a hip, friendly (Tahoe style) staff make it a welcome addition to the off-midtown neighborhood scene. My kids don't drink coffee yet but they love Greg's sandwiches and baked goods..especially the cinnamon rolls.  Back in the day we used to head to Deux Gros Nes for a milkshake after a movie. Now we'll head to Coffeebar for a decaf and gelato. Welcome to Reno, Greg...stoked to have you here.

I had Christmas dinner here. The place was packed to the gills, and it seemed the staff was a bit flustered. That being said, the food was great. We had a mix of veal, trout, and duckling. Everyone enjoyed their meals. They did bring me a trout instead of the roasted duckling at first which was a drag as we had been seated for quite a while. Probably spent 2-3 hours in the place, and only had some form of food infront of me for 45 min. ***
Yum, yum, yum, yum. I encourage getting a few different bowls and sharing them. So much yummy food. And lovely drinks!
Competitive pricing for a drive-through wash, with plenty of FREE vacuums for your seats & floor mats. Can't be beat, both for quality of wash (without damage to your finish) and value for the money.

I like this spot. It's a divey hole in the wall fried chicken joint. They have some different combos to choose from and also offer a wide variety of treats (read SWEET POTATO PIE!). I didn't have it, but it looked amazing. You receive your food in a box with some optional hot sauce. Opt for the hot sauce. From there devour with your hands and lick them clean. I should note there are a few metal tables outside, so keep in mind seating is limited. As a southerner, skip the sweet tea, it tasted like the bottled Lipton's stuff. Blech!

Althought I am not a gambler, I would still say peppermill is the best casino hotel in Reno. 
first of all, staffs are very friendly, it's more than just a casino. 
Newly renovated, all the rooms are with big flat screen tvs, so you can access to the game with out even getting out of your room. extremely  comfortable bed and soft bedding got me to sleep like a little baby and woke up regenerated the next morning. Peppermill's prompt breakfast in bed service is only a phone call away. 
There are many restaunts to choose from, nice recreation pool, aren't these enought to made a  great stay? 
(For wedding couples' need, there's also a fabulous chaple inside the hotel)

The only way I could afford this place on a semi-regular basis is during their happy hour, which features five different items for just $5 each from 5-7 pm. Two wines, two beers and a cheese plate. Lovely.

A friend and I shared a few things. A cheese plate, which was served with prosciutto, high quality olive oil and bread, followed by a small plate of figs and gorgonzola. The figs were smaller and tougher than I had hoped- they seemed previously dried, not fresh. An artichoke panino came next, which we subbed goat cheese for instead of feta- delicious. We wrapped up our meal with another sandwich- dessert, this time. I recommend the caramel, banana and marscapone cheese panino over anything else on the menu. Mmm...

This place is the place to go if you like the small town, whole in the wall (in a GOOD way), local atmosphere. The live music was good and the staff were friendly. This was definitely the the atmosphere my husband and I were looking for while visit Nashville. We only stopped in for one drink but when we visit Nashville again, I will go here and would recommend you checking it out.

I love Trader Joe's.  I've loved it in Chicago, I love it here. Love love love checking out dealson wine.   My only I only comnplaint (and why the negative one star) is that there is no Trader Joe's closer to downtown, and both of the local once are equally as inconvenient to get to.  I frequesntly buy cheese and wine here and their cocktail sauce is not bad! Not a fan of going on the weekends when it gets too crowded.
Great place for taco Tuesday. I always get the Cadillac Margarita with Southern Tacos. Try the Mexican street corn also! Very large place and great for groups.

The food is always good.  I haven't had a bad meal there yet.  If you don't get full off the delicious bread and oil, grab some calamari and share with a friend.  Most of the time I get the pasta...campfire fettucini to be precise..pasta, chicken, andouille sausage and spinach.  It is on the spicy side, but it is so good!  They should know us by name we go there so much!

I spent most of last week at my sister's house in Claymont and wanted to try one of Rigatoni's supposedly "famous" crab cakes. Last Wednesday (02/10), my brother-in-law and I ordered two entrees for pickup: I got the 4 oz. Crab Cake Platter with a Mediterranean salad, and he got the Supreme Crab Combo with a Crab Pretzel. Although I enjoyed my crab cake, I wasn't too thrilled with the Mediterranean salad; I thought I was going to get an actual salad and instead I got pasta salad in an odd-tasting peppery sauce (?). Also, I wasn't too keen on the price. $8.99 for a small-ish crab cake is a bit steep in my opinion. I understand good crab meat can be expensive, but I have a feeling Rigatoni's tends to lean towards the high end of the pricing scale for no other reason than the fact that they have no competition. 

My brother-in-law wasn't entirely pleased with his meal. He said it was "all right", but then felt nauseous afterwards. He was sick for most of the evening nursing a queasy stomach. My sister tried some of the Crab Pretzel and started feeling sick late that evening into the next morning. Maybe there were some pieces of crab that weren't exactly fresh in that pretzel or in my brother-in-law's meal, but I do know that my crab cake was very good, and the pieces of the Crab Pretzel I ate didn't give me any digestive problems. Still, it's disconcerting that two out of three people who ate something from this establishment got sick. I don't like playing stomach roulette when I go out to eat.
Found a hair in my pho, my friend had the beer pho and there was no beef it was all fat. Booba tea was good but they need to put more tapioca balls in their drinks.

I would definitely recommend going... I recommend Celeste she is very informative about the entire process. It was my first Brazilian wax and she talked me through the entire process. They offer discounted prices to first time customers as well

The lightning is terrible you can't see their mistakes until you get outside - how do you miss half the nail with nail color?? I have no idea - the girl pow who did the dip on my finger nails sucked - she was very  judgementsl I don't dig that at all - plus her skills stunk 2 days later all the tips of my nails are chipping off what a rip off

My favorite is mnm concrete. and the Hawaiian. 
love Ted Drews I been going there since I was little favorite ice cream ever!

I'm not usually one for national chain restaurants, but this Joe's Crab Shack is something special...

I highly recommend bypassing the ordinary chain-restaurant-dining-room and immediately heading back to the balcony in the rear.  Who knew that this place was situated right next to a little private lake behind all of the strip malls of 86th Street?!  Sitting on the balcony, watching pontoon boats putter by while cracking some crabs  is not a bad way to spend an evening.

Or, if you're not interested in dropping a bit of money by getting the crab, grab a drink and some appetizers while on the balcony and you're immediately transported to a seaside destination.

But don't go in wintertime.  I think it would be chilly on the balcony and the inside restaurant isn't worth the price.  :-)
It's great. What else do you want me to say? The have an entire flight of bacon. There. I said it.
One of the BETTER places in Reno for sushi. Definitely better then the over hyped ones in the casinos. Sushi to rice ratio is MORE sushi so that's definitely a place. Will definitely be back!
Highly recommend any of their salads ( especially the pear salad and the protein bowl)!! This spot is super delicious and always tastes fresh.
A great lunch option during the week with very fast service. The food is always good and the atmosphere is nice too. Good place to take a break for shakes when shopping at the mall. My kids like it.

Han Dynasty,

You brought me out of Yelp retirement. Do you know what that means? I was 1-2 bites into my delicious bowl of braised beef noodle soup when I had the compulsion to write a yelp review about this soup! 

I'd always heard Han Dynasty is the best, but after 10 years in the area, I finally tried it. I could not believe how downright deliciously flavorful everything in that soup is! There are slices of fresh ginger, sliced garlic cloves, something else with perfect bite and flavor that I don't even know what it was, and the beef! and the noodles! 

My mind was blown. 

The service was wonderful. I chose takeout on my way back from a doctor's visit and my food was ready quickly. I was also offered water while I waited.

I can't wait to go back!

Sincerely,

Margo

We were only able to stay one night in the area so I was hoping the amenities of the hotel would make up for not being able to explore the area.  I was wrong.  I only gave 3 stars instead of 2 because the entire staff was incredibly nice.  First of all the place is a maze which we did end up laughing at.  There are signs but the signage is not good.  I can see where someone who stays there all the time might enjoy the place (if you can afford a higher end room).  For new-bees it was just about 18 hours of confusion.  We stayed in Magnolia and I loved the outdoor pool there (and it was close) but it closes at 6 and doesn't open till 10.  If you want to enjoy a pool you have to go somewhere else and even with all our exploring I never even noticed a sign for it.  It's summer, it's hot and people like to swim outdoors.  Check in was like moving cattle, check out at Magnolia was painless.  The room was adequate but nothing special, clean but a little dated.  Parking-I've stayed at some high end hotels and most validate parking for guests.  We valet parked for about 35 dollars but self parking with ta was still about 25 dollars.  Huge drawback.  In our situation we were stuck eating at the hotel.  We ended up eating at Jack Daniels which was very good.  Breakfast was another story.  The only restaurant available for breakfast was at the other end of the complex.  When you're hungry and need coffee the last thing you want to do is walk a country mile to eat. Again breakfast was an astronomical price for a good breakfast that would be half the price anywhere else.  Hate to say it but parking alone will probably keep me from staying there again, at this price I'll spend my money downtown.  That is of course you love a lot of green plants.  Not even that many interesting flowering plants.

If I could give two separate reviews for food and service, I'd give food a 5 and service a 1. The food was delicious. They offer a wide variety of tasty pan-Asian fusion cuisine and the interior ambience is fantastic. The service, however, kind of sucked. I'm not sure if it was the time of day (8 PM on a Sunday) but our waitress was all but totally absent. We had to get her attention for drink refills multiple times and our appetizers weren't brought out until we had finished eating dinner and were ready to leave. There was only one other couple in the restaurant during our visit so the slow, inattentive service was inexcusable.
Without a doubt, the second best place to see a baseball game.  There is nothing like the fans cheering on their Phillies!!!

Decent hotel for the location and price. Newly remodeled, good breakfast and ok dinner. A few kinks,  though. First, only one of the two guest elevators worked during my stay.  Second, the refrigerator was not cold enough to use safely. Third, it took three calls to the hotel desk to get a form faxed to me prior to my stay. None of these things were dealbreakers and I would stay here again. Oh yeah, WiFi never worked and neither did the Ethernet port at the desk.

I got my haircut from Andrew for the first time a few weeks ago and I must say, it was one of the best haircuts I've had (this was confirmed by my fiance as well). The man definitely knows what he is doing and I already have my next appointment scheduled.
I've always been bad about washing my car but the unlimited wash service has made an amazing difference in my life!

If only for the food, to be honest, they are probably over-charging. 
But the ambience was so nice - intimate yet classy.

Seafood gumbo was a complete indulgement.
Comparatively, the shrimp etuffee was good, but not as good.

I've ordered here several times and the person on the phone always sounds confused. It's almost as if I always happen to call when someone is training. Lo and behold, our order is usually incorrect. I've switched to Amici for my around-the-corner pizza fix.
Soft tofu jigae. Awesomeness and with great rice.very authentic

Went here for breakfast and then later on dessert that same night. Breakfast was really good and I loved he overall atmosphere. We sat on the patio and enjoyed fantastic fresh fruit, perfectly done eggs, bacon and a very good cup of coffee. My only negative to the breakfast was the limited menu since it was a weekday. I went there to have the french toast I read about in other reviews, but it wasn't on the weekday menu. we returned at the end of the day to try the Blondie dessert which was great, maybe a little too sweet for me! I will definitely return here if I am ever in St.Louis again.

New Day has been serving meads and ciders in Fountain Square for about seven years.  So, I thought it about time to stop in and see what I was missing.

The shotgun style shoppe has a serving room in the front and a gathering place/gallery in the back half.  The serving room is lined with tables on the left.  The right side is made up of a display area for merchandise and a long bar area that has blackboards for upcoming events, beverages, and menu items to enjoy while sipping your drinks.

Since it was my first time here, I went with a flight (6 selections for $8).  They hand you a flyer that you can fill out and indicate your selections.  On the back is a listing of custom cocktails that are available made from the house beverages.

Okay, I will admit that I had no idea what mead was other than something knights and commoners drank while roaring about their conquests.  So I asked.  Basically, it is similar to wine, but made with other fruits instead of grapes.  They can also use honey instead of sugars.  However, like craft beers, the drinks can have a variety of ingredients that can take them into a wide range of flavors.

My flight had three hard ciders and three meads.  The Gold Rush (6% ABV) is a dry, champagne like drink.  The South Cider (6%) is more of a gateway beverage for someone who is used to commercial apple ciders sans alcohol.  It is sweet with the taste of apples and honey.  I also tried the seasonal Barrel Aged JC (Johnny Chapman) that is deep in flavor due to the black strap molasses (12%).  This is a drink for those who like their drinks to kind of slap them in the face with flavor!  Surprisingly smooth, it is very complex and somewhat herbal in aftertaste.

The meads I tried had a variety of flavors.  The Washington's Folly (6%) is a cherry mead with fresh tart cherry notes.  The Shelby Blue Ribbon (6%) is made with Strawberry and Rhubarb.  The aroma of rhubarb adds to the enjoyment of this one.  My final selection is another seasonal selection called Breakfast Magpie (8%).  This is a black raspberry mead with a strong coffee (espresso) infusion.  The coffee taste is strong and dominates the raspberry flavors.

As for the rest of the business, the staff seems friendly and well informed.  The merchandise ranges from t-shirts to glasses and growlers.  There are several selections available year round, but the seasonals come in roughly each quarter, but last only as long as the supply lasts.  

Overall, I really enjoyed my beverages and the experience here.

Review #251

Long drive-thru time but I am not going to blame the workers.  I am going to blame the company for selling food that requires heating.  The person who took my order was super pleasant and my coffee was hot and exactly as ordered.  I've never had a bad beverage from this location....just don't go if you're in a hurry.

While Sobeys isn't my go to for the majority of my grocery shopping, I most definitely appreciate their meat and cheese deli areas and the customer service I receive when asking for suggestions or help in selecting items.  There are usually samples available or if requested.

The store is always clean and I've never had to wait more than 5 minutes to check out.

They don't charge for bags - Yay and they don't make you use a stupid discount card to get a "club" price which makes me BONKERS!  They have recently started awarding airmiles here; if you collect them, it's worth grabing your flyer for the week to get the coupon for bonus airmiles.

Oh and you don't need a LOONIE for a cart - Double YAY!

I consider myself lucky for coming across Village Whiskey out of the blue on my first ever visit to Philadelphia. I was on a short road trip with a dear friend and her mom. We ended up parking right by the entrance of the restaurant with empty stomachs. 

The staff was friendly but tables were high, small and cramped. They sat the three of us at a table that was clearly for two. We nearly  got up and left but were lured by the  sight of the burgers at a table beside ours. 

One glance at the menu and we were hooked. We started off with the house made cheese puffs and the fried shrimp. Both were very scrumptious. And you wouldn't expect fried shrimp to be so tender and juicy. We skipped the pickle selection and I regret it. I took a picture of the pickles at a near by table just to remind me to order it next time I'm there.

For our main course we shared the bbq pork sammy with cole slaw on tender bun. Oh my gosh, it was beyond perfection. Tender pulled pork embraced in tangy homemade bbq sauce. 

We also shared the Whiskey King - 8oz of juicy, seriously juicy medium rare burger, topped with applewood bacon, rogue blue cheese, maple bourbon glaze cipollini and a slab of perfectly seared foie gras. One second for me to regroup after remembering this epic mouthful. 

And as if we needed more richness out of a meal, we made the wise decision to order the red velvet milkshake. The best milkshake I have ever tasted. Enough said. :-)

WOW!! Such a beautiful place! Reminds me of a Parisian bakery. Ordered a slice of the red velvet cake. It was phenomenal! The atmosphere and ambience is delightful! Will definitely be back. Such a treat!

The hot dogs are as good as a hot dog can get but one instance that made my experience so much better was the service! One of the cooks was so kind to me and even gave me a mess up order! It made a huge difference in my experience

Checked this place out on Tuesday with my girlfiriend, it was AWESOME. The fish was some of the best quality I have had in Reno. The menu was varied and the dinner all you can eat of $18 is cheaper than the average in Reno. We were the only people there at first, which was semi worriesome, but all for not. They need to do a Groupon or something to get the word out so they can stay in business. Definitely recommend this ALL :)

I just have to say that Toni was exceptionally helpful and really took my style in hand. She helped me find the perfect dress and a gorgeous sash that was the perfect compliment. Way to go Toni  and thank you for all of your help. Maybe I should ring the bell for you.

Once again, Eyesite and Gene have gotten me a WINNER!!!

I am in love, love, LOVE with my new glasses.
They are from Belgium and very unique looking.
They make me feel like a butterfly when I wear them.
