They are so light and comfortable - and GORGEOUS.

I absolutely love to shop for eyewear - and I go to lots of higher-end shops, but EYESITE is where I purchase my frames and lenses.

Simply the best.

Can I give less than 1 star? I was staying at the hotel and just needed a small salad to go. Not a complicated order in my opinion, but it took 23 min for it to be served to me. I ordered from the hostess thinking it would be a quick order, the restaurant was not very busy, and it was such a simple order. Tnhe hostess left her post and disappeared. After 10 min. I sat at the bar and continued to be ignored there as well. A bartender came up to me 10 min later and asked if I had ordered. When I let him know that I had ordered over 20 min ago, he just walked away and chatted with co-workers. I will never go back there again!

Been here a few times recently. The food is always very good and fresh. The fresh corn tortillas are my favorite. Very reasonably priced and authentic Mexican tacos! The family that runs this place is very nice as well. Definetely a Tucson gem!

I came in for breakfast this morning and spoke to the server. She seemed perturbed that I didn't need a menu or straws with my drink. I eat every meal at a restaurant just about every day. I ordered 3 buttermilk pancakes with 4 sausage links and two sausage patties. When the food came out it looked like something from McDonalds. I don't know if they have smaller pancakes there but the ones i've always got covered the plate. The check came as soon as the food as well. She seemed chatty with a table next to me but cold as ice in my direction. I generally tip really well upwards or more of the cost of the meal but she ended up with 20%. Which Im sure she was delighted but on that $12 meal I would normally l would round up to $35 so a $23 tip. Better luck next time if I ever go back into that one.

I went here with my boss a year ago. The food was delicious. Service was great. It was a little loud for our lunch but I would go back with friends. I tell many pilots(I work at an airport) to try it out for lunch and they have all loved it.

Oh DSW, you kill me with your rewards certificates and affordable prices.

I have to watch how often I actually step foot (pun) in the store, lest I use up my monthly budget in shoes! Often times, I'll stop into this DSW to find shoes for special occasions. Most recently, that was a job interview a couple weeks back. After perusing the shelves for a few minutes, I found the most perfect shoes -- and landed the job, though I can't say for sure if there was any correlation!

My only very minor complaint is how quickly the freebies go. A clerk said that after the mailers for free items (with a purchase) are delivered, usually the stock is emptied within a few days. Granted, I really didn't need a free tote, but still.

Very educational. Well paced tour of four wineries and about 20 plus wines. Great lunch as well. Absolutely worth every penny and more! Shawn is a very knowledgeable and seems to enjoy each tour as much as every customer! I highly recommend this tour, whether your an expert or a novice about wine making.

N.B.: Dynasty 3 has recently and puzzlingly been renamed "Misto Diner" (whatever that means), and Yelp hasn't caught wind of this. Look for a purple, barely legible sign that says "Misto Diner."

Given the surrounding area, one can assume that nobody's coming here for an authentic, mind-blowing Chinese experience. That noted, Misto serves its purpose well. It functions as the go-to, neighborhood Americanized Chinese joint, with a very friendly staff. A cursory glance at the menu reveals all the classic American Chinese staples: Egg Foo Young, General Tso's Chicken, various meats in garlic sauce, and the like. All of these dishes are competently prepared with ingredients of a decent quality, though the cooks tend to oversalt things a bit. Despite some flaws I consider Misto's food the best Chinese in Bensalem.

Misto also has some of the highest prices. Although the quality of the food is laudable and consistent, the prices are steep ($10-12 for a dinner combo). Grab lunch there if you can, as you pay $6-7 for a combo meal that's essentially a dinner portion. 

Misto Diner serves its purpose and caters to its market well. I've been eating here for years, which speaks equally to the decent food quality and convenient location. Stick to lunch specials to avoid heavy spending, though.

So back in December when Silk put out their yearly Soy Nog and Pumpkin Spice flavors, I had trouble deciding which one to buy. I had already tried their soy nog and thought about just sticking with a good thing. On the other hand, the pumpkin spice could be awesome. I was in the middle of this dilemma when one of the guys stocking the case noticed my perplexed look. He popped open a pumpkin spice for me and let me sample it. After I decided I really liked it, he marked the carton as a sample and I got to take it home for free! Now that's customer service!
The best turkey sandwich I ever had on a brioche bun!!! And their Oreo chocolate fudge shake was amazing and a beautiful view!

How could I not gladly wait 45 minutes and come back to order because the crawfish were JUST coming in from off the boat?! You can't get fresher than that. 

I got a whole pound of freshly boiled crawfish and loved every bite. They were sweet, tasty and boiled in great but subtle spices. 

We sat at the counter where they shuck fresh oysters and it was picturesque. Better than a sit down restaurant for this kind of seafood experience.

With all the bad reviews I was reluctant to come in. I was pleasantly surprised at how friendly the staff was and how productive the visit was. I needed to switch phone numbers from another carrier and add it to my existing account bringing my own device. The whole transaction was very smooth and the person helping me knew exactly what to do. I was very pleased.

Delicious! So glad that this gorgeous little coffee and donut shop moved in! It's beyond cute inside, and the donuts are delicious. Keep in mind, the donuts are baked and available in just a few flavors daily, but I haven't had one that disappointed me yet. Their cold-brew coffee is also wonderful, perfect for the hot, hot summer!
the seafood soft tofu bowl was really tasty although I wish it had more seafood...i would skip the bbq chicken though at it was pretty plain tasting.....would be great on a cold rainy day
Pizza is good, cheesy (But don't get mushroom. They use canned, not fresh)...wings eh. Customer service is inconsistent. Four words that can use more: Hello, please, and thank you.

I went there for a 50,000 mi maintenance and the first thing I observed (compared to my previous experiences with other Honda dealerships) is that guy said, "okay" and looked at me. I was glad he didn't sell me anything, but was a tad disappointed that I had to ask for services. So I said, "oil change, new tires installation and that'll be that." He quoted 115$ and I was okay with it. However, there was some issues with the front wheel vibrating when braking and I asked for a diagnostic. the dude came back with a "need to sand the rotors" and the cost is 180$. I had no choice and I went with it. Only after I went home did I realize that there was labor involved in removing the tires and labor with sanding the rotors. BUT, the sanding the rotors should not have costed as much because the tires were out anyway for replacement. I found that a rip off of sorts and I think I will reconsider my choice next time I go for service with these guys.

the waiting room was okay, with internet access and shitty coffee. Nothing to write home about. The service was well done as I don't have any issues now, but I would go some place else for any other repairs next time.

When they first opened it was consistently amazing but now not so much. I live 400 feet away and every time we have ordered in the past few months, food comes out soggy, we show up on time to wait for fries so burgers get cold. Not sure what is missing in the process because they always have plenty of people working. Need to refocus on the details to make the burgers worth another try!
This is by far the worst place to eat!!! Extremely long wait times, small portions, and on top of that they did away with bread!!! Realy,  bread!!!

This is our favorite place to go for halal steak and wings. Always cooked perfectly. They have a great selection of comfort foods like lasagna and my favorite, the chicken stirfry. The plates are pretty big and I always have leftovers to take home. I just wish they had smaller plates for a lower price because I never finish everything haha. Definitely recommend this place
Everything, and I mean everything is great here!  Faves are usually the number one or number three.  Service always with a smile and they are way vegetarian friendly.  Go here!!!

So I attempted another time for this place...and my rating won't change. This place shouldn't claim to be a "cafe "if they can't serve customized coffee. I asked for a simple iced coffee with a splash of caramel , but the rude server said "we don't have any of that , I'll just have to give you regular coffee with a side of ice ". So in other words...they don't care about making their customers happy. I don't see what's so hard about making an iced coffee. This place thrives only from the good food...but service had gone to crap. Never shall I dine here again. May skyway cafe hit the skyway and into the ocean.

We were in town for NYE and always try to find a local spot to eat,  this one is a definite return visit spot!  BBQ nachos were good,  she got pulled pork and I got Brisket platter.  It was all great!  The Brisket is the best I have ever eaten!  You can't go wrong!

So the crawfish beignet is the best appetizer I've had in Nola.  Life changing even.  I had the Shrimp fettuccine alfredo with veal and scallops.  The alfredo sauce was perfect, not to heavy but still delicious.  Also had bread pudding and cheesecake which I both highly recommend. New favorite spot!

Layla's is one cool dive bar with kickass live music. It's two stories, and the second floor has a great view of the stage but if you want the music to kiss your face than sit up front. Service was great too as both the bartender (who sang a song with the band) and the wait staff made sure your drinks were always full. There's plenty of options around the vicinity but Layla's knows how to take care of its patrons.

Admittedly, like many reviewers, I found Dr. Biscardi through Yelp. After reading all the rave reviews about her, I knew my search for an optometrist was over. The reviews do not lie. Upon my first time meeting her, Dr. Biscardi greeted me like a long time friend. She made the entire eye exam comfortable for me and explained everything in detail. I had problems with my contacts constantly drying out and she helped me to find the right fit of contacts. You can tell she genuinely and truly cares about her patients and their well-being. Healthcare needs more providers like Dr. Biscardi! The front desk were all lovely as well. They are experts in picking out the right frames that fit your face. I often stop by the office to get my glasses adjusted/tightened and although I am embarrassed to stop by unannounced, they never make me feel bad about coming in to fix my glasses. Dr. Biscardi books months in advance-that should tell you the kind of provider she is!

The building is a repurposed commodities exchange from the late 1800's, so if you're going for the history, that's pretty cool. The gift shops are, well, gift shops; and the food is pretty average. It's definitely touristy, but certainly not trendy. 

Downside: Student tour groups tend to converge on the Bourse during lunch time so it can get pretty loud and overcrowded. Ah, to be young again!

Upside: You can get the sightseeing tour buses and the horse and carriage rides right outside The Bourse, and you may run into Betsy Ross (I did today) or Ben Franklin! 

My recommendation for those visiting Philly, consider The Bourse a pitstop but not a destination.
Excellent and fresh sushi! Started with the soba noodles and ginger salad. So delicious! I got the J&J roll and I wish I had ordered two!! Best sushi I've had in the city by far.

I'm giving it 5 stars because it's still the original theater. Which means it's pretty old.  But the seats were comfortable and it was clean. Banquettes and tables...not rows of seats clipped together so you have no room to breath.  Hate to go to shows in some of the casinos where they use the ballroom and squeeze as many seats as possible in.  The theater is small, so there are no bad seats.  We sat at a banquette in the back and saw everything.  And yes, they do come around and offer you drinks.

Tonight we saw Rendevous with the King.  Pete Storm a British Elvis impersonator.  First he came out in an Elvis white sequined jump suit and did a tribute of Elvis Songs.  Then "dead Elvis" appeared and told him to dump the jumpsuit, if he were alive he would have changed attire according to the era.  Had Pete dress in denim and sing a Bruce Springsteen song, then as Michael Jackson for one of his songs.  Then a country song, then Uptown Funk (each with a different wardrobe).  Finally "dead Elvis" told him to be himself.  So one more change of clothes and he sang a song that he wrote.  Then Pete said that he also impersonated other singers and sang songs by Dean Martin, Johnny Cash & Bobby Darin.   Then he closed with a very sad personal song written by a friend (this was the best song he did).

All the songs he did, he did in impersonator voices.  Not sure whose voice he used when singing his own songs.  You would only know he was British when he talked, not in any of his music.

Unfortunately, it was just ok.  I, personally, was not impressed with the show or his voice. Too much talking by "dead Elvis." This was the opening show and it was being recorded.  Curious what cuts they will use to advertise this show.

As far as the theater itself, I would definitely go back to see other shows.
Great little place. Food is amazing here. Found this place just by driving by and I'm so glad I did.

I've been to this establishment multiple times and have never had such poor service as I experienced today. The customer service today was AWFUL!!!! 

The waiters were running around like chickens with their heads cut off. The waiter came to our table and didn't greet us. He only said "you ready to order?" After two of us ordered, one friend started placing her sushi order but was deciding between two rolls. The waiter literally ran off in the middle of her speaking and said "be back! Let me get somebody else's drink. Every minute counts!". We were baffled at this. In addition, for myself and another friend, our food was much spicier than we requested. He gave us an attitude & then sent somebody else over to the table to assist. He never once asked if we needed refills. 

Needless to say, we won't be frequenting this establishment anytime in the near future. I would suggest they get a larger staff to help during lunch.  so every customer receives good customer service.

I stumbled across this boutique by accident and finding this place made it a great day. Chock full of adorable clothes, you can find almost any style here, from bedazzled to retro, from clubwear to workwear. Some items seem a bit on the expensive side, but you can definitely find some great deals here. If you like Urban Outfitters and ModCloth.com, you will LOVE Imagine That.

Wonderful rolled tacos and awesome carne asada burritos (they leave the rice and beans outside which is how a burrito should be made!).

Best taco shop in the region!

I'm not one for bad reviews because I don't normally have time to complain about niche issues, but this restaurant was literally deplorable. 

My French toast was white bread covered in batter, dropped in the same deep fryer they cook their fries, chicken, etc. I'm pretty sure the maple syrup was that corn syrup substitute stuff they give you at hospitals or whatever. I also had eggs and they were literally some of the most disgusting eggs I've ever eaten in my life. I prefer my college cafeteria eggs and that's saying something. This was 18$. I didn't even want to pay for it, probably one of the worst meals of my life. 

We also waited around 45 minutes to get our food that apparently they put seconds into preparing. They literally throw these cooked substances on a plate and feed it to you. Staff was nice but the food was just so bad I couldn't see past it. 

Best part of the whole experience was how hard me and my friends were laughing about this train wreck of a Saturday brunch. 

Avoid avoid avoid.

Bad service, okay food. Bar was slow and they were out of many wines/beers and no clean wine glasses?? This was a Wednesday!  Limited menu. Only one salad on the menu and it was a Ceasar - horrible!
I will not go back...

I am the pickiest person when it comes to eyebrows!! Just the thought of someone else waxing them makes me nervous.  APRIL however is the best eyebrow waxer I have ever met.  April always asks what you want, and does a great consultation.  Ladies if you want gorgeous brow go to APRIL!!!  Not to mention she does all facial waxing, as well as lash tinting, brow tinting and so much more!!!!  She is so professional, not to mention clean!  I never have to question how clean something is.  
P.S.  She sanitizes her hands before she starts any service! lOVE LOVE LOVE HER!

Went here on a Thursday night with my girlfriend food was awesome I love when people take pride in what they do and this place does. Our waitress was very nice I think her name was Brianna and the general manager Nick was very personable and even sent over a free dessert and said sorry for your loss as we just came from a viewing for my buddies mom. That actually blew me away and just shows what kind of people work here it meant a lot we will definitely make this a regular stop!!!

This is a great local business.  I have tried several of their brews.  They are all pretty good.  I go there for the pizza.  The white east is great getting away from you standard pizzas.  We had our company Christmas party there and they were very accommodating.  Oh and they have a bar!

Absolute scam, do not purchase a coupon of any kind for this company, they are never available, never call back and finally after a long run around they said that they no longer honor the coupons.  Save your self the time and bother and avoid "We Do That" because they obviously don't.
Honestly just amazing food, great atmosphere, even better service and the owners are great! Recommend this place every time. I would recommend getting a curry.

Tired of restaurant servers acting like they're happy to see you? Love being blown off by the staff? Adore being treated like an annoyance by a bartender? 

You'll LOVE Parilla!

I can't think of a restaurant with worse service in Boise. We all go here for the convenience and the price, not for the food or the service. Some of the burrito flavor combinations are tasty (especially the Asian ones), but often the rice and/or the meat are overcooked and dry. The $2 tacos are a good deal...until you remember that you can get a far better taco and be treated with courtesy at a taco truck downtown. But you're hungry and you're tired from your ride and you live nearby, so, in your delerium, you decide it's worth the abuse to support this mediocre business.

This weekend I flagged down the bartender after being ignored for a few minutes and he said "I was having a conversation." I asked about the specials and he mumbled something about the house bloody mary being $6 and some other bloody being $3. Being a bit broke at the moment, I ordered two $3 bloodies and he pushed two glasses at me. They were filled with ice and some vodka in the bottom. "I'm sorry? Did I miss something?" I asked. He jerked a thumb around the corner, and I noticed a couple shelves with bloody mary mix, hot sauces and spices: a bloody mary bar! I save $3 by making my own, and I get the added benefit of not being treated like a mosquito. 

In case you doubt the surly non-service is not intentional, check out the rules they have posted in the bar. Apparently we customers have rules for our behavior, too.

Went here for my birthday this past weekend. We had a group of 16 and did the tasting menu at the $25 level. Lots of food and everything was delicious, I think we were all a bit delirious afterward. They packed up all of our leftovers so I have several days worth of chinese food in my fridge now. They were very attentive and made special accommodations because I have a shellfish allergy.

One thing to note that they didn't tell us when we were making reservations: they can only handle 2 cards for a check, so bring cash unless you want to run to 7-11

Gary (husband and part of our dynamic eating trio--mom was out and about elsewhere) and I turned up there (you never know where we'll go next!) recently on a weekday night. It was surprisingly busy, as in nearly-all-seats-were-taken kind of busy!

We went in cold, having no prior experience with Freddy's or their menu. We found the menu a bit confusing. What was the difference between a steakburger or a double burger, etc.? We needed some descriptions, but all we had to go on was a menu above our heads on the wall. The cashier was a friendly young lady who did her best to answer a bunch of questions. But we didn't want to hold up the line so we dove in and ordered a burger and a double steakburger combo.

The lines moved very quickly. We did manage to nab a table (yahoo!). Gary's double steakburger came with a huge basket full of skinny and delicious fries, plus a drink. I did the a la carte burger. Glad I did so, as there were plenty of fries for two of us! The burger tasted delicious, and I can guess that those burgers are the reason people return here. 

TIP: the burgers are skinny, so go for the double burger so you get a healthy mouthful with each bite!

We noticed the soda dispenser was well used, and that there was a strange pile of ice in the drainage area (like a mountain of ice). We must've come at a high usage time.

I would've loved to have tried the custard dessert, but given our luxurious, audacious quantity of fries, we opted out of any dessert for our own well being! Next time--and we will go again. It was fun and friendly, even though quite the busy place! By the time we left, the lines were to the door (but as I said earlier, moving fast).

Had an amazing time in New Orleans and this hotel was part of the reason. The rooms are clean and the garden is beautiful. We especially loved the service. We are looking forward to going back next year.

Special thanks to Ms. Julie for finding a phone charger for my husband; Mr. Marlon for making sure my gluten free toast was ready every morning for breakfast; and Mr. Larry Charles for all his help throughout or stay. They made out stay very special.

Today's lunch was a visit to Ted Peters. My wife had a wonderful fish spread sandwich along with an excellent German potato salad. I had a bowl of the Manhattan clam chowder and potato salad. Soup was a bit bland which I spiced up with hot sauce and lots of pepper. The outdoor location was noisy as usual complimented by bulldozer work next door at a construction site. Despite this the food was good as was the service.

Had some of the rolled ice cream, was absolutely delicious, very creamy and you get to pick 3 toppings! Cute little place, nice seating to enjoy what you ordered.  They have the boba drinks as well served in plastic light bulbs which is fun! Also when you go in they had sticky notes and a sharpie to be able to leave a not or your mark posted on the wall.

Looking for the best prices on wine and the best beer selection in Tampa?  Oh, here it is!  It took me way too long to find out about Total Wine after moving to Tampa.

Their wine selection is enormous and can be a bit overwhelming, but they have a fantastic staff.  They are always friendly and willing to help you find whatever you need.  Not only do they have a great variety of excellent wine, but I find myself searching for the cheaper bottles towards the bottom of the shelves and I can still find so many great choices.  

Now for my favorite part....the craft beer section.  Holy. Crap.  I could spend hours in this area of the store.  I love beer and often can't find my favorite craft brews at most stores.  At Total Wine, I can't think of one beer that I have looked for and couldn't find.   Awesome variety and their prices are stellar.  Far better than any grocery store in the area (ahem, Publix).  Sometimes, I peruse the beer section at Whole Foods for some things to try and then go to Total Wine to find them at least a dollar or two cheaper.

I don't drink liquor as much as I drink wine and beer, but their selection of liquor is no different than the rest of the store.  You can find anything you need and I've found the prices better here than any liquor store around here.

Total Wine is a one stop shop for all your alcoholic needs.  Trust me, you'll love it.

I have in many posts, described my love for what I like to call, "Missouri Mexican." Because of this, many told me about Mi Ranchito. I was super impressed. Great place in U-City and way better than the El Maguey off Delmar. Plus, if you are a fan of little cartoon Mexican mice, then you'll definitely dig the wall art. 

I would highly recommend Mi Ranchito. Great margaritas, okay queso, hella awesome prices. But if you are not into El Pasino or any other of the Los/EL bunch of restaurants, you'll find nothing to like at Mi Ranchito.

Wonderful brunch location...classy and clean. The chicken liver pate is my favorite.  The strawberry French toast was nice and I loved the cappuccino. There was a Brussel spout side that the chef sent to our table that was absolutely amazing.

As hotels go...the gaylord opryland is wonderful. The rooms were very clean and quiet. Air conditioning worked well. Only a few suggestions. As a gardener...labeling the plants would have been nice. Even though I knew most of the plants  there were a few I could not  idenyify. Also...breakfast was not easily found. If you didn't catch the quick changing sign in the lobby...you didn't think there was breakfast there. The water park will be an added improvement. It could also use things like mini golf, bocci, horseshoes, shuffleboard as there was not really much to do to keep kids busy except swim. I'm sure they want you to go into nashville..but I was disappointed with downtown.

My friends were celebrating a birthday brunch here. The wait was a bit long but we were so preoccupied by the baked goods that it didn't matter! I ordered coffee and macaroons to pass out, and by that time we had our table. Our server was amazing and all of the food was correct (that's huge to us). We are from Ohio, and next time we visit Nashville we will definitely be stopping by our favorite food stop

Brandon was fantastic! We came in with a large group and he was polite, friendly, and fun! We had several individuals with food allergies and he was extremely knowledgeable and accommodating! 

Will definitely be back again soon!

First off - after eatting here, I am ruined for all other places as far as service and freshness of seafood go.  Nothing will ever stack up to this place, and I'm sad becaue I live so far away.

First off - Paige is the nicest server/bartender you will ever meet.  We popped in for lunch on a monday, and then came back later that week, and she not only remembered us, but our entire friggin order, and my quirky drink.

Secondly - the food is amazing.  Oysters $6 for a dozen?  get out of town!  and the whole parking lot is filled with the shells from the oysters.

The crawfish boil is amazing and a pound of the little suckers is like less than $4.  We were crawfish virgins, and Paige showed us exactly how to rip that sucker apart, and suck the head, and pinch the tail.  I am now proficient at the art of crawfish eatting.

The turtle soup is incredible as well... super yum.

Oh, and the blackened alligator - wowie oh wowie oh wow.  I don't think I can say enough about this !!!!

if you aren't used to eatting shrimp cocktails down in the south, you need to go here, because they do it RIGHT - spicy sauce (the best home made horseradish in all of NOLA as well)  and plump shrimp!  super duper delightful. 

and let me not forget the hushpuppies.  YUM...

Everything here was A-friggin-mazing.  top notch, and is seriously better than any food you will ever have in the quarter - the only food in the whole state that may rival it (and it's not seafood) is the roast beef po-boy at parasols. 

ALSO -- (i never shut up -sorry)  They have a fish market where you can buy their proprietary blend of boil. I got a buge pack cheap to take home and make up seafood of my own.  With it, I got great knowledgable service with a smile.  (and a coconut pie and a pecan candy bar)

YUM.. this is a must stop!

Stroll back in time in this area. We've been to several historic sites, this one wasn't the greatest. The house was well maintained, but pretty much empty. There was three buildings on the back lot: The main house, the chicken coop, and the ice house. The guide gave a story of the family before the tour in front of the house, then let us loose for 30 minutes to explore. Then you walk to the barn with a museum with lots of info of the family. Free tour, free museum and just took under an hour to check everything out.  Was very interesting to learn the history. Checking this one off my historic site visits.

A nice little place next to their pizza shop. The Bronzino special was surprisingly tasty. I suspect this place is good for pizza and pasta with your wine. Casual and not noisy, and easy to get in and out if. Try the rice ball appetizer.

The stylist was great! She did a great job with my hair and made me feel comfortable and relaxed. However, the instructor that was guiding her should get a lesson or two about customer service. He was rude and rough to say the least.

The brunch food was dope sauce. Every bite of every thing was so full of flavor!!! I was in love. It's also BYOB. 

My boyfriend and I shared kanella platter, chicken kebab, Greek yogurt with honey, and baklava. They had the best hummus I've ever had!!

Basically, everything was 5 stars!!! .. maybe except the Greek yogurt since I couldn't distinguish from my trader joes Greek yogurt drizzled with honey- I probably won't get that next time.

I was full but it was a feel-good kind of fullness, as I felt good without feeling gross and greasy despite stuffing my face. 

It's a very cute restaurant and it almost made me feel like I was on some Greek island! The waiter could have been friendlier though...

Love this place; freshly made masa tortillas, salsas, and chips. Lately I order one of each taco special; today its blackened grouper and pork al pastor. I like their sangria! I am addicted to their carnitas, barbacoa,  and both pollo tacos. Fish tacos are average. Sangria is good and reasonably priced at $4.50. I like that u can order individual tacos. Dinner for two with one drink each was $25 w tip. I eat here at least twice a week for lunch. Support local St Pete small business owners! Only complaint; closed on Sunday's but I understand they need one day off!

So excited that Uncle Maddio's is in the area. There are options for the whole family including traditional, whole wheat, and gluten free crusts for small, medium, and large custom made pizzas and foldwiches, as well as salads.

Toppings are fresh and there are an abundance of toppings. They also have a chart of what is gluten free as well as vegan which is good for those that do not eaten some things.

The service is great, friendly, and helpful, as well as the owners.

Grand opening weekend is now and there is still time to try their pizza for free or $1. It's a great and I'm excited to come back!

P.s. Sign up for their emails for deals and a free birthday pizza!
big store, lots of stuff, a little disheveled ( im not sure if thats a word, but it fits). They did have a lot of stuff on clearance so there are probably deals to be had.

The best Saturday night I have had in a long time! Service was great, music on demand- danced our lives out. Hookah was great along with exceptional service. Belly dancer was really good and sort of set the mood for the night. Wish she stayed longer.
Great modern, hip and cool hotel. The staff was very attentive to any and all of our needs. Rooms are spacious. Comfortable beds and very clean. Highly recommended this hotel and any Aloft hotel.

Only tried the beer here on a Saturday evening with my boyfriend. Space was cozy and great for a chill spot. We tried the IPA and the Berlin Vice. Both of our beers tasted quite watery. Not a huge fan of the beer, but the food looked good so we may come back to try the food.

Ugh.....  What a waste of money. Had the crab sandwich. Very bland, seriously about 99% sure it comes out of a can......  You think, oh a shellfish and crab restaurant, they should have a good crab sandwich.....  Then you spend $13 store bought out of the can crap......  Coleslaw was the same story, straight up out of a can store bought crap.....  Feeling a bit ripped off at this point.....

Love this locals hangout for Saints games! You bring your meat and they provide the grill and all the fixings...including baked potatoes and salad! Happy Hour everyday 7-7 with $2 beers and $10 bottomless Mimosas can't be beat!

Really great experience with this dentist! He knows his stuff and will not make you do any unnecessary work. I had previously gone to a dentist who wanted me to have three fillings done immediately. Dr. Leggio looked at the X-rays and said they were precavities, which may not need to be filled for years, and that there was no point in filling them now. He is an honest man with a great bedside manner. He also gave me a great price for a night guard for grinding my teeth. Several dentists had told me it would be $450 for a bite plate, and Dr. Leggio's only cost $150 and works great! I highly highly recommend him!!

Affordable prices and good food! We have always had good service and food.  This time the kitchen messed something up, which can happen in every kitchen from time to time.  They made good on their error.  We will continue to go here weekly with our family.

Food was very good... tried the Cioppino, fried calamari and other fish, and the crab cakes, real good but a bit bland if you are looking for a full blown flavor experience. Not much room to sit around and a long looooong wait. Bring a jacket in December.
BYOB.  This is one of our favorite restaurants.  Prices are reasonable and the food is excellent.  Pasta dishes and thin crust pizzas.  Try it.  You won't be disappointed.
Not bad at all! We got the beef drunken noodle, pineapple fried rice with shrimp, and the golden triangle appetizer. Everything was pretty good.

This is the place to spend time with good friends. They have live music and it's not overly loud. We can actually carry on a conversation without having to yell to each other. The wine selection was good, the cheese plate was top notch. The pork shoulder was good, but it would be nice if it came with some bread or mashed potato. The special for the night was grilled sardines. They could do without it. Just wasn't any good.
The food was slow to come because it was a busy night. Overall, great place to be and staff was very friendly. Will definitely come back.
Food is just ok. Nothing special. If anything is labeled spicy do not expect it to ever have any kick to it at all. Seating is also very cramped.

I would love to say that our daughter had a chance to go to this school that we have heard such good things about, but these people don't have the common decency to return a phone call...several at that.  In a small community reputation is everything, and Silver Bear is getting one as a snobby and poorly ran establishment.  If they ever do call us back (which I doubt) we will tell them just that.

Great steak house! A musy go to place if you are in Indy. Either St. Elmos or Izzy & Harry's, basi ally the same restuarant. Get the shimp cocktail, very hot but need to do it just for the experience! Best Cocktail shrimp I've ever had! Not to mention, great steaks as well!

This studio is amazing !!! They take care of everything for you! Not only do they offer you cycling shoes and towels with your ride their facility also has extremely clean locker rooms and showers stocked with body+face wash, deodorant, shampoo, lotion even a hairdryer if needed!  I tried Stephens class and he was phenomenal and so energetic. His ride automatically put me in a good mood and I can't wait to go back again !

While I'm definitely a Chipotle guy, this Qdoba location does a great job and deserves some credit. It's not uncommon for me to meet up with the wife here for a quick workday lunch and this place is hopping. That being said, they do a great job getting everyone through the line quickly and somehow there's always enough seating - definitely a good thing during the lunch rush. And their queso is good enough that it almost makes me question my Chipotle loyalty. I also like that they've simplified their menu recently and made the ordering process a little more streamlined. Plus not charging extra for guacamole or queso is pretty great.

Keep this up, Qdoba, and I might have to come visit you more often.

I went to the store to inquire about some indoor blinds. I was ignored by Gloria in the Window Treatment section for a good ten minutes until another sales person that was helping another customer gestured over to Gloria that she was available to help me. Gloria was completely uninterested and clearly there only to collect a paycheck. We then proceeded to the checkout where we we're completely ignored by the person ringing us up. She didn't say hello. She didn't make eye contact. She continued a personal conversation with another employee and rung us up in silence. She didn't acknowledge us until my husband said thank you. She had  'mom' tattooed on her forearm. Lucky kid... The only reason this stores stay open is because of lack of options. Home Depot down the street treats their customers equally as poorly. Go go Jersey. At least they appreciate their customers.

Went to the Yelp event here several weeks ago... 

Real classy interior; seemed abit loud but intentional... 

Sampled a litney of different appys and enjoyed every last one of em..  would reccommend the shortrib sliders, asian nachos, duck triangles & buffalo bites (wit that bangin blue cheese)...  Thoroughly enjoyed everything from start to finish.

According to the waitstaff everything is made in house.

Overall did not peruse through the menu but from what I hear it is quite extensive; I guess thats to be expected from a cheesecake factory type place; I personally prefer a one page menu wit the items on there done right, but thats neither here nor there.

We are big fans of the Egg & I....We've been to two that were great in Birmingham, AL....This one however was our worst restaurant experience in Nashville. The server knew our iced coffees were bad.....After we were served the iced coffee the waiter immediately came up and asked if they were bad. Then we were told they were brewing a fresh batch. We never saw that fresh batch and were forgotten.

My eggs were cold and my wife's Crab Cake Benedict was cold all the way through. We didn't complain and were comped 50%. I still tipped well but think we should have been totally comped.

I will give this place one more try....But I had to write this review. In hopes that the service will improve.

One of the cleanest Mexican food restaurants I've been to in Tucson (and I've been to almost all of them) not to mention attentive, quick service! Authentic Mexican seafood at a reasonable price. 

To drink: a Michalada (Mexican beer with spicy tomato) which was perfectly spiced and delicious on a hot Tucson day.

Started with the ceviche. Solid amount of fish/shrimp in it (most places it's 75% tomatoes). A BUNCH of hot sauces at the table (a must). Only problem is I almost got too full!

Had the fish Veracruzana and my wife had the fish Culichi and both were absolutely fantastic! No "fishey" flavor to the fish, and mine had an amazing amount fish in it. 

To finish, had a churro and flan. Solid flan, no complaints at all.

Would recommend to anyone!
This primos is probably the worst I have ever been to. Primos in general has great quality and delicious foods, this primo just flat out sucks. Their sandwiches were disappointing to say the least.

Lord, why did I get the thai glazed ribs here! Now, I fiend for them constantly. Sadly, my residence in New Jersey prevents me from getting them as much as I want to. Anyway, this is the place to go for a sizable, delicious meal. More pricey than a lot of other options around town but not anything crazy. Also, it's quite worth it. The grits side here is also amazing.

Nice staff, quality staff, and good food.  We enjoyed a Sunday lunch for a good value a family.
NOTE:  Does not correspond to other locations.... 

CAUTION ADVISED with Court Street location:  Used to be good, what happened?  Horrible insulting customers service.  As we arrived we saw a young arrogant, rude young hostess treat a group of tourists badly and we should have walked away after seeing her behavior.  Then she started with my family, harshly told us we would have to wait 30 minutes, even though there were servers standing around with tons of open and clean tables. 

We were waiting patiently when my 8yr. old needed to use the restroom.  My wife started to take her to the bathroom and the hostess yelled at my wife about not being allowed to go into the restaurant without her approval.  Worse yet she said multiple nasty, vulgar words in Spanish that she thought a gringo family wouldn't understand.  I immediately escorted my family back to our vehicle and we left.

NOTE:  While waiting, we also overheard another couple while leaving the restaurant complaining about the service and food, wondering about what had happened to the place.

My girlfriend and I stopped in here last night, expecting the normal Reginelli's awesomeness. The food was fine, but this location has greatly changed since the last time I've been. I normally go to the State St Reginelli's, but since moving further downtown this location is more convenient to me.
We should have left the moment we went to go sit near the window and there was a SWARM of flies near the table. Blech. We decided to sit in a booth, which was still dirty from the last customers, but we didn't have much of a choice since most of the tables were either dirty, still had plates on them, or were occupied.
Another thing I noticed was that this location was very dark. Maybe I hadn't noticed it before because I had only come during the day? I don't know. At this point, my GF and I had already sat down and ordered our drinks so we decided to stay, but we felt very uncomfortable.
The combination of the darkness, dirtiness, and flies everywhere made me scarf down my pizza just so we could get the hell out of there. Like I said, our food was fine, but next time I am craving Reginelli's I will make sure to go to the State St location even if they chronically mess up my take out orders, they always get it right when I dine in.
This place is fantastic!! The food is delicious. I rate customer service five stars. Monday's they have burger specials.

I came here for a industry/networking event but have to say I was very impressed with their coffee.     After an experience in a 'gourmet' coffee shop you start to realize that Starbucks is the McDonalds of coffee - you're going to get the same tasting stuff and the same experience no matter where you go.

The store has a nice vibe and while the location is slightly off the beaten path for many it works well.    The inside of the store is clean and bright with plenty of seating (there is also a large lounge area).    They offer several different options for milk (Regular milk, soy milk and almond milk) as well as every flavored syrup you could ask for including stuff I'd never heard before.  I ended up having a vanilla-orange soy latte that tasted absolutely fantastic.

They do the foam art which is pretty cool too, it's less dramatic if you're having soy milk but nice never the less.  All the staff was courteous and friendly too.   I'll definitely be back to Swill to try more drinks!

We went there for a birthday breakfast. We had a ham omelet and their french toast, along with a mocha and coffee.
Everything here was amazing. The french toast was fresh and different than any french toast we had ever had before. The waitress explained that they soak it in a citrus liqueur overnight. It's delicious!
The second time we went there for breakfast the waitress remembered us and made recommendations. She was very friendly and seemed to know the menu very well, so she was very helpful. 
I very highly recommend this place, everything we have had there was amazing, and service is excellent!

This small parlor has charisma.  The make the ice cream fresh as you order.  Yes, I mean from scratch.  I've never had that experience before.  It was worth the time to watch them make our orders.  It is pricey, but after seeing the skill and time taken, it's worth it.
Definitely my favorite Gelato shop in town. The dark chocolate is rich, tiramisu is creamy, and the almond and peach have nice twists on the flavor.

Biscuits is what you make it, and you can't expect to have a typical brunch at a place like this. Yes, at least 4 different waiters will be serving you, yes, it will be crowded, yes, it will be loud, yes everything in the place is mismatched and thrown together but that is all part of the beauty of Biscuits. The food isn't going to blow your mind but I guarantee you will not leave hungry. It's large portions of everything. The biscuits and gravy are good and I really like the breakfast tacos. I have never had a bad experience here. Biscuits provides it's customers with large portion breakfast or Mexican dishes with no fuss or frills. Let's just say you won't want to Instagram a pic of your plate you will just want to eat your food and have a lazy day.
Had a good time at Harry and Izzys. Our server was very nice and friendly. The restaurant is beautiful and cant wait to come back

No stars at ALL! Poor customer service in the SERVICE DEPARTMENT. I called and the advisor hung up after I asked him to hold for a sec. I called back, got the receptionist again to have her connect to an advisor, she came back on the phone and asked how she could help me, then sounded like someone picked up the phone and ended the call. What?

The seafood (oysters, clams, etc.) was fresh but the presentation was so-so. 

I ordered the Perfect Storm raw bar plate. I mean this should be a typhoon of seafood, right? They brought out this big tray, the waiter's holding it high over his head like "wait until you see this when I put it down, you're going to freak", and then it's just all filled with ice and lame. Where's my pile of seafood? I want the bounty of the ocean, treat me like I'm Poisiden! Look, I'd pay more, just lay it on me!

Sadly, I turned to the peel and eat shrimp to fill up. It worked but I left with stinky seafood face and fingers. NOT recommended if you plan to cruise the bar scene later, if you know what I mean.

Fun drinks for the ladies, try the Orange Crush if you want to get wrecked. Waitress was in a good mood too. Nice area outside to sit. But they have competitors in the neighborhood with fresh seafood...
Brought in my iPad 3 with a broken screen. They fixed it in two hours at a very reasonable price. I bought a life proof case while I was there, I love it!  Very professional and efficient service.

This place is a beautiful lil hole in the wall . The food is beyond amazing . my boyfriend took me here on a date we had the bruschetta and Rockefeller oysters for appetizers. then we had the lobster ravioli and the filet mignon for the entrees . everything was seriously delicious like melt in your mouth good . literally food porn , I think this is my new favorite place .

sushi was really good. the fresh wasabi was really hot.

pretty expensive but tasty nonetheless.

My girlfriend and I split an xL cheese pizza with half sausage and half mushrooms.  The pizza crust came out wet and the cheese just slid off each piece when you tried to pick it up.  The crust was undercooked. The server asked how it was and both of us shook our heads and I said not great, but the server didn't say anything and just walked away. Normally I eat an entire half, but struggled to eat 3 of my 4 pieces.  They have all you can drink dispencer with Coke products.  The place was crowded, so maybe we just got a bad pie, but we won't try this place again.

I really hate this place . It is always terrible but I love so close I always give it a try after try. I ordered a burrito and tacos....  the most disappointing order yet. And it will be the last. It's like they didn't even care to make it . They threw everything in a bo
Ask for Tika! Fantastic server.

Gavin DJ-ed and emceed for our wedding and did a FANTASTIC job! We couldn't be happier. He and his team answered all of our questions and accommodated our special requests leading up to our wedding, and made our wedding flow perfectly on the actual day. Highly, highly recommend!
The best boba in town. I made my co workers addicted to BoBa and they said nothing compares. Could you please open a new one on the east side we would love it.

I recently found out that their "veggie" pho broth is actually beef-based and they never had a veggie broth. I guess I was being lied to every time I asked. Misleading costumers about the ingredients of their food is pretty shitty. But if that doesn't do it for you, my roommate also found a bug in her bag of sprouts. 

If you do decide to eat here, order your food to go and wash your veggies at home.

It's so wonderful to have a delicious to go to pho place  around Logan square, now that I don't need to go to Chinatown for a good bowl of pho. I only tried their steak pho and summer rolls and they're pretty delicious compared to other great pho restaurants in Chinatown and south Philly. Minh is one of the owners and he was so kind. there were issues with my order but They provided professional and Great service and accommodated my issues. I will deff be back for more! I can't forget to mention that your order will come out really quick!!!! :)

Food was good!  Music was good.  All in all a good experience.  It was a little strange that as we sat down we were told we had a 1.5 hr time limit but I meant I understand why.  I recommend the tempura shrimp and lamb sliders!

Best BBQ in area...located in a grocery store, they have a few tables,  everything is clean and staff was very accommodating, you'll love the rice and beans, very traditional Mexican. Highly recommend. ..

I wouldn't normally leave a review for a fast food restaurant, but my dissatisfaction with this Fishers Wendy's is so strong that I feel like I need to. I've had bad experiences recently going through the drive through here (rude staff, making me feel like I've inconvenienced them) but my most recent trip there trumped all of that. I took my little brother through the drive thru and as soon as I pulled up to the first window, the cashier was BLARING explicit-lyric rap music. I have never experienced something like this at any drive thru, let alone one in a nice community like Fishers. Anyway, she kept telling me that I ordered something that I did not, and I had to tell her several times that I just ordered the chicken nugget meal before she finally got it. I paid her and she gave me back the change. Once I pulled up to the window to get my food, a guy came up to the window and in a threatening way said "you owe her a dollar" like it was my fault that the cashier gave me incorrect change. I gave him the dollar and he took it and laughed and said "he tryna play you." I will not return to this location until something changes. Not only is the service horrid, but I would not feel safe bringing my family inside the restaurant in fear that I would be threatened if the cashier gave me the wrong change.

Medium in size this wawa is the one I opt for at lunch over the one on Belmont ave.  Slightly more parking spots and easier to get into and out of but just as crowded in the morning times and at lunch.
Holy hipster heaven! Super long wait. Average food. Average prices. Skip the wait and go somewhere else.

My son (age 9) and I went on the 5 in 1 tour, and he loved it!  Every subject was right up his alley and explained in a way for every one to understand and keep entertained... young and old. The tour was given by the Voodoo Bone Lady herself...so much fun!  I would highly recommend! Grab a nice beverage beforehand :)  

The group was kept small and intimate....15 people maybe.  There was a mixture of a small family, couple, bachelor party, and bachelorette party. 

The stories were extremely entertaining for everyone. They were not too light for people to lose interest, or heavy to where people would get offended by vulgarities.

There is a restroom break, and beverage break. 

My son and I ended up eating at the haunted restaurant afterwards. I would highly recommend!

I have two small kids and family that lives in Ventura, so the Padaro is a regular meeting place to let the kids play in the sandbox while we enjoy a good burger and local craft brew.  I've been once since the new ownership and it still seems just as good as before.  I wouldn't stray too far from burgers and salads, those are good but mixed reviews on some of the seafood.  Beer is good, and did I mention the kids entertain themselves in the sandbox so you can enjoy an adult conversation?

I am very disappointed by their service.  I ordered a Stromboli and chicken wings at 6:15pm for pick up.  I got there 6:50pm but my order wasn't ready.  I just stood there.  At 7:10pm, my order was finally ready.  No words for I waited quite while.  Stromboli was ok, but chicken wings were terrible.  They were cold and over cooked.  They tasted like there days old chicken wings.  Also, they didn't put celery sticks.  I would not recommend this place and of cause, I won't come back!

We frequent TJs and I do think they have very good food. I have had a few issues with asking for small changes in the menu items, but not a deal breaker. 

the steak is great, but pricey- so I usually stick with chicken, veal or pasta.
It's a nice play to stay if you can afford the not so pleasant staff. Somewhat rude and seem not too care.
Great place to watch the Ravens beat the Bengals. Excellent wings, good potato skins, super cool wait staff. Will def return, even if there are too many Steeler fans there.

It is ok. Nothing special. Drinks are good but they advertise 80's food. Well it was  2014 prices with 2014 quantity. I had the salmon, it was good but 23 dollars for a small piece of salmon with some three bean salad. My date had the 26 dollar lobster roll that had eight French fries. I was expecting 80's proportions at 2014 pricing. The only thing 80's was the movie on the tv. The food took forever the Caesar salad table side was expensive for what you received.
you ever had pizza that was meh? its a meh..good beer on tap though..they say nyc city style but its school lunch amateur..GARBAGARIANS

Loved it!! Service was great! Loved that the oysters were coated in corn flour instead of wheat flour... I'm allergic to wheat flour. Oysters were fried to perfection! My friend had the oyster po'boy & I had the fried shrimp & oysters. The meal was great! Atmosphere amazing!

Our dog Sadie just finished up all three levels of training with Debbi at PetSmart, and passed her CGC exam! Sadie is a VERY energetic dog, and we've BOTH learned so much from spending our Tuesday nights with Debbie over the last 10 months. She genuinely cares so much about the dogs in these classes, and will take the time to work with you on the things she knows your dog is capable of doing and learning. Sadie nearly jumps through the car window any time we drive into the parking lot for class, because she is so happy to see Debbi and her dog class friends. There truly aren't enough good things that I can say about Debbi - she is amazing and I feel like we hit the jackpot by finding her training classes. PetSmart is very lucky to have her!

French comment : nourriture bonne et rapport qualité / prix très satisfaisant ! En revanche, il semble que je n'ai pas eu de chance...mais l'attente a été interminable pour se faire servir ! Perte d'une étoile pour cela...

Did an absolutely excellent job on my 2015 Ram 3500. Did a job in 3 days that two other shops claimed would take a week. Flawless work. I've been around high end paint work for 35 years. These guys are the real deal.

I never in a 1000 years thought I would give a Royal Sonesta a super outstanding rating. Lets face it...they arent a five star hotel nor do they bill themselves that way. In fact we stayed at this particular hotel in December and it was just average, we stayed in the one in Houston in April and it was terrible. 
We decided to stay here again because of its great location and a nice deal we found online. Now dont get me wrong the hotel was never terrible just average. However this time a single staffer made all the difference in the World as she tried to "make us Royal Sonesta People" The young ladies name was Amari and I surly hope that the management sees this and gives this hard working Lady a well deserved pat on the back
Heres what happened...we went to New Orleans for Labor day and to celebrate my Bday. We flew in and actually gotten there pretty early and since we called ahead she already had our room ready, I know what your thinking its all based on availability etc but we stay in a lot of hotels and it surely takes some caring for the desk clerk to go to the extra effort to have it cleaned at 10:30am. 
Well Amari knew from our reservation that we were celebrating a Bday and we had booked a room on the Club Floor. She wished me a Happy Birthday and as we laughed and shared some jokes and pleasantries I teased her about about balloons and birthday cards. She explained that as Birthday guests we will get a free bottle of champaigne and she cracked a sneaky little smile and said she we see what she can do. (Now rememeber we already told her we just arent RS People and we usually prefer The Four Seasons or The W resorts)...according to her she wanted to change that LOL.
We received the champainge that evening as my actual Bday wasnt for 2 more days. We would walk past the front desk and she was always there to say hello and see how we were doing. On the third day of our stay we received a knock at the door to our Suite (Oh BTW she helped orchestrate an additional room upgade) anyway...the man at the door was carrying a half dozen delish petifores and a hand made birthday card! Are you kidding me?! I know this isnt part of the hotels normal hosting...this sweetheart bought them with her own money and handmade the card. I was blown away that she would do such a nice thing. Incredible...
Of course we went down and thanked her...I think she was a little embaressed with the fuss but she deserved it all. 
I dont expect treatment like this all the time but for a hotel employee to go to all that trouble just to make us "Royal Sonesta People" it was wonderful. I will tell you this...when we return to New Orleans from now on this IS our place.
I could go on and on about how pretty the hotel was or how great our suite was but all the props in this review go to Amari!
PS...Hey management, yall better hang on to this one, a competitor might try to do some recruiting!

Service was terrible. We sat at the bar and the bartenders were not friendly. However, the guy shucking oysters was very friendly and helped me decide what to order to eat (he recommended the Island Tuna and it was very good). Gary, a bartender, was absolutely rude and disrespectful. If it were not for Brandon (the guy shucking oysters), we would have left and eaten dinner elsewhere.

The service is not that good here :( we came from CA and wanted to try the food from New Orleans. the staff was impatient, rude and pushy. I would definitely not come back. Save your money and go elsewhere

My Bestie & I dined in after a movie at the Ritz - Bourse, we arrived slightly after 9, the restaurant was still in full swing. The lighting was prefect, cool beats played in the background. Our waiter kind of looked like Alan Thick.but Better. I ordered chicken+ waffles. BEST CHOICE EVER!! She ordered too; At first glance it seemed as if the fish taco had a hair on it,  however, it was from the stem of the cilantro.The waiter was so understanding and patient with us, his Manager came over and he was equally as cool. He reordered the tacos, took them off the bill and treated us to desert. She choose the chocolate cake and I died for another cocktail that contained drumbais or something with honey& whiskey...we Cannot Wait to Return!
#new chill spot

We were brought for lunch last Friday to this place before I left for my return flight to New York and the claim was they have excellent sushi. And while the place looks unassuming and at first glance, dark and not so impressive, when it came to the food, yes, they lived up to that expectation.

I tried Godzilla and it was incredibly good. If you love salmon with avocado roll with some level of spicy, topped with crab meat, then you will truly enjoy this.

I tried their Beef Teriyaki too and it was one of the best Teriyakis that I've had. The meat was tender and while deliciously savory, was not overwhelmingly so. I think they also mentioned somewhere that they do not have MSG in their food. 

If you're craving for some good Japanese in your area, this is your best bet. The place was pretty packed for lunch and that says something!

P.S
Get the fried ice cream for dessert! One of the good ones that I've had this lifetime!

I have been there quite a few times. Nice hardwood flooring, the girls restroom was beautiful with the Marble sink, clean as a whistle, when you enter the bar it's a bit narrow but opens up a bit at the end of the bar. The tables are great also. The owner is friendly, on the premises & makes great food!! Just had a Mushroom, Provolone Cheese Burger with fresh, homemade cut Fries & a banging side sauce tasted like spicy mustard, maybe Russian dressing & other spices, it was absolutely delicious to say the least. The staff is prompt & friendly. The regulars are also friendly too, which most regulars at bars are not receptive to "new" customers. Nice neighborhood bar & yes, there is some sort of adult theater a few doors down, but I've never seen anyone loitering outside or any kind of commotion going on. Lots of friendly walk by people too. Thumbs Up!

It's a diner. If you want escargot bourguignons or pate fois gras, you're in the wrong joint. You want fried eggs, breakfast meats, and a mountain of hashbrowns, all covered in sausage gravy served hot at an odd hour of the night, then this is the place.
Love it!  Great weightlifting gym in downtown STL.  I travel here from out of town and this is walking distance to the main hotels and the drop in fee is cheap!
Stopped by one day and ordered their Tampa cuban sandwich.  Best cuban I've ever had, and I've had my share.

Went for first time last night. Really enjoyed the food, it was different than other Mexican restaurants in town. Different type of menu but a nice change. The Tostadita was my favorite. Delicious! The fresh squeezed margarita was very good, I would have just expected a bigger glass for the price at $8 a glass. Too much ice, 4 sips and it was gone. The food prices were reasonable. Owners checked in with us and we had a wonderful, attentive waitress. Will be back!
This is a great Jewish deli. There is a diverse menu and huge portion. You'll always have enough for a second meal. We always make sure to stop when we're in the area.
The food was amazing, the staff was so friendly, and the coffee could not get any better!

A few years ago, I was gifted a watch from the SVW collection: a Bulova 1957 men's watch. This is absolutely my favorite watch, it was (and still is after 3 years) in perfect condition. I've followed this company closely over the past few years and have seen them consistently put out beautiful, quality timepieces. I've gotten to know the owners personally and have seen how much hard work and pure passion they have put into their company. They are the kindest people you will ever meet and want nothing but to share their special timepieces with the world. Their pieces are classy, each with history and unique characteristics. These are the kind of gifts that will last a lifetime and will be passed down. I only buy from this company and always will, I highly recommend them.
In typical Margaritaville fashion,  this place won't let you down. Food is delicious and our bartender,  Noelle is a sweetheart and was a great Nashville ambassador to tourists like us.
Adorable, sunny little place with the best pastries! The almond eclairs were especially great, and paired perfectly with the deliciously thick and unsweetened hot chocolate.

This is one of my family's favorite places for lunch.  You can't beat all that you can stuff in a bowl for about $10 per person.  The food is always fresh, restocked, and they keep it wiped down continuously.  There is a large choice of noodles, fresh veggies, pork, beef, chicken, and seafood combo, with about 10 different sauces to smother it all in.  Overall, there are probably 2 dozen different vegetable choices.  They also have a "menu" of sauces/oils to mix to achieve a certain flavor.  Add to that the rice, your choice of 3 different soups, and some awesome fry bread, and it's a very large meal.  We always take some home for later!  Other than that, the staff is extremely friendly always quick with a "hello" and "thanks for coming" and the place is immaculate.  Won't stop coming here anytime soon!

I got to say, this is the best I came acroos for pizza in this area. I can only say this is because I haven't  found any other place yet. I haven't recieved any greesy pizza yet but I find this pizza tasty. The sauce is just right but the crust could use a little bit more time in the oven. I need that crunch and it needs to have a thinner crust. 

I like the fact that it is a good family place and has a good sports bar. You can come here with friends or family to watch all the games. They also have gelato and subs, both are good too.

I'll keep coming here for my pizza until I find something better.

Our family loves Han Dynasty.  Always a great meal.  We highly recommend experimenting with the menu.  We've been going there for several years and always try at least one new dish every time we go.  The best way is to share the dishes and don;t just do the "Americanize" menu.  Our favorites are green beans with minced pork, spicy cold cucumbers, dry paper chicken, 3 cup chicken, and anything hot pot.  It's no wonder Han has expanded to NY and beyond.

Barrio Brewing has very good beer, but less than exciting eats.  The Southwest 'eggrolls' were similar to fat flautas and I had to chase down a waitress to ask for a set of silverware.  Meh.  Happy Hour on a Thursday was crowded and noisy, which is probably good for business, but not so good for conversation or relaxation.  I'll be back in winter when I can enjoy the patio and bring my dog.  Who knows.... that might rate 4 stars.  We'll see...

When I first visited Indianapolis to apartment hunt before I moved here, I stumbled across this coffee shop. This place was so charming I immediately decided to live in Broad Ripple, knowing nothing else about the area. Turns out, living near chic coffee shops is probably always a good idea.

The furniture that looks like it came from your living room mixed and the local art for sale on the wall is charming. The baristas are incredibly friendly. Prices for frilly drinks are lower than more corporate coffee shops (Hubbard and Cravens, Starbucks, ect).

Coffee is self-serve, just drop your cash into a slot and pour yourself a cup. Personally, this is a huge bonus for me. It builds a lot of rapport between me and a business if the owners don't assume I'll rob them of 2$ worth of coffee if they're only stupid enough to give me the chance.

Overall, Monon is one of many fantastic coffee shops in Indy. The lower prices for lattes (around 3.50 for a 16 ounce) make it better than most for frilly drinks and the self-serve coffees are excellent. It's probably worth noting that Monon doesn't really do flavored coffees, or at least, not at the self serve. If you're into that, you'll probably want to head somewhere else.

I LOVE STEAK. thank you prime rib for reminding what a good steak tastes like, because you didn't serve it. 
a friend thought it would be nice to dine on a dime. we did the 3 course for $35. well, even after reserving our table, the server informed us "next time" please specify we are here for the $35 deal. why? are we getting a low budget cut of meat?? hmmm.
the old, out of date decor is a bit tacky. but, there clientele were mostly 50 years +, so i guess it fits.  i mean if your are going for a classy, elegant look, please dust your 9 foot vases with plastic flowers engorging them. and, while you're at it make your medium rare steak medium rare.

Too anxious to wait for the 20 week Ultrasound to tell the gender of my baby, I went online and found Womb Service who is able to provide the sex at just 15 weeks. 

The Studio is easy to get to, and looks like someone's house from the outside. Inside you're welcomed into a small waiting room before you enter the private Ultrasound room. The entire studio is modern and comfortable with plenty of seating for you and whoever you choose to bring along. 

The experience itself was amazing. We worked with Jana who explained the process before starting the Ultrasound. Once she started, she kindly explained everything we were seeing on the screen and printed plenty of pictures for us to take home! 

I highly recommend Womb Service to anyone wanting to get a better look at their baby.

My husband's cross pendant broke off from the necklace. We're in town for the weekend and wanted to get it fixed. He called ahead to see if there was a chance to get the pendant repaired. Luckily they were able to squeeze in the repair.  Everyone here is really polite and make you feel like your family. Lupita, thank you so much for having my rings cleaned. My rings look beautiful and my husband's necklace also looks great and he's happy to be wearing it again. Thank you!

New great restaurant, I was surprised by the lack of people there. They have an extensive menu showcasing food from all over the world. Not to mention it was all clean eating and seemed to be mostly organic. My only reservation was the lack of beers on tap. I believe there were only 6 which, for an international restaurant, seems to be a bit dull. Either way, I hope they stay open. It's worth checking out.

I'm surprised there are not more reviews on here about this salon ! I got a cut and color today from Stephanie and am extremely pleased with my entire experience! This organic salon outdid the several high end salons in Philadelphia that I have gone to and the organic color turned out beautiful despite what I have heard from others. Stephanie is not only an amazing colorist but cut and styled my hair perfectly. I highly recommend Sycamore over any salon I've ever been to!

Firstly, I want to say that the staff deserve the full five stars. The lady working at the front was extremely accommodating and on top of taking care of my little group. The chef put extra whipped cream on the girl's shakes & they loved them! 5/5

The place itself is adorable and well-lit, and fun. The art is local and the quirky personalization are special enjoyable. 5/5. 

Unfortunately the reason for 3/5 is the food, which is ultimately an important part of going out to lunch. The coffee was sadly lukewarm and would have tasted wonderful with a simple fix. I ordered a small kale salad and the vegetarian soup of the day, I found the soup rather odd-tasting and didn't end up finishing it due to strange texture and taste-combinations. The kale salad was okay but nothing you couldn't get at Bread Co. My sister ordered a ham & cheese panini and really liked it and the shakes were enjoyed by all despite the other frustrating dishes. Definitely consider what you order if coming here and keep with classics, the more "creative" options may leave you conflicted. 

Like I said, hate to give a 3-star review, the atmosphere and staff were definitely on point.
The foods really good and reasonably priced but the tables for two are so close together it's uncomfortable also it's byob

It is such a quaint little place that I felt like I should be wearing white gloves and a Sunday hat. We had the pot of tea and there are plenty of selections, we had the earl grey and lavendar tea. The earl grey waa wonderful and lavendar tea was okay. It smelled more than tasted like lavendar. but it was good for a cold day. I had the vegetable quiche with a spring salad and homemade biscuits with homemade jam. If you are in Clearwater, you should atop by. There is also a marketplace to buy sweets and wait until they have your table.

Made a reservation for my family of 15 people that were in for thanksgiving. Called the day of to make an adjustment to the reservation, and they said everything was ok. Showed up to the restaurant and they claimed that they do not take reservations, only call ahead seating. They did not try to accommodate us in any way for their screw up. My family and I took our business to landmark across the street who was happy to help us.

The single worst experience! Ordered a product with expensive next day shipping. Received email of confirmation of order but product never arrived. Emailed company 3 times inquiring got no reply. Finally reached someone on phone (not the number listed, was rerouted to some other number) and was told product no longer in stock! Never received an email from company and have a kid leaving for camp with no time to find product elsewhere. Very unprofessional company would advise all to seek out another way to get your cosmetics!

We booked a suite and king room here for a family trip.  The rooms are nice.  The food at the tavern was good.  The service was not what we paid for.  When we arrived I had to find and start loading the luggage cart with our bags to get help.  When we reserved the rooms we made clear we would be using the pull out in our suite for our 2yr old and there was no bedding for the pull out in the room.  The reservations agent asked us for the age and sex of our child to have a gift for him on check in- there was none.  My wife requested a microwave, it came long after the second time she requested it.  Not very relaxing when you come back to your room and have no bedding.  Even worse when you call at 1015pm for bedding and you get it at 1115pm.  Cool location.  Nice building and rooms.  Service....ehhh.

I called and spoke with Daniel and he was professional and provided a quote over the phone. When I arrived I was greeted by John who was from my hometown The Bronx. He was professional and gave me a discount I was satisfied with. They are great here, from work to personality which is difficult to find here or at least I have not found it until coming here. I waited a while but due to the staff's company and humor the time went by fast and the car was ready to go. I would definitely recommend them for service. All the front desk staff are helpful and have great personalities. Jose worked on the car and did a great job!! Completely satisfied....

Akira has a great selection of fish, which I always appreciate.  The last couple times I ordered the eel roll, crazy roll, striped bass, yellow tail, and spicy scallop.  Some of my favorite sushi is at Akira, though I do prefer the one in Voorhees (they have a splash roll that is pretty awesome, and wasn't on the menu in Collingswood last time I was there).

My paramour always gets the udon, she swears by it, but she slightly prefers the udon in Voorhees, but I think it is mostly the giant flat bowl she doesn't like.

Came out to install service, said they had to run a line and would be back tmrw, never came. Calls, no response, "someone will call you in 30 minutes- a supervisor" don't believe that for a second. ARE THERE ANY OTHER OPTIONS FOR THIS AREA?! Please someone tell me

SO delicious and definitely worth it! the workers and customers were all super friendly and helpful! I got the crispy hipcity ranch sandwich, sweet potato fries and a iced green tea. everything was SO good! I will for sure be back to try some different things! also, if you're in the mood for a smoothie the groothie is AMAZING!!!

This was our place to stay during our Santa Barbara, Solvang vacation with our out-of-country visitors. Not a bad place to stay. We got this place cause it offered two bedrooms for the four of us. The rooms were good and basic. We liked the microwave and duel sinks included. The location was good too, close to many restaurants on State St., as well as minutes from the shopping centers, downtown, and freeways. Staff was courteous, and the room attendants left our rooms spotless. (remember to leave a tip)

My only issue was that they didn't have at the time(or ran out of) ice-bucket plastic bags. Isn't it sanitary to use these plastic bags? Or is it just me? Other than that, good overall. Be sure to get their chocolate croissants from their continental breakfast. Yum.

Decided to go out of the usual loop of restaurants in center city, olde city, south philly, norther liberties and hit up the Prohibition Taproom with some friends. It was definitely worth the 10 minute walk from the train station. The burger and fries were better than the average and the beer selection was outstanding. Good place to enjoy conversation over a small meal or drinks.

I'll come out and say it: having sushi in a land-locked state scares me.  Its hard to get something really fresh when its 8 hours to the nearest ocean.  And having been spoiled enough to work with, and dine with, dear Japanese friends, I can be picky.  But let's just call this place what it is: a good place for some decent sushi, located close to the 440 interchange where you can grab a meal on the way home.  They do takeout, FYI, which is very nice when you're in a rush.

There are some fun rolls on the menu, like their baked samarai roll (with red snapper) and their famous Shreveport orgasm roll (tempura shrimp, spicy tuna).  They do great bento boxes (my favorite would be the bulgogi).  The nigiri (traditional Japanese-style sushi with a piece of fish on top of rice) isn't my favorite in all honestly.  The have a great house salad with a delicious dressing and I love their simple yet soothing miso soup.

The service here is always warm and welcoming and like I said, you can't go wrong with takeout.  It's so nice to grab food on the way home after a long day.  I recommend this place for a quick yet relaxing mid-week meal or as a way to surprise your sweetie on the way home from work.
