We ended up at Xochitl almost by accident. It was a very pleasant surprise. Good food, great menu, great service. It might a little on the pricey side, but not too expansive. 
If you are into tequila and/or margarita they have an amazing selection.

As others have said, these guys are great!  We had a complicated move in going mid way across country in one truck - all of our worldly possessions in one vehicle, kind of scary.  In Philadelphia, we lived in a small neighborhood, so 16' truck was all we were getting up the street and what we comfortable with driving over the PA mtns.  They packed that thing to the absolute maximum, no wasted space and well weighted for a big drive.

My husband is an artist, and we collect.  We did the packing and wrapping ourselves, but guys (particularly the one sent specifically to direct how the truck was packed - Auriel (?) - were especially careful.  We don't have a ton of furniture, but a few prized possesions particularly for me an antique dresser with a delicate mirror with a winged frame.

Everything made it! Get these guys if you have an across town move, need to load a truck of just need to rearrange your house.  They were all really nice too.

I love this Target and do a lot of my grocery shopping here!  It's just so much more relaxing somehow than the one off of 202 in Delaware.  That one just always seems like a madhouse to me!  This one is definitely my "Go-To Target."

I work in Mid-City and visit this Rouses on the regular - at least once, usually twice, sometimes three times a week. It's kind of the unofficial cafeteria for my office. So when they started ripping shelves out and moving frozen foods cabinets around and hiding my staple groceries in arbitrary corners ("renovating," they call it), I was vexed. I'm ravenous, bleary-eyed and confused when I stagger into Rouses on a GOOD day, so the obstacles the renovation process presented were borderline insurmountable.

Today, though, there is hope. First: There's now a map in the front that tells you where to find your food. Second: I admitted to God, myself and a kindly  Rouses employee that I am powerless to understand the rhyme and reason behind its reorganizing.

"I'm overwhelmed," I told her.

"Just take it all in, girl," she advised.

She was very soothing. I feel better about these changes now. We're through the looking glass here, people.

Do not buy the groupon for Cindy Graham... It states 'all over color' but she claims that just means a touch up and then wants to charge $30 more for all over color.... I've never paid $90 for a cut and color... Complete rip off!!!
We stopped in with friends for beers and food. While we were seated right away, no server ever showed up, so we left. Hello Rock Bottom!

The service was awful. The restaurant was empty and me and my friend didn't even get our drinks until a little before our food arrived which was almost an hour!

My coffee cup had lipstick on it and I had to holler at my waitress  before she ran off! That wasn't the only issue. I can go on forever. I am also still trying to figure out if crepes are served cold. I didn't even ask them because I knew I'd get a lie. 

Please go to another ihop. It's not worth it here.

Their food truck is awesome. Huge portions, reasonably priced and the food is delicious. Their fried chicken loaded waffle fries are in point, I add bacon to them. Friendly people, just all around good food. I wish they would come to my job more often!
The space is very cool! I ordered the loaded fries with short rib and it was delicious! The short rib just melted in your mouth!

I only popped in for a cappuccino but while I was waiting had some time to look at the menu. I really appreciate when a menu can cater to people with different diets. Cosi had something for everyone! The amount of vegan and gluten free options made me very excited! Most places don't have many gluten free soups, soup is something I miss. Cosi had a couple!

They have plenty to eat for those who have no limitations as well. It would be a great place to stop and have a quick bite to eat with friends or just on a lunch break. I always looked over Cosi but in the future will definitely be stopping in for something to eat. 

The staff was friendly and very attentive. I also noticed on one of their signs that they donate a portion of their profits to those in need. Overall, a great company! 

Oh and my cappuccino was delicious!

Ordered the doro alecha which had a great flavor but not spicy hot. One eats with the hands using the rolled bread, very tasty. 
I had a business lunch it made the experience very bonding.  Great atmosphere, it feels like we're not in south Tampa.

Ummmm...Did I miss something? The food is mediocre, the service is okay, the armed guard in the parking lot is nice given the neighborhood. You pay a lot for nothing inherently special. Should have gone to Ruth's Chris considering the price and service. The chef also needs to learn how to make a Marchand de vin, because what was served was basically store bought brown gravy mix with mushrooms added.

Let me start off by saying I am not a burger aficionado nor to I pretend to be by any means.  I received an email from Thrillist announcing FREE burgers on 500 Degrees' opening day....it's a couple of doors down from the dance studio...I need to eat before class so let me give it a whirl!

There was no line when I arrived.  I liked the setup of communal tables and for those of you afraid to share a meal with a stranger you can grab a stool at a counter facing a wall.  After already researching the spot before I stepped in the door I knew I wanted a Combo 5 (500 Burger Medium Well - Truffle Fries - Diet Coke).  The burger was smaller than I thought it would be but it was a perfect size for me.  The brioche was a bit dry and not really flavorful and I ended up taking the top part off (too much bread).  The patty was juicy with just the right amount of pink.  Alas, I couldn't taste any of the house sauce on the burger and it was quite bland.  

The Truffle Fries...well that's another story....it was an orgasmic delight to my tongue!  I've never tasted ANYTHING like this before!  I was literally licking my fingers!  Just the right amount of salt and the dipping sauces (mayo based) were good....but just interfered with the essence of truffle slathered on the fries.  Next time, I'd skip the dipping sauces (which were included in my order).

The other thing that impressed me (besides the fries) was the employee they had cleaning cleaning CLEANING!  That's all she did was wipe down the tables and she was QUICK - picking up dropped napkins (people can be SO rude) - checking the bathroom after each customer to give a quick wipe down etc.  She was phenomenal!  

I can see this joint being a hot spot for the Boozed Up At Two AM Need A Place To Grub Crowd.  The burgers will taste delummy after a night of drinking.  I would return for the fries and did recommend that everyone I know go just for the fries!
I LOVE this place. Best sushi in town! The staff is always extremely nice and attentive.

I don't give 5 stars often, but this was an EASY call. The absolute best hibachi meal I've ever had. Anyplace. Anywhere.

I ordered the chicken and filet combo to go because I just didn't want to make dinner. 

The salad and ginger dressing were fresh and flavorful, soup was also full of flavor without being too salty, and the chicken / filet & vegetables were perfectly cooked.

I'll be back & can't recommend this place enough!!

just ate here for the first time today.
my wife and I were cruzin around enjoying the day, decided, hey let's stop in here and try it out.  service was good, food, ehh  nothing to write home about,  jack in the box has better tacos. it wouldn't be my first choice if I  were close to something else, but it would do in a pinch. ohh, and don't use the restrooms, I wouldn't let a homeless person near these restrooms. you could throw garbage on the floor and it wouldn't make a difference.  no seriously.  I'm not joking.  so in short food OK if in your in a hurry and don't have time or another choice,  service  mediocre,  and facilities well gross is an understatement.
We were greeted by the hostess before we even entered the restaurant. The service was amazing and the food was great. We all loved it there. The coffee and atmosphere was to die for.

GREAT food! I was in town for a convention earlier this month. Breakfast and brunch were excellent. The only negative was that on each of the days I ate there the servers shorted me on my change. Just based on meals though, this place was a find.

I've always drive pass a lot of restaurants in my area but never got the chance to actually try them. I decided it was time to give this place a try after seeing signs posted on the window that they serve Dim Sum daily. I'm more a Dim Sum person who goes to chinatown a lot during the weekends and sometimes during the weekdays every now and then.

I like the idea that they give you a piece of paper that had printed choices to choose from to order your dim sum. Sometimes eating in chinatown can be a pain as some of the stuff you want gets all taken up because the dim sum ladies goes around but doesn't make it to your table quick enough before everything is gone. On the downside about this is that people who have not eaten Dim Sum before cannot see what their eating before choosing. So at this place you have to kind of know what you want in order to place the order.

The service here was pretty good. The lady definitely welcomes those who doesn't understand Chinese as they can also help you out to choose what to eat if you have questions. I think of the two ladies there can some what speak English.

Keep in mind that the dim sum choices here are very limited as they do not have everything like chinatown does but they do have the popular choices like shrimp dumpling, pork dumpling, beef tripe, pan fried turnip cake (Vietnamese call it bot chien), and chicken feet. There's a few more on the menu as well but those are what I know off the top of my head at the moment.

Would I recommend this place to anyone? Of course and I would definitely come back here and dine as their prices are definitely reasonable. I like the fact that I can find parking relatively quicker than chinatown.

It was Friday night and we were feeling adventurous! Adventurous enough to try Indian but not enough to go ALL the way to our usual hangouts in DTSP. Enter: Deccan Spice in Feather Sound. 

First things first, I heard this place used to be a nightclub, but they did such a good job re-facing it, you'd never know. I was a little shocked to see white tablecloths and such a "fancy" feeling setting considering this is a really affordable lunch or dinner (and takeout) option. But, I appreciate the effort and slightly strange branding of everything (I'm talking from the napkins to the glasses). But you know what? Go ahead and rep yourself! 

Our group hardly ever eats Indian, so this was a gamble for sure, but we played our cards right! They've got EVERY possible Indian dish you could want. After taking nearly half an hour to decide what we wanted, we went for some basics like Tikka Masala and Chicken Korma (de-lish!) but tried some new things as well. Our takeaway? Next time, more spice please. They were probably too nervous to really take it to a medium, so we all felt like our food was more of a mild. I think they are very mindful of their customers, which is nice. 

The staff and manager were incredibly helpful, especially considering my bf's dairy and nut allergies. We didn't realize it, but Indian food has A LOT of dairy and nuts! (who knew?) They did ultimately cook him up a special order of chicken curry that he really liked. 

The consensus: We WILL come back to try the lunch buffet so we can sample everything and educate ourselves on the different varieties and flavors of Indian food. 

Tip for you: They seem to have a big carryout/takeout business and the joint didn't really start getting busy until around 9pm. 

Tip for the biz: Yes, we loved guessing the piano versions of top 40 songs (super jazzy) but we really preferred it when some Indian music came on! Play more of that, please.
I never was into Korean soft tofu much until I frequented this place. Inexpensive, simple 4 or 5 main  selections, levels of spiciness. Simply perfect.

Let me start with a warning. If you are squeamish about dirty, rundown and outdated restaurants please get over it. You can thank me later. 
I accidentally stumbled upon this place and nearly walked out. But it was filled with Korean customers! So glad I stayed. 
I will only delve into the uncleanliness and rundown conditions briefly and because it cost them a Yelp star.  The tile floor was sticky, the ceiling tiles dusty and dirty, the restroom gross and the decor unchanged probably since the early 80s. 
Ok, with that out of the way, let's talk about the remaining 4 stars.  My waitress was Korean and extremely helpful. Being a total Korean couture amateur I needed help. She guided me through replacing a house salad with a "BBQ dressing" salad.  It came out with six small dishes of unexpected sides. Kimchi, sprouts, radishes, eggplant and two others I forget. All were amazingly fresh and uniquely tasty.  Then came an unexpected Miso Soup which was also great.  When the large cast iron bowl arrived with my Bolgogi I was gleeful about this potpourri of tastes and healthy food.  The Bolgogi came with rice and noodles and an egg on top.  Absolutely and utterly delicious.  It continued to cook while I ate it due to the high heat of the cast. To my ending surprise was crispy white rice at the bottom of the bowl. 
So are you reading this while eating here? If so, you are so welcome!

I love this place! It would be easy to just drive right past it and not see it or think it was a dive but that would be your loss. Finally Mexican food in New Orleans that can rival the Mexican food found in California and the south west. The food is always amazing and there is always plenty of it and it's quick I never have to wait more than maybe 15 minutes for my food. They even have vegetarian options which is great for when I bring my friends. It's for sure the best Mexican in the city and the best thing in the East.

The best and only real army surplus store in Reno. They have all the camping, gun, and knife accessories that you could need. They also have a wide selection of camo bdu's and military boots. There is a fenced in space out back of the shop that has a bunch of random stuff with a junkyard atmosphere.Their prices are average for a surplus store but like everything else you could probably find it cheaper online. If you are looking for a typical army navy store with that telltale old musty smell that all good surplus stores have, then you have come to the right place.

~BMO
I just call it "shittle". They were asking for it. I like their spicy fruity drink.

I tried souvlaki platter 
souvlaki was great and vegetables and mashed potatos  and side menu were really good
delivered or take out, both were great

*Amendment to my review:  The owner of the Padaro Beach Grill contacted me regarding my review. He was VERY polite and basically offered to rectify our negative dining experience. I am very impressed with his level of professionalism and customer service. I give the restaurant FIVE stars in this area and hope my next experience will be better and my overall rating will change also! My current rating is just for our one experience and the food we received that time. 

Well, my husband and I were hoping for great things at the new Padaro Beach Grill. Frankly, it was the same old Padaro; over-priced and mediocre food! By the time you order a burger and add everything on it, which is $.75 extra for EACH side, plus order your fries, which are also separate, you've spent over $11.00! The food is ok, but my fish and chips were quite greasy and not worth the price! The one plus, they cut down the hedge so there is an ocean view now. Think I'll skip it and go into SB for a great burger or fish and chips with a view of the ocean at a better price!

Although the food was pretty good, I thought the wait staff was horrible.  Our drink order was all wrong and the meal that my husband and son ordered came with a salad and fruit, but the waitress never asked them about it.  They had to recheck the menu to make sure that they had read it correctly and then had to search down our waitress to ask about it

I love this place, my girl Brandy get me right every week. She is a colorist. No color is impossible, you want, she can do it... you can also get a perdi and manicure along with a massage. Real nice environment. No drama, I love it here :-)
Their bunch is ridiculously good! Original recipes with loads of flavor. Services was great! Heard the owner is from Columbus, please expand to ohio!

Brianna, Kelley Joan-na and all of the girls at the desk were awesome!! Great customer service and Brianna not only handled the front desk but she made food items in the Bistro, she is surely multi-talented! The room was quiet had a small porch for fresh air... I like the fact that they have a full bar in the hotel-lobby sitting areas up to date  with flat-screens and if you want anything to drink.cool! I will be back....JD
Nice spot for a quiet beer and a smoke. Regulars are cool. Bartenders are good. There's a pool table upstairs. Cash only.

This is another time I wish Yelp had the 1/2 star option. If so, Marrakesh would be 3.5 stars.  

I have seen this place quite a few times off of 5th and South but this was my first visit. We were a quasi, unofficial bachelor party for my wife's nephew and probably the strangest and most unlikely grouping for a "wolf pack" ever, but that is another story. The inside is pretty cool and with the tiles, pillows, decor it seemed almost as if we had walked into someone's house in Morocco. The staff was super friendly and very polite and explained Marrakesh has been open for 30 years. Middle Eastern music and Moroccan pop songs played softy in the back ground.

The food on the whole was  good. As others has explained the menu is more or less prix fixed and the choices are limited. The staff gives you some modification options but not much. The only down point food wise was our beef kebab was tough and over cooked. Everything else, especially for a bulk serving style was very good. To check out Marrakesh's menu on their webpage http://www.marrakesheastcoast.com/menu.pdf

Marrakesh has a belly dancer on Friday and Saturday nights and that was interesting. One of our group was Egyptian and he said she was quite outstanding. I wouldn't know good belly dancing from bad, so I can't really confirm. The dancing was tasteful and not raunchy.

One other thing of note is that with some Mid Eastern and North African cuisines, silver ware is in absentia. Guests are encouraged to eat with their hands as the custom in Morocco. All adding to a unique and sometimes a slightly messy experience.

The pricing was pretty reasonable, we were a little under $50.00  per person with 2-3  beers each and gratuity included. Marrakesh does have a small beer and limited drink menu. Marrakesh was doing a brisk business with groups like ours, well no group was quite like ours, but with large parties anyway. Marrakesh is cash only.

To end the night, we were served fruits, baklava and mint tea. It was really a cool place and we all had a good time. I am not in a hurry to return to Marrakesh but for a unique or special occasion it is pretty cool.

Had a breakfast burrito this morning.  Hubby had over easy eggs, turkey sausage, home fries and toast.  The food was very good and the restaurant is cute but the service was lacking alot.  The waitress we had was not very friendly nor was she very attentive.  She seemed to be annoyed that it took us a few minutes longer to decide what we wanted and after she delivered our food she disappeared until it was time to give us the check.  Would have been nice if she'd checked on us at least once.  I needed hot sauce and more water but didn't get either because she was no where to be found.  Bot sure about going back.

Great service! Being a visitor to Philadelphia, I feared my ignorance of meats and cheeses would be a bother, but the man at the counter was patient and kind. His knowingness gave me confident in him. So, I asked him to use his discretion, and I am confident with his selection.

This place was rockstar! I wished I lived near here and could go all the time. I didn't event come for bowling. I was looking for a good place to get a drink and food and thankfully I walked into this place. It is very chic and cool. The bar staff was amazing and even made fun drinks that weren't even off the menu for me. I wished I could remember their name to give them a shout out! The wings were also amazing!

Visited Reno the weekend of Beer Crawl which starts and ends at The Waterfall. Great atmosphere with a good selection of drinks. Employees have great personalities and make it easy to get comfortable. Big lounge in the back to either get a private corner section or sit in the middle and meet new people. I'd definately go back to this spot on the next trip.
First timers! Loved it! We'll be back! Hibachi was great for my non sushi 11 year old! Sushi for my husband and I was almost comparable to our fav Ybor spot. Very impressed with this place.

I booked this hotel last minute through Priceline at a great rate. My wife and I arrived very late on a night in early May - after 1am - due to a long drive from Tennessee on our way home. When checking in, the lobby is amazing. Shiny, new, modern. Good feelings happening. The guy running the front desk, I think his name tag said he was the front desk leader/supervisor to that effect told us he "upgraded" us to a suite. 

Our suite was located in the 2nd tower, the tower the lobby is not located in. As we were dragging our luggage clear across town to get to the other tower, we noticed the change in decor. Gone was the shiny modern look and in came an average, somewhat dated looking atmosphere. When we got to our room, we could see that it was technically a suite, however, this tower was apparantly not part of the "$17 million renovation" the hotel boasts on its website. This room was tired. Old worn-out 1980's furniture, CRT televisions - heck, even the mini-fridge had fake wood paneling on the front. Now you know you haven't seen that since 1987!

Now I will concede that the room was spacious and clean, which says a lot when you are going for the cheap. There was a living room, which included a sofa, some chairs, a desk, and a bar area with bar sink and the mini-fridge. The bed was in a separate bedroom and was comfortable. I was a bit worried the bed was as old as everything else, but it seemed the mattress had to have been replaced at some point. The room was cold so we had to turn on the heat in the bedroom, which smelled for awhile. Maybe it hadn't been used recently.

Perhaps they reserve these rooms for people who Priceline a 3.5 star hotel at the last minute for $60 a night. But this really feels like two different hotels - one 3.5 stars and one 2.5 stars. If you find yourself booked in this hotel, whether by choice or by chance, do yourself a favor and turn down the "upgrade" and specifically ask for a remodeled non-upgraded room. Hopefully you'll be luckier than we were.

Parking is free in a garage next door, but is is no where near the front desk for checking in and out. Wi-fi in the room is not free, but there are nice computers you can use in the lobby for free.

Might have given 3-4 stars if we had a renovated room, but had to deduct for the outdated everything and that they charge for wi-fi.

It's American Thai...not that's a bad thing. In a city full of rich, heavy, delicious food some veggies and a little basil is a welcome respite. The venue is much larger than it appears from the street, but I'd stick to the front room. It's a bit cooler and roomier. 

Again, not bad...there is better Thai out there, not sure if it's to be found in NOLA.
Good food, but a little rough on service. I didn't get drinks we ordered before dinner, and we pointed that out by the time we were finished eating. This was New Years Eve, will try again...

I've now gotten 2 tattoos done by Santana at Stigma Ink, and I couldn't be happier with his work. He did one smaller piece that was primarily linework, and the other larger one was a black and grey piece with a small flag in color.
 I've also gone with two friends to watch them get theirs done, one black and grey by Telly and the other (for his first tattoo) got a black and grey piece by Eddie. Each of the artists there are very easy to work with, taking your tattoo ideas as a jumping off point and producing top-notch work when all is said and done. They're all laidback too, making it easy to talk to them while you pass the time.
Whenever anyone I know is looking to get tattoos in the Bay area, Stigma Ink is always my first suggestion.
Food is AMAZING!! Everything I've had so far has been so good! Only down side is that the service is bad.

Since my wife and I moved to St. Louis from California two years ago we have been looking for a good pizza place in St. Louis. We had Pie, Deweys, Peel, Imo's etc. Pie is above average but not outstanding, Deweys is plain to me and nothing special. Peel is not bad. Imos'...well for my 4 year daughters birthday it works (without provel though). the good pie is your brew pub pizzeria with high quality wood fired pies, good salads and craft beers. Its a different style than all the other places. The menu is simple which I like.The ingredients are high quality and the atmosphere with the brick walls and tin ceilings is cozy. However I would put less, sauce, cheese and olive oil on the pies so that the crust in the middle stays crisp. That being said, I dont think there is any other place in St. Louis that does the Neapolitan type pies. I definitely recommend this place. Just remember its a special style of pizza. Its not domino's.
An absolutely BEAUTIFUL nature park ! A great place to escape the city sounds, you can't hear anything but nature ! A beautiful place for meditation as well .

What a pleasant surprise! I try to bring in treats every now and then for work an since it was a rainy day today, it was perfect timing. When I walked in I was greeted by the ladies behind the counter, they made me feel like I was at home. I wanted to get a lot of bagels so they took the time and went thru all of my options and different menu choices that would cover all basis for a large group. 

They had an array of homemade cream cheese, I tried the chive and it is officially my new favorite. The assortment of bagels and sandwiches I purchased were fair priced and got rave reviews from any and all that tried them. I even got a call asking where they were located so a friend could go themselves. The only issue I had was the coffee, when I went to pour myself some a regular it was empty, then a columbian also empty I'm not sure which I settled for but once I did the milk and half and half were also both empty. I will make the trek to them again, and soon.

Very disappointed. Deceived when placing table and the staff is very blunt and short. Menu is not complicated although there is a surcharge if you don't finish your "all you can eat portion". Would not recommend on weekend night. Food was subpar steak very small and noodles very oily.

We love this place!

We went the night of an Eagles game.  It was full but not overcrowded, the crowd was fun but not too rowdy.  Mainly 20's and 30's.  The food (pizza, wings and some appetizers) and drinks were reasonably priced and everything was great. We were with some other couples and all of us said we would come back.  

I ordered takeout on a different night and once again the food was delicious.  Their specialty pizzas are really good.  So far we have tried the Greek pizza and meat lovers.  The wings were seasoned well and not dried out from overcooking.

The parking lot is a bit small.  I'm not sure if that's ever an issue.  But it looks like there is a close side street for parking if the lot fills up.  We will be back!
Best pizza I've had in a long time. 5  hands down. Great little spot with outdoor seating as well staff is very nice. The food is even better

A must do in Philadelphia! We went to Philadelphia on a day trip and looked for things to do. After the walk from Percy Street BBQ, we were exhausted and looked for something lazy and enjoyable. The lines at nearly everything was long as can be, so we decided to take a tour. 

I spotted the crazy Duck bus, similar to one that I took in Seattle, WA. It was the best idea ever. For $28, it was a great synopsis of the city and we were able to learn so much in such a short time. I loved the experience and will definitely take others to ride the ducks. Who doesn't like to say they rode a bus that could float in water?

A tip: buy your tickets early, they definitely sell out quickly on good weather days
Ray's is my favorite place to get subs in NJ. Super friendly service and great tasting subs!

Not too crowded on Father's Day Sunday 1pm, maybe because of the new menu (though still standard diner choices.)  The iced tea was watery, my gyro was OK but drippy, others had a decent (but drippy) Reuben, Big Breakfast pancakes and sunn-side up platter.  The only exciting food I saw was the home fries and the pancakes...But the price is right and Dad likes it here, so OK for his day.
Best Burger in Tampa hands down and this location is my favorite

Well, I wish I had known about this gem a while ago. There's so much in here, and I would recommend it just for browsing around for Dutch treats alone. I get Raw Dog Food (which iI actually feed my cats) from here, which is cheaper than buying the expensive vet diet I used to buy, and way healthier.

Can't remember the name of what I had but it had "pig" in the name. Purely delicious! It had a very tasty chipolte sauce in it, which added that extra punch. One thing I really liked, was how it was served. Cut in half and in cups! Very neat and didn't get messy.

BYOB and decent Italian food away from the city. The seafood was fresh and the appetizers and entrees came out accordingly and as expected for a great dining experience.  

If only the servers were taught how to properly open a wine bottle.   Popping the bottle is not the proper way to open a bottle.  Perhaps educate with a video our tutorial to cut costs and appease the patrons who bring their nice bottle of wine expecting it to be open by one who was at least trained with the bare minimal to open wine bottles at a byob.

This is the cocktail and burger spot I was hoping to find in Philadelphia. In every city I've lived in, I've found a local spot to get an unreal burger and a killer cocktail - in Boston it was JM Curley and in SF it was Absinthe and now, in Philly, it's Village Whiskey. 
The ambience is great, huge long bar, dark, small and intimate and I found myself trying to figure out what this is - is it a pub? is it hipster? is it old world? It's a lot of good all in one. 
The cocktails rocked and the bartender was even better. The Aviation was TOP. 
The classic burger medium rare was perfect - my ideal burger. Juicy, great meat flavor, soft delicious bun and gooey cheese (I added cheddar). Pickles. YUM. 
Add some Duck Fat Fries with cheese sauce and you're in food coma heaven...and highly motivated to sign up for a spin class the next morning...
One question - WHY isn't there a mac and cheese on the menu made with this cheese sauce?!

On my weekend trip to Nashville, I was in the Gulch area looking for a quick lunch.  I stumbled upon The Turnip Truck and it looked like a locally owned Whole Foods with a hot foods bar in addition to various grocery departments.

I didn't look too far into the grocery section, so this is a review of just the ready-made food products.  There was a decent selection of dishes (some Mexican, some Asian, some Italian, etc.) but most of them looked pretty ordinary and not super good.  I was in a time crunch but I went with a bento box and a small bowl of various steamed veggies.  The bento box was pretty decent and was a good value for just over $5.  The steamed veggies were overcooked and bland, wouldn't recommend getting them.  In addition to the food, I picked up an unfiltered ginger ale which was delicious!  The food wasn't bad but all things considered I think I could make them better and cheaper for myself at home.

The Loews is a renovated bank, and still boasts many of the original details of the building, including an old-timey bank vault and beautiful marble throughout. I love the Art Deco styling of the building.

I've stayed here as well as attended conference proceedings here. I liked my room very much when I stayed. It had a lovely view of the city, and was comfortable and quiet. My only complaint about my stay in the hotel would be that room service was particularly overpriced, even by hotel standards. 

As a conference venue, the Loews is A-OK. I did find some of the room layouts awkward for the presentations, but that may be due to the conference organizers as much as the hotel. And of course, it was overly air-conditioned, but this is typical of any conference setting. The only aspect of the conference that I would hold against Loews specifically is the lack of clear lobby signage; it took a while to find my conference, with two others (!) taking place simultaneously in the hotel.

I would recommend the Loews for your downtown Philadelphia stay, especially if you can finagle a deal on the rate.

Went with my cousins to this place and it was amazing!  We had a great time.  The bartender was friendly and nice as well as the Karaoke DJ.  We sang our butts off and had an amazing time.  They allow smoking in here, too!  The atmosphere is homey and. Blue collar.

Wow!   The best prime filet I have EVER eaten.  Perfectly charred and seasoned grill marks on the outside.  Did not have to add salt or pepper. So tender -- it was incredible!  Service was excellent.  Good pom frites and a nice wine selection.  Cozy feel with a fire place.  Can wear casual or dressy and be fine either way.

Not just another cafe.

First off, I've been here like a bazillion times, and that must say something for the place, huh?  Well of course I can crawl out of bed and walk there in a minute, but still.

It's across the street from the supermarket at 23rd and South Street, so yeah, there is little to no parking if you are driving there, especially on weekends.  

It's cozy inside, haha, yeah meaning its kinda small, but it works.  Counter seating in the front, some tables with bench seating in the middle, more counter seats in the rear, and then a patio with a few tables as well.  In warmer weather you can't beat the patio, but it fills up fast.

The menu is pretty good, something for most.  Things I get a lot are the creme brulee french toast, the dill scrambled eggs, and the egg, ham and brie sandwich (a gooey mess that's so worth it). Oh yeah almost forgot the smoked salmon BLT and the sweet potato fries, mmm.  

The staff is very friendly, even when this place is very busy.  This is key first thing in the morning when you just don't want to deal with shit!

Coffee, breakfast, brunch, whatever, this place fits right in!

My first time today. Lovely spot. I got turkey club which was excellent & way too big so I was happy to take it with me. Our waitress was sweet, very pleasant but sadly didn't get her name to give her a shout out.

My best friend & I went to Mother Hubbard's for a bite. I got 2 eggs, shredded potatoes & toast. Well potatoes had funny taste, used old grease, uck! Toast had old grease, put on grill, I'm sure. Bread wasn't even brown! I received bill, told our server(man) about potatoes & toast, he had a disgusted look said it's free because you dontlike it! I said I was telling you to make it better. Bill was about $12.00. I gave him $10.00. Will never go there again.

It's our favorite festival in the area.  Plenty of good ribs, other food and drinks.  There is even a place where the children can cool off in the water.  Because of the long food lines (and the streets cannot be widened...lol), it causes a very long bottle neck effect for several hundred feet.  Maybe the Nugget can figure out a way to alleviate this.  It can take many many minutes to get through the bottle neck crowd and we are so frustrated long before it opens up to easier walking. It is clear how frustrated the others are in this bottleneck. I suggest making the food line up in a "s" shape or spreading out the booths to other streets.

We had a special celebration in the back room for 12 people.  Janet exceeded our expectations.  She was attentive to everyone's needs, very kind and helpful.  We deferred to her for suggestions and was extremely pleased with the day.  The sandwiches came with sparkles, the drinks came with flower petals, and everyone came and left with smiles.  A beautiful day - many thanks to Janet and the Cake Bake staff.

Pizza was great and service was even polite......but the issue i had was with this coupon $10 for $20.....i purchased it and tried to use it and was only given $10 off my total bill.......FALSE Advertising....if youre only getting $10 off your bill why would you take the time to purchase this "DEAL"......I will return because the pizza and service was great but will NEVER buy a deal from them again....

I'm not much of a pizza fan until my sister, Karen said she got some free pizza coupons for volunteering somewhere and wants to use them.
We went to Famoso in the afternoon to have a late lunch. The restaurant was packed with people.
A very busy and nosy atmosphere. There were a lot of workers and they were all very friendly and helpful. We had many servers assist us and bring us waters  and whatever we requested. 
The kids got a cute cartoon cup to drink out of. 
Two thumbs up for a kids friendly place! 
I ordered the FIRE-ROASTED TOMATO BISQUE to start. It's there homemade soup. I found it to be really salty and not my style.
My sisters wanted the PROSCIUTTO WRAPPED MOZZARELLA BALLS. This appetizer was really tasty and leaving me wanting more!
We used all coupons and ordered 3 Marinara pizzas! I had like 2 pieces of pizza and then I was done! Too much bread. I felt like my stomach was going rise up because of all the yeast I consumed!
We finished off with 3 scoops of gelato ice cream. It was a good chose of flavors; blueberry lemon, salted caramel dark chocolate and the mango banana. It was so delisious! 
We had a blast at Famoso. The service was great, the food was good and overall we had a really fun time! 
Free food is always appealing to me!

Creative and consistently great craft beer.  They live their name; you'll see very few 'standard options', and that's a good thing in this case.  Get a flight and try all the weird stuff they've dreamed up and your palate will thank you.

Favorite yoga studio in Tucson! Front desk is always smiling and welcoming, studio is clean and the space is beautiful! Best to show up early as the classes can get pretty crowded. Always a good sweaty flow :)

I went in not expecting to but anything. And i told the guy (i forgot his name sorry) that I was thinking about upgrading my mod and tank and i told him that I was just looking. But he walked me through everything. I ended up buying some liquid there. But with his great customer service and family vibe, i will decently spend my money there.

I have used the Sultans twice for odd situations, and they are terrific!  The first was a pick-up for a Craigslist washing machine. Tom was so very patient and helpful with trying to make it economical.  We had to coordinate with the seller who was a little disorganized, but they found her and got the machine...which was a super heavy Miele!  Then they got it down a trinity stairs to the basement without a scratch or gouge in the walls, bravo!  

Last week I had a moving POD delivered to a nearby street...finally. Tom was super patient about the date being pushed back due to the snow, always agreeable  The fellas showed up at the exact time and all went well. So, for small moves or large, I would call them again! Thank you SOS!

good luck with your move!

We took the Ghosts/Haunts/Voodoo tour last Friday night, and it was fantastic! Our guide was so great, very knowledgeable and funny!  I loved the History behind the tours.  The pace was good and we were done right around 2 and a half hours even with a break half way.  I loved this tour and cant wait to come back, I will definitely go again!

Rooms were nice and clean. Furniture could use a little cleaning, but that's kind of expected in a smoking room. Breakfast was just breakfast. Enough to get you started and on your way.  No room service.......that was annoying since we stayed over the New Year weekend.  Staff was very friendly and helpful.  That's always a plus for me because the staff can make or break your stay.  They made my day. Overall, this hotel meets the Hilton standard and I would stay here again.

Great beer, good food, average service. This brew pub / restaurant is located in an industrial area, and has an industrial warehouse look. If you have never been here before, you will probably wonder if you are in the right neighborhood. The storefront features custom wrought iron work (made from twisted rebar), and there are two separate dining / drinking areas: the IPA lab and the main restaurant. We walked in to the main dining room, and the person at the bar told us to sit anywhere. Looking around the place, we discovered that there were no unoccupied tables, so we grabbed three open spots at the bar. There are several televisions behind the bar, each showing a different sports program, but the volume on each set is muted -- probably a good idea, since the bar can be a bit loud.

The server took our drink orders immediately and returned a couple minutes later with drinks and menus. She then gave us ample time to examine the menu... maybe a bit too much time, as we could not get her attention again for over 10 minutes. Once she decided to check in with us again, she took the food order and the food arrived about 10 minutes later. The food here consists of some of the standard bar fare (burgers, fries, wings) and also has some real treats: quesadillas, paninis, artichoke and spinach dip, and hot roast beef sandwiches. There is lots of variety in the burgers, but that's not the highlight of this place. It's about the beer.

The brewery has a great India Pale Ale (IPA) that is brewed in-house. It has a nice, bitter flavor from the hops and is very easy to drink. There is also a beer called NCAA, a full-flavored ale with an alcohol content around 10%. I tried some, and was favorably impressed. I'll be back!

I have heard of this place for a long time but never had a time to visit. Finally, I had a lunch there and I wonder why I didn't go! The service is very nice and the food was amazing. Please try mushroom soup! I am not sure about the truffle fries, but I am very very satisfied that I get a chance Silverspoon!

We've tried quite a few sushi places in the West and South County areas. All of the food we had was very good here--nice, complex flavors. All of their rolls were comparably priced to other places. If you want to fill up and not spend way too much, get quite a few of their hand rolls and veggie rolls ($4).

However, we were at the restaurant for 1:30 hours. We didn't get our food for well over an hour and ate it pretty quickly after being so hungry. There were four total couples in the restaurant and a couple of carry-out orders being worked on. It looked as though there was only one chef present and everyone's meals were coming out very slowly. After finishing, we were ignored. The waitress was all around us doing other things: cleaning tables, checking on other people, etc. It  was quite obvious that we were finished for quite some time. The manager came by early on and apologized for the long wait.

Before anyone dismisses this as me being hard to please, that's far from the truth. I always give people the benefit of the doubt and never complain about meals or ask to see managers (and I didn't do that this time either). I eat it even if it's bad, still tip appropriately for less than good service, and go on my way.

The whole point of this is: If the service was bad, I could possibly see around it and return. If the food was slow, same thing...but not both! If I'm looking for a variety of rolls and a decent place to eat them, there are other options out there.
Such a great place to meet friends for brunch! Amazing food and nice people. Coffee is outstanding
Had the elk burger with manchego. Great burger despite the organic ketchup. Little expensive for a smaller burger. Overall a great experience
Super nice girls and a brand new renovated shop next to the hair salon! SO much better than their old tiny shop with no room. A great place to go!! :)

Visiting the area and tried this place for early lunch. I got the Santa Fe omelet which was amazing. Fresh corn! Breakfast potatoes were meh. Husband got the southern burger. Hot and well cooked. Bun was nice a fresh. Pimento cheese was well done. Service was great! Overall would definitely come back here.

Wonderful staff where Tory and the owner Mo make you feel appreciated. The bar food is fresh and absolutely delicious, with the mushrooms being my favorite. The drinks are very reasonable which allows you to spend an evening there without spending a fortune. I'm definitely making this place a regular stop when in Nashville.

Service- painfully slow. 10 minutes for drinks. One water refill. 
Order accuracy- terrible. Ordered steak medium (not medium well) received well dine

I have been literally been coming to Kelly's for over 20 years. I've done a considerable amount of traveling in and out of the US and their creative menu of muffins, quiche and daily unique Eggs Benedict at Kelly's is my favorite. On a nice day sit on the covered back porch or enjoy their artsy interior.  

As for the staff and owners there are insufficient amount of stars for these special folks. Gus and Joey et al make this place feel like home. I rarely if ever miss a weekend without my Kelly's fix. I warn you once you visit once you'll become a regular.

I cannot say enough good things about our experience at Cannoli Queen. The food was phenomenal. I had pasta and my husband had a grinder - both were amazing! Along with the food quality, the service and friendliness of staff was perfect! We will definitely be returning! :)

Very nice restaurant we sat at the bar the bartenders were super nice and you can taste the wine before you buy a glass the wine selection is very nice the pizza is excellent try the motadella pizza. For our entray we had the skirt stake it was excellent but came out cold we told the bartender and she apologized gave us complimentary dessert which was excellent we will be back. Mon. Thru Fri during certain time they have half price pizza.

This place is down the street from my parents home. Every time I come visit i make them go here with me.  It is delicious authentic central mexican style cuisine.  If you are looking for Baja style or Chipotle style, you will be disappointed.  But, if you like shredded chicken, homemade red chile, fresh fried chips, and enchiladas then you will be as happy and satisfied as me.

Best breakfast on the beach! Croissants with veggies and Swiss, and sugar and muenster cheese were amazing. The cherry cheese plait ... yum! Great coffee. This will be the beach stop for breakfast from here on out!
The first thing i fell in love with when i moved to Indy.. Great people, great food and I love that OG DRUNKEN CHIX

A lazy Sunday morning... A craving for biscuits and all things gravy... This was the perfect place. It was our first visit but definitely won't be our last. A word to the wise, go early. It was packed by 10am with a line out the door. Overall, a great place!!

Not good. The actively disengaged staff made it a point to tell me how long each thing I ordered would take in an effort not to have to cook it. I settle on chicken tenders (only going to be three minutes on those), with blackened ranch dip. Simple enough. Three minutes becomes fifteen, and when I get them, they're rock hard undercooked, and I have some sauce called Sweet Heat instead of Blackened Ranch. Inedible.

Cold.  and I'm not talking about the iced coffee or the A/C, but the customer service.

Listen, listen, not alot gets under my skin.  When I first detected indifferent, almost hostile,  body language and mannerisms I was amused.  Girl,  I don't know what got your undies in a bunch, but maybe I stabbed you in a previous life.  Sweetie, I've thrown so much shade that I might as well live in it.  So, we can exchange business cards.  Also I was in a good mood from pokemon hunting.

As long as the coffee tastes good I thought. It was.  We had ordered eiskaffe and dirty thai ger.  I was so impressed that I was quickly formulating a stellar yelp review for what was about to be my favorite, I repeat, my **favorite** coffee bar in Tampa.  So so close, but then I sent my friend for another round.  Shortly thereafter he asks if we could move onto somewhere where it was, in his words, "more welcoming."

That's where I draw the line.  When my friends or the company I keep feel unwelcomed.  He's an innocent! Don't drag him into our dark world.

Take a cue from a more successful business model from Sips on gunn highway.  I will always choose grandma's love over your inexperienced broody millenials.  That's where you'll find me, pokemon or not.

TLDR:   My experience started with Mmmmmmmmmm, but ended with -isery.  Say it with me,  Mmmmisery.

I LOVE CFR!

After extensive online research, I was impressed by the number of reviews consistently highlighting the personalized, structured attention to each client and CFR's individualized approach to all levels of expertise and physical status - especially focusing on each person's specific needs while creating a streamlined workout that while a challenge (and worthy reward) to maintain and grow within, IS attainable by those with the drive to follow through and invest appropriate effort. Having experienced the failure of several mainstream workout options, including: CrossFit, "sheeple" gyms who thrive off of intimidation style motivation, plus a surplus of environments that failed to provide instruction that gave me a sense of ability to accomplish a goal, these were incredibly appealing attributes for a potential investment of both time and money. After an initial call regarding package and pricing structure, where I received  viable information with a welcoming vibe, and a personalized consultation where my goals were addressed, I was confident in furthering my relationship with a company who saw me not as another dollar sign (but as a long term client) who would take satisfaction not only out of my credit card, but out of pride in helping someone achieve their goals, due to their passion for helping people in a specific skill field.

I have been MORE than happy to continue investing my time here almost solely based on the fruition of the above reasons for joining in the first place. Having had such high expectations, I could have easily been let down once I had paid my fees and started my membership. Exactly the opposite has occurred. I am continually challenged in a way that both exceeds and respects my comfort levels and boundaries. My trainer has adjusted and acted in accordance to the challenges I experience physically and mentally. I have never felt pressured to exert more skill or power than I have available, while being healthily pushed to limits I did not know I possessed. This has resulted in workouts that prove satisfying and intimidating; yet challenging while channeling an inner energy to try harder. The flexibility and attentiveness of all staff members, especially the person focused on my success has strengthened and encouraged me to lengthen my journey and efforts to reach my goals. My relatives and loved ones can attest to my improved outlook and attitude about my physical appearance and abilities - as well as a more positive, relaxed approach and outlook to daily challenges. I can 100% contribute to my current feeling of success and drive to my trainer Mike, the staff, the gym atmosphere and the obvious effort placed in long-term success as opposed to short-term exhaustion and burnt out results.

This is not a "gym". The emphasis on safe, proper form for all exercises is something that has proved unique and appealing in an industry that generally promotes overnight, impossible results (even though my coordination continually embarrasses me!). They may not aim towards leaving you incapable of movement within three sessions, but they certainly instill a value of "quality over quantity" wins the race. Seeing myself and the fellow clientele continue to come back and without fail, further their success level is testimony to the structure and strategy of CFR. I am thankful to finally be achieving goals previously thought unattainable - especially now, newly engaged, I am even more thrilled with my decision to sign-on for additional sessions... going to have to rock that wedding dress somehow - and I know they'll help me get there!
A great little place for sushi! I stop by for lunch sometimes and they never disappoint. Real nice people and consistently good people.
I love this place everything is great good value. The pizza is very good very cheesy also try the chicken wings

Went here for the first time Monday night with my boyfriend. The pizza selection is amazing which I love. My boyfriend got a pizza that had BBQ sauce and pulled pork, he loved it! I got one that was just pepperoni but it was delicious. They even have different pizza doughs to choose from. But really made me happy, the toppings go all the way to the edge of the pizza! You can thank my dad for liking my pizza that way, no crust just pure toppings, perfect! The server was nice, a little awkward. And happy hour was nice. Would of been nicer if the server told us about the Monday night football special (I didn't see it until I walked passed it to go to the bathroom and we had already ordered) a outlaw pizza plus a pitcher for $19.99! We would of totally done that! So that was a flaw. But other than that we will definitely be back for their fine pies

Absolutely terrible. I've never heard of a company that doesn't allow you to pick up a 90-day supply at a pharmacy instead of having it delivered to your home. On top of it all, not one of their representatives could figure out how to request a prescription from the pharmacist, and online you only have the option of a mail-in form. What are we in, the stone age? Finally a supervisor was able to assist - now I just hope my medications arrive on time.
Good food.  Kids loved the aquarium. Service was very friendly and helpful.  Very cool environment.

overpriced bland food-nice atmosphere. it just needs rime to get it together
I gave it more time to get it together-the kitchen is still slow and confused. It wasn't busy and our order took a long time and when we were served, it was cold.
Nice people work but-

We started off with the Queso Fundido with Chorizo and was extremely good, I definitely recommend it as an appetizer. Then as entrees, the Cazuela de Maricos was delicious, and the Empanadas were awesome as well. The acompañientos all sound really good, we had the tostones and sweet plantains and were really good as well. To finish, the Churros were delightful, it is awesome when you can try food that you don't commonly find in restaurants around Indy.  The place is beautiful and the music was great!!!

Great speciality store. Also a great selection of board games and other card games. 

The staff is friendly and knowledgable.

Had a wonderful Saturday night dinner at Nathalie's.  The atmosphere is fairly formal, as this a Victorian era home with period décor.  Beautiful artwork and St. Louis memorabilia adorn the walls.  They have some nice event space as well.  Make sure to check out the fabulous bathrooms!  The manager will give you a tour if you ask!

The service was very good, from the coat check all the way up to the general manager and owner who both came table to table.  

As other reviewers mentioned, the concept is farm to table with most of the food sourced from the owner's farm.  The food was delightful-French onion soup was the best I have ever had, and steak salad was very good.  For our main course we had the pork special and the chicken dish.  Both were very good.  We also greatly enjoyed our cocktails-the sangria, a gin drink and bourbon w/thyme drink.  YUM!

Overall this is a fun restaurant to visit.  You really feel like you are at a fancy restaurant but with a laid back friendly vibe. Perfect for date night, get together with friends/family, even work events.  Great food, drinks and service.  Oh, and the bar was bustling with some good live music-but not too loud!  I am looking forward to trying the brunch!

Prohibition is probably the place I have frequented most in the city. I lived in that area for a year and Prohibition is like a golden treasure some leprechaun must have dropped on his way to other parts of the city. 

I mean, really, that is such a shady street. I know, I lived on it. Thank you Prohibition for being a haven in bumble-fu¢k Philadelphia. 

The Fried Green Beans are amazing. And the Grilled Cheese specials which change every week. Oh and the amazing burger specials. Did I leave out the macaroni?

They have a consistently changing draught list which is where I have found some of my favorite obscure beers.

I can't leave out the fact that the wait staff is one of the best I've encountered in the city. They are over-the-top friendly to the point where they get to know people's names. This is 2010; I barely know my aunt's name. Good job, Prohibition.
It's like an overpriced non-chain Hacienda, but constantly full of babes. I don't understand.

This is a beautiful building and an example of what a major-city station should look like (*ahem* Penn Station). Boarding is quite efficient: everyone lines up at the designated stairway in an orderly fashion and proceeds downstairs after showing their ticket to the agent. This station shows that it's possible to do a retro display board in a classy way (unlike Penn Station): it is a split-flap display with white on black text and is very readable.

It is conveniently located with connection to Center City via the MFL.

My friend and I had lunch here to celebrate the beginning of our school semester. We ordered the crispy cucumbers and a serving of dan dan mien each. Dan dan mien could probably serve two, but we were too greedy and wanted a bowl each. Noodles were neither too firm nor too mushy. There was a good mix of creamy from the peanut butter and the spicy. The cucumbers were cool and spicy, very refreshing when eaten with the dan dan mien. Decent service. The noodles were served within 5 minutes of ordering too, great for hungry people!

Christine is awesome. She is good at styling your hair the way you want quickly. My partner and I come to her every two weeks. She is really good at men's style, and always thins out my hair just right.

Went yesterday for my first wax. Love the atmosphere. Girl at reception was super nice and so was Amy Jo, the waxer. Very friendly and had a nice conversation.. Wax did not hurt one bit! Will def go back when I'm in Philly again! Also, since it was my first visit, my wax was 50% off! Awesome!!!!

Pro: the beer was actually excellent. So was the service.

Con: the atmosphere is not great for hanging out, and the food was pretty disappointing. Most of it was burnt. But if you're just coming in for a drink you're golden.

What a fabulous, cool place!!  Yelp reviews were spot on!  If you are in the mood for brunch type food, you have to try this place.  It has an eclectic vibe to decor and menu.  

I highly recommend the Thai Fighter cocktail...if you like the combo of sweet & a hint of spice.  The table next to us had the make it yourself mimosas and they looked good enough to try next time!  The grilled cheese looked fab, as did the Monte Christo but I opted for the pork belly breakfast sandwich.  It was beyond fantastic.  Their version of hash browns is small, chopped potatoes with onion and red peppers sautéed.  

They have a great outside patio, which is dog friendly!  There service is attentive and the wait staff was helpful in answering questions about the menu.  This will be a repeat place for food, for sure!!!

I bought a floral arrangement for a funeral.  I needed it in kind of a hurry.  They got it there early, it was very affordable and was the best looking one there.  Unlike most arrangements I have purchased from photos online, though never here, this one looked better in person than it did on the picture on the website.  The staff was friendly and polite and the flowers were wonderful.

I've ate here about four or five times since it's near my house and it's in the downtown Clayton area. The environment is very clean and creative. 

I always get the calzones and they are very good. Nothing too gourmet but its very homey. Service is very good and the prices are moderately priced.

i really wanted to like fairwheel bikes, primarily because they're extremely convenient--between where i park and where i work on campus. they carry brands i like and they look like the type of bike store i used to frequent when i lived in oregon.
i had one favorable experience where they fixed the seal on my silca pump and were friendly and expedient, but my other experiences have been pretty shoddy. my other experiences have been as if the mechanics and salesmen were "too cool for school." i was treated as if i didn't know anything and when i brought my wheels in to have the cassette swapped the guy backed my rear wheel out of the bracket so far it kept falling out. then he proceded to patronize me for several minutes.
i may go back if i need a tube or to look for a take-off saddle, but otherwise i won't be spending any siginificant money with them, much less let them service my sweet old steelie.

Very nice place to grab lunch at work.
Sandwiches are good and with vegetarian and vegan offerings.
One thing I miss is SYLVIA!!!! Where are you Sylvia???

I stopped by Wimpy's with my teenage son last Saturday because we had not been there before and the menu online looked interesting. The inside is neat and clean with a retro look but only has a few tables and counter seating. I ordered a volcano burger with Wam! fries and a black & white shake. The burger was OK but not spicy enough for my liking and was on the dry side - it could have used more hot sauce. The fries were very good and enough to easily feed two. My son ordered a double Chipotle Chili burger, onion rings and chocolate shake. He really enjoyed the burger (the bite I had was pretty good). Be forewarned that the chili on it makes it messy so grab lots of napkins. The onion rings were very good, too. Both shakes were thick and very tasty. They have specials that are not on the menu so check out the boards to see what they have. I might have ordered the sweet potato fries had I looked. My only gripe with Wimpy's is the price. It cost nearly $30 for us to eat. I don't know - maybe I'm out of touch with burger joints today... I will probably return to try different burgers but not very often at these prices. (4 stars reduced to 3 because of price)

The best place to get New England Seafood. Steamers and lobsters are awesome. I have been looking for new england steamers around tampa for months driving my boyfriend crazy. One of his friends told him to take me to The Lobster Haven. The outside of the building makes you think this place is just another florida fried seafood place. That isn't the case at all. When we walked in, the decor and style immediately took me back to growing up in New England to the lobster shack restaurants along cape cod that had the best food ever. We sat down at a table and I began to look at the menu. I was so excited they really have steamers flown in from Maine. I knew immediately what i was ordering.  Our server Holly was awesome.  She even questioned me you sure you only want one pound. Yes i insisted.  I had to be sure, because the kitchen was closing in 2 min. I should have listened to her because as soon as i had one bite of my food I want more and now i couldn't. But then we learned we could take some home.  I ordered 2 pounds to take home.  
The best place i have eaten at since coming to Tampa.

If you do needlepoint of any kind, this is the place to go!  This is a true needlepoint store!  They do sell yarn and such for other crafting like knitting and crochet, but needlepoint is where it is at!  This is a one of a kind type of place and such a specialty store is rare these days.  For the quality, prices are reasonable.  Other reviewers have stated that they are expensive, yes, they aren't cheap but the quality is worth every penny.  If you are serious or even semi-serious about your needlepoint, be prepared to spend quite a bit of time here.  I was there for an hour browsing the walls looking for the right pattern (I live in Chicago) and then it was another hour while they pulled the yarn out for my selections.  We talked needlepoint and yarn the whole time.  Staff is incredibly knowledgeable, kind, and full of good humor.  Also, if you run out of yarn and haven't finished your needlepoint, send them a bit of the yarn and they will match it and send you back enough to finish.  While I was there, a woman came in with a large Clementine and she needed more yarn.  They matched her right away and she was back on her way in no time and at no charge.  One of my favorite stores in the French Quarter and a must visit when I am in Nawlins!

We absolutely love eating here on a lazy weekend day!  The bacon is thick cut and cooked to perfection. Biscuits & gravy are made from scratch..coffees hot and the service is perfect!  Staff is friendly everytime

Was there for lunch today. Personal Pizza was good as well as the side salad. However service was subpar. Waiter took my order after a 10 minute wait. After serving my food he never came back to check on me. Had to ask manager for my check. Won't eat in restaurant again-always will take out from now.

I walked to Pal's from my house: one star

The fight between Drunk Guy and Over It Bartender: three stars! 

Bartender, to security: "get this guy outta here, he's had enough and driving me crazy."

Drunk Guy, to the bar: "You can't do this to me!!! You know what?!? As a regularly drinking person who drinks alcohol regularly, I have to say that you are the WORST bartender!!! Your beers are awful!! You are a disgrace to bars and people who drink at them. LIKE ME. I drink!!! And I hate you!!!"

We were only in town for four days to find a home.  We are about to make a cross country move.  I contacted principal property management on our last day in Tucson.  We called first thing in the morning as our flight departed at 5pm.  Cutting it close-I know!  

I saw their listing on craigslist for a stunning home in the Sierra Morado subdivision.  I found the price to be perfect!  And trust me I have been scouring craigslist, redirentals, yelp, many, many sites for months.  I was SOLD when I saw the front loading washer and dryers!  (I digress, I just really love the home).  But, seriously, Principal property management took amazing photos of the home, which helped sell me immediately.  Also, they use many sites to advertise the homes they manage, to ensure your home will be leased promptly.

Since I was cutting it close and fearful I might be flying home without a place to live I was so relieved when David called us promptly back to set an appointment that day.  I was also relieved because I was shocked at the lack of response from so many other leasing agents in town.  

David got us in at 11am.  He was educated on the home, very professional, even had a tablet to show us further information.  If there was something he was unsure of, he phoned the office to make sure he was giving us accurate information.  He knew we were in a time crunch so he was prepared and brought us both a paper application to fill out. 

Principal Property management has a great web page!  You can apply online, put in your maintenance request online, and view homes.  Very nice!

When he was showing us around the property he took pictures of any concerns we had, so he could fix any problems that we saw.

He was very patient with us, allowing us to look around for as long as we wanted.  And since we were pretty excited about our new place, we really wanted to look!  He also, encouraged us to look around the community as there are nice features like the community pool, parks, trails.....

He also is great at communicating!  We both have had numerous phone calls, emails, texts, from David keeping us informed.  Very reassuring.

If you are looking for a place or looking to rent your home, I would trust and highly recommend principal property management!

Great food! They have lots of options for everyone, even my friends that were picky eaters found something that they liked! I really like the Magic Carpet Ride and Meet me in St.Louie...I heard that their salads are fantastic as well. The whole place is a fun atmosphere but be careful around lunch because it can get crowded really quick. They also do delivery which is nice for lunch meetings!

First time I tried this place was when I found it on ubereats & I was very impressed. The food was delicious & very filling the presentation for take out was done nicely. The pricing is a little up there but for some good food I'd say it's worth it.
Great food! Lots of delicious options. Never disappointed here! Service is fairly quick and staff is very friendly and accommodating. Will continue to come back :)

I needed a refill on my acrylic nails. This was these worst refill I ever had! She painted on my cutical and did not use polish remover to clean it up. I am highly dissatisfied with my service. I will not be back.
Woodhouse provides a luxurious spa experience. If you're looking to be pampered this is the place!
A great calzone is defined by being delicious on first bite without overpowering you by the final bite. And this calzone was amazing!!!

Big all is awesome. The only problem is the women at the counter no matter who you get are so miserable and make it a horrible experience. If the food wasnt so good I would stop comming there. Onion rings are awesome but the fries are terrible. Pizza is good steaks are ok deli and pasta are also good. Would def recommend getting delivered so you don't get yelled at waiting for your order.

My mouth waters just thinking about this place. I have never had a meal from this restaurant that was not superb. The portions are hefty and well worth the price. They also have good steak/seafood specials every so often. Try the double porterhouse

So I just left Philadelphia (I was there for work)..   first of all..   I only write reviews for EXTREMELY shitty or EXTREMELY impressive places...   I am a meat eater..  so I obviously went on a "Find the best steak sandwich in Philly" mission...  In a three week span, I hit Pat's, Geno's, Ishkabibble on South, Steve Prince of Steaks...    and finally a friend convinced me to try this place, even though there was no meat...  
*FANTASTIC*. When I am in Philadelphia, this will be my new go to place...   Great pricing, impressive quality, and I'm sure the health differences are equally impressive compared to the grease saturated monsters I had tried before finding HipCityVeg. 
Please don't change!
:)

Cold Spring Tavern has stolen my heart. Not only is it picturesque, cozy, and serves delicious food and drink, but their vegetarian options are delicious! I had the vegetable ravioli and while I was not expecting much at all, this was not your typical throw-a-bone-to-the-vegetarians meal. The vegetables were perfectly cooked, the ravioli was great, and the sauce was delicious. Paired that with a great basic green salad, fresh bread, and a few nice glasses of wine, and I am one happy girl. Everyone at my table raved about the food and the ambiance. We all vowed to bring friends and family back whenever we're next in the area. This is the kind of place you talk about for days afterward. I can't wait to return!

This place is a must for any burger fanatic. The portions are not overwhelmingly large so that you slip into a meat comma immediately following dinner but appropriately filling so you can enjoy an appetizing salad, mouth watering burger, finger-licking side and heavenly ice cream, all with out completely hating yourself. And if Kaj (the bartender/server) recommends a beer or burger you should trust him, the man has a Phd in tasty.

A few suggestions for ya: Share everything. The more the merrier. The best burger by far is the Bison Au Poivre.  Beef is great, Bison is better. Don't try to change more than one item per burger. Drink a great local beer. Have dessert.

Ick. We paid $350 for 2 nights! Room 202 had 2 beds, a small fridge and microwave, flat screen TV, 1 window that overlooked trash on the rooftop, and a bathroom that the front desk lady was proud to say was "newly renovated." We heard every slam of the nearby elevator doors (and strangely, the doors DID slam) and could see the shadows of people passing by through the gap at the door bottom and sides. No safety latch on the door. The beds are too short if you're over 6'2" and the sheets are too short if you like to pull them up to your shoulders. No temperature control in the room. We had to call the front desk to adjust our temperature! Housekeeping workroom is right next door so lots of noise early morning. NO FREE BREAKFAST DESPITE WHAT THE WEBSITE SAID. The bathroom looked nice, but on closer inspection the tile work was done poorly. Front desk personnel was nice. But lots of disappointment here!

Love this store. My favorite thing is that I go there so often that Jon that works there knows my style and will put stuff aside for me. He's never wrong and I've bought everything he's picked out. He's amazing and it's like having a personal shopper! Definitely check it out if you have the opportunity!
Came here last weekend for my bday and the vibe was chill. Definitely recommend getting the IPA here! The food was solid too!

Bruno's has one of the friendliest staffs I've ever encountered. The gentleman who I took to be the owner spent extra time detailing everything about their menu and new menu and did so with a friendly demeanor that made us feel he actually was interested in telling us what he had to say. A complimentary plate of bruschetta was sent out before we got our pizza, and the other gentleman working that night was just as friendly and attentive as the owner. 

The pizza was good. Their crust is a little heavy, but it has a wheaty taste to it compared to most crusts, and I found that refreshing. The other ingredients were quite good as well and we really enjoyed the meal on the whole.

I love this place. The food is great and the service was just as amazing. We will call ahead to make sure Maddie is working just to sit in her section. Thanks for the high quality service and original food selections.

I received a voicemail from Lauren Smith with a specific extension.. Gosh, wrong person again.  Avoid this dealership!  Courtesy sure likes to give you the run around!!  Never seen or experienced anything like this place.  Go somewhere that's going to show you some respect and real courtesy!

What happened to accountability?  Seems to me that everyone plays general manager.  

Read the reviews and decide for yourselves.  The whole army can't be out of step.

In my opinion, there are plenty of other places to buy a car AVOID ThIs dealership and go somewhere you are treated with dignity.

Funny thing is...all the responses from the dealership with names and numbers could have been solved if they had called me.  They have all my information, don't be fooled by their attempt to save face publicly.   What a joke!
The food here is so refreshingly delicious!!! The orzo salad is the best and the chicken noodle soup is amazing!!! Can't wait to try everything else!

Been going here for over 4 years! It's honestly my second home!!! Love how spacious it is and Srac is constantly getting new equipment to keep us all motivated to workout! Everyone is so friendly as well!
Great selection. Great staff. The beer law changes are a godsend to this gem that is hidden under the Target monolith. Best mixed six pack I've ever made.

Ugh.  Very very disappointing.  I decided to have my parents come over for dinner tonight, it was going to be a special dinner as my dad was going away for a few months and he wanted Chinese as his last meal with us.  I decided to use Fortune as I had been there four years ago and I remembered it as pretty good.

Have things have changed!  I put my order in over the phone and picked it up in store.  I would say that out of the 34$ in food I ordered, NONE of it tasted good.  The order was also taken wrong and I got a dish different from the way I ordered it.  The worst dish I got was the boneless spare ribs.  Basically pieces of pork in a sauce, no ribs at all.

The food was just so bad, I am embarrassed I ordered it for my family.

The Pearl is a Pearl!  The food is amazing!  There are textures to each dish.  There aren't enough words to describe the dishes.  Go and try anything on the menu and you will be pleased.  The atmosphere is intimate but the wait staff make a point of trying to make each visit a pleasurable one.  I would not bring children because you will want to linger...for a long time!

Lively bar with a large beer selection. You can order large beer "bongs" of draft beer. The chicken parm hoagie is large and awesome. Yard bird/chicken sandwhich is a good pick. Ribs are also tasty. Not a fan of their oblong/hoagie burgers. I like my burgers circular thank you.

Looks good for the younger/happy hour crowd.

This is my favorite spot for my fueling needs the people are super friendly, polite and usually the lowest price for fuel. Its also Liberty gas!! Home of Edward Snowden!! Go get your tank of Liberty!! Go on now!

We were heading out of New Orleans and decided to stop and try this place. It was 4:15 on a Friday and this place was packed. We ordered Boiled Crawfish and Crabs. As we were waiting we saw all the other orders come out and they looked delicious. Our food was great. We plan on going back and ordering other things from the menu. Get there early because you might have to wait for a table. They also have a market and a lot of parking in the back of the restaurant.
Great spot!  Shrimp and Grits tasty and spicy.  Gumbo was delicious and bread pudding was very, very good.  I'd recommend it.

The front office woman was unpleasant and not friendly she didn't smile once and then I got treated for upper respiratory infection and only got a prescription for little coughing pills when I feel it is more sever than that. My lungs and throat are burning and been coughing up some nasty stuff and I don't feel that my illness was treated properly so I will not be coming back here or will I refer anyone there.
