Elevation has the added bonus of being organic grass-fed beef which is much better for you to eat, as well as grinding their meat on site which makes it much less likely to have e coli in it! The french fries are made with olive oil, the milkshakes just scoops of ice cream.  Elevation allows you to customize more than In&Out (unless you know the secret menu of course!) They have all kinds of toppings for your burgers and different milkshake flavors and toppings.

This has become too much of a staple - don't have time, but gotta eat place. But I feel a little better about myself for choosing organic!

This place is cute and the food is good. We haven't had a bad experience yet, and we live nearby so we've gone several times. It's pretty affordable, and I always like Byob! I'll agree that the bread is a little disappointing, but other than that I've been totally satisfied every time. In addition, the service has always been awesome. Sit outside if you can- the patio's great!

Like this review...quick service. Short stay!  Reasonable prices. Waiting room was clean. Their record keeping is thorough, which helps a lot.  Many services are provided besides oil change.  If you have a small car they will rotate the tires. Wipers etc.

They say it's hit or miss. So what, it is and that makes it exciting. I always really enjoy Penca. Give it a shot and decide for yourself.

Tacos are good. Nice deals for happy hour. Cocktails on point. Great service.

One of Philadelphia's many culinary traditions that has survived into the 21st century is Ippolito's Seafood Market.  Founded in 1919, it will soon celebrate a century of providing Philadelphians with fresh fish and seafood.  This South Philadelphia institution is a great place to shop.  The choice is wide and the prices totally fair.  That's why people keep coming back.  And you have the option of eating-in as well as taking-out.  Perhaps the biggest bargain in culinary Philadelphia is Ippolito's crispy catfish jawns with hot sauce. I bet you can't eat just one of them!

We went to a wine tasting event here to use our Living Social Deal.  I never knew New Jersey had such a lovely vineyard! The drive here from New Brunswick was scenic and beautiful, hard to believe we were still in NJ!  We were promptly seated for our wine tasting. We sampled some white and red wines that were grown and made on the vineyards. My favorite was the last one, a sparking sweet red wine. (I forgot the name, but I bought a bottle.) The owner Violetta was knowledgable and hospitable.  After the wine tasting, we took a little tour of the vineyard to see the wine vats and the shop. They have small concerts in a larger hall adjacent to the shop. And the vineyards are well maintained and green. We even got to take our wine glasses home!

This place was a PERFECT Sunday afternoon date. It would also make a great place for celebrating a special event, shower, or just any occasion.

This isn't Nappa Valley; it's New Jersey. And it's amazing.

I ordered a cake as part of a big surprise from out of state (Detroit, MI)  for my anniversary in New Orleans, and I must say the customer service was amazing. They really went the extra mile. Not to mention the cake was beautiful and tasty!! Thank you guys!!!
Awesome pizza and food. Some of best around O'Fallon. Buffalo chicken and double deck pepperoni are awesome! This is a frequent stop and a favorite for me.

Oh man I love the service I got at this location!! 

I was given a Pandora bracelet for Christmas, it broke the first day i had it on. I went to the west Edmonton mall location and was treated very poorly, so poorly that i thought i would never step foot back into another Pandora store. My family spends a lot of money at a Pandora store down in Calgary as that is where i am from. long story short I was able to talk to the manager at the store in Calgary who recommended the Kingsway location.

Kristine is the manager at Kingsway, she is such a joy to deal with. she switched out my bracelet within moments of talking to me. I was so happy I ended up buying a charm to remember the moment by
Pure Design has been my trusted florist for the past 4 years. They have beautiful arrangements and always deliver on time!

First things first. Are you looking for amazing Thai flavors and perfectly cooked dishes? This is the place. I've been here twice, the second time with a large group of 9 people (more on that in a bit). You definitely need to eat here if you are a fan of Thai food. If you aren't a fan of regular Thai restaurants, try it anyway.

So how's the food? I feel that Lanna Thai is much more focused on flavor than other Thai restaurants in town. Their dishes taste much more complex while being simply prepared and not overwhelming you with spice or too many vegetables. The curry is what you would expect (delicious), but dishes like the Ginger Salmon really stand out. Perfectly cooked fish, delicate flavors, fresh (and I mean FRESH) grated ginger, and sauce that doesn't overwhelm the fish.

Now on to the service and environment. This is an old converted house, nicely redone but on the small side. For our party of 9, seating was not an issue (we did call ahead) but overwhelming the lone chef with too many orders was a concern. There were about 6 other guests already there when we arrived. Service was good, but keep in mind this is a family run restaurant. There is one host/waiter/busser and one chef. It took a while to get drinks out and orders placed. That being said, we were never left waiting for more than a few minutes, and food came out at a reasonable pace. We were advised to order multiples of a few dishes (family style) instead of individual dishes. This worked well, and we got one dish every 10 minutes or so. 

The prices were very reasonable, especially for the quality. With drinks, appetizers, and dinner we spent just over $20/person. We will definitely be back, and this is the sort of place we will take friends from out of town when they say they want Thai.
Terrible literally here right now and there are 0 lanes open with like 30 people in line
Great hidden tavern grill. Wonderful old place with early 1800 history. Original chili was yummy!

Was amazing all the way to the last bite.
Be careful when you go is the lines can be very long.
Ted Drews is now a favorite for everyone in my family and we were so happy to discover it

My absolute favorite breakfast place in Indy! The quality of food and service is outstanding and the location is conveniently right downtown Broad Ripple. Food Network's Diners Drive Ins and Dives has eaten here and starred their favorites on the menu!! My suggestion would be to order the lemon curd cakes with the berry sauce. If you don't... then make sure someone you're with does so you can steal a taste. They're amazing.

I dined here on a late Saturday night with five others. Upon arrival, we were almost immediately seated. The service was okay but definitely nothing over the top in any way. 

The food was however was great. Some of us at the table went with appetizers while some of us went with complete meals. I for one had the fried calamari and it was extremely crisp and flavorful. I topped it off with some tarter sauce and it was yummy! Some other guest at the table had the Salmon dip, wings and fries, Caesar salad, and the Churrasco Steak with the yucca fries. 

Every single person said their meal was great and they thoroughly enjoyed it.

I would definitely be willing to give this place another try because of the food and atmosphere. Even on a late night, they didn't seem to rush us out or anything and the food was still cooked to order.

We were visiting from Tampa and had the most wonderful time at the grill! The fried green tomatoes were out of this world!   I can honestly say that the ribs were the best I have ever had !

The Manager Kenneth Stallworth was very welcoming and professional.   He has a well trai ned staff that really impressed us.  It is a casual restaurant with an upper scale vibe.  Our server Vicky was always attentive even when it got busy.  A great dining experience.   Highly recommend.
This place is pretty good. A little on the expensive side but everything tastes really fresh.
This is definitely my favorite sushi place in town.  They have a good selection and fair prices.  Some of my favorites are the vegas roll and the fire dragon roll.

I have used Dough catering and would highly recommend them.  Their food is amazing, presentation beautiful and staff professional. 
This is gourmet catering at its best. Not just another boring deli catering company.

Great place..happy hour 5-7 pm .. 
Hummus delicious... French onion soup"the best"! Very friendly environment

Lots of different burgers and sandwiches to choose from, a few vegetarian options. Mac n cheese was super bland:( my husband had the Napoleon: wish we knew it was a fork & knife  monstrosity, as the server called it. Good comfortable atmosphere, would recommend.

I hardly ever feel moved to write reviews on Yelp, yet I absolutely advise against purchasing a car here. In fact, I regret having purchased my car from the people at Pacifico Hyundai. The sales department made me very uncomfortable from the beginning, and I felt rushed through the process of both choosing a car and trying to negotiate, which was tedious and lengthy. I was forced to speak to many people who continually pushed numbers around in different places in order to make it look like I was getting a deal when, in retrospect, they were manipulating the numbers. Hindsight is 20/20. After purchasing the car, I was asked to come back twice in order to finalize paperwork, and then I had an issue with alignment that was not resolved on my first trip to the service department. I had to go to the service department THREE times in order to get my car realigned appropriately. Moreover, I never received my registration in time and was asked to come in AGAIN to pick up a replacement registration. In the two months since purchasing my car, I had to contact the department several times and drive there to get issues resolved a total of NINE times. I strongly advise that, if you are considering purchasing a vehicle here, you reconsider.  The entire process took way too long, was extremely inconvenient, and very uncomfortable.

I loved this nail salon! I picked them because of their ratings on yelp and I had an image from Pinterest and they got it right on! I highly suggest this place! Workers are really nice! I took me and my bridesmaids here!

The IMA is one of my favorite places to take Indianapolis visitors. The art collection is wide and varied, providing a good intro to different artists and eras. 

However, the real gem here is the grounds. 100 Acres is beautiful in any season and it's a great place to walk around and experience art with friends and family. Also, if you're a John Green fan you'll be interested to learn that you can see the "Funky Bones" sculpture from "The Fault in Our Stars" in the park. 

I also recently had the pleasure of attending a wedding reception in the museum's events pavilion. Small dance floor, fun space.

I always say I will not return here, and time and time again we find ourselves at Mandarin.

Saturday night we stopped in. It took half the time to make it to the bark another quarter to order a drink and then another quarter to find a place to stand. Then the fire alarm started sounding and I was partially ready to run for an exit. But it was amazing out of  easily 200 people or so no one moved toward an exit. People kept dancing, drinking and kicking it. the crowd was a fairly good mix, but mostly 20-somethings and about 100 too many people in there.

We finally decided to head out since the alarm sound was obnoxious and the the flashing strobe-like light was blinding. On our way to an exit we run in to a few firemen in full gear with axes. Yea we were happy to leave.

We left one crazy jammed packed place for another.

For the past 4 years, me and my family and friends that I have invited, have stayed at the Renaissance Arts Hotel, New Orleans, LA, during the Essence Festival.  I love the location of the hotel!  It is convenient to all of the places I love to visit while in New Orleans.  I have always enjoyed my visit, until the last couple of nights there.  
On 9 July 2018, at approximately 4:30pm, my daughter and I returned to our room and noticed that it had not been cleaned, because we forgot to turn off the "do not disturb" light. Finding the housekeeping staff still working on the floor, I promptly visited the front desk and politely requested that our room be cleaned. Justin, the front desk associate, rudely informed me that it was "too late" to have our room cleaned. Shocked by his response, I explained that I have made a similar request at a different Marriott hotel and they kindly accommodated my request.  He stated he would give me some towels, but I could not have the room clean.  He refused to contact housekeeping to determine if it was even possible.  I couldn't believe his failure to accommodate us.  This was truly a first; especially since Marriott prides themselves on being a high customer service provider.  I am a Marriott Rewards Member and have stayed at their properties in various locations throughout the world.  Justin's service does not meet the Marriott standard! 
To make matters worse, nor does the hotel manager, Andy King.  After hearing of my experience, my daughter visited the front desk and asked Justin if he might find a way for our room to be cleaned while we were out for dinner and he said that he would call housekeeping.  But upon our return, around 7:30pm, our room still had not be cleaned, and when she visited the front desk again, to inquire the status of our request, Justin stated that he had made the request, but the housekeeping staff was "too busy preparing for new arrivals" to clean our room."  My daughter then emailed the manager, Andy King, on 9 July, and he has yet to respond.  On the morning of 10 July, I visited Andy King's office at approximately 9:10 a.m. and was told to leave my email address, because he had not arrived to work yet.  I have not heard from Andy King either.  
Justin behaves the way he does because his manager, Andy King, allows it.  The worst customer service ever!
I still have not received my Marriott Rewards.  I also wish they offered Vegan food options.

Double cut Pork Chops, Baby Drum, Escargot and Crawfish & Goat Cheese Crapes were all wonderful.   The pork chops were phenomenal!!!!  Great atmosphere and staff.   Will return.  Be sure to take a look upstairs at the old brothel room.
If you like slow service, and anyplace that can ruin a salad then this is the place for you! Can't say much else. Good luck.

Hearing that frozen custard is a STL staple, I knew I needed to try it. I ordered a small of the oreo and it was the smoothest custard I've ever had. Though, I wish it had a stronger Oreo flavor. I think Ted Drewes has a lot of history with people in STL, which is why this place is popular amongst locals. As a tourist, it was nice to share the experience with a few friends, but I would not consider this the best froxen dessert I've had.
Staff are absolutely the worst!! Rude and don't listen. I made the mistake of going back and regretted it right away. They are slow and never in a hurry!!

My husband and I went here for dinner last night and LOVED it! 
Our server, David, was the best! We had never been to Katie's before and he did a great job of answering our questions and recommending menu items. I'm not sure I've ever had a young server as knowledgeable as he was. I heard other servers speaking to guests while we were there and while they were all pleasant, I feel David was far and away the best. He was friendly, attentive, and so helpful - he wanted us to enjoy our meal.
At his recommendation (there were so many things that sounded good that we asked for guidance) we started with the Corn and Huitlacoche Crostini. I would have this for a meal! We followed that with the Fried Artichoke Salad and the Fiori Arrabiatta pasta. It was all SO good! We split all three dishes and it was plenty of food.
It was a nice night and we sat outside. Nice music in the background, good drinks, great food, great service - couldn't ask for a whole lot more!
My only regret is that we didn't go to this place sooner - we've been missing out!

Hard to rate:  Sushi good, maybe great, miso great,

pad thai??? not so much.  Either this place can't make Pad Thai, or every other Thai place I have ever eaten can't make Pad Thai.  The noodles were bright pink.  I am pretty sure that they stir fried noodles in the red sauce from the Chinese sweet and sour chicken.  It made a dish that I am calling Chinese sweet and nasty noodles.  

Order the sushi!

Decided to try Village Whiskey out for brunch since it was close to our hotel. My meal successfully cured my hangover and left my happy-full. The tables were full so we grabbed a seat at the bar. I ordered the traditional 2 egg breakfast and my boyfriend ordered the biscuits and gravy. Both of our meals were delicious, the service was fast and efficient. Overall it was cozy atmosphere with unique options, but might have been slightly overpriced.
Perfect for a quick stay. Clean & very nice small family run hotel. I never give five stars...always room for change in some areas. Even at the W's & the five star brands in the business.

while in town for jazz fest, we stumbled upon this place thanks to yelp. it was really delicious. everything was so fresh and light and the portions were spot on. I had the migas and we split a cinnamon roll with orange zest. Both were excellent. I especially loved the home made sauce (which we will try to recreate). I highly recommend this place when in the area
Home run. Appetizers were great (esp pasta w walnut pesto), and main courses were perfection. Sea bass, lamb and lobster were great. Aaron Teitelbaum is the SHIZZLE. We'll be back...soon!

2nd time in a row that I came here with my son. Cheaper tickets than surrounding theaters but fountain soda was very flat... both times.  They had no Nacho cheese either which was lame. 

I also can't help but notice the building itself has seen better days. 

Staff were friendly but the overall vibe is that the owners themselves either don't care about the place at all or haven't been here since 2001 to see it rusting away.

Bottom Line:
Goth/Black Leather/Black Hair Feel, Super Friendly Lady Bartender, Memorable

Overview:
After stopping in at the Thaxton Speakeasy, my friend and I stopped in at the Crack Fox.  My first time.  Tonight, they had DJ Chrome along with some cat of nine tales(?) beatings on these 'X'-style crucifixes (is that the correct plural usage?).

Drinks:
They had a beer that was decent.  That's all I got and all I recall of their selection.

Atmosphere:
I think most of the goth contingent of STL was in the house.  (Yes, I'm a white guy.)  Quite the scene and quite hospitable.  I felt welcome hanging out in my 'Lion's Choice' retro T-Shirt and shorts.

Music:
As I mentioned, they had DJ Chrome spinning.  I think KMFDM, Rammstein, etc. are some of the more accessible bands he played.  Honestly, I don't recall exactly, but I think the aforementioned bands should give you a clue what they play here.

A complete wow.  My wife and I had lunch on a whim here recently with no expectations and walked away floored.  The casual and charming setting, the warm and friendly staff, and the simple yet full menu.

My better half went for the Tex Mex Slammer which ruled while I went Waffle Cochon and my eyes nearly rolled back into my head.  Every bite of my delectable dish crescendoed further into a successive 'shut ups' Elaine Benes style.

When I tell you this was the best dining experience I have had this year on par with a visit to Sylvain last year, take it to the bank.  Horn's has my heart and belly, and I cannot wait to return.

I can't say enough good things about Kelly! She is easily one of the best stylists in the city for extensions and she REALLY knows colour. I've been blond, brunette and red and she has managed to make each colour work for without damaging my hair. Plus, she's adorable!

Really really good crawfish!
I have been staying at the Crown Plaza one night every other month for the last year and a half and i just found out about this place :(
You can walk to it from the hotel, just be a little creative.

I ordered two pounds of crawfish and walked back to a open eating area at my hotel from there on it is all a blur...

SO GOOD!!!!!
I can't wait to come back, hopefully i will fly in early enough to order more off their menu.

Good original Nashville breakfast spot. The omelettes are really tasty and you have your choice of several ingredients including, cheddar, goat cheese, ham and bacon. The pancakes are some of the best you'll find anywhere. You will probably have to wait to eat here, but this place is definitely worth it. Great breakfast spot!

This place is pretty small. I got the brisket ramen. The brisket was tender and tasted pretty good. I did not enjoy the Matzo ball in the ramen. The broth was pretty good. It says the brisket ramen would be spicy, but it did not meet my expectations.

My boyfriend is from South America and wanted something sort of close to home so 45 mins before closing he decided to go here. When we arrived we were the only two people there and our server seemed a bit pushy or rude to get us in and out telling us the kitchen closed soon when it was 8:20. However, we ordered 2 appetizers and two entres and when the food arrived everything was absolutely amazing and delicious. Towards the end our server seemed a bit happier (maybe because he thought we were just a couple of college students wanting a couple appetizers in the beginning and realized we were actually getting more food?) and we were extremely happy and left with two full and happy bellies and three to-go boxes. We will definitely be back and I'll be sure to tell people to come back here...just not at 8pm.

Overall experience just awful for our group(and apparently the tables around us).  We were seated at 6:33 on a Tuesday and sat there until we were finally greeted at 6:47.  We sat there after that until a little after 7 when we finally received our drinks.  That was over 35 minutes without even a water.   Our server disappeared multiple times while management did nothing to assure that everything was ok.  We finally got our starters, a few orders of guac, which were amazing(hence the 2 stars) before right around when our drinks finally arrived.  The table next to us began to have the same complaint as they arrived and didnt get waited on until about 15 minutes after seating.  The food itself was average but it did not make up for the complete ineptitude of service that became so frustrating to our table(all of us are waiters and bartenders).  This is now the second straight time coming here with the same server and the experience was beyond bad.  When we were finally finished and paid, of course a manager was the first person to the table to come and clean it up before we had all even gotten up but refused to check in at all during the dinner.  One of the more frustrating experiences at a restaurant in a long time, probably will not be going back here even though I live right across the street.

I noticed as we entered the restaurant wasn't busy. I expected it to be cleaner. After we ordered and got our drinks we made our way to a table. Had to wipe salt and a few fry's from the table.
The food was ready quickly. 
I  love the fry's. However, these were so over salted and I mean over salted we were unable to finish.
The fish was way too greasy.
Once again I was let down.
May have to start going to a different location...

We visited here for the first time today for lunch.  I can't say the food was horrible; it was mediocre at best.  Our waiter was great.....very attentive, very helpful.  The place wasn't so busy but we got stuck sitting elbow to elbow with a really obnoxious, crude old drunk who kept dropping the F bomb throughout our meal.  The worst part for me was looking up the ceiling and seeing all this dirt and disgusting black dust just hovering above our heads.  What would it take to clean that up?  You don't let customers see that....at least I wouldn't.  We were going to order a pizza for takeout but the same thing, only worse, was hovering in that area, too.  Sorry, Lemonicello  but we won't be returning.  Clean up your ceilings, light fixtures and wipe your walls down.
Neat place.  Iffy neighborhood.  Overpriced stuff..like crazy expensive.

Still on the hunt for a BBQ joint.  

The smoking pit in the yard drew me into this establishments and at once repulsed me.  Cooking outside is a violation because the product is not protected from environmental contamination.

The kitchen it self seemed to be messy and the cook was preoccupied in the preparation area to notice i was watching as he scratched himself.  The restroom was not well kept.  This was surprising as the was an over abundance of female staff.  

The establishment was big and empty.  We sat at the bar. I watched as waitress/bartender twirled her dirty fingers in the salt/sugar plates.  

One of the most off putting things was the waitress hovering waiting for us to sign the bill the immediately taking the signed receipt.  

The food was nothing to write home about.  The meat was smokey that is about all I have to say about it.   I also tried the layered bowl with was greasy and gave me indigestion.  My husband had the nachos with the BBQ pork, again it was just ok.

Ooohhhhhh, I love Pagoda Noodle!

I had to write this review even after my husband already did, but I wanted to get into a little more detail for anyone who hasn't tried the place and has seen some of the reviews below.

I don't think I have ever had something from Pagoda I did not like. The owner is an absolute sweetheart and her husband is one excellent chef. She was such a doll that I had a Christmas and Valentine's Day present waiting behind the counter for when we came in [she makes little 'goodie baskets' and the such for the regulars].

When we first started going to Pagoda I couldn't get enough of the noodle soups. Then I started trying the dinner selections and they have all been great so far. The portion sizes are large for the amount that they charge and all of the vegetables and livestock and fish are fresh and well prepared. For the vegetarians/vegans out there they offer a good selection of tofu and gluten dishes including a tofu General Tso platter and a delicious black pepper tofu and rice noodle special I can't get enough of. The also have vegetarian soups as well and they can prepare any soup you'd like with vegetable stock instead of chicken stock for anyone watching what they eat or who are just pescetarian. Also, they do not use MSG like all those corner store imitation Chinese Food places!

Some people noted that the service was mediocre but we have never had any complaints. They never try to disturb you while you are eating and time everything perfectly. The place is very clean and there are always beautiful fresh flowers placed throughout the place. It is spacious so even when it is crowded you still have room to place your coat or bag next to you without it disturbing someone else or someone tripping over it.

During the spring and summer they have outdoor seating so you can enjoy a cocktail and a meal under the trees. There are birds nested all throughout the park area and it is particularly peaceful to hear them call while you're eating. I often slip the little sparrows a couple noodle for them to bring back to their nests! =]

Besides what I already mentioned some must haves at Pagoda are the shrimp dumpling noodle, the garden vegetable noodle, salt baked squid, the tofu and seaweed soup, and the garlic string beans.

There is parking usually available along front street for all you drivers and the PPA Parking Lot sits right above them. The Ritz also provides some bike racks and there are posts and railing to lock in the park area.

The staff was super nice here!! The manager (I think her name was Annie) made sure to say hi and a waitress named Mandy served us. She was hilarious; brightened up my afternoon. Very friendly and inviting :) Great selection of beer, I'll be coming again soon for sure

What I emailed customer service

I come in to your kenner location and look forward to half price Sushi as advertised on your web site and I waited till after 4pm to come. I come to find out that you have stopped the special. But still decide to leave it on the web site it's called bate&switch. My friends and I come to the kenner location often but that will soon stop. I will make sure to pass the word on how you like to do business.

Although I did not end up using her services (we just decided not to use a doula at all), she gave me a very in-depth phone consultation that lasted close to an hour. She appears to be VERY knowledgeable and passionate about her profession. She answered every question I had- and as a first time mom, I had several. I would definitely recommend giving her a call if you are searching for a doula.

The vegtable cream cheese was good.. Large chunks of real crunchy vegtables, but the bagel was everything short of spectacular! Considering there are not many bagel places in the area, I guess this place will have to do.

this place is a great replacement for Franco's before.  the location is perfect on the river and place like this has been needed in East Falls.  the Pizza is amazing, especially their Burrata and the green sangria is like no other!  saying that the only points off are for the lack of Pasta on the menu, i think it would make the options wider than just pizza for the frequent fliers of the restaurant.

Just ate a burger from there about 15 minutes ago. Had the 500 burger, ordered it medium. Got home and was about to take a bite and I look at the patty and the thing is pretty much raw. Now I can understand it being a bit undercooked but this thing was no where near medium. Very disappointing. Had to cook it up and dirty a pan at home. Didn't taste any seasonings. 
Had the truffle fries as well. While the flavor was great but there was nothing but beat up fries in my bag. boooooo.
I'll prob go back and give them one more shot but the first impression is not very good.

The good was great and it was very nice inside. Only thing I would recommend to the owners is to get some more waiters and waitresses and have more details on the menu.  I'm not even sure what I ordered but it tasted great.

My mother, grandma and sister came for a girls trip. We arrived around 3:30 and they closed at 5 (should have allotted more time) however Joyce our personal wine tasting pourer couldn't have been kinder. She didn't rush, explained everything about the wine & was just so sweet! We were thrilled with our experience we only wish it was longer   I can't wait to come back with my husband for a Friday or Saturday visit where we hear they have a live band , food and the wine is really tasty! We heard all about the history and the owner who we can't wait to meet.  I would definitely suggest all that are in the area visit Hopewell.

This was the worst Chinese food I have ever had. Tasteless soup. Dry and over cooked wontons. The bourbon chicken made us ill. The friendly and courteous staff almost made me not want to write this. Be afraid. Be very afraid.

I recently visited sassafras and I must say it's everything the food was prepared to order I had the half shrimp half oyster poboy and the seafood was fried perfectly and had great flavor my daughter he'd the fried chicken and that was the best homefried chicken I've ever had .I would highly recommend this place to any and everyone be back soon thanks again for the good food and great service

Came in for drinks and was pleasantly surprised with great grub. Drinks were reasonably priced, I had a mixed drink and my friend had wine (she said it was really good). 

Staff was friendly and service was great. 

Food was amazing all around. I had blackened wings, my friend had the burger and we had tots on the side. Everything was cooked perfect and seasoned nice. 

Hats off to the local bar that throws down in the kitchen
Largest selection of local products as well as hard to find gourmet items!

We stumbled upon this little gem after we ended our ghost tour.  The tour ended at this restaurant since this building is haunted.

Food: we decided to try the three course meal for $39.99 per person.  We started with the salad (which was very refreshing) and cheesecake (sounded good on the menu but it was too heavy for an appetizer). Our main courses were the mussels (perfect amount of mussels and pasta) and pork chop (wow this was very tender and tasty!!) and ended with creme brûlée (fantastic) and bread pudding (not a big fan).

Service: I'm so impressed with the service here. Everyone is super friendly. Although we walked in 15 min before closing time, they did not rush us in any way. 

We also got to check out the "ghost table", which was cool. Definitely recommend it!

I loved my stay here. The room service was top notch the view was grade A and the mini bar was stocked with the best stuff. Too bad the girl I was dating at the time was a total B but that's neither here nor there. Beautiful atmosphere great location would stay again!

Had our car in for it's regularly scheduled service.  Firestone uncovered an issue which  require dealership action.  They provided me with the temporary fix to the issue and refused to charge me for anything... despite the fact that they put resources and labor into it.  The reason they wouldn't charge was because they couldn't 100% resolve the issue themselves. They refused payment despite the fact I insisted we pay them something.  Mike, Lynn and the entire staff have been exceptionally helpful every single time I have talked to them.  I'm not one of those people who is wary of car shops.  I simply search for the ones who have a great reputations and who are customer focused.  Firestone on Forsyth is EXACTLY one of those places.  I love that I have a place to service my cars that is grown on a basis of full mutual trust and courtesy.  It's like having your good mechanic friend service your car.  But better, because it is a whole team of people putting your interests first.  My highest recommendation.

Waiter was very  good. Hostess was very pleasant. The quantity of food could be a lot better. I ordered the steak sand and there was only about 3 slices of thin steak meat on roll. There was a lot of roll with very little food inside. For$16.95 , I expect more steak meat. 
Total ripoff!!
Very expensive for the amount of food you get.
I would not go back!

Stopped in for lunch. Waiter had no personality.  None of the wait staff were really friendly, very somber atmosphere. A cook pointed out to our waiter that a table needed his attention. Had a Poor Boy shrimp sandwich. I think these sandwiches are special because of the roll. Hard to say but the roll seemed like it was day old and not fresh for the day. The meal came with fries, they were okay. Would i recommend friends to eat here , no. The place was very uninspiring.

Fantastic find!  Try the butternut squash soup if she has it; it has lemon in it and is velvety & wonderful. The spinach pie is also outstanding, and light enough that you'll have room for a piece of baklava!

For a hotel/resort restaurant, it's actually pretty good.

The giant fishtank is obviously the cool talking point here, but don't be one of those jags who goes right up to it if you're not seated there to take pictures with the flash on using your dumb iPhone.  I promise nobody on your snapchat cares about you putting the caption "dinner!" over a picture of a tarpon. 

Anyway, they've got a decent local beer selection and the grouper sandwich was legit, so I guess there are worse places to drop $70 on a lunch.  Bonus points for being a Guy Harvey property, so you can go in wearing your GH shirt with a painting of fish flying around a lighthouse on the back and play "match the apex predator"

Casa video has been a Tucson icon and in this time of Netflix video shops are not long for this world. Casa Video managed to change their business model to include a trendy craft beer, wine and cider bar. They too have big screens playing awesome movies, wonderful alternative to sports crazed other bars. I love the theme nights, Star Trek, Harry Potter Trivia, game nights. Free popcorn is always a big hit. And you can still rent movies. With a selection that doesn't come close to Netflix, it's totally worth checking out. It's one of my favorite places for good libations and great energy. So glad Casa Video survives!

Ramen is good. It's expensive, $11-$14 a bowl. Tucson tends to be more expensive, but I'm from LA and I'm used to $6-9 a bowl. 
Service is eh. Waiting system is stupid you have to wait in line, not just write a name down. Super fun in the Tucson heat. There are also signs all around insisting that the waiting system isn't stupid. Which makes it feel even more so. I've eaten here several times, and getting a check is very hard as well. Every single time. So is getting change for your check. The waiting system would make more sense if they had quicker service, but considering I usually wait for my check about 10 minutes after I finish eating, they should let you write you name and sit around the corner. I hope they listen to the feedback insisting that the customers are wrong. The customers will keep you open! If there's a wait, I always leave. If there's no wait I consider eating here.

Great group of people, great group of instructors that have a great system setup to help you succeed. Very competitive but friendly environment. Love the experience at paragon. People are mostly friendly and helpful to new comers. There is a lot of different people at different skill level so sparring is very effective. Joined 2 month ago for jiujitsu.

A total disappointment!  I'm excited to see new development in DTSP, but not when the quality stinks and the staff lies and deceives potential renters.  I took a tour and am glad I didn't select to live here.  I know a you few ppl living there and feel for them.

Unless you are on the top floor it sounds like you are living under elephants.  The suggestion of the staff is to go and tell your neighbor to put down area rugs, but they are not sure if that helps.  When I toured I heard noise and the sales rep told me it was construction related, b.s. turns out that is normal noise all the time.  

My friend complained about their appliances not working properly, the maintenance man came and  agreed that nothing works well and provided a work around solution . . . really?!?  If I'm paying $1900+ in rent I expect my stuff to work.

I feel like the staff tells you whatever they want to make the sale.  See the panoramic view of the city, isn't it awesome.  Glad I didn't move in as they are putting up another high rise in the parking across the street and my view would be construction.  No view and construction noise - no thank you. 

One of my key reasons for not selecting to leave here is I didn't feel safe.  There was no security presence and I visited a few times while making up mind and found someone sleeping on the sidewalk near by, was asked if I had change by someone else and another not so savory person tried to "bum" a cigarette from me.  While I know this is a downtown location and they can't control the area, they could have a security presence which would encourage people to leave residents / guests alone.  They also rent out parking to ppl who work in the area and while you need a fob to get into the building these ppl do not live in the building just park here, Beacon leaves the gate open so they can come/go and unfavorables could easily walk thru garage wait for someone leaving and then enter the building through the door before it closes.  Plus it adds to traffic / noise that residents shouldn't have to deal with so Beacon can make more $$ selling parking spots.

Be aware . . . look up other reviews on other sites.  There are so many downtown options now that this one should be skipped, quickly.  If I could give this 0 stars I would!

My favorite dessert place in the city. Always get their fancy filled donuts. Most recently had the banana pudding one which was divine with a nice iced coffee. The simple chocolate one cannot compare or really any of their simple donuts. Always get the filled ones! They usually have couple and they change all the time!

Stopped in on a weeknight for a nice dinner when we unexpectedly had a free babysitter.  I love it when that happens!  We shared an ap of little crab claw sticks, which I know sounds incredibly unappealing but I can't remember what they called them.  Basically they left the toe on and removed the rest of the shell off the meat- and then breaded and fried.  Envision a mozzarella stick- only its crab. Delightfully easy to eat!  I wish the crab had been a bit sweeter but that's what we get in the Midwest.  

We then shared a summer salad which was full of summer veggies- different pole beans, beets, pattypan squash, peppers, and lumps of creamy goat cheese.  Oh, andt he best, most tiny yellow cherry tomatoes ever.  They were like little sweet tomato flavor bombs.  

My hubs had their meatloaf, which is supposedly a bit of a big deal.  We weren't impressed frankly.  I mean, it wasn't bad, but it wasn't blow me away good either.  And a bit dry.  My fish however was excellent.  I know they are known for good seafood preparations and they got it right on this one for sure.  Perfectly cooked and a nice light sauce.  

So happy I was able to get in here during the week. The vibe was more laid back and sitting outside was great.

Awesome, friendly staff and a brand new state of the art range. I've never seen lanes like this before, the standard lanes have digitally set targets and lighting. Downstairs has a fully programmable set of lanes with turning, moving targets as well as police strobes. The whole place is clean and the staff is always helping and very, very knowledgable. Oh and the BBQ joint connected to it is great too. They also have great rental options, ladies night is a killer deal, and the store next door has many great weapons and accessories to shop for. Can't wait to get my CCW there soon.
The Pho and Vermicelli are spot on! Try the lemonade soda for something fabulous to have with your meal. Great prices and amazing food!
normally, i do not like vietnamese/chinese/asian food.  but this place is AWESOME!!!!  fabulous food!!!  and the staff is very accommodating!!!   totally reccommend this place!!!

This place was truly awful.....diners are diners.... food is usually good enough in most diners... but this place....not so much!!
When my husband doesn't finish a meal... you know it's bad!!!!!
The staff had no interest in how bad it was!
Needles to say.... a second visit... not even an option!!!
Do yourself a favor... keep on driving .....

The ice was made in house and was good... Nothing out of the ordinary in regards to flavors. According to the sign is the oldest "espresso bar" in Nashville. The staff was friendly and overall the place was clean.

The wife and I were in town with some friends for NYE and paid this place a visit.

We stopped by for the happy hour and turned out to be the best food decision of the trip!  50 cent oysters....can't beat it!

The wife normally isn't a big fan of oysters, but managed to scarf down a dozen herself which is saying a lot, since normally she gets grossed out after the 3rd oyster.

Service is great.  The only knock on this place is that it's a bit small and there's a wait...but this is one of the few places where the food is definitely worth the wait!!!

This is my first comment to Yelp. Thank you Robbie for posting about this location. I will also say avoid this place in general but for SURE AVOID NATALIE. I first waited 25min when only one person was in front of me and 5-6 stylists. While I was waiting I didn't mind so much I was catching up on some clash royale got bored and looked on my google maps and looked at the top 3 Yelp comments and saw Robbie's comment about Natalie I was willing to give it a shot as long as I didn't get her...low and behold I did:( I brought up the comment to her and showed her my phone with Robbie's comment and to gauge her reaction. (Hoping for some sort of normal human recourse...I mean it's the Internet and there are bs people out there) but she reacted with we don't use Yelp here...uhhhh ok thanks don't expect you to...you uhhmm cut hair...but offered no reassurance but offered to have me see another hairstylist if I felt uncomfortable. Which I did. I saw the next girl...asked her if she could do a military Mohawk or a buzz. She immediately got bug eyed and said WHAT?!...this was a big decision for me and it made me feel uncomfortable rather than at peace. I was like do you know of buzz cuts that aren't exactly just a full buzz. Some sort of Mohawk that's short? She laughed...I decided to leave.

Before I left I saw another homie sit down at Natalie's chair and showed him Robbie's comment just to give fair warning. 

So to be completely fair I didn't get my hair cut there. Maybe Robbie is completely wrong and perhaps I'm the jerk here. But I'm relaying my experience and it was embarrassing and unprofessional. I will certainly never come back.

So you get a drop dead gorgeous prom dress but still have to do some major alterations to make it in to a mermaid fit, shorten the layers of ruffles throughout, and alter the top and sleeves...No pressure, right? You really have to put your trust in someone you don't know-because if it gets messed up, you're screwed! After reading the reviews on here, we decided to put that trust in to Stavros at the European Tailor. I liked the fact that from the first call, he made you feel special-not just like a number that the shop would get to a day or two before your special event because they had a lot of other people to work on before you...Yes, I was actually told that from a competitor and was so put off! I would have to agree with the reviews on here that say that the shop could use an update, but that didn't matter. Stavros' old school work ethic, ability to make you feel like a princess, and finished product were what was important! Awesome job and service!
Living on Mesa this is our to go place for sushi. Great service, fast and friendly staff. The rainbow roll is bomb!

Very good, a lot of faux meat dishes on the menu. The crispy chicken ranch sandwich tasted exactly like the real thing! It was a little pricier than I thought as each entree menu item cost between $8-11. Overall great experience with the food and would definitely come again!

Some of the best chicken steaks ive ever had & omg the italian hoagie with side of fries which are a must. 
Oh & i just found out they are 24/7 & i work overnight needless to say ill be there 4am looking for dinner!!

FAVORITE RESTAURANT IN NOLA! (so far anyway lol) Great service, amazing food. we went twice in in two days. The chicken and waffle is absolutely delicious. Their fig and blue cheese dip with pita chips are awesome. Honestly, everything we tried was really good --- including their drinks. A great spot for breakfast, lunch, or dinner. even if you arent into seafood, you can find something you'll enjoy.

Fried oysters with BBQ and blue cheese was the highlight of the meal. I wish we just ordered four of them for our meal! The jambalaya was a nice way to experience it; we should have reserved the shrimp po boy for another place. And the warm bread was a welcome treat as we sat down.

Everything here is southern and delicious!!!
The lavendar lemonade - sounds strange but once you try it you will never want a different summer beverage!
The pimento, chicken salad, she crab soup, ANY off the cakes - so wonderful!
Great place for lunch and I cant believe it's in Bellevue. Love this place!!!

Yikes! Defiantly a miss for us tonight from start to finish. The stuffed mushrooms had a very odd flavor. We didn't eat them because it tasted chemical, not natural. The server said they pour white wine over them. I don't think so. The four of us each got a different entree and none of us finished ours. The portions were huge but very low quality. The poboy was watery and ended up a flavorless mess. The pizza had a very thin, burned crust with too much cheap cheese and not enough real toppings. The muffalatta was so much bread it was hard to find the meager filling inside. Maybe it's good sometimes, but not tonight.

I'm a fan of Wasabi's at both locations - the food is always so good, and the sushi rolls to perfection! I like to give it 5 starts but it's always a little unsettling when we stop into the this location and every table is available (anyway of the week at the lunch hour), and yet, the table service often stinks. But if you're lucky to be ackowdged within 10 minutes of sitting down..you're in for a good lunch. Recently did a take out order on a Saturday night, and was happy to see about 10 guess in the house. Not sure how they even stay in business, but I'll keep going..the food is great and it never disappoints!

Mexican themed bar and restaurant.

Food: not bad, but below average for this price point.
Service: friendly but slow.

Come hang out if you are in the neighborhood. No reason to make a special trip if you are not.

Sage Yoga and Wellness in Boise is amazing!  I am a yoga instructor & health and wellness coach currently living in Washington D.C. and was looking for a studio to practice at while visiting family. I stumbled up this studio and decided to do a walk in, and I was pleasantly surprised beyond words. The instructors are FANTASTIC! They are interdisciplinary and positive energy and compassion just radiates from them. The over all space is great: They have lockers, showers, and even a massage area. The practice space is cozy and warm. 

All levels of practitioners, beginners to instructors will find a wonderful practice here. Lulu Lemon show room is just a block away too. 

Sage Yoga Also offers a community class on the weekend. If you are interested in yoga try a lot of studios and find the style the resonates with you. Come with an open heart and try Sage Yoga and Wellness :)

When this place first opened, it was terrible. Then, It got better, and then gradually got worse again. I got vermicelli today for lunch and could not get over the fact that some ingredient in the dish tasted like propane. I literally could not get over it. Whether, it was the fish sauce or the vermicelli or the meat, I couldn't finish it. I don't get sick from eating a lot of stuff, I mean, I've put down spoiled milk and bad food and been fine. But I definitely got sick after this. I've been raised on Viet food all my life, but good god, nothing ever tasted like this. Pho is decent though.

These guys are great.  They give it to you just like it is.  If it can be fixed, they will, if it can't be fixed, they let you know why.  I've had them look fix my PS3 and my Xbox.  They put in a new screen on a laptop that I thought I was going to have to throw away.  It is done with they say it will be, and once, because they had to order a part, they called to let me know that it was going to be late.

Erin & Jessica at the front desk rock! Pleasant & helpful. We checked in around 1:30a.m. and Anne was warm & welcoming. We had a room with 2 queens as that was all that was available for Sat. night & moved to a king room the following day - front desk made sure to let us know as soon as a king was cleaned. Both rooms were very clean!! Housekeeping should be commended - I am pretty fussy about cleanliness! Beds were very comfortable. Front desk staff was helpful with local eateries & directions. The rooms were spacious and if traveling with children a great choice. Would definitely stay here again!!

About once a month I get an insatiable craving for mexican food and since Novio and I like to explore we went to a lesser known place which lead us to here. We went during prime happy hour time $2 taco special and $5 margaritas, we just walked in didnt have to wait at all. Nice local, great decor and ambiance. The waitress was fantastic, very attentive and stealthy! The food was better than average, I can't say it was the best ever because I have yet to experience that. Novio and I got pretty accquainted with Jose Cuervo. Overall great time, if you want mexican food and dont want a lot of hastle to get it.

My friend from out of town and I went on a "taco tour" of Tucson ordering one taco from each of the 5 different taquerias we chose and this was easily the winner.  The lengua taco was small, but very flavorful.  The homemade tortilla made the difference for me.  I always understood pico de gallo to mean fresh salsa, but if you ask for it here you get a cup of fruit (mangos, watermelon, pineapple, coconut, etc) seasoned with salt and cayenne pepper (optional).  It was quite tasty and refreshing.    I'll be back there soon again to try their other tacos!

I love the Sporting Club. It is an incredible facility; it feels wrong to even just call it a "gym." I've been enjoying it for a little over a month now, I was able to join because of a LivingSocial deal which reduced the normal monthly fee of $102 to $60 (and no initiation charge and a massage or personal training session, to boot!). This now stands as the best LivingSocial deal ever in the history of the universe and it shall never be surpassed. Fin. 

I find most gyms utilitarian. Some are nicer than others, some have more equipment or shorter wait times for machines or cleaner facilities, but generally the vibe is people are there to work out and you go in and get it done and go home. The atmosphere here is totally different. The whole place just seems designed to make you feel taken care of. On the first floor, there is a small cafe with very friendly staff, I like to stop there for a quick snack and some coffee after an early-morning workout. There are some armchairs in front of a flat-screen TV that's usually tuned to CNN, some longer tables where you could eat lunch, and a few smaller tables by the windows overlooking Broad Street that have a great view. I've been to other gyms that have juice bars/cafes, but this one just has a very pleasant, friendly vibe to it. 

The locker rooms are great. They're never crowded, the lockers are big enough to fit whatever you've brought with you. They have absolutely every amenity you could want - for the showers, there are shower caps, razors, body wash, shampoo/conditioner, and shaving cream. The towels are fluffy and always plentiful. There are individual vanities stocked with deodorant, hairspray, body lotion, hairdryers (with diffusers!) and curling irons. Whatever you need, they have it here. I don't think I've showered at home since becoming a member. 

Since it's been approximately 1 million degrees throughout my membership, I've been using the pool rather than the other fitness facilities. It is absolutely lovely. It is occasionally crowded enough that I've had to share a lane, but everyone is very friendly about it. Only once have I ever had to actually wait for a lane, and that was literally for five minutes. After my swims, I like to indulge in a soak in the giant hot tub, which is the size of my living room at home. I am not kidding. There is also a sauna. The hot tubs and saunas are single-sex, while the pool is co-ed. I'm a fan of the setup. 

As others have mentioned, if the Sporting Club has an achilles heel, it is the price. I believe the normal initiation fee is $450, on top of the $102 monthly membership fee. They were recently running a promotion for a $99 initiation fee, but you're still looking at a considerable amount of outlay for a gym membership. If you can find a way to fit it into your budget, it would absolutely be worth it. After my promotion ends, I'll be wistfully looking forward to the day my life allows me to return!

Avoid this theatre as if it had the bubonic plague!

I gladly drive 40 min out of my way (instead of 10 to this) to AMC Elmwood.  

This theatre is smelly and loud and totally covered with police patrol.  I'm positive that goes for all the movie theatres as there is not much to do post-Katrina..but this place smells F-U-N-K-Y and looks F-U-N-K-Y too.

Avoid avoid avoid!  But if you must go, go during bargain matinees to avoid crowds and the eventual stinky-ness! 

Big plus:  Accepts all major credit cards and you can purchase your tickets inside to avoid the line OUTSIDE.

If you're looking for the incredible burgers previously served at this address when it was "Yo Mama's Bar and Grill", I'm afraid those burgers are gone.  Yo Mama's burgers were *amazing*.  Port St Peter's burgers are dry, bland and boring.  :-(

This place has bailed me out a couple of times over the last few years when I've forgotten important dates. The staff is courteous, the selection is great, and is located fairly prominently within Reading Terminal itself. If you find yourself in need of flowers for a special occasion in Center City, this is the place to go.

This restaurant is one block off of Bourbon street and is absolutely one I will be coming back to. The menu is short and sweet. The service is courteous and prompt. The atmosphere is elegant and cozy. The tuna that I got was cooked skillfully to medium rare; one of the best fish I've had. The drinks are all great and expertly made. This is probably my favorite restaurant in NOLA now. Happy eats!

Great pick for breakfast in New Orleans!!

Friends had come here on the day of arrival while I was still in transit - loved it and had nothing but great things to say about the Shrimp & Grits, the delicious coffee and the Healthy Breakfast, too.  (I know, I know)

So a few days later, the three of us decided to check it out since service was prompt & delightful and also because the line out the door (during Essence Music Fest) was not quite as long as some other establishments on the same block.

Our waitress was SO great about helping us customize our orders!  See, I had fallen in love with so many of the pix on the Yelp mobile app that we all began craving items that were no longer on the menu.  Good thing for us, they will make whatever your heart desires!!  

My Seafood Omelet was LOADED with Shrimp, Crawfish, Crabcake, veggies and cheese - amazingness to be precise!  Had it alongside the hasbrowns with gravy on top but the biscuit on the side!  Yes, you heard me right.  Now let's talk about the mimosa - fresh squeezed OJ and champs, with a splash of peach flavor in a big ol' glass.  They don't do anything small in this city apparently.  You will leave here fealing fat & happy :)

I highly recommend Cafe Fleur de Lis!

I didn't even get the haircut, because.....
I was trying to find a sign or leaflet that gave their pricing.

When you ask about price, the answer seems to be "whatever we decide today".

If there was a service/price card - the female at the counter did not show it to me even though she knew I was looking around for it.

This a very international city.
I feel bad for the visitors with limited English that would rather try and read a services-available along with a price card ... as opposed to having to come up with the English term on their own and who would like to see prices.
This is my favorite breakfast spot in Tucson! Expect to probably wait for a table, but worth every minute! My favorite is the Beni or the Steak & Egg Sandwich. Everything is amazing!

The $1 kids book section is where its at.  The staff are friendly but not overbearing. 

The layout and decor makes you want to cozy up in a chair and chill for a few minutes -- and I'm sure many do -- but not me because every time in there I've got my toddler in tow and I'm trying my best to make sure he doesn't eat all of the complimentary cookies that are often set out or start chucking chess pieces from the vintage set that sits near the back of the store!

Crab cakes are good but always have been over in Prospect anyway. The flavor is in the filler though so kinda a bummer there's so much. "Crabby Fries" we're actually potatoes wedges and came out uncooked/cold on inside - don't waste your money on them. Crab cakes sandwiches are a tad over priced but still good if you're in the area.

I remember the first time I tried Chipotle...I hated it.  Haha.  And then I went back...and again...and again...and again...and then I worked for them...and quit...and went back...a million times.

It's a guilty pleasure...your boujie wannabe Mexican food...and I love it.

This location though...fell short.  The rice was not seasoned enough.  The meat portion was fine.  The fajitas were super overcooked and limp.  

They did a great job with their guac but the chips also weren't seasoned enough with lime and salt.  

Overall, it was a mediocre experience.  I'd still pick chipotle over their Q competitors anyday.

3 stars.

Mr. B's did not disappoint. It was recommended by a neighbor business, Royal Antiques (royalantiques.com) as a very good place for a meal. My feeling is that if your neighbor likes you then you must me very good. 
I ordered the Mr. B's BBQ shrimp and also during the course of my meal had 2 glasses of the Parducci Cabernet Sauvignon. The service was impeccable and the food was great. I am from the Pacific Northwest, we know our shrimp and this shrimp from the gulf was tender and prepared very well. The sauce was light and wonderful to dip the french bread in. Do wear the bib! 
Prices are medium, did not startle me. I left a generous tip (25%) because I felt the service deserved it.

They've lost my business over parking. Tiny lot with the spaces closest to front door marked as valet. Makes no practical sense and screams desperation. No way to justify charging for valet there. Knock it off, that's in poor taste.

I went there for the lunch buffet and it was great. Very affordable and all of the food was delicious. Their eggplant and chicken masala both had a very hearty spiciness, and the naan was warm and fresh. I'll be back.

The Cantina is a great staple restaurant in downtown Sparks. On a recent visit back home we stopped in for dinner. This restaurant offers great service, an awesome atmosphere, and appetizing food. This is a great place to stop in and relax, have a cocktail, and enjoy some great food!

The food here is ok, but the management doesn't seem to care about it's customers.  I tried this place using a deal I bought off dealchicken.com, but they refused to honor it.  The manager simply refused to honor the full value, saying there were some special terms of the deal that weren't printed on it.  I'm not sure how I'm supposed to know about those special terms, but the manager seemed to think I should know.  I was astounded by the lack of courtesy and general professionalism.  This is hands down the worst treatment I have ever received as a customer.  I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone, in any regard. Ever.
The mini cupcakes are delicious. They are flavored well, soft and have the perfect sponge to them. I think the best one is the Irish cream. Also the service was great!

This place is not far from my apartment. So, we frequent here. I've had a variety of options from the menu. The employees are always nice. Prices are reasonable. The seasoning that they use, endearingly called "Lemon Pepper Crack" by locals adds the perfect flavor to both the fish and chicken. Sometimes the fish is a bit too crunchy. The fried chicken wings are the best in my opinion with the fried okra. Heart attack in a styrofoam plate. But, that's why you have to screen your fried foods.  ‍ Also, watch out for the white guy with the backpack that hangs around the place. He's asked me for bus fare every time I've gone there. Yet I never see him leave Grand. One day, I gave him a dollar and he followed me to my car insisting that I search my cup holders for change. He doesn't seem to remember much as the next time I went in, I got the same sob story. He seems to be harmless. But you can't really be too careful these days.

1. Best Tater-Tots EVER. (Seriously)
2. You can get St. Elmo Shrimp Cocktail here. (Yay!!)
3. Deep Fried Avocado!! (Yum!)
4. All Bathrooms are Gender Neutral. (Amazing!)

Great atmosphere. Park in the mall garage, no problem!, Burger was really tasty. Awesome Mac & Cheese. Good beer selection. Great service.

We usually dine here at least twice a month. Part of a great dining experience is the staff and how they interact with the customers. The interaction and courtesy is now missing from this venue. There is no longer a "welcoming" atmosphere here or any concern as to the dining experience of the customers. This is unfortunate as it detracts from the overall dining experience. Our order was not completed as asked & we were presented with a dirty wine glass to use. It was wiped with a napkin but was still dirty when given to us. Food still good but the place is in decline...
Love this place! Delicious and a great value. Very friendly staff! I get the authentic pork tacos and my fiancé gets a burrito. We love the salsa bar and I always buy a small guacamole for the side!
A relaxing atmosphere to enjoy dessert and coffee or your favorite wine. The Strawberry Shortcake is a must try!

I like to try new things. I will return to places I enjoy but I have never been a "regular" of any restaurant. Village Pub has changed that. I now enjoy a stuffed pretzel, a cold beer or a mule at least once a week. I have been there for happy hour, dinner and late nights. This place fits what I look for in a restaurant/bar to a T! 

First, the overall atmosphere is laid back and friendly. Servers will take their time to answer your questions and let you sample beer. I've never had to wait long for any order but the goal of the staff is not to rush you or turn tables. They're going to let you enjoy yourself. And its not only the servers who are friendly, most of the patrons seem happy to start up conversations with each other. 

The menu is simple. I recommend... well... everything! Not an overwhelming amount of choices and each one excellent. I absolutely love their twist on classic bruschetta and their stuffed pretzels (basically pretzels turned into sandwiches) are my favorite. Beer selection is good and the mules are the perfect drink for warm weather! 

Bonus feature: you can bring your dog onto the porch. Since I do have a (friendly) dog, it is so nice to have a restaurant with wait service that I can enjoy without having to leave my pup at home. 

There are many other details that help to make the Village Pub stand out as a gem among establishments, but you should go there and discover them for yourself!

I enjoy everything at Senora's.   Like others have said, the best Mexican in West Chester.  Do yourself a favor and try the Jalapeño Con Camarones,  fresh salsa and the carnitas Sausalito.  The prices are  very reasonable and the quality is high.

We flew into town and we're staving -Yelp rated Sabrina's a 5 Star and it lived up to the ratings. It was over the top!  Service was excellent and the food even better!  Red pepper soup, peanut noodle salad, carnitas tacos and luau melt were all fantastic. We will definitely go over of our way to go back.

Southwest salad is so good!!!
Clean, nice play area
Employees were all kind and fast!

I love this place and come at least once a month for lunch. I have been here twice for dinner but my husband doesn't particularly like it so we choose it as a dinner option. I usually come with my kids for lunch on Saturdays because it is our time together.

I love coming here because they know what my kids and I like and always make sure that we have everything that we need. The place is a typical Chinese restaurant with take-out options but I always eat in. It iisn't very fancy but the decor is bright and there is always plenty of seating.

I love the hot and sour soup here because it is flavored well and uses my favorite canned mushroom slices. I'm sure a lot of people would disagree with me but I grew up working in a Chinese restaurant and love Chinese take out food...lol.

I usually get the Kung Pao Chicken or Garlic Chicken lunch specials. I love both because of the texture and crunch of the veggies. The Garlic Chicken does come spicy but I always add hot oil to everything I eat with this included. I LOVE spice!

My kids always get the hot and sour soup (which tells you that it isn't "hot" at all) but they love it. They also get the chicken skewers which are charbroiled and tasty. 

The spring rolls are crunchy and have small shrimps within. Sometimes they are a little greasy but that is to be expected with fried food typically.

Service is great here. The guy that waits on us typically knows that I like hot oil and that my kids like extra cherries, so we are always well taken care of. The free hot tea and fried noodles are given to every table and we always enjoy it while waiting for our food.

All in all, not a fancy restaurant, but that's not why we come here. Food is fresh and delicious with good service...what more can a girl ask for?!

Without a doubt the WORST Pizza Hut I have ever ordered from. Please save your time and money and go elsewhere. 

I have ordered from them on three separate occasions and the order has been wrong EVERY SINGLE TIME! This past weekend they even "forgot" about my order all together. I should have just walked out but I waited 45 minutes for my hand tossed cheese pizza. I got home only to discover it was a cheese stuffed crust and the pizza looked horribly unappetizing-looking thrown together. I am incredibly disappointed that they can't get a simple pizza right and will not be back.
Excellent! Kenji was thoroughly professional and safety conscious, very knowledgeable about a wide variety of topics, and a lot of fun to hang out with.

My old Camry broke down on 101 after a Christmas shopping trip to Santa Barbara on Saturday. We were towed to Santa Barbara Toyota. Thanks to Hai in service & Gabe in car rental what could have been a bad experience morphed into a good one. Excellent service. Very nice people. Thank you for taking such good care of us!

Gyro deluxe,baklava , and cookies are all very good. 
Staff is friendly and everything is reasonably priced. Will be back

I guess you could call this slot machine heaven, smoker central, and definitely not a Vegas casino.  Drinks are expensive, the table games just OK and the poker room way too isolated.  Oh but there are slots, slots everywhere!

Not sure what perks me up more- the great coffee or the friendly, genuine smiles on every employee. Sips is the best!

I recommend everything from a simple iced coffee (they have almond milk which is a huge plus for me) to whatever is their latest drink special/concoction.

I really loved the French Press the coffee was excellent by my coffee geek standards, and the pastries were good too.  It's great to see more of these small roasters doing it right.
I judge 3rd wave coffee joints by the following criteria: 1) The cappuccinos 2) the pour overs; and both were perfect.
The Costa Rican pour over was one of the best cups I've had in a while, so I took some beans home.
The homemade biscuits are a must have.
Also, the staff were pretty nice folks.

Grandin Theatres is outdated cinemas, all 5 cinemas with all seats were worn out and falling apart. It still dirty place and consession is poor service and there are too many young empoyee like teenager doesn't know how do their job. Theatre should be torn down and build new 7 screens cinemas with stadium seating and 3D same as Silvercity Cross Iron Mill with Excape and Bar Scent.

Decent Chipotle. They know how to wrap a burrito! The energy is nice too because they greet people as they enter...at least during the lunch hour. Later in the day it's kind of busy.

I would recommend coming here over La Cumbre if possible. La Cumbre location has some issues but see the Yelp page.

This place is incredibly overpriced
Our party of 6 had 3 chicken sandwiches, 2 orders of chicken strips. And 1 order of fish tacos.
The sandwiches were good, chicken strips were fair, but the fish tacos were inedible.
I have no idea what kind of fish it was. It was soft, and smelled very fishy, I caught a wife from a table away.
Over all tab for this and 6 iced teas... $135 plus tip and tax...

Sometimes there's lively service, but this time our order was taken by a timid individual that never even greeted us. We just received a look upon approaching the register. We chose to order our Cali Burritos as bowls (love that option!) The Big Cali Bowl was full of fresh ingredients, despite them forgetting Guacamole in mine :( Oh yes, I went to the counter and asked for it, wouldnt you? No biggie, a server brought it out soon after and the feast began. Yes, I do mean feast! The bowls are huge and I can eat a lot! The cilantro-lime rice was cooked well and the tortillas fresh crunch compliment the other textures in the bowl. I didnt get any of the hot sauces (15+ to choose from), but theres no shortage. If Taco Bell is your thing, you need to step up your game!

Excellent food, inconsistent service, creative atmosphere, and cool seating options.

Will return.

Sadist behind counter
sadist behind the counter indeed.
want to be treated like crap?  come shop here.

I love this place... Food is decent through the bar and grill... The brunch is great... But nowhere close that is better to get drinks and enjoy beautiful grass fairways and magnificent ponds and waterfalls from a clubhouse... Great service... Incredible to watch sunset with the great views of the ocean

We stopped there for lunch before flying back to Chicago. We had the best mexican food we have eaten. I had fish tacos and my husband had enchiladas and guacamole. My husband was happy that they had a separate menu for vegetarians. The complimentary churros were delicious.
Service was really good. Wish they would open a branch in Chicago!

Never a bad experience here! The ingredients are always top quality and the sandwiches are hearty. We love their pasta and potato salad too.

Above all else, you can always expect some of the best customer service around.  You will be treated like you are friends walking into their home kitchen.  Definitely a mom and pop place we are happy to support!

My first time here and it was a pretty good experience. Never had my own coffee pot served to me before so that was a plus right there. I had the Ham and Egg Melt with fries and everything tasted very good. I've been to Denny's, Alberts and Smittys a few times each and it's pretty much the same food there. Nothing stood out but it was good. The waiter I had, Raja, was great. He took care of us pretty well and seemed to care about how we liked our food.

I believe this restaurant is only a couple years old but it looks like it's been around since the 80's and they haven't changed it. It's kind of tacky looking so I think they'd get more people in if they just spruced it up. This location is pretty out of the way for me so I don't intend to come back here much but if I'm in the area it's a possibility.

Restaurant appeared very clean and staff was polite and helpful. 

I ordered a falafel sandwich and it tasted like the fried shrimp they serve because they fry them in the same oil. This was most unfortunate.

This is a fast food place and mainly thrives on selling wings and other fried up american fare. I'm a little disappointed at Yelp for recommending it to me when I searched for "falafel".

It's basically a Hooters on steroids. 

PROS:
-It was bikini night, and twin Peaks actually hires attractive, young girls, that guys enjoy having in our presence.
-No motorcycle gangs- we're in NE Indy, not Amarillo:) 
-Beer was f'n cold, great selection (Bells Oberon on tap), and the prices are reasonable.
-Above average bar food. 
-Large outside patio

CONS:
-Nothing special, as they didn't reinvent the wheel, as far as these types of restaurants are concerned.
-I'm sure some women's lib group classifies this establishment as sexist.
-I'm sure the LGBT mafia will demand that Twin Peaks hires a multitude of transgender species to flaunt their stuff...you know, because 3% of the population should dictate what the rest of the nation wants.
-I'm sure yelp HQ still hates me.

A decent place. I'd definitely return to watch the games, as there are tons of TV's, and the service was spot on as well.

3.5 stars
Not good..very sick the next ..tried again ...sick ahain..too dark..in there what is going on

After driving by and seeing the line out the door the last week and a half or so, I figured it was time to try Raijin Ramen out. Finding a solid ramen option in town has been a bit of a challenge (aka I didn't previously have my spot yet). I ordered the red chile spicy ramen and it hit the spot (if I ever come back, I will surely order this). The egg was half-boiled (a good sign), and the broth was really flavorful.

Our particular server was friendly and accommodating, although when I initially called with a question, the manager (presumably) literally told me "I'm kind of busy right now, soooo..." Yikes. Not the best customer service on that end, but the server made up for honestly a bit of a rude exchange. The quality of the ramen itself is what earns this review--glad this place is here in Tucson.

A great home feel with friendly service and great pancakes. The sweet potato pancakes are packed with sweet potato and covered in cinnamon and powdered sugar. They are light, fluffy and cooked perfectly -- nothing worse than dense, over cooked pancakes. However, I am glad I went on a Friday morning with no line. I'm not sure I would have been as happy if I waited in the notorious long line on the weekends.
Love Cheu.  Always tasty, service is great.  I work nearby and come here for lunch frequently.  The dumplings are great.

Got the chicken sandwich and it was nothing great, that's what i get for getting a chicken sandwich at a pizza place. So i had some of my friends pizza and wings and they were pretty good. The pizza is well done, nice and crispy and the wings are very tasty.

I went here a few weeks ago so my memory is not perfect but I did want to register my overall very positive impression. Their raw P&J oysters put paid to my former assumption that large warm water gulf oysters are not good on the half shell. These were excellent and nary a bit of grit in sight. Drinks were great, or at least I recall that the French 75 was. Our waiter was terrific too. The Alsatian tart was a little unusual, kind of sweet, but nevertheless tasty and we did eat all of it. We ended up splitting drum for the fish and while it was indeed tasty, it was you typical NO fare with the dirty butter sauce. I would go back in order to try the other menu items and get more oysters and drinks.

I had no knowledge on what vehicle wrapping was. So I met up with Tony and he showed me a couple cars that he was working with at the time . Shortly after that I was sold on getting my car wrapped! Pew pew. A++
I LOVE THESE CANDLES!!!!! The scents are perfect and not too strong, They burn better than any candles ever. I am totally addicted to this store!
