I'm not much of a coffee drinker but my husband is and really enjoyed his Ethiopian blend coffee. He also bought a bag to go. Me? I got the hibiscus berry tea iced and it was really good- even without any sweetener.

My first beignet experience wasn't bad. Too much powdered sugar overwhelmed the wonderful beignet. We also ordered breakfast which was completely a different story. Everything other than the eggs you could tell had been sitting there for hours. The hashfries and grits were just cold and stale. Would not have breakfast here ever again.

This place used to be great.  I am guessing an owner or two ago. Their prices were great and their food was fantastic.  Now, they are just another sandwich place in South Philly.

My wife, daughter, and I have ordered there for years.  We would always get one of their little pizzas and a couple of sandwiches.  Unfortunately, they don't offer the pizzas anymore.  My 2 year old daughter loved their pizza, but since they don't offer it anymore we just order City Pizza all the time if she wants pizza...oh and they don't have pizza rolls anymore either!

The sandwiches also seem to have gone down in quality.  I always try something new, but each sandwich tasted like it was the same dry meat on bread combo.

Sorry Amato's, but until you go back to lower prices and higher quality, this guy is just going to support the other local joints!

I find it difficult to rate a chain, but this location is one of the closest to me, although not much a coffee drinker, I do visit more than the others.  I have never had a poor beverage from this location, and recently they started serving limited gluten free treats.  I spotted a wrapped 2pk of chocolate cookies in the case yesterday. The USA menu is coming up here, just slower than molasses.

They upgraded a while back and added power outlets. Handy in a pinch!

Yes, I definitely come back. And you should get a Starbucks card and the app for the perks. So easy to pay from my phone if I forget my wallet - heck even if I have my card or wallet. Gold stars! Earn beverage upgrades, and freebies. Nothing wrong with that.

Came here for birthday party down in the basement. Place is nice but very small. Gets packed quickly! Parking sucks. The basement is sweet tho. Feels like your hanging out at your friends basement in high school. The location is their key to their sucess but still your basic pub. The crab cake balls are good because they are lightly battered so it tasted like you  we're in Maryland.

These burgers were great - juicy and flavorful! My only major complaint was the amount of grilled onions and mushrooms I got - the smallest portion I've ever gotten/seen on a burger. I could barely taste them! The truffle fries were nothing special...I wouldn't get them again. But the prices are reasonable, the employees are nice and friendly, and the quality of the burgers is good.

I have had a craving for mexican food lately and someone mentioned this place, so we went for the first time tonight and I was very happy with my experience. 

I loved our server Mike, and I especially like the fact that when we mentioned to him it was our first time here, he told us he would bring out some samples for us to try. 

We ordered chips and queso, which were nice, but the salsa he brought was even better, my friend loved it. Then came the samples of pork marinated in tequila, and chicken with queso. The pork was incredible so we ordered that, also the fish tacos were amazing, and I liked how they cooked the fish. I also got the chimichangas with shredded chicken and I loved it.

All in all, the food was great, our server was awesome and the prices were very reasonable. The reason I did not give 5 stars was because I felt there should have been some sort of music playing outside, it was way too quiet.

Writing this post with a mouth full of pasta. Literally could not put the fork down until I let Yelp know how great this place was. I came here with a group of 7 and we each got a different pasta and a pizza. Every single dish was incredible. Amazing taste and great environment. Will definitely make this a weekly outing. Highly recommend!

Excellent service from the moment we arrived!  We traveled from San Antonio to Reno on a late flight with two children. When we arrived a young man named Mo assisted us. He could see exhaustion on my families faces. He was quick to get us checked in. He asked what brought us to Reno, and I explained we came to see Lake Tahoe. He was from Reno and was able to offer us ideas on where to swim at Lake Tahoe. And very informative of the area.   The room was nice and clean. Lots of dining options on site. The pools alone are worth five stars from yelp. 3 hot tubs and two pools enough to make adults and children happy. The only thing lacking is the children's arcade area. Many of the games were out of service. I feel like if a game is broken why leave it in the arcade area. Obviously minor complaint. I would recommend this place to family and friends and definitely come back.

For a cidery, this place has an astonishing lack of ... ciders. We popped in after hyping ourselves up for a delicious cider on our usual Thursday date night. We got a flight of all of their ciders (only 4) and decided there was only one of those we half liked and the rest we did not like at all and had to force down. I think we like dry ciders, not a lot of hops, with a hint of sweetness, but the ciders here were all too sweet, too hoppy, or just plain gross. Recommend going to Cinder if you want to try a bunch of ciders (though not all of theirs are locally brewed obviously since it's a cider/pizza bar, not a cidery).
My girlfriend and I were so high, we decided to eat here. Wasn't our first time, but we had the munchies bruh. Always a good experience eating here. Good weed, good fries, good burgers.
Overpriced, food just okay. Very small basket of chips and they charge for more...even if you buy the $4 queso and beef. Charges for sharing, too. Not impressed and won't return.

So I just moved to Philly from Los Angeles. And I was worried about the food scene. Why, with so many great bars and restaurants? Well, I don't eat meat. And I grew up in a city of a few hundred thousand people in the northeast that STILL has no vegetarian, not to mention vegan, restaurants. So all the gushing about cheesesteaks and German food was a little lost on me, especially after living in a place where vegan restaurants were super common, including a local CHAIN of completely plant-based, fast-casual food.

So I was really excited when I discovered Hip City veg was around the corner from my office. However, their menu isn't very extensive. Would it live up to the vegan food I was used to? YES. Absolutely. I believe their menu only contains about a dozen food items (excluding smoothies) because, having been in to pick up a to-go order, it's a very small place. That's fine, they do their food well. 

The first time I went I walked over, ordered, and had my food in less than 10 minutes. I got the Crispy Hip City Ranch and a side of caesar salad. The salad was not that special. I've actually had better vegan caesar dressing and I thought the choice of adding jicama was an odd one. But the crispy plantains, which stood in for a cruton, or even crispy bacon, were delicious. The chicken ranch sandwich? AMAZING. The "chicken" had a super crispy batter, and was hot, and JUICY. I thought just veggies and ranch on top would be kind of blah, but their peppercorn ranch dressing was one of the best ranch dressings I've had.

After picking it up, I came back to my building to see a Hip City Veg delivery guy (on a bike) bringing food to another floor. So I tried delivery today. I called during the lunch rush and they said it would be an hour, but it only took 40 minutes. I tried the Ziggy burger, which is a soy patty, pickles, lettuce, tomato, onions and tempeh "bacon" with special sauce. It definitely satisfied my burger craving, without the guilt. :) I also tried the sweet potato fries. I was skeptical about the black bean cilantro sauce that they come with, but it was delicious. It was thin like a dressing, not like a black bean dip, and the black beans make it kind of creamy, while the cilantro adds a nice fresh flavor. Perfect with the sweet taste of the fries. 

I will definitely be getting lunch from here regularly!

For as cheap as it is, it's good enough. The locker rooms are surprisingly clean, and I've never had to wait for a machine, even at peak hours. But I absolutely agree with all of the comments about the staff. They could at least pretend to not hate their lives. Also, kudos for being open during all of the snowstorms this year.

Well...there was a devil that was placed in front of us this morning. We pulled into the spot that clearly says cafe only...that's seem very straight forward...the devil came up to us shouting we can't park there politely we tried to explain... Instead she was rude obnoxious and some other words I refuse to say...upon checking the reviews before putting in my two cents worth 98% had the same encounter so sincerely she must be bi-polar...nasty in the morning nice in the evening or maybe just nasty all the time....the devil face should be where that star is

If you're looking for a late night snack/pizza joint, look no further! Axis is the perfect place to stop by after a night of going out or hanging out. Being one of the very few restaurants that open late nearby Penn's campus, Axis is a solid choice. Even better, they open AND deliver 24/7.

However, don't expect much from the quality of their food. My friends and I ordered a medium pizza and an order of mozzarella sticks. The pizza was bland and all the topping fells off after taking the slice. The mozzarella sticks were hard and cheese definitely did not melt in your mouth as you would expect them to. 

Despite this, Axis is such a great option, or probably the only option that actually delivers late nights! But due to it's convenient location within the UCity area, I'll give it another try!

One of the best, if not THE best, food truck in West Philly. 

All of their sandwiches are really, really good - filling, tasty, and cheap. I'm a huge fan of the Mr. Bui and the Mrs. Bui, and get them with Bui's sauce - some sort of sriracha mayo thing, but it makes everything better. Everything else on their menu is great too, and you can get the staples like a BLT/egg sandwich/cheesesteak too. They also have Orangina sometimes as a beverage item, and who doesn't like that?

Mr & Mrs Bui are really friendly too, and once you've been there a few times, they start to remember your order. You can also call or text in your order for pick up which is really convenient if you're in a rush and want something quick to eat.

We had a great time at Baileys' Range tonight. Bradley was our server and he was a delight, we can't wait to go back and visit him! I would recommend the Big Popper burger and "horsey mayo" to everyone.
We had a wonderful experience sending my daughter and 7 of her friends to the Military Ball. The customer communication and service was top notch.  Thank you for helping make such great memories.

To be honest I really struggle with this brewery. I love multiple levels of their establishment, but the beer is not one of them. And let's face it, it's a brewery. Isn't that kind of important? 

Let's start with the heart eyes emoji provoking assets. Their food is great. Their fried chicken sandwich melts in your mouth (I didn't order this but I always get a taste of my buddies palate ). Their bao buns were not the best I've ever had, but still tasty. I actually prefer mine more on the airy, fluffy side, but they choose to sear theirs so it's a little crispy on the outside. I'd also prefer. More crisp than fatty piece of belly inside but hey look who's being contradictory now (make up ya mind, Tone). Anyways, I was surprised at how much I loved the fried rice in my salmon taco. I actually enjoyed a few forkfuls on its own throughout the course. But even still, almost all of the portions are a little small for the price. Quality is important though here, and I feel they nail it. 

The atmosphere is definitely another pro. If you don't like noise, go away. People are having fun and drinking merrily. It's gonna be loud. So talk a little louder, look at your guests when they speak, and laugh at the kids next to you trying to steal their dad's wings. I'm Italian. I'm loud. I love noise. It makes me feel at home. So the tremendously open layout of this building is much preferred over their cafe location. 

So the con here. Guys. Whyyy are your saisons sour? No where else do I experience this, and saisons are my favorites. And guess what.. I hate sours. Don't get me wrong, I've had a few of their beers that I have really enjoyed, but overall I think this place is over hyped. My thought is they just try to get too eccentric, and just get a little nutty with their concoctions. Like I said, I don't hate it, but I rarely love it. I'll still keep going though. The atmosphere, food, and occasional slam dunk brew still reels me in.

Heck yeah, international gift items for a decent price. I'm all about that, since I'm usually confused as to what to get people around the holiday season... And that's just around the corner.

Their large variety of gift items (or decorative, if you're into decorating your home with international items) are apparently fair-trade bought. So that should appease the conscientious consumer.

I was in there for only a short amount of time, so I'll head back with the intention of buying something from one of their friendly, dedicated staff members.

Didn't think it was as impressive as the pictures made it out to be. I ordered the the Buffalo Crispy Hipcity Ranch. Felt like it was only a step above Boca. Not bad but not worth $10. The restaurant is very small and cramped and the seating was obnoxious. The line was backed up out the door but they were very quick and efficient.

Yummy tacos. Not sure if they got my order wrong, but my pork and chicken tacos looked and tasted the same. They tasted very good! The Sonaran dog was decent, kinda soggy by the time we got it. The food came out at different times and it was hard to hear them calling names. But it was a good find.

While I previously gave this location a 5 star review, the new manager and new policies leave me looking for a new gym.  The new manager is not a very nice person, she has a terrible attitude, and she is very demeaning to customers for no reason other than self-absorption.  She refuses to admit that she or any of her employees could be at fault for anything and deflects blame on the customers, which is a terrible policy.  Other employees seem to follow suit with similar attitudes and lack of customer respect.  While the equipment is good, clean, and works well, I would look somewhere else if you want to find a gym to join just because of the staff and manager.  You will feel very unwelcome here as practically a second class citizen in the eyes of the staff and management.

I was here with a friend of mine. I ordered mixed vegetables curry and pickle, and my friend ordered chicken biryani. The portion of food served was very small when compared to the price. I have eaten better quality Indian food at better price. The food had a lot of oil but it tasted good overall. The pickle was charged additionally (unlike other Indian restaurants that serve Indian pickles as complimentary). The server did not know about Indian food or about the items on the menu but he got another person to respond to my queries.

Great spot for breakfast! I was being economical so I got the $4 hook up two eggs, challah toast potato latke and coffee  It was good and the homemade blueberry jam made it! My friend got a breakfast quesadilla which was amazing and a huge portion with fresh re fried beans and pico de gallo.  The service was friendly and nice.  DEf. a bit of a hipster scene but tolerable:)  I love this little neighborhood for food.

The lunch menu looks great as well and I will be sure to return to check it out.  Keep in mind it is cash only!

I am completely unimpressed. For starters we ordered the smoked onion rings which turned out to be overly breaded grease sponges that both my wife and I found to be inedible. Next our burgers arrived and I was little surprised at the tiny morsel that was brought to me. As big around as a coffee cup and on a soggy bun. It was cooked well but come on, $11? Really? 
I think the concept of this place is good and the menu of items is interesting enough but the execution is lacking. The dining area seemed a little dingy and not very clean with a lack of attention to detail like the big chip out of my salad bowl, the wilting flowers on our table and exposed bus tubs at the entrance.
On a positive note, the cucumber boozy lemonade($9?,wow) was pretty darn good.
One of my favorite coffee stops! The ladies are always friendly and helpful. They make THE BEST almond milk white mocha!
Reno needs more restaurants like Bab Cafe. It's clean, hip and most importantly, delicious.
Delicious, delicious, delicious. A mix of unique ingredients and flavors is to die for. Fresh plates. Smaller size dishes, but very filling. Colorful. I loved it! I will be going back a lot!
Tasty pitas, and the small Greek salads are a good portion. They do nickel and dime a bit when it comes to pita add ons, but otherwise, very good.

this ice cream is unbelievably good.  made fresh while you watch   $6.50 includes as many toppings as you want.  So far strawberry lady, monkey business and chocolate chip cookie dough are our favorite !!

My highest compliments. 
I am from California, where amazing mexican food is rampant... This is the first mexican restaurant Ive been to outside of the bordering states that had really good, traditional food. I had the most SPECTACULAR cactus burrito... Their menu is large, their salsas are hot and flavorful, and the prices are awesome! Keep it up, you have a fan for life!

I'm too old to give you five stars......   hahhhahha
as we approached the upstairs pool area we waited for some other older folks to exit so we didn't upset the balance of youth and tres chic.

and I'm not trying to be snarky, I just have a sense of humor.   however spending ten dollars a drink on a teeny drank on the roof wasn't that impressive.    this place will take a bite out of your wallet.    while I like the overall idea, I feel like I'm back home in the city I left for a reason.   yes, I'm from portland.   but this is new orleans.   while stumptown coffee is good, I have a hard time not seeing this as a form of gentrification that only those NOT from here can really savor...

I did see a recent show here / female drag, and that was spectacular.   I didn't have any drinks tho, and I didn't see anyone serving any.   I didn't feel like stepping out of this venue to find the bar...  I was mesmerized by the performer.   this place is beautiful, and I can appreciate the open mindedness of freedom of expression in your hiring practices.    I haven't eaten here yet, but I will.   I look forward to seeing how you handle mardigras next year as friends of ours will be staying with you.   
 
a suite / with guitar / 30 year wedding anniversary.

other than my self expression of my age, I congratulate you on your opening.  please know that setting drinks on a drum in the bar area?  is considered really bad luck.    can you find a place for the drum where she can be more appreciated?   thanks.

Meh is right.  I went here with a group of 5/6 people and we were all pretty disappointed.  First, the service is slow and took us to our patience threshold.  Second, the food is poor.  The fried rice was barely edible and each person decided they couldn't stand to finish eating their food.  I would say go somewhere else.  The only reason it gets 2 stars is for the price (which is as cheap as it gets).

To be honest, I don't "get" the whole Sephora thing. Shopping at a department store makeup counter can be awkward with the salesperson staring at you, but if you go to Sephora when it's not busy it's just as bad (or worse) with employees asking if you "need help" every 15 seconds. It can be as bad as Lush (which I wouldn't go into if you paid me for this reason). Honestly not sure if they think I'm a shoplifter or somehow think harassing customers while they're trying to shop increases sales. I'll stick with Macy's when I'm in center city.
Went on a Monday night as to avoid huge weekend crowds. The meatloaf was amazing. Everywhere my boyfriend and I go now, we always compare the Meatloaf to Jones'.
The Crab Omelet on the local favorites was delectable. The shrimp & Grits had a kick but worth the wait!

This place is amazing! I always get the herb roasted chicken, collard greens and black eyed peas! The chicken falls off the bone and is so tasteful!!! I come from a small hometown in Florida, I moved to Saint Pete over a year ago and this is by far the best southern cooked meal, I'm a white woman that loves some soul food! Not to mention this nice Saturday afternoon, there's live music along with great service!

I love idea of this place. So nicely decorated and themed, but it is sooo over priced in my opinion. 12.50 for a slice of cake and most of the drinks start at 11+ dollars. The cake is pretty good, some better than others. Overall taste from the ones I've tried I'd would give 7/10, but maybe I just had higher expectations due to price. 

However there is nothing else quite like It when you are celebrating something special. When we came it was very hot outside so we sat inside, it was just as hot if not hotter. Not sure if they have a/c there or not but to spend that kind of $$ and be uncomfortable was a bit disappointing, and had to cut my date with my friend short due to it.

The drinks are as tasty as they look/sound but again with what you get for for the price? 5/10

I love this Morning Call. I was so happy when I heard they were keeping this location open. My routine as of late is to come here for a nightcap after a fun night out on the town. Nothing else quite hits the spot like hot beignets and a cafe au lait. I love these beignets in particular because they are so fluffy and have those lovely air pockets when you bite into them. 

I enjoy the nostalgia of Morning Call and if you forget how long they have been around just look at their cash register because George Washington could have used it by the looks of it. 

No matter what time of day or night it is, its always hustling and bustling with customers. Its loud and its perfect.
I've gone to Calvin's shop twice now. He's always very fair and explains the process well. I am very pleased with the work they've done and would definitely recommend them.

Very happy with Dr. Ecker.  He spends time with me and explains everything.  Definitely not a turnstile doctor.  Always understanding and compassionate.   Sometimes people have to wait, but it is worth it. Wouldn't go anyplace else.

This place ROCKS!  Since my teen years (Doesnt matter how long ago that was!!) It's a MUST STOP for me & my family! 

Peanut Butter Cup PLEASE!!!  mmmmmmmmmmmMMMMM

The summer months are the most fun, but any time they are open - it's a great time!  
When the sun is beating down & you just cant stand the HEAT?  Just pull into the Frosty Boy & have a special TREAT!  haha 

Now that I'm living in California I still crave it.  I get text messages and photos from family whenever they are there - MEAN!!  haha 

You can bet I stop in EVERY single time I'm home in Indy! 

 I HEART YOU, Frosty Boy!  I HEART YOU!

I had family in town and thought we could give it a try for the first time. The wait time is about 30 -45 minutes but it went by fast. I'm so glad I did! The food was delicious and the server was very nice and professional. I definitely will be going back soon!
Completely sketchy. They closed the bar at 6:45pm on a Saturday night "for 30 minutes" while the staff laughed and hung out.

Love the service, love the food. There is a reason why this is the only establishment that has been able to stay open in this location. We only ever do take out, but the restaurant is impeccably clean every time we walk in there.
I like their food. The soy milk is my favor drink and sushi too. Will back again. .......

HORRIBLE...To say they forgot our order is an understatement, took over an hour +++ CRAZY...fries looked gross and tasted worse...Waitress did not know her job and was INATTENTIVE!!!!...12 Jan 2017 update...When you have to go to the bar to get a drink that is BAD !!!   Pricey for a burger joint...Seems like the owners do not care that a party of 4 couples will never go back again!!!!

Even though I also have two dogs and a wonderful general veterinarian, I take our cat specifically to St. Louis Cat Clinic. The reviews by Rhonda S. and Saskia S. are 100% accurate. The doctors at SLCC are wonderful wonderful wonderful. 

I've had three of our cats as patients here and can't dream of taking them anywhere else. The staff is so friendly and help to calm down our Mickey once we arrive after his traumatic car ride. (NOT a fan of the car.) 

The care and individual attention is always topnotch. You will never feel as though your cat is "just another" chart and patient for them to deal with. 

Another great perk? There are resident-house cats that are always there roaming the lobby and halls. T-Rex has become our little friend and now any time I go to pick up food, my BF comes along just to get in his face time with Mr. T-Rex. Loves him!

My husband and I had a late lunch/early dinner at ML Rose the other day. I'd never been to the West location, and I have to say, it's great! Easy to get to off the freeway and lots of available parking. It's much easier to find seating inside too than the original location, probably because it's larger. 

You cannot beat the beer selection they offer. It's just hands down one of the best available in Nashville. I tried my first Sour Beer here on this visit, and after looking around online, found it was one of the more popular ones on the "beer market" :) right now. So glad they had it because I am in love!

We both enjoyed burgers for dinner; I had the five alarm which is the perfect blend of spicy and cheesy and juicy, and my husband had the bacon cheeseburger. I upgraded to the sweet potato fries - holy crap! They were crispy and sweet, and our server was awesome enough to bring me a side of the Carolina BBQ sauce for dipping (this was so good - do it!).

We'll be back to this location for sure. Love ML Rose!

I find that the negative reviews for Essene are quite unfair and so feel compelled to write my own review. If you are coming here to buy items like cauliflower and pizza, then you appear to have a flawed understanding of why Essene is a valuable place. Don't come here to buy things that you can get elsewhere. Come here to buy the things that you can't get just anywhere --- like local raw honey, Fresh Wave candles, those magnificent raw vegan chocolate tarts, a wide selection of lunch containers and non-toxic food storage items, and organic unbleached lady care products (to name just a few things that I like). Even Whole Foods doesn't sell local, raw honey. I find some of the prices to be quite reasonable, actually, or at least just the same that they are everywhere else. If I have the choice of buying an item at Essene or WF, I will pick Essene any day of the week. And I , for one, find the vibe and atmosphere to be quite friendly. Perfect lighting. Amicable cashiers that aren't trained to be hokey and irritating a la WF. 

Quite frankly, if you're going to complain about the price of cauliflower, just go buy it somewhere else. And if you're looking to buy pizza at a health food store, then you have delusions about what health food is and probably shouldn't even be there. I'm so fed up of all of the nice businesses that I like getting closed down because most Philadelphians are average people with bad taste, and it's becoming clear to me that I need to support the businesses that add value to my life. So that's why I wrote this review, because Essene is great, and I'm happy that it's there!

great pastries and a super delicious (but not low fat) number of breakfast selections are always available at this great little spot located in a failing strip mall just outside of downtown reno. the el jefe, stuffed with homemade chorizo is delicious, the scones and bear claws are excellent, the coffee is good and the service and overall vibe is welcoming. support this place! high quality and not a slot machine in sight!
We love this place and have been going since they opened. The prices have increased and the size of the dishes have decreased but the food remains fresh and delightful.

Excellent coffee. Really, really excellent coffee. The latte had a nuanced flavor that you will never get at a Starbucks--or any other place that roasts their beans until they are charred.  Interesting owner who is extremely knowledgeable about coffee.  Rather nontraditional storefront. If you need your coffee to go, bring your own cup, but I suggest you stay awhile.

Best bang for your buck!  I was eating at the cart before I realized they had an actual brick and mortar establishment.  Both are great.  For a couple of bucks you get a fresh-made burrito with as little as rice and beans and as much as salsa, guacamole, tofu, plantains, whatever.  I'm a vegetarian, so I didn't notice the meat options, but I'm sure there are some.  This is my new go-to place for lunch!

This place is incredible.  Reminds me of some of the markets in Chicago, just a little nicer. It's a true market. They are a butcher shop, Deli, Bakery, Cheese Monger, Wine depot, grocery store, coffee shop, and restaurant, all really under 1 roof. And we're talking the real deal here. Tons of San Marzano tomatoes, gobs of dried sausage sandwich, and exotic cheeses. Home made gnocchi, Gorgonzola Pillows, Killer breads, and pastries. Gelato, espresso. Pre made entree dishes, fresh and frozen. Salads and sardines, shrimp, clams , and mussels. Olive Oils, and other condiments galore. I was in heaven. I highly recommend this as a great place to visit, and spend some time, and a little money. And I must say the deli and prepared stuff was extremely fairly priced. Really all of it wasn't bad for the quality of what you're getting. I wish I took more pictures, but I'll be back again for sure.
Great bar!  Great beers! Ashley the bartender was awesome!!! She was very helpful. The banana bread pudding was ok.
This place is everything. I would definitely recommend the banana foster French toast and the corned beef breakfast. Simply Amazing !! Will definitely go back.

I was hoping that the restaurant that replaced Copeland's in this space would be a regular in my rotation of Westbank restaurants. I left extremely disappointed after being overcharged for jambalaya that resembled Zatarain's boxed mix and a gumbo that was underwhelming in flavor. Maybe I went too early, maybe I went on a bad day, but I will not be back until the menu prices drop.

I am a local renter in the Santa Barbara market and have had an extremely difficult time dealing with this company. They posted incorrect photos of a property I was interested in displaying a beautiful one bedroom when in fact it was a dingy studio. They also seem to price rentals much higher per square foot which in this current market is $2.50-$3/sq. foot. add an additional $100 per person to a rental prior to advertising that online. They also do not allow one to fill out one application to have credit pulled once allowing that person to apply for multiple listings. Come on people work smarter not harder.

Ok, this place is amazing.  Beyond the unsuspecting strip mall is this whimsical, serene sanctuary with a Parisian flair.  I mean, the decor looks like something that would have it's own show on HGTV.  So, right away you start to relax.  Then you've got amazing staff, from the front desk to the aestheticians.  

I went one time to try it out and accidentally on purpose bought the monthly massage membership.  It's worth it.

You get into your comfy robe, grab a handful of chocolates and head to the relaxation room where you are treated to either in infused water, hot tea or wine (you guessed it... I usually have the wine).  Then, you're whisked away to one of those magical rooms for whatever treatment you...well... treated yourself to.  After your massage is over (you wish it wasn't), you can take a shower and try out some of their sample products.  Then, you step back out into the real world feeling totally refreshed.

You'll love it, I promise.

What a stunning restaurant, in every aspect - interior, food, staff. The hubby and I found ourselves with a spur of the moment kid-free date night and, upon the recommendation of a friend, decided to make a Coolinary reservation for Carrollton Market. 

It didn't disappoint, and I'm still dreaming of the calamari appetizer. Dinner was great. Dessert was amazing too, which was surprising only because I find that dessert is such an after-thought, especially on the limited Coolinary menus at most other participating restaurants. The pot au chocolate with the mini beignets? Fantastic.

Drink menu was on point. I need to return for happy hour to try some cocktails, but we did enjoy some wine and a house-made liquor with our meal. 

This is definitely worth a repeat visit.

As you enter Petra, you immediately know you aren't in Kansas anymore.  The Arabic music, the workers in head coverings, the aromatic foods, all whisk you into another culture.  I ordered the sampler plate off the appetizer menu.  It was a full meal.  The stuffed grape leaves were delicious with the right balance of lemon juice & rice, but they were very oily.  The kibbe was the star of the plate with its cinnamon & perhaps nutmeg spiced beef.  The falafels were probably the low point of the plate.  The falafels were heavily fried & had little taste.  I've had superior falafel almost anywhere else.  The plate came with large scoops of labneh, baba ganoush, & hummus.  All three tasted very good.  In fact the baba ganoush had a nice subtle smoky flavor  that was very appealing.  My wife ordered the chicken schwaarma which I helped her eat.  We thought it was very tasty.  The waitress we had was excellent.  The music however was not so good.  It was blaring out of ancient ceiling speakers which were low quality & seemed to be torn.  The music was tinny & would get full of static & the volume would fade then increase.  So I give this place a mixed review.  It was authentic but the food was above average to below average..

I love this place!  It's got a great, comfortable atmosphere with tons of adorable decor that keeps my baby entertained each time we visit.  The owners are awesome, Kaylen is so nice and I can tell she truly loves her job.  Now for the food.  The hardest part is remembering everything I've tried since the list is pretty long!  The homemade pop tarts are delicious - I believe I had blackberry?  The pastry is perfectly flaky and the filling had a nice, tart punch to it.  The blondies ROCK!  Moist and dense with plenty of white chocolate, just the way I like 'em.  I hope to try the potato chip blondie if I can get my hands on one next time.   The apple cheddar scone is probably one of the most popular items on their menu and I understand why, it's delicious!  The ice pops are great too - I've had the strawberry basil and plum ginger.  And finally, they also sell Mila Sweets macarons.  These little bite-sized wonders are a fabulous treat.  There is always a new flavor to try and they come packaged in cute little boxes, also perfect for a foodie gift.  The best part about this bakery is they are always trying something new - I read on their fb page today that they are now making a popcorn cookie!  Can't wait to go back to give it a try!  Thank you Whisk!
Had the best fettuccine alfredo ever. Waiter said they cut the noodles and make the sauce to order! Amazing!

It's a bit cluttered but I usually go into used bookstores with an open mind.  Things are at least in the right sections, alphabetized unlike some chains (I'm looking at you, Border's in Springfield).  I perused the shelves, I didn't get to go upstairs, apparently, I was looking for a self help book....who knew?  It was a fairly decent price for a book that had never been cracked open.  I like the atmosphere and the charm, I'm glad it never really lost that from it's original location.

Good, fast, consistent and fairly priced. That's all I ask! I usually get one of the burgers, which are good. On the last visit I got a chicken sandwich, made Chik-Fil-A style with just pickles. It was delicious and rivaled Chick-Fil-A. Smash sweet potato fries were yummy. I also tried the Nutty Butty shake. It was too sweet. I've had their other flavors of shakes and it was better. Great place to come for a fast lunch.
Most people come for the Chicago style pizza but they're missing out, the Wrigley Dog is fantastic! Totally worth the calories;)

We were back last night for the second time: as with the first, it was a splendid dinner experience. Style, quality, presentation: everything sets this restaurant apart. It is a welcome addition to the Santa Barbara food scene. I do like the simple, unassuming atmosphere.
Finally a restaurant that will change its menu once a month!!

Breakfast this morning. I'm serious about breakfast and this is as good as it gets. the decor put me off a bit when I came in, thinking its was going to be a place that had to do things out of the box and trendy. I was way wrong. Had the Roundabout breakfast, which is your standard two eggs, meat, potatoes and toast, except it wasn't standard. The attention to detail made this exceptional. I'm a sausage snob and the pork links were perfectly cooked and had a great subtle flavor. Eggs and potatoes were great, too and I found it amusing that the chef is so proud of his flavors that he won't put salt and pepper on the table. At this point I'm going to go out of the box with something that should be on the menu. I asked them to substitute a couple of the granola pancakes for the toast. Wow, dessert with breakfast! Again nothing over the top, just quality with some subtle extra touches. Can't wait for tomorrow so I can try the Donut Bread Pudding French Toast!

Horrible service. There was no sense of urgency at any time. Brought out one of the worst omelets I have ever had. They put unsanitary ketchup packets on top of the food when they brought it out. There was never a question about if I needed anything. The food was just dropped off without a word. Unless your layover is longer than an hour don't stop here.

This was probably my 8th time to eat here for breakfast in the last 5 weeks due to limited options in the airport. While it is always slow it is usually better than this.

The servers & managers are honestly the nicest people ever. Mr. Lee and Miss Kelly are the cutest and friendliest workers ever as well! They just speak really loudly, which gives the impression that they're rude...but that's how a lot of Vietnamese people speak! 

Service: A lot of people complain about the service, but do keep in mind that they are very understaffed. It is extremely difficult to both cook and serve at the same time, especially on busy days. They really do try their best! Pho takes HOURS to prepare and the broth takes a lot of work to maintain-- this goes for most Vietnamese food. Cut them some slack. They even offer free samples! And the other workers are extremely sweet as well.

As for the food: my boyfriend and I love their beef fried rice. It's simple and yummy. Their pho is delicious on cold, SB days when you're too lazy to go out (and of course...they're the best cure for your IV hangovers). I also love love love their coffee milk tea!!! Their banh mi isn't how they're traditionally made in most SoCal places (cold cut meat, veggies, etc) but their beef banh mi is still really really good!

Clean store.  Plenty of choices.  

Our first trip to an Indian store.  Bought a variety of ready-mix spice packets/boxes, frozen veggie that you can't find in American market, frozen meal, seasoned naan bread , herbal shampoo $5.  It was overwhelming because there are so many choices.  

The store has been there for about 20 years. Current owner has been there for about 8 years. Store sits in a plaza that is visible to passing traffic.

Surprisingly good food -- creative menu with options for just about everyone.  If you need a big, interesting burger -- try the Ultimate Cure.  This burger is two patties connected by a grilled bacon and cheese burger on texas toast.  This burger is giant when they bring it to you -- your eyes will say WOW!  I would also recommend the Run Chicken Run sandwich -- thinly sliced chicken breast with cheese, lettuce and green tomatoes.  The amount of avocado that is placed on this sandwich is awesome!  These items can be served with their homemade kettle chips (highly recommended) or you can substitute sweet potato fries (also very good!)  It is a bar -- so it can be loud and crazy -- but the food was definitely worth it -- and priced well for its location.  Definitely try this place!

I don't get why this place is so popular. I have been here three times and will never go back. The food is nowhere near as good as some other options in town (Athens, Blue Fig or even Fattoush Cafe) and the service I've received has always been sub-par.

When I first went to Kalamata's I was surprised at how it worked. You go in, order at a counter and then get your own plastic silverware and napkins and pick a seat. The food is served on styrofoam plates and your drinks are served in styrofoam. This seems like laziness on the restaurant's part. There are no real waiters to speak of so if something is wrong, you have to take it back to the counter--where I've had to wait in line just to get a wrong order fixed.

The food itself is okay. I'm not blown away by anything I've had on their menu. A couple of times I've ordered the hummus with pita bread, which is a big mistake. The hummus tastes about as fresh as the Athenos stuff in the supermarket and the pita bread is served cold. Why? It takes so little time to heat up pita bread. Yet another problem that just seems like laziness on the restaurant's part.

Ultimately,  my biggest problem with Kalamata's is the fact that I can get the same meal on plates with real silverware and receive actual service at a couple other restaurants in Nashville for the same price. I think that for my dollar here I should have gotten a lot more than I did.

This is the original location for Outback so it is typically busier than the others. I ordered the Outback special sirloin medium rare with salad an asparagus. The steak came out cooked exactly how I ordered it. The server was friendly and quick with my drink refills. Overall a good value at $11.99 for that steak. My only complaint is the crowd gets noisy but no too bad.

The place to visit for fudge! Remember to stop here at the changeover of seasons for best pricing on clothing, footwear and sporting goods. The prices are higher reflecting the better quality items. But save your money to buy winter coats before their sping stock is shelved or summer gear before the Christmas stock is displayed. Save a ton of money by shopping on Monday evenings and not during the weekends.

I'm a big beef noodle soup lover. The soup base at Hakka is authentic. If you are looking for the best beef noodle soup in philly, Hakka is a must try.

Side dishes are great and they are great matches for the beef noodle soup. Highly recommend!

Cute, tasty, and maybe one of the best blueberry muffins I've had in years! This place was rated #3 in the top 10 places for sweets in the New Orleans area!

Right across the way from our Saturday farmers market, it was the perfect place to stop before heading back home. There were a number of visual-pleasing treats in the case and plenty of tables and chairs to stay and enjoy a handmade coffee made by the friendly baristas. 

I'm telling you- best blueberry muffin ever!

New Vietnamese restaurant has opened up near my place so decided to check it out on a Saturday night. 
I ordered the Thien An Noodle Soup special.
Very flavourful and generous portion given. 
My girlfriend ordered the Chicken Curry and it was splendid as well. 

Nothing but good things to say about this place. Taste much better than Pho Boy (another place that just open up).

Pancake Pantry is one of those restaurants that your family considers its own. The one you know you'll be eating at on vacation, every time you visit that city/town. The kind of homey, nostalgic place that you elevate to greatness in your mind and speak of with reverence.

The fluffy pancakes, in what seem to be a gazillion forms, are the main attraction. I love the blueberry variety with its warm, fruit compote. I'm also a fan of a Frankenstein creation which involves breakfast potatoes (not hashed browns), veggies, multiple cheeses, ham (which I sub for mushrooms), and two eggs. A meal that lasts most of the day into early evening. My mom's new obsession is the banana walnut cakes which she says taste like banana bread in pancake shape.

Prices are reasonable for the large portion size and service is very prompt. They want to get you in and out with a smile so the line can keep moving right up until their afternoon closing time. I've never left hungry and never needed to have to much after a breakfast here.

Having said that, the Pantry (we use one name after all these years) isn't perfect. Parking in Hillsboro Village is challenging - it's right in the middle of a busy hub of shops, restaurants, hospitals, and Vanderbilt. The wait can be obnoxious - on this last trip we stood (yes, stood, they do it old school here) in line for over an hour on a Friday at 11 am. However, neither of these things has ever deterred us from going. It must be love!

I'm sorry there are so many bad reviews for this place, because my experience was just fine.  But there may be a disclaimer, I came on a very rainy day and we were practically the only customers, so there was plenty of clean seating and service was nice and fast!  I ordered the ginger chicken and broccoli with brown rice.  The rice was very plain but I thought the ginger sauce was yummy and the broccoli was very good.  Nice huge crispy chunks.  The chicken was also tender and well made.  Not tough or chewy or any mystery bites like you get at sketchy Chinese places.  I used the red pepper spicy sauce that they provide at the condiment counter, I love that stuff, gave my food a nice kick.  I went in not expecting much considering the whole Chinese chain ordeal, but I had a good experience.  Fast service and hot yummy food.

I really like this bakery! Everything they have is awesome, no matter what you buy is delicious and fresh.I go there for years and never had bad experience. Everybody is nice and polite. The prices are reasonable for the goodies they have,if you really know how the homemade food and desserts supposed to taste like this is the right place to go,  trust me you won't find any better bakery in north east Philadelphia.Even with the bad economy and prices going up everywhere else they try to do their best to keep the quality high and prices low for the customers.
The food is good and cheap but the customer service needs some BIG improvements.
it's a mediocre bar with HORRIBLE SERVICE.   the venue is great... if they would hire non-coked-out bouncers and bartenders that actually cared about tips... it could be a great place!

Another self serve frozen yogurt place.  Pretty standard in terms of available flavors and toppings only this place has a sports bend to it.  Kinda weird for a yogurt joint but any reason to decorate in blue and white to support the hometown team always goes over big.

Had a Philly Cheese steak mid week, thinking it was going to be yummy. Instead, it was flavorless and dry. And also EXPENSIVE! The quality was not good. The bread was basic white and no seasoning on the meat gave it a bland taste. I am definitely not coming back.

My problem with this place might sound stupid but I just can't get past it. The sandwiches, fries, drinks and service are all as good as they should be. My problem is with how things are served. 
The sandwiches are served on the cheapest smallest paper plates possible. They are just a tiny bit larger than the sandwiches. The plates are like ones you would pick up at a dollar store to serve birthday cake when you didn't have time to go to a real store. The napkins are cheaper than you can imagine. Tissues would almost be better. You are eating a wet sloppy sandwich and these things matter. I used no less than 8 of these tear away napkins when eating the sandwich. If the napkins were just as good as the ones at McDonalds I would have only needed two. This can't be saving them money. I'm not asking for fine china and linen. The sandwich would be better served in a basket with a piece of waxed paper. This has just bothered me. It has been about 10 years between my visits because of this. Again, I realize this is stupid but it just really bothers me and it is an easy fix.

Sushi Sho Rexley is hands down, without a doubt, the best sushi in Tampa Bay! We were absolutely blown away. If you are Americanized, don't come. No spicy mayo, no Mexican rolls, no California roll, nothing fried. If you want fried sushi, Hooks is up 9th street. 

Get the chefs grand tasting & saki pairing. Let Rexley put on a hell of a show that you'll never forget. I've never seen so many exotic fish & saki from around the world, from Spain to New Zealand, it's simply magical. 

I hesitated writing this because the first 3 times I couldn't even get in... but as a local foodie & with respect to Rexley, I needed to share this. The bay areas best kept secret, for now

August 17, 2013 Saturday - dinner 05:45 PM
2 adults 

Atmosphere - 5 star
Food - 5 stars
Service - 5 stars

Background - Finished herding the cats, okay my friends after the afternoon wine walk.

Atmosphere - Sat on the patio, old sidewalk around their restaurant.  It was fun watching the people come from the parking garage elevator.

Food
  Appetizer - none.

  Drinks - Strange but I only ordered water.  What a shame, they have great beer.  But after walking around the afternoon I was parched.  Our waitress was good at bringing the water every ten or so, I was jugging it.

  My Main Course - The Sante Fa, a chicken sandwich.  It had avocado so I had to go for it.  Loved the pasilla pepper on top of the chicken, it was grilled to add the smoke taste.  They also added smoked mozzarella for more smoke.  Great sandwich

  Dessert - Skipped it.

Service - She was there with the water, what I needed.  Great service and she was very helpful when one of the ladies in our party did not like their meal.

Future - Been here before, doubt I will stop now.

Dropped in while traveling from Nashville back to Chicago. Owner and staff could not have been more helpful and were a real pleasure to talk to.

2nd best Cuban sandwich we have had, which for us speaks very highly. The meal complimented well with the Cuban cafe con leche and we were even happier we splurged on the fried bananas.

Treat yourself to something different and if you are new to Cuban food, don't be afraid to ask the staff.

I am so happy to have found this place. I need to take my bedsheets, blankets, top spread etc. to a Laundromat every so often. I've gone to several in my area and not had much luck. Either icky dirty or no chairs or just creepy people wandering about.

I happened to have passed this place and decided to take my stuff in this morning. I got a really good feeling about WW.

To start off, the place is clean. People looked very normal and pleasant. Nice big washers and dryers, and a place to sit down and have a Coke. There was a young lady there who was behind the counter. This is my new place to go when I need those big washer/driers.

We are so lucky and spoiled to have an awesome Children's Museum in Indy.  Sometimes I take it for granted, but this is an awesome place for children (and adults!) of all ages.  They have a nice amount of rotating exhibits to mix it up so that you and your kids don't get bored.

I bring my one year old niece here and she can find things that are fun for her.  They playscape room for babies and toddlers is great because they can play and explore in a safe place away from older kids.  She loves playing in the sand and making music.  I have a good time here too because most of the exhibits are interesting for kids and adults.

Come the first Thursday of the month between 4-8 and get your tickets for 5 bucks!  It's pretty busy, but worth it due to the drastically reduced cost!

I've been going to Mo for over 2 years now and he is the greatest. His haircuts are always on point and his shop has always been one of the nicest I've seen and has only gotten better over time. He really cares about what he does and cares about his customers and the experience they get when coming into his shop. He really makes you feel like a part of the family. If your looking for a new shop with great people, great conversation and great haircuts than you should definitely check out Casablanca. You won't be disappointed.

Simply put, the Customer Service offered at the Edmonton Southside location lacks professionalism and respect. I will never go back nor will I ever recommend this location to my family or friends.

I am updating my review because the regional Manager assisted me in resolving my windshield issue. The 5 star rating is for the 6028 118 Ave NW (Edmonton west) and 2833 Broadmoor Blvd, Sherwood Park locations. In my opinion, both of these locations understand the importance of Customer Service and were willing to listen and understand and work together with me.

If Glass Masters is the place you want to give your business too, don't waste your time with the Southside location, go see Nathan in Sherwood Park or Mark in West Edmonton.
I'm here for the sugary French pastries. I love being covered powdered sugar, like a bag blew up in my face. But man, it is delicious. Viva La Beignets!!!!!!!

This is one of my favorite places to take out-of-towners. You can listen to old radio soap operas in your booths and sit in a classic art deco parlor/lounge. The vibe is really fun and the ice cream is phenomenal. The regular food is good, too, but it's all about the ice cream, IMHO. I am not a drinker, but I've heard the ice cream drinks are very good as well. Come early, as this place gets PACKED.
The monte crisco did not disappoint! And the cinnamon roll!!!! Enjoyed it all. I wish I lived here so I could visit more often!!

Went there for breakfast on 4/30/16 about a half hour after they opened. Couldn't order breakfast potatoes because they were being made. My daughter, a vegan, ordered the oatmeal. After 20 minutes waiting for our food the waitress came out and said they ran out of oatmeal. You'd think they would've known that when we were ordering!  Fortunately she was able to order a breakfast smoothie with a plant based protein (which the waitress said they have but no one is supposed to know). I thought that was odd. They offered her a fruit plate since that was the only other thing they had she could eat.  She asked if they had peanut butter and they did not.  After another 10 minutes they brought her the fruit and I was still waiting on my eggs Benedict and fruit. She finished her fruit and my breakfast finally arrived. Get your act together Caffe Primo!  I probably won't be back. Too many other choices to waste my time here.

Update- received this unprofessional response from Andrew M. BTW contrary to what he said 4/30 WAS a Saturday.  I guess Andrew M. doesn't like two star ratings. 

Andrew M: 
Business Customer Service
hello,
thanks for the note. i'd like to clarify a few things:
fyi we are not opened for breakfast mon-fri, just sat and sun/weekends. so apparently, my staff were trying to accommodate your request beyond the coffee and pastries we serve 9-1130 during the week which includes 4/30 when you were allegedly in. i'd say that sure is a nice thing considering the kitchen wasn't set up for any of what you ordered.. as well, we are not a vegan restaurant nor do we advertise that. no problem on the threat of non return. take care. Andrew

They never disappoint! I didn't realize how much I've missed BR! I had forgotten they were still around and pretty much went to Creole Creamery for ice cream. 
I love the Pralines and Cream and the Bananas Foster! They now have a flavor of the month. It was a salted caramel which was very good 
!
Great place for an excellent gelato. I just wish they had a recycling for their plastics.

Came with my kids and a friend, my children were so thirsty. It took over 10 minutes for water, had it been sooner they would have been more content. The owner/ server neglected us and acted as though we did not exist. I'm appalled, having come alone with a different experience service wise . The choices for Vietnamese in the area are slim. My children are US born Vietnamese-American and love the ethnic food. I'm not sure if it was the kids or a male friend who he made stereotypical assumptions regarding. Needless to say now both times the Pho was unimpressive and the rest kind of followed. I will not be back. Shame, because it's close.

Great service.  My husband came home Friday afternoon with a rock chip in my car windshield.  I called Summit Auto Glass and said that we would be going out at 6pm any way they could get someone over prior to that to fix the windshield. Yes!! Mark showed up shortly after 5pm and took care of the chip.  He let us know that he would not be able to make it completely disappear but would do his best.  His best was great and we were very happy with his professionalism and the quality of his work.  Angela who took the phone call was also great.  I also love using local businesses.

Great restaurant, fun vibe and creative thoughtful menu.  I have been here a few times now and after reading several of the reviews, especially from those who have only been there once, I am amazed at how critical people can be. The atmosphere is a bit on the loud side, but what do you expect when your in a fun open setting.  That makes it all the more interesting.  If I wanted quiet, I would have stayed home.  The booths are my favorite, big and comfortable with enough space for a large party and still with elbow room to eat. Our booth was an awesome spot to do the south tampa people watch, and what a scene it is!  Loved that I could meld into the beautiful woodwork and enjoy.  Our dinner was exceptionally enjoyable from the time the host greeted us to when our waiter wished a safe ride home.  

Stating with the wines by the glass, smart to have Italian choices.  I tend to be a creature of habit so to not sway too far off my normal Sonoma Chardonnay they offered me a delicious Il Borro white.  Smooth and refreshing, loved it. Also the wine glasses themselves have a clever design that allows each glass to breath.  I thought there was a crack in the glass but when the owner stopped by to say hello, he explained how they work and swirled my husbands red.  The attention to detail is truly amazing and I haven't even gotten to the food.  We had the luxury of asking the owner bit more about the menu and he went on to share with us how each morning the bread is kneaded and baked in the wood oven, and that each of the cavatelli pastas are hand rolled.  Reminded me of my great Italian aunts' pasta dishes.  I had to order both!  And I wasn't disappointed, it brought me back.  The pasta was tender and flavorful and the sauce was fresh and simple.  Not overbearing and heavy.  The perfect balance and the right amount.  So tired of the large oversized portions.  The table also ordered the muscles with more of the scrumptious bread.  While I am not a muscles person, I could have devoured the sauce by myself. Along with the smokey flavor of the bread dipped in the sauce, the combination was heaven.  Another guest with us had the Kale Salad and the meatballs.  Wow another great combo choice.  Love the Kale in the tempura batter, crispy, tangy and spectacular.  And the meatballs, something I have been known to make mean one myself, were presented by themselves with no sauce.  Very daring since a meatball without sauce better be pretty darn good.  Again they were flavorful, and spices used were the right amount to complement the meat.  Our daughter ordered the margherita pizza and loved the flavor of the crust but would have liked a bit more cheese.  (and what kid wouldn't like more).  Anyway it was definitely reminiscent of the pizzas we had in Italy, so again kudos to the authenticity of everything Ava's is doing.  

Yes I'm a fan! See you at Ava's soon.

Even in the middle of lunchtime on a weekday, food is cold-old. With that odor associated with something that as waited too long, where flavor transmutes to an impatient attitude. You could maybe account for this by imagining the burger, fries, and fish sandwich had been prepared at some suburban McDonalds and then trucked over to this urban outlet to be re-heated and allow to age a bit. This is an insult to the neighborhood.

Upscale and fancy are the two words that you'll never see in the same sentence with this restaurant's name. What you will hear consistently is how good the food is.... I stop in here 2-3 times per month. The ladies that work here are very nice, welcoming, and helpful. The food is always hot and tasty. I've never had a  disappointing meal here. The  lunch specials are reasonably priced, and the meal size is usually more than you can eat at the time. When I'm passing through, I always search for more Chinese restaurants, but always wind up pulling into this lot. Its really meal good enough to tell someone about.

OThis place has completely gone down the tubes! First impression.... walked into a DISGUSTING stench of old dirty musky carpets! OMG! This carpet hasn't been cleaned in years! Stains cover the once colorful floors. Dirt and grime on every wall, entry way and door! 

We ordered 2 large pizzas, buffalo chicken breadsticks and 5 sodas... $78 WITH COUPONS! Holy crud! We could've got a feast at Peter Piper Pizza! Oh and the pizza.....it's awful! Frozen pizza blows this place out of the water! I'm waiting for my dad to regurgitate his salad from the salad bar. It's definitely been sitting out all day, all the toppings are mixed together and everything is shriveled up and dried out. 

This location is building a new location directly across the street. I really hope that it will come with a new manager and new cleaning crew! What a terrible experience for my daughter on her birthday! 

The only good thing about this place is the staff!  They take pride in their work. VERY friendly and upbeat!

Holy Moses! These people are the real deal. From wonderful chair massages to foot massages and full body, you can't go wrong. The owners are kind and considerate of your time. They really handle themselves professionally and are true to their word. Do you need a massage and cannot get in to your favorite spa? Try this place. It's not a spa experience (so if you're expecting that, don't go) but if you want something that makes you feel better when you're finished, is completed by kind and courteous people, and is amazingly priced, go. Do not hesitate. Just go.
Absolutely perfect. The food is amazing, the staff is very nice, and the prices are great. Love the dinner and a movie deal. Perfect date for me and my wife.
Great place for lunch. Also, they have the best strawberry cake I've ever had in my life.

Great service, great food
Nice atmosphere 
The staff treats everyone with respect and care

Yay: Great breakfast sandwiches at great prices. Plenty of seating, free WiFi, friendly staff, quick service.

Nay: Over $4 for a latte? Whaaaa?

I didn't even know what a praline was until I came here. WOW.  Melt in your mouth deliciousness. They are so indulgent and delicious!  You get to try samples of it first before you decide.  And there is someone there making them fresh as you walk around the store.

So many amazing choices.  I came here for the pralines and that's what I got. Loved the coconut one.  Also picked up some milk & dark chocolate peanut butter cups.  They had great looking king cakes, but that would've been a hassle for me to travel back with.

Just walking into the store, you can smell all the delectable sweet treats and I kinda feel like the aroma leaves with you a little.  Definitely make a stop here if you are visiting this city!

i love chipotle, especially this one on state street. i find that sometimes chipotle skimps on the meat(other locations..) but this place always gives two huge spoons and it makes me happy! i always get a burrito, and it always satisfies my mexican food cravings. cant wait to eat here again!

This is just a quick review for the E Bar staff that run the cafe out front of Nordstroms. You guys are amazing, fun to be around, and fast! I come on my 15 minute breaks for coffee, bagels, cookies, and the interesting treats that change all the time! I feel very welcome to be in this little shop and I just wanted to say tha k you!

i came into toyota of SB, yesterday to get a simple oil change. They quoted me a price of 42.99... which is pretty darn high for a 2002 tacoma v6. Most toyota dealership only charges $29+tax... but the rang me up for $51.40... i have never paid more than $50 for simple oil change at any toyota dealersip ever. . so, i asked them to correct it for me, and they did, after a long slow process canceling payment..  Point is, if you are not careful, you can and will get screwed here pretty good...

I LOVED this place. The pho is solid! The spring rolls solid! The bun vermicelli solid! The food is so delicious. I wish I had a Vietnamese place half as good as this restaurant near me back home.  The base pho broth was delicious. Everything is fresh and delicious. Hmm. I might have said delicious way too much in this review. Lol!

Been wanting to try burgerrito for a while now. The concept is clever burger patties in a burrito, taco salad, sandwich, etc.  Let me start by saying the amount of love and attention that they put into the hatch green chile sauce and their cajun sauce is noticeable and makes these sauces stellar. 
     Now the problem is that they don't pay as much love and attention to the other parts of the whole. I ordered a taco salad which comes with the green chile sauce, diced hamburger patty (beef or turkey), chopped tomato, chopped onion, all on top of a bed of lettuce and surrounded with tortilla chips. I had two problems with this dish: 
1. The hamburger was diced and not ground.
2. The hamburger was a frozen patty.
        I really feel like this food truck has potential to be outstanding if only they put the same amount of love into all items of each dish as they do their sauces. I would really like to see them make fresh or fresh frozen hamburger patties in the future maybe add some diced onion and hatch green chile's to the hamburger patty.

A nice little restaurant in Jenkintown right off Old York Road on West Avenue, hence its name...owned by a family from my synagogue who also owns Max and David's in Elkins Park.  I've only ever been to West  Avenue  Grill once, but I will always remember how amazing their mile high french toast (made with challah bread and garnished with caramelized bananas) was.  It happens to be one of their signature entrees, and  I can see why.  Their hours are interesting though; they are open for breakfast/lunch/brunch,etc. and close around 2pm (however, they allow customers to stay and eat if they are seated prior to that time) and then reopen in the evening around 6 or 7pm for dinner.  Though for anyone who is looking for a nice place to have brunch on a Saturday or Sunday morning, provided it's not too crowded, West Avenue is the place to go, and a  nice plus is that it's surrounded by some nice little shops you can check out before or afterwards.
Fresh ingredients. Huge portions. Tender, flavorful meat. The fried potstickers were soooo good!

My girlfriend and I just had a delightful lunch.

Lunch specials are $9.95, which includes an appetizer, an entrée and a beverage.

Our server was friendly and knowledgeable, and he gave us plenty of time to decide. There were many choices.

She got arancini, spinach ravioli and iced tea. And she ordered a dinner-sized portion of baked cannelloni to take home for dinner.

I got phyllo cigars, chicken madeira and Diet Coke.

Beverage refills were spot-on throughout our meal.

When the appetizers came out, they were fresh out of the fryer -- hot, but not killer hot. The arancini were sitting on a tomato-cheese sauce. The phyllo cigars were served with a tomato-based sauce.

We shared, so I got an arancini, and she got 1-1/2 phyllo cigars. They were both tremendously flavorful and full-bodied. The phyllo cigars were stuffed with dill feta. Besides risotto, the arancini were filled with gorgonzola and steak.

Our entrees were equally impressive, but less eaten. We were both kinda full -- not stuffed, but comfortable.

I took two bites of my tender chicken, which had a tomato and mushroom sauce, and two bites of zucchini (cut on the bias rather thickly to maintain its integrity) beautifully sautéed to the point of lovely browned crispness.

She took two bites of one ravioli, proclaimed it excellent, and we both took home a bunch o' food.

By the time we left, place was pretty filled up . . . just like we were.
New to Downtown Indy. Stop where you are nd go eat at Giordano's downtown Indy.

Excellent Food, Excellent Service
We have been three times in the last few weeks.
The room at the back can get a bit noisy...but I believe that they will be doing something about that

The last time I went to a Penang was in Boston.  So when I came to Chicago, I was so disappointed that the Penang was closed due to a fire.  Luckily they had a Penang in Philadelphia so I was reunited with delicious Malaysian food!  This restaurant is a chain, but the food is delicious! I cant remember the exact dish that I ordered, but the food had great flavors and not a lot of heat (the appetizer was a curry dip with roti bread). Service was good but hovered a lot.  Plus, the restaurant was not full of people but we felt very rushed.  They were quick to give us the bill but were not quick in settling the bill. Weird.

Ok so this place was not a sparkling star. BUT after the best Western lost our reservation we drove around and found this place.  It was cheap and yes its not the newest. But the staff was nice and our room as clean . For 44 bucks for two people  was great and we were tired and mad. So this was not a great place but it was a great price and it was really ok.

Everything about our experience here was top notch. You can tell everyone that works here enjoys their job and is passionate about the quality of their product. The chocolate cake was amazing, the frosting was amazing, and the gluten-free option was a crowd pleaser. Support an outstanding local business the next time you need a cake. You won't be disappointed.
Cool place to bowl and drink. Dis spin all night, good music and bar food. Affordable drink prices and they always seem to have a good size crowd.

We came for date night about six o'clock on a Saturday evening. We were greeted right away and seated.  The atmosphere is comfortable and intimate. Good for couples or small groups.  The layout is open, but leaves for enough privacy, and there really isn't a bad seat to be had.  

The wine list is expansive for bottles as well as glasses and can satisfy any level of wine enthusiast. The staff is knowledgeable and able to give you suggestions if needed. We each started with a glass of red wine (zinfandel and merlot) and took some time to peruse the menu.  

Our server was attentive (but not intrusive) and knowledgeable. The menu is definitely designed to accompany the wine list. It's just broad enough to offer something for everyone, but not overwhelming. More appetizer/tapas style than full main courses. We ordered the baked brie and antipasta plate. Both were scrumptious. 

Overall, a great place to enjoy an intimate evening with a date/spouse, or even girls' night out. Friendly and knowledgeable staff, classy atmosphere, extensive (but not overwhelming) wine list with a lot of options by the glass, and satisfying food menu.

We'll be back!

What a dining experience In the Northern world of Edmonton, Alberta. As a southern boy, i'm particular about my brisket; not only was my selection fantastic,  but I was introduced to fried grits. As you can imagine, being from the south....I thought I knew my grits, but this was my first experience eating them fried. They were great! The price point was very reasonable and the wait staff was very accommodating. The slaw, with a hint of vinegar was exceptional. The portion sizes were most gracious. If you're in Edmonton, find this place; It will be worth it! The atmosphere is great.

Found mold in our peppermill tower suite I got in the shower and all I could smell was mold there was mold on the ceiling and walls of the shower I called the front desk to let them know and the lady said she would send someone up to clean it and they never came and cleaned it had to shower the next day again in the mold. They definitely weren't concerned about it....

Really a great Salon! I got my hair cut by Jessica, and she is the sweetest stylist you will ever meet. I got acquainted to the salon via Yelp, and was definitely willing to try it despite the distance from my house based on the reviews and positive comments. 

Once I got there, I parked on a side street (free, 2am-8pm for 2 hours only) which was  no trouble at all and walked a block to the salon. The area is different from what I was expecting, seeing as this was my first time in this part of town, seemed a little...grubby. However, the salon was presentable, and almost had a little bit of a hipster vibe (it IS organic, anyway) which I was comfortable with. They dont have state of the art decor and furniture, but I liked the homey feel and their vintage pieces and the ease at which the clients and hair stylists moved around. I was offered a drink, and sat to get my hair washed, cut and dried, all for $35. Very affordable, especially for me! She listened to all my concerns and then gave me a nice trim and updated my current cut for the look I wanted. Nothing bad to say about the entire experience. I loved the little scalp massage during the wash too!

Definitely a good experience and I'd likely come back in the future to get my hair cut again, but do wish it was a little closer to home.
Terrible food, ordering system trying to be cool but just ends up irritating, staff rude.  Only authentic tex-mex in this place is the beer

I was on my way to the airport and decided to hit one last spot before leaving Louisiana.  This was across the street from where I got gas for my rental car so I decided to get a to go order.  I ordered the fried crawfish, seafood gumbo, pecan pie and bread pudding.  I didn't love any of it, it was just mediocre.  The crawfish weren't seasoned they tasted like I could probably get them in the freezer section at the grocery store.  My pecan pie was just OK nothing about it made me want to have another slice.  I was very disappointed with the bread pudding; it was cold with a huge chunk of icing on the top.  Perhaps that is their standard practice to give it to people when they are getting to go orders, but they should at least ask if you would like it warmed up because I was heading to the airport.  Since it was cold I didn't eat it because I couldn't enjoy the way a proper bread pudding is supposed to be.

By far, our favorite restaurant in St. Louis! There may be fancier places (no black napkins;) but none that are exceptional AND also a great value! My husband and I prefer Hendel's over Flemings and Citizen Kane's. The service is excellent & personal, and the menu (though limited) is still diverse (steaks, pasta, seafood & daily specials) We usually order a filet mignon & a seafood dish (salad & side included- no a la carte!), a bottle of wine & dessert for around $100--you can't beat that price!  The brunches are also excellent, especially the holiday brunches ( Easter & mothers day.) Though Hendels is a little out of the way for us, the drive is well worth it.

Horrible service. Ordered a pizza online. Saw email confirmation and called them 4 minutes later because it wasn't what we ordered. Was told they couldn't change the order because it was already in the oven. Got a great Pizza from ABC Pizza instead!

Love this place! Best sushi I've had in Edmonton. Great atmosphere and service was really good (especially for Edmonton). Busy on weekend nights though - always had a reservation and sometimes still had to wait 30 minutes for a table.

Thoroughly enjoyed my visits here! I've only given it 4 stars because I'd like for the dressing/shower area to have been a bit larger. But the treatments and staff were wonderful! I had a facial one afternoon which was my first and I was very pleased. The next day, I returned for a Wax Treatment by Misha who was great and a Swedish Massage by Jason who was very professional yet also personable. The massage was just the right balance of relaxing and refreshing! The lobby has lots of items you can purchase for home such as the bathrobes, t-shirts, skincare items, and lots more. The sitting room where you wait was very relaxing in itself with healthy snacks and a great cucumber infused water. I would def visit again as long as I could request the same staff. (Some friends went with me as well, and didn't have quite as good of an experience as I because they had different staff helping them.)

As for a casino, it's ok. I think they need to work on their air filtration system though; I feel like I smoke a pack while waiting for lunch or dinner. I love the restaurants and the little cafe though. They have a very convenient location for me, which is probably what keeps me coming back...plus, those steaks!

UPDATE 6/23/12:  So we've been to Tortugas twice in the last year.  The first time, I had a nice big black chest hair (fingers crossed, let's HOPE it was a chest hair) in my taco.  That kept me from wanting to eat there for a looooong time.  Then we just went back recently and sat down in the restaurant.  The food was great, hot, tasted fresh, I can't complain at all about the food.  The server was another story.  We handed her a coupon and she had an attitude and a tone with us, stating that it had to be "called in and would take a few minutes".  Then she walked off leaving us standing at the register until someone else came and took care of us.  Listen Tortugas, coupons are incentives that get people's behinds in your seats. We don't want to deal with attitude problems just because we have a coupon that you have to do some extra overhead for.  After such a great meal, we left the restaurant talking about the rudeness of the server.  That's a shame.  See you in another year I guess Tortugas....

UPDATE:  6/5/11:  I can't bring myself to eat here anymore.  The place does not seem clean.  The last time I was there, I found a hair in my taco.....A HAIR.  A big greasy hair.
