My drink, The Giant Peach, was not giant. It was all Sprite, with very little peach. Thanks, I just paid $4 for half of a glass of soda. 

The bacon was undercooked and if I wanted mediocre pancakes, I'd make them at home. Not my cup of tea.

My favorite pizza in St. Louis!
Me and the wife have been coming here for years and finally it is getting the notoriety it deserves. Its not "Chicago Style". The sauce has a bit of zip, but the kind that leaves you craving for more. I love the overall vibe of this bar. I know change is coming at Black Thorn, but I can't wait to see what is in store for them!

**CALLING ALL PHOTO ENTHUSIASTS**

Food is great. Fast & friendly service. Don't forget the camera. Amazing sunsets from the deck are postcard perfect. 

~wear bug spray~

The food at this little restaurant was amazing. The restaurant is small but you can tell that the heart of the staff here is large. The setting is very family friendly. I went right after church time on a Sunday and it was very busy. Sometime, service was just a little slow but the food and atmosphere all made up for it. The buffet is a great choice if it is your first time going and you are not quite sure what you want. The fried chicken was unbelievably delicious and the biscuits are to die for. There is a little sitting room outside (about four tables). The restaurant is small so don't expect a lot of legroom or walking space. This restaurant is a great option for brunch.
Cute small place, but filled with a lot of charm and a great staff.  Had the steak and crabcake dish...talk about yummy.  Came in between sets, so didn't hear too much music.

Had an apple strudel from the Hop Angel Brauhaus restaurant near 5 points . The waitress told me that it came from the Holmesburg Bakery . 
It was the best that I ever had. the crust was flaky and the filling was perfect. The Filling was not too sweet and not too spiced. I could still taste the apple.

Brilliant minds at work here. Truly innovative things don't come along this often, and they're really doing great work and going above and beyond what a typical donut place would be. 

To be expected, there is nearly always a line, which is well deserved. They've truly mastered donuts, and take them to and other level. The spicy maple praline donut I had today was sheer perfection, albeit the size is truly more than one can probably handle (I had to take a nap post all of the sugar), and would probably be best done by splitting, or perhaps showing a bit of self restraint and having half later, as they are massive.

I'm yet to try the savory sliders, but I have every bit of faith that they're made with as much thought and compassion as are the donuts. The staff here is fantastic, and I'd definitely suggest following their instagram page. 

Wonderful coffee selection, too!
Great decor, great service, hot hot fries and hot sandwich.  I highly recommend this place . Bring your appetite though, the portions are huge!!!

I'm not sure how everyone else has got this joint on par with The French Laundry (a la cubana) buuuuut....my experience was baaaad. My mom ordered some beef dish (don't remember, it's been awhile) and a family friend who isn't anywhere near as picky as mom ordered the same thing. They agreed that an old tennis shoe would've been tastier. My dish was just forgettable...so much so, I don't even recall what I had (other than it had shrimp). What I do remember is that the whole reason I wanted to go here was for plantains, and I was not advised that those were 86'd. My plate arrived with a paltry chip substitute where the plantains should have been. Not cool! 
When my mother's almost full plate was given back to the server and the owner came over to scope out the situation, he was mildly argumentative, but then gave my mom 1/2 off on the dish she had eaten 1/8 of...never impressed with that kind of remedy when the food sucks. Maybe I'm spoiled, but the Cuban food I'm used to (from Los Angeles) was infinitely superior.
So, if anyone else is looking for great plantains, I suggest a trip to Ramsi's or Mayan Cafe in Louisville. It's worth the trip if your taste buds are running the show...
Food was great, good authentic Italian food... For drinks you must try the lemoncello martini, it's one of the best drinks i've had in a long time.

Not at all authentic Vietnamese food and a little pricey. But the chef is really friendly. I think he is from Thailand so it is understandable that he doesn't cook Vietnamese dishes properly. 

I don't recommend this place if you want to try Vietnamese food, but good option if you just need a quick, light lunch.

Jasmine Thai has portion control sized dishes. In other words, they serve you how much you should really eat in a meal.Most Thai restaurants usually serve bigger sized dishes.This is not a bad thing, just wished I had a little more.It took awhile for someone to get our order but once our order was in, the food came out in 5 minutes. 
Their menu is not very big.Unfortunately they did not have any "kid friendly" dishes so our little one did not eat until after we left.I don't expect them to have mac 'n' cheese obviously, but you could easily fry some chicken pieces/strips in tempura or something. 
The bathrooms are clean and the hand carved table tops at the booths were beautiful. Our waitress was super nice.
Of course everyone has heard of Domino's but they done something special when they started making Brooklyn Style Pizza!!!  It's the pizza by which all other pizza's will be judged!!!
Great greasy-spoon, family diner type breakfast.  Service was okay.  Decor and service were okay.  I'll definitely be back.

Spent a nice evening there with friends. The white sangria was goos and so was the (very small) portion of pea tortellini pasta. The appetizers we had, the crispy artichoke and the charcoal octopus were good but way tooooo salty. Same with the pizzas. The margarita was better than the burrata, but both we too salty.

Food was amazing! We went for a Father's Day Brunch and the two-course meal was sensational! I ordered the Veggie Cobb Salad and the Breakfast Burrito. Our waitress was very responsive and came regularly to check on us.

Chipotle is a great place. Healthy, affordable, tasty and fast food. This location has friendly staff and although the lines can be long at times they're bearable. My one issue with this location is the cleanliness. Last time I went I was impressed, but that's not usually the case.

So, I am a little spoiled when it comes to steaks and so I had relatively low expectations for this place given it is a lower priced chain. When I want a good steak, I usually head to Philly for Ruth's Chris or Morton's but of course pay the price. Things started poorly as it took forever to get someone to answer the phone to find out if there was a wait.  Upon arrival, I was seated quickly and everyone was very friendly. Waitress was great and on two occasions a manager stopped by the table to make sure everything was good... And it was.  Rib appetizer was excellent, tasty, tender and perfectly cooked. Filet was cooked as ordered and  tasty, although I prefer a little more seasoning.  Pretty good quality beef, especially at their price point.  The side dishes were very good and well prepared. Service was exceptional. I don't usually like chains, especially steakhouses, but this was actually pretty good.  I recommend this place for a reasonably priced meal with excellent service.  The call ahead service needs improvement.

I'm a stress puppy. I'd been going to a good massage therapist, but even she wasn't able to get the knots out that Kate did in my first session. She's super considerate and made sure that I was comfortable, checking pressure several times.  If you're not used to the discomfort of trigger point, she'll brief you so you don't have the wrong impression. This is real therapy, not some wishy-washy mall massage. The studio space is professional without being too clinical. I left with drastically better range of motion and calf muscles that weren't locked. Worth every penny.

The service is efficient. The sushi size is larger than Sushi Teri - the most prevalent sushi place in the area - the prices are average on Fri - Sun but Mon - Thu sushi is half-price! They're quick for a call in order, a little slower it seems for in restaurant orders. The place can be pleasant if it is a weekday but it can get very crowded on the weekends. Most employees are efficient and on the nice side, but not overwhelmingly so.

Went here for date night the other night with the hubs.  We had a Foodie Indy card for $10 off a $30 purchase so we decided why not check this place out.  I had only ever been here late at night for drinks, I didn't even realize it was a full restaurant.  

Based on Yelp reviews and the recommendation on the Foodie Indy card we ordered the Osso Bucco to share which is served over a bed of risotto.  It was AMAZING!!   We were both so impressed with it!  I will admit we have neither had ossu bucco before, so we have nothing to compare it to, but this was awesome!  Great flavors, the meat literally just fell off the bone, the risotto was so cheesy and creamy and delicious.  YUM!  For an appetizer we had the eggplant chips.  These were also quite yummy.  They were just very thinly sliced pieces of eggplant that were lightly breaded and fried.  These were served with a nice creamy cucumber sauce for dipping.  Also very pleasing.

Another great thing about this place is their cocktail menu.  They have a nice list of cocktails that are kind of different from the same old boring stuff.  I liked the fact that the first drink I ordered the waiter was nice enough to warn me that 3 out of 4 people send back.  When I asked why I was kind of surprised that he didn't know, but he did have the bartender come explain to me why and help me pick out a drink that I may like better.  (Part of me says you should revamp a cocktail that 75% of people don't like, but I'm not the owner of the restaurant)

Overall, this is a great place with a very simple but good menu.  The service was excellent and much like all the other reviews, we had zero wait time when we walked in at 6:00 on a thursday night.  We will definitely be back!

Great hole in the wall bar in old city. Irish Pol has a tap wall with a lot of good craft beer on there. They had one of my favorite beers on tap, Southern Tier Pumking when it was out of season. The atmosphere is casual and laid back. One of the better bars in Old City that id not overbearingly crowded on a Saturday night.
Some of the best BBQ I've had in ages! Friendly and welcoming staff, very fast food to table. Without a doubt will be going back and using for catering.

This restaurant is small, quaint and has a calm indoor outdoor dining experience. Great for lunch, and we order delivery at least once a week. They have NEVER disappointed us. :). 

Hey have an extensive menu. The staff are genuine and down to earth. This place is great for those who are looking for no frills. Easy going, quick bites. 

This restaurant works like a well oiled machine. 
Autonomous and natural felling to the place.

My niece and I decided to come here for some dessert. This was my first time here and wasn't sure what to expect. Of course I had to order the "Ube Be Baby" and my niece wanted the "Vanilla, Vanilla, Strawberry". The machine for the Ube ran out so my serving was a little short but they offered me more when it was back up. I do have to say it is a little overpriced for some dessert.

Wow, a place that makes a GREAT martini. I don't say that often enough. I order dry, they make dry. Seems like it shouldn't be complicated, but it really is at most places. I have no idea about any of the other cocktails, but really the martini is what it should be.

Food-wise, I've never been disappointed, and a highlight for me was the egg-salad sandwich. Not that I would describe the egg salad as, "What's Up, Tiger Lily," good, but good. Worth a try if you appreciate a good cocktail.

Chipotle gets a big "meh" from me.  I admit I might be hard on them because of their reputation for being amazing, but I just find it to be okay.  And yes, I do get to pick all of my ingredients, but I've been 3-4 times and ordered different items and combinations each time.  I just don't find the flavors to be very inspired.  There are other fast Mexican/build your own burrito/bowl places in town that I find to be much better, and will way more variety to choose from.

The one thing I really appreciate at Chipotle is that they offer "sofritas" which is a vegetarian option.  I'm not a vegetarian, but I appreciate having the option to go meat-free!

I heard rave reviews of this place being the "best Thai in Nashville" so I had to try it out. It is a cool vibe- an old house that has been turned into a restaurant- thus, the parking is very limited, but there is a driveway that wraps around which helps. They don't serve beer, so I was slightly disappointed, but the food itself is standard and the service was good. They are always busy, so we had to wait in the crowded entry-way, and then were seated right next to the kitchen door so we were "in the action" as you could say. It was a typical Thai place, but not the best I've had. 

Note: my standards are high coming from LA, so please take this review with a grain of salt.
This is one of our favorite places to eat.  It's always great.  They have the best margaritas in the city. I recommend the mexican sampler.

I really love this place 

It's very elegant 

Outstanding food and service 

I tasted a 60 year old whisky for only 300.00 and had an amazing meal 

Will be returning for thanksgiving after  time spent from jazz fest
Put my name on this list...25 minute wait. Me: "Can I order something to drink?"...pointing to the bar. Host: "No..owner's policy". Me: "seriously? The sign says Cafe & Juice Bar".

There is no doubt that the food at Pancake Pantry is great, but the customer service is lacking. I understand that a business can be very busy, but that shouldn't take away from the quality of the serving. I've been here several times and the staff spend very little time with you. If you want something you have to remind them several times before they actually bring it to you. This could definitely use some improving.

Cool little restaurant with a lot of healthy options! 
I tried the Recoverii smoothie,it was good but not worth the price.. $6.50 for a small cup

Cute little place with fantastic service. Gave only 4 stars because I asked for no bacon in my breakfast burrito (I'm vegetarian) and they put it in anyway. Would have liked to see them comp the dish, but they just apologized. Great experience otherwise.
It was OK here. Ive had better food. The staff did a great job. I'm sure I'll give it another shot one day.

We stayed on the business floor which included a free breakfast, which we loved. The business floor was very modern and clean, but the bathroom was barely usable...it was so so small.  My husband is 6'4" and his knees were hitting the wall when he sat on the toilet. 

We enjoyed our stay for the night, rates were reasonable for downtown Philly.

What a gem to stumble on !!! Small seating area inside, but ample outdoor ! Food was really good. Had the seafood risotto and my husband had the steak Diane.  Both cooked to perfection, no complaints here ! Would definitely return !

Not a good use of time, we got on a bus and then were told to get off and wait for another bus. 20 minutes later it showed up and took us to another stop where we had to wait for yet another bus. Two hours after starting the tour, we have yet to actually see anything. If you want to see Nashville, I'd recommend you find another option
They were on-time and performed excellent work for a reasonable price. Would recommend to anyone needing new or repaired window screens.

The 4 stars is for the love of Moon's. As a Boise High grad, I have loved Moon's for a long time. The burgers, the shakes, the breakfast burritos; these are my jam. Boise downtown moons; the service is top notch and if I was writing this review on downtown alone it would be 5 stars, no doubt. However, I experienced the fairview location today and it was disappointing. The actual food was fine, but the service was not great. The hostess had to set a table for 14, on her own including wiping down and rearranging the furniture. So due to that curveball out party of 4 was standing there looking at all the open tables. Finally a waitress realized her hostess was busy and sat us. Our first check in from our waitress took 10 minutes and more of the same throughout the meal. I LOVE Moon's. The service from downtown should be mirrored at Fairview.

Love this little Cafe'. The food is fresh, the staff is friendly, the bathrooms are clean! I usually get the combo Pho' with an additional side of - well just about anything. You really can't go wrong here!

I was walking by Mood Cafe about a week ago and had my first Lassi (strawberry) and I was not disappointed. Very delicious! My friend actually saw the owner hanging outside and they insisted I tried one! I loved this place. The owner was friendly and the place had excellent customer service. I would definitely go back. PS I was actually on a date at this time, I highly suggest a detour to this place if you are out on a walk in the area on these summer days!!

They were a bit on the expensive side, but Brian did an excellent job!  I'm a first time home buyer, and had no idea what to expect.  But after a 4 hour inspection, I knew exactly what was wrong with the house.  It was good bones, just mainly cosmetic items that needed to be addressed.  I had my report that same day.  It had pictures of everything he mentioned, along with a note of what needed to be done to correct it. Makes things easier to relate to what he had told me earlier.  It's just like a mini check list of things I need to do as a new home owner.  If I ever buy another house (which i don't hope for lol), I will be using MC2 again.

We ate here for the first time back in March.
As others have mentioned, the service is a little bit off. It was overattentive at times, and then oddly lacking when, for example, we were ready for our cheque.
But those are small missteps in the grand scheme of things. The food, most importantly, is solid. I highly recommend the drunken noodles.

I cannot say enough amazing things about this place!!! I had my wedding ceremony and they were incredible. They were communicative, efficient and caring. They made sure to check in even during the process of our event. The decorating they did for us was top notch. You could tell that they really cared and wanted it to be special for us. They made signs for us and allowed us to take photos wherever. The staff were out of this world and made sure to assist in keeping our event private. I would highly recommend them. We appreciate everything they did for us.

I love the food and the experience here, but the food pricing is one big hustle.

An extra charge for friend rice???  Really?  Isn't fried rice kind of the staple of hibatchi dining?  When I challenged the server about this, she said "it's always been that way".
That's complete bull, and I've never been to a hibatchi restaurant that charges extra for fried rice.
That's like Red Lobster charging extra for Old Bay.

Another secret - dessert comes with your meal, but they don't offer it unless you ask for it.  --hustle.

Makes me wonder if Benihana and Olive Garden have the same ownership.

There's hardly anyone here the many times that I've gone, and for some reason I continuously have to wait 25 minutes minimum. It was so awesome when the couple who had just arrived got seated instantly while I continued to get over looked. ( I'm looking at you redheaded server).
My family's favorite restaurant! I love the food (always ordered the calamari and 21 fried shrimp). I love the atmosphere and the waitstaff is always friendly. Great place!

Overall have always had a good experience.  Had a questionable one though recently that I thought warranted sharing.  Purchased a fish that was supposed to be a male.  Got it home and it had about 15 baby fish 2 or 3 days later.  I contacted the store and asked them for information and tried to determine if they would be helpful in this scenario.  I've not had this happen before and hoped for some help since I purchased the fish from them.  They told me they don't take babies and perhaps I should call PETCO.   Well, I suppose I will.  I will likely also consider alternatives when choosing to purchase additional fish.  I realize it's not an absolute that they have all male fish, but I would think they'd have a policy of some sort to support animals they sell.   It doesn't seem very sensible to not.

I dream of Refuel's grits. I salivate thinking of Refuel's grits. I would walk 500 miles just to eat Refuel's grits. I would sell one of my kidneys just to eat Refuel's grits. If I had a last meal, it'd be Refuel's grits. 

But kidding aside, if you're a local and have yet to try Refuel, go. Now. And order the grits. ( I don't care if you're from the Bywater, Lakeview, Gentilly, or the East. Go make the drive. The Riverbend isn't that far away. It's worth the trip.)

If you're just visiting, you'd be doing a disservice to yourself and everyone else you're traveling with if you didn't take your head that's buried in those tourist guidebooks and take the St. Charles Streetcar all the way to Hampson and S. Carrollton and experience these remarkable grits.

If I had to choose the best place to grab brunch in NOLA, Refuel Cafe would win by far. With their life changing (yes life changing) grits I don't know how any other establishment could compete.

Go. Now! And try a bite of heaven. I'm certain you won't be disappointed.

This is the first time I've ever had such great service that I felt the absolute need to write a yelp review.  V is amazing, MICHAEL is amazing!

I booked my appt. after hearing from a friend that it was a great salon.  I was not disappointed!  Michael offered me a water right when I walked in and began with such energy and enthusiasm that I knew it would be a great experience.  

While Michael is new to V (Just started on 7/12/13!), his experience with hair is very extensive.  We decided to "gloss" my hair, which I'd never done before.  

After a long time chatting and foiling, he gave me a quick cut and sent me on my way.

Michael stayed late for me, which I REALLY appreciated! The pricing was very fair, and as a woman that isn't loyal to their hair stylists, I will ABSOLUTELY be going back to Michael!

Rachael

I am actually angry that I have not heard of this place sooner!! Creme de la Creme needs to do a better job of advertising their eye shadows because they are INCREDIBLE!!! So amazingly pigmented, soft and buttery - and the price is super reasonable. Especially considering I have paid more money for higher end cosmetics at Sephora which don't even come close to comparing to these. They are seriously a dream - I am mad I have so many other eye shadows at home because as soon as they are done I am re-vamping my whole palette with Creme de la Creme shadows!!! Their lipsticks were amazing too, I can't wait to go back when I have more time and create some customized eye shadows, lipsticks and perfumes!!!

OMG!!!! I hate to leave such a good review for such a small restaurant  (12 tables), but they deserve  all the credit! First up,  the Caesar  Salad....good, but just ok. Next course, the canneloni. ..I was used to the one at Vincent's with the cream sauce....this one was with red sauce, but the sauce  was so good....it was delicious!. Next course was a pizza quite possibly one of the best we have ever had. The people at the next table had pasta dishes that looked absolutely  delicious. This will garner a revisit for sure. The server was very nice and efficient.

Mm....yummy food. The Shrimp Fundido omelette is delicious.  Nothing needs to be added and it's still flavorful.  My husband had the Maggie's Special and the pancakes were pretty good, too. 

I love Red Mesa and have been there for lunch and dinner a bazillion times but this is my first time there for brunch and I enjoyed it. Definitely will coming back and more often.

First timer, the food was interesting but delish, service was very friendly and made some recommendations for new vegetarians. The platters were so fresh and nicely prepared. Shared a blueberry dessert that tasted like a graham cracker and mousse- it was mouth watering. Would be returning again soon
Best Thai in town. They know what's up when I ask for "spicy"! Friendly owners and staff, always a table, and always a pleasure. We love you Bangkokville :)
Favorite greek place in Tarpon Springs.  Love the fried cheese and the Gyro's.

Love this place, get there early for lunch a line forms.
Fresh shell fish, great clam chowder, my only complaint is that the bread bowls are kinda stale, over all always recommend it.
Thank you, Sunny

The service kills me here. It is horrible, delivery orders take well over an hour and a half. Every time I am seated with my 6 and 8 year old we are ignored for 30 minutes until someone brings us water. Typically our last 3 trips have taken us well over an hour to an hour and half just to get our food, and that doesn't count all the time to close the bill. The only reason we come here is because they have a good salad and the kids love pizza... So we meet half way. Next time not making the same mistake, ill eat my salad at home and go to a parlor where we aren't ignored. Granted the kids love the pizza, but the service makes me think digorno is a better choice.

Hmmm.. it's so tough to say, but I don't understand why places use the same doughnut dough base for every donut. I guess it would be fine if the topping:dough ratio was more even, but not so here. I find that the flavor of the topping tends to be overwhelmed by the dough, so I usually stick to the filled doughnuts. Love those. But my favorite thing about the place are the sliders and especially, the breakfast sandwiches. Oh be still my aching tummy!  they are so yummy and delicious!

Looks, from the street, like it would be good, but it was just okay. Our waitress pretty much forgot about us the entire time we were there. Not sure what that was all about. We tried practicing mindfulness to make the time pass while we were waiting for her to come back out and take our order. My nachos were disappointing--basically felt like a slice of cheese was melted over chips with globs of black beans. The kale salad was a warm mound of wilted kale mixed with parm cheese. My son liked his burger, so that was good.
Fantastic place with a great atmosphere and helpful employees. Beer selection is fantastic especially since you can drink while you shop.

This place is awesome, although a bit confusing for a first timer. It's not entirely clear on how it works if you haven't been there but everyone seems nice enough to explain, if asked. If you want wine, cheese, and/or meat get it in the entrance room. Otherwise, head outside to find a table. There is a full bar upstairs and food is ordered on the main level below that. 
I had two glasses of white wine which were decent size pours and delicious. I also had the fingerling potatoes (which were awesome, minus the beets) and freshly made fettuccine. Everything was delicious and the live music was great. Probably would be even more enjoyable when it's not over a hundred degrees out!

My friend and I did Keller's Magic Emporium. We really enjoyed it and were able to escape with minutes to spare. This was my sixth puzzle room and when I compare it with other rooms, it was just as unique and interactive. I would recommend Keller's room for beginner players as it is a bit easier than other rooms I have done.  I did note that the room was starting to show some wear and tear on some of the props, which is to be expected but did not affect the outcome. I'm looking forward to returning to try the other rooms at Escape City.

My husband and I went there for our first time on Friday night. We sat down at our table ordered drinks and received the drinks pretty fast. Our servers name was Courtney. She was polite and quick. We ordered 24 piece wings and when we had our food delivered it was only 12. She quickly fixed her mistake and then apologized. We didn't mind that mistake actually. By the time we finished our first basket of 12 we had a new basket of 12 hot wings. We thought she was great. Would go back again and have her as our server.

I used to love coming here because it was delicious and convenient  because I work in International Plaza, however this last visit might have turned me off for good. I was waiting for my sandwich to get made, when I spotted one of those employees picking at a scab. Being in the restaurant industry as long as I have, I can tell you that that's not attractive to any of your customers! Might be time to reevaluate your staff.

My husband booked a massage for me and the massage itself was wonderful! After checking in, I was pointed in the direction of the locker room which was a bit crowded with 5 women. The bench in front of the lockers only accommodates 2 people so I had to wait a few minutes before I was able to snag the last available locker and put on the plush robe they provide. 
There was no intake form like most spas have, but my massage therapist asked a lot of questions. When I told her I was pregnant (I don't have a belly yet) she seemed surprised and told me she would need to perform a prenatal massage. She explained the difference is that the heated table and hot stones are not used, and the calves are not massaged... And these exclusions cost an additional forty dollars. She asked if I was ok with that, which actually seemed unreasonable to me, but I was already there and ready for my massage so I said ok.  I have had prenatal massages at other spas in the past and none had such a steep surcharge. 
After my massage I headed back to the locker room, and was really looking forward to taking a shower alone, without my water-obsessed toddler for once. While they had toiletries available, they did not have a hair dryer so I sadly opted to forgo showering and walking across town with wet hair in January:( 
Overall while I have no complaints about the massage itself, it was not superior in any way to other nice spas in the city, and the amenities provided were lacking. How hard is it to provide a hair dryer??

I went here two weeks ago on a recommendation by a friend who uses a tattoo gun on ceramic. In over 40 years I never expected I'd want any ink.  After changing my mind I'm very glad I went to 805 Ink.

I made an appointment and was told they were busy ybut could fit me in the the next day with Jake. I'd heard good things about his work so agreed to take that spot. Normally I wouldn't have done so,  assuming there was a reason for the opening so soon. 

My tattoo was quite simple - Picasso's line drawing of his friend's dachshund on my shoulder. It's a symbol representing my service dog who happens to be a dachshund. Jake did a fantastic reproduction. He neither added or took away from the original. Yet somehow my right shoulder still had the touch of the tattoo artist. The piece is magnificent.

Such a disappointment.

We opted to go here after we found a long wait at another restaurant down the street. No greeter at the door, so we just stood there awkwardly until someone finally acknowledged us. We found our own seat outside. Not much of a view (fishing boats and houses across the canal) but outside was very clean. The waitress brought a menu, along with a list of specials in a gross plastic sleeve with stains on it. No drink menu. Waitress recommended a margarita, and said they had a house margarita but didn't know what was in it. 

Took 35 min for a grouper sandwich and fish/chips (place was maybe 1/3 full). Drinks were warm and melted by the time our food arrived. Table next to us had ordered after us and received their food before us. Grouper was by far the smallest I've ever been served and didn't taste fresh ($14). 

Overall, the food wasn't horrible. However the staff's 'don't care' attitude really takes away from this place.
The staff was amazingly attentive and personable.  They really paid attention to the allergy needs of my children which really put my mind at ease. Was not cheap but it was worth it. A great evening!

City Limits is an awesome little place over in Bellevue. In my opinion, on par or even better than Bread & Company, City Limits is less frou frou and has a generally better selections of soups, sandwiches, and salads. While perhaps comparative in price, you easily get out of here, with a drink, for less than $10, and the city max (pick 2: bowl of soup, half sandwich, half salad) is a great option if you want a light dinner (probably a bowl of soup) and something to take home the next day (probably one of the generously large half-paninis). 

I feel like City Limits is a warmer and much more low-key atmosphere than Bread&Co, offering a quick bite and a large and satisfying menu. Even so, I would go to Bread & Company for breads and pastries more likely than here.

Suggestions: Chicken jack panini, grilled cheese, Greek salad, cream of potato soup
The people here are very friendly, pleasant and polite.  Food always very hot and good quality.  Fast and efficient service too.

I've given this place a lot of chances since my last review, and I've definitely been impressed with the changes. They've slightly revamped the interior decor, but not only that, the food has become significantly better! It was definitely a pleasant surprise, and I have been making this a regular spot for my family and I. Not only is it a convenient location (rather than going all the way to northeast Philly) for Korean BBQ, but this place definitely gets a higher level of sanitation compared to the ones in northeast Philly! I would go back here just for the salad you get when you order your meats! If only I can recreate that at home, I'd be eating that all day.

I've bumped this place up to 4 stars because their food has gotten significantly better, and their prices aren't so ridiculous. I am always going home with leftovers for fourth meal! You will probably find me stuffing my face with kbbq there every other week!

Absolutely incredible experience at Luke! My boyfriend and I went on a weekend trip to New Orleans and Richy Rich waited on us. He was personable, friendly and had great recommendations. He even sat down with us and gave us the recipe for their incredible brussel sprouts. We ordered a few appetizers and oysters and he talked to us about their happy hour and invited us to come back the next day. (We ordered a half dozen oysters but they gave us a dozen at no extra charge!!) We came back the next day and he waited on us again. He put in the appetizer we loved from the night before AND gave us two glasses of champagne as soon as we sat down - ALL complimentary! The fact that he remembered us, remembered our order and felt compelled to treat us so special is pretty amazing. Customer service is tough, but he makes it seem like he's having the best time in the world! He joked with us that the food is almost as good as the service but truly, he's right! The food AND the service are top notch. Richy Rich made our trip so much more special and we are already looking forward to coming back next time we stop in NOLA! Thank you, Richy Rich & the whole Luke staff!

We are regular customers here at Orchids Thai and we love it. Food and service are consistently good.  Egg roll appetizers are fresh and home-made, as is the "M-1" fried tofu appetizer. Their fried tofu is the best I have ever eaten anywhere, bar none. It is never even a tiny bit greasy, always flawlessly done, with the perfect plum sauce for dipping. Both their Thai and their Japanese dishes are wonderful. Their prices are very reasonable, and their lunch specials are truly a good value. You get soup, egg roll, and your lunch entree, all for one fair price. For dessert, try the banana coins or the Thai donuts! Yum! If you like fresh, home-made food at a good price along with attentive, professional service, Orchids Thai is for you.

Waitress left food to sit and get cold while fries cooked. So my husband had hot fries, but the burger, and my cedar grilled fish, rice, and broccoli were ice cold. When I complained they took my plate away and reheated the fish, but the sides were left cold. My husband but into his burger to find the bacon severely undercooked. After all this, they did not offer any discount or comp. Never going to this location again. Apparently, if the food sucks, it's on your wallet. Call me crazy, but I go to a restaurant intending on paying for hot food.

Came here for lunch with my family. The queso dip is amazing. Margaritas are good and the burrito was delicious. Not only was the food fantastic but the staff here is very friendly and very fast service. We all agree we will definitely be coming back. Definitely our new go to Mexican restaurant.

Love antique stores. This one is like a corn maze, you might need someone to lead you out to the exit or send up a flare. I spent 2 hours in here recently. The staff is really helpful, friendly, and accessible. There are a few walking around when you need to see an item in a case. I found a lot of things I "need". Prices vary like any antique mall, some are right on the money while others are way too high. I like to cruise at my own pace and there is plenty of room and plenty of rooms with a wide variety of pieces.

Total sweetness.  I just moved here from Chicago and I have found a shopping haven, thanks Yelpers!!!  Scored Rag & Bone jeans, a Vera Wang top and T-Bags tank for a TOTAL of $27!!  

I saw labels by Lanvin, Vivan Westwood, Jil Sander, Ferragamo to name a few.  Yes, you have to dig around racks but the ladies who work here are very sweet and helpful.  Definetly digging Nashville so far.. :)

Fantastic! I never had samosas so flaky and fresh. Loved the crispy avocado chaat and naan. We all tried shrimp biryani, chicken korma and lamb vindaloo. We appreciated being able to choose the heat of the spices. The rice was unique and wonderful. The entrees were fresh and delicious. Sauces- excellent. I loved that the serving sizes were just right. The service was attentive and informative. This will be my new go-to restaurant when guests come to town!

I started by joining the 6 week challenge, once it was over I joined Fox Fitness as a member. Becky is very motivating, caring and helpful.  She is always there for any questions you may have and caters to all fitness levels. She constantly walks around to make sure you are in the right form during the workout. Becky and the Fox fitness family are a wonderful team to be a part of!
Adrienne was an excellent server! She took the time to be personal and jovial throughout the dining experience! More should be like her!!!Thanks, Adrienne!

Between the coquito and authenticity of the food one tends to forget where the food was purchased - in TN far from the Caribbean. My advise to everyone is, "order the chefs choice." This allows the chef to be creative and really surprise you. Make sure to inform them of anything you might not want. You will be left satisfied.

We did a "Cook and Catch," where we caught fish in the bayou and brought it to the restaurant.  Chef Glen put an amazing meal together: 12 filets for 3 of us, grits, spinach and a delicious corn dish.  Satisfied my California pallet without question.  Delicious, nuanced and well prepared.  Staff was great too!

Ate here for lunch. One word to describe my food experience... "Confused". Had the chicken club and the husband had the Denver omelette. Two very common menu items but they were different. Service was good but not sure about the food. Just wasn't right for my taste buds. Lastly, if you're going to use the Axxess card, it is NOT buy one get one free! I only got $6.50 off. Think I will call Axxess to update them.

Really great bagels. My go to is the bacon, egg and cheese on a plain toasted bagel (pumpkin or french toast bagel if that's the 'Bagel of the Month'). The house blend coffee is really good as well. The prices are bit on the expensive side, but the quality is good and worth the price.

I used to love this place but I haven't been here in several months. I had an opportunity to go today and was excited. When I got there the place was empty, it used to be packed at lunch on a weekday. The fact that it was empty should have been a warning. I ordered and was surprised when I was told there was no fountain soda, only bottles. I placed my order and sat down. The dining room was greasy and not very clean. I waited so long for my order, a burger and fries, that I had to switch it to a to go order. I don't understand why it took so long since I was the only customer. When I got my food the fries had been cooked so many times they were hard and the burger was tasteless. I was extremely disappointed. I will not be returning. 
This location gives Elevation Burger a bad name.
Absolutely great pizza. and awesome sandwiches.  Get the Farmhouse pizza for a real treat.  Quick service, reasonable prices, casual atmosphere.

First: This place is a solid place to get some work done. Big tables allow you to spread out and the internet connection is good despite the place being full. I also like how spacious it is. 

Second: The service is good...when you're there. There was one Saturday morning when I called hoping to just order a grab and go before a morning tee time and the girl who picked up said they don't do takeout orders on the weekends. Before I could ask if she meant over the phone or at all (walking there and ordering was still an option for me), she had already hung up. Didn't even say bye so I kind of just kept talking until the line went dead (oops). 

Third: The food is serviceable, I guess. I don't think most people go here for dinner plans but eat when they're hungry in the middle of getting some work done. For that reason, it's a solid food place. I typically have the bagel and lox, though, hard to screw that up. The fiance had a salad with chicken and it was below average, if not poor and the food did take awhile. Two or three parties who ordered after us got their food before us.

Points for: Good place to get work done: big tables, a lot of room to work. Coffee
No points: Salads

I found this place Thanks to a coupon in my book tried it loved the food but the servise was awful the first time then I went in today and the service was 10 times better and who ever was running the register defiantly had her crew together and the food is amazing best sub shop I have had here :)

Signature Parking have provided the valet service at our corporate HQ since 2016. Wow! Every single interaction has been spot-on. From the contract negotiation to the account management and billing. Seriously. They have immaculate customer service. I don't know what they do to keep their valet attendants happy, but they hire well and there has been very little turnover. This is white-glove service at its best. If you are looking for the best, look no further. They blow the competition out of the water.

Love their pizza and their baked goods even more. Their seeing spots cake is delicious. I love their white mushroom pizza. It's a pick up pizza joint and the service is always friendly. I also enjoy their soups!

Car shopping is supposed to be fun & exciting. Car dealerships are getting increasingly hard to write. Why does every car salesman think & act like women in general are stupid.
They tried to lead me around by the hand & show me practical cars. I am not a soccer mom ( not that there is anything wrong with soccer moms).
I want a fun exciting car & buying it needs to be the same, not gonna happen here. After 3 dealership bad experiences, I am taking a break. I love my car, maybe I need to just keep it.
What's a girl to do? maybe stay away from car dealerships?
Much needed Verizon store back in town with a new management team, was a nice change from regular stores , very friendly and knowledgeable,staff.would highly recommend.

Everyone treated me great! The care given was fine and I have no complaints about any individual or my care.
However, I may choose an alternative next emergency. 
They were playing FOX NEWS loud and clear in the waiting room. The equivalent of Sensationalized Propaganda TV. I felt I'd wandered into a Nazi Camp. I got up and moved away with my back to the TV but still had to listen!
Yes, I'm gay and liberal, but, I do not expect to have to be bombarded with ANY (liberal, conservative or religious) extremely divisive TV in a medical arena. 
Play the 80's music louder for God's sake! Sheesh!
No thinking person does this by accident. So it must mean Ochsner Urgent Care prefers it.
FOX NEWS!? Am I in Arkansas?

*** I really thought every individual was great.
The veggie burgers are just morning stars, and the fry portions are very small. For a vegetarian this is not a good option.

Great buffet! The owners make all the food from scratch. The handmade Nan bread is brought to your table & is hot from the kitchen. You'll love the food & friendly owners too. Sign up for coupons when you check out & you'all be texted 50% off coupons on a regular basis.

I remember when I first discovered Flying Cupcake.  It was the highlight of my day if I checked facebook and saw that cookie dough was a flavor of the day.  That is until the day I met the chocolate ganache cupcake.  Sadly, that was about 6 years ago and things have changed.  Prices have gone up (inflation, I get it), but quality has gone down.  My most recent encounter was with the salted caramel chocolate, which sounded like a match made in heaven. Sadly, it was not.  The frosting had a weird sticky consistency, and the cake was dry, until you got to the middle which was filled with caramel.  This experience isn't very different from others I've had, but the number of locations and their food truck is why I keep trying... They're everywhere!

So, this is coming from a guy who has yet to actually purchase anything besides glasses from here.. But, I love this place.

First off, the staff is incredibly amazing. I really appreciate their sense of style, but on top, you get people that are EXTREMELY accommodating. I can't say that I've met a more friendly group of people in single store. I find myself talking to these guys way longer than anticipated every time I go in there. Huge plus, the service. 

The quality of product there is top notch.. I know the price tag to mostly everything is pretty high, but the quality product means you won't have to purchase the same thing over and over again. I love that I can walk in and try on red wing iron rangers, whites semi dress boots, and warby Parker's all in one place. 

If you want authentic incredible quality american product, you've found your place. Bring all your money.

Even though I live in the Philadelphia area, it took an episode of the Food Network's "Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives" to finally get me off my keister to visit Honey's Sit-N-Eat.  I heard wonderful things, but the tales of long wait times for a table made me stay away.  As luck would have it, my dining companion and I found ourselves free for lunch on a Monday.  Impressively, the restaurant was full around noon and people were waiting by the time we left.  We chose to sit at the counter, just to get a better view of the whole scene.  It's small-ish, quaint and kitschy, but I wouldn't settle for anything less.  Ave was our tattooed hipster-looking server and couldn't have been friendlier or more attentive.  Here's what we ordered, as we wanted to get a good sampling of what all Honey's had to offer.  We shared the Bubby's Brisket Omelet and ordered the cheese & onion latke, biscuit and grits to go with it.  They also have this amazing blueberry preserves which was yummy on the biscuit.  The grits were super creamy and decadent.  Admittedly, I'm not a connoisseur of grits but I thought this bowl of velvet corn mush was fantastic.  Then, we moved on to the Chicken Chili Frito Pie, as seen on the Food Network.  Um, yeah, worth it.  It was a beautiful plate with lettuce, tomato, sour cream and a heaping helping of Fritos with flavorful chicken chili.  I do believe some cheese was melted in there as well.  We rounded our dining experience with a glass of freshly squeezed orange juice and copious amounts of locally roasted La Colombe coffee.  They brought new meaning to the term, "bottomless cup," as our server was quick to refill at the drop of a hat.  (So very much appreciated.)  Oh, then the grand finale was the Jewish Apple Cake with Pecan Streusel.  This HUGE slice of cake was moist and flavorful.  I mean seriously, this slice was huge.  My comment to the server was, "Wow, how big is the bundt pan it bakes in?!"  Even though we didn't have to wait to be seated on this visit, I would not hesitate to wait if I had to in the future.  The food is fresh and delicious.  It's as if you could taste the care, pride and craftsmanship in every bite.  This brunch for two was, I believe, about $30 before tip.  I felt like it was a steal in exchange for the good mood fueled by Southern-Jewish cuisine that floated us out of there.  So, go bubbeleh, get to Honey's Sit-N-Eat!

Sure, they make good cannoli, but the problem is.......you cannoli eat so many ;)

Lame jokes aside, I've always been impressed with this place.  Nice people. Fair prices. Delicious strawberry shortcake.  What's left to be desired???

I hate how I even have to give 1 star. 

My co-workers and I are frequent Porch visitors, and by frequent I mean everyday. So when we heard that the Porch was making major changes we were a little excited ..that was until we received the horrible news that the food trucks would no longer be apart of our everyday lunch experience. We actually looked forward to the variety of food trucks that we would be able to choose from every day, a monthly print out of the choices would be circulated throughout the office and hung up on our desks in anticipation.. but now, we are left with one food truck consisting of six options and a few patches of "grass" to sit on. 

Opening day of the truck we decided to check it out. I ordered the watermelon feta salad and the BBQ chips w/ ranch dip. One co-worker ordered the porchetta and another ordered the fish tacos. My watermelon feta salad was okay (remind me never to order it again).. not too thrilled about the mint topping. The BBQ chips were also okay, that dip might just be the single worst thing I've ever tasted and as far as the porchetta, its not a sandwich as described to be, but rather an awkward pile of extremely fatty pork meat (that had to be thrown away by more than one person I know to have tried it). The fish tacos seemed to be the better of the choices, although it was mentioned the random cut sized fish and soggy tortillas. I don't even feel its necessary to mention the prices as I'm sure it's easy to figure out how over priced it is.

We are now forced to rummage through 30th Street Station in hopes of finding something edible for our lunch. Thanks Porch @ 30th Street, you have now turned our lunching into just another boring hour of our day.

ULTIMATE POTATO BURGER
(2) 1/2 pound patties topped with Applewood Smoked Bacon, Potatoes and melted cheese - $11.99

If you consider yourself anything of a Foodie, you MUST try this one out. Better yet, let it try you out, because it's that big. Now I have a killer appetite; however, through the words of Adam Richman, "Food Won"! This burger is absolutely absurd (In a good way, that is)! From the Patties, to the Smashed Potatoes and Cheesy Goodness, to the Applewood Smoked Bacon, this will sure test your taste buds. If you're not in it for a burger, be sure to check out Tony's Pizza's or his Signature Tenderloin. You will not walk away hungry or displeased!

As far as location and ambiance goes, it couldn't be better. Tony's is located in Downtown Alton, which is a quiet little town on the Mississippi, about 30 minutes from St Louis. If you want a piece of history, you can get it here. Being in business since 1954, their dining room will draw you in with it's deep colored walls, pressed tin ceiling, and the amber Tiffany lamps adding the perfect glow over the cozy private booths. And if that's too snazzy, check out their Third Street Cafe, a 75 seat Prohibition bar with a charming sidewalk cafe.

Great space in a converted train station acts as lobby and bar area. Good location. Its a little awkward that many of the rooms are across a small footbridge in a newer part of an attached mall. Try and stay in the original part of the building. We had a group of 17 visiting and to watch the Cardinals at Busch Stadium. Very convenient. Hospitality was up to Marriott standards. Dinner was slow for a party of 10. Room service excellent. Randy at the front door with the Bellmen was a standout!

My family has ordered quite a few items from here. The flowers are always fresh, last at least a week (depending on what flowers of course), and the arrangements are always flush and well designed.

This place not only does amazing work but is also generous and cares about the community! I volunteer with an organization called PACAC that helps to organize many of the college fairs in the state of PA. We host an annual conference every year and Risher Van Horn was the only florist in the area kind enough to donate. 

The fact that they are a small business of the community and care enough about the community to give back is reason enough for me to give them my business, the fact that their work is top notch is icing on the cake!

Me and my cuz stopped by for lunch today, place is sooooooo adorable, we got the poutine and a white pizza with clams, bacon, garlic sauce n fresh mozzarella. Both were sooooooooo amazingly delicious!!! Gabby was so nice and gave us a glass of complementary delicious red wine. This is my new favorite spot, and right up the street, can't wait to try other stuff on the menu!

Not a store, its a destination.  I am obsessed with this place.  There aren't a lot of reasons that I actually like about living in St. Pete, but this is one of them.  Any time i am in the area, I stop in.  I am not a fan of crowded bars, markets, or anything else, but i will brave this one any hour of the day, any day of the week.  

It's a gem!  The fresh mozzerella is the best I've ever had (including being IN Italy).  The deli selection, fresh pasta, sandwiches, bakery (desserts and breads) are all top notch.  Everything I have bought from here has been great.  Its worth traveling to even if you aren't in the area.  They have a bunch of ready to eat food that they will heat up, or you can take home and "make" and amazing dinner just by heating a few things up yourself.  

I go here every chance I get, and haven't had anything bad,  I like that there is more than just Italian here too.  Granted 90% of the fresh bread, dessert, and prepared foods could be considered Italian, they do have lots of dry goods that have a more international flair to them.

If you grew up up north, where there seems to be an old school "little Italy" area in most cities, and want to find something from there, this is the place to look.  One side note:  the desserts are really sweet, I think they go best with something from the coffee bar which is almost always got a good crowd at it, or enjoy it on the patio out front.

I read the reviews and almost "went out" to eat as I was staying at the Gaylord Inn....but I decided to go for it and eat at The Grill. I went to the bar to eat and Fred greeted me shortly after I sat down. But that was the only "shortly" for the rest of my dinner. The restaurant was not at that full and half of the stools at the bar were taken. I got my beer and started looking at the menu and decided to go with the Trace Atkins catfish. I am going to go ahead and say right now that Trace does not know he lended his name to this sorry excuse for catfish. I made my selections and closed the menu, a clear signal to any waiter that an order is ready to be taken. Literally four pass by's later I let Fred know that I was ready to order. I did and the food took a little longer to come than what I had hoped but not obnoxiously long...but my beer was dry and I pushed it the edge of the counter and Fred just kept waking by. After I got his attention, he refilled my beer. Two seats down from me, same deal, another guy had to get Fred's attention to get him another beer. My food came and the portion was not small but not huge either...I had been driving for 9.hours with just a small bag of beef jerky and peanuts so I was famished. I also got the coleslaw, fries and broccoli with cheese. The coleslaw was clearly old, the fries were a tad soggy and the cheese on the broccoli was...gritty? All in all the meal was just right at average. The total bill was $23 and if it had been higher I would have possibly complained but clearly here, you get what you pay for. When I was done, once again I had to grab Fred's attention. When I got my bill, I paid and Fred was actually quick to close me out. So, he was quick to greet and quick to close out but in between he could use some help. I don't think I will be back tomorrow night as I am in town for two nights. The beer prices are reasonable though.

First time eating at Crabby Bills...we had the BBQ wings for an appetizer and the meat was tender, sauce was tangy.  For our entree we had the Lobster sandwich and Sea Scallops.  Overall the food was juicy and delicious...service was good in spite of it being packed - our server Kelly was very pleasant and attentive...will definitely return in the future..

I'm going to start with OMG! The food was amazing. I gave the 5 stars but the service is about 3.5. They are a little slow coming to the table to check you out but Elias really good about getting the orders in and getting the food out. I will be visiting this spot in the future. I really don't know what else to add.

Just had an amazing gel manicure and spa pedicure at Symphony Nails. The salon is very clean and relaxing. The nail stations are not cramped together and the decorations are nice. The pictures don't do it justice! Also, they have a really nice large selection of gel polishes. My pedicure included a hot stone message and while I was getting my manicure, one of the girls gave me a very nice back massage. The whole experience was just excellent!! The salon is under new management and have been opened for about 4 months. I highly recommend checking them out.

Very nice hotel. Lobby was awesome. Everyone was so friendly. Food was some of the best we have had in LA. Rooms and food fair price. Rooms small like all old hotels built 70+ years ago. Room was really nice and clean.  Room even had a "clean" smell. Rooftop was nice to hang out with friends. Rooftop pool.  Great location. Can't wait to go back.

The quality of the bbq was great - I got ribs and pork bbq. Ribs are cooked well with great flavor. 

Only draw backs - as with many smoked meat restaurants - they have certain items only until they sell out, since they take several hours to cook. They were out of brisket which my friend really wanted to try. 

Also, side items are somewhat small for cost - but all good options.

Moonshine mojitos were awesome!

A little below average on food taste. I like to get waffles with peanut butter chips and maybe grits. No healthy options other than eggs. Very cheap and friendly staff are a plus. Not very clean either but it's been here a while. You get what you pay for here. And when you  don't have a lot $ it works, better tasting than fast food!

Food was very good. Service was great. The restaurant though was very small and loud, which is fine, but I was unprepared for it. My dad doesn't have the best ears so unless I yelled, we couldn't really talk the entire time we were there.

In the mood for a pastry this morning so I had to stop by. The selection of baked goods is varied and delicious! I ordered the baked cherry fritter and an iced cappuccino. I have to say, it was way better than Starbucks (and better priced). I came here a few months ago and tried the heart healthy orange cookies and the Linzer cookies, they did not disappoint. Everything is fresh, the staff is nice and I prefer to frequent local establishments.

The concept of fast and fresh, build your own items is a home run with this Greek themed restaurant. First choose what you want: pita, salad, wrap, bowl, or a greekadilla (yes, a quesadilla with greek ingredients). You have different types of wraps and pitas you can choose from too. Next you choose the meat, rice, veggies, and finally the sauce or dressing.Gyro meat is cooked and shaved right behind the counter. Get a side of dip, hummus, or salad if you wish but I always find my wrap is gi-normous that I can cut it in half and eat again later. I always get a wrap because of this reason. I really enjoy the spicy feta and the red pepper hummus! I've tried most of the sauces but I think the classic and roasted red pepper are my favorite. I didn't get much out of the lemon avocado sauce but the ingredients I chose may have overpowered the sauce. Grab a bottle of sriracha or other hot sauce and you are good to go!They do have a kids menu and catering! The decor is hip and trendy and they do have a TV if you want to catch the latest on Sportscenter while yo eat!

This place has a great happy hour! Probably one of the best happy hours in town actually. They have a $5 appetizer menu as well as great deals on wine and cocktails. We had to drive back to LA that night so could not enjoy too much, but I look forward to coming back when we don't have a big drive ahead of us and indulging in drinks and appetizers for a great price!

Hidden in the wasteland known as "Downtown Oldsmar", this friendly and clean tavern deserves more traffic than it gets. They have a huge selection of beers, and some decent food to go along with it.

If you have never heard of "Downtown Oldsmar", don't feel bad... Use your GPS and life will be good.

IMA is a free museum in the heart of Indianapolis.  Looking for something to do with the kids that wouldn't break the bank we figured we would give it a shot.  And I must say I was pleasantly surprised.  I think I enjoyed it more than the kids.  Unlike some other museums in town they don't have a whole lot to interest them.  Although they do have a nice interactive kids area there.  Maybe next time we will have a chance to check out the grounds and some of the other non-main attractions there.

There's a saying in Nashville, go get a Sprinkles cupcake...or two. We made that up, but you should go. We had a strawberry and banana cupcake. The banana was the most delicious cupcake that I've ever had. After we walked down the 12 south, we got two more. We should have got more.

The food here is awesome!!!!! My boyfriend is a Fried Chicken Connoisseur...he says their fried chicken is some of the best he's ever had. I had the BBQ Pulled Pork Sammix. I was a very happy girl. Yummy. The bartender was awesome too! She was great, suggesting beers for us to try and what would go well with our meals. Great!!
Happy I chose Dr. Reichman as my doctor for this pregnancy. Appointments are always on time never have to wait long at all unlike most other doctors.

Jones is by far my least favorite Stephen Starr restaurant.

First off, the decorum is far too kitschy for me. It's corny to the point where it's uncomfortable. There is nothing attractive to me about eating in my weird great-aunt's 1970's apartment. 

More importantly, the food + drink leaves much to be desired. I've had the portobello burger, the ALT (avocado lettuce tomato), and something else that I can't remember. It's all just mediocre. Certainly nothing worth writing home about. Drinks, as others have mentioned, are overpriced and not delicious.

Probably the worst part is that the food might actually taste better if you were eating it in a room without a carpeted floor.  Jones just reminds me of having to eat at your friends house whose parents never redecorated.

I haven't been to this deli in awhile. The food has improved. The staff is welcoming and there is a small room to sit and eat in the back. There were many items on the menu, which I'll have to try soon. This morning, I ordered the pork roll, egg, and cheese on a Kaiser roll. The sandwich was soft and tasty. Well worth the short wait.  The place could be a little cleaner inside. Not sure I would dine in but take out seems okay.

Refuel Cafe has a menu item called the Big Breakfast. It included 3 eggs, sunny side up. 4 pieces of toast. 3 andouille sausages. A hearty handful of russet burbank breakfast potatoes. It was served alongside a large cup of dark roast coffee.

It was yummy. I was satisfied. This is the best breakfast I've had in New Orleans. Go here.

I give the staff 5 stars because they were totally accommodating, patient, professional and courteous.  I asked for a roll-away bed & it arrived shortly after check-in.  I asked for towels the next morning & got them right away.


But this place....when I think of a Starwood hotel, I think of modern luxury.  This is not luxurious at all.  I am not impressed.  The walls in my room are riddled with putty filled holes and other botched repair attempts.  The bathtub should just be yanked out.  The view from my room is a construction zone!  I woke up to the sound of construction on an early Saturday morning.  I asked for an upgrade or access to the club lounge but was denied since they are completely booked.  They gave me points instead.  I wish I could've at least gotten a free stay out of it or the lounge access :(.

The classes are amazing, fun, and very informative!!! The staff is very helpful and very knowledgeable with all the firearms as well as keep a keen eye on the range. If you want a great experience then this is the place to come!!!!

We had another appointment  with Susan ( Cloud 9 Grooming ) this week. WOW, she's great! 
She's punctual, quick and did a great job grooming both toy poodles. She arrived exactly at 9:00 and was gone by 10:30. Both dogs are clean, smell nice, perfectly groomed and I didn't have to get out of my pajamas. LOVE her service!

Very fast and thorough from beginning to end.

Stopped in Trend Eye Care a day after making an appointment, and was greeted by a friendly front-office staff and a bright room. The reception staff worked through a somewhat complicated insurance situation and after a short wait, I was in the examination room. An assistant got me started with some quick tests, and Dr. Dinh was in shortly thereafter. Following his examination, I was off to look at glasses, picked them out and had them all set up within about 20 minutes. The next day I went to pick up -- super easy (they even tightened my fiancee's glasses, free of charge).

Even though it's a ways from where I live, Trend Eye Care is definitely going to be my optometrist/optician shop.
Food was very good especially for a chain restaurant.  Service was a little slow. Overall a good experience though.

This is a very nice place to get breakfast or lunch. The atmosphere is great, very relaxed. The food is good too. I usually get the tuna salad sandwich and chips and I'm always very happy with my choice. My boyfriend has gotten the breakfast before, which I tried, and it is also very good. I would recommend stoping by for lunch!

Be ready to have the time of your life!
LEX Nightclub is the most upscale, classy, and exotic nightclub in Reno! I had the privilege of being invited to their soft grand opening for VIP's before the general public could see it. When you walk in, there is a large and extravagant bar in the middle. The well lit bar features all the drinks you could imagine. The bartenders are more than accommodating. They try their best to make you exactly what you desire to drink. Next to the large bar by the entrance is a seating area composed of small leather ottomans and tables. Here you can enjoy talking to your friends and being able to hear one another. Once you pass this area, the fun begins. LEX features an indoor, lighted pool. The pool is adjacent to the dance floor which is lit up by the amazing light technicians and ambiance directors. There are about 4 dancers dancing at all times throughout the night. Surrounding the pool and dance floor are the booths and tables available for reservation for bottle service. These booths actually have enough space to dance by which is surprising because most clubs tend to pack everything together. You cannot feel crowded and pushed at LEX because it has a very open floor plan allowing people to move about smoothly. In the area where the dance floor and pool is, there are two more large bars to accommodate the large number of guests. The bartenders, wait staff, management team, advertising team, and bottle service ladies are all very welcoming and friendly. They will dance with you on the stage whether you are 25 or 75 years old. Yes, one of the bottle service ladies was dancing with an senior citizen gentlemen for a very long time. They really will do anything to make your night at the club an unforgettable one! This was my first ever club experience and I'm very glad it was at LEX because I have never seen or heard of a club as amazing as this one.

Really nice guys who don't try to gouge you for unnecessary work.  Got me in and out pretty quickly.  If you want something specific though, make sure it's clear before they start.  I assumed that they would match the existing diameter of my exhaust system - but they necked it down to make it easier for them to clear my rear axle.  My fault for not making that clear before they started!

My wife and I have been here multiple times now. We've had a great experience every single time. The boba teas are awesome and the sandwiches are huge. The Pad Thai is also very good. The staff is always very friendly and the customer base leads me to believe that it's a very authentic place.

This place was probably nice back in the day, but it needs a major facelift! Playground equipment old, indoor play areas dirty, staff rather unfriendly/not helpful, trails overgrown, don't waste your time here when Johnson's Farm is in nearby Medford- it is a thousand times better.
Their food at both locations is great and seasoned to perfection! And they give you so much food that I eat off 1 platter for 3 days. Should be voted the best soulfood in Philadelphia

Sushi Bar never disappoints! The flavor of the food here is consistent. The Jalapeño Roll is my all time favorite. Not many rolls have a good combo of flavor and are actually spicy. The jalapeño sauce on top makes it. Other rolls here are great too just have my favorite there.

January 2nd visit & probably my last 

Posted a tip earlier about how rude a waitress was here. Name I believe is precilla or however you spell it. She saw us walk up to the restaurant and stand to "wait to be seated" and she totally ignored us. She stared at us rudely in a span of 10 minutes to just ignore us again. One of the other waitress saw us and wanted to help seat us but that's when the rude waitress finally decided to help us. I currently saw the reviews here after the incident and if I would have known how bad their customer service is then we never would have ate here. 

Anyways, here ONLY for a milk shake. Ordered it almost 30 minutes ago and it's still not here. Awesome! 

Don't go here. There's a cafe upstairs. Go there lol
This museum has so many great works of art from all over the world. A lovely cafe with great food is available, and all the staff was very friendly and helpful. Plus, parking and admission are free!

Ninki has beautiful food. I love going for lunch or getting take out whenever I'm in Nashville.
The only reason I'm giving 4 instead of 5 stars is that their fried rice used to be AMAZING, just the best, but last time it was more greasy than usual, couple of my Nashville friends said the same thing. 
But regardless of the rice, it is nice, stylish, pretty, and tasty.

Have you tried Chick-Fil-A breakfast?  If you haven't you should go today!  I love this place for breakfast.  A chicken biscuit sounds a little odd at first but trust me they are great!  The employees are always very nice a chick Fill A too.

My boyfriend has had a really hard time finding a good barber. After seeing Meister's in Philly Mag he decided to give it a try. He loved the atmosphere, prices are reasonable and his barber really took his time and made sure he was happy with his cut and shave. Free beer was also a bonus! I love the cuts he gets there and he'll definitely be going back.
Always good and fresh food! Best grits in town.  And the good service makes it better.

Whoa!  Sunday nights sports nights. Wow!  My wife and I wanted a later dinner and we stopped in Dooney's. We have been here many times before and I get the Reuben and she loves the healthy salmon salad. But stop the press - they have a special menu on a sheet of paper that was just outstanding!  First of all I was blown away by $2 drafts and $3 23 ounce beers. What a savings. And you can get nachos for $4, nachos supreme for $6 and they have Irish nachos for $4. Try them!  Then what got us was the $5 cheesesteaks!  So forget healthy tonight-we pigged out and took home the other half of the cheesesteaks. I had 2 big beers (she was driving) and our tab came to $26. Not to mention I could watch my Packers win on our personal table side TV!!!  I love this place!
Food, service, seating was all great. I do think it's stingy for restaurants to charge a $1 for a side of sauce...

Never again. I have been threw drive thur 3 time every time my order was messed up, On top of this. I emailed the corporate office one week has passed with no response. Seems they care nothing of my service or myself.

This is Japanese with options.  You can have a Benihana-type meal where they cook in front of you, or you can sit at the sushi bar, or you can sit at a regular table.  Wherever you choose, you will have to keep asking yourself if you're still in Indianapolis.  The decor is stunning!  The place looks totally nondescript from the outside, but don't be fooled.  I've been to dozens of Japanese restaurants all over the US and Hawaii - this one is the best, by far.  Unbelievable!
FABULOUS food.  Millions of options for vegetarians and vegans.  I don't remember the name of the veg sushi I had as an appetizer, but when it came out it was hard to eat because it was pure artistry.  What a gorgeous plate!  The individual rolls were arranged around a giant swirled design of sauces in 4 or 5 bright colors - the most beautiful presentation I've ever seen anywhere.  If I remember correctly, the rolls included sweet potato, some other veggies, rice, and all topped by a slice of ripe mango.  WOW.  
I also enjoyed a veggie dish with big, fat Udon noodles.  Delicious!  
Great seaweed salad - one of my test plates at any Japanese restaurant.
My friend had raw fish sushi and a fried rice with meat...  He kept saying "Oh my God..."  every time he tried something whether it was what he ordered or one of my choices.  He is a world traveler and he lives in Chicago - the man knows good food!
I can't close without mentioning the prices.  How low can you go???  Incredible - and this is NOT a chain, thank goodness.  Support your independents!!!  Also, enormous portions and a giant menu so nobody will be unhappy.
Ample free parking - this place is in a small strip mall.
Lovely restrooms, in keeping with the whole restaurant.
Super service!  Everyone was of Asian descent, and each person had a friendly smile.  Our server was a wonderful young woman who was on-the-spot with beverage refills and plate removal.  
If you've all but given up on a perfect restaurant experience in Indianapolis, this place WILL change your mind.
Nice service, good sweet tea, perfectly seasoned fried chicken, greens so good the kids might eat them. Only downside? I feel like I need to see my cardiologist after eating here.

OKAY - LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS PLACE.  Not just for breakfast either.  It is healthy and while the downtown location is sometimes difficult to park by, the La Cumbre location is WICKEDLY easy and fast.

The bowls are delicious - I always get the island bowl and coffee with cashew milk - delicious.

The employees are great.  Brought in my best guy and he adored it - even over his choice room service at the 4 seasons!  Yum!
Great food, fresh food . Clean and lots of entertainment,, Quick service . First time here defiantly ! Will be back ! I left with a fantastic experience . Quick service , fantastic beer.

I have a finicky dog and One Lucky Dog has the only treats my little girl will eat.   The staff are always so warm, friendly, and helpful.    I especially love Heather who grooms Rosie.  She comes back to me so soft, clean, and beautiful.  And the prices, I feel are very reasonably.
We had the White pizza last night and it was excellent. This is a great place and a welcome addition to our neighborhood.
This place is great! The bartenders will serve up some creative and fantastic cocktails here. Trendy vibe that makes me feel like Posh Spice.

You don't get better frozen custard than this. It's all good, you can't order anything that isn't delish here. Don't be daunted by the lines, they move fast. You'll be in shock how fast this operation gets the product out. My husband, who's spent most of his life in California just stood and watched them and couldn't believe the speed and efficiency. He also wondered why on earth there was nothing like this in SoCal. We don't miss Ted's- winter or summer- when we visit my family every year. The lemon frozen custard with crumbled graham crackers is to die for--tastes like Grandma's lemon cream ice box pie.

This place is amazing! Encompasses the true culture of NOLA. The wait was a little long, but that's to be expected in the Quarters. The various mimosa offerings were also a highlight. Can't wait to visit again!

Found this place as we were on our way to a tour and had some extra time. I am SO glad we did. This was one of the best breakfasts I've had. We ordered the breakfast burrito, the Montana Plate, and the French toast. Everything was delicious (especially the grits), but nothing was as delicious as the French toast. By far the best French toast I've ever had. Definitely a place to try!

Had to climb over other patrons to get to seat.  "Cozy" = shoulder to shoulder dining with strangers. If your a standard pub burger person do not go here.  The burgers are ridiculously expensive and frankly too fancy for my taste.  I had two bites of a $30 burger and couldn't eat the rest.  I ordered it medium,  but it came still mooing.  Basically raw.  Waiter was friendly and empathetic,  however I was with my wife and didn't want to make a scene.  Don't go here if you just want a good burger.  If you want to up the doochy factor in your life then go right ahead.  Not for me.

Excellent food!  The atmosphere is cozy friendly staff is very accommodating. The owner came out and talked to us. The Curry mussels were excellent. The oxtails make make you lick your fingers and the escovitch was very good. We were celebrating mom's birthday and they even gave her a free dessert. Will definitely come back when I'm in town.
