My sister said the bathrooms are so clean and smells great. Overall it was a nice birthday for my mother!

Every time I come to this location is a different disappointment. Sometimes, they don't have MOCHA, who runs out of Mocha in a coffee place? Plus, their coffee at this location is watery compared to others. I may just stop coming here altogether!

Yum! All you can eat breakfast...and then some! The sausage, biscuits and eggs were great. The pancakes were awesome though. I seem some visits in my future just for the pancakes. 

The staff was very welcoming. Unknowingly we got there five minutes before bfast was over, but they let us know that they would keep everything warm until we had our fill.

They sell a variety of things that I want to go back and browse when we have more time...homemade soap, pies, breads and pastries and a wall I'd homemade candy. I think that they actually serve lunch, dinner and ice-cream as well.

Very nice decor, super friendly service, but the food was sadly underwhelming. My monte cristo was soggy because of how buttery the bread was. I wished it was a tad crispier/toasted. The ham in it was delicious, the strawberry jam was divine. I'll come back for sure for more pastries next time!
Great tasting sushi art. No dr. Pepper.

I've mostly stuck to one sushi place in town over the last six or seven years. Because of this, there is a feeling of wonder in striking out to brave a new restaurant and finding an excellent meal. Unagi & Sushi has been on my radar for awhile. I mean, I am in love with unagi, and it's literally in the name! I ordered a large hot sake, some eel sashimi, and the special crunchy roll. The portions were nice, the price was fair, and the first bite was oh so satisfying. Eel is one of those things that has to be cooked perfectly: the sauce has to be well-balanced in flavor and portioned correctly, the meat has to be so soft it melts in your mouth, and the consistency must be uniform without a bone to be tasted. This hit all three marks right on target. I already find myself wishing I had taken pictures of the carrot butterfly and flowers that adorned the plate. Maybe next time I'll snap a few photos.

The roll was so good I tried another, the eel special, and again was sent to unagi heaven. I got desert, green tea mochi ice cream, and it was so soft and tasty! The mochi was doughy and the ice cream was smooth, all th best consistency and outlined with whipped cream and sprinkles!

All I can say is if you like eel like I do, and want something that is made with care, please try this place out!

I love the food here! Such yummy Chicken Tikka Masala, Chicken Hakka Noodles, and garlic naan. I'm here tonight to celebrate my birthday! My mom asked where I wanted to go and without hesitation I chose here.

Tried the banana French toast, croque madame and biscuit, and everything was fantastic! The French toast was very sweet, and the croque Madame was huge and wonderfully cheesy, with the hash browns as a perfect compliment.

I was in Clearwater on vacation with my teenage son and paid a visit to the PF on Rt 19.  The first few days we went the staff was pleasant and although the gym was smaller than the PF back home, it was adequate.  However yesterday we walked in and were about to sign in at the main desk when a female staff interrupted another staff talking with us and stated that my son wasn't allowed to work out since we were from out of state.  I explained that another staff told us it was ok, but she got attitude and then proceeded to tell us that the only way my son could work out was if he paid $20 for a day pass.  Needless to say I was pissed off and won't be returning.  It's rather sad that they couldn't make a small concession to satisfy their customers.  As I said before, the gym is small but decent - especially for $10/month...
excellent food and music.  super fun and friendly waitress and hostess.  Great night!

Good burgers, great fries.  You cant go wrong with a burger here and Ive had several types.  No, its not a gourmet restaraunt burger but it is very tasty.  The only issue, at times, is the cashier service.  They can be standoffish, not very warm.  They need to do some customer service training, scripting, etc.  Other than that, everything is great.

Absolutely incredible Italian deli. It doesn't look like much, and it's in a strip mall, but the food is fantastic. I usually get the Eggplant Parmesan sub. They use by far the best bread of any deli or sub shop I've been to. I have also gotten trays of their hot prepared food for parties. I don't know what else to say - the food is just awesome.

It is a small place and it gets crowded and a little hectic during lunch. But I think that adds to the traditional Italian feel!
Love the cheap margaritas.  Poncho Willis is the best eatery there.  Lots of choices, but the mexican is the best.  Great for locals, cheap night out.

I was torn about whether to give this place one or two stars. Our dining experience was terrible terrible terrible, but you can't beat the location or the open air set up. It really is quite lovely to sit, quietly watching   Jackson Square by that ever-present flickering lamp light. And the interior of the restaurant is lush and lovely and oozes history. It would have been much nicer, of course, to enjoy these things while consuming, say, drinks, or food. After a certain point, I might even have settled for the smallest acknowledgment from any employee.

Sadly, that was not in the cards for us. I'll spare you the details but the gist is that we sat, totally ignored by all the staff, for far longer than is acceptable. Once we were noticed, we waited far too long for drinks and food. The service was terrible terrible terrible. 

The food (we both had red beans, rice, and sausage) was fine, though there was something slightly funky about the parsley garnish. Nothing outstanding, but I wasn't expecting outstanding. Given the size, location, and menu, I was betting on some adequate, tourist grade food, which is exactly what we got. 

So, ultimately two stars for the location, ambiance, and the fact that the food is not terrible. But there is not a chance in hell that I would go back. You can find something better.

One of my favorite breakfast/lunch spots in the city. Love eating in or calling ahead for pickup. Fun Australia vibe, unique spin on classic dishes. The sweet potato hash and the chicken bacon ranch sandwich are my favorites. The open faced Apple and Brie was outstanding too. I go here once every two weeks and don't see that stoping anytime soon.

Met the owner, a very nice gentleman, the place was spotlessly clean and nicely appointed. Ordered Thai rolls, Spring rolls, and the Garlic/Black Pepper vegetables with beef for take out. Food prep was about 15 minutes, and everything was very good and freshly prepared. Both the spring and Thai rolls appeared to have been made fresh, not the frozen variety so many places use these days. I thought the prices were fair considering the freshness and the quality of the food. I definitely plan on returning to enjoy eating there at the restaurant.

One of the many Brennan restaurants in NO. A great place for a classic conservative meal in the French Quarter. It's much more formal than a bunch of the places around there but serves really high quality food bursting with Cajun flavors. Of course you know you gotta get the seafood down here near the Gulf. The gumbo, gulf fish and pecan pie stand out in my mind as excellent.

This has become my goto sushi when I'm lazy and wanna eat in.

Its not the best sushi but for the price you pay and to have have it delivered to your door, its pretty darn good.  Not the biggest menu but they got the basics.

Spider roll is a winner

This place is great! We opted for the egg and cheese crossants with a side of potatoes, but were super jealous of the pancake stacks we saw come out for others. Wish we had known before we ordered, they looked so good! Food and service was great. Make sure you get there early as after 10am there is a long wait. We tried to go back another day after 10am and the parking lot was full!

*BE WARNED, NOT A TRUE DINER. MORE OF A JOHNNY ROCKETS STYLE DINER. ADDITIONALLY BREAKFAST STOPS AT 11AM*

Service: slow and lacking effort. Service is definitely not a priority. 

Atmosphere:   Cheesy 40s theme that's again more Johnny Rockets than authentic. 

Food: You aren't a diner when breakfast ends at 11am. Food was mediocre but came quickly. 

Only giving it two stars because I should've put more time into researching the place.  I'm assuming all the Google reviews are paid for.
Comfortable interior.. Good beers and drinks.. Fun place

DO NOT GO HERE! I have written a poor review for Northside Shoe Repair once before, but I see that it has been deleted.  I feel encouraged to warn people once again because I recently ran into a friend who told be about how they had stapled her leather boots together leaving holes in the leather.  My experience was SO BAD I don't even want to go into the details, but essentially, they LOST my shoes for 4 YEARS and when I finally went to retrieve them, this is a very long story, the buckles had been so poorly replaced that I could not physically buckle them!  DO NOT GO HERE!

Great place for brunch.  Recently came with a group of 12 girls. Roughly an hour wait but that was to be expected with such a large group of girls. Hostess took number and while we waited took some pics by angel wings wall.  Coffee was on point as and had a bacon egg and cheese on sour dough which was so good.  Service was great, server offered separate checks which is a huge help with a large group.  We had a party of 3 vegans and everyone was able to find a dish they liked.  

Even stopped here again on our last meal before the airport!   Chicken and waffles were amazing. Hot sauce is to die for!

it was a first time visit for me. upon entering, the facade was impressive with the japanese art, wood and stone decor.  the night was getting late so the place was only half packed and customers appeared to be enjoying themselves  it looked to be a mid or higher tier establishment so i had high expectations. 

the 'banana boat' was what i ordered since it was my first visit and thought this would be a good way to get the 'lay of the land' and try a sample of what the place offered.  the 'boat' arrived in the form of a square plate (someone posted a pic above).  immediately, i was unimpressed.  are you kdding me?! the sushi on this plate looked like the type you find at chinese buffets!  the shrimp over the rice ball and spicy tuna roll on here is the standard line-up at all the buffets!  ok. took a bite and it tastes about as good as it looked, meh.

so, if you want to eat meh overpriced sushi then go here or drive a little into the plaza and there is a chinese buffet that will serve you the exact same thing, except you'll only pay about a third of what they charge here.
I'm reviewing this one due to the online ordering. The food...it's White Castle. It's always good for fast food. Love the online ordering. Had to wait a couple of minutes for the food but worth it.

I came here looking for my wedding gown. The staff was friendly and helpful. Their selection was not huge, but they had some really beautiful dresses. The dressing room is nice and large. I did not get my dress here, but I did purchase a beautiful rhinestone headpiece that I loved. Overall, the prices were decent. Not David's Bridal cheap, but comparable to the average bridal shop.
I wasn't extremely impressed. The banana pancakes where meh. And the hash browns were also meh. Although the hair that came with them was disgusting. I don't know that I'll be back. ‍

Thank you Yelpers for a great meal, and about 10 pounds on the waistline. I love local spots that may not look like much from the front, but put their effort into great food. I followed instructions, read all the reviews, and ventured away from the airport hotels for this one, and you proved me right again.
As advertised, the owner was there preparing meals while her two helpers were the waiter and food prep staff. All three greeted me, told me about the specials, and then let me know which of the menu items they were sold out of...luckily, I am not a huge sauerkraut fan, so I did not miss out on its absence. One thing I was not informed of, but overheard at the end is that there is a tasting menu, which I made me almost eat a full second meal!
I had the stuffed cabbage, which was just perfect, good sauce, seasoned beef with rice and tender cabbage wrapped around it. I would almost call it a Bosnian Spring Roll! Other options could have been stuffed onions, grape leaves, or bell peppers.
The warm pita bread had a nice herb baste and delicious flavour, especially when mixed with the cucumber sauce. 
Then, without further ado... you MUST save room for dessert. Have a Bosnian coffee and the baklava. Best. Baklava. Ever.

I came here for lunch after I saw the reviews and there was definitely no disappointment . The beer selection was above average,  the burger I had was perfect,  and I will make sure to try a milkshake next time. They will even spike it!  The atmosphere was alright but again it's a burger joint. I will definitely be back soon.
Ok food, very small portions. Expensive according to what you get. I'm not coming back!

My only complaint is about the bed we had. I have nerve damage in my hips and legs. I cannot sleep on a rock hard bed without a thick mattress pad covering it. Our mattress was cheap, no cushion at all. The hotel placed a piece of flannel over the mattress and called it a mattress pad. I asked for a thicker pad if they had one, or a queen or king blanket I could fold and place under the fitted sheet. I got the blanket. It helped some but not enough.

The suite set up was compact and inovative.  They got a lot of stuff into a regular hotel room space.  I liked that.

Highly recommend Apple Repair shop.  Needed my computer fixed by a certain date and they assured me whatever my issue was they could handle it.  They were not lying.  They fixed all issues, and now my old MacBook Pro is running fast like a champ.  Very honest and professional.  Would definitely go back to them for future issues.  Side note, I'm never installing Spotify on any of my computers ever again.  Before, even looking at my machine, they had identified the source of my problems through our initial conversation.

Oh, Brunch at Tavern. I'm so sad that it took me so long to visit you. 

I'll keep this brief: The dishes here are superbly crafted. Flavors are lovely and multifaceted, and the plating is gorgeous. My favorite dishes, though, are easy to pinpoint. 

First up is the Sweet Potato Chips, which arrive at your table with a curry salt and blue cheese fondue. This is a perfect start to any meal, and honestly, I could probably be happy just munching on these while sipping a few cocktails (which I'll get to in a moment). As for a main course, though: The Benedict Dos. Poached eggs, smoked salmon, and a creamy hollandaise? Delicious doesn't even begin to cover it. 

I will admit that I find myself rather addicted to their Blood Orange Mimosa, so I haven't actually tried anything else on the menu. However, one of my closest friends loved the Bloody Mary, and their beer selection is impressive and was mat with easy approval from our group a few weeks ago. 

Is it loud? Yes. 
Is it expensive? Sure, although most of the cocktails are two for one. 
But is it worth the insanely long wait? Absolutely.
The nutella banana calzone... Definitely not a recommendation. The server made it sound so delicious but tasted like it was made with their feet, not hands. Sick.

Was in town for business and after checking in to my hotel late I noticed a Cheeseburger in paradise next door and got excited. All the ones in Columbus where Im from closed down a few years back. 

So I headed over before they closed in hopes of some carry out. 

I walked in and thought... wow... is this the right place? Looked more like a run down independent mom and pop joint than a notional franchise location. Decor was kinda blah, and not a whole lot of "Jimmy Buffet" stuff if any. 

I got a menu from the barmaid and looked it over..... didnt take long since there wasnt a whole lot to offer. 

I ordered a Bacon Cheeseburger, figured it was a safe bet. 

took it back to my room to eat it. It was ok, not as good as I remembered them being back home. Fries were good, and they seemed to give me an extra amount. 

Considering that the place looked like it was a few weeks away from closing, I dont think ill be stopping in again. 

Its too bad actually.

As I wrote in another review, I'm from Boston, so I don't know how this place compares with Reno, but I sure can tell you how it compares with Boston.  It compares favorably.  That is really an understatement.  This place is outstanding.

If I had to pick a place back home to equate this with, it would be Sel de la Terre.  Only here, I spent about half what I would spend back home.  The bread and olive oil that preceded the entrée were good, and to be honest, if a restaurant doesn't get that part right, it's usually a bad sign. For the entrée, I got the special for the evening, roasted pork on cabbage, and a nice glass of red wine.  My wife got the seafood primavera linguine, and it was simply packed with fresh seafood.  Coming from Massachusetts, and having grown accustomed to fresh seafood, I was a little uneasy with my wife's choice-- fresh seafood in Reno?!  My fears were unfounded.  Also a great dish.

I wish we had been able to fit dessert-- but we were both quite satisfied by the end of the meal.  I would call the portions tending toward generous, but by no means an ungodly pile of food.

I only have two suggestions: one, no espresso?  OK, my taste in coffee is perhaps a bit too snobby (in their defense, their coffee WAS good), but an espresso would have been the perfect end to the meal.  Second, the place is a little lacking in ambience... specifically, warmth.  It would benefit hugely from, say, a fireplace.  The New Englander in me is simply a sucker for a nice, warm fire.

Anyway, great place.  Highly recommended for a date, and while it was not cheap, it certainly did not break the bank either.  If I were to relocate permanently to Reno, I most definitely could see making this place our standard go-to for special occasions.

OH-- one last thing.  Sunday nights are burgers and pizza only.  While I would probably be happy with their Sunday food, my wife and I went back a second time hoping to have a meal like our first, and were a bit disappointed.  I can't say I blame them, Sunday nights are probably slow.

Review is just for minigolf - my daughter loves minigolf and always wants to try a new place. Greattimes is right next to 465, so it has never looked too appealing to me. We tried it on a recent weekend and the minigolf turns out to be pretty nice! They offer 36 holes and you can play either 18 or all 36.

Minigolf is well maintained, carpeted concrete with a paving stone border and some cast rock obstacles. The surface is not flat, there are rolling "hills" and various ups, downs, and sideways breaks on the putting surface.

There is a fair number of trees, so a decent amount of shade. There's well maintained grass, water features, fountains, lots of decor. We will be back

This truck boasts the BIGGEST lunch box in the university city area and they're right!!! You can order a SMALL jerk chicken with 2 sides for $7 and save half of it for dinner. I'm not kidding.... and I can eat!

I was so bummed when my original jamaican truck left me with its delicious oxtail. But ....  As I was walking from HUP, I saw this truck also selling a Caribbean cuisine. Jerk chicken and oxtail are pretty good. The Jerk chicken is  seasoned with lots of spices and herbs and pretty tender. The oxtail is a bit harder, but they serve steak fries and it's great for soaking up all the sauce!!

I would make sure to come a little earlier. They're not the most efficient pair working together. Also, make sure you only tell her the size and entree. The guy will ask for your sides afterwards.

I found this place on Google, was visiting from out of town.  Its kind of like a fish market with New England seafood.  They had lobster, steamers, etc plus local seafood.  They also have a dine-in area.  We dined in and had lobster.  Prices were great, as in it was cheaper to get a sit-down lobster dinner here than it would be to go to a local grocer and get lobster to steam at home.  They had a huge number of live lobsters, ranging from small chicks to over 4lb'ers.  Largest selection of live lobsters I've ever seen outside of New England.  Staff was super-friendly.  Their chowders are totally awesome, just like in New England.  The prices were wholesale, close to what you'd pay in New England.  Large selection of seafood.  Highly recommend this place.  Wish I lived closer, I'd definitely be a regular customer.
Love ALL The Rice Houses! Cannot go wrong with anything on the menu! Please start making Hot & Sour Soup. I know you guys would put a home made spin on it!

The French fries are the best I've had in a long time. The cheeseburger was a double patty- so prepare your appetite! Direct quote from my "honestly, one of the best cheeseburgers I've ever had. And the chicken breast! It was freakin' delicious!"

Absolutely the best pulled pork and BBQ sauce I've ever tasted, anywhere, and the size of the servings are huge!  Sweet potatoes to die for!  And Russell is one of a kind - very nice, friendly, do anything for you!  

Deserves more stars rating!  I'm hooked on the pulled pork, but everything he sells is absolutely delicious! Varied menu, and it's all good   

Am I raving?  You bet!  This is as good as it gets!  Worth going out of your way to get to.  If you're anywhere in the area, you have to make it your meal stop.  He only has one community table, if you plan to eat there, but that's not a deterrent, there's always room for one more at the table. Or take the food to go, if you prefer.  

All these 5-star reviews can't be wrong: try it, YOU'LL LOVE IT!

Currently, he's not open on Sunday - and he usually sells out early in the afternoon other days, so it's best to call before you go - if it's after around 2:00 PM or later; just to make sure he's still got what you want left.  I think his posted closing time is 6:00 PM, but I don't think he's ever there that late; It's that good that he sells-out daily.  Don't miss out!

You have no doubt read the conflicting reviews of Strange Donuts on Yelp and wondered whether it is has great donuts or terrible donuts (they are not very good), and whether it is staffed by indifferent hipsters or friendly counter people (they are nice and helpful). So, to recap: friendly service, lines aren't too bad, and the donuts are doughy and lacking in flavor. If you want good donuts, go to Glazed and Infused in Chicago. If the 300-mile drive is off-putting, next best thing is Vincent Van Donut in Clayton.

Internet does NOT work!!!!! They told us on the phone it does, After we checked in we learned it is old and rarely works. Writing this from a restaurant! Old TV, toilet is for a child. Cutting to many corners to be any good, dingy. Never again!!!!!

I've been here on multiple occasions and each time my experience has been a hit or miss. I've had the seafood pan fried noodles which were drowning in watery sauce and the seafood was not that fresh. The shrimp are soo small and seems like they are days old. I've had the Prawn Mee noodle soup again the shrimp seemed old and there was nothing Prawnish about the shrimp at all as they were soo small. The slices of pork were extremely tough and the broth was very very fishy. Even the bean sprouts and vegetables seemed old. The stir fried rice noodle with salted fish was just ok. The fried rice with salted fish was pretty good. The Roti Cani is very good as well. I've also tried the fried intestine and oyster pancake both of which were good. The service was always great as the waiter always makes sure to tell us what to expect in the dish so that part I love. So all in all I feel like this place can be so much better if only the seafood and veggies were fresh.

There are a few Thai places in DTSP and I would say Ratchada is the nicest. The staff is extremely polite and everything always comes out perfect and they check in to make sure you're doing well frequently. The atmosphere is relaxed and quiet, even when the place is packed. 

The menu features all the traditional Thai staples, I usually get pad thai and its always great. I really like their spring rolls and wonton soup, they both are really fresh and on some visits these are the only two items I've gotten and I was completely filled up. Thai tea is also awesome! 

Check out the crazy bathroom. It's like going into Wonderland.
The  place is so dark hard to see the menu to start off with. The food is fair not really all the tasty. Waiterss we're a bit slow and the place was not even busy.

Went here with my 4yo for a celebration. We had a cheese pizza and it was delicious. They have a very eclectic menu from hummus pizza, to crawfish and it all looks delicious. I will definitely order from them again.
Best pork dumplings in the city! Also, delicious general tso's chicken. I always, always order from here; reasonable prices and excellent food!
Love everything! Except the parfait.. Really wish they'd put more fruit and use different yogurt! Other than that A+++***

I used to be a denizen of the Old Tangier, so I wanted to see what became of the local neighborhood haunt.  The interior is wonderful.  So sleek and clean.  That being said, with all of the hard surfaces, it is hard to hear yourself think when the place is busy, let alone have a conversation at the table.  They are still developing the menu, so I wasn't able to see the full range of offerings they have.  I had the salad with the sushi tuna and rice.  It was a wonderful combination of tuna, daikon, fennel, pickled ginger and rice.  I found the chili sauce a bit too hot for my personal taste, but would not fault the restaurant for that.  Servers were anxious to please.  The biggest downer was the noise level.  When I mentioned it to our waiter he said that sometimes it's more relaxed and quiet (like when nobody is there?).  Some sound-absorbing materials would help to quiet the place down.  I don't want to have to yell across a tiny talbe for dinner or yell at the waitstaff to order.  I will see what the full menu and the atmosphere are like once they fully open.

Love love this place! Food is exactly prepared as the Original location on Christian Street in S Phila. The Mel's Chicken Cutlet is my favorite and the Greek Salad is next!!! We always introduce our friends to this place bc we know it will b delicious!!!

I always buy my Mother a pound of Mississippi mud when in the Big Easy.   It is to die for.  the pralines are delicious.  My only problem is the rudeness of the staff.  I have never had a smile or greeting from anyone in the shop.  It seems as if being hostile is a prerequisite for working there.  I have been going there for quite a while so I just ignore the poor behavior and enjoy the candy.
Every once in awhile I have a craving for this place. It's an okay place. I like the sesame chicken and their egg rolls are great, definitely different than any other Chinese place in St. Louis.

Can't speak for the baked goods, but definitely some of the worse service I have ever encountered. I walked in hoping to find a cake to buy for my upcoming wedding anniversary. I was the only person in the store with two people behind the counter. Neither of them could care the least bit to help me and when I tried to ask questions, was given almost no information (ex: is that cream cheese frosting or butter cream? Answer: I really don't know, but you can buy a $5 cupcake and try it). Then one left to answer the phone and the other went to the back - in the middle of my asking another question! Suffice to say, I will not be spending my $36 on a cake at this place.

Serendipity Salon is as good as it gets. This beautiful salon has recently been remodeled and offers a quaint and comfortable atmosphere and top of the line service. I have been going to the Salon owner, Heidi, for years and would never go anywhere else! Her service is amazing, she is probably one of the most talented stylists I've ever gone to (and I've lived in major cities and paid top dollar), and ever visit is like going to see a friend!

I'm excited to try out some of the new services now being offered and will report back when I do!

This place is my favorite taco place currently in Tampa. I have been multiple times and have had tacos, burritos, chimichangas, etc. Everything has been good. The ingredients are fresh (so the wait is a little longer), the portions are large, and the staff is friendly. I would recommend this to anyone looking for good tacos.

Of note: The location isn't the best area and parking is minimal. The inside has minimal seating.  They use cabbage instead of lettuce in their tacos so be cognizant of that.Those are the only reasons for 4 stars.

Excellent food and plenty of it. Their fried chicken is the bomb and if you don't have time,go through  the Express drive thru. Warning,they often get your order wrong in drive thru. Not "wrong" but...not 100 percent right.  Better to dine in or get the carry out from inside JB's Express. If you are standing there,less chance of them giving you something you didn't ask for.   
Just tasty comfort food of every description. A little heavy for summer,but in the winter after a long cold day,yum.

Amazing food.  Great ambiance.  We had a little bit of everything.  Not gonna list all the stuff we tried. But everything was really good.  Small portions.  Hard to share. But every bite was worth it.  
Kushi oysters were on point. Probably my favorite dish.  Loved the habanero dropper. 
Caribbean seafood pot was my second favorite.  
You can go wrong here.  Awesome place and walking distance to the casino.

As an East Falls resident, I was excited to check out In Riva and was really hoping it would be as great as it seemed. Fortunately, it was. My meal there was fantastic. For starters, the ambiance of the place is really nice. Cool lighting setup, cute little bar at the front of the restaurant, and a big balcony outside that overlooks the Schuylkill and will be great in the spring. 

The meal started with a complimentary dish of toasted (i think?) nuts that was really tasty and a welcome alternative to the usual basket of bread. We ordered the spicy mussels, which came with a nice, buttery, crusty bread for dipping in the sauce. The sauce, while really tasty, was not really spicy -- my only complaint. 

Our main dish was the cippollini pizza: pancetta, brussel sprouts, goat cheese. An absolutely delicious mix of sweet, salty, and spicy. I loved it. The pizza had a nice char from the wood-fired oven but the crust still remained chewy. 

I do think the restaurant is still figuring itself out a bit. We were sitting at a bar overlooking the kitchen, and our server openly admitted to having a rough time serving us in that area. Also, they serve the pizza on top of a big can of tomatoes, which looks cool, but when the guy brought our pizza he said "watch out, the plate is really hot and unsteady." Not really the best combo; they might want to rethink that. 

However, neither of those things were really a deterrent for me and I will definitely be back. So happy In Riva is here!
I had the espresso rubbed short rib with polenta and brussels. Very well prepared! Excellent flavor. Great atmosphere and service was excellent. My first visit and I will definitely be back!

I came to Baileys' when I was visiting St. Louis. The restaurant was pretty cute with all the decor. 

Food: I got the $5 mac and cheese and half power salad. Both were really good! I'm not one to order mac and cheese ever but I decided to order try it and it was delicious. The portion was pretty big for the price. The salad was also good! The vinaigrette complimented the fix ins really well. 

Service: SUCKED. It took forever for a server to come take our order, and then we waited over 30 minutes for our food to come out. My friends and I flew in from Los Angeles for a convention and were leaving that day. We were afraid we were going to be late. We saw that our food was ready but no one bothered to check on it. Turns out, they made one of the orders wrong.. a little reassurance would have been nice. Our food was almost cold when we got it. We never got a refill on waters either..

Overall: Food was good but service sucked.

This review was for their Sunday brunch. I took a few days to mull over why I couldn't justify giving this place a 4 regardless of the great service, great view and nice ambiance.

Service was great. Sandy took great care of our table making sure to get whatever we wanted from the menu as well as accommodate special requests. One thing to note is that there was no clear beverage menu so we weren't sure what drinks, alcoholic or non-alcoholic, they had for us. 

That being said, I would give this place 3.5 stars. 

When I go to the a buffet especially at at this price point, I'm already going in with the idea I'm going to indulge, indulge and indulge some more. Sadly, the Rusty Pelican's offerings didn't leave me feeling indulgent. 

The set-up here is a separate room with seafood, omelette station, carving station (ham), bacon, potatoes, sausages and two types of pasta salad. It would have been nice to see a nice cheese selection and some great breads.

The seafood had ahi tuna slices, crab legs, oysters, and not deveined shrimp. Our table was a fan of the cocktail sauce though.

There was one attendant for the omelette station so the wait could get long (and others might poach your omelette...true story). ALL the omelettes that came out of the station were overdone and brown - definitely not my idea of a nice fluffy omelette. 

Besides this, there is a menu with items that the server will bring out for you as many times as you want. The favorite of the table seemed to be the mojo pork with garlicky mashed potatoes. The chicken was dry and the "risotto" was more like a pilaf which had an odd taste to me. I wasn't a fan of the salmon seasoning either. The quiche was delicious though (it came as a tiny sliver but you could probably ask for more servings).

The fresh fruit with coconut yogurt that came wasn't exactly like it was described on the menu. It was missing both blueberries and strawberries. It only had pineapples, cantaloupe and honeydew.

Belgian waffle was great. My brother was a fan of the whiskey butter. 

The bread basket came with sad looking "croissants" and uninspired muffins. Our table didn't touch them at all.

There is a dessert table that had different things like a chocolate chip coconut bar, eclairs, coconut mousse, creme brulee and chocolate chip cookies. Nothing particularly was amazing.

For drinks, our table (8 people) stuck with mimosas the entire time we were there being unsure what else we could order. The servers promptly refilled our glasses with premixed mimosas from a pitcher on the side. 

The view was nice but I wouldn't rush back any time soon ($30+ pp) unless I was in the mood to eat piles and piles of crab legs, which I was not.
Definitely will be back!! Looks like a hole in the wall and the place is rather warm but the food was great. Service was also great. They made recommendations but I loved the avocado omelette.

A really great shop for the serious cyclist.  Their store is decent but where they shine is service.  I will only take my bike here for work.  Their staff are all bike nerds and definitely know what they are doing.

Employees were very nice which was a pleasant surprise because we hadn't realized we walked in an hour til closing time! The guy who took our order (name on receipt said Jamar) was really nice and made sure everything on the order was correct and that it was to our liking. Didn't take too long to make and we got home and the food was really good! Shout out to the Kirkwood Hwy Pizza Hut crew (: their good food and good customer service has me hooked.

This place is OK- 3.5 stars. We had a large group for brunch and the staff seemed really confused about seating us. We eventually ended up just taking over the restaurant (it was like 12 of us). We actually had a good 'ol time but that was partly because we had such a large group. 

The food was just OK- maybe 3 stars. It might have been better if the place wasn't so crowded. If we were in the neighborhood we might come back.

So glad I stopped in to the juice bar! Great menu, tons of options, friendly staff! I went with the 'Orange You Glad' juice and sampled the Red Lentil soup of the day. My boyfriend had the 'We got the beet' juice. 
Tip: it is attached to The Grilled Cheeserie

Visited NOLA to see family and of course BOURBON ST. and all the beautiful surrounding areas. If you love history, vintage, and doing things for the experience, here it is. This hotel is steps from Bourbon St., priced well, has the best breakfast café on location, Café Conti. The staff are so friendly and polite it makes your vacation feel like your royalty. Ok maybe a bit overboard but my husband and I loved everyone we came in contact with. But like I said if you want 5 star, pillow top mattresses this is not for you.

After making a return visit here, I feel obligated to bump my review up to 5 stars, as Honey's has now claimed a spot in the brunch-loving corner of my heart.

I was tempted to order the Honey Cristo again since I liked it so much last time, but decided to try the Breakfast Quesadilla instead. It came stuffed with ham, cheese, and scrambled eggs, with avocado sour cream drizzled on top, and beans and pico de gallo on the side. The bulk of the quesadilla was the scrambled eggs, which I really liked, especially with the avocado sour cream adding a great kick of flavor. Would definitely get this again!

I also tried a little bit of my friend's Breakfast Bomb, which she ordered with chocolate chip pancakes instead of regular. The pancakes wrapped around scrambled eggs and ham were very, very yummy, and the chocolate chips were a great addition.

They also make excellent challah french toast. My other friend couldn't finish her Honey Cristo, so I happily ate the rest of her french toast for her.

In conclusion, a TL;DR list of stuff that Honey's does well:
1) Things with ham and eggs
2) Challah french toast
3) Portions that are actually finishable in one sitting and don't leave you feeling like you're about to explode afterwards

Yummy baked goods and special order pies and cakes.  Pastry and cookies are slightly overpriced compared to Beyond Bread but less expensive than Frog.  They serve breakfast & lunch and it's a nice place to enjoy a tea and baked good especially if the weather is nice enough to sit outside.

I was a member here for way too long, when there were other gyms more deserving of my money. Machines are often dirty and not kept in good repair (ex rips in the vinyl armpads). The members are more to blame, as I see people sweat up equipment and not wipe it down. I avoided this place at all costs during flu season for fear of catching something. The staff has zero b*lls and won't tell the cardio hogs they've exceeded the 30min usage time when there are people waiting. 

On a positive note, there were several great instructors for the cycle and kickboxing classes, some who have been there 5+ yrs. 

You get what you pay for, so if you want a gym that feels like Walmart, join this one. If you want Target level or better, seek out the other, slightly pricier, options.

It's a small, very casual restaurant. The staff is friendly. The food is decent. Everyone works together to make sure your cup never goes empty. The seafood omelette is really good. The grits weren't creamy and the hash browns didn't have flavor. I loved how the biscuits are split in half, and the inside is toasted for that extra crunch in every bite. Yet, the biscuit still melts in your mouth.
Pretty good and reasonably priced. Kind of small portions. Not too busy on a Friday night and easily able to accommodate a large crowd.

Some really good, really spicy Mexican food can be found here.  My wife had the chicken enchiladas, and I had the Pambazo.  Both really good.  I was surprised to see fish tacos and other fish items on the menu, which is rare for these small mexican restaurants.  The place is cozy, yet unpretentious on the inside.  I'll probably be returning to try more items in the future.

This place is not for families. Be prepared to spend 450-500 dollars in food for three days. 24 dollar milk and cookies. No food from outside is allowed.  Restaurants in the hotel are more expensive than anywhere else in Nashville.  Ordered a pizza from outside restaurant staff was very hostile to me when I brought it in to hotel.

We came here to get some drinks and some "bad" food before a movie, and just so happened to pop in during their anniversary bash, which meant discounted food! Yay!

A place like this, you know exactly what to expect. Anyone complaining about the waitress' outfits or the food needs to do a serious self check - what did you expect?? This isn't Chili's, this is a clean, restaurant-style sports bar.

We thought the food was great, the drinks were great, and the waitress was great! We made it in time for happy hour, and she made sure to get our drinks in quickly so we'd make the cutoff for happy hour. It was a pretty busy night with the anniversary celebration, but food came out quickly. We told the waitress we were going to go see a movie, and she got us the checks quicker. A lot of people forget to communicate - the ladies can't read minds! 

Actually, I can't think of anything we weren't satisfied with. We've been to other Wing Houses around Tampa and they are all pretty much the same. A fun place to go get some fried/bbq/hot/not-good-for-you food and watch the game, or a pay-per-view match with friends.
Very good prices and the food is delicious. A great spot to come to after a day at the beach.

I had always had a great imperssion of Weinhardt based on what I've read about them in the past.  However, dealing with them first hand has surely changed my opinion of them.  

They were first of all not very helpful when I visited their showroom.  I expected much better customer service and to be shown around at the selection of what they had.  Instead, I was told that they could not read my mind and they don't know what I want.  I was very disappointed by this treatment, as I felt that they are the experts and should be offering a little more guidance with showing me what they have to offer.  I should have walked away from their business right then and there.  Their office hours made it difficult to get there in the first place, as I work a full time job, and I was completely underwhelmed by their level of service when I was finally able to make it in.  However, I figured that since they would only be dropping off the items I rented, I wouldn't have to interact with them much and decided to make the reservation for their services anyway.

WHAT  A MISTAKE!  I rented a pipe and drape from them and had been told in the showroom that the white panels beneath the sparkle pipe and drape was included in the price shown for the rental.  However, I showed up to my wedding rehearsal to see a pipe and drape set up with only the clear sparkle panels, no white panels underneath, and you could see clear through to the wall behind it.  Why on Earth would I have bothered to rent a pipe and drape if I was okay with the wall behind it showing through?  We called to try to point out the error and were then told that we would have to pay an additional fee for them to bring the white drapes that go underneath... this is the exact opposite of what I was told in the show room.  On top of that, Weinhardt sent the deliver to my parents' home instead of to the hotel where my wedding was to be held  AND the white columns I'd rented for my wedding ceremony were the most disgusting, dirty things I've ever seem delivered by a business.  

I promised them that I would get on every single internet outlet that would allow me to rate their business  and let every bride who might be remotely interested in their services know how Weinhardt does business.  They don't wow you with their service, they don't stick to their word, they don't apologize for their mistakes, they aren't willing to rectify what they've done wrong, and they are not a business I  would recommend anyone to use.  Especially not for their wedding.  Who wants to deal with this kind of stress and disappointment the day before their wedding?  I'd finally gotten Weinhardt to deliver the white curtains that were supposed to be included in the first place and even the delivery guy said that they should have sent them in the first place.  Once that was taken care of, I was satisfied to not spend any of my time spreading my negative opinion of this business.  However, they charged an additional fee to my debit card for a missing glass globe without even letting me know that anything was missing.  This was a horrible experience.  I am done with Weinhardt for good and I would never recommend their services to anyone.

I've used this CVS since I moved to the area 9 years ago. It's central location makes it easy to access off of Tampa  Rd. 
They are very clean and well organized. Always well stocked shelves with an area for seasonal shopping too. 
The pharmacy is located in the back of the store beside the Minute Clinic. 
Prices for the store and the pharmacy are comparable to other ones, but the staff (up front) are very friendly and helpful here so it sets it apart for me.
The clinic is accessible and easy to make an appt. most insurances cover his as well. If you're not sure if yours does, just ask they will know. 
The only thing I would say that is not 100% great is the pharmacy staff. Although that seems to slowly be improving.

Once again I found myself hanging out at the Trident for a couple of cold ones with a friend, and we both agreed why we like this place. It's neither trendy or pretentious and nothing fancy, just a great locally owned bar with great service, good food, (Like literally everything on the menu is pretty good) and cute staff.

I'll keep going there and I highly recommend it!
Always great service when we come! Never let's us down! The food is great! We love the Pizzokie!

In my opinion, one of the BEST Indian restaurants in the entire Indianapolis area!  Their garlic naan alone is enough to keep you coming back and every single entrée I've tried has been nothing short of exceptional.  If you like to try a variety of dishes I highly recommend coming during the week for the lunch buffet.  It includes nearly all the traditional favorites including some desserts.

You know this is a pretty cool place and they work efficiently.  If the line gets long an employee comes out and takes orders from the line via remote tablet like at In and Out. 

I've had drinks here twice now, one was a black coffee and the other was an Americano. My reason for only two stars is that they serve their drinks kinda weak.  Make them stronger and it's a 5-star place.
Fantastic! Took my boots and fixed them in 10mins.Very helpful and excellent craftsmanship.

The hotel is absolutely beautiful! There are several restaurants, shops, and a bar located inside as well. There is a garden atrium and small waterfalls and rivers with shrubbery and flowers around. The mall is right next door also!The hotel is very big and you can EASILY get lost here! That is a downside, but if you stay a while, you get to know your way around!

Had lunch with my family (2 adults and 2 kids). We both had pick 2 combos.  Food is good and has been very consistent over my 3-4 visits this year. Kids menu comes with a sundae which they love and my kids eat well here. Any plus for a parent.

Bill: 2 sodas, 2 pick 2 combos, 2 kids meals. $30.83 plus tip

My girlfriend, cousin and I came here for restaurant week because the menu sounded promising. I mean who doesn't love downtown southern food right? 

We arrived right around 8pm and the restaurant was completely empty inside. It was a typical bar look inside with wooden booths and dim lights. We chose to sit outside since our was a nice night. We sat for about 20 minutes before somebody came to take our drink order. This should have been the indication of how slow service would be smh

For appetizers I ordered the shrimp and anchovy toast which the toast was burnt but the shrimp had a decent flavor. My friend ordered the country pate which was bland and not enough bread for the pate. My cousin ordered the biscuits and gravy which was the only good tasting thing. 

For our entrees, I ordered the shrimp gumbo which was decent in flavor but needed more spices. My friend ordered the country fried chicken which was crispy but flavorless. My cousin ordered the braised beef short ribs which were very salty. We were far from impressed. 

For dessert I took the recommendation of the server and ordered the whiskey brownie a la mode. The brownie was stale and so hard. I could have gotten a better brownie premade from the grocery store. 

So the slow service with the mediocre food will cause us not to come back to this place. It's sad considering the food description had so much potential.

My family and I dined here tonight after my nephew's graduation. We were a party of six. It was one of the worst experiences we ever had the moment we sat down. Our waitress name aeriella(don't know how to spell name), was the worst waitress we ever had at this restaurant. She had a bad attitude and the service was horrible. We ordered the appetizers. We all thought it was pretty good. Our waitress never came over to see if we needed anything or ask how was everything or are we doing ok. She back over when it was time to order the entree. We ordered our entrees and our table was never cleared off until it was close to the time for our food to come out. Everytime we asked her any kind of questions, she gave off a bad attitude. It's not like we were rude towards her. Now to the food. None of us enjoyed our entrees; well I didn't even get an entree because I was frustrated. I ordered a ribeye and for $30, I wasn't expecting a thin and small piece of steak. I've been to steakhouses in new york and even chophouse, so I wasn't expecting for it to be that size for that price, but I was expecting it to be a little bit thicker than what I received. I told the waitress and she gave me another attitude and asked what I wanted. As I was telling her what I wanted she was walking away before I could finish the order. I ordered the garlicky shrimp pasta and the sauce came out watery and I had two whole shrimp that was sliced in half, which made it look real curly. They must have ran out of shrimp I couldn't believe the kitchen staff could send something out like that. So, I also sent that back and didn't order anything else. Our waitress sort of snatched the plate away with an attitude. I left without eating any entrees. My family didn't even finish their food. They only ate some of it because they were hungry. When they got home, they just threw their food away. They also, felt that they would've had better at cheesecake factory. When it was time to pay for the food, our waitress was never to be found. My husband had to ask another waiter to get her. The servers that brought the food out was more polite even the waiter that went to get her. I wished we had him. The food and the service was one of the worst experiences we ever had at grandlux. Even the manager didn't come over to apologize for the inconvenience or see if we needed anything. Everyone said they will never return again. This experience ruined my nephew's night. He didn't even enjoy it.

Had diva curl cut but I still have ton of split ends still. It was cute and great to see what the products can do. But I'm still having to trim my own ends after paying $75 for a haircut! Girls were nice enough.
Restaurant supplies on restaurant supplies! Easy to navigate and not very crowded which makes it a quick in and out of your in any kind of rush. They also a have covered parking which is a plus!

Total tourist trap.  I had an oyster po-boy which was just - not very good. - I've had much better in other places.  My sister had the red beans and rice, which she was not too keen on.  They did make a good hefty hamburger which my niece gulped down, so I'm giving them up to 2 stars for that.  The food did come out quickly which was nice.  In general it seems that the place has survived based on its proximity to the Cathedral, thus attracting tourists, but the food just isn't that authentic.

Pros:

- Giant breakfast bar that was open past what was listed (9am). Everything was refilled very quickly too! 
- Everything was clean
- Rooms were equipped with a microwave and mini fridge
- The couch in the "living" area of the room had a queen size mattress, which was nice. Definitely something to consider in the future.
- Stayed in a room facing the pool, so I didn't hear anything while sleeping.

Cons:

- There's a reason the breakfast bar is so big. I thought I was going to get trampled on my way up to get eggs (they were worth it though). 
- Trash cans weren't lined, and there wasn't one next to the toilet.
- The TV was placed awkwardly (in between couch and where the beds were)
- It took forever to check in. The lady at the front desk was quite possibly the slowest being ever. I'm talking sloth-speed. I waited 20 minutes in line and then an additional 15 for her to check on my room. This was the day after Christmas, though, so I can understand it being so busy. But man.
- The heater didn't work. Ended up turning the thermostat really high, then low just to see if it made a difference. It didn't. 
- The fruit at the breakfast bar was never replenished. 
- The layout of the building is terrible. Most of the rooms are quite far from the elevator, and the walls are very thin. VERY. THIN.

This place is awesome! Just popped in to check it out, and there's hot food, a fantastic butcher, fresh-baked tortillas and bread, brilliant produce (at killer prices: $0.75 avocados!), and a very clean and cherry atmosphere. They smoke their own bacon and smoked salmon, have house chorizo (the sample was KILLER), and can sell me any cut of meat I need. Basically, this is the local grocery store of my dreams. I'm pretty in love.

Oh, where to start... Ive tried to go back many times and I just no longer can. People need to know about this place. I'm about half inclined to call state board. They smell like alcohol, they shake, their eyes are yellow and glassed over. In short, they are drunk. After leaving my manicure to dry, my nail person walked to the back where I saw her literally chug the rest of her can of beer. I watched a couple of the guys mix a drink in a coffee thermos and then drink it while doing my nails. You can smell the alcohol in the cup! So much is wrong with why drinking and doing nails! There are major health risks in tools that aren't properly sanitized, this place should be shut down, but they are busy! I can't be the only one who noticed! Do not go here!

I came here twice during my visit to New Orleans, once for dinner and once for happy hour.

The happy hour was so worth it! Half off drinks and 75 cents for giant, juicy oysters. The service was impeccable and the drinks were strong.

For dinner my husband had the shrimp grits and I had the Luke's burger. The burger definitely lives up to its hype. It was juicy, tender and amazingly flavorful. However, we didn't really understand all the hype around the shrimp grits. It was way too salty, which we found to be a common problem with a lot of the restaurants around NoLa. Have they never heard of moderation?

The place is pricey for the portions you get.
I stopped by with my family for lunch buffet. They had a large selection of vegetarian items. We liked the food very much especially Punjabi kadi, Kheer and gulab jamun.

We were on the road for a music tour through the northwest. we stayed at a inn and suites near the airpot in Boise. the Kopper Kitchen was with in walking distance & had decent ratings on yelp so we decided to check it out. we rolled in about 30 min to closing and were still greeted with a great welcoming smile from the host. we were seated quickly and our server quickly got our drinks all set. we all ordered burgers which turned out great and Our server Kristen was amazing, with a great sense of humor and kept a nice vibe with us. She was so on point and the food hit the spot after a long day of travel!! mad shouts to the Kopper Kitchen and yelp for the good recommendation.

I was recently in Philly for one night and had scoped out the reviews beforehand, to make sure we picked a good place for our one and only dinner.  I am so happy I went with Jones - it was just what we were looking for.  We wanted something special, but not fancy schmancy.  Of course, we also wanted solid food.  Jones fit the bill!  Somehow we got really lucky and were seated immediately at 9PM on Saturday night.  Nice surprise, considering we were expecting a wait.   So many things on the menu looked good, but we settled on the mac and cheese appetizer to start things off.   It was delicious - loved the bread crumbs on top.  I often order this at another restaurant at home, where it's served "fancier" with pancetta, truffle oil and mushrooms.  This mac and cheese was old school with delicious cheddar that melted in your mouth.  We literally scraped the dish clean.  I also liked the rolls that they served for the table.  I had the chicken pot pie as my entree and definitely made the right choice - it was so hearty, I almost want to go back on a cold night, just to order it.  Creamy and tasty, with plenty of carrots inside.  My husband may have made the one bad call of the evening - he ordered the jambalaya and didn't love it - it was ok, but he would order something else next time.  However, he was a big fan of the buttered peas that he ordered as a side.  Somehow, I still had room for dessert and seriously could have ordered just about any of the choices on the dessert menu - they all sounded so good.  We went with the carrot cake, because I had been craving it for a while.  Delicious!!  Our waiter was terrific - was on top of things and enthusiastic, but not obtrusive.  The swivel chairs were comfy and the place had a nice vibe.  My one and only complaint is that it is really noisy - the acoustics were terrible - I wouldn't suggest going here on a first date, as it's hard to hear even across the table.  Next time I'm in Philly, I'll be tempted to try somewhere new, but it will be very hard not to return to Jones.

Definitely the worst meal we've had down here in the ten plus years we've been vacationing here. My husband and I both ordered the blackened grouper  when the meals were delivered I thought my husband's jaw was going to hit the table. Without one bit of exaggeration, the portion of grouper was the size of a fish stick! It came with a couple of pieces of sautéed zucchini and squash and our choice of vegetable (French fries).  In addition to being smaller than an appetizer portion, the fish didn't even taste fresh! It was fishy. Plus the restaurant needs a facelift. It's dirty and dated. And the food is way over priced. Save your money. Go across the driveway and have some pizza!

ah I have fallen in love with Whimsy! Got my hair done with Amanda today and couldn't have asked for a better experience. I have been to Other salons where the experience seemed quick and rushed. Amanda truly cares about her clients needs in hair, as well as doing her best work! She knew exactly what would look good for my type of hair and face shape. It turned out great and I couldn't be happier. Did I mention the price is fantastic? Too good to keep a secret.

This is a new addition to Grounds for Sculpture, and it is less fancy and less expensive than the restaurant.  It is also very good.  On nice days, you can eat outside amidst several statues, and the menu, while limited, provides good options for various types of patrons.  A nice addition to a wonderful place.

Nice little italian BYOB in Chestnut Hill. Very attentive service and food is very good. Eggplant appetizer is very good and the gnocchi is cooked perfectly, nice and pillowy. If they have the Branzino entree, make sure to get it. I'd say this is the best Italian restaurant in the area.

I wasn't looking for this place in fact I had suggested another prior to being hemmed into the lunch offering and at first the aloofness I felt from the main service provider, not the lovely young lass who set us up with the menu choices, was a bit disconcerting. Aside from that, the method and care I observed for lunch maestro making their masterpiece which was to become my lunch, was astounding and I am much better for it today.  We had the "new mex" wrap which was filling and simply delicious.  Can't wait to go back.
Check it out, at least once, I am for sure.
eat here. do it. it's sooo good. and get the train wreck po'boy. you won't be disappointed.
Pretty Good Ethiopian food  far from Ethiopia. Great service super nice people

The staff at Sylvia's is friendly and efficient.  The food is spectacular, down-home, and tasty.  The restaurant is clean and has a cool vibe.  They have dishes almost everyone likes such as delicious, moist baked chicken, but also more southern dishes.  The chicken livers are crisp on the outside and moist and tender on the inside.  They are my favorite.  Candied yams are wonderful. The collard greens are the best ever.  All of the food is good.  Find your own favorite.  The portions are generous and I have never had the desserts because I am always satisfied after the entree.  There's also a bar if you want to just go for drinks and appetizers.  Seriously, you can't go wrong.  You will find food you like and very nice people to serve you.
Worth it. Local folks love their customers. We got complimentary tacos because it was our first time. Try the BiBimBap. It was really good and the rice gets a really good crunch from the skillet.
Stayed here 2 weeks ago and it was really great.  Would definitely recommend. Love the Wifi in the lobby and the computers. Would be nice to have free wifi in the rooms.

This bakery makes the best cookies I've ever had.  My favorite, which I highly recommend, are the chocolate fudge dipped in white chocolate - but they sell out quickly, so go early.  They also make a great Mexican wedding cookie.  The staff is super nice and makes everything on the premises.  They also make a lot of various cakes, but I've never tried any of them - although I would not hesitate to.  Great spot!

Yelp's own Andrea B wanted to have a UYE (unofficial yelp event) and this is where we ended up and we were treated (yes, treated, I say!) to our girl BELTING out Welcome to the Jungle.  Please do see the pic I posted, but really it doesn't do justice.  

Best of all, there was a random drag queen bake sale going on & I scored an excellent apple pie.  

No I wasn't brave enough to sing myself...maybe next time.

Being a native, St. Claude was the last place I expected to find such a great club, but it's an avenue that's turning around.  Seriously, a dragon (a real one not a costume) could walk into Kajun's and take turn on the stage and no one would bat an eye.

Minus 1 star for the billowing cigarette smoke.

I have been visiting this hotel for the last 3 decades and I believe this is the best hotel in the entire nation. The food at all of the restaurants is delicious, the bars are fun, the shopping is great! The atmosphere is absolutely unbelievable. There is no better place to relax. Taking walks throughout the atrium and you feel like you are outside. You really don't have to even leave the hotel to feel like you're on the best vacation ever. I can't wait to go back!
I'll keep this short:  You'll be happy you ate at Three Muses.  The six plates we ordered were all delicious.  Relaxed scene, with a great jazz trio, good service, and reasonable prices.

Fresh food, artfully prepared . Really good for what amounts to an upscale fast food establishment. You order at the counter and it is delivered to your table or booth.
Really hip decor and vibe.
The LImeade was good as a beverage.
Friendly Service.
This place is fantastic! The best part was the brisket burger!! Service was amazing and food was superb!
Food was phenomenal... Definitely get the biscuits and sausage gravy... Carnitas Chilaquiles is a must have!
It is a great local restaurant. One of the best in the area, all my friends recommended me to go and they are right! Food is amazing.
$25 medium pizza that took 35 minutes to get to the table? Sure why not. It was fucking delicious. Piping hot and garlicky!

This place is great! Chris was our waiter and he took time to explain different drink and food options to ensure we had exactly what we were looking for. And his guidance was perfect. Being a pescatarian, there were plenty of options on the menu. We love that they are dog friendly and since it was a warm night, they made sure she had a bowl of water within minutes of us sitting down. My husband and I will definitely be back on a regular basis!

So I usually don't complain about anything business related because I'm a pretty mellow customer, but the service here actually prompted me to make a yelp account. I walked in and everyone was just sitting around doing nothing, they were on their phones and not even asking if we needed help. I literally had to bother one of the representatives to even look at me and when she finally did, she just gave me this look like, "what the fuck does this little girl want?" I'm a college student and my phone was stolen two nights ago so I went in to get a new phone. When I explained what happened and that my mom had already spoken to a verizon customer service rep who told us it would only cost 100, she laughed in my face and told me about all these extra charges that would make it closer to 200. Then when I had her explain the extra charges and information to my mom over the phone, she was completely rude and soooo disrespectful. Granted, my mom can be a bit abrasive at times but I was listening to the entire conversation and it did not warrant the response that Brenda (the sales rep) had. My mom was talking about how she had received different information than what Brenda had told her, this bitch actually held the phone away from her face IN FRONT OF ME. How dumb could you be?! My friend and I also overheard her talking about how irritating my mom was being when she went into the back room and even 30 feet away from us. She made several remarks and comments about my mom and the information she was "trying to make her understand," and I was literally infuriated. Then once I had paid for my phone I was on my friends phone telling my mom the total and explaining the process etc and Brenda didnt even say have a nice day or goodbye once the sale was finished, she simply walked into the back room without anther word. I told one of the other very nice sales women that I was very disappointed and she seemed more sincere than the lady who had worked with me. I really wish I'd spoken to her instead. So basically, DO NOT GET BRENDA. Unless you feel like getting irritated and pissed off!

Wow, every town needs a hub like this, great vibe, friendly staff, clean, and great food and coffee, and Beer!! 
I travel from sparks to sit and get work done at this place. Thank you!!

Here's the deal folks. 

We live in SouthFlorida, Homestead to be more accurate. We have many options for tacos in the area, and often don't indulge in taco meals outside of our area, mostly in an effort to try something new. 

Tonight we stumbled onto Americano, its appeal was via Uber Eats, but that turned out to be a mess, but the food was amazing!!! My wife, kids and myself loved it. 

We ordered the following

Croquettes ***
Mojo Pork Tacos
Steak Tacos
Crispy Brussels Sprouts ***
Fried Avocado Tacos ***
Fish Tacos
Americano Burger

*** means items missing from Uber Eats delivery. 

But here is the real cool part, I called Uber, in the end they were helpful but we were frustrated and just called it a night. It had been a long day on the road since 430AM East and we were done. After resolving the error with Uber, we said not to send the missing items. 
I wanted to at least call Americano and tell them how great everything we got was, and to share that feedback. 
In speaking to Alexander, the Manager there I think, he said he's glad we liked the food, and they really wanted us to be happy. So he took it upon himself to drop by and deliver the missing items to us personally, even after 1030PM when the venue is closed. talk about a cool dude!

This place has my vote for great eatery and service that goes beyond the norm.

My favourite store in Edmonton. Everything is beautiful and bright. Such a fun funky display style. I've been "visiting" a couch there for the longest time and finally ordered it. The service is always great, very friendly, and more than willing to help and answer questions. There are great inexpensive little finds for gifts or adding to your decor without breaking the bank. I've bought a number of gifts here. Henry's is great!
Worst service ever!!!! I never got my food!!!! I called them twice for them to tell me my food already on its way for 2 hours already smfh

I thought the Hyatt was supposed to be pretty nice. At least for the price, it should've been. My bathroom had pubic hair on the floor and in the tub, so I called the front desk and someone came up and cleaned it again, but all they did was push it around so I had to pick it up with a Kleenex and throw it away. My pillowcase had a few small stains on it. For breakfast, I went to the restaurant on the first floor and they gave me oatmeal that was barely warm. All in all, not a great experience. The 2 stars is for the view and the gym was good.
Service was good - attentive and friendly. Portions were large, price reasonable. My food was abut bland and not quite cooked to order. No complaints really.
Nice little bar with good food. The bartenders are friendly and the atmosphere is great.

We visit this location fairly regularly, probably once every six weeks or so.

Food has always been consistent, the pizza good, service usually fine but sometimes a bit on the slow side. We've never had a bad experience here and always enjoyed everything we've ordered, from appies to pasta dishes to pizzas. Free wifi is a bonus!
Great atmosphere and they are terrific with scheduling. I'm very satisfied and I've finally found a  salon here in Philadelphia! Also, Morgan is awesome!

Ahh Foodery...home of the $30 six pack. Albeit the BEST six pack you can get, I still have to dock a star for price. 

Much to the disappointment of my bank account I still frequent this lovely spot to marvel at the vast and yummy selection of fine beer from the world over. Naturally, I always cave and take away a bottle (or 2 or 3...) of the latest greatest Belgian wonder-brew to wash down my fab diablo sandwich. 

I suppose there are worse ways to spend 30 smackers...

I've lived in the neighborhood since I moved to Philly in May, 2014, and this has definitely been my go-to spot for pizza. Besides good pizza, wings, and other items, Lazo is a cool ass dude. And, there's always Stewart's pop.

Very disappointed with takeout this week.   We ordered chicken szechuan and found very little chicken.  It would more appropriately be named carrot Szechuan.  I would expect Szechuan to have some kick but found this was bland.  House wonton was good.  I like the option of brown rice.  We have eaten in the restaurant and enjoyed it, but this takeout was a fail.

I can well agrees with Erica and Teri, the Village as they call it, has to be the dirtiest diner around. Someone needs to tell the owners, who are there almost everyday, what a paint brush and a mop and bucket are. Don't even try the rest rooms, they have not been scrubbed in years, the same hot water faucet in the one bathroom has been broken for years, spewing scalding hot water on you hands if you try to clean them. And employes wash their hands here?!... Yeah, right. Why the locals eat there I don't know, their bodies must have built up an immunity. My wife and I went there when it was new many years ago, it was your basic diner. We tried recently and actually cut our meal short due to the condition of our silverware. Now to the food, yes they drop your toast when your order is put in and then it just sits in a pile for each server to grope over. They always burn the omlettes. The potatoes are undercooked and very greasy. Overall I can say the food is bland and lacks any real flavor. I have not had any other meal than breakfast . But please would someone buy this place, blow it up and clean it out. It needs it top to bottom. Enjoy your meal at the Village Diner, if you dare...
Audubon ale house is the perfect place for delicious reasonably priced food and drinks. It's never too loud and they have a pool table which is a plus!!

The owner was so helpful when I was trying to find a veil. I needed it in a short amount of time and she made it happen! She found a way to get it ordered and sent to me just in time for my wedding. I love the veil it is gorgeous! I had already purchased my dress before visiting this store, but the bride trying on dresses next to me looked beautiful in each dress she tried on because the dresses are stunning! I live out of state and was visiting family and this was on of the best places I have seen. I also like the personal attention and helpful not pushy attitude of the employees.

This is one of those reviews where I wish I could give an extra half star. The oysters were great and the fish special of the night was good. The dessert was good but it was not made in house just FYI. The service was good. I got the pizza to go once and it was delicious. I really don't have too many complaints other than the place just being kind of a head ache to get to. Parking is not easy and it is so so packed inside. I actually like waiting for a table if there is a comfortable bar to relax in but you can barely order a drink with the amount of people shoved into the building. Katie's is a good restaurant but not totally worth the hassle with so many options in New Orleans. We ordered a dessert to go and they charged us extra and did not include the whipped cream and berries that came with it when ordered to dine in. It rubbed us the wrong way after the bill being much higher than we expected. If I was in the area during non peak hours I would go back for a sandwich or pizza but I would not go back for dinner looking for a nice entree.

Speaking of Red Sky here..... not sure about the dual names.... I've had two meals here recently: one, a prepared to order lunch and, the other, a catered buffet dinner. Both experiences easily beat expectations. The salmon cakes and mixed greens I had for lunch were both tasty -- the salmon moist and mild, and the service excellent. Then at the catered event, the veggie dishes were excellent, the chicken average, and the service excellent again (for buffet style). Not only was I happy with everything and impressed with the safe yet creative menu items I saw, but they were great sports about accommodating some delicate dietary restrictions for our group, which is a big plus. I'll come back again.

It's huge- you don't realize you big from the outside, but this place never ends and every booth is different. The prices are usually pretty reasonable and I like that the staff wanders around to help or to hold stuff for you. It's hard to dig through stacks when your hands are already full, so they take it and hold it at the front for you. Just make sure you give yourself plenty of time, because you'll be in there for longer than you realize.

One of my favorite restaurants ever. So far I've had (and loved):

- Panang Curry: This is by far my favorite. The quality of the tofu is amazing. 
- Drunken Noodles
- Vegetable Dumplings
- Banana and Chocolate Rolls

The only reason this is a four star and not a five star is because their red curry was pretty awful. 

The place also has great ambience. It's super cute, and a great hidden BYOB. The servers are extremely friendly and service is quick! It is also really easy to get a reservation for a big group on fairly short notice.

Enjoyed the lunch buffet here yesterday. Lots of vegetarian options, but only 1 chicken dish (not including the tandoori chicken). Everything was well spiced (I find buffet offerings are often intentionally bland for 'lowest common denominator' appeal). The naan is delivered to your table vs. on the buffet line, but was some of the best I've had--hot, a bit fluffier than usual and delicious! 

I'm usually too full for dessert after Indian buffet, but I did try the one sweet offering they had and wished I hadn't--very strange texture and chalky taste. So, skip that, and you'll have some great eating!

This was a cute little place, and was well worth the price.  You are in prime SB location, without paying too much.  Use that money in other places in town.

The good....all the rooms are newly refurbished and lovely.  Whoever did the decor deserves applause.  The facility is small, so access to each room is easy, which is a plus for anyone with some mobility problems.  I've mentioned the price; can't be beat.

The other...well, we thought we were getting a queen size room, but it seemed to both my husband and me that the bed was really a full and not queen size.  It was still very comfortable, but I really wonder about that.  Also, the lighting was good in the room, but only spots.  No bedside lamps, which made it difficult if you wanted to read early in the morning, or late at night, without disturbing your partner.  And the breakfast is truly just a snack.  Pre-packaged muffins, bottled juices, and coffee/tea/hot chocolate.  Oh, and a bowl of apples.  OK, to get a start on the day, but definitely not a luxury breakfast by a long shot.

I would definitely go back here.  It's the price/location ratio that's unbeatable.

The staff here couldn't be better. So knowledgeable and always make sure I get a wine that I will love! Whether you know exactly what you want to drink or want to be adventurous this is the place for you! Amazing happy hour too!

My fiance and I stopped by here for some dinner after stopping by to exchange his phone at the Apple Store. I had never been to Cheesecake Factory for real food, only for its namesake cheesecake (which is great). This place was packed on a Friday night but we only had to wait about 30 minutes before a table opened up. Not terrible. As a few people have mentioned before, it is quite loud in here so make sure you sit close to your companions or be prepared to shout.

The menu is enormous. We had decided right away that we wanted the Eggroll Sampler so we ordered that and probably still needed 10-15 minutes before we decided what we were going to have to eat. But our server was really nice and gave some recommendations when it was clear that we were struggling. The Sampler was hot and cold.
