With just a squeeze of lemon or cocktail sauce and horseradish, either way they were great!  

I had the seafood Louie salad which was different than any other Louie salad I had experienced before which leads me to believe that the one I ate today was an original.  The shrimp and crab were tasty in the Louie sauce along with romaine lettuce, cherry tomatoes, black olives, and hard boiled egg.  This wasn't the best Louie salad I'd ever had but we were mainly there for the oysters...which again, were delicious.  

My wife ordered the crab cakes and was a bit disappointed that they came out fried even though the menu didn't say they were.   That being said, they were still mostly crab meant inside and full of flavor so we left there happy.

I came for a conference. The total charge for my three night stay was over $1100 after taxes and resort fees. Even after paying this astronomical amount was I was still charged $8 for a microwaved breakfast sandwich and $16 for a small tube of neosporin. Lets not even talk about the restaurant prices. Lunch at the cafe for two- just ordering 3 small tapas plates (1 California roll was $12!!!!) and 2 alcoholic beverage each was a whopping $70 (not including tip). The resort was INCREDIBLY difficult to navigate and it took me and my coworkers over 20 min to find our rooms. There were limited breakfast options and the grab and go options had massive lines due to being understaffed. Even the shuttle to the airport was not complimentary. Taxis to downtown Nashville were $30 each way. Rooms were clean but needed to be checked better. I had no room service menu, the iron was cheap and leaked water right out of the holes (they brought me a brand new one and it did the same thing)- ruined a dress of mine. Lamp with appliance plugs was broken. I could hear screaming kids up to 11pm at night. I didn't even know how to get to the atrium outside my room. I felt trapped in a biosphere and would never return willingly to this place again. Overall, it completely overpriced and not a relaxing stay at all. For a "world class resort" here in the United States it pretty shameful. I've had a completely better stay at resorts in other countries that are 1/2 the price, go there instead!!!!!
We found the seafood fresh, and the prices fair.  Spouse loved her mussels! Service was terrific.  I'll eat here again next time I'm in the area.

Food is good when it eventually shows up.  Messed up our son's order and we had to ask multiple times to have it straightened out and receive what we ordered.  Appetizer took 30 minutes and server blamed it on another server taking it from the kitchen. Service is either perfect or horrible.

The pizza was good
 The service was really good and the guys working very friendly. DON'T use the Groupon however and think you're getting a great deal because you're not. I bought the $15 value for $8. Ordered a large Canadian bacon/pineapple,  cheese sticks,  large bowl full of lettuce and croutons, and two beers. It still cost me over $25. It was clean. There were no other people in there until we started to leave and then a group of about 8/10 guys showed.. Possibly a lunch meeting or perhaps a low keep Christmas lunch. The pizza was good though!

After traveling, working and being awake for nearly 24 hours, I decided to hit up Honey's Sit-N-Eat.  I had the croque madame, and it was literally one of the best breakfasts I have had in a long time.  Very friendly staff- and the chef substituted veggie sausage for the ham in the dish for me (still taked amazing!)  I visited the historical landmarks afterwards since they're literally right down the street!  Bring cash!

While traveling on October 3rd 2012 with my elderly mother in a wheelchair, passed Wolfgang Puck Express on way to gate.  My mother wanted to try one of their pizzas, so with plenty of time to spare I ordered one for her, this was at 12:56 pm, the height of lunch time.  Was told it would be about twenty minutes, no problem.  Came back twenty five minutes later and the pizza hadn't even been started.  Line chef was too busy making salads and manager just managed to roll in (really, at the height of lunch service) while I was standing there with my mouth agape at the news that they hadn't gotten to it.    At this point, the no problem was a big problem, didn't have another twenty minutes to wait to get a pizza and eat.  I can only give this restaurant an Eek, Me Thinks Not since there was no food and my mother ended up with no lunch.
We enjoyed breakfast here a few days in a row. A nice quiet atmosphere with great food.
I went here for a hot stone massage after a long week. It was amazing!

I would NEVER go to this place again. I cut my leg on a Sunday afternoon. They did a good job on the two stitches and then the billing madness starts. First, they got the copay wrong and told me it was fault for them getting it wrong after they looked it up. The doctor told me to come back in 7 days to have them removed. The front desk said no copay, it was a follow up. The billing department said differently. The doctor did nothing on this visit but tell me to wait another 7 days. On this visit, the front desk said no copay, the billing department said different and when I question them the front desk lied to billing saying they told me about the copay. In the end you are going to get stuck with a bill much higher than expected and them telling you a lie about why.

This is one of my favorite places to eat. I have gone too many times to count. Their blackened chicken tacos will forever be my favorite. They also have good cheese queso. Taco Tuesday there is the best and is really affordable.  Also, their service is friendly and quick. I am always so impressed with the customer service of most of the staff there and from what I always see they work very hard cleaning, bringing people food, and getting them refills.

I stumbled on this place by gassing up next door, and almost didn't stop.  I'm so happy I did as it's now one of my favorite quick stops in Nashville.  I will tell you that HANDS DOWN, best fries I have had, anywhere anytime.  I had a Pork Pita that was also one of my all time faves.  Put this place on your must stop list when you are in Nashville.  BTW, I took mine to go, but they have a nice eat in area as well.

I've been going to Nails by Yen for several years now for regular manis and pedis and shellac manis.  The salon is bright, inviting and clean.  The staff is always friendly; the salon is incredibly clean; the nail techs are professional and do lovely work. AND....the consistency of the manis/pedis is excellent, and the products they use are fresh and last a long time on my nails. I know how seriously the owners take sanitation in terms of tools and tables, and they make sure that the everything is sanitized and never shared between clients.   I've most recently started having waxing done.  What a great job Yen does on my face and legs.  I highly recommend any of the services at nails by Yen.
I ordered an acai bowl. It was watered down and melted into a soup. For the $10 price I would have expected real acai. Disappointing.
My wife and two dear friends went there last night.  Food was excellent, waiter was very attentive, decor very much Italian.  Definitely a go to place again for us

The shop is cute and everything is displayed beautifully.  There is no lot nearby so parking may be weird but it's worth having to walk a few blocks in my opinion.  The items were all gorgeous, no sloppy frosting or whatever else here, you can tell the bakers really care about their work.

I found the prices a tad high to be honest but having gone through  most of my haul, the quality is top notch and is definitely worth the splurge every now and again. Between me and my parents were got a little of everything and I really recommend the red velvet cake (the best cake i've ever had seriously) and the various bars (key lime and lemon are not to be missed!). 

My major complaint was nothing had prices on it, so you had to ask constantly and when I went it was very busy so that quickly became a hassle.  Also, the women at the counter seemed to be a bit overwhelmed by the crowd so things didn't run as smoothly as they should have (it was early afternoon on a weekday...still busy but i'm sure Saturday or sunday mornings are worse). Maybe management should look into getting some extra help! 

I did want to shout out to the women at the counter though, someone came in to pick up a special order cake for the kentucky derby of all things and there was some very minor issue with it that the woman was very upset over (unneeded in my opinion- the issue had no effect on her ability to enjoy the cake it was purely aesthetic and truly a small detail) and the woman helping her was very kind and understanding and considerate when dealing with this drama queen.

I've had good service here. Quite helpful and friendly. They can get busy at times. But will take care of you when your time comes. 

Decent selection of phones. They stock the T-Mobile Tuesday freebies. Our dog loves her T-mobile bowtie and we have T-mobile umbrellas and super hero capes. They come in handy. 

Can you hear me now?
Very good McDonald's they are clean and the customer service is great,  Quality service is all that matters and they deliver it hands down
Cross-country drives are not often food successes. Well, just a few miles off of the I-270 bypass is this very nice and well priced place. The tuna had a rare center and the baby greens very fresh
Been here several times for wheels and tinting. Great service and fair prices. No complaints!

Tasty ice cream, conveniently located. Quick and friendly service.

This ice cream shop is located on one of the side streets right off of Lower Broadway. It's easy to find because they have a couple of big ice cream sculptures right outside their door. 

I chose to get a double scoop in a cup, with whipped cream on top. One scoop of Blackberry Cornbread and one scoop of Banana Pudding. The banana pudding was AMAZING. Very creamy and a very real banana pudding taste (I hate the taste of artificial banana). The Blackberry Cornbread was gross. To be honest, I got it because it sounded weird. Well, one bite into the chewy cornbread I was done. It did not work for me at all.

This is good spot for me to spend hours here to read my documents. Sometimes their internet connection is not very good. However, today I can surfing the Spanish songs videos on YouTube easily. I like the London Fog Latte there. I was surprise that the locals can play Mahjong games in the cafe store. Thank you, 6th North Cafe.

Cool sports pub in a suburban strip-mall. Interior is eclectic and fun and my server was very friendly. I was excited about the brewery aspect and ordered a glass of "Franklin's First" which was listed as a kolsch-type beer. It came out cloudy and looked and tasted to me more like a weiss (wheat beer), but the waitress told me that it "came out a little different" with each brewing and it was indeed what I ordered. That seems like a bit of a quality-control issue to me, but hey, it tasted good, so bottoms up!

I got the fish & chips for my meal, in part because the menu promised that the kitchen staff had all been trained by a "British fish & chip expert" (whatever that means). Unless you have a huge appetite, I recommend the Small portion size which has quite a good size piece of fish. The fish was well battered and fried--tender and flaky inside, just lacking in seasoning (guess the chef really was British, hah!). Served with a small side of saucy coleslaw, it was quite a satisfying  and enjoyable meal.

Positives:  We had the gumbo and fresh gulf fish--excellent.  The veggies were perfectly cooked (my wife still can't stop talking about the brussel sprouts).

Negatives: The waitress was in a bad mood and my seat was right under the A/C vent.  I got so cold, I sat on the bench seat by my wife and another diner.

Food:  5 stars
Service: 1 star
This hospital is clean and fun. The service here is exceptional, and the staff is extremely helpful!!! That's why this is one of the top hospitals in the world for little ones

I went there once for dinner, and I was not impressed.  There were three of us, and we all ordered something different.  I ordered the chicken fried steak, but what I received was something more like a salisbury steak.  It was razor thin, and it honestly looked pre-prepared, like they got it from some industrial food supply place and just heated it up.  I ordered beans and mashed potatoes as sides, and they both came out is a small bowl.  The mashed potatoes seemed like they were the instant kind.  The service staff were decent and attentive, but couldn't make up for the food.

Overall, I did not care much for the Sylvan Park Restaurant on Nolensville Pike (maybe the other location is better).  The food was mediocre, at best.  The portions were very small for the price they charge.  I won't be back.

Absolutely NOT A FOUR STAR HOTEL. I've stayed in many and this is service you get at a motel. 0 star service. Two elevators were broken, waited 30 minutes in line to check in they only had two people working, requested an item for an event they didn't deliver, and received a rude response from staff when asking a question. Also received rude service at restaurant and they were stingy charging me $1 for extra dressing. 

Rooms ground and casino are nice, but any real four star experience has the staff going above and beyond in every way.

I tried this food truck during the September Food Truck Friday event at Tower Grove Park. Between my husband and I, we had two tacos from this truck. 

Grilled fish taco 
This had some kind of fish on a white corn tortilla with their creamy cha cha sauce, and cilantro lime slaw. I asked the lady taking orders what kind of fish it was, but I can't remember what it was called. She said that it was similar to tilapia but with less of a fishy taste. This taco was on the small side, but it was only $3, so I think it was worth it because it was flavored well and I enjoyed it. 

Lobster taco 
This taco featured butter poached lobster, lemon cream cheese sauce, and salt and pepper slaw, and was topped with cilantro and on a flash fried tortilla. This was sooooo delicious! Granted, it was pricey, but come on! Lobster. Taco. Need I say more!? Try it out! 

The lady taking orders was patient with me asking my questions and the food came out quickly. I had a good experience with this food truck and I liked both of the tacos we tried!
Great beer, good atmosphere. The girls look great and the beer selection is awesome. Food is glorified bar food. Worth a stop in.

I live in San Diego and went to Santa Barara because my cousin wanted to get her first tattoo. We stopped at Golden Eagle Friday night at the beginning of our pub crawl. We came back at 2 on Saturday to get our tattoos. (her first, my third). Andrew was on time and worked with us both to finalize the artwork to ensure our satisfaction. He did my cousins first, then mine. The work was outstanding. I just keep looking at it impressed with the detail that he put into it. Andrews work far exceeded my expectations. Prices were fair. Shop was clean. Staff answered all our questions. I will be going back to get another one from him soon. I highly recommend this shop and Andrew in particular. Cool guy, great art, and tons if bars on State Street to drink the sting away. Go there and get one this weekend. See you there. 

(check my profile for pic of tattoo)

Poor service this time. Way understaffed for number of customers. Took over 1/2 hour just to get soup and salad. The soup was cold and had to be sent back. Manager did comp our lunch but the whole lunch experience was ruined.

Yum and yummer.  OK, we were disappointed there was no grouper the day we were there (and no mahi mahi either).  We stood on their deck trying to decide whether to stay or go, and the manager brought us an envelope with a gift certificate in it to apologize for no grouper.  He said, "This never happens.  We always have grouper.  I'm so sorry, please give us a try."  So we stayed and the food was great and the service was fabulous.  We had people checking on us A LOT, and so friendly and welcoming.  I especially liked Travis who was from "Half way between here and Ocala," and had just enough drawl to be charming--and called me "Ma'am" in a cute not patronizing way.

Agree with other reviewers--sit upstairs, outside on a lovely weather day and enjoy the view.

Working as a vendor (flowers and linens - Moon Over Indy) for a wedding at Neidhammer, we had a wonderful experience. Joy and Becca, wedding and event staff, were great to work with. It is a beautiful historic, exposed-brick, wood floors,  high ceiling kind of place. Great view of downtown. Highly recommend for a party or wedding.

The place is cute, but the owner is rude and unfriendly. She was disrespectful towards us  and unaccommodating. Her behavior toward local customers was unacceptable and detracts from the experience at an otherwise quaint establishment. 

In addition to her negative demeanor, she handled food without gloves and refused to put a lid on a to-go cup which was overflowing. She then proceeded to throw the lid in our direction and serve another customer. 

Overall, it is unfortunate that a neighborhood gem is tainted by her misconduct.

Located in the heart of the Italian Market is this mostly take-out sandwich joint, although there are 5-6 stools inside.  You can get a cheesesteak here, but I would recommend ordering the roast pork sandwich.  Or if you`re adventurous, you can even opt for tripe.
Keep in mind, any cheese, brocooli or other addition to the base meat will each cost additional cash.  Which I would say is mildly annoying, especially that your $7 sandwich can turn into a $10 sandwich very easily.  
The roast pork is very tender and juicy.  You will see it being scooped up from a vat of deliciousness that it has been simmering in for many hours.  Those aromas that hit you while ordering will help perk up your appetite.  It`s juiciness will also soak into your breat quickly though, so be sure to dig into your sandwich quickly, especially if you take it to-go.  Would agree that the older bald guy w/ some facial hair is grumpy, but the young lady who ended up making my sandwich was very sweet.  (perhaps his daughter, ha !)
Great service, great ambiance, amazing food. Overall stellar experience every single time ive been. The eggs benedict might  be the best in st. Louis. 5 stars all day.
Offering friendly service, Pho King makes a good bowl of pho tai.  It isn't the best, but it isn't the worst by a long shot.  Recommended if you're in the area.
Sunday Funday !!!! Best place to go on Sunday!!!! Excellent breakfast/brunch! If you got to watch your football/ ice hockey playoffs- any sports! This is the place!

We stopped by The Happy Saguaro to find some things for our home.  Edgar asked us if we had found a food place for Mexican food and Margaritas (we just moved here).  We told
Him we had not and he highly recommended this  place.  Our waiter, Shaune, shares the amazing history of this restaurant (too long to post here but look it up).  The food was amazing!  My fiancé asked for 2 sides of salsa to go.  The "Horney Cucumber" Margarita was amazing.  I had to give my first one to my fiancé because I couldn't see the menu without my glasses and the description clearly states that it is mixed with Jalapeños.  Whoa!  Super spicy.  I got another one minus the Jalapeños.  After hearing the history of this amazing restaurant, we are definitely heading to the downtown location for their signature dish, "Carne Seca."

TRI TIP!

I dont know when they DONT serve the trip tip but I guess im lucky cause its always there.

Drive up the mountain, grab a beer and a tri tip and enjoy the nice day.

I come to this location once a month to have brunch with my uncle and my dad.  I've never had a meal here that I didn't enjoy (the payella(spelling?) is my favorite), and the three of us can order a full meal at a very reasonable price.  Everything is delicious!!  

My dad and his brother come here every weekend to have free coffee and toast (old folks, what can I say, they love a bargain)  I wish I lived closer and I'd join them more often!!!

The only reason I didn't give this particular store 5 stars was because this location does tend to be very busy, and I've sometimes had trouble getting someone to clean a table for us to eat at.  They may want to hire a bit more help for those busy days.

I had a salad, prime rib(medium well), baked potato.  The salad and warm bread rolls were tasty.  The prime rib was delicious.  Everything I had was good.  There is a bar and tables with white linen and candles. My hostess, Gigi and waitress, Cecelia were awesome. Good spot to take a meeting, date, family or reservations.  The parking is the only problem though their is parking across the street next to the dollar tree or you can park at Woodlawn library and walk a couple of blocks.  The prices are somewhat high.  Seafood and steak are always expensive.  I know they have specials and a raw bar on Thursdays.   I would recommend to eat at this establishment.  Nice atmosphere and good eats.

Farmhaus is everything I like in dining. First class locally sourced ingredients prepared to perfection, with the individual elements allowed to shine. This is food how it's meant to be!

 I've been to Farmhaus three times now for dinner and each and every time it's been outstanding. The ambience is classy but laid back, plenty people in suits, plenty in shorts and flip flops. 

The menu is not prepared in the classic style with appetisers and entrees but just an assortment of meals of various price. Everything I've had has been good but showstoppers like the Roasted Ozark Forest Mushroom Salad, the Farmhaus Butcher's Plate and Porchetta Bao cannot be missed. Recently they had a lemon tart with toasted marshmallow and pistachio crumble that was divine, best dessert I've eaten in St. Louis. Only downer for me is the post dinner coffee. They haven't offered espresso when I've been there and their drip is average at best.

Still, overall this is as good a meal as you'll eat in St. Louis and for a bit cheaper than the other high end offerings in the city.

I have been craving for really good South Indian food . As soon as I moved to Indianapolis, I looked for the restaurants in the evening and this was the only place which offer dinner buffet. I dropped in this place for dinner with my friend and needless to say, the restaurant was smelling all curry and I loved the aroma. They were still setting up the dishes for the dinner buffet but they told us to grab the plates and hog on! We were like Hell Yeah !! Let's do it !

The items on the buffet were great. I think it was a huge spread but it's quite common if you drop into an Indian restaurant for buffet. There was two kinds of soup - chicken soup and tomato soup which I didn't try. I always recommend people to stay away from soups at Indian restaurants. Moving on.. There was my favorite South Indian food - Vada [ pro tip: they look like small donuts but they are not sweet] , and they were awesome, I had almost 10 of them. There were four kinds of chutneys, every chutney was perfect. They had delicious sambar too.  [pro tip : you generally have Vada's with chutney and sambar. Especially coconut chutney] They had Potato fry [aloo fry], egg plant curry, panner makhani [paneer butter masala], veg Manchurian and couple more vegetarian dishes. They all were fantastic.

Coming to the non- vegetarian section, they have chicken makhani [chicken butter masala], lamb curry, tandoori chicken, chicken dum biryani. I didn't try the lamb curry but the chicken dum biryani was great. [pro tip: add some chicken makhani to your chicken biryani rice and have it, it's so yummy]. The tandoori chicken was not so great. I don't understand why several Indian restaurants get this dish wrong. They add plenty of food color which spoils the taste of the dish and make it look red and dark pink in color. It's ridiculous. Please get this right!! 

They had carrot halwa, couple of ice creams and fresh cut fruits in the desserts section. 

They serve any kind of naan and roti and Dosa's at your table if you tell the server. [pro tip: Dosa is a South Indian dish and they look little like pan cakes and some people even refer them as Indian pan cakes. And again they are not sweet like pan cakes. You eat them with chutneys and sambar or with potato curry ] 

I really had a very good time having the food at this place. I do recommend this restaurant. I will definitely go there again.

This place was okay they didn't have many flavors but they did have some I've never tried before which was cool. I got there 45 mins before closing and felt like I was in the way of their cleaning duties, and even though I finished eating at 9:30 I felt uncomfortable hanging around. They had a lot of topping options but not peanut butter, this is my favorite topping to add so I'm hoping they get some in the near future.

This place opened in September and I was presently surprised how friendly the staff was. The atmosphere is trendy yet cozy, and the decor is country sleek. 

I ordered the half pumpkin soup and beet salad with a side or cornbread ($13). The soup was ok - it was garnished with oats and this sweet red sauce. Loved the flavor of the oats and sauce, but wasn't a fan of the soup base. The salad was small but very good. Nice flavor and unique combination of ingredients. My friend ordered the friend chicken with 3 sides: Mac and cheese (just ok), beans (excellent), and cauliflower (yum yum yum!!!). I'd definitely come back next I'm in the STL and order the catfish. Hope this place sticks around for a while

The Quick: Go for the view alone. You are right on the water with gorgeous view of Palm trees, blue waves, and even actual pelicans! 

The details: In terms of food, the lobster mango salad was great, I would highly recommend. I also had a side of brussel sprouts which was prepared with a generous amount of bacon and olive oil (just the way I like it). My co-worker ordered the grouper and wasn't overly thrilled by his meal. 

The Rusty Pelican was very good. There are better seafood restaurants in Tampa, however the tropical view and friendly staff are worth many repeat visits.

One star is for the rudeness, not honoring their words and high cost. My dad went their and got his smog check but didnot pass. The guy charged him ~$30 and said next time after he gets the problem fix, he would only charge ~$15. So my dad got the problem fixed, come back, another guy charged him $22. I wasnt there, my dad doesnt speak English so he called me and gave the phone to talk to this guy (on Aug 15, 2017). I explained the situation and he said he can not do that, hes the only one there, everyone was on vacation and then just hung up when I did not finish talking yet. He was very rude on the phone. Their price is way too high. Even their "discount" price is higher than other places. If you need a smog check, GO TO G K Smog INSPECTION on 1960 E 2nd St, Reno, NV 89502. They are very nice there and only charge $16

Beautiful park with terrific trails and scenery as well as picnic area.  Great for biking.  One downside:  a grumpy gate employee.  Because we have a Park Pass, I'm always prepared to provide a photo id as the employee requested.  When I presented him with a current photo ID card from my University, he gruffly said, "I need an ID with your signature."  I gave him my passport as my spouse said to the gentleman, "That ought to suffice as identification as it was issued by the U.S. Government."  Apparently my husband interpreted the exchange with the park ranger as I did:  the ranger was rather rude.  It was not our fault he was working on Christmas Eve--he signed up to work for the National Parks.
If you haven't been to this park, by all means do go--it's definitely worthy of your time.  Don't forget your camera!

This place is wonderful!  If you're looking for a great French inspired breakfast or brunch food, this place is where it's at!  I love local places that aren't chains, and it's even better when the food surpasses expectations!   The design is quaint and you even get a glimpse of the bakery where your food is prepared. We ordered a croissant sandwich which was delicious and so fresh and not greasy at all! ... Banana bread French toast was bomb, and no nuts was a bonus for someone with a nut allergy! (In fact, unlike most French bakeries, ingredients are listed on all to go bakery items, which is a godsend). The chorizo and goat cheese omelet was also delicious!   The owner was very kind and we can only hope he opens up another cafe in Orlando!!

I have been to Naf Naf twice in one week. I love Mediterranean food and I was filled with joy when I found out this place was coming here. I have heard of this place in Chicago and am SOOOOOOOO glad they brought the concept here. The staff is really nice and quick. You can tell they are still get their bearings but their friendliness really makes up for any inconveniences. The baklava is really really good. I wish they had lamb shawarma but I think it makes sense that they stick to what people are comfortable with. I work right across the street and my gym is in the same shopping center. I have a feeling I will be going here quite often, I can't wait for those delicious post workout shawarma salads.
So obsessed with this place! Love, love, love! I was afraid the dough would be dry but it was perfect. I would recommend the original chocolate chip dough.

Wow - I hadn't had a donut in years and since my office is right above and my coworker is now addicted, I've been tasting all the varieties Square Donuts has to offer. These may very well be the best donuts I've had, yes, even including Long's... 

The yeast are perfect -delicious, fresh, sweet, melt in your mouth. The blueberry cake is unlike any I've had. 

These guys know what they're doing - the staff and owner are super friendly too! 

With a cup of coffee, these are quite a treat!
Service was excellent!!! the server always say Hello each time she serve our food lol very attentive. Food were delicious and inexpensive. Would comeback here again and recommend to friends

Truffle fries were delicious. In fact I could just go there and order fries.

Fear not, though, the burgers were also good. My husband had the woodstock burger which he thought was delicious and I had a chicken sandwich - the chicken was moist and perfectly cooked. 

Atmosphere was fun - we enjoyed sitting out on the patio and this fits the bill of a gourmet burger joint.

We will be coming back again.
Try the shrimp and cheese grits. Best I've ever had. Could eat it every day for every meal.
Airbnb guests left us a 312 Pizza - I re-heated it in the toaster oven and it changed me. This place just raised the bar & set the standard for best pizza in Nashville.

Spectacular service and a fresh selection of sandwiches, salads, coffee and baked goods! Lots of healthy choices and they allow you to make substitutions. The owner/manager was very attentive to his customer's needs and went out of his way to make everyone seated to a meal, feel welcomed. Make sure to grab a Magic Bar on your way out, or any other fresh baked good!

Interesting location considering Chipotle and Moe's are so close by.

I walked in and didn't really know what to do. No one yelled "WELCOME to The Lime!" and there was no one else jn line in front of me for me to follow their lead and eavesdrop on their order. 

Why was  I a little flustered upon walking in? Their menu is not very user friendly. My main issue was the disturbingly low occurrence of guacamole on it. I scanned the menu for something with guacamole on it, as I wanted whatever that would be (avocados being present on a menu item is usually how I decide what I'm going to pick). Nothing seemed to come with guac. Could I add guac to my meal? I had no idea how much it would cost since there was no mention of add ons, so I refrained. Perhaps it would have given my naked beef burrito (everything but the tortilla) some more flair. 

Another gripe about the menu: be clear if "beef" means ground beef or steak. They had delicious looking steak cooking on the grill which is why I chose beef for my meal. I was pretty disappointed it ended up being ground beef.

They DO get major points for their salsa bar, which in addition to about 8 different salsas includes fresh cilantro. I'm a huge salsa verde fan, and theirs was pretty on point. 

Overall, this is a middle-of-the-road casual Mexican joint on par with Tijuana Flats or Moe's. I will give it another try but I'll probably go for a quesadilla or tacos since my burrito bowl didn't leave much of an impression.

I'm always getting menus from Chinese restaurants and pizzerias, but when you have your standbys, it's not easy for a new place to catch your eye. The menu for Queen came this week, and I wanted to try a few things from their rather large vegetarian selection. They have the usual veggie and bean curd (a.k.a. tofu) entrees, but they also have mock chicken, beef, and duck. We actually ordered carryout the same day I read the menu - I was excited!

The food was okay, but I have to admit, it was disappointing. Part of me wants to try another few dishes, but that part is being told to quiet down and not be so charitable. 

First up - moo shu vegetables. I usually love the cabbage and sweet sauce, and this had the bonus of including broccoli, baby corn, and mushrooms. But the pancakes were dry, stuck together, and inedible. The corn tasted like a can. Not great.

Next, vegetarian "beef" with mixed vegetables. The beef tasted like my homemade attempts at seitan, where the stuff still tastes like flour. The sauce was good, but the dish was unremarkable. 

Finally, we ordered one of the Chef's Specialties - bean curd with general tso's sauce. The silken tofu was deep fried and coated with a sticky, sugary sauce, and there were a few pieces of broccoli alongside. Very disappointing - no spice, no heat, and just sugar and fat for appeal. 

The two star rating means I've had better. My absolute favorite is Wild Ginger in Huntingdon Valley, and I also prefer China Garden Inn in Willow Grove. I was hoping for a good take out place closer to home, but this isn't it.
Everything is absolutely delicious. If you haven't been here you are missing out. The drinks were outstanding. The food was amazing!

This place has the best chinese food in town. Perhaps its the only chinese food in town though.  Food is authentic, decent on my overall asian food scale, and great on my local nola scale for chinese food. Price is right. The beef noodle soup had great broth.  Noodles and beef were okay.  My friend got the Lo Mein was great.  We went here after taking our step 1 for med school to eat away the sorrows.  

Seems family owned by this nice lady, support your local food.

[rating scale: 5 stars is my favorite of this type +/- an insane deal if the food is super cheap; 4  a normal haunt I revisit; 3 nice but once is enough; 2 I did not get food poisoning; 1 Damn I got staph here]

I recently came here for a pedicure and I'm pleased with the end results. 

I'll definitely come back when I need my nails looking fabulous. I also want to look into their other services. My friend got a pedicure and her eyebrow waxed and she seemed to be pleased with it!

The people here were very nice and friendly.

Absolutely delicious polish cuisine. The pirogies are plump, delicate and flavorful. The special of the day was a stew with kielbasa, lima beans, potatoes, shredded beef and cabbage. It was perfect. Stuffed cabbage was also a hit.

On my first night in New Orleans, walking down Bourbon Street to Three Muses was definitely worth it. Passing through all the crazy costumes, booze and naked chicks made the trendy, unassuming, blues filled restaurant/bar that much more welcoming. I went there because of the good reviews, and ordered based on what others in Yelp had reported. I was not disappointed. The Mac&Cheese with brussel sprouts was amazing. The "Dirty Dan" martini was delicious. 2 martinis, entree and Mexican Chocolate ice cream cost me $30!  WHAT!? That's super cheap for this DC girl. I spent the evening chatting with a local, retired gentleman who had entertaining stories and great food/music recommendations. 

I was there alone, which worked to my advantage: I got a seat at the bar while groups waited close to an hour for a table. This was at 7pm on a Sat in Oct. The only negative was that I spent 10 minutes sitting at the bar without anyone behind the bar making eye contact with me. Finally, a bar tender washing glasses happened to look up and I placed an order with him. That didn't make me feel welcome, but I got my drinks and food very quickly. 

Live Jazz/blues was fantastic! Go to Three Muses if you can. They are very busy, so don't expect great service.

If you want sandwiches, these are good, like New York sandwiches good. Of course they are overpriced but at least the bread is fresh and delish. I'm still glad I had them as I was not craving Popeye's, Starbucks or other.

However, a single slice of plain pizza for $7-8 ?? No thank you!

Had a great experience working with Dom in getting my 2012 Honda Accord--he was extremely helpful and went the extra mile and stayed late to ensure I was able to walk away with the keys in hand. I genuinely appreciate it and would recommend the dealership to anyone!
Italian paradise you can get whatever you need from fresh pasta to coffee to cold cuts to vegetables.  And the canoli is amazing I will definitely frequent this spot.

I love this accounting firm.  Super professional and staff that matches well to whatever bookkeeping personality you happen to have.  Because we can all be a little Jekkyl & Hyde when it comes to bookkeeping and getting everything in on time.  They are great.  I have a small business but my accountant there (M. Bloom) also works extensively on complicated returns of all shapes and sizes.  This is a great firm to work with!

My gf and I were told by the hostess that they were open until 2am. We ordered fries then after they were put in and given to us, we were told they were having a bar clean. The bartender just came around and announced last call at 11:43pm. No sign was posted on the door, nor was it locked preventing any customers from entering. Needless to say that this will be the last time we visit this bar for drinks. Horrible notice. Anyone visiting might want to call to verify when the next "bar clean" will be. The bartender was very rude to customers who arrived after last call, rolling her eyes after an order and seeming to be disgusted when two women arrived.

The food and service was spectacular yet affordable. The Blue Duck menu has the spice and delicious quirks you'd expect in a new University City spot, yet its conveniently located in the Northeast! 

All of the service staff were friendly and on point. I think our waitress could read minds- she knew exactly when to walk over and take our orders. She even brought us go boxes without us needing to ask.  

Two tips: 
Make reservations, but don't be deterred if you forget. We had a 20 min wait for a late dinner. 

Be prepared for a loud restaurant at peak hours. I think they need to do more to absorb noise in the room because this place is kind of small and very noisy when full. Maybe more decor and sound absorbing ceiling tiles?

Goat cheese and spinach salad is tasty. 
The gluten free hamburger bun had good texture. I ordered online and it was ready upon arrival.
Terrible customer service! Waiting 1:30 minutes and 3 calls. Rude guy answering the phone.

It all depends on who the cook is. You got some really good cooks who take their job serious and you have a few who or big on burning and smothering with grease.

When you have the right person cooking, you get an amazing meal at a great price. 

Their soda is off brand and taste DISGUSTING! Be sure to order a drink at the bar first. I usually get a $2 Stella perfect companion with a hot dog or burger .   

Customer service is above average most of the time.

This place is great. After visiting several other dry cleaners in St. Pete and being disappointed with the quality of work and high prices of all of them, I decided to try Seaside. Been using them for about 6 months now, and have always been more than satisfied. The quality of their work is top-notch, and their prices are the lowest I've found! Not to mention the business is owned/operated by an extremely nice couple who always engage in friendly conversation during each visit. Recently I dropped off a light blue dress shirt that was basically covered in red wine stains due to an accident at dinner the previous night. I'm talking a full glass of merlot right across the front from top to bottom. I was pretty sure the shirt was a goner, and didn't hold much hope at all of the wine stains coming out. But, when I returned to see if they were able to do anything with it, I was suprised to see that the shirt looked brand new. On top of that, I was charged less than $10 for removing all of the stains and a fresh dry clean! I will continue to recommend Seaside to all of my friends and coworkers. Keep up the good work guys!

Excellent service. Food is absolutely fantastic for enticing your taste buds. Definitely try the soups (tomato was my favorite), nachos with goat cheese, and the falafel wrap. The ranger cookie sandwich was really good but I felt like I needed a glass of milk or vanilla gelato instead to handle the sweetness. By far the best veggie food I've had in a while.

M.L. Rose isn't bad, but it's not great.  I love the concept.  They are a burger place that offers an above average beer selection.  That's a great start!

The problem is their execution.  The beer list is good.  It could probably be a bit better since 'craft beer' is actually in their name.  However, I have no complaints with their above average selection.  However, the food is very average.  They could do a better job and I would lump their burgers into this group.  Unfortunately, I would have to say that this is you classic example of bar food.

I do come here occasionally and always enjoy myself.  It's a fun atmosphere and the service is good and very friendly.  They also sponsor Nashville Sports Leagues and I love the folks that give back to their community.  I've been there several times just because of that relationship.

M.L. Rose is a decent bar overall and a good place to grab a burger and a beer.  It's just not one of the better places in Nashville to get these items.

I walked in to get Toyota Rear Seat Belt taken care of on Saturday morning. It seemed fairly 5-10 mins job to put plastic protective cover to prevent seat belt rubbing against metal part. I was asked to come back during weekdays with appointment for three reasons a) As per Assistant Service Manager, he did not had any technician to work on recall issue and b) they do not perform any recall related service on weekend (very surprised why not?). c) This recall service will take 2 hours. The next available appointment was 9:00 AM Tuesday which i had to take a half day ff at work. 

I brought car in on the day of appointment and it was fixed within 30 mins including two visit of Service Adviser where they make recommendation to fix other issues. Within this 30 mins they performed recall service and courtesy inspection check (oil change inspection, tire rotation , brake inspection , battery inspection, Air filters replacement inspection, shock absorber inspection). So i had to take half day off just for fairly 15 mins job which i was told takes 2 hrs minimum. 

I was pissed off and i decided to brought this to Service Manager's attention which he laughed saying you are not happy because we did it too fast????? I tried to make my point couple times to help him explain that i had to take half day off just for 15 mins job which could have been easily fixed on first visit. So it took me two visits and half day off to get something fixed which was Toyota's mistake (factory recall). In my opinion they do not perform any recall related service on weekend (specially without appointment) since it's free and they don't make make enough from it.

Update: Service Manager called and he was very apologetic about what happened and how Assistant Service Manager acted. As per him they I could have dropped car off on weekend not not came back during weekdays. Sorry but still you have lost my business. I do not mind going to different dealership or place where they treat you with respect. We are all professionals and shall act like one...!!!

I really wanted to like this, because it is close to our new house. The Tom Yum soup was OK, as were the spring rolls, but basics like drunken noodles and pad se eew were just not good. The noodles were slimy and the pad se ew tasted like plain, bland garlic noodles. I appreciated the fast service which is why it has two stars and not one.

If you just need a place to crash between flights this might work. The place is a dump, featuring dirty, run down rooms. Low water pressure on showers, bath fan inoperative, carpet and furniture stained. Bed was ok, but that's about it. Property is in disrepair and grounds are trashy.

My advice is to "see and avoid".

I gave this place another shot because the sushi is pretty good and they have a bar which is a plus. However, this is the second time I had hair in my food and they refuse to take responsibility for it. Both waitresses came back to make excuses rather than take responsibility of serving food with hair. The management did not approach us at all and said they would take the item off the check, though they normally wouldn't do that because I ate most of it!! I was beyond furious with the service because of course I would not eat any if that was the first piece I ate. This establishment needs better hygiene and better service.

The meal was very good. Had black pasta with seafood, gnocchi, and pizza. Creative, served at perfect temperature, service ruined an otherwise perfect meal. No matter the question about a dish or more water to waiter it was AWESOME. And 33rd time you hear that word to describe something, you realize it is a catch word rather than the truth. I was amazed an M Street restaurant doesn't train their staff on what to say about the food and how to answer a guest's question more descriptively. In other words anytime now my guests and I hear the word we laugh! It is a word we use to mean exaggeration.

I waited for 10 minutes at seafood counter before someone finally came to take my order. The person at the meat counter said he couldn't help me and didn't offer to call for someone.Then I went to the salad bar and there was no lettuce of any kind. This visit was too frustrating and I will not be back.

Ordered 9 platters for a large group on GrubHub.  Got a text message that it was ready but when we got there we still had to wait 10-15 minutes.  Recommend waiting a little bit longer before showing up.  Very affordable and you get a lot of food for the price.  Satisfied our Mediterranean craving!!!

We were the only white people there. Seriously, we walked in, and I heard "one of these things is not like the others" running along in my head. There's always a question of whether or not ethnic restaurants are authentic, and since I've never been to Korea, I can't say for sure, but I'm guessing it's probably pretty on track.

First of all, the kim chee. I have absolutely no idea what they brought to the table, and I decided that I'm ok with that. It all tastes good. They bring a lot of little plates, and they are very happy to bring more as you finish stuff off.

They have both tables with grills and tables without. If you get a table without, don't bother ordering meat for them to cook in the kitchen, go for the meals that come in a hot stone bowl. If you do have a grill, and order meat, they are not stingy. You will get more than enough to eat.

The decor is spare, and kind of grim. Not much on the walls, and the chairs are uncomfortable. There's a big 2nd room, that I have never seen used (but I suspect is there for larger parties). there's a bulletin board at the entrance that has all kinds of Korean events posted, and they have a bunch of Korean newsletters and things (if you were looking for community info)

Overall, I always feel a little out of place here, but it's worth it for the great food!

I guess i'll write a separate review for Cafe Beignet then i did for the Music Legends Park. Came back the next morning here since they were closed when we came for Jazz the night before. We got beignets and coffee. They were super fresh and delicious. A little different than dumonde. I wouldn't say better or worse. Just different but equally delicious. I will say this. Cafe Beignet has the live jazz in the park, which gives it a favorable advantage. Come try and ENJOY!
Great deal on drinks and the unagi melts in your mouth! The place was pretty busy and

The best Taiwanese food ever in Reno. A great variety of selections and reasonably priced. We ordered, crispy pork rolls, the curried Chicken and crispy fish bento box. Everything was very tasty. Great service as well, normally you don't get very vood service in a Asian restaurant.  Definitely would come back here again next time in Reno.
The food, drinks, and ambience was amazing. I ate the salmon, hummus, and mashed potatoes and all three were delicious.

I don't always take Amtrak, but when I do, this is my second favorite station (soft spot for Union Station in DC). The main area is open and spacious with many places to sit. There are plenty of food options. The staff has always been helpful for me. I can keep going on, but you get the point. There are many reason that Amtrak might turn people off, but 30th Street Station should not be one of them.

My husband and I were here on Wednesday 8/30/2017.  We stopped in to Besito Mexican Restaurant on our way home to Lakeland from Tampa Airport.    We stopped in and we were very pleased with the food and the service.  We were served by a gentleman named Andy S.  He was very knowledgeable about the dishes and very attentive to our needs.  The food was delicious, the Sangria was outstanding and Andy was great!
One of the best hidden gems in all of New Orleans! Great local food, and amazing hospitality. Their Po Boy sandwiches are to die for. Next time I'm in New Orleans I'll definitely be back!!!

Luke's Happy Hour 4-6pm M-F. 75 cent oysters as well as half priced cocktails, wine, and beer. Nice lively atmosphere with a good mix of locals and tourist alike. Come early as the bar fills up quickly. Oysters were fresh and plump and the house gumbo has to be one of the best in town.  Come on by and enjoy a dozen or two.

We had dinner at Reed's this past Saturday night and enjoyed the experience for the most part.  Our reservation was waiting for us in the upstairs dining room, which became increasingly louder during the evening.  At times, we couldn't even have a conversation at our table due to the lack of acoustical panels (from other reviews I understand that these will be installed).  We waited for a long time to have our dinners delivered, but not before one of the managers came by our table to let us know that through some sort of an error our order never made it to the kitchen.  The kitchen was very kind and delivered two small plates of food to tide us over till our entrees arrived.  My wife had the roasted chicken which was very good.  My daughter had the pork chop, which was cooked just right.  I had the butcher steak, which was good, but not over the top good.  Our small plates consisted of the corn bread (excellent!), the roasted cauliflower, and the pork belly.  We will definitely go back but will request seating downstairs, which had a much lower level of sound.

The last 3 times I've been to this Taco Bell/KFC they've messed up my order each time.
1. They put tomatoes on my crunch wrap supreme after ordering no tomatoes (receipt confirmed) and they only have us 1 of the 2 crunch wrap supremes we ordered.
2. Same tomato issue from above.
3. Gave me the complete wrong order.

The worst part was that all of this was through the drive thru so I didn't realize until I was home.

Fail.
Wow!   Awesome food!  Great service!  Top notch entertainment!   Great place for a night out with friends.  Unique experience.   Highly recommended.

I like their bar drinks (sitting at the bar watching the mixologist is a lot of fun) and of course the $11 Village Burger (super juicy and tasty) and duck fat fries (although I could never get through the whole batch alone because they are super heavy).  The bbq pork sandwich is ok.  My main complaints are that the sesame bun is too soft, the chunks of pork are too big (and they aren't really juicy like what you'd expect pulled pork to be), the sauce is too sweet, and there isn't enough coleslaw (only a mouthful is placed on top of the meat, booooo).  We have tried the raw bar here too which is just ok as well.

However, I take off a star for how horrible of an experience it is just to get a seat each time I have come here for dinner whether it's closer to 5 or closer to 9pm (I didn't have to wait for lunch for 2 at 3:15pm, but for some reason the hostess still could not seat us promptly and seemed pretty confused at the prospect of seating us).  The dinnertime hostess SUCKS.  She either doesn't know what it means to be a hostess or hates her job and refuses to do it.  They always tell you some absurd wait time if you keep pushing since they're so vague and work so slowly (1 hr 45 min is a common number they use)--is this a strategy to deter people from bombarding this place?  One saving grace is that they'll take your number and will call you once your table is ready (which never takes as long as they claim).  I also think the seating arrangement sucks because there are a few booths that are quite nice if you have a big group (more than 4 ppl) but the tables are round so sharing food becomes difficult.  Otherwise, you are left staring at another couple throughout your meal.  There are plenty of bar seats which are always filled and then there is this weird back area that is just a shafted space. (And why is there this counter that runs all the way to the back of the restaurant that takes up space but serves no purpose? You can't stand there with your drink because the wait staff, hostess and customers going to the bathroom would constantly make you move).  I've never sat outside but it looks like a decent area.

Our servers were a bit slow but overall, friendly.  I would definitely not come back here for dinner--too much hassle!

Great customer service, first time customer cookies and the works.  Very impressed.  Sadly what wasn't impressive was the beer :(  I've never been to a brewery where I disliked all of the beers -- frankly, it was shocking!  So 5 star customer service mixed with 1 star beer = 3 stars.  Also happy hour apps were wonderful!  Definitely a must visit during happy hour, just stay away from the brews...

4-star edit: the manager messaged me here with the friendliest and most professional language I've yet to hear from an owner so I've, in light of that, bumped this review up to 4-stars!  It shows great care that a manager would follow reviews on this site and have the professionalism and take the time to write.  Kudos!  I'll give it another go with I visit Franklin again now for sure.

Exactly what you want in a Philly diner. Crusty exterior, stern attitude and great food. Get close and comfortable with the other patrons. The staff is in your face. This is Philly. The goods. Go birds!
Great customer service, food is so fresh! The ranch is amazing! The new sliced pickles are great! Super fast as well. Very clean. Overall a great experience.
Paul got in touch and was very courteous.  He was able to get Conicelli reimburse me for the work and assured me that it would have been covered if I were still local. Thanks again!

My girlfriend and I were staying in NOLA for a weekend and were wanting to do some fun activities so she recommended we go on this swamp tour. What a great idea! Seriously, this was a lot of fun! We drove there, rather than ride their bus so that saved us some money. I believe the bus takes you on a little tour and sightseeing, we didn't care for that. The building is a fun little area with a gift shop and the swamps in the back (lots of swamp kitties running around).You get on a boat with about 15 other people and the captain takes you on the Mississippi River to see alligators and other wildlife. The alligators pretty much swim right up to the boat as the tour guides entice them with hot dogs and marshmallows. I didn't know gators love marshmallows. After being on the open river, you go into the swamps and look at the amazing trees and feral pigs.  Highly recommended! Our tour guide was Captian Ryan. Super funny guy.

For the amount of time we had to wait youd think service would be a little better. Im not complaining about the wait at all, we knew what we were getting into, but the waitress we had was imcompetant to say the least. after we sat down she took our drink order ... never to be seen again. She came back to take our food order and thank god there was water on the table. She brings the food, its wrong. She brings the check and low and behold charges us for the drinks we never received and is literally mind blown when i ask her to take them off the bill. As some one who has worked in the service industry i know what its like to work a busy shift, but come on...

After eating their rib  and crab cake meal, I had to take a walk outside. I needed a cigarette, because their food is that good... It was like a after the best sex I ever had cigarette. Yea, their food is sex good.

I may despise the phillies being a die hard mets fan. But I give credit where credit is due with how awesome and accommodating the mets rivals ballpark is. I will start off by saying it is exaggerated that phillies fans are notorious for picking fights for I was here back in 2011 when the phillies were still a powerhouse and even though I saw my mets get killed here 11-0 the fans near me of course heckled me but were not too harsh and didn't make thing personal with me. As soon as I entered the ballpark me and my father were treated so kindly here by the entire staff and I was impressed by what ashburn alley behind the outfield had to offer. The phillies museum in front of center field was nice and the selection of food and beer here is outstanding where I tried bbq  from bulls bbq pit named after phillies legend bull luzinski and really enjoyed it. The design and architecture of this ballpark is very animated and clever and ticket prices back when I was here were very reasonable and are ten times cheaper now that the phillies aren't a good team as of late. Overall a great place to catch a ballgame with plenty of convenient parking around.

Amazing!!! Best meal we had in Nola. Large serving of red fish cooked to perfection paired nicely with rice and carrots. I was sad I could not even eat half of my plate!! My husband had shrimp and grits. I stole some of his grits! Service was also fantastic!

Cocktails are fantastic!  Food is inconsistent, have had both great and awful.  Not inexpensive, but huge portions.  Service has never been a problem, beautiful interior as well.  Favorites were the meatloaf sandwich and the Mac and cheese.  Chips with balsamic app is phenomenal if chips are fresh. We'll go back, we'd go more often if food was more consistent.

Enjoyed watching movie with kids for the summer deal. We went to mini-arcade and played some games afterwards. One of the machines ate some of our tokens. Staff were quick to respond and very friendly. Will return for sure.

Love love love this place! The food is so flavorful and delicious. The food comes out quickly and I've never been disappointed with the service. I love the crispy duck! And the Thai tea is not too sweet and great to cool you down on a hot day.

The menu changes daily, which is what you'd expect since they serve fresh, local ingredients.  Scallops were from Cape May, the piggie the bf had was local as well.  All in all, a very good meal.  Although it's sorta pricey, the byob minimizes the impact a bit.

Dive bar, perfected!

I'm not really sure about the quality of boozy goodness but whatever.  I'm not paying for top shelf stuff.  I'm paying to have a drink or five when I'm cranky and poor.  You do the trick of turning my frown upside down and very easily too.

The day and night regulars (two completely different bunches) are probably the best place I've been in Philly for people watching and some of the conversations I've over heard make me giggle to myself for days.  

Clean your taps though. Please, for the love of all things that don't pass on cooties. Clean your taps!

Came for the fancy donuts and not disappointed. Got the almond joy because they didn't have the Samoa which is the one I had heard about and really wanted. Still very happy with the choice. My friend got the PB&J donut. He said it was delicious as well.
Really Great Salmon rolls and Wasabi steamed dumplings. Beautiful place and nice staff.
Love the market. Love the atmosphere. It's dog friendly. There is some unbelievable produce and the fresh figs are amazing. It's also pretty darned expensive. Bring lots of cash.

Brought my car to PA from CA and had to get a PA registration.  Called ahead and was given a list of what to bring.  Took about 15 minutes for her to fill out the paperwork and I was on my way with my new plate.  Good to go.

I can see why this place gets rave reviews. We had a fantastic time here last night. We stumbled upon this place while looking for a bite before going to the movies at AMC veterans. It is tucked in behind another restaurant in the plaza adjacent to the theater. Food was great, hibachi chef was entertaining and good at what he did. It also helped that he gave us plenty of sake shots :) We also had great service. No wait around 8 on a Saturday night. Will be back again for sure.

Good food...but really terrible service. I had the famed Eggs Benedict, which was good (REALLY good hollandaise sauce!) although the Canadian bacon was a little tough.  The dish included potatoes (delicious!) and a decent salad.  

Service was really slow: when we added people to the party, we had to ask for a glass of water, a napkin, and silverware...and then a napkin and silverware...and then a napkin.  Everyone who ordered a drink had to ask for it 3 times to 2 different waitstaff.  I will go back, but only when I'm not in a rush.

My boyfriend and I went here for the first time today. It was so nice. It reminded me of a Save-A-Lot without the Save-A-Lot brands. They had many brands and also off brands. We bought a bunch of things for $30 when we would have spent at least $60 at a normal store. You can't beat $1 Nutella and 50 cent fruit roll ups! Be careful about the dates but many of the items weren't outdated. It's a nice store. Very clean. Staff at checkout were great.
It has a decent beer selection, but it can get very smokey: too much smoke in the air for me.
Great place to sit outside have some beer and delicious  food. I've been here for brunch and dinner, everytime it's been amazing. They also have half off wine night, what could be better than that?

United Van Lines set us up with their local group in our area Hollander International Storage and Moving.  We had an appointment set up to do a virtual tour of our apartment with Kevin.  We had set up the appointment with Maria and had received a confirmation email and text that the appointment was set up.  On the day of the appointment we hadn't heard anything so I called the main line.  I was told that we would receive a call or text with information at the time of our appointment.  We waited until about 10 minutes after the appointment was set to start and called the main line again.  The woman we spoke with told us she didn't have any information about Kevin and that we should give him until half an hour past our appointment time.  Once it was 35 minutes past our scheduled appointment time I called again.  The woman stated that she was unable to see any of our or Kevin's information.  She asked if we were given an email or phone number for Kevin.  I said that we had only been given his name in our confirmation email.  We were told that nothing could be done until Monday as it was the weekend and no one was available at the local office.  We will definitely be using a different moving company that respects our time.

I took my almost 2 year old son here to get his hair cut. My son HATES haircuts and usually cries the whole time, but not here!! Jarrod did such an amazing job cutting his hair, talking to him to keep him distracted, and was quick. He also did an amazing job cutting his hair, which has 4 different cowlicks. They have a fish tank and gave my kid a sucker at the end. In the future, it will be "A treat" going to see Jarrod again. We will most definitely be going back. Also, I thought the price of $15 dollars was incredibly reasonable.

Great Thai food in burbs!! Been in several times over the past few years. Tonight's meal was delish. Spring rolls and coconut soup were our apps and we had a special mussaman curry noodle dish with shrimp and chicken and rack of lamb as entrees. Highly recommend.

Had a great breakfast there this morning. It's very quaint, cozy and service was fast and courteous. My wife ordered the banana filled French toast and I had the biscuits n gravy, scrambled eggs, ham, bacon and grits. Bomb.com. I thought the biscuits could be fluffier and not so thick and hard which would've flowed more with the gravy which had good flavor. My wife utterly destroyed her French toast and as a great cook herself she got more ideas on how to apply her world red own homemade banana pudding! Great place to check out!
This place was delightful, Good food and a great space. Nice friendly service.
One of the best! The pizza and calzones are awesome! The crust is perfect! The dinners are pricey but very good.
For a motel this is very nice! Good price! Good continental breakfast!
The best hurricane cocktail. Fresh oysters and the gulf fish was delicious. Really great atmosphere.

I thought the food and service were great! I had the 1/2 Maine lobster and my husband had the local rock crab. I would give this place a 5 star rating but the washroom was dirty and not well serviced. For that reason it gets 4.

If you want actual street style tacos this is the place. I tried chicken , steak , shredded beef and fish tacos and they were all amazing! Get the street style toppings on it. I also tried their watermelon juice which was amazing. They give free chips and they have a nice salsa bar. Great service overall!
This is a great little hole in the wall. Very good carne asada tacos at a great price. Definitely on my list of places to try again when in the area.

Thank you East Coast Pizza for opening your doors today even though you were short staffed.  The wait was really long, but the pizza was great!  We will be back this weekend!  Thanks again for being so awesome.

p.s.  I would have taken a picture of the amazing pizza but we haven't had power for over 24 hours!

Omg!! This place is a zoo, never mind the clientele but let's talk about the stocking of food. I roamed the isle for my weekly grocery shopping trip to come to the realization that Walmart has ran out of food. The produce section was empty and what was there was already spoiled, the meat department was emptied, the seafood department actually had food in it. As I walked the rest of the isles I looked for anything that I normally buy but no luck. I ended up going to shop-rite just to finish shopping.

This little food stand had such delicious seafood. We tried their charbroiled oysters, shrimp and grits with jalapeño, and boiled shrimp! It was sooo cold, but the grits were perfectly warming and so satisfying. Service is great too!

I want to say that this a review specifically about the Plymouth Meeting Cracker Barrel.  My boyfriend, my parents and my sister and her family have all been to many other Cracker Barrel's and they all raved about their experiences.  This is not a rave review.

Sunday morning around 9:30am on our way to vacation, my boyfriend thought I should experience Cracker Barrel.  I had heard wonderful things from family and friends so I was excited.  The one in Plymouth Meeting was on the way to our destination so we stopped there.  The gift shop is pretty spectacular and well priced but I am trying to lose weight so purchasing candy was not on the to-do list.  Very fun to look around at all the old time candies though!

We were seated very quickly and our waitress came over relatively quickly to give us water.  She smiled once, briefly and then turned into a robot.  I ordered Mama's French Toast Breakfast and asked for the meat on a separate plate since I am a vegetarian and wanted to give my boyfriend the meat.  This confused her I guess because it did not compute and took her some time to process.  My boyfriend ordered Mama's Pancake breakfast, eggs lightly scrambled.  

And then we waited.  And waited.  And waited.  People who were seated after us got served well before us by nicer, more caring waitresses around the room.  

When we finally got our food, it was lukewarm.  The french toast was bland and tasted like uncooked white bread.  They switched the egg orders so I got the lightly scrambled ones and before I realized it had added ketchup so then my boyfriend wouldn't eat it and I had slimy eggs while his were scrambled hard.  The pancakes were burnt and tough.

We were both thoroughly disappointed in this experience and will not return to this CB although I am still open to trying other ones in other parts of the country.

It seems Ed's Rec Room has been in a state of flux the past couple years with ongoing renovations, but it doesn't affect ones bowling experience! The space is open, breezy and has new contemporary lighting. Lanes are each appointed with two comfortable couches and stools, a welcome change from the pew-like seating in the bowling alleys of yesteryear.

They have also recently updated their shoes. They are all fairly new and in good shape. Make sure to bring along a pair of socks if you're like me and wear flats all year round!

I often plan my weeks to have Tuesdays off specifically to take advantage of Ed's Toonie Tuesday. $2 per game and shoe rental, a great deal when you want to try something different for date night.

During the day on Tuesday, you never have to wait for a lane - all of which are in good working order. All in all, a great bowling experience when paying full price; Toonie Tuesdays are the icing on the cake!

Beautiful, unique selection of leather, suede and vegan leather shoes for any fine shoe lover, male or female. Many smaller labels; unique, upmost quality shoes I almost guarantee you won't see on anyone's feet! I'm confident Bus Stop carries labels you'd be hard pressed to find in the area without traveling to NY. Also a fine selection for any bridal shoe! Whether a casual boot or flat or special occasion, Elena and her delightful, helpful staff will have a shoe that make your feet feel so pretty. Also a carrier of Toms and their own label, as well as locally designed purses, wallets, jewelry, and tights and shoe care products. Shoes are priced from $50 -$500, but sign up for their mailing list to be alert of their yearly inventory sales. Shoe lovers rejoice!

Excellent Thai entree's. Service is alway top notch specially from Risa. The decor is upscale with beautiful hand carved tables. Located in a strip mall, it's easy to find and easy to park. Delicious!

Want that chuffed feeling?

Get a bespoke suit from Lee's.

Nothing untoward about this place I can assure you.

Mr. Jin (Jin King Lee) is a Master Taylor from Korea.  He has a vision and an opinion about what looks right and about quality - nothing less than perfect. Stitching is art with small touches everywhere.  Shirts bespoke with suits so that materials, collar and lapel act as one.  Alterations done right as well.

Bravo for craft.
While enjoying the cool ice cream and cold brewed coffee with ginger, I looked up and saw the tag line of the Tshirt for sale. It said "coffee lab". Befitting

One of the thinnest, blandest chocolate milk shakes I've ever had.  I should have guessed it would be since they only have a kitchen blender, not a real milk shake machine (spindle drink mixer).  I ended up throwing it out.  The store also smelled very strongly of cleaning fluid when I was there on a Friday afternoon.  It was not very pleasant.

Country music blaring, I don't like it but understand some might but still! Took 5 min to be seen in such a small place. Then ready to order and waited 10 min and since we couldn't even hold a conversation with the music so loud had to leave. Thank you Villari's  for giving a much better option.

Dr flood and Dr Weber literally saved my life I was in so much pain that no one here in Cedar Rapids Iowa would even touch me let alone do surgery on me truth be told I would not trust anyone in the state of Iowa to even do back surgery on me we drove to Tampa Florida and had surgery done on my back it was the best decision I have ever made in my life I came off of that operating table and I was a changed woman they have never felt so good in my life these two doctors are my guardian angels thank you so much for everything you guys have done for me Dr flood your nurse Vicki v she is so sweet kind and caring she has made sure that I understand everything she takes the time to talk to me she is so terrific if you have back or neck problems and other doctors tell you that you need to back or neck surgery please put your trust in laser Spine Institute you will thank me and you will be so surprised at how well you will feel and you will not have that six weeks of recovery and that huge ugly scar

The employees were very friendly and inviting, greeting me as I entered. I decided to mix Tahitian vanilla (a classic for me) and taro coconut (which is a little outside my taste preference). But, I was pretty satisfied with the mix I made. I gave it three stars because it was a bit pricey (60 cents per ounce when places like Red Mango are usually under 50 cents).

PLEASE READ THIS REVIEW BEFORE CHOOSING THIS HOTEL.

To clrify, I need to create a new post for the downtown riverfront location as this is where we stayed.

We just got engaged and decided to visit my hometown to celebrate.

We don't have a ton of money to spend and were not expecting anymore than we'd paid for.  In my line of work, I have stayed in literally hundreds of hotel rooms and this was the second worst hotel experience I have ever had.  The worst was in Metarie, LA; the TV had a dipstick from a '56 Chevy as an antenna, roaches, and we camped in a tent on top of the bed.

The Staff at the Hyatt was very helpful and polite; no complaints there.

The problem was the cleanliness of the room.  When we walked in, we noticed hair all over the bathroom that had been left by the previous owner.  A couple of hours later, we noticed the same hair was all over the towels and tub.  I went ahead and grabbed some new towels from the cart and put our dirty ones in the dirty linen bag.  We folded the bed down to take a nap and saw dried blood on one of the pillowcases and on the lampshade.  Later, when I went to take a shower, the new towel had a big bloodstain on it as well.  Later I found what I think may have been a bedbug in the sheets.

At that point, I called the Manager and complained.  She was very understanding and offered us a refund in the amount of $100 on room service and movies.  As we were sick, I declined, and instead she authorized a refund on our stay.  This was very helpful and generous, and I hope the problem will not occur again with another guest.  I plan to write to Corporate and alert them as to the issue.

Bottom line, its not at all as nice a place as the Net makes it look.  These days you just can't be too careful, especially when blood is so dangerous to be exposed to.

Best barbecue I've found in Indianapolis which is shocking since it is a chain.  The potato salad is amazing reminds me of my grandmas.  Good Mac and cheese and sweet tea.  Finish it off with some peach cobbler.
The classic Italian hoagie is fantastic and a great value.  Loved it!
My favorite inn/hotel so far. Reasonably priced and walking distant from the beach. Clean and service is great.

Fantastic brunch, bloody Mary's and blood orange mimosas were superb. The Red Velvet waffles, cheddar cheese, chorizo and gravy biscuits were great too and you must try the huevos rancheros, they will not disappoint. The service was also great.

My husband and I stayed at the lovely Palomar hotel in Philadelphia and went to the bar a couple of times.  We were unable to make it for happy hour because we were out exploring the city, but it offered some great deals.  We did have a drink here at the bar where we had Dan.  He was a fantastic bartender.  We ordered a classic blinker and a classic boulevardier.  Both strong and tasty, just how I like my drinks.  He was a great mixologist, as well as a lovely conversationist.  He gave us suggestions on places to go while we were there.  He was so friendly.  I also grabbed a coffee after a long day of walking around, and the bar manager was so kind and got me a coffee. If we lived in Philadelphia we would most definitely eat and have drinks here often,  for we have come to learn that the bars/restaurants that are attached to Kimpton hotels are usually stellar.  We have one here and in Alexandria that we enjoy. 
Kudos to this place, it was  just lovely.

Ok, the food here was not good Mexican food.  The patio was cute and a nice place to sit and have a beer...but not eat.  I ordered ground beef tacos, refried beans, Spanish rice.  The tacos had no seasoning and the tortillas were not prepared correctly.  They seemed like they had been siting out and were very dry.  They also had no taste.  The rice was worse...came in a Styrofoam bowl mashed in with beans.  No taste.  The beans also came in a Styrofoam bowl and were just tasteless.  My Corona was good.  :-)

I am new to Nashville and I really hope this is not considered "good" Mexican food here.

After 4 days of being avoided like the plague because of our little baby experimenting her yelling phase, we found this restaurant with a big outdoor area and a very comprehensive staff. They helped us entertaining our daughter for the whole meal and made sure we were served fast, as we requested. The food was very good and it was just comforting to meet such a nice group of people. Thanks a lot for a short but enjoyable time!

Came here after a film shoot and me and my friend were starving. The food was so good that we repeated. I had a veggie bowl and then veggie flautas. I really recommend the bowl. Excellent service. The girls that attended me were awesome. The location is really pretty too. This is a good gem in Saint Petesburg.

When our order was called out we couldn't understand the person yelling. That had little to do with her heavy accent but very much to do with how fast and mumbled it was. Then when I didn't understand her she gave me a dirty look. Thanks.
