I ordered a Ham, egg and cheese sandwich. I received said sandwich minus the cheese! You got 33% of that incredibly difficult sandwich recipe wrong! How!? 
Also not sure if they normally toast the English muffin or if they forgot that too... but they are crazy if they think people want an un-toasted English muffin on there sandwich. Their hash browns were also gross and soggy and I ended up throwing them out. 

The only reason this isn't a one star is because our drinks were made very well. And the woman that took our order was very polite.
i live nearby and never go in here, john beck bonked me once in a professional matter so i am of the mindset, " once bitten, twice shy " you should think twice before going

We love Pita Jungle typically, but this was the worst experience we have had. Food was way over salted, ran out of three of our four choices and could not seem to handle a large party along with normal business. Really disappointing from one of my favorite restaurants.

We really enjoyed this place. We were in St. Louis on vacation and decided to stop here after reading the yelp reviews. 

It was super cute and casual inside which was perfect after a day at the city museum climbing. 

I was in love with their special ketchup and my husband loved the spicy pickles they served with the burgers. The food was great and we topped it off with a banana split! We would definitely visit it again and recommend to anyone else going to downtown St. Louis. 

Oh, and did I mention that I am a vegetarian? You can substitute a veggie patty for any of their burger specials. :)

Horrible service!  Restaurant was recommended so we decided to check it out.  First time in Nashville so we wanted to see what the downtown experience was, and we were greatly disappointed; mostly due to our unfortunate experience at tavern.  We waited for 20 minutes without any acknowledgement from our waiter.  When we finally saw him in our area he greeted a table who had just arrived, skipped our table and went on to another. We ended up leaving the establishment.  I repeat...horrible service!!!! I guess I can take that back, it wasn't horrible, there WAS NO SERVICE!

Great for lunch or dinner during special shows.  Friendy service and home cooking. Sandwiches salads soups and more

Great place to watch trains on csx line to tampa silver star passes here to and from tampa.

Lots of train stuff on walls and a train  set.
Yummy sushi! Try the hangover and the caterpillar. Pot stickers are good too! Will be back!!
I was extemely impressed by my experience at Parker's Paws. Dr. Klapheke has paid attention to every detail in the design of her clinic and in the care she provided to my cats.

I dunno man, this place just fell flat for me. We tried several things on two different visits and nothing was very good. 

I tried scrapple for the first time (he thought it would be funny) and OMG that was probably the single worst bite of food that I have ever put in my mouth. It was like someone ate breakfast sausage, threw it up and they grilled it on the flat top and served it to me. This does not affect my review because I don't blame this place for that horror, I blame the entire state of Pennsylvania. 

The seafood omelet looked interesting and the crab was spelled with a C and not a K so we asked the server if it was real crab or imitation krab and his response was "I think so, the owner is really into fishing" um jiggawha? He couldn't be bothered to find our for sure so we took a risk and ordered it. Mistake. Not because of fake krab or anything because there was NO crab or seafood of any kind that we could find. Yet it managed to smell fishy and taste like a whole lot of funk. 

Breakfast pie was ok but I make this dish better at home and it was just screaming for cheese, as was I. I did like the hollandaise though. I will say that this dish was served with sliced tomatoes that were very fresh and tasty. One of the best things we had. The corn muffin was good as well. The potatoes were seasoned but were cold. 

Corned beef hash was straight out of the can. Iced tea with lemon comes without lemon, etc. When sliced tomatoes and a corn muffin are the stand outs.....

I'll pass on future visits.

Great coffee spot. Love their cold brew in the summer! Also love stopping by and catching up there with friends. They refill your coffee for a discount. On weekends it definitely is a long line but they are pretty quick.

Nashville just doesn't have good sushi but this is ok. They accommodate my daughter's fish allergy. Very friendly and quick service. Parking can be a pain but we try to avoid peak times. I recommend yum yum and the veggie rolls.

They missed calling our name, and was told "We called it"  Funny, never heard it.  Everyone else is called twice.  We were given a table in a poor location.  How can you screw up breakfast?  The service was good.  But plate was cold.  Cold eggs, grits, gravy and muffins.  Barely cooked hash browns.  There are much better places around.  Won't be back.

I have never been to worse karaoke; and that's saying a lot. The "dj" couldn't care less, wasn't playing right songs and the sound was so low no one could hear a thing - disappointment is an overstatement. I advise with with all the choices out on Nola; I say avoid this place and go somewhere else where the dj is not so distracted by Facebook and smoking that she can't even make eye contact, because ruining karaoke is like ruining pure joy. 
#wontbeback

Cool place, I like the vibe. The bowl of bacon is weird and awesome at the same time. The only thing is the lay out makes it hard to mingle and its busy a lot so if you are not lucky enough to get a seat you end up feeling like you are in the way sometimes.

pretty standard Tex-Mex food. Staff is friendly and tentative. Refilled drink/s early and often, chips and salsa are standard and a great starter to the meal. Plates come out fairly quickly. I'd compare this to the popular El Rodeo chains that can be found around Indy. You know what you are going to get and the food is consistently good.

View is amazing, but service... Bartender is a D!CK! After racking up a bill well over $300 in drinks with friends and giving a generous tip, we requested a couple of glasses of water. This was around 1:54am before closing. Bartender refused to give us any! He then said he did not have any water left for us. We thought he was joking, but was quite serious. We requested again and once again he denied us the request. Francis (a genuinely courteous black gentleman; also bartender) over heard this comment and immediately stepped in and gave us all glasses of water. The tall white guy with crew cut, complete d!ck. He also refused to give us shots when we arrived (around midnight) because they "are not that kind of establishment." We were celebrating my friends MBA graduation from Wharton for crying out loud. A celebration shot is normal. Great venue, but that 1 bartender left a sour experience for all of us. So much so, that we all woke up talking about the bad experience today.

I love this place, tacos are simple but delicious, the chips with all the different sauces are amazing as well. You also cannot beat the drinks! From the house margarita to the Kalesi everything is just delicious. The set up of the restaurant open, and you have to see the decorations to really understand them. Also, don't forget to walk past the bathrooms to the secret tiki bar! It's fun in the winter but even better in the summer. If you have room get the Mexican poutine it's amazing!

Great for Manchester United games! Heard that the local support group for ManU gathered here for the games so we decided we'd check it out. First, it was awesome that they opened up early for the game! I mean who doesn't love brunch and a beer. As we walked in we easily grabbed a table with a great view of the biggest tv. Bartender greeted us with food and drink menus immediately and shortly after that, so did the head of the ManU support group. I ordered the grilled pork roll egg and cheese sandwich and loved every last bite of it!! There weren't really any drink specials for the day so the beer was a bit more than expected, but I've read they do offer great specials during the week. There was an upstairs and a downstairs, that sadly enough, I did not have the experience to check out so I will need to go back again! Definitely a great dive-y bar and especially great for the ManU games. If you are a ManU fan or a soccer fan in general, you must check out Black Sheep Pub during a match!

The restaurant itself is gorgeous! The tanks are amazing and the artwork is great, but the service and food was pretty awful. 

My family and I went in for breakfast this morning (their last day of breakfast service apparently- and I could see why). There were only a couple of families there and it was quiet and dark- not really a beach my vibe but would be nice for dinner. Our waiter was ridiculous- totally out of it. He asked me what I wanted to eat twice when ordering and came back a third time to verify what I had meant (I ordered crab cakes & poached eggs- exactly what it says on the menu and he wanted to make sure I meant crab cake Benedict). 

When the food did come out, my breakfast was missing several items- scallions, arugula and toast. I asked about the toast and was told my breakfast did not come with any. He said brought some anyway to be nice. Hah. And then we ate- not worth the $16 price tag. Not even close. The potatoes were good but the meal was lacking and not impressive. Ultimately very disappointing. No one at my table particularly enjoyed their meals. 

On the way out, we saw their outdoor seating area and bar, a beautiful, well lit area absolutely perfect for breakfast- if they'd been serving breakfast I think they may have had better luck with making a profit. 

I don't think I'd go back for food ever, but perhaps after I stop being bitter over the price of a crap breakfast with missing food I'll stop in for a cocktail at the pretty bar area!

Not exceptional, but I would certainly go back.  

The staff was all very friendly... kept the refills coming and always seeing if I needed anything.  If this was just a review on them it would be a higher rating.

The food was average.  I had some pancakes and an omelet (feta cheese, onions, ham), with a side of cinnamon-raisin toast, scrambled eggs and some peaches (sides were for the kid but I tasted them).  The omelet was pretty good (4 stars) but the pancakes were "meh".  They had a selection of different types of syrups (I only like maple if it is GOOD syrup, not the cheap stuff)... so that was a positive, but the blueberry syrup was just blue sugar syrup.  Come on, don't name your restaurant Blueberry Hill if you don't even offer really blueberry syrup!  Scrambled eggs were bland.  Peaches were canned, not fresh.

I would classify this place as a backup... somewhere to go if you just need an ok breakfast.  I won't be recommend it to family and friends though.... needs a improvement on the quality of food served to get into recommendation range.

My wife and I stopped by here after passing it by from our Airbnb, and were thoroughly impressed. We had the Crabby Wife and the special of the day (oyster Benedict). It was delicious. The service from our waiter Addison was superb. He was very friendly, contagious laugh, and very attentive. It's not the cheapest place but we rank this as our top 3 spots since we've visited NOLA.
Whats not to like. Its great!!!' Need one in Newport Beach. Please!!!!

Everyone has told me to come here and I am so glad I was able to. The music is never too loud and it's a wonderful place to come with friends or to meet random strangers! Which is what me and my friend did. we came here at 8:30-9ish and all the tables downstairs were gone so we pulled up some seats next to some strangers and chatted the night away. A few bottles of wine later, a cheese plate and multiple appetizers later I feel like this place is embedded in my New Orleans memory forever. It seems to be a favorite amongst both locals and visitors alike and nobody ever has anything bad to say about this place. It's truly divine.

I was told the cheese plate was going to take an hour to assemble because the kitchen was backed up but whether it did or took less I have no idea..I was having too much fun. Ordered a few appetizers. Dates, Hangar steak, trout salad shaved brussel sprouts, Slow roasted pork...out of all of them the pork was my least favorite. The meat was not tender at all and kinda tough but by then the wine and atmosphere kind of make it better.

Food is Great!!!! But the service stinks ! I came to pick up my food and the lady seemed like she didn't want to be bothered and had a nasty a** attitude !

Customer service stinks! Won't be ordering from there again.
Excellent teff injera, delicious dishes and kind service! Worth the trip!
They're ice cream machine is consistently broken during Half Priced shakes. Something is always broken or not working.

I just had the worst experience I've ever had at a restaurant here. Avoid it like the plague. 

We didn't even get to ordering the food before we left in intimidation.

So, we had ordered coffee, someone ordered decaf, but then changed her mind to decaf. Our waitress brought both decaf and regular. When we pointed out the confusion, in a very understanding way (really making sure that she knew that we totally see how the confusion had occurred). This lady got angry! Left me speaking half way through and gave me her back, she came back with another thing of regular coffee, and started to bang our silverware on the table with a face of complete discontent. 

She didn't provide a straw for a tea, and there was another waitress near by. Not wanting to upset our waitress even more my brother's fiancee asked this other waitress for a straw. She looked at her also with an attitude, and she said: both of my hands are full, can't you see! 

Full disclosure: both of these waitresses were African American and my family is hispanic. I don't know if there's some sort of racial issue in New Orleans between these two races, but it just seemed that there was a lot of aggression for things that are pretty normal at a restaurant. 

We said we wanted to leave and asked for the check and the manager. The manager came, and asked us what the situation was. Our waitress had these threatening eyes on us the entire time, and the manager asked her to step aside, at which point the waitress started raising her voice. We said to the manager: "this attitude is precisely why we want to pay and leave now and handed her $20dlls without looking at the bill (but we had asked for 2 coffees, 1 tea, water, and 2 diet cokes, a lot less than $20). I was expecting for an apology and to let us go without pay since we had barely touched our drinks. However, she took our $20dlls. and left the table. All the while three people with long hair peaked from the kitchen staring us also in a very threatening way. It was actually very scary. When the manager picked up our $20dlls we didn't wait for the change and left the table. We were actually worried for a little bit about being followed by the guys staring at us from the kitchen, but it was all fine. We're just never going back. 

It is a real shame, because I really like Ihop.

Stopped in here before taking off to the airport. The donuts are the size of my hand and delicious. I had the muffuletta slider for lunch and it was to die for. Perfectly made and the donut was a nice change to the traditional caviars bread. The staff was friendly and vibrant. Adding this one to my must list next time in Nola

The food is really good. I tried the calamari app, bruschetta, and meatballs. All were great. The dinner special was a steak topped with scallops and shrimp with melted cheese. It was perfect. I'd definitely recommend this restaurant.

5 stars for food.
The service really kinda sucked.

However, the food was so good, I can't help but give this place 5 stars.

I live in Phoenix, and I kinda want to drive down to Tucson just to eat here again.

Everything from the apps, to the entrees, the sides, and dessert.  HEAVEN.

So.so.so.good.

I posted a review that was quite negative as I experienced being overlooked and another walk-in client was given my turn after I had waited 30 minutes
After the post, the owner actually called me and explained the situation. She was extremely apologetic and offered me a free mani/pedi and a gift certificate. While she could have explained the situation at the time I can understand that she was embarrassed at the time. 
I do like the work they do and was impressed that the owner called me to explain and apologize. I will go back and give this business another chance...

For breakfast, it was different and pretty good. Perfect service and charming place. Food was Tex-mex breakfasty and that was fun. The food was par for a typical Tex mex restaurant, which is to say it was good but not elevated. I'd recommend it but it is not a place I'd go out of my way to return to.

Do not get Comcast if you live in nashville/brentwood  area. I have been having intermittent outages for weeks. The automated customer care bot simply resets the signal and doesn't let you talk to a real person. If you do get through to a real person, they tell you there is an outage and they can't do anything about it. This is not even the worst part,when I told them that I want to end my service and break my 1yr contract, I was told that I would be charged an early termination fee. I asked the agent ' so let me get this straight, it doesn't matter whether or not Comcast gives me internet service, I still have to pay no matter what?' To which she says ' a contract is a contract'. I hung up the phone. They wouldn't even send a tech to take a look because the system doesn't let them during an outage. Worst company ever!
Super awesome discovery! The Papaya, Hazelnut and coconut were excellent! My kids enjoyed kiwi and pineapple. It was so worth the trip!
Really good food and service!! Ask for Justin on your next visit. Let him know Jamie sent you. Will be back if we are in the area!! Enjoy.
Love this place! They have awesome coffee and pastries and breakfast and sandwiches! There Vietnamese iced coffee and iced chicory coffee is my favorite! They are also so nice in here!

Stopped in on a Sunday and it was busy. Just as we were finishing ordering the computers went down. Carolyn handled it great quickly hand writing tickets and passing them to the kitchen. Our food come out promptly and was very tasty. I had the grilled cheese. Oh my so much melty cheese! Shannon had an omelet that was stuffed with mushrooms and cheesy potatoes. Elaine checked back with is several time to make sure we didn't need anything. The guy cleaning the tables looked like Shaggy but never stopped moving. The place was clean and welcoming. We will be back.

Aesthetics is great love the vibe and desert martinis are delicious! But the traditional fare was uneven. Especially the  grilled pesto chicken sandwich (of course I am assuming you LIKE pesto!?!). If you hate pesto order away!

It's a bar, it's old, it's laid out funny with parts of the bar not reachable by the bartenders.  And there are tables, and it seems there is room for more tables.  It was Friday night and it was pleasantly crowded.  And the crowd was pleasant, mostly 22 to 30 year olds, until I hauled my old ass up to a stool.  A list of specials and draft beers hanging over the bar on a blackboard, were in addition to the beer and food menus.

I had a cask hand pumped Hoppy lil Hudson, a very good English IPA from Yards.  There was a real nice selection to chose from.  We started with the battered and fried string beans.  Someone here said they could eat them all night, I agree.  We had a cauliflower with coconut curry cream, a super side dish we dubbed as an app and cleaned the plate

The grilled cheese of the day was Jack cheese with truffle mashed potatoes ON the sandwich, my dog it was excellent, especially when the server suggested we add bacon to it.  The other choice was the brined pork sandwich.  It was so good and a nice kick to it.  The bread pudding for dessert just topped off this very special find in a semi-deserted neighborhood on north 13th Street.

I love finding places like this, thanks to my YELP friends. :-)
Good spot for a meeting right off the trains in suburban station.  Lunch time crowd is too crazy.  But morning hours are fine.  Plenty of options for good fare including DiBrunos, Jake & Max's Deli.

Does this place have excellent boba and a wide selection of drinks? Yes it does; for product they are very, very good. But like some of the other reviewers, they don't know how to implement a loyalty card program. I filled up my card buying mostly the 'regular' size snow-smoothies. But then when I tried to use the card, regular size was a 50 cent up-sell. I think they even charged me for boba. It just pissed me off. Bad enough that I didn't come back for a year. Sure it is only 50 cents or whatever but it was the principle.  It didn't make me feel like a special customer. It made me feel like a chump.
Lorraine makes a mean blue mist pineapple head hookah. Very chill place. Love the country music with the hookah great twist!
The Angry Dragon may sound a little out there, but it was sooo good.  If you're not feeling adventurous in your burger choice, the Nite Owl is a really solid burger as well.

Out town with my friends and decide to eat here because it was highly rated and close to our hotel.  The best part of the experience was the Seafood Gumbo which was dank, so good! The rest of my experience was ruined by our server Jessica. She hardly checked on us, and it felt like such a burden just to go get a refill from her.  Based off her body language, and tone she definitely didn't want too. To cap it off though when we finish eating. We waited not five but ten minutes to get our checks. After she finally decided to bring the checks. Jessica brought a check not three checks. We had to retell her the order before we were finally able to cash out and leave. Definitely not coming back here and I would not recommend this place at all!!!

best asian food place in town.

I had to visit philadelphia for 5 days, and i came here more than 6 times to get my food. Their prices are very cheap compared to the food they serve.

I dont know what else to say, because i was there last year and i dont remember too much. I tried more than half of their appetizers, and they were all very great.
Great food, friendly service, Hawaiian food with a twist. Get something different than what you normally order in a good way.
Waitress was great. Food was good. I had the shrimp strawberry salad which was good. We also ate steak, chicken and salmon. All were good. They're a little pricey in my opinion but overall good food.
Grateful Cool Springs has such a healthy food option! Loveeee the Tokyo Bowl! I am leaving off 1 star because customer service is important-- a SMILE, eye contact & a greeting goes a long way!

Good food and good environment. We were there for Valentine's Day. Good price for what you get. I will say that there was a very large group next to my boyfriend and I and they were EXTREMELY loud the entire time. All the couples around them couldn't focus on our conversations. That's my only complaint, they had no care in the world of how loud they were.

The best Jamaican restaurant and I come from a city with a good amount of Jamaican restaurants, but this place is the best. Everything tastes like it's home cooked. 

I usually order the Jerk chicken, with cabbage and rice & beans. They are very generous with the portion size, especially the chicken and don't try to pass off uselss bone-bits as pieces. It's also well seasoned. The rice and cabbage is nice and firm, not limp or smushy due to being either reheated leftover or overcooked.

I like that they have the option of a spicy, pepper sauce for the meal. It's a great compliment to the dish. It's also good to not see a messy platter, with the items nearly drowning in sauce like some places.

The customer service is lacking. They don't smile at you or seem eager to shower you in hospitality, but there is respect. This place is definitely a no-frills eatery, but the food is great.

This place is BAD NEWS!   Stay away from Stefano's II at any cost.  I ordered a Chef's Salad to go.,   Got home and discovered that over 50% of the Chef;s Salad consisted of black and green olives.  I immediately called them and explained that I am allergic to black olives.  The guy on the phone got arrogant and copped an attitude and told me to scrape all the olives off and eat the rest of the salad.  Tells me he does over 300 salads a day and that's his policy.  He further told me "I got your money so there's nothing you can do about it" after I told him I would NEVER go back to his business again.  THIS IS TRULY ONE OF THE WORST ESTABLISHMENTS I have ever done business with. Stay away from Stefanos's II

Went there today for some landscape design ideas and was very happy with the young lady that helped us.
No pressure to buy on the spot and lots of great ideas.
Definitely going to purchase here

I just came back from my first time here since Great Tea closed next door (about four years ago) and since I feel like I can't give any place a fair review without three fairly close together visits, I can only (in good conscience) give this place a four at most.
The server was very pleasant and pleased to speak with a semi-native French-speaker. We shot the breeze a bit, which was nice, then my party and I ordered.
Between us, we'd ordered crêpe á la rivage (with tuna, egg, tomato), gâteau de crêpe au jambon (ham, mushroom, spinach), crêpe de mergeuz et something else (haha, I don't quite recall what he got in it other than the lamb sausage, I'm afraid) and nutella et poire (pear and nutella). 
We shared amongst ourselves and we all rather enjoyed them. The tuna one was less my style, but I couldn't stop raving about the ham. It's perfectly balanced of sweet, savoury and delicious and the paper/wafer-thin pancake had that lovely nutty aroma one can only get from a well seasoned pan. Hints of butter made me happy.
The lamb sausage one was cheese-filled. In fact, none of our orderes skimped on the fillings at all. One gripe from our group was the pear we chose for dessert; none of us save one had this issue, but he'd gotten, it seems, all the pear skins in his portion. Sorry, Dan, but the rest of us were enthralled!
Even after several visits, I don't think I could give above four stars due to pricing. I understand; Rittenhouse, yes, expensive, nonetheless, it may be a bit much for a light meal. The server did, however, cut us a price break. I haven't a clue why, but he charged us about 10% less than we'd expected.

Really nice place! Tuscan Tower rooms are very cool. Comfortable, well decorated lots of marble etc. Restaurants were really good too. Great food and selection. Valet parking was a little slow. Good for non smokers, ventilation/air filtration is very effective. Occasionally you might end up near a smokestack, but hey... You can always move! We will definitely look here first the next time in Reno.

It was the thursday before Halloween and my friends and I still needed to get those finishing touches for our costumes. After walking down south street and only finding stores appropriate for those dressing up as things with "slutty" attached, we decided to get out of there and hit Columbus boulevards Halloween superstore. 
When we got there we saw that everyone in Philadelphia thought the same thing. After driving around the parking lot multiple times we finally found a spot and then had to wait in line to actually get into the store. What, was Dracula signing autographs? Thankfully the line moved quickly but we entered into chaos. There were people everywhere, Mom's on the phone with their children picking out Disney Princess costumes, Sorority girls getting their handcuffs or nurse hats, and employees dressed up as creepy clowns pointing us in the wrong direction when looking for temporary tattoos. 
Two of my pack had to actually leave the store because listening to the Cha-Cha slide while bumping into people was just too much to deal with. 
I finally located the "Punk Rock" section, picked up some Sailor tattoos, a studded cuff and hoped that I would pay a somewhat accurate homage to Axl. 
"Okay, let's go pick up a case and get out of here" were my words upon exiting. 

If you need to go to Masquerade, go weeks in advance during the daytime. You'll save yourself from a headache.
By far the most satiating and deliciously authentic Indian cuisine in the immediate area.

While the pizza is always good, I have to sayly that our last delivery driver (and the company's lack of response to my complaint) has ended my patronage of this restaurant. 
The last delivery driver went on a very awkward and semi-aggressive 10 minute rant about poor tippers while standing on my doorstep. I pre-tipped a standard 15% (more than $3 because that's a minimum for drivers, in my opinion) on my card.
I should not be made to feel uncomfortable in my own home. The company had no response to my content in this incredibly unprofessional behavior.

Allison is sick of eating at the Scottrade Center, so I searched for somewhere close by to eat at before the game. Google found Bailey's Range. I like it. We take the Metro in from Scott Air Force Base and exited at 5th and Pine. The walk to Bailey's Range was just past the old Post Office and not very far from the Metro station. The fried pickles were great.

Visited this restaurant  because of the great reviews seen on yelp, it totally lived up to every word. 

We came in at 1030am for brunch. I ordered the shrimp and grits which was DIVINE! My friend ordered the Southern  breakfast with a side of mimi's pancakes.  This was also delicious and the bacon was cooked to perfection, crispy and smoky..

We had Mimosas to top it off and quench our thirst. Overall, the atmosphere  was cozy and our waiter Thomas was attentive enough but not intrusive. We will definitely  come again and would recommend it to anyone visiting  NOLA.

6 North Cafe made for a nice, lighter dinner Sunday night.  A coworker of mine had been here and said he enjoyed it.  he told me where it was, but I hadn't noticed it there.  It's not that it is hidden, but it blends into the new strip center behind the CVS.  All the storefronts look similar, with similar signage over the doors.  So for my birthday, i got a mailer with restaurant coupons - including one from 6 North Cafe for 50% off my bill, up to $10.  Sounded like a good reason to me to try them!

Place was nice enough, very clean, color scheme similar to St L Bread Co.  Layout is pretty rectangular, though - efficient, but loses some atmosphere.  There is a drive thru, though.  Workers were pleasant.  Nice variety in the menu.  Family wound up ordering a BLT, 1/2 roast beef sandwich with pasta salad, and a 3 cheese pizza/flatbread.  The order taker said the pizza would take about 7 minutes, and asked if we wanted all the food to come out with the pizza - showed some consideration for us, not a big thing, but nice.  (We said to bring out the other food first, and let the pizza follow.)  Food was brought to the table after just a few minutes, and the pizza actually followed almost immediately.

Food was all really tasty.  BLT had thick cut, flavorful bacon, decent tomato slices, very crispy lettuce, a chipotle mayo for some nice spicy variety, and thickish toasted bread (but not too thick).  Only negative was that there were really too many lettuce leafs.  Made it thicker, but to no benefit.  Also, it was iceberg lettuce - which, while nice and green, could be improved by perhaps adding romaine or other.  Roast beef was nice and dark, good flavor.  Decent amount of thin sliced red onion.  some lettuce and tomato, and another spiced mayo spread - not chipotle, but more than just plain mayo.  Pizza/flatbread was decent - good, not more or less.  It did have a LOT of cheese, which I really like.

We were there at about 5:30 pm on a very hot Sunday, and there were only two guys getting iced coffees when we arrived.  We were the only patrons inside during our whole stay after they left.  Perhaps it was the time and the heat.  There were two or three cars that came through the drive thru - so it's not like there was no other business.  Don't know if they were coffee-only orders or also got food.

I really struggled with 3 star vs. 4 star rating.  Ultimately, I can't yet give it 4 stars.  I likd it quite a bit, but just not quite there.

There is a lot more to the place than what we ate, but I can only really comment on our food.  It's a nice enough place.  I liked the quality of our food quite a bit.  Hope traffic is high enough for it to prosper.

I always tire of people who mention Roselena's and expensive in the same sentence. They're missing one important facet - the scrumpdiddilyumptiousness of it all.

Don't let the Victorian look or the fact that there's nothing resembling spaghetti and meatballs on the menu. This one's an Italian restaurant in a league of it's own, best gone down on when you have time to spare. The pacing here is old world, while the food is so of the new. Need I say more than Mocha Java encrusted pork chops.

And as for dessert, the best on East P'unk. Trust me - the Passyunk Smore, mon ami!

Avocado omelette.... love love love
Lots of goat cheese, asparagus, mushrooms, spinach, peppers, delicious. Quaint ambiance, chill, sweet, good service. I'd definitely come back.

I just can't justify coming here for the food anymore. Every time I eat here the food has just been really disappointing and I consider myself pretty lenient when it comes to mexican food. I mean I'll eat almost anything. And I know I can't be the only one who feels unsatisfied by this place because I'm not even a terribly picky reviewer. 

My top Mexican go-to list are usually: Carreta's Grill, Juan's Flying Burrito or Superior Grill. But I wanted to try something new. I've really TRIED to like this place. I have visited Casa Garcia maybe 3 times in the past year because it had this great reputation but I felt so disappointed every time and wanted to keep giving it another shot thinking maybe I was ordering the wrong things somehow. The queso is some sort of watered down cheese substance (and not like in a hot cheese kind of way, you could literally pour this stuff into your coffee like its a bowl of cream), the chili relleno had the same cheese inside it so that sort of turned me off, nachos are always soupy and soggy (even right when they get to the table), the fajitas are small, the rice is stale. I don't know I mean I just don't get anything out of this place and I happen to LOVE Mexican food! 

A friend of mine always gets the enchiladas and he swears by it so maybe that's what you need to get there. But I'd hate to try it for the fourth time only to be further disappointed. 

Not to mention the sanitation problem this place seems to have. You can tell they don't clean much, which to be fair, isn't some big requirement for me. There's plenty of hole in the wall shady looking places with great food right? But what I CAN'T ignore is the extremely dirty silverware. I mean there were GIANT obnoxious unmissable amounts of food caked onto my fork and knife from the last person. It looked like they didn't even bother soaking it in some hot sanitized water before throwing it in the dishwasher and baking it right on there. It was pretty gross. I jacked the silverware from the next table over but found the same thing. It took browsing through 3 different sets to find a suitable fork. I mean....c'mon that's just disturbing on so many levels....

The only reason this place really even gets 2 stars is because I've always had a pleasant experience if I JUST sit at the bar and drink a margarita. Their happy hour (2-4-1 margaritas) is a pretty solid deal and the complementary bean and salsa dip that comes with the chips are actually surprisingly decent! The bartender has always been really friendly and knowledgable about tequilas and we have a nice chat.

However, you basically NEED to go visit the bar and drink your sorrows away after encountering the food there....

Sorry Casa Garcia, but we just aren't compatible. Maybe I'll come back for a happy hour special once in a blue moon but that's about all I can give you :-(
This is the 3rd car I've taken here for tint. Luke was my salesman this time. He was very knowledgeable & helpful. They always do a GREAT tint job & are competitive on price. Customer for life.

This place was AMAZING. I was in town for a conference and had just finished business stuff. My partner and I went to the Liberty Bell and then wanted a nice brunch - and wow am I glad we went here.

Excellent wine selection first off - I loved the boutique choices on the menu. Our server was astounding - attentive to the correct degree, personable and happy to provide recommendations/pairings with our orders. We opted to order several small plates and share.

First - Poached Black Mission Figs - so savory and delicious! And I'm not even a big blue cheese fan, but these were perfect. Then we had two of the Bruchettas - Truffled Mushroom with Fontina and Brie de Nangis with Allagash Cherries. Both were really tasty and paired well with the wines recommended by the server. The only potential downside here is that they were fairly simple in construction - we could easily recreate this at home. Then we had the Smoked Duck and Spinach Salad which was just delightful. Again, I'm not the biggest pistachio fan, but they really did add something special to this salad. Finally, we split the Warm Apple Bread Pudding which was a lovely taste of fall.

Unlike some of the other trendy places we visited in Philly, we never felt rushed -- so many other spots the staff seemed like they were just trying to turn over your table. This place was exactly what we were looking for - a quiet spot where we could relax and take our time enjoying brunch. I'd highly recommend it and will make a point to visit again when I'm in the area.

I have been coming to Justin for about 3 months now and have never walked out of his shop without be totally satisfied!!! The quality of the haircut and conversation is reminds me of the days my grandfather used to take me to the barber. When men would go to a barber shop to not only get a haircut but talk sports, politics, etc. and not be rushed out or made to wait long periods of time for a lackluster haircut. Justin provides a quality service at a reasonable price!!

I have been to Dentistry For Life's new location at 16th and Walnut three times now. Once as a new patient, the second time to have five cavities filled (sad face) and the third time for a routine cleaning. With each visit I am once again blown away by the amazing service and experience. I have never enjoyed going to the dentist, I used to fear it. Now I still do not love going to the dentist, but I know that when I do I will be in excellent hands. The staff at Dentistry For Life are friendly (there is free coffee, tea, hot chocolate, and lots of smiles), gentle (when I explained I had sore gums they numbed them for me), knowledgeable (they didn't just tell me to floss twice a day they explained why I needed to and what would happen otherwise), and extremely educated in their craft (they can answer any question you throw at them and will recommend products you can find at CVS). I have already recommended them to several friends and have never had a weird experience!

Bathroom out of toilet paper, bar tender was rude when I notified her, over priced under flavored under portioned "tacos". One day I hope to find a taco shop in Tennessee that at least competes with the places where I grew up in California. This is definitely not it.

This place used to be great.  It's a very inviting, cozy spot filled with regulars.  The problem is if you are not one of those regulars, the service you receive will suffer.  On our last visit, we were largely ignored due to the couple that arrived right after us.  The entire staff proceeded to fawn all over them (the chef himself even came out) while we were unable to get someone to bring us glasses of water and menus.  Despite arriving earlier, we had yet to receive our entrees by the time the VIP couple left the building.  This is not the only time I've experienced an incident like this at Gypsy.  The food has shrunk in portion size and the quality has declined over the past year while the prices have continued to rise.   I am done giving this place a chance to redeem it's former glory.

The ghost tour was average. I won't recommend spending $40.00. It started late and was just a walk around the neighborhood and a description of the suicide or murder that happened there long ago. The tour doesn't take you inside any buildings. You can find a description of each house online and just walk around on your own.

Great service and love the glasses. They were very helpful and worked with me. The prices wasn't as bad as I thought it would be and you have soooo much to choose from I will be back for a second pair and sun glasses when it's time.

I don't normally shop at whole foods because their prices are so out of line with other grocers in town. However I am having such a time getting rid of a colony of ants in my apartment (making it impossible to cook there) that I needed some prepared food and they have a bar where you can pick what you need and pay for it by the pound. I also frequent the olive bar where they offer many different types of olives, mix and match. 

Today I remembered to pick up the instructions about how to use the Amazon prime discount on sale items in the store. I'll be setting up my phone so that I can do that.

I returned for Mothers Day with my mom. They did a lovely prix fix menu with a nice variety of choices. My mom loved the food, and we had a great time! I was a little bit worried with it being a holiday that it would be overly crowded/loud and the service would falter. Not so! The food was just as good as the previous visit and our server was excellent.

Ordered pizza's & sandwich, both were ordered online with Dominoes App, the tracker was correct pizza was ready when we arrived. Pizza's & sandwich were great compared to other mediocre pizza places nearby. They always have great deals, and out of the 5+ times we have ordered the quality has always been the same
Loved this!  Great delivery with Dining In.  Liked the gyro, hummus and little pizzas.  Very fresh!

Loved the queso dip.  Chips were good also.  I had the chicken fajitas to me they were average.  Was a little loud, but they also had a live music group that would come to your table and play for you so that added to the noise level.

Small space and it can be quite loud. 
Service us ok. A but slow after you put your order in. 

Pretty delicious food. Finished to the very last bite. 
Their cocktails are pretty original too and yummy. 

A place to visit and give a try at least once.

Come here mainly for their jalapeno bagel with bacon egg n cheese, its so good!! Today there were no more jalapeno bagels in the case and the young man who worked here went to the back and got me some, great customer service!!

What a fantastic culinary adventure!  We went on a Saturday night and the place was jumping (loved the 80's jams they were pumping)but we still managed to grab two seats at the bar right away.  The bar is often my favorite place to eat in a restaurant as it offers a glimpse into the heart of the operation.  This place was no exception to that and we enjoyed watching the staff whip up small plate after small plate of some really creative fare.  The rice tots proved one of my favorites but we had many outstanding dishes. The beer selection was pretty decent and my wife enjoyed a Sake recommended be the very amicable Dustin who took great care of us.

In sum: AWESOME experience!  Go here for date night or with a few friends for a fun and memorable time.  The dishes will certainly keep you entertained.

Love the location and friendly service. The ice cream was good but I also wish they had more options available and I wish they had a menu on the wall. I ordered the sea foam ice which was on point from the 3 little seafoams that I did get.

We were greeted by a sign that said "oysters Chesapeake Bay Grand Rapids, MI." When we questioned the hostess she said "that was what the box said, that they must have a Chesapeake Bay there." SMH...

It's difficult for me to rate a seafood restaurant chain when I'm originally from Baltimore. My standards are pretty high. I had the East Coast Platter. The crab cake reminded me of the codfish cakes we had when I was growing up. There was very little crab and it screamed out for Old Bay. The stuffed shrimp were overpowered by the amount of green pepper in the stuffing. The beer battered fish were ok. The onion strings were so greasy, I only ate a couple. Overall, all of the seafood was over cooked, especially the shrimp. Will I be back? Yes, but it will be for their steamed crabs, not a seafood platter.

We ate here expecting a lot because of the reviews. We got mozzarella sticks, eggplant fries, and a pizza. The mozzarella sticks weren't hot, the cheese inside wasn't melty. The eggplant fries were fine. The pizza was an overcooked mess. The spinach seemed like frozen chopped spinach that had been freezerburned; it didn't cook down like spinach should but just got super dry and had a weird smell. The crust was really hard and tough. I see a lot of people saying the crust is crunchy here. I like a nice crunchy pizza crust-- I really do. But this pizza crust was incredibly hard and I could barley saw through it with a knife and with TMJ issues I couldn't bite through it at all. We said something to the waitress and she told us that was how it was supposed to be, and if we didn't want it hard we could order it less cooked and have it come out "partly raw" next time. Those were her words, I'm not even kidding. I told her that I would prefer fully cooked dough. They gave us $5 off our uneaten pizza. We had taken a few slices and picked at them hoping for edible parts but if we had reassembled everything on the pan we'd have eaten less than two full slices total. I ended up paying $40 including tip for a meal where basically only one appetizer was decent. I am also just shocked at the service we received when I nicely complained about the pizza. Please, please don't tell more customers that if they don't want hard, overcooked dough they should ask for it raw! That's absurd.
Yummy breakfast with a view! Sat outside on a warm morning and enjoyed every second. Eggs, toast, and sausage were delicious. Friendly staff, will definitely be back!

I wish the food portion was bigger for what I paid, but it was all delicious so I would go back again. They let you mix the protein, so if you get up to 3 scoops of proteins, you can do salmon, tuna, and octopus, or any combo you want.

The food tasted fresh and I liked the variety of fillers.
Omg!!! This is an amazing experience and amazing food! I can't say how much I loved this place!! Definitely will be back!

Good value for price. Great location, convienient.  Very Clean, a most important factor. Showers were very small and could not turn on without getting wet. A simple modification of the shower head to point down would solve. They had paper towels in the bathhouse, a nice amenity. Sites were small, and no fire ring. We were all adults, but I noticed not many amenities for children. LIve music was nice. The biggest disappointment was the pretty much not usable wi fi. A passing signal if you were lucky. Even if we were up at the office. Also the tree trimmers were there and very noisy and equipment blocking roads.
Nothing worth leaving home for. You could make a better sandwich with ingredients from the grocery store and I've had better soups from a can.

Our family has eaten here many, many times. Most of the cooks are entertaining and cooks things the way the customer requests. The servers could be a little more attentive, but overall, they are not bad. Would definitely recommend.

They pick up from and drop off at STL Airport. Service is great as a Gold member. I receive a text message when I land at the airport, indicating that my car is ready. There are a number of shuttles going back and forth between the rental car place and the airport, so the wait isn't that bad. There is a gas station conveniently located next to the place, so filling up is easy.
One of my favorite breakfast spots- dill scrambled eggs with smoked salmon and an iced chai latte - their staff is wonderful and I love the tucked away outdoor seating space

The food was really good but the service was horrible. We waited 45 min for crab egg benidict. Adam was our server and he was just slow. He never checked on us after speaking to the table right next to us. We never received refills on our water. He then brought out the wrong check said he was going to correct it and that took another 10min. I mean seriously slow service. Next time ill have to try the service on the inside if i decide to go back.

When you're trapped at a resort for a conference, food options are limited. A group of eight of us came here for dinner the opening night of our conference because it was close and convenient. 

Service was good. They were attentive and prompt. Food came out pretty quickly, and everything was good. I had a burger. Nothing special, but good enough for the price. The Beef O'Rita, which sounds like a cup of meat soaked in tequila, is actually a delicious margarita. 

I wouldn't recommend this place unless you're staying at the Tradewinds, but it's good enough if you are.

I have been coming here for years with my grandparents. The atmosphere is small town like with friendly hard workers. If you sign up for their points reward system you get good coupons in the mail/email. The breakfast is good I have never had lunch here so I can't say much about that.
Caya, Amy & all aspects of Urban Eats rocked my luncheon meeting today! Gorg presentation, unique & delish food options, kept it healthy and because of that the team i fed stayed awake all afternoon!

I called ahead for a small (around 13 people) going away party for my sister.  The staff at Perennial were very accommodating and allowed me to order special appetizers ahead of time for the party.  They provided us our own table and had everything ready for us at the time of the party.  The appetizers were delicious and everyone enjoyed sampling the beers and thought they were amazing.  I'm not much of a beer drinker myself but greatly enjoyed the locally brewed Pluot soda.  Everyone had a great, laid back time.   I will definitely try to hold another social gathering there.

This place has an amazing market for anything Italian.  Reminded me of NY.  The deli sandwich however was just average for me.  And I don't like when I have to reconstruct my sandwich to be able to bite into it. Will try again considering the great reviews and maybe try some grocery shopping (the cheese and wine selection look promising.

I was already a big fan of Sbraga and wanted to try the Fat Ham, so we opted for the 3-course, fixed-price Sunday Supper. We were thrilled to learn that it's not 1 dish per course over 3 courses, but several family-style dishes in each course. Bring on the Thanksgiving pants a month early!

Everything was delicious, but the standouts for me were the Mustard Greens Caesar and the Hot Chicken (what spice!). I'll be back again soon for the regular menu, probably wearing those Thanksgiving pants in anticipation of another great meal.

Chose this place over others with a higher star count because it was close and right on my way.  I'm glad I did.  The service was decently attentive and nice but not too much to make it uncomfortable.  I ordered the eggs Provençal and it was wonderful.  Eggs cooked perfectly and the mix of fresh garlic, thyme, and grilled tomatoes was exactly what I wanted but didn't know it.  The hash browns were exactly the way I like without having to describe it to them.  I'll go back.

I have been going to this place ever since it opened.  Their manicures and pedicures are great!  The people that work there are some of the nicest people I know.  Someone ALWAYS greets you as you walk in.  They are kind and very respectful.  Do NOT believe the people that complain.  They are always miserable human beings who expect to be treated as if no one else matters.  I promise you will not be disappointed! Kathy W.

The only thing wrong with this place is that it isn't big enough! If you want to meet with more than 2 or 3 others you would probably want to call ahead. We always had the same waitress and she is wonderful. The food is great and the portions are huge and the prices are cheap...what more could you ask for?

Great place to hang out. Relaxed atmosphere reasonably priced.
Smokers welcome. They don,t have a kitchen but a great place right next
door that has a great menu and will bring the food right to you so you can eat
at the bar.

Came here with my brother and a friend on a Sunday looking for brunch. The Gulch was really busy and this was one of the only restaurants that didn't have a crazy insane line. We're glad we chose it! It was a good choice. 
I had the Kentucky Thunder spiked milkshake and it was very chocolatey and delicious. 
As for a burger I got the Veggie burger with an egg on top. It was delicious (not as tasty as a real burger but still good) and so were the tator tots! It was enough food -  I couldn't even finish everything. Service was good and the food came out fairly quick.

Stopped by for some ice coffee on a hot day. The staff were sooo friendly!! I made the mistake of ordering two ice coffees separately/one at a time. So the employee had to go back twice and do double the work (if you read this sorry!!) but she still kept a smile. The place isnt fancy or anything but the coffees were good!

If I was only rating on my dish it would be one star for me. I am doing a round of whole 30 and wanted to give this place a shot. After asking the server what she recommended she said the seared tuna. It was $27 (way more than I would normally pay for a meal) but I was just so thrilled to have someone else cook for me. Unfortunately I was served a big plate of disappointment. The avocado stuffed peppers were bland and my tuna was not edible. It has a very thick (dry) crust on it. The flavor profile was very overwhelming. I had a half of a piece and stopped there. I was so sad to spend so much money on a meal I couldn't enjoy. The other food options looked good, but I'll stick to cooking at home during my whole 30 round.

Nice addition to the neighborhood, but I'm surprised to see so many gushing reviews. Not kid friendly at all, they have no kids menu and offered one off-menu option (chicken wings with fries). My kids love pho and noodle bowls, but it hits the wallet pretty hard. Overall, good to very good food; okay to bad service (slow, inconsistent/chaotic, but friendly) and very loud.

I LOVE Cracker Barrel, but this place just isn't consistent. We always go because the prices are very reasonable and I usually make the decision to head there because I'm hungry and don't feel like cooking due to a hangover. The pancakes are consistently delicious. On the other hand, the bacon isn't. We once had two orders of bacon; One order was burnt and the other was done perfectly. I would suggest stopping by, but cross your fingers and pray they have a good cook back there.

Excellent menu and beer selection. Will definitely go again!
Apps of fried pickles were perfect, the beer cheese sauce for the pretzels was amazing. Lots of burgers to chose from, they were cooked as ordered. Homemade ketchup. We got fried peanut butter balls for dessert that were surprisingly good.

9/13/12-
Anybody been?
Went last night, and really enjoyed it.  First of all, I'm not a giant fan of Mexican food, or heat, but I found this place to have enough choices that there were quite a few things I would have ordered easily.
Started with the empanadas de tinga, which were stuffed with good shredded chicken, some onions, and just enough heat. I'm sure there's something else in there, check the menu.  Another started was a very good salad, served with pineapple and pear, (I love salads with fruit in them) and a delicious cilantro dressing, the menu said glazed almonds, but they weren't there, and it was still very good.
Entree's were enchiladas de cangrejo y camaron, which was packed with tons of crab and shrimp, and the only complaint my companion had was that they wished the topping sauce was just a little spicier.
I ordered mole poblano, and I have to say, it was very good.  A very good size portion, served with rice and black beans (yech, don't care for those). We both couldn't finish our entree's because they were so generous, and we wanted to save room for dessert.  Flan....wonderful, but honestly, if you go there for no other reason, go for the banana crepes.  The crepe was so light, almost see through, and it was a very good finish to the meal.  I think the next time we go, we'll just order a bunch of the appetizers, and sample more.
No entree is over $20, with most in the $16/17 range.  Plus we had a groupon.
I liked it and thought the food and service was fine.  Such a nice little neighborhood treasure, I just thought I would share with anyone who hasn't been.
http://www.lascazuelas.net/Menus/Dinner.html
A must stop when traveling in and out of MSY airport.  Dont except anything fancy but food and prices are great!
I love this place. They take great care of my dog's health. The groomer is awesome too! Bring your pets here, they will thank you for it!

We came for craft frozen daiquiris and oysters and were not disappointed! Happy hour is 4-7 daily with $2 off daiquiris and $9/dozen raw oysters (they also had wine specials and a cocktail of the day). 

For drinks, we got a frozen Pimm's cup and a Singapore Sling, which tasted pretty strong and served in a classy styrofoam cup for our takeaway pleasure. 

We also ordered a half dozen chargrilled oysters because my girlfriend wasn't a fan of the raw oysters we've had in the past in NYC. The cooked oysters were solid, but I really thought the raw oysters were the star of the show. They were fresh and HUGE and surprisingly did not have that strong of a brine taste (something that seemed to be characteristic of oysters from the East coast). 

My only complaint is that there was grit and sand in all of the oysters. That didn't bother me too much, but just be careful on chomping down immediately after you slurp because you might bite into some hard pieces. 

My girlfriend ended up eating half of the raw oysters, which was a huge step forward for someone who had previously hated raw oysters. That said, she still preferred the grilled, so depending on your preference, you can't go wrong with both!
If I am paying a lot for a room, I expect no blood to be on the blankets. My expectations don't matter though! Also, the complementary coffee is scorched.

I purchased a chair and matching table over a year ago and I've yet to receive the table.  I've been told it's on a boat from China (yes, that is exactly) what I was told.  Don't pay for anything until you have it in your hands.

This place had the worse server, there was a cut in my wine glass that almost cut my lip. We were never acknowledged about our anniversary. The assistant manager gave a free glass of the same wine that was in the cut glass, the server said it was policy that they could not put the lobster tempura and petite filet on the same plate due to "policy" which isn't true because the other locations do it naturally, the server served a " rare " steak but
My husband asked for "medium plus" everything they did was horrible... Never going back to this location ever! They didn't even give us the usual candy gifts either!!!!
I love pho, and this place gets it right.  The broth is perfect, which seals the deal for me.  Nice place.  I'll be back for sure.

Today my husband and I went for a nice walk    We went around 7:00 - 7:30 am and lived it. The park was full of people, young, older, middle age. Some were already returning from their hike and almost every single person said good morning, hello or smiled. Don't know if it was the beautiful morning weather but it certainly lifts your spirit. Every time we go I notice new things about the park. Although we are newcomers to Tucson hopefully we will make our way to hiking all the trails ! Only thing I would offer as advice is for the info center. Please greet when hikers come in. We went in and although there were staff members there, Not one person said good morning  or offered  to help. Other than that, perfect morning hike! Left us with energy for the rest of the day!!
Excellent food and service. Loved that I could order my own turkey burger the way I like it! We will eat here again!!!! Location was easy to find!

This is the largest asian market this side of I-75. It doesn't have the cramped feel as some of the other markets in the area and its aisles are well kept. If you don't feel like cookin' there is a small food line in the front, but for those looking for some groceries, the aisles are your playground. A wide array of Choys, shelves and shelves of "goong jai mein", aisle full of asian snacks, and a meat depo thats fresh and clean. If you find yourself there on one of the 360 hot days here, make sure you pick up a box of durian or lychee popsicles, you'll thank me later.

cheers
If you are looking for a good pizza, this is the place. The kicken runs a bit slow, but its pizza pies and seafood pasta were pretty good. Not so much of unique..or special..  Service if ok, too.

Good ambiance (very good for an Indian restaurant!).  Service was attentive (also very good for an Indian restaurant :)). Food was well spiced (saag planner was very good Baingan Bharta was ok). Naan and onion kulcha were also good.
This supermarket is wonderful. We found everything under the sun there. They also have an amazing deli that has excellent fresh dishes. I was very pleased and will be back there at least once a week.

Contacted this company by email to get a quote for replacing my pool pump. I included pictures of my current setup and received an email back with a quote the next day. But when I  asked for some more information and tried to actually schedule the work, I got a replay that indicated that due to a "typo" their original quote was off and now the work was going to cost $500 more. This seems to be pretty consistent with the other negative reviews that indicate the poor level of communication and professionalism by this company. Obviously I'm using another company to actually do the work.

FINALLY!
It had been quite a few years since I had been to Who Cares (simply out of utter forgetfulness) and gosh dang it, I am kicking myself now for not revisiting sooner! I was nothing short of in-awe after my arrival last week. Many of the amazing brands they carry I absolutely cannot find anywhere else in Edmonton, and am accustomed to finding only on my trips to New York or via ordering online. The racks were lush with Mackage jackets, Betsey Johnson & Robert Rodriguez to only mention a few. DROOL. 

On top of my delight at the clothing, the shoes were divine, and they had the sequined leather carry-on tote bag from Oprahs Must Have list I was recently about to order from Neiman Marcus! Of course the prices are not exactly cheap but also not unimaginably expensive, but when I come to a store like Who Cares I am looking specifically for designer, high quality, delectable and one of a kind pieces. And this, they definitely deliver on! I am in love! Their sale rack was also lovely, something to visit the store for alone!

The customer service is also divine. I was greeted instantaneously and the delightful blonde woman was very attentive but never pushy or annoying. I felt comfortable and really enjoyed my visit (and my purchases). I would HIGHLY recommend Who Cares (both of their locations, as I just this weekend visited their south-west location) for a modern, different and beautiful take on fashion in Edmonton. It's refreshing to find outstanding customer service aside fantastic clothing within a short driving distance!

After walking by this restaurant since May, I finally made it inside for dinner. The inside doesn't evoke the same excitement as the badass neon sign outside. The food seemed to be more expensive than it should have been, and I didn't like how dark it was inside, even in the window seating area. The fries were pretty great, but my buffalo wings weren't super pleasant with the addition of cheese in the sauce. This place was just eh.

Do you have a movie in mind?  Chances are Casa has it.  No offense to Casa, but there used to be a terrible smell that you would have to bear in order to rent.  The bad smell is gone! I suspect the smell was from stale popcorn oil. The employees at Casa are very nice and knowledgeable.

Really a 3.5

Made advanced reservations for their Jazz Brunch prior to our arrival to NOLA. 

Arrived a few minutes after our reserved time (12pm) and found the venue pretty empty. I had to let the hostess that we had a reservation as she instantly started to bring us to one of the many empty tables. 

As others have reported, the venue has an upscale and classy feel to it -- a million times better than many of the much hyped/must try restaurants in NOLA. 

Food was decent, nothing spectacular.  The brunch menu is pretty limited which I think hurts Mr. B's more than it helps. No omelettes or egg white options. Not even a made to order omelette option. 

We had:

Crab cake app -- packed. Not much filler and delicious. I wasn't particularly in love with how it was cooked but out of a 5, I'd give it a 4

Shrimp & Grits -- just ok. I'm not a huge fan of grits but this was the only item on the menu that piqued my interest

Chicken pontalba -- my companion ordered this and barely touched it. Pale, gross and gamey.  

Bread pudding - ok 

Cream puffs -- phenomenal! Soooo friggin good. This item alone saved the meal for us 

The true stars here were the cream puffs and the drinks. We had multiple rounds of the Mr. Orange Julius and while good, there is another similar drink on the menu made with vanilla ice cream that stunned us.  The best drink by far. 

Service was good. Our waiters Paul and Eric worked well with us. The gent who refills the water was beyond annoying as he kept coming back and forth to our table and just standing over us. Very creepy. 

I also want to point out that the "Jazz" brunch is not what you'd expect. The band (3 gents) played a song or two in one spot then moved about the restaurant collecting tips. 

Expectantly overhyped. 

Wouldn't return.
Great place to stop by for a quick delicious snack & wine. My boyfriend and I enjoyed coming here. The service was great as well. Nice place nice food & nice people !!

This is THE BEST spot for food and drinks in Ybor.  The drinks are amazing and the food is top notch. Cool, laid back atmosphere and amazing bar!! All of the staff are helpful and accommodating!! Best happy hour!!!

Amazing experience! Can't believe I've never tried a Cuban sandwich till now but it was worth the wait! The owner was so nice and the espresso after the meal was to die for! Will definitely try one of the desserts next time...we were too full after our first visit! You will have two regulars from now on. Can't wait for it to get warmer as we'll be riding our bikes to come visit all the time!

I love this place. If you adhere to a diet that is very restrictive this is the place for you. They have plenty of options for Vegan, Dairy Free,  GF, etc...  I would have a tough time finding the products I like if this place didn't exist. I highly recommend!
Wonderful staff, great food, fresh fish and very consistent. Eat here at least twice a week and never a problem. Thoroughly recommend.

I have been dying to try this place and finally did the inside is gorgeous.   White and yellow decor everywhere. The restrooms were super clean. Sasha did my hair. She started by having me look in the book of styles. I went w the mai tai. We started w a shampoo. I could get my hair shampooed all day by someone else. After that it was onto be dried. This was relaxing. They have a big tv w romcom playing. Loud music.  There are no mirrors so you cannot see what is happening. Which is fine bc I just love having my hair dried. While they put product in your hair they explain the products. The product is displayed up front but no prices so I felt it was expensive and I hate asking prices. I feel if I have to ask and it is too expensive then it is awkward. 

My reveal was great. Loved the style. I did end up buying 2 products which was more than I have ever spent on any products in my life. But my hair is normally dry and it felt like silk. I am posting 2 pics one from that day and one the next day. I can imagine this style lasting me 3 days. 

I would come back for a special event or just to treat myself.

WOW.  I moved to Philly from San Francisco 6 months ago, and this place consistently provides the BEST food...and that's the opinion of a pretty devout foodie!  Every time I eat here, the food just keeps getting better.  They have a beautiful variety of fresh veggies, fish, and meats, and everything is seasoned perfectly.  The service is very warm and friendly, (we are big fans of our favorite waiter, John) and I would HIGHLY recommend the Sunday evening tasting menu.  You choose veggie or meat/seafood and they bring out an absolute smorgasbord of incredible freshly made dishes to sample.  One of the best spots in Philly, in my humble opinion.  Will keep coming back!!!!

The evening started out great..10 min into being seated after ordering and served cocktails the eletricity went off--for the entire time till we left..Drinks were on the house,  since we tolerated the uncomfortable situation as we had guedt from out of town with us..

I can't coment on the food because I did not want to have to listen to the asinine
Maitre dee.
Rude inconsiderate thinks he is a god.
Watch out for the big mouth.

I hear the food is great.

If you can get past the door without making a u-turn and running for your life.

One star, 185 dollars later.   Read on Yelpers...

Go to Mortons, or Ruths Chris - they are predictable and live up to that.  

The Watermark, should reinvent itself, perhaps as 'space for lease', or live up to its facade

Do Nashville a favor, move.  Allow someone else to succeed at what the Watermark is not.

Or, deliver what one should naturally expect from the facade..

Either course would benefit Nashville.  

Ill explain, and I completely hope 'Hughes' the manager replies. 

Disappoint me, I wont care much, it happens.  

Disappoint my wife after I tell her I was assured - by the manager, Hughes  'its handled'? - this is what happens 

Actually, I spoke to him on the phone, asking for a small favor - my wife and her friend were celebrating her birthday early - could he please place a small candle or something in their dessert?  He found their reservation - 'no problem, Ill be happy too'   He made a comment along the lines of 'theres a note for the server..'   

Wrong.  My wife was mildly disappointed when there was no candle. Nothing crazy, didnt want a circus, just a candle.  

Although I took it on faith, since I spoke directly to the manager and from him - it was handled  'it was done'.     

I thought the matter was handled.  Wrong.  Something fairly trivial, fumbled.  I learned this after the fact..

Great non attention to detail.  Wonder if the kitchen staff uses soap to wash their hands..

Feel free to pull the ticket for the evening of the 23rd, table for two...7:30pm...

James the server, was 'very nice', no complaint - perhaps it is he who merited the additional star..

The hostess?  Rather Gothic.  Looked more a bartender than hostess.  

Overall, the menu is terrific. 

Too bad the entrees were lukewarm, and the soup (lobster bisque) was 'room temperature'.

The Chocolate martinis were fine, dessert, fine as well - something went right.  

Pass on this restaurant, on the food temp AND the service.

First, if you don't like eating cafeteria style, stop now and move along.
I spent 4 years active duty and 8 years in the reserves, and I know a thing about cafeteria eating.  This reminds me of those cafeterias, only the variety of food is abundant, and the quality of food much better.  Meat eater?  Yup.  Vegetarian?  Gotcha covered.  Gluten free?  Pretty sure (lots of sugar free items too!).  Generous portions served, and each item is priced a-la-carte.  We had a party of 5, and our main courses included pork, roast beef, chicken, and shrimp.  The deserts were huge and plentiful!  
Here's a hint; if you get soda, get it from the soda fountain selection, you can get refills.
If you walk out of here hungry, you're getting take out.  Great for two to twenty, and reasonably priced.  This was my third time here, and we will be back!

I can't say enough about the great time we had here this past Saturday!
Firstly, at 10:15 am it was pretty quiet . The grandkids and their parents signed up as did my senior husband.

One grandchild was old enough but too short.  I was glad they had safety guidelines!

The staff was very nice and helpful. The GM went out of his way to see if my granddaughter could reach the pedals and she could with the booster behind her!  

Coffee was good , too! Arcade is small but kept the non-rider occupied.  We will definitely return soon.

Great new Nashville venue that features reasonably priced great shows with mostly new and up&coming artists. It's inside Cannery Ballroom so it's great sound, atmosphere and easy to view while having a drink or visiting with friends. Will definitely be attending many more shows here!
Arrived at 2:18,  they advertised they close at 230.  They turned us away,  1st and last time to this place.

For Saint Louis Kampi is one of the best.  The prices are good, the choices are the best for a land locked area and safe, (never have gotten sick, although have gotten hives several times from some ingredient, allergies and not food poisoning) and the service is always perfect as ALL "JAPANESE" restaurants go.  It's MY fave and I will not go to any other local sushi restaurant :-).  The only reason I didn't give it five stars is because I've been to other sushi restaurants in other cities that DID get five stars, including going to restaurants in Japan.

Had appointment at NOLA Tan since January 16th for a spray tan before a very important dinner engagement and cruise the next day. My appointment  was for Feb  3rd at 1:00. I got a call at 10:00 that morning canceling my appt. Immediately got on the internet and found the BEST spray tan place. SALON D NOLA on Burgundy Street. They were extremely nice, quick and very efficient. 
I would DEFINITELY  RECOMMEND  SALON D NOLA for you spray tan or hair needs.

I enjoy the vast selection of healthy food options at Caviar & Bananas. The atmosphere feels very L.A. The white and black decor is perfect. What I don't appreciate is the parking situation. My first time parking in the deck, I thought that I would get an hour free. I grabbed the ticket from the station and parked (it's very narrow and cramped FYI) on the 3rd floor. The parking spaces are not generous nor are the compact spaces truly *compact.* So, whomever your parking company is, however closely affiliated, there should be better customer service reps available to communicate that you HAVE TO VALIDATE your parking. Clear signage would be much appreciated. I'm a pretty observant person and there may have been one sign anywhere in the vicinity. Most places simply note that you've selected an hour and you don't have to reenter the ticket or it notes your "in and out" times and doesn't charge you for less than an hour. This is a fault that is easy to fix. Also, the attendant was less than friendly when I told him it was my first time parking there and if he could make this one exception since the place was right there - he said "Nope. Nothing I can do" and just waited for one of us, my co-worked or myself to pay $3.00 when we were there for 45 minutes. It wouldn't read my card w/ a chip but did read hers which also had a chip. Attendants shouldn't be rude or unhelpful. 

Therefore, in busy places like Nashville, you are only as good as your parking. That gets more people to you on a regular basis and also return customers. If it is difficult to get to you - then you'll suffer. Regardless, this business will most likely flourish but the parking company may get replaced. I'll be back, but I doubt when I have to park there.

Hustle and bustle in the heart of Philly.  If you like people watching, this is the place to be.  Got stranded on the tracks waiting for my train to take me to the airport.  The police had shut down the line from 30th Str Station to the airport due to police activity on/near the train route.  Waited about 30 minutes and Amtrak were able to reroute.

After a few excellent experiences at Luke in San Antonio, we decided to give them a chance to redeem themselves in New Orleans. So. Glad. We. Did. The cocktails and oysters impressed once again, and the service had improved beyond belief. As I mentioned before, the oysters are better than Felix or Acme, and if you come for happy hour, they are only fifty cents a piece!!! We had a dozen oysters, an order of fries, 2 import beers and one French 75 cocktail : $24.42   Not bad for a bistro run by one of the most well-respected chefs in town. Get yourself to Luke around 4:00 and reap the benefits!

The food is just OK. Spicy is genuinely feel it  in your years and have to pause spicy. The rice and plantains were too dry. I do recommend the beef and chicken patties. Service was quick and very polite.

Great service and impressive sushi selection & quality.  It was a quiet night and I was brought a free bowl of edamame since he thought it would go good with my Sapporo.  The ambiance could use a little spicing up -- if the lighting and so on were on par with the food and service, it would be a step in the right direction.

Well, I miss Frankie's a bit...  I wish they had kept the hot dogs!

This place was nicely renovated and is pretty cool inside, although a little small.

Menu has a lot of variety and great stuff for lunch.  I had the Tampa Cheesesteak, which is basically a philly cheesesteak on Cuban bread with mustard.  Pretty good.  The french fries were generic seasoned fries... I'll try a different side next time--they had a wide variety.

Service was good and the place was busy (on a Friday at noon), but not so much that you couldn't get a table.  I will be back.
I have been back several times and am still in love. The food is consistently delicious and well made. Service is better each time I go. Highly recommend this place to all!

DO  NOT GO HERE FOR WAXING. 

They burned my face and I am now desperately trying to use ointments and cold compresses to mend what their horrible products and waxer did to my upper and lower lip area this past weekend. I will be terrified if this scars my face.

NOTE: I've NEVER had a reaction like this before.
