Stopped in to check out their offerings of file cabinets and was very surprised by the amount of furniture available and the very reasonable prices.  I'm not much of a thrift store shopper - actually the whole idea kinda creeps me out - but their prices were really great and they had some pieces that could be fabulous with a coat of paint or new fabric!  Didn't find said file cabinet but I'm sure we will be back to peruse on another occasion.

I went to Smith's just for late night drinks (no food) on a Wednesday night with friends. I liked that it was a place you could have a conversation in without yelling and not too crowded. So, not a great Saturday night fun spot, but a cool low-key meet up spots for friends mid week.

Well, it didn't take me long to head back down to South Tucson for the ultimate taco lunch experience.  And this time I knew what to order, so it was ohmygod amazing.

Adorning our table: six fish tacos in their i-can't-eat-you-fast-enough corn tortillas, two thick and flavorsome tamales (green chile and beef), and a guacamole plate bigger than my head. 

So what did this experience teach me?  
#1: I need to eat at Pico De Gallo even more often.  
#2: Get the corn tortillas, get the guacamole, get the habanero sauce (or whatever it is that's in those condiment dispensers), and... get the corn tortillas! 
#3: This is a great place for out-of-town guests.  They get a glimpse of South Tucson and a taste of really fantastic food.  Of course, you should only take guests here if you'd like them to come back for another visit.  It's sure to get them anxious for a return.

I still want to try the tostada de ceviche and the shrimp tacos, but it'll be hard to order something other than the fish tacos in corn tortillas.  I'm fully convinced that this is the best lunch to be had in Tucson.

Oh my Heaven. Serious place. It's crammed with people for a good reason. Great selection of fresh olives, fresh made pasta, Boar's Head meats (Boar's Hummus is actually very good btw), fresh bread, everything you can imagine. Great wine selection. I bought some Swiss with Almond spread that is to die for.

There's a cafe outdoors and coffee bar inside. Their dessert section looks amazing, so many pastries, cookies, tiramisu, everything you can imagine.

I have been in this place about 5- 6 times and not coming back again. I have had manis, pedis and waxing done here sometimes everything done at the same time. I read the 5 star reviews in Yelp and think, well... I guess people fall for the decoration and glass of wine they offer rather than getting a good mani and pedi.

The positive: The place is very pretty, clean and in my case, it is very close from home. They have many nail polish colors to choose from. 

The negative: They rush the entire time and honestly, at some point if you notice the interaction owner-workers, it feels like you are in a sweatshop. They try to oversell you...always and give you the back look if you settle for a regular mani or pedi. Sorry ladies, I just came here for a pedicure, not a foot or hand massage. 
Last time I received the worse pedi ever. I ask the lady to please to take some extra time since I will be in labor in a couple of weeks (or maybe the next day) and once the baby is born, who knew when I would be able to come back. I said to her to
please please please to have all my cuticle removed since they grew too much and too fast since my last visit (3 weeks prior). HA! My entire pedicure lasted 15 mins total. Rush, rush, rush. She was filing my toe nails and sanding the soles of my feet and looking everywhere around... clients entering the place, weather, owner... except my nails and feet. My entire body started to feel tense. The result... Nice color of toe nails but ... Is that what I came for? 
When I paid I mentioned to the owner in a nice way how dissapointed I was and why.  She limited herself to say ... "Oh, I am sorry you did not like it" then she said "it is $30. How much tip do you want to leave?" I could not believe it. Really! I am a business owner myself, I would have check myself my client's feet, make her sit back again and redo the job!  or offer a second visit free... I don't know, something! 
I left the place feeling so mad. As soon as I came home I soaked my feet in warm water, removed the cuticle myself and sand my feet... It took me 30 minutes to do that and YES, I did it with my 38 week belly. 
NEVER AGAIN PEOPLE, NEVER AGAIN.

A quaint out of the way place. 
You come to this establishment for the experience more so than the food. No belly dancer the night I was here. 

The food is good, nothing absolutely outstanding, but nothing terrible either. 

I highly suggest you attend this restaurant with a group of friends, not just a couple more like four plus. You then will enjoy the experience more with your friends,

Funky retro Stephen Starr restaurant.

Came for brunch:
1. Breakfast burrito was very good - eggs, bacon, and tater tots in the burrito with bits of jalapeno diced up in there. Came with some of their homemade hot sauce/salsa that had a nice smokey flavor to it. Tater tots came on the side. Order some sour cream, mix with salsa, enjoy!
2. Huevos Rancheros - they were pretty good but no beans and thought the corn tortilla could've been fried a bit more, but alas they were delicious nonetheless
3. build your own bloody mary - fill out the form and presto you get a delicious drink
4. had a bunch of other brunch drinks that looked good.

def would come back for brunch again or just to grab a drink.

Their pizza is hit or miss.  We stopped eating at the restaurant over a year ago because the wait is ridiculously long (and cramped),  and the service mediocre.  We will order in occasionally,  but always order the same pizzas because we learned not to take a chance with them.

Love Jasmine Thai. Spring rolls delicious. Green curry delicious. Cashew chicken delicious. Only time I have ever been disappointed was sweet and sour other then that food and service is great! I especially appreciate it when they do not rush you and when I ask about gluten and dairy allergies they take time to discuss options. One Thai restaurant lost my business when they told me to hurry up.

This is a fantastic restaurant. The atmosphere is great, not too formal or stuffy, has a very urban feel and tables are not too crowded together.  

Service was great - we were seated promptly, we were quickly attended to, water glasses were never less than half full, food came quickly and timed well, we were thoroughly impressed with the service and overall experience.

Food-wise, it was excellent as well.  
-biscuits were amazing, and the butter was REALLY good
-Spiced pig ears:  Not the texture I expected, but very good nonetheless, the aioli was delicious
-Roasted Beet salad:  the kale pesto was excellent, was going to try to make it at home!  otherwise solid dish overall
-Brussels Sprouts:  my favorite of what we ordered, large portion, the brussels sprouts were a good texture, not too soft, great flavor, chicken skins were a nice additional touch
-duo of beef/broccoli/fois gras: if I had to pick a "disappointing" dish, it would be this one.  The portions were quite small considering that it's the most expensive dish on the menu.  I also expected a portion of fois gras on the dish, but instead, it's shavings of fois gras on top, so you don't really experience any fois gras flavor.  Good overall, but not amazing
-Spinach cavatelli:   also amazing - loved it (notice a trend?)

Overall, I think it's one of the top restaurants I've tried in New Orleans so far, and we will definitely be back!

My experience was poor. I will not be using these guys ever again. Good luck if you decide to try them. Make sure you take a lot of pictures of your vehicle before it goes through the gate. You'll be glad you did, wish I had.

Took my Living Social to CataVinos on Saturday and was greeted by the owner telling me I needed a reservation. I looked around and no one...NO ONE was in the shoppe. It was 3:45 and she told us that the tastings didn't start until 4:00. We waited until 4:00 and one of the employees saw us and asked if we'd been helped. We told her we were there for a wine tasting. She apoligized and sat us and we did the tasting. She was very nice but my first impression stunk! I bought 3 bottles of wine but most likely won't go back because the owner has terrible...can I repeat TERRIBLE customer service!

This placed really delivered. It's my first visit and I wasn't sure what to expect, but they really have a wide variety to choose from. Are you looking for fish and chips, burgers, or something healthy. You can satisfy your cravings here. The deserts are pretty good, too. This isn't a fine-dining 5 star restaurant, but for who they are and what they provide, they deserve 5 stars tonight. Thanks for the great food and service.

Bought the Groupon for 10 classes here - it was a pretty seamless process to use the coupon. The studio is clean and nice but not as full of natural light as I'd prefer. They have several classes a day in different styles. This provides a little more flexibility but given that I had 10 classes it was also sometimes frustrating when I picked a class because it was convenient from a timing perspective but not my favorite teaching style/class type. Overall though, the groupon is a great deal. Not sure how much it is to join the studio regularly.

This diner has a super cool building. Food was EXCELLENT! There weren't any dolphin entrées on the menu, which I was relieved about. I like dolphins because they're smart. Service was also EXCELLENT! There is a graveyard across the street. New favorite diner!!!

We had a great experience overall.  The waiter was very pleasant. We went for lunch so the menu was basically sandwiches, wraps and salad.  It was very good and inexpensive to our surprise.  The view was just beautiful.  The manager came by our table to make sure everything was ok with us.  I defenitively recommend this place.

Pros:
* Private karaoke lounge upstairs has excellent sound system and selection of songs. Lots of current hits have the actual music videos, which is pretty unusual in my karaoke experience. The songs that have fake music videos are inadvertently hysterical. 
* We had a huge party with lots of people arriving at different times and drinking lots. Our waiter did a good job of keeping up with us and getting us food/drinks promptly. 
Cons: 
* You cannot order pho in the karaoke lounge. So sad!
* They ran out of vodka. (But our waiter gets bonus points for suggesting we switch to tequila instead. I like the way you think!)
* Going through the restaurant to get to the karaoke lounge feels a little sketchy.
My go to for both personal and business autos. Great rates for tires and the service is above average. I trust what they say and pleasant to work with. Keep it up!

H&I.... The legendary St. Elmo's sister restaurant.  By sister, I mean, much uglier, cheaper, and less fun sister.  I'm partially joking here.  Harry's is a 4 star restaurant if you are not comparing it to StEs.  I know it's not fair, but when you share shrimp cocktail, you are inviting comparison.  It's steaks are great and service is above average.  But...it's food quality and swag are no comparison.  StEs is Sinatra to H&Is Josh Groban.  So...if you are looking for a good steak dinner but don't want the price tag of StEs....there is always the cute sister!

Since when is multi-grain and sour dough bread "traditional"? Traditional is white or wheat bread and while I don't mind the newer items not everyone in my family does so it's a challenge to find true "traditional". I was hoping this would be the place but I was very disappointed in my son's behalf. A little truth in advertising, please.

Long waiting list on Monday for decent food and coffee but customer service had too many rules, such as not seating if all of party not present & not serving coffee while waiting in line outside. They were clearly trying to move us through the restaurant swiftly to gain more tables, so not a relaxing place to eat if visiting friends or trying to have a relaxing breakfast. Attempting to clear plates too often. They kept asking my wife if they could take her plate as she was still eating, with food in her mouth. Shrimp and grits decent flavor but grits and "house made bagel" were both too dry, not buttered or no butter offered. Wouldn't come back.

The donuts here are intense but really good. Not thinking while i was here i ordered a berries and cream donut, fried chicken sliders, beef sliders, and the monte cristo. All i would have again, extremely tasty. The fried chicken was perfectly fried and i loved the slaw that came on top of it.

The customer service here is often great, but  too unpredictable. There are some very knowledgeable, friendly people on staff that are engaged and actively seek opportunities to assist customers, but there are just as many that practically run in the opposite direction if it looks like you might need help. The Paint Department is STELLAR - I've been there when it was mobbed, and no one lost their cool, every customer received the attention they needed....they are just brilliant. Plumbing can be a bit of a gamble - there are a couple of men who are quite knowledgeable, but if you get them on a bad day, you'd best just go home until they regroup. Hardware and lumber are definitely places where you're on your own - you won't be offered help unless you're one of their "tribe". Garden is generally deserted except for the cashiers. I know there must be people who work out there, I've just never managed to find one.  The front end staff is usually attentive, friendly and efficient, but Returns are another gamble - it depends on who you get as to how you are treated (mostly very positive - might be the fill-ins that just don't like being there).  I don't know whose responsibility it is to answer the phone, but that is always an adventure. Be prepared to listen to endless adverts and be transferred. A lot.  Mebbe even hung up on."By mistake".

Still the best location in the area .

Super fun experience. Don't be fooled by the exterior of the building. Lots of menu items to chose from. Tried the appetizer sampler that had 7 items $5.50. Loved the Samosas and batata. the paneer wasnt my favorite. We also ordered the cheese naan (bread stuffed with homemade cheese baked in the tandoor) $2.60, gobhi prantha (bread stuffed with cauliflower chili and spices) $2.60 and while both were very tasty there wasn't a huge difference between the two. For entrees my favorite was the Lamb mushrooms $9.75, but a close second was the Shrimp Vindaloo $11.25. Everything was wonderful. Would definitely recommend and can't wait to come back to Tucson again soon!

Omg!!!!! This place is going to get me in trouble.... In a good way. It's too good! I can't afford to eat there on a daily basis, buys its so close to work! I hope they stay open forever and ever!! There's one thing that'll give this place a whole five stars and it would be if they have more seating.

First venue I visited in Nashville and it blew me away.  Electronic Dance party or sit down intimate feel this is one of my favs! I've seen everyone from Bekka Bramlett to Slow Motion Centerfold.. aaahhmazing!
Love this place!! A cute small neighborhood cafe :-) The atmosphere is just so nice. They use La Colombe's coffee. I often come here to relax...

I was a little skeptical based on the location and the fact our wait was nearly an hour and a half on Sunday after church but we stuck it out and man I'm glad we did! It's a nice little mom and pop gen and I'm definitely coming back!
 I started with the coffee while my friends enjoyed the spongebob mimosa that was pretty good (nice and strong). I couldn't help but order the banana foster pancakes based on all the reviews and good lord they were right. Probably some of the if not THE best pancakes I've had. Definitely diabetes on a plate but for sure worth it. The eggs were good on the side and I really loved the turkey bacon that c some with it! It was so good my friends ordered another whole entree of it hahaha. It's definitely going to be a part of my brunch options now but I will attempt to avoid the super long wait times!
Love the bartenders. Nicest girls ever. Don't expect anything more than an awesome dive bar with patrons that land all over the spectrum.

To celebrate my first anniversary with my husband I thought  of sending him a fortune cookie to represent the first year of marriage with "paper."  Since we ate at a Chinese Restaurant the day we were married I thought this was a great idea to send him a giant fortune cookie with a personalized note. They were informative about sending the fortune cookie to my husband's work at decent time to prevent the chocolate cover fortune cookie from melting. I was a bit disappointed because I did pay for overnight shipping and had to wait at least 3 days to my husband to receive it. I was willing to let that go until my husband brought it home from work at the cookie was not only broken but it cookie itself was burnt! I understand the shipping problem since it was to be delivered to California and the fact that it can break while being shipped but for the cookie to be burnt and inedible ?! Of all things it would of been nice for husband to at least enjoy eating the fortune cookie.
Get the nachos with brisket! To die for!!! and finish it off with their pecan cobbler! Loved the atmosphere and the food!

Went here with the girlfriend to celebrate a late Valentine's Day date. Well we ordered mozzarella sticks as an appetizer and 2 burgers ( I ordered a California burger and my girlfriend ordered a cheese burger). The mozzarella sticks were burned and lacked flavor as well did the sauce, it tasted like a jar sauce. Than came the burgers,I should have know something wasn't right when I noticed the slight discoloration of the avocado slices. The cheese burger was not cooked very well it looked like it was a frozen patty that was cooked with non melted cheese. With in minutes after eating we both didn't feel too well. 

The reason this place got 2 stars and not 1 was the server was actually on point and always checking on us through out the night. It's very unlikely we will come back for quite some time which is a shame since we live really close by and the prices are not that bad. Really it's a shame.

This place is really, really good. I'm not ready to crown it best Asian or Korean place around but it certainly is the best Asian fusion in town and my favorite place to eat in Brentwood.

Bim Bi Bap is the most praised item here and that is rightfully so since it's awesome. For $10 you get a rather large bowl of pickled vegetables, rice, chili paste, marinated beef, and a fried egg. It's absolutely delicious and if you eat the whole thing you'll be pretty stuffed. The only downer is that it's only available on Thursdays. Most people know that too because the place is usually very busy that day... on my first visit there for lunch Thursday the parking lot was so crowded cars were lined up on the street and circling for parking. Even though it was really busy we had our lunch in less than 5 minutes. 

My next favorite thing here would be the spicy pork Bulgogi served either as a dish or on tacos. It's only available on Fridays but I can't think of a much better way to celebrate pretty much the best day of the week. 

The service and staff are excellent. It's a family run business so the owners are always around. I've talked with the owners several times and they are very, very nice people.

This was definitely a winner! Came here to eat as I waited for my train. Great energy, awesome environment and the food was GREAT! I ordered the buffalo chicken sandwich...THE BEST I've had hands down. Very mixed staff which made me a lot more comfortable. Just a good place to be.

Just came back from my second visit to the Bourbon Orleans, and it was almost as great as I remember.  My first visit was when I was an impressionable 22 year old totally blown away by the marble lobby, the courteous staff, and the larger than normal (for the Quarter) pool.  

On this visit, I was more aware of the walls being paper thin, and of a somewhat threadbare look to certain aspects of the hotel - the furniture in the lobby, the chipped and broken painting hanging in our bathroom, etc.  However, it's still a gorgeous hotel with superb service at a great price.  While it could use some updating, compared to the horror stories I've heard of other hotels in the area being rife with bugs and mice, I think I'll come back to this hotel next time I visit.  Which, according to my boyfriend, will be very soon.

Found this place on my way to the dollar store and boy was I happy to find this place!!!! The wait wasn't long, three people ahead of me. I threaded my eyebrows and upper lip both which took no time at all, considering my eyebrows were a mess. I gave complete trust to the women threading my brows and she delivered 10/10 would recommend!

Wow! This place was amazing. This is a total package kind of place. Great drinks, food and music.  They sell local brews and the 40 arpent brewing co Milk Stout was yummy. The specialty margarita was as well. We shared eggplant bruschetta, scallops and the most amazing "steak and cake" which is medium rare steak over crab cake! Holy cow amazing! The live jazz band made the visit complete. Make a reservation if you can.

My husband and I went in for an early dinner and I'm so glad we did. I'm pretty picky when it comes to certain salads and when they didn't have anything I liked I was bummed but my husband ordered the house salad and it was delicious! Butter lettuce, peaches, pistachios and a light vinaigrette. One of the best salads I've ever had. We both ordered burgers and they were some of the best burgers ever. The meat was cooked to perfection, fresh ingredients and the pickle was awesome. The fries were really good and the service was great too. If we visit SB again were def coming back!

This place continues to amaze me each and every time I use them. From the initial purchase of our Forte5, to the unlimited car washes, and finally even through a minor recall, they have been simply amazing. 

Truly one of the few great dealerships remaining in the area. It's sad that I am moving from the area, as I will miss visiting Friendly Kia. :(

Did not love this place. 

To be fair, when we came in to eat it was incredibly busy (every table filled) and there was only one server. Based on previous reviews I am sure that if you were to dine at Savvy Jack's when it was not as busy that it must be really good. 

Everything we ordered ranged from pretty blah to only ok. My husband got the biscuits and gravy - pass. I got the cuban sandwich - pass. My mom got the breakfast special with eggs, grits and ham. Her's was probably the best. I didn't even try my brothers veggie omelet, but he mentioned it was only ok. 

I felt like everything we got was cold and had been sitting around. But, again, this could be because they were very busy and just couldn't get anything out fast enough. 

I love to support local restaurants and will give this one a try again, especially since all the previous reviewers seem to rave about the food.

I stopped in for lunch sort of on a whim. I passed 5 Star on the way to the city hall and thought I'd give it a try. Glad I did! What a burger. They make it how you order (med. for me) and the fries come in a little fryer basket. The fries were cooked just right and had salt & pepper on them, which is unique. I had the Blue Ribbon burger and the onions were a perfect addition to it. I've never had Gorgonzola and sauteed onions like that so I'm impressed.

I highly recommend this place. Be warned, it's not a fast food setting, rather bar & grill. Good service too!

My favorite place for pizza. Their Margarita pizza is the best! With a great crust, sauce, fresh mozzarella cheese and basil. The real taste of Italian pizza. They also make great white pizza, with garlic spinach and mushrooms. The owners are from Italy. Very friendly staff and good service. It is a family owned place and Paula is wonderful! We recently tried their Tiramisu dessert- the best I have ever had thus far! Definitely a must try!!
Authentic food that is often hard to find. Staff is friendly. This is my go to place in the city.

Fast service, huge portions, hot food.  Their greek omelette was good, grits were good, and they waitress asked me if I wanted more of anything several times.  Apparently, you can have seconds of some things!

I used to go to the Crystal Lake Diner religiously, but their service has decreased as well as the food quality.  Westmont Diner is my new place!

This places doughnuts are outta pocket fam...

Only reason I am not giving them 5 stars is because the breakfast sandwich's are a little thin.  If they just put more egg and meat they would be just as fleek as the doughnuts #mythreecents

I love taking yoga here. The instructors are always extremely friendly and knowledgeable. I have taken several classes with 3 different instructors and I always leave feeling renewed and relaxed. I highly recommend Rebecca's Saturday morning Yoga Rise class as she is wonderful and clearly loves being a yoga instructor. She takes the time to guide each student and her approach Thank you Yoga Child!!

First time there today for dinner. Food was excellent. Patty our waitress was very helpful with the menu, was very friendly and very attentive. I got the capellini with crab which was very tasty. My son got the lasagna which was really good. And my husband got the shrimp and scallop special. Got the whole wheat garlic bread which was so good. We even got dessert. Patty recommended getting the coconut cake since it was our first time there. We are definitely going back. Restaurant was clean and very inviting. When you call for reservations ask for a table by the front windows. Great view of the river. It's a hidden jewel.

This review is such a throwback, but I was in Franklin in February when an insane run of weather turned Nashville into the coldest place on Earth.  During that time, the entire city shut down and my saving grace was the consistently open Noodles & Company.  The food isn't anything to write home about, but you know what, I have to respect reliability.  I think I would have starved to death if it wasn't for the service of Noodles & Company.
Outstanding Meat and Three kinda place.   Seems like I went to Grandma's house for lunch.  Worth A visit.   Thanks. The cloth napkins always makes me smile!!!

In a city full of great eating destinations, Luke may take the cake.

As others have mentioned, Luke offers the best HH in NO! 50 cent (at time of writing) oysters and half price drinks are a great way to kick off your NO weekend. The place gets busy quickly so to ensure your spot in the HH fracas, do arrive early.

Bonus tip: the pate is awesome.
Their food is so good!! Staff is friendly and alert. I always order their tomato flat bread and their Mista salad with shrimp!

I do not recommend going for lunch. 
Place is super small and you sit on top of your neighbors.
Duck fat fries are delicious, went for dinner multiple times and always had a good meal (didn't get a burger) went for lunch and got a burger and wasn't a fan Waitress was on the ruder side and messed up my order and didn't seem apologetic.

Amazing, amazing, amazing!!!
Don't even hesitate for a second...come, eat & enjoy! :)
The KFC wings were very good- super crunchy and sticky sweet and hot. Great addition to the neighborhood.

The food is great - tons of healthy options ranging from salads, burgers, and wraps. I've tried the curried tofu wrap, the chickn burger with tempeh, and almost all their salads. Each meal takes a bit of time to prep, but leaves you feeling good about your meal, because you know exactly what went into your meal and the ingredients are fresh and healthy! It's a little on the $ side, but expected with most healthy options.

The winner here is the banana whip - it's basically frozen banana soft serve. Game changer. $4 for a huge bowl of soft serve and you can even add toppings like granola / chocolate chips etc., but it's really not needed. Guilt free dessert! 

Not a lot of seating inside so would recommend taking your food to the park if it's nice outside or getting it to go.

So I'm writing this review for The Man...because personally I dislike Taco Bell food.  So yeah...

The Man gives this place 4 stars because:
- They're fast
- They're friendly
- They never get his order wrong

I returned here after my sister-not a bbq fan said she wanted to try a BBQ place here in Nashville. I don't know what brought it out of her but I didn't hesitate to take her to Edley's. Sunday was busy, with a large line but it wasn't as busy on Friday since it seemed like it would be possible to get a table after we ordered. My sis first thought about splitting wings but once she saw the bbq nachos being prepared we both changed our minds. She went with the catfish platter with the mac and cheese, green beans and their bushwacker. I got the turkey platter with mac and cheese and their Brunswick stew-the special side that day. 

The nachos were awesome, with a huge pile of chips and cheese with their smoked pork with sour cream. A hugely awesome starter that was easily a meal in and of itself. My sister really liked the catfish and how fresh it was. The mac and cheese was something she enjoyed.

The turkey was delightfully smoked, the mac and cheese was good as ever and the Brunswick stew was all right. It was my first time trying it so I'm not sure how to compare it. I thought it a little watery but I don't know if it's supposed to be like that. I didn't notice before though that man it is a LOT of food. I couldn't finish, which is something rare enough that I need to write it down for posterity. My sis,also a big eater couldn't finish her stuff either so she packed it all up for later.

Went in around 8:30 hoping to beat the rush. Unfortunately that wasn't the case. We sat in line for about thirty minutes to be seated and when they noticed my wheel chair they had another group jump ahead because there was only one table that was wheelchair accessible. The table wasn't even wheelchair accessible, it was just out of the way. I had to get out of my wheel chair and scoot onto the bench. Service was quick. I ordered the Route 66 burger, which I recommend, and bottomless fries to share, unfortunately I only got one serving of fries. The Oreo milkshake was delicious, it was like a melted mcflurry, you could tell it wasn't from a mix because of all the big Oreo pieces. The waitress was a little rushy bit that's to be expected when groups of 15 people are waiting to be seated.

Take my rating with a grain of salt, as I have not tried the pizza yet. The customer service was outstanding. Sandy was exceptionally friendly and extremely helpful. Annnnd of course Unlimited toppings how you go wrong. They won't nickle and dime you on the toppings which is awesome !

I've been giving places 4-stars saying that the 5th star is likely in there pending return visits, but I'm going to, this time, say it's a 5-star barring any mishap in the future. Truth is, I'm sick of reviews that are less than favorable, which begin "I have been to this place many times and have always had a good time, except for my most recent visit, which was crap". That doesn't seem fair. Upon review, I'm thinking that perhaps giving places I really enjoyed 4 stars just because I haven't been there enough, is unfair in its own right. I digress.

So, Spice Corner. I often need spices, but I tend to suffer the high prices and off-the-assembly-line quality of generic grocery stores because I am intimidated by specialty shops. Whenever I'm in a niche shop, I am uncomfortable whether I'm looking for a common item or something virtually unheard of. I imagine the clerk thinking "really? You couldn't just go to Wawa?" or "Okay. Let me just trek to the remote regions of the earth and procure that for you"... I digress, yet again.

I made the mistake of going to the Head Nut in Reading Market twice before (it Is significantly closer), and both visits were unpleasant. Okay, increase reluctance for trying this place. Anyway, I did go for the spice corner finally, and I'm so glad I did. This will be my default spice shop until forever, I hope. The prices are ridiculously low, first of all. I can't emphasize that enough. Additionally, I was being helped by a lady already, but the recipe I had didn't specify black or yellow mustard seed (probably because it wasn't written for noobs like me), and as I was standing there muttering about blind pigeons (Lithuanian stuffed cabbage) to the confusion and perhaps horror of my helper, another lady came down the stairs and answered simply: "yellow". The recipe turned out terrifically, and I'm glad that was not so awkward and embarrassing! 

Finally, buying loose spices has a great advantage I can't praise enough: you can have EVERYTHING in IDENTICAL CONTAINERS. Granted you'll have to purchase these elsewhere, but whoa, uniformity is pleasing to the soul! No more ethnic markets, Superfresh, Trader Joe's, Whole Foods, and various farmer's market containers in all sizes and shapes leading to cabinet chaos and organization despair.

Very popular place....the wait was about 30 min on a Saturday morning at 8AM.  Kept it pretty simple, had the "simple breakfast"...eggs, toast and hashbrowns.  It was really good...the hashbrowns were the best! Then decided to try one of their pastries, had the boston cream pie dossant, loved it! Would definitely go back.

Great start up brew. The Saison was different but excellent, don't let the description fool you. The vanilla porter was very good with a hint of vanilla and the Irish stout will be a hit today. All the beers are done well and I look forward to many visits and of course an upcoming pint in a lawn chair. Cheers!

Grahm cracker porter brew was outstanding. Cant wait fir the growler!

- TIP:  Their hand torn noodles are back -- available on Sundays with a different spin each week.  

- CON:  Just wish the hand torn were still available all the time.

- BOTTOM LINE:  I returned to Cheu after giving them a 3 star review a couple months ago. Since then, they've brought back a key menu item (hand torn noodles on Sundays) and the rest of their food & service was back up to the standards that made me love them in the first place.

I'm really liking this place.

It's taken me forever to find a family practice doctor in Tucson. Any sort of specialty doctor I've needed I've had zero problem finding, but when it came to just a primary care physician it has seemed impossible.

Finally I came here. Dr. Sanders was the doctor I was able to see the soonest so I that is who I saw.

He's great! He's so so so nice. He listens to you, he answers questions, and he doesn't make you feel stupid for going to the doctor. His medical assistant is also really nice too. When I had a question about my prescription she called me back in just a few hours.

The first time I went I did wait forever. I can't blame them though, this seems to be a healthcare problem in general. The second time though I probably only waited 10 minutes.

I'm seriously so happy to finally have a doctor in Tucson, I'm just sad it almost took me a decade to accomplish.
This place was fantastic. Not too costly, very tasty. Our whole group thought the pickles were amazing.  I had the back yard burger, it had lil smokies built into the patty! Highly recommend.

Hot chicken tacos and pork Tacos were excellent.  Hot cauliflower and chicken and waffles as well.  Brussels sprouts with pork belly very good but a bit over glazed for my taste. Tuna tostada was nice , but I think the tuna may have sat in the fridge. Great service. Good bloody Maries.  Easy parking. Would go back.

Stayed at this location the weekend of 9/29 with some friends. We had 2 rooms and we booked far in advance. Have to say for the prices they charge we were not impressed at all. I am not talking about the decor or the fanciness of the hotel but the lack of service.
1. We asked for an early check in when we booked our rooms (6 weeks in advance). We were told that is not a problem but when we got there it was a problem and they could not accommodate us.
2. We had 2 beds in each room and housekeeping only decided to make one bed. We called down to have the other bed made up (duh) and they never showed up. We also called down for a second robe and that never arrived either.
3. We were getting onto the elevator and an employee was on the phone with her Mom and told us we could not get onto the elevator because it was an employee only elevator. It was not. The employee elevator was 3 over. When we told her that she got very snotty and told us were wrong. All of this and she was ON THE PHONE the entire time.
4. We asked for a late check out due to our flight schedules and AGAIN they would not accommodate us.
When you are paying $400 a night for a hotel room you expect some customer service but that is not a priority at this hotel.
I have stayed at their Santa Barbara and Scottsdale locations and it was better. Not staying at Hotel Indigo's anymore.

I like to think I'm a breakfast connoisseur.  This place has blown my mind. Best grits ever, hands down. Best breakfast burrito ever, hands down... Etc etc. It's really a special place to indulge in culinary mastery.
This place is closed  the signs are off the building  and it looks  like the y are putting up drywall inside.  i don't know if it will reopen as  a BK or just office space.

Don't even think of using the men's restroom. Consistently dirty, disgusting, toilet paper on the floor, last time one toilet overflowing with sh..
Spoke to the manager, he thought it was OK, and he had no budget to fix even the run down toilet seat. This was the second time I brought disgusting conditions to the managers attention. Wrote an email to corporate twice, got form letters in return, they said the manager would get back to me, guess what he didn't,

It's dry cleaning, so not much to say.  Except that they were totally professional and my clothes look great.  

I've tried 3 other dry cleaners in STL (tip top, demun, and westway) and this one has been the best by far.  No shirt buttons missing or damaged, no mystery stains, no half-assed press jobs, etc.  Just a solid clean and press.  The only downside is they charge more than others but I suspect you get what you pay for.  I will be using them for suits and other higher end stuff I don't want messed up by tip top.

First time here. It was a toss up between this and Fiesta Mexicana. Not sure yet if I made the right choice. The place is clean...and was empty besides me. Ordered the flautas, which they make upon ordering and are packed full. They are delicious. Also got a chili rellano burrito and asked for wet. The young girl behind the counter looked at me like I was nuts, but asked if I wanted enchilada sauce on it. Yes.....she then went on to talk to her manager in spanish about what I ordered. Im a gringo....I like sauce (and cheese....which was not offered and not added) on my burrito. When I asked if they put cheese on she just said "No." No sorry...no...do you want to add....so....not really  impressed with customer service between that and the chatting she did after I ordered. Back to the food. I tried a few bites of the burrito....sauce tastes canned. The whole thing needed major spice adjustment....salt, salsa, spicy guac...cheese..... before it tasted like anything like what I was looking forward to. Again....flautas....awesome. Service lacking and seasoning also lacking. Not too bad on the price. Not sure if I will return.

Legit Mexican food. PERIOD!
Everything is excellent. My fiance is from Mexico City and this is by far her favorite place to get tacos and tortas.
I've lived in Los Angeles for about the last decade and I can agree with the other yelpers.. this place has great AUTHENTIC Mexican food. 
The downside, as if it really matters.. would be the hours. 
But the food is so good, that it really doesnt make a difference.
Senor what?
Fan-tastic cupcakes! But go early, as they tend to get stale later in the day when they aren't as fresh. The red-velvet/chocolate chip ones are the absolute best!

I went to plume this week to get a feather extension put in my hair... The ladies who worked they were so sweet and the salon itself was absolutely adorable.

I had read all the reviews listed here and thought there's no way that this salon has such high ratings. but after being there, its no wonder they are rated so high! Well deserved!

Wonderful place. Can't wait to go back.

If you eat here with a baby you better hope they don't need to be changed!!!! How can a restaurant who serves families NOT have a diaper changing station?!?!?!?!  I had to cut my meal short to change  my child's diaper in the trunk of my car in 50 degree weather. Thank god this was not the middle of winter, if it had been, I would have changed her right at the hostess station!!

Les Bons Temps is a unique atmosphere in the Philly - one of those places you walk into and think to yourself "this is different."  I went for lunch for the first time this week and am definitely looking forward to heading back.

I lived in New Orleans for a few months a couple years ago - Gumbo there is like Cheese Steaks here... you just can't enjoy them anywhere else once you've had one.  That said - the Gumbo of the Day (andouilli and seafood) was the best I've had outside of NOLA.  I also had the Muffuletta salad - which was ok.. but in retrospect I wish I had gone with something more exciting.

Also of note here was impeccable lunchtime service.  The waitress was great - and picked up that we were in a hurry... making sure we were in and out quickly but didn't feel rushed at all.

Definitely looking forward to going back - and Les Bons Temps has been officially added to my regular lunch destination list.

This place is now called Hickory.

It is GREAT!!!!!! It actually tastes like healthy BBQ. The meats are smoked very well and the Sweet Potato Fries are ROCKIN!!!!! I eat at this plate every week. If I am in town and I never leave unhappy.

Getting into a PF Changs can be frustrating since they fill up very quickly and the wait times can be long. When I need a PF Chang food fix and am in a hurry, I go to this Pei Wei. The menu has several similar offerings and the prices are better although it has a cafeteria style service vibe. The orange peel dishes (beef, chicken, shrimp) are a favorite. As mentioned by some, the food can be inconsistent - outstanding once time and just OK another. My hit rate is about 80% positive with the shrimp occasionally being bland and the rice not as moist as I like (although easily fixed with lots of soy sauce). Bottomless soda and fortune cookies keep the kids happy too. 

The place can be noisy and the selection is limited to keep prices low but overall it's easily a 3 1/2 star to 4 star place. We eat here about once a month and like it for what it is - fast, tasty food. 

Recommended - especially if you are in a hurry or are bringing along the kids...

By the way - today's visit was excellent (read check in) but the bottomless fortune cookies are gone.

I have trusted Jin with my wedding dress, bridesmaid dresses, and my $1,000 suits. Everything she does is flawless and to perfection. She does not allow me to take anything until it looks absolutely perfect. She has done everything from hemming to completely re-making my wedding dress (and everything in-between). She is courteous and gets things done quickly and cost-effectively. I have sent many people her direction. I would recommend giving her at least 2 weeks for any major alteration (wedding dress, suit, etc. as she needs a few fittings to get it perfect). Trust Jin with your clothing!

hungh....


A lot of inflated reviews I think...

Bar was pretty dirty, my elbows stuck to the railing.

I had EXTREMELY slow service...  I ordered, and my food came out approximately 25 minutes later, while others sat down after me, and were served before me..

Also, I overheard some of the Staff talking, and could tell that there was not good chemistry amongst the work-place...  a lot of jabbering, complaining, hemming and hawing..  not good.

The iced tea was stale, jambalaya, okay, nothing special.

I suppose its worth another try, but I'm not in any hurry

A serious fall in college left me with chronic neck pain, resulting in massive headaches and limited mobility. The only thing that seemed to bring relief was deep tissue massage, and those results were temporary. After a particularly bad day, I called EFC in desperation for some healing. Dr Caley fit me in on his lunch break and spent an hour thoroughly examining my neck and spine and explaining his approach. Now, with two adjustments a week to get me back on track, I have never felt better and I'm finally free of pain!

The added bonus was a totally revitalized fitness routine. As an avid runner, I was certain that icing my knees after a long run was simply a fact of life. Turns out the dysfunction in my neck was causing issues all the way down the line. Dr Caley adjusts my neck and everything else falls into place - I've been running the best times of my adult life and have no knee pain. Zero. For real. I'm a new woman.

Dr Caley's office is warm and inviting, and he gives every patient his sincere and undivided attention. Watching him with other patients while in the waiting area is so refreshing; it's evident he is passionate about not only his practice but also every person that walks through the door. He practices what he preaches, too, and you can tell how fit and vibrant his lifestyle is. I leave feeling energized and healthy, like I've just had a shot of espresso. I'm a believer!

I've been going to Las palmas for many years. I've always had great food. The last two times I've been there for lunch, however, the chips look and taste burnt and brown. It kept me from eating them, though.

They only got two stars because the staff was very friendly and nice and the hotel itself looks nice. 

Starting with the door I left the first night of my stay to go to dinner and came back and my door was cracked open. I asked the maid service if they had cleaned my room and they told me that when I leave I need to remember to pull the door shut because it won't shut on its own. 

The bathroom looks nice when walking in but I immediately realized a huge problem, there was only one light in the bathroom. Upon turning it on it also took a few minutes for the loan light to heat up and it started off red and finally got an, albeit, bright white but still was not enough to light the shower appropriately. 

The room itself is fairly nice but there are no available outlets to plug anything in at all.

The worst part about the room is the view out of the "window."  Upon opening the "window" there is a restaurant one floor below with a glass ceiling, making leaving the curtains open extremely awkward. Additionally, the pool is directly across on the same floor, making it even worse to have the curtains open. 

On a side note the wireless service is poor at best and the hotel charges $10 a day for access to wifi. 

I think this is a terrible job of laying out a hotel and executing that layout. The idea sounds cool but does not work at all. I will not stay here again.

By far the best margaritas in town, go see Dave at the bar, ask to top drink off w/ grand gala ( mexican brandy) you'll be on your way to doing the mexican hat dance!
Food quality not at all authentic, tweaked for the western palate, flavors are somewhat like corporate Mexican food, standardized flavors,  portions are small, service is good, parking sucks

Went to see my sister in ICU with my niece and her daughter. She was her mother and the child's grand mother. The woman literally laying behind the desk couldn't have been ruder! We asked for my sister' room # and you would've thought we wanted her to climb three flights of stairs to get us a glass of water. I can't believe there was no supervisor on duty to see this woman laying in her chair. When we asked if my niece's daughter could go up, she asked her age. Unfortunately she wasn't old enough to go up but we did not need to be told "Gangsta Ghetto" style!  When we finally were able to see my sister, we found no one like this woman anywhere else. Everyone we came in contact with was very pleasant and helpful. A very bad taste in my mouth for this Hospital!

I am a little confused with the reviews. As 'the best sushi place in CWE', isn't the sushi supposed to be the best? 

It should be first emphasized that 'sushi' here refers to the traditional sushi as opposed to the rolls which in no way reflect the sushi quality and authenticity, conceding the fact that these rolls somehow resemble Makizushi. 

Sushi: 2/5, disappointment. Our assessment started from the Nigirizushi (hand-pressed sushi). Apparently it was not well pressed. When I tried to pickup the first sushi, it fell apart. I was also stunned by the sushi preparers' lack in fundamental knowledge such as condiments for different seafood (Amaebi is supposed to be served with grated ginger; grated ginger and sliced scallions accompany mackerel; scallop works better with sea salt and citrus, etc.) None of these happened. 

Ama Ebi (4/5): Botan shrimp took place in their amaebi sushi for its redundancy than the original Alaskan amaebi. As expected, it had less concentrated sweetness and weaker sweet aftertaste. On the plus side, the complimentary deeply fried shrimp head was crispy and the shrimp brain was a delicacy. 

Hotate (2/5): Scallops were lower in glycogen and thus sweetness less perceivable and also somehow losing the fresh texture. One hotate sushi was a failure because the sushi preparer broke the flat cylindrical muscle in half when it was butterflied. Poor preparation due to negligence. 

Saba(5/5): Very rich in omega-3 oil healthy fish, my personal favorite. Their mackerel was rightly cured and still preserved aromas of the mackerel and left it with less fishy oil. Nice job! 

Chirashizushi and Tekkadon 3/5: Very few pieces of small cuts of Sashimi in a huge bowl. I expected to see fish cut into a block shape about 1 to 1.5 inches thick, 3.5 wide. Here it was thin-sliced to translucent pieces. Chirashi often varies regionally but at least 2 slices of salmon and tuna are the baseline. I saw only one piece of salmon. Although tuna are usually thinner, the Tekkadon tuna here was so sheer, light and transparent like diaphanous films. The quality was not bad but they are overpriced. 
-----------------
Appetizer 4/5: We had Grilled Squid and Tempura. The tempura dipping sauce was great. The grilled squid was a bit overcooked and chewy but the sweet Teriyaky sauce with sesame was a delightful surprise.

Ambiance 5/5:  It is a very well decorated neat little place. A lovely restaurant. Quite and stress free. They even have one washitsu, a Japanese-style room having tatami flooring and other traditional architectural features. We were glad to see otoro on the menu, superior quality tuna highly perishable, and uni. 

Service 3/5: We ordered two Saba Nigiri but only got one. We had the second one after we asked the hostess to double check the order. Later she forgot to include a pen in our bill. 

As a medium to upper scale restaurant with the price to back it up, this establishment could train their employees to be more professional and staff more mindful of their guests. No amount of interior design or upholstery can make up for mediocre sushi.
So yummy! Great atmosphere. Valerie was the best! So helpful and attentive. Made the experience so much better!!!

Good pizza, although too much crust around the edge for a thin crust personal-sized pizza.  Seems like a good 25% of surface of the pie, if not more, was uncovered crust, and without butter or parmesan or some other coating, it was not good enough to want to eat.  I toughed it out for one piece, then left the rest.

Service was excellent, as were the pinot noir I ordered (very smooth) and the craft beer my husband had (dark, looked very tasty, but I neglected to try a sip like I often do).

I ordered my Bourbon Chicken pizza with Alfredo sauce instead of the bourbon sauce, and that part was perfect, and I had them hold the caramelized onions.  The server brought some of the bourbon sauce on the side for me to try, but I didn't care for it -- too strong of a flavor that I felt would have overpowered the other ingredients.  It really tasted more like a soy sauce with onion seasoning.  The crust was thin and crispy, the way I like it.  Overall I'd give the pizza a 7 out of 10, so like 3 1/2 Yelp! stars.

My husband had a calzone, which was on a separate menu which we were told had just recently been added.  It had several meats and looked amazing.  He usually doesn't have any trouble finishing a restaurant portion, but he took half of it home so you know it was huge.  His was more like an 8 or 9 out of 10.

My daughter had the Quattro Formaggio pizza, hold the sundried tomatoes, and said it was great.  She's not a fan of red pizza sauce or tomatoes in general, so was glad to have other options.

We tried to order tiramisu for dessert, but the server told us it was no longer available (sigh), which was disappointing but okay since we'd had plenty to eat.  I also brought half of my pizza home -- it was a good sized personal pizza, so plenty for two meals for me.

Will we go back?  Yes, most likely.  It's open late, and very close to our home in suburban Indianapolis.  But I'll definitely ask if they can push the toppings farther out on the pie to minimize the wasted space the next time.

Sully Satisfies

We were on a long road-trip and we weren't making plans too far ahead.  We just needed to spend one night in New Orleans and we preferred it to be in the Garden or Uptown Districts and we prefer B&Bs.

The folks at the Sully Mansion (as do a lot of B&Bs) typically require a 2-day minimum, especially on weekends.  But they were willing to make an exception for us.

The home is in a great location in the middle of the Garden District, just a block from the St Charles Streetcar.  It is a beautiful 1890 mansion house with a bit of funky flavor and a lot of artwork by New Orleans artists.

The rooms are thoughtfully outfitted and everything was quite comfortable.  In the morning we had a delicious cooked breakfast with several items.  We had a very nice conversation with the owners.

We would happily return to the Sully Mansion.

Last minute late night choice.  Glad we stopped in.   Veggie burger was one of the best I've ever had!!!  The pickle spear was pretty awesome too.  Fries were great and loved the dipping sauce options.  Cool spot.
This place is great! I love the portion and the broth is wonderful! I am always greeted with a friendly smile and never have to wait long for my food.

Good food and prices for this area. The only hiccup is no condiments. My husband and I ordered carry out- Southwestern burger and cheesesteak. The food was good but dry. We grabbed napkins on our way out but who doesn't put condiments in for a burger/steak.

To start, the staff is extremely friendly, even when you walk in at closing. They are also knowledgeable about the menu and every ingredient that goes into it. 
The ambiance is comfortable. It's a place to relax from all the chaos. 
The music, though not yet live, is from the 50s. I liked every song, and the waitress, Sonja, even knew the song. Classy lady (: 

Try it out. The food speaks for itself. It is high class ingredients, paired perfectly. Try the sweet potato fries and the confit wings. If I could give ten stars I would. The kitchen takes pride in everything they send out to their customers. You can taste and feel the love in the food.

Bought a deal from them through Groupon.   Every time I would call the phone would say "mailbox full" and they would not respond to my e-mails.  They finally sent a link to schedule an appointment through their automated system.   I scheduled an appointment and they never showed up!   We again tried to call but all phones said mailbox full and again they didn't respond to our e-mails.   Total scam company.

We went for a late family dinner.  It was good.  The seafood gumbo was very, very tasty and very hot.  However, we all agreed that the food could've been hotter.  It was cooked, but not served hot.  Just warm. 

Overall, the diner can not compare this restaurant to Crabby's.  This restaurant has 10 Fold a better selection of food on the menu.  So, if you have your choice to go to Bills or Crabby's, choose Bills.
Best meal so far in New Orleans. Undiscovered treasure, the ceviche. Order it, it's not on the menu as a single item.

My boyfriend and I came in on a Saturday afternoon to randomly check on the status of his upgrade. Patrick was wonderful. He confirmed that the upgrade was possible, told him about their new Value Payment Plan and because they didn't have the BRAND NEW Google phone, he called and reserved the phone for my boyfriend at their Philadelpia location. SO happy with the new phone!

Went Saturday to golf at ElRio.  We haven't golfed there due to high costs.  We were pleasantly surprised at the friendliness of the entire staff.  There was a tournament going on and even though we had not participated we were invited to pay a nominal price and enjoy the prime rib dinner offered the players in the tournament.  To our surprise the entire meal was very good and appreciate the thoughtfulness of the manager Robert.  We plan on joining the next tournament and enjoying the fine food served at El rio Golf Course

BREWERY TOUR REVIEW.

The tour is good, you actually get to hear about their history and see the factory.  The tasting is slightly disorganized though and feels rushed.  The family style pitchers get confusing when there are 2 different types of beer floating around the bar in opposite directions.  They also don't have much variety on tap, as most of the beers we sampled were light beers.  But hey, who can complain about 7 free samples of beer? ;)

Soy Bistro is a great family-operated restaurant that opened in Brentwood 6 years ago. Previous businesses in this location haven't fared too well in the past, but it's been an encouraging sight to see the community love and support Soy Teryaki Bistro since its commencement in 2010. Although I moved to Atlanta five years ago, I still remain a big fan of the restaurant and consider it to be one of my favorite places to eat whenever I visit Nashville, so I wanted to share a quick review. 

I took a look at the menu online to see if anything has changed since my last visit; other than one or two items, I've tried every item on their menu (yes, every single appetizer, salad, fried rice, soup and teriyaki). My favorites were always the spicy fried rice, soy green salad, shrimp tacos and beef teriyaki. What really sticks out, beyond the great flavors or ingredients of the fried rice and salad, is the sauces that they're served alongside. The soy green salad comes with a creamy avocado ranch dressing while the spicy fried rice is served with a creamy, spicy sauce. All are made fresh in-house and are the perfect complements to both dishes. I still find myself craving them and wishing I had a bottle with me so I could put it on my meals here in Atlanta. If you want a lighter option, I loved ordering the soy green salad with salmon - so good! The teriyaki options are all delicious, but I'm a big fan of beef, so I loved ordering the beef teriyaki; the meat is always tender and the sauce has the perfect balance of sweet and savory, without being overly salty or overpowering the meat. If you're not as hungry and want something smaller to snack on, you should check out the tacos. Or if you're just feeling in a taco mood, 3 of these would be a perfect meal; each taco comes served in a corn tortilla with the teriyaki meat, spicy slaw and drizzled with house sauce. My favorite is the shrimp taco, but all the other options are tasty as well. 

I'm normally not a fan of fusion-inspired food, but I love that Soy keeps true to their Korean roots and finds an updated yet refined way to serve every meal with well-balanced flavor. 
The owners, Chris and Hanna, are two of the friendliest and generous people I've had the pleasure of knowing. They run their business with persistence, sincerity and kindness. I loved being in the restaurant and seeing them greet customers by name or remember a 'regular' order - they make it a goal to truly treat you like family. I hope to make a visit to Nashville soon and come back for a meal again!

I visited Eats! American Grill with family for the second time a few days ago. We were trying to find a place to eat dinner that we haven't been to in awhile. Eats is a smaller place that serves great food....Due to the playoff hockey game, seating was very limited. We chose to sit outside rather than hope a big enough table freed up in a reasonable amount of time. Sitting outside at night in the late spring in Florida can be a recipe for disaster btw! The mosquitos ruined our experience (we'll never make that mistake again!)...I wont hold that against the restaurant itself though. The food was great, although it took quite awhile for it to arrive after we ordered. (we later found out there was huge party of 25 that really put a burden on the cooks and servers).... We all ordered burgers. Eats makes some of the best and biggest burgers in the Tampa area. Highly recommended if you cant make a decision on their menu....The service was okay. Felt like we didnt see our server much during our time there. She was nice though....Overall, Eats is a great place for families to enjoy a nice meal together. Our last experience wasnt the greatest mainly because of the mosquitos and the huge party that delayed our food, but again, im not going to hold that against the staff at Eats. Next time we'll be sure to wait for a table inside, so we can enjoy our food without getting eaten ourselves by mosquitos.
They mess up my order every time I call one in. They need to focus less on speed of service and more on accuracy.
Old school NOLA restaurant. Had drinks and gumbo and tomato soup combo appetizer. Delicious. Good Pimms Cup, but a better one across the street at Hotel Monteleon.

I really enjoy ICB. The shadow boxer is probably my favorite beer there. Well balanced, dark, smooth goodness.  
    The building is great. I love that the art always changes inside, giving me a chance to check out new artists. They open the huge garage doors in the summer which is wonderful. 
     A very laid back and friendly place to grab a beer. Service has always been great. Staff is knowledgable and very accommodating.

Wurster's has been amazing in keeping my mid 2000's SL 550 in great shape. I even recently got rear ended and they helped secure my trunk immediately as I drove it in so I could drive the car until a body shop could do the repair. Great people and they'll give you the price of the repair without any surprises. A+!!!

We've walked by this place multiple times, it looks like a genuinely cozy hole in the wall type place that you would rave to your friends about but that won't be my case.

I know this is Edmonton, so I wasn't expecting tapas from Spain but these are the things I was expecting-water glasses filled at least once per hour (I never got a glass after asking for one, and the rest of the table went dry as well after the wine and salty dishes), cutlery would be nice. When you bring a plate to someone and there is no cutlery recognizing first is a plus but even being attentive enough to bring it when it is asked for is acceptable as well. 

There were two cooks for a room holding about 30 people. It shouldn't take that long to make a cold seafood dish. We did make reservations and although the service was very poor it was poor with a smile on their face, so I honestly feel bad and think they can't do any better

Someone might enjoy this place better if it was emptier-the cooking and service would be expected to be better. My suggestion would be to go for the wine and some snack size appies that range from 14-24 dollars, and then walk down to the blue plate diner for a meal that is half the price, excellent service and has that cozy feeling-just in a larger area.

Probably my worst Marriott experience ever. Front desk staff was unresponsive to very disruptive behavior on my hall during nighttime hours. Walls are paper thin. Doors slamming every five minutes. A total nightmare.

Love this place! Always a good energy when you walk in! Food was amazing once again! I had the blackened grouper sandwich with the pineapple tarter! A great twist to a simple sauce. Gwendoly was our server, she was very attentive and had a great personality!

I love trying new places and this place is a great addition to Freret st! I can't wait to come back and try the more "modern" menu items. I had the egg roll noodle bowl tonight and it was really tasty!  The atmosphere was nice and service was great.
My beard needed some serious trimming. I saw Laura and she was amazing. Excellent service and great work.

One of the best places I have EVER eaten. The food was INCREDIBLE. I had a pork dish with corn grits and a vegetable side dish (not sure which one) - ALL WERE INSANELY delicious. I was with a group of 10 and we each passed around each different dish we got - each was better than the next. Alligator bites? Yes, please. Ribs? Fingerlicking good. I also got the Bloody Mary - it definitely is salty/zesty but SO, so good. I was so impressed with this place, including the decor and the feel. For a place this nice, I would expect it to be EVEN MORE expensive than it actually is. Just go for it - this place is worth it.

I like the irony of my first NOLA review being a food truck.. Just sayin'

Anywayyyyy...
Fig mustard = awesome. Fig mustard burbs = not awesome. 
I regret nothing! 5 stars!!

I went to Silver Bullet Gun Works last Monday to pick up some 200 grain 10mm hunting ammo and noticed an old Savage 12 gauge shotgun on their discount rack.  It is now the gem of my collection.  Took it to the range yesterday and it functioned flawlessly.  Big thanks to Mark and the rest of his staff for the great experience.

Came here because my friend is a big It's Always Sunny In Philadelphia fan but it also turned out to have great food. The Red & White Chicken cutlet sandwich was excellent and the daily special and the serving ideal. My friends that had the short stack rib burger said it was among the best they've had. Excellent beer and drink choices and brilliant friendly service. Great place.
The service was great....ask for Lisa. My Pho and the spring rolls were yummy. So glad MK's is in the neighborhood!

love this place! cheap!
delicious authentic tacos with fast friendly service! really busy around lunch time.

Best salsa in town!!!!!! I love everything here any thing they service is a piece of heaven best Mexican food in town it is authentic and good the service is amazing and  the food comes out very fast. And have a big tap and bottled alcohol of any kind plus coke products. Please come and eat this amazing food it will not disappoint!!!!!!!!!!

After a long day last Sunday trudging through the woods to clean and clear trail myself and two other friends decided to go out for dinner.  We stopped at the Pic-A-Lilli on Rt. 206 and it was packed shoulder to shoulder.  So we decided to go to La Campagnola instead, just before five o'clock.  It was really kind of empty at that time.  I read on the bill board outside that they offer an early bird special until 5:30.  We sat at the bar and the tall skinny young bartender, that plays college volleyball and looks like Clarke Kent (I don't know his name) hands us menu's.  I had to ask for the Early Bird Menu, it wasn't automatic.  I ordered the Fettuccine Campagnola which was a white cream sauce with peas and small cubes of prosciutto, it also came with, "soup, salad and my choice of two desserts."  I ordered the seafood bisque for my soup and wanted a house salad and a cannoli for my dessert.  The bartender says, "it is soup OR salad" and i explained that there was a comma in between the words 'soup, salad' and not and 'OR'!  I told him i wanted soup AND salad.  Remember I walked through the woods so at that point in the day I was starving!  I ordered a beer while i was waiting and the soup came out.  It was just ok...nothing too great, no real hunks of seafood.  Then I expected for my salad to come out and instead the pasta dish comes out....so I ask, "where is my salad?" and the bartender responds AGAIN, "it is soup OR salad" as if i am mentally disabled.  I said, "yes, i know, but i wanted salad too."  He said, "Oh, ok.  I can go get that right now." as my pasta dish was sitting there getting cold.  I told him forget about it at this point my entree is here already.  Apparently it was the end of his shift and he was more concerned about cashing his drawer out than waiting on us.  Then he was a douche on top of that explaining that it was 'OR' even though the friggin menu had a comma which indicates AND!!  All the while making me out to be some kind of retard.  Anyway, having a father that is an Executive Chef from Italy and growing up in the restaurant business, I know that THE CUSTOMER IS ALWAYS RIGHT!  I won't be going to that dump anymore!  Eff that place...they should hire people that aren't kids and people that know how to type a specials menu!

This place has some good homemade ice cream. Had the Heath Bar ice cream and it was delicious. Other flavors ordered were Mint Chocolate Chip and Chocolate. Both were as good too! The line was very long, but luckily there were four people taking orders. The atmosphere is very appealing. Found myself looking at the painted murals and finding hidden pictures within them.  They have a giant chalkboard so that children can draw while parents enjoy a scoop of ice cream.  Definitely a place I would go back to again.

Thai food should be delicate, light and flavorful - and this is exactly what you can expect from Lanna Thai.  My BF and I came here late on a Tuesday night and we were the only ones in the restaurant.  Not wanting to keep them open later than they intended, we asked if it was too late to be served.  Without hesitation, the host insisted that we stay and enjoy a private dinner.  It was lovely!  We started with the spring rolls which were the freshest spring rolls I have ever had, most certainly rolled to order, and absolutely delicious!  We then ordered a papaya salad and two of their special dishes - a beef curry dish and a shrimp dish.  WOW.  Each dish was better than the next.  The shrimp were some of the largest I have enjoyed in Reno and the curry was perfectly balanced and unexpectedly light.  Amazingly, we polished off 3 beers and 4 dishes because everything was just that good!  I love thai food and this is most certainly my new favorite!
First time here, would definitely recommend. I ordered the lamb saag, and it was to die for. I see mixed reviews, but my experience was great today and I plan to go back very soon.

Big fan of 312!

My husband, being from Chicago, was super excited about a Chicago pizza place opening up within walking distance of our home. Upon going to 312, we happily discovered that it's not just a Chicago pizza place, but a great Chicago restaurant, bar and new neighborhood staple... Right here in Nashville.

The deep dish pizza is beyond good... The corn based crust was to die for and the sauce to cheese ratio (crazy important, promise) was perfect. Their ingredients are brought from Illinois and it shows. You can get a pizza at a price much cheaper than you'll ever find in Chicago itself. One small pizza will feed 2 people for at least 2 days. (Isn't pizza for breakfast just the best?!) 

My husband loves the Italian beef... I'm a fan of the dogs. We both love the risotto balls and mozzarella sticks for appetizers. 

The place itself is comfy, unassuming and modern. The staff is super friendly and so proud of their true to Chicago fare. 

Go and enjoy!

A friend who lives in NOLA recommended we try this place out because they're known for their tasty donuts and sliders. And boyyy was she right! I got the Black and Gold donut, a fried chicken slider, and a Nitro cold brew coffee. The donut was peanut butter glaze, dark chocolate, banana, and oreo crumble - it was good, but a bit too sweet for me. Though my friend got the Sangria donut and it had just the right amount of sweetness, it really depends I guess. The Chicken slider was amazing!  I loved how crispy yet light the fried chicken was and the slaw was finger-licking good!  Get the Nitro cold brew for a smooth and tasty beverage! Definitely recommend this place if you're in the uptown area!

quite possibly the BEST sushi I've had! A must try! 

It's a quaint little place, no frills, but the sushi is AMAZING!

Yesterday afternoon we were just walking through Broad Ripple for our Tenth Anniversary and chanced upon the Cake Bake shop opening today!  We went inside to check it out while they were setting up...       

My eye caught a most amazing creation...layers upon layers of delicious looking chocolate chip cookies smothered in some kind of scrumptious looking frosting ...something like grandmas batch of cookies ran head long into a bowl of the best buttercream... I so longed for a taste... 

I gathered up my courage and asked if they had any smaller samples (thinking there was no way they would slice into this, well, magnum opus in my mind, because they were actually opening the next day and surely it was meant for tantalizing display on the morrow.) The owner said, no, this is how we serve it, would you like a slice? 

!!!

Run that by me again?

They gave us a monstrous slice we shared and a glass of organic milk and we, well, that's when the screen fades away.

But for your edification it was not frosting per se, but mascarpone with kaluha and something else wonderful.  Not heavy or too rich... Amazingly light.

Very friendly service and a beautiful shop... Brought me back to Carmel Beach and Pinehurst...

Great expectations for future visits!

We are grateful for a great anniversary memory and a first taste!!!

****i am a northern boy****

I really Loved this place. I got the fried oysters for an appetizer after the waiter suggested it and told me that the Green Tomatoes didn't look good today. 

For dinner I got the bacon wrapped shrimp with grits. I have never had grits and told him I had never had them. Basically laughed at me and explained what they were. 

Both were absolutely phenomenal. The place is a little loud but the service was good. Lot of help staff. Wait time was minimal for me on a Sunday at 7pm. 

Would totally recommend.

Here's the short version: 
DELICIOUS food, truly excellent. 
It's BYOB. The prices are very affordable, a big bowl of soup for $12 that could easily feed 3 people.

The one big.. huge issue I had was how long it takes to get your food. It took about an hour for two dishes, the soup came first. After a whole hour. And then another 20 min our second dish came out. What I thought would be a 40 min meal turned into 2 hours. 

The restaurant is family run and everything is made to order. I was told no prep is done and that's why it takes so long. My tip? Get a slice of pizza from up the street before coming so you're not hangry.

The food was decent but the service was atrocious!  We had to ask for napkins and silverware, our salad came out before the appetizers, drinks did not come out for 20 minutes after ordering them, the second round of drinks the server forgot 2 of them and the glasses were smaller but same pour because they didn't have any clean in that size. When we notified the manager, she said thank you but didn't take any action like talk to the server or offer to take something off the bill or give us a dessert, which most restaurants will do. I don't live there but I won't be going back when I do go back to St. Louis.

These guys were AMAZING!!!!
I had my car towed there from another body shop after BMW of the main line recommended them.....
My car was at another body shop who I refused to let them work on my car as they could only be described as sharks...
Century was a breathe of fresh air after dealing witht he other knuckle heads.
The guys at Century were all kind and empathetic during a very stressful time.
Century took care of everything with my insurance company, it was great!

Their work was astounding and my car looked amazing when it was done, they even fixed something on the interior that I had not mentioned to them.
My car was detailed before it was returned and they even offered to get me a ride to their shop after I returned my rental car.

I highly recomend Century, I hope I never need an auto body shop again but if I did I would not hesitate to go back.

It's been over a year and a half since I've been coming here, and boy has it only gotten better. They've expanded into the suite next door, so seating is comfortable and plentiful. They've added many more sandwiches, desserts, and sides to the menu. If you haven't been here yet, you are missing out on Broad Ripple's best!

Yummm!  Husband and I stopped in for the korean food.  The menu is both Japanese and Korean.  Choices are a little limited but what they had was yummy.  We had the spider roll to start with while we were waiting, bimbimbop and one of the special entrees (#2, spicy pork with vegetables).  Prices are reasonable for the area.  Banchan is ok but the meal makes up for it.  The servers are also really nice and attentive with refilling your water.  I would come back again....especially since it's across from the REI!

I went with a big group to Superior last night and I was looking forward to    having a good meal. While the ceviche appetizer was delicious and plenty enough as an app, I felt my main dish was lacking. I had the Baja fish and shrimp tacos.I applaud them for using corn tortillas over flour tortillas, but the size of the fish filet was minuscule and there were only 4 shrimp in the second taco. Great flavor, but just not enough food.

The service was great. Our waiter was really great despite the fact that it was swamped. He was very accommodating.

These people are wonderful! They absolutely saved me. I was traveling from California and visiting family in Tucson on my way for a much-needed week off in Mexico. Horrors! I ran my e-clips through the washing machine and mangled them. After reading good Yelp reviews about this practice, I limped into the office with my poor e-clips, and Anita spent a good 20 minutes working on them. Presto! She fixed them perfectly, and then wouldn't accept payment - just urged me to enjoy my time in Tucson and Mexico. How is that for good business - and kindness? She saved my vacation! If I lived here, I would definitely be a customer. I gave the card to my relatives; I suspect they will become customers in my place.

Nice atmosphere- $1 off happy hour 
Has beer and wine only but a HUGE selection of beer
Good food, not your typical bar food, rather upscale foodie bar food ;) 
Open for all meals (BLD), and the breakfast room/counter area smelled fabulous.
Great place to meet up with friends and enjoy a beer n snack.
