Plain and simple: cannot beat this spot. Great beer selection, pretty good coffee in the morning, and great sandwiches.

I called this morning because my Lexus was making a bad sound when it went over bumps.  Mary told me I could come right over, and a few hours later, and with a new pair of rear struts, my car drives like new.  They saw the problem immediately and fixed it the same day.  I don't know enough about cars to know say whether the prices are reasonable, but the entire staff was friendly, helpful and responsive.  I will definitely be back.

Street tacos in Tucson!  I lived in another state and in every taco truck and authentic Mexican restaurants lengua was a staple.  We moved to Tucson and were expecting lengua everywhere.  It was hard to find.  The tacos at Maico's are great street tacos.  I will become a regular.  
I don't care about atmosphere or location or imbibing...ok I do care about that however when I get a good street taco. I do not need other vices.  
It's all about the access to lengua that I don't have to make.  Thanks Maico!

I WANT to like this place. I really, really do, but I have been disappointed every time I go in. I live very close by and it's really nice to have a place to go to when you're in a pinch in the middle of a recipe and realize you forgot something. However, many items are very overpriced. Also, they don't carry things I thought for SURE they would have. I wanted to get some whole wheat buns. They have to have that, right?? I mean, they sell veggie burger patties, wouldn't they have buns to go with it? No, they only have loaves of bread. Perhaps I was missing something, but no one there is particularly interested in helping customers. Every time I go, I say "I'm never going back there!" But of course, I find myself going back and giving them another chance and another chance. The strength of this place is that it is the only grocery store in the immediate area. For that reason, I'm very happy to have this in the neighborhood. I would never do an actual shopping trip here. I would end up spending 2 to 3 times as much there as I would elsewhere. I was behind a man in line who paid $100 for a couple boxes of veggie patties and some produce. I couldn't believe it when they told him his total! Overall, I don't think this is a terrible place, I just wish the prices were a little reasonable and they carried more things. I've often stopped in here to find something and then had to walk to whole foods when they didn't have it. So I often wonder, what's the point?

Outstanding!!  I have a German Shepard that sheds, sheds, and sheds.  They did such a good job that I have not had to vacuum everyday.  They said she could be bathed about every 6 weeks, so look out I will be back with my fur ball.  haha.  They also did a great job on my yellow lab.

A slight language barrier to start with. When I told the gentleman it was to go, he handed me a bag and told me to have a seat. When the food came up, mine and the other two people's food who were also getting to go, were set on the counter with the boxes open. We just kind of looked at each other wondering whose was whose. After figuring out which boxes were mine and getting home to eat, all I can say was that I was less than impressed. Not a lot of flavor in what I assume was chicken and the fried rice just tasted like regular rice with frozen vegetables and teriyaki in it. The egg roll seemed to have been left in the unchanged grease too long, and not even a fortune cookie. If I'd gotten one it probably would have read, "You'll  have better luck somewhere else"
Great place for a quick and delicious breakfast or brunch. They have gluten free options for picky eaters.

Going to have to settle on 3 stars as it was fresh and pretty good but didn't blow me away. The pho was good but the broth was not the best I've had. Lacked depth. The meat was super tender and overall it was a good bowl of pho. The spicy spring rolls were good but once again nothing remarkable. The egg rolls were good but once again nothing remarkable. Make sure to ask if you want lettuce to wrap them in. I would absolutely eat here again and everything was hot and fresh but...... I have had better. Service was spot on and very friendly!

Our first night in St Louis. Dinner at a BBQ place and desert at Ted's. Pumpkin pie for me and lemon for my wife. Wonderful!!! 

We'll be back next week before we fly out. If we weren't traveling around the state, we'd be here more.

ALERT!! They absolutely will not split the check.  A completely ridiculous policy.  I brought 20 people there for my birthday and they refused plastic and splitting the check.  

The food is good. The rabbit was outstanding.  The waitress did a great job.  However, if I had it to do over again, I would pick another restaurant.

This is my favorite restaurant in Philly!  The food is always fantastic (you HAVE TO get the spicy feta appetizer!), the prices are low, and the staff is a really sweet family who make everyone feel welcome.
In a city full of great restaurants, Luke is a classic stand out. Try the daily lunch specials with an entree and soup - both will be great.

Chocolate snowball is insanely good! Between that and mega mango, definitely two of the best snowballs in the entire metro area! Any of the "mega" flavors are great! Haven't had a disappointing visit yet. Snowballs are consistently delicious and the staff is always friendly.

I enjoyed my visit and my meal. The service was excellent. I'm a Manager by trade and I was treated with excellent quality service. The only problem I had was that the menu prices online were different from inside.
Best cream cheese ever - and I was a total skeptic that cream cheese could be so much different from store bought. So fresh and perfect on bagels.

I was pretty excited that a Jimmy Johns finally opened in Plant City. The first time I came here everything happened as normal, the sandwich was totally on par. 

My second visit though was a bit awkward. I walked in with my small group and the only three workers in the building were having a very involved conversation and not acknowledging any of the customers. We stood there for a few minutes but it eventually became clear that we were waiting in vain, so we left.

I was only in New Orleans for 3 days so I wanted to eat at the best New Orleans places they had to offer. Well Luke's helped make that happen. This was my first breakfast encounter in New Orleans. I was greeted by this super attractive hostess. I wanted her for breakfast, but miss beautiful wasn't on the menu and wouldn't dare ask the waiter what the market price for her was. So I settled for an equally sexy option The Eggs in a Jar. This fun sized mason jar came out filled with creamy grits, two poached eggs smothered & moistened with hollandaise sauce, and 3 soft shell crabs battered & fried perfectly protruding out of the  chubby lil jar. Talk about fun presentation. The creamy grits were the best grits I've have had the pleasure of devouring. The entire combination was perfect. Eating breakfast out a mason jar really gave this modern southern feel that I doubt many other places could have nailed like LUKES did. This place was pricey but only in the monetary sense. All in all one of my fave breakfast encounters ever.

I came here recently for a work-related dinner.
I love that it is tucked far away in a little corner, which makes for quieter dining than another "innovative" sushi place in Santa Barbara.

Which brings me to my next point: Sakana is great for interesting roll and sauce combinations. There are more traditional rolls and sushi, but go for the unique menu items to appreciate what Sakana does best.

The Montecito roll and the Merry-go-round seemed to be the hot picks for the evening. Throw in a few others, add some hot tea and cold sake, and we were happy.

Presentation is really great. The sauces are beautifully presented on the platter. Definitely picture-worthy, if I'd had my camera with me.

There are no reservations here, it's first come, first served, and they would prefer not to seat you until your full party has arrived. Friends have happily waited an hour or two for their seats. But my group got lucky and were seated immediately. Good times.

Excellent Customer service!  My front fender got caught up on a curb while backing out and my insurance company classified it as a collison.  The fender was able to be reattached to a couple of the clips that held it on, but one was broken. Great, I thought, this will be costly.  I went to Prestigious, instead of charging me to replace the fender, they glued the fender while I waited and charged me $0.  That's right, no charge.  I didn't have to pay my deductible to the insurance and it was taken off my record.  Thanks Prestigious for making my life a little easier and my wallet a little fatter =)

My boyfriend and I moved to Bensalem a few months ago. After trying multiple Japanese restaurants in the area we were bummed out and really missing our favorite spot in South Jersey. We came to Tako based on the Yelp reviews and were not let down. The service was great. The chef sent out complimentary sashimi. Everything we had was delicious and amazingly fresh. The quality of sushi here compared to the 50% off places in the area is incredible. We can't wait to go back!

I stopped by this afternoon for a late breakfast. Knowing the how good the food is at the Burg Bar & Grill downtown, I was excited to see if this place was just as good. I pulled into a small plaza and it is right on the end. The parking is somewhat limited. I walked in to find the place quite busy so I decided to take a seat at the bar. I was promptly greeted and was brought drinks. The servers were are very friendly and attentive. I ended up ordering the super Greek omelette.  While waiting for my food, one of the servers explained to me that they are still in their soft opening and trying to work out the kinks. I think they have been open for 2 weeks now. The food took a little longer to come out than expected, but not bad given how small the kitchen was and how busy they were. The omelette was good and on par with most diner type places. I expected a little bit more given how good the food is down at the Burg Bar, but I am sure they will continue to improve.  i also sampled the black eyed pea soup which was quite tasty. Overall, I enjoyed eating there and look forward to trying it again.  The hours are currently breakfast and lunch only, but I was told they plan on extending them into dinner soon.

We've lived in the neighborhood for the last three years and always passed by Bourbon and Branch on our way to Green Eggs Cafe. We decided to avoid the long lines/heat this morning and give it a try.

We arrived right after opening and had our pick of tables. We grabbed a booth by the front and had a nice conversation with the hostess (friendly and welcoming). The menu had a reasonable variety of southern inspired options--we ordered chicken and biscuits, Bubba's Benedict (came with a side of pimento cheese grits), and coffee.

Our server, Marissa, was quick, attentive, and friendly, and the wait time for food was just long enough for us reminisce about our trip to New Orleans. The music and interior definitely reminded us of our time in Louisiana (the thrift store mugs and plates were all mismatched, but gave the restaurant a home-y vibe).

The food was fantastic. The biscuits were flaky and moist, the chicken was well fried and tender. The pimento cheese grits were smooth, flavorful, and unique. The food wasn't greasy or too filling--we left feeling satisfied.

If you're having brunch in the area, we highly recommend skipping some of the other local options with long-lines to try Bourbon and Branch. This might be our new favorite brunch spot, and we'll certainly be back again soon to try dinner and drinks.
Food is really tasty.... I had falafel and baklava. Falafel wraps need more sauce. Baklava for perfect.

I've been eating at Carrabbas four times this week!! Don't call me crazy, but I had this free entree coupon so why not use them? So the four times I ate here, the waiter/waitress were friendly, attentive & were willing to cater us. Whatever we asked for, they gave it to us. So we tipped them big. AND the food were AMAZING!

For the last few year I thought this place, judging solely from the exterior, was just a dilapidated coffee shop or a junky convenience store. Turns out, it's actually an Indonesian restaurant. 

Inside you can see that the owners spared almost no expense in decor or lighting. By that I mean - they spent next to nothing. If you're expecting ambiance, don't. As with most spots like this, the focus is strictly on the food; not so much the quality, but more about that they have some. 

I had the salted fish and rice - it was very good and I would order it again. My wife ordered a soup of some sort and she enjoyed it. We also had an order of spring rolls. Total bill before including tip: $18.

We'll be back.
Fabulous salon spa!  Lois wheeler and staff are a cut above the rest with her classy facilities and full range of options.   Love it !!!

Best Chinese take out in Tampa in my opinion.  The boyfriend urged me to give it 5 stars, but I can't fathom giving any Chinese take out 5 stars. Their hot and sour soup is addicting and I always get the hunan chicken and steamed dumplings and I am always satisfied.  We eat there about 3 times a month, it's our go to. Love it!

Good location, oysters both raw and charred were very good. Service was highly disappointing, my water glass was dirty and our waiter took over 20 minutes to refill a soda. Finally my husband went up to the bar to do this. The bathroom is not very clean. Good people watching if you can get a window seat on Bourbon street, but lots of young hustlers out there looking for your attention and money.

Salad was great. The breadsticks were undercooked. Their counter service was a little wanki..Some of the young woman working here are awesome. Great attitudes, helpful the young man seemed inconvienanced but he was doing five jobs. I think they need a bit better process they got backlogged quickly. Trying but maybe a little help
On Wednesday 6.30pm it was pretty empty. Just another table taken. Miso tasted much better then at Nom Nom Ramen.

This is a really bad establishment overall. We found the restaurant's decor impressive however this restaurant demonstrates really bad waiter service and probably acts of greed. It's a disgrace that this restaurant is serving as a living representation of Taiwanese culture.

First of all, the food is decent enough considering that it is away from the Bay Area, which thusly does not introduces competitive Taiwanese restaurants. If this restaurant were in the Bay Area, the restaurant would be sure to go out of business. At the restaurant, we ordered Stinky Tofu and it was unbelievable when we were given only 8 pieces for 5 dollars. That equals to about roughly 60 cents per piece. That is ridiculous considering the dedication and size of these pieces. Besides from that, we decided that the food is reasonable enough although it was smaller portioned compared to the Bay Area Taiwanese restaurants. 

The waiter service as mentioned previously is horrible. The waiters offered no expression of gratitude for keeping them in employment. In addition, as we left, the waiter offered no thanks and greedily halted his task on hand and searched visually our table for our tips. This is ridiculous. I understand that the all people want money. Or else why work? The problem is that he doesn't mask his temptations and greed of money and plainly expresses it.

The decor in the restaurant is one good aspect of the restaurant. I found the restaurant rather comfortable and the television was conveniently angled so then the customers do not need to turn their necks uncomfortably. I loved the painting of Taipei 101 on the wall as well. The kitchen was opened to us and from what I see, the kitchen looks pretty clean.

The thing that makes me angry at this establishment is the inclination of the waiters to whites opposed to non-whites. The waiter offered better services to our neighboring table of whites however, offered less then decent services to us non-whites. We found this consistent throughout the restaurant. Now, I honestly don't care what the reason of discrimination may be but this is beyond acceptable.

We had a family reunion in Boise and all the ladies made a trip to Two Rivers for massages. I had my first hot stone massage and it was SO AWESOME! I highly recommend it.

The experience was overall very positive. The salon itself is large and very clean, and they can accommodate groups, which was great for my family. I think each of us had a different level of "amazing" with our massages, so it probably depends on who you get. I would go again, and I definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a pampering experience. Also, the prices are super reasonable.

Food is great, services awesome Tina did a great job. Trigger the manager gave us some free appetizers cards!! No complaints food was cooked perfect first time here - will most definitely come back and ask for Tina the waitress!! Thank you:)

Having this place in my neighborhood makes cooking flavorful foods fantastically easy. I am very concerned about the possibility that this colorful, fun and useful spot will be permanently closed. The Market will never be the same. I'm crossing my fingers that the closing is temporary (and over soon).

Just dropped almost 600.00 into my Honda, and Jermey becaome my new best friend.

I would and will be coming back to this Pep Boys to have my struts and shocks done.  Ask for Jermey to help you he did a great job keeping me up to date on what needed to be done, and answered all my "womely" questions.

Dirty inside the restaurant. We ordered carry out and got back to our room, no napkins, plastic ware, or sauces. The food was just so so. Too much ginger in the general tso chicken and the crab Rangoon was lacking in the filling department. Overall, I would not recommend and we will not order again.

This place would be an easy 5-star if it was just rated for beauty of the hotel and grounds. It's absolutely beautiful and relaxing. However, you are pretty much stuck there for meals. The hotel is massive and there just aren't enough facilities for lunch and breakfast. The pool is way too small but they are fixing that soon. It gets old waiting in a one hour line for breakfast and lunch. There are long lines at the convenience stores and just about anywhere you can get food. That being said, we love it and will be back. Great staycation for a weekend.
Nick is awesome! He is terrific at customer service, even when customers are not at their best. Bartenders are friendly and can be a touch inattentive but overall competent. Just ask for Nick.

Quickly becoming my go-to weekend Italian joint! The staff are fantastic and the food is great. I've only had a few things off the menu so I can't speak to it all. The chicken parm can feed a family it's so big. BYO is a bonus! Great for a date night or larger groups.

I always stay at Marriot hotels because they have a good rewards program and I always know I have a nice, clean room to stay in. Towneplace Suites are my second favorite Marriott brand...was just a little disappointed having to wait quite a few minutes-bleary eyed after a long drive, for the front desk staff early in the morning.

Just sat down for our millionth meal at Barrelhouse to find that they have CHANGED THE MENU! Bad choice Barrelhouse! Don't mess with perfection. Took away both my and my husband's favorite meals and also overheard the booth next to us complaining. Hear the people and bring back the goodness! Four stars because we love you, but tonight you earned negative stars. :(

I had he mozzarella-stuffed chicken, the angel hair pasta and the margarita pizza (I polished off my kids meals after mine).  All were very good.  Good food.  Plain atmosphere, but nice, comfortable.  Very friendly staff.  

The gelato desserts were awesome.  Get the salted caramel -- very good.  And lots of restaurants have great food, rich desserts and them come up teeny with weak coffee.  The best cap for a god meal was a nice, hearty cup of coffee. 

I was with a group of 10, and all of us enjoyed our meals.  I recommend the place.

Wait was forever.the waitress was even slower.omg!!flavor was good but overall very salty.pretty good portion and very slow service.we waited 20 minutes to be able to get a table and 20 minutes on a simple appitizer and waited almost 50 minutes to get our meal.went in before 7 and got out around 930.go figure.

I live nearby and I stopped in around 10:00am on a Friday to take a look around and see if I could make an appointment, and they scheduled me for 11:45. Very friendly staff, particularly Wendy who took me around the store before my exam and helped me pick out frames (she was VERY patient as I tried on a bunch). The doctor is also extremely friendly. Great overall service and a beautiful store with lots of light, the set up is very inviting. At 3:30pm that same day they called to tell me my glasses were ready to be picked up, even though they said up to 2 weeks! I highly recommend Trend Eye Care, which takes walk-ins and appointments.

When I heard they had some Bulgogi tacos cooking up and they were rolling on in to my foodie stomping grounds I was all in. ALL IN. (what does that mean?)

Bulgogi is one of my serious food favs. Served in tacos, served on rice, served just as is.... I will eat it. Ka'Chi serves it up on three small corn tortilla tacos shells and offers a variety of sauces for every pallette. I chose the Gochujang which is a hot pepper paste sauce because I always want to take my food up a spice or two!

The tacos were full of flavor combining salty and sweet in a perfect combination. The meat was tender and plentiful. These tacos served with some chopped cilantro, lime wedges and a cool slaw were just perfect!

We waited an hour and a half to eat at this restaurant for a party of 3. We sat at the bar where they offered 2 for 1 drinks. 2 drinks for the price of 1!! What could be better? Towards the end of our hour and a half wait we began to get to hungry so we ordered some fries. They were very yummy!! Since eating the fries, by the time we got our table and ordered a meal, I wasn't very hungry. So I didn't  eat much of the omelette I ordered. So I don't have much feedback for that.

This place was great. I brought my Porsche Cayenne in on a Saturday morning, after making an appointment. He told me 2 hrs and he was finished in a shorter amount of time.  I wasn't suppose to roll down my window for 24 hrs after the application but I accidentally did but it didn't hurt my window. The owner was attentive, courteous, polite and clean.  The waiting room was clean and there's a sofa and tv available.  I am planning to bring in my husband's car soon.

The cake was not pretty when it was delivered...The chocolate shavings all shifted to one side so it was really ugly on the other side...The cake also didn't have a cardboard-holder thingy at the bottom..so my friend had to blow the candle with the cake in the box since we couldn't take out the cake to hold easily. The chocolate plate with writing on it costed an extra $4 and broke before I even got to my friend's place. I did not shake the box. Overall, it just wasn't what I had in mine.

The menu is not really all that selective but they have some creative things on the menu and they're really not kid-friendly as far as the menu. No crayons or menus for kids. That really doesn't matter because my kids also eat from the adult menu. There's no booth seating. The restaurant is very clean. They definitely keep the coffee filled. Biscuits and gravy was kind of bland. I had to hamburger patty and eggs. Hamburger patty was very very good eggs good also. Definitely have some very good servers and waitresses. they made sure the coffee stayed filled they made sure I kept water and they came and checked on me every couple of minutes. definitely will come back to try lunch. One more thing , they only have land of lakes butter spread they don't have margarine.
This is such a great neighborhood spot to listen to wonderful live music, great adult atmosphere, good food and drinks! This will be one of my favorite hangout spots on the weekends!!

This was my first time to try Bagger Daves.  The service was good but they weren't busy on Sunday night. After the waitress read our order back to us, two of the three burgers we ordered were made wrong and we had to wait on them to make them correctly. The food was good especially the homemade soda.  But it will be a while before we come back in order to give Bagger Daves time to get their act together.
Quite good! Lives up to the hype, at least the black and tan does. Good service!

Simply a fantastic experience! The brewery is awesome and the beers are great as well as the food! Melody was my server and I'll tell you she was awesome! She let me sample a few beers, gave me good info about the brewery and was very welcoming knowing I was from out of town! Great job all around guys, keep it up and I will be back every time I come through St. Louis!
Great pizza! Be sure to call ahead, they make and bake fresh so it takes a while. Well worth the wait!

I get taken care of here! Dr. Aric is awesome! Gets me in last minute if necessary, and always runs on time. He makes you feel comfortable. I always feel so much better once I leave! Is highly recommend giving him a try! ;) very friendly staff as well!

We had a lovely time here for my boyfriend's birthday! The food was excellent and the ice cream they brought to him for his birthday was delicious. This location is still getting dialed in as it's pretty new, but no doubt that it'll continue to improve. It has been very busy every time we've gone in for HH and dinner, but we were still seated immediately.

I've been coming to this restaurant for over 5 years because the experience has been great. Unfortunately, when I was there over the weekend for brunch with a party of 8, my experience would probably be my last. We had a very rude server. He was inflexible and arrogant. We  are mostly all vegetarian with one being gluten-free, I purposely selected Blue Sage since I felt their menu and selection really worked for us. 

The person in our party that has severe reactions to dairy requested no hollandaise sauce on her eggs benedict and the response was "So, you want dry eggs?" . He would also not allow ketchup with an entree because he felt it would "not be good", in his words. He did not actually focus on what we wanted as guests of the restaurant, he seemed more interested in voicing his own opinions. As for the food, it was good, albeit too much, as you HAVE to order and 2 course prix fix meals. It's so much food and most of the first courses could be dessert as they included caramel toppings and loads of sugar.
I was only in town for a short time and couldn't get to Decatur, so glad this was right near where I was staying. I got my fix without having to go to Decatur, although that place is awesome!

I simply love Body Cycle Studio.  My body may not agree (especially at 8:30am) but I figure it'll appreciate my efforts when it's toned and fit.

The instructors are all friendly and supportive.  If you're really looking for a sweaty workout, try Shoshanna's (if you can reserve a spot... she's very popular!). She's full of energy and always has a playlist I'm dying to steal.  Even amateurs can jump right in since the workouts can be adapted to any level.

The owner, Russell Carter, is amazing and should win an award for customer service.  When he's teaching a class, you know he's working out just as hard as you are!  He's also constantly stopping by to make sure that everyone's bikes are properly adjusted.  He genuinely seems to care about everyone's welfare and pushes you hard but never beyond your own limits. 

First class is free so there's no excuse not to get off your butt and get on a bike!

The pizza is good. I'd give more than three stars but the pizza is WAY overpriced. Ive ordered takeout twice. Both times the pizza was good. Their pricing makes me assume they will go out of business eventually. Don't get me wrong, I like their pizza, but there's equally good pizza for less money out there. I hate to see a locally owned and operated pizza place go under because of pricing. I've seen it happen in downtown Saint Pete couple times...don't know why it has to happen here in Dunedin.
In Santa Barbara? This was the place to chill and relax for some refreshments and snacks. Nice little get away from the beach.

Visiting New Orleans we wanted to find a place for a nice dinner and while Ralph's was okay, it wasn't as excellent as other place we had been during our visit. The ambience was nice and the service was very attentive. A few of our dishes were outstanding (especially from the Oktoberfest menu) but most were just okay, so a bit disappointing. If visiting again, I think we would go elsewhere.

This is some of the best pizza I've had in a long time. The crust is crispy and fluffy, the sauces are all perfectly balanced, the pizza is made well and quickly, and the staff is extremely courteous. For the price this is some fantastic quality. I like that thy carry Woodchuck Cider, as that's definitely my favorite. The salad is satisfyingly fresh and the bottled beer selection is limited but accommodating. I came here opening day (yesterday) and as expected, I'm back again today. I wouldn't be the least bit surprised if I came back tomorrow. So glad to have real good pizza in my neighborhood. Uncle Maddio's is some of the best food I've had in a while and if I could give it 6 stars I would.

Ok, we clearly have some problems... we tried this place yesterday, lost our minds over how good it was, then drove back from Roxborough the next day. No joke, this place is heaven. Everything is so good and portions are huge. Well worth every dime. We live in VA now, but have family here, so we will make this a regular stop along with our other favorite restaurants. For now, we've got our to-go containers ready for indulging when we get to our bed at home lol. Oh man, we're so fat.
Hands down the best snowballs in this city. I have been to every place in the city and Pandora's is the BEST!!!!

I came here on Wednesday for the "half-off burgers" special (burgers are half price from 11:30am-5pm), since it's pretty popular on Penn's campus. The service was extremely slow, and it took us around 10 mins to get seated even though we were in the front of the line, and the place wasn't full. The hostess then didn't bring us menus, so I had to go ask for them.

We ordered burgers -- I ordered the turkey San Remo, and my friend, a chicken sandwich. Mine was satisfactory, a little on the bland side, but I could have added some hot sauce. A good deal for 3.50 though.

However, when the bill came, my friend's "chicken sandwich" (that was really a burger), was not half-price. The waitress told us that because it was a "sandwich" and not a burger, it wasn't half price. All of the "sandwiches" are in the burger section in the menu, and there's no indication that the special doesn't apply to them. The waitress told us that this was the way it was, and didn't make any effort to tell us that it was fine this time, which is common etiquette. It was 3 bucks, so I didn't make a fuss, but it was still annoying - obviously she would have ordered a "burger" if we had known there was even a difference.
Peno was an exquisite environment. We enjoyed the spinach arugula salad with the chicken/turkey meatballs and Ragu pasta. Highly recommend this Sicilian Italian Soul Food Restaurant.
Great place! Good, solid Italian food at a great price. BYOB keeps the prices down. Always busy make a reservation!!

the pre-made pizzas never look quite appetizing enough to try. 
a made-to-order calzone took forEVER and was not cheap, but it was indeed tasty.  
service is gruff, but i don't really care so long as my calzone is good.
This is a new restaurant, but food here is really nice! Especially the hibachi beef~ and the service is quite good there' feel happy and enjoyable. Really good one to go!

After our steamboat jazz cruise, we dropped by Desire for a late lunch. We had charbroiled oysters on half shells, jambalaya and shrimp etoufee. All the foods are delicious, we even had the chocolate cake for dessert. Again we accepted the fact that cajun/creole foods are salty, but the seafood is very fresh and good eats. This spot was recommended by a local whom we met at another restaurant.

I was not sure what to expect from a restaurant in a plaza but as soon as you walk in you forget you are in Brandon. It is so beautifully decorated and the music is wonderful. The food came quickly, it was delicious and we got free soup and spring rolls with our lunch. We ordered two meals and our total was under $20. The service was great as well; never had to ask for a refill or anything. Can't wait to eat the leftovers and go again to try other dishes.

I like this place. Very relaxed, with friendly and helpful bartenders. Good selection of local beers and we love the fact they use different local food trucks to handle not having a kitchen--gives plenty of chances to try different ones! Cool setting, too. You're basically right there in the brewery, beer-making smells and all. (Of which there are plenty.) It's about the experience, and the experience is a good one! Great beer, good atmosphere!

Phenomenal.  Fantastic authentic Italian food in an Irish bar.  Had the stuffed eggplant, which was very good.  My wife had the best lobster ravioli I have ever tasted and my daughters gnocchi was too die for.  The dessert knocked it out of the park.  This place is a must!

Amazing food, great service!  Just passing through town on Memorial Day and stopped here because my husband wanted baked beans. We ordered way too much food and everything was absolutely delicious. Never had such good bar food before. If we're ever back in Trenton, we will be stopping in to eat again!

Everything here is quite overpriced, disorganized and generally crappy. The people who worked here were rude when I asked them simple questions about a postcard. And god forbid you ask for a bargain they blow up and act like its the worst thing ever. Not coming here again.

Whenever my mother stops into Philadelphia to pay me a visit she chooses to stay here. For a lady from a small town in Connecticut she feels pretty safe having a hotel that is located in a pretty central part of the city. That's about the only positive thing I have to say about this place, that it has a great location.

Once upon a time I stayed at this hotel with my mother and a friend. We decided to take advantage of the pool, I mean, I never get the chance to swim. We took our keys and made our way up to the floor with the pool, and used the facilities on that floor to change into our suits. I swam until my skin looked all raisin like and then decided it was time to go. I walked out of the pool and was questioned about what I was doing in the hotel. Apparently I didn't look like their 'typical' guest. I guess their 'typical' guest doesn't have 1 or 2 small tattoos.

I went back to my room and explained the incident to my mother. We then quickly went to the front desk and I explained to the receptionist what had happened. She apologized and offered me a few cookies. Really?! Is a cookie supposed to make it better?

I was also told that I resemble a UArts student, and they are known for sneaking into the pool. I guess it's kind of a compliment that I look like I go to art school, but again, Really?!

I sent a letter to their corporate and they sent me one free night at any of their hotels. Thanks, guys, because you know I or my family would never stay in one of your hotels again.

Amazing facial with Trudy!!! She is the sweetest, and very experienced and professional. She's also a trained masseuse so she really knows how to make a facial relaxing! She used products that suited my skin type and took care to ask my about my skin concerns. I wish I lived closer, I would go to her all the time!!
We had our rehearsal dinner here. If you are looking for a group setting, please choose this place. Everything was outstanding, no issues. You will not be disappointed.

My friends and I were visiting Nola for the first time and decided to yelp a restaurant close by to our hotel. This place had pretty good ratings so we decided to give it a try. We were on a laid back vacation, we were all dressed quite casual. This may or may not have been the reasoning behind our effortless service. We could tell we were being judged as a group of young kids pretending to be grown ups. Where was the southern hospitality? Not found here, at our table at least. 

I ordered the shrimp and grits, which was said to be a favorite, and I was extremely disappointed. It was SO salty, I was only able to take a few bites and had to stop eating. I really regret not sending it back but the service made me feel uncomfortable. So I basically paid $26 for a couple bites of sodium enhanced grits. Taste aside, the portion was also saddening. You get a little scoop of grits covered in too much sauce. While taking our orders, the waiter asked us if we wanted soup or salad. Where I'm from, this signifies that it comes with the order. But not here. So each of us ordered a side and got charged $5 for it without even meaning to. 

Almost everyone else at my table had ordered a burger, which they seemed to enjoy very much. It came with fries which also seemed to have endured a heavy hand on the salt. Their large burgers with fries were much cheaper than my tiny plate of shrimp and grits. 

So to round it all up, my personal experience consisted of bad service and unsatisfying food. The atmosphere was nice though. I'm sure the other costumers who dressed a little nicer and knew what to order had a better time than I did.

I love this place! Ice cream is arguably my favorite food, so as long as a store offers great service and a variety of flavors, I am happy & Goody's did not disappoint. This place was recommended to me by several coworkers and I have been twice now. The 1950's ice cream parlor feel is awesome & it takes you back in time. I have loved the ice cream & will definitely be back soon!
By far the best dinner we had while in New Orleans. Great dessert and pleasant service

The stir-fry is really good, but both times I have been they've given me the wrong order or messed something up. The smoothies are just ok, some fruit that is added to it is canned. Would probably go back, hopefully the service gets better cause this could be a great place in bala cynwyd.

The experience was a huge disappointment. I hate cold food and bad service. I experienced both here today. Our food was cold, that wouldn't be a problem except it took 30 mins + for two burgers and a child's grilled cheese. My wife's bun was wet (liked dipped in water wet) and the burgers were below average.  I could have even forgiven this if the restaurant was packed. But there were only 4 tables taken in the entire building when we were eating. 

Next was the service or lack of service.  We had to find and carry our own high chair to the booth, seat ourselves and ask for straws and silverware. This service would have been bad for a self service burger joint like Flaky Jakes. I had to ask for my check, which took a long time and when I looked at the bill total, I would have been better off feeding my whole family at Steak N' Shake for $15 less.  I'm shocked that a new restaurant would have servers of this quality when I'm sure they are trying to break in market. These ladies were border line LD. They looked so and acted like they were surprised to be working and shocked that customers were walking into the door. 

This will be the first and last time eating here. Noting worse than a below average burger from a "burger joint".

This is hands-down the best Spa/Wellness center  in terms of quality of service and customer service. I went to Marina for a facial and skin assessment... I highly recommend her. Not only is she knowledgeable, but she is sweet and accommodating. I am excited to have found a home for my pampering.

The main course was actually very tasty and the starters that we got were not bad.  My big issues were that the dessert was meh, and the service was indifferent at best.  The waiter never came to check on us when we got our meal, never noticed that one of the starters we ordered from him never arrived, and while we waited forever for the food and dessert to arrive, he never came over to check on us or give us a status update. However, all of that could have been forgiven if when ask, what the "bread pudding cheesecake" dessert was all about, he hadn't said, "I have no idea" and left it at that.  Not, I'll go check, or let me see, just "you've got me."  Also, for those of you who want to dine here, skip the bread pudding cheesecake, it's very disappointing...bread pudding on Maraschino cherries with cream cheese drizzle on top, talk about a confused dessert.

Terra did an amazing job on the flowers for our wedding.  During our first meeting she brought samples based on what we had discussed during our first phone call and everything was so creative and beautiful while still pulling in the themes I had asked for.  Most importantly she created a bouquet for me which was so personal and significant and incorporated items from my family in memory of those who could not be there - with added touches of her own that were just so beautiful.  All of my friends and family commented on how different and beautiful the florals were.  I can't recommend Terra enough for your events.

I am not known for my meat-eating abilities. Pampa nearly killed me. I don't like bacon (seriously, I know - please keep reading, I promise I will redeem myself one day). I am more of a starchy, carby kind of person. When it comes to most meats, I'm sort of... .indifferent. Sometimes I even willingly choose to eat tofu. But whenever someone suggests to go eat at Sloppy Hoggs, I'm all for it. In fact, I'm the one driving. And cheering as I drive.

I was initially very wary of going for BBQ due to all of the above. But going into Sloppy Hoggs, I got a great first impression. The restaurant is clean, very minimal and laid out nicely. It is a rather small space (and at times it can be near impossible to get a table) but the smell of meat emanating through the restaurant is amazing (AND doesn't cloak you in meat cologne stench).

My significant other is the polar opposite of me - huge meat eater, lover of bacon, barbequed anything, red meat monster. I went because of him and watched him consume a huge platter of pulled pork. I was a little daunted but I ordered The Cure, which I had to admit I thoroughly enjoyed. Fried egg, amazing waffles, pulled pork, bacon (which I even ate!), some sort of sweet sauce, flavor, flavor, more flavor and sweet potato fries. So good.

So we went again. And then I tried the pulled pork. Then we went again and I had the chicken. And the cornbread. And honestly, it has never disappointed me, other than the days when they literally couldn't give us a table due to multiple reservations and lack of seating (and this has happened several times). But that blip aside, we keep coming back. It's just that good. For a bacon-fanatic, meat lovin place, I, the meat-indifferent, love it all the same. Bravo, Sloppy Hoggs, bravo.

I can't believe I've waited this long to write a review about Marrakesh. 

Go to this restaurant for a 7 course meal, for about $40 pp. On the weekends they have belly dancers walking around. Also, you can bring a nice big bottle of wine because you'll probably be there for a good hour and a half. 

The oasis carrot salad that comes in the first course is amazing. I tracked down the recipe (Bon Apetit) and make it weekly for myself. For the meat course I always get the chicken with lemon and olives. I don't know how they make that chicken but it is ridiculously moist. Also, I looked up the recipe for the B'stella pie but I haven't ventured to try and make that yet. 

This is a great place to come for a date, or even with a large group. They have a bunch of little intimate seating areas that are perfect for any occasion. Also, you will eat with your hands so it might not be ideal for germaphobes.

Amazing crepes!! Very thin so I wasn't expecting it to be filling but it was! The atmosphere is very casual, more like a coffee shop than a restaurant. You can see people studying on the bottom floor. I would recommend this place to everyone!!
I just order 5 meals 1 of which was never even entered. So I never got it. But the 4 orders I did receive every single one was incorrect. Pretty disappointed.

Where do I start? This restaurant is amazing the staff, their service and the food and drinks they serve are top notch! After 6 days in New Orleans this was hands down my favorite place we ate in. We went back because it was so wonderful. 

The staff.... A friendly group that truly show southern hospitality. On our first visit we sat at the bar where our bartender Brandi, made some fabulous cocktails and even gave us tea to go since it was so hot and she knew we had walked.  The oyster snickers Jamaal and Derick were so fun to visit with the told us places to go get their favorite po' boys. The found us huge delicious plump oysters while shucking and getting us laughing. What a wonderful experience.

Now for the food.....OH MY GOSH, absolutely fabulous. We wanted to lick our plates. I will start with one of my friends dish, it was a simple ham eggs and grits plate. My friend said she didn't like grits but Jamaal said she would like these, he was right she loved the creamy grits and the eggs were cooked to perfection. Another friend had the eggs in a jar, grits with a poached egg and shrimp wonderful presentation and even better flavors deep in the mason jar. My other friend had their matzo ball soup (best we have ever had even in a Jewish Deli) and the frogs legs, crispy and delicious. Even our picky eating friend loved the frog legs. Now for my dish..... I am still dreaming of those flavors. I had the shrimp and grits. Roasted jalapeño cheese grits topped with andouille sausage grave packed with sausage then topped with jumbo shrimp. I wanted to lick the plate clean it was the most wonderful dish eaten in New Orleans.

We wen back again for happy hour, don't miss it! The oysters were amazing we had them raw and fried. Again the cocktails were wonderful, best mint julep in New Orleans. I felt like I was sitting on the porch of Tara

If you are in New Orleans do not miss the opportunity to try this amazing place! I personally can't wait for my next visit to go back!

We had dinner here tonight and it was fantastic. I had the fish special of the day, it was a red fish lightly pan fried, with creamy polenta and fresh vegetables with a wine reduction- delicious!! My boyfriend had the pork chop- two long bone chops with polenta and vegetables, very juicy and full of flavor! The service was excellent, our waitress was very nice and attentive. The ambiance of the place is also very romantic.

Excellent evening out! We had our corporate dinner here this evening, we can't thank the wait staff and the rest of the Carmine's family in making our dinner an evening to remember.

Angela and Kent were our servers and they are what servers should strive to be and we thank them for their superior service.

Food was cooked to perfection, steaks were as requested and the mushroom risotto was on point! A highlight of the evening for sure was the food, but the atmosphere and friendliness of staff was by far the gem in our visit.

 We ended the evening with some dessert, the tuxedo cake was light and rich the way it's suppose to be and of course we couldn't finish it all but you can believe you can get too much of a good thing.

 Upon leaving we personally thanked everyone the helped make our night so wonderful and as expected they were humble and gracious. We'll be back to enjoy again and are sure our experience will be just as good next time. You have earned our patronage Carmine's Steak House, thank you.
Amazing value. Great potatoes. The spinach benny is to die for.

Eh. Nothing to call home about. No, wait. There was this small thing... At 8 am this morning they only had one pancake left. Seriously? An establishment that serves breakfast and lunch should really stock up on pancake mix. The food was okay, I landed on French toast, but I'd much rather stick with Dixie Picnic down the street for a less expensive and seriously delicious breakfast or even Nudy's if I want something comparable in price and decor.

Wednesday - August 14, 2013 - 1:30 PM

5 stars - Service, chicken salad sandwich, cold gazpacho soup, coffee, and chips.

0 stars - I was forced to share a table designed for four people.  The two occupants welcomed me but I was very uncomfortable.  Fortunately, a patron at a different table left.  I quickly occupied the table. 

Aside: I understand the present economic challenges.  I understand the advantages of using a public facility to minimize costs and maximizing resources.  The primary goal is providing a pleasant eating experience with an optional cyber experience befitting a traditional respite.  Unabated business activities compromise those, like me, who wish only to find an unoccupied table to enjoy a meal.  I'm sure management is cognizant of this practice and must display sensitivity.  It's clear however, management has no intention of disrupting status quo.

So many choices of alcohol, its crazy!!

We stopped here on our way back to Toronto on a mission to find Florida Man IPA by Cigar City Brewing (sadly the brewery itself was out when we stopped).

Alas, we were not successful but will make a point to check out this chain again when visiting the States. Their craft beer selection was really amazing.

I have eaten in the restaurant twice and thought the food was good but fair service. I recently placed an order for an event and was notified by email less than 24 hours before that this could not take place with no apology or offer to make up for this inconvenience. As a full time working mom this totally screwed me for a work event I had planned for and ended up using Whole Foods who came to the rescue. I also contacted crumb de la crumb about a Birthday cake with no return response. So, in a nutshell, I would recommend trying the food by dining in, but do not hold your breath on catering or friendliness of staff.

First time - not planned, but needed food, so randomly selected this place. What a good choice! Excellent service and fantastic food. Shared the sampler plate for two people and left stuffed and happy. Couldn't be more pleased and we'll plan to return.

Everything here is amazing.  The vegan chocolate milk shake is soooo good and pretty much every sandwich I have had here was awesome.  Too bad it is so tiny.  Never enough room in the seating area and the chairs are so uncomfortable.  But I always sit in Rittenhouse when I eat here so it's fine.

Great atmosphere and love the decor. Stopped in with friends for a quick drink early evening. Not expecting $13 for a drink. With tax and tip, $20 is hefty drink pricing.  A bit over the top in my opinion. The waiter was rather snooty which made me chuckle. It's in a sketchy area that thinks very highly of its self. Hipster food choices. Not the run of the mill bar food. I highly doubt I would go out of my way to go back
The pizza is very good for a bar type establishment. The service was decent and they were fairly quick. Lots of tv's with different programming to watch. Also had very good beer promotions.

This was amazing. Super intimate show with some fabulous jazz musicians, just jamming for you. Light easy-going banter, real passion at what they do. Line up 30mins-1hour before the show if you want a seat. Grab drinks wherever, they don't serve any here. It's in this amazing old building and you can just FEEL the history.

Definitely a must if you're visiting NOLA.
Just great food !! Glad I came to try it.. Very clean as well compared to other middle eastern food in the area

At first I liked it a lot. Now I go there and have to wait way too long for just coffee and a muffin early in the morning. Only one person waiting on you doing everything. So you wait why she rings them up and then get their things ready. After waiting in line it was 4 minutes after 10 and she said I could not get breakfast even though I was there waiting my turn. Not very friendly and customer service not good.
Staff is so knowledgeable, I always go to the pharmacy section knowing that someone would be able to give me a professional detailed advice on anything I point my finger at. Thank you!

When we got there, everyone was friendly and courteous. The check-in was quick and simple. The check-out was even easier with no surprises!  We were going to just carry our bag up ourselves since we didn't have many.  Since the bellman wasn't available that second, one of the other guys offered to do it. Every parking attendant we were helped by was friendly and efficient. Parking for ONE NIGHT was $41!  That is OUTRAGEOUS, but I don't hold it against the Hotel because that's the going rate in that area... just pissy about it.

Extremely poor service, and the calzone we ordered was cold and uncooked in the middle, and the crust was both doughy and soggy. The place was so cold we had to keep our coats on the entire time we were there. These folks don't know how to make pizza.

This is a really big store with plenty of variety. Their prices are the most affordable of all the Asian markets and stores that I have shopped at. I like going to this store since they offer fresh veggies and frozen goods. This is the place to go especially when you live in central or east Tucson.

This review is long overdue.  Went here for drinks to celebrate a friend's birthday and couldn't have had a better experience.  The beer was quality, but it was the staff that made this night perfect.  They treated us like regulars even though it was our first time.  Thanks!!

What a gem. The friendliest staff that I have ever interacted with and great food. Everyone was so helpful and nice. Even the atmosphere was cool, with unique art on every wall. I got the spinach omelette with tomatoes, onion and feta and roasted potatoes. Perfect portion and everything was hot and well seasoned. My boyfriend got a breakfast bowl with scrambled eggs over diced ham and the potatoes and loved it.

I am really glad that we have this type of ice cream shop in the Tampa area. What I love most about rolled ice cream shops like this is watching them make your ice cream! I got a cookies and cream ice cream with mochi, whipped cream, and chocolate pocky sticks. It was so good! The serving was pretty big for me, so I would definitely share it with someone next time. The cashier was really friendly. It took about 10 minutes to get the ice cream. The atmosphere is super casual. The only downside that I found was that there weren't enough seats/tables to accommodate all the customers. I think I went at a pretty good time on a Saturday afternoon because I was able to beat the long line of customers that came in after me. I would definitely come back again to try their other flavors!
Had a good time there. Great food and awesome service. The waiter's name was Cassidy. They made sure that the drinks were full.I would recommend the Mongolian beef or sweet and sour chicken

My husband and I ate here one night after driving by and it caught my eye! I grew up where Italian food was as authentic as it can be besides being in Italy!

I really enjoyed my food I love carbonara and was excited to see that I could get my fix with gnocchi which really pleased me!

The pasta was very very good the only real downside to this restaurant is the service I hate to use the word terrible but it doesn't take 15 minuets to get a glass of coke or a glass of wine. 

We had to ask our waitress if we would be able to have some bread before our meal arrived which took just as long if not longer than the drinks!

I would say if you don't mind a wait and not the greatest service but love a good pasta check it out!

Mixed feelings about this hospital.  On the one hand, they are experts and it is the place to go for state of the art veterinary diagnosis/treatment. We are lucky to have them in Philadelphia.   But just like the top hospitals for humans, they seem to forget that these beings are our loved ones/family members.  Be prepared to say no to more and more diagnostic tests, and to advocate for your pet's best interest.  They are definitely advancing veterinary science and learning from your animal's illness, and they don't have the same motivations you do  for your animal's best interest and dignity.  Go in prepared to make tough decisions because they will try every means possible to prolong life, even if it isn't the best choice.  Also expect that it is costly, but IMO that is part of the responsibility of being a  good pet owner.

Had yellowtail and salmon maki sushi. The rolls were tasty, and decently sized, but the fish ratio was dwarfed by the cucumber ratio. Also, you only get 6 pieces of sushi per roll. Can we say, lame? Overall the place was a ripoff as most sushi places in Philly seem to be. I won't return. 

Food Quality/Taste =  4 Stars
Portion Size Given Price = 2 Stars
Price = 2 Stars
Service = 3 Stars
Experience with Staff = 3 Stars
Decor = 3 Stars

I ordered the chicken tacos and carnitas tacos with a cheese pupusa. The food was delicious and full of flavor! The chicken tacos were my favorite! Priced very well. It also has TV where you can watch games as well.

I walked here for lunch the other day after months of walking by and being curious.  I ordered the wonton soup and some egg rolls.  I love wonton soup, I have grown up loving it.  I can not stress enough or be clear enough on how horrible this soup was.  It was literally hot water with a ton of beef flavoring, some spinach, and a few undercooked wontons in it.  Hands down one of the worst things I have ever put in my mouth.  Ever.  I took two mouthfuls of it, the second one only to make sure I hadn't just paid 12 dollars for beef water, and threw it out.  What an incredibly disgusting waste of money.  The egg rolls were good, and I would buy them again, but the soup was horrifying.

We are hotel snobs. We expect service and of course cleanliness. We were greeted by a wonderful, friendly person at check in, offering warm, fresh baked chocolate chip cookie. Told us about all amenities hotel offered, to include free shuttle that took us to our restaurant. Lobby was impressive, beautiful marble flooring, nice bar & restaurant, not far from check-in. Nice place to lounge and have cocktail  Very convenient under ground parking. Highly recommend this hotel. Less than 1/2 price Hotel DuPont a few blocks away. Oh. not to mention, the room was awesome. Our reason for staying, attended Michael Bolton concert at Grand Opera House, a short 2 1/2 block walk. Great experience.

My boyfriend and I came here for my birthday dinner and we both loved it!  I am a vegetarian and my boyfriend chose it specifically because there are some great vegetarian options.

When we arrived, we were seated right away.  Our waitress was very nice and attentive and I liked the clean, modern decor.  I ordered the goat cheese salad for an appetizer and my boyfriend got the caesar salad.  I absolutely LOVED my salad; it was delicious.  I love salads with dried fruit, nuts, and goat cheese and this salad did not disappoint.  My boyfriend also really enjoyed his caesar salad.  We also received warm rolls with our salads that were served with a garlicy butter that was very good.

I ordered the tofu steak for my entree and I really enjoyed it.  It came with rice and vegetables and a good soy-sauce type of sauce.  I liked that it was light and tasty and the vegetables seemed very fresh.  My boyfriend ordered the filet and he absolutely DEVOURED it.  It came with steamed spinach and a blue cheese potato au gratin that was to die for.  My boyfriend can be very picky about his meat and always ends up cutting away fatty pieces, but this was the one time he ate absolutely every bite.  He is STILL talking about that filet!  He called it the "steak of the year"!

All in all, we really enjoyed our meal here and I would absolutely recommend it.

This is our first review on Yelp. We came here to Moto with high expectations. This is not to say that we were completely disappointed with the experience, but rather that a few qualms has marred our memory of our time at Moto. 

Service was not up to par with our other restaurants not only of similar Calibre but budget chains. The waiter took at least 5 minutes to first greet us and another 10 to bring us water. Needless to say, complementary bread took another 10 minutes requiring a reminder to the waiter. 

As for the food itself, the black spaghetti only had 3 pieces of lobster and had a strong tomato-y taste, resenblig Ragu. However, the Cacie a pepe was an excellent and wholesome pasta which packed flavor into every bite. 

The tiramisu was not unlike what you would find in the expiring dairy section of Kroger. Dry lady fingers without the essence of coffee left our mouths dry and wanting.

These people are a first class operation. Even the restrooms are spotlessly clean & air conditioned. You can really tell they take pride in their work. 

The only complaint would be that the check in" process could be more efficient. Office full of people, but only 2 lines..maybe open up all 3 registers when the line is out the door. Maybe designate a line for "prepaid" customers.. they don't even need a register for that, just a clipboard & some wrist bands. 
Other than that,  Pay-extra, Take the small Boat tour. 
Pray that Sonny is 
your Boat Captain..you will have the time of your life!

This is our family's default go-to store for shopping, and not just because it happens to be the closest to us.  Always clean, always friendly, and when they take the cart our to your car, the won't even let you tip.

Safeway has a bad rep for being expensive, but we don't find that that's the case.  If you get a club card, they tend to have really good deals on a lot of the items we buy regularly.

Produce is usually good, but a couple of times has been a bit off.    Bakery is great; it's handled a couple of our special-order cakes without a problem.

The store never seems to be all that busy, but then, we usually go at off hours like on weekdays or late on weeknights.

It is hard to believe that this place is so constantly packed, given its mediocre reviews.  I must confess that it's been over three years since I've been to Plate but I will also say that I gave it several "second chances."  I do recall the drinks and desserts being good, as well as the bread.  Otherwise very so-so food, odd decor (what is with the faux distressed tables?), so-so service.  I laugh when I drive by.  

Please restaurateurs - we are dying for decent restaurants out here on the Main Line.  Please help!

------
Revisited recently.  Same mediocre experience.  Had the salmon salad and seriously, it tasted EXACTLY like Panera's salmon salad.  Now Panera's salad isn't bad but it's also a tiny fraction of the price of this one.

Every dish of the six we ordered were absolutely delicious! Our sever Jenna was kind, helpful, and called a taxi for us while we finished our sake. Definitely a fantastic place to have a Devine sushi fusion experience. Delectable !

My experience could not have been any more different than XJ G's.  Both Joe Greco and the F&I guy with whom I dealt were honest, pleasant, and professional.  They are both people whom I would refer friends to see if/when interested in buying a new or used Toyota.
A good beer and great mac-n-cheese, not a bad combination.

So I wanted to do an update on this review because I was absolutely amazed at being contacted immediately after! The director Dave called and we chatted about how things went, he was very nice to talk to and extremely helpful in handling the situation with empathy and consideration. He made me feel like we mattered as a long time customer and immediately resolved the issue! We have always gone to the Peppermill and we will remain loyal local customers. Any business that takes care of there customers and so quickly deserves continued support in which we will always do!

We were  really looking forward to having a relaxing spa day at the peppermill. We always go there and stay there and decided it would be relaxing to do the spa, omg we were wrong! The treatments and staff they were great! The spa pool area was horribly unrelaxing! We stood for an hour waiting for just a place to sit nobody bothered to ask if we needed anything! Finally we got a table and needed chairs since they were all gone. After 20 min found someone and asked he did help with that but by then we were already fed up it was like a party frat area loud and not what we expected! When you go somewhere like that you want it to be a great experience and it was not! We both made the comment of this is suppost to be relaxing??? Then we decided to go to the 3 rd floor for some peace and quiet we found a quiet room to relax it was good for 15 min then a whole group came in and was talking and there that went we then left and checked out! For spending almost 300 bucks for a non relaxing time we should have gone elsewhere!

Unbelievably beautiful and a great experience! 
My wife and I walked by many times as it was being constructed and were curious what it would be. When we learned it was going to be a Lebanese / Middle Eastern restaurant we were beyond excited. 
We had high expectations for this place. 

When we walked in for the first time, you can't help but be struck by the precision of decor. Beautiful tiling, authentic shapes and colors fill the walls and even the booths have tapestry-like patterns. 

Then, the food. Their hummus is excellent. The freshly made pita is even better. I love the falafel sandwich. With recently introducing dinner service, we went the week it opened and had yet another great experience. There isn't anything bad on the menu. 

If you like middle eastern food, a beautiful ambience and friendly waitstaff, then you should go here!

Severely understaffed, nearly an hour for 2 sushi rolls, and an unapologetic, eye-rolling, only 10% off giving female manager that couldn't concede the lack of staff and lack of professionalism. Plus, manager lady had to be hostess, bartender, and food runner; if that doesn't tell you that the place is mismanaged then I don't know what does. The only kudos I can give is that the hot food I ordered from the kitchen came out in a timely fashion and steaming hot. Kudos to the people working behind the wall. Unfortunately, my family and I will never return here simply because the manager could care less that every, single non-hibachi table was miserable and waiting far too long for their food. She never apologized. She never took responsibility. She never offered anything until we complained and again all she could do was 10% off a $60 bill. Pathetic!

OK, there - snobmeister. This isn't exactly le bec fin, and maybe this dumpy neighborhood bar's patrons are a bit on the unsociable side (can you say clique?)  (a lot like le bec fin) - but I love this place. After blowing your wad at Tinto, Go there on a Tues. night and play Quizno with the local egg heads, drink cheap, COLD beer, get one of the best sandwiches around, like their fresh cut steak and potato skins (I know...classy, eh?)  Everything we've eaten there so far has been basic good (REALLY good) fresh stuff.  Served by a friendly helpful lady. Bartender Marty is a trip and will make you feel welcome.

I'm honestly shocked at the negative reviews.  I'd like to first respond by suggesting that you take someone's review based on a restaurant week experience with a grain of salt.  Seriously...  it's restaurant week, and you're someone who wants to be a hip, know-it-all foodie for 1 week but otherwise orders out for pizza.

I've eaten here many many (emphasis on many) times and have never been disappointed with the food.  If you want to be sure that they don't prepare the food & leave it under the heat lamp for ages, as one reviewer speculated, just look in the little circular window as you walk in and watch them make it. There are no secret cover-ups. 

Lunch is pretty busy, since the restaurant is located on the 4th floor of an interior design building and there really aren't a lot of other places in the immediate area, but the sandwiches  are such a great alternative to the typical hoagie fare.   
my lunch favorite: Cocotte - white meat chicken salad with grapes, basil, apple, walnuts, celery and dijon mayonnaise on pita bread.

The salads are large and there's a diverse selection.. not just garden salad vs. caesar, but some unique and creative combinations and they are definitely satisfying on their own.

Get the sweet potato fries!

Dinner time is almost never crowded. You probably don't need a reservation unless it's a special event. Ask to sit by a window, the views (in either room) are incredible. You get the river with the bridge lit up at night, 30th street station and, though it's better to see during the day, the art museum. The lack of crowds mean you can have an intimate conversation with your guests comfortably.

Patrice is amazing. It is not often that the owner/chef of a restaurant will come out during dinner to go table to table and ask if everything is OK. His accent will also make you melt, which is always a plus for me.

I think it's usually empty because of its location. There is not much around and it can be a little shady at night time, but if you can quickly shuffle a couple blocks to Chestnut or Walnut, you're back in the mix of it all again, safe and sound.

Not Vietnamese fare by any stretch .... With the exception of a few Pho dishes, almost everything else is Chinese or Thai. Perfectly fine, considering their store front states 'Asian bistro'. 

But categorizing this restaurant as Vietnamese is a disservice and a sham to true authentic Vietnamese establishments. Perhaps a Yelp staffer assumed as much because of the word Saigon. Perhaps the menu is based upon the community of Brandon, FL and its ultimate influence of patrons and their tastes. Thereby, the owners modified the menu to appease their clientele. More importantly, just because the restaurant's owners or employees are Vietnamese doesn't mean the dishes will be. Big mistake! 

The category of this restaurant definitely MUST be changed to reflect what is really offered, Chinese and Thai dishes.

Yes, I'm being difficult. Yes, we could have left and gone elsewhere. But there were many of us in our dinner party and several people traveled close 90+ miles to meet others at this location because some of us were on the road RV'ing and on vacation with other destinations to get to. 

Not one of us was familiar with dining in Brandon, FL, other than the "chain-based" establishments. We're all from larger communities and were not seeking, yet another, Beni's, Friday's, Mac Grill, Outback, etc. We all decided on Vietnamese. Wow, who da' thunk there was Vietnamese in a place called Brandon? Furthermore, this gathering was literally planned on the road, using iOS devices and Yelp to coordinate where to meet for dinner. Ultimately a huge disappointment for all concerned.

Aside from all that - the portions are large, the atmosphere quiet and pleasant, the staff friendly and efficient, and pricing is reasonable. I'd give it about 3 - 3.5 stars but I'm a stickler for authenticity. So it only gets 2 stars.

Pros: new presentation 

Cons:
Limited menu
Ordinary food, certainly not 4-star 
Small portions (considering price)

They came up first on my Yelp search. In hindsight, it might be better to go for others. Probably explore a bit more

I quit eating Chinese take out years ago, mostly because I've found that normally I would find a menu shoved in my door jam and I would order and it would be all good and fine and then one day I would actually see the place I ordered from and want to hurl.  Lee How Fook has brought Chinese food back into my life and I could not be more grateful! I'm a huge fan of the family style, but really I've only been to this place with one or two other people but it works anyway. My friend and I split and order of pan fried pork dumplings, chicken fried rice and general tso's and it was literally like $16 bucks.  A ton of really delicious food for not a lot of money.  I have heard rave reviews about the hot and sour soup, and I see there are some on here as well so it's also got that going for it.  I've also ever been in the lunch crowd and it isn't typically slammed, so for a sit down meal, you're out of there in like 30 minutes, maybe a little more. I've always had a positive waitstaff experience. The one thing I will say is that I was a little bothered one day when i saw our waitress with a giant pile of pork (in the dining room mind you) stuffing dumplings for the dinner rush...... Then again there was nothing particularly unsanitary about  it so I just let it roll....

I can't wait for my next heaping bowl of fried rice (boring but AWESOME!) 4 starts for filling my tummy!
pretty decent place to bowl. their rates are fair, its a pretty chill environment. only down side is the food. the food was awful! eat before you arrive and all will be well ;)

20 years ago this was a good venue. Now? Not even close. We've been here a number of times over the past few years, tapering off to nada. The food isn't very good. The service was meh.  The ambiance the same. There are far better places to spend your hard earned dollars.
Huge and nice very friendly clean help you find stuff so love it!

What a cute party place environment in little ol Clementon. My Imported boyfriend actually suggested trying here.

Super friendly service (Veronica) and a nice huge horchata along w chips & guac - both v good (guac a tiny  bit too spicy for moi)  - started us off. 

I had chicken fajitas that were awesome - nice tender chicken, peppers and onions AND slices of guacamole! YUMMY!!!!

Vince had chicken chilaquiles, which he enjoyed - esp the rich red sauce. 

The desserts looked wonderful but we were too full to partake.

You should be able to have high expectations for a $36 steak.   This steak missed.  Cooked to a perfect medium, but way over seasoned and too much fat.    Mashed potatoes were barely warm.   Apps were good, but it's all about the steak.     Maybe a bad night for the service team, but I left completely unimpressed by the meal.

Went there the other night for dinner with my boyfriend. I had a cheeseburger and he got the pulled bloody sandwich. Everything was great! The French fries could have been a little crispier, in my opinion, but there were still good. The service was pretty good :)
The service was top notch. The line was out the door and was handled in high class fashion. It moved super quick and my truck was serviced and complete in less than the time they quoted me.

I visited because of nausea and fever and found the doctor Rahman to be very professional as he spent his time with me to listen all the details. He was immediately available. He recommended blood test and staff was quickly there to draw it. Doctor prescribed some medicine and explain about it too. I received a call from them next day to inform about my blood results. 

I would definitely recommend and visit express care of tampa bay again when needed. Thanks
really really good food. we had a pleasant time. the owners were really nice to us and helpful with anything we asked for. This is a family-owned restaurant and I would recommend supporting it

fix your damn elevators you cheap ass pieces of crap
waiting 10 minutes for an elevator is ridiculous
period
there are four available- including the service 
fix the third guest elevator
guests should not need to use the service elevator for normal use
the rooms are fine but your elevators ruin the entire guest experience 
period

With all the buzz in the air (and on Yelp) about Federal Donuts, I stopped in one unusually balmy winter afternoon and was delightfully greeted by the lovely Blake, whom I hadn't seen in ages.  Since all the fancy donuts had been sold for the day, I settled on a fried-to-order vanilla lavender donut and a black cherry soda.  Both really hit the spot; not to mention I ran into someone I met while I was a first-year student at Arcadia whom I hadn't seen in years!  Nothing better than reuniting and bonding over great donuts and feeling like you're in your friend's kitchen!  I wasn't in the mood for chicken that day, but I am eager to come back and try it, as well as their fancy donuts.  At the rate it's going now, Federal Donuts has great things on the horizon and is well on its way to becoming the next Cheers...where everybody knows your name.

Surprise of the year! Big time diamond in the rough. Had the special meatball sub and fries with their special sauce, then we played ping pong and drank. Great time, music was loud bring ear plugs. Employees super cool

Very Meh. The complimentary chips and salsa are what saves this from a 2-star rating. As I always say, the fish taco is a great marker for the quality of a Mexican restaurant. I give this fish taco 2/5 due to lack of freshness and lack of overall creativity in presentation. I could probably do better at home.

1. Waiters do not speak English here - minus one star 

2. I ordered pancakes and they brought me tilapia - minus one star 

3. They fixed it quickly so I'll add a star 

4. I asked 3 different waiters for sour cream and it took 15 minutes for an English speaker to finally figure it out - minus one star 

5. Food was bland, toast was burnt, and the environment felt like Iat a road side diner on the way to Vegas. Not in a good way either. - minus one star

The Southport Antique Mall is one of our favorite places where we can easily kill several hours. It's huge and you won't find a lot of junky non-antiques like you will in other antique shops. If you haven't been, go and soon.

I would give this business zero stars if that were an option.  

My husband and I came in this store three times looking at a desk.  The first time was just to get measurements and make sure ti would fit in his office.  The second time was two weeks later to discuss the price - non-negotiable! The man said they had just gotten the desk in.  That was not true.  We had seen it previously when getting measurements.  Today we were driving by and decided to stop in.  Again, the price was absolutely non-negotiable.  I am sorry.  This is a thrift store.  This isn't a high end furniture store. The negotiation wasn't anything crazy or outlandish.  We had the cash in our wallet.  It would have been a simple, easy, cash sale.  

With my harsh review comes some suggestions.  The first thing this store needs to do is to consider the amount the client wants to offer and discuss the offer. I know this is a thrift store and customer service isn't paramount but at least engage the customer about what they are looking for.
