Awful business model! it should feel like a win/win situation for both the business and the client.  

I have not written a negative review before but feel this one is warranted. I am amazed this business sells anything. Just for the record, we went to Consign Furniture by Target.  The man took our offer to the front desk.  With a tinch of haggling, it was accepted and we know have a better desk that the original one at Recycled Furniture.

What most people call dives whether it be a bar, hotdog stand or cafe, I call home.   This place is actually at 1160 Gallatin Pike S at the intersection of Due West rd and Gallatin Pike and might not come up on your gps if you type in the address listed above.  The owner serves up hot dogs with a variety of toppings in regular and super sizes, don't get the super if you are not up for a 1/4 pound dog!  I noticed a variety of sandwiches, drinks and chips ,You can even have a beer with your meal, this might be hot dog heaven!  I realize the prices are displayed on the board but when I ordered a tea, superdog loaded and chips the owner looked everything over and said "lets call that $5".  I'm pretty sure I made out on that deal!  Some might complain about the decor but it is working class comfortable with odd and funny signs, a pinball machine and what some may say is an "antique" video game.   If you are in Madison and in the mood for a dog, swing on buy and enjoy.  The joint is not in the strip mall but in the lower level of the 5 story office building next to the Nail salon.

Vegwise, I did not see a vegetarian option on the menu!

Super cool place to come and try different wines and beer. This place isn't a winery itself, just tastings. The staff is super friendly and gave us a low down on each wine we tried (6 in total). They have a beautiful patio and it's just two blocks from the beach and pier.  would definitely go again! I bought two of the bottles of the pinot noir that I liked and got my wine flight for free!

I had King Cake French Toast. It was pretty delicious but a little crowded and busy environment. Smart to add your name to the waitlist through the yelp app so that a table will be ready when you arrive.

Great place for good food and amazing service! I'll be back. I came for happy hour (on a Sunday!!) and the oysters were freshly shucked. The service was bar none. The atmosphere is fun!! Thank you Calvin and Phil for being the best part of my night!

This mall is nice and convenient (at least for me). 

Positive: It is near my house, lots of stores to choose from, great restaurants around the mall, they have a kids play area, only 6 places in the food court but they are very diverse, there is a movie theater (which isn't very good but we aren't reviewing that now are we??), great people watching place 

Negative: no dept stores, it is suppose to be an "outlet" mall but places are pricey and not all shops are outlet, the play area is old and boring for kids, t
Phenomenal! True,  southern bbq! Delicious! Their staff is super nice worth great service too! LOVE this place!
Everything here is wonderful. I highly recommend the Earl Grey Hot Chocolate and caramel cider.

Solid brunch spot on the main-line. It's a BYO so bring some champagne. 

I recommend the breakfast burrito and the bacon waffle sandwich.

Get there early if you want to snag outdoor seating.

This was an overall AWFUL experience! If I could give less than 1 star, I would. The food was a joke. Texas fries smothered in microwaved cheese sauce, calamari tacos with stringy, undercooked calamari. Burritos that you pay EXTRA for rice and beans! Don't get me started on the drinks. I had a strawberry margarita that was syrup on the rocks, my husband had a long island that was sour mix with a splash of soda. The service??  I could've walked out on my check 3 times before she asked if we were ok (I probably should have).... DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY!!  what a joke!!

This started out GREAT! The place smelled wonderful, and the food, Pretty darn tasty. The price was good, and food was plentiful and hot. 

When we arrived there was one table of a mother and daughter, and our table.  After we arrived another couple arrived. There was 1 waitress.  While I can't say it ever got truly busy, I can say that she never checked back with us after the initial "How's everything?" never asked us if we wanted more water. After we were clearly finished with our food, she never came back to see if we needed boxes. 

At this point 2 more groups came in, one group of 4 and one group of 5 and they sat at the back of the place, those seemed to take up her time. This was about 6:30. My friend and I were done by now, we were looking at our watches, commenting that it was relatively early. By 7pm, though we were still talking, the waitress still hadn't checked on us, when we would try to get her attention, she never did seem to make eye contact with us, she simply ghosted to the back areas of the eatery. 

At 7:15 we had to verbally signal her to get us boxes, and to ask for the check. She then didn't remember them for another spate of time, we finally got out of the establishment at 7:44.  The times are known because I made note.   I would come back for the food, but the service was pitifully slow. Need more help in there.

My family and I dined here on a Friday evening a week or so ago. We requested outdoor seating when we made the reservation, but it cannot be guaranteed. It wasn't available when we arrived that night. 

While we perused the menu we were served some complementary bruschetta on toast. We ordered three appetizers: stuffed zucchini flowers, shrimp and scallops, and asparagus wrapped in shrimp and prosciutto. All three were very good. 

Our main courses did not disappoint. We had a variety of pastas and chicken and left with enough food for the next night's dinner. We will be returning here soon!
Great food, that's served quickly and always hot, the staff is friendly and informative. I'll return for sure. The roti canai is a must try favorite of mine.

Like many of the reviewers here, I have been to all the high end eyeglass shops in the city and Manayunk.  I guess it just depends what designer you like and whether or not the shop carries that brand.
Gene, the owner is always accomodating  and very patient as it does take time to see what feels right and looks right on your face.
For me, I discovered Theo from Antwerp.  Theo's owners are two men who's designing skills are finely honed. No one else in Philly carries this designer.  They are very particular about to whom they give their franchise.
Stop in.  A world of new and exciting looks and colors await you!

This is my first review ever on yelp. Thought it was time to give back to the system which I have relied heavily on. Another reason is to find a place where I can share my bitter experience.
I have been to many hotels and casinos over the years. The experience has mostly been good as I am very picky. I try to stay in hotels that is in the top ten be it in Vegas or Reno. I would HAVE to gamble twice a year or at least once. So the natural choice is Vegas. Since Reno is closer to the bay it is a cheaper option. This time I chose peppermill hotel. I have been here before but this is the first time I stayed in the hotel. 
1. Room service was really bad. We came back end of the day to see that the bathroom was not cleaned properly. Our things were moved around.
2. I was playing at one of the roulette tables. I had lost a few hundred bucks(duhh) and wanted to watch how the round plays out. I skipped two turns and until then I had played every round where I lost money. One of the managers came up to me and said that he has been watching me and that I haven't played for almost ten turns. He was not polite either. He was quite rude and made sure everyone around heard. I got really agitated and made my point clear. This has NEVER happened before. I am never EVER returning to a place that is not polite and friendly with their guests. They don't deserve to be in hotel service.
Great place for an afternoon of shooting! Friendly and helpful staff and a great environment!! The turkey sandwich during "break" was awesome!!
Great service! Great food! Great menu! Often times the owner will come out and say hi!

Banko did the garage door openers at my house when it was first built.  We've only had to call them a couple of times for service, but each time they've been prompt and professional.  If I need repairs done on my garage door opener I'm calling these guys and NOT the guys spamming the Tampa Yelp boards with reviews that are blatant ads.   Just thought I'd throw that out there...

Josh and Carlos, another successful move and another satisfied customer.  Came early and all about the business.  Appreciate that since they charge by the hour. Fast, efficient and priced right.  Would use them again if the need arises.

This place is absolutely fantastic. It has grown from such a small restaurant into a highly esteemed one very quickly. Everyone here is also super friendly. The atmosphere is casual and relaxed. The food is served very quickly, typically within 5 minutes of ordering. I'm a vegetarian and they have plenty of options for me. My favorite is the tofu teriyaki but the vegetarian udon noodles are great too (you have to ask for the noodles because they're not on the menu). The "spicy" is also very good.

Stop in for a slice - you will not be disappointed. 
I live in Ambler borough and there are at least 4 pizza shops within walking distance of my house and they all stink.  I will GLADLY get in my car and drive to Blue Bell Pizza. 

My boyfriend is from New York and even he loves it. We stop by once a week and the owners are always on the premises and they greet us by name. They are a great group of hard working guys. 

On occasion I've tried other menu items and was very pleased. Wings are AWESOME. Salads and sandwiches good too. 

The best part is that they have plenty of selection in slices - I always end up going back for the Grandmas though.

Stumbled upon this restaurant on accident and since then I've been waiting for a chance to get back. My rating is based solely on the food. I will say the first time I went I got a burger and a side of Mac and cheese and the Mac was horrible. It was literally just noodles and Kraft white American cheese, and my burger was sub par. However i also ordered the chicken and waffle sliders( one of the best decisions of my life) and my friend ordered the turkey meatloaf which was delicious. So based on that experience I went back yesterday and ordered the same app and meatloaf and it was just as good as the first time and the mashed potatoes were amazing. I will say the service is a little slow, and you seat yourself so it's a very casual feel. It's def worth a try even if it's just for those chicken and waffle sliders!

I was quiet pleased with this store lay-out and impressive wine collection. The staff was attentive and there was plenty of parking. I was happy to find many decent wines on sale. This is my new favorite wine store in the Philly area.

This is a business that knows that we need to be aware of what ingredients we are putting into our bodies!  

This place rocks the smoothie!  Love everything about it.  The owners are community minded and so smart and friendly.  

It is clean and efficient and the deli and smoothies are so healthy!  I wish I didn't live so far away!
Cool place! I had the grouper and it was delish! The service was great and drinks were yummy! I would go back!
Went here with my daughter to show her posh food! She loved it!!! I loved it!!! Great food!!! But I don't think charging again for refills on  cups of tea is fair
I knew their desserts were good and tried the quiche today. Fantastic - rich filling with a buttery crust.

Tonight was my second time. The best meal ever. Felt like I was eating in NYC or SF. Had to remind myself I was in The Biggest Little City. Soon there will be a line out your door.  Till then I'm going to go a lot. What to have? What not to have? Just order. I don't think you can go wrong. Good wine and attentive service.

Great craft brewery. Staff/owners are knowledgeable about their beers. They ask what you like and then give you a few samples to try. The Grandpa Jack was a hit with us. The interior of the brewery is very open with a large bar and several tables. The outside patio has picnic tables and an open area for bean-toss. Although they don't serve food, on the Saturday I went they had a local business making tandori chicken on a grill. The following day they were bringing in a bbq caterer.
I can't believe out of 5 Guys, not one one them had the guts to speak up an say "These buns are terrible."
The spider crab legs was a HUGE portion and looked delicious. Apparently sweeter than the rock crab special we had,   So said the server.  In any event our crab was definitely big enough to share.

Always has been one of my favorite places on Mass Ave. Good food and great service. The complaint I have was from my most recent visit. Again, great service but when was the last time this place had a deep cleaning?! Everything from the chairs to the glasses and salt/pepper shakers were filthy!
We like coming here once in awhile for date night. Service is always fantastic. Try the Passyunk, Paradiso and Izumi rolls. Honestly, try everything, it's just THAT good.

Mazfresco has one of the best lunch deals in the area with 2 tacos rice and beans and other specials that change daily. I tried their chicken chipotle sandwich and it was amazing. I also highly recommend their shrimp ceviche but I would like to see them also offer fish ceviche.
The grocery store offers a good representation of Latin American products and they also have their own in house bakery with a delicious selection of Hispanic breads.
The food is good. The  service is good but the salsas are really good if you sctually like heat. I love them

I have no complaint with the quality of the car wash. However, we hit the button for the $3 wash and were charged $7 (credit card inserted). There was no-one to ask because the attendant went into his booth and, due to the amount of cars, it wouldn't have been prudent to get out of my car. Cars were backed up into the busy street. I immediately called from my cell phone and was told that I had already gone through the wash and that there would be no credit . I don't mind paying $7, but this seems similar to a bait and switch.

I've been to Grain Exchange before and have always enjoyed the grub, cocktails and service. I couldn't find the menu online and when I called to ask about it, Derick went WAY above and beyond the call of duty and actually texted me a picture of the whole menu!  When I decided to drive from South Philly to Mt. Airy to grab dinner with my mom, we were both bordering on hangry.  Despite it being a busy Saturday night, they made sure we had a table waiting for us when we walked in the door.  Talk about feeling like a VIP.

And to add yet another layer to a great evening, our server didn't make a face or even flinch when we asked for veggies of any kind instead of rice and other accouterments to our salmon dishes.  Both plates were bordering on gorgeous!  The food was fresh, delicious, perfectly cooked and came out just in time to keep up from hitting low-blood-sugar-get-annoyed-with-each-other prime time.  

Neither of the two things the staff did cost the restaurant anything but absolutely made our experience what it was.  Finding two people in the same place who go a step beyond what they have to is rare.  I spent 10 years working in the service industry and LOVED doing things like this for people & get so much pleasure from having someone do it for me.  What was supposed to be a low-key impromptu dinner with mom turned into a memorable evening. 

Thank you you, Derick and everyone else at Grain Exchange!  We'll be back before you know it.

This is, without question, the best car wash around. They are insanely thorough when cleaning the car, and the place is always packed. Due to both, be prepared to be there on average 20-30 minutes. But it's well worth it! 
Also, looks like they are now offering coupons online, so be sure to check them out.
Lovely chill spot to drink wine with meat and cheeses. Had a nice band playing. Enjoyed the ambiance, wine, and food! Will tell all my friends to go here when in NOLA!

Great meal here with friends last night. Food was excellent and the staff were attentive and super polite. The owner stopped by to chat briefly as well. Ordered nachos without jalapeños but they came anyway, we just picked them off but they offered twice to redo which we said wasn't necessary; they ended up not charging us...unexpected but very appreciated. Will be back next time we're in town!

Fresh, homemade goodness. I often go to Vecchia Osteria when I can take a long lunch break and enjoy their courses of delicious Italian cuisine. My favorite dish is a sacchetini pasta with a gorgonzola pear filling and sauce. It's outstanding. They make it fresh in house too, which is apparent when you bite into it. Their house salad is simple and yummy too. It's a bed of fluffy lettuce and greens with shaved parmesean cheese. The dressing has a tangy lemon and olive oil taste. Those are my go-to dishes when I go. The service is great too. Family owned so we tend to get the same servers which is nice to see a familar face. It's BYOB, but they are very generous with offering wines to taste or limoncello after a big meal. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for very fresh, thoughtfully cooked Italian food. It's as close as you can get to jumping on a plane and flying to Italy for dinner!

Stayed here during a mini vacation with 3friends of mine. Stayed 2night 3days. I booked the room online,pretty easy. Wasnt charged anything until we showed up and was given the opportunity to cancel with 24hrs notice. Fair. Cute double bed room. Big screen tv, micro, fridge, Keurig coffee pretty awesome. Room was clean and quiet. All the rooms were booked but I felt like we were the only ones there. I love hotels with a breakfast bar. Breakfast was good. Cereal, milk, toast, bagels juice, coffee, yogurt, and bananas. Good enough to get you going to see the sights. Parking was a little tight with ppl and their big ass trucks. Nice gym by the pool which also has a jacuzzi. Staff was friendly and made it easy to check in and out. Except for the $20 city DAILY Tax wtf! Oh and a $1 daily tourist tax. Im from California, how Im I a tourist.

Paragon is one the best gyms I have ever gone to. I grew up in SB but have been living in New York the past few years, so my gym standard is high. I was thrilled to find a gym here that met every expectation I have when I'm looking for a kick-ass workout.
     The boxing and kickboxing classes at Paragon are super fun but also an incredible work out. The instructors make you work but also make sure you are doing it right and help perfect your technique. I have never had so much one on one attention in a group setting, which keeps me constantly motivated and engaged. I look forward to class every day because I know I will get a great workout and learn something new. Paragon is the gym to go to if you want to learn how to box and kickbox. I recommend Paragon to anyone looking for serious fitness and genuine fun.

Pros: attentive and super friendly staff, elegant yet not stuffy ambience, tasty bread pudding, fun history and family recipes increase the charm.

Cons: butter(for bread) very cold and entirely unspreadable, salad had not-so-fresh wilty greens, Creole rabbit had very bland brown gravy which surprised me. Maybe I don't know Creole cooking enough, but when do "bland" and "Creole" mix?  The carrots that accompanied the rabbit seemed just boiled and that's it.

Hi! My husband and I typically enjoy our time at the CVGE. Having been a restaurant worker myself, we are patient with the sometimes slow service. On the night of Sept 21st we tried to dine there and we ended up walking out. We were seated inside, and all the other tables were already served or finishing up their meal when we sat down. We were not acknowledged at all. We waited for 10-15mins. No one said hello or bring us water. The waitress brought the table next to us their check and attended to them multiple times.  She then proceeded to clean the table on the other side of us. All the while, not a glance at our table or interaction with us at all. We did not want to make a scene, so we got up to leave. As we were leaving, the woman behind the bar greeted us goodbye. She noticed I had a unhappy expression and waved me toward her. I said to her "we were not waited on". She was apologetic and asked if we would like to sit back down and she will get someone for us. At that point we were so disappointed we elected to leave and we ended up dining elsewhere that night. Rarely do I feel the need to write such a note to about a food establishment, but I was truly shocked at the lack of attention we got as patrons last night. I tried reaching out to you via FB messenger, and because I did not want to leave you a poor public review because we like CVGE. Given I did not get a response via FB messenger, I feel compelled to inform you of our lackluster experience and I hope that it was an isolated incident.

I was having a party for 140 people and my dessert food truck backed out about 3 hours before the party started.  It was a sunday night and I had no idea what I was going to serve to everyone at the last minute.  Thank God my husband knows one of the owners and gave him a call.  He had his bakers whip up a few trays of cookies, brownie and different kind of bars for us and then he personally brought the trays out to the party on a sunday night.  Everything was delicious and the guests gobbled everything up.  I was so grateful for their last minute help and would recommend that everyone check them out!!!

I wasn't sure what to expect, but after  we were finished, I knew I loved every bite of what we had. This place is on point! 

This place was suggested by a buddy, so when we saw a cl deals offer, I snagged one. We used it with our meal today.

We found the location without issue, right under 275. The place looks interesting and is in a historic building,  the Manhattan Casino building. We walked in and were greeted quickly by the friendly hostess. The space is a wide open dining room. It is very open and has a small bar and takeout area at the front of the restaurant.

We were greeted by our server quickly and he suggested we get the buffet as it had most of the menu available on it. We checked it out and decided to sample through the buffet. 

We tried just about everything on the buffet and did not find an item that wasn't very flavorful and we'll cooked. The sides alone you could make a meal from. From the black-eyed peas, white beans, yellow rice, collards, and the mac & cheese, all of it was amazing. We also tried the meatloaf, baked chicken, and fried chicken which were all perfectly seasoned and full of flavor. Towards the end, we sampled the peach cobbler, which was tasty, but we wished it was over ice cream. In the end, we werr happy with everything we tried. The buffet was $15 per person, and we'll worth it. We used our cl deals coupon, which rung up wrong, but was quickly corrected. The one thing you have to watch for is the 18% gratuity that is automatically added, but we had no issue with this as our server was great. I really look forward to returning.

This was my first time here. My strawberry snow was delicious, and the staff member that helped me was very nice! It's a cute little spot to get a refreshing cold beverage, and I'll definitely be back soon!

It's good till about 20 minutes after you eat it.  I had the breakfast burrito before I moved all day.  That was the worst mistake ever.  I wont share the details.  They are open REAL early in the morning, which is good I guess.  However I still would not recommend this place.

Bourbon street got to be a little too much for me, I just happened to find this place one night and really enjoyed the music here, drinks can be a little pricey here but being from NYC I'm used to it, this is a small chill place that draws you in with the live music that they feature, definitely a favorite go to spot in Nola

First timer here, never had a coal fired pizza. When I think coal fired, my thoughts go to "blackened or charred". We ordered a Paul & Young Ron, and let's just say, they don't skimp on the toppings! So much sausage, it literally covered the every inch of the pizza. Dollops of ricotta and we got half with sweet peppers (for me) and the other half hot
Peppers. The hot peppers are fire roasted and instead of being sliced up, it's the whole pepper! Never seen that before, if you like spicy, the juices from those peppers ooze onto the slice and give it that extra bit of heat. WOW! Enjoy it with a Jai Lai. The crust was crisp and thin, mmm so perfect. I want more pizza!!! Oh! Def try their wings! Dry rub, grilled and topped with caramelized onions. So amazing, will never get wet wings again! 
Service was friendly, and we were sitting outside. The only downfall was a drunk homeless man who kept coming up to our table and mumbling to us about stuff. The manager did come out several times to make sure we were doing alright and to tell the the man to go away. I'll def go back for more pizza, but plan to sit inside next time.

I came for the buffet which is advertised in the window for $7.99.  However, there was a sandwich board on the street saying it was $6.99.   At either price, it's a great deal.   There are a lot of your standard Indian buffet entrees.   What makes this place great is the bread that they bring to your table.  Order it plain or garlic and tell them to keep it coming.

Pretty decent steakhouse! Place overall is small, so you will have to wait. They keep it cozy and don't use pagers or anything like that, however, the front cocktail area really could be more practical if there were more seats available. The menu was small and eclectic- has some nice options for a not so traditional steak place. We ordered both apps that were on special- the scallops wrapped in bacon ($13) and the truffle fries and Gouda sauce ($8)- both on point. My husband got the Tomahawk steak which is 40oz ($59)! Such presentation with the bone in. I got the 7 ounce FM ($24). Overall, it was good... Not the best steak we've had. Bill was $113, which I was pleased with! Our service was great!
Was able to make an appointment the day I called. Took my dog in for anal gland expression and a nail trim. Was in and out of the clinic within ten minutes and the cost was only $30! Very happy!

Chipotle is great. They are way more popular in other areas of the country. I would eat there once a week in Ohio. People seem to like other places better here simply because they knew them prior to Chipotle. It is addictive.

The food was fantastic! Hot, obviously right out of the oven, on a room temperature plate. I'll definitely return. I knocked them down 1 star because the ac was struggling so it was too warm, and the service was slow even though they weren't busy. You can get a $25 gift certificate for here on Restaurant.com for I think it's $4.
Food is hot and always being replenished. Kind staff. Great for the price! I go around 1:30pm and it is never crowded.

I am partial to CC since I am a member of their Gold Medal Club. I really enjoy their wine choices. The location is centered in the funk zone. They provide a nice variety of tasty wines at a great price. You can even try rare high end wines.
I joined their international club and am satisfied.

After checking out the long line at Ruby Slipper we were happy to find Creole.  Great regular breakfast plus creole favorites.  I'll pass on the crawdad cakes next time but my brother's grillade was great.
Very good and quick service.

I have to concur with Rob Y.  Today, I had THE BEST BURGER OF MY LIFE! I am still three days later dreaming of the Village King. 8 ounces of perfectly cooked juiciness, maple glazed chipolini onions, lettuce garden tomato and topped with blue cheese and a modicum of foie gras on a soft brioche roll. 
  As amazing as the burger was the truffled cauliflower pickles with ricotta, and olive tapande. This place is micro in seating and macro on experience. The duck fat fries were good but the aura from the burger was so blinding, it obscured anything near the plate. 
    I had to return to the next day to try to cocktails, including the Ginger Rodger and the Malaysia Punch. Awesome, right out of the classic days of cocktails. 
  I bow down to you Chef Jose Garcis, you are my new idol and are indeed an iron Chef!

The food is not the "greasy-spoon" diner experience I was hoping for. Too many "unique" menu options and too centered around southwestern flavors for our tastes. Very "hipster" kind of atmosphere, which is also not really our thing. Should have just gone to Hungry Fox instead. 3 stars for decent tasting food.

Last night I got home from work at 7:30 and as soon as I got out of the air conditioning into the heat my allergies kicked into high gear, it looked like I had pink eye! I walked down to Andre just to get a pill for my allergies five minutes before he closed. I thought he would be annoyed that I was walking in as he was about to go but what wound up happening was him sitting me down, and putting eye drops in both eyes! I was SO thankful for the drops he put in they worked wonders. Andre has been my pharmacist for about a year now I would recommend him to anyone. He is wonderful!

I went here for the first time today with my 4 year old son and left very disappointed. The food was fantastic, but the following 3 things left me reeling: bad service, price, and food portion. We went on a Sunday afternoon with around 10 other patrons in the whole restaurant. Our waitress was so slow, rarely even checked on us, and had an attitude. I spent $30 on myself and a kids meal, and the portions looked like they came out of ice cream scoops, including the frickin meat! I will not be returning here. If you want great BBQ for a good price that will fill you up, try Lil mickeys BBQ in St. Peters.

Atmosphere sucks, but the Pho is good and the vermicelli bowls are great.  There are better places out there, but this Viet Pho is quite acceptable.

Quite often they have a fairly small child taking orders or bringing out the food -- kind of unsettling.

Came in for a quick drink n bite after work, bartender,Jonh, was super friendly and attentive. Brett greeted n sat me with such enthusiasm n kindness it started my experience off with a bang! Haven't been in years and I will be back my next night off for fresh triple berry margis!!!

This review is for the collision center/ body shop.  Jan Madden really helped me out.  a muffler came flying at bmw 650i on I75 hit the front of my car and then went under my car causing damage that madet my car dangerous to drive.  They fixed it within 9 days and under my insurance I got to drive a nice brand new Cadillac ATC.  I'm glad that there was a shop that did a great job and made my car look and feel the same way before the accident.  Jan had great communication with me and I felt like he really cared that my car was going to be in good shape.  I highly recommend this body shop.

"Frenchness Guaranteed"? Well, this could mean anything from expensive food to rude service. 

What I might forgive sitting in a Parisian cafe is not so "ooh-la-la" in a cafe facing a supermarket parking lot in Tucson. Our cheap sidewalk table tipped. We moved. Someone parked and the windshield glare bored into my eyeballs. 

The much heralded Eggs Provencal were tasteless -- not at all worth the wait! My mom's coffee was lukewarm--first cup and refill. 

The wild divergence in reviews for Ghini's should have been my first clue. C'est la vie. (But never again.)

We opted for the cruise portion as we only wanted to experience the steamboat on the Mississippi River.  It's two hours round trip from Toulouse Street wharf.

Points of interest  -
Jackson Square/St Louis Cathedral
Algiers 
Domino Sugar plant
Exxon refinery
The Outlet Collection at the Riverfront
The cruise terminal
The bridge

We found an online coupon for a savings of $3.00 p/p.

Day cruise either 11:30am or 2:30pm.  We chose 2:30pm.  Around 3'ish, it started to drizzle, then rain downpour with thunder and lightning.  Folks on deck like ourselves started to look for shelter.  

The best part was the operating steam engine room.  You can walk inside and take a peek.

We posed for a photo at the onset but passed on the purchase.

Very pretty restaurant. Great drinks. Went for brunch. Had fruit plate, omelette, lox plate and lemon poppyseed pancakes. Everything was well prepared. Pancakes were the best overall, omelette was good but last on this list. Very solid brunch option.
Very slow service!  The bartenders ignore you.  Food is low end.  Took 40 minutes to get a beer.  I'd say don't bother.

This place is great.  Don't be deceived by the appearance from the outside.  The interior is clean and warm.   
We arrived during prime time on a Friday night. It was about 3/4 full, which is a good blend of not empty but still not too packed to sit comfortably.  
We only ordered from the Indian menu so far and it is excellent! The korma is so good.
The service was also great; both the server and busser were very attentive. I am really excited to return to try more dishes!

everyone who works here is so insanely friendly. i love going because i feel like i see all my friends / neighbors here and its just feels so nice. the fact that its got that neighborhood "spot" feel is the motivation i need to work out. the price is right, i got the "day before they opened" price, and its cheap and includes classes!!!!! i'm just so glad to have city fitness in my hood. i love going and i love the way i feel after i leave. 
love u guys!

Great BBQ tonight - great service too - thanks Sean!

The BBQ nachos rocked and the pick 3 hit the spot.  Super delicious sweet potato casserole and the richest mac and cheese I've had in a while.

I went to Dewey's tonight and it was great.  Their pizza is perfect but sometimes the crust tends to be under cooked. Often when you take a bite most of the cheese comes off and then you end up with under cooked dough with red sauce on it. Dewey's is family restaurant. Not family owned but on weekends or Friday's, 55% of people their are families. Get the chocolate cake. It has cream filling and tastes amazing. They have great service and always get your order right.

I love this salon.  It's taken me so long to find a stylist since moving here 3 years ago.  I have sensitive skin and allergies so it's not easy getting my hair colored.  I'm so happy to have scheduled with Rae.  This is the first time in many years that I've have found a stylist that is very good at what she does, listens & recommends & is so nice & gracious.  

I've never really factored in the "salon" when looking for a stylist because it's difficult enough when you have allergies so I can't be picky - it was a really nice surprise to feel so comfortable & at ease in this salon.  From the moment I walked in everyone was friendly & attentive.  I love the laid back but professional atmosphere, rustic decor & it's very clean.  That it's organic is a major bonus.  I can't wait to go back for additional treatments such as sugar scalp exfoliation & hot oil treatment which will be great for my sensitive skin.

I'm so happy I found Rae & this salon - highest recommendation.
Three words! Marinated Crab Legs.

Since there is no longer a bowling alley on the Westbank, me and my buddy migrated to Harahan to go bowling.

For one hour of bowling and two pair of shoes its cost me around 20 bucks.  Not bad at all for some entertainment.  The actual establishment was fairly clean for a bowling alley.
The employees seemed to not care about me much.  They weren't rude, but they weren't nice.  I guess they just didn't care lol.  

If you are looking to go bowling and are not looking for anything special, Colonial Lanes is always a decent choice.

Oh and I also wish they had a better variety of bowling balls.  I could not find a size and weight I was looking for.

Kinda mad at the recent review so time for an update! No they are not perfect. Few restaurants are. They messed up an order today but they fixed it! Human error can happen ANYWHERE. See the thing is, the food is consistently delicious. Like alot so. Worked in the  area 4 years. No one is this good! We will keep ordering!

I just read the line in the front of a review "Mike is a bit gruff"- I laughed. He is also one of the nicest guys around. He is kind, knows his stuff and is straight forward about things (being from NY originally, even tho I haven't lived there for many many years I have no problem with gruff and I love straight forward). I have been bike only for a number of years now and I have purchased more than one bike in town  - but t he only bike store I have purchased two from is Mike the Bike Guy - ! I can't recommend this shop highly enough.

I went for lunch, I looked at their menu and it has all the basic of middle easter food. Lunch specials are only from 12-2, which includes the entree and rice. I ordered chicken tekka masala, I was given more liquid than chicken. I had 4 small pieces of chicken, it's a rip off. I prefer the hole in the wall on Broadway(name: mt something/ it's Nepalese and middle easter) More variety on lunch specials, lunch special hours longer hours, and you get naan bread (you  don't have to order and pay separate). I guess we all have our preferences

Love this place. The food is authentic and the portions are generous and reasonably priced. Service and ambiance are very typical for a Vietnamese restaurant - comfortable and friendly. I love that they have options for small or large sizes for their soups. I also love that they have the option of brown rice noodles instead of white rice noodles - that's hard to find. Overall, this hidden gem is one of my top choices for Vietnamese in New Orleans.

I wish I could give a more thorough review of Kajun's, but I really can't.

I got here expecting to be able to do a little singing and jamming. It wasn't late at all, but I was told that they were done with Karaoke for the night. Bummer. It was a decent crowd, although it was kind of packed. People seemed friendly enough and the bartenders had a nice beer selection and were fast despite the crowd.

I would love to go back and actually sing some karaoke. Hopefully I will find myself in the area again, soon.

We had a severe ant problem at our house in Goleta.  I struggled to control them but I was out of my league.  I think the drought had them coming indoors looking for any source of moisture.  Tony with Jhonny's came out and treated and viola NO ANTS.  Although I was told I might see a few for a few days while the treatment took full effect, in reality I have yet to see even one ant.  I can hardly believe it.  And no chemical smell whatsoever.  I'm a very happy customer!  Jhonny's Pest Control is on my goto list if I have problems in the future.

The cups on the floor by the elevator surprised me. Who had left them there? How long had they been there?

This older hotel has a decent small indoor pool, is relatively dirty and run down, and has a great location. Walking distance to wonderful restaurants and the City Museum. Our kids found friends to play with in the pool while we read (okay, played Candy Crush) and sipped wine we brought with us. (Bar and restaurant was inexplicably closed.)

(Why were those cups still there by the elevator the next morning? I'd seen housekeepers on our floor and surely they saw the cups as well.)

If you pay full price, you are going to be disappointed. Very, very disappointed.

If you pay low $ for a king suite and can recognize the excellent value that represents, you will be satisfied. 

The noise on the 5th floor (from air handlers, I think) was annoying but we had ear plugs. The parking was odd but worked out for us. The bent shower rod was meh.

(The cups were still there, waiting for Godot to put them in the trash. There was no bin near or I would have done it myself.)

Why housekeeping took our shower curtain after the first night I shall never know. Why would they do that? We left a $5 tip that morning. Maybe they held the curtain for ransom but forgot to leave a note?

The staff was friendly but largely incompetent. We needed little and they provided slightly less than that. 

But for that location and price, I honestly would do it again.

(When we were on our way down to check out, someone had kicked over one of the cups, spilling its contents in the floor.)

Expect the same treatment those cups got, pay little, and you'll enjoy your stay.

Great place to grab a cocktail or a beer. The atmosphere is very similar to Mandarin hide but smaller.

Great variety of interesting cocktails or various beers including craft beers and the drinks are creative and soooo tasty.

We decided to try out a few of their menu items. I was pleasantly surprised. I'm not to sure why but I never thought the food would be that great, maybe because of the size of Cask and Ale or maybe I just viewed it as a cocktail bar. Needless their food is really good. 

We ordered the truffle mac and cheese, who doesn't love truffle mac and cheese, also the chicken Flatbread and pork belly sliders. I'm not sure which item I liked the best, my two friends said the pork sliders but honestly I liked everything. The pork belly sliders had great flavor and a nice kick with the jalapeño , the mac. Cheese of course had the right amount of truffle flavor and a nice cheese sauce with a great topping that added a lovely  texture. The flat bread was also good, crisp, a lot of chicken and lots of flavor.

Service was just as good as the food and drinks, the bartenders were personable , very knowledgeable and the food came out at a reasonable amount of time. Cask and Ale was a winner in every area so I will definitely be back.
Some of the best food i have had in a while great pricing and perfect portions . This is a must stop if you love asian food

This specific UPS Store seems to be very different then the others in the area of Trinity.  The manager/owner is usually the only one working and is extremely rude.  He has no customer service skills, attempts to overcharge and is condescending.  I drive out of the way so I do not have to deal with this man.  Its a shame because the store is in a convenient location and typically I enjoy the UPS store and their employees.

Fresh fish!  Great views if your on the patio. Quick and good service. 
It's not a fancy place. Very casual.  Not casual/low prices however.  On the pricey side. That could be because of the quality of the seafood though.  It is the Best seafood on the pier or the wharf by far!!!

Always meaning to come to this place, but never had the time.  Ohhhh I was so missing out!  First time going to this joint and I see the line wraps around the corner, which tells me they are doing something right!!!

Their sandwiches are worth the wait!! Extremely delicious! I thought I had a taste of heaven when I took my first bite of their Chicken Shack Ranch.  It was that good!  I will keep coming back until I at least try every sandwich on their menu.

I came here for my hair donation. I can't remember the name of the stylist that cut me, she was blonde. The cut was free, so I can't complain too much, but the "clean-up" was hardly clean at all. I have lots of pieces that are uneven and I have to wait a while to get a trim to even everything out or my hair will be shorter than I want it to be. Because of this, I have to put my hair in a ponytail because it looks bad if I wear it down. 
0/10 Will not come back here.
Great turkey burger. I would've taken a photo but I ate it too fast. I will go back for breakfast tomorrow.

Say whatever bad things you want to say about this place, but don't you dare utter a bad word about their crab fries.  Yes, they're world famous for a reason, cuz they're f'in tasty.  Perfectly crispy crinkle fries dusted with seasoning and with two sides of their cheese sauce.  I could just eat these as the meal.  Their crabs are good too, so is the seafood chowder (a bit spicy), as are their cheesesteaks.

I've only been to the original NE location and now this one.  This restaurant is so big, I could get lost in it.  They have sinks in the middle of the restaurant so you can wash the crab guts off your hands. And the sinks in the bathrooms are made out of crab pots.  How cute is that?  Oh, and they have a "Taxi Crab" that will take you to and fro from the stadiums. The size of this place is a little overwhelming, but the food is always good, quite affordable, and it's fun. Just leave any pretentions at the door. It's a Philadelphia sports bar institution.

Only 2 because of the food. Server Alex was lucky she got the 79 cent tip that we did leave.  Son arrived first orders 2 waters and coffee took her 10 minutes to,return with coffee(place wasn't that busy) she then waited again to ask for order we were ready when she dropped off coffee. Son wanted a beer with breakfast she never even asked. Dropped off food never bothered to check back. Went to complain at bAr was told manager was counting money. Only person by a register was our server. Certainly hope she wasn't manager. Left  .79 and she never returned with any change to see if maybe we wanted to add to it. Guess what guys, You're in. Customer service industry better start improving your service.  Can't wait for Buffalo Wild Wings to open!!!   Think next time ill call ahead to order food to go!

I called on a Tuesday afternoon and my entire house was rekeyed within 24 hours.  I was very happy about that.  He showed up right on time and even called to verify that he was on his way.  He was super fast and efficient and even made a few extra keys so I wouldn't have to make a trip to Home Depot.  Woohoo!! Highly recommended.
A great place on Broadway to get your ice cream fix, either before and / or after enjoying any other downtown entertainment venues.
Great place for a fun night out. Never been disappointed. We always left with a smile on our face.

After my review last year, Scott from Peppermill contacted me and and was concerned about my experience. He offered a discount to give them another try. I am pleased to say I had a wonderful visit and am happy I gave them another chance. The Peppermill truly cares about their customers and they go the extra mile to prove it.

Pros:  
Great and fast check in with Mike, who was efficient as well as funny.

Beautiful, clean room and great view.  

Found parking every night except once but there was quick return when I used the valet.

Convenient check out on TV from room. 

Nice courtesy station to print airline boarding passes.

Fresh no smoking gaming area.

Easy to grab a quick coffee and fruit bowl at Biscottis.

Con: 
I won't be back until next year!

It says you can do take out, but when I walked in the rude waitress came up to me, never smiled, and when I asked if I can order to go, she said no, not during lunch. WHAT!! I work in the hospital and like little places I can get real, not fast food to go. Sadly, this place doesn't serve the busy people who can't sit and eat.

I came. I waited 45 minutes for a table. I conquered a delicious burger. 

Like a popular night club with a long line outside, Village Whisky will always have a wait to pull up to their tables. Similar to the night club, you finally get in, you get your first drink (a pimms cup perhaps?) and a beautiful beauty (read: whiskey burger) catches your eye. You examine it from a far, gather some more courage (drink #2 or 3) and finally ask someone about her. She comes over, you lean in and you're hit with pure euphoria and curiosity. The lights come on and she's all gone. And you're left feeling exhausted yet satisfied and ready to tell everyone about what happened. 

Village whiskey burgers are everything you'll read on here. They're great, worth the wait, and something you'll continue to talk about after you leave. 

The service leaves something to be desired, but luckily the meal makes up for it.

This, being my first time dining at this establishment, I must say I'm extremely pleased with my experience. The food was pristine and cook perfectly. The atmosphere was beautiful and inviting! But honestly the reason behind our top notch evening was because of our outstanding server Steven. He was amazing, well spoken and very attentive to our needs.

Just went for the second time in as many weeks and both times were excellent.  Great food and great service.  We had DeAnna (sp?) who was very good and even suggested a late night desert place (Insomnia Cookies in the Loop) which was perfect.  It is open pretty late which is great for me as I usually work late so it's nice to have such a tasty late night option.  They have beers and I think they were on special both times as they were only like two bucks (and the Busch was perfect with the whole shebang XXX spicy flavoring we chose).  This time we got a half pound of the sausage (in addition to the two pounds of crab legs and pound of head-off shrimp) and that was really good and absorbed a lot of the flavor.  Anyway I'll probably be coming here every week or two so I hope this review helps you decide to give it a try.
Popular place. Large servings.  Avoid the omelets, but the other breakfast entrees look good.  Lots of flies in the dining room.
It's 'OK' at best - certainly not worth the wait on a Sunday morning, especially if you do not want to come out smelling like the place afterwards.

This place is over rated. For what you pay in rent you don't get what they offer. The lawn ppl can not even cut the weeds that are growing. Pet friendly ya right it what they want. The office ppl just give you bs comments to make you feel they are looking out for you. If you smoke u can not even smoke in your apartment or they charge you $250 every time someone says something which is bs. We pay $1500.00 for a 3 bed room. They charge you for the dumpster to be emptied .

I had an apple fritter, glaze, and gooey butter cake. The apple fritter was decent and I would eat it again. The batter for the other two donuts was really dry and floury (probably the same dough but fritter ingredients helped). They were some of the worst donuts I have ever tried. The topping on the gooey butter cake was okay but needed more of the cream to counteract the dryness of the donut. 

I give them a bonus star for being open until 12 am on weekends because it is awesome to be able to get a donut late. However, if deciding between going to a Krispy Kreme with a neon "Hot Now" sign on or Strange Donuts, I would pick Krispy Kreme every time (and probably eat a half dozen).

After a few email exchanges with Pizza Hut national customer service and a $10 credit for the dozens of forgotten dips, things got a little better for a while. Sure, I've had to devote the special instructions field on every order to an all caps reminder for their drivers to "PLEASE DON'T FORGET THE DIPS!", and there were still several incidents where an apologetic driver had to run back to the store to get forgotten items, but it was getting a little better. 

Now, however, even the extra reminder isn't helping,  and it's not just dips, but 2 liter sodas that get left behind when the drivers leave the store with a delivery. Tonight, I paid for 2 ranch dips to go with 16 boneless wings, and there was only one in the box. I guess it's time for another round of customer service complaints. 

I wish they'd just automatically include 1 free dip for every 8 wings like their competitors do. Then perhaps their driver training would stick. At the very least, they should not trust that the cooks are filling their delivery bags correctly without checking the order against the receipt,  but I guess that additional step would only extend their already 1.5-hour delivery time (on a good night!).

This was my first experience with Indian cuisine, and this place didn't impress me. The service was poor. There were a few different waiters, no one of whom were friendly or helpful. The waiter that sat us down didn't ask if we wanted anything to drink. He just filled our water glasses, set the pitcher on our table, and walked away. We just assumed to proceed to the buffet (we never received a menu). All in all, the food was alright, however not worth the high cost.

Great repair shop.  Franchise owned by a husband and wife who really seem to care about their customers.  They'll work with you on pricing and are very honest.  They even guided me to finding parts online to save me some more money.  I plan on driving my little Toyota until the wheels fall off and here's where I'll be taking my car from now on to ensure I can do just that.

Booked last minute services for bridal party...hair styling, make-up, massage and nail services. The bride is a make-up maven herself and very, very particular about her hair as well. I was worried she'd walk out with a stiff newscaster look or worse but OMG - gorgeous, perfection.

Make-up was done by Kylyn - false lashes as well. She looked flawless and every wedding photo was beautiful - just took her natural beauty to the wow level and it lasted all day. Hair by Julie - we asked for a "Downton Abbey", turn of the century, romantic up-do with loose french braiding and curls - she knocked it out of the park. Other guests also had up-dos done by Julie and were equally thrilled.

Massage by Jocelyn also met with raves.

I can't believe this is the last place I called! All the independent wedding stylists, either didn't return my inquiry, were busy or wanted astronomical fees. I'm so glad they were able to fit us in.

I do not understand the bad reviews for this restaurant. I haven't had the food, just the pizza. So, this review will be for the Cuban pizza and the service. The girl that waited on us was wonderful. She was extremely nice, with all the warmth and welcoming disposition of the Cuban people's culture. The pizza was outstanding, so was the mango shake, and the espresso at the end to seal the meal. I will be definitely going again.

SO enjoyed my soy chai tea latte and housemade granola parfait on this snowy morning. This place was packed but we found a table and enjoyed the hip but cozy atmosphere. If I'm ever in Reno again, I will definitely stop in!

Customer service at this hotel is negative stars if I could give it. My husband and  I just got off the phone with the front desk after a weeks stay at this hotel to talk to them about why they took $1700 out of our account when they were only supposed to take 700. The woman I spoke to on the phone was extremely rude to me would not let me finish what I was trying to explain to her. All of her responses seem like she had a big attitude over me asking the littlest of questions just trying to figure out what was going on with their establishment and our bank account. Come to also find out that we were charged over $50 for " mini bar use" when my husband and I did not even touch the small refrigerator located under the TV the entire stay. I was hoping to write a good review about our stay here but this absolutely ruined any good remarks that I had on this hotel. We have yet to receive our "incidental "money back when the lady insisted that it was already in our account. Absolutely terrible customer service. Would never recommend.
Not the best , corn bread was definitely unappetizing... same with the rest of the food . Won't be coming back.

I saw broadway show stoppers.  It's a fabulous show. I highly recommend seeing it. It had all kinds of music. The show is very entertaining. It will be running through September 29, 2014. The service is great. There is not a bad seat in the house.

I am giving 3 stars but I won't be back. It's simply too expensive. The cheapest thing on the menu is $8 for a little container of "fresh" juice. I ordered one with apple, pear, kale, mint, etc and the girl got it from the fridge. I am guessing it was pressed that morning (?) but not sure.
There is plenty of space and chairs and there is free Wifi, which makes it a good spot to work or meet people, but I would probably need to bring some "solid" food in with me :)
Most other drinks average $10 for a 14-16 oz. drink...it's just not sustainable unless you're moneybags.

This restaurant used to be called the Spotted Hog, it REALLY needed overhaul-decor, update. Must have sold it to the new owners, Did they overhaul inside or what??! Amazing decor, warm, stylish, fireplace in back, quite eclectic, nice bar, seating is nice, some booths curve around. The four of us went here after the festival lights, to get out of cold, catch a bite to eat. I split burger with my Traveling buddy, firehouse burger & we originally ordered soup 10 min later., waitress said soup was changed, only tomato, no sweet potato, so we ended getting salads.The wait was too long. The burger was good-think most part we were starving.It Was OK, not the BEST-burger, gave you side of kettle chips, no fries, Sketch -in Philly has better burgers then here. But they are a step up from previous place stood there.

STRANGE DONUTS WAS AWESOME, HATERS.

As much as I like to reject the things everyone gets excited about, I couldn't not give into the donut hype. Passion is a wonderful thing. Especially when that passion leads to glorious donuts.

Even with a line going well down the road, the Strange Donuts crew did a great job of keeping things stocked to meet the demand. The classics ($1) are fine, but the strange creations ($2) like Bart's Revenge and the Campfire are what you're really coming here for. Tonight they're featuring a donut topped with a piece of Porter's fried chicken. So don't get on here whining about how great the other donut shops in town are and who cares about this new place. Until World's Fair Donut can one-up these guys with a salisbury steak fritter, I'm not listening to your danged negativity.

Awesome first day, Strange Donuts. I've got 3000 calories of donuty goodness ready for the weekend, a really awesome cup of Kuva coffee, and a t-shirt with a dinosaur on it. Flying a spaceship.

Stay strange.

Great beignets and the cafe au lait is to die for! But DO NOT GET THE GUMBO! It is really disgusting! It tasted like someone used lemonade or lemon juice in their roux!! Super strong lemon/citric flavor, which does not belong in gumbo!!  We all had to throw it out.   Beignets=great, Gumbo=Terrible

Previous pictures posted showing sashimi,  they do Not offer !!  The fish is served in very very thin slices.   Be prepared to Wait,  very Slow service.  Nice people and actually very good for the price!

They answered right away and told me they were busy but could either be here in an hour or refer me to A and R. I asked them to come. They arrived early. Got right in. Super helpful and professional. CHEAP! Only $40 for mobile call and $15 to break in and $3 for key copy. 

I'd use them again.
Great food, I love their breakfast sandwiches and guava pastries.  The staff is extremely friendly and make an effort to please!

Our bartender Alma was amazing!!! Our food was fantastic!!! Service couldn't be more outstanding. Definitely recommend this place in the future. Bloody Mary was on point, recommend all who love mimosas to try the detox mimosa.

The food was so good. My friend and I split a pizza and a chicken parm sandwich, both were delicious and fresh tasting. AND THE PEANUT BUTTER PIE...omg... They make the pie themselves, and it it was amazing! They gave us a big slice that we both split and end up taking some of it home. Our waitress was friendly and attentive without being overbearing. It is BYOB and they put our bottle in a bucket with ice. Even the water they served comes from a wine-like bottle that they leave at your table. This place is a hidden gem in Southampton..Very cozy, great atmosphere. Overall we had a great time and will definitely be going back.

Worst company ever. Took them 3 tries to get it right and every time there was something new that was wrong with my windshield.  They also ruined me headliner. They got black tar glue all over it. Stating that they would pay for it but again it's my time that I would have to find a company to clean it. Then email them or fax the quote and then wait for them to pay for it. Time is money people. Use someone else. That are actual professionals and not hired off the street.

A solid four star restaurant. The small seafood platter is pretty good and enough portion for two. The seafood jumbo soup is a must. Rice soaking in salty seafood and creamy soup is so good! Yum! Besides the service is really good. The waiters are attentive and friendly. 

But the fresh gulf fish is not impressive. I understand it's "fresh" so it had little sauce and salt in it, making it kinda bland. Besides it is a bit greasy for a fish dish. 

Would definitely come back if revisiting NOLA but would pass the fish dish as well.

I had been looking forward to trying HWK for awhile with a couple of false starts.  The plan had been to meet up with a friend from junior high and her husband (with my date) and check the place out but stuff kept coming up and FINALLY, we got there this past Friday.  I very much enjoyed the experience.  It was a great setting for the four of us to talk.  We ended up with the table at the end of the bar, which kind of sits there by itself and kept it somewhat cozy.  Service was excellent, a solid 5 stars there.  

We started out with the combo cheese and meat board and ate it all up.  The variety of cheeses and meats along with the mustard and jam made for a great start.  Among our main dishes were the Amberjack, pork loin and flat iron and all agreed it was some good food.  My pork loin came on a bed of polenta that was very well made.  

The only reason I am not giving them 5 stars is the price.  While my food was very good, it was no way worth the $24 I paid for it (just my opinion, take it for what it's worth).  For that, I was expecting something very juicy and full of flavor, and while it did taste pretty good, it wasn't any better than what an Applebees might do, nothing special, and for $24, special is what one should get.  

We also enjoyed a couple of bottles of wine and as I said, the service was excellent when it came to paying attention to our wine and water glasses.  We were not rushed  and not pushed to move on as we sat there for awhile after our meal and enjoyed the time.  I might go again, especially if someone else wanted to go but definitely a nice place for dinner without having to worry about dressing up too much.

Definitively, the best large pho combo this part of town. True combination of meats, tripe and meat balls for a Monday pho lunch. Can't vouch for other menu items but it's a pho restaurant after all. Enjoy your next pho combo here.

I've had plenty of underwhelming food and service experiences so I have to give props to the Nashville restaurant that got it right.

I stopped in as a solo diner to a tapas restaurant. This can be kinda awkward to ask for at  a tapas restaurant but the hostess quickly and graciously sat me at the bar where I was quickly attended to by the bartender.

I ordered a red sangria which was promptly made in front of me. It wasn't the best sangria I've ever had but it wasn't the worst either. I do think $8 for an average glass of sangria is a little much but I'll go for it. They do have a happy hour special of $5 sangrias on some days so I'll have to catch that.

I ordered the Kale Salad and the Chicken Skewer tapas. The kale salad was AMAZING!! I will be ordering this salad again and again!! The manchego cheese on top was truly the "icing on the cake".
 
The chicken skewers should really be called "chicken skewer" because you only get one. It's plenty for one person but may not be enough to share. The chicken is grilled perfectly and I enjoyed every moment of it. It's served on top of hummus and garlic mayo, which were fine but the chicken really made the dish. 

The service was impeccable and the bartender was friendly and welcoming. He even gave me recommendations for places to eat in Nashville.

Check it out!  You will not be disappointed!!
Favorite pralines in French Quarter! They have delicious traditional pralines, but also have fun, unique flavors like peanut butter and sweet potato (both are amazing by the way...)

I must have initially come here on a bad day. (It was during the weekend and the owner was not here.) However, every other time I've been in here, the owner has been present and is always exceptionally friendly and helpful. I've received excellent recommendations on bicycle safety and security items, and everything here is of good quality. Nothing in this store is cheap, but cheap is definitely not what I had in mind when trying to keep myself from being hit by a car.

I only use my bike to commute, but I think any serious cyclist in town would really appreciate the apparel, parts, and bikes sold at this store. I will definitely try them first when the time comes to repair my bike.
Why are those musicians still only playing in bars?! Such amazing talent! I loved that you can request songs too. Mac and cheese burger was delicious!

Tried this place for the first time and I liked it. They have a good deal on beers for happy hour for sure which I liked. I really liked the wildey beer they had. The place was pretty busy when we went and it was a bit of a wait but we got a seat at the bar and the bartenders were really nice. Also ordered the calamari and beer cheese fries and they were really good. Calamari tasted fresh and wasn't weird and chewy like some places. Was a little annoyed because a waitress basically told us to get out of the way because some of the people I was with had to stand. The place was jam packed so I'm not sure where she expected us to go and we weren't taking up the much space but whatever. The rest of the people there were really nice and helpful with questions about the beers and stuff. Def recommend checking it out tho. Especially in the summer. Great outside seating area.

Never would have found this place but I had a groupon so I tried it out. Such a great little place. Got to meet the owners who are fantastic. Great local business to support. I'm not a beer drinker at all but I did enjoy the white tail ale. The sangria was fantastic. Wednesday's are trivia night. We had a blast. Perfect date night experience. Go! You won't be disappointed...

Delicious coffee, a good selection of tasty food, ample seating, fast WiFi, friendly staff, a cute neighborhood with easy parking, reasonable prices, and a clean bathroom. Literally everything you look for in a coffee shop is true about this place. If I lived in boise, this would be my regular spot for sure.
Only place I've found in town for Korean style steak. Pretty great for a group! Flavors not easily found around town!

Mazzaro's is my friend. This establishment should be on everyone list to visit. It's a deli, a restaurant, a bakery. They have a great wine selection and some awesome IPA beers. They also have people in the wine cellar that help you to pair your tasty wine with tasty cheese. Next time you're in Saint Pete check this place out you will not be disappointed. Don't forget to grab yourself the lobster mac n' cheese...it is oh so good.
The new chef has made an awesome menu and flavor even better! I didn't think it was possible but I was proved wrong. I always love coming home to Southgate.

Very good BBQ in a relaxed atmosphere. We ate outside which was quieter than inside. We had the pulled pork, turkey, grits casserole, black eyed peas, coleslaw, Mac and cheese and salted caramel brownie. Parking available and fast service!

Went for breakfast with hubby.  Food was satisfying, as usual. Had the pancakes and the chicken fried steak.  Our server, Aliona, was great! However, when we went to the cashier to pay, there was this fat guy in a blue shirt (manager?) who wordlessly took our bill and cash in a huff, walked away, commandeered Aliona to take the check and settle it for us while we were waiting by the cash register up front.   

Enjoyed the food, the restaurant atmosphere, our server.  But fat guy in blue shirt left a bad taste in my mouth upon our leaving.  Too bad, it would've been a perfect breakfast outing.

My wife and I have been going to Dr Holloway for the past 8 years. If you want the very best doctor you have ever had this is the place you need to go. Dr Holloway always takes times with his patients and shows great compassion and has a great personality as well. He  goes far beyond what most folks expect from a doctor. His staff is excellent as well. I could not give a strong enough recommendation for anyone who is reading this review. This is as good as it gets for those looking for someone to take care of them and their loved ones.

LOVED everything about this place!  Great upscale sports-themed pub.  The food was so simple but unique.  Brats, fish tacos, cheese curd appetizers, giant pretzels, philly cheese steaks.  It was all delicious.  The service was amazing and the server provided a lot of information about the place and what they have to offer on football sundays.  There are some games for people to play and plenty of TVs for game day.  Good selection of beers, would like to see some more local ones on tap.  The manager came around and said hi and was also very friendly.  The food came out quickly and was very hot and fresh.  Overall I thoroughly enjoyed my visit here.  I left in a great mood after I had a bad day at work and was very happy we decided to stop in.  We'll back ALOT for sure!

in the rapidly expanding world of breakfast bonanzas in Nashville, Egg and I isn't rocking my world.  In close proximity to Monells encouraging you to slap on some fried chicken for breakfast, Copper Kettle giving you mountains of desserts and J Chrstophers crushing the breakfast scramble, The Egg and i doesn't really excel at anything.  The lines on weekends are long, and the wait for food is also long. A girl wants her caffiene after a long wait and that didn't happen.  The portions were okay but the prices were about 20% higher than what it was worth.
On the plus side, the ingredients were fresh, the place was really clean and fruit was great.  If this were 5 years ago and they were all alone in the breakfast market, this would be a winner, but right now its just falling in the middle of a busy pack.

So I may just be the odd man out but each time I have been here something bad happens.  First time there they spilled water all over me.  They were trying to be fancy and pushed the water glass across the table but it hit something, fell and water went in my lap.  They did apologize but still.

This place is sooo loud inside.  I'm 27 and it was loud as hell.  I could not here the people I was with.  

I got the potato and pickle soup and it was the most disgusting thing I have ever ate in my life.  The worker noticed I did not like it as I only ate about 2 to 3 bites out of a bowl.   He laughed and said its a specific taste and not for everyone.  But he did not offer to do anything about it.  

The ice cream is over priced and you can get better quality at Dairy Queen.  If your younger than 30 you should not go here!

Still a huge fan. Vince and his staff are very friendly, and I seriously can't recommend this place enough.  I work at a client close by, and I think I've been here 60+ times in the past year -- no joke.

My co-workers and I have actually created a list that tracks which sandwiches each of us have had from BCD.  I have actually had 26 of their 35 sandwiches over the past year (including all of their specials), and damn they are good.

My favorites, in no particular order, include:
-Italian Beef (add grilled onions and peppers)
-Muffaletta
-The Veno
-Carmelo
-Delta Bayou
-Fu fu turkey (mainly available in summer)
-Aporkalypse (if you ever see this special, GET IT)
-Mike's Spicy Beef & Cheddar (GET THIS ONE TOO)
I tried their taro bubble tea and shaved ice they were both delicious. Price is very reasonable and they have free wi-fi. lady was very kind (good service) definitely coming back!
25th Street Drop Laundry in Speedway is the best since they employed Kelly.  She is a very helpful woman and interacts with her customer.  Nice touch.

Nothing right in this place except they had a clean restroom. Fries were cold and dark, as they usually are. I ordered a burrito, it took 20 minutes to get it after many people were served in front of me. Service in this establishment SUCKS!!!!!!  Everything in this restaurant needs to change , they need to train and hire people who truly care about their work. they really need to toss out the old food they over cooked and not force it down the throats of their customers. French fries, Beans, Salads, Egg, Taco meat. Im sure the corporate offices would agree, but no one comes out here to correct it. I predict if they don't fix these issues soon, they will close for a lack of customers.
Absolutely fabulous value and the best darn lobster outside of Maine. Friendly service , good food and casual atmosphere. A must for the lobster craver at reasonable prices.

I had hoped for authentic Mexican food, even a Spanish flare to Mexican.  Anyway, no chips or salsa brought out, house margarita was fruity and small, and overall non impressive bland/artsy flavor.  

I ordered the Chili Rellenos,  which the server brought out and asked who was having the "chili dinner".  I've never had a fruity Chili Rellenos, but this one was filled with raisins and pine nuts with very little spice or sauces such as Chili Verde or Rojo.  

My opinion, being raised in New Mexico, and extensively traveling Mexico and Spain was that this was an artsy attempt to upsell Mexican cuisine.   

I heard reactions to the enchilada meal as being very coconut heavy in flavor, and even a Taco Bell Reference.  

If you wanted more authentic Mexican food I'd direct you to the closest Applebee's, Chipotle, Taco Bell...and that's not Mexican food as well.

Interesting store!  Department store returns from around the country: some items look brand new, others slightly worn...but all in good shape.

Didn't find anything for myself, but lots more selection for ladies than men items.  Nice sexy boots - check it out Ladies!
Very small and casual. Counter walk up with sit down and take out options. Fast, kind service. If you are looking for solid, quick, cheap bibimbap, this is the place for you!

This place is great! It's a cute family owned restaurant with authentic Mexican food. The service is quick and friendly. Order the guacamole when you get your chips, it might of been my favorite part!

"Top donuts in the country? "

Okay. Whenever I read something that says "top ten blah blah of something in the us or state of" my wife and I are extremely hesitant because it sounds like a gimmick. After coming to experience this place first hand I can understand why you would make that statement. We visited on a Thursday 10:30amish with a line of 5 people. They don't serve sliders until 11am and this gave us a great opportunity to do both separately.

Ambience:
Alot of character and with a ton of regulars. They were on a first name basis with half the people in the place. Located on magazine st in the garden district. Artsy stuff. Nice street to walk, explore, and shop.

Food:
They categorize their donuts into 3 categories to simplify pricing. Reg/fancy/more fancy. This is brilliant as it speeds up the ordering but they still carry variety on their menu.

Glazed donut 4/5
This was a good, well balanced donut. Not overly sweet but had characteristics of what you expect from a donut. I prefer my donuts a bit under cooked but this didn't change the pillow like texture one would desire. The glaze was delicate yet slept on the donut. It didn't over power it at all.

French Toast donut 5/5
My wife had this one and was very surprised by the balance this donut had. Generally, donuts are rich and over the top in these types of establishments, but the donuts made here tasted like they had a plan and they were going to make it their way and not please us the customer. I have alot of respect for these places.

Fried chicken slider 4/5
Small in stature but tasty, balanced and filling. Don't let this slider fool you. It makes a statement with all the pieces it carries: the slaw was amazing, the chicken fried and seasoned properly, to the pickled jalapeño. Great combination.

Pork belly slider 3/5
This slider is very popular among their clientele. Good slider. Picked onion brings nice tart and cuts richness of the belly, the herbs leaves brings a certain bitterness that contrasted the fattiness of the belly. The belly itself was properly cooked. Slow roasted ahead of time then heated up on the flat top for crust. Seasoned well and you get that concentration of the cure. I would have had less of a dry brine imo, but that's just me. My wife says I'm being picky.

Drink:
Cold brew. 4/5
I enjoyed this and honestly had to settle for this. They normally have the Nitro cold brew but it wasn't working today. On a Louisiana humid sunny day there is nothing like proper iced coffee.

Service:
Friendly but for sure they cater to the locals. They aren't here for tourists and they shouldn't baby the tourists. 5/5

Great location. 

Wouldn't let you sit out on the patio with pups, coffee was pretty bad for what I tried. Maybe they'll come around eventually and I can give it another shot. 

You're in Dunedin, like 98% of places here are dog friendly.

Food: Wife had the grilled vegetable salad (pictured) - we both enjoyed it. Chili cheese fries - it's chili on fries, what more needs to be said? (Yummm!) I had the tri-tip sandwich - A-OK (didn't enjoy as much as some reviewers did, but wife said it was good). 

Atmosphere: this is a cool place worth the stop. If you're deciding whether to have lunch here, definitely DO. 

I would recommend Cold Spring Tavern to anyone traveling north of Santa Barbara. It's a nice pit stop on the way to or from Solvang.

Not happy with my cut. I asked the guy to thin out the top and the back, and not cut any length off the sides at all. 

He cut length off and didn't take any weight off the sides. Exactly the opposite of what I wanted. Plus, the sides are now uneven and awkwardly cut. He took off my apron and said "you're all good man" without even letting me look things over. 

Also, reception was not very nice. Took me forever on the phone to schedule an appointment.

Would not recommend. Looks like they made do a decent job on fades and shorter haircuts, but as far as mid to long hair goes, find somewhere else.

I like Black Sheep. Unfortunately I have negative associations due to hitting the absinthe at Parc a little too hard one night before going and then spent a considerable amount of time in the bathroom. But that is neither here nor there.

Good bar food (the cheeseburger especially sticks out in my mind) and a good beer selection, with a friendly unpretentious clientele, makes this a spot I wish I got to more often. And I hear they have Quizzo? Yes please.

Amazing food and the customer service is even better! I called in to place a to-go order and was left on hold.
