I came in and jokingly made a comment to Aaron (found out later that he's a manager) about being left on hold and told him I will just eat-in instead. Despite the fact that I was obviously in good spirits about it and joking, he immediately apologized and decided to put it on the house. If that's not great customer service, I don't know what is! I seriously wasn't even expecting any accommodations, maybe an apology at most since that's what everyone does anyway, but this place gets it right! Definitely will be back! Thanks Aaron!

One of the worst places in terms of both service and food I have ever been to in my life. Absolutely terrible the waiters and waitresses walk past you as if you don't exist and the food does not warrant such an attitude. Absolutely terrible establishment from the top down. 1000% percent do not recommend.

We didn't dine here, just escaped the best to enjoy a glass of wine and some cocktails while we toured the building. We stopped by this place while on a ghost tour and thought it looked charming. We had a huge lunch so we didn't even look at the menu, but the food being served at the bar looked good. Our two bartenders were fast, friendly and made some great drinks for us. The place is supposedly haunted, great story behind it, but we found this place interesting and beautiful. Would definitely come back for dinner.

The hotel added a new tower recently. Based on the pictures posted here by other reviewers, the old and the new seem to be two different worlds within this hotel.  I want to emphasize that this review covers the new section only. 

The rooms in the Tuscany Tower are luxurious. The marble-clad bathroom alone is as big as some of the rooms in other hotels. There were two SONY flat-panel TVs in the room, ~42" in the bedroom and another ~36" in the bathroom facing the jacuzzi bath tub. Both TVs are set in a picture frame as if they are paintings. Double shower heads in a separate shower stall. The shampoo smells so good that I told my wife to take the unused tube home. The water closet has a lockable frosted glass door so that other members of the family can still use the double sinks while someone is stinking up the W.C. Ventilation in the bathroom is excellent, steam and smell disappears in seconds. While not sleeping, my kids spent more time in the bathroom than the bedroom. :-) 

The bed was extremely comfortable, supportive pillow-top mattress, soft and smooth beddings & sheets and warm blankets. My friend told his wife that their bed at home should be made the same way. Ceiling to floor window with great unobstructed view to the mountains. My friend's room was on the opposite side of the hall and it faced the swimming pool and garden below, great views too. Though the large window is a privacy concern looking in or out. there is always a curtain. Every light switch in the room is a Lutron dimmer switch. We remodelled our home a few years ago and I know these switches cost $40 a piece at Home Depot. I joked to my wife that we would only pay for 2 of these switches everyday we stayed there. 

They have in room safe deposit box. They also have a mini bar and snack tray. They are equipped with sensors. Whenever you "move" any items off their original position, a charge shows up in your bill automatically. We had to call the front desk to undo our kids' curious deeds. Check out is easily done using the TV remote control after you've reviewed the itemized bill on the TV screen. 

Yes, I know the room rate is double of those rooms in the older tower. But I think the luxury is worth every penny. Like every resort hotel in Reno and Las Vegas, they slap on a resort fee on top of the room rate too. 

My wife won a few hundred dollars playing blackjack and roulette in the casino on the first day, but she didn't quit and lost all the winnings before we checked out a few days later. One very big drawback, the casino does not have my wife's favorite "Wheel of Fortune" slot machine. The kids loved the video game arcade too which provided cheap entertainment for the kids. 

A disappointment for my kids was that there was a $35 per person per day charge to use the indoor pool.  Even my kids stopped talking about swimming after they've heard the price.  The outdoor pools seemed to be closed while we were there, but I could see water vapor rising from the pool surface, so the water seemed to be heated despite the "Pool Closed" sign at the entrance.  Anyway, I wouldn't want to swim in the snow even if my kids wanted to.

When I tucked my kids in the night after we came home, one of my kids asked "Daddy, do you miss Reno?" Such comment from a kid says more than this review. :-)

I prefer to get my water needs fulfilled at Costco and me and my sister often find ourselves here on our lunch breaks. They have a great dog food prices as well. 

 Also, let's be Frank. Or, since I'm a female, let's be Alice.....But since my name is Januarie, let's just be Januarie (too much?): They score a 9 (on the great day) on the samples!!!!

I can only speak for this Costco because it's the only one I go to, but they have wonderful samples !!! Some days, the possibility for going in during lunch and coming out full, are high risk. I've had a sample so good that it convinced me to purchase a loaf of fun bread for $17! I call it 'funbread' because for $17, I figured  I own the rights to rename it as I see fit. I can't say that was a bargain....I can't say that excusable even with the sample...hmm...let's move on from there. ...

Costco is great. Their lines are long but they move at a good pace. Great samples. Great buck-banging. OH! HOW COULD I FORGET!!!??!?!? For the BEST Vanilla Ice Cream experience ever, CHOOSE KIRKLANDS!!! Trust me. I trusted a sample and ended up buying out the bar. Ok, I didn't buy out the bar (sounded good), but I did end up getting the ice cream. It's MAGIC Vanilla. I'm not sure what Kirkland's does to their Premium Vanilla Ice Cream but it will forever prevent me from purchasing anyone else's Vanilla. So serious about that.

Good bread. Lol. Strawberry Funbread to be exact.

Dewey's is always consistently good. We frequent it often. We usually get a Bronx bomber and a Hawaiin pizza and they have a great Caesar salad. We add chicken to the salad for a reasonable up charge. It's definitely more expensive than a national chain, but the ingredients taste fresh, and the crust is, simply put airy yet chewy. One thing I love is that it's not in the least bit greasy. I almost feel healthy eating it. Ha!  Its a very family friendly place so my husband tween, baby, and myself feel comfortable. We love Dewey's!

This was one of the most disappointing food experiences during our week-long stay in New Orleans. And let me preface this review: We love soul food. That traditional southern home cooking is something we LOVE. And we visit New Orleans a lot, both for business and fun.

First, the good: my husband ordered the fried shrimp and it was served hot and tasty. If you do go, and don't know what to get, order that.

The red beans and rice was a nice mix of meatiness and savoriness. The sauce is a bit watery, but still flavorful (with a little bit of salt). And the waitress - who was not our server, but ended up taking our order after we waited 20+ minutes for someone to stop by and just take our drink order - was very friendly.

Next, the stuff that was so-so: I ordered the meatloaf and it was ... meh. 

Ok, that's being nice. The brown gravy was pretty decent, and I think the meatloaf would have been better if it had been served hot (or even warm) instead of cold. But because it was cold, it had turned gelatinous. (Think head cheese.)

Now, the bad: We waited at the door for more than 15 minutes for someone to ask if we needed a table. I would have understood if the restaurant was packed - I've worked at restaurants before, I get it when the front of the house is slammed. But the place was at least one-third empty.

Every single server who was working walked by U.S. and didn't say a word. Not one "someone will be right with you" - not a smile, nothing.

The female server who finally sat us (after we were about to leave) was clearly not having a great night. She pointed at the table, tossed us a couple of menus and then left.

We waited and waited. Ok, maybe they're busy in the back. We waited some more. We tried to make eye contact and smile - nothing.

Then, the other server came over and asked if anyone had taken our order. When we said no, she apologized and took our order.

If the food had been terrific, I could have ignored that first part of the evening. But it wasn't terrific. Most of it was bland - and in desperate need of a pinch or more of salt. 

The biggest problem: half the dishes (Mac and cheese, collard greens, meatloaf) were served either barely lukewarm or cold (like it had been pulled out of a walk-in). And the corn bread was really dry. Like no-amount-of-butter-can-save-this dry.

For $55 - which included two entrees and one glass of whiskey - I can say this was a huge disappointment. We've eaten far better elsewhere in town for the same or less. 

Maybe the staff was having a really off night? Maybe they had a new cook in the kitchen? Me, I'm kind of kicking myself for not checking reviews more closely.

Do this every year for our anniversary.  Their food isn't as good as many of the other NOLA restaurants, but it's a nice experience dining on the river.  Their drinks are pricey, but I saw people BYOB so that is one way to get around that.  

Great band and a wonderful overall experience.

I just got back from a fantastic haircut experience at the DeCarlo Hair Salon.  My stylist was Lesley (Leslie? - I'm not sure how she spells it); I found her via yelp reviews on the Salon Ricochet page, where she used to work until recently moving to DeCarlo (thanks for the lead everyone!).  Lesley was AMAZING.  

I went into this appointment with some trepidation.  Two days ago I was butchered by an inexperienced student at the Aveda Institute in Queen Village, and so this haircut was initiated as a recovery mission.  It turned out to be so much more.  I have had long hair for most of my life, so when the student at the Aveda Institute cut the angles way too short (and cut them poorly) I was really upset.  There was just no way for it to stay long.  Even with the too-short layers in front due to the student's bad angle job, Lesley managed to give me the cutest haircut I've ever had.  I don't miss the length at all.  

Lesley is also a great conversationalist and just an all around sweet person.  None of those awkward "what are we supposed to talk about?" pauses.  I've never had such a good experience with a stylist before.  

On a final note, the price wasn't too bad at $47.  I'm frugal when it come to my hair (hence the Aveda Institute cut from hell which cost me $16), so for me to say I feel this haircut was worth every penny is really saying something.
One of the nicest breakfasts that I've ever had up north , not to say that southern cooking is better but it's one of the nicest places I've been

Can't really speak for the brick and mortar location but their booth at the Saturday market is pretty great.  Lines and wait times can get pretty long but there's lots to do and see to bide your time between ordering and getting your crepe.  I typically get the turkey artichoke which is delicious.  I tried the salmon today and that was equally yummy.
Great happy hr deal. The oysters were very fresh. The atmosphere was classy yet down to earth. Drinks were great as well. A definite must do when you're in NILA.

In out burger doesn't seem to be what they used to be. After I got my burger and fries I had to return the fries because they were cold and stiff. Took a bite of my burger while I was waiting. It was cold too. Almost no meat to those burgers anymore either. The help used to be so nice and friendly and polite. The girl was snappy and had a bad attitude.

I am not a Philly native, and perhaps do no have an appreciation for Philly Cheesesteaks. When I moved here everyone took me to their favorite city spot - I had to be polite and lie, because I do not get the point - what's good about eating a sandwich with hard/old bread, gross meat and canned cheese. 

Jack's Steaks and Shakes is not that, good soft and warm bread, good meat, chicken and tuna, with nicer cheeses, including blue cheese, my favorite!

If you expect a traditional Philly Cheesesteak, this is not your place, perhaps a gourmet interpretation of it. I like their fries, soft bread, cheese options and specially, the buffalo chicken. The location is good, new and well maintained, really cool.

I take 2 stars off because of their process/service, each time I go there's something funky with the service.

1. You order, pay and not clear on what to do. Do I sit down, wait at the counter, and after I am done, do I leave the basket on the table or take them back? 

2. Crew seems to change a lot, last time I went and asked for my usual, the girl told me they don't do blue cheese but the guy at the grill overheard me and corrected her. 

3. Another time they messed up our party of four order, food came minutes apart, the wrong sandwiches, etc. 

4. The girl asks you to sit down but then brings two drinks or sandwiches at a time, what about trays. In the process, has to take care of other clients and as a customer you are left waiting for her to finish so I can get my coke.

The place its been open for a few months now, they should've figured a process by now.
If you are looking for really good food and a lot of it I would go here! If you're on a diet maybe stay home  I love their pasta and who doesn't love complementary bread?!
Dave was very responsive to our review and has since "made it right". We will be going back in the near future and are looking forward to it!
Best Philly Cheese Steak Ever! All of us are raving, service a little slow but everyone apologized.

I love Zoes. The food and service is always good. 

The only thing is, it feels a bit over priced for not having a waitstaff, but I suppose you save money from having to tip. A Greek salad, steak kabobs, hummus/pita, and two drinks is around $33

Very Nice looking on the exterior. Our room was awesome! I loved it, especially the Jacuzzi huge tub and the dual shower heads. The beds weren't all that comfy, nor were the pillows. The staff at the check-in were professional, the maid service was outstanding! We were upgraded to a room with a patio, which we loved. Great room for the price. The only comps we got was $5 free casino play. For an hour at Atlantis casino and spending only $40 and winning $300, we got free breakfast buffet and we weren't even using their hotel.. go figure. I would stay here again, especially after seeing the hotels/casinos in the main downtown area. I would also recommend Peppermill, although I believe a stay in the Tuscany tower is a must!!

I've been coming to the IMA for years. Whether I was having a lazy day off and wanted to walk the grounds, waited for a special exhibition, or came during the summer for their outdoor movies. But now I can't afford to come here as often, if at all, as a full time working student. It made me so upset that one of the few free (entertaining) things to do in this city, and something of cultural value, decided to start charging nearly $20 to come in. I completely, completely understand from a financial standpoint, but this is a terrible inconvenience to people who can't afford to do many fun things to begin with. Obviously I don't know the circumstances that led them to this, but it's just a tough reality for me to swallow. I really love you, IMA! Beautiful artwork and grounds.

I came here ONCE & that was all it took for me to never come again. I got acrylic nails & the lady that was doing my nails was on the phone the ENTIRE time. & when she actually DID speak to me, she was completely rude. BUT THIS IS WHY I GAVE 1 STAR:
TWO days after I got my nails done from this place, I was closing my bathroom drawer & my middle one popped right off. never stepped foot in that place again.

The quality of the product is good. I'm giving 2 stars because the customer service is so crappy. I've been in on several occasions over the past year... And 9/10 times the staff have been rude, or too busy talking to each other, on their phones, etc.

What a great stay... Fantastic Staff.. very clean.. I could say 5 stars on many items, and 4 stars on others, but certainly 4.5 would be a fit... Wish they did offer at least one free bottle of water in the room, or have had the mini bar charges added to my bill at check out, but I can call them for another receipt. If you cannot stay at this location then at least stop in and gamble, or dine.. Food is great on the buffett, more choices than you could ever imagine.

Ok how can one not give FD 5 stars? I mean we are looking at donuts and fried chicken, two guilty pleasures combined in one house.

I don't know where FD gets their chicken but wow it is really packed with a lot of meat, you will be full sharing a half dozen (and a donut :) )

Make sure to get their early to get their fancy donuts. Their regular donuts are very good (I mean they are homemade) but those fancy look great.

Best bar in New Orleans.  Walking distance from the hostel we were staying in, and the coolest staff we met.  The photobooth was best, and fits approximately 12 people.  The band playing was great music.  I had no complaints.  I'll be back.

I had my first meal there and it was great! The place was clean,food was so good that I may be inclined to eat there often. Lol staff was nice, slight language issue but not bad at all.so if your looking for something delish! To eat, try my favorite one of the bowls!

Ahhhh. I can breathe easy! I'm loving the non-smoking environment! I walked over to Sam's with a few coworkers and we had a lovely lunch. Breezy and relaxing, a most perfect combination. 

Being on a vegetarian diet, I went with the veggie burger. No bun. Good overall. Hit the spot. Service was pretty speedy which I can always appreciate. Overall, I'll be back.

Mom always says if you don't have anything nice to say don't say it. I loved the great waitstaff and the drinks were yummy - hence the five stars. But check the menu before you visit. It is not like other Korean or Korean inspired restaurants I've experienced in the Philadelphia, NYC  and  Baltimore area. In my experience, the side dishes (Banchan) accompany the bibimbap and other main courses and aren't usually a la carte.  There are usually several accompanying little delicious dishes plus kimchee with most entree choices. This is not like those restaurants and the prices and the a la carte sides were a surprise. I recommend going there to enjoy the drinks and wonderful  service the waitstaff provides. But in the Center City area, I recommend going to Washington Avenue, 10th Street, or Chinatown for a less expensive and more authentic Korean (U.S) dining experience. 

My friend loved the burger option which was well seasoned, spicy and flavorful. He loves spicy food and was happy with his choice. Our waiter, the hostess, the bartender as well as the cooking staff were lovely, friendly and anticipated all of our needs.

This place was amazing from start to finish. First it was easy to make a reservation online, then we arrive and the restaurant is gorgeous. Everything made you as the diner feel transported to a different area, including the music playing softly in the background.

Then we are seated and our waiter was wonderful. He was continuously attentive and had great suggestions on what to order. We decided to split 5 mezza between the two of us. We tried the hummous, taboule, fatteh, fried kibbeh and the batata harra. Everything was great, but the fatteh was beyond wonderful. It was so good that we almost got one for dessert - but we were filled by the end of the meal. I will definitely be returning soon, thanks for a wonderful meal!

Love this place. Food is always delicious with unlimited salad and bread sticks. Service for the most part is good. Love the value for what you get. If I wouldn't get fat, I'd eat here all the time. Wish we had one in Metairie!

This is probably one of my favorite places to eat in the city. My husband and I go here maybe twice a month. They know us by name. They know my parents by name....

I love the pork spring rolls. Not quite as good as my best friend's mom's but still delish. The chicken ones are okay but not amazing. 
 
I LOVE the Pho. I have only been to 3 places for Pho but this one is by far my fave. 

Iced coffee.... ooh I am getting thirsty....YUM!

It used to be a BYOB and we could go in there with a six pack and walk out having had dinner for $25 for the 2 of us... now they sell beer, but it's still pretty cheap. 

Might have to go for dinner tonight because I LOOOOOOOVE it here.

The displays are good and informative.
 Wet here to buy a tv for my husband's birthday tomorrow. A senior lo

Came here for drinks and a little dinner before a show a few weeks back. The atmosphere is perfect for a cozy evening: booths tucked away, arm chairs, a fireplace-- all great! We were, however, really disappointed in the food. My husband got the fish and chips and I got the lamb sliders after reading good reviews about them on here. Fish and chips looked like larger versions of fish nuggets and the lamb, although cooked well, was really underwhelming. It was listed as having "a variety of toppings" but in reality, one had half a piece of bacon, the other some melted and congealed cheese, and the last had absolutely nothing. I had to dip them in ketchup to get any flavor other than meat. For that, I would've just gotten a cheeseburger. Would come back here for a drink but not for food.
Really unique menu, the food and service is fantastic. Make sure you make a reservation before showing up though, waited about an hour and a half to be seated. Overall great experience!!

Dr. Gramling is AMAZING!  She takes the time so that you understand your pet's health and provides great advice and recommendations.  I couldn't believe how much time she spent explaining our sweet Kai's kidney problem, the numbers and tests and what are options were.  She and her staff are the best in the area.  I have been to many other vets and have gone to her for the past 4 years!

First time at a keke's and I will definitely be back (soon)! We went during lunch time, but I had my heart set on breakfast. I went with the basic French toast and it was SO yummy. I asked for an extra side of powdered sugar, but didnt actually need it because they aren't shy with their sprinkle :)
Kids' meals were perfectly sized portions and my kids loved it. I saw the glorious pancakes pass by, and they're on my radar for next time. 
My husband got a burger and fries, which he was happy with. One of the managers, Greg, came by to check on us. He wasn't happy with the quality of the French fries so he brought back a second set without even asking us (and they tasted delicious). 
Our server was sweet, food came out quick and correctly, and the manager was great.

I ate here 3 times during my stay at the Tradewinds as its right on property. Honestly I do not understand all of the negative reviews. Obviously this is a chain restaurant and not s 5 star dining establishment. I really want to rate
This restaurant a 3.5 because I did have one negative experience while. The very young male host during the day was extremely rude to me about the placement of my double stroller which I was trying to keep out of the way. 
Every time my family ate here the server was, however, more then pleasant and helpful. These girls definitely deserve a five star rating. 

On my first visit I ordered a Greek salad with shrimp, then I enjoyed some chicken sliders for lunch, and finally I enjoyed a grilled shrimp entree. For a chain restaurant the food was good!!  My husband also enjoyed everything he ordered. He said the burger was FANTASTIC. It was also very cute that Rice Krispie treats accompanied each child entree. 

We would definitely eat here again.

Initially, I was a little hesitant to immerse myself in a 45 minute class of rowing on an erg; despite my desire to get in shape (feel better & cut body fat), the prospect of such intense cardio seemed daunting.  I decided to give it a try, however; the first five classes were $35.  

My first class was with Laura.  She was an absolutely amazing instructor for several reasons:
1) Before class, she worked through my form with me patiently, making sure I was driving with my legs and keeping my back straight.  She placed an emphasis on form throughout the class, reminding me of how to properly row, so after I was done I wasn't injured.
2) Laura structures the class in such a way that allows each individual to work at their own pace.  For instance, Laura will tell the class to start off at a baseline split-which is different for everyone-then modify intensity from there.  This aspect was very important for me because I started a bit slower to get the hang of it and could work at my own pace while still getting a great workout.  I didn't kill myself.
3)  Her energy motivated the classroom and me especially in a constructive manner.
4)  We weren't rowing the whole time.  She integrated strength movements which gave me a break from rowing, helped work different muscle groups, and overall kept the workout interesting.

The 45 minutes flew by.  I was drenched in sweat and felt great.

As someone who has tried multiple workout regiments, in addition to hot yoga, vinyasa yoga, spinning, running, Row Zone with Laura is the one workout that I genuinely look forward to doing.  The others are good, too, but aren't as interesting and don't provide the same level of cardiovascular intensity that rowing does (this fact is scientifically proven).

To date, I have gone to nearly 20 Row Zone classes.  Rowing, the workout I feared most, ended up being the most user friendly (thanks to Laura) and helped get me in great shape.  I now use rowing as a regular part of my workout regiment and will definitely continue to do so.

I highly suggest this class, especially with Laura!!

Ate inside here a couple of years ago with friends and we loved it and had a blast, great atmosphere. Just ran in and got a couple of things to go and not quite the case. The filet mignon salad medium rare and it came out well done, and once I got back to the hotel I realized there was also no salad dressing, so I won't be eating that. I absolutely love meatballs so I got their classic meatballs, and they were very dense but the zesty tomato sauce was tasty and the mozzarella stick was perfection. I also ordered a side of slaw was also was missing from my bag. Disappointed.

Oh my! Everything we ordered was so SO great. Starting with the margaritas perfectly smooth. The queso was so filling and so yummy. Finished with duck enchiladas, you can not go wrong with this place. I can't wait to come back

I highly recommend this auto shop, they were honest guys who weren't in it to get money but to help a graduate student out by finding the cheapest and best way to fix her car. Thank you guys so much and I would come back in a heart beat!!

Great lunch specials! It can be kind of busy at lunch time so if you are restricted on time it may not be a good choice but the lunch specials are decently priced and are more than enough food. Make sure you get a tiramisu (even if it's to go"!

Super smooth, creamy, delicious frozen custard. Great fruit, sauces, and interesting combinations. *****

Maybe a little pricey for what it is. ***

Good bar, great selection. Absolute killer wings!  Get them extra crunchy with signature sauce.  Wings not your thing, then the pear and gorgonzola sandwich is the best.

Wait, did I not mention the fish and chips?  Best I had since my trip to Ireland.  Lots or both, perfectly fried.  Top notch

The service is top notch.  love them all!

I don't know if we hit them on an off day but... first, our service was mediocre at best. Waitress showed up after about 10 minutes for drink orders. When she brings us the drinks, she says she is going to let us "settle in" and takes off, despite the fact we were ready to order. Five to ten minutes later she comes back for our order. When our food FINALLY came out, almost all of it was lukewarm or cold. I ordered fish and clams, which came with fries- the fish was bland, the clams were way too chewy, and there were enough fries on my plate to feed the entire restaurant. My daughter had salmon that was okay but the rice that came with it was terrible and tasted old. The other family members who were with us had similar issues with their food too. However, they are the type who won't say anything when the food sucks and they get embarassed if I do so I am forced to share my opinion about this terrible experience on yelp. Save your money and go to Long John Silvers... you could easily have the same quality food for way cheaper there. Worst Joe's Crabshack I have ever been to.

Employees try to avoid eye contact in order to pretend you're not there. I waited 5 minutes at the counter only to have no one approach me to take my order. I departed letting them know that I would put in a complaint. No surprise, no one got back to me on my complaint.

I had a reservation for weeks to move across the state. The night before the scheduled pick up, they call and say they have no truck for me and to call customer service. I called them and they were equally unhelpful. Waiting until the last minute, they almost guarantee you will not find a truck anywhere else. 

Beware renting from them. They have no care for their customers. The truck I did see was very dirty with hair and cigarette butts after having been "cleaned."

I have always enjoyed Sam's, particularly when craving a burger or chicken tenders while sitting on the terrific patio watching Hillsboro Village walk by.

The only reason I haven't really visited more often until now has been that even while sitting on the patio, you could still smell the smoke wafting in from the bar.

But no more... yelpers... Sam's Hillsboro Village is now smoke free!  Hooray!

And if you haven't visited before and are thinking oh... another sports bar... whatever, I understand.  I'm not a sports fan, couldn't even tell you what season it is to be honest other than March.  How could you not know March Madness is going on?

The folks at Sam's Sports Bar are incredibly nice and incredibly generous.  I work for Big Brothers Big Sisters in Nashville, and Sam's/Sperry's (common ownership, in case you didn't know) are some of the most generous of any of the area's eateries having helped out our agency time and time again.  I like to patronize local places that support local interests - and they definitely fit the bill.  

Pick a warm afternoon and play hooky while hanging out on the patio, then you'll understand.
Got a wonderful burger on a soggy, white Wonder Bread-type bun--didn't taste like any brioche I've ever had. Very disappointing.

The owner Andre is very nice, polite, and welcoming.  Restaurant is very clean and  has a very relaxed atmosphere.  I was in Tampa for 4 days on business.  The first time I went there, I had the spicy meat pie and the sampler plate that included jerk chicken, stewed goat, and stewed oxtail.  The second time, I had just the stewed oxtail.  Both times, the food was absolutely amazing.  I will be back in Tampa next month and will definitely be going back.

Was just OK, I don't think its a tourist trap. I think a lot of regulars go there. For $10.99 you shouldn't expect to much for your basic Chinese Buffet. Other option is a McDonald's meal for $7. Four more dollars you can go back for 2nds, 3rds, and soft serve ice cream.  

Decor - 3 stars, was decent 
Taste - 3 stars, don't expect anything to wow you
Service - 3 stars, good service
Value - 3 stars, again not the best food, but again not the most expensive.

I would give less than one star if I could. To start all the tables were dirty. Even the ones ready to be sat were disgusting.
Next, The service was terrible from the bar to actually sitting at a table. They server never checked on us and took forever to come to the table to take our order. Everyone there was rude, if you smiled at any of the workers they would just look away
Then, the food. It took 35 min for a meal that was probably prepared in the microwave. They weren't busy either. The pictures were deceiving on he menu and my food was gross. 
I got the prim rib n mac sandwich

I love a clean car and could never clean my car myself as well as they do at Cardinals Car Wash. For around $20 you get an outside wash, dry, wheel shine, interior vacuuming, inside and outside window wash, and dashboard cleaning. 

I am a satisfied customer every time and believe it's worth the money given the fact that it would take me hours to make my car look that clean inside and out. I am in and out in less than 30 minutes. 

FYI the detail guys do expect tips. There's usually 2 guys detailing at once so I usually give a few bucks each. 

Keep an eye out for their early bird specials and coupons. Be sure to grab a frequent wash punch card to get a free basic wash on your 7th visit!

Best wash in town hands down.

Justice is amazing at this new Gem in South Mount Juliet. Best Indian food evah! The butter chicken and the Chicken Tikka Marsala provide layers of flavor only Persis can deliver. The lunch specials come with a small soup (Du Jour), an appetizer (vegetarian or not), an Entree (Vegetarian or not), and plenty of Na'an (Garlic, butter, or plain). 

The decor is very modern, but don't be afraid fellow southerners... This place is flavor town on hot pursuit.

Prices are really good. Probably not great for kids, as ours normally eats mac and cheese.
You would want to call ahead for a group as there's not an over abundance of seating.

So good!  Visited on a Wednesday evening for dinner. We both had "regular" Cuban sandwiches (our first ever) and they were SO good.  Next time I will go for the "mini" as the "regular" was pretty big!  I got yellow rice as a side which was okay but my husbands plantains were really good.  A young girl took our order and served us and she was incredibly friendly. Loved the shot of cuban coffee at the end. We'll be back!

I was super disappointed after trying Eddie's this morning. First of all, they have mostly cake donuts which I am not a fan of, but I can't fault them on that. When I walked in people were yelling and I was a bit freaked out. I got a dozen donuts because I'm not going to go to a donut place and not get a dozen. The price was good.  The filled donuts were barely filled. The chocolate cream filled donut was pretty good, just had hardly any filling. The custard was really gross in the one I ate so I guess in that way I'm glad it wasn't filled with more.  The price was good, the donuts were ok. Maybe it was just a bad batch because so many people on here seem to love it, but I won't be back to see.

AWESOME INDIAN FOOD!!! Had the Chicken Vindaloo (Indian hot) and my friend had the butter chicken and both were AMAZING. 

Definitely different tastes but the chicken vindaloo was recommended by the server and it had potato and peppers. I got it Indian spicy but it wasn't hot enough so I got it even hotter. The butter chicken had a creamy flavor profile. The garlic naan is also to die for! Yum! 

I am from out of town but this place was delicious! Definitely can't wait to come back!

I happened to have a day off last Friday and decided to treat myself to some sushi for lunch.   I had not yet been to Tomo and it was floating on my wish list for several months, so I made it a priority.  
Remember that scene in Wizard of Oz where Dorothy catches a glimpse of Munchkinland for the first time?   That was kind of the same thing here.   I went from a fairly nondescript strip mall up on Keystone to the magical and mysterious interior of Tomo.    Ok, it wasn't the same as going from black and white to color, but it was in the same neighborhood.   
The service was outstanding and I felt at ease the whole time I was there.  
I went with a straightforward sushi lunch with a variety of sushi offerings with a delicious salad to start me off.  Having mostly enjoyed "Supermarket Sushi" for the past 6 months or so, it was nice to be able to take those tastes to the next level - there is a difference when the sushi isn't trapped in a little plastic box with little plastic grass.   
All in all, a wonderful experience.   The meal was a great value at lunch and I can't say enough about the service.   As evidenced by the many smiling pictures of patrons on the wall as you walk in, I'm not alone in my review of Tomo.  
I will be back!

Weekend brunch! Who doesn't like unlimited mimosas for 2 hours to kick off their day? Server was very attentive too, and we never had an empty glass. Good variety to choose meals too, from omelettes to pizzas

I assume this is a classic honky-tonk dive. I chose this place because the sign out front said "Nashville Hillbilly Music". The music was great - solid musicians, pretty broad repertoire for requests, and the sound was great. even from way in the back we had an okay view.

Western Village is more of a locals casino but it's much better than the other locals casinos in town.  Over the past couple years, they have renovated all their restaurants and casino.  It looks a lot classier than it did and it's more clean and open.  The table games are cheap which is nice and they have lots of slot machines.  They have a good variety of restaurants including a good steakhouse, a coffee shop, a quickserve, and a mid-range restaurant.  From the outside, the hotel doesn't look all that great but I've never been inside to judge.

I really wanted to like this place and I'm feeling sad. 

Made reservations for birthday dinner. Everyone was very friendly, great service and ambience... At first. 

We ordered a bottle of wine and 2 appetizers the Fritto Misto and the Burrata. I wanted to take my time, have some wine and try the food before I selected an entree. The appetizers were underwhelming to say the least. They were fine, we ate them... But I really wasn't impressed.  Nothing seemed fresh, and I was beginning to have a bad feeling about ordering an entree. 

Instead my guy ordered an entree and I got a salad and I'm so glad I did. He ordered the Cioppino and it just wasn't good. It wasn't warm enough, the broth had no flavor, and the seafood wasn't right. I HATE sending things back but it really wasn't good. The server said he would talk to the "owner" to see what could be done. They offered to replace it with another entree. I'm sorry but after two apps, a salad and an entree all being sub-par, I don't want to waste any more of your food or my time. 

Maybe we ordered the wrong things, or that was just an off dish. The problem came when for the rest of the meal we got sideways looks from the staff and the server gave us forced apologies. I even apologized and explained that we did not want to be insulting but genuinely did not enjoy the food.  They didn't charge us for the entree, which was appreciated. But we still spent over $100, left hungry, and on my birthday I felt like an inconvenience instead of a guest. 

We like to spend money on food... Just not mediocre food. We went somewhere else and had excellent food for less.

Everyone is so friendly here! This is a tiny shop with only about 3 seats if I can remember, so you'll probably make your item to go! The items I picked (chocolate chip cookie & pineapple upside down cake) were super delicious! They barely made it from the walk here to my car.

Let me start with our hostess. I didn't get her name but we walked in with one in our party who is allergic to shell fish she went back to kitchen and made sure that he would be perfectly safe. Then our server MARK this man knows and loves his job. He recommend the boiled shrimp and I played this shrimp heads but they were amazing he also recommend fried crawfish oysters ham and cheddar sandwich and the mahi mahi we ordered all of it and holy cow it was amazing I recommend this place to everyone great staff great food great atmosphere.

I believe this place offered authentic Mexican food.  With that said, there were a few red flags.  First of all, we had trouble ordering.  I do not speak a bit of Spanish, and our waitress, and all staff in proximity did not speak English.  This was awkward.  There was also an issue with a smartphone-based coupon, which was kind of the entire point of going there in the first place.  After a young girl who worked in the adjoining grocery store came over, she advised me that it was her manager's policy that all discount codes had to be physically printed out.  She laughed at me when I told her that it wasn't my problem that they have weird rules for discounts.  She quickly believed that she had stalemated me with 'It's not my problem, either.', and I was laughed at.  When I informed her that it wasn't funny, I was told that the discount would be applied.  

Here comes the food.  It was good; it tasted good, it was priced-well, and the order was accurate.  I noticed 2 things - about 5 feet away from me, a waitress was very clearly picking her nose.  Also, she had a finger in her mouth for no less than 45 seconds.

The ambiance seemed like a practical joke.  Authentic music was supplied via tinny PA speakers that had a source supplied from a laptop playing Youtube videos.  The televisions were strangely lined with a thick layer of Saran wrap.

All-in-all, I'd avoid this place in the future.
These guys are awesome! Super fast, very professional, and really explain the details. Would highly recommend!

Not even with a coupon was this haircut worth it
I've taken the scissors to my own hair 3 times to even it out!
Worst worst haircut EVER
(Stylist = LaPaulla)
Not coming back

We were looking for a place for breakfast yesterday while in the area and came across the Stargate Diner.  After quickly reading the reviews, I must admit I was a bit worried but the parking lot was pretty much packed (not bad for a Monday mid-morning!) so I figured how bad could it be!?!

Our party of five was seated right away and coffee was served quickly. Once we placed our orders, our food came out within about ten minutes and with the exception of having to ask for the bacon we had ordered and one order of toast being missing, everything was hot and fresh and just as we ordered.  

I had no complaints about my Western Omelet and my daughter and my mom both enjoyed the Spanish Omelet.  My stepdad had the Country Omelet (I think that's what it was called) and my husband had a platter with eggs, home fries, pancakes, sausage and bacon.  We had no problems whatsoever with the food - it was right up to par with other diners/breakfast joints.

I didn't see any other customers complaining about anything - everyone seemed perfectly content - so I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this place.

Chick-Fil-A opened and traffic is awful!! My co-worker and I walked over from work and got some fries. It took about 10 minutes to get the fries; which wasn't bad when you saw the line inside and outside.

Basically, if you are in a hurry, go to the veterans location - this one is going to be busy for a while!

This is the best place to go for glasses in the city! They have a gorgeous selection of designer frames, great prices, and awesome service. I am really picky with frames, and there were multiple pairs I liked. I also never  got my glasses back so quick before from other doctors, normally I wait 2 weeks this only took 2 days!!! The doctor is great too. They have the latest technology and eye exams. He was super thorough. I think I'm going to go back for a pair of prescription sunglasses! I really recommend giving them a try!

I love this place!  Great service, fantastic food, awesome cocktails and wine... You can't go wrong. Order the bread pudding...no other dessert... It is a religious experience! Best bread pudding I have ever had!!!

Omg, the worst Japanese restaurant I had in my life. One star for the grilled squid appetizer only. The rolls are okay but still bad. They show the walking dead on TV when we are having lunch, so gross! I don't know why people have such high reviews for this place and I will never return.

Prompt service, albeit a little creepy. A member of the wait staff was constantly looking at my table (for the first 20 minutes of my parties meal we were the only people dining). I took a sip of water and blam! somebody was there to refill.

Their sushi is pretty good and relatively cheap. Their pineapple fried rice is out of this world.

This is the best little bar around. The hospitality and people are friendly. The hurricanes are the best. Ray is the coolest guy there if we are ever in town will definitely visit this again and do the swamp tour. Thanks ray!!!

This place has the best drunken noodles and tom yum. I always ask for everything every spicy and they make it spicy and also give me their homemade hot sauce to add to it. 

Their lunch specials have to be the best in the city you get salad, appetizer and main for 8-10 dollars. It is a really good deal especially because it is really tasty.
This place is super cute and homey! Really good food and super fast! Will definitely order from here again!

I'm not the biggest snowball fan but whenever I'm remotely near New Orleans I make a point to come here! The ice has a significant and great texture. And the syrup isn't just sugar water with food coloring. The staff treats snowball creation like a culinary staff. However I will add never come here if you're rushing cause it's always packed!

Henry's on East Street is a great place to grab a bite to eat and chat with a friend.  It's a small coffee shop with sandwiches, bagels, baked goods, etc.  The coffee is real good and a real bargain compared to Starbucks down the street.  It's out of the way enough that most of the customers are locals.

Last night we celebrated Stephanie's rehearsal dinner at Barone's. It is situated right next to a dry cleaners with an outdoor patio to its left. 

First impression, it was a rustic feel with an open restaurant feel. BYOB. We had a party of 25 and were nestled in a beautiful area in the back of the restaurant. Equipped with a soda fountain and long table set up for the adult beverages.

First, was a pasta course. Penne in vodka sauce and one in red sauce, served family style. Then came the pasta in a vinaigrette dressing with their homemade bread. The bread was warm and fantastic. Each table had their own olive oil with red pepper flakes, salt, pepper and parm cheese. 

The options were chicken Marsala, chicken parm and salmon. They came with garlic mash and green beans. The entrees were nothing special.

I really enjoyed the atmosphere and the service. I would come back here for a sit down meal with the lady.

I had a terrible experience with Homejoy - I purchased a groupon (paid in full in advance) cancelled my regular cleaners and scheduled recurring appointments through your website online. 2 hours prior to my appt the cleaning professional had 'car trouble' and cancelled. I am hosting a party in my home in less than 24 hours and the customer service reps (after sitting on hold over 15 minutes to try and get through) left me high and dry with nobody available to come yesterday or at any time today (I was trying to be flexible). I am going to give this company one more chance (but only because the pleasant supervisor Tasia gave me enough of a free credit to do so) However, I would HIGHLY recommend staying with your regular cleaning service.  Reading all of the reviews online, this company has a terrible record of no-shows - and to me, that's completely unacceptable.

Elizabeth is the best stylist if you like blonde hair! She color corrected my hair and made it the neutral blonde with lowlights that I always wanted. I am attaching before and after photos. What made it so great too was her warm, friendly personality plus! I thought I had good color before, but Elizabeth blew everyone else out of the water with her skills. The pictures say it best! Also, wonderful Bown crossing location with soft plentiful natural lighting. I saw parking places right out back the whole time I was there. Sure beats traffic. My new regular stylist Elizabeth is the best I've had. My hair is now SO pretty! She's not done yet, I had a lot of orange in my hair.

Really bad place to go, un organized , not clean, first of all when we arrived we had no way getting in because nobody told us the code to get in the street door. The office is only staffed during the day. The place was not clean and had no clothes hangers when we got there the keys were posed to be in some box in court yard, but our envelope was out of the box laying there was one key missing. On the good side great location air conditioner worked great, but It had a bathroom and bedroom up a narrow spiral staircase with the closet downstairs. We were in the older units in the back so it was very quiet for us even in the morning. Late at night when we walked from Bourbon Street up to our place,  it seemed a little eerie, but we were told by others, it's not a bad area. Your real close to the local hang out area of Frenchman and farmers market. If you're used to staying in a clean hotel or motel with service available it's not your place. But if you're into something that's  old and historical it's a cool place. But when you open and close your door to get in to your room they are old and not very secure easily can be pushed in.
visiting town and this is the best coffee place! fun and friendly and great coffee..the locals with their dogs really added to the fun atmosphere.! will be back!

If you care about what you put in your body and like food that is well thought out, this is a place for you. Big bonus - fantastic beer. Where can you go for great beer and food that is made with a conscience? 
The fries were crispy, burger oh-so juicy and delicious, hot chicken sandwich - amazing! All locally sourced. This place deserves a "Real" Certification. (https://eatreal.org/ )

The best pancakes I have ever had!!

Everyone in our group loved their breakfasts- chocolate chip, peach, ligonberry, and pecan were all fantastic!  The hashbrowns were perfect, too!

The only downside is that there is always a line out the door- get there early and be prepared to wait- it is worth it!!!
This was my second time visiting this place and while the food was good, I thought it wasn't good enough to warrant coming back here yet again, especially since this is quite a pricey place.

I had dinner here at 7PM on a Sunday.  Made a reservation, although there were tables available.  We were seated right away.

I was extremely impressed with the variety of choices on the menu.  Service was very quick, and we both enjoyed the dishes.  Both the bruschetta and bread that was provided, along with the main dishes, were great and served promptly.

I would definitely come again.

This guy is great! My Samsonite 360 degree rolling bag lost a wheel on the last trip and of course I was devastated (these bags are fantastic! my son loves to ride on top and you can easily drag this bag to hell and back), in a weeks time he got the wheel replaced and it looks like new ($35), the bags worth ($120), I have also had him do zipper work on handbags -great work and very fair prices. the parking can be annoying but it is worth it.

Took our dogs to have their shots at the vetco clinic inside Petco. I thought it might be a cheaper option as we had moved to the area recently and did not want to drive back to the vet. It was not cheaper and in the end, I still have to go to the vet, pay for the visit to get the prescription our dog needs. 

So if you think that this is a good option, think again. Just Don't It!!!
Best blueberry muffin I have ever had! They are flaky and perfectly warmed. They use the freshest produce. The cappuccinos are amazing! It's not bitter and not overly heated.

I've been renting from them for 2 1/2 years & haven't ever really had much of a problem with them. They're unobtrusive & respond quickly to maintenance calls. The only thing they don't really bother with is towing the cars that are parked in the wrong parts of the lot, which gets frustrating, but aside from that, they've been pretty good. It remains to be seen how they'll treat me when I leave next month & what kind of return I'll get back, but I've enjoyed my apartment these past 2 years. However, I moved to Indy quickly & didn't have much time to shop around. If I would've had longer, I would've seen that there are other historic apartments with great features  in the same price range that also have at least a balcony. There's not really any outdoor area aside from the front lawn( which dog owners frequently don't clean up after their dogs on) & other places have pools,gyms, or elevators. The only amenities here aside from the arched doorways, original woodwork, updated kitchens & baths, & hardwood floors are the gated lot & that there is laundry facilities on site. I know that a lot of the Stallard properties feature similar amenities & designs, so that's why I mentioned the features my building (The Barrington) has.

OPEN TIL 3 AM for those late night hunger crawls! BUT be willing to throw some bows because this small little fast food joint is PACKED in the wee hours of the night

it's an extra $2 for specialty fries
---garlic parmesan: SKIP so soggy after being tossed in olive oil & cheese..gross
---truffle fries: nice & crispy, the winner of the night!

you can choose your sauces for dipping the fries.. i liked the spicy fry sauce much more than the white "house" sauce.. i think those are the 2 most popular ones

i wouldn't go out of my way to try 500 degrees in phili but IF you're craving fries after a night at the bars, might as well

I have been coming for my annual appointments here for more then 12 years. Sick visits,  annual visits and emergency appointments. I love how organized they are at the front desk area. Staff is friendly and easy to chat with.

The new space here is very clean, bright and beautifully equipped with state of the art medical equipments. Private rooms are large and spacious.

Doctors and nurses here are great. I have not had any bad experiences here. I have always had all of my medical concerns addressed as I called or came in for a visit. Over the years I have had met a few of the doctors and nurses and all were pleasant, knowledgable and very warm to talk to.

I'd highly recommend making an appointment. Great doctors, nurses, assistants and front desk staff.
Delicious. Good vibe. A bit expensive. A bit too small. But I just had a really good breakfast so I'm happy.

This was our third trip to the Prime Rib.  As on our two other dinners we were not let down on the quality of service.  Our meal was exceptional.   Our waiter Tony was very friendly and helped us with our meal selection and wine selection.  We visited the Prime Rib during their prime rib special.  The atmosphere is phenomenal.  It was well worth the trip.   We intend on dining here again.

Porcini is our favorite local dinner place and we hope to be considered regulars soon. It's is owned and operated by two brothers and I love how personable and attentive they are. We are always greeted at the door by David with a handshake, hug and a big smile and great to see you! And you can usually see Steven in the front of the house by the end of the night too!
The ambiance is very quaint and tiny but in an adorable and very familial way. Everyone feels like family and that's how you are treated. Reservations are helpful but waiting on Sansom street is pretty and not too bad either. 
The food is absolutely out of this world delicious. I often have a hard time getting something different because of how much I'm craving whatever I had last time (typically the ravioli in pecorino sauce) but when I try other peoples dishes I realize I absolutely cannot go wrong. The bolognese, oso bucco, caprese, creme pastry are all to die for. I've really never tasted anything here without uttering the words "that's delicious!" Immediately after. 
We love Porcini and cannot wait to go back as frequently as possible!

Food was ok, not worth the money. Over priced version of red robin. The beers on tap tasted like plain Jane craft beers. I had the burger and it was dry and over cooked. My wife had the prime and the aujus sauce was overly salty and we could barely eat it. And that's coming from a guy that loves salt. Service was great but not good enough to keep me coming back.

I am a little late in my review, but I attended their media event/grand opening for the unveiling of their "Legends Wall" which proudly showcases sports legends such as Lee Roy Selmon, Ronde Barber, Eddie DeBartolo and more. I sampled many of their signature items and was extremely impressed with the service I received at the bar. The bar staff is awesome and attentive. The entire place is beautiful and if I lived closer, I would be a regular. Food is delicious and I left deliriously happy.  My night ended on a sweet note with having the opportunity to meet Ronde himself.  He was super kind and took time to sign autographs. If you are looking for an upscale casual sports bar in Carrollwood, look no further.

Had the special broiled grouperand chips.   Husband had the fried flounder and chips.  Breading was very light.  Both were delicious!  Food came out piping hot!!  Fish very fresh.  Cole slaw was just ok.
Highly recommended!

Don't underestimate this place. It may be in the bottom of a hotel, but it surely rivals any other restaurant in this area. We came here for breakfast on a Monday. I had the two eggs and style with turkey bacon. My friend had the eggs Benedict and both were delicious. It's in a great location and had a great atmosphere. I was extremely satisfied with my entire meal and service.

We have been dining at Rode's for several years.  Last year we had a very pleasant New Year's dinner.  This year, 2016, not so much.

The pork was dry, the bus staff was mouthy, the drinks had very little alcohol in them.

The waitress was edgy.  

Sad, because we've had pleasant experiences in the past.

Great place to bring the kids, purchase farm goods and some decorations, local products, etc.  Visit before another housing development crushes it!  Love the jar goods and crunchy snacks. Many baked goods.  Pick your own and activities for the kids.

I could not have ask for a better dining experience! The food & service exceeded my expectations and I will definitely be going back.

The decor of the restaurant is beautiful... small, cozy and classy. Do make reservations, this place is making a name for itself in the Chestnut Hill. Our waitress was very friendly, knowledgeable and couldn't have done a better job. The manager also came out and introduced herself and welcomed us to the restaurant, which was appreciated because this was our first time there. 

There menu apparently changes during the season, so I would suggest going online and visiting their website to see what they are serving before making arrangements. Also, if you're a wine drink, it's BYOB... so pick up a nice bottle of wine on your way there!

I can't believe I have passed this spot many times and never went in. Thankfully we finally decided to get some food here and I'll def be going back for more. I got a shrimp tostada sandwich and we also got the shrimp/scallop fajitas. Both were really yummy. Staff was great and friendly too. Found a New Mexican spot to go frequent and it's close by!

Taco Tuesday. The ahi tacos that I always get were either overcooked or just plain bad today. Strange because they are normally fantastic. Today they were completely white/ tan color instead of slightly pink in the middle, were stringy, and left an unusual fish aftertaste that I've never noticed before when enjoying their ahi tuna. I guess I'll do brisket next time. My check also didn't show the half price tacos... So make sure to check your bill. They have so many specials that are different every day, it may be hard for the bartenders to keep up (or they just aren't happy with the half price meal deals they are offering).

A little pricier than your average bar food but it came extremely quick, was cooked perfectly  and the bartender was friendly as hell and our drinks never got past half empty. . Will return if I'm ever in the area again. Try the Chipotle chicken sandwich... bomb!
Aveda products, friendly staff...great for a quick cut at a reasonable price!

I live nearby and this place is always very busy. Many of my friends love their pizza. Maybe I'm pickier, growing up on the east coast. While their sauce and toppings are tasty, I am not a fan of their crust. I also find the salads quite ordinary. I prefer Crushed Red's flatbreads, Pi's crust or Racanelli's authentic pizza.

convenient location, cramped and dangerous parking lot. comprehensive selection-with no prices listed- arranged haphazardly in cramped aisles with no one in sight to help you find anything. drove over an hour on the basis of their websites assertion of 'in stock' on a highly rated seasonal (once  a year) beer...upon arrival was informed 'it'll be in next week' and 'we only get four cases anyway so we sell it by a lottery'..'but the website said'...'i just work here, i'm  not the owner'....and i just shop here and will never be back....

I called the Drain Team on a Monday morning due to a stopped up sink pipe beyond the J turn.  They picked up the phone on the first try (what are you serious?  Yes this is an actual operation).  The operator apologized that she could not dispatch someone within the hour because of their morning workload (I had already told her this was not urgent).  Dan, the man, showed up in 2 hours.  He delivered a fair estimate, completed the work (it took longer than estimated and I WAS NOT CHARGED), suggested additional work for the future, and completely cleaned up any mess.

I just moved to St Petersburg and am quickly discovering how many really sucky house vendors are floating around.  In a sea of suckitude, the Drain Team was a breath of fresh air.

I was very disappointed to see that the casino is charging $10 to park.  I think they're making a huge mistake.  This is by no means a "destination" or upscale casino.   There is really nothing there except a second rate casino.  The restaurants are average at best.  
I read the casino's response to other yelpers commenting on the parking fee.  Claiming that it's to improve security is definitely something I don't want to hear.  What casino doesn't make security a number one priority?  Whether or not they are charging a parking fee should have no bearing on the level of security they are providing to their guests.

As you know, today is the day of our #ProtectPublicEd/American Legislative Exchange Council Rally and Protest. One event planned for today was to show the documentary Education Inc about the movement to privatize public schools. We had reserved a meeting room in the JW Marriott where ALEC is meeting to show the film. Imagine our surprise yesterday when the JW Marriott called to inform us there had been a mistake and they would be unable to honor our reservation for a meeting room.

As I sit here at the bar desperately trying to get my waitress attention  I can't help but think back to a time when Luke had really great service. I love this restaurant. The food never disappoints . I have been here countless times.  But the service is to be desired. Ive had cocky waitress's, who love to talk over you when asking a question to next to little attention at times at the bar. And no not during happy hour either. Mr. Besh you need to spend some time there.

I went here on New year's and it was p
PACKED, the waitress was really nice, because of yelp we got a free appetizer. We didn't really need the extra food because the burgers and fries were HUGE! My husband got a personalized burger and ended up paying something close to $20 (not worth it, really) and I went with a regular menu burger and my check was close to maybe $15. The burgers were regular, nothing special, the place was nice but the location is great, we finished eating and kept on walking around the city.
Lots of vegetarian options and egg sandwiches all day. Decent lunch counter kind of place - nothing to wrte home about but good quality for your money.

Okay, so this time I made reservation for Girl's nightout on Wednesday. We didn't have to wait that much, we enjoyed their wine, food,  cheese and chocolate fondou. Our server was very friendly and she definately helped us a lot on selecting our menu, and everything was delicious. 

We probably stayed about 3 hours here, eating and talking. We were all dressed up, restaurant was beautiful, the mood was great. So I had a great time with my girls.

We've been here twice and thought it was pretty good each time.  Both occasions, we ordered the fisherman's platter (or something like that, not sure of the exact name) with fried grouper, cod, clams, then coconut shrimp and butterfly shrimp + fries and lots of tartar sauce, cocktail sauce, and a delicious coconut sauce for the coconut shrimp.  It would be nice if you have the option to have some of the items grilled instead.  Service is pretty good, and atmosphere is ok- patio is nice!

I always love going here.  I think it's the best Cajun place in the Indianapolis area.  I've had the pork po'boy a couple of times and it always great.  You've gotta get the hush puppies if you go, they're excellent.
Great atmosphere, awesome service, and specials that are out of this world! Byob and reasonable prices. Be sure get a reservation early there is limited seated.

I get massages fairly often and this was my first time at Rescue. Did a 90 min deep tissue with Meredith and it was just tremendous. She's got a great touch, and really works out the knots.

On the other hand, my gel manicure was a bit of a mess. There are sloppy touches remaining (e.g. Paint on my fingers) and she didn't apply sunscreen before the gel light exposure (dangerous). A tiny hand massage was nice but this was a very no frills experience and expensive at that.

This review is long overdue as we are frequent patrons of this great Neighborhood Place. I have never had a bad meal at Dagwood's. We love the lunch menu selections which include a serving of soup and salad from the self-serve bar.  Their Lobster special from 12 to 5 with a 1-pound steamed lobster, corn on the cob and boiled potatoes is fantastic and a great deal at $15. Their crab cakes, tuna sandwich, burgers, and any Seafood with pasta are consistently excellent. Service is always attentive and prompt. Thank you for being in the neighborhood, Dagwood's,  and we will continue to be regulars!

This was my first time ordering from here. The food was fresh and delicious. I only gave four stars because it took a while to be cooked. I ordered hot wings and a supreme pizza. I will be going back!!

Went here for early dinner with 3 of my friends about a week ago. We asked for a table and the host immediately asked to see all of our ID's. Now, not all of us are 21, and none of us even were planning on drinking at all. Maybe this is standard for manyunk or something since it's a bit of a party area, but i've never had this happen to me anywhere. It was awkward and seemed like they didn't want us there( the place was basically empty at this time, btw). This kind of made me want to leave but I was hungry and like I said the place wasn't busy. Now, i'm not normally that crazy about Mexican, mainly because i'm a somewhat picky eater, but i'm trying to be more adventurous. We explained that we just wanted something to eat and they dropped it and seated us. We were given chips & salsa to start which were pretty good. They have different specials on different days of the week and the day we went was something like $6 quesadillas. So, I figured I'd try that. The quesadilla was probably the best I ever had! It was great and really flavorful. Our waitress was fine, not memorably great or bad. Not sure if I would come back here just to eat because of the awkward seating thing, but like I said the food was very good.

If fighting against discrimination matters to you, DO NOT go to the Ace Hotel.  Do not give them your money or your business.

Last night, what started off as a nice evening at the Ace Hotel's rooftop pool area, Alto, became a cause for me to leave due to feeling unsafe.  The rooftop area is currently advertised as open to the public.  I live in New Orleans and had heard great things about the new hotel, so a few local friends and I decided to go check it out.

As I relaxed at the rooftop pool with a few friends, I watched a group of three Black men approach the entrance to the pool area. A white woman with a short, close cropped haircut guarded the entrance, and I watched her talk to the three men for several minutes as they tried to enter the pool. She turned them away, and as the three Black men turned to walk away, a group of 7-8 white people approached the entrance. The white woman guarding the entrance immediately granted them access.

I approached the woman at the entrance and, attempting to give her the benefit of the doubt, asked what time the rooftop pool area was closing. Over an hour remained before the pool would be closed and all guests would be asked to leave. I told her I had just witnessed her turning three of my friends away from the entrance even though the pool was not about to close. She said the pool area was "at capacity" and that no one else could enter. I told her I witnessed her allow a group of 7-8 white people enter the area immediately after she turned the three Black men away. The men had watched her allow this larger group to enter. She revised her previous statement, claiming that when the pool is at capacity, only guests at the hotel are allowed to enter the pool area. She had not asked the white group for any form of identification or hotel guest cards before granting them access.  Furthermore, with capacity requirements, you're either at capacity or you're not.  "At capacity" should be a black and white term (although in this case, the Ace Hotel staff seemed to enforce this rule from a racial standpoint).  This woman looked me dead in my eyes and confidently lied. As I left the pool area and the hotel, she allowed two more white women to enter without proving that they were hotel guests.

I will not return to the Ace Hotel, and I will tell everyone I know, including New Orleans locals and friends traveling to the city, about this appalling, discriminatory incident.

OK - So I was in Philly on a short vacation and decided to go here for a good steak. BOY, Was I happy with that decision.

I am a lover off all things beef - especially prime rib. So I decided that I had to order a prime rib, afterall, that is the restaurants namesake. 

The steak was HUUUUUUUUGE. Biggest prime rib I have ever encountered. Now, I know what your thinking.... "Sure, it was big, but was it cooked right and did it taste good?" YES. I resounding - YES.

The food was 100% excellent - worth every penny. 
Don't tell management but I would have paid more!

CONS:
Only 1 - decor. This place looked like it was right out of The Godfather. It was all decked out in black with gold highlights and mirrors. Was kind of funny actually. 

PROs:
Everything else. Seriously, if you want a great steak and are in or are anywhere near Philly - go here. Don't waste your time with anywhere else. 

I am seriously considering driving down (2.5 hours) just for dinner again.

Just got two "special maki rolls" and nothing special about them. I feel totally ripped off as they came to 23.00 and are small and not good at all. If you want real sushi go to Samuari in Glassboro. Honestly this is horrible.

Some of the best craft beer in the city and only 8 minutes from my house.  Located next to Great Fermentations (beer making supply store), Bier is awesome on Saturdays where pints are sometimes sold.  It's fun hanging out while beer tour buses come and go unloading enthusiastic beer connoisseurs.

This restaurant is perfectly located close to a lot of hotels in the area along with situated along the trolley route. We sat on the second floor under the roof and fans, but we still had a great view of outside! The food here was delicious, and I had the steak tacos which I recommend. The steak was cooked fantastic and everyone who had it in their meal as well enjoyed it. It also comes with coconut rice, which was very good as I had never tried it before. They were accommodating in needs, but it seemed they moved a little slower on beach time. Make sure you check in and take advantage of the 10% off coupon. A great dinner spot though!

Walked in and stood at the cash register for about 10 minutes and never saw a human...I could hear people in the back so I used all my covert tricks I.E "hello and opening the door to ring the bell" I then left to shop elsewhere:) Maybe this is a hearing impaired auto parts store only as the phone never stopped ringing with the same outcome? Reminded me of the game of playing not at home when the Kirby vacuum salesman approached back in the day:)

Granted they serviced me at 6:30 after calling. All in all I've had better pedicures. I'm grateful for the manicure and acrylic overlay. The owner seems to be very knowledgeable 
I'm only rating a 3 because I didn't get my paragon wax treatment which was boasted free. I'll come back again.

I ordered medium spice dungenous crab and although the garlicky spicy sauce and crab was good, I was surprised when the check came in at around $43. They charged $18 per pound and I was expecting to get one pound but I was supposedly given 2 pounds which I didnt ask for.I said I wanted dungeonous crab and assumed they'd give me 1 pound.I feel I was misled by server.He first stated minimum weight was 1 pound and when I said the price seemed high, he made it seem like he had told me dungenous crab was around 2 pounds which I'm pretty sure he didn't tell me.so good food but be sure to state how many pounds you want or else they will take advantage of you.

John Estrada was absolutely amazing at our wedding. The music for both the ceremony and reception were spot on. He has a unique talent to get people out on the dance floor. He had props and was so engaging with our guests, everyone had a blast. Can't thank him or recommend them enough!

Solid 3.5 stars.

I was pleasantly surprised.  

The popcorn chicken was a little heavy handed with the black pepper but it was fried perfectly, not greasy at all, and really tasty.  

The chicken basil dish reminded me of home cooked meals by my dad when I was younger.  Tiny bone in portions of chicken with a nice sauce and yummy basil leaves, garlic and slices of ginger.  

The scallion pancakes were also good but I can get the same thing out of the freezer section at an Asian grocery store.  But the sauce they comes with the pancakes - DELICIOUS!  If they got said sauce from a bottle, please let me know what it's called and where I can find it!

The braised beef noodle soup was nice.  The broth was a little lacking in flavor but nothing I can't fix.  The noodles would have been better if they used fresh egg noodles in lieu of the linguini type noodle they use but it's just a personal preference.  The beef was tender and easily fell apart, definitely a must order especially when it's cold and rainy outside.

The oyster pancake was not our favorite.  I'm used to the one my dad made at home and it's a lot crispier than 101's.  This dish came out extremely wet and gelatinous and I couldn't swallow it down without thinking about something gross.

The service was really friendly.  It's a shame that 101's got some bad reviews in reference to service and I'm glad that I didn't have to experience that this trip. 

We would definitely come back again!

The food was decent. I really liked the brussel sprouts tapa, I was so-so about the fried avocado tacos. Unfortunately, our experience was diminished by the fact that they were so understaffed. I could tell that the two(?)people that were serving us were really busy, so I don't blame them, but we had a really hard time ordering food. I asked the person that picked up my tapa plate if we could order our entrees and he said sure but as soon as I said what I wanted he said "ok" and ran off before the person I was with could order her entree. It was over a half hour before she could get her order in, and the server only came over because I tapped her on the shoulder as she was walking by. I didn't have any water for most of the time we were there. This place has good reviews, so maybe this was just a bad night, but I wouldn't go back.

My husband and I eat at the Black Sheep about six times a year.  Most times the food is  good and I love the atmosphere.  However, the last time we and two guests ate here for brunch on 8/14/16, three of the four of us felt that the food was so salty that we couldn't taste or enjoy it.  Maybe it was just an off day, but I think I exceeded my RDA of sodium for the week in this one brunch!
One of the places i go to get my ammo and parts. staff is ok not always the best. but they most of the time have the ammo calliber i need.

Really great vibe in this place. Their setup is really good with a bat inside, patio outside and revolving food trucks. I asked about expansion and they advised that they are presently scoping out several local areas.
Great Salon! So pretty and relaxing.  New nail polishes too. Friendly staff. Def Recommend :)
I tried the homemade roti canai here and it was just perfect.... loved the food. Will definitely be back to try more dish..

I have been to many salons in my time, and I will not be returning to this one.  I've been pondering the keratin treatment for some time but have been nervous to try it.  B/c the results last a few months and the price is high, I was unsure.  So I was advised to try an express treatment.  My mother and I got a groupon for Andre Richard Salon - $30 for an Express Keratin treatment.  

I figured if I liked it, I'd return for the full treatment.  I was advised to arrive 15 minutes prior to my appointment.  We arrived 20 early to the small narrow salon and I was taken 20 minutes late.  No big deal.  She said "do you know about the treatment?"  I told her not really, and she gave me about 4 or 5 facts and that was it.  I was then given the "Spray" treatment.  You can buy this yourself and it lasts barely 2 weeks IF you're lucky.  WE were not given the actual express (which is actually the Keratin treatment left on for less time than the original).  If you did not want to offer the actual treatment , do not offer the groupon.  As someone who actually was trying the service to become a client, I was disappointed.  And the salon lost 2 potential clients who will now go elsewhere.  What we received was basically a $30 smooth blow out.  Oh, and I was given the sales pitch for the line of products they sell.  No thanks.

We stayed here a few times while visiting the schools. Beds are comfy, staff is friendly, great deals. Overall I had a good time here. Someone said something about sketchy. Are you nuts? Camden is sketchy. I think the location here is the best you'll get in this lower price range for center city area.
