I did order my bedroom set from a catalog and was even able to work out a good deal where the manager gave me a discount just from asking for one.  My furniture arrived on the date and time frame I was promised.  And the deliver folks were very cordial and professional as well during the time they were in my apartment setting up the furniture.  No complaints.

I have subsequently visited this place in search of more furniture and each time, I have had a very pleasant interaction with the staff.  Although I have not yet purchased anything after the bedroom furniture, I do hope to buy something from here again soon.

They do have a no refund policy, which I learned of after I made my bedroom purchase.  So, please consider that and inquire for further details before purchasing.

Average at best. 
Reminded me if cafeteria food from a hospital or school. 

Better places to go in the quarter.

This is a special place. Not perfect but 5 stars for intent and almost 5 stars for execution. Great location unique if not intimate decor and then the beer. Some of the most innovative, well executed and well served around with saison and IPA bring there speciality. Great tacos and the burger is one of the best I have had in Philly over 5 years. This is a destination place for beer in Philly and beyond and the food does stand up but is purposefully over-shown by the beer. Highly recommend.
Service is extremely slow, and my shrimp po-boy was more like a tomato sandwich. Not enough shrimp for $15.95. Super disappointed. Highly recommend against.

Great gluten free and vegan breakfast options! I had the breakfast tacos and a planet B smoothie, both where excellent.
Nice atmosphere too.

It's a combined Taco Bell & KFC, which is a plus.  However the staff at this location apparently can't be bothered to clean the lobby. Despite the fact that the place was almost completely empty at the time I visited, there wasn't a clean table in the restaurant.
Always fresh, flavorful, and creative.  Great tacos, regular menu items and specials.  Fridays are Spicy Pork Bulgogi...fantastic dish.

Silver Peak is a great place to eat if you are looking for somewhere downtown that has decent prices. I will say, sometimes their food quality isn't very consistent... but overall, we usually enjoy our meals. The salmon fish and chips are drool worthy and Silver Peak is one of the only places to offer them locally. I always order a side of the salsa from the Chicken and Black Bean Burrito (which is also great), it is a home-made salsa with a very creamy chipolte sort of taste to it. It goes great with fish and if you are a fan of something a little spicy, you will love it. Their children menu is also a wonderful deal. I wan to say the plates are $5 and they are HUGE. The mac and cheese is gourmet style and our little one's love it.

The Trident is a tried and true place, I had not been in a while and was pleased to see it had not changed.  The service was good, the food was okay, not great but better than Denny's, but still no great shakes.  The service was good and I like the fact that is your good old pub from the 80's.  The booths are comfortable and you can have a conversation without shouting.  My friend was very happy with her drinks, and that is what people go there for, and to feel relaxed.  I will go back and bring friends.

The location is great, but overall there is just too much going on at this hotel for me. There seems to be people wandering around all the time and there are multiple restaurants and bars, as well as a Starbucks and (sort of) small sundries store. My room was pretty much your basic hotel room, nothing fancy but nothing seemed especially dirty or out of sorts except that the iron was missing

We go here because my wife doesn't want to drive a few minutes further to the one in Frazer which has better food, and now, better service.  I get the pork chops often and I have to order them medium well or they are medium rare on one side vs medium throughout and almost always salty as hell.  Our latest misadventure involved disappearing waitstaff and a good 45 minutes to an hour between courses.  If we hadn't ordered the special with the dessert included we would have left.  The waiter kept asking "they didn't bring your dessert yet?".  Um, no, for the third time in 45 minutes, no.  When the manager came out he was actually defensive like it was our fault for not complaining when they screwed up the bacon cheese fries with no bacon appetizer or because of all the waiting for bread or drink refills or, or, or.  He comped us the appetizers and dessert, which is funny because most of the desserts were included in the meal price, and he even screwed up the kid's ice cream sundae so we had to wait some more for him to fix it.  It will be a long time before I consider returning to this Outback.

First the wrap was quite good. It was the service and the attitude I did not like.  It is total self serve.  They yell out when your drink is done so you have to listen until it is ready the come get it.  Then you have to come get your wrap when it is ready.  But when you pay with a credit card it prompts you for a tip.  A tip for what.  I had to find my own table.  I had to go to the counter to order.  I have to go back to the counter twice to get my order.  They couldn't even combine my chai and my wrap into one trip.  Arrogant and greedy asking for a tip.  Won't be back

You wait in line for a long time to get so-so custard.  There are so many great local custard places now that do deliver a good product without the wait.  I understand part of the appeal is the social aspect of standing around with hundreds of others waiting, but to me I would rather go to a quiet custard place and enjoy the treat in peace.

I purchased a Groupon for my grandson and daughter to enjoy this place 
 then we came with them and enjoyed watching them discover the fun of archery 
clear good directions instructions and their eenthusiasm for this new experience resulted in plenty of fun as they were getting closer to the target all the time

GREAT cornbread.  Awesome greens.  Beautifully breaded fried chicken wings.  Superb smothered pork chops.  The best:?  The owners and servers are amazingly friendly and welcoming.  It's a tiny place, but quite charming.  And yeah, the food is delicious.

Awesome place
Friendly staff, good prices and the food is bomb af 

Would definitely recommend

I really wanted to like this place. The store is absolutely adorable! The store looks like something I dreamed up in kindergarten when I thought the world was still made up of pink frosting and glitter (this is a good thing).

The staff was wonderful as well. They were quick to give me recommendations and very knowledgeable about ingredients. 

But....the cupcakes were some of the worst I had ever tasted. I was very excited about this place, so a co-worker and I grabbed a sampling of about every cupcake (in order to pick favorites for a future larger order). Every cupcake was extremely dry and lacking flavor (except for the overall flavor of sugar, sugar, sugar). My co-workers all agreed and I felt a little embarrassed for pushing FC so hard. 

I again wanted to like this place so much, so I went back for a solo order and expected the same thing. 

Perhaps they can play around with some new recipes.....Flying Cupcake, you are so cute! I just want to like you!

So went to to jack Dempsey's a few nights ago,  I was really looking forward to trying a local favorite.  But I have to say  I was very disappointed with this place.  The atmosphere is good and very low key.  the service was good, but the fried sea food plater left alot to be desired.  I had catfish, shrimp , oysters, fries, It was all very tastless and left alot to be desired.  I did not even finish my meal that I spent around 25 bucks on.  They really need some kind of seasoning in the batter.  Hate to say If I ever go back it will be a while and deff wont get fried seafood again.

I am on a ever evolving mission to find the Worlds Best Sushi Rolls.... And I didn't find a contender here unfortunately... BUT I DID FIND SOME ROLLS THAT CAN HOLD ME OVER TO A FIND THEM!! Lol nice little date spot in Broad ripple with check in deals and modest prices. They also offered more than the average traditional sushi fare found in droves amongst Indus sushi houses. My wife and I have named it one of the top 5 places we have tried in Indy and would gladly revisit with a coupon

Just enjoyed Sunday morning breakfast at I-Hop, the food was good (large quantity, good quality) excellent coffee, ok service. The down side was the bathrooms, gross - gross - gross! Breakfast for two was $25 with tip.

One of our favorite places..the food is always yummie and the service is great.  They have upgraded their dining room and its very pleasant.  the service is wonderful and the owners care so much about you and the excellence of the food and the experience.
Have been there dozens of times and never been disappointed..You will love it too..
Strong coffee, 10x better than Starbucks and cheaper, vegan jewish apple cake is awesome. Gluten free items too. Funky! Never more than a one minute line. I go multiple times per week.

Special evening with my better half!  Our server Francis was very down to earth and accommodating.  Can't say the same about the hostess...ehem...anyway...we ordered the smoke chicken wings to start off with.  The dry rub was extremely tasty.  I ordered a side of barbecue dipping sauce but quickly realized there was no need for it.  The flavor was big and chicken tender!  Next up was the Lobster and Clam Bake...a Monday night special served all summer long until labor day.  The dish was served in an oval roaster pan.  Included in the roaster pan were a 1lb succulent lobster tail and claws, corn cob, potatoes, clam, mussels and shrimp...all swimming in a light and tasty white sauce.  The special cost $25 and was very filling.  Everything in that roaster pan was well seasoned.  We ordered a side of baked bread to sop up the sauce in the pan...we left full and satisfied!  Magnifique!

Overall, a very good experience for three out of our group of four. Our friends had the barley soup & salad and prime rib and said it was "very good."

I had the bass with coconut rice, mushrooms, bok choy, and curry sauce. The fish was cooked perfectly and almost melted in my mouth. The coconut rice was light with subtle flavor of coconut. The mushrooms were flavorful. The bok choy would had been good if they had put less butter on it which overpowered the bok choy. Not sure about the curry sauce, I felt like it didn't pair well with the rest of the dish. Presentation was nice.

My husband had the pasta with three cheese sauce and chicken- the chicken was reportedly dry and the sauce was very heavy. Additionally, the chicken portion was small in proportion to the pasta amount. My husband asked for both chicken and shrimp (as there was a choice in between the two proteins and we don't mind paying more) but this was too much to ask for because the meat was "pre-portioned." 

Overall, the service was excellent, attentive staff, we were seated promptly (had a reservation), the place is nice and clean.

I'm in town attending a conference with co-workers and the bartender at our hotel recommended this place for dinner. The atmosphere and our waitress Christina was amazing. We got loud at times and she rolled right with it. The drinks and the food was amazing. I had the bbq shrimp and I didn't care how messy that fish was. It was mind blowing delicious. We were the last to leave but they all didn't mind and let us conduct our business conversations we were having. When I'm back in town again, I'll definitely come back again

One of the first times visiting Santa Barbara pier, I walked over to this restaurant, The sign was outside the doors open, when I went in and asked where to order, the guy said we are closed miss, to which I said I'm sorry and left. As I was walking out this guy started laughing and saying can you believe that lady? She thought we were open and laughed. So I tried to get back in and the door was locked so I told the guy from the open window that I heard what he said and i thought it was rude! His reply was I couldn't believe you thought we were open, the chairs were on the table and the door was locked. I replied by saying that I walked right in and I had never been here before, there were customers eating also. Anyway he follows me out and says what is your problem. He never apologized or anything. I will never try to eat here again and let everyone know how rude they are!! There are many nice places to eat on the pier! So whatever you do don't eat there!!!

Visited this place while taking a vacation. The theme was right and it made me expect something that tasted like pizza from the greater tri state, and this just didn't do it for me. Garlic knots were good but the pizza was just off... far off... if you're expecting pizza like that it ny or nj don't bother. If you're not then I'm sure it's not bad, however next time I'll just keep walking.

While my husband dined on four dozen happy hour oysters (yes, 48!), I enjoyed a glass of wine. Amazing happy hour prices, no vegan food options. I had two glasses, he had 2-3 cocktails, and like I said , 48 oysters- bill total under $80!

Loved every bit of the sushi and the options were outstanding considering I'm from Cali and Sushi Rose is a place that I'll hold close to my heart when I Cruz by here again to Reno.
AAA

I have been to NOLA 3 times and every time I have I have tried different hotels. This hotel was by far very over rated. The price you pay for this hotel is ridiculous considering how tiny the room and bathroom is. The beds were very comfortable but every thing else was not updated. There are over 500 rooms in this hotel and only 3 people working the front desk. We waited over 15 minutes just to get an elevator down to the lobby. 

The positive was the carousel bar which was great "if" you can get a seat. If you have a chance try the food in the hotel, that was also great!!

Plenty of great things about this tasting experience. It's as if you're on a yacht drinking delicious wine!
The wine is great and the service superb... The newest additions to the staff have been great and truly provide an outstanding tasting experience without rushing you. There are a variety of wine flights to choose from and you're also able to purchase by the glass and sit and enjoy to beautiful Santa Barbara weather. 
There's a wide array of grapes on both red and white at competitive price points. You won't regret making the trip out to this tasting room - probably the most relaxing stop of our visit.

Horrible Customer Service...I received this message from Megabus regarding my trip from Reno to Sacramento. It came 28 minutes before my bus was scheduled to depart. As I reached the 130 minute mark and calling get half witted responses making it myself and the 15 other waiting passengers fault still no further update on my bus. I called Megabus  when I found out they don't take calls after 6. It is 7:50. No update or communication on their part and the site says no refunds can be awarded until the trip is complete. This is the worst customer service and respect for patrons I've ever seen. Not only is a refund due but an apology. Hardworking Americans do not deserve the treatment given by Megabus.

One word: HASHER. Fantastic BYO and one of my all time favorite brunch spots in the area. So many menu choices and no corkage fee (at least not for our vodka, champs and wine that we brought!) Been here for dinner as well and had an amazing meal. 

Great service full of kind people that make you feel like you're "at home" when you are there.  Kim was our server today and killed it! 

Cool, cozy feeling when you're inside with an exposed brick wall and just a few TVs.  Also outdoor seating is available with great views as the place sits on a corner.

My family has been regulars here since they opened, and I have been going there since it used to be called Peking. The General Tso Chicken is the best around. It is my favorite dish and I have tried at many other Chinese food places, but there is no other Chinese place that I have found yet that makes it quite like Tokyo does. Great staff, service, and food.

What an amazing experience! The staff was so attentive and polite, and our sushi chef, David, understood our likes and dislikes and chatted with us like an old friend.
The ingredients were fresh, atmosphere clean and appealing, and service very quick.

Will DEFINITELY be back soon!

Excellent espresso! I also had an almandine pastry which was delicious. Taste like it just came from a french bakers oven. The service is friendly and efficient, the prices are very reasonable, and they even accept credit cards. This place is a win!
Horrible customer service!!  Do yourself a favor and go to Hertz down the street.

This is the best Greek food outside of the Tarpon Area. The food is obviously outstanding with that intro. The place is clean and the service is friendly. I tend to go for the Gyro or the Chopped Greek Salad when stopping in for lunch. However their Dolmades and Spanikopita are top notch as well.

My friend got some pastries from this store for me.  There were a pie filled with coconut cream, mocha cakes covered with chocolate and a peanut butter cupcake.  While their chocolate based pastries were good but too sweet for my taste, I loved their coconut cream.  It was the perfect sweetness for me. .Their cakes are really moist, even after 2 days of the time of purchase.  They look beautiful and taste delicious :)
Great service and the beer is cold and food is awesome and prices are good. Staff is friendly and helpful.

We have frequented Momos many times because it is one of the only restaurants within walking distance of our house. We have never had a good experience with service or food but it is usually fine enough for its convenient location- would have given it about 2.5 to 3 stars. However, our last experience was truly the worst dining experience we have ever had. Momos offered a groupon that was expiring in a couple days and was therefore over crowded. We waited 35 minutes to get a table on a Monday night. When we finally got a table we ordered quickly and waited on the food. We ordered an appetizer (bacon wrapped olives) and 2 main dishes (kabobs). We waited 45 minutes and still no food had come. People around us were getting food even though they had been seated after us. We had also not seen our waitress since she had taken our order. Finally, a chef brought out one of the kabobs. We still had not gotten our appetizer or the other main dish. We continued to wait until another server came over and asked us what we were waiting on. We explained what else we had ordered and she hurried off. 

Then, finally, our waitress came back and started blaming the busyness of the restaurant on our late food. Yes it was busy - but that is no excuse to forget to put in someone's order!!! She was very rude and unapologetic!!!!! Finally, after waiting more than an hour, the first dish was cold, and they finally brought the appetizer and then twenty minutes later the other main dish. 

We would have expected they would have comped us or something, but when we got the bill - FULL PRICE! To top it off, the food was disgusting, tasteless, and cold. We will never eat here again and recommend to stay away in case they are "too busy" to remember to put in your order. Obviously that sort of thing happens - but servers are usually apologetic and give you your food for free. To summarize - worst dining experience we have ever had. Will not return.

The worst. 

The egg served on my bagel looked like two giant sponges that were nuclear hot and the bagel itself was like a slab of wonder bread. 

Just repulsive, not to mention the line was idiotically long.

TacoSon still serves great food at a fair price. I have never had anything there that was not fresh and delicious. Basic tacos have meat, shredded cheese, cabbage, onions, sour cream, pico de galo, and cilantro. There sauces/salsas are amazing so try both green and red. You can eat in, take out or even use the drive-thru. We are always happy and full after visiting TacoSon.

A terrible service experience. Ordered drinks that never came. A table of 10 ordered food, 6/10 meals came in full. Tried to order more drinks with no success. Several in our party cancelled their meals altogether. We tried to ask for the manager to explain the situation, 3 times we were told she was too busy until I waited at the bar for her to be available. 

The food was good.
After finally being able to chat with her the manager comped all of our meals. Only because the food was good and she did this I will I come back and try again. But overall, just garbage customer service when we were planning on drinking a lot  (and therefore spending a lot of money). I hope it is better next time.

Stayed here while we checked out the Rib Cook off this year and it was an absolute joy. I am actually writing this review while in bed using their free in room wifi.

My friend is considered a high roller here so we stayed at one of the Tuscany suites.  How can you fit 2 king size beds in a room? Yes....the room is that big.  Yes........it is that nice.

This is probably the best Reno has to offer.  It is the closest thing comparable to Vegas quality.  Not saying it's Vegas but the amenities, restaurants, casino, spa, pool,and bars are all exquisite.

The only difference is...........the people.  The reason why this hotel is so reasonable is because the people here control the price.  The law of supply and demand is definitely evident.  The quality of players aren't going to be like the ones in Vegas.  They will generally be your target audience of 60 and over, but guess what?  They are helping you lower the cost of everything.  Food specials, spa specials, cafes, gambling, etc is all catered towards this audience. 

The casino gives out free match plays, meal specials, happy hour meals, money upon arrival.  They pretty much are giving things away.  You will never find this kind of bargain anywhere.  Their pool and spa is top notch.  I personally wouldn't even know that we were in Reno.

Will review the Rib cook off tomorrow!!!

Don't eat here! Worse dining experience I had in NOLA. To begin with, they're severely understaffed. This resulted in not only a long wait to order and be served your food at their lil bar stools, but also the food was cold. I had the jambalaya, which tasted like it was straight out of a Zatarran's box, which is fine if you weren't paying $10 for it. My mom had the grilled shrimp poboy. Much to her dismay the shrimp was not grilled and it was not large shrimp, but rather small baby shrimp. We never got a refill on our diet coke nor were we given water. Whatever you do, don't waste your money here at this tourist trap. There are plenty of other eateries to experience local fare

Found what we needed. Had a larger selection than the home depot down the street.  The reason for the two stars was an employee talking on her cell phone yelled at us for ignoring her. She asked "do you need help with anything?" We all assumed she was talking to the person on her phone. When we did respond to say no she proceeded to bad talk us to the person on the phone as "rude customers."  Seemed very unprofessional. Never had this sort of experience at a Lowes or Home Depot.

I am surprised by all the negative reviews on here, because we had a really pleasant experience.

We rented a furnished two bedroom while waiting to buy a home. Our move-out timeline changed repeatedly, and Rod and Evelyn in the office went above and beyond to help us and make our transition for our family as easy as possible in an already stressful time for us. The pool was lovely, and the maintenance staff were kind and considerate, and while busy, they worked hard to make sure everyone's needs were met and the grounds were well maintained. The gym and clubhouse were also always cleaned and maintained.

Our only complaint was the rude neighbors who drove way too fast through the community, ignoring speed bumps and pedestrians.

The buffet is good. They have a lot of options on it. I love the Nann with the tandoori chicken in it (forget what its called but its 4.95) also the tandoori chicken wings are out of this world! They are full of flavor. Also try the mango lassie. Not too sweet perfect amount of mango. The gentleman let me try a taste!
Excellent food, drinks and service! Rob was friendly and prompt!  Host staff made sure to acknowledge all guests with smiles and greetings!

Well, let's just put it this way:

If you want your appointment to magically disappear, the workers talking about you behind your back (with the door open), and to be treated like an a**hole, then this is TOTALLY the place for you. 

Prices might be great for my tire, but I'd never step foot in there again. Moral of the story for Tire kingdom, employ better people and train them not to talk down to customers.

Absolutely amazing experience from the bar staff during our wait for a table, which wasn't long at all, to the waiters (one dedicated and another making sure you need nothing else) down to the spectacular food. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone. Perfect experience and professionalism. The food was great, we sampled many selections for an appetizer, also ordered meals and dessert. I would give more than 5 stars if I could!

They now are open for breakfast and serve up the best breakfast tacos you will ever have.. 

***pro tip that green sauce is NOT guacamole it is a VERY hot chile sauce.

I Love Cosi food and what they promote far as healthy eating and alternatives while still being tasty. I can help but be disgusted that the workers at this location don't wear hear nets!!!!!!!!!!! this is the food industry have to be clean and use all precautions when handling food. They need to enforce hair nets same way you have to wear gloves when handling food

Dirty, smelly, death trap.  I have complained to the front desk about the conditions of the men's locker and showers but nothing has gotten better. The garbage cans are over flowing and there's trash everywhere. IT STINKS TOO!!  I can never feel clean taking a shower there to go straight to work from the gym so I gave up trying to work out in the morning. The spin room is a death trap with all of the electric extensions they have to use for the fans to keep the spin room cool.  I can't wait for my membership to expire in the next few months.

I'm a sucker for some good plain chocolate ice cream, but I had to get the Triple Threat on my first time here - chocolate ice cream, chocolate brownie chunks, and chocolate chips. Sooooooo good. It's a little expensive, but I think all good ice cream places are. My boyfriend got the mint chocolate chop ice cream, which is infused with mint oil or something like that. He loved it. The girl there took the time to explain to us that they're the only place in Arizona that has a license to pasteurized their own ice cream, giving it a fresh, distinct taste.

All in all...the Element Ewing is....Ok. It looks like a Westin, it talks like a Westin, but it walks like a medium grade Sharaton.

It is mostly a bunch of little things that bug me about this place. Yes, all the features are there, but it is evident that neither the staff nor the management has ever actually visited a 4 or 5 star facility; so that all the "features" that this location offers that should be on par with the upper echelons of the chain really fall flat. Some examples:

1) The gym is like an icebox and the AC controls are locked away from use...AND they have their crap music pumping in there way too loud. Isn't this why you provide *headphones* and something to plug them into? (each workout machine has TV/Radio)

2) The complimentary breakfast is way overpriced. The toaster oven is on, but not hot enough to toast anything. All of the breakfast sandwiches seem to have been sitting covered for hours because they are all chewy. No fresh fruit, and the coffee has to be the weakest crap I have ever had. I am not exaggerating. Yuck.

3) Yes, it is nice that the hotel is "green", which includes large volume shampoo and soap dispensers...but for God's sake, include SEPARATE shampoo and conditioner. I don't need my hair coming out greasier than when I went into the shower.

4) Great. I have a coffee maker and coffee along with my kitchenette in my room. How about some sugar and cream? Or was I supposed to stop by the grocery en route?

5) Fix the damn printer in the lobby. The kiosk software used is crap, and it seems to lose sense that the printer is attached (or vice versa). When I was there, not one of the PCs could print my boarding pass.

PRO-TIP: Borrow a USB cable from the front desk and plug your own laptop directly into the printer.

The facility itself is very nice. Very Westin-y...unfortunately the staff seem to be right on target with their goal of mediocrity.

If I should have to be in this neighborhood again someday I'd come back...but that is mostly because the competition in the area is pretty lame, not because the Element Ewing is banging on all eight cylinders.

All I have been waiting for since I started watching K-dramas years ago. The food is amazing. The veggies are refreshing and pair amazingly with the meat. The miso soup they serve goes perfect with the rest of the meal. The food is flavorful and fresh.  I will be coming here a lot in the future.  The service was super quick. We chose a table and the food was ready. The customer service was great. We were greeted with a smile and when our food was ready we were instructed on stirring our food before we ate it. Very nice!!! Especially for people new to this type of experience.  P.s. their bathrooms are very clean like the rest of this place

Called SPC in Venice. Talked to Frannie, who was very polite and professional.
 I called other PC companies but they either didn't answer, had a terrible automated voice operator, or a rude person who refused to give pricing over the phone.
Frannie gave me the price over the phone and then sent Omar to our home. Omar was one of the nicest and most professional i have ever seen in this bizz! And i used to work for Orkin, so i know.
Not only did he do a SUPERB job, but he even gave us a price that was almost $150- less than what Frannie quoted over the phone! No gimmicks, hidden prices, or anything like that. These guys are no joke!
I cannot recommend anyone else. They are terrific.
Thank you, Frannie & Omar!
Sincerely,
Shane

I'm only giving 3 stars cuz of the drinks " top shelf margaritas "   Were mediocre. I drink lots of margaritas, ok. If ya gonna do Mexican ya need a great margarita.   And the waiter did not know anything. The bar staff seamed lost. 

      I got the red fish fajitas,, it was delicious. the wife got a stake taco , it was stuffed with meat and also delicious. 
 
     For me it's " I ate there  once and won't go back".

This place is failing by the hour! My family and I were headed to a movie but stopped in to CBQ for dinner first. 6:20 on a Friday and 1 person at the bar. Maybe half the tables in the dinning room were full. The hostess sat us with 2 school age children in the bar, when there was plenty of open booths in the dining area, fail #1. After being seated we waited for 15 minutes before being acknowledge, fail #2. When the waitress finally came over she was overly nice and asked if we were going to a movie and at what time, we let her know movie began at 7:15 and she said she will get order in now to ensure we get to movie in time. We placed our food order and drink order. Took another 10 minutes to just get our drinks. All was well we had been chatting and enjoying our drinks for about 15-20 minutes still no dinner, but still no waitress again to come by and ask if we would like another drink. Finally my husband went to the bar and got us refills, fail #3. While at the bar my husband stood there for at least 5 minutes without any acknowledgement, remember only 1 person was sitting at the bar. The bartender acted as if my husband was putting a damper on his oh so busy night fail #4. Finally dinner arrives 45 minutes later, WHAT?! It's BBQ, most should have been smoked or slow roasted during the day. When food came it was cold, fail #5.

I feel bad because as a former business owner I know how much time money and life goes into the food business. But COME ON! Train your staff! The worst part is there was a manager on staff, though he was mostly walking around texting. It's a shame the food was not bad but the staff was poorly trained. Looks like that building will soon be vacant again.

JW is amazing to look at. We came here for a bridal show. JW was more than equipped to assist our needs.

I've stayed here before. I enjoy staying here because the staff is always friendly, informative, and fast. Their quality of service flowed while hosting this event.

There were about 100 vendors set up in the grand ballroom. The space fit everyone in, not as comfy. There was some difficulty navigating through the aisles. There was so much variety and information to gain from this bridal event. The reps stated it is one of the largest in the city. I believe it. We've been to 4. this year. By far, this event had the most vendors.

After having our fill of hors devours and champagne, we headed to the Starbucks just below the ball room. It was cozy and a nice cool down from being in the ball room for 2 hrs. We've now added the JW to our list of venues. We have 5 picked. Look for future reviews so you'll know who we chose.
Went to yoga today at the farmer's market. Enjoyed the class. It was a slow flow class with a lot of warm up for a stiff Sunday morning body. Today's instructor was a substitute.

Pizza is DELICIOUS - greasy in all the right ways! crust is good too. I generally just get the cheese because it doesn't need any more toppings in my opinion. The bartenders are friendly and the vibe is laid back. They also offer delivery!

I eat here at least once a week. So why three stars? For one, that's as high as I go with chains. Also, I eat at four different locations on a fairly regular basis... I admit, it's a problem. Some time during the last three months it felt like they started cutting back on the portions. Nonetheless, always clean, food is delicious, staff is nice enough.

We used to go to Landry's in the French Quarters. It was one of our go to places during Jazz Fest. We noticed that it has re-opened on the north east side of the Jax Brewery Building. It looked good because it had an upstairs and an outside seating that overlooked the Mississippi River. That was the pros. Now the cons. When the hostess seated us she cleared the table but never came back to wipe it. There were no place settings and no dishes. Even though they were not busy everything took forever. When the crab bisque came out it was lukewarm as was the char broiled oysters. The oysters were seasoned with  way to much salt. We ordered bruschetta six oysters 2 cups of bisque and a beer. The bill was $77. Ouch. Too many great restaurants with great service and great food for far less money. Will not be back.

If you want a half ass car wash, go here. I'm very disappointed on how my car looked. I went home to re clean what they missed. I called the store to see what they could do for me and he states the manager only handles complaints face to face and that I can drive all the way back to re do my car. If this place had good customer service, he would of offered me a discount or a free car wash. I unfortunately will not be coming here again.

Can't go wrong with the jerk chicken Caesar salad, best Caesar dressing eva. Fake chicken is good, plantain chips are good... I love this place. Fast vegetarian/vegan food- my prayers have been answered (I'm a meat eater trying to go veg).

We dined in for lunch on a weekday, waited about 20 minutes for outside seating. Not bad. Service is super cool here, waiters and hosts were super attentive and pleasant. The seafood is fresh. They had local lobster available as well as other live seafood made to your liking. 

The clam chowder was decent. I thought my lobster was okay. It was a bit tasteless. My friend's shrimp tacos were bland and not too good as well. 

I'd stick with the fresh/live seafood next time. Do check the prices as well...the live stuff can be pretty expensive (depending on the weight and all).
Great dive bar! The drinks are cheap, it's dark and smoke filled. But is has great atmosphere. If your looking for something a little less polished it's great
I don't want to bash the heck out of this place with my review and frankly this place is not worth the time it takes.  Let me just say this; I WILL NEVER BE BACK HERE AGAIN!!!  IT WAS HORRIBLE
Take advantage of your local vendorsand  agricultural amenities and come to King of Prussia. Located behind the police barracks in their parking lot.

My mom said they have the best beets salad  she's ever tasted. I love the bartender he checked on us regularly and new the menu and special items really well. Great ambiance, seems more business casual but I dress how I want, no one made a fuss. The Friday special, Court Bouillon, was very good and my mother loved her chicken and veggies.

Ghini's is my latest go-to breakfast place. My boyfriend and I love their omelets (so dang fluffy) and other French style egg dishes like the Eggs Provençal and Florentine Croque Madame. I consistently order the Florentine Omelet because I'm very obsessed with both spinach and swiss cheese. It never disappoints and they certainly don't skimp on the fillings. There are super yummy bread options as well courtesy of their adjoined bakery. I like the multi-grain, my boyfriend prefers the French baguette. Look out for discounted mimosas or bloody marys in the mornings... it seems like there's usually some sort of special going on. The dining area is cute and quaint and there's also a nice outdoor patio, which is great when it's not a zillion degrees out. All in all, I always enjoy breakfast at Ghini's and I'll recommend it to anyone who values my opinion (probably a few people).

I have been to this place over a dozen times, and have been very happy with my experiences. I've generally had a different tech each time I go (for mani/spa pedi), and have always had a pleasant experience. I am always greeted pleasantly when I arrive, and if I've ever had to wait, it's only been a few minutes. I love that I can walk in with no appointment since my busy schedule doesn't usually allow my to schedule time to visit. Recently, I tried to go to a place a little bit closer to me, but was told that I would have to return in several hours... so that place is off my list.

I have read some of the complaints about getting horrible manicures or pedicures, but that has not been my experience. It's also a very reasonably priced place. 

I do have to agree that they prefer cash, and offer a $5 discount if paying with cash. So, if I have it, I use it... but if not, they gladly take my credit card. You can also tip by credit card at this place, which isn't true of everywhere.

I usually eat at the food bar but will never eat there again and seriously thinking about never shopping there again.  A customers dog was standing on the bar licking the food. I told customer service and they didnt seem to care.  I will share with everyone I know this information.  This is a health code violation.  Animals should not be allowed in places where they have this situation.  If i want to eat withvthe animals it should be my choice.

Amazing food and service!! Definitely get a reservation, when we walked in the people before us (w/ out reservations) were told a 30 min wait with two people. It is certainly worth the wait, but of course always better if you don't have to wait!  They give you warm bread after you are seated. To me it was good for the first couple of minutes, but after that it got chewy. I got the soup 1-1-1 which was small servings of their seafood gumbo, regular gumbo, and soup of the day (corn and lobster bisque). Their gum is weren't my favorite, but the corn and lobster bisque was delicious! For my meal I got the famed barbecue shrimp. BEST BBQ SHRIMP EVER! It comes with toasted bread (to soak up ever little bit of that yummy buttery sauce) and about 7 huge shrimp! It comes unpeeled, so it's very mess, but that's what makes it fun! Because it's a little messy, they offer you a bib and then a warm cloth after devour your shrimp! My friends got the lamb, and they basically ate the bones because it was so good!

This review is about walking over the bridge, not driving over the bridge.  It's always a beautiful view - no matter what the weather is.  Always a nice variation of blues or grays.  I like to walk my dogs over the bridge - it's the perfect amount of exercise for all 3 of us and we don't have to worry about crossing a bunch of streets or dodging a lot of other pedestrians..  It's also a really nice free attraction for tourists.  What I don't like is that there are sometimes unsavory characters walking over the bridge as a form of free transportation from Camden.  You can always spot them.  Luckily there is a security jeep that drives back and forth to monitor the bridge pedestrians.  Also you should watch out for fast bikers on the down incline.  I'd recommend a walk over this bridge for anyone who has not yet done it.  I enjoy it at least 3 times per week when the weather is decent.

This place is great! The po boys here are delish, the drinks even better!!!! The service is fantastic, our server was so cute and fun, she just had that vibe of a person you want to get a drink with and discuss... Well, anything it is fairly new and not yet established, but I have no doubt we will be coming here next trip. You can watch the parades if you come early and get a good table. If you go, ask for Dee and she will set you up right! This will be a stop we will make out next time in!!!

I chose Convivio for our book club gathering at the recommendation of a friend.  At the end of the year, we vote on the favorite restaurant we visited for the year and the winner gets a prize.  In over a decade, I have only won this coveted prize once.  Maybe this year will be my second!

When we arrived, we were directed to a long rectangle table for the Seven of us, but when a member Spotted a round table off to the side and asked if we could sit there instead, our waiter was happy to oblige.  Round tables are so much better for discussion!  It's a good thing we did move because as the evening progressed, it got a little loud.  We wouldn't have been able to hear each other at all at the other table.   I, honestly, expected this to be a quiet restaurant and want to visit again to see if the noise level that evening is the norm or if we just had a couple of loud groups nearby.  

Not a single food order was duplicated and we were still all satisfied with our orders.   I ordered the John Dory fish dish which came with a sweet potato purée and Brussels sprouts.  It was so good!!   Evidently John Dory is a rarity that people come in for specifically when they have it.   I almost didn't order it because our waiter (when I asked if it was) confirmed that it is, indeed, the fish in Finding Nemo named Dory.  My friends convinced me to get it anyway, but I didn't eat it without at least minimal emotional trauma.  When I got home and googled it, I found that it was not Dory and felt better about eating the deliciousness I was served!  

At the end of our meal our check was delivered....in a book!!  How much more perfect can you get for group of book lovers?   

As I said, I will definitely come back and will definitely recommend to others.
Everyone I was with loved what we got. No problems with service or getting in. I had the crabby wife and loved it
After repeated calls to have Affordable finish their work by we had to resort to a lawyer to get their attention. Next time we will use someone reliable.
I have used them twice for hitches, always a pleasure. I didn't understand how it worked, I know stupid and they were so helpful. I will be back!!
The food doesn't match the prices. The donuts look delicious but honestly were really just okay. I won't be returning.
Love this place.  Huge menu.  Friendly staff.  Good prices. Food is fresh with lots of great proteins and veggies.  Can be loud when a big group is present.

The food was okay. The spam appetizer was the best part of our meal. I would recommend that. The chicken on the chicken sandwich was good but the roll wasn't as soft as it should have been. The sweet potato fries were good with the pepper sauce. The steak was flavorful but did not provide the desired variety in the dish.

I am going to have to give this place only 3 stars. We sampled several flavors (bubblegum, strawberry champagne, blackberry...) and we finally got blackberry and just a chocolate Gelato (we being my daughter and myself). My daughter got sprinkles on hers. 

Positive: I love the space... it is bright and very bold, the service was good (when they were paying attention), they let you try as many flavors as you would like to, the Gelato is pretty healthy compared to ice cream, the chocolate is FAB, and I also tried one of their peanut butter bon bons which I could have eaten 12 of! 

Negative: the staff as friendly as they were when talking with you were kind of rude in the aspect that they would talk to each other before helping a customer (and there were 4 staff members), the blackberry did not taste good once you had more than a sample... it tasted a lot like black licorice with seeds, the price is not what I expected for the small container that you get, the sprinkles were GROSS I had to waste part of the Gelato to get them off (in my opinion they tasted like foam, or what I think foam would taste like) 

Would I come here again?? Maybe, but it would not be my first choice.
Get the lavender latte if you want something calming. I'm from out of town and I wish I wasn't because this place is amazing! I'd come here every day if I could.

I've ordered two sandwiches from this place: Veggie Delight and Baconator. The veggie delight was served on hearty multigrain bread. It was surprisingly filling for a vegan sandwich. The Baconator is a primo BLT, loaded with crispy bacon, a little tomato, and plenty of lettuce to balance out the pork. And a spicy aioli on top, makes it perfect. I will definitely be ordering these again in the future.

Loved it!! Food was fantastic! Ambiance wonderful!!  We came on the recommendation of yelp. Glad we did. They close at 2pm on Saturdays but they still let us in at 1:40 and didn't rush us. Parking lot is in the back or on the street.

When I saw that Fitler Dining Room had closed, I was quite upset - it had become one of my go to place to show people what new American cuisine in Philly was like, to go on a date night, or just to enjoy a night sitting at the counter and watch the expert staff assemble delicious food and enjoy my own. Trattoria Carina is the next evolution in this spot. The location and staff are the same for the most part, but they blew up the menu and started from scratch and totally redecorated the interior. 

Carina seems to be trying to fly under the radar while they discover their new identity, they have no online presence, and seem to be operating as a walk-in discovery to whomever decides to venture in, and I am so glad I did. My partner and I sat outside, and pondered the menu for a while before deciding on ordering the some wine and grilled broccoli (normally a side for an entree) to start. The broccoli was perfectly grilled and had delicious cheese and breadcrumbs sprinkled throughout, and was a perfect start to the meal. Carina doesn't yet have a wine list, and they have a simple listing of white, rose, and red wines available. We tried the red and rose, and were very happy with what they provided.

For entrees we ordered two pasta dishes. The Shells Granchio Arrabbiato (or spicy crab) was delicious, the sauce had just a little punch to it, and there was not much in the way of crab (it was mostly small pieces sprinkled throughout). What we discovered then is that Carina is looking to really drill down and emphasize their speciality - home made pasta. The sauce and other ingredients are there to lift up and emphasize the pasta. While amazing, I normally would look for a little more when ordering a $20+ plate of food than just pasta, sauce, and a little protein, but whoa was it delicious. 

The Gemelli Genovese was likewise very tasty. Whoever makes Carina's pesto sauce should be kissed. This dish likewise was light on other ingredients, with very thinly shaved pieces of cauliflower layered throughout. Again, I would normally look for more to a dish like this, but what they brought was a treat for the mouth. 

For dessert we got hazelnut gelato, which was also very delicious - though it was served with a somewhat strange pretzel cookie, which seemed to serve as a palette cleanser, but didn't really seem to go with the gelato. I ordered a flourless chocolate cake which was sprinkled with confectionery sugar and which was perfectly moist throughout and had an explosion of pure chocolate flavor. My partner thought it could use some fruit to go with it (raspberry maybe) but I was fine with it just the way it was. 

Service was also fantastic - Bruce was constantly buzzing by our table, answering questions and giving us tips. If you go make sure to give your feedback to the staff, as they are definitely looking to refine, revise, and evolve this place into a neighborhood spot that will last, and I hope it does. 

We'll be back. Soon.
Mac cheese crab appetizer was unusual. We think we liked it. Burger had stale bread. Salads were pretty good. Very open sterile and cold. Excellent black ice tea.

Do yourself a favor and do not eat here! The service is terrible, and the employees just don't care. I ordered a chicken sandwich, was told it takes six minutes to make. Made me pull out of line and sit there for seven minutes. I drive home open bag, and NO chicken sandwich! I go back and they employee goes, I know you would be back! I say how about an apology? None given, instead she hands me a sack and says here is your sandwich. I drive home pull out sandwich and it is not even warm!WTF!

Sunday afternoon for lunch. Ambiance was nice, dark wood, bar area open and airy with large windows and big-screen TVs for sports fans, etc. The main dining area is your typical grid lay-out with a large buffet area deep in the area, serving Sunday brunch. Appeared very clean and well-organized and decorated. 

Hostess: Typical 20-something with long hair and an unnatural habit of saying "like" entirely too much and a nervous tic of stroking her hair while she talks without making eye contact. Quickly delegated our seating accommodations to some poor co-worker who happened to walk up to the front counter at the time we were ready to be seated. 

Server: Nice enough. Really (I mean really) pushed the brunch buffet. ( I wonder why? I guess it's the most common/popular Sunday afternoon choice?) Took a while to obtain actual menus but not an intolerable amount of time. Interesting that, even though this was our first trip here, he never emphasized any other popular menu items aside from the brunch buffet. He did give valuable feedback when I asked about items.  

Ordered: The Overlake sandwich and the BLT-avocado sandwich. (I had the Overlake. Partner had the BLT-A, he wound up wearing most of the A. Messy sandwich.)  My order had a good presentation, tasted great. No complaints really. (I mean who can complain with something when it's smothered in bacon?) I'd probably order it again. 

I would like to go again to order from the dinner menu and check that out. It's a fairly new establishment in this chain, so it's decor is current and appealing. The hostess was okay. The server was good, not great. The food was good. No deal-breakers here, but no real reasons for me to activate the culinary phone-tree and recommend it to everyone. It's a good option to occasionally break up the monotony of eateries in the Cool Springs area.

I am psyched to see a cafe in the Dutchtown area!!!! Urban Eats looks to be very promising. They have a great selection of Chauvin coffees, pastries, and muffins in the morning. Their small lunch menu offers paninis, wraps, and flatbread pizzas with your choice of toppings. I had an Italian meats (Volpi's on The Hill) panini which was spectacular. Full of veggies,meat, cheese, and tapenade. Oh boy...it was delish! The Asian slaw is cool and tangy, and the Summer salad is wonderful (full of greens, toasted walnuts and dried cranberries.) Plus, this is just a really cool space. Very relaxing, and free wi-fi! And now with the liqour license, they have BOOZIES! Yes, smoothies with booze. Drink up!

We have been there three times and ive had to wait only one time which was the first time and it was a tuesday after that the two other times were on mondays and got there around 530 and didnt have to wait.  Food was good had the ribs the second time we were there, thery are ok a little dry for me taste. We went about a week ago and i had the strip steak and my husband had the pork shank he loved it I honestly dont like pork shank thought it was overcooked but he loved it and that is what counts. For the money its a good deal and we we also had dessert SO GOOD. Will i go back YES

We used Jump On The School Bus to shuttle ~170 guests from Buellton and Goleta, to our wedding at Dos Pueblos Orchid Ranch, and back. They were so organized, punctual, accommodating, and fun! Darin kindly guided us through the process of surveying our guests about lodging, and then they coordinated the bus game plan. Using JOTSB completely relieved us of the stress of transportation on our big day. And the personalized decals on the sides of the buses were a nice touch.

I loved going to Mirko when it was in Midtown, so I was thrilled when this location appeared just down the street from my house. That was, until I ate there. 

I've given this location lots of tries. Lots. And it always falls flat. My last experience is a pretty good snap shot of how it goes. We sit and wait for a server. And wait. Oh, and then wait. Once he or she arrives, we order drinks -- because we like wine. But any appetizers (and or the free dip they serve) arrives much ahead of the wine. So far ahead that we only order one drink, when we'd like two ... or three (don't judge, we walk there). 

Then, there's the dip. It's a white bean dip with rosemary and olive oil. The drip, usually the consistency of hummus arrives drowning in oil. Yuck. I order GF pasta with broccoli added and the broccoli isn't cooked. 

I don't think I'll be giving them any more chances.

We eat A LOT of tex-mex/mexican and this place is really good as other reviewers say it is! The chips look fresh, but the salsa while good is watered down.  But, honestly who care about the fillers when the food is amazing.  I'm venturing to say it's the best I've had on either side of the river.  And, for a fraction of the cost that you'd expect.  Will be back!

Nice typical movie house but what's going on with the hand driers in the women's rest room?  All three are mounted so low on the wall that any average height person has to bend way down to dry your hands.  Not easy for those with a bad back.  I could see one being mounted low for those in a wheel chair but not all of them.  Come on guy's give us a break.  Typical poor design found one way or another in most ladies rooms.
Best ice cream in Reno! My favorite is the matcha & ube swirled! The inside is super cute too!

If you are looking for some good smoked "BBQ" you MUST try Smokin' Out. For quite some time I've driven by with my husband and we said, "We need to try that." On August 18th, 2012, we made a point to head there for dinner. We are so glad that we did!

The appearance of the place is very casual. The selections of sizes is nice but standard BBQ joint fair (side salad, potato salad, coleslaw, corn on the cob etc.). I was undecided on what meat I wanted to try so I chose the Combo Meal and picked pulled Pork and 1/4 chicken (white meat). OMG, it was so delicious. My husband selected the chopped chicken, mac - n - cheese and the garlic bread. He loved the chicken so much that he ordered a whole chicken to go!

The pulled pork was so amazing that I didn't add any sauce to it! (Just like their slogan!) The smoke flavor added so much taste to the meat it was great! 

I highly recommend Smokin' Out to anyone. This is our new BBQ place over our local Sonny's BBQ. Smokin' Out blows them away!

Previously I trashed this shop. I was a novice and listened to a friend who didn't know what he was talking about... So my comments about this business selling me the wrong size bike was wrong. My apologies!! Although, about their COMPLEMENTARY BIKE FITTING ...I was told to "put a hundred miles on the bike and come back"  I returned after 100 mi. and again and was told  "put a "hundred miles on it and come back". Thanks for the customer service Reno Cycling & Fitness. I took the bike in for a checkup (complimentary?) The disinterested guy that seemed to be doing nothing  told me I had to see Brendan. Brendan was talking story with some one else. Ten minutes later and Brendan was still talkin' so I turned around to leave, the guy in line behind me asked if I was leaving, I said yes and he said "me too I've got better things to do",the guy behind him said he didn't have that kind of time and he  left as well.
I guess we are just not in the clique.

i do nearly all of my grocery shopping here, it's more than worth the drive from Claymont. We have cut down significantly on our grocery bill since we started doing so. Their meat is a bit pricey, but we more than make up for it by the low prices of their frozen fish, produce and dairy, even organic! I also love their housewares and personal care items; I get my shampoo and body lotion here, and my laundry detergent, dishwashing soap, and dishwasher powder, even cardboard scratchers for my cat! So reasonable! They have all the basics plus tasty novelties exclusive to TJs for when we want a treat. It can get crowded on the weekends, which can be overwhelming, but the staff always takes it in stride and is always friendly and helpful. I dread the thought of moving away from here!

It's another Corporate Day at this Cosi. Everybody running around doing everything but ensuring the food gets prepared. After asking where my food was.....I finally walked out. Onion soup at the Midtown 2 Diner instead.

While traveling through the Nashville area I came across this great location across from Cool Springs Mall.  Lots of good restaurants and shopping around, walking distance. The price was reasonable and the rooms were clean. Staff was professional, being able to accommodate our every request at the last minute. We were quite comfortable and slept well. Breakfast was good, with real eggs and biscuits. We will definitely stay there again.

Both Bad Boy locations offer the same good food, but I like this one a little more with the enclosed seating area, and the conversations I overhear from the employees at this location crack me up sometimes.

Bad Boy is my second-favorite burger joint to Big Jud's, but it's more like a #1 and #1A than a #1 and #2. The burgers are big and tasty, and I love how soft the buns always are. They have other sandwich options, but I go there for the burgers. Where Big Jud's has the advantage is with their hand-cut fries, which are some of the best in the city. That's not to say the ones at Bad Boy are bad. They're actually pretty solid, and you get a ton of them for a buck (there's only one size for fries). The amount you get puts the dollar value options at fast-food places to shame. You could feed three small children on the fries alone.

Good burgers + good value = good burger place. One of the best in Boise.

These people went ABOVE and BEYOND to help me! I called from out of the area 12 minutes before closing to see if they would deliver food to my sick daughter at UNR. They were so very helpful and delivered right away!!! I cannot thank them enough!! Please patronize this local business!!
Best PHO in town and the employees always greet you with a smile! I highly recommend trying their Thai tea too!
The food was fairly decent. The service SUCKED! We waited literally 45 minutes and all the other tables were attended to! We will not return, even if they gave me the "$10 jimmy bucks"

Wow! Just amazing Gluten Free food. They're very aware and dedicated to gluten free foods.  Its nice to be able to get a sandwich on the run or have a nice lunch there. My personal favorite is the chili mac and the cake/cupcakes. Even if your not strictly gluten free its worth going.

i loved jones.  like all the other restaurants in this group, i love the theme and decor, and the american homestyle menu.

and like most 'theme restaurants' i expected it to be mediocre overpriced food, but it wasn't. 

the menu is varied and unique, and fits the theme very well, and everything i ordered was absolutley delicious, and served in very generous sized portions.  we had a large doggie bag.  

we ate mac n cheese that was outrageous, delicious salads, and a fantastic burger.  even the drinks were delicious.  

this restaurant delivered exactly what it promised, and i can't wait to go back!  love it!

There's a few Las Palmas locations in and around Nashville, but this particular location has set the bar for me with fajitas. I can't go anywhere else now and get fajitas that are as consistently delicious like I get at this Las Palmas. There's something about the marinade or seasoning that they use on the meat and veggies that sets it apart from all the others. I think it might be made of crack. 

Before discovering their awesome fajitas, I've had their burritos and tacos, which are just as good. The Speedy Gonzalez makes for a perfect lunch. 

The service is usually par for the course with Mexican restaurants in the area. They're attentive just enough without feeling left out or over doing it. The food is always quick to be served, even during the busy lunch rush on weekdays. 

Oh yeah, speaking of weekday lunches, the place gets packed for lunch. I believe the trick is to get there as close to 11 as possible or after 1. There's even notices around the front door from the Fire Marshall because they're pretty serious about you not crowding the front door. 

So if you're looking for the best fajitas in Nashville, THIS Las Palmas is the place to go, except between 11:30 and 1 during the week. Las Palmas was also voted #1 Best Mexican Restaurant in the Nashville Scene's Best of Nashville 2010, though they don't reference which location.

This was my first visit to this particular bar. I wanted some fish and chips. Also it was just a new place. We ordered an iced tea. When it was served you couldn't even taste the liquor, the whole drink was kind of flat. But because I really wanted some fish and chips we decide to stay....let me back up for one minute...When we first walked in the door no one seated us as matter of fact the girl that was working downstairs just walk by didn't say anything went downstairs to the bar and start cleaning the bar. Well I went there and ask her could we be seated she said sure sit anyway you like again we waited., it was not a good experience... But I think I would like to go back then give it another shot.

My husband and I left Doll's and we are very full and very happy! We had the ribs and the salmon patties and both were delicious. We also can't get over the fried cornbread. So good. We could have eaten just a plateful of those. Doll's slogan is "soul food from heaven," and I totally agree. My heaven definitely includes Doll's food! The service is cheerful and friendly, and it has just the right "hole-in-the-wall" feel to it. If you are missing your granny's cooking, head to Doll's! It'll cure what ails ya!

The staff was amazing, impeccable service. The food, unbelievably tasty and at a great price! One look at the menu and you will realize the only issue of the day will be what delectable items to choose. After much debate and lots of help from our 2, not 1 waitressess, I finally gave in to the Shrimp Remoulade
as an appetizer and the Crawfish and Andouille Omelette as my entree. I am so glad I did, every bite was a joy and I am looking forward to returning very soon.

This Jose Garces spot is small (only 7 tables + bar seating) and always packed! I was finally able to try it for an early dinner on a Sunday! Cozy inside, and comfortable seating. The burger was quite delicious and I would have it again. (I had the village burger with caramelized onions, smoked bacon, and goat cheese). 

The only disappointment was the duck fat fries---I'm not sure what I was expecting. But there was nothing special about these fries. I liked that they were thick-cut. But they definitely could have been seasoned better. And aside from knowing that they had been fried in duck fat, possibly a number of times, there was nothing substantial or important to highlight with regards to taste, smell, or overall presentation. I don't know what frying them in duck fat adds to the dish, except an extra layer of fat...which didn't necessarily translate into an extra layer of taste. 

Very nice wait staff!

I have been here a couple of times and the food is great. The parking isn't the greatest and the restaurant is inconvenient to get to. Overall the service is good and the workers are friendly and welcoming.

Great vegetarian options (I got the Buffalo cauliflower - amazing), healthy options (chopped kale salad with almonds and dried blueberries with light dressing), as well as favorites like tacos, nachos, fried chicken and burgers.  Lots of tvs but also more secluded tables. Would definitely come back!

Most know I have been a long time customer of Crest Cadillac. My girl decided to move on from there and I too felt this might be an opportunity to check around for something different, yet have the same class of service. After much research and thought, I recently purchased a new 2017 Jaguar from Jaguar Nashville (Which is in Brentwood ) and I couldn't be Happier! My sales person was Craig Busion, was outstanding! I have a long sales back ground and feel I can be a bit picky at times about salespeople. Craig found the car he knew I would love. The car that had everything I wanted on it, and for the deal I needed it to be for. There were no high-pressure sales games. There were no tricks or gimmicky sales. He simply knew what I could or was willing to pay for the car I wanted, and Craig got the deal done~ 
I never once felt as though I was being sold to, honestly, I felt as though a friend was truly helping me get the car I've always dreamed of. 
I met the owner and he was super nice. He made sure I knew how important my purchase was to him and the dealership, even though I simply felt like a small fish.
He knows from my salesperson, how I am loyal from my years w/ buying and recommending friends and family to buy at Cadillac (btw They also own Andrews Cadillac now!!). He seemed to keep in mind even the small girl like me means a lot in the long haul. They made me feel just as important as the big fish. Maybe one day soon I will buy that F-Type or XJK I love so much!  Nevertheless, He appreciates everyone and made sure I knew.
Finance mgr Steve was easy going, made things simple and processed it quickly. I would truly recommend anyone wanting to get a Jaguar or Land/Range Rover to go see Craig at Jaguar/ Land Rover of Nashville. You won't be sorry and you'll probably leave with the Jaguar you have been dreaming of since you were 16. Thanks Craig!


p.s Now I've been driving my Jag for 4 months and I still Love Love Love it ! You should see the looks it gets ; )
Great service, great food,  and good prices. Pontis is a good place to order from if you are looking for unique combinations of classic American dishes.

Good taste, good service, huge portions!

Very surprising given that our expectations of a chain restaurant weren't high, we both left there planning to return.

Best Wings in the neighborhood. Also there is an amazing lunch special.  

I have been going here since they were called Mr. Wings back in the day. The service is great and owner is really nice.  I love to support local small business, especially in my neighborhood. 

The wings are great and 'hot' wings are the perfect spice and amazing taste. They are not overly hot and spicy like alot of places - so you can actually enjoy them.  Im really not sure where else in the far northeast/Bensalem area you can get high quality chicken. (Steak and hoagie I guess is my 2nd won't place due to the cheaper prices (but quality as service is choose George's Wings in a heartbeat)!
Accommodating staff, cheery environment. Good cappuccino. I recommend their nova lox bagel.

Yummie crepes! We had ordered 3 and everyone was delighted. The gluten free one was exceptional even though I had to ask them to omit some key ingredients in a crepe like cheese due to food allergies. Totally delicious and kind staff members. If we weren't leaving early the next morning we would have went again for breakfast!!Definitely recommend! :)
As Bob says - closed.  The interior of this and the former Red Room next door (moved to where Terrapin Station was) is currently gutted and under construction.

The family and I tried this place as our usual Mexican spot was without power.  A neighbor and friend highly recommended it so why not.  Well, I think we have a new typical Mexican restaurant.  Fantastic and clean atmosphere compared, GREAT service, and delicious food.  Would highly recommend.

I been here twice.  Both times, apparently my timing was off.  The first time the chief was opening a new restaurant (Tuscan Grill) and the second was the day after Christmas.  Both times the food was no better than okay (certainly not worth the price, and no where near what I've heard from others).  It sounded way better on the menu than it tasted on the plate.  On the last visit, my duck was overdone as was my wife's fish.

Krystal and her team literally put together the wedding of my dreams. Being a bride from Houston, TX I hired a Santa Barbara local planner in hopes that they could connect me with some great local vendors. She did not disappoint!!! 
I barely know where to begin in terms of how amazing she is. I honestly was lost (in the wedding planing process) before her!  By the time I found her we were already a little less than a year from the wedding date so from day ONE we hit the ground running! Krystal was so communicative, so cooperative, so patient, so helpful, so reassuring, I mean the list goes on and on. If I wasn't 100% sure or happy with the vendors she initially recommended, she would always have an option that was exactly what I was looking for. She knew my vision before even having to fully explain it - she is that good! 
In terms of day of (wedding was March 31, 2018- so this is still relatively fresh), everything ran extremely smoothly. I mean if there were any issues at all, I didn't even know about them. Krystal checked in on us girls getting ready maybe once or twice just to see if we needed anything or how things were coming along and that was really it! Otherwise we were left to completely enjoy ourselves! I was getting a little worried as we got closer to the ceremony time because we were running a little behind while getting ready, but Krystal was so calming and reassuring that everything will still run smoothly so I was not stressed about making it exactly to my timeline! 
After the ceremony, Krystal had drinks in hand, ready for us, while taking photos. She made sure we got some of our passed appetizers that were going around during our cocktail hour, and she made sure we actually got some food and ate! The rest of the night was just perfect. The DJ, DJ Hectik - someone highly recommended by Krystal, kept everyone on the dance floor the remainder of the night! 
Literally that day was my dream come true. Couldn't have been better. I'm gonna miss Krystal! It was amazing getting to work with her and I would do it again in a heartbeat!

I have waited 2 years for this place to open and so glad they are open!  Their baked goods are high quality and their cupcakes are some of the best in the city without the sickening sweet icing.   They also have a wide variety of items.   And, talk about convenience, I live across the street!

Week-end food is very different from week-day food.  The food we had over the week-end was just OK  however the pizza was excellent.  The Chicken Francese was good and the Chicken Picatta was great but way overpriced for the 2 very small pieces of chicken that were no bigger than the palm of my hand.  Greek Salad had no potato salad.  Garlic rolls were just cold buns with a dusting of garlic powder and not even lukewarm.  Won't eat there again or get takeout on the week-end as food was very disappointing.  I was so looking forward to a great meal but will give it another try during a week-day.

Great sushi and a great value.  I have always loved coming for sushi at this location, even when it was Sansui (remember their tuna rose with wasabi mayo..yum!)

Started with edamame and spicy tuna salad, and we were pleasantly surprised when our server brough comp miso soup and ginger salad as well.  Everything was delicious, though the edamame were slightly overcooked.  The spicy tuna was a standout, and the ginger dressing on the salad was some of the best and freshest I have had.

We had the crazy roll, the fancy roll, and a scallop roll, all very tasty, though the fancy roll was out of this world- spicy, crunchy, flavorful deliciousness.  I also got pieces of toro and unagi.  The toro was good, though not as fatty and succulent as I have had in the past, but the unagi was amazing.  Perfectly prepared with a light, tangy bbq sauce.  My friend, who had a bad experience with eel and won't eat it, even tried a small bite and enjoyed it.  

We had a large bottle of hot sake to accompany our meal, and so were blown away when the bill came and it was $60 for all that food and drink.  Really amazing...it would be $80 or more anywhere else.

Fantastic Dishes all around! We order same items to create our own buffet at home and we are never disappointed. The Mongolian beef was very very heavy on the onions and not as heavy on the beef but we could easily corrected next time by asking for light onion. The General Tso chicken, Szechwan dumplings, and pork fried rice are incredible.  We come from Chicago to visit family in Indiana and this is a must order while we are in town :-)

Excellent! Finally a good Indian restaurant in Pinellas!  It was my kids, 10yrs & 7yrs, first time eating Indian food so I ordered the Chicken masalas and they loved it.  

The 3 of us shared one dish and had some naan.  We were stuffed! 


They make their own yogurt and it's so creamy.  Loved their mango lassi.  

The decor is colorful and elegant.  We were in awe when we walked in as the outside does not reflect the beauty that awaits inside.  

Come try it out! If you like Indian you won't be disappointed.

Tasty tasty! I'm not a brunch/breakfast person but I came here for a friend since she is. For being Sunday brunch time and the day of the Midwest Regional final for March Madness, we were seated quickly [within 10-15min]. I was surprised this was a chain since I try to avoid them. 
Coffee was awesome and a good way to start my late morning. Despite the sheer amount of traffic our server was sweet, nice & quick. 
Try one of the local new things! I had the lemon ricotta pancakes and a side of fruit - definitely filling and the lemon curd on my pancakes was awesome despite my avoidance of lemon-flavoured things. 
Cannot wait to go back!
Always have the freshest, most delicious donuts in St. Louis. If you are in the area, they are definitely worth the trip. - Remember- Cash for orders under $10.00

I give this place even more stars, if I could. The coffee and especially the espresso are truly out-of-this-world. And you can bring your dog in! what's even better though, is the service. There's nothing like walking into a business and consistently being greeted with genuine friendliness. The owner and (as far as I know, the only employee) sets a benchmark in this area. And it's not just an obsequious 'I'm just being friendly because I have to be and want a good tip', it's completely real. Even after just my first visit, he remembered my name, my job, and what I ordered previously. A friend and I have taken to going on dog-walks nearly every day around lunchtime and making a point to stop in, if even just to say hello. True, it doesn't have quite the comfy/cozy atmosphere as a more-established places, but the good vibes the owner exudes, and the quality of the drinks more than make up for that. Philly's coffee shop owners seriously need to just come in and see how the owner conducts himself and treats the customers; it would give them oodles of food-for-thought,

The carne asada is out of this world! Flavors unlike anywhere else in Boise and the owner is excited about his product. We basically got an orientation to Latin food before we ordered. Plus, it's quick and well-packaged if your take your order to go.

Come hungry and bring your friends! It's a high-quality truck tucked away in a fairly quiet corner behind BSU and you won't be disappointed!

And, in fact, I did go back again!!
I wanted to try the Beef Ribs dinner.  It appears they marinate beef short ribs and then broil them to order over mesquite wood.  Waitress asked how I wanted them prepared though she was a little vague.  Normally I am a medium-rare kind of guy.  Got five ribs (actually 2.5 ribs since they were cut in half). The meat had a great flavor, thought this type of preparation causes shrinkage...  A very good change of pace, served with salad, choice of tortillas and beans.

A note:  they offer a drive-thru window...

Friendly waiter, obviously new. He was very good though. Waited a while to order. Waited and waited more for our food. My chili was cold and did not taste like "homemade". My BLT arrived with cheese but no mayo. They fixed it. It was not worth the price, although the bacon was crisp like I like. Mediocre food. Husbands burger was overcooked with little to no taste. The place was nearly empty,. It was a Friday night. Don't know why it took so long to get our food. The other patrons that were there also had issues with their food. Won't go back.
This place was a pleasant surprise. The three different levels gives it a great atmosphere. They do there best to accommodate  their patrons and drinks are great.

I went here with my sister about a week or so ago and was pleasantly surprised.  A lot of these Vietnamese fusion restaurants are popping up all over the place, but the common problem with a lot of them is that they are so Americanized that the dishes don't have enough authentic Vietnamese flavor.

This isn't the case at Mint.  Although the menu is pretty much entirely in English (I wish they had the items in Vietnamese too)  the food here is jam-packed with authentic Vietnamese flavor with beautiful presentation.
