I was looking at the Apples and had never heard of a specific type. The stock person asked me if I had ever tried it..I said no..he pulled out a knife, cut into the apple and handed me a slice right on the spot.

Publix friendliness and customer service meets farm fresh to table goods.

From the review I really expected more.....

Did the Swamp tour with 2 friends. While booking the person on the other end was very rude and not very friendly. But since it was recommended to us by our concierge, we went with this tour company. One bus picked up up from our hotel, only to drop us off at another bus once all passengers were picked up. Which was full and our group could not sit next to each other. 

At the location, the bathroom was the equivalent of an outhouse. It was dirty and dark inside with only 2 womens bathrooms (1 which was out of order) and 1 men's stall.

While waiting in line the swamp tour boat driver was yelling at us to get on the boat, even though he obviously saw us waiting for the rest room.

The tour itself was mediocre. All the promotional guides featuring an alligator encounter was probaly one in a 100. On our roughly 2 hours tour, we saw 2 snakes. I was very disappointed because I paid $49 bucks expecting to see some freakin alligators. The tour was too long for what we saw, trees, more trees, and water. Though it was beautiful, i did not need 2 hours to see it.

The worst part was the lack of organization after the tour. We were waiting for our bus back to the city for nearly 30 minutes. No one from the tour company told us what time the driver would get here. We just had to stand outside and pray they would get there within that day! Wish I could get a refund for this waste of money!

I have been coming to Allisonville Nursery for many years now and continue to be impressed.  I have never purchased trees here but have purchased a wide variety of shrubs (boxwoods, hostas, ninebark, several viburnum varieties, etc.) and all are going very strong in my yard.

I've always been impressed with the quality of the plants here...although my father used to own a landscape business (and purchase wholesale) and I have a pretty good feel for prices.  I think some of it is a tad expensive.  Not too concerned though...I don't mind supporting local business and the store is just really cool.  None of the green peppers I purchased from here last year bore any fruit (similar plant from Home Depot same spot did fine), so that has been my only issue.

As others mentioned, there are a large selection of garden accents, pots, fertilizers, etc.  It really is a very comprehensive selection of products...and there are many items you won't find at a big box.

The staff is extremely helpful...today I was looking for a pedestal for a sundial and the staff went out of their way to assist me in what I was looking for.  I ended up leaving with a birdbath and Patty (?) spent a good amount of time helping...thank you!  It just is the sort of place for people who love gardening and the outdoors...impulse buying is very easy here.

Note of caution...in the spring on a weekend this place can get extremely crowded.  Getting assistance is definitely more an issue just due to volume. If you need help swing by during the week...they will take care of you.

I went there a while ago and remembered why I hate that specific store. Every time I've been in there the clerks have been so rude. I went in to sell some kid toys and they were later rejected after I called and was told they had enough room for them. Not only did I drive 45 min to get there but once I got there I was told how I couldn't bring one of their carts to my car to fill it with the items I was going to be selling. Mind you, I was about 8 months pregnant at that time. So I had to get in my car, pull it to the front of the store, then unload everything. No one bothered to say hello upon walking in. No one bothered to hold the door or open it when they saw I was clearly having issues trying to get all the stuff in side. Then after lugging all that into the store they could only take like 1 item out of 10 things. It was really a waste of my time and energy. I have not been back to that store and probably will never be going back simply because of the customer service I received.
The customer service is amazing. The lady (Laura) in the drive through is sweet and very on top of it!!!! I LOVE to eat at the CRAZY CHICKEN!!

Stopped to see if they had any rooms available on a whim because this is one of the closest hotels to the Nashville night life. The hotel staff was extremely helpful and courteous which, sadly, you don't seem to find anymore. Room rates are slightly higher than other options but still priced right for the location. The decor is trendy and all the rooms have keurig coffee makers which is a great touch. I even found myself doing valet parking because the valet had such a great attitude and seemed genuinely interested in where we were from and what we were doing in Nashville.  Definitely would recommend this to anyone in for a night or two.

Went here on a recommendation and was very satisfied.  Most of the reviews on here were about sushi so figured I would comment on the Chinese food portion.  My food was great and the prices were pretty good as well.  Had it delivered and it came quicker than was told.  I would definitely recommend it.
If I could rate this place a 0, I would. Worst customer services and the employees don't care what so ever. Avoid this place if you could. Never again.
It's the best protein value for fast food out there. 80 grams of protein for there chicken breasts? Awesome. Two meals  for $$7.00? The best

This place is well worth the long ass wait! Although nothing fancy inside & super tight, the food was perfect! We had the bananas foster French toast & shrimp & grits and absolutely loved both!! Service was fine but the overall fabulousness of this place is the food itself! Thoughtfully prepared & delicious!

I enjoyed the friendly nature of the staff.  Room was nice.and clean. Beds and pillows were comfortable.   There is really nothing to legitimately complain About.  Esp when you compare the price and amenities they offer to other hotels.  

Just wish they were in Minnesota.

Great food. Nice decor but nothing fancy.  The waitress seemed distant at first, but warmed up later when it was clear how much we enjoyed the food. 

I had the pepper Steak, the best ever; $9.95. My wife ordered Curry Pork (native spice), also $9.95.   Hers could scorch my esophagus, but she loved it. 

ImPorted beer was a bit pricy at $6-7.  Bud etc was $3.50. We enjoyed a glass of water and departed for $25 all included. Great value.

I'm usually not a burger person but my friend insisted that we try this place out since it was apparently the best burger they have ever had. I ordered the Whiskey Burger. I will admit this is the best burger I have ever had- it literally has all of my fave burger toppings all in one burger. The burger could definitely feed two people (I barely finished it-haha) The service was great, and the bar tenders were excellent. Thanks for making me gain 5 lbs :-) #noregrets
Josh was our server and he was AWESOME! Thanks for the great food and friendly service! Steak was awesome I had the Grouper blackened and it was delicious!
Second time here. The last time was four years ago don't know why it took so long to return.   The only thing negative for this throwback hippie brunch place is waiting a half hour for a table
Simple yet delicious cuban food. Not expensive at all and you get a lot for what you pay. No frills and it doesn't need it, the food speaks for itself!

So I've been to Jones a couple times now and I've always enjoyed the atmosphere. Got the shrimp and chicken dumplings and there were four of em for 8 bucks with soy sauce that just kinda resembled plain old soy sauce. I got the crabcake which was a good size and tasty. Fries that came with the dish were nothing special. Service was fine and I'll probably be back, I just need to figure out what entrees are worth getting.

I pass this place all the time and finally thought I'd give it a try. The ambiance is nice for this place. Lots of variety and options but everything was mediocre. I had some high hopes for this place but I  don't think I'll be going back anytime soon. Service was fine though.

Location is small and it's tucked away in the corner from the Indian store Parking lot. Food is pretty good it's just the time to get food to go or in the restaurant can make for a terrible experience.  

Needs more staff - probably a bigger location And it would do really well.

Spasso is one of my "go-to" places for take out platters when I am a bit ahead on budget, low on time and talent in the kitchen, yet plentiful with hungry house guests.

My favorite, so far, is the Penne Spasso. Baked pasta with a creamy pink tomato sauce that is perfection with peas, prosciutto, mushrooms, and bacon. I got the smaller tray (it fed 6 hungry people) for $50. 

I changed the pick-up time more than once because of last minute issues on my end and they were most accommodating. They even offered to drop my small order off (I live close by). Very kind, indeed. 

I topped off with a Caesar salad and dinner was served (with bread and dessert from my Soprano-wanna-be gal pal Carmela).

I'm placing another order tomorrow for another gathering in a few weeks. Maybe this time I'll confess that I didn't actually make it myself. Hahaha! They didn't believe me anyway. Spasso got all the well-deserved credit.

I was looking for a healthy smoothie place in the area and came across this place. I decided to get food as well because I was hungry as heck.

I ordered a smoothie and a power bowl. After I put in my order I was talking with the manager and she was so polite and helpful.

The place is inviting and just has a good energy about it. As I was waiting for my food I noticed they had "healthy soda". All the flavors sounded really good and I would have gotten that but I was craving the smoothie. When my food was ready, I dug right in. Everything was delicious. I don't think I breathed the entire time. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone.

Great location for getting bait and tackle before heading out to the Skyway Piers.  They've always had shrimp and squid on hand each time I've been here.   
Great little place.

Go just for the views and the scenery!

On the side enjoy their great selection of seafood, drinks, and salads.

There was quite a wait when I went, so I opted to sit outside. It was nice and private out there. I'm not sure why it was so open, but if they offer it...jump on it

My husband and I only had a few short days in St. Petersburg and I am so glad we stayed here. Bill and Wilder are lovely, accommodating people and the room was beautiful (veranda suite). We loved that we could walk to all the great restaurants and could see the bay from down the street. The pool and garden area is like an oasis in the city.  Be sure to ask for a cappuccino!

The only downside was the noise coming from the construction next door...on the positive, the locals say the area is really getting revamped so how could you hold it against them? We would absolutely go back.

Great addition to this area of town. I love that the staff is always super upbeat and positive. it's a great plac to have a smoothie after a long night and they welcome dogs. my only criticisms are the cash only policy and the niche nature of some of the menu items. I wish some of the offerings were a little more simple is all.

I recently popped into kermits to talk about ordering a birthday cake for my daughter, I was told no one there could speak with me and that I would have to email the owner to order a special cake(so I came all the way down here for nothing!?!?) Luckily one of the bakers behind the counter overheard and stepped in, she said that she was the main decorator and would be happy to at least talk over the details of what i wanted.  She was extremely helpful and even talked me into buying some treats to take home!  Unfortunately she still was not "allowed" to take my order or quote me a price, that only the owner would be able to do that.  "oh thats okay, when will he be around?" i asked "not entirely sure, he actually lives in new orleans"  WHAT???? no, sorry I do not think that I will be ordering my cake here.  I have never been to a bakery where i was not able to receive face to face help when wanting to order a cake.  Such a shame because the girl who spoke with me was as much help as she possibly could have been and the treats she recommended were great! But to go all the way down there just to be told to go home and send an email is a real turn off for me.

This is a close grocery store to me and while convenient, it is incredibly pricy. Things may even be a $1 or 2 more than Frys. I only go when its easiest for me.

It is a nice place to grab some prepared food, breakfast or hard to find ethnic foods. 

Great wine selection.

Will go again... only when I need to. 

I usually buy all my birthday cakes (when needed/parties) here. They do a great job.

Part of our Living Social deal included a voucher for Desire Oyster bar.  OH where do I begin? 

I had the shrimp and gritz for breakfast and my girlfriend had the bbq'd shrimp for breakfast.   

I know what you're thinking and trust me, it's not what you think. The food was filled with spices I'd never tasted.  If you go, start with the Oysters.  They are huge!  We live in Southern California and I've yet to see fresh Oysters this size.  Gigantic and delivered from the Gulf that very morning. Don't sleep on this place!  

Cheers!

I have been coming to Andrew at Clayton 230 barber for the past three months. I have difficult hair to cut due to volume and quantity of both hair and cowlicks. Andrew takes the time to give me a professional looking cold suitable for me. In addition, he is always accommodating of my schedule and texting to get an appointment.

Worth the time and money. One of the best cuts I have had, especially since it is consistently repeated.
Had a wonderful time with my daughter, they were not busy the outdoor seating is not to loud with the passing cars and we both had a thoughtful talk with mint chip ice cream. I enjoyed this
The only Culver's in the country without a veggie patty. Ridiculous. I shan't ever stop at that location ever again. Can I give 0 stars?
Love Dunedin, The bar lacks decent entertainment. The bar staff isn't very personal.My husband and i went friday, and the bar staff acted as if getting us a drink was a big deal.

Our first trip this year to this famous St. Louis Landmark.  It always brings back great memories.

Got there about 8:00 and the place, as usual, was SLAMMED.

But, as always, great service.  We got our treats very quickly.  

The kids who work here are taught correctly about hard work and customer service.  Other businesses could learn a lot from the training they receive.

My wife had a bet with the couple we went with that she would find someone she knew.  Sure enough, good friends from Ladue walked around the corner.

That's the kind of place Ted Drewes is!

Francesca!!! She was AMAZING. 

First, I'm from California and I just love the location, set up, and decor of the spa!

I was getting married and my family set up a spa day for me! It could not have been more perfect. I first had a massage with Francesca and then a mud treatment with the hot and cold shower. Francesca had a great touch. She was warm and inviting but also friendly. I have had some very uncomfortable massages before not this one. When and if I ever return to the area I will definitely come back. And for all of the guest who I know who are in the area I have told them to come here.

Had an excellent experience here Saturday morning with my wife and daughter. Our server was Courtney and she did a wonderful job. The food was great and there's nothing better than looking at a menu and being so torn on what to order. Many great options. Settled on French toast, two eggs, and sausage and added some Nutella and strawberries. Coffee is also very good, we will definitely be visiting again!
Food was above mediocre. Went there late night to be greeted by two somewhat rude workers. Took a long time for the food to come out. Will not be coming back.

Super umami and shrimpy tastes, a great place to get Asian food with broths and sauces that will knock your socks off with flavor. Cheap, fast, and a unique Malaysian place to visit while you're in Chinatown.

I tried a lobster taco. You should also try the lobster taco! Man, it is so good, especially with the lightly fried tortilla for some crunch. I did pick off a little bit of the cilantro because I would prefer it chopped up a bit, but that didn't slow me down. Sorry, no pic because it didn't last long enough!

This spa was a wonderful experience. I spent the afternoon here with my daughter and her girlfriend.  The service was fabulous. Everyone was very kind and attentive to us.  I had a facial and body treatment.  I came out completely relaxed with my skin glowing.  The girls had therapeutic massages and both said their masseuse was focused and paid attention to key areas. Overall excellent experience.  I've just moved to the area so I will now be using the spa on a regular basis.
slim pickings for vegan and vegetarian fare.  I hate being told what to eat... especially if it is salad.  next time it will be a liquid dinner or nothing at all.

We were staying nearby while on vacation and we were very happy to have found this bakery!  They have a huge selection of pastries.  Our favorites were the fresh churros and the flaky fruit pastries, similar to turnovers.  But maybe even better were the fresh tamales.  We LOVED the chicken ones which had green salsa and a nice spiciness to them.  Hope to go back someday!

I opted out of the dinner package , seems like the folks that did eat enjoyed it , I was in it for the nostalgic ride up and down the Mississippi with a great Jazz band in the background . Dukes of Dixieland play a mean jazz and Mr . Broom sounds just like Louise Armstrong and I would like to say that you all for hospitality .

These steaks were great!  Got two before boarding our flights out of Philly.  Ate one on the flight when it was still warm.  At the other in Minnesota during our layover and it was great cold!  Good job Oregon!

I decided to try to go to CareStat Urgent Care instead of the Emergency Room for an ear infection.  I should have left after speaking with the unprofessional receptionists at the front desk.  The rest of my experience here consisted of the doctor tapping on my ear stating "I bet this hurts." and him asking me if the nurse I saw at another facility was a young female because she sounded like she didn't know what she was doing.  As if this wasn't bad enough for me to sit through, the 'professional'  then proceeds to mock if I have a drug problem when I declined pain killers for the ear infection.

All around a unpleasant experience.

I have to admit I walked into this not wanting to like it at all.  I like doing art and different things but have never really been good at a paint by numbers thing. Which is what I thought this was. I was very very wrong. 
It was a blast. The person in charge of the class was fun and energetic. She made the class fun. She showed you what to do but made it clear that you can just have fun with it and do what you want if that's what you want to do. 
Coming here with a group of girls and having wine was a ton of fun.  We all left with something fun to show for the evening and I would do it again.  I didn't expect to like this place or this class and this is one of the few times I was happy to be wrong.  Between the people leading and helping with the class and the wine and the mischief we got into painting it was a great night.

I wish I could give it a higher rating.  The food is so good but don't expect anyone to care that you're there. 

The waitress really had no interest in explaining the different items listed on the menu. They really made me feel like they weren't interested in serving me unless I was Bosnian. 

Very poor customer service which was such a shame because the food was so good.

I took my little Charlie boy to Wags to Riches for the first time today and I was extremely happy! Samantha was his groomer and I would have to say this was probably the best haircut he has ever had! Not only was the haircut fantastic their service was great! They were able to work with the drop off and pick up to accommodate my work schedule. I will never go anywhere else!

Whoopsies, apparently the Publix and Tsunami Sushi are not related. My bad. I still enjoy many other places better than this one though, my sister orders takeout from there every once in awhile and it doesn't seem to have changed much since my last visits.

This place is perfect for a special dinner with a special person. It's cozy and romantic. The service is amazing, quick and friendly. We got the scallops to start with and they were delicious. You can tell they are fresh and the waiter let us know that they go the extra mile to make sure they are not frozen. The steaks were delicious! Mine was over cooked a little however the waiter make sure to  fix it immediately and my meal was perfect. I recommend this to anyone wanting an delicious meal!
Shenanigans is no longer there.  Burned to the ground a few weeks ago.

I've been here numerous times. I do not mind the 30 minute trip here because I love their food! For the amount of times I've been here, I am pretty sure I memorized the menu; although I still get the same thing:

6oz. medium rare sirloin w/ caesar salad & seasoned rice. 

I loveeee their bread, omg.

Smiley's Cafe deserves it's five star rating. The owner Smiley has to be one of the most grateful and therefore happy people I've met in Philadelphia. 

I am a long-time regular at the South Street Souvlaki but after one time my boyfriend was literally chocking on a piece of splintered wood in his souvlaki, have tried to go less and less. I love greek food that is easy, delicious, and inexpensive and never thought I'd find somewhere else in the city.

I am sooooo glad I did. I love to support a business with a nice owner. The smoothies were delicious. I love that he offers them. I love the outside seating. I love the taste of the food. 

I had the garlic chicken pita with hummus and salad. The chicken breast was soooo lean and yet soooo moist. How does he do it?  I'm in garlic heaven.

While I have been to art museums that I would rate higher (Cincinnati, OH comes to mind) the IMA ended up being a fantastic place to spend an afternoon.  I was disappointed that the African exhibit was closed for renovation during my visit but the thousands of other pieces on display were quite often breathtaking.  The museum itself has four levels, three of which are devoted to exhibit space.  It sits on 100+ acres containing walking trails, self-guided flora tours, a greenhouse and the Lilly Estate (a renovated 1930s-style mansion that is open to the public for tours).  There is minimal free parking available and otherwise the cost to park is only five dollars.  With admission to the museum being free this makes for quite an inexpensive outing!

Easy parking. Good food. reasonable priced.
Feel like dining at some 5 star restaurant. "Head chef" personally come out to make sure the food is up to standard.
The food is Authentic homemade/in-house recipes. Delicious food amazing service. I love this place!

Went out to lunch with a large group of coworkers here on 8/14/14. Sat outside on the patio. Service was poor and food was mediocre. 

- Service: server was a shorter woman with dark hair in a high bun. We made it clear we were under time constraints but received snappy comments every time we asked for anything. 

- Food: Crossing Burger was decent but no one else had anything particularly worth complimenting. 
 
Wouldn't go here again and wouldn't recommend it.

I have been to the Chipotle at 126th street 2 times now and each time they have been out of either Chicken or Steak.  I was not there at odd hours, and they did not seem in any type of rush to get the food prepared and out.  I decided to have steak instead since they were out of Chicken, the Steak was cold and chewy.  Chipotle has lost some of its appeal.

Under new management. Chris and his team are definitely going the extra mile to make you happy. The food is good, the standard O'Charley's fare. Served hot and fresh, I've never had a bad meal here. And now it comes with better service. I'll take it!

Its been really difficult for me to find good Thai food in the Philadelphia area. I have been ruined since traveling to Thailand in 2012 because the food was simply incredible. I forgot my lunch one day at work, so I took a walk to grab some Thai takeout at a place near this place by my office. It was a pretty quick walk, and I headed out right after I ordered because they said it would be ready in 15 minutes and when I arrived it was. I took it back to the office and set it up immediately

I ordered the green curry that came with a side salad with peanut dressing and white rice. I dumped all of my rice into the container with the curry and immediately dug it. It was still piping hot, and it had a really nice amount of heat to it. Traditional flavors for sure. Thai basil, coconut, chiles, carrots, onion, the balance of flavor was great. The rice soaked up a nice amount of the curry as well, leaving each and ever bite flavorful and comforting. The side salad was definitely lack luster. The dressing was not my favorite. It was very fatty and the flavor wasnt great, I would have preferred not to have gotten it at all. 

I will definitely be back to fill my Thai cravings. This is the best I have found yet in the area, and its definitely affordable and worth the visit.

What an unbelievable find.  Who would have guessed such a great place hidden in the woods of the Santa Barbara mountains.

Rich with history as the building is some 160 years old, and apparently where Wells Fargo used to come through.  Food was great and priced right, and the the inside felt exactly what it must've felt like to dine a couple hundred years ago.  Me and my dinner cohorts almost fought over the artichoke appetizer.  Steak was great, service was good, great ambiance.  Awesome, awesome, awesome!

The best Chicago adjacent pizza!  Can't be true Chicago without Lake Michigan water!!!  I'd love to do a blind tasting of Lou Malnati's and yours.  Bet the reviews would be very very close!  Love the remodel!

I used to come here for drinks after work and the Bruschetta which is delicious and super cheap (3$!!!).  I went for the first time in a long time last night with a few friends and the experience was ice cold.  We go there about 50 minutes before close and were greeted by the manager with no smile and a warning that they closed in 45 minutes.  That being said, all we wanted was a couple drinks and apps.  We did not do any entrees much less any dishes that required any significant time or labor, wings, my bruschetta, and one dessert on top of 3 cocktails.  Server was nice enough and very polite about replacing my first drink which came out in a glass that was nearly cracked in half.  We paid our bill right as they locked doors and let our server clean off our entire table.  We were out on the patio, assuming that it was probably the best place to be if you were going to there a little past close.  Needless to say, the manager on duty came out moments later and proclaimed "I'm lockin' up."  with no smile, empathy, remorse, or hospitality.  I understand you are locking the place down for the night AND that I am there past close... but if you want to send the right message... don't be a jerk 15 minutes after you close and literally kick out all of your guests.  There are much more professional and friendly ways to handle that.  Wouldn't mind being asked to leave or step off the patio so they could locked down the store, I am not that difficult. Nor was it even that late.

Boggles my mind, I've worked in this industry for a long enough time to appreciate good service and a nice place.  I am not that guest, I say thank you, pose questions politely, and only draw flaws to the attention of my server or manager when they are dire enough to be noted.  This guy was a joke, rude and unwelcoming from the get go.  I will not spend my money at a place were it feels like it's an inconvenience to have me sit at one of your tables.... AND NEITHER SHOULD YOU!

A last minute Burning Man booking meant that all the rooms in my usual stay at The Peppermill were completely gone with this place being a mere $60 for the one night it had to be tried.

This hotel really is better than the price suggests with a free two mile shuttle bus to anywhere in town and back. The location is great, just next to the airport with parking if you need it. The rooms are big and clean with a large sitting area and a nice large kitchenette and big clean bathroom. The room itself did feel quite 'premium' with lots of tasteful wood and nice materials with a huge bed. The free wifi is good an the food options are excellent for a smaller hotel like this. There was even a gym and indoor pool which I didn't get to try.

The breakfast menu seems to have a good range of fresh dishes unlike the the rather drab choices found at most small hotels. I tried a burger on my one night there which while not mind blowing was pretty nice, well priced and just what was needed after a long flight.

The staff were wonderfully helpful and enthusiastic finding the time to help you with anything you needed. They even found the time to just have a friendly conversation, because we all need that sometimes!

I really liked this hotel and if one night and a breakfast before travelling again is all you need it provides a really nice stay thats also great value.
The view, the food, the staff= incredible! ! I highly recommend the blackened grouper sandwich at sunset!

I found it quite affordable so I was surprised at the number of people commenting on the price. The food was delicious. The service is average. We have gone many times and the food is consistently superior. It's a gem!
These guys are on point!  I have tried their pork, brisket, & chicken.  Super good!  It is also nice to know that they cook it all there.  Thanks for the fantastic food B&C!

My son LOVES this place and eats here with his friends often.  Their pho is so good and I love those weird lil spring rolls.  The large pho is served in a huge bowl with fresh herbs and lime on the side!  I like the chicken pho but my son and all his friends like the rare beef pho.  My favorite is the green tea boba!!!

Expensive sushi for an average taste. Tried their Hot and a spicy dumpling soup and that was so much better than the rest. It's in a huge shopping outlet so the price is obvious to be on the pricier side. Don't think it was worth the $$ for such average sushi.

Stopped by to try their "Food Network approved" creole seafood gumbo. Don't do it - it's extremely fishy and flavorless. Also tried the Cajun Dirty Rice which had almost no flavor despite being a nice shade of dark brown. Walk past here and go to one of the many other shops in the French Market.

I don't know how a place that's supposed to cater to children and families only has one family room (on first floor, we didn't care to make it to 2nd after bad experience) and one changing station. The museum does not have a nursing area or a microwave. Last time I checked, children and babies need to eat and not everyone can eat Subway. How can they claim to be a children's place but not cater to their clients? We waited 15 min to get into the changing/family room, then we circled around to find where to heat up food. We live 40 min away, if we can't eat breakfast and lunch there the trip isn't worth it. Citrus Park mall has 4 changing stations, 3 nursing rooms, a family room and additional bathroom stalls and changing stations throughout the mall. I asked for my membership money to be refunded and the clerk at front desk told me to leave my info and some would be in touch. 2 business days later still no contact. I was very excited to purchase this membership and extremely disappointed after my first visit with my 18 month old daughter.

This is my favorite place in Santa Barbara. I've been living here for almost two years now and I've experienced nothing better than Intermezzo! I love the cozy yet upbeat atmosphere. This is great place to grab a drink, kick back and eat some AMAZING food. I am especially a fan of their prosciutto and humboldt fog pizza, it is insane! The apps, wine list and service is all exceptional. I am always sad to leave this place!

I love Studio Branca, and recommend it to anyone, any chance I get. 

I've been going to SB for about 3 years now, and have never had a bad experience. The salon is always clean and comfortable, the staff friendly. Atmosphere is great, so relaxing to get your hair washed close to the sound of a fountain built into the wall. 

I'd highly, highly recommend Becky. The first time I went to SB I needed my hair cut quickly, and she was available. I've never switched, nor have I wanted to switch hairdressers. She gets my personality and my hair type, and is able to translate my loose directions into exactly the cut I want. Once, I told her I was going for a french girl summer, and wanted her to match my haircut to that...and, despite its craziness, she did it!

The complementary beverages (alcoholic or not) are always pretty nice, too.

The most striking feature outside of the obviously stunning decor is the friendliness of the bell hops, the security guards, and the concierges.  

Love the clean,clean,clean and perfectly maintained lobby,elevator,halls and rooms.  The room was a nice size and the bed very comfortable. 

I was very thankful for the security guards and the obvious concern for the guest safety.  Screening entry at night by requiring a room key of everyone entering, not letting strangers enter.  Wow.  Thank you for looking out for us newbies to the Bourbon environment with this safe haven.  

The crawdads at the pool bar were unbelievably finger licken.  The chicken wrap tasty.  

Having a coffee shop inside the hotel for mornings quick start breakfast, and afternoon caffeine boosts works for me.

The location on Bourbon street makes access to the action perfect.  You walk right out into the crazy , have a good time, and then when you've had enough go back in to the instant relief of calm serene opulence of the Sonesta.  

When I go back,  I'll only stay here.

We ventured in the store to compare prices with Whole Foods, as soon as we walked in my husband looks at me and our eyebrows raise suddenly.  We made a 360 degree turn and left.   The place is too dark, it feels depressing to be in there, even the outdoor night markets in Thailand are better lit.  How does anybody see in there, It feels like a dark alley, I had to literally squint.  The workers did not seem too happy as well, needless to say we will not be back and will stay with Whole Foods/Trader Joes and wait for Wegemans.

I've been twice few years ago.  The food is average to me.  I saw the groupon deal so I thought why not give them another chance. Nothing has changed. My
Boyfriend ate half of our food to save room for the dessert.  We had cowboy burger and turkey burger. We left half of each burger and a plate of fries. Food still so so, our server was very nice EXCEPT when we asked for to go box he took the food away and never came back with our left over (technically a whole meal, a burger and fries)    We found out he threw it away.  At this point I paid for food that just get throw away. Luckily I used groupon so I didn't pay that much but still it's my food.  I walked away with no leftover that I was looking forward to eat next day. :-(.

PS: as you can see below the manager contacted me. I contacted him back but never heard from him. I thought at least I will get a free dessert or a burger as their apology.  Nothing no respond.
Had a great time here with friends on Saturday night. Very reasonable, and strong drink pours at the bar!  Will definitely be going back.

Today was my first time here. I love it. Fast, simple, delicious, a tiny bit on the pricy side for me ($14 for a salad and a drink) but knowing that it is a super healthy meal, I didn't mind. I agree with other reviewers, that there should be more of these around this city. The restaurant is small but absolutely pristine. Definitely see myself frequenting this place in the future.

Well we went to Tony's last nite.. Sat nite for dinner is busy. 
Upon entering, we noticed that there were several other groups waiting. We told the unsmiling hostess that we were a party of three.  She told us it would be a 20 minute wait.  We reluctantly gave her our name & sat down in the front lobby. 
Tony Roma's hadn't been our first choice, we had been told @ Moxies that it was at least a 45 minute wait. Tony's is not a "reliable" restaurant choice we've found, they have many problems and this particular evening was no exception! 
The restaurant was Not packed, by any means. The problem was that there was no one busing tables!!! So there was sat, in the lobby, as we watched the ridiculous disorganization taking place. 
After about 15 minutes of pacing and watching all these tables sit empty while we waited, I was getting more and more frustrated with the situation. 
Finally I said to the stoic hostess, "either find us a table or I'm going to go clean one myself! She looked @ me with disinterest & said she found us a table. 
The 3 of us sat down at a booth in the restaurant side. 
My man & I ordered the "kickin' shrimp" as an appie (this is our fav and the ONLY reason we continue to eat here!) and decided we'd split the 14 oz ribeye @ 38$ a plate. Our guest ordered a double breast chicken dish with spinach. 
The shrimp was good and up to our usual expectations. 
Our main courses arrived shortly there after. 
Our guest began eating and said, "you know, my chicken is burnt I think!"
We looked @ it and she turned over one of the breasts to reveal a burnt bottom! Who sends out burnt meat??? 
We called the waitress over. She began to say that she'd asked them to add this extra piece of chicken cuz it had looked kinda small. My guest quickly shut her down and said, " this is burnt and dry as dry can be!!!" "Take this back and while ur at it, send your manager over here!" 
Now we had finished our shared ribeye (which was nothing special @ 38$ .. Including the mashed potatoes which tasted like instant!). My guest was livid. 
The manager arrived and was somewhat apologetic. My guest begins a tirade of complaints and explains to the manager that she  won't come here, as a general rule, becuz the place is always a gong show. The manager is starting to have trouble maintaining his composure, wringing his hands as he tries to calm down my friend. He tells her that he'll be removing the plate from her bill and hopes she'll give them another try @ some point. 
I take my turn and tell the already irritated manager, about his unsmiling hostess and how bad that is for business when u walk into a place and feel unwelcome. He says he'll look into that as well and promptly turns around and makes a bee line for the kitchen... He returns momentarily with several "to go" boxes that my friend had requested. She's done, packs up the majority of an unfinished meal and we wait for the bill. 
The bill arrives and the ONLY thing removed from our bill is my friend's chicken, not her shrimp she'd ordered on top of her chicken or her beverage. 
Just a suggestion Tony Roma's.. When u have an irate customer.. Remove all the guests meal, not just a portion of it!!! 
After all was said and done, Tony's was a poor excuse for a restaurant last nite and I would tell anyone that this place is one to be avoided in the future.

We used Toscos for catering for a party. We picked up the food. We got pulled pork, chicken Caesar salad, and garlic knots. It was all very good.  The pulled pork was excellent, which surprised me since it's a pizza place. The serving sizes of these catering-prepared items were very generous, especially the pulled pork. We would definitely order from them again.
Safelite took my car with no appointment and reattached the rear view mirror for free. Thank you!!!
I absolutely love the massaman curry here so I've been back to get it twice. The staff is so friendly and the place is nice and clean. No complaints!

Tried this restaurant on the suggestion of a friend, but we would not go back again. Service was good, but why wouldn't it be with 4 servers standing around waiting for customers. It was not crowded, only two other tables while we were there. The menu was two pieces of paper stapled together with the prices written in pen. The waiter who took our order was nice, but when we asked if they had balsamic vinaigrette for our salad, he said yes, and when we got our salads, he had just poured straight balsamic all over the lettuce! We didn't get offered bread until 1/3 of the way into our meal. The food was just OK. Nothing to write home about and nothing that would ever convince me to give this place another shot. There was one really loud obnoxious server who kept yelling back into the kitchen at someone and telling stories, etc.  A table on the other side of the room did get a lot of attention when they said they were Italian, which I thought was insulting. Just because I am not Italian, I am still a paying customer who should be treated just as well. Our friend's told us they used to have live music, offer you complimentary roasted vegetables to go with your bread, and offer you homemade Limóncello after your meal, but none of this happened. If these things were once true, this place has definitely gone downhill. What a waste of $50!

This is probably the best Mexican restaurant we've been to! We ordered the bacon guacamole and it was amazing!! Best guacamole I've ever had. The fajitas and spare ribs were spot on and the house margarita was delicious! The kids menu is even good as my toddler ate a good bit and she's a picky restaurant eater. We will definitively be back!

When a Chinese restaurant that occupies an old McDonald's building in Cleveland, OH can serve Chinese food that gives some of the best establishments in Hong Kong or Taipei a run for their money, I really have a tough time giving Guilin here in Tucson more than 2 stars. (Drop by Siam Cafe at 3951 Saint Clair Ave next time you're in Cleveland).

The food at Guilin is certainly better than Panda Express, but would probably be better characterized as Chinese-American, rather than Chinese. If the style of Chinese cuisine you prefer consists of things like egg rolls, shrimp fried rice, egg drop soup, and chop suey, then the flavor palate at Guilin is probably okay and the prices reasonable. If the type of Chinese food you prefer consists of dishes whose names are typically poorly translated into English on the menu, move along.

I have been to Ted Drewes before and I can honestly say that Mr. Wizard's is equivalent if not better than Ted Drewes.

I had the Strawberry Shortcake and it was delicious! By far a very satisfying custard. My boyfriend had the banana chocolate and that was amazingly good too!. 

They have seating outside in front of the stand and its a very cute place to come when the weather is nice. Parking is a pain just FYI. To the left of Mr. WIzard's there is a furniture store type building, you can park behind it. 

In a span of 5 min we watched 5 cars park and then back up out of Employee parking in the front! Good thing we parked behind the neighboring building.

I just went to the Panera at this location and had the best experience. When it comes to fast casual dining, it is easy for employees to be short with you or rush you. This was not the case. The cashier, Mariah, was fantastic. She was not only polite and sociable but very knowledgeable about the menu. She gave suggestions and assisted with any questions we had while order. She is an asset to your business and has a knack for hospitality. I would utilize her in any further growth within your establishment.

Overall, Muriel's was a pleasant experience; it's definitely more lively and active than slow-paced and relaxing, but the service is outstanding, and the food is quite good.  I ordered from Prix Fixe menu -- the butternut squash soup, the half-chicken, and the creme brulee.  The soup tasted great, though perhaps could have used more squash flavor.  The chicken tasted slightly bizarre -- I think there was a bit too much thyme in the seasoning.  I only ate about two thirds of it.  The creme brulee tasted good; it didn't knock my socks off, but it definitely passed the test.  

Muriel's is worthwhile for the history and atmosphere alone.  Just steer clear of the chicken entree!

My husband and I went to Luke for our anniversary dinner and we were so pleased with our meals! Both our cocktails were creative and delicious. I had the Silver Saint which I would describe as a refreshing margarita ish cocktail but with less sweetness and more flavor. My husband had the Bufula Negra (I think) which was very tasty, I don't care for Whiskey and even I liked it. (he later tried the Slow and Low at the waiters suggestions, and was very pleased with that as well). 

Both our waiters were very attentive and had great attitudes. They were sweet and just chatty enough without over doing it. My favorite level of attention at a restaurant.  

Our meals, were, sublime. I ordered the Grilled Rib-eye with lump crab meat. The whole dish was buttery and the flavors were interesting and delicious. Often times I get bored with a steak part of the way through... not with this one! My husband had the Jumbo Louisiana Shrimp "en Cocotte" (fancy Shrimp & Grits) and it was so full of flavor and the shrimp were cooked perfectly. He said the grits were like clouds. 

We had read on yelp that the Bread Pudding was the best, and while I am not normally a fan, we ordered that and Bourbon Vanilla Bean Crème Brûlée. The Bread Pudding totally stole the show. It was decadent, buttery, fabulous. The Crème Brûlée was good as well, but do not miss the Bread Pudding. 

Over all a wonderful experience. I'll be back and plan to bring my friends!
Great place to have a drink and listen to jazz. Beignets aren't quite as good as the other place on town. .. but a great place to have a drink and listen to jazz.
Love this spot! Reminds me of a Brooklyn pizza place and I instantly become nostalgic. We love the ambiance and food is always delish!
The most wonderful bagels in the area.tried so many others, but these are the best! Employees are very sweet.

Our wedding at the Riviera Mansion was a perfect setting for 100 people. We held the ceremony outdoors and the reception indoors. Both Breanna and Eli are exceptional to work with - kind, funny, high attention to detail, easy to work with, responsive, considerate - you name it, they had it covered with a smile on their face.

Best car buying experience ever! This is my 5th car purchase and this was by far one of the easiest and they didn't steamroll me or try to get me into more car than I needed. 

I got the car I have been looking at for some time now, and in a rare color which is totally awesome! The process was painless and the interest rate was lower than I expected, not to mention they called me to come in and sign new paperwork when they got me an even lower rate than originally quoted! 

If the service is bad or I have trouble with the extended warranty I'll be sure to update, but so far so good.

I have nothing but great things to say about Bello Nails! If you're looking for a beautiful, spa like experience this is the place to go! The salon is beautiful decorated and well maintained. The selection of colors is plentiful whether you're looking for lacquer, shellac, our powder dip. But what truly makes this experience unlock any other is my nail specialist, Kathy! I'm telling you this woman can do no wrong! Her attention to detail is unmatched! My nails can be upwards three weeks old and I get compliments as though they're recently done. I wear heels more often than not so my feet always need more love than most. Kathy does an incredible job getting my feet smooth and beautiful as can be. The cost is worth every penny, I assure you. They do not cut corners at this salon so it's worth the treat. Book with Kathy today!

Lyndel thank you for your wonderful svc. 
Came with the fam to eat Christmas lunch and the food was way beyond my expectations I got the chipotle chicken sandwich and philly steak loaded fries, the Wifey got a bbq chicken melt, the kids got chicken tenders and mini cheeseburgers, the food was awesome. Our waitress was Lyndel and she couldn't have been better she had a great attitude despite having to work on Christmas Day she was quick, polite, and brought me refills before I even asked. I recommend Lyndel for a raise or award or promotion or all of the above. Merry Christmas!!

Went here for a late dinner after a full day at Jazzfest. There was a wait time but luckily a live jazz band was playing outside the patio to keep us entertained as we waited in the grass on the the sidewalk. Cool.

We finally got a table outside in the patio. Our group of 7 shared chips and guac, quesadillas and fajitas to share. Food was good and satisfying. Also, got a couple liters margarita with ice (not blended). Recommended by some friends it was very refreshing and a little strong. Overall, a satisfying meal.

Service was friendly and attentive. I would go to this place again, if ever I'm in the area. 3.5 stars

Tacos here are inventive and as much as I'd like to give them more stars, they just didn't wow me with the taste. Don't get me wrong, the tacos tastes great, but so does a double cheese burger from Mcdonalds. It's definitely a great place to come for a quick meal. They are always packed but everything seems to move pretty fast which is a plus. Friendly staff and okay atmosphere, I'd stop by again.

My boyfriend and I are both hard-core sneaker and hat enthusiasts, and this place has got to be our favorite in Santa Barbara.  You can always find some really unique kicks here - and the prices don't make you shudder either.  Every time we visit SB we buy multiple pairs of shoes and/or hats here, and every time the employees are so laid back and helpful, the music is awesome, and their stock, while not overwhelming, is completely up-to-date and on trend. If you buy multiple pair of shoes, or are a regular customer, they will kick down a discount for you too - HELLO amazing customer service and salesmanship...just when I thought it was almost extinct.  I do miss the little baby/toddler shoe section they used to have in the back...I used to get my toddler some pretty badass little sneakers that no one else had for their kids - but they were cool about explaining why they didn't carry them anymore.

Overall, I would say the employees and the selection make this place so wonderful.  The employees are young, but really respectful and definitely know their shoe game.  Even if it is not a release they have in the store, if you mention something or even show them a picture, they most likely know what it is and how to find it.  I will keep coming back for more shoes I definitely do not NEED.  Love this place.

Love this place.  Top 5 restaurants to visit on Magazine.  Coffee is fantastic and the food rivals the top restaurants in the area. This place definitely isn't just donuts. This menu is next level. Leave the diet at the door because this place is worth the splurge.

Absolutely loved every single thing about this place. We are new to the Nashville area and we are adding this place to our "favorites" list. The food and service was awesome and everything was delightful. Best peach cobbler EVER! They ran out of banana pudding... So next time

Sigh. This place looks great but the reality is that it's planted in the blistering sun with zero trees for shade and lots and lots of garbage cans surrounding it so that bees can follow you everywhere.  That's not even why I think it's "Meh" but really it's because just like everything else in South Jersey, it's packed to the gills on nice days and there  are only TWO regular swings and TWO seated swings.  Where are the baby swings?  And, to be expected, there are very bad behaving children with zero supervision with parents being God-knows-where.  

What could make it better? 1. an ample structure to accomodate the numbers, 2. garbage cans AWAY from play structure, and 3. shade and water!!  there is one tent thingy with tons of GARBAGE CANS underneath it, but that's taken when it's do or die day saturday.  Like, water fountains?  A splash pad?  No, huh?  Ugh...this place is a disappointment along with all the other things here.

Amazing coffee! Stopped by Coat Coffee for a latte and they were out of bags of coffee; so, I decided to go Tinker's store-so glad I did! Such a nice shop and they helped me pick out a great bag of coffee! Can't wait to go home and brew me a cup :)

Aaahhh....beans. Fresh beans. Also, coffee drinks and accoutrement. And soup, and bagels, and really quite good fruit smoothies. 

Mostly, beans. Roasted on site, so when you're outside the smell is of freshly burnt beans. But inside it's super. Easy to try different beans as there are usually at least 6 airpots of brewed coffee for sampling. Ample seating inside and out. Close around 5pm and aren't open Sundays.  They actually deliver beans for businesses/offices all over, so you've probably tried them already.
This was a fantastic stop for a late lunch. The steak kabobs were done perfectly. The sauce and sides were great.

Fun atmosphere in old warehouse that is reminiscent of the downtown restaurants we know in New York City. Friendly and accommodating staff. Delicious and unique cocktails made by the award winning bartender! Dinner was delicious and menu is very nicely put together. We will be coming back for our fifteenth wedding anniversary

We're in town visiting and found The Silverspoon through Yelp! It's a very charming restaurant. We came for brunch and we were hesitant because of the limited menu choices. We ordered the chicken and waffles, the banana bread French toast, waffles (with chocolate and banana special request), a salad and fruit platter. All the food was delicious. The French toast and the waffles were truly outstanding. If you are a local, there's no excuse of not trying it!
This place closed a few months ago.  I have on good authority that the owner of the Quarterview Restaurant will be opening a daquerie bar in this location.

I don't really have great things to say about Ants Pants, but I also don't have many bad things to say either.  It's just...forgettable.  

First, it's cash only, as are most places in this area.  The wait for brunch on the weekends is insane and in my opinion, not worth it.  You can probably make many of their menu items at home, and save yourself some money too.

While the decor is cute and my mom loved the granola and yogurt (which is near $7...highway robbery!), I'd suggest walking down the street to Honey's or Resurrection.  You might have to wait a bit longer, but it will be worth it.
Been quite a few times. Love the guacamole. Lately the food has been really good. In the past we've been disappointed. I will go again.

Good enough for the price. The only problem is, they will be open and wait for the bread to be delivered. I went once and I didn't care for bread. I was pregnant, sleepy, just got off of a 12 hr overnight shift and I wanted food that was reasonable and I wouldn't have to go out my way for and they told me they weren't taking orders until after the bread was delivered. For all of that the doors should have been locked and closed. I just wanted a platter. I didn't care for toast lol. Haven't been in awhile but will return. Just not on bread day. Lol

Midtown is the nicest liquor store in the area, in my opinion. When you walk in, classical music is playing and they just have that high end feel while browsing. They also know what the hell they are talking about people!

They have a fabulous liquor and wine selection, and are eager to offer a suggestion or opinion on what they carry. Complaints... they aren't the most cost efficient place in town (though not crazily so, just noticeable) and since times have been a bit tighter financially for me lately, I feel like a bit of a bum shopping here for my box o' wine or cheap selections. 

You know what I mean. I actually wanted a boxed wine recommendation (I prefer bottles but you've gotta do what you gotta do) but I noticed I wasn't approached once when I was in that area, whereas other sections will get you some customer service. Oh well, I guess it was less embarrassing to just grab my box and get the heck out of there before I was judged too harshly. 

But I do love shopping here, especially if I can afford something of the nicer variety!

My boyfriend, my friend, and I went here late last night around midnight. We were just looking for a spot to have a nightcap and talk. This place was perfect for that. There were a lot I people at the bar but no one in the seating areas so we sat off to the side near a window looking out onto 116th Street.  That's when the trouble began. Our waitress, Amanda, was rude and seemed to be bothered by our very existence. She never really greeted us, just put menus down and asked what we wanted. We ordered a round of shots which took 10 minutes for her to bring. We ordered beers and my friend asked for an orange slice with hers. It took at least 15 minutes for her to bring the beers and she tells my friend, "We're out of oranges for the night." No apology, etc. She then comes by about 12:45 to tell u the kitchen is closing and to take our menus. She doesn't ask if we need anything...her entire attitude was off putting. She doesn't come back by until 10 after 1 when she tells us that it's last call. I asked what time they closed because the website says 3 and that's what had brought us there. She stated that there's not a set closing time. Weird, but ok. She brought the check out immediately and sort of hovered and stares at us until we paid it. She then takes the cash and goes outside to smoke before bringing the change. She walked by and just laid the change on the table without saying anything. 

Im not sure if Amanda didn't care for us because we didn't sit at the bar or if it was because my friend was black or if she just hates customers in general. I've never felt more unwelcome in an establishment.

My boyfriend did talk to the bartender who was apologetic and gave him a free shot. My suggestion is to sit at the bar and avoid the waitress. Stick to beer as they have a great tap list reasonably priced but the liquor is a bit pricey. The shots of Petron Silver we had were $9.50 each.
Used twice, once they showed up 20 minutes late, the second time they never showed up and I nearly missed my train.  don't use these guys.  :(

The worst KFC around!! They never get our order right and the manager is so rude!!! The food is good it's KFC but because of the staff and manager and the fact we never get what we order we don't go here any more! Let us know when it's under new management!

Love this place!!! Always something adventurous and delicious on tap, only gripe is that it's not closer to me lol.  The main tasting room is small but cozy, during warmer weather the outdoor bar and seating is available.  If you are in the area, it's well worth it to check out for a brew.

AMAZING! This frozen custard is SO thick and creamy! You can turn the cup completely upside down and it stays in place! For $2-$3 for a small cup (which is more than enough for one person), it's a great deal! I got the Tirramizzu and it was delicious. You can also choose your own flavors and create your own mix/combination. A must try!

Had our second ever visit today and can't think about going anywhere else. Everyone is just as friendly as the first time from the front desk even to people just walking in the hall who aren't even seeing you. My almost 2 year old isn't too great at doing things she doesn't want too, weird right :) But Dr. Aldrich is so patient and she'll recite a book while she's doing the work to distract.. I really couldn't recommend this place more. Very kid friendly and with people who actually like/good with kids!

Had lunch here yesterday with 2 business associates.  I was curious to try this establishment as their Yelp reviews are quite strong.

The place was okay.  It was not super fancy nor did it evoke a high-end establishment.  It to me was a glorified diner with white table cloths.

Our waiter was amazing.  So from a service perspective the place gets 5 stars.  He was patient, explained all the specials/menu.  So if I were rating the waiter alone it would be a 5 star review.

All 3 of us had the highly recommended cream of mushroom soup.  It was 4 stars.  It was warm and needed to be served a tad hotter plus the soup needed additional seasoning.  

I had a lunch salad with added protein (seared ahi tuna).  The salad was delicious, the seared tuna was bad.  Maybe it was frozen when they received it?  It was tasteless and actually bad.  I could not eat it.  It was simply bad fish.

The service was great and this clearly is a good place for a business lunch.  However, the food was nothing special.  How they got 4.5 stars on Yelp I just don't know.  Maybe it is me and I just ordered the wrong things.  I even tried the french fries my friends ordered.  They were okay but nothing to write home about.

Will I eat here again?  Probably not guys.

Friendliest staff that you could ever ask for. The staff here always goes above and beyond to try to make you feel welcome and assist you in anyway possible. The manager John is one of the coolest people around and he even went out of his way during the holiday season to go ahead and give cards saying happy holidays to a lot of the customers that he sees on the day-to-day basis which if I wasn't a loyal customer ready I would definitely be from then on. I will honestly go out of my way now to use the store just because how awesome they are

Friendly, excellent service. I got one of those half off deals to try out the place and didn't get any attitude (some places do that for some reason). Got a blow out done and it came out beautifully especially when you consider I have thick, long hair that tends to frizz that I usually get relaxed which hasn't been done since early August. Erica was great, place was clean and well lit.

Minus one star for the jerk (or overly zealous employee) who swiped our cart. It had stuff in it. Luckily no personal items. But there was a one-of-a-kind clearance item we couldn't replace. Otherwise, I've got no complaints about this Target. They have some flavors of Naked juice that I haven't seen anywhere else. If not for lack of luggage space, we'd likely have snatched up some of the clearance deals we found. Still mad about that cart...
Best tacos in Nashville. Go for the fish tacos chips and salsa. If its a Friday go for a Corna best way to end the week!

In an attempt to be urban, I decided on sunny Saturday morning to walk up to the barber shop located a couple blocks from my house. Upon walking in, I felt like I had raveled back in time. The guys at the Big Bend Barber bring you back to a time when General Motors ruled the country and women didn't work. It feels like your walking into a different decade with the pastel green barber chairs (which are mighty comfortable if I do say so myself) and green sinks. Walk in on a Saturday morning and this place is sure to be packed. Cliff, the barber, has been around for years and is a master with the clippers, though he only works part time now. He always has a great story to tell. 
When all the barber asks is "Medium, or shorter" you know are you getting your haircut at a barber. None of this #1, #2 stuff - save that for Great Clips. The best part about the cut is they still shave your neck with the old warm shaving cream and straight razor, so you are sure to get a clean look when its all done. A haircut will run you $13, but the experience will last forever.

Made a reservation this evening for 10 of us. We were served quickly, our waitress was friendly and fast and took excellent care of us. The food was absolutely delicious!! The decor was nice and the restaurant was clean. We are very much looking forward to another family meal at this location. Highly recommended!!

I was having a problem with my Dell laptop and took it to these guys after seeing these great reviews on Yelp. I'm so glad I did because they were very helpful, friendly and no-nonsense as far as solutions. It was clear that they were concerned about solving my laptop's problem -- even if it meant offering a simple solution that could be resolved quite easily. These guys definitely earned my trust and if I should ever have another problem--I'll be sure to turn to them!

This restaurant was on my list of recommendations from a friend and the food was excellent! My entree was the Steak Au'Poivre - perfectly Med-Rare with a delicious sauce! Fried Goat Cheese as an appetizer . Our server Jeremy was courteous and friendly ... must add though, if on a busy night, be prepared to wait as they do not take reservations and have limited seating.

Best kielbasa in the city. Pictured is their jalapeño popper kielbasa, which made an amazing sandwich. Plenty of other options as well as they have a great selection of pierogis, pickles, condiments, etc. Combine that with attentive and friendly service and you have a true Philadelphia gem.

Whether it's their regular or specialty, every item in the store is delicious. If you are in the city and want kielbasa, this is the store you have to go to.

Fried Bacon Wrapped Oysters. It was something different for us to try and it was good but maybe just a little too rich in fried flavor for me. The server very friendly and helpful. The Catfish was okay. The batter was very light. It seems to be a good lunch spot as it became pretty busy. We stopped by here right as they opened and we made it in time to the airport to catch our flight home.
Good food, good service, and good prices the only complaint I have is the place is small. I felt little cramped in there.

It's a dive of a dive. The beer and liquor is cheap along with the clientele. I mean that with all due respect by the way. The only reason I give it a 3 star is that the place absolutely stinks inside. I can only describe the odor as stale cigarettes mixed with BO and dry spilt beer.

I went to The Outpost with colleagues on a business trip. This place had by far one of the best bar trivia nights! We all had a great time. We stuck mostly to beer so I can't review the cocktails. The appetizers were better than you'd expect from a bar, but the fries were perfect. 

The service was slow, but the server was pleasant. My water wasn't refilled the entire time I was there and my colleague had to fetch her twice to get another beer. That may simply have been because it was an event night and the bar was pretty busy. I'm told that's not typical. If you're in the area, and looking for a casual bar with decent food and great trivia nights, this is the place to go.
These cupcakes are amazing! I take them to my accounts all the time and they're always asking for more! I highly recommend Sparkle to anyone who is looking for quality and good prices!

Holy cow. This place is off the hook. 

Everything, and I mean everything, that I tried here is delicious. I knew that it would be good food based on other Yelp reviews as well as local word of mouth, but frankly I was amazed by the quality. 

I had the unsweetened mixed berry iced tea and could not ask for a more perfect house brewed tea. It was slightly sweet due to being infused with berries, but this was perfectly fine, and the flavors were on point. My group started with the tostones, fried mashed plantains, and they were very tasty and plentiful. One plate was enough to feed a table of four, and it came with their house made guacamole. Their guacamole has a little bit of spice to it, but nothing unbearable. 

Feeling drawn to the Buddha tacos I ordered them and wondered if they would be any good. Now I find it unbelievable that some of the best tacos I've ever had come from a vegetarian joint. I got them served on the blue corn Johnny cakes, and liked that they had crisp edges with a more cake-like interior. The filing my consisted primarily of sweet potatoes, avocado and peanuts. Don't let that deter you, it was a combination that was beyond delicious. I would never think to mix them but it worked! Add a little bit of lime on there and it's even better. These also come with the signature guacamole. 

I also got to sample some of my dining partners' foods, all of which were equally tasty. The ginger ramen is done well, with a nice little kick to the broth. It's true to typical Japanese style ramen while being its own unique recipe. The falafel has an interesting grainy texture (as opposed to a smooth, doughy one) but it works. Last but not least is the Velvet Verde, comprised mainly of spaghetti squash. It had a lot of particular flavors going on but it all pulled together to make a tasty dish. 

I can't wait to come back here! Now I feel like I should try everything on the menu since every dish we got was outstanding. Even if you are not a vegetarian I would still suggest trying this place just once. The food is so good you will not miss the meat.

I recently hosted my husband's birthday party at 240Studio.  Michelle was great to work with from the beginning--communicative, flexible and welcoming.  The space is gorgeous with high ceilings and gorgeous natural light during the day.  We had approximately 50 people, with plenty of room to spare.  I really appreciate the way this space can be transformed.  It's got great wood floors and a variety of wall surfaces and textures, which makes it really fun.  I'd highly recommend 240Studio as an event venue.

This is one of those auto service places, where there's always something wrong with your car, no matter how minor the service required. I brought it in for a tire rotation -a simple quick procedure- waiting over an hour, plus a spiel about needing front brakes that cost over. 400.00. My personal mechanic told me the brakes were slightly worn and the job could be done for half the price. They try to take advantage of customers ignorance
A very interesting place.  Go with friends, leave the kids at home.  This place is for drinking and socializing.
Everything here is delish..their Corned beef special,Italian or jewish or American hoagies taste so good! The Salad is Abundant!

While its atmosphere prioritizes theme over comfort, Broken Beaker serves well-balanced and delicious cocktails. Their in-house liquor, though currently limited, is good quality and reasonably priced. The vodkas are smooth and by far their strongest creation. Give them a few months to expand selection and tweak things...this is gonna be great! 

Recommended drinking: Their Mule is one of the best I've ever had. The Bill Nye, with its strawberry-basil infused vodka, is a real treat.

It's going to be pretty hard to leave this review considering I couldn't even eat what I wanted to order. I came here for breakfast at 10:30 with my boyfriend only to find out that they ran out of eggs, so we choose to leave. It's hard to choose something else to order when your heart was set on breakfast food. Very disappointed.

Best breakfast in town! We had the corned beef hash (highly recommend) and it was the BEST I've ever had!! The bananas foster pancakes were decadent and delicious.  Everything we ordered  far exceeded our expectations.  If you're in the area, you definitely should stop by and try Maggie Mae's.  Also, prices were great and portion sizes were filling.

I loved it so much i went back for my very next meal. They have an awesome variety of tacos at just 2.75 each. So far I've tried the Southern Fried, the Local BBQ, the Fish, the Smoked Brisket and the Korean BBQ.

The Southern Fried and Smoked Brisket were my favorites. They crushed the brisket, perfectly smoked. The southern fried is an awesome mix of buttermilk fried chicken strips with honey lime mayo. YUM.

The fish is awesome because it's lightly fried, not too much. I also loved the pickled jalapenos on them. Korean BBQ was great and I'd just say the Local BBQ was okay...had a little too much sauce for me.

You need to get the chips and salsa, it's just too good of a deal not too. A whole lunch bag full of chips and a cup of pico de gallo for $2! Definitely enough for two.

It's an aweome hole in the wall type place that I will continue to go back to over and over again. Just be aware that parking can be a mess, but it's worth it. Trust me!

Two words- seafood sauce!! Everything is absolutely delicious every time! Andy the owner is always there to greet you and to check on you and see how your meal was. Great atmosphere, and did I mention, fried ice cream?!? Yum!

I received a new member reward after staying at their hotel two different weekends and attending three different concerts within a few weeks just last month.  The mailer was for a $59 room rate which expired within a week after receiving it.  I called to see if I could extend it a few days to Friday which is my wife's birthday.  We stayed last month at regular rate and didn't even get to enjoy the pool because of the monsoons.  My regular rate with AAA is $107 so because of a mere $48 in savings that I couldn't be given,  I will never return and I would have spent hundreds of extra dollars between drinks and food at the pool, other meals, and gambling all evening to have more than made up for it.  In Vegas they completely comp me twice a year because they want my business!  To me its just the principle of bad vs good customer service!

I used to love Izzo's, but after my experience yesterday I doubt i will be back again. The only reason im giving them 2 stars is because their customer service was nice at least, but food wise they completely dissappointed both me and my boyfriend. We both got regular steak burrito meals, and we were both lacking the steak in it, it was mainly beans and sour cream in mine,with a few pieces of steak, burnt steak may i add at that, which normally i coule of been okay with, if there was at least enough in there,  was awfully dissappointing, i usually can barely get through half of my burrito, but i ate the whole thing and still wasnt satisfied. Then we both got the queso for our chips, their queso used to be my favorite thing about this place, it was horrible yesterday, it was completely liquid, like melted butter, wouldnt even stick to the chip and was pointless attempting to eat it. I payed $25 for all this and couldnt of been more upset, dont bother wasting your time or money here any longer, youll only be ripped off, dissappointed and left hungry needing more!

We've been numerous times, and are always pleased.  Goat cheese app is great, pretzels are always fantastic as well.  Loses one star for the live music.  Far too loud for such a small space.  Couldn't hear each other, or the waitress.  Will avoid live music nights in the future.
The gumbo ya ya and the seafood gumbo was excellent.  Bloody Mary is only 1.50 and it is delicious.  Highly recommend this place for lunch or dinner!
Great breakfast place! Highly recommend if you are visiting town. Order the build your own hash!

Expecting to enjoy a fantastic meal Chiles was recommended by friends. 

This was my very first time eating here.

I had ordered pulled pork tastados, which looked extremely tasty in the menu. Upon serving my meal I was presented my food by a waitress wearing long elbow level blonde hair that fell into my food before it hit the table. 

The cleanliness was minimal. Instead of taking a cloth to wipe the table and seats before we sat down the waitress decided to hand wipe the crumbs onto the floor. The floor was sticky with lot of crumbs and chunks of food. Not appetizing in the least.

Indiana's first brewpub; opened in 1989 by British transplant John Hill. The BEST brewpub for lovers of English beer.  English beer styles here are authentic and brewed the way they were in England back in the 60s and 70's, before many big British brands were globalized and bought out. 

Food is excellent, great choices for vegans also!  If you get the pub chips, ask for "well done"!  My beer recommendations: start with IPA or ESB, and go from there!

If you have ever dreamed of owning a bad ass bar and restaurant, with phenomenal and creative food, solid service, and atmosphere as cool as - well as cool as the bricks in the streets of Ybor City - don't go here. It will be likely to depress you to see that your dream has already been done so well that there just isnt much improvement. 
Well, if there was parking, that would be an improvement - but that's about it. I work nearby and rock their little patio in the back about once a week, it just never disappoints. The CURE is my favorite sandwich but i dont think there are any bad items on the menu - not even the vegetarian ones, and you know how bad those CAN be!

If you are on the west end of Ybor, or staying at the hotels nearby, or just stepped off the streetcar and want to figure out what Ybor City has come to mean these days - the Bricks of Ybor should be your first stop!
great fast service. Egg based dishes are good. Don't get the pork roll. Smells and tastes terrible.

We ate here on a Thursday night and the place was packed. Service was slow and our waiter somewhat rude. We ordered a small pizza with Italian sausage and a small Greek salad. Both were great. The salad was made with quality ingredients and was more than enough for 2 people. The coal fired oven really makes a difference in the texture of the crust. Best pizza in south Tampa. Next time we'll get a little more creative on the toppings. Like a previous reviewer said, this place is loud. Lots of kids too. Our small simple pizza, salad, 2 beers, and 2 glasses of wine came to $53 before tip which is a lot of money for pizza-night out.  Given the noise, rude waiter, and high cost of beverages, we'll do take-out from on.

Waiter kind of had a blunt/rude tone, and my girlfriend and I could see him talking about and looking at us because he was doing it right in front of us. I also knew he was doing it because he stopped immediately after we made eye contact with him.  I could understand him being annoyed if we were being difficult, but all we had done was sit down and order our drinks.  I've been a fan of Tired Hands for a while and I was excited to check out the fermentaria  but this ruined it for me.
Another decent restaurant that closed. That's sad... Typical Argentine fare with fairly tasty weekend specials. Was hoping to pop in for another weekend getaway to SB to try some more specials =(
My and my friend went there for dinner and our waitress YaYa gave excellent customer services and made sure we were happy. So if you ever go there ask for YaYa
Love this place!  Been there for Sunday brunch many times and it's always delicious. The Stack is my go-to but have tried a few other things - all great.
