Chicken was overcooked and it tasted like they needed to change the shortening in the fryers, (old taste). Potatoes were cold ( they did get me new ones). My wife said her food was just OK. Dessert was lackluster.  $100 later- we left feeling disappointed.
We love the Iron Hill. Hope tonight was just an off night.

The flavors menu is ten miles long! You can get just about anything: clear, creme, sugar-free, they've got it all! I prefer the creme flavors and have tried cherry vanilla, orchid vanilla, strawberry and cream soda (they were all excellent). The ice is so smooth, it can't be beat!
Sometimes the line is long and parking is a task, but the wait is definitely worth it! Fair warning though: Cash only!

No complaints about the food but all the staff was terrible. The hostess was not welcoming or kind. The waiters and other staff did not tell us about a special, did not pull out my chair or help with my jacket, did not help with napkins or other gestures I've experienced at other similar restaurants. The waiter didn't seem to care about what we ordered. We had to repeat our drink orders several times. He simply took our order with no recommendation of other things to pair it with. The staff barely spoke a word when changing silverware and seemed very unhappy. At the end of our meal they brought an iPad and flopped it on the table nearly spilling drinks and not explaining why it was there or what to do with it.  We explained we didn't want this electrical device on our table. It insulted us and took The personal connection away from the meal and the gentleman explained it's the waive of the future and we just need to deal with it. The pad to order dessert made no sense, we had already placed a dessert order with the waiter. When I asked where the restroom was the gentleman said follow me but he was at least 15 ft behind me, so I began walking toward the direction he was going and I was treated with condescending remarks of how I could just lead the way or walk along side instead of doing what I was told and the restroom counter had water trails from the faucet to the floor. 
Very surprising and disappointing service for the type of restaurant it is.
The best pastor tacos around. Their food is delicious all across the board. Truly authentic mexican food.
This is seriously the best frozen custard around! I can't visit St. Louis and not stop at Ted Drewes! The lines may be long but it is definitely worth the wait!

Love their fried okra and smoked chicken wings. The pork sandwich was good, but wish they would put a scoop of coleslaw on it. Next time I'm going to try the smoked turkey sandwich.

No beer for sale. :(
Yucky!! Smelled bad in there. Had a dirty feel to the place. All the surfaces were sticky. The Thai iced tea was not good and neither was my pad Thai. Won't be back.

Great experience. I don't live close but glad I had a errand in the area. Super cool bartender, good selection of craft beers, and the burger I had with the cured bacon is a winner. I wish I could have stayed longer but I will make it back soon.

Found this recent start-up brewery near my parent's house today.

I stopped in with my wife and mother for a sampling, and quite frankly was astounded with how good the beer is.  They only have four beers in tap and available for purchase at the moment, but the owner told us that he had some seasonals that are almost done and that he was getting more taps installed in the next two weeks.

I sampled all four beers that they have for sale right now and they are very, very good.  I'll admit that I'm kind of a beer snob and I've had plenty of small batch beers from small breweries over the years, and I always try to sample the full range of beers from a new brewery when I find it -- and I'm rarely impressed.  Not so with this place.  Every thing they offer really good!  And not just small batch brewery good, this stuff is GOOD.

This is a brewery that's going places.  Check it out if you're nearby, the beer is awesome and the samplings are free.  The owner seems like a really nice guy and was more than happy to explain the beers to us and tell us about the brewery while he was pouring us samples.  I wish Crooked Eye Brewery the best of luck in their endeavors.  Check them out and talk to the owner, I'm sure that you'll leave feeling the same way that I do.
Large servings with fresh, correctly-ripe fruit.  I will come back.

I ate 3 pieces of sushi, and almost instantly vomited.  Thankfully made it to the men's room.

Was there no more than 5 minutes, ate no more than 2 or 3 ounces of food, and it cost me $26.00

Told the host the rolls which I ate, so he could take them off the bar.  No move to remove them, no offer of a refund.

AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

I've always loved "Whose Line is it Anyway?" and never really knew where to go to see Live Improv. Since beginning my search for a good laugh, I've seen a Second City show in Chicago and ImprovAcadia in Maine. I live in NJ and googled improv near me and The N Crowd came up. I went with a few friends and we absolutely loved it. I've been about 5 times now and have loved it each visit. I keep bringing new people. It's a great night out if you're tired of the same boring stuff.

My sense of humor typically LOLs at comedians such as Bo Burnham, Brian Regan, Nick Swardson. I love The Office, Brooklyn Nine Nine, The Colbert Report.... so if you have a similar sense of humor, I think you'd love it. :)

One of the breweries I frequent. I am a Belgian beer guy so it's nice they have a variety of these here. When everyone else is brewing crazy flavored beers these guys keep a solid menu of beers I know I will like.
Chips weren't that good. Ground beef enchilada was meh. Grilled fish taco was good. Grilled shrimp was good. Plastic chairs and wobbly table. Quick service on new years eve tho.

Definitely a dive bar, but that's what we expected. We were wary to order food here but the drinks were reasonably priced. We went on karaoke night which was very entertaining. I think it's mostly a younger crowd who go ironically.

This is the best venue I have ever been to.

I've been here for countless Phillies games, ballpark tours and for the Winter Classic series. I've sat just about anywhere you can sit and can't find a bad seat in this place. The view of the game is always great.

I always recommend CBP to my friends who are visiting from out of town because it's kind of a Cliffs Notes version of Philly. You get a great sampling of all the local cuisine- cheesesteaks from Tony Luke's, hoagies from Planet Hoagie, crab fries from Chickie's & Petes, that heavenly chicken from Federal Donuts, Philadelphia Water Ice, and so many more. There's also a number of gluten free and vegetarian options as well.

As far as beer, CBP sets the standard for all other venues. There is no shortage of locally brewed beer from breweries like Victory, Prism, Dogfish Head, and of course Yuengling. Of course there's also McFadden's and the High & Inside pub if you're looking for more of a bar atmosphere, and Harry the K's if you want a sit-down meal.

The views of the city are beautiful, and the liberty bell that flashes and rings for home runs is a great nod to our local history. Citizens Bank Park really captures the heart and soul of Philadelphia and rolls it all into one package.

Gavin himself DJ'd our wedding in August 2014. He is by far the best wedding DJ I've ever heard! We stole him from my friend's wedding last year and I knew as soon as I got engaged that I wanted him at my wedding too. We got married in Los Angeles and he was totally willing to travel 1.5+ hours to have a meeting at the venue a few months prior. The way he mixes songs and transitions to the next one is so good! He's not cheesy at all and plays good, modern music that people like to dance to. People were dancing not only on the dance floor, but also in the lounge area and in the table aisles at the wedding!

I like on Gavin's website you can enter in songs for specific parts of the wedding and also create a general playlist. He also has song recommendations on there. I even asked him to mix and customize a few songs and he did exactly what I wanted. He also MC'd the wedding and was perfect at it - friendly and said enough to keep the wedding going and announce different things but did not take over. 

Throughout the planning process he was very communicative and helpful. We had a couple phone meetings to talk about what we wanted and how he works. The week before the wedding we went over in detail the flow of the wedding and what happens when. 

Many people asked us where we got our DJ from! I will definitely be recommending him to more people.

Great mom and pop restaurant. I have eaten here 3 times and the staff is great. They know us since they are a small restaurant and even remember what we have ordered in the past. Since my GF is a vegetarian they always make us an entre off the menu which is pretty cool. 

My favorite dish here is the fish with the tamarind sauce. There have been some entries that I do not like but make sure you ask the staff what the food tastes like before you order.

The atmosphere is chill and cozy. It can feel a little small if it is packed but its still a great BYOB. I would def go back and have brought back friends and family.

Awsome you can smoke inside but don't go for food, its over priced and small menu. Large drink selection, have been there many times. Pool tables (1$+ a game though) and dozens of Tvs and trivia on some days

Stop looking for an Italian byob right now and just go here. In fact pick up the phone right now because it is tiny, and you'll want a reservation. It's worth it! The size and atmosphere completely remind me of many a restaurant in Italy so it's easy to forget you're in Philly and get immersed in this culinary experience! Because boy it is a culinary experience! We started with the garlic bread and one order is not enough! Hands down all 4 of us agreed it's the best garlic bread we've ever had. It is a mistake not to get it! Then we split Caesar salads and calamari. No complaints there! Delish! But omg the entrees! I had a hard time making up my mind, but I went with ossobuco ravioli! Such a unique and interesting twist that was so worth it! The only thing better was my friend's fettuccini bolognese. Sounds simple maybe even boring? I kid you not we were fighting with our elbows to try more and more helpings of this dish! Whatever is in that sauce will have me going back to this place asap! I've already texted my friends and family! I didn't even mention the delicious cannolis or after essentially 3 starters, 4 entrees and 3 desserts it only cost $107 a couple with tip!? Damn straight I will be going back here again and again and again!!!

Emily is very professional and outgoing. She is clean too! Her den is in a cute little spot in Midtown and she has a big comfy chair for clients to relax in while getting their lashes done. I recommend her all the way!
Localized seafood paella,nice ambiance .worth going but no worth going twice.

Burger up does not live up to the hype. I have been twice now (hoping it would be better the second time) and most likely won't be back. Last night I had the mushroom swiss burger, which sounded really good but was mediocre. I ordered it medium and it came out well done (this happened the first time also) and the sauce was way too acidic to be able to taste the cheese and mushrooms. The fries however, were pretty good. 

The cook should be fired, how do you fuck up cooking a burger when that is 80% of what you do all day every day?

We wanted to love it here. Waited 50 minutes and didn't get any food. All of the tables around me were without food as well. The menu looked amazing but I can't speak to the food at all. We left after hunting down a waitress to tell her. We will give it another try, because I want the restaurant to work. They just really aren't ready to be open yet.

Every time we are in the Clearwater area we visit this place. The shrimp and grits are amazing. Best I've ever had. On our last visit we also tried the steak bowl. Very tasty as well. The drinks are ok. As in most places in the area they aren't strong. We come here for the food and great service so they get 5 starts.

The Livery is a fairly new restaurant in Indy and it is a great addition to the foodie scene.

Ambiance:  
Upscale casual might be the best way to describe this place. Wooden panels on the wall meet tile floors that create a modern, yet country look that puts you right at home.  Pro tip:  Even if you don't have to go to the restroom, check it out. The space age Dyson combination Fossetts and hand dryer is one of the coolest things I've ever seen! I totally want one now :)

Food:
This food was amazing! When I think about Mexican food, I think of burritos, quesadillas, and tacos. Instead, the Livery produced high end, fresh and tasty treats that put me immediately in a good mood.  We starters with the complimentary chicharrones which were light, crispy, lemony and surprise.... vegetarian!  Instead of pork skin, they managed to make these out of rice flour.  Next came the corn empanadas.  This may have been the best bite of the evening.  Light, doughy, creamy and cheesy at the same time - we definitely heard moans of ecstasy from all those who took a bite.  I got the skirt steak as a main entry, and it was cooked to a perfect medium rare and had a wonderful spice rub and chimichurri sauce on top.  All I can say is - yasss!

Service:
Our waitress, even though she has only been there for three weeks, was kind and knowledgeable. She provided a quality of service that you can usually just find at much higher end restaurants and we were grateful for her service. We even had the general manager come out so that we could give her a compliment.

Bottom line:
If you're in Indy, go here now!!!

I meaaaaan I feel like from the good reviews that maybe I'm an anomaly for having a bad experience. Perhaps I need to see this place in the light of day, it could be a different vibe entirely on a different night too. But I honestly didn't have a very good time on a Friday night with my friends. I thought the bartenders were uppity and snobbish and honestly I stared at a bartender for 20 minutes without any kind of acknowledgement that I existed. Finally my boyfriend caught his attention and he was kind of rude when he asked a question. He basically shoved the menu at him like "here, look, I don't have time for you" even though it really wasn't that busy of a night. I'm not sure if I'd go back...
One of the best spas in Philly hands down. Good customer service, good products and very clean

Tried the St. Louis ribs, the meat fell off the bone it was so tender. The BBC sauce wasn't really anything special. It came with Mac and cheese and I enjoyed it quite a bit. Fast and friendly staff, the server was fast to refill my water all 6 times seeing as I was quite hungover.

Who does love brunch?!

Communists, that's who.

We tried stopping here right when we got to Tucson on a Sunday morning which is an amateur move on our parts.....they had an hour wait for two people. But hearing that only validated that we must come back so we hit up Prep and Pastry again on a Tuesday morning right when they opened so we were guaranteed to get a table. Within 15 minutes, some other tables came in an the place was bumping. 

While I would love to be a sweets for breakfast kinda person, I just can't do it, I'm savory road all the way. I ordered the pork belly breakfast sandwich with country hash and it was good. I was expecting to have a mouthgasm but there was too little sriracha sauce and the slaw wasn't too flavorful. But the pork belly was seasoned and cooked to perfection so I can't complain about that. My boo got the biscuits and gravy with cheddar biscuits and it was heavenly, I would get that if I was to ever come back while in Tucson. We got some sweets to go since we couldn't leave without one, the pistachio/mascarpone croissant redeemed P&P for the pork belly sandwich.....it gave me a mouthgasm! Like multiple ones. Mmmmmm.

Although the grooming and cut done on my dog was good, I was highly disappointed that when I took my dog here for the 1st time they did not ask for proof of shots nor her vet's name. Makes me wonder about their safety standards therefore I will not be returning there with my dog.

I love the pizza and beer selection and in house salads are big and delicious but... my take out salad was so small. It was nowhere near the size when you dine in. I took it back in to ask if the size was right and the staff blew me off. So disappointed I had to write this review. Sorry, but that salad sucked.

Came here Thanksgiving night to see Kermit Ruffins and Papa Grows Funk. Interior is nothing special, but just fine. It's a big open room with a very few tables and bar stools (if you want one, go EARLY), a bar at the back and a stage at the front. To me, this is fine, you're here for the music, not the atmosphere. I guess another few chairs would be nice, but I get that they're packing in the people for a concert, so no huge complaints here.

The music venue bar's beer prices were just fine, but the selection was on the lacking side. Sometimes you just want a step up from Miller Lite and PBR. What I did like, though, was that we were free to go back and forth between the music club and the little dive bar Howlin' Wolf owns next door, which had a fantastic beer selection. Lots on tap, even more bottles, and small bites served late into the night. There were some tables outside, which were fun for hanging at and watching people arrive for the concert. 

Each time bands switched or took a break, we headed over here, chatted with the other bar patrons, and then we headed back into the club when the music started up again. Kind of a nice setup. Plus, you get two distinct atmospheres for the price of one!

Side note: I wasn't as sketched out by the bathrooms as I expected to be after reading Christy L.'s review. No, they weren't the nicest, but they floors were clean and the doors on the stalls locked. I didn't think it was a huge deal.

I had fun here and would come back if there was another fun band playing.

This place has really improved over the last year or so! Burgers used to taste old and disgusting fries used to be stale..I vowed never to come again but was hungry and desperate and close by so I gave it a try a few months back...My burgers tasted fresh and juicy, fries were hot and fresh..the employees were friendlier. I've gone back at least 10 times since. There was a long wait in drive through on one occasion due to a picky customer that kept changing her order at the window..the woman who served me was very apologetic . 

However I had to take a star because on two occasions I ordered steak egg and cheese bagel and received a sausage egg and cheese bagel.

Service is okay, not exceptional. The food is adequate for a quick lunch or dinner. Nothing impressive here. The seems to be a charge for everything. Crowded, noisy and the tables are to close together for me. The name busy changed to San Jose I think.

Today I had the BEST service here. I was in a terrible mood and needed a treat, and the fragrance I have worn for years and years was discontinued recently. Department store fragrance counters scare me - I hate pushy help. Plus I knew there would be an amazing selection here. After looking for a few minutes I realized that all though I like to do things myself, I was in over my head. I was ready to accept assistance. The salesperson in fragrance was great! I told her about what I had been wearing, and even though they don't carry it, she at least was familiar with it. She used this computer they have to search for fragrances by notes and other fragrances I like, and then patiently paraded me around the store. We spritzed, we laughed, we cried, and eventually I walked out with a new fragrance plus two samples of others and a free mascara from my rewards card.

I've only been here for ice cream desserts, but it's a fun place for that, and both the ice cream and the hot fudge are delicious.  We often come with our little girl if we're out in the city on a weekend afternoon, and she loves the "fancy" space, which sets it apart from other options in town.  Definitely kid friendly during the day.

We were walking aimlessly around SB while waiting for something to finish being printed at Staples.  It was either India House buffet or another Indian buffet place across the street.. and since there was absolutely NO ONE in the other place - we choose this place.  

It was disappointing - very disappointing.  Perhaps we have been spoiled with good Indian food places, but this place just fell so short.  First off, the plates were not clean.  I had to go through 3 plates before I found one that wasn't dirty!  As I moved down their lunch buffet line, I noticed that the typical dish of palak paneer at buffets here was missing the paneer!  So it was just minced, unflavorful spinach.  This is one of my favorite dishes usually, but they made me only try one bite and not come back for me.  

They had no traditional Indian drinks. No mango lassi. no Chai masala tea.  the choices were coke and sprite.  

The naan was slow to come out.  The Indian food was overall was bland (which is like heresy!) and the service wasn't great.  Not that SB is the IT spot for Indian cuisine, but this place was a major disappointment.

The best in town! The wonderful ladies up front are more than accommodating and give off a great vibe from the very start. I drive over 40 mins to have my  Brazilian done here (that's how good they are and it's so worth getting the prepaid wax packages!) The staff is knowledgable, professional and always make me feel comfortable.  Great location, the interior is very clean and always organized. Do yourself a favor and try them out for whatever waxing needs you may have. If you're thinking of going all the way down there I highly recommend this place.

I've never lowered a rating on Yelp and I hate that I have to do this, but this place is a real hit or miss.

My favorite technician is kelly and besides her, my experiences were just average that I didn't bother getting their names. I know there are so many glowing reviews for Tracy but even she did not deliver one too many times.

My main complaint is that I often end up leaving with nail polish all over the sides of my nail. I mean, if I want a nail polish on my fingers then I would have painted them myself. I also asked them to do a ghost for Halloween but no one seemed to be able to and none of them were willing. How in the world are you supposed to improve if you're not even willing to try? Eventually Tracy did but not without making me feel like I was imposing some massive inconvenience. 

Another issue is that the fans are too strong so the nail polish gets wrinkled while drying. I asked Tracy to be seated at the back where you put your hands under the fans and directly over your nails (near the tv area) but she insisted that it'd be okay so I should stay where I was. Not wanting to push back, I just sat there watching my nails get wrinkled ...

My manicure only lasted two days before I had a huge chip. I've been coming to this place for close to a year now so the decline in quality technicians is truly disappointing. There is always a technician I see that I dearly wish isn't going to be my technician. You know it's bad when you have a reaction like this upon seeing them.

The three stars are for cleanliness and kelly. I am definitely happy that they don't compromise on hygiene.

I never met the doc, but the staff is really nice and efficient. I got a deal on living social and got a facial and massage.
I was studying for my board license and needed a day of relaxation before I go in...

Got a massage first and met their brand new massage therapist, Sarah. She is awesome!! And so super sweet! I told her I had been clicking on a mouse all day yesterday and my shoulder blades were sore and my lower back hurt because I was sitting for 6 hours straight! She worked me soooo good! She has such strong hands! And her stretching is the best!!!! I loved it!!! I can't wait to go back to her..

Kendra did my facial after my massage and I had a really good experience with her too. She waxed me as well and though I wish she would have tweezed the leftover hairs after she waxed I think she did a good job.

I would come here again. Give these girls a try despite their boss. :)

We had a great experience tonight! 

It took hardly any time at all to place our order and I'd say it only took about two minutes for the server to whip up three beautiful cones. Bobby & I had ours dipped  in chocolate, but Christoph went for a classic cone. As you can see from the pictures, we were served by an ice cream artist. The guy must've had extensive training in some sort of soft serve boot camp. 

The only thing I wasn't liking was the steady stream of country music. I mean, I know this place is right down the street from the Round Up, but still. This is Oldsmar. Other than that, and the scant amount of seating, this Dairy Queen is pretty solid in my opinion. 

We'll be back, and maybe for a Blizzard next time. Here's to hoping they bring back Choco Cherry Love in February!

Some of the best Mexican food in the area. Service is awesome! Very friendly and inviting atmosphere. All of the food is incredibly flavorful and authentic.  Service is fast so you can stop by for lunch break during the work week. I highly recommend this place!

Just came back from HipCity Veg and I am hooked.  This small corner storefront just a stone's throw from Rittenhouse Square serves the lunchtime masses with, dare I say, excellent tasting Vegan sandwiches and salads.  After having many a friend recommend that I try this place, I finally decided to give it a shot.

I'll admit that the place seems gimmicky with its whole "everything is sustainable and earth friendly" pitch, but I appreciate that HipCity Veg puts just as much effort into its food as it does into creating its ambiance and aesthetic.  I decided to try the Crispy HipCity Ranch, which includes chick'n, LTO, pickles, and peppercorn ranch.  At first bite, I swore I was eating meat, and had to remind myself that everything I was putting my mouth was 100% vegan (even the dressing).  The sandwich was juicy, flavorful, and a good balance between the protein and supporting ingredients.  It was actually a very well proportioned and constructed sandwich, I probably could have eaten two of them.  I can't wait to try more of their menu items.

I also want to give them props on outstanding customer service.  I attempted to get my free Green Lemonade upon first Foursquare checkin, but the cashier accidentally charged me for it.  When they realized their mistake, they went the extra mile to make sure that I didn't get charged for the Lemonade and solved everything by the time my lunch was ready.  Kudos to them!

My only complaints are the storefront size and price.  This is definitely a take-out spot, as there are only a handful of seats inside (but when the weather's nice, you can easily head to Rittenhouse Square to eat al fresco).  It's also a bit pricey, and in the grand scale of things, why pay $8.50 for fake chicken when you can go to a food truck and get the real thing for less?  The $4 for fries though seems downright heinous.

But I think if anything, this place will change the way you think about vegan cuisine and its limitations, especially if you're convinced that vegan food is always super healthy.  These guys easily blow that notion right out of the water.  However, it's a shame that there aren't more places like this that exist in Philly, but if trend is any indication (especially with nearby Crisp and Maoz), hopefully there will be more gourmet vegan and vegetarian lunch options to come.  For now, I'm eagerly awaiting my next trip to HCV.

I totally agree that Peach Properties does not even deserve one star.  Beware of the security deposit.  The apartment was left spotless,  even better than move in and 250$ was automatically taken off the top for a cleaning fee.  I have had a 4000 square foot home cleaned for that much.  Then to top it all off the refund check is written to two room mates so it can not be cashed unless they are together.  Well they don't live together anymore.  HELLOOOO?   They refused to write separate checks.  These people are not professional.  Stay far far away from PEACH PROPERTIES.

Yum! The beignets here are fabulous, and the only ones in town that can rival Cafe Du Monde. While Cafe Du Monde has my heart and wins the day on this due to atmosphere, Morning Call is a close second. 

I have to admit that I'm not super crazy about the fact that this restaurant is located inside of a strip mall. However, when you walk inside, any semblance of it being a strip mall joint melts away instantly. 

The menu is simple and everything is affordable. Beignets are delivered hot and fresh to your table where a shaker full of powdered sugar is waiting so you can put as much on top as you would like. Melt in your mouth delicious food. These are incredible.

Really really great! I had a cheeseburger and my brother had the 500 burger both were spectacular.They are very filling despite looking smaller and the quality beats all other burger joints. It wa 20 bucks for two of us to eat, yes its more than wendys but still on par with 5guys.They have milkshakes too! GO!

Great new addition to the SoHo restaurant scene. The free valet parking is key. The decor looks like it's out of a magazine-very hip in a comfortable, low-key way. Everything we tried was excellent, especially the hand-made pasta and pizza right from the wood-buring oven, which the chef told us came from Naples. The bar area was spacious, and they offered an interesting cocktail menu. Already planning a party there in one of the back rooms.
Really wanted to like this place more. Burgers are not bad...certainly not amazing. Not a fan of the waffle fry. Gerst on tap was a treat. Service was ghastly.
The pulled pork didn't taste like anything, but the tri tip was ok.  My general feeling after eating there was "what's the point?l

Went here to shoot for the first time. Recommend getting ear muffs over ear plugs vecuase it was busy and loud inside the range. Staff was very friendly and helpful. Pricey to rent everything for an hour though

Overpriced food. Stinks like smoke everywhere. When I'm hungry and it smells like cigarettes, I feel like throwing up. I only stayed there bcoz I had a gift card. They smoke at the bar only but it smells even at non-smoking areas.
The food was both good and bad.
Good: The Bbq ribs, Bbq chicken, fries, veggies.
There was a musician who was singing on stage.
Bad: Mash potatoes, Caesar and Coleslaw salad.
There are no prices for any of the drinks! Both alcoholic or not. I asked how much is the tea and the waitress didn't know. Well, then have it in a menu.
Service at the bar was so, so.  The Italian beef deep dish was fantastic.  Their pizzas look to be good,  but expect at least 30 min for your food.  At least it's fresh...

I have to be honest, I was a little hesitant about this place simply because of its location. This area is surrounded by big box stores and chains so I thought it was strange that a brewery would pick this location. I tried it because my boyfriend's coworkers raved about the place and I sure am happy I did.

I stopped in here after a workout at the nearby LA fitness.  I went in with low expectations but came out with only smiles.  First off, the staff is very friendly. You can tell the bartenders highly respect the passion the owners put in their beer and they are a good face to the brewery.

We tried the flight of 8, all their beers on tap. They were very generous pours! I took my time sampling all their beers and took my rest in between sampling as a chance to look around the place. They let you bring in your own food! Not only that, but they have a list of places near by and their flyers available to you if you decide you need some carbs to soak up all the beer you have been drinking. They also have GIANT containers of pretzels to also soak up all the beer you have been drinking, for free. The nicest touch is the water jug in the corner. You can fill up your water to your hearts content without having to wait for a waitress to come by. I appreciate that more than they know.

The atmosphere is very laid back, huge tables to line up your pours on, and televisions to watch the game. Happy I decided to stop by. This is brewery that Indy will probably start to see a lot of.

The French Press is a fabulous place. It's very spacious with outdoor and indoor seating. I am not in any way a coffee expert, more like a novice, but I do love an artisanal coffee shop. I was super wowed by my experience here. Matt helped us out, and he was super great. I loved my latte, it definitely perked me up for the drive home.

I recently had a great brunch experience at Jones! I would like to come here again to explore more of the menu!

Service: Our waitress was wonderfully attentive and helpful. One of my friends was observing Lent so our waitress was very knowledgeable as to what she could/could not order. Overall, service here is fantastic!

Food: Jones came highly recommended from a friend who likes simple, Brady-Brunch style food and decor. We heard of the famous monkey bread and it certainly did not disappoint. If you choose to come here for brunch, you must order it! I ordered the spinach and feta omelette which was good but nothing to write home about. The good think about Jones is that the portions are a good size - I got a piece of toast and tater tots included with my order, which was a nice addition. My friend ordered the ALT (avocado, lettuce, tomato) which she raved about as well.

Summary: Jones is a great place to come for a simple, good brunch. The service doesn't disappoint. Jones is worth a try if you're in the area!

Great place to start the day. Really good food and great service. Got here relatively early and were seated right away. Our service was fantastic and they were great with kids. We had a couple of omelettes and French toast and the food was fantastic. The entire staff was very friendly and accommodating. I Would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting or in New Orleans.
My boyfriend and I had a great meal!  He got a stir fry and I got a salad.  Both were super flavorful and packed with toppings.  A great alternative for the regular Chinese take-out!

What a cool joint! I went to BurgerUp after having it highly recommended to me from a friend - and I can see why! My turkey burger was soooo good and the truffle fries were to die for!! The atmosphere and service were also great, didn't feel rushed at all through dinner and our waiter gave us some great recommendations for dessert afterwards.

Great place to find gifts for friends.

I went in looking for a mother's day gift and a birthday gift for my friend.  This store is jam packed full of cute yet unique items.  They have decor for the home, jewelry, lotions, and tons more.  It is a little on the more pricey side, but definitely reasonable.  I think the jewelry is stunning and unique.  

I ended up buying my friend a spa set that was on sale for half off and I got my mom a set of salt and pepper shakers and oil and vinegar bottles.  It was all really cute and really functional.

The woman at the counter was very nice and wrapped my mother's day gift in bubble wrap and gave me a sturdy box once she found out that it was going to be shipped to Texas.

If you're looking for a gift this is definitely a place you will want to stop by.

I have never been here, but I found them on Yelp. Laurie was so nice to help me over the phone. I wanted to surprise my best friend with some pies. Missy my bff has lived very close to this bakery and has never been here. She loved the pies and the bakery. She'll have to write her own review to let you know how they tasted. She did say they tasted amazing. I can say the customer service was fantastic. I'm all the way in Atlanta and when I visit my friend I will be sure to visit this bakery as well!

We were seated at 11:51am we made our drink order at 11:58 we received our drinks promptly but then the misery began. 45 minutes no contact from the waiter only he occasional refill finally 30 mins into our wait we asked what was going on with our food and he said I checked and you are next well 12 minutes later we walked out it shouldn't take 45 minutes for a pancake an order of bacon, a kids omelette and a chicken salad. I will not return. It's not the wait that bothered me it's the lack of contact and any good waiter knows if the wait is long you stop by with something to munch on. Especially with a hungry 4 year old

Offers student discounts, but is still just as expensive as every other place. A brazilian rund from $40-$50, full legs run from $60-$70 (with the student discount). However, the brazilian wax is from europe, and does not require strips. This green wax is amazing, it leaves your skin really soft, takes out the hair only and ultimately results in less ingrown hairs and all! It's ideal for sensitive skin!

Mrs. Ken is also very sweet and comforting. If you're nearby, skip Salon A and all of these crazy places and come here! She takes her time, uses quality wax and her prices are reasonable.

Wowsers!!
Ate there with 2 friends on a Friday night and waited at most 10 min for a table. Quaint atmosphere with friendly service. Steamed mussel special was amazing!! The dipping sauces they make are orgasmic. Thai tea was great too. I ordered Pad Kee Mao and the flavors were unique, no need to add chili paste. I'll most definitely be back next time I'm in NashVegas!

We went in for NYE so excited. I'd eaten at the one by Penn 2x and loved it. This one is good, but if you are an adventurous eater, better go to a Philly location. Everything tastes good here, it just seems spiced down for the suburbanites. Still better than most south Jersey Chinese restaurants.

We got the beef hot pot, allegedly a 10 spice level. It barely rated a 7. The chicken we got, L 7 was not too spicy either. I asked for the Dan Dan noodles to be spicy, but as my daughter was eating them- proof they were not in fact spicy.  The kids loved the 3 cup chicken and the scallion pancake.

The customer service was very good and they were kind to my kids.

The new space is beautiful and relaxing.  I have been seeing Monika for my facials for a few years and she is great.  Gives advice and recommendations and has great attention to detail.  Fantastic skin care products for sale at the spa and she will help you customize what is best for you.

This is another favorite restaurant of mine. We usually eat at the bar. WG has some of the best bartenders around. You can tell they enjoy their job and they want their customer to have a good experience. 

The lettuce wraps,burgers and crab ragoons are to die for!!!! So amazing!

The location is the only positive thing about this restaurant. It is located right on the boardwalk. There are great views of the water. We did see dolphins while waiting.
I ordered the grouper sandwich and it came on a stale bun, wilted lettuce and tomato. The grouper was over cooked and rubbery. My daughter ordered the crab cake sandwich. The bun was also stale. She said she felt ill about an hour after eating the dinner. 
Service lacked as well. Nobody would seat us and the wait staff was not friendly at all. What a horrible experience.... Do not eat there!!!!!!

This place is 6 star review for me, we went on all girls trip for Mardi Gras and it was amazing, there so many great restaurants and bars that you just can choose. We happen to come across Creole House on one of our nights and it had the best Oysters and Seafood you can imagine.  I was in Seafood heaven.

I am still tasting the gumbo, fried and blackened alligator + jambalaya. And I ordered a soft shell crab po-boy to go for the plane ride home. amazing.  and the view of the St. Louis Cathedral and Jackson Square is wonderful, too.

I've lived in Dunedin for over 12 years. Tonight was my first experience at Kally K's. My dad wanted to go out to eat, but a restaurant he wanted to go to was closed early. We debated going to Cafe Alfresco, but I wanted to try the salad bar. The hostess (owner/manager) greeted us at the door. I am curious if the person at the hostess stand is an owner or a manager. The waitress was prompt. I was debating between the fried chicken or the 10 oz. NY strip that was on special. My father ordered the steak and because I haven't eaten a steak in probably 9 months so did I. There was nothing special about it. We both ordered med rare. The steaks were extremely tough and chewy. The strips were unseasoned and tasteless. I was just going to just suffer through it because I've worked off and on in the restaurant business for twenty years. My father really had a hard time cutting his steak. He commented to the waitress three times that our steaks were tough and chewy. She listened, said " I'm sorry" and walked away. At one point while trying to cut through my dad's tough steak his cheap fork completely bent. We had a good laugh. He called the waitress over and showed her his fork. She just laughed. I then asked her to get my father a new fork, before she walked away. My father did tell the waitress that he would eat the steak because he felt like he was taking it out on her. It was obvious we weren't happy. They didn't care. I asked the waitress is the 10 oz . NY strip the same as the other strips. She said yes and that they cut the steaks there. Terrible. I would not recommend this restaurant for one reason. A manager never came to our table. I ate my chewy tasteless NY strip special because I was hungry. Hey, it's just a meal. If I'm serving someone and they aren't happy with their meal I tell my manager. Believe me they would have fixed it. First offer your cu$tomer something else. I would have probably given my steak back before eating the rest of it. If the rest of the food was good I wouldn't have written this review. My dad had enjoyed this restaurant in the past so we would have been back. Maybe I should have ordered the fried chicken. No, we should have just went to Cafe Alfresco instead.
Great happy hour.  Burger was delicious.  I have also had shrimp and grits which were outstanding.  Highly recommend.

I had a delicious breakfast here during our trip, omelet with avocado and Brie topped with shrimp and creole tomato sauce. My only complaint was the biscuits were very dense. Cute decor, great coffee and great location!

I called ahead for a particular piece. They had all their options out waiting for me as I walked in the door. 

Friendly. Easy. No pressure. Answered my questions.

Great local chain that's not scared of making things spicy. The Dan Dan noodles seem to be the must order dish. They get tossed by the staff table side as it's rumored the owner doesn't trust customers to do it properly. Hilarious and he's probably accurate if true. The noodles are more than fine but I enjoyed the Pork Belly w/ Sweet Garlic Chili Oil Sauce was sublime. Served cold, spicy, sweet, fatty, porky goodness. Place was very busy which is always a good sign. Service was efficient and lunch was served at blazing speeds. Decor looked like a scaled back version of PF Changs, more sterile than most Chinese restaurants.

They are just perfect for what I want. Second visit for me and again nothing went wrong. If you just want to have fresh Crawfish, shrimp or oysters... come visit here. I had a dozen each of freshly shucked oyster in front of you and fried oyster!!! My my my..... the room is not clean, table is rough set up and people work here are like buddies; thus, you'll love it here:)))) Will be back 350%~!

Really as amazing as others say.  I have horrible non-typical asian hair.  It's coarse, texturized, frizzy, it doubles in size if I don't take the time to blow-dry it and use product and even then, it doesn't want to do what I ask.  I also had had a weird highlighting job at a place back home and was left with brassy highlights that don't look good in dark brown to black hair!

Jacqui was amazing. Very skilled colorist and very good at picking an AMAZING shade of chestnutty goodness that totally compliments my natural color.  She also verified with me that I hadn't colored black recently to assure that her work would stick.  Great attention to detail.  She also finished a little early for my appointment with Jason and she threw in a free conditioning treatment for my wait!  Awesome service! With my long hair and me wanting full foil highlights it came to $115.

Jason was also great.  I've never had any stylist actually say "did you like your last hair cut?" and that was kind of how he worked out what to do with my hair.  He clearly is very meticulous, looking over each section he was cutting for the split ends and figuring out how much he could save.  He didn't have much to say but considering his work, I was very happy with him either way!  He was a little expensive at $50, but next time I'll bring my WashU ID!

I felt fantastic walking out of V Vegaz.  I kept checking my head out in every shop window!  Will definitely be back!
We came late on a Sunday as all other places were closed.  We were treated like family and had the most delicious garlic rocks, pizza, calzone, and cannoli.  Best service and friendly atmosphere.
Very good! Had take out from there tonight and everything was on point. Changes from usual asian spots; great flavor combos! Highly recommended!
Love this place súper delicioso food is always nice and is super fast and healthy love it

Lunch here was lovely. Quiet setting, especially considering its location on Jasper Avenue. 

The staff treated us warmly and took excellent care of us. I found it a tad overwhelming to be approaches by four different staff members, especially for a business lunch. But as I said, professional and courteous service.

The flatbread was delicious - chicken, pear, caramelized onions, and gorgonzola cheese. Nicely done, Madison Grill. I'll definitely return.

Last time I was here was a long time ago.  My friends and I played our oletimers touch football game nearby.  We stopped by here afterwards and spent over $100.  As we were down to our last pitcher, we talked about ole time for 10 minutes.  For whatever reason, one of the managers stopped over and just about kicked us out, as if we were tying up one of his tables on Saturday night.  It was about 6 o'clock.  I guess he didn't appreciate the $100 that we already spent, and needed that table badly.

I found the food OK, nothing you can't get around the corner,  but more expensive.  Overall, this is a decent place, but overrated.  And honestly, I didn't care for their corporate attitude.  Give me one of the smaller, local cheaper places in South Philly, where aren't in a hurry to get your table.

Went in during Fiesta at 11 am. The place was less than half full. Sat at the bar and waited...waited and waited. No hello, no eye contact and no service. After 15 minutes we left and headed over to Handlebar Roasters, where there was a long lone but we had coffee in 5 minutes from very friendly staff

Too bad, the building on State is beautiful and the location is Primo, but the wait staff is so good at, well, keeping you waiting. 

One and done for this Santa Barbarbarian.

Gem of a place. Can't wait to come back! 
Very nice atmosphere. Outside dining which is rare for north Tampa. 
Water is slightly flavored, refreshing & just amazing. 
Iced tea I recommend for tea lovers. 
The staff is friendly & attentive. 
Menu is appetizing so going back to try more on there as soon as I can. 
I had the chicken panini with caramelized onions and tomatoes etc. with a side of couscous salad. 

You must try this place!

tried a second time...table for 6....we arrived early and had drinks at the bar before being seated. friendly and knowledgeable bartender. great Hemingway daiquiris. the food was amazing, as expected. this place is definitely a hidden gem. very unassuming from the outside and very warm and cozy inside. you've got to try it. very unique menu...between six of us, we tried almost everything and it was all grea

Town And Country veterinary hospital is one of the best vets on the face the planet, in my opinion. 

Both doctors are professional, highly qualified, friendly, approachable, and never rush you out the door to get to the next patient. They have endless patience with questions, and get down on the floor with your pet before starting any sort of examination which really helps relax nervous pups.
Great Ruben and burgers. Great lunch specials. Friendly people. Highly recommend.

So, being a employee at a burger joint, I wanted to try 500 degrees. I've been hearing rave reviews about their burgers and food. Going in for the first time, I was amazed by the many options the menu held. I went in for a Bacon cheeseburger, with jalapenos. I was greeted by a not so friendly cashier, who seemed to also be the manger. Being my first time I thought he would have helped me understand their system of ordering better, but he was sarcastic and rude. 

Other than the lack of hospitality, I will say the food was okay. The fries, banana shake and the cola w/ cane sugar was AMAZING. The burger on the other hand was very dry, and lacked any type of flavor that I would expect from a burger. First looking at it, I thought it might be a great homemade burger, but boy was I wrong. 

Overall: Don't expect amazing hospitality from them, if you do order a burger, make sure you add some type of sauce. Everything else was pretty good, and I like that they have plenty of options to choose from. 

I'm giving 500 degree 2 stars, just for the lack of hospitality and acknowledging the fact that I was a 1st time guest. Also, for the dryness of the burger, the main attraction of a burger joint.

It was our third day in Reno and we were getting tired of fast food. It was our mission to eat Filipino food before we head home. 

We arrived when they just opened. We were welcomed with a warm smile-true Filipino hospitality.

Yes, we waited for about 25 minutes for our food, but it was worth it. Ang sarap!
Food was good, I had a burrito and I was happy with it. The prices are a little higher then what I'm used to, for a burrito, 4 tacos and a chicken quesadilla and 3 small drinks it was $30.

I cannot say enough about this place.  Thanks first to Yelp for helping me find this place.  I glanced through the reviews and saw the good, the bad, the ugly and decided that this would be a good place for us to try on our last night in town.

They make amazing use of their space and the restaurant is smartly decorated and furnished.  The music played over head was not too familiar indie songs, the type you would hear on Public Radio or a good College Radio station.  Very nice atmosphere.

The servers were uber-attentive.  I cannot say too much about how they were always there to take care of us, even with a full house.  My friend felt they were hovering, but whenever they came by, she needed something, so I would have to say their timing was just right. Be prepared to be taken care of here. 

The food was amazing.  The Smoked Duck Salad was absolutely fabulous.  My friend was incredibly taken with the Beet Salad.  We arrived at the beginning of happy hour and took part in the wine and cheese plate.  We also ventured off to other cheese plates that were available and found the 5 Spoke Creamery Tumbleweed to be delightful.  

For dessert, the Flourless Chocolate Cake was delightful with the a sweet cherry sauce.  A nice finish to our dinner...and Tria was a great finish to our visit to Philadelphia.
This is a great family run butcher & deli. Great products & great people. Highly recommend it

My first time at a barber shop.  Usually have hair done at a local beauty shop and have only had 3 other people cut my hair in my 45 years of having hair. I was very nervous.  Omar called me to his chair and assured me I would be happy with the cut.  He is a very friendly guy and is sincere when he talks.  When he got done I was happy with the job he did.  He offered the free drinks and gave a nice massage in the end.  The wife liked the haircut so I will be back Omar! Thanks again...

Casa Video is by far the best video store I have ever visited.  It may also win as the best video store to have ever graced this earth's existence.  The selection is unparalleled.  Their HUGE selection of independent films makes any trip there worthwhile.  BUT, top that with a new release section that never seems to be out of the big name films, free popcorn, and great movies playing, and I'm not sure you can go wrong.  And finally the kickers: Casa is open until 1a, even during the holiday season, and the number of days provided for rental is great.

The staff is usually apathetic and sometimes unfriendly.  But, you know what - that just adds to the atmosphere, and it's one of the few places where I think apathy is a true asset.  It's perfectly priceless.  I would appreciate a few more female employees though!!!

Be sure to go on Tuesdays and Wednesdays to take advantage of the two-for-one special.  

We love Casa, and we take any and all visitors to the greatest video store of all time!

Surrey's is a nice breakfast joint that offers fresh juices and breakfast/brunch items ranging from the vegan bagel plate with avocado mash, to bananas foster french toast.  The first time I went there was during a very busy Sunday morning and I got the huevos rancheros bowl (all the stuff layered together and topped with mole and cheese) and my man got the traditional French toast.  My food was luke-warm and very bland. The French toast was soggy and nothing to write home about.  However, I have been back twice and had 2 tasty meals since, so Surrey's has been redeemed in my eyes.  I strongly recommend the the migas (a yummy southwest-style scramble that includes crushed up corn tortilla chips) the bagel plate, and the special sandwiches which someone else also praised.  The juices are not cheap, but if you are battling a hangover or just feeling crappy, an apple, orange, and carrot juice and a plate of migas will set you right.  Cash only. Service is efficient, but not much else. During my first experience, when they were very busy, it was impossible to get anything, especially coffee refills.

I've been here a few times now, each time I'm in town I try to stop here. The food is good and verbally the device is good as well. However, tonight's visit in was a bit confusing...

I entered the restaurant around 5:45pm, and upon entering there were three people seated inside, a couple in the back corner eating and a lady at the bar eating. Standing there for about 30 seconds or so, unsure if I should wait to be seated or seat myself, a woman in the back of the restaurant started yelling something towards the front of the place. I thought I did something wrong. 

She yelled something again and the guy in the corner turned and looked at me and went back to eating, once more she yelled and then he finally got up confused looking and started walking to the woman at the bar... and again the lady in the back yelled, he finally seems to notice me, and as he looked at me, confused, he said "oh?". At this point I looked at him and said: "Just one please". He still seemed confused as to why he was helpin me but told me to just sit anywhere. He followed me to the table and gave me a menu. Then immediately walked away.

A minute or two later he came back to get my drink order, to which I ordered water. When he returned with the drink he sat the water down with the woman at the bar, she said "this isn't for me, I think that's his drink." Pointing at me...

He then smiled and was like "oh yeah." Picking the drink back up and bringing it to me. He then just stood there, not saying anything - I took this as my queue to order so I pointed to what I wanted and said that I also wants to add an egg roll. Fairly quickly the food came out. Thankfully he not only brought the food to me but he also brought me the right food, with one exception - no egg roll. But after quickly setting it food down he darted outside for about 10'minutes - I believe he was trying to bring in customers who were walking by as he finally returned inside with a small group of people. 

At this point he takes care of their order then brings me a check. $30 with a soda, beer, and two meals on it, and again goes right back outside before I can even pick the ticket up to look over it. Not in a rush I waited a bit, sipped my water. He returned 6-8 minutes later and comes to collect the check. I tell him it's the wrong check.

He smiles and apologizes and comes back with another check. This time it had the correct meal but also had a $2.50 charger for a soft drink, to which I pointed down at my cup of water and told him that I only had a water and that there was a soda charge on the bill. He grabs it back and looks at it for a few seconds and then says he will be right back. 

At this point he finally brings the right check, my card was still in my hand but he darted off again before I could hand it back to him. So  walked up to the bar, near the register and stood there for about 5 minutes before someone would ring it out. At this point there were two tables with 5 total people and the woman at the bar, not a crazy rush by any standards. 

Paid and left... I will definitely think twice about returning, sadly.

We really enjoyed our experience here. The food was really good and so was the beer. The service was friendly. 

We really liked the cheesesteak egg rolls for the appetizer. I ordered the burger of the day from their promotional May burger menu and it was great. My wife ordered the chicken ceasar salad which she loved. The only complaint we have was the strawberry mojito was awful. 

We will definitely go back.
Ok ride, food not worth the price. Not much to see along the Mississippi but other ships and warehouses.  Save your money for an Airboat ride.

I went here with some friends while visiting for the weekend, I am extremely pleased with everything about this place. From the decor, vibe, music (DJ was playing old soul music and R&B that hit every chord in the right way). The portions were grand, I feel like there are often many spots that don't get it right or overcharge for basics, not here. I loved everyone else's dishes too (literally since the place settings are a mixture of types / designs of plates). Their biscuits are SOOOOOO good, make SURE you get them. I had the cheesy grits with shrimp hands down awesome & prepared the right way (and I'm picky since I go to ATL a lot), they get it right here! Absolutely coming back here for my next brunch when I'm in town!

Our whole family was excited about our first time sailing and we booked a trip with Windsong because of the good reviews we'd read.  Booked the trip over the phone and the man who made our reservation was very helpful in answering all our questions. We arrived about 15 minutes late because of traffic on the way in and our captain (Ed) was waiting and got us checked in. The boat wouldn't start and we had to wait about 15 minutes to get a fuse changed out but then we were on our way.  Unfortunately, we didn't get to do much sailing because the engine broke down again once we were out on the water. They sent another boat - a pontoon - to pick us up and took us to an island to swim and look for shells.  The island is a gold mine for shells and sand dollars and we did see a couple dolphins while we were there. Captain Ed was great with our kids and pulled the pontoon up close so we could get some good pics of the dolphins and he made a bad situation somewhat better, but the end result was that we wanted to sail, we paid to sail, and didn't get to sail.  Ed did keep us out on the water 2 extra hours, but at least one of those hours was spent trying to repair the engine and then towing the sailboat back to the dock. No one was there to apologize for the breakdown once we got back to the dock, and we weren't offered any kind of refund or any other compensation for a sailing trip that never happened. Technical problems happen and Ed really did make it an enjoyable time, but we were disappointed that we didn't get to sail.  Will still probably try it again sometime, but it's no fun to pay $330 and not get what you paid for.
needed to do a supply run at 130am.     close to hotel.  good old Walmart always open.

I just stopped in today for the first time. I got an iced tea and they brew each individual cup fresh. I had peppermint green tea but there were so many other teas thatit was hard to chioose. Delicious. The owner was really nice and I found out she bakes the muffins and cupcakes on the premises. I will be back to try the food soon!

Cool place with lots of plants and pots. Great choice of Mexican pots and statues exc. There us a wide variety of fruiting plants and trees. Look for the wild parrots in the power line transformers. Nice people good service. Will go back would recommend

I visited Kei twice this week! This is my new favorite spot in town!  The menu has an awesome mix of traditional rolls you know and love and some new and interesting rolls I haven't seen on any other menu in town. 

My favorite roll is probably the Tiburon- salmon, spicy tuna, pickled jalapeño, daikon and sesame seeds. 

The service was awesome too! I sat at the bar and my plates were cleared quickly and my drink was always full. I can't wait to come back for more to try the specialty nigiri!
More of a tourist site than a place to go for value and good food.  Don't get me wrong as the shell fish is good and fresh but very expensive and terrible atmosphere.

Fantastic company to work with, would love to host another event in the SB area so I can call them again! Darin, Sierra and Kathleen were amazing throughout the entire process, from booking to day of the event. They really made everything so easy and were quick to offer help and suggestions when needed. And Cindy, our driver, was terrific!  We had about twenty kids on the bus and they all had a great time...she was professional, friendly, attentive and a good driver, to boot!

I frequent this Subway cause it's close to my house. The place is clean enough, and the food was average for a Subway restaurant. However the older gentlemen who appears to be Indian is very cold and unpleasant. Oh, and EXTREMELY stingy with the food and toppings! He literally sparkled like 2 pinches of cheese on my sandwich, and I feel like I was shorted on everything else too......won't be going back unless I can help it.

The reason I came here was because I drop my car in the body shop next door. Service is way too slow!!! We wait an hour for our food to come out!!! Sushi is decent but others are terrible. Especially Beef teriyaki. Avoid this place unless you don't have a choice.

Over all the food is good my problem  with this location is they just bring out a few bread sticks for 4 people They brought out enough salad for one person I order Alfredo boat for the bread sticks and there definitely wasn't 1/3 cup in there I told my waitress and she said they got new management and they don't want them giving much no more I will go to the chesterfield location from now on they give you your money's worth

For those who must eat GF, this place is a dreamland. I brought home some of the brownies and donuts and my family quickly devoured them. The assortment of baked goods seemed pretty extensive and I will definitely be coming back soon.

The Barrel is a cool concept but their product is horrible.  It tasted like cheap boxed wine that sat in my car too long on a hot July day.  I hope that as a wine bar they can expand beyond a selection of six basic cheap wines... Otherwise, they won't last.  The ambiance and staff are great... It's only the product that is suffering.

McCree Town used to be one of the finest crack neighborhoods in the area. And now look what's become of it....

This is a gorgeous space with gorgeous baked delicacies. The macarons are fabulous. At first I did think, how crazy is it to put an authentic Patisserie in an area like this and not Clayton? But you know what? We deserve beauty here, too.
I found the staff very pleasant and willing to help, and saw Simone Faure, the pastry chef (who I think looks very much like my favorite chanteuse Nina Simone) greeting each customer. Maybe the opening weeks were stiff and formal, but they have settled in nicely. So go get a strawberry macaron or a chocolate bombe or a beautiful croissant and be thankful. We are very lucky to have Simone grace us with her skills.

The food here is above what you would get in the Quarter. They make their own hot sausage and the french toast is on point. The owner was kind , but his brother was AWESOME! He was really cool and just made us feel so welcome!It's a family run business and I dig that. The servers were excellent and made great suggestions. They make sure to thank you for your business and appreciate it as well. Just a great group of people in there. I have eaten at several restaurants here and this is the only one I felt deserved a five star review.

Laughably HORRIBLE, overly SALTY mexican food. Go to Mi Pais or El Limón or El Charro Negro and eat AUTHENTICO! I ordered a dish and my friend was with me, the older woman who helped us BARELY spoke english and even though my friend did not want anything, she put him down for an order of something else on the menu! Then she was unable to understand that I WOULD NOT PAY for that, so she charged me ANYWAY without telling me. So i paid for 2 meals. One of which I DID NOT EVEN CONSUME! STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE! There are so many better latin cuisine options, i don't know why this place is STILL in existence!!!

I have gotten piercings (helix, lobes, rook) from both Johnny and Josh here and would not go anywhere else!  Despite my sensitive/problematic ears (my 1st lobe piercings from a mall kiosk are still wonky 12 years later), my Golden Eagle piercings have all healed beautifully and look great, and even the cartilage piercings were practically painless. I'm actually planning another cartilage project at the moment... 

Both Johnny and Josh are absolute professionals who do excellent work and take a lot of pride in it. Whenever I describe the type of piercing I wanted, they examine the architecture of my ear (to make sure it would heal well and look good) before agreeing to do the piercing.They always double check placement before actually doing the piercing to make sure it's exactly what I want. They do a great job of explaining aftercare requirements, and they always encourage me to come back to the shop if I have any questions or concerns about how a piercing is healing. The shop is immaculately clean and well maintained, and both Josh and Johnny are meticulous about sterility (they don't let customers touch any of their piercings, healed or new). The guys are really friendly, and even a mild needle-phobe like myself can easily feel comfortable throughout the piercing process. 

The jewelry selection is beautiful and extensive, and they often have sales or special deals. The shop is cash only, but there is an ATM downstairs so it's not really a problem. It's not the cheapest shop around, but is most definitely the best. You get what you pay for, and the quality of work at Golden Eagle is easily worth the extra few dollars.
Nasty flavor. Very sloppy presentation. Empty on Thursday night. Never again. Best part was the serve staff.

I love frozen yogurt and you can usually find me at Phileo Yogurt (South Street) on the week-ends.  But I think Phileo may have met its match.  

Aside from great tasting frozen yogurt, what do I like about this place?  Well, it has the widest selection of toppings I've ever seen at a frozen yogurt shop.  Any kind of candy topping you can think of, they offer it.  They also offer peanut butter syrup (one of my favorites) and I've never seen it offered at Phileo. In addition, they offer the option of creating your own smoothie.  The customer fills his/her cup with yogurt and toppings and they mix it into a smoothie - great idea!  

The staff was friendly and kept the line moving. Next time, I hope to return with my children.  I'm sure they'll enjoy it...

The double butter burger is by far one of my favorites. The good news is I can eat half and share my other half with someone who wants just a little more. The burgers are thin (not as thin as steak n shakes) and the ends are crispy that is why I like half of a double   It's perfect!!  And the concrete mixers.. Make ur own shake!!! We get a vanilla ice cream base with a little chocolate caramel and coconut added. Yes these are our fat day meals. Lol

I love Milktooth  the food is absolutely amazing atmosphere is fun and  after my first visit I couldn't wait to go back.
I am very pleased that they serve their most beautiful and incredible coffee with a milk substitute. I love coffee and chocolate but after a certain age  I have had  to be very careful about the amount of caffeine my body can tolerate.  After my first visit I was up until 2 am but still couldn't wait to go back. Crazy about  this place!!!
Unfortunately after my visit at ~9 am this am I'm still awake. Even so, I am hopeful that someday decaf will be served. This is the only reason I only gave them 3 stars. It seems simple that I just wouldn't order coffee but I don't have that kind of will power
Fantastic cinnamon rolls according to my kid. I had the Denver omelet which was great. The coffee was good. I liked the patio seating.

I genuinely question the sanity of anyone who does not absolutely love this place. This is one of the most outstanding places I have ever eaten, and I am often tempted to drive the 6+ hours to NOLA just to get a box of their donuts. 
District donuts does not mess around. There's a line around the block for this place for very good reason. Not because it's hip or trendy or an Instagram fad, but because it's actually THAT good. Have you ever had a croque monsieur or madame made with a donut instead of boring old bread? Have you ever watched someone brulee a cinnamon roll to somehow make it even more amazing? I bet you didn't even know that it was possible to brulee a cinnamon roll, did you?! Well, now you know. And you should try it immediately. 
This place is so many of my dessert dreams come true. I cannot wait to visit again!

Let me start with the bathrooms. Where my brother went to grab toilet paper and stuck his hand in a massive amount of shit. Where my wife and sister in law some poop smeared all over the toilets. Let me continue on with the food. The Mongolian bar had shrimp with the chicken, what about people with an allergy to shrimp? Or how about the noodles that smelled sour. Let's not forget to mention the chicken was either cold and gross and/or contained nothing but fat. OH! The chocolate pudding had big yellow chunks of food in it! What was left of the ice cream was slimy! Then not only did it already cost $40 just for my family of 4 (2 adults and 2 children) but they helped themselves to a pre tip of $4, something called a "gratituity" and then asked for an additional tip. Wouldn't have been a problem IF someone helped. Although they were quick to pick up my credit card, my table was piled with dishes. This place is disgusting and I'm half tempted to call someone to inspect their filth filled restaurant. Never going again
Decor is awesome. Service was impeccable. It was Mexican cuisine with a French twist. I recommend give  this quaint and trendy spot a try...

The place was dead when we got there and there we're more ppl working than customers in the restaurant. The service was pathetic and the food was extremely mediocre. Should have gone to Denny's next door, that's how much of a waste a time this place is

I love this place! Freshest food is always worth the money! I'm a huge fan of the Fa La La La La-roasted turkey, house made cranberry sauce, baby swiss, lettuce and tarragon mayo, and I get mine on the pretzel ciabatta. Mmmm! Salads are always heaped with tons of the good stuff-greens, avocado, eggs, fruit, nuts....whatever it's topped with, there's always more than enough (in a good way!) And the tea there is absolutely fantastic! Always cold and refreshing!  To wrap up your meal and satiate your sweet tooth-huge chocolate chip cookies! Sometimes it gets a little crowded in the dining area, but in the restaurant biz, I guess that's a good thing!  I only don't care for the awkwardness of sitting at the side tables near the windows; if someone is at the table next to you, it's like sitting on their lap...yikes! but that's the only complaint I have! Overall, love the atmosphere and the food is super!

I brought the general's chicken (white meat) it was awful. The chicken was fried so hard that I couldn't eat it, but my dog liked it. The rib tips were ok. Also, I had shrimp fried rice, which wasn't too bad except some of the shrimp were mushy. Well to make a long story short, I won't be getting anything else from there.

A better follow up experience today.  Mr. Shula, I'm a hostage at the hotel so you have a captive audience.

So, I stopped by for a quick lunch.  Took a while to get a server but once that happened, she was attentive.  Ordered the Chicken Sandwich (I know it's a Steak House but they don't have lunch sized portions).  It came in a reasonable amount of time.  Brioche bun was good, tomato and onion were fresh.  Butterflying the chicken seems to make for a better sandwich but the breast was cooked well none the less.

Better experience but wish they had a lunch specific smaller option on the steaks.

It was a great pub! There was a decent selection of beers, including some local brews. The cheesesteak was tasty and Christmas chicken was surprisingly good. Plenty of seating inside, with fast and attentive service. Overall, it was a good pick for a stay in Philly.
Vicky was great!  Loved her cheesy jokes and enthusiasm for an early tour - likeable!! Great tour but I thought they'd dress up like the do in Boston duck boats.

I was really excited to go to Ants Pants and I'll be back.  I was definitely not as impressed as I wanted to be.  I loved the clean aesthetic.  I loved the coffee and the sweet potato fries with chile sauce rock.  

I was saddened to see the manager snap at the new dishwasher.  I know that happens and people get stressed, but I just had a sense that entire staff was really busy and morale seemed low. The breakfast burrito I ordered lacked major flavor.

I will go back because I think it might have been an off day.
I would have to say that this is our new favorite Thai restaurant in Boise. The price is a bit higher but worth it. We have tried a number of dishes and have not been disappointed.

My doctor referred me here and not a specialist for an eye condition. The equipment that is used for vision testing is dated. You could easily cheat on these tests. The ophthalmologist I saw had no confidence in what he was doing. Of the 2-3 visits I had I was only ever offered temp inserts for your glasses for sun. Whenever I would ask for realistic long term prognosis ideas I was left in the dark. Unfortunately for me, my condition became worse and I was referred to the specialist I wanted in the first place to have surgery (I was told it was needed ASAP- in reality it isn't needed at all). Instead of being devastated I thought: "well at least I don't have to go through this shit blizzard anymore." 

The optical place is awful as well. I ordered large glasses and they refused to give me a case that fit until I went back and complained, they wouldn't properly adjust my glasses to fit my face until I came back and complained. I had bought a higher end brand of glasses so I figured they would want me to have a good experience and keep purchasing higher end frames. 

The only pros: is that they get you in and out quickly, there don't seem to be any screaming children in the waiting room, and the front desk staff are nice and professional.

Three stars is the highest I can give chains, I do make exceptions. This Outback is great, servers are super friendly, foods is consistent and in a pinch when I can't get to my favorite steak place their ribeye is great. I eat my steak Pittsburgh rare and they know how to cook it.

Photobooth. DIrtbags. Collard-shirt-types who brag loudly about "slumming it" 

I love being slightly plastered, dancing until I am woozy, and high-fiving strangers. The bartenders pour pretty heavily, and the regulars are slightly friendly.. 

I really love the new backyard area. It is brilliantly decorated in a "crap we found in the props department of sea world" kind of way. I sit back there sometimes and just LOVE to listen to the madness of inside, as well as people watch. 

Minus 1 star because the potties are usually occupied for long periods of time. GRRRRRR.

Tried this place out for dinner the other night and was pleasantly surprised. They have such a fun and creative menu. I can't wait to try something else they offer. I also love that their menu has a really fun sense of humor to it as well (check out how they can slice your pizza) we got the mooseknuckle which was just pepperoni and pineapple and an order of wings. 

The pizza crust was cooked perfectly and the sauce was flavorful. Everything worked well together... and the pizza was not overly greasy which is always a plus. The wings were delish... I wish they came in weight and not number (you can get an order of 6 or 12) we got the Buffalo flavor and it was super tasty. 

This is a smaller place kind of tucked away in the back, they do not deliver so you'll have to pick up. There isn't much room to dine in but there are seats inside and outside. Will definitely eat here again.

The pizza is good. The best in Hendersonville in my opinion. But the place is seemingly run by a bunch of high schoolers that play around way too much. For the price of this pizza, a pleasant customer experience shouldn't be too much to ask for.

I need to go to this place a few more times to try their different stuff.. but the doubles (chickpea stew sandwiched between 2 puffy flatbreads) I had there were a great little afternoon snack.  $1.50 each and you could have 3 for a totally legit lunch.. maybe 2 if you are eating light.  They also have roti with all different meats including shrimp and "soya" and other standard West Indian fare like curry goat, collard greens, etc.  Plates of those things range in price and size from about $5 up.  I am giving 4 stars just because doubles I've had in the past were a little more substantial, and they could have been spicier (though they were well-spiced, just not hot). The thing I was most disappointed by was  the subpar ginger-pineapple juice I got for $3.  $3!?  But I think that was more my fault than theirs.

btw this is a storefront bakery setup with a window in the back with the hot dishes to order.  There are a couple of tables in there too but it's not a nice-lunch-out sort of place.

How can you not love trader joes?  There is always something new and delicious to try.  The people who work here are awesome too!  They Always say hi to me and know my kids names too.  Fruit and veggies are always fresh and the prices beat every big box grocery store!  They make it easy to eat healthy!
