The location of the place was a little hard to find since we were dining for the first time. Arriving there, the staff was friendly and inviting. We made a note on the reservation that there was a birthday and we were seated in a window booth with an outstanding view of the city and sunset. Our server was very informing, courteous, and made our first experience delightful. It is a higher end restaurant so be prepared to spend some cash, but it is perfect for special occasion.

Just stayed at The Hyatt for the first time over Easter weekend. Nice hotel, great location, more of a business hotel, vallet is extremely rude otherwise the people who work inside the hotel are nice & willing to help with anything. Before the maid came I wrote a note and left a tip asking for new bed sheets and comforter & new towels, when we came back from a long day at the St Louis Zoo we found a BUG in our bed ( not a bed big ) so we immediately called down to the front desk and showed them the bug once house keeping manager came and he switched us from the 12th floor to the 15th floor which had an amazing view unlike our other room we couldn't see the arch at all but once they moved us we could. They were really nice about it & I enjoyed my stay there besides Vallet.

Wait staff was polite, pleasant and efficient.  Food was OK, not great.  Clam chowder like a can of Progresso.  

Ambiance was zero, but could still be OK; like a crab house on theMaryland shore that specializes in their food, not the environment.

Went there to check out a place to take guests after a tour of the Historical sights, but this is not the place.

Worst thing was the mismatch of the prices with the overall experience.  For those prices I would have expected waiters in tuxes with linen napkins over their arms.

The beer selection is amazing and the servers know their beer so if you have a tough time deciding, they can help you out.  I have been here twice and both times I ordered the peanut butter and jelly burger.  When I go again I will order it a third time.  It is just that good.  It is the perfect combination of sweet and salty.  They offer sweet potato fries which have a light coating of sugar on them.  They are just ok.  I will probably try a different side next time.  The only reason this place didn't get five stars is that the decor is pretty meh.  They have a lot of room for improvement.  However when looking at just the food and drinks, this place is a must go!!

I normally give positive reviews on yelp because I think there is too much negativity in this world. However, I have not been to a McDonald's where the employees were more unpleasant, indifferent, or downright rude. Food is normal McDonald's fare, but be prepared for employees who obviously don't care about their job.

TERRIBLE FRONT DESK!!!  Rudest people I have ever met. Trying to check in and all they cared about was talking and ordering their own lunch!  I had to wait while the girl places her order before I was waited on.

Once again I have received some of the best service I've ever got at a chilis before. Our waitress Katrina(like the hurricane) was absolutely fantastic, nice, polite, got everything right and kept our drinks full the entire time! 5 stars again chills keep it up.
Everything about this place is amazing!!! The food and dessert are delicious. Everything is so reasonably priced! Our waitor, Joe was amazing, hilarious and helpful!

Our first visit and we were disappointed (mostly).  I'm Italian so I look for good Italian markets and got super excited.  I admit, it is an experience, going from room to room, section to section selecting goodies.  I'll go from best to worst 'cause we bought a lot.  The cheese we bought, while the selection was not plentiful, was VERY good/enjoyable, albeit pricey.  The fresh-made pizza tasted really good but the crust is just too thick and hard to chew (and they don't put cooking instructions on the pizza which they should).  Bought the marinara sauce; I make better so I won't do that again, it was too sweet like school cafeteria sauce.  Bought my fave Italian pastries Sfogliatella (the clam shaped multi layer pastry) and Cannolis.  The Sfogliatella was passable but nothing like what it should be.  The Cannolis were just awful and a huge disappointment -- absolutely not even close to authentic; the cream was too thick, the shell not fresh, just didn't taste right at all; have never thrown a cannoli out.  Bought the pre-made large eggplant parm.  We were disappointed maybe because of the sauce, I don't know but I can't recommend it.  Now my sister and brother-in-law go all the time and purposely for the eggplant parm so...you decide.  We have found more authentic Italian markets around Florida in Fort Myers (Marios) and Miami and Cape Coral with great authentic sauces, etc.  If you want the best of the best, then get your Italian pastry in New York City at Veneiro's and get your Italian goodies at Eataly in Chelsea.  Sorry, we are spoiled ex-New Yorkers so hard to please us.  Mazzaro's is ok for the experience and a one-time visit but won't be a staple for us.

Starts the job and could not get the guy to finish.  He held up the construction of my new home.  All he had to do was put in 4 10" sky tubes.  After 3 visits he had 1 complete and 2 partially complete.  The roofers could not finish their job and seal the roof up until he was done.  I left many many messages and never a call back.  Once when he answer the phone I told him about all the messages and he said he is too busy to check his messages.  DON'T TAKE ON WORK YOU CANT HANDLE.  He would tell me he was going to be at the house a certain day to complete the work and would just no show.  In my humble opinion he is a piece of work you should not do business with this company.  This is not how you treat customers.

Update - after me speaking my mind he did come back and quickly complete the job, so I added a star.
Great Vesper Martini, okay gumbo, kinda cool atmosphere. I probably won't go back but it was a good place to stop in.

I do not understood how this place has 4 stars. Service was good. However, the food really disappointed me. The guacamole was very bland. The rice and beans where the worst I have ever had. Everything else was just ok.

Located at the Q&D Rock Quarry the Wild West Motorsports Raceway hosts the Lucas Oil Off Road Race Series. Take Exit 23 Mustang heading East on Highway 80 outside of the Reno/Sparks area.

The race track is in the middle of nowhere, so expect dust storms, high heat, sun beating on the shoulders type of environment. Wear shoes, not sandals, bring sun screen and a hat. A water bottle will help keep you hydrated.

If you have not yet been it's a must! 

5 STARS!!!

I've ordered from uber eats with them before and had great service.  Today I ordered and they delivered 2 of my orders incorrectly with brown rice instead of white. If I'm going to be paying more for this delivery order through uber eats I expect for them to get it right.  Instead of acknowledging that they got it wrong,  the rep insisted she was right, did not offer a refund or a replacement and called me a bitch upon hanging up.  I have Never had such bad service.  Never returning again.
MJ is where its at!!! Great hairstylist and customer service was top notch!  Very informative and of course provided me with great curls!  I got lots of compliments!

I have been having my nails done for some time now.  I am an esthetician and my hands are often abused and in water.  I need my nails short for my job and polish doesn't last.  I started having gel manicure several years ago and while I loved them at first the love affair didn't;t last.  The gel would lift and I would peel it off. Over time this caused damage to my nail and I had given up being told that the gel "just wouldn't stick" and that "I would need them done weekly" After being with Verla for several months now I can say I won't go anywhere else.  She offers a wide variety of brands of gel manicures and after hearing my story we decided to try another brand.  Who Knew??  so now I am back with one of my all time classic favorite colors: ESSIE BALLET SLIPPERS. She has a magic touch and while I haven't changed jobs or anything I am doing at home; the polish STAYS PUT! The gel Mani includes cuticle work, filing, and the best hand massage ever! Try a pedicure too. My polish doesn't chip even when my toe nail does :-)

The new remodel Gator Dockside looks a lot better than the old one. They have change the carpet floor to wood floor look more elegant. From the old projected TV to digital large screen TV. The renovation is welcoming the patron to the new football season. 

I like to come to this restaurant mainly is their chicken wings. First, select the way you want it - Grill, breaded, wet sauce, or boneless. Second, select number of wings. Third, select the flavor. Tonight we have tried 12 different flavors. My top three I like most are grill chipotle BBQ, grill Thai chili, and the grill Yucatan. If you dare, try their 4 alam wings. This wing is super hot that one of our friends tries it and burn the mouth. I also like the peanut butter flavor with unique taste. 

This sport bar is family oriented bar. Many families bring their kids. They have the children menu. The restaurant service is good and the food came out fast with 100 wings.

Whenever I pick up the City Paper I go right to the "I love you I hate you" section. This always entertains me to no end. Vulgar messages of lust and passion and then total disgust and extreme anger.  People venting their most primal urges- Gotta love it. They even published the one I wrote when somebody broke into my car- Yee ha!! 

Other than the love/hate column. I also enjoy the Bell Curve, and the Ice Pack as mentioned by Bill M. If you need to fuel your body with food or live music check here. You can find whatever floats your boat. There used to be an enteraining sex column Paper Doll, before that Ask Isadora. If I want to read crazy sex stories now I read Savage Love in the (Phila)Weekly.

Just had a wonderful dinner with family and friends at Punky's. Steven was an excellent waiter and took great care of us. I had the Cajun chicken with brie cheese sauce, fresh vegetables, and jalapeño macaroni and cheese. Delicious! Everyone else had hamburgers and we started the meal with delicious fried green tomatoes. Everything tasted fresh and was cooked exactly to order. For dessert we had blackberry peach cobbler à la mode, fantastic! I highly recommend Punkys restaurant and grill; ask for Steven!

I love this place! For one, the customer service is amazing. Second, the food is fresh and delicious. I have tried most of the menu and haven't found a single thing I don't love. The rice bowls are particularly good and the tacos are generous and flavorful. If you haven't tried Soy, I'd absolutely recommend it. You won't regret it.

A little far out if your staying in the French Quarter but a great spot for crawfish. Extremely fresh, and priced very well. This little spot is located next to a fresh seafood market, just in case you decide to take the freshness back home.
I'm not a big bar-hop, but if I lived in NOLA, I would frequent this place. I rally liked the look and the drinks.

here's a hidden gem for you. super friendly, relaxed but excellent food (mostly). i have been for breakfast a few times, and throughly enjoyed it. went for lunch a few days ago, and while the Club sandwich was stellar, the BBQ shrimp po boy was really bland. both my friend and i were struck by how flavourless it was. added some siracha and it was fine, and really the rest of the place is so good, and they are soooo friendly, i'm totally willing to let this one slide and stick with the five stars.

dog friendly sidewalk seating too!

Experience the Hancock Club outstanding  all you can eat and drink buffet  while enjoying the 2nd best professional baseball team play (if you are lucky the Yankees will be in town and you will get a chance to watch the top two teams play). No matter what, you will have a great time at this air-conditioned stadium!

Eclipse used to be my favorite California style pizza place in town. But I've been very disappointed my last two visits-  the margherita was a particularly poor example of the classic, and leftovers got tossed. For the price, I expect the fresh, high quality ingredients and careful oven temperature management I remember from several yrs ago.
This SAMs is great. We smear at the one in Murfreesboro regularly and the food and atmosphere is very good. Same here. Server Kristin was awesome.
Food was good and tasty and reasonably priced but my god please clean your bathrooms!!!

Went one evening for dinner, the place was not very busy but we were not able to be waited on, we left.   Went another evening for cocktails, we're not able to be waited on, we left again! We will not be back or recommend.
This is one of those gems that I never regret eating or recommending to anyone. The food and drink specials never disappoint

The fish tacos were great! They were perfectly fried and crispy! The service was also great, especially our waitress Donna! Whether you are just taking a day trip to the beach or staying in the Tradewinds hotel, this is a great place for lunch or dinner!

Hosts/security guards suck.. Won't let you in with "baggy" black jeans on when there not even baggy. Been to numerous clubs around the world (Vegas, Miami, NYC, Hollywood,Tokyo, Dubai) no problem with my jeans. Looked empty for a Friday night won't be returning here to say the least

Our first and best stop as far as bars in New Orleans. This place will always be on my to do list when I visit. Unfortunately, we got there when the Sunday night band was wrapping up their set but the 2 songs we heard were amazing. Drinks were great as was the atmosphere. Very cool, chill and classy bar.

Unfortunately a sad disappointment for a Sunday brunch. First time here after hearing this was a great place to come to enjoy a Sunday morning. The option to sit outside, sounded amazing however, we were left neglected. Waiting for along time for drinks, (approx. a 1/2 hour) food and service. For the price, atmosphere and service was not worth the effort to plan a Sunday here. Let alone, when leaving the restaurant was bare inside. Not sure, with the excuse they were short staffed by the server, where everyone was during our dining experience, not even apologetic nor a manger to come to check on the experience. Next Sunday, will be dining and recommending other options for a Sunday brunch.

Not bad.  The burger I got was tasty, but kind of small.  Priced appropriately compared to places like 5 guys or Smashburger.  Patties were kind of small and I ordered a double, but again not overpriced in my opinion.  Food was tasty.  The biggest downside was the dining area.  Seemed a bit dirty and dingy.  A bit run down.  Plus, I was dining with flies.  Not great.  If we go again, it would be take away.  I prefer to pay a little more for a better burger at 5 Guys.

This is not a date spot or a place to go for a formal event. That being said, the food is great and the staff is friendly. If you're looking for atmosphere, stay away. But if you just want some great food and don't want to spend an outrageous amount of money, this place is perfect. Will definitely go back.

Stopped for lunch. Harry's did not disappoint.  They're "wings" are pork shanks. .. Tender, no fat, amazing. With some Victory Oktoberfest (great beers on tap).  Plus bartender and servers customer service excellent.   Trained well.  Definitely recommend

The three of us had a late lunch. Delicate, tasty eggs Benedict, could have been warmer, was enjoyed by Beverly. Alexander had a delicious personal crusty pizza with goat cheese and pesto with two slices to be brought home. I had perfectly woodfired asparagus with Parmesan cheese. One of our favorite restaurants.
I moved from Lenox Village to West End and these guys were amazing with my entire apartment in under two hours.

The hot pot scene in Edmonton has been bubbling up over the past few years with several restaurants opening up in succession but things seem to have finally settled down. The main players, 97 Hot Pot and Asian Express Hot Pot, are located in Chinatown with Chili Hot Pot just off of Whyte Ave. Okay, Asian Express has a second location south side if you want to get all technical on me. Rounding things out, there's Kings Noodle & Hot Pot, Bangkok Restaurant and BoBo Hot Pot Restaurant.

I'm not the biggest fan of hot pot (AYCE once every 6-9 months is more than enough for me) but a sweet Groupon deal ($70.00 for 4 people) couldn't be passed up. After holding onto the coupon for a couple of months, we finally made our way over to Urban Shabu to use it with the deadline fast approaching. Always seems to be the case when you buy one, eh?

Three bros and I arrived at 7:00pm on a Thursday evening. It was L's first time ever having hot pot so we eased him into the process. The inside is spacious and what I really liked about Urban Shabu (besides their hilariously random signage) was their ventilation system. Yes, you will smell like hot pot before/during/after your meal but that's a given. Regular price is $27.95/person for all you can eat dinner, $2.00 extra for specialty soup broths (chicken broth is free) and $3.00 if you want half/half. They have a solid lunch deal ($11.95), which I believe is similar to 97's deal. There's even a parking lot in the back aka. two ways to get into the restaurant.

We each ordered a different broth - I went with the HK style satay. Not too satay-ish but it was good enough. I wasn't in a super spicy mood so it worked for me. The sauce station is pretty standard while the ordering system is guess, wait and see, which always seems to be the case when you go for hot pot. Just order more the next round to compensate!

- Good stuff: lamb, beef, enoki mushrooms, bok choy, fried bean curd (try it if you've never had it before. It soaks up all the flavours in your broth.), lamb mash, quail eggs and noodles.

- Meh stuff: beef brisket (weird odd looking pieces, not what we were expecting), green onion and spring rolls (dry, luke warm. Skip out on the fried crap).

- Japanese style sesame balls, mango tapioca, soft tofu, vanilla ice cream and osmanthus jelly cake - we were stuffed silly but obviously, we ordered dessert. There's five different items to choose from and we decided to try them all. Ridiculous. Mango tapioca was probably the best but the osmanthus jelly and soft tofu were close runner ups. The ice cream was pretty standard although I found it a bit too artificial tasting while the Japanese balls were luke warm and glutinous.

Don't be afraid to try something new. There's a ton of items to choose from so you might as well make the most of it! For the most part, everything was pretty good except for the fried items that we ordered. Price wise, it's pretty standard AYCE fare. My advice: go during lunch. Your wallet and belly will both be happy campers.
Nice little place in Carp.  Great food. The chia seeds dessert is a bit pricey at $4.25 though.

I love lowes. Its supposed to be a home improvment store but they sell everything. This particular store is very clean. The aisles and the bathrooms are immaculate. 

They also sell water and gatorade and the prices are very reasonable.

When my girlfriend and I are in town we usually always make it a point to visit Pho 36. The staff is very friendly and is very knowledgable of their menu. The spring rolls are very fresh and delicious, and the pho is amazing as well.

My first review ever. I travel for business and honestly I get so sick of chains, etc. Sometimes I just go to the grocery store and dethaw some shrimp cocktail in the room and some raw sugar snap peas. I try many mom and pops but mostly get disappointed. This one was not disappointing. My wife is Lithuanian so I have a lot of this food at home. The Cerna which are stuffed cabbages was on par with my wife's which is a complement. At least on the night I went. Yes, it was microwaved to heat it up unless you are lucky enough to get there when a batch comes fresh out of the oven. We have to heat it up at home as well because you normally make big batches of it. I had the Cream of Asparagus soup and it was the best version I have had anywhere. The owner was nice. The location and decor are mediocre but I have been to many great locations that have fabulous decor only to be sorely disappointed. I thought the prices were extremely fair and to be honest really reasonable. My dinner was 14 bucks. Come on now. Oh, no alcohol, however it looks as if you can bring your own.

Some things were good, some so so. I went here last night for a Happy Hour with some girls from our Alumnae group. We pick different places every month. That being said I wasn't all that impressed with their happy hour. It was short and just not all that great. Their drinks however were good. My friend had the bubbles I think that's what it was called and it was good. I had the blackberry collins, also very good. Ok let's move to food. I bought the cheese plate....it was ok. I wish there were more accouterments to go with it. There was goat cheese, brie, and gouda or cheddar, salami, pepperoni, and Prosciutto. Good selection there, but it just came with olives and mustard. I prefer sweet with my cheese plates, but whatev. I tried most of what people got and this is the verdict:

Must Haves:
Zucchini Ribbons:really really fantastic, I was surprised by this.
Blue Cheese chips: so good
Pork Meatballs
French onion soup 

So So Items:
Mac and cheese
Wedge salad 

Didn't like at all:
Greek meatballs- I really wasn't a fan. Go for the pork-much better. 

All in all, I'll go back, but not my fave.
I love the kuchi for two deal!! Only $49! Ask for chef Andy he's funny and makes the best hibachi!

I am a ridiculously huge fan of taco bell, in the sense that I could eat it for lunch almost every day and then go back for dinner.  This particular taco bell is the worst i have ever, ever been to.    The wait times are just outragous, whether in store or in the drive-through.  I dont know if it is the staff, or lack of management, or both combined, but something definitely needs to be changed at this location.  I will say this is the first time in about the 50+ times i have been there that my order was completely correct.  But hell, it should have been considering i was there for 25 minutes or more.  I should not be able to go to a sit down restaurant and potentially get my food quicker than i would through this fast food joint.

Italian Affair has been around for a long time now. It was a favorite of my parents' when I was in high school and they've continued to visit together ever since. I couldn't remember the last time I tried it since I was never the biggest fan back then so I figured I'd go in with an open mind and see how they've evolved.

It's safe to say the space itself has not evolved. It looks exactly the same as it did years ago. But the food seemed to get better or perhaps my taste buds were just more refined..? I ordered a lasagna dish and it was pretty good, but my mom's bowtie something pasta (sorry I forget!) was the star of the table. It had spices and olive oil and it was just really nicely prepared all around. I ordered tiramisu to go, which was also a quality item.

In terms of Gloucester County's Italian restaurants, I'd say this is a good met for a nice meal. It's not outrageously good but it's satiating nonetheless.

As a non-vegan I knew it would not be my new favorite place but I was eager to give it a try as I always enjoy trying new places and I try to eat pretty healthy. 

I can't say I was disappointed but i also was not blown away.  
It was also pretty expensive. Which granted is expected in montecito.  But to serve chick pea "crab cakes" at a comparable to reall crab cakes is a little absurd. 
Everything was tasty though. 
I did order the crab cakes and I really like them! 
I had the lush bowl and tuna salad as well. 
The only thing I would not order again would be the potatoes with truffle.   Very very bland. Even after adding lots of salt they were not very flavorful. 
Great service! Our waitress was very delightful!  And the guy who was setting the tables around us was very friendly as well. 
The cocktails were good.  They are basically pressed juicery juices with alcohol. A little expensive for being so simple. The bartender was nice but not super talkative.- which I thought was a requirement for all bartenders to interact with the customers well.  
I would go back with my vegan roommate but probably won't take my sister when she comes to visit.

I recently went here on lunch break with a group of eight. The food and atmosphere were awesome but I'm docking stars due to service.

It took us about an hour and a half for lunch, which was pretty long considering we made reservations and the restaurant wasn't crowded. I will return but definitely not when I'm pushing for time.

We have gone here twice in about 15 months. The first time the food was less then favorable and the second time was today ( figured we would give them a second try-may they have gotten better) WOW was i wrong. We waiting about 15 mins to sit and there were tons of tables available... then when we were finally welcomed ten mins later..we were told our table was get cleared. After that we saw four people walk right in and get the table " which was being cleared for us" ... horrible service.. no organization and from the smell... the food hadn't gotten any better. So we went down the road to oaks cafe and a place, and the service...awesome makes you feel like a customer... would never go back to wildflowers again! Thumbs down.!!
..
Nice place to have a drink in a "quieter" section of Bourbon, if there's such a thing. I wish I had gotten the bartender's name and give him props. He was great!
Definitely cleaned up a lot. Anyway, great fast food burger. But this place has awesome staff. Just wanted to say that.  Keep it up.

Tonight was our first time here & it was excellent! The beer selection was amazing. Our server was great as well. My wife & I split the fried pickles, with the chipotle ranch dipping sauce, and a dozen wings, half 309 recipe & half extra hot. The wings were very good but I could have used a little extra sauce just because that is my preference. The fried pickles were very good but could have been a little more crispy. The chipotle dipping sauce was awesome. My wife & I then split the Belly Buster Burger special, 2 cheeseburger patties, a HUGE slice of pork roll, homemade Thousand Island Dressing & fries! It was awesome! It also came with fries on the side with homemade ketchup as well as homemade chipotle ketchup. Both were amazing. I love ketchup & usually don't like homemade ketchup but theirs was amazing! Can't wait to go back!!

One of the best pizza places I've been to - great thin crust and superb Chicago-style pizzas made with fresh ingredients and an interesting array of toppings and spices. I loved the Cherokee Street pizza with chorizo, goat cheese and spinach. I also enjoyed their Berkshire sausage pizza. It's hard to get a table on Friday and Saturday night so I'd suggest making reservations. But the food is truly worth the wait...
If you haven't tried this place you better get here before I eat it all... The corn is crazy good and you better bring an appetite if you get the stoner burrito... amazingly delicious
Excellent crab cakes and she-crab bisque. Very friendly staff. We look forward to becoming regulars.

My wife and I stopped by the past Sunday (Memorial Day Weekend). When my wife asked the server as to a possible available table? (larger young woman with black hair) she launched into a stern warning that we "better not sit at any table that hasn't been cleaned!" Taken back by this attitude by the server we complained to the bartender ( blond hair) about the server's behavior and she first placated us but then began to gossip about us to another woman helping her at the bar. We left without finishing our drinks. Oh, and the anemic jazz band was inaudible!

First time ordering here and it was really disappointing. My husband ordered a burrito and said that it was really good. It's a good thing he didn't ask for any changes because my food was a different story. I asked for nachos with beans on the side instead of on the nachos. The put beans all over the nachos and gave us beans on the side and no sour cream. I called to fix the issue and all the woman said was sorry. She didn't offer to fix it. So I asked if they could make it the way I wanted it. Took my order and then hung up on me mid sentence. when my husband got back with the order it was just the chips! No cheese, no sour cream. Just chips and pico. I didn't even bother trying to get it fixed I just ordered from somewhere else. Very frustrating and very disappointing.
Nice place inside, but food is way too pricey and service is slow! 1st and last time eating here! Thank you, but noooo thank you!!

Really good. The double char gives the right proportion of meat to bread. Better than the In-n-Out burger?  No, they're both good and I wouldn't want to give up either, but at The Habit you can get some pretty tasty onion rings instead of the sucky fries. Can't do that at In-n-Out.

I was worried moving to SB I wouldn't find a decent Thai restaurant but while we were up for a day visit looking for apartments came across the Mesa and this little Thai place and we've loved it ever since. The service can be shady sometimes, they're kinda all over the place and forgetful but whatever. The food is consistent and I'm a creature of habit to always order the same Thai dishes at different restaurants (its easier for me to gage whether or not I like the place). Its just too bad they don't deliver. I have yet to find a decent Chinese restaurant in SB but still searching...any suggestions?

If you are veggie, this is a Philly MUST! Had the cheesesteak and the Crispy HipCityRanch. The Ranch sandwich is a must. If you can only get one thing, get that. Very much like real chicken! Tons of fresh veggies. And the sauce is the bomb. Service is fast and friendly. They forgot about my boyfriend's shake, but apologized and gave us a free cupcake. Very good customer service - mistakes happen but doing nice things for customers more than makes up for it. Can't wait to visit again!

I loved this AYCE sushi place. LOVED. Past tense. I even hyped it to my friends. I brought my friend here to experience it. But the whole experience turned into a fiasco as I initially thought the staff were being rude. We had an issue of ordering too fast on the menu items. What will I do? I eat fast and lots as my body needs it. I brought my workout buddy and he eats good also. He is addicted to sushi and who got me started on eating it in the first place. I asked the staff to give me another ordering sheet but the staff outright refused. She said we need to finish all in plate before she even gives it.  She then points out the male cook as the one who said it and says he is the owner. His face looked really grumpy and my friends stopped me from saying anything as I was already beat red from anger. I didn't expect this kind of behavior from the owner of the business. At all. We all have bad days but taking it out on your customers, in a customer service oriented business, is a big no-no. I won't be back here.

This place is a bit overrated. While the service was great, I think you can find better sushi almost anywhere you go. I didn't dislike my yellowtail canopy roll....but I also wasn't impressed by it. The yellowtail canopy was finely chopped rather than the normal whole pieces of fish, which I worried was hiding bad quality fish. I ended up removing it and basically just eating a spicy salmon roll. We also had the sashimi sampler (meh) and the pork dumplings which were actually very good. 

I probably wouldn't come back if not for our very attentive waiter.

Ok I'm not gonna lie, this place really kinda freaked me out after staying for a couple of days. Let's start with the decor. What I learned is that it is the largest hotel in the country with no casino, so this place as you can imagine is immense, and very confusing. Although you get the lay of the land at some point, every different section of the hotel looks exactly the same. So although you may be in The Cascades lobby Vs. The Garden Conservatory it's all the exact same indoor "bio-dome" as we came to call it. At first I enjoyed the indoor/outdoor theme of the hotel. Waterfalls, koi ponds, rivers with boats....wait a boat? Yes that's right there is a boat tour around the "delta river." This was my first confused moment. This place is like Disney meets the MGM grand, meets a bio dome, meets a convention center. Real flowers and trees, fake rocks with music emanating from them. The indoor/outdoor thing started to become a little uncanny and I was happy they had two outdoor pools to choose from. The pool in Cascades I very much enjoyed, plenty of chairs to lounge all day and a big enough space to feel like you are in your own little world. Food and drink service available, and a hot tub, if the Nashville sun isn't heating you up enough. BUT let me tell you about the food in this place. If you are going to create a hotel where you intend me to never leave, please feed me well. Although we didn't try the steak house, which they say is the best, I tried almost everything else and it was near inedible. Solerio the Mexican restaurant gets a star, if that. Cascades, also gets one star if I must, i couldn't believe how rude one of the staff was one day, and the sushi place Wasabi's is passable, although I ate vegetarian. This place was an interesting place to stay, certainly stimulating, but it got a little old. And if you stay here make other arrangements for food, you will be upset at your empty wallet and stomach.

I must be missing something on this one.  The food was okay.  The service was okay.  The price was okay.  I can't say that that I didn't enjoy dining there but given the reviews I read on Yelp I was expecting so much more.

A couple friends and I stopped in at Marrakesh Express on our way out of town after a hockey tournament.  The place is bright and friendly with a great-looking menu.  Two of us had the Sahara sandwich and one of us had a spicy tuna pita.  The sandwiches were simply phenomenal - delicious, well-made, and filling without being heavy.  Totally hit the spot.  I didn't even feel regretful that we went here instead of grabbing a cheesesteak at Pat's.

The guy that ran the place was also super chill and friendly.  A native of Morocco, he moved to the USA as a teenager with nothing but $40.  Now he's married, owns a house, and owns the restaurant.  He obviously takes great pride in his business and the quality of the food.

A++++ meal, highly recommend, would eat again!

I want to make clear that my review is based only on the sandwich bar (deli) at Dorignac's. I went there based upon the 4.5 star review hoping for a great little sandwich place in the Metairie side of town. The grocery store looked pretty great, but the sandwich bar on a Saturday at lunchtime was abysmal, and the worst place I've paid money to eat since moving here several weeks ago. 

The service consisted of "What do you want?" followed by the staff contuing their conversation and offering no help at all. The turkey sandwich my wife bought was shaved lettice and tomato on a plain white hamburger bun. Hardly worth the $7 we paid. My "hot sausage po boy" was some kind of pressed mass of orange meat with more shredded "lettuce".  The only redeemable thing about the whole meal was the package of cole slaw that made it edible. If you're looking for a grocery store, definitely check it out; but if you're looking for a sandwich or a po boy, pass it by. It's an amateurish half-hearted attempt.

Been coming to 101 for over a year now and I've got to say it's one of the best/authentic Chinese/Taiwanese restaurants not only in Reno, but that I've had! Being in Hawaii I'm surrounded by real authentic Chinese/Taiwanese food and 101 Taiwanese is very flavorful and delicious! I've had the spicy basil chicken, chow fun, popcorn chicken box, chicken cutlet box, braised pork bowl, scallion pancake, fried tofu, braised pork and tofu bao buns, xia xiang mein, and more! Everything I order is always delicious and I can't wait to try more items! Their bubble drinks (boba) are so good and one of the best I've had. They have boba smoothies, slushies, and now tea! I would recommend this place to anyone who loves Chinese/Taiwanese food, and even those who have never tried it before!

Hearty, big sandwiches at a great price! Damn, am I glad a friend suggested this place for a casual bite to eat!! I haven't had a cheese steak in years and boy did this make my night. My only thing is that you request the roll to be toasted, depending on your toppings. I got a cheese steak hoagie with fried onions and mushrooms. Don't know what made it so soggy but my roll was drippy!! Excellent quality and taste. If you're in the area, give this place a try. Onion petals are good, also.

One of the best meals I've had in California. The build your own hash was delicious. Friendly and fast service. The best part was the meal which was delicious. Every part of the meal was awesome down to the side salad and toast. Highly recommend!!!

My boyfriend said to me, "Now when we get there, you can't do the voice--ok? I'm sure they hear it all the time." He's talking about the raspy Yat y'all have heard on the radio commercials; "I ain't ya momma, but you're always at home at Dots dinah." Yeah you right! Well I've never been and we had an excuse to go out to celebrate (because eating out IS a celebration no matter where you are IMO) so we grabbed a bite, eavesdropped on the family behind us, filled our bellies and observed another family also selecting Dots to celebrate Grandmas birthday! Who knew this was such a place for special occasions! I'd say overall, value was five stars as I've had two additional meals from my leftovers, service was four--hot coffee refills, constant checkups and intuitive service (when you communicate in sign language with the cook for a box across the dining room) and food was three stars. Grits were lumpy, gravy had skin on top, hash browns lacked color. Overall I'd go back for the atmosphere and value, plus ...it's fun to do the voice! ;)

What do we have here? Pottstown's finest.
I called for carryout. Asked for the tuesday deal named "Papas Play". The deal is valid tuesdays only and only if Monday night football total score adds up to 51 points..which it did. The girl who answered had not been trained in telephone ettiquite. Rude and yelling to a manager or another associate if they had heard of the deal. Both employees had no idea what I was talking about and she said "no we don't do that. Bye"
Click. Hung up. No suggesting another deal, no "can I get you anything else" just bye, click. So we spent 35 bucks at wawa.
This hotel is excellent! We've stayed at doubletree down the road but this place is much better. Mia my housekeeper was great at keeping my room clean. The cafe for breakfast was fast!

Wanted to try some local flavours and got inside this simple looking place, I was surprised! Food was very good, large dishes and good prices. Try the fried chicken livers!!!
The only disappointment is the cocktails... Not updated, too sweet and not interesting. Stick to the food.

Well I have to say that Frenchy's on the beach has always been my all time favorite but this most recent trip my kids and I will agree that Salty's gave them a run for their money!

Not only is the food awesome, the big, burly, bearded man at the front was always inviting as we were walking by or walking in. Great customer service! If I had to pick the best out of the two restaurants, it would be tough and not sure that I could.

Everything I've ever had from here has been excellent. I could each the nachos every day! They also have amazing desserts! The staff has always been friendly, the atmosphere pleasant, the meals excellent, and I have never felt rushed or had a meal take too long. They are BYOB, which is nice, too. I  was afraid to take my 1 year old to dinner, but it was not an issue. She loved the food, and the other customers were super friendly towards us. My only complaint is that they are sometimes really busy, and being a small place, they can't have space for everyone, but that's why you phone ahead or make reservations for common busy days or holidays. Overall, I love this place, and I can't wait to try their brunch now that they started it on Sundays!

I called AM PM Locksmith after my bike key broke in the lock. I was able to coordinate a time with Shay to come assess the situation and free my bike. We discussed options: 1.) dig broken key out and leave the bike until a replacement key arrived OR 2.) cut the lock. He said that even with the broken key removed the lock couldn't be picked so we decided to cut the lock and in a few short seconds my bike was free again.

He had all the tools needed to get the job done and at my convenience. I'd definitely recommend him to others and will keep the AM PM Locksmith number on hand for other key/lock needs.

Short: 

Good food, Good service, small parking lot.

Long:  

This place is smaller than the one located at Carrollwood, but is much closer for me.  The food here is just as good as the other.  This time I got a brisket sandwich.  It was cook perfectly, wasn't dry at all.  

The style is still the same as most BBQ places, cafeteria style.  You got up order the food, and they load up your tray.  The food is prepared and ready to go on their hot table, so it definitely a great place to grab some good food quick.  

All their sides are delicious, I haven't been disappointed yet by any of the sides I've gotten.  Its hard to choose what sides to get.  They even offer to let you get a sample of a side if you can't decide.  As for meat, I recommend trying the brisket, it is my favorite meat choice over there.

Pub and kitchen has well prepared, well presented food. 
The menu is small for entrees, more selection for appetisers. 
The server Nate whom waited on me, both times I have been there is friendly, engaging, and adds to experience. 
I had the soft shelled crabs which were the special last night and they were great. a little to peppery for my friend. my fiance had a homemade blueberry infused vodka, which she enjoyed. 
The only issue have with pub and kitchen is the price. 
the portions are small, and the price is large. 
so be warned, this is a Rittenhouse restaurant with Rittenhouse prices. 
don't let the pub in the name fool you, its not a place for a quick, inexpensive bite to eat. 
Also, I think if your special is going to be several dollars more then your highest menu item, you might want to mention it. 
Blueberry vodka , which was suggested was 16 a pop, which seemed a bit high too. 
overall nice place, just be aware of the size to price ratio...and don't go there starving.

my son and I went 11.12.16 and the food I ordered was not good at all. for the price it was even worse. ordered the sam dunk $10.99 and the rib tips (1) was very cold the chicken tenders(2) were okay but old so they were tough(flavor was good) and the steak fingers (4) were hard and nasty.(means how many in the basket) the fries were very salty you had to blow the salt off before eating them.

 I order the coleslaw which was very good. we also had ordered zucchini and it was very good too.  my son had the mushroom burger was delicious he said and actually looked good.

 I have never had such bad food from a famous sams. will not go back or recommend this famous sams

Meadows is amazing. Great food, happy friendly service and a great price. I frequently pick up food there later at night and even at 11pm they have smiles. I'm a vegetarian and they are always helpful with coming up with creative dinner ideas for me! Absolutely love this place! I seriously can not say enough about them. Tonight I went in a midnight to pick up dinner, the woman at the register was friendly and patient. I ponder over cheesecake and she was totally ok with me taking my time even though the closed in less then an hour at that point and I am sure she had other closing routine things to accomplish then waiting for me to choose dessert. She even went through the salad bar and made me a big salad to go with my dinner! 
And for families with special needs kids, they are great. I bring my friends autistic son there for dinner and they are so friendly with him, never asking us those questions that always make the parent (he's actually my ex's son) cringe. They never treat him differently because he won't make eye contact with them. They just nicely rub his head and smile and tell us how sweet he is. I don't know if anyone with a special needs kid will ever read this, but this dinner is great to try with them!

Great specials.  Food is a little pricey but always good. :). Unique tastes.  Veggie options are delicious but wish there was an extra spoonful of veggies! Always seems a little less than a full serving.  Plus veggies are cheaper than meat, so I never really understand why not fill it up with veggies?? :).
These guys are the best! They are consistently nice and fast. Great prices and honest mechanics.

Meh. Thats really all I have to say about this place. Food was OK, service was awful. The bartenders were more concerned about texting and laughing with their friends than bringing another drink. I will be back to see if maybe it was a fluke but at this point I doubt it.

Love this place! Second time here, but first time for brunch. WHAT A DEAL! Spent $16 on food for 2 people and HAD LEFTOVERS. Love the BYOT and got a pitcher of margaritas. I know dinner is a bit pricier but this is the perfect place for brunch with a bunch of friends looking for great food on a budget.

Great beach bar. Offers fantastic food. Rum Runners is the drink of choice for most patrons. The wings are to die for. Seating is comfortable and oversized. Firepit and two pools add to the atmosphere. Bag game available on site. Hammocks also there.

Every other bakery in town should probably be worried because The Cake Bake is going to take off. This place is absolutely precious. The best way to describe the store is that it looks like you stepped into a doll house decorated by Pottery Barn. The Cake Bake hasn't even opened yet which means everyone in Indy should start counting down the days until they do. 

The Cake Bake is a high-end bakery that specializes in anything sweet: cakes, cupcakes, cookies, pies, etc. They bake everything in their kitchen (which has a large glass window so you can peak in whenever you like) and the result is fresh desserts that are out of this world. In addition, they will be offering a wide variety of wine, champagne and coffee. 

I stopped into the store with a friend and got a sneak peak even though it is still closed (*let it be noted that I'm a college student who they by no means had a reason to impress). We walked in and were instantly greeted by the staff and given a quick tour. We were told that when they open they will offer private parties, wine tastings and in-store dining. They went out of their way to accommodate the two of us, even though they were busy with opening the store. 

I don't even know what I ate, but I do know that it was amazing. The best way to describe the dessert was that it was a layered cake with sheets of cookies on top of a chocolate mascarpone mousse. My friend got a red velvet cupcake that she said blew Flying Cupcake out of the water. We sat and ate at one of their tables in the front of their darling store. The dining area has benches lined with adorable pillows and granite café tables perfect for sitting and mingling for hours. 

Now I'm no expert, but in a time with many people trying to open their own stores and promptly closing them up, I think The Cake Bake will thrive. I urge anyone in the area to hurry in once they open because I have a feeling there will be lines out the door once every one hears about this precious and delicious new bakery.

Huge menu, great food, great service, good prices!  What more could you want. Loved the artichoke dip appetizer and fried raviolis. Loved the fillet mignon. Baked Chicken carbonara was good, and enough for 3 people. Even a decent array of wines by the glass. Yum!
Healthy and delicious! Order is ready quickly and they are always friendly. One of my favorite go-to lunch spots in South Tampa.
Brilliant! Stunning. Lovely. Best florist by far in town!

Just wandered into this place, nice setup & soothing music. Ordered the days special of Rib Eye steak with rubbed chilli sauce. It was just mind blowing :)
Even their chicken chowder soup was out of this world. A must try place. Cheers.

We purchased the month-of package and these ladies went above and beyond what was listed in their contract. They handled aspects of planning totally unrelated to the wedding planning (scheduling hair and makeup for my wedding GUESTS, and reserving the bridal party's mani/pedis for the rehearsal dinner). They even helped my mom with the bridal shower. To say they're valuable is a huge understatement. 

While basically nothing went according to plan during our wedding, it was still a huge success.  I think they finally got a taste of Iranian chaos, though, and are that much better prepared for their next Persian event. They truly made my life a million times easier, took so much off my plate, knew when to take the reins and let me focus on my day job, and got me in touch with the best vendors in my budget without any extra push from me. 

My husband could not have talked more highly of these ladies, which is saying a lot. Not only did he actually notice their skill, he actually recognized the competence and professionalism behind their work. 

And, the cherry on top comes from our experiencing the complete opposite with another company, which we dropped the month before our wedding. This was because we were simply too terrified of risking our last month of planning on the continued sub-par service that that company was providing (for their full planning package; to be fair, we got what we had paid for). But, having still had so many aspects unplanned 30 days before the big day, and firing the full-planning coordinator we'd had for months, we found Rae and Moore, and these ladies actually honored our bargain contract price with the other coordinator. Then, they worked above and beyond their contract for us. They deserve every cent of what they get. I'm honored to get to add anything to their portfolio.

This is now my favorite seafood restaurant in the city. We sat at the bar and had the pleasure of having 3 waiters. Chloe, our actual waitress, was amazing. So friendly and personable. Curtis and Dee, the most amazing oyster shuckers, were all amazing as well and awesome at what they do. The service they all provided was top notch. We ordered the chargrilled oysters, barbecue shrimp pasta and stuffed fish. All delicious. We will definitely return and we will be sitting at the bar.

I am a fan of Boston Market's food! We came to this place because my grandma suggested we go there. I got the half dark chicken and it came with 2 sides. The chicken was juicy and delicious and the sides were tasty as well. For one of my sides I got creamed spinach and you could tell it was a day old or so because of the way it clumped together. The mac n cheese there was amazing like always though. I really enjoyed my food, I just thought it could have been a little fresher and the service a little better. The people taking our order didnt really smile or seem to care about customer satisfaction. Good place, but nothing extraordinary.

Try this place once, they definitely have some items that you won't forget: like the roti canai, amazingly crunchy and warm, a little bit sweet and creamy, perfect! I love their satay skewers, and even though my husband is not that into those. However, their Hainan chicken and chicken broth rice is just off, I can tell not too much effort has been put into this dish. The cut of the chicken pieces is a mess and they probably marinated these just briefly. The chicken broth rice is not too much difference compared to regular rice, where is the heavenly chicken flavor? Go eat Hainan chicken in Hongkong or any Cantonese restaurants in China! Anyway, a rare and pretty authentic Malaysian restaurant here, a nice addition to the Chinatown.

This place is amazing.  They offer a lot.of alternative breads from flours like spelt flour.  They also have delicious pesto spinach buns. I also recommend the spelt flour buns, they are great for a healthier option sandwich or hamburger.

How cool!!! 

Went to Reno Art Bar last night as a gift for my birthday, with the Reno Diocese and I had no idea what to expect. 

They offer a glass of wine with every class and Napa next door sends a waitress over to bring more drinks or cocktails if you feel that one isn't enough. They even let me get a whiskey next door and bring it in with me! The cheese and deli tray was superb it's also offered with your glass of wine.

Class begins and they have one painting they will teach you and you look at and think " I can't ever do that!" But the instructor is kind and patient and shows you what you need to know. 

They tell me there are couples painting and mother days painting. I think would be a great gift for anyone looking for something different or someone hard to buy for.
Best Prime rib!! Everything is amazing here. Love the decor too!! Will definitely come back again.

Very engaging server (Brittany) and bartender (Fiona) who were both happy to accommodate me and my family and make delicious bartender's choice drinks. And the olives were amazing. Really cute de or as well!

Stopped in here on a Saturday for a few drinks and really enjoyed it.  

Ordered a bourbon flight - which came in a nice little bourbon tree! Went for the Colonial Iron Flight for $14 - Eagle Rare, Johnny Drum, and Jefferson Straight.  Very tasty!  

The lady had the Red Southern Wine Cooler - tasted very much like Sangira! 

Oh - and the live music of Nate Myers and the Aces was awesome - I'll definitely be coming back! The food looked fantastic too - looking forward to get back there to try the food!

If you're on a budget and looking for food, I would go to an authentic tacqueria or find a food truck somewhere.  This cantina has a gastro-pub meets tacqueria feel.  If you get their house-made pepper infused tequila in a margarita or other drink you might enjoy it.  The tequila has a spicy finish, which is very different.  Don't be too distracted by that "spicy rim" on the margarita glasses - they're just as good without it.  If you order food they'll offer a sampling of hot sauces.  I am hoping that they'll modify their menu a little bit - since a street taco is normally served on the street (and not out of an air conditioned kitchen).  I would give it 4-5 stars, were it not for the uncomfortable and very hipster intersection of overpriced food and small portioned food with artisan booze.  Noticed at the very end of the meal that there is a patio in the back - so it should be a nice place to go for margaritas this fall.  If all you want is a taco and a Margarita you can get away with spending $15.00.

Sooooo good! The food here is amazing!!! The service it top notch! Sit outside and enjoy the sun, or inside and enjoy the bar. Everything from the appetizers to the entrees are great! Don't fill up before you have dessert and be sure to try the cocktails!

I love dining at Giovanni's. It's such a good addition to the Ladue dining scene. My friends and I like to dine at the bar instead of the tables. The bartender Carmello is very professional and great at making suggestions of drinks and food. He has a good memory of what we drink which is unusual for today's world. The Ricotta and spinach stuffed salmon is out of this world as is the Butternut squash ravioli. The wine and cocktail prices are reasonable and well chosen.

Been here a few times. Second time I used them, my sweater came back with a hole in it. I chalked it up to just bad luck and didn't blame them. It was a delicate sweater. 

Next time I used them, they stored my clothes under the wrong name and number ( quite a hard thing to do since I had picking up clothes at the same time I dropped those off, and they already had my name up in their system). Tip: Never lose your green slip or you may never see your clothes again!!

When I got home,  I inspected my black and white formal dress. They ruined it. The white had grey stains all over it. When I brought it back to show them, the blamed it on "dirt that got inside the lining of the dress". Apparently, I rolled around in the dirt in my formal dress so much that it got trapped between layers of sewn together fabric. This "dirt" conveniently was invisible to the naked eye until it was dry-cleaned. 

When I asked to speak to the owner, they said to call ahead the next day to make sure he's in before I come. I told them that I would come at noon and to let the owner know that. The next day I call at 11:30 to remind them. They tell me that there's no need to talk to the owner. He confirmed that it was dirt inside the dress and has left. They can fix it but that it will be hard and expensive. How convenient. Ruin my dress and then up-charge me clean it again, all the whole complaining about how hard it will be to clean. Now that's customer service. 

Off to find a new dry-cleaner

I just adopted a long-haired terrier mix and knew she would be needing a grooming. I'd never had a dog groomed before (only owned short-haired dogs with no hair to groom), so I came to Yelp to find a good groomer in my area. I was able to make an appointment with their groomer and they fit me in pretty quickly. I told him to do "whatever he wanted" since I knew nothing about dog grooming. The grooming took a little over an hour and when I picked her up she had on a cute little bandana! She looked soooooo much better. She got a few treats while I browsed the shop's large selection of dog accessories, and the entire staff was great.

I will definitely be back next time she needs to be groomed!

I'm so disappointed. The GM of this location called me and wanted to make things better after my first review. She offered me a free order of whatever I wanted and promised they would do right by me. Pleased with this communication, I made an order a few weeks later, but when the delivery arrived, it was wrong (yet again). I got a regular 2-Liter Coke, instead of Diet Coke. The driver said he had a diet coke in the car, then I watched him drive away. I was not sure if he was coming back! About 15 minutes later, he showed up again with a diet coke for me. I have literally ordered from this location three times, and each time have been disappointed. 

My recommendation? Order from another Domino's location, or drive yourself there to pick it up. Their drivers struggle with accuracy and quality (quality meaning pizzas that have slid around in the box to the point of getting smooshed).

Gorgeous ocean view!  My favorite was the Deep Sea Red, mmm.... and I was quite surprised how much I enjoyed the Deep Sea Chardonnay that was 100% stainless steel aged (don't like the oak aged Chardonnays).  We enjoyed a super fun 2-hour tastings with Amelia who was very sweet and super friendly.  She invited us to join in the petals throwing make a wish at the end of the golden hour.  We'll be back for sure!  

PS: Wish the Deep Sea logo tasting glass was included in the tasting fee, would be a nice souvenir :-)

This is the type of business that I love to support.  Good food, good prices, and friendly service.  It doesn't get any better than that.

Tried the chicken curry (medium spice) and the lamb nihiri.  Both were full of explosive flavor, with just the perfect amount of heat.  The chicken and lamb were cooked perfectly; hot and juicy.

Served with a side of rice, and paired with an order of fresh garlic naan bread, this becomes a memorable meal that you are eager to have again in the future.

Very convenient to the loop.  Dine in or carry out... both options are highly recommended.

My driver Michael S was awesome!  I had a pickup on Fort Myers beach to southwest Florida International Airport on Jan 5.  Michael was 10 minutes early, courteous, polite, and was such a hoot to talk to!  He made me feel comfortable as I was traveling alone to meet my husband at the airport!  Thanks so much Michael - from Jim Cantore's "cousin", Amy Cantore lololol

As a local I can say by far they got the best of everything! Well seasoned and southern fried!! Seems like home when ya walk through the door! The red beans are the best I've ever had in my southern life!!!!

Cool spot! Reminds me of a BBQ joint in rural North Carolina. In the wood. Cold cabin without heat. Good brisket. Cold beer. If you can survive the freezing cold venue (in the winter), you should check it out. Oh, you might have to wait in line, but if you're not in a hurry, no worries.

I'm sure this place is good for drinks, but we made the mistake of going here for brunch when we saw the line at Pancake Pantry. The only thing worse than the slow, poor service was the food. I could cry thinking about the disappointment. Do not make the same mistake!
I worked with GoGo Booth at a wedding in September of 2014, where I was the photographer, and they were great! Very professional, and they got some GREAT photobooth pictures! I highly recommend them!

Great solid sushi spot. Got the sashimi and some rolls and was pleased. There seems to be a great bar and they also do Thai food. selection of specialty rolls was large and seemed pretty creative. I will have to try some out on my next visit. Also, there's a half off deal on some menu items due to their grand opening.

I really like this place. It's one of the best places to go with a group in Philly, I think. The food that they serve here is really so delicious.and it is all at a most ridiculously good price. I've been here twice - the first time they ran out of the naan-like bread (!!what!!) and the second time was thankfully perfect. Unfortunately, little did I realize that when you come to Marrakesh multiple times in a row, you get the exact same food each time. And for me, that is enough for me to not come back again. BUT, that should not deter you from coming to this place. If it's your first time, I'm so excited for you. But if it's your second time, hopefully you're here for a special event; otherwise I'd tell you to go somewhere else.

Really enjoyed this place. We all did the fixed menu, and it was a lot of food, but tasty. The fish and steaks were good, as were the sides. Waiter was knowledgeable, and attentive. Very enjoyable evening.

I visit here weekly and am normally pleased with the service and food but today I was not happy. 

My hard shell taco supremes had almost 0 cheese on them and barely any tomatoes.

Taco Bell needs to crack down on quality control. 

We'll see how they do next time.

Thid was the worst. Have been there before ( prob 2 years ago) thought it would be a nice  inexpensive meal. I love chicken rice and beans. First of all the man that took our order was rude. Should have been the first clue. Ordered the 1/4 chicken,rice and black beans. The rice was dry and hard as well as the chicken that was also dry and little meat, also had the ice tea. Sad to say the ice tea was the only good thing. Looked for a clean table but they all appeared to need a good cleaning. Neadless to say I will never go there again. Corporate should check out this store in Oldsmar and shake up the staff.

Stayed here for a night as part of my wedding extravaganza -- my partner and I needed a room for one night before we could move into a condo on the beach with a bunch of friends. We picked Hotel Isis because we wanted to support an independent hotel, and we had a positive experience overall.

The bed was SUPER comfy. I propped myself up with the 5 pillows (thank you for not being stingy with pillows!), made myself a cup of tea in the kitchenette, and read happily for hours. A+ bed, which is really all you need from a hotel.

Hotel Isis also has a truly beautiful courtyard and pool area in the center of the hotel. Other guests who stayed there for our wedding spent a lot of time hanging out by the pool, chatting, and relaxing. The hotel's beach access is also very pretty, and complete with hammocks for the ultimate in Florida lounging.

I had to lower my rating a bit because there were a few issues. First and foremost, the sound-proofing and light-proofing in the room were not great, and that is a problem. We could hear people rolling their luggage past our door, and it happened a lot because our room was near the front entrance. There were also no curtains for the windows, just wooden blinds, and there was a little glass panel in the door to our room that couldn't be covered. If you're a light sleeper, you might have trouble with this.

When I took a shower, the water took FOREVER to get hot. I had to leave it running for like 5 minutes before venturing in. But, once it warmed up, there was plenty of hot water.

Finally, the staff at the front desk are only in from 9 AM to 10 PM. We needed to check out first thing in the morning, and ended up having to wait for the staff to arrive. They will make arrangements if you talk to them ahead of time, so make sure to let them know if you need to check in or check out at off hours.

I would still stay here again if I got a good rate (we found a great deal on hotels.com), but if I had to pay full price, I might opt for a chain instead.

We happened upon this place late on a Friday night, we were hungry and tired of looking for a place to eat. This place was exactly what we needed. Not only could they make a perfect Black Manhattan, my husband had 3 and then asked for a few more cherries, the food was orgasmic. We started out with deep fried pickles and French fries fried in duck fat served with warm cheddar cheese. This was incredible, I just savored every bite. The pickle chunks were perfect, enough meat to still give a good crunch and perfectly seasoned before frying. Wonderful!! Then we had both the whiskey burger and the turkey dish/sandwich. The burger was cooked perfectly and the flavor of each layer complimented each one in a oral sensory overload. Yes, it was divine. The turkey dish was a little salty, maybe the bacon? Idk. I still inhaled it because the cheese sauce was incredible. I could have just sat there with a loaf of bread eating that sauce. Will I go there again? Yes, I will definitely go back there the next time I'm in town. Thank you so much for an absolutely perfect evening with my husband. It was what we both needed.
The best options when it comes to local Chai. Maybe a little pricey but a great atmosphere to enjoy a morning cup of coffee!
Delicious and innovative. Try the green blends and salads. Amazing and friendly. For vegan lovers and all the others. Taste so good.

One of the best new places I've tried in a while! My only complaint is the seating being tight but that just is what it is. The food (burgers and salads) are all super tasty. Loved the "sack of potatoes" this is the new fun cuisine safety harbor needs!

After a disastrous first experience (which I won't go into), I vowed to never return. This review, however, is a story of second chances. After my 2+ year boycott, I decided to try Burger Up again, and again, and again. Burger Up is now one of my favorite burger spots in Nashville. My, how far we've come.

My favorite thing on the menu is their bison burger, topped with rich white cheddar, cut by fried onions and jalapeños, romaine, tomato, and honey Dijon aioli. It's full of well-balanced flavor. Their hand cut fries are good, but their truffle fries are even better. Be sure to try their house ketchup and aioli.

To start, I recommend the fried pickle chips, pimento cheese plate, or fried oysters.

Looking for something lighter? The chopped kale salad rocks, and the Marathon (black bean and quinoa burger) is one of the better veggie patties I've had.

They offer a suitable beer selection and have, more recently, introduced a cocktail list with delicious seasonal offerings. The ambience is contemporary and cozy, with high ceilings, wood finishes, and plenty of natural light. Expect to wait for a table, especially at peak hours and on the weekends. Service is generally very good, intermittently scattered with space cadets.

This is wonderful facility for 24/ 7 emergency care but an often frustrating place for routine visits. They have misplaced or even lost my pet's records on several occasions and it is not possible for your animal to have an ongoing relationship with any of the vets because as a teaching hospital there are new and constantly changing interns and young vets assigned for each regular visit. And the teaching, supervising vets often go by a strict, textbook approach that does not seem to offer much in the way of basic intuition and common sense and it has been my experience that they usually recommend a bevy of tests and occasionally invasive procedures that may not always prove to be necessary of even helpful. And finally, you may inexplicably find yourself being rather capriciously grilled for ID by an employee at the front test who, while acknowledging that they recognize you as a steady and regular client for the past several years, may suddenly and mysteriously choose to view a routine, recurring pet food purchase with suspicion - even after several thousand dollars have been spent at this hospital for several surgical procedures, food, medicine, and regular visits without the slightest hint of a problem and after presenting a CC with a name that clearly matches up with the computer info. This final complaint is obviously not a big deal but in light of the other more compelling concerns I would have to sadly say that you would do well to go a regular private vet for anything but emergency care, a service I am happy to say the Ryan Veterinary Hospital clearly excels at.

The food was very good, I ordered this take away and it was ready on time and the order was correct and the food was tasty. I would go back there again next time I am in Tucson. I would also recommend this for anyone looking for quick food that tastes good.

Unfortunately I had a negative experience with Philly Circus. I went on their website and saw they offered private lessons, I thought this would be great for my daughter and her friend for a birthday treat. I contacted them through email on 11/17 got a quick response and tried to hash out details on scheduling the lesson and then crickets...

On 11/19 I received an email from them saying they would get back to me the following day with availability. The next day I hear nothing on 11/21 I send a follow up response thinking it may have slipped their mind(no big deal). I hear no response so then on 11/25 I send another general polite email saying just following up as my daughters birthday was getting closer, I hear nothing. In my mind I already started to cancel them out but figured maybe I needed to escalate this as the admin assistant didn't respond to me. So on 12/3 I call. The person who was supposed to email me back answers and I ask to speak to management she wants to know why so I politely tell her who I am and why I am calling and even went as far and said I was communicating through email with you and you didn't respond back blah blah blah - she offers no apology and I'm transferred to director of programming. I then give her the timeline of events and she doesn't seem that phased and checks the calendar and throws out some times for the lesson, the times didn't  coincide with the birthday girl's schedule of events for that day but who knows the time slots could have been filled up by others after the fact I inquired but who really knows considering my emails for whatever reason were ignored. She informed me the person who should have responded was out of the office dealing with personal matters and I told her that if her email is your first point of contact from web inquiries then someone should be monitoring it when she is out she apologized and stated they are a small company as an excuse. I informed her I have worked for small companies before and that is no excuse as the smaller the company the better for management and oversight. I politely informed her I couldn't mesh with those time frames and my experience was unfortunate as it jaded my perception of their company and it was a shame as this could have led into something more for my daughter. 

I'm a reasonable person and I get things come up and things happen but their response to my inquiry and complaint was bad as when I called I was polite and not irate meaning they could have still salvaged me as a customer but you could tell they just didn't care and as a woman who operates on principle I had to chalk it up and move on.

Their food is delicious but their service is lackluster especially when it comes to take out. I should know better to check my take out before I take it out the door. 

They've reconciled my order a few times but at this point, I'm just tired of calling them , explaining what I didn't get, bieng asked to go back for the completion of my order.  Examples:

a)  guacamole (after stating and being charged for it and not getting it)
b) dressing for my salads
c) didn't add meat to an order where I've added meat. (don't get any smart ideas)

Be consistent El Camino and maybe you can get the ranks of adding the Real.

UPDATE TO REVIEW BELOW: Muhammad (spelling?) was MORE than accommodating once we got in. As promised by Erin, we were granted front of line preference at 11. Actually, we were the first party inside. We had access to our preferred seating, and when a friend showed up much later than expected, Muhammad was willing to come outside and wait in the cold with me for over ten minutes until he arrived. The service improved substantially. Heads up to anyone reading this: Trilogy opens at 11 on Saturday nights! 

My friends and I arrived at approximately 10PM on a Saturday night, in accordance with Trilogy's posted opening time. Staff refused to let us in, and told us that they don't open until 11PM on Saturday nights. Why isn't this mentioned on the Groupon, or their website, or...anywhere?

The manager left much to be desired, and wasn't helpful. The DJ was kind enough to offer the first round on him. But seriously. Management could and SHOULD have done better. They didn't offer to accommodate us for the inconvenience for our party of nearly 15. Many party members left in disgust...Trilogy! Do better! Your ambiance is nice and folks love hookah. Improve your people skills and public relations, and perhaps you'll get better reviews!

Loved the crab cakes (suggest to put sauce on the side), the Étouffée was wonderful, and my server April was AWESOME!  Went in to eat before heading out to the airport at 11:30 a.m. and was seated and eating this awesome food by 11:42!
The BEST blintzes in South Jersey. One of the largest menus around. They have everything...breakfast, lunch and dinner. Been coming here for years.

Great spoke in Seminole Heights with some awesome beer options. Its a small place with access from the back lot, not the front! They don't want people stumbling out into the street after drinking. Its not a destination, its a stop along the way. So if you are bar hopping or visiting some shops in the area then definitely stop in here.

Very, very disappointing. I went here this past weekend for dinner and had a VERY mediocre meal. It was actually one of the worst meals I have had in the 6 years I've lived in Philly. Everything was very bland, like not even seasoned with salt and pepper bland. We ordered the grilled octopus appetizer which was very chewy and tasteless. The only dish that had any seasoning to it was the shrimp pil pil appetizer, which was tasty but nothing all that special. The entrees we ordered were all served with rice and escarole. Completely bland and unseasoned rice and escarole. My squid seemed fresh but had no seasoning at all. My dinner companions had similar complaints about the dishes they order (flounder, soft shell crab). Again, the fish seemed fresh but had no flavor or seasoning. I can't even say that the food was under-seasoned, it was just plain not seasoned.

I love this place so much!  Just wish we were still getting our free rooms.  I think the word got out how nice it is here.  Only the high rollers get comps anymore.  BTW the pool is AMAZING!  You can even hear the music underwater!

Had to come here on my vacation to Philly - huge Always Sunny fan!! I loved that there were pictures of 'the gang' around the bar!

I didn't eat any food here because they didn't really have any gluten free options, but they did have gluten free beer and gluten free cider, so we had some drinks. Cool place to hang out and watch a game.

As consistent as it gets!

I have eaten from Jones (in house and delivery) countless times and I have to say they are always very good.

I usually go with the Hummus and Pita and the Matzo Ball Soup, but decided to try the calamari salad, which I heard was very good.

Let me just say, it was way better than "good."  It was great. The server followed the instructions of no tentacles and that made it even better.  I hate wasting food and I despise the tentacles, so I was in heaven.

The dressing is out of this world and the calamari was lightly fried to perfection.  The little pieces of corn added a nice flavor as well.  

HHHHMMMMMMM...I think I know what I am having for dinner tonight!

My wife and I decide to try the new Friday's menu this week and was it awful.  I had the roasted marrow.  It was a mess, two large segments of bone one having a core that was smaller than my little finger with nothing to extract the marrow.  I finally got a small spoon but had to use the handle to dig out the grossly undercooked marrow.  The other piece of bone had a larger core but it too was undercooked.  I haven't had marrow before but my understanding is that it is supposed to slide out of the bone.  Not even close.  I had ordered escargot as an appetizer and they had a metallic taste with undercooked garlic in the butter.  My wife ordered the shrimp with grits and the shrimp (all four of them) were tasteless but the grits were terrific.  My dish came with a salad which was adequate but not tossed.  Anyway, I'll stick to breakfast which I have had before and is quite good.

Why am I being forced to use a service I do not like.Express Scripts has not gotten my prescription  correct yet.It also costs more than my pharmacy. Their customer  service reps are not knowledgeable. I feel as though I am being held hostage.Where is my right to choose? I liked being able to speak to the people at my pharmacy. They were always  there to help.No stars from me.

A great place to get ramen in Philadelphia.  I have tried a bunch of ramen places in NYC and this is on par with them.  Tried the standard miso ramen and the broth was extremely flavorful and delicious.  The base is the key to good ramen and this places knows there stuff.
