Four stars for a unique atmosphere!  Harry & Izzy's definately stands out from the dozens of ordinary bar & grill/steakhoues scattered all over Indy.  I hear it's fairly new to this city and they present a classy 1920's environment complete with Frank Sinatra playing in the background.  

Four stars for excellent service, our server was a hoot and very accommodating.  

Negative three stars for a limited menu when they advertise, "steak, seafood and pasta."  

Negative one star for the drunk old geezers shouting out,  "you're hot!" when you walk by.  

On a good note...the appetizers were got were delicious!  We were feeling ambitious and tried the Escargot.  We couldn't pass up the affordable chance to try this "delicacy."  We also had the red pepper meatballs and seared ahi tuna.  

The Harry & Izzy Cosmo is very good too!  It's made with Stoli Orange, yumm.

It was my first time and the guy behind the counter was very generous in offering a few samples of his favorites before ringing up our order. He offered quinoa as a replacement for the rice. And checked up on us if the food was okay. It was delicious!! We shared the half and half: drunken chicken, Cajun crawfish, beans and sausage, and gumbo. Hard to say which was my favorite they were all so different and we loved the spice. Try them all!

We were in town moving our son and decided to try it. After an exhausting day moving it hit the spot. It was fast, offered delayed take out for our company too tired to eat out. The food was fresh, hot, and great. The takeout even arrived still heated. Very family friendly. The staff was attentive and accommodating.

Enjoyable atmosphere, good music/musicians, & a super sweet waitress made this place enjoyable. I was really hoping I would love this place but the menu is limited and our food wasn't great. We got the fried pickles as an appetizer and the Nashville Hot Chicken & biscuit with Fries and tator-tots for dinner. The biscuit buns were great, I actually think I would've enjoyed them alone with butter and jelly more than I did on the sandwich. The chicken was hard to chew and not very spicy. The French fries were nothing to write home about but the tarot-tots were great! They're homemade and much better than the boring steak fries. The fried pickles were good, large portion so easy to share with a group of 5-6! Overall just an ok experience, I'd probably pick a different place next time to get the real honky-Tonk Nashville vibes.

I've been to Crazy Sushi quite a few times (most recently about a month ago with my SO), and I have to say that the quality has gone down. 

They specialize in novel rolls (hence the name), and while they might be good (I never get them so I can't say) as a sushi spot you have to do traditional rolls right as well. Unfortunately, crazy sushi does not do that. The fish isn't super fresh and the rice-fish-seaweed ratio is off. It's not worse than most other sushi spots in the city, but it's not better either.

Myself and a small group of friends ended up going here over the weekend actually by accident. We needed to find a place nearby where we were and the Underground Tap & Grill was the first sign we saw. Their menu was posted outside beside the door, which I appreciated because I like to know what I'm getting myself into!
We were seated right away, and the hostess, wait staff and manager (as I assumed he was) were all extremely nice. They clearly made an effort to be as friendly as possible which made the atmosphere of the place very enjoyable. 
All of us started with drinks - I ordered the Coconut White Russian which was stronger than anticipated but still very good! I just wish they had ounces on the list before I had ordered it!
We then ordered the nachos which were deceivingly smaller than they appeared, it was actually pretty comical and no one found it to be too big of a deal. It was a pretty generic bowl of nachos - nothing amazing , nothing bad - just your good old fashion kraft cheese nachos.
All of us ended up ordering the Bison Burger for our main meals. Some people asked for cheddar cheese instead of blue cheese which is probably what I should of done as I found the blue cheese a bit too overpowering on the burger. But honestly not horrible - just a little funky.

The highlight however ... and the sole reason I would come back ... is for those sweet potato fries.
Oh my.
You haven't lived until you've had those sweet potato fries. Those alone get a 100/10 - delicious!

My husband LOVES a good burger.  I could be a girl and get a salad and be "so full."   

We opened our wrappers after a quick moment at the register.  A little smaller than expected.  Then, Hubby bit into his 500 burger and said, "Oh, wow!"   I bit into mine and thought, this is just great.  I really liked the eggy, brioche bun (sign says they bake 2x's a day).   The grill guys are hand forming the burger balls while we eat.  Nothing frozen here.

The original Rouge burger is now something like $15 and you have to deal with the bizarre crowd who hangs there (It used to be $9 and a great deal).  So, I would definitely take the 500 burger any day.

So, where does this range: Mojo burger, Village Whiskey, In and Out, Ted's Montana, The Breslin....  Pretty high up there.

I really wanted this place to be fantastic.  

I took my boyfriend here while we were in town visiting my family.  I was hoping to show him a wonderful time and I had seen the menu and thought it should be really something.  

We went on a rainy afternoon for lunch and the place was empty.  Our waitress barely spoke to us and only came to take our order, bring the food, and bring the check.  

They were also out of my original choice which was very dissapointing.  I ended up with the vegetable lasagna which was indeed very good.  

The rest of our food was just ok though, so i doubt i'll head back here again.

Ah!  I love this place!  It's been a while, I really wanna go back! This is one of my favorite places to go, that is like chinese but you can do anything you want with your meal.  Get any veggies, noodles, meat, whatever!  Mix and match sauces and you also get soup and this awesome Naan-like bread.  The staff is always really nice.  I've never eaten in though, always taken it to go, but seriously, it's great!

What's more to say about this place then yassss. This is a little gem of a dive bar with movies outside, chiminea, pool tables, drink specials, great staff and the jukebox is the shit! Love this place.

I really liked the deep dish hot chicken pizza. The ranch is amazing. But the thin crust pizza is not good. The wait for food is ridiculous and carry out always seems to be cold. I gave this place a chance, but I am extremely underwhelmed.

Called on a Wednesday to schedule an appt. They asked if I would be waiting for the car, I said yes. They said it would be best to schedule on Friday as I would not have to wait as long. I came 15 min before my 9am appt. and 2 hours later they still have not gotten to the car. They estimate another 30 min to get to it and about an hour for the PA state inspection. I seem to recall this happening last time I was in for inspection so I should have known.

Good date spot, with solid sushi.  This past weekend I had a wonderful experience at Izumi.  The service was lovely, and the food was very good.  I am kind of a sushi snob, and I was overall impressed.  We ordered the Izumi Roll, Spider Roll, and Remy Roll, as well as a seaweed salad.  I went with someone who is not a big sushi eater, so we tried to select a variety of rolls.  The Remy Roll was by far my favorite.  The white fish was very fresh and tasty.  The other rolls were more standard with mostly cooked ingredients, but were delicious regardless. I loved the atmosphere.  We sat  outside and brought a couple of bottles.  The service was a little slow, but the staff was very nice and accommodating.  We were not in a rush and did not mind.  Overall, great dinner and I look forward to returning.

This is a wonderful collection of constantly changing books, used, rare, new . . .  refreshingly clean and well organized -- apparently there is keen attention to astute gleaning and a well-balanced inventory inflow/outflow.  
bring your own coffee, relax, peruse, read and buy, for surely you will find enticement . . . .
there are many activities as well for book lovers, poets and writers who are willing to come out of their own lofts.
French crepes, french service. Took forever to get our food while the wait staff noisily bused and washed dishes next to our table. Not worth the 2 hours or the headache.

WOW, what a deli!  I never expected to find an Italian market and deli on a nondescript street in St. Pete's.  This place has it all. friendly staff, great bakery, great deli, olive bar, wine and cheese room, patio eating area.  I haven't seen any Italian deli this big and well stocked in North Beach (San Francisco) or Little Italy (New York).  Oh, and by the way they have a coffee bar where they serve coffee that they roast!

This place sucks. And when I say sucks I mean BIG DONKEY BALLS sucks! I think that yelp owes me a start just for taking the time to write this. The bartenders think there doing me a favor by getting me a drink and "letting" me tip them. And they know nothing of the beer that there serving. Completely incompetent! Oh and the kitchen? Nuff said! People dont waste your time. I think Mac has some serious management/ownership issues. I guess with all that money you can afford to have a slezzy place!

It's always difficult to find and depend on good Chinese delivery that is consistent. And, I am very picky. I can say, every time I have ordered from here, it has been right on the spot. I am a Lo Mein fan and it always comes out right, and the specialty dishes are fabulous too! As for the delivery, it is extremely fast; I'd say between 20-30min (this is to south Tampa). What's great is, their drivers are usually the same, and are very complimentary that you ordered from Top China. Give this place a go.

Really nice coffee shop! Loved the place as soon as I walked in...

Their coffee was very nice, very balanced. They also have some pastries, though I didn't try those. 

The atmosphere is pretty chill, and the decor was nice and creative. 

There's also a cowork space adjoining the coffee shop.

I seriously would spend every paycheck to my name here if theyd slash their prices by 1/2.!! all aside they rock!. The staff here knows there stuff, ive asked every dim-witted mornonic question you can think of and they answered it with a smile, suggestion and even a demo for my clue-less responses. I learned EVERYTHING here, from what the heck is primer? to...tricks on my now signature berry lipstick (lasts 7 hours!!!!)
seriously GO HERE. they really can perfome magic for you.....see you there!!!

From Tortured Customer!!
We were looking to purchase a Certified used Toyota Camry. We were attracted to Conicelli from the Rave reviews posted on this Dealer at different websites. But our overall experience has been Painful, Pathetic and Distasteful to say the very least! The attitude of the salesman Matt was completely indifferent, arrogant, distrustful and unprofessional. We were given wrong quotes and subjected to painfully long wait times at the showroom  for repeated visits in a weeks time. Finally to our dismay the car we selected and had set a deal to purchase was sold out to someone else without even giving us a heads up! The sales managers were least interested in listening to our queries or complaints. We hope that no other customer in the future is subject to the torture & torment that we had the fate of going through by deciding to spend a week long ordeal with this dealer! We strongly recommend other customers to AVOID the hassle of dealing with this rotten behavior!

Here on a weekday isn't bad. Crowded but not to a point where it annoys you. I think the outside activities are cleaner and newer. I would like to give a special attention to the instructor at the flow rider. I been sitting here for a good 30 mins. He's been so great and patient with every single new rider he came across. Gives them enough information to give them the best experience possible and most importantly. He wasn't rushing them at all. Awesome job!! I have attached photo of him. I hope someone could give him some credit for the patient and great dedication he put into his work.

I love National but this location is a mess. Not enough vans so the wait at baggage claim is way too long. All other agencies have at least two vans circling every few minutes. Once on the bus it's obvious the drivers are miserable. Time to try Hertz or Budget I guess.

To be completely honest, their food is, in fact, very good. 
However, one of the male employees felt it necessary to harass me!!! I felt so uncomfortable. He continued to keep talking after I asked him to stop. 
Ladies: beware!!

My hair is thick, and I've just been impatient to grow it out. Therefore,  I needed a stylist that can work with short hair and have razor skills. Thankfully, I was matched up with Maria. I let her do her magic, and I love the way it looks and feels! Definitely has the edge that I was looking for. 

The salon is very cute and stylish, and the staff were really friendly. Since it was my first time, the cut was only $35. Niiiiice! Can't wait to go back, and see what Maria will do to my hair next!

I've attempted to use megabus twice.  The first time they cancelled the bus altogether due to bad weather.  That's fine except I only received notification of the cancellation after I had someone drive me to the stop in the storm.  And yes, I called them before we left an they said it was still running.  The second time, right now, the bus rolled up 30 mins. Late with zero apology or acknowledgement from the driver.  As we were waiting a woman told me that she waited THREE hours for this bus last week an when it finally came they made her but another ticket!

I took Greyhound Express without a problem once before so that's what I'm going back to for Indianapolis to Chicago trips.

Ps. Oh and it's in the mid 90's today an there was virtually no shade at the stop.  Can't wait for megabus to get sued for someone getting sunstroke.
Great pizza place! We had Samantha as our waitress and she was awesome! She was helpful in giving us suggestion on food. I highlyrecommend getting their deep dish pizza. All the speciality are good!

I recently started Muy Thai at combat fitness. I was a little nervous, but everyone who works and trains there are welcoming. Jesse for morning class is amazing. He's very patient and explains things thoroughly. The class flies by and its the best way I could start my morning! So fun.
Lots of awesome local artists and a great little outdoor art market. Def worth checking out.
Cool place. Flatbreads are great and they have nights you can buy bottles at retail and drink them there. Highly recommend.

Keep walking, there are better restaurants than this in every direction. Service was good or I would give it 2 stars. Preparation was poor, shrimp were over-cooked. Nobody at our table were impressed by anything. This is NOLA, and this was below average at best.

Ummmm say what you want about the Mexican food in St. Louis but Missouri can't do two things right, one being sushi and two being Mexican food. Mi Ranchito might be its saving grace though. When I want cheese smothered beans and an enchilada drowning in delicious hot sauce i walk the corner to Mi Ranchito. I highly recommend the fried chimichanga. I will not lie and mention that sometimes I crave it.....its that damn good!! The chips are greasy and gooooooooooooood in a good way. Don't count and eating healthy or clean here, but do expect going home with a very full and happy stomach. 

The food is on point and delicious and CHEAP. 
The service is quick and friendly. The line is out the door on the weekends and Friday evenings. My life is becoming more complete now that I have discovered this place.
I like starting off my day with a kona bowl. YOU HAVE TO TRY IT!!!! Also love the fresh ginger shots.

This place is a Santa Barbara whores paradise. This club has everything. Techno trash DJ's, Desperate housewives dancing on poles and picking up drinks with their snizz! Shots of botox, a fat mexican puking out front and frat guys that punch girls in the face! This is the premier club to go to in Santa Barbara if you are looking to catch syphilis.

Stopped by to get two pints of ice cream. Can't remember the flavors but was not disappointed. Took about 15 minutes to get in and out due it being packed, but can't complain. 

Visited in July 2016.
So surprised by the quality this food was delicious and so fresh. Not bad of a wait time either for delivery. So pleased.

Great locals place. Simple Creole food , as good as it gets. The buffet had gumbo, fried chicken, seafood pasta, fried fish, potato salad, salad bar and bread pudding for $15.99. 
I would definitely go back.

Hoo wee! I do love some Black Thorn pizza. Is it a pub/dive inside? Yes. Does it take forever for a carryout? Yes. Is it the best pizza in the city? Yes. I suggest you stop the fucking comparison to authentic whatever style, go inside, sit and relax at the bar with a beer, and talk to the folks around while you wait. It's not some crappy chain, so it takes time. Great robust, spicy sauce, lots of whole milk mozzarella, and fresh toppings. It tastes nothing like Domino's, as someone from Chicago reported. (Probably a Cubs fan, so you know their taste can't be relied upon.)

Amazing service and even better food.  Only been in New Orleans 3 days so far and we hit this spot twice,  And probably will hit it everyday until we leave. I have to try the rest of the deliciousness on the menu. "Don't come here if you on a diets" says the owner, he is so right.
I had the crispy hip city ranch and it was life changing.

Amazing urgent care!  Very friendly, professional, and  knowledgeable.  Sara and Lauren are the best team!!  My daughter had been to another urgent care and an ER and finally got the help she needed at this place.  We will never go anywhere else!  Thank you "hot tamales" team! Keep up the excellent work!

Lisa B

I LOVE this Boutique
Anything and everything you could want for your cute little fur baby 
Anything they don't have they can custom order size, color etc
Excellent customer service, warm welcome and all around great energy at the store 
I can feel my bank account emptying already!
But my little Martini will be the best dressed girl on the block 
Look no further this is your one stop shop doggy boutique 
I am so glad I found One Lucky Dog
Great job by Bridget! She did a great job and understood what I was asking for - long bob with some choppy layers. Thanks, Plume!

Yummy and delicious! I'm on a korean chicken wing kick these days, and the chili-garlic friend chicken was excellent. Not super spicy, but the chicken was moist and juicy - exactly as described. We also got the za'atar chicken, which was great. The crispy chicken kept better than the glazed chicken in case you're going to eat some later.

We went overboard on the donuts, but the pina colada donut (which I wouldn't have predicted I'd like) was incredible. It tastes like coconut and pineapple - nothing like the cloying sweetness of the drink. The smores and caramel banana donut were only okay (I was expecting a lot I guess), and the pistachio halwa was a bit too much but I should have predicted that given my dislike for halwa. If you like it I think this donut will knock your socks off. The standouts were the hot donuts. All three were super delicious. Its hard to dislike a hot donut, but even still - amazing.

The lobster roll has almost too much lobster. Delicious as was the lobster bisque and clam chowder. If you're looking for great seafood this is the place. Not the cleanest place I'd have to say, the open kitchen looks clean and staff are all friendly. Many regulars there when we were.

My brother and I were excited to try this place for the first time for lunch today.  Got there at 10:50 (open at 11:00) and no sign of anyone around.  Finally at 11:00, someone came rushing in the side door and opened the front door.  Was not impressed when entering.  Musty smelling and not very clean.  My brother and I both ordered the luncheon cannelloni and side salad.  Side salad was great.  Cannelloni was ok, but I've tasted better.  When they brought it out, it appeared to be steaming, but upon cutting it, it was just lukewarm and the noodles were a little undercooked.  They need to clean the place up before I go back.
Pretty good food, the salads my co-diners ordered were sort of swimming in dressing, but my salmon and veggies were very good. Interesting decor.

Had a great time at brunch here last Sunday. Great drinks, even better food. We had the pickle sampler, biscuits and gravy, eggs Benedict, and salmon. All delicious!Plus the service was excellent. Warm, friendly atmosphere. And easy to get a table. We'll definitely be coming back for more.

Mazzaro's is awesome! I think the only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because it's slightly disorganized for the amount of traffic it gets. But they have so much here to love! So many fresh deli treats- sandwiches, pastas, salads, sides. There is also a nice selection of Italian meals to take home and and heat up- lasagna, baked ziti, large pizzas. They have an amazing wine and cheese room with tastings- I just wish I was a little more of a connoisseur. They also have a nice craft beer selection, fresh coffee and gelato- like I said, there's a lot. I was probably there at the busiest time- noon on a Saturday. The deli and checkout lines didn't take long, there were just a ton of people to navigate through and we ended up leaving to enjoy our food because there were people everywhere and it was a hassle to try to work through the crowds and find a place to relax. This was fine since I wanted to get all my delicious treats home anyways. I will definitely be back!

Frankly, I don't understand how anyone has had a good experience at Heffe.  The staff was inattentive and unfriendly right off the bat.  That being said,  places can have bad service and still have good food, and we had been interested in stopping by the Fishtown location for some time, so we figured we'd give them a shot anyway.  I ordered the Almost Pastor tacos, my friend ordered the Fat Man burrito, and we got the poutine to share.  The tacos were bland and boring.  The pineapple was less than fresh, the pork was tough, and it seems they completely forgot any seasoning whatsoever.  I took a couple bites and just didn't feel like it was worth the calories, so I gave up.

The burrito was sizeable, so my friend suggested we just share that instead.  The burrito and poutine however, were completely the opposite.  There was plenty of flavor, and would be great if your preferred flavor is salt, and only salt.  The poutine was so salty that the other flavors didn't come through at all.  I think my blood pressure went up 20 points by the first bite.  The Fat Man burrito was just totally inedible.  Unless you happen to be a horse, or some other animal that enjoys a salt lick.  It was seriously gross.  After a couple bites, we actually decided to toss all the food and went next door to Stockyard to split a sandwich instead.  We didn't see the point in complaining since the staff was less than cordial from the beginning.   

I was hoping that maybe it was just an "off" night - it would be really cool to have a decent taco place in this neighborhood.  Unfortunately, based on the other negative reviews and how truly terrible our experience was, it's just not worth another try.  The tacos really do suck, and so did everything else about our experience.

Dear Yelpers, how do I love thee? Let me count the ways.

My hair was a long, stringy, uneven (because I tried to cut it myself, yo) mess. I went to different salons in St. Louis and was unimpressed every time--I don't want to be treated like I'm in a herd of cattle (*coughPhilipJohnsoncough*) or have my Salon Buzz killed by an overzealous stylist who wants to sell me everything she's pumping in my hair (*coughDZinecough*). 

Yelp to the rescue. I saw these amazing reviews for V Vegaz and knew right away that I had to make an appointment. From the time I walked through the door, I knew I had found my salon home.

The decor is dark, witty, and well-executed, girly without screaming 'girly'. Antique furniture plays off of teal and black walls, silver accessories, and glittery skulls. The music is eclectic, not too loud, just right--it really added to the experience.

My new Hair Savior is Jason, who didn't really say much, looked at my pictures, said "I can do that," and had me out of the chair with much less hair and looking great less than an hour later. He is silent and really meticulous, and it's great. Not only did he give me the style that I wanted, but he tailored it to my thin, fine hair. 

I finally found a great stylist in a comfortable place with good music and laid-back people! This is what I was looking for, and thanks to Yelp, it finally happened. Make an appointment NOW and put your hair in their very capable hands.

These guys are the best! I'm a grad student from IN living in CWE for grad school and the undercarriage of my car got damaged and loose on my drive over one day. These guys were fantastic! They cut off a piece that was loose and tied up the rest so that it wouldn't drag on the road. They understood that I was not interested in replacing the broken piece, and that I just wanted it secured for safety. They took care of it quickly and then didn't even charge me! They insisted that they could not charge me for simply cutting a piece of plastic and tying a few knots. Very cordial and respectful. Honest, reasonable. Absolutely the best in the business and they make you feel right at home. My new car shop in St. Louis for sure.

Expect a wait - line to get a seat was about an hour and then another 45 minutes to get our food. When we left, the line still started at the same spot. Worth the hype? I would say no. The food is okay, but the price is great for a brunch place. Got the Santa Fe Corn meal pancakes and it was good for the first few bites, but needed a change of flavor. Wouldn't recommend the hash browns, they were average.

I'm still on a high from attending last night's Game 5 where the Phils rallied and fended off a Yank "clinch." The crowd was AWESOME, the seats, even though in the 400 section, were good. The stadium looks great. Prices can be high, but I've seen higher at Nats Stadium and Fedex Field (DC area). I also like that it's relatively easy to get here (yeah, Broad Street line) or, as we lucked out, free shuttles provided by the MLB from nearby major hotels. 

One complaint, I wish they would display the speed of the pitches a bit more prominently.

I also loved the songs that would play when the Yankees would hold their tea parties on the mound. Those seemed to be plentiful when Burnett was at the plate. Lol.

Our company has been using Buddy Heilig & Sons for years and we have always been happy with the service we receive. 

They are knowledgeable, courteous and their prices are fair. 

This is a local family owned company.
Food was reaaaally good - but they waits forgot to bring me something to clean my hands when i ordered shrimps.... Thats a no go.... Especially for a place rated that high.

Our family always look forward to our night out at Crabby Bills on vacation.  It's one of the many reasons we book the same condo each year.  The food is excellent and what you would expect from a beach-town seafood place.  I had blackened fish and vegetables, and it was worthy of a white-tablecloth establishment's menu.  

We love sitting outside on the picnic tables.  With the kids it is great because they can move around a bit.  And the music is consistently great.  Lots of laughs and memories every time we go.  We all have Crabby Bill's T-shirts we have gotten through the years.  We all reminisce about our experience here.  

Go, when you can take a few minutes to eat.  If you go when it's busy, it can be hectic.  Remember this is a beach atmosphere and they don't move at the pace of McDonald's.  However, the food is great and we always have a good time.

I originally wanted to go to Table and received a gift card from my in-laws , but alas it's no longer open so I called home wine and they said they would be happy to honor the card.  My mother-in-law also called to make sure and they said yes.

So we went out tonight for dinner and did not enjoy the experience at all.  The food wasn't very flavorful and the portion size and ingredients were not justified by the price at all.   Three of us had the mushroom dish which consisted of a grit cake, sautéed mushrooms and spinach, maybe $5 worth of ingredients for $26!  My husband had the hash which was mostly potatoes and little  slivers of over cooked duck and chicken, again pushing $5 of food for $26.  The bread "course" was also a joke.  We were told it would be focaccia but instead we were given 6 small slices of grilled Italian bread.  It's pretty laughable  when it cost $6  and most places give much better bread courses for free.

We aren't diners  who shy away from nice places as long as we feel satisfied at the end of the night and  enjoyed flavorful food.   To top off the lackluster night, the manager told us they didn't have the capacity to read the plastic gift cards and could we come back in 3/6 months when they do?  By that time we knew we would never be back.  He eventually accepted the value my 80 year old mother-in-law swore was on there.  Really awkward!! 

Maplewood has much better restaurants than this.

Nice coffee shop on Central Ave. Plenty of communal working space and some smaller tables on the side. The coffee is ok, could be a bit stronger. The chocolate almond ball is a good treat to curb a craving, not too big or too sweet.
Awsome food very big portions they are in walking distance from my house.and servic is very friendly.The portions are awsome for a meal and something for later

food is meh. beer selection is average. like everyone says have a beer while you wait at monks

ps the bathroom has weird mc escher steps to nowhere

I was surprised at how good the Mandalay chicken was! I will definitely go back for more of that. They give you a huge heap of fried rice which is so-so. It didn't have much flavor and was a bit disappointing. Could eat the chicken all day and all night tho.

Great experience buying a used car through salesman, Kyle Wexler, and his manager, Dan Hill.  Professional, courteous, and accommodating.  They truly gave me a fair price for my trade-in and made the whole process a pleasure.  I feel confident in recommending these gentleman when you're in the market for a vehicle.

My boyfriend and I try new places around town every week and have been to a lot of great places but none quite like this. We Went in for a late lunch and the grilled cheese was absolutely amazing! My boy friend had the BLT which was also awesome. The fries were delicious as well! It's definitely our new favorite place!

It is pizza and they serve beer.  Nothing too special but can hit the spot.  It is chain which knocks it down in my opinion.  That being said I still eat it a couple times a year because will hit the spot.

Had Brunch a Sunday, very modern and great location for the south end. Made a reservation as I heard it gets really busy. Lots of parking. 

Heard in the summer they grow their own ingredients right beside their restaurant. 

The Just Ducky Omelette was good, a really large portion size. I definitely need to go back for dinner .

The chicken waffle that my friend wanted sold out. If you plan to try these go before 1:30 PM as we were told by the server as it's the most popular dish.

I like the mask I got and the service but the problem is I open up the new packaging and the mask had white scuffs on it. I paid 26$ for the mask so I expected it to be in new perfect condition. When I look at the packaging you can see someone just restapled it shut. Selling used stuff as new? That's messed up.
This place is great for any meal but my favorite is their breakfast! Super fast service and a sweet staff. The prices are great and the quanity will having you leaving with a doggie bag.
I think this is a great place for people who want "kind of Latin food." It's overpriced. It's pretentious. It's like that girl you met in college from the suburbs.
Felt so pampered getting a facial.My skin looked amazing after the facial.I upgraded my facial with a brightening serum.They have a variety of options to add on to any service.

I live close by and have always loved this place,  when I moved to the big city from a small town in B.C, I found the environment in this store to be particularly inviting and always felt at home there.  I love what Mike is doing in providing good food for good people, we need more people like him out there.  One cashier in particular Brandon is always meeting me with a warm welcome I always appreciated. 
Thanks for everything EGS.

Dear Anthropologie,

I would like to move in to your flagship store. It appears you have everything I might need: adorable clothes and shoes, comfortable and stylish bedding and furniture, and a soundtrack that makes me feel like I'm Zooey Deschanel.

Let me know when I can send over the moving van. My bags are packed.

Love,

Molly K

x
Great food great place. Staff is all way's courteous and polite and attentive to your order. Prices are fair won't brake the bank for a good wholesome meal!

I love Pet Pals.  I started at another, larger animal hospital on the north side but didn't feel my dogs were getting quality care, so I switched to Pet Pals.  Dr. Towle is wonderful, very knowledgable, listens to your concerns and addresses them, and really cares about her patients.  The staff are all so caring and friendly.  My dog has several chronic conditions and was hospitalized there for several days; the staff took such wonderful care of her.  Very happy we changed vets!

Should be 10 stars.  Good gas prices, great food, clean restroom, what's not to like.  I'm a big fan of their bowls.  All of f them.  I had the turkey bowl last Thanksgiving.  The seem to always have the newest chips and snacks.  I really like their ice tea.
The best Grouper Rueben! Great to be out by the water eating great food, having a cocktail listening to music and watching an amazing sunset. Relaxing and looking forward to going back to.

Update on the seating: there was this time I was here on an unexpectedly cold day in March, and the only place I could find to sit was outside. Since I hadn't properly prepared for the weather, I sat out there with my coffee and sandwich shivering, until I couldn't take it anymore and went inside and sat on the floor (yes it was that crowded). Luckily, a few minutes later, I saw somebody get up to leave and I rushed over to take their seat.

My previous review still stands though. I also like the selection of baked goods here (they once had this red velvet cake I was tempted to try), and sometime I'll have to try the lavender latte another reviewer mentioned.

And on the plus side, when it's a nice day, sitting outside is rather nice in the back area (not talking about the metal tables and chairs scattered haphazardly on the front lawn).

Walnut Hill is clearly a neighborhood I need to spend more time in.

I am having A Situation with my roommate, which has its benefits.  Namely, my friends are all throwing me a pity party, and J offered to take me out to lunch to this little cafe.  She promised me mind-blowing food.

I had never had Trini cuisine before, so I didn't know what to expect, but I was excited.  We bounced through the modest front, past the pastry cases and tried to order doubles.

What we quickly found out is that what food on the menu is available here varies a lot by time and day of the week.  Undaunted, we decided to wait a half hour for the rotis and ordered two vegetable pastries for 1.50$ each.  SCORE!  The dough was clearly baked in-house.  The vegetables were seasoned well and tasty, but I just can't get my mind off of that dough.

After finding out all my carnivore options had bones, I chickened out and ordered a soya roti.

Hold the phones.

This sandwich?, which is deceptively tiny, is served in aluminum wrapper.  You split it open, stare longingly at it and dive right in, probably burning your mouth in the process.  BUT DEAR GOD.  This roti was popping with chickpeas and soya, which had the taste and texture of meat.  The spices!  I have no idea what they were!  They were great!  AND AGAIN THE DOUGH.  It was so filling and wonderful and delicious.  Ask for the yellow goopy hot sauce, and use it sparingly -- it has a great flavor too, but it has a slow, long, loooong burn.

We met the chef (she plopped down in the booth behind us with a Coke) and chattered about her cooking process, and everyone was patient with our fumbling and my baby "wah wah bones" shtick.

By the way, I was STUFFED, STUUUUUUFFED, like couldn't move stuffed.

Dropped a star only because of restricting what fudz we could get, which I totally understand as a logistical thing, but these are my reviews, and I get to be arbitrary and unfair.  Also, the prices of drinks are a leeeetle high.
Great assortment of multicultural treats. Chocolate layer cake is moist and has the perfect balance of cake to icing. Homemade pretzels are a must! Butter cake is an old timers delight!
This was one of the best lunches I have ever had. I am vegan and a picky one and the food and service was excellent.
My God. We arrived at 6:17pm, ordered, and our food didn't show up until 7:36pm...cold.

OMG!  If you're ever in New Orleans you must stop here!  Delicious raspberry margarita for $5 during happy hour.  The steak tacos are outstanding as well as the pastor.  Phenomenal salsa.  The wait staff is beyond awesome.

I don't know how other people rated this Wendy's a 5 because it was horrible. We waited 30 minutes to be served and then another 30 to get our food. They were out of potatoes and overall just had horrible customer service. I understand that this is a fast food place and I am the kind of guy who gets that service at a place like this is always going to be mediocre but I cannot believe how slow they were. The bathrooms were also disguising

This place gets a 5-star simply for the no-kid rule after certain hours. There's nothing I hate worse than paying top dollar to see a movie, and having to listen to kids screaming, and mom just tuning them out. This no-kid rule remedies that. This place is a bit on the pricey side, but I honestly think it's worth it, because the food is amazing, you can get alcohol/buckets of beer, and the seats are so comfy that you can sink right into them! Also, you can pick your seats when you purchase your tickets

I love the Reuben sandwich.  The burgers are great as well.  Great place to go later in the evening have an appetizer and adult beverage.  The staff is always pleasant and efficient.  Big Smiles everywhere!!!  We try to stop there at least 2 times a month.

This truck never disappoints. The best grilled chicken and homemade falafel I've ever had. Don't question anything....just get what he gives you...he even makes the pasta from scratch. Get there early to avoid the long lines....Yum!

I've been going to this park for quite some time now and I have to say it is easily one of my favorite places to go. Its a clean, quiet and relaxing atmosphere.
There are so many things on can do at this park, too. Its great for a picnic, walk or a place to let your kids run around. 
Im fairly certain you can still rent paddle boats to go out in the water in the summer time as well. 

If you're a fan of walking along trails this is the place for you. The park is quite large and has many paths to go through. Just today I found one that led me directly behind a huge corn field, which I also took a little stroll through. Its amazingly fun to lose track of time and just enjoy the beautiful outdoors.

Brooks Falzone (my Service Consultant) at Crown Honda is awesome!  He responds whenever I send an e-mail trying to schedule my car maintenance (even late at night or when he is at a bucks game) and he has worked hard to keep me up to date on any warranty items. I really feel that he cares about my happiness with my car  & the Crown company.  Plus he is there to make sure the process is easy! It's hard to believe but going to have my car worked at Crown Honda is actually an awesome experience, I can connect to the wifi- Brooks keeps me informed on what is happening with my car and I am able to get work done, drink a coffee relax in the lounge and feel content that I am being taken care of. I highly recommend Brooks as a consultant and Crown Honda as the place to go for your Honda vehicle Repairs! 

Plus they even have a resident outside kitty that is sweet to pet.

Both the salon & spa services people overwhelmed me with their spirit & the love they show for their professions. From Emily, well did my nail services, to April who helped me since my haircut difficulties, to Loni (sp?) who did miracles squirrel on my face (facial), and even the receptionists in front represented a true team of caring individuals. My family lives in the area & now I know where to go when staying in Eagle!  

1/13/2018 Still super enjoying my haircut. Just going for a trim again. Over the last few months I recceived at least 7 complements on my skin! I purchased skin care products from them as well.  Note: I am 62 years old, so the skin complements are simply amazing. Just FYI

I am not a huge fan of "pub food" but Chatham Tap has enough variety in the menu that when I feel like eating something marginally healthy (about half the time), I actually have some real options to choose.  I literally eat at the Tap 3-4 times a week (its the place that everyone at my work can agree on) and I have never had a bad experience.  I am a huge soccer fan so I appreciate the fact that I can go someone in the city and actually watch the games "live".  Plus, it is funny to see the look on people's faces who walk in expecting a sports bar and can't believe that the place is filled with soccer fans (yes, they do exist in the United States and our numbers are growing).  I left my laptop bag here once as well on accident and the servers immediately put it behind the bar and secured it for me so I appreciate their genuine concern and attention to detail.  

When I am feeling unhealthy, I'll go with the burger or the reuben (light on the cheese).  On days where I am counting calories, I elect to go with either the hummus or the side salad so I don't have to engage in self-flagellation when I count my calories at the end of the day.  Really the only thing negative that I have to say about the whole place is that the owner through some misguided choice in life is apparently a Manchester United fan.  Since this is beyond my rational ability to process, I choose to engage instead in a healthy amount of denial when frequenting his establishment (the fact that he isn't obnoxious about it helps a lot too since he is apparently a better man than I).

Stayed nearby for work at a hotel for about 2 months. Time was limited and laundry facilities were nonexistent. I took my laundry here and they took great care of it and folded it beautifully. It's the only place I'll use while here for business.

This is a cute little place-- very reminiscent of the pizza parlor I used to visit as a kid.  They have a nice outdoor seating area that is very cozy, too.  Overall the food was OK.  Service was OK, too.  I asked for ranch and the server totally forgot about it.  They have some good deals with the Axxess card, so it's definitely worth a trip if you have that.  The leftover pizza tasted differently than any I had had before--it left a layer of fat on my tongue.
Best pizza on south side, also amazing ranch dressing. It truly has to be made in house . I love their salads. A little pricey but worth it.

I was really happy to find this place on Yelp and discover that it measured it up.  Christine is sweet as pie and really seems to be extremely knowledgeable about skin care.  I'd recommend it to others.

First, the good. The food was AMAZING. My first time eating from Albasha and everything that I tasted was fantastic. The quality and quantity was better that I expected. The Vegetarian platter is highly recommended and would be enough for two people. The gyro and the hummus was the best that I have had in the city yet. I am a die hard Mona's fan.
Now, the bad and the reason for losing a star.
Albasha just recently opened near my home. I was excited to say the least. I call on a Saturday night to check on the operating hours. I was informed that they close at 9 and stop taking to go orders at 9:30. I found this really odd for a new place, weekend night and an area filled with restaurants. Reluctantly, I placed an order to go. When I got to the restaurant, I notice that the signs say that they are open til 10 on the weekends. When I brought it up to the girl that I spoke to on the phone she informed me that they do not do much business after 9 so they close early(maybe because you tell everyone that you close at 9). Also, she informed me that they work all day and that they are tired. Nice to know. There were 6 of us that were wanting to go and try them out. When we found that we would have to get the food to go, the other four dropped out.
Please put your hours on your website. Its a nice site. I hate having to call a restaurant and bugging an employee with something so trivial. If it is going to be 9, please change your hours on your signs.
Also, why no Greek salad??

Ive eaten here many times and really enjoyed the food but they ust have changed hands or something  because the salads were soggy - took it back and the second one was absolutely no different...the chicken is really not the original chickenďl!...disappointed

I am originally from the Lehigh valley and had an amazing authentic taco place in Bethlehem called Aqu Es and it was rated #2 in the nation. Taqueria el Jalapeno is definitely the closest to Mexican authentic i have had here in the philly burbs since moving and it's a walk from my home in Bridgeport. Daily fresh juices and the lengua was superb!!! Highly recommend and they take credit cards!

Burger UP has a great burger.  I am a fan.  I east at most burger joints around Nashville and this is one of my Fave's.  The patty is very well seasoned.  The buns are light and fluffy and the Fry's are great.  Always hand cut and cooked perfectly.  I highly recommend you try this place.

Adventurous fair. Tasty Brussels with some lime and good but unknown spices. Also had the lamb and I don't necessarily like the flavor of lamb usually but this was a good choice! Kinda pricey though. Great service nice folks. Again kinda pricey for my taste.

Awesome time!! Our guide was fun and knowledgeable and the wineries were very nice. Great to not have to drive around and lunch was really good too. Sandwich pasta salad fruit brownie etc. Loved it would do it again!!
Thank you for opening your new restaurant in Tucson. Now I don't have to drive all the way to Scottsdale to eat your delicious food. Tasty food combined with good size portions and a fair price.

Breakfast service was very slow
Needed to ask for coffee cream, butter, & a fork
Power drinks were great! Eggs Benedict was good -- but not a 5.0 place

INCREDIBLE BURGERS!!! Go for the truffle fries, and ketchup which is made in house! Very friendly service, my girlfriend and I frequent this place. Very consistent experience. Try the lamb or black and bleu burger!

Local favorite. Cannot go back to Dunkin' Donuts any more! 
I like simple grazed donuts or cinnamon sugar.

Room service sent my order to another room.  I normally stay at the Westin when I am here for work and I think I will be going back next time. Dear Grand Hyatt- when you behave people traveling for work the least you could do is  deliver their dinner to the right room

When they first opened, I came here a couple of times for dinner. Initially, they were almost as good as Minado's (another big-name buffet) but recently, the selection and quality has downgraded a lot. Don't know who's in management now but it sure looks like they're trying to cut costs down and have become very Americanized with their menu. I'm pretty sure I can get fries at McDonald's. Why bother having sushi buffet in their name if the Americanized foods outnumbers the sushi they offer? Was looking forward towards some beef short rib and seafood soup and of course an ample variety of sushi - but those are no longer offered. Me and my group arrived about 3 hours before closing time on a Thursday night while it was still sort of packed (we had to park in the back). However, it appeared that they stopped making sushi around that time, leaving only a couple plain pieces on the serving plates. I'm sure the 10 cooks they got behind the island could've replenished that. The price has went down slightly but the selection went down greatly. 

PROS:
Very attentive and sharp-looking waiters.
Good ambience, interior design.
Nice hostess.
Nice bathroom.

CONS:
Limited sushi selection. No premium rolls.
A lot of offerings are Americanized or fried everything.
No green tea ice cream or yogurt.
Dishes are not replenished fast enough when empty. 

My suggestion: GO TO MINADO'S to get your money's worth. 

Until then, I would not be returning until I hear that this place has improved.

Absolutely, charming place stuck right in the middle of east and westbound route 4 in Stanton. Passed the place a million times over the years but this morning, I was hungry, and the packed parking lot intrigued me. I'm glad I did.
Everything looked great. Not just the pork chop and egg special with a side of grilled cornbread I had, but also everything I saw pass by me on the way to other tables. The pork chop was grilled and seasoned well. My entree was huge, and even with the side of cornbread and coffee, my bill was still only a little bit over 11 bucks.... This place is definitely worth trying

My friend came from SIUE to visit me so i decided that we will check it out . The food was good, I always order the same regular gyro, I like the presentation of the food, it has a little spice to it but not much. I saw the same guy all the time I went there and he is a nice guy. I will be going back here whenever my  cravings for gyro kicks in, thats about all I will try there. Overall it is a nice place to go.

An excellent restaurant if you want to experience a full dining evening.  The hostess was friendly and kicked off a good evening with her attention to detail.  Our waiter was a bit young but knowledgeable about the food.  While the menu was small, all options were excellent.  This would be a great restaurant for an adventurous eater but not for the picky.  Save room for dessert.

This place has some great texmex food! It's usually a bit crowded during dinner, so I try to go during off hours. The staff is friendly, and the food is delish. Last time I was there I had their seasonal fish burritos. It was super tasty, even if the fish was fried. They have an extensive drink menu as well, if you're looking to just have a drink. I definitely recommend the blood orange mojito.

Since the boyfriend and I haven't been here before, we drove by a few times before assuming where the place was.  My suggestion is to look for the colorful Spice End sign right next door.  However, if you use Google Maps (and can see the teeny tiny sign on the awkward right that reads "1 Tippling Place"), you should be able to find it without a problem.

We went here last Friday around 9pm, so there was quite a lot of people, but not enough for it to seem claustrophobic-like.  Place was cute and atmosphere was dimly nostalgic.  Coworkers, boyfriend, and I sat all the way in the back booth and chairs, so we got a good spot.  But somehow, the chair I sat in was slumped inward -- so hope nobody sits in that chair!

What we ordered:

- Meatballs
- Charcuterie Plate
- Crab Cakes (which the server forgot about)
- Grilled Cheese (coworkers ordered two of them, but we didn't try them)

The meatballs were plenty since we were able to share it among my coworkers.  The meatballs were a decent mix of sweet and tangy, but strangely reminded me of a somewhat better version of IKEA's Swedish meatballs.  Charcuterie plate was not bad, but the pate was a bit overwhelming because of its chunky, meatloaf-y consistency (I prefer the spreadable pates).  Prosciutto and two types of pork salami were good.  Definitely ask for more toast points if you decide to order the charcuterie plate because there weren't many to begin with.  Oh, and the wonderful crab cakes that our waitress forgot about... the boyfriend really wanted to try them because it was a Friday special, but I guess we'll have to wait until next time for that.

Drink-wise, I got the Lavender.  I forgot what was in it, but it was ah-mazing!  Very small amount though, might I add, but maybe that's just me.  I inhaled it within minutes (tehehe).  The boyfriend got the pinot noir and that was just okay.

Back to our server forgetting our crab cakes -- she was pretty much in, what seemed to me, a very rushed and 'blah' mood.  Towards the end, she was nowhere to be found and the bartender had to come over and see what else we wanted.  But even he gave off the same vibe, in my opinion.  

I'm not sure if the huge crowd and short of staff working that night had anything to do with the lackluster service, but I will definitely be back again to try other drinks (or get more of the Lavender~) and other hors d'oeuvre!

Absolutely the worst hair cut I have ever seen on a Maltese dog. The staff is friendly, they were kind enough to get his haircut done quickly as I didn't know they would close at 1pm on a Monday when the drop off time was 10am. However, it's like a 5 year old cut his hair, chopped all over, bald spots over his body, they didn't clip his nails, they burned his belly with the clippers and he wasn't even all the way dry when I picked him up. I have been trying to contact the owner since the minute I left to get a refund (I made the payment before I saw him) and she doesn't return my calls. DO NOT GO THERE!
Go for the Caruso's sauce!  And maybe the cheese ravioli, delicious!  Great service!

Savory and soft brisket, great BBQ pork ribs. Good Chinese cuisine, duck and shrimp dishes. Very attentive staff and quick response time. Good selection of savory and sweet dishes, dessert was good with a gelato and other standard desserts (apple pie, cheese cake, etc). All you can eat for $29/person.
Do not bring a large group here! They do not have the staff to handle it. Had to leave with MANY unserved & unhappy students

My job orders from them all the time so I knew when my mom came to visit I needed to take her there. This was the first hibachi spot my wife and I visited when we came to Tampa and it doesn't compare to Kobe or the other hibachi food chains.
Fast and cheap(ish) lunch option in the CBD for Mexican food. Staff is friendly and menu is big.

I ordered a Shrimp Cauli Bowl via uber eats. My order came quickly within a reasonable period of time. My food was cold, I'm thinking it's the clear plastic clamshell container used, it doesn't keep the heat in. Not a big deal for me. My total without the uber eats surcharge was $19.90. For close to $20 I would expect more than a container with 80% brown rice, some diced cauliflower, 6 florets if broccoli (literally, I counted), 3 paper thin slices of carrot and 8 measly shrimp. It did taste good but it is waaayy overpriced for what you get. I will give it another shot on a day when I can actually go in, in person but initial reaction is not that SoFresh is not SoImpressive

Extremely disappointed by my stay here. For the first time ever, I've had something taken from my room (a belt) and I've learned a valuable lesson.; no one cares when items go missing from a guest's room. I won't be back. I've stayed in a lot of places all over the world and this is the first time anything has ever gone missing.

Great space, building and staff.  Go there for the coffee and large tea options, but I wouldn't go there for the pastries.  Damn, tried muffins, scones, cookies and anything that might help feed a morning hangover/hunger....all kind of sucked.  Wanted to give a 2.5.  But, it's a coffee shop.

This is always a favorite with our family, whether driving or grabbing hot chocolate and bundling the kiddos up and walking thru...the lights & houses are always fun and festive. 

Something our family looks forward to every year!
Wine - great! But the food.... Not so much. Really lacking flavor. I ordered the shrimp scampi and it was very bland, no flavor at all. Service was good.

Food tastes great and the service is good. Our waitress was very attentive and the manager also came by to talk to us. They even did some cool square dance that I wanted to join in on but I didn't want to embarrass my wife..again. 
We get to eat peanuts and throw the shells on the floor (the kids love this). Try the cheese fries with bacon..

I stopped there for lunch and had the Gumbo YaYa. It was very good, but not the best I've ever had.  Like others have said, the place has a lot of old-school charm.  The waiters are prompt, well-dressed, and give a sense of genuine pride in the establishment.  

I was honored to have been seated at the Ronald Reagan table, where there is a commemorative plaque acknowledging the Gipper's two visits between 1989 and 1990.  I understand that there's also a designated Bill Clinton table, which I would personally avoid.  That said, Mr. B's is the choice of Presidents in New Orleans, and I was certainly happy with my experience.
Deff not the best steak . At all . Blue rare not what I ordered . Gross  sent back and nothing changed .

Actual service received was adequate, the atmosphere in which it was provided was not. 
While sitting on a glorifed bar stool for 30 minutes of brow shaping (via tweezing) only two feet away from the receptionist desk, I was distracted by less than hushed social and work conflcit discussions from the receptionist & staff members. 
Regardless of the service all guests should be granted the privacy, relaxation, and comfort they deserve. The spa requests no cell phone use to preserve the "tranquil, relaxing atmosphere", practice what you preach.

All I can say is that this place is awesome and comfy.  It is a neighborhood and community-wide meeting place.  So many activities available! And of course good coffee, great bran muffins, homemade chai and usually some creative vegan snacks.  Robert and Elizabeth take care of this place like we are their children. Thanks!
A true St. Petersburg gem. One of maybe two places in all of St. Pete where you actually feel miles and miles from civilization. This park is amazing through and through.
Great old school italian food! The veal cap and mussels red are a must. If you have not been to Ralphs you are missing out .

This is the very worst!!!! With our order, we picked to have fries as our side. They just handed our food with no side.... we said we ordered fries as our side. She looked at us like we had 3 heads and said well we have none made. So we said is there anything else and she said yeah it won't be an extra charge. Really????? So we ordered mash potatoes and she hand us a tiny Dixie cup size. I will never ever recommend this place to anyone!

Good food. The portions are much larger than what we were told so we ended up leaving a ton of food. The salt cooked if more like fried but in salt?  Don't know how to describe it. It's good but you need to eat it hot. The dumplings were ok. Kinda greasy. I think you need to know what you want because the wait staff, while I think really trying to be helpful, wasn't as much as I would have hoped.

Found a good Peruvian spot while here in Reno...say what!!  Yes, RENO!

Service was friendly. Our waiter was very nice and even gave us his suggestions. Overall, our foodie experience was great! We will definitely come back to El Tumi whenever we visit.

Chips and Salsa were served. The chips were really crunchy. 
My boyfriend wanted to order the Seco but they ran out!! :/ Oh Well, next time. He ended up getting the daily lunch special, which was the Aji de Gallina (chicken in a garlicky cream sauce) - he loved it.  It came with a chicken noodle soup, which some might think is a little salty but still good. I had the Lomo Saltado and it was very tasty!

We have stayed here several times.  First, the positive.  This place is absolutely GORGEOUS!!!   It feels like Hawaii!  I can't say enough good things about how beautiful it is inside.  The plants, waterfalls and natural light are just amazing.  The reason I am giving it only two stars is because of the service and COST.  Our room was not ready at check-in (after waiting over half an hour in line).  Since we arrived before 4:00 we had to come back to get the room key which required waiting another half an hour in the "key pick up" line.  Lots of waiting.  Lots of lines.  They charge you extras for EVERYTHING!  ...parking..resort fees etc.  The room isn't cheap to begin with but then you add on all these extra fees and taxes.  Be prepared that you will pay a lot more than the quoted room rate when you are booking (which is not cheap either!).  On our most recent visit, when we finally got to our room we brought in the bags that we were carrying and then made a quick trip to the car to get our luggage.  When we got back to the room (15 minutes later - max!) someone from housekeeping had been in and for some reason completely stripped the beds!  It was so strange!  When we originally got to our room it was obviously clean, beds made, so I have no idea why they would have done this.  It took over half an hour for someone to respond to our call.  Then after housekeeping did arrive they took another half hour to bring sheets and make the beds.  All this after all the waiting to check in!  Bottom line, this place is stunning but know what you're getting into in terms of cost.  I just like everything to be upfront and I feel like when there are all these hidden fees, it feels slightly deceptive to me or something.  For our family of four, two nights cost us just under $1,000 with all the charges and some meals.   Despite the 2 star review I probably would stay here again because I just love how beautiful the inside is and we love Nashville!

I stopped in here with my toddler for a quick lunch before a trip to the movie theatre. I was impressed with the service and simple menu. It can be nervous taking a young one out to lunch by yourself. You can tell very quickly when young ones aren't necessarily welcome. The atmosphere was very nice and warm. They offered my little guy a bowl of rice and I got to ordering my noodles. The ramen was alright. I've been spoiled with with some kick a** ramen. The broth here was a little lack luster and I really wished their eggs were soaked in soy. But, I'm not giving up on this little joint! I will surely be back.

The pancakes were amazing! They melt in your mouth! We will be going back their again! Since they are so busy, be prepared to not see your waitress quickly! 

We waited in the long line for about 30 minutes which shows how quickly they get people in and out of there. Note about parking, it is free but you have to get a parking ticket for you car first then you get an 1 1/2 hours free. If you don't get that parking receipt, plan on getting a $15 ticket.
Ordered late at night. Very welcome and great staff. Delicious pizza and wings and will definitely return  and recommend, any time of day

The bar overall is nice. Nice facade, very large interior, and a big patio. 

They have a solid beer selection, and all of their drinks are reasonably priced ($3 bud light pints, $4 wells) and the bartenders are personable. 

The food selection is fantastic and the prices are cheap considering what is offered. 

They have a bunch of games all around the bar including really nice soft and steel tip dart boards and a pool table. 

The pool table unfortunately is the only drawback to this bar. There is only one table and it's in shoddy condition and it costs $10/hour. 

Aside from the pool price/table condition this bar is a 5-star. If they were to replace the table with a coin-operated version it would be. That being said, I would have gladly paid a slightly higher price for the drinks or the food at least and had free pool.

After searching the web, yelp and groupon for laser hair removal I finally found this clinic. The staff including Dr. Steele is very friendly and the service was great. I went in for my first treatment today so I'll have to wait and see what the results will bare but I am pretty happy with the treatment and the price. Great price and professional service. Can't beat that.
Food was amazing but the service is kinda slow! They are under staffed, so just go in knowing that. I would definitely go back, when I am in town.

This is my second time here, I will say the food is worth the price. I got the lunch special which is about $2-3 less than the regular price. I got the gomoku ramen which has a shio base soup. The soup is not too salty, the noodles are cooked right, it isn't especially chewy (not a fan of chewy noodles). I also had my friends chicken katsu. The chicken is juicy but it was quite oily. Good thing the oil looks fresh. I took a good look at the menu. They have a variety of food, not just ramen. Th ey have rice and udon too. The ambience is nice, I came after lunch so it is quiet. It is clean and spacey. You can bring strollers here if you have children. I will come back again.

Great atmosphere that pays total homage to Tampa! Mostly local vendors in a sundry setting that has something to offer for everyone.  Clean and fresh with energetic employees. Great new Tampa addition

Great service and amazing staff and obviously delicious food ! It was my first time going to this restaurant and I am so pleased with it. When you walk in you are greeted with a happy hello and I just loved it and such sweet girls to help you out with any questions you have. The chef is amazing as well with her and her husband as a team it just makes it even more amazing. The food was INCREDIBLE I had my entire family so we ordered a lot ... I ordered the roast beef Marsala 5 Stars my boyfriend ordered the traditional Cuban and the devil crab and my two sisters ordered the shrimp basket and the fish sandwich. And let me tell you it was amazing I am so happy and I will be a coming back very soon !

Way overpriced fifteen bucks for a little burger used to give you coleslaw but no more the quantity of the food went down within the past year no more going back there. Fries were cold and food took foreeeeeeever to come.
One of the few chains I visit quite often. Always enjoy the lo mein and the steamed veggie dumplins. I have had a few desserts, and been satisfied with all of them.

Do you have two legs? Do you have a liver? Excite all your body parts in one location.  Run by a sexy pixie of a woman, this bar features delicious one of a kind cocktails made by expert bar mixtresses. 

Get the shrimp and goat cheese pizza, along with a spiked cider slathered with alcoholic whipped cream.  You will go into a flavor coma. 

Nice patio area with a big cast iron stove to keep your tush warm in the winter months. 

NOM!

After a long day of sightseeing, shopping and people watching, we searched for food. The hawker outside convinced our group that THIS restaurant had the same food as "the expensive guys nearby" but THIS was better and cheaper. We were tired, so we let ourselves be convinced. THIS was the only disappointment in a 3 day stay. I truly don't get the positive Yelp reviews unless the reviewers were tipsy or just don't look for great food. Hilary was our server and started out ok. Menu was pretty standard bar food and Hilary was pleasant enough. Problems began quickly. First diner ordered a burger with mozzarella and Hilary stated there was no mozzarella. We gave her grief for being out of the first thing we ordered...she said it was not a matter of being out of mozzarella, but that the restaurant didn't offer mozzarella. We showed it to her on the menu. She said it was just wrong and they'd never offered mozzarella. Ok, a little weird, but the diner took it in stride and ordered a mushroom burger instead. Hilary was quick to say they were out of mushrooms. First diner is less than thrilled at this point so another diner gave an order so first diner could regroup and re-examine the menu. Second diner ordered a Hang-Over burger. Wait for it....they were out of eggs. What we should have done was get up and leave at this point, but we were tired - too tired to look for a new place. Eventually all five of us ordered something we thought we could live with, but I don't think any one of us was able to order exactly what we wanted because Port St. Peter was out of a LOT of things...on a Friday night???   I can say that the portions were huge and the food wasn't bad, but I've much, much, MUCH better food elsewhere. We finished our meals leaving a lot of food on the table because of the portion size, and asked for our checks. OMG, you would think we'd asked Hilary to paint the Sistine chapel in 15 minutes using only her toes. It took three staff members a total of 22 minutes for the check to be split two ways. Please eat here if you're feeding hungry teenage football players - - portion size would be about right. Otherwise, go elsewhere.

New to the area, I listen to what friends and coworkers recommend so off we went to check out a local favorite for dinner.  We'd been there once before for lunch and decided we wanted to check it out at night.

The only challenge that evening was trying to find parking, which, coming from NYC, I find more challenging in Philly than in the Big Apple, but we were lucky enough to finally get a spot right in front of the restaurant.

We were greeted and sat immediately by a friendly staff member.  We ordered our margaritas and appetizers and checked out the menu.  While the patrons kept pouring in.  

Mexican and Texas BBQ are divided, we all went with the Mexican fare and ordered Carnitas Tacos, Seared Ahi Tuna Tacos and Shrimp Tacos.

All the tacos are served Mexican 'street style' on small tortillas, so those expecting the bell style, forget it.  

The Carnitas (pork) were succulent and with a squeeze of lime, very tasty and perfectly accompanied by cilantro and raw onions.

The shrimp and seared ahi tuna tacos were also a big hit, although a white fish would be more welcome on fish tacos as the fleshy tuna just doesn't quite cut it for this dish.  With the lime juice and accompanying condiments it's just not as complimentary as say a sea bass or even codfish.

The ambiance is great.  Casual diners and locals gathering for conversation and some bar games during the reverse happy hour packs the place, but our service was friendly and attentive.

Looking forward to the weather warming up again so we can sit outside and people-watch while dining at this very hipster locale.

I ordered the 3 meats and 2 sides combo and it was one of the best bbq places I have been to!!! There was so much food, that it's hard for two people to eat it. The ribs were so tender that they slide off the bones. The meat was smoked to perfection. The yellow rices was so delicious. My boyfriend ordered a corona that was so cold it was almost a slushy. It's Must go!! The service was patience with us too!

This place has everything but good pastries. 

Patisserie is a cute warm cafe that serves overpriced stale pastries. 

We bought an almond croissant, a brownie and a cup of coffee for $10. 

The almond croissant was stale and had barely any almond paste in it, or rather it had a little on the outside and no paste inside. It was not flaky either. 

The brownie was the right texture of moist brownie but tasted 4 days old and of the refrigerator. 

The coffee is watery, but some people like it that way. 

I get that it's quaint and it's local. But they really should offer FRESH pastries. 

Gross.

I hate to say it because Nashville was on my bucket list but this place shattered my visions of a perfect trip even after an amazing show at the Grand Ole Opry. Our waitress said all of two words to us, never checked on us after she delivered our food and I had to ask the manager for a refill on my glass of water. When she finally did she brought 2 of the 3 of us water but never brought me a glass (and I was the one who ordered Nashville hot chicken). The food was average. The live musician was good but it was really loud and we couldn't hear ourselves talking (and we were pretty far from the stage).

I was told that Port of Call was THE place to go for the best burger in NOLA, but I truly believe the only people saying that are the people that haven't eaten at District! My boyfriend ordered the double cheeseburger, and I ordered the Croque Madame per the recommendation of Mike, the awesome guy working that took our order! Without being overly dramatic, I'm pretty sure their double cheeseburger is, hands down, the juiciest burger I've ever had the pleasure of tasting (my boyfriend let me have a bite) in my entire life! The Croque Madam is equally delicious, as they use a griddled donut (no glaze) as the bun, so you get this decadent sweet/salty combination! The donut does a fabulous job soaking up the melted Havarti cheese and runny yolk from the sunnyside up egg they top the sandwich with...yum! Writing this review makes me want to go back for a second round of deliciousness!! The only thing I wish they would add as a permanent menu item is the double cheeseburger atop a griddled donut bun...that sweet/salty combination would absolutely take the cake! You could easily think, "A donut store with burgers??? Riiiight!" and continue walking by because donuts and burgers together doesn't make a whole lot of sense, but DO YOURSELF A FAVOR! Put this place on the top of your list to try in NOLA!! Oh, and the donuts are good too ;) please bring District to KC!!!

We walked out of Copperfsh caused they had wanted to seat us at this rotten table they have, so we found ourselves in SOHO on a Saturday evening at 7:00 without dinner reservations. Fired up the Open Table app and scored a table right away even though the area was jammed with people.

We got seated immediately. Ordered the Chef's Selection of House Cured Meats and a Margherita Pizza. Very shortly the Cured Meats and cheese showed. Very tasty. We were enjoying that and much to our surprise the pizza arrived. Place was jammed and the service was incredible! 

In short, service was great, prices reasonable, and the food was good.

My boyfriend and I went on both the city tour and a swamp tour. In both cases the guides were informative and entertaining. The swamp tour was excellent if you are interested in seeing a wide variety of wildlife. The only issue we had with this company is that they accidentally put us on a large boat (22 people) when we had already paid for a small boat (8 people) tour. We still greatly enjoyed the experience, and when we got back, they knew exactly who we were and were quick to refund the price difference in cash. I would highly recommend this tour group.

This is a solid reliable taco and steak place which also has Sonoran style hot dogs. They have a nice fixings bar with all the guacamole you like salsas excetera. I find the quality is good the meats are well done and chopped properly. The tortillas are a fairly good quality not the best but good and they have states which are good but for the money. It's a bustling place about medium in price but I have always found them to be very reliable and very consistent.
The prices here were okay. I filled up the rental car here before returning it at the nearby airport.

Wahoo's is always the tits. Surfy atmosphere, friendly staff, inexpensive food. Don't be turned off by the somewhat gimmicky decorations, still one of my favorites for fish tacos (at all locations, not just SB). Hits the spot just right after a surf session or a general day at the beach. Or simply just got the munchies and not too much cash.

Not that I would do this to myself, but some people like this sort of thing: 
$1 pitcher of Natty Light on Mondays!

Tons of drink specials and happy hour for hookah!  They even had a promo where you guess the special blend and get $5 off.  I would tell you what it is, but the guy would probably hurt me.  

Very cool set up and décor.  I am definitely visiting them again the next time I am in Reno.

If you are looking for good Mexican food, this is not the place for you.  I ordered the chicken enchiladas and it was not good.  It appeared that they pre cooked the meat, threw it into corn tortillas, wrapped it poorly, poured sauce over it, and then placed it in the microwave to heat it up.  My mom ordered chicken quesadillas and the chicken was cold.  The only thing I liked about my meal was the side of corn cake.  The corn cake was delicious; however, I would not come back here.

Only the best southern comfort brunch food you can find. I'm so lucky to live just a few blocks away. The eggs dauphine is nothing short of amazing. Laid back service from locals who make you feel right at home. Plus they carry French Truck coffee. Definitely give this a place a try for brunch!

Randomly popped into this place while roaming around channelside! It's a tiny place but very fun to hangout. They play good music nice and loud and have pool tables and dart boards. But the drinks are the best part! They have tasty drinks :)

This café certainly is cozy. Great ambiance! Perfect for a quick pastry or have coffee with friends. You can choose to sit at a table, at the bar or in the nice couches area. 

They offer a great selection of coffee. I had a latté and it was delicious. However I went there at 9am and had to realize on the spot that this is not a breakfast café. They do offer a choice of 2 breakfast sandwiches but it was very disappointing: small, tasteless and soggy. Makes me wonder why they bother serving that. It gives the wrong idea of their potential. 

Still I really enjoy the place and will definitely come back and try more.
This was some of the best steak that I have ever had.  The margaritas were very good.  We had the corn side, and

It was busy this time but considering this is like my tenth time here, I've come to have very low expectations. There is a honda dealership near by and coffee isn't so great. Worth walking to Dunkin for coffee. However if you order anything but coffee be aware. I often get the wrong items, wrong quantity or even don't get things. Today was particularly bad. It's Mother's Day and it seems they have been stockpiling the items because the muffins were sooooo dry. As in they crumbled just getting the wrapper off the bottom. It was like eating croutons that were muffin flavor. Very dissatisfied. Coffee was good as always so whatever. Good stinks but coffee is close to where I drop of car so most likely I'll be back. Something better than nothing.
