I was surprised a bit by the prices, yet I naively figured that it must mean the food is made with extra care. My husband ordered a burger and I ordered the roasted chicken. The burger, based on my husband's review, was delicious. My chicken, on the other hand, was a disaster. At first glance the chicken looked huge, so seeing some burned sections didn't bother me as much, that was until I noticed that what wasn't burned was pure bone. The couple of bites I took of it ended up being extremely dry and had no other flavor except for burnt. I mainly ate the mashed potatoes, which was also a disappointment, and considered the $22+ we spent on my meal alone, as a lost. Maybe I was unfortunate and the chef simply got distracted, yet for their meal prices I expected so much more. In regards to the service, like I mentioned, we got greeted and seated quickly. The only negative thing I saw was that some of the employees who I think had just ended their shift were sitting in the bar talking with the staff that was still on the clock and they complaint throughout our entire meal about their work and other guests. I didn't find it appropriate to be talking badly about previous guests while current ones were eating their dinner just 10 feet away.
Came here 7/2, @6pm, got seated, got drinks, got served, got dinner, all good, no problems as with other reviews.Good meal, good service, good time. Good night and good bye!

I booked a two night stay here.  I had emergency and needed to leave! I booked through a 3rd party website. I called the 3rd party and explained everything they were willing to give me my money back but Samantha the general manager at the hotel wouldn't approve it. She was extremely cold hearted, rude, and was extremely unprofessional about things! She didn't care about my emergency and didn't want to help. She keep saying it's the 3rd party decision and when it was all up to her. I would never recommend this place. I lost over $100 on this trip. On top of it all people were getting locked out of their room and they requested a later check out time!

we stopped here Friday night for something different.  they have  very very good, inexpensive seafood.  Everything is cooked to order.  I had the Maryland crab cakes, and they were Delicious.  the Calamari app was not what i was expecting however is wasn't bad.  I will definitely go back.

The worst fried chicken I've ever had. The nastiest/saltiest mac and cheese I've ever had. I almost vomited after eating my food. I will never visit this place again. I'll stick to home cooked or Sweetie Pies.

I am an ex-server for olive garden. It is one of my favorite restaurants and I drove over half an hour to eat there with two of my friends on Thursday may 31st. Our servers were Tracey and mikayla, whose was training, and I was extremely disappointed in the service that we recieved.
I'd like to highlight first the some service that met the outstanding expectations that I know olive garden expects.
When we arrived we were seated right away and our server in training introduced herself fairly quickly. We were given adequate time to look at the menu and make our selections. Our first round of salad and bread sticks, along with our appetizer very quickly. After this though the whole atmosphere and attitude seemed to change.
Our tray of breadsticks and salad stood empty for almost 20 minutes after that initial  round. One of the reasons I love olive garden is because of the refills on salad, soup, and breadsticks. While we waited on someone to recognize that we needed refills, a tray of dirty dishes sat out in the dining room for approximately 30 minutes across from our table. Our main courses came out before our second round of salad and breadsticks and when I recieved my entree the sauce in the ravioli de portabellas that I had ordered congealed and the entree was cold. I flagged down a server as no one had asked us how are meal was. Although my meal was replaced with no question, it came out after both of my friends were finished eating and had recieved to-go boxes, so I was eating my meal alone. After we were all done eating, everything was boxed up, and dishes were cleared we then waited over another 15 minutes for my dessert to-go and our check. Finally when we did receive our check it was the wrong one. Thankfully I was planning on paying with a credit card so I didn't just leave money on the table and walk out. 
Again I am very disappointed in the service I recieved tonight. The problem with our service is that there was no direction from the server that was training the new employee. Tracey seemed to be more worried about a large party that was sitting behind us but made a point to mention in passing that mikayla better do good tonight because she was making her money. Now I understand the basis behind why trainees give their tips to their trainer, as I went through the training myself, but tracy was not guiding her, checking on the table or shadowing her anyway. I feel like mikayla was sent out to the wolves with no food.

Yat's is an incredible restaurant, filled with a cool, kinda weird New Orleans vibe, jazz music, pictures, and cajun memorabilia. The food is great, too. I love the Chill-Cheese Etouffee the best, as well as the Maque Choux. It's all good though! 
The owner is a great guy, who loves his restaurant and loves his patrons.
They were very helpful (and successful) to get me to quit cigarette smoking! Guys were knowledgeable and friendly! I would go back again definitely!

I visited the Café Fleur De Lis several years ago.  Alone in New Orleans, wandering the streets in the early morning hours, I chose the restaurant because it was cute, and having lived in Louisville, KY, the Fleur De Lis name seemed like a bit of home.  It was a great decision!  Despite the amount of time that has passed, I've never forgotten the Fleur de Lis omelet; it was so good.  I'd jump at the chance to visit NOLA, again, just to be able to return to the café for breakfast.

My love for Harry and Izzy's has no limits!!!!! If you want a wonderful dinner and experience this is a great place to dine. I love the fact that I am able to make reservations and have a table available immediately. I also love the variety in the menu, because when you go to more upscale places you don't see that often a variety in the menu. The service is always amazing and they also have a great dessert menu. I would recommend Harry and Izzy's if you want a date night or a night out with your family or if you have out of town guest visiting. They don't disappoint!!!!!!!

My husband first noticed the wood floors. The restaurant has a great atmosphere. Our waiter, Charlie, could not have been any better!  He was awesome!  He noticed my husband looking at the beer list so Charlie explained it was happy hour (7 days a week, 3-6 PM) and told us about the $5 appetizers and drink specials.   Then he proceeded to tell us about the menu and how the tri-tip and rotisserie chicken was prepared. He made it all sound so great it was hard to choose. My husband got the chicken and tri-tip combo and I got  salmon risotto.  After trying the tri-tip and chicken we both agreed they were just as good as Charlie described: tender and moist prime rib and juicy chicken with crispy skin. Yum!!  The generous portion of risotto was surrounded by roasted veggies and topped with a very moist portion of salmon.  Their menu had my husband's favorite dessert--mud pie. So we had to splurge. The coffee ice cream was marbled with fudge and nuts.  Enough for us to share.  Our waiter was accommodating to a small change to a side dish and taught us a few things about the beer choices on their menu.  Great place, tasty food and excellent service.! Will definitely recommend it to my friends!
Food is overpriced and the menu online is not the same as the menu in the cafe.  The food is the same but the prices are vastly different.  False advertising. Not impressed.

The spice level is just right, numbing with heat, the Szechuan classics are correct, the West Philly location is lively with a full bar, and great prices. So why only 3 stars? Because each time I eat here, the happy post-meal glow is followed by the symptoms of MSG overdose. Headache, dry mouth, drowsiness, etc. Please, Han Dynasty, stop using or at least cut down on the MSG so I can love you without regrets!!!

No major complaints about the service, the ambiance, the view. I doubt I'll be suggesting anyone go out of their way to come here though. My NY strip was requested MR and came out the MW side of M. That is pretty much unacceptable in my book considering that I don't often go out looking to pay for steak.. and this is a steakhouse.

On a more positive note, the creme brulee was excellent for dessert, and my friend appeared to enjoy the sauce his mussels came in.

Great coffee, knowledgeable yet approachable staff, light airy, chill atmosphere, great place to get your jolt on the run, or sit and sip.  If you need a good cup of coffee this is a worthwhile legit destination.
As novice customers we were looking for some advice on growing vegetables.  The person helping was very quick acting like he could not be bothered even though the place was empty.

My husband and I were visiting Santa Barbara for our baby moon and had great meals the whole time we were here and decided to try Dawn Patrol for the great reviews. The ambience is super cool and chill and the menu looked good. I got the patrol combo, scrambled eggs with sausage and added a pancake while my husband got the breakfast burrito. The food was ok, my scrambled eggs were more like an omelette with no flavor, sausage had no flavor either and the garlic potatoes tasted a day old. The only good thing for me was the pancake and the fresh squeezed oj. My husband enjoyed his burrito but it was small compared to the price. I really wanted to like this place but if we visit SB again we won't be coming here.

In town for a week. Rented two bikes. Got advice on where to ride and more importantly where to eat. Got a flat on a ride and called the shop. One the guys who wasn't working but hanging out at the shop grabbed a wheel, came out an swapped wheels for me. Super nice.

I have used this jewelry store since it opened.  Ya gotta love Sergio and now his son, friendly honest people.  I can't say I have bought a lot of jewelry here, but enough to take up some space. They used to do their own repairs, which I really appreciated, as I could often get my jewelry the same day or wait for a new clasp, or whatever I needed to fix the piece, sadly those days are gone. They send Rolex repairs out , but I will rival them against any other store on repairing and cleaning Rolex for a fair price.
All repairs are great, no complaints. The store has a large variety of jewelry pieces to offer and if you watch they often have some great sales. This is another Tampa independent family owned and operated, now into the next generation.
Once I dropped of a piece after the repair place had picked up orders and I really wanted to wear that piece in the near future, so they made an exception and dropped the piece off at the repair place, so I could receive it back in a timely manner.
Love local businesses and anyone that has read my posts knows this. Always happy when I can give them lots of stars and sad when I can't!
What's a girl to do? Always support your local business and shop there whenever possible.

Average-mediocre. There is a nickname for this place that seems is somewhat accurate. It's not the worst, but frequently food quality leaves much to be desired. It might depend on what you order. If you are hammered and need delivery, it's ok, but it's not going to impress a date. Food does not frequently taste like it is prepared fresh.

Sometimes the food delivered is worse quality, but others it's ok. Delivery is convenient.
Come on your one of the highest grossing casinos and you have to start charging $10 for parking and up your drink prices, I appreciate the memories hard rock but not cool

I would recommend ordering one of their crab leg platters. For no more than 25 bucks you get crab legs , shrimp, potatoes, corn , and broccoli. There was enough food to share with three people.  Also get there early if you plan to order on a Friday because the line will be long and everything is cooked to order fresh. The food is delicious and well worth the money.

Just went to a Temple bball there on a Saturday. I have been to many events at this venue but I thought that I would add a more recent review. The area is coming along nicely with lots of new stores and venues. Next door at McGonigle Hall there is now a Cosi coffee shop. Also the Liacouras Center has really stepped up it's beer selection. Most college games don't offer beer. Alcohol sales stop after half time which is ok with me. The food is not cheap but it never is at any top level venue.
The Liacouras Center is setup more like a pro arena with luxury boxes and other offerings. The arena seats 10k which is about right. 
Parking is available at the attached garage but I generally like to get there early and find and on street spot. Make sure you read the parking signs carefully because Philly likes to write tickets. 
I advise trying to get a lower level seat if you can. There are two nice pubs on Cecil B. Moore ave if you want to hangout after the game...

What a fantastic place to dine. Great food, wonderful atmosphere, cordial staff. Everything you could ask for in a dining establishment. Oh, how could I forget the varied selection of pies and cakes. I'll be back for more.

I LOVE THIS PLACE!!  I saw "Gunsmokin'" 2 nights ago and had a fantastic time!  The actors are very funny and entertaining!!  And the atmosphere is so laid back.  I can't wait to see the next production!
Was helped in the fitting room by a lovely associate named Rhyan. Very helpful and knowledgable about the styles! The decor was beautiful.

It amazes me how people say racism still doesn't exist. I was just there on New years day to have a couple of drinks with my boyfriend and cousin, and I have never been so disrespected in my life. As soon as we walked in the guy in charge placed a sign on the touch tunes music box, I couldn't read what it said so I assumed that it said it was out of order. I asked him what it said and he ignored me. I assumed he didn't hear me so I waited until he got closer and he still didn't respond. So yes, he was ignoring me. I got up and saw the note that read "no rap music or it will be skipped". We finished up the one drink we each ordered and proceeded to walk out, the guy who was with the man in charge said "the sign worked" WOW! My heart dropped you may as well put a sign up that said 'no blacks allowed'.

Great new location adjacent to the Greenbelt with vast selection of Payette beers. Have been there a couple of times.  The problem is the noise level which was very loud last evening when I was last there.  We moved a table out into the patio area which helped. Seems like they need to work on the acoustics.
AWSOME breakfast went back for second round. The "Big Easy" wad the Busines!

Great food, great service ... Drove by this place a number of times and finally made it to the restaurant. The food is wonderful. I really like the deep-fried zucchini and the steak specials are great. My son had the ribs and steak combo and really liked the combo. The beans are tasty as is the coleslaw. I haven't tried their signature dessert yet ... We are usually too full to order dessert.

I will forever be calling upon Delicious Designs whenever I need some tasty and beautifully crafted desserts. When I met Leigh Anne and saw her work, I immediately knew that she was the woman for the job to create our wedding cake. Leigh Anne is incredible and pays such close attention to detail. She listens to what it is that her customers want and makes sure that everything is exactly the way you want it to be. Everyone at our wedding raved about how beautiful and delicious the cake and tarts were. I highly recommend this bakery!
I am a repeat customer. Fernando takes care of me every time I go in there. I will continue to go back and refer as many times as I can. Will not take a watch to anyone but them.

A treasure! So glad we found this wonderful little spot for breakfast (or lunch). Sweet casual decor, excellent menu choices and specials, attentive friendly staff. No gluten free bread yet, but they are hoping to add some when they find a good supplier.
They do have GF cookies in the meantime.
Loved the cheesy grits. Everything that went by looked fabulous!

I have to say that The Food Liaison is my favorite place to eat for lunch. There hasn't been one thing that I haven't loved! And the pastries! OMG don't get me started. The food is fresh, lunches healthy.....did I mention the desserts? 

My vote would be for The Food Liaison to be open longer and on the weekends!  Yes that request is to feed my Food Liaison addiction! :)

I have been to this store several times over the years. 

It strikes me as light and bright with good space between the isles. 

it often has what seems to me a theme of merchandise through out the store, so if you are not in that mode you are out of luck. but for every day stuff they seem to have a good mix and prices.

today our visit was precipitated by Gus as he was looking for three things all of which he figured he could find at target, he was wrong. not one item of want was found so off we went.

Best Chinese restaurant in Reno. We tried to go there before for dinner but the wait was insane. Got there right when they opened for lunch  and they quickly filled up after.

Great flavor for all dishes. Looooooved their stinky tofu...best dish of the day. Perfectly fried and seasoned. 

We had 8 dishes along w/ drinks and it only came out to around $60ish. 10% off w/ check in if you order over $40. Awesome!

We purchased the 8 piece fried chicken from the deli at 5:45pm. We assumed the chicken would be fresh since it was dinner time. Wrong!!  It was the smallest pieces of chicken we have ever seen and it was all dried out. One wing was so small that it only had a piece of a bone.  One thigh was dried out and was missing the crispy skin. It was just a piece of almost black dried meat.  We couldn't eat half the chicken it was so bad. Apparently there isn't any quality control in the deli. Very disappointing.

MMW is definitely my favorite place to see a show in Nashville. The layout allows for a great view of the stage no matter where you stand. The bars a large and easy to access throughout the night. And the sound fills the room perfectly. I've been to multiple shows at MMW, each different genres, and the venue adapts easily to the different styles. I always have more shows here on my radar because they book the best acts and up and coming talent I always want to see. I'll be back time and time again!

Pretty fun place!
We had a good time. And the staff was nice, which is always a plus!

Greeted and seated promptly. 
Ordered the original sticky fingers. They were excellent. Great taste and cooked perfectly. 
Waitress was friendly. 
Great meal for the price.
Amazing food, nice ambience and commendable service. The prices are cheap. I'm a regular visitor. Their tacos are great, especially fish tacos. Fried fish is also great.

Quintessential New Orleans atmosphere, were able to show our out of town guests what we are always trying to describe about the laid-back eclectic nature of the city. Find your own table in the backyard, go upstairs to the wine bar and order a unique bottle of wine, pick something exciting and delectable off their gourmet bistro menu, then watch the sun go down listening to great live music. Our favorite restaurant in the city.

A gem in manayunk! Stopped in today for some breakfast and left satisfied. The sandwiches looked delicious, but I ordered the double down: 2 eggs, 2 french toast w/ sausage. The staff was very kind. It's small, so if you think of going with a large group, call first.

So I have to start this with saying that I never write reviews. I never just take the time, but I always read reviews. I've been going to the rock gym for years with my daughter and she loves it but yesterday they were truly phenomenal! I had a group of 10 kids coming in last minute (as in two hours before they were going to arrive) and the gym not only accommodated them completely but gave them an awesome experience! I have no complaints and kids seem to all have a blast doing the high climbs, the bouldering and the slack line. But really it was the customer service that was above and beyond.

Delicious food!  The service was great , the maitre d' and our waitress were very friendly.  The bread is to die for, actually the bread all over New Orleans is to die for.  I ordered the roasted chicken and it melted in my mouth along with the mash potatoes.  Only complaint was that the air conditioning was on and it was freezing, but apparently it is a consistent problem that restaurant has with the hotel it is located in. Ohhh, almost forgot, the dessert. I can't remember the name but it was this chocolate, chicory, mousse type dessert, WOW! So good!
Awesome bike shop! My family has been coming here for years. Al/Jack are the real deal. Great bikes and customer service.
If what you want is really curry in a hurry, this place isn't bad. Not the most authentic Indian food ever, but considering the staff isn't Indian, it's not half bad. I like the naan.

I was surprised this little hole in the wall sushi place in the middle of no where was so good. Everything on the extensive menu looked and sounded very good. I was a little weary of the hibachi nature look of everything but it was really legit

Our 30 year old AC/Furnace wasn't working well.  I looked at Yelp, found D&H had good reviews, called them and they had a guy out to look at that afternoon.  It was shot.  A salesman showed up while the tech guy was still here.  We all talked about the situation and we bought a new one.  Two days later two guys came and installed it.  It is working great.  The company was very good to work with.  Don't see how you could go wrong.
long line but it was quick. For some reason, they have like 5+ windows here but only two people working them, and they are both sooooo slow.

I have a real hard time with this place. Last time they wouldn't let me in based on my shoes. (Your on Bourbon Street in WEM calm the shit down) This time the bouncer was much nicer and we got in. So we talked to the manager I assume about a couple things and he was great to deal with. However out waitress wasn't overly friendly.  I do not agree with 18%  At any place. Fine add 10% but the point of tips is for good service. I will tip 20% on average but dont push it on me. And WTF is an entertainment fee?? Your tipping to get a song played already. On that note they do deliver! The pianos are awesome! While the drink prices are great on hi balls the rest is steep. The food menu is similar great range of choice but steep. And to be honest it is only average food. No one complained but no one was amazed. So I am torn. I give it a 2.5/5 what is good is great what is not good is very meh....

My favorite part was the atmosphere! It was just what we were looking for: a non-touristy, innovative take on classic foods. The sliders were delicious, the house salad was to die for, and the Monte Christo was out of this world! 

Their famous donuts are gorgeous, each looking like pieces of art. 

The staff is friendly and welcoming. Lots of locals frequent here, tipping us off to a true find of a restaurant. 

As a creative, I would definitely make this a frequent stop if I was a local. It would be a great place to meet with friends, or to be inspired to write.

I ordered a salad for takeout and a grilled cheese for my kiddo. The prices were higher than I expected. Grilled cheese was cold and hard. They forgot the pickle. They forgot to make the chocolate drink. My "bread roll" was hard a a rock. The staff was not very pleasant. I won't return.

Save your time and don't shop here. I went in to purchase a bedroom set for my daughter first time I went in to look and get prices then I had to go home measure and talk to my husband.. I went back and the lady who quoted me all my prices which she wrote down in detail everything she told me was off. The manager said why didn't you buy it the first time you were here then and basically told me he dosent know what to tell me so I said I was going to shop elsewhere and he said OK. I was blown away from the lack of professionalism. The furniture is cheaply made anyway. Ended up going to ashley furniture the same day, got my daughter a 5 piece bedroom set for 1,800!!!! Including mattress box spring warranty delivery mattress protector everything !! WAY BETTER quality than bobs and I saved money at Ashley's!!!!

Worst BYOB I've been to ! Came in with a group and as we we're waiting for guests to arrive we asked for bread and were told we can't have bread until we order appetizers. The server never asked us if we wanted appetizers at the time. The server also told my friend to move into table closer two times, very rudely . The tables are like 3 inches apart to begin with! Food was not authentic! Lacked serious flavor! Blah! This is why I cook at home. Tiny cash only BYOB should be more welcoming
Good pizza! U can get different taste in here. Anyway, there are some Really good TW food.

We were in from out of town and so glad we went to this restaurant. It has a lovely vibe and our waitress was outstanding. I got the lobster risotto and while it was good - I would say it wasn't the most enticing dish I'd ever had. You get a dinner rolls with some interesting (tasty) hummus and salads were not part of the dish. We got the Caesar and again not the best I'd ever had or seen - but still.. We were comfortable, welcomed, and full when we left. Loved the location of this place the food was good - I wouldn't list it in the top Italian food ever category though. Give it a try!

Forget about atmosphere and ambiance, as this place is located under a parking garage and it definitely has a grimy kinda vibe to it.  When you enter the restaurant, you can't help but question the cleanliness of the place. I agree with the other posters who touted their breakfast sandwiches on long rolls.  I've had a bacon egg and cheese and a pork roll egg and cheese and the prices were very cheap for a good sandwich.  Sandwiches are one thing, but do yourself a favor and don't get the pizza.  I honestly think it's frozen and not made fresh on premises.  It was very bad quality pizza.

The food was great, but everything else was lacking.  We arrived on time for our 715pm reservation for a requested. quiet table for for. Upon arrival, Frank told us our table would not be ready for a half hour and we should wait at the bar. After awhile, when no one took our drink orders, other tables emptied and walk-ins were seated, we asked for another table. Frank told us that customers should request, not demand and that the entire staff was aware of us. (!?!). Eventually we were seated  next to a table for eight that took up most of the dining room exit/entry area and was about 3 inches from our table. Result? Every guest entering or leaving the restaurant and/ or rest room bumped into my chair, put their hands on my shoulders to squeeze by or asked me to move. Unpleasant in so many ways, will not return.

Taste good, lively atmosphere, respectful and friendly staff.

I had the cabeza caramelo, sonoran hot dog, and chiles ahogados.  Really tasty.

As a three-year, going on four, member of Newfields (formerly the IMA), I can honestly say that I will never get bored of visiting this campus. Whether it be frolicking through the formal gardens, or taking a seat in front of a painting and pondering the artist's decision in using that certain color of paint. I have never been disappointed​ in any of my number of visits to Newfields. 

I recently took a group of my friends who had never been before to explore the campus and it was the perfect sunny day for it. We began on​ the top floor with the contemporary galleries and worked our way down and outside to the beautifully kept gardens. The newly renovated Design Gallery was outstanding and so much better organized and presented than how it formerly was. From experiencing a virtual reality tour of the Miller House and Gardens, to immersing yourself into the design process, everything was beautifully done. I even got to make a prototype of a toaster! 

I think a key benefit that I experience is the amount of things to do. There are three galleries that are always filled with rotating exhibits so every season brings about new artwork. While Summer Wonderland may have just finished, the new galleries featuring​ George Platt Lynes and The Year of Japan are about to open later in the fall. Also, one of the Docents told me that the curatorial​ staff changes out paintings every week so there really is something new to be seen on​ each visit.  

I would highly recommend visiting Newfields. If you are visiting Indy, it is definitely​ worth your time and finances. If you are an Indy local, it is definitely worth the membership. Plus, if you are a Butler University student, you get a free membership with your student ID!

Five stars and all that, but what this review is mainly for is my disbelief that there isn't more mention of the pork liver pate.

Vegetarian is great and all, and the pork is a good standby, but if you want that perfect, illusive, and characteristically combined Vietnamese/French hybrid, do yourself a favor.

Pate Party 2k10

I had my wedding ring (engagement ring and wedding band which have been joined already) re-sized (smaller) here. I am extremely happy with their work and customer service. They were friendly, it was super fast for both the pick-up and drop-off (both times I was in and out in less than 5 minutes). They only charged me $35. This is the second time I have had the ring re-sized after having a baby (my fingers took over a year to completely go back to their normal size), and the first place I went (I won't name) charged me $150 plus tax to re-size this ring. Gossage was far less expensive, and I can't see any difference whatsoever in the quality of their work. It's just as good. I would definitely recommend them. This is a family business, and they are clearly on top of customer service.

I went in July 2016 with my family. They ordered sandwiches which were okay, no rave. One salad order wrong. I ordered a chicken quesadilla. Horrible. I had to hunt for the few pieces of chicken and they used a yellow cheese, not real sure but I think cheddar. Clumpy and cold. And no ocean view. Parked WAY down the road so forget handicap or elderly. There was a tiki bar that had 'stay out' yellow tape and a sign warning 'no kids'. Of course children kept going in and one of my party rescued them until the parents noticed. Poor way to insure customer safety.

We had wings, brisket and the C Rock special. Delicious and tender!!! The service was good. The vibe was great - this is clearly the spot where the locals go on a Friday night. Can't wait to go back and hang out on the patio. I wish it was closer to my home but well worth the travel.

Rincon events catered my wedding in March of this year. They did an excellent job!  Angie was so helpful from beginning to end. The food was amazing and the staff was very professional.  They even made us a meal to go and boy was I hungry when I got home.  Can't say enough about this wonderful company!

I am writing about the precinct pizza in New Tampa, owned by the same person. Last week ordered 2 pizzas one plain and the other with toppings. Specifically told the employee slightly well done and not too thick. When I got the pizzas home, they were thick doughy and undercooked. Not even close to NY style pizza. Wasted 37 dollars. Believe me, as an Italian New Yorker, this place is awful. Will never go back. The pizza is awful.

This is my all time favorite Greek restaurant! Great food, service and pricing.  Many choices for Greek cuisin in Tarpon but this is definitely one of the top places to eat while you're in the sponge docks!
Great coffee and food! Ask for the Monica Kelly - a healthy bagel with veggies and added lox for a great meal anytime of day.

Carlota's on Lambert in O.V. is about as authentic as you can get! The first hint is the Salsa and chips which appears quickly by friendly and efficient staff. The menu is extensive and has about 5 soups, for example.

Yes, service is a bit slow. The reason is simple. They make it from scratch. But the short wait is worth it. Piping hot, well seasoned, tasty dishes are the hallmark at Carlota's!

Had the Steak and Broccoli rabe with bacon and sharp provolone! The wife had The chicken pizza Awesome! Got a couple Hoagies for later tonight. Had it delivered to our Semi through Yelp. Service was good and food was Delicious!

This is my new favorite place. I've been there about 5 times - once was at 7:30 am and I got a great drink recommended by the bartender. It was a pint of hard cider with a shot of fireball whiskey - REALLY good! They have good vegan food at affordable prices with big servings. The veggie wrap is GREAT and NOT boring like most veggie wraps can be, AND it was a big, normal portion size and not the typical you're-a-vegan-so-you-obviously-don't-need-your-money's-worth size. My boyfriend had some kind of bacon/shrimp/cheesey grits plate that he loved. I've always found the service to be good and the workers to be super friendly. I love the decor and it's crazy funky upstairs.
Awesome breakfast/lunch spot! Potato Cakes are the truth. You will not be disappointed.

This is a classic is school steak house experience. The Prime Rib is particularly delicious and enormous. Been around for a long time and it feels like it in a good way. Big steaks. Stiff drinks. Low pretense. What's not to love?

I have been going to this place for a about 2 years now. The food is great with a great menu. You have an option of about 10 quesadillas. However, you can make each quesadilla a wrap. The buffalo chicken wrap did not impress me. I usually get the Aztec. One thing that stops this place from getting 5 stars is the the price. It is a little expensive for what you get. I would think they would give you a free side of salsa or sour cream, but that's extra!

I've been here twice and the service is always exceptional! All of the beers are delicious and you've got to try their kolsche! However, the food is really hit or miss. I went with the daily chicken sandwich special and it was not good. I let the waiter know that I didn't want my food and they took it back, insisted on getting me something else to eat. I politely declined and just asked for another beer and they comped it. I will always come back to the Bottleworks when I'm in town! They have really fun events and their beer is extraordinary!

My food was great on my first visit!
Amazing price point; great, quality ingredients. Love they have crust options of wheat, gluten free, and now cauliflower. I like that they grow with the current trends.

I went into the store today because I had a $5 off coupon and I was looking for a drug store bb/cc cream. I walked around for a little looking at higher end products then made my way around to the drug store products. A worker who was super busy (the store was restocking) stopped to ask me if I needed help. After talking for a few minutes and listening to me suggested I go over to the Clinique bar. The girls there were super helpful! They color matched me with a lightweight foundation after she did a section she went and did my full face and even did some concealer. After she finished she made me some samples of the products and gave me a sample of a primer because I mentioned my pores on my nose are huge. All in all super helpful! Not the first time I've had great service here either! Will definitely go back

Their service is amazing.   I ordered a pizza for delivery. (Love their pizza.)  The order was inadvertently written as a pickup.  I called and they apologize.  However they offered to make me a new one and deliver it all free of charge.  I am really impressed.

The service and the drink was good, but that is where it ends.  I ordered the Falafel plate.  It came with a teaspoon of hummus, 3 falafels, pita, some roasted veggies, and some nasty grain. I tried to make the most of it and asked from some more hummus.  I was given another teaspoon (not tablespoon).  So my falafels were dry.  It was a 17 dollar horrible meal.  I left unsatisfied so we went to another place so I could actually eat.  Good drinks but don't get the falafels unless you hate hummus.

The shop was busy when I entered so I was not greeted.  I noticed a sign in sheet on the counter and being reasonably intelligent I signed in on the next available slot.  After waiting for over twenty minutes I rechecked and found that my name had been inadvertently crossed off.  Not wanting to make a scene with a person I expected to then cut my hair I left.  I am probably not going to give them a second chance.  On the plus side I did enjoy watching some March Madness action while I waited.

Hands down the best restaurant in New Orleans!

Crispy brussel sprouts appetizer was good, very saucy, not bitter.

Lump crab appetizer was pretty good. 

Jumbo Louisiana Shrimp "En Cocotte" (roasted jalapeño cheese grits, andouille & green onion sausage) is my absolute favorite meal in New Orleans. Also their jalapeno cheesy grits is the best in town. No one makes it like them.

The only positive about this franchise location is how new it is. The food, while still pretty good, was not up to the standard we have become accustom to at other Red Robin restaurants. While we were seated relatively quickly that was where the service ended. We were ready for drink refills while waiting for our waitress to return to take our food order... For some strange reason the wait staff at this location does not clear the table as food and drink is finished. Instead they leave everything on the table until after you leave when a busboy clears everything. It was a little challenging to keep young children entertained with a massive pile of dishes and glasses in the middle of the table.

It might be good,  but I'll never know...

I just walked in to this restaurant and almost immediately walked out. As I walked in I was greeted by two people. The first was the bartender who appeared to be very nice. The other was an older gentleman with a bad perm and gold glasses.

I indicated that it was just me. The gentleman looked at the bartender,  paused and let out an audible sigh. He just stood and looked at her as if to say, "what am I supposed to do with this?" She encouraged him to seat me and he shrugged. I just walked out. I certainly don't want or need to be somewhere that it's clear I'm not welcome.

I certainly won't be back.

AWESOME! The employees/owner are the nicest, most welcoming people! Best Vape shop I've been to. Super cool environment, HUGE couch and big TV, a flavor bar, and much more. Great for beginners to king vapers. Exclusive juices!

CHECK THEM OUT!
Well priced, good sushi. Intimate atmosphere with a nice/casual feel.i could see it being loud in there at full capacity. Had a large sake for 2, beer, 4 sushi rolls and a side of rice for $60.
Every time I come here I could just keep eating. All the food is delicious and true to Indian flavors. The staff is very attentive and friendly. My one and only place to eat Indian food!

Visited for restaurant week with my boyfriend... As others have said, the location was strange and kind of unfortunate.  The building is mainly a design complex for home decor.  We followed signs throughout the building leading us up to the 4th floor.  We were greeted by an incredibly friendly waitress who took our coats and introduced us to the French chef and owner.  She then led us through a cozy seating area to the far dining room overlooking the Schuylkill River and 30th St Station.  The chrome wall behind the bar reflected the reds and blues of the neon sign and logo in the window giving off a modern vibe.  

We had chosen it for the restaurant week menu which we'd read online... we ordered some cocktails and double checked our choices from the menu.  An added first course was brought out to us- truffle mushroom soup.  Neither of us actually like mushrooms much, but both enjoyed the light, creamy soup quite a bit.  His appetizer of lobster stuffed calamari was a bit tough, though he easily ate it all anyway. My  eggplant dish was phenomenal.  For the main course, the bf had chicken and I chose striped bass.  We each loved our own dish and liked the other's.  Our desserts were creme brulee (fantastic, I thought, though the boy would've preferred it slightly warmer) and an apple pie tart (quite good I thought, the boy loved).  

Overall, it was a great choice.  We would never have found it if not for restaurant week, and we'd definitely go back in the future.  Service was friendly and prompt, food was fantastic, and view was gorgeous.
Over all a good year they need to bring back the early bird tickets though. But it was nice having fewer people this year
Ever heard of vanilla earl grey tea gelato? Me neither. But my goodness it was good! The atmosphere was relaxed yet classy. It would be a nice choice for a casual date.

Despite reading these poor reviews, I still went by here because it was the only place I could find in SB. 

I can only repeat others recommendations not to go.

I went in on a Tues for new linings in my shoes. Was told to come back on Friday, and that it would be $25 (seemed a little high but I have little experience with shoe repairs).

Returned Monday to pick up the shoes - spent 10 mins waiting around while they randomly and idly perused the shop looking for my shoes. They had no idea where they were. Finally 10 mins later they found them, and they hadn't been touched. I took them back and walked out.

Nuff said.

Small but very cozy little spot. My co-worker and I stopped by here for lunch on a business trip and were starving. I ordered a cup of seasonal bisque soup with a salad and the lobster tacos. Excellent choice. Lots of flavor and delicious. It helped that we were starving too. I would have tried everything on the menu. It was windy when we went and a bit too cold for people to sit outside, so we sat at one of the exterior tables/counters overlooking the wharf. Great good and great atmosphere...would be happy to come back again if and when I'm back in the area.
This is our favorite restaurant now. Great food and service! The triple vegetable dish was too salty, but so delicious. Will definitely go back. Highly recommended!

A hidden little gem. If you're looking for an authentic NOLA foodie experience come here. Everything we ordered was delicious. Waitstaff were all sweet and accommodating. Just straight up delicious food. Quality is on point.

Once again I have finally stopped into a place in my own neighborhood that I've been passing for years.

An old converted train station, Woodbury Station Cafe's several dining rooms have an odd sort of divided layout.  Still, I'd describe the atmosphere as cozy rather than cramped.  The photos of historical Woodbury that cover the walls are a nice touch, but the plastic tablecloths depicting old 1920s newspaper ads are a little corny.

The menu, though, is anything but corny.  I was surprised to find a place in my own backyard that featured housemade beignets and chicory coffee.  Soon after sitting down, our friendly server brought us a sample plate of homemade biscuits topped with creamy, flavorful cream chipped beef.  My husband went on to order the full cream chipped beef platter for breakfast, which came served over fresh white toast and with crispy, oniony potato cakes.  I went with crepes, which were served paper thin and filled with perfectly tender-crisp asparagus, mushrooms and feta cheese.  My potatoes were more traditional diner hashbrown, but with tiny flecks of crispy bacon throughout and served with my choice of either redeye or sawmill gravy.  I chose both.

Throughout our breakfast, my coffee cup remained full and our server stopped by a number of times to see if there was anything we needed.      I was too full to indulge in the beignets she suggested at the end of our meal, but will definitely be back again to try the doughy fried puffs.  And maybe the brioche French toast.  Or the homemade waffles.  Or the eggs Benedict served on a bialy... Mmmmm... Like I said, I will DEFINITELY be back.

Ate lunch and had the special Red Snapper and we ordered fried Oysters as an appetizier (ordered kids Oysters since they don't have them as appetizer).    The oysters were great and typical of fresh NOLA restaurants.  The special was fried snapper but I got it blackened and the fish was very good although the cream lobster sauce was overpowering.  Good thing I got it on the side cause after one bite I didn't eat anymore.  Overall the place is somewhat a hole in the wall but with good food.  I'm not a fan of fried seafood but would visit again just to try the Oyster Po Boy after having the fried oysters initially.

Definitely one of my favorite Chinese places in the city. I have been going for many years and it's never disappointed. 

Something not to miss are the soups for two - there are multiple interesting and delicious options. The duck soup is great as well as the chicken and vegetables. They are rich and satisfying. 

I usually always get the same entree because it is so tasty - beef with black bean sauce and pan fried noodles. The beef and chinese greens are done perfectly and the egg noodles are buttery and satisfying. One order is enough for at least two and possibly three meals, depending on how hungry you are, so be prepped for leftovers.

It's BYOB and inexpensive. Gets very crowded on weekend eveningsl. So worth it!

The donuts here are nothing short of great. The texture and taste are clear indicators that their donuts are some of the best around. The only bad thing about this place is the lack of coffee options. A great iced coffee paired with our donuts would have been euphoric.

Some times things just work. The wildflower is one of those places in time that just works. Leslie one of the two owners met me like an old friend at the door Cathy my waitress made a wonderful suggestion for lunch that was on the regular menu bit not the days special.    I had the roast beef sandwich with tomato jam Lettuce and a special dressing on home made bread.   The roast beef was perfect and tender. I am talking butter tender.  One look at it told the story. Only premium cut cow here.   I had an ice tea and an oatmeal cookie (also home made.   Oh they have a little market if you need things to go.  Clean tastefully decorated with a tree shaded porch.  Parking is good.   Hey I had never been there before today.   I will be back.    Sandwich with chips $11.00. A great deal with the heap of roast beef an attentive service
Normal ice cream - hot fudge was a bit too sweet and not warm on my sundae. Not enough seating space.
Horrible service.  Horribly managed.  Constantly out of something in the mornings.  Drive thru orders are often wrong.  Bad days can be expected anywhere but it's constant here.

This restaurant is absolutely horrendous. I went here with my family after exploring some of the cool historic sites Philly has to offer. This place was suggested after our plans to eat at the City Tavern had changed (they were not open). Upon arriving to the restaraunt, I immediately regretted it. The decor was a mix of gothic, antique and my grandma's house. It smelled so horribly of smoke, I may have contracted asthma. 

    We made our way up to the dining area on the second level. We were seated and waited about 10 minutes for a waitor or waitress to help us. When she finally made her way to our table she took our drink orders and returned shortly with our cokes. She spilt mine, apologized and then continued to clean the table - sticking her armpit in my face. This wouldn't be so bad if she wasn't wearing a skimpy strapless dress and didn't smell as though she had never heard of deodorant (talk about unappetizing).  

     We ordered our food; which included chicken parmesan, a steak burger and a grilled chicken sandwich. We waited AN HOUR or more for our food, during which I suggested plenty of times that we should leave. Also during which, a women who looked like the old witch from Snow White tried to strike up a conversation with my little sister and touched her/was very close to her and made her almost cry in fright (my sister is 9). Creepy. Just creepy. 

     When our food came, we were already having the worst dining experience we have EVER had. Spoiler alert: it didn't get better.
 
      My spaghetti in my chicken parm wasn't even drained and had no sauce!? When I asked for more, we were charged 75¢. My chicken was chewy and disgusting. Same goes for the grilled chicken sandwich. No one enjoyed their meals. Even the pop tasted gross which makes the fact that they charge full price for refills even worse! 
Our waitress was unattentive and made only three trips to our table. 
We paid our bill and RAN out of there. 

DO NOT EAT AT ROTTEN RALPH'S. THE NAME IS NOT CONTRADICTING, IT'S LITERAL. 

-56682838382628393 stars
Prices are too high and if you're not a "somebody" in the New Orleans area, the employees follow and watch your every move.

Food was good but service was poor. Apparently they ask that you order before you sit but when we walked in nobody was even present to greet us. We sat ourselves and it took nearly 15 mins for us to be waited on properly. Other patrons seemed to have this issue as well. My advice to management is to have it more clearly stated on how service is given at your restaurant and also have more attentive staff on hand.
Good Sunday brunch if you don't want the typical jersey diner food. Great atmosphere and service. Special coffees and hot chocolate.

They do have good pancakes and waffles. The prices are a little steep in my opinion, but because they are a chain you know what to expect because they basically are the same everywhere. I have never had problems with service here.

Staff was extremely friendly especially our waiter. I ordered the traditional with potatoes and my friend had ordered the Lucy omelette. Big portions. Everything was delicious. Would recommend this place for breakfast ! Also mimosas were delight too

Drinks, appetizers, dinner and dessert...impeccable. 

Service...impeccable.  Heather was lovely and very knowledgeable. 

Atmosphere...wonderful. 

Prices...very reasonable for all the above. 

Highly recommend!!!!!

I'm super sensitive about restaurant hygiene.  I can't stand sweaty bartenders/servers.  Bit my lady friend and I didn't touch our good and drinks and we had the food packed to go not to look rude.  They should wipe their faces with a towel and bit their hands that's about to handle my food and drinks.  This is like somebody spitting in your food pretty much. Gross!
The food is not making the review since we didn't even get to eat it.  I guess to be fair we're very picky with hygiene to where we'd like to see hair nets on everybody. But sweat dripping from a servers face is unacceptable .
Right on the bike path, interior was clean and modern-industrial and the beer was good. Not amazing, but good.

The wait was really long, and it was freezing outside. They only had one heater going, which seemed like a mistake -- and it's entirely possible one of the folks I was waiting with is the one who ultimately turned it on. 

They were out of all but one kind of roll when we did get seated, the ones we had were fairly standard fare. I did love my food, as did my most charming date, but the place is small and cramped and not necessarily in a good way. The prices were kind of high considering serving size and my previous experience with Thai food elsewhere. (I'm used to two meals from one serving in these kinds of restaurants.)

Ultimately I'd come back, because the food really was good, but I'm not sure the value was really 1000% there.

There are a lot of options at Coventry if you've got the urge to feel mega-bloated and uber-satisfied after lunch. During work, I generally avoid mega-bloatation and uber-satisfaction, because they are both feelings that make me want to stop working and enjoy life.

However, I ordered the grilled cheese (provolone) with a tomato slice and rocked some parmesan pepper mashed potatoes on my virgin visit to this calor-ific yuppie feeding frenzy in the heart of Center City and, I must say, the yuppies might just know what's uppie.

The sandwich was not the soggy puddle of buttery cheesiness that I have come to expect from grilled cheese over the years. The bread was crisply toasted, the cheese was melted but not burned or pure liquid.

Somehow, it actually achieved standard grilled cheese satisfaction levels without making me nervous that I'd start feeling pain in my left arm and get light-headed moments after eating it.

The mashed potatoes (which, incidentally, are one of my top three favorite foods in the Milky Way) were awesome and left me sad that it was such a little cup-o-potatoes. 

Bring a few extra bucks for this place (and if you bring a rectangular piece of plastic, be sure to get in the line on the right, so as not to piss off the otherwise friendly Asian women who smilingly stand guard at the registers).

It's a good experience, and I've been told that the one pound baked potato is absolutely to eat for! So I'll probably be heading back for sloppy seconds, right after my next paycheck.

I wanted an above average sammich. What I got was an amazing one. I got the Kalua pork sandwich. The pork was perfectly seasoned and not dry at all. The bread was crispy and soft. Also, the server seems like he used to work at Trader Joe's! Super friendly and welcoming.

This is a cozy place and great for date nights. There is a parking lot across the street, which is convenient. Drinks were good and they have some interesting martini options. We enjoyed the complimentary bruschetta and the arancini. 

The saltimbocca was very good, but the chicken lemoncello was only good. Portions are generous. The service was very good, well above average for Delaware County. We had a nice time and hope to return soon.

Debbie has been great to us with taking Care of Sandy with the long hours that me and my wife work she is a huge help. Even done over nights when we had to go out of town for work. Would Absolutely  recommend her services.

The food is worth the wait. Legit charcoal grilled chicken with falafel in a delicious sauce topped with fruit that is the best combination of flavors.  Very fresh.  I will try to go again a bit earlier.
OMG this place defies the standards of fast food. Longer wait in the drive thru than in the lobby. If there was an option for negative stars this location would get it...

I am giving one star only because the woman who runs this place was nice enough. First off, what she is selling on Groupon as a luxury, hour long, herbal detox wrap, is really the ItWorks product, a multilevel marketing product that has become rather big right now, however I have friends who distribute for them, could have had a party at my house and got the wrap for free. Also I am pretty sure it is against their regulations to use Groupon to sell, also no where on her website or Groupon did it say ItWorks, but I will be contacting them later today. Secondly, she literally took me to the bathroom, applied the wrap and sent me on my way...not the relaxing "hour long herbal wrap" experience that I had I visioned when I purchased this deal and proceeded to hire a babysitter for my 2 year old. All in all I feel totally ripped off. I will be contacting groupon as well as ItWorks and hopefully this scammer gets shut down.

I have been here a few times with my family and my mom. We usually don't eat out Thai food because Im half Thai and my mothers cooking is amazing. I was pleasantly surprised that I loved the Chicken Panang. Normally when I have this at other Thai restaurants I don't really like it. At this place it's super flavorful and I can get it spicy like I like. The fried rice is not bad either but not the best. I'm personally not a fan of Pad Thai but my hubby said his was really good. One of my favorite things to drink is Thai Tea which theirs doesn't disappoint. The service is good and the price is reasonable. If you want good Thai food at a decent price then I recommend going here.

After  driving  by Honeygrow  countless  times,  I  finally  went here  for lunch today with a  friend.   I'm  giving   this place  four  stars  because my  salad  was so tasty  and a very nice young woman employee  came  over  to help me and my friend  order  with their  touch  screen system (   much more elaborate  than   WAWA).   AND  because they  offer   healthy food!!!! (  would be  great if there  were   as many Honeygrow  restaurants as  there are McDonalds in this  country) . The   interior  is nice and clean  and bright.  All good.  Here is  the not  so  good:  too chaotic   and VERY VERY NOISY! The  noise  level was  deafening  and  I could not   carry on a  conversation  with   my  friend.  Add to that, the  beat of  some kind of  music  below the  surface (WHY????).   Other patrons in  a  hurry  were pushing  us around (  rude).  I noticed the  assembly line of  workers  behind the  counter were not all pulling their  weight.  This  bothered  me ( some  were   working  so hard).   My last  grievance  was the  price. I bought a  Cesar  type  salad (  forget their name  for it) and added  breaded chicken.  Nothing to  drink and  the total  was $10.02 .   Too expensive.  For  $10, I  should  be eating left over  salad  for the next two meals.   But  this  is a restaurant   that is a giant  step in the  right  direction.  And I   made  sure to thank  the employee  who helped me  and my  friend.  Kindness  never goes out of style!

My boyfriend and I were looking for a froyo place close to his place and found this. I am so glad that we did. They don't have a huge variety of flavors, but the ones they have are good. Plus, they rotate them. Then there are the usual froyo fixin's. The Reese's cups, cookie dough, and cheesecake are all HUGE chunks, which I appreciated. Though, I'm not sure I recommend the cookie dough from there...

The main talking point here is their ROLLED FROYO. I don't know why no one's mentioned it yet, but YES. THEY HAVE IT. I'd been searching for a rolled ice cream place in Indy since the trend hit the internet. You can create your own (froyo base + 2 mix-ins) or choose one from their menu. I made my own with strawberry and chocolate. She even topped it off with strawberries and some whipped cream. Even though this isn't exactly rolled "ice cream", it's so so good.

Extraordinarily average. Food is just "OK" and portions are small and pricey. Service is meh. Restaurant itself is beautiful, and it's not a bad place to grab a happy hour drink, but I wouldn't eat there again. Definitely not one of Jose Garces' better spots.
Worst sushi I've ever had. Worse than all you can eat sushi. The fish is gross, the rolls are terrible. They fall apart. It's not good sushi at all.

I have been platinum player for years there food is great customer service is good but gaming machines are a joke I have noticed in last couple months$200 lasts no less than 45 minutes and I was only playing$0.45 a hand I am seriously considering going to different Casinos I love going there for everything but this place is becoming corporate nightmare and it's far away from being what it used to be

Wanting to change up the Thursday routine, we decided to go bowling after dinner.

Headed here because its close to home, plus they had pay $6 and bowl all you want from 9-close (Mon-Thur, I believe).  So, there was a little bit of a line but it went pretty good. 

Overall, its a bowling alley.  Like most, its dark and a little old, but I don't think I would know what to do if a bowling alley was any other way.

I did have to wait a few times for the bartender to get back to the bar, but overall, it wasn't bad.  And why would I complain when I am paying $1.50 per drink?  

So, for two of us to bowl six games and have 3 beers each, it cost $25, tip included.  And we probably could have bowled more if my arm wasn't getting sore.  (Or if I hadn't been losing, but whatever).

Overall, it was a good deal and I will probably be back.

HANDS down the friendliest nail salon around. Being from Baton Rouge, I have my favorite spot back home, so I've been searching since I moved for a great nail salon here! They are awesome! So friendly. Took the time to know my name, where I work, etc. Paid attention to detail and really were awesome. Definitely going back

I love this place, it is definitely a staple in my restaurant reportoire.  My husband and I like to either dine in or get take out, both are great.  Even though you can bring your own beverages, they also carry some Indian beers.  I always get the garlic naan and veggie samosas and pretty much every entree is delicious.  The staff is also very pleasant.

Retrospect is one of my favorite resources for vintage furniture, clothing and accessories in the city.  Their prices are always the lowest in town and everything in their shop is really carefully curated (like shopping in a thrift shop with only stuff I like!)

This Christmas I scored several pieces of glassware that match a set I already had as well as a gorgeous vintage hand-painted sled that was the envy of many friends and family at our holiday party! Then when i told them the price tag--a mere $16--they just about fell over!!

Credit Cards are accepted. They offer exchanges within 7 days. Metered Street Parking (which is the only downside).

We arrived late after driving through heavy rain and storms. When we came the front desk woman was very friendly and asked us how our trip was. We had a quick check in as I had already done it on the app and we were placed on the SPG member floor which was very quiet and I loved the fact the ice machine was located one floor below. The room was spacious and clean with a jacuzzi tub we didn't use based on all of our travels visiting family and friends. The bed was very soft but supporting, the only down side was only 4 pillows for two of us. One down side was no hairdryer for her. The television gets directv which is a plus because that is what I have but also a down side because I can't watch the Phillies. Our room was refreshed to perfect condition upon our return Saturday. I would definitely stay here again it's quiet and comfortable. I'll try the restaurant next time also
Freaking delicious!!!! Go there! Delicious burgers and chilli fries so good. Kinda pricey but worth it

Before this Saturdays showing of Buddy Holly at the Muny 3 friends and I had reservations at Herbies.  We went there last year and I don't remember anything special except it was a bit pricy.   This time my guest and I ordered a tomato pasta special they had.  I had water to drink and he had a coke.  The pasta was fine, something I'd make at home.  It did give me a bad case of heart burn though.  The description of that special wasn't quite right.  Our bill was $71, tip it was $90.  Two bowls of pasta, 1 coke, $90.  The waiting staff was great.  I won't be back though, that's ridiculous.

This has been my family's go-to Chinese spot since I was a kid. In general I'm not the biggest fan of Asian cuisine in general but the basic stuff I like has always been better here than anywhere else I've been. While not always the quickest of orders (I'm guessing the food in general takes a bit to make), it's always hot and fresh when we do get it.  The chicken here is always flavorful and juicy, the beef is the same and every type of rice here is to die for. Definitely a place for everyone to check out.

Bananas Foster French Toast. Best french toast I've ever had. Not too sweet. I don't normally like ordering sweet dishes, but this was amazing and worth it! 

Shrimp & Grits. Super creamy grits. Delicious.

This place is where you want to go for piercings in Nola. Extremely clean and friendly environment. I went for lobe piercings (my very first piercings for all intents and purposes) and Carmela was extremely patient and informative about the process and aftercare. She made me feel at ease 100%. She owns the business so that's also a plus, support your local female business owners!
It's alright...pricey, needs remodeling.  I've had some great things and some mediocre things.  Not my first pick in the area.

They know you're jittery, upset, and maybe even angry about the state of your pet, but every staff member I encountered was beyond nice when I brought my cat, Seido, in for 24 Emergency Service.  The security guard was super nice when he asked me to move my car, and he was kind enough to stand outside and wait for me (it was late at night - didn't even have to ask him and I really appreciate it).  Seido's emergency staff and primary care physician after being moved out of the ICU were all incredibly understanding, knowledgeable, and kind.  Thank you.

Seido is happy and healthy again thanks to you guys. :)
Best donuts ever! Light fluffy,always fresh, fast and friendly service,  always!! If you love Apple Fritters like I do go early or they're gone!!!

As a 12 year Customer of the Inn and Restaurant and previous raving Five star supporter....I'm sad to say; the magic seems to be gone. Once upon a time I raved and bragged about the DK and to be sure I have many fond memories. It was my home away from home. I thought they cared for me as much as I did them. Now I see they are a business...I am a revenue source and I understand just how much Sam understood about the difference between pleasing a Customer for the night versus maintaining a loyal Patron for life. Twelve years was a great run though. Thanks for the memories.
Took 20 minutes to get their basic burger. Not worth $12 after tip. Decent atmosphere

All you can eat pizza! Need I say more. The pizza is average but the beer garden is really one of a kind in the area, and quite reasonable. 

We have had large groups here before and they are always very accommodating. It's media so parking can be a pain but the dedicated lot does really help.

My partner and I love PFFCU, but our last visit was absolutely exceptional.  
We are buying a house soon, but all of the online calculators and articles were conflicting. We could not get answers to our specific questions, nor get a detailed roadmap for each step we needed to take. 
We sat down with Elliot, who was so incredibly knowledgeable, and broke down the entire process for us, along with details that were specific to us. He spent plenty of time making sure we understood each aspect and the actions we would need to take. After our meeting, we left feeling much more empowered and educated. 
I can't recommend this bank enough!

My small pepperoni pizza was hot and fresh, right from the oven! Plenty of cheese and there was something quite tasty about the sauce! My only disappointment was that it didn't look like the picture of the pizza on the Yelp review. Mine had sliced pepperoni and it looks like crumbled/diced in the review. The price was right and the service was fast. I love supporting local businesses, so I'll be back!!

We just completed a stay there this weekend and it definately only deserves 3 stars. We cant complain because we got a deal on the hotel on Hotwire. 

Pros: The bellhops were very. very helpful! They greeted us every time we were in and out of the hotel, let us wait inside while they hailed us a cab in the cold, windy weather, and they gave us directions for every where we needed to go. The hotel was very kind to let us check-in early and check-out late. There is a bar/restaurant/pantry in the lobby. The bar has really good happy hour specials which is great if you're looking to grab a quick drink. Also, the location was prime!! Right in the center of everything!! 

Cons: the pictures on various websites do not compare to what the rooms actually look like!! Our room had a tube tv which was very fuzzy (heads up for guys looking for HDTVs in the hotel rooms). The bathroom was very tiny that you cant have two people getting ready at the same time. The shower head had mildew. There was just overall very poor lightening in the whole bathroom area. No convenient plug-in outlets near the bed to charge your phone. The desk area is not really a desk area..it was two tables pushed in together to make it look like a bigger desk area. Just poor use of the space.  The mattress wasn't too comfortable either..not sure if it was too old or what the deal was. Also, the pillows were kind of uncomfortable as well. 

Overall, if you are looking for an affordable place to stay in center city you cant beat the location. The price you pay is what you get.

I just visited 45 Tchoup after having lived here for 3 years.  I really regret not stopping by earlier! While this place sort of reminds me of sports bar meets dive bar - it really is a pretty comfortable atmosphere and a good place to grab a few drinks.

The prices are very fair - $2 high life all the time, 2.50 mexican beer night on Tuesdays and drafts range $3-5.  Overall, its one of those places where if you drink cheap, you'll be tipsy to make your $10 credit card minimum! 

The one downside is that the place is VERY smokey - the only portal to the outside world appears to be the front door, so not a lot of air circulation going on in here.

Best waitresses (shout outs to Rebecca and Tanya) ever!! I came here practically every week with my husband. I love the environment of being able to bring my laptop and working on whatever I wanted. We even got hugs, when we told them that we would be moving to San Diego. 

I still miss this place and trying to find a replacement for it here in SD. I always got the Kaldis iced tea, which is the best black tea I've ever had and a bagel or an omelet to eat. Sometimes, if I really needed it I'd grab a coffee or orange juice. 

Everything here is phenomenal. If you don't come here for breakfast or brunch when visiting St. Louis, you are missing out!!

My family and I love this place !!  the food is AMAZING!! The pizza is the best I've ever had ..& my favorite part is that they have options for my little guy. My little boy is on the autism spectrum so we have him on a special gluten free dairy free ect diet and they have options for him :-) he loves the pizza here he can eat the whole medium by himself . Definitely recommend this place for family's or for even a guys or girls night out for some pizza and beer !

Everytime we have a family gathering/party, BBQ, etc...  This is what I am told to bring.  I have had only the cakes from here and let me say they are absolutely delicious.  They taste the same way every single time.  The icing isn't sweet, and the fruit on top is always fresh.  Try it out!
Can't believe I waited for 1h30min for the dinner! Definitely not a delightful thanksgiving night
Not impressive at all, I ordered turkey hummus wraps, turned out that half of my wraps barely contained any turkey! Only green and hummus. What a surprise!

The service was great and the rolls were fresh and tasty...be sure to try the wasabi fries they are so addicting!....if you like spicy food the volcano roll is the way to go...the special roll the server recommended was also great....will return soon

The General's chicken was really amazing, as was the hot and sour soup. The 5 spice pork and chow mein were both misses, however. Both slightly flavorless and slimey. It also seemed slightly overpriced.

I'm as close as you can get to an ice cream connoisseur, and Glazée is simply transcendent.  Everything is handmade; even the waffle cones are made ONLY AFTER YOU ORDER ONE.  Black Walnut is my favorite.  I can't stop myself from coming here when I'm in Cool Springs.
Paula our server was very pleasant and really nice.  All smiles all the time and very polite.  Ordered famous chicken wings and really tasty and delicious to the bone.

So happy I found this place. I only have time to go once a week, but it is the most relaxing part of my day. They have classes for all levels and ages. Plus they have student discounts and drop in classes so you're not tied down.

We made reservations for Sunday Brunch on October 18, 2015.  The service was impeccable and the food superb!    There were 4 adults in our party and each ordered a different entree.  We had their famous BBQ shrimp, Shrimp & Grits, Brisket and Chicken Pontalba.   We were very pleased with the quality of food and service!

I've been here a couple of times, and would definitely continue to come back.  It's a casual place with great pizza!  But if you're a picky eater, be careful because their pizza is "well done", meaning a crispy crust.  So if that's not your style you may not like it.  However, each time I go I enjoy myself, the service, and of course the fabulous pizza.  Each time I go the manager makes it a point to go to each table and check on everyone, which I love.  One time, he came over to our table and noticed the pizza was a little more well done than usual, and he offered to have our pizza be on the house, and he gave us a free $25 gift card to come back.  We weren't even complaining about the food at all!  Great customer service, definitely how you get customers to come back and share their experience with their friends.
Also, if it's nice out definitely sit outside on the patio!  It's a little more quiet than inside.

My stylist moved out of the area so I tried Salon Dacota and saw Jesse. She was awesome! She did a great job taking my long hair to a shorter bob, and it turned out great. Very stylish and she listened to what I wanted. You could tell she had a ton of experience by the way she worked those scissors!!! It's been a week and still loving this cut!

This place has the food you need for a Chinese dinner buffet. I am not Chinese food expert, but they seems to do the basics well enough. They had a slightly better than average salad bar selection as well. The rest seemed like like typical Chinese fare to me. The age-based pricing helps when you have a couple kids in tow. Also, these are good folks - I lost my wallet in there and called them the next day and they still had it.

So, my wife and I have been on a 3-week road trip and have traveled to/through FL-TX-OK-NM-AZ-MS-Co-Wy-AL and KS and have had some decent food but when our last stop came we did not expect to hit the jackpot!  Wow!  This place is small but HUGE on Flavor, variety and Customer Service!!!  Our waitress, Sara (with no H) was on point and by far the best waitress or waiter we've had, we never had to ask for refills, she was super fast with any requests we had and I need to tell you that this place was HOPPING so she was moving the whole time but made us feel like we were the only ones here!!  Bottom Line,...Food is fantastic, atmosphere is inviting with a small town warmth!  On a side note, all the staff was super friendly but be warned of Gina, she is LOUD but also super personable!  (And she said I should tell you all that she is "Amazing") Finally, we live in FL, ..... but we WILL be back!

I've had multiple dishes from Roberts, Steak sandwich, grouper pasta, the salad is amazing.. to say the least if you're looking for yummy home cooked meals this is the place to go. Very friendly staff!

My wife and I have visited twice, and another time with friends. While we like the food and beer choices, the service is inexcusably very slow. We visited on a Saturday afternoon around 5:00 and the place was only 1/3 full. Took a while for our server to greet us, arrived just when we were about to get up and leave. Ordered a beer for each of us and waited at least 10 minutes before I finally got up to ask the bartender about our drinks (after watching him not making any drinks for several minutes and serving a few others who just arrived at the bar). I could barely get the words out before he says they'll be right up. I sit back down, and he still doesn't pour them. We were about to leave again when another bartender made eye contact and she poured the drinks and brought them to us. While our waitress was friendly, she should have been checking on our drinks. Same slow experience with the other two visits, this time we are certain we will not be back.

Walked in for a pedicure and gel manicure. I was taken right away. The guy who did my nails took his time and really cleaned up my terrible cuticles. They were friendly and reasonably priced ($57 for pedicure and gel manicure). They also have the powder option available too.

As far as places to eat in Plant City go, having Wayback here definitely adds some variety. That being said, it's not the  greatest burger I've ever had. In addition, adding fries and a drink jacks up the price another 2 or 3 dollars. Not quite the price you're looking to pay for just ok food.

The fries are good. I ordered a milkshake on my most recent visit and it was ok. I'm not sure if it had real banana in it or banana syrup. It tasted rather fake. I thought I was ordering the advertised shake but I couldn't read the menu because I'm red-green colorblind.

So, ate here for breakfast one morning as it was close to the convention. 

I ordered the seafood omelet with croissant and grits. 

The omelet was descent, the croissant dry and bland, but the grits amazing. I recommend you eat the grits, and go for some eggs and bacon. I think i would go back.

Bellagio has proven time and time again to be the hands down best pizza joint in Nashville. Prices, amazing. Food, astounding. Service, extraordinary. Great hours, outdoor seating, speedy delivery, and lovely people. 

I recommend the spinach artichoke pizza, Italian Stromboli, and the fried mushrooms.

Coffee is decent, prices are alright for there coffee the food is way overpriced for the quality that you get. And they have a huge drive thru issue sometimes  you can't even drive down the road because people have blocked it waiting to order.

One of my favorite places to eat in Indy. Food is excellent -- best jambalaya in town, for sure -- and the staff's always friendly and eager to please. I always take friends from out of town when they visit.

My only complaint would be about the Styrofoam plates and plastic ware used in many of their locations. Real plates and silverware would be great, especially for the environment.

If this review were based solely on the waitstaff, and presentation it would get a five.  Our waiter was attentive without being annoying, and when my sister and I said we were going to share everything, they brought the sandwich that we ordered on two plates.  We ordered two appetizers, the chicken tamales and the avocado fries, and the chicken Monsieur sandwich, and just asked the waiter to bring it all at once, which he did.  The avocado fries were pretty delicious and I love the sauce that they serve with it.  The tamales were OK and the chicken sandwich, while it was kind of inventive and the description of it in the menu made it sound delicious, it was just OK also.  The coleslaw served with the sandwich was very oniony.... not to our liking.  Everything was served really beautifully and I really liked the dishware that they use there.
