Unbelievable. Un-be-FREAKING-lievable. You've been to Longwood a dozen times, right? It's amazing, isn't it? Well, it turns out that there is more than one way to be an amazing, world-class horticultural jewel. Chanticleer is smaller, more private, more... Hell, I don't know: polished? There's lots more chairs? You should just come. It's absolutely amazing.

Wow...what a treat. Stopped by for a fast bite and we were amazed at the excellent pizza and burger.  We are nyc pizza snobs and this place rivals nyc pizza.  They suggested the eggplant pizza and we were glad we took their advice. Nice thin crust amd flavorful toppings. The burger looked like it was fresh meat not a preformed patty.  Served on a big kaiser roll. Will be back next time we are in area. Right across from walnut st theater.

Picky sushi eaters may find things a little fishy, and might do better to stick with rolls.  The Sakana roll is worth trying.

They offer an extensive sake selection, including brands that don't have US distributorship.

I've been eating here for about two years now and I've never had any major complaints with the place. Sure, it's no five star restaurant - but it IS the perfect place to go to when you're suddenly experiencing a case of the munchies at 3am (I'm an insomniac). I've tried just about everything that they have to offer, but I regularly eat their yummy house omelette with cheese grits. It usually hits the spot. 

The staff is friendly, expect for maybe the occasional bimbos ( that usually don't last long). If you become a regular, you'll  get to experience interesting characters strolling in late a night that will offer you much amusement. 

Worth checking out if you're looking for an alternative to the Waffle House and Denny's. Plus, it's a local business - so show some support!

Beef skewers were flavorful, chicken breast and parmesan risotto was good, but the tortellini was absolutely delicious!! The pear mojito was very good and the fresh bread was a hit! Kids meal they enjoyed mac n cheese and burger, def a must have
Five stars!!! The only complaint is that they don't take credit cards ( there is an ATM)... Great service and friendly staff. I would tell everyone to get your noodle fix!

Great place to stop by for some quick, delicious, authentic Mexican food. Tacos are great! They have a great salsa bar and the atmosphere is nice and cozy. The place is small and it is hard to find parking since they share it with other businesses but it is worth the hassle. If you are craving some tacos, this is the place to go! Haven't tried everything but looking forward to it when I am in town again!
Pretty cool place with average pricing. The atmosphere is fun with that everywhere and an outdoor area with games. I would recommend flights and appetizers.

If you are looking for a place to give you a little culture, drink a little coffee or beer, and soak up the rays - this is the place for you! (If you are a college student in Indianapolis, bring your ID for free admission!) The musuem itself has a little for everyone with a great variety in artistic eras and styles. I loved the contemporary art on the fourth floor (and the many volunteers who were more than willing to explain to me what I was actually looking at). 
If you are coming on a nice day, you have to check out the Spring Blooms gardens. There are seemingly endless paths to wander throughout that will eventually lead you by the Lilly house through gorgeous greenhouses and to a beer garden! There is ample seating at the beer garden (you can also get wine, coffee, and snacks), and it is a great place for people of all ages. We posted up for a couple hours, and it ended up being the perfect way to spend a sunny Saturday.
Absolutely one of my favorite places in Florida! The crab & shrimp quesadilla is so good!

I've been to a few hibachi restaurants , this was my least favorite , to start I made a reservation they wouldn't let us four people sit down , we had one person on the way who was stuck in traffic and got a little lost , there was plenty of tables open and they could have allowed us to sit then we weren't seated until 30 mins after the reservations , the guy that cooked the food was not very entertaining honestly the only reason they got 3 stars is cause the waitress was a sweet heart and the rice was delicious.

Listen, don't worry about the service. There is only usually one server and she does the best she can. Seat yourself and you will be waited on. This stuff is good.

I love Vietnamese food and I find that each place in Nashville has their own specialty. My favorites a Kien Giang are the Banh Mi Thit Nuong and the noodle salads. 

Get the noodle salad with pork and shrimp. I'm not a big fan of the sauce it comes with (that would be some mix of fish sauce, garlic, pickled veggies and seasonings), but I love to put a good bit of peanut sauce on top. My Vietnamese family feels the need to remind me that this "is so American" but whatever. It tastes good.

But the real winner here is the Banh Mi. Banh Mi are Vietnamese style sandwiches. This means french baguette topped with grilled pork, some kind of butter spread (try not to think about it), pickled veggies, cilantro, and jalapeno. I have no idea what they do to it. I'm not 100% sure why the meat is slightly pink. But I don't care. I could eat 5 of these. And at just $2.75 each, I could probably afford it. 

I also recommend Cafe Sura Da at any Vietnamese restaurant. It's not healthy but, if you like coffee and you have a sweet tooth, you'll enjoy it.

Oh yea and CASH OR CHECK ONLY! Just saying.
My favorite theater!!! Not all the theaters are converted but the ones that are sure are comfy!! Great staff. Join the movie club and get great perks!!!

Beautifully and thoughtfully decorated. You feel like you are transported from
Indianapolis to Paris. Presentation has always been lovely, but not all cakes are created equally. The chocolate Earl cake is very decadent and delicious. Also the cherry-topped cheesecake was perfectly rich and amazing. If you are an avid red velvet eater, you may be disappointed because this one does not have a cream cheese icing. Instead, there's a whipped 'buttercream icing. Similarly, the black and white cake has the same underwhelming airy 'butter cream' icing that is bland and left a film on the roof of my mouth. I have yet to try any of the cookies or pies but I can't wait to go back and try some more treats. It's always a pleasant experience, I just want to love each cake, and it has been hit or miss.
*EDIT* I have since returned and tried the French silk pie. I died. The graham cracker crust is On. Point.

I am going to get a lot of grief for this post... but I just don't get the hype. I have tried their "frozen custard" on several occasions, and I don't think that they are that great. They are incredibly rich and if you can finish an entire small custard you are likely to have a stomach ache. I will say-- they know how to crank out the concretes.  If you stop by their shop in South St. Louis-- don't be overwhelmed by a line that wraps around the building.  In 10 minutes or less you'll have your chance to order. I prefer frozen yogurt or gelato-- something a little lighter.

So, an omnivore and his vegetarian, pescetarian, vegan, paleo and gluten-free friends walk into the same restaurant for lunch. An hour later, all leave satisfied. That's it, that's the punch-line. Despite the potential humor/horror of a chef attempting to cater to every modern dietary concern, the creative cuisine being served at BFF Café is no joke.

The sign says "your body's best friend" and the menu is "powered by SoDo". Fitness magazines are casually laid out on the fireplace coffee table and the parent SoDo Restaurant is known for fresh ingredients, so right away you know processed foods won't be on the menu.

The decor is simple and stylish with seating for perhaps 50 plus patio seating for warmer months. Ordering is informal; menus available at the counter, place your order and seat yourself. One thing I found odd was being directed to serve myself water from a soda fountain set behind the counter, yet our food was delivered to the table. Maybe it's just me.

There are two menus. The green menu features high protein, low fat dishes with nutritional information listed for each. The orange menu is full of American favorites including buffalo wings, fajitas, chicken fingers and sandwiches including cheesesteak and french dip. We were there to try the green menu, but if the orange is anything like the food at SoDo it's probably pretty good.

Cauliflower pizza has become a trendy option for those avoiding gluten and/or carbs. BFF's version is served as two 5" mini pies with grilled chicken, red sauce, roasted red pepper, red onion, goat cheese, mozzarella, and fresh basil ($8). I don't know the recipe for their "crust", but most involve steamed and pulverized cauliflower blended with cheese, egg and other ingredients to form a sort of dough. In fact, the texture reminds me of undercooked pizza, but not in a gross, doughy way. It's not really pizza, but it is packed with a ton of flavor and nutrition.

Zoodles are long, thin strands of zucchini used in place of pasta. You can blanch them a bit to make the texture more pasta-like, but the entire house zoodle salad was raw including zoodles, cucumber, onion, tomato, goat cheese, mixed greens, lemon house dressing, and red pepper coils ($8). The dressing was very good and the flavors were well-combined, though I think the greens got lost amongst the mounds of shredded zucchini. We went veggie but you can add chicken, prawns, salmon, or tri-tip for an additional fee

My wife's clucker bowl ($11) was loaded with grilled chicken, zoodles, cabbage, peppers, red potato and red onion, lightly drizzled with blue cheese dressing. Again, I think the amount of zoodles overwhelmed a bit, but the chicken and potatoes were tender and well-seasoned. My wife was more than pleased with her selection.

I wandered off the veggie train with a beefalo burger ($14) sporting an 8 ounce blend of ground beef and bison, blue cheese crumbles, spinach, balsamic-marinated tomato, and mushrooms sandwiched between two squares of grilled falafel bread (cauliflower bread can be substituted for $3 extra). I was pleasantly surprised with the "bread" and it held up well to the well-topped burger. The meat was cooked exactly to order and the mix of flavors and textures worked remarkably well. In other words, I really enjoyed it. The quinoa salad I chose as a side was less amazing, but my wife happily added it to her bowl. Next time I'll order the cauliflower sticks.

This place is just getting started but I think they're on the right track. I'm told they'll be replacing the beefalo with a pure bison burger, and breakfast offerings are in the future. If you're looking for healthy options that are both delicious and filling, BFF Café could indeed become your best friend forever.

This review was a long time coming, but 6.30 AM pizza cravings (yes, there are days like this) gave me a nudge.  One must know, firstly, that there is a beer and a slice special for five bucks.  Can't beat that.  I usually get wine (which is over-priced, but good selection and amply poured).  The toppings choices are pretty much anything under the sun, and the crust is just right.
  On one visit, the bartender Tierney was apologetic about how long it was taking to bring my order - frankly i didn't notice.  The kitchen gave me a free second slice (i would have ordered one anyways).  
   What really stood out-all that aside- was the flair with which Miss Tierney handled her bar, the phone orders, and tables.  Add that to some well-wishers who came in to congratulate her on a newly-revealed pregnancy.  Some other employees have trouble enough doing just one of those tasks (but i like them just the same).  
   All in all, when i find meself working uptown this is a perfect excuse to unwind, watch some Jeopardy with enthusiastic others, and have some satisfying slices.
Had a hamburger there the other day. No wonder the place was empty. Terrible French Onion Burger!! A Coors Lite draft was $4! Come on!! Another chain restaurant to avoid.

Don't bother coming to this bar when there are plenty of others around. We only stopped in for the country music, and drinks were such a rip off. Seriously...$10.50 for two bottles of bud light. I shouldn't have even given you tip!

Also, who charges to ride a bull. All the places I've ever been with one lets you do it for free. Total tourist trap and not worth the visit.

I come here maybe once a month.  I dont have anytthing bad to say about the place.

I am usually out of there in 20-30 minutes.  the $19 option is the best way to go

Dropped in here one night with my wife about 15 minutes before closing time. As soon as we walked in, the "barista" (hard for me to call her that) was seated at a table and was obviously not happy that she had to get up to serve us. She forced a grin and asked what we would like. My wife ordered a caramel iced latte and I ordered an espresso. Being that I love Buddy Brew coffee, I was happy to see that was the coffee they used. She then asked my wife if she wanted sugar in her latte....wait, what?! Red flag! No good coffee shop asks patrons if they want sugar added to their drink - they should want you to taste the coffee! It would be like going to Ruth's Chris or Morton's and having them ask you if you want A1 sauce for your prime steak. Anyway, my wife declined and a few minutes later we were served our coffees. My espresso was sour because the double shot poured way too fast, under extracting the coffee. My wife, who isn't the coffee snob I am and drinks Dunkin & Starbucks, took a sip and gave me the look of "yeah, this isn't good."  We walked out of the shop and my wife immediately said, "I can't even force this down," and threw her drink away. What a waste of money. This "barista" figured out how to take good, freshly roasted coffee and ruin it. I hope the issue is isolated to her, and based on the other reviews here maybe it is, but we will not be back.

My husband and I stayed at the Sandyland Reef Inn while visiting Santa Barbara for a conference. We are both low maintenance travelers, so I was pleasantly surprised by the cleanliness and comfort of the room we stayed in. It was also incredibly cheap! For only $48/night, this is a great deal. 

We would definitely consider staying here again.

Pros: 
+ Newly remodeled bathrooms- floor and shower seem to be brand new stone. 
+ Extremely inexpensive by comparison to every other motel in the area
+ A short 15-min drive to downtown SB. 
+ Large king-sized bed, mini fridge, flatscreen TV. 

Cons:
- The lock on our door did not work. We used the chain lock that had been mounted on the door, though.
- No closet (but clothing rack on the wall)
- No bathtub, only a shower
- No blow dryer or clothing iron. 

The room had a two small tables, one for work (with phone on it) and one breakfast table at the window.

if you want an honest,real upfront electrical contractor select electric should be your first choice,they have done work in my house off and on for the last couple of months(ceiling fans,new light fixures,the prices are great no hidden charges and russ the electrican was very professional and on most courteous person ive ever met.russ was very easy to talk with, and  knew how i wanted the work done and he did do it right.again i cant thank select electric enough for all of there effort and up scale work
jim c

I am with everyone that has had a bad experience dealing with Thoroughbred Nissan (I have had a few). I wish I could post zero stars as well. It seems the good reviews they receive come from sales...DUH! If I was making money I would kiss butt also. Just wait until after your car is in your hands and something is wrong, these guys don't give a crap about the customer which is always the problem with big companies, they laugh at the little guy once there is trouble. 

Take a look at the BBB reports (they have 13 complaints against them) I wish I had checked it out before I bought my truck there. The mechanics are either clueless or they sabotage vehicles on purpose so you have to go back.  I will say one thing for sure...I WILL NEVER buy a car or truck from them again and would NEVER recommend this place to anyone! I will most likely never buy a Nissan again...My experience has left such a bad taste in my mouth, I am going with a Toyota!!!!!! 

I am so frustrated I could just spit.

I had my first tattoo done here by Billy and I love it. I had no problems with it after and it looks great. The shop is very nice and is in a nice area to spend the day or just stop by. Although we waited awhile because there are no appointments, it was worth the wait. I wanted a phrase in my best friend's handwriting and he traced it for me and had the whole thing done in about ten to fifteen minutes. He was very nice and I got exactly what I wanted. Three of my friends have also gotten piercings there and the woman is very professional. None of us have had any problems with Liberty Tattoo, I'm sure we'll be back soon.

I agree with some of the other recent reviews. The Earls Court chocolate cake is wonderful but I feel since the opening the quality of the cakes has definitely gone down. I have had several pieces that I felt were definitely passed their freshness. Last week I had a wonderful chocolate chip cookie but today the cookie it was nothing like the other. I've had better frozen toll house.  For five dollars I will never purchase another cookie there.

Ok I lied.  I just bought a sugar cookie for a friend.  AGAIN my dissatisfaction and disappointment are so much more than the ridiculous $7 I paid for ONE average size but extremely below average cookie.  STAY AWAY from the cookies and stick with a piece of cake.
Delicious food, large quantity, love the atmosphere. Bento box is a deal! Fresh and delicious sushi, too. Will be back for sure

We've been here twice and enjoyed it both times. Had the fish and chips once (good) and an assortment of burgers (very good), also liked the salads and all beef chili. As an aside, the burgers are rectangular in shape.. unnerving? yes, but it worked for me. 

Service is good and waitresses all seem to have some personality. 

Good assortment of libations, plenty of TV's for sports but overall a good atmosphere for just hanging out. They were really good about keeping my Diet Coke topped off!  :)

We'll be back

My first time coming here, I order the Curry Goat for take out, I got the large which was $15 cause I was going to get the small, but my mom insist on me getting the large.. Everything seem to taste good too me, I wonder how the small portion would have looked compared to the larger

To be completely honest, probably the worst pho I've ever had. I ordered for pick up 20 mins prior to arriving, and my food wasn't ready. I told the gentleman at the front that I had a to-go order, and he just walked away without saying anything. I waited for maybe 10-15 minutes, unaware of what was actually going on.

When I actually tasted the pho, the broth was completely flavorless, and a lot lighter than any other I've seen. The noodles were dry and almost a weird crunchy, and the beef was extremely chewy. It wasn't inedible, but I hope somewhere in Boise there is better pho.

How can you not like this place? Fresh water upon arrival followed by healthy food with a twist. The service has always been exemplary so no complaints there. This is one of the few joints in Tampa that can appease an array of crowds - hipsters love the decor, drink selections, etc.; geriatrics enjoy the healthy food portions, friendliness, etc.; and out-of-towners relish the overall uniqueness of the place. This is beyond highly recommended.

We were staying in Clayton and looking for a place to eat in walking distance from our hotel.   We had the meat me, the special, and the cocka-doodle-noodle and the smokehouse salad.  The food was great and fresh.  The place has a cool vibe and clean.  Our server/food runner was not impressive!!  We got the Nutella to go and my wife and kids loved it.  Overall it was a good experience.

I love the food here, especially the small pizza lunch special. However, the service here is ways so slow. I can never pick up my food at the estimated time I'm given online and I'm constantly having to try and grab someone's attention from the back to be helped. They always seem understaffed, which doesn't make sense for a lunch rush. The only thing keeping me coming is my love for their deep dish pizza with turbo crust. If you want to eat here frustration-free, I suggest you come at a time that other people normally don't eat around.

The best reason to come to Church's...the biscuits.  I am sure they are covered in some kind of lard type concoction...but man are they delicious...

The chicken is cut differently than you are probably used to (thighs and legs together, etc.) so that might throw you, but it's far better than KFC...and seriously, the rolls...wow.

Before I arrived at the Peppermill Hotel I looked it up to see how will it be. To be honest nothing impressive, just another obscure 3-4 star hotel. 
Totally not the case.

This is a CLASSY Italian themed hotel/resort/casino that did not fail to impress my positively. 

Actually this room I had at the top floor in the Tuscanny tower is AWESOME. Pictures don't do justice

Yummy bagels, soup, sandwich, coffee, and breakfast place. Very friendly staff. It was pretty similar to panera (bread co) just a bit of a smaller local chain. I'd have to go back several times to figure out all the differences. I think there would be some advantages to not receiving like frozen ingredients from corporate or something.

Not exactly my kind of food, but it would be good to sit and work or meet up with a friend over coffee. Always nice for coffee places to have real food options though.

I'm absolutely in love with this place. I've tried so many different things here and have loved everything. This place serves true delicious quality coffee, not overly sweet drinks. Definitely recommend this place for any real coffee lovers.
Great change of pace from my usual Mexican spot on Cherokee. Salsa and torta were both excellent. Will definitely be coming back here.

Had a pretty good experience here, was in NOLA for the weekend, it happeend to be essence fest weekend, super busy, both me and my buddy got tattoos, got right in, they even called in their Script and lettering expert Stephen for me. Stephen killed it, will even be better when I come back to finish it, and my buddy got his work done by chopper Pete and he's killed it too. Check them out! Won't be disappointed.

Excellent! Some of the best pizza I've ever had, great cheesesteaks and pastas. We usually order take-out... the one complaint I have about this place is that they will always say "20-25 minutes" for a pick-up, but it's usually longer (especially on weekends). Oh, and if they delivered I'd give them 10 stars!

Pretty much everyone on staff is friendly, especially the owners' older sons. You can tell it's a really nice family business and probably a nice place to work (when they're not frantically running around taking orders and passing out food!)

Well-priced, huge portions, nothing to add beyond what other reviewers have said except you should definitely eat here. They recently expanded their seating area and also have a nice pub-type of restaurant next door if you want more beer options and some other food choices (less "Italian").

It's a dive bar, so I won't knock it for character. But even dive bars have good, solid drinks. We did the Ghost Tour, which came with 2-for-1 hurricanes. But instead of a Pat O'Brien's style concoction, we got the Gatorade Thermos variety for $12.00. Which is still $6.00 a piece, once you look past the 2-for-1 deal. As for the drink itself: they should rename it a "gust," since that's how hard it hits you. I imagine that after drinking 20 cups of this stuff, you could get your buzz on. So, there you have it: $6.00 iced Kool-Aid. Aside from that, the atmosphere was on par with your standard NOLA dive bar. Nothing special.

The food is okay...not fantastic,  just ho-hum okay. The service varies from wonderful to frustrating. ..it is always disappointing and unappealing to have dirty tables, seats and floors when you are eating. ...it's understandable IF the place is crazy busy but not when there are just a few tables occupied.  But even if the place is crazy busy...clear the tables ,clean off the seats so you don't leave customers waiting....I don't know if it is staffing issues or something else. It's a shame because this could be a go to hang out spot for friends to have a drink and meal....but grabbing a burger at the place one block down the 21 Burger joint was a better experience. ...and I have give this place a dozen chances..

R2L is a beautiful restaurant/bar with breathtaking views and a nice bar and good service. The food was mixed, in my opinion. I stuck to several vegetarian options on the menu (as opposed to "special vegetarian options" that are not advertised on the menu). The bread is delicious but I found the dishes to be far too salty and one of the dishes to have an absolutely excessive amount of cheese, in addition to being salty. It did not taste bad, but it is just not humanly possible to eat that much cheese without becoming ill. What could have been a tasty, relatively hearty meal turned into something sloppy.

Great food and service! Our first visit we did not have a reservation, and our wait was twice as long as the hostess told us, so I highly recommend a reservation! Our waitress was fantastic, and took great care of us. We tried the crab, spinach, and artichoke dip, the "famous" salad, fried shrimp, fries/onion straws, and crawfish etouffee. Everything was wonderful.

Love their coffee, but what a continuing disappointment this place has become, as its staff consistenly decides to pack up long before the listedclosing time.  So they shut things down or actually wash the floor around you because it's "not busy."  What a way to run a business.  We really like their coffee and much prefer it over Starbucks, but come on, more than an hour before closing and everything's cleaned.  This has happened so many times, we simply won't go back unless it's early in the day. I wish I had the owner's name to tell him what goes on when he's not around.
Ziggy burger fabulous. Managers attitude sucks. Will not return due to her.
Cider... And corn chowder... I'm a happy guy...

Was looking for a new place to go and we saw this new Thai Restaurant, so we gave it a shot.. and I'm so glad we did. The food is so good!! The place is completely brand new and in a comfortable setting, the staff are friendly, and of course the PRICE--- super affordable! I definitely recommend trying their Thai Fish Cake and of course the Pad Thai, my all-time favorite!

all those 5 stars reviews. Really??grilled pork chop was dry. cat fish, the green curry broth came with it was too salty. they measured exactly less than 1/3 of wine glass for $9. way way overrated...

Horrible customer service.  Customers should be allowed to try on other sizes.  You can give me advice on how it should fit, but don't make me stand there peeking out of the fitting room doorway, half dressed, trying to justify why I just want to *try* another size.  I know how I want my lingerie to fit and will go elsewhere where I won't be put in such a humiliating situation.

I met Teresa 3 years ago outside in front of what now is her restaurant. We start talking because we were both waiting for Dr Anna to open her Metaphysical store.
Teresa was such a delight with her warm hugs and award winning smile. Being in the restaurant business for over 20 years and owning my own catering company, I knew she would succeed.Everything is wonderful !! I live in Clearwater and I always look forward to take my husband or my girlfriends there for a treat.The Garden Veggie Delight is so delicious.Blackberry Jasmine Green tea is so good and refreshing. The Wiki Wiki Wraps are so fresh and are scrumptious.Teresa"s mom is also a delight, they are so warm and fuzzy..hugs, hugs, and more hugs Teresa and mom really make you feel you are part of the family. You must try this little hidden paradise restaurant you won't be disappointed. Everything is just so fresh and there coffee and deserts make the meal complete. Teresa you will be in business a long time because you are the package deal !!!!!
Benita Hallam
Love the atmosphere and also the food! Drinks were great, bartenders were friendly and recommended drinks for you

My beloved massage therapist left the country and it is difficult to find a new place after that happens. She recommended Indy Massage Company and I have appreciated the recommendation. I have had massages with a few of the massage therapists and they do a great job every time. Yesterday I decided to tack on a facial with Chelsea and she did a fantastic job. The facial was very relaxing and and my skin looks great. I was happy that I was able to stay in the room for my facial and massage so I was very relaxed after I left. Also, their scheduling system is very convenient. You can schedule on line and they are open 7 days a week.

Just a short walk from the Repritory Theatre, this is a fantastic dinner option! The restaurant was packed on a Saturday night, but we had reservations so we were sat straight away. 
Our waiter was very hospitable and professional. I was happy with their varied and extensive by the glass wine list. I ordered the Oregon Pinot Gris to drink then ordered the Greek Salad sans-cheese and roasted cauliflower with spinach and tomatoes. Our food came out promptly with the exception of my boyfriend's mom's main dish, which followed about 5 minutes later. My food was fantastic! The salad portion was generous and the cauliflower was fantastic. For my second glass of wine, I enjoyed a Sangiovese. 
All of us enjoyed our meals and experience and they even took the delayed dish off the bill.
5 stars!.

Loved it! My boyfriend and I came here for breakfast on a Saturday morning. The orange juice was fresh squeezed and delicious. We both loved our food and the staff were friendly. We will definitely be coming back.
I, only gave 1 star because based on the appearance of the building,  it was not well maintained.  Obliviously, they are not making money and when u are not making $,  they might have nasty menu.

Pita jungle has some of the tastiest food especially for the healthy conscious! Been here a few times ordered lunch one time and everything went smoothly. Also been here for team lunches. This time for my daughter who has never dined here. Started with the cilantro jalapeño hummus. Why would you not! We ordered the lavish turkey pewrap and a lamb gyro. Can I just say the lamb had a crispiness that added-a ton of flavor. The amount of sauce was just right! And let it be known that you could taste the freshness in every bite. I tasted the wrap and it too was crispy and full of flavor. We sat out on the patio, first time for me, usually I don't like to sit on the patios I feel like I might be missed or forgotten but not here! Service was spot on and everything came out as asked even down the lemon I asked for in my water! Really good and impressed with all.

I hadn't been to Lulu's in a couple of years and finally made it back the other day. Absolutely delicious. I can't believe I'd forgotten how good of a neighborhood eatery this is. I ordered a calzone with pepperoni, sausage and basil. And I was not prepared for what I was going to receive. The portion was more than I expected and the sauce served with my calzone was amazing. I was very satisfied by the quality of my meal and the ingredients used to make it. Also the staff were very friendly and helpful. Thank you Lulu's!

Great atmosphere and the servers were awesome! !
I live about an hour away and just happen to see this place driving by while working and it caught my attention because my daughters name is Gia...I took my family there the following day!! The manager come over and welcomed us and made small talk and we mentioned that our daughter's name was Gia he tought that was cool he then took our drink order...the waitress then came over and she was very nice as well...right before our food come out the manager come back over and give my daughter a Gia's pizza staff Tshirt...it made her day!!!...The pizza  and wings was GREAT!!!!...we will be returning to this great pizza joint!!....

EVERY company does the same thing. They hope you do not look at your bill when your contract is up and they hope you ignore the letter they send you (assuming you have a contract of six months or more) and then the variable rates go up to double what you would be paying otherwise. It is a bit slimy, yes indeed. Did I get caught, yup! Then I made sure every renewal was on my calendar. Problem solved.

I picked up lunch from here the other day. I ordered the burger. LOVEDDDD it. Can't wait to go back! It had a nice chew to the burger patty part and there was smoked tempeh on the burger. The tempeh was a little salty but overall, really great and filling. If you like your food extra sauce, ask for sauce on the side too! I couldn't finish the whole thing and had to save it for later because it was a massive burger. Def one of the better veggie burgers I've had! I'll probably head back within the next week to try something else new:)

We just finished our stay at The Saint and we couldn't get out of there fast enough!  We stayed 6 nights and I think this was the worst hotel we've ever stayed in. The  bed was rock hard and so uncomfortable that we had trouble sleeping. We asked for a different room and were told that the would sort it out and call us...they never did call. We followed up with the manager who said she would see what she could do for us. We never heard from her again either. I should say that she offered us a free breakfast buffet for that morning. It was 10:55 when she offered it and breakfast ended at 11. Total slap in the face. 

While our room was clean, we had to request shampoo, etc to be replenished.  They didn't automatically do that.  Our belongings were shoved around to make room for towels, etc and dirty face clothes were left hanging in the bathroom day after day. 

While the location of the hotel is fantastic, we will never stay here again. Stuff can happen during a stay so it becomes about how the staff deals with it. The staff at The Saint just didn't care.
The ticket clinic has always managed to help me with my tickets . I'm not sure why all the negative reviews but it has worked out great for me . Give them a try !
Awesome! Great food, great service! Our waitress Rebecca was wonderful! The Moco Loco was amazing!

Been there twice. One of the most bland and uninteresting Indian Restaurants I've ever been to, even for suburbia, and I've been to plenty places in the US and UK. Maybe the best antidote is to go to an interesting and sophisticated place in Center City Philadelphia like IndeBlue, but frankly even mainstream places like Indian Restaurant in Philly or Indian Garden in Yardley are better. 

Added one star for apparent cleanliness.

So today was a day where my wife wanted to try something different and new. Cool, why not I mean new is always good right!! But in this case it was WRONG!! In so many ways.

We were out and driving down Dale Mabry and she said let's go into this shopping area. We were surrounded by different options and she saw [Jazz] open for breakfast, New Orleans style food so she was sold!! When you walk in you can see the potential in it, though the decor was to dark especially during the day you could see the vision they had for when it was a Jazz night. 

The Hostess Petal was 1 of 2 things that were right for our visit here. The 2nd was the 2 for 1 Mimosas she made, OMG!!! Not shy with the champagne just the way a Mimosa should be. So we were like okay we might be okay here. Once the food arrived it was straight downhill and what's so bad about it is you want to root for this place. Every thing that came out you can tell there is no love being put into these dishes. Every last one looked like something you can make at home and even better looking as well.

My wife had the chicken and waffles, lil man had pancake [1] and eggs and I had the Tace classic egg Benedict which came with / thinly sliced ham, two poached eggs, topped w/ Louisiana hot sauce Hollandaise. Choice of fresh fruit, grits or brabant potato. When the plate arrived no ham [for it wasn't thawed] So they replaced it with bacon. I wasn't asked if I wanted grits or fruit they just decided for me and did put what suppose to be a fancier named for home fries [Brabant potato].

The food was something a guy might try to make to impress his girlfriend that spend the night. I do believe a real CHEF is needed and not that average Joe they have back there cooking. Because nothing is New Orleans about their food. I can see why this place is empty and Starbucks is winning. Goes to show you people would rather have microwave food then this establishment food. Next time if we decide to come again will be for Petals 2 for 1 Mimosas she made us cause this was the only thing worth paying for.

Got into Lambert-St. Louis International Airport in the evening - around 7:30 pm. Took the Hertz shuttle bus out to the rental car facility. Name was on the board, quickly found my car and was on the way.

On the way back, pulled in, got my receipt and started to walk over to the pickup spot. The shuttle bus had already left - but the shuttle bus driver saw me and stopped the shuttle and waved me over!

My Grandparents introduced me to Kinjo's at a family dinner and they adore it... and now we do also!  It's fantastic.  The family that owns it are the sweetest bunch.  The customer service is great.  We have only had one "questionable" meal and they immediately replaced it.  The sushi is amazing, the portions are HUGE.  The TOFU and veggie tempura are my fave and they are delish.  The only thing I miss here is fried rice, but I would always come here over Arigato's.  Far more down to earth, reasonably priced, they have SUSHI for those who want it, they have fantastic salad, they offer tofu, great seafood, lots of menu options, early bird specials.  Just about everything you could want.  

They are open for a couple hours for lunch during the week and we plan to start taking advantage of that!  Be careful, they do close early sometimes if they aren't busy toward the end of the night, so you may want to call ahead if it's nearing closing time.  

It's very quiet, great place to have a good first date, can actually carry on a conversation here.  Good spot for a family dinner or having a nice big party and feel like you have privacy.  The sushi bar seating is cute as well.  

One of our favorites.

I love it here. The nachos are by my favorite thing here. The food is always good. The burgers are great. The beer selection is nice too. If you are going during the weekend dinner rush, get a reservation.

I enjoyed my meal, but the quoted wait time was wildly inaccurate, seating very cramped, others in my party were not wowed, and service was a bit uneven.  Came here for breakfast on a Saturday and the small storefront was overflowing with people.  We put in our request for a table for 4 and was told it would be a 45 minute wait.  We decided to wait and walked a few blocks uptown to grab a cup of coffee.  45 minutes came and went.  Then another 45 minutes came and went.  I would say our wait was closer to 90 minutes.  Don't you appreciate when places overestimate the time of your wait so you feel lucky when you are seated prior to the quoted time?  Doesn't it leave a bad taste in you mouth when your wait time far exceeds that time that has been quoted?  

When we were finally seated, we were put a small table, and seriously it was cramped and not very comfortable.  One of the highlights was the juice I ordered, a ginger grapefruit and something else I forget..whatever it was it was delicious.  Although I was the only one in my party to be served in a to go cup, which looked a little smaller than the glasses others had gotten.  I guess they ran out of those.  We finally ordered and waited patiently. Servers seemed overworked. The food took a bit of time to arrive, and when it did it looked great.  I had the shrimp and grits.  Shrimp was plentiful, a nice sized portion, very good buttery creamy grits, and a savory sauce with decent kick.  A really nice dish.  My friend's corned beef hash was  a little strange..Huge chunks of corned beef was a little too tough.  Another friend's egg and ham steak combination did not look like anything special.  An omelet looked good.  Overall it was a good meal, but not worth the wait.  Also, no bloody Mary's or alcohol here, which when in New Orleans, is sometimes what you need in the morning.  I'd return but would be skeptical of wait times.  Parties of 2 seemed to get seated quicker.

We did a couples massage after work on Friday.  It was a great way to start the weekend.  Alli and April are both very friendly, amicable, and obviously know their trade well.  Even at 5:30PM on a Friday (when the rest of us would be pissed if we were still at work) they were still smiling and welcoming.

The massage was very relaxing, and they make the room into a very serene setting. They made it a point at the beginning to ask good questions to determine what we were looking for from the massage as well as to discuss any areas that we may not want massaged (i.e. feet, hands, face, etc).

We opted for the Swedish massage, but I know they also offer deep tissue and a hot stone/hot room detox massage (which sounds amazing).

Very charming establishment! Very old school soda shop feel. Mason jars that you fill on your own with the water pitcher at your table. The menu was very simple. Just a couple pages with not too many overwhelming choices. I chose the BBQ burger and was very pleased. They cooked the burger to the perfect medium and it was presented on the plate very nicely. When I asked if I could get an order of half onions rings and half fries, which was not on the menu, the server was very accommodating. We finished our meal with a pistachio shake and a white chocolate raspberry. Be warned the small shakes should be called MINI because they were soooo tiny. Still tasted great though. Must go here for a good ole' fashioned burger if you are in the area!
Great combo of indo Chinese . Curry fried rice was the best. Service was very friendly and fast

I LOVE THIS PLACE!! The lunch buffet is amazing.  So many options to choose from both vegetarian and meat dishes.  Whenever I come here for lunch I stuff myself and don't have to eat for the rest of the day! LOL! The man who waits on people at lunch is very friendly and attentive. I come here so much that he knows I like to have sliced lime in my water and I don't even have to ask for it.  He automatically leaves a little dish of sliced limes on my table for me.  This is a place where I can come and enjoy authentic wonderful food with a wonderful atmosphere at a great price.  You won't be disappointed!
Best tacos around hands down! It might look alittle rough on the inside but the food is amazing and the Texas brushfire sauce can't be beat.

If you were expecting tiki this place is so much more.  Pearl diver has an excellent selection of Agave and sugar cane based drinks in addition to a wide selection of tiki drinks that would make their inventors proud.  This place has an island vibe, it reminds me a lot of the broken shaker in Miami Beach but with a Nashville twist.  If you live here or just in town for the weekend this is a must try... don't forget the kitchen....

Bello Nails has to be the best nail salon experience I've ever had.  I came in on a Sunday about an hour and a half before they closed, but my nail tech did not rush.  Initially I told her that I only wanted a pedicure, then midway through my pedi I decided i also wanted a manicure, because she was doing such a nice job!  She had no problem with my last minute change of heart.  I was also brought a complimentary water, which was a kind gesture.  Aside from the amazing service the salon is beautiful, relaxing, and kept up nicely!  The cost of the services is a little pricier than my typical salons but I can truthfully say it was well worth it! I can't wait for my return to Bello!

Great little place ....and it is little.......but the service, food and price can't be beat .......I have been driving by this place for three months now and finials stop in    Should have sooner.  Nice place.   Wil return again

I've only had positive experiences with the front desk, vet techs and veterinarians here. 

I just signed my dog up for the Wellness Plan, too. There's a lot of negative press and reviews surrounding the plan, so I'm hoping it works out well for us. It seemed to make financial sense at the time I signed up. I pay $40/month for unlimited free office visits, standard vaccinations and heartworm/flea prevention. The heartworm/flea pills alone cost $20/month, so that seemed like a great deal.
Food was excellent and very authentic. A lot of Vegan  options. Will definitely be eating here again.
Love everything about this place. The fish tacos our amazing, the cheese dip they light on fire is a great starter, and the seafood chimichanga is fabulous. Great atmosphere as well.

We have gone in previous years and found it much more enjoyable.   This year we got in  under the sign that said VIP and waited about 10 minute to be helped and then were sent to the end of the regular line.  We were finally moved to a shorter line for VIP but not without asking.  We just left at 3:45 and most all wine vendors are out of wine and closed down and it is supposed to last until 5. In every booth we were told " the good stuff went fast" as there wasn't as much.  Additionally the bridge was open to all pedestrians which made it extremely crowded.  We will not be returning next year.

I needed pants hemmed for a nursing school uniform.  Lee was awesome.  He got them done quicker than I needed.  Such a nice man also.  We chatted about nursing school.  Excellent work and reasonable price.  I will ONLY go to Lee from now on.

New to Reno area, but NOT new to back pain and discomfort. Dr. Riley was recommended by family member. Dr. Riley took my case pronto and relief was noticed just as quickly.
 We have progressed in treatment and analysis. Dr. Riley has put forth so much effort in making me feel better, and also informed about our progress. 
I am confident in my future, and am looking forward to continuing a very active healthy lifestyle.
Great thanks to everyone @ Integrated Spinal Solutions. 
Always a pleasant atmosphere and eager to assist!
Mahalo!!

It was my first time getting this type of massage- Michael was great, personable, and made me feel comfortable. After the massage my body felt rejuvenated and relaxed. I recommend it for anyone that feels like they have a stiff back- I feel completely aligned after working with him.

Sometimes during my work day, I have to take a drive to the Williams Centre on Broadway.  As I am headed to and from, I pass the most peculiar storefront that always seems to have a parking situation on a daily basis.  I mean you can't even see the front entrance on most days, the car park is that packed!  It's a place called Wings Over Broadway and I keep hearing positive things about it.  Today is Saturday: my bud/colleague are out of ideas for lunch, so we figure what the hell.

We phoned in a take away order; I ordered a dozen wings, medium flavoured, he orders a dozen, half mild and half lemon pepper.  I also ordered a batch of bacon cheese fries.  Order is ready in fifteen minutes, I get to the store, surprisingly I land a parking space right in front of the main entrance, and the cashier tells me my order had just come out.  Oh shklit, fresh hot wings!

Back at the office break room, we tear the shklit out of that plastic bag, we are both very hungry.  My medium wings are astounding; sauce is not too runny and not too thick; the taste is somewhat less then what I would consider to be medium- more like half mild- half true medium; but it doesn't reek of vinegar and doesn't drip too much so overall I am pleased.  Added bonus; these wings are fried to crispy perfection.  I appreciate a good crisp, as I have had many wings which absorbed too much sauce and rendered into limp mushy nuggets with bones in them; not these wings.  The meat is moist and steamy, no sign of dry to be found.  

I trade with my bud, one of my mediums for one of his lemon pepper.  It was acceptable, a tad dull perhaps because I'm still under the influence of the medium spice.  Its not fair to dismiss a flavour if I can't taste it properly.  I can never understand why anyone would eat an atomic flavoured wing; all you're tasting is the pain from the capsaicin and not the actual morsel.  

Bacon cheese fries are out of this world; homemade seasoned fries smothered with melted cheese and bacon.  Made me sad that I had six more hours to work instead of kicking back at this chicken wing shack with the giant telly showing the UofA Wildcat game with those fries and a nice cold beer.  C'est la vie...

The verdict?  Why on earth did it take me so bloody long to succumb to crispy sauced poultry Nirvana.  I must spread the news about Wings Over Broadway to my friends and family; they have to experience the goodness I had today. Thank you for a wonderful experience.

My sincerest appreciation to the six chickens who made my dining experience possible.

Im a big history nerd. Like real big. A couple of things about me: My friends say that I have a hard-on for history. I love California history. Its like dirty foreplay talk to me.

So when my weekend plans got cancelled at the very last minute and I heard that we were going to Santa Barbara instead I got understandably excited! Oh, the mission! *Squeal*! What I wasn't aware of, though, was the fact that Santa Barbara has a presidio! Being from San Diego, Im well aware of presidios and missions. We have the first ones in California. But unlike San Diego, Santa Barbara actually has a presidio. It may be fake and reconstructed, but its there, and right in downtown SB nonetheless! It was the first established settlement in the town. Since this is the case, the actual area of the presidio is stretched over 4 blocks. like right in the middle of an intersection. 

Whats really cool about this place is that they have reconstructed rooms and signs that tell you of the uses. It may be small, but you can actually see what the presidio was used for. They even have gardens with vegetables and crops growing! It was really cool stopping by after lunch and doing a quick tour of history. No one was there so it felt like I had the whole place to myself. I didnt go into the church area because there was a wedding going on, but it looked interesting from the outside.

This is a nice interesting place to stop for a quick attraction. Theres plenty to do in the area as it is right in the middle of town.

Was looking for some tasty, local fare and I did not have a lot of time to spend waiting for food or a table. The staff set me up with a delicious pork plate with some great sides. Good price and a much shorter wait than anything else nearby, even during the dinner rush. Definitely would recommend to anyone short on time but who doesn't want to skimp on taste!

Nope. Terrible service, terrible food. This is the second time we've made the mistake of going here because I meant to call it into the GOOD thai restaurant 30 seconds down the street but called this one by accident. They forgot the main part of our takeout order and didn't even apologize when I called. Most of the vegetables in my soup were rotting. Never coming back.

If you feed your backyard birds, you need to go here. Not only do they have a varied and gorgeous collection of feeders and bird baths, they also carry an incredible selection of food of all kinds (caterpillars in a can - gourmet bird food!). And they know their stuff. I started going here recently and each time I go I learn something new about birds and bird feeding. The staff is tremendously helpful at making suggestions and pointing you to just what you need. They also have some nice sales promotions from time to time. I also love that they have two cute and friendly shop cats who roam the store.

Not a huge fan. Has the lunch special (2 rolls + salad for $9). The salad is boring and plain- some of the lettuce was browning. The sushi was just ok. My biggest problem was that it all fell apart. I had he spicy shrimp roll which was drenched in sauce and just soggy from all that sauce. The philly roll was pretty good. Won't be getting pick up from here again but was worth a shot to try it.

Found this gem on Yelp while I was nearby picking up my mom and I will definitely be going back!
We ordered the pad Thai and the Umami roll but substituted one of the fish for eel and it was very delicious. My mom and I are both very picky about our food and if it's not to our standard we don't go back. However, this is a spot we will be going to when we take a trip to Nashville! ALSO, the service was great! It was like 9pm and our server was very patient and friendly!!

If your philosoply is the more crap on a pizza the better, then you'll like Black Thorn pizza. And I am not a Chicago style pizza hater, but this stuff has absolutely no balance or finesse. Actually, it in no way resembles any chicago pizza I've ever had. Just loads and loads of gloppy cheese and a heavy, leaden crust that is quite capable of sickening anyone who would dare to eat more than a slice or two.  It just blows my mind that anyone who isn't thoroughly drunk and/or stoned would really like this stuff.
Dined here with my wife a few friends during the holidays and we had a great time... Food was good and atmosphere was great.  We all had a nice time.  Looking forward to going back!

Usually neat and tidy.  I have had pleasant interactions with associates helping me locate products.  I do avoid the dressing rooms, because every time I go near them, their has been workers bitching about one thing or another.  My biggest peeve is their lack of cashiers at the registers.  There are usually only 2-3 open with lines 3+ deep.
1:20 minutes from arrival to food is simply not acceptable.  If waiting 80 minutes for food isn't your thing don't make other plans
Excellent traditional sushi as well as asian/ fusion dishes. Nice airy decor and excellent service!
Bravo! The fried pickles are awesome. They also have great vegetarian options.  Wonderful atmosphere, friendly staff, but parking and getting seats can be tricky.

Perfect. Quality haircuts (male and female) for a good price, and doesn't take too long. 

My partner and I went in for a hair cut. We got Nicole since my partner has curly hair and Nicole knows curly hair. I was expecting to be there for at least 4 hours based on past experience, but at Paris Hair, it took a less than that and cost a lot less. 

My cut is the same cut I have been trying to get from every barber: Short on the sides, longer on the top, layered, no crimping, above the eyebrows and a bit of overhang on the ears. I got the exact cut I wanted with no regrets. I'm 100% satisfied. 

From the salons I've been to, I can compare this place to Barbara Forgione's. However,  Paris Hair blows that place out of the water in price and quality. I'm amazed that such a great place for hair was so close.

BTW: It's by Cilantro, but not in the same plaza. It looks like it is, but it's not.

This is my favorite place to eat delicious pasta in Edmonton. It is all homemade, fresh food, The service is wonderful, and the atmosphere is cosy without being too crowded. Also, the calamari is also the best I've had. Everywhere else it's breaded and/or deepfried, here it is not, served instead with a delicious tomato sauce! I recommend this place to anybody who wishes a truly tasty treat!

I'm a sucker for a place that makes me feel like a cowboy. Well, a little bit at least.
El Camino is one of my favorite places for brunch.
The Baked Huevos Rancheros is glorious. When that skillet gets put in front of my face..... so good! Eggs, pork belly, and all the other goodness all baked just for me! I'll take a mug of cowboy coffee to go with that, thanks! or maybe a Tecate. I don't care if its Sunday Brunch. Screw Monday!
And the side of chili? Set whatever preconceived notion you have of chili by the door. This stuff is great.
And... call my sense of humor juvenile, but I think the "additions" to the big wall photo murals in the bathroom are hilarious.

Five Guys, it is not.  4* because it's a vegan place that I willingly visited based on reviews alone, and state, whilst not under duress, that I would eat here again.  

That said, product called "Chick'n" will always creep me out.  I'm cool with tempeh because that's a product with a name not trying to copy something.  I'm even cool with seitan, and that's some real frankenfood shizzle.  But Chick'n, you're soy protein dammit, so come up with an original name, because there's just no way you taste like a perfectly-executed grilled chicken breast sandwich from, say Village Whiskey (see review).  

If I were to put my "burger" sandwich "meat" up against other veggie burgers, it'd score a solid "meh."  However, the bun, topping, & sauce combinations were really tasty, and if you put an all beef, well-seasoned, well-cooked patty in there, it'd probably be amazing.  

Comparing the best vegan patty to beef is like comparing your sled riding hill to Everest, or putting a vegan in a boxing ring with Tyson...it's just not a fair comparison.  If you're in the mood for vegan (??) by all means go here.  If you're a carnivore, don't expect this place to knock your socks off, but go into it with an open mind to see how the other half lives.

I stopped off here for lunch with a number of colleagues and noticed that the lunch menu had changed. I decided to go light  and went for a cup of avgolemono and a grilled calamari salad. The soup was OK, the squid tasted old. I've loved this place in the past and will revisit hoping this was an exception. 

The new menu is a bit more oriented to lunch with fewer choices.. also a bit of a disappointment.

Dr. Badhia is a very knowledgeable practitioner and kind and gentle with animals. We went in to see him with zero notice for an emergency visit and the doctor treated our poor Pomeranian immediately without hesitation. He filled the scripts while we waited and even called us the next day to check on our little pup. He is A1 in my book! I cant imagine another vet seeing us with no appointment, and then staying well past closing to make sure we received the service that was required. Thank you Dr. Badhia & god bless!

I live in the neighborhood and wanted to try this place, I had a long day at work and I needed to sit down but I really wanted a hot pizza.... Im totally sick of dominoes across the street, I needed some substance. 
My boyfriend and I sat down at the counter and had a glass of wine and watched the owner make our pizzas, we chatted with him and enjoyed the peaceful respite from the normal pizza joint feel. It was cozy and the pizzas were great (Im no expert but I m from philly, and I like a good pizza). The crusts were chewy and soft and flavorful, and the sauce was sweet and mild. 
I am very glad this restaurant is in the neighborhood!

Jamie and his team catered our wedding and they were over the top amazing. The whole process was first class and Jamie could not have been more awesome to deal with. The pizza itself was absolutely amazing as well, all of our guests were raving about it afterwards. If you are looking for a a great catering option I would totally give Jamie a call.

4 stars because it is a unique place, a good find and because the cooking is Sicilian, it's more distinctive than the hundreds of other Italian places in the area.

Portion sizes are sensible so you can have an ante pasta, primo, secondo, and dessert.   BYOB but because you will have several plates here don't expect to save that much.

Gambaretti e faggioli appetizer outstanding as is the sausage appetizer. Pastas are all nice and made in house.  The entrees are good as far as I can tell; haven't had them all yet.  The rabbit is distinctive on the menu but I concur with some of the other Yelp reviews that it is somewhat dry. Desserts are great too.

I also concur with some of the reviews that it is extremely loud.  All of the wood chairs, floor, and walls contribute to this.  I did not mind but it is NOT a quiet little,place.  Definitely need a reservation for this place.

Absolutely loved the food! The decor isn't anything special, and our server was actually kinda weird, but it made it all the more interesting. We ordered two appetizers and entrees, and it was enough food for FOUR people! The food was totally delicious. It's BYOB.

Very disappointed with the experience I had last evening. My friends and I decided on a girls night that began with dinner at Friendlys and ended with a movie close by. We ordered our food at 6pm- so we could leave by 7, for a movie that started at 7:20. None of us ordered anything fancy- chicken fingers, a wrap, a sandwich. At 6:50 our food finally came, and we quickly had to scarf it down in order to leave. (We did let our server know we were headed to the movies after dinner, there was only 5 of us) This was extremely disappointing, even though they offered is boxes to take with us...which honestly, we couldn't even do since we would be at a movie for a few hours. 


We expressed our disappointment to the "Manager," who never even looked up, made eye contact, or engaged in a conversation when we shared with her our experience. All she said was "I gave you a little something off"- Which was $1.50 off the entire check. It wasn't even the discount that irked me- We were looking for someone to validate and at least pretend they were concerned about our experience, and even that was too difficult to do. 

I would just eat at the theater or head to Red Robbins if you're looking for a quick bite to eat. Apparently, the fry times for Friendlies chicken fingers, fries, etc exceed over 20 minutes.
Ok the picture of that hamburger was exactly how it tasted I don't think I ever had a hamburger that was as bad as this one I sent it back and I won't be back. 711 has better burgers

As someone that doesn't have the ability to schedule out appointments in advance , I was able to walk in and within 10 minutes be in a chair getting my haircut.
Cassi did a great job listening to what I wanted and executed it perfectly. She asked if I the cut was what I wanted at the end. She always kept checking in when she was washing my hair if the water was a good temperature as well as if the hot towel was ok. 
She definitely is one to request.
Amy, the manager is also one to request at this location!

I went to upgrade my iPhone 7 which is only a year old and Owe $400 left on it for the new iPhone 8. Verizon store here said I have a 14 day trial and you can return the phone.  Well I tried it for 2 days and returned it.  However I didn't know that I couldn't get my phone back or at least a refurbished phone at the same value of what I owed.  Basically if I would return my iPhone 8 to go back down to iPhone 7 then I will get a new iPhone 7 and restart not only the contract, but sadly start at zero again which means the iPhone 7 will cost me $800.  So let me think about this I can return my iPhone 8 and go back to iPhone 7 for $800.  Sounds like a deal right?  At least I could of been informed before making the deal.  Spoke to the manager Megan Rivas and she said sorry, but is the policy.  Sad how companies policies are set up to make money.

These people lie about needing the most expensive oil change. They also promised a gift card which turned out to be a coupon. Last time they changed my oil the drain plug fell out and left me stranded on the side of the road. I will never visit this location again!

Delicious meal with outstanding views! We had the special which was spider crab with two bowls of soup and two salads. We had the clam chowder and Cesar salad. Perfect portions and very yummy. The waitress was friendly and checked in at all the right times! We were all smiles at this place!
Very nice bake shop. Got a chocolate cake with strawberry frosting custom made. It was reallllyyyy delicious.

Arrived 1225. Host told us it would be a 45 minute wait. We were seated an hour and a half later. Ordered. Mmmmm carrot apple juice was yummy. Time goes by... Three parties come in after us, order and get their food. We finally inquire about our food. Waiter tells us the kitchen is backed up. Okay! So we only get pissed because, the answer was a bs answer. We call for the manager, manager is not in, Tom comes out and offers a better explanation and offers to give us out drinks free *side eye* ... We complain a little more and he's a bit more reasonable. Half off the order and the food was amazing!!!!!!!! Omg so good! Like my friend said, "people will settle for mediocre food for good service, but not the other way around" she's right!
Honestly the best bubble tea I have found in the city. My favorite is the watermelon. They are a bit stingy on boba so ask for extra.

When I specifically ask for extra ranch, and you don't give me extra ranch... You fail. I was also asked to pull around the front and wait for fries. I have been going to eegees all my life and that has never happened before, and I had to wait a long while.

So, I'm a local. I live here in East Nashville and love it, but when it comes to a slow, drippy Saturday afternoon and I need to relieve my boredom and satisfy my hunger, I stop into this place. True to it's name a lot is battered and fried, but this place offers a great selection of sushi rolls, sides and cold beer. 

I have to admit that trying to find a place that serves food worthy of repeat patronage and service that matches is hard to find anywhere, but here. As I write this review, sitting in the bar area  I'm watching one young man, StevN literally jog between tables checking on his customers, handing out menus, running credit cards, stopping at each table to ensure all of his  guests are not only satisfied, but genuinely happy with their experience today...this is not unusual for StevN, he by far and hands down is the best bar tender/server/bus boy (I say it this way because he is doing it all) I have ever seen in the food and beverage industry. There are currently 32 people sitting in the bar area and this guy has not only maintained his professionalism, he is showing one table at a time what it's like to have a great experience while dining at Battered and Fried. 

I'm having the fish and chips, lightly breaded cod and fresh, hot, hand cut fries with a cold draft. It doesn't get much better than this. Even when I order something other than my "usual", it arrives piping hot and fresh. This is why I continue to come here, I know that, with out a doubt I will have a fantastic dining experience that exceeds my expectations every time.  Thanks, StevN for another great meal, cheers all!

I am new to Indian cuisine so I was nervous but I'll say that the food was amazing we tried three chicken dishes and all were amazing I did about a level 8 on a hot scale and it was perfect spicy like I like but great flavor! The staff was awesome! We had a super nice waiter who recommend dishes and helped us decide!

I had the pleasure of performing here this past weekend at 'Late Night Love' and I'm really impressed by the venue and the sound.  The DJ booth was dialed in as was the guy on the mixing board.  It's a great feeling as a performer to just be able to show up and perform, not having to worry whether a sound check was even done, whether everything is hooked up properly, and know that the promoter is passionate about his brand or club night.

The crowd is a mix of young and older (leaning toward young) and the bar staff and security were both very cool.  Add a splash of professional go-go dancers and concert lighting and you've got a solid club experience.

If you're a fan of house, techno, etc. and are looking for a club night to get wild at, I strongly suggest you check out TheKnit on Saturday nights for 'Late Night Love'.

The hotel itself is not bad.  However, the hotel requires packages to funnel through the FEDEX office it has on site, which charges a $20 per box handling fee just to pick it up, which you yourself have to go to do despite the $20 topper on top of whatever it cost to send the box in the first place.  Absurd nickel and diming by the hotel.

This place is pretty neat! 

I recently met up with some friends to have some snacks, and maybe a beverage or two. 

The decor was nice, pleasant, warm and pub-ish. A pretty good amount of seating. And while they were absolutely packed, the service didn't suffer. 

I also found it pretty handy with the late night food menu. A few folks that were already there (that we met up with) had some wings. Those were some pretty damn good wings. Decent amount of meat, good flavor, etc. 

I ordered a Ruben pizza. There was so much I wanted to try, but this one jumped out. The pizza exceeded my expectations. 

They also seemed to have a good beer selection. 

It was a little late getting there, and the crowd was entertaining. We were chatting with another patron... He was DESTROYED. Good times.

I have been going to this practice for over 20 years, and it has been a good experience. Yes, there have been staff changes and mistakes, but not big ones. I find the staff to be friendly, helpful, and professional. I have recommended numerous people over the years, and they have all been pleased.

I love making groceries and liquor at Dorignac's!  Not too big, but has most of what I need.  The prices are very good and the perishable food is always fresh and presented well.  Fast check out.  Somehow I always leave with a full cart, no matter what I went in for! And I find exotic liquors here that I cannot find anywhere else!

should own stock in the place with how much money I have spent here!!

been here since it was first renovated many years ago-it has since been re-hauled well over a year ago-to much fan fare and improvemnent.-this is the best bar so far on whyte for good food, and bar service is always pretty good. 

I like the salt and pepper wings the best, they have other daily specials which are all good. The patio in the summer is only good late at night-when it is not too busy, and there aren't hundreds of cars pulling up to the light to stare at you. I'm not into gasoline paparazzi.

Once in a while you get a waitress who will ask for your credit card so you can place your food or drink order-hey waitress get a different job-you cant possibly have been a dine and dash victim that many times!!!

I always refuse to give my CC and just (pay up front) and then don't tip out more than 1 dollar-. Like I said they should know me by now-my bill always get paid here with a generous tips.

I really like the nachos, and the steak dinner is a nice cut for what they charge. They have soup specials which are tasty, and I like there salads.

I also like the crowd that comes here, only occasionally do you get a loud screaming group of girl's I guess they cant believe the bar actually let them in :) 

My favourite thing is to watch an old couple who comes out to this place on 'date night' or something and don't realize how loud its gets-and the woman-usually looks annoyed. Fun times is why I always return. Hey bartender I'll have another!!

I have been to the location in Philly but this was my first visit here. The décor is modern and spacious, but lacks the old school feel of the original. Our waiter was very knowledgeable about the menu and attentive. The wine list is fare, but I would like to see a few more Italian wine offerings. We started with the fried calamari and it was by far the best in Media. Very fresh with a light breading, so you could actually taste the squid. The marinara sauce accompanying it was good as well. My wife choose the braciole, which is a special they have every Sunday. This was her first time having the dish, and it may be her last. The meat was a little tough, and the stuffing had a somewhat overpowering taste of spices, primarily rosemary, that threw the flavor off. I personally liked it, and ended up eating most of it as she ate my chicken parm. My dish was excellent. The chicken was tender and moist, with a very flavorful breading. I had a side of gnocchi with it and they were delicious. They were cooked just right, and were not too dense. All in all a great dining experience. It seems every time we go for Italian in Media we end up at Fellini's, but we will definitely be back to Spasso!
Employees are friendly and get the job done! Great options for your vehicle and they often have deals for a free wash.

While I was visiting in town I stopped here. Pizza was pretty good and the people in the shop were really nice. The wait was a normal time to be expected for fresh made pizza. The breadsticks were ok but they came with a cheese type of dipping sauce, I prefer marinara but it could be how this city does it so I'm not sure.

The food was great, and the service was awesome.  We were a table of 12, and had a great time there.   I had the filet, which was grilled to perfection.  The potatoes on the side were great, but the dish is lacking some sort of sauce to go with the potatoes, other thank ketchup.

Came here for a friends birthday on a Wednesday night, party of 13. We were seated upstairs and we were the only people there so we could be as loud as we wanted. A very different experience, so much food!!! Favorite courses were the three salad appetizer and spicy chicken. Loved the fruit platter at the end, they weren't joking about.  We didn't have any belly dancers since it wasn't the weekend but totally fun and worth a visit for something other than traditional American.

Wondering about this online check in - the app said zero wait and I show up and it's a 40 minute wait? Something not right between the app and the salon! Overall its a nice place. I have had my hair cut by two of the stylist and for an $18 dollar Haircut and shampoo not a bad job. I would definitely recommend them but watch coming an hour before and after lunch as its really busy unless you have checked in online.
I am not one of those distinguished diners, so I find KFC delicious.  The only thing I don't like is that they close at 9 every night.  I wish they would stay open at least until 10 on the weekends.

Cheu Noodle Bar
PA Philadelphia Washington Square West
7pm Friday 23rd October 2015
Four Stars

The place is small, hip, and crowded. I put my name on the list at prime time Friday night and it was only a 15 minute wait. I enjoyed an Anderson Valley Gose ($5.5) outside on the sidewalk while I waited. I sat at the bar. I ordered a Miso Ramen ($14) which is a dollar increase from their website. The broth was light but packed with nice salty and umami flavors. The thick curvy noodles were undercooked a bit but not unenjoyable. The egg yolk was a perfect velvety texture and white was just solidified. Plus the seasoning on it was on point.  The braised pork shoulder was not very fatty but nicely rendered with nuances of smoke and salt. It was warmed under a broiler and topped with a barbecue-like sauce on it. There were not any sea beans but some sort of pickled cabbage. The raw bean sprouts were a nice pho-like touch. 

Overall, the service was friendly and great. The food was prepared with consistency and care. The price point was reasonable.

The absolute worst restaurant that I have ever been to. I'm not going to re-write my open table review, but I wish there was a zero star rating. They completely deserve it for the food, the horrible service and the bingo hall style ambience. 
I, seriously, would have preferred a quarter pounder. Ugh.

This place is a fun spot off the main Broadripple strip.  It tends to be a mid-30s crowd which is a needed break from the 21 crowd of Broadripple.  This place feels like it belongs on Mass Ave, or Fountain Square.

I come here for the Bread Pudding dessert.  Delicious! :) Although this time they put way too much honey on it which stole the flavor.  Good beer selection as well.

I've been wanting to go Capofitto for a while because HELLO pizza and gelato, and I finally made my dream come true yesterday. The restaurant itself is really cute - gelato in the front, pizza (party!) in the back. Lots of space, classy decor, and I'm always a fan of seeing the actual open fire pizza grill. It was also very bright, which was a nice change from the dim lighting that I think so many places are embracing these days - my parents didn't need to use their cell phones as mini flashlights to read the menu, which is always a promising sign!

Service was a lovely mix of attentive without being overbearing, and our server was incredibly pleasant. When he noticed that most of us were vegetarians (he heard me make a vegetarian-related comment while we were ordering) he made sure to tell us which items were made with chicken stock, and offered to bring us lard-free bread, which isn't their normal recipe. I so appreciate that kind of recognition and sensitivity to our eating habits.

The menu itself is really generous - a handful of apps/snacks, some salads, a soup, a few pasta options, and probably 15 kinds of pizza! Plus a really extensive beer/wine/cocktail list. We opted for the arancini, the eggplant "meatballs," the house salad, two pizzas, and a calzone. The starters were really good - both the arancini and the "meatballs" had four little fried balls per serving, which were very tasty, but not super filling, and the house salad was also solid - I liked the addition of a few crispy fried onions on top. 

My parents and I were able to comfortably share two pizzas - we went with the Tartufello and the Genovese. Both were really yummy with unique flavors, and despite having a plethora of ingredients, neither one felt heavy - like we could eat a lot without needing to be rolled out of the restaurant (#winning). But...like some other reviewers have said, the pizza literally feels wet. The middle of the pies were both soaking, for lack of a better term. The crust has no holding capacity, and we really needed to use a knife and fork to eat the "tip half" of the pizza - once you get closer to the crust, you can pick it up, normal style. I don't think this necessarily made the pizza bad...but it was a bit strange. I'm sure that this really is the authentic style that they're going for, but it might be nice to give diners a heads-up at some point during the meal that this consistency is normal.

Although I didn't have gelato on this visit because Philly is currently the same temperature as the Arctic Circle, I've had Capogiro gelato at other locations and it is truly drool-worthy, so I know it's a deadly combination to have it offered under the same roof as tasty pizza. Overall, this place is worth a visit - just prepare yourself for the pizza :)
