(Note: After writing this review, I actually researched "wet" pizza, and turns out, authentic Neapolitan pizza is soggy in the center and usually can't be "hand held." So, lo and behold Capofitto knows just what they're doing and this style of pizza is totally a thing! Mangia!)

This was a cute little place on the corner -- a no frills, affordable place to grab a bite to eat. They have a good selection of things for brunch and lunch. 

The BBQ shrimp po boy was huge and I loved the proportion of lettuce/tomato/pickles to the shrimp. However, the shrimp itself was a little too salty and I wanted a little spiciness on it. The potato chips and fries were great though! The fries were crunchy on the outside and fluffy on the inside.

Philly,PA
 
I cant believe I forgot to review this place! PROS. : Open Late. Plain steak is okay. This is awesome to find this spot when the other spot down Front & Oregon is closed and you are starving late night!!!!

Came here for lunch. The service was good but the food was underwhelming, especially for the price.

Ordered the...
1/2 dozen stuffed PJ oyster ($19)
Croque Madame with fries ($15)

The oysters were stuffed and broiled over a shrimp and crab mix. They were very salty and had very little flavor.

The Croque Madame is two pieces of bread with ham covered in cheese with an egg on top. This dish was also very salty with little flavor. The Croque Madame along with the fries was cold.

I've been here twice, both times were pretty good. Nothing special, nothing terrible. The staff was efficient, not very friendly but not mean. The food was good. The menu had some fun rolls. The price is great for all you can eat!

Popped in here to grab lunch at the bar shortly after noon and luckily for me this place was not crowded. Staff was incredibly friendly and I ordered the Miso Ramen with Greens (extra $). The Miso broth could have used a tad more salt but I found the noodles to be a good chewy, enjoyed the sauce on the tender pork shoulder and the marinade on the greens, and the egg was poached perfectly. I wish I had more room to try additional things but this bowl of ramen was very filling!! I enjoyed sitting at the bar, watching the chefs at work, but the space is really, like really, small. And they take credit card.

Cruising is one of the best ways to take a vacation.  I have been on a couple of cruises with Carnival and it has been great.  The Service on bored is amazing.  The staff will do about anything to make the trip as good as they can.  There is so much to do on the ships to keep you busy or you can just do nothing and relax.  I love the food on bored.  i would recommend the late dinning time this way it gives you more time on shore when you are at port.  The drinks on bored are a bit pricy and you have to be careful about how much you spend on them because you don't use cash you can spend way more then you think or want.  There is a way around this though.  Each person is allowed to bring on two bottles of wine in there carry on bags.  Also each person can bring on a case of pop or water.  So that is a way to save some money.  So when you get ready for your cruise have fun.

Authentic Thai cuisine. This is a great take out place on Dale Mabry situated next to a hotel and a cremation service company. Ha! You can even ask for your curry to be "Thai hot." :) The Green curry is delightful, but also try their specials. Don't forget to ring the bell when you give a tip!

I absolutely love oysters and have been on the hunt for good oysters in the area every since I've moved here. I've been to Doc's Magrogan's Oyster House in West Chester on two different occasions. Unfortunately both times I have been sorely disappointed! While the oysters were fresh, I had bits and pieces of the shell in almost ever half shell I got - and we must've ordered three or four dozens for 3 people. Such a shame!

Being that fresh oysters and seafood is their biggest draw... I would expect more from Doc Magrogan's! I do not plan to return to the restaurant again.

I've been coming here for a few months for facials and massages.  Ike and Heather do a great job. Today I booked a spa day for my mother and I. It was a facial, massage and pedicures. It was scheduled to last 2.75 hours. Each person that service did a great job, absolutely no complaints about that. My complaint is that we were there 5 hours. Scheduling was a huge issue, I'm not sure I would book a spa day there again. The spa did comp a manicure that I had added in at the last minute but come on, five hours!!!

We had the rudest waiter ever. No refills for anyone at our table.   It took over an hour to get our check after asking and  then another 45 minutes to get my card back. I have never considered walking out on a check before this.

Incredible assortment of flavours - I couldn't even look at them all before I decided or else I knew I'd be there forever! Loved my selection of Bartlett pear w balsamic caramel and chocolate amaretto cheesecake! Going back soon to see the other choices :)

OH my Gosh what great food!!  You have to get the potato rolls, so yummy and oh so good!  I love the pot roast and the chicken fingers, each is some scrumptious, your taste buds will thank you! 

Its a family owned place and everyone is so friendly and welcoming.  The only negative thing is thats is always so busy... but i suppose thats a good thing :)

This Deli is Fantastic! They have been in the same location in Ardmore Forever. They make Delicious Hoagies the size of your Arm. Everything they use is quality! I like both their Tuna and Italian. If you ask for Hot Peppers they use Jalepenos instead of cherry peppers, which give it a little different flair.

All I wanted was a simple gentleman's haircut. After reading the reviews I decided to make the drive from Tampa... 

While the overall atmosphere was nice the haircut left a lot to be desired; to say I was disappointed would be an understatement. I asked for my hair to be left fairly long and not get a buzzcut and he gave me a #3 on the sides and a very short and UNEVEN cut at the top. He basically gave me the haircut he wanted and not what I requested, even then he did a poor job. He knew he had messed up before I left but still took my money, this is the first time in my life I have not left my barber a tip. 

I do not recommend and I will certainly not be going back.

We bought a new CRV from Conicelli back in 2004, and my wife has faithfully taken it back to Conicelli for scheduled maintenance (because, you know, dealerships are notoriously the most cost-effective way to keep your car in good working order...). She has been generally satisfied with the service she's received. My perspective on this, however, is that I've heard a lot of offhand comments from her over the years about things she would point out to the service department that would get ignored or dismissed--things ranging from the trivial (like burned out interior bulbs [ignored] to bigger things like persistent rattles [dismissed with a chuckling "Oh, you mean the 'Honda rattle'?"]. But, well, OK.

So flash forward to this year. Not only do we need to start looking for a new CRV, but we need to replace a 2000 Civic (purchased elsewhere). We liked the looks of the new HRV, and after doing a lot of research, we headed to Conicelli for a test drive. We liked it, so we decided to go ahead and buy one. We knew precisely what we were willing to pay, which we based on reading through a LOT of forum posts to see what other people in our area were paying for the trim line we wanted. Prepared or not, there was (apparently) no getting around running the gantlet of the stereotypical car-salesman experience: we were shown LOTS of printouts of prices (these were supposed to show us how reasonable--nay, PAINFUL to the dealership--the salesman's counterproposal was), we were left alone at the negotiatin' desk several times so the salesman could--wait for it!--check with his manager--all the usual nonsense (though I am disappointed that the salesman didn't put his arm around my shoulders and ask me what it was going to take to get me in a new car TODAY--so we missed the trifecta). We did not get our price, we did not get anything thrown in (several HRV buyers working with other dealerships got things like cargo covers or pads), and we got an insulting offer for (and lecture about) our trade-in. So we walked out...

...and headed to CarSense (Pottstown Pike, Chester Springs, PA), where we spent one tenth the time test driving multiple cars, got three times as much for our trade-in as Conicelli was offering, and overall dealt with one one-hundredth of the bullshi*. The best part was that while we were finalizing the purchase of a car we like even better than the HRV (though admittedly used, but late model and low mileage), we got a call from Conicelli telling us that, on further consideration, they could double their offer for our trade-in. Well, twice nothing is still nothing: no deal. The thing that still amazes my wife and me is that Conicelli blew the sale of two new Hondas--losing customers who, for better or worse, had been loyal to them for 12 years--for what was probably no more than a couple of hundred dollars. 

All through the negotiation for the HRV, our salesman told us how their dealership was #1 in, I don't know, the universe. Maybe it's true, and maybe it's SO true that the loss of a few customers is no big thing for them. If so, bully for them. But, frankly, I'd rather buy from a dealership that at least makes a better show of wanting me as a customer.

(Now, the REAL question...is a 2-star review enough to get the coveted "Lori H. from Conicelli Honda" apology and assurance that she'll look into my unsatisfactory experience? Also, I was stunned to see that Conicelli Honda has over 70 "not recommended" Yelp reviews, almost all of which detail what appear to be quite legitimate unhappy customer experiences.)
Lots and lots of pies! Fried chicken, roast beef and typical cafeteria style foods. Good place for comfort food. Nice service people. Always crowded!

Was excited to try this place after a recommendation from the pastor of a local Korean church. The space is limited inside, but it's definitely worth the trip! A fun place to grab lunch during the work week if you're feeling a hankering for Asian fusion/Korean tacos. The service is wonderful; they knew me just the second time I went in and are always friendly and helpful. I would choose Soy over Local Taco across the street, much better bang for your buck.
Waited over an hour and a half before we even had a chef to cook our food. We had a reservation so they knew we were coming. My 1st and last time there.
All I can say is stay away from this place. I waited for half an hour for my server to get my order and the silver plates show that they are not clean
Excellent Food. Best pork chop ive ever had. Service was good..skip the bread though its nothing special. Be sure to make a reservation.

I've been to many sushi restaurants and Osaka is at the top.  The atmosphere is very friendly and the food is delicious and fresh.  When you find a restaurant at the beach that is filled with locals, you know you have a winner!  Excellent food and service every time we eat here!  I highly recommend!

Where to start! Everything was on point from the salmon Benedict, pancakes, healthy breakfast with eggs avo and a oatmeal. Oh and you can't go wrong with the pastry's the cinnamon roll & chocolate croissant are to die for!!!

Literally the worst rental company in SB! I have a pretty high tolerance for awful rental companies, having lived in SB for 5 years and dealing with one scummy slum lord to the next but... This place should be ashamed to call themselves a rental management company.. If housing wasn't so hard to come by in SB, and people ACTUALLY had a choice instead of having their hand forced financially, I know this "Co." would be out of business.
I just recently was able to get off the hook of living in one of their rentals. The rental itself was nice and spacious (no problem with the property). 
My issues lay entirely with the rental company. First off, they are practically unreachable at all times. I called multiples times during different weekdays, and was never able to speak to my property manager. I think he maybe returned 1 call to me out of the countless messages left.  Secondly, when it came to having new roommates move in/out, they somehow lost our numerous roommate swap applications sent in! Then a few months later, acted surprised that the person who had applied many times (and told they had been approved) was residing in the apartment. 
I had a sketchy roommate move in, without Bartlein providing any kind of background. When this person did not pay rent for 2 months, I began to feel uncomfortable and provided an ultimatum for either moving out ASAP or providing owed rent and moving out at an agreed time. When I contacted Bartlein for help on this matter, they acted as if it was something they had never dealt with. I ended up paying to have the locks changed myself. I then paid to have 3 extra copies made so I could provide them to Bartlein to be up front about everything. One of their star employees told me that I would be responsible for a charge for them to make copies of the key. Seriously, these people are useless.
This brings me to the staff... Where do you find these people?! I hope future employers of Bartlein employees look at this yelp page. These employees are literally all awful. Everytime I went in, no one had any idea what was going on, everyone looked just as confused (if not more confused) than I was. Never had any problems solved by going into their office.
Needless to say, I am relieved and grateful for having moved out. Of course Bartlein kept 2/3 of my security deposit (charging me to repair broken stove, garbage disposal) that they themselves had no fixed, even after I put in multiple service requests. Honestly, losing all that money was painful, but I am okay knowing I flushed over $1600 down the toilet, but no longer have to deal with Bartlein ever again.
If you're reading this and considering renting from them, listen to allllll of these reviews! It's not worth it!

I didn't go to the show tonight, but I did get a cool backstage tour of the IRT at a Yelp party. Our guide, Brian, is the production manager. Really nice and happy to show us everything. He was knowledgable about the day to day operations at IRT as well as its history. 

I have been to several shows here before. Some are great, some are just okay, but this is a wonderful, historic gem in our city. Everyone should experience at least one performance at the IRT. The setting takes you through a time portal into the past, though you still have all the modern conveniences (and booze) you could want. The staff has always been friendly and helpful, and I feel like the prices are a great value considering what a good experience it is to take your family or a date to the theatre.

Had a coupon for $1 off so figured I'd give it a try after walking by it so often. Veggie regular burrito was good, but it was literally rice, beans, lettuce, pico. Every Mexican place I've been to, when the veggie option is same price as meat option, at least has grilled mushrooms, sauteed veggies, free quac, or something extra. So with my $1 it was an ok deal ($3.40)  for what I got, but probably won't do it again at regular price. Thought everything tasted fresh, but again, doesnt make up for making vegetarians having to pay the same price when all you did was take out the most expensive ingredient.

It took 15 minutes for her to make a milkshake. She started restocking toppings while holding the milk. It doesn't take that long and she definitely wasn't in a rush. Sat down and still she moved so slowly. Should have just left and driven to the one across town. Would have been quicker. She then let my shake sit and it was warm once I got it and only 3/4 full.

I rode the Megabus for a short trip from St. Louis to Chicago on the morning of January 11, 2014.  It felt like the longest, most disgusting and unsafe trip EVER due to the circumstances.  The restroom was coated in crusty dried chunks of vomit (door, walls, toilet, everything!), completely uncleaned for many many hours (and it was early in the morning when we boarded)!  Additionally, there were empty soda cans all throughout the "behind the seat" storage nets on the bus.  The driver was swerving all over the road and driving quite a bit over the speed limit.  I did not feel safe with this driver in particular.  The guests were watching DVDs and listening to music on speakers, not headphones.  Several passengers were also speaking very loudly on their cell phones and speaking very literally about drug deals they were planning to conduct after their Megabus stop.  I was very concerned for my safety at this point.  I do not understand how anyone was comfortable, as it was uncomfortably hot and humid inside the Megabus, no vents were working at all.  The driver literally screamed VERY inappropriately to my friend's mother who is super sweet and polite and was asking a question in regards to the proper process for boarding.  She had first ensured that NO OTHER passengers were around, so she was not taking up someone else's time.  After raising his voice to her and walking away, we all sat in silence on the bus for an additional 15 minutes, at which time he could have answered her simple question appropriately.  I was disgusted by the driver's inappropriate behavior (my guess is that he was under the influence of something, probably alcohol or worse), the unacceptable condition of the ONE and ONLY restroom on the bus, the driver's unsafe driving, the rude and disrespectful behavior of the passengers, the cleanliness of the Megabus as a whole, the poor climate control in the bus, just to cover the major points.  I felt disgusted and most importantly very unsafe with Megabus and NEVER plan to travel via the Megabus for the rest of my life!

The food here is just... wow. This place is AWESOME. We've already been back within two weeks of trying this place for the first time. We can't get enough of the fried chicken, chicken and biscuits, mashed potatoes, and cole slaw. Everything is always so flavorful, so fresh-tasting, and so delicious. The atmosphere is really bright and welcoming, very open with plenty of seating that doesn't feel crammed together. All of the staff are always lovely. Definitely gonna keep coming back!
i love this place. spicy fries are a plus. there burgers are so amazing. nothing better then a good old fashion joint.
My favorite health food store. Has all the products I need at great prices. The restaurant is very good too.

I ordered the hummus and the vegetarian platter. Both were good, but could use more flavor. Their black tea is excellent and so is the service. I would definitely come back as the food is so fresh and the ambiance is relaxing.

I ordered buffalo wings fried hard & a salad with romaine lettuce. My salad was delivered iceberg lettuce who still uses that it has no nutritional value besides I specifically said romaine. The wings looked like they had already cooked them had the sauce on them and placed back in the fryer they had this weird taste and looked like something from an alien movie.
So now I drive to the Sorranos to take it back I asked for the manager he made every excuse in the book. He said we usually don't give money back it's too much. How did he think I felt paying that much for gross food. I really don't like leaving negative reviews but the manager really got under my skin. Won't be ordering here again!!
Noisy, Poor service, not a "pub" experience in any way, shape or form.

Very fresh, delicious food. I had the lamb gyro platter and it was huge. There were three different salads that came with it (tomato cucumber parsley, a cabbage slaw and some iceberg with tomatoes and onions) and pita bread. It was a little expensive but worth treating yourself especially since I was craving gyro. I made a special trip in the snow today since work was canceled and I never can go due to my work schedule. I'll have to try their kebabs, falafel, and desserts next time!

Well, as far as fast food restaurants go I like Chick-fil-A but I don't think it's anything special.  Breaded chicken or grilled chicken, waffle fries or slaw and salads.  I find their menu a little bit lacking and I find the chicken to be rather bland.  Sometimes the service is a little spotty but not because of inattention by the employees but more because they seem to be understaffed.  I like Chick-Fil-A's business philosophy but I'm rating the restaurant, not the entire business.

I waited to write this review as my first time being here was my first time having Indian food. I've eaten at several different places since so I feel I can give this place an accurate review. 

As far as overall value goes, this is extremely affordable for the buffet and the options provided to you. The buffet can vary in options but generally has popular dishes most expect at an Indian place along with several vegetable and dessert options. 

The customer service is very attentive and friendly and I often see that they have regulars that they are casual with and I think that's nice. 

I found out through a friend that they do serve lassi's (just ok tasting) and gulab jamun (included with buffet) but you have to request these which is a bit strange as they do not even offer a regular menu when ordering buffet. It kind of makes me wonder what else they offer via special request. 

Realistically I give this place 3.5 stars only because the food has been hit or miss when I come. Sometimes it's flavorful and excellent while other times there are several dishes lacking substance and flavor. I will continue to come here because the location is convenient and I like to have various options when eating ethnic food so I'm not restricted to a single dish I may not like. For the price, it's definitely worth mentioning or recommending to someone who's checking out places in University City.

They just moved me this morning. I had Justin Justin and Akili. They arrived perfectly on time (8am sharp). They introduced themselves and we inspected the stuff to be loaded. Then we all started loading. It was breeze! They were very careful, and wrapped our stuff with blankets and stretch film before loading. It was done without any trouble. Then we drove to the new house (slowly but safely). Unloading was fast too. No damage no problems of any kind! They put everything where I told them to and made sure I was happy. Can't ask for better care. You'd better believe I'm telling my friends and would use again

Once again, a Marriott loses points for housekeeping.  Room looked ok on first glance.  But, there was a thin plastic bag on the floor behind one of the desk legs.  Easy to see.

OK...let it pass.   First use of the bath, I close the door and find a damp towel hanging on the hook.  Hand towels aren't evenly hung...as if one had been used.

Table light missing a bulb.

Bed nicely made...tight...

Dinner and service in the lounge quite acceptable.

Captive audience for the airport travelers....  adequate.

did I mention no hot water in the shower? Handle loose in the wall?

How can this place not have better ratings? We have fun here. The food is great. The staff is friendly, but could be a little more attentive at times. It's still definitely a 5 star experience...they're just super busy...All The Time!

Finally found a neighborhood bar to call home! Patio is great and the cozy in door atmosphere reminds me of the pubs in Ireland.  All the staff are wonderful and make you feel welcome the minute you walk through the door. Besides the Moscow Mule, try the English A**, made with Gin, Ginger Beer and lemon, Awesome!

AVERAGE!

The only way to describe this place.  Had the sirloin steak salad, the meat was over cooked, huge inedible pieces, onions were the same (huge) but raw and not seasoned.  Also had the chicken tacos, which were under seasoned, dry and uninspired (also wayyy to big to eat without a fork).

2 drinks + 2 cheap entrees = $42

Drinks are good though.

2.75 stars

I had a cup of crawfish soup which was excellent. They put real crawfish(about 6)in there. It was Satuday night 9p.m. and I was the only person in the bar area which was cool. Great service. I had "The Ponchatrain" seafood platter as the main entrée. I liked how the outside of the fish was slightly crusted. It gave great texture. The price of the crawfish soup($7) and the main entrée($24.50) is slightly on the steep side. I don't expect to pay fast food prices but geez could ya lower the price to like $18 for the main entrée lol?

I know i usually come to this best buy and bring my laptop here for the Geek Squad to take a look, it took about 2 weeks which wasnt bad, cause i thought it was gonna be a month wait! LOL but they were very friendly and did let me know if i had any questions comments or concerns to let them know. I love comming to best buy for new CD's for new release music tuesdays :) ( new name i came up with) But their cd's are $9.99 which is better than FYE and their new release song which are $14.99 im like NO WAY!! If there is something that best buy doesnt have and if they do have it on their computer system you can order it online and pick it up. I know i order DVD's online and it was cheap and i could pick it up at customer service. The Best Buy on the Blvd is pretty big and i hope it never closes down :)

Best Nail Salon in St. Louis. Tracy is the manager and she alone does a fantastic job. She has the right tools when it comes to excellent customer service. She does her job to satisfy your needs and desires for your nails. Shes an excellent nail technician and best of all she has a kicking personality. She really does care and her staff are just as friendly and mannered. 

It sets everything great for a relaxing spa day and enjoyable employees who can and do take care of you.

The employees here are so nice and friendly. The burgers are awesome, way better than any other similar establishments in the area. Their shoestring are great too! The dining area is very clean and your food is delivered to your seat. I will definitely come back here.

My partner and I had dinner here on Friday night, and we were extremely impressed with the extensive veggie menu and the wonderful service. The garlic naan was on point along with the veg korma, paneer tikka masala, and malai kofta. We ordered it mild (because I'm super Caucasian), and it was perfectly spicy for me without being too hot. Topped off with chai, it was the perfect Indian meal. We are definitely looking forward to returning for the lunch buffet, which the owner said has 6 meat dishes and 6 veggie dishes and is available 7 days a week. Can't wait!!

This was a really cool experience and I'm really glad I got to try Marrakesh. However a few things - this place is cash only! Although a previous review on yelp said that the 7 course meal cost $25 including tip, I actually paid closer to $35 so watch out for that. Also, it's in a really tiny alley so ask your uber to drop you off or pick you up at a more accessible corner if you can. Other than that, it was fun trying to eat without utensils or plates. I wasn't a fan of this powdered sugar chicken dish we got, but everything else was great - especially loved the tea here. Also there's a belly dancer!

This is a great store when your looking for all your alterntive religion needs. The staff is very nice and they will help you to the best of their ability.  The selection is huge due to the size of their store.  Theres lots of room to move around and one can look at their goods without them hovering over you or bumping into people. They have a large selection of books and even some used books.  If your looking for Dryad Design staues this is the place to go.  Overall I love this place and recommend it!
Cute and friendly! :) came here with my family for a quick meal and ended up staying and eating more!

What a yummy place for handmade icecream! Lots of flavors, 5 or 6 different cone choices, fair pricing, and a very pleasant staff. Be prepared to stand in a line, it's a full house (in a narrow space)!

Only reason I wouldn't say 5 stars is due to the location. There's no easy way to access this location unless you're already downtown. You could get lucky and find a parking spot, but with 2nd street becoming more popular, it's a bit difficult to get to.

I enjoyed a scoop of cake batter with sprinkles. It wasn't really all that, but my boyfriend got the red velvet cake, and that was to die for! ABSOLUTELY delicious!!

It was just okay to me. Kind of over priced. I paid 14 buck's for two smalls drinks. The register locked up and I had to wait 20 minutes to get my change. I was super frustrated and asked if I could do credit but the cashier said that she couldn't do it... I feel like I should have atleast gotten a discount or my drinks for free for the amount of my time that was wasted. Unfortunately I do not care to come back to this place.
I've only been here twice. So far, I really like the space. I got a groupon here as a gift. I expect that I will get my own actual membership.

4 stars for the gas prices and beer selection

This service station always has a decent selection of beer and low gas prices. They also have 20 pumps so you'll rarely wait in line for gas. The beer prices are ok for craft beers and cheaper than Shep's. The real negative is the location - it's right on the corner of 22nd Ave and 4th street. That makes it difficult to exit from unless you're headed east on 22nd Ave.

As a Sunday treat after church, we go to pet puppies at the Nashville Humane Association. The building itself is so inviting and the staff members/volunteers keep the facility clean and the animals safe. 

These animals are very lively and are obviously getting plenty of attention. The building itself, as you would imagine is divided into to distinct sections for the dogs and cats. To the right they have a wall full of cats in their little habitats as well as a kitten room where you can sit and play among toys and huge cat climbing tree.

On the left there are three dog rooms: the large dog room, the small dog and the puppy room. All are great especially the small dog and puppy room where you can actually pet and hold the animals. The Nashville Humane Association also has a huge backyard behind the building that allows you to walk any dog (except for the puppies, you can take them out and play with them in the puppy room).  Open until 5 nearly every day, petting animals and offering them love is a stress relief!

Sabino Canyon is beautiful and has trails suitable for any level of experience. They have picnic areas and decent bathrooms (for a mountain), and paved/unpaved trails. Parking is $5 a pop though, so if you plan on going more than 4 times in a year, just buy the year pass for $20. The year pass gets you into other park sites as well.

I have no complaints about Mo'Ziki, so 5 stars it is. Looking for a healthy option, and found this on Yelp. It's like a Moe's type of establishment, but for Greek pitas and wraps. So you pick pita, wrap, bowl, etc.; then your meat; then the add-ins.

I tried a spinach wrap w chicken & other veggies. Added some hummus (95cents extra). And the highlight of it all is their 6 choices of "Ziki sauce," aka varieties of tzatziki sauce. I tried the avocado & lemon. Yummy! Good and filling portion of chicken. 

My companion for the night ordered a gyro pita. Also added hummus and traditional tzatziki sauce. His was so stuffed with gyro that it looked impossible to eat. 

We also each picked up our free cookie with check-in. Huge, but could taste better. And what's a visit to a Greek restaurant without baklava for dessert? I can tell it's not made in-house, but it is really good. Tastes exactly like the ones my mom buys for family gatherings from Sam's Club. And that's not a complaint. I love those more than some homemade ones.

I wish I knew some Greek words to end this review...
Oh well. Oppa!

Great service and great food! I've ordered delivery from PJ's several times during my stay in Tuscon and I'm always impressed with their customer service. Twice the manger went out of his way to call me when me when the delivery time was going to be longer than expected (usually it's super quick and on time).

They don't skimp on the meat either!  This is my go to place in Tuscon for a reliable quick sandwich fix!

Drove through the drive-through for a couple of double cheeseburgers and an order of sweet potato fried.    The bottom of one was burnt - not the burger but the roll itself for sitting on the hot plate too long I guess.    The other was looked okay but both were not looking all that fresh.   The fries were piping hot, sweet, and spicy all at the same time - curly style too - which just means they can't fit as many in the container.

Fresh ingredients, thoughtfully prepared, excellent service, small portions.  My only real issue is the portion size... If I order a soup, salad and entree, or a 5-course tasting, I'm expecting to leave full.  Not overly full, but full.  The last several times I've dined here, I've left hungry. And the cost is significant. If ingredient cost/portion is an issue, this could easily be solved with the non-proteins.  ie. more sides, starches, vegetables.  Love the restaurant for the flavors, but I find myself passing it over for this issue.

Good, but not great!
There side orders, not as good as I wanted.
The sliders were good, and they should be.
Dont' waste your time on the side orders.
I would order a mixed variety of sliders and determine which is  best for you.

My roommate and I have been dying to try one of these for months! We went on Saturday afternoon around three, and after seeing dozens of pictures of the most creative, mouth watering donuts on yelp and Instagram, I was a little disappointed they only had three flavors. Lesson learned: go in the morning! I did appreciate that their three flavors are all made to order and served hot. I had a cinnamon sugar. It was good, but my mind wasn't blown. I look forward to trying something unique next time!

Great stop for a quick get together. Inexpensive and good time with friends, yes. High quality sushi, no. I do not go for the atmosphere. I go for happy hour. 2 for 1 sake & half price sushi, or just takeout for half price sushi. I get the spicy tuna and PCH roll. I have never had a real problem with waiting, been lucky with this because I know there can be 45 minute waits sometimes. I find 4-6 there is no to little wait on the days I have gone.

I repeat, they are not the best place for sushi, but I am always happy with these two rolls. I sometimes get avocado with the tuna. For the price, I can't beat it. 

I do find they are inconsistent with seating. I was allowed, with a group of friends, to sit at the hibachi tables for sushi, drinking our sake while waiting for a table because the bar was full. They then just served us there instead of moving us. Other times with different hosts we were not allowed to preorder our sake and sip while waiting, not allowed to use the hibachi empty tables.

Went there for supper at around 7 PM on Friday, 8 August.  I realize that this is a chain, but this was my first experience with the chain.  Seating was prompt.  Food was OK -- nothing special but not horrible as chain Mexican/Tex-Mex places go.  (I ordered the Conquistador.)  Service was mediocre, but that was mostly because of understaffing.
Very good meal actually excellent Maximo Polo - also bread was warm and salad fresh - service very going and dining music pleasant

BOA has changed the landscape of their facility somewhat recently.  Gone is the ATM drive-up on the east side of the building after a robbery took place there about a year ago.  There are now two ATM's inside of the bank accessible through the southern entrance along with the ATM just off of Park Blvd. near the McDonald's.

I guess they are trying to make the place less of an attraction for robbers, but I don't understand why they do so now and not immediately after the robbery last year that was well publicized on local TV.

Was there with my family for dinner.  Waiter was great and came up with good suggestions.  Food was great and came out in a timely manner.  The Mac and Cheese was the best I ever tasted.  Interesting retro shag carpet.  Kids loved it and so did I and the wife.  If we are ever back in Philly in this area we will be sure to visit again.

This place has gone downhill.  Used to love coming here but the past few visits have been dreadful and even dirty.  Both recent visits, the server was hardly around.  My order was messed up but the server never came to ask how everything was so I just ate what I had.   Had to get the cashier to get my bill on my last visit which will be my final one.

My Husband and I celebrated our 44th Wedding Anniversary here. 
I ordered my Favorite Filet Mignon..
melt in your mouth heaven!!!
First time there.. Won't be the last!
My Husband wasn't happy with what he ordered but was surprised 
How gracious the wait staff made sure he got something else that he was more than pleased with!!. We were treated to a dessert of our choice to celebrate our Anniversary
as well as a card signed by all the Staff!!! What a thoughtful touch.

I love this beer and this tap room.  Really comfortable, always great beer selections but they need better help!   I stopped in with a friend from out of town on a Wednesday afternoon and we were the only ones there.  The woman working had  ZERO personality.  Could I get more than an one word answer and could you maybe work it a little for the tip you were expecting?   Come on, Free Will.

Really nice spot. The bar was so wonderful and cozy we decided to eat there. I had the crab risotto with truffles. It was so wonderful I could have done with just that and a drink. The absolute only downside is its right on Bourbon St which meant great music when anyone opened the door ( also great inside) but a bit of a let down when you leave and step into total insanity.

Food was great, service was great!  Prices very reasonable. We are from Michigan and have eaten out all week. This was our favorite meal in 6 days!  Would recommend this place. I had beef fajitas and my wife had enchiladas with cheese and onion also spinach and artichoke. Both very good!  Will be back next time in town.

Came here after visiting the Tucson Museum of Art, my first thought when I walked in was oh no another Chipotle type of place but to my surprise they served different offerings. 
I don't eat meat so I had the calabacita tacos on flour gringo style, sooooo good !!!

Their watermelon cucumber juice is so refreshing

Avoid this place even if it is the only open restaurant in town.

Four of us went to India House for dinner on Sunday, 27th May, after a grueling hike on Santa Cruz. The service was the worst and the guy who works as a host there is lousy to say the least. While I do not have anything to say about the people of Santa Barbara, no place is less customer friendly, India House has the worst combination of all - a disgusting host, tacky decor and over-priced tasteless food. I am an Indian and did not like the food an iota.

Their food tastes very authentic and good. Definitely try their soups because they will warm your soul on a cold rainy day, which is prevalent here in Indy. When it is summer, their bubble teas are delicious and a great way to cool down.
It's legit! I had a mushroom n Swiss burger that was juicy and quite filling. One of the top burger joints in Nashville. Also, they have a great draft beer selection.

A decent little place in Philly's gayborhood.  But nothing to write home about.  I do have to say, the food was actually pretty good.  They have tasty wood fired pizzas for $8 or something and hummus is so good.  But the only employee working was the bartender, who also had to wait the tables.  He gave us attitude for ordering or for not having a full list of what we might possibly want all ready for his convenience.  He actually said "I hope you aren't going to make me come back again" or something like that.  Kinda of sarcastic and annoying.  I overheard him with the same attitude at the next table. They all stared with a WTF look when he walked away.

So all in all, pretty good food and great prices but they could work on their service.

I had scheduled an eye exam appointment at   Urban optics to see Dr Neel, but when I got to the office I was told he retired. I was a little hesitant to try a new doctor. . But after meeting Dr Zucker 
I was very impressed with him .

 He is very knowledgeable and thorough with the eye exams. He also  explained various of options for  contacts.   I had a bit of trouble getting my contacts just right at first. But he gave me samples to tie me over and  he called me himself to make sure the issue was resolved to get me the right contacts to fit  for my difficult high astigmatism eyes.. 

My job is very  detailed so  my eyesight is very important in my line of work.. I can't afford not to see well. 
 I recommend him for  all your eyesight needs100%.

If you ever go to St. Louis you need to go here I think it's an official part of the city tour.  I had heard of the legendary concretes on the Food Network.

It was a bust summer night with a line 20 people deep so maybe the rush to serve everyone effected the consistency of my dessert.  It wasn't frozen enough to turn over upsdei down but damn that stuff was tasty.

I went with a friend to Chili's today and found it an enjoyable experience. We had the southwest egg rolls for appetizer. I had a fresh margarita for a drink, and the fajita trio for the main meal. I also had a chocolate shake (I was hungry!) for dessert. The egg rolls were delicious, the margarita was divine, the fajita trio was hot and plentiful although too salty, and sadly the shake was a let-down. The service was excellent. The music (from Galaxy cable) was perfect for two people who were teens in the 80s. Easy to get to, easy parking, and for the two of us for lots of food with drinks, it came to $62.00 before tip.
I'd go again.  :)
Vibrant ambiance, great food, and good people. The only downside was that I would've liked the broth to have been slightly warmer. Other than that, all the flavors were spot on.

First time to Granite City and I am a fan.  We went here with my family this past Sunday afternoon to celebrate my husband's birthday.

When we arrived, we noticed that they had a huge brunch buffet set up.  I am usually not a fan of buffets (usually avoid them at all costs) because 1) its usually just a lot of so-so food and 2) I tend to eat more to try to "get my money's worth".  But I made an exception this time because it all looked really good and I could tell that it was good quality.  $16 for adults and $6 for kids.

My kids immediately noticed the cinnamon rolls which were HUGE and so based on that alone they also insisted on ordering the buffet.  They had caesar salad (OK), tomato basil soup (delish), great fruit, sausage, bacon, two types of eggs, hashbrown casserole (really good), biscuits and some sort of creole gravy, prime rib (really good), eggs benedict station (didn't have this but husband said it was good).  And of course the huge cinnamon rolls and french toast which had grand marnier in them.  

My Mother in law ordered the Salmon Oscar which came out without the hollandaise sauce as noted on the menu. She said it was a 3.  My father in law ordered the reuben sandwich and he seemed to enjoy it.  

Overall, it was delicous and I ate more than I should.  Needless to say I didn't eat anything for the rest of the day.  Would I go back, definitely.  If in the Cool Springs area on a Sunday and are wanting a good brunch place, you should check it out.

I just tried this place for the first time. It is their grand opening. I think this may formerly have been called Sakura but I'm not sure.

I have eaten in many many sushi bars but this is one of the higher quality places I have tried. The pieces of fish on the nigiri sushi are large and fresh. I tried three types of tuna, The redfish, the unagi, and the hamachi and all were very good. The spider roll was beautifully prepared and very flavorful. The menu has great variety and some interesting rolls that you won't see on many other menus. 
They also have some good beers on tap and the decor of the restaurant is quite upscale.
Right now because of the grand opening they have a 50% off special going on. The restaurant was empty when I was there at noon on a Saturday.  I pretty well stuffed myself with sushi and had a beer and the total damage was 23 bucks. Try it out!

Had a much needed massage on a day off from work. Absolute Haven was clean and very professional in appearance and with staffing. I felt at ease right away. I live only 5 minutes away and wish I had known about this place before now. I probably had the best massage of my life and left so relaxed. I will definitely be back and recommend Absolute Haven to anyone needing some relaxation and "me" time.

This is probably the blandest pizza in East Nashville. The crust has less flavor than most frozen pizzas. I gave them more than 1 Star just because they are in my neighborhood and I want them to be better than they are. I order from here about 1 once a year and that reminds me why I go other places. Their wings are good but if your looking for pizza I'd suggest going elsewhere.

Very friendly staff and my fajitas were excellent. Good quality meats. The inside decor was nice. The only thing was- they only gave me 2 tortillas for my fajitas... usually Mexican restaurants give you at least 3. I had to ask for more but they were nice about it.

Last time I will use FedEx Office. Went in for a passport photo, and there were two guys working there. In ten minutes of standing at the counter, neither of them ever acknowledged that I existed, or even looked my way. As I waited, a line of customers waiting to pay formed behind me. I originally thought it would be faster than taking my own picture, cropping and printing it, but I gave up on FedEx and went and did it myself. Don't know who else does passport photos, but for copies, I certainly choose to use the local Bill's Copy Shop, after a previous bad experience with FedEx for copies. They're a waste of time.

I had the CRISPY HIPCITY RANCH  and my friend had the UDON NOODLE SALAD. Im not much of a salad person but it was good, but wow, my ranch sandwich was Amazing! I have never had anything taste so much like the real thing. This is the place to go if you want to satisfy the cravings from missing out on many favorite foods.  I cant wait to go back and try other items on the menu!

Went here for lunch last week. Chicken salad sun was amazing. I'll go back because the subs are fresh and higher caliber than most sub shops. The staff were friendly but not the most knowledgeable... I'd say 3 on service 4 on food quality.

Please thumb up/comment if you liked this review and I would count it a privilege if you chose to follow me as I review places I travel and visit. Thank you for taking the time to read! ~mp

I ordered a med pizza with pepperoni & mushrooms and 2 gyro platters on grubhub. When I finally got my order, which took a little over an hour, the food was cold and my pizza didnt have any pepperoni on it. When I called the restaurant I spoke with manager who agreed to send me another pizza but was very adamant about me sending the wrong pizza back to him. I told him I didnt eat it and was willing to send it back. Another 50 mins later, I called because I hadnt received my new pizza yet. He said that the pizza was on its way and again told me he wants his pizza back and immediately hung up the phone on me. The food is usually good but their customer service sucks. Don't be mad at the customer if you messed up! I usually order from here atleast once or twice a month but I think I'm going to take my business somewhere else now.

The food was excellent and the staff where very friendly and welcoming. My only complaint is the lack of seating, it was very crowded the day I was there, but it is a small place and I gather they do a lot of takeout.

Dante's has the best roast pork sandwiches ever. The prices are reasonable considering the area. The establishment is clean and the service is really good. The wait staff is also very kind. I would highly recommend going to Dante's for a quick bite to eat!

Be on the lookout for this place because you'll probably just drive on by without even knowing it's there. The place was slow when my gf and I were there but that was not a hint in how our experience would be. I had the Special Dinner and she had the Camarones Rancheros. Both were great.

Ever since moving down to the area, we've been trying to find that classic, free chips and salsa, albeit not authentic, Mexican place. Well, we found it here. I love true authentic Mexican food but sometimes you just crave the good old americanized version. Huge portions, quick service, and 2-4-1 happy hour. Great little place, we'll definitely be back.
*Five stars if the margaritas were a little stronger.*
Tried it for the first time because we had a Groupon, but we will definitely be back. its a cozy shop with a beautiful decor and awesome service. the food is the best we've had in Tampa yet.

Food is okay assuming you don't mind waiting ten minutes for the server to take a drink order and more than 45 minutes for food. And they weren't busy. This is the same experience we've had ever time we've been here, but this is the last time. Manager came out and was worthless, blaming it on "them" (wth, isn't that YOU?) not staffing sufficiently. Pretty pricey for portions, too. We've gone back because it's our end point when we get off the Katy Trail, but next time we'll head over to Trailhead. Would NOT recommend.

Decided to give this place a shot given its proximity from where we stayed. In town week of Thanksgiving so not busy. Snow white sushi dee-lish! Vegetable udon good. I thought sauce was a little too sweet but my husband had no issue. Server warmed up to us and was polite. I'd go back and try it again. Fish was fresh, great flavors.

This is a wonderful addition to CWE! 

My boyfriend and I ordered vegetable kofta, lamb and barley soup, kale salad (that is included in the main), Zarzuela de mariscos, and the moussaka al forno. 

We went in at around 4pm so we were the only ones dining there, which was nice. The waiter was super attentive. I ordered a glass of cab (clos de bois) which was fairly generously poured. The bread came pretty promptly and was freshly baked just for us. There was pumpernickel, min corn muffins, and one other rustic white bread. The breads were so good we ended up asking (or accept the offer) for a refill. 

The kofta came out first and it was lovely! i didn't realize it would be kind of falafel-esque but i love falafels so that was no problem. The lentil cakes were fried and seasoned perfectly and the lentil curry was also very savory. Everything came together well, and we cleaned the plate (to which the waiter said he'll tell the chef how much we liked the dish). Then the soup and salad came. The soup was okay, not that surprising- tasted like lamb and barley. The kale salad was great. I loved being able to taste the fresh kale and not have the salad be overpowered by the creamy anchovy dressing. The crostinis seemed to be baked though and not fried, so the crunch wasn't as satisfying. 

As for our entres, the zarzuela was cooked to perfection. The scallops had a nice char to them without being overcooked. Unfortunately, at this point I was too full to finish. The Moussaka (bf's dish) was also great. The lamb may have been slightly overseasoned but it wasnt unpleasant. Nathalie's seems to focus on highlighting the flavors of their quality ingredients. 

I really wanted to try their desserts but really didn't have any room, so decided to get one to-go. We opted for the Childs' Delight (as it serves 3 kinds). The caramel, whipped cream, and chocolate fudge were all packaged in a separate small container, so that was nice but kinda hard for me to know which sauce went with which pastry. But they were still sweet and tasty. 

I would definitely like to come back here and try the pate and the other chef's specials.

I rarely give a five star rating to a restaurant. The Red Pony Restaurant in Franklin, Tennessee deserves five stars. The food was exceptional, and the service was a perfect match. My server was a very polite, attentive and friendly chap named Michael. He was simply superb... I wish all waiters were as professional. I ordered a house salad, lamb chops from the appetizer menu, two side orders, and a cocktail. All of that for $50! A fine choice for dinner in Franklin.

Teens, youth, and even toddlers all have a home here.  With tons of sites around town and very low fees, there's an opportunity for just about any family to get support. 

$20 per YEAR membership fee for teens, and low weekly rates for youth and toddlers, and scholarships for needy families make this such a contribution to our community.

The facilities are clean and the Staff is competent and flexible.  Such a great organization.

Went with friends last night for the first time. We all wanna get back there ASAP, such a fun night. Colleen, our server, was really great. Not only was she super genuine and nice, she took great care of us and our order.

Margaritas tasted fresh, we got a few pitchers...gotta say Im pretty sure they were weak.

Pork soft tacos were very good, split them with a friend and totally wished I'd gotten my own.

My other friend got the five alarm burrito, he was disappointed it wasn't spicier. Don't worry he just drenched it in hot sauce- so no harm done.

I'm a big fan of Mexican food. This is a great casual spot, gotta get back on a Monday for $10 pitchers.

Very professional and helpful staff.  Will go back.

We went in for a Smog Check and we were out in 10 minutes.  You can just tell from the cleanliness and the staff that this is a great place.

They even renewed our car registration along with the smog check.

Restroom was spotless.  Waiting room was comfortable.

And as a Southern Boy who grew up working on engines, I can tell you that Castrol has always been a top grade lubricant.

Just want to share my obnoxious experience at Total Wine today. Went in with my 19 year old daughter as I have many times. She has helped me carry bottles of booze in there many times before, no problem. Today because she was holding my bottle of cider as we were approaching the cashier, the cashier wouldn't sell it to me. The manager said I would have to leave and come back tomorrow to get it. I left and came back five minutes later, went to a different cashier and bought it, with my daughter still in tow, just as a f*ck you. Correct me if I'm wrong but if I buy booze and give it to my daughter, I'm the one getting in trouble, not Total Wine.
Gorgeous place with delicious wine.  It's on a dock at the edge of the pier in Santa Barbara.  There are tables outside and a view that is incredible.  A perfect date place.  :)

The Fat Ham is a small space so reservations is a must.  We arrived right on time for our 6:30pm reservation and got seated right away.  We ordered 7 dishes for just the 2 of us for the variety but I think we would have been fine with 5 dishes. 

We ordered:

Ricotta Cheese - so so good!
Oyster Slider - Delicious!
Shrimp & Grits - just so so
Baked Macaroni & Cheese - good - liked the added bbq chips sprinkled on top
Hot Chicken - Really crispy and Really spicy - perfect with the white bread and ranch dressing
Pulled Pork - least fave.  lacked flavor and bread got soggy.
Banana Pudding - perfect ending to temper all the spicyness  

The spicy sauce provided was so good.  I added it to pretty much all my bites. 

The Ricotta Cheese, Oyster Slider, and Hot Chicken were my favorites of the night.

Really delicious.  Went w/ the special grilled pork and spring roll over noodles. (Bún tht nng, I think.)  Pork was super tasty.  Salad and pickled veggies were fresh and nuoc plam was on point.  It was warm today and this absolutely hit the spot.  I won't hesitate to return again.

We attended the Father John Misty show on March 27th, 2015. The opening act was King Tuff. Parking was Super convenient cheap and a block away from the entry.

When entering the show the usual security measures were in place. Stamp on the hand and in you go. We quickly made our way to one of the two bars inside and  were friendly served weak drinks. Drinks in hand, we made our way to the bands merchandise stand. We bought a record and a tshirt. Since we had plenty of time before the show we wanted to take our purchases to the car so we could have both hands free. This was prohibited by security despite having a hand stamp and ticket. We shuffled into our place for the opening act. 

And this is where the real problem is with this venue. The reflective  nature of the concrete floor destroyed any hopes for decent acoustics and created an impossible task for the FOH(front of house) sound guy. So the sound was shite. The low end was muddy and overwhelming. The high end was worse. The middle was absent. 

I really believe FJM is a top shelf act. They were killin IT.  We walked away feeling like we didn't see or hear their best performance due to the Marathon Music Work shite PA filter.
Friendly staff and damn good comfort food. I'll eat my greens if it's cooked they way they do. Also the bone marrow gravy, I wish I could drizzle that on everything!

Driving around downtown looking for food and happened upon Maynards. The atmosphere inside is very welcoming and eclectic. Menus are provided when you are waiting in line. The food was amazing! I highly recommend the Jerk Chicken and Chicken Salad  sandwich. My main issue is with the service and time in which our food was brought to us. As we waited, my friend received her food first. After 15 minutes we asked a passing waiter for our food. 5 minutes later they explained there was a mix up. 5 minutes AFTER THAT, we received our food with a quick apology. I won't be returning.

Cell phone usage is out of hand. Some people talk on the phone during their entire work out. Distracting and annoying. People walking and reading texts thru crowded workout areas-unsafe. Gym has/had policy against phone calls on workout floor-was in contract but staff don't seem to know anything about this when asked. I'm guessing other gyms are seeing an acceleration in cell phone usage. Ugh...

Amazing. All of it was amazing. The pho broth will bring you back to life after drinking until death. We had Beef Pho with brisket and chicken pho were AMAZING. Loved the crab rangoons. Loved the Vietnamese iced coffee. Everything literally couldn't have been better. Also the wait staff is so attentive and kind. The lady waitress warmed my heart . Please come here and enjoy this dining experience. It was a much needed recharge after the loudness of bourbon street.

My review is biased. I only tried 3 flavors. 

Decor: 4/5
-lots of seating
-some of the tables might be sticky from gelato

Service: 3/5
-only one guy serving gelato and checking out.
-Expect a wait especially when you can have samples

Gelato: 4.5/5
-There are just so many flavors that I wanted to sample them all
-Jamaican coffee caught my eye and it had a strong coffee taste. If you're a coffee lover, I'd recommend the Jamaican coffee

The only thing I have to say against the Sonesta is, the redo for the bathrooms won't stay on.  Other wise, it's a beautiful place. Oh, the pool is on the third floor.  We did t find it until late yesterday.

Great selection and very helpful staff.  I buy all my dog's food and treats here, and they are always kind and patient with both of us.  I found a cat (or it found me), and I had it for over a week before I was able to reunite it with its owners.  I don't know a lot about cats, and the staff was very helpful to me.  Highly recommend this store.

Okay, here's the deal: this used to be an Avon staple (and I'm sure it all is for some), as it was one of the original restaurants along Rockville Road. 

This location's food has always been great. I've always stuck with the BBQ grilled chicken, steak fries and salad or the gelled chicken salad. The portion sizes are consistent & I commend them for all of that. 

However, the last few times my family and I visited the host staff has been incredibly rude - incredibly. I'm not the guy who often complains about much, but when it comes this, the host staff can really set the tone for a patron's experience. (Can you tell I was a host trainer in a past life?) The problem is each time we've been to this location the head host made it seem like we were bothering her to be seated. Last week (a weekday, around 4:45pm), when I asked for a low both the head host took a deep breath, didn't say anything and rolled her eyes. This, my friends, is NOT acceptable!

On the other hand, the service is usually pretty great! Of course, once you set a bad tone the moment a patron walks in the door, the less likely they are to remember how great everything else was.

I had a wonderful experience with Jones West Ford of Reno.  I researched the vehicles I was interested in, then contacted the Internet Sales person online. I ended up with a great, beautiful vehicle, at a fair price. The staff is very knowledgeable, professional and treated me with the utmost respect. I am happy with my purchase, and highly recommend this dealership.

I love rescue spa.  The staff is so friendly. The spa/salon is clean and very modern.  It's quite beautiful.  Hardwood floors, chandeliers, calming aroma- very Zen.  

I've been here several times for waxing and am ALWAYS pleased.  My most recent appointment for the Lotus wax was with Chrissy.  She is an excellent esthetician and was fast, efficient, friendly, and fun.  All things positive when you're getting waxed.  The Lotus is $60 and is worth every penny.   I've been here before where my esthetician used blue (hard) wax- a bit painful but as they say "the juice is worth the squeeze".  Results are awesome.

The staff at Rescue are well trained and leave you feeling wonderful.  That's the point right?  Rescue Spa is my go-to in the city and no other place compares.

My family and I ate here after my graduation and I am so glad we did. At first glance I was a bit skeptical because the place is so small but we were sat fairly quickly. The service was great staff was very attentive to our large party. 
We ordered hibachi, sushi rolls, and edamame which was all delish.  My favorite was the tempura lobster roll. Even my Granny who has never tried sushi enjoyed it.
To our surprise, we received a $10 gift card for our future visits! Since this visit, I've ordered Tomo on Grubhub and it was still as good as it was in-house.
Fantastic! In town on business and found this place on yelp...food was outstanding.  Highly recommend the Vietnamese taco appetizer.  Only downside is BYOB/no alcohol.

This is such a great breakfast spot to eat in the gulch neighborhood area. Parking is located directly across the street, and the first hour is free. If you arrive early, you will more then likely get seated promptly. The place itself has plenty of seating for small and larger groups. If you're looking to order and grab and go, there is that option as well. For starters, I was highly impressed with the service and hospitality. My drink and meal order was taken promptly and brought out even faster. I ordered a vanilla bean latte made with coconut milk and the hot mess. The aroma of the latte alone was mouth watering. Overall, everything was great, and had amazing flavor. This place is definitely a must try if In the Nashville area.

I have gone to this Minute Clinic two times in the past month and have been so pleased with the service & care. The NPs are fabulous and so good with kids! The pharmacy techs are awesome too. If you need a quick care clinic, I would highly recommend them. No more urgent care clinics for us!

Tried this place after receiving a menu in the mail...very disappointed...ordered a brick oven pizza with grilled chicken and carmelized onions fresh tomatoes and cheese medallions...what I received was burnt, raw onions, a few tomatoes and a few cheese medalions...very disappointing.
We also tried their wings...run away...nasty frozen NOT fresh breaded/coated small wings that weren't even equally coated with sauce of choice.
Kicker was a small pizza and 10 wings was more than $25.00
Very disappointed...won't even try going back if they can't use the ingredients they tell you they will use
The owners need to fix the place up, the food is good though the employees are nice but not as efficient.

They diagnosed the problem correctly, quoted the work and completed on time. I received several quotes prior and Christian Brothers was the best price. I will take my other vehicles there for service in the future.

It pains me to say this but I had to give up on Plume. After calling at least 4 different times to try to see Jenny, it just wasn't gonna happen. I even requested appointment times in the middle or the day on weekdays. Nada. The woman answering the phone was not exactly apologetic about it either. Sigh. I have since found Nicole at American Mortals and am very happy there.

I've visited several highly rated coctail bars in the last 2 years and in St. Petersburg this is easily my favorite choice.
Interesting and entertaining mixologists, a good feel and great crowd.
Next time I'm downtown I know where I'm heading

Stopped by on a stormy day to find it nearly vacant at lunch time; I quickly found out it was because they had lost power and were not expecting their kitchen to begin producing hot food for another 30 minutes. Thankfully, I only wanted some oysters! The staff was super attentive, and I was quickly enjoying 6 of the largest oysters I've ever seen. They kept apologizing for the inconvenience, and the bartender gave me a free bowl of the gumbo base (sausage and okra). Then the oyster shucker handed me 2 more oysters on the house; all of the oysters were very fresh and mild. 

I can't speak to anything other than the oysters, really, or what their service is like during busy times, but what I experienced was fantastic!

La Encantada is a beautiful outdoor mall.  They have very high end stores and the crowds to go with it.

If I need a nice gift or need that perfect dress, I always hit La Encantada first.  With Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Crate and Barrel, Anthropologie, Papyrus, Coach, MAC, and an Apple store (among many others), it's a great place to spend the day.

I love to hit Williams-Sonoma to look at their latest stuff, wanter around Anthropologie and Crate and Barrel and then hit up AJ's Fine Foods for an iced coffee and some chocolate.  And a 6 pack of beer and fancy cheese to go.

I recommend parking in the back (entrance is off of Campbell north of Sunrise)- there are more spots and it's less hectic than the entrance off of Sunrise by AJs.  I've never left La Encantada disappointed after a shopping trip.

HOWEVER

At night, the restaurants (Especially North) come alive with a pretty unique crowd- older singles (post-college) acting like they have more money than they actually do.  Or the DILF wanna bes dropping Benjamins like it's no big deal, just trying to hook up.  On the flipside, it's also a Cougartown.  So be warned.

Interesting place with an interesting crowd given that I guess it's a speakeasy-ish kind of place, but that's why I like it. You've got your upholstered furnishings, paintings, and an aesthetic that fits right in with the other speakeasies in Center City. But the crowd is more Center City after-hours casual - that's not to say you can walk in with flip-flops or gymwear, but the general feel is that it's way less of a hassle to step in and enjoy a drink or few over the course of the night without having to endure long lines, cramped and dark waits.

Favorite restaurant in Indy, no questions asked! Love everything about Oakleys, except for the fact that more people don't know about it, and that it's usually not too busy after 9PM (I enjoy late dining, and not being the last one to leave!) Other than that...GO! You'll be glad you did!

This is the place to go if you live within one block and do not want to walk further, or only have five dollars to get trashed for the evening.  Also, people still smoke in here. 

One fun event- they have a rib cook off in the summer.  The locals from Conshy all bring their best ribs, and you can sample ribs and drink (all you can!) for five bucks.  Had a great time... i think....

We came to cap off our dinner with a bit of gelato for dessert. All of the flavors in the display case looked so delicious and inviting, that I couldn't decide what to choose. Luckily, the worker was kind enough to humor me and allow me to try a few samples, and to ask a lot of silly questions, before deciding.

We were told that all of the gelato was made from milk from an Amish farm in Lancaster County, and that the sweet Amish milk flavor is the base they use for all of the other gelato flavors. Because there was so much to pick from, we ended up asking which flavors we should get. He suggested gooseberry if we wanted to get something local that we can't get elsewhere, or strawberry since they're in season and from Lancaster County... I ended up with miniature cup of toasted almond and strawberry terragon, and they were delicious. Before filling up my cup, he asked if I liked terragon and gave me a sample to make sure that I'd be happy with my choice.

I also requested to top my gelato with free panna per the sign on the counter, not exactly knowing what it was... it's whipped cream. A friend said that the panna here was amazing, but I didn't care for it and could have done well enough with just the gelato, instead.

All in all, I enjoyed my gelato and I appreciated the good customer service! Too bad it's a little expensive... and that I live in Los Angeles.

Extremely delicious sandwiches. Great decor, diverse crowd. The mulfaletta is the best!!  Great service, nice owner. What more could you want?? Live Blues every Thursday and Saturday. Definitely coming back here more often.

This is hands down one of the best places to eat on the Eastern Main line. The service is impeccable- timely, polite, friendly and responsive. When I ordered the tofu pad Thai, the server asked if I was ok with egg in the dish. So conscientious! 

We eat here A LOT and have tried most of the menu. The soups are delicious as are the appetizers we have tried. Our favorite entrees are the curries, pad Thai, drunken noodles and some of their specials. Recently they had a Broad Street special and it was spectacular. We also love the apple salad. 

Highly HIGHLY recommend making this one of your regular spots!!

Quite honestly, the worst dining experience I've ever had, not just in Nola. 

We got there early for our reservation, and they sat us early. Good start. They brought out good bread. Ok, not so bad so far. First issue: we specifically asked for a game to be on their TVs when we made the reservation, and they assured us that the bar would be playing that game. They did not play that game. Oh well, not really a big deal.

Hey, that reminds me. Didn't we put in for drinks and oysters half an hour ago? Where are they? After another 15 minutes, a separate waiter comes and gets our drinks, finally. After another 15 minutes, no oysters, so we decide to put in our orders. Maybe the oysters have escaped.

Our oysters finally come after an hour of waiting for them, and they're ok. My matza ball soup is pretty much tasteless. The broth has a slight chicken flavor but other than that, nothing. The gumbo my friends got was tiny. Our waiter has now not talked to us or checked on us in well over an hour. He is busy talking to the bachelorette party and some random guy at the bar. Our other waiter is busy with his own tables, but makes more of an effort to check in on us probably 3 times over the course of a 2.5 hour marathon restaurant experience.

Now I get my entree, the fried oyster salad. The only redeeming quality of this salad is the bacon. Everything else was pretty much worthless. They oysters tasted slightly of salt, but that's it. 

The bread pudding was only good for the topping and ice cream. Once you run out of sauce, it became literally a semi-thick, unsweet dough. 

0/5 terrible experience.

7:50pm on a Saturday. Terrible service. Been here 30mins so far and no food, our order was just taken. Took almost 20 mins to get a glass of wine. The wine selection is really small and I would not say good. The wine we picked it terrible. It seems like everyone in here is waiting for something. The food was good, however no one ever came to check on us. Like at all. We are still currently waiting for the waitress to come out. It is very awkward in here, considering my table and 1 other table of 2 are left. Watching everyone clean.

I have been to other JCSs and the food was tasty, the staff was fun and the dining experience was enjoyable - this location however lacked all three and more. 
My salad was rotten and the staff made me feel like it was my fault to return it, our order came out wrong and the food was greasy, gross and tasteless. The manager eventually came out and offered free appetizers for our next visit, but I really have no intention of ever going back and declined the offer. 
I did appreciate his effort. however after bad food and questionable service combined with yelling, singing and loud goofing-off from the kitchen area I felt they really don't care if this ship sinks. My advise is to skip it.

The food is the same as any other Wendy's...just 10x's slower service. They seemed to be understaffed for lunch and disorganized. The guy taking orders was also handing out food, getting drinks and making salads. I really felt bad for this poor guy lol.  The lady behind me in line started to complain about how long it was taking for the guy to take orders so I reminded her that there was another restaurant acorss the street if she didnt want to wait and that it wasn't the guys fault he was doing the job of three people. Sigh...people who have never worked in the food industry.  

In the end, the wait was long but not bause of a "long menu" or people not working...just very understaffed.
Got the deluxe scramble. It was incredibly good! Best scramble I've ever had. Great food. Great service.

Pizza Hut usually sucks but not this time. After a long day at 6 Flags, my cousins, their kids, and my siblings were starving and all the good ole ma and pa pizzeria's were closed at 11. I usually go for Dominos but it wasn't nearby so we ordered a large pan pizza, a large stuffed crust, and a regular large pie. They had seating inside but no one was there. It looked pretty new and clean. 3 pies with one topping came out to $39, pretty pricey compared to the other chained pizzeria's but it was so fresh it was really worth it. Its about 5-10 mins from the Elements Ewing, for anyone that is looking for late night pizza.

I'll keep it short and sweet. 

Pros: Great atmosphere, intimate, live performances bring life, excellent food.

Cons: Poor inconsistent service, "tapas style" food(small portions, not a meal to get full or it will cost you), reservations a must, seedy neighborhood.

Great Greek Restaurant. 
Harry and Family have mastered the the skills of running several First Class Greek Restaurants.

Always great food, great service and a wonderful experience. 

We have enjoyed many delicious meals a Spiros. 

They have several private dining rooms at this location as well.

We have enjoyed Family get togethers here as well as entertaining business clients. 

The waiter's and staff are a class act.

If they offered 10 Stars You Have Earned It.

Had dinner last night with my 94 year old Dad and 85 Year old Mom.

Thanks Michael.
best cuban sandwich in the midwest & its authentic.  the owner and daughter are rockstarsgreat people very personable and customer service driven.  clean, colorful and vibrant.

HALLELUJAH!

Some innovative, INTERESTING, DARING southeast Asian food in NOLA! (And in my neighborhood no less!) The food here is far different from what you'll get at your standard New Orleans Vietnamese restaurant, and light years away from a local Thai place. Everything we ate was aggressively seasoned (and by that I mean perfectly seasoned), cooked to perfection, and unlike anything else in the city.

I've been struggling with the new restaurants in the city because I feel like everyone is doing the same thing - crudos, pastas, flatbreads blah blah blah. Marjie's Grill is wholly unique, and wholly delicious.

Stand outs:
- The charred cabbage salad: This really reminded me of something that would come out of Grandmother's kitchen. Somehow managed to be cooked and doused in delicious sauce but still feel fresh.
- The charred pig knuckles: I always appreciate a restaurant that's ballsy enough to put stuff like this on the menu. If you're not an adventurous eater, I think this is a great gateway into all things beautiful and chewy. TRY IT!
- The half BBQ chicken: This stole the show. You get half of a *perfectly barbecued* chicken, a huge pile of herbs and a delicious sauce. You're instructed to essentially make your own lettuce wraps out of the herbs and top them with the sauce. So yummy. So so yummy. Dreaming about eating this again.

Other notes:
- The restaurant ambiance is very casual- they're currently building a back patio that will be a total game changer.
- Happy hour Tues-Fri 4:30-6:30
Very impressed with the quality of food. The place itself is a cool spot where you can sit outside and service is very good! Highly recommend!

We ordered:
-tri tip sliders
-pork belly breakfast sandwich
-coffee
-scone
-Cronut (Tucsons version)

Positives:
-properly cooked
-properly seasoned
-friendly/knowledgeable/attentive staff
-serves specialty/locally roasted coffee from EXO.
-the space is comfortable and welcoming. You could stay there all day. 
-Sunday brunch is worth the wait. 

Negatives:
-the only complaint I have is for the Cronut. It's unfortunately dry and hard if not ordered from the oven. Ask how long it's been out of the oven before you order it, and or ask them to warm it up first. 

Business suggestions:
-you guys are excellent and a true Tucson gem. Keep doing what your doing. 

Will we return:
-absolutely. Every Sunday brunch! It's refreshing to have a place serve excellent breakfast with intentional flavors and attention to detail. Not to mention having a place serve quality coffee. Check it out, see you Sunday!

Food is A++ every time my friends and I go we try something different on the menu and have never been disappointed. I give it 4 stars because the service is so-so and they have DJs and bands come in at night. Some people may enjoy it but I find it really annoying. It's so loud you can't even hear the person next to you. They have great deals too - my favorite is Wine down Wednesdays; $3 off wings and wine.

Like the 2 stars on Yelp say... "meh, I've experienced better" - yep.

Although the service was pretty good and the dishes came out promptly, the food wasn't all that great.
