The lunch started out with a house soup (your usual "leftovers" soup - bamboo shoots, tofu, sprouts - whatever else is left over from yesterday thrown in a pot) - meh. 

Fresh Rolls - I've had much better. Lettuce, sprouts, and a bit o' shrimp in some rice paper rolls. 

Spicy Chicken Fried Rice - Wasn't all that great... the weird part was that it had a sweaty kinda look to it - moist, maybe? The taste was okay and the portions were large... but ehh...

My friends both had the pad kra prow - and both said it was bland. Not a very good way to describe food. 

Well... I guess we should've known when we arrived to a pretty empty restaurant right in the middle of lunch hour. Didn't get much better throughout the lunch hour, either. Whatever... 

Definite skipper in my opinion... I'd rather go to Chiang Mai

A group of four came in after a visit to the rotating display at the Sellersville Museum. It was Mr Peanut and Planters. Well worth a stop next time you are close... but that's a different review... on to the Horse! We started with beverages, three local beers and a cocktail. A dish of steamers in white sauce and the homemade, beer battered pickles. Tasty! Only two of the steamers hadn't opened although we could have used crunchy bread to sop up the garlicky, buttery juice. Pickles, sliced twice the size of commercial pickles were just on the edge of too big... but never fell over. Lightly battered, a bit salty, quite yummy. Three of the party all had the Cuban sandwiches, melted cheese oozing & again with those snappy pickles, the sandwich was good. Love to bite through the crispy crust. I had the burger just to compare their bacon jam to mine and I was pleasantly surprised to have the flavor & texture be right there! Juicy patty, the jam made a wonderful counterpoint to be buttery bun that caught all the meaty goodness. We come up once a year and we'll definitely be back. Our waitress was very nice, sorry forgot her name.

This is the best place to catch a movie in the week before it leaves the theatres. Never mind the hassle of navigating the cloverleaf from hell and the throng of screaming tweens who are just, like, so happy that Mom and Dad let them see a movie unsupervised and, summarily, have no idea how to behave (let's not talk about how my fiance and I recently went to see 'Gran Torino' and, upon leaving the theatre, were faced with dozens of Jonas Brothers-obsessed fangirls who didn't understand the concept of indoor voices). But none of that's not Loews' fault.

Like every other movie theatre, your wallet is going to feel ravaged in all the wrong ways by the time you've paid for your tickets and some snacks. But that's okay! The smaller theatres for last-chance-to-see-'em flicks are so cozy and clean and intimate, and the foods and snacks are some of the best in the area (second only to The Ritz in Voorhees). The staff is also surprisingly competent, which is a total bonus. 

Also? The comfiness of the theatre seats and the fact that they're able to recline a bit is deserving of its own paragraph. 

After years of the in-shambles Marlton AMC8 being my primary movie theatre, Loews is a wonderful upgrade. I'm eager to check out the still-relatively-new IMAX theatre they installed during the summer. I'm sure once I do, I'll bump this up to four stars.

This place is a great location with an awesome vibe! I appreciated that they knew we were in a hurry so they got us in and out quickly and worked with us on running late.
Heads up! The Asian shrimp appetizer is SPICY!! It was too spicy for most of us!
What a romantic restaurant with such delicious food! It was so good that I wished the portions were a little bit bigger :) BYOB is def a plus! Thank you for a wonderful time The Farm and Fisherman!!!

Highly recommend the bbq shrimp paired w duck horn Merlot or a nice refreshing beer. Several locals raved about the bbq shrimp here and they were right. Sat at the bar had great service and got a tip on this dish... Ask for extra bread, you'll want it to soak up every drop of this sauce. The bread in the bag that they bring is better than the bread the dish is served with.

Dear Mary (the owner), I'm very disappointed.   I came here on Sunday (feb 11) at 5:11.  Friendly counter person.  I asked for a dark roast to find it was not ready.  To be accomodating, I said I'd try the last of the medium roast. I tried and found it to be not hot and didnt taste right.  BUT, that same previously friendly counter person replaced with a small instead of the 16oz I paid for.  He refused to replace because he did a pour over.   I'm disgusted.   I left the coffee behind.  I'll not be back.
24 hour store that is great for on the way to work pick up.   Picked up some decent flowers for a work display.  A security guard was at the door on my last 5:30 am visit.

Had been curious about Freddy's after seeing them pop up around town. Well, not so any more. Not my favorite burger; tasted like charred meat. Onion rings extra crispy were good dipped in the fry sauce.  Half our order was messed up somehow which the manager attributed to the computer screens messing up. ??  What was most disturbing though was how filthy the place was. The tables were all greasy and had clearly been "cleaned" with greasy rags. The floor was dirty and very sticky. It was disturbing to see that the floor was being "mopped" with a Swiffer, and food on the floor was just pushed to the side.  I really wanted some custard because the taste we had been given was really good, but after watching the water on the dripping rag being slopped all over the machine we decided not to.

At other Home Depots I have felt very lost. I have had trouble finding things and have walked out with what I thought was the proper thing - only to find - once I got home that I made a mistake. 

While this Home Depot is indeed large, the employees are easy to find- they are always very helpful, knowledgeable and friendly. In all my years of going there I only had difficulty finding an employee to help on one occasion. ---- at that time I climbed to the top of one of their ladders and an employee was at my side within seconds- ready to help.

Went on a friend's birthday for a birthday dinner and had a very bad experience. A very long wait despite having reservations, and then it took forever just to get a drink from the bar. The food was very, very disappointing--I ordered the lettuce wraps and left hungry. We split a few appetizers, including the crudite/hummus plate--I was just shocked at how overpriced it all was. This is definitely for the yuppie set that doesn't mind spending $ on mediocre food.

I'm not sure if this is correct cab company, but we took a cab with a man named Matthew from White Fleet Cab and he was AWESOME!!  He had taken us to City Park and gave us his card for when we needed a ride back to our hotel.  We ended up getting engaged that night while at City Park.  When Matthew came back to pick us up, we told him what had happened and he shared in our excitement!  It made the night so much more fun.  He even took us to the airport the next day and gave us our first wedding gift - a New Orleans Jazz CD.  Matthew was truly an amazing guy and he made our first days as an engaged couple so much more memorable and enjoyable.

Coming from the Northeast Coast of the US (NYC Metro Area) I have been blessed with an abundance in options when it comes to great delis and sub shops.  Therefore, I can firmly say that the subs here are simply awful. The bread is blah and too soft.  The deli meats and cheeses were also blah, especially on their bread...yuck.  The tuna salad seemed fresh but again, blah.  

Tips to the Owners and/or Management:
-First off, learn to make good bread or start purchasing it from a decent bread shop or bakery.  
-Secondly, taste a piece of cardboard, then a piece of any of your sandwiches, note the similarities and vow to change every thing.  

My advice: Stick to Wonder bread, ham & cheese from the supermarket; you'll save money & won't be as hugely disappointed.
I am here now. The location is terrific  but our carpet is stained!!! 250$ a night is a  bit overpriced.  Boo..

I created an account just to write this. 

This place is terrific. The gentleman who runs it is very nice, and its modest appearance belies the quality of food on offer.

The menu is quite small, but the bibimbap is excellent. $8 gets you a whole meal of fresh vegetables, quality meat (or tofu), and just the right amount of heat. There is no heavy-handed dousing of sauce all over the vegetables, and you can finish a meal without feeling like a hot mess. I've sampled almost the whole menu, and each time the experience is the same - a full stomach, great taste, the freshest ingredients, quick service, and a kind proprietor. I'm not sure what else you could ask for. Highly, highly recommended.

Terrible service on our visit here on 05/16/2015 server name Lyndel waited for my strawberry shakes for 45 min. and when we ask for it she said still in the process of making them and unlimited fries still in the fryer. This is our third visit and to my dismay this is the worst server we ever have.

Started off badly when the hostess wanted to seat the two (my mom and i) of us across from the kitchen when the entire establishment was 1/3 full. I objected and we were placed in a better spot. we both ordered the fried chicken. Chicken tasty and lots of it. Could have used more gravy. Server nice and attentive.

Very cool place. You walk into what seems like a living room with couches and round coffee tables as the dining tables. 

You eat the entire meal with a towel on your lap as a sort of large body-napkin. This is different, but useful as you're eating solely with your hands and that can get quite messy. 

As for the food: all 7 courses were very good and I personally loved the variety. You did not have to pick one entree but rather got the full spread of Moroccan cuisine. Loved the lamb although it's a pretty fatty meat. Finished it off with a hot cup of mint tea. 

Oh yeah, and there was a belly dancer which certainly added to the whole experience. I would recommend this as a great group outing or date night if you want a cultural experience and something different from your ordinary dining options. 

FYI: cash only. Had to sneak out and hit up the atm across the street in the smoke shop. Ended up buying some hookah to keep the "mellow" vibe going. 

Definitely check this place out.

We have eaten here before and had very good food and service, however , on our recent lunch experience we had poor food. The vegetable of the day was lima beans which were so salty we didn't finish eating them. The squash casserole was bland and tasteless. We paid extra to include a house salad on the veggie plate and it was basically greens, carrots, tomatoes, purple onion with dressing of choice.. no croutons, no cheese, no bacon ... overall poor lunch, but good service.

Kya baat, kya baat, kya baat
Good restaurant with good food.
Kya baat, kya baat, kya baat

I visited during a trip last September to NOLA and absolutely loved this place. We did a couples massage and the staff was so kind and thoughtful. Also, my massage therapist pointed out a couple of bad habits of mine, too much salt, leaning to one direction when driving, etc., which was amazing! I couldn't believe how much she could tell by working me over. I left feeling refreshed and VERY happy! I'll be back!!!

fantastic brunch today.  dishes are thoughtfully put together.  French toast was to die for.  just the right lightness in the brioche.  dads special with corned beef hash another highlight.  bloody Mary bar has pickles made by the chef and was fantastic.    the chef Steve was superfriendly.  as was our server angel.  really not a thing to improve and while the restaurant is not cheap, we got excellent value for money.

This place is great! It has outdoor seating and is BYOB. Not sure why people are docking them a star for that, it's Philadelphia we all know how hard it is to get a liquor license in PA. Anyway about the food we had the special the avocado toast and I added the egg. It was an amazing huge piece of marbled rye toast with avocado and chopped tri color tomatoes. It was so good! Some things to know when you go is definitely bring cash since its cash only and get there early or expect to wait a really long time! Other then that bring your poison and appetite.
Love it! Can't get enough of it. Music, cocktails and spicy Mexican food that is to die for. Great place to take a date!

They clearly have addressed my first review. I love this place now..................(old review) It's your average donut shop with some cool and or Strange donut flavors. Nothing about the actually donut was amazing.  Underwhelmed really..........

These guys made things right after my previous visit there the district manager contacted me back in regards to the complaint that I had left and sent me a gift card up to $20 over the original amount that I spent in order to compensate me for my time as well as the amount that I spent there that is good business indeed however I don't think that it was necessary but I will continue coming here because I was taken seriously and was given a business apology.

Spectacular!! Had a family meal there tonight and boy was it good.  Service was great and manager was very personable. Had hibachi meals and they were perfect.  Excellent rice and ginger salad was great as well.  Definitely recommend to anyone who likes sushi and hibachi.

I love this place! As someone who has eaten a lot of Indian food I can say that this one is really good. There are a lot of veggie options too, and the place has a nice atmosphere. I've never been for lunch, but I've heard they do a buffet, which would be a great time to try new things if you're not sure what you like yet.

The only thing I found unusual was putting a little bit of shredded cheese on top of my dish for garnish, which I'd never seen done at an Indian place before. Overall, 5 Stars, give it a shot.

I come here every day on my lunch break and it never gets old. Very friendly, promptly gets the food out, and have amazing benefits with the rewards card. The best WiFi in that plaza too. It's pretty peaceful if you get past the annoying kids that the mom won't supervise. . But all thumps up for me

Jessah and Dustin are very cute and made me very welcome.
90 minutes Massage with Jessah was WONDERFUL. 

Would recommend it to everyone.

Thank you, will definetely return!!

We hit the U City Dewey's after a movie at the Tivoli.  We were surprised that at 9:30, it was still packed with families and young kids.  It was loud and busy, but fun, and we were given a booth in which we could still have a conversation and nice meal.  The service here is amazing.  Our server was prompt and smiling, and came back with our starter salad within minutes of ordering.  It was fresh and tasty.  While we were eating, a chef , GM, or manager of some sort checked on us.  
Next, we got a half & half pizza, which is actively promoted or even encouraged by the waitstaff.  Not too common at a pizza joint where sometimes that is not allowed, costs extra, or is greeted with an eye roll...  Pizza was good- solid crust, lots of yummy ingredients, and the perfect amount for us.  We got checked on a few more times- and while this might be overkill at cozy, romantic place, it's spot on for a family joint in which kids, parents, etc have many requests and needs.  
In addition to the enthusiastic service, other employees were cleaning and helping out all over the restaurant.  Well run place.  Not necessarily our speed on a regular basis with not having kids, but glad we went.

I feel like you have to TRY to screw up orders as bad as they do. Not only that but we had an experience once when I was there with my 2 kids and 2 employees were screaming at each other. They were cussing and finally one left. I got her name and called corporate to complain- never heard back. Next time we went in (we always went before PSR on Wednesdays) that employee was there again. I can't believe she wasn't fired for screaming and cussing in front of kids!

My family and I have been going here since I was a child and it is always delicious - literally everything on the menu is amazing - homemade, authentic, and crafted with love. The warm, friendly atmosphere and welcoming family vibe feels truly like being in my grandmother's kitchen. My favorites are the ravioli, stuffed shells, and eggplant. You can't go wrong with this little hidden Italian gem.

This place is easily one of the best in Indy!  Very unique menu that may not appeal to all as substitutions are "politely declined" per the menu, but there is no reason to request substitites! My wife ordered their grilled cheese and it was phenomenal! Cheese on the outside of the bread and inside topped with a sunny side up egg and the combination was exquisite! I ordered the tarte pancake, and it was to die for! Only open for breakfast and lunch, but definitely a must-stop at kind of place!

I tried this place out for the first time today and I have to say I was very pleased. I went around 11am and they took me right away. The nail tech was very professional and friendly. I got a mani/pedi with shellac and it came out beautifully. The nail tech took his time cleaning up my nails making sure they looked nice and healthy.  I'm really happy with the visit and I will definitely be back.
Delicious food, I had the Meatloaf with potato cake, and the housemade spiced mocha made with specialty coffee from Ethos Coffee Roasters (best dessert ever). Super friendly staff.

This is a great pharmacy. Refills are handled promptly expeditiously and with care. Service with a smile. Prices are excellent. Pharmacist directly involved in the service rendered and if there's a problem they will go out of their way to resolve your problem.
They will actively pursue insurance related problems. They will readily call your physician's office for refills. Here you're not an anonymous customer
Impeccable service, terrific selection, exquisite taste. Not cheap. Not cheap at all. But if you can afford it, worth it, without a doubt.

I have been to this location many times in the past and do not recall any issues. I did just go here again tonight and was still very satisfied. The menu has defiantly grown significantly since my last visit years ago. The staff were very friendly to me and being a NY Style pizza joint I feel it was great. Pricing is pretty good. I did knock down a star because of the location. Im not saying its not clean it certainly seems to be from the outside but it definitely seems disorganized. Im never a fan of the joints that have pre made boxes especially when they are stacked to the ceiling. It makes you wonder how clean they are plus attracts insects. I think the main entrance could be polished up pretty easily and reorganized which would gain some visual appeal to customers especially those whom were scared off in the past from issues. Keep it up guys you have a great product! Now lets make it shine!

First visit and very impressed. We ordered almost one of every meat between our two combos to give a fair assessment. Ribs, pork, sausage were exceptional. Brisket was good but a bit dry. We'd skip the chicken next time. Okra, French fries (to die for!), green beans and baked beans were all delicious. Had the banana pudding for dessert and it was tasty. Great to find this friendly, solid place so close to home. We will be back.
Took my daughter out for a daddy/daughter date. Great options and great service. The setting  and Decor was bright and clean.
Delicious veggie tacos and guacamole! I even prefer these tacos over the ones at Bakersfield! Service was quick and friendly. We will definitely be back for more.

In a nut shell: smoky with a bizarre layout, nice spa, and decent food. 

Stayed here during a cross country road trip. The place is HUGE and the woman who checked us in had to write down the directions to our room. "Take the main lobby elevator to the third floor, walk down to the skyway, across the skyway, take the elevator to the second floor and your room is right there." The second elevator was small, rickety, and cold, like it was an old service elevator. It seemed like there must be a better way to get there but what do I know?

Had a massage in the spa. Nice amenities to enjoy before and/or after your service (sauna, steam room, whirlpools, etc.). The masseuse talked the entire time about HERSELF. It was weird. The massage was nice but way overpriced.

Our room was small but not cramped. It was cheap, so we weren't expecting a luxurious suite or anything. We ate at one of their restaurants that was decorated like we were under water or something. Bad decor, but really good food. The Ahi tuna appetizer was amazing!

Had a good night's sleep and a decent breakfast the next morning. Overall, it was fine but next time, I'll drive the extra 90 minutes and stay in Lake Tahoe.
Best coffee in the city! The staff is super friendly, the food is amazing! Great prices and relax environment!

Cute place. Has smoothies where you choose what you want and what fruits. They also have ice cream and soft serve where you can add toppings. There was even a chocolate rocks topping where I haven't seen since I was a kid. I got a soft serve smoothie with mango and strawberry. The regular size is about 16 ounces I want to say...

I LOVE THEIR CHARBURGERS and ONION RINGS and ZUCCHINI STICKS! I go at least two Sundays a month for the 1.89 charburger deal. I get two burgers and some onion rings, it usually costs about six bucks, WHAT A DEAL! The owner is awesome and friendly, as are the gals that work the register and the cooks in the back. They have never gotten my order wrong and their ranch dressing is to die for.

Very nice dining experience.  Immerse yourself into a relaxing  "far east" ambiance. Wait staff were very courteous and helpful. Had Chicken & veges over rice with the brown sauce. The sauce was the highlight of the dish. Spot on in terms of taste and consistency. Can't wait to go back and try their soups..

Everything about this place is awesome ...  I personally love the garlic knots and chicken wings ...my wife gives the spaghetti a 10 and my daughter likes the baked ziti , I have been here several times and will be here several times more !!!

Really great Italian food that doesn't hurt ur wallet. Stopped in for the first time. Seated right away. Really like the atmosphere. Casual and Very friendly staff. Seemed like a lot of regulars frequent this establishment.  It was really busy for a Tuesday night. Pizza was amazing as was the veal. I will definitely be back.

Went to Yo Sushi and had a great experience. The food was very tasty and I ventured out to try some new items. I had a lot of questions about the food and the ingredients and they were very helpful with answering all of my questions. I really enjoyed the yellowtail jalapeño and vegetable rice the most. Look forward to coming back to this location in the future.

Decided to hit the market for lunch on a rainy afternoon. After reading several reviews about what to eat, I looked up and noticed I was standing in front of Beck's. The reviews for their Mac n cheese balls did not disappoint!! They were excellent!!

Went with a couple of friends and family and all said place was nice and will  definitely come back.  

Appetizers (Cheese bread and Artichoke Dip) and were terrific.  Pizzas were better than average.  Garlic Parmesan wings were delicious.

When you have better than average food and good service, it makes for a great night out.

Give them a shot.

Schlafly brew tour is a must first! Enjoyable 45 minute presentation followed by some samples with education of the samples. Then go eat and have a few more. Food is very good although a bit high priced. One of my favorites as for craft beer quality and types.

Our pup just spent the weeking at the Petshotel and Doggie Daycare while we went and got married.. She loves it here.. She always comes home exhausted for days... We picked her up at noon on Monday, and when I got home, I noticed we were charged for a full day of doggie daycare.. Also when we arrived, they told us she was in "time out" because she was being a little snippy with some other dogs.. ok fine.. she is a JRT... but I guess I would expect to not be charged for a full day.. I didnt say anything or call, but its the little things like that which annoy me.They staff is really friendly.. and she always comes back clean..  We will certainly take her back. She also goes to Banfield in the same Petsmart, so they check her vaccinations and I dont have to bring any extra paperwork in.. That makes it convenient. Thanks for taking great care of her!

This Bob Evans has consistently had issues with service.   I can't say how many times we've visited and had poor to non-existent service.   We visited recently on a Saturday night with only a few tables filled and sat for nearly 10 minutes without so much as a single server coming by.  We witnessed 3 servers standing around behind the counter, chatting, drinking sodas, doing nothing.  Meanwhile we noticed several tables filled with dirty dishes and several other tables with food and trash beneath them.   I have even ordered take-out and stood waiting at the counter for a long time before anyone even asked to help me.  Plus, the food in the past has been inconsistent at best.   I would say avoid this location and drive a few miles north on 37 if you want a Bob Evans meal!

Are you hungry?

If you're on Yelp and reading this, chances are you are. Go ahead and close your laptop. Put your phone in your pocket. Push your chair back. And go to BCD right now. 

Here's what you need to know:

1) BCD is in the outer limits of Soulard. You're going to have to park and walk a block. Nothing you can do about it. Don't worry about trying to park super close, because you can't. There isn't a lot. 

2) There will be a line. It moves fast. But I promise you there will be a line. Sometimes it's out the door and around the side of the building. Sometimes it's only a few people. But there is always a line. That's why you need to have a lunch buddy to stand in line with. No matter how long it appears, you'll be through it in under 10 minutes.

3) Don't sit down until you order. This is a small place. And you might be worried about getting a seat. But by the time you order, someone will have left. It's not going to feel like this system will work, but it does. 

4) Order anything on the menu. It's all great. Personal favorites are the Italian Beef w/ hot peppers and the Uncle Sam's Club. But you can't go wrong with any sandwich or salad. Be sure to order some Dad's Cookies too. Oh, and they've got the good pellet ice.

5) Food usually takes another 5-10 minutes to come out after you order, pending what you got. 

6) Eat and then head on out. Someone is going to need your table.

On Saturday's BCD does have live blues acts, meaning the seating is even more limited and the crowds are a bit bigger. So be prepared for longer waits.

But go. 

Now.

I am a lover of Beignets - our dog was even named Beignet. 

This is my second favorite beignet place in Louisiana. Although it is in a new location, they did manage to maintain the ambience of the traditional cafe. The food is an amazing price, and there are a few different items to eat other than beignets. They do not have "fingers" here, only regular beignets. The beignets are three to an order and served without powder sugar on top.

Although they are normally served fresh, if you go at an off time they will be look warm from a large, metal container of beignets. They require a "healthy" amount of powder sugar and either a cafe au lait, chocolate milk, or hot chocolate. They dough is a bit heavy and lacking some salt. 

Still these are better than Cafe Du Monde, and I would recommend anyone who is in New Orleans to come here instead for their beignets. There is not abundant parking, but the parking does turn over rather quickly, so it is not such a big problem. It is located in a cute strip mall with some cute shops around.

We decided to eat late lunch here on a Friday, after visiting a nearby museum.   We were asked to wait at the bar for a table and probably would have waited even longer had we not taken the initiative to ask the  hostess again to seat us at one of the open tables ("Oh yeah, sure, go ahead...").   I was pretty excited about this place having read all the rave reviews.  We ordered some drinks and deliberated long and hard on what we wanted our burgers to look like.  I opted for mushrooms & fried egg on mine, and husband asked for crab salad on his.  We patiently munched on tater tots as we waited for our burgers and fries.  When these hefty sandwiches finally arrived at our table, we oohed and aahed a bit before digging in.  The first bite was quite tasty I'll admit, the patty nicely seasoned.  Though I ordered mine medium, it came out medium rare.  A couple more bites and the whole thing just started to fall apart.  Before long, the burger was swimming in a pool of meat juice and egg yolk, not the most appetizing thing to look at.  I didn't manage to finish mine, but I liked it well enough.  
I think that  the main problem, though, was that we weren't blown away by any aspect of the meal.  It was just... nice.  I don't know if I'm comfortable shelling out close to $70 for burgers  for two (with a couple of cocktails & potatoes on the side) and have it be just NICE.

You've probably read about this shop in magazines if you're an out of towner. This place is quintessential Nashville in my opinion. This is that hipster shop where Gweny and Nicole got their jeans made and it's well worth a stop if you're strolling along the 12south strip. I stopped in finally, only to try on their in house collection of Warby Parker frames. If I ever get my butt to look good, I might consider buying a pair of their handmade jeans, but until then I can't justify it for my flat ass. It's true this place seems like the cool peoples place to hang out and to spend outrageous sums of cash, but everyone was polite and friendly upon my visit!

I hadn't been to this Marathon in about 2 years. Since then the prices have risen but I found the service is better than it used to be. I will not be returning though.  I had forgotten my green card and they were unable to give me points for the two expensive breakfasts I had. It's not worth the price anymore. I will go back to frequenting Le pain quotidien. It has less options but the food is organic, tastes better and about the same price now!

I have always loved Bread Co!  You can always find something to satisfy your hunger here.

I chose this location because I had an appointment at St. Johns (Mercy) and even though it was the lunch rush, I got my order in and served to me in a timely manner.

The staff was cheerful, eager to help me and cater to me.

Its a great place to people watch, get some work done and enjoy your lunch break...indoors or out.

I did forget about their 30 min internet cut off during their peak hours but I got the work done I needed to get done.

Keep up the good work Bread Co!

This place has pretty good food and an awesome spot.  However, the staff is RUDE and I have only had one nice server here.  I keep going because it is fun to sit on the patio and chill.  Also, there are not many vegetarian options to choose from.  Get a new staff and I'll give you more stars.

I let the action speaking, they have the best cup of freshness tea guarantee !  from the top to the bottom of my drink stays the same taste, unlike others bubble tea places contact water more than what you paid for, you are getting a WHOLE drink that are cold/hot ready they have their owe logo for interior, logos, cups, be sure to try the waffle.

When I went to school in Philadelphia I tried my best to come here as often as possible. Great healthy choices that after you eat, you always feel light and not dragged down by a large meal. The salads are great here as well as the noodle based dishes. You can also, for desert or brunch get yogurt topped with a variety of goodies. They even have a charging station for your phones which encourages you to actually talk during your meal. Another positive is the touch screen ordering, similar to WaWa.

The food is not that good but what kills me are the servers standing in the alley smoking. Not just once in a while but all the time. Does the management really think this is ok. Buffet at lunch is tired food sitting out maybe you have to arrive early. Had two very bad dinners. Soggy over sauced pizza and poorly made salads. I really wanted to like it but.....
Very chill, relaxing place. Somewhat of a mixed crowd and the music didn't seem to match the crowd but it was still dance-worthy. Good for a night where you wanna go out but not go overboard.

App Mac n cheese was surprising better than most. Cheese steak was better than any I have had on main line, and honey mustard sauce for salad was amazing.  Pickiest eater alive and can't wait too come back

Phenomenal food paired with phenomenal service. Matthew was awesome tonight with his suggestions and his camaraderie was the icing on the cake. We brought our own bottle, but if you don't get the chance to pick up a bottle beforehand, rest assured that their selection is top notch. Do the pre fixe--it's completely worth it. Definitely a place to visit when you come to Philly or a staple to keep in your book for those Friday nights by the river.

I have heard several people talk about Luke... now that I finally made it here... i can't believe I have deprived myself of this place for so long.  Very very excellent food.  Shrimp and grits w/crab meat was a one of a kind dish!  Crawfish bisque was no slouch at all either! Already planning an encore visit.

Since I have to move into my new apartment this weekend I thought I'd stop by Slyman Brothers  and check out their washers and dryers. Stopped in yesterday around 5:30 PM and only one salesman was on the floor. The other person was helping someone at the service desk. When I walked in, no one greeted me. Realizing that both salesmen were busy, I decided to give them the benefit of the doubt. I busied myself by looking at all the appliances. Five minutes went by and no one greeted me. Decided to stick around a little bit longer. Still nothing. So after being there for about 15 minutes,and neither of the salesman looking up to make eye contact to say "Hello," or "we'll be with you shortly," I decided to leave. I ended up at Home Depot and I spent my $1800 with them.  It's too bad how they couldn't take just a few seconds to greet a potential customer and in the and lost a good customer, not to mention almost $2000.

This is a new hotel.. Perfect location .. Close to beach with great views! The rooms were clean and updated! Staff was friendly! I like all the little touches they do... Made a monkey out of the towels.. I like the parking under hotel out
If blazing sun..
It had a rooftop bar with munchie food and a great sunset countdown and party! 
One word of advice to the owner who I was told us from Wisconsin... PUT HEATERS ON ROOFTOP!! We are mostly florida people and it gets cold up there!!! Even the staff was wearing hoodies!! Brr we would have stayed and drank more but tooo cold!
About the pool .. It's in north side of building so nooooo sun! Good thing the beach was across the street. 
We will be back!!

If you are looking for a gourmet burger in an upscale atmosphere this is the place for you!  I had the pbj it was awesome!  My husband had the osark which was amazing as well!  With yummy grown up lemonade, shakes, and floats what more could you ask for?!

We had so much fun in Nashville and visiting many of the bars with live music on Broadway! On a busy Thursday night Margaritaville was the only place that had an open table. My husband and I just shared a club sandwich as a late night snack which was delicious and went just fine with my margarita. The service was outstanding! Claire was our server and she was so sweet, friendly, helpful and made sure we were completely satisfied with our experience at Margaritaville.

Awesome place. The staff is very professional. Im a new shooter, they are really patient with me even discounted the price my second visit. Great teachers, reasonable prices, decent selection. Just a great place

Brewpub you are delicious and I miss you so. Ever since I moved out to California I have been searching for a place with such a comfortable homey feel that serves delicious eclectic food and locally brewed beers. No such luck yet. I came to visit you last week when I was in town briefly and ordered my staple bison burger (medium rare is a must when ordering bison) and the fried veggie chips... Oh fried veggie chips...Please come to me out in CA..I would cover you in malt vinegar and dip you in sweet sweet ketchup. Sigh..     Anyways my Hubby and I love this place! Whether it's just the two of us or when it was a big group...Great Food, Great Beer and Great Times :)  Service is pretty good.. a little slow, but they're busy! And I'm never in a hurry when I'm there..why would I be? I like to sit down eat, drink and enjoy.
Dr Martin is great! Very thorough and spends time with the patient to make sure that all questions are answered.
Loved Besito's!  The food and service were amazing!  We will definitely be back. Freshest Mexican food I've ever had. Andy was a fun waiter!

Sorry the other reviewer had a bad experience.   I have been a customer for years and never had any instance of rudeness.   Staff is always helpful.  The offices are conveniently located.  Rates are good and products are competitive.

Just wish they could not keep sending out junk mail solicitations for insurance, etc.

Came here for restaurant week. Everything was delicious! Had the dipping trio for an appetizer and tasted my friend's calamari. Both were great. I had the duck over truffled duck egg (which was like a thin egg crepe). It was perfect. Not fatty at all and very flavorful. I had the bread pudding with s'more gelato for dessert and tasted my friend's pear tarte. Although I barely had room to eat it, both were excellent. The atmosphere was sophisticated yet calming. I will definetely come back for dinner.

Tried out Jackson's as a new restaurant on Tanque Verde.  We won't be back.  They have a huge selection of booze, and a limited selection of food.  I ordered the shaved ham & swiss after being told it was a hot sandwich.

The ham was not shaved - it was 1/8th inch thick.  two slices of plain white toast, with a small ball of ham - clearly picked up by tongs and dumped in the middle, a slice of swiss cheese - and that was it for $12.  And, it came out cold.  I asked our waiter for a warm sandwich, they took it back and threw the sandwich in the microwave - so the bottom bread was now soggy.

I had the Lucky Girl original, which is a burger on delicious bread with jicama-carrot slaw, cucumbers and some delectable mayo/chile sauce combo.  It was great! Asian and sort of Middle-Eastern at the same time (although I don't think they meant for it to be that), and totally what you want to drink a good beer or glass of wine with at Tap and  Bottle.

We had a technician (Pat King) do some diagnostic work and maintenance on our two air conditioning units.  I can't say enough good things about him.  He was professional, courteous and kept our house clean.  I would highly recommend Unique Indoor Comfort and Pat King to anyone looking for AC unit maintenance.

As a Chinese, I like this restaurant because they serve some real Chinese food but not Americanized. It can not compare with the restaurant in China,  (but to be honest, almost none of the Chinese restaurants in here or NYC can meet the standard for any good restaurants in China) at least it gives some home-style Sichuan flavor. I like the duck, fish with silken toufu, and the spicy chicken as the cold appetizer. It is a good place if you liek spicy food!
Grouper Reuben was fishy and bland. Salad was iceberg lettuce with a few extras thrown in, also unremarkable. We have no reason to return.

Food is off the charts amazing.  Got lucky and got a table for 2 quickly on a Friday night, but generally be prepared for a bit of a wait.  FYI this place is BYOB and only accepts cash or checks.  The food is SO worth it though.  Amazing.

Had a great experience using the CAA iPhone app to request roadside assistance. Worked like a dream. The GPS on the phone locates you and dispatches help. You get an automated call when the help is 10 minutes out.

Did a great job, flexible timing, good price! We were able to come to an agreement that worked with my schedule.

Would use again! Even threw in a free screen protector.

UPDATE:


     2 Days later I noticed that my front facing camera was not working. Brought back to Mobile Ninja to get repaired and unfortunately he was unable to help. I know that sometimes phones can be fickle but it worked before I brought it in. 
      Still 4 stars because I really think that he changed my screen a few more times and changed the camera trying to get it to work. He worked hard on my phone, but unfortunately it didn't fix it :-(.

Shopping trips to International Plaza can easily include the need to feed oneself due to the large scale layout of the retail center and its diverse dining options.

When a crowded, and sometimes noisy, food court won't fill the bill and you want to spend your valuable time shopping not waiting to be seated at a table and for an order to be taken, then this fun sushi place presents a great option.

Booths or seats at counters are equally accessible to the small bowls of hot and cold items that roll by providing tempting visuals of nicely presented food and ease of access to getting a bite right away. 

The dishes are not labeled so you can just be adventurous and help yourself to whatever catches your eye or you can try to match the descriptions and images printed on the menu to identify which passing dish suits you.

This is such a smart alternative to ordering only what you know you already like because you can expand your eating horizons for just a few more dollars per plate. There are lots of seafood, chicken, beef and vegetarian selections available to please anyone with specific preferences or dietary restrictions. Sadly, eel is not available at any of the YO! Sushi sites but everything was so fresh and tastily my disappointment over that omission was fleeting.

I like the speed, convenience and smoothness of this operation. I can sit down and have as much, or as little, as I like or select from ready-to-eat small takeaway trays of select items that are good to go when you just can't stop to take a seat and eat.

Fabulous place with darling decor! Server was very attentive. Our meal was delicious and the selection of Sangrias were countless  I had the best Gyro ever! Their bakery items are to die for. Too many sweets to choose from.

Express Scripts has been a terrible option.  If you have any questions or problems, they pass you from one representative to another, in hopes that you will finally get tired of being on hold and will hang up.  I ordered one medication which was a refill.  They indicated that I needed a new prescription (No one could tell me why.)  I got a new prescription sent to them and then they decide it needs preauthorization for this medication.  They call the doctor's office and provide a list of alternative medications.  Some tech. picks one and Express scripts sends out the new medication, all without any communication with me, the customer.  Unfortunately, I am allergic to this medication, but I am stuck with a 3 month supply of it and they won't refund my money.  Terrible customer service, terrible, terrible, terrible!!!!!  

If you can avoid using this company, do so.  I can't tell you how frustrating it has been dealing with this company.  Be aware that if they send you a prescription, even if you are allergic to it or if sent in error, you have no recourse but to keep it.  My husband and I get a lot of prescriptions, and Express Scripts would prefer to lose our business rather that remedy the situation.  Customer service and policies couldn't be worse.  I initially thought that all our prescriptions had to be filled by them, but I have discovered that some local pharmacies like Tom Thumb and Sam's will fill 90 day prescriptions.  Look for an alternative.  Express Scripts has been frustrating from the very beginning.  And please don't think that if you jump through all their hoops, they will get it right and quickly.  NOTHING IS QUICK!!!  

By the way, if your doctor sends in a 30 day prescription in error, instead of a 90 day prescription, they will charge you the same amount.  Ordinarily a 30 day prescription which cost me $25 at CVS was $65 at Express Scripts, because my doctor sent in a 30 day rather than a 90 day prescription.  Even if my doctor was willing to change the prescription, Express Scripts was not willing to send me the other two months supply.  You are simply out the money.  Beware, if they can screw you over, they will!

I give this place 2 stars for cheap and basic. If you aren't into any fancy work and just looking for a basic mani/pedi then it's worth the $24. I've been coming here for like a yr because it's totally worth it to me. I've been to other places for a basic mani/ pedi and they charge atleast $35. This is the spot for simple basic with polish.

This place was so good. I had 2 of the cheeseburger sliders and the cheese waffle fries. The burgers were super juicy and topped with fresh ingredients. The fries had an awesome cheese sauce. The service was good considering the place was packed. Definitely recommend stopping here!

A very good place to bowl though always busy when a normal person would be free ie. weekends, after work, holidays. This leads to wait times of nearly an hour for a lane. And of course there are no lane reservations on those important weekend days ... Why would there be? It's almost as if there is a shortage of bowling alleys in the city. It surprises me that this would be such a popular activity. People still bowl, and the activity has stood the test of time.

They do serve alcohol, but the stuff on tap is pretty harsh and could likely be used as an industrial cleaner! Lots of younger adults and teenagers. Not that is a bad thing, just know this going in. 

Price is 5$ to 7.50$ per round depending on when you go. 3$ for shoes. Still a fun activity!

Went for lunch and thought food and portions were really good.  Besides the bread, they seriously gave us 1 slice for each person.  I am like Oprah, "I Loveeee bread!".  Service was slow and the place was not even busy and not too fond of their dirty looking plastic woven placemats that were on all the tables, do those things even get thoroughly cleaned between customers?  With all that being said, If someone twisted my arm, I would probably go again for lunch or breakfast (and discard my placemat).  I don't think I would ever go here for dinner though, seemed just like a Cheesecake Factory, but way more expensive.

As a devoted fan of the Sabrina's Cafe on Callowhill, I have been very pleasantly surprised to find that they have a location here in Collingswood, NJ (after moving to Cherry Hill from Philly very recently). We have been here quite a few times, and of course have to endure the same wait time (30min-1hr) as to be expected in Philly locations. The food here is just as delicious, with equally aesthetic dining rooms. The staff here is also super friendly. What more can you ask for? Oh, BYOB! :)
Great coffee and cupcakes- a lot of variety- they'll make any kind of coffee you want - Cathey & Thais are very friendly- highly recommend the cupcakes.

I brought my family here whenever they came Into town and they absolutely loved it. We got the wings and ramen noodle bowl. I can still taste that delicious meal. I will be going back very soon because it was that good! Friendly staff and informative.

I have been coming here regularly for years. To this day Tako is still the best Japanese food I have had anywhere. I have never had anything from there I did not love. The staff is amazing. Every time my family and I go they welcome us like we are their friends. I recommend this place to everyone! Amazing food, awesome staff, and adorable atmosphere. I couldn't ask for more! I love this restaurant.

Awesome decor. Great service. A very busy place so either get reservations or sit at the oyster bar. As soon as you sit down, you're greeted by a round of biscuits and delicious salty butter - gratis. Ordered the steak tartare, pig ears, cheesy rice balls, curry goat, and their special crab/gnocchi. Everything was super savory. Very heavy but delicious flavors. The steak was smoked - not the best tartare I've ever tried but a nice starter. The bread Served should have been a thin crostini to appreciate the meaty flavor more. Pig ears were crispy, slightly chewy but definitely yummy. Great seasoning. Rice balls were verrry cheesy. Good flavor. The goat dish was a winner. Amazing flavors. Curry wasn't overwhelming. Served with soft gnocchi. The underwhelming dish was the crab special. Could have used more specific seasoning. Crab almost got lost in the gnocchi. Overall will come back if there are new items added to the menu!

I received an excellent education at Little Flower that helped me to develop my character, confidence, and intellect. Little Flower set me on the path to success. Now, after 50 years, I can still say that my education at Little Flower was one of the best experiences of my life.

Yikes. Where do I begin? Shall I begin with when did Indians learn to cook Mexican? Food, just ok - but smells like KFC, which according to Gordan Ramsay means they don't clean their grills.  Next - the iced tea had to have been at least a few days old - it had that taste; I should have known better from the scum lines on the inside of the container. Blech.  The floors were sticky too.  Ew.  There was like 1 napkin and 2 drink lids out, and just seemed kinda shim-sham. For the money, OMG I could eat like a Queen @ taco bell - and not worry so much about food standards.  Won't be going back.  I doubt they will stay alive for too long.

Stopped through to a Mom and Pop Mediterranean Grille healthy lunch spot and was surprised at the warm greeting and smiles.. The menu was very sophisticated and the servers were patient in explaining dishes I wasn't familiar with. All in all, very impressed. Food was very fresh and hot, and seasoned to perfection.. I will be back..

Had my quarter of a century birthday dinner here last night and this place deserves 5 stars! Started off with a glass of their Spanish white wine (compared to a Riesling) then ordered the bacon wrapped dates (which I absolutely loved), the salmon flatbread (too salty for me), and the goat cheese in tomato paste (very delicious)! Then, I finished the night with the sponge cake dessert and sad to say but I devoured that in under 60 seconds... It was that good! 

Service was decent for 5 people but I thought it could have been better but the food was delicious so I cannot complain! :)

If I had kids, I'm sure I would have a completely different opinion. If you are going for the playground/splashpad, they look awesome and you can disregard this review :)

If you don't have kids, it's not so great. There's a side walk around the place but it's far to small to walk or anything. The restaurant is okay, but pricey for mostly fried food.

We went with our dog since we read they were a good place to walk her. Not so. There is also a fairly busy road nearby so I would never be comfortable letting her off leash.

There is hardly any parking at all. 

If you don't fish and you don't have kids, go somewhere else.
Presentation was nice...taste was mediocre...servers had no clue which roll was what...makes you wonder....
Wonderful comfort food. The potpie, mac and cheese, and chili were all exceptional.

If I could give zero stars, I would. I have to say, I'm very upset with this hotel. I walked in and immediately smelled feces, number one. The girl that was operating the elevator was deplorable and ASTOUNDINGLY rude. The manager came out dressed as though he had just came from the gym - this is not a professional establishment. The room was atrocious and was overpriced - I could go on forever. Do not stay here.

Absolutely horrible experience. Food was terrible no presentation never got the salad chicken piccata had no capers or lemon.. was drenched in whirl oil Not Butter. 
They should be embarrassed of themselves selling this type of food.
$35....really?
We found the elusive $15/hour fast food workers! The place is so clean and the people are friendly & knowledgeable. The food was great; fresh and quick.

Excellent food that's a step above typical pub fare. The place is fancier than a gastropub but still casual. The prices are great.

I had the burger, which was excellent, as was the steak tartare appetizer. The corn soup was a tad sweet for my taste, though to be fair it is described as sweet on the menu.
KFT was great. Perfect size for an indulgence without getting stuffed. Fries are some of the best i have had in CC; nice and browned and not grease laden.

I took my friend who's from Colorado  here and she loved it! The bartender was awesome and super fun! We made our way through all the different beers and weren't disappointed. The variety of beer flavors was delightful, their beermaster is a genius! They have a small, but fun menu. We had the pretzel bites, which were good, but the nachos looked amazing! So I recommend trying those or the Pachos, which are made with Billy Goat chips! The setup and decor is really  modern and sets a great chill  mood! My only advice is to be leary of parking if you go on a Cardinals game day! Go and Enjoy!!

I'm a regular here and a harsh critic. I only eat at the hibachi grill but, it's consistently good. I drink ice tea there and on fill ups they take the glass to the kitchen which I don't like-but other than that.

Great service and very cool! Delicious food! Perfect for a small bite and drink.
I took my Japanese friend here for his birthday and we loved it! This place is a perfect blend of Japanese appetizers and the cool local Reno flair. We had several delicious appetizers. The fried chicken was crisp and not heavy on the oil, with a slightly spicy mayo sauce. The giant squid was pleasantly peppered with the Japanese 7 Spice, and the bacon wrapped sweet potato skewers were balanced between sweet and salty and perfectly grilled. They are a little bit pricey but if you like unique delicious food it's worth it. We also enjoyed their unique beer selection and the pork ramen was hot and very good. Our server went above an beyond to make the cake we brought for my friends birthday special by putting the candles on it and everything. We will definitely be back!.

We ate here a few weeks ago and enjoyed the food.  So we decided to go back and have a nice dinner.  The place was crowded and we had to wait 30 minutes for a table.  Once seated our server took our order which was a main entrée and a side salad.  In about 5 to 10 minutes we received our salads.  Everything was going just fine; we finished our salads and were enjoying the bread and wine.  

After some time we realized we had drank two glasses of wine and finished the bread, but had not received our entrée.  Our waiter never came by to check on us or explain why it was taking so long to get our entrée.  So we asked the manager if she could check our order.  Come to find out the waiter never placed our order! 

We sat there for an hour eating salad, bread and wine and our order was never entered.  We were giving the place the benefit of the doubt that they were busy and had gotten backed-up in the kitchen. We even over heard the table next to us ask our same waiter why it was taking so long to get their order.  We just did not realize how much time had passed until we ran out of conversation.  Wow!  The level of incompetence at this place is extraordinary. 

The manager was very apologetic.  She was embarrassed at the level of service we received and made no excuses.  She of course comp our meal and offered to expedite the order so we could eat.  However, there is no excuse for this type of mistake.  Hiring staff that are incompetence is unacceptable.   Unfortunately, we will not be supporting a business that can't hire a professional waitstaff.

I've been to Brummis three times on my visits to Santa Barbara, and its been an exceptional experience each time. 

The most recent experience prompted this review:  order the crispy duck at the holidays!  We had to order two days in advance, but like anything Veronica cooks up in her kitchen, it was an amazing meal that clearly took extensive prep time.

And that's what I've noticed each time I've been here:  Much of the food is old-school German, slow-cooked for hours.  Flavorful red cabbage, tender meats that fall of the bone -- there's a lot of time and love put into this food, and it's clear that Veronica is the zeitgeist of the place.  

If you're looking for the efficient American eating experience -- seated, served, out the door -- then this is not the place for you.  If you like the idea of a slow meal, a liter of beer served with plate after plate of delicious food, the owner and cook checking in to make sure you get the full German experience, then Brummis is a match.  

Ah! Sauerbraten!
My friend ordered beef chow mein and a dish came out that resembled fritos chips... nuff said..

Called to install a light above our stairs.  Usually my dad installs my lights but I didn't want him on a ladder this tall!  They came out the same day and did a perfect job.  Would definitely recommend!

I'm pretty fussy when it comes to Italian pizza/sandwiches/takeout, but I have to give five stars to Vano's because I believe it's the best in the area. The cheesesteaks have plenty of beef, and the large size could supply most people with two meals -- quite the bargain. The steaks actually have *beef flavor* -- something lacking from any kind of beef these days, IMHO. My favorite, though, is the sausage-onions-peppers-cheese-sauce sandwich. There's so much tasty Italian sausage in there that it's almost impossible to close it. It's actually my favorite sandwich *anywhere*. I haven't been a pizza fan for many years, partially due to a desire to cut down on starch -- and four slices of pizza has a lot more than a steak/hoagie roll. Nonetheless, circumstances forced me to take-out a small at Vano's, and I have to say it was the best I've had in at least a decade. I nuked a couple of slices briefly to warm them up, and everything melted/melded together perfectly. The crust was nice and thin, not doughy or bread-like (not Melba toast, either), sauce also excellent, plenty of cheese, and likely the only place left on Earth that puts *chunks* of sausage on the pie -- instead of those tiny crumbs or slices so thin you can see through them. The other half of the pizza had pepperoni, and there was a substantial amount of that classic topping as well. The only thing I would change here is adding delivery service, but it's well worth the trip for dine-in or take-out!

Ok...... ALL DELISH! We had the fish and chips that were seasoned and battered just right. The fish tacos were as well perfect. Even the chicken sandwich was done right! The tuna sandwich was delish!
The outside garden with the ocean and beach view is breathe taking! Sandy play area for kids and adult area with firepit!

So, yesterday we were caught in a spontaneous monsoon dropped on us in the French Quarter.  The ladies gave us refuge!  For their graciousness, i bought some little items which included hand-poured buttons which ate so lovely.  Thank you again for saving a couple of nearly-drowned rats!

Ah-Mazing! I went there for the first time last week and the place was jam packed! It's a good thing that we played it safe and made a reservation because there were three folks in front of us who got turned away because there was no availability.  This place appears to be the epicenter of business lunches! I felt so sophisticated just being in there! Refer to the following delicious points: 1. Mango iced tea.  I usually prefer unflavored sweet tea, but I chose to try it as my lunch dates insisted on it's deliciousness. It was pretty good. The ice tea wasn't sweetened, but on the table was a miniature pitcher of liquid sugar! Fancy! 2. The bread. Spicy Onion Focaccia. Soooo good! 3. The bread was served with butter on the side, of course, with a sprinkling of pink Himalayan salt. Again, fancy! 4. Musroom Bisque. I'm a huge meat eater, but this soup was to DIE FOR! It was topped with truffle cream. You HAVE to get a cup! 5. Chicken Pad Thai. I was a little nervous to try this Asian dish in a non-Asian restaurant, but it was pretty tasty. Usually, I would not have ordered it since this was not a Thai restaurant, but my lunch dates raved about it's deliciousness. It had a very fresh taste, and it's worth a try. There were also generous bits of tofu in the Pad Thai as well. 6. Yukon Potato Pizza. I had a slice from the plate of one of my lunch dates. I personally wouldn't order it (only because it's not my thing , not because it wasn't tasty). It tasted like a loaded baked potato on a pizza. Might be good to try it as an appetizer for the table, in addition to the Mushroom Bisque of course!

Someone else said that it was with a heavy heart that they gave a meh review.
I stayed here in early July, 2016 on a business trip after staying for three years at the Courtyard next door.
On the positive side I liked their evening drinks and snacks setup. That is, until I came back from work on the Friday evening to find that it was gone.  Yes, it is only Monday to Thursday.  I liked their breakfast and managed to find something that was sort of healthy.  Also, they have a shuttle, but you have to really know what you're doing to actually get to use it. Clue: book your ride well in advance and make sure that you're only going close by.
Now for the meh part. You can hear the people walking above you so get a top floor room.  Also, I specifically hung the "do not clean I want 250 points" outside my door way in advance.  Needless to say the cleaning people cleaned my room.  Also, the hotel is very difficult to find.  So find it on google maps, print out the map, and take it with you.  On my Friday night there there was a large group of young people partying outside.  One of them was driving his car around in a crazy manner and sometimes he drove with the door open.  Also, the hotel isn't near anything entertainment-like.  So, you need a reason to be there like the airport or the hospital.  There isn't anything to "do" within walking distance.
All in all my stay was meh.  I've had better.
I love Burke Williams but their prices have just been too painful for my wallet. When I am able to visit, the service and facilities never disappoint.

Ann is amazing!!! She's detailed oriented and takes her time, which I love!! nobody wants to go into a salon & feel rushed! My nails look so beautiful!! I'm just in love with her work!! The amazing talent runs in the family because Ann, Ly & Steven are all amazingly skilled. Their nail work is absolute art!!!

I gave two stars only because the girl who took our order was very nice.  The food, however,  was awful. We both had the Fuji Apple Chicken salad at the same price and my daughter's order had barley half as much as mine and they didn't give her any salad dressing.  Mine came with two containers of salad dressing, but  they were each only 1/4 full, if that.  My salad looked bigger because it was mostly kale, the menu says mixed greens- I felt like they dumped in whatever green  they needed to get rid of and so I dumped the nasty bitter salad-kale- into the garbage after just a few bites. I had asked for "extra" cucumbers, which have always come thinly sliced on the top of the salad at every other Panera I have been to.  These were chopped and there was barely any, let alone the extra I ordered.  And to just add insult to injury, the Apple Chips were stale, chewy and nasty.  So much for a crisp Fall Salad.  So much for ever visiting this Panera again, first and last time.  We ordered to go and should have checked our food before we left.  Spent $23.00 on a disaster dinner and will
Never go back again because the Manager on Duty was the one overseeing the making of our meal.  Wish someone from the district or regional office would see this.  (We didn't stay to eat there because - yes- the dining room was too awful to sit in) worst Panera I have ever been to.

Cant go wrong with this local gem.  Have ordered from here many times in the past 4 years and love all of their food.  Its everything under one roof-great cheeseteaks, tender wings, tasty wraps and confort food.  Although priced a little higher higher than competition, the quality of chicken they use is great-all white meat and juicy so its worth it in my opinion.

In Italian cooking, it is very important to use the best and the freshest ingredients possible because the food is rather simple. Italian style pizzas call for the best dough, cheese and tomatoes. The owners of Famoso have mastered this aspect of preparing their pizzas. Both flour for the dough and tomatoes are imported from Italy. The cheese is a freshly made mozarella. This is what Famoso is all about - fresh ingredients that result in amazingly tasting pizzas.
My friends and I came in one late afternoon, and the place was packed and it was very noisy. We had to wait to be seated but it was no problem since we desperately wanted to try Famoso's famous thin crust pizza. We ordered two: one Prosciutto Arugula and  one Comforto. You have to pay for your order in advance, before you are seated and then wait for the waiter to bring your order. A little unusual but not inconvenient. When our pizzas came, we dug right in. The crust was thin and chewy; the ingredients combination tasted great. We could really taste the italian sausage and prosciutto, the olive oil and fresh herbs. Very yummy and fresh. Naples pizza in all its glory!
The owners of Famoso hit the nail on the head by opening their unique pizzeria in Edmonton. There are no pizza places like this in our little town.
Not friendly at all. Girl forgot to give me my cup so I asked for a cup. She asked me questions like I took a cup. Is she for real? Bad customer service. Has gone downhill since new ownership.

I bought a kids hotdog meal and the original Italian Grinder on wheat bread with a Eegee flavor of the month (Orange Dream, my favorite) for me and my daughter yesterday.  The food was good and fresh, the service friendly, prompt, and accurate, and the rest rooms and seating area very clean.  Keep up the great work!

Had a wonderful dinner at Kelly's.  Most of the reviews I had read talked about breakfast and brunch, so I wasn't sure how dinner would be.  We shared a lump crab appetizer, which was delicious.  
We also shared the dinner special - barbecue shrimp served on a bed of cornbread pudding with a roasted strawberry and jalapeño burre blanc sauce. Wow.
After dinner I had the chocolate mousse cake and my wife had the banana rum toasted coconut cheesecake plated with whipped cream and rich chocolate sauce.  Oh my.
Dinner was made especially enjoyable by our waiter (Dutch), who made several excellent suggestions and was perfectly attentive, as well as very knowledgeable about food.
All in all, a truly delightful dining experience.

While I do not frequent night clubs, I do like to have a good time out with friends once in a while. Karma is kind of hard to find initially because the entrance on 3rd Ave S is around the corner from their physical address on Broadway.There was no cover the night I went and it was pretty empty for a Friday night. The music was good and it was easy to order drinks. You would think more people would go here.

This place is a good hang out for Vanderbilt students after class. The tacos are okay, not a lot of variety but the quality is good. However, this is just a great place to relax on the patio with a bunch of friends and the buckets of beer that you can get here. The atmosphere is fun and friendly.

Came here at a weird time, so it was just us and a single large party of students. Service was very fast, and prices were very solid. Food was great, and the decor was charming and interesting to look at. If you like Thai food, you'll enjoy this restaurant.

This is a great place, high quality food, and great costumer service. I was out with my boys Billy, Tommy, and Steve and we just had the dopest time it was on a Saturday, (Saturday's are for the boys) we had some cold ones (with the boys) and we also love bread sticks (UNLIMITED BREAD STICKS YEAH BOY) Steve had one 2 many cold ones (of apple juice) and we had to carry him to the 18 wheeler its was a good time. Oh Boy.

Thank you Olive Garden, 
For the dopest, sickest (at sports), most savage elegant time at my local Olive Garden.

My wife and I were visiting NOLA over the Christmas/New Years holidays.  Our daughter Skye is a super rooter of Kajuns so it was a natural that we'd give it a whack.  Our first night there was on a Monday Night Football night, the very night Drew Brees broke the all-time passing record of 27 years.  The entire place was turbo charged on steroids.  The Saints are the KINGS as it should be; the consummate pros they are.  Joann & Lisa were kind enough to reserve & comp my wife and I a front row table to the BIG screen in the non-smoking section, and wow did we have a blast.  The buffet table was largely put together by Fay, Skye's partner, and DELICIOUS chow it was .. !  

The following Sunday, New Years Day the Saints are at it again.  My wife wasn't feeling all that perky that day and told me to go ahead and go and enjoy the game with Skye & Co.  To say that I had a good time would be grossly understating it.  The folks who frequent the place are TOPS.  I speak of Lori, Raijko, Robert, Jose, and so many others.  When my beer glass came within an inch or two of bottom Barry or Wendy the best bartenders (!) would slam another one down just for me.  I found myself dancing and playing the air guitar, and of course some kind soul took photos of me having an uncommonly good time.  

In short .... one of the best party times I've been to, ever.  Thank you Joanne and Lisa, and a hearty thanks to the folks who were there to have a good time ... just like me.  Blessings to all of you .... I've been telling everyone it's simply impossible to NOT have a good time there .. !  

Al Farr

We had an object in our tire and it wasn't holding air. We pulled into discount tire a few minutes after 5 pm to see if they could fix it. They were closing up shop (closed at 5 pm), but Canton offered to fix the tire anyway. Once the tire was off, they determined that the tire could not be fixed and had to be replaced (they pulled a cotter pin out of the tire). The car is all wheel drive, so we had to replace all tires. They stayed open and replaced all four tires for us and they were awesome about it. Not once did they seem put out, after all, it was after closing. We have purchased 4 sets of tires from Discount tire and have always experienced great service and price. I will continue to go back to Discount Tire in the future and would recommend them without hesitation to anyone. 
Thank you Canton and the Discount Tire team!
Simply the best lamb chops I have ever had. The risotto and the toasted ravioli were exceptional as well. It's my new number one destination when I work in St. Louis.

This place gets five stars hands down best pizza best delivery service this business is how other businesses should look at on how to run one. Grew up here as a kid and moved back here it's been 2 years I know about all the pizza spots around Delaware county and New Jersey this place is pizza is one of the best the white with broccoli tops mackomanko in jersey if you know the place on the boardwalk everyone thrives on around here most of all this place is professional great all around food from the cheese steak egg rolls to the fries. Hope this helps because I'm always on here trying to find good places to eat *yelp* and this place deserves the attention for good food and good delivery service and business!

I don't live too close to target, so I really have to decide before hand if I even want to go which is about 1-2x every 3 months if even that. Now the last half a year Every-Single -Time I walked in I was starred down for no other reason than obviously being a "bad" customer like I'm apparently stealing. God forbid I brought my favorite lipstick to compare and try to purchase the same color or try to exchange a sports bra for a larger size (meaning come back and try on larger size before returning the smaller one just incase) I am a kind customer and appreciate the small things but this has gone far far far and is Highly uncalled for. The fact I lack giving crap to put on my make up and impress " target" is my own business. I am definitely asking for their reference number for their countless disrespect. It's been easily noticeable that I'm being judged this way FOR NO REASON So of course I react. Who wouldnt.

Located on the west side of Starr Pass Blvd, Kettle Restaurant has managed to stay open for many years. Their welcoming atmosphere features dozens of clocks with times from various cities all over the world. 

I would like to commend the exceptional service here. A lady server who has worked there for years was nice and attentive. The owner was extremely friendly and welcoming. He came by the table to have a conversation; a sign that he cares about his customers. He brought out extra food not even on the food from his native country of Jordan. If he converted his restaurant to Jordanian food, it could easily be one of the best in town.

Going off the last sentence above, I will say avoid the buffet. The soups and the hot food were cold, while the cold food wasn't cold enough. The Middle Eastern food he brought out saved the meal. They do have a regular American food menu so you are better off ordering from that. 

Here's to hoping that this restaurant soon becomes a restaurant specializing in Jordanian food. That would easily get this place more stars!

Excellent Experience! 

Took my Toyota Corolla here today after it was sputtering yesterday and had check engine and maintenance lights on.  I was thinking it was having power issues because of the alternator or something...but I know nothing.  John was very easy to deal with, has a night drop AND night pick up system which I utilized.  The greatest thing about John though was that he called me, sought more information to correctly diagnosis, and then after driving the car around and checking things out decided that he was not confident in what the issue was and decided it may have been a fluke and that he wasn't comfortable making a repair that he wasn't 100% sure was the actual issue.  I was sold.  No pushiness, no making me feel like an idiot, straightforward and honest.

Id say get the oysters and corn cake it was killer, But The menu changes as they get different ingredients. 

The food we had was outstanding and they mix drinks are super yummy. I had a chili margarita and my fiancé had the regular margarita. Both were spot on great drinks. 

The staff was awesome, and the piano player was really good.

They were able to sneak us in as a large group on a busy night. The crepes were amazing as well as just about everything else. My son got the duck, which was the only thing that was not delicious. The salmon was great and the pork chop my other son had was one of the best we have ever had. I highly recommend this place

I had such a wonderful experience working with Amie at the Shade Store.  She spent time going through literally every fabric swatch with me until we stumbled on the right design and light filter that I needed for my home.  After that, she had a mock up created based on a photo of my living room so that I could get a sense for how the print I selected would look.  The customer service, responsiveness and clarity throughout the process was top notch!  I would strongly recommend working with Amie and the Shade Store. The lifetime warranty is a huge plus too!  If you are thinking about replacing your window treatments, look no further than the Chestnut Street location.

I worked with Frank to coordinate a bachelorette party for my girlfriend and it was so much fun! We enjoyed ourselves, learned a lot about whiskey and had some pretty tasty cocktails at the end! Love the decor in the distillery and the staff was super friendly! thanks again :)
I ate here twice on an overnight stay in Philly. Great food, great service and great prices!!

Came here because I saw they had a check-in offer for a free slush cooler with boba (bubble tea?) while we were next door. So we ordered a taro w/ boba, lychee w/ boba and rainbow jelly and bought a siopao (steam bun) and ube (purple yam). 

Service- was good...I guess...Although we did stand at the wrong end of the counter for about 5 minutes before another customer told us we ordered from the other side. Not sure if employees saw us or not. Lol. The lady at the counter was friendly enough. The guy giving us our slush coolers seemed less than enthusiastic. 

This review is going off just the slush coolers (boba tea??). Not as good as other places. I feel like there should have been more boba and my taro flavor was not very distinct. The lychee one was good though. Very refreshing and the rainbow jelly was yum! Unfortunately, I did not get to try the ube or siopao. We left the ube on the kitchen counter for a few hours while preparing dinner, so I think it was my fault- I should have put in the refrigerator. But when I went to open it and try some, it was kind of watery on top and didn't look appetizing. My husband (who is Filipino) ate the siopao when he got home from work and said it was just "ok."

Interior is nice and bright, modern looking and there seemed to be a good constant stream of customers coming in. Will definitely have to try some of their food specials and hope to update this review and add some more stars.
Love this place! Just like Party City (love them too) with just about the same type of merchandise. Lots of costume gear and accessories!

Got my oil changed here. Things went pretty well. 

I made my oil change appointment online the day before. I like being able to do that. 

Showed up a couple minutes past my appointment time. They let me know it would be about 45-60 minutes wait. They were pleasant. I had my little kids with me and we needed to wait. 

The waiting room is what to be expected at a garage - nothing fancy. 

We ended up waiting 70 minutes for the oil change.

The total cost for the oil change was great, because I used a coupon (came to $15).
Excellent flavor. The mango chicken is a real winner.  Just the right mix of sweetness with acid.  The house giant prawns were done with a strong aromatic sauce.  We very much enjoyed it.

The portions are small, but maybe only by gargantuan American standards. The fries and various sauces are all super tasty. After having it a couple of times, it has become one of my favorite burger joints in St. Louis.
