His reply ... "Why would I come in for someone who doesn't even tip me".  Yup you are reading that correctly! And that was just one of what ended up being numerous back and forth texts. 

Umm. Can we start with how many ways this is unprofessional!!! 

First of all .. tipping your hairdresser is not mandatory. It is a courtesy. I'm sorry that some if some of your clients can afford to tip better than me and that has made you ungrateful for lesser tips, but I offer a lot of word of mouth. I mean, can we say greed?!  
Second .. I do not have the slightest clue how much my services are at this salon b/c it is paid for through my work. So I just give a tip based on the fact he spends approximately an hour working on my hair, total. This is while he works on other people while I am under the dryer, etc.  
Third ... and maybe most important. I ALWAYS tip him.  Always! So his comment wasn't even valid. There have been times I've given $10 on a bang trim he spent 5 min on!!  I gave him $50 at Christmas last year. I always tip when I leave - always!! It may not be as much as he is used to by other people, but I do tip. There have been times that I have given a lower tip of only $10, yes, but there is a reason when I do.  I have also tipped him much more than needed - as I stated before. To me, it all evens out I guess. But I never don't tip him - and the one time I didn't - was not my fault!

As for why sometimes I tip LESS.  This is very important to anyone thinking about going to Jason. I know it would be a deal breaker to many of you. 

His work was always consistent. His personality...not so much. His company had started to be lack luster over the past 8 months. Every time I went in I had to sit and listen to a "debbie downer" session!! No one wants to hear story after story after story about how you hate everyone, how your best friend is getting on your nerves all the time, how your roommate has a fat friend that you can't stand, how you didn't like the last 3 dates you went on because you are better than them, how you are better than pretty much everyone in fact, about how your friend needs botox and you told them and don't understand why they are mad at you now, how you went off on a sales woman at a department store for nothing other than you were being a diva, how you are RUDE to people and don't care about it. Oh and did I mention the fact that some of the negative talk is about his co-workers as well?!  Also be prepared for a few dozen F-bombs. I could tell the lady next to me was getting rather irritated since her 5 year old son was there. 

I put all that aside and laughed - because he did a decent job on my very simple hair cut/color and I needed to go there for work. I liked him. He was funny. But to quote a text I sent to my fiancee the last time I was there "Get me out of this chair. My hair dresser is a hot mess again today". I think that speaks for itself. 


I feel bad, because Rodney is a great guy and there are some other super sweet people at that salon. But Jason really has made them look bad! 

So, my review. Unless you wanna tip more than 20% on an very average cut/color - and want to sit an listen to constant complaining, negativity and I am so much better than anyone statements - see someone other than Jason.

I'm from Los Angeles and have tried a whole bevy of Thai food restaurants in Thai town. Siam Elephant is in a league similar to any restaurant in Thai town. Their Pad Thai is probably the best I've ever had. Their Thai Ice Tea is the perfect amount of sweet! Their green beans in The Prik King were fresh and the spice was on point! I also tried the Seafood Fried Rice (yummy) and the hot pot soup was yummy too. 

Here is what I really loved and appreciated. I walked in with my son who is four. He isn't a picky eater by any means so I knew I'd find something for him to eat. I didn't have to worry about that at all. The waitress who sat us asked if I wanted a kid's menu. Ummm a what ma'am? KID'S MENU! I have NEVER been offered a kid's menu at a Thai restaurant. They had special REAL forks for the small hands and divided plates which they gave a salad and fruit to go with their entree. I was so excited about the service I haven't had the opportunity to order the sticky rice and mango and review it here! My only sadness comes from the fact that I live nowhere near here and will probably not have the opportunity to eat here again for a while. Other than that this place is perfect with excellent service!

I always thought this place looked weird from the outside with all the spray painted signs so I reluctantly tried it after 2 years. Wow - I am so mad I missed out on this place for so long!!! The food was absolutely incredible. I was totally blown away. They had many vegetarian options and the service was great. I can't wait to go back.

Just thought I'd mention this is NOT a four-star review for Venuto's because that place sucked. It was replaced several months ago, however, by Zesto's Pizza, a vast improvement. Very nice behind the counter, the manager is always there, wait time is minimal, and the food is very good. hard to find pizza as good as new york, or even close, but it's good here. like the penne with garlic and oil and jumbo shrimp (yes, they are jumbo). You get bang for your buck here. A simple grilled chicken wrap lasted for three meals. desserts are good, too - try the rice pudding. everytime i go past Zesto's there are people there. nice to see a roxborough business doing well.
The Fat Tuesday:  A bright purple kingcake-flavored snowball with cheesecake stuffing and condensed milk drizzles.  Absolute heaven. I eat one a week.....

Ordered takeout for a dinner with friends i was hosting and showed up on the later side of the range indicated for pickup to be told (unapologetically) that the kitchen  was over an hour behind and my pizzas wouldn't be ready until then. Was able to cancel order, but the staff was totally unapologetic and made zero effort to make up for the inconvenience.  Not ever coming back - seemed like a total sh*tshow to be honest

I want to like this place. I really do!  It's the only self serve car wash in Spring Hill that I've found, so far. I have never been to a wash that has a dryer. That's awesome. I like that there's a separate tire/wheel brush that has stiff bristles and the regular soft bristled one for washing. Huge number of settings on the dial; bug pre-wash, waxes, Rainex..... and everything takes a card even the vacuums!

Here's where we get to the sticky situation, the pricing signage is kinda vague. Vacuums are $3, but for how long? I had to swipe twice, so $6 there and couldn't have been more than 15 minutes use.

On to the wash, of which there are only 3 bays for self serve. Here it's a $5 minimum. I swipe and start scrubbing. I get a pre-wash, tires and wheels, and half the car soaped up when the machine asks for more money. I actually like this feature so I don't spend too much time and money here. 
So, second swipe. And I'm doing great! Finished soaping up, gave the floor mats a little rub with the brush and on to rinse. Uh oh, streaks. So now I've got the brush and rinse sprayer going together. Spray, scrub, spray. Keep moving. You've got to be getting close to "times up".

Ok, all swirls and streaks gone. Phew! Let's rinse and try this fancy hand held dryer. 

And we're done! Turn to the machine to see the time counting up, not down. Oh crap! Turn the knob to 'Off' and press the button above twice. Done! 
Nope still counting up. Frantically jab the button several times really hard. 18:15,18:16,18:17... I'm freakin out.

A gentleman walks past with a wheeled trash can. Aha! An employee that can help. I give chase. "Sir!"
"SIR!!!!"  Mere steps from his ear now, Sir!!! I'm acknowledged, yay! But I now realize it's way to noisy for his hearing and my voice to make situation clear and articulate. "It won't stop! The timer. It won't stop!" And I motion him to follow me. 
19:16, 19:17, 19:18... He comes and pushes the button once and the timer stops. 

Phew. That's weird but thank you. I guess an extra minute isn't too bad. How much could that be. But, strange that it didn't shut off like the first time. Well, $10-15 for a sparkling clean car, worth it I'd say. Car hasn't looked this good in months. 

So checking the bank for other things,  there it is a single $5 authorization for the wash. Ok, no worries. 
Checking the bank the next day? $31 for a car wash, that I did myself. And I did a fine job, but I certainly wasn't slow about it. I'm pretty sure I could pay less than that for someone else to do an even better job than I did. 

I think I need to speak to someone, hopefully there's somebody even there to speak with. I don't think the older gentleman had any authority. So we'll see

Update 3/4/18: Jefferey the owner contacted me and was very helpful regarding my experience at the car wash. Sometimes technology gets the better of us and errors happen. Glad knowing Jefferey is fighting our robot overlords anyway he can!

Tom and I stopped by for dinner around 5:30 this past Friday, there was only 2 other people seated at the time, the hostess asked us if we had a reservation and checked her incoming reservations then politely told us we could sit anywhere. After that it took 5 minutes before anyone acknowledged us again despite the place being empty and there being 2 other serving staff but I did notice a couple of people coming in to pick up take out. The decor is quaint put the place is small and tables are close together so as it began to fill up it did get a little loud. When we finally did order we started with the Duck Fries and Mac and Cheese. The Duck Fries were good, the portion is definitely enough for 2-3 people. I was disappointed with the Mac & Cheese it was just ok  it reminded me of Kraft Mac and cheese it had a runny cheesy consistency I was looking forward to a baked Mac & cheese. Tom like the Mac & Cheese so it really is about your personal preference. Our server read off a long list of specials & I was impressed that she remembered them all,me on the other hand I forgot them & ended  having to get her to remind me again because she disappeared for 10 minutes. I ended up ordering the blackened ravioli which I found out when they brought them out had hot peppers on them, they kindly took them back so I ordered the Ribeye which was worth the $40.00 price tag. Not only was it cooked to perfection the seasoning was out of this world. Since the specials are recited to you and not written down I was surprised when I got the check at the $40 price but it was a good cut of meet that was accompanied with some potatoes and mushroom. Tom had the Northeast Burger and said he liked the Burgers at Gallo's Burger Barn better, again it is all about preference. In conclusion I had a good enough experience that I would try the place again Tom said he would pass, he felt like it was too loud, wait staff could have been more attentive and specials should be written down with the prices published. We both mentioned that to a gentleman who may have been the manager and he said we can always go to their Twitter page to look them up. Not the response that I expected but this is the age of Social Media & I don't think the gentleman was trying to be rude. Sorry I forgot to take photos we were starving by the time we got our food.

We've been here a few times. The food is always pretty good, but the service is never that great. Good for late night food in the SoCo area. Beer selection is good, but most of the beers are tap are the typical AB products. They've got a good selection in cans and bottles though.

This business will continue to do well, simply because of the real estate. It has a great location. But because of this, they serve mediocre food and give horrible service and probably keep getting away with it. The food is standard bar fare, nothing special. My meal was super greasy and salty and I felt very bloated afterwards. Service is very poor. The food took a long time to come out even though the restaurant was practically empty and lots of servers standing around.

I have known Garrett for many years since he worked at the local dealerships in Reno.  I met him years ago when i brought my Tacoma into the dealership get tint and clear bra.  His exceptional customer service and integrity has been bringing me back to him for years.  He has tinted and clear bra'd all of me and my wife's vehicles which include a tacoma, tundra and 4runner.  I recently purchased a new F150 and he did an exceptional job with the tint. I will be setting up an appointment next week for the clear bra.  I have also sent numerous friends and family members to his shop.  By far the best tint and clear bra shop in town!  Thank you Premier!

This store has an employee named Nicholette who is rude and who called me rude while going through her line. Nicholette engaged in a conversation with the customer in line behind me about how rude I was as she completed my transaction. I will never spend another cent at this store as long as Nicholette remains employed here. Customers deserve better than Nicholette as a checkout clerk. Dollar General has lost a loyal customer.

if only I could give 0 stars. service was terrible. food was terrible and cold. eggs benedict was not near what a benedict should be, bland and the eggs were hard. the only thing good about this place is the location.

This is by far my favorite place for amazing tacos and sunset watching in the area! High quality food, huge portions, delicious fresh fish and excellent ambience. Family friendly, also perfect for romantic occasions! Love, love, love!

SATCOOOOO

I've been coming here since I can remember, my dad has been coming here since he went to college, etc. Whenever I want bomba$$ tacos I come here. It's cheap, tortillas are made in house, healthy? (depends?), delicious, and fast. And it's open late which is highly convenient for late night taco cravings. Not to mention classic rock songs always playing :) My go to tacos are the grilled chicken and fish. The enchiladas are also great! The sauce they use makes my heart happy. Sometimes I'll get enchiladas and tacos and dip the tacos in the sauce. YUP. I also enjoy putting queso in the tacos. And on the rice. And everything. 

Come here if you like tacos and a happy atmosphere!

What a wonderful little place.  I was visiting relatives and we were all in the mood for Italian food.  We came upon Trattoria Carina quite by accident and decided to give it a try.  The staff is really terrific - friendly and genuinely happy to see you.  The Chef came out to discuss some of his creations.  The place is buzzing and charming to look at.  And the food is really, really good.  I would recommend this restaurant to anyone who wants a very nice dining experience.

I didn't know upscale Chinese places existed until I went to Han Dynasty. Portions are HUGE, so come prepared to share and take home leftovers. Or come during lunch and get a bunch of the smaller plates to share with a group. There's a rotating centerpiece on every table which makes passing dishes super easy so everyone can have a taste.
Not very attentive. Coffee is watered and perilously hot and the egg soufflé was extremely salty. But hey, the furniture is pretty happy!

It isn't fancy, it isn't special.  But if all you need is a decent sandwich, a piece of pie, and a cup of joe, this place does the trick.  The waitresses are a hoot too.  It's got good history.  I'd compare it to the Classic Diner, but I can never get in the place.
Went first time and was great This time was terrible I found a piece of bone in the meat Will not go back again

Solid food with really friendly service. I've tried the sweet potato chicken curry and chicken katsu. Would recommend both but if I had to pick one katsu wins. Usually a big crowd so expect to wait at least 20min

We made a reservation a week ahead of time for a large group (12 people).  We all met in the lobby, and had to wait 25 minutes until after our reservation time because they didn't have the tables set up yet.  

Once we were seated, the server took our drink orders.  It took 25 minutes to get the drinks on the table!  Then the server took our food order.  Another 45 minutes for 1/2 of the food to arrive.  The rest of the food came about five minutes later.  I ordered lasagna and meat balls.  It was luke warm, and had a bland sauce.   My wife enjoyed her plate of chicken parm and shells.

When the server brought the check, he stood and waited while we counted out the cash and figured out the tip.  That was a little unnerving.

One of the biggest problems was finding parking.  We finally found a spot three blocks from the restaurant.

We may try it again with a smaller group to see if the poor service was just a fluke

I love this place. I always get the bento box and I love it. Food is awesome and the staff is very friendly. Great selection of drinks and cool sushi items as well. This is my new favorite lunch spot.
View amazing. Food was great. Our server was amazing. Overall it was a great experience. We will definitely be going back. Highly recommend!

Came here the morning of St. Patrick's Day, and the barista was pretty festive. 
Apparently his celebration had started at midnight. Liked the old building and all the open
windows (or doors? Can't remember which.). Food was simple but good, and most
of the people in the cafe seemed like locals so a big thumbs-up for that.
I called at noon and got an appointment this afternoon.  The salon is clean and professional.  I received a great eyebrow, lip, brazil wax (thorough, painless, fast),

My boyfriend and I walked in one day and we won't be going back. To start off, the huge place was empty which should've been our first red flag and menu items are wayy overpriced. $7 for a smoothie? I can see if it was organic fruit, but for a normal ice cream and frozen fruit smoothie? Am I missing something?  I get the soft serve is supposed to be more healthy than your regular old soft serve but when I asked if it was all organic like the sign said, the girl told me no, just the flavoring was. Sorry but I think I'll go elsewhere.

Have been tons of times before - brunch, nights out on the patio for drinks, dinner. Went back last night with my daughter and we had an absolutely fabulous experience. Service was stupendous from the time we were seated by Paige through our server Mahim. He was attentive, friendly, gave a great recommendation on my meal, and was awesome from start to finish. Menu is improved and massive, dining room has been recently updated again, and the beer list is even better then the last time I was there. We started with tortilla chips, which came with salsa, sour cream and guacamole. Yum. Great kids menu, with lots of choices. I almost went with the special, but our wonderful server recommended the triple decker reuben, which was fabulous. Dessert was great as well, and we both had a blast. Wonderful night, looking forward to getting back! Thanks for a great time.

Seriously one of the coolest places in town. I don't know why there's not a line out the door every night. Everything I've ordered has been absolutely amazing. The Short Rib Hash is to die for. The wings are great. Their sauce is very good and unlike anyone else's I've had. The Turkey Club is awesome too. Their chicken fried bacon strips make the sandwich!

Great service and ambiance. You have indoor and outdoor seating area.
Waiters are well trained and very very friendly and attentive.
We had the eggs Benedict's with lamb and the burrito together with the feta cheese dip.... a must!!
Ac is a bit cold... everything else is perfect!!

Great pizza place. Good pizza even on a busy night. But unfortunately and honestly I saw a rolled joint half by the phone on the counter. When asked, "Are you selling that too" they quickly swept it up and said. "Uhhh, ...no". So I think they are selling more then pizza. I hope not. 

I waited more then an hour for pizza. By be time I got it I was so hungry. And I think it was worth it. This review is a combination of two visits here. 

The bar was packed with happy people but I didn't go in. It did look inviting. 

If my family wants to go back I will go as we often meet here.

Unfortunately, the delicious food was marred by the terrible service.  The waitress we had was perhaps one of the rudest I've encountered in a while.  It started when my boyfriend and I decided to order the Kolsch- which happens to be our favorite beer, despite being the cheapest on the menu and in a can.  The waitress' response when we ordered this:"'um, really?"  She also asked us 4 times if we wanted a glass with it...she finally brought the beers out with some glasses and asked AGAIN, if we needed a glass.  YES we said again.  She then attempted to pour the beer into the glass while it fizzed all over and told us she was a bad at pouring beer.  Just give me the glass, I'll pour it myself I told her.  GOOD was her response.

The food however was delicious.  Both the mussels and the skate were awesome.  I would have stayed for dessert and more drinks if the waitress hadn't brought us over our check immediately after we finished dinner without asking us if there was anything else we'd like.  I'll definitely be back here, but avoid the rude waitress' section.

It was worth the hype! The breakfast was amazing I ordered the catfish eggs and grits! The server said, "I will add a biscuit, you don't come here and not get a biscuit". Real life the biscuit was amazing! They are none for their fried chicken, so I ordered a wing on the side! Amazing!!!
This place! The burgers were great but their milkshakes were AMAZING! I had the maple bourbon and it was heaven. Go, ASAP and get one! You won't be disappointed!

We stopped in for the lunch special (on recommendation from the park visitor center) and were told it was only on the patio and the patio was closed - good day. Not a very friendly welcome and I for one will not return.

This restaurant is consistent with good food, new kinds of dishes, excellent choices for vegetarians, the best coffee in town and servers who Are always friendly  and efficient. Super nice patio To bring your dog who also get excellent service. One of the best restaurants in town.

This review is just for Power Hour.

Service: The service was good. Our waiter did his job. He didn't go above and beyond, but he was friendly and made sure we had what we needed. 

Location: King of Prussia Mall (court). There's an entrance from the mall or you can park around back (near DSW) and walk right in without going through the mall. If you're just going to the bar area, I recommend using the entrance near DSW so you don't have to walk through the dining area.  

Must Try: Miniature Prime Cheeseburger Trio
 
Summary:  I've attended Power Hour twice this week, and had a good experience both times. I'd never been to Morton's before, and I still haven't had a full meal there. But the $5 bar bites were delicious, and the price was just right. The bar area was separate from the dining area and got kind of loud once more people started to arrive, but it did not seem overly crowded. The only down-side to the event is that there are no drink specials. But the $5 Bar Bites were enough to make me come back a 2nd time.

One star may seem harsh, the food was mediocre at best and the service/restaurant policies are horrendous. 
I have eaten here for lunch several times over the years but tonight's meal will be my last.
I arrived around 7 pm, it's a make up your bowl and we cook it concept. A one time trip to the ingredient bar is $9 while a All-You-Can eat option is $13. Signage at the buffet is small print and no one greets you at the door to explain the "rules". 
I filled my bowl headed to the register and I said I just wanted one bowl. The almost impossible to hear cashier/waitress said only the all you can eat option is available after 4pm. I told her I don't want that and she said she'd give me a box for my second bowl. $14.50 with no drink plus they wanted a tip. 
After I ate my first bowl, I had my second bowl made and had a few bites. I was ready for my box. The other almost silent waitress, suddenly very audible, said I couldn't have one it was against policy. I told her what the other girl said and she told me that was "impossible" because the girl knew better and had worked there a very long time. I went to the register to confront the girl who denied she made me that offer. I told her she lied with my voice raised a bit and the dominant waitress handed me the smallest box possible. I packed my bowl and left. Ironically, I even tipped them, a self service restaurant.

Not sure about this place. I wanted to like it- the menu, the atmosphere, and even the look of the food is appetizing, but the food and drinks just didn't do it for me and my friends. 

Was the food horrible?  Nope!  Was it memorably tasty?  Nope!  It was just middle of the road which, for all the presentation, I would have hoped for better. 
 For instance I had the Chronic which is a pulled pork sandwich with a potato but and mac and cheese piled in the sandwich as well. Sounds good and looks even better.  But the taste was just lacking.  I didn't go in expecting KC or Texas level BBQ, but the food here was a little under par from Tony Roma's or Chili's. It just didn't have the bang I expect from a BBQ place. 

The rest of our orders were the same. It wasn't bad, it just wasn't great.

 I'll probably give this place another try at some point and if I like it I'll change my review- but 3 stars is all I can give this place.

Super-convenient location, but be ready for incredibly loud music until about 4 am if you stay on Bourbon Street. Obviously, this isn't the hotel's fault.....but the extremely narrow balcony on Bourbon Street is. Great spot, excellent coffee shop, and no complaints about service or quality......just need to widen and connect all balconies.

Terrible. I don't know how many properties they manage but one hand does know what the other is doing. We've been spending months trying to get appliances fixed. Their tactic seems to be ignore the request as long as possible then say "maintenance" will look it which doesn't happen. Then start the cycle again.

Sabrina's is one of my favorite brunch spots. I first went to one of the locations in Philly and really enjoyed it, so I was thrilled when a Jersey location opened up. 
I've been here several times, and one of my favorite things is the ever changing and incredibly fun to read specials menu. They have had horror movie specials around Halloween, patriotic specials for 4th of July,  TGIF edition specials, and today when we went it was all St. Paddy's day themed specials. 
We actually got there 20 minutes before it opened today (should have checked the website but we were being impulsive!). The door was open so we walked in and were greeted by a very nice woman, possibly a manager. She told us they didn't open til 8 and that the servers weren't in yet. We didn't really want to venture back out into the cold and luckily for us she was very accommodating and offered to seat us anyway. She even brought us water and coffee! So nice. 
My boyfriend loves a sweet breakfast, so as usual he ordered the stuffed French toast. Fine by me, since it means I get to have several bites. The portion size is HUGE. I've never seen bread slices so big. It's stuffed with a yummy sweet cream cheese mixture, topped with bananas and syrup. We always end up taking half of it home. He got a side of scrapple and wanted me to include in my review the fact that it was a very large portion size, which he was pleased with. 
I prefer a savory breakfast so I almost always go with a special. Today I chose "The Special Breakfast that Drove the Snakes out of Ireland". If nothing else it was fun to order. I enjoyed it very much, though I did ask for some franks red hot to spice it up a bit. It was a polenta base with corn flake crusted fried chicken, two over easy eggs (it was super delicious with the runny yolk pouring out onto the chicken as I cut it open), a fresh tomato salsa, and of course a side of their breakfast potatoes. It was very yummy, and similarly to the French toast I ended up taking half of it home for tomorrow's breakfast. 
As always with Sabrina's, I'm looking forward to my next visit!

Went with friends. Very much enjoyed the rice bowl I had. It was made Vegan. Very flavorful. The staff are very friendly and accommodating.
It should be at a bigger location. Only 4 tables to sit at.

I'm originally from Brooklyn, and am an Italian American. I really like Ceriello's. I discovered it first at their location in Grand Central, and was happy to discover their location in Medford, way closer to where I live. Great meats, including Veal, but our favorite is the Brooklyn/Long Island style Italian pinwheel pork sausage with pecorino cheese and fresh parsley. Perfect. Great pricing on grated cheese, good bread, nice deli. The real deal. I don't have to make the trek to Court Street anymore! Minus one star because they don't always have my fave sausages when I drop by!!!!!!!!

Amazing, undisputed selection of films! Thank goodness for Casa Video. And given its LGBT film section, it proved to be crucial for my sexual identity development. And the staff picks are actually decent. Well thought out, obviously.

I had my first Brazilian with Tina and I cannot imagine it going any smoother (literally and figuratively...)! She has a very calming demeanor that made it as pleasant as possible. Will definitely be returning for her services in the future.

I had the worst customer service last evening. My boyfriend and I went into this gas station for some beer and waited at the counter for 10-15 minutes because they were having a shift change. There's nothing wrong with that, but the lady at the front desk didn't have to be so Snyde about it. Once he waited for so long he came back out to the car and I went in and basically yelled hello across the counter and then was finally checked out, and the lady who rang everything out was rude the whole time because she didn't care, and the other employees were laughing the whole time. Terrible, ignorant customer service

Whaaaaaaa?  Whaaaaaa?!   How many years has this place been here and I never wobbled my way into the door?  Whaaaaa?!?!!!    I have come here quite a bit since I found it, and let me tell ya.... the buffalo wings are rollin!!  Im not kidding, they are really super good!  The right size, right amount of batter, no feathers, and the hot sauce is actually kinda hot.  Made me sweat , well that isn't saying much, but its a good sweat and I keep coming back for more.

If you are going to someones house for the game or a garage sale or whatever, drop in here real quick like, they don't do phone orders, and order 50 wangs real quick.  You will be kicking yourself like I have as to why you haven't been eating wings here all along.

Oh...and they are ludicrous cheap

This was our second visit to the Ritz, having seen Shrek the Musical a few years ago. My wife daughter and I attended the final performance of "Disney's Beauty and the Beast "  on Sunday 8/6/2017 @ 2:00 p.m. Just a bit about the theatre. It is an historical landmark and harkens back to Trenton theatres like the Olden and Greenwood where many a baby boomer cut their teeth on movies with double feature .25 cent Saturday matinees. Not a bad seat in the house, although a nice upgrade would be replacing the seats during the off season. A nice supply of treats, candy and drinks at fair affordable prices are available. All staff members were friendly, warm, and willing to assist you to your seats, and answer any questions you may have had. Parking is iffy but we were lucky enough to find a spot on the street right across  from the theatre. ( FREE !!!! ).

All I can say about the performance was.....AMAZING!!!!!!. As limited as they are for space they pulled off the magic usually reserved for Broadway productions. Scenery, ensembles special effects and the leads in the show were nothing short of NYC productions, and all three tickets cost a grand total of $96,00. Nowadays you cant see a B'way show at mid premium seating for less than $175.00 a ticket ! All of the cast were excellent with a special shout out to Jennifer Garcia who was a delight as Belle. She uncannily sounded exactly  like the actress who voiced Belle in the Academy Award nominated animated feature for Best picture before a separate category for full length animated feature was established. The score was "canned," but I personally preferred this to a so-so 7 or 8 piece live orchestra I heartily recommend you give yourself a treat and check out the Ritz to form your own opinion, but I'm sure you will be very satisfied with the entire experience. This was the final show of the season but they have a great lineup for 2017-2018 season. Highly recommended from a former lead singer in an all purpose band ( Clubs, Weddings, etc. ) for over thirty years. I'm no expert but I know good talent when I hear and see it

Fast friendly and knowledgable. I needed some parts for my Toyota 4Runner. I called and the man on the phone was professional. I explained to him what I needed and he helped me get the correct parts and some parts I didn't know I was going to have to use. The price is more than your Auto-Zone, but you get the OEM Parts, they fit correctly and were designed for your specific application.

We had a bad experience here, food was cold, bread was soggy, and to top it off the pulled pork was inedible.  The BBQ sauce had no flavor and didn't help mask the taste of the pulled pork. Would not recommend eating eating here.

My personal lunch combo pizza was barely warmer than room temperature. The fries were cold and stale.  The only good thing at our table was the house salad.  The service was okay. A little slow and sloppy, but the server was pleasant. Definitely not the same as the Chicago locations we've experienced/heard so much about.

I never thought a chain BBQ joint could be so fantastic !!! The brisket is juicy and tender. The cheddar jalepeno sausage is amazing :) I love the fact that the sauce is NOT sweet...it's just right. For sides I love their creamy Mac n Cheese and the jalepeno baked beans. If you save the plastic drink cup, next visit bring it back and the refill is only $1. Top all that off with free ice cream for dessert :)
I can't say enough nice things about the staff either...very nice group of people !! I think they need to expand the dining room :)
Can't rave enough about this place.  Friendly staff, great food and awesome ambiance.  A definite must visit!!

Love this place!  I have a 2 and 3 year old and they love to play in the play area while I shop.  Found great condition high end Jordan shoes for my son for only $10 and True Religion capris for my daughter for $13.  Brand new they go for $60 and $100+,  respectively!  Love how they have deals and promotions every once in a while.  Always friendly and huge selection.  No complaints!

I probably will be criticized for saying this, but to me the candy was too sweet. I know, you are saying: "dude, candy is supposed to be sweet, it has sugar." And I reply: "Yes, I know, but candy should not be so sweet that you cannot even swallow." And then you reply: "If you don't like it, don't go." And now we have agreement, I won't.
The staff was excellent and extremely helpful.  I would stay at this embassy suites again.

I was on a mission of mercy and picked up dog food (not in my neighborhood) for a friend.  The staff was really nice and repeatedly offered to carry the bag of food to the car. The prices seemed compatible with big box chains, but this is a locally owned store.  (The original is in my childhood neighborhood). PLUS you get the convenience of down the street, well y'know if you're my friend.

Nice selection of doggie items, collars, treats, food, etc. I didn't look at cat stuff.

I recently visited this diner due to a segment on the local  news in the winter. While the service was OK, the food was LESS than pleasing. It was tasteless and not appetizing at all. The bacon and turkey sausage were like plastic and cardboard- could have went to a fast food joint for that! The only thing worth ordering was the rye toast. Even the cranberry juice was not a good brand of juice. Needless to say I will not be returning. I will visit Michael's if I need a diner or Fairlane Grill in Flourtown. I only gave 2 stars because the service was not bad.

Gumbo is indeed as good as people say.

I sat at the bar and ordered the seafood gumbo.  It came with a loaf of French bread that was crisp on the outside and the soft on the inside.  Gumbo was one of the best I've had.

I think I saw some complaints about service in the other comments.  This was not the case for my visit.  Bartender was friendly and service was quick.
Great seating area and atmosphere, the view is amazing. I've been here a few times now, and I'd recommend the red sampler. Merlot is fantastic.

This place is convenient and inexpensive, ive been going there for years and have always had fun hanging out, Jeff is a charcter and they guys that work there know what they are doing.  As long as your not a spandex wearing roadie snob they have most everything you could need.

It's close to my house, and helps me avoid the drive down into the terrible big box lands of south philadelphia. Hell, I can even bike there. And the selection is decent. But forget about getting any help. As a customer who occasionally frequent home improvement stores, I have a better idea of what product I'm looking for, and where to find it, then the staff at this Lowes. And I've definitely had two employees ignore me, after I asked them a conversation, to finish their personal gossip then yell at each other, arguing about who was actually going to help me, directly in front of my face. It was shocking. I'll pop in there to pick something up, but I'll avoid the "customer service," thank you very much.
This place is amazing.  Great food and service.  I would definitely go again when I'm in town.

We had a great experience eating here. Loved the guac made on the table. Drinks were good and our server Manuel was very attentive to everything we needed. Looking forward to come back next time we are in the area.

We (party of 5) visited this establishment on Saturday, June 6, 2015 for my sisters birthday and was excited to see, meet and taste the food of Chef Milly's, as we rooted for him on Hells Kitchen.  To start off we had a 9pm reservation and was not seated until at least 10:30pm (we waited patiently, some of us anyway).  Then once we were seated we waited again for anyone to even acknowledge our table.  Someone finally came and bought over silverware and stated they would bring back bread.  We finally received the bread I would say about 30-45 minutes later sitting in a whole stick of melted butter. If it had not been for the birthday cupcakes we bought with us we would have starved to death. I believe it was his brother but not sure who finally came to wait on our table (Ty?).  He was superb, very apologetic, and gracious, because we could tell he was not suppose to be waiting tables.  We ordered appetizers which came out in a reasonable amount of time I would say (Wings, Crab Fries, and Shrimp) all superb, the wings are the BOMB!  Finally we ordered our entrees.  Shortly after placing our order the waiter came to tell us several of our orders weren't available (thad just about ran out of everything we came for mainly being the fried lobster) . The food came out about 12am one by one.  Needless to say we didn't get back to our hotel until 1:27AM from being here since 9PM.  I understand this was only day 6 open but the service was the absolute worst.  I wish I could give them a better review but 2 stars is the best I can do.  The food is ok, I ordered the crabcakes with seafood mac n'cheese, and corn on the cob.  Oh and Chef Milly does come out from the kitchen but not to greet his guests...WOW.

Great customer service and quality. Found my new jewlery place!

I originally came in for sizing but their jeweler was completely honest and said that if I sized it now, I risk it being too tight in the summer. So I just had it cleaned, which the jeweler put a rush (pick up in 3 hrs) on it since I lived far away.  I appreciate the honesty and commitment to good service.

I am a pizza whore!!!! . This place has amazing pizza.  The crust the sauce and the cheese was fresh and on point!!! .  I love when my food comes smoking hot and I was not disappointed tonight!!  I will be back again!!
Nice place. Great location across from Hotel Monteleone. A little pricey. Pork Chop was amazing! Very tender. It cut like butter. Bread pudding was awesome. Bar drinks were nice and strong.

I've only been for lunch and sat at the bar area.  They have a good lunch special.  They offer teppanyaki style table cooking for groups or you get paired with other folks.  Menu is varied from sushi and tempura to miso soup, salad and entree's.  Full bar is available.  Enjoy!

We frequently order take out for lunch at work, and this is one of the only places in Temple Terrace that I really like to order from. 

For starters, prices are super reasonable. I usually get quesadilla which are under $5 and chips and salsa for another $2. Its a large meal for a low price. Another plus is that its fast. We place a large order, and its ready to be picked up within 10 minutes. The quality of the food is pretty good, but with any cheap restaurant, some things are better quality than others. Chips, queso, cheese, and veggies seem really fresh and delicious. The chicen is good, but probably not of the highest quality. You can't have everything for $7 right?? 

Overall I definitely recommend this for the area.

Overall it was a great experience.   We had drinks at the bar and then got a table.   The margaritas  we had were very good.  They also served us chips and 2 different salsas and a bean dip.  All three were really good.   Our server was a young sweet girl and this was her first week ever serving.   She tried really hard and in time she will be a great server.  Getting drinks at the table took forever.   The food for the most part was good.  We tried the quail appetizer, the funego dip, taquitos and a green tamale.  The dip was the best.  The tamale could have been good but was very dry.  It needed a sauce. I had the poblano grouper and do not recommend that at all.  It had no taste or any flavor.  Extremely boring.  Hubby had a flank steak with an enchilada and it was very good.   A friend had bean soup and it was watery.   Another friend had the red snapper and really liked it.   Will come back and try it again.  Hopefully, this time my entree will be yum.

While shopping in downtown Franklin, a store owner recommended Puckett's for a good barbecue lunch. We arrived around 1pm on a Sunday and waited about 15-20 minutes. We ordered the ribs, pulled BBQ chicken, and Tennessee philly. The sides we had included the skillet mac & cheese, baked beans, and cole slaw. The food itself was delicious and authentic southern style. 

The service, however, was below average. My friend's meal came out missing a side order. In addition, our waitress did not return to check if everything was okay shortly after bringing our food out. If she had, she could have brought the missing side, and refilled our drinks that remained empty for the rest of our meals.

My boyfriend and I stayed at this hotel for a wedding. I thought the location was great, as it was steps away from the French Market and Cafe du Monde. I also liked the fact that it was close enough to Bourbon Street and all of the action without being noisy.

We checked in late at night (thanks to a delayed flight and stormy weather) but the person at the front desk was very nice. The room was in good condition - it definitely wasn't the newest or cleanest room I've stayed in, but it served us well. They did put a condom on one of the bedside stands, or perhaps it was left there by the previous occupant? In any case, I found that a bit odd.

When you check in, they give you a "Buy One Get One Free" voucher for a drink at their bar. We didn't have time to check out the bar, but I thought the coupon was a nice touch. They also have a continental breakfast, but we didn't take advantage of that either (we opted for beignets at Cafe du Monde, of course!).

I had to dock a star for the fact that they don't offer late check out. I've actually never been to a hotel that didn't push back the check out time by at least one hour when requested, so I found it strange that this hotel didn't let us do that.

Overall, it was a nice hotel and we had a pleasant stay.

This place is straight out of a time warp!  Walt is very smart, always helpful, and genuinely acts in a caring and highly responsive nature to your prescription needs.  He fills quickly when you walk in with a prescription, and gives helpful advice on some insurance gotchas, or things you should think to do/contact with your insurance, in order to make sure he can fill when you bring it in.  If you live in the neighborhood, as I used to, patronize this establishment.  (I live about a mile away and still use only Ellis Pharmacy - it's worth the 10 minute walk.) It is absolutely worth supporting Walt;  this pharmacy gives you amazing customer service from yesteryear, but is up to date on all the current drug and prescribing trends.

Stopped in at The Coffee Room on a visit from San Francisco and I'm so glad I did! Great local coffee shop - brand new but the baristas made a good latté and the breakfast options looked yummy. Power outlets at almost every seat pair nicely with the free wifi. I'll definitely be back on my next visit to Newtown!

-we made a reservation, and I'm glad we did; even on a Thursday night, the place was still 80% full. 
-based on the other reviews on yelp, I was a little worried that it was going to be too thick for my taste, but I was 
-service was prompt at the beginning, and drinks were served fast. However, we waited for a while to order. 
-I also must note that every single item on the menu has tons of ingredients in it. That's great but for those picky eaters (my kids), you have to ask for something "off the menu" like pasta with marina. Not that big a deal, but still. 
-the Caesar salad was great, God love those sundried tomatoes!!
-I ordered the "Pappardelle Alla Bolognese" I thought it was great! The seasoning was excellent.

overall, a great experience. All people in my party thoroughly enjoyed their food. we will be back for more soon. I invite you to come and experience a classy, upscale restaurant with adequate service and a large selection of drinks.

iPhone 5S screen replacement 
Walk ins exempted,
I was in and out like a nascar pit crew!!!
Great place fair prices.


I seen a 1 star review  for a screen that broke after 2 months come on 2 days and you might have an argument but 2 months "come on MAN!"
#not fair # Idope fairy dust

I just opened my chiropractic office in downtown Santa Barbara (Van Wickle Chiropractic) and needed just a basic sign to hang up on the wall of my building. Goodland signs was one of the first places I contacted to get my sign built and I am SOOO glad I decided to go with them. 

The thing that impressed me the most about working with Paul from Goodland Signs was that he went above and beyond and made my ok idea into a killer reality.

I originally only wanted an exterior sign but at the last second I asked if he could also make me a window decal. Paul was totally accommodating to my request and the end product was AMAZING! And his prices are extremely reasonable too.

I would definitely go here again to get another sign made, no hesitation. The only reason I am putting four stars is that the time it took for the sign to be made was a little longer that I was hoping, but I knew that it would be going in (I think I came at a really busy week, plus the fact they were in the process of getting a brand new printer, so it's hard knock 'em that). However my signs turned out PERFECT, so in reality this rating is should be more like a 4.75.

I'm still stoked on those signs! Thanks Paul!

The Mr was looking for a voodoo doll to bring back for a buddy at work & the Yelp App came up w/ Voodoo Authentica

We wouldn't have entered had it not been for Yelp - the outside signage states it's a "cultural center" so we thought it was a museum but rest assured it's a shop & they have absolutely everything you'd ever be looking for, when it comes to voodoo

All kinds of dolls to ward off evil, protect health, promote sexual well-being - there are big dolls, small dolls, pencil dolls, doll-magnets, feathered dolls, stuffed dolls & this doesn't even begin to cover all the candles & scents & herbs & books & whatnot you'll find all over the shop

The girl working there was super-nice & allowed us to browse but was totally available & willing to answer whatever questions we had.

For providing education & every single juju supply one could think of, this place has got to be as good as it gets!

Have only been here for lunch a few times...and each time I ordered the Pork Belly Banh Mi which is braised pork belly, Cajun pate, pickled carrots and tomatillos, chipotle aioli, jalapeno and cilantro. Wow! I dream about this sandwich. I think it's the best banh mi I've had anywhere. I haven't tried anything else because I keep coming back for this sandwich. A friend had the pulled pork sandwich and said it was very good. Service was great, prices are okay. I'll update once I've tried other menu items.

It literally pisses me off how fucking fantastic Three Carrots is. Like, I'm mad when I'm done eating/full, I want it for every meal of every god damn day (sometimes I do actually get it for every meal, WHY WOULDN'T YOU?!). It's not only great vegan food, it's great fucking food!

I've been going here for 5 years now and they're just great! I don't understand those reviews who don't understand what the lunk system's for. We don't call them "lunks" because they're buff. We call lunks to those who slam weights down, don't wipe their equipment, make sound, etc. I think it's a great idea and it's apparently working because I've never seen one in a long time. 

True, they have old equipment but it's not like you're going there to play with the equipment. You're there to work out and it works perfectly fine. 

Sadly, I'm looking to go to the Northtowne one because they're closer to my house. Hopefully they have great customer service there. If not, I'd be happy to come back here.

I promise you've never had barbecue this good anywhere else. The owner of this place is an evil genius of barbecue. From the appetizers all the way to the desserts, the menu is exciting, Inspired, and even insane. They must be crazy because the prices seem way to low for the portions you get. 

Every time I go, I have to pinch myself to make sure I'm not dreaming. The beef brisket is the best I've ever had, juicy and smoky. The smoked chicken is just perfect, it takes chicken to new heights. The ribs, well, I almost cried when I Tasted them. 

The ridiculous side of the menu is where I always order from, you get way too much food to eat in one sitting which is great because who doesn't love BBQ for breakfast the next day? 

I'd pick out the choice items for you but seriously, they're all choice. Try the Hog Nads, and make sure to get the swine juice too!

The place is great, the staff is awesome, what more can I say? Go get the best BBQ you've ever had!

I just went there yesterday for a Brazilian and I loved the atmosphere. I was about 30min late yet they still accommodated me with a smile. Linda did the deed and she made it as relaxing and easing as possible. She explained everything. She was very informative.  I'm mos def going back!!!
Lucy's is amazing. Great food (wide variety) and great service always. Fun for lunch, brunch or dinner. THE place to be for Saints home games.. Who dat!

Two stars and that is being generous! OVERPRICED AND ALWAYS CROWDED. Oh wait they do have a student discount, but it's only valid I think one or two nights a week! What's that all about? If you do make the mistake of coming, be prepared to spend close to $30 for two people and snacks.

I attended here with my wife. She got the Diego bowl and I got the Berry Bowl. It is a nice little place. The bowls tasted amazing. My only complaint is that the small bowls that we got were still very large! Other than that, I would definitely come here again.

Sushi was good rice was a bit undercooked better than their Carson location but when we got seated by the host I let them know I was doing the dinner menu for lunch so I can have a full menu and also let the chef know and everything was great.... until I ordered dinner rolls I felt like I was being watched by the other chefs about the rolls I ordered and they kept going to talk to my chef in Spanish not knowing I spoke Spanish saying "those are dinner only rolls" in Spanish. I continued with my lunch but definitely didn't like being watched on what I was eating especially if they were speaking Spanish so I wouldn't understand that's not very professional and hopefully they learn from situations like this.

There were many things I liked about this hotel.  Location, beautiful landscaping, nice pool and hot tub areas, free wireless Internet.

However, our room had kind of strange and outdated decor.  The sheets reminded me of those ones that your mom has had for 20 years-- they were worn, and floral.  The bedspread had a different floral pattern, but the pillow cases were a white stripe.  My parents' room had bedding that was all in the white stripe (including duvet covers), so maybe they're in the process of updating it.  If you end up with mom's floral sheets, ask to change and I bet they will.

Overall, I liked it and would stay there again.

I've been back and forth over this since eating here yesterday.  Mrs. S and I were excited to finally be in the area for dinner, as we are huge fans of Bailey's Chocolate Bar, and figured we would love the Range just as much.  

However, we were displeased with our visit!

For starters, I had been joking about he new trends with bacon flavored deserts, and joked about checking the menu for a bacon shake.  Little did I know there was a bacon shake on their "boozy" menu.  I was feeling adventurous so I ordered this mixture of ice cream, caramel, candied bacon and Makers Mark liquor.  At $9 it was one of those situations that I generally avoid, because $9 for a drink that I know NOTHING about is a risk I just don't take.  And if I ever had any questions of WHY I don't take these risks, the bacon shake did it for me.  This shake is tasted in levels.  First you get the liquor (YUMMY!).  That's your first sip, ice cream and liquor.  Next you get the caramel.  By the third or fourth drink, I was getting chunks of bacon.  Not so yummy at this point. For me it wasn't about the bacon alone.  It was the tremendously sweet caramel, with the salty yet sweet bacon, all mixed into one thing.  It was too sweet, too much to handle, and at $9, too much money to go out on a limb for.  

For dinner, I ordered a bison burger (forgot to order cheese!) with fries and honey mustard sauce.  Mrs. S got a regular burger with fries and cheese sauce.  My burger was decent, not bad, but not the best.  Mrs. S was not as excited about her burger, mostly because the ketchup wasn't your every day flavor.  I tolerated the different style but I honestly just am not a fan.  As for the fries, they were good.  The cheese sauce was much better than the honey mustard, mostly because the honey mustard tasted more like spicy mustard.  Maybe a mistake was made, maybe not, hard to say.

All in all, Bailey's Range was just "ok" for me and the wife.  I am torn between 2 and 3 stars as I write this review, for the simple fact that if someone were visiting and asked to go here, I would probably suggest passing on it, (at least if I was expected to be a part of the group) and point them in a different direction.  I think the most fair review I can give here is 3 stars, as part of my issue with Bailey's Range has to do with taste, and for me this isn't my style of food.  Service and atmosphere are both ok as well, but really when I think of a 4-5 star place, it should transcend tastes and be inviting for people who usually do not eat a certain style of meal or cooking.  Bailey's does not do this for me.  It's not exceptional to me.  It's just, "ok."

So here goes, 3 stars for Bailey's Range and a new list for my followers.  Just not my cup of tea.  A fair rating for a place that just isn't my cup of tea, but some might still find value in the experience.  That seems fair, right?

I love Trader Joe's.  It's a reliable place to stock up on treats and staples when we're traveling.  Today, after brunch at Bobo's followed by a perfectly lovely visit w/ my dear Yelp friend, Bleep, we headed to this Trader Joe's to shop.

We bought bananas and oranges and unsalted almonds, chocolate covered almonds, candied ginger, beer for Alan and an Australian Shiraz for me.  I love that we know their stock, have favorite things and everything looks familiar.  I guess that's why people shop in chain stores:  familiarity and predictability.  I didn't buy flowers as I often do because I don't think we have a vase.  But now we have healthy and fairly healthy snacks to carry us through our 10 day trip w/o a trip to a conventional grocery store.  The staff, as usual, were friendly and capable.

Wait for one hour for food at lunch time around 12 pm. There is not much people in restaurant. No idea what is the kitchen doing. Worst experience ever! 

We finally got the food after one hour. One comment, not worth the price and wait. The redfish is dry like frozened for a long time. The rib eye is over cooked. We got a new order of ribeye and it comes out with not much flavor. Not sure if it is because of returned dish.

I thought the food was really good . I think the place ia a little stuffy though . The bartenders are wearing tuxedos and the waiter or table captain as they put it was wearing a suit . I have to say that our table captain who's name was Jimmy was not a very good waiter at all !!

I tried a corned beef sandwich as I was enticed by a $5.00 coupon. Warm on rye, the meat was sliced thin so very tender. I was impressed with the help yourself pickles which were pretty good, but the sandwich was pretty average. For a good corned beef on real NY rye, baked in store along with house roasted corned beef and others I ll drive a little further south on Dale Mabry to Carrollwood Deli. The closest thing to a real NY sandwich in Tampa.With a very varied menu I will be back to try something else, as the pickles were worth the trip,

We had so much fun today at Picasso and Wine! When we arrived, we were greeted by super friendly hosts who created beautiful and tasty cocktails. I had champagne and helped myself to the mimosa bar. Yum! The music was great and our artist was fantastic. She showed us everything we needed to see to recreate the painting we chose. She was friendly and funny, and patient too! I am definitely not an artist, but I had a great time creating my 'masterpiece'!

Very rude employees. They will not help you when asking about specific items and smart off about even asking as if they don't have time or the "how dare you speak to me" attitude. Employees at the cutting counter are the rudest. I've been treated like trash by them for buying clearance fabric and lectured about using coupons as if I don't know the general rules or as if I can't afford it as well as treated badly when having regular priced items cut. Asking for anything in the locked counter like paint is definitely out of the question unless you want to be treated like you're wasting their time.

Mike is awesome! He is friendly, kind and personable. He humanized the checkout experience just by being a nice human being. I mean, we've all had the checkout experience somewhere where you are either completely ignored or the cashier is just flat out rude or on their phone, especially in Tampa. Mike actually took the initiative to smile, make a quick joke, wish me a good night and I actually believe he meant it. Mike for President!

The beer snob in me was a huge fan of the beer selection.  The carnivore in me was thrilled by one of the most delicious burgers I've ever had.  The accommodater in me was pleased to see lots of vegan and vegetarian options for my more enlightened friends.  This place pleases all of the Brandies inside of me!  

You enter into the bar area, which is pleasantly dark and cozy, and then have the option of stepping down into a larger room with tables if you want to eat.  I loved the atmosphere, including the *REAL* jukebox, instead of those stupid Touchtunes jukeboxes that have invaded even the best of bars. 

The server wasn't the most attentive in the world, but this was a Friday night, so I totally can't hold that against them.  

Like I said, the beer selection was great, and being an out of towner, I got to try a few things I had never had before.  It was actually the beers that brought me there, but the burger that left me RIDICULOUSLY HAPPY.  Oh man.  My friends actually had to tell me to stop gloating about it.  Yeah, it was that good.  One of my friends got the vegetarian pulled pork and was also pretty pleased with it.
 
Go here.  Get the burger.  Drink good beer.  Be happy.

I've been going to AJ's to rent mountain bikes for the past 5 years. Each year I do a trip to the Tampa area to see family and like to take advantage of the great riding at Alafia and Boyette. AJ's has always has  great selection of high  demo mountain bikes available at a reasonable price and in good working order. They'll take time with you to get the suspension set up to your weight and install yours or their pedals and any other items you might need. They also have a well stocked shop should you need an accessory. They carry high quality parts by serious MTB companies. This is not some fair weather mountain bike team at AJ's. They live near and ride some of the best trails in the state. More important the team there is friendly and helpful whether it is regarding the bike or trail information. This year I had some minor mechanical issues with the rental bike and took it to another shop as I was traveling to Santos with the bike. I explained the situation to AJ's upon return and they credited me the amount of the repair on my rental as it was not something that I had caused. This is great customer service and they have once again exceeded my expectations as being a great bike shop. If you are need of a serious bike shop in the Tampa, St Pete and Lakeland area pay AJ's a visit.

Don't waste your money. The deep dish pizza taste more like lasagna than pizza. The crust is like eating rocks. All the staff are unfriendly. It takes 45-60 minutes to get a deep dish once you place the order. This place is also overpriced. Also, the pizza is 8 slices. You will be full after 1 slice and you will be miserable after 2 slices.

The only positive thing I can say is the restaurant was cool.

If you want good Old Chicago style pizza go to Old Chicago's in Franklin.

For about a month after going to the Jamaican Jerk Hut, I felt physically sick when I heard reggae.   I wish I were kidding, but I really disliked the food that much.

Our table (a large party) paid an "entertainment fee" to listen to bad live music.  We were also charged a corking fee for every bottle of wine and 6-pack of beer--even though we brought our own opener and the waiter never actually opened anything.  If you want to charge for alcohol, please get a liquor license.  

Service was abysmal.  They mixed up our food orders and it took close to an hour and a half to get our food.

The only plus I can think of is that they have outdoor seating, which meant smokers could smoke their little lungs out while waiting an hour and a half for the food to arrive.

I love the pizza at Pinocchio's! This is my go-to place for a fun night out with the kids. We order a pitcher of root beer for the little ones, while mom and dad get to order from the extensive beer menu. We order large fries and a jumbo pizza and if we're lucky we have leftovers for lunch the next day. This pizza reminds me of shore pizza---thin crust and so tasty. The people who work at Pinocchio's are extremely friendly and very knowledgeable when it comes to beer. I love that they give out dough to keep the kiddies occupied. Also, a good menu item is the bread pudding (I love bread pudding). We ordered the soft pretzels before, but were disappointed and the complimentary bread sticks are pretty bland---could use a tangy sauce, or just skip them, because I'll be filling up on pie.

This Store Has By Far, The Best Finds on The Pier. I Found a Few Treasures at a Phenomenal Price.  I was Blown Away by the Treasure Finds; But More Amazed at the Low Price Tag!!! Go On UP!!  Like Me You'll Be GLAD You Did.  They Have a Great Selection of Unique Momentos to Make Your Gifts Memorable. ( Also The Gentleman who owns it it the kindest nice man)

The food was great.  Service was a bit slow but it was a little busy.  Very nice people and the area was clean.  Most places wipe the table with the same rag over and over again, not here.  Table next to us was cleared and then  was sprayed and wiped with a paper towel.  

The food came out it was appealling and tasted great.  The person next to us had the french toast, almost traded plates with them.  Check it out, you will not be disappointed.

Disappointing considering how expensive this place is.

After living close to it for a few years, a friend took me along to meet up with a group there.  It's just your standard casino but overpriced.  I wanted to play some 21 but couldn't find a table for less than $15 a hand with most tables saying $25.  I'm a little cheaper than that.

Then walking around the casino, I was shocked.  Not much can shock me these days but in 2015, seeing people indoors smoking just seemed weird.

The food was amazing! We are definitely making this place our go to spot for sushi! We ordered the Mexican and shrimp tempura rolls. They were excellent. The miso soup was on point. We ordered a bowl of yakisoba too. That was delicious! Overall, I would definitely recommend this place. We are going back for sure!

This place never ever lets me down. Everything on the menu.... amazing. Reasonable pricing too!

I usually get their burritos & they are HUGE. Very filling. If you get their combo meal, which comes with rice and beans... you'll be full the wholeeee day. SO GOOD. My favorite!

This Taco Bell lives up to the standards that makes Taco Bell so great. The employees at this location deserve all the credit in the world, as their liveliness and energy always improves my experience. I've had very few issues with my order here,  and it always tastes better than a gourmet meal.

Fantastic food!! Just had an egg role as well as I
Lillys roll followed by spicy shrimp pho.. I'm perfectly satisfied and so glad we stopped in. Highly recommend!

Ate here for the first time this weekend and i can honestly say it was pretty bad and tasteless. I know this place has been here for a very long time and the owner works hard to keep the place running but what i had from the dinner buffet was not very good. There was sweet and sour sauce on the buffet but no chicken balls were offered in the buffet on this day. I guess it was there to maybe put on the bland white rice they called fried rice. I have had chicken and beef fried rice many times in my life and there was no way that was fried rice. More like warmed up/steamed plain old white rice that was clumpy and hardly had anything in it. There was no vegetable in the rice. I honestly don't know what that was. I tried the ginger beef and it was way overly spicey and soggy. The egg roll was soggy as well and seriously had nothing inside it besides bean sprouts that tasted really bad. Not what i would call an egg roll. I tried the fried chicked that was on the buffet and that was pretty good. Overall i was disappointed though and will not go back.

The first time I went to Spike's was wonderful. A young man who worked there (I think  it's the owner's son) was an amazing help. He showed me everything, answered questions, and made sure that by the time my dog left, she looked like a million bucks. My dog liked him and he made me feel welcome.

I was so impressed that I went back today and instead of the cheapest service (which is what I had the first time), I went with the Deluxe package which was supposed to include everything.

This time, though, the nice young man was busy with a cat & I was left with the owner, Alan. Alan, unlike his son, was an unfriendly, unhelpful, and even belligerent jerk. Not only would he not voluntarily help with anything, he acted totally put-out even showing me how his shop's clippers worked. His attitude seemed to be somewhere between F-U and tough luck. 

After about 10 minutes of trying to clip my dog with a blade that wasn't up to snuff, and getting no help from Alan, I told him that this wasn't going to work for me and it looked like I'd have to go to Petco. He took my debit card and said he was going to charge me the full fee, even though I hadn't yet bathed, brushed, cut, or done anything else to my dog. 

At that point, I decided if I was going to have to pay for it, I might as well try to muddle through. Alan spent all of about two minutes trying to help, which he did silently and with a hostile attitude. Long story short -- my dog left the place looking terrible. She was unhappy to be there and I have never felt as unwelcome or uncomfortable at a business -- ever. 

I would suggest that before anyone else go there, they check to see who's working and if it's Alan, don't go. He's a man who either hates his job or just hates people. Luckily, his son doesn't take after him, which is the best thing I can say about Spike's.

Over priced but very good.    Comparable in quality and price  to a few other places much like them in that particular frozen custard/yogurt genre.  One other place that comes to mind is Ella's on 135.   Lots of choices. Location is very convenient for me because it is very close to where I live - next to the GP mall.  Service was acceptable.  No frills dining area.  Very casual.  Some benches that surround the room and a few tables. 
They have a gimmicky rewards card program in place.   You have to jump through hoops (sign up online) to get it started/activated.  Once started, you bring the card in to get scanned.  It's just another mickey mouse rewards type card to clutter my key chain, juggle and/or keep track of.   I wish this place as well as all of the others that use these silly cards would just give us the deal and cut out the ridiculousness of it all.

Oh,...my favorite flavor - sugar free vanilla, cheesecake, or vanilla cake batter.  Put some fresh strawberries and blueberries on it, and I am calling it heaven in a paper receptacle.

this is exactly what the doylestown area needed - a bar and grill that isn't tiny and overpriced and isn't a crappy chain restaurant. they have TONS of beers, and you can get any of the ones on tap in a pitcher.  there are large TVs around the dining area so it would be a great place to watch a game. the food is tasty and very reasonably priced. i ordered a pork panini and i loved it. (pork loin, bacon, provolone, and mixed greens with a balsamic sauce. muy tasty.) i'm looking forward to going here not only to hang out at the bar, but at the outdoor patio as well.

First visit today. Super small lobby. Not enough seating. The seating they have is overly fancy and impractical. 

Prices were good. Simple menu.

Burger was mediocre. Pretty much Whataburger quality. Onion rings were good. Touchscreen soda machine is slow and annoying. They filled my cup 3/4 full of ice. No napkins or condiments in lobby, very bad design.

Tons of staff but they were more in the way than helpful. They mostly just goofed around. They were training employees and wasting the limited lobby seating.

Overall I think this place will be closed by the end of the year. This might of cut it in New Mexico but we have too many good burger options to settle.

TL, DR: Don't waste your time. Go to Five Guys.

Donuts are good, but the real star is the food.

Their donuts and coffee are great- fun flavors that were seriously delicious and worth the diabetic coma HOWEVER their porkbelly breakfast tacos were what had us coming back for seconds. Be prepared to wait if you get there past 9 though! Highly recommend for a quick but super yums breakfast.

Hi...just an update..... They sent there tech out to fix this......now we are back to the same problem.....bed collapsing
Now my dresser is collapsing also.....

This FURNITURE needs a recall before someone gets hurt..... 
I am so disappointed. Someone please call me 618-719-3717

Wow! I "now" normally wait until the second time I eat somewhere before reviewing it, but I have time right now and honestly I don't need to wait, it was amazing!

First of, this place is in the La Cumbre Plaza next to Sears.  Took us a bit to find it.. Stoopid Siri!

Anyways, the restaurant is super small, mostly a order counter type.  But the bread, the meats, the veggies, everything was just delicious!  I could not find a fault about this place.  And as if all of that wasn't enough, the prices are way lower than any other sandwich place.

So forget Subway, Jersey Mikes or Gandolfo's.. They are not even in the same league as this place!

I just ate there about 30 minutes ago and already want to plan our next time ;). Seriously though, kudos to the owners and kitchen staff you are doing an amazing job.  And if you ever want to open a second place in Ventura, trust me, you will have NO competition, our county sucks for food!!

I discovered this super hidden bar during an adventure to the Homedale Inn with a group of friends.  This bar is further down behind Homedale Inn and we just saw it as we were turning around and decided we had to check it out.  We came in here and there were only around two people in the entire place so it seemed a bit spooky.  It looks like a place that only people that live in the immediate area would even know about or go to.  I've never met anybody else that has even heard of this place or been here.  It looks like a decent place to hang out but it is just very far off the beaten path.  If there were more people here and I would have stayed for longer than one drink this might actually have been a fantastic place but from my short visit there wasn't much going on here.

Not impressed at all. It took them 15 minutes to seat my party for breakfast. They were busy but not that busy. Once we ordered we waited a little over 45 minutes for our food. That is absolutely ridiculous to wait that long for a dinner order let alone a breakfast order. The food wasn't even that good either. I will not be going back here.

The Blue Door is paradise for your eyes. So much to see and admire! Mostly everything was way out of my pocket range (for example, a small vintage le Creuset Dutch oven will set you back $150 and a vintage bowl like a salad bowl is $70) but that didn't stop me from oogling and dreaming of the day I can fill my home with these beautiful antiques. 

There are 3 floors to admire, but the first floor has the most amount of goodies and furniture. There are also unique jewelry finds if you're looking for to gift a friend or yourself.

I think the Blue Door is a gathering of different vendors under one room which makes it especially fun to discover something new. 

This vintage shop is located in the Funk Zone and a must visit if you're in the area!

Wow! We had decided on a destination wedding in New Orleans. I started researching online and Muriel's came up in many searches. It seemed like a great place for a group of any size, we were looking for around 25 people. I contacted them for more information and immediately heard back from the sales staff. I had many, many questions and they were so helpful. I had Maria helping us and she was so quick with responses, she had recommendations on wedding planners, flowers, everything! Because of her we made our decision to have our wedding dinner here. The atmosphere was amazing, such a beautiful place! The rooms are so cool and love the history to it. But the food...oh the food... wow! From the appetizers to the desert - everything was outstanding. Goat cheese crepes, Muriel's salad, redfish, pork chops, bread pudding - wow! My mouth is watering just thinking of it. We were in New Orleans for a week and our guests are raving about how this was the best meal. The service was completely amazing. So friendly and professional. You don't find service like this anymore and it is exactly what you would hope for during your wedding dinner. Thank you Muriel's, we are so looking forward to visiting you for our anniversaries!

Love this restaurant. This is our favorite sushi place. The Philly rolls aren't too salty which I like and the noodles are great, too. The staff is always very nice. 

It's never busy when we go there.

TIP:  Be the first 1000 ticket holder at tonight's game for a special Blackhawk / Fuel ice hockey puck.  All this at the pre-game event from 5 - 7 pm at the Grand Hall across from the fair coliseum.  

Also, at that day's pre-game, there were free games of corn hole and hockey.  Food was available for purchase.  A few of the Chicago Blackhawk's Ice Crew ladies were signing autographs and taking pictures with the audience.  I wanted a signature of Bobby Hull, but there was miscommunication that we needed a voucher at a certain time.  The music was too loud.

This was my first Indy Fuel game in person.  The entertainment at the beginning of the game was exciting.  Fiery blowup creature that the players came through!  Also, I like the flying blimp.  Unfortunately, the Fuel lost 0-2.  

There is a $5 parking fee at the fairground, but free shuttling.  There were a lot of activities that night through the grounds.
Dawn Patrol is a first-class hash joint!  Chose your own hash!  You pick from the list of possible ingredients and the results are magical!  Yum!!  A must try when in Santa Barbara!

Baileys' Range is definitely worth a shot. It has a nice open feel to it (although when we went it was kinda hot upstairs). The drink menu was fun and all of the beers are from local breweries. I don't eat that much red meat so originally I was going to go with a chicken selection. I am glad I went with my choice...the LGBT. SO GOOD! I thought the portion was perfect and I think the prices are good. I shared the fries with someone and got the rooster sauce. Everything was really good and our server was great. I will be coming back and would suggest anyone visiting to check it out as well!

Tasty place to grab a unique sandwich or something else with some tasty beer. I love the decor in this restaurant, as it seems to marry bricks, random tomfoolery, and nerdiness quite well. I've enjoyed most things there. The Bird and Pig was quite good as well as their veggie burger. They also have lots of theme nights, but I've never been to one.
