I have found my nail shop!! My husband and I came in on a whim. I got Gels and he got a pedicure. Not only is the shop clean and esthetically pleasing but the service was done to my exact wishes. Thank you Kim, I will be returning. My only feedback, for the price, I should have been offered water or wine.

I was looking for somewhere new to grab dinner and a beer when I'm too lazy to cook, and read about this new Fishtown spot via Twitter.  Suddenly what I really wanted was a burger and a scotch.  I decided to trek through the first snow/sleet/nastiness of the season to check it out.

After reading up on the brand new bar, I was hoping for "Village Whiskey, Fishtown Edition" and that is exactly what I got.  No, they don't have 50 single malt scotches on the menu.  But the do have close to 10, at a big discount from Village Whiskey's prices.  And they have my personal favorite scotch -- Laphroaig 10yr -- which I enjoyed with an excellent burger. (It's not really fair to compare to the Village Whiskey burger, which is arguably the best burger in the city, so I won't.)

Overall, my first visit was excellent, and I will most likely find myself there again every time someone I've shared a drink with at Village Whiskey is in my neighborhood.
Super clean, healthy, fast and convenient.  I'm so glad something healthy opened in this area.  I like the grains :)

I had a very delicious burger and fries from BYB today for lunch! I love that their waffle fries have a little bit of a zest to them. I really don't think there is a better fast food hamburger. Prices are a little steep but the food is pretty much worth it. I also enjoyed the fact that the employees working the drive thru window were friendly, upbeat and actually seem to enjoy their job. If you can make me laugh during a drive thru window exchange, then you get 5 stars from me! :)

The drinks are cheap. The bartenders are rude. An apparent regular was happy, she had a dog in the bar. I got there around 8 and thought, cool place, what could go wrong.

Apparently a lot. 

Not that Im complaining.  

You should definitely go to this bar.  But dont talk to anyone, and leave before its too late.

Crab fries

Buffalo tenders

Decent service

What's up with the leggings?
Clean bathrooms 
Interesting sinks in the bar area
Hyoooge
Taxi crab for 10$
Not too far of a walk to the ballpark
I love this place! This is my go-to restaurant when I'm craving Malaysian food. The price, atmosphere, and most importantly, the food, is exquisite. The waiters/waitresses are very friendly as well.

This place is just the ticket if you go with reasonable expectations and the understanding that everything is extraordinarily overpriced. But if you go expecting a five-star spa experience, you will be sorely disappointed.

The reason I'm OK with this place, and will probably return? It is ideal for families, even those with new babies such as ourselves. Don't get me wrong, there are plenty of headaches and frustrations about this place. Check-in is a disaster...if you are staying for a holiday (we stayed for their Country Christmas, and again for Labor Day), you can expect to wait at least 30-45 minutes trying to hand off your car to the parking valets, and then another 20-30 minutes in line trying to check in. Here's a tip...if you are waiting in the parking line, send your significant other to wait in the other line...it's the only way to survive.

But there is so much to look at and explore for little kids...waterfalls, water fountains everywhere. And it is so big inside that you can take them on a walk and they will fall asleep lickety split. Food places inside the Gaylord are uniformly lousy and criminally expensive. For mediocre food, go next door to Opry Mills Outlet mall. The rooms are a little the worse for wear, and can really use renovation (though they claimed to have renovated after the flood). But the pool areas are really well done and perfect for the little ones...ours really enjoyed herself. 

If you prepare yourself to be price-gouged on everything, it can be quite a nice experience. It is the perfect place for us.

There was nothing bad about this place, but I was expecting a lot more from the high Yelp rating.  I liked the small rooms where you could have an intimate dining experience with a group of friends.  I'm new to town and this was my first sushi experience here.  My boyfriend and I split six rolls.  I wish they were a little bigger.  It has always bothered me when a roll comes with six pieces instead of eight.  The Tiger Roll was delicious and I would highly recommend it.  They did have good beer specials, which my boyfriend took advantage of.

Update: went back for lunch and it was a MUCH better value.  Three rolls and a cup of miso soup for $10.  I still wish the rolls were eight pieces.
This place is fantastic.  Sit outside with a cold beer. Cheeseburgers are the best and the german potato salad is delicious.
Came by for post dinner drinks and were not disappointed. The atmosphere is classy and eclectic yet comfortable. The mixed drinks were well made and the service was prompt and friendly.

I don't think I was as impressed with some of the other reviews in here.  It's a small place not quite of the 'hole-in-the-wall' nature.  Off-street parking is available.  The menu is simple and traditional... so if you're looking for the texmex, don't come here. 

Everything about it was average for this type of Mexican restaurant in Norristown.  The food wasn't bad, but I've had better.  I would go back.

What can I say? This is a hole in the wall, with a lot of soul! You never know what kind of music is spinning, until you walk through the door. And I have "clowned" on their dance floor many times. It's popularity can pack the house at peek hours on weekends, but the neighborhood locals (like me), venture in for short spells on any given day. It's the Saint! Cozy, dark, and sometimes rocking! It's small, but don't let it fool you, local bands perform, local star dj's, and yes a ridiculous Kareoke night (took away a star)!  I must add, there's a plethora of trashy wenches that show up here too (minus another star). But besides that, I like it!

What just happened in my mouth was amazing.  Homemade ricotta with black eyed peas.  Smooth, creamy and delicious. Shrimp and grits went down like buttah!  Hot chicken took a few seconds before the heat set in, but whew! My tongue stills tingles.  The pulled pork was a welcome break and then we rounded out the meal with a piece of pecan pie.  Can't wait to head back and try a new set of delicious.

I really used to like value vet. However, now I will never use them again. I have 5 dogs & a cat and they will not allow me to schedule 6 consecutive appointments to bring my animals all in at the same time, no matter how far out in advance I schedule them. They want to schedule 2 in the morning, take a three hour break and schedule 2 in the afternoon, take another hour and a half and then schedule the other 2. I would have to take off a whole entire day of work just to take them for their yearly exam. I guarantee that they will start losing customers due to this ridiculous policy!

Went here for the first time on a recent trip to Nashville. The service was good and they were able to seat my party of 7 right away vs other restaurants in the area had a bit of a wait. It was a weekday night and they had live music going on in the front. My salad was okay, I felt the chicken wasn't so great but the rest of the ingredients were good. My dining companions enjoyed the tacos. The bathroom wasn't the cleanest but for a bar bathroom I don't expect anything much better. Overall would go back and try this place again.

I attended a private event at Harry and Izzy's. The staff was attentive and friendly.I ordered a steak and it was perfection. The atmosphere is very comfortable and relaxed - perfect for big groups and social gatherings. I had a wonderful evening and would definitely come back.

Nothing to complain about. Good food, atmosphere, service, prices. It was nice to go somewhere that probided all of that without goudging you with prices. Clean restaurant. I liked there outside seating....it was covered and ventilated well. I ordered the Monte Cristo and it was yummy. The kids pancakes are 3 good sized pancakes with fresh fruit around it and my hubby got the breakfast sandwich. He said it was good but the bread was a little too dense for him. All in all it was good.

Wow! This is how customer service should be! I don't really expect exceptional customer service at a place like this, but it is refreshing to receive it. The pizza is always fantastic, and this particular location deserves a five star.

This place will last six months, tops. Slow service, terrible food, uncaring servers. It isn't that difficult to make decent Mexican food but this place fails on so many levels. I'm not really a picky eater but the food was over salted, lacking spice and flavor, served Luke warm/cold and basically a mound of lettuce. The meat quality is poor and the queso is gross... Seriously how do you mess up queso? I honestly rather eat Taco Bell. I live within walking distance to this place and am rooting for Channelside but sadly my hopes for the plaza are dismal. Channelside, be careful about who you are choosing to put in your plaza! I will not be returning.

Fantastique!  Revolucion has a bazillion things going for it.  It's in Fountain Square.  It's owned and operated by the owners of Radio Radio, a Fountain Square institution.  It's got a tiki bar!  I've actually been recommending it to others before I had even been there.  That's how confident I was that it would rock.  And upon my first visit, I was not disappointed.  I had the fish tacos and a Mexican beer.  The fish tacos were super tasty, filling and a mere $6!  I am anxious to try the margaritas.  There's no doubt I will be here lots!
Food and service are great, but the waiting is horrible!!! Make sure you have eaten something before you go!!!

I had wanted to visit Bella Pizzeria for quite a while. Located in a rather large strip center on East 82nd Street just East of Keystone at the Crossing, Bella Pizza is a four-location indiana mini-chain with locations in Keystone, Hamilton Town Center, Clay Terrace, and in Kokomo. Self-dubbed as a "New York Style Eatery," one can only assume it's because the restaurant tends to be dirty as it's certainly not a description of the pizza. 

Okay, I'm sorry. That was a tad too snarky. 

Bella offers pizza by the slice along with whole pies along with calzones, pasta, salads, breadsticks, a kids menu and some desserts. The location is next to a Mattress Firm  and not too far from Maggie Moo's. It happens to have a couple of accessible parking spots right in front of it, and while they're not quite ADA compliant I'd suspect most people won't have any trouble with them. You enter the front door and head straight toward an ordering counter. They do serve up several specials. I found their slice prices to be pretty workable, though I wasn't as impressed with their whole pie prices. They do offer delivery. 

I ordered a slice of sausage pizza, two pepperoni breadsticks and a large fountain drink. They do have Gold Peak iced tea, so that was a definite plus. My entire meal came in at just over $7 - certainly less than you'll pay for mall pizza, though this isn't a mall and they sure don't have the convenience factor going on. You can actually order online. 

I will admit that considering their location I'd expect it to be a lot nicer inside Bella. Yes, you have multiple tables where you can sit down and enjoy the meal and they certainly are decked out in the usual New York urban decor, think a grittier Subway, but it all seemed a lot more kitsch than I expected. 

I've seen a couple Yelp reviews refer to Bella's pizza as glorified mall pizza and, quite honestly, that's an accurate description. The sausage was chunked, which is fine, but it clearly wasn't fresh and it was barely warm. While I expect this in a mall, when I'm actually in a functioning restaurant I do have higher expectations. The pizza wasn't bad, but there's definitely no way I'd go out of my way for it. The pepperoni breadsticks were warm, though they lacked anything distinct in terms of flavor. I suppose for $7 it wasn't bad, but since I was splurging a bit on my diet I really was hoping for a tastier splurge. 

Bella's was semi-clean. It certainly wasn't divey, but I couldn't help but notice with 3-4 employees working and about as many customers that it seemed like socializing was a higher priority than actually cleaning or keeping busy. They weren't unfriendly and I didn't feel neglected, but with a little interaction with customers they could have really created a much more positive dining experience. 

With Indy really possessing a pretty good pizza scene these days, it's hard to fathom a good reason to return to Bella's. The employees didn't seem to care that I was there and, quite honestly, if you can't serve me a simple hot slice of pizza then you're really not worth my hard-earned dollars. With Napolese in the mall across the street and Puccini's not that far away, when I want a good meal I'll visit them and when I want mall pizza I'll actually go to the mall.

The inside of the salon is cutely decorated and clean. I got the express keratin treatment, because I have frizzy hair that doesn't stay straight during the summer months in Florida. My stylist was very nice and walked me through the entire process. So far, it has been two weeks since I had the keratin treatment done. It took me less time to straighten my hair, and my hair did not frizz up during my beach trip to Miami/Key West. The keratin express treatment does not last as long as a Brazilian blowout, though, so it will only last for about two months. I would definitely come back again.

I've gone here multiple times and have consistently had good food and service. Food cooked perfectly every time. I took a foodie friend (from San Fran, Nob Hill) here and he LOVED it. The scallop sashimi is one of the most amazing apps ever.  Nice selection of wine and drinks.  

As a local I'm very familiar with the food at all of the restaurants mentioned in other reviews--this restaurant is on par with them and in some aspects better.  Ambience here is hard to beat.   Not sure why some reviews here are so harsh and critical.  Maybe it's just because B.G. is the "new guy" in town? Whatever, I really like this place!

This was my first visit so I went with the steak teriyaki. It was so good but I was jealous when I saw my boyfriend's dish. He ordered the Bibimap which is pictured in the large stainless bowl. Both dishes were fantastic. Note: it gets pretty busy at lunchtime during the week so plan ahead.

This is a carnivour heaven, every rib for every taste, but be prepared to pay big.  These are not your Sizzler ribs, these are top-of the line ribs that cost as much as gold.  Well, almost. They are great, but expensive. So if you don't mind eating expensive food on the sidewalk, then this is for you.  It has a nice outdoorsey feel and families and people everywhere, hence the no seating.  I, however, would like a place to sit when I eat so if I do get ribs I bring them home. I'm not one for all the crowds and drunk people either, you can find that downtown any night of the week. I guess it's nostalgic for newcommers to the area, but I'm over it.

Made this my before work morning stop today for my daily Iced Coffee problem. Added in a parfait  as the daily baked goods were still baking. You can actually watch the pastry chef at work, which I always like. 

First, I usually sweeten my iced coffee - this was spot on and didn't need the extra. Although the lady who rang me up had her drink for the morning, and iced mocha with almond and maple... may have to try that pairing soon. Sounded delish. 

Second, the service was fantastic. The drinks were prepared quickly and everyone was personable and chatty. 

Third..ly, I can't wait to come back and sample lunch. 

There is parking around the area, don't be scared of the the parallel and take change for the metors.

This is hands down one of the only reasons I like living in Broad Ripple. There is of course a wait if you're going to brunch on the weekend, just like every other place in town, but especially due to popularity. Big deal. Totally worth the wait, quality, and genuine people on staff. It's such a cozy place if you like long, relaxed breakfasts with friends.

One of the best things about this place is the abundance of produce you get with your meals. Obviously vegetarian/vegan friendly. Thank god, something green on my plate! I hate having meals that are all starches, fried items, brown and yellow, meats AKA typical American breakfast joints. No. Give me something of nutritional value, thanks. This place does that, and the portions are generous. You WILL be full when you leave. The lemon corncakes with berry sauce featured on Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives are incredible and I always get a side of the powerhouse potatoes (garlic,onions,cheddar,salsa,tofu.) Ugh, flavor explosion. I love it this place, dearly.

I've been to Dööners several times and the food isn't super bad, but coming from Germany, I am German and grew up there, the Döner there is extremely bland and boring. The sauce, which is the best part for me in Döner stores, is completely tasteless. The meat was very dry and hard to swallow. The person working there was nice but didn't listen to anything I said and put things on my Döner that I didn't want even though I repeated myself 3 times. 
They also do not have onions, which are very traditionally on EVERY Döner anywhere else in the world, their own picture even has onions on it. They only have a onion-tomato mixture which is disgusting to someone like me who doesn't like tomatoes. 
And no A/C either, in FLORIDA! 
Lastly, the price. Usually, anywhere else, a Döner is about $6, but not here. They are trying to be super expensive with $17 for 2. And mine only had sauce and very little meat on it. I guess those prices are not going to the missing A/C......Needless to say, a waste of your money and I'd never go back there again.

Decor is classy and trendy. Staff is attentive and kind. Can't skip items on the small plate menu are the Korean fried chicken and the shrimp and pork dumplings. You will crave the fried chicken for weeks. The bibimbap rice bowls are flavorful and the portion size is generous. Haven't tried any of their large plates yet but I'm sure they are just as excellent!
Nicest folks on South Street. The pudding and the cupcakes are insanely awesome. But really...the employees are insanely wonderful. Makes all the difference.

Maxwell Cabs is like a comical tirade from a 3rd world 1960s bad comedy movie. I travel with them sometimes because there aren't many other options on the Main Line.

- Watch out if you pay by credit card. They will overcharge you and you will need to dispute it with your credit card company.
- Some of the cabs are disgusting. One of the drivers is so overweight that his chair collapsed and he lies in the cab like a human Jabba the Hutt, meaning someone can't sit behind the drivers seat.
- Some of the cabs are downright dangerous. There was a stink of gas in one and I complained to the driver, who said that there was nothing he could do and he knew about it. He then radio'd into his controller and complained. The controller was like yeah whatever shut up and keep driving. The taxi driver looked back and shrugged.
- Calling into the controller is like calling into a comedy slap down radio talk show. He will hurl abuse at you - it's kind of a bizarre black comedy.

God only knows how Maxwell is still in business - probably because people put up with them because there are few choices.
2 floors to dance with different music on both floors. Very crowded but a good time all the same. I will be going here again in the near future

We have actually ate here a total of three times this trip! They truly have something for everyone.  Staff are super friendly and accommodating   Very active at getting people in and out. On the weekends there can be quite a crowd.  Environment is clean and staff work to keep it that way.

Looking for good crayfish?.... this NOT the place. I was sorely disappointed. They were small, not spicey, flavorless ... and I had to send them back because they came out cold. I was not impressed with raw oysters, either. A real disappointment for New Orleans. On the other hand the Brussels sprouts coleslaw was quite tasty.

I booked a 60 min massage there a few days ago. I go for massages sometimes twice a month cause I'm in the construction world and there nice to have. The massage girl only massaged me for 40 min and then thought she was a chiropractor or fitness instructor cause for the last 20 min she wanted to do stretches!! Like WTF!!! I didn't pay 89.00$ plus tip to go stretches I will never go back to this place and don't recommend it to no one either. Sorry but u lost a good customer!!
I enjoyed two lemon water ice on this hot Philly day. It was perfectly refreshing, not too sweet or sour. My husband enjoyed the chocolate ice cream. I hope the New Jersey location is just as good.

I love this place. I'm a dive bar kinda guy so this place hits all the right marks for me. Small, dark, cheap drinks and laid back people. The owner is good at keeping the shitty people out and he comes in often to make sure no one is causing problems.

I have been going to this dealership to service my Toyota for the past 1.5 years. It is more convenient for me to go to a couple of other dealerships nearby but the drive is worth it!! I love the new location and the service lounge and waiting area!! Very clean and comfortable and free Wi-Fi when I need to get some business done!! Very easy to setup an appointment online. My service always gets done in a timely manner. Chris, my service advisor, takes really good care of me and makes sure the services that need to be done are done right by the service technicians in the back!!

The Pecks Smapler is a nice choice with boneless wing, mozzarella bites and fried pickles are a good starter or meal depending one your appetite. 

The spicy Thai wings are a good side item to go with the sampler

Go to Courtesy Hyundai and ASK FOR MO!!!   Momenul Akhand is a a very helpful, proficient, knowledgeable salesman.  I did my research on the vehicle that I wanted and been to a few other dealerships, but I had to "Go with Mo".  Mo made sure that we got the best price that we could get, with no pressure to buy at all.  I have bought a few vehicles in my life and this experience was by far the best.  Thanks Mo, I will be back to buy all my future vehicles.

I have been coming here for many years. I have never had a bad experience. Love the Key Lime Martini & the view of the bay is gorgeous. The band's are always rockin' & the bartenders are always slingin' drinks! The food is good, I always stick with the fish sandwich and you can never go wrong with the raw oysters.  What's not to like!!!

Cheers.....Kimberly Parker (Atlanta)

Horrible horrible horrible. Never go here. My husband, 2 kids and i went to the drive through because we had gift cards. The ordering was fine. Then we were in line for over 30 minutes and stuck because there were cars in front and behind of us. Also there is a concrete barrier on either side of you. So while we were waiting, we saw food finally getting handed to the people in front of us. I saw what my son had ordered and even commented to my husband that i bet that was my son's food. It was a tall truck so we could see what the people in the cab were doing. We saw them go through the food. They went through everything then handed everything back through the window. I saw the worker set the food down on the counter. Finally that customer got their food. When it was our turn,  we drove up to the window and the worker handed us that same food. The same food that had been sitting there for the past 10 minutes and that was in another person's car and other people's hands had gone through. I said i knew it was old food and i saw what he had done.....so he yelled and huffed at me. Needless to say....i drove off. I will not ever go back there. Disgusting!!!!!!

I've always thought the idea of apple on a sandwich (that didn't involve peanut butter) as completely preposterous, because sweet things do not belong on sandwiches!  

So what did I order at The Bricks?  Naturally, the Bird and Pig - which features chicken, bacon, apple, brie and agave nectar.   It was definitely sweet.  And savory.  And absolutely, positively to die for.  I loved every scrumptious bite of it.... except for the dry chicken breast.  I'm not sure if it was just old, but either way it was dry and disappointing.

Next on the menu was the deluxe grilled cheese sandwich, which was all sorts of yummy cheese, smothering delicious garden fresh basil (wow!), spinach and tomato.   The first bite of this sandwich was knock-your-socks-off.  The basil really stands out and it definitely warranted an audible moan.  The next few bites weren't as spectacular, but I still loved the sandwich.  I'd go with the Bird and Pig again if I had to choose.

While we waited, we treated our faces to black bean dip (suggested by the waiter) and we enjoyed it.  If you like black bean dip, then you'll like this one.  

We washed all of that down with a glass of liquid heroin, and all was right with the world.

The end.

Oh, and the service - spot on.  The place is cute, the staff is attentive, and it's clear this place easily doubles as a comfy daytime spot and a lovely night spot - if that's your kinda thing.

Great location to sit and watch the streetcars pass by!  Super friendly staff, our waitress sat and chatted with us like old friends!  
Full bar, if you're craving bloody marys, or anything else!
A friend and I had breakfast before work at Cafe at The Square.  We were immediately please by how clean and just adorable the restaurant is.  Our server rocked, and most importantly our food was SOOO GOOD!  Like so good you know you should've stopped three bites ago, but cant stop, then you find yourself in a food coma for hours!
I def look forward to returning, maybe on a weekend so I can try out the bar!

Love this place! The espresso drinks are well crafted. The baked goods are solid. The ambiance is simple and clean, an excellent environment to chat with friends or use the free wifi. The service is good and friendly. The place makes the neighborhood better. On top of this, it's local.

Asked someone on a street if they knew of a rooftop bar and they sent us here. We loved it! Got a seat at the bar right away and ordered drinks immediately. We ended up ordering dessert and WOW! The warm vanilla cake was to die for. An absolute must.

Quick shout outs - our server, Jordan, worked really hard to make our meal enjoyable.  He was prompt and responsive and my family and I really appreciated his effort.

Now to the review - the food was pretty good, when it came out correct...We are vegetarian and ordered the Brussel sprouts (without bacon), two pizzas (margharita and potato) and one pasta (arrabiata).  When the person brought the Brussel sprouts to the table, she said there was no meat...but in my first bite I had a piece of bacon. Definitely disappointed from that experience.  Luckily they paid extra attention to the rest of our order and made sure everything was correct.  I think the kitchen at this place is very overwhelmed...

This actually leads to the main reason for the 2-star review.  We made a reservation for 6 at 7:30p.  When we got there at 7:25p they told us that the had 2 other parties of 6 that needed to be seated before us and the kitchen was running behind.  We said that we had a reservation but apparently so did the other parties.  Why in the world would they book three reservations at the same time when they clearly didn't have the space/ability to accommodate?! We heard similar comments about why even make a reservation from most of the people waiting in the waiting area.  When we finally got seated...30 mins after our reservation...it was at a make shift table that was extremely tight without sufficient space for all our plates. 

The food was the redeeming quality for my experience.  My brother said that he had a similar experience the last time he came here for dinner.  Eventually the negative experience is going to outweigh the quality of food...and I feel that's going to happen pretty quick. They need to figure something out to turn around the service, and fast.
Best vape shop around.  The staff is awesome and their specials rock.  They got the juice and the mods you want.  Trust Fam.

I have been buying CD's at Sound Exchange for years.  Selection is vast, and prices are reasonable. A knowledgeable staff, many who have been there for years, will help you with anything.  Recently, they helped promote my local musical and even donated a few CD's.  Support independent record shops!

Tacos are great and excellent value!  Owners are very nice and engaging.  Fast friendly service. 

$2 tacos are filling and tasty.  Chops and salsa are excellent as well.  I will be making this my go-to taco joint!

What is going on with this place? Always short-staffed, and remaining staff is surly in the weekday mornings. Today (Sunday) I went there after church, and they're not even open. Handwritten sign on the door says, "Sorry. Open at 10:00". Disappointing.

Went here for the first time recently. The Taiwanese beef noodle soup was amazing. Haven't had one this good in so long. The broth was rich and flavorful, the noodles were homemade and had a great chew and the bit of picked vegetables tied it together perfectly. Scallion pancakes were also excellent. Took some dumplings and 3 cups chicken home. Dumplings were so so. 3 cups chicken had a great sauce but be prepared for bones-it's basically thighs chopped into small pieces which Americans who are not used to chewing through things like us chinese may not be used to. Get the beef noodle soup, you will not be disappointed.

Went to Fleming Friday the service was great. Oscar took great care of us. The main course was great with the exception of the rubbery baked potato served to us. That changed the rating from 5 stars to 4 stars. Skip the baked potato when you go there.

I feel real fortunate to have had this as a stop on a recent bus excursion; as during my only other SB visit we went right to the mission and blew outta town.
As the pics show, this really an architectural gem I envy the folks working here daily to deliver justice.  Don't miss going to the top of the tower !

I went here with some friends for quizzo, and I was really pleased.  The beer list covers a wide range of tastes, and the prices are reasonable given the area.  The happy hour was pretty awesome too.  

Some friends and I shared some appetisers along with our beers.  I had a few bites of the guac and fell in love.  The chips are fresh and delicious.  The pizzas have super-thin crust that is almost cracker-like, which i really enjoy when i'm having a few beers.  I hate that too-much-crust + wheat beer feeling.  I tried a slice of the margarita pizza, and a slice of the mushroom pizza.  They were both phenomenal.  The margarita was so simple, yet tasty while the mushroom had this amazing truffle oil taste that gets me every time.  The only complaint i have is that they cut the pies weird.  If you want a middle slice, it's a commitment!  If you get an end piece, you're lucky the crust isn't doughy.  I'd come back here for sure!

It will not let me give less than one star.  This place is the worst. I have been to Denny's all across this country and this one is the WORST. The service is atrocious at best. The " people " are ??? I will die before I ever set foot in this place again. UNBELIEVABLE. DID I SAY IT IS THE WORST DENNY'S I HAVE EVER BEEN TO!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

This place is the jam! It's simple, well-curated aesthetic is pleasing to the frenetic mind. The coffee is outstanding! But the staff may be the best part. I was helped without that how-dare-you-not-be-a-coffee-snob vibe that can typify many coffee shops. The owners are down to earth, caring people that have added value to their community.

My BFF and I were in town for different events and wanted to grab some breakfast. I've been here a few times and she hadn't but I knew she would love the biscuits and gravy. She ordered The Montana Plate and I ordered the Surrey's Egg Plate. Both dishes were awesome and we finished all of our food! (No judgement!) There is always a wait at Surrey's, but not longer than 30 mins. Tom was our waiter and the service was great!

Today I enjoyed lunch with one of my Sweetest Friends/Sisters (she's a foodie too). @hendelscafe was her suggestion and it was perfect! First of all, I love that this historic little building is tucked away in a residential neighborhood and the restaurant is absolutely beautiful inside and out. We shared the Crab Stuffed Mushrooms (not for those that do not Garlic), she had Fish Tacos, and I had the Salmon BLT (salmon and bun were fresh, soft, and flavorful). And of course we couldn't leave without sharing dessert: Salted Carmel Cake... I am not sure who their distributor is but I will seriously be stalking someone about that cake! Everything was delicious and on top of that, our service was great! #stlmetrofoodie

Went early on a Wednesday night between the holidays and it got packed quick. Wait staff was wonderful constantly looking for what you needed refilled. 
I asked the waiter for chicken Marsala oddly not on the menu since the veal was. It is a simple dish that I use to compare Italian restaurants. Should have went with the veal, as they did not know how to prepare the chicken. It must have come out of the freezer and they forgot to tenderize it. 
Shrimp scampi was good, as was the salad. 
We had a group of six celebrating our kids engagement so they sharply provided a large serving of tiramisu which they make in-house and was worth the meal. 
The bill was a bit of shock at $45 per, but you pay for the nice ambience.
Not that great tasting food.  Gulab jamun is the saving grace of otherwise very average tasting food

Named after a former town mayor, this park includes gazebos with picnic tables and rusty iron barbecues, a children's playground, a softball diamond, and a two-mile hiking/jogging/biking trail that encricles a freshwater lake well-stocked for fishing. What I found most surprising was the vast number of towering pines, a tree I always have associated with northern climates. There's some spectacular birdlife here - during our stroll, we saw several egrets and a number of attractive species I was unable to identify - and the squirrels are friendly enough to eat out of your hand. Walking too close to the water's edge could be dangerous, as alligators lurk in the thick vegetation just off-shore. It may get crowded on weekends, but on a Tuesday afternoon it was the perfect place to escape for some peaceful solitude.

What a wonderful hidden gem!   This is a very unique bywater dive.  You would never realize it from the outside though!  When you walk in there are many of bottles of wine to choose from at retail price (you can also buy a few by the glass). 

Simply pick your bottle.  Head to the refrigerators on the left side and grab what cheese and meats you'd like. Head to the counter to pay.  (They take credit cards at this counter, but only cash out back when the chef is there).  They will plate your cheese for you and bring out w/ olives and wonderful bread.   Continue out back with your wine and glasses and find a unique table and set of chairs in their large backyard area. 

They have a small stage and feature live music and also have a chef with a changing menu that comes in to cook outside. I didn't try any of the food- but I heard it was great.  

I will definitely make it back here often as it reminds me of Austin!

The young man with the very large eyebrows, almost like caterpillars, he was very kind. He helped me pick what i wanted, choosing between the island bowl and the cocoa almond bowl. I chose the cocoa almond. Although it was very loud and i could barely hear in there the food was totally worth it. It was really hot and i was uncomfortable sitting inside and had to take my bowl to-go.  Overall my experience was great and would definitely recommend my out of town friends to visit!

I'm on the fence about Edison's...the reason being is the set up. While I think it's awesome that they can accommodate people of all ages, I think there needs to be a separation of bar area to the entertainment area. With the number of small children running around, it's not unlikely that they've overheard conversations or seen the mannerism of adults drinking. Upon our visit there, I observed a group of younger men being loud and vulgar towards the entrance of the bar which isn't far from the rest of the gaming or bowling area. I was also told by our friend that the bathrooms which are also used by children had vomit from which I assume was an adult having a little too much to drink.

Food: while refillable beverages is a plus, I thought the food was lacking. I ordered their version of the sampler and after ordering chicken fingers, the dip, and the potato skins and I think I'll stray away from this next time we go. I'm not sure if our waitress was new or just uninformed/not familiar with the menu. I've worked in the food business for over 8 years and knowing the menu and the size of the portions is key. I'm honest when I say that in every restaurant that I've worked in that I've tried everything on the menu...that way I know how it looks when it comes to the window, how to describe the tastes, and suggesting food to new customers. The potato skins where average, the chicken tenders were not the size anticipated giving the waitresses description, and I was disappointed by the chips and their version of queso dip. The queso dip serving dish was the equivalent of a serving dish that you would get when you asked for a side of ranch and it wasn't even full. You could tell that the dip wasn't heated up to full temp because the top layer had already begun to harden when it came out. The chips were WAY over salted. I mistakenly picked up one that had the underside covered in a layer of salt and was simply inedible, good thing they give you an over sized portion of chips to accompany the small portion of salsa. The food lacked for me. As far as the rest of the establishment it was what you would expect games, laser tag, and bowling. My only complaint was the bowling lanes not being oiled properly. 

Overall, this is a great place, but I think some adjustments need to be made to accommodate everyone comfortably. During the day this would be a great place to hold a children's birthday party.
Obsessed with this place. Food was amazing ! Service was amazing ! Everyone in the Philadelphia area has to go check this place out ASAP!

I went there for the first night they were open to the public.  I was alone and sat at the bar.  The service was very good, especially considering it was their first night.  I started with the Panzanella salad, which was a big disappointment.  It was a very nice green salad with giant croutons, which is not a Panzanella salad.  My main course was the gnocchi in a braised beef tomatoes sauce.  It was excellent, although I missed the little ridge in the gnocchi.  I had two glasses of the house red which was very good,  They offer multiple pour sizes.  The tab came to about $40, which I thought was a little steep.  All in all a good first night.  They said they would  fix the Panzanella.
Love love this salon. My friend is the owner and she is one of the best nail tech I know. She gets me right every time. AndEveryone here is so friendly and the vibe is really chill.

I am writing to express my disappointment in customer service at your Charlottes Pike (Nashville, TN) location.  On this Monday evening I had to wait in line for nearly 10 minutes to ring myself up in the self check-out.  This line extended 8-10 people long, creating obstructing traffic in that area for still-shopping customers.  The story was similar for the two other registers open that were "regular" check outs.  There too the lines extended into open aisles and the departments nearby. Recognizing that the store could benefit from having another few registers opened I called the store on my cell-phone and asked to speak to the manager on duty.  Here I was put on hold for more than 10 minutes.  By this time I had decided I would return my whole purchase.  I have shared my experience with families and friends.  I will also share my disappointment through any other means so others will know not to shop at this location.
 In sharing my experience, it is also my hope that others will see how my story is little different than their experiences at your other stores and they might elect to not step foot in another Wal-Mart again. Having worked in retail management, I understand that a retailer's greatest opportunity for reducing costs is by managing payroll hours.  Finding a balance between a customer's needs for an associate and the store's need to remain profitable is essential for a company to be successful.  However, this argument is strengthened only when employees are paid fair wages and provide appropriate benefits.  It is no secret that your company makes little effort to provide these for your employees.  As a consequence, your continued lack of customer associates at the registers perplexes me.  There must be more effective ways of reducing costs.  I have had some time and thought of some ways you can ensure continued profitability and reduced costs of operation.  Perhaps, some of the savings could lead to better pay and treatment for your employees  (Just kidding...we know that's not a priority).
1. Disconnect all of the lights in all of the stores.  Most everyone has a Smartphone with a flashlight on it.  The store lights are redundant.
2. Don't wash or wax the floors.  With the lights off, who is going to notice anyway?  Additionally, the stickiness of the floor will make a sound so in the event a poor sap doesn't have a flashlight on their phone, they'll be able to hear the customers walking around them preventing any collisions.
3. Eliminate large signage hanging from the ceilings.  The flashlight on my iPhone won't shine that far anyway.
4.  Get rid of the automatic doors.  Not only will this save money chain-wide but it will also help with loss-prevention.  Should a person shoplift, they will be forced to touch some part of the door, providing us with finger prints.
5.  Get rid of the customer service desk.  Come on, should we really continue pretending we "care" about the customers?  I know you are probably wondering how to deal with customer returns.  Simple: Caveat emptor.  
 These are all for now.  I have a bunch more but as a consultant, this is all I will provide for free.  Please let me know when you'd like to talk further about these and other ideas.

Chef Josh Besh's shrimp and grits was pretty amazing. This is just one of the many places he operates in New Orleans and a must if you are in town for some signature dishes.  Their lunch menu was fantastic. The person next to me got some kind of a grilled cheese with corn beef and a fried egg on the top, calling chef Besh creative is an understatement.
What a great tasting deal for the family meal. We officially are fans of their chicken wings and onion rings also. Will try to have the shakes next. Burgers were definitely bigger than a slider.
This place is awesome!   The employees are friendly and it's like everybody knows your name if you're a regular.  So many food options to choose from especially for "4th meal" and beyond.
Delicious authentic Japanese food.  Generous portions and VERY reasonable prices. Clean. bright dining room and friendly prompt service.   Couldn't ask for more.

This is my type of bar.

Everything from the tap list, to the shared apps, to the music was Excellent. The servers seemed a bit "resistant" at first, but after they warmed up to us I realized they were just hipsters and slightly introverted. That's fine with me, and works perfectly with the vibe.

Only knock is that the neighborhood seems slightly sketchy.. But being in town for business I guess I can't really say. Most of Philly seemed slightly sketch! Would absolutely return.

My oil change monitor showed the car to be two thirds full after they did extensive work and an oil change.  So I took it back to them. They looked at the monitor and said its not that low, put in some oil and complained that I brought it back. So I drove home and looked at the oil monitor again and it was still only two thirds full! I checked under the vehicle to see if there was some kind of leak?  No leaks. So I went to an auto parts store bought a couple of quarts and put in a quart. Now I checked the monitor and it showed it was full.  Nothing wrong with the car they just shorted me a quart and even after taking it back obviously didn't put much in. You might get a price break here but if their work isn't right don't take it back because they won't be happy that you did.  Maybe they were just having a bad day!

By far the best Thai food in Santa Barbara! The panang curry, curry noodles, garlic chicken, chicken satay and sizzling platter are all delicious. Before I found this place, I had given up on Thai food here, but this rivals any place I have eaten at in LA. Great price for what you get as well. This is definitely one of my favorite restaurants in SB.

Closer to 3.5 stars.

Just had this for lunch.

The place was nice looking and clean.

The staff was really friendly.

I paid 15.99 for a fire quacker duck burger and some sweet fries.

The burger itself was a little smaller than I had anticipated.  It wasn't as flavorful as I thought it was going to be either.  It wasn't even remotely spicy.  The duck was cooked very well though and tasted good.  I've had better sweet fries.  

I think I will try this place again though, I really want to try the duck bacon or brisket on a burger.

I rented a trailer last week and the trailer was broken. They realized this and set me up with a different trailer and did all of the paper work without me in the building. When I return the trailer, I notice a $60 charge for the insurance (I did not choose the insurance on the initial trailer). I called and the girl told me that the general manager would call me back and refund the money. He never called, and I had to call 3 different numbers before getting ahold of him. When I finally did talk to him, he was VERY rude and told me that the insurance was an option that I had to have picked. VERY POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE. Charles Short, the GM, needs a lesson in customer service.

Great atmosphere but service is far from being acceptable. The waitstaff hangs out at the bar talking to themselves rather than serving their customers. Hard to say I'd return when customer satisfaction is far from their goals.
I can't order anything besides the California burrito and the carne asada quesadillas, because those are too good to not order every time I go.

I love this hotel. I would stay here agin if I came back to Philly and recommend it to anyone coming in. It has lovely hardwood floors and huge vaulted ceilings making it feel like I'm staying in the lap of luxury. Bathroom works for me. It has a microwave, fridge, and Keirug and the offer complimentary continental breakfast room service. It's also in a nice neighborhood close to lots of restaurants and bars. Noise was not an issue for me.

This place was great.  The best cocktails I had in New Orleans, and great small plates of food.  It's on the fancy side, but not obnoxiously so (hellooo Sazerac bar).
If you love great cocktails, this is the one place you should not miss in New Orleans.

This place gets zero stars. We went into this place for dinner this evening. We were told by the waitresses as we passed the pizza counter to sit anywhere in the dining room. We sat down and reviewed their menu. We waited 10 minutes while the wait staff just bullshited at the counter. No one approached us to offer to take our drink order or even acknowledged our presence. We got up and walked out! We'll never step into this place or every order any food from Lascala Pronto Pizza.

I love this place and the wonderful people that work here! They make my dog feel so loved, which makes the entire experience nice for both my dog and I.   My little guy always walks out looking amazing and better than I could have ever expected. Whether it's a basic touch up or getting rid of terrible mats, the staff does a perfect job!

Always amazing.
Great food served by lovely ladies!
Whether you're Gluten free or not, the food is delicious.
I eat here everyday... And am reluctant to let too many people know how good it is! ;)

Was greated warmly by the employees. I went at an odd time so I was able to just relax by myself in the shop. I got a taro bubble tea. I love me some taro so it's hard to screw it up haha good place would go again :)

I've gone to several yoga studios in town and Mesa Yoga is my favorite.  I love the great yoga classes taught my Courtney, she is knowledgeable, friendly and does a well-balanced variety of postures.  I also love the heat; it is not too hot - just warm enough to give you a nice sweat without making you want to bolt from the room.   The studio is beautiful and well equipped and the attitude is laid back and happy. I also like it that a variety of types of people enjoy the studio, you don't feel like you have to be a yogi pro to take the classes.  And the classes are a good duration, an hour to an hour and fifteen minutes which is great for a busy schedule or when you don't want to overdo it.

I went there and my answers were answered. I was looking to inquire about the Oranda goldfish and a young lady helped me with all my questions. She gave me advice on how to prepare before I got my Orandas and because of that, she saved me time and money. Also, I like how the fish were set up.

I couldn't help, but to buy a cute blue Betta on my way out. By the way, I named him Cicero. I will definitely be back soon to get my Orandas. I gave them 4 stars because they didn't have a small animal section, my little one wanted a hamster, but as soon as it comes I will give them 5 stars.

Menu offered a great variety and selection  
Service was excellent and followup consistent and frequent .   The clam chowder was piping hot and flavorful.  The fish was light and flakey but a little too much oil still on it.  The fries were good but I prefer a little crisper.  The surprise was three onion rings on top that were perfection.
Too full for desert, but very attractive pies and cakes as well as a few other choices.
Next time!!!
I recommend Hollywood Grill and don't think you will be disappointed.

I received an email for a discounted blow out so i booked it. Ive been here a couple times before but that was over two years ago. which i guess is unfortunate because the woman who used to do my hair would've known what to do and how and, most importantly, been pleasant about it. and when i say, "what to do and how" i mean: blow dry my hair and not be a jerk about my hair being curly and thick. I'm black, you cannot call yourself a professional hair stylist if you see a black woman with a head full of curls and think, "oh dear god." lets just say with the look on her face, she'd fail at poker. she repeatedly asked if ALL i wanted was a simple blow out without the flat iron or styling. i repeatedly said yes, thats all i wanted and i said that I've received only blow outs before. she said in a condescending warning tone that my hair would be fuzzy and frizzy without the sealing of a flat iron. and she'd say it like this, "you have a lot of hair and body and a flat iron is the only way to get rid of that." last i checked, people pay thousands of dollars to get the kind of hair that i just have naturally. a few times the dryer came to close and i naturally flinched. after one flinch she said in an incredibly mean tone, "are you hurting when I'm trying to blow out the roots of your cuuuuurrrly hair?" it was the weirdest exchange I've ever had. this isn't my first time at the blow out rodeo. usually if theres a too close/flinch moment the stylist says a quick sorry or excuse me and its nothing. 

about a third of the way in the blow out process i think she began to realize her stereotypical expectations were off. because she was a lot quieter. when she was done she made a comment that i needed a trim and i said i probably do. 

when i checked out i made sure to tip her because she performed the labor i wanted and i'm an honest patron. plus, honestly, i did it out of spite bc i knew she wasn't expecting that.  but, i won't be going back there again.
Best traditional Vietnamese in the city of New Orleans.

The ribeye (medium) was amazing! Seriously so big I highly recommend splitting I couldn't even finish my half 
Butter mushrooms were also very good, not crazy about the ceaser salad but still was good. Overall, I would recommend to try if you come to Nola!

I stayed at this location the week of July 4th. The visit was amazing. Everything in the hotel was nice and clean. We were promptly greeted and assisted with our luggage upon arrival. The room was very nice with a bay view and we could also see the pool area. This room had one of the largest televisions that I have ever seen in a hotel room. I didn't order any food or drinks from the hotel on this stay so I can't comment on that part of the service. The environment is very family friendly and it is so easy to take a drive to Clearwater beach. My only complaint about the hotel is that the cleaning staff will only leave 2 washcloths in your room regardless of how many guests you have. It was 3 of us and I would have to call each day to get an additional washcloth. I had also requested that the sheets be changed one day by leaving a note with a $5. The note and money was gone but the same old sheets were on the bed. Other than that, my experience was nothing short of amazing.
Great little sushi place, first one in this area and people LOVE it. Pretty good prices. A couple menu items are a bit overpriced in my opinion but overall definitely still worth it!

The reviews of this truck are right on the money.  His sandwiches and platters are well worth the money and they smell, look and taste unbelievable.  They owner is funny and loves to tell you how great his food is and how long it takes for him to prepare his "quality" ingredients.  But he is telling the truth.  Not only the best food truck, but easily one of the best places to eat lunch in the city.
Food was okay for a bar. Medium size establishment. Doesn't seem to be a bad place for a quick drink after work.
this restaurant is listed as takka a's on eat24. anyway, the beef pepperoni pizza is delicious. I will be ordering from them again. the delivery time was good.

Awful service. I am a loyal customer and they kept me waiting almost 2 goes for my pizza. I get 30minutes but when I called at the hour mark they acted like it was on its way and lied to me when you could tell it wasn't even in the oven.

I even called this place multiple times, no apology for taking forever, no problems with leaving the customer in the dark about a simple pizza.

When it finally arrived it was completely wrong. Called three HQ and got the run around. I didn't rip anyone a new asshole nor did I demand anything, just wanted to pass along the poor service. 

Go someplace else for pizza, these bums aren't worth it. Their manager is usually pretty cool, he must not work their anymore.

So impressed by the great customer service and follow up by this company!   Prompt, efficient and courteous service.    I had several issues and all were addressed calmly and efficiently.   The technician called me to ask questions about my needs to be sure that he did exactly what I needed.    I had a portable hard drive which didn't work any more and my laptop's drive was broken.   They put all data on another hard drive per my request and I was able to have it back just two days.    It was during Christmas too!     It takes a lot to impress me and Fixit Computer & Phone Repair did so.     Trustworthy and great customer service!     Hopefully I will have no computer issues anytime soon, but I know where to go if necessary.   A big thank you to the entire team!

It was extremely busy when we came on Saturday. It took about an hour to order and receive our donuts with how many people were there. You get an order form and can pick what donuts you want. They have some set donuts or you can do all custom. Despite the fact that they were packed, everyone was moving as fast as they could and they were all super polite. It was worth the wait! We absolutely loved the donuts! They were delicious and we will definitely be back.

Luke was my first meal in NOLA and the start of an entire week of eating.  WOW.  Everything was amazing.  I had the seafood gumbo (which I had to ask around the table if they also agreed that it was good) and it was best gumbo I had the entire week. Also had the shrimp etoufee and housemade sausages which were also yummy.

I agree that I have seen members not wipe down the equipment, unfortunately. The people who sit texting on the machines is frustrating. I don't feel judgment walking in the door,  which is the second reason I go; the first is price. I like the fact that there are people of all sizes and ages. Yes there are the few people there looking to find  a date, but I just go in get my work out done and leave. I haven't been to other locations to compare it to.

I've been to In Riva many times for lunch and dinner.  I like coming here more for lunch than dinner.  For dinner, I like a more intimate, dark atmosphere.  I've enjoyed a very diverse crowd every time I've frequented In Riva.  Whenever I'm here I have one of their  pizza's (they're all good) and a drink (the cocktails are phenomenal, and the beer selection). My favorite pizzas are the sausage with peppers and the margarita.  

 The location, atmosphere, and service are great. If you happen to be going into Center City or leaving...it's a welcomed break from the traffic (they have a free parking lot, which I have a love hate relationship with).  I've never had a problem finding parking, regardless. As for the small plates, salads, or the very popular pea soup...They are all either too salty, smokey, or both for my liking. I think It might be a good idea for In Riva to list which plates will complement each other, especially since you can pick three for a fixed price.  Overall, I'm a big fan.

Simply terrible.  

The server brought the sodas out after our food, then got both orders wrong.  Normally, I wouldn't care, however....
She brings back my burger and tells me there wasn't onion on it in the first place.  I lift the bun up and it's the same burger and the marks from the onions were still on it.  Shoulda seen her face when she was caught in her lie.  Really unapologetic, too.  And it's not like it was even busy.  Probably 3 tables were occupied in the whole place.  TERRIBLE.  DO NOT GIVE THIS PLACE BUSINESS.

This is the go-to place of a friend and I can see why. We ordered the scallop app and the meatball app. Would have preferred one more of each in the serving, but probably because they were SO good. Our Margherita pizza was one of the best I've had. We opted not to drink on a school night (lol) so it kept the bill down. I look forward to going back and sitting on the patio next time.

It's been a while since I've been to KFC but I'm glad I came to the Goleta location. Very clean, Nice people behind the counter...and even was given a recommendation and a coupon to reduce the cost of my purchase by almost $10.00 Very happy and the all around experience and the my order was ready by the time I filled my large drink#winning

I love my dentist. Now, that is obviously a strange statement but it's true. I love my dentist and I love going to the dentist and I'm not afraid to say it. 

We have all had that horrific experience with the really crappy dentist who jabs our gums and scrapes with the force of a marine sergeant. There is absolutely no need for this brutality and I find it hard to believe that it is somehow beneficial in the long run. 

I have been to Dr. Dodd for a couple of years now and I have absolutely no complaints. I am vigilant about the dentist (as I don't want to be a toothless old lady) and visit every six months like clockwork and always get anything that is necessary taken care of. The offices are clean with a great music selection of neo-soul and jazz. The dentist is a huge jazz and art fan and much of the office is covered in art (some his own) and a massive jazz inspired mural. Dr. Dodd usually only sees you for the big stuff (ie. cavities, etc.) but the hygienists I have seen each time are unbelievable - every one. I have stopped asking for a particular one as I find the entire staff to be phenomenal. 

If your insurance covers it, go to Dr. Dodd. He will take care of you and you will leave with a big, sparkling smile!
Love this place. The family and staff are very very friendly. You have to go. Especially Thursdays the chicken livers are great.

We experienced J. Gilbert's for the first time last night to celebrate our wedding anniversary.  What a perfect evening!  Our waiter, Ken, was friendly and attentive and guided us to make the best choices on the menu.  The filet was the best steak we have ever had (better even than Ruth's Chris) and the scallops were absolutely amazing!  The blackberry lemonade martini was exceptional as well.  We cannot say enough good about the service, atmosphere, food and dining experience.  We cannot wait to return (and we'll definitely be asking to be seated in Ken's section!).  Thank you, J. Gilbert's, for the fantastic evening!

Ever time I came toNew Orleans I come to this place to relax and have a glass or two. It's a Members only place in which you can have a wonderful dinner. It's close to the House of blues  just some doors down. Dress code no open toe shoes but casual. The Foundation room is a very sexy place therefore I like to dress accordingly.

Food was good and the portions large. I would definitely say its more like the style of food you would order at a Mexican restaurant as opposed to Qdoba or Chipotle. everything definitely tastes fresh as well. That said, I would say that Chipotle compares in the quality department but the styles are a little bit different is all. I think you would just have to decide who has the toppings or flavors you prefer if you had this place next to a Chipotle. That said, it definitely stands above Qdoba. They are definitely fast and convenient. Wish they had a few more drink choices though. Prices are fair. I do like that they had fresh diced jalapeno which the other chains definitely don't.

Classic old school train station that has Amtrak, Septa and NJ Transit trains.   I love it purely because of the architecture, not everyday you walk in a room that large.   I used to be here everyday because of commuting to my old job so now when I visit, I get pure joy out of nostalgia.
The wings were so small and super salty. The wing size was about the side of two quarters laying side by side. Very disappointed.

The food is fine but the staff, oh the staff. I asked for sauce and was told they charge for it. The young lady looked at me like I was trying to rip her off, took my 27 cents and reluctantly fetched one packet of sauce. Maybe I'm strange but I don't like paying to be treated like a looser.
Well I guess I kindles liked it but just not really but here's my comment OMG I rather eat at McDonald's
Good Mex and other good stuff that makes you happy in your belly.
Friendly, albeit incompetent, customer service. Falsely advertised free diagnostics online ($40). Slow slow slow to complete the requested work.

We tried this place out for dinner on Saturday night based on a recommendation. The food was amazing. We liked it so much that we came back the next morning (ish) for brunch! They knocked it out of the park again! Don't be scared of the label of vegan. Even meat eaters would love this place. The service is top notch, and all the employees are very friendly. The owner came around to ask how the food was, and didn't even tell us he was the owner (very modest).They even recommended places to go to watch the Olympics. I can't say enough positive things about this restaurant. The only negative is that as they get more popular (no doubt they will) and we will have to wait for a table! Shout out to Jenny, Ryan, and Ian for 2 amazing meals with an unrivaled atmosphere! We will be back!

Tonight my father and I went to Megu and we sat at the bar. The bar was very clean and fancy. The sushi chef was very nice and happy which I like to see when I go to restaurants.  We placed our order which consisted of Yellowfin tuna roll, Yellowfin tuna sashimi, Spider Roll, Spicy Tuna Roll, Surf Clam sushi, and live scallop. All the food was to die for especially the Spicy Yellowfin Tuna Roll it was my favorite Roll my only problem was that the surf clam was chewy but it was still flavorful. The Spider Roll was to die for since it was super crispy. Also it blended well with the other ingredients. The sashimi was like butter since it melted in your mouth and that goes with the scallop sushi too. And it also was a little pricey but at least it was fresh so it doesn't really matter. Other than that I'd recommend for whomever is reading this to go here and order when I had. So I'd easily go here again and again!
Really good breakfast!!  Nice stroll off the beaten path to a neighborhood with beautiful architecture!  Large portions; great, friendly service!
You can't believe the choices in hot chocolate you can get there and all so yummy on a cold winter day.  Not too sweet the drink hits the spot.  Wish it wasn't so cold, I would have had ice cream.

This room was incredibly comfortable. We got in late and were greeted with warm cookies and the sweetest lady at the front desk. When we got to our room they were clean and the beds were so comfortable. The next morning we went to the pool which was extremely clean. The hotel was also right next to a casino and some awesome outlet stores. I definitely recommend staying here.

I do happy hour here pretty regularly. It's near work and there is outdoor seating, a key element for this time of the year. There's good people watching and most of the wait staff is pretty good. Shout out to Armando--you rock!! He was my server last night and was good enough that I'll be remembering to ask for him next time. That's a first. 

The happy hour prices are very reasonable, as long as you aren't too picky about what you're drinking. It's pretty much Coors Light, Yuengling, House Wine etc. but it's do-able. I prefer something a little more original.

SO, their White Sangria is fabulous if you are picking something off of the regular drink menu. Food-wise the Risotto Balls are a decent option off of the HH menu and I enjoy the Margherita Pizza as well.

Every time I see this food truck I get same thing. The curds with chipotle ranch. So. Good. Why only 4/5 stars you ask? Well the price is a bit steep and sometimes when they are at festivals and what not, their dipping sauces aren't available. However they can pretty much guarantee at least one sale if they are nearby my location at the time. Beware as this will really decrease your positive opinion of mozzarella sticks.

My prefered mexican restaurant in the Avon area. Consistantly good food and service. Their salsa and chips are particularly tasty, and its easy to eat too many and be near full before the main course arrives.

For the pipe smokers out there;

I am neither a cigar, nor frequent cigarette smoker. What I am is "that F(@*&!% hipster!" bobbing and weaving through traffic and pedestrians in center city on a bicycle with a corn cob hanging out of his mouth. It is rare to find a shop, even a "smoke" shop with pipe tobacco of quality surpassing drugstore brands like Captain Black. Places with quality tins like Dunhill or Davidoff are a rarity, I can only think of a single other place in Philadelphia that has them. Places with exotic tins like flake, or actual St. James Perique blending tobacco are almost unheard of, I know of two other places in the area (and by that I mean NY and NJ) that stocks things like that.

This place, was a first though. I love a good English blend, and the more Latakia the better. I looked around for a little bit and saw the usual suspects in tin tobaccos like Elizabethan when a man asked me if I could be helped. I told him exactly what I was looking for, a Latakia heavy  English blend. Not only did the guy not look at me like I was speaking Afrikaans to him he was more than passingly familiar with pipe tobacco. He took me over to their loose blends, which I typical avoid out of habit, since in my experience they're often stale and crappy bulk buys off the internet in a fancy jar. He pointed out a mixture and told me they blend it there.

Wut? I said, with a preposterous look on my face.

What a blend. What a price. It was fragrant, spicy, and fresh. Virginias, Orientals and a heavy hit of Syrian. Exactly what an English blend should be. Exactly what I was looking for, and most importantly he knew it. Finding people TRULY familiar with tobacco in this day and age, especially pipe tobacco, is incredible. To find ones that are so familiar they blend on premises AND get it right is insanity.

Six stars if I could. Can not praise them enough.

Went there for lunch and the place must have changed owners and chefs. The food got bland and the staff has been replaced with slow and sloppy staff. Our waiter brought me a cup of water with a tiny rock and spilled sauce all over my backpack. 

The sandwiches are still a good deal but the vermicelli Bun bowl is mediocre. I will now be returning there.
I tried to call in an order to go and was decline to do so because they no longer take call in orders after 11 and when I asked when did this start he said a few months back very disappointed.

I really wish I was still in college because Edgehill Cafe would be my study spot!  With large tables, wifi and a calm atmosphere Edgehill makes a great location to get some work done or have a nice breakfast.  I've been in a few times, to work or eat.  
I liked working at the previous location better because of the bar table along the windows made me feel like I was not taking up any room and could work as long as I wanted.  The new location has a long table in the middle but I felt bad taking up a spot when there was a wait to eat.  I go at off peak times when I want to work.  
Overall- great food and drinks.  The staff is super nice and quick to get anything you need.

Celebrated an event here with my Significant Other. Enjoyed the house special of the day, which was a Lionfish appetizer that was expertly prepared.

Our choice of entrees were well prepared, seasoned and served hot by our attentive and friendly waitress. We enjoyed the Pulled Slow Braised Short Rib Fat Noodle dish and Bouillabaisse of Seafood dishes.

Our meals were complimented by wine selections served by our knowledgeable waitress, who was very helpful in selecting wines that would complement our menu selections. Wait staff was attentive throughout our meal, keeping water glasses full and the table clear as we finished our appetizer. 

We will be returning to this fine establishment to try other selections on the menu and wine list.

We came here to try it out since we were in Exton Main Street shopping. The prices seem reasonable for a Japanese place....until you get the food. The portions are the stingiest I have ever seen and the quality is not even all that great. 

Avoid this high priced small portion place at all costs.
Staff was nice, price is good. Probably hit or miss depending on the troop for the evening, but the funny to profanity ratio was disappointing. Had much higher expectations from previous reviews.

I order from this place about once a week, if not more, because that's how much I love it. The food is so good! It never gets old to me. Ive never felt this way about healthy food before in my life (not even kidding). While they have many deliciously fresh options, the turkey avocado wrap is always a crowd pleaser. Highly recommend.
The game room sucks.  Mackie was especially rude and unpleasant.

01/09/18

I just came back from Applebees I was a little apprehensive after reading the reviews because I hadn't been there for a while. Well I had nothing to worry about My Husband took me there for my Birthday. No one else there knew it was my Birthday. We had a server named Mo He was a great server. He had a least 5 tables that we saw maybe more that he was waiting on but treated all his customers the same asking always is everything ok do you need any thing else. The food came out fast and was excellent could not complain about anything. It was a great night Good Server great food . I will be back again.

One person who reviewed this place and said he got a big whif of stinky strong fish. I will disagree with that. It smells like a typical Chinese Buffet, nothing more, nothing less.

We were in the area, and figured we would go since it just opened last week, and we would be shopping in the area. 

They have a hibachi grill, sushi bar, fried items, typical Chinese dishes like chicken and broccoli and veggies, noodles, etc. They also have pizza, macaroni and cheese, fish, potatoes for the kids. They have a salad bar, soups, fruit, and desserts, and ice cream. Same type of place different day. 

Not horrible whatsoever, just standard and nothing out of the ordinary. Not too much seafood either.

I've gone here for several massages since moving to Philly, great place to get pampered! Colleen is an exceptional massage therapist, great for deep tissue work and getting in there to work on problem areas and address issues. Beth is also great and will utilize multiple techniques to relieve pain and get you relaxed.

Can use the rest of the facilities if you get a spa treatment, including sauna and steam shower. Highly recommended!

Have to say i love this place.  Need to have this place in Sarasota.  Stopped by early before a TB Lightening game, and enjoyed sitting at one of the outside tables.  The inside felt like a chilly 65 degrees....i did not bring a coat.
We started with the grilled romaine, the blue cheese dressing divine.  I chose not to lick the plate, did not want to appear uncouth.  Next the parmesan fries, oh they went quick, so quick.  Delicious and crispy...
I had the broad noodle pasta with grilled shrimp.  A really nice dish with mint and peas.  Larry had the short ribs, he declared them to be delicious, i do not eat meat so not tempting.  
Not eating meat would pose no problem here.  There were several small plate/appetizers that i would try next time.  But still get those fries..
The greeter/host was friendly and our waitress knowledgeable and attentive throughout our meal.  I chose a great wine by the glass and Larry had a nice selection of beer to choose from.
I think you should try this restaurant sooner rather than later.  My first time, Larry's second and he is already talking about our next trip to St. Pete.
Best apple fritter in St. Louis. Probably the best yeast donuts in St. Louis. No fu fu donuts, just the classics. Can't get enough of this place!

I am never sure what to say when it comes to franchises and chains.  If you find yourself at a home depot for the first time, and yelp has guided you there, please tell me what information helped.   This store is typical in every way, not impressive, nor upsetting.  It is an okay home depot- not as well organized or laid out as other Home Depots I have been to in the past.  It has an okay, if over priced, garden store.  

It does have a decent area of parking and immediate store access reserved for contractors. I haven't seen that perk at other Home Depots.  As a non contractor who had to drive pass the empty contractor parking at 8pm on a Monday night, I was unimpressed- but I can see how it might appeal to the folks who are using the store on a more regular basis.

This is the best Sushi place I've ever been to. Every time I come to SB I HAVE to take a trip here. It's expensive, but worth every penny. I see people complaining about the service, but I've never felt that way. I always sit at the sushi bar and order everything from the chefs. Must go!! The White Dragon is amazing!
Delicious vegetarian food and meat lovers go crazy too. My favorite is the Chawla Kadu. It's sautéed pumpkin over long grain rice. So good. And BYOB

The Pearl is a little gem on Treasure Island. Glad we stumbled upon it. The hummus and other appies were incredible  Leslie, our server made wonderful recommendations. Good food, ambience, service and experience all around.  Eat here and you won't be disappointed.  She had the lamb and I had the sea bass. Whoah!  Wine list is decent.

Great place! We're in the area for a few days for my son's hockey tournament and wanted to get some good ribs, something that I cannot seem to find in the DC area. Had great ribs previously in Memphis, Raleigh-Durham, Jacksonville, and in rural South Carolina as well as poor to bad ribs at other locales. The spare ribs at Bridgeport Rib House competed with those southern places that know how to do ribs. My 11 y/o son and I split a full rack with two sides and brought more than half the ribs back with us because the were so large and meaty. And absolutely delicious. The hot honey sauce is terrific but if you're not sure whether it's too hot (it's not), I suggest you get the mild sauce with a side of the hot honey and you can apply the honey sauce to your liking. Also, the service is great, the waitress very friendly, offering suggestions and always with a nice smile. Place can be loud and the locals language is not always g-rated, but it goes with the atmosphere which is sports bar charming, imo. Fabulous ribs in Pennsylvania?! Who would have thought!

I always prefer local spots over the "bucks" whenever I can. 
Nice environment, outdoor seating and they make a mean cafe Au lait. And the location is top notch right off esplanade kinda hidden. 
Mmmmmmmmmmmmm

I have been wanting to try this place for awhile and finally had a chance last week. Do not let the fact that this is a food truck with tables and awning dissuade you from going the food is good. I had the Carne Asada tacos and the Carne Asada caramelo which were good. My friend had the cabeza tacos which were also good. It was a little crowded but the food was served quickly. It is outside, so keep in mind the temperature when you go.They also have Sonoran hot dogs, but we decided to try them next time.

You have got. To he kidding since this new owner has taken over alot of people will not go in here its now dirty 

What a shame it was an awesome place before 
Not now
Hotel is beautiful and elegant inside.  Very quiet on the street facing rooms. Beware of rooms off the center atrium the sound was loud and travelled straight up.

ON DINING IN
