Got the special Blueberries n Cream pancakes with Cardamom in the batter. These are the best pancakes I've ever had! They were sooo smooth and delicious, perfectly seasoned. I ate the entire plate! 

The freshly squeezes Grapefruit Juice was also on point. 

I came late at 2 PM for brunch to avoid the usual long wait time.

No Menu, No Drinks, and  it's the BEST Truck food you'll ever have!!! You might not know what you are getting but it will be amazing. He doesn't sell beverages so pick one up on your way. Don't try to get 2 because you'll be sure to get yelled at and the rest of the 20 people waiting patiently in line with hear about it too. Basically the Soup Nazi. of carts lol. Worth every bit of the wait. And you won't be able to stop thinking about that food. I'm so glad he's back. :)

I accidentally booked a bay front room, instead of a gulf front room.  When I realized this, I asked them to change the room, but was told that all three hotels were 100% booked and I would just have to be happy where I booked.  It wasn't what I wanted, tho.  I explained that it was my wife's 65th birthday and that I wanted it to be perfect for her.  No go.  No help what so ever from them.  Just be happy for what you get from us. Apparently, I was LUCKY to have a reservation at all!

The reservation was booked 5 days before my intended stay, but their policy says that I have to cancel 7 days prior.  As a result, they refused to let me cancel.  Does that make sense?

In the end, I said, "Screw them.  Keep the money.  Choke on it" and walked.

I seriously doubt that the hotel was 100% booked, because I drove by their half-empty parking lot while I was in town... all three of them.  

We was staying at the Dolphin Beach Resort, 4900 Gulf Blvd, St Pete Beach, FL.  Now THAT'S  a hotel!  Stay there instead.

Recently moved to the area and needed a drain line installed for my washer and a water line installed on my ice maker. Ray came out and gave a very competitive estimate compared to other companies in the area. Their office worked with my schedule to set up a date and time for an install. Tim and Jake came to do the installs and were very professional about the entire process. They explained how they were going to do the install. They had the water of for minimal time. They cleaned everything up when they were finished. And they even took the extra time to help level the washer so it wouldn't jump around when it was running. I definitely recommend their services to anyone needing plumbing work done. I will be using them again in the future if the need ever arises.

Mmmmm. Love this place. Though it is a gelateria, make sure you swing by here for some nommable paninis at lunch. 

The gelato is delicious also!
Yummylicious!!! An abundance of amazing flavors to choose from! The staff is nice and works quickly. Which is great since there is always a crowd here.
Love chipotle. This location has a great patio with views of tall Palm trees. Everyone was very friendly.

Zeppoli is a welcome addition to the byobs in Collingswood. It is not the traditional Collingswood Italian restaurant, it's Sicilian.  It is obvious that they just opened. There are little details still missing from their service, but not worth mentioning here.  They will work out the little kinks. The service is pleasant and efficient. They are still breaking in new servers.  The only complaint we had with Zeppoli was the noise volume. The place was almost full on a Wednesday night. At numerous times we could not hear our conversation. There is a difference between a high energy place and LOUD noise. They will have to address that soon.
The food. It is delicious. We tried four dishes and two desserts, all were very good to excellent. The Sicilian antipasta is mostly veggies, a few pieces of  sopressata and very little cheese. The veggies are mostly grilled
or marinated and have flavor. The two pasta dishes were excellent.  The spinach/ricotta gnochi were terrific. The cheese and the sauce were just right. The tagliatelli with shaved tuna was also very good. The rabbit with roasted potatoes was also delicious.The two dessrts zeppoli ( a Sicilian doughnut) came with a chocolate sauce and was good. The almond panna cotta was refreshing and wonderful.
I think this place has great potential and I look forward to going back soon.

Great food and great staff! The bartenders were more than patient having served me and about 19 other friends. The live jazz band was solid and definitely contributed to the New Orleans atmosphere. Jojo was especially awesome as she jotted down her favorite shopping and food spots in the city which we really took into consideration and enjoyed!! (Thanks again, Jojo!!)

We loved the boat ride with all of its great photo ops. We definitely would recommend taking a ride on the Steamboat Natchez as a fun daytime activity.

Went there for a date; not a too romantic setting, but the old mill walls and atmosphere is fine. We got seated quickly and ordered a bottle of sauvignon blanc. Little Neck clams were good, but the broth was absolutely delicious and with the tomatoes, was a perfect appetizer. I ordered the Chiciken Maximus for my entrée. It was good but nothing extraordinary. She ordered the rotini which had a really good sauce. The sauces here that I have tried are very good, the food itself is about average. the price for the food was about $50 for two people, so not too bad.

Seriously though, this place is out of hand delicious!  The service is reliably slow, but the wait is definitely worth it!  So good!  All these years I thought I didn't like Paneer, but it turns out that everyone else's was terrible.  But not Gateway To India's!  Theirs is so flavorful and the texture can't be beat.  Makes this vegetarian so happy.  They have also made my neighborhood smell delicious all day as well!  Thank you Gateway to India!  Please stay here!

I've tried all the local Chinese places, and this one has the best food!   Fresh vegetables, light sauces (hate when it's too heavy and salty!).  The seafood soup had loads of shrimp, squid and scallops.  Portions were large, and always gives us lunch the next day.  We like the Ho fun (wide rice noodles) and the eggplant.  The other places in the area just don't taste as good.  Service and take-out always is prompt.  This is where we go when not in Chinatown.

We had an early dinner rez at 24 and were seated promptly after a friendly greeting! The menu is great with various apps, a great selection of pizza and pastas, and various mains. We loved the scallops entree and pesto pasta! The pizzas were good but nothing exceptional. we greatly appreciated the service and overall had a great dining experience!
The drinks selections were great as the wine list wasn't vast, but we loved every drink we ordered!
Will be back!

They have made some changes in the kitchen and the quality of food has gone down. I think the same kitchen is also working at Sahms so it's par for the course. One good server has left and they let a good one go. They have a few veteran servers left. If it were not for the veteran servers and the locals I would not go to this place. The Jose Skillet is still my favorite.  The biscuits and gravy are not what they used to be. The kids still like their waffles. The bacon is not what it used to be- it's now something you would find on a burger at Wendy's.  I remember the good ol' days when this place was a four or five out of five stars.  I went to this place everyday for a couple of years. Now I go once a month. It's turned into another Sahm's.

Within 10 minutes I tried both Cafe Beignet and Cafe du Monde. Both fresh and hot. For my taste if you are only going to have one Beignet experience go to Cafe Beignet. First I didn't encounter any lines, where at the main Cafe Du Monde it was 15 mins at least even at the take out window.  Du Monde was $3 of 3 and I found them to be dense and chewy even when hot. Cafe Beignet's are $4 for 3 that are at least 25% larger. I found them to be lighter with a funnel cake texture and elephant ear taste. Much more enjoyable for my tastes.

Super quaint little place between downtown and the fairgrounds. Parking is super easy and free. Went today for brunch. Menu is limited. But the bartenders hooked up to amazing drinks based off the things that we told him we liked.Will definitely be back.
I had the mofongo con pollo and it was delicious. Washed it down with tamarindo juice. Liked the atmosphere service and food I hope to go back soon
Very good service, healthy food and all the employees are all smile and they remember your name. Move over McDonald.i

I have been to Taste of Havana a few times now and I am blown away each time by the experience.

Starting with the food, as that is the main attraction, there is no wrong choice, the sandwiches are the perfect combination of meat, cheese, and bread.  If it is your first time, without a doubt you should get the original Cuban, it is in my humble opinion, the perfect sandwich.  The other sandwiches they have are plays on the Cuban, but all great as well.

One of my favorite things on the menu is their every day special 'Lechon Asado' roasted pork over rice and beans, really amazing.  They also serve sweet and savory pastries, they are a great add on or meal in themselves, with the sweet option grab a guava pastelito.

Past the food; the owner, his family, and workers are absolutely the best, always happy and always accommodating, pleasant to the point where even if the food was not great I would come back.

Oh, and the Cuban style coffee should not be missed!

I read the reviews and was not disappointed.  I ordered the Prez-pastrami Rueben which has piles of new york brisket pastrami, swiss cheese, sauerkraut, and thousand island dressing on toasted rye...   

Great little Restaurant in a historic setting.

This is a true 5-star place. Great food, great service, great decor and atmosphere. Their food is so fresh they don't keep any freezers around! And the table-side guacamole is probably the best I've ever had. This was our second time here and they were amazing enough to make the special my husband absolutely loved last time even though it wasn't on the menu that night. Just amazing service and or waiter Andy was especially wonderful. Oh and, the margaritas are great told. Basically if you're thinking about checking this place out, stop thinking and get hungry!

We went here for dinner and drinks because someone gave us a gift card.  I was REALLY excited to go.  The building is super cool and the location is pretty awesome.  This place has all the potential in the world.  However, the food is ok at best and the beer....it's horrible.  There's no other way to put it.  Reno has a lot of good beer, but not from the Depot.  Pretty sure I have $30 left on a gift card that just won't get used.  If they had good beer, I'd go with 3 stars.  But I can't give them a good rating just because the building is cool.

For a little place it was sure busy for a Thursday night. Service was great and we were sat down immediately. I went with a couple of friends and we ordered the General Tso's wings w/ wasabi blue cheese, the Pork Roll burger, Blue Duck Fat Fries and Blue Duck signature sandwich. 

Here are my honest opinions on the individual dishes. First the Blue Duck fat fries. So so good, maybe even the best surprise of the night. While realistically they were little more then cheese fries with some added flare, they were quite good. Even without the sauce they were cooked and seasoned perfectly. That being said the portion size could have been a little more generous given the price of this side.

The General Tso's wings were okay. Pretty much what I expected so I wasn't disappointed with the wings or the sauce them self. However the wasabi blue cheese was lacking the punch and heat I'd expect from that combination of flavors. The taste of wasabi was barely present and completely over shadowed by the wing sauce and the blue cheese.

The Pork Roll burger was delicious ! The the seasoning of the meat and the Sriracha mayo worked great together. My only true gripe about the burger is the use of the tiny cheap store bought potato rolls that are suppose to contain the massive meat patty. The burger nearly fell completely apart the moment I picked it up off of my plate. 

The burger has an egg and sauce topping which means you already have to apply pressure to hold it together, which also means the bun needs to be strong enough to withstand that pressure without breaking apart during the completion of the meal. There are lots of local bakery's near by and an Acme up the road in which to buy a bags of Amoroso Kaiser rolls so no excuse.

Lastly there was the Signature Blue Sandwich. My feelings about this sandwich are mixed because while it wasn't a bad tasting sandwich I wouldn't make it my signature sandwich. The Pork Roll burger was much easier on the palate. A little too sweet for my liking and could've used some complexities in flavor. 

All in all a great little place with a lot of potential. Will definitely be back in the future.

This is my go to nail spa and I highly recommend. I like to wear pink and white nails and Nikki is the best I've ever gone to for this service. She is impeccably detailed and concerned about customer satisfaction. The salon is comfortable and always busy but able to accommodate your schedule. Tiffany gives a great pedicure and doesn't tickle feet, which is important! I really am glad this place was recommended to me.

I don't know how I missed this joint in my search for decent grub on the Mt. Airy main drag. Fantastic menu. Lotsa vegetarian options. But plenty meat, fish, oysters, salads, incredible fries, good and prompt service. 

This joint has it all. Bring your appetite.

Update: My wife's ring has been delivered and picked up. Very apologetically we were offered a resolution that works for us to a point. Therefore I've changed my rate from one star to 3. In the future we will be very cautious. 

Originally, my wife and I loved, and I mean loved this place. We both got our rings here and the experience was just perfect. Now, fast forward about three months to my wife's rings broke. She had one of the Disney collection rings and the diamond and rose setting fell off. We rushed right in on 12/22/2017 to drop it off and get it repaired. Understandably, with it being the holiday they said it may take about three weeks. Three weeks goes by and no phone call, so we stop in and see how things are going. Well nothing happened, and we were told sorry over and over and they'd get right on it and it would take a couple more weeks. Three more weeks goes by, we stop in again... still no replacement, still no answers, but we got another apology which doesn't do any good. That brings us to about the beginning of February. Just when I'm talking to my wife about how crazy this whole situation is, she gets a call. It's 2/14/2018, and her ring will be in that week! Finally the saga is over, or so we think. Today is 3/3/2018 and finally I've had enough so I call. The person who answers the phone tells me it still isn't in and can they call me back because they are doing 6 things at once... what about my one thing? My fully paid for wedding ring that is in limbo now for almost 3 months. I was offered a callback on Monday or Tuesday. That is absolutely unacceptable. So I demand a same day call back with some answers by the owner, the truth for once or a refund so I can buy her something she can actually wear. This experience has been absolutely horrible and there is no excuse that would make it any better. It doesn't take 3 months to replace a ring, there is absolutely no way
This is the worst the ice cream is melty it melted all over my new adidas pants mind you it stained the costumer service is terrible she didn't know witch ice cream was witch

This spot is so good if you go to ASU, you should transfer to U of A to be closer to this place. Had the special, Indian taco with beef + a soda or bottle H2O for $5.50. Outstanding. Definitely a 3 or 4 napkin joint, don't come here on a 1st date, wait until you can get a little messy at dinner and then come often. It will make your workouts worth it. Enjoy!

Best pizza in the city!! The amount of thought that went into creating this shows in the taste! Pizzas are absolutely delicious, inventive, and flavorful, and small enough to be able to share a few! The atmosphere is fun and clean, servers are knowledgable and gracious.  This is a fabulous additional to Old City!

Full disclosure: My experience might just have been an isolated, rare occurrence. I arrived to The Brick and sat myself at the bar. After 15 minutes of zero service I was getting ready to leave but I noticed the waiting staff on the main floor looked active and on top of things. I decided to transition from the lack of service bar to the main floor and, literally, as soon as I sat down I had a waiter hand me a menu, take my drink order and before even a blink I had a Bloody Mary in front on me. Moral of this story, careful sitting at the bar since the service there seemed to be lacking. I'm sure it was the timing since my overall experience was a thumbs up. 

I ordered the loaded Bloody Mary. The drink was simple but very delightful, clearly proving that less is more. The drink had a little satisfying kick that's normal to any Bloody Mary. Overall- very satisfied with their Bloody Mary, so much in fact I ordered two. Maybe a little more body to it but not a must. 

Food: I ordered the Tuna BLT with the side of Asian slaw. Overall: GREAT. The theme here is clearly simple. They exploit every taste which is gratifying since that's the most important thing. The slaw was crisp and surprisingly very refreshing. Now, the tuna can only be described as crafted by a masterful craftsman! Yes, I said it. It tasted better than it looked and that's hard todo since it looked as if out of a magazine. Nothing but quality dining. 

I place four starts because of the first part of my experience but other than that it was a good experience and I I'll come to The Brick again.

Wow, what a treasure. Visited with my wife around 11am and we ordered the fish and chicken slider, cheese fries, and two doughnuts. Amazing food! The chicken was by far the best, and waffle fries with cheese were delicious. We had the mardi gras and brownie doughnut. My wife is more of the "sweet tooth" but I enjoyed the doughnuts a bunch. The line is around 15 people back but moves quickly. They have limited amount of seats but makes for a great atmosphere. I will almost certainly be back and will spread the word.
Waaay overpriced for a greasy burger.  The pickles are a nice idea, but $7-$12 for an appetizer sized plate of vegetables in vinegar?

Best chicken and waffles I've ever had. Don't be afraid of the pepper jelly. It's made in house and makes the dish!
*I forgot to take a pic so I asked my neighbor lol. He already started but at least you have an idea...

First time here...certainly not the last!!   The restaurant is in the small side and very clean.  The menu has so many unique an interesting items that it was hard to chose!  I ordered the crispy wrapped pork and the Basil Chicken.  Before the appetizer came I was presented with a terrific cup of cabbage soup.... so yummy!  
The Crispy Wrapped Pork was really great.  It came with a dipping sauce.  I like spicy..in the table there is a tray with Siracha and hot chilies in oil to add as needed.   
The Basil Chicken was in a black bean Garlic and Basil sauce and the chicken is on the bone.  Another winner!   
Looking forward to my return trip!
So fresh is the best lunch spot for healthy food. I absolutely love their cooked to order freshness and their zoodles are amazing!
Delicious.  The seafood beignet was to die for. The stuffed shrimp and seafood pasta was great.  I will return again.

Overpriced food for what they served you!  We had stuffed chicken ( their signature dish), dry and not much flavor! Price for the food, didn't match the quality. The only thing we were impressed about was our server Micheal B. He was excellent, he was always on top of things!!!

Walking distance from our Airbnb on our last stay in NOLA, Surrey's is a charming neighborhood spot I'm happy to say I was able to enjoy twice in one weekend!

I about lost it over the shrimp and grits--these grits are so light and fluffy (even my grits-hating husband enjoyed them), and the spicy sauce was practically drinkable. 

The bananas foster french toast is at once airy and decadent, bathed in a caramel sauce so good you could lick the plate. Definitely split this dish with at least another person!

While they don't serve alcohol, we saw several tables with bottles of champagne, or you could go to the bar next door and grab a bloody mary ;).

Absolutely delicious!!! The bread and the dipping sauce were so yummy. I ordered the caprese appetizer, and I love that the tomatoes and cheese were placed on top of bread! My boyfriend ordered the cheese pizza, and it was the perfect mix of sauce and cheese! I would definitely come here again!

I went here a few months ago with my girlfriend. The service seemed decent at first because we were seated within a few minutes. Our food took 25 minutes to come out (which was OK but seemed a little long for just two burgers and some fries). To be honest, the burgers were on the bland side, though, and the portion was tiny for the price. It tasted like something I could make at home (I've got your typical college student cooking skills). Plus, I was a little confused because the menu description for my burger listed bacon jam but I didn't taste any.

Here's the kicker. Nearly 30 minutes into our meal, the waiter approaches our table with two more burgers. He told us our food was here but awkwardly stuttered as he walked away after we told him he was at the wrong table. A light bulb flashed in my head and I realized that those burgers were actually the ones we ordered. We had been eating the wrong ones! The waiter knew this when he saw the food on our table and craftily walked away, trying to hide this. This place doesn't deserve 1 star because the food, although bland and overpriced, was edible. The service was decent despite the fact that we were served the wrong order. (The correct order took nearly 50 minutes to reach our table by the way....) I won't be returning.

Funny that this place has so many mediocre/bad reviews, yet is fully packed!  We were lucky to get seated right away.  Food quality is pretty standard for a bar - not bad but not amazing (had the grilled cheese & roast pork sandwich).  Our waitress was not particularly attentive and we waited quite a while for drinks and the check.  They have a decent variety of drinks however, the Stella on tap was definitely stale.

Solid not going to complain, I mean they are doing it... bringing pho to mainstream America (well UCSB that is).  I wish they were here when I attended UCSB but better late than never.  

I had the Pho Tai and if you are craving pho then this may satisfy your craving.  However, I prefer my thin slices of meat rare and thin.  My noodles were a bit limp and I like my bean sprouts crisper.  I also would have loved me some more jalapeno, limes and Thai Basil.  Can't get enough of the Thai Basil.

My sister got her usual bowl and WOW that was amazing.  I would definately reccommend that.  Ban Cha Gio Tom Thit Nuong a lovely medley of Rice noodles, egg roll, grilled shrimp choice of pork or chicken served atop of lettuce, cucumbers, bean sprouts, cilantro, crushed peanuts and served with a ddipping sauce (containing fish sauce I'm guessing).  Solid.  It's also called the #32 in case you are wondering.  This bowl is bursting with flavors.  My sister got the pork and it was tender and full of flavor.  Addiciting.

The 2 young men behind the counter were very sweet and lovely.  Although I'm more of a salty girl but when it comes to Vietnamese Coffee, I go all out.  Give me the 2 inches of condensed milk.   They go light here, maybe just looking out for you.

Yeah a bit pricey for a Vietnamese joint but I'd rather spend 10 bucks on a meal here then spend $7 at a drive thru.  Much better for you and go ahead and titilate your senses.  You can alwasy douse your pho with Siracha or Hoisin Sauce.

The importance of the doorman (first contact) is often overlooked . My friends visiting from Europe were refused in (we are all 29) because no California Id. They had Id but not the "correct" one.  
I have my Cali one and was let in so it wasn't an issue of dress, drunk etc.... . 


So we went to Eos which is always better in any case and they gladly let us in with the id's

Awesome food, tried their fried fish and it was amazing. It was the 3 spices thai fish.

Also its a new business so its not too busy yet, but food quality is good and definitely home made cooking

Do NOT choose this moving company. They 'sound' good but they do NOT follow up when they break things regardless of what they say in the quote interview.

NEVER will use them again! They broke 2 expensive items and then refused to fix them or cover the damage after even the driver said it was their fault. TERRIBLE  company!!!!!

Went here last minute-looking for Italian food and was not disappointed! Everything we ordered was really very good with enough fir leftovers for the next day! If looking for good pasta, I definitely recommend

Had takeout from Marathon.

Meatloaf was pretty tasty.  Solid.

Turkey plate was hard to eat.  Actually, I didn't want any more after trying a bite.  Turkey was overcooked and dry.  Stuffing was overly salty.  Maybe the turkey didn't travel well for takeout, although overcooked is still overcooked whenever you serve it.

Somewhere between 2 & 3 stars.

Once again - while on vacation I had the pleasure of being introduced to this establishment. I have a close relative that lives in the vicinity of this market. I have never seen anything like it. The choices of freshly prepared salads, desserts, sandwiches, pastas, etc... were absolutely amazing.
We visited and hit the deli for some sandwiches - placed our orders - grabbed our drinks and went to the patio to sit down and enjoy. I got the #20, (Hot Italian), - it was probably the best Italian grinder that I have ever had. I am under the impression that the bread is baked daily - the meats are sliced upon request and the sandwiches are prepped accordingly. I do believe!!
Absolutely - incredible sandwich and service!
You can get just about any drink that you can imagine - huge choice of beers, wines, juices, soft drinks, waters, etc.....
The amazing part - the grinder was $5.50. Absolutely amazing. I have never experienced anything like this..
Later during the week - we drove 35 minutes from the resort that we were staying at - to experience this atmosphere and culinary for the 2nd time in 6 days. It did not disappoint!!!
Absolutely fulfilling experience and I will visit again on my next trip to FL.
Would recommend to everyone. 5 star experience - without the $$$ involved. Incredible value - INCREDIBLE EXPERIENCE ! 
One of the Highlights of my vacation.
HATS OFF to the owners of this business!

The hangover burger was excellent. It had a perfectly cooked sunny side up egg on top. Yummm!

The waitress was friendly, helpful and prompt. 

They have a lot of beers. The menu is a bit overwhelming. It would be helpful to have an ABV and IBU listed for each beer.

The only reason I did not give 4 stars is that the place noisy. It was a relief to get back outside.

Food is five stars and service is excellent, so why only three stars?  Because we had to wait over thirty minutes past the 7:15 pm reservation time, not to mention the waiting area... Oh Wait, they don't really have one...

If you are going to a movie, meeting important contacts, etc. you might want to try somewhere else with higher standards.  Got all the time in the world and don't mind waiting for your scheduled dinner time, then Morton's is great.

Very impressed with this place and surprised I haven't heard more buzz about it. Everything I had was great and my whole party of six loved every single course, from drinks and appetizers to dessert.

My girlfriend and I arrived first so we waited at the bar. The bartender was friendly and accommodating and didn't mind transferring the check to our table when everyone else arrived. The oyster appetizer was delicious; the portion of four is perfect for sharing. They were rich and flavorful. Yum. For my main course I had the steak frites, which I figured was a safe bet but I was jonesing for some red meat. I usually get the fillet but they served a strip and I had no complaints about it at all. The fries were crispy and awesome. Everyone else loved what they got too -- the snapper was apparently very good but had a strong coconut flavor, so watch out if that's not your thing (like me). The only complaint we had was that my uncle said the scallops weren't hot. They were just room temperature so he sent them back to get them warmed up. I'm pretty sure they gave him a whole new order since it took a few minutes to come back to the table. 

The service was also excellent as our waiter took care of all of our needs but wasn't overbearing or intrusive. I can't comment on the price, really, as I was treated to this meal. Entrees range from the mid $20s to $34, which was the highest price I saw on the menu. Shockingly, it was for a burger! But it did have foie gras on it, so I guess that's why it was so pricey. This is definitely a special occasion kind of place but I hope to be back again soon.

My son asked that I write a review of this place. I will say that it's authentic, good prices and all locals here. My tacos were great... The Carnitas and Carne Asada were perfect. Smells a little like Old fryers but sitting outside is fantastic.  

The 5 stars are my sons touch....I give it 4.

Small, clean salon conveniently located next to Embassy Suites. I needed a pedi while on vacation in Tucson. I called on a Saturday morning & got right in. The pedi was good, the leg massage amazing. The woman who did my pedi spoke very little English, so it made it hard to communicate at times, but this isn't the first time I've encountered a language barrier. For $25 bucks I got fresh toes for the rest of the time I was in town. It's not a spa, it's a basic nail salon & a good value for this part of town.

One of my favorite places to go for brunch. I have not been disappointed. I would always bring my friend Diane who is a vegetarian here for breakfast. I love the sausage with biscuit and gravy and also I love their egg white omelet with vegetables and a side of turkey bacon. Their potatoes latke is delicious but I can never finish it. Diane would always get the grits. It is also one of our favorite place after our Aids Walk. They have selection for vegetarian friends and non vegetarian friends as well.

it's not just Jazz, it's NEW ORLEANS Jazz.  Go.  Now.. breath in the ghosts of the past and leave a changed person. 
Clear your ears and rest a while.
Freshest sushi in town. No wait on a Saturday night. Staff is very accommodating and nice.

Like all Starr places they had great service! A friend of mine a belligerently drunk from their $18 all you can drink champagne special and they didn't throw him out like he deserved! I love Starr restaurants in general because if their staff is always top notch and Jones was no different. I got an avocado sandwich which was really good, especially the multi grain bread. All in all I can't wait to go back.

This place is insanely GREAT. The sandwiches are fresh, the menu is vast. If you're looking for an excellent sandwhich and don't have a lot of time, this is the place for you! The staff is amazing and attentive. They remember their customers/lunch orders after a while. I can't say enough about my experiences at Citi Market.
The food is always good. But if u come u have to get the sweet tea. It's the best in the bay.

Christ, this place is noisy - wouldn't go back again.   The area is really nice but there's no public transport nearby.  Go to the 4 points (a lot cheaper) or the Sheraton City Center if you're an SPG points collector.

Three stars, because the food was not that good, I went there because it was mention on a food magazine. Just average, but the service is really below average. Despite the fact that is a REALLY small place.

We were only in st Pete for 3 days, and we came here twice. The first time we were just having appetizers, but the apple sweet baked brie was to die for. It was perfect and my wife and I ended up eating the whole thing. 

The next morning we came for breakfast, and it was amazing. I had the Sedona Scramble with smoked chipotle hollandaise sauce. It was perfect. My wife had the spinach artichoke and goat cheese crepes. I simply could not believe how good everything we had was. 

The service is excellent, the food was stunning and the environment is cozy and fun. Be sure to try the espressotini if you are in the mood for a stronger drink than soda or coffee. 

Chill is a restaurant that you MUST go to if you are near St Pete Beach.

YES! That's all I can say. This was a great tour, Ernie was a great guide. Funny, knowledgeable, personable. Highly recommend this tour of the famous St. Louis Cemetery. Great price and well worth the money.
They have really good deli sandwiches and soups. I like the egg salad and also baked potato soup.

Went back in two weekends ago with my husband. It was around 1:45pm when we arrived and while the Yelp listing had 3pm as closing, the door said 2pm. We walked up to the counter to see the same young lady from my previous review. She didn't greet us and I asked if we were too late because I didn't want to put the kitchen out if they were almost broken down. The response I got was, "No, we close in 15 minutes."

Now, on it's face, it might seem harmless, it's true, they did close in 15 minutes....but it essentially made us feel like we would be rude to order. I understand that this is a touchy subject as far as how long before closing should you stop ordering food. Honestly, I would have been more comfortable with being told the kitchen was shutting down and no longer preparing food. 

The whole situation left a bad taste in my mouth. We love supporting small, local cafes, and I really enjoyed Refuel's food the time before, but even though we live up the street, we won't be back in.

The only reason I'm even giving this 2 stars is because of the kind employees. I got the most expensive car wash and after I went through my car was still dirty. I let an employee know, and he came to look at my car and let me go through the car wash again for free. Unfortunately, it didn't help. My car is still dirty. The vacuums also aren't that great here. It's nice that they're free, but it wouldn't suck up some of the stuff in my car.

A great bar lounge where the decor made you believe you were in Las Vegas!

The entire bar is designed in a circle with the seating arranged around the bar accordingly. But here is the kicker: they have oversized Victorian chairs and leather couches...awesome!!

They bring freshly, homemade, potato chips as a free bar snack.

They have a small dance floor and staged where we listened to "Miner" a decent, live, folk rock band. 

The service was amazing and attentive even when they got busy. We had two waitresses, one being Barb, throughout the night and never a hiccup. 

A full whiskey menu and many beers on tap. If you are undecided, they have a trust the bartender. Pick your poison and they will do the rest.

The food is a step above bar food because they use the adjacent kitchen of another restaraunt, however we mainly ordered drinks. The chips and guacamole with salsa were great!!

Only downside was lack of ventilation for the smoke. However, it is a casino and they can't control if the people to right and left of us are smoking like chimney's.

DosaHut was amazing a few years back.. But now they have reduced the size of the serving and increased the price on all the entrees.

It is way too expensive for the quality of food they are serving.. You can give it a try, but keep your expectations low...

The prices online on the website are way cheaper and when you go to the restaurant you are told that they have increased the prices and it really isn't worth it to go there on a weekend....
A favorite casual lunch destination. Tacos and alambres plates are divine. Gorditas are fantastic.

Poor service.  They did not give me what I paid for.  I ordered two owners cards but they only gave me one.  No refund, either.  They blamed the error on the state, which is questionable, but it is 100% clear that Pastore did not check my order for completeness before calling me to come pick up the owners card.

I am continuing my search for good Chinese food in the area, and it has brought me to the Big Bok Choy Bistro.  The reviews say great food, a bit expensive.....hmmm

I walked in, and this place doesn't impress.  Certainly doesn't appear to be worth the premium prices on the menu.   I attempted to order Generals Chicken with fried rice.  It comes with jasmine rice....and my desire was to pay a up charge for pork fried rice(my favorite). I was told that they wouldn't do it.  If I want fried rice I must pay 14.95 for the large portion......WHAT? I offered to pay a upgrade again....she must have misunderstood.  Nope.  This isn't a good start.  

Won ton soup arrives, looks to be house made.  Broth is tasty, won tons are a bit doughy.

Okay....strangely my entrée arrives with a knife and fork.   I asked for chopsticks, perhaps this was because I am a Caucasian white guy and they think I can't wield the tools of the trade?

The plate looks spectacular, if it tasted half as good this is going to be awesome.  Unfortunately it doesn't and I quickly realize why I have a knife and fork.  These pieces of chicken are HUGE...impossible to eat with chopsticks.  The chicken tastes a bit off like it was fried in old oil.....yes definitely.  This was fried and then the sauce was added, it may have not even touched a wok.  

Complete and udder disappointment.....and to top it off they delivered my bill before I was half done my meal.  I guess they want me to get out of here so the place can be empty again......well don't worry, I'll be leaving and not returning anytime soon.

It's a tourist chain. It's cute 50s diner and if you are looking for that you will love this place. A little over priced but it's a chain. The food is good, burger and milkshake joint. Everything is a side order from your burger so that will add up. What saves this is the staff, everyone is on top of what they do. Super friendly, great service, little added touches, very attentive. Also the place was spotless clean and has free soda refills which is rare.

Whenever I come back to visit the fam, I try to make a stop at Gryphon. It's a great neighborhood cafe with a chill atmosphere, perfect for a meet up with friends or a solo work date.

I usually get their chai lattes, which are a bit sweet but spice forward (mostly cinnamon and something else i can't quite pinpoint). They have both soy and almond milk as non-dairy options. The Tall Man enjoys their cortados, and I've picked up their beans for satisfying coffee at home. One day we'll have to come back for the nitro and kombucha on tap.

They do have lunch options, but I've never tried them. Their pastries are a fresh treat, but often not gluten or dairy free.

Sometimes this place can get crowded and a little cramped, but I've often been able to find a seat and/or outlet.

We stopped by to grab a quick sandwich. The service was great and the food was WONDERFUL. I couldn't decide what to get because everything looked great. We both loved our sandwiches and will definitely go back if we are around.

We have been members for many years. There is so much to love about this museum- the permanent collections, the travelling exhibits, the movies and music, and the beautiful gardens! However, this may be our last year as members. The museum has changed its access, so we can no longer walk or ride our bicycles for a visit. Since 90% of our visits were non-car, we no longer feel welcome.

I saw a roach crawl on my table here before my co-workers and  I had gotten halfway through our sushi lunch. In an effort not to make a scene, my lunch companions and I quietly got up from the table and walked to the hostess stand in order to let them know about said roach and then, ideally, get the heck out of Dodge.

It didn't seem to phase them that their restaurant was crawling with roaches -- they didn't apologize, only said "Oh we just sprayed, and that's why." They proceeded to charge us in FULL for our meals! Shaken by the image of one of the largest cockroaches I had ever seen, scurrying past my spicy tuna (and again, not wanting to disgust other diners) I promptly paid and left. 

30 minutes later, I sat, thinking "What did I do? Why did I just pay for that?!" They gave my coworker who expressed more disgust than I (I was somehow rendered speechless) a gift card for $20 when she left. This didn't cover what our total would have been and 20 bucks is definitely not enough "hush money" for this Yelper!

Another time I ate here with a group of 6, prior to said incident, the server made an (very acceptable) mistake and put my coworker's soda on my tab. We let her know and, instead of fixing it, she replied that my coworker should just hand me $2 in cash. WTH?! Really?  Then we discovered it happened twice (wrong soda on wrong tab for another 2 out of our 6.) She returned and instead of just going back to the drawing board and re-doing our checks to get them all right, she ALSO told him to fork over $2 cash to cover the difference. Hello, this is not common practice, Sake House -- frankly, it's rude and not everyone carries single dollar bills at all times.
Fool me once, shame on you. Fool me twice, shame on me! Between these antics and roaches on the table, shame abounds at Sake House...

We liked the food but we're completely ignored at the ordering counter by FOUR employees.  They would make eye contact with us and continue to not help us.  It was extremely rude and unprofessional.  I will not ever go back here.  Then when one employee finally decided to acknowledge us, I asked if they were still open at 8pm because of how poorly we were treated.  Then a second employee decided to help the first employee- put a glove on to start handling food items, and jokingly slapped the first employee in the back of his head/ neck with the food glove!  Then started working with the food!!! I thought I was being pranked! This place is a total joke!

High quality coffee, really some of the best I have had. Breakfast poached eggs are lovely as well. It's quite a popular spot- got there right when they opened at 8am on a Saturday and there was already a line. They sell packages of roasted whole beans that can be brewed in a cold-brew system. They also sell cold-brew systems.
Stopped in for lunch on a nice Saturday afternoon. Kind of gothic looking, but oh well. Had a grilled chicken and avocado sandwich which was pretty good. It was good, glad I stopped in

Above-average, creative sushi in a cozy, hip space in a great location.  Perfect for grabbing a bite before a concert at The End or Exit/Inn.  Try the signature Choo Choo Roll, the Crazy Roll or the Samurai Roll.  For sushi snobs too good for rolls, the real stuff is also very good.

It's as good as can be expected.

The service was friendly and everyone enjoyed their food in our party.

Not much more to say about this place. ;)

The do have a nice outdoor patio facing the river.

I've lived here in New Orleans since Katrina. It's a city of culinary delights on par with New York and Paris. Restaurants here have to be good to compete and have success. 

One of our great seafood delights is char grilled oysters. I've tried them all over town, and the ones here are in a league of their own. Lots of tender loving care goes into all the prep work, and the actual grilling is an art form to behold. 

The flavors come together in beautifully plumped up oyster heaven that hits my taste buds in perfect harmony. You have to stop in and treat yourself to half a dozen.  The service is attentive, the prices are competitive, and this local can't get enough.
This place is an absolute Gem. The cheeses, meats, and baked good are excellent! It can be crowded, but that's because it is an authentic market.

After the wild mushroom gnocchi I really wanted to give it a five-star rating BUT I had ordered a beet and goat cheese salad, "light on the dressing". Well, it was so light that it ended up being non existent.
Nice ambiance, excellent service and great location. I'll be back.
Such great service! I get the drunken noodles here, and they can instantly make it vegan by substituting chicken for tofu and removing the eggs. Love how flexible they are.

Awesome place! Walked in with my wife, it was not packed at all, just a friendly bunch of folks. Made us feel like locals. Great beer selection, good service and good prices. Yes it may look like a dive, but that is not a bad thing at all. Had a great time.
Always good food and friendly wait staff. Whenever there is an issue they fix it immediately and are super nice about it.

We stopped by on a Tuesday around eleven after waiting in a ridiculously long line at Biscuit Love for a short period of time. We were told 15-20 minutes for two, which I was cool with. They have an app to let you know wait times and where you are at in line based on your phone number. We were notified and seated right at the twenty minute mark. It was a little loud in the restaurant, but it was packed to the gills. Our waitress was a dear, Robin was her name, I believe. She served us well. I got the Hodgepodge Hash and my husband got the Chicken and Waffles. The waitress offered us a biscuit or something to start. We chose a biscuit, since neither of our meals came with one. It was amazing. Light, fluffy, crispy on the outside. It came with butter, jam, and honey. The honey was so unique and flavorful that I asked the waitress to write down the type of honey it was. (They have a chalkboard in the restaurant that tells you which items are locally sourced and where they come from - they had two types of honey listed.) The food came out quickly. Mine was delicious, but I couldn't quite pick out each of the ingredients to taste them separately. Together, they are tasty. The chipotle crema was really good. My husband enjoyed his chicken and Waffles and let me have a bite. The waffle was light and fluffy. The chicken crispy. He also had a Bloody Mary. Didn't rave about it but didn't complain either. Overall, a good experience and good food!

Visit began with a surprisingly rude and disappointing restaurant experience with the hostess. Because she was a difficult person, I asked for the manager on duty to discuss my open table reservation. Sadly I do not get to enjoy the food here and may consider not to after my first (or last) visit. My rating was due to an unprofessional and disrespectful staff!

You get in line and place your order then go find a table. You get a number and they bring it to you when it's ready. Child friendly but also nice for a couple. We didn't have kids though, group of 7 and they let us push tables together. There were also a couple tables outside if you prefer that. 

I had a Bloody Mary and the Biscuits & Gravy. Came w over easy egg on top. I enjoyed it. Next time I'll ask for extra gravy. I ran out of gravy before I ran outta biscuit, but only by a couple bites. Personal preference, not their fault, but I like my biscuits to be in a gravy bath.

We stumbled upon this hidden gem one day while mattress shopping. I googled mattress stores in the area and this came up. And boy are we glad we stopped by! Victor was amazing at helping us find just the right mattress. I felt like Harry Potter in Ollivander's wand shop, as Victor dug through his stash looking for just the right one for us. Not only was the mattress we bought hundreds of $$ cheaper than what we would've paid anywhere else, but it is the most amazing mattress we've ever slept on. We've never slept better, and I mean that!! I highly recommend stopping by to see Victor. If he's not there, call the number on the door.

Was expecting a lower priced menu but quickly realized the potential of high quality food and service. Food took a while to arrive but when it did it was HOT and fresh. Couple with no alcohol can expect to spend  $45.00 or so.

I came here because of the great reviews.  HUGE mistake.  We were the only table but it took at least 30 mins before we got our food.  By that time I asked the waitress to just serve everything as it becomes ready instead of waiting.  The chicken teriyaki was just dry deep fried chicken breast with sauce on top.  The nabeyaki udon was so over done, the noodle was soggy, the veggies cooked to mush and chicken dry.  We also had calamari which was tasteless only saved by the hot sauce.  Overall, extremely disappointing since I was expecting a decent meal given the high rating.  This is not Japanese food.  Won't be back.

Chipotle is a reliable place for a good burrito. It pales in comparison to SoCal for burritos, but here in the east coast, I'll take what I can get.. Particularly for a good price and fresh ingredients. The sofritas is amazing and would be loved by carnivores if they gave it a chance. The guacamole could use a little more lime and I prefer it chunkier, but is above average for being mass produced.  

This location is generally pretty quick with their service. The parking lot is usually filled. 

Pro tip. Get a veggie burrito or bowl, and your guacamole is free99 son. Easily the best deal. Also, they have redeemed expired coupons for me in the past, so don't be afraid to give them a try- you never know. The Tabasco chipotle and Tabasco like sauces are a required addition to anything you order here.
Ordered white greek pizza...loved it. Delivery was fast and the pizza hot and delish...definitely will order again!
Came in for my first appointment today with Holly, who is incredible! She has great expertise and was wonderful to talk to. Had a really great experience and I'll be back for another visit!

oh my god, where do i begin? carmine's is a great family joint with more "upscale" seating upstairs. the lower floor has sports on tv, and a main bar so you will be entertained while you wait for your table. the upstairs area has booths and smaller tables (great for a date) where you will begin your salivation as you flip through the menu. can't decide what you want? let me make it simple. BEER BATTERED PRAWNS! let me belabor this point. shrimp with a dipping remoulade and cocktail sauce will only wet your appetite for more food. at this point, you get one of the best cuts of steak they serve. this will not be a cheap night out, but it's sooooooooo worth it!

They have the best seafood and the family enjoyed it too. It is bar style seating so it is very limited and always a line but it moves quickly. You can also get takeout on their side window and eat on the pier patio tables. It is very fresh seafood, i can taste the difference. They cook it right in the open so its nice to see your dishes well-prepared.  We had the fried combination, clam chowder, clam linguine, and calamari pasta - all were great! Even the tartar sauce was so good lol!! Service was fast and very good. Will definitely be back next time I'm in SB.

Outsiders Salon is amazing because Jenn Yenser is a master colorist. If you want to look cute, sexy, beautiful or all of the above and try something new, she is your stylist! I get tons of compliments when she does my color and styling. Services I've gotten: hair braiding for Burning Man, "autumn hair" featuring a few browns and reds, "pink hair that don't care" with a pink magenta and purple mix. She always curls and finishes the styles really nicely too. Basically, she rocks and you need to let her make you look amazing, because she will!

The food here is incredible, there's no doubt and the buffet is a great value.  Yet every time I come, there is something shady going on: this most recent time, they refused a patron's credit.  They also charge a $10 minimum to use your credit card, which isn't posted anywhere.  This results in the person usually paying more for their meal.

Also, I went in there to order take out dinner one weekday night at around 5 PM...the doors were open, but it was dark when I walked in...there were several (waitstaff?) lying on the floor between the tables.  They yelled out: we're closed!  Frigging weird...I've ordered take out dinner from there before so needless to say I was surprised.

There is another choice in the area called Chinnar in the Pathmark shopping center.  The buffet is a little more spartan, but has all the regular favorites.  It seems cleaner, more well-lit and also less um...shady.

Tasty. Crowded. Picturesque.  On a pier with multiple selections of seafood restaurants, we chose this one based on the reviews. Heed the warning from other patrons...the location is small and there is a considerable waiting list for a table. Since we were interested in the food and not so much how we eat it, we ordered from the side window and ate our food on the outside patio tables. I ordered the cioppinno served in a bread bowl.  The flavor was delicious and there was plenty of seafood, including a rock crab claw, blue crab legs, shrimp, scallops, and mussels. My only problem with this dish was the awkward way in which I had to eat it without a shell cracker for the rock crab and how messy the soup was served in the bread bowl. 8 napkins were not enough to keep my hands clean as I ate. I'm assuming that if I tried the food served in the restaurant, it might have been a little smoother. My husband ordered the crab cakes and they were good...more. Ran than cake which is always a plus. I'd like to give this place another shot when I'm in Santa Barbara and see if there is a difference with the dine-in experience.
Long-overdue review... I have been going to SoCo Gyros (and recommending it highly) for the past 4-5 years...every time I get a delicious Gyro and I cannot wait to visit again

I have only eaten at Casa Azteca for lunch and had the buffet every time that I have been there. The food is authentic and has great flavor and I think the taco's and enchiladas are really good. The thing that I find as most bizarre is that this place has some of the best fried chicken that I have had. It's never greasy and always has been hot and fresh. I know it seems odd to me that a Mexican place has the best fried chicken but it is what it is. The food has great authentic flavor and you can choose between mild or spicy taco's but I always get the spicy ones. The service has always been great and the staff has been there forever so I really think that helps. The only reason not a 5 star is because I have never had anything but the buffet.

Best wings in Tucson by far!! My husband and I go there maybe once a week, he goes for spicy and I get "honey hot" (spicy BBQ). The wings are nice and meaty with just the right amount of sauce, and when you buy by the dozen, the prices are very reasonable.

Very disappointed! The pictures on yelp are misleading as the don't offer mac & cheese on regular menu and much of the items are not on menu. The first two beers my husband order they did not have. We had the peppers for an app and they were good. The depot burger was very disappointing.  The pastrami was very fatty and seemed undercooked.  The chicken sandwich was okay, not bad bit nothing special. My son had the classic burger and wasn't impressed. The worst part was getting change. It took over 20 min to get Bill then another for change??? It's a $100 bill...how hard is that to break? Then waitress goes MIA...very frustrating to say the least!!

We had a great time on carnival dream. However for a budget cruise we couldn't ask for more. Staff was always friendly and willing to help. We were first time cruisers so we don't have much to compare this cruise to. However our room was always clean, room service was fast. 
We were shocked when we first saw the tiny beds in our ocean view aft room. We are used to queen sized beds at home and sleeping in these single beds was quite a challenge. However we were able to sleep in comfort without any problems. 
Make sure to take advantage of the sea day brunch as much as you can. If you don't have reservations to their special sit down restaurant sea day brunch is as good as it gets. 
The reason I didn't give 5 stars is because of the food and entertainment. Food tasted good but it's more American type food. We loved the Indian station they had on board. Asian food station and other Asian food stations were always jam packed. In or 7 days we never had a chance to try at least 3 stations due to overcrowding. Pizza station sucks. No flavor. 
I'm 27 years old and I found entertainment really boring. Carnival dreams idea of entertainment is gather everyone by the two tiny pools and let dj play songs. We had a blast at the stand up comedian on the very last day. 
We expected a whole lot in entertainment, but carnival dream didn't deliver in that end. 
Spa was nice but the massage was just ok. Only reason we went to the spa is because I won some money at the casino. 
All and all we had a good time. I wish they add a whole lot more activities and entertainment for young adults. Ship also can benefit from a little more organization when it comes to sit down dinners. Some days we had to wait over 30 mins standing up all dressed up in huge crowds waiting to be seated. 

We did 3 excursions and they were well organized. I highly recommend secret river in playa del Carmen if you're in good health. Few negatives about the excursions are not enough time for meals in Belize and ships director going on and on about some dumb jokes. 
I recommend carnival dream if your tight on money but still want to have a good worry free vacation.

Being an all you can eat buffet I didn't expect much; however, our server Carlos was exceptional he greeted us as we were seated. He checked on us constantly watched him clear a table that just left he made sure to clean the table and wipe every condiment and holder on the table he made sure the floors were clean also.  The fried chicken was so good and crispy and moist it was not soaked in lard. The steak was so soft and juicy it is better than any of the steak we have  eaten at High End Restaurants like Ruth Chris. Would definitely recommend this Golden Corral to all be sure to ask for Carlos as your server.

ButterMilk!!! Wow

You wait in line for a reason.. It took us until we actually received our food where we understood why we snaked a line outside. 

The Inside is spacious an people work feverishly to turn tables- we only had to wait about 30 mins for a table as they shuffle people in and out. The wait was well worth the taste of the Pancakes- I ordered a Standard breakfast but of course had to get a small stack of Buttermilk pancakes.. They were the BEST I have ever had. Moist, tasty and plentiful...We also ordered a "Poka Dot" pancake for my nephew-- (was some M&Ms on top of the 2 pancakes-- prettys weak, but still the pancakes were awesome. One thing I will say is the way they hustle people in and out they service is quick and efficient, but very dry.. If It were a bit more hospitable I go 5 stars on this place. The front cashier guy seemed absolutkey miserable-- we asked if they sold the pancake mix kit (hoping to bring some back as a great souvenir) the guy must have thought it was the stupidest question in the world.. He just looked down and said nope.. Okay sorry for asking bud... He then went back to play on his phone.. All in all our actual server was a 22 year vet of the pantry.. She knew what she was doing.. Efficient and straight to the point.. Great Breakfast and Tremendous Pancakes-- if your in Nashville go stand in line and grab a Stack..

The flat white was very good as was the pour over.  The hot chocolate we ordered for the girls was very late - in fact didn't even get made.  I'm not sure if the request wasn't heard by the cashier or just not entered.  Fun little place.

Hands down best Indian food around. I have ran past this tiny storefront dozens of time and the name always threw me off. When I yelped looking for Indian food, this place came up.  I am so happy we found our new go-to Indian restaurant.   
We have gotten food from here a few times, and I have never been unhappy. 
Pro's
-Food is amazing
-BYOB
-Excellent take-out and portion sizes

Con's
-super tiny inside and limited seating. Do not walk in and expect a seat. You can make a reservation, or call ahead to see if any spots are available. But best for take-out.
It's Yats! It's great! The service is always good and so is the food. Stop reading reviews and just go. Reasonably priced and a reliable dining experience. This place is wonderful.

This wine tour through Wine Edventures was our first experience in wine tasting.  My husband Bob and I actually didn't know what to expect.  We were pleasantly surprised when Shawn, our tour guide showed up at our doorstep to pick us up with a friendly smile in his Sprinter van.  The van was extremely comfortable and air conditioned, which we fully appreciated since the temperature that day rose to 108 degrees. Six other people were picked up and off we went to explore 4 different wineries.  We had a wonderful time and learned a great deal about the making of wine.  Shawn shared his wealth of information with us in an entertaining and fun way.  We highly recommend Wine Edventures to anyone looking for a fun, educational experience!

I'm not going to lie. This place looks a little shady, it's a little dark and my table wobbled. My husband drug me in here because a local recommended it and man am I glad he did. 
My husband got the seafood platter (calamari, catfish, shrimp, and crab cake) and he was more excited than a kid a chuck-e-cheese! I couldn't get him to stop eating long enough to tell me how it tasted, but by the look on his face it was amazing. 
I got the creole pasta and it did not disappoint.  Followed by a beer and football updates on the TV and I am one happy wife!
My advice: sometimes the most shady resturaunts have the best food!

I don't get the fun in slot machines.  I'm not a gambler, and I never have been.  Nothing here was much fun for me.  I walked through the whole casino.  It was very smoky and had a bad smell. I didn't enjoy myself the whole time I was there. There are few restaurants, they look great, but I'm not sure if it's worth the smoke and smell.

Mmmmm. Now that hit the spot! I have to admit, I had low expectations. I've had some meh pho lately. But this place offers a solid, good bowl of pho. It's not going to knock your socks off, it's not fancy, it's just simply good. My husband had the vegetarian broth, vegetables, and tofu. I had the beef broth, beef, and vegetable. The next time we're in town, we will be sure to come back.

Figured I better write a good burger review since I just slammed a couple local ones who couldn't match up to my Culvers. I come back here for the consistency. Yes there are kids running the registers most of the time but I rarely have an issue unless its super busy. Everything is always consistent here and I never wait long for food even in the drive thru and its always hot. Its clean too. I'll keep coming back as long as they are consistent! Good job Culvers! Oh yea, and I love when they put marshmallow in the custard!

This place maybe a bit hard to find considering it's located in a very quiet part of West Edmonton Mall.  The store is very small and believe it or not they sell rocks.  The rocks they have are polished and smoothed down but they also have some rocks with gagged pieces sticking out.  Some of the stuff is kind of neat.  It's working taking a look at just to see how cool nature can be.  

I think the best that this store has to offer is its jewelry.  They have some interesting and unique pieces.  They have some great looking necklaces, rings and earrings made from good-old Canadian jade.  This stuff can be a little pricey but if you like Canadian jade then it's worth it.  Some of the necklaces ranged from about $40 to $395; the rings and earrings ranged form about $25 - $45 (or more).  

If you like amber then I'm sure you'll be able to find something that you like from this place.  They didn't have a huge selection of amber but what they had made me wish I could afford to take apiece home with me.  They have some really nice and simple looking rings.  I thought their necklaces were a bit much; they had large pieces of amber and it was very chunky looking; but if you like that kind of style then you'll like what they have.  I did like their selection of amber bracelets.

Gena and the rest of the crew are extraordinary at their craft. Reasonable prices, great products, wonderful presence and no complaints. True masters at hair and nails. Their the number one stylists in the area.

"Salt peppa ketchup Bui sauce?" Always Bui sauce. Always always always.

Every breakfast sandwich from Bui's is on point on point on point. Super SUPER filling, delicious, cheap, and with quick service to boot! The long rolls are always so delicious and wonderfully chewy like some kind of magic French baguette.

Again, they're pretty fast, but even so, if you don't want to wait, you can definitely order ahead! :)

Last I checked, unlike Lyn's, Bui's is open 7 days a week. Lazy weekend mornings are made all the better with a Bui's breakfast sandwich.

We visited Nashville last year for the first time. We love historic buildings, so when we heard there was a hotel and restaurant in the former railroad station, we were there. We were not disappointed. Wonderful meal, attentive service. So when we had occasion to visit Nashville again this year, we had to go back to Prime 108.

Again, great food, great service. The chef had recently been to the Cayman Islands, so he was doing a grouper with a tangy sauce, accompanied by rice with crab and topped with ginger. I wasn't sure if I was in the Carribean or in Japan, but I knew I was in heaven.

The atmosphere is trendy, kinda loud even in the back of the restaurant but it is a beautiful spot. The food was good but not amazing! We had the goat which was probably the best dish, the pig ears,  dirty rice balls, beef and shrimp. The service was slow but the water guy was on top of it. I really expected more. I would only come back to have cocktails and hang in the bar with maybe a snack and/or dessert.

Very good coffee. Love the Chai latte here. Excellent soups. Most of the pastries I've tried were great. Customer service is hit and miss(more hits than misses). If you're short on time, go somewhere else.

Delicious and flavorful food at a fair price. It's a little odd being next to a laundromat, but hole in the wall places like this often have food that exceeds expectations.

The sitting area is pretty bare bones, but there's everything you need for a great dining experience - amazing food, fast service, a big bucket of beers, and sports on the TV.

When you're in the area, don't pass this hidden gem up.  You won't be disappointed!

Panera bread is reliably delicious. Use your owners card for discounts and free treats. I find the salads, even half a salad, to be a large portion. Some of the sandwiches are flat and sad, but the pasta is consistently good. I like how this Panera gives out numbers and personally delivers the food to your table. This location is a nice quiet spot for some along time or a business meeting.
No complaints here. The place was clean, service friendly and timely, food was delicious and priced great.

Super service by Philip!

(He's now moved to Love Nails on Gunn Hwy!)

Color me surprised. I didn't expect to get Thai/Vietnamese/Chinese cuisine of this quality in this tiny restaurant in the middle of Maryland Farms. 

The food is fresh, flavorful, and expertly prepared. If your dish has the option, ask for it to be served in a hot skillet. The rice bottom will crisp nicely and provide a wonderful texture palette. 

The only negative I had with the food was my dish was topped with a fried egg that was definitely over-well. When I order a fried egg, I do so for the creamy yolk that can be used to sauce the dish. I guess next time I'll specify over-easy. 
'
If you're in Brentwood and are getting tired of Peter's...try Soy and you won't be disappointed. I'd put them up on the same level as Smiling Elephant.

The young lady at the desk was lovely...courteous and most helpful.
We requested 5th floor and we did get it. Room was clean, quiet and large (2 queens).
The breakfast in the morning was perfect as we were heading home early.
Will definitely stay here again !

Came here because of the great reviews on yelp. I am from the Seattle area and have been to many good teriyaki joints. 

This place was great. The food was interesting and delicious. Most of all the customer service was incredible. Very attentive and friendly. I definitely recommend this place and would come back anytime I am back in the area.
I've been here a few times for brunch - it's been a while though and need to get back soon!

My friends and I booked the bike wine tasting tour and it was a great experience. The staff was very friendly and accommodating. The complete bike ride from one winery to another was very pleasant and the scenery was beautiful. I highly recommend this tour! The first winery stop was awesome and the staff there was very informative and helpful with their wine selection. We made our way to our 2nd winery where we had lunch and the scene there was beautiful and it gave us a lot of opportunities for pictures. 
I highly recommend comfortable clothes, tennis shoes, and girls might want to consider braiding your hair or something because the bike ride was a nice workout.

yeah, i know, you never knew this place had a name, well it does and you best learn it! this is basically a satellite of taqueria veracruzana to me, for what is awesome mexican food without a nice cold beer? just awesome mexican food.
 my circle of friends call this place "the grime" or " the beer garden" or "the hockey arena", you'll have to actually go to figure the last one out. they do have , i believe, the cheapest six pack of yuengling lager in the hood and some of the drunkest mexicans you'll ever see. this place has served me well for the last few years, just dont take your girlfriend along unless you like fighting.
the owners name is sonny, he's nice.

I used to take clients here a lot for lunch/dinner because of its convenient location, however after the experience I had last night I will no longer be doing so. My girlfriend and I met up for dinner and drinks. The service was ok but once we got the bill it was triple what we ordered.  When I questioned the waitress she brought over the manager who basically called us liars. He was completely nasty and rude and did not at all handle the situation as I would have expected.  His horrible attitude ruined it for me.

So decided to order from Tito's pizzeria tonight looking for a new mom-and-pop pizza place and staying away from the major chains. 

Got the online special for 2- 16inch pizzas, 40 wings ( best wings I've had in a while ) which came with a 2 liter soda. 
      Only problem I had was with the amount of toppings I paid extra for (1.75) for the size of pizza I got when I added broccoli to one of the pizzas. Not worth it to add any toppings not because the price is bad to add, but because they don't put enough to even taste 
    Other then the whole toppings debacle, I would have to say this place was good. From the order process to the delivery guy being great. The pizza was good and the wings where just amazing I have to say. Wings are priced to sell !!!!!!!!!!!!!! ( got 40 for 18 bucks )

Cashier Tanya was rude. I asked for pepperoni pizza, she said we don't have any. I said that's okay I can wait for the next one that's made and she seemed perturbed that I didn't just take what was available. When I got to the counter and bought a soda and paid in advance for the pizza that was not yet made, she said you can pay for it when it's done , then I asked are you going to make me wait in line again and she rolled her eyes and just let out a gasp. She refused to wear gloves when making the pizza. When I asked her why she wasnt wearing gloves she said she didn't have to in TN and that she had just washed her hands. I didn't see her wash her hands the time I was there. Terrible service. She shouldn't be allowed to deal with the public. She seemed unhappy in her line of work.

Used 1911 Smoke House for another work party, this time a wedding shower. Reggie is awesome and always works with our budget to get us the most for our money. We've actually used them several times for parties since my last review a year ago. I feel compelled to update due to something different that happened this time.

The guest of honor (aka the bride) called out sick on the day of our party (she did not know about the party), so we needed to postpone it until the next day. Naturally, we were frantic, but when I called Reggie and explained the situation, he laughed and said moving the order to the next day was no problem. It was that easy! The next day, everything was delivered as promised. We had two types of wings, pulled pork, mac n cheese, collard greens (fabulous), & sweet potato tots. It was awesome, as usual. Work parties that are catered by Smoke House are always popular, and it's easy to see why!
Every time I visit I find a gem. Amazing, amazing deals, great quality clothing & personable people in one place for a great cause

This is right around the corner from our house, so we had to give it a try.  The service was great!  I called and a woman named Heather was super helpful in helping me place an order for pickup without me having seen a menu. We ordered a large cheese pizza and a large house salad.  When I walked in, I thought "wow, Steve E. was right" because even though the space was large and nice and clean, it seemed like they were still trying to find their groove.  They have counter and case space not being utilized.

The bar area was really pretty and had TVs for sports, and the restaurant was spacious. They also have a drive through-not sure if they use it though.

The food was good. The pizza crust was sort of buttery and thin (just the way I like it) and the house salad was really yummy. I gave it 4/5 stars because they didn't beat Marsala's or Anthony's (in my book).   $23 for the pizza and salad, plus tip.

We will definitely be returning and trying other things on the menu!

Twistee Treat has great ice cream, and the ice cream cone shaped building is adorable! I usually get the "twirl" with chocolate ice cream and Reese's peanut butter cups. The kiddie size is HUGE. Low prices too. There is no indoor seating, so not the best choice for cold or rainy weather. Good service, and they are usually pretty fast.

I grew up eating at this restaurant, and nothing has changed over the last 20 years.  Still great quality food and an authentic feel, something you don't get from the national Italian chains.

I love this place for Italian, because they are not the pricey Italian food you get in the foothills that barely fills your stomach, leaving you hungry for more.  They give you large portions that taste great too.

You get awesome garlic bread with your meal.  This is real garlic bread, and not bread sticks.  This is one of my favorite things about Caruso's.

I always get the antipasta for 2 or 3 people when dining with others, as this is a great Italian salad.  The dressing is amazing, and it comes with things like baby corns, olives, tomatoes, onion, artichokes, and peppers.  Its a great appetizer.

The spaghetti with meat sauce and meatballs is my go to dinner of choice.  The caruso sauce is great too, but I just prefer the meat sauce.  The lasagna is also amazing.  They have tons of choices, but I stick to the classics.

The pizza is another good choice if you are with a larger group.

The interior of the restaurant is dimly lit, and has murals and paintings throughout.  The back patio is great if it is not too hot or cold, and is a nice addition.

The service may be lacking at times, but they more than make up for it with the food they serve.  The management should take more care in the service though, because it does upset me at times.  But I can't stop going there as the food is way better than Olive Garden.

Hands down the best Italian in Tucson. Nothing beats this place.
Good food, they didn't rush us when we were eating last closing. The fish tacos were BOMB!

This restaurant was recommended by a friend. I checked out their website and signed up for their email club. After receiving a $25 discount we decided to try it. 
We made a reservation for 8pm on Friday night and it really wasn't necessary. The restaurant was maybe  half full when we arrived. Nice ambiance and music. Typical dark wood steak house. There is a nice patio area but it is located next to the mall entrance. 
Our server was very friendly and we ordered a drink while we scanned the menu. Drinks were tasty and the top shelf alcohol drove the prices a little high. 
My husband and I both decided on the filet combos. He chose a crab cake and I chose the scallops. The food arrived in a timely manner and it was hot. The crab cake was large with nice solid chunks of lump crab. I was surprised to see the scallops were the size of quarters and maybe an inch thick. Although small, they were sweet and cooked well. The sides were pablano au gratin potatoes, Sriracha carrots, Yukon mashed and asparagus. They all tasted fine but nothing stood out as amazing. Run of the mill flavor and the veggies were not bright or fresh looking. The steaks were cooked perfectly (just a little under medium) but there was a hard char on one side. What should have been the star of the plate ended up ruining the taste of everything. There was so much seasoning on the steak that it had burned and gave the steak an extremely salty, bitter taste that overpowered everything on the plate. I know that salt is an essential part of cooking a steak but this was just too much for my taste. 
I guess if it weren't for the price I probably would give this restaurant a higher rating. I expect much more from the food when I have a tab of $125 (+ tax and tip) for 2 cocktails and 2 entrees. I could think of a dozen other restaurants in the St Louis area that serve that same meal for less with much better quality. There are better options out there than this mall restaurant. Seek them out!

Always a fan of Sabrinas in Philly so we decided to check out Collingswood location. Food is still delicious but I forgot portions are huge. We ended up bringing half our meal home. Coffee is still the best I've ever had. My only complaint is the noise level. It's too loud in there. We could barely hear our waitress let alone hear each other and we were sitting at a table for two! It sounded like we were dining at a football stadium during the Superbowl. Not cool!

Tried all the meats by becoming hooked and going here at least 6 times already. Take a few pounds meat home or get a good meal there with a large selection of side dishes to choose from.
