We ordered steaks with baked potato, and we also head the escargot appetizer, which was an incredible $5.95.  They were fantastic.  Our food was prompt and hot, and the service was spot on.  We were out the door after less than $45, and stuffed to the gills. My only tip is that when you order your meat, their medium is what I would consider medium rare - just be advised. Great food, great service, and we will definitely be back!

Came here to try a frozen coffee since it was in the area we were shopping. I got the mocha frappe which was okay. I wouldn't drive distances for it. The atmosphere is decent for a cafe, but based on how big it is, you'd think it would be busier. I will say that my dad usually picks up birthday cakes from here and they are pretty delicious, especially the birthday cake with the fruit. Overall, don't really expect great coffee, but definitely try some desserts.

This is one of the coolest hidden gems in Nashville. The cocktails are extraordinary and the bar tenders are so cool. The interior and architecture of this bar makes for an amazing atmosphere. I will absolutely be back, especially when I need to impress friends with a cool spot to get drinks.

Very affordable and very very very good! Extra bread is only 50 cents and they let you do a half and half order if you want to try two things. 

My only complaint is that they use almost all disposable stuff to serve their food. 

I LOVE the chili cheese etouffee with crawfish served over rice. When people think of cajun food, they often think it's spicy, but this dish has just the right amount of spice.
Matt and Seamus were excellent!!!  They made us feel very welcome and assisted with special requests.   Excellent place to stay for the night

John Asshole (it shows up as John A so who really knows) says anyone that has a negative review about this place must be stupid.  Sorry Mr Asshole, but I know good food and this isn't it.  Frozen pizza dough, canned sauce, greasy cheese.  What else is there to say.  If you want to order from here, might as well go to craptastic places like Dominos, Little Caesars, Pizza Hut or Papa Johns.  I personally like my pizza hand made.  So I probably won't see John at Franks, Vinnies or Guiseppes....

Andy S was absolutely amazing! Explained the menu very well and his menu recommendations were on point! I had the braised short ribs and they were the best I've had. Drink recommendations were fabulous! Go here and ask for andy!

I went here for the first time for Thanksgiving with the family. I usually don't like buffets because I never been to a buffet that actually met my satisfaction - in terms of quality, cleanliness, and etc. But Noboru was different. The place is soooo clean and nice, and doesn't give off that typical buffet look. The food was great too. The rolls were very delicious! They also have hibachi, shabu shabu, noodles, stews that the waiters bring over to your table once it's cooked. I will be back!

Maybe the best food in Narberth. It's small neighborhood place, and I was surprised the combination of really bold and spicy flavors, with very fresh ingredients treated with respect. This place punches above it's weight class. It's BYOB, but if you forget to bring booze, there is an excellent selection of beer at the Greek's next door and their is state-store across the street.
Teen says food was good.  Mom says food was ok.  Service was average.  Hard to find a place to park.  Beautiful Indy.
Inexpensive lunch combos. Fresh and tasty. Nothing to write home about though.

I'll start with the negative and why I'm giving them 4 stars.
1. The parking lot is crap (not really there fault but it's crap) half of it was under water!
2. They have 4 little tables and 1 high chair, I have 2 kids that sit on high chairs not that a table was even available after our ice cream was done being made so we ended up eating in the car. 

Positives 
1. The ice cream is really good
2. You don't see places like this very often (I've been looking) 
3. The staff was really nice to us and explained everything to us!
4. They let you wright on sticky notes to decorate - so cool

I will definitely be back I don't live in Tampa but just got year pass to mosi.

I love this bistro!
I came here on a busy night during Mardi Gras, and was told I would have to wait at least 45 minutes. Got seated within 20, and that was only the start of my wonderful night.

THE FOOD was absolutely delicious. I ordered the BBQ Shrimp as well as the Seafood Gumbo as appetizer. It was like nothing I have ever tasted before, and I realized that I am in love with Cajun food.

THE SERVICE was marvelous. My server was so sweet and attentive, I left 50% tip. I felt like a baby when he put the bib on me.

THE ATMOSPHERE was as good as it gets. It was a dim-lighted room, with lots of New Orleans flair. 

If I ever visit New Orleans again, I will make a note to visit again :)

THIS RESTAURANT is By far The Best Middle Eastern Restaurant in Kenner City ,and surrounding areas. -The food is Beyond Exceptional, with culture and Authenticity seeping through Every Plate that I have ever Tried at this establishment - (try the stuffed Grape Leaves) -  not to mention the family Like service that Is Given here, Especially by one server-Aly, is the best food and beverage employee anyone can acquire-she knows me by name every time i walk in and can recite my order to me before i know it , Always thanks Ally!

Such a fun time on a beautiful night. Find a table outside, listen to some amazing tunes and get a few bottles of wine. We shared lots of different plates. Cheeses, meats, other yummies were all perfect compliments for each other. Some of the mains seemed small for the price. Wished I lived closer bc this would be my go to hang out. A must go to!
My wife and I love Jimmy the Greeks. It's very cozy, intimate restaurant with very tasty options for authentic Greek food. The desert is great too.

Great pizza.  Very fresh tasting, but the environment is take it or leave it.  Very uncomfortable seating and nothing welcoming in the interior of this store.  I'm not stuffy; I prefer casual, so it's not that.  But I'd definitely get my pizza to go from here again because the veggie pizza is awesome.

Went here the day after valentines day! I went to tria for drinks before and then walked the one block here for dinner; brought a large 220z bottle of beer with and they were happy to bring a nice bucket to keep it cool and some chalice type glasses. They started us off with bread and tahini which was very good. My bf and I went with the trio of dips, the rabbit leg and the summer ravioli. The rabbit leg was good, but the ravioli stole the show. It was so flavorful!  I would def come back here, ESP for brunch. There are so many things on their menu that sound amazing. They've got good service too!
Food is good and the service in the restaurant is good; however, if you sit outside, they seem to forget about you.

Called ahead was told to call back in 30 minutes. Ordered a vodka martini came back nasty total different color than clear and that was just for starters no excuse for a Friday. Waitress is very polite and strictly doing her job no complaints in that department. Food is always excellent .

This is something tantamount to a spiritual experience and I am shocked that I'm the first to be writing a review.  I've been visiting Izzie's all summer either at their main location at the corner of Riverside and Rosebank or at the East Nashville Farmer's market on Wednesday's.    They freshly make the ices each day with fresh fruit and make them in wonderful combinations that only true genius could conger.  A child's portion is a reasonable $2 and an adult portion is $3.  They tweet out their flavors and satellite locations each day on twitter @izziesice.  

I have to recommend trying the classic lemon at least once or do it in combination with another flavor.  They have the lemon every day and OMG it is this sweet, sour, refreshing experience that  that melts the summer heat away. It reminds me of Polar Cup for anyone who is from Florida and remembers those amazing ices that I used to beg my mother for every day.   So thanks izzie's Ice for settling in so close to my house and thank you Izzie's for giving me a wonderful part of my childhood back that I get to now enjoy with my kids.

Well, for the price we paid, the server was condescending and the food was good but not spectacular.  We had the goat cheese and crawfish crepes, turtle soup, seafood bayoubase, shrimp and grits, bread pudding and cremebrulee.  Although the food was quite good, it lacked content; not much "turtle" in the turtle soup, large portions of grits compared to shrimp, and a few errors with our drinks and bill.  The most challenging lo engine part was trying to get our server to not be condescending and to find her excuse for being so, well, stuck-up.  Perhaps there been riding on their notoriety for too long.

Teri and her team are fantastic! Teri is truly a dog whisperer. She really understands dogs and their behavior. She has helped us with a range of issues with our two bulldogs...from basic dog training to leash aggression. She is patient and exudes love for doggies! We have used Teri for training and overnight care for the last few years and I completely trust her with our bullies. I feel like the care they give our dogs is so personalized and they always go so out of their way to accommodate us. I really appreciate their flexibility. We were out of the country a few years ago when our Frenchie got really sick. Teri nursed him back to health and took complete care of him. I also know that the doggies will get lots of exercise, attention, and training at Teri's house. Sometimes Teri has helpers with overnight care and they are all wonderful. They all follow Teri's way of dog care and my pups always come home happy and tired. I really can't say enough great things about Teri and her team! Their true love and passion for dogs makes them one of the best dog training/care businesses in the Bay Area.

Very good food for sure.

Wife's fried oyster banh mi was fantastic.., 5 stars for that.

I had the red beans and rice.  The grilled andouille sausage was excellent as was the cabbage.  The beans and rice was a bit too heavy IMO. Still, good food and excellent outdoor service.

About 3 months ago, we were looking for movers. I found these guys on yelp and hired them to help us move. They were very polite. The only problem is they took almost 7 hours to move a bedroom set, a bunk bed, a china cabinet and some boxes AND charged us $550 (to make 1 trip and it was less than 10 miles)!! My husband is a disabled veteran and was not able to move any of the furniture. They scratched and broke the frame of our $10,000 bed that we got brand new and was assembled in our house only 5 months before we moved. 
My husband called them a few days later when we started to notice all the scratches and dents on our bed frame and a side table that's been in my family for 15 years. They asked my husband to send pictures of the damages and he did. It's been over 3 months and still no word from these guys. I hired these guys cuz of the reviews on yelp. WTF happened??? I seriously feel like we got ripped the f*ck off! I'm really more mad about the fact that my husband tried to contact them about the damages and they never called back or even email back. Call me unreasonable but I would never hire these guys again or recommend them to anyone! Pictures of the damages are posted! ***UPDATE****
I get an email stating that my picture were REMOVED because they do not represent the business.. Really??? My funiture is damaged BECAUSE of their business. And when my husband tried to reach out to them about the damages, all they said was email us some pictures. Guess what???? HE DID!! Did they even call back? NOPE. It's been 5 months and still no callback, not even a letter. No worries. I will take it up with Channel 8 news and I'll have them investigate. Very unprofessional..

Pi makes my absolute favorite pizza. Nothing beats their corn meal crust deep dish!  It is so good, when I want pizza, I am willing to pay the extra charges to have it delivered by Postmates even though I could get a less expensive pie closer to home.

This park is located at the edge of southern Hillsborough county, only a few minutes over the Gandy Bridge for me. It is compacted on the corner of the bay which makes this park breezing and cool even on a 90 degree day as it was on this day. 

The splash park has partial fenced in area, really more in order to separate the water space from the other areas that this great area has to offer. As you can see from the picture below, there is a great view of the bay, some shady places to squat and have lunch. There is a small walking pier and boat docks for the water sport enthusiast. There is even a bait shop and small restaurant if you would like to pop in and make a day of it.


The play areas are multiple. There is a 2-5 playground area and a 5 and up area. They are huge, spectacular really. The one for the bigger kids is very elaborate and high. So high that our little ones which don't read the signs of age appropriateness are way to high to reach as they climb. Being as short as I am, sometimes a little nerve racking, but I try to be calm and let her try. Both areas have shade built in, but the park does have plenty of trees  for natural shade if needed. 


The day was a splash ton of fun. Even Vivian got into the fun. Though I will say that the splash park itself was a little too much for her baby age. Next time I will wear a bathing suit and sit on the ground with her. Our friends brought buckets and they had a ball filling them up and sticking their feet in them and just spilling them over

The park also has several picnic areas and a giant gazebo with tables. We took shelter there when it started to sprinkle a little. The larger park area isn't fenced in and it is next to a road which means you have to keep your eyes open. There are restrooms which is a new great thing for me as we continue to potty train. This a gem. Go and enjoy! It is so close to northern area of St. Pete there is no reason not to venture across the Gandy bridge. 


http://spiritualmayatravels.blogspot.com/

Always fresh ! I have eaten here many times. I always get the hard shell, puerquito pibil (shredded pork) tacos wirh everything on them.  Refried beans and queso dip.  The ingredients on the taco are always fresh. If you do not like cilantro then ask for no cilantro. I think they will do it. Very inexpensive. Much beter than Taco Bus in my opinion. Also the grilled beef tacos...the meat is very tender. Not a fan of the tongue tacos but I don't like tongue so that could have something to do with it.

Delicious food & coffee!!! Awesome selection. We had the Honey Bee Crepe & the Goat Bacon crepe to eat. I'd highly recommend both of them. I also got the Mochacchino (hot) and it did not disappoint.

We will definitely be back!

Drinks we had were great, our server was outgoing and friendly. This would be a great place to stop by for some drinks or desert, but the food was seriously disappointing. I ordered the Friday special, enchiladas la bamba, which turned out to be just a really plain taco casserole on top of tortilla chips. Really nothing special about it at all. My date ordered the chicken pesto, which turned out to be the type of frozen chicken with the grill lines painted on it. As I said, the food was a major disappointment and I would not recommend it, but the drinks were good and the atmosphere was nice and appealing.

This is hands down the best AUTHENTIC Mexiacan food. Once you come here you will start comparing it to all other places in town. The inside is not that big but they also have outside seating. Let ls not forget the drinks top best margaritas!! Get anything off the special entree menu where you see Gios Flautas that is my favorite!! If you love queso also you will be in heaven here the  queso is BOMB . Go eat it all
Just no. Expensive. And crap. I don't believe 10 bucks a pound for crawfish is reasonable. Bye Felicia.
Love Chili's!  It's one of the best chain restaurants around!

I have had an amazing stay here with my husband. We brought our little girl for a few days & she truly enjoyed herself as well as my sister who also came. This resort is so beautiful & the atrium is perfect. The service has been so wonderful throughout our entire stay. I also have loved their shower toiletries from the spa whereas sometimes ya know, when ya stay somewhere, the toiletries they give ya to use can be quite subpar. The only thing I would recommend is parking at the very back at the mall for FREE because there is simply absolutely no need to be paying for parking or valet here in Nashville, esp not out here lol... that's just silly. Also, definitely get an atrium side room if you can help it, you certainly won't regret it! Bring a jacket as it gets a bit cool in there as well. All in all, this place has it goin' on :)

This is my first review on Yelp ever and I only write this because of one thing.. Peppermill, for me, is the best Hotel   Resort here in Reno! I would definitely give it 6 stars if I can! But the only thing that triggers me to write this review ( which cost it 4 stars )  is about this rude In room dining representative! It's my third time here in Peppermill and I could say that my two stays ( 2013 & last year ) were so perfect! And the third time, someone made me really really upset! It happened on May 26, 2015 around 3pm! I didn't know what his name is but he's a guy with accent but i wasnt sure what kind of accent was that! I called to order some food, I told him that I want Buffalo Wings and he asked me if I want the 6pcs or 12pcs. I didn't see the 12pcs so I asked him how much was it so I can compare the price, but he said to me, "You have the menu in your room right?" Wtf? Is it that hard just to answer my question instead of telling me that? 
Secondly, I ordered 2 bottled waters but then my bf told me to ask if we have to pay for the waters so I asked him and he said, " of course it's BOTTLED" and he didn't stop there yet! I told him to cancel the bottled waters and he laughed way too hard! What was funny about that? Just because I cancelled the BOTTLED waters after knowing that I have to pay for it, you had the right to make fun of me? Somebody needs to tell him how to treat his customers right!

This place was great. Had a punctured tire and needed a new one. They were polite and knowledgeable. They were jammed solid all day, but they squeezed me in to get it back to me before I had to leave town. I will most definitely come back here if I'm in the area and in need of tires!

It's always clean, and the staff is always nice. Getting to the location is a bit awkward, but perfectly doable. 

The food definitely matches national Chipotle standards of awesome.

Everything about our experience here a few months ago was top notch.  I live on the Hill and haven't been totally impressed by the pasta offerings to be honest.  The pizza around is very good but pasta is on the, eh, decent side.  We were seated a little bit after our reservation time, but nothing a few drinks at the bar couldn't solve.

We started with a couple glasses of wine and the calamari appetizer when we were seated.  Cooked perfectly and a crunchy crust--most of the time when I order fried calamari it comes out as rubber bands and a weak breading job.  We also split the butternut squash pizza.  It was much larger than we expected, and it was the star of the meal.  We also split the Rigatoni.  It was really good, although a bit rich for my tastes.  Either way, it was scrumptious.

Service was attentive and friendly.  We made out for $75, I believe, which wasn't bad for a few drinks and an entirely unnecessary amount of food.  The portions here are really generous.

All in all, will be returning, many many times.

This was a fantastic experience on a busy Saturday night. It was a trifecta in delicious food, wonderful atmosphere, and superb service. My party ordered the lamb tamale, Brussels sprouts, and queso empanadas. I tried all three, and they were among the best-tasting dishes I've had in a while. Livery is a must-visit eatery in the Mass Ave district.

The food is amazing, place is pretty, but the staff is unbelievably rude! I cant believe this type of customer service is even allowed. 
My suggestion is to order your food and leave becasue you dont want to miss out on their delicious pastry.. :)

Just spent a weekend with my wife at Peppermill.  Everything was top notch.  Room was great.  Bathroom outstanding.  Casino ton of fun and I lost money to boot!  Bimini great steak house and wife's fish was also good.  To many people wine about all the little things.  Over done décor, soft pillows, long check in line.  Get over it!  This place is great.

This is a really fun store to walk around in! Everything is super organized and displayed nicely. Staff is extremely friendly, too :) I love popping in here just to browse, mostly. They have tons of shoes and quite a large selection of vintage housewares. I'm always on the look out for Pyrex (the main reason I thrift) and I'm giving this place 4 stars only because the Pyrex is typically wayyyy over priced. Most of the pieces I recently saw here were in terrible condition (extreme fading/scratches to paint) and still priced $8+ (I recently found a mint condition yellow pyrex bowl for $1.50 at a Goodwill). Other than that, love this place and would totally recommend checking it out!
Visited due to the Yelp reviews. The food was good the chicken and waffles were delicious. Great customer service. Nice family owned establishment.
Great restaurant! Delicious food -  probably one of the best Italian food in the area , the only one thing that I don't like- it's always crowded and noisy... just like in Italy ;)

i love this place. i mean the memories i have of this place are amazing.

i try to take my wife here every year and will again this year.

i love how most of the house are really clever and also some cheeky humor is always funny.

Ok food, nothing special, it's a huge menu of all types of food, kind of like your poor man's Cheesecake factory.  Service was good, but not a place I feel the need to get back to.  The decor in the place seems to have been stuck in the 80's with random posters, plants, plywood walls.  I'm guessing it might be fun before a game to grab some drinks.

If you are considering hiring a mover for your long-distance move, I cannot stress this enough: DO NOT USE MAYFLOWER. Mayflower contracts everything out to local agencies, and the result is that the head doesn't know what the arms are doing. The movers failed to show up on my agreed-upon move date, and I had to do the legwork to call and find out what was going on. Now, my delivery day keeps getting moved back. This is partially because they keep loading other people's stuff onto the truck, and it has to make additional stops. The only response I get from anyone I speak to is, "We apologize." They offer a paltry $100 per day late delivery compensation, which isn't nearly enough to cover food and accommodations for two adults, an infant, and two dogs. Seriously, think twice before hiring Mayflower.
Great pedi! I was a walkin and they took me right back.  Reasonably priced and very friendly.  Great pedicure.  Highly recommend

1st time there. Haven't eaten at one since they had one in Miami, which was horrible and closed down. I was not the least bit impressed. Had to wait too long for a bottle of perrier. While my bf was already on his 2nd coke. We got the appetizer tower, it was decent. The sw egg rolls were good. The chicken tenders were rubbery. My boyfriend, a 6'4250 lb healthy eater ordered the red, white & blue 10 0z burger. Looked a,azing in menu. Not so much. Looked like 4 oz. Didn't even come close to filling bun. A few mishappened crumbles of bleu cheese and an onion ring. Blech. He couldn't even finish it. He never ever wastes food. He just didn't want anymore it was that pathetic. I ordered eggplant parm. Was so excited reading about the celebrity chef inspired dish. First they brought me the meatball sandwich. Oopsy. How does that sound similar to eggplant parm? Then I had to wait another 10 minutes while m bf picked apart his awful burger for my correct dish to arrive. The sauce was good, The mozzerella was high quality fresh mozzarella. But the eggplant was greasy, overfried and tasteless. Nothing like the menu description promised. Wasn't even garnished with fresh basil like the menu said. I ate a little. Luckily my bf enjoyed it way more than his pathetic burger. No apology, nothing comped, no nothing. So unimpressed. The place was almost deserted too. No excuse for this place to be that awful. Definitely overpriced. Will never go back.
Great music.  Reasonable beer prices.  Triple over-inflated cocktails.  Scant indoor seating.

Fantastic... I just arrived in NO for the first time and made a stop at the Creole House for a quick beer. When I ordered a typical domestic beer my bartender Beast refused to let me have on but instead suggested I try a local craft beer. The beer was awesome, I let him order my food and he brought me Oysters and Gator bites and both were spectacular. Beast was so fun, professional and knowledgeable about the menu, town and gave me many great suggestions. I liked the experience so much I returned for dinner.

They changed chefs and the food is allot better... I got asked to return after a coworker suggested we go. Had the meat lovers sandwich, friends had chicken, pulled pork and brisket. We were all happy!

These are some of the BEST cookies I have ever had. I bought a six pack of snickerdoodles and chocolate chips and ate them up faster than I should have. They are gooey and warm and definitely don't skimp on quality. I can't wait to go back and try an ice cream sandwich! I would recommend this place over Insomnia Cookies.

This place is one of the BEST Asian snack and dessert cafés in Tampa!  I fell in love with the Halo Halo the second I saw the Yelp! reviews and tasted it!  It is above all Asian desserts that I ever had in southern CA, and I've eaten a lot of boba, shaved ice, coconut, agar, tapioca, beans, and ice cream!
Now this place has a frequent Halo Halo card. Buy 10, get 1 free!  You must try the desserts or drinks here.
I finally tried the food only offered on the weekend. Wow, it is homemade, delicious, and $5!  I had the Sinampalukang Manok, a chicken stew. I felt as if an Auntie had cooked it for me!
This cafe is bright with beautiful Filipino scenery and food pictures. The family and friends working there are very nice. There's a dessert guy who serves generously.
Saigon Cafe is nearby and super popular.  I prefer the Filipino Cafe. More quiet and home cooking to me. Being Vietnamese, I've had it all. Except for Halo Halo!

I have to say that I live in this neighborhood and I love that I can walk to the Santa Fe.  In fact, I walk by here often, so the sight of the place is just so familiar it has a very homey feeling to me.  The owners are a cute little couple that can often be seen sitting outside on off hours with their little dog.  They are friendly to all that pass.  If you like to take your dog to your meals with you, this would be a good spot.  

My favorite meal by far has been the brunch.  I absolutely love having the Sunday brunch here.  At this point I always order the huevos rancheros, yes it is expensive (over $10), but the platter is huge.  With two perfectly cooked eggs, plenty of black beans layered on a tostada it is beyond filling.  It also comes with a hearty portion of potatoes and peppers.  If you like to drink they have also been offering $1 mimosas.  

The lunch/dinner food has been satisfactory.  As a vegetarian option the grilled vegetable quesadilla is both flavorful and filling.   

This is a great place in the Bayou St John neighborhood to sit outside, have a nice meal and people watch.
this place is amazing and surprisingly delicious...fresh food. and very clean. the staff is friendly...plz come try it..u won't be sorry

I've been going to Bimmerworks since 2007. Steve and his team do great work and really know BMWs. What I like about Steve is that I don't think he tries to sell me stuff I don't need (for example, the dealer told me I was a good candidate for some sort of fuel system flush...I called Steve and he said I didn't need it with my low mileage. He easily could have gone along with it and taken my money, but he didn't). Bottom line - I trust him. I 100% recommend anyone with a BMW to go to Bimmerworks for routine maintenence as well as larger repairs (unless you just enjoy paying more at a dealer).
Very nice Tucktaway spot in West chester. Great service outstanding beer. Plenty of parking in an outdoor eating area that is dog friendly.

Sorry, my first experience here was not good.  I came because I heard Happy was there.

The food was generally OK.  My chicken was surely reheated and rubbery.  My wife actually felt rather ill.  The naan was a bit damp and limp.  My wife had the korma and it was poor.

I am actually going to try this again though because I have faith in Happy.  The food at Shagun WHEN HE WAS THERE was phenomenal.

I don't understand the 1 star reviews on here.  I live in the neighborhood and am in Ippolito's a few times a month.  I have never had anything less than fresh fish here.  I tend to buy from the market side and cook my own food.  That being said, I have had cooked dishes here that were not amazing, but never anything I would not eat again.  On the fresh side, I have never bought anything that wasn't first grade when I got it home.  If I'm out and walking the dog, even if I had not planned on food shopping, I stop in Ippolito's just to see what the special are and what's for sale.

It take three qualities to run a successful restaurant, great food, great customer service, and a clean/beautiful place. Cafe Soleil has all three of these. With an amazing relaxing atmosphere and flavorful food you drift off to a heaven that has relaxing music. The customer service is amazing and the food is fresh. I will be back.

I went to the Twisted Tail after hitting a few other places earlier in the evening.  I was having a cool evening with friends and we happy to find this cool place to bring our night to a close.  It was super crowded, but we hung out and stood real close to a few people sitting at the bar and they finally got the hint and we grabbed their seats....LOL

Although it was busy, the bar keep and was patient and friendly.  I enjoyed the energy of the patrons and I think it was because it was different age groups here and that was a nice balance.  
We ordered some appetizers and drinks and both we pretty good.  I had the lamb meatballs and friends had the cheese plate.  

I would go back to really enjoy the atmosphere when it is less crowded.  I also like the neighborhood.

Wow! This place is awesome! There is so much history and the designs of the restaurant is so intriguing. We were there for a nice dinner and the sever took his time to explained the famous stories of the place. It was busy and there were plenty of workers so we were being treated very well. I got the toasted duck plate and it was absolutely delicious! I would highly recommend checking this restaurant out if you're in New Orleans.

My first time coming here was an absolute fail. Messed up orders, almost 40 minutes to get the table's food and the server didn't even know what roll was what. That was about 9 months ago. My wife and I decided to give Sushi Rose another try today, and it was a great decision. Upon walking in, we see a banner that reads "One free small beer when you check in on Yelp at Sushi Rose" so I feel as if I instantly won already. 

Our chef was nice and pretty fast, only got held up when we ordered something from the kitchen. The rolls are good and my favorite part is they're small. I enjoy the small size of the rolls makes it so you can eat a lot of rolls and try out all the different options. Also, they don't over pack each roll with rice, I'd has each roll has about half as much as most other sushi places. With less rice, you get most fish and other ingredients. I'd recommend their Mountain Roll and Tiger Rolls. Desert, the tempura banana is awesome as well, definitely a good way to end the meal! 

Definitely will be coming back again soon!
I come here regularly for manicures, pedicures, & some waxing. Love Phong & Tram! Good selection of gel colors. Great attention to detail :)

Food was good and reasonably priced. I had a special, shrimp and chips the portion was oversized. My son had a chicken sandwich which was average. The soft pretzels were hot, and delicious. The atmosphere is a bar so it was loud. But overall not a bad place.

Absolutely the best Thai food! Their garden rolls are amazing, they have this delicious radish on them. Cashew chicken is my favorite or their curries. Plus their Thai ice tea is really good, sweeter than usual. Parking is hard and the crowd is big so get there early.

Great selection of vegetarian and meat wraps, tacos, house favs like Bibimbap, spicy fried rice, kimchee, dumplings, salads, they even serve spam!  Reasonable price.  Accepts all payment  Crowded!  Line is forming as I write this review.  Vein from Hawaii, I highly recommend this eatery.  You will not be disappointed.

I went in free eye exam and 2- pair of glasses at 69.99 I ended up paying $321 for one pair of glasses single vision bio focal.after I told the girl I couldn't afford to spend 371. For one pair. I feel like this is false advertising and my experience was not very good ... the girl seemed annoyed when I told her I didn't expect to spend that much. I would not recommend going here I was very disappointed.
Super cool local coffee shop. Great customer service, the coffee is amazing, and the muffins melt in your mouth. This is a weekly hot spot for me!

On Dec. 26, my wife and I had 6PM reservations at this restaurant... supposedly a more casual version of the mother restaurant, Galatoire's, right next door. We had intended to have take part in their Reveillon special... a fixed menu that many New Orleans restaurants run from Dec. 1st - 31st... we were pretty much dressed business casual... but I did have on black jeans... there is no dress code there, but we looked pretty good. My guess is the awful waitress thought we were tourists (we live less than 4 blocks away from the restaurant) and for some reason, she didn't want her table taken up by us... even though the place was pretty empty at the time... this witch of a waitress flat out lied to us, saying that Reveillon had ended on Christmas at their and all of the other restaurants... we were quite mystified but accepted it and left... ended up eating sushi at at little place on Decatur. 

Anyway, while planning our New Year's Eve, I had been looking through Nola.com and discovered that Reveillon was indeed still going at not only Galatoire's 33, but all the other restaurants. This despicable waitress (I wish I could remember her name) at this over-priced restaurant deserves to have its business go in the take... the laughable kicker in the whole situation... my wife is a best selling travel author (numerous travel guides to her name, including a best selling New Orleans guide for Moon Handbooks). Don't give you business to this snobby, greedy restaurant or its mother restaurant... don't support anyone that would lie to customers simply to keep their tables open for someone who would pay their high prices vs going with the fixed meal price of Reveillon... pathetic!

Very, very disappointed. I had heard great reviews on this bar but upon visiting I can assure you I won't be back. Once we finally found a spot at the bar not one bartender even spoke to us let alone asked us what we wanted to drink.  In the twenty minutes we waited on one drink on an averagely busy day two couples came to the bar and then left because no service was shown. The drink prices were very high and only mediocre in taste/appearance. Sorry to have to write a poor review.

My family has been going to Anthony Jewelers for years, but my most recent experience promoted me to write a review. 
I had a ring resized and when I got it back there was a small flaw in the design that wasn't there before. They took it back and made the repairs free of charge then shipped the ring to me (I don't live in New Jersey, but my family still does). 

Love that they take time to get to know the customers and keep up with your family. Thanks to Tom for helping me out.

Do not come here the music terrible, the manager is terrible, and the price is to high. I was here for a birthday party and the kids were yelling and screaming like kids do and, a lady told the kids mother and other parents that they need it to shut up because they were messing up her concentration...Not Cool.
Surprised at how bland the food is. It was a real disappointed. Atmosphere was good and in the good neighhood.
First time having tapas and they were delicious. The server was knowledgeable on nearby attractions and they served local microbrews. Win, win!
Service is SLOW. Waitress was sleepy. Ignored my request for mild spices. Food arrived WAY too spicey. Wake up, waitress! Listen to me when I say "MILD spice."

Casual and classy at the same time, The Three Muses has a wonderfully eclectic menu. For those that shy away from the sazerac, try their orange blossom version - you'd never have tasted whiskey with that hint of orange before! The food was excellent - melt in the mouth mac and cheese and soft tofu bulgogi. The service was discreet, yet prompt, the best combination. And last but not the least, the live music took the ambiance to a whole new level! The French duo playing on the night we were there were Norbert Slama and Raphael Bas, and I can't thank them enough for making this one of the meals I'll remember for a long, long time!

Quality and food selection = 5 stars
Customer service = 0 stars

A quick stop here after a Blues game for a munchie turned into one of the rudest customer services I've ever experienced.

I stopped in their bathroom first and was disappointed to see that there was not a hook to hang my purse.  Seeing no other flat spots, I sat it on the floor before realizing the floor was soaked with some kind of liquid that didn't appear to be clear.  I quickly snatched it up, finished and went out to grab what I needed.

While checking out, I told the cashier that their restroom wasn't very clean and it needed immediate attention.  He stared straight through me like I was crazy and only talked to my husband.  He mumbles he was going to pass along my concerns to the lady running the self-check out, we see him telling her and she literally just stares me down.  I said aloud that if my purse is discolored I would be back the next day to complain and they continued to stare at me.

I have never had more rude customer service than I did tonight.  I am not a stranger to retail an usually you are told the customer is always right and everything will be done to make sure they are happy.  I did not walk away feeling like this.

Luckily this was just on the way home from a game.  I will probably not return to this one unless I absolutely have to.

It's worse than I thought
Their "chicken" is processed stuff
Fake chewy "meat" -- Yech!
Great pizza for a small town.

I got their jalapeno cheese tots and a two piece fried chicken. The jalapeno cheese fritter was delicious, I would buy that everytime I decide to go to church's again. The chicken too was well cooked but I could not feel the spice in their batter. I am guessing they messed up my order for some reason, which is ok. Its a fast food chain and I got my order placed at the drive through.

I've been to other church's chicken and this was the first time I had an experince worth sharing. 

FYI, Nashville has tons of places for hot chicken and for whatever reason you can't go there, this would be a good alternative.
Quaint. seemed kind of picked over but that might be because it was the end of tourist season. I think they need to restock. Good variety. Nice local conversation. Friendly people. reasonable prices.

The food is decent if overpriced, the beer acceptable, the customer service varies. I enjoy the live music more than anything. In my humble opinion, there needs to be more variety in the beer offered. Bring back Scottish Ale!

I am a regular customer at remedy however this location is horrible. They don't have enough staff in the back to get people's order out. I ordered and waited 30 minutes just for a take out. The worst part is, three people behind me had their ordered filled and mine was probably sitting in the back. The lady didn't even apologize, she just said.. We are busy but there was no line up. Frustrated.. Going to a better remedy location.  Avoid the attitude.

Adding to this review two days later. Yup, it happened. Got an INFECTION by my nail bed on my pointer finger. In the photo you can also see how my nails were cut at a slant and not straight. Not even filed into a shape.
Exquisite food bursting with a perfect blend of flavors. The chef has a special talent, and we are lucky that he shares it with us here. Outdoor seating is a nice new addition.

We had great experience at this place today. We arrived around 1:30 pm. The place was quite full. We had about 4 people (two groups) ahead of us. We just waited at the entrance for 10 minutes or so. We were seated and served quite promptly. All the dishes were really large and good. My waffle and chicken was superb.  Veggie home fries was awesome. All in all great experience!

I came across Newk's Eatery at the Lobster Festival that was held at the Kapok Tree venue in Clearwater. I read good reviews about the restaurant so I was glad to see them there. The food was very good especially the Shrimp salad that my new friend and I had. Plus the Lobster Bisque was excellent.

However, the service was not. Closed to closing of the festival my friend who was a vendor there told me that they had lowered their prices. So I want over there. The manager told me the price for the shrimp salad went down to $7.00 from $10.00. So I purchased two of them. I should have been charged $14.00 plus tax. You would think so. Instead the manager charged me the full price and it came out to be $21.50. Big difference. I complained to the manager at the booth and she did nothing. I called the store later and spoke to Tim the manager on duty and explained it to him and he told me to call back on Monday. I call the store on Monday and spoked to the General Manager who happened to be the same person that was at the booth at the show and she said she would refund my money. I was only interested in the difference between what I was charged and what I should have been charged.
The manager said she would give me a full refund. That was Monday. It is now Thursday and I am still waiting.

This is the place I go for consistently good BBQ. My favorites include the burnt ends and smoked jalapeños. They will let you sample the sides if you ask - which is great! For ice snobs - they got the good stuff! They also have a tempting variety of sweets but it is hard to save space with food this good.

"Beeeeeeeessttt in the UNIVERSE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!" was the recommendation I got from a friend local to this place.

Not...exactly....but the pursuit of such things is admirable.   They are definitely trying and succeeding at being more than a common Mexican restaurant.  

You can tell that the place was converted from a breakfast type place from the past.  If you notice that then you will notice that they made every effort to soften each and every corner of the place to make their own theme.

The food is creative.  Many choice for breakfast including my two-tone eggs (green sauce on one egg, red on the other) with chorizo potatoes, and cactus thingys.  A whole range of omelets, enchiladas, etc etc.

Try it

Dafe
I just had the best Panang curry that I've ever put in my mouth. The Tom Yum soup was excellent. I tasted my friend's green curry with chicken, which was also amazing.

I ate at Farmer Boy this morn - use to come here many many years ago and loved it back then so decided to stop in again as I was in town for Fiesta.

Breakfast was deeeelicious! Eggs and potatoes and bacon was all quality and not greasy like other places can be...It still has a great small town diner feel that has been updated...  Booth seat was comfortable and wait staff were all very friendly and accommodating... It's not a huge space but has tables, booths and a counter.  Cost was average.

The mushroom swiss burger was great, I added sauteed onions. The service was really good, our waitress checked on us several times and made sure we had everything we needed. Nice meal after a day hiking the tanque verde falls!
Ted Drewes is the best! Dutch Apple caramel pecans I can't remember, but it was good! Can't wait to go back.

It's been better. the food used to wow,, now it's ok. Loaded waffle fries half the size they used to be and wrong ones served, had to be sent back,,, waited,, waited,,, waited,,,  wings nothing special. too many places in Nashville to be average, probably won't be back.

I've only gotten delivery from this place, but they've become my standby. Delivery time is ridiculously fast, and my food always arrives molten-hot and delicious.  The egg drop soup is tasty without being overly salty. I love their spring rolls and steamed dumplings. And the Hunan Shrimp earns five stars by itself - perfectly seared-yet-tender shrimp with crisp vegetables and delicious brown sauce. It's my new favorite. The only disappointing dish I've ever had from there was kung pao chicken. Like someone else said, the veggies were good but the chicken was a little off. I've since stuck to other choices (like Singapore noodles) and haven't been disappointed.
Usually enjoy this place a lot. I asked for burger medium and it was close to burnt. Burgers are usually spot on.
Love this place!  I always get one of the pasta specials or the pescatore in white sauce over linguine.

This is the place for biscuits and gravy. Yum. Takes alittle time once you order to get your food however its cooked to order.  If you get here early especially on the weekends there can be along wait.

Service is horrible. We called in a reservation but once we got there they said we would have to wait 2 hours to be seated. There were probably 4 tables seated in the restaurant. The host had the worst attitude and was completely rude and told me it didn't matter if I had a reservation. The next day I went and picked up an order since everyone kept talking about how good the food is. Walked in and was never approached by anyone. I had to ask someone to help me after a few minutes and she was worse than the guy that was rude to us the day before. After looking at me up and down and giving me a dirty look she got my food and cashed me out. I asked her for a receipt and you would think it was the end of the world. She went in the back and didn't come back for almost 10 minutes with my receipt. The food was ok. I will never go back to even try the rest of the food and will be sure to let everyone else know to not waste their time on that bs.

Girls night out in Philly brought us to Sbraga. We arrived early for our 7pm reservation and were seated right away. We started with cocktails which were lovely. The popover and foie gras soup was such a great start. The soup was just the right amount  (though honestly I wanted more...) and had such a velvety texture. I loved the way the flavor built the more you tasted. Really great! The three of us all ordered different items and no one was disappointed. Standouts included the capicola mousse, the fettuccine with rabbit, the rigatoni with pork shoulder, the salmon and the Bavarian dessert. Our server was just attentive enough - there when she was needed but not overwhelming. We never felt rushed or crowded and even when the place was full it didn't feel overwhelmingly loud or cramped. I would happily return if I find myself looking for a fine dining experience in Philly again!

I have only been here twice but I loved it each time. Both times I opted for dishes with the duck confit. It's nice to be able to get something normally served at fancier restaurants. The croughnuts or dossants...can't remember what they call them here, are sublime. Worthy of a cheat day, for sure!!

I have now visited this establishment twice and have thoroughly enjoyed them both. First the service is top notch and friendly. They are attentive but don't constantly bug you with questions. Both times I got great suggestions on the beer I might want to try and also on food.

I like their pizza a lot but their flagship for me is their Fish and Chips. The cod is top quality and you can tell as soon as you bite into it.

Cool Springs Brewery will definitely be one of our regular eating places.

Update 7/8/16
Have regularly visited this place now for 3 years and still love it. Besides the Cod and Chips I have grown quite fond of their Bangers and Mash. For appetizers I have yet to find one that I don't like. My favorites are Stuffed Mushroom and Calimari. Have never tried a desert because I have always been too full.

The best hotel experience I've ever had, beats Ritz Carlton any day! Sam Jung at the door remembered our entire family's name, got us everything we needed, gave great advice, even brought us some wine to our room (at no charge!)!!! The amazing lady at the fest let us check in two ours early and gave us a ridiculously cool room. Honestly, our stay was 100% flawless, I would not change one millisecond about it. This has been and will be my favorite hotel in the world, and I've been to many!!

My search across the city to find the best fit for my eyebrows has finally come to an end. I've had issues in the past with the lack of arch and taking too much off of the top. Thankfully, a can honestly say my eyebrows are perfect. The name says it all!
The ice cream here is awesome!!  You really can't beat it. Their fries are amazing as well. Definitely worth the trip out to New Pal for lunch, dinner, or just ice cream!
I got the #4 w/shredded beef and corn tortillas(the best I've had) my daughter had hard shell tacos she loved them rice was great and love their got sauces.
Let me start by saying I love Indian food. I have been looking for a consistently good Indian restaurant since moving out of the city and I have found it. Everything is fresh and delicious.

It is wonderful to be newly aware that something is possible. I had never conceived of salt fish, coconut, and a slightly sweet sandwich bun as a breakfast food. Brown Sugar made a compelling argument to me that not only is such a thing possible, but that is desirable. Similarly, I knew that in the Caribbean South Asian cuisine could mix with African and South American cuisines into something original and delightful. I had had chapatis. I had had thick African stews. I was familiar with jerk chicken. But a roti, a delightful, substantial combination of all three? Amazing! 

I have no real basis to compare Brown Sugar with other Trini food, but for 6 bucks you can do a lot worse than a chicken or goat roti.

Highly recommend! 

I ordered the SB dog that had bacon, crema, grilled onions, tomatoes, avocado and cilantro. 

It was so delicious that both my friend and myself went up and ordered another one. 

Dave himself is an absolute joy.
This is without a doubt my new go-to spot.

He also has specials! And rumor has it next weeks is mac n cheese!

Go here- you will be so happy you did.
This place is absolutely delicious! I had the pumpkin ice cream and my husband had the marionberry cream soda. Both were so good we wanted seconds. Worth the money.

We came on a week night so it was slow but that only added to the quiet ambiance which we were looking for. However its easy to see why this place could be packed and popular as it is a trendy place to hang out. Torn as the burgers for the price are tiny and are more like sliders so that's a 3 star but again the decor of the place and the positive experience overall comes out at 4 stars. Worth a visit if your in the area.

The worst service I have ever experienced. .... waited 30min only thing we got was some plates and wait a moment. ... man we just trying to get a drink.... my boy went to the bar and he was like I saw yall over there but we don't have anyone here..... What.....

I really wish I could base this review on the food, but I didn't even get a chance to order.

Initially, I looked at the menu for Mood Cafe, but accidentally called Desi Chaat House. I decided to just roll with the mistake and order.

After picking up the chaat from Desi Chaat House, I thought, "Damn, that Dhokla chaat on Mood Cafe's menu sounded bangin' and I could eat 3 orders of chaat by myself!"

I call Mood Cafe and no one picks up. Maybe, they're busy.

I go inside and there are two customers sitting down awaiting their order. The worker was behind the counter with his back turned making their lassi, so I just say hi -- not rushing you or anything. He turns around, looks at me, and goes back to work.

Alright, whatever. Maybe he wasn't in a chaat-y mood?

Another customer rolls in and walks to the counter. The worker suddenly comes over to him to shoot the shit like they're old friends.

Nope, I'm out.

I've worked retail before. I can understand if you're busy and can't pick up the phone or take down my order right away. But ignoring me and then dropping what you're doing to talk to someone who came in afterwards was just bad customer service.

From other reviews that I've read, the owner is fine and friendly, but the younger employee isn't -- especially, when it is just him there.

I'll update the review if/when I get to actually try out the place.

Edited for clarity, because someone/Yelp thinks that I posted this to the wrong restaurant.

I love this place not only is the atmosphere fun but the food is great.  every time I come here I love whatever I order. My new spot! Btw playroom for kids!!!! and Byob for adults (enough reason to try it out!!!!)

This, ladies and gents, is a bar. Fantastic beer variety ranging from local to national to European. Service was great, and loved the dim atmosphere. What caught me off guard was their fantastic food options. Their regular menu has some tasty sounding items, but then they have an extensive specials menu as well. I had a special crawfish etouffee that was simply divine and absolutely traditional. This dish could certainly have held its own down on the Gulf Coast.

Whether a local or a visitor (like me), this place is a must stop. Plus they play some great tunes on top of it all. A bit pricy, but you're getting what you pay for.

Blunders every time. My husband has been using this compounding pharmacy, under the recommadation of his post cancer doctor, for an injectable compound.  Each time we drove the 70 miles to this pharmacy, there was an issue.  Come to find out, the pharmacy has a"relationship" with the the doctor, as long as the patient remains under his care.  If the patient chooses to go with another doctor, the pharmacy changes the cost and extras given with the rx.  This last visit was our last, having been misinformed by a staff member over the phone, then no call back when told they would look into the script, we have again faced another blunder with Westchase Compounding Pharmacy.  Today, there are far too many choices in compounding pharmacies to use one that makes this type of errors over and over.

One of my favorites. I used to love coming here to get work done or even read. Big windows, lots of tables, annd outlets galore. The coffee was good. The drinks Ive tried have always been delicious. The ambiance - just perfect. Loved sitting here at night - bright lights, big tables, just the right background music. Open till 10 pm. Plus less crowded in the evening hours.
 I love my coffee shops and this is def one of them.

I had the special avocado eggs Benedict and it was delicious. It had a mashed avocado spread and bacon as opposed to a traditional eggs Benedict. It was very good and I recommend it. I also had the iced chocolate and it was delicious and refreshing. It tastes just like a chocolate milk with ice cream in it. I will definitely be back here again for brunch. Everyone was very friendly and it was a good experience.

The staff here are fantastic. The very polite and friendly woman who works the register will remember your name and ask how you're doing. There's a genuinely caring ma-and-pa vibe to the service here.

The specialty slices are excellent. The plain and pepperoni slices aren't the best in Swedesboro, but stellar options like stuffed cheesesteak and tomato pie more than make up for this. The paninis and fries are great too.

Just stopped for lunch today and the pizza was delicious and fresh. Definitely will be back the location is great get to watch people coming and going on the trail.
I'll be back!!!!
Fabulous! Delicious food and great service. It would be five stars, but for the hour plus wait.
Great local grocery store with affordable prices and friendly owners!  Go check them out and support a fantastic local business.
This buffet had a great selection of food. The staff was friendly and always keep our drinks full. Great for groups and if your local you get a discount.

What happened to Larry's?  The woman at the counter is one miserable specimen.  It used to be one of my go-to places for cheesesteaks.  I frequently traveled from South Philly to buy sandwiches, but on my last few visits, the experience was horrible.  There is a new cook who simply is unskilled or uncaring about making sandwiches.  This lack of skill or disdain shows up in the quality of the food.  The woman that takes the orders gets more miserable by the visit.  The cook has changed and it is not for the better.  My last visit I had a confrontation with the cook about pickles on the side.  Even the other employees seemed embarrassed that this was going on.  If you have heard of Larry's reputation for great food, please move on.  That day has passed and the customer service absolutely sucks.  It's sad to see a well regarded establishment come to this!  I read in other reviews that the management changed and it has.  When the Girard Avenue store opened, I thought it was a lousy place to be piggy-backing off the Larry's name, but now the 54th Street store has fallen to its level instead of the other way around.

This review won't make much of a difference because it's IHOP, however I have to express how terrible this IHOP location actually is. I have been to this IHOP on 4 separate occasions and every single time there has been something wrong with my order. IT WAS ALWAYS WRONG, EVERY TIME. The international house of pancakes shouldn't be screwing up pancakes. When I order sausage they give me bacon. When I order chocolate chip pancakes they give me blueberry. Missing eggs and hash browns, I could go on....I can't tell if its a language barrier or laziness but this location has screwed up both my dine-in and take-out orders literally every time I have given them a try. How many times can one apologize for incompetence? That location is mostly for the guest at the adjoining hotel, locals know better. I won't be going back. The location a few miles down on veterans is much much better.

Paul in the Chanel makeup counter was fabulous.  He is extremely knowledgeable and takes the time to give you exactly what you are looking for as far as colors etc. 
I highly recommend him.  I previously had bought items from Ruthie who seemed just as knowledgeable.  
You will not be disappointed.

I just discovered this place, and I've already eaten there twice.  The owner says the restaurant is affiliated with the Thai place next to One Shell Square downtown, and I love that place too.  The Mee Crob is a subtle curry dish with cabbage, carrots, mushrooms, and noodles served with shrimp and beef or pork.  I can't tell which.  The texture of the rice noodles is like nothing I've had before.  They start out slightly crunchy, then as the meal progresses they absorb the creamy curry sauce, and become more - well noodley.  The crunchy cabbage and carrots work with the noodles to provide a very pleasing texture, while the creamy curry sauce comes around from the side while you're not looking, and really fills out the dish.  The spring rolls have cucumber and rice noodles in them, and are served with crumbled peanuts and a unique sweet and sour sauce as opposed to the usual plum sauce.  The Pad Thai likewise is less spicy than Pad Thai I've had at other restaurants, and this lets the flavors of the fresh ingredients show themselves.

The place has two outdoor tables on the porch, and inside the decor is modern and clean in a renovated-uptown-house sort of way.  The bathroom was very clean and spacious, and the staff are friendly and efficient.  My only issue is there is no parking, so you have to park in the neighborhood, and walk there.  No big issue really for me, but there it is.  Prices for lunch are about $9 while prices for dinner run between $8 and $20.  I highly recommend this place, and I want it to succeed, so I can return there for a long time.

Fantastic food, great prices, great service. 

You can really tell this is a small restaurant that offers food at low prices when the baked goods counter is nearly empty by 11AM. Face it people, they can't afford to throw away food at the end of day just to ensure they have everything available in the afternoon. You get the feeling that Chef Dan really cares for the restaurant, and does his best to ensure everything is top notch.  

I've been here over a dozen times, and only once had a merely acceptable meal, where I got some gristle in a pulled pork sandwich. I've had that sandwich 4-5 times so I attribute it to a bad batch of meat from the supplier. Every other meal has been excellent, from the huge omlette's, to the thick and delicious french toast, to the breakfast cuban... 

Servers are friendly, although there are times when all the tables are full that you may end up waiting a few more minutes, but it's well worth it. I only hope that they get more space someday, but it's great the way it is now... low overhead means we get great food at low prices. This is definitely a hidden Gem in Reno...

They're going to start dinner service soon, can't wait.

It is truly a shame! The food is great. I love their Chicago Style pizza and wings. The service is terrible. This has not just been a one time occurrence. We have had poor service the past couple times we have been there. It takes forever to get anything, and it seems like the staff is more worried about having a good time than serving the customers. You have to ask for everything at Uno Pizzeria & grill. The prices are relatively high considering the poor service we received. I do not recommend going to Uno Pizzeria & Grill in Oaks, PA.

Apparently a call ahead isn't what I thought...according to the turning point. Although, another review states otherwise. I called ahead, (90 minutes prior) and arrived and was told it would take an hour to be seated. I was a bit confused and asked why so long, and the hostess said the call ahead didn't really matter, it takes into affect when I arrive....that made absolutely no sense. I left. I have been here before and the food was okay, not the best and two wait an extra hour after my call ahead and getting the response from the host was unacceptable.
Wow. Terrible. Pasta conBroccoli was nothing more than warm milk. Crust on pie ok,,,sauce had no flavor. Toppings were usual. Never again.

I suggest calling 45 minutes ahead if you want to order pizza. It takes a bit of a wait to get your pizza because it's more of a pub than a pizza joint.

However, the pizza is worth it. The Chicago style is enormous. I can't finish more than one slice. The sauce (according to a Vegan friend) is Vegan in nature. But I don't really care about that: this is good stuff. I suggest the hand-tossed style of pizza. I think it's more enjoyable than a slice of Chicago indulgence, since it's more comfortable to carry around in your stomach when you go into the game room for a round of shuffle board.

Always find what we're looking for!! Associates are always friendly too. I must be lucky since I seem to go in during BOGO 50% off That helps the wallet. I highly recommend you check out this shoe store. Selection, pricing and assistance if needed is all there. 2 prs of sneaks this time 'round-

Basically, this place is simply awesome and never disappoints! The first time I came here was a Monday night after a Cardinals game and it was not as busy as we thought it would be. The staff are all friendly and helpful, always smiles on their faces. Our waiter was very specific in explaining how their menu worked and the history about the restaurant, which is amazing. I have tried almost everything on their menu besides the newest burgers in the burger showdown every week :) I love the idea of that by the way! Everything there is organic, grown just for them, or either made by scratch by them. They never ever disappoint, and I go there almost every weekend with my friends. I simply love this place. Owner David Bailey is truly an icon in St.Louis for owning and running all 4 of his amazing restaurants! BIG FAN!

The store and employees are fine. In fact, a couple of the employees are VERY fine...as in "sexy as hell." But all these complaints about the pharmacy are 100% accurate. They never act with any sense of urgency, even though the line of customers is usually at least 5 deep, and they display almost zero empathy. When you call, you're always on hold for at least a couple minutes before you end up talking to someone who sounds too bored to be bothered. 

My doctor said they sent a prescription to CVS a few days ago. I still hadn't received the call from CVS telling me that it's ready. I just called and a girl (who sounded too tired to fully form words) managed to tell me that she sees it in the system. She said they can fill it today if I'd like to pick it up. I said, "Well, yeah." Her response: "It'll be about an hour to ninety minutes." 

#1. WHY WOULD IT TAKE 90 MINUTES TO PUT PILLS IN A BOTTLE?! 
#2. WHY DID THEY NOT FILL THE RX WHEN IT ORIGINALLY CAME IN FROM MY DOCTOR?!

The answer to both questions is "incompetence."

Went here for lunch - was told that the lunch portions were 60% the size of the normal entrees and 60% of the price.  Well, these portions were SCANT - not even appetizer sized.  We got 6 shrimps!  That's almost $2 per shrimp!  Now, I've been to the Han Dynasty in Old City and what we got was probably 30% the size of their entrees.  Price-wise, both Sang Kee and Peking are closer to me and more affordable for lunch so probably I will not venture here anytime soon.  I feel like for 2 people to get full, you need either 4 lunch portions or 2 dinner entrees.

Also, we did not get the second entree until we had mostly finished the first one - thank goodness we were sharing!

That and the whole atmosphere is weird.  I understand not changing the Midatlantic decor much for cost reasons, but playing ambient electronic pop?  I'd expect that maybe for a frozen yogurt shop or some new age vegetarian restaurant, but not a Szechuan restaurant, and certainly not Han's restaurant!

The only reason this did not get a lower rating is because the food was still tasty - what little of it there was.

While the pizza here is good and the delivery is speedy, this restaurant's customer service skills is lacking, to say the least. Today I ordered a pizza and a two liter soda paying $2.50 for the soda for the convenience. The delivery person forgot my soda and said he'd be right back. So I waited....after 20 minutes I called the restaurant. The man who answered made it sound as if it was my privilege to wait. Of course, the delivery person had other deliveries so I would have to wait. Which I did....after 30 minutes I called the delivery person who also made me feel like a dick for being upset that they got my order wrong and that they made me wait. He still had not gone back to Allegro to get my soda (which was only 8 blocks away). So I waited....50 minutes later my soda arrived.
Okay so I am down visiting my dad and the pizza was fabulous the spaghetti was good even thou they were out of both angel hair and meat sauce over all still 5 stars

This place makes J Crew look like Wall Mart.  They are the old guard haberdasher of Up Town.  I like to shop here for some reason, I think it may be because it is a bit of an anthropological fascination.  It's just fun to hear the snooty staff mingle with their regular  (as in third generation of regular) customers.  
I was all but ignored for a while in the store- even pushing Miriam in her stroller.  It was her "snap and go" a slightly generic looking model that we use when we travel.  I was clad in my Jazz Fest casual- long sleeve button down and Target khaki knickers.  Not the typical garb of the typical customer.  I waited for fifteen minutes for the shoe salesman to process a return and then got fitted for a pair of bucks.  I had to leave my credit card at the counter while I shopped for more clothes (huh?).  I got a super fly  Tailorbyrd long sleeve, and some sweet Madras shorts.  When the old bird that was assisting me at this point realized that I had already bought a pair of shoes she suddenly got a bit friendlier.  This might explain the great service I got from them when I got fitted for a suit several years ago (as in don't expect a nod if you're only looking at boxers).   I would have to say it was a pleasent shopping experience and I had a very cordial interaction with said bird.  There is always a lot of love when Miriam is around though.
I haven't been upstairs where they also have kids and women's clothes.  I will have to check next time, if only to get a good fix of some more of that idle moneyed Southern belle phenomenon.

I really love Jesse's. I've been eating here for 20 years and I've been having consistently great food for 20 years. I can always count on having a good steak. Their shrimp entrees come with the plumpest shrimp around. Great service and affordable drinks. I would definitely recommend Jesse's!
I love getting a mani/pedi at the Salon de Belleza.  I always schedule my appointments with Cindy she is wonderful.  And Rose the owner is conscientious to every detail in the salon.

This is the most deserving five starts I have ever given. While visiting New Orleans I found district donates via a hashtag on Instagram. BEST DISCOVERY OF OUR TRIP. After all the bloody Mary's, memos as, crawfish ... These donuts were so exceptional.  The store does a rotation of seven donuts and has everything from wedding cake to s'mores to maple bacon. I was a little apprehensive at first because I thought they would be over the top sweet/filling, but I am telling your, they weren't!!! District donuts does it right. Oh and after our donuts we went back and ordered a fried chicken slide and a burger slider that were just as impressive.

The food, service, and management here are phenomenal. It's very nice to see a manager actually managing and directing, opposed to just standing around. The managers here also know how to handle a customers complaint properly and respectfully. This is the reason I gave five stars even though there was an issue with my visit. I came in for a late lunch on Sunday and sat at the bar. I was immediately greeted by a friendly bartender (Candy), and order a fried grouper sandwich with fires and coleslaw. The food came out very fast and everything was delicious. The grouper filet was huge, breaded properly, and not greasy ! The fries were seasoned, crisp, and fresh. The only complaint I had was a sticker being on some produce in the coleslaw (at least you know it's homemade). I brought this to Candy's attention and she immediately corrected the issue by notifying a manager. I was blow away at the level of service I received, it's a rarity and I appreciate it. Besides that little hiccup I was very pleased with my meal and would recommend this location to anyone. The beer is priced very well, and the food is excellent. The quality and service here is also better than the Dunedin location in my opinion. I'll be coming here more often.

Hmmm it is bizarre to me that another reviewer tagged this place as dirty, seeing as when I went in just last night, it was remarkably clean. Also, in comparison to Don Pablo's, I think On the Border beats them in every category besides salsa. That is one thing DP can't be touched with, their bottomless salsa. 

I ordered the grilled mahi mahi fish tacos and they were great! The fish was grilled just perfectly, the soft tortilla it was wrapped in was obviously fresh, and the creamy red pepper dressing it was served with was refreshingly tasty. It was paired with some decent black beans, and rice I found to be pretty good when, let's admit, it was probably microwaved. My meal came to just $9.99... works for me! My friend ordered the southwest chicken tacos and cleaned her plate, so I believe it is safe to say she thoroughly enjoyed her meal too. 

I did however have to dock a star for service. Though it wasn't very busy when I ate here, my server was considerably slow. She was nice enough... it's just that my friend and I did a lot of sitting around when we were trying to bounce. AND it was seriously cold inside! I can't stand eating while I'm cold, I can't enjoy it!

The City of Philadelphia is a party pooper...the tour cannot pass out the quackers until the tour is over....too much noise...Yeah car horns are much more quiet. My only reason for giving it a 4 instead of a 5 star is the seats are too small for 2 adults so an 80 minute ride with a cheek hanging over is pretty uncomfortable. Vicky is wonderful.  Great tour; well worth the money.

On recommendation of hotel staff we ordered pizza.  EXTREMELY disappointing. Pizza was a lot smaller than expected due to its oval shape. We ordered 2 large pizzas -1 well done with extra cheese. Apparently  their pizzas are made without pizza  sauce . The extra cheese that we ordered was non existant & the cheese that was on it was a orange cheese. The under crust looked & tasted undercooked, bland & tough. I should have checked YELP reviews before wasting almost $40 on this place.
The food was tasty but the portion size for the price was small.A group of 6 wanted to sit together and were rather rude in getting us to leave before desert.We did leave and not planning to go back.

I first met the cronut on a recent trip to Canada. When I returned to Philly and learned that there was a version in my own backyard, I was ecstatic. The Swiss Haus Bakery's crocreme is amazing...and much larger than the cronut I had previously had! I've had them for my own treat, taken them to South Carolina where they were a hit with family, and am planning to order many of them for an upcoming work event. Other items were equally good, from the chocolate chip cookies to the hazelnut cake. 

In addition to outstanding baked goods, the service is excellent! The staff was quick to greet me when I walked in the door, friendly, courteous and very helpful with custom orders. Truly outstanding experience that I'm happy to have in my own neighborhood!

This is my favorite bar in Philly thus far. Dirty Frank's is everything you hope it will be. An amazing dive bar with amazing patrons. I found that the drinks were good and the people enjoying them were so willing to engage one another. I love a bar with that homey feeling that allows everyone to just enjoy themselves so much that they interact like old friends. This bar reminds me so much of my fave spots in SF. Yay Dirty Frank's.
The food is great and I love the atmosphere!  Downtown franklin is so beautiful and I love the Southern vibe at Puckett's.  Definitely a must for tourists.  I highly recommend!

To start, the food at Umami is really good. I've had their Pad Thai (great flavor with a few levels of heat to choose from) and Korean tacos (super good). Their raspberry lemon cheesecake is also amazing. My only complaint about Umami is the service. The staff has always been friendly, but consistently slow. We called ahead for a to go order once, showed up 15 minutes later - which was a 5 minutes before they said it would be ready - and ended up waiting at the bar for another 25 minutes for our order. There also hasn't been a hostess up front when we've been there so we usually have to awkwardly wave someone down to get a table. So, bottom line, service isn't great, but the food is good enough to make up for it on the occasional visit.

Great seafood place. Food is "down-home". Nothing extravagant, just plain good cooking.
The parking lot is a bit of a challenge, as so many spots are designated for other stores in the shopping area. But that as a very minor gripe as food and service more than made up for it.
 They have a full bar, very friendly staff, and the servers know the menu well. My wife had the shrimp and tenderloin kabob, and I had the fried platter. My dinner was excellent, it was more food than I could eat, and I'm a pretty big guy. My wife enjoyed her meal, but she couldn't finish it either.

Best French fries around!
Restaurant itself is nicely appointed-lots of nautical stuff and wood work.

We will definitely be back!

Gross. First time at Aldi. There were fruit flies and moldy veggies out. I may try the one in Clearwater next time since the produce section is highly recommended by several friends. Wasn't impressed with this one.
With so much talk about Joe's Crab Shack I decided to try it. It was tough w/ no taste take my advice and stick w/ red lobster.

I have been using Castrillos for years and I think they have gotten under new ownership in the last 6 months and I don't like it as much... Crap, I mean I really want to, I do. I even tried again the other day and I was just underwhelmed. 

I don't think the sauce is all that good any more and I have gotten some soggy dough a few times. This last time the pepperoni so so over cooked it had hardened and started to shrivel. I didn't even finish one piece. 

So, whomever bought this business needs to call the old owners and find out their secrets and go back to the way it was because that was working for me and this is just not even close.
A diner in West Philly?  This place does a fine job of it too.  Great service.  Decent coffee.  Excellent eggs, sausage, pancakes.  I highly recommend the chicken with waffles.

If this Quik Mart didn't exist at this location, I would run out of gas at least twice a month, I often forget to fill up on my way back home from town. I only add a few gallons though because it is always $0.10-$0.20/gallon more expensive than any other gas stations. I am not complaining since that's the cost of convenience.

I do have one complaint - those annoying scratchy sounding speaker screens that yell at me when I use the pump. I jumped about 3 feet in the air the first time the gas pump started talking to me. They should invest in a speaker that doesn't sound like a drive through speaker from the late 90's.
