Went for the first time last night with friends and was amazed at the quality of the food and the friendliness of the staff. We had oysters, mussels, and smoked wings for appetizers and the rabbit meatballs and roasted chicken for entrees. Excellent!!! I recommend this place to everybody.
Excellent Service, table was to close to our neighbor, felt like we were part of their conversation, food was great!

As I walk in I am bombarded with a new sense of disgust. The style is Art Deco, and the wall art reminds me of something you would see off pbs kids. After the kind worker takes my order I see something that chills my heart, a hipster soda fountain..... Each flavor is something unheard of and unsatisfying.

They forgot to give me an order number so my order went to a different table, this I don't mind. What bugs me is that the telephone that rings every minute and is loud enough to wake up my dead grandmother. 

Now the food is decent. I ordered  cock a doodle noodle. The macaroni is smooth and soft. while the bread is crunchy and fresh. The sauce though was tangy and ruined the calzone. 

Overall I give this place 2 stars. The food was decent and I would go as far to say good. The sauce that was paired with it on the other hand was not. I am excited to see how this establishment takes hold and hope they franchise. Because at this point I only see sauce on the side competing with fast food chains such as McDonald's and Burger King.

This has been a regular spot of mine for the past 6 months, but I've been patronizing since day one.  I'm pretty sure I'm addicted to the garlic cheese fries!

Their line-up of craft beers never disappoints and their patio is one of the better hidden spots downtown.  

This is a great spot to catch just about any sporting event, just be weary of Fri/Sat nights.. it can be packed and full of unsavory people!
Went to this place almost every day recently when I went for jazz fest. The oysters are really good and the gumbo was excellent, particulalry the first day! A must visit place!

I've been here more times than I can count, as it is a frequent stop when my husband & I go out on the motorcycle. The service is hit or miss. The food is ok-not great, not awful. Drinks are usually strong, although you don't get very much in a cocktail. They sometimes have live music and that's a fun time. Parking area is small. Overall, I would never choose to come here on my own, but it's easy to make the best of the situation when you're here.

Sister and I went for a drink and appetizer. We got the fries that came with 3 different sauces...they were delish! The drinks were ok...but the lady tending bar was very friendly. I would like to go back for dinner some time.

A definite hidden gem in Indianapolis. We had never heard of this place. My husband was browsing to find things to do in Indy. This sounded unique and fun. It was wonderful! A lot like the old show "who's line was it anyways". The staff was very entertaining and courteous. There is PG show around 7:30pm. The adult show starts at 10 PM. They also were very well organized, and got the audience involves a lot! It was wonderful. Will be going back!

Easiest 5 stars I've given in a while. I got the grilled ham n cheese with egg on top. Omg I savored every bite. My wife got the raclette Patty melt and it was luscious and perfect. Beers were on point too. Just eat here.

I stopped by Greko to pick up food on the way home, so this was a to go order. The counter service is great, everyone is really personable, which is a definite plus. I noticed that the owner was even kind enough to assist someone (possibly homeless) by giving them something to eat. This added the third star. 

My experience, I ordered the Greek Salad and added the lamb.  The salad ingredients were fresh, if sparse. I was able to count the number of cucumbers and tomatoes and kalamata olives, the addition of the fried chickpeas was nice. My salad was completely missing feta cheese ( I did call back and let them know that my salad was missing feta). I only received an apology.  That was by far my biggest disappointment. My total with tax was over $15. There was not enough food to justify this, and while the quality was great, I was definitely still hungry.   I also didn't love that they chop the lamb up before putting it on the salad. I am probably one of those rare individuals that would rather they leave it sliced.  

I really want them to do well, but fear that these serving sizes and price might prevent some from trying it out.

I went to this place for the first time yesterday and it was simply AMAZING! The food had so much flavor, the staff is so nice, it was simply perfect and quick! I was able to go in and out in a mater of 30 minutes so its perfect for lunch!
I love this place. .always Crowded and Great Food. The staff always take care care of their customers as well. And it's close to the Park to take a nap thereafter.

This hotel is on the verge of becoming something very special.  The service is fantastic and the downstairs jazz bar is awesome.  The only area lacking is the guest rooms themselves.  My wife and I have visited this property twice in the last year for weekend getaways and found our room to be quite humid.  When we checked out, the front desk clerk asked about our stay.  When we told her about the humidity issue, she said she can't do anything about the "achitecture".   While I agree she can't fix this issue, others can.  Maybe she could have told somebody?  Maybe a manager or facilities person?  Other than that, I would recommend this place to anyone wanting a true New Orleans experience.

Ordered the Monterey Jack and green chiles omelette. It had a very light flavor and a little too much cheese (which I removed some of) and definitely had to eat it with the salsa it came with to add some kick.

French toast was simple and good but a little too much butter.

Decent breakfast and pretty inexpensive (than what I'm used to in LA). I would come back to try some of their other options if I'm ever back in Boise...

Ambiance - cozy...except for the bathroom...so small...no place to wait on line...
Food - salty...small portions...and here's what we ordered
App - Veg dumplings: it was ok...I could've bought this at a local hmart and cooked it myself
Soup - Lemon Grass Soup: so blend...what the heck was that...
Entree- Duck slice with Evil Gaga style...(VERY SALTY...)
Coco Pad Thai - Very lame...this was not a pad thai...

Conclusion: Not going back.

This is a remodeled hotel in downtown Boise with relatively new furnishings.  Underground and convenient parking is available for $12 per day (more for valet, but convenient enough that valet is not needed, and at different times is not available anyway.  Location is excellent with downtown a very short walk away with restaurants and downtown stores (unfortunately mostly national chains).  USA is provided in front of the door in the mornings and the local paper and Wall Street Journal in the lobby (A first - I appreciated having three complementary papers to read each day).  

There is also free wifi although speed proved to be very spotty. View of Grove Square was okay from the 7th floor but will likely get worse in the future as construction completes.  Beds were nicer than usual with fluffy pillows.  There is a refrigerator in the room and a decent size flatscreen although picture on cable channels was bad.   The room had ample plugs and 4 USB jacks under the TV (probably 1 amp since charging tablets was slow). There was no luggage rack and placing luggage on top of the dresser was a little high.  Our toilet often kept running and looking into tank exposed vintage innards.  

There a few minor things which I did not expect, like a lack of adequate clothes hooks, a drying line over the bath, and a towel rack close to the bath.  As it is, I often started started showering, then realized the towel and facecloth were on the other side of the bathroom.

Price was pretty good, my conference rate being much lower than usual compared to metropolitan cities.  If I were to visit Boise again, I would stay here, although I was kind of bored with the city itself.
Came here after going to la divina gelateria which was closed. So we saw this place and decided to give it a try. Great ice cream very rich & not too sweet definitely recommend it.

So beautiful! Had the spa suit for 3 days! And Loved every minute of it. Clean. Updated. Steam shower was a nice add on too. We had a room at the end which gave us many more Windows. I loved that. And service was fantastic, from registration to room service to restaurant people. Had so much fun at the Super Bowl party! Tons of people, and even ran into people we knew from back home, which added to our fun. Tons of food and the screens were huge and plenty of them!!! Didn't go in the pool but looked great. Same with all the amenities of the hotel. Restaurants were good, service great. One thing is... I kept getting lost or turned around. Signage I would say needs to be clearer. But had a great time.

Decided to check this place out after seeing some five star reviews about this sushi place. We decided to go for dinner, and we're not disappointed! 

We started with the baked mussels, the dragon balls ,and  miso soup. The baked mussels where amazing, along with the dragon balls and I loved that the miso soup had added raw mushrooms.

Then we had some speciality nigiri, the salmon lover, kei tuna and fire ball. They where a refreshing change from the usual Mickey Mouse and Donald ducks that ever sushi place in Reno has. 

We tried two long rolls, both which I would very much recommend, the ninja and the Optimus. 

A lot of places in Reno seem to serve the same sushi rolls just named differently. This place is an extremely refreshing option with lots of different flavor options! 

We ended with the Miami dessert roll, which the only turn off was that the rice was just normal sushi rice that added a unwanted savory aspect to the dessert roll.

I would highly recommend this place as a new and refreshing option for sushi

Yelp you've done it again! It was my birthday and we were attempting to eat at Acme but the wait was ridiculously long so we grabbed a table across the street...mistake. After ordering drinks we asked for the bill due to really poor service (think: server eating chips at the register next to our table). I searched on Yelp and discovered Luke so we took the short walk over.
Upon arrival, we were pleasantly surprised. We were quickly seated and served water and bread. The servers were informative, patient (we may have had a bit to drink), and friendly, but more importantly, the food was delicious! 
As others have said, happy hour is well worth it, we ordered fried, stuffed and half shell oysters along with a bowl of seafood gumbo for the table to share. BOMB.com! 
I wish I had pictures to share, but the food was so good I forgot. I do have one though...

Loved our stay at The Saint!  We came in from Baton Rouge to celebrate our first wedding anniversary, and everything went really well.  We were able to check in over an hour early even though our check in was specified as 4pm.  The entrance and lobby are high ceilinged, sleek, and modern, just our taste!  The room was on the 6th floor and while a bit small, it was clean and comfortable.  While there, we did not order room service or drink the VOSS water in the tiny fridge so we can't speak to those items.  The hallways are lit with royal blue lights, making it seem as though it would be any time of day and you'd never know if it was 6am or 6pm!  The ONLY issues we had were yes, the walls are thin, which was a bit awkward, and there is no fan in the bathroom, which seemed a little weird, and I would give 6 stars if they had a rooftop pool!!!

We only stayed one night, and I purchased on Expedia so it was cheaper than going through the actual website, pretty reasonable for a special occasion, at least to me!  In the morning we went down and ate breakfast at Tempt, their restaurant.  It was buffet style and there was a fairly large selection of foods.  They do valet parking, and it IS pricey overnight, but I can't imagine trying to find street parking around Canal, so it was worth the $38 we paid.  

I would love to come back and stay again at The Saint Hotel, after reading mixed reviews everywhere, we were a little hesitant but overall our stay was great, with excellent service, attention to detail, and interesting décor.

My HUSBAND and I got married here last week and it was a great experience. We only held our ceremony in Godric Grove, so I can't speak on if there would be any issues with the reception and complaints from people in the surrounding area as other reviews have mentioned. We had our rehearsal for the wedding very early in the morning and there were lots of people hanging out around the grove and asking if it was okay to be there. I didn't mind, but I found it interesting that it said wedding parking only at the bottom of the park, yet people still went through. The ceremony cite was perfect for our small group. It was a perfect day and perfect for the intimate ceremony that we wanted and we could see the ocean from the hill. It was perfect and I would recommend it to anyone who is looking to get married in a lovely, quiet place in California overlooking the ocean. Perfect.

500 Degrees is my favorite place to get a burger, still. Burgers are cooked to order and the menu continues to grow with ingredients to top. You can add a variety of different cheeses (regular or gourmet) and sauces, two types of bacon, or even an egg fried to your liking. The fries are greatly improved since I first went. Plenty crispier. There's truffle and new (for me at least) garlic parm fries. Drinks are refillable with flavors like cherry soda and sweetened black tea.
The best place to jet ski by far! Great people, great service, great prices, unforgettable experience! I will be back each and every time I'm in the area!

The mozzerella at the separate entrance next door is is good as I have had in a long time. Delicious, melt in your mouth and incredible.
The deli next door has hard to find products I have not seen since visiting small towns in Italy. Great pasta selection, cheeses, olives and much more. The proscioutto was sliced razor thin and excellent.

By far my favorite restaurant. They have the best burger I've EVER eaten... not to mention an amazing selection of whiskey & beer. It's tiny and crowded and I love it. I usually have to wait for a table when I get there, but it's so worth it. Don't forget to try the duck fat fries.. they are ridiculously amazing. I've eaten here about 5 or 6 times in the last 6 months and I'm always ready to go back.
Service was a little slow but building was cool, the drinks great and my fried chicken sandwich was literally the perfect bite.

This gym has lots of amenities such as the basketball court, pool, racquetball, and of course equipment... however, for the amount of money you pay each month they need to invest in some friendly front desk staff, some fans and AC that actually works, more cleaning stations (there are like 3 in the entire place), and people to come around and actually clean equipment. I've been to multiple LA Fitness's and this one by far needs some extra tender love for cleaning.

I wish I could give this place six stars! It's fast and friendly. Great prices for great food! I've had the fish tacos, the chicken tacos, the steak tacos. All good! My review is short because there's nothing bad to say about this place! If you're in the area stop in! It'll make for a good quick tasty lunch.

Great time! Small intimate classes and really personably people running it. Mike and Chef Yoon are so lovely. Feels like you've been welcomed into their home. Total beginner and learned so much (apparently sweet potatoes and yams are different)!

Can't wait to come back!

This has always been the best place in town to buy your used video games. First off, it's a family owned business, which means prices are negotiable. They also have really great deals on a huge selection of games from Ps4/Wiiu/XboxOne games to old classic NES/SNES/SEGA games, nice customer service and a pretty damn good rewards program. The building itself might be a little old, but don't judge a book by its cover, this place is a Gem.

I and a friend just came in a bit late and service was nice and quick. We're definitely going back again. I got the Phat Albert, and it was great a tad bit salty but pretty Dam good. Oh, and met the owner on the way out. He was a very nice person even if the food weren't as good as it is,  I'd still go just for the environment and friendly staff.

Whenever I go to a high end restaurant, I ask the server to please evaluate what we've ordered and make any comments and suggestions.  I believe our server was Joseph and a 10 year veteran of Mr. Bs.  Thanks to him, we changed our orders and everyone (4 of us) were thrilled with the result.  My scallops were (4 huge U10s) were perfecty seared and tender in an amazing sauce.  The fried oyster appetizer was crispy and tender, the lamb chops looked wonderful and the BBQ shrimp was tasty and fun to eat and the bread was perfect for soaking up the fantastic sauce.  The wine list included many of our favorites and the service was beyond informative and friendly.  I plan to visit Mr. Bs again on my next visit to NO.

I'm giving these guys 2 stars. I have been waiting over an hour for food because "somebody bought all the fried chicken". No excuse. We ordered 2 pieces of chicken for my kids. I could literally fry 2 pieces of chicken in my house in this time.  There is no place to wait, and they give you your order complete. Shape up guys. I'm being a little harsh because this place is owned by another restaurant. You should be able to adjust accordingly. I will change my review based on another trip. But as of now, be prepared for an hour wait for food.
Stayed there 2 nights this week in a wonderful Corner suite with an in room spa.  It was perfect!

MARK! Great server! It was my mom's bday. We had about 12 people, 5 of them were kids. He anticipated exactly what we needed the entire time. Food was also fantastic. The restaurant and restrooms were clean as well. All around great store. Great job out there management!

Yup, I'm a fan of Studio Branca!  I consider it my little slice of heaven everytime I have ANYTHING done here.  

Services: I come here to get the brazilian wax (that's right folks, nothing is too off topic for me!).  I get it from this lady named Sarah, who is the first waxer to single-handedly change my life.  She is simply AMAZING because she's quick and painless!!  Seriously folks, she's GOOD!  So good in fact that women in St. Louis have mentioned her name on the radio before!!  My BF wanted to send her a Christmas card last year, no joke!  This place also gives GREAT facial treatments and Sarah can do that too!  Best of all, they carry Aveda products and a skincare line called Skinceuticals.  I've used their "Simply Clean" cleanser and can't imagine using anything else now!  It leaves your face feeling fresh without drying it out!  In addition, they are ALWAYS up to par on their OPI lines, so feel free to book an appointment to get that mani/pedi in the 80's neon color this summer!

NOTE: I've just learned that Sarah (the best St. Louis Brazilian waxer) is moving to AZ.  But don't let that discourage you from booking an appointment at this oasis!!  

Ambiance (spa only):  They'll always do a great job at making you feel peaceful and serene here.  It's almost like your mini getaway from your hectic lifestyle!  They've done a good job at creating a tranquil atmosphere for all your spa needs.

I've been to my share of PF Chang's all around. Last night I was in the Plymouth Meeting one for the 1st time.  The menu has changed some since last being there with some good new additions. Had a fabulous meal, with hot and sour soup, steamed pork dumplings, spicy tuna roll and spicy chicken lomein. Wrapped it up with the banana spring rolls which were the best I've had at this chain.  The sushi was good, the hot and sour soup excellent, the spicy lomein was outstanding but the biggest winner was the dessert.  Service was nice as was the atmosphere. All in all only positives to say here.
Absolutely love this place! Delicious ribs, beans, and potato salad! Fantastic service!
This is a really good starbucks. One thing I like is that it had really quick service. All the drinks I have had have been on point

Horrible CUSTOMER SERVICE! After hearing all the great reviews of this place I was excited to eat here. Upon arrival asked if we could sit outside for the bay view. Immediately the older hostess rolled her eyes and sighed and said "are you sure?" She questioned us twice to see if we would change our minds. There was plenty of outside seating as well. Restaurants should not offer outside seating if they are not willing to. When seated she continued to give us attitude when asking for our drinks and didn't even look us in the face. I immediately left with my fiancé as I did not feel comfortable giving this establishment my money.

I really appreciated the expertise of The Bone Lady. She is a VooDoo priestess. She really knew her history and was quite the story teller. She was very demonstrative and acted out some of the stories. You could tell that she really lived these stories. Really enjoyed it- I think we had a better tour than some of the other tour groups out at the same time.

You know its good comfort food when you cant stop stuffing your face, even when you notice how dirty the place is. I brought a cousin here for the first time since he just returned from New Orleans. I figured if he liked it, it must be good Cajan creole food. He took one bite and said, "oh man, this is good...and cheap too!" I think he will be a regular now. We ate our food an admired the odd decor. It is a casual dining experience which is great for catching up with a relative that had been gone for months.  The guy at the register fully explained the menu so we all knew what was available and how to order. We felt right at home even though it was comfort creole food found right in the mix of Indianapolis.

The flavor is almost there, but the pie...totally undercooked.  Too much sauce (undercooked) and not enough toppings.  Crust is good, but undercooked.  Even our 2 year old pizza crazy man wouldn't eat it.  I don't know if it's the oven, the number of people ovens (maybe they can't handle the volume), but it's not working out.

I have selected Morales Landscapers for my monthly maintenance program.   Jorge does a good job communicating and is very polite.  Although it was my first monthly visit, I was very pleased with the work and length of time they spent on my property.  The team was very nice.  I look forward to working with them on a monthly basis.

So this is one of the best restaurants in St. Pete? At least that's what people say.

Kind of American fusion Mexican here. Ambiance is eh. Too many tables jam-packed into a small space. They don't dim the lights for dinner until about 7:30 or so. If you arrive before then, it'll feel a little cafeteria style.

OK maybe I'm being too harsh. It's just when people say "Oh my gosh you have to try this place" I assume it'll be GREAT. It was good. I wouldn't go out of my way to impress out of town guests here. But the food was yummy. Loud- you can bring your kids. Not dressy.

Our waitress forgot our wine. We were seated very close to the waiter and waitress computer station and could hear them all complaining about their tables all night. That was unprofessional. 

Food GOOD
Service OKAY
Ambiance MEDIOCRE
Food was amazing as told. Chicken sandwich was awesome staff was great. service was fast. And specially the man reason I tried there chicken it was halal . I'll be there regular customer.
Have really enjoyed the food here before today....bbq pork sanwich meat was barely warm and chicken tortilla soup was all broth and needed seasoning...very disappointed

Provisions is my favourite kitchen store in Edmonton, no question.
It isn't huge and it doesn't have 50 different kinds of the same item, but you can trust that what it does have will be fantastic.
And despite the specialty nature of the store, the prices of most items aren't outrageous (especially considering the quality).
The service is always top notch and they even sell frozen pie dough, chocolate, salted caramel and baking books to put it all together. 
Is there any doubt this would be one of my favourite stops in town?
Absolutely fantastic food. Did have to wait a while for the food but was worth it. Only had one waitress so that was a little inconvenient.

Let me tell you, the beignets here are incredibly awesome! They are so light and fluffy that we had to come back again tonight to take them back to our hotel room! It is my understanding that they are made to order. 

We went to another very famous place and had coffee and beignets after having the beignets here yesterday.......absolutely no comparison! Cafe Beignet knows how to make BEIGNETS! 

The live entertainment is impressive! This is a nice place to relax and enjoy coffee and beignets. I will always come here instead of the other place. You must give it a try!

You pay for the views but have to pay extra to sit near a window. Service was terrible. Took us an hour and a half to get our food. Waiter was awkward and inattentive. Food was mediocre and over priced.

Farmer's Cabinet's "divvy" sibling is more reasonably-priced, serves up better portions, has friendlier service, and is in a cool, rustic-chic space so all together, I think it's much better than it's older, better-known sibling. Happy hour prices include cheap local beer and the rest of the menu offers a plethora of beer, inventive (and knocok-you-on-your-ass) cocktails and the food menu has lowbrow items like soft preztel bites to pork poutine to sandwhich. Great date space as it's dark and cavernous, and good for a drink at the bar for those who like their bourbon and whiskey.

Visited Nashville from LA with my family. A large group of us went here for sunday brunch (9 people).  I couldn't have been more impressed with the wait staff here. They were so friendly and knowledgable about their food. They made excellent recommendations. The owner even came around to see how our meal was.  The decor was creative and very classy. Overall we had an excellent experience and when I'm in town again I'd definitely visit this place.

As far as food goes, I had the Banana Foster pancake and it was incredible. The pancakes nice and fluffy and the caramelized bananas plus walnuts were a perfect compliment. Their Ginger Ice tea was really delicious too, be sure to stir it first.

My wife had the salmon cakes and I tasted it. It was really really good too.

Got the massage package which included mani-pedi and blowout. Great price for all those services. My hair is thick so they ended up charging extra for that so just be aware. The massage was fantastic - ask for Tara if you go.
We moved to Florida a year and a half ago and we were looking for a good pizza place. Sangria is pretty good. The pretzels are amazing and the pizza it's awesome. I will recommend it anytime!

It was all that I expected it to be, great seafood.
The service was just ok, nothing to rave about (thats the reason for the 4 over a 5.)

Just were there with 6 people. We sat there for 20 minutes and got no help so we asked for bread. They gave us a spread that was bland & never told us what was in it. We had to ask for olive oil. Everything we asked for the waiter gave us a look like we were really put him out. They didn't have pepper on the table or offer us pepper or Parmesan. It was bland except appetizers were good. It took hours to get served and then they added 20% for tip. I guess he knew he would get 20% no matter what. We were upstairs and most tables were downstairs.

Made a stop here one afternoon for an addition to my Hard Rock T-Shirt Collection. The t-shirts here are a little different in that the logo in the middle of the shirt is purple instead of yellow and it fades pretty badly after you wash it once.

I went to the food court and got something to eat and it was basically like you average mall food court. I looked around some and I thought that the casino itself was pretty nice but probably not as good as Vegas. If you are sensitive to cigarette smoke, I would stay out of here, this place reeks of it but that's to be expected in a casino in my opinion and it didn't bother me that much.

I agree with some of the other reviewers in that it did look like a good place to party, if I would have discovered this place ten years ago, I could have gotten into a lot of trouble here, LOL.

The service at Sizzler is incomparable. Quick seating to the best salad bar in town. The best prices and a staff that constantly meets your needs. Portion size and quality is excellent and so are the managers who consistently, without fail come to your table and ask you about your meal experience. Beautiful building w great people and food. Great options for vegetarians also!

I had bugs in my bed, the staff was very unfriendly and just denied it when I reported it.
They had not the courtesy to come to the room to see it for them self. 
Well then they put me in another room, next day again into another room; where the heater did not work. Just stay away from that place if you do not want to bring home any bugs.

I kept going back and forth on what to rate this place, If they had a 3.5 option I would probably pick that. The service was good, people were very friendly, may have helped that I got there right at opening and was one of the only people in the restaurant, your experience may be different if its during a busy time.

I ordered the two meat plate with ribs and brisket. The beans and Texas toast were good, nothing to rave about but I would eat them again. The ribs left a lot to be desired, they were dry and very tough, I had trouble cutting through the ribs with my knife, I would not order them again. 

I didn't have high expectations on the brisket after trying the ribs but much to my surprise the brisket was honestly the best I have had. In fact it was so good I added two orders of the brisket to go. My rating would probably be a one or two at most if it wasn't for the brisket.

This place is adorable, exactly the type of "local flavor" that I look for when visiting a new city. The decor is cute, the food and juice were great, and the service is friendly. Prices are extremely reasonable. Highly recommended.

They don't do separate checks.

Sweetgreen is a KOP favorite of ours! So fresh, healthy and all the employees are so nice every time. I highly recommend it :) They have tons of options for build your own and the selected specials are excellent! My one complaint is that the last time I went for lunch they were "cash only". Def not ideal if you are expecting to use your card...and only have your card.  May have been a one time thing...not sure. Besides that- awesome!
Excellent! Original Chicago dog on the grill. Every bit worth the calories. Choice of fresh buns. I chose to have my poppyseed bun grilled. Quaint atmosphere and friendly staff.

One of my fav DDs in town. This place is super busy, just because of the location. But yet staff is very friendly and super quick. Even on mornings when the drive thru line is wrapped around the block, it moves pretty quick. I do opt to go inside at times, which is equally as quick. The inside is clean, with about 5 tables. They have a highchair available if needed too. Usually I'm ordering 1-2 items, but when I've got a list, they always get the order correct.
My group of friends really enjoyed the pub crawl with Linley. Took us to three fun pubs, we had good deals and she told fun stories.

It's above average for a Walmart with some things you just simply wouldn't see stocked in other Walmart's. They also have a great selection and everything is always fully stocked. However the bathrooms are very filthy.

I love this place! I went out there for dinner with my family, after it was recommended to my sister, and we weren't disappointed. They have a lot of unique and tasty foods there :) I love the thin crust on the pizza, and especially the fact that it's NOT greasy at all- I ate like 6 slices, plus dessert, and left with a happy tummy and no food coma :P The desserts are awesome too!

Popped over to Besito for happy hour after picking up a friend from the airport. Super friendly and helpful staff! The food was amazing, too. Between the four of us, we split multiple items on the happy hour menu. From Flautas de Pollo to guac made tableside, everything tasted amazing and was a perfect meal in the sun in Tampa! (from Seattle, not so much sun right now in spring)

Paradise Ship.  Got back this week for the Saturday thru Thursday morning return from TAmpa.  We had sailed 2 other Carnival ships that were good.  This one need some updating and tiding up, but for the most part,  poor amenities on this ship.  I give the crew 5 stars for the continued caring and outgoing help.  They were always there, trying to please or help you with anything.  We had 259 cabin in the AFT - back of ship - right above the motors.   Our first night we could not sleep - complained at 3 30A.  Very helpful but could not change us, ship was booked.   In the morning, we get a letter saying a room is available.   Someone did not show and we got a much better room.  They were so helpful and always trying to please the guests.   The room was nice and we were able to sleep. Food?  Oh No!!!!!!!!!!!  Destiny and Elation dining - AWFUL. Twice we sent back prime rib and it was terrible.  Then ried the ribs, AWFUL too.  Breakfast at  Destiny AWFUL - surf and turf ?  Awful.  We ate at the buffet most of the time.  Rooms on this ship - had NO fridge in the room, but other carnival ships, did.  Also,  there were no other specialty restaurants on this ship.  We were stuck with Destiny and Elation, which we never returned to after our initial experience.  Food was HORRIBLE.   The were always friendly and so very helpful.  This ship sadly needed a complete make over.

Food was just OK. Expect to wait a while to be seated and served. The oysters were good. The PoBoys (the reason we came) were not great, nothing special, not worth the travel or price. Fries were a bit soggy. Portions were large. Not bad, but there are better options.

I defy anyone who can say anything negative about this St. Louis tradition.  I don't care how long the lines are (they hire off duty police to direct traffic and ensure everyone gets a parking spot), but those kids who are making and serving the frozen custard are phenomenal.

No written orders, hundreds of variations, and the order taker serves several groups while other folks make the treats.  It is a sight to behold.

I don't know how or where Ted finds these youngsters and trains them, but I do believe that he should take over management of all of the school districts, the man knows how to train youngsters in math and memory.

Cream, eggs and honey...that is it for the ingredients along with a tremendous number of toppings and sizes.

Wonderful, absolutely wonderful.

I was so surprised at how much I got back given that I graduated almost 3.5 years ago! I went in close to closing and the lady who helped me was super sweet and nice. Very efficient- basically scanned my stack of about 10 books and told me how much each was worth. Walked out a happy customer or I guess seller. Haha

I was taking a weird route from SoCo to the city and stumbled across Urban Matter. 

Urban Matter has:

Candles
StL stuff
Kitchen stuff
Jewelry
Greeting cards
Coasters
Cologne
Hats
Journals
Lots more

And all of it is made in MO or not too far from MO. Much is made of special stones and pretty wood that I've never heard of. Most of it was a little too pricey for me to purchase for myself on a whim, but lots and lots of great gift potential there.
 
They were having some kind of a workshop in the back -- looked like wreath-making -- and so there was spiked cider, cheese and crackers, and little-chocolate covered cookies to munch on. 

The employees were friendly and helpful but didn't pressure or pester us. I only bought two cards, but my friends bought earrings ($8!), cologne, and a few other things. 

Cool place. Definitely worth a visit.

There are a lot of restaurants in Tarpon Springs, so it's a great place to visit if you like Greek food. We went to Hellas for lunch and the restaurant was busy, always a good sign. We enjoyed Salad, Hummus, Gyros and Souvlaki - all were really good plus our waitress Sasha was excellent. Highly recommend Hellas, and it's gorgeous bakery next door.

I went to Ellen for over 8 years, which is a record for me because stylists usually piss me off after the third or fourth visit. (I have short hair and minimal room for error, and therefore I am picky.) In all that time, there were only one or two occasions in which I wasn't completely thrilled with the end result. Unfortunately, when I called to make an appointment last month, I was informed that Ellen had moved, so I had to pick another stylist on the fly. I requested Jason since I had read wonderful reviews about him.

With Ellen, I had grown accustomed to giving her a general sense of what I wanted, and she would have free reign to work her magic. However, Jason requested photos and specifics. While it's fine and good to want a clear direction, I immediately became nervous because I was unprepared. All I had in mind was a basic angled bob, undershave, and bang trim, and beyond that I wanted him to use his expertise to make it snazzy. I mentioned that I am growing out my hair, that I typically let it dry naturally, and that I needed to keep it low-maintenance. Then he pulled up photos on his phone and wanted me to point to something that resembled what I wanted, even though nothing he showed me was remotely close to my personal style. I told him repeatedly that I didn't know what else to say, and that I was trusting him to do what he thought was best. Ultimately he did only what I had specifically requested and nothing more. Also, the undershave is about an inch higher in the back than it is in the front, which is NOT what I requested and will take at least 6 months to grow out.

When the cut was finished, he handed me off to a girl who was shadowing him. She rinsed my hair, loaded it with mousse, and set me under the dryer for about 20 minutes. I became uncomfortably hot and agitated to the point that I was ready to pay and leave right then, crunchy hair and all. Then she brought me to a chair and proceeded to "style." When she was supposedly done, I looked like a granny with bed head. Jason came over and made it look slightly more presentable for public, but it was still stiff with product and felt disgustingly filthy. I can't remember the last time I left a salon feeling worse about myself than when I arrived. I was embarrassed, self-conscious, and bummed. Jason might be a fantastic stylist for all I know, but as a long-time customer who was seeing him for the first time, he gave me a horrible first impression that led me to lose trust in V Vegaz.

I miss you, Ellen, you delightful little weirdo.
Great food and friendly service. Generous servings and lots of choices. Will definitely go back and take my friends!

I used to live in Philly and live right down the road from this Sandwich shop.  It serves great Philly Cheesesteak.  yes, I could go to the original Tony Luke or go to those other better known cheese-steak places, but this place was only a 5 minute walk from my high-rise apartment in Center City.

Actually, I tried like 5 of the steak sandwiches.  All were very good.  The secret is not in the meat or types of meat.  It is the BREAD!!!  The bread that they serve it on makes the sandwich.

Yes, this is a definite place to visit!

Came here for Labor Day brunch with my boyfriend, and this place was not as busy so we were able to seat ourselves right away. However, service was absolutely terrible. We had to go up to the bar multiple times and talk to at least 3 different servers to even get waters. After putting our drinks in at the bar with the intoxicated bartender/manager, we had to wait another 20 minutes to receive these drinks and ask another couple of servers about the status of our drinks. The staff was less than apologetic about our wait, which frustrated us even more. After a while, I believe a bus-boy took our order and finally gave us our drinks. We ordered mimosas and coffee which were pretty good and decently sized. After the bus-boy took our order for the Piazza Omelette and the Breakfast Calzone, we received our food in about 30 minutes. The woman that ended up helping us said that she was a volunteer for the outdoor bar and didn't actually work at Cafe Piazza (ridiculous). Our food was a 7/10 with good sized portions and flavor. However, overall I was astounded how awful the service was. The only reason I give this place 2 stars instead of 1 is because the food and drinks were good. But that was also screwed up by the time and manner we received them. If your staff can't handle a half full restaurant, hire more servers or go through extensive training because this was the worst service I have ever received in my life.

This place at first sight is very nice but the service we got was not. The menu  was not explained. We ordered  the st elmo shrimp  (not the exact title ) but that stuff was hot it had a real kick but $20 for 6 shrimp and a horseradish sause. Not again! The best thing was the shrimp  and chicken Alfredo that was 5 starts. At some point our servers changed  and we just had random  people  coming to our table. Was not a good experience for us.
It's like being in a friends yard, but your friend has an incredible wine selection, out of this world food, and a jazz band to rock your socks off. Don't miss this place.
The food is way over priced. $1.50 for a small piece of fried chicken, $1.00 for a can of soda. $1.00 for a bag of chips.

Nice quaint place, but WAY overly priced. I filled my 64oz growler and it cost $28. Keep in mind prices vary on the beers so it can range. I definitely didn't pick anything fancy or rare. I tried this place because it was close to home; first time fill here. I would stick to the local breweries to fill, it is MUCH cheaper. Catalina brewery is $16, the barrio is $12, tap & bottle ranges around $18. Bartender was friendly enough,  but I won't be back to fill, which is unfortunate because it is called Growler and close to home. Bummer.

Service is somewhat improved over prior reviews. The portion size is small which would be okay if the quality were exceptional. It is not. The vegetables were very salty. The pasta appeared to be cooked in butter, not olive oil. The pork belly was not properly cooked. Braised lamb was tender and fell off the bone. Grunge background music was intrusive, not what you'd expect in a good restaurant. Valet parking was good in every respect. Overall not worth the effort if you live more than 10 minutes away.

Food was very good. We had the omlets and they were good. Plenty of food. You won't go away hungry. A few small issues make it a 4 out of 5. Slow to get the check. Slow on the refills of coffee and water.
I really loved the design Tracy created. Really pretty and the gel nails has lasted me a month.

Clean, well-laid out store.  All of the employees I pass by were friendly and offered some sort of acknowledgment or greeting.  I appreciate this as is tells me that if I have a question they might actually help instead of walk the other way.  I'm sure we have all experienced that type of treatment sometime or somewhere.  

I had the chance to peek in on the Manager who was in an office doing some desk work.  She appeared to be in on her time off as she wasn't in uniform.  I was probably interrupting whatever she was doing as it was a bit obvious she wasn't in on official work duties.  Still, she took the time to talk to me and offer advice and help. 

Customer service goes a long way with me; it can make or break deals.  I may frequent an establishment who may fall short in other areas if the staff treats customers kindly.  Many times customer service is the saving grace for a second chance.  

Clean, well-organized, well-stocked, full-service (vet, growing, training, boarding, supplies, etc) pet store.  Big chain, of course, but friendly and helpful staff at this location is great.  It is often-times unexpected from the bigger chain stores.

Excellent breakfast. I currently have someone in the family at Vanderbilt Hospital, and the walk from the hospital was not bad at all. In fact, it did some of us well to get out of the hospital. 

Service was great; our waitress took great care of us. I got the country ham breakfast but substituted my 3 buttermilk pancakes for 1 Santa Fe pancake. This was the best decision I made. The Santa Fe is cornmeal based, almost like southern flat cornbread. It's mixed with green chilis, cheese, and BACON . It comes with butter (not really needed), picante sauce, and sour cream. I just lathered it up, and it was great. Country ham and eggs were wonderful. 

Overall, highly recommend, especially if you have family in the hospital. Good escape from the place.

Yes, 5 stars - something I rarely give.

I have been eating at this establishment for over 30 years. I have relatives who are snowbirds in nearby Pasco County. They will often tell me about some new (usually to them) pizza or Italian place they found that I HAVE to try. Most of them are gone. Angelo's is still here, now remodeled. There is a reason they are still around: they are about the best at what they do.

I am a pizza nut. A fanatic. Angelo's gets it right. New York style right on the money. The sauce, the cheese, the crust - all superb. Baked right. The crust has the perfect crunch while remaining chewy. You want soft crust, then order Papa John's. (Couple of low-rated reviews have knocked the Sicilian style pizza. I have not had it; it isn't my preference. But it's supposed to be thick and chewy. It's made in a pan and topped simply.)

I enjoy a good antipasto and a pizza. This is generally what I order here. My son and I are big eaters, and the antipasto for one was more than enough for two persons. The large sausage pizza, well we took home three slices. All for $25 including tax (we drink water). The antipasto here puts 99% of other places I've ordered the same to shame. Not just the quantity and price, but the sheer quality of the ingredients. 

Over the years we have had pasta and other dishes here. All are well prepared. Angelo's is my go-to Italian restaurant in this area. Probably going back tomorrow.

Had dinner here before going to the Fox.  WOW!  I'm so glad we tried this and we will make a trip back.  Enjoyed the pickle soup, mushroom soup, roast beef melt.  We had orange sherbet and a hot fudge brownie sundae for dessert, and both were great.  My granddaughter got the black cherry soda which is made in house and she loved it.  Once we were able to get seated, the service was VERY fast and our waiter was great with suggestions and checking in with us a few times.  LOVED the décor.  We watched other diners and their selections all looked yummy, so I could see how this could become a local favorite.  Prices were so reasonable, especially considering the popularity of the restaurant and the location in mid-town STL.
Yes, haunted, wonderful, full of character.  A bit imperfect, but somehow fits with the whole perfect imperfection of New Orleans.  If you want flavor and a great French Quarter location, stay here.

The doughnuts here are awesome. The maple bacon is really good. It's a grab and go type of vibe. They do have tables and chairs but it isn't an inviting space to hang out. It is worth the trip to stop in and get some awesome doughnuts. They do run out- so get there early. The bagels are good too. I would suggest going here over a place like Dunkin' Donuts. I can't speak for the coffee here since I have never had it. Just doughnuts and bagels.

This place is delicious! Consistently. Their smoothies are amazing, sandwhichs and wraps are well balanced and delicious, their salads are flavorful, though a bit wet towards the end. Friendly service. Be mindful of lunch time as it can take quite some time to get your food but if you order ahead, you'll be fine! LOVE this place.

Performances have been great, but this venue is not my favorite.  Squeaky disruptive chairs. Poor viewing. Poor views from almost all seats.  Not steep enough to prevent the heads in front of you from blocking your view. Cramped seating. Strict bag searches and no external food or drink allowed.   Horrible lines for overpriced snacks at intermission. Inadequate restrooms with unacceptable, atrocious long lines.  No parking close by which is difficult for elderly guests and women wearing high heels.

I have been to this nail salon twice now. The people there are wonderful. I had the deluxe pedicure today and it was heavenly. The massage on my legs felt incredible. I didn't realize how tight the muscles were! The lady who gave me my pedicure took her time with my massage and I really felt pampered. I've been to many, many nail salons and this is my 100% favorite. Most salons when you go in have a strong odor but not this place. I only smelled that particular scent a couple of times for a short bit in the 90 minutes I was there and it was BUSY. I would without hesitation recommend this place.
Worst orange leaf. Haven't been to this one in years but decided to give it a shot. Same. Not flavorful froyo, almost too cold to taste anything.

This place is a joke. I hardly ever leave bad reviews but this was the biggest waste of time ever. Don't be fooled by their nice website. This woman who was supposed to help me had no idea I had even made an appointment and couldn't have been more rude. She didn't even introduce herself. She had my friend checking the front of the store to see if more guests had come in while she was "consulting" with me. I told her my budget, which was extremely reasonable, and she actually said "well that's going to be hard to do". She only let me try on 2 gowns and literally had me out the door in 20 minutes. Their gowns are horrid and way over priced. I just would like to warn people about this place and seriously save yourself from even attempting to find a dress here. The shop was dirty and extremely unwelcoming.

The Starbucks locations in Tampa Bay are below average. Usually they are mobbed and have below average staff in terms of drink-making skills. This location is no exception. If you want a large Starbucks to hang out in, check out the one on MLK Jr. Blvd. in Tampa. It's never mobbed and staff are nice.

It's Kmart folks not Nordstroms !! Fact, it's the second most successful Kmart in the USA, behind Maui. I go to Kmart for  things I know Kmart sells , I'm not looking for high end merchandise , it's Kmart !!! I have always found great deals here on small appliances, household supplies, and many other items as well . Yeah it's old school but so what, it's basic and works for  my family
Allot of the posters here are posting some 
Pretty inaccurate information . I'm thinking it's the Target brigade !

Crabby Bills is always a solid spot. They won't blow you away with the food quality but it is always good and priced well. We are trying every spot down the beach that has oysters. Crabby's are from VA and, just like everything else, are solid.

We had some catering ordered by our Company from this restaurant. It was Baked Ziti with Cheese and Meatballs with Garlic Knots. The Garlic Knots were alright, and their pizza may be good, as I haven't had any I can't comment. What I can say is that there pasta sucks, the meatballs taste like they just bought them at a store and stuck them on top, and they used almost no pasta sauce, like 3 cups per 10 lbs of pasta. Wouldn't eat it even though it was free, certainly wouldn't spend any money there.

People smoking in the bar. Bar games- jumbo jenga, shuffle board, corn hole. Give it a try. 
I don't know if it is a St. Louis thing, but I haven't seen the words "douche bag" and "douchey" in so many reviews before. Maybe it fits, I thought it was ok.

Megabus has saved my traveling butt numerous times. This one in particular showed up about 20 minutes late (a 6:30ish a.m. trip) en route to Chicago. It seems pretty standard that Megabus offers free Wi-Fi and air conditioning, so the ride back was breezy despite being split up from my guy since we were the last group heading toward Chi-town, thus having to deal with folks entitled to an entire row of seats for their sleeping pleasure. 

But all was great. Without traffic from Indy to Chicago, the ride was about 2.5 hours. Comfy seats, nice air circulation...and all that without the price tag of a Greyhound. I dig it. 

TIPS: 

*Be sure to have your confirmation number available immediately or risk getting told off by the driver.

*Sometimes a no-brainer, but I've fallen victim to this kind of unpreparedness: Wear layers or bring a blanket.

Nice to see a stand alone specialty toy store in Sherwood park. They have a great selection of educational toys as well as all the standards like Lego, playmobile etc.
Their prices aren't bad and they offer free gift wrapping on everything in the store! Too bad they don't sell gifts for my wife!
I went in to do some Christmas shopping and bought a couple of kids books and some playmobile for my son. I am sure I will go back next time I need a present for a birthday party or event to take care of the free gift wrap offering for sure.
FINALLY - someone that makes street tacos the way you are supposed to!  Great food and location
$5 drinks is wonderful, if they didn't run out of ribs at 730pm on Thursday.  Wings and pazookie are good.  One time I got marinara instead of salsa lmao

Awesome food at a great price.  Fast and very pleasant service.  Fusion Asian food at its best.  We will definitely be back!!  So many new dishes to try!   Jess was the best waitress ever.  Make sure and ask for her.

Yesterday was my 1st visit to this shop. Dollar Bill is highly recommended by a friend of mine who set up my appointment and took me there. Bill's personality was a great match for mine and he put me completely at ease, as I was confused as to exactly how and where I wanted the tatto. In Bill's words, we played a game of 20 questions till I arrived at exactly how I wanted my tatto to look. He was patient, helpful, professional, and funny. I'm excited to go back and have Dollar Bill do my next tat. The shop is clean, comfortable, and professional.

This is our first visit since the remodel.  The atmosphere is much more sterile and loud.   We ordered quiche for $8.  The slice was tasty yet rather small for the price.   The coffee menu has fewer options than pre remodel.  This will be our last visit.  This change was definitely not an improvement.

Came here for breakfast as I was staying at the Royal Sonesta.   Went with the basics.  2 eggs, potatoes, bacon and a biscuit.  Food was done well and I really like the fact that peppers and onions were cooked on it.   

I meant it come over during happy hour but never made it out of other bars.   Not a bad place for breakfast and want to try it for other meals.
The garlic chicken pizza is delicious. Would not recommend delivery. The pizza is always cold because it takes so long, usually an hour. Last night it didn't even arrive at all.

Great atmosphere, great food, great price. This place is packed during soccer games. Try their breadsticks. You won't regret it. I always get the earl club. Solid choice. Decent amount of vegetarian options, too.
Family-run, Fresh, Friendly and Fabulous! Great place to get veggies, eggs, milk, honey, beef and herbs, all locally sourced and freshly harvested.

Stopped by before the Blues game last night. There was a 30 minute wait but I think it was quicker. It was definitely hopping. Our waiter took our order right away because we wanted to go quickly so we could get to the game. 

I started with a rosemary white peach boozy lemonade. It was delicious! Good sized and perfectly flavored. They have lots of variations of fruity boozy drinks, which I love. It was hard to decide what to get. My dining partners each got something different, and each liked theirs. 

For my meal, I knew I had to try the veggie burger, which has changed since my last (dismal) review. Now it is described as "sweet potato patty, pecan butter, sage aioli, spinach." I wasn't so sure about the toppings but got it as is because I wanted to try how they had hopefully improved the flavors since last time. My husband and I also ordered a large order of fries with sriracha catsup and cheddar sauce. 

Our drinks took awhile to come but the food was quick. And.... REDEMPTION!!!! This veggie burger was DELICIOUS. SO MUCH BETTER than it used to be! The flavors of the aioli and pecan butter were perfect with the earthy flavor of the burger. The bun was so soft and fresh. Just wonderful. I ate it all up. The fries here are really good, and the sauces also were. They bring bigger portions than they did the last time I went. The total bill for 2 drinks, 2 burgers and a large fry was about $40 without tip. A little pricey, but good for the quality and location.

The only bad thing was that one of my dining partners got a burger that was still mooing, but he sent it back and it was redone and brought back quickly. The others enjoyed theirs. I liked mine so much that I really want to come back soon to get another!

Been there three times... Third time still not a charm.  First time server took 15 minutes to greet table most people would have walked out and refills took forever... Second time doors locked over an hour before stated closing time .. And then the other night.. Waited ten minutes at bar while watched bartender tend to a group of girls at end of bar and put away salt and pepper shakers although when asked when closing his answer implied two hours which would have been 1am.. Again not stated closing time.  Maybe each time in I'm alone I am a paying customer.. Very poor device

Was I warped in time?

Hmm, I think that the roller blades and poodle skirts were missing. LOL I don't think I know what I'm talking about, but anyway...

Cannot go wrong with a burger with guacamole :-) minus the guacamole = meh. 

I also recommend sight-seeing :-)

I had eaten at this place once before and thought it was good. My grandmother and I went today and I thought it was great. Sushi was fresh, service was great, price, even better. We were pleasantly surprised to find out it was Monday so if you bought all you can eat (14.95 for lunch) you also got all you can drink (beer and sake). We will be back sooner than later. Cutest little spot!

I love the menu,but im a local an i been here many times and there is never a good satisfying  good welcome or would u like to oreder!! Nothing not even a hi! Just a straight face!! Love love the items on the menu!!! But costumers service sucks !!!    
 Worst part!!! When i ask for a container to go! The cashier did not even bother to strive to make up for the straight face! Without a word she just pointed at the to go containers!!!!
Awesome seafood. Great atmosphere. Line can get long and wait can get long but it's worth it. Best seafood in Kenner.

Almost an hour and a half for delivery of one pizza pie. Check out the receipt and time on the adjacent iPhone. We were all disappointed with the speed of delivery. We understand pizzas can take a while to make and get delivered but an hour and half for delivery in the same town? Not good.

Came here for lunch with some of my co-workers.

They recommended the chicken tenders or shark on the lunch menu, so I ended up ordered the chicken tenders with Syberg's sauce along with a salad with Caesar dressing.

Service was fast and our food came out quickly. The salad was decent, nothing special and nothing to rave about. Kind of reminded me of one of those salad kits you could pick up at a grocery store. The chicken tenders were fried nice and juicy, but unfortunately lacked flavor. Even with the Syberg's sauce, I had to add quite a bit of pepper.

Quick food, but nothing spectacular.
Excellent food!. Always nice and courteous staff. Highly recommend their Mac n cheese! Delicious!
Awesome place to have a nice cold beer. Friendly service and good food. Will come back to visit.
I've ordered from here a few times, and it's not the best sushi I've ever had but it's decent. As far as I know it is the best sushi in Bensalem so I continue to eat there occasionally.

Went to tacos 46 and then decided to check out this place. Definitely a hidden gem.  Best parking is in the Home Depot lot and then enter through the first white door on the south side of the building.  As everyone says it's tiny but the kitchen is rocking with fun and food. Would recommend calling in your order as there is very little waiting room.  
  This is the first Mexican Taqueria I have found in this city that's worth traveling for
Torta bread was fresh and the carne asada has more flavor than any other place.  New favorite by far.

Good but pricey cocktails; disappointing and pricey food. Like other Yelpers, I agree the location is beautiful and it's a fun spot for drinks. 

But the food is actually bad! The pretzel bites are not made of pretzel - they're more like whole wheat rolls. The happy hour burger comes only with meat and cheese. The strip loin sliders have tough meat and a cold mushroom for some reason. The brioche buns on all burgers/sandwiches are dry and felt a bit stale.

I was super excited about a new place with "All-American comfort food" but left very disappointed.

Good was acceptable, desert was the best a berry dish with ice cream and a cream puff, the best part of the meal. Waitress and service was very good. Food both my wife's and mine came out warm and that's being generous. Taste was decent and onion soup was very good.

One of the nicest salons around! They have great specials and weekly deals. They have extensive nail polish colors as well as the new gelish and UV polish. The salon is clean and the staff are friendly and polite. Drinks and snacks are offered with service. Always have a short wait and a great experience.

Dr. Ashley is fine herself. She gets the job the done. So I guess I can't complain about her. A lot of the time she is rushed and doesn't listen thoroughly. Her office staff is the worst I've dealt with. I too work in the office of a medical office. I understand completely being busy and overbook or stressed out. But come on!! The girls are rude. They have canceled two of my appointments without notice and cannot give me a new appointment for months. THEY canceled I did not. There is so urgency. There is no compassion. Not once have they understood why I am there for the visit. My labs take weeks to have them tell me the results once they are received. I never receive a reminder or confirmation call. Sadly, this is who my insurance says I can see. But if it were up to me, I would be in a new office.

Had dinner on Friday night and we were charged $3 for 3 pieces of bread to start with. Our server decided to wipe her mouth with her fingers and proceed to cut our bread and serve. Ordered the Maddon special chicken parmigiana and eggplant. Was small portions and pasta was small portion. Then watched the head chef (in white coat) stick his finger in his mouth and then proceed to pinch seasonings and add to food while cooking. I would never go back. Plus we came all the way from Chicago!

We loved the cozy, welcoming atmosphere of this place. Brick wall filled with artwork, tables, couch, and a bar wrapped around the window with a bunch of art magazines lying around. The coffee was great as well. I can't believe I didn't realize this place was here. We'll be coming back often whenever we're in town.


I must say, they really do often have some of the most interesting artwork I've seen at coffee shops. Each time we've gone, it's been a new artist. We just purchased a few pieces from the current artist on display. I believe her name is Stevie something?

I love this place! I miss the old owner Sherry but Rebecca new owner is super sweet and helpful and she chit chats with you instead of just hurrying you in and out which is rare these days. She was a bit late opening up today, but that's ok as I know things happen sometimes and I have been late to work myself sometimes. Still very kitschy and cute place and packed with lots of goodies just waiting to be discovered :) def a great place to check out and reminisce of days gone by....
We come here pretty regularly for our Mexican food cravings! Real easy menu and affordable! Friendly staff too

A very colorful atmosphere greeted us upon arrival. I had the pulled pork with a side of collard greens, coleslaw and the hush puppies. Now we could not have the ribs, because they weren't done. Now the menu had been cut and the choises where not that many and pulled pork is always good, right? No exception here, a rich molasses flavored bbq-sauce covered the pulled pork and it was good. Not great, but good. Now the sides where as sides goes, nothing exceptional but not bad. Now as we where leaving we saw the ribs being pulled of the smoker and they looked good, perhaps call ahead and ask about the ribs? 

Would I revisit? If I were to get the ribs, yes, otherwice, no.

I've been here 6 or 7 times.  The food is consistently good, if overpriced ($12-14+ Mexican entrees?!).  However, almost every time there has been a service issue, regardless of time of day or how busy it is.  They really haven't figured out the timing...sometimes you sit for 10 minutes before a server introduces themselves.  Other times you order chips/salsa (which is now an extra charge) and it comes out a minute before the food.  This past weekend there was no host at the host stand for a good 5 minutes, even when the place was quiet.  When we were finally seated, we were bounced between two different hosts and, in the process, our menus and silverware were left in a pile on a different table, for us to fetch ourselves.  Several weeks ago, I ordered a beer and the server cleared it when there were several sips remaining.

I will say that on two or three occasions I've raised concerns to the manager and have found him/her to be competent, apologetic and accommodating about the situation.  But I really just want a problem-free meal, and that seems hard to come by at the Wynnewood location.

My wife and I had been wanting to check this place out for a long time and finally got in for lunch today. We wish we would've tried it sooner.

We both went with the regular-sized Cuban (when in Rome, right?). The sandwich was big enough for two portions, and that's not even the largest size they offer.  They were fantastic.  The pork and ham were juicy and the bread was fresh.

She had the black bean soup and I had the yellow rice as sides. Both stellar, but I preferred the soup. As most have stated in here, it's a must-get.

We're going back soon for the coffee and pastries!
Had the risotto crawfish cake and jumbo shrimp in the most delicious Creole sauce as a special. Yes yes yes. The Royal street salad dressing was amazing!!!

We got here yesterday and our day was awesome! I remember Peppermill when I was younger but they have updated for new age. We stayed at the Peppermill Tower, still elegant and luxurious. Our friend stayed at the Tuscany Tower and it was gorgeous. For the price we paid for our room, it was worth it and more. They have a game room for kids (Game Lab) but we spent more time in there than on the casino floor.

The only downside is the food is good tasting but expensive.

Village Whiskey is good, not great.  They have a very large selection of mostly overpriced whiskeys and scotches that line the back of the bar, one of the largest in the city as far as I've seen.

Service is always good although it's cramped in there and the servers have no where to go on the floor so I guess they kind of have to be attentive.

When you order a burger here, they prompt with 'medium rare' okay? Which is perfect, except that all three times I've gotten burgers here they've all been overcooked.  They are still good, mind you, not so much that I would make a fuss and send it back, not the best in the city and maybe not worth the price tag.   Maybe they should change their prompt to 'medium well okay?' 

PS. cheese puffs are on point and so are the duckfat fries.

Bone Daddy and Chicago were excellent and some of the best ribs I've ever had the pleasure of eating. Anywhere you go will be excellent but some are out of this world amazing. 

The people got it right as Chicago BBQ Company won for the Peoples Choice. I personally loved Kinders and its hard to pick one over the other. 

The party starts officially at 11AM but we came on Saturday morning at around 9:45 and there were a dozen places that were already selling. My suggestion is to be on the street and ready to eat before 10AM so you can avoid the HEAT and the crowds. Then by 11 you can go back to your room for a few minutes. 

There is a 97% chance we will be back next year.

Our go to for local sushi. Staff is wonderful and always remembers us. We usually sit on the deck above broad ripple avenue with one or more of the dogs and feast on generous portions of tasty sushi creations. I love the valentine roll, raw tuna wrapped around (sadly faux but still yummy) crab, or the tobiko rainbow, various fish in a roll smothered with four different kinds of caviar. Best negamaki I've ever had. Decent wine, beer, and sake lists. It's a great, family feeling type of joint with a very broad ripple vibe.

I stopped in over the holidays in mid December for takeout on my way home. My wife and kids were out for the night so I stopped to get a chicken parm dinner with pasta to take home. The staff took my order upon walking in at the pizza counter, I then took at seat in the lobby to wait for my food. I waited about 20-25 min on and off my cell phone which was fine, until the owner looks over the counter and says hey boss what did you order to find out they didn't start making my food yet. I ended up leaving with my food about 10 min later which was good and why I have to give them 3 stars (1 star for service/5 stars for the food). I probably won't be back since I have other options closer to home.

Great ambiance with a "grandmas kitchen table" atmosphere. Super friendly staff and delicious food, hot chocolate and lattes. We stumbled in on a mini vacation and Sad we don't live closer. Next time we're in the area, we'll definitely stop by!

Lucy's is... Lucy's. A fun, casual place that's often very crowded. Food's serviceable if not spectacular. Staff is always friendly and on-point. Good to know they have a private space upstairs you can rent for parties/events.

Unexpectedly the best part of our NOLA girls trip. To say I'm obsessed with this place and it's concept is an understatement. 

It's just as cool, casual and fun as everyone makes it sound - but the moment you roll up outside in your Uber, you'll probably think otherwise. And your friends will say "Where the hell did you bring us." It's way off the beaten path, hidden in a part of town that seems a bit industrial. Then, you walk in to a dark and dingy wine room, but don't let it fool you. 

You grab all of your supplies inside - bottle of wine etc.. Then, you step outside, grab a plastic bucket and fill it with water from the spout that's attached to the house (the establishment was transformed from a home). Then, you sit down in hodge-podge chairs and tables in the most charmingly lit and blossomed backyard. All while listening to a solo acoustic artist play guitar and sing sweet jams. NOW THE BEST PART. Go back inside, pick out a few blocks of local cheese, and they'll plate it for you (bread, jams, olives, cornichons) for a small fee. DO THIS. Some of the best cheese I've ever had, and they do a great job plating. 

We went on a Monday afternoon, and the backyard was pretty full for a weekday. The yard has the perfect amount of shade and sun, and we stayed much longer than we expected. Great HH deals, too. Pure bliss and the best break after a night spent on Bourbon St. Don't miss this spot.
SO good. Hearty sized donuts with unique variations. Not open very late, but perfect for a morning bite after a late night.

I've been coming here regularly and I LOVE it.
I get the gel-powder and it lasts for a full two weeks and I come back because of the regrow, not because it's chipped. My nails are healthy and strong. I love coming here. Everyone is so personal and amazing.

Carter's Florist, are the most awesome people.  My husband had them make an arrangement for my 60th Birthday! 60 yellow roses!  The arrangement was stunning!  If you are in the St Petersburg, Fl area, 
I recommend them highly. The arrangement took my breath away!  5 stars no doubt!

Very, very loud. Parking next to impossible. Food was OK but not authentic Mex. Was Tex-Mex.
Margaritas were good and was happy hour so they were even better. Waiter was friendly and humorous.
Very expensive for what we had.

Good reliable food!  We used to do the yuppie long wait at Goldy's but as I said in that review, we stopped going the day the cook told me my sing sausage patty for like $6 came from COSTCO!  WOW!  No thanks!  Moons has changed hands and they still kept it pretty consistent.  Its much more of a diner and what you would expect for your money!  Skip the annoying waits and costco food and try this joint!
Since St. Louis City finally passed a half way decent smoking ordinance this place is now non-smoking. So the smoke is no longer an issue.

I ordered the Hatchery and it was amazing! The goat cheese was so good, I loved it. The service was great and the servers very attentive and friendly. I recommend you go here if you're in the area..wouldn't drive out of my way to come but definitely recommend it!

Really great place. Got takeout on Wednesday night - quesadilla and tacos. The earlier review about the quesadilla was spot on - fresh and flavorful. Tacos were excellent too. Family operation with everyone working the kitchen - great atmosphere. Highly recommend.

Came here last night with a friend. We came for a couple drinks between dinner and a movie. We came here because of its growing reputation for having a wonderfully large craft bottle menu. The menu doesn't disappointed, 4 pages of craft beer bottles and cans. I would like to see more seasonal choices. A man who I believed to be the owner was very friendly and talked beer with us. The bar has a great layout (big central rectangular bar with tables on all sides) and seems pretty clean. It also seemed to have a decent crowd for a Thursday. I will definitely be back.

Good luck getting something to eat here. The service at the snack bar is bad today. (9-3-18) Only one person working, a bunch of customers standing around. No organized line, no one knows who's next, just a jumble of people. The girl working doesn't seem to care. People that came after me got helped first. I got frustrated and walked away and left soon after to get food elsewhere.
Fantastic choices of frozen yogurt with a nice selection of toppings. The staff was friendly,  the place was bright, inviting, and very clean.
Terrible service. I entered a refill order on Dec. 3 and received an email with an expected ship date of Dec. 9!!! Terrible!!

Great interior decorating, very lovely ambiance. The servers/waiters were very nice and friendly. Me and a buncha friends came here during restaurant week and ordered from that menu. I got the Summer Gazpacho, which has spiced shrimp, piment d'espelette, parsley croutons in it, the 12oz prime rib, and the Valrhona Chocolate Mousse. The gaspacho was alright... first time I ever tried it. The prime rib was advertised to be medium rare, but it came out to be medium well for me. Way overdone. But nonetheless it wasn't too bad... at least the tender parts anyway. And you can't go wrong with the chocolate mousse cake. Four stars for the place, though I feel it could've been better if they didn't serve everyone at once. It seemed like they cooked appetizers for everyone and then entrees for everyone to make it more efficient. That may be why the steak was overcooked.
Super long line and only drip coffee and no gluten free pancakes. Big disappointment considering that it comes up on gluten free search on yelp.

Brunch or dinner, it doesn't matter. Delicia's chefs have created a great menu of brunch and dinner items that have good variety. And if you hear people try and call this "Mexican food," speak up and tell them it's"Latin american cuisine with a twist." 

Every item is great but my favorite two are the fish tacos and duck enchiladas. And for brunch, the biscuits and gravy are amazing.

And I haven't even gotten to the drinks. They have good beer and wine options, but you must try the fire and ice cocktail. Just do it.

The only downside is that it can get loud on a Friday or Saturday night, so don't go there if you want a quieter setting.

If you're looking for a wine tour for your bachelorette party, or to get massively tanked, this tour probably isn't for you.  However, if you're looking for a chill day of wine tasting and learning, you're in the right spot.

I gravitated towards this tour because I don't know shit about wine.  I know I enjoy it, but that's about it (I'm from Salt Lake City, sue me).

Well, I finally learned a thing or two on this tour and had a great experience in the process.  As other reviewers stated, the tour hits four wineries and you get a picnic lunch.  Kalayra, in my opinion, is the best, so if you're buying bottles to take home, stock up.  I'd definitely recommend the port.

The tour guide is great and I'd definitely recommend. Think of all the money you'll save by not getting a DUI in Solvang!

This place is an above-average, but not exceptional pizza place.  As much as I love Philly significantly more than New York, and think Philly is a bastion of high food culture whereas New York is a sinkhole of overpriced junk, New York does Pizza better than Philly, and New Haven, CT absolutely owns Philly.  So the bar is set lower.

This is one of the better pizza places I've found in Philly, but compared against the other non-pizza restaurants in the surrounding neighborhood, many of which earn their five stars, this one falls short.

It's very good, but the pizza just isn't as good as it could be.  Every time I sink my teeth into a slice of pizza here, I am heartily satisfied.  The ingredients are fresh, it's not too greasy...but...it just doesn't wow me.  It isn't an otherworldy experience.  And...in the Philly metro, up the road in the north 'burbs, is Jules Thin Crust, which costs only a bit more per slice, and does wow me like this.  And...up in New York and New Haven, CT, there are lots of places that look superficially like this one, but also wow me like that.  I need that experience of awesomeness before I dole out the fifth star.

Other things that this place has going for it though are a great beer selection, really great location, a friendly staff, and the fact it's open late at night.
