This place will make you say "heck yeah" when you are hungry and want a place to get good pizza and beer, but it won't knock your socks off if you're looking for the best gourmet pizza around.
Still A+ Service, now with more emotional service understanding customers, their taste, top notch environment and as always great menu. Paneer 65, Veg Coins and Chinese Bhel for WIN!!!!

Never have had a problem, and I'm sure if there was Lisa would have no problem fixing it.  I love when my husband brings me home flowers from her shop she always adds that special touch to it !! Love Pennypack flowers!!

I have been to this cafe more times than I can count.

The first year that I lived here I was frequenting this place on the way to school nearly every day.  My trips were for one reason, the AWESOME iced coffee.  Obviously it's a cold drip coffee, it's so delicious I loved it.

Another thing that's awesome here.  The waffles.  They will basically do whatever you want and one of the best things is apples, walnuts, and peanut butter.  SO GOOD! yummy!

It kinda sucks that they close by 2 or 3, but if you like early breakfast than go go, but if you like brunch time they will be super busy and you will have to wait.  Later in the day they tend to start running out of things so make sure and get there early!

They do take credit.  :)
Although the food tastes good it is not fresh. Rice tastes weird. They don't defrost the food enough. The gobi manchurian is bad. Tasted weird.

Visited here on a Saturday and I guess I was expecting  a little more.  The store is a bit overwhelming, had a dusty odor, I didn't see anything eye-catching (and usually I can find anything and easy to please), and the clothing selections was kinda "drabby".  Maybe I came in on the wrong day? *shrug*

The best SICILIAN food around. Hands down. Was here for my 25th bday celebration with my girlfriend. The food was AMAZING!!!!!!! 

Can't miss dish is the antipasti to start, an absolute sensational dish that hits every note and is plate licking good. The special app was stewed beef tripe. Both were a great start to the meal. For our mains, we ordered 3 small plates of pasta to share. The special pasta, a silky pillow gnocchi in a sweet pea/stewed calamari sauce was the star of the night. Rigatoni with eggplant was tremendous, the eggplant is cooked to perfection. The final pasta was a pesto, the best damn pesto I've had. Everything was 11/10. The meal ended with dessert, and the zeppolis left us smiling. Couldn't have had a better experience. The new regular for a great night out. Keep up the great work here!!!!

Best brewery I visited in Indianapolis. Blew every other brewery out of the water. Beer was consistently tasty. Service awesome. Amazing loyal regulars. Great atmosphere. Great place to unwind after work or place to meet friends or just try some new beer. Free goldfish too ;) om nom

We came here all the time after they opened but the service just keeps getting worse.  Sorry to say it.

Its time to switch to switch to Besito.

I'm a fairly new rider and I'm super exciting about road biking. With this new love, I've been enjoying checking out some of the different bike shops in town. Since I'd been looking for a specific set of pedals, I decided to give these guys a try and this was my experience:

I walked in mid-day to a store with no other customers. There was a guy eating lunch on one of the display counters who didn't even look up at me. After browsing around for a while with no acknowledgement from the staff, I walked up to the counter with the pedals where the guy had decided to eat his lunch. While awkwardly trying to look around him in to the case, I asked about the pedals. You'd think that he would either move or grab them for me, but he did neither, responding that they had them in stock. I asked him about the price and he guessed a price or two rather than look it up. Finally, another employee came over, grabbed the pedals, and gave me the price. This experience left a bad taste in my mouth. On top of bad experience, the price was the most expensive out of the three shops that I compared. 

Not a good first experience. Coming from someone who has worked in customer service for 10+ years, I can easily say that this is not good retail. I would've happily paid the higher price had I received excellent service to make up for it. 

With so many other shops in the area, I doubt I'll return.

Great for breakfast so I decided to try for dinner. Fried chicken was very small and side portions are even smaller. My country fried steak was chewy and not very warm. If you're looking for a good breakfast Place I would recommend caposeys but definitely not for dinner.

I've eaten at Luke before with good results. The Hamburger seems to be the best deal on the menu in terms of portion size and quality. The service seems to be suffering on my last couple of visits. They had three hostesses and a host rotating around the restaurant but somehow it took the waitress 40 minutes to take our order and bring out our food. When the shrimp and grits arrived the shrimp were room temperature at best. The grits were warm, likely secondary to the hot iron skillet. The portions are undersized. I don't want to go to apple-bees and get 10 pounds of food, but I would like my entree priced at $20 plus to be larger than an appetizer. 

Also, do they really have to serve diet coke in an 8 oz bottle. Can they just give a large glass which will be refilled like every other restaurant? I feel like the drink seems to be a way to generate revenue. It was ha hassle.

I also would have ordered dessert but the service was so slow that I didn't know how long it would be until we got out of there. 

In short good food, undersized portions with mediocre service.

Maybe, they should transition one of the five host/hostesses to wait staff to minimize this problem.

Won't be eating here until this is fixed.
Great food and an amazing Pilsner. Was short on time and service was fast and on cue. Can't wait to come back again.

This place could be a candidate for Chef Ramsey's "Kitchen Nightmares" series. I understand that this place was destroyed by the 2010 Cumberland River flood, and that it was recently rebuilt. It looks great, and is in a great location, right on the river, although a bit off the beaten path. The place was practically empty at a time when it should have been really busy. That should have been our first clue that all was not well. The food was practically inedible, and our server, while she didn't say it, seemed to be embarrassed to serve it. 

What the owners of so many restaurants fail to understand is that we go to restaurants first for the FOOD, not the decor or the view. If you don't get the food part right, everything else was a waste of money. For a fraction of the price of the decor you can hire a good, solid executive chef who can turn out some amazing food that will bring customers back again and again. Great food turns into happy customers, and happy customers turn into profits.

Such a cute place with AMAZING cake! You can try a bunch of different types of cake with their mini cakes. I would highly recommend the carrot and the coffee flavors. The owner is super cordial. We drove all the way from north Tampa to check them out and Im so glad we did!

Davidson and Son has done ALL of the work in my home. They installed a deck, Sliding doors, New Windows, put new pipes in bathroom and renovated it too,Put a fireplace in my bedroom, crown molding, baseboards, trim work, painting, all new electric, finished my basement and more!!!!! Im in a wheelchair and the workers always go out of there way to make sure that the work is done as minimum invasive as possible!!! They really have gone above and beyond as a company. Before I hired them the first time, I had 4 different contractors give me prices for the job and they were DOUBLE what Davidson and Son quoted me!!! I highly reccomend them to anyone who wants great work done at a great price!!!!

I used to LOVE going to India Palace for their lunch & dinner buffets. I would say in the past year, the cleanliness and customer service have declined immensely. We've had the same server the last couple times we've gone, and he's been incredibly RUDE, impatient and disrespectful. We're never asked if we would like anything other than water to drink. We have to chase them down for refills when we manage to get sodas ordered. Plates are grabbed before we're finished. IT'S BEEN TERRIBLE! I've been going here for almost 6 yrs but its time to find a new Indian Restaurant because its just not worth the drive or time anymore.
Location has been closed for months.

I LOVE the food and drinks here, I've never had anything I didn't like. My favorite is the grilled cheese, mixing apples and cheese is my favorite, so this sandwich is a hit for me. The decor is awesome as well, very unique and and fun. What I find really disappointing is the service. The past few times I've been in I've had the same male server who has been less than stellar. We wait maybe 10 minutes to give an order, waited 30 minutes for our first drinks, and then another 20 for the check. I would have loved to order a couple more drinks and maybe some desert, but waiting on the server 30 minutes per drink is something I don't have time for. The other staff seemed to be working really hard and even helped us out a little when our server was no where to be found, I wish I would have had one of them instead.

my favorite tofu place, gosh the hot spicy soon dubu is to die for! they have private parking, so it is great and generous with their serving of side dishes. I have brought guests here and they all love this place! Great pricing with heavenly food!

I've never felt the need to write a review until now... Was super excited to try this place with some coworkers one day last week. Arrived just after noon. There were 4 other tables and then us. It took 15 min to be offered anything besides water. We said we were n a bit of a hurry and would like to order. 10 min later he came back so we actually could... Another 25 min later when we were still without food ( salads and a flatbread and simple sandwich) we asked that our food be packaged to go.  Sadly the poor service (empty water bottle, forgotten ice tea) didn't stop there. The salads were not the ones we ordered and we were missing a sandwich! Looks cool on paper and at the actual location but I would recommend this place to an enemy. The food and service were sad.

It's been a little while since last I've visited The Depot, and this was the first time I'd visited for brunch.

Walking in, we were seated right away, got settled, and quickly put in our drink orders.  Half of our party opted for the Man-Mosa, a large serving of champagne and juice which is the perfect thing on a sunny weekend morning.  The other half of us, myself included, went for a tall mug of beer.  They've got a great deal on their American Pale Ale, where for just five bucks you can get a 32 ounce stein full.  Needless to say, I was immediately a fan.  Placing our food orders from their small but pretty awesome brunch menu, we were soon served up with all our tasty fare.

I will say this about The Depot; their food is top notch!  Every time I've visited, I have consistently been impressed with their fare.  A lot of their menu is for sure versions of pub favorites, but at a whole other level, and beyond these you can usually find something new and interesting to try out.  On this morning, my Fish n Chips were simply divine, and I was instantly addicted to their fries dipped in their house-made ketchup.  My companions likewise were blown away by their burger, and their pan-fried hash and eggs.  It certainly had me chowing down with gusto.

Now, let me contrast the food a bit with their drink menu.  It is great that they are a brewery and distillery, making them another great addition to our region's craft beverage scene.  I will say that all their beers are pretty darn good, even if they aren't really my favorite brews in town.  But hey, the stein special is hard to beat anywhere!  Their spirits are likewise good, and you can get them neat or in cocktails.  An addition they've made since last I was here is their Amer Picon liqueur, and seeing this, we of course had to order a round of Picon Punches, eager to see how it stacks up to the punches from places around town like Louis', Santa Fe, or 1864.  I'll admit, it was a really good cocktail, but seemed a lot lighter and just sort of different than what I tend to think of as a more standard form of our unofficial state drink.  But I applaud them for branching out with something not seen terribly often, and making it quite tasty to boot.  Should you desire, you can also purchase bottles of their liquors to go.

Another feature I must mention about this place is the building itself.  As the name suggests, it is the old railway depot, and they have done simply a phenomenal job updating and maintaining this historic building.  Open rooms, chique decorations, a great looking bar looking back into the brewery, and just in general capturing a warm, welcoming feel really makes this place a piece of eye candy.  The service here is always amazingly friendly and attentive, adding to that welcoming feel.  Parking can be a bit of a pain, though, as their lot is around back through an alleyway, a bit on the small side, and shared with the businesses next door.

Anyone exploring our local food and drink scenes should for sure add The Depot to their list.  Hopefully it won't be as long until the next time I visit.
You have to get the ice cream. The butter pecan is amazing!  Shakes are a bit small.  I get something new for lunch each time.  Salads are huge.

Really good food with an even better backstory! 
There is a very local/community-driven vibe at the restaurant. Very authentic to New Orleans. 
I would recommend the catfish with mac and cheese and jambalaya on the side. Especially the jambalaya. 
If you have time after your meal, check out the Ashé Cultural Center across the street.

I've been going here since they were basically a closet behind the Hub. Now being a Downtowner it's great to see how she has grown up to suit the locals needs. From pet food to pasta to great selection of beer and wine everything is there. Along with a moderate amount of fresh fruit veggies and herbs anything you need in case "you forgot" when you were at Publix. Now add in some gourmet chocolates and heat and eat meals that are well beyond your grocery freezer and cooler sections is why this place gets 5 Stars. If Publix is 4 Stars this place is a 5 :)

recently went here for my birthday with a huge group of 16. we were treated well and everyone liked the food! i met a guy who got fired for having 3 facial piercings even though they hired him that way - a customer complained and so they let him go. not fair!

Hands down our best dining experience while on NOLA. The food was excellent. We had been given recommendations from the hotel and other locals but found this place on Yelp. Most places were hit or miss and a lot of the food lacked flavor.
The donuts are indeed SQUARE. These donuts are great! Some of the best donuts I've ever had. Even the staff at this establishment were extremely nice. I really wish we had one of these in Nashville.

My wife and I love the different burrito places around and moes is one of our favorites. I would usually give it a 5 but this location seems to have a tendency to put ingredients in piles instead of spreading them out so you bite into your burrito and get everything g in layers.. If they took the time to spread it instead they would be our favorite instead of blue coast

got my first brazilian wax here from natalie and she was fabulous. they use hard wax and walked me thru the procedure. she made me feel comfortable and chatted with me to distract me which was nice. the salon is cute, modern and clean. would definitely recommend to others and return as a client.

I took my sis here today for lunch. We left her place headed for another restaurant that turned out to be closed on Mondays. I told our server I was tempted to send them a Thank you card for being closed!! My burger was so fresh & beautifully rare. The fries were great as well nice and crispy w a good amount of seasoning. Sis had a chopped salad w her burger that she said was also very good. ( apologies for failing to get pictures)

Bamboo offers a fairly decent selection of Vietnamese dishes at affordable prices.
Offering numerous Pho, noodle, and rice dishes, Bamboo is my go-to place when I feel a craving for Vietnamese cuisine. Their appetizers are delicious as well.

Their interior decor and music is calming, which is a plus. Their friendly staff help cement this place as West Chester's best Vietnamese restaurant.

If you feel like Vietnamese and don't want to drive an hour to Philadelphia, Bamboo is your best option.

Absolutely amazing menu had so many delicious dishes had a hard time deciding we had eggrolls the dumplings amazing for entree we had the Pad Thai great I had the green curry with shrimp the smell when down in front of me was so wonderful but the taste was even better. It will be hard time to decide what to try next. Everyone try this place it will definitely be a legecy in this area, bravo finally a wonderful place to have real thai food and wonderful serves. Might go tonight just thinking about.

Worth the wait!! It is worth the wait!! The shrimp and grits made you want to swim in them they were so good. I would have licked my plate if I was at home. Yass!! Oh and the biscuit are so dense with a touch of fluffiness, you don't even need butter or honey. We tried the crab omelet and another item and they were excellent. Don't be discouraged by the wait. You are giving your tummy a treat.  What a reward !!

Great lunch specials with 1980's prices!!! Always a favorite but lately it seems the place needs a good clean up inside and out......
#santabarbara #food #sbdining

My friends and I had just finished a 5K run in Fairmount Park and needed something warm to eat. I saw Mel's Kitchen nearby on Yelp and decided to give it a try! I ordered the "Healthy Alternative", a bowl of "Crab Corn Chowder" (recommended by Yelpers), and cup of tea. Friends had the vegetarian omelette, bowl of beef chili, and Manhattan Chowder. 

Healthy Alternative: IT WAS THE BEST NON-HEART-ATTACK-INDUCING BREAKFAST EVER. It was a large portion of eggs, mushrooms, squash/cucumbers, cheese, and some other vegetable-goodness on a multi-grain bread, served with sausages. It didn't give me one of those regrettable, fat-soaked feelings like other breakfast foods. 

Crab Corn Chowder: IF YOU DO NOT TRY THIS, YOU ARE MISSING OUT ON LIFE. LIFE IS MEANINGLESS WITHOUT THIS SOUP. Unless you are allergic to seafood and/or corn. 

All my friends LOVED their foods and really want to come here again although we are out in Allentown. But I definitely will be coming here again :) Especially when it's warmer because I noticed a patio out! 

Service: Everyone was SO accommodating to us. Especially my one friend who is the type of person to ask "Where do you get your meat from?" "Is your vegetables organic?" "How large is the portions?" and other questions that make you want to smack the be-jesus out of them. They answered everything and were VERY home-like and friendly. 

It's also very jam-packed so you know it's good!

Came here one Saturday morning without really knowing what to expect, was a little bit of a wait (20ish minutes?), but was absolutely worth it. Great atmosphere, excellent service, plus it's dog friendly, so our pooch was able to happily come along.

Food was great, we were in the mood for crepes so we had the ham, spinach, and cheese crepe as well as the strawberry crepe. Strawberry crepe was a little heavy on the whipped cream, but the ham, spinach and cheese crepe was outstanding. Overall great and light breakfast meal - we'll be back to try more things on the menu!

If you haven't been to Ghini's before, I would definitely take some time out of your morning to stop by!

Went for the Happy hour after friends had highly recommended Luke. We were in town for a cruise so we flew in a couple days early. From the airport after flying for 14 hours we checked into our hotel and then bee lined it to Luke before happy hour finished. The bar was packed, but luckily a table for 2 opened up and we were seated with 45 min left. We started with 1 doz baked, 2 doz raw oysters, and a couple glasses of champagne. Baked arrived first and my wife was in heaven (she doesn't care for the raw ones) next the raw, these are plump  med. size gulf oysters, fresh as can be, simply wonderful !! We were going to order a bottle of the same champagne at the same time as I was ordering another 2 doz raw, but our waiter informed us that it was cheaper to order by the glass during happy hour. With 15 min left I got a call from my 82 y/o mother who had also just arrived in town with her 3 friends. I asked if she wanted some oysters and of course she said yes. Our waiter was great, after informing him that we needed  another 4 doz  raw for my mom and her friends he cleared a table next to us even though happy hour was almost over. All of us had a great time, the service, food, drinks, and atmosphere was as advertised and then some. The next day my wife and I decided to go back and we were seated at the same table. The manager recognized us and came over to chat, commenting that he had just seen us at the same table 23 hrs ago. NOLA has a lot of great restaurants and happy hours  to choose from and we think Luke  should definitely be high on your list to experience.

Had a reunion here - reunions make me feel old. 

I have to admit that I wasn't TOO thrilled w/ the idea of the venue when I first Yelped the place and saw the bad reviews. 

I shall be the first to admit I was wrong and that I was pleasantly surprised when I got there. The hostess was very polite (even though she was busy on that Sat. night) when she directed us to the upstairs area. The bartenders were friendly and paid attention. 

The cost of one of these gatherings (top shelf liquor and 3 finger foods selected from 6 or more choices) was $40 per person. What really made me warm up to Paddy Whack's was that they were very flexible about the arrangement. If you couldn't/didn't want to partake in the food/drinks, you didn't have to. Those who did, got a green wrist band. Those who only wanted to eat could pay $20 and go at the food. Those who came late to the party ($40 for drinks lasted 3 hours only) could opt to do a cash bar only.

I will say that the food (in steaming trays) didn't look super amazing, but then again, Paddy Whack's isn't exactly advertising it as gourmet food either.  I didn't try it, so I have no opinion on whether they were yummy.

I'm very thrilled about the flexibility they gave our party and would definitely recommend them as a venue (provided the flexibility remains).

Thanks for hosting our fun evening!

Sunday Brunch was disappointing.  While there were wonderful items available, many of the hot foods were barely warm, including the coffee.  Our server was very friendly but she didn't offer us the small plate menu until after we had made our selections.  In fact, it was the guy at the omelet station who told us to ask the server for a waffle.  The server also didn't mention the mimosas that were part of the Brunch.  
Very pricey for an omelet, cold bacon, cold sausage, cold carved pork and warm coffee.
I would have preferred to order from the menu but don't think that was possible.

Very disappointed. I looked online at the Krispy Kreme menu and figured out the assorted dozen I wanted with my girlfriend. I go to this place, and like nothing is there. OK - I understand some sound a bit more specialty, like chocolate iced raspberry filled, double dark chocolate, cinnamon apple filled, and powdered blueberry filled. But they literally didn't have ANY powdered sugar donuts at all, no maple glazed anything, no lemon filled anything. And when I commented about them not having much, I got attitude back from the girl behind the counter telling me they had everything except for maybe one or two donuts. It's one thing to not have many routine donuts. It's another to have bad attitude. But to have both? One star it is.

Came here late on a Friday night after catching a free jazz concert and fireworks at Penn's Landing. I had pretty high hopes for this meal because the two friends I was with had been talking about taking me there to celebrate my graduation since I got my diploma in June. We ordered two baskets of crab fries for the three of us, and although we all have big appetites and were starving when we arrived, we couldn't finish them. The fries were wayyy too salty! I was told by J that they usually aren't, and judging from the pictures that others have uploaded, our crab fries were obviously very over-seasoned. A spent half the meal shaking the seasoning off each individual fry before eating it. I did like the cheese sauce but overall I was disappointed that the crabfries did not live up to the hype. 

I also had the Magooby--a sandwich with jumbo shrimp, pickles, onions topped with crab fries and cheese sauce. The funny name caught my attention (I should've asked where it came from!), and I ordered it even though it sounds like a weird combo, because weird combos usually turn out to be absolutely delicious, right (i.e. anything from Little Baby's)? Here, not so much. It wasn't bad--but it wasn't good, either. My biggest qualm with it was that the sandwich was cut in half before the fries and sauce were put on top, which made it difficult to actually separate the two halves without making a mess. Maybe I'm being picky, but I just don't like getting cheese sauce all over my hands! J enjoyed his buffalo cheesesteak (you can't really go wrong with that), but A thought his white mussels were just so-so. I was also pretty shocked (in a bad way) when we got the check. 

The hostesses were a little standoffish, but our server (I think her name was Nicole?) was wonderful! The sports bar atmosphere is pretty cool, but I'm not a sports fan at all so I probably won't be back.
The food was okay but they setted us very close to the bathroom so I believe they didn't clean very well then smell was there not too happy

I come here every year on my annual road trips to Florida because gas is cheap at the Flying J, and it amazes me that every time I come it takes them FOREVER!!!!!! It's McDonalds people not a gourmet meal.. There is nothing fast about it. Pretty sure I could get a meal at Cracker Barrel next door in the time it takes them to make my number 4 sausage mcmuffin meal.. The slowest service I have ever had at a McDonald. And that includes the south where they typically move super slow. To give you an idea I'm writing this review while I'm waiting in line and still haven't even ordered. What gets me is that it is every year!!! I keep waiting for them to get better one year but it never happens..........

Pretty good pizza!! Nice menu - I'd like to try a sub next time because they sound delicious.  Ordered two pies - a Taco pizza and a Hawaiian and they were good.  Ordered the thin crust and it's a thin, crisp crust.  This place is generous with their toppings.  They have a well appointed salad bar inside too.

Very slow service but the garden is nice. The salmon burger was good. The torpedo: an italian sandwich with French roll, Italian prosciutto and a lot  salt :), was just salty ;). I will not recommend this place if you are hungry with just one hour to eat.I am settling for an average length review because is not too much to say about this place.

I highly recommend Optilife and Dr. Danielle Hoeffner. The staff is very friendly and helpful. Dr Danielle has great bedside manner, cares for her patients and she is very good at what she does. 
 I have a lot of experience with Chirpractic services and I can says hands down this is a premier provider. Do not hesitate to use them. They have helped me immensely and they are very accomodating. 
 I don't write reviews but I felt compelled to do this because of the superior services and care Optilife provides. Thanks
Just average and the service isn't good. The older woman behind the counter is rude and pushy. Too bad as it used to be really good. Veggies were ok.  Broth was unseasoned.

Ordered takeout for dinner - asked if they could put a rush on it and they did - food arrived when they said it would in 20 minutes! Great online ordering system. Food was delicious - will definitely order from there again.
Kim did my nails, was the first time I've been here. She did a great job and I love them. They look fantastic!!!
Absolutey the BEST customer service I have received from anywhere for anything in a long time.  Timely and great service with a smile!

This is one of the more laid-back sushi restaurants in New Orleans.  We each had some edamame, a cup of soup and an order of rolls. The bill came to about $12 per person and the food was great.  The restaurant is small and the rolls are being made at a counter along one side of the restaurant.  There are chairs at the counter, and I've always wanted to sit there and watch the people make the sushi rolls. But we usually have too many people to do that. We had fresh salmon rolls, spicy tuna rolls and crunchy dynamite rolls.  All good.

My wife and I get a craving for Burger Up about once a month and have to go.  We love the place.  I don't like greasy burgers so I love the fact that I can get leaner meats like Bison and Lamb.  But the beef burgers are fantastic too.  Every now and then we'll get the veggie burger and I have to say, it's a great sandwich!

I also like the fact that they source their meat as locally as possible.  It's good to know that my burger came from a farm down the road, and not some feed lot in California.  Sourcing local is what really nails the five star rating in my book.

And I have to mention the Truffle fries.  Wow!  Best thing that ever happened to a potato!

I once spent the summer between my Junior and Senior years of college watching every episode ever of Little House on the Prairie. Who enabled that amazing time? Casa Video.

Casa has an insane variety of movies and tv shows. I love that I can easily re-watch old shows from the past plus more recent ones that I missed while they were running.

They also now have daily specials, if you go on a Thursday or Sunday you get to keep your movie for a week, totally helps avoid the late fees.

For awhile we were relying on Netflix and neglecting Casa, then we returned one evening and remembered exactly why we love it, they have everything, even things you'd never know you wanted to watch until you got there, and you can have it that very moment.

Viva Casa Video.

Foodie Heaven

This is my favorite place for a delicious (and gluttonous) brunch. It's never too crowded at 11am when they open for brunch, so "no waiting with a hangry fiancé" makes it my mans favorite place as well. Always check their specials menu and order a charcuterie board- you won't regret it.

Good beer selection, awesome whiskey selection and if you try the donut you'll know why this place is a neighborhood favorite.
The Seafood here is great and its amazing how much the owner knows, she explained the different types of fish, how sustainable practices work, etc.

Anthony was extremely professional and helpful.  I had two small problems that he took a look at and he was more then reasonable.  Was at my house an hour after I called and was excellent.  Hard to find good trustworthy service like this these days.  Cannot recommend high enough.

This used to be our favourite sports bar. However in the last six months the service and food has gone extremely downhill. In December my family and I came to have dinner. At this time we waited at least twenty minutes to get help and then we're told that she was really busy. There were two other tables in the whole restaurant... We ordered chicken wings and a burger at that time with a salad for our daughter. My husband can't have seeds and asked for a different type of bun or two bottoms.. they go back and forth on whether or not they will even allow us to have two bottom buns, this night it was a no. They gave us a stale and burnt bun after they forgot about his order all together. My daughter and I were done eating prior to him getting his food. The manager gave us a 10% off coupon and when we tried to use it tonight they wouldn't allow it. After everything in the last six months, we will not be back and would highly recommend you go somewhere else.

When you visit St Louis, it is pretty much required that you need to go to Ted Drewes at some point during your stay.  Yes, they can be crazy crowded at all times of the day but they usually have several counters opened and their staff is very efficient so the short wait is not that bad.   The concretes are good and you can really hold them upside down, but I just don't buy into the hype.  I have tried several of their specials/favorites combinations at both of their locations and they are tasty but not mind blowingly good.  I give them 3.5 stars (and a  1/2 star bonus only because they can be a welcome treat on a hot summer night).

After being disappointed with the previous Thai place I used to go to I decided to try this one out.  I ordered takeout of Yellow Curry, Pad Thai, Clear Noodle Dish (Pad Woon Sen), and a appetizer sampler platter.

The sampler platter was okay, but forgettable about the only thing that both my wife and I enjoyed was the spring rolls.  The other items were either too greasy, too salty, or just too fried.

The Pad Thai was a little mild for my taste, but I still enjoyed this immensely.  Very light and tasty and I would recommend this if you do not like spicy food, but very tasty.

The clear noodles or Pad Woon Sen is one of my favorite dishes, very light and very delicate.  The noodles play well with the vegetables and was not overcooked at all, not easy to accomplish because this dish is easy to burn or cook until rubber.

The Yellow Curry was the best, my wife commented that it was the best she had.  It was the best I've had in a long time.  I will definitely be trying this again.

While I was there looking at the menu I was counting the number of times I would need to come back and try everything I wanted to order tonight, quite a few trips I need to make.  I think I have found my new Thai Place.

Prep and pasty is an amazing place for breakfast. I have not tried their lunch items but I can only assume they're amazing as well. All the food is excellent and it should go without saying that you have to try a pastry at least once! The manager is probably hands down the best one I've seen at a restaurant, very personal and friendly and always going above and beyond. Only downside is the wait, if you arrive anytime after 8:00 or so you'll be looking at a 15-30 minute wait, even more so on the weekends. Totally worth it to put your name on the waitlist here on yelp and come around the time it says your table will be ready. Otherwise totally amazing restaurant

Amazing deli with the most delicious sandwiches and best prices in Santa Barbara!
My favorite is the California chicken with avocado!
Awesome. Had the eggs Benedict. Hollandaise sauce was perfect. Don't miss this place.

I feel like people are being a little harsh on this place. Or maybe because they went right when it opened. Either way, this place is not bad at all. I ordered the hot and spicy chicken, and it was really good. This is the only place in IV that I know of that puts a little spice in their food. So yeah, if you don't like spicy food, you might not like it here. The only thing I didn't really like was that it had bones in it, which made it kind of hard to eat. My roommates got the tofu and the eggplant. My roommate who got the tofu said it was good, but she liked firm tofu better and this one wasn't. My roommate who got the eggplant loved it. And they didn't give us "too much" rice at all. One giant plate of food, with a bowl of rice on the side. We went when it was fairly less crowded, so the service was pretty fast. Oh, and the food isn't super salty like I've heard people say.
Basically, i'd go back, especially when you're really really craving Chinese food. I had a pretty pleasant experience there.

From the moment we walken in I was conflicted. On one hand the staff was attractive and the Tv's were nice but the smell was like an aquarium. Maybe it's just the new bar smell. Our Bartender was friendly though she was brushing her hair with her hand while talking to us(weird). Then it gets worse. She lets us sample a local craft beer but she sips out of the cup first.After placing our order she wipes her nose with her hand while pouring the beer and the beer is not the one we ordered. Just a brush up on bar awareness and techniques and I'll come back. I'm gonna wait till they weed out the grossness. Nice Tv's

Although people say they have good burgers, I wouldn't know,  since I couldn't get in to try them without waiting an hour and a half! And you can't make reservations either! Ridiculous! Go across the street to shake shack and save some money and no waiting.
Has to be one of the best cheese stake places in town.  Worth the trip.

We thought we'd give the new kid on the block a chance tonight and were not disappointed! What once was the Green Iguana, Kelly Days has revamped the space and stays true to the firehouse theme throughout the space. I especially love the new upstairs area! Great selection of food and drinks---I had the mac and cheese burger and my boyfriend had the slider flight and everything was delicious! Liz was an amazing server! Welcome to the hood, Kelly Days!

Was hesitant about the buffet price but the food was pretty good as well as the ambiance experience. The fried chicken & the gumbo are definitely my favorite . Didn't care for the dessert. They do close early, check hours. Staff was very busy but friendly. Enjoyed eating outside and taking a walk around the historical Treme neighborhood afterwards. Would definitely go again!

If you like good omelettes, then you will like this particular IHOP!  The omelettes are consistently good - and of course, so are the pancakes (which my husband always orders as 'a side to go'). 

The management for the last several years have hired very good cook. We have tried other IHOPS from Los Angeles to the north of the Central Coast, and the omelettes of the  other IHOPS just can't compare. 

IHOP offers dietary and allergy info about all of their products - which can be viewed and downloaded from their website. This is particularly helpful for my niece who needs a gluten-free menu - which they do offer. It's not an extensive gluten-free cuisine, but we like how conscientiously they are about the break-down of what they offer. 

The staff at this IHOP are very friendly - and so are the managers, who we always thank when leaving. Keep up the good work! 

Thank you, Turnpike/Calle Real IHOP!

Can't believe it took me so long to find this fabulous dive bar... I was told happy hour is the best time to come, we went on a sat afternoon and it was slow, but this could turn into a regular hangout.  Carrie our waitreSs was great!!!!
This restaurant was probably the worst dining experience I ever had in Tampa!   Bad food, bad service and outrageous prices!

Visiting New Orleans for the first time... my sister had a taste for oysters and we found this place here, so we decided to try it.... turned out to be amazing. I order oysters, crab mac and cheese, and southern greens, everything was delicious!!!!

Love this gym. Ample amount of space for cardio and weights. Never an issue with wait times or searching for a particular weight. Staff is friendly and helpful. I haven't participated in any classes yet so don't reference me yet for those opinions. Four stars
I was born and raised here, but this was my first time here. Very great food. And my cousin is one of the chefs .

This shop was one of the worst I've ever been to. I called in advance to make an appointment for a simple oil change. When I brought the vehicle at 10:45 for an 11:00 appointment it took over an hour just to get it into the garage. It was not completed until 1:00 and at that time the cashier told me she doesn't know how to process a fleet vehicle and would have to wait for a manager. She then said the manager is on a conference call which usually takes about 30 minutes. Poor service and concept of time. I will never be back to this shop and if you cherish the time in your day I suggest you don't either. I would have given them negative stars if it was possible. Oh yea they also charged $98 for the oil change and new wiper blades.

If you're feeling low and damn near suicidal, then this place will instantly make you feel better about your life because you're not a regular. Dark, musty, smoky, smelly, and the service is lousy too.
Wonderful food, good coffee, and hash browns to die for. Will definitely eat here again when we are in town.

Horrible customer service!!!  Called to check on something and was put on hold forever then was disconnected.  Called back twice and couldn't get anyone to even answer the phone in any department.  Seems like no one wants to work there and they ignore the phone hoping you will finally give up... very unprofessional!

The dealio here... you've got hundreds of board games that you can play for an hourly rate. I brought my 8 year old sister here and we had a pretty good time. She of course, wanted to play all the games she has at home, which kinda defeats the purpose! But we did try a few new games that she loved. The staff was very polite and knowledgeable on everything we asked.

Best salon I have found in awhile! My parents are St. Pete locals and every time I come into town from Manhattan, I always make a visit to see Brittany! She has done a great job, no matter what! She has done a fix for me and a complete makeover. I am always 100% satisfied by her work and professionalism. I can't wait to go back for a visit!

This is a good old small neighborhood bar.  We met here for a friends birthday and you could tell right away they were not used to this many people or people that don't live within walking distance.  Overall the patrons were friendly once they got to know us.  The staff here was attentive and really good.  The bar is well stocked and the prices were great.  IT is billed as a pizza pub so we had to try the pizza.  I would rate the pizza higher than your normal little corner bar overall.  the crust probably was not home made and not very crisp but fair.  The toppings and cheese were tasty and cooked well.  We also ordered wings and they were large and very tasty.  Overall a fun little bar and pub if you are in the area.  Very limited seating inside but adds to the family atmosphere.  We met the owner and she is a hoot.  So by all means go and check it out for yourself.
I've been twice for lunch and disappointed each time. The food is fine but in this city fine does not cut it. The service was down right bad the 2nd visit.

We visited with a group of middle school students after a Philadelphia Orchestra rehearsal.  We emailed for a reservation on the bus on the way into the city.  They were so gracious and took us at the time which was most convenient for us.  The food was awesome - pizzas for the kids and salads for the adults, plus delicious bread knots with olive oil and roasted garlic!  Our server was so sweet and gracious!  
I will visit again in the future.  Good food and pleasant service - what else could anyone ask for?

I had much higher expectations. A couple flies were bothering me the whole time, so this place could use a few flytraps. Tried one of their signature cocktails called the Giovanni. The flavor was not entirely unpleasant but quite sour. The salsa was savory but i have a suspicion it's not made in house as ive tasted it before elsewhere. My entree was the Shortrib Chilaquiles and what a waste of good flavors it was. The proteins to corn chips was very scant. The egg whites were still translucent. Even with the tomatillo sauce it was way too much corn chip/carbs, made worse by the fact that i had chips and salsa prior to. Shocking, that such good presentation and decor are being let down.
What a great, hip, quick place for lunch. Food is healthy, service is quick, place is clean. Not many tables and parking is tough, but we had a nice lunch.

CRU is a wonderful place wether youre just grabbing a drink after work or hosting an event. Their wine selection is amazing, all of the food is delicious and the staff is super friendly and helpful. Seriously .... don't underestimate the food!

Italian Market heaven!! 

Everything you could possibly want for an Italian foodie experience chances are you will find here. Meats, produce, cheeses & wine from all over the world. There are rare finds & fancy foodie items that you really need to take your time & walk through the aisles to find. This place is huge & they have recently added a kitchen supply & souvenirs shop. 

There is a deli that is absolutely a must to try & fresh made ravioli to go. There is so much to see, purchase & enjoy that I have never been able to just walk in and walk out with what I came in for. I have found so many new favorites & flavors at Mazzaro's over the years. 

I love love their coffee bar. They roast their own coffee beans. The cappuccinos are huge and delicious. There is a large variety of fresh baked goods, cookies and cakes available to buy and take home or enjoy while you're having your coffee at the bar. I have to say the only downside for me is some of the baked goods at this place are not as flavorful or delicious as they look. I always get carried away and order some new baked goods & sweets options I haven't tried before & I haven't always been blown away. 

If you haven't visited yet, do yourself a favor & make the trip this weekend. You won't regret it.

If your going to see a concert and planning on drinking, I HIGHLY recommend pre gaming it somewhere else. Their drink prices are absolutely absurd! You would think paying 7-10  for a 2 ingredient drink it would at least be a good one. NOPE! You can barely taste the alcohol. They don't allow smoking inside so that's nice, but the place is a tiny little hole in the wall. I've been to two shows so far (going to Sick Puppies tomorrow!) I got invited as VIP by the lead singer of Blue October (it's a cool story ) and some chick metal band (was not interested in that one two much) Anyway, I was not impressed with any of the staff or the venue. Why do these artists choose such a dump? I went to Rise Against in the GSR, that was freakin awesome! Why not pick a nicer place?! If the place got a bigger crowd for more popular artists, I would hate to see what a nightmare that would be. Will post my experience with tomorrow's concert in the tip section!

Very thankful to Turnip Truck for opening in the Gulch and I've been too long in writing a review!
My family are huge fans of their hot buffet, especially the breakfasts!  I always take out-of-town guests there for breakfast in the morning and they are thoroughly impressed!
I love running over for fresh fruits and veggies and they carry a good selection of yogurts and milk from local TN dairies.
My only wish is that they would extend their hours and stay open until 10 pm....us urbanites are known to work some late hours and I don't get to eat there as much as I'd like because they are closed....also makes it hard to stop in after work for milk and groceries.  That is the only reason I did not give 5 stars.
Thanks, Turnip Truck, for locating in our neighborhood and providing a clean, fun shopping experience where we can also eat some really good food!
ParadICE has super tasty shaved iced, and great vibes inside the store definitely would recommend.

Absolutely pathetic drive through times. I live near by and every single time I'm in their drive through I wait no less than 15 minutes and have spent 30 minutes+ more than once. Once you're in their drive through, you're trapped and can't leave due to their barriers.  Do not go here unless you have a lot of time and want to waste it.

Derek is amazing! Fashion week level professionalism meets down home social comfort. Derek asks all the right questions to provide the end result your looking for. Thank you Derek for an incredible experience in the chair.
Love this place! Fresh and made to order! Was great! Get the pickled cabbage on whatever you order! Delish! 10 out of 10! Going back soon!

If you have a lot of time on your hands to wait for run of the mill food then this is the place.  Went there once and it took 30 minutes to get food but that was Saturday morning and the place was full so, ok, it's not Mickey D's amirite? But (sadly there is one) Monday morning with the place 1/2 full took almost an hour to get some really runny eggs, a cup of grits with a skin, and to be informed that the bagel with cream cheese we ordered was going to be plain because they were out of cream cheese. They comped the bagel.  Too many other really good places in the area to go back there.

We had a less than stellar experience tonight. We came in for a birthday dinner and I called earlier in the afternoon to see whether they did anything special. They don't, which is fine, but the response I got wasn't the warmest and it's hard to imagine that a birthday dessert is an unusual request. They told me it was "acceptable" for us to bring our own cake. So I don't think I'll keep this place in mind for future celebrations.

Unfortunately our server spilled an entire drink on one of our party members almost immediately after they arrived. It could happen to anyone. It wasn't that big of a deal, although, I'm sure it wasn't very comfortable for him. Everyone dealt with it. The manager made a point to come over and tell us it was our server's first night. We all blew it over- no big deal. I was disappointed at the end of the night, though, to see that nothing at all had been comped to make up for the inconvenience and discomfort. We were a large enough party that there was a substantial check and not even a single cocktail or cup of coffee was spared from the tabulation. 

As for the actual meal- the food was great but it all came out at exactly the same time. We ordered the whipped ricotta vassi, which is an amazing opener, but within minutes of its arrival the pizza came..and then two salads..and then the antipasti and the pasta- all within a span of 5 minutes. Our table was crowded, we felt like they were rushing us out the door, and we couldn't savor the different courses of our meals. To me that was the worst part of the meal (though to our wet friend perhaps that seemed less offensive). The remainder of the service was slow and clunky.

All in all I was really disappointed by a place that I have really enjoyed in the past. We can all appreciate a few mistakes here or there or the bumps in the road that might come with training a new person. She was otherwise a friendly server and was doing well for her first night. But she could have used more guidance and it might have been nice to give a more seasoned server to a large party that made a reservation and made it clear we were celebrating a birthday. 

Food is good but I was very disappointed by the service.
I get the create your own with strawberry, raspberry, orange, and lemon and it's an awesome combo. Really friendly people and delicious smoothies!

Wow, just wow. This place is awesome. My first time trying boba tea in Tucson and it was definitely a hit! I'm used to boba tea from Atlanta and California, so I kind of have high hopes for these drinks and Chatime definitely hit the bar. 

I ordered the Taro pudding milk tea & mu husband ordered the Thai milk tea with rainbow jelly and both were spectacular! The Taro is a little different than most, since they use actual root, it has a little bit of a pulp texture to it. The girl at the register kindly informed me of this ahead of time incase I wouldn't like it and was willing to make me another if I still wanted to try it out, which was awesome of her, but I like to take my chances and try new things. 

What's better than the actual root compared to artificial powder though? NOTHING! It was great! It kind of made me feel like I was drinking something fresher (though I kept my sugar level normal). Haha, yes. That's right, you can also adjust the sugar levels in your drinks to your liking! Regardless, they came out perfectly. The thai milk tea was a little milkier than most, but it just added to the flavor and wasn't too rich, so I also loved that as well.

 I would definitely recommend trying these two if you haven't.
 I'll be back for more, I guarantee.
Dr. Youngblood has left the practice.  But I have seen Dr. Velez twice now.  He's one of the most gentle dentist I have ever been to.  Great hygienists too.  Nice office staff.

This has to be the best Mexican restaurant I have ever been to.  I would know, I'm from Texas and I've grown up eating Mexican and Tex-Mex all of my life.  I swear that I must have been fed the stuff as a baby because I can't even remember a time when I wasn't eating something that was from south of the border.  So when I went to El Sol I thought that sure it might not be a decent place to find Mexican food considering that it's located in Indiana of all places.  I didn't expect much out of the place...and that's a misconception that I'm sure a lot of people make.  

It's located in what some (okay yes pretty much everyone) would consider a not-so-great part of town, on a pretty dark street, and the sign is rather dimly lit so you really have to know what your looking for to even find it.  But man-o-man is it worth the hunt once you step inside!  It's like walking back home.  You step in and the smell of sizzling onions and peppers great you.  The place is bright and colorful...it makes ya think that you're walking into a fiesta!

From the moment I sat down I felt like I was back home in Texas talking to some of my moms friends from Mexico.  My mother would converse in her limited Spanish with our waitress as if they had known each other all of their lives.  As they laughed and teased each other about being stuck in Indy I would look over the lengthy menu and try to find just one dish rather than just tell our server to just get me one of everything.  

The salsa is hot.  Yes, they really use spices and don't just serve you a bowl of diced tomatoes with some onions thrown in there for decoration!  What a novel idea.  The food is out of this world good.  I'm not even going to try to explain to you how great it really is.  You're just going to have to try it for yourself if you are even going to start to fully understand where I'm coming from.

It was Wednesday night August 10 when we reached Saint Louis, Missouri. I asked a local leaving the stadium where we could find good food at this hour. He did not hesitate to point straight ahead to the place with the red white and green striped awning. This must be an Italian place! I thought. 

I am taking away one star because of how rude the hostess was when we four stepped inside. Instead of "Good evening", "Welcome to Caleco's" or even just plain old "Hi!", she quickly snaps at us with "We only have pizza and appetizers," wearing an ugly frown. We first wanted to order take-out but changed our minds. This cool guy Kevin took our orders and promptly brought us our chicken fingers with honey mustard, and excellently prepared fried calamari.

It was Kevin's great customer service and the absolutely delicious food that prevented a one star review and brought it way up to four stars instead. This guy Kevin of course had to run back and forth all over the place since it was a busy night but he still managed to take the time to keep our cups of water full and to make sure we had everything we needed.

Then came the hostess again or whatever title she has, to take our plates. I reached for another plate at the same time and I guess that interrupted her endeavors to take another plate away or something silly and she made this really mean face like a toddler throwing a temper tantrum (it was kind of adorable, you should have seen it! Made us almost say "awwwww" and give her a cookie to improve her feewings). It seemed like she was angry that we came to her restaurant. It was ridiculous and we laughed and made jokes about it after we left, imagining all the hilarious reasons she could have been miserable.
Great chicken rice bowl. Nice guys. Shrimp also looks good. Fresh ingredients. Will return next time I cross Broad. Jarritos is a nice touch.
I'm a big fan of rolled ice cream and this place did not disappoint. I had someone pick it up for me so I can't comment on atmosphere but very good. I got the S'mores flavor.

Trust me, nobody knows more about thrift shopping than this woman right here. And when I tell you that this is truly a gem of a shop, you must believe it. I have found so many wonderful deals in the shop. All of my personal favorite name brands not just the preppy ones in the cool ones like Abercrombie and Hollister, but also eccentrics ones and artsy ones that are fun to wear. If I had $1 million I could find 1 million different ways to spend it here but I need to slow it down LOL I encourage everyone to visit

My boyfriend and I had dinner at Earl's New American to celebrate our anniversary. The staff was very attentive, the food was great, and the restaurant was very clean. Ehrin was our waiter and he was wonderful. The woman who sat us at our table (I didn't catch her name) was so sweet, and insisted that we take a piece of cake home with us. My boyfriend ate the cake when we got home and said it was delicious. Overall, we had a great experience at Earl's and would definitely come back.

What a wonderful place! Absolutely loved this restaurant. From the atmospheric music to the authentic Greek cuisine and decor, Hellas is the go to for a quick hop to Greece!

During our visit, my boyfriend wanted a special drink, a cotton candy margarita (they have a cotton candy martini on the menu, in addition to other intriguing delights!), which the owner actually made himself. It was amazing. I had a peach sangria, one of the better I've had. Round two, the owner requested we let him switch it up a little bit. Of course! No idea what he did to the marg., but it was insane! A wonderful fruity drink, in a crazy milky pink. So good!

For dinner, I did the gyro (don't call it a ji-row) which was made to absolute perfection. Growing up with Greek neighbors, Hellas hit the nail on the head with this one. My boyfriend did the stuffed grouper. His plate was full no more than 4 minutes. He loved it and has asked multiple times since we've gone (6 days ago), when are we going back!?

Absolute Deliciousness - Did not miss eating meat (I'm not a vegetarian but do love my vegetables)!  I went to blue sage for lunch on 1/30 for the first time and I want to go back again today!  Our waitress was very pleasant and service oriented - great experience from beginning to the end of the meal.  We started with the Tostones.  Great avocado relish to smother on the plantains. Be careful - they are filling! Then I had the Blue LT at the recommendation of our waitress....and it was excellent for a blue cheese lover like me.  I also got the coffee which was great. The coffee is so smooth - had 2 cups of it!  Where have I been all these years - wish I would have discovered this place earlier :-)

Walked in the late morning and was not that crowded, but while waiting for service it filled up. The staff are very friendly and so enthusiastic to allow you to sample their sweets. We tasted about 4 types of freshly made praline and purchased one of each. They have pre packaged boxes to purchase or you can by them by the piece. Such a variety of flavors and so unique and delicious. The original creamy and rum flavors were my favorite. You must try this place for the best pralines in NOLA.

One of the best, if not THE BEST, ice cream joints in the ville. You get SOOOO much ice cream, they have a ton of flavors (salted caramel is my favorite), and, for an ice cream joint, the price is alright (much better than the competition). The new location on 2nd Avenue is perfect if you want to sit and eat your ice cream or walk around and see Nashville with it. Loved coming here since I was in high school, will always be a fan!

The pizza turned out good.  Better than I expected.  The service was okay.  The Thai chili chicken wings were pretty good.  It was nice and neat inside.  

I'll go back, next time I'm in the mood for pizza.

Place is awesome for a local diner. Owner and staff are very friendly and food is very good. I tend to stick to sandwiches and breakfast so I don't have much input on their dinners. I will say that their burgers and turkey clubs ( type of food I would normally get at a diner) are the best around and are very reasonable.....try the cheeseburger deluxe or turkey club with a side of onion rings and you won't be sorry
Awesome bison burger, truffle fries, and sweet potato fries. Trevor was such an amazing server. We shall return!

Jared did my rose tattoo behind my ear today, and it's so beautiful! It's a small tattoo, and he added so much detail! The shop is very clean, and some awesome vintage furniture! They were very nice, even though we were running a little late! I will for sure be back to get more!
We had some great service here and really enjoyed the fresh food. Great place to take someone who has never had a fresh tortilla.

The food is not expensive, there is a lot of it, and it is very very good. I am usually a guy who likes diner type breakfasts, and First Watch basically takes all of the grease and fat out of breakfast and replaces it with fresh locally grown healthy substitutes. I had the omelette which came with probably the best multi-grain toast I've ever had. My girlfriend got the avocado toast which is piled high with avocado. 

The only problem I had was the waitress was clearly very rushed. She did not greet us or even try to be nice, she asked for our orders and only came around with the check. I would give First Watch 5 stars it wasn't for our waitresses poor attitude.

The Eagle Inn is about a 5 minute walk to the beach, on a quiet, beautiful, palm-lined street. Been to Santa Barbara many times but never tried the Eagle Inn before. We will certainly go back. Exceptional courtesy at the desk, room staff amazing, delicious choice of breakfasts in the dining room or delivered to the room at no charge. And the rooms... heavenly. We noted a primarily European clientele, all of whom looked very happy indeed. Highly recommended.

We got to stay at Days Inn for free for a night so that was great.  The parking is $15 with in and out privileges but you need your room key to get in, so best to park in front and check in and then head to the adjacent parkade.  The lobby has chairs and sofas, nearby washrooms which require a room key, and an exercise room with a few cardio machines. 

The elevator is old and there's a sign a maximum of 5 people.  I don't think more than 2 people would fit if they both had luggage.  The stairs are convenient as they also lead to the floors in the parkade too.  The room was basic and comfortable.  To the left was the bathroom sink and across from it were coat hangers.  There was a door into the toilet and tub.

The room had 2 Queen beds, a little table with 2 chairs, and a dresser with TV.  There's no mini fridge but a small coffee maker.  On certain floors there's an ice machine and vending machine.  Our room faced 106 Street and in the evenings when you look out, there's a bright light from the hotel shining up at you.

Although the bed was comfortable, my sleep was interrupted by people talking in the hallway and before bedtime, I could hear people running in the hallway.  The location is good being downtown and within walking distances to restaurants and Tim Hortons.

For a free stay, it was good and decent for those that want to save their money for other activities in the city.

Let's get this out of the way right now: it's pronounced "Ah-vuh" NOT "Ay-vuh" a fact that distinguishes the restaurant from the young lady it is named after.  I have been to Ava plenty of times but never wrote a review prior to now...it's time to spread the love! 

My first experience at Ava was during Creative Loafing's Restaurant Week Tampa Bay in 2015. Since then I've been to Ava several times, mostly for dinner with family and friends and sometimes for lunch. I've also visited Ava to pick up food as an UberEats delivery person.  

Having visited Ava several times, I am certain about a few loves: 

1. The ambiance. It's perfect -- lively yet romantic; trendy yet comfortable. Ava offers al fresco dining (covered outdoor seating) as well as a variety of table styles inside (from classy high tops to traditional table seating). Be sure to ask about the "Secret Dining Room" if you're in need of a reservation for at least 10 guests! 

2. The Casarecce al Pomodoro. I love to order this dish with extra ricotta and sometimes, if I'm feeling frisky, with the Nduja sausage (this is a spicy sausage which is different from the fennel sausage). 

3. The Ava House Salad. It's a bit on the pricy side at $8.00, but the ingredients (mixed greens, cucumber, radish, tomato, red onion tossed in a house Italian vinaigrette) offer the perfect explosion of flavors pre-entree.

4. Joe Maddon. He is part owner of Ava and he is former manager of the Tampa Bay Rays...so duh, he is a love.

Also, for solo diners, Ava is one restaurant that has an incredibly welcoming bar that erases all of the unnecessary shame in dining alone. Trust me, I've done it time and time again.  :)

We have been here twice and both times enjoyed the food, HOWEVER not the service! Both times the server Barbara( same waitress both times) was neglectful. I don't usually review places unless I had a great experience or a really bad one. We arrived before the table next to us but received chips last, our orders were taken last even though we were ready, got our bill last as well. We were polite and thanked her every time she brought our food or came to the table, she however never responded, which I find to be quite rude. I would return but I pray we don't encounter this woman again.

Cute neighborhood find where you can enjoy great coffee and good food.

Came here a few months ago with a friend for a weekday lunch but never got around to finish posting!

Ambiance: Cozy but small space so beware if you are trying to bring big groups. When it's warm the outdoor seating in the back is quite nice. Has the feel that you can just hang out and read during it's off-peak brunch/lunch hours, especially if you can snag that corner bench nook with some cushions!

Service: Our waiter was friendly and indulged us in some witty banter. I can see it getting a bit hectic when it's a full house.

Food: Mixed review with some pros and cons. Their scrambled eggs with apple and bacon were scrumptious! However, their creme brulee french toast was a bit dry for our likin'. But that's just our personal preference. Their fries were great! Something between a potato chip and a french fry, like a potato chip fry. Crispy but with some good fluffy potato substance. 

Drinks: Espresso drinks were well done. I'm obsessed with good froth in my cappuccino and this place hit the nail on the head.

Overall, I'll swing by again during a slow hour to enjoy a drink and maybe lunch with a friend or a good book.

I've only been here once but I loved the omelet I got - Baja Omelet. The friend I went with LOVES Refuel so I imagine we will be going back soon. She loves the Huevos Rancheros and that's what I want to try next time. It's a small place, but luckily we didn't have to wait long after placing our order for a table. Definitely going to be one of my go-to spots for brunch.

Dinner was no good at all. Food was bland and they had very few options to choose from. The entertainment was not bad, but when buying a ticket make sure to only come for the show...but that kind of defeats the purpose of a dinner theater.

I took our dog, Bruno, in for a visit due to seasonal allergies that caused him to scratch himself to the point of bleeding. Dr. O'Pella took the time to examine him thoroughly and discussed what could be causing the issue with me. She prescribed an antibiotic and steroids, as well as an OTC antihistamine. Within 24 hours, Bruno was back to his normal playful and happy self with no scratching. A clean facility with a very knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful team.

Came here for lunch, but it turned out to be only a brunch menu (1:15pm on a Sunday).  The menu was generally concise, but if I was in a brunch mood I think I would've been more excited.  I got burger which was okay.  The fries weren't very hot.  I also wasn't a fan of their "house ketchup," and they didn't have an alternative (Heinz, Hunt's, etc).  For comparison's sake, I know Burger Up nearby has their own house ketchup, but also "normal ketchup."  My gf got a squash dish, which she liked, but didn't love.  The service was friendly and professional and the decor was rustic and inviting.  I plan to come back another time when they're serving more than brunch -- our waitress mentioned that the dinner menu is great and changes regularly.  I'd expect my next visit to be 4/5, but it wasn't on this occasion.  Nonetheless, this seems like a clean, generally well-run establishment.  Check out the bathroom sinks while you're here.  Never seen one like that before!
Love this place. The location on Williams blvd. Is one of the Best... Come here often and have loved each meal.. The kids love the options. And so do we!! Try the double dot burger!

Stayed here for a conference and I'm glad my company booked this hotel....Fabulous!!! If I ever come back here to NO, I'll be staying here. I've never been to a hotel where you can get a breakfast cooked to order, not even in London....Pricey but worth it!!

This place is Fast and as for the Fancy part, well it's for your own opinion. The place is a little hole in the wall kind of diner. The people are way cool and the service is up to par. I gave it 4 stars because of the eggs. It be outrageous that I gave them 4 stars just for that, but really, how can someone make scrambled eggs taste like cardboard? To have scrambled eggs taste like that, one would have to try very hard. Fast And Fancy diner seem to have that down cold. Other then that all is good. Their pancakes were crazy good and moist. A must try when there. Happy eating peoples!!

These guys did an amazing job detailing my car! The service was excellent too. Dave went out of his way to accommodate my schedule, and Jennifer was also so pleasant to interact with. The work itself was fantastic, and the whole experience was top-notch. I really trust these people, and when can I ever say that about anything related to my car?
If you want it hot and spicy, you'll get it here!!  I chose the regular size burrito and it filled me up quite nicely - I can't imagine how big their large size is.
Been over an hour and still no delivery. Called them and they said they already came by. Clearly they had not. I definitely wouldn't try them again.

Love love love this theater. My husband and I are crazy big movie fans, and since discovering Keller, we're able to enjoy going out a lot more because the two of us can get tickets and snacks and it totals around $20-- versus more than twice that if we had gone to Ronnies. We still go to the big theaters for new releases that we can't wait for, but nothing compares to a cheap date at Keller. I hope this theater stays around forever. (Keller: please stay around forever!!)

My wife and I went to A Taste of Thai for lunch on Monday. We were quite impressed right from the moment we walked in. The place is very clean and nicely decorated, I had the Drunken Noodle lunch (all lunches are $7.95) with pork, prepared Hot, and an egg drop-like soup. It was absolutely fabulous and everything tasted very fresh.  My wife had the Tempura appetizer with shrimp ($14.95). It was easily enough food for two people. It came with a house salad, which featured a vinegarette-mayo dressing that she couldn't stop raving about. Service was excellent. We will definitely return soon.
Got a great cut by Dara - would def go back!! She did exactly as I asked and I didn't go home and cry (have been known to cry after a bad haircut - don't judge me!).
When I heard that Garces Restaurant Group was opening a fish taco joint in the neighborhood, I thought it would be a dream come true. It is. Thank little baby Jesus for Buena Onda.

Great ambiance, you just feel at home here. I ordered a cappuccino late morning and as I perused the menu I had to order the fresh roast beef with caramelized onions, roasted red peppers, Vermont Cheddar on whole grain bread. Wow, it was delicious. Janet and Rich were great, very friendly and they do dinner once a month which I'm looking forward to. I'll be back, so stay tuned........

This post might be a little bias because I love ice cream. However, this place has fantastic service. I really wish the hours were till 10pm during Mon-Thurs though. Overall, I have had wonderful experiences at this location and delicious ice cream.

Busted my iphone 5c screen badly and had to replace it ASAP since I am only here on business. 

Came in and CJ hooked it up within 7 minutes.i am really happy at getting my phone fixed. CJ was a really nice guy and gave me peace of mind.

The wait was very long to sit down, get order in, and get the food.  At the end of the day, the food was just okay.  We went there out of convenience from the hotel but next time we stay there we will go out and find a restaurant.

Well there is a reason this place is dead on a Thursday night. Worst watered down Mojito ever with not a hint of alcohol. I would consider changing there name to something that they can actually make.

So many good breweries in Indy - and this is one of them! We ventured here with some friends for dinner and drinks. The atmosphere is nice and mellow, the place is cute and well kept, and there's plenty of parking in the lot and nearby. While I can't say it was the best beer I've ever had, I certainly did enjoy what I tried. Their food also didn't disappoint, as everything we tried was flavorful and fun (better than the reheated or refried offerings of many bars). The staff was also friendly and made for a good experience. This place is definitely worth a stop!

This is a super tourist spot, and the service kinda sucked. They know they'll likely never see you again. But the food was actually alright; a big portion for the price. And most dishes come with a salad and ice cream for dessert. Sorry my picture isn't too appealing, but this was the "stuffed pasta" dish.

Eileen did the most beautiful job on our wedding flowers! She took my vision and made it into a reality, and I couldn't be happier. We got compliments all night on how gorgeous everything was! So happy I chose to work with her. She is a true professional and she was reasonable as well!

Delicious! We just moved to the area and stumbled upon Frankie's in the middle of moving day. We were starving and their killer sandwiches hit the spot. My boyfriend had the Italian Steamroller and I had the San Franciscan, both hot off the press. Really. So good!

Deeeeeeeeeeeeep Dish. No kidding-Like a swimming pool. Fun place. When we sat our waiter told us up front quite nicely that the deep dish takes 45 minutes to make. No solitaries. Cocktails and appetizers kept us happy. "Trendy" bar stuff with the latest labels. Black Magic instead of Captain Morgan etc. Still have no idea what the pop was (No Coke) it was good. 
Mozzarella sticks a pretzels were delicious. The Deep Dish was as described. Thick heavy crust with cheese and toppings covered in Sauce. 
Good pizza. Great service. Nice atmosphere. Definitely a fun place to hit!

I almost hate to say how much I like the place because it's not usually crowded and I want it to stay that way.  The best thing is, they change the menu to showcase seasonal produce and just because I think the chef likes to be creative.  I don't go for taco night or brunch so I don't know about that, but dinner is always an adventure.  Small plates are good, sharing a lot of stuff is also good.  Have had good drinks too, good raviolis, weird stuff.  Just quirky and tasty, nice casual atmosphere.  I think it's never going to be everybody's taste so that's good for me, I love that I can walk there too.

This is my first time going to an American barbershop. In the past 6 years, I always went to Asian barber because I thought chinese hairdresser maybe know more-better about Asian people hair style, color, and fashion. This time, to be honest, at the beginning I just want to try..But! I'm so lucky since I met a really really professional hairdresser here. She is so good of the skill of the stylists techniques. Also, all her assistants are so professional and nice too. I got a very cute bangs and pretty color in the end. ;) I would like be a loyal customer here! -Chloe

An old girlfriend introduced me to the original Crabby Bills in Indian Rocks Beach back in the 1980's.  It was fun, the food was simple and plentiful, a place on the rise.  Like far too many restaurants, when they open new locations and time goes by, the quality goes downhill rapidly.  Put simply, this is a tourist trap that survives with tiny portions of passable seafood at prices much too high for what you get.  Even the Early Bird is overpriced.  Out of town friends insisted on taking me there 2-2-15. The blackened mahi-mahi was small, tasty, but eminently unremarkable. The sides of french fries and steamed broccoli were below ordinary.  Service is disinterested.  AVOID!

Pleasantly surprised! We have ordered takeout from here twice now. The second time was far superior to the first. I ordered the beef pad Thai the first time and it was tasty, but a bit dry. 

However I am glad that we went back! I had the shrimp pad Thai the second time and it was so good! The summer rolls with the peanut sauce are excellent and huge! I think next time we will try eating in and see how that is. I may bump up to 5 stars!!

If you need flowers sent in the Tucson area, definitely go with Mayfield Florist.  They have exceptional customer service and work with you to decide exactly what you want to send.

A friend of mine who lives in the Tucson area went in for surgery and I wanted to send her some flowers to cheer her up and wish her a quick recovery.  Instead of taking my chances with FTD, I googled florists in Tucson and found Mayfield Florist, who had excellent ratings on both Google and Yelp, and went with them.  The lady with whom I spoke when I called this morning was very helpful and texted me photos of the two orchid plants they had in stock, both of which were beautiful.  I placed my order with her around 9:30 AM and the orchid plant I selected was delivered to my friend's hospital room before noon.  The delivery driver even called me after he made the delivery to tell me that my friend loved the orchid and that it really cheered her up.  Honestly, you simply can't get better customer service than that!
