We waited, waited, waited..after 1 hour we asked for manager...They finally brought food like 1p min later. The manager was nice, took 25% off..gave us coupons for next time but we won't be back. Our server gave us tude when she brought bill and upon our leaving. I normally do not complain but although the food is supposed to be part of Nashville's finest, the management here is severely lacking to keep up with demand. Tgey also should afford air condition. We finally got to our hotel pool at our $400 a night hotel at 3p because of this place. Thanks Milk & Honey for ruining a huge part of our Nashville vacation.

Super rude customer service. The man working the front was very abrasive and short with us. We were interested in doing tastings at both the brewery and the distillery and decided against coming here after our service.

I can't give this place 4 stars because the burrito I ordered, steak was just ok.  For $7 it was bland and light on the meat.  HOWEVER, the place is called Indy Taco's for a reason (other then a hopeless lack of creativity).  The Taco I ordered was terrific.  The Mole (which is a flavor that can easily be mutilated) taco was amazing.  Finally an authentic taco in Indiana.  It was packed with fresh, tasty ingredients and the sauce was fantastic.  I will go back and try the other tacos, if I can get past the Mole, skipping the steak of course.  2 to 3 tacos would make for a filling lunch, which is cheap in my book.

Okay I don't see what all the hype is. Three stars because the service was great, the iced tea delicious and the potato salad rocked. So did the corn cakes. Pulled pork and st. Louis ribs. First of all, the ribs tasted baked. The meat was completely mushy and the bones were so soggy is that you could smash them in your fingers.  The membrane was left on the back of the ribs, and was totally rubbery,  which led me to believe these things set in a pot or a pan with liquid somewhere for quite a while.   Pulled pork the same way very mushy, no texture. I wish you could trade the customer service with Buffalo P BBQ also in Gallatin and the food with the pulled pork, brisket and ribs from Buffalo p.   Unfortunately at buffalo P, the service sucks, the workers are rude and not friendly but the food is delicious. Other way here at Top Hog. Very disappointed, I really really wanted to like this place. On a side note the catfish look awesome as I saw it go by and the burgers looked really good, maybe try it again or something like that but definitely not the barbecue

I feel I must complete this review. My sister and I went to Coffee & on Saturday afternoon June 17th. She ordered a chicken salad sandwich on French Bread and a side of potato salad. I ordered a Roast Beef on French dressed. The chicken salad was so salty my sister could not eat it. The roast beef was half burnt. The lettuce was a dark green, not sure what kind. The tomatoes and pickles were cut very thick not adding to what I thought would be a tasteful experience . 
I have been a frequent customer and have never had anything I didn't like served to me. We told the waitress what had happened. She tried her best to make things right under the circumstances. In the end we were only charged for the potato salad and one drink. 
At no time did the present manager come to speak to us preferring to let the waitress handle the situation. We were also told there was a different cook in the afternoon preparing the food. 
I was very disappointed as I had brought my sister there as a treat and to introduce her to Coffee &. Needless to say we were both disappointed. Not sure if I will be back---if ever.

this t-mobile store was the worst experience i've ever had ! it's an ALL MALE establishment. basically all of them are tools. no one in there really knows what they're talking about. i had an $800 + bill almost sent to collections ALL for a MISUNDERSTANDING. drive the extra distance to go to a different t-mobile store in my opinion.

We stopped here for a quick ice cream treat for the kids. It is a small eat in ice cream shop. They also have a few food items. We ordered ice cream for the kids & were happy with the amount of flavor choices and toppings. The woman at the counter was very friendly.  We will definitely stop by again!

I was on the line between a 3 and a 4, but the dishes are good enough that I landed on 4.

I have been here a couple of times. The first time I got the sampler with my girlfriend and the 2nd time we got individual dishes: the fish tibs and the doro wot. The doro wat was great. The fish tibs were meh. I recommend getting the sampler. Oh, and the honey wine. It's weird and awesome!

I really believe there is only one server. Service is friendly, a little rough with speaking English, and very S L O W.

This is not a place where you can pop in and out. You are in for at least an hour, probably more. This is the reason why they almost got 3 stars from me. But the food is so good and unique, I feel it is worth the wait. 

I will come back - just not on a day when I have something else planned ;)
Love the atmosphere, the staff, seeing the food prepared in the middle of the restaurant. The lobster bisque with the puff pastry... On a scale of 1 to 10 I give it a 15
I am the weekday night chef at the Ribby, I take great pride in what I put out to our customers... a Great place for Food, Drinks, Music entertainment and AMAZING PEOPLE! :-)

Without question the best food truck on Penn's campus. The food is extremely fresh, does not rely on cheap/ultra-decadent/cheesy/bad for you ingredients like the others. You cannot find a better winter meal than the chicken or lamb couscous -- the banh mi sandwiches are excellent (legit baguettes) -- and the quinoa salads are great summer meals. In the early days the coordination between the owner & his helpers was lacking -- it would take forever to make a simple sandwich -- but now they've got it down. Can't recommend more!

I went to this place right after cardinals game ended and the place was super packed!! Regardless of that, the place is pretty big and can accommodate a lot of people on tables and also near the bar. I tried their 16" thin sliced cheese pizza with onion and jalapenos and it was delicious! 

I got their pizza to go and ate it at the park right across from it which I would really recommend doing. Eventhough it was pretty packed, our order was ready within 15 mins which I really appreciated since I was really hungry lol!
Hands down been my favorite nail salon in the area. The mini neck/back massages are a nice treat. Prices are reasonable and the quality is always spot on.
I was skeptical at first but had an absolutely wonderful time. And the best part is that all of the cats were available for adoption I totally recommend this for anyone who wants a smile.

Though a bit pricey, this is a wonderful way to spend a few hour with the kids. Downstairs there is a water area where kids can "re-flow" water with pvc pipes, "transport" balls from one "harbor" to the next, and learn about weather; plus there is a (play) sand area for kids to dig and have fun, and a great toddler only area with pretend fishing, a fun boat, books and tot geared toys. Oftentimes there is a traveling exhibit on the first floor as well - most recently we played in the recycling exhibit. 

Upstairs is the bulk of the activities - different "rooms" for different types of play -- sports area where you can race against a computer hare or tortoise or dog plus a min rock climbing wall. The construction area is probably my boys' favorite play area. A vet's area, firetruck with firehouse pole they can slide down, grocery store to pretend shop or work, the Actor's area with tons of dress up options and even stage controls for sounds, music and art area and they usually have some fun interactive exhibits going on (our favorite was learning about hot air balloons!)

That being said, if you plan on going more than once, just spring for the annual pass. Far more cost effective. Also, follow their page on Facebook - they try and post field trip forecasts so you can see when the quieter times to go are.
Late night ice cream? Just do it. Incredible. We got the banana chip and from what I remember it was incredible.

I really enjoyed the food here. I tried the bahn Nu burger and the pork belly taco.

Pork belly taco - served with some veggie in a sweet white bun (like the ones you eat with Peking duck). I highly recommend this.

Bahn mi burger was good. Definitely worth a try.

I want to come back and try the lemon grass vermicelli and the kimchi burger.

Food was okay.  But,  expensive for what you get. 
Staff leaves a lot to be desired.  Seems like they hire the best for the least amount of money.  Bathrooms were clean.  Had some dirty tables that needed to be cleaned.  I don't think I will be back.

Wow.. Haven't had sushi this bad in a long time.

We got take out and ended up throwing most of it out. Much of the fish was extremely fishy and inedible. We ordered an octopus dumpling appetizer that was dense and mushy. The octopus itself had a strange flavor. 

Highly disappointed. Especially given all the positive reviews. Although north Tampa is probably the worst place for food I've in the country. Im from the midwest; NO COMPARISON.

El Merendero is by far one of my favorite LUNCH Mexican food spots on the south/south west side of town!  When friends are in town - I take them here. All of their lunch specials are great but I enjoy the Thursday Chicken Flautas Special! Price is reasonable at a little over $7 for lunch! Only wish they had a liquor license, but it is what it is?!

I come here when I want to get a little creative with my caffeinated beverages. I'm a big fan of their "El Diablo", a raspberry mocha with cayenne. Definitely try it if you're a fan of a little pep! Most recently I tried the "Wooly Mammoth" which contained dark chocolate, cardamom, cinnamon and blackberry. It was very delicious! 

They always have two menu posters on the wall noting the seasonal drinks, both teas and coffee which they are currently offering as well as one poster with their signature house favorites. They are all uber creative and it's really hard each time I've visited to choose just one of the options with quirky names such as "Walking Dead" & "007".

Lucky Goat of course offers all of the standard coffee shop beverages, but honestly, that's not why you're going to want to come here. Stepping out of your comfort zone a bit here would be my advice. I love the feeling of coming in knowing I can try something new each and every time I visit, but can always go back to an old favorite if I so choose. 

There's a couch and some outdoor seating which I where you can usually find me. There are barstool seats by the side windows as well as two tops in the main room. There's also an upstairs which is a tad more spacious. There's games for adults and books for kiddos. 

I haven't tasted any of the food, but I do go a few blocks out of my way just for those unique drinks alone when in Fairmount/Brewery section of the city. I say try it! Oh, and they have almond and other non dairy milk varieties for the fellow veg-heads out there!
So cute! A must stop on your Nashville adventure!!! Cutest drinks and brunch spot. I got the red sangria and an egg white and fruit brunch. My friends for mimosas. We are all so happy!

Second visit while on a business trip to the Tampa brewery, and still have yet to find a beer by them that I'm not a fan of.  Amazing employees who have just as much fun as the patrons.  Amazing beers, cool merch, local hangout.  Will return again.

After getting my hair did in Broad Ripple, I figured I'd get myself some brunch or lunch. The mobile app directed me here, a mom and pop Mexican place that also serves traditional breakfast favorites. After browsing the menu, I settled on the Mexican breakfast sandwich. Soon after I ordered, I decided to check out other peoples' reviews and pictures on Biscuits Cafe's Yelp page. Read your reviews and really glad I didn't get the biscuits and gravy! I'm from the South and what they hell do they put in their biscuits and gravy to make them pink like that? I sat right next to the order counter, and yes, THEY ARE PINK IN REAL LIFE. Ick. So, I will never ever get them. I don't care if they taste great (a LOT of people were ordering them, but I will never get over the fact that they're that color).

My sandwich, however was really nice, and I paired it with Mexican style potatoes. The sort of comfort food that I crave from time to time, not to mention hella cheap.

Yum! The sliders here were amazing and the cinnamon sugar donut was light, fluffy and fresh! I wish we had noticed the seating out back before we ate cuz it's really cute & cozy back there- next time! I loved the cheeseburger slider and also the fried chicken slider. They are messy, but finger lickin' good!! Their oyster slider special was just ok. 
I love sliders and this place is great!! Check it out and definitely get one of their donuts. They make different flavor donuts every day! Check them out on social media to find out the donut flavors for the day.

I've worked with the Sultans three times in the past few months-- twice for moving things out of my house and once for moving things around inside including my stove, fridge, and dishwasher.  Tom really listens to what you want and then makes sure it's done in a thoughtful way.  The crew is both personal and professional and really pays attention to your exact needs.  Extremely responsive and I'll absolutely use them whenever I need anything moved.
Below average tasting Mexican food. Prices are reasonable and the menu has standard items. Staff is polite but tables and menus are dirty.

Woo! Go Phillies!! 

They're struggling right now but I have amazing memories of their World Series runs and Hall of Fame players.

I hope they can get back someday because they've proven that Philadelphia is a championship city and always will be!

I'm going to give community coffee 5 stars because their coffee is incredibly delicious and not to mention CONSISTENT. I go here about 3-4 times a week and I own a Keurig.. Their drive through is always very fast and takes no longer than 3 minutes total. Drive through workers are almost always friendly. I did come across a very rude one at one point in time.. I was so angry because she always had a sour face on but they seemed to have gotten rid of her. So I'm happy again. 

If you go inside the cafe, there is a large seating area - both inside and out (free wifi). The cafe offers cookies, croissants, scones, muffins, etc. I love their holiday drinks especially the peppermint bark latte. However, I usually always order a hazelnut iced latte. I guess what makes their coffee very good is the dark roast. I love you guys! Y'all are the real MVPs who make my mornings perfect.

This is a must see if you are in town, the exhibits are updated often with some long time treasures like the carousel from the early 1900's to a unique dinosaur experience, admission is a little pricy  until you see the thousands of things to see and do many interactive things for kids and adults we came back after being gone for 30+ years and were amazed at the expansion and variety of thing to see and do

Classic hipster coffee shop in the thick of it on state street.

Minimalist menu with high quality espresso.  A nice treat for those who suffer from indecisiveness.  Although I do prefer to a few more options myself, as I love trying new things.  Perhaps a special of the day or something seasonal would be a fun addition.

Bonus stars for case of what looked to be fresh in-house baked pastries =)

Average prices; large iced tres leches (latte-like) $4.55

These were hands down the best fried green tomatoes I have ever had in my life. The burnt end sliders were excellent as well. Prices were reasonable and service was great. I like the live music as well. The place wasn't too loud. It was a good time, nice environment.

I don't often get to Tarpon Springs, so I don't know how well Hellas compares to all the other Greek restaurants in town.  But it's the place I bring friends and family to when they're in town, mainly because it never fails making them salivate at the sight of all the bakery goodies next door. I've also found the flavors at Hellas compare a bit better than the Greek restaurants I've been to around Clearwater.

I recently took two friends there on a sunny afternoon for lunch, and we had the outdoor porch to ourselves.  The restaurant being much calmer than normal, the pleasant weather, the good conversation, the great service from our waiter, and the tasty food that was served up promptly all combined to make it a great day and meal.   Since that meal I've had a chance to talk to some locals who say they frequent several Greek restaurants away from the sponge docks that they like better, so I'll be checking them out over the next few weeks.  But for a meal that the tourists in town can enjoy, Hellas has always been good choice for us, and I'm sure I'll be bringing more back.

Atmosphere:  4
Service:  4
Food:  4
Value:  4

I ordered the Banh Mi sandwich - the large or full size, I don't recall their term.

The food was tasty, though it could have used more pickled radish.

Unfortunately tasty did not satisfy ... the "large" sandwich left me hungry after eating it and 45 minutes later I was famished. The same goes for a co-worker. 

This was not worth $9 when you can get the same sandwich in IV for about $4.

I will never eat nor order takeout from this establishment again! This restaurant is walking distance from my office so after having ordered takeout several times before some colleagues and I decided to walk over and dine in since the weather was so nice. Big mistake! We barely sat down before being asked for our orders, when told we needed more time the waiter rolled his eyes at us and walked away. He proceeded to be curt with is throughout the duration of our meals. Never once were we offered refills on drinks, our plates were not cleared upon finishing and one of my colleagues had to ask for a takeout container 3 times. To top it off the cashier was taking phone orders, seating guests and ringing up the checks at the same time. I get that it was during the lunch rush but there is no excuse for rude behavior when I am spending money in your establishment. Hire more help! I will not spend another dime here!

This place is an f-ing joke!  The food tastes good but the small portions are ridiculous.  You could spend $100 per person just to feel like you ate an entire meal.  I like tapas and I like the idea of tasting plates, but this restaurant needs to rethink itself.  It's in East Falls not Rittenhouse square and the ambiance is not good enough to justify the the prices.  Its a great restaurant if you want to waste your money and feel like a chump.

This is a must go to place! I came here for the first time for something special. I came with my mock trial team for the annual "Mock trial competitions." 

Anyways, you guys probably aren't interested in that. Although if you are, don't be, you have no idea how draining it gets after a while. Anyways...

Parking and walking through the front doors you immediately get this feeling of awe. The front doors look to be almost a hundred feet tall! You feel like you are walking into this important place, which you are. 

Getting to walk around, especially in the main courtyard, was just very cool. It's green, photogenic and overall, enjoyable. The first thing that you might notice is that there are so many people here all doing different things. While I was there, people were taking wedding pictures, being tourists, I was there with hundreds of other high schoolers all dressed up for our mock trial tournaments, there was even a couple of Disney princess there. Everyone comes here. 

If you are fortunate enough to be able to go into a court house like I was, that's where the trip becomes even more magical. I won't give too much away, but it is unlike any other court I have ever seen. They have banners, high ceilings, all the good stuff. It gives the place a sense of majesty, like you are walking into a royal conference or something. 

Final verdict: Come check this place out! You will not be disappointed. There is a lot to look at and definitely take pictures. You can take some good ones. I would know, my dad's a photographer.

Did a really nice job and quickly got the job done.  It does take a while for a response or getting time to get a quote so I wouldn't be in a hurry.  Once you have them booked they are very responsive and helpful through the process.
Delicious chickpea burritos! I've only had the chickpea burrito and the "go go burrito" from here but the experience has always been a good one. Flavorful and filling.

We had reservations which I Recommen! We had three dinner meals in NOLA on a recent Spring Break visit. All were very good, But Mr B's Bistro was ahead of the pack. 

Service was excellent, atmosphere is refined and classic, but very comfortable. Wait staff was super attentive but not overly so. Professional is my best description.

The four of us all ordered different entrees and it was hard to tell what was best. We shared two appetizers. To a dish, they were all excellent.
.
Deserts were very good and the expression was just right after dinner.

I live in a really narrow house so when the movers showed up with a couch we had bought and it looked like it wasn't going to fit, we thought we would have to just return the couch. But the guy told us that the name of the company is "It Can Fit" and if he didn't think it could fit then he wouldn't be wasting his time with it. I couldn't believe it when a few minutes later he had the couch in the living room! Very professional, very fast, and very friendly.
Terrible wait (unnecessary), average service, above average prices, and excruciating wait for food. Find someplace else. There's lots to choose from.

Next time, if I go back, I'll definitely get the fresh squeezed OJ (the machine is so cool!). The breakfast was edible, but under-seasoned.  The service was nothing special... I did give it 3 stars because one of the guys was wearing a ghostbusters T-shirt.  The wait for us was only 20 minutes, which is decent on the weekend.  It's just ok. Cash only.

This is one of my favorite places in Reno to eat or drink one of their microbrews.  The service and food is always consistent and their brews are the best!  The menu has a good variety of food and it's all delicous.  I wish there was one in Las Vegas, I miss this place!

Such a friendly and cute atmosphere!
Husband loved the cookie dough as he's a fan of it in general, my first time ever trying cookie dough and it was okay! Would recommend for all the cookie dough lovers

Nice brand new looking store.Very clean inside with modern decor. They had latin muzak playing 
which was very good. 
I ordered a mucho burrito carnitas which is pulled pork.
The usual toppings and a choice of  3 hot salsas.
The 'hot' version turned out to be perfect for me.
The burrito was very big .
Cost about $12 which is average these days.
They have the 'death' brand sauces in racks in case you want more spice. 
Service was very fast and efficient as they have a 3 person line cook setup.
Tasted great. 
I'll likely come back again .

Being fresh was about the only good thing about my chicken teriyaki here. It tasted like something I can get in the food court at the mall, and way over priced. The broccoli was cold and so was the rice. There are 20+ other places within a couple miles that are more worth going to. Save yourself the trouble and go somewhere else.

I like to test places out during restaurant week. This Ruth's Chris in particular treated the restaurant week customers like a nuisance. The service was not attentive and the portions were laughable. Think I'll stick with Morton's when I'm in center city.

I LOVE Blu Fig!!! It is the CROWN JEWEL of my neighborhood! This is my go-to place when I want to have something healthy, fresh & tasty and guilt free! My favorite is their sampler platter that includes stuffed grape leaves, hummus & pita. Love their tabouleh and yummy salads! They make everything fresh on the premises except for the baklava, I believe. The baklava is TO DIE FOR...very fresh, tender and NEVER chewy! They cut each piece in fourths so you can eat a fourth and take the rest to go. I've been a total fan since the first time I went. The owners and staff are super-friendly and service oriented. Their take out is just as great as eating in, too!
Food was really good but service was a little slow. Took 30 mins before server came and only checked on us once. Hopefully this will get better.

We had made a reservation beforehand and were seated almost immediately. The hostess and our waitress were both very friendly. I had the rigatoni alla vodka and it was great. All of the portions were huge! Will definitely be back again.

Hands down my favorite brewery in Tucson. The beer is excellent (and $1 off any time the train crossing arms are down) and the food is fantastic. They have a great happy hour, as well, with wings that are VERY good. They do a solid job of rotating beers, which is something that I like. Nothing bad to say about this place at all! Looking forward to my next trip to Tucson and visit to this place!
I have never been to someplace like this before.  It as spectacular.  I love this type of breakfast!  I had the island bowl and fell in love instantly.  My husband had the yogurt bowl.

Installed several remote starters for us. Anytime we have had any problems we have stopped by and they fixed it on site. These are the only guys we will use for our remote starters! Keep up the good work guys!

Was looking for a new Indian place after my favorite one had moved. This is by far the best one yet. I always get butter chicken and is one of my favorite. My boyfriend always tries something else and it's always good. We go in about 1 or 2 times a week and the owner always recognizes us, we even see him around town he is very local. Would recommend this place to anyone who is just dying for some awesome Indian food!

I've never thought Fulin's was that bad...until today.   
The menu's are DISGUSTINGLY sticky and in need of wiping down.   The window by table looks like two year olds rubbed their dirty hands all over it.   Our waitress attire looks like she never washes it...by the way she's served us before with dirty clothing so it's her mojo.  The first two sushi's were okay but something seemed to be lacking in taste and the presentation was... nothing...usually sushi is presented quite beautifully.  
But we ate it and wondered if we were ruined since we had sushi at a new place in Murfreesboro that was over the TOP delicious and fresh.   So we went on and ordered a third sushi.   The waitress served us the third sushi with the oddest hesitation...the sushi looked awful.  The menu never said the seaweed paper was on the outside.  It said it was served with avocado and one tiny piece of avocado was on ONE slice.  It was suppose to have Roe and it was nowhere to be found.  So we got the menu and proceeded to complain to the waitress as we felt it wasn't clearly explained what we were getting.  I honestly now wonder if the other two sushi's were even prepared correctly.   I had tasted one bite of the scallops sprinkled over the top and it was sooooooo dried out and disgusting.   My husband tried a slice of the roll.  He doesn't like seaweed on the outside to begin with but he said he's had better at the grocery stores (which is usually very bad).  So that's how low this place has gone.   Fulin's need a serious makeover and management that wants to serve good food.   You've lost two customers.

Two blocks away from busch gardens, which after driving to Tampa, roller coasters, and being in the sun all day is a relief. Checked in at 9 pm and still had a room.  Room service had a good  variety of  things, its available till 10 , so you can relax after a rough day. All in all, during my short stay, I enjoyed the room very much. Friendly staff, except for the cleaning lady. (I'll let u know when I'm good and ready to leave!!)I missed breakfast, but I heard it was good. Late check out was at 130, Not good enough for me.
Horrible!  Don't do it!  10x10 room with no charm, a l lumpy bed and a shower I had to wear shower shoes in.

I absolutely cannot stand Reno. My HOT August Nights era is long gone and I have had no desire to come back to Reno ever since. Lucky for me I had two weddings to attend in Reno this year that I dreaded only because they were in Reno!

As much as Reno is not for me, I must say if you are going to have to come here you might as well stay at the nicest hotel/resort there is. Yes, the Peppermill. It's no Vegas hotel but it's the closest thing they have.

The suites are very nice. I highly recommend the Veranda suites in the Tuscany tower. They are huge suites with several amenities and a private patio. Do not stay in room T 320. We somehow got booked in that same room each time. It has the worst odor like chemicals. I had to have them bring a humidifier to help clear the stench and it really did not help. I truly became a fan of this hotel when I got a massage at the spa. Wow, this spa blew me away! It's 4 levels of pure bliss! Next to the massage itself, the relaxation room is heavenly. 

The pools are beautiful, they offer cabanas and poolside wait services for food and drinks. The restaurants are not that great - poor service. Room service was accurate and prompt each time. Make sure to get a player's card before gambling to rack up those points. We have not paid once for our stays due to comps.

At first glance it might seem a little pricey at $45 a head for food you're not even choosing, not including drinks, but for the amount of food and the experience, it's worth it. I got out of there for around $70 for just me including cocktails - a splurge on my budget for sure, but I'm glad I did it.  Even though the menu is set, you can look it up a head of time and there is a wide enough range of dishes that there's something for everyone.  I'm sure the menu changes, but at least that was the case when I went.

I was honestly a little underwhelmed at some of the dishes, but most of them were amazing.  I guess from everything I'd heard I expected to be consistently wow'ed with every course, but how realistic is that, really?

It's community seating and family-style serving, so go prepared to make friends!
Also, there is a mid-meal dance break. 
Sold.

This is no typical sushi place. I love the music and decor. The Wasabi fries where so good my 9 year old wouldn't even share. I had to special rolls thwy where both spicy. The only problem was there was no price on the specials. The sushi was expensive but in all fairness the food was fresh and worth it. It's not a place I can afford every week but it's worth going for special occasions.

Beautifully decorated ambience- check.

A drink menu to turn a Monday happy hour into a Tuesday hangover- check.

The who's who of New Orleans' business elite- double check.


All in all, the coolest place to see or be seen in the most unpretentious way. Yummy handmade violet simple syrup, fruit juiced daily and a highly knowledgeable staff make up this quintessential boutique lounge in New Orleans. 

**Sightings to date: Ron Jeremy, Trent Reznor, Tom Drummond and Kevin Griiffin.

I tried the Shrimp Caminada Po-Boy and the stuffed burger. Both were delicious. When you walk in you notice the fresh herbs being grown right outside. They are deliciously loaded on the poboy for a nice fresh flavorful full bodied taste. It's light and perfectly portioned for summertime. My favorite was the stuffed burger. It's stuffed with cheeses and good tasting herbs that look like they're freshly grown right outside the restaurant. I enjoyed it quite a bit. I would recommend that burger any time.
Build a hash and a small order of GF pancakes. Hash had a delicious blend of sweet and savory pancakes were good as well. The true star the coffee not too strong not too weak,  perfect!

My favorite latte can be found right here.  I moved to Philly a little over 2 years ago, and one of my first experiences was sitting at La Colombe sipping on that latte I just ordered.  I was really surprised at how good it was.  Not that I was expecting something bad, but really, I thought that was the best latte I'd ever had.  I hardly needed to put any sugar in it (for example, at Starbucks, I usually put in 1.5 - 2 packets of sugar to wash away the bitterness).  

Anyway, I won't pretend to be a coffee aficionado.  I'm not.  But I'll just say that, for what it's worth, I love La Colombe coffee.  And I come back regularly to buy their packs (Corsica blend) to brew at home in my french press.

The actual cafe is a nice place to study if you can tolerate the noise and/or have headphones.  But seating can be kind of difficult to come by.  It gets crowded here.
The friendly cashiers talked me into buying a $20 rewards plus and a month later, they are going out of business.  I'm sticking with Amazon!!!
This is a great place for lunch or dinner. The prime rib sandwich is outstanding as well as the blackened catfish. Don't forget to get the shrimp cocktail.

We chose Rincon Beach Club for our venue, because of their delicious food, intimate atmosphere on the coast, and because a lot of the work was done for us by Rincon, which helped manage the stress levels while planning a wedding. Our guests kept complimenting the food saying that it was "the best they've ever had at a wedding". We loved that there were several options that Rincon could provide for decor, table arrangements and settings, ceremony styles, as well as different options of food service (e.i. buffet, served dinners, passed hors d'ourves, specialty cocktails, cake, desserts, etc.). Caitlin and Carol were so wonderful in helping us create our dream wedding, and really let us put our personal touches on it. They worked hard to collaborate with our vendors to make sure everything ran smoothly on the big day. Everything was so professionally executed, and all of the staff were very helpful and friendly, making us feel so comfortable. And again, we can't say enough about the food; there were so many options at the tasting, and all of them delicious!

If you need a sushi fix before hitting a movie at the Garneau, Kyoto is waiting for you.  We usually head to his place when in the neighbourhood for a film and the line-up at the Sugar Bowl is too long.  While not my go-to sushi pick, Kyoto does a great job with the whole "raw fish" experience.  

Last time there, we went with an assorted plate so that we could have good sample of what they have to offer.  What we got was plentiful (for the price) and a nice mix of the offerings.  The fish/seafood was fresh and tasty (you KNOW when you get a bad piece - amiright or amiright) and and plated nicely with the rice.

We had mentioned that we were catching a movie and the friendly, attentive waitress made sure we were served fast - so kudos to Kyoto for serving up a quick and delicious sushi fix!

This is a tough review for me.

I love donuts. Growing up, a lit "HOT NOW" sign followed by a warm Krispy Kreme donut was a favorite scenario of mine. Rightfully so yeast donuts have always been my favorite until I grew older and couldn't deal with the excessive sweetness and converted to an occasional cake donut  

I heard all the rave about this place when I moved here and I just knew I found the perfect way to satisfy my donut crave without being too sweet like Krispy Kreme or too dense like Dunkin. I think hearing everyone else talk so much about it clouded my judgement and I just thought they were the best hands down. After that excitement wore off I returned and I was able to think on my own how I felt about them. 

As for the donut itself I could go without. It's dry and not usually what I think of as a real donut (in my opinion) when it comes to taste. Not yeast-y but also not cake-y. It's definitely it's own breed. 

What keeps me coming back however, are the toppings. These guys are always making up the best flavor combos using just about anything u can think of as inspiration. They post the donut lineup of the day on their Instagram every morning so you know which they are offering on that day. Between the varieties of the flavors along with their levels of sweetness everyone is sure to find something they like. 

They have an entire menu outside of the donuts though. Usually 3 slider options for the day. Your usual coffee drinks and teas plus soda and juiced veggies. 

They do have wifi and indoor as well as 2 outdoor seating locations. I love the open kitchen and hearing the buzz of all the customers in and out. Definitely a place to at least try once.

A great place to study. A local spot for anyone and everyone. I had a great chat with total strangers on the front patio. Great coffee drinks, but the pastries were average. Bonus points for freshly made club soda.
Great new taproom!!   My dad and I have found a new home!!   Great food, great atmosphere, and beverage selection.   Owner made all of the tables and bar stools.  Very cool place

Service was excellent, and rooms were clean. We ordered our room on Hotel Tonight, so we got a discount. We also called in to be able to get a room with two double beds. Our first room had a leaky toilet, and they promptly gave us another room. We also get free wi-fi. Plus, you get fresh fruit, apple cider, and chocolate cookies. Yum yum! It's close to the downtown area, so it's easy to go exploring too. Overall, great plus to stay if you are in Santa Barbara.

I love the location of Cafe Pontalba next to Jackson Square. I really came here for a Cajun Bloody Mary and it was well worth it! The menu looks great as some breakfasts that I noticed while walking to the beautiful bar. Next time I'll eat instead of drinking my breakfast in The Big Easy!

We came back to Philly for a visit and Sbraga seemed to be the place for our 1 year anniversary.  I could sum it up in 3 words: too much salt.  The excellent service, especially from a very caring manager and the delectable desert saved the night for us.
- Foie Gras Soup:  the crunchy veg was refreshing.  However, the soup was dominated by lemongrass and saltiness so it should have been named creamy lemongrass soup.  What a waste of foie gras! 2 stars
- Wagyu Beef Carpaccio: thinly slice beef and fresh veg is a great combination then all that works are thrown away by the dstraction of chunks of salty crunch.  No balance, 1/2 stars.
- Escargots: the garlicky sauce is very nice, but again, the salt was a bit much.  However we did enjoy this dish.  Almost balanced, 3 1/2 stars.
- Wild mushroom & Sunflower seeds risotto: creamy sauce was great, but then the crunch, not cool! We could not finish it.  2 stars.  
- Blue Crab Bucatini: what a delightful dish, the pasta and the sauce were meant for each other and seasoned to perfection. 5 stars
- Veal Shoulder: amazing, the meat is perfectly cooked and paired with very fitting vegs: sauteed mustard green, cranberry and yam. 5 Stars
- Golden Tile Fish: amazing texture texture from the fish (this wonder fish presented itself).  However, we weren't too crazy about the pickled veg.  They were more of a distraction than a compliment.  3 stars.
- Pear tarts: Great dish, it wasn't overwhelmingly sweet, 4 stars.
- Malted Semifreddo: AMAZING! 5 Stars +++

After our experience last night, I will not be ordering again. I placed an order online and I am grateful I selected the pay cash option as it never arrived. 
I called the restaurant an hour and some change after placing the order and I was told it was on its way. I live about 10 minutes with lights and light traffic away from the restaurant so I expected it to be here soon after calling. 
Finally we reached the hour and forty-five minute mark and we called again. The woman at the restaurant was screaming at us when we asked again where our food was. We told her our address again, the same address we gave her the first time, only to be told now she didn't have an order for us. 
But wait, forty-five minutes ago it was on its way? 
Terrible, terrible service. It's one thing to be backed up on a weekend. It's another thing to lie about our order being on its way when it wasn't. They left us with few to none fast delivery options now that it was prime delivery time when we discovered our food was never coming. 
We will be finding another reliable Chinese restaurant in our area since Dragon City has lost our business for good.

This place is located in the middle of a somewhat shabby looking shopping center (Giant Food, Big K, Sears Hdwe.), but it's surprisingly good and quite consistent. They tend towards sweet and greasy American-style Thai food (think of apps like fried taro root or "golden triangles" of deep-fried tofu with sweet sauce), but if you stay away from fried dishes with funny names and go for traditional stuff like curries and noodle dishes, you will do pretty well. Take-out service is reliable. A little pricey for what you're getting, but in Phoenixville, beggars can't be choosers.

Update (Dec. 2007): I realize that my review sounds pretty negative. Maybe I overdid the snark. This is actually quite a good place. It's a bit overpriced, in my view, and you have to be careful with what you order, but I've been going there consistently for a number of years now. I love the curries, all of them. I also really like the Drungken Noodle dish, though sometimes they get kind of chintzy with the shrimp. Anyhow, I recommend it. It's not perfect, but it's quite good. I'm just stingy with the stars, I guess.

This place is the crown jewel of line dancing in tampa. They have ladies night on Thursday which is sure to never disappoint! They have a cover for men but it is worth it. The drinks are reasonable and the atmosphere is great. They cater to all ages and even have lessons to help You learn the dances.

Went in to Blue Moon for the first time today with my family and it was a great experience. I could have made a meal on the garlic knots alone haha The pizzas were awesome and the service couldnt have been better...particularly from the brunette girl, she was SO friendly and accommodating. I will definetly be going back :)
Foods good but, there is not seating and it's very loud. They ran out of ciabatta buns.

Wow!  This place is absolutely the best -never have I actually had an hour massage last the full hour -- other places cut it short and count the consult and dress time as part of the massage, leaving me with usually 45-50 minutes on my one hour massage.  I started going to Sweet Momma with my first pregnancy, then my second and now I just go to treat myself.  Highly recommend this spa to all.

Kim Henke.

Timothy was the photographer for my May 2014 wedding. I was a long-distance bride--living in Brooklyn, planning a St. Louis wedding--and the folks at Artisan were responsive and patient with my questions. When the wedding grew closer, my fiancé and I filled out a survey meant to plan out exactly what we wanted from our photos, which made me feel prepared. Timothy also helped me plot out the day's timeline in terms of photography--he went above and beyond to make a long-distance bride feel a little more in control. On the big day, Timothy directed the wedding party and our families well--knew good spots for portraits, told us how to stand--but was personable and made us feel comfortable. I love the finished product: a mix of portraits and natural, non-posed photos. I highly recommend Artisan for your wedding!

Initially had a difficult time finding the place. It was def worth
the effort. The waitress was friendly and took the time
to explain the menu.  Upon her suggestion we ordered 
the meat platter sampler.  A huge platter piled high
with hearty portions of BBQ and smoked meats as well as coleslaw
beans, corn bread and fries. We did not go home hungry! A thoroughly enjoyable food experience.
We will def make a point of frequenting this restaurant
every visit to Edmonton!

Customer service gave me incorrect information on where to leave my car at night after hours.  I had to leave my car in the dealership next door because all the gates were closed and locked.  I had to call to find out when my car was finished.  They did give me a helpful writeup of what my car needed, however, they told me that I was going to need new brakes with my last oil change, I went to a different Toyota dealership to have my oil changed and they said my breaks were completely fine.  The price of the service was the higheset I even payed.  I am never going back to this dealership.
Fast lines, delicious custard and an all around great place to take the kids or out of town family!

Second timer and once again this is authentic Greek food for the island. I would recommend the octopus app and the half chicken. The wife had the Greek salad with chicken and she raved about the freshness of the heirloom  and the feta was great. Order, sir, eat, and enjoy. The place was semi busy but the service was on point. Enjoy a cold class of white wine and a cold local beer. A very welcoming spot and same owners of the Gondola Restaurant in Hermitage. Excellent addition to the east side and we will be back

My mother and I were in Philly for my birthday. I am a Chinese food lover and I decided that I wanted Chinese food. We took a shot in the dark and bam! The food was great. The Chow Fun was great and the OMG the pan fried noodle with seafood was great. I highly recommend that you come here.

We had a wonderful experience at Muriel's tonight! My sister raved about the sweet potato soup with bacon and caramelized onions OMG!  We loved everything-- shrimp appetizer, crab cake, oven roasted chicken with mushrooms, asparagus side - the bread pudding was also wonderful (paired with coffee and cappuccinos!) 

This restaurant is a must for me any time I return to NOLA!

I go into the health food store at least 4x per week, I buy groceries , purchase food from their sandwich and smoothie bar. Their fruit bowls are delicious. The staff is always so helpful and they try to answer any questions I have regarding their products! Awesome locally owned healthy shop.

With a Toast to Roast, I say welcome to the E-town cafe scene! I spent a few hours in this welcoming and inviting space today working & amerced in the awe inspiring ambiance. Located in the historic & newly renovated Mercer building, this coffee house by day/wine bar by night has meticulously mastered creating a spacious environment that embodies the original charm and elegance I so hoped it would have. 

The pastries are fresh and delicious, the intoxicating aroma of the Roasted beans is delish, and the ode to the London Fog called the Morning Mist put a sublime smile on my face for hours after. Yes, I think I have found another regular haunt!

Friendly staff, great food, clean, great times. My husband and I went to the Fulton Alley and we were presently surprised. Friendly staff all around. We ordered drinks from the bar and were delicious. We also ordered food and to our surprise the food was very very good. We enjoyed every minute.

Tips: Take advantage of the Happy Hour Specials in bowling and drinks. We saved a few dollars. 

Definitely recommend .

I went there for  the first time this week and now I know what everyone is talking about. This place us legit !!
I got the Tommy roast beef sandwich and it was so juicy and delicious!! Can't wait to go back.

I went on a a Saturday afternoon and it was totally empty apart from my friend and I.  The service was great, the food was awesome (I don't eat sushi, so I tried some of the beef and chicken dishes they had - so good), and as the Beatles are my favorite band, I thought the music was perfect.

Ordered a family diner which is supposed to include a whole chicken, beans and rice.  On more than one occasion I got home and opened the box to find one breast and a mix of thighs, legs and what appeared to be a back.  The chicken is often over salted and over cooked.  The yellow rice is the worst I have ever had.  How in the world can you mess up rice?  The beans often are mostly liquid and the beans are missing.  The last time it happened I called  800 number (corporate headquarters) on the receipt and was advised that someone from the Brandon restaurant would call me.  Ronnie (not sure since I couldn't understand his message) called and advised me to come back to the drive through and my entire meal would be replaced.  I went today and gave them my name but was advised they could not replace the meal.  Ok, I guess you can lose a customer forever over a $12.00 chicken meal and that is fine by me.  No great loss for me.

Ordered from them via POSTMATES. My coworker pretty much finished his sweet and sour dish when discovered a dead bug that been cooked in his entree. When I called to report issue, a new gentleman said he would call his manager. He called me right back and said that manger said "If you want a refund call POSTMATES". I understand we ordered through a third party delivery service, however POSTMATES didn't make the food. Very disappointed and grossed out. Will not be returning due to poor customer service.

Come prepared for an experience - not just to pick up some yummy treats. The shop is carefully decorated, and you'll want to take some time to appreciate all the little charming details. There are flowers, crystals, and glitter galore - and tons of pictures/autographs of celebrity fans of the Cake Bake Shop. I just had to stop in when I found out that the Mint Chocolate Chip cake would be featured in Oprah's "O" Magazine (I wanted to beat the inevitable crowds) and wish I had planned more time to spend there (and come earlier in the day - it was already crowded when I got there). The little cafe and the corresponding menu looks darling. I can definitely see myself making a reservation (you'll need one!) for a fun girls-day lunch or afternoon tea. A slice of cake will set you back $10-15, but it's HUGE. I would definitely recommend coming hungry, with a partner to share with, or do what I did: Grab a slice, portion out a little for now, and freeze the rest for a late-night treat to elevate a relaxing night in.

Great brunch!! Great service!! 
Everything was tasty. Biscuits were good & the grits cooked perfectly.

Clean, well-organized, and the buses that I have caught here have been more on-time than other stops in the city.  I think this is where they do a bit of schedule-adjusting if they are running a touch ahead.  Very convenient to lots of downtown locales.

The breakfast potatoes with Swiss cheese and have been great had it not been swimming in oil. I like the concept but the execution was the issue. Same for the chicken and biscuits. The chicken was thick and tough and lacked seasoning. The biscuits were way too small for the chicken proportions.the server was friendly and attentive. The atmosphere is hip with nice music and local art on display.

We came here because it was dog friendly.  I thought that was pretty cool and wanted to try it and also I can bring my four legged son. But it was all down hill from moment we sat down. Associates are not friendly it took 10 or so to get our first round of drinks. My dog didn't even get water til we asked. When we finally got our food our drink was half way gone and waiter didn't even ask if we wanted a refill.  So we waited and no one came to check on us. My husband actually called the restaurant ask for a manager and said we needed a refill and our waiter hasn't come to do refill it. Manager Amy apologizes and finally our drinks came. Waiter didn't even apologize and just hands it out.  Some people just have no customer service skills and shouldn't work where u have to interact with customers.

I was really excited to try this place, esp because my regular taco food truck was nowhere to be found today...unfortunately, the beef burrito I had was incredibly tasteless. I had no idea burritos could even be that tasteless, and yet, there it was. 

The other reviews seem to love it, so maybe it was an off day, or maybe I ordered the wrong thing. I can't argue that the price is amazing for the quantity of food, but honestly, I'd rather spend an extra dollar and get a better burrito elsewhere.

I didnt know there was a jamba juice so close to work. Anyways their mango chia omega smoothie was fresh and delicious. The chia seeds were soft and sweet. Ill go again when im craving a fruity drink. :)

Went here with friends on a Thursday evening and really enjoyed the atmosphere. The waitress seemed a bit off in answering some questions about the menu, but I will say everything came out decent. I got the grilled salmon and it was yummy, and my sister got the Marathon burger which she raved over. Drinks were a little slow, but it was pretty crowded. All in all I'd come back, just maybe on a less crowded night.
Good service.  The food was just OK.  Good enough for a quick seafood fix.  No oysters???

Food is very subpar if you ask me. It's very Tex mex so if you're not into that then stay away. Good thing about this place is their margaritas pitchers during happy hour. Super cheap you really can't beat them. Chips are prob the best tasting thing here honestly. Wings aren't that bad either. Everything is pretty much just "ok". If you want more authentic food go to dos segundos right up the street. Food there is way better.

Ended up here by accident, but well worth it. Whole family happy with what they had. Crab dip was excellent.  Fried redfish with shrimp and crawfish quite good too. Nice local restaurant. We will definitely be back.

This restaurant is 2 minutes away from me so why not brunch? Here's why.

The staff is very uninterested in you. Not friendly at all. They are not invested in you unless they know you are legitimately their friend. Our waitress was having such a good time attending her neighbors and chatting about their personal lives but when it came to our table, she took the order and dashed off.

The wait was long and the food did not make up for it. The pancakes are better at McDonald's. The hashbrowns were burnt. The eggs were undercooked. I ordered orange juice at it tasted like cheapest orange gallon they could've gotten at Marsh right next door.

I got out of there wondering why this is a restaurant? I could have made their meal at home and a lot better too! 

STAY AWAY!
It's a hidden gem! Came on Sunday afternoon and it was not crowded at all. Good vibes, great wine and can't beat the view.

Sophia has done it again (she has had a place in Bryn Mawr for years)!! The salon in Bala Cynwyd is a soothing place to go and get great work done--with the heart, spirit and action of true service. Clean, attentive and thorough work. This location also has her daughter (trained and experienced in NYC) doing complete hair services. Bravo!!! P.S. my only wish is a bit more warm color and artwork--the monochrome while stylish is a bit stark-but the warmth exudes from Sophia and her staff!
Wonderful family run restaurant, warm atmosphere and phenomenal food. The Tres Tacos were awesome and be sure to try the coconut cilantro rice. We will most definitely will be back. Thank you!

First time getting a proper Barber Shop shave.  We were offered a whiskey and beer to complement the shave.  

Very cool shop. 

These guys were awesome.  Great experience. A must do.

Thoroughly happy customer that has been frequenting In Riva for years now. It is by far our favorite restaurant, we make it a point to head there at least a couple times a month. Their pizza specials during the week are too good to pass up, service and beer menu is always on point. And perfect ambiance on top of that. This will be my greatest heartbreak when we inevitably move from the Manayunk/East Falls area!
Ordered triple dipper and fried pickles were sawgy and awful

This Cracker Barrel was pretty good. I love the chicken & dumplings, & sweet potatoes. The biscuits are great, too, we were given tons for free. My mom had the blueberry pancakes, which were delicious. 

It's not too expensive, and they give a lot of food for the money.

Myself and my son went here on the rare Saturday night that I had off from work. I had a giant margarita, and we both had the steaks. I always love this location, it's never really crazy and loud like some of the other locations and the staff are always very friendly. Plus it's good for a 9 year old, which makes a difference to us!

3.5 stars. 
This was the bride's #1 choice for her bachelorette party and it was all about her this night. It honestly wouldn't be the first place that comes to mind for me for such an occasion and I did indeed suggest other restaurants, even other Starr's. I hadn't been to Jones in way over a decade so I figured maybe things had changed. Ehh. 

Positives: 

The sweet printed menu with the name of the event at the top. 

Mac and cheese was said to be fantastic. 

Nachos were another favorite. 

Shoestring fries were great and went fast. 

Whoopee pies went and the dairy free berry sorbet was delicious and well liked by all. 

Guava margs were good. A tad too much ice. Pricey. 

Service was fantastic! Thanks to Dalton and the manager, Steve. 

Vibes were fairly good. 

They went out of their way to provide a vegan meal just for me and it was delicious. 

Separate bills for drinks were appreciated. 

Negatives: 

The meal was very heavy for the last time we were dining. Not the restaurants fault. 

The pierogis were said to taste like frozen just "jazzed up"   

The apps were preferred over the main meals. 
"Underwhelmed" was a word used at the table.

No one was really thrilled with having to eat pre-select entrees and paying a set price which is what is required for a party our size (11 people) 

Many didn't feel the price we paid per person was worth it. 

**You must email the events coordinator Abby to secure this type of reservation. A 50% deposit is then required.

They have opened a new location just outside of Scott AFB.  The good was delicious....but....we waited for over an hour for food.  There is no excuse for service like that, especially at a BBQ place where the meat is already cooked.  I saw many people request a refund because the food was taking so long to come out.  Will not be returning!
Will give it five star without a doubt . The food, service, everything is really good here. The beef kebab are the awesomest

Great spot and ambience, but the food was such a disappointment.  This is the second time we have been here, the first being when they first opened.  We were a bit letdown with our first visit, but chalked it up to being newly opened.  This time we ordered Posole, and my  husband ordered a fish taco.  The Posole had no flavor, and the taco not much more.  I don't understand how you can make Posole (which we make occasionally), without flavor.  We don't use pork, either, we use chicken or just vegetables, so it wasn't because of the lack of pork.  It was a lack of spices.  I do have to say the chips and salsa were excellent, and we were hopeful, but...

Mac's had to work very, very hard to earn that 3-star rating, and had to claw its way back up from a much lower one, at that.  While there is nothing really wrong going on here, something was just off .

Mac's prides itself on its large beer list which, while it is long, is not really that impressive if you know your beer.  Nothing on there is very unique, and the list is thinned out by the long section of humdrum domestics.  What microbrews they do have are not very impressive either.  While they do have a few hard to find beers, like the Old Speckled Hen, it's mostly made up of the larger, easily available beers.  Honestly, you can go almost anywhere these days for a Bells, Dogfishhead, or a Rogue.  Really, there is nothing WRONG with their section, but its nothing very clever, either.  Their large chalkboard beer list on the wall could use some updating as well.  Many of the choices were no longer available, and it sounds like they may have been gone for a while. 

I also wasn't terribly impressed with the waitstaff, but I did come around on this.  When we first sat down, our guy was a little odd, and gave off an attitude like he had much, much better things to do than listen to my questions about beers that he couldn't answer anyway.  For a weekday, and not a very busy one, either, he was very hard to get a hold of, and probably made it a point to avert his gaze when he walked by.  He did come around a little at the end.  When I was a little unsure on what to order, he gave me three very different samples of some of their best sellers to help me make my mind up.

So, if you're in the area, Mac's might not be a bad choice for the convenience.  The prices aren't outrageous for the types of beer they offer or the neighborhood in which they're selling them, and the food that my friends ordered looked pretty fantastic.  They seemed to enjoy it, and the sweet potato fries I snatched were pretty good.  Unless you got yourself a Groupon, like I did, it's not really worth the trip across town.  You could do better, but you could also do much, much worse.

A friend and I found this little cafe on our way back to the hotel one afternoon and decided that we should keep it in mind to try out before we left.  Turns out we went there the very next morning for a well needed hangover cure before a lengthy day of sight seeing and an even longer night of roaming around Bourbon Street.  

The menu is listed on huge black chalkboards above the counter where you order, although if you don't feel like craning your neck backwards and squinting from your spot in line, you can find a paper copy close to the entrance or left on tables.  It's your typical cafe menu (bagels, omlettes, breakfast platters, etc.) with a slight french twist to some dishes (i.e. you can order a "fresh" croissant instead of toast).  The prices aren't too bad either--about 6 or 7 bucks for a breakfast platter, 2 or 3 bucks for a special coffee.

The line can get pretty long, but I don't see it as the kind of place with a line out the door as there are tons of other similar cafes splattered all over the French Quarter.  You have to order at the counter, take your number card and try to find a place to sit.  The turnover in this place is pretty quick, so it shouldn't be too hard to find a seat and you can always move tables if necessary.  If you don't want to eat there, I think you can also get the food to go.  Since the place is small, it's easy to feel very crowded in there when the line is long, so I recommend sitting by the door if you can snag a spot, makes it feel a little more open.

I got a breakfast platter with eggs, hash browns, bacon and a croissant instead of toast.  The eggs were fine (I don't like yolk, so I only order the whites and it's very hard to mess those up);  the hash browns were great, shredded and greasy (maybe a little too greasy) with random bites of crispy potatoes mixed in; the croissant was ok...it was supposed to be warm and buttered but it was more like a crispy flaky mess with a spot of butter;  sadly the bacon was greasy and limp instead of nice and crispy like I expected (I ate it anyway.....you can never turn down bacon!).  My friends ordered similar platters which came out looking a lot like mine.  

Overall, the food was a little greasy for my taste, but it did the job.

I love this store. I can find everything I need at this location!

Added 7/8/'17: My son lost over 50 pounds and we were able to outfield him with new clothes for his new figure for very little money. Yeah hey Ross‼

That's a shame! 
This place is full of junkies customers 
The staff and the service is fast 
It's just too much like homeless or you can tell the addict people all coming here and soliciting

2nd best baseball stadium in PA, in every way inferior to PNC park, no real charecter & Cannot be compared to Pac Bell or Camden or Comerica or Arlington. Luckily the Philles are good right now so good baseball is to be had & CBP is easy to get to by Subway, but the least intersting of all the new ballparks.
Verify impressed with the speed of service and attention to small details. Lunch was delicious and efficient.

Another win in our early days here in Tampa!
Super nice wait staff, lots of food options and complimentary homemade potato chips!!! With some kinda ranch sauce that will satisfy the locals and the northern visitors! ;)
Definitely get the mashed potatoes as your side, the mac and cheese was pretty darn good too. And a 2 for 1 drink special!?!?! Get out of town!
We will be returning and bringing friends!

Stopped in on our way home from an afternoon of exploring the town. We really liked their curb appeal of the outside bar and seating area with fire pit. We love the real wood bar tops inside. We were greeted quickly by our bartender Olivia. All the staff we encountered were very welcoming and nice. We only stayed for a couple of drinks and ordered a cheese pizza to go. You must try the pizza! It was perfectly cooked, not too saucy and very tasty. My husband and I look forward to returning and actally sitting down and enjoy a real meal there. They do offer tours of their brewery on the weekends for $5 or $10. We will try that another time. Beer is tasety too!

My fiance and I took our second trip with Wine Edventures Saturday Feb 12th. 

Shawn picked us up at our hotel in Santa Barbara for a fun filled day of wine tasting in a clean, comfortable shuttle van. He's a nice guy and a good sport and was cracking jokes all day. He was more than accommodating, even when I managed to lose my complimentary wine tasting glass along the way.

He gave us a brief history of the area and the wine making process as well as a quick lesson on wine tasting and were set free to taste to our heart's content at 4 wineries and saw beautiful scenery along the way.

Being a popular holiday weekend the van was full and it was a big group.  All the wineries we visited had a lot of traffic and other wine tours coming in and out. Shawn handled it well as did all of the wineries. 

The picnic lunch is excellent and for sandwiches it really is gourmet. 

I've taken a few different wine tours with various companies and this one has been the best by far. Definitely recommended for a group outing, a day trip, romantic date or special occasion.

Note for couples -
Based on our experience if you book a tour on a not so busy day you'll be with a smaller group and your experience may be more intimate. It was a very different experience our first time being with a group of 6 on a random Sunday vs full bus of 22 people on a busy holiday weekend. We still found it to be a very romantic day despite the big group and all the action. Overall no complaints and we would do it again either way.

Take a tour with these guys, it's a bargain for the price and you'll have a good time.
Love the sushi here! The sushi bar is a little small (which I love sitting at) but the dining room is very nice. They also have Thai here.

We ordered this in as room service while we were at The Cheshire so have no knowledge of being in the place itself just the food. I had the lamb sliders which were out of this world! My wife had the wings with the Newcastle sauce and they were amazing! I'm not big on wings but I wanted to eat them all and wanted more! We also had an order of the fries which were great. Of special note is the 'dipping sauce' they gave with the wings and the fries...i'm not sure exactly what it was but it tasted like a mayo base with some real good herb flavor. We definitely want to go back next time we're in St. Louis.

Worth the effort to get here. Cool concept that offers a lot.  From the wine store on ground level with well-priced bottle selections, to the craft cocktails upstairs in the bar/dining area, everything was good and nicely presented.  The live jazz was fantastic on a stormy New Year's Day evening. Well- dressed good-looking crowd of 30-somethings. Surprisingly affordable, possibly due to lower real estate costs in this neighborhood. Easy parking. Cheap Uber ride from FQ.

Alright so Starbucks is usually Starbucks in my book. Went in here after lunch, got through the line quick with friendly service. Coffee was hot, and they have coconut milk here. Things seemed business as usual and what you would expect walking into a Starbucks. 

Remember: if you have the Starbucks app, open it while your in line to make sure your signed in and not when you get to the register (like I did #fail).
Great chicken sandwich. Burger tasted great. Buffalo chili very tasty would get them again. Service was friendly. Beautiful patio.

I'm writing this review specifically for the taco al pastor.  Up until I visited Polo's Taqueria, I had never had tacos al pastor, but I will tell you that they are most excellent.  I'm told, though I cannot verify the accuracy, that Polo's is the only shop in Tucson to make their taco al pastor in the traditional Mexican style.  That is to say, the pork is put on a vertical spit, a la Greek gyro style, and a slice of pineapple is placed on the top and bottom.  While cooking, the juices from the pineapple drizzle down into the pork and the flavor is amazing.

Polo's is in a non-descript strip mall location near the corner of Fairview and Prince.  They have all of the "fixins" that you expect from a taco shop, such as pico de gallo, a variety of salsas, limes of course, pickled red onions, etc.  I highly recommend it.

My wife and I went for lunch, since we were at downtown. I was around 2:30 and didn't know if they still served lunch. They did, but not the buffet, which was fine. Being vegetarian, I ordered the margherita pizza and she ordered the vegan ravioli. For the first time, she loved a ravioli with no cheese and cream sauce, the mushrooms, zucchinis and cherry tomatoes were prepared perfectly. There was only 1 word for me to describe the pizza - blissful. The coffee was strong, but without an after-taste, just flavorful. Highly recommended for a quick lunch.
best soft tofu in town. hands down. no competition. totally worth the drive from center city, every time.... if you're into that kind of thing that is.
we did not even get to food .The first four plates on buffet were filthy with food remains.Never go there again doesn't even deserve one star

Essentially, Blaze Pizza is Subway for pizza. Get a build-your-own and you choose your crust, your sauce, and toppings for a super reasonable price. You go through the line and build your pizza like a Subway sandwich and watch them fire it up until it's ready to eat. I go here a few times a month for lunch on workdays and have never had a bad experience. Some days at peak lunch hour, it's crowded, but my co-workers and I haven't had trouble getting a table. Highly recommended! I've also tried a few of their specialty pizzas and my picky 3-year-old loves the Simple Pie. Eat here and you won't regret it.

Also, parents, heading to Blaze is not a far walk from the Louisiana Children's Museum. It is a bit of a trek, but an easy one and your taste buds, wallet and child(ren) will thank you. :)

So I normally love this place but today, not so much. Ordered 2 bowls (the same except one fish change) and mine was missing ingredients and looked like a darn mess (as compared to the other bowl). Consistency is key!

We'd heard about this opening recently at the KOP mall, and my wife had tried it a few days ago, so we decided to stop in after a walk at Valley Forge. It's pretty close to the mall entrance near Cheesecake Factory, and it's a nice little space. No real place to sit and drink the bubble tea, but cute shop with a section with lots of Asian snacks. There's not as much variety of choice of tea here compared to other bubble tea places, but it's largely because they focus on using fresh fruit in their teas, and don't use powders.

The tea is definitely tasty, though a bit on the pricey side. My wife got a cold mango tea with sago, and I got a hot ginger milk tea. The mango tea was very refreshing and light, and the ginger milk tea was really great for a chilly day. It wasn't super hot, so I could drink it through a straw. I probably wouldn't have minded it being hotter, but it was delicious. I would totally get that again, or try another ginger tea...

From out of town and came here on a local's rec.  good service. oysters were good, blackened redfish was so so, gumbo was ok, and ayce seafood buffet looked like a lot of work for $40. Best thing we had was the kids fresh friend shrimp for $6. Actually, bread pudding was really good too.
Very unique lounge, decor is beautiful, shows are awesome. Great place to start the night in the city!!! Wish they open earlier on Saturdays.

If the service was better this would be a 4 star review. The meal began with some rolls (Parker House style) that were boring.  The restaurant made butter, fortunately, was quite good and enlivened the bland rolls.   

The spring salad had a lively assortment of fresh greens served over a schmear of creme fraiche.  Too bad there was a little more so you could taste a ramp and such more than once.  The mackrel appetizer was very well prepared, seared on one side and served with juicy, sweet grapefruit.  That was a hit.  The one very annoying component of these two dishes was the ridiculously large plates on which they were served.  The plates would have been appropriate for a individual pizza, but not a small fistful of fresh greens. 

The "mains" of pork belly and loin with mustard greens and spaetzel, and hanger steak, were both excellently prepared.  The steak was perfectly seared and the vegetables crisp and delicious.  The spaetzel had an interesting flavor and provided a good texture to compliment the mustard greens.  Both of these dishes were spot on and demonstrated talent in the kitchen.

Great food. The build your own hash was great. The coffee was great. The blueberry coffee cake was fantastic. My only issue is the line. For a Sunday morning, around 10:30AM, from start of the wait in line to actually receiving the food, 45 minutes. If you are hungover, probably not the spot due to the line. If you have the patience, its worth it.

large number of books.  crowded shelves.  high shelves.  no help or service.  its dark and dank & narrow as you go in the back.  finding and browsing are not exactly a pleasure--you have to go low or high to find stuff.  finally, things are not all that cheap.  nearly every book is priced at $5 or more.  they do take books in trade--your optimal strategy is to bring boxes of old books dvds vhs tapes, trade them in, get store credit, and then use the store credit for what you really want to read.  i had trouble finding books on connie mack, the Phila As, the Negro Leagues, but did find some other worthwhile selections.

Not sure why Yelp thinks this is in Green Hills - it's definitely in Belle Meade.  But besides that...

Newk's is better than Panera.  That's kind of the standard by which I judge chain sandwich shops.  It's also a little bit pricier but, at least for the salads, it's worth it.  Newks has much better salads - much better quality of ingredients and just more variety.  I got the dressing on the side and had no issues with it except that the ratio of oil to vinegar was a little on the oily side.  Lots of seating inside.  My food always comes quickly.

What a great sports bar!  This place is huge and has several television screens throughout the restaurant and the best thing is that they have steamed seafood!

And I love my blue crabs which they had perfectly seasoned and delicious!  I got to eat my crabbies while the bf watched his games.  A winning combination!

This place was awful.  They insisted on ordering my dress a size larger than I asked for, because they said there was no chance the size I claimed I was and the measurements didn't lie.  Only they measured me in a sweatshirt and thick baggy denim, without pulling the tape measure tight.
When I saw her write the measurements down I was horrified, I insisted she measure me with my clothes off. 
Of course she refused and said that she does this all the time.  A month later the dress comes in and of course- It's WAY too big.  There is boning in the top half and my small B cup breasts will never fill out this DD purple monstrosity.  I told them I wanted them to order another one in the correct size. And they said that they could not guarantee that it would arrive by the wedding date. But they had an excellent seamstress that could take care of it for me.  I walked over to the part of the shop where the seamstress happen to be (normally I guess she doesn't work in the shop)
She informed me that to tailor this with the boning would actually cost me more than the dress had.  I wanted to scream, it felt like a setup.  Like they did this on purpose to make more money.
I don't know if that's true, but it sure as heck felt like that.  I had a few choice words with them and told them I would find a more reputable place to make the alterations.
I will never EVER go back here. Nor will anyone int he wedding party.

It was okay at best. Prices were moderate, really that on par where you would expect them to be.  The food was not the greatest, almost tasted like it was a microwaved meal. That being said perhaps it was just the dish I got.  I ordered the brisket, portions were not overly huge and it was just boing. Meat was a little tough and chewy.   My wife ordered salmon and she says her meal was very good. The best part of our meal was the appetizer. Do yourself a favor and get the nachos. They were very good. 

I think the other part of the diner that was disappointing was the service. Slow and un-attentive was being kind. I would probably never go back nor recommend this place. Hope this helps.

This place has a great casual atmosphere. Food is amazing, but be prepared to get messy. We ordered 6 raw oysters as an appetizer and received 8 of the hugest most beautiful fresh oysters I've seen. Then the angry combo with lobster, crawfish, clams, and shrimp-medium spicy garlic flavor. It came with corn, potatoes, and pork sausage and we ordered garlic bread to soak up the liquid. This was for 2 people and we got way more than we needed. Reheating at home is easy...just place the bag in boiling water. The service was great and although it appears pricey, it's a good value and well worth it for a fun date-night dinner.

The food was superb and the menu was classic bistro with flair (though the menu itself had a coffee stain on the back). My wife and I shared a French onion soup that was comme il faut (the wife would have liked more cheese, but then she's from Wisconsin). For the main course, we shared the steak frites. The 10oz NY steak was a perfect medium rare, and very tender, especially for a NY cut. The frites were simply perfect.
   The service was another story. We arrived at 5:00 pm on a Tuesday and had the place to ourselves until we were nearly finished. The decor is also great, btw: airy, light, and clean. But something happens to servers in Tucson when they land a job at a real restaurant. They can turn into insufferably condescending, attitude-stricken, unctuous, pompous twits. And yet, somehow, also obsequious. That said, the food did come out mostly on time, and we did have the attention of our server when we needed him (and then some).
