Not your usual Mexican fare, semi nouvo. Very good. No liquor license, that's a shame. This restaraunt is making it on its great food alone.

When you walk in the mood is very relaxed but the first thing you notice is a plethora of food that has been sitting in a warmer all day. Everything looks dried out. Let me start with what I ordered. I had the mofongo (chicken) and yellow rice with black beans. The mofongo was tasty but the salt content was unacceptable. The chicken was clearly left overs from the previous day. It was dry almost like a jerky. The yellow rice was bland and so dry from sitting in the warmer all day that it almost seeemed undercooked or raw. The beans were salty and lacking in flavor as well. I am not even an expert at dominican cuisine but from an avid lover of the culture I cook better dominican food than this place in my home. I will never eat here again.

Ok, I normally go for the crawfish & tasso white pizza, which is great, but tonight I opted for pasta.  Crawfish in a garlicky cream sauce, which I asked to have spiced up a bit.  Perfectly cooked and seasoned.  Been going there for about 15 years, will always go back

This place was absolutely fantastic. It's right by my apartment so I have it a try after reading the reviews. Completely worth it. I had the pork taco head taco and steak burrito (only finished half in one sitting). The head taco was amazing and the hot sauces that they give you are phenomenal. I will be back.

Free museum and completely self guided.  Security is strict and they checked our IDs before we entered the building.  No photographs inside, which is a shame because they have many photo-worthy items, but I'm sure it's for security reasons.  They had some pretty neat commemorative coins and medals on display.  Also, during our visit, we only saw a handful of other visitors which was a nice break compared to other tightly packed sites.

Great vegetarian food, cheap lunch menu. Very authentic. Especially reccommend a mango lassi to go with you meal. Share a samosa to start but ve warned they are huge! Vegetable pakoras also great!

Only drawbacks : vegetarian and only open fri sat sun.

Food is so good you will forget its vegetarian.

Not bad! I'm not going to lie, I always hated the idea of eating here...

Well the sliders with jalapeño cheese are the jam!

My only complaint is the bottom of the buns got soggy before I could get to them - no worries - ill eat much faster next time

If you're looking for a laid back place with a good beer list, ok pizza and above average sandwiches, this is a great place for you and the family. If you're looking for a place with basic, well made italian dishes and good service, try elsewhere. They do some things well and should stick to them.

Pulled chicken, briskets, pulled pork - sandwich or plate - this menu is delicious! The sides are also pretty much all great. I especially love that squash casserole. yum!

Only issue lately is that there is a relatively new person behind the counter, and he doesn't seem to care much. Serves much smaller portions, never smiles, barely listens to you. Nevertheless, that shouldn't take away from the food here. Great BBQ!

Here on business and ate at this restaurant twice. I am being generous with 3 stars because the food was OK as expected. Service was good on the first visit and that's why the 3. Food was good both times. On the second visit, had very poor service from my waitress. They were busy it was Saturday night. The attitude of my server when I had my meal served with the wrong type of chicken was, "that's what you ordered". It was not. She exchanged it quickly and was short when I paid. It's a thankless job but telling a customer even at JRs it's your fault will be why I won't go back.

Comfortable and relaxed atmosphere with a super friendly staff.  I walked there from the courthouse.  The waitress found time for me and answered questions about the menu while she was hustling around serving tables and ringing up customers.  There are plenty of gluten free options.
I went with the ribs and they were delicious.  A little bit of smoke with a well done bark.  I tried all of the sauces on the table.  They were all god but the maple chipotle bbq sauce was outstanding.  The chili with meat was tasty too.  I substituted a gluten free role and it was a little cornbready which complemented the BBQ.  
Relaxing atmosphere with great service and tasty food.  It might actually make me look forward to getting called for jury duty again.

Cafe Envie was an amazing cafe to visit while in NOLA. The espresso my sister got and the warm coffee I got was amazing!
The food selections were amazing ! 
Thank you Cafe Envie!

Since I'm mildly obsessed with Mediterranean food, I got really excited when this place opened so close to my office, especially since the trek to Athens for my Greek fix usually pushes the time boundaries of an acceptable lunch hour. 

I had the gyro with cucumber salad and the hummus appetizer.... the gyro was pretty good, the cucumber salad was delicious, but I honestly can't tell you how the hummus was because all I could taste was the 63 pounds of salt/seasoning on the overcooked pita chips.  I tried to scrape them off, but I swear that crap was glued on. Gross.

The restaurant itself is cute and comfy - lots of people parked with their laptops when I was there. 

The staff was very friendly, but it seemed like they were still working out a few kinks.  I heard someone, who I assume was a manager, gently reminding employees of best practices several times... (now, when someone orders water we should give them the SMALL cups!)

You sometimes have to get creative with parking over there... the small lot that Taziki shares with Which Wich is almost always full. Try the lot across the street behind Panera. 

I'll definitely be back, but if I have a hummus craving I'll opt for Athens.

This place is fantastic!  I went for the first time today with a friend and had an amazing experience.  I must have looked lost reading the menu because another customer stopped to offer his recommendations.  Hassan upon learning it was my first time for chaat told me he would explain everything and the menu would only make me more confused.  He spent more than five minutes explaining what a chaat was, how he made it, and the differences between the different menu offerings.  He told me that number 9 was the best place to start for the beginners and asked me my spice preference.  It was really nice that he explained the process and paid careful attention to my preference (when I said I wanted spicy but wasn't sure if that was American spicy or Indian medium he gave me American spicy and put hot sauce on the side so I could customize it).  He told me that he would guide me through the menu and options on subsequent visits.  I really like that he sees it as a 'journey' through food.  We ate at the restaurant; there aren't a ton of seats but a lot of people get take-out so its not an issue.  Hassan brought us small glasses of Banana Fig Lassis so we could try them.  When we had finished the meal he asked how I had liked it and explained how chaat isn't something served in restaurants because of the complexity, variation, and customizable character.  He said each menu option was characteristic of the cuisine of a certain region, but that by no means these were the limit to his food creations.  Hassan truly approaches chaat as an art - it is completely customizable.  He let me try each of the crunch toppings individually so I could get a sense of the ingredients and how chaat is composed. He said you can only find mango lassi at Indian restaurants, but he figured why not have a rose lassi or a passionfruit lassi.  He promised he could make any kind of lassi or milkshake I could think of - which I take as a desirable challenge :)  He even gave me a spoonful of the rose petal jam he uses to make the rose lassi.  He says he makes it out of real rose petals, not just extract so it has real rose flavor.  It was awesome and I'm definitely going to order a rose lassi when I come back.  And for those wondering what chaat is its basically a salad on crack - it has a thousand ingredients, spices, sweet, sour, spicy, salty crunchy, balanced, and fantastic.  I definitely recommend it!  Overall the experience was fantastic as was the food.  Hassan is truly what makes this restaurant special.

This place was pleasant surprise in Reno.  Yelped for a good noodle place besides going to the casino's since we were with the grandkids.  When boba was mentioned, the grandkids wanted to try this place.  They not only liked the boba, but they loved the popcorn chicken, chicken chow fun and the braised beef noodle soup.

We will make this a go to spot to eat when we visit Reno again.  My grandkids wanted their parents to take them back for lunch the next day!

We will definitely be back and try other menu items.

Went here for a coworkers birthday today for lunch. Loved the overall atmosphere and ambience. I ordered the Asian chicken salad and tomato basil soup (which was the soup of the day). The soup was excellent! Will definitely order again and I actually wished I had ordered the big bowl. On to the salad... Very good as well love the textures and flavors in it. Only problem was the chicken. I really cannot describe to you what was wrong with it because I cannot quite put my finger on it. I just found myself eating around it.  Maybe mine was just a fluke I am not sure.  If I decide to try it again I will just omit the chicken from the salad. 

And last but not least the reason I am writing this review... 2 of my coworkers ordered the Mediterranean  flat bread pizza. AMAZING! I immediately regretted not ordering it. If you like veggie pizza you cannot go wrong (and for all you vegetarians it is one of the few options you have here). I liked it so much that I ordered one to go. I admit it did not taste as great the next day. I will be back but I will go for happy hour next time (my coworker raved about the mixed drinks so much that I have to see for myself!)

Excellent from start to finish! The service is excellent and Priya, in particular, is the most pleasant, welcoming and helpful person I've met in a while. My knowledge of Indian food is limited and she found out our taste and helped us order a delicious selection of dishes to match. And then the bill came and it is very reasonably priced.... Great dining experience...looking forward to going back.

I've been here twice. Here's how it went:
Happy Hour: crowded. slow service. but fries were yum diddly delicious. we got every single french fry offered. cheese did the weird gross thing when it gets cold and congeals. in like 2 minutes. that sucked. 

Random Friday night at 9pm: loud-ass music could barely make conversation which is weird because there were like 10 people in the bar, clearly not there to start a dance party. One waiter. So service was slow. Waiter tried to make up for it by being good looking.

Great place to go to if you're looking for a good slice of pizza. The owner and staff are very nice people. Their seafood pizza and whole wings are amazing. There 's also a great selection of specialty and limited edition beers. I would recommend anyone in the area to check it out.

I've waited to type this review as I wanted to try a few things from their menu. I have tried the Sicilian with pepperoni, the house special (no anchovies), wings, and their cheesesteak with wiz, onions, and mushrooms. These were all separate orders and the orders were correct and made within a decent time frame. The pizzas are very good and so are the cheesesteaks. Extra bonus that they have take out beer and malt liquor.

Not sure with some of the reviews I have read as the people I have spoken with at this location that have taken my order spoke English. I think some may be confusing this place with the Joey's Pizza in West Chester that did close down.

I wasn't happy with the sushi quality. No flavor. When I ordered the resturant just opened so I hope that was the reason why the sushi wasn't good. The seafood soup was also flavorless, and watered down.  They do deliver so I'll give them two stars instead of one. Would not recommend unless your desperate and don't feel like going out or paying fees for delivery services like  Postmates, if the fees don't bother you order from someplace else.

So good!!! Visited here for lunch during a work trip, and definitely happy we did! The service was great and the food was wonderful!!!!!! I got the corned beef sandwich with the VooDoo chips, and I scarfed down every bite. The sandwich was amazing.. full of flavor! The service was quick, even during a busy lunch period, which helps for those of us on a time crunch. Will definitely eat here again next time I'm in the area!

Thank you to the guys at Eclipse who made my vegan calzone.  Note to vegans: if you bring in the vegan mozzarella, they can make an amazing delicious calzone with all the veggies.  I am spreading the word and going to plan a vegan meet up there!  
THANK YOU!

I have stopped by a few times since moving into Rittenhouse Square looking for a friendly pub. In my first two visits during the Spring, the bartenders were nice, friendly and welcoming. This past Fall and Winter, the staff made me feel like an imposition. They were more content sitting/standing on the side of the bar talking about their days and nights and, dare I mention, making fun of customers rather than acknowledging paying attention to the bar of customers. One gentlemen had to ask numerous times to pay his tab (it was not busy). This was my last try at The Black Sheep and will stay with Twenty Manning Grill.

A nice pearl in the middle of the swamps. After our swamp adventure, we stopped in this restaurant. The best restaurant that we had visited during our vacation in New Orleans.
Service was great, food was the best. Gumbo was the best!
The back patio is limited by a swamp with a large alligator and turtles.
If you are driving, try to go to this place, very close to the swamp tour with Captain Lou.

As a collector of rare books, I have always loved the Fleisher!
It is an international icon and deserves more attention!!!

My favorite Japanese restaurant so far around the area. The staff was great and the food is amazing! My husband and I had a great time a couple of months back and we are crazy to go back again. Their sushi and dinner show is great!

Great mom and pop restaurant. Came here based off of Groupon ... they serve a lot food for what you pay but Service it self was not very attentive and we were the only people in the building .. we waited about 20-25 min just for the check and never got our refills for our drinks
Tasty authentic Taiwanese chinese food! Delivery to hotels! Yay! Popcorn chicken, chow mein, fried rice, stinky tofu, boba

I can't say enough great things about this place. We found it on yelp and decided to give it a try and was blown away. Megan, our waitress, was so attentive with our food and bottomless mimosas. She created such a wonderfully fun and positive vibe. I'm from Sacramento, and I will forever come here and recommend this place to others.

Having the worst experience EVER right now..... I hate when servers e somebody and assume ..... I tip heavy I am nice to all service crew and I'm a blogger.... So this not a good look.... The manager was awesome so far....!!

I used it 3 times over the years. My experience was positive every time. Honest, polite and reliable. Never had any problems with them. (The location may seem a bit dicey, with a dead-end street and an empty lot across but don't worry it is totally o.k.).

Oh My Dear Lord!!!  This place is huge, seriously i was there for 6 days and i did not leave the place, They have shopping, restaurants out the arse and a couple bars on top of that.  The only downside is that its real easy to get lost in there,  don't laugh I'm serious.  For the first couple of days I carried my map everywhere and asked a whole lot of people for directions.  Don't be afraid to ask anyone either for directions because what I found out is that everyone goes through the same thing when they first get there, so they are real helpful and will point you in the right direction.

Love my new baby 2017 Kia Optima.. upgraded from my 2012 Nissan Altima. John Armstrong was amazing, friendly, and so patient. My last experience with my Altima was horrible, found out today that my Altima was in an accident before I bought it in 2013, super pissed about that. I would never go back to @sutherlandnissan_ In Orlando Fl. Friendly Kia really did care about our needs, it wasn't about "Making all the money." In 5 years I will go back to  @friendly.kiafl and purchase another vehicle from John A, thanks to Diane (F&I) for putting up with me being a brat, cuz I was hungry and tired.
Good Korean style chicken ! Not too greasy lots of meat . I like this as a good alternative to the regular fried fast food joints . Home made and full of flavor . I'll be back forsure !

We decided to try something new since we had just moved more central from northeast. I did peep Yelp to check out some reviews and figured it was worth a shot. The food was so bland! I ordered the spinach artichoke dip or whatever it was-HORRIBLE. Also we had two kinds of pizza, both sucked. We are big foodies and we didn't even finish half. Maybe I would consider giving this place a second chance, but honestly it isn't worth the money.

So this place is awesome they are very helpful people. Huge variety of wine for my price range which is not much lol. So I was glad I can get some fancy wine without breaking the bank. I also played my very first lottery card not too long ago and they nicely explained how all the cards worked and everything. I appreciated that. It's the kind of place you can ask for help or advice and get all the answers you need.

I come here a lot because it's quite, it's locally owned, and it's cheaper then any other cafe I've been to. I usually get the latte which is one of the best I've had, and their Salami Turkey sandwich, or their turkey wrap. It's a great place to get work done or study.

Steak meat on sandwich had an eerie texture and was cold. Soda was stale and tasted "off". Wings were odd. They were obviously chicken wings, but had a shape and size not consistent with anything you would find  in a restaurant or a supermarket.  The bartender/cook was a nice guy, though and they had a great south park pinball machine.

Stay away from the food. I'm not so sure I'd feed it to my dog, if I had one.
You want to talk about some good ribs, Al has them. Nice chill vibe in his restaurant. Sides are great. Will be going back very soon. Here's my half rack!!!!

Banh Mi pork and charred pork sandwiches, vermicelli with charred pork or shrimp, Vietnamese style pancake with shrimp and sprouts, fresh spring rolls, and Vietnamese style coffee with condensed milk are my suggestions for food.  I have tried soups and stir fries, but they are only ok.  The fresh spring rolls, vermicelli, pancakes and sandwiches, are really good.  Bring cash, it is a cash only.  I have no idea where there is an ATM close by, so get cash early.

Get the $4 breakfast special. You can get a breakfast sandwich or wrap and a drink with a doughnut all for $4. I'd highly recommend the cream cheese filled doughnut. It has be the greatest doughnut ever.

I like their buffet the best, but they have a good vegetarian selection for dinner as well.   The first time I went was valentines day and it was so crowded. We made a reservation, but still ended up waiting almost an hour. It can also get a little crowded during the weekend buffet.

Cruising is the best and I love Carnival. It truly is the fun ship, there are always activities and the crew always knows how to have fun with you. 
The reason why I gave it 4 stars is because the the crew on this ship was not to the standards of past cruises I have been on. There was a cleaning bucket outside my door everyday, they never delivered my breakfast because they lost my order card and then they charged me for towels even though I returned them.
We did get stuck at sea an extra day and it was lovely. The captain was great with keeping us us out of storms path and gave us a smooth sailing. the cruise director was great with communicating and keeping us all happy and having a good time.

I have been waiting for Fleming's to open for months. A friend and I decided to try them tonight. 

We had an 8 pm reservations and arrived a few minutes early. We were greeted by a friendly host who we engaged in light joking conversation and we were promptly sat. 

Waiter was Neil who introduced himself and took good care of us throughout the meal. 

My friend and I both had the small filets. They were exceptional. Perfectly cooked. Tasty and very tender. 

The onion soup and side mashed potatoes were very good also. 

The reality is being a chain restaurant I had somewhat low expectations going in. That opinion has changed dramatically. 

Now it's not cheap but, I'm a believer in paying for a good meal so, I'm okay with it. 

I will be back soon and I recommend this place highly.
You can't go wrong with Ihop. The food was good, the  restaurant was clean, service is okay, in a prime location.

I love Essene Market! It smells amazing, Most of their grocery offerings seem to be vegan/vegetarian, and there's a good deal of organic produce. I go there for everything from tofu to lipstick, and the occasional fresh juice or frozen treat. 

It's a little more expensive than Whole Foods, but there's nothing like supporting a small Philly business!

I've stayed here three times, it's become my go-to place in Santa Barbara.  I love the neighborhood location, the bed-and-breakfast feel of the place, and that all the rooms are different.  

Downstairs is a little more noisy, and there's no A/C so having the windows open can add to the noise.  The ceiling fans are an added bonus during the warmer months.  The breakfast options have greatly improved from the first time I stayed there five years ago. I like that they have last-minute specials too.  It really does feel like home!

J.B. Dawson is great for a nicer night out than just the usual! I love how there is always someone to help you! I am huge fan of french onion soup and I do no like JB Dawsons at all   because there is no cheese, only sprinkles of cheese its I believe they call it "onion soup" I would recommend trying to go old fashioned! steaks are normally really good! Also maybe more options for desserts!

Love this store- lovely clothes at fair prices. I think the owner and her staff are great. Consistent, helpful, pleasant. And I love the clothes. I just relocated to New Orleans and always would visit on my many trips here. Well, now I live here again, and will be shopping there whenever I can. Try it out - make your own decision. I have purchased many things there, and have been happy. I think its great!

I like the Tijuana Flats chain, and this is a new location close to home for me!

TF is a chain of Mexican Restaurants.  You order at a counter and pay, and then they bring the food to your table.  They also refill drinks for you.  There is a self-service hot sauce bar with lots of choices of varying "hotness."

I always get the tacos, which are very tasty.  Make it a meal and you get beans (black or refried), rice and a drink --- not bad.  The queso and chips are also very good.

If you like this kind of food -- you'll like TF.

This particular location is kind of small compared to others, but is otherwise pretty much like every other one.

First of all....the service was awesome. Second of all, WOWWWWWWWWWW!!! The food was AHH-MAZZZZZZZZING! And I'll def!! Be a repeat customer here! I'm SO excited about this vegan restaurant . My FAVORITE vegan spot HANDS DOWN. Not to mention , no tofu or soy products. I had the stuffed pepper, Mac n cheese, greens, and cauliflower and omg was it delicious(and I'm a harsh food critic too btw). Giving credit where credit is due. BRAAAAAAAVO

One of the decent places in Saint Pete. They are pretty willing to work with vegans to provide vegan offerings. Actual food is just ok, nothing that knocks our socks off. Have been here probably at least 10 times, and each time said to myself that it was too cramped in there. Parking lot is too small.

The food is delicious! However the location isn't ideal. I felt uncomfortable picking my food up. A lot of lingering around  but the food is worth it. My favorite is the Alfredo but it's so rich. I can only eat it once in a while. This is the best place to order soul food!
Such good food options for fast food at a mall. The naan is fresh and the butter chicken is amazing!

My cousin had her wedding here the last weekend in July and the place was great. There is plenty of parking out front, so no need to bring cash for the valet. 

The ceremony took place right before sunset and it was spectacular. The staff efficiently converted the space that held the chairs from the ceremony into the dining area. We had dinner under the stars and although it was a bit chilly, they did provide heat lamps. I conveniently switched place seating so that I was right next to one. Lights were strung throughout the trees which added to the romantic setting. 

The food was OK for a sit down dinner, appetizers were better than expected. The open bar helped keep the party going. The dance floor was indoors and the DJ did a really good job all night.
Came for brunch. I ordered the gulf coast omelette, which is ok. Country potatoes were below average. I'll return to check the lunch menu next time.

I have dined at Desires twice. Excellent oysters. Warning some of the hottest cocktail sauce I have had ever had.Turtle soup is perfect and I love the Sherry on the side so that I can control the mixture. Some other restaurants in the area are very heavy on the sherry. I really enjoy this place but on my second visit I think the waitress had about all the tourist she could handle. We were there for Mardi Gras and she literally threw the bread at us when we asked for it. I felt sorry for her because it was late and you could tell it had been a very busy day. We tipped her huge. I defiantley prefer Desires over Acme. Sit at the shucking bar if you can get a seat.

This review is strictly for the coffee. This stuff is like to crack to me. It is worth every dollar of it's $13 a pound price. For reals.

The shops themselves I can take or leave, the seating is weird and it's weird overall, uncomfortable. But holy shit did you nail that coffee, La Colombe. Don't ever, ever go anywhere.

There are many, MANY reasons that this place is beyond amazing, but here are my top 3...

1.  They still sell milk in glass bottles that you bring back to them when you're empty.

2.  Good god their chocolate milke is the creamiest, thickest, fattiest, most delicious you will ever taste.

3.  They are one of the very few places that sell Cherry Ski.  Oh Cherry Ski, I miss you!

This place is great! Im from chicago and Originally found this place because a friend and I wanted some boba so we came here and it was really yummy! Ended up coming here the following day for pho and it was delicious! Highly recommend. When I'm back in FL, I'll definitely come back.

Let me just say, it is hard to find a good philly sandwich around here and I believe I just found it. If not one of the best philly sandwiches and the French dip is  All tho I have not been in the place personally , the food is amazing,and only takes about the same time as a pizza to arrive here... I usually stay away from hot delivery food specially sandwiches. I don't know how they do it, but my sandwiches are never mushy when they arrive and trust me nothing is worse than a mushy sandwich... The bread is always fresh and soft, the meat is always cooked perfectly. They add just the right about of cheese (philly) and the grilled onions are an amazing touch. I have never had lettuce on a philly till now, but I gotta say, I approve! Curly fries on the side which are cooked perfectly and they give you a lot, with a 16oz drink. All said and done it was only 16$ even. For how much and what you get, I think this is an amazing deal! So if you want a great sandwich and want be lazy like me  I highly suggest trying PJ's SUBS!!!!!
Definitely 1 star, arrived back at hotel feeling bad in my stomach, frozen food. Avoid this place.
We came here for dinner on a weeknight and the experience was delightful! Very friendly staff, casual and comfortable ambience, huge portion sizes, and fantastic food!

We always get great service and great food. I'm always amazed at how good of a value this places seems to be. Tonight was exceptional the bartender was extremely friendly and the chef made us a special desert on the house and it was amazing. I will certainly keep coming back for the great food, great staff, and great selection of craft beers.

Very good food. Had the stone crab special, lobster bisque and steamed clams. Least favorite was the clams, I didn't realize that I hate tarragon. Stone crab was sweet and fresh though had to work to get all that meat out without showering in crab jus. Best was the lobster bisque...not too heavy and not too creamy. Definitely coming back

Great happy hour sushi specials, but not so great sushi.  They seemed a bit disheveled when we arrived around 4 on a Sunday.  They couldn't find the champagne for mimosas, food wasn't entirely fresh tasting and while someone seemed to try a good presentation, there were spills and such on every dish and it was sloppy  The dessert was really good though and it was presented well.  

Siam has  a nice patio and they have done a great job on the renovation of the tired old building that Novak's once inhabited.  I'll have to return at night to check out the club rather than visit for restaurant service.  It looks like it has all of the right bones.

I've been here a couple of times over the last few years but somehow neglected to write a review.  I like ice cream but I love gelato.  I've munched on gelato (chocolate, of course) all over Europe and it just doesn't taste the same here.  That said, this place is among the best I've had on this side of the pond.  

Great location, friendly staff and a good vibe make this the place to kick back and enjoy a chocolate gelato! 

Last night I departed from my chocolate tradition and branched out to experiment with something confusing which tasted great; it was named salted chocolate caramel...or maybe it was salted caramel chocolate?
very professional, good work, excellent towing crew, AAA tower, they are good guys, and do a great job whatever they are doing, go there you'll be pleased

Quality.

I arrived around 1 pm starved after running the Crescent City Classic (even though I stuffed my face at the post race party). I ended up waiting about 10 minutes, which gave me some time to peruse the menu and narrow my list down to 3 options:

-Lump Meat Crab Salad with tomato, mozzarella, pesto vinaigrette and greens. ($14)
-Crab Meat omelete with avocado and brie ($12.50)
-Avocado and brie omelete with cajun crawfish gravy ($12)

I chose the 3rd option and was glad that I did. Since I was dining alone, I was placed at the counter. My server assisted me right away and I had no problems with him. 

I received my food within 10 minutes. A good sized omelet covered with the crawfish gravy. The brie was melted perfectly, the avocado was ripe but not overly so (not mushy) and the gravy had 12-16 good dime sized chunks of crawfish. It was served with a warm biscuit. 

The gravy was spicy and flavorful and worked really well with the eggs, avocado and brie (I was nervous about how seafood and eggs would taste together).

I did not get the juice as I I found $5 for a 12 oz glass to be too pricey for me, even if it is fresh squeezed.

I have only been back for 8 hours but have already recommended this spot to 3 other people. I would definitely come back here as the menu had some great options for breakfast/brunch.

I went to Dave's a while back after my Ford F150 failed emissions; he turned a screw 1/4 of an inch and charged me $40. Not thrilled, but hey - the truck passed. So I take my son's MR2 to him because it's just a little high in CO. He charged me the same $40 to tell me he had no idea what was wrong with the car. It might be this or it could be that and here's how much I will charge for each of them. Useless.....

Excellent experience. 

I had the Woodstock burger. The blend of flavors was something unique that I hadn't had at any other burger places... including the plethora of burger restaurants I patronized in DC over the summer. Almost everything on the menu had some connection back to Tennessee and the beef was from a farm in Franklin! 

The atmosphere was great, the old desks-turned-into-chairs added a nice touch.

This place is amazing! It's NOT fancy, ha! It's literally a truck with a couple tables, but seriously worth it. The hole-in-the-wall feel is comfortable and the staff are suuuuuper nice. The food is authentic and delicious. We had the barbacoa tacos, chorizo quesadilla and horchata. We were very pleased and would definitely come back.

My mom grew up in St. Louis so when we went back to visit the old hometown, a stop at Ted Drewe's was obviously a requirement.

A Dairy Queen Blizzard is like a drippy, watered down, knock off of a Ted Drewe's concrete.  The custard is sweeter and richer than typical ice cream, and all in all it's just the most delicious at Ted Drewe's.

I even bought a keychain to prove my visit to this legendary custard stand.
The tacos here are superb!  And the people who run this place are very sweet. You won't be disappointed!

Really good pizza. We ordered this pizza for delivery today. It is pouring down rain. And I mean thunder, lightening and torrential downpour! They promised delivery in an hour. Even with the terrible weather, delivery came in about 40 minutes, under the promised time. 

The pizza is buy one, get one free. The person on the phone did suggest we order a smaller size if we didn't want as much pizza. However, we went ahead and ordered the large and got two pizzas so we could have leftovers. 

The pizza was the only thing we ordered. I had planned to order breadsticks, but when we got the two pizzas instead of one, I figured we had enough food. The menu is really diverse for a place called Just pizza. They include a menu on the pizza box. Besides pizza, they have lots of sides, sandwiches, wings, potatoes, desserts and hot dogs. 

As for our pizza, I was really impressed. The brick-fired crust has a great flavor. The sauce also has a great flavor that isn't too sweet and isn't to savory...it is just right. They do put a lot of cheese on the pizza...we ordered a sausage pizza and the other pizza was cheese only. Both had a LOT of cheese. I would be careful before you order extra cheese unless you really, really like cheese. Not complaining, it is nice that they are generous. It was easy to pick off to get the amount I wanted and make it perfect for me. :)

I would recommend this place for anyone who loves pizza. Don't go for the regular chain stores, places like this are a rare gem that need our business!

okay so my family and i  stayed here for the rib cook off last week.... when we arrived at 3 they told us our room would'nt be ready until 9... what kind of shit is that exspecially after driving for 5 hours!!! so we sat by the pool until they kicked us out at 8pm.. wtf!! who closes the pool at 8??? so after arguing with the reception we got upgrades to a tuscony tower suite.. the room was awesome but the construction outside sucked!!! i reallly expected more... but the bell boy who got by suitcases was a cutie... we lost our ticket for the vallet and the chich told me i had to pay 5 $ for them to find my car.. wtf??? so this cutie went out and yelled at them and i got the car!! thanx if you ever read this

When asked what my favorite place to eat here in New Orleans, I always pause and ponder. But really, one place always comes to mind immediately... and it's Bacchanal. 

Bacchanal is a triple threat - good atmosphere, good music, and good food. The steak is always a good
choice and the shaved brussel sprouts. Even if you're just stopping by for a snack, a cheese board is a good call. This is a spot that will satisfy both the meat eater and the vegetarian. 

I will say that I've seen this place change quite a bit over the years. Some good changes, some bad. The food situation has improved immensely. And the addition of the bar upstairs means that you can enjoy Bacchanal year round. However the wine selection has gotten pricier and the crowds are huge nowadays. On a decent night, definitely expect a good wait before getting a table outside while the live music is going. 
Still I find myself returning to Bacchanal again and again and being satisfied each time. I live in the neighborhood now which helps too. 

Bacchanal has so much to offer that you're bound to enjoy yourself one way or another. Whether it's the delicious food, or the local live music, or the extensive wine and cheese selection, or just sitting outside with good company on a beautiful New Orleans night in one of the coolest neighborhoods in town, Bacchanal is a treat. 

RIP Bacchus.
The chicken wings are good and everything i had was fresh. I like there bubble tea aswell overall nice spot
We liked it. Took a break from the beach for a mid day lunch.  Staff was great.  Food was good.  We had sandwiches and salads. Will definitely be back to try the pizza.

Amazing food all made in house. Had the teriyaki chicken burger and the flavor was impressive. Also had the watermelon salad which was a surprise menu item in a "burger joint". Everything was really good and had that fresh feel to it. Highly recommend.

I'm a huge fan of Pennhurst, it's in my area and all the kids have been there at least once to check it out. I was also excited when they came out with a public attraction. thinking (finally! i dont have to worry about running from cops!) 

I could go into great detail in my disapointment, but I'll keep it simple. All the locals cherish this place, we really do. It was like a rite of passage as teens in high school to trespass with friends and go on creepy night urban explorations. It was like our little hometown secret. Part of me is sad that Pennhurst is turning into it's own brand, being developed and franchised into something it never was. I personally wish the attraction never opened after I started going to the Halloween attraction. 

First it's kind of sick that they play on the whole mental paitient thing. They market it differently to make the back story deviate from the real deal Pennhurst State School once was. When you're in the Admin Buiding for the Asylum attraction however, the actors are clearly acting as mental paitients. I'm actually really offended by that the more I think of it. Anyway, my personal opinions aside the basics;

Pros:
the setting is real and there is significant history behind it rather then a buliding simply thrown together to make an attraction.
the drive up is creepy! sets the tone
your surroundings are also intriguing
the actors are very theatrical

Cons:
it's really not scary, AT ALL. 
the ghost hunt is a WASTE, dont do it! It's like a building full of other people talking loudly with flashlights everywhere
the tunnels are disgusting, full ofstill water and mud. 
not much to really do as far as concessions 
way OVERPRICED. 
really long waits in the line if you go in October, opening night in September is the best.

I really don't think I'll go again. I see enough of the area as is with my recruiter's office on the property anyway.

This place was lovely and the food was great! Our server was super helpful and very sweet. When she brought out our soup she even served in into 6 individual bowls for us! We were all very impressed. We had popcorn ckn, beef noodle soup, and the kids wanted orange ckn, and sweet and sour pork (which was the only one my husband and I didn't like), oh and basil ckn. It's a most try while in Reno!

Fajitas had barely any peppers.. zingers were room temp. Waitress took 35 mins between stops to the table. Asked if a tv would be able to switch to a diff game and was given the response "well sometimes they will sometimes the won't but I guess I can ask".... 40 mins later after getting fed up clearly went to a bar for sports and still hadn't heard of this was a possibility had to just ask the hostess for a check after calling another bar and receiving an immediate answer on if they'd be showing that game" piss poor service I'll visit their competition going forward.. quality of food wasn't enough to warrant a return trip

Modesto is great! I have never had a bad meal here, or drink. I love the whole tapas concept, and they do a great job with it. Go with a group and order 3 or 4 dishes a person. The sangria is awesome, aswell as the cocktails. Service is always spectacular and the dishes come out quick. Great addition to the hill. I am going to go for happy hour and report back soon!
I came here for the tamales, which are very much tasty. The chicken and jalapeno tamales the meat inside is not dry like others that I have tried.

What a great place.  
Pulled up one of the limited stools (this place is little more than a counter and a closet kitchen) and told them it was my first time.  Out came good size, 3 bite, samples of Gumbo, Jambalaya, Red beans & rice, and Tomato parm soup.  Each was fantastic, full of flavor, and an experience in and of itself. I went for the Jam and the meat lovers mac and cheese.  You'll leave feeling warm, happy, and satisfied inside and out.  Their menu has defintely made my menu wall.

Pros:
- Amazing food and flavors
- Good value
- Friendly service/environment, even when they're barking at each other

Cons:
- 6 stools at a counter

Mind you this added to the overall experience and I'll definitely be back but a weekend kickback it is not; should you value your personal space, consider ordering it to-go and eating it in the car.

Love this new coffee/lunch/drinks place!! Locally owned, which I'm all about, and has yummy drinks, great food, and will be offering wine and beer by the end of the month! The atmosphere is cozy and cute, and the people here are so welcoming and friendly. So glad this place is in the neighborhood now!

There are not many chains that deserve any kind of kudos for their food, but this Romano's is about as close as they come. As is my usual chain policy, I only went there because my mother in law was buying:) 
I had the chicken scaloppini and it exceeded my expectations, not that I have high expectations at a Italian chain restaurant. To their credit, the restaurant was clean and well lit, and we had attentive service. However, if I'm craving Italian and I'm footing the bill, La Strada is my first choice.

My husband and I just registered for Uber and used the service for two short trips today. We were pleasantly surprised.  Immediately upon requesting a ride we were given a time that we would be picked up. Both times were within 5 minutes and we were able to track our drivers progress to our location.  The drivers were professional and friendly and the cars were very clean.  Our rides were short and our fare was under $5 each time.   We will definitely use Uber again!!
Went here with a large group yesterday. Our service was amazing and so are the nachos!!

Stopped by on our way back from the airport.  It is off the beaten path, but well worth it.  The service was awesome.  They kept our drinks and chips and salsa full.  The food was very tasty.  The salsa was also very good.  We will be back.

This place was hands down one of the best diner experiences I've had in a long time. Everything was excellent that we had ordered. Salads were big, appetizer was made perfectly, entrees were cooked with fresh ingredients and tasted phenomenal and our desserts were to die for. Would highly recommend! The only thing I can say is that I hope and pray they are able to keep serving our food that good even if business picks up. Don't change anything !
Really good sno-balls. Super friendly service. Best part it is a drive thru.  Nice way to cool off in this ridiculous heat
The drinks are cheap and the food is tops.  Have some of the mac 'n cheese.

RJ and I attended Love, Lies, and Taxidermy on Feb 17.  What a great production.  We had front row seats and enjoyed the show very much.  There were only 3 actors, and they went on for 90 minutes with no breaks.  I don't know how it is possible to memorize all those lines, they are truly talented.  I really enjoyed the intimate setting, and you can't go wrong with theater in the round.  This was a great little play.

My new favorite local bar & grill. From the outside it looks like a diner but inside it's more of a family-friendly sports bar with great food. 

Cheeseburger was good, but the highlights were actually the sweet potato tots with caramel sauce (OMG delicious) and the house-made chips (also with a great sauce!). My mom ordered the sirloin which I expected would be terrible, but it was actually tender, well-seasoned, and perfectly cooked. Will definitely return!

Service was friendly, not super fast but decent for a busy Friday night.

It's a stellar environment, a fun menu, and friendly service coming together to make a good breakfast place. I love the duck confit hash. Super flavorful and addicting. But everything else I've tried has sorta fallen short. Nothing memorable. Tri tip sandwich didn't have a lot of flavor. Pork belly was kinda bland. The French toast was ok, didn't have enough butter in it I think.

It's pretty good but I'd rather go to Roberts or Bobos most days

Hard not to enjoy yourself with all the excitement popping around you at a casino like The Hard Rock!

What fun.  1st off I must confess I've never been a huge fan of slot machines.  Never understood some of the crazier games, and I usually just end up losing money there.

Table games, however, that's where it's at!  I enjoy Let it Ride - a 5-card stud poker game you play with the house where 10s or better pays out.  Sounds easier than it is - but if you play at a $10 min or less table you can last awhile through a losing streak and bounce back.

They also have a poker room with $1/$2 blind no-limit tables.  I'm personally used to tournament play but this is great if you want to drop in and play without the tournament commitment.

Plenty of food options, no charge for parking (smart - when they changed this briefly I was stunned), and live entertainment.  Wish there wasn't smoking, but hey, it's a casino!

We went on a Monday around 9 am and avoided all lines. There is parking behind the restaurant, the first hour and half is for free. It has a cute little wood and brick style inside. The food came pretty quick, and I liked how you could do a combo meal and substitute their buttermilk pancakes for specialty ones. They had a great variety! We had the chocolate divine, sugar and spice, and the cornmeal pancake. All of it was tasty! The pancakes were smaller, the ham was pretty salty, but overall it was great.

This is a beautiful building and it has a great atmosphere. The food was very tasty and the wait staff was nice. I will definitely be back! It was expensive though. For 4 of us for lunch it came to 160. To be fair, we did have 2 beers each, so not horrible, but still on the pricier side.
Had dinner tonight.  The food and service were both great!  Very nice atmosphere--highly recommend.

I had two breakfasts here and my wife had dinner with the kids last night.  The first breakfast was a spin on eggs Benedict with smothered greens-it was under seasoned and just ok.  My wife said that her steak was ok last night and the pancakes were good this morning.  If not for the fact that this was located in a really cool hotel I doubt that it would see much action-but given that it is it will probably survive.  If given no other choices it is an ok choice.

Fast, friendly and fantastic sausage.  I was skeptical about their "best sausage egg and cheese " claim, but they were right. The sandwich gets 4 & 4.5 stars from my wife & me.  Simple, unpretentious place. We will be back. I am curious about Aunt Millie's eggs.

I love Bare Burger. Whenever I feel like treating myself this place is at the top of the list. The food is great and I love trying something new every time I visit. I also love the staff! They are super sweet and genuine.
Terrible service, nasty attitudes, and manager who doesn't care. If you get the server Felix, expect slow ass service, and you'll only see him about once or twice during your meal.

Excellent meals, service and atmosphere!  What can i say?  From the Owner, Ted, who is as nice and respectful to his customers as any food restaurant owner i have ever met! I love the combination meals including the General Tso's Chicken to the Sweet and Sour Chicken.   My wife's favorites are: Garlic Chicken; Garlic Shrimp and the Beef & Broccoli!   Mmmm Mmmmm good! Come in and enjoy! You won't be dissapointed!

I've only used them once. I was mildly content with the service. The woman wasn't very nice who helped me. The price is really only worth it if you have a coupon. I didn't know you have to have the coupon at the time you drop off. Luckily I was able to pull it up on my phone but I could tell the woman was annoyed with me.

Recently changed management. So happy with new one. They are very attentive, delivered service as the promised. I was frustrated with the previous owner because of communication but sticked with it just because no other cleaners in that area. With the new owner I don't have that problem... so happy they are here !!

I wanted to come to NOLA to listen to some good live jazz. This was the place for it.  It was friendly and casual, and some might call it a dump.  Well, it's a bar.  On Bourbon Street.  The five-piece band was fantastic.  They take donations, and the bar requires patrons to buy one drink per set.  My cocktail was $10.50, but I enjoyed myself, and I look forward to going back!!

Wow! All the positive reviews are spot on. Sabrina's is amazing, we started with the stacked ceviche and is was so good, should have taken a pic, but we dove in too quick. Hub ordered the Torta Mexicano and loved it. My Nacho Cubano was delicious, warm and tasty!! Can't wait to come back to sample some more tasty treats.

I've eaten from here twice - once for al pastor tacos and once for a burrito. I was underwhelmed each time and I don't plan to ever go back. Both the tacos and the burrito were very dry, the meat was minimal and overcooked. 

The staff is friendly and helpful, but the food is just not up to par when there are usually other taco trucks nearby that are far superior, IMHO.
The mushroom tacos and the beer are worth coming for.   Ate and drank at the sister bar and gotta say they are both worth the trip from NJ
Nice place to go for a good meal and friendly service. Menu is decent with plenty of options. And a plus "free parking"

We went early - around 4:45. Not very crowded but it took at least 20 mins for our food to come out. That's ok. We ordered the pad Thai and lettuce wraps. Pad Thai was stellar; lettuce wraps were just ok. I think the prices are a little too high. Love the atmosphere in here, it's warm and there are lots of sweet little plants.
Food was just okay and the price a little high. I think the fish house is better if you're gonna spend the money (they high too).

The restaurant is big with a large patio. They have a lot of egg choices. I got the Greek Frittata  open face omelette with ham,artichoke hearts,roasted tomatoes,asparagus ,mushrooms with basil pesto and havarti dill cheese cooked in a iron skillet oh so good it comes with a side. Fresh fruit or grits or ranch potatoes they are the best. They also have sandwich and salads. The staff very friendly and knows what there doing.

One of my goals for my trip to Philadelphia was to visit Reading Terminal.  The place is filled with great options for food. I was leaning towards the southern food so it was either the fried chicken place (Deliah?) or the Cajun Cafe.  I  have been to New Orleans a couple of times, so I decided to try the Cajun Cafe to see how the food matched up.  The oyster po boy was great.  The oysters were friend nicely, not too greasy.  The mayo, pickles, and tomato were in good balance.  The bread had a nice chewiness to it as well.  I really enjoyed the Po Boy; it brought back some memories of New Orleans (pre-Katrina).  I also had an order of the Jambalaya (just cooked within an hour) and brought it back to the hotel.  There was a nice spiciness which was not overpowering. 
jambalaya

One of my favorite bars on campus, simply for how comfy and defining of my college experience it is. I only regularly come here for Tuesday night quizzo, which is probably why I'm rating it so high since I wouldn't know about the super crowded weekend nights-- not too crowded, but lively at the same time to have a great time with your friends while also being able to hold a conversation. Great late night deals on food (I recommend the onion rings, although you can't go wrong with any other of the fried, greasy, drunk food) and good selection of beers, although I'm not a huge beer person. 

The quizzo questions are just challenging enough to keep you interested and motivated, with great prizes ($60 tab for 1st place, $30 tab for 2nd place, case of beer for 3rd place, and usually something really cool for the last place winner). The announcer is really nice and friendly, and the bartenders are usually college students so they tend to know what kind of service we like.

They have gotten stricter about carding-- implemented a scan machine and also asks for a backup ID.

We came here on a Saturday morning with no expectations, 4 days after it opened. The food was delicious and the casual brunch atmosphere was perfect! Service was OK, but I am sure that it will get better with time. A pitcher of water and a carafe of coffee at the table within two minutes. Free wifi as well... We will be back!

There are not many times that I can say I am totally satisfied with automotive repair facilities. Between the work done and the businesses integrity, many times it's not a great experience.  This includes dealers, chains and privately owned facilities. Northeastern is the exception and I keep coming back even after moving 10 miles away.  They are honest and do the repairs correctly the first time.  They have stayed past closing and gotten my vehicle back to me when promised.  They answer any and all questions and provide accurate estimates.  I tried several facilities near me and some highly recommended but I am driving to K of P to get great work and a fair price.
My favorite place in Philly. Love the crazy chaat and rose lassi. Possibly the nicest owner on the planet. You must eat here.

Saw this had opened and have been meaning to try it based on what all my Midwest friends say.  I only stopped in for a sweet treat and the flavor of the day was turtle. I got a one scoop in a dish and took it home.  It didn't disappoint.  I was told I HAVE to come back and try the butter burgers so that's next on my list :)

Isn't it annoying when you go to an automatic carwash that doesn't get the job done?  Or you go to another and discover that the vacuums suck by not sucking properly?

I work on the westbank, and this is the only carwash I've tried that truly gets a car 100% clean.  There are 2 attendants, one who helps process your transaction and gives you a towel to touch up the car afterwards; and another to spray the front with rain-x before guiding you in, which I think is a nice touch.  The vacuuming area is super clean and the vacuums have very good suction.

At the beginning of April 2015, our group of 8 childhood gal pals embarked on a New Orleans getaway.  After much research, I picked the Hotel Mazarin based on the great reviews on Tripadvisor.  This  hotel certainly did not disappoint!  The rooms were very clean, decent sized, beds & bedding comfy.  I liked the fact that the décor was traditional with a modern twist, still elegant.  Location was perfect!

I would definitely recommend getting a room with the windows not facing the courtyard.  The courtyard echoes with hotel sounds and street sounds.  One of my friend's room faced the courtyard, and she had a hard time sleeping.  Not to mention it just looked kind of motel-ish, and seemed a bit smaller than ours.  They ended up switching to a beautiful 1 bedroom suite, and slept great.  The rest of us had rooms on the 4th floor with windows facing a small street.  Loved our corner room next to the ice machine.  Sometimes we heard an occasional reveler on the street, but hey, it is New Orleans!  Plus it was Easter weekend.  

We started each day with the complimentary breakfast.  The selection was decent.  The staff was wonderful, even offered us freshly made to order eggs!  We also appreciated the complimentary water in our rooms each day, as well as in the workout room.  It was also nice to have the fresh fruit water table in the courtyard.  After a long day of exploring, grabbing a glass was very refreshing and much appreciated.

There was only 1 hiccup.  On 2 days in a row during our stay, one of the rooms was overlooked for housekeeping.  My friends were definitely not happy.  It was rectified after the 2nd time.

What made this hotel stay truly memorable was the staff.  From Janet, the concierge; Larry Henry, the doorman; the front desk staff; the restaurant staff; everyone was wonderful!  During our 4 night stay, we felt like we were treated like longtime friends...so well cared for.  Janet and Larry Henry (there are many Larry's there) especially made us feel extra special!  

I would definitely recommend this hotel.  Thanks Hotel Mazarin for making trip extra special!

Surrey's was just the type of brunch I was looking for on a random Friday off. I didn't want anything too dressy or over-rated. Surrey's is casual, artsy, comfy, and delicious. The high ratings are justified! Their fresh juice of the day when we went was so yummy, and it helped me decide what to get because I'm sort of lost in the juice world. I got the biscuit and sausage gravy, recommended by a co-worker, and this is my one and only reason for 4 stars. The gravy was so peppery (not spicy)! I add pepper to everything, so I enjoy it, but maybe someone was heavy handed that day because it was hard to eat. The Bananas Foster french toast totally made up for it, and I'll be back for sure. Thanks for a great birthday brunch, wonderful people of Surrey's!

Hey there true believers... err, umm... I mean FoOoOod HoOounds!!! Brimstone here to continue singing the praises of an already legendary landmark on Route 66 - Ted Drewes Frozen Custard. Let's face it, if you've ever watched the Food Network, Travel Channel or read ANY books concerning 'eats' while on the road... you've probably heard of this place. Legit - the entire time spent there, we witnessed hordes of fans from all around the country and further! People from near and far revel in the uber-goodness that is frozen custard. Picture ice cream; but better... thicker and tastier. There's a reason that they've been in business for over 80 years and it lies in this tasty treat... Vanilla ONLY! You can enjoy your custard in a 'zillion different ways by adding in whatever else you'd like; but the base has always been and will always be vanilla. 

There were SO many different specialties to choose from, we had to try a whole slue of them - we couldn't merely have just one taste... nuh-uh! The Cardinal Sin Sundae was orgasmic - tart cherries and decadent hot fudge make this specialty a MUST have while at Ted Drewes. I got pretty excited over the Caramel Apple - warm and delish apple pie, topped with custard, almonds and sweet, sweet ooey gooey and chewy caramel. Another favorite was the Strawberry Shortcake - little chunks of amazing shortcake mixed into the custard with strawberries and yummy whipped cream. Apples... check. Strawberries... check. How about something bigger and chocolaty - like the Terramizzou! SooOoo good - the Terremizzou (aptly named after the University of MO), was an incredible blend of chocolates and pistachios. We indulged in a Reeses PB Custard which was a terrific blend of vanilla, chocolate and peanut butter mixed into what they call a concrete - FACT - you can hold one of their concretes over your head without getting as little as a drop on you! I also broke into a S'mores concrete that went above and beyond in flavor behavior. There was just nonstop deliciousness with everything that they threw at us - WIN.

Hands down Hounds... if you are having a hot time in St. Louis and are looking for something to 'cool' you down... I would highly suggest you witness Ted Drewes Frozen Custard for yourself... it's much better eating it than reading it!

Absolutely fantastic experience. We were seated quickly, and server was quick and took our apps order rather quick. Drinks and apps were out fast, and we ordered kids food early. Although the kitchen had an issue with their oven, they were still able to have the kids food out at least at the same time as our meals. Manager came and explained and apologized, comping the kids meals due to the inconvenience, even when we said it was fine. Manager Josh went above and beyond for us, and we definitely will be returning. The food was fantastic. Highly recommend the Burnin' love burger if you like a light spicy kick.

This place is a coffee shop so of course the place is always crowded with anorexic hipsters in overpriced thrifty looking clothes checking emails and Facebook on $1,000 Apple laptops. I can live with that. I can live with the fact that they can't properly park their bikes and mopeds and block half the street. I can live with the fact they run extension cords on the busy floor of the shop. But I can't recommend this place for one reason: the baristas.

Between one who can't properly tamp coffee, resulting in a bitter brew full of ground coffee residue, lacking crema and another who tries to rob you of a shot every time you ask for an odd number of them, this coffee shop just isn't serious about who they hire.

And it's a shame as the place itself is very charming and quiet, prices are reasonable and the food looks great (I didn't taste any of it. Considering the experience I had with their coffee, who knows what they may have overlooked when processing food.)

Making straight espresso really isn't complicated, yet the people at Fair Grinds have failed to deliver so far. Get it together.

Edit as of 10/18/13: it seems they'v hired some baristas who actually know what they're doing so I'm updating my rating.

Visiting out of town, colleague told me I had to check this place out, so glad I did. I fell in love with the jean fit, they are hemming them for me tonight, ready to be picked up tomorrow before I leave town. Bailey was so friendly and helpful! Cannot wait to wear them in!

Absolutely love this restaurant. I sat at the bar and ordered a glass of wine and dinner. The staff was wonderful. High energy and very attentive. I ordered the General Wang with the brown rice. Excellent. Great atmosphere. I will be back with customers. Keep up the great work.
Wonderful variety on the menu, with sensitivity to gluten restrictions.

I go to this place every few months. Now, I've had soondubu (spicy tofu soup) in places in NJ/NY/LA, and Seoul, SK...and this place is on par with Seoul. Nuff said! While the price has gone up since I started going to this place 6 years ago ($6-$10), it's still affordable compared to other places in Philly, NYC, NJ. You get all the bancheon you like, the soup, rice in a stone bowl, and egg, and good service. The decor is also very pleasant. Don't waste your time going to other places for soondubu. This place has the others beaten by a long shot.

The service is diabolical which isn't really surprising as it's located in the Hyatt. I've spent 30 days staying at the Hyatt on business (not my location of choice but rather it's been chosen for me). The poor selection of food is average. If you're into burgers and fries it's probably OK but I burnt out on this place the second night I stayed. 

The first night I was there I asked for an IPA, the bar girl looked confused. I don't consider it a sin to not know what an IPA is but I kind of expect someone behind a bar to know what it is. Anyway, after I described the beer I was after, "a pale, hoppy beer", she told me she knew exactly the thing.. I got a half a pint of blonde wheat beer and half a pint of head. After giving up on the beer I ordered a Glenlivet. $16. I could walk down to Rouses and buy a bottle for $30.

Overall a good meal. The only reason for 3 stars are because I have had much better Chinese take out other places.  This will fill you up and satisfy your cravings but don't expect anything over the top. We had the dumplings,ribs , crab ragooon and pizza roll. Ribs were probly the best choice.

I highly recommend these folks.  They moved my belongings swiftly and professionally.  This was the first time I hired movers and it was worthwhile.

They moved my second floor two bedroom apartment into a Pack Rat Storage unit.  They utilized every inch of space and built perfect box and item walls that were snug enough to prevent my stuff from shifting around when the storage pod was in transit.

Thanks guys!

They made a Cuban Delite much like 'Huevos Ranchero' that was top shelf.  Corn tortillas, mojo pork, rice and black beans, and eggs anyway you like them.  Greek American family owned and operated so you they take pride and love what they do.  The staff and owner were extremely cordial.  This was the first time I was in here.  Must go back with friends!
Good food, fast to go orders. The red beans and rice was great and ton of food! And the crawfish pasta was delicious.

Larry's is a good late night option for dining in. Other than that, there are better places. In that particular area though I'm not sure. My steak was about as good as any other "like" establishment. My gripe with Larry's was the bathroom. It was so bad I was hoping that the people that worked there actually had there own separate bathroom. They have a couple of flat screens in there which is a nice touch and an ATM. It's not a bad spot.

Their cheese pizza was pretty good too.

Disclaimer, I love RL, it's one of my absolute faves, but something has gone awry with this location and sadly its the only one near by. Every time I go here, it's like they're trying to set a new pace for dinner because they serve it so slow that by the time I get my food, I'm no longer hungry. Plus the food never looks like the ads, it always looks like it's been under a hot lamp for hours, which is odd since it took so long to come out. They always seem to put a lot of salt on their food. The servers are never sympathetic. They also rarely give refills unless I ask, this goes for bread and drinks. They're lucky they have that bread, because that's the only reason I come back!

I don't write reviews but noticed this place doesn't have recent ones & should write my experience. 

I gave this place two stars because one was the effort of being greeted as my boyfriend & I walked in. Kudos. 

But when I started talking about what I wanted and where I wanted my tattoo, I instantly got a "oh hell no" vibe.  She basically said no can do and went on how its not gonna fit and blah blah blah but seriously tho, I have seen a similar tattoo like the one I wanted, done on a finger and it was pretty clean. She kept looking at the picture and winged the price from anywhere from 120 to 150. (which I was kinda okay paying for because differences places varies. So, i was gonna get it done.) 

Anyways, so I told her that I would give it more thought to another placement for my tattoo because she obviously didn't like the originally placement idea. I was already skeptical about Golden Eagle, after 10 minutes of deciding, I came up with another placement and told her about it. from the 10 minute pow wow with my boyfriend deciding on placement to her doing her own thing, She looks at the picture a couple more times & talks about the size and measuring the size with her fingers ... and all of a sudden, She blurts out 180. (The fuck? Are you serious?) I was okay with her winging the price the first time but now, She was talking outta her ass. 

I honestly don't know what happened. She gave me the same size of how big I was gonna have it and priced it fair and she came back & sized it the again the same but gave me a ridiculous price. After hearing the 180, we said our goodbyes and am never going back. 

Sorry! I wanted to give this place a chance because I had gotten a piercing from here a couple years back. Outrageous price but it was late and I wanted to repierce my tragus. Cool dude tho ..

We weren't here our first night in town. This place is just ok. The food was just ok. Not much flavor, and I'm sure the étouffée had ketchup in it. We got oysters, and they left a lot to be desired, unfortunately. When we told locals we went here they said it was a tourist trap!

While I really enjoy the ambiance and atmosphere at Joe's Crab Shack, the food is just really over-rated. The last time I was there (and I do mean last), I ordered calimari, and it came out greasy with "parts" in the calimari that didn't belong. Nasty, nasty, nasty. It looked as though they had dumped fish parts in batter, deep fried it, and served it. Still makes me shudder just thinking about it. The rest of the food was merely so-so. For the prices, location, and time it takes to get a table--I really expect some excellent seafood. If they would improve their menu and food quality, this would be my go-to restaurant for large groups and out of town friends. I like the singing waiters and fun atmosphere. But, it's one of those restaurants that relies on its good looks and charm, not its food.

Really surprised this place isn't busier.  I really love the Sofritas bowl.  It feels like home.
When you don't eat meat, having a place like this to go to is great.

Reasonably clean, and the people are super nice.  I wish they were more reliable in their portions.  Some servers give more, and others much less.

Update:  One of the co-owners of Spa Aria read my review and contacted me.  She let me know that protocol whenever a customer expresses concern to any staff member at the spa is to contact her or the other co-owner so that they can try to make it right but that this had not been done when I had expressed concern after my treatment.  She apologized for my experience, especially that my concern had not been passed on to her when it happened, and she offered to refund the cost of the eye treatment add-on and 20% of the body scrub.  I appreciate that she took the time to reach out and make it right.  It restores my belief that this spa really does care about providing a good customer experience.  I still hope that they square their advertised treatment times with what is provided, but appreciate that she took time out to reach out to me and that she was willing to adjust the cost to reflect the treatment times not provided.  

I decided to get two services for my birthday.  I got a 60 minute sugar scrub and a 30 minute express facial with a 20-30 minute eye treatment add- on.  First, the body scrub lasted 45 minutes from start to finish, including the time I was in the shower, despite being advertised as a 60 minute treatment.  I expressed my confusion to the receptionist between appointments and she told me she would look into it.  Then, concerned about what had just happened, I told my next woman who was providing a treatment how I had called ahead and was told that the eye treatment was an additional 20-30 minutes on top of the 30 minute mini facial and I wanted to confirm that.  She said that actually, it was probably only 15-20 minutes on top.  In the end, the 30 minute mini facial plus 20-30 minute add on eye treatment lasted 40 minutes.  So, the add on was neither 20-30 minutes as advertised, nor 15-20 minutes as stated, but only ten.  When I spoke to the receptionist again when it was time for me to check out, she sincerely apologized that my first treatment had only lasted 3/4 of the advertised time, but did not offer to adjust the bill.  This was a truly disappointing service.  They should not advertise that services last longer than they actually do, and it is disappointing that they did not stand behind their service and make any kind of adjustment for services not rendered.  The services themselves were fine- the products didn't seem special and I didn't come out feeling as fresh as I usually do after a facial treatment.  As I write this, I still can't believe I spent $50 on a ten minute eye treatment that consisted of putting one cream on and then holding ice over my eyes.

This review is on the Spa portion... 
I made appoints for my wife and myself to celebrate her birthday. We had a great experience at the spas previous location last year. 
This year was different:
Staff was friendly and we enjoyed our salt scrub treatments however the facilities are not very warm and inviting, The coat check thing was strange to say the least. The acoustics were terrible. my wife and I were in the "relaxation" room before and after our treatments. "Not very relaxing" the door was and you could here all the noise from the salon e.g. hair dryers people taking etc. Plus my wife and I are in there in our robes trying to relax and they put an old lady from the salon who was having her hair done in there for some reason (she was with her aide). She would not Shut up!!  once again acoustics were terrible. In the treatment rooms you could hear constant chatter. Very annoying. They should have stayed at previous location. 
We wanted a step up from Toppers but not the case this time around.

Will not be returning unless things change

I think if I was hosting a show on the Travel Channel, it would be called "Man vs. Food Bill."  After all, I really don't care about how much a meal costs as long as the experience is worth it.  After hitting SLeeK recently for their anniversary party (where a slider version of the Rossini was served), I knew that a visit to the Burger Bar with the beautiful wife was going to happen soon.

Unfortunately, scalability doesn't apply to burgers.  In a case where "more should be more" instead, all those intense flavors we had at SLeeK sort of melted together into a really good, but not anything amazing burger.  The explosiveness of the fois gras was missing, the slices of black truffle almost flavorless.

I will say that the zucchini fries were good, but again, those that we had at SLeeK were much better (I'd rather have four excellent fries than fifteen "good")

Service started off a bit iffy -- we were waiting at the hostess stand while she was on the phone (I swear, at first I thought it was a personal phone call) and we didn't even get a mouthed "one minute" or anything.  Finally, a server came over and seated us.  Kudos to him for that.

The rest of the service was fine -- prompt and friendly.

But even with that, they're not going to get a 3rd star.  When two people manage to have a bill the size we had, we better be walking away raving.  Instead, I couldn't help but think we should have gone back to SLeek.

(and for the record, the wife's burger was far tastier and $40 less than mine)
Great food and Friendly staff. Only space for the improvement us the service (from order to serve).

A quaint old-style southern restaurant.  I had the brownie sundae (sugar coma!) and hubby had a malt.  we got there just at closing.  a lady was playing a piano and came by our table to ask for song requests.   I read that the place used to be a drug store on the ground floor and a hospital on the 2nd floor-built in 1898 (?).  It's got charming atmosphere and the desserts are hand made, not shipped in.

Tiki Bar? Surf rock? Dynamite nachos? Check. Check and Check. While the inside leaves much to be desired by way of atmosphere and comfort their backyard tiki bar is a heavenly escape in the middle of the bustling square!

First time we tried this place,wife was out shopping and saw there sign.
She wanted pizza for supper. Ordered medium supreme with mozzarella sticks. She waited for about 20 minutes was ready to go 
20 minutes till she got home with it we had to warm it up alittle .
All said and done we really enjoyed it.
Next time we'll eat in

Update:. I was here again and excellent food!!! See picture.


Reason price and excellent food!!   Crowded, but worth the wait!!

I couldn't wait for the pics to be taken.   I started eating already! !!   Sorry!!

This was the best service and experience I've even had at a nail salon. This is definitely my new go-to. Tina and Ken are fun and professional and do a fabulous job. My toes and nails look perfect and three days later, not a chip. High quality and beautiful. It started pouring down rain as I was leaving and Ken walked me to my car with an umbrella. That's service! Love it here. I could not recommend it more.

Classic diner with a comfort food vibe. You will find breakfast & lunch choices to suit your mood! Desserts & bakery goods scored in looks but I didn't sample the sweets. That stated, the first time I had visited this place was over 3 years prior with my son. I remember over easy eggs, bacon, home fries, and a pancake that gave me comfort. Being in a healthier state now, I was just as happy with my egg white veggie omelet. The service was quite attentive and pleasant! I have to say that this was a second choice as the first choice was closed and location made it convenient. That says it all. I would come back in a pinch.
Very friendly staff. The manager was attentive and courteous. Excellent food - must try the ox tail!!!

Uh-huhhhh. That is good stuff.  The staff is also really GREAT, and someone has exceedingly good taste in music...other than mi mi mi mi.  
Burgers: consistently delicious
Fries: Zing
Soda: really? Pa Dutch Birch and Cherry soda.
Milkshake: great ingredients, but could use some thickening.  I LOVE vanilla milkshakes
Prices: a little steep
Thank you, that is all.

P.s....a little selective liquor might be a nice addition. Maybe three beers a season or something.

I've been here for over an hour past my appointment and I'm still waiting. I got here early and left another appointment to make sure I'd be on time. I've seen 5 people who got here after me get taken back to be seen. Just asked the front desk girl (blonde, late twenties) if she knew how much longer it would be. She literally giggled and said "they're checking, she's behind." Sounded like a prepared line they give everyone. 

Doesn't matter how good this doctor is, I'm never coming back. This is unacceptable and disrespectful of every patient's time. Would give negative stars if I could.

I rarely take the time to write a yelp review! This place deserves it! I am vegetarian and this vegan pho is the best I've ever had! I went with 2 other friends, we live in NY and haven't found comprable places! The staff is so friendly and even with a full restaurant on a Saturday our food came in less than 15 min. Everything is fresh. Spring rolls and peanut sauce on point! My friends had the steamed pork bun and pork vermicelli bowl and reported deliciousness.
