I've tried the smoked salmon on toast and it was perfectly satisfying with fresh dill and lemon juice which added a good bite of flavor. I love this place!
We tried this new place and it was Awesome!!!!  it just opened ... You need to try it!  We had an amazing breakfast !!!  They also have TVs for sports and great pizza!

Nice, homey atmosphere! Our waiter was extremely polite. We got a table immediately, but that's probably because we came on a Thursday at 11:15ish am. Our food arrived within 10-15 minutes, so that's an average wait time. 
I ordered the berry chocolaty pancakes, and my friend ordered the seasonal special "I can't believe they're vegan pancakes". The berry chocolaty pancakes were very, very good; however, I started feeling a bit sick by the third pancake because of how sweet it all was! They don't skimp on the chocolate sauce and chocolate chips in the pancakes for sure. The vegan pancakes were alright, but my friend had to keep spitting out some of the stringy parts of the pineapple cubes. 
I would definitely come here again, but I wouldn't order the same thing... my blood sugar levels probably spiked! I would order one of the omelettes, which looked pretty good as waiters walked past with them.
Cuenelli's food is great and their prices very afforable! This was my first taste of peruvina  food and will definatly be back! Fresh food and clean(emaculate)location!

Delicious food and the employees are very accommodating.  Excellent customer service.  With a call ahead, they can modify meals for those that must adhere to a gluten free diet.  I highly recommend this restaurant.

This is the only film developer in Philadelphia.

Right, you can get your film developed at Ritz, or CVS, or Target, or wherever, but this is the only place to really get it done.  I took the vast majority of my film (colour print, black and white, and colour slide) here, and the results were always fantastic.  Colour balance seemed correct (the Velvia just jumped out with saturation ... love it!).  Black and white had good contrast.  I usually had my film scanned, as well, and the scans were pretty decent, too.  I always had to play around with the colour on the Velvia scans, but I guess that's to be expected.  Finally, any prints I had done always came out well.

I'm not giving them five stars for two reasons: first, one batch of negatives I had developed had significant scratches on a few of the frames.  While they weren't important frames, it was a little concerning.  The proprietor said that the scratched were their fault, and that they could get it fixed for free.  Nonetheless, it seemed a bit disconcerting.  Second, it's not cheap to get film developed and scanned her.  I can slides developed and scanned in Kansas for significantly less (although, I'm waiting to see how the slides turned out). 

But, if you're in Philadelphia, this is the place to go.

Watch out for credit card fraud. Eat dinner last Thursday nite service was good tipped 20% which is my standard if service is good, they added an additional 5$ to the tip. Over priced ok food! 
Oh and another thing there grey goose is not!! Will never go back!!!

First of all let me say that John Besh is my favorite and so I think all his restaurants are marvelous and perfect. (I'm talking to you Domenica, my precious, tender angel.)

I prefer Luke for those cold/rainy days when you want some warm, heavy, and hearty food. The interior is also very warm and cozy and comforting. It has a golden kind of glow that is quite pleasant (and no, it was not just the wine, I promise!)

I found to be one of those places where everything on the menu is amazing. (Except the escargot. He may even have the best escargot in the world. But no amount of talent or whimsy can make snails look/taste/smell/feel delicious to me).

I love the pate. For an entree, my favorite has to the schnitzel.

We were so excited to try this place - advertised a great menu and live music. When we got there on a Friday night it was dead. There were only 2 other couples in there and the "live" music was a saxophonist playing over recorded music. The Sax was so loud that we couldn't even hear each other. We didn't stay for the food. The bartender was nice and attentive though.

My wife and I eat Saturday morning breakfast at... where else, but at The Breakfast Club.  This out of the way treasure has great food and low prices with friendly and personable waitstaff.  It's motto is "Where it's never to late for breakfast and never too early for lunch."  From Mo, the hostess, to David, the busboy, to the excellent waitstaff of Laura, Kathi, Jenn, Shanna, and more, everyone is geared to make the meal enjoyable.  The atmosphere is 50's diner, with booths of shiny metalflake vinyl and 50's style tables.  All food is of top notch quality.  Coffee is fresh ground just before brewed.  Full compliments of half-half, sweeteners of all varieties (not just the pink stuff and sugar), syrup, ketchup, jellies, are all on the table ready to use.  You will not be disappointed in your meal at this clean and bright lunch/breakfast cafe.

The staff here is SO RUDE!!!!! 
Lady had asked me "what you want?" She wasn't even looking at me so I assumed so wasn't talking to me. Then she looked at me and said it again. There was no thank you not even a smile or nothing. The entire time I was ordering "Shundra" didn't look up at me one time. The only thing she kept saying was "yup, yup,yup"  with an attitude like that you shouldn't be working with the public!!! 
Only giving it 1 star because the food was good.

This is officially the best restaurant in South Philadelphia now and incredibly affordable.  I took my Anglo-Saxon family there and the food was astounding.  The service is very slow, so when you go, do not be in a rush.  The food is made to order and the definition of delectable.  Everything on the menu was amazing.  They go out of their way to create make each order designed to share.  It takes them a lot more time but if you love food, it is worth the wait.  BYOB, cash only.  They should remove the T.V., and play music, those are my only two suggestions.  The prices here will inevitably go up very soon, and still it would be worth it.  Thanks for providing South Philadelphia with high-quality food, we need it.  I felt like I ate food in someone's family kitchen.  Each dish was presented and prepared with a lot of love.

I have eaten here a few times and every time I go back I get the loaded nachos. They are an awesome value. Two people can share the platter and be full. Service is usually fast and friendly. The nachos are usually loaded with toppings but on a few occasions they were very skimpy. I spoke to the manager and he was happy to fix it and add more toppings. I ordered the pulled pork sandwich once and it was a bit dry but the dipping sauce was fantastic. I have also ordered the cheese pizza but it  had an off/funky taste. 
Overall great atmosphere. You can come and sit in the relax bar area or sit in the dinning area for a nice more formal dinner.

Update: This weekend I tried the bruchetta and fiesta chicken salads. My girlfriend and I were very impressed and a bit shocked at how good both of these item were. The waitress was friendly and attentive!

5 Stars for Thai 5. Delicious and hearty dishes  made to accommodate every level of spice. The owner works her butt off and makes sure everyone feels welcome. 

She mentioned that she needs help so if anyone is looking for a place to work, definitely stop in. She seems like she would be a great boss to work for. If not, go in and get some Tom Yum and Beef Basil.

Really quality food, nothing is skimped. We've been 3 times and happy every time. Burger was delicious, fries are perfect, apps were all tasty- we did happy hour mix of crab balls, fried mozz & clams casino. Chicken & waffles was good, but does have heavy amount of cilantro for those that are sensitive. Always pleasant service and we haven't been where it's been crowded. Clean. Definitely becoming one of our places we can trust in DELCO. Kid friendly too.

Wonderful Sunday brunch. Make a reservation for sure. Gulf oysters - the best. Yummy French 75, sausages and unique bread pudding - from a bread pudding snob. Will go back for the charcuterie platter.

My husband had his work party here last weekend, and we had an amazing time! The food was delicious and artfully presented--I loved the fact that there was a vegan entree option--the servers were attentive, and the performers were outstanding! Katie Perman's version of "All about that Bass" was way better than the original.

So I tried Bernie's on opening night.  There were about 10 tables open.  They told me it would be a short wait.  We waited for about 40 minutes.  I asked what was taking so long.  They told me that they were waiting for the kitchen to catch up.  Wow, opening night and they were completely unprepared.  So then I tried again yesterday.  I went at 2:40 PM.  We sat down and were handed a brunch menu.  I told the bartender that I was not interested in the brunch menu and wanted to order off of the regular menu.  I was told that the menu changes at 3:00.  I asked if that was a hard 3:00 since it was only 20 minutes away.  She then told me that I still could not order off the regular menu and they only add pizzas after 3:00 PM.  We got up and left.  I tried twice at this place and both times the service was awful.  How hard it is to add some appetizers from the regular menu.  Or even the popular food items.  Why would you not make that available all the time.

I make acai bowls at home all the time, so I was curious to try their acai "green" bowl just because it sounded interesting and different.  The first bite was a little bit odd but as I kept eating it it got better and better, and by the time I finished the bowl, I was happy and satisfied.

If you've never had acai before I'd say go with the "standard" acai berry bowl, but the other variations of acai bowls are worth trying.  I usually make mine with soy milk because I like the taste and slight creaminess it adds better than the apple juice they use at this place.  I didn't ask this time but I think they would be willing to substitute if you wanted.
Great drinks, consistently good service, laid back atmosphere. The shrimp and grits was excellent.

Just moved to Reno from the Bay Area in California and was so glad I found Tangerine! They were everything I was looking for in an Aveda salon and then some. Not only was I greeted by a friendly reception I was also offered the beverage of my choice: coffee and tea or beer and wine depending on the time (I got the feeling they wouldn't judge a 10:00 am white wine though). Selection of complimentary salty snacks as well.

My stylist Brianna was awesome, a fellow California transplant! I was treated to an aromatherapy and scalp/shoulder massage. This is pretty standard for Aveda but always appreciated but in addition I got a bonus hand/arm massage during shampoo. I bought a purse size version of the Hand Therapy cream she used (Reno is soooo dry) as well as my beloved Smooth Infusion products (medium length, thick, straight hair; wanting to be smooth and glossy.) I had a good bikini wax from Crystal for my trip to Santa Cruz (just in case) and it was friendly and... thorough. What more can you ask from a bikini wax? :)

I really appreciated the thoughtful product recommendations from the lovely gentleman in the front of house who's name I didn't catch but introduced me to an upcoming men's line. ;-) I'll get you next time as I already booked my next appt. as well as my boyfriends. They support the Keep Tahoe Blue campaign too which is a nice touch!

Its a great way to spend a few hours, explore a steamboat and some history of new orleans associated with the river. I'd recommend getting a bloody mary and settling in a nice zone on the boat (away from screaming ill behaved children) and enjoy the boat ride. Listen to the commentary for awhile followed some jazz music and enjoy the breeze .

As far as service, I had an awful experience when just trying to call. I was interrogated about how I was making a reservation. I guess someone was trying to make a reservation at the same time I was calling, on Open Table. They were very rude and hung up the phone stating they had no reservations. This likely will be the ONLY restaurant on Philly top 50 that I will not eat at. Plus, I'm going to now tell 50 friends. Smooth move F & F.

Tried this place out for the first time last night with my girlfriend.  Very happy we made the choice.  Excellent service and outstanding food.  I had a couple different Indian beers and the lamb shank with garlic na'an.  She had the chicken tikka masala.  All main dishes are served with rice.

I have to say, lamb is pretty difficult to do right, but they nailed it.  Best lamb I've had in a very long time.  She was very happy with her meal as well.  The owner spoke to us several times and was a very charming fellow.  His wife is the cook and makes all meals from scratch.  Slightly longer wait than normal, but well worth it.  I highly recommend this restaurant.

I bought their 3 month groupon since the gym is very close to my job and directly on my way home. The signage from the road sucks! I drove right up to the side of the building, I mean directly next to the curb, to see if it was open. 
Pros: 
          convenient from 295
          Good hours, most days 5am to 10 or 11 pm
           Many different types of machines
           
Cons:
            It is tight in there! Like 10 lbs of (!) In a 5lb bag. The machines are so close together it is dangerous. Yesterday I wasn't able to walk down the aisle to the women's locker, I had to step aside so we didn't collide. There is a yoga mat area w balance balls but only 2 people can be there at a time. There is a boss's desk or managers desk right next to the aisle too- right in front of where people work out. I Wil take pics and upload

There is a smoothie bar that is directly across from where people are working out. So while I am red paced and sweating on a elliptical, there are meat heads talking to the young girls up front 

The big stall in the women's bathroom doesn't have a lock. I get changed after work into my gym clothes and I have to use the lock knob  ( that is missing the pin that goes into the door frame) and pinch it together to hold long enough for me to change.

The lighting sucks! It's so fluorescent but dim, really hard to describe. 

Overall if you are looking to be in and out on a treadmill or elliptical you are fine, just suck it up. If you are looking for a great place to work out in diversified ways I would find somewhere else.

There is fit older woman, in comparison to the super young college kids that are there, that is nice. She seems to be invested in the place but other than that I'm not woo'd by retro fitness.

We went close to closing time, and I was worried the buffet would have limited options as sometimes happens with a buffet. That was absolutely not the case. There was plenty and it was all hot, fresh, and delicious. We took our daughter because she had never had Indian food. It was a hit!
The food was phenomenal! Best malai kofta I have ever had.  Service was precise and polite. I didn't want the meal to end and luckily there were large servings so I had leftovers, yum!!

I will recommed this cafe, It is a small family own cafe. Owner and staff are very friendly. Owner came to every table and greeted us with a smile and asked us how are food was.
Excellent food, service, and decor. Kelly greeted us with a smile and seated us right away. Food was good and filling.

This was my first time here, and overall, pretty great! Location is great in downtown Franklin, such a cute area. It's nice to be able to wander in for a casual lunch without breaking the bank.

Food is southern style, pretty casual. Mostly sandwiches and salads.  I got the brisket taco salad and it was tasty. The brisket clearly came with a lot of love and just melted on your mouth. Coworkers I was with had Nashville hot chicken, and pulled pork sandwiches, which also looked tasty.

Service was nice, hospitable, but a little on the slow side.  Overall... I'll likely be back!

Food was delicious and fresh! We had The Patrol combo plate with a fluffy pancake and the Build-a-Hash plate that was so yummy! Can't forget the fresh squeezed orange juice! Definitely a great brunch spot.

I purchased my used 2015 Subaru Forester here in June 2015. It had 3000 miles on it at purchase. In the year and a half I've had it I've put about 30,000 miles on it. I have only had it in for oil changes and inspection but each time I am there I am impressed with the friendliness and service provided by the staff. I was overdue on my inspection and they fit me in the day after I called to schedule. They had warned me on the phone there would be a long wait  as I was squeezed in last minute so I was prepared and brought a book. As expected the wait was long; however, unexpectedly the service manager comped my inspection because they felt it was too long. While at other car dealers in the past I've felt spoken down to because I'm a woman, I've never felt that here. They've never tried to sell me things I didn't need and have even cleaned out my filters during an oil change so I wouldn't need to replace them. I highly recommend this dealer for both sales and service.

Only been a handful of times, but I am in LOVE with this place. Fantastic, REAL Italian food. Authentic Italian atmosphere (crowded and lively). I've been to Rome and Florence, and Portobello is the real deal. You can't get a bad meal. Fantastic, prompt service. I can't believe I live this close to Italy! Go! Enjoy!  (Oh, and bring a nice bottle of wine. No license, and you're better off.)

Entrees thoroughly enjoyed: Mahi mahi with crab meat (more more more), Osso bucco (oh, so 'melt in your mouth'), Eggplant parmesan (Eggcellent!).

Mangia, mangia!  Delizioso!

Lovely tour of the Cemetery #1we were very lucky to have it just be the tour guide and the two of us. The other reservation didn't show up. Use of Groupon voucher was very easy. I'd recommend this company and the guide who joked if we didn't like her to call her Susan in the review and now I can't recall her real name, sorry "not Susan"
We picked up the huge 28 in  pizza for a 4th of july party..huge hit!  Prsetty cheap--$25 bucks.  It tasted good and wasn't too doughy or soggy.

McAlisters is a common chain of delis in the South. Decent sandwiches, fast service.  This location is located In the food court of Harrahs. 

Tonight I had the Chicken Ceasar Wrap ($7.69) which included one side. I opted for the Mac and Cheese. Both the sandwich and the Mac and Cheese were very good. I would recommend this place if your in the area and looking for a quick bite to eat.

It's nothing exceptional but then again it's in a food court right?
Good was good. Forgot our fence bread but they were busy. Service was kind kg crappy AGAIN!

The food was good, but the service was maddening. The owner is very kind and respectful, but it took 25 minutes to get our drinks and ice water. He took alot of time to go over the menu with us and chat before taking our drink order, which is the wrong order to do things. We were all parched and said so...We all just had soda or iced tea, nothing complicated. I asked 3 times for water I never got. There were 4 other tables and they were not busy. The food was good, original, and nicely presented. I'm a stickler for good service and it is as important to me as the food.
Beyond amazing, fish so fresh, iced tea amazing as well!!! Large bowl is a must if hungry. Amazing food and addictive

This place usually has a wait list in the mornings for good reason; it's the best breakfast in town. Large menu, the best staff, and incredibly quick. Don't  let a wait deter you, it's usually just a few minutes and is well worth it. I've eaten here about once a month for years and never been remotely disappointed. So delicious.
My family has used Swat for years. Friendly service, gets the job done right the first time, and is always punctual.

We love this joint!  Especially after dining at nearby restaurants like Deweys pizza, or Momo's Mediterranean cuisine. Even if we eat at home, it's nice to take a walk to Tutti Frutti and have a bite of dessert.

Outdoor seating with stringed lights creates a festive ambience to enjoy dessert. Music is always playing on speakers. Makes a great hangout! 

The frozen yogurt flavors are always changing, so you can help yourself to samples to try as many as you want. 

FAVS:
Tart flavor
Peach flavor 
Berry flavors 

I'd love if they had more no-sugar-added, reduced sugar, or sugar free options.

The inside is so tiny, it gets crowded fast. They really need more room inside, and more flavor options of frozen yogurt on the machines.

Great spot for the vegan or vegetarian. The portions are perfect for lunch, and the prices are more than fair. I had a veggie sandwich on wheat ($6.50). My friend had the flying squirrel - a vegetarian rice and tofu bowl with peanut sauce (around $7). Both we're delicious. 

The inside is adorable - I think it used to be a laundry mat, and someone's house before that. A little chilly though. 

The menu is a little limited. Mostly healthy fare, no greasy diner food here.

We were big fans when they first opened however our last visit was less than impressive.  The server seemed disconnected and bored.  The fish is still good but the paper napkins are a red flag that perhaps even management has lost its way.

Absolutely beyond the 'woohoo! as good as it gets!' 5 Yelp stars!  

Zeppoli blew me away with every course from start to finish!    Hands down - BEST MEAL OF THE YEAR 2016!  

The restaurant itself is small/intimate and no big deal of a decor; however, I loved all of their fresh plants and black & white photos of Italy.  

Bread - two varieties of each (3) with an incredible seasoned olive oil (comes w/ three olives).  

We shared two appetizers - a shrimp and bean one (three large and totally taste galore shrimp!) and an incredible pesto pasta one.  The sauces on each were insanely delcious!  Even the pasta itself was devine & that's my 'area of expertise!'  

I had a hard time choosing from the (small) menu b/c I do not eat (nor have ever tried, nor want to) rabbit, wasn't in the mood for chicken, was still teetering about the branzino and wasn't interested in the other menu items for differing reasons.

I did decide on the 'Fisherman's Stew.'  GREAT choice!!!!  It was absolutely AMAZING.  Clams, mussels, swordfish, shrimp and calamari in a broth that I made sure to get every possible lick of w/ my large spoon!  It also boasted really good cous cous (a touch more would've been nice).  Everything was cooked perfectly.  I cannot say enough about the broth!!   W  O  W  !!!!

Vince had a wonderfully delcious 'slab' of swordfish accompanied by an orange fennel salad (not up my alley) that he enjoyed tremendously.

We finished w/ a fabulously delectible dessert - pistachio and walnut semifreddo.  I have NEVER had a dessert such as this one before.  Every bite was absolutely luscious!  

They even put a sparkler atop for Vince's birthday!

I did not want this night or meal to end!  

I will & would reccommend 'Zeppoli' to everyone, especially those who are looking to impess someone for a special occasion. 

 TO DIE FOR!

Excellent BYOB Indian restaurant. Went for dinner last night with 2 others. We got vegetarian samosas, chicken saag (medium spice) ; shrimp vindaloo (high spice); chicken tikka masala (med spice) along with garlic naan and garlic cheese naan. Easy to get a table on a Saturday night. Very good service. Portions were good, we had a lot of leftovers to take home and were stuffed. I highly recommend this restaurant! 

It can be a little confusing to figure out how to get in the restaurant. The entrance is through unmarked doors to the right of the restaurant, which sort of don't look like they are connected to the restaurant. Hopefully they will move their hours or something into the door. On the left is an Indian market and take out pick-up. 

Eat here!!!!

I'll start with the good news - my stuffed french toast was hot, fresh and quite tasty.

It did, however, come 30 minutes after the rest of our group's food.

First things first.  We came in willing to wait but, after an hour and a half of sitting in the lobby, it turned out that they had skipped our name on the list.  The front staff apoligized and sat us within 15 more minutes.  After 10 more minutes, the waitress came to take our drink orders.  We finally received them 20 minutes after that.  We placed our meal orders, and tried to stop looking at the clock.  When we got our food (mostly), some of the toppings were different, but we were so hungry at this point that everything was devoured.

I'd like to state that very little of this was the waitress' fault.  It seemed as though the entire staff was poorly-trained and confused.  There was an excess of managment roaming the floor, doing very little to help.

I'd chalk this all up to opening issues and head back in a few months when it had calmed down, if it were not for the final straw.  We asked to speak to a manager as we were paying.  As we were commenting our dining experience, we were told, "You're just one guy, your opinion doesn't matter."

I'm not going back to this location.  Even if the french toast was tasty.

I was a walk-in at this salon since I like Aveda products and it is near Yogurt Beach in Sparks.  They were busy (says something about their people).  I had to wait only a short time to have them squeeze me in.  I cannot recall her name, but my lady was young and nice.  She had "HI" on her business card.  So nice and my hair cut was solid - none of the little "post cut" issues where I had to cut stuff myself.  Thank you Shearz.
A beautiful and very busy convention hotel in the heart of Indy.  Great service, ok food, good bar and very clean rooms.

Such a nice, friendly little diner!  I had never had slaw on a burger before though.  Ordered an all American burger, fries and salad. $15.  Enormous amount of food.  $15 for 1 person is a little too much for me to eat there every day but it was quite good.

This place is hidden in corner of a business complex. It's small and quaint. There was one waitress and one cook. Their menu has about 12 breakfast offerings and 12 lunch offerings. I had the Nook Cobb salad, with ranch. On this salad it's avacado, bacon, chicken, olives and big chunks of feta cheese. It also came with a side of garlic sourdough bread. The cook came out and asked how I liked the salad and recommended his lemon garlic vinaigrette on it. I will try that next time as the waitress did not mention this dressing. The service was attentive, the food was served quickly. The cost $11.00 including a 25% tip.
Very good service. They give you a really good foot massage. All the girls there are really friendly. I don't feel like I was being rushed at all. They really make sure you had a good time.
Absolute best brewery in indy if you are looking for that unique craft beer experience. These guys definitely "deviate from the norm" and it shows in the quality of their beers.

After frequenting Fresco Pizzeria for over three years, I consistently put up with the poor customer service, occasional long wait times, and undercooked pizza. Today was the final straw. After not being told the total on my order I was then overcharged for my large pizza. To top it off there was little to no tomato sauce on my pizza and I was left eating essentially cheesy bread. Poor experience

Always get it right. On time. And for less than what I would pay anywhere else. They can handle all the suit and dress pants tapering as well as dress shirts and jeans. Saves so much money to tailor compared to buying totally new items.

I've been coming here for many years now.   Always a 5 star restaurant to me - great food, and attention to detail.   No matter if you get something from the regular menu, tasting menu, etc. its always a treat.    I've learned to like some favorites, but welcome trying new things here!   Will recommend to anyone - and often do!

I checked into several companies online and through the BBB before choosing Highland.  I also had a collegue use Highland two weeks before our move and she was thoroughly satisfied with them.  Chris, Eric, Trevor and Matthew were professional and courteous.  They were careful with our items and ensured they were placed in the rooms we wanted.  I would definitely recommend Highland Moving in Edmonton!

We went here for a friends 50th birthday party on a Saturday night. I don't remember ever being here before however my wife said we had, and for those of you that are married you know it is a good idea to agree with your wife.

We arrived a little early so we decided to grab a couple of appetizers and some drinks while we waited. We ordered oysters and nachos. They also had a happy hour special that went in till 7 p.m. which was buy one get one for limited drink items.

All the servers were very nice, including the folks that greet you when you first walk in. They were friendly, helpful, and delivered our orders timely and accurately. The prices here are not cheap, they are not super expensive, I would categorize them as somewhere in the middle.

Oysters were little on the small side. I'm not sure if that's quality issue or a time of year issue. The nachos were a big portion for an appetizer, and were loaded with lots of good stuff including pork. We seriously enjoyed digging into these nachos. The drinks seemed a little light on the alcohol or maybe just a little heavy on the mixers. We hard margaritas and they were a little sweet for my taste but still okay.

The party we are attending was outside on the patio. The patio is nice and it has ample seating for a decent sized group.  The service out here with a little bit slower but the place was pretty busy so that makes sense. They also had live music which consisted of one man and a guitar. My overall experience at this place was a good one and I would certainly go to this place again if I found myself in the area.

Been here long ago after eating at glendale location.  Lots have changed.  More like a pub now instead of a diner.  Stopped for something cool on a 96 degree day.  We were stupid to order a milkshake from a diner.  First off the temp inside matched the outside.  Our bartender, yes that is the best way to describe her,  delivered our shakes.  Kind of strange looking at someone so old dressed in little shorts and top showing all her tattoos, belly piercing etc...  the shakes were like nestle quick poured over ice cubes and blended.  I know this was not true because I'm rating from the bathroom at home.  Beware,  might be a hot spot for drinking but not a place for kids or shakes. Just saying
The food is very good and the service is great. It is a little pricey, but worth it for the upscale environment.

Great place for happy hour oysters. The gumbo was delicious and they kept the drinks flowing. Service was impeccable and the servers are very polite and friendly. I wish they would expand to other states.

I finally found the best nail salon in town! Natalie is always so flexible and gets me in anytime! Got my nails done yesterday from Vick and she fixed my bad nails I got done in California! Love them and they are so nice and Vick just makes me laugh and she's so fun! Thank you guys!

Finally after passing up here for so long, made my way in. It was my bday and mom's treat; perfect opportunity to check off a new place from my list. This is a local, family run joint, some members I know, most are whom my parents are familiar with. Came in for lunch and there was a buffet, but you could also order from the menu which i was more pleased about. Not that the buffet did not look delicious, just i'm not the one to rave over buffet's, so i glazed over it and after seeing a bunch of heavy stuff in there (fried chicken, macaroni and cheese, red beans and other meats in brown gravy) i decided that breakfast was what i wanted.

I settled on a crabmeat omelet with all the dressings and i must say it was pretty banging. It sure seemed like a five-egg-omelet because that thing was massive. I also got a side of grits and wheat toast. The grits were super good, the consistency was perfect and it needed no salt, pepper or butter. The only thing about the omelet was every now and then i'd get little pieces of crab shell, but it was loaded with a lot of crab meat so i was okay with that.

A lot of times when places have dishes with crab meat in it, it comes out pretty skimp but that definitely was not the issue with mine. It could have also been they might have overheard it was my bday and i got a little extra love, but i doubt it. The staff's interactions with patrons and each other told me everything about this place was genuine.

Nothing i noticed gave me an impression this place lacked in sanitation practices, even considering the buffet. Our waitress was so cool; a real down to Earth southern belle that kept the flow of our lunch a good one. I would certainly come back in here to try more menu items and perhaps give the buffet a try because it did look pretty good, just wasn't in the mood for the food coma it would have put me in. I mean, it was my birthday and  beautiful day, i would have hated to waste it passed out on the couch.

Thanks for the great service and meal, i'll be seeing you all again, soon!
Probably one of the worst cheesecake factories in America. Our waitress was SUPER friendly, but only so much friendliness can accommodate for crap food.

I started with Caleco's on Laclede and continued to follow it. The Owner/Manager is very passionate about this establishment and I greatly applaud Jim. He brings a personal flare to the place you won't find at any other restaurant. I wish him further luck and success on a St. Louis landmark.

YUGGH!  Don't expect much from this place.  I've had the pizza, wings, french fries, onion rings, curly fries, and sandwiches.  I have given it plenty of tries.  It's nasty cafeteria food, which is probably why they are still in business...being that it's next to Reno High.  Maybe there pasta is good, but I highly doubt it!  Such a disappointment and waste of money unless you like stale tasting cafeteria food.

SO good! I was a little skeptical about making the drive out to Southampton, PA (never even heard of it) but wow, totally worth every ounce of gas. When I first got to my destination I almost passed it up because the outside was so inconspicuous and unassuming. It was literally just a white building with windows and their sign. Looking back I think they could totally do well with some outside beautification and possibly add some outdoor patio seating! :)

Anyway, upon entering, the place was actually rather cute inside and packed with people (always a good sign). The crowd was comprised mostly of young and middle aged people - no overly granola-type people or hipsters to be found in this vegetarian spot! Our server was nice and OMG the food was amazing. My friend and I split 2 entrees: the Koagie (or Korean hoagie, for those who are unfamiliar) and the Farmhouse Cubano sandwich. Both were served in really generous portions (neither of us could finish) and a side of greens. We happily ate our meal and talked over what ended up being 2 hours...mean while the restaurant never seemed to have more than one open table at a time; the customers kept on coming. Still, we were never rushed from our seats or made to feel like they needed the space. 

I would definitely return again!

meh. this place isn't bad, but i mean i'm certainly not dying for more. its pretty mediocre indian food. the tandoori chicken was super dry, and lacked that awesome flavor i was looking forward to. also, if you're looking for something spicy, make it clear. We got our food medium, and it had zero spice to it. i also think it costs too much for what it is. i dont really recommend it.

alright i love qdoba but this location is an exception. i just moved to the area and before would frequent the hermitage and west end stores which are delicious. 

the first time i came to the brentwood location they were completely out of ground beef. it was later in the evening (around 8) so i figured the day had just took its toll and it was fine. i ordered chicken instead to go. 

the chicken was tough, dry and impossible to bite through so i ended up throwing my meal away, but again i chalked this up to just a bad experience. 

so tonight i came back. ordered the tacos again. this time they had the beef which i was pleased about. i began paying while the girl finished up my tacos, which were completely wrong. swimming in sour cream which i didn't ask for and no tortilla strips or corn. again no big deal. i walk up to the counter and mention my order was wrong. i even told the girl she could just scrape the sour cream off and i would still enjoy them but her manager insisted on a remake. 

the cashier snatches my plate out of my hand and begins heavily sighing, eye rolling and in general bad attitude. she remakes my tacos and hands them back to me, still sans tortilla strips and corn. i ask for them and she says, "they're already on there," with the most attitude possible as if i didn't watch her remake them and no they weren't. she begrudgingly adds more, and i'm so annoyed i just take my food and leave. 

the beef was cold and i paid for queso i never got. i ordered 4 tacos and they only remade 3 of them. honestly i would rather drive 20 minutes out of my way to not have another garbage experience here.
I wish there was a 3.5. This place was fun and the staff was very friendly, but despite  the name no drinks are included. Any drink is an extra $5. :/

Afton is very professional at what she does! Communication is key with me and she will definitely bring that! Sometimes I felt like I was asking for too much...but she really took the time to meet every need and then some! And trust me...out of all the search, her price was the BEST!! I mean...she found the awesome locations, worked around our schedule, had lots of fun, & I can tell that she only wants her best work out there...so she really takes her time with each shot. Also, like I mentioned before, if she doesn't know of an area to shoot that meets your needs off the top of her head... She'll take the time to find the perfect spot for you! The locations I told her about, were actually the locations she sent me and I went by to check them out. My wife and I were sold lol. Thanks again Afton!! The family photos are great! I'll be calling you again for the next shoot  oh...and I highly recommend her!

It's a mid level seafood joint. I'd say it's a step up from red lobster, but a step down from legitimate seafood. 

The pricing in fair. I got king crap and shrimp, I thought the shrimp was bland. The crab was pretty good. 

Don't order the green beans...they're disgusting. Straight out of a can. 

Id go here again for a night out with some buddies.

Prices aren't clear with so many add on and options. I paid $23 for a wash and to have my SUV (that is an extra fee apparently) washed and vacuumed. I asked for their basic/cheapest wash and for the car to be vacuumed. I took my car to be washed because of it having some grass clippings on it- 90% were still on, but now set on the car. Total waste of money. They charge extra for an SUV, but didn't clean the inside of my back windows nor lift the hatch and dry there or clean the inside of the windows. Also waited for close to 30 minutes because they seem to be understaffed. Really disappointed and won't be back.

Awesome vibe and delicious food to snack on. I'd love to spend an afternoon here reading a whimsical novel or biography while chowing down on sliders and donuts.

I'd like to get a hold of their playlist...

I love verchios and have been a customer for over 15+ years but today I was really dissatisfied with the hoagies. Typically I love the hoagies, amazing price, huge hoagie and great quality! But today I got 2 hoagies for my house and the italian had practically no meat and cheese, very thin hoagie. The quantity is usually better but for The price I cant complain typically. If they are cutting back due to prices, id gladly pay a few extra bucks for a full hoagie! This was pretty pathetic IMO not good at all

Great job. Broke a tooth and did not have insurance. Left a message in the middle of the night and was called promptly the next morning. Was seen within 30 minutes of the phone call. After evaluation and x-rays, a game plan was set and my problem is now on its way to getting better. Without insurance I knew it would not be cheap bit financing was offered to help afford everything.
Terrible pizza and worse customer service. Was totally unhappy with every facet of your business.

We had 3 people in our group. 1 -17 year old 1-49 year old and 1 -81 year old. We all had a great time. First you walk in and in the parking garage and enterance there are 2 statues to look at. They have several nice exhibits. Dinosaur, space, outside, science, Ryan, Ann Frank and Ruby ( I think that was her name ). The exhibits had fun interactive things to do. There are restrooms on each level. The horse ride was good. I do recommend it

I took my mom here for her birthday. My  mom loves the Cheesecake Factory and I was told this is part  of the same franchise. Lord and behold I liked it better. My mom had the shrimp scampi and I had the fried shrimp. It's was absolutely delicious. To top it off the waitress told us there were several desserts that are freshly made and you have to place your order the same time  you place your order for your meal. My mom order the peach cobbler with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. The added a candle for get birthday. The ambiance is perfect. Please go you will enjoy!

This bakery is within walking distance of my house. My daughter and I love to pick out a delicious treat and everything we have tried is amazing. The puff pastry that they make is the flakiest I've ever had and sooo tasty!

I love Ted "Drew's and the staff there is very friendly and nice. However the white people over there seem reserved and afraid to communicate with blacks that are there for the exact same thing. Won't keep me from going but it is a bit uncomfortable for those not use to those type of people on non-color!

Very welcoming staff and owner! The food was piping hot when it came out but it took quite a while to get our food. It also came out one meal at a time. I had a veggie omelet and blueberry waffle, both were mediocre. We waited a long time for refills as well. I think our party of 8 was a little too much for them to handle on a Sunday morning.

This is a good place to have drinks and people watch, enjoy the outdoor patio upstairs..bring out of towners.  But I wouldn't call it a restaurant.  They happen to have food if you're starving, but the best I can say about it is it is edible.
Awesome French toast, wonderful service,  vibe was nice and I love the outside seating...I would definitely return

Second time here. Wasn't thrilled the first time, but had to book last minute this time and figured we'd go with the devil that we know.
Everywhere was booked so we decided to give it another chance. Bad idea.The room was nice (claw foot tub was the main draw). We were let in by some guests who were heading out for the night,and were met by an employee who rudely inquired how we managed to get in,and then scolded us for not ringing the bell. The owner who came shortly after was polite enough to let us know about the fireworks and which restaurants had the best views. We ended up going to Marsha Brown after the suggested places had refused to seat due to rain,and had an awesome dinner. We went back to the inn for a cozy night in and a good rest. When we awoke and headed to breakfast,the owner again gretted us and asked where we went-when we told her she gave us a patronizing look and seemed amazed that we could afford such a place(it's actually pretty reasonable). We later asked our server if we could move our breakfast to the outside,and she happily allowed it. However,once out there, we were completely ignored,despite the couple next to us getting great service. In short,this place is lovely and reasonably priced, but the owners make it uncomfortable. I'd rather give my money to more welcoming people, not coming here again.

Side note-the owner is carl glassman,and many positive reviews and suggestions to come here come from user Carl G. Seems pretty coincidental. If it's him posting these, that's a really awful and inappropriate thing to do...

Usually I just get ice cream from Culvers.  I would not have ordered a fish sandwich but my co-worker was ordering one so I decided too also.  Very impressed with Culver's  North Atlantic fish sandwich. (Topped with their tartar sauce featuring olives, capers and sweet relish, crisp lettuce and Cheddar. ) Served on a toasted hoagie roll. Your order is cooked when you order the item, by my surprise we didn't wait hardly any time.  I might have to stop in and order another one.

Love the guac!!!  Made tableside and to your level of spiciness.  SO good!  salsa is also great and without doubt a great selection of margaritas and tequila.  It's popular for happy hour so can get crowded and busy as well.  My entree (el pastor tacos) was just ok flavor wise and the meat was dry.  But your bill comes with warm churros so after filling up on guac and wrapping it up with a churro, no complaints here.

Lucy's used to be a go-to place for me since I've lived down the street for years now. I hadn't been back since they renovated, so I suggested it for brunch. I was embarrassed to have been the one to suggest it. We were "greeted" by a gaggle of millennial girls, half of whom looked like they had not slept or showered since being out the night before. We ordered chips and queso (hard to mess up, right?) and there was a marble sized, black ball of deep fried crud mixed in with the chips. I ordered the steak and eggs, medium rare. I got a greasy, fatty, thin, well-done steak with completely unseasoned scrambled eggs. I asked for a steak knife and received another regular knife. I would have asked for a manager, but between the hungover, ratty army of 21-23-year-old waitresses, and the bathrooms that hadn't been cleaned since the night before, I didn't think it would make any difference.

We got here just in time for happy hour! Half off appetizers so we ordered some buffalo wings, beer battered french fries, and artichoke dip. Our waitress recommended the fish tacos so I got them. I think all the appetizers were way better than the tacos. They were good, but not the best I've had. Loved the decor inside and it was very spacious. Wished I tried one of their beers but I was with people from work and they didn't drink either.
Food was fresh, service was great! The manager even stopped by to check on us. The salad bar selection is good, lots of fresh fruit too.

Pretty novel, definitely a change of pace from your typical night out of chills and thrills.
$26/person for the paintball zombie shoot a/o this date.
Line was pretty stiff, something like 2 hrs which flew at least given the company (4 of us 30-somethings), but it's a fair barometer of the draw for this attraction.  Ride itself was a bit shorter than I'd like/expected, but you can see they put considerable effort into this venue.

Something like 20 semi-auto paintball guns to each side of the trucks, guessing about 2 trucks total, so the turnover was high, but again, the lines.  There was ample vending and so forth, but I recommend you bring a hot drink.  You may need it.

I have had my hair cut six times at Meister's. I have been cut by each of the four barbers at least once. It doesn't matter which barber cuts your hair, you can feel confident that you will receive a quality cut. If you go during peak times, you may have a short wait... But that's why there is cold beer. You will pay $26, a price well worth the attention to detail the barbers provide.

Certainly the nicest range I have been to. Yes, the store is huge and usually very busy. But I have to say that whenever I spoke to anyone, I had their undivided attention. Every employee I've had contact with has been very courteous. As with all Gun shops, the prices are high right now. I saw very few items that were out of the ballpark given the recent demand.

I've introduced several new family members to the store. Even though they knew little about guns and ammo, they were treated just as well as high-end buyers.

As a member, I shoot a few times a month. The membership is surely worth every penny.

On a side note, because the store is so nice, it seems to attract lots of people who have never even held a weapon. Watching some of these people playing Mel Gibson with their target at 30 yard, or blasting out the ceiling tiles with the silhouette at 5 yards is a bit freaky. Hopefully, they are just renting a gun and getting it out of their system while going home unarmed!

I was able to walk in and get a seat at the oyster bar with no wait. This was after walking by the ridiculous line outside acme (I don't understand why that place is always so packed when there are dozens of good places near by). The oysters were great, and the horseradish really cleared my sinuses out. The crab mac and cheese was okay, but not super flavorful- adding some Crystals hot sauce took care of that though.

Food here is decent, predictable.  My daughter got pancakes, and my son and I got burgers.  I thought we were told I've if the burgers came with a refill on fries, but it was never offered, so maybe I remember that wrong
There was a balloon artist there, and she was creative and talented.
We would come back.

By far, this is one of my favorite places to go for lunch time. The food is wonderful! The service is wonderful! The management staff amazing. I was just overall very pleased with this restaurant and would strongly recommend it to anyone in the downtown area!

I was in town for the Blackhawks game, the bf and I were walking around looking for a place to grab a quick bite. Came in to Blondies for breakfast, we were seated right away! The coffee was fresh and all of our food was so tasty! Couldn't be happier with the amazing services and great eats!

New to the area, I found this convenient location...hair cut was good but services fell way way short. Maybe my expectations are a NY thing...Escorted to chair...had to ask if I could get a shsmpoo...wasn't  asked if I wanted one. Seems like there missing the boat here, on a good revenue source. At the end, my side burns were not squared off with electric trimmers, nor was the back of my upper neck, or ears cleaned up of those hairs that are also to long. I'm old guy with good eyebrows and in NY they ask if I would like them trimmed (and I do...lol). They didn't even brush off my neck off of the loss cuttings with a brush. So I had to spend an itchy afternoon...UGH. These little things take but a moment make a hugh difference and are a reflection on there lack of attention, pride in workmaship and caring. The whole time I was across from the Mgr desk and watched her playing on here computer...WOW...Here's a novel idea...have your system note new customers  and greet and welcome them. Maybe to much to ask the Mgr to work so hard. I'll try Super Cuts next...hope it's better...

Never , never ever would I Stay at The Blake Hotel .... It's nasty , bad customer service. Rooms are dirty . We had a ant's all in our bed and chairs. They promise to refund on day of parking which 44.07 . Which I haven't seen yet on my card ... Yes parking is 40.00 a night plus taxes . Customer is horrible. They have men bring in women off the streets . Not a safe area at all . Let's not forget the noise . Please don't waste your time and money !! Sonya B. My stay was June 15 though the June 17 and regret every day I was there !!!

I have tried many of the places in downtown St Pete so had to try this place. 
The pasta carbonara was not that good and the Cobia was over cooked. 
The Tryst drink was pretty good but 10 minutes to get a drink. They messed up on our order and service was slow. 
This may be a good place to have a drink but I will not be back for food. Probably not even for a drink either Too many other better places than here.

Had a great time at Brick and Mortar. The table had Ox Tail, Short Ribs, Octopus, Tuna Tartare and parmesan fries. Everything was exceptional except we prefer our fries a little firmer. Great menu with unique combinations. We will be back!

We couldn't be more pleased with our wedding photos; they are absolutely gorgeous! Michael traveled to Phoenix for our wedding and we're so glad we chose him. He is very talented but also a really cool guy that is fun to be around- something important since you spend a lot of time with your photographers :) He really helped calm my nerves before the wedding when we were doing photos. Would absolutely recommend!

Service was good and the food was good, but we felt very rushed.  Ordered the Chef tasting and then a drink assuming it would be 10-15 minutes until the first course arrived.  Our drinks arrived and 30 seconds later course one plus wine pairing.  We could not keep up with the wine and food pairing all evening.  Desert arrived and one bite in our check arrived.  When I am spending $115 a person for a tasting menu, I expect better kitchen management and should not have to sprint through the meal.  Our server was lovely and gentleman who seated us was polished and a restaurant vet.  

The food was good, but 5 out of 10 good.  The chef tasting which was recommended was obviously what the kitchen was prepared for.  Hot plates and warm to slightly cool food means advanced preparation and sorbet that has been hanging out in the blast chiller vs scooped to order.  Small, but crucial details.

Maybe this was an off night, but I am sure that when all things are firing properly, the food and experience is outstanding.  Doubt I will go back - hoped for more than good.

So, I chose to eat at Sage today for lunch and I must say that I was not very pleased with their new lunch menu.  While I do appreciate them creating a quicker and cheaper lunch for business workers.... the food quality has been sacrificed.  I ordered the pulled pork sandwich with chips.  I remember their pulled pork being very good, so I felt that was a safe order.  WRONG!  The pulled pork that came out to me might as well have been called "Shredded Flash Fried Pork".  There was not a drop of moistness to this at all.  Very crunchy and dry.  It was served with a side of lettuce/tomato/onion, but that would not have aided the sandwich in any way.  The chips were ok, but lacked proper seasoning.  The person who i was sitting next to ordered a burger.  When it came out it looked like a pre-formed/pre-cooked/re-heated mess.  Not like the burgers I remember and loved.  

I know they only changed their menu a few days ago and maybe they are getting used to things.... but this was just not good.  I would rather pay a few more dollars and wait an extra 15 minutes for good food.

Also, it would be helpful for those patrons who don't know about the change yet to maybe have something on the hostess stand that says "please proceed to the bar to place your order".    

Definitely a miss on your part Sage.... i used to really enjoy coming here.  I felt it was special when I was able to come.  I really am having second thoughts about the restaurant.com gift certificate that I just purchased...  Maybe dinner will be better.

Horrible service. We made a reservation on Yelp and called to confirm our reservation. Upon arrival, we were informed that our table have been given away. The explanation was that they had only 15 minutes per table before they rotated. We asked why they hadn't told us when we called to say we were running late. They flatly replied that it was the policy. We eye 15 minutes late. Birthday ruined!

I love the food here it is pretty damn good for a chain. Service is usually good but the place is always a mess food all over the floors and they just can't seem to keep it clean. Hire another couple of people to keep the place tidy.  This is a popular place for birthdays so be prepared to heAr their birthday song over and over and over and over

Wonderful consistancy among the locations, the food and service is delicious everywhere! I had been to one of their restaurants in Tuscon, AZ and I loved it, so when I saw that Indianapolis had a location, I had to visit. I ordered a bacon avocado omelette with fresh greens and was happy to recieve all fresh ingredients. The flavor combination of the avocado, bacon, tomatoes, and sour cream made this omelette a delicious start to my day. Prices were very reasonable, especially with the 2 sides you recieve in addition to the omelette. Service was very quick and attentive to us, making sure we had everything we needed. Overall, great meal and atmosphere!

Friday night 
Wait was 30 minutes ish
Waited outside with the heaters - not bad but wouldnt do it if it were any colder
Had to get our own drinks from the crowded bar while waiting
Rum and coke - $8 - strong! All rum, little coke, $5 beer - average

----
Long tables, sitting with others - makes for making friends with strangers
Service was nice 
---
Food:
Bison burger with froi gra cabarnet sauce, $13 - delicious!
Best sweet potatoe fries ever
Homemade ketchup - good just not enough offered with the food
Salad of figs cranberry nuts arugala -  my friend cleaned her plate

S'more tiramisu - too heavy to end a meal with

I would honestly have to say that I had a great meal here. I went to a Mexican restaurant and ordered a made to order Big Ass Burger and it was Damn good. 

The prices seemed reasonable and the service was good as well. It's also open many nights until 2 am so it would be great for late night too.

Women waitresses, need to seriously be replaced. I am not sexist, I just don't know their names, so I have to resort to generalizations. But after going through this ordeal, I probably should be.

Before I go on my rant, I'd just like to credit waiters like Kevin and the manager ( bald guy) who were phenomenal because they actually do their jobs and build personal relationships with new customers even when they aren't my servers, and therefore have no incentive for doing so. That is not just customer service, it shows great personal character as well. Because I could do nothing for them as far as tips, but they were still helpful anyway.

However, I seldom get Kevin and I ALWAYS get the increasingly incompetent women waitresses who don't do their jobs correctly and that is what destroyed the whole Han Dynasty experience for me. 

Every time I come in, the place is not that busy at all, so there shouldn't be any excuses for any customer mistreatment. For example I was there the other day, one of only three people in the dining room during lunch, my water was never filled, and I had to get up out of my seat to ask someone else for extra rice because she never came back to see how I was doing. I even had to get back up to ask her ( the white, slinky waitress ) to bring my check. When she gave me my check she didn't come back for 20 minutes. She wasn't even busy, she was counting her tips about 5 tables away from me. Kevin saw this neglect and processed my payment for me. I wanted to tip Kevin. I should have put zero dollars on the tip but I felt guilty.

I actually just started coming here, and I have been buying food for the past couple weeks, both takeout and eat-in. No more. 

The dishes aren't difficult to make; pork belly appetizer, and dry pepper fish can be made at home. I will be going to China Town today to buy my ingredients instead of dealing with the crappy hospitality that the waitresses provide.

Overall, the experience is ZERO Stars.

Food, however, is phenomenal. But when eating in, hospitality prevails over food. And I am not paying for OVERPRICED food from a restaurant that is void of customer service skills, unless of course, you get a male waiter, which is rare.

I've been here a few times before and enjoyed it, but after my last visit, I will not be returning. 

I ordered the basil pesto grilled chicken panini and when it came out, it had no pesto on it. I asked the girl at the counter if I could have a side of it to put on myself, but she did not believe me about it not being there. I opened the sandwhich to show her and she took it back into the kitchen. She brought it back torn apart and told me they were out of pesto so that's why it wasn't on it. Ok, so why didn't you tell me that when I ordered it? My boyfriend ordered the turkey sandwhich and was also disappointed. For some reason, they brought out 1 and a half sandwhiches, maybe to make up for the fact that 1 piece of lettuce had been torn apart and placed on all three halves. Yes, 1 piece torn for all 3 halves. Perplexing.

As far as facilities go, Skyline Medical Center is one of the nicest hospitals in the HCA/Tri-Star family.  The views are amazing from the campus.  I've, unfortunately, had several trips to the ER with friends and family and each time we've been handled quickly, efficiently and politely.

My podiatrist is here, also, and he is amazing.  The professional building is in tip-top shape and there's not a bad parking spot here.  Definitely my hospital of choice in the Nashville area.

Our two girls love it here. Being a product of an excellent public school I was skeptical of Waldorf education, thinking it was too "touchy-feely" and "crunchy granola." Now that I understand the basic philosophy of Waldorf, to let younger children learn from play and, before trying to cram a lot of data into them, help them develop their social skills, sense of community and respect, and connectedness with the natural world into which we've all been born and fit. When this healthy foundation has been established, and their little bodies finally have grown enough to grasp and integrate the data, they're ready to learn how to read and do math, etc. Our girls are not only getting an excellent  education but are growing into the savvy, well-rounded and happy women citizens of the world their caring parents know they'll be. And, let's not forget that successful, high achievers like the chairman of AmEx and a former NASA rocket scientist are products of a Waldorf education.

Knowing this location is new I decided to wait to visit so they could work out the kinks. My husband and I finally were able to visit on Black Friday. We were immediately seated since it was 9 pm. Our service was fantastic. Our waitress suggested a few beers for me to try, my favorite being the Grand Cru.  Our meal was paced correctly and we never waited long for drinks.  We shared an order of potstickers and they were great!  My husband had the Italian vegetable pasta with added blackened chicken and I had the pulled pork sandwich. We both really enjoyed our dinners and the portions are huge!  Food great. Service great. Beer great! 

Now the negative, do not order a Moscow mule here. It's terrible. Not only is it terrible but the bar doesn't stock regular ginger beer. They only have alcoholic ginger beer so you have to pay for your ginger beer ($5) on top of your mule. But if you order more than one you'll have enough ginger beer for a second and they bring you the ginger beer.  I know it's a beer place but they have a liquor bar. They should stock ginger beer. Heck Stoli gives it to bars for free!

Having grown up in Northeast Philly with a mom & pop deli at the corner of my block, I consider my palate quite refined when it comes to Philly-style neighborhood fare. Now... I have lived in the boro for a little over two years now and despite the fact that I live a little less than a quarter mile away from this place, I've never wandered in. 

That's mostly due to the fact that almost every raving recommendation I've gotten for a sandwich shop from boro natives has fallen painfully short of expectations. 

Not to put too fine a point on it, but Bevans will be my go-to from now on. 

The deli case is a carbon copy of the ones you'll find throughout the Northeast parts of the city, and the selection of cold cuts sidesteps the mediocrity of supermarket-style displays by taking the approach Henry Ford took when he rolled out the model T: "The customer may have any color he wishes so long as it is black."

Each product on display has most obviously been expertly selected by the proprietor. And you should thank him for it.

Bodega-style limited inventory is also close at hand for your convenience, but the real evidence that these folks have elevated the deli sandwich to a high art are in the details. 

Order the hoagie special (a sentimental philly traditional offering that includes a small bag of chips and a can of soda) and your sandwich will arrive at the counter in traditional butcher paper... snugly wrapped (without tape) by the hands of a true artist. It's a presentation that subtly hints at the deli's long history of success in the neighborhood having been in business since the late 1950's. 

UNWRAP that butcher paper (on a tailgate or an office desk) and what you'll find inside can only be described as philly deli perfection. Wafer-thin slices of cold cuts are staged according to your preference (ham & cheese, American, Italian, etc.) and placed on top of expertly proportioned layers of lettuce tomato and onion.

Where most local places in this niche try to upsell you on "double meat", Bevans understands the subtle art of keeping hoagie contents in balance... balance that won't have your Amoroso's long roll (I'm guessing) bursting in your hands halfway through the sandwich. They're satisfying without doubling as a post-lunch sedative. 

Five stars doesn't do it justice. And I'm sure you'll agree.

Highly recommended. I was able to reserve a pickup truck online and get it the next day. The woman at the desk told me how long I could keep it without any extra charges. I hadn't anticipated using it for more than 3 hours but it was good to know that I could if something came up. When I went to get the truck, the worker out on the lot showed me what I needed to know, we walked around the vehicle checking for damage (none), and I was off! Returning was quick and easy. Done!

Came here with a group of friends and our kids (all 1 and under), but we managed to get a table pretty quickly!  The food was great, and I'm not even the biggest burger person.  I think my drink was some time of whiskey/tea, and it was really good.  The fries were also really addictive.  Next time I'm hoping to try one of their shakes!

I have heard great things locally about this bakery and have been dying to check it out....alone and without kids FIRST, lol!  Actually, I was on my way to work and decided to stop by. The bakery shop itself is so cute!  I had the pleasure of meeting one of the owners and baker, Eveline (forgive me if I spelled her name wrong) who so graciously gave me a summary of everything offered, as well as some samples!  She has such a sweet personality and hearing her story of how this cute bakery was so beautiful put together was awesome!  She gave me a sample of their signature Rainbow cookie and it was so delicious. I love Italian cookies and that hit the spot!  I settled for a larger cannoli half dipped in chocolate with their chocolate chip filling.  I love how they pipe it into the cannoli in front of you to ensure freshness and to keep the pastry crispy. She also gave me a sample of their other house cream for the cannoli and it was delicious too!  The cream was so light with a hint of cinnamon and not too sweet. That will be my choice next time!  I also ordered a cup of coffee with the cannoli which made this girl happy. I can't wait to come back with my family to enjoy Wesley Chapel's hidden gem. You've gotta check it out as you won't be disappointed!!! P.S. I only gave 4 stars to be fair as I only had 2 of their items, rest assured it will be updated upon my next visit and I won't be surprised if I change it to 5 stars....
First time (Fri 12/14). Excellent! Service. Food. Price. Guillermo and hostess nothing short of perfection. Watched hostess/cashier do EVERYTHING. They should pay her more.

I have been here twice and everything was great both times! Best bar in the city. I went both times with my best friend and the first time, I had a lot of wine, Chardonnay, which was good. Met some cute guys too. The second time, last night, I had a couple of amaretto sours and a couple of glasses of reisling. The prices were a little high, especially for the wine...$8.80 per glass. My friend and I shared vegan pulled pork nachos with no sour cream and no cheese, and I didn't even miss the dairy and meat. (My friend is vegan so I eat vegan when I'm out with her.) We both met a guy we hit it off with too! (Tip: ask for Ritchie's vegan wings...haven't had em yet but they're supposed to be good, coming from the upstairs manager.) Enjoy! :)

I wish there was a "get's the job done" option.  It was serviceable food, good price, subpar service.  I feel like carryout is the way to go.  The inside is beautiful and clean, but service is not great.  I was nearly finished with my hot and sour soup before they brought our drinks, and then only because I asked for them again.  The food was ok, good sized portions, not the most delicious I have had, but tasty.  I love General Tso's and this version was alright but too much ginger flavor for me and not at all spicy. The chicken was all white meat, but very overcooked and some pieces were pretty tough.  But you got a large portion with chicken fried rice for less than $8.  I might get carryout on the way home, but I don't see going back to dine in anytime soon.

What a great experience but you really want to either book your tickets in advance to get a reserved seat or you get in line an hour early to make sure you're one of the first 10 or so or you'll be standing for an hour. Even though we had seats I would do it again if I had to stand...it's that good. You also need to go next door to Pat O'Briens to get a drink and use the restroom as neither are available here.
Huge improvement over Strattons. Sandwiches are as good as anywhere (I like the roasted pork) and great coffee from Blueprint. It's a great looking place as well.
This Italian restaurant has tremendous food we had anti pasta salad and fruitidimarepasta everything was fabulous we all enjoyed it

This vet is wackadoo!  I took my dog there for an ear infection.  Since she has anxiety they politely asked I come back with my dog tranquilized a week later however charging me s $130 for an office visit and hemp oil!  This morning I go back for the visit after giving her the tranquilizer and when I arrived they told me the visit wasn't until the following day even though a confirmation call stated it was today.  The vet said they were too booked to see her and I was left with no other options.  So with my dog doped up I left and took her back to her normal vet.  This place is all about feeling good, eastern meds, hemp oil and probably smoking a little themselves.  The staff up front are disorganized, unapologetic and the office is aged and outdated for technology,  I will never return or recommend this place!  I believe they are not a professional vet office that truly had information on how to care for animals.  The people that give other good reviews might have s screw loose also and want this kind of persons looking after their pets.  When I left I took my dog to her. Penal vet who immediately saw her and is now treating her.  Isn't the most important issue to take care of their health?!  As you can see below the response was that I was a day early for the appointment.  Yes the appointment time was communicated as Thursday but the voice mail message on that Tuesday said I was scheduled for Wednesday and I didn't get my message till after the office had closed.  Yes the office staff was flustered and not very empathetic either.  Again this place is unorganized and didn't really care about my dogs health more than being correct about the appointment.  I think it's telling that they reached out on this review and covered themselves but never followed up with me by phone to apologize.  Again more concerned with my review and the public opinion than serving the customer!

What are these people talking about, they must work for the restaurant. My girlfriend and I ate here today and the food was bland, microwaved, and horrible presentation. Not to mention it was pricey for how horrible it was, $65 for 2 of us. If you want real italian food Arugula is right down the road. Don't waste your time or money. Very disappointing.

We specifically requested Ernie base on a recommendation from a co-worker. This was our first time to New Orleans and we were looking for something to do other than drink, eat, and sweat. Luckily we found something that gave us a break from two out of the three. 

Ernie is the epitome of tour guide. He has the brains and the personality to make a your educational without feeling like you back in 8th grade history waiting for the bell to ring. 

Here are some other tidbits of information that might be helpful for future tour attendees:
- The Cemetery Tour lasted 2 hours 
- We walked around 1 - 1.5 miles total
- There was a half time potty break at the visitor center
- Road booze is permitted (obviously)

Overall, I highly recommend booking a tour with Ernie.

This place has a quite a few tasty vegan options. However, many of the "veggie" dishes are simply vegetarian and not vegan. Although, if you let the server know you are vegan they are very accommodating and can alter the "veggie" dishes to make them vegan. For example, the veggie wings have butter in the sauce, but they will gladly make it without. Overall, this place has good food and a fun atmosphere!

You get your bang for the buck here at Primo's.  I'm just adding this location so other people know about it.

For a place that's a stone's throw from my place, I really like the subs here (we don't say hoagies in nj).  Beware the lunch hours for your sandwich may be delayed because the hospital is right across the street.  Definitely a place to go to fill your stomach full of hoagie-goodness.  And with good portion sizes too ;)
Yum! Searched this out on our way to Philly airport on 95. A platter will definitely feed 2. Pulled pork,  coleslaw & sweet potatoes all good.
Lloyds is simply a beautiful bar with great drinks and food. A great addition to the neighborhood. Please visit and decide for yourself.

Octopus Appetizer is amazing. I am from out of town, and a colleague introduced me to this place. The food is very appetizing and the drinks are very good. A great place to unwind after a day at work. Gets a bit crowded and loud in the evening, but if you are okay with the crowds, you will enjoy this place.

The sushi here is less than fresh (the 3 or 4 times I've eaten here).  It is very expensive for a take-out sushi place.  It also takes very long to get your order.  There is nothing attractive or enjoyable about the atmosphere. Blah!

From the most deliciously brewed coffee to the perfectly prepared  Waffle Slider, this place will now be my number one go-to whenever I am in Clearwater Beach.  Top notch ingredients prepared by people who know what they are doing, served by attentive and competent folks.  This place rocks!

Man..... This ice cream was soooooo good! Milkshakes are MASSIVE. Literally two people can split it and you might still have some left over. Customer service was just okay. my sister waited an hour for her milkshake that they forgot about.
 
They started on it, 10 minutes later we look up and they were fraternizing again instead of making her milkshake that she been waiting for OVER an hour over for. 

We also ordered food. The beyond wings and pizza were BOMB. Pizza was a slight replica of imo's, no lie!!!! Fries were just regular crinkle cut fries. Definitely will be back.

First off... 3 Stars is "good" on my scale. This is a lively place for lunch, happy hour, dinner or late night. It is what it is... A fun bar with TVs for sports watching, seating inside and on the side walk, reasonable priced drinks and food. My experience with the food has been good, not great, not awesome. But the crowd makes for great people watching, I found the service good, they will turn you around quickly if you tell them you're in a hurry. Calibrate your expectations and Lucy's will not disappoint.
Great secret gem! We brought a cooler and made margaritas since it's BYOB. SUPER authentic and great prices! Can't wait to go back!!

If I could give Wishbone ten stars, I would. From the staff to how they interact with customers via social media or in person, to the food; there's a huge reason why I'm there every weekend (because I don't have a social life, but that's a different story for next time).

Service:
I love when I walk in, I'm always greeted with smiling faces. I worked in the food industry since I was 18 to my early twenties, I know a fake, pasted on smile when I see it because their GM's demanded the "best of the best". No. I hate that. It's forced and honestly, it's exhausting having someone check up on you. All. The. Time. 

Yes, my mouth is full, so obviously I'm enjoying the food -- why are you asking me?! So, thank you Wishbone for letting me get my order, go upstairs and be a hermit. 

The staff is young so there's an uplifting energy since it's also on UPenn's campus. 

Atmosphere/Decor:

If I can get the name of their interior decorator, I would give them my first born, no lie. It's GORGEOUS. It's like I walked into an Anthropologie that sells fried chicken! The bathroom is unisex so those who are complaining are such diva's. 

Food: 

My boyfriend always make sure we're there on the weekends and would drag me out of bed just to get more fried chicken, just to eat them in bed happily. He also whines that they don't have his rice krispies treats anymore (whyudodis Wishbone?) -- so he's more in love with the store than he is with me.

The fried chicken is amazing, as well as the mac and cheese. I've never had a cold meal before, everything is always hot and delicious.

..And somehow I end up with two huge chocolate chip cookies in my bag. Not complaining!

Love ya, Wishbone.

Plate is not extremely overpriced, but its certainly not a value by any means. If you're shopping in Suburban Square, and feeling lazy, its not a bad option. However; I wouldn't go out of my way to eat at Plate. 

The service can be unreliable, and the food is a mixed bag. The execution just seems to be off with the seemingly random mix of menu items.
First time going to eat here.. delicious, great customer service, and helpful with telling me the options.  I cant wait to go back with my family.  Truly delicious and fresh!

Preservation Hall is a New Orleans staple. I have heard about it for years and finally was able to experience it for myself! The music was absolutely wonderful. There were 6 band members who played for around an hour and it was definitely a highlight of our Nawlins visit. Our kids went with us so it is a perfect family experience too!

When my mom and dad said this place "Cracker Barrel with a bar," I laughed.  

I understood where they were coming from, but I have a little different take.
