Not too hot, and certainly not a wimpy pepper in that sauce! 

The staff was friendly. The decor was good. And the menu looked great. I can't wait to try the soup!

Oh, and for the PC police: Get over it. Seriously. No need to cry wolf. Considering an Albanian likes Mexican food and respects Mexicans enough to not only honor their cuisine, but to employ at least one Mexican, I'm pretty sure he's not racist. So stop accusing people of racism just because you're so brainwashed that you find offense in a restaurant name! My interpretation of the name was that their tacos are so good they should be illegal - and, hey, with the minimal amount they had leftover to give me, the taco was still damn good! Maybe it should've been illegal that it was that good with so little. 

Welcome to the neighborhood, Illegal Tacos! I now have a perfect option on my way home from work after another 14-hour day. Thank you!

Eggs in salad were so old they were petrified.  Salmon was cooked to leather.  Decor is "meh". Bathroom was dirty.  Got a bowl of the worst bowl of clam chowder I've ever had. Well paid for a bowl but got a cup's worth.

Ummm margaritas and vegetarian wings.  That should cover it.

But really, everything I've ever ordered from here is good.  The service is great, too!  You're missing out if you don't get some huevos rancheros and a bloody mary for brunch.

I don't think I've ever waited more than 5 minutes for a table.  If I do have to wait, there's always some sort of seating available at the bar.  

If you want consistently good food, an awesome outdoor seating area, and some great people watching (more like hipster watching- you'll never see so many fixed gears and  mustaches pass by/around you in one meal).  This is my go to I want a good meal and some booze that isn't going to cost me a million $$$$.
It was delicious.  Going back today. The chicken is rhe best. The frozen daiquiri was delicious!!!!!

What can I say?  I just love Target.  This is the closest one to our house, so we venture here quite often.  Usually at least twice a week.  Now that they have an expanded grocery section, we go even more.  They have all the staple items we need and more.  They also have all the household cleaners/items, hygiene products, and over-the-counter medications that we use, at great prices.  There are some departments where their selection isn't the best, like certain bathroom and kitchen items, but overall, they can often be our "one stop shop".

This particular Target is always clean.  The staff is always very friendly and helpful.  The store is laid out in a way that is easy enough for me to navigate.  My only gripe is that they sometimes don't have enough registers opened, but when the lines are getting out of hand, they are generally quick to remedy that.

In summary:  I love Target, even though they take more money from me than I ever plan on spending because I always find more items I need!  I don't mind, though.

Came here the other day for the first time since it's right down the street. I had some questions regarding the selection and I could tell it kinda bothered the barista working. I'm sorry I'm so picky. But overall she wasn't rude or anything and my smoothie was really good and reasonably priced considering the quality of the products that they use. I don't mind paying more for local and organic products.

Can you say Amazing!! And how many languages can you say it in? I was extremely happy with everything from the service, to the cold brew (best ever), to the sliders, to the waffle fries, to the last but for sure not least the donuts! Yes, I tried everything! The cold brew coffee is perfection! Honestly of all the cold brew or other ice coffee I have had in the past, nothing comes close! The cold brew at District is full bodied & out of this world!!!! Order it!!  I enjoyed the burger slider, the chicken slider, and the Bulgogi slider. (Bulgogi = Korean BBQ beef tenderloin, Asian pear-rhubarb slaw, Kim chi mayo). The sliders were all perfectly crafted! I would suggest to everyone don't mess with the sliders. Meaning, order them how they are presented in the menu because they are well thought out. The fries were great just add salt and pepper or try with the cheese sauce. I did salt and pepper today. For the grand finale, donuts! The brown butter pistachio donut is wonderful! It's light and flavorful, and the best donut I've ever eaten!
I've eaten my fair share over the years. 
I will be recommending District to everyone I come across from now on, and I'll be back for more!!!

Extra note: District has off the street parking. It's easy to miss because the sign is covered up, but it's there. Parking lots are rare on Magazine street, and the meter maids are no joke here.

It's Easter Sunday. The Pancake Pantry had a long, wrap around line so we decided to give this place a try. We were seated right away. There seemed to be a steady flow of food coming out. However, we didn't get our food until 40 minutes later. The waitress apologized for the delay. One of our plates was not hot. We ordered the Grand omelette and biscuits and gravy with side of eggs. The grand was not so grand in flavor.  I was disappointed. The side of eggs was burnt and the biscuits and gravy was cool (not hot) with good flavor but spicy (either not indicated on menu or we missed it). 

Going to the bathroom was a challenge.  The walkway between the front door and bar area was a high traffic area as it was the only way to go from kitchen to the seating area by the open windows and outdoor seating. 

Maybe on any other day, with a different menu item would result in a 3 star rating but not today. The customer service was decent but nothing remarkable to mention.

It was okay.  I purchased enchiladas and my son purchased a quesadilla.  He had to go inside because the quesadilla wasn't put in the bag.  The horchata was just mediocre.  It's nice to have authentic Mexican through a drive thru.  The prices and serving sizes were adequate but i think there are better options in the area.

The people who work at Ulta in Exton, PA are a disgrace.  I am going to complaint with the BBB about the 'services' performed by the employees there. 
 I have had various unprofessional, dishonest, rude, services, but the last one, hair color, cut, and style, was a complete disaster: wrong color, uneven cut, and my hair was not rinse properly.  
During the same hair visit, I've also returned an item, but unfortunately I had the wrong receipt.  The salesperson started arguing with me and accused me of packing the item!!!!  I was outraged and I asked her if she was accusing me of such thing.  Promptly, she retried the accusation.  She continued looking for the transaction on the register and keeps saying that that was no transaction for that product.  I replied saying that was impossible and, at that point, she said that probably the product was not scanned by another cashier; again I said that that was impossible.  Therefore, I left, went home, and look for the correct receipt.  The same cashier did the refund, but never apologized for the accusations and for her rudeness.
First service, was about a facial microdermaabrasion for which I was charged full price when, instead, something else was done, which costs less than the $ 85 I was charged and the service, from this dishonest lady, was for only 35 minutes versus the 80.  I complained with Brian, the manager, and I got the complete refund.  
Now, I am demanding my money back for the disastrous hair cut/color/style.

I've always been curious about this place because I've seen photos of their dessert cases.  I went with my mother in law and my 7 month old daughter for a late lunch.  When we pulled up, we weren't even sure that it was open as it looked quite desolate, but that could have had to do with the time of day.  As we approached the building, I saw a broken beer bottle near the door and the cigarette catcher looked as if it had been on fire at some point.  When we walked inside, it felt as if they didn't have air conditioning.  It wasn't unbearable but it definitely wasn't ideal.  The service is what you expect from a diner type restaurant.  The salad bar intrigued me, as I'm a sucker for a salad bar, but due to the temperature in the building, I thought it would be a good idea to steer clear of that.  I ordered a breakfast skillet meal as the menu stated that they served breakfast all day.  The potatoes were definitely reheated and hard as rocks.  I had to ask for ketchup and hot sauce to make the dish edible.  The high chair that they brought for my daughter was literally falling apart and I eventually just held her in my lap as I ate since I didn't want to risk it falling apart under her wiggly body.  When I went home I told my husband that we will not be visiting there again, because it was just a depressing experience all around.  I agree with a previous reviewer they need a total overhaul... this place was probably once good but it seems that it's fallen by the wayside with other dining options in the area.
Fantastic linguini with mussels! Good amount of food and the wine selection is phenomenal.

I ate here with my partner and our nephew for under 40.00 bucks......that never happens.  All three of us left full and satisfied.  We all enjoyed everything we ordered and would have given the place five starts if not for the run down area inside.  It won't take much to fix the roof and throw a coat of paint. This is south tampa after all.

First time here and it is the definition of four out of five stars. The place was empty except for the employees (given the time of the day, 2pm, this was expected).They had a lot of pizza options, size and ingredients, the employees were extremely friendly. We ordered and it only took 15 minutes to cook our pizza. It was super hot, but after it cooled down the pizza was pretty good. We got the 10" Porky the Pie. Everything was awesome but it wasn't outstanding, not a place I would go out of my way to eat at, but there were no complaints at all about the experience.

I have been going to this nail salon for over a year. In between this salon I had visited others, but this is the spot to come back. Went to get my nails done yesterday and it was the best experience I ever had ! 

There are many nail colors to choose from with brands such as OPI and Essie. Paying $10 for a manicure that includes back massages and hand waxing is definitely worth it !

This place just opened, so I thought I'd give it a try. It used to be On The Border, and they did a decent job renovating. I sat at the bar, where I noticed about 20 beers on tap.

Menu was limited but varied. I ordered a prime rib sandwich with salad instead of fries. The salad was $2.00 extra as a substitute for the fries. I should've stuck with the fries. The sandwich and salad arrived with good presentation, but I noticed there wasn't much meat. There was a piece of bread under the salad to give it the illusion that it was bigger. 

Everything tasted very good. A wonderful blend of flavors, but the serving sizes were too small for the prices, including the beer.

Service was fair, but it's new, so give them some time for to get on their feet.

I'm not going to say I won't give it another try at a later date, but I will go knowing that the prices are too high for the serving size and a minimally renovated Mexican restaurant.
Great place to catch old' style New Orleans.  Food wasn't memorable, but great for brunch and a stroll in the park afterwards.
How can anyone not love this place? Wine, food, music, and a very relaxed setting. All at reasonable prices, too.

I visited Kien Giang for the first time today which is backwards as this is one of older Vietnamese restaurants in Nashville and the last one I could find that I haven't been to.  The first thing I noticed is the prices were more moderately priced than everywhere else.  You could get a beef and carrot sandwich on French bread for three bucks and change.  I went with the specialty seafood phó.  It was definitely not Americanized in any way.  There was a plethora of different fish slices, beef, shrimp, and even some gelatinous substance I had no idea what it was.  I consider myself adventurous, but even that part was above my threshold.  There was also some crab meat which I think was imitation.  I got the meal via takeout,  overall I enjoyed the soup.  I'll be back to try out the sandwiches.

Been here twice.  Both times wings were great and came fast.  Steak fries are very good.  Could be a little cheaper but tolerable.  Friendly wait staff and management. Manager took great care of us.

It is a good place, but I like the Clearwater one a little  better, except for...Paula.

On a side note: Paula is a godddess.  She is absolutely beautiful and should be a model.

Came with friends here for a wonderful evening! The service was impeccable! I got the agnolotti, which was phenomenal. Try out their signature cocktail list! I had the 8th ward and Better Than Ever drinks and they were awesome. Definitely a must in uptown New Orleans!!!!!

Gonna bust out a cliche and say Tavern is a lot of style without much sustenance. Not a horrid place, mind you. Just not a place I'd actually choose to hang. Silly me, I forgot my LBD to hang out on a patio on a random Wednesday night across the street from a gruesome looking construction site (not their fault). Seriously - even though Tavern is going for a manly man scene there were hordes of cute ladies dressed to the nines (obvs not *this* cute lady) sitting amongst the concrete, dark wood and large chains (!?!?) decor. 

Huh, now that I think about it I guess hordes of pretty ladies do draw men, so ignore that last statement ;D

I personally, didn't eat anything but the food looked alright. I'm not joking when I say there was a $9 bologna sammie on the menu. The catfish and the salmon are also the same cool $15. I was with a larger group that ordered a variety of food. The fish taco was literally a huge fish stick on a tortilla. Weird. Okay, fine I am paying for the honor to look hip. I get it, but I'll stick to your 2-4-1 Wednesday night drink specials. 

I had the 'Tavern Collins' ($7.50) - once again even the drink was style without sustenance. It was very pretty - served with an old school lemon twist, but it was sorely lacking booze. Half priced = half the alcohol maybe? 

Our server was pretty much 3 star as well, she seemed to have a hustle (it was 2-4-1 night after all) and claimed to have a perfect memory, but tell that to my boys who were quite annoyed at forgotten beer orders. I'll let it slide, my service was good enough and she did seem wicked busy!

Either way - if one of my friends recommended we go to Tavern I'd be alright with it, I'll just remember my LBD and stick to a beer special next time!
I grew up in Mooresville. Grays has wonderful homestyle cooking. The food can be a little too salty sometimes, but overall it's very good!
Go to the second floor bar over looking the river - the service with Rickey is fantastic - the oysters are amazing and the happy hour is worth the time

I was there on a week day and considering the $15/person price....it was pretty good. I appreciated the wide selection of Italian, American, Chinese and salad bar choices.

But the desert bar......that maybe be the only reason I go back. They had 6-7 choices of super delicious ice cream. My mint and oreo ice cream mix was perfection. Plus lots of other little cakes, pies and what not.

Just returned from a visit to Tucson and had a delightful dinner at BK Tacos. The Carne Asada tacos were excellent. The meat well prepared with a great selection of toppings available. Service was excellent as well. I would highly recommend a visit if you are in the area.

Got spring rolls and their shrimp fried rice since we were skeptical of getting pho at a place where the people did not know how to speak vietnamese. Spring rolls were alright, definitely not the best I've ever had but they were decent although a little plain tasting if you didn't douse it with sauce. Whatever, the thing that was really bad was the fried rice! First of all, it was all orange... And tasted like I don't know did they use ketchup or some tomato sauce to make it? The rice itself wasn't even good. The shrimp were orange too and gross. It was super greasy too. Not appetizing at all. It was shared between three girls and we didn't even make a dent in it. Van D lost her appetite and didn't even want to try it... Have we been too spoiled by the Vietnamese food we have available in the San Gabriel Valley and Westminster/Garden Grove area?! I dont know, either way it didn't taste good.

My husband and I each got a shrimp po' boy. He got his with fries and I got mine with a side of mac 'n' cheese. 

We both loved the bread which was crusty enough on the outside and chewy on the inside. The shrimp were fried perfectly and the pickles were a good touch. The mac 'n' cheese was different. Long mac 'n' cheese is how I describe the noodles. It was not the best, but it was good and the different noodles were fun. 

We both forgot how generous portions are down here, so we were full at only half the po' boy. The funny thing is, we liked it so much that we kept on eating. We still didn't finish, but we didn't want any of that deliciousness to be wasted. 

The service was friendly and attentive. The candy store is connected and it's tiny. The service there was also friendly, even though I didn't buy any pralines. This place is definitely worth the trip. My only regret is that I couldn't eat more and try more items.

Amazing little gem. Had the chicken salad Sammie combo and oh my goodness! I'll be a frequent customer here. It's adorable, quaint, great food, and music makes for a nice place to sit, people watch and eat a great sandwich! Go now, thank me later! :)

Worked with Anthony on a used car.  He did a great job of not continuously trying to close the sale and or be all over me looking at the car. 
 We ended up making a deal with them and it was a pleasant experience. Took longer than expected, but I get my oil changed there too and that takes longer than expected too.
This place is near the VA. Good real Mexican food ! I enjoy taking some home. We've tried eating there but it sometimes is just too hot in the morning.

My husband needed a haircut and he walked in this place while I was shopping in the same complex. There was only one customer before him but he still waited for over 50 min.

When it was his turn, somebody walked in and since the person was the regular customer I'm guessing, the owner just took him in instead of my husband.  That's when my husband walked out saying it was a bullshit  and decided to go to Supercuts next door and he was done in 15 min, and the hair came out nice.  Do yourself favor, just go to the Supercuts next door.  You will get a good hair cut and you barely have to wait.

And to the person who thinks he just walked in and didn't let the barber know, he did let him know he wanted a haircut and waited.

The steak looked microwaved and tasted like I ran over it with my car... However I think they have the best staff that's polite and attentive.  They even hold back their laughter when you scoop the secret meat into your taco shell... If you don't mind convenience store food then it's a great place to eat. Two stars for the polite staff! Way over priced for what you get as far as food quality.

I'm a big fan of 30th street.  Let me count the ways:

It's easily accessible, by car or train.  Cabbies actually know how to get there (huge win)

It's very nicely sized.  People aren't standing all over you like some other major stations.

Variety of food options: You can come early and grab your pre train meal.  Even a halfway decent bar for beers.

Food trucks: The porch is where it's at.

It's clean.  The bathrooms are bathrooms and are probably the least cleanly, but still, it's not bad.

I like what they got goin on.
We went to four wineries and we got a free wine bottle at the end and wine glasses. Can't be mad at that! Our tour guide was super knowledgable too and had great sarcastic humor.

Called up the best computer repair shop because my hard drive didn't come with any screws. Not only did he have the right equipment but gave me the screws for free and was super nice! Definitely coming back for any and all computer problems!!

Their sausage local gringo tacos are to die for. Also they have great service and in multiple occasions have offered me a small something to try. I was just in there last week and they gave me a free nut and fruit shake thing. I didn't catch the name but it was great. Definitely a must try if your in the area.
Amazing food and service! The white fish was great. They have fun cocktails which was a great treat.

We went in thinking it would just be a small place with some take out.  But, what we found was a large, actual real Chinatown style restaurant in Delco.  It's so much fun in there; I really enjoy the decor.   Traditional American Chinese menu set-up with the Plan A, B, C that you remember from childhood.  We've tried several dishes and all are yummy.  Best wonton soup around.

They Know How to Keep their Customers HAPPY AND LOYAL. We ordered Our Usual. We LOVE THEIR CLASSIC COMBO.You Can Order To Your Specific Preference. I ask for no Onions. They do NOT MIND:-) I Have to Do Gluten Free.When it Comes To Italian Food it's not easy.But,I have Become Very Good at Working this Out.They have(Vegan)Lactose Free Cheese. It is Creamy and Verrry Satisfying.And I have a good Palate,Guys c(-:  I've been Cooking for a lonng time.Gourmet Pizza is located behind the CVS That is Located on Swann and Howard.If ur Not Familiar w/the Area Paneras is there,Chipotles and Kotos Sushi.Honestly, this PLACE IS A GEM.About a month ago for some odd Reason. We Called Our usual Order.And We Were told.It Would take About 45min. Well... TIC,TOC.. 1 hr went by Ok.Anything Can Happen.Called and Checked.Not a Good Reply at the Other Side.After More Tic...TOC of The Clock.I just Reheated Something Frozen.Order Showed Up.They Did Apologize.Refused the Order.Next Day I Called and Spoke to Mike.WELLL!!! What a Pleasant Surprise.Not Only was He Sincerely Apologetic.But,he Informed that he was Aware of the Incident.He Offered to Send the Original Order annd Compt the Order.He Honored The Entire Order.I Told him that was Not Necessary.And he Would Not Accept. My Refusal.In my Opinion, This Is Called Integrity, They Absolutely Have my Loyalty As A Customer For their LIFE TIME OR THEIRS.:-) Which EVER COMES FIRST. FAMILY OWNED AND OPERATED.And YES YOU GET WHAT YOU PAY 4.With Gourmet Pizza.I am Glad to Pay the Tad above Average. Mike,Shaun(?Sp)and Paul will take Good Care of You.So mangiare:-)

Great brew selection, food could be better. Had a few and we all were pleasantly surprised to pay $3-5 per drink outside of happy hour. We will be back and probably order the food a few drinks in so it satisfies instead of disappoints.

We had the best experience at Muriel's.  My husband had the pecan crusted drum and I had the barbque shrimp.  I highly recommend either.  Our waitress was very attentive and gave us excellent recommendations on appetizers and dessert.  We spent a week in New Orleans and this was the best meal we had!
I absolutely love this place! Their wraps and salads are so good! I've never had anything I didn't like here. It's a very hip place to hang out. The service is always great.

I really don't like Il Posto. I rate this on the basis of several breakfasts. 

I find their breakfast menu uninspired and lazy, and their service matches their menu. My final straw was this morning when I arrived with a group of eight as the restaurant opened. There was one person behind the bar, and he was clearly not interested in being there or providing even adequate customer service. He looked hungover as he reached into the cookie jar to grab one for himself. I asked for a hard boiled egg in addition to my bagel. He looked at the basket (do they leave their eggs out overnight?!) and said they were out. I suppose as part of their lazy personna, they cannot exert the energy to actually boil more eggs. In the morning. For breakfast. He was very slow to take the group's orders at the counter. He then slowly prepared the food (again, we're talking uninspired food--bagels and yogurt) but did not bother to tell us when he was done. So, we waited and waited. We were at a large table around the corner and were trying to be patient. The food, when we noticed it was ready, was fine. Then, someone at the table did not get served yogurt and granola that he had  ordered. He and I went up, and the employee said that he had written down three orders of the yogurt and had made three. He continued to insist on this point and felt no responsibility to make the situation right despite the fact that his customer had paid for it.

I have never wanted to reach into a tip jar and remove my tip after a meal, but I really wanted to this time.

It's really sad that I have to leave a bad review because the decor is cute and the front two baristas were nice. However if I'm being honest their coffee and specialty drinks are mediocre at best :/. (And too expensive for what it is)

Also the lady who I assume to be the boss (bigger lady with dark hair) and one of the workers (an Asian girl) kept leaving the back door open near where we were sitting on a cold day despite us having shut the door after they left it open the first time. I understand leaving the door open for minute to carry things in and out, but they left the door open for a while just talking while the customers inside got cold. We promptly left afterwards. 

If you want good coffee and good service, I recommend tradestone which is just a few blocks down. My friend and I wanted to try something new today, but feine just does not compare...in the slightest. There are way better coffee shops with nicer staff close by.

When I'm having haircut cause it's wet it looks good but after I had a shower all it was uneven. I'm really disappointed for this haircut. I asked the lady to make an even length on top, but it was totally uneven and sad about my haircut. It doesn't worth to spend $14 here, rather I would suggest the other Great Clips. Soooo disappointed

I love this place .. if they put their price down a notch, they would compete
with another local indian food restaurant! The food is very good! love the buffet!

Very friendly staff !! 
Alot cleaner than other Extended stays in Tampa ! Pay monthly and rent not that bad !! Perfect location and def not Busch blvd dirty

I have been coming to Nadia for a few years. They never let me down!  Tonight I had the lemon grass soup, which is always spot on.  For an entree I had the special - fried soft shell crab with pasta. 5 spice. It was awesome !  I always get the iced Thai tea as a beverage which cools the heat.

So after many dinners at Han Dynasty, I've determined that the best way to experience this restaurant is the tasting menu option. Offered to groups of 8 or larger, this fixed-price-per-person option brings out a plethora of dishes that can be highly customized to the needs/wants of the group (vegetarians, food allergies, spice preferences, etc).  Rather than deliberating between an order of noodles and entree, you can have both (and probably 6-8 other dishes besides). And don't be wary about the sharing component as the portions are large. The wait staff even kindly packaged up the portions left on the lazy Susan before the next round began. As always, they give a quick and obviously rehearsed description of the dish (cheesy but appreciated nonetheless) when they bring it to your table.

Some must haves for the tasting menu-Spicy cucumbers, cold sesame noodles, and hot sauce style *insert protein of choice here*.

Since its a popular venue, it can never hurt making a reservation.

I've been coming here for several years.  I've had all kinds of work done at this Meineke location, from simple oil changes to installation of a new transmission, and everything in between.  John, Justin, and the entire team are always professional, friendly, courteous, and do great work to make sure that their customers are satisfied.  Most important of all, they are honest.  This trustworthiness is the main reason I go back again and again.  The shop is sparkling clean, with free beverages and snacks, and I always get a call the next day to make sure I was completely satisfied with the service performed on my vehicles.  I've lived in quite a few places around the country, and I can tell you, I've never experienced a better place for car service.

Hostess: 3.5
Waitress: 3.5
Food-taste, presentation: 4.0
Property-style, decor, ambiance: 3.5

How about foie gras and shaved truffles to top off your Amercan Kobe burger?  Absolutely!

I have trusted Maggie and her seamstresses to tailor many garments, from Gap jeans to delicate silk Chinese dresses to a Tory Burch trench coat. They've always done an amazing, professional job and it's always ready by the time they say it will be. I recommend her all the time to friends and family and they've all had great luck with her.

Liberty is the only person in the world who seems to be able to cut my hair properly.  Anyone who has left a negative review probably got what they asked for and want to blame their bad decision on Liberty.

This place is legit, definitely the premier night club in Reno! I went for the soft opening but there was nothing soft about it! It took a while to get in and from reading other reviews I understand there are things that need to be worked on but my group had a blast, and we all can't wait to go again! I didn't give it 5-stars because I think it still has potential to do better, ie what are they going to do with the pool? but it's still an awesome place to party!

Good spot to grab a quick workout during the winter time. My wife and I do triathlons and the spring and summer keep us busy outdoors training but love to workout here on bad wether days or winter training.
Great food, great service, love it all around! Favorite & go-to Thai spot in the city.

Beautiful outdoor mall that has great restaurants.  Love to bring your dog with you? This is the place! Humane Society store is my favorite store, but lots of upscale shops. Great Gelato place to go to.

The South Street Night Market (Aug 15, 2013) was my 1st Night Market experience, and quite possibly, my last. Way too crowded, ridiculously long lines, and very few vegan options. 

I don't understand why people get excited about events like this, where it's too crowded to even really walk. Not for me.

Meh.

Frag out. (as we say in the Army) As a person who qualified expert with grenades I managed to easily make the throw of the grenade into the little nets that hang from the ceiling.

Of course I had to have a hand grenade or two while visiting New Orleans. And what a potent drink it is.... (at least so far as I remember) Their nachos were adequate (making up for a lack of quality with quantity).

One neat note, they have a "skinny" hand grenade now. While made from artificial sweeteners, the drink came off as less sweet than the original (I kind of liked it better). And of course it still has the same punch as the original.

We went to don cherrys because I had heard that it was like Boston pizza, and wanted to give it a try. The first things we noticed is that all the furnature looked like it had been beaten and not kept in good repair, same goes for the carpet which was dirty, freying and falling apart. 

The menu was ok, and the nachos we got were acceptable, but not remarkable. 

The server was nice and service was good. The only problem this location had was they had two credit card machines, but only one phone line for them, causing a 20 minute delay when paying. 

Oh yes, my wife said that the womens washroom was the dirtiest she ever saw in a restaurant in Edmonton.
BEST BURGERS!! I love this place and their fry sauce is wonderful. I love the Western Burger...bacon, cheese, and onion rings! Great service, very friendly and fast service.

Been eating at Ruby Tuesday's for years.  Mostly when I lived in Rhode Island, but we have one close to home so gave it a try.

Their salad bar is the highlight! So many choices, how does one decide on what to put on your salad?  Biscuits (a la Red Lobster type but more heavily seasoned) were warm and yummy.  I ordered the Jambalaya Pasta.  It was awful.  Although the shrimp was fresh, the chicken juicy and the sausage quite good, I absolutely hated the sauce. I have no idea what it was. It was a brown cheesy something, Yucka!  Not at all what I know Jambalaya to be.  Seeing I had pushed my plate aside our server came over and asked if I wanted to try anything else.  No thank you, no longer feel like eating.  I was soon visited by the Manager who tried to tell me there are different kinds of Jambalaya sauces.  Whatever, yours sucks. I much say however, that he was more gracious and the order was removed from our bill. There ya go, now I'm happy again.

I am not going to slam everything about this place.  I know they have a super salad bar and awesome burgers,  I would just say stick to what they are known for and you will be happy !
Nice people. Very affordable. Large portions that I can eat for two meals. Probably the cheapest smoothies in downtown Manayunk. 5 out of 5 for adorableness.

I came in here for the first time. I usually go to chickafil but wanted to try something different. I got the grilled chicken salad. It was good nothing special and wasn't any better that other places I get a chicken salad from. Inside it was decorated nice though.

I have been going to the Bull to get my line dancing on for years. In fact I went to the "old" bull for those who know where it is. The new bull is amazing and looks like a barn. Of course it comes equipped with the staple country bar mechanical bull, tons of bars that have fast service, and two large dance floors. The first floor main dance floor is for country music and the upstairs dance floor is to shake your bootay on. Either way a mixture of people come from all different places to get their dance on. I learned to dance at the bull and I will never forget the friends or memories that I have made.

Review for donuts only. Must go back for the chicken. 

We found this new location of federal donuts  on yelp on our way back up to NYC and were so excited. We picked up three fancy donuts to go: chocolate coconut, blueberry marscapone and cherry. Amazing!! They weren't too sweet and the flavors were really good. The cakey donut itself is moist and soft. I wish I'd bought more. 

Go early because they sell out. In fact, we were lucky enough to grab the last blueberry and coconut ones. 

Will definitely be back for more donuts and to try the fried chicken.

Amazing food and great service. We had it all came home gull and very happy.  The empanadillas were full of meat from one end t the next, the mofongo was very tasty. The we had ropa vieja and goat, sancocho, moved t bread pudding.  And we wrre looking for a hammock to lay down since we could not move.  The only thing missing on t menu was a good coffee to perk us up after the feast. The food is good, lots of flavor and reminds u of the food made by ur grandma.

The puppies look great after leaving, and the staff is super friendly and accommodating.  I called two days before I was looking to get my puppies groomed and they were able to fit them both in.  For $35 each, I have my two long-hair miniature dachshunds fully groomed.  You can't be the price and the service!

I wandered in off the street for a slice thinking that any place that calls itself "New York Pizza" must be capable of, a) producing reasonably good pizza and b) bringing a slice out quickly. 

Wow was I mistaken about B. Some of the worst service imaginable was rendered despite the fact that at least 6 people seem to work there at all times. The chef was a lonely pimple faced teenager trying to do way more than could be expected of him. 

They were telling people on the phone to wait a up to 2 hours. All this while the staff to patron ratio was at least one to one.

The pizza was passable, somewhere near the middle of the New York pizza spectrum on terms of quality. 

In short only eat here if you don't care at all to service, because the employees sure don't. Every request is seen as an afront to their busy day of staring into space. 

I look forward to this place changing hands again soon.
Ted Drewes is a staple in St. Louis! Consistently good and something for everyone. Whether you live in St. Louis or are visiting, this is worth a stop!
Waffles and pork were amazing. Had some at the Pierce Street Market today. Will definitely be coming back for more. Cheese, pork, BBQ sauce... all very fresh.

To the passerby, this place is the structured like Mediterranean love child of Chipotle and Subway, but once the food is brought to your table, Zoës steps it up. Reasonably priced and fresh meals...it's not the same as a legit dining restaurant, but is worth the stop for an easy bite. 

Shout out to Eric! The manager not only brought a friendly presence to what could have simply been an order and move on, but he provided suggestions on the dishes and offered us humor behind the counter.
Dong Patrol is great!  Big fan!  So many quality dongs to chose from.  Highly recommend for any and all dong lovers.

Be careful when you take your kids in this place because a black kid punches my boy on the face without any reason and he's bigger than my boy. I told the employee about it and they didn't do anything about it.  Not a safe place if somebody trying to bully your kids. BE CAREFUL think twice going to this place...

Good service and food is good.  However, the food is the American version of what Mexican food should be plus the prices are a little in the expensive side. That said the place is in great location and the perfect place to spent an early Friday or Saturday night with a date or friends. Reason for the rating is the prices.

I would definitely recommend this place in Bryn Mawr, I think I liked it more than the other  location (Brew Cafe) on Ardmore Avenue. The beer selection is quite good, had the Oktüberfest, which was perfect for the time of year!

Place rocks excellent children's activities and great staff this is one treasure in our community that needs to be publicized more I feel my child loves this place.  We are very fortunate to have such a place in our community and we live to attend activities there and make it a frequent stop for us

The gold standard of Philadelphia Gelato arrives in West Philly! Truth be told, I've never been too clear on what gelato is, and I'm even Italian. Isn't it just thick ice cream? 

Whatever it is, Capogiro does it better than right and this new location is no exception. The flavors and selection seemed in line with what you would expect; of course, they are all delicious. There were a lot of people working there for a Wednesday night, probably because it just opened, but the staff was very friendly and eager to get the small crowd of customers to try out some flavors. It should also be noted that this location has a liquor license and has beer and wine available... or at least I saw a beer tap, I'm not sure if they've flipped the switch on that portion of the business as of this writing. The space is nice inside and there a few seats, but there's also a cement courtyard area that's part of the enclosing apartment building where you can sit on the steps away from traffic and chow down on your $5 gelato. 

I think this Capogiro is a great addition to the growing 40th and Walnut area and just as Chipotle turned the nearby Q'doba into a ghost town, I expect the superior Capogiro to do the same to the poorly run Ben & Jerry's down the street.

Lived in Chicago for 2 years. I miss Dunkin donuts being on every corner. This one is a pathetic excuse for a DD. Slow service. I was literally just told they do not sell long johns. Yes you do. Don't lie to customers just because you are out of everything all of the time. How can a Dunkin donuts in Chicago that is basically run out of a closet be so much better than a full store with a full staff.... 

Went back again. I don't know why I punish myself. The donuts are awful and the service sucks.  They need to close this location or get some new management.
Stopped in specifically for the oysters and was not disappointed. Bloody Mary was pretty good as well. Atmosphere is nice and service was pleasant.

Love this place, the food is consisently good and the service has always been friendly. Ive been coming here for years and the only complaint that I really have are the wait times as the food can sometimes take a bit to come out. Aside from that, the burger is always tasty!

LOVE this place!!! My fave Thai restaurant...best curries, best ambience (matching fancy upscale porcelain dishes, native artifacts, paintings, cloisonne display,...like a museum as a bonus!) and a wonderful family feel by a family run business. Highly recommend it!

I make a point of stopping at JBs when I'm in the area. I have always liked the atmosphere,  and love my bacon and eggs there. I went there yesterday, between appointments. 
When I first entered they had liver and onions on for the days special ( or so I thought).  I was torn between my bacon and eggs, and the liver, as I really like both.I decided on the liver, simply because it has been some time since I've had it. I got my food. It was a huge portion, for sure. I ate about half my meal. It was about 10 minutes after eating that I got this really painful stomach ache and ended up having to run to the washroom more than once, and  it wasn't to comb my hair so to speak. I informed the waitress of my situation, explaining that there was  a problem with the liver. Response was, oh no , I don't think so. She continued to serve everyone who entered the restaurant,  not bothering to consult with the cook or the manager, on my complaint. I paid my bill, left. NO TIP. I kept the left over liver, and am seriously thinking of having it tested. I may also file a complaint with the health and safety food board. I have been a long time fan of JBs,  and don't make a fuss over little things. To be treated so disrespectfully is disgusting.  The restaurant has lost a long time customer, and I will never recommend them to anyone. I WILL  share  this experience with people. Oh yeah. I was charged 16 dollars and some cents for a meal that was on the daily special board, for 10 dollars.
Best wings in Nashville ! I highly recommend the bone in !!  Always friendly, always lively. You'll feel right at home.

If i could give 0 stars, I would. First, it took 2 hours and 15 minutes for them to even show up, and that was after I called grubhub to see where they were two hours ago. Then, the order was supposed to be a sicillion pizza. This was much more $ than a regular pizza. This was a regular pizza in square shape. The sauce was terrible, the pizza was cold, and it looked thrown together. There was only pepperoni on one side of the pizza. HORRIBLE. Never again. Never.

I wasn't surprised. As suggested by Yelp reviewers, this place is great.  

It's little, colorful, fun, byob. The food was awesome. Honestly, I didn't really know what I was eating until I asked the waitress what was in the specials she had recommended. But that was OK, because it was delicious and filling. 

I'm not well-versed in Indian culture generally, but I did feel that the menu and atmosphere was tailored to a Passyunk-strolling consumer. There were a variety in dishes, which was nice for trying a bit of everything. The room was painted in bright colors and patterns (I'm not sure if that's an authentic Indian thing, or just for effect). The only blemish from the experience was that the waitress didn't know how to say some of the dishes names, which took some of the authenticity away. 

All in all, its great food in a fun byob spot.

I don't think I would some back here. Nothing we really bad. And nothing was really good. 

We got fried cheese for apps it was okay. 
My kids shared the ribeye. It had a weird flavor to it so they didn't like it. Hubby got pork cutlets which were suppose to be panned fried but it totally we looked deep fried to me. And I got chicken carbonara. It wasn't to impressing at all. 

The service was great and so were the margaritas

Karmic Korner is a new shop that recently opened in the Morgan Ford business district, just south of Arsenal.  They are nice people.  They sell tea, candles, herbs, homemade toiletries, incense, spiritual books, etc.  They're just getting started.  They were offering complimentary shamanic healing when i stopped by and say they offer tarot readings, Runes, and a variety of other alternative spiritual offerings.

The shrimp and grits were awesome! Best I have had in a long time. My wife and son had the lump crab meat omelette that they like just as well as I like my meal. They had great service and were very friendly. If you want a great breakfast give them a try

Had one of the worst meals of my life here. 

They don't know how to cook a steak properly, and I can buy better quality meat at Kroger and cook it myself. 

Their version of cheese fries: cold fries from the freezer with shredded cheddar cheese microwaved on top. But seriously, I've had better fries from a school cafeteria. 

That being said, they comped half of our meal and apologized. 

The bar here is great though... Nice people and good drinks (for a chain restaurant). I would go back and sit at the bar, but will never risk another meal.  Hungry people: stay away.

Went for the lengua tacos and they did not disappoint! Also had the cabeza tacos and fish tacos which were delicious but the lengua was the true star! I've lived in Tucson my whole life and finally decided to give this place a shot when my bf wanted lengua. So glad we found it, we will definitely be back

They have great breakfast crepes, in addition to the lunch crepes and sandwiches. Really nice staff. Great gelato too! I enjoy eating breakfast at 365, the mall is quiet and peaceful it feels like your at a European cafe. The colors are red and white, very cool.

Stopped in on a recent Monday afternoon, mostly to get out of a downpour. Cheap Ambers, a pool table, and friendly barkeep make this a neat little neighborhood/dive bar.

Oh, and one of the highlights of my NOLA trip: so there is one of those fish tanks built into the wall of the pool room. Inside this tank is a school of what apparently are called glowfish tetra: small fish about an inch long with a bright orange stripe down their bodies. Anywho, while most of the glowfish tetra swim around like normal fishies, there is one who just jumps up and down excitedly. Like, while perpendicular, he bounces up and down in one place while the others swim from side to side, wondering WTF he's doing. So while we were here, the bartender was playing a bunch of 80s techno music--and when the rapid drum machine-beat of, say, "Blue Monday" came on, it looked like our little fishy was dancing along. Hours of entertainment. Well, minutes, at least.

I found I was so excited, I could barely sit still or hold a thought in my head. I think it's the excitement only a free fishy can feel, a free fishy at the start of a long journey whose conclusion is uncertain. I hope fishy can make it out of the tank. I hope to see my fishy friend and shake his fin. I hope the Pacific is as blue as it has been in fishy's dreams. I hope.

Lunch after a massage is always something that I crave. So since this was in the same plaza as the massage envy I go to, I stopped in for a bite. 

The locale is large, it's spacious with nice seating. I was even greeted by the company dog outside.  Once inside, I realised I was the only person there on a Monday Afternoon. Sad really.. 

I placed an order for water and a small pizza, this way I could take most of it home and eat it later.  I ended up getting the margharita pizza, and it came out rather quickly. The ingredients were fresh, large slices of tomato topping it with lots of basil and some garlic and oil. Tasty. But a touch underdone. 

I'd go again.

Was in NOLA for a guys weekend and found the Hampton Inn right near the quarter.   What a great hotel.   It is within walking distance to everything that you want, but far enough from the craziness.  

It's in an old historical building but the rooms are very modern.   I was very comfortable in every way.   It is also nice that you need your key is required in order to get to the room floors.   The only minus is the elevator.  Not so much as bad but just a tad scary.  When you get to the 10th floor it starts to shake a little. I think that is mainly due to the age.  

Overall the location, property and service is great.   I would highly recommend and plan on staying there again.

Stopped in tonight after dinner. I had the red velvet ice cream on a waffle cone. It's was very good, not too sweet which is a plus. The staff was great and offered samples. The prices were very reasonable, compared to big chain ice cream shops. I couldn't give 5 stars because I'm from Texas and the only ice cream that I can EVER give 5 stars to is Blue Bell. I'd definitely go back again.
I've been here a few times and the food is always consistently good. The brisket is one of the best you can get locally and the ribs and pork are always good. Service is good but not great.

My favorite place to go in Tucson to get tacos, no doubt.  I order flour tacos "street style" and usually get al pastor or carnitas - simple, yet so flavorful.  They also give you free chips which are homemade and kept warm along side the salsa bar where you can put as many kinds as you want on your plate (one of my favorite things as I very big on sauces/salsas).  There is usually never an issue finding seating, and even if the line is long it moves very quickly.  They also have a good Taco Tuesday special making it a very reasonably priced experience overall.  A must try!

Beignets are like down pillows and the powder on top is like something outta scarface. Three big fresh and flavorful beignets are amazing. Just don't eat them by the big fans that circulate air in the courtyard. I was wearing a fair bit of powdered sugar by the end. Coffee was good too.
Really good, authentic Peruvian food. The ceviche was delicious, as was the lomo saltado. I really recommend that you try it out!

We had lunch at Muriel's today at 12:30 I had the vegetable soiree (sp?). I have eaten fine food in most States in the USA, some in Jordan, many in Mexico, and a few in Canada it was probably the best thing I have ever eaten. My husband has the burger and it was great he said. We will definitely give it 5 stars. Harold and Debby Bingham

This place is very great! If your looking for solid Taiwanese food this is place to go! I love their pot roast Taiwanese hamburger make sure you get the spicy peanut sauce with it! Also I like their crispy pork roll and the sauce that comes with the roll is incredible. The only thing I did not love was their American Chinese type lunch special it was not horrible but just very similar to all American style Chinese.

honestly this is a staple and a gem in reno.

forget the next portland or up and coming austin this place needs no like comparison as it stands on its own...which is a reno institution

the bartender on mon nites is a consummate professional.  his demeanor, persona and work ethic exudes top notch mixologist.  like weho, gramercy, south beach undiscovered kinda thing.

great poutine, ocd attention to topping off cocktails like shaking of egg whites to grinding off garnish of cocktails.  even heard waitress come back sayin yea they don't like their drink.  with a humble attitude he smiles says no worries and redoes another. he's dressed like erkle w/his hipster glasses and suspenders but prolly hung like lex steele

any occasion or accidental outing  will do, get here if you haven't already and enjoy fine dining and drinks that will have you thinkin your somewhere else

My computer had a frightening encounter with hackers and I didnt know what to do. Found  PC Mechanic and took my computer. Ramsin was knowledgeable, fair and got the job done fast! He was extremely helpful on how to avoid future problems even if he did not benefit financially! Truly a good guy and I will definitely use him for all my computer needs!

After noticing my 7 year old scratching a lot I did a check and found she had lice.  Tough to deal with at 11:00 pm on a Saturday night. She fell asleep and I continued to panic.  I called Emily at Lice Happens, she answered and she calmed me down immediately. By 8:45 am Sunday morning Caroline was ringing my door. With her calm, even tone she put our fears and anxieties to rest. She cleaned my daughters head, all the while speaking and educating us. It was no surprise that I too had contracted lice and so did my middle daughter.  Caroline took her time and methodically removed all of the nits, nymphs and lice in all three of our heads. She left only after teaching me
how to check and recheck myself and the kids. She left me with all of the tools I needed to be successful going forward.  She reminded me that even though I can be as vigilant as I can - the rest of the world can handle things very differently therefore I should be calm and ready and educated.  
Thank you Lice Happens for your fast arrival time, exceptional service, chemical free appproach and your calmness during a very difficult time.

A relative newcomer to St. Louis, Old Standard delivers a solid dining experience. The food and presentation are great and the service is about to par.

The best: The chicken is solid. The seasoning is good and the spice choice was unique and left me relying on my mediocre culinary chops to wrap my head around. It is not completely traditional gastronomy. That said, the chicken is tasty, not at all greasy, and definitely gives Old Standard a unique flavor branding -- that's quite hard to do with something as ubiquitous as fried chicken.

The good: The sides are the standard fare but there is an obvious bit of prep put into each to develop a distinct flavor and presentation. However, the sides were never "too much". They complemented the chicken well. The greens, for example, were tender, had a tinge of citrus and heat.

The drink selection here is fantastic, but I am an unabashed bourbon drinker, so I have my obvious inclinations to their whiskey theme. If you like other fare, the choices are more limited.

The so-so: The service isn't the best. There seems to be a little disconnect between the back and front of house staff, but the experience is far from bad, I'd say.

The weird: The prices are a bit on the moderate side. There's an obvious amount of prep effort, but the chicken is still - as far I can tell - conventionally raised chicken. Nothing particularly special.

Still, Old Standard is on my short-list of places to go when I want some clean, refined comfort food or a tasty Bourbon neat.

I'm not really into the whole hipster thing anymore, but I like the Barbary.  They have the only DJ night I enjoy going to anymore(10 Commandments.)  John is a nice guy too.  It has a good beer selection for being a hipster bar.  This is definitely a spot I like to hang out when I'm in Fishtown.
The Mall is nice. It has a movie theater, food court, and a play area for small kids. We used to go here to let the kids play when it was too hot to go to the park.

This place reminds me of Lucille's bbq in ca, but with a More authentic feel. You're greeted as you walk in and order at the front right away. You go to your table then your food is brought to you. It's very flavorful and each meal has its distinct taste. There is also a few beers on tap as well as many canned drinks. I haven't had much southern food, but this was great and the atmosphere was right. Thank you for a great experience.
I happened upon this old school barber shop after moving to Philly from San Francisco. Used to paying $60 for a haircut, I was amazed at the great cut I got here for $22. Left the shop a happy man!!

The coffee was wonderful, as were the scones and croissant. Then we got the prosciutto and asparagus omelet..... words cannot express how yummy it was! The hash browns were hands down the best I've ever had. It's a must if you're in NOLA.

I was happy with the service for my haircut, but I have had problems with their scheduling - one appt. cancelled last minute, and once I showed up and they didn't have me on the books (though I had the reminder card with the date/time). I need somewhere more reliable.

This is a much nicer park than I expected and a lot of time has been taken with the decorative foliage planting.  The view of the river isn't as nice as other spots along the river as there is a fence blocking access.  This park is all shiny and new and certainly doesn't look like your typical New Orleans riverside venue.  The access bridge could be a challenge for some but it is also one of the best places to train running up and down a significant elevation in NOLA.  The biggest downside is this park closes relatively early and they lock everything down so no later night running which during the Summer months is the better way to go in our heat.

I received a call from Page regarding Leila's grooming situation. She did rectify the snafu by refunding my money & apologizing profusely. The fact that they wanted to make the situation right has left me with a different outlook towards this establishment. I will miss McKenna & wish her the best on her new adventure & will have to give the other groomer a try.

My husband had a minor surgical procedure at Rothman's Surgi-Center on the 4th Floor and he was well cared for - but there was a long wait (we arrived at 8 AM and he was prepped right away but not seen by the doctor until close to 11:30 AM.  Eek.)

We got outta there just after 1 PM.

Follow-up care and administrative staff seemed good also.

Cannot say enough great things about this place!!  The food is AMAZING - great oysters, great sushi, great pad thai, great desserts....I haven't had anything that was not outstanding.  The servers are always pleasant and wanting you to have a good experience.  It's a small restaurant in a strip shopping center but the interior is very cool.  It's a BYO but the liquor store is two doors down.  If you love sushi, you will love Hachi!
Delicious food, friendly people. Just what we needed on this hot day. We got the pepper cheesesteak and the spinach steak.

Been to Trident before (mainly for a drink) but went last night with an old friend from the Navy. Haven't seen each other in 18 years but he was in town for a night so Trident seemed like a good location with great beer. (Absolutely nothing better than sharing some sea stories over a few pints). 

We were lucky we got there early because this place got PACKED (on a Wednesday night, who knew?!). Apparently it's GEEKS WHO DRINK night and it was kinda hysterical to watch (but we didn't participate).

Stella on tap, seats at the bar, happy hour specials - not bad for a quick reunion. Love all the military unit stickers all over the place and the SEAL Trident in the bar - reminded me a lot of a few places I've gone to on North Island and around the world. 

Food was typical bar food - some guy down the bar from us got the biggest hamburger I've ever seen (it was literally like a foot high) but it looked amazing. Had chicken tenders (was WAY too much for me but good) while Rob got the fish tacos, which were so good that he got two orders. 

Gonna head there again tonight for some pre-gaming before the UA/Cal game - really looking forward to it!!

Good breakfast! No frills, just solid food for a good price! Ate breakfast here twice during our trip to New Orleans. Seems like a local spot. I suggest the eggs and fried catfish (not on the sunday menu)! Sunday menu has less options and is a bit more expensive.

I just moved out of the area and wish I could come back just for the waxing service.  I have been going here for over a year for a Brazilian wax and love it!!  They use a hard blue wax that isn't as painful as the strips.  My normal esthetician was Pam who is WONDERFUL!  She always made me feel comfortable and was quick and professional.  I would recommend Heads and Tails to anyone who is looking for a quality waxing experience!!  They care about their customers!
i heard it was bought by puck from the real world and that's how it got ruined. then he sold it. so, now they're trying to do shows again... only upstairs. not the same. oh well.

I found Dr. Worman on yelp and am so glad we went! My son didn't make it through a cleaning at his last dentist, so I wanted to make sure we went somewhere he would be comfortable. Dr. Worman's office was so welcoming and he felt at ease right away. He loved the games in the waiting room and he did great during his cleaning. He enjoyed it so much that he said he can't wait to go back. Definitely recommend this office!
My hubby and I had a great meal the fried green tomatoes were the best we've had I had a smoked burger was so good cooked perfect great service and a real fun atmosphere

Damn you, URBN.  I want to hate you so badly.  Not only do you underpay my talented friends, most of your nigh-on disposable products are made by even more flagrantly underpaid people on other continents!

Yet you continue to define the aesthetic of millions of design-conscious people. Including myself, le sigh. Though there are always new, covetable pieces by Urban Outfitter's youthful house brands, Anthropologie's soft-focus, post-preppy prettiness speaks to women of many ages and cultures. The day before Thanksgiving, that flurry of femininity kept the registers cha-chinging for hours on end. The fact that employee discounts are extended to card-bearing, photo-I.D. producing friends and family this week also had something to do with it, I suspect.

This particular Anthro is housed in a historic Rittenhouse Square mansion and stuffed with women's apparel, accessories, hilariously spendy shoes, housewares, a lifetime's supply of scented candles and the famous Basement Sale Room.  It's the first location I ever visited (when it used to be Urban years ago) and still my favorite.  The perfect place to buy a gift for your favorite femme à la mode.

This is the best breakfast I've had! The build your own hash is the best with so many options for all taste buds. If you're in Santa Barbara you must try this place! Service is great! Very dedicated to having your experience here worth the buck!

Excellent fast food that tastes like formal sit down quality food. They prepared the Jap Chae Top-Bop vegan.  The glass noodles were excellent. Nice portion, presentation and service. Good WiFi too, nice bathrooms. Definitely visit! I also like that they use sustainable cardboard food containers and wood sporks instead of plastic.

Rain Control is an excellent company to get your gutters done. They gave me a good price, came out a week early, gutters look very professional . They had to come out to finish the job with no complaints at all & installed our chains as well. Todd, Joe, Matt & Eric killed it!
Thaks a lot!

What a great place to buy a piano! Lamis was absolutely wonderful in helping me find the right piano at the right price, and I got a lot of excellent information and advice from Wade, their technician. I cannot speak highly enough of this business and their  business ethic. Highly, highly recommended. Tell Lamis to give you "Kathy's price." She will enjoy the joke.

You know..I love the city of New Orleans, the people, the food, the music, all of it. And usually you can never ever go wrong there - except for this place. 
My two friends and I happened to go there on Saturday night 05/14/16. The place was quiet. No music. Empty lawn, so we went to the upstairs cocktail bar. 
My friends are in their late 40s, respectable, white women. We ordered a Holy cross cocktail, bloody mary and a dark and stormy. The dark and stormy cocktail, which is basically ginger beer and rum, was fine to taste but the other two were terrible. The holy cross is their own invention but a bloody mary is pretty standard. They were so week and bitter. Not trying to be rude, we figured, lets add a bit more alcohol to fix them and we'll pay for that. We asked to have them fixed. Offered to pay for the extra shot. The young, not local, bar tender got defensive and literally shouted at us and refused service. Maybe he thought his "9th Ward" tshirt made him a bad ass. 
There were just a couple of people sitting at the bar upstairs, which is where we were also. The other patrons seemed to be friends with the bartender and I guess he didnt want to bother with us. My friend said "excuse me" and insisted on service, to which he complied but refused to serve me. We walked away, came back a short while later and I asked for whiskey. Cant screw that up. He said that we were being refused service. Needless to say, we asked to speak to someone. The manager was absolutely rude, body language screaming out a disdain and lack of caring for her customers, Basically the absolute worst attitude I've ever come across ever - EVER! 
Finally the GM was called and we got someone to listen to our side. She was way more amiable and heard our side and satisfied with that, we left immediately. Horrible service. 
They are surviving on the love that people have for NOLA but otherwise, its a total shit show. Prices not in line with the neighborhood. Not local friendly. Crazy bad attitude even when its basically empty. Never ever go in this place. People that have reviewed it, have had a good time inspite of the service, let me assure you.

Top flight establishment. That's all that needs to be said. Italian Hoagies and the other deli fair are some of the best in the city. Not much can beat their diablo sandwiches. The bread makes this place truly special. They serve a great seeded, thick Italian roll

Primo is a local chain. So you can't go wrong at any of the locations. 

Prices are reasonable for the quality you receive!

Great back deck with Motown music to enjoy.  Fun band and lots of locals hang out there.  Happy hour from 11 until 6 with beer for $1.25.  Cheap food also then.  Festive atmosphere and Caribbean theme.  Neat place to dine and listen to music
I love this dive bar! It's a perfect place to get together to watch a game and you can even order food to be delivered!

When one of my friends (Jess C) texted me yesterday to meet her for a burrito, you best believe I dropped everything to get there. I live for burritos (when my nephew was swaddled as an infant, I used to call him a burrito...he's yummy too!). Qdoba did not let me down. Staff was friendly, lots of vegan options, tasty burrito. 

I wasn't really impressed with their chips, wouldn't order them again, but the burrito, hell yes!
I Love This Place...Everything Is Always Served Fresh And Tasty. The Best Clean Chinese Place To Me In The Nashville/Antioch Area.

I ordered fried rice, not yellow rice.

The rice was not fried, the shrimp was under cooked, and i really don't care for peas in my shrimp fried rice. oddly enough after waiting for 20 minutes when i got home i still had to reheat the rice, the rice was bland and was not fried, its just yellow rice they are passing off as fried, I am used to upnorth chinese food i guess i still have to search for a good chinese spot.

This was our second trip the the henpeck restaurant, and unfortunately it fell below expectations. The atmosphere was cute with a country kitchen decor, a giant hen statue on the outside and appeared to have the making of a good southern style restaurant. Our party of 6 ordered lunch the first time and breakfast today. There were few other patrons eating but nothing that one would consider to be busy. The food was ok, nothing overly exceptional or poor. The reason for the low review was service was HORRIBLE. Never have I seen a southern restaurant where you literally wait 30-40 min for food. Unacceptable. But we thought it was a fluke and went for breakfast this morning and unfortunately again the service was horrible. We never received refills, we actually got up and got the pot of coffee for ourselves. The breakfast was decent enough to warrant going again, but time make the food and customer service must be improved A LOT!

The service was warm and friendly. The food was good, but felt heavy on the fried chips, and had a processed food feel. There is no way this place should be number one on Yelp Philadelphia restaurants.

The best chaats in Philly might be at Indeblue.   Or tiffin bistro.  Or high end Tashan.

Good food here, not great, middle of the pack.

This place is a hidden food paradise! New favorite in IV. 10/10 would recommend to a friend. The portion sizes are amazing, and the food came out so delicious. They cook the meat fresh! The garlic paste is flavorful and their beef is tender and juicy. I want to literally come back later today LOL.

Yes, a men's haircut here (especially next to a college) is a shiny 18 dollars (plus tip)... but it is definitely worth it with these guys. I been here a few times and I always get spectacular haircut (and I have more cowlicks than a cow can reasonable expect to lick.

They are quick.. professional... and will talk to you as much or as little. I also like the old school (like your grand father's barber shop feeling) and the straight razor shave on the back of the neck. 

I will say that getting in here is a bit of a pain - as in you have to do this mega super loop... so be warned!

We stayed at an Airbnb right down the road and it was such a pleasant walk to this cafe. Met the owner and she was super friendly. They accommodated some changes for me on my latte and had some super delicious muffins.

Very spacious and nicely decorated on the inside with an extensive menu. Would be a nice place for a group or for a solo traveler to get some work done.

MMmmmm pizza.  My boyfriend and I live in Old City and had seen this place several times while walking around, so we had to stop in for the $6 lunch special - two slices and a soda for $6??! Yes, please!!

The pizza was soooooo goooooood.  Fresh toppings, just the right amount of cheese, the thinnest crust ever.  Our server was very friendly and attentive, and they take LevelUp!

I will definitely be back, and I will definitely get the spinach and ricotta slice again :-D

Recommended to us by a friend who is very into the restaurant scene here- it's such a great spot! Considering the lack of Asian food options in South Lake, this place fits the bill. Reasonable prices and on a weekday,  not too crowded.

Parking lot is odd. Starbucks located 2 doors down and there are 6 spots including 1 placard spot.  Easier to park on the road. 

Our picks: green beans, fried tofu, taiwanese sausage, &  salt/pepper pork chops.  

Even if you're not into the OG dishes like stinky tofu, you'll find something to fit your palate.  

Their strawberry milk tea was so very very good btw.

THIS PLACE IS AWSOME ! Like having dinner at Mom's house. The grits and the chicken fried steak are dynamite! Friendly servers, big portions and clean tables. These people know how to make a ckicken fried steak. Many places serve chopped and formed frozen "chicken fried steaks" which is NOT the real deal, Caposey's in general is just that, the real deal ! Can't wait to try the whole menu !

Great service! Really knowledgeable staff. The beer is awesome and so is the food. The crowd on the bar side is a little tough to get through if you need to use the bathroom. I feel like people just don't want to move because it is a sign of weakness. I still go to the bathroom OK, however, I did have to kinda push  my way through which I am not comfortable with doing. I am a lover, not a fighter. Well, unless you try to fight me ... then I am a fighter. Despite the bathroom barrier... 5 stars to this location!

Checked it out based on the recent reviews and lived up to the hype

Sashimi presentation and selection was very good and the actual pieces of sashimi were some of the largest I can recall. 

The did not have a liquor license when we went so that needs to be remedied
Our go to pizza place. Pizza is always tasty and ready when you order.  Great deal on Tuesday and a little pricey on regular days.

This was a favorite lunch spot for me when I worked full time in Old City. Let me say this first: the service is slow. If you don't have a full hour or more to eat here, don't bother showing up, even if the place is empty.

That said, this is a great little spot to get lost in your own little world. Pub food is reasonably-priced and meets reasonable expectations for pub food. The fountain drinks seem to come out all right--no weird extra syrup or lack of syrup. This place gets crowded at night, so I've never had an alcoholic beverage here.

The service is polite and the food is decent, but this place only gets two stars because it's just.....so.......................slow. They have some vegetarian options (salads are great); there's something for everyone.

Very good spot to get a gourmet burger and enjoy the atmosphere.   Plenty of beer on tap, the Tennessean Burger is outstanding..Peanut Butter Milkshake is a must and the staff was great and friendly.  A good spot to hit up if you wonder off Broadway.

My boyfriend and I sat at the bar tonight. The staff at the bar was more than helpful with the questions we had about the tequilas and the different specials. We also ordered food while there. We're both vegan, so we had a few extra questions to ask regarding ingredients. The staff member taking our order was super helpful with addressing our questions. When he wasn't completely sure, the manager on duty and the chef came over. That's beyond great service! We honestly don't try to be needy or ask annoying questions and the staff made us feel like it was no big deal. We definitely will be back and will for sure be checking out that tequila flight! Thanks guys!
Small comfy diner. The service was fast and pleasant. Great homemade pancakes and sausage. Good skillet with sausage gravy.  We will be back!
Amazing!! Cannot wait to go back!! Mac and cheese grilled cheese is the best! Tomato soup is awesome!

Hotel is walking distance from the St. Louis Arch. Parking validation for the hotel is pretty easy and I am glad the hotel offers it because parking Downtown St. Louis is tricky if you are out of town. What I was not that crazy about is that the gym equipment did not work;  2 of 3 machines were broken. Also the layout of the hotel is little strange; the pool can be seen by all the hotel rooms. Maybe good if you have children. Their printer in the business center did not work. Not a fan. Walls were not the cleanest. I liked that at least they offered coffee in the morning in the lobby because I was not sure about using the in room coffee maker.  Based on this hotel I will not even consider getting Ramada rewards card. Don't want it, don't need it.

Great during the weekends, just make sure to get here early because it gets packed, you'll be lucky to find a decent parking spot. So why come to Mazzaro's? Well... Do you love anything Italian? Cheese, Wine, Meats, Olive Oil, Cannolis, Breads, Pasta, Coffee. Should I go on?? this is the place. Great location down in the Pete, I love the Chivata bread, the absolute best, very fresh, you buy it and eat it the same day or it will go bad. The Deli has excellent sandwiches which you can enjoy with your coffee in the back patio. Hard to get into specifics or find anything negative to say about Mazzaro's, enjoy coming here and trying different things. If there's a downfall is that it gets overwhelmingly crowded to the point where you can't find a seat or parking for that matter.

I had to come back to update and give this place a 5 star rating!! I must say that when in doubt ML Rose it! Every Time I go it is amazing. The food is out of sight! It always comes hot and fresh! ALWAYS! To me that is major. To patron a place and the food quality never changes is a pretty big deal. All of the food is great. Most times when I stop in Camrin is my bartender and she is great! I love to see how well she handles the bar because she handles it! She makes you feel like you are there alone when honestly she is also working several other people. She knows about all the beers on tap and always makes good recommendations according to your taste. Overall ML Rose is one of the coolest bars and my husband and I love it!

I had an amazing deep tissue massage with Alli today. I have been dedicated to the same therapist for years, but I was desperate & overdue and he couldn't get me in. I took a gamble on IMC & it definitely paid off! Alli's technique is the perfect combination of soft/soothing and firm. The spa room, ambience, and bed were comfortable & relaxing. All of her products felt and smelled amazing too. Truly felt like a luxury experience. Great value & I would highly recommend!

We stumbled onto Maynard's while were in town moving my daughter into University.  I am so glad we did.  We ended up eating three meals there during our short Tucson stay.

The first night we poked our head in, were greeted kindly by the hostess and really liked the vibe and the menu .  We checked over at Hotel Congress which looked really fun, too, but Maynard's Kitchen won us over so that's where we ended up.  We sat at the bar where we were met Eddie, our new best friend!  He gave great suggestions, showed wonderful bar knowledge and proceeded to completely erase our 6 hour drive with some beautiful hand-crafted cocktail.  I'm not going to remember all the names, but I had one with watermelon and my boyfriend had a tequila one called the Heritage.  Mine was good but his was transformative.  The cilantro made it pop!  How Eddie managed simple and complex at the same time, I still don't know!  We then grazed our way through several starters.  The mussels were really good and fresh but it was the tomato and grilled watermelon salad that made us sit up and take notice!  Wow!!!  And then, the steak tartare!  It was one of the best things I've ever had.  Oh, time for more cocktails.  The time I had the East End and I was on Cloud 9!  It was just an incredible blend of gin, honeydew (fresh) and lemon grass.  So good!  We had already ordered the Poutine and really didn't need it.  As far as poutine goes, it was really, really good, topped with grilled foie gras.  But I had already heard what the dessert was so we just had a few nibbles them moved on to the Meyer Lemon Goat Cheese Cheesecake.  It was a work of art!

The next morning, daughter wasn't up early, so we went off on breakfast on our own.  I had remember seeing beignets on the menu so we headed back to Maynard's Kitchen.  The hostess remembered us and greeted us like old friends.  Eddie wasn't there but I ordered a virgin bloody mary (too busy of a day for the real deal) and again, it was incredible.  I am pretty sure it had smoked paprika in it.  It also had mint, cilantro, a gherkin, an olive a cucumber slice and an olive stuffed with Blue Cheese.  Sounds like a lot but it hit the spot!  We ordered the Beignets, that were light as cooton puffs,  the red velvet pancakes a la carte that came with smoked maple syrup (wow!!!) and the baked eggs.  I am not sure how they were made but we both agreed it was one of the best things we've ever tasted for breakfast.
