When I stepped into Joe's it was a step back in time. That's a good thing. The old fashioned soda shop decor was awesome as was the waitresses. I went upstairs to the bathroom and I had a flashback. The wallpaper pattern was identical to the wallpaper in my dining room growing up in the 60's. 

The true test was the actual cheese steak. The roll was delicious not so much for the meat. Much more grisly than the S Philly steaks. Not a whole lot of taste. 

If you want to visit in a time warp then visit Joe's. Do not go for the steak.

I love this place.  Moved in last month and love the location.  We had a couple of issues but its new construction and that's to be expected.  What really makes Beaon 430 stand out as they realize that this is new construction in there could be unforeseen issues and have responded and resolved any issues we had.  We had an issue with the garbage disposal and the staff on site responded immediately and fix the problem. You couldn't ask for a better response time or  a better customer service experience.

The meal I had was fine, but the service was slow. A few other members of the party were very displeased with their entrees, cold fries, soggy bread etc. Our waitress was friendly, the food however was sub par.

my friend and i went there about 12:15, both of us were getting hungry but the service is so damn slow. first, nobody came to greet to us. so i finally asked if anybody is here, then we were seated, they were so busy serving other guests not worried about us as we were checking the menu still. but i mean they could start the free side dishes but they did not. i waved to one server but she told me our server should be here soon in stead helping us first so thumb down for that behavior.
until i talked to our server to give us some side dishes, let us start eating, she finally did. after all that, tofu soup is good but unlike tofu house, they don't even offer mild or spicy or non-spicy, they just gave us mild soup, no egg? so i asked her if they do egg like the other korean restaurant, so she did then. i mean why not offer if its free anyway.( when we pay the bill later, realized no extra charge for the egg) their side dishes suck compare to tofu house's side dishes!
we went there like Tuesday for lunch so they had lunch special but the one my friend ordered, she saw the picture, thought it is korean rib but when it came, nope! just beef with some white rice which we both don't care much about the rice, only ribs. overall, the food is ok but not as good compare to tofu house and i really don't like the service plus our server's English is hard to understand(i m Chinese btw, i guess its hard for them to understand me too) never asked if we need anything else. it's not expensive for lunch though, never tried for dinner.no tea at the beginning like the other korean restaurant.

I had a really nice first visit there. I wish I remembered the name of my stylist, but I don't. I called that day and they were able to squeeze me in, they knew they could color my hair, but weren't sure how much they would be able to complete in the time frame they had open. They were able to color my entire hair, shampoo, everything. The place was so interesting, It reminded me of somewhere Kat Von D would work. I am a friendly person but after a long day of work, I was just in the mood to read my books and the stylist was very sweet and personable, but respected that and it wasn't awkward or anything. They are a full service salon, and I live down the street, so I will be back to try and get my nails done.

Great Italian restaurant, we had Lobster al Diablo and egg plant parmesan. Both were excellent. I was on a business trip with my business partner from Mexico. He could not understand the concept on BYOB and how a restaurant could operate in such a way. One good thing is that a wine and spirit shop is 0.1 mile away in the Walmart shopping center. The final touch is that at the end of your meal the owner brings an after dinner drink like Amaretto. They leave the bottle at your table so since we were having double expressos we indulged and had two each
I had a vanilla sundae with all the fixins and was quite pleased. The ice cream was silky and not overly sweetened. My only regret was that I did not get two scoops. Looking forward to going back

My husband took me there yesterday and boy I was so excited! In reviews people saying about the smell are the people who haven't been to places in the world I bet ! This place was awesome and I can't wait to go back there. They have so many different kind of veggies that I  couldn't get a hold of before! I enjoy cooking all kinds of food ( the food I know how to prepare ) so this is a "one-stop" store that I can pick up ingredients for Japanese, Korean, Thai, Mexican and Vietnamese. I'd like to learn more and try new dish!

They have pretty big Frozen Food section, so next time I will bring cooler box!

Thank you guys for your awesome work!
Great movers.  Friendly, reliable responsible. Having  moved 5 times in the last 2 years these guys were the best!  I'd definitely recommend them.  Great team, great movers!

Whenever we're in the area, or having guests visiting we always make sure to get our fix. By fix, I mean those delicious fancy donuts and sliders at District Donuts. Passion goes into their donuts, their so sinful, and out of this world. When you walk into the shop, you can tell that the staff members take pride in what they do. The Vietnamese coffee is the best, and the tofu sliders are perfection. After your indulgence you can go for a walk down Magazine Street. Love this place.

I had the beef cheek and shrimp tacos with amazing corn tortillas.  Both were amazing but the shrimp was off the charts!  The real deal and a gem of a taqueria.  Best this Albuquerque guy found in Tucson!

Absolutely love this hotel. My bf and I have been here 3 times in the past year (that should tell you something). 

We always stay at the suite in the Tuscany tower. Very spacious bathroom! The bed is super comfy. 

The spa in itself is amazing! 

Employees throughout the hotel are always helpful and friendly. 

The restaurants are all worth trying as well (Island Buffet, Chi, Oceano). 

The club inside the hotel ( Club Edge) is nice, dj plays a variety of music, which is a plus for me!

Like so many other customers, I found this establishment to be rude, with unfriendly customer service. 

 I have been buying school uniforms for over 20 years and in many different cities.  I have never had an experience that was so bad that I had to write a negative Yelp review.

Problems:  
1.  The lack of sufficient help in the weeks prior to the start of the school year.  Getting assistance was almost impossible. 
2.   The lines were ridiculously long.  
3.  The stock of items was ridiculously low so that everything had to be special ordered and thus not returnable.  The owner Mitzi is extremely negative - says she can't take returns because she has so much stock.   If she had the stock, we would not have had to special order.  Did not put anything on the shirts but the school logo. 
4.  The wait time for ordering items was ridiculously long.   The store does not even call when they are ready as they tell you they will when you check out.  It takes numerous calls to get through to check on orders or to speak with the owner.
5.  The service after  month into the school year is no better - inefficient and unfriendly service and still no stock. 

As said by many others, this establishment has  a captive audience and I wish schools would either change their supplier or convince the owner to improve things immensely.   There really are some businesses that handle the start of school 100% better

Came here with a friend who had been here before.  The food was amazing.  The layout a bit odd, but it was very cozy and nice.  I had a garden salad which was fresh and very yummy.  For the entree I had salmon with Oscar sauce, and fried green tomatoes.  The tomatoes was awesome by themselves, but if you like spice you will love the sauce that comes with it.  My friend an I split a creme brulee which was very yummy too.  Our waiter was very friendly and nice too.  Would highly recommend this for a lovely place.

SB Adventure is amazing!! I went on the Santa Cruz Island sea cave kayaking trip and it was AWESOME!! 

They took care of everything for us from the the kayaking gear to offering snorkels and wet suits for us to use after we went kayaking.  

Our kayaking guide, Aaron, took us around the island and through the caves.  He was super knowledgeable about all the wildlife on the island, from different kinds of birds to the various types of kelp.  Our group had a pretty big age range but everyone had a blast!

I've been visiting SB since I was a kid and this was my trip out to the islands.  Will definitely make a point to try and go back each time I go back down there, with SB Adventure of course.

Great hole-in-the wall local joint. I've only been here during lunch, but I can always find a seat and the location is pretty convenient from work.
My go-to dish is the veggie pho. I can't say it's the most authentic pho broth I've ever had, but it is delicious and really hits the stop when you want a warm bowl of spicy soup. Price point is great.
The spring rolls are also amazing. Not sure what the magic ingredient is, but holy smokes, they're fantastic.

Ordered a chicken Caesar wrap. Soon after, my stomach turned into knots. I became very ill and had to lay in bed the rest of the day. Will not order anything besides a pizza from here again. I don't trust their cooks when it comes to meat. Also, their phone service is very short and rude. Their delivery drivers however, have always been very pleasant. 

Pizza and kind drivers is why I give a 2 star instead of 1.
Awesome place clean friendly burritos are great definitely recommended A++++ will see u guys today.!!

My husband and I are here for vacation and after reading many reviews, we stopped in to Kelly's for breakfast our first Sunday morning here. There was quite a wait but it was the weekend so we understood. The block that Kelly's is on is cute and full of little shops so we entertained ourselves while we waited. Once seated in the adorable outdoor area, we ordered our food and once we tasted it we knew what all of the fuss was about.

I HIGHLY recommend The Huey & their french fries. Absolutely delicious and decently priced. We will definitely be coming back before we go back home!

Love this place! Everything I've tried has been good so far, the snowballs, stuffed snowballs, ice cream sundae, dip m dots, and nachos.
The staff is super friendly and they work pretty fast to get people their orders.

The previous time I went here, the restaurant/bar were closed due to a power failure, so i was looking forward to it. What a huge disappointment it was! Ron's advertisement on Yelp.com indicated $4 any flavor martinis and discounted happy hour appetizers on Mon-Fri during happy hour, but charged $8 for a lousy martini in the dining room on a Friday during happy hour. When I questioned this, the manager indicated happy hour specials only apply in the bar area and not the dining area. This was not specified anywhere on their website, nor  was it in their sponsored advertisement on Yelp.com. 

The food is mediocre at best and the service is spotty/inconsistent. They charged an additional $2 for an extra dinner roll and the server tried to clear my plate when I was eating with over half of the food remaining on it. The focus seemed to be on getting people in and getting them out as soon as possible and not on quality customer service. 

If you are in the mood for good Italian food, mussels, pasta, seafood, etc. at a good restaurant/bar, I recommend Weso's in Marchwood and Fellini's in Berwyn. 

Don't waste your time and money at Ron's Original Bar & Grille!
Great choices for a nontraditional hotdog or sausage meal. Got my hot dog faster then ever.

This place is worth checking out just to see the space.  They have done a great job decorating.  It looks like an old art deco soda shop and some of the booths even play a radio show.  There is a huge menu of classic ice cream desserts, ice cream martinis, and some very tempting baked goods.  There brownie in a mug is unbelievable.  Everything is high fructose corn syrup free - even the sodas.  

There food menu is small, however, everything was tasty.  If you are looking for something different, try the peanut or pickle soup!
Amanda was very helpful and friendly  with answering all my questions with contacts and glasses.

Every year we purchase multiple gift cards for Brio as mother's day presents. We have been doing this for years. The last two times I have been to this Brio to purchase gift cards or have lunch, I have stood at the counter and been ignored as multiple employees have either walked past or helped people that have come in after me. Today I told the host what had happened and he laughed. Their food is decent. Their service leaves a lot to be desired. I would not recommend going to this Brio, especially when there are numerous options in the same plaza with great food and service.

Oh my gawd! Has Vegas moved to Reno? Have you guys seen new and remodeled and improved Peppermill? It is gorgeous, and luxury, and exciting and oh-so-fun to be in!

Decor - beautiful! Food - REALLY good (and I am extremely hard to please in that department). Walls in the casino and hallways decorated with huge high definition panels, all of which display some kind of zen, soothing, nature scenery, or Italian streets (looks like live cam), or fashion shows. Lots of Italian country side paintings on the walls. Bars look like melted ice cubes, lit with a blue light.

Casino was nice to me too. I scored a 1000 win on a slot machine, and few hundreds here and there.

But all that good stuff is not what moved me to write this review....

If you ever make it to Peppermill, please visit their SPA. It is just out of this world! Get a treatment and massage (prices are decent), and spend couple of hours in the dry sauna, steam room, or pool side (indoor or outdoor). 

SPA takes up three floors, impeccably clean, and staff is very friendly. Not in "let me kiss your butt for a tip" friendly! They really want you to enjoy the experience, and relax. Customer service at its best.

So, check it out!

By a habit we checked in into Atlantis (before we discovered Peppermill), so I can't comment on the rooms, but I am sure they are as wonderful.

I stumbled in here yesterday as I was riding my bike to work, wanted a quick bite to eat, and I was famished. I have rode or driven by here a million times. It's right next to my barber and I frequent Seven Cups a lot as well, so I thought I would give it a try.

PJ Subs is, well...leaves much to be desired. The club sub was edible, though the chopped meats tasted freezer burnt and/or old. The bar area that I ate in was very run down and dirty as if it had not been deep cleaned for a year or two and the stools were beat up (could use some refreshing). I did not expect a lot from this establishment and was not surprised by anything. However, what really become bothersome and annoying was the constant ringing of a buzzer going off from what sounded like the kitchen area. On top of this, they let the phone ring and go unanswered several times. I understand staff may be preoccupied with other tasks, but please just answer the phone and turn off your timers. No one wants to dine with obnoxious noise distractions as those, even if it is just a sub and beer place.
This place was ok, I guess.  I have definitely had better coffee and the hot chocolate was way too sweet.
A nearly complete failure. Bad service. Bad food. Something is seriously wrong here. I have eaten at the other locations and they were much better.

Soy is a Korean fusion spot and it's top notch! One of my favorite places in the city. The food is consistently delicious and the staff is super friendly.

If you love Asian food, this place is a must. You have to stop in.

If you want a super authentic Korean meal, this may not be your spot. It's teriyaki and fusion, not a old school, course meal.

Bim bim bap in the skillet is incredible. My favorites are the fried rice dishes. They even have a Hawaiian fried rice with spam. Solid.

This place is worth it. Enjoy!

Jess was fun and attentive as bartenders go.. She definitely had her regulars (small town bar) but she and they made me feel like one of the crew. Food was okay, sauce was good but my bacon was burned and part of the pork was dry.. Overall it was an enjoyable time. Good place to catch a ballgame.

I was a member here for 5 years and recently switched to City Fitness (21st & South). Here are a few reasons why:
1. The Sporting Club staff is way unfriendly, with the exception of the cleaning people. In 5 years, not one person ever got to know my name. Really?
2. The spin classes are like a cult. If you don't go weekly, you're given the stare down from people when you walk into class.
3. The already sky-high membership rates were increased every year. When I asked to be put back to my original rate, I was basically told to take my money elsewhere, which I did. 
4. The indoor track was not properly maintained. There were divots all over the place. 
5. The free-weights section was meat head city.
6. The basketball court was never available. I'm a female who likes to shoot around, but would never use the court because it was never open or inviting. 

Either way, I'm really happy with my new gym. The monthly rate is better, it's closer to my apartment, and the personal trainers and staff are much friendlier. At the end of the day, I wouldn't recommend the Sporting Club to a friend.

I came here for dinner for the first time a few nights ago and the food was great. I had a seafood craving and this place satisfied it well. I had very pleasant waitress and everything I ordered came out pretty fast. I would suggest this place to anyone that likes a Creole style seafood taste. I will be back!

Ive been there several times for lunch and we tried dinner this time. The food is always prepared well and the service is aways great. 
But there wasn't anything over the top as far as dinner goes. If you are looking for a good steak and a little more casual then sit at the bar and people watch. They have a great layout to let you see everything going on in the place. We would come back but I'll probably make it a nice business lunch spot for now.

Our family visited St. Louis and ate here. We literally all said it was the best pizza we ever had. We had the maplewood deep dish and it was so good! My 12 year old still talks about this pizza and it's too bad we are so far away! Service was excellent, seated immediately, nice atmosphere. We loved it!

Just the name biscuit love was appealing to me. I was wanting to try a southern type breakfast and this was the perfect place to come. There were lines at both locations, but the service is prompt and the ordering is efficient. You will need to have your order ready before being seated. I had the egg plate which came perfectly prepared with thick cut bacon that I asked for extra crispy. I used the house made jam on 1/2 my biscuit...it was delicious. On the other 1/2 I order their white gravy which was good, but nothing on my grams homemade gravy.  I also ordered the cheese grits which were a great southern fresh grit compared to others that I have tried.

Poor service from host through lunch. 
We had a large group (13) so they made us split up. They refused to even seat us near each other even though there were enough empty tables to put both groups next to each other. We were all seated by 2:50. Not even during a lunch rush. The party of 6 had menus when they sat down and had their drink order take right away and good order fairly quickly. The party of seven had no menus  for over 20 minutes and only after we asked 3x. No one took our drink order until after we had been seated for 30 minutes and I spoke to an employee standing by the doorway to the elevator.  We did not actually order our food or our first beverages until 3:25.  My first beverage was made incorrectly. Our waiter said he knew that but did nothing to correct the issue. 

A trainer came over to inform us our server was in training and today was his last day of training so he was trying to go solo. She told US we needed to give him a hard time for the errors. I told her that is not our place. She needed to address it and she may want to give him more support in training. 

Food finally came around 4:00. The party of 5 was completely done eating. So we're the smaller parties they say at the two empty tables near us. Most things came out correctly except for the smoked chicken. Two of us ordered 1/2 orders. Both orders came out full. The manager eventually reduced our food bill (not including any drinks) by 50%.  We finally got our bill about 4:35. But our waiter did not fix what he charged for the chicken so we still paid more than we should have.  

We finally got out of there about 2:45. Almost 2 hours after being seated. We did package up our leftovers and shared with Nashville's homeless. Saw a lot of need along Broadway. 

All in all, not the experience I expected and not a place I would suggest to others without a lot of warning about what could happen.

Stayed here right at the start of Carnival season (my trip was January 6-9). In my review of their sister property, Hotel Le Marais, I said I wouldn't wait so long to post this review, but alas, here is it is several months late. I adored everything about this hotel, and the only reason I'm deducting 1 star is that none of their double queen rooms have balconies. After staying at the Hotel Le Marais for my birthday last August, I became spoiled by having a room with a balcony - makes for great people-watching! Anyway, here's what I loved about the Hotel Mazarin:
Marble floors in the room
Large bathroom
Really good complimentary breakfast with a very friendly dining room staff
One of the loveliest French Quarter courtyards that I've seen
The 21st Amendment Bar ( where we got our free welcome drink) is really cute and has live music
Great proximity to everything in the French Quarter

If I could have gotten my double queen with a balcony, this place would have gotten 5 stars for sure! I look forward to staying here again!
To wrap up, I'll go over more comparisons between this hotel and the Hotel Le Marais. When planning my birthday trip last summer, this comparison would have really helped me when I narrowed my hotel choices down to these two properties. Here goes:
Location: equal, as the hotels are in the same block of two consecutive, parallel streets (Hotel Mazarin is located at 730 Bienville Street, Hotel Le Marais at 717 Conti Street)
Room: Hotel Mazarin is the winner here, for the marble floors, and larger bathroom. However, only the Hotel Le Marais offers double queens with balconies)
Complimentary breakfast: Mazarin. Better selection, also served in a separate dining room off the beautiful courtyard. The breakfast at Hotel Le Marais is served in the hotel bar & lobby area. 
Courtyard: Mazarin, hands down. It's absolutely gorgeous and I can see why they host many weddings
Price: equal, their rates are similar. If price is the deciding factor, do your research. Last summer, the Hotel Le Marais was cheaper; in January, Hotel Mazarin had the better rates.

Ultimately, I would gladly stay at either hotel again, but my preference leans a more toward the Hotel Mazarin because of the reasons stated above.

I finally got to this place after a long wait. The Mediterranean menu was inspired. Had the turkey thigh which was fork tender, beautifully marinated, besting most bbqs. The cocktails were great as well.

First I'll say that I definitely get a good work out here.  I just moved into center city from the suburbs and I've regularly attended spin classes 4-5 days a week for the past year.  I didn't want to join a gym right away down here with the nice weather approaching so when I heard about this place I thought it would be perfect.
The room is very small for the amount of bikes, so you are kind of on top of each other, which kind of grosses me out when everyone is sweating profusely and breathing heavily.  The bikes are also very different than any other spin bike I've ever seen.  This isn't a bad thing.  I do like the power meter on there, because usually I'm just guessing at my speed and resistance level.  
The online reservation system is nice too, but I've had a hard time getting a spot in a lot of the classes even signing up a week in advance.  I guess that's a testament to how well this place is doing, but its a little frustrating.  
All in all, I think its a great class, just wish the studio was bigger and there were more classes available.

This place is spectacular. Adorable decor and seriously scrumptious treats. We used Choquette for our wedding. They did a beautiful job, and everyone raved about the cake for months after our wedding. The bakery also made custom absinthe flavored macaroons for favors that were almost too beautiful to eat. 
A MUST for anyone who lives in Saint Louis or just passing through. Pastry chef Simone really takes her craft to a new level with truly perfect pastries. Yum.

When I broke my beloved iPhone screen for the 19564th time, I knew I was cut off by Apple Care as I exceeded the number of repairs they would do (who knew there was a limit?!) so I had do find other option. 

I recall passing this place many times in the mall, so I immediately thought of them. They were swift and very efficient and friendly. 

They let me know up front the cost out the door was $117. Cool. 

They used a checklist and tested features on my phone to be sure they didn't mess something up when fixing my phone's boo boo. Check and check! 

They told me it would take 25-30 minutes to fix the phone. I went downstairs to the Starbucks & chilled out and enjoyed good people watching whilst I waited. The time went by fast and I went back up there and got my beloved rectangle creature. 

I'm very happy with the way that the repair turned out. It's been nearly a week and I'm good to go. They stand behind their work and I can bring it back in should something go wrong. Highly recommend them for a fix! :-)

It pains me to do this.  Sigh.  I will preface this by saying I WILL go back here....because this place to me, is awesome by all accounts with one exception THUS FAR....and hopefully this will change for the better - but the food crimes being perpetrated here must stop.  I know what you are saying - if the food is that bad why go back.  Answer:  none of the food here is "bad", but it is being prepared by bad cooks/chefs.  Hopefully Mgmt. takes note of what I am about to say.

Customer service here is great, the staff is always friendly and goes the extra mile....the kitchen however - oh boy....things need to change...or there will be.....trouble.

This was my second visit and my first ordering a dinner entree.  After my first visit for a late night snack at the patio bar where I had wonderful service from Howie the bartender, and had some phenomenal quesadillas....my friend had the southern fish sandwich, which was great as well.  Fast forward a week or so, and I convinced 9 of my friends to come here for dinner.  A 10 top....not too shabby for business.  Honestly, 2 or 3 will probably never come back.  Here's why:  A friend ordered the fried chicken dinner.  As it came out, I knew there would be issues - the batter was dark brown, not golden brown as it should be - indicative that the oil fryer heat was up too high...this translates into burned outside, RAW chicken inside.  Sure enough, raw chicken.  Food crime.  As Gordon Ramsey would say, "You coulda killed somebody".

Not as bad of a problem were my "House Dry Rubbed Pork Spare Ribs....with Turkey Collards and Smashed Potatoes."  I am a Memphis BBQ fan, dry rubbed, with sauce on the side.  This type of BBQ rib has a dry rub (visible on the rib mind you) consisting usually of brown sugar, onion and garlic powders, black pepper, cayenne, and the like.  These ribs had ZERO dry rub on them.  I asked our server Angie (who was great and friendly - hats off to her) to ask the cook what has happened here.  Some other people at our table also ordered these....no rub at all.  They were cooked wonderfully with great smoke flavor but do NOT advertise dry rub if there isn't going to be any.  Angie came back from the kitchen saying they put some on, but lightly -- there is no such thing.  Dry Rub is dry rub....it covers the entire rack.  Also, a big BBQ Faux pas, they left the membrane on.  I know, to each their own opinions on smoked ribs, but the membrane should be removed.  

I was looking forward to my turkey collard greens.....WOW....the salt - Oh the salt.  Almost inedible.  So it seems in the kitchen anyway, there is some learning to do.  Too much salt here.....ZERO seasoning over there.  These are quick fixes for my dinner issue - and the food will rock once that is fixed.  The chicken issue though, is culinary 101.  The bigger the chicken pieces, the slower you must cook it.  Dropping it into oil 100 degrees above where it should be does not cook chicken faster - it destroys the batter you spent all morning mixing and dipping....and results in raw chicken being served to guests.

I wanted to give 4 to 5 stars but the chicken issue cannot be ignored or factored in no matter how much I want this place to succeed.  

Grand Opening is Feb 1st....tomorrow.  Hopefully, once they start getting more tables for dinner and the kitchen gets used to the equipment, they should start getting into a groove.  This place has alot to offer, three full bars, a nightclub separate from dining area, an open patio bar area (when the weather is nice) and great staff.  

Again, I will go back - they WILL fix their problems.....right Gunslingers...?  I know you will.  The friend chicken dinner is my next target...I'll order it with hopes they fixed the issue.

See you soon.


YELP!!!

Every last thing we ordered was fantastic!!!! . This is the best breakfast we've had on the beach... any beach! We had omelets, crumpets, and French toast. The owners are so wonderfully kind and attentive.

We were only in Philly for a couple of hours and really wanted to see some sites. Our tour guide was Glenn and he was fantastic! He was on time, funny, appropriate, and made the history come to life. He also recommended places to eat, see, and places to avoid. Great tour!

Definition of your all American breakfast! Definitely has a homey feel once you walk in. I would recommend the latkes over anything. Portion size is fairly big so come prepared! Also, only takes cash!

Really nice place right on the beach and next to a great fishing pier.  All the rooms have balconies facing the gulf and the staff are super friendly and professional.  They took great care of us and unit # 506 was very nicely furnished, clean and spacious.  Next time we come back, we will definitely request this condo. 

They take great care of the property and all of the 3-bedroom units seem to be well-maintained.  Great pool area right on the beach with an area for grilling and hanging out. 

Great place to get away from it all and enjoy the Florida life, even for us locals.  Highly recommended and will definitely be back soon!

I absolutely love this place! Food is very good.... beer is cold and a great variety. Facility is clean. Service is extremely inconsistent.  I have been to this location several times and each time it is like going to a different restaurant.  For the first time we had a great server Rachel!  Although the service was slow she was great.   Again out order was wrong,  but she actually caught it before we could say anything.   She apologized and coolrrected it immediately.  Not sure if the problem is corporate or local management but someone needs to address the inconsistency in everything from service to portion size to timing.  Overall if you have time it is worth the wait, but don't go starving or you may not make it before you are initially served.  12 minutes from sitting to getting my beer.
Simply put...it is NOT the best Korean Fried Chicken in town. Try Wing Chix and see the difference.

The atmosphere in this restaurant is adorable. I love all of the signs, tables and chairs, etc. My boyfriend and I came in for brunch on a Sunday. I checked in on yelp because the wait was an hour. Once we got there we checked in at the front counter and only waited five minutes before we were seated. They have quite the selection of breakfast items. I ordered a short stack pancakes and then I ordered eggs, bacon, and potatoes. I was not blown away by the pancakes. In fact I wasn't the biggest fan. But they serve you a good portion of food and I was not able to finish it. It's definitely worth the prices. I'll have to try something different if we come back.

Hardee's is the red headed step child when it comes to fast food, it always seems to take a back seat to McDonalds, Wendy's and Jack in the Box. However I always forget that their food is actually better than all of the other options.

I stopped by this location while in a hurry and needed a quick meal. I opted for the Chicken Tender Sandwich, which was three chicken tenders with honey mustard, bacon, and cheese on a standard bun. The chicken tenders were good, not dried out like some places.

This location was clean with a friendly staff.

I would give this sorry excuse for a Manhattan Bagel zero stars if I could.  Stopped in to grab coffee and a bagel with cream cheese and ended up waiting over 25 minutes for my food.  No excuse/apology/"miss, your order is coming up."  There were only 5 customers (with normal-sized orders, not catering) in front of me!  The place itself is tiny and not very clean.  There is minimal seating and the tables were dirty and covered with crumbs and used napkins.  They do not take any national offers (not a big deal) and don't make any of the special bagels like the CA powerbagel, chocolate chip, asiago, onion (not even a special variety!), or bialys or bagel sticks, ALTHOUGH they DO list them on the menu, along with prices (much bigger deal).  The coffee was cold (it had obviously been sitting in the carafe for a long time) and barely passed as colored water; usually, the House Blend is medium-bodied and decently flavored.  The coffee here was incredibly weak and tasted off.  I would almost venture that they used a generic/less expensive coffee blend and just passed it off as the official blend.  The everything bagel was so salty that I had to guzzle 2 whole bottles of Nestle Pure Life in my car.  And I hate drinking plain water!  It was also way too dough and did not have the nice characteristic shell (the entire reason for going to a Manhattan Bagel in the first place versus Brueggers or Einstein's or Panera's). It came to $4.54 for a small coffe wannabe and a barely edible bagel with cream cheese that I threw away half of.  Avoid at all costs and go to Panera's across the street.
Wanted a Carribbean lunch. The food was great and for a bit I was not in Indiana. Will come again and will try dinner next time!

Located near the corner of Broad and Walnut Streets, Williams-Sonoma is a wonderful place to look for kitchen essentials in a variety of colors and styles, as well as fun items that are nice to have when you want to use them.  I was delighted to see that there were Marvel Superheroes and Star Wars cookie cutters, mini cake pans, and spatulas!  They make great gifts and will please anyone from kids to grown-ups who are fans!

I like the pizza here, they are located in Reno airport. They cater to flyers - you have to pass through security to get to this pizza place. I always stop before hoping on Southwest flight home. If you're getting a slice - generous size, tasty fresh toppings, at least 4-6 types to choose from, and nice helpful people.  Crust is on thick side.  About $7.50 a slice.
This place is great. Everyone is so caring and helpful. They even helped me get insurance. I would highly recommend them.
I love Full Pedal! I've never had an instructor or class I didn't like! I wish it were even cheaper so I could go more often. But this is definitely my go-to place for spin.

There were four of us and we all enjoyed our meal.  After looking at some of the dishes that others in my party had, I wanted to return another night and order theirs also.  However just not enough nights in my vacation to do that.  Despite seeing the others plates my food was also very good. We visited both the ghosts table and the séance room that is upstairs while there. It was an interesting experience.  Definitely would return.  Two other highly hyped restaurants we went to couldn't  even hold a candle to this one.

Two words... Vandy roll. You have to try it. It was by far my absolute favorite.

Good sushi, affordable prices and a cozy atmosphere. I didn't have one bad bite of anything. It was fresh, creative and served up really fast. Everything you want in a good sushi restaurant.

I can't wait to go back.

It pains me to write this review since the previous dozen or so times I'my boyfriend and I have been to Tzin for date nights, it was always enjoyable, cozy and the servers really made us feel special, however, this past weekend, my boyfriend and I had our least favourite dining experience there and that really made us both question if we want to return in the near future. 

It's true when they say customer service either makes or breaks an experience. When we first started going to Tzin about two years ago, we were blessed with two excellent servers - Kerrie & Mel... they alone made us want to come back because they made us laugh and were so enthusiastic about the experience and the food. However, about a year ago, Mel left to pursue other endeavours, but we were left in the capable hands of Kerrie (who is also the owner). She has always been friendly, sweet and super pleasant. Re-hired was a former male server from the past. The last few times we've dined there we luckily had Kerrie has our server so my boyfriend and I were happy about that. However, this past Saturday, upon arrival, we were surprised to see that Kerrie was not there, and instead, there was the regular male server from previous times plus another gentleman serving the room. We were greeted promptly and asked if we had reservations (which we did). There were two free tables, for two, at the time - one right near the entrance, and the other in the middle of the room. He immediately pointed to the table right near the entrance for us to sit. We obviously preferred to sit closer inside since it was -30 outside and there isn't much of a barrier between the outside door and inside. I therefore had to ask if we could sit at the other table instead. Instead of agreeing to it, we had to wait until the server asked the other gentleman for permission (which I thought weird since they were both tables for 2). Anyways, that's fine. We got our table in the middle and were seated promptly but missing a menu until my boyfriend had to ask for me. It's around this point that I really started feeling like this date night wasn't going to be the same as others and my boyfriend said he was just thinking the same thing. The server wasn't warm and genuine in his greeting, didn't even ask how we were doing, just wanted to see if we were ready to make our order. Throughout the night, I noticed the same lack of personal attentiveness - for instance, in the past with the girls, usually when the dish is placed on the table, it is described in delicious detail - this time nothing was described except for the three different sauces accompanying the chorizo. Also, our server never once checked up on us after the first few bites, to see how our food was. Incidentally, we ordered three of our favourite dishes and they are all usually very good, but this time round, the potato bravas was seriously lacking in depth - a certain smokiness that we've tasted in the past was not there and all the flavours felt disconjointed like they didn't have time to meld together. The bacon and the chorizo we ordered were very good. All-in-all, my boyfriend and I commented on how cold and inpersonal it felt, even though the space is small and warm. We actually finished our food and drink, didn't linger to have dessert like usual, because that's how disappointed we were with the night's experience. In fact, our date lasted a grand total of 1 hour from start to finish. So much for a lovely evening out.

Please note, the price for food here is a steep, albeit good, compared to the portion sizes. For instance, we ordered the "potato bravas" which was $14.50 for literally two small handfuls of chopped potatoes with bits of bacon, covered in a tomato sauce and topped with green onion. The "bacon" dish  was $16 for 3 bite-size pieces of pork belly on crostini. And the "grilled chorizo sausage" was $15 for maybe a 20 cm long piece of sausage.

Enjoyed the Greek salad with the tender grilled chicken, one of my very favorites around town. Another of my favorites is the shrimp and oyster poboy. Absolutely Love the atmosphere at please u which is on st Charles avenue.

First thing to say about the Depot, is that you should probably make a reservation.  We got there without one at 6pm on a Saturday and there was an hour wait.  Not to worry though, they have communal seating in the bar area with a full dinner menu. 

Beer Selection: Good selection from a straight forward lager to a full stout, try the sampler.

Food: We only went for the appetizers. They were approximately half the price of the main dishes, so we got 2 each.  The onion rings were great, well worth having again.  The Duck Confit sliders were amazing and I highly recommend them.  The Bone marrow was very good, the chimichurri made the dish.  The sweetbreads were good but forgettable.  

All and all I look forward to going back, with and without reservations, to try more of their menu.

My fiance and I went out to Santa Cruz last week and booked the afternoon 1:30 kayaking trip with Hallie (Halley)... So awesome! Weather was perfect and our guide was super chill and knowledgeable. I'd recommend these guys if you're looking for a sweet time without breaking the bank. Ana-Crapa!

K, I don't usually go for the janky Chinese buffets, but it wasn't my idea.  Let's do this.

First, it was way nicer on the inside than I was expecting, and much cleaner.  The staff was also quite nice.  Right there - best Chinese buffet I've ever been to!

The sushi was... what it needs to be to keep the operating cost down.  Most was meh.  The mixed tempura dumpling type thing was original, but not great.  The spicy tuna roll was... actually ok!  It had a big chunk of imitation crab (dat operating cost), and the rice was dry, but I think I snarfed down six of them and felt like I had a win for the day.

The rest of the stuff was pretty much to be expected.  There was the assortment of heavily-breaded meats in different sauces.  A non-breaded "spicy" chicken which wasn't bad at all.  Wonton soup (can't go wrong.)  Highlight of the day was when I stumbled upon the gyoza (pot-stickers, fried dumplings, etc) complete with good sauce.

I do feel like I cheated myself by not trying the Mongolian.  Next time.  Yes, I will be back, if only to try the Mongolian and have some more fried dumplings.

A surprisingly good Vietnamese restaurant!  I had Pho rare beef soup and bestie had the chicken soup. Both were great. Although his was just a little better. Fresh basil included. Ambiance is a no. But you come for the food. Prices are cheap. $8 for large bowl.

Fantastic meal, great music, great cocktails. A complete New Orleans experience. The five of us ordered a ton of food and a drink each, and it came to like $30 each. Absolutely top on my list next time I'm back.

I recently stopped here after hearing rave reviews from my coworkers. I tried the large chicken quesadilla and mango Jarritos for $8.  It was plenty and very filling. The quesadilla was seasoned very well and included 2 dipping sauces. Don't know what the sauces were, but they were good, lol. I plan on returning to try the tacos.

EDIT: The manager actually took it upon himself to read this review, look through the orders to find our information, and call our house, leaving a message apologizing and offering us a free pizza! WHO DOES THAT? Absolutely amazed with the level of customer service. Today we picked up the Fajita Pizza, free of charge and it is very tasty! We all agreed we like this much more than the previous pizzas we ordered and will return to Pizza Mizza to try some more of their creative pies.

Had the boyfriend pick up two pizzas on the way home from work for the family. We had never eaten there before, someone told us it wasn't all that great and overpriced, but we decided to try it because they were donating %15 of the proceeds to C.A.L.M. 

Ordered a large Thai chicken pizza and a medium half tangy BBQ chicken, half plain cheese. The Thai chicken was the driest pizza I've ever eaten. We all agreed it was a complete waste of money. Almost zero sauce, over-cooked chicken, and very bland. The bbq chicken was better, but still a bit dry with very little BBQ flavor, I'd rather eat a Rusty's BBQ chicken any day of the week. The plain cheese was bleh, again, almost no sauce and really tasteless and dry. 

Maybe they were having an off night because it was so busy because of the promo, or were running out of product and that's why our pizzas were so dry and had very little flavor? I'm not quite sure if I would try them again, to be honest I wish I'd just given C.A.L.M the $40 dollars spent on the pizzas and gotten a $5 Digiorno from Ralphs.

EDIT: I added an extra star after re-considering the fact that they were very busy and are doing good things for the community. I will probably try them again when they have those deals everyone on here is talking about.

What a great event,1st time I've gone and loved it.tried 2 different kinds of ribs walked around all the arts and crafts had some yummy jumbo onion rings,great festival great day and lots of great food,recommend to all.

I love coming to this nice Otalian place! We come and get homemade pasta and desserts and of course a nice panini for lunch! I always get the number 11 sandwich and its big enough to split between two people. I havent had a bad thing here between the pasta, desserts, wines and cheeses.
Came here with a bunch of my girlfriends. Ordered the duck hash with poached eggs. Super yummy and the croissants were on point! Definitely coming back.

All-in-all our meals were ok. My Ahi tacos had too much going on toppings-wise and the fish and avocado were lost in the mix. I had black beans on the side which I believe came from a can. Normally I'd be fine with that, but they were bland. No extra seasoning detected. The steak tacos had a good flavor, meat was a bit greasy (more like brisket rather than tenderloin as listed on menu). I would probably try this place again next time I'm downtown. I'll  explore the menu a bit :-)

Great restaurant with really cool vibes.  Highly recommend sitting on the second level rooftop if you can.  The menu is great, you really can't go wrong!! For my vegetarian friends out there, be sure to try the cauliflower- it's amazing!

This is an excellent Concert Venue! While celebrating my Niece, Tawny, on her 17th Birthday, we went to a show at The Knitting Factory. It was the best live show I have attended in awhile. Not only were all 4 bands great (thank you for a great line up goes to the nightclub), but the venue was great too.
My Sister and I needed seats, as she is a temporary crip, and I am permanently crippled (they call it "disabled" LOL). So, they gave us special wristbands, and seats in the VIP section. This made it possible for us not only to tag along with the teenagers, but to thoroughly enjoy a killer Rock show.
I plan to keep track of the show schedule, and return to Rock out again. It reminds me of when I was in my 20's & 30's and used to hang out often in the San Francisco Bay Area LIVE music scene. VERY COOL!
Thank you to The Knitting Factory for booking great tours and acts, and for taking good care of the Artists, too. They all enjoyed playing the venue, and thats important, it allows them to give us Fans a great show. Touring can be rough, so its nice to be taken care of when you are on the road.
After the bands played, they had a "meet the bands" area. It was so exciting for the teens (and us die hard Rockers) to not only buy a CD to support the band, but to get it Autographed, and to get to thank the Artists for a great show.

This morning I told my daughter that we're going to visit her cousins in Seattle. She said, "My wishes really DO come true!" The look on her face told me it was the first granted wish she's received in a long time. It brought me back in time to the Halloween when we bought a fairy princess costume from Polyesther's. My daughter got those wings on, and ran around the store expectantly. 

Her shoulders slumped and she muttered, "The wings don't work. I can't fly." It was the saddest thing ever! Polyesther took my daughter by the hand to go outside and get the wings working. They ran up and down the sidewalk and jumped off the window ledge until Franki was feeling like a fairy that could fly. Polyesther's Costume Boutique takes customer service to a whole new level. Esther is the fairy godmother of costumes; she grants wishes and goes the extra mile to make sure they come true.

My wife and I have been going to Parx Grill for over year now, and I think it's about time I give them their props! we love to just stop in for appetizers and drinks. Try to get there at least once a month for dinner. The service is fantastic, the wait staff all work as a team, so someone is always available if you need them. We consider it casual fine dining and it is the best in the area. From the appetizers to the salads to the entrées, everything that we have ever ordered has been phenomenal. We highly recommend to anyone just for drinks and appetizers or a full dinner. They usually have dinner specials we had one for $40 for a full course meal. Thank you to the bartenders the waitstaff and compliments to the chef!

Great experience here. It looks like a bit of a dive from outside but the coconut rice, pad thai and stir fry were all perfect. 

We will definitely be coming back again. I'm looking forward to trying the curry and stay!

This is a must if you love Thai food.

Best pho in town- hands down.

I can't believe I had never been to this place despite living SO close to it! We pass it almost on a daily basis. My friend and I had both been to Thai Phuket and tried this pretty amazing pho so that's sort of what we were comparing the amazingness of this pho to. 

First of all, the location is completely a turn off. I have been to this lost before and it has three Vietnamese Restaurants, one of which had previously disappointed me. The Asian market here is one we frequent so again, we pass this place all the time!

I tried the summer rolls. They were delicious. They were just the right amount of crispy and were filled with shrimp and meat. My friend and I both ordered the small pho (#2, beef tendon). The small was MASSIVE and neither of us could finish it. It came with noodles, jalapenos, tons of sprouts, and the rest of the regular pho additions. The soup was flavorful and so was the meat! 

In total, it cost each of us $8.00 a person. Yep, no lie. 

Yes, it's cash only but carrying $8 in cash isn't that bad. Also, the decor is nothing special but the food is lovely and the service was great, so who cares?

I'm totally coming here all the time now!

Crowne Plaza Valley Forge, getting the job done and doing what it does.

It's also pretty cool that the hotel has partnership with the four-story Bally's (LA Fitness) across the parking lot. What other hotel is going to have a better workout facility?! Not many! I was going to call it complimentary, but no. it is in your bill unseen somewhere.

One weird thing was the shower doors. They are this sliding like thing with no lock/latch to secure the door. It wasn't a problem for me, just awkward and of an interest to you.

Also note worth is that the enormous King Prussia Mall is directly across the street making for plenty of eating and drinking options to go along with unlimited shopping.

Beautiful facility. Clean and Nicely upgraded room. No bed bugs, lol.The breakfast was certainly not your run of the mill, gloopy mess. He eggs taste like eggs and the selection is ample. Loved the little cereal boxes and milk you can take for the little ones. There was always plenty of food when I went and the to go Seattles best coffee was genius! Most of the staff was friendly; one suggested we take their shuttle to the airport, which is across the street and then shuttle from there to one of the casinos. As we were carless, this was much appreciated. The free ice was helpful, as we kept a nice ice chest with plenty of drinks and the soaps, shower, fridge were much appreciated. The pressure on the water was a little much for my toddler but I enjoyed it. Knocked off a star because the pool was only open for a limited time. I wish I could have enjoyed maybe a few extended hours during my trip there. Pool closes at 10 and with the busy schedule we had, we never made it over there. Also, while most staff was friendly there were some glaring front desk staff that made this place seem quite stuffy and unwelcoming for us. We paid over $600 for the three nights we were there. Certainly expected a much more welcoming staff for that price. We will not be staying here in the future because to me, customer service is EVERYTHING. If I feel uncomfortable walking through the lobby to my room, why come back?

I love this place!  If you have little ones and want to entertain them, this is a great option in Tarpon Springs.  We spend a few hours here every time we are in town.  The kids love the touch tank and interaction with the snakes, sharks and stingrays.  The staff is very knowledgeable about the different marine creatures. It's air-conditioned and has an adjacent indoor playground/bounce house for the kids!  Don't miss the coupon in the Tarpon Spring's tourist map for a free cup of food to feed the sharks and stingrays!

We love the game room as well as the outdoor seating on the patio. Mark and Josh do a great job talking to tables to make sure everyone is satisfied. Great staff and they work as a team.  Also enjoy the happy hour menu....plenty to choose from including a $3 footlong hotdog.

You will enjoy yourself at Henry's for sure!!!

This place truly is quite gimmicky, as you would expect from a typical gift shop, but it's got enough of the usual fares to keep you and your loved ones content and satisfied after a trip away from home. I'm a poor sap of a collector for souvenir spoons, so after the staff were incredibly helpful to point out all of the potential spoons I could buy, I spent the rest of the 20 minutes looking for stuff for the rest of the family and fiancée. Unfortunately, even with all of cowboy hats, t-shirts, shot glasses, pork-inspired snacks, I still couldn't find an item that suited my needs.

Maynards! I LOVE YOUR FOOD. I have eaten indoors and outdoors, and the service has always been divine. My most recent experience was about a month ago. My husband and I were having our last date night before I left for a trip and he left for work. 

We came in on a Monday night. It was not crowded, but it was pretty late for dinner. I think we were there around 8PM. We ordered the Poutine which are fries made in duck fat, with duck confit, foie gras, cheese curds, and topped with duck gravy. That plate in itself is absolutely breathtakingly fabulously delicious. I am not going overboard with the description. Just order the Poutine... it is mind-blowing.

The waiter recommended a wine. I can't remember, but it was delicious. Maynard's has a very good drink selection as far as cocktails and wine go. I ordered the pork shank. It was pretty ridiculous in size. There were so many flavors in that dish that it was hard to combine them all in one bite. It was definitely a winner in my book. The portion size was huge, so I was definitely unable to even make it look like I tried to eat it. Nevertheless, my experience was wonderful.

If you are looking for an upscale atmosphere and wonderful food, check out Maynards. You won't be disappointed!

The Gyro Shack is where it's at! If you're ever in Boise and have a hankering for quick, quality, and inexpensive Greek -- GO HERE. The ingredients are fresh and delicious, made by friendly staff. They even have a frequent buyer card to work towards getting free gyros, which is very easy to fill once you've had your first taste.

I have been a customer for about 2 years with Jayme. I love love love my lashes. They consistently last about 3 weeks(with normal shedding) and don't require any extra care that some lashes I have had in the past did. I shower and wash my face and my lashes stay perfect! If you have had a bad experience with other lashes not lasting definitely give Lash Therapy a try, you won't be disappointed.

There's just something about Berwyn Vet that I absolutely adore. They remind me of what a veterinary practice would be like if you were in Ireland. There is a feeling of home when I am there .......I love all the girls and their special care of my Ginger especially Dr. Whipple. Thank you for all of your care & expertise including accupuncture for my baby girl Ginger ~ 0X0X0X

I love this little coffee shop. Close to my house, cozy and hip. Reminds me of something that'd be in the city. Cute little section selling homemade goods. The food is great and so is the coffee of course. They even let you bring your dog in to order ( can't stay and sit with the dog though. Bummer. )

They only let me have 2 pancakes at a time and when I ordered more it took another 10 minutes! My friend got a egg croissant and there were egg shells in it. And when we told them, they did not even apologize! Horrable service, bad wait, and to top it off dont know hot to cook.

Enthusiastic and friendly staff, nice optometrist, great prices. I indulged in the buy one pair, get the lenses half off promotion at the end of March. (They will run the special again during back to school time). Also, prescription sunglasses were only $99.00

Great value.

DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY!  I made an online purchase with House of Beauty (housebeautyworld.com) for a very specific product.  Once selected, the product photo in the cart confirmed the correct selection.  However, when I received the order, it was not the product I selected.  It had been switched with my knowledge or consent.  Regretfully, because I trusted this company, I did not notice the switch in the confirmation email.  Also regretfully, I missed the 5-day return policy as I was out of town when it was delivered (had it sent to a family member).  Once I returned, two weeks later, I immediately contacted House of Beauty via their customer service email to tell them of the error.  I was very surprised and disappointed with the curt response I received.  There was no effort to offer any reconciliation for their error.  I've since learned that the product I ordered had been discontinued, which probably explains the switch.  I've also learned that they have a D+ rating with the BBB.  I hope this helps others who shop online.,.do your homework if it's the first time you're shopping with a company.  I'm now out $101 as I cannot use the product sent...it's in the trash.

It is so nice to find a locally owned family place to eat.  Food and service is always tops.  If you are looking for a place to eat that is not a big chain place this is it.   I appreciate how at tentative the wait staff is.   I had the NY Strip tonight and it was done perfect.  The steak was great.   I will see them again next time I am in town.   I can always refer this place to all of my friends

this was my 5th carnival cruise. the worst ever! any form of service was gone. they are running a skeleton crew except for drink services where they make their money. used to recommend carnival. NEVER AGAIN!! from being packed in the cruise terminal like cattle to the dirty dishes in our stateroom when we got to it to the public hairs in the shower waiting to surprise us on the first shower, or the 3 hours straight of trying to get room service to answer the phone, or the waiter being the only one in our half of the restaurant. they may be saving money but when nobody goes back, was it really worth it?

This is a great new STL store. The prices are good. I bought an iron garden chair here for $24,very ornate details, I got it home and a friend gave me an antique appraisal book. As I was skimming through the book I saw my exact chair-$200. That sounds like an awesome deal to me. Check out quintessential antiques-practically next door. Two of my fav stores side by side!

I called the morning after Labor Day right a 8:05 AM and someone came out around 1:00 PM as promised.  The serviceman was friendly, thorough, competent and honest.  He washed out my AC which apparently was a mess, fixed a previously unknown problem that was causing it to become dysfunctional and was very helpful with my questions.  Cost seemed reasonable.
Much better experience  this time.  Great upbeat staff!   Everyone is having a great time. And the Dropkick Murphys on the sound system make it even better!

The service: really, really good. Again, the waitstaff seem genuinely interested in making sure you enjoy the experience. Our waitress was very down to earth with us. When we asked how a certain item on the menu was, she was very honest. 
The location is wonderful. 10 steps from the beautiful white sands of St. Pete Beach.

Burgers are real winners, juicy and char-grilled. I recommend the burger with guacamole and bacon. Mmm.
Food was cold and the taco was more lettuce than anything. Will not be back at this location

Glad we chose this hotel. It is located about a few miles from downtown Reno but it is much nicer and you deal with less people and less smoke. The room was spacious and clean. Check in was quick. We requested some more towels and they were delivered within 10mins. Good customer service. Lots of restaurants, bars and tv's. I would def come back to this hotel whenever I go back to visit Reno.

They are having a promotion, anytime the temp hits over 23 you get a free order of wings. So it was packed when I met up with my wife and some friends and we had a booth which was rare, but they got there early. 

With it being as busy as it was, I can understand that service is going to be hit, so I can't fault them too much. But my wife had to ask numerous times for her water, not once did it have the lemon that she requested. They didn't have enough napkins at the table and had to wait a while for them as well. 

The wings were good, they've added some new flavours, the maple bacon was amazing!

We'll start with the ambiance - small and uber trendy, right on track with the urban industrial chic movement. Next, the service - nice bartending, nothing exceptional though. And the food - a pretty interesting beer list (both draught and bottled) and a nice little cocktail menu. 

The veggie burger (yes, because of Food Network) was pretty good, though I wasn't super blown away. The brisket fries (which we heard is soon to be on a Food Network show) were pretty damn good. We'll be back for the meat burgers and more trials of the draughts and cocktails.
Me likely. Tim likey. My friends likey. Already said d they have excellent Old Fashioneds.
The best french toast I have ever tried in my life!!! I want everyone and their mothers to try it right now! PS someone pls bring me some to Miami!

I love me some Cheeseburger In Paradise.  
CIP's menu suits my taste buds very well.  There are many things that sound good.. but I almost always get the same thing.  The Jerk chicken wrap with sweet potato chips.  Occasionally, my stomach will come calling for some dill pickle chips too.  

The atmosphere for those who haven't been is 'Paradise', but not over the top tacky like some other places.  They have a tiki bar in the middle for your drinking needs with some TV's and such.  There is a good amount of room within the restaurant with a nice area by the patio for larger parties. We've never had a problem with service. They do get bogged down at times, but always take care of us.  

They have a decent mixed drink menu, but I think their beer selection is one of the things that is really lacking.  I'd love to see this beefed up a bit with some more Caribbean flavors and choices.  

The food is great.  In my opinion the quality is very good for the price.  I love the jerk chicken wrap as its something you don't see many other places (I would like to see a grilled jerk chicken wrap).

I would reccomend this gym 120x over. The gents who run the place are top notch. I really enjoy the diverse selection of equipment to choose from. Lastly, the personal training sessions with Mike are THE BOMB!!

Stumbled across this place a little while back. It's in a Plaza and they were doing construction so it was hard to see. If you are looking for a healthy place this is definitely the place. Everything starts off vegetarian and then you can add meat if you want. I will say that when you add the meat the price seems a little high. The caloric intake of the entrees is not always low so be mindful of that. I also ordered their energy bites and they were yummy but pricy as you only get two. Overall   great for vegetarians and health conscious but a little pricy. I would go back.

I was really impressed with this courtyard...especially after reading the mediocre reviews on here.  The staff was wonderful...from the valets to the front desk to the bartenders.  The all gave great advice on where to go and what to do.  You simply cannot ask for a better location.  Less than a 5 minute walk to Broadway...even in heels ;)  The room was clean and comfortable.  Nothing overly exciting as far as decor but not your standard Courtyard.  If you are looking for a great place to stay with friendly staff and an unbeatable location, stay here.  I know I will be the next time I'm in Nashville

Another favorite. This place is my home away from everything. It is hard to leave because I am truly treated like one of their own.  Toni, Carla, Jackie, and Brian are the very best at what they do. I love them and they love me... they prove that every visit with service, presentation,  and food that will make you forget your name.
Always satisfy with the job and the attention the staff provides me with! Both Sam and He are amazing! I absolutely love it here! This place is very nice and clean and relaxing! Can't complain.

Siam Elephant has risen back to the top of my local faves! They've punched more favor into their dishes. It had dipped down and become somewhat bland (only 3 star worthy), but with this latest visit just the other night, in which I had the pumpkin curry and my wife the pad thai, we both agreed that it was as good as ever. Way to bounce back Siam Elephant!

This is a nice hotel. It's a Hampton, but since it's in the Garden District, it's more expensive than your typical Hampton. We paid 152 (AAA discount) for a king-sized bed room. That said, the parking is free, which is not the case in most NOLA hotels, so, in that respect, the room wasn't expensive at all.
Front desk was super-friendly and welcoming.
If you need to use the gym, there is one a block away that you have to walk to, but it's very nice and so were the people who greeted me there. 
Also, there is no laundry room, but luckily, we didn't need one this time.
It's sonic. What do you expect. Sometimes it just hits the spot. And a sonic drink during happy hour is never a bad thing!

Love their soups...hate their sandwiches.  

I have eaten here twice and both times got the bowl of soup/half a sandwich combo.  The soups were both fantastic!  One was the baked potato soup and the other creamy turkey and rice.  The sandwiches on the other hand, terrible.

First time was the turkey artichoke, which was nothing special, but gave me terrible indigestion later.  Second time was the smokehouse turkey.  The turkey was way too "smoked" and the ale mustard was so overwhelming that I couldn't taste anything else.  My husband also got the steak and white cheddar special and didn't like it at all.  Hardly any meat on the baguette and what was on there was dry and crusty.

Pluses are the service is always very fast and the restaurant is clean.
Superb amenities. Nice people in a very nice community. Highly recommended. The price is a little more than I can afford long term

Your expectations should be that you are going to order food, wait for it to be prepared, carry it to a bench and eat it outside.  If you have an expectation that you will be served, or in a place that is quiet - this isn't your place.  BUT if you want a really relaxing, nice and fun experience - this is one of the best places we have been to in the Carp area.  I almost always get the same thing, Fish and Chips, my family get different things - burgers and sandwiches.  They like it and never say that their meal wasn't good.

Lots of young families - really worth a visit!

What is GREAT about this Starbucks is its location, as Gerald S noted.   Given the dearth of decent "to go" coffee purveyors in this area, Starbucks is a nice addition to this neighborhood.   As other Yelpers have noted, this is a relatively small store.  It has comfy chairs and is a nice place to meet a friend for coffee and convo. The staff is pleasant and helpful even if they are not always burdened with a sense of urgency.

I'm sentimental about George Thomas, since they've been around since I lived in Indianapolis over 25 years ago. 

The flowers are always fresh and delivery is always as promised. My friends and relatives are never disappointed, which is saying something, since the nationwide services often make delivery mistakes or provide less than satisfactory flowers.

I was pleasantly surprised at the very low cost to get flowers to one of my dearest friends on Mother's Day this year. Furthermore, they have my trust, because they admitted when I attempted to order for some more of my relatives that they are overwhelmed with orders and might not be able to deliver on time. I doubt that many florists would be candid about that. Because of this candor, they lost my business for one other order this week, but I will trust them just that much more.
The food is great and staff is always friendly.  Love taking my boys here for breakfast/lunch.

This place took 45 mins to get our order with only 6 people in the restaurant...... they didn't have all ingredients to make what we ordered food was horrible! How u mess up breakfast food? This place gets five thumbs down
the chicken was moist and had great flavor to it. i was a little sad they did not serve Brisket at dinner but both the Hot Chicken and the 1/4 chicken meal were great.
This place was fun! Cheap, easy, good food. Customer service was blah but it was cool being in a vintage place....

I've been going to Kary's Salon for about 4+ years now. She and all her stylists are great and talented at what they do. I started the process of going blonde here and I always get compliments on my hair. Every person that asks me who does my hair, I ALWAYS refer them to Kary's Salon!! Their prices are also very reasonable compared to other salons in the city.

With my full set of highlights, I usually spend about 2 hours here, so I'm always seeing the cuts they do. These ladies actually listen to what you want and they do what you want. When I tell Kary I only want an inch off, she does exactly that. They are great at cutting men's hair as well. My eyebrows are always on point because of them! If I could give them more stars, I would!!

Great happy hour deals! They also have a decent beer selection, including gluten free beer. Dinner has always been delicious. Service is generally good- our servers/bartenders have always been courteous, quick on the refills, and really nice. My favorites are the mussels, Parmesan fries, crab cake sandwich, and shrimp Caesar salad. The desserts are also always fantastic- freshly made on site and delicious.

Kinda disappointed The price was really high and it's not that good Our table isn't clean and the food wasn't good I ordered bbq shrimp super disappointed but my boyfriend ordered something with chicken he said its alright Anyway we payed about 80$

Best buffet I have ever been to WAY worth the code not a single item I got wasn't fantastic. The Chinese soup though is a winner. They keep serving a half hour after they close and our serve even offered us coffee after our meal. The gelato is so amazing as well
Cheese Grits were delicious! I would definitely go back. Service was wonderful too and amazing coffee. Great food for the price and hue plus that they open extremely early.

I was in here last Saturday and I will never go to a different spa again. It was so serene and beautiful inside. I got a massage and a mani/pedi and I left feeling like a million dollars. The staff here are all so kind and easy to talk to. They all know exactly what they're doing. I will most definitely be coming back in the very near future!

Complained about the girl (not the daughter of owner nor owner) because she went off on my mom for accidentally hitting a display with purse in passing. Visited the store 2 days later and gave her my card to have owner call me. Spoke with owner, very nice. She apologized. Employee called me and threatened me saying "they don't believe you" "I am going to filing a restraining order" said crazy things!!!! Was appalled! Immediately took a snap shot of my caller ID so I could show owner!  This girl is unstable and crazy!!!!!

The best part of the arena is the amount of awesome bars you can drink at before and after the game. There is not a bad seat in the house here for a hockey game and getting to and from the arena is so easy

Loved the chicory coffee but I found the counter service to be pretty unresponsive. Perhaps I caught them at an off-time, but I felt like I was imposing to get the woman to wait on me. I only wanted a praline and cup of coffee.

I've given this place several tries as it's in my neighborhood.
First time we went there it had just opened. It was great. Food was fast and tasty.
Second time we got our food to go. We ordered through Waitr and my food took an hour to get to my house. They forgot the dressing for salad, and when I called to tell them I had no dressing, it was a very awkward conversation with a lot of silence on their part and no apology? 
Third time my pasta was super bland. It literally just tasted like butter and noodles. But, my husband enjoyed his po boy. 
And my final time, yesterday, we ordered through pickup it took an hour and 45 minutes for the Waitr app to say my food was ready for pickup. When I picked it up, it was extremely cold. 

It seems as though this place had a great start and has gone off the deep end fast. I work in the restaurant business myself, andI know how important it is to just be nice, apologize and make an effort to get the food out in a timely fashion and it seems like this place hasn't picked up on any of those things. It's a real shame.

Totally best neighborhood grill in New Orleans... if you only go to New Orleans once.. this is the place...don't waste a meal... this is the place... everyone in the part shared the same comments... had the surf and turf... ad the cat meunière ... yep..... da bomb!!!!!
Many pizza choices and good beer list. Pizza was delivered promptly and service good. Pizza variety varies.

Wife and I stopped in for an early dinner.  We both love BBQ; I've been smoking meats for 20+ years. 

Can't figure out previous comment about grit in sauce; they do have a finishing sauce on the ribs which were both outstanding and very tender.  In addition both the sausage and brisket were excellent with just the right amount smoke flavor. 

For sides we had the baked beans, green beans and cornbread. Baked beans were some of the best we've had, and cornbread was excellent. Green beans were a bit crunchy for our taste but had great flavor. 

Overall, a great experience and it's nice to have a good BBQ offering in the Horsham area. We will be back soon.

The food is consistently 5 star quality being tasty,, fresh ingredients, and huge portions. However, the service is consistently 0 stars. I have waited as long as 30 minutes to have my order taken and another 30 minutes for the food to be served.  On my last visit, after being served , the wait person did not return until I signaled that I needed the check. Before that, dirty dishes remained on the table, we needed more drinks, and no offer of dessert was made.

We FINALLY made it to the Body Worlds Exhibit last night for what was our very first experience at the Telus World of Science.

First things first, if you can get here before this exhibit moves on, it is absolutely worth it!  What an incredible view into the fragile yet oh-so-powerful body that each of us inhabits?!?! While it is a very graphic exhibit (Insert disclaimer here)  I marveled at the  things to see, the fantastically fun facts, and the intricacies of how our many parts work together!  

So now on to the museum itself: while the Body Worlds Exhibit caters to an older crowd - there are plenty of other exhibits where I found myself wishing we'd brought a ten-year old along to TRULY appreciate the experience. We enjoyed the hands-on weather stations where we created a tornado. We loved looking at the tropical fish. And we appreciated the artifacts and photos detailing the history of law enforcement officials. While we're far from being ten-years-old, there was plenty to see and to interact with!  The best part for us, is that on a Friday night at approximately 8:30, there weren't any school field trips and for the most part the exhibits were quiet.  

Although we absolutely enjoyed our visit, and may go back for free entry to the observatory, the entry fee of $26.00 per adult means we'll be finding something else to do next weekend.

Wow!!! It's like a Wine-a-palooza in there!!!  And beer and liquor.  Total Wine is exactly that...Total Wine.  At first arrival, it can be a bit daunting as to where to start or what to look at.  But I find this place very exciting for many reasons.  

A) They have the largest stock of wines from all over the world that I have ever seen.  Easily broken down into varieties (Chardonnay, Cabernet, Rose, etc.)  So, if you know that you only like a certain type of wine, then simply can go to that shelf and ohh and ahh to your hearts desire.  

B)  The staff here is very friendly and knowledgable with all they wine varieties they have in stock.  They make great suggestions and as you look through the shelves, you see certain wines marked as a "staff favorite" or "Number 1 Pinot Noir", which is incredibly helpful to me.  

C) If you aren't a huge wine enthusiast, check out all the beer options they have as well.  So many choices from all around the world.  Their liquor stock is incredible too.
