They have great prices ranging from "I'm a little broke but still want to get buzzed" to "I just got a new job and I want to splurge on a nice bottle"  So there is a little something for everyone.
The doughnuts are good, but the apple fritter may be the best I have ever had.  Stopped in on a Sunday afternoon and full selection was still available and fresh.

I've been going here regularly for several years and have been pretty satisfied with their service and food.

My order is ready when they say it'll be ready.  The staff there are usually pleasant to interact with, and the price is fine.  The food is good and has been consistent throughout the years.

A couple of times they've messed up my order (that's really not that bad since I've been going here for several years), but they always redeem themselves by fixing the mistake for me, which I really, really appreciate! They actually take care of me, their customer, which is wonderful (since so many other places don't). 

I'll keep going here unless they give me a reason not to.

I've had good experiences here and recommend this place.

The pizzsa here is sublime. Order the margherita and experience bliss. It is a little pricey for me so sadly I cannot go frequently but you are getting a high quality product for the price. I took my kids during pope week and my 12 year old boy declared it the greatest pizza he had ever eaten. Funny story, a few days later we were at Lo Spiedo eating some wings and my sond said he has not tasted food this good since we had that pizza last week. He did not know they were both Vetri places. When I told him he was not surprised
El Jefe is the bomb!  Wife liked the eggs Benedict too. Great food, great service!

Oh, the Pancake!  Many a hung-over breakfast was spent there in my single days.  This place is fun if you want to meet up with your friends in the Village and stand in line a long time  (out the door!) or wake up at 2:00 p.m. and roll in shortly before close.  I love Southern breakfast food.  While this is standard fare, the reason why Pancake got so popular, for people wondering what the big deal is, has to do with Nashville being Music City U.S.A. and musicians eating there- not so much for the food.  That is the secret.  I, personally, am not a country music fan nor have I ever been the star struck type.  Who knows (or cares) whether the rich and famous even deign to descend on the Pancake anymore.  But, as a native Nashvillian reading the bad reviews here, I feel it my duty to give you the DL on why Pancake became the hot spot that it is.

The owner of this place wiil cut deals for business and is very friendly & polite,  they do lots of services you wouldnt expect, like elec window motors, etc, "one stop shop" in most cases.all equipment in good working orderl as well.

I loved loved loved my 80 minute Swedish massage here. I was so relaxed and it was exactly what I was looking for. I wasn't extremely pleased with my manicure though. I would recommend the massage but the manicure was a disappointment.

Very cool spot with DELICIOUS  food. I wasn't expecting much at first, but everything we ordered was phenomenal! We had the wings (can't remember the name, but it had curry in it), pulled pork sliders, another slider (hamburger like), and the brisket sliders. The wings were seriously the most delicious wings I have ever had in my entire life- the breading was crunchy, yet not too crunchy, and the meat was tender. The sliders were als also incredible. If the three different sliders we tried, the brisket was my least favorite, but it was still delicious

I love this place and everything about it.
Love a place that is casual with great wine and atmosphere. Very relaxing after a tough day. Very clean

This place has so many delicious choices that you don't know where to start. There is always a big crowd here. They say to follow the less beaten path. In this case follow the path that leads to Mazzaro's. I got a chicken parm sandwich which was great. It was on toasted bun with a huge juicy chicken breast, lots of good red sauce. Also got a meatball sausage pizza and Mazzaro burger for nephew at home. Everything was so good and great quality for the prices.

Michelle is excellent! I went in initially for back pain but she has also helped me with other health concerns. I leave feeling great. The environment is comfortable and welcoming. I recommend Gathering Point to everyone!
Went with a group of people, it was an ok time. In my opinion this place is a bit overrated. But for $12 not a bad show

We have had Jason groom our dog twice and both times he has done a great job. The last groomer who was mobile said the 6.3 lb Maltese needed to be sedated the next time I saw her favor a back leg after (the dog not the groomer). With Jason she is just fine and looks great and doesn't seemed stressed when we pick her up. 
He also trims our rescue Chihuahuas nails for cheap.. can't beat him hope this don't make him too busy for us to get in...

I ate here last night while checking out First Friday Channelside. It was a pleasant find. Even though it appeared busy, my friend and I were seated right away. My friend did not eat anything, but ordered a beer, which was  like 5 bucks. I ordered a fancy drink (sangria-rita) and the avacodo deluxe (stuffed avacodo with ahi tuna). Both were delicious. Our server was nice enough, he was timely with bringing our food and drinks. I would eat here again. Good food and reasonable prices. I'm sure I will next time I'm in channelside.

I didn't give it 1 star only because I'm trying to be understanding of the situation. My tour guide got food poisoning and my tour was canceled at the last minute on my last night in Nola. My biggest problem with the fact is that they only have one tour guide for this company at the moment, and so if anything happens to them, you're screwed. Very disappointed to have missed out on what sounded like a great tour. Please have better protocols in place for something like this.

WOW!!! The name says it all what a MARATHON!!!The wait time to get your order is ridiculous!!! Waited over 30 minutes and the excuse was "We had a large party" how is that MY fault???Food is very average. Won't be back!! Offered dessert for the trouble, then when we ordered we were informed we could only get one dessert.  Humm... There were 2 in our party. Not a good experience, 
don't bother. There are far better restaurants in Philly to try!

We were there this past weekend and we got in after a 20 minute wait we were seated. Which was pretty good on a Saturday night. As soon as we were seated, the server came over, took our drink and appetizer order. We were immediately given our drinks, yummy bread, and our appetizer. Service was great up to this point only. Then it was downhill. Our dinner was taking a long time to be brought out, and we never saw our server, she never came by to check on us, give us an update or anything, we just sat there.

The food was bad. I ordered the prime rib special, which came with mashed potatoes, salmon and a small lobster tail, so I thought. When it finally came out, I couldn't even tell it was prime rib. It was so blackend, that for me, it was too spicy to eat. I couldn't taste anything but pepper. I did notice the prime rib was not juciy but dry and tough. I was wondering about the salmon, well come to find out it was salmon mashed potatoes, which was gross. It was so fishy, it wasn't even dressed up with butter or anything! The only good food item was my lobster tail. My partner had the lamb, which was tough and not juicy and was just ok, nothing special.

Without alcohol our food bill was over $100. I feel so jipped for paying that much for what we had. It was one of the worst meals I have ever had.

Yes, I did send my prime rib back and guess what, now they were all out. So I had the last piece, that was just sitting for who knows how long in the pan, so it makes since on why they tried to cover that fact up with seasoning..lol...They brought me out a filet mignon piece and it was much better but still no bang for my buck. I can't believe for a restuarant like this, when the food was sent back no manager came out. I got better service at the Outback at home.

No amenities. The locker/ lounge area is not up to date ! No champagne or beverages are offered without a high extra fee ($25 for a glass of champagne) even if you book several treatments. 


5 stars for the massage and massage room that overlooks the ocean! Absolutely stunning! The pedicure was great, the nail salon small but cute.

This place is GREAT! It is really hard to find a good restaurant of ANY kind here in Port Richey, but I can honestly say that Grand Deli is one of my favorite sub shops, Ive tried multiple different sandwiches here, and have yet to have anything bad! Their brownies are delicious too! Only thing I would change is that their dill pickles were cold but hey I can live with that!

Fave!!!!! I got the low carb bread, trim lavash, tziki sauce, gluten free almond biscotti and gluten free macaroon cookies. Everything cost much less than I expected. Flavor of everything was incredible. Food is of high quality and fresh. I will definitely be going here often.

Mediocre at best.  High ticket prices are fine with me if your food is exceptional.  We started with pretzel coated onion rings.  They were good but there were 4 rings on the plate with enough sauces for plenty of onion rings and the top of the stack was  a ring the size of a silver dollar.  $9....you can buy a ton of onions for 9 dollars. The gentlemen ordered ck tortilla soup and the presentation was awesome but the broth was cold.  No one ever checked after dropping off food.  You would have thought that picking up bowls with all the chips and the butter still in the bowl the server might have asked if things were alright. Our steaks arrived rather slowly and mine, ordered m/r was so rare it was cold in the center.  We had to flag the waitress to send it back.  A man in a sport coat returned it to the table but not a word was said, he laid it on the table and took off.(now it's medium--we'll show you)  I assume he was some sort of manager there were several men with jackets on walking around. If you are going to have food runners serving the tables then someone should shortly be behind to see if things are prepared properly or if anything is needed.  We asked for water 3 different times.  If you are looking for a quiet spot to dine, have good food, and chat this place is not for you.  Very loud . So for $235 dollars for 3 I can go elsewhere for an exceptional dinner.

I can't believe I haven't reviewed rons yet.  Maybe I hesitate because I don't want the wait to get any longer during peak hours.  Although, waiting for a table while enjoying a beer ain't too bad.  Anyway...

Plain and simple it's our go-to restaurant.  We dine there once a week and get takeout probably 3-4 times a week.  We have our favorites - Val's nachos, blackened chicken salad, salmon entree, chicken south philly, boneless wings, cheesesteaks, sorrento, etc... Truth is, everything is good.  Wegmans motto is "food you can feel good about", and although we rarely eat healthy at Ron's, we know it's all made from the best and freshest ingredients possible.  As far as food goes, we typically stick to "bar food" and salads and I can say with confidence it's better and more consistent than anything else around town.    

If you're not into good eats, you should come for the beer.  They always have a great lineup of crafts and the takeout selection is exceptional.  

ROCK club - I don't know the exact math, but I think you get $25 credit for every $500 you spend.  Essentially, that's 5% off every time you go - including booze.    Say what?  That's a club anyone can get behind, especially since they have monthly drawling for random prizes.  I won two phillies tickets in primo seats last summer.  Phillies stink, but what other restaurant is doing this?  

They have great food, great beer, family friendly ambiance, live music on the weekends, great bar tenders and waitstaff, and they reward you for dining with them.  In my opinion, the 5 star rating system is an insult to how great this place actually is.
No coffee in the house is a grocery store emergency.  Thanks Walgreens for stocking kcup coffee.  And with my Walgreens points it was buy two boxes for the price of one.

Great beer, good atmosphere (lots of outdoor seating), and good food. You get a free beer with a growler fill but they don't fill growlers on Sundays. The TVs are very small, it's not a good place to watch sports, which actually could be a plus.

Just not that impressed with the lamb sliders.  Extremely gamey.  However I will try it again and order something different. Maybe.  Perhaps that's something that's not for me.   Service was  great until I was asked to move my seat over to accommodate an additional chair at another table, ( I was sitting at the bar). No problem but the hostess (I  assume) puts my chair at the end of the bar and doesn't ask the other people at the bar to move down. I'm sitting at the corner end of the bar.   I asked for the check at that time. The customer at the bar asked me if I had enough  room after I sat there for a minute. I told her not to worry i asked for the check.

Just had our first meal here. Chose the restaurant based on reviews, and it did not disappoint! Food was fantastic, sangria was delicious and plentiful and Amanda was terrific. The pace of service was perfect - not slow but not hovering. Had the ceviche sampler for appetizer and skirt steak. Food was great and plentiful - looking forward to leftovers tomorrow! Would recommend making reservations.

The studio is the best for all levels of yogis.  The instructors are all. Eh knowledgeable and personable. The scheduling of classes has something for everyone.  I have been practicing here for 9 months and enjoy every session.

Their customer service is top notch. We had prepaid tickets that expired a month before we were able to make a trip to the museum. Customer Service was kind enough to extend our expiration so we did not have to buy new tickets. That is amazing in itself. 

The employees that work here have a crazy amount of energy and enthusiasm. I have no idea how they do this 8 hours a day, 5 days a week. They really make the museum, not the exhibits. 

Speaking of exhibits, no expense seems spared when it comes to building these. And considering thousands of people visit the museum each day, you would never know this as everything looks clean and new. 

The only very slightly negative comment I would have regards the age appropriateness of the exhibits.  This museum is 5 floors! Crazy.  But We went with a 6, 5 and 3 year old. They were really only interested in the lower level, and the fourth floor.  The stuff in between was not much interactive (except the circus exhibit, very cool!) and was more story telling and preaching type stuff. 

The place is really build to appeal to toddlers through teenagers. So keep this in mind. You kids likely won't find everything fascinating. But that's OK.  There is enough in this building to occupy a half day of any kids time. 

Last, we did eat at the first floor cafeteria. It is overpriced, yes. Like every other zoo, museum, and park. Spend your money wisely. Order the pizza family deal and everyone should be happy. Stay away from the cheeseburger. The grilled chicken sandwich is fantastic. Bring your own food if you want to save money.

I ordered a plate of dibi with yellow rice it was good overall just needed a little more seasoning and I like the customer service. They offered me tea while I waited for my food to be served which was a lovely thing because it was cold outside so it helped warm me up.

We have used Pinellas Tree Service on two previous occasions.  The first to trim a large Queen Palm and the second to remove a large ailing Slash Pine.  Both job were handled professionally and at a reasonable cost.  
When the time came to again trim the palm we called Pinellas Tree.  A friendly secretary took the information, thanked us for calling them and said their arborist  would contact us promptly which he did.  After evaluating the tree we were informed the tree was diseased with Ganoderma, root rod, and should be removed before it fell.  We agreed and accepted the proposal to cut down and remove the tree then grind the stump. 
Saturday night the area suffered a severe storm, high winds and torrential rain.  These conditions caused the tree to fall missing everything but the ground.   The downed tree unfortunately blocked our driveway and part of the neighborhood street.  We were able to cut the tree into manageable pieces, unblock the street and driveway.  We emailed Pinellas Tree Service who immediately responded,  This morning they arrived at 7:45pm and removed the debris. for a very nominal and reasonable charge.  
We feel comfortable recommending this company.
If I could give it no stars, I would. The worst, most favorless meal ever. While they were semi-apologetic, it didn't make up for the food. Just bad.

A great alternative to Starbuck's chain atmosphere and burnt-tasting coffee roasts. The Gryphon is what a coffee spot should be. A mix of young, and not so young clientele. The coffee offerings are good, but not superb. Other beverages are also good-offbeat sodas, homemade lemonades, and really decent hot chocolate. The food works in a pinch, but more about the  beverages. The only downside is that it has been overrun by "the Wayne ladies who lunch," and a fair number of "alternative" poseurs wearing crocs. The counter staff can be a bit flaky but adds to the charm.

One of my most favorite things to do while visiting a city is to go to the laundromat.  It is where the real people are!  This is a great, clean friendly little place just off the street car line.  It's really easy to get to and a very safe area to be in.

I've been looking for a salon to call home for a while and after reading the reviews on Yelp, I decided to give this a try. I've been wanting this very specific ash colour for my hair and have had 3 failed attempts resulting in fried, damaged hair. 

As I started to give up on the dream hair, I gave Beauty Parlour a call and thought this will be my last attempt. Had a consultation with Kat, she is very knowledgable and she knows her stuff! I left the consultation feeling very confident in their ability. Plus, the salon is GORGEOUS! It's a beautiful space and I love the shabby chic decor with so much personality. As the cherry on top, they are environmentally conscious and only use products that support this vision.

I had to wait one month to get in, they are booked well in advance. Finally, my appointment day came and I am completely in love with the result. Kat totally nailed it, all in one shot! I am impressed and would definitely recommend the Beauty Parlour to everyone!

I've been here twice for eyebrow threading and I've never been so happy with my eyebrows in all the years I've gotten them done elsewhere! My eyebrows are finally becoming the shape I've always desired, after only two visits. Not to mention, the price for threading and quality is unbeatable- especially for broke college students like myself :) I plan on coming back here regularly- highly recommend!

This is my first review in my new hometown, Nashville!  Local Taco is close to our new house and we went there almost every day for lunch as we unpacked our house.  I LOVE the tacos.  (My faves are the brisket, the buttermilk fried chicken, and the korean bbq.)  The skillet corn was also tasty, and I loved the giant glasses of pop with shaved ice.  

The only warning I would give is that the line can get long, especially on weekends and around noon.  However, the service and management aim to please and as long as you know it may be a bit of a wait, it's not bad.  

We'll be back many times!

Very good, locally owned, neighborhood joint! All three sandwiches and fries were under $30 and the the food came out rapidly. As someone on the industry, I'm glad when your order is cooked FRESH! As it was here. I'm picky when it comes to tomatoes and dressing my sandwich but they nailed it!!! Extra pickles add onions no tomatoes. We ate, we sighed and then passed out after a long extended weekend of work for us all. Will be back soon you guys!!!

Excellent selection of beers - especially if you're into IPAs. Pretty good bar food...I mean, it all tastes the same after a few beers anyway. Great parking situation with probably 50 or 100 spaces between their own lot and plentiful street parking. Plus, it's stumbling distance to the train station in case you've had too many and need to head home.

Very rude and attitude and cashier does not feel like taking your order and ordered the wrong thing and does not feel like giving you a refund without having an attitude and refusing to do an x-ray for something else that you do not want

Although somewhat on the expensive side, Pho Orchid offers quality Vietnamese Food. They offer the basic array of Vietnamese dishes (rice, noodle, bahn mi) along with some specials and one very unique dish -- buttered chicken wings (which are a must-try). 

As I mentioned, some of the prices are a wee bit high and they are closed on Wednesdays, but the quality of the food is consistently good and I've never been let down by their service. Although I enjoyed Le Viet Cafe, which previously occupied the space, I find Pho Orchid to be a improvement.

The vibe was cute. Waited in line for a table on a Friday morning but the wait was over an hour. Instead decided I was going to get a take out coffee. It took 15 mins to order and I waited another 15 mins for the coffee that was just average. Don't think I'd bother trying to come here again, not worth the wait...

I love this place! Solid gyros and side salads, and really wonderful baklava. I personally have never had anything less than superior customer service here as well - the young women who work the cash register are always swift and friendly. :)

Got my wedding dress here!
The owner, Jayna, was super nice and did a terrific job altering the dress so it fit me like a glove. I would definitely recommend this cute shop- its a nice shop right downtown and Jayna is great with alterations and has some really nice dresses- which was perfect for my beach wedding.

This place couldn't be any more adorable if it tried.  A local pet store catering to only the best for your four legged babies, Spot's is a gem out in East Nashville that should be your first stop over PetSmart or other large and cold pet shops.  Organic treats, real healthy eating options, friendly owners...this place is truly wonderful.  You will pay a bit more but what you're paying for are real healthy options to better the life and health of your pet...and let's face it, most of us love our pups and kitties more than people half the time.  With so much garbage in the usual store pet grub, a place like Spot's stands out as a better option to provide your little furry ones with what they truly deserve - a healthy diet, great toys, and fantastic snacks.  I will be coming back here considering how fast the treats I brought home were devoured by my little guy.  And think of it as spending a little more on good food and long life over vet bills for poor health.  Spot's is what we as Nashvillians should rally behind, local shops catering to what matters most to us.

My bf and I saw a groupon for this restaurant and decided to try it. When we walked in, we were seated immediately and was greeted right away. We were seated in the corner for two people, however, we thought that the table was kind of small for us.

We ordered the mussels ($14) as our appetizers. Good thing, we finished the appetizer first before our entrees came because you couldn't have fit 3 plates on that table. The mussels were okay.. We definitely had better. I guess, we were a little disappointed that the mussels weren't bigger since they should be in season? I mean, the Italian market is like right there... and they sell a lot of fresh seafood there. Anyways, as my entree, I decided on the seafood pescatore ($26) and my bf got the chicken alfredo ($19). I felt that my dish wasn't as great. There was good amount of seafood but the sauce was a little off for me. My bf's dish was mediocre at best. It didn't look that appetizing nor did it taste that great. It was really bland and we added salt and pepper so that it could taste a little better. 

Honestly, we were sort of disappointed since a friend did recommend this place. It could be that our friend has bad taste or it could be, what we ordered? We decided to skip desserts since we weren't really satisfied with our meals. I'm glad that we had a groupon because we were not happy with our meal. We don't mind paying the price for good food but we felt that it wasn't worth it here. I gave it 2 stars because everyone was really friendly.

This location is the weakest of the Bully's franchises.  I swear the food isn't as good as the others and the wait staff is not as good and friendly.  They spend most of the time grouped by the soda fountain discussing god knows what.  All the while your soda remains empty.

If I was only rating the food I might give this place five stars. We has the tikki masala, the lamb samosas, half a tandoori chicken, and some garlic naan and everything was fantastic. If you like flavorful Indian-Paki food, this place is a hit.

The wait staff wasn't all that great however. The young girl that was serving us was very disinterested and disengaged. Don't go in expecting classy service or anything. They have some liquor but don't expect them to know how to prepare your mixed drink of choice unless its as simple as adding ice.  They also have a small wine list; nothing to write home about. I also wouldn't really take advice on any of these wines from the wait staff as I'm not sure they'd be able to help.

To sun up, remember that the food is great. Just go in with the mindset that your service will be poor.

The Local Taco is not your average taco joint.  It's eclectic, it's a Sylvan Park hotspot, it's nontraditional, it's in one word -Yum.

Each day there is a different taco on special, my favorite is Wednesday's Lobster BLT, how can one not love something that incorporated both lobster and bacon in a soft taco shell?!  Another favorite of mine is the Brisket Taco that can also be ordered as an enchilada, tender smoked brisket with pickled red onions, it's divine.  Tequila Lime Chicken Taco, Shrimp with Lemon Sauce... the flavor combinations go on and on...   Sangria is made fresh daily and is available with either red or white wine. 

This is not authentic or traditional Mexican food, this is a hip spin on tacos, a boutique taco shop with extremely reasonable prices.

I've gone here three times now and it does not disappoint. 
It's a sure great location by bike or car. The trail directly connect to it. 
The outside dog area is an awesome idea and perfectly executed. Especially for people like me who don't like leaving their mutt at home! 
My two favorite dishes are the meatballs and the broccoli César salad.
Love this store!!! So many wonderful things for children!! Love to shop here for unusual gifts for friends!! I will always shop here first for Grandchildren and shower gifts! Love it!

Tip: Don't be fooled by the weird entrance and accidentally wind up in the Hair Cuttery.

This Trader Joe's is very friendly. They always seem well stocked on items and very eager to help you with anything you might need. Since everyone is so friendly who works here, I'd suggest budgeting a little extra time waiting in checkout since the cashiers tend to chat up the customers. That's nice, if you're not on your lunch break.

They don't sample out any vegan items, as long as I've been going there. I'd like to see those items sampled more often so I know what new vegan items to try.

Pricey but good! Two of us had breakfast here for $26. I got a coffee (nice big serving) and lox plate, and he got an OJ and a veggie wrap. Everything was tasty. The service here was quick and friendly. It would make 5 stars if the prices were a little lower but it was awesome here!

The ambiance is nice. I'd go back!

Very Cute French style market and restaurant. 3 different ordering areas...brunch/breakfast, sandwiches/hot food, and salads. Wine/beer cooler area as well. Great options at all ordering areas and very stylish decor.  Very posh place! Wine on draft and frosè!! Brunch was very tasty as well! Enjoyed the B.E.L.T and breakfast sandwich! Cheese grits were so cheesy and delicious! All staff were very helpful and friendly! The pastry items also looked divine, but we were too full to indulge! They will validate your Parking garage ticket for 1 hour as well! They also have a lot of local items for sale (seasonings, drinks mixes, jams/ jellies and sauces) that would make a great gift basket! You can dine in or order to go and I even plan on bringing my hubs here to get some yummy snacks to take on a picnic at Centennial park (when the weather is warmer!)

Update to a prior review: I have continued to have problems with a ring that Curt Parker made for my wife. The ring has lost two baguettes due to the poor quality of the ring. I took the ring to two separate jewelers to try to have the ring fixed since Curt Parker refused to accept responsibility. Both jewelers stated that the ring had so much porosity that they would not take my money to repair the ring since they could not guarantee the results. I shared that information with Curt Parker but he refused to look at the ring again and said that it did not have porosity. I have been shocked by his total lack of professionalism in dealing with this situation.

I just left the restaurant and feel like I need to write in now because I am so irritated with the attitude of a member of your staff. My husband and two kids and I came in because we used to go to the KOP location all of the time. We ordered our food, including refried beans which always came with chips at the kop spot. The beans came alone at the beginning with nothing but a spoon. I understand bringing food as it's ready...I actually appreciate it. But why on earth would I want a bowl of refried beans without anything to eat them with? When the food came they brought me the wrong quesadilla. The employee, without apology, took it back to get me the right one. I then sat for 8+ minutes without food. When the employee  finally brought the food I asked for the chips for the beans. I was told that I was wrong - it doesn't come that way. I replied "well, could I get some chips?" I was directed to go stand in line again to order them myself. I told the employee that I thought maybe, as an apology for making me wait so long for the correct food, he could just bring us some chips. The response I got was a blank stare and him walking away without a word. As I left I asked another employee if that person, in their pink windbreaker, was a manager. I was then informed that he infact was the manager. It's shocking that this person, with their inability to provide even a modicum of hospitality, is your manager on duty. It's unacceptable.

Love, love, LOVE this restaurant for good southern food comfort! We've had breakfast, lunch and dinner here several times during our visit over the past several years and never disappointed! LUV the fried chicken myself! The entertainment is pure joy. Saw David Ball and enjoyed his music. It was also inexpensive with dinner!

Good morning to everyone!
This hotel is horrible , the rooms are dirty and the bathrooms are filthy and run down.
This morning I went downstairs for coffee and I wanted to take my coffee back to the room and the women that was attending the front desk said that I couldn't take back my coffee back to my room because, it was there policy! I thought to my self why the Hell is there a refrigerator and a coffee maker in my room then!!!???? I don't get it!
Nothing makes sense with the Indian culture!!!

I seem to be in disagreement with most Yelpers in regard to this restaurant.

The food isn't horrible. Actually, it is.

We were served complimentary soup and salad. The miso soup had a rather salty aftertaste and lacked tofu. I'm normally a fan of Asian sesame dressing on salad however their dressing was very sour - probably saturated with vinegar. 

I ordered tempura for an app and donkatsu for my main course. The tempura arrived quickly but the batter on the shrimp was limp. The sauce left much to be desired as it was barely sweet (like most tempura sauce). I've had better and cheaper tempura elsewhere such as Sushi Ai and I am not a fan of that place. The 5 dollar price tag on it also added to my dismay.

The donkatsu arrived rather fast also but it was likewise a disappointment. It included 2 small cutlets of pork served upon a HUGE plate of vegetables including broccoli, carrots, onions and cabbage. The vegetables had seasoning on it but it tasted bland. It seemed to be heated up from an assorted frozen bag. The cabbage tasted bleak and I was done with it after a small nibble.

The Katsu is a staple of Japanese food. It can be served with curry or more commonly, with a side of a sweet katsu fruit sauce. Kampai's katsu was fried well (a little on the dry side) and it tasted a little below average. It certainly was not bad and was enough to fill me up however the 15.50 price tag was certainly not worth it.

I expected the bill to be 20-21 however upon receiving the check, I noticed my total to be 27.50. Kampai added the gratuity in the total without any consent. Tax and the "forced" tip accumulated my bill an extra 6 dollars.I was not overthrilled by the food I received and the inflated check added even more to my feelings towards this place.

Upon paying the bill, I received the receipt back for a signature. Surprise, below the total was a blank line for "Additional Tip". The friends I came with all agreed that this was unnecessary and went along to sign the bottom to finalize what we had to pay for the overpriced food.

I'm aware this place is $$, but let me put this into your perspective. I had one appetizer and one entree - 27.50. My friend and his gf shared a check and they paid 47 for 3 rolls and a couple pieces of sushi. Another friend split a check with someone else and paid 74. Both of them complained of being hungry shortly after as well. Another person in my party ordered one crunch roll and paid 11. 

Nope, never again. 

Kampai seems to have stellar reviews but the sub-par food and insanely overpriced food will keep me from visiting this establishment ever again.

Mostly Organic but all the way delicious, these pizzas this is very good pizza. 

I eat gluten free and this was an unexpected gem. Strangely enough, I was on my way to have drinks with friends but I was early and heard some good music bumping from this pizza place. I was like "oh man, I remember when I used to eat pizza..." and I literally looked at the menu to imagine what it would taste like. I saw the huge gluten free section and that they make pizzas like that and I'm so glad I went in! Music selection was great, people were super friendly and the food was good.

I will definitely return when I am nearby, though I wouldn't seek this place out just to eat there.
We have been there many times now and always the same -- good service, good food, lots of TV viewing. Pricing is appropriate for location so not "cheap". Enjoy

1st visit - LOVE this place! 
The food was delicious, lots of curry, 
Jerk chicken wings, oxtail, brown chicken stew! Service was AMAZING, too! Will definitely return.
Best breakfast spot I've tried so far in northern liberties! Their breakfast potatoes are awesome! I also really liked their eggs Benedict! Haven't had anything I didn't like.

Gelato - Baked Goods - Toasty warm drinks. 

We always stop over after dinner in Skippack. 

They have just about every old school candy you think of. They have local raw honey and imported candy. 

Gelato comes in 12 different flavors. Fudge cabinet pop rocks candy cigarettes... So much I to see and try. You need to stop in yourself.

We're becoming less and less enthusiastic about this place every time we visit.
The service is up to par, but the food taste and value seems to be slipping every time we go.
It seems as though they are emphasizing their margaritas more than they are their menu offerings. (If that's what you're looking for, look no further!)
Visited yesterday, but probably won't be back. There are so many as-good or better Mexican joints to choose from; I'm not inclined to come back to the most expensive one. ($26 for carne asada? Srsly???)

A good place for breakfast.  The donuts are actually good and not too doughy.  I think it's better than DD.  The coffee is also pretty good not like the burnt taste of Starbucks.  If you haven't tried this place I would check it out!

This is truly a top notch facility and staff and I am so glad I found them!  I really used to dread the dentist and now literally look forward to my visits. Andrea is the best!  So caring and genuine. I know they are doing something right when my visit to the dentist is the highlight of my day. Excellent dentistry, Paraffin hand treatments, personalized tv and headphones are a great plus but it really is the feeling that you are genuinely cared for and important to them makes all the difference in the world. Thank you Andrea, Dr. Nabors and all the wonderful staff!  Highly recommend!!

Found this gem today via the yelp app on my iphone.  What a wonderful lunch followed be an investigation of the upstairs rooms. Our waiter James was most helpful.   We had the goat cheese crepes and the salad midi.  Both were delicious and made a delightfully light lunch shared between two.

Friendly people, great food!! I have had the yaki-mein, Cajun creole, and 0017th and they have all been delicious! The staff is nice and they make you feel right at home. I would definitely recommend this place to eat. The atmosphere/decor could be better, but that's really my only criticism!

I think was the best pizza I've ever had. The TARTUFELLA it was called.  Truffle oil, local mushrooms, DOP tomatoes, absolute perfection.  I never thought pizza could be so intense. I ate it all by myself, slowly, savoring every folded up bite. Exquisite. I still think about it. I went twice in a row. 

Great location by my hotel Monaco. Open nice and late. Good people. 

The staff is very friendly and passionate about gelato. They do deep investigations into what would be best paired with your personality and mood.  

I wish we had one in Houston

My marscapone fig gelato was very creative and real. So packed with wow.  The pear was also a delight m fresh, crunchy, real.

This was a real treat to find during lunch time. The menu was no muss or fuss. Fresh ingredients and a scrumptious selection of tacos. I ordered 4 tacos (chorizo, chicken, grilled steak, and a combo taco with all three on it). Chorizo had a nice kick with the little bit of greasy goodness that you expect when you order it. Chicken and steak were also well prepared. For $8 dollars, the tacos were truly a good deal. 

Being it is summertime, I cooled down with a refreshing horchata. It was sweet, creamy, and hit the spot. 

The people that work and run the truck were very friendly and I appreciated that they had a covered outdoor eating space because while I like my food trucks, I also enjoy not scorching to do so. I will gladly revisit Los Comparres when I need a taco fix.

This Walmart is always crowded in the middle of the day, traffic along the highway is busy leading in the store and parking lot. It's best to shop in the middle of the night where there's not a lot of people around hogging the isles. Also cheaper than most of the other grocery stores in the area and the bathroom is always.

The food here is quite palatable, but I can speak only for the pho. In comparison to Miss Saigon on the other side of the parking lot, Kien Giang establishes a more low key, cafeteria-esque vibe on the fringes of the plaza. The orderly tables each correspond to a particular number. The hostess directed us to one promptly before a server arrived within minutes to take our orders. I dined on the most varied pho dish on the menu, I believe it was the first one on the list. The restaurant provides several sauces and condiments on the side for patron perusal. I found the broth just savory and sweet enough, although sorely lacking in fish sauce.

While the food was quite delicious and lived up to expectations, service was sadly askew. The waitstaff and chefs took turns ogling us as we waited, occasionally snickering and scoffing. To add insult to injury, the not-so-prominently displayed "cash or check only" sign left our party scrambling for an ATM. NOT to mention a sexist, rude patron strides up during our frantic search for cash to afford the pompous comment, "Next time, get some richer girlfriends." Pretentious, suffice to say. All the while, the staff at the register openly glared, whispered in Vietnamese, rolled their eyes, and broke into uncontrollable laughter. I have never been in an environment where the waitstaff expressed this level of condescension to its patron.

I'll pass on the attitude despite the decent food. Not worth a second glance. As someone who has had pho in Hanoi, the staff just make this experience extremely unforgiving.
outstanding food, even the buffet.  crappy service (read *mean*) but will endure for food quality.

Rating is really a gift since I have no idea how the sushi is-because this place is closed more than it is open it seems!?  Third time I arrived during their posted business hours-and they were closed.  Three strikes....

We've been using this company for a year or so switching from a company that came i and sprayed inside and outside of our home. I was hesitant at first on how the perimeter outside spraying would work. But we've seen no bugs at all inside. We did see ants outside our house, trailing everywhere and called Steve, he came the next day and put out bait, explained thoroughly how the ants migrate and then a week later came to check to see how things were progressing. Very impressed with this, and since we have an annual contract, this was addressed at no additional charge! Great service, honest to the point helpful information. I can highly recommend using this company.
I stop by here twice a month for take out and try various authentic Mexican foods.  Quick service and reasonably priced.  Clean establishment.

I was in town from Chicago visiting a friend who is new to the city. We were looking for a place to have brunch and I instantly recognized Milktooth as I read about it in Food & Wine and couldn't forget the unique name. We walked in about 2:15 on a Wednesday and although they closed at 3, the staff were perfectly kind and accommodating and the restaurant had a few tables full. I instantly loved the kitschy decor and airy space. I got the cold brew and it was so refreshing. My friend and I split the grilled cheese, the burger and a grapefruit pastry. It was all so amazing but the grilled cheese was definitely the stand out for me. It was the perfect combination of salty and sweet and unlike anything I've ever tasted although the idea seems so simple. The burger was delicious as well but was missing a little something in the flavor the of patty. The pastry was absolutely perfect and it doesn't hurt that it's citrus season! I'd definitely go back the next time I'm in town to try the crispy cauliflower wedge and dutch baby to name a few. Living in Chicago, some of the best restaurants are just outside my door, but I have to say, I was seriously impressed with this place and the grilled cheese was among one of the best things I've put in my mouth!

We stayed at Peppermill during the last stop of our mini-vacation on November 28. Check-in took a while; the line was long and staff was moving slow. Since I had booked and fully paid for the room through Hotels.com, once we got to the front of the line it was a quick and painless process. The man told us he had a room ready on the 14th floor. Nice!

We get up to the room, open the door, and see.....coffee cups half full of coffee. Towels on the floor. Trash can full of cigarette packs. Messed up bed. Yes, as you guessed, the room in fact was NOT ready. I called the front desk to which they apologized and said their system showed the room clean. She offered to move us to the 4th floor or the 10th floor, but the view and/or room would not be the same, of course. Since I booked the room specifically since it was a suite, I wasn't willing to compromise. She understood and gave us a $25 resort credit which we could use at any restaurant or bar on the property. They came to clean the room within 30 minutes and the housekeeper apologized several times.

When we returned later, the room was clean but there was still an unknown piece of something on the arm of the sofa. Guess they don't wipe that down during their cleaning. On a positive note, though, the room was awesome! The view was great (as far as views in Reno go...you know...not much to see), and the suite was awesome. There was a closet for coats, a large bathroom with nice shower stall, a living room/sitting area with a leather sofa, 2 chairs with a table in between, a dresser-like piece of furniture under the large flat-screen tv, and a padded ottoman in the center of it all. Across from the living room, by the bathroom, was a kitchen-like area with a long counter, sink, coffee pot, empty mini-fridge, and cabinets. The bedroom came off between the kitchen area and the living room area. It had a large king-sized bed, 2 bedside tables, flat-screen tv on the wall, writing desk, dresser with snacks on top and a fully stocked mini-fridge underneath, and let's not forget the large jacuzzi by the window! We loved the room so much we called the front desk and extended our stay another night.

Things we loved:
- all of the televisions had picture frames around them - love this idea!
- there were televisions/screens throughout the casino showing areas from around the world - also a great idea. 
- the best casino in Reno
- Fireside Lounge - although very outdated, including the music videos, the drinks were good, we could take them to our room, and the waitress was nice (although service was slow at times).


Things we didn't love:
- The food. Cafe Milano earned a separate review on Yelp. Island Buffet was not as good as the first time I went years ago. Great variety, but some of the food was cold or just didn't have much flavor. We were there for the Sunday brunch, so the champagne was included. 

All in all, we would stay here again next time we are in Reno!

Experience depends on your server.
 First time we went had a great server. She was friendly. We are simple and easy to please. I do not understand when a server just seems unhappy and as if my family and I being there is ruining there day. 
We went today had a server named Lexi and she seemed so unhappy. We asked for cranberry juice was told they didn't have it. Than asked for orange juice. Told they didn't have that. Asked if they had any juices.was told they had pink lemonade. Asked if they had any bar juices. And was told that it's just sugar and she didn't know how much it would be, so we just got water. Just seemed like such a hassle (the first time we went and asked for cranberry juice for our child we got it). 
When we went to pay the first time the server took our credit card and ran it. This time we tried to give it to Lexi twice and she finally came back and said "would you like me to take it up front for you?" 
Yes we would or please let us know we can take it up front.
I apologize to Lexi for us coming in to eat when you apparently didn't want to be there serving people. Next try spitting out your gum and smiling. Our $18 tip on a $90 check could have been more. I wish we had the male server from inside the whole time. He showed us more gratitude and friendliness in the minute we walked past him going in and out of restaurant.

We had a very nice meal here this evening and were pleasantly surprised.  My partner had the filet mignon, which was excellent, with perfectly cooked green beans and truffled mashed potatoes (to die for, in my opinion).  I loved the pescatarian delight, which was the catch of the day with sauteed vegetables on spaghetti squash--a perfect melange of flavors and textures.  The flourless chocolate cake was not quite to our liking (a little too sweet), but others would probably love it.  The service was good, although I have to say that I find it almost unforgiveable when the waitstaff fails to take care of the bill promptly when the credit card is with it on the table.  But for that small misstep, the service was very good.

I was so hungry today and saw the sign for pho. I live pho, but I wanted to try an easier and faster dish since I had to get back to work quickly. I ordered the grilled chieken vermacelli. I asked for it with rice and extra spicy which is how I like it. The lady was so nice and they had it ready to pick up in 15 minutes. Everyone in there was enjoying pho. It looked so good. I want to get that next time. The chicken was delicious and so tender. It was the same texture as pulled pork. The rice was aldo very good on the bottom and it came with a side salad. Dob't let this place decieve you by its looks and location. It was definitelt worth the short walk across the street and I will definitely be back!

Marrakesh serves 7 courses for only $25, but that's not what makes it so amazing. Eating here is like being transported into someone's home in Morocco, with the ornate tapestries on the walls and the cozy, dark ambiance. 

Our group of 8 was seated upstairs in a small circular sofa area. There was a large table in the middle for everyone to share food. We had two vegetarians in our group, and the waiter easily accommodated for them. There are no utensils or plates -- you just grab food off the table in the middle. 

In terms of the food, prepared walk out very full. They give you as much pita as you want, but be careful not to fill up on one of the earlier courses (although their eggplant appetizer is absolutely amazing). Dessert for us consisted of a baklava and a giant bowl of fruit.

Overall, good food, even better atmosphere. I've already recommended this place to many of my friends. It's the experience of eating here that makes Marrakesh so wonderful, and I'll definitely be back in the near future.

My sister raves about this place so when I was in the area I decided to try it. I arrived at 4:55pm on a Saturday and was told that I couldn't be accommodated without a reservation. Anyone who is/was in the restaurant business knows that you can turn a single diner in 30 minutes. I guess the blue hairs that were in there must tip well since they can afford to turn away business. Next time a new person walks in realize that you have a chance to build new business. I won't be returning.
Nice place, bad service. Felt like the lady doing my manicure would rather be anywhere but there. Felt like she was rushing me and my nails were not well done.

I tried to order the Mediterranean chicken dinner, which is listed on the menu. The employee behind the counter told me they no longer served that there, only salmon and steak. I asked if she meant they were out of chicken for the day. No, she said, they just don't serve it any longer. I left and went to the Vets location instead.

Not exactly Greek.

This is a decent place which for some reason is usually swimming in college educated mid 20's / early 30's estrogen. Women love Kanella. Take a date here!

I'll admit: I'm biased. I'm Greek, and I've been all over Greece. I've never been to Cyprus. Therefore, I don't really like the food if it is supposed to be what I know from Greece. I even prefer Turkish food to what I've had at Kanella. 

The food at Kanella isn't bad, for what it is. I can't say whether it is authentic Cypriot cuisine. It's nothing like mainland Greek cuisine. I can say for sure at least from a Northern Greek perspective, there are better options in the city in this price range. Try Estia.

That all said, the service was friendly. Best part of the whole meal was the desserts and coffee. If the place weren't so small, and perhaps had lots of sidewalk seating in summertime, I would be there several nights per week just for desert and coffee. But this is Philadelphia....

We arrived early on a Sat eve. We were told most people make a reservation and our wait would be 40 mins. Fyi, you may want to place something on your website to ensure to make a reservation. We saw at least 6 parties of 2-4, leave because the wait was an hour and 45 mins. The pasta dishes were perfection, as was the panzanella salad and the bread and oil served pre-meal. The service was an issue. No drink  re-fills ( wine, beer, milk or water) were offered until we asked and the meal was almost finished. Cheese was offered to one person in our party and not the rest? Dessert? Again, not offered, just the check. The food is solid, but the service left much to be desired! The linguini and clams was fantastic! The pizza was also solid and a large portion for the price!

I am so happy with my experience at A. Brandt and Son! We made the trip from center city not knowing what to expect. I am so glad we took the chance! First of all, it is located in such a quaint town! Parking has never an issue and at this point we've been there three times. It's street metered and all you need is a quarter. It is right down the street from the train station (in case you use septa). Anyway they had a nice selection of rings in our price range. My fiancé settled on a ring from the 1880s that looks brand new! The staff accommodated his proposal plans and helped him purchase the ring even though the store was closed for vacation! They were also very helpful when I needed a repair. They covered the cost without the blink of an eye. I will always remember this special shop in when I think of my engagement. Their selection is so unique and beautifully displayed, I look forward to shopping for jewelry there in the years to come!

No surprises here, it is lots of bird related items (food for outside, bird watching information, etc.). They can be helpful if you're not sure what you are looking for and post information about people and what they are seeing in the area.

Only drawback is their hours, usually close at 6pm during the week, which can make it hard to get to sometimes.

Their bird baths are nice too, you don't see that at a lot of stores, but they have quite a variety for such a smaller store.

WOW! Reminds me exactly of a New York City market. Such a gem in the middle of St. Pete! First time here but definitely not the last.  I stopped in to get lunch for co-workers and didn't have time to enjoy it all, but the short visit in has me hooked. Can't wait to go back when I have time to really browse and see everything they have!
Great Malaysian and pan-asian food.  Good service and a nice space for the price which can't be beat.
Extremely impressed with service and quality of the food. Found out is it it is independently owned and not a chain and therefore no wonder it was so good

In this area in particular, I was warned by my friend that no, you cannot walk there at night.  Take a cab or drive!  Dayum.  Is it that dangerous?  

We didn't take advantage of the drink specials much to my disappointment.  So the top shelf liquors are actually NOT cheap.  boo.  Indoor smoking abound, so you will be choking with every other breath as you listen to the karaoke.  Some were good but most were horrid.  A homely crowd so don't come here horny looking to get laid, unless you are homely or fucking homelies is your thing.

Great selection of draft and bottled beer in a convenient location (within walking distance to the arena and in the Downtowner range). The food is amazing too! They do trivia on Wednesdays and Taco Tuesdays, which I have yet to try but the menu looked really good.  Very nice atmosphere inside as well. Will definitely be back!

As far as I can tell, this joint is not affiliated with the famous Tony Luke's.  Maybe they are trying to mooch off of the name and reputation of the more famous establishment.  Ok, fine, that's not my fight.  All I know is that they serve food and I can review it.  (Even Yelp.com is confused:  One of the photos posted is NOT of this establishment, strike one, and the website address is wrong, strike two.)

Everyone who visits Philadelphia wants to try a cheesesteak (or two or four) and you should try one.  Tony's cheesesteak is ok but it's not great.  It was the only one I tried in Philly and I picked wrong.

On the other hand, Tony Jr's, serves up an outstanding roast pork sandwich with broccoli rabe.  Hell to the yes.  It is absolutely delicious and you do need to try it.

And then head off to find a better cheesesteak if your stomach lining can handle it.  Better wear sweatpants and pack some Pepto.

I love this place.

Bacchanal should import their concept to other cities. Buy a bottle, get some queso, sit outside while you enjoy the outdoors and music while your delectables are brought to your table with cornichons, olives, chutney/spreads, and warmly toasted crostini.

Love love love! What's better than good company, good drinks, and good food?

I love this place! Why? Because it's hidden and it's got loads of history with some really good fresh made dishes. Plus they have a bar! The restroom is outside in another building and that sucks especially when it's dark and you're alone. Kinda scary. I like they are open for short periods of time, makes you feel special when you eat. I've been here twice and look forward to more visits. They serve you fresh bread here too!

We came here for my cousins bachelorette weekend and stop here last minute they got us in right away told us the history of the building. I got the shrimp and grits which was amazing and I'm still craving it now would recommend this place for weekend brunch!!

Went here to see a Hornets game. The facility was clean and had reasonable prices for tickets. We were up on the balcony, and still had  a good view. Staff were also very friendly and the lines moved quickly.

I love this place and staff. Great coffee, teas hot and cold. Truly free wifi, perfect place to hangout or wait for your train or bus. The bean goes to another level during the open mike nights. This a must stop if you find yourself in Germantown.

Drinks good, food mediocre, waiters full of meaningless patter about the alleged nuances of food and drink. Service only fair. Prices grossly inflated. Noisy. More about a marketing strategy than good food. Won't return.
BANGIN'. Only reason for 4 stars is because it was hotter than hell and the floor was crazy wet. The burger was retardedly good.
It's a must if you are passing through STL!  The lines move fast, don't be intimidated.  I recommend the ALL SHOOK UP.

Like to talk some about this camp ground the staff not very friendly. The day I arrived the counter person gave me a map and she trace directions to my site so I follow her instructions. I went away and pick up a car rental and came back to my site out of the blue a man in a truck pull next to me telling me that I m driving the wrong way and he goes on and on so I tell him I have map I follow the directions I show this to him after a few minutes he tones down and said that he apologizes for his reaction so finally he figures out he was wrong and he goes away he said that he work at this site. I did not like his reaction he could approach a customer in a much Better way will not be coming back and I don't recommend this site to any one else my taxi driver that gave a ride said that is not a very good place to stay.

We decided last night to try this restaurant after reading some positive reviews, and were delighted beyond all hopes. The food was outstanding, and we had a variety of both appetizers and entrees. Each tasted homemade and authentic, equal to the finest cuisine at much more expensive locations even in the city. This find in our own neighborhood was wonderful. The serivce was attentive and personable. Victoria and her brother Justin gave us great suggestions. We even managed a chat with the owner who was as gracious as possible. Specifically, we enjoyed the meatballs, risotto balls, chopped salad, lasagna and seafood fra diavolo. 

 I would not hesitate to give this the highest recommendation to anyone and everyone.
I travel to West Chester from Philadelphia for their expert service and the best price around. They keep my BIMMER purring!

The food here is decent, but the service is terrible. The last time we ate here, the waitress would barely give us the time of day, and when she did  ask if we needed anything, she then walked off while I was in the middle of a sentence. All I wanted was a refill on my water, nothing too hard. But she walked off when I said, "Yes, could you get me..." Rude! Unfortunately, we've had a few experiences like that here.

The deep dish square pizzas are the BOMB!!! I use to live in Michigan 10 years ago and use to get this pizza on a regular basis. Now they have opened a few Jets locations in Indiana I feel right at home.

This place isn't bad. I went in late one afternoon to get a takeout Mexican and rainbow roll. They got it ready for me in about 20 minutes (longer than the 5 they said it would take...). They were really nice and gave me lots of extra soy sauce, wasabi, and some containers to mix it up in on the go when I asked for it. The fish was fresh and the rolls were tasty but they weren't rolled up very tightly and so they kept falling apart when I tried to dip them in the soy sauce. This was especially a problem with the tempura flakes in the Mexican roll.. 
The price wasn't bad for the quality (compared to other, worse places around town) - I think it was about $8 per roll and they were 8 big pieces each. Kyoto does the job in a pinch.

LOVE this place! They are professional, pleasant, and have awesome massage chairs. BUT... best of all, they line their tubs with disposable plastic liners and autoclave all instruments! No fungus at this establishment! This girl has found a new place and will tell all her friends! Thank you Jenny!
Loud. Food was underwhelming. My banana split was not a banana split, and was mostly just chocolate ice cream.

This is a BYOB. Off the beaten track kind of place - good food, good prices - excellent wait staff.  The restaurant is kind of small, so calling ahead might be a good idea. 

Not opened Sundays - kind of a drag.
Surprisingly delicious Chicago-style deep dish pizza!  One pie was enough for us 3, might have to order a second if you are a party of 4.

Popovers and blondies, both very well done, though not much else to add other than if you're in the mood for a delicious blondie in a romantic setting, come to Blondie's. They do have one of the nicest sitting areas in Downtown St. Louis with a nice fireplace, plush seating and pastel colors, as well as an outdoor area to enjoy the outdoor happenings of Washington Ave, their hours have changed so check in if they'll have a live band or be open late in the evening.
Basically the same as Cafe Du Monde.  Go here late at night, otherwise go to the Coffee Bean a block away.
The food was not so great.the desserts were good. I was wondering if the owner ever smiles or properly recieves his customers. He was definitely not welcoming. Won't be going there again

If you dance and want to purchase a fabulous dress, Boulevard of Dreams has the new session catalogs in and from one dancer to another, there are many fabulous smooth and rhythm dressed.  Check them out at 611 Kuenzli St.

Absolutely fantastic cupcakes. I tried a few at a night market, so I ended up having Jimmies cater a party for me. We ordered about 150 cupcakes. Every cupcake was perfectly decorated and delicious. These cupcakes are pretty big too!
They were an absolute gem to work with, and everything was done so professionally! 

Overall: amazing cupcakes, great service!
Downtown vibe in Mount Airy....great food, reasonable drinks and awesome staff...you'll think ur in downtown Philly...even a great outside seating area.. Luv this place!!

I was legit craving a burger badly when I walked by Bareburger. There are a lot of pluses going on here. Different types of meats you might not see at your average burger joint. You can build your own burger or stick with the creations they've invented. Gluten-free buns, veggie options, and non-burger sandwiches are all on the menu. And they have a liquor license/little bar! Ron was my server and he was great. Friendly and attentive while also respecting that I needed some time to chow down properly. I'll be back with friends!

This place seems destined to fail, which is too bad.  Maybe with the new museum right across the street it will be saved.  The food is OK, the prices a bit high for the offering, but the setting is pretty awesome.  Quiet and relaxing without pushing you out the door.  

I don't know much about the area, but imagine this would be a great place to have a wedding or event, and a nice place to grab a cup of coffee on a weekend morning. 

Good luck to them.

Found this place through Yelp. 
Absolutely fantastic choice! So glad I decided to try it based on the reviews.  

The place is definitely busy so if you're with a group be sure to call ahead and reserve a spot. I was travelling solo for business and was lucky to get the last seat at the bar. The service here is fantastic! Everyone was very friendly and helpful for choosing something off the menu - I always like to ask the servers what their favorite dishes are when I go somewhere new. Even the other patrons of the restaurant are really friendly.

I ended up going with the spicy beef kabob - I believe it was called 'Adana Kabob' but I could be wrong. It was a signature dish. Anyway, it was amazing. So delicious. Yes, spicy but not too bad. It came with grilled veggies and salad - I opted out of the bulgar wheat. You can tell everything on the plate was made fresh and in-house. Seriously fantastic. I also tried Turkish coffee for the first time - I don't know where this has been all my life!!! 

I will definitely be going back any time I'm in Edmonton. Don't miss out! Check this place out, you won't be disappointed.

We have been here twice and have only tried the pizza and the cheesy garlic bread.  Both are excellent.  They have a good selection of craft beers and do some type of beer tasting event occasionally. It's very small and stays busy so get there early or expect a wait.  

So far we've had great service and I would definitely recommend giving them a try.

Went there for an impromptu Friday happy hour and was pleasantly surprised with the amazing offerings of free appetizers and their interesting and extensive drink menu!  The service was wonderful and the atmosphere was warm and friendly.  The owner even stopped by and chatted with us for quite a while. This could be our new favorite home town happy hour spot.  (Also check out the cutting boards and table tops the owner made...fabulous!!).
Service was pretty bad!  Coffee was cold while waiting  for the milk.  Avocado toast was delicious   Fried chicken and biscuit was good.  Eat inside.  Lots of flys outside
Simply amazing rolls.  I grew up in Santa Barbara and make it home 2-3 times a year and ALWAYS go to Sakana.  A great meal every time.

Very average pizza including the tasteless crust. On top of that, I ordered their 10" "everything" pizza with additional anchovies for $1.50 extra. Got home and no anchovies. The prices are are high for the quality and taste IMHO. Smokey Mountain Pizza on Fairview is much much better both in crust, Smokey flavor and price. That's where I'm going next time.

If I had to live on nothing but Southern eats for the rest of my life, I'd be perfectly content.

Jones intrigued me for quite some time -- the storefront seemingly standing out whenever I'd walk by it. Finally, last Sunday, a friend and I decided to stop in for a late brunch. We saw people waiting outside, but since we were a small party, we were quickly seated.

I had a perfect view of the kitchen from my chair. It was a curse. Despite the fact that we had been seated just three minutes before and hadn't even ordered yet, I wanted my food that instant. I don't think I've ever been as impatient at a restaurant than I was at Jones. It's amazing my friend didn't hurt her neck considering how many times I urged her to turn around/strain to look at plates being produced behind her.

We decided to have a sober brunch, so I started with a Jones cream soda -- mostly because of the irony and the fact that I didn't think I had one since I was 13. Still good stuff.

For entrees, my friend got the meatless cheese sandwich and ate every bite. She loved it. I got the fried chicken and fries basket, and despite a truly valiant effort, it looked like I didn't take a bite by the time I was finished with it. I'm fairly certain they had an entire chicken squished into that basket, sans feet (thank you for that, Jones) and head (also thank you for that, Jones). It also came with cole slaw, which was exceptional for when you're comparing it to other slaws.

Needless to say, I'll be back. I could only fit so much chicken in my stomach on that day -- and there are so many other menu options still on my in-brain list to try!

My friends and I were looking for places around Reno to try new food. We've been here about twice now and we absolutely love it. I enjoy their vegetarian dishes, especially the Mesir Wat, which is lentils cooked with spices. I look forward to coming back and trying the rest of their dishes. The owner is very friendly and stated that she remembered us from our previous visit a couple of months ago.

I love Tavern. They have exceptional cocktails, killer food, and an ambiance that can't be beat! I foresee many a dollar of mine being spent here....

It gets VERY busy, and on Sunday when I stopped in with a friend it was no exception. Luckily, there were two seats at the bar, so we snagged them and sat down. After drooling over another customer's plate of mussels, I decided I had to get them. White wine with bacon, leeks, and a piece of "dippy" bread? Um score. My friend had the chicken chimichanga, and it was cheesy but still full of flavor and amazing! 

But let's talk cocktails, something that really gets my engine running and Tavern hit the mark.

The red sangria was pre-mixed and topped off with some bubbly. It was a good sangria, but not over the top good. However, my balsamic martini with stoli, strawberry puree, and a splash of balsamic syrup?? Creative and delicious! I will be ordering the drink again and again! The bellini sparkle was not in a tiny champagne flute, it was in a tumbler and was refreshing. My friend couldn't stop ordering the cucumber, apple, and elderflower cocktail. Be warned, it is very strong! 

I was worried our service would be poor because they only had 2 bartenders for the entire bar, but it wasn't. They were attentive and sure to check up on us and get our orders in. They also have some incredible outdoor seating areas, and enjoying a cocktail on a nice day here is heaven. 

Thanks for the good times Tavern, I can't wait to see you again!

I use that car wash at least once a week..The employees are more than accomodating.  For $6. you cannot beat it...I have zero complaints about this car wash, and the way they run it...It would cost me more to pay someone to wash my car.  Keep up the good work.
Donna Fenza
Fenza's Auto Body
Chester Tsp Pa

I have had windows replaced by Tony's Auto Glass on two of my previous cars I owned, which makes me a repeat customer, I have also referred two of my cousins whom were happy with the price above all. The windows were clean and well installed. I even went back and got immediate attention on what I thought was a chip crack, turns out it was a stain but the important thing is they responded quickly rather than making me wait. Price was the lowest, wait time is long(couple hours)but once you see your new windshield that doesn't matter. Stop calling around for prices, just come in now, it's a first come first served basis.

I am from NYC  and Indian is my go to comfort food. This was the first time at EKTA and it will be my last. Barely edible food (completely flavorless) and nonexistent service. We went at a time that was not busy, so there was no excuse for the lack of service.  We didn't eat most of our food. No one ever came to ask if everything was okay. Worst of all, my dining partner and I were both ill a few hours after eating this food. YUCK!  We won't ever go back.

this place isnt bad, but its really isnt good either, and yeah it shares a dining area with port of subs, youll get over it after 10 minutes of sitting there.

i ordered tai sach (steak/tripe) pho. i dont think its on the menu but they knew what i was talking about when i ordered it. i say its not good because its sort of bland. the stock they used lacked flavor, it didnt taste like they used very many ingredients to make it. i cant really blame them considering the small space they have. 

what WAS good was the soup the beef balls were boiled in. we ordered a side of just beef ball in soup, and had the pho been in THAT soup, it would have been a 4 star rating.

what saved this place from a one star rating was that at least the soup was plenty salty, despite lacking flavor.

i would NOT come back here for pho, maybe beef ball and broth, but definitely not pho. i would rather go to mac donalds down the parking lot. 

would not recommend for someone with high cholesterol.

Every time I walk by this place is smells like heaven, so I finally went it.  Great customer service.  They let me sample the one I wanted first.  Got the $5 individual bag of the toasted coconut.  It's delicious. They have so many flavors it's hard to pick.

The drinks were good and had a good amount of liquor in them. They had  2 pianists playing the night we went and they played current music like new Beyonce and Usher. It was really entertaining to watch. We eventually left when it got too crowded because people were bumping into each other. Overall, the drinks were accurately priced with a good amount of liquor, and the entertainment was great. We would definitely come back on a less busy night.

Our first encounter when walking into Jds at a non-busy time was a very unfriendly,snarky, rude hostess who proceeded to sit us in the back. Mind you this was around 4:15 pm and the restaurant was pretty empty. We continued to sit there for probably ten minutes with no service as multiple servers walked past us. We decided we did not want to eat there and proceeded to walk down the road to Los Mexicanos where our dinner and service were excellent. Didn't eat anything at JDs would never go back.

Cycling the causeway, we discovered this breakfast gem.  A quaint neighborhood, short order diner with personality and culinary WOW!  The Greek omelet, blueberry short stack, homemade hash browns, french toast....even the coffee provided a morning delight for four hungry cyclists pedaling the Pinellas Trail.  We shared a scrumptious sticky roll as a "appetizer".   

Our first visit, won't be our last.

I am giving a perfect review based solely on the hard shell chicken tacos all the way, a side of queso, and hot sauce. The chicken is cooked well enough not to leave the shells soggy. They aren't overly flavorful just simply good.
Best sushi place in the area. If you're looking for quality- go here. Been going here for 10+ years and it's better than any other new place in the area.
Delicious chicken and bacon burrito, with just a little kick! Atmosphere is 'hip', cool decor. Would be a good place for a happy hour.

I have been an avid user of Yelp since its inception, across multiple geographies and years, taking users advice without investing the time to reciprocate. 

In leading to amazing service and culinary experiences in NYC, Dallas, Denver, Austin, SF, LA, Nawlins, DC, Boston and elsewhere, Basimo's is forcing me to write my first review of any product/service through any app/website ever. 

Writing with Israel Kamakawiwo'ole' "Somewhere over the rainbow" in the background on the 4th of July, and the owners' young son playing with their 3 month old puppy, this place embodies everything that America, small business, and entrepreneurism should be. The freshest coconuts and organic ingredients were scraped, measured and blended in the most delicious smoothie I've ever had. The son chatted me up, while ringing me up, with the polish of a Burberry's salesman on 5th Ave, up selling me with the banana walnut muffin, which was as delicious as promised. 

Child labor laws aside, this is the type of business, family and commitment to personal and professional excellence that I imagine old Ben Franklin practicing and which is lost at the jamba juices and other chains, including those "intimate", PE-backed chains like Juice Press or Organic Avenue in NYC. Plus, the prices are half and quality superior.

I have a serious Han addiction.

I don't know if it was years of greasy sub-par Chinese takeout, or I was abducted by aliens. Whatever the reason, I am a Han fan girl now.

For starters, the Cherry Hill location is BYO (awesome). I've never tried the Philly locations, but I know they have alcohol available to them. The waitstaff and management is incredibly friendly and knowledgeable, it's clear they are held to a high standard. The decor is simple, but clean and modern. It doesn't scream "CHINESE RESTAURANT" like many do. 

But the star is, of course, the food.

It's a "family style" deal, but I find for two people one entree plus an appetizer or an order of their yummy noodles is MORE then enough food. They always suggest their Dan-Dan Noodles for starters, and I've gotta agree - although if you are not fond of spice I'd suggest you'd ask the waiter to tone it down (which they will gladly do with ANY of their menu items) The nutty, spicy noodles are a great starter. I also love their Spicy Pickled Cucumbers, so crisp, flavorful and again SPICY.

There is a selection of entrees with a wild variety of meats to choose from. Ranging from the more familiar Kung-Pao style to the not so familiar "Dry Pot" or "Dry Pepper" Style. I personally always go for the dry pot style, because I LOVE the combo of the meat with the bamboo shoots and the sliced of garlic and peppercorn. Their food isn't just HOT it's massively flavorful. Although if your a spice junky like me, this food rivals Thai in its painfully good spice level. You'll never order greasy lo-mein from your local chinese stop again.
This place is amazing! I love a great seafood place. Everything was tasty, full of flavor and you get a lot of food. If I lived in town I would come back for sure.

We went to the Underground Tap & Grill for the first time on a Saturday evening. We were expecting the place to be packed (Oilers game) but when we got there around 7pm, it wasn't!  Place is nicer than I expected with a very cozy, chilled out bar vibe. I really liked the music - good song selection and best part is that they don't blast it. You can actually have a decent conversation without having to scream and yell. A nice change of pace from the rest of the bars in town.
