Anyways, beer wise, they have a great selection. You can pick from their regular menu (100-400 level which is categorized based on intensity/level of flavour). Then they have their rotational menu with quite a selection to choose from. A buddy and I got there early so we had a few beers and drinks before the rest of our friends came to join us. So I'm just writing about what we had:

- Guldenberg ($8) - 12oz beer from their rotational menu. It is 8.5% and from Belgium. I'm no beer expert but it was a blond ale and was well balanced.
- Wee Angry Scotch Ale (300 level) - dark ale that my buddy ordered. 
- Lowrider Double Rye Ale (rotational menu) - I believe this was the other beer he ordered. I can't remember the name for sure but it was a 12oz and it almost had a bit of a wine aroma to it.
 
- Green onion cake sandwich ($13) - a friend that had gone before told me that this was pretty decent. Comes with pulled pork, suey choy, tomatoes and green onions with a green onion cake as the sandwich. They claim it is homemade but I wasn't too impressed with it. I've had better green onion cakes at Asian restaurants. And for the price, definitely would not order it again. For my side, I had the garden salad with lemon honey dressing. Nothing special again.
- BBQ burger ($15) - 8oz beef infused with bbq sauce, cheddar and bacon. My buddy liked it but said he has had much better burgers. He upgraded to get the sweet potato fries.

Basically, good if you want to try beers. Mediocre for food (as you would expect for bar food in Edmonton). Overall, I'd give it 3.5 stars. Just go for a few beers.
For fast food you can't beat the taste and quality. At this Popeyes the staff was exceptionally courteous and welcoming.  Too bad we were just visiting from out of town.

Visited with my family (5 total) on our way to Disney World during Christmas week.  Had a 30 minute wait but it was well worth it.  The establishment is small but the service was quick and friendly. Everyone enjoyed their plate, the Bananas Foster French Toast was incredible as mentioned many times over. Other plates included ham omelette, biscuits and gravy and a large croissant breakfast sandwich. 
I would definitely recommend and plan to return on my next trip to NOLA. Cash only!
Absolutely professionals here. Great place and environment. This is a must visit. Mature clientele and staff. Far from a dive bar.

Very pleasant dining, particularly on the outdoor deck overlooking the Schuylkill and its busy adjacent sidewalks. Did not try the pizzas, but they looked and smelled good as they went by. A broccolini salad was a generous portion, with long shavings of Parmigiano and prosciutto. Some bread accompanying it would've been nice. The famous meatballs were...different, with a veal-tomato sauce and pine nuts; very good, but some bread accompanying it would've been nice. At $11, though, for three average-size meatballs? I thought that was a bit high. A sea scallop appetizer was quite good also, but at $15 for just two scallops, that was a bit high. Some bread accompanying it would've been nice. A small dollop of spaghetti with rock shrimp and a two cooked slices of cappacolle (gobagool?) in a spicy tomato and squid ink sauce looked disgusting on the plate, but was delicious. At $14 for such a small portion, I thought it was, as they say in the trade, a bit high, and some bread accompanying it would've been nice, to mop up the sauce.

If someone else is paying, you'll love In Riva.

All employees were efficient and most kind indeed. Hopefully one of them will think, "Hey! We  know how to make great pizza crust! Why don't we roll some into loaf shapes and make bread to slice for the patrons' delicious appetizers and entrees? They'll say we're nice!"

My first visit to T.H.I.S. Place was for a Yelp UYE and I was pretty impressed. I'm not a guy who frequents coffee shops, since I don't drink coffee and only drink tea when I'm sick. I really like the space. There were lots of interesting books around that caught my eye and some pretty cool local art on the walls. 

Since coffee isn't my thing, I had a hot chocolate, and it was excellent. It was made with real melted chocolate, not some gross powder, like other places use. I had the dark chocolate and peppermint. A great mix. I originally wanted peppermint with white chocolate but Tom steered me towards dark chocolate, as it goes better with the mint. It was good advice. You can also buy the hot chocolate to make later - it comes in a little cube of chocolate, just mix with warm milk. 

I also had a blueberry popsicle. I grew up eating wild, hand-picked blueberries from my cottage and I've grown very picky when it comes to blueberry based foods, since I've always had the best. There's a lot of blueberry products that probably aren't much more than sugar and blue food colouring. So I was very pleased when I unwrapped the popsicle and saw there were real blueberry skins inside it! It was great and tasted fresh and wasn't loaded full of sugar. 

Cool space, great treats. I'll be back.

My husband and I recently spent three days at the Peppermill Hotel in  Reno Nv . 
Upon making reservations I was very clear that I needed to rooms close to the elevator and close to the casino because we would be traveling with our 91-year-old aunt and uncle. 
Only got to the hotel we checked in and we were given directions to get to our rooms. The room was about a half a mile away from the front desk and the casino. Our room would be rated like a Motel 6 the comforter was the lumpy the room was messy and it smelled of smoke. I went down to the front desk on three different occasions any each occasion was pretty much told too bad they were for nothing they could do for us. I will never stay at the Peppermill again. I'm going to post some pictures of the comforter and the  air purifier they stuck in our room which then smell like purified smoke. 
Don't stay at the Peppermill.

Amazed to find a breakfast place that has vegan & gluten-free options. Hard to find that in most places, except for the standard oatmeal (not usually GF), grits (avoid those for GMOs plus the way it's processed, or the less frequent tofu which isn't always GMO-free. But I was really enjoying my hot quinoa bowl loaded with raisins, fresh RIPE strawberries & blueberries (not the standard tasteless kind). Would have liked to try an acai bowl but morning was still cool so the hot quinoa was the choice & I loved it. Filled me up enough that I didn't try a smoothie either. 

Service is super friendly. Like the bulletin board with all the local announcements, yoga studios, etc. This will be a go to spot whenever I visit Santa Barbara. So glad I found it since yelp didn't list it under vegan but hopefully this review will change that so other visitors can find this gem.
Georgia is so welcoming! She helped me pick a few great choices of beer. Lovely atmosphere along with the best customer service!
Mussels were large and tender but not enough garlic in the white sauce.  Very dark inside. We sat on the porch.

Disappointed. The meat was very greasy and not very flavorful. The onions were bland as well. The bread was good and probably the best part of the sandwich. There were 2 slices of provolone so it wasn't "cheesy" at all. 
The neighbor hood wasn't so great but I did expect that. 
Going to continue my quest for a great Philly Cheese Steak!
Just ordered for the first time from Fresco's. Pizza was exellent! And very happy with the delivery time... arrived within the time they specified.
Very Awsome Spot. it smells delicious, very nice smooth rum . Owners are very nice . defenetly up and comming. highly recomend it
Stopped by this new place today and met the owner. Great coffee and a great addition to the neighborhood! Clean and inviting with quality pastries and beverages.

Been a patron since they opened and Dooney's used to be awesome. Over the past few years service and food quality has declined. Tonight, I get it that it's St Patrick's Day, but the bar service was absolutely horrible. On a night where you would expect the alcohol to flow, it creeped. Our apps made it to the table before our first drinks and we were done with the apps before my drink made it. Not the servers fault at all. This is totally the sign of a horrible bar staff. Drinks should be FIRST. I dont care about comp'd drinks. I want good overall service. I do NOT recommend Dooney's on a high volume night.

The Guinness Irish Stew was horrible and one of our meals came out cold. The stew looked like it had been sitting for a day and the gravy looked broken ad store bought. Terrible!

So Fresh is my go to for easy healthy food to pick up. I always build my bowl and get as many veggies as I can and extra Zoodles. I love the Zoodles. They are probably my favorite thing. Gluten Free friendly and absolutely delicious and filling!
Great atmosphere!!! Great drinks!!! Great Jazz music....place is in a great area in Tampa/ Hyde Park. The outside seating is fantastic on a nice evening. Gotta check this place out.

Okay, it was July 4th...but: no hostess at the station. Show up with four people and told a 20 minute wait. 5 open tables and 5 dirty tables in sight.  Went across the road to Muldoon's, sat down immediately and had great service.

Second time visiting Ooka. Food was great but will not return. My party arrived around 5:30pm on a Friday. We spent $200 dollars on food.  Waitress and managers hovered over our table after we finished dessert. Rushed us to pay our bill and pretty much ran us out of our seats by hovering over us, watching and intensely walking by and throwing doggy bags on our table. We left a 20% tip also. When we finally decided to leave, the hostess basically knocked us over to get to a table. This was between 8 and 8:30pm. I understand that it is a busy Friday night however the rudeness to turn over a table was horrible. One individual in our party came a little late and was still eating. Never again...

Our poorly trained waiter.  How could they have put him on the floor? It was sad. He was clueless. The food was boring and tasteless. The first time we went we sat at the sushi bar and it was okay (2 stars). This last time our party of four sat at the hibachi table and it was pretty terrible even though we ordered sushi and off the grill. It just isn't worth the money. Their is no ambience, service, or personality here. It's like a burnt out chain restaurant filled with zombies.

DONT COME HERE!  So our group initially wanted to hit up one of the mom & pop diners along South Virginia, but the wait was horrendous for a group for 19.  We slowly piled back towards our cars - decided to give Yama Sushi a try.  It was definitely a BIG DISAPPOINTMENT.

We walk in and there's absolutely no business, its prime time for lunch.  Some of us order the ALL-YOU-CAN-EAT sushi - which can decently fill you up.  However for those who ordered A LA CARTE, the prices of our food came up to near the same price.  If you have no choice, stick to the ALL-YOU-CAN-EAT cuz at least it'll fill you up and you get a variety of sushi rolls.

I ordered the Beef Teriyaki and California Roll.  

Beef Teriyaki - beef was either frozen/old + overcooked, super dry, not made for humans to consume.

California Roll - the imitation crab was the stick you buy at the frozen aisle, this was literally something i can make myself .

They were also very short staffed for our group of 19, and the portion of our group that got ALL-YOU-CAN-EAT received better service than the A-LA-CARTE table.

I bet that we were the biggest business/clients of the day.

Great service, disappointing food. 
My husband and I ate here recently on a layover due to the great priority pass deal and while the deal was great - the food wasn't quite so. 
We ordered the meat lovers pizza, the toasted ravioli, and the side salad. 
The toasted ravioli was okay - my husband didn't much enjoy it but I didn't mind it too much. I did like the marinara that came with it for dipping. 
The salad was unremarkable - a standard salad. 
The pizza was...not good. The cheese was...I don't even know how to describe it. It was like a goopy chewy mess. I liked the meat on the pizza and the pizza sauce, but ugh the cheese. If you can order it w/out the cheese maybe you should. The crust of the pizza was a thin crust whatever. Maybe a little on the crispy side but honestly not too noteworthy good or bad.

Snacks by the lb is a very customer oriented establishment. My family has been a patron of this business since its opening and through experience have seen this to be true. They are very focused on delivery a personal experience for each customer and meeting everyone's needs. They have a wide selection of candy ranging from the chocolates they have behind the counter to unique packaged candy. They even have allergen free candy! They also have greeting cards and small gifts that would be great for any house warming gift or birthday. To add to the convenience, it's located right in the borough of Newtown! Steps away from all of the restaurants and shops. You must stop by, you'll be sure to find something you like.

My family has been going to eat at Semenza's since I was in my mother's womb.
Awesome pizza, great crust, but more importantly, the best chicken wings I've had yet. 

Great location, it's never busy and the staff is chill.

Been here a few times since my last review. Continues so have a solid burger and fries dish, but I have tried some of the vegetarian/vegan dishes and they just don't stack up. Veggie 'bacon' has been especially bland. Overall, I still like coming here!

Had an event and stayed after as it was such a great time! The bartenders and staff are so welcoming and always there to help. My event went off without a hitch and ended up being a huge HIT!

Thanks Bourbon Cowboy

Such a great experience here I will only stay at the Peppermill whenever I go to Reno! The staff is hands down professional and make you feel like you are a high roller even if you're not. I can't believe there still is EXCEPTIONAL service in this day in time but they nailed it!!!!

Everything I've gotten here has been fantastic. My favorites have been the peanut butter candy cake and some strawberry shortcake I had awhile back. A lot of their baked goods are not overly sugary, but place more emphasis on the heavy cream/flavor like I prefer. They also have a large assortment of small cookies, which I like because you can get more variety without feeling the pressure of buying huge desserts.

Great service from Gem State.  Came in at 9:00 Am and my truck was ready the same afternoon.  Had a real bad noise from an installation of a large gas tank from a dealer.  These guys found that the DEF hose was not routed correctly and solved the problem.  No rattles, inexpensive fix and super nice guys.  Will definitely be back for my regular service and any other needs.

I went last night with a friend for Khyber's 4th Anniversary. The service was a bit slow but considering the crowd it was expected. They had an amazing craft beer menu for the event. We ordered the pulled pork nachos which were awesome! A small is more then enough for two people. I ordered the fried chicken po boy with a side of mashed potatoes, delish! My friend ordered the Sammie po boy with a side of cheddar fries, the fries were average but the rolls for the po boys were spent on authentic. We love the casual cozy vibe of this pub!
Your new "packaging" SUCKS!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  Trying to stir a grabbagreen now makes a HUGE mess!  Go back to the box.  It's cute and functional.  IRRITATING!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

The set up was kinda odd, with people having to share tables inside so I ate outside on the patio.  I didn't wanna sit inside because it seemed like no matter where I was all I could hear were people shouting orders.  I had the spicy pulled pork sandwich and it was amazingly tender and obviously made with a careful hand and a slow cooker!  On a sidenote they carry Cheerwine; the unofficial best thing about the south! Cherry Soda!!!!!!!

I bit the bullet and bought a membership after seeing the 2015 pricing! I love this place. Peruse their website (imamuseum.org) or follow them on Facebook or Twitter for a bit about what they have to offer! The IMA is one of my favorite places in Indianapolis. :)

Considering a Membership? The Perks:
- Membership gets you a discount in the cafe (its Kahn's so you know its good!) & free parking.
- The dual membership option is the way to go! You can go-in w/any 2 adults & when one of you goes you can bring another adult w/you! I signed up my sister and I so either of us can go together or on our own w/our hubbies!
- If you paid for parking on the day you bought your membership they'll take the $5 off your membership price!

Random Fugalista Tips:
- If you don't have a membership and want to avoid the $5 parking fee, there is a lot to the left after entering via the Michigan Roan entrance. 
 - If you paid for parking on the day you bought your membership they'll take the $5 off your membership price!
- Free refills on coffee purchased at the IMA Cafe!
- Free coat check on the 1st floor near the elevators / welcome desk.

Random Mommy Tips:
- There is a nursing mother's room on the first floor outside of the IMA Cafe.
- There are free family friendly events on the first Saturday of the month - and they look amazing and engaging for kiddos of all ages!
- Stroller friendly. And diaper bags are welcome throughout the museum!

When it comes to Subway's the product is pretty much uniform across locations as long as they keep fresh buns and toppings on hand. Most of the difference I believe is when it comes to staff, customer service, cleanliness, and the location.

I came in one day for lunch when I was between meetings and in the area. It was just starting to get busy for lunch so there was a bit of a line-up. By just starting to get busy I mean there were 2 people that just finished paying and I was next and then 2 people behind me and people were starting to come in behind those people. So by any means I wouldn't not consider that a huge line-up at all.

My main reason for giving such a low rating is purely the dysfunctional layout of the store. As you move down the line towards the till you are herded into the corner where the pop vending machine is and all of the eating utensils and essentials. So this design pushes people into a tight corner where everyone is in each others way. It is very uncomfortable to say the least. It isn't a huge store...maybe 20 seats in total perhaps. There must be a better way to lay things out to better control the flow of customers but it may take a bit of remodelling. Personally this dysfunctional layout would prevent me from coming back. It is just too awkward and uncomfortable of a location. Hopefully they can remedy this at some point. If so I may revisit and update my review.

First impression was not good. They were out of the signature appetizer, but sounds like this was a vendor issue. However, I ordered the Mahi with black beans and rice. Soggy, cold fries were substituted for the rice. I was not informed that there was no rice in the back, nor was I given a choice of what vegetable I could have as a substitution prior to my dinner being served. In addition, the servers and hostess crew were disorganized and confused. It took a long time to get out food. There were no apologies for the food or service from the staff.   Having said this, other than the fries which I substituted broccoli for, the food was good. I would try again, but I hope that our next time will be memorable for all the right reasons.//

Since original review have been back. I see some improvement has been made in service. Overall still about average on food, but glad to see them moving in the right direction.

OK steakhouse. As one of the review said kind of 70s inside. Watch out for the bench seats they have springs in them that send you across the room. Quality of the meat was fair but it was cooked on wood which made it very tasty. Straight up steak ,baked potato and salad. I go back again.

We took the Ferry operated by Hubbard's Marina from Ft DeSoto to Egmont Key this morning.  Both captains were great, deviating both going out and coming back to watch dolphin activity in the area!  The boat was clean. The island is a hidden jewel. There are picnic tables and shaded areas to relax as well as beautiful uncrowned beaches!  Seabirds and tortoises abound along with the ruins of Ft Dade. Well worth the $20. ticket to take the ferry.

After evacuating Florida for hurricane Irma, my wife and I came here for breakfast. So Happy we made this choice. The breakfast was so GOOD!  My wife had the southern stack with sweet potato pancakes, pulled pork, egg and potatos and I had an omelet with pulled pork and sausage. Real nice.  Also, being with 2 pets the outdoor seating was wonderful! Thanks Pucketts!

Place is very nice and clean. Service is friendly and welcoming. We had about 3 different people serving us that made us feel very welcomed. The menu had plenty of choices for the two of us.
We started the dinner with the burrata and risotto cakes. The cheese was decent. Lacked a bit of salt for our taste buds but we still ate every last piece. The risotto cakes were very heavy on the breading and lacked flavor. We next shared a salad and the tomato soup. The soup was some of the best we have ever had and was our favorite plate of the night. The salad was fresh and bright. The main dish consisted of Rigatoni for me and the wife had seafood paella. The chicken meatballs in the rigatoni were tough, dry, and not desirable. The pasta and sauce were great. The paella was tasty with a good selection of seafood.
We finished the evening with a chocolate mouse tarte. The little dessert was full of great flavor.
I would recommend Richard's to anybody looking for a great night out. Service is great. overall flavors are solid. 
Cheers Always!

Service was great. I am not a beer drinker and our waiter was very helpful when I asked about the Sunset Raspberry.  I ordered it and was very glad iI did. My husband had the salmon fish and chips. They were light and tasty. He raved about the chips. I had the fried green BLT. It was very tasty, thread and sauce on point. The sweet potato fries were great.

Some of the best Cuban food around. We really enjoyed our dinner there. There was about a 30 minute wait on a Saturday night, which didn't bother us. While we were waiting we had some mojitos at the bar which were really delicious. There was also live music which was awesome. We got seated fairly quickly. Food was delicious. My boyfriend had he Mexican bowl with steak and I had the Ropa Vieja. It was excellent. The meat was so tender and flavorful and the sides were amazing. It also came with tortilla soup and was so good. Will be back.
Hardly gourmet...but unique place and pretty good food at a really good price! I go here almost every time I'm in the St. Pete area.

We love going to the Hopewell Valley Vineyards on Friday evenings during the summer.  It's relaxing to sit outside on the deck or the picnic tables (too loud inside...) and watch the sun set over the vineyard while enjoying the quite good Chambourcin or Barbera.
  
Unfortunately, there is some zoning controversy with the local government, so they had to shut down the large backroom and they no longer make pizza.  :-(   But still, I enjoy supporting local agriculture and local business, the wine is great, and the location is wonderful.

The rock crab combo here is pretty bomb. It comes with the crab, a choice of lobster bisque/clam chowder, onion rings and a caesar salad. I think it was around $30 and the crab alone is probably worth it. I also got the cioppino and it was soooo good - like seafood should always taste like :D

Unfortunately, I don't have anything good to say about the lobster roll. I wouldn't have finished it if I didn't pay like $20 for it. Anyways, definitely coming back with my girlfriend to try some other things.

You will be blown away by the choices and variety of pancakes. Stuffed with sausage or ham? No problem.  Cornmeal? You got it. I got more traditional breakfast  -  eggs with huge slice of country that kept me thirsty all day, plus pancakes on the side. Loved it. Lots of students and staff from Vanderbilt University makes for a college vibe. Definitely will go back.
Awful, Awful, Awful... I'm never going back. That place is filthy, the food was disguising, the all you can eat sushi buffet bar for $9.95 at lunch is not worth it.

We popped into Sherbrooke specifically looking to pick up a few bottles of unique beer to include in a Christmas gift and we were blown away with the selection. We of course had heard about Sherbrooke and they definitely lived up to their reputation.

I'm a huge fan of service, if anyone knows me, and wow, 5 starts to Sherbrooke for great service! We had bought a Game of Thrones beer for a friend who's a fan of the show and at the till, the cashier asked if we had seen the other bottle as well. We hadn't, and instead of sending us into the cooler, he ran in to get it for us. We ended up then buying two of each of the two bottles plus the other beer and few bottles of wine that we had stopped in for.

Great experience, great selection and fantastic customer service from a cashier who clearly knows the product and is willing to serve.

We stopped in on an afternoon of shopping in Metairie and were looking for something quick and easy. I had never heard of this place before, but I am a fan of Moe's so we decided to give it a try.
It was OK. there was nothing really special about this place and nothing wrong with it. I felt like my burrito lacked flavor, but I like fresh veggies which you always get in these types of places as opposed to a McDonalds or similar. All in all, it was OK. 
What I can say for sure is that I didn't find it anywhere near as good as Moe's and we have not been back at all since and it's been about 3 months. So I think our lack  of enthusiasm kind of says it all.

When we visited the city and of course you have to eat everywhere you go. We ended up trying this place, not disappointed! I as a meat eater (wife is vegetarian) couldn't believe the flavor. There were actually two other people who I assumed was their first time there, the lady, after taking a bite, actually went to the counter just to make sure there was no meat in the burger. They assured her there wasn't. So, this place is best veggie burger place, hands down.
Nice selection, great customer service plus a wonderful selection of garden knick knacks.

Average to below average seafood for way above average price. Where do they get off saying this is "fresh seafood". I had the broiled platter and it was frozen crap that I could get at a Captain D's for a fraction of the cost. This platter had  one of those cheap crab cakes in the crab body shell. You know the kind with no crab meat what so ever in it.  The instant rice pilaf reminded me of something at Shoney's.. Farm raised small shrimp, that I know were frozen. FIsh that was billed at "Fresh Catch Ponchatrain", give me a break, that  fish was cheap old tilapia probably raised in China! I ordered a side of sautéed spinach for 5 bucks that I swear was about 2 tablespoons, that's it!


Bottom line is I had 3 beers,  and a very low quality seafood dinner and with tip it was $63.49, my GOD what a rip off! I will never go back to a Landry's. No wonder the place was empty. I thought  it was supposed to be a good place, wrongggggg!

Great food, very nice atmosphere, and an exceptional staff. 

The setup is quite nice, with a casual yet elegant feel to it. My wife and I shared the jerk wings and the curry chicken, and both were phenomenal. The wings simply fall off the bone, and the seasoning (while hot, which we liked) is just right. The curry chicken (equally tender) is nicely seasoned with rice/peas and plantains. The Cab Sav wine goes nicely with the meal. 

So glad we saw the excellent reviews and decided to try out Yah Mon (though I'm also glad we used the GPS b/c I really had not seen it before since it's a little tucked away). Next time we'll try the desert...they have some great looking options, we just didn't have room for it this time around. Some reviews mention the longer prep time for certain dishes, which our server made us aware of. For reference, our food was ready almost immediately, likely due to the fact that it was marinating for flavor and not a dish that the kitchen had to prepare upon order. 

We'll definitely be back!

There seem to be two types of reviews: those who say it's fresh, gourmet, delicious Chinese food, and those who say it's not that great and overpriced.  I side with the former and not the latter.

The food is fresh and well-prepared.  It's solidly good Chinese food.  It isn't the best I've had (in the Tampa Bay Area, that's ABC Seafood in St. Pete, and Hong Kong House in Temple Terrace - both of which are 30-45 minutes from my house, and as a result I go there infrequently), but it's good.  Some reviewers have complained that it's a little bland.  Our food wasn't, but I'm curious if there's some sort of... non-American menu.  I've heard of Asian restaurants toning down their food for Americans, and it's possible that they do it here.  I would recommend that they don't, or that they give the option of more or less authentic.  We could have handled more spice/garlic/ginger.  But that said, we enjoyed our food.  It's close to my house.  It's family run.  We will definitely be back.  

The complainers seem to take issue at three things: the price, the portion size, and whether or not the owner was rude to them/ why the food took so long to prepare.  First, the price: this is a restaurant, it is not your greasy neighborhood Chinese take-out (you know, China Pearl or Chinese # 1).  The interior is lovely and clean, with nice lighting and pretty fixtures.  Accordingly, they charge as a restaurant would.  If you want greasy take-out then get greasy take-out.  But this is not the place to do so.  Second, the portion size: I think this falls under my first point: this isn't China # 1.  The portions aren't mammoth, and you probably won't become obese or develop diabetes eating here.  But the portions are not small!  My husband and I ordered a few things to share, and we have plenty of leftovers.  Third, a few reviewers said that the owner was rude to them, and/or that the food took forever to prepare.  To the time, it's a two person operation!  The husband is the entire kitchen staff, and the wife runs the front of the house.  That is an awful lot of work.  Further, fresh food takes time to prepare.  If you want pork fried rice in 10 minutes, go somewhere else.  As to the alleged rudeness, I can't speak to it, because the owner was nothing but nice to us.  She even gave us a free lychee soda while we waited for our take-out!  If people have perceived her as rude, the only thing I can imagine is, if it was busy, (remember, it's only a 2-person operation and she runs the entire front of the house) she may have been rushed or hurried, and thus seemed not super friendly.  This is normal.  It's one thing to accuse someone of being rude, but it's another to fail to take into account the various factors that are going on in a situation.  Restaurant work is hard, so cut your servers some slack.  Especially when the server is the owner, and the other owner is the entire kitchen staff. 

In short, I recommend this restaurant, although next time I go I will ask for less-Americanized food.  And we will probably eat in the restaurant, because it really is lovely and romantic.

My girlfriend drove me up and down about this review whoever the young light skin gentleman that helped us out May 30 between 8-830 was one of the best customer service we have revived around the whole city was a great guy he took his time made our food how we liked it even though  we share everything he made our bowl to fit both of us and are chicken quesadillas to fix both of our taste in flavor need more people like you around I believe you deserve a raise or a higher position your going somewhere appreciate how you appreciate your job  Thanks for your great spirit and making our food excellent to GO ! My girlfriend will be happy to read this review keep up the great work

The food here is always hit or miss for me, and the last time I was there the service was extremely slow (2 hrs for lunch mid-week!). I think the atmosphere and taste of the food make the prices seem high, especially when there are other authentic New Orleans restaurants not too far away that do it better for cheaper. If you're in the area, and there's a table open, great. I wouldn't trek here, and I wouldn't wait for a table. The specials tend to be awesome, and rather pricey. Some of the main menu items can be total misses, and also pricey. The cocktails are generally the most consistent thing about the restaurant, so I don't mind the price quite as much, but they're not cheap. I've always had meh service on every visit, so nothing impressive there. Overall, at this point, I only go here when other people really want to go. If I can convince them otherwise, we eat elsewhere. Midcity has too many other great options at this point.
This is definitely my favorite one so far out of all the LA Fitness locations I've been to....friendly helpful staff, equipment is always where it belongs, always paper towels and soap.

Very helpful staff, very clean hotel and rooms. The entire place is non smoking, rare in Reno. I would stay there again.  I would give five stars except the breakfast was horrible.  Dried out eggs, yuk.

Amazing!

I order the Tofu Amazing and it is truly amazing. It's a peanut sauce with broccoli and the best peanut sauce I've ever had and that's what I always order. You can get any protein with the sauce. Their serving of sauce is super generous and I always make more tofu or fake chicken and rice to serve with leftover sauce. 

The staff is friendly and they're so so fast! I'm happy to see they deliver now and have a restaurant with seating! We'll be back soon to sit down and eat in.
It is moor redneck join, owner is root food was cold and mass up order  will not recommend.Place small and music loud can't hear anyone

The food is good, the service is mediocre at best. We came at a slow time on a Sunday, and our server neglected to give us plates, silverware, and napkins. He was inattentive, neglected to refill drinks, and did not once check on how we were doing or if we needed anything. I won't be rushing back.

One of my favorite restaurants in Nashville. Build your own soup is perfect on a rainy April night and the Pad Thai is authentic with both chicken and tofu! Don't skip on the mango sticky rice, it's divine..Eat here!!

We stopped in after hiking Saguaro National Park.  We were hot and sweaty and ready for some great ice cream, which we found!  I ordered chocolate and toffee coffee, and my husband ordered German chocolate and coffee toffee.  They were out of gluten free waffle cones, so we'll have to go back! We enjoyed chatting with the owner about his pasteurization process and the many flavors while sitting at the ice cream bar!

The day of our tour it was raining off and on but they didn't cancel which I give props for. The tour lasted a little over 2 hours and we went to 4 places. We tried gumbo, jambalaya, a brisket sandwich and a muffuletta. The food was good, I didn't care much for the jambalaya but every place we stopped at the people from the restaurant seemed like they hadn't gotten a heads up that we were coming. So every time we stopped we'd have to watch the staff scramble around as we waited for tables to be put together and food to be brought out, it was odd. We lost a few people along the way I'm not sure if they just left or the guide left without them. I'd recommend a different food tour that offers more stops to get a better variety of food. It was nice to get a tour around the city but it's he's to take in the scenery when you're trying to keep up with everyone in the rain.

I finally bought something here and It was definitely a pleasant experience.

A few years ago I stopped in here with friend who was buying film. I asked one of the salesman about a problem I was having with my camcorder. Even though I wasn't there to buy anything for myself, he still spent some time to help me out and gave me info on where to send my camcorder to get fixed by Canon. That is when I knew I'd be back to Schiller's if I ever wanted to buy a new camera. 

Last week I stopped in to see what my options were. A fellow named Brad asked me if I needed help. He was very helpful and patient with me. He answered all of my questions and helped me narrow down the selection. There were three that I was interested in so he wrote the brand and models down on his business card. He probably expected that I would buy one for cheaper on the internet but that was out of the question. I did some research on the cameras and decided on one of them. 

A few days later I returned but Brad was busy with another customer. Some other gentlemen that worked there helped me out until Brad was done with the other customer. The camera I purchased was about $60 more at Schiller's than on the internet but the customer service was totally worth it for me. The extra battery and memory card put the price a bit above what I wanted to spend but then Brad told me since I bought the camera there, I get 25 free prints every month for a year. That was totally worth spending the extra dough on an extra battery and then he even threw in a little camera case! What a guy! 

Schiller's seems to have a great selection of cameras and camera equipment. The one gentleman that helped me for a minute was a little awkward to deal with and my friend said he had a little bit of difficulty with customer service. Brad and the guy who helped me with my camcorder were great to deal with so I guess it all depends on which employee is helping you. I definitely recommend giving Schiller's a chance. I'm a huge fan of supporting local businesses, even if you are dead set on buying from a big chain store or on the internet, at least stop in and see what they have and what there prices are.
I workout here 5 days a week, and love it!  The staff is friendly,  the place is immaculate,  the equipment is in excellent shape.
Save your money. I cook better tasting food than this place.
Perfect after a hard workout.  The right amount of carbs and protein!

On my last visit to Philadelphia, I did not have time to get a cheese steak.  I just arrived and made it my first priority to get one.  I walked around the Rittenhouse district and came upon Tony Jr's.  I placed an order for the Steak Hoagie with Provolone Cheese (hot peppers but no onions).  I didn't have to wait long for the order to come out.  I woofed it down and enjoyed every bite.  The steak was tender and tasty.  The hots looked a bit weird, but added a good spiciness.  The place only has four small tables, so I think most people do take out.

I was very impressed by the professionalism, friendliness,  and straight talking that we experienced from the technician and the dispatcher.  We have a great deal of experience with AC companies and thus far Family Air is the best we have encountered. 
They did not try to come up with extra charges nor did they try to sell me things I didn't needed.

Great company run by great people. Their service is amazing and they walk you through very step. I had the worst situation happen. My AC completely went out unexpectedly right as the temperatures got into the high 80's. With indoor pets and a 2 year old, I needed AC quickly and Diamond Heating and Cooling delivered. They also have a great service program and warranty. Highly recommended.

This place was a joke.  We were sat at a table the was not even clean.  The table cloth was dirty and full of crumbs.  We ordered bruchetta which had very little on it and the cheese wasn't even melted.  The food was nothing to brag about.  I have had better frozen Italian with sauce from a jar.  The owner is very arrogant and does not care if his customers are happy.

One of the best places in Indy.  So the food may not be 100% up to the expectations of what the Louisiana yuppies would call authentic Cajun... but it's good.  Damn good.  I have dreams about the Chili Cheese étouffée.  The staff is always helpful and they will let you try anything.  They are FAST and friendly and have a cool, mellow, hip vibe.  Love.......this......... place!

Recently tried this place on a Wednesday night for Geeks who Drink! Service was great - our server Melissa never let our drinks get too empty and always accommodating. I ordered the trident burger, MR with a side of sweet potato fries. The burger was delicious and cooked to order! The fries were a perfect texture, crisp and not soggy. 

The venue itself is a little small for the amount of people that were there on a busy night as it got really stuffy and hot. They only have 2 stalls in their womens restrooms so there was almost always a line. Everything was very clean, however, despite the vast number of bodies in the room.

This Uptown gem is truly as good as it gets.  The atmosphere is charming and perfect for romantic evenings, friends night out, or family gatherings.  Prices aren't expensive for high-end New Orleans, which makes it even more appealing!

My recommendations: Oysters Goodenough, Oysters Goodenough Omelette (or really anything they do with oysters), and the burger.

I didn't stay here but I can tell you the staff is incredible.  Got caught in an absolute monsoon across the street along with a few dozen other people.  Ran into the Hyatt and immediately staff set up a table and brought down a ton of towels, allowing non-patrons to come in and dry off while the storm passed.  If you treat people that aren't your customers that well I can only imagine what it would be like to stay here.

Iam a recent client of Stephanie and I couldn't be happier! She does the most beautiful lash perm!! I have very straight eyelashes so I am obsessed with perming! Definitely recommend this spa and request Stephanie!
Nice quiet location. Good coffee. I got the mocha. It was excellent. Nice and friendly service. Mellow atmosphere. Stop by and check it out.

The food is absolutely amazing - definitely worth the wait - I frequent this place on Sundays for brunch. Staff is attentive and organized. There are a few downsides that the food more than makes up for: 1) it's a long wait (try to get there early, put your name down, etc.); 2) it's cash only (atm machine in the back); 3) it's crowded and a little cramped at times, but again, amazing food and good service.

This is a really attractive place with a friendly staff. Last time we were there we shared the place with a brewery tour bus, so it was a festive atmosphere. I really did not like any of the beers I tasted, though. Perhaps it's just me.

Make an appointment or just drop in.  Quick, efficient, reasonably priced services.

They explain everything to you and don't pressure you to have work done there.
Don't get the smaller tavern burger! It's a different patty that taste like the 49 cents McDonald's special.

These donuts were pretty good, a bit more cakey than other donuts we've had, but the unique flavors had us really interested. We ordered the the apple jelly filled, the cranapple filled, and two classic chocolate donuts. They were good to try. I will say there wasn't a ton of filling in the jelly-filled donuts, we were surprised at how little. They tasted as though they were a couple days old. The customer service was top notch, though. 

The location was great when we arrived (shortly after 9:30am on a Friday) but I'd imagine it could get very cramped very quickly. I was surprised there wasn't really any place to eat the donuts in the shop, but we found a park nearby.

Stumbled upon this place because all the other bars were closed because of a water main break. We were going to order food until we walked in and saw it was a little run down and the bathroom was disgusting. Decided to just get a beer and leave. Wasn't worth our time.
The staff is always very friendly, the store is always clean and a great place to meet friends for coffee!

If you are looking for middle of the road Mexican, this place is for you.  I do not mean it is bad, the food is prepared well.  It is just not special; the service is good but not great.  The notable exception is the tequila, they had plenty of varieties, and they mixed their margaritas well.

So go, just do not expect exceptional.

I like the chicken here. The taste is clean, yet moist and flavorful. The green sauce is the best. I don't care for the white sauce as much.

The Cilantro rice and beans I've had were decent as well. 

The other meats are just okay. Stick with the chicken.

The location is in a weird spot on Hillsborough near the airport, so I always forget to eat here.

Seriously wish this place would open up another location in Phx. My husband and I used to work down the road from el nene and would get it for lunch but now we live in Phx and can't find ANYONE who makes a correct senoran dog!!!.

With all the hype I was hoping to eat some Ramen that was extremely delicious. I will admit it was very tasty, but I was disappointed in the amount of choices I had. I eat everything from beef to seafood to veggies, unfortunately my girlfriend doesn't and ordering for a person who only eats chicken and vegetables; Cheu falls a little short. I ordered the lamb noodles and ordered the pork shoulder ramen without the pork for my girlfriend. We both enjoyed it however the pork ramen was very bland so we had to add a healthy serving of Sriracha to make it to our liking. 

This place is good if you're a full on carnivore like myself, alas I now have to be more selective on the types of restaurants I choose when I go out my girl. It sucks!!! Anyway sorry for getting side tracked. I had to give it a 3 just because of the lack of menu choices and vegetarian options.
Best chicken wings in town.  Zippy chicken sandwich is a winner and the steaks are also good.  Love this place.

I went to Lee's tailoring because I needed a suit tailored before graduation. I needed the pants hemmed and the sleeves on my coat shortened.

When I walked in, Lee helped me immediately and was very friendly. I put on the suit, and he marked the sleeves accordingly. When it came to the pants, I told him I wanted little to no break and he worked with that splendidly.

I picked up my items a week later and tried them on--fit like a dream. I was very happy with the outcome! 

Now, the only complaint that I have, and this is potentially unfair on my part, was the price I had to pay. I saved a lot on the suit, so spending money on the tailor was something I knew I was going to have to do--I just didn't expect to pay as much as I did. 

But I think good tailoring is like getting a tattoo--if you have articles of clothing you plan on wearing perfectly for a long time, you have to go to a good tailor. Bargaining on a tattoo artist is not something you do and it should be the same way with a tailor. 

I give the place 5 stars for perfect tailoring, excellent service, and an overall great experience.

Decided last minute to buy a new mattress before a cross country move. Dale was the sales associate in the store that day. She was a great listener, very knowledgable, and not pushy at all. She made me feel very comfortable about the entire process. 

Something else that made me feel good about the purchase is that they have a "happiness guarantee" policy where you can return the mattress (for $149 pick-up/processing fee) if you're unhappy with it after trying it out for about 4 months. Fingers crossed I don't have to use it!

Just had the best eyebrow waxing here. Ronnie did my eyebrows and she was wonderful. I was even telling her how it was the least painful eyebrow waxing I've ever experienced (and I have tons). I can tell that she was really passionate about what she does as she has so much knowledge to share with me. I look forward to go back to Ronnie for my eyebrows!

I had to leave a review for O'Neal and Dr. Littlejohn. If you're looking for an inexpensive and experienced vet in West Philly GO HERE. I'm moving across country and Dr. Littlejohn was super nice and helpful. He gave my cat her annual shots, some Xanax for the flight and a health certificate for the airline. The total cost was $80!!! Very reasonable and perfectly located for Drexel and Penn students at 45th and Market. The offices are definitely run down, but don't be turned off by the shabby exterior. Dr. Littlejohn was great and the prices are perfect for a college student like myself who still wants to take care of her furry baby.

I liked staying at the peppermill.  The people were very nice that they upgraded my room to stay at the tuscany suites which wsa a very nice room. I got the room for $70 dollars a night. It came with a nice jacuzzi, shower and a great toilet.  The room was quite big that I could have stayed in there the whole day.  I really like the sheets as well and the bed was nice and comfortable that I could have fallen asleep in there all day long.

Room service was good and the food as well, but like in any hotel place it was quite pricey but then tip and everything is included so we did not have to worry about that stuff.

Anyways unfortunately I did not gamble there, but it was okay though. It was probably the nicest casino out in reno however.  The resort fee does suck it is $12 dollars a night.  But with it comes with internet though.

A much better use of an ex Tim Hortons location! I understand why this cafe is so busy. The phone soups are delicious. Satay noodle soup is a solid 8 out of 10. Friendly courteous service. Affordable. Excellent choice for Vietnamese in South Edmonton. Love how they Reno's a Tim's to a higher purpose.

TJ is great at what he does! Always polite and courteous, he under promises and over delivers! TJ's prices are also a bargain! He has saved me hundreds by repairing my favorite winter boots, work pumps and night out heels. I will only go to TJ!
All fried stuff here pretty much. They have the raw oysters which my bf loved. I don't care for raw foods. The hushpuppies were good. I loved the Strawberry Shortcake drink = YUMMY. :D

We are big fans of the Kimpton Brand and have stayed twice at the Monaco over the holidays.  The most recent time was with the family and we were very impressed with the dinner at the Red Owl Tavern.  Some kinks to work out with the service (newer restaurant), but the food and the effort was great.  
Food - wife and 4 year old loved the short ribs. I had a beet pasta dish that was fantastic.  7 year old did not see anything on the menu she liked, so she just ordered off menu - no problem
Service - a little disorganized, but tried really hard.  No booster seats, so they grabbed a larger pillow from the lobby.  I appreciate the effort.
Overall, we have been to many Kimpton properties and most times, the food/food choice is just "OK".  Not the case with the Monaco in Philly.

Tucked away in a very small and desolate mall is this little gem in Indy.  It's hard to find good/authentic Asian food in the Indy area, especially one that stays true to the flavors of Thai/Lao cuisine.  If you are looking for traditional flavors, check out this restaurant.  The papaya salad was great, crab paste base had a nice balance.  For some places, the crab paste can be a little too strong and lingers at the back of my throat but this one was balanced, not too dark!  The Laotian style wings were also great, the sauce had a nice sweet,sour,fermenty flavor to them. Wish I had more room in my stomach to order more from the menu. If it I was closer I'd come almost every day!!  Will definitely come back to try their Sunday pho and other items on their menu.

I had gone to Native Seeds next door for seeds for my garden and wondered about Amelia Grey's next door. Then when I drove past a couple weeks ago and noticed it was now occupied by a new establishment called Prep & Pastry I checked out the menu online. Everything looked amazing!

I finally got down there on Monday this week and I asked the waiter/possible owner(?) to pick something for me. He picked the brioche French toast stuffed with a berry compote and freshly whipped cream. It was decadent, sweet but balanced, and served with real maple syrup. I also ordered a cup of chamomile tea and they brought it out in a personal size French press. So cute! I also got another to go, at no added cost! 

I also loved the interior. It has a farmhouse or old barn feel about it with chalkboard painted walls covered in cute drawings and quotes. The decor makes you feel good, with so much natural light coming in through the many windows in the building. 

I will definitely be back and next time I'm trying something savory!

This place is brand new, and my first experience was really enjoyable. The decorations set a good vibe; its calm and cool in there. Some of the art on the wall is for sale too. I was greeted by a cashier whose name I've unfortunately forgotten, but she was incredibly kind. She recommended the green oasis smoothie, and I took her advice. I did tell her that I am dairy free, and she said that wasnt a problem, they just didn't add the yogurt.

They also have breakfast sandwiches, pastries, and pre-made salads and sandwiches that will be great when I'm in a hurry to get to work.

The green oasis smoothie was so delicious that I stuck my head back in the door to tell the woman who I assume was the owner that it was delicious. Entire staff was pleasant, delicious first product, and enjoyed the atmosphere. I may become a regular.
Love going to the Hattery and Kennedy is the best!!

While the food is okay, trying to deal with the people who run this place makes it not worth it. Kind of rude and they'll really try to nickle and dime you over every little thing. Here's hoping that you'll actually get what you ordered.

My friend went here the weekend before I came into town. She highly recommend this place. Knowing that she is a true foodie, like myself, I trusted her and made the drive over. Let me just say words can't express how delicious the food is here. I ordered two meals. The French  toast and the shrimp and grits. The shrimp and grits are by far the best I ever ate. Creamy, seasoned, delicious, fresh, the best I ever late! We also ordered the biscuits & gravy. The biscuits are just like the ones my grandmother makes and the gravy was the perfect compliment. Seasoning was perfect, sausage was delicious. I will be back here again the next time I am in New Orleans.

Cool little bar with friendly service, some good cocktails and live music. It's a good place to stop in for a drink before or after dinner at Felix's or Acme's. We found it while headed to one of those restaurants for dinner and wanted a place to wait out the line.

Twice this past week they were closed when the sign on the door (and their answering machine - I called too) said they'd be open. Once I can maybe understand, on a Monday night, but Saturday we thought we'd try again but waited 45 minutes past their opening at 6 only to see the manager next door (Pollo Ray, where we then DID eat - movie next door started at 7) come over to put a sign on the door indicating they wouldn't be opening. 

They even had an employee who didn't have keys to open the place waiting outside to work. Even the best food is terrible if you can't get in to have it!

Service was quick but good! They have WiFi! Got a basic mani and pedi and was in and out in about an hour. I was disappointed in the polish choices that were offered when I was there which is why I docked a star. There wasn't a wide variety of colors to choose from. And the nail tech didn't coat my entire nail with the top coat which left it looking a little wonky. However, I'd come back, the nail tech was sweet and did a decent job.

Tonight was my first stop at this great restaurant.  For $22, I picked up a whole roast beef poboy, a half veal poboy w brown gravy (this was awesome), a burger on bun, and an order of fries.  I was stunned that it was so inexpensive, and then I was thrilled that it tasted so good.  

The ladies working tonight were also very friendly, and I enjoyed chatting with them.  
All in all, it was a pleasant experience, and I plan to go back and try more of their sandwiches and also buy some seafood.

If you need a poboy fix and are out in Gentilly, this is the place to go.

We just got take out from here.  I had the seafood risotto, but it was not like risotto at all.  It was just rice in light red sauce.  Risotto is supposed to have a certain consistency and mouth feel that makes it risotto! Also, my seafood was overcooked.  My husband got the chicken piccata, which was kinda dry.  He was also disappointed it only came with veggies and no pasta...especially for the price  I give it a solid 3 stars, but there are way too many good choices around here to try this place again.

Early this month I had taken my car into the shop to replace my front tires. It was very late and near closing time. I explained that I was heading to the beach in the morning and was worried if my worned tires were safe to drive long distant. The mechanic  who i originally spoke to went to explained to the service manager and had decided to allow me to purchase the proper tires 5 mins before closing. Not only i was able to purchase the new tires, the service crew had them installed properly and rotate them as well.  The excellent service doesn't stop there, as I was waiting in the waiting room, one of the cashier personnel came over to see if I was ok and asked if I would like some bottled water, which I thought was pretty nice. Excellent job guys! Thank you again! I would definitely recommend people taking their cars there!

This place is great! They have tons of ski stuff. An unbelievable selection!! Also talked scuba chat and the guy was sooooo knowledgable! He told us about a group dive in August, definitely going!!! Very cool place. Love that it is family own!! Can't wait to come back and buy as much stuff as my bank account can handle.

Noisy and crowded but otherwise (assuming you don't like that -- maybe you do!) extremely nice.  We started with an excellent mushroom soup.  The mushrooms, seasoning, and croutons were all perfect.  

I had the turkey sandwich, which I didn't plan to eat all of but I did.  Then we had a brownie Sunday for dessert -- excellent!!  I forget what my husband's main course was, but the waiter helped him with a beer selection, letting him taste two beers to pick one to drink.  He enjoyed his beer very much.
One of the best burgers of my life. Paid extra to add bacon and avocado and they put a lot on, and bacon was perfectly cooked. Good beer list too!

From out of town and went here for a one off in a bind and they got me in and did a great job. 
Glad they just used scissors and didn't go clipper and thinning scissors crazy. I would recommend for in towners and out of towners
The mushroom soup is delicious! Sweet tea is good too but the spiked sausage hoagie was to die for. My dad & I split the whole hoagie and we both couldn't get over how good it was. So much flavor!
I got the seaweed salad as a side. $8.00 for a bowl of premade seaweed. Are you serious? I also got a spicy tuna topped with salmon the salmon was warm and tasted fishy. Will never return.

Great food and german beer!!! 
Their homemade curry and pork is extremely tasty, and my friend loves the apfelkuchlein dessert, I like the homemade warm pretzels and the mustard sauce! 
Simply place, nice and clean
Nice service and the lady is delightful :)

Great food, great drinks and an amazing show! Go for a girls/guys night, with a group of friends or a date night! Make sure when they they ask for volunteers that you ease your hand and get in on their plan!
Good food.  service is decent. We go here probably once a month.  I would recommend people give it a try.

GREAT LOCATION friendly staff needs updating but  not a issue for me. 
Good food in both the lobby restaurant and the catering ballrooms.

Great atmosphere with a very interesting menu. My lamb burger was cooked to perfection and very tasty. Good drink menu with a healthy selection of local beers. The owner was kind and took a moment to speak with me and answer any questions I had. I imagine I will frequent this pub.
Delicious food and affordable. Quick service, friendly staff, clean restaurant, and I can't wait to come back for more.

Suzy-Jo is the place to go for donuts in the western Philly burbs.  Holy cow.  Always fresh, never had a bad donut, but I always look forward to fall when they have their pumpkin with cream cheese frosting...seriously, if it were socially acceptable to make love to a donut, I would....and a sweet, sweet love it would be.

Word of advice, if you're looking for a large order, either call the day before, or get there early.

I went to this place while staying at the Renaissance across the street. It wasn't bad at all, traditional bar food, I liked the drinks. The bartender, Brittany, was very helpful and pleasant. My friends weren't too impressed but it was alright with me :)
There's honestly nothing more to say here but HANDS DOWN THE BEST BAGELS EVER!!! stop in here for good service and great prices.

One big change from a year ago ! Excellent assistance from Nicole in customer assistance , I was looking at a tankless hot water unit and there were no associates back there who were not busy with someone . So I took my brochure for the unit to the customer assistance desk and Nicole was very helpful she not only looked up the price for the unit I was looking at but also the unit smaller and larger and gave me the specifics on all three , wrote down the information and gave me information on the installation parts associated with the tank piping elbows plastic or copper and where to get assistance in the store for those items . Every time I go there with a question she is Johnny on the spot with the answer . All the associates greet you and ask you if you need assistance - a far cry from a year ago when I couldn't find the help I needed from people I no longer see there ! Great job Home Depot - you sure turned your store around . Now I won't go anywhere else !

I booked the Linden Manor B&B when a work conference brought me to Nashville. I didn't want to stay in the limited options of hotels Nashville had, which are mostly your standard Shaerton's etc. Linden Manor is in THE BEST neighborhood in Nashville, 12 South, which is walkable and beautiful. Tucked away on a cozy street, it was a delightful place to stay. The breakfast was homemade and amazing, and the company and service was a delight!

This is just a place to drink as the food is completely overpriced for the boring and typical Tex-Mex crap wrapped in a tortilla of some type.  Tex-Mex isn't complicated and nothing in it is very expensive so there is no way the outrageous prices this place charges for their food can ever be justified other than  they must get a lot of tourists and locals who don't know better so they just rip those clueless folks off.  Why even bother with the overpriced mediocre food here anyway when you can just go eat awesome food right across the street at Lola's!  The owners are nice people but what they charge for a freaking taco is insulting.  Do yourself and your wallet a favor and just booze it up here but never eat.

Stayed at the  hotel for 5 days and was treated better than at any hotel I've been to in a long time.  The staff is just excellent.  My room (located at the end of a very long hall) was quiet, large and the bed was very comfortable.   No view, though, of anything except the other buildings outside and the freeway.   The food is pricey, but they are accommodating to special diets.  They have plenty of gluten free options, including bread and buns.    All in all a great experience.   Highly  recommend this place, though it may not be suitable for families.  It seems more geared to the business traveler.

I love me some salad.  

Usually, I love me some Saladworks.  

Not this Saladworks, though.  

One - the pasta spills  into the romaine constantly, and as someone who can't have pasta, this is a problem.  An almost-died kind of problem.  

Second - the female manager there is downright nasty.  I almost want to give her a hug to cheer her up, but I'm scared to cus she sure is mean.  

Will not be back.

The staff is as lovely as the flowers. I called from another state, which always feels like a gamble, but Mayfield went above and beyond to get a gorgeous arrangement to my aunt. The flowers were beautiful and adhered to my special requests. Plus, they made *all kinds* of extra efforts to deliver them, despite being denied by mutiple phone numbers and rejected by a gate. After some calls and texts, and having to return to the shop with the flowers still in-hand, they ultimately made sure my aunt recieved them on her birthday even though the delivery drivers had gone home for the day. Mayfield rocks.

I love that we have place as a nice take out Mexican stand-by (you can eat in too).  It's close to our house on the west side.  They keep their prices low, and they're so good!  It's a family run long time business.  It's always packed, you can be guaranteed to be full and happy.  The rice and beans and meat are flavorful and delicious.  I like how they wrap my fork in a tortilla too!  It's a little on the dirty side inside, but I don't mind, I usually take the food out, and we're always super satisfied!
Doesn't get any better than BB's in Franklin. Pulled pork and smoked wings are my favorites. Check out the white sauce!

This place lives up to its name: itty bitty, but the food was delicious! Nothing fancy- we had a breakfast if bacon & eggs & biscuits & gravy, but everything they did was done well. The eggs were cooked perfectly, the bacon was crispy & the biscuits & gravy was much tastier than I  normally experience outside of the South. The best part, though, was the service! Sometimes super small diners make newcomers feel awkward, but this place was welcoming from the moment we walked in! The server was friendly and attentive and kept us well supplied with coffee while we visited. Don't let the small size deter you- this place serves up a big helping of hospitality! Definitely gonna go back for lunch to try the burgers!

Enjoyed lunch here yesterday.  I had the daily soup which was asparagus and it was sooooo good on a chilly day. Not too heavy, just right.  I also had the Ellen Salad which was very tasty. I loved the dijon dressing and the shellfish, but my piece of salmon was quite overcooked.  Service was friendly and I loved the Italian Cinema photos everywhere.  We will be back for dinner soon.

OMG what can I say different than others - you must go, enjoy and eat. Fish to non-fish items are all good. Please try the spread.. Whatever you order they provide plenty to fill you. Thank you Ted Peters!!

I'm giving them one star because of the dine-in service. We were seated, ordered... no problem. 40 min later still no food. Called our waitress over and set send a different girl over to our table. We couldn't get a straight answer on how much longer it would be. Finally, we just decided to leave.

Red velvet cake ice cream was rich, creamy, and really satisfied my craving for something sweet! Great location, and friendly staff. They have a lot of intriguing flavors. I know I will want to come back and try more flavors!

Live music and big crowds on Saturday afternoon with mouth watering sandwiches! The line is outside and around the corner so it took a total time of about 55mins to get the food and when we left the line was even longer. Not a ton of seating but we were lucky to find a table for 6, we just had great timing I guess. A lot of people seemed to get food to go, which I would love to do
But for a work day lunch, I would spend my whole lunch break waiting in line! Need to see if they do call ahead orders. The best way to go with a big group, which several of us had never been to was to get 6 different sandwiches and split them all up, that ensured we got to taste a large amount of different things. I would get 2 out of the 6 sandwiches again. We didn't try the special of the day, which I heard is a must do! The atmosphere and workers are awesome, and the music was great! I will be back for more and stay longer for the music next time, can't wait to go back!

Great service by Neil. He was so good to my son and  paid attention to whatever we needed. Had a wonderful Birthday Brunch. Perfection location. Wonderful food and great mimosas. Would highly recommend.

Go figure...we don't do carbs but we love coming to TJ's Italian!  We come here pretty often because it is in our neighborhood.  But our neighborhood has a lot of good restaurants.  We always end up here.  Food is good, the gals at the bar are attentive, and they always are willing to customize a dish for us.  We order the proteins over spinach rather than pasta and we love the antipasto, which is generous. Brandon created a chicken Sorrentino over fresh spinach that looked fantastic and tasted even better.  Thanks TJ and crew... watched a World Series game with a nice bottle of wine and a great dinner at the bar.  We will be back soon!

My friend took me here the other day, as it has become one of her favorite places to eat out.  I can see why.  Urban Eats does healthy scrumptious eating right.  As you walk in you are enveloped with wonderful scents of yeast, meats and more, leaving your stomach screaming for some of their food.  

The set up of the menu is really to my liking.  You can choose panini, wrap or flatbread pizza with listings about what is in it, you then decide what you want in it: chicken, veggies and the like.  There are many options, and all of them are good options.  

I got a wrap with herbed tomatoes with the chicken breast.  This is one of the best wraps that I have ever eaten,  hands down.  I cannot wait to bring my husband here, he is going to love it as will all of you!

I made reservations three days in advanced to take me to the airport. I specifically asked for a taxicab, and not one of their so called limos. They did not send a taxicab they sent a victory limo. Their idea of a limo is not my idea of a limo. A banged up towncar that smells, and has stains all over the seat is not even remotely close. I was in a hurry and did not want to miss my flight. I got in and had to help the guy with directions to the airport. When we got to the airport the guy was like $45.00. What?! No meter in the car? Crap. I got a plane to catch. Never again will I use Victory. Plenty of other reputable cab companies out there.

Love this place! I went with a party of 11 and the hostess was very helpful. We sat at two different tables but it was worth it. Everyone loved the food! I had the B.L.A.T on sourdough and it was perfect! Everyone loved their food and liked their coffee drinks even more. I had an iced coffee with coconut milk and vanilla and it was delicious. I would recommend this to anyone heading to Nashville

The best pies I have ever had, as far as I can tell.  My favorites are the Dutch Apple and the original Sugar Cream pie.  We always get them for holidays and special occasions, and they don't last long!

I'm totally catching up on my reviews for the past couple of months and it seems like I have been very fortunate to have tried some very great eats! Mr. B's was our last dining experience before we headed home the next day and I am so glad we were able to stop by. Cajun food is always so tasty to me because of the bold flavors and of course many of the dishes feature fresh seafood. Mr. B's reminds you off an olden day bistro where ad men come to eat and wine and dine their fancy clients! Maybe I'm anticipating the return of Mad Men, but ah, I digress! We didn't have a sit down dinner but rather grabbed a few seats at the bar and got to know the bartenders. I still dream about Mr. B's BBQ shrimp. Don't be fooled by the name. The shrimp is juicy, plump, and so full of buttery goodness. I was on the fringe of licking my plate!! My second fav dish is actually a side dish. It's the grits in the shrimp and grits plate.I'm usually not a fan of grits but these were amazing. Again, rich in flavor and oh so creamy. We happily finished the meal with a side of the pecan pie. Again, never thought I was a fan but Mr. B's changed my mind. I'm not sure if I would come back to New Orleans anytime soon but if I could hop on a jet and dine at Mr. B's, I'd go in a heart beat!
I was an Ethiopian food virgin, and Queen of Sheba has officially made me a fan! We had the sampler of 8 of their vegetarian dishes. After eating here all we could discuss is when we were going back!

I'm so glad we circled back and walked the five blocks to get to this shop. It was Halloween and they had some sort of event going on so it was packed. Being such a tiny store it was hard to navigate with all the people. Nonetheless, it had oil based potions, candles for whatever you want (love, money, success), voodoo dolls and a million other cool things. We went to another nearby voodoo shop afterwards, and it didn't compare to this one.

Today was my first time at Ooh La La salon. I am getting married on Saturday and leaving tomorrow for the remainder of the week so I needed to get a mani-pedi last minute. I called ahead to make an appointment. When I arrived the staff was very friendly and welcoming. I've been into other salons where they seem to rush you in and out and barely take the time to smile at you. My nail tech was amazing. I believe her name was Cindy. I told her about my upcoming wedding and she made sure to make my nails looked extra perfect, even applying top coats and painting beautiful designs for my pedi. She was able to keep a conversation going with me for the whole hour and a half I was there which is a plus--I didn't have to sit in awkward silence. The only downfall was that the ceiling started to leak right next to where my chair was--not their fault, things happen! As soon as she noticed she moved me over so myself and my belongings would not be soaked. I could not recommend her and his salon enough. I will definitely be back!

We yelped a good italian restaurant in the area of Tuscon and we came up with Caruso's, which ranked pretty high. We were psyched! We entered and were seated immediately. The restaurant wasn't super busy and we were greeted by our server pretty quickly. We ordered a bottle of wine and received it right away and were poured a pretty healthy glass. He also served us some garlic bread that was a little more than toasted, meaning you bit into it and it disintegrated into dust. Oh well. It's only bread, right? No biggie. Our waiter returned and we placed our order. Garlic and Oil. Two Italian staples, right? Nope, not here. We placed your typical italian restaurant order.I got the eggplant parm and my husband got the veal parm. My husband ordered a side of aglio ed olio- garlic and oil spaghetti. The waiter was a bit confused, so my husband explained, "You know, garlic, oil and butter sauteed, spaghetti thrown in?" The waiter acted like he knew what we were talking about and then retreated to the kitchen. A few moments later, he came scurrying back to our table and told us that there would be a $.75 charge for the garlic and butter. Say what? We were a bit perplexed, but we took it in stride. A few minutes later he arrives back again with our dinner that did not in anyway resemble eggplant or veal parm or garlic and oil spaghetti. The eggplant was cut into spears, like pickles, unbreaded, and was thrown into sauce with cheese broiled over the top. The veal was a bit stranger- more of a scallopini sliced very thin, unbreaded with same cheese and sauce broiled over the top. The spaghetti arrived with a literal pat of butter on the top, sprinkled with garlic salt. Yup, no kidding, garlic salt. It was so salty that it was  unedible. My husband expressed his displeasure to the waiter, who scurried away yet again, never to return... Until it was time for the bill, of course. Hysterically enough, they removed the $.75 charge for the unedible spaghetti, but there was no other explanation or apology made for the really substandard food or the resulting lack of customer service. I don't know what these other folks are eating at Caruso's, but we did not enjoy our meal at all.

Very obviously catering to the local Vandy student body, SatCo welcomes you with blaring 80s music just across the school library.  And they come, filling it to the brim to devour cheap Tex-Mex and drink cheap beer. Its basic food of choice is the soft taco and its various iterations, filled with chicken, pork or beef, as well as cheese, lettuce and tomatoes,  and bell peppers, for an additional $0.25 each, making a single taco around $1.75-$3.50, or around $5-10 for a decent meal of two tacos and a drink. Many people I know (my roommate) save money by simply purchasing the taco and then loading up on sauces and/or purchasing the limitless chips and salsa or nachos.  Since he survived a full semester on it, I assume it is not a fatal diet. 

The taco isn't bad, its just not particularly special in any way, and if you really get down and calculate, its not that cheap either. The ambiance reminds me of "nice frat house", crowds of noisy people, a certain suspicious cleanliness like that of a school cafeteria, and an ordering system consisting of filling out a form and turning it in. 

Maybe I need to drink more beer.
Delicious!! Best Indian food out there and worth the drive over to South Philly. Somosas are tasty!

Brie is an amazing stylist and a complete doll! I have very short hair and am very particular when it comes to who cuts it. Brie is extremely talented and very detail oriented. For me talent is as important as the ease of conversation throughout the appointment. Brie and I chatted it up and in the end I had a haircut that was perfect!

Went to Luke's for happy hour oysters and half prices wine. Had 1/2 dozen oysters with  a glass of sauvignon branc.  Not bad very fresh accompanied with horseradish and cocktail sauce. My first time trying oysters on the half shell.  Good experience. Then ordered stuffed oysters which was very good. All this for 26.00.

Amazing and delicious! Such friendly staff. Got a mango and a strawberry margarita. They even have the option for getting the flavored margaritas on the rocks which is hard to come by! Homemade, not puréed, salsa was so tasty! Glad I got to experience it  everything ordered was great! And the servers aren't hard on the eyes lol

Dedicating these five stars to Elisa.  She donated a hair cut to a breast cancer fund raiser which I bid on and won.  While I was there I got a whole head of highlights for 150 bucks.  She explained everything that she was doing to me and the nature of hair color...she was very professional and informative.  She was friendly but didn't talk the whole time, so I got to read a couple magazines from their wide selection.  I loved the cut...totally fixed me up from a dull and boring cut I got from Sevan salon in Conshohocken.  I will definitely go back to her and confidently recommend her to someone looking for a new stylist.
