My husband recently sold a car to car max. It belonged to his father, recently deceased. We didn't need to trade it in, and weren't too excited about trying to sell it ourselves. He took it in to them one evening. They looked it over, gave him an offer that was comparable to Kelly Blue book. The next day we took in the title and the written offer. The whole experience took 20 minutes! Hassle free!

Without a shadow of a doubt, one of the best places around Tampa for a drink or food! The atmosphere is great, the place is just beautifully made and huge and the staff super friendly and polite. There's seating outdoors and indoors both options being exceptional. From the music to the drinks and the food I was impressed and ultimately convinced that that's definitely my favorite place in Tampa. Give it a try and you won't miss. Hopefully they will franchise to different locations soon.

While researching some local breweries before our anniversary trip to NOLA, we came across this awesome new brewery in the heart of the warehouse district. We were happy just with being away from the brutal Chicago cold, but we're even more excited when we tried the Holy Roller IPA. Wow! We visit a ton of breweries all over the country, but we were incredibly impressed with this one! Delicious hoppy pine flavor without the bitter after taste. The brewery is less than a year old but definitely has a bright future ahead! Well done!

Before taking a tour of the city we stopped in at Basin St. Station to use the bathrooms as well as grab pamphlets on the city. 

The building itself has an incredible history and the staff here was very polite. We enjoyed learning about the trolley lines in the city, the history of the French Quarter, as well as some of the best attractions in the town. 

In the end, this is a great place to stop at and there are some great parking lots in the area that are cheap and provide easy access into town.
Sirloin, pulled pork & shrimp was average at best and mashed potatoes had dirt in it.

I have been here a few times and have enjoyed it, however, brunch today was a bad experience. As someone who tries to eat somewhat healthy there aren't even any healthy-ish items on the brunch menu, not even a salad, not even a side of fruit. I asked for egg white substitution- negative. I ordered the frittata and it came out looking like a big blob of scrambled eggs/cheese and grease. I couldn't tell which was the "frittata" or which was the side of potato concoction at first. I've liked other things on the regular menus- but brunch was a big miss.

Driving from San Francisco to Southern California on vacation, the last thing you want is to lose power to the engine while heading down the freeway, accompanied by an ominous clunk clunk clunk sound coming from under the hood. Luckily, I broke down right outside of Goleta, CA. AAA recommended Top Shop Automotive, and I think my car must have known where it would get the attention it deserved. Willie diagnosed the car overnight and explained what had happened in a way that I could understand. He has made himself available to both me and my mechanic, and stands by the work with a one-year warranty that I don't have to travel the length of the state to use if need be. My car is running better than it has in years. Now I don't have to think about buying a new car for at least 6-8 more years!

Thank you, Willie, for being there when I broke down, and for taking such good care of me and my car. I almost wish I lived closer so that I could have Top Shop as my go-to auto repair shop.

I recently took the MSF Basic Rider Course with Rider Education of New Jersey and received my motorcycle M endorsement.  I did not just want to go out and buy a motorcycle having very little experience and not knowing what I liked in a bike.  I did a search on Google and found this company which is now known as Redline Rentals, LLC.  They are actually the only company in the area that rents sportbikes.

The entire process is simple, the prices are good, and the staff are very friendly.  Kevin makes the rental process simple, you fill out a form, go over the features and condition of the bike and are ready to ride in minutes.  They are located in an area of central NJ right off exit 7 on the turnpike which is in my opinion the perfect place to ride, especially for a beginner as you are not dealing with lots of traffic, traffic lights, etc.  The first time I rented, I used their guide service and Pierce was great.  He understood my skill level and took me on some very nice back roads where I could build my skills and confidence.

So far, I have rented from Redline a total of five times.  Their Ninja 250 is a perfect starter bike, and I rented that three times.  More recently, now that I have more experience, I moved up to their Yamaha FZ6.  Their bikes are in great condition mechanically, I did not have a single issue in the 800+ miles I rode.  They also offer plenty of options for more experienced riders, all the way up to supersports like CBR600RR, ZX6R, GSXR-1000, Ducati 1198, Aprilia RSV4, and others.  I will probably buy a bike of my own in the spring, but I am really glad that I rented as I got to experience different bikes and learn what I personally want in a bike.

I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this great family run business to anyone, whether you are just starting out, are vacationing in the NJ area, or just want to try a different bike for a day or before you buy it.

Yesterday was my birtday and my daughter took me out for a nice steak dinner and the steak was great super great and they gave me a great birthday song. The entire restaurant wish me a happy birthday. Great steak great place.iwill return.
Awesome food, nice environment outside. Just a great experience. We will definitely be back!
Another burger joint in town.  Burger and fries eaten were OK.  I will return to try the signature milk shakes
best ball park in the east coast better than Balt   NY  boston

This was The "second chance" for Anthony's  and I will never return.  Both times the pizza was very dry and over cooked. The salad was incomplete at best! Pricey and DEFINITELY not worth it! Sad because I live so close!

Was it here that Abraham Lincoln asked, upon ordering coffee, "If this is coffee, bring me tea. If this is tea, bring me coffee." ?

Maybe the food is good, but don't buy the coffee unless you like over-priced hot brown water.

I've only been to the ER here.  It, too, was recommended to me by Banfield at Petsmart.
They were AMAZING! My cat had to stay in the hospital for 4 days and they treated him like a king! Whenever my vet called, she would talk to me like he was an actual person and not an animal.  It may sound cheesy, but when your cat almost dies, its nice to know the people looking after him actually care (not just about the pets, but about the owners).  She even encouraged us to come and visit him, which was sad (he had lots of tubes coming out of him) but definitely improved his morale.  They even followed up several times after he had left the hospital.  They were very thorough and friendly and taught me what to look for next time so I can catch his infection before it gets to that point again. (And their advice worked! I caught the next one

Yes, it was VERY expensive!  But there is no substitute for great care.
I wouldn't recommend you take your pets here for routine checkups and basic care, but if its an emergency, don't go anywhere else!

The Flying Cupcake is a deliciously delightful bakery boutique. My personal favorite: the Red Velvet Elvis. This scrumptious red velvet cupcake has ooey-gooey chocolate chips inside and is topped with cream cheese icing and white chocolate. I'm also partial to the Lemon Berry Zinger: lemon cake with whole (fresh, not freeze-dried) blueberries inside topped with Italian cream and drizzled with lemon glaze. A perfect Summer treat.

From their adorable store front to their yummy desserts, The Flying Cupcake is a definite A+.
You cannot go wrong at The Fat Ham.  I recommend sitting at the bar, the staff is incredible and the food is delicious. A must eat Philly restaurant. Just go...right now. :-)
With an abundance of Vietnamese restaurants in the area, this failed to live up to the hype. Completely serviceable and outstandingly average.

I love Sketchers shoes but I don't love Sketchers prices.

Sketchers shoes are so comfortable and they are really cute.  I really do love their shoes.  But they are expensive.  I guess Sketchers decided that they could put a price on comfort.  

The store is nice and it's set up well to show off their products.  The staff is fairly typical in my opinion.  They aren't very enthusiastic about their jobs but they will get you shoes when you ask for them.  That's about it.

I've found Sketchers on sale at other stores (such as The Shoe Company) and, in that case, I'll buy them.  I don't buy them from the Sketchers store though.

Best authentic southern BBQ comfort food!!!  It's the real deal ever time!!!  Owner is super friendly, happy, and always welcoming to his customers who delivers a high quality product every time. and his food is absolutely delicious and unbelievably reasonably priced!!  By far the best gem I've even been to.

Metro car wash is The only automated or drive-thru car wash ill use. I've been here many of times with a wide array of vehicles and never had any issues. 

Personally I park and wipe down my vehicle immediately after exiting the dryer portion of the wash. The dryer actually does a really good job but I don't like having any water spots on my vehicles after I wash them. 

After my OCD is satisfied, I use the free vacuum and if time permits and there is no one else waiting for my spot, I'll do a quick detail of the inside. Other times my detail time is cut short by some derelict next to me that thinks the whole block needs to hear their music. Other than that this place is pretty awesome. 

If times were better I'd probably have Mr. Magic wash my vehicles every time but hey, it is what it is.

Very tasty, balanced meals. We ordered the classic and Mary BEAR and enjoyed it immensely. Small space and communal seating...we enjoyed it as it gave us the feel of eating in someone's kitchen! The decor is absolutely adorable and aesthetically pleasing.

My 3rd time there, reviews are accurate, nice hotel, grand entrance, good location. the only bad experience and it was bad -  was the doorman. The 2 big fellows were ok and but it appeared like we were bothering them when we asked a question. The nighttime doorman was the worst. the front desk told us there would be a taxi at 6:00 am for our airport trip. when there wasnt we asked the doorman to hail us one and he began to yell at my wife. When i said we could handle it he said "it was the thrill of my life to serve you" - really? i stopped dead in my tracks (loading our suitcases) and said you need to find a new job. If you want 4 or 5 stars then you need to act like it in all facets. What a shame.....I have never been treated like that.

Perfect score from me!  Been a regular for 3 years.  Absolutely love my nail treatment.  Always get my pink and white nails done by Niki!  Amazing! but love pedicures by Karen!  Love the complimentary wine but Gigi's is next door if you prefer a better wine or another drink.  Accommodating to pedicure parties!

Awesome service and excellent ice cream. Really nice ambiance too.  Best ice cream in Royersford, apparently based in Royersford.  Almost felt like I was on vacation, just around the bend from my home.

One of my favorite places to visit downtown. Great beer selection and amazing pizza. BBQ and the Mexican are my favorite. Service staff is the best. Super friendly and welcoming to all. Plus, great place to watch World Cup games.

Ludwig's never disappoints! My husband hosted his work staff at our home last night and I ordered trays. The presentation of the cheese tray was beautiful, and the hot food was elegant and delicious. Made a wonderful impression, and I highly recommend!

Well at least Jones is pretty consistent. But then again, you'd expect that out of a Steven Starr establishment.

Came back, brought my parents, and enjoyed another evening of comfort foods.

This time I was smart and ordered their Mac & Cheese to share with everyone. Honestly, I wasn't too impressed. It tasted just like Velveeta to me, same sharp cheese and thick consistency. I don't really mind Velveeta, I just was expecting something more...

My grilled cheese and tomato soup were very satisfying and my step-father practically licked his thanksgiving dinner plate clean. So all in all it was a successful trip. I just don't see the hype in their Mac & Cheese, o well...

Food- 5/5 we had the sweet tea chicken over biscuits and gravy, it was gluttonly awesome.  The bacon lived up to the hype and the latkes were perfect. The pie crust pancakes were just ok for us.  I had a couple of the Radler beers which I haven't had since I lived in Germany, that was a very nice suprise.  My wife had a champagne vodka mix which she did not really care for but that is just a taste preference. 
Decor- 3/5 I don't think they particularly are going for any look, just a long lasting brunch place that will still be relevant in 10 years. 
Service- 5/5 our server had suggestions and opinions and really knew the menu.  We had to wait 40 mins with a baby and a 4 year old which was a pain in the ass but that is to be expected with a new hot spot.

It's a must visit Indy spot that has lasting power.

We ended up here purely by chance... coming back home from a shopping trip and navigating through the construction at the Marlton Circle, we saw the sign and decided to stop by and check it out..
Although I expected your run of the mill liquor store but instead I got to enter heaven...
First of all, the store is huge, bright, clean and very nicely arranged... I might not be a fan of their decor, but it still much better than 99% of other liquor stores....
Secondly, it's not a wine store, as the name suggests nor it is really a liquor store either - you have a bit of everything you need - wine, beer, hard liquor (just as you would anywhere else) but on top of that you get a high-end cheese shop, wine tasting section, cigar shop and even movies!! I mean, what else can you possible need when buying alcohol??
The cheese shop selection is small, but very strong and the prices are competitive...
While I am not a wine aficionado, I can appreciate the size of their collection and my wife, who does know her wine, was certainly impressed...
What's more, they have a wine tasting machine - you buy a membership for $5 that gives you 2000 points on a card, you slide the card into the machine and it give you an ounce to taste (and you can do a lot of tasting for your money - though they do limit you to four per 24 hours!!)...
Beer, well, what can I say - one of if not the best selection in South Jersey with ability to pick your own six-pack and people who know their beer and can help you out...
Also, they deliver and if you live nearby, it's free..
All in all, this is now officially the best liquor store in the area....

Hands down best hot dogs you can find in SB. The Western Dog was so delicious and SPICY! I started off with three Dogs. Even though I was full, I had to eat another. 

Another cool thing is that they have a Bluetooth speaker you can connect to with your phone and you can play whatever music you want while you eat.  

Good experience for being my first time. Will definitely go again. I'm recommending all my friends and family to try these dogs out! 

Thanks for the good eats!
Great selection and great prices...by the way, the Aldi beer is really good! Staff is super friendly! Bring your own bags!!!!

Sadly ill be changing my review of this place to 2.5 stars....

Crab cake sandwich people.

Jones is definitely average quality, not many complaints, but nothing to really rave over either. We went as a group of five with a reservation so we didn't have to wait long for a table. They have a limited menu during certain times, so be careful of that. It was very busy and loud, but this wasn't an issue for us. We would go back if there weren't any other options, but considering the area, there are many other better options.
yeah i wasn't that impressed the last time    i went ,   i been to this one  4  times and the  last  2  have not been  the best . i will be choosing  a  different korean place

I LOVE SANTA BARBARA!.   Is my favorite city in CA  and I drive to a lot of cities in CA for my business. Since CA is a wine country, I have decided to bring a local bottle of wine for every place I visit and love.  Santa Barbara Wharf has the most beautiful, old looking,authentic wharf. So that  Thursday afternoon, after visiting the last spot of the day and before driving to the hotel I decided to stop at the fisherman wharf for the sunset  and  finally visit the winery Deep Ocean, The riesling I bought was delicious, the servers were very friendly and eager to serve people. The views on top of the wharf by the balcony where spectacular, it was sunset time of a beautiful summer day. It was paradise. And the best of everything that balcony is pet friendly, so you can bring your best friend with you to see the sunset at the wharf while you chill out, relax and sip wine. Perfect and paradise in earth for a ocean lover girl like me. Of all the wineries in the "city"  wine trail in Santa Barbara also known as "funk zone", this is my favorite spot. And I really mean it,because I have visited all of them for business reasons in the last 2 days. But finishing my day visiting this winery and watching the sunset, will forever stick in my mind and life is about moments and memories. I left the place promising myself to come back the next time, to Santa Barbara, not for business, but for pleasure in the company of my dear husband.  This place is in my must visit list. They have also a gift shop inside selling jams and Tshirts ,my only comment is they should get more cute merchandise for the shop because looks almost empty and women love to wine and shop.

This place has the most amazing tacos in Chester County. I have had their Shrimp, Chorizo, Tounge, carnitas and carne asada tacos and loved every one! It's a tough place to find but well worth it when you locate it. The prices are very reasonable as well.

My husband and I tried Brixx for the first time on Saturday evening to use a buy one get one free coupon. We got there around 7:15 and only had to wait about 10 minutes for a table. The service was average, but the food was great! This place also has a wonderful beer list, especially for Fishers! 

We started with the stix, you get 6 so it's a lot of food. We ordered 2 pizzas - the buffalo chicken and the Bronx. The Bronx was alright but the buffalo chicken was delicious! Because it is wood fired pizza, the very outer edge of the crust is almost burned, my husband didn't like this but I feel like that's the case at almost any wood fired pizza place. 

It's not a romantic place but is a good place for a casual date night. We will definitely be back.
My go to place to eat whenever I don't feel like cooking dinner which is about 3 times a week. I'm a huge fan of the pho chicken and any of their vermicelli bowls.

This restaurant looks a bit older on the outside and the building is quite deceiving! I would have never guessed without Google and Yelp that this was a Vietnamese restaurant! I came here for lunch wanting soup for my cold. I ordered the chicken curry and it was delicious! They were generous on the chicken, vermicelli was abundant and two large slices of potato in a very tasty broth that wasn't too spicy!! I thoroughly enjoyed this soup very much!
Will return again.
Awful! Have been there for breakfast a few times, was always good, however, tried it for lunch. Frankly, I've had better hospital food. Dry, tasteless, overpriced. Crappy service.

I never write reviews (check my history on here..) .. but I am THAT impressed with Dr. Gibbs and his staff that I had to go ahead and write one. I've had horrible experiences like most with dentists.. ones that are just condescending.. not friendly... not gentle.. trying to sell things.. etc etc etc! Dr. Gibbs and his staff were very welcoming and 'real'. Not like the pushy dentists I'm used to! They made me feel relaxed and talked me through every concern I had (about my own teeth). I'm actually not afraid of going back hahah !  Looking forward to it! Thank you for making this experience a PLEASANT one! Go figure.. A pleasant dental trip! ;) Highly Recommended!

I was very disappointed with the dry cleaning services. I took my winter coat in to be cleaned after coffee was spilled on it. It has a belt on it with a metal clasp. Not only did the coat still smell like coffee when they returned it to me, but they also broke the metal clasp on the belt in the dry cleaning machine. When I asked what happened and for some resolution, the owner told me that I should have known that metal items can get damaged in the dry cleaning machine. Isn't that why we went to a so-called expert, so he could tell us what should and should not go into the machine? Regardless, the clasp was not fixable so after about 30 minutes of arguing (during which time his wife would not stop staring at me and giving me the evil eye), he finally agreed that he would shop around for another clasp to fix it, and I should give him a week. I came back a week later, and he informed me that he didn't find another clasp but that he instead "fixed" the one he had broken. This mostly consisted of him painting the chipped metal. The clasp no longer works like it used to, and they didn't even offer to refund the price of the cleaning (I had to ask to get the money back). I won't be returning.

I needed to get a very annoying car alarm off of my truck, something I had been meaning to do for a few months.  Had a couple of people (not professionals) look at it and they were amazed at what a mess the wires were and didn't want to touch it in fear that they might screw something up.  I called Infinity and they had me in in the same day and had the alarm removed within a couple of hours.  Very good customer service also, they made sure to explain everything they did.  Very reasonably priced as well.  My only regret is not getting with Infinity earlier to have this done.

Wow. Unique & rly cool vibes!!! Our waitress was super helpful and the menu was SO creative!!! I've never seen a menu like it. Sis & I wanted to try EVERYTHING! So we split 5 plates. But everything that kept coming out we just stared at and our mouths were watering the whole time. 
Such a fun spot. Probs one of my top recs in Indy
Great waxing service, fast, painless and awesome salon. The waxing esthetician really knows what she's doing, it was 50% for my first time. Super happy!!
Good quality breakfast and reasonable prices.  Do to location the parking can be tough and during weekend the lines can be long.

I came in to Savers for the first time the weeks before Halloween.  My costume needed to be a'la carte, and since I would only wear it for Halloween, I didn't want to spend a ton of money on it.  My friend knew about Savers and he and I came here for the first time in search of an extremely frilly skirt-suit.

We asked one of the employees who not only directed to the section that would have it, walked us over there and started going through clothes and pulling them off the rack along side us.

While we didn't find the costume pieces over the 5-10 times we went in, we found some amazing shoes, my friend's Halloween costume, and black slacks for his new job.  Everything was inexpensive, and the service was always beyond helpful and friendly!

I'm giving this hotel 5 stars for one reason only. The service with the front line hotel employees. Blair. The luggage handler was super nice and took time to show us where a great oyster bar was located. Kevin our room service guy was friendly and helpful. Neil the bartender at The Carousel Bar was wonderful. He even took the time to write down recipes for us. As for the hotel itself a lot went wrong. No early check in. I had to fight for a later check out. The air didn't work. The coffee pot was broken.I asked for a nice view and got a brick wall out the parlor window. The location was perfect. It was my birthday celebration and a place I stayed 41 years ago with my dear Grandmother. Would I return here? Only because of the way the above staff treated us.
Went here for dinner with my son, very tasty and fresh food. Not spicy you can add to your spice levels by choosing your meat choices. Will definitely be back.

I really enjoyed my tour Swamp Tour with Cajun Encounters, in fact this was the highlight of my trip! I called the day before to confirm my reservation just because I was worried about the shuttle remembering to get me. I had a pickup window of 8-8:30am at a hotel in the French Quarter for a 9:30 tour. Miss Josephine, the shuttle driver picked me up around 8:20. Then we made a few more stops to fill the bus and were on our way. Miss Josephine was very informative on the 45 minute drive, pointing things out as we drove along and talking a bit about her personal experience with Hurricane Katrina. We arrived with just enough time to get our wristbands inside the shop and take a quick bathroom break. Captain Bishop lead us to the boat and we were off! Thanks to the tip from another yelper I waited to board the boat last so I could sit up front (GREAT IDEA!). Though everyone gets a good view at one point or another, Captain Bishop was good about moving the boat from side to side for everyone to see. We saw about 10 gators, some raccoons, turtles, herron, and wild hogs too. The houses were interesting to look at and the swamp vegetation was really cool. Captain Bishop was both informative and funny. Great experience and highly recommended!
Portions sizes are pretty small considering the price and somewhat mediocre quality of the food. Not horrible, but not the best either.
Hipster smoothie.. Ahhh it is a must try if you're in West Chester. Nutella, banana and graham crackers. Delicious. Slightly over priced my opinion. $6 for a smoothie?

This place came to town with a huge reputation out west and a huge ego, and I think the people of Indianapolis should slap the shit out of them for their cockiness and tell them to make a better freaking burger. 

When you walk in the walls are adorned with a thousand magazine articles heralding the place. You would think it was La Bernadine or something. (La Bernadine is a 4 star restaurant in New York owned and operated by Eric Ripert). (Eric Ripert is one of the best chef's in the world). Anyway, the place think's is the shit, but in stead of being, the shit, it's just shit. I had the cajun fries with my underwhelming burger, and they were gross too. 

The burger was so unappealing. It had minimal flavor, and I'm guessing they aren't using the best beef in the world. The topping options are sparse and the dining options are more sparse still, "Would you like a burger...or a....burger?" 

I was looking forward to the experience because of the swagger, but left with more of a stagger.

8/13/2016 visit was a great find for our first time in St Louis. Our server was Julia and she did a fantastic job!! Between Julia's outstanding service, the tasty smoked salmon and choices of beers.......we will be back!!!!

Don't know if this place could pass an Osha inspection at that moment. Food was not the best. One of the lamb kafta tasted old and kind of sour. Seemed like it was sitting in the fridge a little bit too long. It was a one man crew, weird but whatever. Wouldn't recommend...

One of the servers was really really cute. So they get a four star review just for that. He even was nice enough to stop and take a picture for us. The decor is cute and I loved the salt/pepper shakers. The food was scrumptious and reasonably priced. I'll definitely be back in the spring. I think I'll try the drinks next time.

I went here to get some Boba because I was missing it. As a transplant I didn't know where to go, so I looked up Boba online and found this little gem. I think its going to be my new fav spot, I will deff be coming back, and the location next to the asian market is perfect!!!

We went early for dinner with 3 adults and 4 kids.  They were accommodating to us and all the kids. I ordered the sirloin and grilled shrimp. It was just ok, they both lacked much flavor. I had to add ketchup to the steak in order to eat it. The shrimp pasta was good and the fries shrimp was decent. Very cool atmosphere in the dining area.

not great.

ordered the wonton soup and sesame beef, (apparently, a "house special"). my soup had one measly wonton in it and the beef was waaaaay overcooked, almost unchewable. boyf got the general tsos chicken, which was better (meaning we could actually bite into it, no problem) but, still, nothing special.

service was good, and i really liked the ambiance. 

alas, our hunt for good local chinese continues...
I'm from Wisconsin, I visit my Snow Bird parents every Christmas and we go here for the Pack Game. Good wings, prices and service. I'm all a-boot it.

I know it's shameful, but I went over 10 years without going to the dentist. I didn't have any problems(or dental insurance) so I just didn't feel the need. Well...turns out I had 4 cavities :/ In the past, I dreaded dentist visits. Dr. Nabors has such a gentle touch, not even the needle hurt! And it was affordable enough that I could pay with cash. If I had known that going to the dentist didn't have to be scary I would've gone years ago. Now I'm in every 6 months for a cleaning like a good little girl and everything is great!! Andrea is my hygienist and she is gentle as well. I'm a big baby and she deals with the weird faces I make. She also whitens my teeth and they look sparkly and stay white for months after!! The office staff is always friendly and accommodating. Love this place!!

A very traditional Japanese tasting menu.  This seven course tasting gives you the most amazing experience of a true Japanese meal.  Staring with an appetizer box in which the food represents good fortune, health for the new year to desert of sweet potato or a sesame pudding.  Not only was the taste pleasing to the pallet, but the presentation was beautiful.
Our favorite little place to go on a late night date or watch sports! Love the food and of course the beer and atmosphere!

I thought it was lots of fun--I had initially paid for the $20 ticket but after waiting for about an hour and a half, I chose to upgrade to the VIP ticket for another 20 bucks when a staff member walked by asking.

The actors were great in their parts and the set decorations were really cool. I jumped a few times and my date was scared to death. I'd recommend it as well as the VIP (unless you love 3 hr long lines).

Wear some good outdoor shoes/sneaks since you'll do lots of walking over uneven ground getting from the parking lot down to the main grounds.

The prickly pear glazed meatballs were awesome. The filet was super tender and perfectly seasoned. Get the mac and cheese, you won't regret it. My only suggestion to the restaurant would be to ditch the limp green onion on top of the steak.

While the historic site certainly had it's charm and the waitress/hostess name fit her to a tee = Sunny" sadly the food did not live up to the expectations.  Very little flavor.  At least the beer and wine were good.  Pecan pie way too mushy.

BEWARE. This Firestone location does not stand behind their warranties, forgets to put oil caps back on and allows customers to drive off.  My car was smoking and looked as if it could catch on fire.  No apologizes and still charged me for the oil change.  Bought two new tires from here - had a flat in less than six weeks.  When I called I was told they were too busy to look at the tire.  Take you time and money elsewhere.

Great jazz Sunday Brunch!! The food is excellent and the 3 instrument floating jazz band is awesome. The band is comprised of 3 older gentlemen who are fun, talented & play an assortment of tunes. We had 2 cappuccinos and split a muffuletta and the bread pudding. Both were delicious! The only reason I gave it 4 out of 5 stars is the price. $22 for a muffuletta half the size of the one at Central Grocery but then again, you're paying for the ambience as well. Overall, a great experience!!
An AMAZING beer list, fantastic staff & great Burgers.  I had the firecracker shrimp today. I was expecting fried but it was grilled, very good.

Is it possible out of the eight dishes we ordered, six were awful?? Where to start...? 
"Kobe" sliders?? Tasted like chunky dirt.  Onions and greasy bun were good. My salmon (maybe my fault for ordering salmon in a burger joint) tasted and smelled like five-day old bad fish.  The server graciously replaced it with a rubbery piece of chicken then announced in a hushed tone he wasn't charging me for the salmon.  The bed of lettuce the salmon was resting on was filled with watery, wilted greens, sort of like when you leave a bag of spinach in the refrigerator for two weeks.  My husband's french fries were completely burnt; but the others at the table who had properly cooked french fries found them pretty good. 
Next, The Mediterranean flatbread, which had artichokes that somehow tasted like fish, was soggy and mostly consisted of bread and raw onions.
Lastly, and best of all, while we were there celebrating a birthday. I quietly asked the waiter if he could bring out a cheesecake with a candle and we would all sing.  Sitting with a table full of dishes and spilled food, we see a food runner arrive with a piece of cheesecake (no candle): "Who gets the cheesecake?"  Not quite the birthday surprise we were going for. 
My generous two-star rating is from our table's beer drinkers who liked the variety of beers.  Oh, and the friendly waiter.

This place is great! Cheap, delicious and always fresh. They have tons of choices on the menu and now they also deliver! The delivery fee is only $2 or $3 which is not bad at all. Ordered delivery and got it within less than an hour. Everyone is very friendly there too.

Great kale long life salad, Greek salad, hummus and chicken salad! Fresh. Fast. Come early and beat the crowd. Be prepared to be undecided about what to order!  Local fave and a must see and do. Serious foodies please consider!

5 of us gals had dinner here last night right before the Boz Scaggs concert at the Capital. The location is fab as it's right across the street & there is ample city parking within a block area. The front dining/bar area is very cool looking & pubby. Dark wood, classy, etc. We had requested a table in the garden room, which is totally different: very high ceilings with numerous skylights, plus big windows on the north side. There are faux windows with shutters on the brick interior that give the feeling of a garden and there is a lovely fountain on one wall where we were seated. 

We were greeted by Rachquel (sp. is probably wrong) who was delightful & attentive. Unfortunately, they were slammed due to the concert no doubt as this was a Mon. night. They didn't have enough staff & the bar was really behind as it took a good 10-15 mins. to bring our drinks. We ordered our food quickly. I had the duck tacos. They were just ok as the sauce was mediocre. Two friends had the mushroom ramen. The taste was good, but the mushrooms were under-cooked & the ramen was mushy. The menu is quite eclectic & varied, but that's not always good as it takes a lot of effort to deliver a quality product. It's hard to give an accurate picture when a restaurant is so slammed, so I'm giving them 4 stars for now & will update if I return, which will only be when I go to another concert. 

BTW, Rachquel comped our 1st round because we had to wait so long. Now that's the kind of customer service that brings people back!  Give this place a try & write a review.

I first fell in love with Indian food in Frankfurt Germany and have since had Indian food all across the world. I was pleasantly surprised when I went to the norristown location, the food was delicious and the place was packed. My family and I live near Harleysville and so decided to try this location. Every dish we order has been wonderful, service is pleasant, very helpful and friendly. I definitely enjoyed my meals here and say the flavors ranked up there with the best. While Norristown is packed this location isn't quite as busy so we will definitely be back here!

Not really as bad as people say.
I come here a lot because it somewhat satisfies my constant cravings for Japanese food without having to commute all the way to state street or goleta.

While the place does seem a little sketchy, the rolls are pretty solid. The hungry roll is huge (and not to mention deep fried). It's good, unique, and filling and comes with miso soup (so yummy) and salad!
The kiss dragon roll was pretty good as well.

I tried the sashimi dinner plate today and it was a little sketch. Only the salmon and tuna tasted legit while the other fish didn't taste as fresh. I don't think this is the best place to come for raw fish (or ramen for that matter; the ramen is basically ramen noodles placed in a generic udon broth). 

Order the chicken katsu plate or sesame chicken but keep in mind that the portions aren't exactly worth the price you pay in terms of the entrees and sashimi. 

However, if you are looking for a decent Japanese place, come here for the specialty rolls! Their lunch happy hour is a pretty good deal too, so check that out. The only thing is that some of the dishes are way too expensive for the quantity they give. Other than that, I'd come back for the rolls!

Oh my gosh!!! I had the Jumbo Louisiana Shrimp "En Cocotte". It was the best meal I have ever had in my life!!! The ambience was very nice and I was seated very quickly with my reservation. My server was adorable as well as the friendly hostesses. I would surely say that my visit here made my trip to New Orleans that much more memorable!!! Thank you!!!

Nothing but good things to say about this place!  Quick service, large selection of house and specialty rolls (get the fire roll!), the plate decorations are AWESOME, and prices are reasonable.  Would definitely recommend- added bonus that it's BYOB as well!

There were high notes, and some low notes. 

The food was pretty good although the portions were small. Hummus, lamb plate and greek salad were all tasty. 

On to the bad. I went in on a Tuesday night around 815 to get takeout, and they made me feel like I was interrupting clean up time. I wasn't greeted by anyone, even though there were 4 guys behind the line and a girl sweeping the dining room floor. 

Even as I approached the register, the girl put her broom down, went behind the line, and just looked at me. Not a hello, how are you, or what would you like. 

To further this point, two ladies came in after me and were told that the food they wanted would take over 10 minutes to cook. But the tone was what was telling. It was said in a way that was clear they didn't want to be bothered and should go elsewhere for food. 

I can get good Mediterranean food just about anywhere in town. It is the little things that will keep me coming back. Feeling as though I inconvenienced you by eating at your restaurant is a definite way to ensure I wont be back.


UPDATE 1/5: The GM emailed me and asked for my phone # and then called me shortly there after. He was very apologetic and asked me to come back in and give them another try. I will do so because of the way they handled this. Kudos to Jose

Definitely a restaurant for females.  If you're here to find a female.  You're in luck.  If you're here to find a bomb ass sandwich, go elsewhere.

Identical to any Panera/Corner Bakery.  Not bad, but nothing special.

Great burgers, albeit a little overpriced.  It's a hipsters paradise.  So bring your crappy 80's sunglasses, wear your stupid skinny jeans (if you are a dude and yes if you actually DO wear skinny jeans then you just lost a MAN card).  If you like waitresses who probably rarely shave their legs or armpits and have no idea what a bra is then this is your place.   Great beer selection too, this ALSO is a little overpriced, but the quality of selection is solid.  The pimento cheese burger is the bomb and worth the price and the chicken wings have a great flavor but overpriced for what it is...if looking for locally grown beef (I say that like beef grows on a tree, wouldn't that be freakin awesome) but anyhow...if you like local beef options with a hipster flair then come have you a great burger (for only about two hours of minimum wage for 1 burger).

I'm a fan but would rank this as a borderline 3/4 star. There's nothing exciting but it is one of the better sushi restaurants in Carrollwood. I'd say if you want good sushi definitely stop by but it you want a special occasion sushi stop this is probably not the place.

The quality and portion size of meals has decreased considerably in the last year. 
They also no longer accept credit card payment for deliveries.
RYDER'S KICKS ASS.  Service, beer selection, food, ambiance and music is impeccable. For real, this place is a gem.  So glad it is in my neighborhood.

We rented bikes from Fun Ride earlier this week. The rates were very reasonable ($8 per hour) and we found a coupon for a free second hour in one of the maps that they had in the lobby of our hotel. The owners are friendly and they even gave us free drink tickets for crabby's when we were done. 

The part that really showed us how great the owners are happened the next day. The battery in our rental car died and we had no one to jump it. The owner (sandy's husband) went out of his way to help us and got our car started. We tried to give him money and he would not accept it. He even offered us another drink ticket. It saved our day and made me remember there are still good people out there!!

The menu is authentically Italian, which I loved and left wanting to try many more dishes. Family owned and run, with friendly and prompt staff. Just wish that they sold alcohol for those of us who forget to stop by the liquor store. My boyfriend was also not happy as he is 6'7" and they put us at a tiny table in the middle of an aisle, so he felt cramped and in the way the whole time. Our linens and glassware were also dirty so that was a little worrisome but if I lived around here I would be back to try many more dishes on the menu!

Lama Dog Rocks! We visited on a Friday around lunch. It's not a huge place but has a good sized bar area along with a long and high community table as the main seating options. There is also a really nice outdoor patio that's away from the road. Lama keeps an eclectic mix of about 20 beers on tap at any given time spanning the gamut from light sours thru big chewy stouts. These days 20 beers is a solid number but not amazing. What is amazing about the 20 beers they had on when we visited was the quality level of the producers represented. A few great local brewers you don't see a lot around town, Draughtsmen and The Brewhouse as well as some fairly rare sightings from outside the area like Bottle Logic , El Segundo and 21st Amendment. Sour beer lovers take note, spots 11-13 on the board are reserved for sour beers.. Overall this is a great place. Staff are great, vibe is really good, it can get packed but on a not too crowded day it's a place you just never want to leave. Oh, did I mention that the Nook food bar is located right inside next to Lama Dog? And, on top of all that they have an excellent selection of bottle beers to buy and take home.

Tremendous!  The date night lamb burger was tender and cooked to perfection. The whiskey & rye was great!  Super ice cream also. White chocolate raspberry!  Bailey's. Be careful of the overhang on the second floor window seating.

Looking at this place you expect something amazing, but this absolutely gorgeous building and furnishings are wasted on a mediocre restaurant. Iceberg lettuce slathered with dressing is their definition of a salad, and the dinner options are pretty boring and limited. The food was decent, but for the most part highly disappointing. We were well dressed, and overly so, as most patrons were in shorts and t-shirts.

I'm a sucker for egg nog, so I jumped at the egg nog cupcake. Somehow, between the sweet frosting and alluringly less-sweet cake, the cupcake got better as I made my way through it. When does that ever happen? Only four stars because the cake was a tad dry, and the bacon chocolate chip cookie wasn't anything special. Cute space, too.

April from Indy Massage Co. is AMAZING! Her facility is exactly what I want when I go to get a massage. It's very clean, dark, soothing sounds, and a great relaxed atmosphere to unwind before a great massage. Since my first massage at IMC I haven't gone anywhere else. Strongly recommend April if you can get scheduled, but everyone is great!
Love this location! Good bang for your buck, and the staff is really friendly! Love coming here with my husband for breakfast on the weekends!

I had such a great experience at Mass Ave Tattoo. Patrick was my artist and he was very kind and patient through the entire process. This was my first tattoo and I was getting in honor of my Dad who recently passed away. I brought in a letter my Dad had wrote to me and wanted his handwriting tattooed on my forearm. It took a few sketches but Patrick came up with resemblance of my Dad's handwriting. I absolutely love my tattoo. Patrick is the man. The shop is super clean as well. If I get another tattoo, I'll definitely be back.

I made a last minute decision to have dinner here last night with my husband.  We started with an avocado and shrimp appetizer which was fresh and well portioned.  We had friendly service and both enjoyed our meals.  I'm glad me made a random turn into a secret gem of a restaurant.  I look forward to going again.

Stopped by Olio around 5 o'clock on a Thurs before a class at the Botanical Garden. Sat out on the patio. It was a gorgeous day and the patio was wonderful - very relaxing. Service was excellent. I had the ceviche and my wife had the lahmacun. Both were excellent. My wife said it was the best ceviche she's ever had. 

I'm torn between 4 and 5 stars. The reason I didn't give it 5 stars - we paid $36 for 2 small plates and we were starving 3 hours later.

Based on the reviews and price point I had high expectations. Hotel Monteleone did not deliver. 

My husband and I arrived around 2 pm and our room wasn't ready. We left our baggage and the staff actually asked us for a tip- which I thought was rather bold and distasteful. We didn't get a call until after 4 pm that our room was ready, which was a little less than ideal after a long day of travel.

When we finally got to our room we asked for our bags to be sent up and didn't get them until my husband went to the front desk to ask about them. They had tried bringing them to the wrong room and then argued with my husband- saying that they were not in fact our bags.

The room was okay- but not wildly impressive. We had a great view, dated decor, non-working phones. The bathroom was absolutely incredible and was a highlight for us.

It was a hassle to get wifi and bottled water. The employees were not particularly friendly or helpful.

The bar was pretty cheesy and extremely crowded. We skipped it and just went into town. This is in a fabulous location and extremely walkable.

We ordered late night room service- which we weren't expecting to be great. However, this was beyond bad. From the very limited menu, we got a pizza that was simultaneously extremely burnt and cold.

The absolute kicker was spotting a cockroach in the hallway! I definitely didn't sleep soundly and felt wildly disappointed with our stay.

My wife had a 5:45 a.m. flight a couple of weeks ago so we decided to stay in Reno and save an hour's drive that morning.  We had dinner plans so we were looking for a place to grab an after dinner drink then crash.  I called them and asked a very simple question: Is there a non-smoking bar?  The receptionist put me on hold for a moment and then said, "Yes...the Terrace lounge is non-smoking."

I then skimmed some reviews here on Yelp and saw mention of cigar smoke there.  In the meantime, I had located a text number.

"I wanted to verify that you do have a non-smoking bar.  I was told it was the Terrace but online reviews mention cigars."

Simple question, right?

"Thank you for contacting service excellence, our Terrance (sic) Lounge Bar is non-smoking.  Christopher Service Excellence Agent"

So, we book, have dinner offsite, check in and head down to the bar.  Ashtrays on every table.  Back to the room.  I'd been texting about an unrelated issue so I commented:

"FYI, last night before we booked Christopher told us the Terrace was non smoking.  That was part of our booking choice and it was quite wrong."

"I sincerely apologize for the mistake.  We do allow cigarette smoking in the Terrace Lounge but we do not allow cigar smoking there. I apologize for the misinformation.  Jared ____ | Service Excellence Agent"

I filled out their online comment form and have yet to get a reply after over two weeks.  Calling yourself "Service Excellence" does not make it so.

Finally got a chance to sample the food here at HCV while the kiddies were home for the holiday. I ordered the Corn Chowder. It was good and filling I would have spiced it up a bit  with some pepper and (gasp!) salt. With enough left over for today's lunch I thinned it out a bit added more seasoning and made a great soup.Loved the décor simple, functional easy to keep clean. Succulents on the wall a plus. I will come back to this place again before school is back in session..

traveled from New York City & was not disappointed. the service, the food and the vibe was amazing! The owners name is Jose and he treated us like we were his favorite customers although it was our first time. they have an outdoor seating area that made it a great place to enjoy the weather. can't wait to go back! :)

I have been here a number of times and every time I'm super happy I came. The food is always incredible and the service and ambiance is wonderful. Trust me, if you're in Center City and looking for a great meal that will surprise you.. go here!
On the way home after leaving The Chinese duck house my boyfriend and his mother started feeling very sick and started throwing up. I would avoid this place at all costs.

I absolutely love going to New Day! They always are trying new things with infusions and the like. The choice and quantity of cocktails using their ciders are fantastic. My favorite one is the South Cider and the Breakfast Magpie. This place also has specials almost every day and the best one is on Tuesday's they have half price fills! Come support this local business! Love it!
Best oysters in NOLA! Happy hour prices are amazing and the service is friendly. Sit at the bar, order a drink and a dozen and relax!

Happy hour here is awesome!  You can order a cocktail for $5 bucks and they will provide you with a mini app. 

The food was fresh and delicious.   We multiple servings of nachos, calamari, chips, salsa and guacamole.  

With the three of us, we had two cocktails each and 6 app. All for about $35.  Now if that's not a deal I don't know what is.

We will be back fo sho!

Finally a restaurant that serves full portion, quality food! I don't know what's with the tapas trend in Reno, but I absolutely hate it. If I like the taste of the food I got, I want a lot of it, not a tiny bite and only with a full plate, I will share it with my friend. Thank you for not doing that small plate thing. The food was amazing!

I came here today after purchasing a groupon for a gel manicure & a pedicure. I'm glad I got it because I didn't know about this salon. I had a great experience and plan on going back. I would recommend to anyone. Great prices and my nails look beautiful.  Thanks!

Very good Korean food! I was actually surprised. The decor is not so attractive, but the food absolutely makes up for it. I had #31 (can't remember the name) and it was better than the first time I had it in NJ! It was a little pricey, but I wouldn't hold it against them. It's large portions and delicious!
OK, I'm off the hater wagon.  Izzo's does its job.  Good food, fast, and cheap.   I'll take a burrito any day.

What a fantastic place, guitars are displayed well, cool vibe, and even cooler staff.  They are very welcoming and helpful, not typical with a lot of Nashville music stores.  They are a cut above in their selection, while they don't have as many instruments as some other close by stores, their inventory is much more consistent of high end vintage equipment.  You'll be "wowed" by what they do have, and impressed by the helpful, friendly staff.  I visited quite a few stores in the area, Rumble Seat was definitely my favorite!

This is my favorite burger joint hands down !! It wa terrific! Every burger they have is amazing and their homemade sauces top everything off. I ended my trip with a salted caramel malt which was perfect and the the customer service is also outstanding . We had a slight mix up in the kitchen and the server and manager were more than happy to give me a replacement sandwich free of charge . If you go ask for Sam as your server she's is outstanding !

The name "Twisted Tail" attracted me in the first place. I came here with a friend on a Saturday evening. The restaurant was super busy and seemed a bit under staffed. The Twisted Tail had casual vibe, not too loud or anything so you can actually have a conversation with someone. Our server took a while to get our order in (like I said it was under staffed on a busy Saturday). We ordered a few drinks, which seemed to be watered down and pricey for the amount given. They are also limited on domestic beers. I ordered the Pennsylvania trout. I didn't expect it to be a whole fish (head and tail included) when it came out. It seemed to be a bit over cooked. It also came with cauliflower seasoned in a vinaigrette, which was okay. Overall, I don't think its a bad place. I'll have to give it another try on a less busy day.

Thanks to my experience here I'll look for Drury Inns wherever I travel now- but of course one of the ways they keep prices down is by having their locations outside of the major metrapoles in many states (or the obvious ones anyway).

I knew I was going to like this place when, upon check-in, they told me that they'd noticed my preference for a room away from the elevator, and since they had it free they upgraded me to a suite with a jumbo jacuzzi. Wow! 

The next clincher was the delicious breakfast- standard hotel breakfast in some ways, but free! The biscuits were amazing. Biscuits plus good scrambled eggs plus salsa and Tabasco sauce plus orange juice = yum! When I got tired of that I tried the fresh french toast, muffins, or yogurt. Jim relished the Belgian waffles. 

Another perk was coffee available in the lobby at all hours, or free soda of many kinds.

And then there was the 5:30pm free munchies and cocktails!
And did I mention the free no-catch wireless? And the free parking in New Orleans? 

This was a quick walk to Canal St for my conferences, or right next to the trolley stop. 
Although I had trouble sleeping, the bed was no more or less comfortable than any other decent hotel's.
Really, I couldn't beat the price for the quality in New Orleans, and was much, much less happy the time I stayed at the Marriott on Canal whose only selling point was a Starbucks in the lobby.

I have recently become a vegetarian and as such have been desperately looking for places to eat that have good vegetarian options. My daughter suggested that we try Queen of Sheba Ethiopian restaurant because she and heard that they have many vegetarian items on their menu. Upon arriving at the restaurant I noticed the decor was very warm and inviting with lots of Ethiopian posters, artifacts, drums and aromas. Upon arrival I was immediately greeted and seated by a very nice gentleman The table was appointed with cloth napkins and tablecloth; very elegant for a midday meal. I asked the nice gentleman to recommend the best vegetarian option for someone new to Ethiopian cuisine. He showed me that there were several vegetarian entrees on the menu, but he recommended that I try one of the vegetarian combination meals.  The combination meal included a sampling of six of the top vegetarian options. I'm not sure exactly what I got,  I just know that there were collard greens, taters, carrots and beans and just about every other vegetable you could imagine. I have to say that the offerings were flavorful, colorful and delicious. You should know that, in this restaurant, you're encouraged to use your bread instead of utensils for eating. The bread is different, unlike anything else I've ever tried . It's sort of like a crepe,  but not really, a bit more spongy . Wasn't my favorite thing, but it was good to try something new. However, it was a wonderful experience trying vegetables in a new way. At one point in our meal a very merry woman came out to talk with us and see how we liked the food. She was very delightful, I assume she was the owner but I'm not sure. We really enjoyed meeting her and talking to her about ourselves and her restaurant. I encourage you to try Queen of Sheba if you're looking for something a little exotic and also yummy.

Food was bland. Potato salad, creamed spinach & cole slaw had no flavor. Ribs were tough and underdone. Veggie burgers were seasoned well but possibly not even cooked or barely heated up. At the least. Hush puppies & fries were good. Kids mac-n-cheese was OK. Wait staff was very friendly and did a great job. 
Expensive considering the poor quality.

This place is the pits. I went there with a medium-sized party (with reservations) and sat outside. The waitress screwed up nearly everyone's orders, the service took more than an hour (not counting the time AFTER we got the wrong foods it took for her to get the people who even cared to wait longer their correct orders), and the stuff we were told was "spicy" was fairly mild. My spice-phobic friends ordered a green salad, which they were not warned (but told afterward by the waitress) is "the spiciest thing on the menu." We were charged an entertainment fee and a BYO fee PER PERSON for them to give us a bottle opener. All in all, possibly the worst dining experience I've had in Philly.
The service was great and I tell you what that burger melted in my mouth and really a friendly atmosphere I loved it

I wanted to like this truck, as I enjoyed it at a previous food truck event.  Unfortunately, this time around, they took my order and i waited at least 20 minutes, while other orders behind me were getting done.  They were very disorganized to say the least.  

I ordered the jerk chicken.  When I opened the package, what a disappointment.  ONE piece of thigh meat with SIX PIECES of soggy chicken SKIN sitting in the sauce.  Wow...so not worth the wait or the $10 price.  They get one star for my friend's fried fish dish, which was okay.  I genuinely hope they can turn it around and get consistency.

Not sure if this Taqueria Del Sol is in any way connected to the locations in Atlanta.. my guess is yes since the signs looked the same. I thought this was only in Atlanta but was pleasantly surprised to see it near where I was working. 

Thus, my expectations were high start with and they did not fail.

Ordered Brisket, Fried Chicken, Memphis, Carnita, and Fish tacos. The only other taco I didn't get was the Veggie taco. All were $2.49

My favorite would have to go to the Fish Taco. It was just so simple and tasty. Then comes Carnita. A lot of reviews mentioned Memphis which was good.. but for my personal taste, soft fish tacos are always my favorite and this place does it well.

They also have $3 margaritas for all you margarita lovers.

Definitely check this place out if you are near buy. In Atlanta, there is always a line at opening. I was surprised to see this place pretty empty during dinner time here in Willow Grove.

GO Go Go

Don't be fooled by the stripmall location and uninteresting store name, this place is a gem. It fills that rare void between bargain bin and boutique. They have some higher end brands (UPPAbaby) and a nice selection of more reasonable (Britax, Chicco) and cheaper (Graco) brands.

Expecting our first child in a few months, the whole process of making all these decisions between so many items for all the things we need (stroller, carseat, furniture, etc) seemed a bit overwhelming. The sales staff here put you right at ease. Marie, the store manager, is so full of knowledge! They've got customer service figured out over here. A pleasant greeting at the door, let you wander for a bit, and then come over after a minute to check on you. There was never any pressure to buy. When we seemed to be overanalyzing things and needed our own room to breathe, they let us ponder and gave us some space.

They also have a nice selection of chairs. We'd been having a hard time deciding between the few hundred dollar gliders at Babies R Us (that are fine, but nothing special) and the unbelievably comfortable $1500 glider at Pottery Barn. They have a wide selection of chairs that fall right in the middle and there are a LOT of upholstery options to choose from. Another bonus that Marie mentioned is that the chairs are made in Illinois, whereas most others are made in China.

Overall, a fantastic one stop shop for all your baby needs! We'll definitely be back.

Oh, and they also have some crazy jungle gym stuff in the back room. You can get some awesome backyard stuff if you have a big yard!

This is another place that is a whole in the wall, yet produces a fantastic product. Tacos and burritos are both incredible and inexpensive. You can go downtown and pay 3x for a less desirable product. Don't let the outside fool you, it's worth your while.

I really could hardly believe my ears when I not only got an appointment the next day as a new patient, but also received an eye exam including changes to my prescription and walked out with glasses the same day!!! I was told my prescription was in stock and that they would be ready in 25 minutes! Sooooo worth the commute to the city from New Jersey, which I did because of the consistently amazing reviews. I really can't believe I am waiting for my glasses right now. Every other place I've been over the years has been a long wait to even get seen and then another 7- 10 days on top of that for the glasses. The selection here is so trendy as well. Tory burch, dior, Prada, tom ford, Gucci and more ! I had basically a personal shopper walk around with a tray for me holding the glasses as I tried them on. He was so awesome and did not push me to get the most expensive ones. He really seemed like he cared and tried to get to know what I was looking for to offer genuine suggestions and he actually encouraged the cheaper one! Jeff is the best. I really can't believe this place . I have nothing but exceeded expectations leaving here. They take vba insurance! So for 130 bucks I walked out same day with a new eye exam, prescription changes and Tory burch glasses. Can it get any better ?

This organization is unbelievable.  You complain about how they overcharge on a credit card and then you get a private message that they want to help you - and you never hear from these idiots again.  All I can say is watch your credit card statement after you leave as they slammed a promotional card that I had and unfortunately, I have no recourse.  WILL NEVER BE SUCKERED INTO THIS JOINT AGAIN!

my first time here and i got the fried cheese  (because...fried cheese) and the blt. i think you can tell a lot about a place by their bacon to lettuce ratio. 

this place didn't disappoint. embarrassingly, i snacked on the cheese on the way back to my office. they were delicious. the blt was stuffed full of bacon and equally satisfying.  the prices are a bit high,  but there's nothing wrong with splurging occasionally.  i would definitely go back.

When in Nawlins, I expect to drink at least one daiquiri and this place catered to my needs. The prices were pretty great.  In fact it was only about $10 for two super huge 32 ounce daiquiris that were also very strong. 
We stumbled upon the place after determining that we should grab a to go beverage of some sort along Claiborne. The lady at the counter asked if we wanted more sweet or strong and we insisted that we prefer a strong beverage. She recommended the triple threat daiquiri which was filled with vodka and grain alcohol, but I'm ignorant about what the fruit flavors were. Let me tell you, it is definitely strong and worth the $5. They were also not to sweet so the flavor wasn't that intimidating. 
We decided to sit for a moment in the bar which is pretty dark but it had some TVs playing Bowl games as well as some kind of casino machines along the back wall. The drinks were to go though so we were able to take them out and carry on our merry way.

Because of the phenomenal ratings, my sister and I drove 30 minutes to get to Thai Place on 6/18 only to walk in at 2:45 PM, wait a bit, and then be told they were closed until 5pm, despite their Yelp hours, despite their posted hours, and despite the Open sign they still had in the window.  They then switched the sign to closed and put up one of those "Back at [clock face]." signs.  I feel bad giving a one star review but I can't think of many worse experiences.  I'd rather have had lousy food than be turned away with no food and a lot of wasted time and gas.  (If someone died or was rushed to hospital I'll amend this review, but I got the impression based on the host's interaction that closing when business was slow might be normal.)

This is the worst restaurant in Carpinteria, second only to Ihop. I have come here because there is no other sushi restaurant and my kids used to like it as a change of scene.

We walked in tonight and the place is empty. It smells like the restroom.
I have been in the restaurant biz for over 20 years. I am used to seeing a certain flow and the way the staff  go about their jobs is so disorganized. This place is obviously not well managed as the inexperienced staff have no training They make each staff member independent of each other so that on any given night you can have three servers come and ask to take your order. On the ticket, instead of a server's name, it just says "manager." The servers are mostly indifferent. They will bring out the food without concern for who ordered it, if the patrons have basic utensils, etc. I often order miso soup and 9 times out of 10 the server carries it in hand with their thumb on the rim. Many people sip from the rim of this kind of bowl. They usually forget to bring something ordered.
One can go to Vons and get just about anything that tastes fresher. If you like frozen beef or chicken that is heated in a microwave and smothered with store bought teriyaki goop, then this place is for you! The sushi looks authentic but for me, the success of a sushi restaurant is freshness of the seafood. They use the lowest grade of fish and the color, odor and taste is not what one sees in a good sushi restaurant.
The staff spend an inordinate amount of time doing side-work (consolidating soy sauce) instead of paying attention to customers.
For me it is an extremely MEDIOCRE dining place.

The tacos are definitely good, but overpriced. It's more like a $7 snack than a meal. I've had them twice and the wait time has been around ten minutes both times. A food truck should be both convenient/fast and affordable, neither of which West Coast Tacos is. There seems to be a certain social & novelty hype to the whole ordeal that subconsciously tricks 20-something's into obsessively raving about the place. 

I was very excited about a food truck like this in Indy, especially one that utilizes social media to communicate with it's customers; however the price point and wait time compared to the relative simplicity of the product has left me disappointed.

Left a lot to be desired. Our waitress, while nice, was unprofessional and had no presentation skills considering the caliber if service usually found in Olde City. We were told Happy Hours drinks were only for people sitting at the bar (we were outside) which I have never experienced at any other restaurant. The entire service was very slow and our server did not come back to check on us after the food was served which was a problem because I found a long black hair in my salad.  We ordered the three toast spreads, Caesar Salad and Mushroom Salad; the food was fine (other than the hair) but not exceptional for the price. There are so many great places in Olde City that I will not be returning here.

Awesome hotel! Nice rooms. Legacy bar is awesome... Danny was the best bartender... Lots of games for the guys. Walking distance to harrahs casino. Loved this hotel. Will definitely stay here again! Cory ricks checked us in... Great customer service & showed us a lot of places to eat & visit while in New Orleans!

Location: near the University, but I wish it was a bit more central, but the fact that I'll drive 20 minutes to North reno for this place should speak volumes.
Ambiance: mellow and retro. What I expect from the late 80s early 90s California beach scene. 
Food: I love the food, it's unique but so tasty with a large variety. There is literally something for everyone. I love the pig Kahana. And the surfing  cow. This place also has a good selections of local and micro brew on tap
Price: Be warned it is a tad expensive, but the regular size is great for one person and you could share a large if you and a friend are craving the same thing.
Artcade: yes I spelled that right, it an art gallery and throwback retro arcade games. It's enough to nerd out at for a few minutes. The best part is you can actually play these arcade games 
Service: This is what drops us to the four star rating.. They are a bit slow and not the most friendly people, not mean or bad, just mediocre, doing their job.
Overall: 4 out 5 and highly recommend with price and service in mind :)

Just outstanding. Consistently vibrant and dynamic flavors, lovely, family based staff that make it seem effortless to be kind and communicative, astoundingly reasonable prices for the volume and quality of food you get.

I'm from Southern Cali and I always come here when I visit. I would never order crawfish back home but I always love the spicy crawfish here. It's pretty spicy but you can't stop because it's so good. My family and I were able to share 2 lbs between the 4 of us and we were fine for a small lunch. They don't have different spicy levels FYI. When we ordered we also got our food very quickly probably because all we got were the crawfish and it was already made.
Beer is ok at best. Over an hour wait for hamburger and they weren't even busy... bad service.

Beers are ok. Not fantastic and here in Indy, there are a lot of better beers avaiable. The food is good. Flatbreads being the best thing on the menu. Wings were ok and there are better near by. The artichoke dip is pretty good since it has lots of cheese. The decor here is really great. I think it is really attractive and makes me feel very comfortable. The service is very attentive and well versed in their product. But, nothing really outstanding. I am sure I will be back but I am not breaking down the door.

We went on a plantation tour.  Our bus driver didn't explain or share anything on our way there.  When we arrived at Laura Plantation she quickly gave us directions and a time to be back at the bus.  The tour itself was great.  The guide was very knowledgeable.  We then got back on the bus heading towards Oak Alley Plantation.  To be fair she did mention a couple details on that little portion of the trip.  Upon arrival at the plantation she once again gave us directions and said we didn't have time to eat, we should buy food and eat on our way back.  Again the tour of the house was wonderful but this time there were outer buildings to check out, a gift shop, movie, and food.  We only had 20 minutes to spare for all this.  We felt rushed and like we were missing out.  We still don't know what the hurry was since we had been told we would be back around 4 and it was only 1:30 pm.
I always get the coconut curry. One time I arrived right before closing the lady let me order. It's not very noisy. He was really happy. I always get the coconut curry stir fry it tastes delicious.
Everything was delicious. I got build your hash, love that it comes with a side salad. Great atmosphere and cute decor.

Incredibly good food and usually quick service.  The only reason I don't give them 5 stars is because the last time or two we went the server was kind of terrible.  I think this is because they recently expanded and had to hire more people.

Still a great spot with good service and quality drip coffee but I think it needs something fresh and new.  The menu is solid but I've ordered a few sandwiches and noticed the meat was store bought grade from your average supermarket.  Pretty disappointing and something they should avoid.

Oh. My. God. The bread pudding?! Skip everything else; it is THAT incredible. Sticky, ooey gooey, moist, decadent---insert every other adjective that is borderline sexual because Cyrano's bread pudding is off the chain. You'll compare every other bread pudding you'll ever have to Cyrano's for the rest of your life after this, and it will never measure up. Delicious.

Note: we also had the brown shuga pie which was tasty as well, but the bread pudding stole the show.
An amazing selection of unique meat options (including boar, elk, and bison) in addition to your standard beef.  If you want a really special burger - this is the place!
Amazingly Huge selection of international produce! Prices very cheap!! Worth the trip. They also have fish swimming in tanks ready for you to pick them for your dinner plans.

Has always been a favorite, BUT, got a couple of bad sandwiches last week.  Bread was dry and not as much meat as usual.  It was a to-go order so did not discover the travesty right away.  Went in and told them about it a few days later and was met with the "We don't give a shit" attitude.  That was enough for me...we're done.

The food here is great along with the service. The breakfast was affordable and very filling, while the lunch selection is very good and believe it or not... It's good for you. At least alot better than a regular burger joint. If you can find another place that serves grass fed organic meat let me know, but untill then this is the place to go!

There are times when entering a store, one might expect to make a purchase of items and exit unceremoniously. However, Lumber Associate Ron Coats, took the lead from the Lumber Manager and filled my order. Bro. Coats went to work and in no time, selected the best boards and followed through by cutting the two (2) eight foot pieces in half.

Moreover, Ron finished his job at the cash register,  and fully shrink wrapped the four (4) foot sections together. Shrink wrapping facilitates and  is the preferred way to take a limited number of boards to travel by PSTA,  to a given location. Moreover, it is factually the best way to travel by bus, cutting down on splatter and possible injury. 

I want to thank again Ron Coates and his Lumber Manager for helping in such a way.
Please be advised that this is not the first time I have worked with Ron who has always given me the best of customer service.

It's hard to describe this market so I'm just going to put it into one word ...FABULOUS! You just have to go experience it yourself,  it's so much more than a market! (The hot Italian sausage there is as good as it is in New York)

I couldn't disagree more with some of the reviews on here. I just got my first wax in a year, and my experience at European Wax Center was really positive. The staff at reception were welcoming and kind, and my waxer Rachel was fantastic. She made me feel completely comfortable, and she really went above and beyond to make sure I was in as little pain as possible.  Also the prices are affordable and fair. I'll definitely be back next month.

Been trying not to eat too many cheese steaks and hoagies lately....and failing miserably.  Damm you Concord Pike S.S.  I've never had anything bad here (...and yes I actually have had a bad cheese steak/hoagie) Their portions are very generous, prices fair and ingredients top quality.  They customize your sandwich any way you like and I've found the staff very friendly. I once walked in 10 minutes before closing, when they were all cleaned up and they fired up a cheeses steak for me no worries.   Probably shouldn't have mentioned that last part....

Wow! A really nice pizza place just one block away from where I live..how did I not try it before?! Oh well better late than never. 

My husband and I ordered a take out from here recently. We got a large Greek delite pizza and a side of jalapeño poppers. It took about 20 mins to get the order ready for our pick up. The poppers were tasty, not too spicy but the flavor was good..they came with a tomato/marinara sauce. The pizza was absolutely delicious. I have a minor issue that they probably forgot to add salt to our pizza (I usually very less salt in my food so it was strange that I found it low). 

Although we didn't pick up any drinks, we noticed they have a pretty good selection of beers. We have always shopped for beer at Local 44 but it is good to know that there is an alternative in the area. May be we will try it next time.

We spent most of our time up stairs due to the 3 for 1 special that was only offered up there.  As I was checking out the place I noticed they have Fire Department shirts lining all the rooms up stairs.  Being a firemen myself I felt at home.  I even saw a memorial shirt for LT Pete Lund.  

They have a balcony that provides a great view of the intoxicated crowd strolling down bourbon.  Several rooms break up the 2nd floor and we were able to find a spot to sit down and relax for a bit.

Bourbon Street Blues is a solid spot to hit while hanging on Bourbon Street.
Excellent food - BYOB or buy a bottle at the restaurant - not by the glass.  Zucchini  bread is like bread  pudding - so good.

Very poor first and only experience at Jacksons. 

It was a busy Saturday right at lunch time. We walked in to find no entryway/hostess stand and stood uncomfortably in the middle of a busy dining area until the hostess arrived and told us we could sit at the bar or wait 30 min (she was seating a party of 2 as she was explaining this to us, which was odd). We sat at the end of the bar which doubles as a server stand/hostess area where 3 servers were polishing silverware and rolling napkins. They were complaining of needing a stiff drink rather which I found rude. 

Once our food arrived we were let down. We had a chicken Caesar salad and a Reuben sandwich. Everything tasted bland but we did eat it. We noticed 2 other couples at the bar struggling with receiving the correct order and the long wait time on food. 

This place was packed though! People seem to love it, so maybe we were missing something but regardless, we won't be back.
