I went here for my friends bday dinner & I love how they remodeled half of the restaurant. However, I did not like the food. That was my second time going there & I was still disappointed. We had a rude sarcastic waitress & I could tell she was getting annoyed with my friends and I. She acted like she forgot to take my order when she was standing right in front of me. Unprofessional.

This place is god awful. The service is horrible the girls are rude and they are never open when they are supposed to be. Every time I go there there's always little home made signs saying be back asap ect. I am so sick of paying $60 a month on this And only being able to tan when these girls decide they want to be there   Canceling my membership and will I will deter everyone I know from going here

This place is lovely and has great rooms/beds/bathrooms/complementary toiletries... but there is something missing and I can't quite figure that part out. It is very average. And Average is fine... but average isn't great. For visitors, it's definitely one of the nicer downtown Boise hotels. It's in walking distance to a lot of great restaurants (Bardenay, Goldy's, Bittercreek, Piper Pub). The staff is super friendly. OH! The hot tub closes early on Friday and Saturday nights. You know, the nights when most people want to stay up late and do something like that? Yeah, THOSE are the nights it closes early. THAT was a mean trick we found out the hard way! 

Overall, it's super clean and lovely. But also kinda meh.
Had breakfast at this place last saturday. It was great.. Food was awesome and not at all expensive. Waffles were great and so was everything else. I loved this place and would definitely go again.

The sushi is really good. Definitely blew me away, especially for "all you can eat".
But it's really cheap by the roll as well, so definitely weigh out how hungry you are before you commit to all you can eat.

We had high hopes but were quite disappointed. Pizza had very few toppings very little cheese and even less sauce. I'm baffled how a pizza can be served so quickly and still be only luke warm and rubbery.  The thing that pushed me over the edge though was the smell of the pizza. You know that smell of a frozen pizza that has been in the freezer way too long but you are starved so you cook it anyway?  That is what Brixx pizza reminded me of.  
   The decor was ok if you were seated in the front but we were fortunate enough to be seated right by the bathroom.  
   Oh, the two star rating is because they had a very good craft beer selection that included Zombie Dust!!!

I have avoided dental treatments for a decade or two, but this year I am getting everything done because I love Desert Dental.  The front office ladies are kind and helpful and Dr. Barney is the BEST.  He is funny and personable and makes sure that you are as comfortable as possible.  I had my wisdom teeth taken out the day before Thanksgiving and they called me on Thanksgiving (a holiday) to make sure I was doing ok.  When I did have a minor complication, I came straight to the office with no appointment and they helped me almost immediately.  I can't recommend them enough!

I'm keeping this at a four, but it is within shooting distance of a five.

Same great beer selection and overall positive attitude. The burger I had this time was much better than the previous burger. 

The manager, Dave, came over to us and talked with us for about an hour about his goals here and in the neighborhood. He seems to be truly involved, interested, and driven to turn Franklin's into a quality place that no longer has the college crowd. If you get to talk to him, you will hear great stories from a pretty cool guy who loves his job.

If you have an issue, bring it up because Dave only wants to improve his restaurant. I said earlier that it wasn't in contention of being that go-to spot, but it definitely is now.

I stayed at this Hotel a little more than a year ago ( before I was a yelper), and it came to mind while I am planning a trip back East. I really like this place. The staff was really friendly ( front desk, bar, and cleaning lady my personal favs). I love that it was so close to the freeway! My first night there they had a mixer and it was cool being that I was there for the first time. The room was young, funky,and cute. This is the first hotel that I check for when ever I am traveling. The Aloft is the hotel for young(or young at heart) and ready for fun crowd. The prices were pretty good as well.

This is my go-to sushi place for many reasons, namely the food...there isn't a place in town that (in my opinion) can even come close to the freshness and flavor of the sushi and the service is exemplary.

That being noted, I'm  dropping it one star for the seating.

Last Saturday night:
Five people in our party: four of us for AYCE, one person wanting chinese food. We have to sit in the "Sushi" portion of the restaurant which is usually fine.

However, when one person is 6'7" and another is 6'3"  the corner booth is pretty uncomfortable. The booth could comfortably seat four people of average height but even with the addition of a chair in the aisle, my knees were squashed against my husband's and my nephew's (6'3" and 6'7", respectively) and it was damn tight! 

I wish they would allow bigger parties (or parties who have freakishly tall people)  to sit at the beautiful, large tables in the chinese section of the restaurant instead of cramming them into a booth in the sushi section...it's only another 10 feet from the sushi bar and would make for a better arrangement.

Other than that, the smoked salmon nigiri was as delicious as ever and the service is so prompt, attentive and friendly that I'll still go every chance I get, even if I have to eat in the closet.

The beer selection here is ok. The problem is you can't taste any of it before you buy it. If I'm going to pay almost $15 for a growler, I want to make sure I like what I'm getting. The staff seemed polite and knowledgeable, but descriptions of beers only go so far. If I want to pick up a growler on this side of town, I'll be going down the street a bit, where they have just as good of selection and you can sample it first.
We went for strawberry festival and had a great time! My kids loved it! Lines were not long. Parking was let bad either. Prices were great! There is a ton for kids to do there.

Regular that goes here for lunch 3 days a week, ordered sandwich and asked for substitute  of salad for fries; still served fries and charged up charge for side salad. Gotta be kidding me, and very sure there was not a miscommunication just trying to make an extra dollar and lost a regular guest instead.

Service on this Fourth of July was really painful.  The poor dear of a server just had CRS.  Can't Remember Sh*t.  Oh I will be right back with whatever.  Oh I forgot I will be right back.  Nope but three times was the charm.

I ordered a specialty burger which consisted of bleu cheese and pesto sauce.  This was my total mistake on my part.  Too much flavor going on and really not very harmonious.  The burger was served medium well and it was more well than medium.  But standard what they are with undercooked food sure makes it hard on the establishment to serve at a safe temp.  

I am thankful they were open and what they served was what I ordered for the most part.  I would come back but I am thinking why didn't get the pizza?

So won't be coming back. Top coat was uneven on pedi so i have to fix that. I asked about manicure with dip powder bc I feel cuticle never looks super clean and she said don't worry cuticle will be cleaned up with drill when dip powder is done...well that's done and they are not. One of my nails is rough on the tip and I'll have to file that myself. I don't pay to have to go behind their work. For all the fancy nails they are doing the basic pedi/mani I got should've been no problem...very disappointing.

I rarely give 5 stars but this one def. deserved one! We were recommended by a friend to try out this new restaurant and it was simply outstanding. The staff was attentive and filled our water super fast and checked on us at the appropriate times. Nothing like good service at an ASIAN restaurant so I def. appreciated that.

Prices were reasonable and on top of it all... The food was good! Especially for the price, we ordered the volcano roll and the peanang curry and it was enough to feed the two of us (maybe because I wasn't hungry). 

Overall, worth a try :) def. come! And did I mention that it's BYOB?!

Very nice service, and comfortable atmosphere. 
Food is quite tasty and well-presented. 
Location and setting is nicely close on the Mesa, but off the beaten path with good parking. Very close to the corner of Cliff Dr and Meigs Rd.

Today's the first time I tried out this place. Suffice to say I scrutinized the food a bit more than I should have. Nonetheless IT WAS GOOD! Service was fast and friendly, and the food's super fresh and good for low-carb diets (forget about the pita in this review). 

Anyways for lunch, I ordered the $7.50 ($9 with taxes) Souvlaki Platter 1+ 1 with Chicken and Sausage gyro. It come with 2 sides (I got salad w/ feta and roasted veggies for the low-carb thing, you can also get rice or fries as well), pita bread quarters (I didn't eat these, but I did give these away!), as well as the tzatziki and red vinegar/oil sauces, separate from the main entreé. 

For the most part, I was satisfied with the meal. The gyros sausages were absolutely tender and delicious. GET THE GYROS if you come here. The chicken was good, where I can bite into the skewers to find clear juices running out. However it does not beat the gyros.

There's grease on the sausage gyros (There isn't much on the chicken), but as a high-fat/low carb ketogenic person, this was fantastic, especially since you can dip your food into the red vinegar olive oil that they give you! I didn't get kicked from Keto from the gyros, so that implies that they probably use 100% meat and not some substitute for their gyros! Much of the menu is for high fats/low carb diets and I'd say if you want a low fat place to eat, go somewhere else.

S/O to the tzatziki sauce for being SO GOOD. 

This food will make you thirsty though, dressings have a bit of a bite and saltier for some people, keep in mind that. 

Also, I know the people there can answer questions because this girl in front of me asked if Apple Pay is accepted here, which is not available now, but could be added later according the the cashier. It's good to see the staff answering questions.

The prices for the big plates are on par with what to expect for the portions, so expect me to be back again.
Franny Lou's is a great neighborhood coffee shop with a wonderful owner and friendly baristas. If you're looking for something to eat with your coffee, try the peach tart.
Delicious homemade food.  They Are accommodating to kids and what they will eat.  They will also make most anything GF.  This is a regular stop for us.

We were visiting in town and decided to meet a friend here.  What a great choice! I neither love wine nor beer, but this place has such a friendly list of both.  I chose the Nascetta Langhe Blanco Rivetto. My God, no nasty after taste, now I know why people love wine...all those boxed wines in college really gave me a bad intro to wine.  My husband ordered the Yards Brawler, and we are so glad we are moving to Philly soon, because this beer was so smooth and drinkable.  They compare it to Bud Light I think in the menu, but that is almost offensive. I hate bud light, love Yards Brawler.  I must say that the best part of the menu are the descriptions of each selection.  They were really helpful especially since neither of us know much about wine or beer.

Now to the cheese selection.  I may not love beer and wine, but I do love cheese.  We selected three bruschetta: goat cheese & pesto, ricotta with honey and pistachio, and classic caprese.  What great combinations of flavors, I wish I could replicate them in my own kitchen.  We also ordered a the asparagus and white bean salad; it was huge and light, great for summer. My husband ordered the flourless chocolate cake with mascarpone...absolutely delicious! 

Our server was very slow to initially take our order.  It was very busy when we arrived. Service could be more attentive.  

The atmosphere was modern but cozy.  The music play list was a great mix of alternative rock, which I thoroughly appreciate.

Been there once,already my favorite breakfast place in town,me and my gf are already planning our next visit. Loved the set up and feel of the place,staff was helpful,upbeat and made the experience even better. The passion fruit tea woke up taste buds up and prepared me for my plate of Duck Confiet Hash which was amazing from the first bite to the last,I also ended up stealing half of my girlfriend's Tri-slidder do to the fact of how good the tri tip was,the amazing house made biscuits,and the jalapeno jam slightly adding some Sonoran to the mix. Looking forward to my next visit for sure.

This is quirky little place. Since the venue is small, the musicians were comfortable talking to the audience between songs. After each musician was done with their performance they sat down with the audience to view the next performer and interacted with the audience about their performance.

The sound system guy should have paid attention more. Several times the musicians had to ask for adjustments on the sound in the middle of the performance. One time there was nasty feedback during a song and the performers almost had to stop the song.

Unfortunately, I wasn't impressed. I had the scallops, (only 3 actually came in the dish) and asparagus, 2 glasses of wine. My date, the veal, 1 glass of wine for 115.00 dollars + 30.00 tip = a very over priced meal.. I had to stop at Jersey Mikes on the way home just to get full.. This is not a $$ issue, this is a portion issue..
Awesome food. Awesome beer. Awesome service. I had the meatball sandwich and slaw, both awesome. My favorite beer was the Prescott Achocholypse.

I wish more businesses were run like this establishment. Every time I have been there, not only is the food amazing and fresh...the service is above and beyond. I went through the drive through the other day and one of the two happened to be down. Most would think screw this and just give up. But no! I stayed in line and figured it was worth the wait. Well wait I did not. They had three employees outside with iPads to take peoples orders and it was quite fast and efficient! The order was correct when I received it and it was delivered with a smile. The inside of this location is always clean and the staff is always very nice. More businesses seriously need to play by these rules and step things up.

I had my 40th bday party here and what a great night! The staff treated me like gold and even made me a cake. The helped all my friends and treated us soooo well. The drinks were yummy. I love that there is no smoking inside. I love that they have games to play. I also love the lounge that is in the next building over. They have been nice to us when we went there before too. I would highly recommend you come here for a great time and great service. Nice open place as well.

We had the sesame chicken, sweet and sour chicken, the Banh mi pork and crab and cheese spring roll and it was amazing. Great flavor enough food for leftovers. Fast friendly and priced reasonable. Cooked to order.  Clean and well decorated.

Don't be fooled by the name this is not a vintage store. Went in looking for vintage clothing and all they had was new clothing!  It's more like a platos closet for an older crowd. If you're going to advertise yourself as a vintage store you should actually have vintage!!

I just don't understand! I've been to Burger Up about 4 times in the last 2-3 years and every time walk away wondering why I came back! Every time they are very busy so evidently my taste buds are not as highly evolved as most but too me the burgers just aren't that good and the Truffle fries are worse!! Ordered the Woodstock with Benton bacon and had to look under the cheese to find it! Service has always been good but 20.00 for burger, fries and coke (after tip) is just crazy to get at least in my humble opinion (in the flavor department), a well below average burger and fries.

I was prompted to check in as soon as I entered the door. The receptionist was very kind and after waiting only a few min (with one person ahead of me) I was asked to be seen by a technician. While waiting, one lady worker came up to my children and gave them stickers. She even came around while my blood was being drawn and helped entertained them. She was so nice. Another technician over heard that chocolate had gotten over my stroller and came in with a handy alcohol pad to help my little girl clean up the mess. Nice people everywhere with the most efficient process... My best Renown lab experience yet. 

It doesn't hurt that it's next door to a chocolate shop and petsmart and in the same plaza as baskin robbins and L&L BBQ. I was able to take care of so many errands without lugging my kids in and out of the car so much.

Food: Get the gyro platters! So much food (meat/salad/rice/pita) for the value. The pita bread was hot and the strawberry lemonade smoothies have real fruit pieces in them, too.

Service: Amazing. The owner, Smiley, was super friendly and warm-this might be best hospitality I've ever received in a restaurant. He took the time to talk with my family and even sang happy birthday to my brother in multiple languages.

Ambience: Seating area downstairs is casual and looks a little like a coffee shop with some tables and a few couches.

Nice place. Nice people. Nice service. Great experience. Awesome follow up. Better than expected wait time. Never felt rushed. Saw the nurse practitioner instead of the doctor and I don't mind that. The doctor called two days later go follow up. Answered all my questions. My only recommendation is more room privacy. The walls are thin and you can hear pretty well the patient in the next room. They need to play background  music or use sound neutralizes. Aside from that, I will definitely use them again. Great experience.

Had a great experience with this company. Ray was prompt and professional. We discussed my areas of concern before hand and he went above and beyond. The oircr was extremely reasonably and I plan use him every quarter

This spot is different from the Tired Hands Brewing company. The Fermentaria is a lot bigger and the beer/kitchen menus have more variety. The IPAs here are great and also have some cool glasses as well. Came on a Sunday afternoon and there was a good crowd here. Would recommend this place to hangout and grab a beer.

Friendly staff and service. Wine selection is large and selective. Low key and relaxed for a date, catch up or just some good friends. Would recommend to those looking for a good time, spending sharp.

Average burger for $9 came out in 30 minutes, and my wife's salad hit our table 50 minutes after ordering. Clearly understaffed for a Saturday evening. They refunded a few customers. Luckily, we weren't in a hurry and had a great convo. On a positive note, beverages were served in a mason jar.
I dnt knw if there's a new cook but the ox tails had no flavor at all nothing like it use to b very upset the whole thing went in the trash
Just not good compared to other places around. I personally like the sweeter "pinched" crab Rangoon, not the folded ones like they have. I also like big egg rolls not the small bready ones.

Amazing food, fantastic service. If we lived in Philly, we would be here once a week. From beginning to end, each course was extraordinary...particularly enjoyed the pasta with halloumi and yogurt sauce. They were very accomodating of a picky little eaters vegetarian palette and generally very solicitous of all members of our disheveld party.  We will be back!

Yes, just yes. Because it's described as a wine bar, I really thought it'd be a stop on our way out to dinner, but it's so much more! It was SLAMMED on the (Saturday) night we went, but there were still plenty of places to sit. And the service- 5 stars FOR SURE. From the doorman to the entire staff really, they have it all flowing like a fine-tuned machine. Upon walking into the backyard of what once was a little bungalow, you'll see lots of tables to sit down at. It's all communal, so don't be shy! Share a table and your bottle of wine with your new found friends. Also, do yourself a favor and order the mussels and the pork shoulder as well...large portions and your stomach will thank you! Oh and did I say talented jazz musicians? Now if I could only transport this place to Austin....

Yep, definitely have been missing out on this place. Best gyro I have had in Tampa to date! I will have to come back again with the lady because I just know she would love the greek salad I saw a few people dining on!

I also liked the setup of the place...walk up counter to order so you can take it out or dine in, which is pretty nice and calm inside.

The greek fries were also a favorite when I brought the rest back home!

IF YOU ARE A FAMILY WITH FOOD ALLERGIES...STAY VERY FAR AWAY FROM HERE. I waited the long line to find out if they could accommodate a peanut allergy. I was told they would make them in a separate section in the back. After waiting another 15 minutes, I watched an employee look very frazzled as they realized they hadn't segregated my peanut free order. Another five minutes went by, and I was told they could only make cinnamon or vanilla icing for a nut allergy and that's it.  I have been to Sundaes in the heart of the summer where they would open a new tub of ice cream and wash equipment for my son. I asked for the manager who took another ten minutes to refund my money. When I expressed my disappointment that they wasted my time and seems to be insensitive to the group of children that were just disappointed by not being able to have their order (3 of the 4 had nut allergies). Nobody cared. I asked to reach out to the owner. The owner looked at me and said you got your money back and walked away. Not a great way to run a business. I watched the donuts come out in the half hour I waited and they were sloppy in the prep area and sloppy in the presentation boxes. In this day and age, I would think people would be more sensitive to food allergies and not want to alienate that demographic.

Best experience ever!!! I meant to write this the other  night I visited the Outback however,  I ordered a Flat Iron Steak, (First time) via the curbside.  A very pleasant young man (Mike) greeted me immediately.  I waa a few minutes early but Mike asked if I would like something to drink while I was waiting for them to finish up my order. Within moments, a nice young lady brought out my order. This is the very First time I decided not to check my bag.  I'm usually the nut who will go through everything even checking for salt. But I wanted to see how they did. I just gotta say. .. IMPRESSIVE! !! My Steak was Perfectly cooked, super hot, delicious! !  Dressing on the side as i requested. Mashed potatoes loaded...perfect! !! Apps...hot, crispy, Perfect! All utensils,  napkins,  condiments! ! I am super picky and maybe a lil bit of a critic when it comes to dining out...so for me to write anything and be Perfectly satisfied? ? As my husband would say...a miracle!!! We are die hard Texas Roadhouse patrons but I gotta say I just became a new Outback customer over our Roadhouse!!!! Great job Outback!

This is not a bad review just a suggestion to the restaurant. When I filtered "delivery" and "open now" you guys came up so I looked at the menu, called, and was told that you were not doing delivery's anymore. As I said, not a bad review, just a heads up.

I have to agree with Adam. Caruso's is terrible. Ketchup and 40 minute pasta would taste better. Being from NY, I was ushered there the first year we moved here after complaining about the local Italian. Everyone said you'll love this. They were wrong.

This hotel has charged me twice to stay in a hotel for you one night. I booked through Priceline and apparently that doesn't count for anything. The Manager named Regina was absolutely no help to me what so ever. Refused to refund me the money to stay in a moldy room for one night. This hotel is outdated and in need of a renovation and new manager. I will be telling everyone I know to never come here and spend their hard earned money to be taken advantage of. This hotel also makes a hold in the amount of your reservation on your card for a week long. They will not tell you about this either.

Very disappointed. Clearly not an authentic Mexican restaurant. The flavor of the Mexican rice and the refried beans was not that good to begin with, but on top of that, they tasted like they were old. As if the food had been sitting there in a warmer all day. The rice tasted like it was scraped from the bottom of the pan... It was dry and crunchy. I rarely don't finish a meal but I left food uneaten. Service was, well, there wasn't any. Nobody even came back to check how the meal was or refill drinks or bring more chips. Anytime I needed anything I had to get up and go find someone and even then they didn't send anyone to the table. The people that were supposed to be at the order counter weren't where they were supposed to be, they were standing outside the restaurant. It's no wonder you have to pay for your meal up front. And it was about three times the price as it usually costs us to eat mex food. Would not go back to this place!

The Crab Rangoon was very fishy tasting with a bad texture. The Sushi seemed fairly old and was falling apart,  The rest of the dishes were OKAY. Several things miss labeled. The fried banana was I think chicken? The chicken was squid or some other sea food. Diet soda tasted overwhelmingly of fake sweetener (beyond what is normal). On the plus side - it had the red bean sesame balls that I LOVE and the Mushrooms were REALLY good.  Not sure I'd go back just for those two things though

If you're reading this, you are wondering which tailor is the best bet in Indianapolis. Without a doubt, Lee is the absolute best. He will tell you this himself (which may be off-putting to some) but trust me, I have tried the competition - and they can't compete. He is literally in a class of his own and he knows it. It is the difference between a C-average student and an honors student with an A. One shop provides subpar work that requires multiple visits to get right, long turnaround times, and headaches. Lee's provides insanely fast turnaround, very competitive prices, and levels of handiwork that rival or exceed what is done on high-end men's clothing. The stitching in the cuff and tapering on the sleeves on a suit I took him looks like it came straight from Hickey Freeman, not an "alterations shop." That's because it came from Master Tailor Lee, who truly earns that title after working with him.

Don't cheap out on clothes. And don't be cheap on getting them altered. It's worth the extra few bucks to go to the best. I'll be bringing him more to alter, including a quite expensive Isaia jacket and a Brooks Brothers suit - things I wouldn't dare risk at the competition who must employ blind elderly people with box cutters for their tailoring. You know who you are, and anyone reading this will as well. 

By the way, his selection of shoes and fabric offerings looks miles better than anyone else in town. I have no doubt he will do fantastic work when I'm finally ready to do bespoke or MTM.

I'm not sure if there really is a Philly connection, but Ralph's has great pizza!  With at least a dozen pizza shops in a one mile radius of our house in Willow Grove, Ralph's has the tastiest pizza crust and at a great price. Their wings are also good, although the limp celery isn't appealing (they stash it under the wings, heating it up and destroying the crisp factor.). We have only had take out from Ralph's and our orders are always correct.  The food is ready for pick-up when they state and always hot & fresh.  Their chicken cheesesteaks are great too.  There is a tiny counter to eat at Ralph's, but it isn't exactly a great dining experience, since it's outdoors on York Road.  Definitely a great neighborhood take out pizza shop!
The girl that was working Saturday afternoon of July 22nd was rudeeeeee!!! It was pretty good coffee, just wish the service was more friendly.
Got my bacon egg and cheese breakfast sandwich in less than five minutes. Killer sandwich and the coffee is pretty good too.

We had a number of the small plates. They were all very good. We showed up 30 minutes early before our reservation. Although there were a number of seats available, the issue is it is a very small kitchen and everything is made fresh at time of order.  We were very patient and I'm glad that we were. The meal was exceptional. In addition to the small plates that we shared we also shared a main entrée. It was way more food than we intended. Lovely atmosphere, exceptional food. I wish it was closer to where we lived.

Great environment! We ate lunch here recently. My friend had a Reuben, and I took a bahn mi and a glass of wine. Both sandwiches were great, and they have an extensive wine selection. Of interest for future dates are paired wine dinners, but we are out of towners, so we will have to coordinate with their schedule. Service was excellent.
Cramped little place in the Quarter.   Great food so it was worth rubbing elbows with the neighbors.

Something I wish I had known prior to arriving here (which is super helpful to know) is that the non-pizza items here are somewhat tapas style. So that being said, this place ends up being somewhat pricier than you would think. We ended up ordering about 10 different ~$15 plates and 1 pizza for 4 people. We weren't planning on spending that much when initially looking at the menu online, but still glad we came because everything was amazing!

I drove by this place a million times on my commute along Kelly drive, and finally decided to give this place a try. I must say, everything was better than I expected it to be! We needed to order some veggie options so I reluctantly agreed to getting the pea ravioli... which actually blew my mind! Salads are fresh, flavors are incredible, and textures of all pasta and meat are perfect. You can pretty much order anything on the menu here and you will be happy... Even I, the meat lover, who also had to eat a vegan pizza that night, left more than satisified.
Really enjoyed mani-pedi with cosmetologist Gina Saldana! She is really attentive to details! Felt pampered!

Great cigar shop. Good selection with a very helpful knowledgable staff. Prices are reasonable and even better with their buy 4 and get 1 free special going on right now. Although I took my cigar to go, the smoking room in the back looked inviting with several chairs and sofas and a TV.
Cool vibe! the food is very good, we had the Mac and cheese bites and French fries (just came in for a quick bite). Good portions too. Emma was a great server

Nice clean store with great selection of organics. People at the register are always friendly too and love that their bakery super careful about cross contamination when it comes to peanuts...at least so they say when I expressed the concern.

Not that great. I had the chicken, macaroni and cheese, brussels sprouts, and bread pudding. The skin of fried chicken is usually my favorite part, but it lacked salt and felt a little to flour-y or a little chalky. The chicken itself was moist, though my boss had the chicken tenders and they were dry. The macaroni & cheese had no seasoning either. I added salt, but I would have enjoyed more flavor provided by the chef. The bread pudding was not only dry, but seemed stale or as if it had been frozen a couple of times. The only thing that I really liked were the brussels sprouts. I'm disappointed because I've been looking forward to enjoying this restaurant!

While certainly not gourmet on NYC standards (the soft water in FL is somewhat to blame, I'm sure), the two pies we ordered were passable...delivery took quite a bit too long and the pies were close to cold on arrival, so the saice and cheese didn't hold up very well. Toppings, etc., will be exactly as requested, which in this day and age is a plus.

The husband and I ate here one month ago. 
How many ways can I say a-ma-zing?!

I had bananas foster french toast with a side of boudin and fresh squeezed apple juice.

The husband had a fried oyster poboy and some yummy organic juice with ginger and other goodness.

The place is cozy with great affordable eats.

We were very pleased.

I like how you can see the cook , it's looks nice and clean, cute seating area.  The people working was great. The food was good and tasty plus  fresh . Just wish they devein the shrimps. Next time I will get the beef. I will be back

I don't know why I continue to patronize this place. It is so slow and the servers are mostly inattentive. I probably give Henpeck a fresh chance every six months or so and they never fail to disappoint in reminding me why I don't come more often. The food is its one redeeming quality but frankly not worth the effort in terms of how much time you have to spend waiting for it. There are plenty of good local restaurants in Franklin--go there instead b

This is probably the best place in Tucson for a frozen treat. 
In the past, we had gone to "Applause" (on Campbell) until they closed. And then to Austins (until they closed), and were looking for a new supplier for our ice cream "fix" -- so we checked with Yelp.

As usual, the Yelp reviews were spot-on. We loved every bite, and returned every day we were in town.

I would recommend the dark chocolate, the Alpencarmel, and their root beer floats.

Wishing they had a location in the Northwest!

Best frozen custard I've ever tried. Being from Seattle, we don't have frozen custard. Froyo, yes, but frozen custard, no. Anytime I'm in town for a business trip I have to find my way to this place.

The first time in StL, I was in town for a week and must've had frozen custard at least 3 times. Originally heard about this place from the travel channel and wondered what the heck is a concrete?! Think of a diary queen blizzard but better, 10 times better!!! Long lines, but fast service! 

The most recent time (May 2015), nothing on the menu caught my eye so I asked if they could make me a mint Oreo concrete and of course they did! Ah-mazing and totally worth a sweet cheat from my training plan. Until next time! Toodles Ted.

Hailing from a big, bustling city with many professional salons, I was a bit hesitant in finding a stylist in Santa Barbara. In turn, I went onto Yelp to find somewhere to go as I was in need of a haircut. I read all these good reviews at 19 Blue for Savannah, so I went ahead and booked a haircut. 

Firstly, parking isn't bad - there are some meter spots right outside but worst case scenario you can park in the Paseo Nuevo parking lot and if you make it back in under 75 minutes, I'm pretty sure parking will be free. 

My first impression of the salon was that the ladies working there were extremely chatty, friendly, enthusiastic, and full of energy (which I loved). I checked in at the reception and waited less than five minutes until Savannah came over and introduced herself.

I told her what I wanted and she led me off to get my hair washed. One of my complaints was that the head and neck massage that I'm very used to in the salon back at home was missing! There was a little bit of massaging, but not enough to constitute it as a massage. Boo! That's usually the best and most relaxing part of getting my hair done and it wasn't there - major disappointment. 

Anyways, during the whole cut Savannah seemed very nice and genuine, making appropriate conversation but taking care not to be overly enthusiastic or fake which was nice. She did exactly as I asked and my hair felt great. This isn't the cheapest place to get your hair cut but I'm always paying $50+ because I have long hair that requires a little bit more time so I didn't think too much of it. 

Pros: friendly, efficient, listened to what I wanted, easy parking, and great results
Cons: missing head massage during shampoo
Verdict: I'll definitely be going back to Savannah from now on!

I would give this place no stars but it forces me to give it one. I believe this establishment has the worst customer service I have ever experienced. I work in customer service. I know about rules but when unforeseen things happen there need to be exceptions. I know every place has them. I had bought 6 items for one of my friends who had a baby. The worst imaginable thing happened he died when he was  only five days old!! I have been dealing with helping my friend and her family deal with the horrible event that happened to them. I went to return what I had bought. I had taken the tags off because they were in a gift bag ready to be given to her precious child. They would not return them even for a store credit. They said because the tags were off they couldn't do anything but have us resell it to them. Of course that was not at the price I had paid. No one in their right mind makes up a story about a baby dying. How could they not match the 6 items on the receipt to the 6 in front of them. They are a children's store they apparently have no sympathy for others. I will never step foot in this establishment again and inform all of my friends who deal with this loss that they should never shop there as well. I have a lot of friends and family with children and who are pregnant. This sickens me to my core how they acted and could careless and policy is all that stood. I know and understand policy I work with it and uphold it everyday, however I know my work place does make expectations outside of that simply because it's the right thing to do and we have compassion and understand. I deal with a much higher monetary value then they do. I also was only asking for store credit not a refund so really they wouldn't be losing anything but my business and that of all my friends and family. I have a lot of that. I hope one day they are more than people just working in a store and have a heart.
I have eaten here numerous times and the food was always very good. The service however, is not consistent and I believe they are a little pricey.

I haven't been here since the storm, so I cannot testify to the current state of the restaurant.  What I can say was Mr. B's was one of the handful of restaurants I visited when I decided that New Orleans has the best food in the entire country-- yes, and by a landslide.

BBQ shrimp here was life changing.  Service is over the top impeccable.  I wonder if this place remains as good as before.  I hope so.  What a gem.

Snap is a great place. Your pizza will be ready in about 5 minutes from the time you order. The topping are always fresh and delicious.  The staff there are very nice - they treat you good. I love this place and can binge eat their pizza no problem.  The sodas are great too.

The food was delicious! I ordered the chicken fried steak,
Comes with eggs potatoes and toast!(so many carbs, exactly what I needed), and a pancake - that I'm taking home. Service was amazing and she definitely deserved  the 10$ tip (bill was 20$). I always love coming here!

Wow! Talk about a true Greek experience!  This place is the real deal!  The menu is huge with authentic Greek meals and the waitstaff are always ready to explain what any dish is or answer other questions.  You totally get a feel that you are somewhere other than a coastal Florida town here in this restaurant. Food was amazing and the desserts and dessert bar/counter portion attached to the restaurant will leave your taste buds screaming for their tasty treats.  Restaurant offers secure, gated parking out back which is $3 if you don't dine there, but if you do they provide an all day pass and parking is free!  Can't beat that in a touristy town like Tarpon Springs.  Had a great meal, strolled around town a bit, took a boat ride and then when we were tired, Headed back to the car with free parking!  I love Tarpon Springs and the Sponge Docks, immerse yourself there and you WILL forget your in Florida and feel like your rather at a small Greek coast fishing village!

I have been eyeing this place since I drive by it everyday from work and knew I wanted to try it when it opened. I was not let down! It's nice to have a new local restaurant rather than a chain restaurant. Service and food was great, it was very clean, decent prices and the staff was very knowledgable and helpful regarding what to order. I think it's a great place to kick back on a Friday night, I will definitely be back!

This is my worst HAVAC experience! The business is very unprofessional and incompetent. They took much longer in doing a simple warranty work because they keep ordering the wrong parts leaving my senior parents to go without AC for 4 days in a very hot and humid climate without any apologies or concerns for the customer. Even their own service techs were bad mouthing the business on their incompetence and bad customer service.

I'll remove the 1 stat rating AFTER they fix the over price on my credit card.  
I was charged $2.13 more than I signed for.  
I know it's a small amount but if they did it to me, they may do it to you.  Small amounts add up quickly.

I have been going to Dr O for over 18 years. She offers a full service dermatology benefitting our damaged Skin. After years of sun exposure she has helped me regain healthy skin. She has the latest in products and technology to help reverse the signs of aging and damage.
Delicious! Best meal we've had in New Orleans and very reasonably priced. The biscuits and cornbread are amazing!

This place is generally hit or miss. When it's on it's game, it's awesome, but when it's a miss it's all kinds of frustrating.

A big part of the quality is how many people are staffed and who is cooking the burgers. When there's more than one person behind the counter the service is generally prompt and at least courteous, and when the cook makes your burger the way you want it the food is spot on. Their fries are always amazing, especially the Truffle Fries.

Things get problematic when there's only one person there to do register and cook, or when your burger comes out overdone. I've gone in several times to find no one behind the counter and had to wait for several minutes before someone emerged from the back to take my order and make my food. Once the guy who came out was on his phone, and continued his conversation while ringing me out and then cooking my burger. 

Additionally, the burgers are overdone one out of every three times. They have very specific descriptions of what you'll get when you order your burger a specific way but they don't seem to adhere to that particularly well. I always order rare and I'm not always happy with what I get from the grill.

Overall I like this place and I'll keep going back, but they need to step up their game.

I contacted Hertz Customer Service with complete documentation. On June 13 I received an email from Hertz Customer Service. It was the " we will be looking into it" message.  Hertz wanted receipts for the taxi and Red Cap.  Red Caps don't provide receipts and Taxi's don't provide receipts when you are in a hurry or miss the only train that day from Phily to Pittsburgh.

All Hertz needs to do is to put a sign out showing where to turn in the car and provide transport back to the designated drop point if the contract drop point is closed or ???

I messaged Hertz in response to their June 13 email.  We shall  see what we shall see.

I really can't say anything bad with this Domino's location. They make the order perfect every time. I have never had a order messed up, and the timing of delivery is always spot on or earlier. The driver's at this location are always courteous as well.

I appreciate that the online ordering system and makes it very convenient.

All of Brennan's restaurants are great, Mr. B's is no different. My friend and I shared the rib eye and a Mr. B's salad. Our steak was like butter, a fantastic cut. The salad was great too. I would go back in a heartbeat!

Do yourself a favor and BOOK HER! Ashley is fun loving, professional, and extremely talented in her craft. She and her team will make you feel comfortable in front of the camera and will produce some of the most beautiful, authentic images. We will treasure the photos she took of us for the rest of our lives. I highly recommend Ashley and would suggest you book her as one of your first vendors. She was extremely helpful in recommending other vendors for us to work with and our wedding would not have been as much of a success as it was without her. JUST DO IT - YOU WILL NOT REGRET YOUR DECISION!

Great happy hour and awesome cocktails!  French 75 is made with cognac (as it should be) and the raw oysters were huge, the fried oysters delicious, crawfish bisque out if this world, and the lemongrass shrimp meatballs w/ spaghetti was equally awesome.  Also,love that they have an absinthe cocktail and a variety of pastis.

Depending on your exposure to wine, this place could potentially be a five star or three star experience.

Round up to the middle. 

Malbec is "Old World".

Thoroughly dissatisfied. I really wanted to love this place, I've been to the Jerry Bob's on Houghton and had a great experience every time. Jerry Bob's on Broadway is nowhere close in quality or service. I brought in a coupon, and they did not accept it. The stuffed French toast with strawberries and cream cheese was soggy and sickening, completely soaked with sad strawberry juice. A table near me complained about their food taking too long, and seconds later their food was brought out to them. At first I thought the people at that table were being jerks, but after the food was brought out so quickly after the complaint I started to wonder if it was coincidence or if their food was ready and just sitting there. 
I spent more money than I normally would on breakfast because I had a coupon, and they did not accept it. So I'm thoroughly dissatisfied.
Bad service. No one helps us in the office. The room is really dirty too. Negative experience.

Wish I was hungrier or else I would have eaten one of those amazing looking burgers in a second!  Duck fat fries, sign me up!  The only food I tried were the deviled eggs which were great and the drinks were awesome.  Cool place but small so get here early or make a res.!

The best Carne Seca tacos in town!  The chips and salsa are sooo good too. The service is very fast and efficient.  I have tried to eat here at least once a week for the last six months because I cannot get over how wonderful the Carne Seca tacos are.  My mom loved the salsa so much she asked to buy some and take it home, it was only $3!  Love this place!

I am not sure how to rate this place because the food is good but the service is odd? Initially she comes to you with a smile and "how are you" but you will not see her again. Don't ask for anything out of the ordinary or try to substitute a sauce with a different dish, she will not look at you again but agree against her will! It is like they "pretend" to be nice? Culture? They were not very professional and pleasant for being in the food and beverage industry. Cultural? She never came back once to see how everything was, after she dropped off our food. Someone else came by to pick up our plates when we were done and gave us the check. She was sitting at the bar in her Paul Frank shirt, watching something on her computer, while we were still eating. Overall the food is good but the service is lacking. You can split portions, they are a good size.

Our 1.5yr old "new" Pitbull rescue gets along ok with our other 2 dogs, but is a total attention hog and would mow the others down to get it!  Rachel  spent several days working with him.  She also spent a lot of time with us to ensure we understood the commands and training to continue at home.  You can tell they love these dogs and treat as if they were on
Small intimate spot. Great wine selection, generous pour, reasonable prices. Salads are huge and loaded with ingredients. Pizzas are great. wonderful crust. A nice little spot for lunch or dinner.

The Food was great, but we went to this place because it had a Starbucks inside or so we thought..turns out they serve starbucks coffee- but not all starbucks drinks....like an Iced Venti Vanilla Latte... The parking was crazy. Had to park in front of the dumpsters and because of how many people were trying to find a space or get out of there, we had to exit through the drive thru.

Delicious Mexican food. I'm from Chicago and this is the closest authentic Mexican food I've found. The food truck is clean the service is great and you can call your order in and have it ready for pickup. There very busy, they also accept credit/debit cards. Prices are great too!! Horchata is on point.

Sorry, but this cuisine is average at best. Seems like the frozen dinners i get (not good). 

The one thing that saved this restaurant from a two-star review is their genuine and happy customer service. 

Go in with your expectations at the right level. : )

312 is consistently the most inconsistent restaurant I have ever experienced. 

I want to give this place 5 stars for the 3 times I've been here when the food was excellent and the service was on point; however, for the 4 times I've been here when it was terrible, I simply cannot...

The first two deep dish pizzas I ordered here were perfect... The right amount of cheese, meat, and messy-ness. The encounters thereafter just weren't the same. 

For our (fiancé and I) next visit, we ordered wings, a basket of fries, and a sandwich. Well, the wings came out raw, we received a sandwich that tasted like they bought it from a gas station, soaked it in water and put it in the microwave. Half the fries were undercooked while the other half were fine. We spoke to the manager, who apologized and gave us a free pizza coupon. Good show of customer service there. 

Well, that free pizza was divine. Another shocking turn in the tale of 312. 

Recently, we came in later on a Saturday (1030PM) with five people. We take a seat and 20 minutes go by without anyone coming by...we leave. 

We STILL have faith in this place...

And here are we tonight. We come back and the pizza is 5 seconds from being completely burnt. 

PLEASE 312, I want to love you but you are making it really effing hard......

Love Love Love! The food is super fresh and delicious. Upbeat atmosphere and really knowledgeable, attentive and friendly staff. Loved trying the different Mimosas and took home some amazing pastries. I can't wait to go back.
Local pizza joint with a great staff and great food. The Downieville pizza along with the apple/goat cheese salad and a beer is a hard combo to beat.

This is a great spot for sushi. It is always fresh and prepared nicely. I've never had a complaint here. The restaurant itself is clean and has a calm atmosphere. Although it is not very big. I usually order takeout because it's more convenient for me. I look forward to ordering sushi from here when I'm at work.

Great food! I actually have cravings for it. Small place, kind of a dive, upstairs, and parking can be a challenge. Fast service, friendly staff, great menu, excellent flavor on everything we've tried. I can't wait to return. We've eaten here 3 times so far and it has never disappointed. Large portions.

The Red Pony is a great place to dine in downtown Franklin. The city has been in the need of a place like this for years. The added outside patio/deck area is a nice bonus to an already cool place that has the right vibe. I've met friends there for drinks on more than one occasion and was pleasantly surprised by the above average service. I encourage everyone to check out the Red Pony whether it's for dinner or just drinks.
Picked up the Pizza on Sat afternoon 2/10/18 , found a long hair in it. I pulled it from my month and then vomited , I'll never return , A hair net would  be nice .
Cute, clean and casual. Happy and helpful employees. Enjoyed the little that I had, pork rinds and hush puppies, and special cocktail. Looking forward to trying again soon.

My kids and I love the in house babysitting. The staff are great and make my kids feel welcomed. My kids prefer it over watching a movie. So it's a win win For both parents and kids. 6.00 per kid. Theater is clean and comfortable. Plenty of options for snacks and drinks. Thanks Harkins for the babysitting option.

One could easily miss seeing nam kitchen express tucked away in the strip malls beside T&T at north gate center. It's a small restaurant with limited seating, but packs big Vietnamese flavor! From the pho to vermicelli bowls to the fried noodles, nam kitchen express has tasty authentic Vietnamese dishes for a great price. Servings are very generous, I ordered the special noodle bowl for takeout and I could hardly finished have the bowl. The green onion cakes are also a nice treat, light and crispy. It's defiantly not a place to eat if you're looking for an ambient atmosphere or stellar service, but you can't go wrong if you're looking for some genuine Vietnamese food.
Really great sausage and biscuits, per BF.  I had a Mexican scramble that was very good.  A bit of a wait but worth it!

I found this place when I was buying shoes next door, big surprise.  I love sushi and this place did not disappoint.  I had one of there platers, what a good idea most of the time I have to order 3 or 4 different things with the platers you get a bunch of stuff.  The fish was fresh and the service was good.  I will definitely be back.

Ok so I went to this place several months ago, maybe January? And can't believe I haven't left a review yet. To be honest I don't remember the exact name of my dish but it was some type of truffle bucatini. There are no words. Just incredible. In full disclosure I'm a sucker for truffle anything, and pasta, so this was kind of a no brainer. Can't wait to go back now that it's nice out!

This place has so many mirrors and so much neon that I thought my eyeballs were going to burn out of my sockets. The decor is so freaking cheesy and over the top and the ceilings are way to low. I can't quite describe how uncomfortable I felt even being here. 

I played mainly poker at a 1-2 NL table. The structure of this game was unique in that you could buy in up to the highest stack on the table. So if someone had $1,000 then you could buy in with a hundred. The play at the table was fairly decent and I wasn't running all too great. I was down $250 quick, built up my stack back to even and then ended up losing all $300. All in all a bad night. 

The one good thing about this place is $3 minimum craps. Before I got sat at the poker table I played a little, ran good, and won around $125. So the night wasn't a complete loss. 

I haven't been to any other casino is Reno (I think Reno is a dump) and I don't want to considering that the Peppermill is held in such high regards.

got to to say, it has been 4 to 5 visits now that the service just keeps getting worse. last night's visit we went with a $25 gift card that the GM mailed me as a result of our visit two months ago when the service was so bad. last night's service still bad. waitress was bringing out one drink at a time four a party of 5. my wife waited over 20 minutes just to get her first glass of wine. wrong drinks twice. wrong food ordered. waitress was told it was wrong and then asked if we still wanted the wrong item. we finally asked a busser for help. getting the bill took forever. waiting for the receipt to come back took another 15 minutes. please do not send any gift cards. we have given you numerous chances. if you are going to hire inexperienced servers. please train them.

Druing this restaurant week, I reserved a table yesterday. The restaurant is located in walnut street and 14th street near by City Hall. Dark environment,  pretty waitresses and dressed up customers. I enjoyed the time. However, the food here is OK.

When I visited New Orleans, The Quarter Stitch was one of my favorite shops I went to. I popped in just to look around and I ended up finding a little gift for my boyfriend's mother. This shop is packed floor to ceiling with yarn of all colors, shapes, and sizes. When I asked if they had alpaca yarn, the young woman working was excited to help and showed me a rainbow of colors of alpaca or alpaca blended with wool yarn.

In addition to selling yarn, they also sell knitting and crochet books, along with a bunch of finished products. When I was talking to my Mom about my friends who spin their own bulky yarn, the woman working showed me a hat she had just finished and it was incredible! There are also very delicate shawls, cozy colorful scarves, and felted beads. This place is a haven, I'm sure, for those crafty ladies who get stuck in New Orleans and don't feel like walking around the Quarter drinking Hurricanes all day long.

AMC Westbank Palace is an ok theater in Harvey--it gets the job done on the Westbank, I guess.  Like most chain theaters, they gouge with concessions ($13 for one large soda and popcorn and $19 for 2 large sodas and popcorn and $3.50 for boxes of Raisinets or Goobers that you can get for $1-$1.50 at any local gas station or dollar store).  They could do a better job indicating which movies and times are sold out, and, when I went on a Friday evening, they did not have enough people working the concessions.  It's the same old story compared to other theaters, but it is mostly harmless.
Tonight was the BEST EXPERIENCE ever sine I started eaten here. Our server CANDICE was AWESOME and I fell like everybody should sat in her section.

I'm from San Diego and was told by a friend that no matter what, I needed to go to Bacchanal when in New Orleans. Fantastic find and I highly recommend this place. Funky cool, and fantastic food! The wine selection is broad and the people are wonderful there. The music is on the patio, but the bar is upstairs and there are tables up there as well. Pick your wine, and enjoy! The bread is a must have - it comes with 3 butters. As my friend said "You must go to Bacchanal!"

Great coffee.

I love this place.

Give me more coffee.
We were there last Saturday.  The waitress and the guy who served us drinks were very pleasant.  Had the spaghetti made of squash with pesto sauce and chicken. Delectable and healthy!
Best lobster roll in town! Get there early or order at the window outside.  Yummy
Dante is cool. The new girls don't know how to read passports so don't go there if you have a foreign passport. "They don't feel comfortable taking that as a form of id "

This is the first time I used College Hunks and I'll never use anyone but them from now on. They were on time, professional, fairly priced,  courteous of wrapping necessary items, etc. We had Harrison, Jordan, and Jon move us from St. Louis to Illinois and it was the smoothest move I could have asked for! Thanks Hunks!!

Great concept, a place to sample micro brews before you buy them. Thomas, the bartender was attentive and informative and knows his brews. They serve some food, I opted for a cheeseburger and sweet potato fries. The burger was good, with a nice bun baked in the store, but the fries were a bit overdone. The beers, however were great. Plus you can get them in a plastic cup and drink one while shopping, how cool is that? Found out later there's a tap room at a newer Whole Foods in Tucson, can't wait to try it. 4 stars for the beer and bartender, 3 for the food so this rating should be more like a 3.5.
This place is a family owned gem.   Everything is delicious.  Fresh and frozen.  There is not a family event that goes by without Ryan's potato salad at the head of the table.   Highly recommend.
Food was amazing.  Came for breakfast, had the shrimp and grits and the southern breakfast.  Shrimp and grits were delicious.  The coffee is amazing!!!!  Service was excellent.

Olympia is ALWAYS my go to for delivery! Great food, wonderful service, and super fast delivery! I love the fact that I can order online, track my order status, and earn reward points. Hands down, the best in the area! Keep up the great work!

Golden Nails has grown on me! Today was my second time here after my fill last time left me with ever so slightly uneven nails (I'm very particular, nail imperfections drive me crazy). I tried out a pedicure today and it was the best one I've gotten!! Nice leg massage, hot stones used for a foot massage, and attention to detail. Also my fill with a different nail tech left me with very straight nails this time :) lots of gel color and regular polish selection. Convenient location. Clean. Overall, recommended.
It was good. The environment was cute and the service was very nice! The popovers were a little burnt but besides that, I liked it all :)

The Bridge is a pretty interesting Theater. My friends actually got married in one of the Movie rooms, had a reception in the bar area, which later extended into the Rotunda. The seats there are really nice and the place is clean. Its a good place to see the latest Blockbuster. I applied to work there when it first opened up, but they wouldn't hire me because of my tattoo.

You are probably wondering why I gave this restaurant 5 stars, I review restaurants accordingly. We took a chance on this restaurant, it is a bit of a dive, but that never stopped us! We started with the suggested Rum Runner, and they didn't disappoint! Lucky for my husband and I our 18 yr old is our designated driver. My husband and I had two different salads and they were both excellent. Our two boys both had burgers and they were both excellent. My husband had the blackened shrimp with fries. He asked our server if they were able to go light on the seasoning and they did, so an extra thanks goes out to our server and the cook! I had the lobster mac and cheese.... to die for, big chunks of lobster and pasta in a creamy cheese sauce. Unfortunately we did not leave room for dessert. The portions are very big, so make sure you go there with a big appetite.

One of our favorite restaurants! Their red sauce is probably the best in town that we have found. Try their homemade house dressing- it's amazing. Everything we have had has been tasty and the portions are big. We always have enough left for lunch the next day. This is the place we bring friends to when they are visiting us from out of town instead and they want good food. It is also a frequent birthday or special occasion dinner location! We have been dining at the restaurant since it was located further south on 66th street. Love it.
Food is okay, drinks are super pricey for tiny cups and tons of ice. Service was okay, bartender was friendly but made weak drinks. If you're charging me $$$ for the tiny cup, hook it up.

Went with my nephew D stopped by because it was close to the hotel. Lucky us, they were having a comedy show in the back. We'll the show has about 7 comedians who were early in their comedy careers and not very funny. Although the bald guy with the hairy beard was knock down funny! We had a great time anyway, good selection of IPA beers.

Had food at the bar that was much better than expected. Service was adequate.

Not impressed. The restaurant was design to have a French theme but was masked by the large amount of clutter throughout the restaurant, obnoxiously loud blender, and trashy flower Dixi paper plates and plastic utensils. I ordered the strawberries and Nutella crepe. It had way to much Nutella for how few strawberries were in it. Overall, I was not impressed. I would rather go to a cleaner, more professional establishment.

Convenient location to our home, a regular in our "take-out rotation". My kids love their pizza (I'm a big fan, too), and the pastas are great (esp. Tortellini and lobster ravioli). Only thing I'm not big on is the house salad and bread)

I've been to Hendrick's a few times now and I would love to give it 5 stars, but I don't think it deserves it! I want to love it. The meat I would give 5 stars. The sauce I would give 4.5 stars. But, I think the sides are just lacking. There seems to be a problem with even knife cuts and inconsistent seasoning as well. 
This time, my mom had a giant uneven slice of tomato on her burger and the kitchen forgot to put the cheese on it. I love the corn casserole, but it can sometimes be dry, and this time it was lacking salt. The other sides I've experienced are the collard greens which were good, but I just don't think I like collard greens. The baked beans were 5 star worthy. The sweet potato fries were cold and needed a lot more salt. They also were unevenly cut so some were more like chips and others were like fries. The creamed spinach was a little rich for me. I prefer my spinach a little less mushy and weighed down by heavy sauce. I've also tried the deviled eggs which were good. They're super tangy and heavy on the mustard though, so if you don't like mustard, you won't like them.
Overall, I like this place. The atmosphere and decoration is great. The smell is divine! I love the meats and the sauces! I just think they could do a little better on the sides. How hard is it to salt the food and cut it nicely??
This is our first time. Absolutely excellent food and fantastic service. Very nice find.

Where do I begin.. horrible horrible experience. So I came in with 5 other bridesmaids after the Alfred Angelo bankruptcy to try to find dresses in time for a Nov 4th wedding. There were so many problems I have to make a list because it would take too much time to explain them all in detail. 
1. After two weeks of calling 5x a day and texting (it's a cell phone) and not one reply I had to just go in and hope the person who does the fittings was there, because she isn't always.
2. One girl ripped her seam on the first fitting and after requesting this be fixed and taken out to avoid it happening again... they only sewed up the seam... to be ripped again. And they tried to say it's fine just wear tan spanks... 
3. 5/6 of us are large girls. We had multiple fitting and still the day of the wedding 1 girl ripped her dress before the ceremony having her halter strap rip... 3 of us ripped the lining trying to sit down at the reception, not one bridesmaid was able to comfortably wear the dress for the whole reception. We actually had to have someone go get us all clothes because of how uncomfortable we were and how ripped the dresses were. Even the skinny girls dress was too big!  So after all those fitting they didn't manage to get one right. 

4. 5 of the 6 dresses wouldn't even zip all the way the day of the ceremony. 

5. My dress showed up covered in glitter because she didn't bother bagging any of the dresses and mine was laid on top of a quinceñera dress. 

6. The one girl who is not in charge did her best to help remedy all of our problems, but is obviously unable, and the other girl who runs the show doesn't give a damn about you or your wants. 

My suspicion is that we asked them if they could get dresses in our sizes in time after we were screwed by alfred Angelo and instead of them turning us away they tried their best to stuff us into something to make a sale. Once again we were left feeling like because we wear sizes 16-26 we weren't able to be beautiful and have clothing made to fit us. Even the one girl who wasn't plus size had her dress made too big, so maybe our size isn't the problem. Now I'm left with a ripped dress, bruises from how tight the dress had to be on my ribs, and some serious anger toward how this business is run. I used to shop here all the time before the original sold it. Now it's been run into the ground. We would have been better off shopping on amazon.

I love their Island Bowl so much! Had a chance to enjoy a bowl while on a weekend getaway & since I've been back home, I can't stop thinking about it. Lol will definitely visit again when I'm in town or in LA (because I've already looked up all the locations lol)

I went here as a guest of a member on a Wednesday after work.  Despite the nice day, it was pretty dead.  Cocktails were $5 during happy hour, although most of them are usually $11.  Way overpriced if you want to hang out by the pool all day.  The locker room was really nice, the chairs were pretty comfy, and the pool was okay, just small.  Seems like it could be a great spot, but the management has come kinks to work through.

I give them a 5 because I DON'T KNOW HOW THEY COULD GET ANY BETTER.   Everything about the food was homemade.  I don't know for sure, but I think they must cook with butter because everything tastes that good.  The biscuits were fluffy, as were the pancakes.  I had an omelette that was stuffed full of the ingredients I ordered.   I have it on good authority that the eggs Benedict and grits are great.  Oh my God -  they will deep fry the home fries, a decedant choice, and they also have hash browns, biscuits and gravy, corned beef hash, well - an extensive breakfast menu.

What makes this restaurant stand out?  This is a southern breakfast place.  Beside the menu choices (it ain't Denny's folks and thank the heavens for that), the staff is so friendly.   I mean really friendly, not just "if I'm nice maybe my tip will be bigger" friendly.  The inside seating was a bit stuffy for my taste,  although almost every table was full, but they have an outside area that is nicely-fenced off and covered.  AND, even though they were busy and we were seated outside, we were not forgotten by the wait staff.  The service was prompt but not pushy.  The outside area is dog friendly too.

This is one of my new Sunday breakfast places!  Whoo hoo!
Great service and great food.  Stopped for brunch and had huevos rancheros. They were different but very good.  Portions were generous. Service was very good.

I feel like I have to consider location when I write some reviews. It's Indianapolis. I don't even know of three Jamaican restaurants here. This one is probably the best that I've tried here. My favorite ever? Far from, but it scratches the itch. 

It's a tiny little place with no dining area, unless you would like to eat outside with all of the bees. Seriously, I've been attacked by lots of bees while waiting for my food. Aaaaaanyway, you might want to grab it to-go.  

The staff is very sweet. That's always beautiful. 

The last time I went, there were no veggies - only plantains and rice and peas. Fine, but womp. 

They do start to run out of things early, especially jerk chicken. If you want it, go early... or not long after lunch hours. 

Don't let the location scare you. It is attached to a hood liquor store, but the people who work there seem harmless. :)

Came to this place for the first time for lunch. Waited 30 minutes for 2 chicken quesadillas. Heard them call every number but ours. Finally  went up to the counter and asked the lady for our food. It wasn't made, our ticket was still in the printer along with a few others. Lady at the register had no hair net but was in and out of the kitchen area. Won't go to this place again.

Completed ahead of schedule (said it would take 3.5 hours, but took just 2.5) and done well - the house was cleaned better than the team at CheckMaid. I'm very happy and think I'll now be signing up for the monthly option, at the least.

I gotta give it three. First I have a sneaking suspicion that the same Asian family owns this and the restaurant next door....I could be wrong, but I doubt it. That place serves average american chinese. This place serves average Asian fusion...from a variety of off the shelf cook books.
There is nothing original here, not even the Stephen Starr inspired music. Its like they went to POD and tried to copy it...poorly.
You walk in to a chalk board in the vestibule. Take a picture of it because it is nowhere to be found inside. Look at the sushi counter. To the left is a few bits of shellfish on ice. I don't know if this is for show. The other two are filled with grocery store sushi makings. Why show off the kani? Is yours different? Homemade? Its krab stick from a box. 
We ordered the left side of the menu. I told the waiter that I hate cilantro. Over 50% of the dishes have cilantro in the description. Almost every dish came covered in cilantro microgreens. It is still cilantro! Btw this is a steal from Bluefin in East Norriton. 
They throw the food at you. Out of order and several at the same time. No sequence. No break. We got king crab croquettes, average with no noticable crab and wasabi crackers with spicy tuna. A hot app and a cold app at the same time. Before that was finished I got my soup put in front of me, a clam miso soup, with sandy inedibleclams. The broth was fabulous though.
Japanese cuisine does not rely upon cilantro. Chinese and vietnamese do. So we aren't japanese. Do what you do best.
Oh back to the menu. Its huge. Too huge. Cut it by 2/3. 
The sushi was very sweet. Too much mayo. Nothing really popped.
The tuna pizza sucked. Sweet. Too sweet. Unweildy to eat. 
What are you trying to be?! Habachi?! No habachi tables. Korean...there's galbi and gochujjang, but no real spice to anything. Japanese..nope.
I wouldn't go again.
Was in town for a seminar in Newtown. Went to Pines Tavern nearby my hotel for a beer and a bite. It is a cute, cozy, homey place. Great "Stop Short Rib" Sandwich. Good choice of beers.

I brought in my phone for a cracked screen. After waiting 2 hrs it was finally repaired- with a battery @1%. I then had to buy a charger as I did have a charger with me. However the phone was unable to charge and kept shutting itself off. I then had to return the next day and wait another 1/2 hr to have them tell me they had to give me a new phone.

First thing is the terrible musty odor in the rooms.  Figured it was just the fact that the room was empty for a while.  We ran the AC for most of the day on high. Still smelled. We requested another room. All the interior facing rooms were booked so they graciously gave us another exterior facing room.  Guess what same smell!
Housekeeping forgets to empty your garbage, hairs all over the floor. Sleep number beds don't work.   Exterior facing rooms are LOUD. From the traffic noises to the guests rolling their luggage.  Sounds like it's in the same room with you. One of the worst MOTELS  I've stayed in in years.  Many others to choose from.  Do your homework!!

This was one of my favorite spots in the city, every underrated. Until I went about a month ago, the menu change was not a great one, the chicken and waffles was my favorite item on the old menu it was sweet, savory, large portioned etc, but the new is very basic! Then the french toast has changed at well wasnt happy. Please bring back the old menu!!! The positive though, still a great atmosphere and great music.

Strange that anyone would want to try this joint... including myself. Going back would be just stupid. Really the worst doughnuts I've ever had - doughy, dry, and tasteless. I think they were at least a day old, and I bought them in the morning. Did I mention overpriced?

The food here is really good and authentic.  I live for the flame-broiled beef and lemongrass!  The service staff leaves a bit to be desired.  They take your order and drop your food off and that is it.  You have to go to the register if you need anything and to get your check and pay. The staff isn't rude, they just aren't all that friendly. The restaurant is connected to a 7-11 so the ambiance is pretty poor but they have at least decorated their section.  It's a small restaurant so it's pretty packed at lunchtime.
Very nice place to eat. Lots of parking.  Employees are outstanding.  Many TVs to watch.  Food comes out hot and very traitor.  Nice large bar.

Great value, outstanding food, large portions.

The Jambalaya was absolutely outstanding as well as many of the etouffee offerings.  The overall atmosphere was unique and quaint; the staff was extremely friendly and the service was quick with quality.

We both ate and were very full eating half meals and we walked out for $11.  The only down side is that they are cash only, but it did not detract at all from our experience.
This is a quaint restaurant with excellent service. We split the pumpkin pancake (very filling) on the specials menu which was very good. Very affordable! I highly recommend it for breakfast.

excellent food! fresh local ingredients, extremely flavorful and delicious! also very efficient with to go orders. They always check the receipt to make sure everything is in the bag that was ordered which is also greatly appreciated! and lastly, I enjoyed reading the words from Ron  that I picked up as I  was leaving about happiness and being happy, such a small personal touch that makes Ron's so wonderful!
Do not visit for the food.  It's very poor quality.  In addition they don't have many gluten free options either.  Our group enjoyed having cocktails on the rooftop and that's all I would recommend.

G i'm only getting two stars because I've been there in the past and the food has been good. I ordered do you pick to roast a turkey and cranberry flatbread with the autumn harvest squash soup... I don't know what happened to their thinly sliced roasted chicken breasts that were in all of their dishes?  This flatbread was full of inedible goop (I saw one cranberry) and the rest was white??  And the chicken was chunked with some very chewy - gross - pieces...and I would be lying if I said there were more than 4 pitiful "chunks" of chicken in it.  Soup tasted ok, but more of a purée than a bisque.  I won't be ordering any of that again.  At least not at this store.  I would give this meal 1 star...ick.
Service was great. Burgers were okay.  Not much on the order of onion rings.  Fries were the best part.

Warm friendly staff with a great atmosphere. the food was delicious and with the perfect portions. The pecan coffee was great too! Definitely recommend this place if you are looking for a light home cooked breakfast

Wow the pork chop was awesome and the scallops were cooked to perfection. Seriously those two items were awesome. Really is one of the best pork chops probably from anywhere. The duck egg rolls were good and the sauce is great.  Great stuff. The 201 drink was ok. Had some other drink that was too sweet and switched. Can't remember what it was. Still totally worth the price of scallops and chop.

What a remarkable gem in South Philly - and a perfect event space for the MANNA PA fist annual Guac-off.

Friendly staff at reception, clean restrooms, small kitchenette.

Good stuff!

You can even have a wedding here.

Solid three.  Food was totally OK, somewhat expensive.  It's a great, loud place where one should go to have a bachelorette party dinner, as many were doing when we were there.  Given what else I found in the area, it was somewhat over-expensive for what we got, but in part that has to be factored in with the real estate and location.  I wouldn't be a regular here, but I think it would be a good first evening dinner in New Orleans if one were "doing it up."

Richmond put a new roof and guttering on our home in 2014. Mostly non-english-speaking crew, but they did a great job. The problem was with the roof on our screened in porch in the back of the home.
