Take notice business world; this is how you gain loyal customers and get them to advertise for you for free.
Loved it! Can't wait to go back!!! The service was great, the food spectacular! Coffee, yes please!

I am done with this place. While the coffee is excellent, the barista's are total a-holes. Yesterday, I was next in line, and the barista bypassed me, and placed the order for the guy behind me that appeared to be a regular. Really? I was in shock. There was no apology, nor was there any eye contact when he finally took my order. The barista's were more interested in chatting with the regular folks than finishing up with my order. This is not the first time this has happened, and I am not returning. Total morons running this place. I don't care how good your coffee is. If you don't know how to treat customers, there is no need for me to give you my business.
My favorite place in NOLA. The sweet tea is awesome. The Jambalaya is great. The Crawfish is amazing. A must go if you're ever in Naw' leans.

My plane was delayed for 3hrs, and all I wanted was a slice of Meatball ricotta pizza. When I arrived with my posse of world travelers, Anthony's was closed FeelsBadMan but they insisted we wait a bit and they would hook us up. SeemsGood So we waited and with the most generous of helping we received our pizza's. One word. direGasm

I always make sure to eat local when traveling. Tried this place after a craving for sushi and reading the positive yelp reviews. Singapore did not disappoint. The Hot & Sour Lemongrass soup was outstanding. Had basic rolls, but all were excellent. Only minor complaint would be that the edamame appetizer bowl was a smaller portion than most places. Overall two thumbs up!

I am a Chai Tea Latte connoisseur and The Coffee Bar has a great one.  I love that it's organic and the price isn't bad because the quality it worth it.  It has just the right amount of spice.  I'm glad I found somewhere with good chai tea because Starbucks has become very dissapointing with theirs. 

I tried a chocolate cupcake here recently and it was very good.  I haven't sat down a nd spent any time but when time allows, I wouldn't mind. 

I don't get to this part of town often but will make it a regular stop when I am in the neighborhood.

Nice little casual taco spot by Garces! Hubby and I went on a Saturday night, and while busy, it wasn't super packed. Short wait for food. Between the two of us we tried 5 different kinds of tacos, which were all fantastic. The fish ones were definitely our favorite. Guac was good, albeit a bit pricy. Margaritas were awesome and it was a nice touch for a quick service place. All in all food was fantastic but deducted one star for value as we thought it was a tad pricy. Would definitely return though!

Maybe I just love any place that is a BYOB because when I am drinking as much wine as I want, I tend to have an enjoyable experience.

That being said, this place is great.  The servers were so kind and friendly.  The atmosphere is really nice, but it is tiny.  The spring rolls were pretty tasty.  My Pad See Ewe was delicious.  My friend got the Penang curry and his meal was on point.  I guess the only complaint is the fact that as others have said, I usually have a lot of leftovers when I eat at Thai restaurants, but this time I had none..but that could've been the wine inside me eating all of the delicious food.

I would definitely go back!

Reno needed Whole Foods, and Reno is now better for it.
Great location, fantastic hot bar!

Alexis made my day. She was so polite and I was having a bad day but she made it all better! The food is good too but I'll be back just for the customer service. She deserves a raise.

I had an everything bagel with plain cream cheese (INCREDIBLY delicious. I am way too happy over just a bagel - because it's not just a bagel).

Of 4 or so coffee shops on euclid (kaldis, Starbucks, coffee cartel) this is my favorite. It just has such a nice atmosphere. The room to the side is perfect. Today is a rainy day and hazelnut coffee just hits the spot.

Absolutely love this place - then again I'm a sucker for coffee shops. No idea why it has less than 4 stars. Easily a 5 star place for me (and I rate mostly on how much you get for your money/customer service/food quality)

A nice spot for BBQ. Busy, but plenty of open tables. Food came out under 10 minutes. Giving four stars because the server rolled his eyes when we asked him a question. Besides that, a good experience.

Great atmosphere. 2 servers were on it every step of the way. Shrimp and grits are probably the best I've ever had. Gumbo was spot on as well. Prix fixed option makes for reasonable pricing.  A couple of private rooms upstairs that look like they would be great for groups.
Food is ok.  Service is extremely slow.   Go when you are not hungry!   Actually don't ever come.

If you are within 50 miles of this place, it is worth the drive for a coffee & home made pastry!!! One of my favorite coffee shops & "patisseries" in the world  I swear if I glance outside, I can see the Seine...

I always get the salted caramel latte, the chocolate croissant & the Nutella & banana croissant  It is heaven!

Lately, when we come to Reno, we try to eat at this buffet at least once. We had dinner here this past Saturday with some friends and their huge entourage (there were 15 of us in total)! Was afraid they wouldn't be able to seat us but luckily there was a reservation for a group of 16 and they were late so we were given their 2 tables. EXCELLENT!!

Still, the line is insane during dinner. We once waited over an hour and a half before we were seated!

The very first time we ate here, everyone thought the food was great for a hotel buffet but since then, the quality seems to be going down. I remember when their prime rib was so juicy and tasty!! Now, it's dried out and blah. Their "famous mushroom raviolli" has been disappointing of late, with the raviolli sometimes undercooked. The fettucine with lobster & shrimp sauce was probably the best pasta dish and the clams in butter/wine sauce were pretty good. It was the weekend so they served raw oysters....yay!

But the best thing here? The fortune cookies!! I'm serious! Those fortune cookies are so good and we always grab extra to go :D They're awesome with gelato!!
Great place! Beautiful retro interior, delicious cocktails, ice cream martini, soups, and out of the world pesto chicken! Great for friends and family fun!

AMAZING! 
These donuts are so awesome. I like you can get fancier flavors but picky eaters can also enjoy them, they aren't too crazy.  I can not wait to try and the fried chicken, it smelled amazing and I keep hearing great stuff about it!

Yum! This place is delicious! We went on a Friday night just after happy hour so it was pretty busy and there was a shortage of seats but it was quick moving and everyone was speedy and helpful. The Al Pastor was super flavorful. There are free chips and salsa and the chips are always fresh. We had classic margaritas which were good but not memorable. The Frescas were also refreshing. Great place for a quick bite to eat and a laid back atmosphere.

So, if your a lover of books this is where you need to be! It is the heaven of book lover's it's called Haslams!!!! They have books that you don't find in your average bookstore like Walmart or BArnes and Noble or Books a Million. I mean they have books from back when. They have every genre, author, you can think of. I would love to get locked in here and just read every book they have because it's just an amazing selection and find. Yeah, there not the fanciest with a Starbucks in it's store, or selling decadent muffins but what there selling you just can't find anywhere else and that's what makes this a rare find. 

I have brought my kids here since they were small and now I'm bringing my grandson. I hope this bookstore lives on forever.

The tour was only a few minutes late picking me up, but understandable as it was a full bus with most couples coming from different hotels.  Our guide, Richard, was quite lovely and did a fantastic job sharing the culture of New Orleans during our hour long journey to the first plantation.  He had great insight into the culture and history of the area and had a very natural and humorous delivery.

He did a wonderful job setting up each plantation for each group before dropping us off.

Really not too many complaints.

I do wish we had a little more time at Oak Alley Plantation after the tour to take advantage of some of the other highlights of the property including the gift shop.  You get there a little early so my recommendation would be to explore the grounds and take pictures. Then zip by the gift shop on your way out.

LOCATION- Located in the French Market, N'awlins Cafe and Spice Emporium definitely catches the eye. They sell racks and racks of hot sauces and spices, but also have a booth-like "restaurant" with local, gamey food such as gator sausages and burgers. 

SERVICE- Sorry not sorry, but this is where the one star heavily comes in. Two Asians walk into N'awlins... and how does that joke finish? Oh wait, it wasn't a joke because it happened in real life. I'll tell you how it went down. A handful of other parties were served before us, so not only did we wait a long time to put our orders in, but it also took forever and a day for us to get our food! By the time we finished our food and paid, the market was literally closing and daylight was gone. 

FOOD- It was ok. Definitely a bit on the oiler side, especially the fries. I ordered the gator burger because they ran out of gator dogs (womp). I finished it all, but I think the variety of hot sauces available made it more exciting and yummy than it would have been plain. Couldn't really taste that it was gator, but the idea of it was cool, I guess. 

Wouldn't come back to this market to eat food. Service is too slow and the food does not justify the long wait. Maybe get spices here, but there is also a Pepper Palace next to the entrance of the market...

You know you can't really complain too much here, for $1.50 w/ student discount! I came here to watch Fast 6 and with the ticket price I wasn't expecting like a 5 star theater. If you don't mind too too much about quality and just want to see a movie for super cheap than this is the place for you. You still get a big screen to watch your movie and a movie theater atmosphere, but don't expect the cleanest/well run type of place. I'd continue to come here for cheap nights especially for movies that were not worth paying full price to see when they first come out.
Toad in the hole! Yummy! Limeade Yummy! Potatoes Latka Yummy! Waiter really friendly! Tomato soup Yummy!
been on multiple occasions and its always as good as before. The wait can get a little long but its honestly worth the wait

I found this shop on Yelp, after shattering my iPhone screen and discovering how much Apple would charge me to replace it. I briefly considered ordering a kit online, but am not an especially tech savvy person and decided it wasn't worth the headache. I went to iDope after work one afternoon, and was greeted by its very friendly staff. I gave them my phone, filled out a form, and was out the door with a brand new screen in under 10 minutes--for less than half of what Apple would have charged me to replace it! The screen is as good as new, but I realized after a week or two that I was having issues with the keypad not disappearing when I was on a call. Inadvertently, I kept hitting the mute button and other keys with my cheek. I googled it and learned that it was likely an issue with my proximity sensor, so I took it back to iDope and explained the situation. They opened it back up, repositioned the sensor slightly, put it back together, and I was on my way (free of charge). I highly recommend these guys to anyone looking for phone or tablet repair. They're super fast, super nice, and reasonably priced!
Problem was resolved at springhouse drive and we are happy with the results and service.

My husband and I stopped to try Big Q over the weekend. The fried chicken and biscuits are really good! The pulled pork was also very good. The sides left us wanting more though. They ran out if collard greens on a Saturday at 5pm, which was unfortunate. The Mac and cheese was eh. And the fries were run of the mill. The portions are small for the price, also. I'll give it some time, and try this place again in a few months.
This place is amazing! I had the Colorado burger? I think that what it was called, but it was amazing and I highly recommend this place to any Dunedin goers!
Food was good and the service was also good. Margaritas were definitely out of this world!! Didn't have a long wait either.

Don't judge a book by its cover! Street tacos served on the corner outside of a truck

Always fresh, awesome customer service and the fish and shrimp tacos (can be separate) are amazing. 

I spent some time in Mexico and have had street tacos while visiting in Mexico, this place is by far, the most authentic I've had in Tampa!

These guys are the best. I've done a surf school before and it was all a bit disorganized. These guys are well staffed, well prepared, great with kids and adults alike. They are super careful with the children, as well as enthusiastic and energetic. They have enough instructors to insure that everyone is well attended and no one feels ignored.
My party of 8 had a fabulous morning. We couldn't be happier.
Store owner very kind and helpful to pick out a wig due to chemo hair loss. Good prices. Parking free on weekends. Wish I didn't have to buy a wig but she tried to make it fun.

The juice bar is now open and they have added some additional cardio and weight equipment.  This includes a leg press/sled and a pec/delt fly machine that are very nice.  The only issue now is the temperature upstairs... What is going on with the A/C?  Overall a very good gym!

A good selection of burgers and sauces, the milkshakes are a MUST. Definitely wish I got a bigger size... The layout of the restaurant is pretty cool too. Only thing though is that it's a bit pricey for the portions they give. Worth checking out!

I tried out this place because of the rating on Yelp and everybody review about how wonderful this place is. It did not meet up to my expectation. The food was tasteless.  Nothing really "wowed" me. the Lamb and chicken was not seasoned to perfection..I expected the meats to be roasted/grilled or something and seasoned well. The only thing that was seasoned was the eggplant.
 You are charged about 35 dollar per person even though the meal is shared amongst your group of friends.
I could have went to another place and purchase good food half the price of what i paid at the Marrakesh. 
On the flip side staff was attentive and kind, belly dancer was really entertaining.

Decent but nothing special. If you're looking for a place to eat oysters and drink beer, come here for happy hour as Desire does have some good happy hour beer & oyster specials ($4 Abita drafts and $1 oysters if I'm not mistaken). There are many better tasting and cheaper options for food & drink outside of happy hour in the Quarter.
We went there for lunch last week and loved it!  Go once a year when we are in Tucson.  I had the steak fajitas and couldn't begin to eat it all.  Delicious!
Crossroad grill is awesome good food live band you have to check it out had a  good time!!!

This pizza was delicious! Just what the tastebuds ordered for s late evening snack! The order was here within  an hour and fresh.  The delivery service brought it right to my door, so I never got out of my pjs. My compliments to the chef!

I got all the remaining supplies to finish my chicken coop today.  All of their staff was very helpful and polite.  I also picked up some sprinkler heads I have been needing to replace.  They were very busy.  I will continue to shop at this location.

I was nervous this place wouldn't live up to it's high expectations, it did.  After moving here from the east coast 5 years ago  I've searched long and hard all over STL looking for a good deli.  I've finally found it.  My sister and I had the Redbird and the Vino.  We couldn't decide which one we liked better, the red pepper sauce is delicious! Not only was the food amazing, but the atmosphere was great as well.  The service was fast and upbeat. The owner even took time to stop by and thank us for coming in.  Overall, I couldn't have asked for a better experience.  I cannot wait to go back.
The food and drinks are awesome. Definitely ask for Andy when you visit. Best place in South Tampa.

Picturesque and cozy trattoria across the street from Stevens on State in the middle of Media's quaint and lovable downtown.  I like Media. 

Puppy friendly if you sit al fresco.  Really good and knowledgeable service.  I had the Insalata di frutti di mare. and it was huge.  And good.  No fishy smell, just goodness and lots of shrimp and calamari.  My partner had the Meatball panini with succulent Homemade potato chips. These were awesome.

Superb lunch and we'll be back.

I was invited for the soft opening for the restaurant over the weekend, so that needs to be taken into great consideration for this review.

The space: beautiful, clean, bright....very Dean & Deluca'esque. Everything is order at the counter(s) - salad bar, sandwich & soup bar, prepared foods bar and then an open air market throughout.
The prices: it's not cheap ($10+ for brunch entrees, mimosa carafe $22)
The service: Not fair to comment, since it was the soft opening...it was exactly where it should've been for a soft opening.
The food: errrrr, I had the B.E.L.T. and my counterpart had the chicken and waffle biscuit. I felt like I wanted more to mine (more egg? more arugula? more balance?) the best part was the toasted sourdough. The biscuit...It's huge - as in, big gulp huge. I regret saying, it was a bit dry and seemed to be more on display and less tasty, but I digress, how do you eat something that big anyways.

Grits were delish, but lacked any jalapeño spice and the potatoes were actually very good, crispy and all.
Another friend had flattering things to say about the breakfast burrito as well. It was all....good.

Also, to be clear, this was a soft opening, so I think there are always things to iron out, however, this is not their first rodeo. I don't think I would personally return (I'm cheap), however, the space itself is worth a look and if you need a brunch place in this area for parents or out-of-towners it is dressed to impress, I have no doubt they'll do well. 
I would imagine the night time wine bar is pretty nice as well - okay, I'd probably give another try for a special brunch or drink if I ever venture into Midtown.
Excellent service. Quick. Reasonably priced. Went out of their way to get me in the same day because of my busy schedule. Will definitely be taking my car there again.

We loved our spooky tour with Brian!! Very articulate well delivered stories which caught both our attention and adventure seeking personalities! A few good laughs too! Would highly recommend this tour for people who want to learn about the history, ghost stories, and interesting people that shaped New Orleans!

This is by far the best breakfast ever.  I'm a southern country boy and I attest that you'll fall in love with the food! I had the Georgia peach pancake, chocolate sin and strawberry pancake and I will be back to try the others! Totally worth the wait!

Stopped in this afternoon to check this place out. Had a baked pumpkin donut with butter cream frosting... WONDERFUL! Flat white was pretty good for a decaf to go with it (already had enough caffeine for the day). Looking forward to trying it for breakfast soon... quiche offerings and steel cut oatmeal all sounds good to me Small menu, but I think the idea is to limit the selections to do what they do well. Would not be surprised to see more offerings in the future. Staff was extremely nice to interact with too.
Since I came here in Tampa my husband never fails to visit Twistee every week. Aside from the wise variety of ice cream selection, service is also great

The service at this location is TERRIBLE. Twice in the last month, I have gone there for lunch and it took 25 minutes from the time I paid for my bowl until the time they called my name. Absolutely ridiculous. The other locations aren't like this. I really don't understand. They have such a good product but this location needs some serious help with their service.

Out of all the Panda Express chains I've been to, this one has got to be the freshest and most generous. They load their fried rice with veggies and their steamed veggies are fresh and not soggy.  Their meat entrees are also fresh and not as heavy on the oil.  After eating at PF Changs twice, I felt sick.  I can eat a 2 entree meal at Panda and not feel sick. Nice open eating area with lots of light, clean, and fast service. Bonus points for being next door to Jamba Juice!

I go to Villaggio Suits and see Lacie Carl as my nail tech.  She is great at what she does and has been being it forever.  I never have a problem with her canceling on me she is always there.  I also never have a problem with my nails she gives me what I pay for.  She is not just a nail lady she is also a friend to her clients.

Never disappoints. They have a rotating menu/options that change a lot but they always have the classics. I switch it up every time I go because all of it is good. I always ask for extra bread and if I take it to go I toast it a little longer because it can get soggy.

The room was beautiful this time, I mean breathtaking. However when we went to open the sofa bed for my girls, the mattress was filthy with nail cuttings, stains, food bits, and dots that looked to me like bed bugs. The shower floor was filthy too and needs and update. I always stay here when in NOLA. It's a shame this time because the room seemed so pretty. All four of us had to sleep in the same bed.
AC didn't work either or control in bedroom. Room 429. Unbelievable

My husband and I went to lunch here last week on his day off. I wish now we had went somewhere else. The drinks we got were horrible ( raspberry lemonade) and we told our waitress we both needed some water and she brought out one glass. Seriously?? I know there is a drought but that is terrible service. The food we ordered wasn't even edible. The salad bar was out of chicken wings...my husband and i gave up trying to eat and just went home. That was a waste of 40 dollars we will never see again.

Food is 4/5 but the service and the atmosphere can improve. You can definitely tell that it's a family-ran restaurant. If you don't mind the service as much as you care about the food, this is a good place for a tasty meal.

This place has everything that the famous Cafe du Monde in the French Quarter has except the charm. The beignets are just as good as is the coffee and other drinks you may want. I usually go for the frozen Cafe au Lait, which is great at both places. 

As I said, the only thing missing is the charm and history of the original place in the French Quarter. With that being said, this place is easier to get to if you are not in the Quarter and out and about on Veterans Blvd.

New traditional Mexican food from Ventura. We used to live on Ventura ave where the original one is and it was our favorite and we were SO sad to leave it when we moved to SB. This new location has changed our lives!!

The al Pastor meat is to die for and the tacos are amazing. They have such good tortas (cubana) and Alambres (plates with tortillas on the side). The price is right on and the salsa bar is so good. 

The owners are the nicest people and they made a big leap coming up here so support them and their amazing food!!

Pulled up at drive thru at 4:57 am and Waited till 5 and was greeted by employee,who stated that they open at 5am when I explained that it was 5am she advised me that she goes by the store clock and they would be ready in 10 minutes...... REALLY wake up corporate this is not acceptable

Easily and without a doubt my favorite food is pizza. Bury me with it. New Orleans is trying to get up in the pizza game and it's about time; we are way behind. Yes we have Pizza D and yes there's Mid City Pizza, Slice and let's not forget Theo's. However where each of those places excel in ingredients and tastiness, it's hard to find an excellent pie that is relative in price to the cost of what it takes to make each one. Blaze has that component down packed and for that, they're getting my #1 best pizza spot in Nola...for now. 

You can get a nice sized pie for under $10 with however many toppings you want in any combination. It's like the Subway of pizza but I dare not put Blaze's quality on Subway's level. Nestled in a newer, edgier sector of downtown it's got that modern touch to its interior. You can choose from their specialty pizzas or build your own. Since it was my first time I went with a specialty as I didn't want the pressure of building something I'd regret.

I went with the Meat Eater, pause. Came out super quick, the only setback I had about it was when asked if I wanted a sauce as a topping, I went with the bbq which it was good, however I don't think I would have wanted it swirled over my whole pie. I should've asked if I could get some on the side. Wasn't expecting to commit my entire pizza to that, but hey, ya live n ya learn. 

Super friendly and attentive staff, I also appreciated that the guy running the place went around and asked people if they were happy with their orders. A little bit goes a long way in hospitality with me. I'd definitely drop in here if I were you needing a downtown fix for a good pizza.

Giving bad review because we were so excited to come here. Planned to come at 5 on Saturday and when we arrived, they said that they close at 5. Change your website hours dude!! We left with very very sad faces and unsatisfied tummys

First time here and I'm a fan. I believe Pancheros opened recently. I like how it's located right across the street from some prime shopping spots, Nordstrom Rack and The Container Store.  I ordered the steak burrito with hot and corn salsa, black beans, white rice, shredded cheese, and oooo diced jalapenos. While the flavors were very reminiscent of Qdoba, which is not a bad thing, it's the service that really sets this place apart. From the first person taking my order to the last person ringing me up on the register, they were all very professional and polite. Also, I was warmly greeted by whom I presume to the owner/manager. I sat munching away and during my meal the same gentleman stopped by every table to check on us and I even noticed him taking away another table's trays. Oh, forgot to mention the burritos are served on a warmed metal tray which was a nice touch especially since it took me a while to eat. I will definitely be back.

This place evokes all sorts of feelings and memories for me. I hadn't been back, until recently, since I was a tween. I have fond memories of splitting the killer cookie for two with my Dad and of having my mom drop me and a few girlfriends off here for a very grown-up style restaurant birthday party. We weren't rich, but this place was definitely within our price range. 

I recently dragged my husband here to see if it was even still open and to grab dinner one late Saturday eve. I remembered the food to be of the TGI Friday's variety - same price and a little bit better quality. It was still open and we easily found a table at the mildly packed restaurant at 8pm on a Saturday. 

I'd say that the menu has changed drastically. Along with the burger and salad fare I remember, they've added a number of more upscale entrees, numerous pizzas, some more intriguing salads, and a slew of beer choices. I ordered the quiche of the day with a side salad for my meal. The quiche had asparagus, ham and the slightest bit of swiss cheese all in a scrumptious pastry shell. I asked for the caeser salad on the side, and it was nice but the dressing was a little bland. I also asked for a glass of Pinot Grigio which was relatively inexpensive, but it took way too long for my drink to arrive. My husband got his soup before we got any of our drinks, and I do consider that to be a faux pas. 

We had to order the killer cookie for two. Basically, that was why I decided to go to Gullifty's that night, to begin with. It was better than I remembered. A very warm, freshly baked, thick chocolate chip & walnut cookie covered with a wonderful homemade vanilla ice cream and served with a drizzle of hot fudge. We cleaned the bowl.

FYI, looks like they stay open pretty late; even until 1am on the weekends. Good to know because this can be hard to find in the burbs!

Dropped in Cheu on a Sunday afternoon and had no wait.  Enjoyed the Mojo Pork Dumplings while they prepared our ramen bowls.  The dumplings were outstanding.  The Miso Ramen and Brisket Ramen bowls we had were very good - rich in flavor, spiced just right, unique sauces.  Cheu is a funky place with a young, cozy vibe.  If I lived in downtown Philly, Cheu would be a weekly visit.

How do you mess up an It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia bar? Doesn't look like Paddy's Pub at all, and just has a few token photos of the cast on the wall. Are you kidding me? One of the saddest fan experiences I've ever had. What a scam! Rob McElhenney should be ashamed of himself.

This is probably the coolest thing you'll ever see in a lobby.  I really love that if you come at the right time, it just looks like a regular wall.  

All of the sudden, a guy drops down in a trapeze!  What are you doing, man??  Where did you come from?  He and a few friends will swing around for a while before the entire wall changes to a waterfall.  

The resolution and size of this wall are truly impressive.  It's free, and it's a great place to swing by if you're in Center City.  I've seen it a few times and still think it's impressive.
Pleasantly surprised by the portions served here. The french toast wasn't as fluffy as it looked but overall I would definitely return if I had the choice.

Ultra clean rooms, a little upscale than most casino's in Reno, or anywhere for that matter. I always get my rooms comped. Try to stay in the Tuscany Suite rooms if possible, they're new and beautiful and only a little more than a regular room, which by the way, is very clean and nice as well.
Love their burgers, chicken sandwiches, fries, shakes, ice cream, chicken caesar salads, chili, and everything else on the menu is amazing!!!  Fun, fun, takeout!

Went here today for the first time and ordered two different cupcakes.  There were many to chose from as well as homemade truffles, gelato, cakes, etc.  our cupcakes were very good but a bit to sweet for my taste. The atmosphere is comfortable and there are places to sit and relax while having coffee and a sweet treat.  The cake video running while we were eating was very intriguing to watch.  I would definitely go back but maybe this time try something other than a cupcake.
Great pizza. Stopped here on our way to Harrisburg. It's worth the extra driving time.
Very friendly atmosphere and excellent food and service. The Claude sandwich is my favorite.

Went there yesterday with a friend for the first time after hearing my daughter rave about this place. Rich wonderfully roasted coffee and really great service. Server very happy to be there and smiling. Owner also there and said sincerely they enjoyed having us and to come back. I'll definitely be back

Standard Hampton.

Decent bed, a choice of pillows.  Room was pretty standard, but it did not have a fridge.  

Internet horrible.  I really wish Hotels would get better internet in this day and age!

I hate to be this guy but I'm pissed. I'm almost 30 years old and I've never written a negative review on a restaurant. Tonight, I was running errands after work and hadn't had a chance to eat since breakfast. I attempted to call to place a pick-up order several times but got a busy signal. After the 5th time it finally rang once and was answered "please hold". Silence. Now it's a Friday night so I assume they are busy. No big deal right? While on hold, I went into Petco, got dog food, then got gas and realized I was still on hold. 15 minutes. So I hang up and try to call back, busy signal. So I say screw it and drive there. I walk up to the bar and they aren't busy at all 3 4tops and a 3 top with 3 servers, a runner and a bartender. So I see the phone sitting on the bar and call while standing there. Busy signal. The server- Thuy, asks me if she can help me. Now I know from being in the industry that being an asshole isn't going to get me anywhere but they should be aware of the issue because they are losing business. So I explain to her what I just told you and continue to tell her that this is the third time in two weeks that it has happened. Her response was "okay well I don't know where the phone is, do you want me to take your order?" As if she could care less that the phone may be off the hook. I bit my lip and ordered. A few minutes later, I see the bartender, grab the phone without looking, press the end button and set it back down. After he put me on hold, he purposely took the phone off the hook. I began to boil but kept my mouth shut. This place is a block away and the food is decent so my fiancé and I go almost every week. But not after tonight. Instead we will go to Bahn Mi. I hope the owner sees this so they get their ish together.

Leased a Nissan Rogue from them today. Overall, everyone was very friendly. My salesman Todd was helpful and showed me all the details of the car. I expressed my concern with time on signing contracts and he did everything to speed the process along.

As far as dealerships go, no problems here. Make sure you read your paperwork when you get home, you have 24 hours to review any agreement. 

I haven't had any experience with their service department yet but will update the review when I do.

The space is huge and inviting with reasonably comfy tables and chairs; a nice upgrade from the Truckee shop. Lots of nice decorative details too, like the mosaic lion on the wall. It looks like they're still landscaping out back which should be a nice outdoor space in the spring. I shared a latte with the wife and thought it was great and fresh. Kids hot chocolate for the kid was tasty enough. 

The big ding was for a $6.75 calzone (made next door,I believe) that they reheated on the panini press. While the filling was tasty enough, the reheating seared and slightly warmed a  chewy, stale crust. This awful texture voided anything good going inside the thing. While the pre-assembled sandwiches seem to hold up to the refrigeration and reheating, I would highly recommend coffeebar nix the reheated calzone idea; it just doesn't work.
Just had a very delicious breakfast watching multiple football games at the same time.  Great service, awesome bar, amazing good! We will be back!
Had a business meeting here this afternoon. Had the quesadillas they were amazing. Service was awesome and spot on. Definitely will be back to try more.

We just ate a chocolate chip serious cookie. It was delicious five bucks but well worth it considering feeds four people easily.  Man behind the counter was extremely courteous and friendly not sure what all the negative reviews are about him. Chocolate chip cookie was chewy and not crunchy best described as perfect.

First off the place is gorgeous and nice to look at. They are not used to hosting people for one thing and second they put add a tip and then they tax the tip as well. WTF is that. I will not be going here again.

Hellas is hella good. I've eaten here several times when visiting my parents who live nearby. The gyro is good, I tried the Greek-style scallops which were amazing. The sauce was a red onion/tomato-y buttery sauce and was delicious. We've always had good service and the only time we didn't stop here for lunch while we were in Tarpon Springs was because the wait was too long. Also, stop by their bakery and get some baklava and cannolis! Definitely recommend this place

We have been using this place as out address for over a year.  The  staff is friendly and the price is right for a private mailbox that includes a unique address just for the renter.  I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a private mailbox.

We wanted to listen to some music and have some beers on a Sunday night. TT was the perfect venue.  We only had beers so we can't speak to the food . But we had a really great time listening to an exceptional lineup of Blues artists for the Sunday night Jam.  There was no cover so we spent more money on the drinks and we had a great time.
Was really cool to see the crowd up and dancing too.
We will be back.

This is the best place in St. Louis to get a beer, or two. The beers change with the season so they always have what you are looking for as well as reliable favorites. 
If you are visiting St. Louis come here.

God almighty, the level of service at this location is unparalleled... Unparalleled bad. I walked in with 15 minutes to spare before closing. I was placed in their "queue" system to be helped. No one attended to me except for the guy who put me in their "queue". I left after 40 minutes since I figured at that point, there would be no hope for an adequate outcome. Also, I was really annoyed at the signs they had at each counter: green smiley face ("Very Satisfied"), red frowny face ("Satisfied"). Can't I be just satisfied? What if I were completely dissatisfied? Double red angry face? Because that's what I felt like when I walked outta there today.

4 stars for the beer - I tried their IPA and their Raspberry Ale. Both were good, but I had a hard time finishing the raspberry, it was very sweet. I would order the IPA again. I wanted something lighter, so I had a cup of chicken tortilla soup and a 1/2 of the Althea sandwich. The soup was very salty (and I like salt) - wasn't my thing. I only had a couple of bites. The sandwich was good, definitely fit the mood I was in. I'd go back for the beer for sure for happy hour and head somewhere else for dinner. the atmosphere was great.

I have been using Lindsey E as my stylist for about 10 years now (That makes Lindsey and I sound ancient and we aren't even that old! Ha!). She does an amazing job. She is incredibly seasoned and artistic so she can transform anyone. I've tried many different stylists over the years and no one is as good as Lindsey. Her salon is very big yet you feel cozy in it. The salon is pretty hip and they have some good deals on products! Lindsey has a wonderful personality, you never run out of things to talk to with her so time always flies by.

Really impressed with the service and honesty of Reno Vulcanizing! It's not always easy to find reliable auto service. I thought I needed front and back struts and came to find out I only needed front struts.

It's cozy sitting outside and it is located at a nice plaza. They have very limited menu. I ordered the farm omelette and it's just fine, but the coffee was really good, somehow it had some kind of flower flavor to it.

So friendly!! Doesn't have the toxic acrylic smell of other nail salons. Great detail with manicures. I have had two gel manicures and they were both flawless. It's a beautiful salon with a great staff.

I just spent $25.00 for three COLD carne asada burritos!They charged me $1.20 extra for sour cream per burrito. I tried calling the phone number listed; to let them know how disappointing it is to have to eat a cold burrito, but it's not a working number.

Hoping for a quick dinner, I missed the turn for McDonalds due to congestion, and took the next turn. There on the left was an attractive diversion. Finally found a parking spot and went into a nicely designed restaurant - see through fireplace and all.  Ordered the Smoke House Chicken (did someone say grilled onions and mushrooms?), then was warned it would take 15 minutes. A bit longer than I would like, but thought it would be okay. It was MORE than okay! The wait was a bit longer, I think, but well worth it! The entree and the sides were delicious. I'm sure I'll be back the next time I'm in town (maybe on this visit again).  :)
Probably the best kept secret restaurant in Florissant. It can compete with the top restaurants in St. Louis. Wonderful staff.

Not bad at all. I've gotten my eyelashes done here several times and every time they've looked great! They do really cool decisions and the pedicures are good as well. I tried my first 3D Flower nail designs here and they came out so cuteee. The only reason why I gave a 4/5 is because the time before last I went, they rushed through my pedicure and I had an inconsistent paint application which has never happened to me before here. I paid, walked out and walked right back in after I seen outside in the light and their response was to come back tomorrow because it was 7:05 and they close at 7.

Loved this place, biscuits, omlettes, waffles, very, very good!!   Service was great, and a nice atmosphere.  Took home a brownie, it was just wonderful....This may sound odd, but the bathroom was so cute, and clean to.
  A great place to bring guests, all the food was well prepared any nicely done...My one bit of advice, put on a more relaxing music station, as it was a bit loud and more for the teenie bopper crowd....Ah, but then nothing is perfect....but this place is close:)

Had an amazing private event here!! The staff was awesome (Taylor, Tom and Christina), the wine is excellent and the view can't be beat. 

We would recommend for a private event or for wine tasting! One of the best views in SB, it won't disappoint. 

Thanks so much Deep Sea!! We'll be back :)

I have been here a few times, but most recently the other night. Went with a party of 7 for a friends birthday. The food was delicious and the service was excellent. We had Noel and she was awesome! Ask for her. The place is a bit cramped, but the food and service made up for that.

Great dessert spot!  Very cool location and design, excellent desserts.  Parking is street only and can be a little crowded.  I don't believe they take reservations and I've had to wait every time I go.  I've never a meal there, but I assume it's great. Definitely worth going to and the waits aren't that bad.

Came for drinks and an appetizer and was not disappointed at all. The best roasted Brussel sprouts ever. Sat next to a local and had a great conversation.  We will be back in the future to have dinner next time.

I am so pleased we decided to stay here two nights as part of our 4 week cross-country-and-back vacation. The service was consistently amazing. Every single employee was friendly and professional, from the servers in the restaurants, to the bell hops, to management. They must have a great training program. 
In addition, the food was great! We had a wonderful buffet breakfast in the Grille one morning. The fresh blueberries and watermelon were a welcome treat. We also got a great breakfast in Suite 3000, which is available when you upgrade and well worth the cost. Fresh blackberries, raspberries, blueberries and strawberries were wonderful!
The best part about the hotel is the amazing Grand Lobby. Even if you don't stay here, visit at night, get a cocktail and watch the light show which plays to music on the massive ornate ceiling. I preferred this to Disneyland's water/light show and this one is free.

Food was good but pricey for what you received. Decor was not impressive, and men usually aren't that observant. No soft drinks were available as a drink choice for those who didn't want ice tea or lemonade or something distilled. Parking was abysmal in front; only 15 spaces available by the building - not well thought out if someone needs handicap parking. With Louie's Basque Corner next door, that makes for a big lunch crowd all looking for a spot. One of the members of our group had to park 2 1/2 blocks away because all the parking areas were full, not a good option for a not-so-good neighborhood. Doubtful we will go back.

This is still my all time favorite Mexican restaurant!  Just wish it was closer to home! Best chips and salsa...the chips are so light and crunchy! 
Several menu items I've never seen offered at any other Mexican restaurants. Very nice decor and atmosphere. Again everything was delicious! ! The only down side to this years visit was our favorite waitress wasn't there.

Lauri is an incredible sitter and in tune to catering to your pet's every need. She watched our dog while we got married and throughout the day I could rest assured that he was having fun because she sent a few pics of him playing in her yard and house. You can be confident that she's a professional and will take the upmost care of your pet. I will ABSOLUTELY use her services and recommend you give her a try too!!!

This hole in the wall blew me away. A subterranean dive, be careful as you descend the steep steps into this Afghani spot. It doesn't look like much when you walk in (fast-food like), but it's dark, comfy, and kitchy in the back. where the small dining room has waterfalls, some Christmas lights, and statues--a bit of decor to enhance what will likely be a tasty experience. We got the fried potato pancake app which was served with delish yogurt sauce. For $2,50, you can't beat it. Then I had chicken kabobs. Sounds uninteresting but they were the most tender and well-seasoned kabobs ever. They came on a large plate of well-seasoned jasmine rice, and were accompanied by a few roasted veggies. It also came with a salad with something like ranch dressing. And they brought crusty bread and a spicy dip of some sort. This was all $11! My friend had the lamb which was the best lamb ever. It's also BYO (but there's a corkage fee) so it's an amazing deal. Can't wait to go back!

The stuffed mushroom appetizer and the pomegranate iced tea was good, however, now the bad,  my wife ordered the Mahi Mahi (grilled) sandwich, half way through eating it she noticed blood and raw fish, when we advised our server about it she apologized and took it to get a new one, while we were waiting for the new one to arrive the manager came over and advised that it was a 'blood line' which is normal in this type of fish!!?? The new piece of fish was cooked better (and no blood line!!).

I ordered the fish and chips, the fish was good firm white fish, however, the chips were terrible.. they looked like and tasted like double fried fries, some of them weren't even cooked totally, when I brought this to the managers attention when he was at our table he seemed flippant about it.

We noticed that all the tables were given bread when they arrived, when I asked the server about it I was advised that you don't get it unless you ask (funny, they were putting bread on tables before a party of 10 arrived to be seated)... I wish I hadn't asked for the bread, all I can say is that I found it weird, more like pound cake!.

First,  I very much enjoy the vallet parking service at this place, especially on a rainy day! After living in the area for some good 10 years,  finally decided try this upscale place through a friend's recommendation. Place seems very upscale, and I was very intimdiated by their enormous menu selection. I'm typically not a fan of  large menu selections since most of then often are "jacks of all trade and master of none."

However,  I was wrong. Deadly wrong. I asked the waitress for her recommendation and she suggested the Asian Short Ribs Tacos, not sure she recommended that because she saw I was Asian but whatever reason, it was be far the best choice selection ever. It had a rich spicy flavor and the beef was some nice beef, no fat at all. My friend ordered their signature hamburger (I could remember the name, but it was the first choice under the burger section). The meat was cooked perfectly,  not too over cooked and it was still juicy. I took a bite of that burger and ended grinding through half of it. It was on point. 

Their price may seem a bit in the upper end however the quality reflects it. Our waitresss was a sweetie. Very friendly and attentive. This would make a perfect date spot if you want some quietness and an environment to enjoy delicious food while carrying a legit rom talk on a date night. 

P.S. be sure to try their coffee + cheesecake as well. You won't regret that! My compliment to the chef...everything is delicious!

After several grooming appointments for my great dane, I've found most of the staff unfriendly and the appointments taking way longer than they had said (one time by 3 hours).  I've decided to look for a better experience somewhere else!

Cockroaches, fights, naked kids and Ghetto. First time at this Walmart you notice a huge sign that says "no stealing or you will be prosecuted" as if we have to be told that a 5 finger discount is not accepted here. First time at night a black women had a fight with a security guard in the parking lot because she felt the items she stole were hers, she actually left the store with the items and the security guard wrestled her to the ground then the cops came. Then at midnight white trailer park trash mom brings in shirtless shoeless 5 year old boy while she looks for Flat screen TV's. Then this lady was fighting with the cashier because her food stamps card did not scan he wanted to speak to the manager this took 20 minutes' then I notices the carts of clothes in front of the store that reminded me of Tijuana Mexico of the flea markets of used and torn clothing of a low end good will. This store is just straight up Ghetto it is like a good will that sells food. I rather pay slightly more and go to Target at least I don't have to wait in 30 minute line or the self express line in Walmart where someone is always trying to steal and needs assistance. Fuck this Ghetto Ass Walmart and the Cockroaches that came out of the Oranges.

Nice small place to eat, they very good bibimbap with awesome bulgogi and chicken teriyaki also taste really good, and their avocado salad dressing is also good. Gonna come back to try different menu and the place is nice and also clean and the service is fast.
I absolutely love this place make it a point to visit every time I go to Tucson. Their tacos are fresh and homemade corn tortillas make it a homerun. Definitely worthwhile to visit

We didn't even attempt to eat there since the wait for a table for two was 45 minutes. The hostess was super nice and we got takeout and took it back to our hotel. The food itself was pretty average, we had panang curry with beef, shrimp fried rice, and a drunken noodle dish. I wouldn't say it was bland, but certainly not as flavorful as Thai should be. A bit overrated, but maybe it is the best in SB.
Great bar close to campus with amazing food. Lunch specials are amazing, especially Tuesdays when it's buy one food get one free. The wraps are delish and the taco salad mmmm.
We've used Mitch for the last 2+ years now and he does a great job every time. We won't use anyone else and I refer His Concepts to all my friends.

I don't live in Nashville any more, but do travel here for business. When possible, I make the trip to Kien Gang. Since I've eaten their bun bowls (my current favorite is #3, pork and egg rolls), I use them as the standard for what I want in a Vietnamese restaurant.

Also not to be missed is their fresh lemonade, and their French roast coffee, which you can order to drip into a puddle of sweetened condensed milk. Delicious by itself or over ice. 

They do close for several weeks in the summer while the owner goes to Vietnam, so get your fix in now!

After not being an Old Navy shopper for a few years a friend talked me into going to their Black Friday sale.....I HAVE NO REGRETS!!! The deals, the selection, the variety of ages/gender and the staff at this specific location have completely won me over . 

We arrived ready to shop early and thank goodness we did as the lineups during the day and crowds can be more than a little daunting. Our timeframe before filling our arms was only minutes. Not only did I buy for most people in my family I picked up a new fitness outfit for myself (and I am kinda fussy about those). 

Once at the till the staff was friendly helpful and made me feel like I could t wait to come back!! Which I did just a few days later to exchange a size and check on a receipt issue. The manager was SO AMAZING as she not only solved the issue by going above and beyond....she let me shop until the problem could be solved and then came out to find me. I LOVE that type of attitude in the manager level as it means the staff aren't pressured to be strict and relentless in their style either. 

Looking forward to wrapping up some stocking stuffers and Boxing Day sales here now.

After being talked into the AT&T Digital Life system last year, at this location, I came back in in May 2016 to cancel the service as we had to move.  I was told that the service would be cancelled on my closing date.  Yesterday (July 2016) I received a bill with a late payment and called AT&T today.  After an hour and a half I am still trying to get the bill corrected and the account canceled.  This is a huge waste of time with the process being more important than customer service.  I have been with AT&T for 15+ years.  This type of service makes me want to look elsewhere.
I have been to this place two times and it was okay.  For a local spot, it's pretty decent...the drinks are questionable...but try the organic sockie.

Heather from Vitality acupuncture is a super kind, very personable acupuncturist.  She is flexible in her treatments and also in her scheduling; always helping me find a way to get in and get what I need.

She is very knowledgeable in her profession and works well with a wide clientele.  Before I saw her I was terrified of needles, yet she has helped me find a way to experience the amazing benefits of acupuncture.

She is really helpful and I appreciate that she remembered me and my needs and goals from visit to visit; I didn't have to repeat everything when I saw her.

Totally recommended!

My daughter and i came here last night and had a very enjoyable dinner. We sat on the patio and though it was busy, our wait time wasn't bad, and our waitress made sure to stop by a few times to check in with us.

We started with the fried green tomatoes with a horseradish cream sauce. These were very well prepared; piping hot with a crunchy batter. Neither greasy nor burnt. I had the shrimp and grits and it was very good. Just a touch of heat, very smooth, and at least eight medium-sized shrimp. The gravy was a bit oily/greasy but that is to be expected, based on the dish. I would have preferred a little more grits to soak up the sauce, but in all it was nice.

For desert we shared the flash-fried wonton-wrapped chocolate chip cookie dough. Very rich and heavy! I am not a big fan of sweets or deserts, but my spoon kept slipping back into the dish. They served it with ice cream which provided another texture and cooled the wonton a bit. If you are a fan of any one ingredient listed in this desert, you really ought to try it.

I can't give you a specific reason for less than five stars; there is no one reason. It is a nice, slightly trendy, restaurant that caters to the Vanderbilt students. Now I am scratching my head so there is this. The road is very heavily traveled and it often takes 10 minutes or more to move the few blocks before and after Jackson's. Certainly NOT the restaurant's fault, but it does impact dining experiences.
The best service you can get for your BMW or Mercedes. They are the most honest and fairest priced around! I will not go anywhere else!
This place is great!! The people are nice and the food is great! Shrimp and mix veg or chicken and broccoli! And the Wonton soup is not Mushy! I hate mushy soup! Ten Stars! Try it!!

I had high expectations for this place when I stopped in for lunch with co-workers this afternoon. Guess I shouldn't have psyched myself up for it so much... 

Food was 3/5 - mediocre. Nothing really special. Expected a TON of Cuban flavor and deliciousness..annnnd, well, I've had better Cuban sandwiches at Creation Cafe. The plantains were interesting, though nothing to rave about in my opinion. 

Service was fine. No real rating needed here. Not much of an issue. I didn't go without water, and our server was friendly and attentive, however, that didn't really make a difference when it came to the food. 

Atmosphere, well, it's really a "hole-in-the-wall" type place. The UPS office is right next door and if you've ever been inside that, that's nearly the exact same size as the restaurant. Careful if you're claustrophobic. Also, there was a strange music video/cartoon mix thing playing on the TV behind us. Maybe it's a cultural thing. But eh..

Overall, I probably won't be back.

Absolutely amazing service. They were so helpful with the menu and more than patient with us as we were catching up with friends and couldn't decide what to get! The food was amazing and the drinks are delicious. Can't wait to go back! :)

Avoid the very expensive margaritas that would you believe have very and I mean very little alcohol in them.  The name of this place doesn't say it all, and the employees all looked angry.  Not a good experience...

Came here on a slow Wednesday night, but the place filled up fast.  I ordered sushi rolls and we had udon soup and salad.  I would say the sushi was slightly above average--nothing spectacular.  The udon was small for the price, but was pretty good.  I don't understand the wild raves about this place, but maybe I ordered the wrong thing.  It's an average sushi spot, as far as I can tell.

I found this listing on Yelp (on my iPhone) after a photo shoot outside of Philly. So I decided to stop here with my assistant before driving back to NYC. That was the best decision! The food was Amazing! That said, it was a little pricier than I would have liked, but worth every penny. 

The only reason that I give this 4 stars and not 5 is that I have only eaten there one time and I think I will reserve 5 stars for those absolutely amazing WOW meals (that usually cost way too much money, but each bite is a symphony on your tongue)

Tried it because we have tried all the other chains in the area. Nothing new here. The service was horrible , food was ok. Typical for this area. When your competing against other average chain restaurants your standards don't have to be all that high. They met the minimum. Not much higher.
Good. Not exceptional.  Large serving...almost too much.  Friendly service and quick.

This is strictly for the Hotel. Tuscany tower to be exact. 

Pepper mill has great suites. We booked our stay through Expedia and picked out a room with two king beds (children traveling with us) and when we arrived at check out they nice gentleman ran down the list of amenities. It had only one bed. I let him know that we needed two beds as we had booked and a nice soaking tub for my wife. 

He upgraded us to a kings suite and it was amazing. Customer service is on point and he made sure we had everything we needed. 

The room is very large and clean. Two massive king size beds with benches at the end. Clean bedding and amazing bathrooms. Huge soaking tub big enough for two. Great walk in shower big enough for two. Dual vanities and nice tiles floors. Spa like feel.

Beds were soft and comfortable. Pillows with silk like pillow cases were a nice touch. Very warm blankets and duvets. 

I can go on and on. But this is getting long as is. 

Everything was great.
shittest hookah in americaaaaaaaaaa do not go it is ass. the guy is a asshole and they only take cash and it sucks so bad

Before I start my review I had to laugh at the yelper who was bugged this restaurant did not serve their tacos with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, and sour cream.   Obviously they have no idea that authentic tacos come with two corn tortillas, the protein, diced white onions, and cilantro.  Lol.  Moving on.....

As I loosen my belt after enjoying my to go meal from this spot. I happily give five stars.  Apologies in advance for no photos - I started eating standing up and forgot about photos before half the meal was gone.  I ordered a chorizo burrito and al pastor taco to go.   The burrito was huge and filled with savory chorizo, refried beans, rice, and topped with a scattering of tomato and a few strands of lettuce.  I opted for the spicy sauce on top. I think there was cheese sauce on there too.  It was great. Very flavorful. The rice and beans inside were a great addition. Being inside they mixed with the chorizo juices and were very good.  The taco was as I mentioned.  True to form, the al pastor had pineapple chunks in there too. Three of these alone would be a great meal in and of themselves.   I did not get to sample the guacamole or chips.  I'll be back however to dine in and I am expecting good eats.  

Very pleased. Service was quick, prices were decent, and the place was vibrant. Don't come expecting Taco Bell food and you'll be pleased.

My Wife and I spent a few days here for our 1 year Wedding Anniversary. We had a really nice time. The room was comfortable and remodeled. Dan the Manager was really helpful with local knowledge. Very close to Stearns Wharf and State street. Highly recommended for the price. Good value. Check out Brophy Bros. Seafood down the street...

Been coming here for a while now and should have written my raves long ago.  It really is a nice quiet place for my business meetings where we can enjoy a nice wine (great selection since you get it at RR) and a bowl of shellfish.  Staff has always been very pleasant.  The corkage fee seems silly but its not a big deal.  I could see this being a nice romantic dinner...If I could get a date :P
Besh has done it again. A beautiful blend of fancy foods and a French menu with a casual feel and very affordable prices. The shrimp and grits are to die for.

WCSP is one of the true "hidden gems" of NJ. Roughly 4000 scenic acres right along the Delaware River, in a very relaxed setting. In fact, if you want to visit a beautiful park and avoid crowds, this is one of your best choices. While the picnic tables near the river get crowded on summer weekends, the rest of the park (across Rt 29) is usually almost empty.
The D&R Canal cuts right through the park, so you can start here and bicycle up to Lambertville (7 miles each way), have lunch and come back and never cross a busy road. The tow path is hard packed cinder & gravel so I'd recommend using a mountain bike or hybrid. The gravel could be a little rough on road bike tires, so don't say I didn't warn you. You cna also bike south toward Trenton, although I'd recommend you stop before getting to the city, unless you are wearing body armor.
Just north of the park is the tiny hamlet of Titusville, which is one of the most quaint towns in NJ. Biking or walking through here is a treat anytime of the year. You can do a really nice three-mile loop from the WCSP lower parking lot, up the towpath to Titusville, go left on Church St. Left again onto River Rd, and walk/bike down to the parking lot.
Across Rt 29, in the main section of the park, are tons of trails, a nature center, a small museum (yes, George did cross here). 
So whether you like to hike, walk your dog, bike ride, picnic, or just relax on a bench watching the majestic Delaware River go by, this park has it all.
We had the spicy miso ramen. It was THE BEST RAMEN I've ever had. By far. I will be coming here every time I'm in Tucson.

This place is WOW! The place is cozy and quaint. Considering we did not have reservations on a Saturday morning, we were lucky enough to be seated right by the door. It was a cold day and the heater was a little help, considering my friend wore a t-shirt under a light parka ( we are from Los Angeles. Philly in the middle of February is brrrrrrrrr freezing cold~ knowing is half the battle).  Service was friendly and personable. I love that the servers knew the regulars and it appeared that some built a connection and relationship with them. I like that it shows that Kanella staff care about their guests. 

My experience, being a first time guest was also enjoyable. I noticed the Chef come out a few times to check on the guest. Personally, I thought that was a thoughtful gesture.

 I ordered the Cyprus Breakfast and my companion ordered the Malawa. We shared the dishes. I was totally amazed! The Cyprus Breakfast was simple, the flavors all complemented the ingredients. When you ate it all together, the was a party in your mouth. You feel compelled to just close your eyes and enjoy what is in your palette. Gosh! Writing about my experience is just taking me back! Which is proof that the experience in Kanella is a full experience not a partial one! 

The Malawa is also a great dish the yogurt and the bread... Woohoo! Explosion in your palette! 

I highly recommend both. This place is awesome! I am impressed. When I visit Philly again, Kanella will be a "must stop by" places! 

KUDOS TO THE CHEF
This place is great!  The sushi and sashimi were very fresh and the hibachi menu is so yummy!  Plus it's BYOB!  Keep this place in mind for any occasion!

I am a super-fan of Schlafly Bottleworks.  I love it here, crave it constantly, and visit often!  First of all, Schlafly beer is some of the best craft beer St. Louis has to offer.  This is a great draw to just come here for happy hours or when the weather gets warm, out to the patio!  

If you don't really dig beer, you still need to come to Bottleworks to try the food!  They change some of their menu entree items based on the season and what is fresh and available.  But the always offer some of the standard quality items (burgers and sandwiches).  One of my favorite things to eat are the pizzas.  They have many to choose from, but if you want to be especially unhealthy but fulfilled, you can try the carnivore pizza.  WOW.  It rocks!  

My other must-have here is the Beer Cheese Soup.  I love this soup so much (if you do, too, then check out the copy-cat recipe online!).  It is very creamy and is flavor-city.

Finally, I love the atmosphere and service.  You generally get really passionate, knowledgeable, and attentive service.  And the place just has a cool industrial look to it.  There is a great bar and separate dining room, and an epic patio for the warmer months.  Sometimes when I lunch alone, I like to sit at the bar or patio, but the dining room is great for larger groups.  

I highly recommend the Bottleworks!!!  (oh and check out their live music and events, too!)

Wonderful outdoor experience. Mingle w/ friends & strangers, listening  to cool jazz on a hot summer's eve while sipping on a wide selection of good wines & sampling an extensive selection of cheese, meats & accompaniments. What could be more enjoyable?
This is my go to Italian restaurant next time I'm in this area. Fresh ingredients cooked "clean".  They'll get you a bottle of wine if you forget (it's BYOB).

Thrilled with the menu change and new chef. Hitting the breakfast venues on the weekend, it was great to see a menu with lots of gluten free options. The spinach frittata was delish- gluten free toast one of the best ever. And the preserves were amazing. The order of buckwheat pancakes was substantial- again gluten free- and tasty!  Open egg sandwich had great flavor; the andouille sausage really stood out. If you are an andouille fan, this is clearly for you.
Great coffee- nice outdoor seating under a tree. Ok for doggies- enjoy!

Great family friendly spot! Huge sandbox and lots of space for the kids to run around. Train passes right by as you eat. Food is good (owned by Hook Burger folks). Nice selection of beer and wine. Just watch out, the seagulls are really aggressive!

I waited a week after our purchase before providing a review and this was one of the best purchases(investments) we've made in a while for ourselves. First, Brent B. assisted us in our purchase and we got premier service from him and his team. They assisted us in options that helped us get the best deal for the beds we purchased. Low pressure and no remorse and we were excited to have our beds delivered. Secondly, and most important was the product. We chose the Tempur-Pedic line and we haven't slept a comfortable night in ages, this bed does wonders and I don't feel any awkward pressure like we did with our old mattress. In short, a week or so later and we're very happy with our purchase and with the level of service we got from Brent at this location.

Service was decent. Food was over priced and mediocre. Crab stuffed shrimp was greasy and soggy and the steak was over cooked(ordered medium rare) came out Barely pink and flavorless. Calamari was decent. Not just the rings. Ordered off the kids menu for my two year old and the plate came out too hot to touch. The only reason for the two starts is that servers get the benefit of the doubt from me.

My granddaughters computer fried and we decided to replace it. We had Ramsin at PC Mechanic built a new one The whole process was stress free thanks to Ramsins patiently walking me through every step of the way. He had suggestions that saved us money on all that we needed to purchase.                                                                   His prices are so very reasonable and he got the PC to my granddaughter very quickly. She has had her new PC for over a month now and it has exceed her every wish. I truly believe you can not go wrong with PC Mechanic and Ramsin. Thank you Ramsin for all your hard work and patience.... YOU ARE THE VERY BEST.

Drove by after an early doctors visit. Hospitals make me hungry. Got the Pecan Bun and coffee. 
This sticky piece of heaven had me sold on the first bite. I'm talking fluffed pastry and sugary happiness filled my jaws. Coffee to dissolve the bun into itty bitty particles of joy. 
It lifted my day so much that even though I drove in the wrong direction home ; adding 20 min to my drive, I did not even care. 
Coffee had great aromatics and flavorful accents. Basically it tastes like love.

I didn't even mind the sticky remnants in my beard. They shall be missed.
Delicious food and great staff. Alicia was friendly, knowledgeable, and went out of her way to make my dining experience a great one.  I will definitely be back!!!
They have the very BEST curry chicken salad wrap EVER!  I get it on a fairly regular basis and it is alway good.  Today it was incredible!  Thank you!  I also like their soy latte a lot too!

This is a great place to start your culinary tour of New Orleans.  Good, open atmosphere, the oysters were properly prepared and the service is excellent.
Drinks a little pricey, but what you would expect on Bourbon Street.

I admit, I came here because my hair doesn't have a lot of options: it is either long or short... the tragedy of fine, thin hair.  After my last place charged me $65.oo for a haircut that legitimately took 3 minutes, (wet it and cut off two inches before they saw my color) I decided to find new place that was affordable, and hopefully decent.

Deluxe is in my 'hood and the rave reviews (+the 10$ off your first haircut) sold me.  I had an appointment late in the afternoon and was scheduled with Maria.  I waited for almost a 1/2 hour and then because she was so behind, she had someone else wash my hair.

Granted, I do watch a lot of Tabitha's Salon Takeover but still- wash and wet my hair before even talking to me or seeing what my hair looked like? I thought that was bad news. How did she know my hair texture or the damage level?

Once I actually got in the chair, she gave me a decent haircut; again, nothing abnormal but nothing phenomenal.  Since most of my haircuts look the same, the personal time is usually what puts me over the edge or makes me a fan.    Admittedly, I will return because the haircut was fine and the cheapest around.  Hopefully, my trip back will be better and I can rave like the other yelpers here.

Absolutely delicious, the staff was really great! And super attentive. The only reason it is not a 5 is because it is extremely loud in the dinning room,  perhaps some sound cushioning would work. we wanted to sit outdoors  but it was full and I know why the food is great, so that was ok. But it was hard to hear conversations with friends unless you spoke loudly.

We order from here once in a while, and we like it because they deliver so quickly.  We usually order the Greek pizza, which is REALLY delicious.  It's white pizza, with tomatoes, feta cheese, and spinach.  We always ask for it well done, as their pizzas always seem a little undercooked for our taste.  Haven't tried a lot of the menu yet, but the cheese steak and hoagies are pretty standard.  The prices are fair, the delivery quick, and we've never had a problem with the customer service.
Palm Harbor location, just recently opened. In a word; EXCELLENT. Service, food.  Can't go wrong here.  Resealable prices. Will recommend and will return.

The place is cute. Always packed. Cross that.. ULTRA packed. Went there on Sunday noon.. only to find the waiting time for one person only is about one hour. Since I didn't have anything to do after, I decided to wait. They sent me to wait at The Random Tea House a block away from this place. It seems like this place work together or.. they have the same owner. Anyway, Honey's gonna call you at Random's when a seat available for you. I found it interesting.

I waited at Random's not even 30 mins. Maybe 15? That's already including waiting time to order the infamous chai from that place. Cool.

Service and the patrons was friendly. The whole atmosphere was good. The food? Tasty. I've tasted better at somewhere else though. Potato latke was good. Prices? Not the cheapest out there. I had breakfast bomb. $11 + tax. for pancake with egg mix with sausage and cheddar ($.75). and a side of potato latke.

Will be back to try on something else though. - All in all it's just good, nothing special.. yet.

Went to New Orleans with friends to celebrate Southern Decadence.  We arrived in New Orleans right after Hurricane Isaac.   I just had to go on a swamp tour and I did my research.  I found that Cajun Encounters was the best and it was recommended by several locals.  So, we booked our tour (4 of us).  We opted to get picked up at our hotel since we didn't have a car.  I don't know what other people are talking about having problems with the shuttle.  Ours was on time and the driver was very funny and giving us information about the city while we drove out to the tour location.  It's around a 40-45 minute drive, but you get to see so much of the area...

Once we arrived at Cajun Encounters, we checked in, got a colored wristband and within a few minutes, we walked to our boat.  Quick tip...before boarding, grab a cold drink since this is a 2 hour tour.  We boarded our boat...it holds 20 people or so and it was covered from the hot sun...thank goodness...Captain Eric was our driver, as he refers to him as Captain Crash.  He's very funny and very knowledgeable about the area.  The river/swamp was high due to the flooding from the hurricane.  He said we were experiencing the river about 6' higher than usual.  

We started the tour up the river...saw some local birds, turtles sunning on the logs and the occasional gator on the river.  Once we went deep into the swamp, this is where we saw most of the gators.  They were mostly smaller ones as the Captain said most of the larger ones are on land due to the storm.  As we slowly crept deeper into the swamp, we got to see HUGE wolf spiders.  These were awesome looking.  Sad part of the tour was we saw some pigs and nurtia (big rat looking creatures) and some snakes that didn't make it through the storm.  But Eric said these would be cleaned up by the gators.  

Overall, the tour was great.  We were right next to the wildlife and the plants of the swamp.  We didn't get to hold a baby alligator since the Captain couldn't catch one...but I give him an A for effort. 

We saw so much of the area in 2 hours...we even traveled up the river through a village of houses.  These homes were flooded by the storm and the residents were back packing up more of their belongings since the river was still rising.  
They were waving at us as we past their houses...

So, I could go on and on, but if you are ever in the area and want to see the swamp, I 100% recommend Cajun Encounters...and special thanks to Captain Eric for the wonderful tour and knowledge.  Hope to see you again next year!!

Everything here is delish..I was catering with them once..but now they aren't do it no more..it used to be $7 and they delivered to your house everyday..around south philly..next time you come here try the crab noddle..and satay padang/beef tongue bbq on skewer ;)

I am giving this place four stars solely because they have tofu for CHEAP.  

I moseyed into the P & P looking for canned "mock duck" or "seitan." They didn't have it, which wasn't a big deal.  I did have an awkward conversation with the man working there though to get this information. 

The point is, the store is small and slightly cluttered, but they have ridiculously cheap tofu with which I made a delicious scramble.  Hurray for soy-based protein!

This is one of the best breweries in town. It's local, they always have a good beer (especially dark and hoppy focused), they have live music occasionally on the weekend, and they have cornhole and ping pong inside.  In the summer, they have a patio outside. I love the architecture and the exposed beams inside. The history that this was an old turn-of-the-century brewery is awesome. When you are in Indy looking for real beer with real locals, swing by ICB.

This bridge connects Philly to Camden, New Jersey. I walked across this bridge from to Camden and back. The Philly side is far better looking as it is on the riverfront and near bars and restaurants. You get decent scenic views of both cities skylines as the walkway is right on the edge. Other than it, it is a very standard looking bridge.

Excellent coconut bread. Good with
Kids. Grouper was good.

Curry chicken salad wrap with crisp veggies and fresh organic fruits.  I actually died.. it was that good.  The coffee is delicious and it is nice to have agave syrup as a sweetener option.  This is my favorite place in Phoenixville  for fresh fast eats.

We came here based off a recommendation from our hotel.  The food was fine but nothing impressive.  It was basic bar food.  The music was way too loud.  Impossible to have a conversation and we were there at 5:30 on a Saturday.  If you're in from out of town, try another place for dinner.
The arinchini is to die for. Clams in white wine sauce were cooked perfectly and the veal Parmesan was melt in your mouth delicious. Great service that was timed perfectly. Strongly recommend

The fact that this place has 4 stars on Yelp is an absolute travesty. This place is more than 5 stars in my opinion. Absolutely incredible, and the service was even better. Our waitress was great, attentive, fast, and her recommendations were on point. Would recommend this place to anyone visiting Nashville. Dinner was so good I made brunch reservations on the way out. Looking forward to my next visit.

I love this store!!!!! I shop here at least twice a week.  About a year ago we went fully Organic & non GMO so everybody told me that it would be a lot more expensive.
