They didn't really have any difference in taste though.  The main difference here seems to be the cute decoration.  I'm okay with that though.  I get excited like a five year old child at the idea of what cute animal or fruit I will get on my cake next.  The mango pudding was okay, but not as good as I've had in some Thai restaurants, or even what I could make at home.  I haven't tried any of the buns, but they do look tasty and are priced right.  They also offer bubble tea and smoothies here, but I haven't tried them.  I'm always too distracted by the cake.

    You should drop by here after a nice dinner in Chinatown and get some sweets to take home.  It doesn't matter if you're still full from your meal like I usually am. The cute little cakes look and taste just as good the next day.
So far the best tacos I've had in a VERY long time. Definitely worth coming back to..
Everything from the food, wine & service was spectacular. Such a cute hidden little gem, very non-expected for the area it is in, but much needed nonetheless. Thank you little lamb

Service was impeccable, food was cooked perfect, wine and beer were great. It's nice when the general manager comes over to your table to see if you need anything and helps clean off your table. After every course they bring you new silverware, even if you haven't used it. This was very well run, the chef knows how to cook meat! I definitely suggest the 24oz porterhouse...... Mmmmmmm can't describe it. The sautéed broccoli florets were perfect as well. I would recommend Morton's to everyone.
Nice service , went with family members here . Our waitress was very proffesional she made sure we were well taken care of . Sure will be coming back to eat more of this yummy food:))

It was a dark rainy day in New Orleans and my friend and I hopped into Mr. B's for refuge from the weather in search of some snacks and libations.  This place was PACKED and we were lucky enough to snag two seats together at the bar.
After ordering a tasty IPA we then put in an order each for some gumbo and to share the fried catfish fingers.  My favorite and most memorable part of the meal was the bag of fresh warm bread we each received.  It was delicious and hit the spot.
After things calmed down a bit we had the opportunity to chat with the bartenders.  Small world, both had ties to our hometown of Pittsburgh.  It was fun chatting with them about the city and learning how they moved to New Orleans.
This is a cool place and I would love to go back on my next visit to sit in the dining room and enjoy dinner.

I tried a small sample of the Spumante Secco at the tasting bar, and liked it enough to buy a bottle for our group - but the bottle was flat.  

The $10 music night included light appetizers which turned out to mean pretzels and crackers - I was expecting something a bit more substantial.  They did have pizza for sale,  but it was nothing special.

Went here yesterday with high hopes but was rather disappointed. They boast about their entirely plant-based menu, but many of the items on their menu were actually just highly processed fake meat products! I opted for the tofu curry wrap, which was okay, but I felt like it was lacking flavor. They did have a few appealing  items on the menu that were actually plant based, such as delicious portobella sandwiches (I tried my friends'). The sweet potato fries were delicious, but overpriced at $4.50 for a small bag (think McDonald's kids meal size).

My experience here wasn't entirely unpleasant, but I don't think it would be worth it for someone who's not vegan or actually follows a plant-based diet to come here.

Just came here for lunch on a Friday. Picked the worst time to come, 1pm. It was extremely crowded, but only waited in line for about 15 minutes for the girl to take my order so not so bad. No seats were open, so I sat at the bar. The bartender was extremely nice and helpful.

I ordered the BBQ sandwich with coleslaw on it, and it rocked!! A side of some AMAZING Mac-n-cheese and bean slaw that was so-so. The cornbread was pretty darn good and so was the sweet tea. Took only about ten minutes for the food to come out. 

Will definitely come here again. Maybe at another time, so I don't have to sit at the bar.

What a let down,i bought a couch and the legs are bent. Yes they are ordering them for me, 6-8weeks
Next,all my decorative pillows are falling appart...
The quality was much different 6 years ago! Honestly I didn't think it could change this much..
Fyi: it's only been a month since the purchase

I ordered the grilled chicken sandwich meal, at a cost of $10. The service was very slow.  The tiny piece of chicken was very dry, the bun not good. 
Don't order the grilled chicken!
Love love love love love love it, wings duck fries,,,crazy kinda tacos,,,,,its cozy....porkroll in there cheeseburger,,,yummmm

Union Station.  Wow what a building.  Absolutely stunning.

Prime 108 offers an experience that is worthy of this elegant space.  

Attention to detail.  The hostess recognized that my date and I were dressed in black.  Before we knew it, she had casually replaced our white napkins with black.  If you have ever worn black and had to deal with the white lint lap after a meal using white napkins...you know how cool it was that the hostess made that move.  Great!

We tried the Popcorn Rock Shrimp per our servers recommendation.  Delicious. 

My wife enjoyed the vegetarian sampler dish that the chef prepared for her entree.  It was a really tasty assortment of seasonal veggies and spices.  I loved my Lobster Ravioli entree.  They nailed it.

I don't remember what we had for wine...but it was great!  We asked our server for jammy and fruit forward and we got it.  

We split the Creme Brulee for dessert and a dessert wine.  Delightful.
   
Recommended!

I do not give 5 stars easily, but this place is so cute! I loved the music lightly playing in the background, the art work, and most of all the food. I was so happy to see dal on the menu too! It's so hard to find regular dal and rice on the menu. When I'm craving comfort food, this is it! I loved my ginger chai, the bhel puri, and dal and rice. I had a bite of the chicken curry too and it was delicious. Everything was flavorful without being too spicy. 
Will definitely go back to try other items on the menu !

Great place for good food, good beer selection and a hopping atomosphere.

Try the Sunday brunch - not too crowded, good breakfast foods, and a price that cannot be beat.

Overall, we were underwhelmed by this place. The food quality was mediocre, our onion petals appetizer did not resemble the menu photos - we were expecting petals but got thin strings. Fried and salted to compensate for the lack of flavor. Ribs and wings - their specialty - were average. Not bad, but not great. Fish sandwich was bland, overly fishy, and resulted in an upset stomach for several hours. I wish we could say the service was the saving grace but our waiter seemed detached and uninterested. We came mid afternoon and were one of just three parties dining there. We waited and waited for every request to be fulfilled - drink refills, to go boxes, etc. Smart diners will avoid this restaurant. Nothing special to be had here.

I have been seeing Dr. Garces for the past 3 years and just recently started bring my 3 year old daughter along with me for her dental check ups... Besides every great experience i have had there, my daughter loves her visits to Dr. Garces!  We are always greeted by a super friendly office staff and then taken back almost right away.  I have never had to wait there.  Not only is the office so modern, pretty and clean, all the technology they use amazes me.  Dr. Garces is so gentle with my daughter.  I get no fuss from her when we have to go to the dentist!  But what I love is that we can be seen together!  I would strongly recommend Sonrisa Dental to all!

I had a craving for a burger with an egg on it!  I chose Village Whiskey because of José Garces. Bourbon and beef. What could be better. 

I only get these cravings about three times a year.  This is a full commitment meal.  I didn't have breakfast or lunch so I knew I could consume the calories. 

The bourbon choices are plentiful. The scotch menu was equally as impressive. 

To start,  the fried pickles looked like a good idea. Most fried pickles are thinly sliced.   I was eager to see Jose's interpretation.  They came out larger than most I've seen. The only time I have seen anything similar was in Denver at biker Jim's hot dog restaurant where they are fried in the whole slices.   These were not extraordinary but they were tasty nonetheless and well worth the calories.  

 For my burger, I ordered the 8 ounce and I added the jalapeno bacon, the cheddar and a fried egg. 

The first thing I noticed was that my egg was slightly over cooked. i expect my burger eggs to have runny yokes. This one was solid. The burger itself, which I ordered to be cooked to medium was also just slightly over cooked -- no pink anywhere. 

Lastly the duck fat fries rounded out the meal.

Overall my burger tasted incredibly good. It probably is the second best burger that I've had... My recently reviewed burger from Vegas was just a little better due to the slight carelessness of the chef tonight with my the temperature on my burger and egg. 

Ur was juicy and flavorful.  It was very fresh, which is am odd way to describe a burger.  Think McDonald's and then it's COMPLETE OPPOSITE.  :-)

My dinner companion had the veggie burger and added truffle mushrooms. She said it was delicious!!!!

Four out of five.... Will be back!!!
Great spot in Chinatown. The food is excellent, and the prices are so cheap (especially if you order a bunch of plates as a group, rather than one meal per person). Definitely recommended.

Best target around! It's huge, they have everything you possibly need and maybe more! I needed some nice hangers and they had nice wood ones that weren't over price and expensive.  I also got a new water bottle that infuses fruit. It's perfect. Also got some grocery items. It was a great one stop shop!

Probably should be a 4.5. The food was amazing, pork roll fries are definitely a must, but you gotta try the meatballs as well! They were juicy and melted in your mouth and the crab cake sandwich was delicious as well. All in all good prices for what you get. A lot of places charge a lot more for smaller portions and lesser quality food. Service was a little on the slow side but it was packed on a Saturday night, so you have to take that into consideration. I just moved to the area so I'll be back many more times.

We stopped by for lunch kind of late, maybe around 1:45 PM.  We were the only customers at that time.  The music was blaring!!  Really, really loud!!  I asked, very politely, if the music could be turned a bit softer so that we could have a conversation over lunch.  The cashier told us "The music can't be adjusted!"
Of course music can be adjusted!!  It can be turned off!!
Not caring about the customer at all.
Not going back.

Not bad at all for a team dinner for a party of 9. Good pasta, nachos and great hummus! Good selection of beer, slow service, but the pace was chill. Spacious, large TV screen for the playoffs and reasonable too.

This place rocks!  Service, Food, pastry shop, ambience, etc..   All great!

The servers have such a smooth, peaceful way about them, they are like people-whisperers.  I watched one of the servers whisper a client into submission in the kindest and most respectful of ways...   It was awesome!  She mind-handled a disgruntled client who had ordered the wrong "Tart" thinking it was a "Quiche".  By the time the server was done with her, the lady was willing to accept she screwed up by ordering the wrong item, willing to pay for the more expensive quiche, and apologized for her mistake.  I loved it...  The server was sooooo nice, the partially lobotomized client just admitted she was missing part of her frontal lobe while attempting a smile :-) 
 
The food was very fresh and tasty.  The coffee was excellent.  Also, the shop next door to them (also owned by Wildflower) has the most amazing Orange juice and scones.

The only thing I wasn't too crazy about was the older face-lift victims that frequent Wildflower Café. I witnessed a lot of rich-wannabe older ladies who obviously inherited their defunct husband's 401-K and/or life insurance and are just itching to show the world they now drive an E-class Mercedes.  We had some of these poor creatures sitting behind us and they talked about their yard-man, their pool-boy, and the car-wash guy (I promise I am not making this up).  They were all in their late 60's / early 70's and dressed in some sort of Nike workout clothing....  It was hilarious, except for the part where they wouldn't shut up about the pool boys.  But let me make it clear:  I am not holding these ghosts against Wildflower Café. 

We will definitely return when I am in Clearwater area.

FANTASTIC!! I had a lot of issues with another wheel company replacing my rims, after an accident. They gave me the run around for 6months that my tires unavailable & rims had been discontinued. I called Wheel Tech, spoke to Waldie & he tracked everything down. My tires arrived in 48hrs & rims in less than a week, from California no less. Wish I would of called him sooner. Waldie is great to deal with & will keep in contact with you every step of the way. (He also helped with all of the insurance company  correspondence)
Pitaya Bowl is amazing!! Need to branch out and try other bowls though because they all look so yummy!!
The baristas are all very nice & they all know my order when I pull up. Fast, friendly, good coffee at good prices. I love the iced sugar daddy (Americano with vanilla & caramel).

I fell in love with the decor the second we walked in.  Cozy,  rustic,  classy, romantic,  elegant.  I actually prefer black tablecloths instead of white and this cute restaurant has them (it's the little things that make me happy). Anywho....
We went on a Wednesday night for dinner. 
I ordered the rib eye with tomatoes and red onions. Comes with white rice and oven roasted potatoes.  Sooo good.  Couldn't finish it though.  Took half home for breakfast the next morning. Don't judge. 
We also ordered a ceviche dish as an app. I'm not a ceviche girl but my bf is and he made me try it.  It was actually pretty good but I quickly turned my attention back to my rib eye. I'm a steak girl. He also ordered a seafood chaufa. Very good as well. 
Service was very good.
No room for dessert. Don't forget to check in so you can get a $10 credit.  If you don't have signal just step outside for a sec. Total was approx $55 after the Yelp discount. Go check them out!

We found ourselves in an emergency situation broken down on the freeway and had a friend to recommend Leverett us. The service has been impeccable from start to finish. The pricing was very fair and we received high-quality from the dealership parts.

I had lunch today and Hangook Kwan and let me tell you something, where in the world has this place been hiding? The food is great, wonderful, dare I say it, inspiring. Yes, the food is that great.

Walking into the restaurant the fist thing that you might notice is that most all the signs are written in Korean so, English is defiantly not the most common language at this restaurant, which I think is great because that add to the experience of eating there. That of course, has no impact on the service because we were seated promptly and everyone was friendly and helpful.

Hangook Kwan is a great place to eat. I was pleasantly surprised by this find and I can't wait to go back. I think next time I am going to try and make it for dinner and see what other great things they have to offer.
Tyler was our server. He explained the menus and was excellent. Jason's bacon for appetizer. I had the shrimp and grits. Hubby had blt. I highly recommend this place !!! The dessert is amazing

This place is nasty!!!! The food wasn't done my chicken was slimey. The staff was really nice. I talked to a man in there who had blood in his chicken. The food isn't good at all......we'll the potato salad was good. I will not be back

Best Chinese Food in the city. My wife and I have been eating here for about 3 years and have never been dissapointed. I am not sure what the problem is with some of the others on here but the service has always been excellent. In fact the owner always remembers us and takes the time to talk with us everytime we come in for dinner. 

The Peking Duck is unbelievable. The Shrimp Dumpling Noodle and the Veggie Dumpling Noddle soups are superb. Excellent appetizers including Salt Baked Squid.

There is only one word in the English language to describe this Chick-Fil-A, Amazing! Even when it's crowded you get the fastest service. When I go, I go simple, and order the #1 (Chicken Sandwich, w/ order of waffle fries and a small drink). As soon as I order it they send it out to me ASAP, and I'm already sitting down eating. Other than the fast service, you get the best tasting food you can get. Waffle fries to die for, and the best chicken sandwich in Philadelphia.

Very tasty and inexpensive, not to mention you can eat a meal and not feeling stuffed nor hungry.

I've recommended to my friends and plan to stop by again!

Be sure to try their buffalo blue sandwich!

My hairless guinea pig had been suffering from a strange skin problem since the day I brought him home.  I'd talked to many people in the hairless guinea pig community, including vet techs and I'd tried a half dozen or dozen home remedies but his skin remained gross and oily.  Finally I decided to bring him to Dr. Greek for her diagnosis.  She was able to confirm he had a bacterial skin infection and prescribed a medicated shampoo that has significantly improved his condition.  The visit was quite expensive, about $20 for the shampoo but over $200 for her expertise.  That said, I am glad to have a solution to Johnnie's problem and I'm glad it could be done in one visit and that she was very knowledgeable and understanding.  I felt her bedside manner was very good.  She was attentive to my concerns, the problem and finding the right solution.  I would recommend her if you have a pet skin problem you are unable to resolve.

First experience, WOW the truffle burger and truffle fries, rule! Truffle overload! Second experience, this place is good, I enjoy all the options. The wait is a little long when busy but that's normal. 

Latest review: NEVER COMING BACK. The cashier is an unfriendly and very unsympathetic when he NEVER rang up our order and we waited over 20 minutes watching as the 3 people who ordered AFTER us received their burgers. No refund, no freebies, just a simple "sorry for the wait" and that was it. 

The place could benefit from better customer service if you're going to screw up. The burger is nothing to brag about when you still have Shake Shack and other restaurants who could build a burger and still treat you like a paying customer.
Delicious crab dip and oysters! Super friendly service! New restaurant with great outdoor patio on the water.

I think it's helpful to see an updated review, so folks know you can still trust Chez Bow Wow with your kitties. I took two cats to them this time, and the one is needy and unpredictable (she might bite). They did a great job with both - being smart enough to trim down the fur on my cats mohawk (we request her cut this way), so it was the best her mohawk ever looked (it never occurred to me to ask this from other groomers in the past). I wanted unpredictable, needy cat bathed, but they informed me it didn't work out. I appreciate a groomer that pays attention to my cat's needs and doesn't force her into a situation where everyone would be extremely unhappy. They did a great job with both haircuts, so the bath wasn't really necessary after all. I've bounced around with groomers, but I'm sticking with Chez Bow Wow especially since the needy cat will need brush outs (this is new to me, but she is awful at grooming herself) in addition to her summer cut.
One of our favorite places to eat and it's a BYOB. The food is amazing and the service is fast. Also the prices are resonable. don't forget a cheesecake on your way out

This place has really good chicken.  Like really good.  However, their service is hideous!  Unfortunately it's not the staffs' fault.  Their system crashes regularly, and causes them to ask for repeat orders and HUGE delays in paying and serving food.  Unfortunately they've lost me as a customer.

Overall a quality brewery.  Service is quick and friendly.  Food items are good, but not outstanding, and portions are large.  Beers are CHEAP and GOOD.  And that's what you're here for anyway, right?

I try to get a cupcake when I'm out of town.   We tried the Flying Cupcake and I was impressed.   The fresh strawberries in my cupcake were yummy.  They weren't dry,  dense or gummy and the frosting wasn't too sweet like some places!

Their lattes are quite good but sometimes not consistent depending on who makes it and if they use whole milk. Most of the time it is cold which is a bummer. Pastries are so-so. Service is also so-so and generally quite slow. Their paninis, especially the prosciutto and the tomato mozzarella, are yummy if they haven't run out or if they've actually made them for the day. Gelato is mediocre - definitely not the best in the world as they claim. Also melts easily.

Fancy, hip new burger joint.  I ordered the vegetarian burger, and LOVED it.  Seriously was bomb.  Drinks were strong and expensive.  And a little too fancy for me.  All of the reviews I heard about the food were amazing.  And I personally didn't think it quite lived up to the hype (aside from the veggie burger, of course).  I'm glad I went and had a great time.  I won't turn down an invitation to go again, but I also won't make a special effort to go back on my own.

My husband and I hyped up burger study thinking it was going to be a great place to eat, especially being in the St Elmo's family. We visited Burger study during devour downtown. We reserved our table on OpenTable and had no problem getting in. Our servers name was Justin and was really great to begin with. Once we ordered our burgers we continued to talk with our friends. About three minutes after our orders were taken, I completely forgot that I hadn't informed our server that I had celiac disease and needed a gluten-free bun. Justin immediately acted annoyed and frustrated with us. He went back to the kitchen to make sure to get this corrected. He did not return back to our table for over 20 minutes. He asked if a manager had come to speak with me and I said no. A manager never stopped by the entire night as Justin said they would. Our food came out great and we actually really enjoyed our meal. However the rest of our visit was really horrible. The server continue to treat us like total crap. It was frustrating for us because while we understood it was devour downtown and Justin was busy, we still figured we would be treated like human beings. My husband and I have both been in the service industry, and we understand it's frustrating when people forget to tell you things such as an allergy. We even apologized on her own behalf to Justin and said repeatedly that we completely forgot to tell him and apologized for any inconvenience WE caused HIM. However he still continue to treat us like absolute garbage. All this to say we definitely will never be back to Burger study. I'm not going somewhere I am treated differently because of an allergy that I can't help. We'll continue to go to St Elmo's, as they treat us with respect and are OVERLY accommodating when it comes to my allergy. It's a real shame that Burger Study can't be the same.

Everything in this shop is incredible right down to their tasty chai teas and coffees. Their king cakes are moist and decadent. This was a great place to stumble upon unexpectedly while walking to lunch.
I seem to have an AJ's addiction go there almost everyday. Best meat and fish dept in Tucson. Staff are generally very helpful and friendly best check out staff ever!

We picked Birchtree to cater our wedding because they were the only caterer whose sample menus made us drool. We ended up with a fun, family-style meal (with so many compliments that evening!) and it was easy to work with chef Rasa to fit in some of our special requests.

In addition to the incredible food, Jenna and Allegra's organizing & coordinating experience (rentals, timing, etc. their team even set up lots of our decorations and brought bug spray for our outdoor location, and completely cleaned up our site afterwards) were key. They made the day run so smoothly and we actually had time to kick back and enjoy our wedding reception!

If you're reading this review, you're probably just starting to choose sites, caterers, etc. Just know that producing a full-blown meal in a warehouse or the woods costs a lot. A restaurant reception (where staff fees, rentals, etc. are all included) or food trucks (ditto with those paper places) are 2 options to save significant dollars. But if you choose to go with caterers, we can't recommend Birchtree enough.
Yay!! A second location in Clearwater Beach! Best and only healthy food option near the beaches. Something for everyone, even kids, new location bigger and great views. Bravo Basimo!

We love Alfredo's and order it often.When we have company they often ask where the pizza is from because its so good. We've had hoagies, fries, chicken fingers, mozzarella sticks, pizza, cheesesteaks and more and all were delicious. The staff are friendly and the delivery people are fast.

This market is right across the street from my work, and honestly it's a nice break from Liberty Place.  I'm glad I don't have to see McDonalds, and Chick something or other. 

I like the fresh seafood, the produce store - and yes you pay a bit more, but it's good stuff. 

I say it's worth a walk at lunch time.

Just moved back to Tampa from the OC and this was the first place I stopped. What drew me in was the special menu placed outside the door "Pizza & Salad" $4.95... All natural, All organic, ALL the time!

So  as we walked in we were warmly welcomed by the staff, seated promptly and given drinks quickly. 

The pizza crust was sloppily rounded and not perfected, which only added to the wonderful flavor and uniqueness. It was thin and crunchy on the outside, yet warm and moist on the inside. The pepperonis were the size of my fist, but were not greasy... The salad was a perfect mix of mixed greens, carrots, tomatoes and croutons and the balsamic was great!

Parking here was a little tricky since it's downtown, but I would definitely come back here again. The idea of a "Healthy" pizza  is a winner in my book!

I stopped in here while strolling in Center City. Hungry, but not sure what I was craving, the sleek decor and attractive menu board drew me in off Sansom.

After a quick deliberation, I settled on a cheeseburger combo. Never have I ever been given so many options after ordering- how would I like the burger don? What kind of cheese? What kind of fries? All the customization was worth it, though. My burger was cooked to a perfect medium and topped with delicious mushrooms.

The burger cook was really nice, too, and offered me a few different sauces on the side. One of which was a fry sauce, which was solid. The worcestershire-based "500 Degrees sauce" was excellent, though. It went great with the fries, of which they gave me a very generous portion. I'll be back next time I'm jonesing for a burger in Center City.

I love going to Blush. Their wall of basics is every girl's dream: endless arrays of camis, tank tops, leggings, bandeaus, etc. in a rainbow of different colors and shades. Layering is a staple in my wardrobe, so I love knowing that if I need to find something to complete an outfit, I can probably find it in the wall of basics at Blush.

I've bought a few dresses from Blush, and I always get compliments when I wear them, which helps me know that my investment in the clothing was worth it. Nothing in the store is shockingly expensive, like at most other boutiques, so that's a definite plus for broke college kids like me!

Awesome place to stay!!! Beautiful hotel with very nice rooms. I was on the 30th floor so the view was spectacular!!! 

Very close to everything, walking distance to many sights!!!

Smoky. It's definitely not the standard 5 star level for a casino you would find in Vegas but decent for Reno. 

Restaurants and buffet are pricey though.

My brother in law is insane, no really he is. He will not eat anything unless he knows it comes from whole food. Now if that is not insane I don't know what is.

So we have been to this store a lot, sometimes just to buy one item to get the bag to fill it with cheaper stuff. I told you he was insane.

But at first I hated this place since I too am a bit insane and can not stand crowds of folks in small spaces and this place seems really small with tons of folks acting like it is a museum and just staring at the products that they have never seen before.

So we have been ;lucky in finding the store at times not too overly crowded and I can relax and shop, and when this happens I find some interesting products and great veggies and fruits along with some great cheese, even though they do not carry my favourite cheese, that being stinking bishop. Non the less I have found I do actually enjoy the store even when there are too many over processed folks shopping along side of me.

Oh but one time when looking at the cheese a female employee asked me if they she could help. I asked if the have any beer case cheese, now I realize it is a German cheese but have never heard it pronounced any differently than how I asked for it. So she asked me again and I said once again the same thing, she very haughtily said with a pointed finger, the beer cases are over there, of course pointing to the actual cases of beer. I then said no I am referring to the German pungent cheese. And then she once again in her best bitch voice said oh you mean and then pronounced it in the proper German. She of course knew what I was asking all along and it took ever bit of self control on my part to not crawl over the cheese counter and slam her head against the wall. 

Yeah but I still like the place.
Great sales team and informative employees. Jonnette was great and helped us a lot with financing options.

Um it's decent. For 5 people got the rock crab special and spider crab- which came with 5 clam chowders. 

We LOVE shellfish, but this was not our favorite. Just nothing special about it. Simply put- the place is overrated.

OH! And they charge an automatic gratuity for live crab?!?!?! I know they charge a automatic gratuity for parties of 6+, but nothing about the live crab. So heads up anyone who is going there for the first time.

I have stopped by this new location several times, and always had great experiences and great donuts.  A few times were drive thru and a few were walk in. It's always been a pleasant experience.  The first few weeks that they opened you could tell the employees were still getting used to things. But honestly that was expected. And they were always very pleasant and helpful.  

In terms of the food,  we always get donuts.  I have never had an improperly frosted donut,  lol, so not sure what happened with that one lady. I often buy a nice variety, they are always intact and delicious in my experiences! 

I would definitely recommend this location. Clean,  modern, and pleasant workers.

What a gem! My husband and I were staying in the Treme, and Lil' Dizzy's Café was recommended by our Airbnb host. It was a quick walk and we are so glad we made the trip! We were there for breakfast (their lunch does not start until 11, so if you want fried chicken you have to go after that time!) That said, breakfast was incredible! I had the shrimp grillade, their version of shrimp and grits, with a homemade biscuit, and my husband had a jambalaya omelette. So tasty! Exactly the comfort food we needed on a chilly winter NOLA day. The service was incredible; everyone made us feel very welcome and we saw three or four folks during our dining experience, including the owner, all helping to make our experience positive. The music station they play is pretty great too. We truly loved it and will definitely be back! Best breakfast in the Treme for sure!

Where to even begin. A group of 8 of us reserved a table and bottle service for my cousins birthday. We arrived before 11pm, as requested by Managment so we didn't have to pay the cover fee. We arrived at 10:45pm, the place was dead but we were seated at our table immediately. After 20 minutes of waiting at our table, a waitress (Annie) finally greeted us and we ordered 3 bottles to start. After our bottles came out the waitresses immediately walked away. Never once offering to pour our drinks, ask how things were going etc. This was a red flag but we gave her the benefit of the doubt. An hour and a half later, still no sign of our waitress or any other staff member. Not one person came over to see how things were going since they brought our bottles and mixers out. At this point, we were out of ice, mixers and were pretty disappointed in the customer service we had received thus far. After having to go up to the bar twice to ask for our waitress (Annie) she finally came back to check on our table. Not only was she rude and short with us but she really set the tone for our disappointing experience. If we wanted to serve ourselves and have to go to the bar, we wouldn't of reserved table service. Instead, when we asked her for more mixers and ice, we were brushed off and made to feel like we were asking for too much. When our ice and mixers were finally replenished, they were flat. My cousin had to go up to the bar yet again and ask them to replace our mixers. We ending up closing our tab out shortly after this due to the worst customer service I've ever encountered and it basically ruined our night. It gets worse, I received an alert from my credit card company today that our waitress decided to give herself a $680.00 tip on my credit card and my cousins credit card was charged another $816 tip as well!!! Not only was it the worst customer service experience I've ever had but they fraudulently charged my cousin and I's credit cards hundreds of dollars. I'm completely disgusted and feel so violated by what should have been a wonderful celebration and a nice night out, turned into a nightmare. Don't trust this place or their rude, thieving employees! I would never recommend this establishment to anyone unless they want to be disrespected and robbed.
The service was lousy and the food made me violently  ill for the remainder of the day.  My experience was nothing like everyone else's, I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone.

We were pretty disappointed in Whetstone given the published reviews recently and can't say that is at all what we saw or experienced ourselves. Service was lacking to the point we needed to step inside to request basics like silverware, condiments, and the even bill. The afternoon menu was also very disappointing. The portions were way less than we expected given the price and fairly weak in flavor. We live in the neighborhood and will not be returning but who knows, maybe things will get better.

Fair disclosure: I'm a Texan. I've been to San Antonio many times. And I know tacos.

When a good friend decided to bring me here, I knew it was mistake.

The tacos were flavorless. The guac almost had some flavor, but really it was tasted like processed avocado. I would have preferred Taco Bell.

The cashier was friendly, and it does seem like a great place to hang out with friends and have some beers. Parking would be nice too.

I guess the best way to put it is this: It will probably be OK for most people in the area. It's not *bad* food by any means.

But if you're a foodie, or if you know what tacos should be, keep on movin'.

I have taken my CRV here for the past year for things like oil change, tire rotations - whatever my car notifies me to have done. There have been times when I've gone to other places because I had a coupon or there was a deal to be had... and each time I wind up coming to Martin Honda to have them fix what the other places messed up - new tires, state inspection. So, I have learned the hard way that sometimes "deals" aren't really deals if they aren't done correctly. 

At Martin Honda, I have never had an issue with service, work completed, or wait times. They do what needs to be done, are friendly and customer-service-oriented, and I never feel like they are giving me a sell-job or up-selling me on services. I have a newer car, but I have been to places that always find something or another. I don't have that experience here. 

Soon, I'm in the market for new tires - I hope they have a deal here (because I DO still like deals!) Regardless, Honda has earned my loyalty as a customer.

I came here tonight for dinner with four gal pals. It was my first visit to The Block. The experience was awful. I was the first of the group to arrive. Let me start by saying that the whole point of a hostess is to 1.) greet you at the door and welcome you to the restaurant, and 2.) select a table for you and seat your table. The hostess here did neither. When I approached her station at the door, the hostess seemed scared and nervous as if I had three eyes and was speaking a different language. I found this odd but told her that I'd like a table for five people. She seemed awkward and said "oh, uh, I don't know...um... let me check with the manager." Huh? Check with the manager? Aren't you the hostess?! This set the tone for the rest of our evening....

She went to get the manager, who also seemed jittery, and told me and a friend who had arrived that it should be ten minutes for us to get a table because they were waiting on a table who had paid their bill to leave. She told us that we could go to the bar while we waited.  We were standing at a long table in the bar area, which had no stools. The bar area waiter came by promptly to get our drink orders and we told him that we were  wating on a table. After more than ten minutes, the rest of our friends arrived and we were still not seated at a table. A friend who had just arrived asked the manager if we could order food and eat at the table that we were standing at, and she agreed and told us that we could pull chairs up to the table. Now, while it's good that she advised us that we could just sit there, why didn't she offer that to begin with?

Our entire group ordered the Block Burger medium well. The burger comes with fries and I asked if I could substitute my fries for green beans and was told by the waiter that it would be a $2 upcharge, which was fine. While ordering, I asked the waiter if the burger came with the traditional lettuce, tomato, onions, mustard, etc and was flatly told no. I asked if I could get that and he said sure. What he didn't say was that this addition of toppings would cost $2. I didn't find that out until I got my bill. SMH. I also should add, that the lettuce, tomato, and onions were chopped as though they were prepared for a salad and not a burger.

All of our burgers came out at different temperatures. Mine came closer to the well done side than the medium side (there was no pink at all in the burger), while a friend had a burger that was medium rare. It was completely pink on the inside. I didn't complain to the waiter about my burger, but my friend justifiedly alerted the waiter and he took her meal away to accomodate the error. He did not apologize. After the rest of our group was almost done with our meals, my friend still had not received her meal back so she went to talk to the manager about it. Shortly after, a brand new burger was brought out. It was cooked medium well, as requested. Right after she received it, the manager came to her and asked "how is your burger? good. good." and then she walked away. She didn't even wait for my friend to answer her question! My friend was quite upset about the long wait that she had for her corrected burger to arrive, as we were all finishing up when she finally got her burger. However, her bill was not accomodated for the inconvenience which my friend expected after talking to the manager. She asked the waiter, and was told "unfortunately we can't do anything about the bill because you ate the entire burger." Wow! I understand that not all restaurants/managers comp bills for ill-prepared meat dishes, but that response was strange.

While I've heard that the happy hour at the Block is pretty good, I don't think I'll ever return due to the poor service that we received tonight. From start to finish, the wait staff and manager seemed rushed and seemed like they did not care much for providing us with a good dining experience. I don't understand why the vibe was as strange as it was. Although the burgers and my green beans were all well-seasoned, I think the strange vibe of the staff, unspecified $2 upcharges, and poor service will prevent me from returning.

Resource Exchange has become my go-to place for low priced beads & other materials that can be incorporated into mixed media & collage projects. I highly recommend that artists & crafters make this place a regular destination AND donate the supplies, art books, etc. that they no longer need to the R.E. Several of the major thrift shops don't have anywhere near the amount of donated art & craft supplies like this place has. The prices can't be beat, either.

Outstanding all around.  Actually was heading somewhere else, but tried it on a whim.  Unique Latin fare with tasty, fresh ingredients.  Our waiter, Blake, did a masterful job of going over the expansive menu.  His recommendations were well received.  Garden margarita was spectacular.  Most difficult part of our experience was choosing what to order.   Will definitely go back.
Bought a Mardi Gras package online. Don't do this save your $$. For the amount of money you could feed 4 people plus drinks! Felt very ripped off. Buyer beware!

I used to come here a lot and would always get the hainanese chicken rice. It was pretty good but recently I came and got the same thing and was really disappointed!! The chicken had ZERO flavor, not even like salt or any sign of anything. The rice was super yellow which was kind of strange. After I finished my meal I wasn't feeling well at all. I don't know what happened, maybe they got a different chef? I won't be back, the hainanese chicken rice at banana leaf is way better.

Best Pad Thai I've ever had to date (and I've had a lot of variations). The classic Penang Pad Thai will give you strips of tofu, shrimp and squid added to the classic egg noddles and peanut sauce. However, I'd advise starting with the chicken (comes with tofu, as well) or just tofu Pad Thai. 

In addition, they give you pickled beans sprouts in a sweet sauce to eat separately or, as I do, dump on top of the dish. Adding the sprouts elevates the Pad Thai to a whole new experience. 

I've never eaten in at Penang but it is an exceptionally clean and nice establishment (sort of an oasis) in the middle of smelly, dirty China Town. Each time I've taken out I'm greeted with a smile and given a nice Penang plastic bag with my dishes wrapped inside a paper bag. I can tell you from experience that the packaging method they use (plastic dish containers, closed paper bag) keep things hot for a good hour after taking out. I pick up and drive home, place the dishes in the microwave until my boo is home and things are still hot and ready.

Lastly, Penang charges you little for great quality food. I pay under $20 for two heaping dishes of Pad Thai (used to paying about $25 at other establishments).

This is hands down my favorite restaurant in St. Louis. My roommate and I have made it a weekly tradition to come here... you can't go wrong with anything on their menu. This food is incredibly authentic and delicious. The owners make this food even better, though, as they are some of the nicest people I have met. They make their food with love!

GO VILLAGE WHISKEY !!!!!

Really good food that sticks to your bones and fills you up in a flavorful way.  
I had the Popcorn Shrimp the Pork Sammy and those excellent Duck Fries that are nice and crispy.  
The pork was perfect with the fried pickles and that slaw just cut the taste perfectly...
Look here...if you are looking for a nice bite and reasonable prices for that area of the city I suggest it strongly.

Peace. Out.
Matty.

As a Yankee who's lived all over Yankeedom, I can say that Rouses definitively beats any regional northern supermarket.Why?

(1) It's basically a poor man's whole foods, stocked with local Louisiana products. They have fancy groceries and not fancy groceries. If you need an extremely pretenoious food, you're still going to have to hit up whole foods, but if you want good produce Rouses has you covered.

(2) They also have a killer salad and hot foods bar as well as an olive bar, making it one of the best affordable meals in Midcity.

(3) Rouses is the best liqour store in New Orleans, a city essentiality made out of booze.

(4) I know what you're thinking Yankees, what about Wegmans? But let's face it, starting in almost New Orleans is way cooler than starting in almost Rochester.

Rent A Chef does lunch at my job! I love having them here. I usually bring my lunch, but on the days where I forget, they are great in a pinch. Great quality food and an AMAZING price. Always something different, with great service. Love them!

We almost decided to take a longer drive to the Carabba's in the area but my father didn't find that appealing. The restaurant was very clean and elegant looking on the inside. Our waiter was very helpful and attentive, albeit the place wasn't very busy, nonetheless the service was great. 

They were very accommodating. My father ordered the veal Parmesan with a side of pasta. He requested the bolognese sauce for the pasta. I ordered the chicken in mushroom sauce which came with a side of pasta. I also got the bolognese sauce on my pasta. The sauce was so meaty and rich it was like a meal in itself. My wife got the spaghetti alla puttanesca. 

The chicken was just what I was craving. I was hoping to get something like the Pollo Rosa Maria like the one at Carabbas but this was better. My father said the veal was the best he ever had. I had a taste and I agree it was wonderful. My wife enjoyed the spaghetti alla puttanesca.

We didn't stay for desert but I will definitely be back when I'm in town.

The hot chicken sandwich was pretty darn good, but the green beans, Mac & cheese, and coleslaw weren't up to par. Pretty disappointed by them. Didn't even eat over one bite.

Not horrible, but not worth coming back for. 

Coming from West TN, I had high standards and they clearly were not met. My husband had the pork tacos and said they were lame and didn't have much flavor. 

Also, we went in for brisket but it's not served past noon.

Great location !
We travel from LA and walk  from Santa Barbara train station  to the Hotel, 3 blocks not bad.
We have a room in the second floor and was nice and quiet very clean room and bed was comfortable. Walking distance  to all. the restaurants  and night life,
The only concern  is about the homeless people around the area, but I guess that's all over the down town.

I've been to Milktooth a few times and have had good luck with both meals. We went on a Sunday during prime brunch time and had to wait about 90 minutes. The coffee and cocktails (we got the coffee long island ice tea) are both very good (albeit very expensive). If the cocktails were just a few dollars cheaper we probably would have gotten more than one during our long wait. Once you are seated the service is very fast and friendly. They are very generous with their coffee refills.

Went to Barrio  Brewing on St. Patty's Day eve. Traveling into the heart of Tucson you get a feel for the city coming from the Oracle Valley. This place is in an industrial part of town. If your an out of towner, your a little apprehensive about where your going to. From the outside it looks like a rundown warehouse with a scrap metal look. It took a little bit for me to warm up to the look but after my experience I became a fan of Barrio.
My wife had a veggie burger that was average but the toppings of guacamole, cheese and horseradish sauce made her burger tasty.
I had the California burger with mushrooms added. Nice size burger, very well cooked. The fries for me were a little below average. They need to leave the skins on the fries to have some body to them.
We had there stout and porter. Both beers were pretty good with the stout being a little more creamy.
They have a shuffleboard table that took me back. Haven't seen one in years. We played and had a youngster watching us play and kept him entertained. It was fun.
We recommend Barrio to locals and out of towners.
Hands down the best Alaskan Crab Legs I've ever had! And great beer. The staff was awesome and the view is absolutely beautiful from the pier! Highly recommend.

Um, YUM! We have been wanting to try this place for a while... There's always a wait though & my man is quite impatient. We decided to wait this time. So glad we did. The food is great and the place is so cute. It's a bit congested inside & getting a table is a bit of a cluster, but once ya get past that and start eating - yay! We'll definitely be back for more.

What I could not believe through the entire tour was that the whole thing was free. Parking was free, entrance was free, and the beer samples (2) were free. 

We went on the first Saturday of the month so we were able to get our picture with the Clydesdale horses and were able to buy our picture for $20 in the beer room if we wanted. Note: if you just want to see the horses, it is the first stop so you can turn around and head the beer room afterwards. 

The tour gives a great basic overview of the process of making beer and you get to see a lot of the processes but at times it seemed as though it was more about taking pictures than the actual knowledge of brewing beer.

The overall rating of 3.5 doesn't do this place justice. The food was seasoned exceptionally well and the service was excellent. If you're looking for a laid back brunch spot, I definitely recommend Cafe Fleur De Lis.

O'malleys was the first actual pub on the Evil Pub Tour.

This place was fun, but it didn't really stand out.  The bartender was a lovely girl who did a good job of chatting us up.  I think Sycophant #1 might have fallen in love with her.

There is a decent selection of draft beers.  I liked it.

The only negative is that the bartender told Evil that we can only get up on the little stages if we were a girl and mostly nude.  This made us sad...because A) we didn't get to go up on the stage as we're a man (a manly man!) and B) there weren't any mostly nude girls in the bar while we were there.

Bummer.

Delicious food! Excellent customer service! Their original, house-made dim sum sauce goes well with everything. We were walking around before we had to pickup our car and decided to stop in for lunch. The establishment small, but now crowded or uncomfortable. Highly recommended.

We ordered over 150.00 worth of food today takeout.  I complained that the wings were dry, and that I had ordered them with mild sause. Granted 3 hours had gone by before I could sit down to eat, so the staff explained to me that the wings absorbed all the sause. I questioned why the foil the wings were sitting on was completely dry, and was told it too absorbed the sause! LOL. They only offered to pour more sause on them.   Needless to say I left them the wings.  If this is how they treat customers with this kind of tab, I can only imagine if you only buy a sandwich.

The guy that did my nails did a really nice job but the entire place was filthy. I watched another nail tech drop the tool he was using on this lady's nails on the floor and pick it right back up and started using it again. Gross. My reg nail place was closed today so I came here after finding it on yelp. They could be a really great salon if they cleaned it up-no doubt they would fail an inspection.

I cannot comment on the food. The decor is nice but incredibly tight. I was more surprised by the fact that they sell beers far past their expiration date and hope that no patron notices. 

Their only golden horse is that their are open late and individuals drinking late may not know that they are drinking flat beer.

Been meaning to try for a while now, finally had the chance to stop in with bae. 

Atmosphere is nice, music was great and staff was attentive and friendly!

I got the pierogis (apparently a new addition) and a side of braised green beans and tomatoes. Pierogis should have been great but I was underwhelmed. The meat inside was yummy, but the dish was cold when it came out and it generally lacked flavor. The green beans were also cold and tasted like frozen steamed green beans covered in Ragu sauce. 

Bae had the burger and enjoyed it-nothing exceptional though. 

I really wanted this place to be great! Hoping the menu gets better if I decide to stop in again.

The passport office is horrible if your in any type of hurry, not super busy but every time we go in there's only one person working so it takes an hour for them to even help 14 people, they really need some help with staffing properly

Creole Creamery is always on the must go to list whenever I visit New Orleans. It's homemade, yummy, a nice atmosphere and I love sitting out in front.
I order Red Velvet in a waffle cone every time, and am never disappointed. 
It's so good that I'm letting it be my one no sweets for Lent exception!
Oh and last time I went saw there was a Yogurtland across the street, quite disappointing, especially compared to the real deal at Creole Creamery!

These guys catered my wedding. Everyone was raving all night about the amazing coffee! Their shop is a great place i love hanging out in with extremely friendly and knowledgable staff. They seem to have higher end stuff for reasonable prices. Can't wait for YOU to go and have this "experience" yourself as it really is a must for people with a taste for a cup of coffee you'll never forget!

I have to recognize this particular Cosi for excellent customer service. I was waiting for my train, I stopped in during a busy dinner hour. My food came out quickly, but my drink was forgotten. The employee was extremely friendly, apologetic, and made it right after. Additionally, the manager came over, apologized, and offered a free entree. I noticed the manager working right alongside the staff and also checking to see if the seating areas needed to be cleaned. The food was your standard Cosi food, but the service really stood out and was appreciated.

You guys with 4 and 5 stars are nuts.  This pizza may be a step above PizzaHut or Dominos.  They crusts with cheese are pre-made and placed in the pizza oven with toppings added.  Mass produced, which shows in the results.  At $16 for a 2 topping pizza, I can't even look at it as a value pizza, sacrificing taste for price.  Any real pizza fan should look elsewhere.
Love shopping here! Great customer service! And you can find what you need and be out of there in no time. Love the sales and incentives they offer.
Love this shop. In and out service and often don't even charge for the work they do! If you're looking for a bike shop with exceptional customer service this is the place.

This place has a wonderful staff of groomers that takes special care of your dog! My dog has dry skin and the groomer had the knowledge, care and compassion to recognize her issue and address it with the proper shampoo and care!! Not only does this place have awesome groomers but the doggy shop is my all time favorite! I went to purchase a beautiful handmade Harness that came in xs, small, medium and large unfortunately my dog was in between sizes and they had it made over the weekend just for her with no additional cost. Overall just wanted share my experience with other viewers and give them a big thumbs up!!

I've given this establishment three different shots to change my mind, each visit yields the same results. Terrible service accompanied with sub-par food and drink every single time. Tacos are always served very dry and cold, like they have been sitting out. Enchiladas are over cooked and dried to the plate upon serving. Margaritas are way too sweet with very little alcohol. The worst aspect of this place is the service. Each visit I've waited at least 30 minutes for another beer, more chips, or an opportunity to order anything. If visiting, allow for at least an hour and a half if you're going to eat there. 

Too many better options in this city to settle for this place.
Best sushi in Nashville! Service was great and food was fantastic! Will definitely be back! Thanks Mr. Choo :)

I went to the ER at 8:30pm... did not leave until 5:30 am and all they did was get a blood test and an xray and gave me medication!

update to this... just got the bill and it's over $3000 ... thank goodness i have health insurance!

I honestly was debating if I should or shouldn't  come to my appointment today  because every other salon had always shave my nails so thin that it burns so much and the techs would always say "well then I can't do your nails your sensitive" I stopped getting my nails done for a while but my bf called kumi nails salon to book me a  appointment  for my bday because we live across the street and Everytime we drive by I say Id love to check that place out sometime! However as scared as I was going in the staff were actually awesome! Offered me water & to take my jacket, I only waited a minute to see my tech and when I explained to my tech my thin nail issue she was SUPER GENTLE I loved her  and btw her work is amazing :)  (my tech was Mireong) I'll forsure come back to see her. So happy with my service.  Also the salon is the prettiest I've seen in Edmonton. The owner has these two CUTEST dogs who are so well behaved walking around!   5star salon.

So my experience at Tsunami Japanese Steakhouse has been interesting. I'm new to the area so I wanted to find a good Japanese restraunt and stumbled upon this by word of mouth. So I thought I would try it and got some sushi rolls. They were pretty good until I found hair in my food at the bottom mixed in with the sauce. I called there immediately telling them about my issue and when I thought they would graciously apologize profusely and act surprised about how that hair got into my food. All I got was attitude and a receptionist that made me feel like all I wanted was free food instead of just wanting to enjoy my meal hair free. They offered me store credit or to remake it but why would I want to eat there again after I found your hair in my food? How do I know it won't happen again? And did the manager make an appearance on the phone oh hell no she made the receptionist handle the situation like it's a routine thing oh yeah just give them credit and shoo them away. Awful place awful business. Don't waste your money eating here if there is hair in the food what else do you think might be in the food?

expensive but fairly clean and convenient. i just started working next to them so it'll be my go-to for lunches/snacks when i forget to pack one or get too lazy to. i def wouldn't do all my grocery shopping here though. it's ok.

If you love your pet stay away from this veterinary clinic. My 90 year old mother took her 14 year old cat to be euthanized. It was a very difficult decision. The vet stuck my mother's cat 5 times before finding a vein. Meanwhile the office staff had 3 confused people working on the bill. All this time my mother is crying. In the end they charged her for euthanasia and cremation which is appropriate. But they also tacked on an $80 charge for an office visit which is ridiculous and excessive. I actually commented to the staff that I found them lacking in compassion.

I had lunch. I really like it.  Mexican food with their own fruity tropical twist.  I had the Ceviche.  It was more fruity than it was tangy, oniony; cilantro.  Surprised my palate but was good.   Also had the shrimp Salad,it was good next time I will order extra shrimp.  Overall great first time experience.  I will go back.
Fast, delicious, friendly staff, clean, nice atmosphere, generous portions and a number of options for a reasonable price.

reading the reviews makes me wonder if i went to the same place as the other reviewers. 

i had reserved a table for one for 7.30p this eve. upon arrival, i was seated at the worst table in the house: the one by the entrance, in which the two seat options were either immediately behind the entry door, which would hit me each time it swung open, or on the opposite side of the table where the vent was blowing ferociously on me. i chose the latter as long as the waitress offered me the next open table. a deal was made, and thankfully carried out right after the bread was served. 

one waitress seemed to be catering to every table so it did take me a few minutes to receive my turn, a rundown of the menu, and the obligatory introductory bread. i opted for four pasta dishes, explaining to her to leave out the seafood in any of them due to my allergy. 

each came out quickly in succession, as per request, but the main carbonara dish came with the swordfish, rather than without, so i left much of it untouched. the rigatoni and gnocchi plates were solid; the pesto pasta was rich on basil, which was not to my liking, but not the fault of the restaurant.

my waitress noticed the carbonara mishap and offered to bring me a new one, but i was ready for dessert. i ordered the almond panna cotta, which was this evening's highlight, easily. light yet filling and with fruit to complement the airiness.

i was offered a complimentary zeppoli dish of doughnuts over nutella and did finish those, which also did please the palate.

my three stars are for the table situation, the quick and almost abrupt nature of the waitress in serving me (no niceties or time to mingle/linger), and the cold, cold dining room. seriously: bring a parka. the food was overall presented well, through i will likely never head to nj (from philly) for dinner again as it's a far visit for a culinary scene that cannot compare to philly's.

Only giving this place two stars for its' cleanliness and appearance. Other than that, the customer service here is terrible. Upon arrival, I had to wait about 20 minutes at the clerk's stand until someone finally came to help. When finally getting to our room after a poor initial customer experience, come to find out we didn't even get the room we had reserved. If you're into good customer service and experience, I wouldn't recommend

Stopped in for lunch on Saturday. We were the only two people in the restaurant on a Saturday afternoon, so hopefully things will pick up for these people.
Server was very nice although had to look for her to get some more iced tea.
Chicken salad was very good and came with peppered kettle chips. Spicy chicken sliders were not very spicy, but that could just be me. The chicken was a little chewy, but overall it was ok.

Went to Slate with a group of 5 for Happy Hour last night (and a small dog last night).  We sat outside on the sidewalk at table.  Our server was the owner I think.   He was very accomodating and hooked our hungry dog up with seemingly endless treats and water.  He's definitely a dog lover.

They have a very solid craft beer list and the wine list was good too.   We hung around for a while and ended up ordering food.  Server recommended the short rib stuffed burger and it was BANGING.  fries were perfect too.  Everyone liked their food.

Will definitely go back thanks to good food & drink options, great service, and outdoor seating.   Thanks!

I was a brand new patient at A Dentistry today. I've been to various dentists throughout my life, but have never been made to feel as cared for as Dr. Nick and his staff.  They definitely demonstrated their passion for Oral health, and with a friendly and welcoming attitude.  I don't write a lot of reviews, but was so impressed that I was compelled to post this.

Had a late lunch at Lilly's today.  The place was pacjed at 2pm ... and after having a meal here, I know why. 

We only had two dishes. .. spicy tofu and Pho Ga (chicken).  The spicy tofu was excellent,  tender, tasty with a spicy flavor that was perfect as served.   The Pho is also very very good... it comes to the table piping hot with fresh sprouts and basil to add as desire.  I found that a few good doses of rooster sauce (sriracha) brought the flavor to just where I like it.  Final verdict: we both agreed that we would willingly order the same again... but will try other dishes as well.

Service was very good,  courteous and efficient and Lilly is a great hostess.
Just had lunch at 312 Pizza Co.  Had a slice of the Capone pizza and cheese all appetizers. Amazing food!  Good atmosphere.  Will definitely return!

This place is amazing and Vinnie  makes a mean tomato soup. I called on a Friday in lent and wanted tomato soup he told me he didn't make it as they were so busy so I was a little disappointed and ordered a tuna on toasted rye. As quick as you like it was delivered and guess what Vinnie made me tomato soup yummy and warm. They are quick and deliver and their food is amazing.  There spaghetti with Pomodoro sauce is to die for.  So safe to say anything tomato these guys do it well. Keep up the good work guys

Let me just update this review because I've had a new experience with this Heavenly Eden. 

I had these lovely people and gifted cooks cater an event of mine. Not only were they ridiculously affordable AND generous with their portions -- huge trays of individually cupped mango sticky rice for 40 people, with extra "sauce" and a good amount of mango topping each one -- but they were so nice about everything! Incredibly helpful, lovely people (who give you free chopsticks and more!

I picked summer rolls, two entrees (one of which came with rice without me even having to ask for it), and a big dessert. Yum! The food was just as fantastic as it was in-house!

Very helpful and friendly salespeople, and the mattress was delivered the same day.  We ended up choosing a mattress that one of the salespeople used, but were given plenty of time to test out other options.

I checked out Bourbon & Branch for the first time last night, Friday night happy hour into evening. It was very busy but not unpleasantly packed.The cocktail menu is amazing. Their menu is pasted into pages of old children's books.The one I got was "What Is a Stranger and What Should I Do?" which was wonderfully creepy.  My bartender Kate was extremely friendly and knowledgeable.She started me with "The Hemingway" rum cocktail-it was sweet and refreshing. Because so many of the drinks sounded tantalizing on the menu I decided to switch it up to the "Branch Cosmo" for my next drink.It was such a refreshing change from the saccharine sweet that you have come to expect from your typical cosmo.Fresh cranberries and orange were muddled into the Tito's vodka.It was delicious.Both the Hemingway and the Cosmo were made with all fresh ingredients and were both balanced and stiff. They tasted the way a beautiful spring day feels.

There was a shift change and Brendon took over on bartending duties.I noticed it was still happy hour so I figured I would take advantage of the specials and order an Old Fashioned.It was easily the best Old Fashioned I had ever had in my life. I can definitely see myself going back to Bourbon & Branch for many many more of these.

The cocktail prices might have seemed a little expensive at first glance but they were all WELL worth the price.

By this time I realized I was pretty hungry so I decided to order some food.
The Irish nachos appetizer was awesome and more than affordably priced.It was ample enough for 3-4 people to eat. Since it was just me,there were PLENTY of leftovers.

I can't wait to go back and try the rest of the menu there.I had a really tough time deciding which thing to get,especially after seeing so many other patrons' food go by that looked simply amazing.
Very good Italian sandwich. Will be back and will bring friends from work.The restaurant will cover the parking cost of the garage in the same building.

Nice but expensive! I live in the Chicago area so I know that goceris can be costly but this place was more than I normally pay. I had to stop in while visiting family to get some salad fixings since I that was my potluck dish to bring.

Everything cost more than at home - lettuce, tomatoes, vinegar and herbs!

The store is big and has lots of food to go options with sushi and a salad bar but the layout seems a bit awkward as I kept having grocery cart traffic jams I need many areas.

It's nice but not worth the price!
Great vegetarian entrees. Definitely recommend the crudité appetizer. Warm aesthetic.
Although we had a fairly long wait it was well worth it. Beer was cold, pizza was delicious and price was fair. Our waitress seemed a bit frazzled but overall she did well.
You want fast an good, I stopped in,i was served quick food was good an staff was friendly.... I'd stop back if it was that kinda of night

The ultimate hipster burger dive (though it's not a dive in the least). The truffle fries lived up to the hype and the housemade mustard and ketchup made a good thing better. The burger was delicious, but the bacon was even better than the meat. I'm not sure it tasted like a $13 burger, but I'm willing to pay a few dollars extra for locally sourced meat and there's no doubt it was very tasty. 

Wear your hipster glasses and be prepared for a slight wait, but you'll leave happy and full.

They have the best lamb simosas & the best lamb vidaloo anywhere! And they have a dope lunch bufet. Plus they ask you if you want mild, medium or hot. I go for hot but it's all up to you! Waiters are fast & attentive. Prices are great.

This is a nice place to sit down and have a cup of coffee, a nice breakfast, or one of their many pastries.  The decor is even nice enough to meet here for a lunch date.  The coffee is good.  I found the latte to be so-so.  The cookies they have are great.  I cannot pass up the opportunity to have a chocolate chip or oatmeal cookie.  The oatmeal cookie is huge.  The chocolate chip cookie is unique with large chunks of chocolate chips.

One day I will stop through and try one of their breakfast entrees.
Great dinner. We also went on Ladies night which consisted of half off drinks. We split the heirloom tomato caprese salad and the po boy sandwich. Everything was tasty and the service was goodnight
Super super great food and excellent service! The mole enchiladas are delicious and the owner/server is very nice!

Because of a Groupon I finally got to try this place. I would like to give it 3.5 stars but the rating system won't let me. I loved that they offered the Jubilee Nut Brown Ale. I also loved their unique taco creations. I went with 3 tacos recommended by the hostess. The Tequila Lime Chicken, Fish, and Southern Fried. The Tequila Lime was my favorite. A great combination of flavors. The Southern Fried my second favorite. The Fish was average. The disappointment came from the tortillas on all of them. They were not even warmed up. They tasted so store bought/packaged that it took away from the great flavors and tastes offered in the tacos. They say they are locally made so if they are they are the worse locally made tortillas.

I have never been to such a slow drive thru, and that's comparing to other S&S's!! It's literally at least a 20 minute wait just to order and that's at 10pm. Although I have gone to their take-out counter and waited just as long for cold food and a melted shake. Not sure why this location can't pull it off like others. It's really disappointing because it's right by my house.

Modesto is a good place to spend a long (which will become) expensive dinner and drinks with friends, trying as many plates as possible and drinking as many mojitos as you can. Well, maybe not the last part, but one or two is a must. I'm not the biggest fan of sangria (I can't get past the name), but my friends rave about it. There are a lot of choices here, and tapas are so much fun to share. This place gets very loud, but its fun, the energy is good, and the atmosphere is colorful and cute.

I have several categories for Italian food. If I want fresh pasta and red sauce I go Ristorante Attilio, great veal and more upscale then La Casa Pasta and if  I want amazing chicken dishes then it's always Cafe Napoli. The chicken cardinale in wine sauce is top notch and you will never see bigger portions.

The club recently raised their rates. Read the find print. A $29 start up fee and $39 membership fee. They use to charge no fees for existing members. THe  previous owner charged $99.00 for a 12 month membership.  I will be looking at Youfit who still offers $99.for a year with no fees. Disappointed that Planet Fitness does not value loyal members.
Food is always good and fresh. They are always happy to put whatever you want and even a little extra if you ask. Delicious. Staff very friendly as well.

They're great. They're awesome. Had multiple stylist do my hair on multiple occasions and everyone of them has done a good job. Nothing bad to say. They're professionals here and know what they're doing.

This is the ONLY place I buy my shoes... and I live in California! I can't say enough good things about Marti and Liz. On my last trip I got a pair of Ed Hardy tennis shoes, a pair of Tommy Hilfiger pumps, AND a pair of BRAND NEW Sketcher's Shape Up tennis shoes (which are usually $100 +) for $25 each... can't beat that. Make sure you go on Thursday and Friday because those are the days they put out their new shoes. You WILL find something! I PROMISE!

Unexpected.  We landed here by chance.  They have a simple Saturday and Sunday all you can eat buffet for $10. Everything on the menu was worth going back for seconds.  Grits that make your mouth water for more.  Friendly, fast, and tentative service.  Out waiters name was Jeffrey, he was superb.  Highly recommended for a weekend breakfast, you won't be disappointed!

We came as a huge family, ordered lots of food: 3orders of scallion pancake (pretty good) 3 orders of fried noodles (some of the noodles are not fully cooked) 1 order of fish congee ( really good) 1 order sautéed spinach (salty ) 2 order of fried rice (alright) 1 order of green bean with pork (ok) 2 order of spicy wonton (THEY OnLY GAVE US ONE, decide to not go get it cuz is too far) the rest is alright. They were at busy hour so the server is kind of mean, and we ordered some drinks...they were sweet and really powdery ! And yea, three star because most of the food are good but they forgot one order !

Love all of the unique flavors and the mixture "cookie monster."  Not the best ice-cream I have had but pretty darn close! Whenever I get a "cheat meal" I like to head over to Creole creamery... yum! cash only

Self service ordering and great tasting food. Service was great as well.

The dining area was more clean than I've seen in awhile.
I've had some great finds here, but you gotta dig. That's cool. That's why I'm at a record store in the first place.
I will start with 2 words: JASON BRADSHAW.  Jason is awesome, he is amazing at so many types of art and I am fortunate enough to have two tattoos by him.  You'll love his work.

We went there last night for our Valentine's Day celebration. The staff was friendly and very efficient. The food was expertly prepared, perfectly seasoned and clearly made with love. I love that they had some half bottles on the wine list, we found a great chianti Classico reserva. The calamari was the best I've ever had in St. Louis. The lasagna was divine! The creme brulee was perfection! And it paired perfectly with the amaro nonino. Our server was clearly a professional. 
This is my new favorite restaurant for sure!!
I can't believe I've never been here before!

Frozen Yogurt places have been popping up all over New Orleans. It's becoming an over-done craze and also creates a lot of competition for a good review. 

I'd say that the yogurt at Orange Leaf was okay, their flavors weren't very exciting and I was escorted through my samplings.  The server wouldn't just give me tasting cups, she stood by my side and would put the yogurt into the sampling cups that I wanted to try.  Obnoxiously, she would do it one immediately after the other, trying to pass them all into my hands when I was obviously already holding one cup in one hand and my wallet in the other.  She was impatient and rushing me through so I don't even really understand what I tasted.  I do know however, that what I tasted was not as good as the frozen yogurt I've had at other places, like Yogurtland or Plum Crazy.

I think what also annoyed me was that I entered the establishment and waited around inside for about 8 minutes before someone showed up at the front counter.  I actually thought they had closed, but had forgotten to lock the doors.

Did I also mention that it's extremely cold to sit in the store?

So summary? Just okay yogurt, toppings were okay as well, and service was terrible.  Oh wait, almost forgot.  The yogurt consistency is soft, maybe watery.  So expect your yogurt to melt and disappear fast after you put some toppings on.  BTW for some toppings, they force you take a certain amount instead of just a little.

I think it's garbage that they started making me wait in line for them to pump my coffee out of the thermos - and still makes me walk to the back of the store to pour my own milk. Let us do it all ourselves like we've been doing for as long as I can remember or really make my coffee! I do not like this system - it makes me late now and I won't be stopping in the morning any longer. Other than that - if you don't have a job or aren't in any sort of hurry, go to buddy brew because the coffee is good

I love this place.  You are greeted by the friendliest people as soon as you go it.  The chicken and side dishes are next best thing to your own cooking.  Corn bread---YUM.   Just a great place to go to.   No complaints about any of it.

Have been going to MexiCali ever since it was a store, not a food truck. Overall, great value and great quality burritos. 

My go-to is the Pollo Y Papas burrito which is a great chicken/sweet potato combo burrito. You can choose what level of spiciness you want in the sauce which is nice. I think the sweet potato option is great - you don't often come across places that put sweet potato in their burritos, but it's absolutely delicious. They also have a variety of vegetarian options . 

I also like that they have jarritos - always down for that!

By far the best donut I have ever had. And the cold brew coffee was amazing !! But have to say there was quite a group of us so we ordered many different donuts and the hands down winner was .......(drum roll) the grilled Cubano on a donut ?!?!? I know sounds crazy but is was the best Cubano I have eaten and I just came from Maimi!!!

Charming little place.  The food and service were good, so I recommend trying it.  Doesn't seem to be the most popular place around, but that doesn't bother me.

Give it a try
