Had a latte , little too sweet but the ice cream and fresh waffle cones being made make me want to go back

Someone who reads my reviews may be sensing a theme: dive bars. And yeah, I like paying a little and getting a lot. This place was good. The bartender scoffed at the cocktails on the menu, which was perfect, because we didn't see a damn thing we liked. He made us his own special tequila drink with hot sauce and pineapple juice which was actually incredible--I had two. I also ordered their grown up grilled cheese. I get that grilled cheese is easy as pie to make, but I'll be damned if it wasn't the best grilled cheese I've ever tasted. All of this and the price was RIGHT. I strongly recommend.

We went for Sunday breakfast. We ordered the French Toast, Pork Belly Sandwich and Biscuits and Gravy and a dossant. My wife ordered loose leaf tea and I had coffee. I'll start with the service: top notch, really just amazing. You'll notice Phil from Jax Kitchen as a familiar face and he does an excellent job as does all of the other wait staff. Very, very attentive. The food is excellent overall. The biscuits were light and flaky (clearly handmade) and the gravy was amazing. Creamy, flavorful and just right. My pork belly sandwich was equally good. I could have done without the shredded apple and the pork belly didn't seem braised but it was still very good. The french toast was the best! Buttery, flavorful and well executed. We tried to have the original "Cronut" ala D. Ansel in New York, but it didn't work out. I think this would be a worthy substitute.

Leslie and her crew are excellent. They work around your schedule and are very thorough when they arrive. Leslie always makes sure my place is in top shape and goes above and beyond in asking questions if I need anything else done a certain way. Would highly recommend her cleaning services.

Yuu-UM! Great food, upbeat ambiance, great service...overall an amazing experience and restaurant! I loved that they played latin/spanish music! It is definitely a lively environment---amazing complement to the mexican cuisine served! 

For antojitos/appetizers: 

First, get the guacamole ($9). Someone will come by and mix & blend the ingredients from scratch into a delicious dip! 

The queso fundido ($9)---ok, it's simple in nature: melted cheese. But it is DELICIOUS! It is served with a side of warm, steamed tortillas. So good. 

The pulpo ($12)---light and delicious! Highly recommend it! 

Main entree: 

The salmon ($22). It is served with green fava beans and some bites of fried yuca, over a sea of some tasty, green sauce. The yuca was a tad salty but still great. The salmon was beautifully broiled and flavorful. Overall, a mouth-melting meal! 

No desert. But next time!

We absolutely LOVE coming here! 

We always come and do happy hour margaritas and guacamole before our movie, and every time it's AMAZING!!!! We had Josh as our server this time and he made it even better. He's super funny and his guac is FIRE!! Can't wait to come back and have him be our server again! 

If you're looking for a before movie place or just an awesome dinner, you found your new spot!
Very chill place in a lazy part of mid-town.  Plenty of indoor/outdoor space, good menu.  Great spot any time of the day.

First time here so they gave us 10% off and free drinks! The food was fab! I ordered the chicken roll up and the cheese was mouth melting and my boyfriend ordered the steak roll up and it was so good!!!!! We wanna know what kind of sauce they use for the dipping sauce :( but for my side I ordered the vegetables and they were really salty. I just won't get the vegetables as sides next time but for entrees I'll definitely come again!

I've been to a couple Comedy Hideaway shows. They were both a good time. The headliner usually ends up being pretty funny but some of the opening comedians need a little more practice. I wouldn't really complain though for the prices of the shows. It isn't Kevin Hart, but it's not a bad event to come to to have a casual time and laugh with friends.

We used the Master's Baker for our wedding cake last week. Hope was our consultant and she was so sweet and helpful. The cake was so pretty! Even more important, it was delicious. We had two flavors, lemon and carrot cake...so good! Definitely recommend!

This place is by far my favorite nail shop! The staff is so professional, great time management and the shop is so clean! I wont go anywhere else again. Nancy did my pedicure and it was the best one Ive ever had!!

I lived around the corner from Black Sheep for two+ years, and I wanted to like it.  Everytime I went, I wanted to like it.  But everytime I left...yeah, not so much.  Part of the problem is the plethora of better bars nearby, most notably Good Dog, Monk's, Tangier, and, of course, McGlinchey's.  Another issue: hostess seating in the main room at all times - why?  It's a bar, just let people come in, get a beer, and sit where they find a seat.

But the bigger problem is the clientele.  Not exactly a neighborhood (or city) crowd.  For whatever reason this place draws an "older" crowd, and not in a good way.  And when the crowd is younger, it seems as though all of them crossed the Ben Franklin Bridge to get there.

Food: american cheese in the Quesadilla is never, never ok. Let that be your indication.

Long story short: there's better bars.

Great place for brunch! The staff is amazing! Everyone greeted us as we walked in. Our waiter was great he filled us in on the menus & drinks.The food was delicious! I Definitely recommend this place.
Why go anywhere else on campus? Never had a bad experience and Richie is a great guy. Buffalo Chicken Cheesesteak is a classic there.

This place is always delicious (anything you get is going to be amazing), staff has always been friendly, never hesitant to make honest recommendations and they serve hot tea in one of those cool tea press things which makes me feel fancy. 
Yes, the wait can be long but trust me - it really is worth it to stand around all those smelly man-buns and loud sorority babes.

My girlfriend and I love Indian food and always hit up spots we find. We were in the area and stopped in for lunch on Sunday and loved this place!  It's a little lunch spot that has better food than fancier Indian restaurants. Everything we ordered was delicious and the prices weren't bad at all. Definitely an awesome lunch spot you need to visit.

Fantastic restaurant, had the truffle and foie gras pasta special and it was worth every penny.  The spicy crab was just as good, as was the grilled octopus.  The service, including the host and just about everyone we passed on the way in and out of the restaurant, is genuinely friendly and attentive.  I honestly couldn't have asked for a better dining experience.  Having just moved to the neighborhood I look forward to making this a regular spot.

Dr. Gibbs and his staff are truly exceptional. I've never had a better experience at any other dental office. They make you feel welcome and take care of you in a timely matter; I've never waited more than 5 or so minutes in the waiting room. They remember who you are, things you've talked about, and just generally do amazing work. 

I had a lot of major problems, but they made me feel comfortable and calmed my nerves. (I'm normally terrified of the dentist.) Dr. Gibbs assured me that we would take it step by step and that I would be taken care of. I can gladly say he was so right! I am pain free and now only working on minor issues. 

Another major thing I've noticed is that I've never heard a single member of the staff say anything negative. I've been to a number of offices where the staff talks to you like you are incompetent on the phone, or makes snide remarks about patients after they leave or hang up. Not here! They are not only respectful, but caring too. I would recommend Dr. Gibbs to EVERYONE!
Kathy is the best!! She did a beautiful job in our home, the wallpaper came out seamless. The job site was left clean. Kathy is very personable, knowledgeable and a perfectionist.

My family swears by this place because of the wonderful food at great service. This is a family owned resaurant owned by two brothers and their wives.
A lot of the food is not your standard Szechuan/American hybrid. While they do have a few of the standard dishes that we think of as Chinese like beef with broccoli and Mongolian chicken, many of their dishes are Cantonese style. If you are a fan of Egg Foo Yong, this is the place to get it.
Their lunch buffet is very affordable, at six dollars for Monday through Friday and seven dollars on weekends. This includes drinks. The thing I love about it is it has several very popular standard dishes that are always on the buffet, but also has a few unusual dishes so that your experience at the buffet is never the same.
My dad took my sister and me there last week for a buffet. He doesn't like Hot and Sour soup and devoured it. He was amazed that they even had Chinese desserts, which he loved more than some Western desserts.

Nothing has changed since the last time I was in this drive thru, except at the moment I've been waiting for twenty minutes....thought I'd keep busy and update my review. I'm tired and hungry- next time I'll get some tacos from an actual restaurant and just call it in. This is completely ridiculous....waiting and waiting. Two cars ahead of me....last time I'll ever come to this place I really mean this now!
This pizza is really good! Probably the best pizza I have had in Florida. I just love their thin crust pizza. Yum!

Country Sweets made both my Baby Shower cake and most recently my Daughter's baptism cake! Both cakes were absolutely to die for. My daughters baptism cake consisted of a dense moist almond pound cake with a raspberry mousse filling. It was mouth watering. The cake was a lot larger than I anticipated, ordered a 14" round cake and we had 36 adults and 6 kids and we still had 1/2 a cake left and everyone had a very generous portion of cake. Great Quality, Great Price, Friendly Service and. a beautiful cake. Safe to say you have a customer for life! See you for her 1st Birthday Cake!

We love burger up! One of the first elevated burger places in Nashville Burger Up always has us coming back for several years. The marathon burger is the best burger and veg friendly! Great service and delicious beers and cocktails. What more could you want.

Ive been hearing things....the best...awesome....over rated...a little pricey...rude servers.

Sometimes you just have to check it out for yourself.

I found this place to be awesome in every way....great service and atmosphere....I only wish the kitchen was open when we go there.

A second date will clear up all my questions.

When contemplating a pregame spot for the Yelp 10th bash, I was glad when some good friends invited me to meet at black sheep for a number of reasons.

First it was spending time with good friends instead of drinking alone like an asshole. Second, in order to keep my elite status, I need to review things and in order to review things, I actually have to go somewhere, otherwise I'm reviewing another damn McDonalds. 

Lastly, since I never go out, eating out is a treat I relish and Black Sheep didn't disappoint. I had a happy hour Guinness and 2 of their $5 apps ( wings and cheesesteak spring rolls). Both were out of this world. I'd go so far as to say that the wings rivaled the best I've ever had. 

So mark Black Sheep as a new go to pub in Philly. They had me at $5.

First of all, Asian Kitchen is in a great location, the Seabreeze Plaza at US 19 and Curlew. As you enter the place, you will notice how clean it is. The menu is fairly standard. Take out and eat in are offered. I've had the Beef Lo Mein, the Hot & Sour soup, egg rolls and Beef with Oyster sauce over several visits. At the very least all the food is very flavorful. The Hot & Sour soup was outstanding! I was a little disappointed in the amount of meat in the Beef with Oyster Sauce but otherwise it was very good. The staff is pleasant and very efficient. I plan to work my way through the menu over time.

Everything Alyssa, Paula and Martha said. 

Wendy is The Real Deal. She's brilliant, hilarious, down to earth, and just good at what she does.
I ordered popcorn chicken, beef stew with rice and stinky tofu. They were all good and closed to Real Taiwanese flavor. Stinky tofu was ok but kimchi was great.
If your'e a scallop fan, this place has some of the best. They really know how to cook 'em! Casual, fun place in a cool little neighborhood - will definitely go back.

I LOVE the Fur Bee. After moving to Indianapolis from Michigan I was unsure of where to take my puppy and selected the Fur Bee after some careful research.

I have a miniature golden doodle who started seeing Ted when he was only a couple months old. Ted was so great with him! My dog enjoyed going and was never scared to leave me. He always came out looking exactly as I had hoped and smelled great for weeks! 

Golden doodle hair can be hard to groom as it gets matted easy and can be hard to take. I always loved how Bo looked when he was finished - never too poodle like I had asked. Would definitely recommend!

Been here several times and it has never disappointed.  My favorite dish is the Chicken and Spinach Cannelloni while my wife loves the Chicken Spedini.  Their bread is fantastic as well, which is served with a little hummus.  I've never had anything on the menu here that wasn't good.  They used to have a hanger steak dish that was excellent, although I haven't seen it on the menu in quite some time.  It is a casual place to have a nice dinner.  We did try to the toasted ravioli the last time we were there, and they were great as well.  I really have nothing bad to say about this place.  I've never had dessert there, mainly because Ted Drewes is right down the street. :)
Honestly obsessed with Topperstix, wish they still had the pizza with honey mustard on it. Hope they're doing well!

stopped in for a quick lunch, wife had a side salad cobbed, I had a full size cobb, brought some of both home, too good too not finish. server Cody c was top of the line as always. cook Miles n went out of the way to package up a half dozen oysters for our 91 year old roomie who was pickled tink  with the very fresh shellfish very nice place, good people, great food. will return as often as possible
Awesome Cuban sandwich! This is a nice local spot for a quick bite to eat. They also have a ice cream shop and the typical snacks.
If you love calzones then you will love this place. They are so big that I am never able to finish them. Best calzone in STL.

Slainte used to be a fantastic lunch spot, especially since its right across the street from our office and there really hasn't been much around, but it has REALLY gone down hill.  I recently returned after a long hiatus only to see that they revamped their menu and took probably 60% of the items off.

They used to have an amazing turkey burger, but its gone.  In its place?  TACOS.  You know, the traditional Irish taco.  Perfect for an Irish Pub?  Get the heck out of here!  What are they doing?!?! TACOS?!?!  SMH.

They also used to have amazing daily specials but those seem to be a thing of the past as well.

It's too bad.  We used to come here once a week, sometimes more.  Now I bet it'll be more like once a month, if that.  There are just too many other options now and the extra walk to them is worth it.

Recommended by my wedding venue. They did an absolutely amazing job on our cake.  The cake was moist and the buttercream frosting was delicious.  Considering that I was really not sure exactly what I wanted and only had an idea. My cake was exactly what I wanted simple and meaningful.  Thank you for making my wedding cake so meaningful!
Had ribeye melt for lunch.  While it was good, it was expensive and not very filling especially for the price.  Expected more

We come by New Day every time we are in town.  The mead and cider here are delicious, and with two people its easy to split two flights and try all of them.  We will keep coming back to New Day as long as it is still open!

Dear Dake, 
We came in because we knew that Colin is an incredible chef, but we stayed because YOU are AMAZING! I mean, that smile, that service, attention to detail... and those filet medallions and beverages you brought over.... Thank you, Dake for taking care of us after the rodeo and dealing with our last minute reservation and me talking WAY too much! We appreciate you and can't wait to come back!!!  (earlier in the evening, of course)

Oops I had written a review for the wrong place! So disregard previous review. 

I know this place is popular in Bellevue but honestly I think it's just okay. The coffee is good (I like the maple latte) but the menu isn't clear and the desserts aren't usually very fresh. Maybe I've just had a bad experience but i'll try it again!

My girlfriends and I came in to celebrate our friends engagement and the service was terrific! Phil and Shannon both had such great personalities and had us laughing! They are definitely an great asset to the bar! I love bartenders who get to know their customers we will be going back!

Excellent quality pizza for the price. Large cheese pizza for $10.95. I used Grubhub and got my food delivered. Food arrived 10 minutes early and the driver was friendly. All things considered definitely a 5 star experience. Will order again!
I love this place!  The bagels and donuts are delicious!  It's so nice to finally have a great bagel shop on the main line!

If it weren't for the beer I'd give this 1 star, good beer, completely awful service. The bartenders did not offer any education when it came to their beers and seemed like pouring me a beer was a nuisance. But nothing came close to as bad as the "chef" in their small kitchen. When my girlfriend asked how were the nachos he simply replied smugly "they're chips with cheese on them". He then gave me a beeper and since my party was upstairs I asked how long the wait would be to see if I should just wait downstairs, to which Prince Charming replied "your food is ready when your number goes off". Disappointing experience since I think they have the best beer in STL.
Visuals are interest.  Food  is fine.  Service is very good

This place changed hands about 1 year ago as Mister HotShine bought several carwashes in Tucson. Mostly you wouldn't notice any big change other than the staff was better on service. I had a issue with a $129 detail job and called the location and they said they would get back to me with an answer within 2 days They didn't call back.
So I called their local Corp office and was given the "regioonal managers" phone number. Well:
He was quick to answer
Told me he would look into it and get back to me
2 days he called back
Admitted it was their fault and get a bid to fix it then call him

I did that, called him with the cost ($90.) and he said get it fixed & he will pay for it and give me a great wash when I returned with the bill.

This was one of those "this will never happen" deals 
BUT IT DID AND THATS WHY I'M WRITTING.

THEY HAVE MY BUSINESS AND SHOULD GET YOURS AS WELL

Happy customer

This place reminds me of the steakhouses I went to growing up. Good country band playing, lots of noise, local servers who seem to never leave and always remember you and good solid food. 

We did a big family gathering here before my daughter's wedding and reserved the big room in the back. They took great care of us and served a group of 40+ in record time. This is always a fun place to go on a Friday or Saturday night to have a simple steak with a long neck and some two stepping fun to work off the meal.
Went for lunch while in town for work and did not disappoint.  Agreed that parking can be confusing but it's worth it.
Very good Chinese take out! We really like the general tous tofu and the lo main. Delivery was on time. Will definitely order from here again.
Best eye care in Tucson. First place that the glasses were perfect the first timet. Took no time getting used to. Dr. Martin and the staff are awesome! Highly recommended.

North 53.... The ideal cozy little late night date venue.  At least that was my first thoughts and impressions upon going to North 53. 

The venue is small, dimly light and just cozy. North 53 has a signature smoke & oak drink that smells basically like camp fire and well smoke.. So if you're lucky enough to walk in when someone has just ordered it, you'll get this amazing waft of smoke as you walk through the door. 

First off, if you go to North 53, definitely go with the intention of trying one or more of the hand crafted signature drinks. We had the Smoke & Oak, the London Calling (think a london fog with booze) and one other one (don't remember it). All the drinks were great. There's definitely a reason this place has been on yeg's list of best drinks in the city. 

The menu has a few appetizers and a handful of main entrées. My friend and I each just ordered two appetizers and that more than enough for both of us. My friend ordered the salmon and the brussel sprouts and I ordered the fried chicken and meatballs. I can't speak for my friend's dishes, although she said it was tasty. My favorite of my 2 dishes was definitely the meatballs, although the chicken was moist/tender and came with a tasty dipping sauce. 

Overall this place was great and like I initially stated, the perfect cozy date night venue. My guess is that they probably get pretty busy on weekends and during regular dining hours so I would suggest reservations or just go a little later in the evening. I will absolutely be going back to North 53 in the future.

I went to Clarkson Eyecare in the CWE the other day to get my first eye exam in close to 10 years - and to get my very first pair of glasses! I can speak most highly to their customer service. One of the Opticians, named Rita, took such amazing care of me and was so incredibly kind and patient. Good customer service goes such a long way and I am very grateful that she practically held my hand through the whole process and was so genuinely nice. I came away with a great new pair of glasses. The store is very nice and the process was all very seamless. Thank you to the entire staff for such an easy experience and to Dr. Sherman for all of the exams.

Went to this location before and liked it fine, but I went just now and TERRIBLE. The person who took my order was perfectly nice,  the person at the window didn't look at me, overcharged me, did not give me a receipt, and closed the window in my face without speaking to me. The store was not busy at the time so I can't imagine she was helping someone else. On top of all that, my iced coffee was no good. Three ice cubes floating in warm coffee is not iced coffee! I didn't have time to go in and try to fix it or I would've asked for a manager. UGH.

Went there on Thursday late in the  afternoon, I was really looking forward to their Sea Urchin and rock crab, unfortunately they were sold out. Their next batch was not to come in from their fisherman until the evening (at we know it's fresh). Settled for their scallop ceviche -- it was a bit underwhelming, flavor was a bit lacking. Their clam chowder was really good. Crab cakes were a bit subpar (not enough crab chunks, kinda doughy). I may return again the next time I'm up that way. Will try to get there a bit earlier in the afternoon for availability of rock crab and sea urchin. I am really hoping the place can redeem itself the next time around.

We took the Katrina Tour with our Guide Carol and driver George. Our Family of 3 where the only ones on it. WE HAD A BLAST. Carol had so much history and stories and facts from being born and raised right in the area. She had done her homework above and beyond. She put all kinds of great information together. Gremlins you have a Gem working for you. George the driver did a great job at knowing when Carol wanted to stop and to concentrate on the important areas of the tour.

Treated myself to dinner here last night and I'll definitely be back! I had the egg rolls and shrimp in Boiling House sauce. The environment is very nice and the staff was extremely friendly and helpful. Now I wasn't prepared to be breaking shells or anything but that's okay because it was delicious!  And the lava cake was sooooooooo good!!!!
I'll definitely be back!

We found this restaurant online and decided to try it the food was excellent I had to blacken fish and the Greek salad and the service was excellent then I also have Cafe Con Leche for dessert which I've never had one before and I fell in love with it me and my husband will return again

Judith. You rock. 
Fast, efficient, kind service and a beautiful attitude.

Have not been here in awhile, and were pleased with the Dark Hero and IPA.  Good to see the quality of beer and service have returned to a level we experienced 5+ years ago.  Thank you, John for bringing the Brewpub back!

Ordered before the morning rush and got a chance to talk to the employees. All really nice and knowledgeable. I tried the Nitro Latte (on tap) and my friend got an Iced Vanilla Lavender Latte. The Nitro Latte was pretty good if you like creamy and light. Compared to the Vanilla Lavender Latte though, it had a bolder taste. Overall presentation and experience was good. I recommend and will go again next time I'm back in Reno.

My husband and I stopped in last night.  I've gotten to-go orders here before, but never actually sat down in the place.  They have a lot of square footage so even though there were easily 10-12 parties in there, it looked pretty empty.  I think that might work against them....people tend to stay away from restaurants that appear to be empty.  My advice to you all:  go here anyway.

We got chips with cheese dip and guac to start - both dips were super delicious!  And since we were there during happy hour, it was only $3!

My husband got brisket tacos and pork tacos.  He reported that both were delicious.  I got the shrimp tacos and thought they were fantastic.  The slaw they put on them has the perfect amount of spiciness in it - really good.  Definitely will order again.

We didn't drink but both were very surprised by their selection of beers.  You would never suspect it judging from the outside!  I'm sure we'll be making a repeat trip for a drink soon.

We also didn't try the donuts but people seemed to really enjoy them.

I never felt rushed, nor did I feel like I was waiting a long time for anything.
 We were in and out in about 30 minutes, which was perfect since we were catching a movie as well. 

Super fast & friendly service, shockingly great beer selection, and really good tacos.  Can't ask for much more than that!

Small kitchen experience with an intimate dining feel. Trendy and engaging. The server recommended a drink off the menu for my taste and the mixologist served it up.right. wings for appetizers., sliders and.pork chop for dinner. A great night out!
Amazing selection, great food, great service! Chicken and Waffles, Eggs Benedict, pancakes and omelets. All were amazing. We will definitely be back!

This new little gem is just open up on Waters. It's a mother and daughter collaboration. The owners are so nice and it feels like I'm at their home for dinner. Best service! The prices are crazy inexpensive...I can't imagine it will stay this low once this place catches on. The inside is adorable and the food is great! We were there for an event and got to try the Polynesia chicken, tuna sandwich and the stuffed French toast. Everything was fantastic and all made in house! I highly recommend!!!
Nice atmosphere. A little pricey. Food was great. It's a good place to go for a summer dinner where it's still light enough to enjoy the view. I would go again

Great ambiance and service! I got the biscuits and gravy with two poached eggs on top--which was pretty darn good. My only complaint would be that my food was a little cold when it got to me. Other than that, I thoroughly enjoyed it.
Good was delicious....I had the ramen bowl and couldn't stop. Spicy, high notes of ginger, sweet, loads of pork and a lovely egg. Would come back and order again.

If you want good Southern style food do not go to Biscuit Love. Being from the south, I am offended by the food. It is strictly for tourists who don't know how biscuits, gravy, grits, etc are supposed to taste. There is no service although they expect you to tip and It is very over priced. Have been twice to give them the benefit of the doubt and will never go back. If you are from out of town please go anywhere else if you want to have Southern cooking. Even Bojangles would be better.

I've been to Vegas and I like this place more....in many ways..and less in other ways.  The more?  This place is HUGE....I don't think I've been in a Vegas casino with this many slots.  They even just expanded and put in more parking.  They have tons of parking, but it's still hard to get a spot most evenings.  They say there are over 4100 slot machines and I can't believe there's not more.  With the newest expansion, the place goes on and on.  So, instead of running from casino to casino, in Vegas, we are in one spot with every slot under the sun and close to home.  For that we love it.  The bartenders are fantastic...especially at our favorite bar.  Once you become a regular, they treat you like one.  Some of the new bartenders, like the dark, long haired girl in the brand new room , by the pool, who worked the night of 5/26, was downright mean.  She had no idea how to make a drink and got upset because I told her it wasn't good, she got  Incredibly snippy and defensive.  It's bad when you can't even swallow it.  She made drinks for our friends too....all bad. She wasn't close to nice and she didn't know how to make a drink. Bad drinks and attitude. So, I walked all the way across the casino to our favorite bartenders and they glady made me another(which I paid for again) and ahhhhhhh....it was absolutely perfect and it was served with a big smile. :)  I do think it should be the policy that you are treated well by the staff, since you are there spending $$$.  She didn't get the memo.  Another complaint would be the 1.00 sodas.  I know they are free...........but, did you ever take a free one?  The girls get angry when you do.  Most of the time, my money is in the machine...and I don't have a 1.00....so, I won't get a soda.........because I'd rather not be glared at and have someone huff off.  I've had that happen....and it's crazy.  They should get the memo that the drinks are free and not everyone can tip....beause their money is in the machine.  Theys should offer comps...like rooms.  They use to... My casino host ignores any emails I send him...which is incredibly rare that I ask for anything...but, he ignores them.  If you are there a lot....give people some free drinks.  Something.  But, other than that..........I'd rather go here than anywhere else....I love the noise, music and the energy.  Play slow.......don't get in your head that you need to make $$.  Plan what you are going to spend.......relax and enjoy yourself.  Some people play hard and want their money back..........no can do.  It doesn't work that way.  Just play with what you can...find some cheap penny machines and relax.  If you have big bucks,....go spend them.  But, if you are on a budget........think less is more.  Play slow, sip a drink and enjoy yourself.  Don't expect to win........expect to have fun.  So, if you do win....it's a nice suprise. :)
I love Amber Indian. Their food is fairly close to what some of my Indian friends made back in college, and I look forward to having a meal from there at least once per week!
I had banana french toast.  I am coming back here (from San Francisco) because of this dish.  It was worth every minute of the wait, which is a bit on Sundays.  Try going on another day if possible.

Went here for my brother and my birthday. Our group was a table of 12 on a Saturday night. We had great service great food and great drinks. We had the shrimp tacos, pork and beans, both burger options, filet ordered and we all loved out meals. Definitely will be coming back as often as possible.

RIDICULOUS establishment!! I had to call corporate multiple times on a single employee think the name is Jasmine.  This young person has BY FAR THE WORST ATTITUDE EVER!!!!! Quick snapshot I am a public servant went through the drive thru to pick up my order which is NEVER an issue with any other employee I while in uniform asked can you apply emergency service employee discount? She said "WHAT" I again repeated myself same question she immediately turned her back and threw my bag of food on the counter and said I can't believe he wants a discount.  That made me be not so kind in response...my wife spoke to the manager and then called the corporate office they were going to look into it.  Fast forward about a month later went inside same location hadn't went there for a long time because of the little jerk employee she strikes me as the type that would spit in your food... anyway went in there with regular clothes on not sure if she recognized me from the month ago anyway she said "is there a reason you are looking at me?"  Again my response was not to kind as I wasn't staring or giving her any reason to say anything to me.. She just in true HOODRAT format I guess called herself challenging me! The manager while seemingly a nice guy has ZERO control over this little young employee to the degree my assessment was I have to reach a higher level to speak on this.  I know that CHICK FIL A everywhere and I have lived in many places has an extensive hiring process to include keeping Bokeefa and dem out dat spot.... through multiple interviews, ensuring no visible tattoos, no mixed hair color, assume a personality check.. Although the aforementioned person doesn't have the hair or tattoo issues the personality is indeed dysfunctional!! SO obviously they missed one!  Had to call Corporate again on the second incident they said they were sending someone to this location based upon second complaint on the same person! Again manager was a nice guy but lacked the control of the establishment! CHICK FIL A is not the cheap place to eat as such (fast food) u just expect a little better in the service department! Do better or change the staff!!! Other than that further up Roosevelt Boulevard is 100% always on point ZERO issues!!!!  Which in my opinion is the best option..... to ensure the correct location I am speaking of the TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE this was at Rising Sun Plaza at Roosevelt Boulevard and Adams Avenue! The one to go to is up by Red Lion Road!

I am one of the World's pickiest eaters ... Sally Albreit from "When Harry Met Sally" has nothing on me. I can deconstruct an entree and rebuild it to my exact specifications in seconds ... which is why I was so surprised how much I LOVED the BBQ Chicken Pizza exactly as it was listed on the menu. The crust was great, the BBQ sauce smoky yet sweet, and the chicken was nice and white with no chicken funkiness. Take it from me, you will be happy you ordered this pizza!

We have been enjoying Enzo's on such a regular basis since it was reinvented out of the former Nabruzzi that I decided it was time for a yelp review. By now, we have tried everything from appetizers and daily soups to pizza, Strombolis, pastas and dessert. The portions are amazing and the pricing is family friendly. Tonight, we enjoyed fabulous service from Charlie. His knowledge of the menu and ingredients was excellent as well as we wanted to check out a few items that we had been wanting to try from our prior visits. We definitely are enjoying the improved service, generous portions and well priced menu from Enzo's and look forward to even more visits.

Fuzzys has officially become my new favorite place. From the minute I walked in the the staff was extremely helpful and friendly. There's numerous drink and food specials throughout the week which made the environment even more fun! My favorite meal by far is the Fajita Chicken Burrito Bowl! Extremely tasty and filling!

We stayed two nights while visiting Philadelphia: two parents and two kids, 13 and 11.  The hotel design is reminiscent of the W Hotel line, but somewhat downscale.  It's definitely not the run-of-the-mill Holiday Inn.

The complimentary Wired magazine gives you a clue, along with the typical USA Today.  There's a junction box in the room to connect all your electronics to the flat-panel screen mounted to the wall.  Free wireless Internet access.  Two cordless phones and a retro alarm clock.  In our room, two pedestal queen size beds were covered in quality sheets and a comfortable duvet.  The ceilings are oversize, lending to a feel of roominess.

The bathroom has an above-counter basin, a walk-in tiled shower with rain-like shower head, and Euro-style shampoo and body wash dispensers.  There's a refrig underneath.

The "splash pool" was a normal pool, 5ft deep on one end sloping to 3 ft on the other end.  Fine for doing laps.  I didn't see a spa.  The registration "desk" is kind of like a kiosk in the lobby next to the juice bar.

We Hotwired a $69 rate.  When I tried to go directly to their websote for reservations, it was $189!  I wouldn't be too happy with the accommodations at that rate.  But for $69 this place was great.

Only two downsides from my POV:  $6 parking charge - what for?  Seems unnecessary.   On top of that, the gate machine broke down while I was watching from the room.  A big queue formed, and they finally took the gate arm off while they worked on it.

The access road seemed to be an emergency route of some kind.  I heard sirens wailing every 15-30 mins or so, it seemed.

I'd go back, via Hotwire.

I Really wanted some tacos, so I decided to stop by here. The cashier that took my order was very nice and accommodating. Overall, my tacos were bery bland , sloppy and lacked flavor. Although the ingredients sound good on the board. The ingredients don't really shine through and all you taste is mush. For example, I had the pork taco w/ jalapeño slaw. The slaw was chopped very fine  and seemed more  like relish. All you taste is watery mayo and nothing resembling Jalapeño.

Shrimp taco- just lettuce and red mayo that was supposed to be spicy  mayo. No spice at all and my shrimp were very hard as if they were just reheated and not fired fresh.

You would be better off getting tacos from Taco Bell. One thing I will say, my Salted Caramel Donut was AMAZING! The salted caramel was the right amount of sweetness and the cake donut was moist and not greasy. S

I am eating healthier and wasted my cheat day and $11 on this. No more cheat days!
So glad we finally made it last weekend, if your from Cali these are the kind of street tacos were used too... soooo yummy .and the torta was bomb

Booking is easy.  Staff is helpful and quick to reply to questions.  Pre-instructions leave no surprises.  There is ample free parking at Island Packers near the ferry dock.  Santa Cruz Island takes about an hour by ferry.  Kayakers are provided with a mandatory helmet and life jacket.  There are secure storage boxes for all the extra stuff you brought that you won't need.  A dry pouch is recommended for cash (ferry purchases and tipping), granola bars, sun block and underwater camera.  You may want a water bottle with a clip to hook to your life vest.  The guides are helpful and knowledgeable.  Hector fascinated us with history of the Island and its wildlife.  The caves are amazing.  There is time after kayaking for lunch, hiking and snorkeling.  It was such fun that we are thinking of making this a yearly event.

Solid. The best part about going to Whaley's is the fact you just stopped at a roadside BBQ smoke shack to get food. Hell yeah. I have always wanted to try the ribs but I haven't had the chance yet. I feel it's very possible another star is in their future once I do. As for the pork sandwiches? 5 for 10 bucks! (Or 2 for $5) Come on! Smoked on site, soft buns, and great homemade sauce, what more do you want out of your roadside BBQ stand? If you find yourself hungry while riding out on 41 someday, swing in and try it out!

The food is delicious, it's an upscale restaurant with up scale prices. The service was AWFUL. Our waiter was in a terrible mood, was annoyed that we ordered coffee at 11am and over explained everything about the menu in a condescending fashion. We payed $80 for our meal and tipped 20% anyway. After we had payed our bill one of our friends went to use the restroom so we were waiting and taking care of some business our our phones. A manager approached our table, began to clear plates and made a comment "Due to the excessive texting & playing on your phones and the lack of noshing I'm going to assume you'll all done here." Basically asking us to leave. I explained that we were still waiting on a member of our party to return and that we would free up the table shortly. To which he responded with a smirk "Ok, keep being awesome."  We were a group of 4 young people and It is my believe that were being discriminated against because of our age. The table next to us had been there longer, had ordered less, was a bigger group, and an older demographic.  If you're a young working professional who would like to feel snubbed, by all means go to Butcher & Bee.

Know going in, this is a strip mall order at a counter restaurant.
That being said, very interesting sandwich selection.  We had one panini, one cranberry bread with cream cheese, avocado, sprouts(fabulous), and a grilled chicken sandwich, and a fruit tart.  Only complaint is the chicken breast was minuscule, soooo small.  As others have noted, they are a bit unorganized, which slows them down a bit, otherwise, beautiful yummy food and baked goods.

They should change the name from "Antique Mall" to "Junk Store".  I've always enjoyed looking for unique items at both large and small antique stores across the country but this place has to be the arm pit of Magazine St.  The place is filthy and the items are more like leftovers that no one wanted from a yard sale also the prices are ridiculously high.  The staff has mastered the "I don't give a Damn attitude" and they didn't even have a functioning restroom.  Please take my advice and pass this one up.  Or if you decide to "slum it" and take your chances I have one recommendation........ Lots of hand sanitizer!

I heart this place- so please stop going there if you are super loud and annoying, you heard me!

Prohibition on a Monday-Wednesday night is so nice, you don't have to worry about finding a seat because there are plenty. The bartenders are incredibly nice and remember your face. Fridays and Saturdays it seems littered with young fools who forgot what inside voice is- yea I'm old, get off my lawn!

Sundays is bring your own vinyl which is cool, I'm searching for the worst thrift store album I can find just to put them to the test, haha. In due time....

The food is always on, with a late night kitchen open to 1am, and awesome specials I always find myself nomnomnoming on something delicious.

The neighborhood is kind of sketch so bike or drive there-walking seems like a good idea if you want someone to drag you into a dumpster.

Overall, I'm happy to have this as one of my local haunts. And the best thing about it, it doesn't reek of old mildewy floors or piss littered bathrooms- they keep it clean and that's quite the task in filthadelphia.

If you are visiting Nashville and want to hear live music at the famous Broadway area, this is a must visit!! The live music here was absolutely beautiful! There were so many places to choose from, but this place was the best choice we made.

I came here with my family on a friday night and enjoyed every single moment of the live music, food, drinks and atmosphere! The cheeseburger taco and their local nashville beers were very delicious! Staff was super nice and friendly. 

Highly recommended!!
I stop in as often as I can. Love the  Banh Mi sandwiches, spring rolls and cabbage and shrimp salad. Owner is a super nice guy. Good prices for the quality of the food.

I was stoked to find a burger place to please the bf (always wants beef when we dine out) and that fit the bill for being as local as possible as well as responsible to animals and the environment. They did also offer a gluten free bun, which may have been house made. A little on the crumbly moist biscuit side so it was difficult to eat as a burger, but none-the-less tasty.  I tried the southwest burger special-I only wish it had some salsa to go with the fresh guac. 

Salads and black bean-quinoa burgers for vegetarians.
We love this place!!!! Food and staff are amazing  this place is in the forest down a long road which was used by the stagecoach back in the day. It a must go for so many reason. It stunning there

Ok so I know I've kinda been saying it a lot recently but I love buddy's grill! I used to make a point of eating here once a week. I don't know why I stopped.. ok well I moved across town but I eat here any chance I get.  It's the kinda place that does everything pretty well, burgers, steaks, salads, soups, sandwiches, you name it they have one that will satisfy. 

Zucchini bread muffins! Mmm so good! The bread as well. 

Some of my regular picks: rubin, french dip, belt-buster burger (if your feeling up to it), chicken cesar salad, chicken tenders. When I was a kid the PB&J. 

oh and I too eat with my grandparents here regularly..

I'm always in the mood for sweets First time there though I was a little put off by the ordering system-picking from choices on a pad. You pick the donut, topping etc Not sure why you can't just place the order verbally-saves time, they say. After all that, the actual donut was ok!

This place is so cool! What a great concept. Who doesn't love cookie dough?! 
I love the s'mores flavor best but you can try it when you get there. 
Great place for a date or fun weekend outing.

They're not getting even one star from me!  First, we were told we'd be charged a fee for paying cash.  Then, after using our card, they charged us 3 times.  When we called and complained they were completely uncooperative.  We called later to speak with the manager and weren't connected to one.  This place also needs new carpet! DO NOT STAY HERE.

This place needs a major adjustment the service is terrible. We called for reservations they said they don't take any so we pulled up over there.
the place was not busy ordered a scotch on the rocks no one would bring it. 
Later the guy came back wondering whether I wanted scotch and Coke. I told him no.
I wanted scotch on the rocks.. he never came back...
 I had to walk to the bar and ask for my scotch on the rocks and there it was still sit there ..all water down.. the bartender gave it to me.
 I went to my table another waiter came up... I told her about it she said she'd bring me another one then I ordered a dozen fresh oysters on the half shell which are supposed to be on ice and freezing cold. Not so at this place okay no problem.. let's move on.. ordered a grilled chicken salad the chicken was so dry seem like it was sitting there for 4 days you needed a gallon of water to push down one strip. Finally we ordered the bread pudding..  I've had a thousand of them this one was definitely the worst so needless to say no need to go back here again

No one ever came and asked how we were doing or if we needed anything else. Each time we wanted something we had to flag the waitress down.

I have no idea when this theater opened, but I'm kicking myself for not knowing about it sooner. The seats are amazing! They're leather, they're wide and they recline!!!! You can pretty much recline to a full horizontal position. How awesome is that?! The theater, as with most theaters, is a bit on the cold side so be sure to bring a cardigan.

Currently, this theater has no online ticket purchase so you have to purchase them in person. The cool thing about this theater is that you can select your seats while purchasing your tickets, so you don't have to go into the theater early to grab the good seats.

My bf and I got to the theater just 5 min before our show time so we couldn't participate in the In Theater Dining, though we could order food and drinks at the Bar & Lounge and have someone bring them to us. We ended up ordering Calamari and a bucket of Heineken. While watching the previews our calamari arrived. I really liked the homemade marinara sauce, but I found the calamari to be thin and chewy. The menu looks decent so I'm looking forward to trying another dish next time.

Definitely my new favorite movie theater. Can't wait to go back!

Probably the most confusing service I've ever encountered in Tucson. It was our first time here and just moved in down the street so, why not. We initially got our drinks right away (being pregnant I only had water). But then things started flying out of the kitchen and we hear some man screaming in there who then comes out and slams stuff down on the bar.. like having a real meltdown in the middle of his shift. Crazy. 

I asked for a refill on my water and the bartender grabbed a pitcher, slammed it down in front of me and then said "you can have it then." WHAT!!!  Ok ignored that too, we went outside to the batting cages which were really neat and busy but not overly crowded. 

We got hungry so I grabbed a menu and placed my order at the bar- sort of. I started with my guys food order and she just turned around and said "ok" totally cutting me off as she walked away.. I had to yell over the volume of the place wait I'm not done!! Then when the food came a confused looking young girl who ran our food looked at me like I was insane for asking for ketchup and mustard for a hot dog. Which when she brought the mustard it was clogged so bad I couldn't even get it out, gross. 

Overall, food was good and at least I had my pitcher of water, lol. I grabbed rounds of beers for the boys a couple times  to get out of the smoking area temporarily and the service was quick and to the point. 

When it came time to close our tab the bartender was SO sweet and nice, obviously. I tipped 20% like a normal person and left with no intention of coming back on my own decision.

I visited tavern for lunch looking to try their burger.  I had been told they have one of the best burgers in Nashville.  I thought it was a pretty good burger but I can think of several burgers better in a 5 mile radius.  I will say as a dining venue it is top notch.  Staff was excellent and the layout is very cool.  The menu has several unique items that might bring me back to try like the fried chicken skins...    A tip would be you will probably need to valet since parking is scarce in the area

I had one of the salmon teriyaki bento box dinners, and my husband had sushi: eel roll, yellowtail roll, Philadelphia roll, and spicy tuna roll.  The restaurant itself is a little worn at the edges....dried leaf decorations on the shoji window coverings, curling acoustic panels on the ceiling, many with water stains, and radio playing in the background.  The outside of the restaurant makes it looks like an abandoned building (boarded up windows), my hubby and I didn't actually know it was a functioning restaurant for the first few months we drove by.  The food was edible but not great.  The salmon was covered in copious amounts of onions and mushrooms, and the teriyaki sauce was watery. The salad dressing was good, but I wasn't expecting fried rice and potstickers in a bento box.  Anyway, the restaurant is relocating, as the building owner decided not to renew the lease...look for a new restaurant here in the near-ish future. I hope they renovate the building, it needs it.

Just had dinner there tonight. I had veal, my wife had chicken.  Both were excellent!

We will be returning for another dinner.

This delivery/take-out only Chinese on Girard is great on price and presentation but the food is kind of meh.

Walking into this establishment makes one somewhat uneasy. Maybe it's the inch thick bullet proof glass, or the fact that you can buy cigarettes and Imodium, or maybe the two broke down chairs next to the ATM machine, maybe the sticky floors...not really sure if it's one of these things or a combination of all...I really felt like taking a hot shower though when I got home.

3 stars because the bar staff was great. Walked in and no one was at the hostess station to seat me so I went to the bar area. A friend recommended that I try the bread pudding but I've had better. The shrimp and grits was amazing! I was under the weather and the bartender made me a hot toddy and was very attentive which made up for the lack of service upon my initial arrival. Can't say I was impressed enough to return

I moved to Philadelphia almost six months ago and had not read or heard a word about this place.  I pass it several times a week and finally decided it was time to try it.  I was not disappointed.  

It was one of the top 10 meals I've had since moving here, and I eat out a lot.  I shared four small plates with one other person and we each had two drinks.   I really enjoyed the south american shrimp, the tuna tostadas, and the bacon-wrapped dates.  The ingredients were very fresh, the dishes were well-plated, and the flavor combinations were great.  We also had the serrano ham, which I enjoyed, but it wasn't quite what I was expecting (the ham arrived atop crutons--but who can really complaint about wonderfully salty serrano ham?).  Everything was reasonably priced.  And the end of the meal came with a bonus: because it was national chocolate lovers' day, we were each given a small chocolate dessert at the end of our meal. 

I was also impressed with the service.  Our waitress knew everything on the menu by heart, gave us great recommendations, and was attentive but not overbearing.   

I'd recommend the food at this place place to anyone, but it has a too-cool-for-school vibe that might be off-putting to some, and I can understand how the restaurant could feel very crowded if there were a lot of people there (not my experience, but other reveiwers seem to complain about the lack of personal space). 

Overall, I was incredibly pleased.

I was a member for 18 months or so.  I was unable to keep going, and called to terminate my membership.  The assistant told me to fax in a termination request, so I did.  They kept billing me for months.  When I found out and told them, they said that assistant had been terminated, and asked for a copy of the fax, which I no longer had.  They checked to see that I didn't enter the gym that whole time, but still refused to refund my money.  Classless.

I went into the store today and was slightly overwhelmed at all the yarns.  I'm a relatively new knitter and was so glad that I went to THIS store.  You couldn't find more helpful ladies.  Their guidance and suggestions really helped me get what I needed to start my project tonight.  
This will definitely be my LYS in the future.  Many, many thanks.

I love this place! It is my local spot for delivery! Always get the same driver and he is so sweet!! The food is good! Crab ragoons are perfect! Only reason I give 4/5 stars is the fried rice could use some work. Try the lo mein though! It is so good!!

I was so excited to try this place because they had a great yelp review and it was recommended to me by my cousin you recently traveled here. But I had a really awful experience here. The service and the food were absolutely terrible, I wouldn't recommend it to my worst enemy. 

We were seated and waited about 10 minutes to just get a glass of water.  After we were seated and kept waiting we asked the hostess if anyone was going to get us water. She looked at me blankly and then walked away. Then we waited even longer to get water and to order. 

We ordered the eggs Florentine. The waiter messed up one of the orders and instead of poached eggs one of the eggs were over easy. The whole thing was swimming in some sort of liquid. Also the hollandaise sauce was cold. The hash browns were cold, completely unseasoned, and not even brown. The waiter never checked in on us to see how we were doing. 

There are lots of lovely brunch places in New Orleans, but this is certainly not one of them.

It is a super cute coffee shop. I stopped by the area while I was dining next door at OTB. I love the chalk board decoration with all the cute quotes. We saw other yelp review for their donuts so we decided to try one. Unfortunately, they didn't have a lot of options. We got tiramisu donuts and it was delicious...also it is gluten free. I love the environment and it is a very cute little coffee shop to spend some time to catch up with friends. The pricing is reasonable for coffee and their coffee is from Buddy Brew which is one of my favorite as well as Kaleisia tea. :]

This is my second favorite place for pastries down in Chinatown.  The egg tarts are second best, first being Asia Bakery.  I usually end up in here if im too lazy to walk over to Asia Bakery lol.  The breads are soft and chewy and always fresh.  Im not a big fan of their cakes though.  They have been too dry for my taste.  They have almond cookies and they are very good and cheap.  As most bakeries down there, they make milk bubble tea and smoothies.  Not a fan of the bubble tea and never had the smoothies, though alot of people do buy it here.  I'll stick to my favorite bubble tea place down there. (see my other reviews lol)

Good bread, cookies and egg tarts here.  So give it a try!  

Happy Eatings!!

It's a two star review. I don't review much, so this one is because I wasn't happy at all.  Service was good. Beer was not very cold and I like my beer cold. My friends enjoyed their food and I also thought their food was very good. I ordered a burger, just like that, medium. I was told the food was very good there. The burger was kinda sad. Smallish, third of the size of the bun, or so. I asked for it to be medium, but it appeared to be well done, at least, it was dry and was burnt bitter. I pointed that out to the server and received a new burger after a little wait. The replacement was soaked in blood, just plain raw meat inside... I mean, I get the "fuck you" attitude, but dude, you are the chef, don't be like that. So I sent it back and asked for a check. They "didn't charge for the burger." I should be charging YOU for this! Whatever.

Excellent food, very good service.  Only two stars because dinner at least is outrageously expensive.  27 bucks for a lamb stew that was definitely good, but about the size of a bowl of cereal.  I mean good or not, it's still stew.  The kids moussaka was good as well, but 22 bucks for 1 slice with a small side of khorabi.  Ripoff.

One of the better burgers in the area. My burger snob buddy comes all the time. Wait-- pretty solid tap list too, for a small place. Just came here for ultra-rare Sierra Nevada Narwhal, on TAP. HOOyah!! THAT'S quality. Never mind a great bottle list fifty long.

This place smells like a pile of old pissy diapers.  As soon as I walked in the door I was overcome by the odor.  I had to meet some people here so I did not have a choice but to stay.  I was the first person there so I chose a table nearest to Prater Blvd.  The smell was less noticeable there.  I remembered the last time I had come to this restaurant there was the same smell so we left without eating.  I could not eat my meal because of the urine stench. GROSS!!!!

I attended a convention at the Union Station Hotel and so Landry's was close by...the first time I went I had the crawfish etoufee and it was amazing!  Very good...flavorful, had just the right bite...I would have liked more rice, but it was good!  For dessert, I treated everyone to Bananas Foster and it was huge and fed 6 of us!

Our waiter was Mario and he was a class act, he kept our table clean and just provided us with a wonderful dining experience!

The second time I went, I went in for lunch and I had the crawfish mac and cheese and it was excellent and just enough!  Loved their garlic bread, but it was very filling the first time I had it, so I didn't have it for lunch.

Class act for sure!

I enjoyed my dinner at Southgate, but definitely felt like they skimped on the Korean flavor. Tried the KFC wings (both flavors), they had a delicious crunch but definitely not spicy. Same with the spicy fries. You can see they dusted it with something but the taste does not translate. The dolsot bibimbap was ok. Nothing particularly great to justify the $17 price tag. Service from the kitchen was very slow, long wait after our wings. The waiter and bartender were both great. And we enjoyed our cocktails, which were well crafted and delicious.

While staying at the Don Caesar on the ground floor is Uncle Andy's. We visited there to get our morning coffee and a quick lite bite - breakfast bars, toasted bagels ect are available.

Ez to grab a hot brew before heading to the beach. Also the ice cream selection is great for a late afternoon snack. 

Staff is very courteous and friendly - worth visiting to start the day!

I've never really had a specific nail salon before. None have really stuck. Nails by Yen popped up when I was trying to find a good nail place, so I went there. The service is amazing every time I go here I get the guy and he's the best , he always does whatever I ask for and makes it so much better. When he's working on my nails we always talk , the sweetest guy. But when you walk in everyone greets you everyone is just so nice.
I've never been to a nail salon that has so many regulars come in every time I'm here. So you know it's a good place. 
This is officially my new and favorite place. I highly recommend everyone to go here.
Yen & her husband are so sweet & funny. Makes me feel so comfortable to just hangout there.

This place used to be amazing in the 90's and early 2000's.  The decor hasn't changed very much since then so the place looks a little run - down and tacky.  The last time that I was there, it took our waitress 20 minutes to take our drink orders but managed to take another table's order right away.  Our waitress was a petite lady with very long hair.  It seemed like she treated her customers differently depending on how much each customer would tip.  

She never smiled and made us feel like we were a huge burden.  Never again.  Bathrooms were also gross and dirty.
I should of listened to the reviews and saved my time and money. Very chaotic and of course the server got my order wrong. Too much of a wait to get it fixed.
This was AMAZING... Cauliflower Steaks with Split peas and veggies over Kale... The flavor of the romesco sauce was slap yo Mama good ...

The drinks were very creative and delicious. Food was good. The pig ears, pasta, and panna cotta were the best. I didn't really think the curry goat was good although it was the most recommended entree. Overall, pretty good dinner.

Forget the specialty donuts and just get one of the hot donuts, made to order fresh all day. You get a free honey donut with your chicken order, but I actually don't like that kind at all and usually give it to my daughter, who inevitably hovers over me waiting for my donut like a baby bird waiting for food to drop from its mother's beak.

The famous fried chicken is really really good, if you love crispy savory skin. In fact, I could just order their za'tar dry rub skin and be happy. While the chicken is also good, it's really just fried chicken, and when you order a "half chicken" you're not actually getting a half a chicken. You get four smallish pieces of chicken that are mostly bone. It's delicious, but it's not a lot of meat for the price.

I LOVE STARBUCKS!!! I think that's all I have to say about it.. 
The location, however, is very convenient and the service is great, friendly and fast. 
Definitely recommend.

Fairly good. The hype for Korean Fried chicken has finally made it to Nashville. Haha with that being said if you want to try it this place will be the spot. Get your quick fix for Korean style fried chicken! They have marinated and fried style. Also they have variety of Thai dishes and sushi. Owners are super friendly and very accomedating.

Let me start out by saying that for this hotel being still a shuttle ride from Downtown, it was expensive. That being said, there are several places to go get food and drinks around the hotel. The bar in the hotel was pretty lackluster and the breakfast buffet was OK. We did not have a vehicle so we did not worry about parking. The shuttle guys were STELLAR. Especially Chris and Jersey. I still have no clue what Jersey's real name is, but he is from Jersey hence the nickname. These two guys were wonderful and made our trip 100 times more enjoyable. Also, Olga the housekeeper is AMAZING. She was one of the sweetest people we had met in nashville. Make no mistake, if you have Olga for a housekeeper, making friends with her goes a long way. She always stopped to ask where we were going or what we were up to while we passing by.

I stayed here for a work conference. It's lovely and has everything you'd expect- though sort of annoying that coffee in the morning is not free and you have to pay for wireless. That said, the location on the river is ideal and I enjoyed dinner at the brewery nearby.

I'm not a big fan of hot dogs, so when my wife suggested it, I was a little bummed out, but I need to make her happy...LOL. Surprisingly, it was delicious and filling. I wanted to order the Cincinnati skyline, but since my wife was ordering it, she told me to order something else. So, I order the surf and turf dog...again to make her happy. Oh, the things I do for her.

Philly Surf N Turf - Fried fish with a hot dog. Huge and extremly filling. Fish was large and flaky, but lacked a lil bit of flavor.

Cincinnati Skyline - I wish I stuck with my gut and ordered this. Packed with tons of flavor. I'm not huge on scallions, but this hotdog did it well. The melted cheese with the gooey chili was great! 

Fries - really good and tasted fresh. I tried it with siracha ketchup. Nothing special regarding the sauce. I make this at home.

Overall: I would definately be back even though I'm not a hot dog kind of guy. Price isn't bad for how filled you get from one dog.

It's hard to even give this place one star. I ordered a whole bunch of stuff and about halfway through eating I discovered a long dark hair weaved into a piece of sushi that was IN MY MOUTH. I immediately spit it out and got sick. I took pictures just to prove that the hair was fully immersed in the roll. Needless to say, we did not finish our meal. I called for a refund and they hung up on me not once, but twice. They only wanted to refund the $7 avocado mango roll that the hair was in. I simply explained we wanted a full refund because we were obviously not going to finish the food. So they actually sent a delivery man back here to pick up the uneaten food to MAKE SURE WE DIDN'T EAT. I've never felt so disrespected and disgusted at the same time. I will NEVER be coming back here and I've told all my friends to be wary of this garbage establishment.
We just had Brian Applegate Wood Floors install new oak floors throughout our house. Danny, the installation guy, does really amazing work, and the final product looks beautiful.
The food was fine, once we got it. The service was very, very slow. Many tables of people who came later than us were served before us.

Ahhhhmazzing. 
We had some mishaps with our drinks not coming and soup being a little on the cold side, but they remedied the mistakes immediately and sent us desserts at the conclusion of our meal. 
Raw oysters were divine. 
I had a special of grits with pork belly. Only compliant was that it wasn't served to me in the comfort of my bed. I would loved to have curled up with that cast iron dish and dreamt sweet dreams next to it. 
This place is a must. Fairly priced, too.

I've been going here for dinner and drinks with friends on Monday nights for quite some time and it's definitely become my regular pub of choice, due in part to these friends who go here frequently. As a non-drinker (for the most part), I am mostly concerned with the food quality, which is excellent! I adore their food specials for special events such as holidays (the Canada Day specials were delicious for example in 2014, as was the St. Patrick's Day special). The soups are consistently unusual but good. The Monday night steak special with all you can eat sides is a consistent favorite for our group.

My friends really enjoy trying the great drinks from their 72 taps and other drink menu, and I happen to like having a blueberry tea here on occasion, though it's rare to see me drink alcohol. We love the service we get when we come here!

Don't forget to order a yummy dessert if you do eat here: the tapioca dessert is especially good as is the Bailey's Creme Brulee and the Chocolate lava cake.

My wife and I have eaten at the nook for breakfast and lunch. The food is awesome and so is the service. The chef usually brings out a little special offering he has cooked and wants feed back from his customers. Their food is always fresh and is presented nicely on your plate. If you are hungery and near the Nook, GIVE IT A TRY.

Terrific coffee bar in a nice neighborhood location.  Lots of gourmet pastries and breakfast items and great coffee.  Went there twice in three days even though it was a fairly long hike from our hotel.  Friendly staff, cool vibe, and plenty of indoor and outdoor seating.
The best Mexican food in New Orleans period. Cindy the waitress is so sexy and beautiful. The customer service is great .

Exceptional care and professionalism by Dr Nabors and his entire staff. Whereas many other dentists have suggested more invasive procedures because of ease, Dr. Nabors, with his innovative expertise and knowledge has taken care to preserve my teeth. Extremely satisfied and happy with the care. I do not live in Tennessee and it is well worth my drive or flight and time and money to be seen by him and his whole support staff team.

My grandparents were in town and I wanted a place with some southern charm. This place was perfect! We had to wait about 40 minutes for a table but Main Street Franklin is always fun to explore so the wait seemed like nothing. They have a great selection of southern favorites and their lunch special is a great deal. Cool atmosphere and at night they have live music. The food was delicious, the service was super friendly, and everyone left happy! Great experience overall.
Did not like this place. The pastas were absolutely sub par! Over priced for the type of food. Will not go back here
Meh... I wasn't impressed a lot of hype not much substance. The burgers are over priced for what you get. The Top Dog poutine was overly salty. The waitress was friendly and on the ball.

This is one of the best pub's in Edmonton. Its pretty unassuming, so you wouldn't necessarily stop here; as it's attached to a hotel..but I promise that it's worth trying. The food is amazing and pretty cheep. We go there a few times a month when were in the area (and even when were not!). The service at times can be pretty slow, but the food really makes up for your wait times.

Very authentic high quality Thai food ! 
Beautiful decor with tradional Thai carvings in the entire restaurant. Cashew chicken & green eggplant curry were excellent! The sticky rice with coconut ice creat was rich & satisfying end to a great meal.

I like this place, The food is good, I especially love their Mocha Bubble Tea. It is great for lunch, very inexpensive. The atmosphere is pretty typical, but luckily the lighting is not harsh. The service is excellent. I eat here often from work which is close. Authentic food. Try it out this is easy, fast and good.

After reading the reviews on yelp I decided not to go along with this company. When they contacted me after giving a quote and when I mentioned the yelp reviews, the agent Todd Smith, got angry and abusive. If this is how they plan to get my business I can only imagine what their service is going to be like.

This place if fantastic.  I have a few other spots around town that I enjoy for Mediterranean cuisine (Tazikis and Kalamatas), but Blu Fig blows them away.

I've been there a few times.  I took my in-laws and some other family members last Christmas and they were all very impressed (and a few members of the group can be quite picky).  I also took my parents to try it out and they live about 40 minutes away from the restaurant.

We live on the east side of Cool Springs and take the back way through Concord Road and Nolensville Road to get there.  It's worth the trip.  The chicken is excellent, but I like the duo plate where you can get the traditional meat as well.  The fruit tea is also very good. 

I believe that I've met both partners and they are both very friendly as is the rest of the staff.  They make sure that we have everything we need and keep the drinks full.  

My only complaint is that they don't have a second location in Cool Springs.  If needed, I can point out several establishments that they can replace.
Amazing night!!! The jazz band was spot on. The food for great. Each side excellent. The Natchez punch was great too. Got an amazing captain hat for $12. Def good back anytime

The plates and cup were dirty coming on the table. The milk jug was extremely stained and my coffee cup was having brown residue all over. Coffee was bad, but that's OK. Turtle soup was very tasty, while redfish & friends was not that great! I don't think I would go back!

This place is not close to my house, but its worth the 20-30 minute walk.  Cheap and mostly authentic Middle Eastern food.  The Gyro/Shwarma and Babaganouj were both great.  Even better was the little market where I can buy a giant tubs of Tahina, grape leaves, and other hard to find Middle East foods.

The Pralines are delicious here.  When you walk into the store, the fragrance from the candy just surrounds you making you want to buy some.  The service is nice and friendly, and they even offer free samples.

This place was awesome!  It was like having my own upscale apartment complete with modern shower heads, stovetops and fridge, and proper media connections for the entertainment system.  Upscale, that is... if you like Ikea's furniture; with their strength in modern and inviting decor and their hollow, flimsy materials.  But hey, it was great for comfort away from home.  The breakfast was good.  The room was squeaky clean.  Their bed was comfy.  Their staff was sweet.  What more do you need?

This is a really cool place. The portabella pizza was really tasty, and loaded with bacon, sausage, and goodness. I especially like the tangy pizza sauce. We went for devour downtown, and got the special, which was 2 for $30. With it came a medium pizza, choice of appetizer, and 2 beers. We wanted a deep dish, but they didn't have the dough ready, probably because they were busy. Service was great, and so was the atmosphere.

I have been to shear artistry twice now and have had a great experience each time. After calling around for a hair cut and to get my roots done I found that it also had one of the best prices. 
Molly cut and colored my hair, she kept me on file so she knew what mix to put in my hair again. 
I had plenty of reading material and she was friendly so we talked a lot. 
I was happy with the trim, she was good at communicating with me and i felt she undertstood what I wanted. 
She also made recommendations for me that fit both my lifestyle and budget, like around when I should force myself to get another cut (I usually only go like once every two years) she also helped me find a deep conditioner that I could afford, ended up being 40% off awesome!

I would totally recommend this salon, clean, friendly, and they did a good job!
What an incredibly odd & eclectic menu.  Food was pretty good and the wine/liquor selection is good too.  Nice atmosphere, even if it's a little loud.

The location on Canal street is great. Its a 4 star hotel on priceline. But I don't get it. I think they were going for a modern decor but it seems cheap to me. And the purple lights and black and white pics of strippers in the hall gives it a brothel feel. The perfume smell in the hall makes me sick and adds to the french brothel ambiance.  

The staff is very nice.

When I walked into my room all of the drawers were open which seems odd. I was happy to see the keurig in my room but they only had tea and decaf available. I tried the decaf. It wasn't very good. I was disappointed

The alarm cord is too short for the alarm to be beside the bed

An alarm went off and I just had to evacuate the hotel in my PJ's. Fortunately it was a false alarm

My business partner and I decided to get some coffee this morning at Gelateria for our weekly Monday meeting.  We got some coffee and a muffin. I got the vanilla latte and it was okay. I will try something else next time. It is a fantastic building. It has a nice patio and an amazing upstairs. We meet many clients at coffee shops and this is now our favorite. They will let you reserve any rooms upstairs for FREE! We were blown away and will definitely make this our meeting spot during the brutal hot months this summer. Thank you Gelateria!

Good eats!  Great service!! The crab cake eggs Benedict were amazing!!!  I also had the carnitas chilaquiles-- equally awesome!  

Modest Mouse show last night was super; but this place for breakfast.... not sure which I enjoyed more!

For years, when my family and I would make the sojourn from St. Louis to Indianapolis, my dad would say something everytime we passed Blue Springs. It was the billboard that got him.

It read: Foot Hi Pies, and had a picture of a giant plume of what I guessed to be meringue on top of a tiny piece of pie. He'd wax poetic about it so many times one year my mom ordered him to turn the car around and get off on that exit and get a darned Foot Hi Pie. 

I wanted to go just to tell them to fix the spelling on their billboard.

But here's what happened: it was just a piece of pie. Yes, it had heaps of meringue, but it certainly wasn't a foot. It was just the idea of the thing that lured him in.

And I think that's the way folks feel about the Cleopatra, which is really just vanilla ice cream, bananas, strawberries, rum sauce, chocolate and whipped cream piled to the sky, much like dad's beloved pie.

It's the novelty of the thing. Anyone can make a sundae like that at home, but isn't it more fun to ooh and aah with your friends in a super cool environment? The place is all pink, very funky and that's why I like going. I haven't liked their food much, though the cobb salad is always a winner for my money. I had the tarte tatin once and it was good.

Otherwise, it's the theatre of the whole thing. It's what drives us all to pull off the exit and just do something crazy every now and then.

My best friend and I walked into the store and were immediately asked "what are you looking for?" I then replied with a smile "we're just browsing." The man at the counter began scowling and said "this store isn't for browsing." I've never felt so unwelcomed and looked down upon. We didnt have a large bag or anything to suggest we were up to no good.
I can't afford buying groceries here but I enjoy the sushi at the bar especially during happy hour. I think they have the fresh sushi in Tucson.
