Very disappointed with this restaurant. I have had wings other places that were better. If this is the best Reno has. I'm sorry. The service was excessively slow and every order was wrong. The server kept apologizing for everything. Which was nice but when you have to keep asking for silverware and the carrots celery and you get salad after main course. Sorry but they missed the mark.

My wife and I have been to Upland many times over the past few years and have always had a good experience. It was on our list of go to places in Carmel. The beer is very good (Coastbuster is my favorite) and the food has always been very good as well. We are vegetarian and there have always been some good choices, and our very favorite was the Southwest Tofu Salad. I say "was" because when we sat down on the patio last week we were shocked to see the salad was taken off the menu and replaced with another tofu salad that simply is nowhere close to the Southwest. The tofu tacos are also changed to a new version of bland fried tofu that comes out a bit greasy. When we asked our server the reason for the change we were told the chef found the southwest tofu too time consuming to prepare so he took it off. Never a good idea to remove a top selling and delicious item from your menu out of mere convenience for the kitchen. In addition they have taken off the vegetarian pizza option in favor of a meat version. I'll go back for beers now and then but Upland is off my list of go to places for a great meal. Sorry Upland but you should listen to your customers and not your cooks.

Mister Car Wash may have cornered the car wash market in Tucson but the Price increase and poor car cleaning service speaks volumes.  Yes I did get a decent car wash for $27.00 after I did a walk around pointing out everything they missed. Windows/Door Jams/Bug Residue/Missed Water Spots how much due you have to pay to get a decent car wash without all the hassle. The old adage  if you want it done right do it yourself is were I guess I am headed with the limited choices for reasonably priced good quality car washes in Tucson. Spoke to Manager who said what doesn't come off in the wash is not their responsibility and could have cared less about my comments.

Used to go to Snell Island to the old place many years ago. The food is just as good now as it was then. I am a fan of European food, especially German/ Austrian food. They have nice servers, and myself and hubby always enjoy CV.

First timer there and I loved it. Great to see freshly cut meats and cheeses, I had the number 9 I believe, next time the only thing I would change is a little less oil and vinegar but other than that  no complaints here, the guy that made my sub was awesome, I think he said he just started working there as well. Good job buddy.
Very nice hotel. The room is a good size & the shower is large. The staff is very friendly.
First time visitors and we loved it!   Seaweed salad was perfect.  Then I had the fantasy roll. Amazing presentation and perfectly delicious!

Honey's sit and Eat is a really quaint place - cash only- where you can just enjoy a nice meal with a friend or a date or really anyone. I have been twice - once for breakfast and once for lunch. And to my surprise - i could order breakfast Anytime!!! For me this is a huge bonus. i would eat breakfast for every meal of the day if i could. 

Bacon is not crisp - more on the fatty side, but still flavorful and the portion is good.   Pancakes are huge and delicious.  Price is not out of this world, it is reasonable and the staff is friendly and courteous.  When there is a wait, you have to fight your way to find a host/ess to give your name, but they are true to their times they give and some people will get bored of waiting so you may sit earlier than you expect. Coffee is plentiful, and the decor is interesting to look at.  

If you are looking for a cute place for lunch, just try it. Or if you want to impress a friend with a breakfast date, go ahead.  You wont be sorry, and you may come back for more :)

My wife and I are new to road biking and were very happy with the service and attention at The Hub. Ron spent 2-3 hours with us on Saturday, undertstanding what we were looking for without pressuring us to buy. We ultimately sold ourselves up one model on the road bikes we purchased...and are glad we did. 
We returned a few days later and Ron spent another 1.5 hours fitting us, giving my wife a more comfortable seat, and giving us advice on our first rides.
Great, great service, local (for us), and an all around great experience. We will be back for all the 'other stuff' we will eventually need. 
If you are looking for a great bike shop....this is it!

I can't believe no locals have reviewed this place.  Delicious food.  Huge portions.  My husband and I went here the first time because of word of mouth.  The only disappointment was that we were riding our bikes downtown and were uninformed enough to order the large cubans.  We couldn't possibly eat it all and had no way to bring leftovers home.  
This is really a take-out place.  The cuban is outstanding and generous although not a "typical" cuban.  It is pressed, but usually cubans don't have quite so much meat.  It also has lettuce, tomato, and the wonderful special sauce.  They have some specials that look and smell great (and everyone raves about them -- especially the meatloaf), but I love this cuban sandwich so much (I also love traditional cubans).  If you want a dainty meal, this place is not for you.  You could not make this food at home for this price.
It is family owned and they are a warm bunch.  I do miss Papa J (Joe, I think) who passed away a few years ago.  He really knew how to work a crowd.

Had a couple beers reading the reviews after we stayed our first night but look at it like this.. The place may have some rough edges here and there but what are your expectations when visiting NOLA? A modern, boring Hilton in the metro section or an old home with charm? I don't sit atop a high horse in life so I found Rathbone charming, amazing bed, nice staff, outdoor pool, fun morning music, close to FQ and bus route. Even Henry the cat takes refuge there, traumatized by gutter punks and hid in a tree for 2 weeks until staff coaxed him down and fed him.   The reality is you're just another globetrotting tourist in any town but they made my stay very comfortable. Cheers!

Decent food. Literally the worst service I have ever come across. I have had about 10 terrible experiences at is location. Each time I think they are playing a joke on me. I guess they stay open because of idiots like me who hope it is just a fluke. My husband waited an hour for our online order tonight, and naturally it was missing a few things. Never again.

Always a favorite and continues to be. I've actually stayed here once and it was quite comfortable. I continue to return for the excellent slot assortment including many of my favorite games.

My latest visit was no exception and I had some gains too so I couldn't ask for a better visit. I'm looking into another overnight stay soon so I hope they can deliver like they've delivered before.

This coffee shop is tucked away from CVS, in a shopping strip along Clayton Road near Schoettler Road out in the county. 
Easy to miss, unless you're looking for the sign.
Plenty of seating, and friendly staff. 
I've experienced the chilli and was underwhelmed. Little flavor, midway through, I'd had enough beans for my week. 
They use Kaldi's coffee, so +star there!
I'll probably stick with coffee if I continue to frequent this cafe, so try a salad based on a few other reviews.

Went here on a Saturday night. This is the BEST buffet in RENO/TAHOE in my opinion. There was way to much to pick from and seemed to cater to everyone's taste buds. There was Lots of Crab and even some lobster infused dishes. 

This buffet is the closest you will get to an authentic Las Vegas Hotel here in Reno. 
Highly Recommend!!
Great place to eat and drink. Tacos and the curry soup were amazing. Sabrina is awesome!

Not your typical hotel bar. The atmosphere is lively and offers some nice nighttimme views of the city. If you are into hand crafted cocktails give it a try.  If you prefer beer or wine then I would head downstairs to Cerulean.

Kermit Bake Shoppe resides on Philadelphia's "Super Highway" also known as Washington Avenue. The location is off the beaten path and seems a bit remote, but it's next to Springfield Beer Distributor, so maybe not so much. Walk inside and you see a display of all the treats and the pizza, which looked so delicious. I figured I would stay on the safe side and had the 24 carat carrot cupcake and a slice of the bread pudding. The cupcake was alright. I wasn't wowed, but I did like what tasted like cereal flakes (I doubt that's what they are) on top of the cream cheese frosting. The bread pudding is good cold, but is significantly better when heated. The chocolate, the warm, the comfort. Just a great dessert. So good that I was trying to find and eat all the crumbs. The salted caramel brownie is on my list of "things to try" on my return.

Boooooo-ring.

This dog park is fine enough if there's nothing closer. It's fenced-in and off leash, so it's a safe place to go, but my dog couldn't have been more bored. 

This is basically a ring walking trail with a couple short trails cutting through it. There is nowhere for the dogs to congregate and play, and nowhere to throw a ball and really let your dog tear off. 

I went here 3 times, trying to give it a fair share. First time, I liked it, although the dog was bored. Second time, okay the dog is really bored. Third time, okay now the dog and I are bored, and it's a little awkward having to walk behind/next to someone you don't know. Because all there is to do here is walk the circuit as many times as your brain can handle it. My dog stopped at every gate wanting to leave, and had more fun walking the trails outside of the dog park area. 

There aren't many fenced-in places in south Jersey, but if your dog is well-behaved, you'd fair better in an open field or sports field. We just opt for Cooper River Dog Run instead. It's small but long so he can chase a ball. And the usuals there tend to be cuckoos instead of clique-y, so it's more comfortable of a scene.
Service and food under par. They capitalize on their location and forget about the quality of the food and service. Do not order jambalaya, dry and  tastes like nothing.

Excellent drinks. Loved the fire and ice cocktail. Very spicy and great flavor! The apps were great too. Had the queso dip and shrimp ceviche. We weren't as impressed with our entrees though. I had the scallops with pork belly and my husband had the mahi mahi which was dry. We would probably opt for the tacos next time. Excellent service and will be back!

My boyfriend and I visited Brindle on a Wednesday afternoon for lunch.  Apparently, the guy who owns the place has no employees and mans the place himself.  We ordered the vegan chili and prosuitto and mozerella panini.  I must start off by saying that my expectations were low (due to the poor reviews).  The chili came out first and it was a HUGE bowl.  I was shocked at how delicious, spicy and rich it was (considering it was vegan).  The sandwich was also incredibly tasty with fresh basil and a liberal serving of proscuitto.  Let's just say that we were pleasantly surprised by the quality portions and prices.  We will definitely be back when we are in fishtown.  The owner does like to chat but I didn't mind.

Upon reading my previous review, the owner called me to apologize for his behavior.  The staff also sent us a present to commemorate our event, which was lovely.  I do believe they normally have outstanding service, but I caught them on a bad day.

Love this place! They always know my name, even if I haven't been in for a long while. The lettuce wraps are a perfect light lunch. My other favorites include the hot chicken, chicken teriyaki (I ask for light sauce), and the bibimbap. Its a great place to grab take-out or enjoy a nice eat-in meal. I've never been disappointed here!

Ryan and team are great.  They helped us through the entire process of purchasing hardwood flooring for our new home and even helped get the wood to us faster than we expected so we could finish the job sooner.  I would recommend going to Lumber Liquidators for your flooring needs and make sure to ask for Ryan, he is knowlegable, professional and will help you find success on your next project.
Good burgers.  Great pickled veggies.  Good whiskey selection, including my personal favorite, Red Breast.  Get there at 11:30 to avoid the lunch crowd and get whatever table you want.
Love this Place!! Became a wine club member first time I went. Happy hour every thursday. Definitely recommend trying it at least once, guarantee you will be back for more.

This place is great. Was a little surprised to find this little restaurant and is so good. You have to try the Korean ribs, chicken wings and Lamb juicy Lucy. Delicious. And the desserts are primo. The chocolate dessert is the best. Service is impeccable. Will be back again.
The brunch here was fantastic. I ate the smoked salmon on a pretzel bagel, assorted pickles, and drank a cold brew. All delicious. The waitstaff was attentive and helpful.

What an awesome way to spend Valentine's Day! Unique, different, & authentic if you can get the sofa/pillow table area. The Queens Eight Platter was very filling for two. We will def have to go back for their ceremonial coffee, the place was packed & service was slow, but totally understandable because they were packed. Thank God it was a unique place & I was highly entertained! Lol Their dark African beer is amazing (insert strange, unpronounceable name here) as well. Will definitely go again & bring a group of clean, well kept friends ;)) (gotta eat with your fingers)!!
Love coming here for breakfast, lunch or dinner! They have great donuts, and for dinner I would recommend the steak they have its very juicy and tasty!

Dave's chop house burger...amazeballs.  Loved the extra flavors for everything.  
Power salad was deelish.
 (-) Fried chicken salad was good except chicken was TOO fried.  Hard to eat too fried which cost them a star.
Fried pickles...amazeballs 
Loaded fries...amazeballs 
Mint shake...amazeballs
Butter pecan scoop...amazeballs 

Ice cream tasted homemade.

Plus...they offer a military discount!  Call this 4.33 stars!  Forgot to add...service was terrific.  Let's make it 4.48 stars.

I love the outdoor dining at Sunset Grille.... Tons of tables PLUS live music! Very casual & chill, this is a great place for a group of people, too. Service is prompt, and they have a large menu with lots of great diner-style fare, at quite reasonable prices. No liquor, but their beer prices are very good, at any time. Fast, tasty, and plentiful... Sunset Grille is a solid, consistent restaurant, with a comfortable, neighborhood vibe.

Senior citizen mom was quoted $397 for a job and when she wanted me to give the green light I was told it would be the same over the phone. When asked how they come up with the price J**h got defensive and advise he was doing my mother a favor! When I called to complain about his lack of professionalism and to get some more info, customer service advised that the work order was suspended and I was put on hold, when she came back on the line she said that the cost would be $283.97. Talked to the supervisor and he said he would deal with the plumber in his own way. At the end of the day I felt the Supervisor didn't believe that we were verbally quoted $400 and that the cost would be $283.97...take it or leave it!!! Oh the nice part was that the plumber went back into the house and told my mom and her friend that he didn't verbally quote the $397....what??  Please watch out of this plumber in particular.

I've been a fan of the South Philly location for many years.  I'm happy to say that this location is every bit as good with much better parking.   This is the best roast beef sandwich I have had outside of the North Shore in the Boston area, and might even be better.
I really enjoyed this restaurant. The service and food were great! I'd recommend the seared scallop and shrimp.

The gelato is obviously the highlight here. Every flavor I've ever gotten here has always been top notch. Great after dinner spot to wind down and relax with plenty of outdoor seating.

The guy who took our order was extremely friendly and very helpful describing all the different flavors to us.

A asian family first time here. Service was very poor.  When they realize we know sushi and etc, they start to give a bad attitude.  A lot of items they do not have.  Not even a slice of sashimi. Anything you think relatively expensive they did not have it.  When you ask why, they get upset and state you only pay $18 per person.  My family are all from Taiwan except me.  I just hate to say that Chinese people are not nice to their own people.  Never go again.

The boyfriend and I ordered an Alaskan roll and a Kalbi combo for lunch last weekend. When they delivered it, we realized they delivered a Bulgogi combo instead of the Kalbi. I called Sushiya to tell them they got the wrong order, and James (the manager) told me they'd send the correct order right away. He called us a few minutes later saying he'd include a coupon for our next order.

The sushi was yummy and the portion for the Korean food was very generous. We saved most of the Bulgogi and a little bit of the Kalbi as leftovers for our next meal. They also include Miso soup with meal, and if you use the coupon code, you get a free ice cream mochi! It was a little bit pricey (lunch + delivery was about $30) but I think it's pretty worth it! I gave them the fourth star for really good customer service. Even though the delivery got messed up, we were impressed with how quickly they resolved everything and how well they handled the situation, and we would definitely come back here again!

Chick Fricken Fil A. Well, it's about time!  I luvitty-luv-luv Chick-fil-A. Their chicken is so good.  It's like candy. Sweet, breaded chicken candy.  Nuggets. Sammitches. Minis. Lemonade. Sweet Tea. It's all good. Really, literally all good. 

As for the shiny new Reno location, I've only been once and that was a drive-thru venture just before noon. It was crowded, as I expected, but they had a small army of employees rocking it. Despite the throngs of chicken cravers I was in and out in short order and treated to the customary excellent service. CFA really sets the bar in courtesy, professionalism and helpfulness. I've never had a bad experience at any location and I've been to a few. 

Hooray for CFA for finally planting their flag in the soil of Northern Nevada. Hooray also for the people of Northern Nevada for welcoming this establishment to our area.
First time in St. Louis and used yelp to find a place to eat.  I wasn't disappointed. Italian Sausage Spring Rolls were delicious and the Canneloni was justa like mama used ta maka!

I truly do love this cool hip vibe of this hotel.  We frequented this place while I was pregnant for "get aways" and got a ridiculously good deal ($40) a night on priceline with "naming your own price".  The service here is excellent, the location is excellent for a night out, and we couldn't beat the price.  But if you don't know the area and valet it will cost you.  Parking was almost as much as our room rate that we totally scored as a bargain so it kind of offset but again, totally worth it!

Luke is just one of those places hat I have to visit each time in visiting NOLA.  It's a great restaurant attached to the Hilton Hotel that doesn't feel like a hotel restaurant.  Service is fantastic...usually. (I will get to that in a little while...)

Was in town with a coworker who is Vegan, and he raved about the concoction that the kitchen whipped up for him. It ended being his favorite NOLA meal EVER.  Unfortunately, it set up all the other meals during our trip to be failures because he enjoyed it that much and was impressed by our waiter's knowledge of the vegan diet and how he worked with the kitchen to make my coworker happy. Thumbs up guy with the ponytail! (Sorry, didn't get your name.)

We were so enablers by the service, that we hung out, ordered more drinks and dessert...forgetting our our urgency to make it to Bourbon Street for a fun night. Oops.

Fast forward to Sunday Brunch.  Waiter seemed hungover and slow. Kept reaching over the table to serve drinks and fill our glasses.  Now, I've never been a server, but I am pretty sure that is incorrect etiquette.  And as much as I have been to Luke's, all other wait staff made this guy look like a chump.  Anyway, we kept trying to warm him up by being super polite and friendly, but it was more out of annoyance than anything...

Food is always consistent here.  Although, I will say that the bacon bits in my salad seemed more fresh on Sunday morning than they did on Friday night.  I also love to get the shrimp and grits when I am feeling like something more hearty. Luke does it the best. 

Get the bread pudding.  It is a MUST.  You can hit the gym the next day.  No regrets.

I was on business in PA and craving Indian.  
Took a look around an made the drive to the Guru from Horsham.
Definitely worth the drive.  These guys made me feel like home.  Quick service. 
Food was really tasty without being overpowering.  Chicken Masala was very tender.
Bring your own bottle of wine and they will pour it.  In my case the owner was nice enough to share her own wine stash with me.

When I went to pick up my pizza, I saw that the girls making the pizza were not wearing any gloves! I asked about it, and they confirmed that they don't wear gloves to make the food! Well, I went against my better judgement and still ate it after reheating it. Big mistake! After eating my Chicago style pizza, which was pretty average, I ended sick for the rest of the night. Definitely not going back here!

$2.50 BUD?! 

BALLPARK with chili and cheese, add the sauerkraut. 

VIENNA all beef dog with a whole sliced pickle, chunky tomatoes. ADD the sauerkraut. 

For all the places open at 11 pm on a Sat night, this place took the lead. 

The guy behind the counter was working alone the entire night, at the cashier and getting drinks, dogs, chili cheese fries, etc. as college and non-college fans poured in. Swamped, but sweet, helpful and prompt the whole time! Sadly, his tip jar was empty (gah, college budgets do not preclude tipping!!), so he got extras from us. 

Definitely trying the chili cheese fries next time. The paper trays passed us oozing with cheddar and chili. 

I may also have to leave room for their soft serve vanilla with churros.

1.5 stars. 

The only good thing about dining here is we got a 90min free parking with validation and their clam chowder. Unfortunately, that's it. 

With all the good reviews, my expectations were high. It was a hot day and it was lunch time, we didn't mind the long wait under the sun. But the wait could have been shorter if the staff were more attentive. There were already vacant seats but it took another 5 mins before they call the next guest on the list. Not good for the business, definitely not good for waiting customers.

Crab cakes - If i didn't know what they were, I won't be able to guess that they were crab cakes. Just a fishy patty of some sort.

Fried calamari/scallop/shirmps - They were cooked just right. Could have been perfect if they were not salty.

Rock crab special, served with soup and salad - Soup and salad were served first, expecting they were cooking the crab. After 20 mins, we follow up on the crab and it was brought to our table right away... It was big! At least the top shell.. Underneath the deceiving shell was a crab half of the top shell size. The top shell was even clean, meaning it was empty like as if it has been washed and used several times already. Also, we waited 20 mins for a steamed crab to be served COLD.. Not just room temperature but like it came out of the fridge. Thinking we may have placed the order wrong, we asked the server if it was supposed to be cold. She acted surprised and took the crab back and said she will send it back to be reheated. She came back just few minutes after she sent back the crab, im not surprised that its still not warm. What a waste of money. 

Silverwares have heavy water stains, looks very unsanitary. Forks were crooked. We asked for water refill for all 5 glasses and she only filled 2 glasses and attended to needs of the other customers. Good for them, bad for us. We will never come back.

What a great little shop in Broad Ripple. Do yourself a favor and skip the Starbucks down the street and head in to MCC next time you're in need of a caffeine fix.

I've stopped by several times, and have always ordered something non-coffee.  I'm not much of a coffee fan, but that doesn't mean there aren't tons of options for you here.  I've had smoothies, italian sodas (peach! highly recommend!) and hot chocolate from here.  Prices are very fair.

The atmosphere is very casual and inviting.  You're lucky to score a seat here on a busy weekend, but that's fine because you can sip your beverage while perusing the local shops in the area.  You won't want to pass up this gem in the heart of Broad Ripple!

My fiancé and I have stopped here twice during lunch time. Both times we received exceptional service. During lunch hours, you definitely do get your money's worth. It comes with an eggroll and a side of soup, along with your entree for only $7.95. (You can't beat that). I believe the soup changes daily/weekly because both times we dined in, it was a different type of soup. 

We ordered papaya salad, (yummy with different texture of crunch) pad kee mao (noodle dish, had a kick of spice, but was a little too sweet for our liking) and the fish with Thai herbal sauce (fish was fresh, tender and crunchy on the outside; had good flavors).

My boyfriend and I were glad that we stopped in for lunch. Fast and friendly service, with good portion sizes and tasty food. Nothing fancy or complicated. I will definitely come back when I'm in the area. Keep in mind, I don't have experience with what Cuban food is supposed to taste like, so those with a particular taste in mind might have a different experience.

I guess you could consider me a "loyal" customer because I haven't been to any other smog place in town since my short time here. 

Side rant: I'm from Florida. I don't know anything or WHY Nevada is all about this smog business. I think its just to generate more revenue for the DMV who makes out like a bandit with cash. I guess its just the stubborn Floridian in me that doesn't want to be told that I have to go the extra mile to prove to somebody that my car isn't leaving a remarkably large footprint on the environment.... okay end rant. 

So: My experience with Q's Quick Smog is just about as brief as I'm going to write in this review. This place is easy as pie, the guys working here are quick efficient and KNOWLEDGEABLE (even with my dumb floridian questions), I've never had any problems, their prices are competitive, and its close to everywhere else I go.

So, there it is yelpers. If you just finished reading this review and are currently at this location waiting for the check to be completed..... its already done.

I am giving this 4 stars because it has all the right stuff including location (for me at least).  I was teetering between three and four stars b/c though the food is good, atmosphere kitchy, there isn't anything exceptional about the place.  Like no creepy regular who sits at the counter harassing the waitresses or fun music to get your day going.  but i guess i am more into the offbeat kinda places that have those things.  anyway about the food.  WOAH french toast....oh yes this is my favorite breakfast food, and boy do they cook it up right!  kudos to them for not getting all crazy fancy like most places and botching what should be a simple and tasty treat.  now for the home fries, second most favorite item on the menu.  they are like little potato chips that rock!  the eggs...well i am picky about eggs over MEDIUM! they are adequate, but not my fav.  i haven't drank coffee in over a year now so i can't comment on that...i have moved on to tea and well...really? you'd have to be really bad to mess that up.  

over all i really like this place.  staff is friendly and stays out of your hair which i like.  food comes out super quick. and prices are good.  if you're in the area check it out.

The restaurant opens at 5 p.m. on Sunday. I arrived at 5:08 and was told I was the first name on the list. Great.  Sat at the bar and had a tea with a shot of brandy.  When my friends checked to see how long the wait was, we were told it would be two hours.  Even though we were first on the list.  So I went to pay for my drink and it was $13.  FOR A TEA AND A SHOT. 
    When the drink is more than the burger and there's a two-hour wait when you're first on the list, there's something wrong.    If you're not an uber foodie, save your money and your time and head over to Royal or Good Dog.

It was a wait in line for awhile, say about an hour and we went at 7:30. The selection is awesome, from pastas to seafood, Asian to Mexican foods. They had plenty of everything Prime Rib, snow crab legs both steamed and cold on ice, seafood soup with mussels, clams and crab legs in it. The service was great, stayed on top of drink refills and took away used buffet plates quickly. The atmosphere was good to, modern decor, stacked stone walls, tiled floors and sculptured lighting. If in the area we would return!

Mobile check-in was easy. The location is just off I40 at Donelson near BNA. The guy at the front desk was super friendly. They put me in a suite, but I did not care for it. I called down stairs
And the front desk moved me to a standard king room. Much more comfortable. About like a Hilton Garden Inn.

Delicious ramen, duh. The dumplings (whatever the special is, just get it) were also tasty.

The place is very, very small - I'd call it cramped - so be prepared. There's also often a long wait, though I was there on a Tuesday night around 6 pm and was lucky to get at able for two without a wait.

Only other negative is I do think it's just a tad overpriced. I mean, it is still soup and noodles (with perhaps a little protein), so leaving down over $20 for a soup and a few dumplings is a little more than I would've liked. 

But it's by no means not worth it - if you're a ramen fan, or are thinking of trying it, Cheu is a fantastic choice.

WORST HOOKAH BAR EVER!!!! If you have smoked good hookah you know this isn't it. Our hookah tasted burnt making us suspect that it was probably an old hookah where they add a little bit of fresh shisha. The staff is rude and don't try to help you if you tell them you have a problem. Instead they keep walking by you, look at you and ignore you as if they do not care. As a female, the staff hits on you and only assists you if you flirt with them. Been here a few times because it's open late, while hoping each experience would get better. Nope I was wrong! Disappointed for the LAST time!

We dined at Luke for Christmas dinner 2016.  This is a busy, hectic restaurant and does not bode well for a relaxing atmosphere.  In addition, the layout is a long galley so the servers are carefully navigating the space to not bump into each other or customers.  The lighting was bright, not what we were expecting.  We spoke with the manager that night, a woman named Tea who was really great and you could tell that she was the glue keeping the operation together.  Food was good, but I wasn't blown away.  It's tough to stand out in a city with so many great options.

This is a long running food festival event in Nashville. It has a lot of potential and honestly can be a lot of fun! Why the 3 stars then, you ask! 

First lets talk about the good. The drinks. There are tons of different types of drinks to try, whether you are into beers, wine, cocktails, tea or water. Some places give you quite generous pours and you can try as much or as little as you want. That's the awesome part and brings up the value of the tickets. 

Food. This is where it is hit or miss and brings it down. Honestly, there is so much potential with this food festival. But it is not in line, food wise, with some of the other food festivals in Nashville to make it great. This isn't a reflection on the Taste of Music City itself, but a word on the actual tents and participants. The issue is that they have to mass produce a large amount of food, with limited space and basically only things to keep it warm. Which means lower product quality unfortunately. It also means that there is a ton amount of pork. I am not a big pork eater and when half of the tents are serving pork - because its easy to cook in huge quantities and hard to mess up - it means you are basically doing a pork tour. We had pork tacos, pork buns, pulled pork, pork sandwiches etc. I will give it up to the several people on the inner circle who were able to grill and put out a good product. Several good chicken dishes included the Farm House and Whiskey Kitchen. 

This is a fun event. Great time with another couple or friends who enjoy spending time eating and drinking. I wouldn't suggest it as a food-driven event though. Although it did have a lot of food choices, they money on the food-side would be better served at a nice sit-down restaurant. As for the drinks, that's well worth the money. 

TIP: Get there early because although it was supposed to go to 9pm, most places ran out or were close to shutting down around 7:30/8.

Went in around 8:30am, no line, seated immediately.
Staff were all very friendly and helpful.
Ordered the bacon and eggs breakfast, and the chocolate chip pancakes with a side of sausage. Both dishes were great. 

Not sure what the hype is about. Seems like standard decent pancake house or diner food. Would go again, but not sure if I'd wait on the long lines that are usually around.

You cannot beat the quality for the $$, do not bother with Zappos/Amazon, unless you need an idea of models out there...

I Just got two pairs of Asics for $150. Best deal ever!

And a question for other reviewer re: Crocs- "wtf: they don't sell crocs, have you even been there??!!!"

small fee for credit cards, but you'll not really notice in the grand scheme of things
went inside. fam got hibachi all around and Sushi. hibachi was great hade better sushi at other places

This place is average.  Don't be fooled by the name, this place doesn't qualify as a "lodge", I would put it a step or two above "motel".hat 

The Good:  everything in this place was clean, and everything works.  Until you've stayed in a hotel where that isn't true, you don't realize that gets a star all by itself.  The staff is friendly and helpful, and I'm pretty sure even the cleaning staff mostly spoke english.  You get the basic amenities, plus a fridge (Bonus!).  The rooms are large and amicably decorated.  The headboard looks like palm leaves.

The Bad:  The power button on our decade-old T.V. was broken.  Remote worked so it wasn't a big deal.  The Continental breakfast was definitely lacking.  Coffee, O.J., milk, and sugary carbs is only technically a balanced breakfast.  On Sunday morning they spoiled their guests with an offering of bananas.  The sheets had a noticeably low thread count and were itchy, and I had a hard time both falling and staying asleep both nights I stayed here, so I may be a little grumpy as I write this.

Best company ever!!  During the hottest summer ever, the HVAC unit in our condo quit.  It is a very unique unit that is not made by most manufacturers. There was a 4 week delay in being able to get the unit.  Unique Indoor Comfort came out to the condo twice to see if they could get the AC to work until we could get a new unit.  It was not fixable. Meanwhile, they started calling their suppliers and found 1 unit nearby.  They picked it up and installed in the next day.  They gave me an Angie's list $300 discount that they were offering that I didn't even know about.  Everyone I spoke to and delay with at the company was so helpful and went above and beyond what was expected.  I will recommend them to everyone I know and use them in the future.  Special thank you to Chris!!

This was a nice dining experience, and it's definately very hard to decide whether it's 3 stars or 4 stars. Here's the breakdown of my experience at Bistro St. Tropez...

Location- 2 Stars; it was a very odd location

View- 4 Stars; it offered a nice view of 30th St station and the river

Food- 3.5 Stars;  I enjoyed the Saumon Fume I ordered for my appetizer, but my meal was good, not great. My husbands meal was great, not excellent

Decor- 3 Stars; The decor was a tad 90's. It could use a little decor update, but it wasn't horrible

Service- 4 Stars; our waiter was attentive and pleasant without being overbearing

Overall, it was a pleasant enough experience, but I probably wouldn't head back there again any time soon.

Have to say this is one of my favorite places to eat in Pinellas County.  Nice atmosphere!  Great food! Great desserts! Friendly bar!  Always have received outstanding service. I took a friend there and it immediately became his favorite as well!  Such a nice change from a "chain" restaurant.

The root beer soda was the best part of the dinner. Loaded fries were unloaded. The fajitas were totally burned. Worst dinner every. The waiter tried what else can I say but stay away. 
2 stars is being generous!!!

Not bad overall, but lacked the complexity of flavor I enjoy from typical Thai food.The sauces were very similar and the spices needed some kick. However, some folks may really enjoy it if they want simpler flavors, and the service was very nice and attentive. I wouldn't say it's worth a special trip out to the Main Line, and there are other options worth trying if you're already out there.

Pork/chicken/shrimp rolls - Steamed dumplings with a nice sauce, but very dry stuffing

Evil jungle princess - Tasty, crisp vegetables and a generous portion of chicken with this Thai restaurant staple

(forgot the name) - Chicken and shrimp in a tamarind sauce served in hollowed out pineapple half. Interesting presentation, crispy vegetables, but sauce was very similar to the evil jungle princess sauce.

Came to Sun Diner on Friday morning to be met by the most awesome waitress Jillian! Great atmosphere, awesome awesome staff! Food is so good and something for everyone. Thanks Jillian! You made our experience so so much fun!!!
Everything I order is perfect everytime. Pizza's are incredible, sauce is full of fresh basil.

I can't stand this place.  Called and was cursed out for no reason.  I guess we were ordering to much and the guy couldn't keep up so he started yelling at me. The pizza is to sweet anyway so screw them. Uncle nicks has better pizza and they're crust is way tastier.

INCREDIBLE subs for a great price. it never fails when i order my #8 with no lettuce or tomato, they usually have it at my place of employment, before i even have the money ready. super-fast delivery, fresh meats and breads, and the price is just right. i am always happy to get a DOUBA J SUB. kudos.

In town for Essence Festival and all I can say is how do service workers do it with all these people !!! Anyway, absolutely loved the Shrimp and Crabmeat Omelette. Spencer, our waiter, has a killer smile !!
Every time I order from here I'm disappointed I guess every time Ive given it  another chance I hope it will be better because it's convenient.Im wrong I'm official done!

Went here with my husband for a night away from the kids and as a place to stay near Longwood gardens. It is reasonably priced for the area. We stayed in a suite, it had a fireplace (which we didn't use), a jacuzzi tub - small and only room for one, and VERY comfortable king bed. The room was clean and overall comfortable with just a smudge more charm than a standard chain hotel. The AC in the room was terrible - it was not super hot or anything but it never got cool. Don't expect much for the included breakfast-  3 containers of strawberry yogurt, a few boxes of cereal, and a waffle iron. Rooms don't have coffee maker. The location was good for what we needed and the price was also good for what we needed. I wouldn't go out of my way to stay here but it worked for us.

Things have definitely improved here. I've gone the last couple of Friday afternoons with my step kids. Burgers are quite delicious and well made. Onion soup is also improved with cheese properly melted. Service is attentive and the beer selection is good and cold. I'm glad to see the place making a go of it!

Excellent place to decompress and relax!  I started with 30 minutes of sauna/whirlpool/relax room. Wow. What a treat. Make sure to turn down the lights and experience the stars up on the ceiling. A great way to get ready for a massage. From there I moved to a 90 min massage with Shawn. 

Outstanding therapist. Very strong and he had a rhythm that offered the perfect pressure. Outstanding scalp and neck treatment. The entire session was epic. 

The place is very clean and well maintained. Go check it out!
Come here every couple weeks and load up on tacos. Ask for the salsa from the back its way hotter than the bar one

Have been here twice now and liked it both times. The place has a bar in front, restaurant in back. I bring my kids and don't love waiting in the bar for a table, but that's really about the only down side to this place. Good kids options and tons of food in the kids meals. Also great things for the kids to play with while you wait. Salad is the Gianino family recipe and done better than most of the Gianino family  places in town, but super big so it may fill you up. Great toasted ravs, really plump and fresh. I like the variety on the menu and my food was good and fresh both times. It would be nice if pastas came with a salad, but the salad is so big that my husband and I shared the one that came with his entree and both had plenty. I will be back for a great dinner where my kids are happy too.

Great place in the "middle district" of St Pete off 49th and 30th ave. Great Burg favorites, freshest breakfast in town, and they pay homage to the old Cuban Delight with a cool Cuban menu! Small space so get here early! Limited seating out front.
The only thing worse than the food was the horrible service. Wouldn't recommend this place to my worst enemy. Eating here is $60 and 2 hours of my life that I will never get back

I assume this is the BP we get delivery from. Which is always amazing! I admit they are a few $$ more but in the end they are my fav. pizza delivery place. Prompt and tasty. Lunch wasn't that great. The service was good. I mean not amazing. I did ask for a second to pick a drink but it did take a few minutes. The ceaser I had was great though. While the ribs were tasty the size was tiny. Overall it was a decent lunch but I wish I had stuck to the pizza or pasta I know is always good there. It is the delivery that gives this place a 4/5 in the end!

I had a great experience at Rodney Mitchell. I actually got my haircut from Rodney himself. It was easy to make an appointment and my appointment actually started on time. The haircut itself did not last long at all because Rodney clearly knows what he is doing. I really didn't have much of an idea of what I wanted to do with my hair (minus make me look JUST LIKE Kate Middleton) and Rodney was great with guiding me to the right cut. 

Of note, there is a second location opening downtown soon. Also, be careful with parking at this salon (right by Vanderbilt) because they ticket heavily.

If you are new, your haircut is going to run you ~$50.

This place is amazing. If you like duck, you must try their infamous duck fries. It is sooooooo good. This is my go to spot when in doubt. The reason why it didn't get 5star is because food literally takes forever to come out and portions are kind of small. But other than that everything is amazing, interior is cute although can get a little loud during busy hours and it's hard to hear myself breathe.

We came here for a change as we hadn't eaten here in quite  a while. The hostess seated us promptly within moments of our arrival. Next, came Joe our server who took excellent care of our needs. 

We started with Calamari as an appetizer which was excellent. My wife had the blu salad which she said was great. I had the Capris salad which was excellent. Next my wife ordered the mix grill which was way to spiceynfor her as they used way too many  red peppers. 

I ordered the steak med rare and it was cook perfectly, but was way tuff and had no flavor. If it wasn't for Joe's service I would have given 2 stars

Second run theater that still has the corporate backing of Cinemark, making it slightly nicer than your average second run theater. Nice because you can still find second run 3D movies here. This older theater has a fun retro vibe.

Best sushi place around hands down!!! I tried about 10 sushi restaurants in the area before finding this one and they really have the best menu! Gyoza is amazing. Tuna tartar is amazing. And all their special sushi rolls are delicious! I go here at least once a week!
Very poor service and pathetic quality of food. Would never come back here and also not recommend for any of them this place.

Fried chicken.
Fried chicken.
Fried chicken.

That's pretty much all I heard one morning was, "Fried chicken." So, we got fried chicken.

Willie's Chicken Shack is basically a fast food joint. But, it wasn't so fast. It could have been because everyone just got out of the Saints vs. Cubs game. When friends and I arrived, the line was almost at the door. Ordering was slow going. There was only 1 cashier taking food orders. The other cashier, closest to the entrance, was strictly for drinks. 

After waiting a good 15 minutes, it was my time to order. I got the 2 piece mix w/ biscuit and side. But, side choices are limited to only fries, jambalaya and red beans & rice. I was told that they didn't have mashed potatoes, even though it was on the menu. It could have been that they just run out. The impatient cashier just made it sound like they no longer served it. I ended up picking the jambalaya.

Besides the 2 cashiers, there was one person to plate the food and another person to deliver the meals. I'm also going to assume that there's one person in the back doing all the cooking. Quite frankly, it's not enough people to deal with such a big rush. 

Tables were dirty and it took a while for someone to clean them off. We pretty much cleaned our own, as we waited for our food to arrive. Surprisingly, the our food order didn't take that long. So, that was a plus. The chicken was pretty good and juicy. My side of jambalaya was merely okay. Biscuit was good, but I've had better. 

Willie's would be an A-OK stop, if you want fried chicken. Just not when a football game has been let out or when it's a meal rush.
Nice space, great vibe and some good dishes.  Especially fond of the pork rillettes appetizer!

OK, I ordered their supreme pizza with a thin crust. If this is thin, I would hate to see their regular crust. There is nothing thin about it. The crust is quite similar to Papa Johns, a location that I have boycotted for years. The toppings are nothing special. Will not be returning and do not recommend. Go the NYPD (New York Pizza Department) or Broadway Pizza if you want good pizza.

When I think of pizza, I think of Deweys! I have tried all the pizza joints in town and nothing beats this place. The peppercorn salad is a great way to start. I love love love their buffalo chicken pizza (inferno).  It is to die for. Their crust is so flakey and soft. Whenever I'm in the mood for pizza, this is my place.

So I had a bikini wax with Valerie and it was so much less painful then I remember having done before. This was my first time waxing at European Wax Center and so I got my first visit free which was great. I will be back, and will always ask for Valerie. Also, service was fast and the place seemed very clean.

I went to brunch at Herbie's this morning with my family. We were a large group however, there were not a lot of patrons in the restaurant. We waited 20 minutes before the server took our order. And then another entire hour before our food came. I complained to the manager and he did give us 20% off of our bill. If that weren't bad enough the food was subpar and over priced. I would not return.
Horrible fish tacos, looked like fish sticks from the microwave..i would never eat there again.
Went here with my wife for her birthday and was a very good experience.  Loved the food and the staff.  Definitely a place to go to again.

Took my parents here for a nice casual dinner in Philly. They, as well as myself, loved it. Pizza is made fresh right in front of you and it tastes that way. The pepperoni was fantastic. The prosciutto was great. And don't skip one of the fresh salads. The dressing was just the right amount. Washed this all down with a pale ale from their nice sized beer selection.
Pulled pork is Awesome!! They were sold out of ribs, beef, chicken, and sausage.  Shows that the BBQ is really good!

This place could not be cuter. The decor, the staff, the baked goods, everything. Firstly, the shop is a treat for the eyes. Everything about it conjures images of Madam Puddifoot's Tea Shop; delicate, pink, princessy. Absolutely adorable. Secondly, the displays of baked goods is astonishing. Everything looks perfect, yet edible and delicious. Lastly, service is so friendly! Love all around. Can't wait to go back and try their champagne cocktails. 

Pro-tip: they have a small parking lot, use it! Also, cake slices are HUGE! Buy one to share. Lastly, service is great, but comes with a bit of a wait. Build in extra time for your stop!
Nice for the laid back approach. Burger was delicious. The service was not so great. The margaritas were not too tasty. The furniture and room to move around was not there it's very crowded and loud.

Ok so I'm gonna be honest and say I really only went here for the cookie dough egg roll because I saw a video on Facebook and knew I was going to be in Nashville and HAD to try it! Well, it didn't disappoint. We went and had brunch - I had the breakfast sliders which I thought were just ok because the biscuit was a little dry (not sure why most biscuits I had were dry). The portions were fairly small so I was able to get my dessert and enjoy it. The egg roll wrapper was odd but with the chocolate it really didn't taste any different. Glad I came across the Facebook video about this place

5 stars

Pretty sure it's Halal now, so that's a plus [not a muslim, but i'm all for adhering to a strict code of cleanliness, etc. when it comes to food]

Always fresh, always cooked per order
All their chicken, large pieces, or just wings, are deep fried after your order them, not once have I gotten any chicken from under the heat lamp.

Today, I got a fish sandwich, best fish sandwich I've had in a while.
Cooked per order, 5 minute wait and I had myself a great little fish sandwich.

Fish sandwich, side of fries, and a medium coke for $5.50 is a pretty good deal by me.

He sells used cars here

He's got more lemons than a 10 year old with a lemonade stand on a Saturday afternoon

 I paid $3,000 for a used vehicle 6 days later the engine exploded in a blaze while I was on the highway returning home from work

I had it towed back to the shop and he said he would repair it I left my car and returned 3 days later the mechanic that was supposed to be working on my car was sitting on the floor eating a bucket of chicken wings he looked up at me like he had never seen me before I asked him when my car will be ready, he replied: "God only knows!" Had to buy a new car, lost that $3,000...will buy fron official dealers for the rest of my life.
If you have money to burn, this is the place for you!

I purchased a batch of these cookies and some of the cookies contained sayings from someone else's order  (various orders). It made handing out the cookies kind of scary since I never knew what someone would get when they cracked one open (one of the sayings, for example, seemed to belong to a bachelorette party). I contacted the company about four times via both email and telephone with absolutely no response.

I heard a girl walk out of the bathroom and proclaim, "wow this might be the best bar I've ever been too." and I gotta say, she's right. Great drinks, friendly bartenders, excellently thought out decor.

Food was pretty good and big portions.  We went on a Sunday at 11am and had to wait over 20 minutes but we figured it would be lengthy.  On the weekends when it's really busy, they should have a policy of not seating partial groups.  If everyone in your party isn't there, oh well.  There are plenty of people waiting to eat.  Will try again but maybe on a weekday.

I'm definitely not the target demo for this place, because I'm not really the kind of guy who likes to spend ten bucks on a sandwich/drink combo. If I'm going to pay that much for a sandwich, I'd rather go to a dedicated sandwich shop (Jersey Mike's is usually my go-to), rather than pay the premium that comes with a cafe like this.

It's hard to totally call the meal overpriced though, since I actually really liked the food. I had the Newk's Q sandwich (bbq chicken), and it was great. I subbed the chips for a pasta salad in an ill-fated attempt for a healthier option, and that was a regrettable choice. But overall, great food.

There's tons of seating, and it's a very open space, so the atmosphere is nice. But in the end, I just don't think it's the place for me. I'd much rather get a better and bigger sandwich at Jersey Mike's for a couple dollars less.

YUMM... The sliders were amazing. I had the Bulgogi and my hubby had the chicken...AMAZING! So full of flavor!!! I was a little disappointed they weren't making the Nutella donut that day, I got the pink lemonade...it was ok, a little too tart for my taste buds, though. Hubby had the chocolate orange and he loved it! Next trip I hope they have Nutella donut!!

Heard folks rave about their bagels and lox, but it was just okay, not the greatest.  The lox didn't have enough taste to it, no real "punch" for me to say that it was off the hook.  Don't get me wrong though, this place was good as some of my other friends ordered other things.  Surrey's is also known for their bananas foster french toast, which was pretty good.  Some of us also ordered the "jungle punch or juice," which consisted of fresh juices, which I cannot recall anymore and cactus juice.  This had a rather interesting taste.  It tasted "green" and I don't know how to describe that.  I think it's an acquired taste, but I sure wouldn't order it.  Service was good, as the waitress came by to refill our water and my coffee.  Lastly, go early, as there are lines, but we lucked out and a table was ready when we got there.  On our way out, there was a line outside the restaurant.

I'd rate Surrey's a solid 3.5 star, not quite a 4 star in my books.

We stopped in on a Monday afternoon and gave this place a try after reading the reviews. It was really a great place. The drink specials they offer was 1/2 off margaritas on Mondays and the best part was the service. Our server Natasha was awsome. She explained some of her favorite dishes when we told her it was our first time and couldn't decide what to try. 
The grilled beef burrito was delicious with the red sauce and the portion was huge. We certainly were surprised at the great  level of service we got because Natasha was working by herself and she had 6 tables by the time our food arrived. If you want a great laid back spot to enjoy a drink and get some good food , check this spot out!

I have been here more times than I can count, and they never fail to disappoint. The food is delicious and very reasonably priced. Try the pupusas, tamales, or any of the combo platters and you will go home full and happy. The staff is very nice, patient, and friendly to non-Spanish speakers and took time to answer my questions about the dishes. Can't wait to go back!

This is such an amazing place, great service, large list of cocktails & mescals and the food is as good as anyplace in Tampa Bay. Andreas has done such a great job and this place deserves all the wonderful reviews you see on Yelp. Highly recommend!!!

Friendly staff, nicely decorated.  Looked like customers were mostly nearby college students.  Combination bùn was pretty decent, and the shrimp in it was good but on the smaller side.   Also the beef was charred. Egg roll could use a little something.
Like I said helpful and friendly staff,  but I had to flag one down to get the check. 
Will go back to try their banh mi as they did not have bread today due to an family emergency.

If you lonely and need someone to talk to go here!! You will find people old and young to talk to who are down to earth, live in the neighborhood and are friendly. This place has pole tables,good kitchen bar food, and borderline decent staff. When you first walk in it takes a second for you to find a seat since the seating arrangements are disorganized a little. People are loud at talking and normally screaming at the sports on t.v. When a bartender finally approaches you , they are on a grand hustle. They speak real fast, get to the point, take your order and charge u up !!!! At the end coming out of there I would always be cautious seems kind of shady and maybe some cops hiding in the cut ........This is a place I would visit a few times out of the year!!

Although the cantina at La Cocina is my fav spot, I do enjoy popping in here for a whiskey or European beer education from time to time. They've also got a rotating lineup of local beers. The inside and little outside patio are dog friendly as long as your pups are well behaved. It's a super charming little place with bumper tables and actual tables to sit at.
4.5....only because the icecream is exceedingly sweet. Toasted coconut in a sugar cone was soooooo good.

John Besh delivers in a big way here. The $.75 raw oysters are amazing and the fried ones are soft, not greasy or chewy and just friggin delicious. Drinks are half price during happy hour and I'd suggest the French 75 or the bourbon smash with peaches and mint. I was looking forward to this as was my wife and let's just say, there was not a single drop of disappointment in this place. Just fantastic.

Coming back from Carson wine walk. hungry. Heard the chicken was good here.   Like a sports. Bar the game was on  several tv s. Got here at 7pm  only 6 dinners. Plus 5 People at the bar. The server came over right away. Got our drinks.
We ordered 2 chicken dinners , our son ordered his usual cheeseburger.   Food came out in 18 min.   The chicken dinner cones with a biscuit fires and a side I got the Cole slaw.  Chicken was 5 stars Cole slaw ,2   stars needs something.   Will come back for the. Chicken.

The presentation of every dishes was so artistic! And loved the modern tasteful interior! Toro & King salmon sashimi were so fresh and delicious. Duck Confit came with a small side salad in house made plum dressing, toasted pine nuts, grapefruit & pomegranate was so fragrant, tender and juicy. Spicy seafood soup w bok choy was perfect for that snowy day. Most of all, never forget to try their dessert! Especially Thai Mango, passion fruit and Yuju sorbets were soooo good!!! Caramel cashew ice ream, Yuju ginger creme brûlée, and fresh Yuju whipped cream in fried wonton with berries in top - they all pleased our eyes and taste buds at the same time!! Chef Ben is simply a genius! One of the finest dining experience.

Great tasting subs made to order.  I love the fresh real turkey (not turkey roll you get at a deli).  Try the "Bobbie" sub..(turkey with stuffing and cranberry sauce)... only if you are not on a weight watchers diet.

Bland, nothing special abt it. A to go joint.  If you decide to eat there you will be served a plastic baggie with watery wasabi, and plastic cup with nasty tasting soy sauce. Really wanted to like this place but besides the cool look, it was a huge disappointment. Btw, the specialty rolls are ridiculously small for the price.

This location is amazing. There is a small courtyard where you can enjoy your food and listen to jazz literally all day long. The atmosphere is much better than the Royal St. location, but the food tastes the same. The beignets, eggs, waffles, potatoes, and coffee are all of the same quality in both locations. The line for food here is perpetually long, but it's definitely worth it. If you're going to do the tourist bit and eat a huge plate of beignets, this is absolutely the place to do it.

Not a frequent Yelper but felt compelled to write a review for this Hertz location.

The last two cars I have picked up from this location, including the one from this morning which I just got out of, absolutely reeked of cigar smoke.  I don't think they clean their cars here.  Which is a whole other level of problem I don't want to get into.  I'm sensitive to the smell as a former smoker but unless you absolutely love the smell of cigars your odds of finding a clean car are probably much better at one of the other counters here: Avis, National, etc

Food was great but our experience was a little odd...

I went for brunch on a Sunday with my roommates/friends. We had to wait outside for probably 15 minutes, not a biggie though. We were seated and when our waitress came to fill our waters she spilled one of the full glasses all over my friends phone/lap/shoes. She didn't really apologize which was weird... then about 10 minutes later she came to fill up the coffees and spilled my friends orange juice in the process of filling the coffees. It was 2 spills within 15 minutes and it was kindof crazy to be honest. Thank god it wasn't the hot coffee!

Otherwise, the food was very good. The atmosphere is very hipster but it was cool. I would go back, but I would be careful!

I've had a couple good experiences here since I moved into the area a few months ago. I've only had take out but it has been pretty tasty, and it comes out super fast, even for a chinese place. The decor inside is a bit over the top in my opinion, you just have to see it to understand.
 I'll continue to order from here cause I live right around the corner. There are some places in the general area that are just as good or better but Dragon Garden definitely satisfies the chinese food craving for me.

This place reminds me of Portland/Seattle. I only had one (gigantic) doughnut, the lemon icebox, it was a bit too sweet. Being a doughnut place I expected it to be on point. I recommend getting multiple chicken sliders because they are delicious. The bread is nice and the chicken is cooked perfectly! This place is busy, so I'd go before or after lunch time. You order at the counter and wait for your name to be called when your order is ready. There is free water available at the bar.

Ordered for pickup when I arrived order was ready. When I got home opened bag found wrong order had to go back and exchange order but also was charged for wrong order and was refunded difference. Food is always good here this is the first time had issue with them

Lovely little yoga studio!  My first impression of this place was that it was clean.  I've been to many yoga studios and one thing I can't stand is the moldy, gym-sock smell that lurks in some of Philly's studios.  

Yoga Garden sounds just like its name - fresh and clean.  The studio space is quite large and they keep extra mats and blocks nicely organized in the rear of the room.  The staff is very friendly and knowledgeable too!

I really like the sunrise vinyasa classes at 7am, but I wish they held them every day of the week (excluding weekends, of course).  Right now, they are only offered Tues/Thurs.  If you're on a budget like I am, the early morning or lunch hour classes are affordable ($8).  They do offer a week of free yoga, so you really have no excuses not to try it out, do you?

This place is worth the glowing reviews and  5 stars it currently has. Small clean dining space but the important thing here is the food. The chaats are truly a flavor explosion that is custom built for you. I order spicy and find it perfectly so, not too mild but doesn't leave me in tears. 

The number of lassi flavors and combinations are impressive. I've only had Cardamom & Mango so far but both were delicious!

Where you'll find me on Tuesday nights. 
"What is Our Place?"
That's correct, and let me tell you why-
I'd been in Greg's before, for a couple of IYG events, but it was weird, I was the only woman I spotted and there was a performer, and no one was tipping her except me, so I pretty much stayed with Talbott. That is, until one of my fb friends mentioned Bingo and on a whim, I checked it out, and walked into one of the most friendly, crazy (don't deny it) and fun things to do on a Tuesday. It is definitely something I look forward to, and I like drinking where I don't feel obligated to dance, because I cannot. Plus, I won! How cool is that? Just don't take my seat when you go- you gotta go sit with the losers in the other room. :)

Being that I am addicted to Boba Tea, this place has the best Lavender Boba Tea I've ever had.  We've eaten there a few times and everything is good. They don't rush, so make sure you allow plenty of time to enjoy your meal. The servers are friendly and the atmosphere is pleasant. About 11 tables if I remember correctly. I haven't had a chance to try the shaved ice yet, but according to the reviews, it's the best.
food is great and all at great pricing. don't mind eating here all the time. the variety of food is immense and you wont leave hungry. you gotta love the home style taste. thumbs up and 5 star

I love this place. The food blows Applebees away for a fast lunch. Sometimes the burgers are a bit greasy but hey, it's a burger. The good part about this place is that you can get in and out quick if you are trying to have a quick lunch during the day if you are at work!! I love the onion rings here too.

five stars for their soon doo boo.  soon doo boo is a spicy silken tofu stew served in a mini stone pot.  the soup is meant to be eaten spicy so it will taste bland if you order it mild.  for me, their soon doo boo stands out because of the broth.  it is full of complex flavors other than red chili peppers.  

i loved that the rice was served in a stone pot as well.  when you finish your meal, you will notice a layer of roasted rice at the bottom of the pot.  you can ask for hot water to be poured into your rice pot for an after-meal palette cleanser.

the restaurant is clean and has a traditional feel to it.  the servers left us alone but we were able to use the call buttons on the table for service.

overall, excellent soon doo boo!!
Cool beach vibe. Lot's of margarita choices. Items on their menu can be made Gluten Free which is a plus. Staff was very friendly, food arrived quickly and was very good. The live music was great.
We had a blast over eating as we sampled from the menu. Food was fresh and delicious. Nice friendly family and welcoming service.  Experienced NOLA chefs taking pride and serving good stuff.

This brand new salon looks so chic inside. Everything is sparkly and fresh and just looks so new from the floors to the chairs to the giant flat screen and the trendy decor. 

I had my eyebrows done and a basic pedicure and I've never had anyone take so much time with me at this price range ($30 for the pedi, $12 for brows). It's slightly more than other places in Old City but definitely worth it. I'll be back!
It was my second time eating here the first time was a very long time ago. Well the food was great and so was the service if nice portions. I had the seafood platter was very good

I really like the design of this place. Very tropical, very beachy which I love. You walk in and painted all over the walls is fish, and birds, and palm trees. Very beachy type drinks and food. Food is excellent I usually get some sort of fish. Very fresh and tasty. The amount of TVs help you keep up with sports if you need to, but if not it's just a nice place to go hang out for a little

Just pizza has really good pizza, we order from them every weekend. I order their bake potato with cheese and bacon and talking about delicious OMG. They also have awesome subs, but tonight i order a ham & cheese (only) and when we got our food everyone elses food was good but mine. My sandwich had lettuce and mayo on it (which i didn't want on it) and on one half of it, it has little pieces of ham like someone ate it and put on the bread, and one or two pieces on it. The other half had 2 big pieces of ham on it. And it wasn't even cooked. So i called them and told them about it.When the delievery guy got here he said to toss the old one, i showed it to him and he said that wasn't even cooked. And the owner is there and he will take it back to show him. So they send me out another one and this time the ham was really sliced thin like for pizza and not much on it and alot of cheese, burnt. Bread burnt. I won't be ordering anything from them anymore. They lost my busy. Since they moved to 16th Street they went down. We pay alot of money each time we order from there EVERY WEEKEND!!!!!

they have got to update and clean the ladies room!!!!
Food was good, expected more after all the reviews.

The whiskey is just coming of age. The brews are distinctive - this is not another Sierra Nevada imitation. And the food is both good and a good value. Upstairs for the non-family crowd and downstairs otherwise. Either way the restored depot architecture is worth checking out.

Great staff and location! The happy hour deal for tacos you cannot beat! The tacos are fantastic and the meat is so tender. They source some of their meats from two-run farm among other local ingredients.

Awesome layout, great music, interesting drinks, and knowledgeable bartenders. I had the Clubber Lang which was Bourbon, bitters, and vermouth I think. They went down realllllly smooth. We sat upstairs but there's plenty of seating in the courtyard by the stage too.

Wine and cheese isn't my thing, but that's the main draw. I was happy to find out they were way more than just a place to get a wine and cheese tray.

Worst store to do business with ever, in my opinion. I have just spent the last 30 minutes trying to get someone in their linen department. Not one person ever picked up in that department. I was transferred all over the store though. Called back to let the mgr of the store know how lousy customer service is, shockingly no one could connect me with him. I was transferred to the "executive offices" and hung up after being on hold for almost 9 minutes.  Done with Macy's

Located in the bottom of a canyon under the highway 152 bridge,  this is an incredibly awesome place to stop for a short walk. The food is okay, but the buildings and scenery are fantastic. Since the bathroom is located outside of the restaurant, you can use it without much trouble.

To say that I am disappointed in the people organizing this race is being incredibly nice. I gave my money and trained hard for the Philly race. While they aren't responsible for the weather, the people running the show should be responsible for at least rescheduling. I was warned that these guys were administrative amateurs...

We ordered a half sausage half cheese pizza that was awesome!  Im so picky with pizza places but this was just as good as boardwalk pizza.  We had 2 cheese steaks which are better than the 12.00 ones in south philly. Full of meat and cheesey goodness. Worth every penny.  We didnt wait long for delivery on a sat at 5pm. Under an hour!! I found my new pizza joint!
This Chipotle is very clean and has the most friendly staff. The food is fresh and chips are hot. I know we will be returning!

Kyber Pass Pub is a great little bar and restaurant. I love all of the vegan options and the unique cuisine. I've tried both the vegan chicken po'boy and the vegan bbq pulled pork. Both were delicious! So far, my favorite side order has been fried okra, which was a weekend special. This place also has a nice craft beer selection, which I always appreciate. Warning: they're crowded! You'll probably need to wait a while for a table.

Went in because my daughter couldn't breathe. She had been diagnosed that morning with her pediatrician with strep throat that had an asthma component. She was given a breathing treatment, steroid and antibiotic that morning and had a pretty good day. 
At night, she was constantly coughing and struggling to breathe. She couldn't sleep and was just beside herself. I decided that a trip to the urgent care was appropriate, and that another breathing treatment might help. 
Checked in online, easy process.
Pleasant front desk staff. 
Wait was longer than I expected considering the online system said only one person was in front of me. 
Triage nurse, the gal who took our vitals was very nice, thorough and understanding. At that time my daughters oxygen saturation was 95, which is the very lowest acceptable level for a child. 
Went into a room and waited, when the NP came in it was pretty clear he had already made the "diagnosis" and declared that she had allergies, and offered me a prescription for Claritin. Seriously? He looked in her ears, batted away all of my concerns with, "yeah she has strep" and was ready to walk out the door. I insisted on a breathing treatment, and he allowed it, "it probably won't help though."

Imagine my surprise when the tech came in to check her oxygen levels again and it was at 98. The tech said, "it's a little better!" And the NP quickly said, "Yep, that's what she came in with!"

No, that's not what she came in with, I made sure to take note of it because she was low that morning with her pediatrician. 

Overall, a frustrating experience, even for an Urgent Care. I'm not expecting a full assessment, but a little bedside manner could go a long way here. 

There are probably other good NPs at this location, but we didn't have a good experience. If you go, you better already know what you need and be ready to advocate for yourself, because you might get dismissed pretty quickly.
OMG best shrimp and grits ever! I haven't had a lot of grits but those were some nicely seasoned shrimp!

OMG!!  No wonder this place is always PACKED!!  The decor is so pretty and fitting in the Quarter. It's totally fine dining with a more relaxed attitude and ambiance.  JC is AWESOME!!  So nice, so accommodating and friendly! And the food....must have the Gumbo Ya Ya!!  Super tasty, best gumbo I had on my visit to NOLA BY FAR!  We had 4 in our party, had a drink at the bar...waited maybe 10 minutes tops!!  My hubby had the pork chop, 2 of us had the filet and 1 had the fish of the day.   We ALL were sharing and raving.  The food is TOP NOTCH!!  Can't wait for our next trip to NOLA and to Mr. B's.

I've been to this place twice now: once for the lunch buffet and one time for takeout.

For the buffet lunch, I'd like to contribute our late arrival to the food being rather stale because other reviewers seem to love the buffet. The options that were offered were simply not fresh but the flavors were definitely amazing, don't get me wrong!

For the takeout, I ordered the chicken biryani, which should have been really called biryani rice with 3 pieces of chicken. I could barely find the chicken in the mound of rice. The other dishes were flavored great and everyone was pleased except for the fact that we were also missing a couple ordered items that we were charged for. And by the time we got it home, it's too much effort to drive all the way back so that person wasn't able to get all their food.

I really wanted to like this place as the reviews rave about it but honestly both experiences weren't amazing for me and there's a lot of other Indian restaurants in the surrounding area that may offer better service.

I had such high hopes for this place! We visited on a Thursday night and there was only one other table. It took us over an hour to get our food and the waitress forgot to ring in one of our items, so we spent about 2.5 hours there. The food was brought out cold and she didn't even offer to take it off the check. I will certainly not be returning here, ever!

Worst service! Told the hostess we wanted to sit in the bar area and she insists on sitting us in the back of the restaurant which is empty. Sat there for over 10mins with tons of staff walking by & just staring at us but no service, not even water. We finally got fed up and walked out. Horrible!
I'm just going to say try the Wing Sauce Pizza, get it with a side of Blue Cheese or Ranch,  it will change your life.

A really unique place that's up in the mountains about 30 min from S.B. the building does remind you of a time when it was on the stage coach trail, great charm. The Cold Spring Chicken was excellent.
The food was delicious and the service was almost too fast. It has a beautiful atmosphere and the tables have outlets! The prices are reasonable and I am definitely returning.
They were great! Had a new person training and they even gave me the left over but smoothie in the blender! First time I've had that happen to me anywhere! Sweet!

I selected Mr. B's Bistro for my birthday dinner and was not disappointed. We had the BBQ shrimp and the bacon wrapped shrimp and grits. The BBQ shrimp were easily the best I've ever had. They were flavorful and it was a very generous portion in which we ate every last bite. The grits were creamy and delicious with the right amount of sweetness and the shrimps were perfectly cooked. The service was professional and attentive and the ambiance of the restaurant was very nice. We will be back!
Great cause, better food.  The neighborhood is not the best but do not let that detour you from experiencing this place
Karina tended to our order and the quality of the products are extraordinary and so fresh!! Such an amazing quality fudge and such great customer service.

My family and I have been going to Nicks in South Philly since we were kids.  I am so happy they are in my local neck of the woods.  Their food is amazing every time.  Their service is hit or miss.  The food is the best!!

Literally the best dining experience I've had in Tucson.  
Beet carpaccio was delicious -- light and interesting.
Mussels were really good -- usually Tucson seafood freaks me out -- but no angst here.
Arctic char was perfect -- seriously just go.  Call make a reservation and stop eating subpar food.  Enjoy!

I am always rooting for Qdoba. I think the toppings (bbq sauce and queso) should give it a real edge over Chipotle. But for some reason, it just never feels better.

The ambiance is ok, but its more fast food than fast casual. The staff is friendly. Food execution is consistent, but the food in general lacks the zest and freshness of a Chipotle.

I would not hesitate to eat here if I needed something real quick, but I wouldn't go out of my way.

Every time I go I say I'll never go back (it's just so close).  I've never had to wait and the people are pleasant.  But I've never seen them sterilize their tools or clean the foot baths with a cleaner.   My pedis have been fine but the last two chipped.  I'm mostly concerned about the cleanliness.
