I've been to this place twice, with two separate female barbers, and won't be going back.  Each time, I've asked for the sides to be buzzed and a trim on the top.  It's a pretty easy request.  

Both times, the barber missed TONS of stray hairs on the top.  I kept pointing them out, and she obligingly cut them, but it shouldn't be on me to make sure the barber does a competent job.  Last time and the most recent time, I had to get my girlfriend to take a pair of scissors and trim all the stray hairs that they missed.  I forget the name of the first barber, but Christine was the one who screwed up this time.  I looked in the mirror and found small patches of hair that she missed with the clippers all over my head because she didn't do a thorough job.  

If I'm going to pay good money for a haircut, I shouldn't have to fix it myself afterward.  The barbers here are more concerned about gossiping and chatting than focusing on the task at hand.  They also resisted what I wanted, and I had to specifically request that they please do what I'm paying them to do.  

If they screw up my relatively simple request, don't trust them to do something more complicated.

Our first experience at a Vietnamese restaurant and it was amazing. 

You can taste the freshness of the noodles, the vegetables and the meat. 

We are sold and will be back again.

I can not say NO to this place.  It is always PACKED.  If you order a sandwich just remember they are BIG ... save room for expresso and dessert.

It is not inexpensive, but worth every penny!

Found this place during a rain delay for a softball tournament.  Will definitely come back if we are back in town.  The flautas were great and the queso was amazing. The beef was spicy on the tacos. Great authentic mexican food.

Read all the yelp reviews and was excited about the cinnamon buns I had ordered. Was disappointed with what I actually got! When I opened the box at the brunch , I realized that they were actually "cinnamon rolls" not the buns I was expecting. Also, a little pricey I felt at $3.00 per roll. However, fair being fair,they were delicious and you could taste the quality of the cinnamon they use. Please note that the extra icing, which I ordered , was skimpy. So check your order before you leave the bakery. Taste and ingredient quality deserves four stars. Plus the baker has good skills. But they really should not refer to them as buns and the price was high to me  for what it was. Definitely deserves my rating for the taste which made up for the sticker shock at first sight.

I called up Champion Chevy early last week and described to them the C7 vette of my dreams. I told them about a horrible event that took place with another Chevy dealer where they failed to fill a promised order. My requests we're out of this world, the type of requests no one comes up with without a custom order. Kevin Lemus called me back 3 days after our initial conversation and produced exactly what I wanted. I was speechless. After an extremely easy financing process I was out the door with a fine piece of American made machinery. I would recommend this place to anyone, best car dealer experience of my life.

If you're having a burger craving you need to eat here.  I came here with the hubs during the off -peak hours to satisfy a craving and the place was still full of patrons. I would hate to see what the wait is like during peak hours.  

We ordered the pickled beets to start -- they were amazing! We even seriously considered nixing our village Burger order for another round of the beets, but we're so glad didn't.  The 8oz patty was perfectly cooked to medium well and was still juicy.  We couldn't taste the duck fat flavor in the fries, but they were crispy. The Irish car bomb shake was heavenly. It's what a true milkshake should taste like...though we couldn't taste the whiskey and Baileys they added.  It comes with fresh dollop of whipped cream and a brownie on top.  

We will definitely come back here, but only during their off peak hours.
Absolutely delighted we were told about Mazzaro's. Next time we'll need to bring a cooler. The atmosphere, staff, treats, drinks were so tasty.
I've never had someone who has kept me consistently happy with my haircuts until I met Janai (spelling?) at Sport Clips!

It's too cold to go out bare-chested. I get up and I put on my new blue merino wool hoodie that I have purchased from the Gap. It is new and it is perfect. It flows comfortably over my body and keeps me warmer than any blue merino wool hoodie has ever kept anyone warm before. I fawn over it in a way that can only be described as the love that hand model, Ellen Sirot, expressed for her hands to Katie Couric. Like Ellen and her hands, we are inseparable. 

Oh, we are good. The hoodie was on sale but together we are spectacular. We sit on the train to the city together and we walk to Mac's Tavern, padding and shunning the cold wind. We sit in the back of the bar and raise a hand to make a drinking gesture to the waiter that, in a different context, could land us in the back of a cop car. We make the gesture with such accuracy, and with such ridiculous beauty that the server surely knows to bring over a Jack and Coke without ever hearing a single word.

We await the arrival of our drink, in such an astounding fashion that my drinking buddies share the anguish and dire thirst. They wait too, looking around the room for the server to return. When he does, he douses the blue hoodie in Jack Daniels, stripping it of its perfect nature. The drink is too strong and garnished with a lemon. 

He does not look like a professional, like he never saw the inside of a bar prior to that moment. Patrons stop and stare at the spill. He walks away without ever saying a word. Later, he bumps into me and gets ketchup on the back of the tarnished hoodie. After continually ignoring my perfect requests for another drink and telling me to wait, he finally brings a second Jack and Coke. This one is devoid of liquor. He spills it on my hoodie, pants, and hand. Again, he walks away without ever saying a word. I sit and shake my head, gasping. No one has ever seen anything quite like it.

*Please don't sue me, David Eggers, for blatantly ripping you off.

Well we started being seated by creepy chick that stares into your soul when giving you her red robin visit quiz. Let me stop there and ask, what difference does it make if I've been to red robin before? Let me guess, there's menus with food on them, perhaps a variety of fountain drinks, and a bathroom for people to warm the porcelain after they digest the food? 

We ordered the chips and French onion dip that tasted awful! It tasted like they used a while packet do French onion soup and a teaspoon of sour cream.

I ordered a turkey burger that tasted like the soul of my chuck Taylor's i wore in 4th grade P.E. Class.

My boyfriend didn't complain about hid burger, but it had avocado and bacon on it. You can put those two ingredients on dog poo and it would be good, which I'm sure was the case of his burger.

Never going again. Wanted to barf it up when we left so I could re-eat something decent.

The bottomless steak fries is ridiculous. If you need a second helping of fries then you also probably need a cardiologist.

Opening night! I love the rich, dark decor of the interior. Gives a great French bistro feel to the place. Staff was fantastic, very attentive. 

We had the calamari, which was surprisingly different than the norm. It was sweet and spicy! Pork lollipops were, well just redic! Great glaze and the portions were HUGE bites. Fried rice was very savory, we added pork belly to the fantastic Vietnamese sausage in it. 

Then the ramen... there are no words, but I will try! Pork belly cooked to perfection, crispy edges yet tender on the inside. Charred garlic, the ever perfect Sun noodles. Broth was rich and flavorful. Only drawback was the egg as it was over cooked, but that will be remedied soon enough I am sure. 

Going back next week, cannot wait, like Christmas in June.

I bought two Voice Daily Deals for We Do That. Three hours of house-cleaning services. The first Saturday we had scheduled (which was in May), they didn't show up, and I sat around all day waiting for them. Boo-hiss! When I called Monday, they said I wasn't on the schedule.

We rescheduleld for another Saturday (in June). They called three times that morning to confirm the appointment. Why do you have to do that?

Three people came for one hour. They cleaned two floors.

When it was time for them to leave, they told me there was a $15 upcharge for them to come on Saturday, because people "volunteer" to work on Saturday. Surprise!!

Upon inspection, I found dust absolutely everywhere. They didn't even mop the kitchen floor -- just swept it. And they didn't vacuum the steps to the second floor.

With that deceit and poor performance, I chose to not use my second coupon.

So I lost on this one.

And I'll be wary of future coupons related to services. And certainly wouldn't buy two!!

Very poor service. The servers  seem uninterested to serve you. The food quality though ok, has dropped since the last time we were there. They also have stopped serving dosas with the  buffet which was another disappointment.  The halwa served with the buffet was over..and not refilled. All in all..another average Indian restaurant  now:(

Definitely a go to place while you're in Nashville! Got there around 8AM on a Monday morning so there wasn't any wait at all. I got the blueberry pancakes and my friend got the French toast. Both were excellent! I highly recommend this place to anyone in the area!

Ice cream is pretty good and the espresso is ok. I recommend the black cherry. Bathrooms are clean and service is pretty good. They offer a variety of flavors and combinations. Overall, it is pretty good and very fair pricing for being in downtown Nashville. Service was great

Of course Chick-fil-A is great. But this franchise consistently has the slowest service compared to any other franchise I've ever been to. Word to the wise, when you see a long line, move on somewhere else.
First time there today! I picked up some Avery, my favorite, and a few surprises. The staff were very interested in making sure I found what I was looking for. I'll be back!

Amazing dinner. My family went to Vetri for my dad's 60th birthday. I would have gone back the next day if I could. The restaurant is small but in no means cramped. I believe there are only 13 tables in the restaurant. The meal was everything I thought it would be and more. All four of us ordered an app, a pasta course, and an entreé. That was by no means too much food. It was just the right amount. The pasta courses can be ordered in half portions as well. The rabbit pasta dish was excellent, as was the papadelle(spelling) pasta dish. For my entreé, I ordered the baby goat with polenta. My entire family said it was the best of the entree's we ordered. The flavoring of the crispy skin was amazing! My dad ordered the venison. For him, I wish there was more to it. The portion of venison seemed small. My mom and brother spit the branzino. It was very good. My brother loved the sprouts. For dessert we ordered the cheese platter and the doughnuts. My dad loved the cheese. There were six different hunks of chess on the platter with bread and jellies. My doughnuts were amazing. I wanted to order a second plate of them. I even took a picture of them and sent it to my girlfriend. The only issue with the night was my dad said his coffee was not hot enough for him. I'd go back any night of the week!!!!

This store is tiny compared to the Borders on the west coast! I see there is a lot of hating towards Borders in New Orleans. However, I enjoyed being in a store I'm used to and browsing for more books.

The cafe area is pretty large. Also, there is a huge music and DVD selection. They could probably make that area smaller and put more books in there.

This place is absolutely beautiful! Once you're inside, its almost as if youre in this tropical paradise. There's so much to do here. There are beautiful waterfalls and some great restaurants. 

They have a river boat ride that gives you a bit about the history of the hotel and the water the river contains. You could get lost in this place. I have been here on 2 occasions and I still don't think I've seen everything. Great place to take some nice photos!

Spend the few extra dollars and stay here. You won't be sorry!!

Wouldn't eat here again. Small portions for the price. Food had zero flavor and the service was nonexistent. We never had our waters refilled nor did our waiter even check on us. I doubt the voodoo juice had any alcohol in it and the jambalaya was dry and was a small serving for $16. Disappointed that we had lunch here.
The best brunch in Bellevue, but let's be honest, there's not much competition. Regardless, it's fantastic on its own and the sister shop next door, Capitol Coffee is fantastic. (Get the Cuban)

I can't believe this has been right down the road for so long. Delicious. Went there on a Monday night for the Fish and Chips special. It was the best I have had in years, doesn't disappoint and you can taste the beer in the batter. The portion was so large there was enough to take home, certainly a bargain on the buy one get one price. Was so impressed decided to go back on Sunday for the wing special. Again, amazing, beats the local wing houses, also tried the fried pickles, good choice again. I have been back 2 more times for the fish special, this is my new go to place on Monday nights. The only downfall is the drinks, I asked for a brandy and sour, what I got was sour mix and brandy, no soda. The waitress tried to doctor it up, there was no fixing it. The next time I will specifically ask if they have 50/50, Squirt or a similar sour soda. Great place, friendly staff.
We went for lunch on a Saturday.  The food was delicious and the staff was so courteous.  I really felt like I was invited in to their home to enjoy a homecooked Ethiopian meal.

I got the prime rib, it was okay. Nothing to write home about. I've definitely had a bigger piece of prime rib at other places but it wasn't bad.

The potatoes tasted a little like instant potatoes. The ceasar salad was good.

There was just nothing that stood out or made us want to come back.

Id rather go to longhorn.
The food is absolutely great! Do not hesitate. At first we ordered only a plate to get to know how it would be but ended up ordering twice as much after tasting! The shrimp pasta is amazing!

Don't let the exterior fool you, the food here is fantastic! I was feeling very veg when I visited Tomo, so I ended up ordering clear soup along with the cucumber roll and sweet potato roll. I am partial to cucumber rolls, ordering them everywhere I go. However, the sweet potato roll was the show-stopper for me. It was tempura sweet potato in a roll. Fried potato in a roll. So. Good. 

It was a great and inexpensive lunch option on the north side. 

I am excited to revisit Tomo soon and continue to explore their menu.
We stopped by to meet friends for lunch and was blown away by the food and service. We can't wait to add this to our list of weekly visits!

Stunning atmosphere, great live music, friendly, knowledgeable service, great wine selection, and amazing charcuterie boards you help build and they absolutely crush. I loved this place; it's great for couples or for groups.

Even while picking out wine, cheese and meats, sometimes I'm overwhelmed by my lack of knowledge of wines, and what meats and cheeses go with it, but we were helped by a lovely member of the staff who put us at ease right away, listened to our insane food allergies, and helped bring us out one of the best meals I've ever had in New Orleans.

Excellent, authentic Chinese schezuan food! Even nicer is that it is nearby and that one doesn't have to drive into Philly to experience it. Nice to have actual Chinese food close to home rather than that sweet tasting food at most quasi-Chinese restaurants.....

My experience here was just okay. I purchased a Groupon for me and my hubby to enjoy an 80 minute massage and 50 Min pedicure, while my hubby enjoyed his massage (he even fell asleep on the table) mine was simply mediocre. The therapist assigned to me didn't even attempt to touch my gluteal area and the pressure was not on point even though I specified moderate to deep pressure on the entrance doc. She never even asked if the pressure was okay at any point during the experience. I also noted my shoulder blades as a problem area (in writing and verbally) and little to no attention was paid to that part of my body. Not sure if the therapist was new to the field or what. 
As for the pedicure, mine was awesome. The technician seemed experienced and was very accommodating. Overall, I would give them another try but only for the pedicure.

Servers were super slow and aloof bordering on rude. Coffee was burned. 
The physical locale of Blind tiger is a cool little brick room where you are left to your own devices, which can be relaxing, I guess. 
Its more of a skate shop than a coffee shop.

This place is a good neighborhood Thai restaurant - mostly standard dishes, not fancy but good. I like the spicy eggplant. Very nice people who own it, and a nice place to sit outside on a summer evening walking home from the beach. Or better yet get takeout and head over to Island Brewing Company for a pint or two to wash it down while the sun sets.
Delicious Greek food and excellent service... Yummy spanakopita, pastitsio, baklava.... Mmmmmm!!!! Loved it!

We decided to try something different, so we checked out Honu. We went during a quiet time in the afternoon. Emma was awesome in telling us about the restaurant and food offered.

Both of our meals were delicious. The Kona coffee was amazing! I'm sure they get busy on the weekends, but, when you are downtown, check out this unique dining experience.

Went here on a Wednesday night and our first round we got 8 shots of vodka for $32. Not bad at all, awesome actually. However, for the next round we ordered 3 mixed vodka drinks and 1 beer and the total was $38?? I saw her mix the drinks and she used the same test tubes to pour out the shot in the drinks, so why would it cost more?? I didn't think much of it at the time until my friend bought another round of 2 Jack and cokes and she saw the girl (server 35 according to our receipt) punch in drinks that were $7.50 but the total came out to $22.50. Totally charged us for an extra drink! Moral of the story, make sure you know what ur paying for!!
Grabbed a short cab ride in the rain. Cab driver was friendly, but took us the longest way possible for a ride that could have been shorter than 1 mile.

Coffee was great. I think it may have been the owner that served me today. He was very nice and had a great energy. Internet was fast and best of all the pandora selections were on point. Little small, but I was able to snag a table and post up for a couple hours and get some work done.

This restaurant is huge and when other places are packed on a weekend, you can usually get in here.  The food is typical Mexican fare, maybe a little more authentic than most chain restuarants, but not particularly notable.  Pretty good overall.
Can't beat it for the price. Tasty rolls and appetizers, quick service. Definitely the best sushi I've had at an all you can eat restaurant, and they have a good variety!

This place is without a doubt the best lunch deal around. 
The food is fresh, hand made and delicious.... And only $10 for the buffet. 
I would strongly recommend it to anyone who enjoys Indian cuisine.

Just walked in at 8:40 PM to find they were out of the bread I wanted and one other. They were cleaning and had the cutting boards removed so thank you for doing so! But just an fyi customers don't really want to see what's under them! As the guy put my bread down on the bare metal albeit on paper I saw my bread hanging over and touching the metal counter top right next to a scrapper of some kind with black goo on the end. DISGUSTING, walked right out!!!! it'll be a long time before I come back here.

I have no idea what changed at all, maybe it's because I wasn't sitting at the bar, but oh my god it was terrible! My girlfriend wanted to treat me to sushi and we got there, no seats at the bar available, kinda strapped on time, so we got a table. We ordered 6 rolls and they all arrived at different times after 30 minutes. Wow, that took a while. Then we placed another order and the rolls just disappeared with the abysmal service. Our final roll came out after over an hour has passed and we asked for the check.

I used to go here weekly for two months, this has made me question if the legend of Sushi Minato has finally ran it's course, and it's time for us to find a new spot?

This is my 100th Yelp review. 

The 100th has to be special. The Wissahickon Valley Trail and Forbidden Drive meets that criteria.

I was first introduced to this wonderful area when I had first moved to Philly and was teaching at a charter school in Nicetown. The school wisely took advantage of the trail. We would walk students there for field trips and enter at Lincoln Drive. Wissahickon Valley Trail is a wonderful place for youngsters to develop an appreciation of nature. The school would at minimum use it once in Fall and once in Spring and I would always look forward to those days.

I have recently discovered another part of the trail, accessible at Northwestern Drive. That is where the Andorra Run meets the Wissahickon Creek. I took my high school class there for a lesson with the Wissahickon Environmental Center. Could there be a better place to learn about watersheds? For any fellow teachers reading this: the WEC is great, I highly recommend working with them.

I now run on the trail from Northwestern Drive to the Valley Green Inn and back. That's 2.5 miles each way for a nice 5 mile loop. Along the way, you see the covered bridge, the only covered bridge still standing in a major American city and a few WPA built structures that are beautifully rustic. If only we could do stimulus today like we did in the 1930s!

There are a few historical markers along the way and the creek is gorgeous, especially at the dams. I love the sound of the water cascading down them. It is the perfect place to run: you are ensconced by the trees overhead and have a forest on one side, the Creek on the other. One drawback is that it tends to hold in humidity so it can stay very muddy in spots after rain. The surface is hard dirt, not concrete, much more forgiving on the knees. I really notice the difference when I finish my route and run for a second on the paved Northwestern Avenue.

Having run in Central Park and on Forbidden Drive, its not's not close. I'd rather run on Forbidden Drive any day.

Absolutely horrible. I ordered grubhub for lunch today. I ordered chicken tikka masala and garlic/cheese naan. My order arrived not even 15 minutes later, (I work about a 15 min walk away). This really worried me because they have a menu where you can order your food and they have a lunch buffet. As soon as the driver called and said he has arrived I was not too happy because I was worried and assumed that my food was just scooped from the buffet. Well, I opened my food, COLD. COLD chicken, COLD naans. PISSED. being preggo and hungry and wanting a specific craving only to have it arrive cold and totally tasteless is such a let down. For 2 dinky naans and a 12oz container of food scooped from a buffet cost me $22. A freakin rip-off.
Haters, step aside.  This place has mermen across the street. It looks like a Lancelot castle. And the main ballroom/bar is some of the best hotel decor in the entire United States.

This bar is an old classic in Blackwood.  They did a great job rehabbing the place over the last few years.  Unfortunatly, the food is not that great.  Last week, ordered a burger medium rare with fries.  Pretty simple.  Well, the burger came out more on the well side, and you could tell it was a frozen pre-manufacured burger. The burger also tasted like it was old/bad also.  The fries were the typical frozen bar fries.  Not sure why places like this dont slice their own.  Its cheaper, easier, and taste better.  Drinks are poured OK, but nothing to get excited about.

Overall, if you going to watch a game and not expecting great bar food, then why not try it.  Drinks could be poured better for the price, but the food isnt their high mark.  Great outdoor area and nice outside bar.

Visited this breakfast spot while in NOLA for the Essence Festival and like everywhere else they had long lines. the restaurant is very small for the lines of people that it draws which makes for a very TIGHT seating arrangement. 
For breakfast I ordered the big easy because it gave more of a variety for a first timer (Pancakes, sausage, bacon, hash brown or grits, 2 eggs and toast). The pancakes come with powdered sugar dusting which I didnt care for and was not easy to get them to leave off I guess because it was a habit for them to dust every plate! The food itself was very good as well as the portion sizing.
During our visit it was difficult for us to get seating together (but we were a large group), silverware and drinks because thay ran out of alot of things due to the big crowd. 
My experienece Im sure wouldve been better outside of the touristy time of year the essence festival occurs. Hopefully, they are more prepared for crowds like this in the future.

Fresh fish. Great service. We've eaten there 3 times a week for six months and always good. Highly recommend. Maki rolls are more fish than rice. Nigiri is nice ratio of fish to rice. Chirasi bowl is great.
So far so good - I was a Commerce Bank client and now bank at TD Bank by default.  Jury's still out as I discovered an erroneous charge and need to have it investigated.

Great hotel right on Bourbon St.  Craziness outside the door, sanctuary inside the door.  Remarkably quiet.  Only complaint is that the Internet is so bad -- completely unusable.  I upgraded to get the speed boost, but it is not worth it...  The connection is unstable and intermittent: page loads stall & time out.  Burning through the data on my phone instead.

I tried this place for takeout last night. I called in and they said 30 min but it took almost an hour for them to get my food ready. I was not impressed with the lamb curry it was runny and just not what I was expecting. I have eaten indian food all over the PNW and I wouldn't eat here again.The owners were nice they did try and gave me tea while I waited but I don't think I would eat here again.
The best enough said. Quality food and service. Highly recommend. By far worth the trip to Tarpon Springs
Great Cali-cat experience with Steven! Thanks for makin our Starbucks experience fun!
The standout here was the crawfish pie. The creole was good, the pasta was solid and well prepared, the drinks were good. I would go back again and again for a crawfish pie.
Great beers good pizza and live music.  Outdoor patio also allows dogs which is definitely a plus.
I got my suit tailored and it came out perfect. Pays great attention to detail. Great job...you have a returning customer

Food was good, clean atmosphere. The only reason for taking a star away was because there was only one server and a few tables, about a third of the place was full so we didn't see her much and it just seemed really impersonal.
Great Matzoh ball soup and latkas. Awesome fatty comfort food. This is place to chow down and get stuffed.
Fast and friendly. They did the SMOG check and renewed my registration in just a few minutes. I used them last year as well.

Went to dinner at 7:30 with my girlfriends intending to eat wings and potato fries and get out within an hour. Our server, rose, was extremely slow, showing barely any attention to us yet could spend minutes talking to tables filled with boys. For about 30 min she was just straight up MIA. When we FINALLY got her attention, got our checks and sent them to be rung up, we received our checks back with our credit cards at 9:30 (2 hours after we initially sat down) one was missing and another one was attached to the incorrect bill. My friend had to get up from the table to find her missing card where she eventually found it in a puddle of water on the bar next to some crumbled up napkins. They were out of potato fries and every single one of their desserts. Usually LOVE the outpost but after tonight we are probably never going back.

Looking for Unique liquor, this is the spot to go. Unlike most liquor stores their stock here has more variety in choices. See photos. Although it can be quite pricey but they do carry the cheap stuff too. A bit smaller than most common liquor stores. They do have a very wide selection of wines so if that's your thing, check this place out. Maybe even if your cooking for that special someone for a perfect night. Staff is friendly, parking is moderately small. This place is also good for a quick liquor stop before house parties. Some of these alcoholic drinks look very foreign maybe that's why the price is high. After visiting this place, i'd come here for their rare drinks. 
Recommended for the chefs looking for a unique wine to cook with or people seeking new liquor tastes.

My wife and I enjoyed our experience at Cool Springs Brewery tonight.  I had wings, which were sweet and spicy and she had nachos. Both were great and very tasty.  Our waitress was both nice and helpful. We will definitely return.

OK food.  Horrible service.

We stopped in for a late lunch on a Sunday.  We ordered the dan dan noodles, braised beef noodle soup, Sichuan beef noodle soup, doubled cooked pork, and long pepper beef.  The food was pretty decent but, the service (from the host to the wait staff) was absolutely dismal.  It took forever to get seated, and even longer to get anyone to stop by the table and take our order.  The place was about 25% full so there was no reason why the staff could not pay attention to us.  

Forget smile with a service.  I did really like the long pepper beef and if I want to try it again, I will make sure to get take-out.

Great beer choices, quite a variety, but I was a little thrown off by the good reviews.  I think it's because we went later on a Saturday night - the place was packed, and it took the bar staff forever to acknowledge us, even after we got two seats at the bar (this was quite the wait).  Beers were expensive - and they were only 10 oz.

Also, we walked there from Market St., which probably wasn't the best idea.  Granted, I really wouldn't recommend the place on a Saturday night, but if you do decide to go, take a cab, and go early to ensure a bar seat.

We had our 8 yr old daughters bday there . I realize we probably picked peel time . We felt rushed and it was very crowded . Our hostess Maggy was so sweet and tried so hard . Our daughter enjoyed her day but it could have been handled better !!

Chill spot for hipsters and an okay happy hour for drinks, prices were affordable. We didn't get appetizers for happy hour, just a brownie sundae dessert which was super rich. If you're looking for a hipster spot and that's your scene, this place works.

We will not return to this place. Ordered Fried Green Tomato Sliders and mushroom Swiss sliders!  Bread was cold and hard and most of the sandwich WAS bread!  Meat was flavorless....
Fried Mac n cheese was ok but the onion rings were greasy.  Bill was $39 for two people! Crazy for not good food.  Sorry, Burger Up, we won't be going back.

Excellent Mexican food in the southside.  Corn tortillas are homemade - soft & thick - best corn tortillas I've had at a restaurant.  I had the shrimp & fish tacos and they were delicious.  The horchata was great, too!  They had a huge bucket of horchata for the day right next to the cash registers.

Live in Nashville and walked by Americano for years without stopping in.  Do yourself a favor and don't pass it by.  Paella was fantastic - worth the wait.  $5 margaritas on par with the $12 ones on 12th South.  Our server David, was a true professional and just the right amount of friendly.  We celebrated our anniversary... will be back for a birthday!

great food, good prices, and a super friendly staff who remembers you.  this isn't just your neighborhood pizza joint.  they serve up gourmet pizzas, sandwiches, pastas, salads, etc.  i have never eaten something here that i didn't love.  best pizza in wayne!

Close to the Opry, clean bathrooms, big spaces, nice doggie park, free WiFi and more! Not sure what happened with the other folks but oh well! It is right next to Camping World! Live music and comedy on a Thursday night. What!? Also, shuttle to downtown picks up every hour for $10 round trip. Simple check in and no issues. They even called to confirm and had previously changed my reservation with ease. What more can I say?

If you are in Indian Rocks Beach I strongly recommend dining at JDs.  The food is excellent, service outstanding, and the atmosphere relaxed.  During the past week we dined twice at JDs - once for breakfast and a dinner meal.  The breakfast was well prepared and really reasonable priced.  This evening (Thursday) the entire family dined on a $5 steak (5 oz) each that was truly tasty and filling!  Thursdays is $5 steak night at  JDs.  You can't beat the dining experience and the price.

Excellent selection if you are looking to butterfly garden.  Great prices and the staff (owners?) are really understand plants and take their time to help you with any questions and offer advice.  They are really nice, friendly people and will continue to shop here instead of going to a big box nursery.

Took my Mother here for a pre-birthday dinner & used a Groupon.   Told them if was her birthday when I made the reservations & they printed special menus with a "Happy Birthday" on them. Great touch. Great menu selection.  Happy with all the food we ordered.  Everything was cooked perfectly.  Seared tuna appetizer was huge. Staff was awesome.  Kids loved it. All around win.  Real close to getting 5 stars.

Jose Garces, you did not disappoint! The servers were kind and professional and the ambiance was loud and exciting. Went in for a drink and decided on the Philadelphia Fish House Punch. It arrived after a few minutes and it was well-mixed and delicious. Stayed for one more Punch and reluctantly left, as the restaurant was about to close. I definitely plan on returning soon!

Just sayin, if you like donuts do yourself a favor and get hard chocolate and sour cream. If you are not amazed, give up eating donuts forever!

Not to mention the staff who work on sat mornings are so nice!

We spent part of our honeymoon here last week for 5 nights. It was our first time in New Orleans and we wanted to experience the real deal. This place is right in the middle of all the French Quartet action! 
Their prices fluctuate almost daily on their website, so if you see a good price one day, don't wait. I made that mistake and almost ended up paying $500 more than I actually ended up paying. I ended up emailing the hotel before purchasing our room and explaining how we really wanted to stay there and that it was our honeymoon and how frustrated I was because the room rate seemed to fluctuate so often and for no apparent reason. Someone named Chris emailed me back and was so awesome and  gave us the lower room rate! Awesome!!!!!
The hotel is very pretty on the inside. You would never guess all the debauchery was going on right outside once you step into this lobby. The staff and bell service guys were all so very nice and professional! The ONLY complaint I have was that housekeeping knocked on our door 2 nights at 10 pm for turn down service. Why would they come that late? Lol. But we would for sure stay here again! We had a great stay!!
Pho bistro is amazing! Every time I eat there I get great food and fast service!! I would highly recommend eating here!!

Sugar Rush made my wedding cake, it was perfect! They delivered my cake on time, it was sturdy and survived the heat of late June.
The cake was so moist, and delicious i have never seen so many people eat multiple pieces of  cake!! Thank you to Sugar Rush for making my big day delicious!

I have been coming to Arner's for 30+ years and unfortunately, it seems to have taken a turn for the worse.  First you have to understand this restaurant is (was?) a Delaware staple, a go to place for good service and food...having seen the remodel after fire damage and it just keeping up with the times, I have to say I was super disappointed!  

I took my son for a special Sunday morning breakfast.  After driving for 45 minutes, we arrived just before 10am.  The first thing that struck me was the empty parking lot, I totally expected to get there and wait for 30+ minutes for a table but not this day.  We got sat right away; I only saw about 7-10 other tables sat.  Server's timing was fine and we ordered right away.  

My son ordered hot chocolate which isn't something he get regularly so this was a big deal that he was allowed to have it and of course he wanted whipped cream.  Then the hot chocolate arrived, it had a clump of white stuff on top which looked like sour cream, he took a small bite (because it didn't even have enough to cover the top of the hot chocolate so a big bite wasn't possible) and I was sure he was going to make an "oh my gosh, I just ate sour cream," face but he made a "oh my gosh, I just ate weird whipped cream," face.  I tasted it to be sure and although it wasn't sour, it wasn't whipped cream but more like part way whipped cream so I mixed it into the hot chocolate but the unmixed, solid cream bits were too much to over come and he didn't touch it again.

We ordered creamed chip beef, strawberry waffle and an omelet.  The omelet was fine; cooked well and tasty.  However, the waffle was covered by the same sorry excuse for whipped cream as the hot chocolate; we scrapped it to the side and enjoyed the waffle all the same.  The whipped cream looked like an attempt at homemade whipped cream gone wrong or from way too many minutes ago as it was part thick clumps and part runny sauce.  The creamed chip beef was more like lumpy sauce with a few pieces of chipped beef (very few); the taste was ok but it obviously had been sitting around long enough to coagulate making it thick and gloopy (if that's a word?)...a little thinning with some milk would have made all the difference.  Because nothing tasted bad and it was all edible, I didn't mention it to the server.  BUT, she never asked why it wasn't eaten either which I feel would have been appropriate for her to do.

As we sat and waited for the check, my son asked what was under the booth across the isle.  After looking at the baseboard (which he was talking about) I explained to him it was just not clean and had lots of splatter on it.  So, of course, now I look around and notice lots of things which were not clean...food splatter on the booth walls/glass, small food/paper debris all over the floor, dirty light fixtures, server area was messy...basically this place needs to close and deep clean the dinning room; things needs to be scrubbed, not wiped off, scrubbed!  If this is what the dining room looks like what on earth does the kitchen look like?  On a side note, watching servers fix their hair and wipe at their eyes/noses is gross...they need to be told not to do this in the dining room.

When I paid, the cashier asked me how everything was and I looked at her, shook my head and told her it was very disappointing...here's the kicker, she said NOTHING after that!!  She didn't ask me what was wrong, what happened, why I was disappointed, NOTHING.  I responded to her question and told her I was disappointed and she said nothing in response.  This is such a shame that an institution, a local business, has let things go so far wrong that the employees don't even care but a guess if the owners don't care, why should they????

I mainly use the pharmacy and it is has been wonderful! The staff is always so knowledgeable and helpful.  My prescriptions are always filled on time and ready when I need them.  The auto-refill feature has been great to me since I have insurance and would normally forget to call in refills.  The staff is always willing to go out of their way to be accommodating.

Wondering if some of the previous Yelp reviewers actually dined here.

On a rainy night, the valet service and coat check was greatly appreciated. We were a little early for our reservation but were immediately greeted and seated. As one of the staff filled our water glasses, he greeted those in our party having a birthday. Again as our waiter, Megan, first came to our table, she also identified our birthday companions. A very classy touch from both Moto employees. 
We began with two very good martinis. Then the burrata with beets and a pistachio pesto and an order of mussels with fennel and garbanzo beans in a lemon flavored sauce. The mussels were the best we have had in years. The accompanying bread was first rate, as well. Looking across the table, the burrata was gone. 
Next we ordered three pastas- the pappardelle, the gnochetti and the pomodoro-and the pork chop. We accompanied with brussel sprouts and the al forno potatoes.  
The chop was a beautiful plate, perfectly cooked. My pappardelle went quickly, as did the pomodoro. The gnochetti with gorgonzola and truffle oil
was tasty but too rich for my wife to complete. Both the brussel sprouts and potatoes were great versions of themselves. Our wines-the Primitivo, the Nero d'Avola and a Coppola cabernet-were all excellent. We finished with a Lemon Budino and a Chocolate Mousse Cake. Both were good but the Budino was a star way to finish our meal.
We couldn't have been more pleased with both the food and service we received. A perfect birthday occasion for the four of us.

First time rock climber and I became a quick pro. Much like Tom Cruise in the opening to the 2nd Mission Impossible movie's opening. Although he didn't have to fend off children.

The location was a pain to find. It is not well marked. Look for the tallest building.

I found the staff to be incredibly friendly and knowledgeable. A good combination for a beginner. They were also good about feeding into my ego by complimenting me on my fast skills.

There are many levels in the facility to keep you interested. I will definitely check it out again.

These customer service representatives rude as hell.  First Bridget felt it was okay to yell across the restaurant and embarass a young woman who left her credit card after paying.  She was yelling her name then while holding up the card repeatedly said "really...just really, get it together."

We ordered a two piece white meat meal.  It costs more but we were sharing.  It was a wing and a breast.  Apparently they consider a wing white meat.  I went up to ask about it and she began with the "baby a wing is white meat you should know that."  Not at any deli, KFC or Popeye's I have been to.  Then for the next 10 minutes she went on to every customer and worker in the restaurant, loud enough for us to hear across the room about how she doesn't understand how people can draw attention to themselves that way.  REALLY???? You spent the entire time drawing attention to yourself and embarrassing customers.   FIRE THIS WOMAN!!!  Wouldn't recommend this location to ANYONE.  There are multiple locations in a small area, do not visit this location. 

The food was decent, the service, far from it.
Delicious ice cream! I had ice cream in a few different places in Nashville and besides Jeni's this place is the best! Try their nutter butter. It's to die for!
I've been to Good Karma twice and I've had a great experience both times. Great coffee and plenty of seating... it's the perfect spot to study or get work done because it's typically pretty quiet.

The papusas here are homemade and amazing!!  They have several different kinds, I personally love the queso and the cheese, meat and bean ones.  A lot of the time we order a bunch of them for lunch from work and they are only $1 each!  They get crazy busy at lunch but are really fast with the food, so don't be afraid even if there is a line at the counter, totally worth it!   They also have this seafood burrito that one of my co-workers just raves about so it might be worth checking out as well.

Great atmosphere and fantastic service .......

Mussels are amazing and so perfectly cooked.

The Clam Chowder is the best I've ever had

This place used to be great. Now it's a $10 cover to listen to a live band. Not to be rude, but the lead singer was/is dreadful. To go to the club side, you now need to pay an extra $5.. people don't have that money. I intend to never come again.

It has been a few years, and I was due. Man, this place has changed a LOT. But still the same in all the right ways. Now it's flooded with visitors and they have broken up services into different areas. Having a great meal in the fireplace room was just as charming though. The outside Sven looked perfect for a post ride beer and some onion rings. The venison sausage burger was great. Pulled pork decent. Expect a wait on weekends.

Surprisingly great salad, filled with a variety of crisp and roasted veggies, grilled salmon topper, and at fair prices. 

Wonderful local beers on tap, friendly service from a down to earth artsy chick, and a local vibe with paintings and murals. 

Yes. This. Place.

.we had a fantastic time with Jenn as our tour guide. She is fabulous...smart, funny & especially full of wonderful stories about your city. 

Even though it was raining throughout most of the walking tour & cold, we still managed to enjoy it because the sites were so interesting!!

We have been to Philly before & did the museum, art, liberty bell, constitution etc tour but this time with the walking tour it was more special.  We experienced the city through its various neighbourhoods...
(We eventually went back to South street to grab some dinner of cheesesteaks that Jenn recommended!!)
My all time favorite place to eat in NO!    Mainly because reasonably priced fresh oysters, great gumbo and ice cold Abita!
The Tavern have the best burgers and the service was great. Atmosphere was nice and family friendly. I will definitely be back if I visit Nashville again.

Well, where do I start? My family is staying in Indian Rocks Beach and we were looking for a good place to eat lunch. Like every good tourist I decided to scan through the information packet with all the brochures, coupons, etc given to us by the resort where we are staying and ran across this little jewel. With a name like Jimmy Guana's what could possibly go wrong? Not much you say? Well, it goes a little something like this. We started off the meal with an order of hot wings. Can't really mess up hot wings, right? Well....when they finally arrived, the waitress asked if we could have bleu cheese AND ranch dressing as our sauces. Since the sauce arrived in three separate containers it shouldn't be much of a problem to maybe make one of those containers a bleu cheese but that would turn out not to be the case. But let's save that for later. Before I ever got to decide which sauce I wanted to use I looked at my hot wing (which I tend to to do as a general rule before eating anything) and noticed a pube on my chicken! Not a whisker, not a hair from the top of your head....it was a genuine pubic hair courtesy of the chef or some other hapless drone passing by the hot wing fryer. When the waitress came back by to check on us she asked if everything was ok. I held up the plate with state's evidence exhibit A and said "well, I think there's a problem with this one." Not wanting to make a scene or get a free meal I just wanted to let her know there was a problem and that maybe we should get a do-over? She looked at me and said "what do you want to do?" I have to say this was not the response I was expecting and it left me feeling a little awkward and wondering if maybe I was the one at fault. Maybe it was the crushing burden of having to find a solution to a problem while looking at a pube sticking out the side of a hot wing that had me rattled. What options did I have at my disposal to correct this situation? Could I initiate a full blown investigation of the kitchen staff and take DNA samples? I thought they were supposed to give me ideas about what to do? My confusion left me looking limp and lame as she walked off with the suspect wing to deposit it in the evidence locker or wherever they take defiled chicken wings. It wasn't long before the manager came over and said something along the lines of "I see you had a problem with your order." Still a little embarrassed from the earlier exchange I could only weakly say "yes" while staring blankly at my placemat hoping that he wasn't mad at me. He then asked if I would like a couple of hot wings on the house. Thinking it might be a trick, I just shook my head and hoped for the best. About ten minutes later he returned with literally "a couple of hot wings." Two whole hot wings on it's own special plate! Considering that one of my original wings had a hair from someone's nether regions the transaction only netted me a single hot wing!! Back to the bleu cheese dressing. The waitress did eventually bring me the dressing but charged me .50 cents! After all of that I get charged for sauce that we originally asked for? Unless you are into crime scene analysis and want some random DNA to examine I would be like a bird and fly far, far away from this place.

After getting rebooted in the Summer of 2006, this performance is now entering into it's ninth season, and it has never been stronger. 

The Edmonton Oilers, with shows regularly at Rexall Place, includes a recurring cast of Daryl Katz (as Apathy), Kevin Lowe (as Arrogance), Craig MacTavish (as Incompetence), and new cast member Dallas Eakins (as Naiveté). 

This satirical take on a professional sports team follows a hockey club that went from one game of a Stanley Cup with a bunch of a overachieving, hard-working players, through a string of failed free agent signings, threats of barnyard fights between managers, a full front-office reunion of an Old Boys Club, the owner threatening to move the team if a new palace is not built, multiple #1 Draft picks who are full of promise and ultimately disappointment, and continual plot twists where you think the team has hit rock bottom - only to be surprised there is a new low (or should we say "Lowe"). 

The Edmonton Oilers is a performance full of lessons true to life: the same people that created a mess cannot solve it; pride always comes before a fall; and the attitude of a leader will affect a whole organization. It's a performance art piece that brings out a committed crowd on a nightly basis and a performance you won't soon forget, even if you wish you could.

Only reviewing the pizza. You get a coupon with every large pie you buy and get a free pie after collecting 15. I've tried the  plain, margarita and Sicilian, all have been perfect. Only complaint is some wait staff is not very attentive. For example if someone is at the door struggling to open it (door is heavy) as they carry out 2 large pizzas and  a waitress a few feet away, it would be greatly appreciated if someone could kindly hold the door as you exit.
We went for the Jazz Brunch on Sunday morning and were more than happy with the food, the service and the cool jazz.

This is my favorite place to have seafood the calamari there is mind blowing and the staff is great! I would recommend anyone to go there . The view is exceptional and pairing it with a hoppy poppy is a good way to go

Came in an placed a carry-out it has been 30 mins since it was put in one person has asked if I'm doing ok, looking around had I known the 3 tables I'm looking at that have been empty an dirty were still going to be here I probably would have stood up an left, it's a holiday an low on staff an poor on service this place has been going down hill for some time, take the time an drive extra few miles to another steak joint, it's time for the gm to go or clean house..... Pitiful

Ok. 5 for 5. For convenience, originality, awesomeness. Fresh tastes, local all fresh food made to order. Convenient touch screen ordering and payment! Super fast service. Love the concept of this fast food establishment. Fast food redefined, I will make this a frequent stop when I am in the area!

Wonderful new addition to Philly/Old City. Isreal behind the bar is a real bartender in a city of imposters, completely​ knowledgeable​ about cocktails/liquor​. ​Chef Ken is running a tight ship. the sushi is consistently​ fresh/clean everything you want in a sushi place. Happy hour is prime. Don't​ have anything negative​ to say about this beautiful new spot. I love everything down to the glassware​ and bar tools.

I appreciate the restaurant's mission but the food just wasn't all that good. 

I found Tace via Google and decided to check it out even though it apparently hadn't been open very long. It was a Wednesday night so we decided not to call ahead to make reservations and it turned out to be a good call. The restaurant was nearly empty when we arrived so we were seated right away.

The service was prompt, friendly and professional. I don't recall our waiter's name was he was really nice. He and the hostess took the time to tell us about the restaurant's history and the mission behind it all. Turns out Tace is a non-profit organization. All of the profits go towards a youth organization that is affiliated with Tace's owners. 

I ordered the New Orleans collection which consisted of Jambalaya, Crawfish Étouffée, Fried Catfish, Red Beans Blackened Red Fish & Gumbo. I love cajun food. Being from a food capital, Chicago, I've had the privilege of being able to enjoy authentic cajun food like one would find down south. I have to say that the food I had at Tace tasted unlike any cajun food I've ever had in my life.

The jambalaya and gumbo looked and taste exactly the same. I actually thought i'd received two of the same item and had the waiter check with the chef to make sure I'd received all the right dishes. I was informed that it was indeed gumbo and jambalaya. Turns out it didn't really matter because I didn't really care for dishes anyway. 

The catfish was good as were the red beans with rice. I can't really say I was especially impressed with the red fish though. I'm not a fan of crawfish etouffee so I didn't eat it. A friend of mine did and she said she thought it was okay.

The ambiance was nice so that added to the experience. The restaurant is nicely decorated with artwork from local artists. All of the pieces can be purchased as well. There were also salsa lessons being taught by a staff member while we dined. Dancing isn't my thing but it was fun to watch the others try their hand at it. 

I hate to say it but even with all the good stuff going on at Tace the food doesn't warrant my making a return trip or even recommending it.

Great little bar and grill close to convention center. Limited seating. Limited A/C but you easily get acclimated to the natural outdoor feeling. Coach got adventurous and had the GATOR sausage. JoMo had the chicken philly and I had a homemade hamburger that looked like a true hand made seasoned patty. Slaw comes with each sandwich. HOT and SPICY with a vinegar kick. Would totally recommend this place. 
PROS: Great food. Great servers. Watch the cook make his magical dishes. Yum factor 8. 
CONS: Limited seating. Can be steamy because more of an open air establishment.

This place used to be good. What happened?
I was so disappointing with the assortment of food and the quality was totally not there! Anything that was made from a mayonnaise base had an off stench and taste. The salad beans were not fresh either. Quite frankly, I was afraid to eat a lot of the dishes. My sister's fried chicken was over cooked and very very dry. Don't come here midweek even though the price is right. You'll end up eating like a bird. The best part of my meal was my tea with honey and the freshly wok stir fried veggies (made every 30 mins or so).

I've been here on Fridays and Saturdays before and it's always bustling. That's when the food is fresh.

Just moved here and this was a great find! Great prices on meat, fruits and veggies. They also have a hot bar, which is amazing and very reasonable.   Always pretty busy at the hot bar, but well worth the wait.

My future husband and I stayed at The Harney House Inn at the beginning of June. We absolutely loved the experience. 

We went away for the weekend for our dating anniversary of six years, and during that time we got engaged! Hooray!

Anyway, we stayed in the Garden Room. It was amazing! The bed was super comfy. The spa tub was great. We watched a movie or two from their selection and snacked on some of the soda and treats that were provided in the common area.

The area is great in general with lots to do, and it's just a short walk away from Massachusetts Avenue, a great street with a bunch of little shops and restaurants.

The only thing that was even remotely out of perfection was the size of the shower. It was a pretty cramped, but if anything, it will be a funny memory of fumbling around like a doofus. Not a complaint, just an observation. :) Also, the towels made up for it! They were super plushy and soft. 

Breakfast was great, too! Sausage, eggs, some kind of apple coffe cake thing (I could have eaten the entire loaf), fruit, yogurt, a Keurig with a large variety of coffees and teas, cereal, toast, etc.

All-in-all we had a wonderful time and will definitely be back! Thank

I took my kids and the line was pretty long. The cinnamon roll was a bit hard. And the toppings were not that great. I feel like the price for what you get is not that great of a value. I prefer Cinnabon at the local Mavricks.

Took my brand new Mustang to Clear View today.  Roman did a great job removing the stock tint and applying new darker tint.  This is the 4th vehicle I've taken to Clear View and I keep coming back cuz of the great service and quality tint.
The best authentic Mexican food in town. I always come here for tortillas that come on a variety of sizes.

Went on a trip NOLA in May with family and friends. We tried out Luke since it was right across the street from the hotel. We ended up eating here 5 more times during the trip! Each time it was great.
The service was amazing and the food even better. I tried a bunch of stuff I've never had before, loved all of it. One night my father in-law got a steak, it was perfectly cooked to the temp he ordered. If we ever go back to the area, we will definitely stop in again!

If I was in Los Angeles and I got the equivalent to a 500 degree burger, truffle fries, and a soda (all made by local distributors) it would have cost me at least 20 bucks. This place is great, open late, and pure quality. The patties are succulent and they have a pretty wide variety of specialty burgers; kim chee burgers, bacon infused patty burger, and many more. Definitely going to make this one of my go to spots in Philly

I had a wonderful experience at Jones! My boyfriend and I went there for dinner not long ago and we were both extremely pleased! I ordered the sesame crusted Ahi Tuna steak and was very delighted! The fish was extremely fresh and flavored just right! My boyfriend ordered the chicken pot pie and was also extremely satisfied. At first I criticized his choice of pot pie, but once it came out I quickly changed my mind! It was the largest pot pie I have ever seen! The portion was gigantic and it was full of all yummy fresh ingredients. You can also tell the crust was homemade! Although I thoroughly enjoyed  my tuna, I would probably get the pot pie for myself on our next trip there!

The prices were a little bit steep but you're paying for excellent quality food, great service, and an awesome atmosphere to take in! I would recommend Jones for anyone looking for a great home cooked meal!

All was wonderful with the exception of the Turtle soup.  Wasn't the typical Brennan family batch! Three of us ordered it as a normal staple and we must have really caught them in an off night.  Sherry couldn't help.  Otherwise great atmosphere, food and service!

The menu is so much fun! I had the fried pickles and the Texas Cheesesteak and it ROCKED. 

The restaurant was pretty dark that my friend and I had to whip out our iphone flashlights to read the menu.

was at the Blue Duck tonight was very hungry ordered the chicken wings for a app . and the tagliatelle well this waitress brought me my chicken wings as my entree, my husband ordered the scallops as a special which came out first we shared it then she brought generals tso's chicken wings with my husbands burger . my tagliatelle never came out when she came to are table she said well its finish time it was 10 minutes to 10 which is closeing time i had a reservation for 915 pm what a disappointment left hungry but didn't complain just felt cheated never gone back

I needed new wiper blades for my 2014 Chevy Cruze and he no desire to go to the dealer and pay outrageous prices. They were a great price and the employee (Orlando) came out and installed them for me.

A fuji apple chicken salad is made with more than lettuce, tomato and dressing. Maybe if the girl behind the counter would stop making eyes at the guy behind the counter with her I would not have had to ask for them to fix it. 

3 stars is only for the fact that they made the salad again for me the right way.

First visit to this hotel for a meeting. Parking lot was torn up and the smoker's ashtrays are too close to the front door. I don't like having freshly showered and being forced to walk through someone else's smoke. Bathrooms had not been cleaned in at least 24 hours. Our meeting room was nice and the breakfast service was adequate. 

They could improve the experience by paying attention to some of the small, but important details.

This place is waaay past its prime. Inadequate heating and hot water systems made for an uncomfortable, unpleasant stay. Heating is a hot air system that fills the space with extremely dry heat from the ceiling down. Cold night means parched head and cold feet. The Arctic wind blew in through the ill-fitting door frame which we had to insulate with cushions. Barely enough tepid (not hot)water for one shower so   sure you go first! And replace the not-functioning clock.Marriott, it's time for a top-to-bottom renovation. Staff is pleasant but no substitute for physical comfort.
And the free wifi is pathetic!

Zucchini Pasta.
That's what caught my eye on their menu and when my planned vegan destination did not work out, I headed for this place.
I sat at the bar and was immediately chatted up by Steven, the bartender who clearly has his own regulars and yet effortlessly blended them together with the new guy. He recommended a great wine pairing and the dish was so well made and each mouthful was as tasty as the first.

He was fun to talk to and gave life and charm to the dark lightening of the restaurant which I first mistook for a gay bar.

By far the best breakfast/brunch place we have found in this area. Thank you Yelp for this score!! Found it when I was a baby Yelper and we have been regulars ever since!!

We drive 25 minutes to come and always enjoy it. The staff are always sweet and friendly. A few of the long time servers are ultra nice but a little on the slower side (probably because they take the extra time with their customers).

We come on Sundays for their special brunch menu which is always great. Our favorites include the Wildflower Crepes, Sunday Omelet filled with field greens, Swiss and Ham & the kids love the waffles. They also always have fresh baked goodies in the front case! They have homemade cookies, scones, cupcakes and a specialty cake. Today's selection there was Key Lime Cake, chocolate chip cookies, Dark chocolate cookies, gluten free Peanut butter cookies, gf macaroons, Red Velvet cupcakes and mint chocolate cupcakes. They don't make a huge amount so they are always fresh but if it's late in the day thy might not have all Selections available. 

Not much more I can say but if you are in the area this is a good place to try!!

WOW! I thought I was going to write my 100th review! Woohoo... I have been putting it off long enough and I have been putting off writing a review for here as well. Well lo and behold I wrote a review two summers ago when I went with my family. Boy have things changed in two years. I had no idea the amazingness of the Schlafly Brewery. Maybe I am basing this review more off of the all the amazing beers they offer, and I enjoy, But whatever. The City Hop wasn't a bad event either, yes it was at the Tap Room (I need to eat there, then I'll review). 

Molly and our friend from Chicago, down on business, ventured in last Monday night. We got a table in the smaller dining room. Molly had a bunless veggie burger and Hannah had the BBQ pulled pork with slaw. They both seemed to enjoy them. The pork was delicious. I had the brat burger with kraut and swiss on a pretzel bun! It was unbelievable! The brat flavor is something you really can't mess up too much, and this was not at all, especially on that awesome bun! We all had the asparagus as a side, which was delicious. I had a pumpkin beer, which is something I would probably actually die for. That good. Get one if you haven't had one. Preferably on tap. Hannah had a sampler and seemed to enjoy them all for the most, my heart got real warm in my chest when she listed the Pale Ale as one of her two favorites of the six. Some thing about that Pale Ale is just comforting. The wedding I went to this weekend had it as one of their bottle choices. I am determined to have a keg of it at mine. Probably not a full keg, but a smaller one I will only fill certain people in on. I look forward to many a trips back here and am almost embarrassed about my original review... Here's to another 20 years in St. Louis with Schlafly!
Never answer the phone, the website is impossible, the food is decent but you can't order it so that's irrelevant!!!! So annoyed.

I checked out this place on a Monday night for dinner. It was pretty empty which I was glad about because they have a very small parking lot. 
The restaurant was cute and much bigger then it looked. The walls was painted this terra-cotta orange color with different murals on it. Overall it was very clean. 
The waiter was very nice and attentive. He gave us salsa and chips as soon as we sat down and got out drink orders. The food was very good and flavorful. I ordered the Camarones al Chipotle which was grilled shrimp served in a spicy sauce with rice and beans. It had the right amount of heat and was full of flavor. One person at my table got the Combo plate with a chicken taco, burrito, rice and beans. And the other got Special dinner -served on two plates!  It comes with chili poblano, beef taco, enchiladas, rice and beans. It definitely was way too much food for one person to eat but he had no complaints about it. He said everything was delicious and he  had plenty to take home.

I've heard of this salon through some friends and instagram. Sarah does a wonderful job at coloring and cutting. I came in with 50 shades of brassiness and came out with 50 shades of blondes, grays, and silvers. I showed her a picture of my desired look and she said she would try to get me as light as possible. With that being said I didn't get my hopes up but by the end of the entire process, she exceeded my expectations completely. Not only was she able to take out the brassiness within my hair, she was able to lift my hair to this beautiful smoky-blonde shade. It was exactly what I wanted. I highly recommend this salon! It's a given that Sarah does lovely work but she is also kind-hearted, warm, passionate, and hilarious. She talks you through the entire process which is comforting for those who are nervous about coloring their hair. All in all, I'm pleased with my hair and will be returning. Two thumbs up :)

Fantastic beer selection, unique Russian inspired cuisine, and dance parties with some of the best DJs in town, what more could you want from a bar? Well HandleBar takes it one step further by treating its customers right and having an owner that frequents her own establishment. I have always had great drink service here. Creative specials and some of the lower prices in town make going out here on the weekend easy on your pocketbook. The crowd is usually pretty laid back and eclectic, always friendly from my experience. Once you get heated up on the dance floor you can always cool off in their massive backyard patio area. The cycling themed decor of the bar is unique and reflects one of the owners favorite pastimes.

A hidden gem of an Italian restaurant. Best pasta and bread I have ever had. True Authentic Italian atmosphere with anItalian pianist in a cozy and warm setting. The service was excellent and the food superb.

Great staff, great food and great atmosphere. The staff was friendly, accommodating, and professional. My wife an I enjoyed the decor and the food. The waitress stopped by multiple times to check on us and our young son. She even played with him for a bit. The staff seems to be close knit and fun loving. We'll be coming back.

- TIP:  After you eat your meal -- they've got great prices on desserts ($1 baklava) and to-go containers of hummus.

- CON:  Closes @ 7pm most days.

- BOTTOM LINE:  Even if the food was mediocre, it'd be worth grabbing considering you get a big plate of mediterranean food for $8.  But the food is far better from mediocre -- and I would be ordering it instead of my other go-to take-out mediterranean spots (e.g. Hummus Grill, Al Zaytouna) if it was open later.

Gem! Tender Tri tip. Inspired sides and sauces.  Great Catfish sandwich was just fantastic. Our server Renee was sweet and helpful. Very happy to come back again and order the same. Great place to catch the game with 8 plus flat screens.

Parking - plentiful, and unpaid.

Decor - Clean, upscale, and very comfortable. Booths and tables.

Overall food type- barbecue dishes with unique/fusion sides.

Affordability- Our 1/2 pound tri tip & chicken combo with 2 sides was 14.99 and my other ordered a catfish sandwich at around 12.  

Atmosphere - lots of big flat screens, but the sounds is not on so it does not disturb you to have a nice meal.

Oh my God. I can't believe I didn't review this place already. Don't tell William, the owner. He'd KILL me.

This is the place you go for good coffee that's cheaper than most other places. This is the place you go because it's located, very conveniently, in the heart of Broad Ripple. Bonus--it has free Wi-Fi. 

Really though, this is the place you keep coming back to because of its warm, inviting community. Everyone becomes a regular here.

The baristas all have their own personalities: Dan "The Man" Fahrner is part of popular local band, Everthus the Deadbeats. Tatjana Byrd is a formidable local poet. Carly Cooke is super-friendly at first, but longer conversation reveals her hilarious humor. This is like the Saturday Night Live of local coffee places. Who needs Indy Fringe? 

Oh yeah, the drinks are pretty good too. The white chocolate mochas are the best I've ever tasted anywhere: not too cloying, not terribly sweet. Smooth. The oatmeal shagbark cookies are absolutely addictive. And the smoothies and juices are made on-the-fly from your selection of fresh fruit (thank GOD they got their juicer fixed--for a while, it sounded like they were blending bricks! Inside joke.)  

See you there! Seriously. I never leave.

G. Thrapp jewelers is the utmost in personalized service!  Dana is incredible at her job - friendly, attentive and knowledgeable.  They specialize in the unique, antique and customized.  I searched for the perfect engagement / wedding ring for 6 months before coming to G. Thrapp and Dana worked with us to create the ring of my dreams. If you want jewelry you can cherish and pass down to your family for generations then come here.
Can u say microwave and sushi from last week they found on the floor for reg price aka double the price then say half off lol

Great variety at this $10 lunch buffet. Everything was very flavorful without being over the top spicy. The usual Indian buffet fare (chicken tikka masala, tandoori chicken, basmati rice, samosas) was present as well as a few dishes I've not tried before.

Freshly made naan delivered to the table to compliment the buffet items. A refill on bread was provided at no extra cost.

Buffet runs from 11:30am to 3PM.

Our server was great.

Will definitely go back.

We used to love Brixx Pizza especially the Korean meatballs and the pear martinis but we tried it tonight and it was I'm sorry to say horrible the martini did not have the pear in it and it tasted like a water down margarita and we noticed that our waitress had to make her own drinks instead of the bartender who was sitting there chatting it up with the customers the pizza was okay but the crust was sorta cardboardish the Korean meatballs were sort of bland they used to be very tasty in the sauce used to be very sweet and sticky very disappointing will probably try back again in this summer hopefully it'll be a lot better

Great food and drinks.  Was on the top of my "go to" list until they removed the Trout from the menu.  Still, you're sure to find something delicious. The Creme Brulee was perfect on our last visit...as was the special - Striped Bass.  Only disappoint I've ever had here was finding the Trout missing from the menu!

This was a "one and done" for us. The sushi is not fresh, doesn't taste good at all. The place looks dark. The quality of the food is like a Chinese buffet like they've been sitting there for hours. We left with a nasty taste in our mouth. The service is okay.

We had a great time last week there.  Brought some out of town guest who also loved it.  

We went on a Sunday night,  which our server told us was one of their busier nights of the week when we asked .  Place was busy, but had a fun good vibe going.  

Food-awesome.  The chicken had great crispy crunch and texture to the skin, but perfectly moist and juicy inside. Kudos on that. Only room for improvement on food is the sides.  The man-n-cheese was just Ok.  It was however the only side that size wise was separable.  The mash potatoes where really good.  Pretty positive the beans where just "dressed up" Bush's baked beans from a can, which is not cool for the price and portion size of the sides. 

The bar program itself was good and the Bourbon and cocktail selection was really spot on and thought out.  the "bartender" on the other hand needs to maybe find another job.  Took 20 minutes to get our drinks, we watched her look at our drink ticket and set it down on the bar and start chatting away with a male server and a couple of guests at the bar.  You could tell our server was really frustrated with the slow bar service and she doing to her best to make the most of our time.  But it's bad when you order apps and get them and almost done eating them before you get you cocktails.  By the way we only ordered Kentucky Mules,  which was on the suggestion of our server and they were delish, just took forever to get the first one so we didn't order a second round.  Thats bad for business. Also maybe management should talk to said bartender about maybe not looking like she just rolled out of bed before her shift. 

Beside the snail pace bar service, we had great service from Julie.  She was pretty knowledgeable about the Bourbons and we enjoyed all of her suggestions.  Her and the hostess where very sweet to our son, which trust us we know restaurants don't generally like kids too much. They we're playing really fun old music that everyone knows and loves.  It was fun seeing people singing to what was playing, created a fun atmosphere. 

Overall we love this place! Just needs a few little adjustments

The employees in this Starbucks are some of the best and sweetest baristas I've encountered in a while. Their products are consistent, and if not they are always there for easy fixes. This store is always clean and the wait is never too long!!!

Very nice authentic Italian restaurant in Newtown, not Italian American like many others throughout the area. This family-run establishment serves fresh cuisine that has never disappointed. It is BYOB; however, they do serve complimentary home made wine. The establishment feels like a home more than a restaurant, I always end up with the zuppa de pesce or linguini pescatore, you must check this place out. Make sure to make a reservation on weekends, the place gets packed.

Friendly service.  

A taste reminiscent of the Disney Dole Whip.  Pineapple flavored soft serve.   They have a bunch of toppings to try but plain is just as tasty. 

Tucked in the new Market in Kennett we hope this place gains a following and hangs tough.

What a great find!

I stopped in for lunch. Nice selection on the menu. 

I ordered the Turkey BLT sandwich. Generous portions of turkey piled high on a bun. It came with a side of fresh cut fries. 

Quick and friendly service.

The takoyaki balls were one of my food adventures for the summer.  I first tried them in June and I loved them.  Went back in July with my wife and I continued to love them.  Went back a few days ago and probably had the best takoyaki in 3 visits.  I liked them all.  The octupus, spicey shrimp and the sweet and sour were my favorites.  The crab c ake and the barbecue were also done well.  I think the chef- owner works hard to please his customers.  His wife is very friendly, easy going and aims to please.
We also tried the yakosobi noodles, which were good.  The Japanese potato salad was very good.
I think it is an interesting place, small and quaint.  The food is very different from any other restaurant.  
Be adventuresome and take a trip to the streets of Japan.

Shilpa is amazing! Hours can be hard b/c she splits her time b/w the two locations. But I arrange my life around her schedule. Lol. She is quick, painless, & the atmosphere is a spa, so ur in a private room. Love it here, die hard devotee for many years, before they moved to their current locale.
Great spot for a shave and a cut. No wait, great service. The guy who shaved me had been in the business for over 30 years. Needless to say I wasn't nicked.
This place is so good. The pork bowl,  both Thai bowls, Tuscan veggie bowl, is so flavorful.  Prices are a little high but the food makes up for it.

Very nice for an airport hotel! Room was large and spacious, very comfortable bed, and the television was quality. The bar and outdoor area are beautiful and modern. Shuttles to and from the airport were timely, and the staff was exceptionally courteous. Perfect for a quick or extended stay! Highly recommend for travel for business as well! 

My only complaint is that I called down to the front desk many times about an issue with the toilet and there was no response. It was late at night, so I'd give them the benefit of the doubt.

In town for business and found this little restaurant on Yelp.  It did not disappoint!  The owner is delightful and helped us with our selections.   Everything from the egg rolls, jerky, cucumber salad to our three different main entrees was made to order, tasty and had the appropriate heat.
