This place should really step it up by giving Chick-Fil-A a larger kiosk because that is the only reason anyone comes in here. And maybe Master Wok.

The shopping choices are abysmal. Yelp should have function that tells ppl what kind of shopper you are so others can properly asses your reviews. I've seen reviewers say there's great shopping. It is not. I don't shop @ Victoria's Secret, Nine West, or Godiva Chocolate. I'll get an occasional piece from J Crew but that's rare. The draw here for me is the Food Court & that's it. I like how spacious the seating is. But the food choices are bad.

Had a great experience here- nice atmosphere and location.  Walked out completely happy with my hair cut/highlights. It was a great balance between the things that I normally like and her personal recommendations. I walked out super happy!

What sort of sacrilegious place stays open until midnight or later on Easter? Well, apparently that's the cool thing to do, and I am so glad it did. That was my first time to Village Pub, but it hasn't been (and certainly won't be) the last. Some bars are expertly designed and equipped to accommodate laughter, music, fun, etc. Village Pub goes for a different motif: home. There is perhaps no other place I feel relaxed to sit around drinking outside the confines of my own property.

Aside from the relaxation, the mules are another great reason to come here. The gin-based version is fun to order ("The English Ass") and equally fun to drink. I can't immediately think of a more refreshing alcoholic beverage. The beer selection is also superb.

One final note: I played two games of chess with my friend when I was in here. The pre-drinks game went well for me. The post-drinks game did not. But I loved it all the same.
Loved this restaurant. Probably the best grilled cheese sandwich I've ever had. Also enjoyed some delicious oysters. Very friendly service which made the experience even more enjoyable.

I had lunch there. Portions are VERY small. Their kabob is so mediocre. Their rice is not good. This place is definitely not representative of delicious middle eastern cuisine especially  for Kabobs. Sorry Sansom Kabobs you gotta increase your portions and quality.

Pleasant surprise! Our new favorite Gulch spot! The Short Rib Gnocchi was amazing and my girlfriend had the Short Rib Grilled Cheese (from the lunch menu) which was equally amazing in its own right. For dessert, we tried the Ricotta Cheesecake which was perfectly sweet and savory. I highly recommend these items and imagine everything else on the menu is fabulous as well! Cheers!!
I went there for the first time today and the burrito was great. It was fresh and tasty! I also loved the great variety of vegetarian options. Definitely will go there again!

Well what an awesome restaurant across from London Drugs in T&T Market plaza.  I ordered the #27 Bun Bo Hue.  

Kim works the front and her business partner Thu is the chef.  Kim is very friendly and recommended it to me.  The broth is everything in a good bowl of Vietnamese soup and it didn't disappoint.  It was delicious.  

The ingredients were fresh and I could watch Thu make the soup.  I couldn't believe all the steps in a bowl of soup, but she was busy.

I had a Vietnamese iced coffee and it was great.  My bill was $15.17.

They will definitely be welcomed in the neighbourhood.

The restaurant, is new, clean, bright and nice.

I would highly recommend this restaurant.

Been here twice - both times because someone gave me a gift certificate.  First time not impressed by any means.  I thought I would get a great "wow" cut.  Second time I was butchered.  Not only did my hair cut make no absolute sense - it was horribly uneven.  I can't believe for a salon on the main line charging $60-75 for a master cut that this is what you get. Shameful!   Edward Scissor Hands would have done better.  Back to Super Cuts for me - have never gotten a bad haircut there.

This place was fun, we sat on the stage,  the service was good. They were crowded and it was the lunch hour.
Had the fried chicken,  and all the fixings. Excellent.
Then we took the time to have dessert...it was a battered dipped brownie,  Ice cream, chocolate syrup with bacon...very good and rich...
Atmosphere was fun, artifacts and groceries mixed together.
A good place to visit. ..

This is my second time to eat at Brio. It has been in two different cities and as a whole, the chain has sub par food with poor service. Avoid the eggs benedictano and pollo al forno flatbread. There as too many good Italian place in STL and this place should be avoided.

I can't say enough about this place. The food is great, the restaurant is clean and trendy and the employees are fun and engaging. Today I went in to order some tacos and while I was waiting, one of the guys behind the counter offered me a free smoothie (they had made some in the back and had extra.) It was so thoughtful of him. Quite honestly, I would not  normally think to order a smoothie there as I just go for the tacos, but now that I had a chance to taste how good they are, I will definitely order one in the future. Excellent customer service!

Wonderful experience. ...15 of us went, we had Linda as our waitress and she was wonderful with that many people. No matter what we needed she was right there.  The food was fantastic, service outstanding!

I'm not sure why this place is not rated higher. The service and food are very good, my wife and I bring our child here and she has a great time. The fries are particularly yummy - hand cut and seasoned well. Late night breakfast on Wednesday is a lot of fun.

I'm surprised that this theatre only has three stars. Whenever I'm wanting to see a movie this is definitely the theatre I always come to. 
The theatre rooms inside are large and spacious. The seating is very comfortable and has a nice recline. 
Don't worry about being able to hear movies from the other rooms because the walls are thick and sound proof. 
Every time I've been here the staff has been courteous and I've never had a bad experience with the employees, most are eager to help and answer questions. 

There is also a bar inside the theatre which is also a win, However I have never personally been to the bar. I prefer the Coke freestyle machine during my movie experience. This theatre is also filled to the brim with all types of movie concession food and snacks so you don't get hungry, but the prices are typical for a movie theatre. 

They also have an IMAX theatre which is great, as I've been to see two IMAX productions and enjoyed them thoroughly. 

I will continue to go to this theatre every time!

A friend of mine and I had dinner few nights ago and was really impressed.. we ordered quite a bit & everything we tried was fantastic .. must try if you're looking for me Benihana style restaurant in Santa Barbara

Location, parking, menu, prices, wait staff were all good. The only thing that wasn't that good was my food... it was just ok. Denver Omelette was a little over cooked & the fried potatoes & toast were under cooked. Potatoes could have used some seasoning. I thought they'd be kind of oily but it was the complete opposite.. pretty dry & not crispy at all. Also ordered a small plate with just an over easy egg, sausage and biscuit and that was fine tho. Didn't have the pancakes but they looked good. Might try it once more to see if it was an off day.
Whites are better then the reds here. We did a few tastings and we found the international tasting was the best of the bunch.  Great prices and music as well.

this place is an OK place to live. there are a few good and a few bad things. lets start with good... nice pool, good parking, playground, affordable. now..for the bad...1. rude loud neighbors, people smoking weed outside like its no big deal, they are always turning the water off and sometimes its out for the entire day and night...

Five stars all the way, best drinks, huge beer selection and the have all great servers and bartenders. Always will be a return customer. Jezebel is by far the most attentive server I have ever had, she is always consistent and great at her job, always a pleasure to come and have a great evening on a regular.

Delicious. I can't say enough about the food prepared at this place. As with most restaurants in the FQ, make reservations. And even if you arrive on time, there may still be a little bit of a wait. 

The prix fixe offers such a variety for all 3 courses. For the appetizer, the turtle soup was one of our group's favorite. The savory Gorgonzola cheesecake cannot be described. TIP: spread this on the bread they leave at the table and top with the honey pecans and green apple. This appetizer really should come with crackers or something. 

For the entrees, wow, everything was 5 star, from the pork chop to the bayoubaisse, to the shrimp and grits. If you save room for dessert, the creme brulee is so creamy and not gritty like some places. But the bread pudding...there is no equal. 

Beautiful restaurant with an interesting history. highly recommend dining here at least one while  you are in New Orleans.

Gotta love Saint Philips! The Farmers Market on Sundays are the best in town. It's a great place to come with the pups and walk around during this and other fun Tucson events the plaza holds. I think I've been to three or four that were a blast. If I remember correctly a couple art events, a Jazz festival, and mini farmers markets.

The plaza is also home to great lunch and dinner spots like Scordato's Pizzeria and Bodega Kitchen and Wine... Not to mention the night life fun at Union for Whiskey Wednesday! I haven't been there myself but I also hear Gadabouts is a great place to get your hair done. 

Lunch, shopping, dinner and a late night scene in the foothills! Plus, a clean and unkept place with a peaceful ambiance... Not too much to complain about! You almost forget you're in the Arizona desert.

I couldn't have asked for a better experience. Food was wonderful. And the service was even better! Our server Wanda was hands down the best! If we owned a restaurant, we would steal her! The views were spectacular! Highly recommend Spinners

If you are a Chicago deep dish fan like me; order the Pi-cago pizza. It's not on the menu, but it's fully loaded to the brim with cheese just like Chicago deep dish except it's better. The crust is lighter, the tomato sauce/topping is fresher, and it makes for an overall much better pizza.

I no longer have to drive to Chicago for my Gino's or Lou's fix as I can get a better pizza right here!

If they don't know Pi-cago when you order, just tell them it's the deep dish cheese with as much cheese as the pizza can hold.

I only found Old Glory thanks to a local's recommendation of "you have to check it out".  Now I've heard that statement before and was disappointed in some other visits. That wasn't the case with Old Glory!  Like everyone has said it's a bit tricky to find but it added to the appeal of the lounge. Right after walking in you descend down the amazing gold staircase that mimics the gold triangle on the door. Ascetically it feels like an industrial speakeasy.  Then as the night goes on the entire lounge is illuminated by candlelight. Now the staff and cocktails are both amazing!  Our waitress was fantastic and was able to provide her own recommendations for us!  I was surprised to see the large selection of gin and gin based cocktails. It was very refreshing!  I had an amazing time here and I can't wait to come back!

Lilly's is by far my favorite Vietnamese place in New Orleans. Not only is the family so sweet... The food lives up to all the great reviews. The pho broth is delicious and so flavorful, the sauce on the bun is awesome, and the shrimp and avocado salad is amazing! The spring rolls are also key. I haven't had a bite at Lilly's I didn't like. 

Also the coconut candies they give with your check are delicious!! I would give 10 stars if I could!

While visiting New Orleans, a few locals brought me here.
Such a wonderful place! I ordered a mint lemonade, which was so delicious! And the Gyro which comes with hummus, pita bread and a salad. I was quite surprised to see the way it was presented, my past experiences have been of the gyro wraps, everything was seperate here, more of a build your own type plate. By far the best Gyro I've had. 

Attached is the market, with imported items, nothing caught my eye to buy, but it was a nice experience.
I love this place. This is my #1 spot for sushi. Food  is fresh and the services is excelente.

Service is extremely slow.  The server maybe came to our table 3 times and was not at all apologetic. The food is awful.  My 14 year old daughter could make a better, more appealing plate.  I felt like the food was overpriced for what we got.  My son got a half of a peanut butter and jelly sandwich thrown on a plate with no garnish.  3 bucks.  My daughter had the frittata and it made her sick.  I had the spring roll salad and it was bland and the carrots look like they were cut a few days prior to me getting them.  My other son had the tomato soup which was more like tomato sauce and he found woody pieces in it.  If I was paying McDonald's prices I would think the food had value.  I just expected more from the look of the building and space which is beautiful and clean.  We came with friends and the server said we couldn't have separate checks. At the end of the 1.5 hours we were there, we had to go to the cashier and hash out who had what. The menu is confusing and complicated.  If they could simplify the menu, they may be able to pull it off with the small kitchen they have.  The service would be faster too.  I really wanted to like this place.

Really enjoyed our meal here.  We had one beef dish and two veggie:  the key wat was really good and the two pea dishes were one hit and one sort of miss.  I'd like a little more variety on the veggie menu, but it's probably wise for a new place to keep the menu simple until the business justifies the complexity.

I didn't feel the meal was over-priced at all; but then I'm usually suspicious of places where the food is too cheap.  You know, like the places with dollar menus.

I will definitely come back here and recommend it with no hesitation!

Disappointing.  With delicious other Mexican options close by, this place was overpriced and underwhelming.  The tacos have interesting combinations (like fried chicken) which could either be kitschy or creative but you can't mix and match which makes one apprehensive to commit to three cauliflower tacos.  Fajitas were not sizzling (which is one of the main reasons for ordering fajitas.)  Some of the drinks came out as a shot and a mixer for you to put together rather than the bartender making it for you.  Will not return.

This is not the place to go if you're looking for healthy menu options - but what it has is great!  We placed our first delivery order yesterday and were very impressed.  Online ordering was easy and the delivery itself was quick, with a friendly delivery person.  We ordered specialty mac and cheese (pulled pork and all in) as well as a buffalo chicken grilled cheese and a grilled peanut butter and fluff and everything was really good.  We'll definitely be ordering again soon!
Forgetful pub. The food is defrosted and microwaved...enough said

As soon as we walked in, the young lady asked us for our order. She gave no explanation on the menu items or what the popular choices were. When we took longer than one minute to order she prompted the next individual behind us to give us their order because we were clearly indecisive. She was rude and unhelpful in explaining what our options were. This is not a place to go if Wendy is at the counter or any other person who clearly doesn't understand what your company has to offer.

I like to use uber eats but the draw back is you can't speak with the person that made your sandwich. This is unacceptable. Worst club ever. Your are a sandwich shop. It's what you do!! Make a great sandwich especially for take out! Never again.

The food is good, and the service is good, but everything is overpriced as you'd expect from a restaurant at a fancy hotel/golf course. The decor in the restaurant is nice, and it is a very clean restaurant.

They're rude and need to learn how to be respectful. If you go through the drive-thru, they carry on their conversations while you're trying to order. You can hear them laughing and talking to their coworkers from the speaker. I had to repeat myself several times because she was talking to someone else and she couldn't hear me. In the end, she got my order wrong. Plus, she said that there would be a 4 minute wait on the biscuits, and I didn't get my food about 20 minutes. The food is great but terrible service...

Came here just to grab a slice of pizza to go and I was so presently surprised (growing up in New York has made me a pizza snob). My boyfriend got pepperoni and I had a cheese slice-both very excellent and satisfying! The bartender who took our order was also very nice!

This place is a hidden gem in Mt Juliet! Wow! I am a die hard Woodlands Nashville fan when it comes to Indian food, but Persis has stolen my heart with their Gobi Manchuria and Bhindi Masala. 

Small and unassuming in a strip shopping center off the main drag by Providence, but don't let this fool you. The space is adorable and clean in white and gray decor, and the delicious smell hits you when you open the door. 

Our server was so sweet and friendly, and agreed with our decision of Gobi Manchuria for an appetizer. I will now get this every time I come. The spice is perfection. I always err on the side of caution and get mild spice, and it was perfect without being overpowering. 

The Bhindi Masala was a generous portion of tender chunks of okra cooked with tomatoes and onions, and the rice was cooked to perfection. My dining friend ordered the Vegetable Biryani, and I think I probably ate a lot of her food, too! Once again, a huge portion of food and the flavor was on point. 

I actually left my credit card here the first time I came in, and ended up ordering take out when I went to pick it up. If you do take out, call ahead. It can take 20-30 minutes. I have nothing bad to say--I'll be driving to Mt Juliet for my Indian cravings from now on. Yummy!

I love primanti brothers sandwiches but this particular location is dysfunctional. 

Check out my picture that I took of the menu. Yes that's mold and yes that's gross. 

Not to mention that the waitresses were fighting w each other because one of them accused the other of stealing her table. 

The sandwich was good. 

If the menus have mold on them I can't imagine what the kitchen looks like. 
Yikes!

Moving isn't fun. Especially moving that starts at 7:00 Saturday morning. Especially when there was a party the night before. You get the idea. 

Anyway, despite my exhaustion (and anxiety from reading these other reviews!) my Uhaul experience couldn't have been better. I arrived promptly at 7 and trucks were already driving away. During my short wait in line, I listened as the manager worked out a solution for a customer who was having problems with his reservation. Moments later, I was out the door! The same manager assisted me, and he was friendly, helpful, and willing to take the time to answer my questions even though the place was busy. 

Returning the truck and paying was equally painless, though I had forgotten to factor in mileage and insurance (optional) when figuring out how much it would cost. Don't make the same mistake! $20 for a 10 foot truck isn't Really $20 for a 10 foot truck!

We had a surprisingly nice dinner at Fresco, including some of the best customer service I've ever experienced. The woman that took our order took care of us, served us, and was so genuine and sweet that I tipped her double. There are things about the food at Fresco that are still in tact from when it was Picurro's, which made me happy. I loved that there was NO TV to distract the kids with so we could have a nice family meal. We will definitely go again.

I tried the Opry Backstage Grill about two weeks after they opened.  To say they are having some birthing pains would be an understatement.  I should say that I live less than 2 miles from the place and I think it's intended for the folks who will eat their once on a family trip and will get a kick out of singing servers and will pick something up at the giftshop on the way out--obviously, I was sad to see Apple Bees (though not the best) replaced with mediocre food--food that even good sangin' can't make enjoyable.  

The server was very attentive..took my order and swore everything on the menu was wonderful.  I love fresh smoked ribs and love Memphis style dry rub ribs the most--so that's what I ordered.  When they arrived at the table, they were mush--they didn't just slide off the bone, they were fatty mush on the bone.  I also found it rather odd that their dry rub ribs were in fact, wet--served with lots of BBQ sauce.  I took one bite and couldnt deal with the fat.  I asked the server if I had gotten the right item and he knew immediatly that I was referring to the fact that they weren't DRY rub ribs.  He said that their dry rub ribs are served wet.. (I will pause so everyone can let that sink in--huh?)

Obvioulsy, I wasn't terribly impressed this answer.  He said that was a common complaint--again...not terribly impressed.  I wasn't really in the mood to eat dinner after this so I sent the ribs back and ordered Dolly Parton's Banana Pudding.  Dolly Parton would not be impressed either.  The menu listed the item as a delicious banana pudding with a warm baked meringue.  It was vanilla pudding in a wine glass with chopped up bananas, crunchy nilla wafers and the stuff on top--not even the manager could tell me what it was.  It wasn't really whipped topping and it wasn't meringue--it was some sort of frosting.  I asked her if it was meringue and if it was baked--"no--it doesn't appear to be" to both questions.  It's not that it tasted terrible (it was as good as something you would get served at a conference rubber chicken meal)--it was that it wasn't anything close to what was advertised.

The manager was very apologetic and admitted that they had some quality issues and offered to take the ribs of my ticket--very generous of her considering I only ate two bites before sending them back. She also admited that the banana pudding was not correct and was not anything close to what is mentioned on the menu--but she still charged me.  

This to me, is the nail in the coffin.  Bad food AND bad customer experience and then to have to pay for the joy of hearing a server sing a B- version of a Garth Brooks song--no thanks.  I won't be back "y'all."

What a lovely evening.   Our wait staff, Jenny and Gary, were on point the whole evening.  Our water glasses were always full and the food was well paced.  We started with the crawfish and goat cheese crepes - OMG!  I swear there was a party in my mouth.  I can't recommend this appetizer highly enough.  I had the beet salad as my second course  while my spouse had the turtle soup.  Both were very very good.  For our main course I had the duck with wild rice and my spouse had the fillet.  They were both outstanding!  For desert I had the homemade sorbet sampler and my spouse had the pecan pie.  The pie was good and the sorbet was very good.  Overall a wonderful experience - highly recommend!

My wife & I wanted Japanese but were looking for something different than our usual Japanese go-to spots. We had previously been to Benihana, Izakaya, and Kazaan. This restaurant was the worst of the four. Our waitress was often MIA - I had to ask another waitress for a refill. My steak was overcooked and the shrimp wasn't seasoned with anything but butter. Her Yakisoba was prepared in the back kitchen as opposed to on the grill and was also under seasoned. The whole presentation by the chef was rushed and impersonal. My wife did enjoy the atmosphere better than some of the other Japanese steakhouses but the food was considerably lower in quality. Tomo's pricing is positioned lowered then the other steakhouses so our expectations were probably a bit high but we ended up spending around the same amount. If you are considering this place, pay an extra 10% and head a few miles up the road to Benihana.

I don't know why this place gets such bad reviews?  The wait staff are super friendly, very quick, and the food is always good.  Why would you expect a top notch steak for $12?  I always order a salad or a burger here, and I've never been let down.

OH my Precious Beautiful Restoration Hardware HOW YOU HAVE CHANGED!!!!!
The sales staff or as they say they are called " designers" are HORRIBLE!!!!
I have ordered 11 times in the last year furniture and décor for my clients and have walked out of the store and ordered on line- 
I was in the store over the last week 3 times working on completion of my clients home and never once was greeted nor ask if I needed help!  I even ask a sales person for help and they said they would be back- never to return.   I pulled several small  items off a table to purchase and was made to feel as I committed a SIN as they were on sale and they were to "Pull" the items from the back-which they did not have- The sales person made me feel like I was the most STUPID person on the planet!  No place should make anyone feel that way- 
I cannot believe they can not be kinder and more helpful and loose the attitude- 
I am a Interior designer and have huge developments I would never treat anyone like this-  
I love RH pieces to place with my other findings and designs-  I will continue to order on line
( which I have an excellent Sales designer I work with)  or when I am in Atlanta shop there-  what a shame to loose the business in my own back yard!

iiiiiiiiiiiii love this bar. I've only been here a few times, twice to pregame while waiting for a table at Cafe Lift, and once to postgame brunch at Cafe Lift and ended up staying for several hours. 

Haven't had the pleasure of trying the food yet but it's definitely on my list. The bartender dude is super friendly and helpful. One of those people that knows when to leave you the fuck alone but is also more than willing to engage in witty banter. 

The beers on tap are all unique and range from low to high %, and the staff knows how to recommend a winner based on your personal taste. 

I just really like the vibe here, it's hard to put into words exactly what I mean. The kind of place that it's easy to lose track of time in. Gotta come here yourself and I'm sure you'll see what I mean!

I came in from the city to visit family and we got take-out from this joint a couple nights ago.  Let me just say, this is the best Thai I have had in all of Philadelphia and the surrounding areas.  And I've tried a lot.  And I've been to Thailand twice.  Just great food.
Had the:
Mussels - I can eat them every single day.  They were so perfectly balanced.
Pad Thai (both chicken and shrimp) - reviews are correct.  Spot on great.
Yellow Curry Shrimp - my lady doesn't like the spice so we went with this milder version and I don't regret it for a second.  Next time I'm doing the red curry.
Cucumber salad - crisp and fresh with a hint of sweetness.
Tom Yum soup - also really good.
I'm coming back next time I'm in town to try different items and if they're as good as this first experience, my 4 stars will become 5 real quick.
PS, even my family members who are on the fence about Thai food were completely converted.  Great, great Thai spot.

NEVER GO HERE FOR A WAX. I went for a lip wax and the lady who was servicing me was incredibly rude from the start. No greeting, she simply gestured to me when it was my turn. When she applied the wax, she gave no warning as to how hot the wax would be and got maybe 50% of the hair, if that. The lady also managed to get wax in my hair, which was tied back in a ponytail. When I went to the counter to pay, she raised her voice saying that they don't accept card for anything less than $10. I had asked the last couple of times I went for a wax if using credit would be a problem and was never told so. Never going back. Poor service and poor job.

The food here is phenomenal and I highly recommend the Portobello Soup! It's absolutely worth the calories.... the only downside is that this place is small, so you may feel cramped. However the brothers who work there make you feel like family and the food makes it feel like home!

I've been to La Dolce twice now and was impressed each time. I had my nails done yesterday, which I don't do often, and they still look great. The nail technician was friendly and did a very clean job. 

My friend goes here for makeup and they always do a clean, natural application. I also know several brides who have used their services for their wedding day and they've all been very satisfied. 

I only wish it wasn't so far from Meridian/Kessler as I'd attend this salon more often!

I have never had one single bad experience with Uber.  I use the service all the time and today I must say was exceptionally great!  Tarek was my driver, who is from Clearwater, he was so interesting to talk to, professional, and courteous.  This company is far better than any cab service in the area!

I have eaten here and done takeout dozens of time.  Great portions and great food.  We have split entrees when dining in and still had leftovers to take home.  Worth the drive for takeout from Hockessin even though there are several places closer to us.

Amazing customer service, beautiful arrangement, and very reasonable price point!!!
Living in San Francisco, you can get anything delivered anywhere in the city at any hour. So, when my best friend was hospitalized in Santa Barbara for a heart condition, I knew it would be difficult to messenger him a porn mag and a box of Mike n Ike's with love. 
I also didn't want to go the traditional route. A bouquet of fragrant blooms just wouldn't be the right fit for the occasion. This is a man's man we're talking about here (excuse the gender normative terminology). He knows the dust and the smells of our mountains. There is nothing about him that says "delicate lily." Still, I needed something classy. A succulent, perhaps.
I called around and LO, a recommendation from another florist for Dalla Vita. 
I called, got the website and ordered right away. With infant twins in my care and a feeble thumb on my phone screen, I couldn't pull it off. A little defeated by my circumstances, I called back. Jessica (I think Cali's mother) was so accommodating and sweet. I ordered the single succulent which was delivered within a few hours. I got an email confirmation with a photo of my order and a phone call as well.
A real class act, you guys! I will definitely be using your services again and recommending to all my Santa Barbara friends and family. A big, warm Thank You!

I went here with my spouse and a friend. It's another one of those mid-town hipster places that's kinda overrated. Expect to pay around $12-14 for each dish, which would be okay if the amount of food portion wasn't shockingly small. It's kinda up there with Sup as far as value goes :\
I wasn't all that impressed by the flavor, I normally like spicy things but I couldn't taste anything else so maybe it was a bit much. My friend felt like the ramen broth tasted like potatoes? Maybe it was vegan or something. The ambiance was kinda cute but it's ruined by the extremely loud music, expect to have to shout at the top of your lungs to be barely heard.

The service was good and the food came out fast though, so I mean if the negatives are the kind of things you don't mind you'll really like it.

This theater has a huge variety of screens with 24 options. The theater is clean and the concession stand is amply stocked with a variety of food. This theater has more than just popcorn, pretzels and candy. You can actually get chicken nuggets, french fries, mozzarella sticks, ice cream and more at the concession stand. This is the place to go if you need something a little more for you or your little ones. There is ample parking here as well. I frequent this theater, which is across the street from the Cherry Hill Mall :).

So glad we stumbled on this place! Great vibe, excellent music and the food was ridiculous! Lamb sliders...yes! Fish tacos...yes. gumbo, and the bulgogi rice bowl.  Washed down with a fancy drink. You can't go wrong!
I'm not sure about the food, but this place has the BEST Lemon Supreme pie on the planet.  I don't know who their pie cook is, but he/she deserves a medal.  And a raise.
Decided to treat my mom here for a birthday present! We were extremely impressed with our shellac mani and pedi - not to mention the customer service and attention to detail was superior.

Awesome burgers. Calamari steak sandwich is on point as is the friendly service and comfortable atmosphere.  A lifelong resident of SB and this was my first visit here.  Will definitely come back again!

Loved this place, the margaritas were phenomenal and the salmon dish was an incredibly interesting twist. Our party of three really enjoyed all the food, had a few different tacos and a couple other items on the menu. Overall, very creative twist on Mexican cuisine. 

Was skeptical after seeing the reviews, but half of them were for the service not being up to par or because some people wanted more food for the price. 

My opinion is that if people want a huge plate of beans, rice, and whatever other crap traditional Mexican includes - go to your cookie cutter chevys or on the border to pay $15 for a plate to feed an entire Nicaraguan family with tasteless food - this is more expensive and lighter portions because the dishes are very well thought out, with plenty of "out of the norm" ingredients, which seemed to our party to be extremely fresh (including the margaritas). Also, did not find the portions to be small as I was stuffed when I left, those complaining might want to go on a diet as well.

Service seemed fine, I think all those negative reviews were from when the place first opened. Suckers come on here to trash this place and then rave about applebees. Those morons should have gone to Golden Corral instead and given them a 5 star review for eating the "fresh" wet dog food they are served at the joint.

My wife and I have been a few times recently and really like the place... The food has been great and the place is very nice inside... They have a great happy hour; but I typically still order off the full menu!

We got the menu at mail and tried the opening sale. We ordered a lunch special ( 3 rolls), teriyaki beef, and a fried gyoza. The teriyaki beef came with a lunch-truck shitty box and it was lacking flavor and sloppy. The beef was kinda rubbery too. The sauce seemed like it was squeezed at last instead of mixed well with the dish. The sushi was bad... Especially compared with what I usually get from other places. We found this (see pic) in the sushi and have zero idea what that is!! The delivery guy was friendly and on time, I guess that's the only thing we were cool with.

I'm always on the hunt for chocolate; especially hot chocolate!  We came specifically, so I could try their hot chocolate.  :)

It's a cute spot.  Someone on yelp mentioned there was plenty of parking, but that is actually not the case.  :)  The parking lot is small, and it's in a residential area.  Luckily we found a spot on the street.

HOT CHOCOLATE:
Big disappoint.  :(  Well, I guess I'm used to not finding good hot chocolate, so maybe not that big of a disappointment.  Honestly, it's very rare to find places that make really good hot chocolate.  Most places, like this particular visit, make versions that taste just like hot milk.  Sometimes, the drink just needs to be stirred, but I tried that and it still tasted like hot milk.

DOUBLE CHOCOLATE DONUT:
I loved this though!  :)  If I was nearby, I would stop by to grab some of these.  

My BF ordered a cappuccino and he said it was really good.  I'm not a coffee drinker, so I didn't try any coffee drinks.  The stars were definitely just for the hot chocolate.

Place was excellent. A little cramp'd but great. The employees were nice, polite and friendly which is rare these days. Food was excellent so was the green lemonade. I had the hipcity ranch "chicken" sandwich. Couldn't even tell it wasn't chicken. I will definitely be back. Worth the trip and the kinda high price.

Impressive beer selection. Check. Great patio space. Check. Chalk outlines on patio of crime scene bodies. Check. Whaaat? This is why Handle Bar is unexpectedly a great idea for the Grove area. A litle nonsense in a bustling area of town. And did I mention cra cra beer selection??? And of course, ride your bike.

The MOXI museum is a bright and open place in three stories for kids to explore and play right in downtown Santa Barbara. There are hands on exhibits highlighting science, art and technology with similar exhibits as other museums in Northern CA, such as the Exploratorium in SF and tech museum in San Jose but in a smaller, less in depth scale. There's a nice rooftop play area (which is really sunny) with water play and musical instrument displays, as well as, view of the Santa Ynez mountains on one side and Pacific Ocean on the other side.  There is a short, 15-20 minute movie in the theater on the second floor which runs about every 30 min (schedule is posted there). We arrived at the opening time and the kids, 5 and 8 years old, played for about 2 hours. We may have been able to stretch it out for another hour but not the whole day. 

I did find myself wishing there were plaques with blurbs explaining the science behind some of the less self explanatory exhibits. There are several guides walking around offering help but they are not always there. For example, the Mind Ball exhibit. Two guides walking around gave variable responses about what was actually being measured (one talked about alpha waves and another just said a blank mind is better). Another example, the drum on the roof. It appears that you complete the circuit with your hands with the drum beat corresponding to your heart rate. 

I would recommend a hat for the roof as it is very sunny there, as well as, snacks (no cafe or snack bar). Check out the movie schedule on the second floor at or near the beginning of your visit if think you want to watch. We tried to go towards the end of our visit and didn't know where it was located, then got there when the auditorium was full. We left without watching the movie because we didn't want to wait. We did go to Rusty's for pizza afterwards which is also kid friendly.
LOVED tonight's burger - bacon jam?!? What?!? Great staff and good food. The Woodstock burger with aioli fries is a staple.

It's rare when both my wife and I can say we ate the best of something at a restaurant. For her it was the Shrimp and Grits and for me it was the Creme Brûlée. The grits were simply heaven. The crawfish crepes and the boulabase were also great choices. I got an Old Fashioned made with my bourbon of choice to accompany my meal, but I can see how wine could be paired with the food as well.

The three course meal is a reasonable price for such high quality. 

The service at Muriel's is top notch. All the servers were quite personable and up for conversation. The ambiance is hard to beat. We thought it would be pretentious but that was far from the truth. 

After the meal ask if you can go up to to second floor to see the seance room, it is quite a treat!

Best Italian food ever! The family owned place has wonderful service and the family is working there with their staff. The food is amazing, and the speed is faster then fast!! This place is defiantly worth 5 stars!
Best meal in NO, so far. Shrimp crepes with goat cheese were outstanding and the bread pudding is rich and sweet.

Ok so I RARLEY eat healthy stuff, but Wendy's Pecan Chicken Salad is my favorite thing ever! I always ask for extra dressing because let's be real I can't eat a salad without it! ( downside-you probably will have to as the cashier a few times for the extra dressing). Other than that the people at the drive thru are usually super friendly and patient as I order even when I have to wait a minute to get my fiancées order.
   Oh and their soft serve is on point! Chocolate milkshakes to die for.
Delicious and healthy breakfast, friendly staff, clean and welcoming. Highly recommend !!!
This place is great! They recently added poutine to the menu and it was insane!! One of the best I've ever had (and I've had many, including in Canada)! Other food is very good too.

Ehh I'll round up from 3.5 stars. This place was alright. Didn't knock my socks off, but it was serviceable. The garlic naan was kind of a let down in comparison to the pictures I saw online. Didn't seem to match that but was moderately tasty. I had the lamb Marsala which was, again, ok. The meat chunks where a bit more fatty then I'd like. It's pretty fancy and the service was good. Can't complain about the price either. So overall, it's good for a meal but I wouldn't take a date there or anyone I want to impress.

This new bar is clean, open and wonderful. There are always fresh flowers and the service is impeccable. All of the bartenders work together, so everyone is really willing to help you - they aren't just considered about "their tables."

There are board/card games for your leisure, and the weekly Bluegrass is fantastic! Plus, once a week they play music from up and coming local bands. 

Try the Moscow Mule (vodka, ginger beer, and lime) it's this summer's most refreshing drink!

Great food and very lovely staff! I'd recommend any of the egg scrambles/omelets and the sweet potato hash bowl. Very god Australian coffee drinks as well. I MUCH prefer it to Honey's down the street. There can be long lines on Saturday and Sunday mornings, but if you get there early it's not usually a problem. In the warmer weather, there is a nice outdoor dining area at the back.

In a sea of crowded shot girl pushing, loud music blaring, college style bars, sits a cozy pub named Wellington. 

Keeping true to form, the Wellington is full of dark woods,book cases, a roaring fire place, darts, and pints of ale being poured as the preferred beverage of choice.  Seating is limited to around 40 people, so it is cozy.  Don't let this scare you away, it's definitely worth a visit.

Since the Wellington is connected to The Corner Wine Bar, they offer more wine options than most bars in Broad Ripple.  This is tempered with the a solid selection of beers on tap and bottle, as well as a full bar.

No other bar like it in Broad Ripple.

We went to Chick-fil-A last night for Valentine's Day. They did a reservation dinner. It was $20 for two people and that included an entree, 2 sides, a drink and dessert. Plus you had a server. Each table had a goody bag with some chocolate and a mini moo in it. They also had a photo booth and a group of gentlemen singing. It was a super cute date night with our 8 month old son. I hope they do more events like this!

One of the best burgers in town if your out of state you must try in-n-out ! It does get buys but it's well worth the wait. They also have some good shakes! Fries are on point not to salty and they are freshly made. I'm a local I know what I'm talking about you must try this!

I just about made my mind up on 2 stars after waiting a good hour for our food only to be disappointed by mediocre Mexican food. Also I ordered a meal with 3 items and only received 2 of them (taco & chile relleno). I've had way better chile rellenos and tacos. However, I thought the margaritas were slightly above average. 2 star food, however, the manager saved the day by comping 2 drinks because of the long wait. Showed he cared...

I wish I could give this four stars. I loved the food, the pizzas were charred and crusty, the cheese gooey and delicious, and even the tap list was half decent. The rotolo was to die for, almost too decadent. And the fried pizza dough for dessert? Da bomb. Great location, great vibe, even great option to donate to a good foundation at the end of the meal.

But the service was, in a word, indifferent. A few others: inattentive, idle, isolated.  Couldn't get the servers' attention to order more food or drinks.Might be two stars if that rotolo wasn't so darn good.

I was frustrated, but some spots have their off nights. I'll be back for a re-review in time.

I must admit.
I've been sceptical.
If indeed they don't keep regular hours...phone ahead.
Just induged in a Super Donair after reading all the positive reviews.
I've eaten here a few times in the last few years.
I think because on my first visit I watched the chef pull the meat from a tray...and not off the spigot...I was turned off. Shaving it "fresh" just seems right.
So I've always approached since with trepidation.
Tonight however...
Damn.
It really hit the spot!
Juicy and delicious.
Friendly service.
It's not fancy...at all!
But I think I finally appreciate why they are famous!

A beautiful architectural building! Admission into the museum is ridiculously cheap, and they give discounts for students. Like I said before the building and surrounding grounds is beautiful! The layout of the exhibits are done with great care and effort! The museum is huge so you aren't crowded and can aimlessly wander with out being disturbed and in silence.
The actual content of the museum is impressive and has some beautiful pieces of art work! When I lived in Indiana I tried to visit at least once a year.

I felt compelled to write a review as I witnessed the most disgusting thing. There was a worker there smoking outside. She saw me and my kids come in ready to order a sandwich. She proceeded to go in the back (as I was closely watching her to see if she was going to wash her hands.) She didn't then proceeded to ask us what we wanted while putting gloves on never washing her hands. I quickly walked out with my kids and made a promise to myself never to set foot again in this store. If only the owner knew how disgusting her hygiene was. They've lost a customer for good. So gross

I LOVE this place and the people there are very friendly. The food is very original and ingredients are high quality. Check it out next time you're in the mood for something fresh and out of the ordinary!
We love this place!  Great food, terrific ambience, and a place that makes you feel like family from the moment you arrive!

I love these guys, they are some of the friendliest donair guys around. (Probably because they only open until 12AM and don't see too many people stumble out of bars.)

It is not something to be proud of to call yourself a donair connoisseur, so I won't do that. I would say there donairs are on the side of very good and above average. If you like your donair a certain way, they can do it.

If you want burgers, they can do that too.

I don't usually make a mess when I get a donair but the way they throw french fries on  a piece of paper and tray makes you think that they expect you to.

The restaurant was once a Blimpie's and has changed hands several times through the years and it is pretty interesting to see artifacts from the past poking through - I don't think this place is called Chef Donair anymore.

It could use a good wipe down but otherwise, when I get a craving for a donair, Best Donair is near the top of the list.

Great place for a steak in Avon!

I have eaten at Texas Roadhouse at least 15 times over a 6-year span.  I will start by saying that this is a great place to get a steak!

Steak has a marinade/seasoning that makes it taste great!  I'd recommend the Cowboy cut Sirloin for the big appetites-- a 16 oz. cut of pure steak, no bones or fat-- I ended up enjoying this more than the Ribeye or Porterhouse steak there!

Other notable food items at Texas Roadhouse-- Beanless Chili is excellent, as is anything here with barbecue sauce on it. (ribs, chicken)  All of the appetizers are good also.  The one exception is the burger, I ordered this once and received a burnt up burger that was not good at all!  Very odd considering the quality of the other food here.

Something they do not advertise much is the beer there-- the COLDEST beer I have had in the Indy Metro Area!  I once ordered a Bud Select (aluminium bottle) and I swore it had frost on it!-- yes, FROST!  This is one seriously cold beer served up here LOL!!!  Beer drinkers, this is your big tip!

The prices are very resonable too for a steakhouse-- the above mentioned 16oz steak, drink, salad and baked potato cost about $20 before tax and tip-- not gonna happen if you visit one of the downtown Indy steakhouses, that's for sure!   

Having said all of this, this place is not for everyone, as it is awfully loud and can be quite busy and raucous during dinner-- not the spot for an intimate dinner for 2 for sure!  There are a couple of vegetarian options here, but mostly the menu is directed squarely at the carnivorous appetites for sure.

I highly recommend visiting here if you are in the mood for a good steak at a good price.

Literally worst service ever. Goodish food, very skimpy wine pours, cute spot except for the extremely creepy bathroom. Overall 2 stars because I repeat: worst.service.ever. We had to go inside to ask our server for wine after 12 minutes of sitting with empty wine and water glasses, mid meal. On a Sunday. Not super busy. Never going there again.

Great food, reasonably priced and at a great location. I have recently been working in this area and have had lunch and dinner at this location.  Fast and friendly service, I have recommended Pegg 's to several people.  Try it for yourself.

One afternoon I was having a craving for a hamburger.  Now, my frequent dining companion does not really care for hamburgers, but the fry menu was enticing enough to intrigue both of us.

I ordered a plain cheeseburger that came out dressed.  FAIL.  However, after removing the extra "stuff" the flavor of the burger was exactly what I was looking for... you know... grilled BEEF.  The rosemary fries are always a refreshing twist on the old favorite, and I you can't go wrong with a hand dipped Oreo milk shake.  I love that they bring out the metal cup with that tiny bit extra that won't fit in the glass.

So, yes, Smashburger is a chain, and yes they screwed up my order, but in the end it hit the spot.  I don't do the burger and fries thing often, but at least I know where I can go next time it comes up.

Had the Miami Cuban which the meat is freshly sliced on the spot. Free drink with it to. 
Do not pass on this place!  

Been back several times and the Cuban is great!!
Stopped in for dinner while working overtime in west Philly. Grabbed 2 slices BBQ pizza. Good food, not bad price.

Having just moved down to Center City from West Philly, this Gym is great compared with the Penn gym I had access to for the last four years.  Do I think a television and fan in every piece of aerobic equipment is unnecessary? Yes, but am I complaining about it? NO! It is awesome! Though I have heard that is standard now.  

The facilities are great, very clean and well maintained, and it looks like it will stay that way.  The staff is incredibly friendly and willing to take care of any issue a member might have.

Came into town for just one night, having tickets to see the snarkypuppys live recording of family dinner 2.  Loved this hotel. It was close to everything... and by everything I mean cafe du monde =) Even being the last week of mardi gras, the staff was very nice and valet for our car was prompt. It was teeming with people, but we expected that during mardi gras... also due to the fact Hotel Monteleone is famous for their carousal bar (yes, it moves) It's very elegant and we loved our stay. Only disclaimer would be that at first glance--- room service (served 24 hrs) seems really affordable.... $13 for a burger etc. But be sure to tack on 21% delivery and like 19% for something else-- all together totaling $21 without gratuity. Esh. But I guess that's what you pay for staying in a classy hotel in the middle of the french quarter. I can't complain.

I've purchased my last two vehicles from Toyota of Santa Barbara, and both experiences were positive overall. Most recently, I bought a new 2016 Tacoma Access Cab 4x4. I met with Sam Ladd of their sales staff, and he proved himself very knowledgable about the Toyota line-up. He's a veteran and knows his stuff.

Initially I wasn't sure if I wanted to go the pickup route, or stay with a mid-sized SUV. Sam was patient about helping me understand the options, and definitely was not hard-sell.

When I finally settled on the Tacoma Off-Road model, Sam and his manager came through with the configuration and color I wanted, tracking it down at another dealership in the region.

It's hard to get any kind of deal on the Tacoma, but Toyota of SB was competitive on the price, which isn't always the case with local dealers who have to compete with the big boys in L.A.

If you're in the market for a Toyota, I'd definitely give these guys -- especially Sam Ladd -- a shot at earning your business. I was glad I was able to keep my business local.

The Ice Cream Gods reached down and blessed the dirty coast with one of the finest ice cream stops either side of the Mason-Dixon line.

Boston has it's crown jewels, like Harrell's in Harvard Square and my all-time number one pick in the universe:  Christina's Ice Cream in Cambridge, serving the world's best chocolate concoction aptly entitled Nietzsche's Chocolate Ascension.  We also can't forget Bertillon ice cream in Paris, no sir.

But in light of all of the above, Creole Creamery proudly sits at the most elite table, and holds it's own with savoir faire and undeniable expertise. 

You want some examples?  How about:  Mexican Hot Chocolate with fresh Cayenne, Cayenne Lime Butter, Steen's Molasses Oatmeal Cookie, Coffee Pecan Brittle, Lavender Honey, Cake Batter, Cookie Monster, Creole Cream Cheese, Mascarpone, Honey Almond Egg Nog, A Chock-Work Orange....need I continue?

They also have a super-mega dessert called the Tchoupitoulas (pronounced Chop-Eh-Too-Less).  It's 8 scoops of ice cream and 8 toppings - if you finish one, you get your picture on the wall of shame.  

NOLA throws down with a five star, triple A, top shelf, ice cream perfection paradise.

The locals know it, and if you visit - make this top on your list.

My brother and I went here for a bit of a nightcap and we ended up having a much better night than we ever intended. We were greeted warmly by every waiter we came in contact with. The bartenders were attentive and made sure we always had a drink in front of us which was amazing given the amount of people there that night. The small plates we tried were amazing and we couldn't get enough of them. The thing that really set this bar apart was the owner. She was more than happy to talk to us about the bar, the drinks and the city which was great because we're Aussies on holiday in the US and we love to hear about that kind of stuff. As for the previous review I saw about the owner 'smelling of cigarettes and being on the sauce' I cannot even believe we're talking about the same woman. I loved this place!

I'm not even sure I can begin to describe how good a meal at Village Whiskey is!

First off, let me mention that my fiancee and I got here on a Saturday around 7:00, and while we expected there might be a wait, we had no idea it would be and hour and a half wait! Strangely, though, seating outside was available right away, so we were more than happy to take it!

As with most people, I had heard about this place from a friend and had been wanting to try it for a while. My fiancee, being a vegetarian, has been on a kick to try as many different veggie burgers around the city as she can. 

I really wanted to order a glass of whiskey here, but decided to go for a beer instead figuring it would go better with a burger than a glass of whiskey (which I prefer without any food). So, I ordered the IPA they had on tap, which I should mention was one of the best I've tasted. For dinner, my fiancee ordered the veggie burger (no surprise there) with sautéed onions and fried egg (she's a vegetarian that eats eggs...) along with vegetarian fries, and I ordered the village burger (medium) with sautéed onions and the cheddar cheese along with the duck fat fries.

The burger was hands down THE BEST BURGER I HAVE EVER TRIED. The meat was cooked perfectly, had the right amount of seasoning and flavor, and the toppings (including their house thousand island dressing) all went together perfectly. And somehow, even though it was a standard sized 8 oz burger, the thing felt like it was 16 oz, nonetheless I ate the entire thing! As if this was not enough, the duck fat fries were incredible; and yes, I ate all of them as well...

I would be amiss if I did not also mention on here that the veggie burger my fiancee got was also very good, according to her it was the best she has tried as well. So for, those of you who are burger lovers, either standard beef or vegetarian, Village Whiskey is a place you MUST try.

Thank you again Yelp users for helping us find a great place to eat near Philly.  We love grilled cheese sandwiches, but this place took grilled cheese to an entirely different level.  We ordered 4 different sandwiches and they were all really good.  The staff was so friendly and interactive with us.  Oh how we would like to open a franchise in So Cal of this place!!

Insanely good! This is the first time I've ever been in St. Louis and Yelp helped me find this gem! I'm so happy that I found Ted Drewes because BOY IT WAS GOOD! My dad who normally eats insanely healthy had to have one of their concretes! I had "The Christy" and it was absolutely delicious! It had hot fudge, caramel and brownie mixed together as a concrete. It was so good! The brownie was soft and fudgy and the custard was very creamy and flavorful. 

If you're in St. Louis, you need to stop here asap!

Best bread in town!  In addition to the staples, Mazarro's sells different specialty loaves each day of the week.  Saturday is Sour Dough, which is my favorite!  Throughout the week, they also sell jalapeno, rosemary and sun dried tomato, to name a few. 
I also buy all my meat here.  It's not too expensive and is fresher and better cut than meat at a standard grocery.  They do their own dry aging and will accommodate specialty orders, such as course ground beef for chili.
The wine and cheese room smells awful but it's a must see!  They have a huge variety of cheese on offer and a very nice selection of wines.
I love shopping here, however, it's become a very popular spot with tourists which can make for long lines on the weekend.  It's usually best to avoid peak times such as breakfast and lunch.

The Nashvegas is one of my favorite burgers in Nashville. But what happened here? Not only was the bun smashed paper thin, the burger was well done (not medium as ordered), and there was barely any BBQ sauce. I usually  go to the one on 8th, guess I'll stick to that one from now on. 

This was to go, or I would have sent it back. Which I've only done once in my life.

Food here is outstanding Cajun soul food hard to find anywhere else and especially good food on the late night since the kitchen is open until 1am! 

However this building is so old and place is always so dim that it's always crawling with bugs therefore I haven't been back for any food. It's a shame really cause there. Mac n cheese and fried green tomatoes are excellent!  I wish the owner cared more and up kept his building

So maybe this shouldn't bother me so much but we are here at lunchtime. Our waitress is currently at a table fooling with her phone and occasionally making some coffee or leaving her table and coming back all while we are in our 20th minute waiting for our food. 

I don't know if the food is all made so fresh that I'm supposed to be grateful that they even let me eat here but I feel like appearances matter. She's not been back to ask how we are, or to indicate that our food will EVER be ready. I can only assume they are back there cooking it. There may only be one person cooking. 

Maybe I'm not hip enough for this new style of eating

I'll report back when the food actually arrives. Unless I die of starvation. 

27 minutes.

When the food finally did arrive it was very good. A significantly large burger for the price but I'm not sure the wait and sense of isolation would lead me to return. I would at least recommend the staff appear busy when they are within view of the patrons.

Wasn't my first choice of activities but hey, I'll go.  And so glad I did.  Loved our captain!  He was intelligent and funny and you could tell he loved his alligators and turtles and all the birds and his swamp.  I loved that he took so much pride in his job and you could really tell he loved his swamp.  Great information without being boring!  I would totally totally recommend this to anyone that wants a fun half day tour and see a lot of beauty in this wonderful city!

I signed up for their Chef's Table e-mails and I received a $30 gift certificate for my birthday- good towards the entire check, not just my individual meal! We had two sushi rolls, seaweed salad and fillet Mignon, hibachi style. Everything was GREAT! The service was great and the atmosphere was just dimly lit enough, without being dark at all. They had an interesting drink menu that I will have to try next time! Also, their happy hour is from 5-8 and includes MANY half-priced items and drinks... we are definitely going back soon!
Love this place! Everything tastes so fresh. Ordered the sashimi sampler platter and was blown away by how great everything was.

Currently, Makiman makes me angry, but I would be willing to give them another chance.  It was a Friday night, and Katrina C. and I wanted to grab a quick dinner before a party.  We were in a hurry, so we figured if we ordered take out it would be faster.  I asked the hostess if that was true and she said yes.  They had several specials with crab in them, and I had a groupon so I was willing to splurge on the fancy sushi.  We ordered and then sat down to wait.  Probably 25 minutes go by and the waitress comes over to tell Katrina they are out of crab, and she has to pick a different roll.  Now, they didn't say anything to me, so we figured I must have gotten the last of it.  Well, about 10 minutes later the waitress came to let me know that two of the rolls I ordered were no longer available.  I replaced one with something different, and requested that the other just have the crab changed to something else.  About 15 minutes after that, we finally got our food.  It took about 45 minutes for this process to go down, which caused us to be really late for the party, so we actually requested to just sit at a table and eat our food instead of taking it with us.    We specifically told them we had to be somewhere before ordering, so they should have just said they couldn't accommodate us.  Also, probably not a good idea to make crab the ingredient in every roll, and then not have enough.  I have no major complaints about the sushi, although apparently the spicy salmon was lacking in spice.  It didn't wow me though, and without a groupon, I won't be back.

Not sure about the other yelpers but I thought the food was pretty tasty. I had delivery and it was pretty fast. I ordered chicken with broccoli in white sauce with white rice. No complaints here. Just recently moved to Brandon and Ive already ordered twice. Will order again.

I just changed this rating to three stars after trying The Flavors Buffet. I liked the food more than Flavors.

The Review:
I thought it was okay, we went as a party of 8 for the seafood buffet on Friday. It wasn't that good, I mean their hot food consisted of a lot of seafood but didn't enjoy it much. I just have had better, I don't know what to say I feel like the $20.99 wasn't worth it.

really enjoyed their lobster fettucine, mushroom ravioli, clam chowder, crab legs, gelato was really really good and the cherry pie.

They should have some kind of hot sauce like tapatio for their ceviche too.

I suggest, to the owners they should make smaller portions of the desserts, I only wanted to try the desserts and I wasted a lot, they should consider this change.

Oh and they really need to get better toppings for their salad, I see better salad toppings at old country buffet. Sad to see the buffet at the casino was really poor in this category. I had high expectations for their salad bar too.  

Um pretty much good service of getting plates cleared and will probably go again to try their regular buffet for $12.99 because my boyfriend said it was a lot better than this seafood experience, and see where that puts me in favoring this place in the future. maybe ill edit my review later if its better.

This place definitely needs more than one visit. Food was good but I was expecting more.  Need to try the birria and barbacoa. Carne asada was rather plain. Torta needed sauce to kick up flavor. 
Nothing was bad. But nothing was extraordinary

I always thought Crispers was "ok" after eating there in Gainesville. Recently stopped by this S Tampa location for a quick bite before grocery shopping at Publix next door.

Maybe the menu has upgraded since eating there in 2005? The food here is so fancy and flavorful! I love the crab stack salad. So healthy and delicious. Portions are large. The bf had an Asian salad and chowder 1/2 and 1/2. Both great, too. Customer service is great. They asked us if we needed anything a few times. Very friendly here.

Highly recommended; best of its class.  Excellent curated collection of (mostly) beautiful Mexican furniture, jewelry, textiles, artwork, and clothing, all with prices that are competitive anywhere in Tucson.  There are many fine shops like this in Tucson, and we've visited many of them, but we continue to come back to Que Bonita.  The selection is large and diverse but without being overwhelming.  Quality is consistently good.  Inventory is dynamic -- always something new.  The proprietor is a lovely woman and is herself a joy to visit and speak with, and when she is not there, the other members of the staff are always helpful.

very cute

basic italian food

but sitting outside
with the fairy lights
is perfect
for a first date

While I can not complain about the food at Soy Bistro, the service is SO BAD!!!!  I called in a to-go order for 4 people.  They told me it would be ready in 20 minutes.  When I arrived, there were two other parties in front of me placing their dine-in order.  I paid for our food and was told it would be about 5 more minutes.  Not a big deal, right...wrong!  I sat in the restaurant for another 25 minutes waiting for the kitchen to prepare the two parties orders (that were placed AFTER mine) before they even began on my order.  I told the hostess this was unacceptable and got essentially no reply other than she would tell her manager.  If this restaurant wants to keep business, when they screw up like this they need to acknowlegde it and compensate for it.  I like their food, but will not be back after they way a regular customer was treated.  Sigh....

Food is exceptional, but their customer service is lacking!  The reason why I stay away!  As far as this place being better than miss saigon or pho & deli, just depends on what you are getting.  Its all perspectives on the food.
This place is simple...and great. They even make egg salad made to order. No one does that anymorw

This is my delivery location...and I order Papa John's a good amount. The pizza is consistently good, more or less on time, and I like that they're generous with their toppings. I've ordered from other locations and it just didn't seem as fresh.

The delivery guy is pretty chill, too.

I needed a restaurant to take my wife on her birthday, and we had both heard a ton of great things about this new place called Farmhaus, so that's what I decided on. It was only a few blocks from our place and it seemed perfect, so I called and made reservations. This was great, because they called the morning of our reservation to remind me about it, almost virtually guaranteeing I wouldn't forget about it and screw up the wife's bday.

The restaurant itself could be called small, but probably prefers "cozy." You sit closer to other patrons than you would at other places. This means, when the guy next to you is using his "outside voice" inside such a confined space, you'll hear every detail. But being this close to other patrons has advantages, especially when you get to scope out their food.

The food is very, very good. The only problem, for the price you're paying, the portions are tiny. I don't mind spending ~$100 on a nice meal, but I'd like to be full when I leave. Scratch that. I'd like to be miserably full when I leave. It's the American way. Do not anticipate having any leftovers from Farmhaus. 

And honestly, the food to dollar ratio is my only complaint. The staff was incredible. Our waitress, whose name I meant to remember (Rachel, maybe?) was thorough and well-spoken. The drink selection was top notch, with a range of wines and beers, and even $2 Busch cans for the hipsters and grandpas. 

Dessert knocked our socks off. I would recommend this place to any couple looking for a nice night out. Any group bigger than a couple would be challenging I imagine, although there was a family with some small kids when we went, which was surprising. 

Farmhaus sticks to the trend of these "New American" style restaurants, which provides food very similar to that which you would find at your grandma's house (e.g., meat loaf and mac&cheese). It's delicious and warm, but unlike your grandma's, you don't get full and pass out on the couch.
Only went once.  Wasn't sure about the hype.  I loved it.

The drive-thru service is trying my patience, if it's not someone dragging out their greeting a little too much wasting what little of my lunch break I have, it's someone rushing me when I place my order.  Today, in particular, I asked for a med '4 for 4' combo.  She asked the drink, I tell her and she then just asks if I want anything, I haven't even told her what sandwich I wanted.  I tried to ask for the sandwich, but she goes "yeah yeah, I got it.  Anything else?"  How rude can you possibly be?!  The service should be quick, but the customer shouldn't be rushed especially when not asked the complete questions for the order.  I paid, I got my food but it wasn't how I tried to ask for it since the lady at the window rushed me.  Not even a bloody smile.  I rushed back inside, told them what happened and they give me my new sandwich without even a bloody apology.  Far be it for me to tell someone how to do their job, but I used to work for a drive thru and even on my amateur days would I have worked circles around that worker.  Do better and be more thorough with taking orders, no matter if it's lunch rush or not.

I'm a college student living in New Orleans and haven't found a primary care doctor in the city yet.  With our student health clinic being a complete and total joke, I have been left to my own devices to get well which has consisted mainly of lots of Emergen-C packets.

This time, however, I got sick and wasn't getting better.  It was time to find a doctor.

I found N.O. Urgent Care online and showed up without an appointment.  I was seen immediately.  Dr. Nikolic saw me quickly, listened to what I had to say, and make a diagnosis.  Then she gave me an Rx that she didn't think I'd necessarily need, but could fill if I didn't get better in a week.  No need to come back in a week, she said.  How awesome is that?

Granted, I'm not used to being asked if I do street drugs, but I guess the clientele is slightly different than your typical GP.

I'll definitely be back, if ever sick again.

We ate the vegetarian burger here three years ago and we are specifically going out of our way in two weeks to make it through New Orleans on our way from California to Florida JUST to eat here again.  My kids and I loved this place.  We cannot wait!!!!  Excellent food and our service that day was great.

It's not hard to find pralines in New Orleans but these are far and above the best that I've tasted. Stop
In for a free sample of the original creamy pralines. Pure Heaven!

I have had good and bad experiences with espresso, and this is definitely one of the better ones. I got the espresso bombón, which comes with condensed milk at the bottom, and it surprisingly was the perfect sweetness. I like my coffee still a little bitter and it was perfect. The place itself is nice and quiet and the staff is very friendly.

Ninki gets 4 stars for fresh fish, friendly service and a knowledgeable staff. I have to take a star away for a poorly rolled (very loose) sushi roll that wouldn't hold together, forcing me to dissect it, which is embarassing and I hate to do. 

However, 20% off on Wednesdays is certainly a draw, and I have never in my life, across the many many sushi joints I've been to, seen a flaming sushi roll. 

Overall, this place will teach you not to turn your nose up at a sushi place in a shopping center.

this is going to be short and sweet...

the best cannoli i've ever eaten

I love this farmers' market for the variety and the location. There is always a nice selection of produce, but there are also artisan breads and cheeses, herbs and sprouts, and plenty of homemade goodies. Prices are what you'd expect (you get what you pay for), and people are always friendly. I love their expanded hours, and Tower Grove Park is a beautiful spot to spend a couple of hours!

I seldom get on this side of town, so I spent an evening just going to many places, ordering 1 item and then on to the next destination.
I found the place almost empty. Service was slower than slow.
I tried the California rool. I found it a bit lacking & tasteless. Overall not impressed.
Not my type of place for fresh, innovative sushi.
What's a girl to do? Go where you know exactly  what you are getting, especially  when it comes to raw fish.

I love this store. I've found all of the associates helpful and friendly - especially the dude who usually hangs out in the fragrance section. happily, most products are always in stock, and in my few years of coming to this store, I've only had one visit where a product listed as "in stock" on their website wasn't available.

Only persistent downside: this place is hella expensive.

If you like total salt and sodium infused food, then this is the place to go. I kid you not. I do not believe the food at this restaurant is freshly prepared. We were in shock at the salt factor and the $122.00 tab. Will never go again..

Lots of New Orleans Service here!!  Wait Staff was EXEMPLARY of the Quarter!!

Beautiful decor, this is a stunning restaurant that seemed to offer the promise of the best in New Orleans. I was very hopeful that Muriel's would deliver on this promise and IT DID!!

The appetizers and food were great and fairly priced.

First things first, this is a dining establishment within the Ritz Carlton, so like all resorts a meal comes with a fairly high price tag. I know this going in...so...aside from that what's not to enjoy about spending the day relaxing poolside with a gorgeous view to the Arizona desert and the loveliest most polite staff in the Tucson city limits? Turquesa is the poolside restaurant at the resort. The menu covers your standard Latin fare from tacos to Nachos, salads, guacamole, ceviche and more. After two days at the pool we determined our favorite item were the Nachos. A GIANT bowl that's easily big enough for 6 people is about $11 with all the fixings- cheese, jalapeños, nachos, a TON of cheese, and your choice of chicken or meat. These nachos are legit. Sure, the green chile tacos were tasty and the grape fruit and avocado salad was certainly crispy and refreshing, but a giant bowl of nachos with a buckets of Tecate light can't be beat. Ultimately, the staff at Turquesa makes it worth while. The team here is all smiles and seriously at your service. Mac and Joel are two in particular that were so wonderful to our group. They remembered us by name the next day too! And our orders. I love staying at the Ritz for a staycation and the team at Turquesa makes the poolside experience totally fabulous.

When I am going out to buy beer or wine for a party or as a gift I think of Trainos first. Trainos has a great staff, always willing to talk about the product. Trainos has a great selection of microbrews and runs specials daily on all kinds of products. But the real reason I will go out of my way to stop in at Trainos is because it hasn't lost its local feel. The people who work there are always willing to put in special orders for me or find product I am looking for.

Over rated and resting on its Laurels. To have a store adjacent to restaurant is part of the "franchising" approach of NOLA food establishments. 

Came in for an afternoon snack, with dinner at another place later in the evening.  Gumbo was so-so, Oakland's Brown Sugar Cafe is far superior. Fried pickles, skinny and fried to long --aka almost burnt.  

The best NOLA cooking I had were in people's home during the holidays. The variety and quality exceeds those found in run of the mill places.

Yes, I am a San Francisco foodie and expected better from moderately priced restaurants such as TPC.

Stopped in for Sunday brunch on a whim and really enjoyed my Cornbread Biscuits with Chorizo-Thyme gravy. The cornbread was sweet and moist; the gravy had a great flavor with th eight amount of heat.  Sadly, only brewed coffee available. A legit Cafe con Leche would've been a great compliment.

My experience is similar to a lot of previous reviews:  Good service, mediocre food, overpriced.  I had a Cobb Salad that I'd give 3.5 stars, but the calimari was not very good.  A friend had the Oyster and Shrimp Po Boy, and two of the shrimp were not deveined.  Add one draft beer, and this lunch ran me nearly $50 with tip.

I was so excited to try this new place! Even with a 20 minute wait (9 months pregnant) outside of the door, it was worth it! The vegetable ramen was creamy and packed with great vegetables! I can't wait to go back again.

Recently adopted a vegan diet and have been growing tired of cooking all of my meals at home. Ordered the Havana (sub daiya non-dairy cheese) which came with mixed greens and guacamole- it 's basically a quesadilla on a whole wheat tortilla with black beans and peppers.  The quesadilla had a very nice flavor, the "cheese" didn't taste processed, but was creamy and smokey. The guacamole was excellent. Only suggestion would be to ask for a side of hot sauce, if you like things spicy- it didn't have much kick. The maple balsamic on the greens was also nice. All in all, a hearty portion, if a bit pricey- if you're tired of cooking at home for lack of good vegan/vegetarian options, Blue Sage is a wonderful and exciting treat!
I went there February 24, on a Saturday, I had the pepperoni calzone it was so good, full of pepperoni and cheese! Great customer service also! I'll definitely go back

Very nice bartender but he really was rather clueless. For a bar that advertises its large selection of tequila he didn't understand when I ordered a Sauza margarita. I moved here from AZ so when you're serving me a margarita you better come correct! He served it to me in a styrofoam cup. Gross.
