I always want to have something at a restaurant that I can't easily make on my own at home. There was not one thing about the preparation of this meal that made it unique in any way.

Atmosphere: Interesting crowd. Very young and trendy. Likely very privaledged people and that are local or college students. Not diverse at all. Most seem to be beach style (trendy but rough like you just got out of bed but your look is premeditated). Comfortable seating area, very busy which is probably great for business. Pretty sure I saw a dude with beach clothes on and a gold chain. Also saw some women in emo style but they appeared to be privaledged as well (obviously not certain of any of this but I want to paint you an accurate picture). 

Food: Pretty good and likely considered healthy (I can never really tell). Lots of Acai and other styles of bowls to include oatmeal and quinoa. I got the quinoa bowl and my wife tried the muesli bowl. The food was pretty good. 

Service: Nothing special. Good service. 

Overall: Probably worth going back based on the healthy option route. Not bad.
Pretty good burgers along with not dogs, you can defiantly tell meat is fresh. Can't say I'm a fan of the fries though.

One of philly finest.  Well prepared steaks on the correct and flavorful rolls.  Prepare to wait about 45 minutes, but if you are familiar with Philly, this is not news.  Highly recommended, but definitely a place for carry out...very small establishment not met for dining in.

Cafe style. I have the take out all the time. This place have all kind Spanish food from fried whole fish to teriyaki chicken. They gave selection of small or big plate. Range from $4 to $6.50. 

They also have devil crab, chicken or ground beef empanadas, stuff potato. They also have freshly make Cuban sandwich. 

Compare to fast food change, cafeteria style is a better option. I always come here for for the guarapole ( sugar cane juice). They prepare the fresh squeeze on the site. It is good. 

Please be aware the lunch crowd build up after 11:30 am. Please come early. If you come after 11:30 am, the line is already to the door. Friday night, music and fun is happen here. People gather after work for music.

We stopped in for dinner during a weekday to a nearly empty restaurant.  Waited 10 minutes for someone to greet and seat us.  We ordered the 'customized' guacamole.  The portion size is admirable but the guacamole was basically bland despite the additions you can select.  Chips were crisp and tasty though.  We order Tamales which were very disappointing.  The masa needed salt and the fillings are served along side the tamale, as a restaurant means not to have to make four kinds of tamales.  The mushroom mix was bitter tasting.  The pulled pork was dry and flavorless.   I also ordered a Gin and tonic (a pretty weak pour) and when I tried to order another drink they said they were out of gin.  Perhaps that was the reason for the weak pour, but what bar/restaurant runs out of gin when you serve umpteen kinds of tequila.  Pretty disappointing all the way around.
High quality comfort food. We braved the cold for over an hour, standing in the queue. Was it worth it? Sure, by a nose.

Very surprised at how good the food was. When we entered for the first time, my wife observed that it reminded her of McAllister's. Came to find out that the founders are the same people that created McAllister's. That being said, Newk's is much better. Both the dishes we got were bursting with flavor and generous in portion size. We left wishing that the chain had locations where we live. Maybe someday.

This is my favorite place in Voorhees.  I used to go there every day to the point the guys all know my order!  The main difference I have found between Pancheros and Chipotle, which are pretty much the two competing stores in this area, is Panch is mainly focused on hot ingredients such as queso and Chipotle is more along the lines of sour cream and guac.  Both very good just depending upon what you are in the mood for at the time!  Would definitely recommend this for anyone and cannot wait to get it when I come home from school!
We came here for a family birthday dinner, delicious food, although small menu, cute atmosphere, only reason for 4 stars was once it started to get busy it got super loud!!!!

I came here for supper with some friends.  My friends ordered pita sandwiches while I ordered the mozarella and tomato apppetizer plus a small Greek salad.  No alcoholic beverage.

The appetizers are sized to share between two people.

My food was good, and the sandwiches were consumed, so they must have been good, too.  The menu has a nice selection, and I can see myself returning to try other items.  I just didn't feel like eating a full dinner that evening.

The service was fine.

I walked in for a pedicure and gel/no-chip manicure and was assisted right away.  I selected a dark blue toe polish from a very slim selection. My pedicure was great until the girl who was going to be doing my manicure started doing my nails while I was still in the chair.  At first I thought it was because I was a walk in and they were squeezing me in. But as my appointment went on the place didn't get any more packed.  So all that did was make the whole process feel rushed. They didn't just remove the gel from my previous manicure while I was still in the pedicure chair, she cut and filled my finger nails too. This should have been the first red flag. Each of my nails turned out different shapes and lengths.  When I got home I also noticed air bubbles and bumps in the gel.  Then, I took a closer look at my toes and realized they were jet black. So they either did not use the color I picked out, or are trying to refill their own polish bottles.  One week after the manicure multiple nails had chipped and my nails are EXTREMELY brittle.  

Not only do I not recommend this place, but I severely question the legitimacy of their certifications and their business practices.
We are here today for the buffet lunch! It was fantastic! We will be back...the wait staff was quick and efficient the food was yummy!

45 minutes later and I am still sitting here listening to that incessant music that pauses every once in a while to instruct me to unplug my cable box if I am having trouble with my cable. As soon as a representative comes on she asks me if I have unplugged my box. I told her I had been told 50 times to do so while I waited 45 minutes for her to answer my call....so I would be a real moron if I hadn't tried that by now. Let's not forget the appointments they set up for you that they don't bother keeping. No, I don't mind wasting 3 hours of work to wait for a tech who doesn't show. Thanks for the 20 bucks but you cost me more then that. But...my favorite of all time is the tech who sits in front of your house for 20 minutes without coming to your door. Then you call them and the techs notes say customer not home. "Let's set up another appointment". Comcast, get your shit together. You are like a billion dollar company and have the worst customer service. You are truly hated by most. Congrats!

We cam here for my wife's birthday this year that also just so happens to be Cinco De Mayo. We didn't want to go to a mexican joint so we chose the Bricks after reading some specials that they had going online. I have to say it was a good night and a lot of fun. Good drinks as well as food. Great ambiance, this is an older building in Ybor that they really did a great job of restoring. These guys are always having great food and happy hour specials. You won't be disappointed.

I ordered for delivery from this place several times. Unfortunately the last couple times, they packed the food while it was still too hot or they did not seal the containers correctly because it leaked everywhere and the bag was soaked. Tell me the delivery guy didn't notice this... He should have. I took pictures but can't find a way to post them here.

Ordered the stir fry bowl with ahi and avocado!  Would come back for sure!!
Good portion size and lots of choices.
Only problem is difficult to park at lunch hour!

i really like the food here, but the service is hit or miss.  i would definitely go if you have a bit of patience!  the cookie dough egg rolls are delicious, a definite recommendation!  when i ate meat, the best dish was the chicken salad torrado.  i also like their panini's and their cocktails!  have fun!

I've been here 3 times. Loved it every time. Their food is so delicious. I loved their Qabli Paloa...

The atmosphere is cool too. Although a bit small.

Also the enterance is a little hidden. It's in the basement and sort of easy to miss...

Great little pizza spot in Soho. Interesting selection of specialty pizzas and sauces. Our favorite was the BLT pizza (with balsamic glaze)...delicious! Definitely worth the money and a visit. Offers gluten-free options too.

I lived in South Korea for 3 years and this restaurant food was over priced with horrible sides. The Kimchi was dry and a bottle of soju was $15.00.  The potato salad was bland with no taste.  The decor is beautiful, but if you want  good authentic Korean food, go to Gogi Korean restaurant.

Not a great experience!!! I've been here a couple of times and haven't had much to complain about, I've really enjoyed their food and services, but that changed when I planned a larger group event. With the increase in guests their care of us got exponentially worse. Every other time I've been here there has only been two ladies and they seemed to handle us well no hick ups. This time I made a 15 person table the first thing that happened was when we arrived they miscounted our table setting and it took about 10 minutes to get it handled and with three different servers that were not communicating to each other we kept getting more chairs and more plates and settings that had to be removed or brought back. The service this time seemed subpar and almost crass. I don't know if it was because they knew we had to pay a 18% gratuity anyway, but they were not very hospitable and I even felt ignored, they barely looked at us and often overlooked us for other smaller groups. One serve even said "I barely saw you out of the corner of my eye" because they never looked at our table directly. The food was sloppily presented Family style which I did not expect considering it was always plated individually before, I don't mind the sharing but the way it was arranged made my event feel slapdash and childish. We were constantly having to reorder things from different servers because the other would forget. What really pushed the Brunch to a bad place was that a plate of half burnt scones was dropped off, not only did it look bad, but it smelled worse and to have that placed in front of us was unappetizing and a huge oversight by the staff. One of my guests was also horribly talked down to by the staff in a very berating way when she asked for butter for her scone the server which I think was the owner stopped and said "you are in a tea house and you don't want butter, here we use Devonshire cream and not butter for our scones" this I feel was not the way to talk to a customer and embarrass them in front of a large group.  I had high hopes for this Brunch, but my hope was sorely misplaced. I don't think I will be hosting a get together here again because the service and attention to detail was so poor.

Don't go to this Wendy's. Ordered food and waited 20 minutes for it to come out. It is Halloween night but a large crowd of rowdy kids came in and took seats, even though only maybe one or two of them were ordering.  They also got my order wrong, which we noticed before leaving and the cheeseburgers were cold.

Horrible customer service!!! Came down for essence fest called several times showed the hostess when we got there paid for a $30 Lyft and everything and all the hostess could say is "I've been answering the phone, then says oh it's dead." And proceeds to plug it up. Pathetic... she needs to go home. Then the guy outside the door says " Three hour wait, and they are closed." I have never seen anything like this in my life! Ain't never heard of this in my life. We called cause we heard how good everything was, as a food blogger I'm sad to say I won't even come back to rate the food.

The most D.E.P.L.O.R.A.B.L.E. dining experience I have ever had. Service is non existant...al of the severs stand around in the bar, talking about the guy they were with last night...then...six TV's...I am watching one...and a guy just walks up and changes the channel...3 laps to go in the race...never asked if anyone was watching...put them all on the game he and the cooks wanted to watch...no manners or consideration.The place is a "roadhouse"....but there is crap on the floor that has been here...awhile. A good team is assembled by a manager who cares...and then rides herd on the emplyees....Manager walks around just watching it all...smdh.

Cannuli's has managed to be around for nearly 100 years. It's a traditional butcher shop. How do I know it's a traditional butcher shop? Well that is easy, there is butcher paper separating the layers of meats in the trays in the cold case. And I think it is one of the key businesses that makes Italian Market a great place to go shopping. 

The shop is split into halves -- the beef and pork side and the poultry side. They have separate entrances.  Behind the scenes each side is connected. You can go back there and see where they dress the beef. It is really amazing. 

The Italian sausage is awesome! We bought three pounds for using in my pasta sauce last Saturday. It was great!! We went back today and bought another two pounds. This time we bought a mix of the hot Italian and the mild Italian to try this week. I am looking forward to it. 

We also bought a roasting chicken and the price was great.  Roasting chickens are hard to find in the regular grocery store, so we were very happy to find one here. To my beau, it felt more like France (he is French) and it is where traditional butcher shops still exist. 

They also had, and we bought, chicken gizzards. It's not the same as the gizzards we get in France but we took them and came close to making the tasty salad I have enjoyed in France and at Bistrot Jeanty in Yountville, California. 

There is a lot to explore. Myriad possibilities, and the guys there will help you. They are courteous and efficient. 

Enjoy!

Did not disappoint! A group of 6 of us went here on a Friday with a long line out the door. Lone moved quite fast and everything we ordered was on point.  The hot beef sandwiches were a standout but honestly anything you order will be amazing.

Mexican restaurants are ubiquitous inTucson. El Charro differentiates itself as being the oldest continuously operated restaurant in town. Recently visited their Oro Valley location. Had the chorizo rellanos (sp?) and pollo y burro. Both tasty. Homemade salsa good and spicy. Tres Leches Tini for her, cervasas pour moi. I liked the interior, open, with alcovey tables against the wall. Bar and TV within easy reach and viewing. I definitely liked the modern interpretation of the tin plate lights. i've heard some folks say it's too noisy, the concrete floor doesn't help, but the noise level the night we were there wasn't bad. We'll keep it on the list for a return visit.

Their pizza is consistently really good and I love the great combinations they offer! Other pasta options are good too. 
They also have really nice customer service always. My fav in town!
They limit your drinks not only that but bought a jalapeño mcchicken isn't it suppose to have jalapeños ? My fries were old

I  had a nice lunch with friends and family last weekend.   I'm on a special diet and i appreciate that they were quick to accommodate my dietary requests.
I love their new clean look and I look forward to coming back and trying out some of their new tasty looking dishes.
Absolutely wonderful, unique pizza. This is the kind of place to try when you're looking for something a bit out-of-the-box.

Typically this place has great service. But today with a party of five and the place not that busy the servers were not at their best. They didn't get us a chair for the 5th member of our group, not enough silverware and napkins were provided. No one asked during our meal if we had everything we needed. Bussed a dish without asking if she was done eating and didn't ask if we needed anything else like dessert at the end of our meal. Food was good, service was terrible.

We like this hotel because of its spacious room, nice bathroom,  swimming pool, restaurant choices, and fast wifi.  We didn't care for the walk passing the gambling machines before you get to the restaurants because we have children with me.  

A reviewer mentioned about the pool with rowdy kids.  That's true.  My child was knocked down by some teen who was backing up before he was going to do a cannonball to the pool.  She fell and bruised her hip badly.  I think the lifeguards should be monitoring the people who are playing rough and diving in the pool.  NO running as well.
Absolutely the best. The orange juice is fresh squeezed and my favorite thing in the world. I love going as often as possible!

What a disappointment.

This place used to be one of the few authentic, elegant Italian eateries in town. Now it's serving only competent, middle of the road Italian-American fare.

The service was also lacking. We had to wait about 20 minutes for the salad course. Then I had to ask three times for the wine list to order a second bottle, and by the time it was served, we were almost done with our meal.

There are plenty of other restaurants in town with far better food, atmostphere, and service at this price point.
When I order nachos from a restaurant I expect the cheese to be grated cheese, not  the liquid dispense from a nozzle movie theater variety. Gross
The food was great...but they ran out of biscuits and corn bread. The service was horrible. Really slow and the waitress seemed scared. Not sure what's going on today but I am disappointed

This is a really great space. The history and prior use of the building adds to the vibe. There are several artists within the space. There are varying types of styles and genres.  Lots of good art within the space. Some interesting photography on canvas.

"it was the best of times, it was the worst of times" these words from Dicken's a Tale of Two Cities describe the haircuts that I've gotten here. My stylist, Jamie, did a great job on my haircut today.It was the best one that I've ever had in this place. Color me happy. On the other hand, some of the other ones here have been mediocre and a few,well, awful. Remember, folks, we go to Supercuts to get an inexpensive haircut for a reasonable price. In this world, you get what you pay for.

If I wanted a razor cut, I'd somewhere else and pay big bucks. Now, I just want a simple haircut and Supercuts is where I go. They get three stars.

I love this place.  Sushi in general is expensive, and this place is no exception, but they have a happy hour where u can get $3 sushi rolls.  Plus, there food is really good.  They can customize any roll, and will make u what u want if it's not on the menu.  Very fresh fish, even my kids eat it.

Great color selection. Good prices. Friendly staff. If you don't want to destroy your nails with gel, they have weekly polish for a few $ more than a regular manicure that lasts about 10 days. Very clean, and you get a drink with your service. All good things!

After flying back and forth to St. Louis (my former home) for all of my haircuts, I finally checked out Bauhaus...it was just up the street from my house, has great curb appeal, and after asking around was able to get some positive feedback on the stylists there.

Love it!!  Louis gave a great haircut, gorgeous color, and it was very affordable.  Plus, I always love a chance to support local businesses in Collingswood.

I have since sent another friend to the salon, and she loved her haircut too.  Thanks Louis!

Service- It is a completely self-serve restraunt which is borderline confusing when you first walk in. You approach the area where the food is being prepared to order, but pay after you're done eating  in the back where it looks like the staff takes short breaks. 
Staff- They're present. That's about it, you barely interact with them or need them honestly. 
Food- Oh I couldn't wait to tell you'll about this, it's awful!!! Your food is ready in barely seconds after you order, and this is supposed to be a place that can compare to Tazikis( another meditteranean cafe that's great&fresh daily and consistently), but instead it's the complete opposite. The meat astes very microwaved along with the rice and unrealistic like mcdonalds meat. The basmati rice was not how I normally see it, it was over greasy& gooey!!!! Then the supposed tazikis sauce they gave  tastes like runny mayonnaise, and their drinks were insanely overpriced. Their cream sodas were like 2.95 when they're a buck cheaper elsewhere. Overall the only good thing they have  keeping them in business is their location& atmosphere, but the cuisine is . Save yourself
Some the best food I have ever tasted, definitely a place to go back, I had ordered the Hawaiian girl pizza that had chicken ham pineapple it was the bomb.com!

Tried this place for dinner and it was so good! 
The tacos tasted so fresh and they were packed with flavor! There were so many diverse flavors and options from the exotic octopus tacos to bacon cheeseburgers. Plus, they had $3 margaritas the night I went. They were fresh and strong! Definitely will have to go back!

Service was good, the beer it took 4 samples to figure out my taste. I went on a Tuesday night so it was only a handful of people, entertaining from the music. The chairs at the bar are not comfortable I felt like sitting on the floor. The bartender was cute lol.

Reminds me a lot of nearby Martin's BBQ. Edley's is a fun, upbeat place to come for lunch or dinner. Whether you're solo, with friends or the family for a meal there's a place for you here. What sets this aside from many of the other BBQ places in the greater Nashville area? I'd like to think the quality of meats and sides. All of their sides seem to be made with care. They aren't the boring cole slaw, baked beans and potato salad you get at peer locations. In addition you have sides of the day, which are made up fresh and packed with flavor. Even the cornbread (which most dishes come with) is worthy. 

As for the meats my only complaint is they don't offer two and three meat combos. Unfortunately, if you're from out-of-town and only get one shot at this place you're going to have to choose one meat. I choose the Turkey Platter and it was tender and full of flavor. My friend had the Wing Platter and raved about it. We also had the chess and chocolate pie and enjoyed every bite. 

Edley's does a great job at blending a fun atmosphere (there's a bar here, too) with good BBQ. It's the kind of place you can walk up, place your order and be back on the road in 20 minutes or stay for an hour and have a few drinks. There's also ample TV's to watch sporting events. In Nashville it's one of the better BBQ spots you'll find.

Super delicious food. A very cute set up! Great service 10/10! The pulled pork was to die for! The servers and hostesses were all so welcoming and kind making sure that everything and everyone was good and comfortable. The seating was simple but the building layout was cool! I recommend going
me and my boyfriends favorite place. never disappointed. gnocchi is to die for!!! you definitely get what you paid for.

What a great find! Great family owned, local spot! Took a chance during a busy Saturday and so glad we did. The food was fantastic. Husband and I split the cinnamon bun french toast with the homemade sausage and the spinach omelet. Yum! Owner and staff were super kind and personable. Great family vibes!

Awesome target, but I wish they would update their cafe to a Starbucks!!! The CD/DVD is extensive and affordable. I love targets grocery store. Prices are good, and they have food items that most grocery stores do not carry. For example, target carries a new soup item from smart ones that I have not seen in supermarkets. Argent has an equally nice, home, beauty, seasonal, and toy section.i recommend it here!

Street Parking only. Get ready to wait for 25 mins for your order. Portions are small for the price you pay. Collard greens are very salty. Beef short ribs were tough and chewy. It was not tender at all. All side orders were all gone by 6:30p. Only collard greens was left.

dont ever get a uhaul from here, twice I had a reservation for a truck and when I got there they didnt have it, then on top of that the staff were probably the rudest people ive ever met who work in customer service and wouldnt even help me make another reservation. just a bunch of very slimy people

I really enjoyed this tour that I took last weekend. I brought my boyfriend and my 13 year old niece - who was OH so excited about the ducks!!! 

We had planned to ride on Friday, but found out that the tickets were sold out - so planned ahead for Sunday, and bought tickets for a Noon tour on Sunday. We were told to meet the group at 11:45 at 6th & Chestnut. 

On Sunday morning, we arrived at 6th & Chestnut, but did not see any Duck boat! We waited and then finally went back towards the Visitors Museum, and asked for clarification. The girl at the counter looked at me as if I was a moron when I asked where the Duck was departing from! 

So, at 11:59, they were about to close the door on the Duck - and we ran over and just made it on! Panting from running, they forced us to take a group photo and then we boarded. 

The Tour Guide / Comedian / Driver was hilarious & he really knew his lines well. The tour combined music with history with jokes, and everything was timed perfectly!! I think the leaders must have to spend many days in training for this job. Overall, the tour was well worth the money and I'm glad that we went! It was a blast. I learned a lot about Philadelphia - and I've been living here for a few years! The Duck tour was one of my niece's highlights from her visit to see her Aunt. 

When we arrived back at the Visitors Center at 1:15pm, we were immediately greeted by Duck Tour employees with our photographs in their hands. They had pre-printed them out, and put them into nice little envelopes for us to purchase for the small price of $21. No thank you! 

Overall, I was impressed with the tour and I would recommend it to others. HOWEVER, Please be cautious, as you never know where you're actually going to board for the tour. AND I think the company should think more green - and not waste the paper and chemicals on printing everyone's photographs, which are bound to be thrown in the trash if not purchased. #wasteful 

P.S. They Tour Guide / Comedian / Driver did a great job with reviewing lifejacket safety twice!!! I felt safe on here - no worries about barges. They don't go very far into the water anymore.

This restaurant is always really good authentic Italian food. My wife and I got the shrimp spinach and pesto rolls as an appetizer. Wonderful. We also shared the muffuletta calzone. Fantastic. The menu, especially at lunch has so many specials, all are amazing. The service was wonderful, our waitress Jessica was so very patient and sweet to us. We recommend this restaurant to everyone for all occasions

This is a very cute little restaurant to dine at for breakfast, brunch or lunch. The decor was nice, food was delicious and service was great. Our server was very nice and friendly. Would definitely return if ever in NOLA again.
Southern food cooked to perfection. The bananas foster was a bit too much, so bring a friend to share. Great food and a great cause.

This place is quite new-- I noticed it the other day so I figured I'd stop in since we are looking for good non-chain restaurants in Largo. When I parked in the rear parking lot, one of the owners was hanging out in the back, outside the kitchen, tending to the jerk. It smelled incredible! I love being able to smell the food before you even walk into a restaurant. Everyone was extremely friendly, and the jerk wings and curry chicken roti I ordered to go were outstanding. I will definitely be coming back!

Definitely go here! The atmosphere is great. Just a really good vibe when you walk in the reallllly fancy doors! Everyone was happy & welcoming. The decor inside is so nice! I love the rustic but also slightly modern feel. Food was good! My friend & I had salads but the portions were perfect & everything was fresh. We will definitely be back & my fiancé is excited to give Bernie's a try too! Can't wait to try some of their other food. So excited to have a new place to go to in Hatboro!

The food was fine. Some of it was even GOOD.  But the MANAGER...creep fat man in a lime green dress shirt.  Came by EVERY table to  make sure this were going well but the table my Mother and I were at.  Went by us several times (7 AFTER I started counting), even walked right towards us, only to suddenly veer off at the last minute.  If this is who is running things there, I will not be going back.  Don't get me wrong...our server was tops!  She got a great tip for the service she gave us.  But I was made to feel VERY unwelcome by the Manager.  And the comments I heard him make to others as he made his rounds ("Better chug that beef before I get to it!") were not what I might consider appropriate.    Creepy Sizzler Manager, you have failed to being me anything approaching decent customer service!

Was greeted warmly by two lovely older gentlemen, and I asked to be seated at the bar.  I had gotten there for a late lunch, so around 2:30pm.  Since it was my first proper meal in NOLA, I kind of went big: cup of okra gumbo, fried eggplant, and the crab and avocado salad.  Bread, Miss?  I'd LOVE some.  Also had a local NOLA beer that the very attentive and kind bartender recommended.

Although a cup of gumbo, there were two huge shrimp, oysters, okra and chunks of crab.  It was perfectly seasoned with a lovely spicy bite.  I had done a bit too much the night before, so I needed the fried eggplant that came with very fresh hollandaise (yum!!) and powdered sugar (new to me). What the heck, try each, try them together, it was all perfect!  The bread was freshly baked and soft and warm and the butter was of the best quality.  Lastly, the salad.  Half of an avocado with an NBA player handful of fresh crab on a bed of bibb lettuce with tomato slices.  Amazing, and so refreshing in the warm weather.  

The service was impeccable and when I make my way back to NOLA, I will go again.  Merci beaucoup!!

Great cigar shop in the heart of Philly. Friendly and knowledgeable staff. Small, clean smoking lounge on the first floor, rear of the wall humidors. Wide selection. The beauty of this place is the proximity to many little cafes and coffee shops if you want to carry in a drink in the afternoon. Ashton lounge on the second floor is open late night, too.

We came for a late Sunday afternoon lunch. After waiting a considerable amount of time for someone to come over (we were the only people in the restaurant at the time), we were finally greeted by the bartender. No one came back to take our order for another long while. After finally ordering two small pizzas, one gluten-free and one Neapolitan crust, we then waited over an hour with no pizza in sight. The one other table of customers that came in and ordered after us received their pizza and finished eating before ours arrived. There was also a hair in one of our water glasses. The pizzas finally arrived after about an hour and fifteen minutes. No one ever came to check on us, otherwise we would have ordered a new water. 

Also, when we went to pay our bill we saw a small child running around the kitchen eating cheese out of the cheese bin used for customers' pizza. I almost threw up my pizza and we ended up throwing away the $35 worth of pizza that we had leftover: completely unsanitary, unacceptable, and waste of money. 

I realize things like this can happen anywhere (with the exception of a toddler in the kitchen). The pizzas were slightly better than average but the poor customer service is enough to keep me from coming back. There are too many other great options for pizza in STL to waste time at Bono's.

This is one of my favorite casual places to eat and drink. The staff is very pleasant, knows their beer and food and recognizes why patrons come. On two recent visits I had the turkey and brie sandwich and the cornflake trout. My favorite was the turkey and brie; great flavor- a fine compliment was a glass of the APA. The trout was also quite good, a large portion of fish with potatos and corn. I love the special events that this location and the one downtown host. A great place to go for beer lovers, food lovers and anyone who just wants to relax and have fun!

First off, the noise level is off the charts. There is no dress code, each guy walking in came in sweat pants and flip flops. Turn off. We ordered shredded duck pappardelle and prosciutto wrapped duck breast in balsamic glaze. The duck breast was cooked perfectly and was juicy and delicious.  The sauce on the paperdellle pasta was so salty that it was as inedible.  I like salt on my food but I could not stomach this entree. It was a major disappointment after hearing glowing reviews. I will NOT be going back..

I cannot say enough good things about the store manager Garrett! I had some trouble with a return, which I tried to resolve over the phone with corporate customer service. They were no help, so I went into the store instead. Garrett went above and beyond and made sure that the problem was solved to my satisfaction. I was very pleased and impressed with the customer service I received in the store.

I don't really buy CDs anymore, and I don't have a record player, but if you do, this is a great place to go if you're looking for old, rare recordings.  SUPPORT INDIE RECORD SHOPS (and local musicians, too, which most, if not all the employees are ;))
Great food, great staff and their happy hour prices cannot be beat.  I recommend the fried oysters and Brussel sprouts ... !

I come for the spa and stay for Ocean restaurant.   Love love love the spa....Tony gives great massage!  So far about even on the gambling....great steam shower in our room!  My favorite Reno destination

I think it's important to prepare yourself for what Black Thorn are selling. This is not quality pizza to my mind, more like really tasty "junk food" pizza. The deep dish is ridiculously filling, most people will struggle to finish two slices so you get a lot of value for your money. The sauce is great and if you love cheese, you will not be disappointed.

Looking for a fun bar to hang out and eat something greasy and tasty then Black Thorn is the place. If you are looking for something more traditional Italian or more upmarket, it's not going to fit the bill.

We recently moved to the Tampa area from Austin and have been searching for a good place for wings and football. We found our new home!!

North 30 is not very convenient to where we live (Northdale), but worth the trip. The hot naked wings are excellent! Not obnoxiously spicy, but perfect amount of heat.

The number of tv's and variety is just what we are looking for. And the staff is very friendly.
I had the short rib and had a taste of the sautéed scallops from my wife's dish along with sharing the cheese platter. It was delicious

Booked a Glycolique Facial & Brow... Wow!! I'm a CMT and her facial was fabulous!! Very relaxing... absolutely loved you're products... the pineapple enzymes was heaven.. and the Glycolique peel spicy!  The whole experience was heaven!! Thank you Jenn for you're expertise!!

We had a great experience here recently, and very much recommended this for others.

First, the service was great.  Robin, our waitress, was great.  Timely with attending to us without being overbearing, had no issue with the additional questions & requests.  Thank you Robin, you rock!

Drinks were also very good.  I had a great whiskey sour that was spruced up with some Syrah and Egg White.

The dinner was good, not great, but certainly a fine experience.  I recommend the salmon burger.  My only comment would be that they might need to look at adding 1 more vegan item to the menu.

Will definitely be back!

First time here.  The atmosphere is nice.  Busy spot. 
Pros: Wonderful menu,  amazing - delicious food, generous portions,  friendly - good wait staff, outdoor seating. 
Cons: You have to pay to park - no validat ing, limited outdoor seating. 

Summary: Overall a good place to eat. Nice for brunch as well.  Needs better parking or offer validating.

Worse customer service I ever had at this ice cream please.
The server was not polite... Did not even made mix the right ingredients!!!!

Even though we had 10 in our group, it was WORTH the wait!!! Amanda (server) was so efficient & food came out exactly as ordered, AND Jim (owner) came to our table several times-helped serve, made sure everything was fine, and he shared their cool business story, which is why they're SO  successful... a MUST VISIT in Nashville. Best Quality, hands down!

The staff here is amazing! So nice and personable and made me feel really welcome. Hot sauce bar is the best. Been there a few times and my food has been pretty good! Taco Tuesday's and throwback Thursday's are the best days to go because they have specials on tacos and burritos. Only down side to this place is that there isn't a lot of room to park.

This place is hands down the best sushi in town. It is not your typical sushi place where you will see people pounding back sake and Sapporo and eating rainbow rolls and edamame. The fish is so fresh. The brothers know what they are doing so when you come here, trust in them and let them take your tastebuds on a ride. The whiskey aged soy tuna was so good we ordered it 3 times. All the rolls have such different flavors that melt away in your mouth. No soy sauce is needed for anything. The fish is always so smooth and buttery that you never feel full you just keep wanting more. Also yes there is sake and nothing goes better than great tasting sushi and sake. Can't wait to go back for more.

I love a neighborhood coffee shop, and Henry's is pretty much the one for Cottage Home. A literally 2 minute drive or a nice 10-15 minute stroll and your at this friendly establishment. 

The staff is beyond friendly, as well, and I love that one of them was set up with her kids selling Girl Scout Cookies this past Saturday. So. Adorable.  

Beyond that, the coffee and coffee drinks are great. The food is delicious and they have a huge menu. No reason for anyone to say there isn't something for the to eat. 

Although they don't carry gluten-free menu items, my kid was VERY happy with bacon and quiche, haha :).

We love this as a Saturday-read-the-paper-hangout-with-the -fam spot. And you will too.

I'm not quite sure how I got on these guys email list, but I'm sure glad I did.
Four Roses had a bottle signing by their master distiller there the other day, and since I'm getting pretty passionate about my bourbons, I thought I'd check it out.
WOW. Talk about feeling like a kid in a candy store!. They had just about every bourbon I had ever wanted, not to mention heard of. Even more impressive was the fact that the sales guy actually knew most of the bourbons I was talking about, had tried them and had opinions as to his recommendations. Knowledgeable sales staff-  didnt that go out of fashion in the 90's?
Anyway, their specialty beer selection was also pretty impressive as was the mixers. I'm not mixer crazy like some of my friends - no need for special cinnamon flavored bitters or rare liqueurs  - but I do like having a well stocked bar, and there was nothing I wanted that I did not find.
I hope they have another event soon and email it to me so I can find yet another (flimsy) excuse to duck out and shop.

I felt like this was a Starbucks claim at a trailer park! Very entertaining staff! If you want a show I'd recommend going in and watching the tattooed toothless baristas trying to figure out how to brew coffee. Don't order from here they don't know anything!

The gyros at this place are awesome!  The gyros alone would make this a 5 star  The rest of the menu is hit or just ok.  This place is always clean, (in fact every time i've walked in there off peek hours they are cleaning.) but its not a fancy place and its loud in there when they are busy. I recommend taking the food to go.

My mom and I were in town for the day and I looked up the best lash places on yelp and found this one. It was a miracle we were both able to get in same day, there was a fortunate cancellation. While it was more expensive than any other lash place I've gone to to get a full set, I have to say I am so happy with them!! I had Jared and he was phenomenal. Easy to talk to, kind to my son that I wouldn't normally bring to something like this but it was necessary, and finally did the most fantastic work on my lashes! My mother is tempted to drive 3 hours every few weeks to come back to this place she was so impressed. You get what you pay for! And I payed for the most beautiful lashes I've ever had!
This place is amazing.. Very relaxing and my daughter loved it she made friends there while we enjoyed the view... and good food.
One of the unique McDonald's where service and quality are consistently good. Drive thru is always quick

Salty's is great!  The service is awesome, really friendly and enthusiastic and completely welcoming to the swarms of tourists like us.
The shrimp appetizer was a bummer, just warm shrimp with old bay floating in a bowl of water.  The water was yucky and distilled the flavor, so these really should be served dry.
The fish and shrimp tacos were both really great and nice and full of seafood. Drink specials were good, and the sour/midori margarita was delicious.
1.5hrs to get to a window..the women are more interested in chatting up up each other about weekend plans more than doing work.

Where do i start with this place!
I love that they have local art on the walls/ always doing art shows 

the staff that works there always rocking smiles talking to all the guess a all around good atmosphere vibe

I tip my hat to the head chef (Chef Ben) The food is always on point and i like when the cooks yell "ORDER UP" hahaha 

I can wright a book about how awesome this place is 

KEEP UP THE GOOD WORK and SEE YOU SOON!

Mmm... just writing this review makes me want to hop in my car and go get one of their new Maple Macchiatos. Layers of sweet and rich... YUMMY!

I digress...

Okay, so a Starbucks is a Starbucks and if you know me I love Starbucks.  I mean I am from Seattle after all ;-)

What I love about this Starbucks -

LOCATION!  I that it's on the corner of Jasper and 109 street and great for people watching and has wall to wall glass windows with three seating areas.  The staff are always friendly and drinks divine.

What I don't love as much about this location -

LOCATION!  Argh, sometimes there is no parking in the guard patrolled lot so you have to wait and wait and wait.  And don't go for a walk across the street or they will ticket you - Yikes!

Also, this is an uber busy location so they do run out of things.  So if you come here with your heart set on a blueberry scone, you might need to have a plan B.

And don't forget to use  registered starbucks card or download the starbucks app on your smart phone to collect stars for every purchase to earn free drinks and treats!  They also have discounts and specials several times a month that you only find out about if you are registered :-)
Trendy and modern atmosphere coupled with souped up classics make this a delicious spot for lunch or dinner. Service was quick and attentive and the food was phenomenal.

Going to BBQ BBQ was one of the most disappointing BBQ comfort food experience I have had in the USA. The only credit I can honestly give them is that the meats were cooked to the proper temperature.

Upon entry to this restaurant, you are not greeted with the delectable smells of slow cooked food... In fact, there was no food aroma at all. Granted I did stop in on a week night but there was no turn over- no flow of customers to generate freshly cooked food aromas.

The "sides" came out luke warm, the Mac and cheese has almost no cheese, and the  ribs certainly didn't have that loving, slow cooked flavor that is the essence of bbq; The corn bread and the garlic mashed potatoes clearly came out of a package. 

Don't waste your time this place, there is no love in this food.

Even though I usually like this place , they rushed us out, salmon Nigiri had scales on it and tasted fishy. I was very
Disappointed.

Shrimp and grits = awesome.
Biscuits and gravy = awesome.
No wait on Saturday afternoon, good service.
Nuff said.

John did a fantastic job.  We just purchased our house and the chimney hadn't been cleaned in years.  It is now pristine.  He also looked over our entire fireplace system (doors, etc.) and made some useful suggestions.  Best of all, he didn't try to upsell me or sell me services that I don't really need.  He also sweeps the chimney from the bottom so all of the soot goes out the top.  He left the area clean as a whistle.  I will definitely have him back next season.

This place blows. I took an out of town guest here. After 10 minutes of no bar service we left. The place was not crowded either. Judging by the clientele I'd say it gets a fairly high douche rating as well

We just stopped in for a quick lunch and it was a very good pizza. I like thin crust and they nailed a perfect thin crunchy crust that was way better than the cracker thin that others in StL use. 
I am knocking off a star due to the lack of value. $20 for a peperoni is a bit crazy.
But I'll go back, hopefully fo dinner so I can enjoy their beer.

Ignore all the negative reviews,  especially from the people who haven't actually eaten there! My husband and I ate there with two other couples and stopped by an hour early to drop off our BYOB, and they were happy to hold our wine and beer while we walked around town. The service was friendly and attentive and the food was so good. We shared many appetizers and a couple of entrees and our bill was still under $100 for 6 people! We will definitely be back and I would highly recommend!

Originally was headed to get food elsewhere but they were fortuitously closed so our group headed here for lunch.  What a great place!  Unpretentious. Super friendly. Absolutely delicious Po boys and drinks. Those bloody Mary's and beer in a large chalice were key.  Katey, our server, was precious. She made this place even more enjoyable! Would highly recommend!

We tried this restaurant after reading the good reviews.  I now realize they must have been written by the staff. Service was mediocre at best. Staff seemed disorganized and lost. I don't think there was a manager on duty. Soup of the day - shrimp corn bisque was very good. Happy hour tacos were tasty. Rice on the  other hand was the worst I've ever had, possibly canned.  Won't be back.

This place is so fun for any age. I take the children I nanny for here all the time And my husband and I came in last week for a date and it was just as much fun. Super colorful and friendly staff. Check out the bathroom too, talk about artistic inspiration!

One word describes this place, the food, and the staff... AWESOME!!!

A bit of a drive but WELL WORTH IT!! 

Food selection has something for everyone along with a full bar..  Great food, great quality, and portions are enough to satisfy.  A comfortable setting, a true Louisiana gem...

I ordered the Tiramisu cake for a friend's bday because he loves tiramisu. These cakes are good if you like buttercream icing, but if not I would try something else. I'm not a fan of buttercream and the cake had so much on it that we had to scrape off an entire plate's worth. Eager to try their other desserts. 
The inside of the shop is like a dream, though! So adorable and gorgeous!
This place is great.  Michelle is the best hostess.  What I really love is all the food combos.   It's amazing!  The beef bulgogi is the bomb!

I love this cozy little boutique hotel. Friendly staff, great breakfast, nice rooms.
We stayed for our 15 year anniversary, the hotel surprised us with a nice card and a bottle of champagne. We will be back soon.
One of the best massages I have ever had! Very relaxing atmosphere and the staff/owner are all very nice. I will definitely go back.

Full disclosure - I have only had Vietnamese food twice in my life and both times have been at Kien Giang.  My total obsession with Anthony Bourdain had me reeling over the fact that I had yet to try Pho.  Thankfully I have a knowledgeable co-worker who could assist in such a travesty of justice and take me to the right place on Charlotte Pike.  I would not have known which of the four or five places to pick as there seems to be a two block ratio that houses the most authentic of Vietnamese places in town.  

I knew I was going to get Pho, there was no question about that.  Instead, the only detail to iron out was which one?  I am an adventuresome eater, of that I have no doubt.  I've eaten a kangaroo filet so I think there is not a lot out there I am not willing to try.  But since I was not certain which way to lean, I went with the Pho Tai.  Again, this was only my second trip so I have nothing to compare this culinary excursion with so I just had to let my taste buds do the judging.

Oh.  My.  Stars.  Rare beef, noodles, bean sprouts, lime juice, basil, jalapenos, and chili oil - you are a party in my mouth!  A delicious mélange of flavors and textures doing some exotic dance that renders me speechless (not just from the flavor, but also the sheer heat of the slick of crushed red pepper oil).  I'm in love.  I think I've found my Vietnamese soul mate in a bowl.  I think I now understand why Anthony Bourdain adores this stuff - it's perfect in its simplicity.  All broths should be this layered in flavors.  This stuff could almost snuff out a need for my anti-depressants!!  It made me THAT happy!

I don't know if I could go there and ever try anything else.  I don't know if I even want to try another place in town.  Pho Tai at Kien Giang is now a part of me.  I will always have a $10 bill tucked in my purse for emergency Pho purposes since they do not take cards.  I will dream of this stuff and sing its praises.  All hail, Kien Giang!

Really looked forward to the meal here. Our server was wonderful and the ambience is fabulous. The kitchen really dropped the ball on a Sunday night. Our food took over 45 minutes to make it to the table. And then they couldn't even get a burger well done. It's not that hard. Completely dissatisfied and won't be coming again. No comps, or even explanations from the kitchen staff or management.

Holy God.....why do I do this to myself? I think maybe its my every 5 year or so excursion to remember I don't want to go to Hell for all the bad things I've done, much less eat there. This place SUCKS. And they aren't nice either. 
I went with a friend who was in from out of town and knew I didn't like this place, but it was close, and, well....I guess I hate my friend?  The steak fajitas were marinated in what I can only gather was napalm and the guacamole was brown.  So, in short, if you have someone you really dislike, do I have a place for you!

Go to a traditional ramen place instead! This place is overrated. I don't get how people love this place. Don't waste your money or time here.

I had the miso ramen and it was sweet! I never had sweet miso broth before. The sweetness drowned out the miso flavor. Even the pork shoulder had a sweet glaze on it that did not appeal to me and I didn't bother to finish the pork shoulder. The noodles were hard, clumped together and I didn't get enough broth with my ramen. Good thing I was very hungry, otherwise I wouldn't have finished eating the miso ramen. 

This place is also expensive for Philly. The miso ramen is $14. This is Philly not NYC. I have paid ~$15 for good ramen in NYC. 

I also had an unimpressive sangria...small glass filled with mostly ice for $10. 

The decorative lights made it feel like it was Christmas. 

I will definitely stick to traditional ramen places.
This place was awesome! The oysters were great along with the Cobia fish and boiled shrimp. And the management was exceptional. We will definitely go back.

We stayed a few blocks from this coffee shop last weekend and stopped in on Sunday morning. I have two words: Latte.Draft. 

It was the most unique coffee drink I've ever had, very light and airy which is hard to imagine for coffee, but trust me, you have to try it! I would come again and everyone should try!

5 dollar meal deal gets you a combo platter with a canned soda.  Need I say much more?  Kind of kept this place a secret from people I knew because I didn't want the line getting any longer at lunchtime.  However, I don't live in Philly anymore so dig in!

Spice lovers.....get the "hot hot" sauce....that is all.

Awesome, seemingly out of the way joint with wickedly good cocktails (get the Jag, it's watermelon heaven) and a unique interior. The crowd was definitely on the younger side (or maybe I'm just old) but a fun time nonetheless.
Typical food selection. Service is great and happy hour even better. $3 drafts. Who can pass that up.

I absolutely love this place. 

My school's end of the year dinner was located at this place and the name rang a bell. After thinking about it more, I realized I have been here before about 5 years ago for a birthday party. At that time, I remember it being delicious and it was something unique because we ate with our hands. Also there were belly dancers there! 

When I went again recently (a week ago), I had an emergency so I had to leave right after. I called the restaurant earlier in the day to let them know I probably would not be able to make it. But the owner insisted I came in to get the food packed. I obliged, and glad I did! 

We had a party of 25 at least, and we all got seated at around 3 huge round tables upstairs. I stayed for the appetizer, which was actually just what I had remembered 5 years ago! And just as delicious. Good to know that some things don't change :) This was just #1 in our 7 course meal that we had gotten as a group. 

I had to leave after this meal and asked for a to-go box. To my surprise, I got 5 boxes to take home. I went back and opened each box. I got plenty of food. I got the chicken, which was marinated so delicious. I also got lamb, which at first I was hesistant about since I don't enjoy lamb particularly, but I don't know what it was, but this lamb was ...differently marinated? cooked differently? I'm not sure what it was, but I kept eating the lamb! It was so good! First time I will say that. 

I also got some desserts- a egg dessert with a pastry covering it, it was something I've never had before, but very delicious. 

And then I topped it off with the dessert, which was a honey, very sweet, dessert- it was delicious, but I couldn't see myself eating too much of it because it was very sweet, but the amount he gave me was perfect. 

I had forgotten about this place, but ever since coming here again, I would definitely think of this place again, especially for big parties. The owner was so nice and gave me such a good amount of food to eat. He was very nice about the whole situation. The variety of food is also just so good. I'll come back again for sure! Hopefully earlier than 5 years :)

Was stoked for this location to open considering Donelson has such limited options in this price range that aren't fast food. Seemed to be hyped up as they trained the staff for weeks before opening. 

I have worked in foodservice my whole life since I was 17 and have never seen such a unprofessional operation. Its simply mind boggling to me that places can be out of nearly half of there menu daily. Also the management, bless there heart, is honestly either untrained or lacking in many departments. Also, waiting for food and hearing young employees discussing there recreational drug use from the previous night is not something I think most hard working people want to hear about on there lunch break.
Fabulous wine and beer selection. Very knowledgeable servers. Great events. I always am happy with whatever new drink I try. Food's pretty good too.

I have been a client of Lisa's for close to 3 years.  Before seeing Lisa I thought I had been taking Pilates classes.  Boy was I wrong!  Lisa is incredibly dedicated to Pilates and is constantly continuing her education and knowledge of the practice.  If you are looking for a beautiful studio with a dedicated instructor who truly cares about your well being then this is the place for you!  Lisa will bring your fitness to a whole new level.

Had dinner here spontaneously with a friend. Well, we knew we were having dinner, we just didn't have any idea where between our hotel and the bar we were ultimately aiming for. When we passed this place on the street, it seemed like the right choice.

And it was.

The food (as I recall, I had the catfish, and nicely strong coffee) was great, as was the service, and we were seated immediately. When two other folks we knew happened in a few minutes later, they had no problem seating us together and keeping a separate tab, and even managed to get all our meals out at nearly the same time.
Great all around. It's downtown so I was expecting a harder time to find close parking but it's in a good corner.

After being told the wait for a table would be over an hour we decided to just get some pastries and coffee to go. Waited 17 minutes for latte... I watched as the girl making the drinks kept making drinks for the tables shoving my to go order to the side. It wasn't until I brought it to their attention and had to show them my receipt that the girl finally made my drink. No one was apologetic. They were just rude and a waste of my time. I will NEVER go back there!

Lately I've been on a taco craze and my fiancé and I have been seeking out all the taco places in the area. This one had been on the list for awhile but since it's a small food truck in the parking lot of a "questionable" night club I haven't wanted to venture there on my own. Tonight we were hungry and decided to go for a late night snack. There was a man and a women on the truck, she was taking orders and he was cooking. Very nice people, didn't speak a lot of English but spoke enough. They have 3 or 4 small tables to sit at and eat but we got ours Togo. We got the 4 taco special to share. 2 shrimp and 2 steak tacos- comes with cilantro, onions and cheese On your choice of flour or corn tortilla. We prefer flour. 8 bucks. Then we got a small quesadilla 4 bucks. Chicken and cheese quesadilla was super delish! Cheese was perfectly melted and the tortilla was nicely browned, a lot of meat! Also cilantro but we opted for no onion on the quesadilla. They also have us limes and 2 sauces- a red and a green. Salsa verde and a spicy red salsa-ish sauce. Both very good! Shrimp taco was very tasty with about 5 small shrimp on each and the steak melted in your mouth! We will definitely be back to try the chorizo quesadilla and the other tacos!

Figured it was time for yet another update.  After taking some time off I've starting going back to Alfredo's.  The one thing that hasn't changed is how wonderful you're treated.  While I can't imagine the owner actually remembers every person that's been in, he'll always make you feel like he does.  They did have one slip up and gave me the wrong item but they more than made up for it once I called.  The last few visits have resulted in the same delicious pizza I spoke of in my original review.  Let's just chalk up that phase in the middle to a few hiccups that seem to have been corrected.  Thanks Alfredo, you're part of the family once more!

Changed their menu since I was there last, and regrettably did away with my favorite menu item... The puntas. I had the parillada tonight which is essentially fajitas without the tortillas, which was strange. Needless to say, I ordered a side of tortillas. I liked that they had a veggie option of saitan for an extra $1.50, but also found it strange that the default meat for the dish was beef but if you wanted chicken it was an also an extra $1.50! Not that it's necessarily gone downhill over the years, but it has definitely changed... Just not sure yet if it's for the better. Love the BYOB thing though!
The food was delicious! It was a little cramped but the place has a ton of character in a cute neighborhood. I'd come back for sure.

Showed up at exactly 6:00 pm (according to time on mobile) and "sorry we are closed". 
I mean exactly. 
Then they told me I could transfer my prescription to Prytania. 
Not what I'd call good customer service.
Service was slow. Not all sides ordered were delivered. Ordered brisket but wasn't informed that they were out until the others at the table received their food.

Good food but a bit pricey and no lunch sized portion option.  I'm a pretty big eater, but I could only do lunch here if I took a co-worker and we split one meal between the two of us. I'm a fan of large portions but at almost $12.00 for lunch with a drink, where you either throw 75% of the meal away or you need a person to share it with...no thanks.  I suggested a lunch sized (and priced) option on a couple of occasions when I was there, but it seems to have fallen upon deaf ears. I bet a lunch menu would pick up their lunch time business dramatically. I know I wanted to go several times at lunch but without anyone else to split the meal I was stuck going somewhere else.

No complaints about this place! My group ordered pork/shrimp & shrimp spring rolls, beef "tacos" (which are really steamed buns), a banh mi, and chicken bun. My favorites were the beef steamed bun and banh mi! The bread was perfect. The service was fast and efficient. I definitely suggest giving this place a try!!!

Lucy's is.. good. Not great, not bad, just good. If you are looking for a happy hour spot, this is the place. The food has never been that great to me and the service in the restaurant has never been a stellar experience for me.  It's loud so don't expect to have a conversation but its a fun time and a great post saints game hangout.

We had a great experience here. We got a super good deal on our room (which turned out to be a suite!) thanks to their military discount, so that was very appreciated. All of the employees we talked to, from the valet guys to the front desk staff to who I'm assuming was the manager were super courteous and helpful. The best part of our whole one-night stay was the fact that they had a free happy hour going on! Three free drinks per person and the very sweet bartender was not shy with the alcohol. Plus, there was food - Nachos, veggies and dip, salad, hot dogs, baked potatoes, and pasta with meatballs! We didn't partake of the food because we were headed out to dinner but it looked really good. And the free hot breakfast in the morning was really yummy! My only complaint about breakfast was that they were packing it up by ten... We barely made it before they started to close it down. 

The hotel is a short walk from the French Quarter and the Superdome, and it's right in the CBD. Plus all the included perks really help offset the cost of the room. All in all I would highly, highly recommend staying here!
The New York atmosphere is neat, and the pizza is very good, but the service is always really slow, especially on Lightning game days.

I was really excited to try this place since it's the first place I've heard of that has boba, Thai rolled ice cream, and crepes. It's about a 15 minute drive from USF campus and the GPS doesn't take you to the exact location which is within a large shopping plaza next to Aldi's market. 

There weren't that many flavors of boba besides the staple flavors. I opted to try was the galaxy tea which came in four flavors: Passionfruit, mango, strawberry, and lychee. It comes in a plastic light bulb cup and has basil seeds already included. The drink tasted similar to lemonade and was very sweet (most likely because I chose passion fruit). It was interesting to taste but I wouldn't order it again. The crepe menu has about 8 options you can choose from sweet or savory concoctions. I ordered the fruit crepe that had blueberries, strawberries, bananas, and kiwi. I was really disappointed that my crepe was cold when I got it and the filling was mediocre. The fruits were fresh but the crepe itself was chewy and bland so It wasn't enjoyable to eat. 

Overall, I feel like this place has potential if they were to improve the quality of the crepe and had a larger drink selection.

Very busy mall location.  Service people are great, and they do manage to get the customers in and out as quickly as possible.  I've stood in line outside in the hall several times.  Good thing I'm a coffee junkie :-)

Food is always stellar. Civili is owner/proprietor. Great service and great atmosphere. It's a let down for me going into an ethnic restaurant and hearing local radio stations. I like to be immersed in the culture. They play traditional and modern Thai music over the sound system! Best Thai tea in town! Ask about their rewards program for repeat customers.

The wait for inside seating is always going to be super packed on a Saturday but I'd suggest opting to take the food to-go to eat on the outdoor benches, assuming that you're not afraid of birds! Those seagulls can be pretty vicious...(I'm terrified of birds so thank goodness we found a little bench off to the side of the restaurant safe from those monstrous creatures..)

My boyfriend and I wanted to grab a snack and try something from this famous restaurant. The rock crab seems to be the house favorite but we wanted something more than just crab so we opted for the cioppino in a bread bowl ($18.95). 

We expected it to come with all the seafood out of their shells. Boy, were we terribly wrong! It literally came with a leg of rock crab, and mussels and clams in their shells. At least the shrimp was ready to eat. Thus, it was a bit hard to eat the bowl but still delicious. The bread bowl itself was a little stale but still yummy once drenched in the sauce.

I'd be back to try the lobster tacos and maybe the rock crab once I'm in the mood!

I've been here a few times, for both lunch and dinner. The wait is usually minimal if you don't have an extremely large group and the service is good. They offer a nice variety of rolls and nigiri. It's definitely at the top of my list when I'm in the mood for sushi.

I'm all about supporting local business, particularly when that business is owned/operated by a true craftsman. Toby seems to be that person, and seems to be extremely knowledgable. Unfortunately, the boots I took for him to polish ended up costing me $20 and a couple hours of working on them when I got home! How embarrassing, right? Merely polishing a leather shoe should be easy, but it looked like he had smeared polish hap-hazardly (not sparing the gold-toned hardware) and sent me home with streaked boots that weren't done. So, lesson learned... If you have a terrible, difficult problem, he's your guy. If you just want a really beautifully polished shoe, buy the supplies and do it yourself.

this is the worst establishment ever to exist. there is never anybody to help you find anything, the store is unorganized and smells bad, and the worst of all is the checkout line. the line is not even long, but they find a way for it to take about 30 minutes. this is not an exaggeration. take the time to drive somewhere else it will be worth it i promise. i wish there was a zero star option.
Have ate here the last 3 Saturday's and each time we have really enjoyed our meals ! Highly recommend this place .

We'll I'm not a really big fan of fancy pizza like this. I got a pizza with no cheese and one with only cheese. I really wished I got one with both . We sat right in front of the oven watching them cook.  I don't think they enjoy people watching them, I wouldn't. Our waiter was really slow and when he  went to get a box for the rest of our pizza took forever and when we saw him he had to ask him for it. I guess he forgot about it. Then we ordered dessert which was the Nutella pizza. It tasted like Nutella and toast which wasn't very exciting but what else is there to expect. It's also supposed to have marshmallows on it but it barely had any. Overall I left unsatisfied.

Admittedly, I am not a fan of hot dogs. What I am, however, is a french fry nut, and Hot Diggity clearly knows how to worm their way into my heart. Belgian-style in nature (i.e. thicker, twice-fried), the fries themselves are full bodied and have a rich potato flavor. They also arrive in a sturdy paper cone that fits neatly into the holes carved into your tables for that specific purpose. In my uber-opinionated mind, what truly distinguishes Hot Diggity from most other establishments are the array of dipping sauces they offer. They fall under the "gourmet" moniker with fancy "aiolis" and "rosemary"-ies and such and such. I highly demand you try the new ginger and curry flavors. They're about $0.25/ea, although I might be off by a dime.

This is a new joint (ca. June 18th 2011) and apparently they're at the tail-end of the process of obtaining a beer license, with plans to serve local craft brews. None better than beer and fries (and hot dogs, if that's your thing).

OK, I've only been a Yelper since March, and forgot to write a review of the Peppermill, so here goes!

I began visiting almost a decade ago, at the advice of some friends, when I was still living in Florida.  Gotta admit that all the casino's neon, velour panels, and overall unique decor provide a definite sensory overload that keeps you playing.  Little did I know that the rooms were decorated in a similar fashion back in the day before they constructed the Tuscany Tower, and remodeled the Peppermill Tower, until my first stay in a Spa Suite back in 2005.  To be totally honest, I kinda miss that old decor, along with the old casino planet carpet.  Those things just made the place.  It was like a cross between old-skool Vegas and the set of some adult movie.  To this day, the older black jacuzzi tubs in the Peppermill Tower rooms still have to be the best I've ever encountered in a hotel room or suite.  They're identical to an outdoor setup, with huge, powerful jets, and can easily fit 2 people.  No weak "jetted tub" - these things are real Jacuzzis!  The in-room steam showers rock too, although some have been deactivated, or are no longer working.

I've had several awesome stays over the years, in several different room and suite types in both towers, but have not yet tried the North and West Wings (previously known as the Annex and Montego Bay rooms.)  Locals get awesome weekly free play and food discounts with minimal play.  The Café Milano (previously the Coffee Shop) has always been great, and the Island Buffet is good, although a bit pricey (see separate reviews.)

My only reasons for not giving it a 5 star rating:

1. The Passport Club has many perks, and has improved greatly over the years with new promotions and comp multiplier days.  However, after visiting literally every casino in town and being a member of literally every player's club, both as a local and a visitor, the Passport Club seems to still be one of the slowest as far as advancing tier levels goes.  I stayed a Purple member for close to seven years, and finally got bumped up to Bronze, but I think it was done only as a courtesy, because there was a timeframe when I didn't play there for a good couple of years.  There were a couple of occasions back in the day when I held Bronze status, used some comp dollars to pay for room and food bills, only to discover my points were completely erased and I had been bumped back down to Purple.  The same scenario has happened with a lot of people I've talked to.

2.  I've had some customer service and booking related issues over the years, but they've gotten a lot better.  It seems like there were major problems at one point with lost reservations, bad attitudes, overbooking, and customers getting bumped out of their desired room types for a while, but the online checkin system they invented seemed to alleviate that.  I had the chance to meet David Fuller, who I believe is in the hotel operations division, last summer, and it's good seeing there's higher-ups over there that actually care about their business - and even these Yelp/TripAdvisor reviews!  Most other properties in town don't even look at them, much less respond and try to make things right if there's a problem.  The self check-in kiosks in the lobby are often not working.

3.  It was a bit unique and infuriating, but I unfortunately had an incident in the casino a few years ago, where someone left about $100 in credits in a particular machine.  Me, being the machine jumper that I am, didn't notice, as I had been playing for almost 9 hours that day.  Anyhow, I stuck my ticket in this particular machine, played it for a bit, cashed out, moved to another machine, and the next thing you know, I'm surrounded by three security guards, treating me like a criminal, with an accusation that I up and out stole money and was forced to pay it back on the spot to avoid having the police being called.  Meanwhile, the 90 year old white hair on the Hoveround, who "accidentally" left her credits in that machine, sat in the background and laughed!  (Note to lady:  I now keep thumbtacks and nails in my pockets that I accidentally-on-purpose drop on the floor for pains-in-the-asses such as yourself to run over!!!!)  Nope, she didn't have the decency to scoot up and say, "Hey, I accidentally left my credits in your machine" - she had to go ratting me out to security and making things difficult.  I wasn't banned from playing in the casino, but a note was left on my Passport account that I was warned, and forced to pay back credits.  Hopefully a one-off situation that I'm hoping won't happen again!

All in all, old decor or new, the Peppermill is a great, unique place.  They take pride in advertising slot machines with higher payback percentages than the norm, and I've won thousands here.  Give the kiosk of Blazing Sevens in front of the Peppermill Tower elevators/stairs a try, they fire like mad.  Just watch out for the little old ladies on Hoverounds!

Good god I love you Mazzaro's. Sandwiches are always awesome, prepped food ready to be taken home, fresh bread, meat, cheese, gelato... 

The people who work here are awesome, the parking can get crazy, and be prepared for a little bit of a wait if you end up there during the lunch rush. The chicken parm sandwich is worth it though!
I wasted 7 bucks on a meal I thought was going to be awesome. The fried chicken was stale and tasteless. They had no more wings only drums. At 4pm?! come on. The fries were old. I'm done SMH
Best KOREAN I have ever had!! Even better than Los Angeles KOREAN restaurants! YUM!!!

The fiesta buffet is always really good! We typically go on Seafood Thursday it is really important to get their early or else you are standing in line for 30+ mins to get a seat.  However, when you get it the staff never make you feel rushed and allow you to get you $30 worth of food.

This is an update from my previous review. Nordstrom invited us back for a complementary meal! We gave it another shot! For lunch we ordered the french dip sandwich and my aunt ordered a salad. I'm allergic to dairy so we took a few things off the sandwich but the server was very accommodating and the food was good. We had fresh coffee - yay!!  We had chocolate cake for dessert and
it was so yummy the cake was the best part of the meal. The food did take a little longer than expected but we were not in a hurry so it was all good. I will definitely be back.
The original "Habit".  The best damn burger I've ever had...I dare anyone to challenge this statement.  The only reason I try to make my commute pass through Santa Barbara...

There is not much more to say about Oh Yoko that has not already been said. It's a really cute restaurant, with attentive friendly service, and delicious Sushi. The tuna flower appetizer was really good. It was served with a sweet slaw that was delicious. The sushi cuts were beautiful and impressive. The white tuna melted in my mouth, as did the fluke which blew me away! Fluke, who knew?! I had way too much beer with me so I poured a couple glasses for the chefs who were very appreciative, I was glad they could hang with my Double IPA. Overall I was very impressed with the place, including the Yelp certificate in the Men's room! The only reason I did not give them 5 stars is that they are a lot pricier than my old standby a mile down the road. I will be back for sure.

Where do I start? The initial cleanup was back in December and they did a half ass job putting a humidifier. I called in January and February to find out about part 2. In march I found out it was still wet and started to smell so bad I was throwing up. They came out and determined they needed to put another humidifier in. Now on to part 2. The original guy was fired so I was lost in the sauce. They finally sent someone out that said I would have it done the next Monday morning. No one showed. When I called he said I needed to pay them everything first before they came out. Unusual but ok you never said this before. I paid and then the following week someone came out. Mind you this is May by now. They came out did a half ass job and I told them I was unhappy. I would not sign a finished work order until they fixed it. He told me 3x someone would call me back. I called last Wednesday and he said he would call me Thursday to schedule. I called him today a week later and told them they need to be here by Monday. They stained my carpet and stained my chimney and never cleaned up. I'm filing a bbb complaint as well!

Update* guy comes today and in the middle of us talking he interrupts me talking to take a phone call from another customer. Steps outside and gives me the one finger like hold on. How unprofessional! At this point it's like I'm bothering him more than he is supposed to be here helping the situation

Update** you guys say refer to your sister company but your sister company doesn't have a yelp page for reviews or contact. Could this possibly be the reason why those of us with bad reviews post here? Smh this is ridiculous
Food is really good Cajun shrimp is my favorite. Also the avocado and taro smoothies are amazing

This modest French bakery won us over during our trip to St. Pete's beach. Initially we stopped in for a cappuccino and a latte on our way to Siesta Key. Which is to say, our stop here began as an afterthought, but we were feeling a little peckish so we got the cherry cheese plait (a danish) to go. It was seriously just the right amounts of crispy and moist, indicating that it was very fresh. It's maybe two weeks later now, and just thinking about it I'm still like MMM. The cheese was creamy and sweet and MMM. On the espresso front: nice and smooth.
