We hadta come back the next two days. Among the things we tried were a grilled croissant and a lox/cucumber sandwich (and 12 more cheese cherry plaits give or take). They're very keen on customer service -- every time drinks and food were brought out to us. At first we just kind of loitered around, but they made it known that it was no big deal and they'd find us. So, we enjoyed the Florida sun while sitting out front. They have a few tables/chairs for those of us that want to get as much of that as possible (before having to sadly fly back to this on-again-off-again DC winter).

So I've never been to France, and maybe it's sacrilegious to compare any cafe that's not in France to a French cafe in France. But man. This place is good.
The food was good considering the location, however the wait time was over an hour. Four two adults and two children we spent over $100.. I think it's too much for this little restaurant.

One of the BEST meals I've ever had in my life!!!!  Got combo, and I'm still in awe at how much I enjoyed every single thing on my plate. Service was so great and friendly, while providing food "orientation!" If I lived closer, I'd be a regular; maybe I still will be!

My husband and I came here for the first time and had no idea what we were walking into. Although the lady at the register was not much help, we soon found that we didn't need it. The menu was very self explanatory. I ordered the breakfast bowl and substituted the rice/quinoa for broccoli and it was far better than what I expected! My husband ordered the stir fry bowl, he said it was delicious but the portion seemed a little small for $10. Overall we were pleased with our experience and it's a great place to come, especially if you are trying to eat healthy :)

Stopped in for lunch with coworkers on a Thursday. Place looked moderately busy. The menu looks great offering breakfast all day and your typical lunch items. There is also a decent dessert menu. Only street parking is available. We waited almost 20 minutes before someone took our order. Our waitress was slow but the food was decent. As I was waiting to pay, I commented on the assorted desserts they had displayed behind the glass. A staff member was very generous as to offer me one on the house. I had to refuse (watching my diet haha). Items were priced okay.

I just paid $32.00 for the "Uptown Wash" I observed the men as they were drying off the vehicles and noticed that they were all moving in slow motion.  The cars were backing up so they began to cut corners.  This should have been my first clue.

I  received my vehicle and quickly left as I was en route to an appointment.  As I was driving down Tchoupitoulas St.  I noticed that the interior of the vehicle had not been touched.  I then noticed that the windows on the interior had not been cleaned.  

Obviously I could return to the car wash and risk missing my appointment.  The point is that I should not have to return to the car wash.  Management needs to put someone in place  to monitor the actions of the employees and ensure that each vehicle receives proper attention.

We absolutely love this place. The Pho is DELICIOUS, the accompaniments are plentiful and fresh, service is prompt and friendly, the restaurant is clean, and it is very affordable. Yes, it is cash-only, but coming from someone who truly never carries cash, it's worth making a stop at an ATM.
Four of us, four different meals for lunch.  3 of us flexitarians, 1 a meat eater.  We ALL loves our meals.  Food was fresh and flavorful.  Can't wait to go back!

Comfort Food in a comfortable setting.  This is sort of like a more interesting version of a hometown diner; the kind of place where friendly people from the community meet and eat BUT where the food ranges from great cheeseseaks to homemade pasta, grilled veggies and Asian delicacies.  The specials are always changing and so creative and tasty. I never order off the menu and usually ask Misha, the delightful owner/chef,  to make me whatever she likes. It is always a wonderful surprise. Try the homemade dumplings for lunch. For breakfast, pancakes are the best around. Call ahead to order if you are in a rush. This place is busy; especially around lunchtime.  Or take it outside and sit at the tables on the sidewalk for a moving portrait of small town Americana.

Sorry City Fitness, but I have to downgrade you a star.  The facility is fine, and the staff is nice, but they are driving me crazy with the class schedule.  First, there are a lot of classes that are offered during the day when most of the people that live in this neighborhood are at work.  For those of us that want to work out on the morning, there are very few options for classes.  Given that, when I do show up for a morning class I expect to have the class.  I have gone there at least 4 times for a class only to find out that the class was cancelled.  This morning in particular, there were about 10 of us in the group exercise room all set up for body pump, only to find out that the instructor overslept.  They have to come up with some kind of system to alert people to cancelled classes if someone is sick or something at the last minute, but otherwise I don't understand why the classes aren't running.  They've been open over a month, and the class schedule has been the same the whole time.  I will say that the Monday morning spin class always runs, but I think that's the only class I've ever gotten to do in the morning, and I'm not the only one.  Everyone there this morning was extremely frustrated because it keeps happening.  I'll happily update again if they get their act together, but for now this is unacceptable.

Butter's catered my grandmothers repass yesterday. Kevin was very professional and delivered as promised. We found Butter's online, as we are from Brooklyn, NY. Upon arriving at the repass, all the food was set up properly with linens, drinks, and utensils. We didn't have to do anything. The food was great as well! We ordered fried chicken, baked chicken, Mac and cheese, collard greens, string beans, African rice and salad. If in Philly again, I will stop in and dine.

Burger was lame.  Crinkle fries undercooked and tasteless.

Damn good shake though.  Waaay over priced

Love this place since my first time here 2 months ago. Menu is easy to navigate, service is wonderful and prompt( however I've only been here during the middle of the night when barely to no one else is here), food is delicious, overall just wonderful. If there is anything I am not too happy about, it's that I always go home smelling like burnt charcoal, but I guess that's not something that can be changed. Thankfully I always go home right afterwards so I can shower immediately.

Looking forward to being of age soon so I can pay visits to their bar, usually sounds lively in there when I'm having a post midnight meal.

This is our go to wing place. Been there 100 times and never had food that disappointed. Always fresh crispy saucy piping hot delicious wings and sides. Try the onion rings too! Don't let the divey style of the place deter you... It's just super casual they aren't focused on the building they are all about thier food and service.

Great lunch deals on weekdays. I got this lunch combo for $7.50.  A choice of entree, soup, an egg roll, a piece of fruit and  salad.     I don't think any other restaurant can beat this deal. Food and service was good.

I recently wrote a less than stellar review of this spa.  Less than 24 hours after my posting I had a call from the Assistant Manager.  He was very sorry my experience was not wonderful. He refunded me for my pricey lunch and offered to give me 20% off any future services at any of their locations.

That is some excellent customer service!!!

We ended up eating here for lunch after a friend suggested Pappy's a few blocks away. Pappy's had a line and we found the Fountain. 

It has an awesome decor and ambiance. There is plenty to look at while you wait. 

The staff was really nice. The food was really good. We each had a sandwich and they were both super good. The potato chips were awesome and so was the Dill pickle soup. 

The milk shake we had was great. We got a pretzel cone to go. The cone was okay, too crumbly and hard to eat, but the salty sweet flavor was good. 

If this place was in San Diego I would go here all the time. I will definitely suggest it to anyone I know that will be visiting St. Louis.

Great alternative to GRB or Beijing Beijing. We come here for dim sum at least once a month.  The service is great and the dim sum is delicious.  The pricing may be more than dim sum restaurants in Chinatown, BUT it's Chinatown, if you catch my drift.  Haven't tried this place for dinner though.

Jenny created the bouquets and boutonnieres for my wedding in April and they were absolutely beautiful! I don't know a lot about flowers so I was nervous about making sure I chose the right thing, but with very little direction from me, she put me at ease that she would create something amazing within my budget. She was always very responsive during the planning process and made the experience a breeze. I was also able to order flowers through Jenny to put together my own centerpieces. The flowers we received were so fresh and beautiful that the centerpieces stayed nice for a really long time. I would highly recommend Jenny!
Ordered mozzarella sticks and a small cheese pizza via delivery. Driver did not speak English. Food was okay until I discovered 2 hairs in my pizza that were baked into it. Will not eat here again.

Lousy service, crap food and$21 for four shrimp...  And they are find with that when i talked to them about it.. I didn't even eat half

Garbage
El Camino is my absolute favorite spot in the city! They have great food and drinks and the atmosphere is hard to beat!

I'm the duchess! Chao roll is bomb diggity dawg! I've had like a hundo check ins. Plus free sush on your bday is totally rad. And free beer and sushi mid week is nuts and balls! Super awesome! Grub here.
Excellent tour. Brian the tour guide was great, knowledgeable, courteous and hysterical. The man knows his New Orleans ghost stories and loves his parades! A+++

Understaffed for brunch the Sunday after gasparilla. It took 30 minutes to get a Bloody Mary after I ordered it. People who came later got their drink first. The food took forever and was not worth the wait. A simple brunch took 3 hours since they were slow. Only reason this is getting a 2 was due to the manager comping our group for all the problems.

First, this place is right on the road, second, the staff is not the best (waited for 15 minutes without even being acknowledged and only one person working the desk - then finally got to the desk and the idiot got on the phone). A little customer service 101 would go a long way. Secondly, the rooms are super old and musty, although they are clean. Finally, the price is ridiculous for this quality. Not bad if you want a motel quality place, but for the price, I would rather stay at even a holiday inn.

Banana Foster French Toast and Pulled Pork Benedict. Amazing. Quaint place in Garden District. All the food is great as are the juices. I would highly recommend this spot as the best place to grab breakfast before a walk down Magazine.

Holy yum yum! I went in here after hearing about all the hype good and bad. I have to say it lives up to all the good hype I'm not sure what folks were complaining about but it was great. I had the Bart's revenge a regular old cake donut and a Gooey Butter donut all were superb! What can you say there was gooey butter crumbles on my donut with vanilla icing it was top notch! They but butterfinger on a donut that's awesome. Plainly put its a great donut shop they will have something for you and everyone in the family. Staff was super friendly and funny. All around great experience I will be back.
Awesome practice!!!! They are like a machine, all moving parts move perfectly!! You never wait very long and doctors give you as much time as you need!!!

I feel obliged to update my thoughts about this restaurant, given that I switched to a whole food-plant based diet (vegan) over a month ago, and I must say, I've found no better Indian restaurant for vegans and vegetarians (or overall for non-veg) than India Sizzling 2!  Actually, I am now keenly aware of the fact that this city does not really have a good restaurant with lots of wholesome vegan cuisine options (there are snack and junk food vegan options but not many places with actually healthy and complete meals).

Everyday, you'll find vegan options such as rasam (a tomato and garlic soup) sambar (a traditional thick soup with lots of veggies and healthy spices), puriyal (a south Indian cabbage/veggie stir fry), veg manchurian (an Indo-chinese sweet/spicy deep fried veggie dish) and much more Tuesday-Sunday. 

If you are a vegetarian or vegan, you have nowhere else to go for awesome Indian food, since Spice Nation (formerly Udupi) closed years ago, than to this South Indian gem on Lafayette road! 
:-)

West Ave Grill, or WAG for short was a wonderful stop for a brunch with some pals.  Upon entering we were greeted with a warm smile from Rene. She was extremely attentive during our stay. I ordered the buffalo chicken eggs benedict- WOWZERS that was a first class trip to flavor town. ALL ABOARD!! Will definitely becoming back soon xoxox
Prices, service and food are top of the line! I love going to BJs. Their pizza especially is very good.

This was the most helpful and least painful dress shopping experience that I had during the wedding planning process!

After lots of online browsing, pinterest-ing, etc., I made appointments for my 'maids and I to visit a few shops that carried the styles and color of dresses we had narrowed it down to. Most bridal shops treated us as second class citizens and couldn't be bothered to help us (even with an appointment!) since we were there for bridesmaid dresses and not a wedding dress. But not Bella! TGFB. Thank God for Bella!

We arrived a little early (since the previous place was a total, unhelpful bust) and were told to come back at our appointment time.  No big deal, go next door to Taziki's for a glass of wine! It's a tiny shop and there isn't much room to wait - which is great once you're up since all the attention is on your group! 

The staff was 100% focused on us and had already pulled the styles I had mentioned when I made the appointment.  Since we were the only ones in there, we had total reign of the multiple dressing rooms, so everyone could try things on at the same time, which was really helpful for comparisons and to speed the process along. The staff also seemed genuinely interested in helping us find flattering/comfortable dresses for each person. They offered their honest opinions and didn't seem to be pushing us into a sale or into the most expensive dresses. (There's nothing I hate more than being told by a salesperson that I look amazing and need to buy something when I clearly look like a stuffed sausage)

The only minor negative thing was that since it's a small shop, the color selection was a bit limited.  They had the styles we wanted to see, but only one was in our color.  Anything could be ordered, but beware if you're planning to see the actual dress in your actual color.  PRO TIP: I ordered swatches from the designer I knew I wanted before going, so I already knew what the color would look like on each different fabric texture. 

Bella was great throughout the whole process, including ordering and picking up.  They send reminder emails and give you a suggested ordering deadline based on your date, but were flexible when we needed to extend that a bit, woops. The dresses came in earlier than estimated and we had no issues. They don't do alterations, but did recommend someone if we needed it (we didn't use them, so I can't vouch for their rec).

All in all, a very positive experience!

I am really overwhelmed by the amount of frozen yogurt shops that are springing up everywhere (especially between Broadway and West End - yikes!). I do love my fro-yo, but sometimes I need a some real ice cream in my life. (Especially with the growing prices of self-serve yogurt, non-identifiable soft serve, and other 'yogurt like' desserts that can't even be called yogurt.. sheesh!)

What brings me back to Mike's is their delicious red velvet cake ice cream. It is full of pieces of real red velvet cake AND cream cheese frosting pieces. DELICIOUS! I don't mind throwing a quarter into a parking meter so I can run in to Mike's and pick up a single scoop. It is totally worth it.

I'll preface with the "there's no shame in getting three stars" caveat. I had brunch at Home Wine Kitchen this morning and it was A-OK. Not knock-your-socks off good, but not bad either. 

We went after noon, so there was no trouble finding a seat. We opted for a high-top table, and I thought it was plenty comfortable. 

My friend wanted a Bloody Mary, but nothing too spicy. They only serve their house mix, which our server warned would probably be on the peppier side. Grateful for the warning, my friend asked if they served fresh-squeezed orange juice. No. But they are working on it, so that's nice to know. 

It would be nice if the brunch menu listed out some more beverage options than just the mimosa or bloody mary. Do you have lattes or just coffee? Juice? Sodas? 

For a starter, we had the cinnamon bread. The topping was lovely and had a great flavor, but the bread itself was just ok. For entrees, I had the eggs benedict and my friend went with the steak and eggs. 

The eggs benedict: 3.5 stars. The eggs were poached perfectly. I liked the crispy spinach and the buttered ciabatta or whatever toasty bread they put everything on. It came with a deceptive amount of prosciutto. I really liked it, but at the end I had a big pile of it left over. I was not a fan of the brown butter hollandaise. It didn't look appealing the way it was squirted on the dish and I wasn't crazy about the flavor. There was something spicy that kind of turned me off. But on the whole -- it is a solid dish. 

I can't comment on the steak and eggs, as I only tried a little piece of the carpaccio. My friend enjoyed it. 

I felt the portions were generous for the price. The service was excellent. My coffee and water were always full. Also, those little clear jars for the sugar are a nice touch. 

All that said, I don't think this is somewhere I would think to come back to when I'm craving brunch. Everything was fine and good, but nothing really stood out to be crave-worthy. 

I'm going to give them a try for dinner, which is where I'm sure their biggest strengths lie.

Just an update, my husband left a message for the owner after speaking with the owners wife.  The owner did not return the call so my husband called again - who was then told by the owner, "I looked at the notes and chose not to call you" very easy to understand where the management staff has learned unprofessional behavior.

My boyfriend and I just moved to Tampa and are really enjoying our new home just off Bayshore Blvd but seeing all of the happy looking bikers enjoying the breeze as they cruised by us as we walked in the hot sun made us decide that some new bikes were definitely in order right away! 

He called the shop a day before we visited and the salesman who answered was wonderful: asking a few lifestyle needs related questions and then recommending that we consider Electra brand bikes for our relatively simple needs and modest budget for this spur of the moment purchase. 

We researched them online and found that consumers love the classic design of the one speed cruisers, high quality construction including patented flat foot operation making frequent city stopping and starting easy plus their very low maintenance requirements. Sounds good! 

When we arrived the next day, Bill greeted us promptly and showed us to the requested bikes right away while sharing some general features and benefits of this brand and reinforced our initial positive feelings about Flying Fish Bike Shop as well as the bikes we thought we wanted to purchase. 

He welcomed us to take a test drive so we each made a selection of color and style and after he carefully adjusted the seat and handlebar heights, we took them for a 10 min spin around the quiet residential neighborhood behind the bike shop, perfect for getting a good feel before making a purchase. 

My bf loved his choice right away, but I did not find mine to be comfortable at first, so Bill adjusted the seat height again that was much better but a beautiful 3 speed lilac colored "Townie" model had caught my eye when we first arrived and while it was significantly more expensive than the simple one speed cruiser, I wanted to take it for a spin just to see and I LOVED IT! It was perfectly comfortable and operated exactly as I had hoped, so the decision was made. 

Two bikes, lights for front and back, a basket and bell for mine, a bike lock for both etc and the team in the back of the shop worked quickly to get the bikes customized for us as we paid up all the while learning about incredible riding trails and local bike events - even monthly pub and restaurant crawls - and then rode them home. 


Buying local is important to me and the selection and service was top notch here. You get what you pay for and more and your purchase also includes a free tune up a month or so after owning your bike plus a warranty on top of the manufacturer's warranty. 

When you are in need of a bike or accessories, even just some valuable free bike related advice, this is a great place to check out!

The Clearwater area has been in dire need for a sushi spot like this!

This restaurant offers an excellent all you can eat sushi and hibachi menu along with plenty of appetizers and soups to choose from. For dinner the price is very reasonable at $17.95 per person and kids 4-8 are only $4.99! Can you even get a happy meal for that price? Our daughter loves sushi and Chicken Teriyaki so she was in heaven. If you aren't into sushi that's ok as you can choose from a wide array of dinner items. 

Please note this is not a buffet style place like many other places in the area. You place your order from the menu they give you and then they make the items for you and bring them out. This is better as you know they are making it fresh for you and it hasn't been sitting on some warmer exposed to the public with a chance of people breathing all over it.

We went on a Monday night around 6:30 and it was nice and quiet as we were the only ones in the restaurant. The inside is very nicely decorated and doesn't quite feel like a Japanese restaurant with the tasteful decor they have.

We had a few of the rolls on the menu including Spicy Tuna and Salmon rolls along with a Mexican roll off of the standard rolls menu. Each one was amazing and you could tell everything was fresh as it melted in your mouth and the fish had no smell whatsoever. The spicy rolls are not really spicy so if you like it hot ask for it Extra Spicy to kick it up a notch.

Where the good rolls are at is in the Signature Rolls section which is included in the menu. I know some other places in Pinellas County where they charge you extra for these. We had a large variety including The Hawaii, Rainbow, Dancing Krab, Green Sarabay, Saki, Volcano and the Crunchy 2 in 1. Wow that sounds like a lot! Our favorite by far was the Volcano which was baked and topped with Krab and spicy mayo. I'm not usually a fan of cooked rolls but this was amazing. Another to recommend is the Crunchy 2 in 1. Our goal is to try every roll they have as the menu is quite extensive.

Make sure to only order what you know you will eat as they will charge you for any pieces you leave up to .75 per piece I believe.

The server was always smiling and very courteous and made us feel welcomed. By the time we left, the restaurant was starting to fill up.

This is definitely a place to try if you are into sushi and looking for an all you can eat option. The sushi is actually better than other places in the area that don't off the AYCE option.

Dont know what else to say. 5 stars baby...good as it gets for me. We came like homeless people, after a rain soaked first Friday of Jazzfest this year, dying for some food. Got the shrimp platter....they didnt miss a beat. Enjoyed it so much we came back when we were visiting family in Gretna a couple weeks ago. Shrimp poboy for me this time around and they passed that test with a 100%. I posted the pic on facebook and it got raving reviews on there, so I will share my joy with all you yelpers so that you do not miss out on this gift from the heavens. Take one look, one bite and then write your 5 star review.

If you are a fan of Collingswood restaurants this is one to try. You are not going to get a particularly bad meal but maybe just not the best meal. They need to work on being a little more memorable. I do think its worth a try and you should form your own opinion on this one.
The reason I gave them 3 stars was because I tasted more bread than fillings in my sandwich. I got the Westside Turkey Club and felt there could have been a little more turkey in there. I do not like when restaurants pack the meat in there either but there was just one weak layer. From the little turkey I had it was tender and tasty. The raisin bread was really good but I think it would have been better if it were toasted. 
We ordered desert, we were handed a desert menu with no prices. I got the flourless chocolate tort, my friend got the fruit compote. Of course I ate all mine, lol, although it was just maybe a little dry or something not all together great. She liked hers.
Now the shock! When we got the bill I was curious why it was so high. My tort was $10! And hers $7!!! Mine was more than the sandwich I ordered!
I felt a little ripped off. They need to put prices on their desert menu ASAP. I would have never ordered it had I known it was priced so high. Way too high for what you got. 
This place has so much potential, loved the vintage decor and tables! They have a great food concept!! They just need to tweak. My suggestion is they offer a complimentary small basket of their homemade chips when seated(to be fair no free refill), slightly up the meat in their sandwiches, and offer specialty pies ($5-6) for desert. Pie would go much better with the rest of the comfort foods they offer.

Ate there tonight based on a review from a coworker. The server was attentive and very helpful with advice on meal selection. Everything was delicious. This is truly the best Indian food I have eaten in a long time. Give this place a try and you will not be sorry. Think we just found our new favorite Indian restaurant.

The studio is located in Rockledge,  which is only a few miles away from the Northeast section of Phila.  The teachers are very helpful and knowledgeable and the studio offers both regular and hot yoga classes and yoga workshops. (I took one on healthy eating and detoxing your body which was very informative). One drawback is that there's only off-street parkingand sometimes it could be hard to find a spot.

I've been seeing Celaithia now for about 6 months. She is AMAZING! My hair has NEVER looked better. I get balayage and her precision is awesome. She's always on time and never double books her appointments. The salon looks great and they play a variety of music. Would highly recommend!

My parents have been coming here for months and love it, so while visiting them we went to Bruno's for lunch.  The atmosphere was cute, very quiet since we went early on a Sunday (around noon).  We each ordered large pasta dishes, I had the mezzaluna special and it was fantastic.  The portions are huge and we each took half home for dinner later.  Everything was fresh and the pasta is light because it's freshly made, not heavy with preservatives.    The staff was friendly and service was quick.  We will definitely be enjoying another lunch there again before I leave!
Very quick and not as painful as my first time, so it's true that the first time ever getting a Brazilian is the worst! After that it's not so bad. Definitely my new go to spot

These guys are one of the big boys in the area for flooring.  They sell other products but they are especially known for their tile.

* Huge selection
* Decent prices
* Great technical advice
* Knowledgeable and responsive sales folks (Denise is super!)
* Convenient return of unopened product
* Just over the PA/DE boarder so tax free 

It's amazing how many people call this their go to place for flooring.

Wasn't expecting to do anything but have a beer and watch some football. I was surprised to enjoy a phenomenal meal prepared by head chef Mike and superb service compliments of Chaz. Beyond pleased with today's experience. Will be bringing the family back soon.

I wanted Chinese fast food, so I checked this out.  Java B had said this location was the better one over the Plumb Ln location.  I went on that recommendation, and I agree.  I pulled into the 15 minute parking space, and went in.  They were packed, All the seating outside was occupied, and most of the tables inside were also full.  I walked in, and was helped immediately.  They were very nice, and the place was very clean.  I was impressed with the cleanliness, as some expressed that it was an issue.  I was there around 1:15 - the height of lunch hour.  I was out of there in about 7 minutes.  The food was what you would expect - it was good.  I don't expect spectacular for fast food, but I was good with it.  For what it is, if you want Chinese fast food, in a clean place, this will serve your needs.

I just ordered from them this past Saturday night from their online menu. They had to call me b/c they only received part of my order. The delivery took an hour but they had said that it might take that long as I ordered at about 6pm that night.. 

When the food did arrive I was actually charged about $.50 more than the what the online total indicated. While the entrees were large and hot, the appetizers were ice cold. But that wasn't the worse part of it all.

About 3 or 4 hours after dinner, my face and hands started to swell. So much so, that I could barely see out of my puffy eyes. In addition, I started to have stomach cramps, bloating, an extremely dry mouth, horrible headache and insomina. It eventually went away with some allergy meds and plenty of liquid and aspirin. I wasn't sure what to think of it until I started doing some research and believe I may have had an allerigic reaction to what I think was MSG in their food. There is no listing on their menu or online page that says that they don't use MSG so it's possible they do. 

I have never had this happen before but don't intend on going back to find out if happens again. Just a warning to others who might be allergic.

If you are busy and always in a rush but can't find a good chiropractor this is the place. It's more affordable and easy going. I can walk in whenever and get a good adjustment. This place is definitely for the common person who needs a good adjustment especially after sitting so much or looking down so much.

I really like this place the burgers are great, a little small but very good. The beer selection is good and as everyone says the homemade catsup is awesome.  The big problem here is that is is so damn expensive!  
$12 for a tiny burger, then another 2-4 for fries? don't get me wrong, the food is very good, it's just not good enough to justify their prices.
The food is good but the service is pretty bad. My food came out 10 minutes prior to my friend's food and we had planned to eat TOGETHER so I had the server re-heat my food.

A Carrollwood hidden gem. Retro vibes with modern amenities. This theatre has a full bar and restaurant. Service is very good, the ticket agents are friendly and the bar staff polite. Cold beers & refreshing cocktails, the black bean burger is okay...not great but okay. The garlic fries are phenomenal. Great for date night or outing with friends.

This is our go-to place in Broad Ripple. Our last visit was to support Dining Out For Life, an annual fundrasier for the Damien Center. 

I was surprised to see the menu had recently changed, and the beloved (by me, and perhaps not many others apparently) dolmades are off the menu. So, on this visit I tried something new! I ordered the veggie quesadillas and added spinach. Good choice, and this might just be my new staple! This dish packs heat, so beware. 

Other things I love about the Brew Pub:
-Plentiful outdoor dining space
-Interesting and truly homemade menu options
-Beers available by the pint, or in smaller portions (this was much more appealing to me when I was a breastfeeding mom and just wanted a smidge of my favorite Porter)
-Great kids menu (go for the Shepherds Pie, every time!)

Things that add to the charm of the Brew Pub, but might be irritating to some:
-Slow-ish service
-Cigarette smoke wafting over from the fire-pit area IF you choose to sit outdoors on that side of the building (not a fan of smoke? Request to sit on the street side and you'll be in the clear)

The food is really good but it's a standard NY style pizza for a little more money. The sizes are great, a medium is a chain pizza stores' large. We do really love it, it's just a little expensive. Worth going to for sure!

This is for "The Lookout" which should be called the Watchout. IT IS NOT OLE RED. We made a reservation but didn't realize The Lookout was not part of Ole Red. We were whisked through Ole Red which looked fun and had a great menu. The Lookout is like a lame hotel bar and does NOT play country music. Our server was wonderful but she had to shoo people away from our table when we arrived. People who continued to stand behind us the entire time and blocked our view. AWKWARD. The food was overpriced and not good. The wine was warm. The table was dirty. The view was okay, I watched people at the bar across the street having fun and wished I was there instead. The worst part? The stench of rotten trash blowing up from the street to the table. Is this a "thing" in Nashville or were the garbage collectors on strike? Every dumpster was overflowing. I became nauseous from it and we had to leave. So sad that this was how we had to spend our last night in Nashville, we were having a great time until this.
We enjoyed the shrimp fu young. Have had it a couple of times and it's been great every time. Not sure about the other items on menu but will try more of the food over time.

Let me start out by saying I really want to like this place. Really. They are in my neighborhood, they have a lovely patio, and serve alt-tacos. However, I still can't give them a whole-hearted endorsement for a couple of reasons; most importantly the disparity between their portions and prices. I'm not looking for lard-butt size meals, but when you charge $2.50 per taco you expect them to at least be filling. Make them larger, or drop the price. Even a slight drop could reconcile the difference. And if you charge for chips, they should be good. REALLY good. 

As for the taste itself, I've found them to be ok. The issue I've found is that everything is a little bland. When you say spicy at a Mexican (even be it alt-Mex) you should mean spicy. The tacos I've tried with a creamy "sauce" are overwhelmed by the mayo-like taste and consistency.

One thing they are tops at is the speed at lunch (can't vouch for dinner, it's always too busy for me to bother given my past experiences). I've got my food within minutes of ordering it.
Very tasty dinner and great drinks and service. Recommend the grits, fish, and bread pudding!

The best experience! We had looked at many places in and around the Tampa area and this seemed to be the only place that actually knew their products. John Clayton was able to answer all our questions and made the whole buying process so easy for us. Would 100% recommend them to anyone who is in the market for a camper.

The selection here is a-mazing!  We ordered pralines and this amazing candy on a stick, that consisted of a marshmallow, caramel, rice crispys, and smothered in chocolate.  That thing made me drool, literally!  The candy all tasted great and made for a perfect souvenir to take home.

I have dined at Baguette Deli a handful of times in the past, with my most recent visit being after nearly a year since the previous one. During prior visits, I had always been pleased with the value and quality of the food, as well as the prices. Unfortunately, it seems the place has changed. 

First, the girl taking my order at the counter seemed hurried and became visibly impatient when I took an extra few moments to decide my order, even though there were only two other customers in the restaurant and no one else in line. I have always enjoyed the fresh shrimp spring rolls, but was disappointed to find they were out. In the past, they had been able to make them to order if customers were willing to wait, but when I asked about this, the girl responded with a terse, "No," and seemed to take pleasure in being unhelpful. So I settled on the teriyaki chicken banh mi. Although the bread was crusty and delicious and the veggie toppings were fresh, the chicken was mushy, salty, tasted old, and had the texture of a purée rather than actual meat. In addition, the meat portion was minuscule, which I was somewhat grateful for in this instance because it simply wouldn't have been palatable.

While eating my lackluster sandwich, I overheard the conversation between a customer and the girl at the counter. While placing his order, the customer inquired about the same fresh spring rolls I had been interested in. The girl told the gentleman they were out, but when he asked about having some made to order, she said yes, after she had given me a flat, unapologetic no. 

Despite already being furious, my next, and possibly most significant issue with Baguette Deli, is that they no longer offer free water to customers, which I am reading is a complaint I share with other reviewers. Instead of a pitcher of water with reusable plastic cups that diners could help themselves from, the restaurant now requires patrons to purchase an overpriced bottle of water. I find this practice cheap, greedy, and in the worst possible taste and service. Despite relatively reasonable base prices and good experiences in the past, the new "nickeling and diming" tactics, inconsistency, and poor customer service has made Baguette Deli a place I no longer wish to give my patronage to.

Apparently they feel free to charge people's bank accounts and then not deliver the food they charged for. I don't know what kind if business they're running, but it's not worth it. Then when confronted they try to cover up their mistakes instead of addressing their error.

Had a great time sitting at the bar talking with the bartender (and feel bad not remembering her name). The restaurant is a small cafe like setting with an incredibly friendly staff. We had the Veggie Nachos, unveggied by adding steak ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

Nachos alone were delicious and the beef very flavorful, great addition. Afterwards, we got their homemade macadamia ice cream. Yum! Tip, you can eat the flower with it. 

Can't wait to go back for a full meal.

I am now wondering how often businesses read these reviews because shortly after writing this review the packaging has been improves to small little take out boxes. What the hell, there really aren't any issues with this restaurant--five stars!

edit: I wrote a very thorough positive 4 star review but now that I updated it to do the 5 star review it's disappeared? Youll have to trust i said good things. Yelp fix this quirk.

I often stay here when I'm in Reno for work. The rooms are clean, comfy bed, quiet, smoke free and the front desk staff is friendly. 

Cons-The food service is seriously lacking; during every visit there's an issue. This visit I ordered the hummus and veggies, I'm vegan so this is my only option. I got a lot of hummus but only 7 veggie sticks. And I bag of chips that I didn't order, doesn't say it comes with it and I won't eat. I much rather have veggies with my hummus than chip. 

The last visit here they were out of hummus and veggies by 6:30pm-just the start of dinner time. So I ordered a quinoa salad that also came with nuts, lettuce, dried cranberries and butternut squash, chicken as well but I asked to have that removed. All I got was lettuce and nuts. When I asked where the rest was they said they were out-could have told me that before paying $12 for a container of lettuce? And they wouldn't adjust the price. 

The only other place to eat close by is sushi so being able to have at least hummus and veggies-done correctly would be nice.

Also this visit I had zero bathroom products. I was stepping into the shower when I realized I didn't even have soap. That's a basic hotel item. So that was a mishap on housekeeping but the front desk girl was very apologetic and brought me everything I needed. 

So basically this hotel is clean and close to work while I'm in town. Other than that don't expect too much.

I went Osteria with my coworkers for a celebration dinner.  It was my very first time so I didn't know what to expect.  Service seemed good...Our server Kyle was on point. As far as the food. .....If I was to rate it I would give it a five.... I had the robiiolia francobolli it was good but it looked as if it was placed in the microwave. ....  I order soup the server said there was only one soup left...I was like what? I had to reserve the last bowl if I wanted it...so I did....The soup was way too salty and I love salt.....The question would be..would I ever go back or suggest it for a place to eat? My true answer would be absolutely not. I can't say anything about prices because  I was treated by the company I work for and all I can say is I was so glad I didn't waste my own money. ...
Certainly not worth the price. IMO food was not seasoned the way I expect an Italian restaurant to be.

A well kept secret of Indy. These actors (they're known as "actletes") are HILARIOUS. They're very talented. I would give it a 5 if tickets were a little cheaper. It can be a fun date....unless the audience is packed with obnoxious, screaming teenage girls, which happens from time-to-time. Downside: the food is not good.

I like to come here Sunday's for lunch, when Oscar's is closed.  Good location.  Decent burrito's, I prefer Chipotle or Blue Coast, And best Horchata at Chile burrito.  Location, location location.  Not too busy usually, good portions.

Wow, what a disappointment. After hearing others give such high marks, this restaurant was horrible all the way around. First our waiter was awful, he did not check on us for probably 20 minutes. The bartender served us our appetizers and we had no silverware. After stopping another waiter to find ours for silverware, he went and told our waiter and he still waited 10 minutes to come. When he finally did, he refilled drinks and left for another 20 minutes without bringing us utensils. We eventually took them off a different table when our food was served to us and then he came and said he forgot. 2 people in our party ordered drinks from the bar that were awful, it was as if they didn't have a drop of liquor. The food was just plain bad. The pork steaks were like chewing rubber, the sides were flavorless. We were shocked after we started eating. The only food that was okay was the kids Mac n cheese and the BBQ nachos. Don't waste your money, you'll end up leaving frustrated that you paid so much for horrible service and gross food.

This is my favorite restaurant! My husband and I go to Nirvana Indian Bistro every chance we get. We've probably tried the entire menu at this point and it's all fantastic. The owner is the nicest guy and he's very health-conscious, so you never need to feel bad about ordering extra! The staff are all incredibly helpful and attentive. Don't forget to order orange kulfi for dessert!

Despite spotty and uneven service, the food and atmosphere was amazing enough to warrant 5 stars.  The decor is hip and modern, and the lighting perfect (just low enough to make it sexy).  We started with the raw oysters; fresh and clean tasting but with a dab of cocktail type mignonette that wasn't to my taste.  The grits souffle was outstanding; crisp on the outside and airy inside- wow!  The quail was crisp yet moist, with a deliciously gamey taste.  The fried green tomatoes stack was superb, with an interplay between the crispy fried goodness and the rich, juicy tomato.  For main courses, my wife loved her bone-in pork chop (although a tad too well done), served with braised cabbage and polenta. My rabbit two ways was absolutely incredible; a loin wrapped in bacon cooked "soo vide" and a leg prepared simply (roasted, I think).  Super tasty and well presented.  The wine list is extensive, although we stuck to choices by the glass - and everything was high quality.  The service issues were minor, but annoying.  They served us courses without replacing our silverware, and then we had to wait a solid five minutes before anyone noticed - and we kept trying to flag people down.  The bread guy came over once, then disappeared- we had to finally ask someone to send him back!  Still, the food (Modern Southern) is so good that I can't complain too loudly.  For foodies, this is a great place!

Been going to Jones on and off for about 18 months since we live in the area. No more. 
No one seems to attend to the complaint that this place is deafening. In fact we left early on one visit because the noise level was so aversive that our ears were ringing and it was impossible to carry on a conversation.
The food continues to be predictable and OK but so overpriced for essentially diner food.
The service is chaotic and staff is not trained competently. Recently our party of 8 tried to get in on a weekday at 5 pm and the host was so scattered that he barely knew what he was doing with a line that was out the door. He looked like a deer in the headlights. Not confidence inspiring. And the people kept waiting while he dithered. Then come to find out that they NOW have changed to taking reservations. Way to go Jones -- should have done that years ago not changed the rules midstream. Needless to say, we did not have reservations and they missed out on feeding 8 hungry people. This place is on its demise I think and I further think that Starr needs to attend to the complaints that people who know food and service and ambiance are posting here and on other venues. I don't see that happening.

THIS is no doubt my FAVORITE place to eat! I invite my friends and they love it! The fried shrimp dinner is amazing, the Smokey Jack burger is delicious, and even the Gator tail I tried out is absolutely amazing! Compliments to the chef!! Atmosphere feels like Any other place I go to. Everyone at my table was treated well, and no orders were wrong. Burgers were tender, and lean, seasoned fries were just my favorite! I tend to eat my fries first then to the meal. I strongly recommend anyone who is a Blue cheese lover (like me) to try out the black and bleu bacon burger, it's not like the other restaurant that lightly puts crumbles on it no no no, at Gator's they fill it and you can just taste it's rich flavor! I invited my family here to eat and my Father absolutely loved the gator tail! His first time and I'm sure he will be back. Onion petals were delicious especially eating with Fried shrimp dinner. Like I said before Compliments to the Chef! 5/5 I loved it! Great food! And a wonderful experience when wanting to try something new!

Amidst the slew of tours in this great 'haunting' city, we settled on the help of the great reviews of prior Yelpers. 

Our guide was super enthusiastic, which I believe is required for any good tour guides, and was super knowledgeable about the tour in general. It wasn't a super long tour, but there were many great stories and a break in the middle where a bar was nearby for refreshments. 

Definitely enjoyable! And do go and get one of their spots for readings. It was incredible to say the least!

Don't forget to tip the guide!
Our favorite Mexican spot in town, and from what we can tell, it's Michael Keaton's (Gung Ho), too.

Standard Holiday Inn but they get an extra star for service which was over and above my experience in these category hotels
-USB ports in the room outlets
- provided space heaters on request 
- clean, modern rooms
- very personable staff

Only negative is due to location downtown, the walk from the parking lot to the hotel can feel a little uncomfortable in the dark. 

I'd love to stay here again.

Skip the food & stick to the coffee. Great space for reading and working. Paninis are pre-made &
 are too expensive for the quality. Panera does a better job. We had the mozzarella & tomato panini, it was cool on the inside, not as gooey as it should be.

Donuts are amazing.  There is nothing that comes even close.  The flavors are so unique and interesting.  The chicken is above average, but I'd eat their chicken over 90% of other fried chicken in Philly.  This is a true South Philly gem.

Lunch reservations for 1:30p. Tables not ready until 2:15p and our party of 14 scattered across the restaurant. Wamp.

UPDATE (10/18/14):
After all were reseated and arranged, I was overall satisfied at the creativity displayed by the management to accommodate our party of twelve adults and two babies. My wife missed out on the meal she ordered, but we walked out with all limbs in tact and heart beating, so I cannot complain too much. Bumped to three stars.

Update on my last review 
So on my last review it was winter and they were in winter mode.
I bought a membership card for the season so i'd get a percentage off and have been buying plants for my backyard and a few tools.
They have a great selection of trees,perennials ,annuals,cactus,whatever you need.
I also tried out the restaurant .
It is very nice and classy with a lot of outside tables as well as inside ones.
Staff was friendly and prompt.
I had a proscuito and pineapple pizza with a coffee.
The pizza was one of those ultra thin types with a very thin layer of cheese and a few pineapple chunks,a mall amount of thin meat slices and a few pepper rings on it.
It was a 12 inch i think and cooked perfectly and it was tasty but  wasn't very filling and 1 person can eat it easily .
A little disappointing for $15+tip .
The coffee was really good. 
Anyways still a great place to buy garden stuff.

Gym office on Saturday is advertised to close at 1pm. They closed before 1pm which made them lose business as my husband and I were going to sign up today. But if a companies employees can not stay the scheduled hours of the business; then that business will lose business.

Love this place!  We dined here on Saturday around 7:00pm. There were only 4 guest plus the two of us.  I understand they have a bustling lunch crowd, but it's great for evening dining too. Prices were very reasonable.staff very attentive, service was excellent. We shared the shrimp spring rolls. Ordered shredded pork Bahn Mi, it was outstanding.  Also ordered a beef curry noodle bowl that was delicious.

Absolutely amazing BBQ located in 12South District in Nashville! Atmosphere is adorable with cement floors, wood and brick walls, and light strands on the ceiling. There is also a little patio area. My husband had the brisket with potato salad and gumbo. I had the Bulls on Parade sandwich. Everything was so tasty. The staff was extremely friendly. Just a heads up for lunch, come before 11:45a because that's when it starts getting very busy! Although, it'll be worth the wait if you come when it is busy.

Was looking for a new breakfast spot, so I tried this. Heard about the other location in Carmel, but this one is closer to my home. Anyway, there was a small wait on a Sunday which is typical. Finally got sat. The service was very poor and dining room extremely dirty. The food on the other hand was pretty good. I ordered from the healthier options. It was the Corn Flake Crusted French Toast. topped with fresh bananas and strawberries. I was blown away considering the other factors of the restaurant. Hopefully next time I stop in the restaurant is cleaner and the service is better. Clean the Carpets it's an eye sore.

Very philly style brunch. I tried the Benedict egg and my friend tried the sandwich. Both taste great. Best Benedict eggs ever I would say, especially the chef handled great temperature and times to cook the egg. One thing to improve is maybe to refine the sides a little bit? Like adding more options

This review is about The Lookout which is the top floor of Ole Red. It has a different menu. When you get tired of bar food or just want a superb meal, this is the place to go. We are seafood lovers and this was some of the best we have ever eaten including at the gulf. They have a raw bar and you pay by the item. We ordered two Alaskan King Crab Legs, a dozen raw oysters, a dozen boiled shrimp.  We also got their special huge pretzel with great warm queso dip, which was very good . The seafood was amazing ...  Most of the reviews on here are for the main floor food. Don't stop there. Go to the roof top. We can't wait to go back. Delicious! We were a group of four and had plenty of food. View was also great.

I loved my stay at the Royal Sonesta! All the staff were friendly, knowledgeable and wonderfully attentive.  The hotel was absolutely gorgeous and its location in French Quarter could not be beat.  The rooms were clean and comfortable.  Others have said they were charged for Internet. I was not, so they may have changed their policy (or perhaps it was free for me since I had a group rate since I was there for a conference).  For live jazz and a drink, I only needed to take the elevator down to the lobby to the Irving Mayfield's Jazz Playhouse.  I attended meetings in a couple of different ballrooms . They were attractively decorated and spacious. 

The bed was a little softer than I would have liked and, although the hotel had a coffee shop and offers room service, I would have liked an in-room coffeemaker. But these were very minor issues. I miss the sumptuous treatment and would stay there again in a heartbeat.

I haven't had my hair cut for a year. I am hopeless at styling it, always have been. I went to Mary without a clue, and simply told her I wanted it around chin length and that it's really frizzy and I would like to avoid that if possible. She played with my hair for a while, made me look at pictures, and asked me tons of questions about how I usually style it (non existent) before she even lifted a scissor. She's also really friendly and chatting with her made me much less nervous about getting my hair cut. And furthermore, it looked GREAT. Even the oblivious dudes in my life who never notice these kinds of things have been complimenting me on it constantly since I had it cut, which is always entertaining.

And when I STILL couldn't manage it on my own, because I've never really used a flat iron before, she let me come in and showed me how to do it properly with the iron I own, taking time out of her schedule to help me out and calm me down at no charge.

Definitely coming back here, and I'd have to recommend Apsara Cutting Edge to everyone!

Very busy Friday night. Went upstairs to the bar to watch a game with my husband. Due to the busyness of the restaurant we were overlooked to be greeted by a waitress. When we were greeted, we were met by an adorable waitress with the biggest smile! She quickly took our orders and our food was out quickly. I had the veggie flatbread and I must say it was one of the best flatbreads I have ever had. I was shocked. Great atmosphere for live music or regular dining. Highly recommend.

buyer beware-300% markup on cafe du monde 12 ct keurig coffee $23!!! no receipts given!!! at cafe du monde they charge $8!!! cafe du monde has been alerted & i'm alerting better business bureau asap. i will personally boycott this pathetic excuse for an establishment that takes advantage of consumers & gives the french market a
bad name!
Probably the best Chinese food around.  Great lunch special and their general tso chicken is really amazing

Okay so I have to start this review by saying (1) that the food was actually really good and (2) that this was one of the weirdest experiences of our entire lives.

We came here to use my $30 off birthday certificate and it was also our first time at Benihana.  We'd been to Hibachi before so somewhat knew what to expect but went into it with no expectations.  We sat down with two other couples and immediately knew this was going to be a weird night.  The couple next to us told us that they were regulars and came roughly once/week so we leaned on them for guidance and expertise.  I ordered the Rocky's choice and my husband got the teriyaki steak - both were good but the problem was our experience.  Immediately my water was overfilled and the woman to the other side of the table made a huge deal about it and we knew that they were going to be persnickity and make all of the servers and chefs very flustered and because of that my husband and I just tried to smile, laugh and enjoy our date night and not pay attention to them.  They went on to correct the chef multiple times during his presentation, tell the servers that they were getting them the incorrect sauces, extra dressings, multiple waters and sodas even if they weren't finished with the ones that they had (people, i tried to tell you that this was the weirdest experience we've ever had).  With how shaken the staff was, our presentation was not the best and our food wasn't cooked properly because the chef had to cater to this couples ridiculous demands (more butter, cooked more, i want my vegetables and meat mixed together, cut my meat in the opposite direction).... and then the weirdest part was that the couple ordered an additional steak which when the server went through to ensure that our orders were accurate was never brought up but then when the couple didn't receive it at the end of the meal were OUTRAGED.  To the point where the manager came over and assured them and guaranteed that he put the steak on the plate himself (he didn't) and they called his bluff and everyone got even more uncomfortable.  phew.  Now they forgot my white rice as well as the entire table's ice cream and tea and gave us the incorrect check twice.  The bathroom floors were incredibly sticky and gross and two people at our table had to request new flatware or plates because they weren't cleaned properly.  This review is after a dinner on a Monday night so maybe it was just an off time for this crew and I know that the customers were not helping the cause but we're not willing to try again to find out if it was just a fluke.

The guy was great, he was a good server. 
server: we are know for our "UNI" he brag bout it then, after i order he said we only have it on weekends. 

Remove it on your weekday menu if you only have it on weekends. 

Other than that nothing special except its BYOB. 

Ambience was good, its located on the belt of Passyunk restaurant street.

Amazing work! Perfectly done. 
I was referred by Marie Couture Bridal and the wonderful ladies at Yong's did an amazing job with both the alterations and bustle. 

I requested a piece of lace from my mother's dress sewn into the lining and it was just beautiful. 

I received nothing but compliments on my gown and how beautiful it was. 

They were so flexible with my crazy schedule and so helpful with feedback. 

Thank you for making our day special and for your lovely work!

Capo fitto is an awesome urban environment with authentic  handmade Italian pizza and frozen yogurt. A great environment for the family or for a fancy dinner. You will not regret going to this place!!

Perfectly fine brunch here with friends - nothing to write home about.  Nice setting.  Small portions.  High price point. Squash fritters and pasta with goat meat ragu were good.  Everything else was meh.  My friend loves this place so there is a good chance that she will drag me back.  Lol.

The name of this business should be unavailable, unprofessional and incompetent plumbing. My husband and I recently purchased a home. An agreement of that purchase was that a draining issue in the bathroom would be corrected. We had a quick settlement so there was not time for the job to be completed prior to settlement which left us with a check payable to available plumbing for completion of the work. My husband called Randy (the owner) the day after settlement to get the work scheduled, Randy was on vacation. The following monday I called again to schedule the job, I was told that the soonest he would be able to start would be that Friday and that he could come out and meet with me thursday morning. This led me to believe that he would be starting work on my home that friday, but I was wrong. When he came out to meet with me, on a job he had already started, he informed me I would need to get tile before he could procede. Now why I wasn't informed of that while i was waiting nearly 2 weeks for him to come out i don't know, but a friend of the family does tile work so I called him and due to his vacation and an emergency at home, it took a week for him to get out. The day after my tile guy came and measured I called Randy again, this was a friday. I left a message with my name, the address of the house, and the date that I would like him to start the job if he was available. He never returned the call. Monday afternoon I called again, slightly unpleasant this time because he hadn't returned my call, and left essentially the same message. About an hour later he called my office, one of the girls i work with answered the phone and he said "yeah this is the plumber" he couldn't even remember the name of the person he was calling, and when the call made its way over to me after some assessing, he asked me what day I wanted him to start (i'd left that in 2 messages) I gave him the date and he said he would have to check his schedule and get back to me. So we had a very pointless and unprofessional phone call. He did not call back that day or the following morning, so I once again called him the next afternoon. He actually answered his phone this time, and i again gave my name and address and asked if he could start work on the 17th, no he says, that day isn't good for me. ok i say, what day is? he says the 24th, august 24th, that is nearly 2 weeks away and more than 2 weeks from the first message i left him. I told him that was unacceptable, we needed to be out of our apartment by the 31st and that simply didn't allow enough time. He went on to say that it wasn't his fault my tile guy took a week, well i said, that isn't but if i would have known from the start that i needed tile, that would have been done. Completely fed up at this point i told him just to start as soon as he could, to which he responded I should find a  new plumber, that was the first good thing he had said to me. My new plumber came out and began work the very next day, which was yesterday, He will be back today most likely to complete the job, and so far there has been no mention of ordering tile or tearing up my bathroom floor.
I visited this restaurant with my family on Mother's Day. This place was the best by far . The buffet was fresh and clean . This taste just like your mothers kitchen !

As a resident of Columbia, i can honestly tell you that is the best restaurant we have to offer. I've work all over St. Louis and no matter how far away from Columbia, I always hear talk of Thai House. People come form far and away to enjoy the incredible flavor, and unparalleled cuisine. As The duck curry is a must for any curry fans, and their tofu is by far the best around. Any fans of Thai food I recommend you take the trip across the river, or where every your coming from to enjoy such kind service, and wonderful food.

Great bar! Abigail was very knowledgeable and friendly. Learned a bunch while having fun and a perfectly balanced daiquiri! The pot tenderloin was delicious and the service was excellent. Thank you to Kyle for going to retrieve my gift bag from The Swizzle Stick. Hospitality at its best!
Wonderful place in the heart of the quarter! Food, atmosphere, service and servers make your visit a special occasion and the only place to go for that special dinner!

Let me just start by saying that I recently moved to the area from LA and my review may be a bit biased because of the caliber of Thai food that I am normally used to.  I should also note that I frequent some of the better Thai establishments around LA county so my review is probably bias.

Meun Fan Thai simply fell on "ok" status for me. My girlfriend and I went here to have lunch one weekend and we were really disappointed by the limited menu offerings and the quality of the food after we had ordered. Sure this place is nice and clean, but just because you have a gold elephant on the wall, it doesn't make your restaurant legit Thai.
One of the first things that I noticed about the menu was the lack of noodle soups. Sure there are hot pot and tom yum but where's the boat noodle? That should be a simple thing to have on the menu and is usually a staple item on just about any Thai menu.
My girlfriend ordered the Pad Thai and while the color and flavor were present, the noodles were a shame. They were more pho noodle than typical rice stick noodle that pad thai usually is made with. This made it more soggy and not as good to eat.
My order of curry noodle had a brick of noodles sitting in curry sauce.  It was sad. How does one overcook a brick of pre-prepped noodles?

Anyway, needless to say, 10$ per dish was not pleasing. Sure we pay higher prices due to location and area but dishes of this quality and caliber would not have been any more than 7.50 on any other menu.
Jacob provided us with prompt service to quickly troubleshoot a couple of bathroom light switches.   We will definitely use him again for all of our electrical needs!

Our go to place.  We love it.  Their Fig Jam Flatbread is a must - I get it every time.  We also love their cheese options.  Have tried multiple seasonal dishes that have all been a huge hit.  Oh, the wine - top notch!  I typically get a full-bodied flight of some sort.  We have also gotten several bottles of wine from them, as their staff is very knowledgeable and helpful.  Go check it out yourself for a chilled out experience.  I find myself stealing their Pandora stations every time I leave...

I love coming here with my husband. They have an indoor pool and hot tub and the rooms are nice and spacious. It's nice to get away for a night here and there to a place like this. Heading back on Saturday.

Ichiban's sushi is not "authentic" Japanese sushi.  The menu caters to the American pallet (daa, "you're in America"- I get it.).  The rice, 鮨飯 sushi meshi, is too salty/sweet, not subtle in flavor and the sauces poured over different rolls are too strong.  Like a lot of adopted international food in the US, "natural" flavors get hidden by adding too much salt and sugar, and using too much "exotic" sauce.  If you want a taste of Japanese sushi I would not recommend Ichiban.  Also the chiefs have not been trained in proper Japanese presentation, delivery or etiquette.  Generally they do not speak Japanese, which often adds to the ambiance and experience.  There is nothing wrong with Americanized sushi but Ichiban is not "authentic Japanese sushi" if that's what you're seeking.   If you want to experience true Americanized sushi then Ichiban is one of many places for you.

Love Buff Beauty Bar! Cydney for my waxing & Whitney  & Jordan have both done my nails! I just moved to New Orleans and alreafy have a place for hair, waxes & nails clise to home and the office!! The complimentary mimosa is just a binus!

I went to this salon at the end of last year and had my hair washed and colored. The color job was beyond amazing. Right shade found and mixed within minutes. 5 stars so far. However, when it came to washing my hair I can only agree with one of the other reviews here: I have long hair, so the hair stylist needs to take time!!! to wash it properly (or better say, to clean up the scalp from any color residue). There was still shampoo on my neck after the hair wash was finished and I had a weird feeling about my scalp. But I thought I was in good hands and after mentioning my neck, I dropped it. Drying my hair was absolutely awful. Two people pulling vehemently at my hair (while brushing it) in opposite directions. I left there with a headache and this is no exaggeration. I will never ever let a stylist dry my hair again. I would rather want to do this myself and take time. After all, I am paying for it and they aren't cheap either. I woke up the next morning and my scalp was itching. After scratching, I looked at my finger and it was brown (I had my hair colored in a brown shade). I had to jump right into the shower and wash out the color that had obviously been on my scalp for over 24 h. How is this possible at an Aveda Salon? It's actually sad, because they are so close to where I live. But honestly, I do not want to lose my hair. 
P.S. I will not mention the stylist's name, since I do believe that -if already 2 customers have made the same negative experience- the entire team needs to sit down and discuss what needs to be done to improve the customer experience when it comes to washing and drying hair. This part is really terrible and actually belongs to the basic knowledge at a hair salon.

One of the kids favorite places to eat. I'm sure they'd give it five stars. They recently renovated and I think the smell mentioned in other reviews is gone. It always bothered me too. With new paint, carpet and tables it definitely appears much cleaner. 

It was not very busy when we were there. We received our food in a reasonable timeframe. Lots of birthdays that night. Waitress was okay. Kids meals aren't really a bargain. The burgers are really good. I'm sure the kids will continue to lobby to go here.

not the most welcoming of businesses.

i came seeking a specific item and was shown the selection that matched my interest rather quickly. i felt the service was cold and that they were happy to see me leave, even though my 5pm inquiry and purchase was clearly the first business they had all day.

for selling to such a niche market they should consider being friendlier to people that drop in for miscellaneous needs.
Home away from home...I seem to be here all the time and I have always had good luck and good experiences with staff finding them friendly and helpful.
Excellent service, much better prices than nearby competitor and it was finished in about an hour! Very satisfied

More than Just Ice cream is exactly just that! 

When you walk in you might see a huge sign hanging around the restaurant seating area of the cafe/ice cream joint. That sign depicting a woman doing something naughty to her ice cream cone is the original sign of the place when it first established on Pine St. right where the Mixto restaurant now stands. A little history I learned from a patron and resident of the gayborhood. 

I tried their burger with melted cheddar and it tasted very fresh. Instead of fries they serve it with some greens and a huge slice of orange. A more healthier side dish than the norm. Most of the servers are of the homo-kind and look forward to 'you' asking questions about the many strange flavors of ice cream including birthday, which is basically bits of cake and the ice cream tastes like icing. None of us tried it...
... too much on the diabetic side. 

So if you are wondering, YES! there ice cream is the treat you've been waiting for before or after a meal there. You don't have to have more than just ice cream after all but my mint choco chip hit the spot.

The food is fantastic! Had the Sunday Gravy meatball in the bar. 

Good house wine too! 

Service was great!.

Decor really out dated. Has that 1990s oak trim and tile floors. Not that matters much, but the ambience is seriously lacking, wouldn't gather there with family or friends, 
Really loud 80s music. We ate, and left 

I recommend, would sit in resteraunt next time. great food and service

This distillery is awesome!!! My fiancé and I went today for the tour and tasting. The tour guide was very knowledgeable and answered all our questions. The selection of whiskey they have here taste great. We ended up ordering cocktails and buying a bottle for home.
Good. Coffee not their specialty. But nice clean friendly staff. Drive up is quick and easy. Beignets are delish!!

Caitlin Laverty is absolutely amazing in hair color, cutting, and styling. Caitlin makes everyone feel comfortable. She will ask you what you want to do with your hair and she listens. She not only listens but she gives her input on what will look best on you. She works with the client to achieve a great color and cut that looks good on them. Caitlin works with me by pointing out what would look best on me.... I listen to her because... she's the best!  I make my appointments that are convenient for me. Caitlin goes out of her way to make me and all of her clients happy. I could not be happier to have met Caitlin. I highly recommend Caitlin Laverty. I think she's up and coming in philly.

This is our second time going to capital cellars. I'm leaving my review based on price point and comparison to other similar priced venuses such as Brick 29, Chandlers, Ruth Chris and Alavita.  We had a salmon fish and a seafood risotto dish.  For appatizer we had a bowl of French onion soup, no doubt the best thing the entire night.  The salmon should have never made it to our table. Even a new chef would have know it was way over cooked and extremely dry.  The seafood risotto was ok but nothing I'd pay $20+ for.  This was our second go at the place and for sure our last.  I always give a place two attempts to get it right, capital failed on both.

I wanted to like this place but unfortunately it didn't live up to the hype. I went on a Saturday night with the Bf.
Let's starts with the Cons: 
Parking:  There is only street parking. 
Seating:  The place is tiny so if you try to go on a weekend. Good luck with that. 
Food:  I was not impressed with the chicken whatsoever. This was sad considering this is what they are known for. The greens were horrible. They were sweet. I've never had sweet greens in my life! They were Vegan style which I somewhat appreciate but I did not come to a southern/chicken restaurant for vegan greens Throw some pork in that shit!  They also ran out of Macaroni and Cheese. The server informed us that this typically happens on busier nights Iike weekends. Ok that's no excuse!  I did not come to a FOOD establishment for them to tell me they ran out of FOOD!  Sounds like it's something that happens frequently. Well then do something to prevent it!
I also had the mashed potatoes with gravy. Everything tasted flavorless. I had to put tons of salt on my mashed potatoes despite them having gravy on then. My chicken was tasteless. They give you two sauces for your chicken. One is a weird sweet yogurt concoction. The other was hot sauce. The yogurt one was very sweet. I found it to be a very weird thing to offer as a sauce for chicken. The other was hot sauce. Probably some store bought brand transferred into a clear bottle they are trying to pass off as their own. The server recommended mixing the two and that was a great idea. I enjoyed the sauce concoction better than the chicken. That's Not good!
Menu:  Lots of items I wanted to try where no longer on the menu. Not sure whose fault that Is but if you are looking at the yelp menu they don't have a lot of the items listed. Speaking of menus even the ones inside the restaurant were dated and tacky. Items were crossed out with marker and the menu was literally a piece of paper taped to cardboard. The server said they were in the process of making new ones.  Somebody needs to speed that process along.  

Pros:  
Seating: They have the no wait app so that helps out with the limited seating. 
Staff:  The staff was really nice. Several different ones helped out by filling our drinks and running our food out. 
Food:  The Pimento cheese was good and filling. This was the only food item that I enjoyed. That's not good considering it's an appetizer. 
Drinks:  The flavored sodas are amazing. I had the Mango. I wanted to try the toasted almond one but they no longer serve it despite it being listed on the menu. (See cons. Section A under Menu)
Decor:  The decor is pretty neat and different. 

Overall I won't be returning especially since Sweetie Pies is right around the corner.

The food is good but this experience had the worst service. Waited for basically 30 minutes to get our change/cards back from our waitress while we could literally see her just talking with other tables about her fanny pack pins. Super disappointed and a real waste of my time. .... update now it has been an hour

Dr.Wank is great at his profession. He's friendly and will explain everything you would like to know so that you are put at ease.

Staff are friendly as well. Recommend Dr. Wank if you need.tort wisdom teeth out. 

He will work with you so that you feel comfortable and so that the procedure is as painless as it can be made to be. 

Great place to have your dental issues fixed. Plus he has key.chains, pens, etc. with the slogan "I got yanked by wank".

I'm not one to usually write this kind of review, but AVOID THIS PLACE AT ALL COSTS. Maybe it was the fact that my group went in for Endless Lunch, but service was awfully slow, the sushi was kinda warm and mediocre at best, and my favorite part? 

The violent, unrelenting ///food poisoning/// that kicked in the next day. I'm talking I was ridiculously nauseous for about 12 hours straight, I vomited almost non-stop for about five and a half hours, I continue to have intense diarrea, and my body simply rejected anything that wasn't water for the entire time.

I'm absolutely exhausted. Of my party of four, three of us experienced sickness as bad or even worse than mine. We're pretty sure it was the raw tuna. Stay away.

Scheduled an oil change on line. Chose the special they had advertised for 49.99 for their rewards customers. The oil change included up to 5 quarts of synthetic oil and oil filter. The only fine print on the page was about shop materials and extra time and costs for hybrid and electric vehicles. When I arrived I was told that since I have a Volvo it would be more expensive. I needed an extra quart of oil and the service writer said that the oil filter included with the special wouldn't work with my vehicle. Uhhhhh it said nothing about only one model of filter being used for the special. One model of oil filter? You should advertise that the oil change is only for one model of car. Now the oil filter my vehicle uses is just a cartridge. It has no metal housing like the standard spin ons used on most vehicle. Sooo its typically fairly inexpensive. He quoted me $90 for the service. Then after I laughed at him he said it would be $20 off making it $70. Which is still $20 more than it should have been. One extra quart of oil is not $20. I have spent a lot of money at this store in the past. I used to be a service writer here and continued to use this location after I left. I actually used to bring our fleet vehicles here.
