One circle around the block was perfect timing for pick-up...

This is the cutest thai place in the area.  The restaurant itself is decorated like an Asian nursery rhyme with elephant marionettes and bird cages hanging near the windows.  It's small but cozy, and the service was fantastic.  The waitress was so sweet and constantly refilled our water glasses.

In terms of food, this is Chiangmai's sister restaurant so it was excellent.  I had the lady's slipper, which was nicely presented.  It's not that complicated to make (steamed chicken breast stuffed with shrimp spinach, and shittake mushrooms, then covered with a glaze of orange sauce) but did look pretty and taste good.  I wish that I had gotten a curry since I did sample the panang curry and it was amazing.              I will be back to try more since it's soooo close to where I'll be living that it's likely i'll have to refrain from ordering here every other day.  I'll give it 4 stars for now (4.5 actually) and if the seafood medley is as good, it'll be 5.

Buffalo Bella and sweet potato fries w/ black bean aioli are  my go to faves. Great place for a quick bite and the fact they they use eco friendly take out containers is the icing on the cake. Definitely are favorite spot, great customer service.

Note: I am not giving it a mediocre rating due to food or cleanliness, this rating is simply for the horrendous service. 

My roommate and I went for sushi while my boyfriend was in class (I know, completely unfair). She's been with her significant other several times and she said it was pretty cheap and really good. We walked in and were seated at the bar. I ordered a beer, she a water (they carded me; shocker!) the waiter came back over and took our orders: we both got the $15.99 dinner special which were two rolls of our choice, miso soup, and salad. Our soup and salad came out promptly and the guys behind the counter even gave us a complimentary spicy crab salad, which was my favorite. 

Now, I understand when I order sushi that needs to be fried, it takes a while. But it was grueling trying to wait between the appetizer and main course. Finally after 20 minutes after the salad, the sushi came out. It was hot and delicious! But since I have to watch my girlish figure (hey, round is a shape!), I had the desire to box up what was left and go pick up the boyfriend. I had to wait THIRTY MINUTES for my freaking check! Not once did anyone say anything to us or even glance in our direction, because believe me I would've gotten their attention. The place had gotten considerably more crowded since I had walked in, but come on. Half an hour? Maybe if I go back and it's slow the whole time it'll be better, but I was definitely not happy at all over the service.

My sisters and I tried Stella Rossa for the first time last night.  We all started with a different specialty cocktail and they were all just great and well thought   out.  The favorite was the Italian water ice martini!  We tried 3 appetizers and the favorite was the beef meatballs.  Being Italian, we are all picky about our sauce ( or gravy as we call it) and we all thought theirs was great.  We shared the beet salad which was wonderful as well.  The pizzas looked great, but we chose entrees instead.  The chicken parm was excellent and my sisters enjoyed the crab pasta and another chicken dish.  Dessert was ok in the little cups but nothing spectacular.  The atmosphere is friendly, casual and the space is just beautiful.  The service was great as well.  We will be returning soon!
A very cool experience and great food! This place is all around awesome! I just wish they were open later than 5:00 :)

Awesome & fast service.  I needed someone to look at my a/c cuz the house was taking too long to get cooled down.  The price was a bit hefty but that's typical for these types of services.  The specialist told me many things that I never knew (e.g. mistakes made when the house was built).

This hotel is so nice. It's in Nashville Tennessee and the decor, food and Southern hospitality all strike just the right note. They have wines tastings, a walking tour of the gardens, a boat tour of the grounds, 3 pools many shops and many restaurants. We are having so much fun here and the staff has been so kind and helpful with all our needs.

We went when Devour Downtown, Fringe, and Colts game (letting out) were all going on. The staff handled it great, was friendly, and made our wait pleasant. The food was amazing. We ordered several tapas, shared, and filled us up. Definitely looking forward to going back.

Han Dynasty. We love the one in proper Philladelphia so much, our excitement was unbounded upon hearing that one opened in West Philly. 

In short: The food is just as good at the new location. Immediate five stars.

A bit longer: We ordered the Dan Dan Noodle, the Dry Pot Shrimp, and the Double Cooked Pork Belly. Dan Dan Noodle, is a delicious, spicy, noodley confection which has thousands of recipes online. Still, the ones at Han Dynasty (old and new) are the best, and we order them every time. The dry pot shrimp, flavored with hot peppers and ginger enough to make your tongue numb, was cooked properly and left me drinking the sauce at the end. The star of this trip was the double-cooked pork belly. I'm a sucker for pork belly, but the way this is prepared in thin slices with the slightly dry texture, although not crispy, is to die for.

Service was really good too -- our waters were refilled often. We will definitely come back to the new location rather than trekking across Philly in the future.

I love wawa. Probably there at least 3, 4 times a week. This location is super busy all the time. The lines are always long. A lot of times there's people stealing in the snacks/Candy isles. There also a. nice amount of homeless people, inside and out. But they do there best to give good customer service. It's this one guy(can't remember his name, but he's usually at the cash wrap), who is always friendly.

I like this place. I drive from Far Northeast Phila to get my cars washed here. The place is a bit pricey but they do a good job. They spend the time it takes to make the vehicle perfect. They vacuum the vehicle in the beginning and at the end. The quality is there, they have always done a great job. As any other car was I will not buy any accessories there, they are way overpriced. But the car wash is good for the money. I will continue to go back.

This hotel is so luxe, it will make you feel like you are rolling like a Kardashian. It has the best location by far of any of the downtown hotels -- not only are you right next door to the stadium, I love that you can use the skywalks to go pretty much anywhere in air conditioned (or heated) splendor. There are tons of great restaurants and things to see nearby.

Went there today late brunch at 1:30 . Not a fancy place. No line , not a fancy place , waiter very attentive , slow service . We had Sweet potato pancakes with cinnamon syrup,,  delicious but they were kinda baby ones , veg egg white omelet was ok with raw veggies just dumped on top of the omelet , guess it's a pancake place not an omelette place .
Been coming here for a couple months now and they always have been friendly and do a great job. I would recommend Charlene!

Came into this place with a friend after we heard so much about it. They have a lot of local beers on tap. The menu had a lot of variety so I ordered one of the burgers on their weekly burger battle section. I heard a lot about their horchata so I ordered one.. It was delicious!!! Perfect balance of everything!

Would definitely juts come in to order that again!

Based on great reviews, our party (in need of brunch) on a November Sunday, went looking for the Speckled Hen. Alas, when we finally found someone at the Farmers' Market who had heard of the SH, they could only tell us it had gone out of business.

They say this place closes at 1am. At 11:30 pm, we went to eat. Guy at the door says no outside drinks. So I throw mine away just inside the door, no problem. Then he says "The kitchen is closed."  I asked him why he didn't tell me that before I threw my drink away. He said "You looked like you didn't want it anymore, buy another one" . What a jerk.

My friends and I left, there are plenty of other places to go to be mistreated in the city.
I will never go back, I will tell everyone I know to avoid it. 

if you want to be abused pick anywhere else.

let me say that i wouldn't have been as harsh as some of the other reviewers, until we were reading the reviews on the way home AFTER a terrible experience, and saying to ourselves "YES, that person is exactly right"

I mean, I wouldn't have gone so far as to say that the food wasn't smoked.  The ribs had a smoke ring, but the wings were not smoky.  

ok, start over.
service was fine, no issues
was there on Wed night - AYCE crab night.  place is rocking.  I'm thinking, WOW!!! popular

WE HAD 5 THINGS

1) st. louis ribs were NOT burned, at all.  Looked fine, except lacking flavor AND very tough & chewy.  They were fresh for sure, just not good ribs. period.

2)  Got 25. They were MOSTLY dry and overcooked/charred.  Girl took them back and got us fresh ones from the kitchen.  she happily agreed they were dry/overdone.  said the cook agreed.

2nd batch looked awesome - moist, shiny, hot... except the only flavor they had was from what had to be some kind of baste they brush on when these are on the grill.   was just an oily taste... mixed with grill char & grit.  
They looked so different, i told the owner "its an insult" that you served us that first batch of wings. 

cudos for bringing out more wings - they ain't cheap - but these aren't worth eating either.

YOU COULD HAVE OFFERED ME ALL YOU CAN EAT RIBS & WINGS and I WOULD NOT have been satisfied at any price.  Its just a waste of a meal.

3) fries that came with ribs were great.  ordered a 2nd order ($1.49) and they were not as good.  left half.  was really odd

4) baked beans have a sauce/juice in them right?  these were the goo that comes in the bean can.  not much else added.   Open a can of Van Camp's, take a bite, and thats what these were.

OK... still here... here it comes !!!!

5) Uncle Mikes has a unique approach to doing some sides.  Most places would crack open a can of green beans and all all sorts of stuff to make them flavorful (salt, chicken base, onions, pepper, etc.).    NOPE.   Not at Mikes.  They try to REMOVE ALL FLAVOR from their green beans.   I actually tricked my wife into a bite by claiming "awesome", "holy cow", and then she spit hers out and gave me a nasty look while I laughed at her.   

Talked with two other tables who were not happy either.   
Place SHOULD do well, except that the food is bad.  
Good luck.
Wouldn't expect them to stay open much longer.
The sushi and soups were delicious and presentation was quite superb. I highly recommend.
Excellent service- and fast! Even when they are packed with customers they somehow manage to get to everyone very quickly. And everyone is very friendly!
Friendly service. Great specials! Free sake Monday through Thursday. Good combinations for rolls.

Moved to Hamilton with my wife about a year ago and we were sad that we didn't try this place until now. My Mom (who is Chinese) has lived in the Mercer county area for almost 20 years and this is the best Chinese food I've had in the area so far. Definitely the best fried dumplings I've had at a Chinese restaurant and we were very impressed with their steamed flounder and singapore noodles. We were even impressed with the decor which was much less tacky than most restaurants. We definitely plan on returning in the very near future.

Stayed here for the Essence Festival. The hotel is BEAUTIFUL! It was my first time in New Orleans and I preferred to stay in a boutique hotel to get an authentic experience. It did not disappoint!...as far as that goes anyway. The staff wasn't always courteous or friendly. Some were, some weren't. I was there for 5 days so I feel like I probably saw everyone on their staff. Next time I go to New Orleans I'll give another hotel a try...but that's not to say I wouldn't stay here again. The location is perfect if you want to be close to Bourbon Street but not ON it. It's only a block away.
Really good food and attentive service. We had a number of dishes including chicken and vegetarian which were all delicious. Great to have a good Indian restaurant close by.

Hope everybody had a nice Valentine's Day yesterday! I had a great dinner which lead right into our trip to San Francisco so I'll have to write about it later! In the mean time, just wanted to post up my visit to ROAST Coffeehouse on 104 St!

It took me a long time to make my way down to ROAST but I finally did it. As much as I love the atmosphere of Transcend (may you return to downtown one day) and Credo, I think I like ROAST the best! Something about the wooden interior, the expansive seating areas and trendy wallpaper makes it a place where I'd want to sit and relax.

Joe and I went on a Sunday afternoon and the place was pretty bustling from what would have expected. Another plus: their menu is extensive, serving up specialty drinks as well (Credo, please expand, I can't drink straight coffee!). ROAST also serves food and wine after 4pm, which makes me want to return ASAP!

For that day though, we were happy with our drinks. Joe and his regular latte, decorated with their signature 'R' (to go, because he just had a cup of coffee with breakfast), and a dark chocolate mocha for me. This is the first time I've ever had a mocha where I didn't find was too bitter (aside from anything served at Starbucks, pure cream and sugar). Absolutely loved my drink!

ROAST Coffeehouse, thus far, is my favorite out of all coffee hangouts. Runner-up: Wild Earth Bakery. I only wished I discovered these places when I was in school! Perfect place to study. What's your favorite coffee place?

there was a long wait, but it was dinnertime and there was a party of 12. what else would you expect from a middle-sized establishment?

pontalba is a milestone restaurant for me because it was crowned as the first place i ever got to try alligator. and blackened, at that. it was AMAZING. and seriously, it really does taste like chicken.

for my main course, i had the ragin' cajun pasta. for a first dinner in new orleans, this hit all the right spots. gulf shrimp, andouille sausage, and crawfish tails simmered in a spicy cream sauce and served atop a bed of fettucine. if that doesn't win you over, check out my picture of it. the pasta also had a little cup of parmesan with it, but i found that i didn't need it. the meat and seafood was generous and the cajun heat was exactly what i was looking for. all food came with garlic bread, and it was honestly some of the best garlic bread i've had: thick chunks of french bread, buttered up real good, with garlic and chives sprinkled on top. MMM!

i've also included a picture of the seafood platter, which a friend of mine got and just couldn't even put a dent into it because there was so much goodness. for $19.95, you get fish, shrimp, oysters, and a crabcake. all fried. with fries.

our waiter mickey was incredibly helpful, and the chef even came out to answer questions, but the removal of a star is due to the teeny and really kind of gross bathroom. there is one stall in a TINY room, with toilet paper all over the floor, garbage overflowing from the bin, and the sink had wads of paper towel in it. really?? this was especially shocking because the restaurant itself is pretty nice. i suppose you can't win 'em all.

so basically..enjoy the food but opt for a different lavatory.

Celnik and his team always do an amazing job on my vehicles!  They are friendly, fast and extremely professional. 
Maybe with the amount that some of us pay there every month, you could consider some free coffee?  Just a thought is all. 
Keep up the good work!
Fresh, tasty, excellent Mexican food! My entire family gives it a thumbs UP!!!!

TLDR; I brought my phone in and he fixed one thing but broke 3 other things! DON'T GO HERE!

I noticed the home button on my Galaxy Note quit working, so I brought it here for repair. I spoke directly with the shop owner, and he said he'd give me a good price if I remembered to leave him a review on Yelp. When I got it back, it working again, except the screen looked bizarre! The colors were all washed out and strange. 

When I asked him about it, he looked nervous and sheepishly said, "Well, I wasn't sure if it was like that when you brought it here so I was just going to see if you'd say something." My feelings are, judging by his nervousness, he KNEW he'd done something wrong but he was just hoping I wouldn't notice!

He took it back from me, and swore up and down he'd make it right. When I got it back the second time, the screen looked normal again, but my headphone no longer fit in the headphone jack (the housing clearly had not been fastened on tightly enough). To make matters worse, when I tried to turn the WiFi or Bluetooth on using the toggles on the notification bar, it refused to register. 

I brought this to his attention and he tried to fix it but when he couldn't, he turned it around and blamed ME! He said the phone was water damaged and that's why it suddenly quit working. I did not damage the phone after I got it back from him, it was working just fine UNTIL he "fixed" it. He said I was trying to take advantage of him and he was losing money by continuing to try to fix it so he wouldn't help me any further. 

I opened a dispute with my credit card company and though they agreed that I was wronged, they said they wouldn't be able to refund me because technically he did fix the home button, which is what I had originally paid him for. They said they weren't able to force him to pay me for the damages he did to the rest of my phone. So basically, I'd have to contact a lawyer.

So I was left with a phone with a working home button, but no WiFi or Bluetooth function and a weird headphone jack. I ended up having to buy a new phone! 

I still get mad when I think about it now. I'm kind of quiet and don't like to scream and carry on, and I was already so frustrated by the situation that I just gave up fighting him. I lost so much time and money driving back and forth from St Pete to Tampa trying to work with this guy. 

The experience definitely taught me not to allow people to walk all over me though. Lately I have been considering pursing legal action but figured I should start by posting this warning for everyone else. I don't think people like this should be able to get away with ripping others off! I think at the very least I should have my old phone replaced.

We found this place on our last night in Philadelphia and only wish we had found it sooner! Devon, our bartender was awesome and trivia night was hilarious! Everyone we met there was fun and welcoming and made this one of the best highlights of our Philly trip! We hope to return:)

The 45 minute wait was well worth it, especially since you have drinks while you wait! The staff here at Tavern were super attentive and really helpful in giving suggestions on what to order. We got the maple fondue and it was incredible, you got to try a little bit of everything. The red velvet waffles were out of this world, the blueberry cornmeal waffles were a slam dunk, the Frosted Flakes crusted French toast was life changing. The sausages were great, the chicken was very spicy but overall great and the fruit was super fresh and sweet. The eggs benedict were really good but very large. All in all I would come back again in a heartbeat!!

WE LOVE TAVERN BRUNCH
Finally!! I found authentic Mexican food !!! Tacos are delicious!!! Having a drive thru is a huge plus when you just want to bring food home without the fuss of going inside !!!!!!
Basically, some of the best Mexican food in St. Louis.  Always  good, fast and friendly.  Often see a large Hispanic crowd enjoying a meal so you know it's the real deal!

Had dinner here last week.  Tapas plates were good. I think we had one of everything between four people!  Fish tacos were ok.  Nothing special.  The fish in one of the tacos was a bit burnt.  They were more than gracious and took it off the bill.    All in all a good experience.  

Food was sort of interesting and quite good.  Not the best Nashville has to offer, but nice for a casual dinner.  

Washrooms were terribly messy.  Not part of the restaurant since you have to go out an inner door into a hallway for the rest of the building to find it.  

Cocktails are good, and they have a happy hour!

Simply the best neighborhood coffee shop.

-The baristas are charming and excellent at their trade
-The actual shop is small, but forces you to get friendly with your neighbors
-The pastries are scrumptious
-And the coffee products? EXCELLENT.

Like this location for the convenience, but I prefer the Butler location.  Same food, but the atmosphere at Butler is better.  This location is more like a place where you see, and stop in, whereas Butler is more like a neighborhood feel.  However, the service here (esp Slap) is great.  Food served hot, quickly and they check on you just enough.  I was reading and she just came by to clear the plates and leave more coffee and cream.  Either place is great -- give it a try!

Absolutely excellent,  only wish I was closer,  but since I'll be in St.Petes, I'm going to try and make this my regular spot. I had a gel manicure,  I forgot who i was with,  but she was meticulously detailed,  especially with my cuticles and shaping.  They have a great polish selection, and a nice nail art display.  I got a opalescent dark purple for Halloween,  which still looks great, but i won't post because I'm a grower and my "roots" are showing.  Most importantly- hygenic and clean,  clean,  CLEAN. I have no issues paying more money so I can relax and not worry about an infection.

I then had a blowout with James, which was phenomenonal. I moved from miami and the first two establishments i tried had lackluster blowouts that fall flat the next morning.  I'm posting a picture of my blowout FOUR days after having it done.  I utilized a little dry shampoo and got to day 5 with my hair looking amazing.  I didn't get to snap my hair any sooner but it was exactly what I wanted- smooth, volumnious, ms.america curls and done in an hour. Moroccan oil backbar, and they offer a complimentary drink i believe. Andrea at the front desk was very welcoming,  and the Pandora station "crystal castle" was perfect salon ambiance.
pretty standard take-out Chinese, good for a quick lunch.  Reasonable prices ($5-$6 at lunch).  A fair amount of vegetarian stuff.
This casino is one of the cleanest and friendliest I've been to.  We are visiting from Arizona and were able to ride our bikes over here from the RV park we were staying at.  Highly  recommend
The place was aight.  I would not saw they have the best dessert but it's interesting. If you have a date, and want a place to experience, come to this spot.  Not bad.
Been in the area for a long time and mannys rocks!! Lol top 5 cheesesteak! And im from philly i know lol. Every one else burns their food... And burnt food sux.

I wanted to give this place more stars but after what happened tonight, I just couldn't. Check in yesterday went smoothly. The front desk agent was lovely and we got great room with a view even though we booked third party. Unfortunately, the room was not the cleanest. There were marshmallows on the floor and a lot of the counter surfaces were not wiped down. I didn't see it as too big of a deal but I expect a 4 star hotel to be clean. Valet parking is $40 a night. That seems pretty steep. Also, internet is an additional $11 a day. Keep those fees in mind if you want to book here. My biggest complaint is what happened to us tonight. We received a knock on our door at about 9:30 pm. I had just got back from getting a few groceries. It had already been a long day because I had two kiddos that were not feeling too well. A man was at the door. He did not introduce himself or anything. I seriously thought it was some drunk guy at the wrong door until I noticed the tag on his coat. He said that he had received several noise complaints about us. I looked at my daughter confused and said, "Were we being too loud?".The guy looked at me and said he had been listening at our door for a few minutes and yes, we were being too loud! What in the world?!?!? How creepy is that?! So not only do you not introduce yourself as a manager or front desk agent or anything, you then tell me you have been sitting outside my room door listening. Also, if he had received several complaints then why didn't I receive a phone call after the first one? Surely, if we were being too loud I would have liked to have been informed. It was so odd. We were gone for the hour prior to that so none of it made sense to me. I am a full-time traveler and I have stayed at many hotels. However, this is the first time I have ever received a noise complaint and this is the first time I have ever felt the need to write a negative review. There has to be a better procedure for addressing a noise complaint. Surely a phone call at first and surely introducing yourself would be standard. Geez! I am seriously upset by this. For the price of this hotel, I just can't recommend it. Also, the hot tub was not working today and the pool is pretty tiny but it was nice that they at least had a pool. 

Positives: 
Good location 
Pool
Unique History
Unique Decor

Negative:
Hefty Valet fee
Small pool
Rude staff
Paper thin walls
Dirty room

This is a nice track but the service is horrible. We paid for two races. The first race we waited 20 minutes for. The second race was not until 2 hours later. I think this is ridiculous. I am not sure if this is a scam to try and get you to spend more money in the arcade or what but I would never return he again even if it was free.

Luke is a great place no matter the time  of day. Food is excellent and happy hour is the best in NOLA. Staff is friendly, kind and very helpful with any questions you may have.
Shay the bartender is the best. And you have to sit at the bar down by the oyster shucking. Shucker Sean is awesome. He likes to be called Kenny Stills.
Thanks guys see you soon.

They have everything but a pool and a hot  tub.  They have a trainer that is VERY for your fitness there, Twila, and they are very very affordable.  All the equipment is in great shape and the place is VERY clean!

Although we were seated by the door, the experience was enjoyable. The four courses left us feeling just full enough. The food was absolutely delicious. And Chef Sbraga was very warm and hospitable to us as well as the rest of his staff.

This place is not what it used to be. The staff is anything but friendly, and the cake is mediocre at best.. not to mention you will pay much more for a cake the same size as neighboring bakeries. Save your money, morning and tastebuds and go to Maurice's or Antoines!!! Can't say enough good things about either of those places- but it's definitely a pass on gambiNOs!

As always I rate by similar types of places.  This place caters to teenagers.  Somewhat expensive.  Medium sized portions and long waits even if it is not busy.  If you have never been here you will need to find a local middle schooler for a tutorial.   Pretty sure the menu is in some sort of teenager code. Taste is good and it is fun to visit once.   Most adults this will be a one time kind of place.

Midtown is the Mecca of liquor stores.  It has the class of Woodland Wines and the selection of Sinker's plus Weiss plus...well, let's just say they have a better selection than anywhere else in the city.  I was a bit surprised and overwhelmed when I first entered Midtown; the place is literally a superstore.  It's easily the size of a Whole Foods or a Walgreen's, but it's stocked with nothing but liquor and fine wines.

Due to Tennessee's nonsensical liquor laws, you of course cannot purchase beer at Midtown Wine & Spirits.  You can, however, find pretty much any wine or liquor imaginable.  I even finally located a bottle of my much sought-after Fireball!  It took a while, but I knew one of the upscale liquor joints in town would stock it.  And here's the best part: a fifth only cost me $14 plus tax!

The merchants at Midtown were very helpful and kind, and each one of them who spotted me carrying the bottle of Fireball called out to me with a resounding, "Alright!  Fireball!"  They have a weird little character known as the Cork Dork (a wine cork with the features of a human), who picks weekly wine specials.  They even have a massive concrete Cork Dork overlooking the parking lot.  There's always plenty of parking, and shopping at Midtown Wine & Spirits takes all the seediness out of liquor-browsing.  It's a liquor and wine store you could take your mother to.

Thank you to the management for reinventing as such a great, neighborhood appropriate restaurant. Family friendly while maintaining excellent quality and flavors. Nice selection of wine, but allows BYOB. Staff are super, and the space is beautiful. Value for the reasonable price. I almost want to keep you my little secret, but know it won't be long before word gets out. Looking forward to many delicious meals with you.

We were so excited to find a dog friendly place for breakfast this morning! The staff was super friendly, and the owner brought out some water for my pup and even hung out to visit for a few. On top of all this, the food was phenomenal. Simple, but amazing. By far the best restaurant breakfast I've had in YEARS.

We have eaten here several times and each time the quality of food seems to be declining a bit.  We took our daughters who were visiting for the fathers day weekend here for lunch most recently.
The food was ok.  not great.
It is a beautiful place and if the food was better, you would get a lot more business

HOLY WOW!!!   This is a fantastic dinner spot!  I had the Shrimp and grits for dinner and started with the crab cake!  I really enjoyed this  experience.  The  service is spot on - the food is excellent!   The desserts makes this fat kid happy!!  The bread pudding is really excellent!

This place is the definition of no-frills. The food is decent and plentiful. The decor
pretty standard. Another reviewer called it a "hole in the wall," and the description
fits. You order at the counter, but it can get dicey if you haven't grabbed a 
table first if the place is crowded. Otherwise you might end up with a plate of
hot food on the curb.

I've tried the Tom Kha (tofu), the Pad Thai (tofu) and the mango with sticky rice. Easily some of the best Thai dishes I've ever had. So excited to keep coming back for more :)

Also! Sit outside!! The ambience/decor is so cute :)

I've been to Pho 97 Vietnamese Restaurant more times than I like to admit.  All the food here is pretty standard and similar to any other Vietnamese restaurant you will find all over the world.  I swear they have the same menu from a place I know in California and this other place I been to in Germany.  I always get the Large Bowl of Pho with all the good stuff (beef, tendon, tripe, squish stuff, stringy stuff, etc.)  The prices are reasonable and the staff pretty much leave you alone to eat.  This place is a safe bet.

First time at Besito and the service was excellent. It was really our waitress that made our night out as a family really pleasant. The food was good and the restaurant itself is quite family friendly. I got the Carne Asada, which was good, however, I wasn't a fan of the corn tortillas, I prefer flour. The guacamole was awesome, they make it right in front of you. The salsa is house made and was delicious.

While a bit cramped for dine in during the morning hours, it is more than worth it. The donuts are amazing, but I'd recommend the breakfast biscuit sandwiches. Great coffee, and great food, can't go wrong!
Good beer selection and nice apps and sides to snack on with at a very reasonable price

We arrived at this restaurant around 6:30 on a Saturday evening and were a bit behind the crowd.  The wait would have been at least 30 minutes so we found another place to eat.  But it got such good reviews that I made a reservation for the following evening.  Complete success this time!  Our table was ready and waiting.  Service was fast and friendly.  We were even able to watch Sunday night football with their three televisions.  We ordered and it was literally the fastest I've ever received my sushi in a restaurant.  Ever!  This makes the all you can eat option a great option since you don't have to wait forever if you order a few rolls at a time.  Our favorites were the Playboy and the the Winwin.  Delicious!!  The staff is outstanding, the wait staff is super friendly and all the chefs said goodbye when we left even thought the restaurant was packed!  Will definitely return when we visit Reno again.  Highly recommended!!

Just picked up some delicious Fancy Fortune Cookies for a party we are having Saturday Night. Exceptional personal customer service. Custom colors for our party were no problem, the order was ready ahead of schedule and the product was exceptional.  

I enjoy being treated like I matter when patronizing a business, and Erin and the entire team definitely provide that experience.  The perfect unexpected addition to any party. 

Highly recommended!

It was not bad, I had the jerk chicken dinner platter and my friend had the mango chicken dinner platter. We also ordered jerk chicken wings for an app. The jerk chicken holds a very nice kick and I enjoyed it tho the jerk wings were very burnt and dry. The dinner platters were more moist and tasty and over all very good.

Loved it!!!  We've been twice now and both times the pizzas were great. One time we ordered in and everyone order personal size pizzas. It was great that everyone could customize their pizzas and get just what they wanted. The second time we ordered online. The ordering process was very easy and again the pizzas were tasty!  We will definitely be going back!
Screw Pat's and Geno's! Joe's is the best by far! The fries are always crispy and I personally prefer larger chunks of meat in my cheesesteaks. The milkshakes are incredible also!

pretty good food, I definitely left stuffed.  I really enjoyed the sushi selection and we even got fresh beef cooked on a hot plate and brought straight to our table, included in the price! I would go back.
Great happy hour specials for drinks & apps! The spicy capellini is amazing!   It is always so crowded because it is a great place- one of my favorites in the area!

Micha's catered a family party I had last week.  The food was delicious, hot and very appealing.  They deliver right to your home and help you set up the food.  The price couldn't be beat... I chose the Traditional Mexican Buffet to feed 20 adults for under $200 including tax and delivery.  All my guests loved the food and talked about doing this again for our next party.

Came in with my family of three and ordered very simple entree's. The server was nice though had to repeatedly tell us our food was on its way. An hour later after notifying management of our displeasure our meal comes out a cheesesteak,salad, and pasta dish. Eager to finally eat they screwed up the pasta dish and by then I was fed up and told them I'm not happy and will not eat anything else on there menu. All they did was take that pasta dish cost off the check. That is very unacceptable customer service. I would be very careful about going to this establishment. Unacceptable!!!
Best beer and atmosphere in tampa. This is where real people hang out.

Good burgers, good beer on tap. Last two times have had same server, and she's SOOO SLOW! She insists on waiting multiple tables before putting orders in, and waiting on multiple orders before serving drinks to tables. Yes, this method limits her trips to/from bar, but sometimes people need a water! Would be a 4 or even 5 star if got different service. Had better service on 1st of the 3 visits.

I have eaten here many times.... the food is fantastic, the atmosphere is cool and the owner is Very personable !!!
I always recommend them ..

Dr. Caley is excellent. I came in experiencing pain in my elbow and left arm. I left feeling like a different person. He has great energy and knowledge. We share a love of Crossfit and he was acutely aware of what I was feeling and how to help me.

I went here once before to have a pedicure. I then went to another place for acrylic nails I didn't like. Went back to Lilly to have them removed and got a gel polish. I love it here abd will always keep coming back. David was soo friendly and funny and the rest of the staff was great. I wouldn't change a thing about it.

Food was excellent. We ordered the daal and chicken and beef skewers. The daal had great flavor, rice was delicious and meat was tender and flavorful. I've spent time in Afghanistan and was excited to see the popular Afghan dish Qabooli Palow on the menu-will definitely try that next time.

The place itself was very clean, quiet, and decorated in tasteful Middle Eastern decor. The owners were extremely nice and attentive. 

Highly recommend!

The Bourbon Street Breakfast is really good and a great value. It's basically a dish of red beans and rice topped with a fried egg and split-and-toasted corn muffin. I had one today and it really hit the spot! Great comfort food. I also tried the gator sausage on a stick which was really good.

This is the most authentic Italian pizza place in St. Louis, hands down. Takes you straight to the south of italy (I spent there over a month and ate pizza quasi-daily). It is more pricey than your average non-fast food pizza spot, but it's well worth it.

Comfortable ambiance, Chix piccata to die for, and the white bean dip and provaka was AMAZING!  We went for a drink in the afternoon and then back for dinner the same night. The bartender has been there for 29 years and is a great guy :)

I'm not even a doughnut person, but the "cronut" was seriously delicious. Layers + glaze = heaven. 
Husband got bagel sandwich on a jalapeno bagel and was happily surprised to find it was heavy on the jalapeno. 
Didn't try coffee yet, but I have a feeling we'll be back!

St. Louis and Chicago meet...literally.  Had my Chicago friends in and brought them to Pi.  Everyone enjoyed the pizza, even the out of towners.  We ordered two pizzas, thin and thick...2 salads and garlic bread.  The crust is excellent...crispy cornmeal.  Lots of veggie options...we had the western addition.  It had our table agreeing with Obama...pizza good enough for the prez.

Service was good.  Drew was out waiter and was super-friendly and patient with our large group.  

Atmosphere is fun and upbeat.  

In the past the wait has been something we have run into.  

I recommend PI

After seeing a sub my coworker brought back from lunch i took a pic and sent it to my girlfriend. Next day we went. We love yellow sub now. Bring your appetite as they are stuffed with deliciousness. Small inside and the dolls are a little creepy but food is so good. I recommend them to everyone now.

The best fedex center ever! I am always greeted right away and the people here are just so polite and a pleasure to interact with. I've only shipped things from here but if I ever need to print anything I would go here.

My dinner options were rather limited on account of it being Christmas Day, so I chose Luke based on the reviews and the fact that they were serving their Reveillon menu on Dec 25 as well. Who doesn't want to experience Reveillon when they're in NOLA?

There's a lot that's good about this restaurant. There's also a lot that isn't quite up to par.

Pros:
- Happy Hour: 50-cent oysters? Pretty sure I died and went to heaven. And they were huge, succulent, deliciously briny Gulf Coast oysters! Some were easily twice the size of normal oysters
- Delicious cocktails: Seeing as they were half off because of HH, I indulged and got both the Champagne au Peche (Champagne and fresh peach puree) and the St. Charles Streetcar (St. Germain, pear vodka, Champagne). Both were tasty and refreshing

Cons:
- The Reveillon menu left a lot to be desired. For the first course, my boyfriend got the shrimp remoulade and I got the crispy sweetbread with beluga lentils and blood orange brown butter vinaigrette. The remoulade was flavorless and forgettable. The sweetbread was actually well-cooked (very crisp) but got to be too rich after a while.
- The turtle soup and seafood gumbo that made up our second course were both terrible. There was maybe a kernel of turtle meat in the entire bowl of soup and the gumbo lacked seasoning. Our third course consisted of crispy flounder stuffed with crab, shrimp and mirliton dressing, and a rib roast with oyster dressing, turnip and apple puree, and cherry compote. - 
- The roast was decent if a bit chewy, but the flounder was so rich that my boyfriend couldn't finish it. 
- Our final course was dessert--bread pudding with vanilla ice-cream and hot buttered pecan sauce for him, apple tart with caramel and praline ice-cream for me. The praline ice-cream was great, but the bread pudding was too sweet in my opinion and the apple tart was virtually inedible on account of being too dry.
- Service was also disappointing for a restaurant with this reputation. Our server was nice enough, but she would disappear for long blocks of time during inopportune moments when we really needed her

All in all, I'm glad I did a Reveillon dinner in NOLA, but I don't think I'll be recommending Luke to anyone.

We were just strolling downtown after the shops closed early on Sunday of Labor Day Weekend and since there was no cover charge decided to check it out!

There were two dance floors, one inside which played hiphop and the outside had EDM with a bar and cabanas. Multiple restrooms and the lines weren't too long for the drinks.

Sex Panther was Djing at the Sunday Session Labor Day Weekend Event. It was awesome. The people there knew how to have fun and drinks weren't too bad either.  Everyone enjoyed the music and when the sunsetted they had lights that went with the music. 

Cool place to check out!
Deep fried pickles, enough said.  Great happy hour, half off pitchers...
Such an awesome place to hang out. Went on Wednesday for trivia night, a blast. definitely recommend it
The last few times we've been here the food wasn't great. The chicken was very dry and stringy. We may give it one more try just because the options in the area are limited.

This is not a place to go if you are really hungry, or in a hurry. That's not say the food, such as it is, and the beer is bad. There just isn't a lot to say about a place whose claim to fame is grilled cheese sandwiches. 
This isn't really your normal restaurant or brewery; it's more like a family room, complete with board games

The building is beautiful inside and out. The place is First Class with all fresh made,in house dishes. We had a large party but our food came out in a timely manner and was hot. Everyone enjoyed what they ordered and the service was great! We will definitely be back next time we are in Reno!!
Great ambiance. Instructor is great and offers assistance and modifications as needed. Have only attended the prenatal series but enjoyed it very much.

The New Chipotle Mexican Grill conveniently located in Largo Mall, across from Chik-fil-a on Ulmerton Road. Completely brand new building and restaurant. Same consistant quality food Chipotle is known for. Great new addition to the area!

Too noisy, slow service, waiter didn't open wine bottle, waited excessively long for food to be served, portion size too large, no option to order smaller size portions, prices high for pasta - $17.00 for lasagna!  Only one bathroom for entire restaurant; take-out customers standing next to table while diners eating - very annoying.  Overall, a very unpleasant experience and not at all enjoyable.  Would definitely not recommend this restaurant.  Management needs to train staff better and work on improving service.
Always a favorite for my wife and I.  The Salmon, the Scallops, and The Chocolate Mousse are my trio of choice!

When you first walk in the door you are treated by a small dingy front desk with cheap tacky furniture. Electrical cords are hanging out all over the desk, talk about a fire hazard! If you come at night good luck finding a clerk! when we came there were transients rooming the halls looking for a bathroom,no one at the front desk to tell them to leave. The rooms have charm with the brick walls but it ends there.
The rooms are furnished with cheap cheap furniture .everything is falling apart. The bathroom is a mess! The big round shower tub has cracks and mold and mildew everywhere. They have one hot water heater for every floor , which means you share a heater with 4 other rooms. Get up early or there is no hot water to shower with! Te shower curtain is hanging by a dollar store tension rod that has mildew as old as the hotel. The hand bar to grab to enter the shower is half black from mold and mildew and half of the cheap gold color showing through the mildew. The ceiling in the tub is chipping away.
Dust everywhere! Housekeeping doesn't clean well.we had a cockroach in the Closet, when we called the front desk they just offered bug spay that we could go down and get. There was hair in the sheets when we arrived. Hair on the bathroom floor.
Our fridge only had one setting, freeze. We called three days in a row and now one ever came to fix it. 
The beds are old and very uncomfortable. 
The kitchen is run down. Cracks in the floor. Peeling counters.dirt caked in the corners of the floor and counters. They take. No pride in this hotel, when they fix or add a new item, such as a blow dryer in the bath room, they don't bother to attach with screws! We had a towel bar fall to the floor as soon as we touched it. They don't bother to touch up paint, you can tell where old items on the walls used to hang.
The patio on the balcony is run down! Looks like it is more of a storage place than a balcony.
Do not waist your time or money here!

In a world with "gucci" burgers and steakhouses, something was lost. That was good decently prices chunk of meat. This is where Cody's beef and beans pull away from the bullshit. They have t-bone that is the best deal in town. Well cooked as well. They also serve soda in cowboy boot shaped glasses. if that doesn't get you there...

You just cant go wrong. Its nice a quiet, never a line. Also read the "raw" meat disclaimer while you wait for your food. Its the best.

This place has a cool vintage vibe! Between the funky teal colored walls, classic rock on the radio and some old school seating, you'd swear you were back in 1960 or 70! But that aside, this is really a neighborhood diner with a small staff, honest prices, serving comfort food classics for breakfast and lunch.

The Nook is tucked in the back of a shopping center on the corner of Vassar and Kietzke. There's no way you'd see it from the road and the signage is minimal. My friend, who I'd met for lunch, has worked across the street for several years and had never been before. I hate hearing that kind of stuff because they are located right near several large businesses that could be regular customers.

The Nook is, well a nook in the shopping center. They have a small menu and serve breakfast all day, which is a nice treat, but today I was in the mood for lunch so I ordered a turkey club on two slices of bread, and my friend had a garden salad. My sandwich was good, with well toasted bread, crispy bacon, crunchy lettuce, fresh tomato, and impressively, house roasted, thick cut turkey breast. It was served with crispy fries and a garnish of parsley a black olive, and a few shavings of carrot, which is about what you'd expect at a diner! 

The garden salad was well, garden variety. Iceberg lettuce, black olives, tomatoes, cucumbers, and carrots. It all looked fresh and crisp, but nothing to write home about. 

It's a quiet place to grab a bite, sit and talk, or have a lunch meeting, worthy of your support, but nothing about it is calling me back anytime soon.
I'm going to start coming here every week I love the brunch menu! the sandwiches and pastries are all so good.

We were here during our weekend out in Nashville. The last night in Nashville we came here. They have their own parking lot which here is very important so hard to park in Nashville. Atmosphere is nice relaxed. Clean restaurant which I so appreciate. The service is wonderful very attentive. We came here with another couple we traveled with. We ordered the Brussels spouts, which were wonderful, filled with flavor. We both ordered the chicken paiaya. WOW lots of food it was huge. We could have ordered one and spit it between the 4 of us. It was delicious. I have never had paiaya before since I do not eat seafood. This was a treat to try something I normally would not be able to eat. We enjoyed out meal very much and took lots of left overs back with us.

Take it from a life-long New Orleans Native,
this is the real deal.

Schnucks store itself: 3 stars
Schnucks Central Bakery: 0 stars.

This review has nothing to do with the store itself other than the store carries a full line of bakery items baked at Schnuck's own central bakery that are baked with or frosted with hydrogenated oils. I thought a government mandate by the FDA was initiated a couple of years ago with a 3 year compliance that all trans fats (non naturally occuring) are to be removed from all foods by January 1, 2018. Schnucks, on the other hand, are putting the trans fats right back in. I may be anti Walmart but at least they frost their cakes and bake their pies with palm oil. Walmart even ordered their suppliers to quit using trans fats by 2015. What kind of oil is Schnucks currently using to fry their donuts in?  The same hydrogenated oil?  Read the labels (ingredients). Hydrogenated oils can even be found in Schnuck's fresh baked cookies. It's everywhere.  I'm thinking this is nothing short of a cost saving measure by the front office. (nobody else wanted those 5 gallon pails of partially hydrogenated soybean and/or cottonseed oil that Schnucks bought on the cheap and are currently stockpiling). In others words, Schnucks cares more about their immediate bottom line than the future health of their customer(s). I thought you guys were better than this. I guess I was wrong. Now where am I supposed to buy my freshly baked goods? Walmart?

I was impressed with the atmosphere and the menu (half off all food on Sundays) but the service fell a little short. There were only two people at the bar, two tables of 2 and another table of 4 but it took the bartender 30 minutes to pour our drinks. I am worried what service would be like on a very busy night. I will go back especially for their Sunday special. It's a great spot for date night.
Delish! The ambience is fun and takes one back in time. A tad noisy and our server needs some coaching re the wines but otherwise great meal.

Interesting menu. I ordered the grilled chicken thighs with farro, gochugaru (sriracha-like) sauce, mint and cilantro. Balanced dish, good textures, and perfectly cooked protein.

We shared homemade biscuits with herb cream cheese, honey, and black pepper, and they were excellent.

Wife had grilled cheese with cranberry and walnut, raclette and Gouda cheese, and a black truffle honey. Good flavors, but lacking in texture. We couldn't identify the fruit or nuts, and I couldn't taste any truffle in the honey, though there were visible shavings. Was delicious, but not very well balanced, and felt very heavy. She at half and saved half for later.

I enjoyed a cocktail infused with CBD oil. Very tasty.

I like that there are no substitutions, no reservations, and no straws here. We came around 10:30 for brunch. We were seated around 11:15, and finished our meal around 12:15. Would return again.

I got the fried chicken that was on the menu it was pretty good. Very tasty. Worth 21 dollars? I don't think so. Probably worth 15 or something. 

My fiancée and I came at a down time. Wasn't too busy or anything. When I asked the waitress what she would recommend, I felt as though she kind of didn't know what to say and pulled the "they're are my favorite" type of line. 

The environment was loud but the live performance was great.

In a food truck food court, one food truck stood out in stark contrast above the others, it was Twisted Iron. Why? they had a line.  We were at the front of this line and I was happy for that, because it was chilly under the Bridge at Pierce street market. 

Both the husbeast and I got Chicken & Waffles. The wait time was short but the food portions were large. 3 juicy pieces of chicken atop a large waffle, a serving of smuckers breakfast syrup and I THINK It was honey Mustard, but since I don't use it, I gave that to the husband. 

The chicken was good. VERY VERY GOOD. it had a nice flavour and was perfectly cooked.  THe only thing about the waffle I can say negative is that it wasn't light. it was very heavy and dense, and that's not the way I prefer my waffles. Bt the flavour was spot on and yum to my mouth! 

I ate all the chicken and 1/4 the waffle. The husbeastie was a member of the clean plate club!

Support awesome, local businesses!!
Fresh, fun, flavorful and friendly...the food is as good as the service!!
The orzo salad is ridiculously good!

Everything from the live band, the bar, the drink and the food are absolutely amazing! The lamb meatballs were delicious, so was the duck leg confit, and the apple cobbler and rum raisin ice cream that is home made.
This restaurant is a neighborhood gem. You can get really delicious and healthy food fast here. The owners are also super sweet. It's a perfect place for takeout.

I  went to Urban Angels 3 years ago because of the positive yelp reviews and I'm so happy I did because I absolutely love this place.  Im in my 30's and this is the first time i found a hair stylist and salon that i love and don't cheat on.  I see Taray but I don't think you'll go wrong with any of the stylist because everyone walking out looks great. Really you'll get the best cut you've ever had.  Also, their coloring is beautiful. I have brown hair and don't color it but i see ladies with blonde hair in there all the time and their color job looks so pretty I wish I could try it out.  
I highly recommend this salon

Family came here for lunch and it was fantastic. The mussels appetizer was delicious and everyone enjoyed their entrees. The fried shrimp was also very good, and the fish tacos are great for lunch. Highly recommend.
This is a great addition to the neighborhood.  Great place for grooming and great prices.

For a vinophile living in Philly, Tria is true love. 

Happy hour wine specials are just ok... BUT the cheese specials are great!

Veekoo is simply one of the best Asian restaurants I've ever been to. The great food, the excellent service and atmosphere are always consistent. I prefer the Japanese menu and the sushi is always superb.  My kids usually go for the Chinese menu and they always love their meals. Be sure to make reservations during prime time on Friday and Saturday nights. It gets crowded!

Bulk Barn is a cornucopia of wholesale goods - there is literally everything anyone who eats or cooks could need. Candy, herbs, spices, nuts, cereal, even pet snacks - I literally could not keep track of everything available here. I also made some discoveries - dried mulberries, for one, honey-roasted sunflower seeds, assorted snack foods - there is even a section of organic foods. Some items are available in individual packages, like teas and cookies, but for the most part, everything is in bulk bins. You don't even have to fiddle with pens and twist ties, writing down bin numbers. Just fill your bag, tie it shut, and the checkout person seems to know what you've got. I had a lot of fun browsing and can't wait to get back here to actually get some healthy snacks.

So wife and I hit up this joint right after the new owners took over and they bent over backwards to see that we were happy with the food. So basically, there are my thoughts:

1.  They do RC Cola products, which is AWESOME!
2. Their gyro is strong, and their crinkle-cut fries hit the spot.
3. I tried the Sonoran Dog, and it was overcooked. I was sad kitty, but understand that mistakes happen.

To me, this is the type of place that will be hit or miss because it's still getting its feet underneath it, and yes, good help is hard to find.  They are open to suggetions, and are looking to make a name in the local east side community.  I wish them the best and plan on returning soon to try something new.

I'm a huge fan of this location! I have gotten designer clothing for under $5 (Paige Denim, Banana Republic, Aeropostale, and Max Studio.....). The store is organized and the women's section is the bulk of the store. The men's section isn't as huge on variety, so I only end up grabbing one thing, if that. The children's section is small... so if you're here on the hunt for children or toddlers I suggest you try Nesting House on Passyunk or in West Philadelphia for Goodwill-like prices.

Tips:
Shop during the week: less traffic, more freedom to shop without huge crowds.
Pay attention to the discounted color tags: in the front of the store, the 50% color tags will be posted, so you can shop for even deeper discounts!
Grab a cart: you'll need it!
Holds: items cannot be put on hold, so come prepared to take your item (furniture or large items) with you.

Hot Items:
Wedding dresses, formal gowns, stiletto heels, high end department items for $10.00- ( boutique items begin at 10.00)
A salesperson told me that a few customers actually buy here and resell items on posh mark and eBay.. I totally believe it!

This has quickly become one of our favorite places to go!! The lunch special is amazing, the jalapeno popper pizza is the best pizza I have ate. But for me, the scape goat salad is Heaven on earth!!! Mixed greens, bacon, tomato, pine nuts and a heap of Goat cheese......so good. The creamy balsamic is one that I wish they would bottle and sell!!! Try this place, you will not be dissapointed.
Once again I love this place!! So excited that they added bao pork buns (and other varieties) to their new menu. Definitely worth a visit!

I love me some spicy salsa and thanks to the yelpers they brought me here. I didn't get to explore other Indianapolis Mexican Restaurants but I didn't really need to.

I don't know if this is a chain or not but the all around service and food was excellent. I loved their habanero salsa, very very spicy.

I feel like it is just a courtesy for me to order tacos because I feel so bad for eating all of their salsa.
Ordered to go for lunch and got a potato skins. Potato skins tasted fine, everyone else's food was good as well. Everything was cooked fine. It was nothing spectacular but it did the job.

Never been treated so rude and with such attitudes.  I tan at this salon weekly i Bought in September a lotion for $76  with 100%rebate in bonus bucks was told it could be used with specials and upgrades.   Today wanted to buy sunless special being advertised and told cant use it because it's a "bundle" special. Not a single session. Explained that that was not was told to me at time of purchase of lotion and the two girls just gave horrible attitudes.  The blonde should never be around customers rolling her eyes and wanting to argue  Made the fact that I was upset worse.  Not someone you want representing your salon

This is a great place to go for mexican food and magarita's. The food is great -my personal favorite are the steak fajitas! The margaritas are good enough to sing about!! Best part is the pricing is 1st-date reasonable! 
I am not usually a fan of the 'chain' mexican restaurants but this place does a lot of things right!

Delicious fresh corn tortillas cooked daily in the store.  Wonderful produce but really iffy packaged deli meats and cheeses.  Good dates but mold and even water in packages.  Great place to shop if you know what you're doing and store has a welcoming multicultural atmosphere.

We just stayed here for 6 nights.  The highlight of our stay was the morning breakfasts, and the staff.  Excellent customer service, friendly, and very efficient.  Our room was clean, and kept that way by the great housekeeping staff.  The heat and air conditioning worked flawlessly, and we really liked the amenities in our room.  The room was spacious, we used the fridge to store drinks, but found ourselves frequenting the complimentary soda during the evening hours, a very nice touch.  There is also a food kiosk available 7/24 at the front desk, another nice feature.  There was a big group of team volleyball players that kept the place hopping on Friday and Saturday.  The staff kept up, keeping things stocked and clean during the busy hours.  There was a bit of noise from all the kids, doors slamming, running in the halls, and general loud voices.  To be expected with the weekend crowds.  All was quiet after 10pm, thankfully.  Our TV worked great, we really liked the convenient outlets in the room.  Great for charging all of our electronics.  I know this hotel is on the lower end of the luxury spectrum, but we had a really good experience here.  One thing we felt could make the hallways quieter was some sound absorbing wall coverings, maybe some canvas pictures etc.  That was our only critique, and really it was a very small one.

AMAZING! I consider myself a food connoissuer, I keep a list of restuarants to go to on my phone and rate them as I go. This way I know where to tell people who are visiting to go and I can remind myself where to go back to when I have friends and family come visit. Village Whiskey was revisited! 

Aside from their pretty legit alcohol list, their food is delicious. Ive had their fish sandwich, pickled beets, duck fat fries and kentucky hot brown. The pickled beets are worth going back for on their own. My friends have had the pulled pork sandwich and burger. They all raved about their entrees, not one complaint. Jose Garces got it right.

Small place, great atmosphere, great for a date or just a night out with your friends to get good food accompanied by a good drink. The prices are reasonable and you really just cant beat the quality. Id go back again and again.

Excellent!  Worth the ride into the bywater! Group of 4 thoroughly enjoyed the Eggs Benny, chicken and biscuits, monte cristo, boudin balls and scotch eggs.  Deluxe Bloody Mary was a meal in itself.  The service was also impeccable, our drinks were never half empty!

Hooters I love you. No seriously I love everything about you. 

Is there a more consistent chain? 

Almost as much as their food I love hooters clientele (wait, I love myself?). If I wrote a book about how to not parent a child I could use so many amazing examples, specifically at Tyrone Hooters after 9 pm. 

Hey it's 9:30, I think I'll let my 3 year old sit at a bar rotating between sucking on a giant marshmallow and licking a deliciously frosted cupcake. Good plan, mom. 

This is also apparently the go to place for dad's weekend with their kid. Know what's cuter than your two year old watching a UFC fight at Hooters at 10pm? Responsible parenting and well behaved children. 

Yes. Five stars for sure.

My sister and brother in law have both bought cars at Conicelli so was looking forward to a wonderful experience. I was greeted warmly by my sales person, Tone and he is a real go getter, friendly, funny, contagious laugh and felt like he became a friend of mine when the process was completed. He was not pushy, honest, easy to talk to and can see why he is one of the top sales people! Most of the employees are friendly including the Sales Manager, Andrew who was easy to work with when we were constructing the framework for the deal and was very flexible with his negotiations and did his best to let me walk out with a car that night and felt that he gave me a good deal. They have a good selection and am grateful that I did not have to venture to other Honda dealers in Pottstown or Reading. I'm also excited about their program of free state inspections as long as you own the car and my sister is excited about her referral bonus of sending me to Conicelli. It's a family owned business with some very "Nice" people and can see why they are one of the top dealerships in Philly and the state of Pennsylvania.

First impressions are incredibly important. The first impression I got of the new Khyber was during their grand opening this past Wednesday... I got their just in time for the hour of free Sly Fox and bourbon, friendly, generous and attentive bartenders were walking around with beers to give away, no annoying wait at the bar to get their attention for a drink. Awesomeeee! I just missed all 22 drafts being $2 but a look at the list was promising, they even carry the Dogfishhead Olde Barleywine (15% ABV, $7- not bad!). Good juke box, nice bartenders, good atmosphere.

I like the new revamped interior, white christmas lights all around gave it a Cantina-esque feel. The dining area was open and not cramped. I would definitely go back for a drink here whenever I'm in Old City, gotta try the food too!

There is no doubt that the food here is first rate.  The flavors are fresh and authentic Sicilian, and the antipasto is possibly one of the best I have ever eaten.  There was sweet, spicy, savory cheeses - it was phenomenal, and artfully put together.  I could have licked the plate of the lamb ragout that accompanied the pillowy light potato gnocchi, and my husband reminisced about our own trips to Italy with the grilled sardine appetizer her enjoyed.  But the dining experience here was dreadful.  My husband and I couldn't hear each other talk across the table, so we just didn't talk through most of the meal, which made us look like a couple on an awkward first date.  You don't have an assigned server, instead, the multiple servers in the dining room flit around like vultures waiting to snag an empty plate.  There's no warmth, no friendliness, no Sicilian "family" feeling.  The gentleman at the table next to ours tipped our bread basket forward every time he leaned back in his chair, but we left the basket there instead of switching it with the drinks on the other side.  As the evening wore on, the restaurant became quite dark, and some white, bright table cloths would have gone a long way to add warmth and light to the place.

Again, if you are going for delicious food and ambiance is not a priority, definitely go to Zeppoli to enjoy the amazing food.  But after waiting a couple of months to snag a table, we wanted a whole wonderful dining experience.  We definitely didn't get that.

I don't even know where to begin. This is the closest KFC to my house and it is the biggest disappointment. Every time I go there, there is always something wrong. For instance one night they were out of chicken tenders and mashed potatoes. Almost every time I go there they forget something in my order or get it wrong. Like ordering a number six and a number eight and only getting one number 6. Or not getting any sauces that I asked for. Or 4 getting my cookie AND my sauce.... AND my utensils in the same order. And there's always a weird smell coming from the window when I pull up for the drive thru... And when I peek in it just looks like a mess. Of course the floor looks disgusting. Honestly I don't even know why I come back. If I could give them zero Stars I would but fortunately I can't so they get one star. And I guess that one star accounts for the fact that everyone is always friendly. At least they're nice.

Comfy leather booths and patio seating. Great wings and burgers. Play a song on the jukebox, and get in a cozy local mood. One of my favorite group meet-ups or pre-game spots.
              5 STAR PATTY MELT

This is one of my favorite places in Edmonton that will leave a lasting impression on me now that I've left the city. I went there probably 3 or 4 times in the last week and really enjoyed it. I had only been there 2-3 times over the course of this last semester, and regret not going more often until my last week in town.

Their coffee drinks are very good, and they have an excellent selection of bottled beers, as well as a few beers on tap. Both upstairs and downstairs, there is a good selection of seating. My favorite is the set of couches upstairs. Kick off your shoes and get cozy with your computer and the couches - either alone or with a group of people. There is free wifi, too.

Their appetizer dishes are all excellent. I had a wrap that included tandoori chicken and something else involving spinach and potatoes, I believe. It was spicy by my taste, but not for Indian food. Good bang for your buck!

The location of Remedy is also prime; you can take any number of buses that go up and down 109 street, and it is a short walk from the UofA campus.

Just tried The Creperie this evening - on a Friday night at 6:30 pm and the place was packed! Since this is the first review for it on yelp, let me add that they are located in the regal 22 restaurant row. And what a wonderful addition it is! Now we know where to go for dinner on our movie dates. 
These are the same people who have the cart in the Farmers market on Saturdays (or so I read in the Scene mag). So most people probably are familiar with their offerings. Apparently people had been asking them to get a brick and mortar place and so here they are. Thank heavens! 
Prices range from $3 - $7 - sweet and savory. We tried the La Provence and Thai Chicken today - both were generously portioned so much so that even my husband admitted it was difficult to finish one on his own. And they didn't scrimp on anything for $7. We can't wait to go back to try some sweet ones. I was very happy to see th crowds there. As we all know, that particular row of businesses hasn't enjoyed good luck in the past so please Boise, let this one make it. Go try them out. After "Square" closed, I didn't dare hope that we would ever have another such establishment. And in some ways this one might even be better (price point). The place is on the cozy side - but laid out nicely. The staff were friendly.

We have been coming to hard rock tampa for a couple of years and love it.  We come on weekends and get there early Saturday so we can start with the 5 blackjack but by end of day at 25. Fun!! And dealers are great. Slots are okay. Have won have lost. That is how is goes. Love love council oaks. Actually just arrived Friday nite will be there tomorrow have not been able to stay at hotel as not high rollers. But stay in brandon at a great embassy suite. It's iur weekend away place

By far the best service. Best price for high quality product. Thank you for working with me and my busy work schedule to get my car in and out so quickly. And my car looks amazing! The tint is perfect and exactly what I wanted. And the clear bra is barely noticeable. And I love it! Best in town. ***Allen, thank you for going above and beyond you are a great asset to the front desk crew!

A family member highly recommended and referred me to Art of Acupuncture. When entering into Art of Acupuncture, you'll quickly notice the relaxing ambiance and welcoming office space. All the staff members in this office are pleasant. The woman who typically works the front end of the office is friendly, professional, and willing. I have met with both Dr. Emily and Dr. Brian, and I highly recommend either of these DOM professionals. Dr. Brian is genuine, truly passionate & knowledgeable about his work, and eager to work with his patients & explain the process each step of the way. Dr. Emily also shares this enthusiasm for her work and is another fantastic practitioner that I have seen in this office. Overall, I highly recommend Art of Acupuncture to anyone, whether it be those that are interested in holistic medicine for their first time, those that are very familiar with this medicine but are looking for a new office, or anyone seeking acupuncture services.

Really great off the beaten path Italian on the Port Richmond / Kensington border. A pretty small building with a simple but nice dining room. Great service and fresh food. The prices were a little higher but no different than what you would have down in South Philly.  I went with the lobster raviolis and the wife had the chicken Parmesan.  Both excellent. The homemade meatballs were fantastic too. Plenty of street parking. BYOB.
This has become one of our go to's. Really good food, friendly service, nice selection of local beers (and a cider or two).

I had a private room here and it was pretty large with enough space for your stuff, clean with no bugs but with no kitchen so you have to eat outside everyday so be aware of chosing healthy restaurant whih are all around the Ihouse.
Besided that rooms should be painted again and the wall renovated, a lot of wholes do exist in the wall of my room.

Socially, lot of event and of international student so that you can get new friends you can never be bored at Ihouse.

Academically I am a phd student and I was very happy that the Ihouse provids a calm study room where you can study the whole night without any disturbation.

The big drawback of this place is the internet connection, It 's very slow , all stream websites doesn't work  you can't download anything unless it's 3am in the moorning where you are possibly the only person using the bandwidth.

It seems like every other place the Brennans have on the surface and can be a bit pricey but as long as you are ordering the BBQ shrimp, you will not mind at all.  They're the size of friggin lobsters!  And you will want to dip an entire loaf of french bread into the sauce

We used to LOVE their pizza but have been seriously disappointed lately. The last few pizzas we've ordered have been super doughy in the middle and undercooked to the point of being mushy (think raw biscuit dough)-- even when we ask for well done. When we take advantage of their carry out specials, we end up putting the pizzas in our over at home to try to finish them off. I don't know where the disconnect is between asking for well done and getting underdone pizza, but we're now in the market for a new go-to pizza option.

Very gud sandwich I like it. Nice and clean inside and the bathroom are nice. The lady's are nice to me helpful. Just one lady are shabby.but all around I love the food and the place. Ill be back to eat my fav sandwich...

Lamb burgers were good.  Service was spotty. Some bartenders were really on the ball and some you couldn't get their attention. House cocktails sucked. I loves me some hard liquor but these were mixed way too heavy for cocktails and then topped with a quarter inch of whatever soda was supposed to go in it. Totally unbalanced and unforgivable.

Service:5 
Drinks:5
Atmosphere:4
Food:4 (small sample size)

Everything was pretty amazing.  Danny was our server and he gets mucho kudos.  We had two cocktails, both awesome.  First time having a Sazerac served in this way, and the wise blood was super unique and sooo tasty.  We sat on the patio and I know, tis the season, but the mosquitoes we out in full force.  We got two small plates, the octopus (5) and the heirloom salad (3).  Octopus was cooked perfectly, with tons of natural flavor complimented by the seasonings & peppers. & the texture was absolutely perfect.  The peppers can speak for themselves as always, but oh so tasty, in a perfect compliment to the tentacles.  The heirloom salad, however, left a few things to be desired.  There was almost no pork belly, and the tomatoes were slightly under flavored. I'll just leave it at room for improvement, hopefully it was a one off.  Other than that, we will be back to experience more and more, as we are crazy excited about all the intriguing menu changes!!!

We wen't here yesterday for my birthday dinner and it was one of the best places I have ever eaten! The decor and ambiance of this place is outstanding. The service was exceptional along with our drinks and food. We ordered tapas to begin with and then our table of 8 also ordered individual entrees. The entire table was raving about how great the food was and to top it off the desert was phenomenal. The Chile con Carne dough God is amazing along with the Prickly Pear Ribs. I can't say a single bad thing and will absolutely be back!

Lovely evening! Service was great, food Delish, prices reasonable. We were never rushed and our server was very attentive and personable. Only downfall, very loud environment probably because there some large parties with many children. All in all good experience! Will return but will ask to be seated away from large parties.

Mr. B's is pricey, so I always tell myself I'm going to skip it next time... but I always end up there anyway.  The BBQ shrimp is perfection, and any time they have scallops on the menu, ORDER THEM! The lemon drop martinis are especially good too.

Okay I must be missing something.  There is no question the chicken is crispy..... but that's it. It was devoid of any seasoning and other than ketchup and siracha there were no sauces to help it along. 

The only flavour I got was oil from the fryer. Don't get me wrong it wasn't really greasy... just no flavour. $9.50 for a wing, drumstick and part of a breast and fries. Not even a jug of water to fill a glass up to wash down the oil flavour. Tried once won't bother trying again.
Went and waited 2 separate days and on the 2nd they tell me they don't have the glass? WTF do not go to this place. You are treated like veal.

Had the absolute best customer service experience at this Bed Pros ! Chad was our salesman and showed us all the differences between all of the matresses and found the perfect mattress for us. He was very polite professional and shared a great deal of knowledge and got us the right matress not the most expensive one. I will definitely recommend this place to my friends.

Thoroughly enjoyed our lunch.  We started with a fr no, the Tipsy Turtle and a Maui Brewing Co Coconut HIWA Porte.  Had The Stack and DOS Tacos with the pineapple habanero salsa.  Just enough heat!  The macadamia nut ice cream finished everything off beautifully!  The restaurant is very cute with all the turtle decorations and great seating outside.  We will be back for sure!
It's still no bastion of authentic Mexican cuisine by a long shot, but dare I say it?  El Arado is now actually passable. A solid three stars. Hurrah!
I am delighted this food truck has posted up near my house. I walked over today and picked up a refreshing iced coffee. Can't wait to try some of the food. Looks awesome.

I can't add anything to the already glowing reviews from other yelpers.
The food is very fresh and is well prepared and presented.
The décor is very calming, sort of Zen, a surprise in this otherwise dismal shopping center.
The service is very attentive and friendly.
My first time there won't be my last.

I actually found this little gem by looking on Yelp! It was a little bit of a walk from our hotel but well worth it. We went for breakfast and I got the breakfast bowl and it was super delicious. Everything I wanted for breakfast in a bowl ... I think I would get it with bacon next time instead of sausage just to be easier to eat.
