She pointed again so I assumed that meant I had to climb behind the desk and get it from under the wires and dirt. I did, and proceeded to the seat the same lady pointed me to. There was only one other person in the pedi chairs and she sat me directly next to her. This wouldn't have been a problem but every other chair is up against the next one. No space no separation. I bumped her and vice versa on several different occasions while sitting there. Anyway, after all these small annoyances I decided to stay bc I didn't have time to find another place. I am currently 4 days past due with my first child and suspect I'll go into labor very soon and I just wanted my nails done. Anyway, she fills up the water and I stick my feet in and ITS FREEZING!!!!!! I asked her to add some hot water and she did but not enough. At this point I was already convinced I would never come back. THEN, my seat didn't even work!!!!! So no massage for me! There were several other seats they could have put me in. The lady pushed the power button twice and sat the controller back down. Didn't offer to move me or anything. Well I waited with my feet in cold water, in an uncomfortable chair without a working massager for 34 mins. Meanwhile the woman waxed someone's eyebrows, who came in after me, and another woman started in s pedicure of someone who also came in after me. The final straw was the other woman's working massage chair. I had had enough at that point, thanked them, and asked for a towel to dry my feet. THEN, the lady who put me in the chair kept repeating "I'll do yours now" "are you ready now?" I kept repeating no, thank you. It was VERY frustrating!!!! The place looks awful, their chairs don't all work, their staff is inconsiderate.... I found a place closer to home with much better everything!!!!! Oh and a guy kept cleaning the glass spraying awful smelling cleaning product all over!!! It was not a relaxing experience at all. Also my sister in law has to go once a week. Gel or shellac should last at least two so I suspect the products aren't good quality. Look elsewhere!

ew- really?
We had a Nashvillian recommend this as the best Tex Mex west of the Mississip...and brother, y'all need to come to Denver then. The service was great- all the people behind the counter were laughing and hollering and hootin- more fun than anywhere else on Broadway...but the food was mediocre. And that's being kind.
We have a place here called Casa Bonita (yes, like on South Park) and it is renowned for bad Mex food- and I think it would win in a taste contest. Cheese enchiladas were a bit like a luke warm Hungryman frozen meal. Know what Im sayin? 
I really wanted to love the place and I did love the interior, the people,the ordering method, the staff and the location- but dude, the food was bad news. Sorry San Antonio Taco Co - the only thing I can recommend is that you'd be a cool place to hang and drink some Sweet Tea.

OK -- have to admit, the last thing I wanted to do was give a casino joint a high rating, but daaaaammnnn, they know how to make some burgers.  It can get a little pricey as you add toppings (and fries are extra), but if you have a craving for a great burger this is a good spot.  When you order medium, it's really medium.  They're not going to overcook it like most people do.

Maybe if you're feeling a little lucky, you can stop by at a blackjack table and win $20 and the meal should be free.  

I'd recommend the black angus burger with portabella mushrooms and swiss cheese.  Yummm.

I know how hard it is to leave your pet.  But, if you have to leave them - this is a really nice place.  I have boarded my dog here several times in the past year.  He is well taken care of.  The staff is very friendly and helpful.  Cannot say enough about The Lodge at New Tampa...... Excellent!!
Great service, great food. Ditched the money pits in the French quarter to come here for a wonderful New Orleans experience.

I LOVE BRUMMIS.

The food is authentically German and incredibly good.  The priciest entrees are huge portions of food so really, they're quite reasonable, and there are some more affordable options as well.

I have heard that they are considering closing their doors in the next couple months so GO THERE NOW while you still can!

I could go on and on about this place.  The service is wonderful.  I highly recommend the Rouladen or Goulash (which comes with Spaetzle -- Germany's answer to mac n' cheese--- delicious).  I've heard that the various Schnitzel dishes are also extremely good.  Also, their darkest beer on tap is wunderbar.

All in all, I am heartbroken that they plan to close.  But I wish Veronika and Rudi all the best!

Great burgers and service!
Parking limited so go early with a group. Nice facilities for a group meeting or family celebration.

I have been interested in trying this place, having passed its location in CC Phila many times and finally got the opportunity to sample their ware. First off, I was put off the "no cash " policy. Really?
I understand their philosophy behind this, but as a business decision in my opinion it is not sustainable over the long haul. They are artificially limiting their potential market, even though the trend is towards a plastic society. This in of itself is not a deal breaker for me, but I would not frequent this establishment as much as one that accepts cash. So I ordered the Mexican  Corn Elote Bowl and added chicken for a total of $13.00. Now I don't mind paying this for a salad if the quality is good ( which it was), and appetizing (which it also was)
but the question was " where's the goat cheese and  chicken" I accounted for three bites of goat cheese and about 4 small cubes of chicken. The rest was dominated by greens. The quinoa was good also but I basically stuffed myself on lettuce and was hungry about an hour later. I gave it three stars primarily for value equation which unfortunately brings down what could have been a 4.5-5 Star review.

The best authentic Thai food in the area! The most gracious staff we've encountered in all our travels. They have amazing pumpkin dishes as well as the usual Thai fare. They make my hubby a special crispy duck Pad Thai that he just adores! The lunch specials are very reasonably priced with soup and salad or soup and a spring roll, their peanut sauce is out of this world! A must try is you're looking for delicious Thai food as well as outstanding service

Swung by here for lunch with a few co-workers a couple weeks back.  The lunch portions were healthy and very good.  I wounded up getting a BBQ chicken pizza.. Whew, it was GOOD!  It was cooked very well on thin crust and the flavor was amazing.. I like spice so I wouldn't have minded a bit more spice.  I was able to eat most of the pizza but ended up having a piece to take home and snack on for dinner/lunch the next day.  

Service was decent, but a little on the slow side on occasion.

I wasn't expecting much from this hotel given its huge size, but I was expecting a little more.

Pros:
* Friendly, pleasant staff.
* Lunch at the Cascades American Cafe was good.

Cons:
* 3 thin pillows for a king size bed and no comforter.
* Valet service inconsistent - twice over a 3 night stay I called valet to have my car brought around only to be told they turned off that service and I would have to walk down to ask for my car and then wait up to 20 minutes for it.
* Traffic returning to the hotel before one of the big stage shows is ridiculous. It took us 45 minutes to travel from the highway exit to the hotel entrance because of the traffic, even though we weren't going to the show.
* Our room was by the outdoor nativity scene which featured a loudspeaker with a recorded voice telling the story of the nativity over and over again. It sounded like the gentlemen was in our room it was so loud. We had to drown it out by turning up a nature sounds app on my phone.
* Breakfast buffet at Ravello's was awful. Dry powdery eggs, undercooked potatoes, mediocre coffee.
* No mini bar / snack bar in the room.

They either need to fix these problems or cut the room rate in half.

This is the worst Mongolian bar be cue we have dined in. Poor selection and poor ingredients. Been to several they need to go to Virginia beach or Houston to see how its done    Very disappointed. Then they want to charge extra for dessert. Terrible!!!

This place was lovely! We came right before Halloween which of course was the perfect time. Prices at the market are expectedly pretty high. Try the pumpkin frozen yogurt! It was phenomenal. Inside the markeT, the whoopie pies were absolutely fantastic. It's very family friendly and there are lots of activities. There's also a petting zoo and live music.
The best Chinese food I've ever had. Best customer service I've ever had too :) Always delicious, always friendly service.

I bought a Toyota Camry 2 weeks ago and couldn't be happier! When I arrived at the dealership, I wasn't exactly sure what i was looking for. Andy was the sales rep who was assisting me. He walked me through the lot and was very knowledgeable and helpful in helping me decide which car to go with. He made the process enjoyable and relaxed.  I had a lot of questions, and he was patient in explaining all the different features of each car.  I've never purchased a car from a dealership, and I was grateful for all the help from the Toyota team members. After choosing the Camry, the managers were very willing to work with me to find a payment plan suitable to my needs.  Toyota really goes above and beyond with their services, care and assistance. I thought the overall experience was great and would definitely recommend the dealership to anyone in the market for a new car.

A very nice hotel located just a few minutes away from the Tampa airport.  One of the better Hyatts I've stayed at.

Most of the hotel areas are renovated and has a fresh look.  The front desk check in and check out process was a breeze.  It could be because it was low season.   I didn't get to use the gym or pool but it would have been nice maybe the next time I am in the area again.  

Free wifi with my platinum Hyatt membership.  My meeting ran over and they were also able to extend my checkout time smoothly.

I also went there for a conference.  The conference rooms were nicely lit and maintained.

The best thing on the menu is the peshawari naan.  I cannot believe all these positive reviews.  Folks in Drexel Hill must not be familiar with good Indian food.  Every thing I have ordered from this place has been salty as hell.  I believe they are stingy with the spices and use mostly salt to season the food.  I've had way better Indian food at a hole in the wall in Philly on Chestnut Street.

Spoke to owner on phone, I was struggling to find a menu online. He pointed me to grubhub to find the menu. I ordered the chicken parm over spaghetti, a chicken salad sandwich, and a grilled chicken gyro. I was feeling hungry ;)

The chicken parm had a good sauce. The chicken was tasty, but it looked of rather low quality (think 1999 McDonald's Chicken McNugget). The gyro was overfilled with the sauce - it was dripping everywhere. and the chicken that was used on that similarly looked ... fake. It tasted okay, but within 30 minutes I did not feel.

I see why this place has such high reviews - food tastes good (least the chicken parm did); and my order was ready within 15 minutes - impressive.
But the food quality, in my opinion, is really poor. 
I will not return.

Let me first say the establishment is beautiful. Secondly, the staff is complete with beautiful well- dressed men who remind you, that even though rare, there are still gentlemen out there. The women are as beautiful as the men and , even though appear quite intimidating,  are very approachable and helpful. The vibe is chill and classy.

Decided to try Genoa after getting a mailer. Always willing to try something new. We called for pickup and got great service from the phone girl who answered. At 9:30pm on a Friday, the wait was about 20 min. We ordered 2-14" (8 slices) cheese pies with a 2 liter and 5 bone in hot wings for $25. Food was hot when we picked it up and was pleasantly surprised at the quality. The pizza is New England style aka Greek Pizza, tasty ingredients with a crispy thick crust. It wasn't too oily or greasy, nothing I had to use extra napkins for. The wings were super yummy!  I was a bit apprehensive after reading a review about how bad the wings were but I found them to be meaty, nice sized and just the right amount of spicy kick....definitely finger lickin' good!

Really looking forward to trying other menu items soon!!

This review is of a cooking class my husband and I took here.  We received a gift certificate and were able to attend any class of our choice.  They have a huge selection of classes and things to make.  We chose a Paella date night class.  We were taught the recipes to make Sangria, a seafood paella, and a chicken paella.

First of all, for some reason I pictured going into a home ec.  type situation with individual kitchens and tools.  That is not the case.  They have two kitchens, but  a different class is being offered in each kitchen.  

The process for what you are cooking is explained step by step, but you only participate in one or two steps.  The class had over 15 people in it, and so each person is delegated small tasks.  (One person peels the potatoes and another person slices it, one person mans the oven, and another person squeezes lemons, etc.)  I must say that this disappointed me, because you really don't lean many (if any) skills this way.  The instructor did not really explain how the proper way to do said task was unless you were doing it incorrectly.  

I am not sure if the class would have been different had an actual Kitchen Conservatory staff instructor was teaching it, but we really didn't learn much from the chef.  

The classes are quite pricey, and while it was a fun experience, I would not spend the money again because the take away is small.  I would recommend more individualized instruction and for more skills to be taught.
Very good and gluten free is available.  Tucked in a quiet residential neighborhood. Sitting outside loving  life and chatting with the locals.

Went there on a Thursday for dinner.  They won't seat you until your entire party arrives, which is pretty dumb.  We had 6:30 reservations, they wanted us gone by 8:00 (so they could seat the next reservation), I get that.  But why not seat the people that are there so they can get started and we can leave on time?

Anyway, stupid policy.  Food is pretty good.  We ordered pretty much everything on the menu.  Certainly some hits & misses.  Overall, very good.  Much better than Sbraga.

Ok, let me start by saying I not only visited on a Saturday but it was an essence weekend type of Saturday. The line was down the block when my friend and I got there. We get in the line and the ladies come out and say they know they aren't going to be able to serve over half of the line. People left we stayed with Hope's that something would come up at the bar or someone would leave anything lol. I followed them on Instagram recently so I was NOT leaving without my morrows. We chose to wait and I'm glad we did! Something did come up and we were seated. Greeted right away and then again by what I think is the front house msngr she was amazing. Then top it of our waiter Fernandez was phenomenal they were super busy as u can imagine but he didnt skip a beat! He took really good care of us so service was a plus and I'm hoping that other people would give this restaurant a fair shot it's worth it! If u had a bad experience try again and then one more time. Now let's get to the good part! THE FOOD! I had the wings mmm.mmm. yeessss delicious I didnt even wanna dip them in ranch the flavor was so delicious! The salmon was friggin huge! And it was beautifully prepared and tasted amazing! The brown rice at first i was like I want potatoes (ordered a side of garlic mash and vegetables) the brown rice was delicious it was light and had great flavor I was pleasantly surprised. The vegetables omg cooked and seasoned to perfection! Ya'll I ate ALL the sides my salmon was too big to finish so I brought it home. Reasonable prices. And oh the DRINKS! We started out with the Dominican mami delicious and ended with the French henny apple martini! AMAZING! Overall great experience. The wait was expected as it is close to downtown. This was there first essence hopefully they will have expanded to accommodate the troves of people who want to dine. But that's a good problem to have right? 
A bit of feedback I would give is just a better process for guests when they check in and maybe if you could put some seating out doors for guests who are waiting for long periods so it could take their mind of of the wait by chopping it up and offer them to go to the bar and buy a drink everybody wins then! Cant wait to visit again!

I went here for a pre valentines dinner date last Sunday with my lady friend.  I was excited to see that the guacamole was made tableside, not scooped out of a plastic tub into a bowl and brought to the table.  It is also great that you can control the heat and cilantro and onion content of the guac to your own personal preference.  This was a nice touch to have personalized guacamole.  My girlfriend loves gaucamole, so this was like heaven for her.  We agreed that it was probably the best that we had ever had.  It was so fresh.  It was literally straight out of the avocado shell and into our mouths.

The entrees themselves were also very good, but less memorable than the gauc.  I had the baby back ribs.  although they had a nice smokey flavor, I prefer a baby back rib with a nice caramelized sheen on it instead of a really moist and thick rib.  Don't get me wrong, they were very good.  I've just had better.

I was comparing this place to Lolita.  I have to say that the beat Lolita's gauc hands down, but Lolita's entrees are much, much better and more flavorful.

Love this place for their Jazz brunch. Very attentive service and they were happy to tell us about the haunted history behind the place too. Jazz musicians are very good and switch between rooms so you can switch between chatting and listening to some music. We had a window table so it makes for good people watching too. The brunch 3 course meal seems like a good deal. We went with the Ala-carte option though and ordered some delicious breakfast beverages. All in all a must try spot for dinner or brunch - a NoLa tradition.

I had a really different experience here. Computer Express is where I always go to get odd little bits (like an adapter for the plug, or an enclosure for an old hard drive), and they always have these. They also have old used restored computers. I've bought a couple old notebooks for the kids, no problems. I am not one to fix a laptop (they're so cheap, I always just buy and replace), but I've had to get files taken off the old hard drive and they've been helpful with that. 
They aren't particularly cheap or fast, but I've never felt I've been ripped off or anything. They've fixed what I wanted fixed, and were helpful showing me how to switch out the hard drive or whatever I was needing. This is not a flashy Apple Store, but if you're looking for a cable for your laptop, or you need another adapter, or you have a virus, I've always found them helpful and polite.

This was my first time into Sushi Rose. A couple of friends and I had all never been wanted to branch out with out Reno sushi game. We went during lunch and based on their reviews opted for the all you can eat $15.95 When the first round of starters came out we were given one item that didn't look like how we expected. It was yakiton and it ended up being like crab ragoon with sweet and sour dipping sauce. It was good for Chinese food but not what we expected.

My nerves started to spike thinking of all the stuff we ordered. We were delivered four rolls and like one of the three. We then were brought our nigiri. I liked the smoked salmon and tuna I ordered. The red snapper was ok. The regular salmon was ok. One friend really did not like her yellowtail. We were then brought another roll which ended up being our favorite.

Most of the rolls had ingredients that were were not looking for. The three of us all look for fresh fish, light sauce, no fried items, no cream cheese. Most of the menu contained items with cream cheese or some aspect was fried (tempura, the roll, shrimp). The dinner menu had some options that I would be interested in but based on lunch might not get to experience. One friend never got his dessert. We paid and ate our desserts and his never came.

There was one server who was really on service and table bussing. He would say each roll when he dropped them. The one who was taking our orders part of the time would not say anything when pick you up our slip or dropping off. We all ordered all you can eat on a Monday and were not offered a free beer or sake. Maybe it's dinner only. The waiter mentioned the deal and said that was why they were so busy. Perhaps they assumed we had been before and knew. Overall I was underwhelmed by the experience.

I scheduled this pub crawl for my sister's bachelorette party this past weekend and we had a blast!  Linley was our guide and she is AWESOME!  She is so friendly, accommodating & has great energy!  The whole experience was great from start to finish.  Linley was always super responsive and even texted me a few days before our crawl to see what color tulle I preferred for my sister's veiled cowboy that was included!  She texted me the morning of the crawl to let us know where to meet her.  She told us some interesting history about Nashville and we played trivia at each bar we went to.  There were drink specials at all the bars and Linley had the perfect spots to take pictures for us.  Before we went to the last bar (karaoke!), we played a little photo scavenger hunt for 10 minutes.  We all had such a great time and a lot of the girls said it was the highlight of their trip.  We absolutely loved Linley and wish we could've hung out with her all weekend!!  I would definitely recommend doing this bar crawl if you're in town!
the saint is a great little neighborhood dive.  I like to go on tues. when a couple of guys serve awesome korean bbq in the patio!  the karaoke coming in the from inside is pretty entertaining too!

I am so pleased with the service I received once again from Danny Price. I have been a chevy customer for 23 years and Danny has been my Reno service writer the entire time. I just arrived in Reno and had a warranty issue and once again Danny gave me top notch service. He is knowledgeable and so helpful whenever I bring my car in. He is your guy if you want great service in Reno.
Good service and a nice evening but I was not a fan of the noodles they were to soft for my pallet. It was reasonably priced and easy to find on the main drive in Broad Ripple.

Decent pizza but way overpriced, $19.21 for a 12 inch traditional pie with 2 toppings. That's insanely over priced doesn't matter if you order meatballs or pepperoni $1.99 per extra topping. You can get a large pie at any other pizza place with toppings for same price.

I emailed her and never received a response

I went with a group of 7 for brunch on Sunday. Honestly our service was awful. It took forever to order drinks, get them, our food was mixed up and did not come out together at all after waiting close to an hour for it. The manager and veteran wait staff went above and beyond to make it up to us and make sure that by the end we had everything we asked for and more. 
Based on the way the manager made sure to take care of us at the end and the AMAZING food I would absolutely go back.
This was the best brunch I have ever had in terms of the food/drinks. I highly recommend the peach mimosas and the breakfast nachos, YUM!!

The whole experience here was basic. I mean I wasn't expecting something amazing but maybe a little better than what we got. The burnt ends appetizer was small plated horribly and lacked taste. The calamari had a mushy batter and was just bland. All of the food that came out looked really good (the main courses). There were six of us we all got different things. I had the Cajun Pasta it looked great but it was missing taste. The same with the St. Louis ribs, meatloaf, French dip, and Greek pizza. My daughter got chicken strips that were tasty. Would I come back, maybe just to try a burger. It was a little bit better than Applebee's. Oh yeah they had homemade beer that was pretty good.
The food was alright. Nothing to be excited about. It was filling and satified my taste buds but given the choice I would go else where.

It was great to see the old Carrow's building back up and running again as a new establishment. The decor is reminiscent of an upscale restaurant on a golf course. 
Our waitress Marissa was a great! She gave us a rundown on the menu and her personal recommendations.
To drink, I had an ACE Cider, which was very good. Not sure where they found it, but I'd like to try it again. My wife had to explain how to make a Moscow Mule, since the bartender was unsure how to make one, which ended up good once it was made correctly. 
Have to say the best part of the evening was the tater tot nachos! They were fantastic! Probably some of the best nacho cheese I've ever had!
For dinner I had the salmon plank. It could have used a bit more seasoning, but moreover, it was placed on a bed of cold corn and green chili slaw, which cooled fish off quickly. 
Overall, it was a fairly average experience. I may be willing to come back and try their namesake of Rotisserie, but definitely for the tot nachos and cider.
Awesome burgers and shakes. If looking for one of the best burger places in STL, this should be on your list. If you don't order some type of ice cream you will suffer a lifetime of regrets.

Food was excellent. I had the Brat and it was yummy paired with the tater tots. I deducted one star (only would have deducted half if I could) since they allow dogs on the patio. I like dogs, but this particular night there were two dogs on the patio and they did not like each other so there was frequent barking. Other than that, it was great!
Food was amazing!!! No issues at all. Justin was amazing! Great waiter. Will be back. I hear they have an early bird special from 4:30-6 with some half price apps.

Where to begin: 
1. Service is great! There is rarely a wait and if there is its short. They're always quick and make sure your drink stays filled!
2. Food is delicious! My friends and I only go here when we're craving Mexican. We all get different things and share. It's wonderful there isn't anything I wouldn't recommend and you get TONS for your money. Hello leftovers!
3. Drinks!!! Beer, margs, tequila. Nuff said. 
4. Atmosphere: it's loud, it's fun, it's kid friendly, it's adult friendly just go check it out yourself

I walked into the restaurant and the general scene was promising: a friendly environment with interesting decor like a diner, despite being poorly lit.

I ordered the "King Fu pork bowl" and a macchiato, to which the waitress replied that their barista doesn't really make it the traditional way. I still ordered it.

The macchiato came first, and to my surprise it was in a mug filled to the brim. I let the barista know that I ordered a macchiato, not a latte or cappuccino, and she said that she knows that, she made a macchiato. After a brief discussion I discovered she doesn't know what a macchiato was. I went back to my table. 

The food came. The pork was room temperature and the rice was plain. The dish lacked flavor overall. 

Maybe they don't specialize in rice bowls as it was a smaller item on their menu, but that was my experience.
Delicious food and fun atmosphere. Great for a hot chai, spiked coffee, pastry in the morning or panini and liquor in the evening. Coffee shop with free wifi and good food, if limited seating

This place is great - played there for 4 hours yesterday. Their Neo Geo arcade machine has over 100 titles including Magical Drop 2 (fast paced match 3). Some of the pinballs are good for their music alone. Guardians of the Galaxy starts playing Cherry Bomb when you hit its 5-ball wizard mode. Keep hitting Groot for multiball. They have some rare stuff there too, like the 3-level Haunted House and the huge "holographic" Time Traveler game. Their Addam's Family game could be a museum piece. It has a color display and like-new playfield.

As far as thing not working, just let them know and they'll get to it when they can. I suggested they look for a Tatio Battle Shark. Those aren't easy to find. When I checked, only 10 are owned by collectors on VAPS (Vintage Arcade Preservation Society).

I forgot to tell them a couple things: AC/DC needs a right flipper solenoid (unplayable) and Caveman is playing at about 40% of the flipper strength it should have. Caveman was the first video pinball game and not easy to keep going. I only know how it's supposed to play since I had one at a skating rink in the 80s. Try to beat 14 million, the score only goes to 9,999,999 :)

Ok this is Bourbon street. Is it fancy? Is it clean, do they serve food?  NO!  They do sell drinks and they are cheap. 3 for 1 beers till like midnight. Avoid the shot girls(they are cute and fun). The shot girls always want to hook you up with 2 test tube shots. What is in the shots? Who knows. Go to the bar and they will give you a test tube of pure good alcohol(vodka, Tequila) for the same price and you can buy 1 at a time.  The mechanical bull is the entertainment here and is some good raunchy fun. The MC's and the DJ really make it fun. So your in the heart of Bourbon street, you have cheap drinks, free entertainment, and a bathroom(don't even think about skipping out without washing your hands and tipping the attendant!) . People watching and getting drunk. This is the place

There are only a few Veterinarians that are able to care for an animal during the night in Tucson and this place is one of them. 

My mother's dog has had many problems with his health and they never seem to occur during regular business hours (9am-5pm) but only in the middle of the night.

We decided to go there when her dog started showing problems and they were very professional, courteous, and handled the dog with extreme care. Their facility is very pleasant in appearance, and the staff is polite. Like any vet visit the price is costly (100+ dollars) but in an emergency it is expected.

We go to ABC pet clinic (at 22nd. & Craycroft) to get affordable shots for our cat and mom's dog. However, I have not been to any other emergency vet clinic in Tucson who has been as polite and professional as those at SAVSEC.

The Courtyard is nicely renovated hotel from another era near a lot of  downtown Nashville action. 

The Courtyard Nashville Downtown seems to have it all except FREE breakfast. We were told on the phone while making reservations and at the check-in there would be a FREE breakfast buffet included in the cost of staying here. Unfortunately, when presented with our breakfast bill we informed the staff of our FREE breakfast and no one knew anything about it. We had to speak to the manager, Dennis, before we were finally given what was promised to us from the start. This is no way to run a upscale hotel. Shame on you Marriott Corporation.

Three Stars for the hotel room, the lobby and beautiful dinning area and ONE STAR for the bait and switch attempt on our poor little street smart souls.

Go there and see if they promise you the same FREE breakfast deal, but refuse to keep their promise until confronted by me. Bow Wow!

Call it what you want: Retro; Throw Back; Antiquated.  Bonnie Doon Bowl IS FUN. Modern scoring system, 5-pin bowling with glow bowl spells family fun for me.  Small concession has enough snacks but not what I call healthy but that's not why I am there.  

Our office had our year end party there it was a huge success.  Cathy made it easy to book and feedback from staff was through the roof.  

Can't wait to go back!

Brunch here was the perfect start to my day in Nashville! Instead of making a reservation, you have to wait on a line to get in, so we went on a Monday early afternoon, and the wait wasn't bad at all. "The Medley" is a dish of hash browns, eggs, peppers, onions, and cheese served with a side of their signature pancakes. It was a great bang for our buck, and we were all stuffed when we left. The pancakes were fluffy and perfectly cooked. Even the butter and syrup served with the pancakes were noticeably high quality, fresh, and delicious. This was a great find - reasonably priced, good service, and fantastic food! Highly recommend!

It was OK, but i've had better steaks.  The shrimp cocktail was pretty delicious, the shrimp was nice and firm and the cocktail sauce was a serious horseradish blast, which i loved!

I had the wedge salad which was super delicious, tasty thick cute smoked bacon and awesome blue cheese.  if you like wedges, this is a good one.

the NY strip was just ok, it wasn't very flavorful.  it was prepared properly, it just lacked in beefy flavor.  i had the potato pancakes as my side and  they were overcooked and too crunchy to eat.

Overall, it was an OK meal, but I'll try someplace else next time.

i'm done with this place. Every time I come here it's either were not accepting credit cards or were out of service for the next 30 minutes.its December 30, 2013 and nobody is able to accept orders in the drive-through.....I'm done.....calling corporate.... hopefully I get a free hamburger
This must be one of the best Thai restaurants in the city! The value is unsurpassed. The curries are to 'write home about'

This is a fantastic breakfast spot. Either some people below don't know what they're talking about, or the owners literally read those reviews and fixed everything. We went here twice on our trip to NOLA. Both times everything was spot on. The ingredients are high quality - the egg yolk was cage free, the iron maiden juice with beets tasted like candy, coffee was fresh, service was excellent and the girls are chatty and friendly. The price is just right - maybe just a tad high but you're between two hotels and the convention center - they could be greedier and still get away with it. Seriously great breakfast foods. Recommend easily.

Oh hell-to-the-yea! I am a fan. This will be my new favorite hot spot for lunches during the work week although I am 100% my waistline will grow in size if I make this a weekly occurrence. 

Passed this place on Monday when I was next store at BOA and my mouth immediately started watering. I came back to the office and immediately spread the word to the troops that lunch tomorrow is on Melt Down! 

A fab group of Evolve employee's headed there today for lunch. Myself and a fellow fab coworker indulged in the Brie Melt Sliders (See my picture). Absolutely filling & deli-sh. The house made dipping sauce on the side wasn't necessary & the cheese definitely can stand alone here! My other fab co workers had the Honey Apple & I forget what the other one had but he still had to run to McDonald's for french fries because they served chips here. His recommendation would be to add fries to the menu and ensure the soup was hot - He had the Soup of the Day and it was luke warm (I double dipped!). 

Staff was overly friendly and accommodating! They must have stopped by 3-4 times asking if we needed anything (even to refill our bevy's!). Place was swarming with mainline mama's and their children so we quickly ate up and got out - Back to the grind!!

What a great idea to open this joint! Only disappointment was that I didn't think of this idea first for a restaurant!

Awesome. I went in just when it opens for dinner (5pm), just after an hour it's still not busy and my food came in pretty quick and hot! I was hesitant due to bad reviews but I was craving Japanese food and my food was great. Red snapper sashimi was too rubbery for me, so I liked their salmon sashimi better.

Omgosh! Very friendly, very clean! Food is . I will be a regular! My wife loved the grilled Tilapia! I am very.....VERY picky when it comes to diners. The bright atmosphere, and friendly staff makes the food taste even better. Treat Yourself!

The staff are really friendly and make wicked delicious la coulombe coffee drinks.  We go here at least once per week.  A cute area in back if you want to study or play with your baby while you guzzle your caffeine.  Outside seats are usually full and scums will beg for cash, cigarettes, etc while you sit out there but you're still lucky to find a seat esp on a weekend.
Really great food and wonderful service! Great atmosphere as well. The chicken and green tea waffles were an especially interesting and delicious infusion of southern and Vietnamese cuisine.
I live this place! You can order from an app and pick it up hassle free. Food is delicious!

Weird place with strange vibes BUT had to give them a solid review for great customer service.  My friend lost her Louis Vuitton purse and they found it and returned it! Everything is in was saved! And then my husband forgot his credit card and never closed his tab.. but when we went back the next day, they waited to charge us and were cool.  Nice nice staff!

I decided to give this Haggen location a chance. I walked into an mostly empty store. I notice some items that have been marked down in the deli due to product expiring the same day. I take it up to the register. The store manager was at the register. She refused to honor the discount on the packaging and said it was a mistake. Haggen, you can keep your expired food!

Nope, wanted donair, read the review, only 2.  Might as well try it.  3 workers, make 1 order, 1 order at the time, so 3 orders ahead of mine, leave 30min later, brutal.  Taste Ok, worst wrap job I've ever had.    Full of regret, just the facts.

Cute little bakery and café (patisserie) in the Garden district just south of The Grove and north of the Botanical Gardens. Inside decor is eclectic and quaint. Known for their macaroons, they also boast a coffee and tea bar to complement their delicious pastries (sweet and savory).  As it was near Thanksgiving, we had the tur-duck-en croissant accompanied by the French toast (bostock). Excellent choices.  The location shares a corner with three other excellent dining options.

Last night I was having a mean craving for some saucy Italian food.  I had been to Cafe Nino once before, several years ago, and really enjoyed it.  I hadn't been back because I usually make pasta at home. However, last night I returned to this adorable, cafeteria-style Italian restaurant.  

When I walked in the man who worked behind the counter greeted me with a huge smile, he was so excited to see me and was beyond helpful.  He described all the dishes and even let me taste test the very juicy Chicken Marsala before I made my final decision. I decided on the Veal Parmesan because I wanted something covered in marinara sauce, I absolutely love marinara sauce.  As a side I choose the beef lasagna, imagine my excitement when he told me that my options for sides were pizza or lasagna! The meal was topped of with a giant piece of bread that was toasted on the spot and another layer of marinara sauce, of course! 

Everything was so yummy!! My craving was totally satisfied! The Veal was tender and perfectly breaded; the sauce was a bit sweet and very savory.  The lasagna practically melted in my mouth and the bread! I had to tell my roommate that she was only allowed one more bite of the bread because she was trying to steal it from me.  Another fabulous part about Cafe Nino is the portions are huge! I had lunch for the next day and it was just as tasty. Not to mention how affordable it was!  I will definitely be making Cafe Nino a regular go-to spot from now on!

"Banh mi"- Vietnamese sandwich is the best. There are several type of sandwich you can choose to go with the same bread which also smell incredible and not not for your gum like any other places. Price is super reasonable too. Come try them out

Recently had a small celebration on their second floor. Our dining selections, craft beer, specialty cocktails and especially the attentive service were just perfect.  Shrimp scampi, short rib pizza, margarita pizza,  wings, sausage / broccoli rabe were all very good.  Great spot for a quick dinner for two or for very special gathering of many - Sam's can handle either well! We'll be back for sure.

I had visited Empress Tea Room a number of years ago at their old location for afternoon tea with a group of coworkers.  We chose the tea room because one of our number who had recently celebrated their birthday was originally from Britain.  A good time was had by all so I was initially excited when my book club suggested doing Sunday Brunch to discuss a book that had a strong plot element of the tea trade.  So far, so good.

And that's sort of where the good ended.  We met at 11 am and I was a little worried that it might be very crowded, but not to worry.  Three of our party were seated with our fourth on the way.  We weren't starving and had an ETA on our fourth so we ordered tea and chatted for a bit.  The tea was good, though one of our group asked for a different cup as her tea cup was chipped and the glaze on the inner surface was badly cracked and stained with tea.  At home, we probably would have shrugged and assumed it was clean enough, but dining out, when you have no idea how clean the cup is or who has used it before, it was a little off-putting.

Our fourth arrived and we got started on the brunch.  We started with a family-style serving of oatmeal, which was topped with brown sugar and excellent.  Our individual brunch plates arrived with bacon, sausage in a Grand Marnier glaze, roasted potatoes, fruit, bacon, a scone and the quiche of the day.  If that seems like a lot to fit on a plate, you have an idea how small the portions were to fit on that plate.  The potatoes, bacon, and fruit were good but nothing outstanding.  The scone required the clotted cream and jam provided and honestly our table could have used twice as much as provided.  The sausage, served as a single sausage coin of kielbasa, was probably the best thing on the plate.  And then there was the quiche...I have never seen a serving of quiche as tiny as this one was. It was about  1/2 the size of a playing card.   The flavor was good, but it was slightly on the cold side.  As we noshed, a family-style plate of waffles with whipped cream and fruit arrived.  Once again, good but not amazing.  

Our server was fairly attentive and provided a few refills on our water.  She seemed to be the only server for all six or so tables so I could forgive having to flag her down once or twice.  It says something about the food quality that the entire table was leaning towards "no thanks" when she asked if we wanted another serving of any of the items, as the brunch was all you could eat.  In the end, we each ordered one or two items as we were still very hungry from the very dainty portions.  The décor was spot on for a tea room ala small English town and the dining area was bright and cheery from a full wall of windows looking out on a courtyard.  I am not sure based on my brunch experience that I will be back, but I think for someone who loves tea or is looking more for the full experience than amazing food, this could be a nice place.

Finally! 

My husband and I have been looking for decent Indian food closer to home and this is it. Nice vegetarian options, and the spice level is exact what we asked for. Everything was fresh and full of flavor. We will be back!

I like this spot always quick and the servers are nice. I've never sat down inside and eaten as to I prefer to get carry out, but they are always courteous and prompt with my order. The inside is always full with people eating there buffet which all I hear is it is great. You can never go wrong with Super China Buffet

Did a 12 person brunch for Father's Day and I thought they did a great job. Their family style menu was perfect for the large table. We ordered chicken & waffles, Huevos rancheros and quiche. We were given more than enough food and also had monkey bread to start the meal. 
I thought serving it family style made it much better for a large group than everybody ordering their own meal. I didn't order a drink, but their Bloody Mary/Maria menu had everything you would want in a drink.

Came highly recommended so we drove from our hotel on the Riverwalk to check it out.  Definitely worth it.  Easy to park and just a very short line.  Great choices of both snowball flavors and other items too.  Extremely well staffed with assembly line-like speed.  Great prices as well - some of the snowball places downtown are charging $3 just for a plain small and this place is still within the norm.  Will be back!

POSITIVE:
+Great place to bring the kid when the weather is shitty
+Price is right
+Clean

NEGATIVE:
-Money traps by the front door.  Am I the only one with a son that quickly gets bored of the bouncy houses and wants me to spend cash on those little rides that just move back and forth?
-$2 for the hurricane simulator?  Seriously?
Have purchased several AGM batteries here, and they worked fine... have also used them for their lifetime watch battery service 3 times now and all went well!

Prince's Fences did what they said they would do and for the price they quoted. Doesn't get much better than that. Their crews were easy to work with and the fence they built us looks great. Chuck and Clint were honest about how things would go and very helpful.

I can say you first hand that Jennifer is absolutely wonderful!!! I am also a massage therapist and she addressed every muscle that needed care. She not only provided a very therapeutic massage but also relaxing. She is very attentive to her clients needs. I went in to her with severe neck pain and headache yesterday and feel great today. She's very passionate about what she does and that's obvious throughout her massage.
I was greeted on time and was pleased the  with service.just dissatisfied with the book an appointment with a credit card

This visit was just not good - others have been better. 
First the water came with a cucumber - without even asking.  Not everyone likes cucumber. 
After ordering we sat for 20 minutes and no one offered bread. 
My mushroom risotto was so bland.  I'm not that picky of an eater but this really had very little taste as if they left out an ingredient. My friend ordered the bolognese and it was so watery, there were chunks of cheese mixed in (not melted) and the meat was really chewy - he didn't eat it.  Even after we mentioned it to our server, they took his plate and said 'sorry' but never offered to take it off the bill!

u like dive bar s? u will love dirty f's this place is an absolute shit hole. everything is crooked, slanted, dirty or all the above. just looking at the bathroom u can contract a venereal disease. still it usually has a surprising mix of people which i like plus it is one of the few places where u can absolutely punish your liver into submission for 20 bucks. they have "specials" of shots of jim bean and a 7 0z beer for 2 or 3 bucks, $1 mugs of lager, college priced pitchers etc. every city needs fine establishment like dirty's.
The food is so good. I eat Vietnamese food all the time in Atlanta.  This place is fresh,  clean and just different.  Like eating at your OCD Grandma's house. I'm definitely coming back.
Very hesitant about trying new Thai places but decided to give this a try since it's so close to home. Pad Thai was delicious. Very friendly staff. Will be coming back!

When I need to get a gift for someone I care about, this is the first (and often only) place I stop. They always have a great selection of unique items, all made by local artists. Yes, I know I'll end up spending a little more here than I might at a bigger chain store, or if I really spent time hunting around online, but I like being able to wander in and be surprised by cool items that I never would have even thought to look for. Many times, I have some idea of what I might want to get, but end up with something different and even more perfect for the person I have in mind. I always know that my friends will love what I get them--the gifts I find here are always met with excitement, and I end up recommending the shop all the time since people always want to know where I found something so unique and perfect.

The shop has a warm vibe, and the ladies who own the shop are lovely. If you're in the area, I highly recommend stopping by and seeing what jumps out at you! They also have a great Instagram game if you want to make sure you keep up with their always-changing inventory.

This nail salon is awesome! My sister and I always try to go whenever she visits me.  They take their time, do a great job and always so friendly.  We also love it because we can take our little girls (3 & 5 yrs old) to get their nails done in the pink teddy bear chairs.  We've made some great memories and look forward for more to come!

Best authentic Mexican restaurant I have ever had the pleasure visiting.  Not fancy at all, but the food is terrific.  I love Mexican food and this place is awesome. The service was amazing, however English is definitely a second language. Great experience!!!!!!

The hotel was amazing and a perfect place to be when the temperature outside is between 97 and 100.  We loved the room, food, atmosphere and service.  One person who stood out was Roxie Mays who checked us in and got tickets for us for the Opry.  She went beyond and set the tone for an amazing stay. My husband was at a conference and said that throughout the entire conference, Neveen who was one of the servers was also excellent.

YUMMY! And fast, too. We don't often come here because they often have a long line. But when it snowed on Tuesday we had the place to ourselves and the service was fast & friendly, the sandwiches delicious!

The staff is so friendly. After my first visit, Willie remembered my friend and I and always comes and talks to us.  The food is amazing. The J spot might be the best burger I have ever had in my life. I had one yesterday and Im seriously considering going back again today. It's that good.

Love the food! I have always had impeccable service when Bo is my server.

 Everything takes a while there to have your patient pants on and enjoy the scenery / conversations. 

For some reason this is the place people go when they feel like they need to sit and have a 3 hour conversation to catch up... Aka, walk in expecting to wait for a table. 

It is worth the wait

I didn't manage to order anything here because the line was too long and my boyfriend lost patience. However, everything that I smelled was delicious and the place was packed. I would like to try this place next time. Until then!
Great place! Looks shady but the inside is really nice and the food is always fresh/great quality!

I have been here a few times and love the atmosphere. Everything is very fresh and it is just fun to go inside, walk around, and see all that they have to offer. 
They have a large selection of baked goods that always smell amazing! 
Their selection of fresh pasta is ample and I've had the spinach and cheese ravioli. The dough was so fresh and it was tasty. 
They have a fresh coffee section. I am not a coffee drinker but my boss loves this coffee so I go to pick some up for her. 
They have a wine and cheese room, along with a neat counter and a produce section. This would be a fun place to go shopping for a date night-get some fresh Italian food to whip up at home!
I am a fan of the egg sandwich, the cornbread casserole and the coffee cake. Friendly neighborhood breakfast spot.

I popped in last winter while I was looking for a dress for an event.  They didn't have exactly what I had in mind, but a good selection.  They arrange the store by sections:  Little Black Dress, Wedding Season, Date Night, Casual Saturdays, etc.  Makes it easy to shop if you are looking for something in particular.  

They were at a City Moms/Girl's Pint Out event in June and talked me about a Girl's Night Out.  You have the store from 7-9 to shop with your friends.  As a mom to a toddler, this is perfect, hubby knows how long to expect me to be gone.  Going from store to store isn't my thing anymore.  One stop shopping with my friends and fantastic prices.  I picked up some dresses and accessories.  

Emily the owner was there and she is great.  Knowledgeable on her styles and products and very friendly.  Pop in and check out their selection.

Such a fun place to grab a taco and/or beer in Nashville! We were looking for a moderately-priced, casual-yet-trendy, delicious place for dinner and we found it in Cerveza Jacks! Great live music to add to the already hip atmosphere :)

Food is awesome and service is great! BYO keeps the prices reasonable - downside is sometimes folks stay longer to finish their wine/beer - which could delay your reservation time. 

Duck fries are a MUST!

I've been here about 3 times. I never go when I want a huge change--usually just a trim or to get my bangs cut. The prices are pretty cheap ($23 for shampoo, haircut, & blowdry). They have open hours every day and are open late on Friday/Saturday. I've had to wait up to 15 minutes before when they were pretty full. One of the girls who works here, Erin,is actually really, really good. She helped me out when I got sick of my super short haircut and was considering extensions. I ask for her specifically whenever I go.

Overall, though, I only come here when I'm having a hair emergency and need a trim.

was in this location today at 4:40. I ordered two (2) angus bacon and cheese burgers. I asked for no onions which I got nothing but the cheese, pickles, bacon and meat on one and NO bacon on the other as well as the lettuce and tomatos on either. I feel completely ripped off. I also tried to order a sweet tea which the girl at the counter told me they had no ice.. Now this is the 3rd time I've been told that by this location, that is completely ridiculous. You serve drinks you should have ice. This location is a very poor excuse for a restaurant! 
If I could give this place a ZERO star I would.

Came for a late Sunday lunch. Got a booth by the huge open air wall-window with my son. Friendly attentive staff. Nice selection of booze and drinks (but I had iced tea.)  Stylish decor. The meal was good, but not great. I'd happily come back just for the cool vibe and keep my meal expectations in check.

Stopped here for some fresh oysters and Seafood Gumbo, "THE BEST"!!!
If you're in town and want some good food this is the place.
Service was out standing! I loved there small sidewalk cafe. We shared some small plates among the three of us. They had several vegetarian options as well. Oh and you MUST try the home made pasta!

It was a long wait, but totally worth it. $10 cash gets you a ton of delicious food. 

Don't go if you're picky. He'll give you whatever he's making that day and that's it.  Today I got a couple falafels, sweet grilled chicken, a hunk of bread a scoop of diced fruit, some sort of chickpea/hummus stuff, spicy rice, and another sauce I don't know what it was because I suck at food but it was delicious.

DO go if you think you'll be amused by whatever rant he has picked out for the day. Today I received a rant about how he makes special food that will make your hurts go away and some people don't understand how unique and special his food is, and if they want other food they can go somewhere else in the city. I was amused.

It wasn't very crowded on a Friday evening, so I was able to sit at a high top with family. We ordered the tilapia special with orzo, and the special burrito. The entrees and nacho app were nothing to really phone home about, but their donuts are amazing. It doesn't hurt that there is also a bar inside. Decor is nice, and the waitstaff were polite and friendly.
Service is slow, salsa is yummy, and happy hour specials are just drinks.  No free chips & salsa or discounted food. :(

I initially heard about The Beauty Parlour from friends. Every time they went to this salon they'd come back with gorgeous haircuts & colours. After one particularly bad haircut, I decided to try out the Parlour.
According to their website, The BP believes in beauty with a conscience. They offer ammonia-free colour services with little or no scent properties or chemical emanation. They also stock Kevin Murphy products, of which I am a fan. 
Anyways, after walking up the stairs  to their 2nd floor location (note:no elevators) I immediately feel comfortable in their spacious, tranquil salon. I feel relaxed here, and I enjoy the vintage-y ambiance created by their reclaimed furnishings and wood flooring. It's also got high windows with views of Whyte Ave.
The friendly receptionist usually offers wine (!), coffee, green tea, or juice.While waiting for my stylist Alysha, I check out their mini-boutique. Clothing from local designer Cinder+Smoke and jewelry from local artist Plum Tipsy are among the fun products they stock.
I always get my hair done by Alysha. She listens as I attempt to describe what i want, and my hair turns out gorgeous every time. She cuts with precision and doesn't use the razor much to texture my coarse,thick hair.
I highly recommend Alysha!
Because I have short hair, I am charged for a men's cut ($60), so it's very reasonable, in my opinion, for an exceptional salon.  Also, you get 5% off if you pay with cash!
I love this place, it's a high quality salon experience without pretention.

I've been to several buffets in Reno, and-not including Sterling's, which has the best Sunday brunch around-The Buffet in the El Dorado is the best.  Their dining area is large, so you are more likely to be seated away from smokers than in other buffets.  Their selection of food is also larger than other Reno locations.  The food is great!  Some selections of food can be kind of blah, but for the most part they are good.  

Not sure why, but one time we waited forever to be seated!  The line was super super super long!  Everyone was trying to get in to eat!  Luckily this was the case only once when we've visited.

nice people, pleasant and clean space. Very minimal, no changing room (you change in the treatment room). Reasonable prices.

Massage was a good massage, sorry I forgot my masseur's name. If I return to Philly I will probably come back here.

Woohoo first review! Sadly, this will be a review for the crappiest place I ate at in Reno.

I wasn't expecting much from a casino, but somehow my hopes went up when I saw that the two chefs in the Asian part of the restaurant were actually...Asian! There is a wide selection of dishes that actually can't be found at any other Chinese fast food place. Props for that. The whole restaurant itself also has American food and I believe Mexican, but I don't quite remember.

Anyway, back to the food. All of the ingredients are already prepared and are out for the chefs to use, sort of like at Subway. One guy puts it all together, and the other cooks it. I ordered the Cashew & Almond Chicken, which also had some vegetables with it and came with some rice. The first chef put everything together and gave it to another guy to cook. However, he threw it in the wok, let it warm up for 30 seconds, and thew it on the plate. I was expecting some actual cooking. Maybe some soy sauce? Garlic? Any spices? Nope, nothing.

After trying the dish, I almost didn't want to eat it anymore, but I had no choice. The nuts were plentiful, which I enjoyed *that's what she said*. However, the whole dish was just ridiculously bland and tasteless. There actually wasn't that much chicken and the vegetables consisted a large portion of the dish.

A cheap place on the bottom floor of a Reno casino. I didn't expect much in the first place, but any restaurant can do better, especially this one.

Everyone must try the sauce and meatballs! Life changing! The Stl personalized historical rendition of the cathedral ceiling is intriguing. Makes me want to learn about all the famous people that came from Stl.

My hubby was craving wings. We pass here often and decided to give it a try. I tried calling 4 times to preorder, but there was no answer. We got there and were greeted by a mumbling cashier. I had to have her repeat what she was saying with each new statement. I ordered a small boneless wing combo plain, with sauce on the side. My hubby ordered a medium traditional with the sauce on the side. All the tables, except for a small one were filthy. A guy halfway bussed one table, so we sat at the only clean small table near thr front window. It was miserably cold!  We waited 17 minutes for our order, which was packed to go, even though we said we were dining in.  We, however, were happy to take it to go because it was miserable to sit there and shiver. Once we got home, (less than 2 miles away) the fries were barely warm. My husband's wings were partly covered with sauce (since when does plain mean cover some with sauce, if you want.  My boneless wings also had some covered and some plain. The fries have some fake barbecue tasting seasoning on them that ruins a perfectly good, partly warm French fry. Another establishment I won't be frequenting!

This place is so convenient to home, great reclining seats and priced reasonably, BUT .... SERIOUSLY NEEDS A DEEP CLEANING .... .... the smell was so stale and had such a "dirty" atmosphere..I couldn't wait to get home to shower and take my clothes off and throw into the wash right away. I had to put my phone light on before the movie started because I dropped something while in my seat and BOY WAS I SORRY .... the food and dirt between the seats and on the floor was incredible... I felt so grossed out the entire time I watched the movie that I couldn't enjoy it .... unfortunately I couldn't change my seat as the seats are assigned but I don't think that would have been any better either....I would not order anything to eat because I saw a roach scurry down the hall between theaters ..... I do know they were sited for DIRTY DINING at one point a while back ... this totally validated it .......The bartender's blouse was so open and low-cut and she kept adjusting it to make sure her tits were showing enough .... she should have been serving next door at the club .... my 11 year old commented on that to me ....That's not right when kids see the help like that in a movie theater . SHAME on the management. I definitely would have demanded a REFUND if it weren't for my father in law paying for a large family group of us to go see Wonder Woman ... the kids were really looking forward to seeing it .... I can tell you I will not be back there .... such a shame because it's not hard to KEEP THE PLACE CLEAN ...I understand there's going to be "some" dirt but this was quite ridiculous... Sorry to leave a bad review but couldn't help but to do so ..... PLEASE CLEAN UP ...

I was referred to Enterprise Car Sales by a coworker. She get me in touch with Breanna specifically who was fantastic. They found me exactly what I was looking for in a lightly used vehicle to replace my aging car. I was able to get a 2015 Ford Focus with low miles and all the new features I was looking for.  I could not be happier. Lauren in the finance department worked for hours to find me the right financing as well.  Thank you guys so much for your help! I will definitely be recommending your services to my friends!

This is the place.  Coming from El Paso, TX we have nothing like this place!!!  I love it. Americana dining.  Had the liver and onions. Delicious. Can't find this food any other place.  The service was great.  Kathy our waitress came over and chatted with us and sat down for a couple of minutes to tell us about her grand kids. Delightful !!!  Met the manager from Greece. Reasonable price.  Now I want to come back for breakfast.

I often stop by Smith's after work as it's very close. The drinks are good and the food is always impressive. They've got some delicious guacamole too! The service is always friendly and usually pretty speedy and I always meet great people here.

The drinks can be a little pricey, but they've got a great variety. They also have many TV's so you can usually watch whatever game you're looking for.

The reason I docked a few stars was because it can get really packed for being such a small place and when that happens it's not very enjoyable. Along with that, they used to have an awesome special for Phillies games ($1 hotdogs and $2 Yuenglings)- I loved the dollar dogs and told a bunch of my friends about their promotion (they would do it every night there was a Phillies game) until one night in the middle of the season where they just decided they were no longer doing it. About a week after I told everyone about it. Kind of odd to take something like that away.

Aside from no longer having any unique specials and crowds, the drinks are good and the service is good- stop by if you're in the area!

I'm from Chicago and love pizza. Was visiting Cherry Hill and went to Leo Tucci's for dinner. Leo is great and his pizza is even better. Such a nice, family owned restaurant with good food. Highly recommend.

I'm not sure how I missed this place when I started working in the neighborhood a year ago.  I usually bring my lunch to work (mainly because there are so few decent places to eat in the area). The times I don't have my lunch can be traumatic because the options are limited and pretty terrible (unless you like Cosi or paying way too much at Red Owl Tavern).  Had a well constructed salad - fresh and not drowning in dressing - that I was able to order online and pick up within 15 minutes.  With a great lunchtime take out option like this, I will definitely be okay coming to work lunchless.  

Should note that the only reason I didn't give them 5 stars was their website wasn't super current and I ordered a salad option that wasn't on their current menu.  That said, they still made it for me and it was delicious.

Never buy appliances from Best Buy. We had what began as a pleasant experience with the sales staff at the store, only to have our appliance deliveries delayed multiple times. 
Our fridge took a week to arrive, and was 2 days later than expected because "well it is in the warehouse but it didn't make it to the loading dock on time."  It then had a manufacturer defect which they said they would send a replacement part for. On the scheduled delivery day they said "oh we never ordered the replacement part, we don't know if it can be ordered."  They refused to take our water line back (which they didn't need and were supposed to take back) and said we had to take it ourselves in store.  Now our dryer doesn't come until September 22nd and I doubt it will arrive on time. 
Nice sales staff, terrible delivery execution.  My parents fridge broke and they bought one from Home Depot.  They had it the next day. Do not buy appliances from Best Buy.

Please do not waste your money.
You get exactly less than what you pay for.
Horrible service.
Rude employee
Messed up order without an apology or refund.
Nasty unscrambled eggs on top of one slice of cheese, hard bagel without butter and wrong meat.
Never again!

Linda catered a bridal shower that I recently planned at The Little Red Schoolhouse in Mickleton, NJ. She had been very professional and was accommodating to our needs as we wanted a tea party themed shower. Our bride really enjoyed the seafood salad rolls and the presentation was very nice.

My only issue is that we had discussed the menu and the fact that we had a few vegetarians. I was disappointing to see after the girl came to set up that there were no grilled veggie wraps.  Our vegetarians only had the option of fruit salad and Caesar salad without the chicken (both good, but not very filling). 

Again, the food was good and presented very nicely however I was disappointing that a critical element was missing from the selection. Price was right for each person as well. I would suggest using her again.

The food was fantastic! But the service was not so great. Our server disappeared halfway through our meal. I told our server it was my boyfriends birthday when we arrived, and he said he would make it special for him, but we never saw him again. The food was great though, I highly recommend the skillet tacos and natural margarita!
The price is right! The cafe has a surprisingly amazing chef and the food is amazing!  Brian, the waiter, is charming, funny and right on with his suggestions! Rooms are spacious, clean and bright!

I'm just not a primanti guy, I dont want mushy fries on my sandwich, takes away the flavor of the good enough meat on my sandwich....it's ok for some just not me.  I hit the one in downtown Pittsburgh before a cubs/pirates game.  Service was pub comparable and nice enough, just not my gig food wise..

We were visiting a friend and he brought us here.
When we arrived, it was closed and the owner was outside and he OPENED up just for us. We couldn't believe it. And the food was sensational. Top Class

Nice spot. Has outdoor seating. Food was great. Had the hungry man's skillet and my girlfriend had the French toast, eggs and sausage links. With our meals and 2 OJs our bill came out to $25. Great price in my opinion. Food was amazing and her sausage links looked like they were on steroids lol. Definitely recommend!
Pretty good street food, very small tacos, so order several!

Everything is great about panda. I normally used to give 4 stars but Im taking one off since they took forever to serve the food for me. I was the only person at that time standing in line to order, the girl said she will be back in a sec but she turned up after 2-3 min and by that time the queue grew to 10 people.

Fabulous food and service neatly wrapped up in to a wonderful atmospheric package. Loved the place. And for people who are just  trying the  seasons and scents of creole and Cajun delights.... Options to ease into it and leave you wanting more we're abounding here at Mr B's Bistro. This was a recommendation from a local couple we met the night before at the carousel bar in the hotel Monteleone (another must visit).  Glad we listened.  We tried the Gumbo Ya Ya and YA it was YUM.  Then the beer battered, coconut shrimp... Delish!  Then for my sister it was a burger since she's not really a seafood fan. Huge portion and a juicy mouthwatering meat patty on a brioche bun. Yum and Done! Lastly, my Shrimp angel hair pasta was very good. A little too safe for me and I will branch further next trip. Some Cajun seasoning on the shrimp and rich herb and buttered angel hair cooked to perfection.  It was very good but if you want to get the full experience opt for something more authentic. I will and will do it next time I visit by coming back to Mr. B's Bistro... 
 OH and did I say how wonderful the wait staff was. Three amazing gents took great care of us. Wish I wasn't so distracted by my food to remember there names. But there is a picture of me with a couple of them... Thank you kind Sirs. You made our lunch just perfect.

We had a reservation for 24 hours a week or more in advance, but the morning on the day before our reservation, we got a notification that our reservation was changed to 20 hours, which threw off everything completely because we needed those 4 hours the next day to move in in the morning. We called UHaul and the representatives basically told us to suck it, and that reserving out time that you already had reserved to other people were essentially their business practice. Instead of trying to accommodate us, they just told us they could cancel our reservation or just charge us double for the late fee.

Best grilled oysters in the city, hands down. The Sunday brunch is delightful, especially the lemon zest pancakes. 

Great for outdoor seating. A little pricy for a neighborhood spot, but really tasty. 

Sometimes the service is terrible, especially when they're busy.
Ordered Pad Thai, pineapple chicken and an order of wings as takeout..... yummy yummy yum! Next time I plan to dine in- it's very casual and chill inside

OVER-RATED.  We got there early so thankfully the waitress "let" us take our time making a selection.  They have a poor sushi selection and what we had was not great - the sumo roll. Salad and soup were lacking and not worth the space in my stomach. The steak was surprisingly tender but everything was so over-buttered and over-peppered I could barely taste it.  I was happy I didn't take my 4 year old who loves the Hibachi experience because she would have protested the pepper. I almost went for the green tea ice cream but decided not to add insult to injury to our already overpriced unauthentic experience with their self important waitstaff.  If you're looking for a good sushi plus Hibachi experience go to Hibachi in Devon.
Nice place, especially the Tiki Bar. Very good pork tacos, good Margaritas and Tequilas. Really, one of the best joints in Fountain Square
GREAT place! Fun atmosphere, super nice wait staff, delicious food. Grouper sandwich was HUGE and yummy. Definitely worth a visit.

I bought my first car from carmax today and couldn't be more happy with my experience. Through some crazy events, I ended up working with four sales people who I thought were all amazing. Matt, Mike, Rachel and Eddie were all so helpful and nice that I would recommend them to anyone. The team worked together to get me exactly what I wanted and were so patient with me as a first time (probably annoying) buyer. From there, the people in the business office were friendly, patient and funny as I waited on hold with the bank and signed paperwork (Samantha and Iris made even this part tolerable) I can't say thank you enough! I love my bright blue Ford escape, thanks guys!!

First of all let's talk for a second about how awesome it is that you can rate a mobile restaurant, because the reality is, it could be ANYWHERE and it would be awesome.

Second the food truck is one of the greatest idea's man has ever had right behind electricity, the light bulb, and adding bacon to anything.  So 4th place is pretty good.

Cha Cha Chow pulled up to my office today, excitement and my mouth water almost overwhelmed me.

I walked down and ordered the fish tacos.  First of all ordering anything through a window increases the appeal of it.  Then probably the second best fish tacos I've had in St. Louis show up on some corn tortillas with some fresh slaw and delicious sauce.  2 in a basket, but I probably could have eaten 15.  They also had this delicious berry drink in tub in front of the truck which I also got and I highly recommend.

Let's recap.  Food truck, one of man's greatest ideas.  Cha Cha chow, epic fish tacos.  Mobile eats, can't beat it!
As good as it gets as far as "normal" movie theaters in this area. The recliners are extremely comfortable, and there's a full bar as well. I never go to another theater if I can help it.
Quick eat burritos served with fresh veggies. All good.

Great service! Nice atmosphere. Excellent food in a casual setting. We started with the rabbit pate with pickles and toast. I especially enjoyed the chopped beet and watermelon rind pickles. I had the fried oyster salad w/ bacon and avocado w/ a cup of seafood gumbo. Both were great. Husband had duck 2 ways. I was surprised that the food was light. Excellent!

I'm a regular, but I agree with those that have complained about nails chipping within hours and days of receiving service and their occasional poor customer service. In my experience people whisper and snicker and seemingly talk about the customers in Vietnamese/ Mandarin.

This is always my favorite honky tonk for the unique music selection.  Was in on a recent Friday night with an out of town friend.  I hadn't been there since they added the second story addition, which helps with crowds on a busy night.  The band featured a female lead and she was a total bad a$$, we enjoyed singing, dancing, and drinking along.

There seemed to be a shortage of waitresses tonight!! I think the owner or his wife waited on me and was very stressed. Otherwise I had a fantastic dinner of Pad something or other. The Jasmine rice tasted like good old white rice. My pad noodles with beef however was superb!!! The decor and presentation and taste makes this place a winner!!!
Being Polish and growing up on Polish food, I can say that Czerw's is the best. The skin is not tough tough and the meat of not full of fat. I recommend the hot Keilbasy on the grill..

Stopped here since Cowbell is closed on Mondays. The food was good but the wait for eggs and bacons seemed out of proportion. Especially considering they were not that busy. And it was expensive. Two breakfasts with coffee for $30?? And it wasn't anything fancy. I had three eggs over easy and bacon. 

The wait staff was super nice!! Definitely recommend for a bite as long as you're not in a rush.

In my opinion, the best pizza in UC. It's a little on the pricey side - 2 slices and a Coke will run you about $7. Still, this has been my quick on-the-go-dinner spot for a while, and is always good for a laid-back time, eating pizza and watching TV.

Loved the Santa Fe quesadilla! Too big for one so I had leftovers. Good food and great service! Have returned in our travels a few times to try other items on the menu, and they have been delicious, too.

Do you want the BEST Thai in the city? Do you want the best Thai in the state?? This is your place. I've eaten everything on the menu, in varying degrees of spiciness, and I have not had one, single, bad, dish. NOT ONE!! This place is simple, basic, BUSY, and the owners really care about the food they serve. I mean, the man has a masters degree in nutrition from Cornell. CORNELL!! Seriously, how do you knock a restaurant that grows their own herbs? And the ginger/lemongrass tea will blow you away, hot OR cold. Run, don't walk, to get to this place, but get there EARLY. If you don't, you'll be waiting in line for a while.

Vinnie (the owner) is the best - he usually remembers your name.  :)  There is always a waiting line to get in when they open around 11.  My only complaint would be that I wish the place where bigger!  My personal favorite sandwich is the Veno but the chcago style dogs are so good too!!!

So glad we tried Dawn Patrol for an early breakfast. I came to SB with my sister to visit my daughter... this was a great start to our day. Friendly greeting as we entered, and prompt service. We ordered at the counter then experienced attentive staff after we took a seat at a table of our choice. Cool, current beachy decor. All our food was delicious (between the three of us we had the Build a Hash, 3 Egg White Frittata, and the House Cured Salmon, each having the fresh squeezed orange juice, too). I cannot wait to return when I get a chance to come to SB again... I wish we had something like this where I live.

Location is tucked away so it takes a bit to find if you are not familiar with the area, but we had the address so we knew where to look.

Went to The Good Pie before catching a show at The Fox, so we arrived around 6pm.  The dining room was semi-crowded, but the three of us were seated quickly.  Unfortunately, since this is a popular place, the table placed is cramped, making moving around a bit of a chore.
