The on-tap beer selection was good...especially if you like heavier or more hoppy beers.  For lighter beer drinkers, there was not much of a selection, but they also have wine (though I did not see a wine list).  It appears that the beer list changes frequently, so you'll just have to see what's on tap when you get there.

The service was efficient when we sat down, but waned over the course of the meal.  By the time we wanted to pay, it was hard to track down our waitress...at the next table over, the gentleman ended up getting up and tracking down his waitress so he could pay his bill.

Now onto the food.  We started with the Caesar Salad with anchovies.  The salad was delicious, not overdressed, with nice fresh romaine.  The salad came with three anchovies, which definitely enhanced the salad for me...but were three anchovies really worth and extra $1.50???

The pizza came out not long after we finished our salads.  We split a prosciutto bianca, which was described on the menu as fresh mozzarella, prosciutto di parma, and arugula.  The server promptly said that they were out of arugula and would discount the cost for us...but we wanted a little more than just the cheese and prosciutto, so we asked if they could substitute basil for the arugula...and she happily agreed.  The pizza crust was chewy and soft at the same time (the closest I've come to the NJ style pizza I grew up with), but appeared that it could have used a little more time in the oven to get to the perfect "doneness".  The toppings worked well together, though the prosciutto di parma was a little difficult to cut with the pizza slicer.  Overall though, the pizza was very good...especially with a small sprinkling of crushed red pepper.

The Good Pie was a fun and good restaurant to go to...is it my favorite...not yet.  I think they need to get through the growing pains of becoming a popular St. Louis spot (more customers....more food ordered...and only one pizza oven), and then I'll be back.

Since I was a child I've been visiting after hours pediatrics. They have always shown great professionalism and kindness to my family and now my children. I have never had any issues with transparency with the staff, wait times or anything else.
Excellent food - Chicharrone's are off the chain! Staff is amazing, especially BJ! Must stop in when at Armature Works!

I've been struggling to find a Dentist that doesn't feel like 'high pressured sales'. Gulch Dental Studio made me feel comfortable from the moment I walked through the door. Thoughtfully explained areas for improvement and options in a non intrusive way.

Went back to get a specific cigar that I like and the boxes were empty. Couple girls in there went out of their way to go in back and open new boxes so I could have some. One also recommended another brand that I have tried and liked as well.  I will be back!
Are you serious the burgers are the size of a half dollar .Come on give people what they pay for .i wont even waste any more time writing .

With a Peruvian friend who rated this authentic. Enjoyed the perfectly fried fish and seafood (Jalea) plate with a tasty yellow sauce. Free chips came with a wonderful green sauce which we had to ask for more. Great flavors here.

Very cool bar not too far from the train.  Good beer selection, a beautiful outdoor deck, decent food  and lots of bar games.  It seems like a good neighborhood bar.  I've had fun both times I've been there (it's not in my neighborhood).   If I'm in the area again I would definitely stop by.

Pretty good Irish pub, There wasn't too much Irish food available, but what I ate was pretty good.  I had a salad with candied nuts, grapes, strawberries, and chicken.  The chicken was spiced well, everything paired well.  I would have liked the salad a bit larger, but it wasn't bad at all.

The fries were terrific.  Large enough to have a soft interior surrounded by a crisp exterior.  Well cooked.

Moscow Mules were good, well made.  The second round that we ordered didn't come in a copper mug and was significantly smaller due to the glass.  Good enough to come back to, check it out if you're in the area.
I have eaten here with my parents while staying at the nugget across the street at least 3 times. The service is great and their bean and cheese burrito is probably the best burrito ever.
Great tour. Captain Bishop was very informative, funny, and entertaining. We got to see a lot of alligators and other wildlife. The scenery was beautiful. I would definitely do this tour again.

Changed my conception of what a donut can be. We got five different donuts, ginger lemon, sugared, brownie, strawberry, and banana cream. I tried them in that order and each was more amazing than the last. I almost passed on the banana cream because the "cream" that most places use tends to be pretty gross. This donut, however, was filled with real cream flavored with the essence of about a thousand ripe, delicious bananas. If this donut somehow became a human, I would turn it back into a donut because its deliciousness is greater than the inherent value of human life.
We also got two breakfast biscuits, fried chicken, and bacon and egg. The biscuits are fantastic. The fried chicken was perfect and the "miso gravy", which sounded iffy, was great. Espresso was good too.

This place has the best wings I have ever eaten in the entirety of my existence. The wings are huge. The Wings Are Juicy. The wings are crispy. The wings are Sauced perfectly.  I know I had a delicious Burger there but I can barely remember what it tasted like because the wings blew my mind.  This is no overstatement. One of my friends had the ribs and allowed me to taste them and they are amazing as well.

I know I'm one of the few who seem to have had a bad experience at Rescue, but I left Rescue tonight with such a bad taste in my mouth that I will never return.  

I booked a 60 minute prenatal massage that I was very excited about, and would cost $100.  When I got to rescue 10 minutes before my appointment, I was told that they were running 5 minutes late.  no biggie.  25 minutes after my scheduled appointment time, and still waiting to be taken back I told the manager that I no longer had time for a one hour massage.  She kindly apologized and offered to give me a half hour massage at a discounted price.   That seemed reasonably fair.  I was finally taken back for my massage over half an hour late.  The massage was decent, however, once my shortened massage was over and I went to pay, i found out that they charged me $65 for my "discounted" half hour massage.  When I expressed my displeasure, the manager informed me that that's what a half hour massage costs.  After pleading with them that I didn't book a half hour massage and that it was their fault they were running over a half an hour late, she begrudgingly agreed to charge me $50.  Still, barely a discount seeing as the hour would have cost me $100.  

If they had any decent business sense they would have charged $40, or given me an incentive to return for a full hour long massage.  They did neither.  My gripe with rescue is solely based on their customer service and has nothing to do with the quality of the massage.

Came here first for breakfast and had their yummy grits and shrimp dish, which had 2 fried eggs on TOP. Loved it but couldn't finish it it was so huge. Came back for dinner and had delicious steamed mussels. They were not the largest mussels I've had, but I loved the sauce and they accommodated my request for extra garlic, yum! The service was excellent. We were seated in the back room near the kitchen which I would recommend as it is a tad quieter.  The only disappointing item I ordered was an old fashion cocktail, wasn't very good, but wouldn't stop me from coming back for the food.

Food was good. I had a decent breakfast but nothing to write home about. Other dish at the table had great flavor -the lamb burger but it was very small...maybe a 3oz patty cooked which isn't bad, in fact a welcome change to a gigantic burger, but it was 12 bucks. Come on....
Way too much hype around this place that should have told me to steer clear. I doubt I'll be back soon but perhaps when it comes back to earth. It was fun hanging out waiting for the table...quality people watching. Service was good and staff was very nice.

It's cool that Second Image is trying. They sort of have a vintage section now, even though at the best it looks like something scavenged from Squaresville's dumpster. The clothing selection is a little lacking, but I've found a few gems in terms of housewares and books. The dressing rooms are kind of terrifying, but maybe that's just a thrift store requirement. All in all, Second Image is okay by me.

Best shrimp on the beach!  Steamed to order, deveined (which very few others do), and served with melted butter as well as your basic cocktail sauce.   Plump, juicy, and briny sweet.  Well worth waiting a few extra minutes for.  Also had the grouper tacos - two nice, big, portions of grouper prepared simply so you can actually taste the fish.  Fresh, crunchy coleslaw in a light dressing.  The atmosphere is very casual, but cheerful; you order at the bar, pick your food up, and clear your own table.  But that keeps prices down, and you don't have to worry about dressing for dinner!  The owner is friendly, and has smartly chosen to start off with a small menu and do things right.  Great addition to the local scene.

The hotel is very nice and clean, and looks fairly new. They have a great staff, so friendly, professional, and efficient at what they do. I enjoyed my stay so much more because of how clean the rooms were and the great service I had wherever I went!
